chapters.en: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
chapters.zh: 起初，上帝创造天地。

chapters.en: Now the earth was formless and void, and darkness was over the surface of the deep. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters.
chapters.zh: 地是空虚混沌，渊面黑暗；上帝的灵运行在水面上。

chapters.en: And God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
chapters.zh: 上帝说：「要有光」，就有了光。

chapters.en: And God saw that the light was good, and He separated the light from the darkness.
chapters.zh: 上帝看光是好的，就把光暗分开了。

chapters.en:
God called the light “day,” and the darkness He called “night.”
And there was evening, and there was morning—the first day.
chapters.zh: 上帝称光为「昼」，称暗为「夜」。有晚上，有早晨，这是头一日。

chapters.en: And God said, “Let there be an expanse between the waters, to separate the waters from the waters.”
chapters.zh: 上帝说：「诸水之间要有空气，将水分为上下。」

chapters.en: So God made the expanse and separated the waters beneath it from the waters above. And it was so.
chapters.zh: 上帝就造出空气，将空气以下的水、空气以上的水分开了。事就这样成了。

chapters.en:
God called the expanse “sky.”
And there was evening, and there was morning—the second day.
chapters.zh: 上帝称空气为「天」。有晚上，有早晨，是第二日。

chapters.en: And God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered into one place, so that the dry land may appear.” And it was so.
chapters.zh: 上帝说：「天下的水要聚在一处，使旱地露出来。」事就这样成了。

chapters.en: God called the dry land “earth,” and the gathering of waters He called “seas.” And God saw that it was good.
chapters.zh: 上帝称旱地为「地」，称水的聚处为「海」。上帝看着是好的。

chapters.en: Then God said, “Let the earth bring forth vegetation: seed-bearing plants and fruit trees, each bearing fruit with seed according to its kind.” And it was so.
chapters.zh: 上帝说：「地要发生青草和结种子的菜蔬，并结果子的树木，各从其类，果子都包着核。」事就这样成了。

chapters.en: The earth produced vegetation: seed-bearing plants according to their kinds and trees bearing fruit with seed according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.
chapters.zh: 于是地发生了青草和结种子的菜蔬，各从其类；并结果子的树木，各从其类；果子都包着核。上帝看着是好的。

chapters.en: And there was evening, and there was morning—the third day.
chapters.zh: 有晚上，有早晨，是第三日。

chapters.en: And God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to distinguish between the day and the night, and let them be signs to mark the seasons and days and years.
chapters.zh: 上帝说：「天上要有光体，可以分昼夜，作记号，定节令、日子、年岁，

chapters.en: And let them serve as lights in the expanse of the sky to shine upon the earth.” And it was so.
chapters.zh: 并要发光在天空，普照在地上。」事就这样成了。

chapters.en: God made two great lights: the greater light to rule the day and the lesser light to rule the night. And He made the stars as well.
chapters.zh: 于是上帝造了两个大光，大的管昼，小的管夜，又〔造〕众星，

chapters.en: God set these lights in the expanse of the sky to shine upon the earth,
chapters.zh: 就把这些光摆列在天空，普照在地上，

chapters.en: to preside over the day and the night, and to separate the light from the darkness. And God saw that it was good.
chapters.zh: 管理昼夜，分别明暗。上帝看着是好的。

chapters.en: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fourth day.
chapters.zh: 有晚上，有早晨，是第四日。

chapters.en: And God said, “Let the waters teem with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”
chapters.zh: 上帝说：「水要多多滋生有生命的物；要有雀鸟飞在地面以上，天空之中。」

chapters.en: So God created the great sea creatures and every living thing that moves, with which the waters teemed according to their kinds, and every winged bird after its kind. And God saw that it was good.
chapters.zh: 上帝就造出大鱼和水中所滋生各样有生命的动物，各从其类；又造出各样飞鸟，各从其类。上帝看着是好的。

chapters.en: Then God blessed them and said, “Be fruitful and multiply and fill the waters of the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”
chapters.zh: 上帝就赐福给这一切，说：「滋生繁多，充满海中的水；雀鸟也要多生在地上。」

chapters.en: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fifth day.
chapters.zh: 有晚上，有早晨，是第五日。

chapters.en: And God said, “Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kinds: livestock, land crawlers, and beasts of the earth according to their kinds.” And it was so.
chapters.zh: 上帝说：「地要生出活物来，各从其类；牲畜、昆虫、野兽，各从其类。」事就这样成了。

chapters.en: God made the beasts of the earth according to their kinds, the livestock according to their kinds, and everything that crawls upon the earth according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.
chapters.zh: 于是上帝造出野兽，各从其类；牲畜，各从其类；地上一切昆虫，各从其类。上帝看着是好的。

chapters.en: Then God said, “Let Us make man in Our image, after Our likeness, to rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air, over the livestock, and over all the earth itself and every creature that crawls upon it.”
chapters.zh: 上帝说：「我们要照着我们的形像、按着我们的样式造人，使他们管理海里的鱼、空中的鸟、地上的牲畜，和全地，并地上所爬的一切昆虫。」

chapters.en:
So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him;
male and female He created them.
chapters.zh: 上帝就照着自己的形像造人，乃是照着他的形像造男造女。

chapters.en: God blessed them and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it; rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth.”
chapters.zh: 上帝就赐福给他们，又对他们说：「要生养众多，遍满地面，治理这地，也要管理海里的鱼、空中的鸟，和地上各样行动的活物。」

chapters.en: Then God said, “Behold, I have given you every seed-bearing plant on the face of all the earth, and every tree whose fruit contains seed. They will be yours for food.
chapters.zh: 上帝说：「看哪，我将遍地上一切结种子的菜蔬和一切树上所结有核的果子全赐给你们作食物。

chapters.en: And to every beast of the earth and every bird of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth—everything that has the breath of life in it—I have given every green plant for food.” And it was so.
chapters.zh: 至于地上的走兽和空中的飞鸟，并各样爬在地上有生命的物，〔我将〕青草〔赐给〕牠们作食物。」事就这样成了。

chapters.en:
And God looked upon all that He had made, and indeed, it was very good.
And there was evening, and there was morning—the sixth day.
chapters.zh: 上帝看着一切所造的都甚好。有晚上，有早晨，是第六日。

chapters.en: Thus the heavens and the earth were completed in all their vast array.
chapters.zh: 天地万物都造齐了。

chapters.en: And by the seventh day God had finished the work He had been doing; so on that day He rested from all His work.
chapters.zh: 到第七日，上帝造物的工已经完毕，就在第七日歇了他一切的工，安息了。

chapters.en: Then God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it, because on that day He rested from all the work of creation that He had accomplished.
chapters.zh: 上帝赐福给第七日，定为圣日；因为在这日，上帝歇了他一切创造的工，就安息了。

chapters.en: This is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made them.
chapters.zh: 创造天地的来历，在耶和华上帝造天地的日子，乃是这样，

chapters.en: Now no shrub of the field had yet appeared on the earth, nor had any plant of the field sprouted, for the LORD God had not yet sent rain upon the earth, and there was no man to cultivate the ground.
chapters.zh: 野地还没有草木，田间的菜蔬还没有长起来；因为耶和华上帝还没有降雨在地上，也没有人耕地，

chapters.en: But springs welled up from the earth and watered the whole surface of the ground.
chapters.zh: 但有雾气从地上腾，滋润遍地。

chapters.en: Then the LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground and breathed the breath of life into his nostrils, and the man became a living being.
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝用地上的尘土造人，将生气吹在他鼻孔里，他就成了有灵的活人，〔名叫亚当〕。

chapters.en: And the LORD God planted a garden in Eden, in the east, where He placed the man He had formed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝在东方的伊甸立了一个园子，把所造的人安置在那里。

chapters.en: Out of the ground the LORD God gave growth to every tree that is pleasing to the eye and good for food. And in the middle of the garden were the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝使各样的树从地里长出来，可以悦人的眼目，〔其上的果子〕好作食物。园子当中又有生命树和分别善恶的树。

chapters.en: Now a river flowed out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it branched into four headwaters:
chapters.zh: 有河从伊甸流出来，滋润那园子，从那里分为四道：

chapters.en: The name of the first river is the Pishon; it winds through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold.
chapters.zh: 第一道名叫比逊，就是环绕哈腓拉全地的。在那里有金子，

chapters.en: And the gold of that land is pure, and bdellium and onyx are found there.
chapters.zh: 并且那地的金子是好的；在那里又有珍珠和红玛瑙。

chapters.en: The name of the second river is the Gihon; it winds through the whole land of Cush.
chapters.zh: 第二道河名叫基训，就是环绕古实全地的。

chapters.en:
The name of the third river is the Tigris; it runs along the east side of Assyria.
And the fourth river is the Euphrates.
chapters.zh: 第三道河名叫底格里斯，流在亚述的东边。第四道河就是幼发拉底河。

chapters.en: Then the LORD God took the man and placed him in the Garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理，看守。

chapters.en: And the LORD God commanded him, “You may eat freely from every tree of the garden,
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝吩咐他说：「园中各样树上的果子，你可以随意吃，

chapters.en: but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”
chapters.zh: 只是分别善恶树上的果子，你不可吃，因为你吃的日子必定死！」

chapters.en: The LORD God also said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make for him a suitable helper.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝说：「那人独居不好，我要为他造一个配偶帮助他。」

chapters.en: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field and every bird of the air, and He brought them to the man to see what he would name each one. And whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name.
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝用土所造成的野地各样走兽和空中各样飞鸟都带到那人面前，看他叫什么。那人怎样叫各样的活物，那就是牠的名字。

chapters.en: The man gave names to all the livestock, to the birds of the air, and to every beast of the field. But for Adam no suitable helper was found.
chapters.zh: 那人便给一切牲畜和空中飞鸟、野地走兽都起了名；只是那人没有遇见配偶帮助他。

chapters.en: So the LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep, and while he slept, He took one of the man’s ribs and closed up the area with flesh.
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝使他沉睡，他就睡了；于是取下他的一条肋骨，又把肉合起来。

chapters.en: And from the rib that the LORD God had taken from the man, He made a woman and brought her to him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝就用那人身上所取的肋骨造成一个女人，领她到那人跟前。

chapters.en:
And the man said:
“This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called ‘woman,’ for out of man she was taken.”
chapters.zh: 那人说： 这是我骨中的骨， 肉中的肉， 可以称她为「女人」， 因为她是从「男人」身上取出来的。

chapters.en: For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and they will become one flesh.
chapters.zh: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

chapters.en: And the man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.
chapters.zh: 当时夫妻二人赤身露体，并不羞耻。

chapters.en: Now the serpent was more crafty than any beast of the field that the LORD God had made. And he said to the woman, “Did God really say, ‘You must not eat from any tree in the garden?’”
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝所造的，惟有蛇比田野一切的活物更狡猾。蛇对女人说：「上帝岂是真说不许你们吃园中所有树上的果子吗？」

chapters.en: The woman answered the serpent, “We may eat the fruit of the trees of the garden,
chapters.zh: 女人对蛇说：「园中树上的果子，我们可以吃，

chapters.en: but about the fruit of the tree in the middle of the garden, God has said, ‘You must not eat of it or touch it, or you will die.’”
chapters.zh: 惟有园当中那棵树上的果子，上帝曾说：『你们不可吃，也不可摸，免得你们死。』」

chapters.en: “You will not surely die,” the serpent told the woman.
chapters.zh: 蛇对女人说：「你们不一定死；

chapters.en: “For God knows that in the day you eat of it, your eyes will be opened and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”
chapters.zh: 因为上帝知道，你们吃的日子眼睛就明亮了，你们便如上帝能知道善恶。」

chapters.en: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food and pleasing to the eyes, and that it was desirable for obtaining wisdom, she took the fruit and ate it. She also gave some to her husband who was with her, and he ate it.
chapters.zh: 于是女人见那棵树〔的果子〕好作食物，也悦人的眼目，且是可喜爱的，能使人有智慧，就摘下果子来吃了，又给她丈夫，她丈夫也吃了。

chapters.en: And the eyes of both of them were opened, and they knew that they were naked; so they sewed together fig leaves and made coverings for themselves.
chapters.zh: 他们二人的眼睛就明亮了，才知道自己是赤身露体，便拿无花果树的叶子为自己编做裙子。

chapters.en: Then the man and his wife heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the breeze of the day, and they hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.
chapters.zh: 天起了凉风，耶和华上帝在园中行走。那人和他妻子听见上帝的声音，就藏在园里的树木中，躲避耶和华上帝的面。

chapters.en: But the LORD God called out to the man, “Where are you?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝呼唤那人，对他说：「你在哪里？」

chapters.en: “I heard Your voice in the garden,” he replied, “and I was afraid because I was naked; so I hid myself.”
chapters.zh: 他说：「我在园中听见你的声音，我就害怕；因为我赤身露体，我便藏了。」

chapters.en: “Who told you that you were naked?” asked the LORD God. “Have you eaten from the tree of which I commanded you not to eat?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「谁告诉你赤身露体呢？莫非你吃了我吩咐你不可吃的那树上的果子吗？」

chapters.en: And the man answered, “The woman whom You gave me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”
chapters.zh: 那人说：「你所赐给我、与我同居的女人，她把那树上的果子给我，我就吃了。」

chapters.en:
Then the LORD God said to the woman, “What is this you have done?”
“The serpent deceived me,” she replied, “and I ate.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝对女人说：「你做的是什么事呢？」女人说：「那蛇引诱我，我就吃了。」

chapters.en:
So the LORD God said to the serpent:
“Because you have done this, cursed are you above all livestock
and every beast of the field! On your belly will you go, and dust you will eat,
all the days of your life.
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝对蛇说： 你既做了这事，就必受咒诅， 比一切的牲畜野兽更甚； 你必用肚子行走， 终身吃土。

chapters.en: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed. He will crush your head, and you will strike his heel. ”
chapters.zh: 我又要叫你和女人彼此为仇； 你的后裔和女人的后裔也彼此为仇。 女人的后裔要伤你的头； 你要伤他的脚跟。

chapters.en:
To the woman He said:
“I will sharply increase your pain in childbirth; in pain you will bring forth children. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”
chapters.zh: 又对女人说： 我必多多加增你怀胎的苦楚； 你生产儿女必多受苦楚。 你必恋慕你丈夫； 你丈夫必管辖你。

chapters.en:
And to Adam He said:
“Because you have listened to the voice of your wife and have eaten from the tree
of which I commanded you not to eat, cursed is the ground because of you; through toil you will eat of it
all the days of your life.
chapters.zh: 又对亚当说： 你既听从妻子的话， 吃了我所吩咐你不可吃的那树上的果子， 地必为你的缘故受咒诅； 你必终身劳苦才能从地里得吃的。

chapters.en: Both thorns and thistles it will yield for you, and you will eat the plants of the field.
chapters.zh: 地必给你长出荆棘和蒺藜来； 你也要吃田间的菜蔬。

chapters.en: By the sweat of your brow you will eat your bread, until you return to the ground— because out of it were you taken. For dust you are, and to dust you shall return.”
chapters.zh: 你必汗流满面才得糊口， 直到你归了土， 因为你是从土而出的。 你本是尘土，仍要归于尘土。

chapters.en: And Adam named his wife Eve, because she would be the mother of all the living.
chapters.zh: 亚当给他妻子起名叫夏娃，因为她是众生之母。

chapters.en: And the LORD God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife, and He clothed them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝为亚当和他妻子用皮子做衣服给他们穿。

chapters.en: Then the LORD God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of Us, knowing good and evil. And now, lest he reach out his hand and take also from the tree of life, and eat, and live forever...”
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝说：「那人已经与我们相似，能知道善恶；现在恐怕他伸手又摘生命树的果子吃，就永远活着。」

chapters.en: Therefore the LORD God banished him from the Garden of Eden to work the ground from which he had been taken.
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝便打发他出伊甸园去，耕种他所自出之土。

chapters.en: So He drove out the man and stationed cherubim on the east side of the Garden of Eden, along with a whirling sword of flame to guard the way to the tree of life.
chapters.zh: 于是把他赶出去了；又在伊甸园的东边安设基路伯和四面转动发火焰的剑，要把守生命树的道路。

chapters.en:
And Adam had relations with his wife Eve, and she conceived and gave birth to Cain.
“With the help of the LORD I have brought forth a man,” she said.
chapters.zh: 有一日，那人和他妻子夏娃同房，夏娃就怀孕，生了该隐〔注：就是得的意思〕，便说：「耶和华使我得了一个男子。」

chapters.en:
Later she gave birth to Cain’s brother Abel.
Now Abel was a keeper of sheep, while Cain was a tiller of the soil.
chapters.zh: 又生了该隐的兄弟亚伯。亚伯是牧羊的；该隐是种地的。

chapters.en: So in the course of time, Cain brought some of the fruit of the soil as an offering to the LORD,
chapters.zh: 有一日，该隐拿地里的出产为供物献给耶和华；

chapters.en:
while Abel brought the best portions of the firstborn of his flock.
And the LORD looked with favor on Abel and his offering,
chapters.zh: 亚伯也将他羊群中头生的和羊的脂油献上。耶和华看中了亚伯和他的供物，

chapters.en: but He had no regard for Cain and his offering. So Cain became very angry, and his countenance fell.
chapters.zh: 只是看不中该隐和他的供物。该隐就大大地发怒，变了脸色。

chapters.en: “Why are you angry,” said the LORD to Cain, “and why has your countenance fallen?
chapters.zh: 耶和华对该隐说：「你为什么发怒呢？你为什么变了脸色呢？

chapters.en: If you do what is right, will you not be accepted? But if you refuse to do what is right, sin is crouching at your door; it desires you, but you must master it.”
chapters.zh: 你若行得好，岂不蒙悦纳？你若行得不好，罪就伏在门前。它必恋慕你，你却要制伏它。」

chapters.en: Then Cain said to his brother Abel, “Let us go out to the field.” And while they were in the field, Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him.
chapters.zh: 该隐与他兄弟亚伯说话；二人正在田间。该隐起来打他兄弟亚伯，把他杀了。

chapters.en:
And the LORD said to Cain, “Where is your brother Abel?”
“I do not know!” he answered. “Am I my brother’s keeper?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对该隐说：「你兄弟亚伯在哪里？」他说：「我不知道！我岂是看守我兄弟的吗？」

chapters.en: “What have you done?” replied the LORD. “The voice of your brother’s blood cries out to Me from the ground.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「你做了什么事呢？你兄弟的血有声音从地里向我哀告。

chapters.en: Now you are cursed and banished from the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
chapters.zh: 地开了口，从你手里接受你兄弟的血。现在你必从这地受咒诅。

chapters.en: When you till the ground, it will no longer yield its produce to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth.”
chapters.zh: 你种地，地不再给你效力；你必流离飘荡在地上。」

chapters.en: But Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.
chapters.zh: 该隐对耶和华说：「我的刑罚太重，过于我所能当的。

chapters.en: Behold, this day You have driven me from the face of the earth, and from Your face I will be hidden; I will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth, and whoever finds me will kill me.”
chapters.zh: 你如今赶逐我离开这地，以致不见你面；我必流离飘荡在地上，凡遇见我的必杀我。」

chapters.en: “Not so!” replied the LORD. “If anyone slays Cain, then Cain will be avenged sevenfold.” And the LORD placed a mark on Cain, so that no one who found him would kill him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对他说：「凡杀该隐的，必遭报七倍。」耶和华就给该隐立一个记号，免得人遇见他就杀他。

chapters.en: So Cain went out from the presence of the LORD and settled in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
chapters.zh: 于是该隐离开耶和华的面，去住在伊甸东边挪得之地。

chapters.en: And Cain had relations with his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to Enoch. Then Cain built a city and named it after his son Enoch.
chapters.zh: 该隐与妻子同房，他妻子就怀孕，生了以诺。该隐建造了一座城，就按着他儿子的名将那城叫做以诺。

chapters.en: Now to Enoch was born Irad, and Irad was the father of Mehujael, and Mehujael was the father of Methusael, and Methusael was the father of Lamech.
chapters.zh: 以诺生以拿；以拿生米户雅利；米户雅利生玛土撒利；玛土撒利生拉麦。

chapters.en: And Lamech married two women, one named Adah and the other Zillah.
chapters.zh: 拉麦娶了两个妻：一个名叫亚大，一个名叫洗拉。

chapters.en: Adah gave birth to Jabal; he was the father of those who dwell in tents and raise livestock.
chapters.zh: 亚大生雅八；雅八就是住帐棚、牧养牲畜之人的祖师。

chapters.en: And his brother’s name was Jubal; he was the father of all who play the harp and flute.
chapters.zh: 雅八的兄弟名叫犹八；他是一切弹琴吹箫之人的祖师。

chapters.en: And Zillah gave birth to Tubal-cain, a forger of every implement of bronze and iron. And the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.
chapters.zh: 洗拉又生了土八‧该隐；他是打造各样铜铁利器的〔注：或译：是铜匠铁匠的祖师〕。土八‧该隐的妹子是拿玛。

chapters.en:
Then Lamech said to his wives:
“Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; wives of Lamech, listen to my speech. For I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for striking me.
chapters.zh: 拉麦对他两个妻子说： 亚大、洗拉，听我的声音； 拉麦的妻子，细听我的话语： 壮年人伤我，我把他杀了； 少年人损我，我把他害了〔注：或译：我杀壮士却伤自己，我害幼童却损本身〕。

chapters.en: If Cain is avenged sevenfold, then Lamech seventy-sevenfold.”
chapters.zh: 若杀该隐，遭报七倍， 杀拉麦，必遭报七十七倍。

chapters.en: And Adam again had relations with his wife, and she gave birth to a son and named him Seth, saying, “God has granted me another seed in place of Abel, since Cain killed him.”
chapters.zh: 亚当又与妻子同房，她就生了一个儿子，起名叫塞特，意思说：「上帝另给我立了一个儿子代替亚伯，因为该隐杀了他。」

chapters.en:
And to Seth also a son was born, and he called him Enosh.
At that time men began to call upon the name of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 塞特也生了一个儿子，起名叫以挪士。那时候，人才求告耶和华的名。

chapters.en: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, He made him in His own likeness.
chapters.zh: 亚当的后代记在下面。（当上帝造人的日子，是照着自己的样式造的，

chapters.en: Male and female He created them, and He blessed them. And in the day they were created, He called them “man.”
chapters.zh: 并且造男造女。在他们被造的日子，上帝赐福给他们，称他们为「人」。）

chapters.en: When Adam was 130 years old, he had a son in his own likeness, after his own image; and he named him Seth.
chapters.zh: 亚当活到一百三十岁，生了一个儿子，形像样式和自己相似，就给他起名叫塞特。

chapters.en: And after he had become the father of Seth, Adam lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 亚当生塞特之后，又在世八百年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: So Adam lived a total of 930 years, and then he died.
chapters.zh: 亚当共活了九百三十岁就死了。

chapters.en: When Seth was 105 years old, he became the father of Enosh.
chapters.zh: 塞特活到一百零五岁，生了以挪士。

chapters.en: And after he had become the father of Enosh, Seth lived 807 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 塞特生以挪士之后，又活了八百零七年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: So Seth lived a total of 912 years, and then he died.
chapters.zh: 塞特共活了九百一十二岁就死了。

chapters.en: When Enosh was 90 years old, he became the father of Kenan.
chapters.zh: 以挪士活到九十岁，生了该南。

chapters.en: And after he had become the father of Kenan, Enosh lived 815 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 以挪士生该南之后，又活了八百一十五年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: So Enosh lived a total of 905 years, and then he died.
chapters.zh: 以挪士共活了九百零五岁就死了。

chapters.en: When Kenan was 70 years old, he became the father of Mahalalel.
chapters.zh: 该南活到七十岁，生了玛勒列。

chapters.en: And after he had become the father of Mahalalel, Kenan lived 840 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 该南生玛勒列之后，又活了八百四十年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: So Kenan lived a total of 910 years, and then he died.
chapters.zh: 该南共活了九百一十岁就死了。

chapters.en: When Mahalalel was 65 years old, he became the father of Jared.
chapters.zh: 玛勒列活到六十五岁，生了雅列。

chapters.en: And after he had become the father of Jared, Mahalalel lived 830 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 玛勒列生雅列之后，又活了八百三十年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: So Mahalalel lived a total of 895 years, and then he died.
chapters.zh: 玛勒列共活了八百九十五岁就死了。

chapters.en: When Jared was 162 years old, he became the father of Enoch.
chapters.zh: 雅列活到一百六十二岁，生了以诺。

chapters.en: And after he had become the father of Enoch, Jared lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 雅列生以诺之后，又活了八百年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: So Jared lived a total of 962 years, and then he died.
chapters.zh: 雅列共活了九百六十二岁就死了。

chapters.en: When Enoch was 65 years old, he became the father of Methuselah.
chapters.zh: 以诺活到六十五岁，生了玛土撒拉。

chapters.en: And after he had become the father of Methuselah, Enoch walked with God 300 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 以诺生玛土撒拉之后，与上帝同行三百年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: So Enoch lived a total of 365 years.
chapters.zh: 以诺共活了三百六十五岁。

chapters.en: Enoch walked with God, and then he was no more, because God had taken him away.
chapters.zh: 以诺与上帝同行，上帝将他取去，他就不在世了。

chapters.en: When Methuselah was 187 years old, he became the father of Lamech.
chapters.zh: 玛土撒拉活到一百八十七岁，生了拉麦。

chapters.en: And after he had become the father of Lamech, Methuselah lived 782 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 玛土撒拉生拉麦之后，又活了七百八十二年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: So Methuselah lived a total of 969 years, and then he died.
chapters.zh: 玛土撒拉共活了九百六十九岁就死了。

chapters.en: When Lamech was 182 years old, he had a son.
chapters.zh: 拉麦活到一百八十二岁，生了一个儿子，

chapters.en: And he named him Noah, saying, “May this one comfort us in the labor and toil of our hands caused by the ground that the LORD has cursed.”
chapters.zh: 给他起名叫挪亚，说：「这个儿子必为我们的操作和手中的劳苦安慰我们；这操作劳苦是因为耶和华咒诅地。」

chapters.en: And after he had become the father of Noah, Lamech lived 595 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 拉麦生挪亚之后，又活了五百九十五年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: So Lamech lived a total of 777 years, and then he died.
chapters.zh: 拉麦共活了七百七十七岁就死了。

chapters.en: After Noah was 500 years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
chapters.zh: 挪亚五百岁生了闪、含、雅弗。

chapters.en: Now when men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them,
chapters.zh: 当人在世上多起来、又生女儿的时候，

chapters.en: the sons of God saw that the daughters of men were beautiful, and they took as wives whomever they chose.
chapters.zh: 上帝的儿子们看见人的女子美貌，就随意挑选，娶来为妻。

chapters.en: So the LORD said, “My Spirit will not contend with man forever, for he is mortal; his days shall be 120 years.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「人既属乎血气，我的灵就不永远住在他里面；然而他的日子还可到一百二十年。」

chapters.en: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days—and afterward as well—when the sons of God had relations with the daughters of men. And they bore them children who became the mighty men of old, men of renown.
chapters.zh: 那时候有伟人在地上，后来上帝的儿子们和人的女子们交合生子；那就是上古英武有名的人。

chapters.en: Then the LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great upon the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of his heart was altogether evil all the time.
chapters.zh: 耶和华见人在地上罪恶很大，终日所思想的尽都是恶，

chapters.en: And the LORD regretted that He had made man on the earth, and He was grieved in His heart.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就后悔造人在地上，心中忧伤。

chapters.en: So the LORD said, “I will blot out man, whom I have created, from the face of the earth—every man and beast and crawling creature and bird of the air—for I am grieved that I have made them.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我要将所造的人和走兽，并昆虫，以及空中的飞鸟，都从地上除灭，因为我造他们后悔了。」

chapters.en: Noah, however, found favor in the eyes of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 惟有挪亚在耶和华眼前蒙恩。

chapters.en: This is the account of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generation; Noah walked with God.
chapters.zh: 挪亚的后代记在下面。挪亚是个义人，在当时的世代是个完全人。挪亚与上帝同行。

chapters.en: And Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
chapters.zh: 挪亚生了三个儿子，就是闪、含、雅弗。

chapters.en: Now the earth was corrupt in the sight of God, and full of violence.
chapters.zh: 世界在上帝面前败坏，地上满了强暴。

chapters.en: And God looked upon the earth and saw that it was corrupt; for all living creatures on the earth had corrupted their ways.
chapters.zh: 上帝观看世界，见是败坏了；凡有血气的人在地上都败坏了行为。

chapters.en: Then God said to Noah, “The end of all living creatures has come before Me, because through them the earth is full of violence. Now behold, I will destroy both them and the earth.
chapters.zh: 上帝就对挪亚说：「凡有血气的人，他的尽头已经来到我面前；因为地上满了他们的强暴，我要把他们和地一并毁灭。

chapters.en: Make for yourself an ark of gopher wood; make rooms in the ark and coat it with pitch inside and out.
chapters.zh: 你要用歌斐木造一只方舟，分一间一间地造，里外抹上松香。

chapters.en: And this is how you are to build it: The ark is to be 300 cubits long, 50 cubits wide, and 30 cubits high.
chapters.zh: 方舟的造法乃是这样：要长三百肘，宽五十肘，高三十肘。

chapters.en: You are to make a roof for the ark, finish its walls a cubit from the top, place a door in the side of the ark, and build lower, middle, and upper decks.
chapters.zh: 方舟上边要留透光处，高一肘。方舟的门要开在旁边。方舟要分上、中、下三层。

chapters.en: And behold, I will bring floodwaters upon the earth to destroy every creature under the heavens that has the breath of life. Everything on the earth will perish.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我要使洪水泛滥在地上，毁灭天下；凡地上有血肉、有气息的活物，无一不死。

chapters.en: But I will establish My covenant with you, and you will enter the ark—you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you.
chapters.zh: 我却要与你立约；你同你的妻，与儿子儿妇，都要进入方舟。

chapters.en: And you are to bring two of every living creature into the ark—male and female—to keep them alive with you.
chapters.zh: 凡有血肉的活物，每样两个，一公一母，你要带进方舟，好在你那里保全生命。

chapters.en: Two of every kind of bird and animal and crawling creature will come to you to be kept alive.
chapters.zh: 飞鸟各从其类，牲畜各从其类，地上的昆虫各从其类，每样两个，要到你那里，好保全生命。

chapters.en: You are also to take for yourself every kind of food that is eaten and gather it as food for yourselves and for the animals.”
chapters.zh: 你要拿各样食物积蓄起来，好作你和牠们的食物。」

chapters.en: So Noah did everything precisely as God had commanded him.
chapters.zh: 挪亚就这样行。凡上帝所吩咐的，他都照样行了。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Noah, “Go into the ark, you and all your family, because I have found you righteous in this generation.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对挪亚说：「你和你的全家都要进入方舟；因为在这世代中，我见你在我面前是义人。

chapters.en: You are to take with you seven pairs of every kind of clean animal, a male and its mate; a pair of every kind of unclean animal, a male and its mate;
chapters.zh: 凡洁净的畜类，你要带七公七母；不洁净的畜类，你要带一公一母；

chapters.en: and seven pairs of every kind of bird of the air, male and female, to preserve their offspring on the face of all the earth.
chapters.zh: 空中的飞鸟也要带七公七母，可以留种，活在全地上；

chapters.en: For seven days from now I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights, and I will wipe from the face of the earth every living thing I have made.”
chapters.zh: 因为再过七天，我要降雨在地上四十昼夜，把我所造的各种活物都从地上除灭。」

chapters.en: And Noah did all that the LORD had commanded him.
chapters.zh: 挪亚就遵着耶和华所吩咐的行了。

chapters.en: Now Noah was 600 years old when the floodwaters came upon the earth.
chapters.zh: 当洪水泛滥在地上的时候，挪亚整六百岁。

chapters.en: And Noah and his wife, with his sons and their wives, entered the ark to escape the waters of the flood.
chapters.zh: 挪亚就同他的妻和儿子儿妇都进入方舟，躲避洪水。

chapters.en: The clean and unclean animals, the birds, and everything that crawls along the ground
chapters.zh: 洁净的畜类和不洁净的畜类，飞鸟并地上一切的昆虫，

chapters.en: came to Noah to enter the ark, two by two, male and female, as God had commanded Noah.
chapters.zh: 都是一对一对地，有公有母，到挪亚那里进入方舟，正如上帝所吩咐挪亚的。

chapters.en: And after seven days the floodwaters came upon the earth.
chapters.zh: 过了那七天，洪水泛滥在地上。

chapters.en: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, on the seventeenth day of the second month, all the fountains of the great deep burst forth, and the floodgates of the heavens were opened.
chapters.zh: 当挪亚六百岁，二月十七日那一天，大渊的泉源都裂开了，天上的窗户也敞开了，

chapters.en: And the rain fell upon the earth for forty days and forty nights.
chapters.zh: 四十昼夜降大雨在地上。

chapters.en: On that very day Noah entered the ark, along with his sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth, and his wife, and the three wives of his sons—
chapters.zh: 正当那日，挪亚和他三个儿子闪、含、雅弗，并挪亚的妻子和三个儿妇，都进入方舟。

chapters.en: they and every kind of wild animal, livestock, crawling creature, bird, and winged creature.
chapters.zh: 他们和百兽，各从其类，一切牲畜，各从其类，爬在地上的昆虫，各从其类，一切禽鸟，各从其类，都进入方舟。

chapters.en: They came to Noah to enter the ark, two by two of every creature with the breath of life.
chapters.zh: 凡有血肉、有气息的活物，都一对一对地到挪亚那里，进入方舟。

chapters.en: And they entered, the male and female of every living thing, as God had commanded Noah. Then the LORD shut him in.
chapters.zh: 凡有血肉进入方舟的，都是有公有母，正如上帝所吩咐挪亚的。耶和华就把他关在方舟里头。

chapters.en: For forty days the flood kept coming on the earth, and the waters rose and lifted the ark high above the earth.
chapters.zh: 洪水泛滥在地上四十天，水往上长，把方舟从地上漂起。

chapters.en: So the waters continued to surge and rise greatly on the earth, and the ark floated on the surface of the waters.
chapters.zh: 水势浩大，在地上大大地往上长，方舟在水面上漂来漂去。

chapters.en: Finally, the waters completely prevailed upon the earth, so that all the high mountains under all the heavens were covered.
chapters.zh: 水势在地上极其浩大，天下的高山都淹没了。

chapters.en: The waters rose and covered the mountaintops to a depth of fifteen cubits.
chapters.zh: 水势比山高过十五肘，山岭都淹没了。

chapters.en: And every living thing that moved upon the earth perished—birds, livestock, animals, every creature that swarms upon the earth, and all mankind.
chapters.zh: 凡在地上有血肉的动物，就是飞鸟、牲畜、走兽，和爬在地上的昆虫，以及所有的人，都死了。

chapters.en: Of all that was on dry land, everything that had the breath of life in its nostrils died.
chapters.zh: 凡在旱地上、鼻孔有气息的生灵都死了。

chapters.en: And every living thing on the face of the earth was destroyed—man and livestock, crawling creatures and birds of the air; they were blotted out from the earth, and only Noah and those with him in the ark remained.
chapters.zh: 凡地上各类的活物，连人带牲畜、昆虫，以及空中的飞鸟，都从地上除灭了，只留下挪亚和那些与他同在方舟里的。

chapters.en: And the waters prevailed upon the earth for 150 days.
chapters.zh: 水势浩大，在地上共一百五十天。

chapters.en: But God remembered Noah and all the animals and livestock that were with him in the ark. And God sent a wind over the earth, and the waters began to subside.
chapters.zh: 上帝记念挪亚和挪亚方舟里的一切走兽牲畜。上帝叫风吹地，水势渐落。

chapters.en: The springs of the deep and the floodgates of the heavens were closed, and the rain from the sky was restrained.
chapters.zh: 渊源和天上的窗户都闭塞了，天上的大雨也止住了。

chapters.en: The waters receded steadily from the earth, and after 150 days the waters had gone down.
chapters.zh: 水从地上渐退。过了一百五十天，水就渐消。

chapters.en: On the seventeenth day of the seventh month, the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.
chapters.zh: 七月十七日，方舟停在亚拉腊山上。

chapters.en: And the waters continued to recede until the tenth month, and on the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains became visible.
chapters.zh: 水又渐消，到十月初一日，山顶都现出来了。

chapters.en: After forty days Noah opened the window he had made in the ark
chapters.zh: 过了四十天，挪亚开了方舟的窗户，

chapters.en: and sent out a raven. It kept flying back and forth until the waters had dried up from the earth.
chapters.zh: 放出一只乌鸦去；那乌鸦飞来飞去，直到地上的水都干了。

chapters.en: Then Noah sent out a dove to see if the waters had receded from the surface of the ground.
chapters.zh: 他又放出一只鸽子去，要看看水从地上退了没有。

chapters.en: But the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned to him in the ark, because the waters were still covering the surface of all the earth. So he reached out his hand and brought her back inside the ark.
chapters.zh: 但遍地上都是水，鸽子找不着落脚之地，就回到方舟挪亚那里，挪亚伸手把鸽子接进方舟来。

chapters.en: Noah waited seven more days and again sent out the dove from the ark.
chapters.zh: 他又等了七天，再把鸽子从方舟放出去。

chapters.en: And behold, the dove returned to him in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf in her beak. So Noah knew that the waters had receded from the earth.
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，鸽子回到他那里，嘴里叼着一个新拧下来的橄榄叶子，挪亚就知道地上的水退了。

chapters.en: And Noah waited seven more days and sent out the dove again, but this time she did not return to him.
chapters.zh: 他又等了七天，放出鸽子去，鸽子就不再回来了。

chapters.en: In Noah’s six hundred and first year, on the first day of the first month, the waters had dried up from the earth. So Noah removed the covering from the ark and saw that the surface of the ground was dry.
chapters.zh: 到挪亚六百零一岁，正月初一日，地上的水都干了。挪亚撤去方舟的盖观看，便见地面上干了。

chapters.en: By the twenty-seventh day of the second month, the earth was fully dry.
chapters.zh: 到了二月二十七日，地就都干了。

chapters.en: Then God said to Noah,
chapters.zh: 上帝对挪亚说：

chapters.en: “Come out of the ark, you and your wife, along with your sons and their wives.
chapters.zh: 「你和你的妻子、儿子、儿妇都可以出方舟。

chapters.en: Bring out all the living creatures that are with you—birds, livestock, and everything that crawls upon the ground—so that they can spread out over the earth and be fruitful and multiply upon it.”
chapters.zh: 在你那里凡有血肉的活物，就是飞鸟、牲畜，和一切爬在地上的昆虫，都要带出来，叫牠在地上多多滋生，大大兴旺。」

chapters.en: So Noah came out, along with his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives.
chapters.zh: 于是挪亚和他的妻子、儿子、儿妇都出来了。

chapters.en: Every living creature, every creeping thing, and every bird—everything that moves upon the earth—came out of the ark, kind by kind.
chapters.zh: 一切走兽、昆虫、飞鸟，和地上所有的动物，各从其类，也都出了方舟。

chapters.en: Then Noah built an altar to the LORD. And taking from every kind of clean animal and clean bird, he offered burnt offerings on the altar.
chapters.zh: 挪亚为耶和华筑了一座坛，拿各类洁净的牲畜、飞鸟献在坛上为燔祭。

chapters.en: When the LORD smelled the pleasing aroma, He said in His heart, “Never again will I curse the ground because of man, even though every inclination of his heart is evil from his youth. And never again will I destroy all living creatures as I have done.
chapters.zh: 耶和华闻那馨香之气，就心里说：「我不再因人的缘故咒诅地（人从小时心里怀着恶念），也不再按着我才行的灭各种的活物了。

chapters.en: As long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night shall never cease.”
chapters.zh: 地还存留的时候，稼穑、寒暑、冬夏、昼夜就永不停息了。」

chapters.en: And God blessed Noah and his sons and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth.
chapters.zh: 上帝赐福给挪亚和他的儿子，对他们说：「你们要生养众多，遍满了地。

chapters.en: The fear and dread of you will fall on every living creature on the earth, every bird of the air, every creature that crawls on the ground, and all the fish of the sea. They are delivered into your hand.
chapters.zh: 凡地上的走兽和空中的飞鸟都必惊恐，惧怕你们，连地上一切的昆虫并海里一切的鱼都交付你们的手。

chapters.en: Everything that lives and moves will be food for you; just as I gave you the green plants, I now give you all things.
chapters.zh: 凡活着的动物都可以作你们的食物。这一切我都赐给你们，如同菜蔬一样。

chapters.en: But you must not eat meat with its lifeblood still in it.
chapters.zh: 惟独肉带着血，那就是牠的生命，你们不可吃。

chapters.en: And surely I will require the life of any man or beast by whose hand your lifeblood is shed. I will demand an accounting from anyone who takes the life of his fellow man:
chapters.zh: 流你们血、害你们命的，无论是兽是人，我必讨他的罪，就是向各人的弟兄也是如此。

chapters.en: Whoever sheds the blood of man, by man his blood will be shed; for in His own image God has made mankind.
chapters.zh: 凡流人血的，他的血也必被人所流，因为上帝造人是照自己的形像造的。

chapters.en: But as for you, be fruitful and multiply; spread out across the earth and multiply upon it.”
chapters.zh: 你们要生养众多，在地上昌盛繁茂。」

chapters.en: Then God said to Noah and his sons with him,
chapters.zh: 上帝晓谕挪亚和他的儿子说：

chapters.en: “Behold, I now establish My covenant with you and your descendants after you,
chapters.zh: 「我与你们和你们的后裔立约，

chapters.en: and with every living creature that was with you—the birds, the livestock, and every beast of the earth—every living thing that came out of the ark.
chapters.zh: 并与你们这里的一切活物－就是飞鸟、牲畜、走兽，凡从方舟里出来的活物－立约。

chapters.en: And I establish My covenant with you: Never again will all life be cut off by the waters of a flood; never again will there be a flood to destroy the earth.”
chapters.zh: 我与你们立约，凡有血肉的，不再被洪水灭绝，也不再有洪水毁坏地了。」

chapters.en: And God said, “This is the sign of the covenant I am making between Me and you and every living creature with you, a covenant for all generations to come:
chapters.zh: 上帝说：「我与你们并你们这里的各样活物所立的永约是有记号的。

chapters.en: I have set My rainbow in the clouds, and it will be a sign of the covenant between Me and the earth.
chapters.zh: 我把虹放在云彩中，这就可作我与地立约的记号了。

chapters.en: Whenever I form clouds over the earth and the rainbow appears in the clouds,
chapters.zh: 我使云彩盖地的时候，必有虹现在云彩中，

chapters.en: I will remember My covenant between Me and you and every living creature of every kind. Never again will the waters become a flood to destroy all life.
chapters.zh: 我便记念我与你们和各样有血肉的活物所立的约，水就再不泛滥、毁坏一切有血肉的物了。

chapters.en: And whenever the rainbow appears in the clouds, I will see it and remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of every kind that is on the earth.”
chapters.zh: 虹必现在云彩中，我看见，就要记念我与地上各样有血肉的活物所立的永约。」

chapters.en: So God said to Noah, “This is the sign of the covenant that I have established between Me and every creature on the earth.”
chapters.zh: 上帝对挪亚说：「这就是我与地上一切有血肉之物立约的记号了。」

chapters.en: The sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And Ham was the father of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 出方舟挪亚的儿子就是闪、含、雅弗。含是迦南的父亲。

chapters.en: These three were the sons of Noah, and from them the whole earth was populated.
chapters.zh: 这是挪亚的三个儿子，他们的后裔分散在全地。

chapters.en: Now Noah, a man of the soil, proceeded to plant a vineyard.
chapters.zh: 挪亚作起农夫来，栽了一个葡萄园。

chapters.en: But when he drank some of its wine, he became drunk and uncovered himself inside his tent.
chapters.zh: 他喝了园中的酒便醉了，在帐棚里赤着身子。

chapters.en: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father’s nakedness and told his two brothers outside.
chapters.zh: 迦南的父亲含看见他父亲赤身，就到外边告诉他两个弟兄。

chapters.en: Then Shem and Japheth took a garment and placed it across their shoulders, and walking backward, they covered their father’s nakedness. Their faces were turned away so that they did not see their father’s nakedness.
chapters.zh: 于是闪和雅弗拿件衣服搭在肩上，倒退着进去，给他父亲盖上；他们背着脸就看不见父亲的赤身。

chapters.en: When Noah awoke from his drunkenness and learned what his youngest son had done to him,
chapters.zh: 挪亚醒了酒，知道小儿子向他所做的事，

chapters.en:
he said,
“Cursed be Canaan! A servant of servants
shall he be to his brothers.”
chapters.zh: 就说： 迦南当受咒诅， 必给他弟兄作奴仆的奴仆；

chapters.en:
He also declared:
“Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem! May Canaan be the servant of Shem.
chapters.zh: 又说： 耶和华－闪的上帝是应当称颂的！ 愿迦南作闪的奴仆。

chapters.en:
May God expand the territory of Japheth; may he dwell in the tents of Shem,
and may Canaan be his servant.”
chapters.zh: 愿上帝使雅弗扩张， 使他住在闪的帐棚里； 又愿迦南作他的奴仆。

chapters.en: After the flood, Noah lived 350 years.
chapters.zh: 洪水以后，挪亚又活了三百五十年。

chapters.en: So Noah lived a total of 950 years, and then he died.
chapters.zh: 挪亚共活了九百五十岁就死了。

chapters.en: This is the account of Noah’s sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth, who also had sons after the flood.
chapters.zh: 挪亚的儿子闪、含、雅弗的后代记在下面。洪水以后，他们都生了儿子。

chapters.en:
The sons of Japheth:
Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
chapters.zh: 雅弗的儿子是歌篾、玛各、玛代、雅完、土巴、米设、提拉。

chapters.en:
The sons of Gomer:
Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
chapters.zh: 歌篾的儿子是亚实基拿、利法、陀迦玛。

chapters.en:
And the sons of Javan:
Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites.
chapters.zh: 雅完的儿子是以利沙、他施、基提、多单。

chapters.en: From these, the maritime peoples separated into their territories, according to their languages, by clans within their nations.
chapters.zh: 这些人的后裔将各国的地土、海岛分开居住，各随各的方言、宗族立国。

chapters.en:
The sons of Ham:
Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
chapters.zh: 含的儿子是古实、麦西、弗、迦南。

chapters.en:
The sons of Cush:
Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca.
And the sons of Raamah:
Sheba and Dedan.
chapters.zh: 古实的儿子是西巴、哈腓拉、撒弗他、拉玛、撒弗提迦。拉玛的儿子是示巴、底但。

chapters.en: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one on the earth.
chapters.zh: 古实又生宁录，他为世上英雄之首。

chapters.en: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD; so it is said, “Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 他在耶和华面前是个英勇的猎户，所以俗语说：「像宁录在耶和华面前是个英勇的猎户。」

chapters.en: His kingdom began in Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
chapters.zh: 他国的起头是巴别、以力、亚甲、甲尼，都在示拿地。

chapters.en: From that land he went forth into Assyria, where he built Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Calah,
chapters.zh: 他从那地出来往亚述去，建造尼尼微、利河伯、迦拉，

chapters.en: and Resen, which is between Nineveh and the great city of Calah.
chapters.zh: 和尼尼微、迦拉中间的利鲜，这就是那大城。

chapters.en: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, the Anamites, the Lehabites, the Naphtuhites,
chapters.zh: 麦西生路低人、亚拿米人、利哈比人、拿弗土希人、

chapters.en: the Pathrusites, the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorites.
chapters.zh: 帕斯鲁细人、迦斯路希人、迦斐讬人；从迦斐讬出来的有非利士人。

chapters.en: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
chapters.zh: 迦南生长子西顿，又生赫

chapters.en: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
chapters.zh: 和耶布斯人、亚摩利人、革迦撒人、

chapters.en: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
chapters.zh: 希未人、亚基人、西尼人、

chapters.en:
the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.
Later the Canaanite clans were scattered,
chapters.zh: 亚瓦底人、洗玛利人、哈马人，后来迦南的诸族分散了。

chapters.en: and the borders of Canaan extended from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, and then toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.
chapters.zh: 迦南的境界是从西顿向基拉耳的路上，直到迦萨，又向所多玛、蛾摩拉、押玛、洗扁的路上，直到拉沙。

chapters.en: These are the sons of Ham according to their clans, languages, lands, and nations.
chapters.zh: 这就是含的后裔，各随他们的宗族、方言，所住的地土、邦国。

chapters.en: And sons were also born to Shem, the older brother of Japheth; Shem was the forefather of all the sons of Eber.
chapters.zh: 雅弗的哥哥闪，是希伯子孙之祖，他也生了儿子。

chapters.en:
The sons of Shem:
Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.
chapters.zh: 闪的儿子是以拦、亚述、亚法撒、路德、亚兰。

chapters.en:
The sons of Aram:
Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
chapters.zh: 亚兰的儿子是乌斯、户勒、基帖、玛施。

chapters.en: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
chapters.zh: 亚法撒生沙拉；沙拉生希伯。

chapters.en: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.
chapters.zh: 希伯生了两个儿子，一个名叫法勒〔注：就是分的意思〕，因为那时人就分地居住；法勒的兄弟名叫约坍。

chapters.en: And Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
chapters.zh: 约坍生亚摩答、沙列、哈萨玛非、耶拉、

chapters.en: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
chapters.zh: 哈多兰、乌萨、德拉、

chapters.en: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
chapters.zh: 俄巴路、亚比玛利、示巴、

chapters.en: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
chapters.zh: 阿斐、哈腓拉、约巴，这都是约坍的儿子。

chapters.en: Their territory extended from Mesha to Sephar, in the eastern hill country.
chapters.zh: 他们所住的地方是从米沙直到西发东边的山。

chapters.en: These are the sons of Shem, according to their clans, languages, lands, and nations.
chapters.zh: 这就是闪的子孙，各随他们的宗族、方言，所住的地土、邦国。

chapters.en: All these are the clans of Noah’s sons, according to their generations and nations. From these the nations of the earth spread out after the flood.
chapters.zh: 这些都是挪亚三个儿子的宗族，各随他们的支派立国。洪水以后，他们在地上分为邦国。

chapters.en: Now the whole world had one language and a common form of speech.
chapters.zh: 那时，天下人的口音、言语都是一样。

chapters.en: And as people journeyed eastward, they found a plain in the land of Shinar and settled there.
chapters.zh: 他们往东边迁移的时候，在示拿地遇见一片平原，就住在那里。

chapters.en: And they said to one another, “Come, let us make bricks and bake them thoroughly.” So they used brick instead of stone, and tar instead of mortar.
chapters.zh: 他们彼此商量说：「来吧！我们要做砖，把砖烧透了。」他们就拿砖当石头，又拿石漆当灰泥。

chapters.en: “Come,” they said, “let us build for ourselves a city with a tower that reaches to the heavens, that we may make a name for ourselves and not be scattered over the face of all the earth.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「来吧！我们要建造一座城和一座塔，塔顶通天，为要传扬我们的名，免得我们分散在全地上。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD came down to see the city and the tower that the sons of men were building.
chapters.zh: 耶和华降临，要看看世人所建造的城和塔。

chapters.en: And the LORD said, “If they have begun to do this as one people speaking the same language, then nothing they devise will be beyond them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。

chapters.en: Come, let Us go down and confuse their language, so that they will not understand one another’s speech.”
chapters.zh: 我们下去，在那里变乱他们的口音，使他们的言语彼此不通。」

chapters.en: So the LORD scattered them from there over the face of all the earth, and they stopped building the city.
chapters.zh: 于是耶和华使他们从那里分散在全地上；他们就停工，不造那城了。

chapters.en: That is why it is called Babel, for there the LORD confused the language of the whole world, and from that place the LORD scattered them over the face of all the earth.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华在那里变乱天下人的言语，使众人分散在全地上，所以那城名叫巴别〔注：就是变乱的意思〕。

chapters.en: This is the account of Shem. Two years after the flood, when Shem was 100 years old, he became the father of Arphaxad.
chapters.zh: 闪的后代记在下面。洪水以后二年，闪一百岁生了亚法撒。

chapters.en: And after he had become the father of Arphaxad, Shem lived 500 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 闪生亚法撒之后又活了五百年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: When Arphaxad was 35 years old, he became the father of Shelah.
chapters.zh: 亚法撒活到三十五岁，生了沙拉。

chapters.en: And after he had become the father of Shelah, Arphaxad lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 亚法撒生沙拉之后又活了四百零三年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: When Shelah was 30 years old, he became the father of Eber.
chapters.zh: 沙拉活到三十岁，生了希伯。

chapters.en: And after he had become the father of Eber, Shelah lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 沙拉生希伯之后又活了四百零三年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: When Eber was 34 years old, he became the father of Peleg.
chapters.zh: 希伯活到三十四岁，生了法勒。

chapters.en: And after he had become the father of Peleg, Eber lived 430 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 希伯生法勒之后又活了四百三十年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: When Peleg was 30 years old, he became the father of Reu.
chapters.zh: 法勒活到三十岁，生了拉吴。

chapters.en: And after he had become the father of Reu, Peleg lived 209 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 法勒生拉吴之后又活了二百零九年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: When Reu was 32 years old, he became the father of Serug.
chapters.zh: 拉吴活到三十二岁，生了西鹿。

chapters.en: And after he had become the father of Serug, Reu lived 207 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 拉吴生西鹿之后又活了二百零七年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: When Serug was 30 years old, he became the father of Nahor.
chapters.zh: 西鹿活到三十岁，生了拿鹤。

chapters.en: And after he had become the father of Nahor, Serug lived 200 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 西鹿生拿鹤之后又活了二百年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: When Nahor was 29 years old, he became the father of Terah.
chapters.zh: 拿鹤活到二十九岁，生了他拉。

chapters.en: And after he had become the father of Terah, Nahor lived 119 years and had other sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 拿鹤生他拉之后又活了一百一十九年，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: When Terah was 70 years old, he became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
chapters.zh: 他拉活到七十岁，生了亚伯兰、拿鹤、哈兰。

chapters.en: This is the account of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. And Haran became the father of Lot.
chapters.zh: 他拉的后代记在下面。他拉生亚伯兰、拿鹤、哈兰；哈兰生罗得。

chapters.en: During his father Terah’s lifetime, Haran died in his native land, in Ur of the Chaldeans.
chapters.zh: 哈兰死在他的本地迦勒底的吾珥，在他父亲他拉之先。

chapters.en: And Abram and Nahor took wives for themselves. Abram’s wife was named Sarai, and Nahor’s wife was named Milcah; she was the daughter of Haran, who was the father of both Milcah and Iscah.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰、拿鹤各娶了妻：亚伯兰的妻子名叫撒莱；拿鹤的妻子名叫密迦，是哈兰的女儿；哈兰是密迦和亦迦的父亲。

chapters.en: But Sarai was barren; she had no children.
chapters.zh: 撒莱不生育，没有孩子。

chapters.en: And Terah took his son Abram, his grandson Lot son of Haran, and his daughter-in-law Sarai the wife of Abram, and they set out from Ur of the Chaldeans for the land of Canaan. But when they arrived in Haran, they settled there.
chapters.zh: 他拉带着他儿子亚伯兰和他孙子哈兰的儿子罗得，并他儿妇亚伯兰的妻子撒莱，出了迦勒底的吾珥，要往迦南地去；他们走到哈兰，就住在那里。

chapters.en: Terah lived 205 years, and he died in Haran.
chapters.zh: 他拉共活了二百零五岁，就死在哈兰。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Abram, “Leave your country, your kindred, and your father’s household, and go to the land I will show you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对亚伯兰说：「你要离开本地、本族、父家，往我所要指示你的地去。

chapters.en: I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, so that you will be a blessing.
chapters.zh: 我必叫你成为大国。我必赐福给你，叫你的名为大；你也要叫别人得福。

chapters.en: I will bless those who bless you and curse those who curse you; and all the families of the earth will be blessed through you. ”
chapters.zh: 为你祝福的，我必赐福与他；那咒诅你的，我必咒诅他。地上的万族都要因你得福。」

chapters.en: So Abram departed, as the LORD had directed him, and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he left Haran.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰就照着耶和华的吩咐去了；罗得也和他同去。亚伯兰出哈兰的时候年七十五岁。

chapters.en:
And Abram took his wife Sarai, his nephew Lot, and all the possessions and people they had acquired in Haran, and set out for the land of Canaan.
When they came to the land of Canaan,
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰将他妻子撒莱和姪儿罗得，连他们在哈兰所积蓄的财物、所得的人口，都带往迦南地去。他们就到了迦南地。

chapters.en: Abram traveled through the land as far as the site of the Oak of Moreh at Shechem. And at that time the Canaanites were in the land.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰经过那地，到了示剑地方、摩利橡树那里。那时迦南人住在那地。

chapters.en: Then the LORD appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring. ” So Abram built an altar there to the LORD, who had appeared to him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华向亚伯兰显现，说：「我要把这地赐给你的后裔。」亚伯兰就在那里为向他显现的耶和华筑了一座坛。

chapters.en: From there Abram moved on to the hill country east of Bethel and pitched his tent, with Bethel to the west and Ai to the east. There he built an altar to the LORD, and he called on the name of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 从那里他又迁到伯特利东边的山，支搭帐棚；西边是伯特利，东边是艾。他在那里又为耶和华筑了一座坛，求告耶和华的名。

chapters.en: And Abram journeyed on toward the Negev.
chapters.zh: 后来亚伯兰又渐渐迁往南地去。

chapters.en: Now there was a famine in the land. So Abram went down to Egypt to live there for a while because the famine was severe.
chapters.zh: 那地遭遇饥荒。因饥荒甚大，亚伯兰就下埃及去，要在那里暂居。

chapters.en: As he was about to enter Egypt, he said to his wife Sarai, “Look, I know that you are a beautiful woman,
chapters.zh: 将近埃及，就对他妻子撒莱说：「我知道你是容貌俊美的妇人。

chapters.en: and when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ Then they will kill me but will let you live.
chapters.zh: 埃及人看见你必说：『这是他的妻子』，他们就要杀我，却叫你存活。

chapters.en: Please say you are my sister, so that I will be treated well for your sake, and on account of you my life will be spared.”
chapters.zh: 求你说，你是我的妹子，使我因你得平安，我的命也因你存活。」

chapters.en: So when Abram entered Egypt, the Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.
chapters.zh: 及至亚伯兰到了埃及，埃及人看见那妇人极其美貌。

chapters.en: When Pharaoh’s officials saw Sarai, they commended her to him, and she was taken into the palace of Pharaoh.
chapters.zh: 法老的臣宰看见了她，就在法老面前夸奖她。那妇人就被带进法老的宫去。

chapters.en: He treated Abram well on her account, and Abram acquired sheep and cattle, male and female donkeys, menservants and maidservants, and camels.
chapters.zh: 法老因这妇人就厚待亚伯兰，亚伯兰得了许多牛、羊、骆驼、公驴、母驴、仆婢。

chapters.en: The LORD, however, afflicted Pharaoh and his household with severe plagues because of Abram’s wife Sarai.
chapters.zh: 耶和华因亚伯兰妻子撒莱的缘故，降大灾与法老和他的全家。

chapters.en: So Pharaoh summoned Abram and asked, “What have you done to me? Why didn’t you tell me she was your wife?
chapters.zh: 法老就召了亚伯兰来，说：「你这向我做的是什么事呢？为什么没有告诉我她是你的妻子？

chapters.en: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her as my wife? Now then, here is your wife. Take her and go!”
chapters.zh: 为什么说她是你的妹子，以致我把她取来要作我的妻子？现在你的妻子在这里，可以带她走吧。」

chapters.en: Then Pharaoh gave his men orders concerning Abram, and they sent him away with his wife and all his possessions.
chapters.zh: 于是法老吩咐人将亚伯兰和他妻子，并他所有的都送走了。

chapters.en: So Abram went up out of Egypt into the Negev—he and his wife and all his possessions—and Lot was with him.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰带着他的妻子与罗得，并一切所有的，都从埃及上南地去。

chapters.en: And Abram had become extremely wealthy in livestock and silver and gold.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰的金、银、牲畜极多。

chapters.en: From the Negev he journeyed from place to place toward Bethel, until he came to the place between Bethel and Ai where his tent had formerly been pitched,
chapters.zh: 他从南地渐渐往伯特利去，到了伯特利和艾的中间，就是从前支搭帐棚的地方，

chapters.en: to the site where he had built the altar. And there Abram called on the name of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 也是他起先筑坛的地方；他又在那里求告耶和华的名。

chapters.en: Now Lot, who was traveling with Abram, also had flocks and herds and tents.
chapters.zh: 与亚伯兰同行的罗得也有牛群、羊群、帐棚。

chapters.en: But the land was unable to support both of them while they stayed together, for they had so many possessions that they were unable to coexist.
chapters.zh: 那地容不下他们；因为他们的财物甚多，使他们不能同居。

chapters.en: And there was discord between the herdsmen of Abram and the herdsmen of Lot. At that time the Canaanites and the Perizzites were also living in the land.
chapters.zh: 当时，迦南人与比利洗人在那地居住。亚伯兰的牧人和罗得的牧人相争。

chapters.en: So Abram said to Lot, “Please let there be no contention between you and me, or between your herdsmen and my herdsmen. After all, we are kinsmen.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰就对罗得说：「你我不可相争，你的牧人和我的牧人也不可相争，因为我们是骨肉〔注：原文是弟兄〕。

chapters.en: Is not the whole land before you? Now separate yourself from me. If you go to the left, I will go to the right; if you go to the right, I will go to the left.”
chapters.zh: 遍地不都在你眼前吗？请你离开我：你向左，我就向右；你向右，我就向左。」

chapters.en: And Lot looked out and saw that the whole plain of the Jordan, all the way to Zoar, was well watered like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt. (This was before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.)
chapters.zh: 罗得举目看见约旦河的全平原，直到琐珥，都是滋润的，那地在耶和华未灭所多玛、蛾摩拉以先如同耶和华的园子，也像埃及地。

chapters.en: So Lot chose the whole plain of the Jordan for himself and set out toward the east. And Abram and Lot parted company.
chapters.zh: 于是罗得选择约旦河的全平原，往东迁移；他们就彼此分离了。

chapters.en: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, but Lot settled in the cities of the plain and pitched his tent toward Sodom.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰住在迦南地，罗得住在平原的城邑，渐渐挪移帐棚，直到所多玛。

chapters.en: But the men of Sodom were wicked, sinning greatly against the LORD.
chapters.zh: 所多玛人在耶和华面前罪大恶极。

chapters.en: After Lot had departed, the LORD said to Abram, “Now lift up your eyes from the place where you are, and look to the north and south and east and west,
chapters.zh: 罗得离别亚伯兰以后，耶和华对亚伯兰说：「从你所在的地方，你举目向东西南北观看；

chapters.en: for all the land that you see, I will give to you and your offspring forever.
chapters.zh: 凡你所看见的一切地，我都要赐给你和你的后裔，直到永远。

chapters.en: I will make your offspring like the dust of the earth, so that if one could count the dust of the earth, then your offspring could be counted.
chapters.zh: 我也要使你的后裔如同地上的尘沙那样多，人若能数算地上的尘沙才能数算你的后裔。

chapters.en: Get up and walk around the land, through its length and breadth, for I will give it to you.”
chapters.zh: 你起来，纵横走遍这地，因为我必把这地赐给你。」

chapters.en: So Abram moved his tent and went to live near the Oaks of Mamre at Hebron, where he built an altar to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰就搬了帐棚，来到希伯崙幔利的橡树那里居住，在那里为耶和华筑了一座坛。

chapters.en: In those days Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim
chapters.zh: 当暗拉非作示拿王，亚略作以拉撒王，基大老玛作以拦王，提达作戈印王的时候，

chapters.en: went to war against Bera king of Sodom, Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar).
chapters.zh: 他们都攻打所多玛王比拉、蛾摩拉王比沙、押玛王示纳、洗扁王善以别，和比拉王；比拉就是琐珥。

chapters.en: The latter five came as allies to the Valley of Siddim (that is, the Salt Sea ).
chapters.zh: 这五王都在西订谷会合；西订谷就是盐海。

chapters.en: For twelve years they had been subject to Chedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
chapters.zh: 他们已经事奉基大老玛十二年，到十三年就背叛了。

chapters.en: In the fourteenth year, Chedorlaomer and the kings allied with him went out and defeated the Rephaites in Ashteroth-karnaim, the Zuzites in Ham, the Emites in Shaveh-kiriathaim,
chapters.zh: 十四年，基大老玛和同盟的王都来在亚特律‧加宁，杀败了利乏音人，在哈麦杀败了苏西人，在沙微‧基列亭杀败了以米人，

chapters.en: and the Horites in the area of Mount Seir, as far as El-paran, which is near the desert.
chapters.zh: 在何利人的西珥山杀败了何利人，一直杀到靠近旷野的伊勒‧巴兰。

chapters.en: Then they turned back to invade En-mishpat (that is, Kadesh), and they conquered the whole territory of the Amalekites, as well as the Amorites who lived in Hazazon-tamar.
chapters.zh: 他们回到安‧密巴，就是加低斯，杀败了亚玛力全地的人，以及住在哈洗逊‧他玛的亚摩利人。

chapters.en: Then the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) marched out and arrayed themselves for battle in the Valley of Siddim
chapters.zh: 于是所多玛王、蛾摩拉王、押玛王、洗扁王，和比拉王（比拉就是琐珥）都出来，在西订谷摆阵，与他们交战，

chapters.en: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar—four kings against five.
chapters.zh: 就是与以拦王基大老玛、戈印王提达、示拿王暗拉非、以拉撒王亚略交战；乃是四王与五王交战。

chapters.en: Now the Valley of Siddim was full of tar pits, and as the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, some men fell into the pits, but the survivors fled to the hill country.
chapters.zh: 西订谷有许多石漆坑。所多玛王和蛾摩拉王逃跑，有掉在坑里的，其余的人都往山上逃跑。

chapters.en: The four kings seized all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah and all their food, and they went on their way.
chapters.zh: 四王就把所多玛和蛾摩拉所有的财物，并一切的粮食都掳掠去了；

chapters.en: They also carried off Abram’s nephew Lot and his possessions, since Lot was living in Sodom.
chapters.zh: 又把亚伯兰的姪儿罗得和罗得的财物掳掠去了。当时罗得正住在所多玛。

chapters.en: Then an escapee came and reported this to Abram the Hebrew. Now Abram was living near the Oaks of Mamre the Amorite, a brother of Eshcol and Aner, all of whom were bound by treaty to Abram.
chapters.zh: 有一个逃出来的人告诉希伯来人亚伯兰；亚伯兰正住在亚摩利人幔利的橡树那里。幔利和以实各并亚乃都是弟兄，曾与亚伯兰联盟。

chapters.en: And when Abram heard that his relative had been captured, he mobilized the 318 trained men born in his household, and they set out in pursuit as far as Dan.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰听见他姪儿〔注：原文是弟兄〕被掳去，就率领他家里生养的精练壮丁三百一十八人，直追到但，

chapters.en: During the night, Abram divided his forces and routed Chedorlaomer’s army, pursuing them as far as Hobah, north of Damascus.
chapters.zh: 便在夜间，自己同仆人分队杀败敌人，又追到大马士革左边的何把，

chapters.en: He retrieved all the goods, as well as his relative Lot and his possessions, together with the women and the rest of the people.
chapters.zh: 将被掳掠的一切财物夺回来，连他姪儿罗得和他的财物，以及妇女、人民也都夺回来。

chapters.en: After Abram returned from defeating Chedorlaomer and the kings allied with him, the king of Sodom went out to meet him in the Valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰杀败基大老玛和与他同盟的王回来的时候，所多玛王出来，在沙微谷迎接他；沙微谷就是王谷。

chapters.en: Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine—since he was priest of God Most High —
chapters.zh: 又有撒冷王麦基洗德带着饼和酒出来迎接；他是至高上帝的祭司。

chapters.en:
and he blessed Abram and said:
“Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,
chapters.zh: 他为亚伯兰祝福，说：「愿天地的主、至高的上帝赐福与亚伯兰！

chapters.en:
and blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.”
Then Abram gave Melchizedek a tenth of everything.
chapters.zh: 至高的上帝把敌人交在你手里，是应当称颂的！」亚伯兰就把所得的拿出十分之一来，给麦基洗德。

chapters.en: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, but take the goods for yourself.”
chapters.zh: 所多玛王对亚伯兰说：「你把人口给我，财物你自己拿去吧！」

chapters.en: But Abram replied to the king of Sodom, “I have raised my hand to the LORD God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰对所多玛王说：「我已经向天地的主－至高的上帝耶和华起誓：

chapters.en: that I will not accept even a thread, or a strap of a sandal, or anything that belongs to you, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’
chapters.zh: 凡是你的东西，就是一根线、一根鞋带，我都不拿，免得你说：『我使亚伯兰富足！』

chapters.en: I will accept nothing but what my men have eaten and the share for the men who went with me—Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. They may take their portion.”
chapters.zh: 只有仆人所吃的，并与我同行的亚乃、以实各、幔利所应得的分，可以任凭他们拿去。」

chapters.en:
After these events, the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision:
“Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield,
your very great reward.”
chapters.zh: 这事以后，耶和华在异象中有话对亚伯兰说：「亚伯兰，你不要惧怕！我是你的盾牌，必大大地赏赐你。」

chapters.en: But Abram replied, “O Lord GOD, what can You give me, since I remain childless, and the heir of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?”
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰说：「主耶和华啊，我既无子，你还赐我什么呢？并且要承受我家业的是大马士革人以利以谢。」

chapters.en: Abram continued, “Behold, You have given me no offspring, so a servant in my household will be my heir.”
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰又说：「你没有给我儿子；那生在我家中的人就是我的后嗣。」

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Abram, saying, “This one will not be your heir, but one who comes from your own body will be your heir.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华又有话对他说：「这人必不成为你的后嗣；你本身所生的才成为你的后嗣。」

chapters.en: And the LORD took him outside and said, “Now look to the heavens and count the stars, if you are able.” Then He told him, “So shall your offspring be.”
chapters.zh: 于是领他走到外边，说：「你向天观看，数算众星，能数得过来吗？」又对他说：「你的后裔将要如此。」

chapters.en: Abram believed the LORD, and it was credited to him as righteousness.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰信耶和华，耶和华就以此为他的义。

chapters.en: The LORD also told him, “I am the LORD, who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to possess.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华又对他说：「我是耶和华，曾领你出了迦勒底的吾珥，为要将这地赐你为业。」

chapters.en: But Abram replied, “Lord GOD, how can I know that I will possess it?”
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰说：「主耶和华啊，我怎能知道必得这地为业呢？」

chapters.en: And the LORD said to him, “Bring Me a heifer, a goat, and a ram, each three years old, along with a turtledove and a young pigeon.”
chapters.zh: 他说：「你为我取一只三年的母牛，一只三年的母山羊，一只三年的公绵羊，一只斑鸠，一只雏鸽。」

chapters.en: So Abram brought all these to Him, split each of them down the middle, and laid the halves opposite each other. The birds, however, he did not cut in half.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰就取了这些来，每样劈开，分成两半，一半对着一半地摆列，只有鸟没有劈开。

chapters.en: And the birds of prey descended on the carcasses, but Abram drove them away.
chapters.zh: 有鸷鸟下来，落在那死畜的肉上，亚伯兰就把牠吓飞了。

chapters.en: As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and suddenly great terror and darkness overwhelmed him.
chapters.zh: 日头正落的时候，亚伯兰沉沉地睡了；忽然有惊人的大黑暗落在他身上。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Abram, “Know for certain that your descendants will be strangers in a land that is not their own, and they will be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对亚伯兰说：「你要的确知道，你的后裔必寄居别人的地，又服事那地的人；那地的人要苦待他们四百年。

chapters.en: But I will judge the nation they serve as slaves, and afterward they will depart with many possessions.
chapters.zh: 并且他们所要服事的那国，我要惩罚，后来他们必带着许多财物从那里出来。

chapters.en: You, however, will go to your fathers in peace and be buried at a ripe old age.
chapters.zh: 但你要享大寿数，平平安安地归到你列祖那里，被人埋葬。

chapters.en: In the fourth generation your descendants will return here, for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet complete.”
chapters.zh: 到了第四代，他们必回到此地，因为亚摩利人的罪孽还没有满盈。」

chapters.en: When the sun had set and darkness had fallen, behold, a smoking firepot and a flaming torch appeared and passed between the halves of the carcasses.
chapters.zh: 日落天黑，不料有冒烟的炉并烧着的火把从那些肉块中经过。

chapters.en: On that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, “To your descendants I have given this land—from the river of Egypt to the great River Euphrates—
chapters.zh: 当那日，耶和华与亚伯兰立约，说：「我已赐给你的后裔，从埃及河直到幼发拉底大河之地，

chapters.en: the land of the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites,
chapters.zh: 就是基尼人、基尼洗人、甲摩尼人、

chapters.en: Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaites,
chapters.zh: 赫人、比利洗人、利乏音人、

chapters.en: Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites, and Jebusites.”
chapters.zh: 亚摩利人、迦南人、革迦撒人、耶布斯人之地。」

chapters.en: Now Abram’s wife Sarai had borne him no children, but she had an Egyptian maidservant named Hagar.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰的妻子撒莱不给他生儿女。撒莱有一个使女，名叫夏甲，是埃及人。

chapters.en:
So Sarai said to Abram, “Look now, the LORD has prevented me from bearing children. Please go to my maidservant; perhaps I can build a family by her.”
And Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.
chapters.zh: 撒莱对亚伯兰说：「耶和华使我不能生育。求你和我的使女同房，或者我可以因她得孩子〔注：得孩子：原文是被建立〕。」亚伯兰听从了撒莱的话。

chapters.en: So after he had lived in Canaan for ten years, his wife Sarai took her Egyptian maidservant Hagar and gave her to Abram to be his wife.
chapters.zh: 于是亚伯兰的妻子撒莱将使女埃及人夏甲给了丈夫为妾；那时亚伯兰在迦南已经住了十年。

chapters.en: And he slept with Hagar, and she conceived. But when Hagar realized that she was pregnant, she began to despise her mistress.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰与夏甲同房，夏甲就怀了孕；她见自己有孕，就小看她的主母。

chapters.en: Then Sarai said to Abram, “May the wrong done to me be upon you! I delivered my servant into your arms, and ever since she saw that she was pregnant, she has treated me with contempt. May the LORD judge between you and me.”
chapters.zh: 撒莱对亚伯兰说：「我因你受屈。我将我的使女放在你怀中，她见自己有了孕，就小看我。愿耶和华在你我中间判断。」

chapters.en: “Here,” said Abram, “your servant is in your hands. Do whatever you want with her.” Then Sarai treated Hagar so harshly that she fled from her.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰对撒莱说：「使女在你手下，你可以随意待她。」撒莱苦待她，她就从撒莱面前逃走了。

chapters.en: Now the angel of the LORD found Hagar by a spring of water in the desert—the spring along the road to Shur.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者在旷野书珥路上的水泉旁遇见她，

chapters.en:
“Hagar, servant of Sarai,” he said, “where have you come from, and where are you going?”
“I am running away from my mistress Sarai,” she replied.
chapters.zh: 对她说：「撒莱的使女夏甲，你从哪里来？要往哪里去？」夏甲说：「我从我的主母撒莱面前逃出来。」

chapters.en: So the angel of the LORD told her, “Return to your mistress and submit to her authority.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者对她说：「你回到你主母那里，服在她手下」；

chapters.en: Then the angel added, “I will greatly multiply your offspring so that they will be too numerous to count.”
chapters.zh: 又说：「我必使你的后裔极其繁多，甚至不可胜数」；

chapters.en:
The angel of the LORD proceeded:
“Behold, you have conceived and will bear a son. And you shall name him Ishmael,
for the LORD has heard your cry of affliction.
chapters.zh: 并说：「你如今怀孕要生一个儿子，可以给他起名叫以实玛利〔注：就是上帝听见的意思〕，因为耶和华听见了你的苦情。

chapters.en:
He will be a wild donkey of a man, and his hand will be against everyone,
and everyone’s hand against him; he will live in hostility toward all his brothers.”
chapters.zh: 他为人必像野驴。他的手要攻打人，人的手也要攻打他；他必住在众弟兄的东边。」

chapters.en: So Hagar gave this name to the LORD who had spoken to her: “You are the God who sees me, ” for she said, “Here I have seen the One who sees me!”
chapters.zh: 夏甲就称那对她说话的耶和华为「看顾人的上帝」。因而说：「在这里我也看见那看顾我的吗？」

chapters.en: Therefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi. It is located between Kadesh and Bered.
chapters.zh: 所以这井名叫庇耳‧拉海‧莱。这井正在加低斯和巴列中间。

chapters.en: And Hagar bore Abram a son, and Abram gave the name Ishmael to the son she had borne.
chapters.zh: 后来夏甲给亚伯兰生了一个儿子；亚伯兰给他起名叫以实玛利。

chapters.en: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to him.
chapters.zh: 夏甲给亚伯兰生以实玛利的时候，亚伯兰年八十六岁。

chapters.en: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to him and said, “I am God Almighty. Walk before Me and be blameless.
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰年九十九岁的时候，耶和华向他显现，对他说：「我是全能的上帝。你当在我面前作完全人，

chapters.en: I will establish My covenant between Me and you, and I will multiply you exceedingly.”
chapters.zh: 我就与你立约，使你〔的后裔〕极其繁多。」

chapters.en: Then Abram fell facedown, and God said to him,
chapters.zh: 亚伯兰俯伏在地；上帝又对他说：

chapters.en: “As for Me, this is My covenant with you: You will be the father of many nations.
chapters.zh: 「我与你立约：你要作多国的父。

chapters.en: No longer will you be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham, for I have made you a father of many nations.
chapters.zh: 从此以后，你的名不再叫亚伯兰，要叫亚伯拉罕，因为我已立你作多国的父。

chapters.en: I will make you exceedingly fruitful; I will make nations of you, and kings will descend from you.
chapters.zh: 我必使你〔的后裔〕极其繁多；国度从你而立，君王从你而出。

chapters.en: I will establish My covenant as an everlasting covenant between Me and you and your descendants after you, to be your God and the God of your descendants after you.
chapters.zh: 我要与你并你世世代代的后裔坚立我的约，作永远的约，是要作你和你后裔的上帝。

chapters.en: And to you and your descendants I will give the land where you are residing—all the land of Canaan—as an eternal possession; and I will be their God.”
chapters.zh: 我要将你现在寄居的地，就是迦南全地，赐给你和你的后裔永远为业，我也必作他们的上帝。」

chapters.en: God also said to Abraham, “You must keep My covenant—you and your descendants in the generations after you.
chapters.zh: 上帝又对亚伯拉罕说：「你和你的后裔必世世代代遵守我的约。

chapters.en: This is My covenant with you and your descendants after you, which you are to keep: Every male among you must be circumcised.
chapters.zh: 你们所有的男子都要受割礼；这就是我与你并你的后裔所立的约，是你们所当遵守的。

chapters.en: You are to circumcise the flesh of your foreskin, and this will be a sign of the covenant between Me and you.
chapters.zh: 你们都要受割礼〔注：原文是割阳皮；十四、二十三、二十四、二十五节同〕；这是我与你们立约的证据。

chapters.en: Generation after generation, every male must be circumcised when he is eight days old, including those born in your household and those purchased from a foreigner—even those who are not your offspring.
chapters.zh: 你们世世代代的男子，无论是家里生的，是在你后裔之外用银子从外人买的，生下来第八日，都要受割礼。

chapters.en: Whether they are born in your household or purchased, they must be circumcised. My covenant in your flesh will be an everlasting covenant.
chapters.zh: 你家里生的和你用银子买的，都必须受割礼。这样，我的约就立在你们肉体上作永远的约。

chapters.en: But if any male is not circumcised, he will be cut off from his people; he has broken My covenant.”
chapters.zh: 但不受割礼的男子必从民中剪除，因他背了我的约。」

chapters.en: Then God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, do not call her Sarai, for her name is to be Sarah.
chapters.zh: 上帝又对亚伯拉罕说：「你的妻子撒莱不可再叫撒莱，她的名要叫撒拉。

chapters.en: And I will bless her and will surely give you a son by her. I will bless her, and she will be the mother of nations; kings of peoples will descend from her.”
chapters.zh: 我必赐福给她，也要使你从她得一个儿子。我要赐福给她，她也要作多国之〔母〕；必有百姓的君王从她而出。」

chapters.en: Abraham fell facedown. Then he laughed and said to himself, “Can a child be born to a man who is a hundred years old? Can Sarah give birth at the age of ninety?”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕就俯伏在地喜笑，心里说：「一百岁的人还能得孩子吗？撒拉已经九十岁了，还能生养吗？」

chapters.en: And Abraham said to God, “O that Ishmael might live under Your blessing!”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕对上帝说：「但愿以实玛利活在你面前。」

chapters.en: But God replied, “Your wife Sarah will indeed bear you a son, and you are to name him Isaac. I will establish My covenant with him as an everlasting covenant for his descendants after him.
chapters.zh: 上帝说：「不然，你妻子撒拉要给你生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫以撒。我要与他坚定所立的约，作他后裔永远的约。

chapters.en: As for Ishmael, I have heard you, and I will surely bless him; I will make him fruitful and multiply him greatly. He will become the father of twelve rulers, and I will make him into a great nation.
chapters.zh: 至于以实玛利，我也应允你：我必赐福给他，使他昌盛，极其繁多。他必生十二个族长；我也要使他成为大国。

chapters.en: But I will establish My covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this time next year.”
chapters.zh: 到明年这时节，撒拉必给你生以撒，我要与他坚定所立的约。」

chapters.en: When He had finished speaking with Abraham, God went up from him.
chapters.zh: 上帝和亚伯拉罕说完了话，就离开他上升去了。

chapters.en: On that very day Abraham took his son Ishmael and all those born in his household or purchased with his money—every male among the members of Abraham’s household—and he circumcised them, just as God had told him.
chapters.zh: 正当那日，亚伯拉罕遵着上帝的命，给他的儿子以实玛利和家里的一切男子，无论是在家里生的，是用银子买的，都行了割礼。

chapters.en: So Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised,
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕受割礼的时候年九十九岁。

chapters.en: and his son Ishmael was thirteen;
chapters.zh: 他儿子以实玛利受割礼的时候年十三岁。

chapters.en: Abraham and his son Ishmael were circumcised on the same day.
chapters.zh: 正当那日，亚伯拉罕和他儿子以实玛利一同受了割礼。

chapters.en: And all the men of Abraham’s household—both servants born in his household and those purchased from foreigners—were circumcised with him.
chapters.zh: 家里所有的人，无论是在家里生的，是用银子从外人买的，也都一同受了割礼。

chapters.en: Then the LORD appeared to Abraham by the Oaks of Mamre in the heat of the day, while he was sitting at the entrance of his tent.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在幔利橡树那里向亚伯拉罕显现出来。那时正热，亚伯拉罕坐在帐棚门口，

chapters.en: And Abraham looked up and saw three men standing nearby. When he saw them, he ran from the entrance of his tent to meet them and bowed low to the ground.
chapters.zh: 举目观看，见有三个人在对面站着。他一见，就从帐棚门口跑去迎接他们，俯伏在地，

chapters.en: “My lord,” said Abraham, “if I have found favor in your sight, please do not pass your servant by.
chapters.zh: 说：「我主，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你不要离开仆人往前去。

chapters.en: Let a little water be brought, that you may wash your feet and rest yourselves under the tree.
chapters.zh: 容我拿点水来，你们洗洗脚，在树下歇息歇息。

chapters.en:
And I will bring a bit of bread so that you may refresh yourselves. This is why you have passed your servant’s way. After that, you may continue on your way.”
“Yes,” they replied, “you may do as you have said.”
chapters.zh: 我再拿一点饼来，你们可以加添心力，然后往前去。你们既到仆人这里来，理当如此。」他们说：「就照你说的行吧。」

chapters.en: So Abraham hurried into the tent and said to Sarah, “Quick! Prepare three seahs of fine flour, knead it, and bake some bread.”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕急忙进帐棚见撒拉，说：「你速速拿三细亚细面调和做饼。」

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Abraham ran to the herd, selected a tender and choice calf, and gave it to a servant, who hurried to prepare it.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕又跑到牛群里，牵了一只又嫩又好的牛犊来，交给仆人，仆人急忙预备好了。

chapters.en: Then Abraham brought curds and milk and the calf that had been prepared, and he set them before the men and stood by them under the tree as they ate.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕又取了奶油和奶，并预备好的牛犊来，摆在他们面前，自己在树下站在旁边，他们就吃了。

chapters.en:
“Where is your wife Sarah?” they asked.
“There, in the tent,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 他们问亚伯拉罕说：「你妻子撒拉在哪里？」他说：「在帐棚里。」

chapters.en:
Then the LORD said, “I will surely return to you at this time next year, and your wife Sarah will have a son!”
Now Sarah was behind him, listening at the entrance to the tent.
chapters.zh: 三人中有一位说：「到明年这时候，我必要回到你这里；你的妻子撒拉必生一个儿子。」撒拉在那人后边的帐棚门口也听见了这话。

chapters.en: And Abraham and Sarah were already old and well along in years; Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕和撒拉年纪老迈，撒拉的月经已断绝了。

chapters.en: So she laughed to herself, saying, “After I am worn out and my master is old, will I now have this pleasure?”
chapters.zh: 撒拉心里暗笑，说：「我既已衰败，我主也老迈，岂能有这喜事呢？」

chapters.en: And the LORD asked Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh and say, ‘Can I really bear a child when I am old?’
chapters.zh: 耶和华对亚伯拉罕说：「撒拉为什么暗笑，说：『我既已年老，果真能生养吗？』

chapters.en: Is anything too difficult for the LORD? At the appointed time I will return to you—in about a year—and Sarah will have a son.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华岂有难成的事吗？到了日期，明年这时候，我必回到你这里，撒拉必生一个儿子。」

chapters.en:
But Sarah was afraid, so she denied it and said, “I did not laugh.”
“No,” replied the LORD, “but you did laugh.”
chapters.zh: 撒拉就害怕，不承认，说：「我没有笑。」那位说：「不然，你实在笑了。」

chapters.en: When the men got up to leave, they looked out over Sodom, and Abraham walked along with them to see them off.
chapters.zh: 三人就从那里起行，向所多玛观看，亚伯拉罕也与他们同行，要送他们一程。

chapters.en: And the LORD said, “Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do?
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我所要做的事岂可瞒着亚伯拉罕呢？

chapters.en: Abraham will surely become a great and powerful nation, and through him all the nations of the earth will be blessed.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕必要成为强大的国；地上的万国都必因他得福。

chapters.en: For I have chosen him, so that he will command his children and his household after him to keep the way of the LORD by doing what is right and just, in order that the LORD may bring upon Abraham what He has promised.”
chapters.zh: 我眷顾他，为要叫他吩咐他的众子和他的眷属遵守我的道，秉公行义，使我所应许亚伯拉罕的话都成就了。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said, “The outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is great. Because their sin is so grievous,
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「所多玛和蛾摩拉的罪恶甚重，声闻于我。

chapters.en: I will go down to see if their actions fully justify the outcry that has reached Me. If not, I will find out.”
chapters.zh: 我现在要下去，察看他们所行的，果然尽像那达到我耳中的声音一样吗？若是不然，我也必知道。」

chapters.en: And the two men turned away and went toward Sodom, but Abraham remained standing before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 二人转身离开那里，向所多玛去；但亚伯拉罕仍旧站在耶和华面前。

chapters.en: Abraham stepped forward and said, “Will You really sweep away the righteous with the wicked?
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕近前来，说：「无论善恶，你都要剿灭吗？

chapters.en: What if there are fifty righteous ones in the city? Will You really sweep it away and not spare the place for the sake of the fifty righteous ones who are there?
chapters.zh: 假若那城里有五十个义人，你还剿灭那地方吗？不为城里这五十个义人饶恕其中的人吗？

chapters.en: Far be it from You to do such a thing—to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous and the wicked are treated alike. Far be it from You! Will not the Judge of all the earth do what is right?”
chapters.zh: 将义人与恶人同杀，将义人与恶人一样看待，这断不是你所行的。审判全地的主岂不行公义吗？」

chapters.en: So the LORD replied, “If I find fifty righteous ones within the city of Sodom, on their account I will spare the whole place.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我若在所多玛城里见有五十个义人，我就为他们的缘故饶恕那地方的众人。」

chapters.en: Then Abraham answered, “Now that I have ventured to speak to the Lord—though I am but dust and ashes—
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：「我虽然是灰尘，还敢对主说话。

chapters.en:
suppose the fifty righteous ones lack five. Will You destroy the whole city for the lack of five?”
He replied, “If I find forty-five there, I will not destroy it.”
chapters.zh: 假若这五十个义人短了五个，你就因为短了五个毁灭全城吗？」他说：「我在那里若见有四十五个，也不毁灭那城。」

chapters.en:
Once again Abraham spoke to the LORD, “Suppose forty are found there?”
He answered, “On account of the forty, I will not do it.”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕又对他说：「假若在那里见有四十个怎么样呢？」他说：「为这四十个的缘故，我也不做这事。」

chapters.en:
Then Abraham said, “May the Lord not be angry, but let me speak further. Suppose thirty are found there?”
He replied, “If I find thirty there, I will not do it.”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：「求主不要动怒，容我说，假若在那里见有三十个怎么样呢？」他说：「我在那里若见有三十个，我也不做这事。」

chapters.en:
And Abraham said, “Now that I have ventured to speak to the Lord, suppose twenty are found there?”
He answered, “On account of the twenty, I will not destroy it.”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：「我还敢对主说话，假若在那里见有二十个怎么样呢？」他说：「为这二十个的缘故，我也不毁灭那城。」

chapters.en:
Finally, Abraham said, “May the Lord not be angry, but let me speak once more. Suppose ten are found there?”
And He answered, “On account of the ten, I will not destroy it.”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：「求主不要动怒，我再说这一次，假若在那里见有十个呢？」他说：「为这十个的缘故，我也不毁灭那城。」

chapters.en: When the LORD had finished speaking with Abraham, He departed, and Abraham returned home.
chapters.zh: 耶和华与亚伯拉罕说完了话就走了；亚伯拉罕也回到自己的地方去了。

chapters.en: Now the two angels arrived at Sodom in the evening, and Lot was sitting in the gateway of the city. When Lot saw them, he got up to meet them, bowed facedown,
chapters.zh: 那两个天使晚上到了所多玛；罗得正坐在所多玛城门口，看见他们，就起来迎接，脸伏于地下拜，

chapters.en:
and said, “My lords, please turn aside into the house of your servant; wash your feet and spend the night. Then you can rise early and go on your way.”
“No,” they answered, “we will spend the night in the square.”
chapters.zh: 说：「我主啊，请你们到仆人家里洗洗脚，住一夜，清早起来再走。」他们说：「不！我们要在街上过夜。」

chapters.en: But Lot insisted so strongly that they followed him into his house. He prepared a feast for them and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.
