chapters.zh: 罗得切切地请他们，他们这才进去，到他屋里。罗得为他们预备筵席，烤无酵饼，他们就吃了。

chapters.en: Before they had gone to bed, all the men of the city of Sodom, both young and old, surrounded the house.
chapters.zh: 他们还没有躺下，所多玛城里各处的人，连老带少，都来围住那房子，

chapters.en: They called out to Lot, saying, “Where are the men who came to you tonight? Send them out to us so we can have relations with them!”
chapters.zh: 呼叫罗得说：「今日晚上到你这里来的人在哪里呢？把他们带出来，任我们所为。」

chapters.en: Lot went outside to meet them, shutting the door behind him.
chapters.zh: 罗得出来，把门关上，到众人那里，

chapters.en: “Please, my brothers,” he pleaded, “don’t do such a wicked thing!
chapters.zh: 说：「众弟兄，请你们不要做这恶事。

chapters.en: Look, I have two daughters who have never slept with a man. Let me bring them to you, and you can do to them as you please. But do not do anything to these men, for they have come under the protection of my roof.”
chapters.zh: 我有两个女儿，还是处女，容我领出来，任凭你们的心愿而行；只是这两个人既然到我舍下，不要向他们做什么。」

chapters.en: “Get out of the way!” they replied. And they declared, “This one came here as a foreigner, and he is already acting like a judge! Now we will treat you worse than them.” And they pressed in on Lot and moved in to break down the door.
chapters.zh: 众人说：「退去吧！」又说：「这个人来寄居，还想要作官哪！现在我们要害你比害他们更甚。」众人就向前拥挤罗得，要攻破房门。

chapters.en: But the men inside reached out, pulled Lot into the house with them, and shut the door.
chapters.zh: 只是那二人伸出手来，将罗得拉进屋去，把门关上，

chapters.en: And they struck the men at the entrance, young and old, with blindness, so that they wearied themselves trying to find the door.
chapters.zh: 并且使门外的人，无论老少，眼都昏迷；他们摸来摸去，总寻不着房门。

chapters.en: Then the two men said to Lot, “Do you have anyone else here—a son-in-law, your sons or daughters, or anyone else in the city who belongs to you? Get them out of here,
chapters.zh: 二人对罗得说：「你这里还有什么人吗？无论是女婿是儿女，和这城中一切属你的人，你都要将他们从这地方带出去。

chapters.en: because we are about to destroy this place. For the outcry to the LORD against its people is so great that He has sent us to destroy it.”
chapters.zh: 我们要毁灭这地方；因为城内罪恶的声音在耶和华面前甚大，耶和华差我们来，要毁灭这地方。」

chapters.en: So Lot went out and spoke to the sons-in-law who were pledged in marriage to his daughters. “Get up,” he said. “Get out of this place, for the LORD is about to destroy the city!” But his sons-in-law thought he was joking.
chapters.zh: 罗得就出去，告诉娶了〔注：或译：将要娶〕他女儿的女婿们说：「你们起来离开这地方，因为耶和华要毁灭这城。」他女婿们却以为他说的是戏言。

chapters.en: At daybreak the angels hurried Lot along, saying, “Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, or you will be swept away in the punishment of the city.”
chapters.zh: 天明了，天使催逼罗得说：「起来！带着你的妻子和你在这里的两个女儿出去，免得你因这城里的罪恶同被剿灭。」

chapters.en: But when Lot hesitated, the men grabbed his hand and the hands of his wife and his two daughters. And they led them safely out of the city, because of the LORD’s compassion for them.
chapters.zh: 但罗得迟延不走。二人因为耶和华怜恤罗得，就拉着他的手和他妻子的手，并他两个女儿的手，把他们领出来，安置在城外；

chapters.en: As soon as the men had brought them out, one of them said, “Run for your lives! Do not look back, and do not stop anywhere on the plain! Flee to the mountains, or you will be swept away!”
chapters.zh: 领他们出来以后，就说：「逃命吧！不可回头看，也不可在平原站住。要往山上逃跑，免得你被剿灭。」

chapters.en: But Lot replied, “No, my lords, please!
chapters.zh: 罗得对他们说：「我主啊，不要如此！

chapters.en: Your servant has indeed found favor in your sight, and you have shown me great kindness by sparing my life. But I cannot run to the mountains; the disaster will overtake me, and I will die.
chapters.zh: 你仆人已经在你眼前蒙恩；你又向我显出莫大的慈爱，救我的性命。我不能逃到山上去，恐怕这灾祸临到我，我便死了。

chapters.en: Look, there is a town nearby where I can flee, and it is a small place. Please let me flee there—is it not a small place? Then my life will be saved.”
chapters.zh: 看哪，这座城又小又近，容易逃到，这不是一个小的吗？求你容我逃到那里，我的性命就得存活。」

chapters.en: “Very well,” he answered, “I will grant this request as well, and will not demolish the town you indicate.
chapters.zh: 天使对他说：「这事我也应允你；我不倾覆你所说的这城。

chapters.en: Hurry! Run there quickly, for I cannot do anything until you reach it.” That is why the town was called Zoar.
chapters.zh: 你要速速地逃到那城；因为你还没有到那里，我不能做什么。」因此那城名叫琐珥〔注：就是小的意思〕。

chapters.en: And by the time the sun had risen over the land, Lot had reached Zoar.
chapters.zh: 罗得到了琐珥，日头已经出来了。

chapters.en: Then the LORD rained down sulfur and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah—from the LORD out of the heavens.
chapters.zh: 当时，耶和华将硫磺与火从天上耶和华那里降与所多玛和蛾摩拉，

chapters.en: Thus He destroyed these cities and the entire plain, including all the inhabitants of the cities and everything that grew on the ground.
chapters.zh: 把那些城和全平原，并城里所有的居民，连地上生长的，都毁灭了。

chapters.en: But Lot’s wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.
chapters.zh: 罗得的妻子在后边回头一看，就变成了一根盐柱。

chapters.en: Early the next morning, Abraham got up and returned to the place where he had stood before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕清早起来，到了他从前站在耶和华面前的地方，

chapters.en: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah and all the land of the plain, and he saw the smoke rising from the land like smoke from a furnace.
chapters.zh: 向所多玛和蛾摩拉与平原的全地观看，不料，那地方烟气上腾，如同烧窑一般。

chapters.en: So when God destroyed the cities of the plain, He remembered Abraham, and He brought Lot out of the catastrophe that destroyed the cities where he had lived.
chapters.zh: 当上帝毁灭平原诸城的时候，他记念亚伯拉罕，正在倾覆罗得所住之城的时候，就打发罗得从倾覆之中出来。

chapters.en: Lot and his two daughters left Zoar and settled in the mountains—for he was afraid to stay in Zoar—where they lived in a cave.
chapters.zh: 罗得因为怕住在琐珥，就同他两个女儿从琐珥上去，住在山里；他和两个女儿住在一个洞里。

chapters.en: One day the older daughter said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is no man in the land to sleep with us, as is the custom over all the earth.
chapters.zh: 大女儿对小女儿说：「我们的父亲老了，地上又无人按着世上的常规进到我们这里。

chapters.en: Come, let us get our father drunk with wine so we can sleep with him and preserve his line.”
chapters.zh: 来！我们可以叫父亲喝酒，与他同寝。这样，我们好从他存留后裔。」

chapters.en: So that night they got their father drunk with wine, and the firstborn went in and slept with her father; he was not aware when she lay down or when she got up.
chapters.zh: 于是，那夜她们叫父亲喝酒，大女儿就进去和她父亲同寝；她几时躺下，几时起来，父亲都不知道。

chapters.en: The next day the older daughter said to the younger, “Look, I slept with my father last night. Let us get him drunk with wine again tonight so you can go in and sleep with him and we can preserve our father’s line.”
chapters.zh: 第二天，大女儿对小女儿说：「我昨夜与父亲同寝。今夜我们再叫他喝酒，你可以进去与他同寝。这样，我们好从父亲存留后裔。」

chapters.en: So again that night they got their father drunk with wine, and the younger daughter went in and slept with him; he was not aware when she lay down or when she got up.
chapters.zh: 于是，那夜她们又叫父亲喝酒，小女儿起来与她父亲同寝；她几时躺下，几时起来，父亲都不知道。

chapters.en: Thus both of Lot’s daughters became pregnant by their father.
chapters.zh: 这样，罗得的两个女儿都从她父亲怀了孕。

chapters.en: The older daughter gave birth to a son and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites of today.
chapters.zh: 大女儿生了儿子，给他起名叫摩押，就是现今摩押人的始祖。

chapters.en: The younger daughter also gave birth to a son, and she named him Ben-ammi. He is the father of the Ammonites of today.
chapters.zh: 小女儿也生了儿子，给他起名叫便‧亚米，就是现今亚扪人的始祖。

chapters.en: Now Abraham journeyed from there to the region of the Negev and settled between Kadesh and Shur. While he was staying in Gerar,
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕从那里向南地迁去，寄居在加低斯和书珥中间的基拉耳。

chapters.en: Abraham said of his wife Sarah, “She is my sister.” So Abimelech king of Gerar had Sarah brought to him.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕称他的妻撒拉为妹子，基拉耳王亚比米勒差人把撒拉取了去。

chapters.en: One night, however, God came to Abimelech in a dream and told him, “You are as good as dead because of the woman you have taken, for she is a married woman.”
chapters.zh: 但夜间，上帝来，在梦中对亚比米勒说：「你是个死人哪！因为你取了那女人来；她原是别人的妻子。」

chapters.en: Now Abimelech had not gone near her, so he replied, “Lord, would You destroy a nation even though it is innocent?
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒却还没有亲近撒拉；他说：「主啊，连有义的国，你也要毁灭吗？

chapters.en: Didn’t Abraham tell me, ‘She is my sister’? And she herself said, ‘He is my brother.’ I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.”
chapters.zh: 那人岂不是自己对我说『她是我的妹子』吗？就是女人也自己说：『他是我的哥哥。』我做这事是心正手洁的。」

chapters.en: Then God said to Abimelech in the dream, “Yes, I know that you did this with a clear conscience, and so I have kept you from sinning against Me. That is why I did not let you touch her.
chapters.zh: 上帝在梦中对他说：「我知道你做这事是心中正直；我也拦阻了你，免得你得罪我，所以我不容你沾着她。

chapters.en: Now return the man’s wife, for he is a prophet; he will pray for you and you will live. But if you do not restore her, be aware that you will surely die—you and all who belong to you.”
chapters.zh: 现在你把这人的妻子归还他；因为他是先知，他要为你祷告，使你存活。你若不归还他，你当知道，你和你所有的人都必要死。」

chapters.en: Early the next morning Abimelech got up and summoned all his servants; and when he described to them all that had happened, the men were terrified.
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒清早起来，召了众臣仆来，将这些事都说给他们听，他们都甚惧怕。

chapters.en: Then Abimelech called Abraham and asked, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought such tremendous guilt upon me and my kingdom? You have done things to me that should not be done.”
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒召了亚伯拉罕来，对他说：「你怎么向我这样行呢？我在什么事上得罪了你，你竟使我和我国里的人陷在大罪里？你向我行不当行的事了！」

chapters.en: Abimelech also asked Abraham, “What prompted you to do such a thing?”
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒又对亚伯拉罕说：「你见了什么才做这事呢？」

chapters.en: Abraham replied, “I thought to myself, ‘Surely there is no fear of God in this place. They will kill me on account of my wife.’
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：「我以为这地方的人总不惧怕上帝，必为我妻子的缘故杀我。

chapters.en: Besides, she really is my sister, the daughter of my father—though not the daughter of my mother—and she became my wife.
chapters.zh: 况且她也实在是我的妹子；她与我是同父异母，后来作了我的妻子。

chapters.en: So when God had me journey from my father’s house, I said to Sarah, ‘This is how you can show your loyalty to me: Wherever we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”
chapters.zh: 当上帝叫我离开父家、飘流在外的时候，我对她说：『我们无论走到什么地方，你可以对人说：他是我的哥哥；这就是你待我的恩典了。』」

chapters.en: So Abimelech brought sheep and cattle, menservants and maidservants, and he gave them to Abraham and restored his wife Sarah to him.
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒把牛、羊、仆婢赐给亚伯拉罕，又把他的妻子撒拉归还他。

chapters.en: And Abimelech said, “Look, my land is before you. Settle wherever you please.”
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒又说：「看哪，我的地都在你面前，你可以随意居住」；

chapters.en: And he said to Sarah, “See, I am giving your brother a thousand pieces of silver. It is your vindication before all who are with you; you are completely cleared.”
chapters.zh: 又对撒拉说：「我给你哥哥一千银子，作为你在合家人面前遮羞的〔注：羞：原文是眼〕，你就在众人面前没有不是了。」

chapters.en: Then Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech and his wife and his maidservants, so that they could again bear children—
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕祷告上帝，上帝就医好了亚比米勒和他的妻子，并他的众女仆，她们便能生育。

chapters.en: for on account of Abraham’s wife Sarah, the LORD had completely closed all the wombs in Abimelech’s household.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华为亚伯拉罕的妻子撒拉的缘故，已经使亚比米勒家中的妇人不能生育。

chapters.en: Now the LORD attended to Sarah as He had said, and the LORD did for Sarah what He had promised.
chapters.zh: 耶和华按着先前的话眷顾撒拉，便照他所说的给撒拉成就。

chapters.en: So Sarah conceived and bore a son to Abraham in his old age, at the very time God had promised.
chapters.zh: 当亚伯拉罕年老的时候，撒拉怀了孕；到上帝所说的日期，就给亚伯拉罕生了一个儿子。

chapters.en: And Abraham gave the name Isaac to the son Sarah bore to him.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕给撒拉所生的儿子起名叫以撒。

chapters.en: When his son Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him, as God had commanded him.
chapters.zh: 以撒生下来第八日，亚伯拉罕照着上帝所吩咐的，给以撒行了割礼。

chapters.en: Abraham was a hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.
chapters.zh: 他儿子以撒生的时候，亚伯拉罕年一百岁。

chapters.en: Then Sarah said, “God has made me laugh, and everyone who hears of this will laugh with me.”
chapters.zh: 撒拉说：「上帝使我喜笑，凡听见的必与我一同喜笑」；

chapters.en: She added, “Who would have told Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? Yet I have borne him a son in his old age.”
chapters.zh: 又说：「谁能预先对亚伯拉罕说『撒拉要乳养婴孩』呢？因为在他年老的时候，我给他生了一个儿子。」

chapters.en: So the child grew and was weaned, and Abraham held a great feast on the day Isaac was weaned.
chapters.zh: 孩子渐长，就断了奶。以撒断奶的日子，亚伯拉罕设摆丰盛的筵席。

chapters.en: But Sarah saw that the son whom Hagar the Egyptian had borne to Abraham was mocking her son,
chapters.zh: 当时，撒拉看见埃及人夏甲给亚伯拉罕所生的儿子戏笑，

chapters.en: and she said to Abraham, “Expel the slave woman and her son, for the slave woman’s son will never share in the inheritance with my son Isaac!”
chapters.zh: 就对亚伯拉罕说：「你把这使女和她儿子赶出去！因为这使女的儿子不可与我的儿子以撒一同承受产业。」

chapters.en: Now this matter distressed Abraham greatly because it concerned his son Ishmael.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕因他儿子的缘故很忧愁。

chapters.en: But God said to Abraham, “Do not be distressed about the boy and your maidservant. Listen to everything that Sarah tells you, for through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned.
chapters.zh: 上帝对亚伯拉罕说：「你不必为这童子和你的使女忧愁。凡撒拉对你说的话，你都该听从；因为从以撒生的，才要称为你的后裔。

chapters.en: But I will also make a nation of the slave woman’s son, because he is your offspring.”
chapters.zh: 至于使女的儿子，我也必使他〔的后裔〕成立一国，因为他是你所生的。」

chapters.en: Early in the morning, Abraham got up, took bread and a skin of water, put them on Hagar’s shoulders, and sent her away with the boy. She left and wandered in the Wilderness of Beersheba.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕清早起来，拿饼和一皮袋水，给了夏甲，搭在她的肩上，又把孩子〔交给她〕，打发她走。夏甲就走了，在别是巴的旷野走迷了路。

chapters.en: When the water in the skin was gone, she left the boy under one of the bushes.
chapters.zh: 皮袋的水用尽了，夏甲就把孩子撇在小树底下，

chapters.en: Then she went off and sat down nearby, about a bowshot away, for she said, “I cannot bear to watch the boy die!” And as she sat nearby, she lifted up her voice and wept.
chapters.zh: 自己走开约有一箭之远，相对而坐，说：「我不忍见孩子死」，就相对而坐，放声大哭。

chapters.en: Then God heard the voice of the boy, and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven, “What is wrong, Hagar? Do not be afraid, for God has heard the voice of the boy where he lies.
chapters.zh: 上帝听见童子的声音；上帝的使者从天上呼叫夏甲说：「夏甲，你为何这样呢？不要害怕，上帝已经听见童子的声音了。

chapters.en: Get up, lift up the boy, and take him by the hand, for I will make him into a great nation.”
chapters.zh: 起来！把童子抱在怀中〔注：怀：原文是手〕，我必使他〔的后裔〕成为大国。」

chapters.en: Then God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. So she went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink.
chapters.zh: 上帝使夏甲的眼睛明亮，她就看见一口水井，便去将皮袋盛满了水，给童子喝。

chapters.en: And God was with the boy, and he grew up and settled in the wilderness and became a great archer.
chapters.zh: 上帝保佑童子，他就渐长，住在旷野，成了弓箭手。

chapters.en: And while he was dwelling in the Wilderness of Paran, his mother got a wife for him from the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 他住在巴兰的旷野；他母亲从埃及地给他娶了一个妻子。

chapters.en: At that time Abimelech and Phicol the commander of his army said to Abraham, “God is with you in all that you do.
chapters.zh: 当那时候，亚比米勒同他军长非各对亚伯拉罕说：「凡你所行的事都有上帝的保佑。

chapters.en: Now, therefore, swear to me here before God that you will not deal falsely with me or my children or descendants. Show to me and to the country in which you reside the same kindness that I have shown to you.”
chapters.zh: 我愿你如今在这里指着上帝对我起誓，不要欺负我与我的儿子，并我的子孙。我怎样厚待了你，你也要照样厚待我与你所寄居这地的民。」

chapters.en: And Abraham replied, “I swear it.”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：「我情愿起誓。」

chapters.en: But when Abraham complained to Abimelech about a well that Abimelech’s servants had seized,
chapters.zh: 从前，亚比米勒的仆人霸占了一口水井，亚伯拉罕为这事指责亚比米勒。

chapters.en: Abimelech replied, “I do not know who has done this. You did not tell me, so I have not heard about it until today.”
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒说：「谁做这事，我不知道，你也没有告诉我，今日我才听见了。」

chapters.en: So Abraham brought sheep and cattle and gave them to Abimelech, and the two men made a covenant.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕把羊和牛给了亚比米勒，二人就彼此立约。

chapters.en: Abraham separated seven ewe lambs from the flock,
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕把七只母羊羔另放在一处。

chapters.en: and Abimelech asked him, “Why have you set apart these seven ewe lambs?”
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒问亚伯拉罕说：「你把这七只母羊羔另放在一处，是什么意思呢？」

chapters.en: He replied, “You are to accept the seven ewe lambs from my hand as my witness that I dug this well.”
chapters.zh: 他说：「你要从我手里受这七只母羊羔，作我挖这口井的证据。」

chapters.en: So that place was called Beersheba, because it was there that the two of them swore an oath.
chapters.zh: 所以他给那地方起名叫别是巴〔注：就是盟誓的井的意思〕，因为他们二人在那里起了誓。

chapters.en: After they had made the covenant at Beersheba, Abimelech and Phicol the commander of his army got up and returned to the land of the Philistines.
chapters.zh: 他们在别是巴立了约，亚比米勒就同他军长非各起身回非利士地去了。

chapters.en: And Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called upon the name of the LORD, the Eternal God.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕在别是巴栽上一棵垂丝柳树，又在那里求告耶和华－永生上帝的名。

chapters.en: And Abraham resided in the land of the Philistines for a long time.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕在非利士人的地寄居了多日。

chapters.en:
Some time later God tested Abraham and said to him, “Abraham!”
“Here I am,” he answered.
chapters.zh: 这些事以后，上帝要试验亚伯拉罕，就呼叫他说：「亚伯拉罕！」他说：「我在这里。」

chapters.en: “Take your son,” God said, “your only son Isaac, whom you love, and go to the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains, which I will show you.”
chapters.zh: 上帝说：「你带着你的儿子，就是你独生的儿子，你所爱的以撒，往摩利亚地去，在我所要指示你的山上，把他献为燔祭。」

chapters.en: So Abraham got up early the next morning, saddled his donkey, and took along two of his servants and his son Isaac. He split the wood for a burnt offering and set out for the place God had designated.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕清早起来，备上驴，带着两个仆人和他儿子以撒，也劈好了燔祭的柴，就起身往上帝所指示他的地方去了。

chapters.en: On the third day Abraham looked up and saw the place in the distance.
chapters.zh: 到了第三日，亚伯拉罕举目远远地看见那地方。

chapters.en: “Stay here with the donkey,” Abraham told his servants. “The boy and I will go over there to worship, and then we will return to you.”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕对他的仆人说：「你们和驴在此等候，我与童子往那里去拜一拜，就回到你们这里来。」

chapters.en: Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering and placed it on his son Isaac. He himself carried the fire and the sacrificial knife, and the two of them walked on together.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕把燔祭的柴放在他儿子以撒身上，自己手里拿着火与刀；于是二人同行。

chapters.en:
Then Isaac said to his father Abraham, “My father!”
“Here I am, my son,” he replied.
“The fire and the wood are here,” said Isaac, “but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?”
chapters.zh: 以撒对他父亲亚伯拉罕说：「父亲哪！」亚伯拉罕说：「我儿，我在这里。」以撒说：「请看，火与柴都有了，但燔祭的羊羔在哪里呢？」

chapters.en: Abraham answered, “God Himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son.” And the two walked on together.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：「我儿，上帝必自己预备作燔祭的羊羔。」于是二人同行。

chapters.en: When they arrived at the place God had designated, Abraham built the altar there and arranged the wood. He bound his son Isaac and placed him on the altar, atop the wood.
chapters.zh: 他们到了上帝所指示的地方，亚伯拉罕在那里筑坛，把柴摆好，捆绑他的儿子以撒，放在坛的柴上。

chapters.en: Then Abraham reached out his hand and took the knife to slaughter his son.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕就伸手拿刀，要杀他的儿子。

chapters.en:
Just then the angel of the LORD called out to him from heaven, “Abraham, Abraham!”
“Here I am,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者从天上呼叫他说：「亚伯拉罕！亚伯拉罕！」他说：「我在这里。」

chapters.en: “Do not lay a hand on the boy or do anything to him,” said the angel, “for now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your only son from me. ”
chapters.zh: 天使说：「你不可在这童子身上下手。一点不可害他！现在我知道你是敬畏上帝的了；因为你没有将你的儿子，就是你独生的儿子，留下不给我。」

chapters.en: Then Abraham looked up and saw behind him a ram in a thicket, caught by its horns. So he went and took the ram and offered it as a burnt offering in place of his son.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕举目观看，不料，有一只公羊，两角扣在稠密的小树中。亚伯拉罕就取了那只公羊来，献为燔祭，代替他的儿子。

chapters.en: And Abraham called that place The LORD Will Provide. So to this day it is said, “On the mountain of the LORD it will be provided.”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕给那地方起名叫「耶和华以勒」〔注：就是耶和华必预备的意思〕，直到今日人还说：「在耶和华的山上必有预备。」

chapters.en: And the angel of the LORD called to Abraham from heaven a second time,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者第二次从天上呼叫亚伯拉罕说：

chapters.en: saying, “By Myself I have sworn, declares the LORD, that because you have done this and have not withheld your only son,
chapters.zh: 「耶和华说：『你既行了这事，不留下你的儿子，就是你独生的儿子，我便指着自己起誓说：

chapters.en: I will surely bless you, and I will multiply your descendants like the stars in the sky and the sand on the seashore. Your descendants will possess the gates of their enemies.
chapters.zh: 论福，我必赐大福给你；论子孙，我必叫你的子孙多起来，如同天上的星，海边的沙。你子孙必得着仇敌的城门，

chapters.en: And through your offspring all nations of the earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice.”
chapters.zh: 并且地上万国都必因你的后裔得福，因为你听从了我的话。』」

chapters.en: Abraham went back to his servants, and they got up and set out together for Beersheba. And Abraham settled in Beersheba.
chapters.zh: 于是亚伯拉罕回到他仆人那里，他们一同起身往别是巴去，亚伯拉罕就住在别是巴。

chapters.en: Some time later, Abraham was told, “Milcah has also borne sons to your brother Nahor:
chapters.zh: 这事以后，有人告诉亚伯拉罕说：「密迦给你兄弟拿鹤生了几个儿子，

chapters.en: Uz the firstborn, his brother Buz, Kemuel (the father of Aram),
chapters.zh: 长子是乌斯，他的兄弟是布斯和亚兰的父亲基母利，

chapters.en: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”
chapters.zh: 并基薛、哈琐、必达、益拉、彼土利（彼土利生利百加）。」

chapters.en: And Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. Milcah bore these eight sons to Abraham’s brother Nahor.
chapters.zh: 这八个人都是密迦给亚伯拉罕的兄弟拿鹤生的。

chapters.en: Moreover, Nahor’s concubine, whose name was Reumah, bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
chapters.zh: 拿鹤的妾名叫流玛，生了提八、迦含、他辖，和玛迦。

chapters.en: Now Sarah lived to be 127 years old.
chapters.zh: 撒拉享寿一百二十七岁，这是撒拉一生的岁数。

chapters.en: She died in Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan, and Abraham went out to mourn and to weep for her.
chapters.zh: 撒拉死在迦南地的基列‧亚巴，就是希伯崙。亚伯拉罕为她哀恸哭号。

chapters.en: Then Abraham got up from beside his dead wife and said to the Hittites,
chapters.zh: 后来亚伯拉罕从死人面前起来，对赫人说：

chapters.en: “I am a foreigner and an outsider among you. Give me a burial site among you so that I can bury my dead.”
chapters.zh: 「我在你们中间是外人，是寄居的。求你们在这里给我一块地，我好埋葬我的死人，使她不在我眼前。」

chapters.en: The Hittites replied to Abraham,
chapters.zh: 赫人回答亚伯拉罕说：

chapters.en: “Listen to us, sir. You are God’s chosen one among us. Bury your dead in the finest of our tombs. None of us will withhold his tomb for burying your dead.”
chapters.zh: 「我主请听。你在我们中间是一位尊大的王子，只管在我们最好的坟地里埋葬你的死人；我们没有一人不容你在他的坟地里埋葬你的死人。」

chapters.en: Then Abraham rose and bowed down before the people of the land, the Hittites.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕就起来，向那地的赫人下拜，

chapters.en: “If you are willing for me to bury my dead,” he said to them, “listen to me, and approach Ephron son of Zohar on my behalf
chapters.zh: 对他们说：「你们若有意叫我埋葬我的死人，使她不在我眼前，就请听我的话，为我求琐辖的儿子以弗崙，

chapters.en: to sell me the cave of Machpelah that belongs to him; it is at the end of his field. Let him sell it to me in your presence for full price, so that I may have a burial site.”
chapters.zh: 把田头上那麦比拉洞给我，他可以按着足价卖给我，作我在你们中间的坟地。」

chapters.en: Now Ephron was sitting among the sons of Heth. So in the presence of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city, Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham,
chapters.zh: 当时以弗崙正坐在赫人中间。于是，赫人以弗崙在城门出入的赫人面前对亚伯拉罕说：

chapters.en: “No, my lord. Listen to me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. I give it to you in the presence of my people. Bury your dead.”
chapters.zh: 「不然，我主请听。我送给你这块田，连田间的洞也送给你，在我同族的人面前都给你，可以埋葬你的死人。」

chapters.en: Again Abraham bowed down before the people of the land
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕就在那地的人民面前下拜，

chapters.en: and said to Ephron in their presence, “If you will please listen to me, I will pay you the price of the field. Accept it from me, so that I may bury my dead there.”
chapters.zh: 在他们面前对以弗崙说：「你若应允，请听我的话。我要把田价给你，求你收下，我就在那里埋葬我的死人。」

chapters.en: Ephron answered Abraham,
chapters.zh: 以弗崙回答亚伯拉罕说：

chapters.en: “Listen to me, my lord. The land is worth four hundred shekels of silver, but what is that between you and me? Bury your dead.”
chapters.zh: 「我主请听。值四百舍客勒银子的一块田，在你我中间还算什么呢？只管埋葬你的死人吧！」

chapters.en: Abraham agreed to Ephron’s terms and weighed out for him the price he had named in the hearing of the Hittites: four hundred shekels of silver, according to the standard of the merchants.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕听从了以弗崙，照着他在赫人面前所说的话，把买卖通用的银子平了四百舍客勒给以弗崙。

chapters.en: So Ephron’s field at Machpelah near Mamre, the cave that was in it, and all the trees within the boundaries of the field were deeded over
chapters.zh: 于是，麦比拉、幔利前、以弗崙的那块田和其中的洞，并田间四围的树木，

chapters.en: to Abraham’s possession in the presence of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city.
chapters.zh: 都定准归与亚伯拉罕，乃是他在赫人面前并城门出入的人面前买妥的。

chapters.en: After this, Abraham buried his wife Sarah in the cave of the field at Machpelah near Mamre (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 此后，亚伯拉罕把他妻子撒拉埋葬在迦南地幔利前的麦比拉田间的洞里。（幔利就是希伯崙）。

chapters.en: So the field and its cave were deeded by the Hittites to Abraham as a burial site.
chapters.zh: 从此，那块田和田间的洞就藉着赫人定准归与亚伯拉罕作坟地。

chapters.en: By now Abraham was old and well along in years, and the LORD had blessed him in every way.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕年纪老迈，向来在一切事上耶和华都赐福给他。

chapters.en: So Abraham instructed the chief servant of his household, who managed all he owned, “Place your hand under my thigh,
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕对管理他全业最老的仆人说：「请你把手放在我大腿底下。

chapters.en: and I will have you swear by the LORD, the God of heaven and the God of earth, that you will not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites among whom I am dwelling,
chapters.zh: 我要叫你指着耶和华－天地的主起誓，不要为我儿子娶这迦南地中的女子为妻。

chapters.en: but will go to my country and my kindred to take a wife for my son Isaac.”
chapters.zh: 你要往我本地本族去，为我的儿子以撒娶一个妻子。」

chapters.en: The servant asked him, “What if the woman is unwilling to follow me to this land? Shall I then take your son back to the land from which you came?”
chapters.zh: 仆人对他说：「倘若女子不肯跟我到这地方来，我必须将你的儿子带回你原出之地吗？」

chapters.en: Abraham replied, “Make sure that you do not take my son back there.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕对他说：「你要谨慎，不要带我的儿子回那里去。

chapters.en: The LORD, the God of heaven, who brought me from my father’s house and my native land, who spoke to me and promised me on oath, saying, ‘To your offspring I will give this land’—He will send His angel before you so that you can take a wife for my son from there.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－天上的主曾带领我离开父家和本族的地，对我说话，向我起誓说：『我要将这地赐给你的后裔。』他必差遣使者在你面前，你就可以从那里为我儿子娶一个妻子。

chapters.en: And if the woman is unwilling to follow you, then you are released from this oath of mine. Only do not take my son back there.”
chapters.zh: 倘若女子不肯跟你来，我使你起的誓就与你无干了，只是不可带我的儿子回那里去。」

chapters.en: So the servant placed his hand under the thigh of his master Abraham and swore an oath to him concerning this matter.
chapters.zh: 仆人就把手放在他主人亚伯拉罕的大腿底下，为这事向他起誓。

chapters.en: Then the servant took ten of his master’s camels and departed with all manner of good things from his master in hand. And he set out for Nahor’s hometown in Aram-naharaim.
chapters.zh: 那仆人从他主人的骆驼里取了十匹骆驼，并带些他主人各样的财物，起身往美索不达米亚去，到了拿鹤的城。

chapters.en: As evening approached, he made the camels kneel down near the well outside the town at the time when the women went out to draw water.
chapters.zh: 天将晚，众女子出来打水的时候，他便叫骆驼跪在城外的水井那里。

chapters.en: “O LORD, God of my master Abraham,” he prayed, “please grant me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
chapters.zh: 他说：「耶和华－我主人亚伯拉罕的上帝啊，求你施恩给我主人亚伯拉罕，使我今日遇见好机会。

chapters.en: Here I am, standing beside the spring, and the daughters of the townspeople are coming out to draw water.
chapters.zh: 我现今站在井旁，城内居民的女子们正出来打水。

chapters.en: Now may it happen that the girl to whom I say, ‘Please let down your jar that I may drink,’ and who responds, ‘Drink, and I will water your camels as well’—let her be the one You have appointed for Your servant Isaac. By this I will know that You have shown kindness to my master.”
chapters.zh: 我向那一个女子说：『请你拿下水瓶来，给我水喝。』她若说：『请喝！我也给你的骆驼喝。』愿那女子就作你所预定给你仆人以撒的妻。这样，我便知道你施恩给我主人了。」

chapters.en: Before the servant had finished praying, Rebekah came out with her jar on her shoulder. She was the daughter of Bethuel son of Milcah, the wife of Abraham’s brother Nahor.
chapters.zh: 话还没有说完，不料，利百加肩头上扛着水瓶出来。利百加是彼土利所生的；彼土利是亚伯拉罕兄弟拿鹤妻子密迦的儿子。

chapters.en: Now the girl was very beautiful, a virgin who had not had relations with any man. She went down to the spring, filled her jar, and came up again.
chapters.zh: 那女子容貌极其俊美，还是处女，也未曾有人亲近她。她下到井旁，打满了瓶，又上来。

chapters.en: So the servant ran to meet her and said, “Please let me have a little water from your jar.”
chapters.zh: 仆人跑上前去迎着她，说：「求你将瓶里的水给我一点喝。」

chapters.en: “Drink, my lord,” she replied, and she quickly lowered her jar to her hands and gave him a drink.
chapters.zh: 女子说：「我主请喝！」就急忙拿下瓶来，托在手上给他喝。

chapters.en: After she had given him a drink, she said, “I will also draw water for your camels, until they have had enough to drink.”
chapters.zh: 女子给他喝了，就说：「我再为你的骆驼打水，叫骆驼也喝足。」

chapters.en: And she quickly emptied her jar into the trough and ran back to the well to draw water, until she had drawn water for all his camels.
chapters.zh: 她就急忙把瓶里的水倒在槽里，又跑到井旁打水，就为所有的骆驼打上水来。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, the man watched her silently to see whether or not the LORD had made his journey a success.
chapters.zh: 那人定睛看她，一句话也不说，要晓得耶和华赐他通达的道路没有。

chapters.en: And after the camels had finished drinking, he took out a gold ring weighing a beka, and two gold bracelets for her wrists weighing ten shekels.
chapters.zh: 骆驼喝足了，那人就拿一个金环，重半舍客勒，两个金镯，重十舍客勒，给了那女子，

chapters.en: “Whose daughter are you?” he asked. “Please tell me, is there room in your father’s house for us to spend the night?”
chapters.zh: 说：「请告诉我，你是谁的女儿？你父亲家里有我们住宿的地方没有？」

chapters.en: She replied, “I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son that Milcah bore to Nahor.”
chapters.zh: 女子说：「我是密迦与拿鹤之子彼土利的女儿」；

chapters.en: Then she added, “We have plenty of straw and feed, as well as a place for you to spend the night.”
chapters.zh: 又说：「我们家里足有粮草，也有住宿的地方。」

chapters.en: Then the man bowed down and worshiped the LORD,
chapters.zh: 那人就低头向耶和华下拜，

chapters.en: saying, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who has not withheld His kindness and faithfulness from my master. As for me, the LORD has led me on the journey to the house of my master’s relatives.”
chapters.zh: 说：「耶和华－我主人亚伯拉罕的上帝是应当称颂的，因他不断地以慈爱诚实待我主人。至于我，耶和华在路上引领我，直走到我主人的兄弟家里。」

chapters.en: The girl ran and told her mother’s household about these things.
chapters.zh: 女子跑回去，照着这些话告诉她母亲和她家里的人。

chapters.en: Now Rebekah had a brother named Laban, and he rushed out to the man at the spring.
As soon as he saw the ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s wrists, and heard Rebekah’s words, “The man said this to me,” he went and found the man standing by the camels near the spring.
chapters.zh: 利百加有一个哥哥，名叫拉班，看见金环，又看见金镯在他妹子的手上，并听见他妹子利百加的话，说那人对我如此如此说。拉班就跑出来往井旁去，到那人跟前，见他仍站在骆驼旁边的井旁那里，

chapters.en: “Come, you who are blessed by the LORD,” said Laban. “Why are you standing out here? I have prepared the house and a place for the camels.”
chapters.zh: 便对他说：「你这蒙耶和华赐福的，请进来，为什么站在外边？我已经收拾了房屋，也为骆驼预备了地方。」

chapters.en: So the man came to the house, and the camels were unloaded. Straw and feed were brought to the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of his companions.
chapters.zh: 那人就进了拉班的家。拉班卸了骆驼，用草料餵上，拿水给那人和跟随的人洗脚；

chapters.en:
Then a meal was set before the man, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told you what I came to say.”
So Laban said, “Please speak.”
chapters.zh: 把饭摆在他面前，叫他吃，他却说：「我不吃，等我说明白我的事情再吃。」拉班说：「请说。」

chapters.en: “I am Abraham’s servant,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 他说：「我是亚伯拉罕的仆人。

chapters.en: “The LORD has greatly blessed my master, and he has become rich. He has given him sheep and cattle, silver and gold, menservants and maidservants, camels and donkeys.
chapters.zh: 耶和华大大地赐福给我主人，使他昌大，又赐给他羊群、牛群、金银、仆婢、骆驼，和驴。

chapters.en: My master’s wife Sarah has borne him a son in her old age, and my master has given him everything he owns.
chapters.zh: 我主人的妻子撒拉年老的时候给我主人生了一个儿子；我主人也将一切所有的都给了这个儿子。

chapters.en: My master made me swear an oath and said, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites in whose land I dwell,
chapters.zh: 我主人叫我起誓说：『你不要为我儿子娶迦南地的女子为妻。

chapters.en: but you shall go to my father’s house and to my kindred to take a wife for my son.’
chapters.zh: 你要往我父家、我本族那里去，为我的儿子娶一个妻子。』

chapters.en: Then I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not come back with me?’
chapters.zh: 我对我主人说：『恐怕女子不肯跟我来。』

chapters.en: And he told me, ‘The LORD, before whom I have walked, will send His angel with you and make your journey a success, so that you may take a wife for my son from my kindred and from my father’s house.
chapters.zh: 他就说：『我所事奉的耶和华必要差遣他的使者与你同去，叫你的道路通达，你就得以在我父家、我本族那里，给我的儿子娶一个妻子。

chapters.en: And when you go to my kindred, if they refuse to give her to you, then you will be released from my oath.’
chapters.zh: 只要你到了我本族那里，我使你起的誓就与你无干。他们若不把女子交给你，我使你起的誓也与你无干。』

chapters.en: So when I came to the spring today, I prayed: O LORD, God of my master Abraham, if only You would make my journey a success!
chapters.zh: 「我今日到了井旁，便说：『耶和华－我主人亚伯拉罕的上帝啊，愿你叫我所行的道路通达。

chapters.en: Here I am, standing beside this spring. Now if a maiden comes out to draw water and I say to her, ‘Please let me drink a little water from your jar,’
chapters.zh: 我如今站在井旁，对哪一个出来打水的女子说：请你把你瓶里的水给我一点喝；

chapters.en: and she replies, ‘Drink, and I will draw water for your camels as well,’ may she be the woman the LORD has appointed for my master’s son.
chapters.zh: 她若说：你只管喝，我也为你的骆驼打水；愿那女子就作耶和华给我主人儿子所预定的妻。』

chapters.en: And before I had finished praying in my heart, there was Rebekah coming out with her jar on her shoulder, and she went down to the spring and drew water. So I said to her, ‘Please give me a drink.’
chapters.zh: 我心里的话还没有说完，利百加就出来，肩头上扛着水瓶，下到井旁打水。我便对她说：『请你给我水喝。』

chapters.en: She quickly lowered her jar from her shoulder and said, ‘Drink, and I will water your camels as well.’ So I drank, and she also watered the camels.
chapters.zh: 她就急忙从肩头上拿下瓶来，说：『请喝！我也给你的骆驼喝。』我便喝了；她又给我的骆驼喝了。

chapters.en:
Then I asked her, ‘Whose daughter are you?’
She replied, ‘The daughter of Bethuel son of Nahor, whom Milcah bore to him.’ So I put the ring on her nose and the bracelets on her wrists.
chapters.zh: 我问她说：『你是谁的女儿？』她说：『我是密迦与拿鹤之子彼土利的女儿。』我就把环子戴在她鼻子上，把镯子戴在她两手上。

chapters.en: Then I bowed down and worshiped the LORD; and I blessed the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who led me on the right road to take the granddaughter of my master’s brother for his son.
chapters.zh: 随后我低头向耶和华下拜，称颂耶和华－我主人亚伯拉罕的上帝；因为他引导我走合式的道路，使我得着我主人兄弟的孙女，给我主人的儿子为妻。

chapters.en: Now if you will show kindness and faithfulness to my master, tell me; but if not, let me know, so that I may go elsewhere.”
chapters.zh: 现在你们若愿以慈爱诚实待我主人，就告诉我；若不然，也告诉我，使我可以或向左，或向右。」

chapters.en: Laban and Bethuel answered, “This is from the LORD; we have no choice in the matter.
chapters.zh: 拉班和彼土利回答说：「这事乃出于耶和华，我们不能向你说好说歹。

chapters.en: Rebekah is here before you. Take her and go, and let her become the wife of your master’s son, just as the LORD has decreed.”
chapters.zh: 看哪，利百加在你面前，可以将她带去，照着耶和华所说的，给你主人的儿子为妻。」

chapters.en: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed down to the ground before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕的仆人听见他们这话，就向耶和华俯伏在地。

chapters.en: Then he brought out jewels of silver and gold, and articles of clothing, and he gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious gifts to her brother and her mother.
chapters.zh: 当下仆人拿出金器、银器，和衣服送给利百加，又将宝物送给她哥哥和她母亲。

chapters.en:
Then he and the men with him ate and drank and spent the night there.
When they got up the next morning, he said, “Send me on my way to my master.”
chapters.zh: 仆人和跟从他的人吃了喝了，住了一夜。早晨起来，仆人就说：「请打发我回我主人那里去吧。」

chapters.en: But her brother and mother said, “Let the girl remain with us ten days or so. After that, she may go.”
chapters.zh: 利百加的哥哥和她母亲说：「让女子同我们再住几天，至少十天，然后她可以去。」

chapters.en: But he replied, “Do not delay me, since the LORD has made my journey a success. Send me on my way so that I may go to my master.”
chapters.zh: 仆人说：「耶和华既赐给我通达的道路，你们不要耽误我，请打发我走，回我主人那里去吧。」

chapters.en: So they said, “We will call the girl and ask her opinion.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「我们把女子叫来问问她」，

chapters.en:
They called Rebekah and asked her, “Will you go with this man?”
“I will go,” she replied.
chapters.zh: 就叫了利百加来，问她说：「你和这人同去吗？」利百加说：「我去。」

chapters.en: So they sent their sister Rebekah on her way, along with her nurse and Abraham’s servant and his men.
chapters.zh: 于是他们打发妹子利百加和她的乳母，同亚伯拉罕的仆人，并跟从仆人的，都走了。

chapters.en:
And they blessed Rebekah and said to her,
“Our sister, may you become the mother of thousands upon thousands. May your offspring possess the gates of their enemies.”
chapters.zh: 他们就给利百加祝福说： 我们的妹子啊，愿你作千万人的母！ 愿你的后裔得着仇敌的城门！

chapters.en: Then Rebekah and her servant girls got ready, mounted the camels, and followed the man. So the servant took Rebekah and left.
chapters.zh: 利百加和她的使女们起来，骑上骆驼，跟着那仆人，仆人就带着利百加走了。

chapters.en: Now Isaac had just returned from Beer-lahai-roi, for he was living in the Negev.
chapters.zh: 那时，以撒住在南地，刚从庇耳‧拉海‧莱回来。

chapters.en: Early in the evening, Isaac went out to the field to meditate, and looking up, he saw the camels approaching.
chapters.zh: 天将晚，以撒出来在田间默想，举目一看，见来了些骆驼。

chapters.en: And when Rebekah looked up and saw Isaac, she got down from her camel
chapters.zh: 利百加举目看见以撒，就急忙下了骆驼，

chapters.en:
and asked the servant, “Who is that man in the field coming to meet us?”
“It is my master,” the servant answered. So she took her veil and covered herself.
chapters.zh: 问那仆人说：「这田间走来迎接我们的是谁？」仆人说：「是我的主人。」利百加就拿帕子蒙上脸。

chapters.en: Then the servant told Isaac all that he had done.
chapters.zh: 仆人就将所办的一切事都告诉以撒。

chapters.en: And Isaac brought her into the tent of his mother Sarah and took Rebekah as his wife. And Isaac loved her and was comforted after his mother’s death.
chapters.zh: 以撒便领利百加进了他母亲撒拉的帐棚，娶了她为妻，并且爱她。以撒自从他母亲不在了，这才得了安慰。

chapters.en: Now Abraham had taken another wife, named Keturah,
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕又娶了一妻，名叫基土拉。

chapters.en: and she bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
chapters.zh: 基土拉给他生了心兰、约珊、米但、米甸、伊施巴，和书亚。

chapters.en: Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were the Asshurites, the Letushites, and the Leummites.
chapters.zh: 约珊生了示巴和底但。底但的子孙是亚书利族、利都是族，和利乌米族。

chapters.en:
The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah.
All these were descendants of Keturah.
chapters.zh: 米甸的儿子是以法、以弗、哈诺、亚比大，和以勒大。这都是基土拉的子孙。

chapters.en: Abraham left everything he owned to Isaac.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕将一切所有的都给了以撒。

chapters.en: But while he was still alive, Abraham gave gifts to the sons of his concubines and sent them away from his son Isaac to the land of the east.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕把财物分给他庶出的众子，趁着自己还在世的时候打发他们离开他的儿子以撒，往东方去。

chapters.en: Abraham lived a total of 175 years.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕一生的年日是一百七十五岁。

chapters.en: And at a ripe old age he breathed his last and died, old and contented, and was gathered to his people.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕寿高年迈，气绝而死，归到他列祖〔注：原文是本民〕那里。

chapters.en: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre, in the field of Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite.
chapters.zh: 他两个儿子以撒、以实玛利把他埋葬在麦比拉洞里。这洞在幔利前、赫人琐辖的儿子以弗崙的田中，

chapters.en: This was the field that Abraham had bought from the Hittites. Abraham was buried there with his wife Sarah.
chapters.zh: 就是亚伯拉罕向赫人买的那块田。亚伯拉罕和他妻子撒拉都葬在那里。

chapters.en: After Abraham’s death, God blessed his son Isaac, who lived near Beer-lahai-roi.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕死了以后，上帝赐福给他的儿子以撒。以撒靠近庇耳‧拉海‧莱居住。

chapters.en: This is the account of Abraham’s son Ishmael, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s maidservant, bore to Abraham.
chapters.zh: 撒拉的使女埃及人夏甲给亚伯拉罕所生的儿子是以实玛利。

chapters.en: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael in the order of their birth: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
chapters.zh: 以实玛利儿子们的名字，按着他们的家谱记在下面。以实玛利的长子是尼拜约，又有基达、亚德别、米比衫、

chapters.en: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
chapters.zh: 米施玛、度玛、玛撒、

chapters.en: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
chapters.zh: 哈大、提玛、伊突、拿非施、基底玛。

chapters.en: These were the sons of Ishmael, and these were their names by their villages and encampments—twelve princes of their tribes.
chapters.zh: 这是以实玛利众子的名字，照着他们的村庄、营寨，作了十二族的族长。

chapters.en: Ishmael lived a total of 137 years. Then he breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people.
chapters.zh: 以实玛利享寿一百三十七岁，气绝而死，归到他列祖〔注：原文是本民〕那里。

chapters.en: Ishmael’s descendants settled from Havilah to Shur, which is near the border of Egypt as you go toward Asshur. And they lived in hostility toward all their brothers.
chapters.zh: 他子孙的住处在他众弟兄东边，从哈腓拉直到埃及前的书珥，正在亚述的道上。

chapters.en: This is the account of Abraham’s son Isaac. Abraham became the father of Isaac,
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕的儿子以撒的后代记在下面。亚伯拉罕生以撒。

chapters.en: and Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean from Paddan-aram and the sister of Laban the Aramean.
chapters.zh: 以撒娶利百加为妻的时候正四十岁。利百加是巴旦‧亚兰地的亚兰人彼土利的女儿，是亚兰人拉班的妹子。

chapters.en: Later, Isaac prayed to the LORD on behalf of his wife, because she was barren. And the LORD heard his prayer, and his wife Rebekah conceived.
chapters.zh: 以撒因他妻子不生育，就为她祈求耶和华；耶和华应允他的祈求，他的妻子利百加就怀了孕。

chapters.en: But the children inside her struggled with each other, and she said, “Why is this happening to me?” So Rebekah went to inquire of the LORD,
chapters.zh: 孩子们在她腹中彼此相争，她就说：「若是这样，我为什么活着呢〔注：或译：我为什么如此呢〕？」她就去求问耶和华。

chapters.en:
and He declared to her:
“Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples from within you will be separated; one people will be stronger than the other, and the older will serve the younger.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对她说： 两国在你腹内； 两族要从你身上出来。 这族必强于那族； 将来大的要服事小的。

chapters.en: When her time came to give birth, there were indeed twins in her womb.
chapters.zh: 生产的日子到了，腹中果然是双子。

chapters.en: The first one came out red, covered with hair like a fur coat; so they named him Esau.
chapters.zh: 先产的身体发红，浑身有毛，如同皮衣，他们就给他起名叫以扫〔注：就是有毛的意思〕。

chapters.en: After this, his brother came out grasping Esau’s heel; so he was named Jacob. And Isaac was sixty years old when the twins were born.
chapters.zh: 随后又生了以扫的兄弟，手抓住以扫的脚跟，因此给他起名叫雅各〔注：就是抓住的意思〕。利百加生下两个儿子的时候，以撒年正六十岁。

chapters.en: When the boys grew up, Esau became a skillful hunter, a man of the field, while Jacob was a quiet man who stayed at home.
chapters.zh: 两个孩子渐渐长大，以扫善于打猎，常在田野；雅各为人安静，常住在帐棚里。

chapters.en: Because Isaac had a taste for wild game, he loved Esau; but Rebekah loved Jacob.
chapters.zh: 以撒爱以扫，因为常吃他的野味；利百加却爱雅各。

chapters.en: One day, while Jacob was cooking some stew, Esau came in from the field and was famished.
chapters.zh: 有一天，雅各熬汤，以扫从田野回来累昏了。

chapters.en: He said to Jacob, “Let me eat some of that red stew, for I am famished.” (That is why he was also called Edom. )
chapters.zh: 以扫对雅各说：「我累昏了，求你把这红〔汤〕给我喝。」因此以扫又叫以东〔注：就是红的意思〕。

chapters.en: “First sell me your birthright,” Jacob replied.
chapters.zh: 雅各说：「你今日把长子的名分卖给我吧。」

chapters.en: “Look,” said Esau, “I am about to die, so what good is a birthright to me?”
chapters.zh: 以扫说：「我将要死，这长子的名分于我有什么益处呢？」

chapters.en:
“Swear to me first,” Jacob said.
So Esau swore to Jacob and sold him the birthright.
chapters.zh: 雅各说：「你今日对我起誓吧。」以扫就对他起了誓，把长子的名分卖给雅各。

chapters.en: Then Jacob gave some bread and lentil stew to Esau, who ate and drank and then got up and went away. Thus Esau despised his birthright.
chapters.zh: 于是雅各将饼和红豆汤给了以扫，以扫吃了喝了，便起来走了。这就是以扫轻看了他长子的名分。

chapters.en: Now there was another famine in the land, subsequent to the one that had occurred in Abraham’s time. And Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines at Gerar.
chapters.zh: 在亚伯拉罕的日子，那地有一次饥荒；这时又有饥荒，以撒就往基拉耳去，到非利士人的王亚比米勒那里。

chapters.en: The LORD appeared to Isaac and said, “Do not go down to Egypt. Settle in the land where I tell you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华向以撒显现，说：「你不要下埃及去，要住在我所指示你的地。

chapters.en: Stay in this land as a foreigner, and I will be with you and bless you. For I will give all these lands to you and your offspring, and I will confirm the oath that I swore to your father Abraham.
chapters.zh: 你寄居在这地，我必与你同在，赐福给你，因为我要将这些地都赐给你和你的后裔。我必坚定我向你父亚伯拉罕所起的誓。

chapters.en: I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky, and I will give them all these lands, and through your offspring all nations of the earth will be blessed,
chapters.zh: 我要加增你的后裔，像天上的星那样多，又要将这些地都赐给你的后裔。并且地上万国必因你的后裔得福－

chapters.en: because Abraham listened to My voice and kept My charge, My commandments, My statutes, and My laws.”
chapters.zh: 都因亚伯拉罕听从我的话，遵守我的吩咐和我的命令、律例、法度。」

chapters.en: So Isaac settled in Gerar.
chapters.zh: 以撒就住在基拉耳。

chapters.en: But when the men of that place asked about his wife, he said, “She is my sister.” For he was afraid to say, “She is my wife,” since he thought to himself, “The men of this place will kill me on account of Rebekah, because she is so beautiful.”
chapters.zh: 那地方的人问到他的妻子，他便说：「那是我的妹子。」原来他怕说：「是我的妻子」；〔他心里想〕：「恐怕这地方的人为利百加的缘故杀我」，因为她容貌俊美。

chapters.en: When Isaac had been there a long time, Abimelech king of the Philistines looked down from the window and was surprised to see Isaac caressing his wife Rebekah.
chapters.zh: 他在那里住了许久。有一天，非利士人的王亚比米勒从窗户里往外观看，见以撒和他的妻子利百加戏玩。

chapters.en:
Abimelech sent for Isaac and said, “So she is really your wife! How could you say, ‘She is my sister’?”
Isaac replied, “Because I thought I might die on account of her.”
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒召了以撒来，对他说：「她实在是你的妻子，你怎么说她是你的妹子？」以撒说：「我心里想，恐怕我因她而死。」

chapters.en: “What is this you have done to us?” asked Abimelech. “One of the people could easily have slept with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us.”
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒说：「你向我们做的是什么事呢？民中险些有人和你的妻同寝，把我们陷在罪里。」

chapters.en: So Abimelech warned all the people, saying, “Whoever harms this man or his wife will surely be put to death.”
chapters.zh: 于是亚比米勒晓谕众民说：「凡沾着这个人，或是他妻子的，定要把他治死。」

chapters.en: Now Isaac sowed seed in the land, and that very year he reaped a hundredfold. And the LORD blessed him,
chapters.zh: 以撒在那地耕种，那一年有百倍的收成。耶和华赐福给他，

chapters.en: and he became richer and richer, until he was exceedingly wealthy.
chapters.zh: 他就昌大，日增月盛，成了大富户。

chapters.en: He owned so many flocks and herds and servants that the Philistines envied him.
chapters.zh: 他有羊群牛群，又有许多仆人，非利士人就嫉妒他。

chapters.en: So the Philistines took dirt and stopped up all the wells that his father’s servants had dug in the days of his father Abraham.
chapters.zh: 当他父亲亚伯拉罕在世的日子，他父亲的仆人所挖的井，非利士人全都塞住，填满了土。

chapters.en: Then Abimelech said to Isaac, “Depart from us, for you are much too powerful for us.”
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒对以撒说：「你离开我们去吧。因为你比我们强盛得多。」

chapters.en: So Isaac left that place and encamped in the Valley of Gerar and settled there.
chapters.zh: 以撒就离开那里，在基拉耳谷支搭帐棚，住在那里。

chapters.en: Isaac reopened the wells that had been dug in the days of his father Abraham, which the Philistines had stopped up after Abraham died. And he gave these wells the same names his father had given them.
chapters.zh: 当他父亲亚伯拉罕在世之日所挖的水井因非利士人在亚伯拉罕死后塞住了，以撒就重新挖出来，仍照他父亲所叫的叫那些井的名字。

chapters.en: Then Isaac’s servants dug in the valley and found a well of fresh water there.
chapters.zh: 以撒的仆人在谷中挖〔井〕，便得了一口活水井。

chapters.en: But the herdsmen of Gerar quarreled with Isaac’s herdsmen and said, “The water is ours!” So he named the well Esek, because they contended with him.
chapters.zh: 基拉耳的牧人与以撒的牧人争竞，说：「这水是我们的。」以撒就给那井起名叫埃色〔注：就是相敌的意思〕，因为他们和他相争。

chapters.en: Then they dug another well and quarreled over that one also; so he named it Sitnah.
chapters.zh: 以撒的仆人又挖了一口井，他们又为这井争竞，因此以撒给这井起名叫西提拿〔注：就是为敌的意思〕。

chapters.en: He moved on from there and dug another well, and they did not quarrel over it. He named it Rehoboth and said, “At last the LORD has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.”
chapters.zh: 以撒离开那里，又挖了一口井，他们不为这井争竞了，他就给那井起名叫利河伯〔注：就是宽阔的意思〕。他说：「耶和华现在给我们宽阔之地，我们必在这地昌盛。」

chapters.en: From there Isaac went up to Beersheba,
chapters.zh: 以撒从那里上别是巴去。

chapters.en: and that night the LORD appeared to him and said, “I am the God of your father Abraham. Do not be afraid, for I am with you. I will bless you and multiply your descendants for the sake of My servant Abraham.”
chapters.zh: 当夜耶和华向他显现，说：「我是你父亲亚伯拉罕的上帝，不要惧怕！因为我与你同在，要赐福给你，并要为我仆人亚伯拉罕的缘故，使你的后裔繁多。」

chapters.en: So Isaac built an altar there and called on the name of the LORD, and he pitched his tent there. His servants also dug a well there.
chapters.zh: 以撒就在那里筑了一座坛，求告耶和华的名，并且支搭帐棚；他的仆人便在那里挖了一口井。

chapters.en: Later, Abimelech came to Isaac from Gerar, with Ahuzzath his adviser and Phicol the commander of his army.
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒，同他的朋友亚户撒和他的军长非各，从基拉耳来见以撒。

chapters.en: “Why have you come to me?” Isaac asked them. “You hated me and sent me away.”
chapters.zh: 以撒对他们说：「你们既然恨我，打发我走了，为什么到我这里来呢？」

chapters.en: “We can plainly see that the LORD has been with you,” they replied. “We recommend that there should now be an oath between us and you. Let us make a covenant with you
chapters.zh: 他们说：「我们明明地看见耶和华与你同在，便说，不如我们两下彼此起誓，彼此立约，

chapters.en: that you will not harm us, just as we have not harmed you but have done only good to you, sending you on your way in peace. And now you are blessed by the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 使你不害我们，正如我们未曾害你，一味地厚待你，并且打发你平平安安地走。你是蒙耶和华赐福的了。」

chapters.en: So Isaac prepared a feast for them, and they ate and drank.
chapters.zh: 以撒就为他们设摆筵席，他们便吃了喝了。

chapters.en: And they got up early the next morning and swore an oath to each other. Then Isaac sent them on their way, and they left him in peace.
chapters.zh: 他们清早起来彼此起誓。以撒打发他们走，他们就平平安安地离开他走了。

chapters.en: On that same day, Isaac’s servants came and told him about the well they had dug. “We have found water!” they told him.
chapters.zh: 那一天，以撒的仆人来，将挖井的事告诉他说：「我们得了水了。」

chapters.en: So he called it Shibah, and to this day the name of the city is Beersheba.
chapters.zh: 他就给那井起名叫示巴；因此那城叫做别是巴，直到今日。

chapters.en: When Esau was forty years old, he took as his wives Judith daughter of Beeri the Hittite and Basemath daughter of Elon the Hittite.
chapters.zh: 以扫四十岁的时候娶了赫人比利的女儿犹滴，与赫人以伦的女儿巴实抹为妻。

chapters.en: And they brought grief to Isaac and Rebekah.
chapters.zh: 她们常使以撒和利百加心里愁烦。

chapters.en:
When Isaac was old and his eyes were so weak that he could no longer see, he called his older son Esau and said to him, “My son.”
“Here I am,” Esau replied.
chapters.zh: 以撒年老，眼睛昏花，不能看见，就叫了他大儿子以扫来，说：「我儿。」以扫说：「我在这里。」

chapters.en: “Look,” said Isaac, “I am now old, and I do not know the day of my death.
chapters.zh: 他说：「我如今老了，不知道哪一天死。

chapters.en: Take your weapons—your quiver and bow—and go out into the field to hunt some game for me.
chapters.zh: 现在拿你的器械，就是箭囊和弓，往田野去为我打猎，

chapters.en: Then prepare a tasty dish that I love and bring it to me to eat, so that I may bless you before I die.”
chapters.zh: 照我所爱的做成美味，拿来给我吃，使我在未死之先给你祝福。」

chapters.en: Now Rebekah was listening to what Isaac told his son Esau. So when Esau went into the field to hunt game and bring it back,
chapters.zh: 以撒对他儿子以扫说话，利百加也听见了。以扫往田野去打猎，要得野味带来。

chapters.en: Rebekah said to her son Jacob, “Behold, I overheard your father saying to your brother Esau,
chapters.zh: 利百加就对她儿子雅各说：「我听见你父亲对你哥哥以扫说：

chapters.en: ‘Bring me some game and prepare me a tasty dish to eat, so that I may bless you in the presence of the LORD before I die.’
chapters.zh: 『你去把野兽带来，做成美味给我吃，我好在未死之先，在耶和华面前给你祝福。』

chapters.en: Now, my son, listen to my voice and do exactly as I tell you.
chapters.zh: 现在，我儿，你要照着我所吩咐你的，听从我的话。

chapters.en: Go out to the flock and bring me two choice young goats, so that I can make them into a tasty dish for your father—the kind he loves.
chapters.zh: 你到羊群里去，给我拿两只肥山羊羔来，我便照你父亲所爱的给他做成美味。

chapters.en: Then take it to your father to eat, so that he may bless you before he dies.”
chapters.zh: 你拿到你父亲那里给他吃，使他在未死之先给你祝福。」

chapters.en: Jacob answered his mother Rebekah, “Look, my brother Esau is a hairy man, but I am smooth-skinned.
chapters.zh: 雅各对他母亲利百加说：「我哥哥以扫浑身是有毛的，我身上是光滑的；

chapters.en: What if my father touches me? Then I would be revealed to him as a deceiver, and I would bring upon myself a curse rather than a blessing.”
chapters.zh: 倘若我父亲摸着我，必以我为欺哄人的，我就招咒诅，不得祝福。」

chapters.en: His mother replied, “Your curse be on me, my son. Just obey my voice and go get them for me.”
chapters.zh: 他母亲对他说：「我儿，你招的咒诅归到我身上；你只管听我的话，去把羊羔给我拿来。」

chapters.en: So Jacob went and got two goats and brought them to his mother, who made the tasty food his father loved.
chapters.zh: 他便去拿来，交给他母亲；他母亲就照他父亲所爱的做成美味。

chapters.en: And Rebekah took the finest clothes in the house that belonged to her older son Esau, and she put them on her younger son Jacob.
chapters.zh: 利百加又把家里所存大儿子以扫上好的衣服给她小儿子雅各穿上，

chapters.en: She also put the skins of the young goats on his hands and on the smooth part of his neck.
chapters.zh: 又用山羊羔皮包在雅各的手上和颈项的光滑处，

chapters.en: Then she handed her son Jacob the tasty food and bread she had made.
chapters.zh: 就把所做的美味和饼交在她儿子雅各的手里。

chapters.en:
So Jacob went to his father and said, “My father.”
“Here I am!” he answered. “Which one are you, my son?”
chapters.zh: 雅各到他父亲那里说：「我父亲！」他说：「我在这里。我儿，你是谁？」

chapters.en: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau, your firstborn. I have done as you told me. Please sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may bless me.”
chapters.zh: 雅各对他父亲说：「我是你的长子以扫；我已照你所吩咐我的行了。请起来坐着，吃我的野味，好给我祝福。」

chapters.en:
But Isaac asked his son, “How did you ever find it so quickly, my son?”
“Because the LORD your God brought it to me,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 以撒对他儿子说：「我儿，你如何找得这么快呢？」他说：「因为耶和华－你的上帝使我遇见好机会得着的。」

chapters.en: Then Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come closer so I can touch you, my son. Are you really my son Esau, or not?”
chapters.zh: 以撒对雅各说：「我儿，你近前来，我摸摸你，知道你真是我的儿子以扫不是。」

chapters.en: So Jacob came close to his father Isaac, who touched him and said, “The voice is the voice of Jacob, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”
chapters.zh: 雅各就挨近他父亲以撒。以撒摸着他，说：「声音是雅各的声音，手却是以扫的手。」

chapters.en: Isaac did not recognize him, because his hands were hairy like those of his brother Esau; so he blessed him.
chapters.zh: 以撒就辨不出他来；因为他手上有毛，像他哥哥以扫的手一样，就给他祝福；

chapters.en:
Again he asked, “Are you really my son Esau?”
And he replied, “I am.”
chapters.zh: 又说：「你真是我儿子以扫吗？」他说：「我是。」

chapters.en:
“Serve me,” said Isaac, “and let me eat some of my son’s game, so that I may bless you.”
Jacob brought it to him, and he ate; then he brought him wine, and he drank.
chapters.zh: 以撒说：「你递给我，我好吃我儿子的野味，给你祝福。」雅各就递给他，他便吃了，又拿酒给他，他也喝了。

chapters.en: Then his father Isaac said to him, “Please come near and kiss me, my son.”
chapters.zh: 他父亲以撒对他说：「我儿，你上前来与我亲嘴。」

chapters.en:
So he came near and kissed him. When Isaac smelled his clothing, he blessed him and said:
“Ah, the smell of my son is like the smell of a field
that the LORD has blessed.
chapters.zh: 他就上前与父亲亲嘴。他父亲一闻他衣服上的香气，就给他祝福，说： 我儿的香气 如同耶和华赐福之田地的香气一样。

chapters.en:
May God give to you the dew of heaven and the richness of the earth—
an abundance of grain and new wine.
chapters.zh: 愿上帝赐你天上的甘露， 地上的肥土， 并许多五谷新酒。

chapters.en: May peoples serve you and nations bow down to you. May you be the master of your brothers, and may the sons of your mother bow down to you. May those who curse you be cursed, and those who bless you be blessed.”
chapters.zh: 愿多民事奉你， 多国跪拜你。 愿你作你弟兄的主； 你母亲的儿子向你跪拜。 凡咒诅你的，愿他受咒诅； 为你祝福的，愿他蒙福。

chapters.en: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing him and Jacob had left his father’s presence, his brother Esau returned from the hunt.
chapters.zh: 以撒为雅各祝福已毕，雅各从他父亲那里才出来，他哥哥以扫正打猎回来，

chapters.en: He too made some tasty food, brought it to his father, and said to him, “My father, sit up and eat of your son’s game, so that you may bless me.”
chapters.zh: 也做了美味，拿来给他父亲，说：「请父亲起来，吃你儿子的野味，好给我祝福。」

chapters.en:
But his father Isaac replied, “Who are you?”
“I am Esau, your firstborn son,” he answered.
chapters.zh: 他父亲以撒对他说：「你是谁？」他说：「我是你的长子以扫。」

chapters.en: Isaac began to tremble violently and said, “Who was it, then, who hunted the game and brought it to me? Before you came in, I ate it all and blessed him—and indeed, he will be blessed!”
chapters.zh: 以撒就大大地战兢，说：「你未来之先，是谁得了野味拿来给我呢？我已经吃了，为他祝福；他将来也必蒙福。」

chapters.en: When Esau heard his father’s words, he let out a loud and bitter cry and said to his father, “Bless me too, O my father!”
chapters.zh: 以扫听了他父亲的话，就放声痛哭，说：「我父啊，求你也为我祝福！」

chapters.en: But Isaac replied, “Your brother came deceitfully and took your blessing.”
chapters.zh: 以撒说：「你兄弟已经用诡计来将你的福分夺去了。」

chapters.en: So Esau declared, “Is he not rightly named Jacob? For he has cheated me twice. He took my birthright, and now he has taken my blessing.” Then he asked, “Haven’t you saved a blessing for me?”
chapters.zh: 以扫说：「他名雅各，岂不是正对吗？因为他欺骗了我两次：他从前夺了我长子的名分，你看，他现在又夺了我的福分。」以扫又说：「你没有留下为我可祝的福吗？」

chapters.en: But Isaac answered Esau: “Look, I have made him your master and given him all his relatives as servants; I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What is left that I can do for you, my son?”
chapters.zh: 以撒回答以扫说：「我已立他为你的主，使他的弟兄都给他作仆人，并赐他五谷新酒可以养生。我儿，现在我还能为你做什么呢？」

chapters.en: Esau said to his father, “Do you have only one blessing, my father? Bless me too, O my father!” Then Esau wept aloud.
chapters.zh: 以扫对他父亲说：「父啊，你只有一样可祝的福吗？我父啊，求你也为我祝福！」以扫就放声而哭。

chapters.en:
His father Isaac answered him:
“Behold, your dwelling place shall be away from the richness of the land,
away from the dew of heaven above.
chapters.zh: 他父亲以撒说： 地上的肥土必为你所住； 天上的甘露必为你所得。

chapters.en: You shall live by the sword and serve your brother. But when you rebel, you will tear his yoke from your neck.”
chapters.zh: 你必倚靠刀剑度日， 又必事奉你的兄弟； 到你强盛的时候， 必从你颈项上挣开他的轭。

chapters.en: Esau held a grudge against Jacob because of the blessing his father had given him. And Esau said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then I will kill my brother Jacob.”
chapters.zh: 以扫因他父亲给雅各祝的福，就怨恨雅各，心里说：「为我父亲居丧的日子近了，到那时候，我要杀我的兄弟雅各。」

chapters.en: When the words of her older son Esau were relayed to Rebekah, she sent for her younger son Jacob and told him, “Look, your brother Esau is consoling himself by plotting to kill you.
chapters.zh: 有人把利百加大儿子以扫的话告诉利百加，她就打发人去，叫了她小儿子雅各来，对他说：「你哥哥以扫〔想要〕杀你，报仇雪恨。

chapters.en: So now, my son, obey my voice and flee at once to my brother Laban in Haran.
chapters.zh: 现在，我儿，你要听我的话：起来，逃往哈兰、我哥哥拉班那里去，

chapters.en: Stay with him for a while, until your brother’s fury subsides—
chapters.zh: 同他住些日子，直等你哥哥的怒气消了。

chapters.en: until your brother’s rage against you wanes and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send for you and bring you back from there. Why should I lose both of you in one day?”
chapters.zh: 你哥哥向你消了怒气，忘了你向他所做的事，我便打发人去把你从那里带回来。为什么一日丧你们二人呢？」

chapters.en: Then Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of these Hittite women. If Jacob takes a Hittite wife from among them, what good is my life?”
chapters.zh: 利百加对以撒说：「我因这赫人的女子连性命都厌烦了；倘若雅各也娶赫人的女子为妻，像这些一样，我活着还有什么益处呢？」

chapters.en: So Isaac called for Jacob and blessed him. “Do not take a wife from the Canaanite women,” he commanded.
chapters.zh: 以撒叫了雅各来，给他祝福，并嘱咐他说：「你不要娶迦南的女子为妻。

chapters.en: “Go at once to Paddan-aram, to the house of your mother’s father Bethuel, and take a wife from among the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.
chapters.zh: 你起身往巴旦‧亚兰去，到你外祖彼土利家里，在你母舅拉班的女儿中娶一女为妻。

chapters.en: May God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful and multiply you, so that you may become a company of peoples.
chapters.zh: 愿全能的上帝赐福给你，使你生养众多，成为多族，

chapters.en: And may He give the blessing of Abraham to you and your descendants, so that you may possess the land where you dwell as a foreigner, the land God gave to Abraham.”
chapters.zh: 将应许亚伯拉罕的福赐给你和你的后裔，使你承受你所寄居的地为业，就是上帝赐给亚伯拉罕的地。」

chapters.en: So Isaac sent Jacob to Paddan-aram, to Laban son of Bethuel the Aramean, the brother of Rebekah, who was the mother of Jacob and Esau.
chapters.zh: 以撒打发雅各走了，他就往巴旦‧亚兰去，到亚兰人彼土利的儿子拉班那里。拉班是雅各、以扫的母舅。

chapters.en: Now Esau learned that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him to Paddan-aram to take a wife there, commanding him, “Do not marry a Canaanite woman,”
chapters.zh: 以扫见以撒已经给雅各祝福，而且打发他往巴旦‧亚兰去，在那里娶妻，并见祝福的时候嘱咐他说：「不要娶迦南的女子为妻」，

chapters.en: and that Jacob had obeyed his father and mother and gone to Paddan-aram.
chapters.zh: 又见雅各听从父母的话往巴旦‧亚兰去了，

chapters.en: And seeing that his father Isaac disapproved of the Canaanite women,
chapters.zh: 以扫就晓得他父亲以撒看不中迦南的女子，

chapters.en: Esau went to Ishmael and married Mahalath, the sister of Nebaioth and daughter of Abraham’s son Ishmael, in addition to the wives he already had.
chapters.zh: 便往以实玛利那里去，在他二妻之外又娶了玛哈拉为妻。她是亚伯拉罕儿子以实玛利的女儿，尼拜约的妹子。

chapters.en: Meanwhile Jacob left Beersheba and set out for Haran.
chapters.zh: 雅各出了别是巴，向哈兰走去；

chapters.en: On reaching a certain place, he spent the night there because the sun had set. And taking one of the stones from that place, he put it under his head and lay down to sleep.
chapters.zh: 到了一个地方，因为太阳落了，就在那里住宿，便拾起那地方的一块石头枕在头下，在那里躺卧睡了，

chapters.en: And Jacob had a dream about a ladder that rested on the earth with its top reaching up to heaven, and God’s angels were going up and down the ladder.
chapters.zh: 梦见一个梯子立在地上，梯子的头顶着天，有上帝的使者在梯子上，上去下来。

chapters.en: And there at the top the LORD was standing and saying, “I am the LORD, the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac. I will give you and your descendants the land on which you now lie.
chapters.zh: 耶和华站在梯子以上〔注：或译：站在他旁边〕，说：「我是耶和华－你祖亚伯拉罕的上帝，也是以撒的上帝；我要将你现在所躺卧之地赐给你和你的后裔。

chapters.en: Your descendants will be like the dust of the earth, and you will spread out to the west and east and north and south. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you and your offspring.
chapters.zh: 你的后裔必像地上的尘沙那样多，必向东西南北开展；地上万族必因你和你的后裔得福。

chapters.en: Look, I am with you, and I will watch over you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. For I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you.”
chapters.zh: 我也与你同在。你无论往哪里去，我必保佑你，领你归回这地，总不离弃你，直到我成全了向你所应许的。」

chapters.en: When Jacob woke up, he said, “Surely the LORD is in this place, and I was unaware of it.”
chapters.zh: 雅各睡醒了，说：「耶和华真在这里，我竟不知道！」

chapters.en: And he was afraid and said, “How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God; this is the gate of heaven!”
chapters.zh: 就惧怕，说：「这地方何等可畏！这不是别的，乃是上帝的殿，也是天的门。」

chapters.en: Early the next morning, Jacob took the stone that he had placed under his head, and he set it up as a pillar. He poured oil on top of it,
chapters.zh: 雅各清早起来，把所枕的石头立作柱子，浇油在上面。

chapters.en: and he called that place Bethel, though previously the city had been named Luz.
chapters.zh: 他就给那地方起名叫伯特利〔注：就是上帝殿的意思〕；但那地方起先名叫路斯。

chapters.en: Then Jacob made a vow, saying, “If God will be with me and watch over me on this journey, and if He will provide me with food to eat and clothes to wear,
chapters.zh: 雅各许愿说：「上帝若与我同在，在我所行的路上保佑我，又给我食物吃，衣服穿，

chapters.en: so that I may return safely to my father’s house, then the LORD will be my God.
chapters.zh: 使我平平安安地回到我父亲的家，我就必以耶和华为我的上帝。

chapters.en: And this stone I have set up as a pillar will be God’s house, and of all that You give me I will surely give You a tenth.”
chapters.zh: 我所立为柱子的石头也必作上帝的殿；凡你所赐给我的，我必将十分之一献给你。」

chapters.en: Jacob resumed his journey and came to the land of the people of the east.
chapters.zh: 雅各起行，到了东方人之地，

chapters.en: He looked and saw a well in the field, and near it lay three flocks of sheep, because the sheep were watered from this well. And a large stone covered the mouth of the well.
chapters.zh: 看见田间有一口井，有三群羊卧在井旁；因为人饮羊群都是用那井里的水。井口上的石头是大的。

chapters.en: When all the flocks had been gathered there, the shepherds would roll away the stone from the mouth of the well and water the sheep. Then they would return the stone to its place over the mouth of the well.
chapters.zh: 常有羊群在那里聚集，牧人把石头转离井口饮羊，随后又把石头放在井口的原处。

chapters.en:
“My brothers,” Jacob asked the shepherds, “where are you from?”
“We are from Haran,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 雅各对牧人说：「弟兄们，你们是哪里来的？」他们说：「我们是哈兰来的。」

chapters.en:
“Do you know Laban the grandson of Nahor?” Jacob asked.
“We know him,” they replied.
chapters.zh: 他问他们说：「拿鹤的孙子拉班，你们认识吗？」他们说：「我们认识。」

chapters.en:
“Is he well?” Jacob inquired.
“Yes,” they answered, “and here comes his daughter Rachel with his sheep.”
chapters.zh: 雅各说：「他平安吗？」他们说：「平安。看哪，他女儿拉结领着羊来了。」

chapters.en: “Look,” said Jacob, “it is still broad daylight; it is not yet time to gather the livestock. Water the sheep and take them back to pasture.”
chapters.zh: 雅各说：「日头还高，不是羊群聚集的时候，你们不如饮羊，再去放一放。」

chapters.en: But they replied, “We cannot, until all the flocks have been gathered and the stone has been rolled away from the mouth of the well. Then we will water the sheep.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「我们不能，必等羊群聚齐，人把石头转离井口才可饮羊。」

chapters.en: While he was still speaking with them, Rachel arrived with her father’s sheep, for she was a shepherdess.
chapters.zh: 雅各正和他们说话的时候，拉结领着她父亲的羊来了，因为那些羊是她牧放的。

chapters.en: As soon as Jacob saw Rachel, the daughter of his mother’s brother Laban, with Laban’s sheep, he went up and rolled the stone away from the mouth of the well and watered his uncle’s sheep.
chapters.zh: 雅各看见母舅拉班的女儿拉结和母舅拉班的羊群，就上前把石头转离井口，饮他母舅拉班的羊群。

chapters.en: Then Jacob kissed Rachel and wept aloud.
chapters.zh: 雅各与拉结亲嘴，就放声而哭。

chapters.en: He told Rachel that he was Rebekah’s son, a relative of her father, and she ran and told her father.
chapters.zh: 雅各告诉拉结，自己是她父亲的外甥，是利百加的儿子，拉结就跑去告诉她父亲。

chapters.en: When Laban heard the news about his sister’s son Jacob, he ran out to meet him. He embraced him and kissed him and brought him to his home, where Jacob told him all that had happened.
chapters.zh: 拉班听见外甥雅各的信息，就跑去迎接，抱着他，与他亲嘴，领他到自己的家。雅各将一切的情由告诉拉班。

chapters.en:
Then Laban declared, “You are indeed my own flesh and blood.”
After Jacob had stayed with him a month,
chapters.zh: 拉班对他说：「你实在是我的骨肉。」雅各就和他同住了一个月。

chapters.en: Laban said to him, “Just because you are my relative, should you work for nothing? Tell me what your wages should be.”
chapters.zh: 拉班对雅各说：「你虽是我的骨肉〔注：原文是弟兄〕，岂可白白地服事我？请告诉我，你要什么为工价？」

chapters.en: Now Laban had two daughters; the older was named Leah, and the younger was named Rachel.
chapters.zh: 拉班有两个女儿，大的名叫利亚，小的名叫拉结。

chapters.en: Leah had weak eyes, but Rachel was shapely and beautiful.
chapters.zh: 利亚的眼睛没有神气，拉结却生得美貌俊秀。

chapters.en: Since Jacob loved Rachel, he answered, “I will serve you seven years for your younger daughter Rachel.”
chapters.zh: 雅各爱拉结，就说：「我愿为你小女儿拉结服事你七年。」

chapters.en: Laban replied, “Better that I give her to you than to another. Stay here with me.”
chapters.zh: 拉班说：「我把她给你，胜似给别人，你与我同住吧！」

chapters.en: So Jacob served seven years for Rachel, yet it seemed but a few days because of his love for her.
chapters.zh: 雅各就为拉结服事了七年；他因为深爱拉结，就看这七年如同几天。

chapters.en: Finally Jacob said to Laban, “Grant me my wife, for my time is complete, and I want to sleep with her.”
chapters.zh: 雅各对拉班说：「日期已经满了，求你把我的妻子给我，我好与她同房。」

chapters.en: So Laban invited all the men of that place and prepared a feast.
chapters.zh: 拉班就摆设筵席，请齐了那地方的众人。

chapters.en: But when evening came, Laban took his daughter Leah and gave her to Jacob, and he slept with her.
chapters.zh: 到晚上，拉班将女儿利亚送来给雅各，雅各就与她同房。

chapters.en: And Laban gave his servant girl Zilpah to his daughter Leah as her maidservant.
chapters.zh: 拉班又将婢女悉帕给女儿利亚作使女。

chapters.en: When morning came, there was Leah! “What have you done to me?” Jacob said to Laban. “Wasn’t it for Rachel that I served you? Why have you deceived me?”
chapters.zh: 到了早晨，雅各一看是利亚，就对拉班说：「你向我做的是什么事呢？我服事你，不是为拉结吗？你为什么欺哄我呢？」

chapters.en: Laban replied, “It is not our custom here to give the younger daughter in marriage before the older.
chapters.zh: 拉班说：「大女儿还没有给人，先把小女儿给人，在我们这地方没有这规矩。

chapters.en: Finish this week’s celebration, and we will give you the younger one in return for another seven years of work.”
chapters.zh: 你为这个满了七日，我就把那个也给你，你再为她服事我七年。」

chapters.en: And Jacob did just that. He finished the week’s celebration, and Laban gave him his daughter Rachel as his wife.
chapters.zh: 雅各就如此行。满了利亚的七日，拉班便将女儿拉结给雅各为妻。

chapters.en: Laban also gave his servant girl Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as her maidservant.
chapters.zh: 拉班又将婢女辟拉给女儿拉结作使女。

chapters.en: Jacob slept with Rachel as well, and indeed, he loved Rachel more than Leah. So he worked for Laban another seven years.
chapters.zh: 雅各也与拉结同房，并且爱拉结胜似爱利亚，于是又服事了拉班七年。

chapters.en: When the LORD saw that Leah was unloved, He opened her womb; but Rachel was barren.
chapters.zh: 耶和华见利亚失宠〔注：原文是被恨；下同〕，就使她生育，拉结却不生育。

chapters.en: And Leah conceived and gave birth to a son, and she named him Reuben, for she said, “The LORD has seen my affliction. Surely my husband will love me now.”
chapters.zh: 利亚怀孕生子，就给他起名叫吕便〔注：就是有儿子的意思〕，因而说：「耶和华看见我的苦情，如今我的丈夫必爱我。」

chapters.en: Again she conceived and gave birth to a son, and she said, “Because the LORD has heard that I am unloved, He has given me this son as well.” So she named him Simeon.
chapters.zh: 她又怀孕生子，就说：「耶和华因为听见我失宠，所以又赐给我这个儿子」，于是给他起名叫西缅〔注：就是听见的意思〕。

chapters.en: Once again Leah conceived and gave birth to a son, and she said, “Now at last my husband will become attached to me, because I have borne him three sons.” So he was named Levi.
chapters.zh: 她又怀孕生子，起名叫利未〔注：就是联合的意思〕，说：「我给丈夫生了三个儿子，他必与我联合。」

chapters.en: And once more she conceived and gave birth to a son and said, “This time I will praise the LORD.” So she named him Judah. Then Leah stopped having children.
chapters.zh: 她又怀孕生子，说：「这回我要赞美耶和华」，因此给他起名叫犹大〔注：就是赞美的意思〕。这才停了生育。

chapters.en: When Rachel saw that she was not bearing any children for Jacob, she envied her sister. “Give me children, or I will die!” she said to Jacob.
chapters.zh: 拉结见自己不给雅各生子，就嫉妒她姊姊，对雅各说：「你给我孩子，不然我就死了。」

chapters.en: Jacob became angry with Rachel and said, “Am I in the place of God, who has withheld children from you?”
chapters.zh: 雅各向拉结生气，说：「叫你不生育的是上帝，我岂能代替他〔作主〕呢？」

chapters.en: Then she said, “Here is my maidservant Bilhah. Sleep with her, that she may bear children for me, so that through her I too can build a family.”
chapters.zh: 拉结说：「有我的使女辟拉在这里，你可以与她同房，使她生子在我膝下，我便因她也得孩子〔注：原文是被建立〕。」

chapters.en: So Rachel gave Jacob her servant Bilhah as a wife, and he slept with her,
chapters.zh: 拉结就把她的使女辟拉给丈夫为妾；雅各便与她同房，

chapters.en: and Bilhah conceived and bore him a son.
chapters.zh: 辟拉就怀孕，给雅各生了一个儿子。

chapters.en: Then Rachel said, “God has vindicated me; He has heard my plea and given me a son.” So she named him Dan.
chapters.zh: 拉结说：「上帝伸了我的冤，也听了我的声音，赐我一个儿子」，因此给他起名叫但〔注：就是伸冤的意思〕。

chapters.en: And Rachel’s servant Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.
chapters.zh: 拉结的使女辟拉又怀孕，给雅各生了第二个儿子。

chapters.en: Then Rachel said, “In my great struggles, I have wrestled with my sister and won.” So she named him Naphtali.
chapters.zh: 拉结说：「我与我姊姊大大相争，并且得胜」，于是给他起名叫拿弗他利〔注：就是相争的意思〕。

chapters.en: When Leah saw that she had stopped having children, she gave her servant Zilpah to Jacob as a wife.
chapters.zh: 利亚见自己停了生育，就把使女悉帕给雅各为妾。

chapters.en: And Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a son.
chapters.zh: 利亚的使女悉帕给雅各生了一个儿子。

chapters.en: Then Leah said, “How fortunate!” So she named him Gad.
chapters.zh: 利亚说：「万幸！」于是给他起名叫迦得〔注：就是万幸的意思〕。

chapters.en: When Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a second son,
chapters.zh: 利亚的使女悉帕又给雅各生了第二个儿子。

chapters.en: Leah said, “How happy I am! For the women call me happy.” So she named him Asher.
chapters.zh: 利亚说：「我有福啊，众女子都要称我是有福的」，于是给他起名叫亚设〔注：就是有福的意思〕。

chapters.en: Now during the wheat harvest, Reuben went out and found some mandrakes in the field. When he brought them to his mother, Rachel begged Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”
chapters.zh: 割麦子的时候，吕便往田里去，寻见风茄，拿来给他母亲利亚。拉结对利亚说：「请你把你儿子的风茄给我些。」

chapters.en:
But Leah replied, “Is it not enough that you have taken away my husband? Now you want to take my son’s mandrakes as well?”
“Very well,” said Rachel, “he may sleep with you tonight in exchange for your son’s mandrakes.”
chapters.zh: 利亚说：「你夺了我的丈夫还算小事吗？你又要夺我儿子的风茄吗？」拉结说：「为你儿子的风茄，今夜他可以与你同寝。」

chapters.en: When Jacob came in from the field that evening, Leah went out to meet him and said, “You must come with me, for I have hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” So he slept with her that night.
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，雅各从田里回来，利亚出来迎接他，说：「你要与我同寝，因为我实在用我儿子的风茄把你雇下了。」那一夜，雅各就与她同寝。

chapters.en: And God listened to Leah, and she conceived and bore a fifth son to Jacob.
chapters.zh: 上帝应允了利亚，她就怀孕，给雅各生了第五个儿子。

chapters.en: Then Leah said, “God has rewarded me for giving my maidservant to my husband.” So she named him Issachar.
chapters.zh: 利亚说：「上帝给了我价值，因为我把使女给了我丈夫」，于是给他起名叫以萨迦〔注：就是价值的意思〕。

chapters.en: Again Leah conceived and bore a sixth son to Jacob.
chapters.zh: 利亚又怀孕，给雅各生了第六个儿子。

chapters.en: “God has given me a good gift,” she said. “This time my husband will honor me, because I have borne him six sons.” And she named him Zebulun.
chapters.zh: 利亚说：「上帝赐我厚赏；我丈夫必与我同住，因我给他生了六个儿子」，于是给他起名西布伦〔注：就是同住的意思〕。

chapters.en: After that, Leah gave birth to a daughter and named her Dinah.
chapters.zh: 后来又生了一个女儿，给她起名叫底拿。

chapters.en: Then God remembered Rachel. He listened to her and opened her womb,
chapters.zh: 上帝顾念拉结，应允了她，使她能生育。

chapters.en: and she conceived and gave birth to a son. “God has taken away my shame,” she said.
chapters.zh: 拉结怀孕生子，说：「上帝除去了我的羞耻」，

chapters.en: She named him Joseph, and said, “May the LORD add to me another son.”
chapters.zh: 就给他起名叫约瑟〔注：就是增添的意思〕，意思说：「愿耶和华再增添我一个儿子。」

chapters.en: Now after Rachel had given birth to Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me on my way so I can return to my homeland.
chapters.zh: 拉结生约瑟之后，雅各对拉班说：「请打发我走，叫我回到我本乡本土去。

chapters.en: Give me my wives and children for whom I have served you, that I may go on my way. You know how hard I have worked for you.”
chapters.zh: 请你把我服事你所得的妻子和儿女给我，让我走；我怎样服事你，你都知道。」

chapters.en: But Laban replied, “If I have found favor in your eyes, please stay. I have learned by divination that the LORD has blessed me because of you.”
chapters.zh: 拉班对他说：「我若在你眼前蒙恩，请你〔仍与我同住〕，〔因为〕我已算定，耶和华赐福与我是为你的缘故」；

chapters.en: And he added, “Name your wages, and I will pay them.”
chapters.zh: 又说：「请你定你的工价，我就给你。」

chapters.en: Then Jacob answered, “You know how I have served you and how your livestock have thrived under my care.
chapters.zh: 雅各对他说：「我怎样服事你，你的牲畜在我手里怎样，是你知道的。

chapters.en: Indeed, you had very little before my arrival, but now your wealth has increased many times over. The LORD has blessed you wherever I set foot. But now, when may I also provide for my own household?”
chapters.zh: 我未来之先，你所有的很少，现今却发大众多，耶和华随我的脚步赐福与你。如今，我什么时候才为自己兴家立业呢？」

chapters.en:
“What can I give you?” Laban asked.
“You do not need to give me anything,” Jacob replied. “If you do this one thing for me, I will keep on shepherding and keeping your flocks.
chapters.zh: 拉班说：「我当给你什么呢？」雅各说：「什么你也不必给我，只有一件事，你若应承，我便仍旧牧放你的羊群。

chapters.en: Let me go through all your flocks today and remove from them every speckled or spotted sheep, every dark-colored lamb, and every spotted or speckled goat. These will be my wages.
chapters.zh: 今天我要走遍你的羊群，把绵羊中凡有点的、有斑的，和黑色的，并山羊中凡有斑的、有点的，都挑出来；将来〔这一等的〕就算我的工价。

chapters.en: So my honesty will testify for me when you come to check on my wages in the future. If I have any goats that are not speckled or spotted, or any lambs that are not dark-colored, they will be considered stolen.”
chapters.zh: 以后你来查看我的工价，凡在我手里的山羊不是有点有斑的，绵羊不是黑色的，那就算是我偷的；这样便可证出我的公义来。」

chapters.en: “Agreed,” said Laban. “Let it be as you have said.”
chapters.zh: 拉班说：「好啊！我情愿照着你的话行。」

chapters.en: That very day Laban removed all the streaked or spotted male goats and every speckled or spotted female goat—every one that had any white on it—and every dark-colored lamb, and he placed them under the care of his sons.
chapters.zh: 当日，拉班把有纹的、有斑的公山羊，有点的、有斑的、有杂白纹的母山羊，并黑色的绵羊，都挑出来，交在他儿子们的手下，

chapters.en: Then he put a three-day journey between himself and Jacob, while Jacob was shepherding the rest of Laban’s flocks.
chapters.zh: 又使自己和雅各相离三天的路程。雅各就牧养拉班其余的羊。

chapters.en: Jacob, however, took fresh branches of poplar, almond, and plane trees, and peeled the bark, exposing the white inner wood of the branches.
chapters.zh: 雅各拿杨树、杏树、枫树的嫩枝，将皮剥成白纹，使枝子露出白的来，

chapters.en: Then he set the peeled branches in the watering troughs in front of the flocks coming in to drink. So when the flocks were in heat and came to drink,
chapters.zh: 将剥了皮的枝子，对着羊群，插在饮羊的水沟里和水槽里，羊来喝的时候，牝牡配合。

chapters.en: they mated in front of the branches. And they bore young that were streaked or speckled or spotted.
chapters.zh: 羊对着枝子配合，就生下有纹的、有点的、有斑的来。

chapters.en: Jacob set apart the young, but made the rest face the streaked dark-colored sheep in Laban’s flocks. Then he set his own stock apart and did not put them with Laban’s animals.
chapters.zh: 雅各把羊羔分出来，使拉班的羊与这有纹和黑色的羊相对，把自己的羊另放一处，不叫他和拉班的羊混杂。

chapters.en: Whenever the stronger females of the flock were in heat, Jacob would place the branches in the troughs, in full view of the animals, so that they would breed in front of the branches.
chapters.zh: 到羊群肥壮配合的时候，雅各就把枝子插在水沟里，使羊对着枝子配合。

chapters.en: But if the animals were weak, he did not set out the branches. So the weaker animals went to Laban and the stronger ones to Jacob.
chapters.zh: 只是到羊瘦弱配合的时候就不插枝子。这样，瘦弱的就归拉班，肥壮的就归雅各。

chapters.en: Thus Jacob became exceedingly prosperous. He owned large flocks, maidservants and menservants, and camels and donkeys.
chapters.zh: 于是雅各极其发大，得了许多的羊群、仆婢、骆驼，和驴。

chapters.en: Now Jacob heard that Laban’s sons were saying, “Jacob has taken away all that belonged to our father and built all this wealth at our father’s expense.”
chapters.zh: 雅各听见拉班的儿子们有话说：「雅各把我们父亲所有的都夺了去，并藉着我们父亲的，得了这一切的荣耀〔注：或译：财〕。」

chapters.en: And Jacob saw from the countenance of Laban that his attitude toward him had changed.
chapters.zh: 雅各见拉班的气色向他不如从前了。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Jacob, “Go back to the land of your fathers and to your kindred, and I will be with you.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对雅各说：「你要回你祖、你父之地，到你亲族那里去，我必与你同在。」

chapters.en: So Jacob sent word and called Rachel and Leah to the field where his flocks were,
chapters.zh: 雅各就打发人，叫拉结和利亚到田野羊群那里来，

chapters.en: and he told them, “I can see from your father’s countenance that his attitude toward me has changed; but the God of my father has been with me.
chapters.zh: 对她们说：「我看你们父亲的气色向我不如从前了；但我父亲的上帝向来与我同在。

chapters.en: You know that I have served your father with all my strength.
chapters.zh: 你们也知道，我尽了我的力量服事你们的父亲。

chapters.en: And although he has cheated me and changed my wages ten times, God has not allowed him to harm me.
chapters.zh: 你们的父亲欺哄我，十次改了我的工价；然而上帝不容他害我。

chapters.en: If he said, ‘The speckled will be your wages,’ then the whole flock bore speckled offspring. If he said, ‘The streaked will be your wages,’ then the whole flock bore streaked offspring.
chapters.zh: 他若说：『有点的归你作工价』，羊群所生的都有点；他若说：『有纹的归你作工价』，羊群所生的都有纹。

chapters.en: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock and given them to me.
chapters.zh: 这样，上帝把你们父亲的牲畜夺来赐给我了。

chapters.en: When the flocks were breeding, I saw in a dream that the streaked, spotted, and speckled males were mating with the females.
chapters.zh: 羊配合的时候，我梦中举目一看，见跳母羊的公羊都是有纹的、有点的、有花斑的。

chapters.en:
In that dream the angel of God said to me, ‘Jacob!’
And I replied, ‘Here I am.’
chapters.zh: 上帝的使者在那梦中呼叫我说：『雅各。』我说：『我在这里。』

chapters.en: ‘Look up,’ he said, ‘and see that all the males that are mating with the flock are streaked, spotted, or speckled; for I have seen all that Laban has done to you.
chapters.zh: 他说：『你举目观看，跳母羊的公羊都是有纹的、有点的、有花斑的；凡拉班向你所做的，我都看见了。

chapters.en: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed the pillar and made a solemn vow to Me. Now get up, leave this land at once, and return to your native land.’”
chapters.zh: 我是伯特利的上帝；你在那里〔用油〕浇过柱子，向我许过愿。现今你起来，离开这地，回你本地去吧！』」

chapters.en: And Rachel and Leah replied, “Do we have any portion or inheritance left in our father’s house?
chapters.zh: 拉结和利亚回答雅各说：「在我们父亲的家里还有我们可得的分吗？还有我们的产业吗？

chapters.en: Are we not regarded by him as outsiders? Not only has he sold us, but he has certainly squandered what was paid for us.
chapters.zh: 我们不是被他当作外人吗？因为他卖了我们，吞了我们的价值。

chapters.en: Surely all the wealth that God has taken away from our father belongs to us and to our children. So do whatever God has told you.”
chapters.zh: 上帝从我们父亲所夺出来的一切财物，那就是我们和我们孩子们的。现今凡上帝所吩咐你的，你只管去行吧！」

chapters.en: Then Jacob got up and put his children and his wives on camels,
chapters.zh: 雅各起来，使他的儿子和妻子都骑上骆驼，

chapters.en: and he drove all his livestock before him, along with all the possessions he had acquired in Paddan-aram, to go to his father Isaac in the land in Canaan.
chapters.zh: 又带着他在巴旦‧亚兰所得的一切牲畜和财物，往迦南地、他父亲以撒那里去了。

chapters.en: Now while Laban was out shearing his sheep, Rachel stole her father’s household idols.
chapters.zh: 当时拉班剪羊毛去了，拉结偷了他父亲家中的神像。

chapters.en: Moreover, Jacob deceived Laban the Aramean by not telling him that he was running away.
chapters.zh: 雅各背着亚兰人拉班偷走了，并不告诉他，

chapters.en: So he fled with all his possessions, crossed the Euphrates, and headed for the hill country of Gilead.
chapters.zh: 就带着所有的逃跑。他起身过大河，面向基列山行去。

chapters.en: On the third day Laban was informed that Jacob had fled.
chapters.zh: 到第三日，有人告诉拉班，雅各逃跑了。
