chapters.en: So he took his relatives with him, pursued Jacob for seven days, and overtook him in the hill country of Gilead.
chapters.zh: 拉班带领他的众弟兄去追赶，追了七日，在基列山就追上了。

chapters.en: But that night God came to Laban the Aramean in a dream and warned him, “Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.”
chapters.zh: 夜间，上帝到亚兰人拉班那里，在梦中对他说：「你要小心，不可与雅各说好说歹。」

chapters.en: Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the hill country of Gilead when Laban overtook him, and Laban and his relatives camped there as well.
chapters.zh: 拉班追上雅各。雅各在山上支搭帐棚；拉班和他的众弟兄也在基列山上支搭帐棚。

chapters.en: Then Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done? You have deceived me and carried off my daughters like captives of war!
chapters.zh: 拉班对雅各说：「你做的是什么事呢？你背着我偷走了，又把我的女儿们带了去，如同用刀剑掳去的一般。

chapters.en: Why did you run away secretly and deceive me, without even telling me? I would have sent you away with joy and singing, with tambourines and harps.
chapters.zh: 你为什么暗暗地逃跑，偷着走，并不告诉我，叫我可以欢乐、唱歌、击鼓、弹琴地送你回去？

chapters.en: But you did not even let me kiss my grandchildren and my daughters goodbye. Now you have done a foolish thing.
chapters.zh: 又不容我与外孙和女儿亲嘴？你所行的真是愚昧！

chapters.en: I have power to do you great harm, but last night the God of your father said to me, ‘Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.’
chapters.zh: 我手中原有能力害你，只是你父亲的上帝昨夜对我说：『你要小心，不可与雅各说好说歹。』

chapters.en: Now you have gone off because you long for your father’s house. But why have you stolen my gods?”
chapters.zh: 现在你虽然想你父家，不得不去，为什么又偷了我的神像呢？」

chapters.en: “I was afraid,” Jacob answered, “for I thought you would take your daughters from me by force.
chapters.zh: 雅各回答拉班说：「恐怕你把你的女儿从我夺去，所以我逃跑。

chapters.en: If you find your gods with anyone here, he shall not live! In the presence of our relatives, see for yourself if anything is yours, and take it back.” For Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen the idols.
chapters.zh: 至于你的神像，你在谁那里搜出来，就不容谁存活。当着我们的众弟兄，你认一认，在我这里有什么东西是你的，就拿去。」原来雅各不知道拉结偷了那些神像。

chapters.en: So Laban went into Jacob’s tent, then Leah’s tent, and then the tents of the two maidservants, but he found nothing. Then he left Leah’s tent and entered Rachel’s tent.
chapters.zh: 拉班进了雅各、利亚，并两个使女的帐棚，都没有搜出来，就从利亚的帐棚出来，进了拉结的帐棚。

chapters.en: Now Rachel had taken Laban’s household idols, put them in the saddlebag of her camel, and was sitting on them. And Laban searched everything in the tent but found nothing.
chapters.zh: 拉结已经把神像藏在骆驼的驮篓里，便坐在上头。拉班摸遍了那帐棚，并没有摸着。

chapters.en: Rachel said to her father, “Sir, do not be angry that I cannot stand up before you; for I am having my period.” So Laban searched but could not find the household idols.
chapters.zh: 拉结对她父亲说：「现在我身上不便，不能在你面前起来，求我主不要生气。」这样，拉班搜寻神像，竟没有搜出来。

chapters.en: Then Jacob became incensed and challenged Laban. “What is my crime?” he said. “For what sin of mine have you so hotly pursued me?
chapters.zh: 雅各就发怒斥责拉班说：「我有什么过犯，有什么罪恶，你竟这样火速地追我？

chapters.en: You have searched all my goods! Have you found anything that belongs to you? Put it here before my brothers and yours, that they may judge between the two of us.
chapters.zh: 你摸遍了我一切的家具，你搜出什么来呢？可以放在你我弟兄面前，叫他们在你我中间辨别辨别。

chapters.en: I have been with you for twenty years now. Your sheep and goats have not miscarried, nor have I eaten the rams of your flock.
chapters.zh: 我在你家这二十年，你的母绵羊、母山羊没有掉过胎。你群中的公羊，我没有吃过；

chapters.en: I did not bring you anything torn by wild beasts; I bore the loss myself. And you demanded payment from me for what was stolen by day or night.
chapters.zh: 被野兽撕裂的，我没有带来给你，是我自己赔上。无论是白日，是黑夜，被偷去的，你都向我索要。

chapters.en: As it was, the heat consumed me by day and the frost by night, and sleep fled from my eyes.
chapters.zh: 我白日受尽干热，黑夜受尽寒霜，不得合眼睡着，我常是这样。

chapters.en: Thus for twenty years I have served in your household—fourteen years for your two daughters and six years for your flocks—and you have changed my wages ten times!
chapters.zh: 我这二十年在你家里，为你的两个女儿服事你十四年，为你的羊群服事你六年，你又十次改了我的工价。

chapters.en: If the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had not been with me, surely by now you would have sent me away empty-handed. But God has seen my affliction and the toil of my hands, and last night He rendered judgment.”
chapters.zh: 若不是我父亲以撒所敬畏的上帝，就是亚伯拉罕的上帝与我同在，你如今必定打发我空手而去。上帝看见我的苦情和我的劳碌，就在昨夜责备你。」

chapters.en: But Laban answered Jacob, “These daughters are my daughters, these sons are my sons, and these flocks are my flocks! Everything you see is mine! Yet what can I do today about these daughters of mine or the children they have borne?
chapters.zh: 拉班回答雅各说：「这女儿是我的女儿，这些孩子是我的孩子，这些羊群也是我的羊群；凡在你眼前的都是我的。我的女儿并她们所生的孩子，我今日能向他们做什么呢？

chapters.en: Come now, let us make a covenant, you and I, and let it serve as a witness between you and me.”
chapters.zh: 来吧！你我二人可以立约，作你我中间的证据。」

chapters.en: So Jacob picked out a stone and set it up as a pillar,
chapters.zh: 雅各就拿一块石头立作柱子，

chapters.en: and he said to his relatives, “Gather some stones.” So they took stones and made a mound, and there by the mound they ate.
chapters.zh: 又对众弟兄说：「你们堆聚石头。」他们就拿石头来堆成一堆，大家便在旁边吃喝。

chapters.en: Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha, and Jacob called it Galeed.
chapters.zh: 拉班称那石堆为伊迦尔‧撒哈杜他，雅各却称那石堆为迦累得〔注：都是以石堆为证的意思〕。

chapters.en:
Then Laban declared, “This mound is a witness between you and me this day.”
Therefore the place was called Galeed.
chapters.zh: 拉班说：「今日这石堆作你我中间的证据。」因此这地方名叫迦累得，

chapters.en: It was also called Mizpah, because Laban said, “May the LORD keep watch between you and me when we are absent from each other.
chapters.zh: 又叫米斯巴，意思说：「我们彼此离别以后，愿耶和华在你我中间鉴察。

chapters.en: If you mistreat my daughters or take other wives, although no one is with us, remember that God is a witness between you and me.”
chapters.zh: 你若苦待我的女儿，又在我的女儿以外另娶妻，虽没有人知道，却有上帝在你我中间作见证。」

chapters.en: Laban also said to Jacob, “Here is the mound, and here is the pillar I have set up between you and me.
chapters.zh: 拉班又说：「你看我在你我中间所立的这石堆和柱子。

chapters.en: This mound is a witness, and this pillar is a witness, that I will not go past this mound to harm you, and you will not go past this mound and pillar to harm me.
chapters.zh: 这石堆作证据，这柱子也作证据。我必不过这石堆去害你；你也不可过这石堆和柱子来害我。

chapters.en:
May the God of Abraham and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.”
So Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.
chapters.zh: 但愿亚伯拉罕的上帝和拿鹤的上帝，就是他们父亲的上帝，在你我中间判断。」雅各就指着他父亲以撒所敬畏的〔上帝〕起誓，

chapters.en: Then Jacob offered a sacrifice on the mountain and invited his relatives to eat a meal. And after they had eaten, they spent the night on the mountain.
chapters.zh: 又在山上献祭，请众弟兄来吃饭。他们吃了饭，便在山上住宿。

chapters.en: Early the next morning, Laban got up and kissed his grandchildren and daughters and blessed them. Then he left to return home.
chapters.zh: 拉班清早起来，与他外孙和女儿亲嘴，给他们祝福，回往自己的地方去了。

chapters.en: Jacob also went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
chapters.zh: 雅各仍旧行路，上帝的使者遇见他。

chapters.en: When Jacob saw them, he said, “This is the camp of God.” So he named that place Mahanaim.
chapters.zh: 雅各看见他们就说：「这是上帝的军兵」，于是给那地方起名叫玛哈念〔注：就是二军兵的意思〕。

chapters.en: Jacob sent messengers ahead of him to his brother Esau in the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
chapters.zh: 雅各打发人先往西珥地去，就是以东地，见他哥哥以扫，

chapters.en: He instructed them, “You are to say to my master Esau, ‘Your servant Jacob says: I have been staying with Laban and have remained there until now.
chapters.zh: 吩咐他们说：「你们对我主以扫说：『你的仆人雅各这样说：我在拉班那里寄居，直到如今。

chapters.en: I have oxen, donkeys, flocks, menservants, and maidservants. I have sent this message to inform my master, so that I may find favor in your sight.’”
chapters.zh: 我有牛、驴、羊群、仆婢，现在打发人来报告我主，为要在你眼前蒙恩。』」

chapters.en: When the messengers returned to Jacob, they said, “We went to your brother Esau, and now he is coming to meet you—he and four hundred men with him.”
chapters.zh: 所打发的人回到雅各那里，说：「我们到了你哥哥以扫那里，他带着四百人，正迎着你来。」

chapters.en: In great fear and distress, Jacob divided his people into two camps, as well as the flocks and herds and camels.
chapters.zh: 雅各就甚惧怕，而且愁烦，便把那与他同在的人口和羊群、牛群、骆驼分做两队，

chapters.en: He thought, “If Esau comes and attacks one camp, then the other camp can escape.”
chapters.zh: 说：「以扫若来击杀这一队，剩下的那一队还可以逃避。」

chapters.en: Then Jacob declared, “O God of my father Abraham, God of my father Isaac, the LORD who told me, ‘Go back to your country and to your kindred, and I will make you prosper,’
chapters.zh: 雅各说：「耶和华－我祖亚伯拉罕的上帝，我父亲以撒的上帝啊，你曾对我说：『回你本地本族去，我要厚待你。』

chapters.en: I am unworthy of all the kindness and faithfulness You have shown Your servant. Indeed, with only my staff I came across the Jordan, but now I have become two camps.
chapters.zh: 你向仆人所施的一切慈爱和诚实，我一点也不配得；我先前只拿着我的杖过这约旦河，如今我却成了两队了。

chapters.en: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother Esau, for I am afraid that he may come and attack me and the mothers and children with me.
chapters.zh: 求你救我脱离我哥哥以扫的手；因为我怕他来杀我，连妻子带儿女一同杀了。

chapters.en: But You have said, ‘I will surely make you prosper, and I will make your offspring like the sand of the sea, too numerous to count.’”
chapters.zh: 你曾说：『我必定厚待你，使你的后裔如同海边的沙，多得不可胜数。』」

chapters.en: Jacob spent the night there, and from what he had brought with him, he selected a gift for his brother Esau:
chapters.zh: 当夜，雅各在那里住宿，就从他所有的物中拿礼物要送给他哥哥以扫：

chapters.en: 200 female goats, 20 male goats, 200 ewes, 20 rams,
chapters.zh: 母山羊二百只，公山羊二十只，母绵羊二百只，公绵羊二十只，

chapters.en: 30 milk camels with their young, 40 cows, 10 bulls, 20 female donkeys, and 10 male donkeys.
chapters.zh: 奶崽子的骆驼三十只－各带着崽子，母牛四十只，公牛十只，母驴二十匹，驴驹十匹；

chapters.en: He entrusted them to his servants in separate herds and told them, “Go on ahead of me, and keep some distance between the herds.”
chapters.zh: 每样各分一群，交在仆人手下，就对仆人说：「你们要在我前头过去，使群群相离，有空闲的地方」；

chapters.en: He instructed the one in the lead, “When my brother Esau meets you and asks, ‘To whom do you belong, where are you going, and whose animals are these before you?’
chapters.zh: 又吩咐尽先走的说：「我哥哥以扫遇见你的时候，问你说：『你是哪家的人？要往哪里去？你前头这些是谁的？』

chapters.en: then you are to say, ‘They belong to your servant Jacob. They are a gift, sent to my lord Esau. And behold, Jacob is behind us.’”
chapters.zh: 你就说：『是你仆人雅各的，是送给我主以扫的礼物；他自己也在我们后边。』」

chapters.en: He also instructed the second, the third, and all those following behind the herds: “When you meet Esau, you are to say the same thing to him.
chapters.zh: 又吩咐第二、第三，和一切赶群畜的人说：「你们遇见以扫的时候也要这样对他说；

chapters.en: You are also to say, ‘Look, your servant Jacob is right behind us.’” For he thought, “I will appease Esau with the gift that is going before me. After that I can face him, and perhaps he will accept me. ”
chapters.zh: 并且你们要说：『你仆人雅各在我们后边。』」因雅各心里说：「我藉着在我前头去的礼物解他的恨，然后再见他的面，或者他容纳我。」

chapters.en: So Jacob’s gifts went on before him, while he spent the night in the camp.
chapters.zh: 于是礼物先过去了；那夜，雅各在队中住宿。

chapters.en: During the night Jacob got up and took his two wives, his two maidservants, and his eleven sons, and crossed the ford of the Jabbok.
chapters.zh: 他夜间起来，带着两个妻子，两个使女，并十一个儿子，都过了雅博渡口，

chapters.en: He took them and sent them across the stream, along with all his possessions.
chapters.zh: 先打发他们过河，又打发所有的都过去，

chapters.en: So Jacob was left all alone, and there a man wrestled with him until daybreak.
chapters.zh: 只剩下雅各一人。有一个人来和他摔跤，直到黎明。

chapters.en: When the man saw that he could not overpower Jacob, he struck the socket of Jacob’s hip and dislocated it as they wrestled.
chapters.zh: 那人见自己胜不过他，就将他的大腿窝摸了一把，雅各的大腿窝正在摔跤的时候就扭了。

chapters.en:
Then the man said, “Let me go, for it is daybreak.”
But Jacob replied, “I will not let you go unless you bless me.”
chapters.zh: 那人说：「天黎明了，容我去吧！」雅各说：「你不给我祝福，我就不容你去。」

chapters.en:
“What is your name?” the man asked.
“Jacob,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 那人说：「你名叫什么？」他说：「我名叫雅各。」

chapters.en: Then the man said, “Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have struggled with God and with men, and you have prevailed.”
chapters.zh: 那人说：「你的名不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列；因为你与上帝与人较力，都得了胜。」

chapters.en:
And Jacob requested, “Please tell me your name.”
But he replied, “Why do you ask my name?” Then he blessed Jacob there.
chapters.zh: 雅各问他说：「请将你的名告诉我。」那人说：「何必问我的名？」于是在那里给雅各祝福。

chapters.en: So Jacob named the place Peniel, saying, “Indeed, I have seen God face to face, and yet my life was spared.”
chapters.zh: 雅各便给那地方起名叫毗努伊勒〔注：就是上帝之面的意思〕，意思说：「我面对面见了上帝，我的性命仍得保全。」

chapters.en: The sun rose above him as he passed by Penuel, and he was limping because of his hip.
chapters.zh: 日头刚出来的时候，雅各经过毗努伊勒，他的大腿就瘸了。

chapters.en: Therefore to this day the Israelites do not eat the tendon attached to the socket of the hip, because the socket of Jacob’s hip was struck near that tendon.
chapters.zh: 故此，以色列人不吃大腿窝的筋，直到今日，因为那人摸了雅各大腿窝的筋。

chapters.en: Now Jacob looked up and saw Esau coming toward him with four hundred men. So he divided the children among Leah, Rachel, and the two maidservants.
chapters.zh: 雅各举目观看，见以扫来了，后头跟着四百人，他就把孩子们分开交给利亚、拉结，和两个使女，

chapters.en: He put the maidservants and their children in front, Leah and her children next, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.
chapters.zh: 并且叫两个使女和她们的孩子在前头，利亚和她的孩子在后头，拉结和约瑟在尽后头。

chapters.en: But Jacob himself went on ahead and bowed to the ground seven times as he approached his brother.
chapters.zh: 他自己在他们前头过去，一连七次俯伏在地才就近他哥哥。

chapters.en: Esau, however, ran to him and embraced him, threw his arms around his neck, and kissed him. And they both wept.
chapters.zh: 以扫跑来迎接他，将他抱住，又搂着他的颈项，与他亲嘴，两个人就哭了。

chapters.en:
When Esau looked up and saw the women and children, he asked, “Who are these with you?”
Jacob answered, “These are the children God has graciously given your servant.”
chapters.zh: 以扫举目看见妇人孩子，就说：「这些和你同行的是谁呢？」雅各说：「这些孩子是上帝施恩给你的仆人的。」

chapters.en: Then the maidservants and their children approached and bowed down.
chapters.zh: 于是两个使女和她们的孩子前来下拜；

chapters.en: Leah and her children also approached and bowed down, and then Joseph and Rachel approached and bowed down.
chapters.zh: 利亚和她的孩子也前来下拜；随后约瑟和拉结也前来下拜。

chapters.en:
“What do you mean by sending this whole company to meet me?” asked Esau.
“To find favor in your sight, my lord,” Jacob answered.
chapters.zh: 以扫说：「我所遇见的这些群畜是什么意思呢？」雅各说：「是要在我主面前蒙恩的。」

chapters.en: “I already have plenty, my brother,” Esau replied. “Keep what belongs to you.”
chapters.zh: 以扫说：「兄弟啊，我的已经够了，你的仍归你吧！」

chapters.en: But Jacob insisted, “No, please! If I have found favor in your sight, then receive this gift from my hand. For indeed, I have seen your face, and it is like seeing the face of God, since you have received me favorably.
chapters.zh: 雅各说：「不然，我若在你眼前蒙恩，就求你从我手里收下这礼物；因为我见了你的面，如同见了上帝的面，并且你容纳了我。

chapters.en: Please accept my gift that was brought to you, because God has been gracious to me and I have all I need.” So Jacob pressed him until he accepted.
chapters.zh: 求你收下我带来给你的礼物；因为上帝恩待我，使我充足。」雅各再三地求他，他才收下了。

chapters.en: Then Esau said, “Let us be on our way, and I will go ahead of you.”
chapters.zh: 以扫说：「我们可以起身前往，我在你前头走。」

chapters.en: But Jacob replied, “My lord knows that the children are frail, and I must care for sheep and cattle that are nursing their young. If they are driven hard for even a day, all the animals will die.
chapters.zh: 雅各对他说：「我主知道孩子们年幼娇嫩，牛羊也正在乳养的时候，若是催赶一天，群畜都必死了。

chapters.en: Please let my lord go ahead of his servant. I will continue on slowly, at a comfortable pace for the livestock and children, until I come to my lord at Seir.”
chapters.zh: 求我主在仆人前头走，我要量着在我面前群畜和孩子的力量慢慢地前行，直走到西珥我主那里。」

chapters.en:
“Let me leave some of my people with you,” Esau said.
But Jacob replied, “Why do that? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”
chapters.zh: 以扫说：「容我把跟随我的人留几个在你这里。」雅各说：「何必呢？只要在我主眼前蒙恩就是了。」

chapters.en: So that day Esau started on his way back to Seir,
chapters.zh: 于是，以扫当日起行，回往西珥去了。

chapters.en: but Jacob went on to Succoth, where he built a house for himself and shelters for his livestock; that is why the place was called Succoth.
chapters.zh: 雅各就往疏割去，在那里为自己盖造房屋，又为牲畜搭棚；因此那地方名叫疏割〔注：就是棚的意思〕。

chapters.en: After Jacob had come from Paddan-aram, he arrived safely at the city of Shechem in the land of Canaan, and he camped just outside the city.
chapters.zh: 雅各从巴旦‧亚兰回来的时候，平平安安地到了迦南地的示剑城，在城东支搭帐棚，

chapters.en: And the plot of ground where he pitched his tent, he purchased from the sons of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for a hundred pieces of silver.
chapters.zh: 就用一百块〔银子〕向示剑的父亲、哈抹的子孙买了支帐棚的那块地，

chapters.en: There he set up an altar and called it El-Elohe-Israel.
chapters.zh: 在那里筑了一座坛，起名叫伊利‧伊罗伊‧以色列〔注：就是上帝、以色列上帝的意思〕。

chapters.en: Now Dinah, the daughter Leah had borne to Jacob, went out to visit the daughters of the land.
chapters.zh: 利亚给雅各所生的女儿底拿出去，要见那地的女子们。

chapters.en: When Shechem son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the region, saw her, he took her and lay with her by force.
chapters.zh: 那地的主－希未人、哈抹的儿子示剑看见她，就拉住她，与她行淫，玷辱她。

chapters.en: And his soul was drawn to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob. He loved the young girl and spoke to her tenderly.
chapters.zh: 示剑的心系恋雅各的女儿底拿，喜爱这女子，甜言蜜语地安慰她。

chapters.en: So Shechem told his father Hamor, “Get me this girl as a wife.”
chapters.zh: 示剑对他父亲哈抹说：「求你为我聘这女子为妻。」

chapters.en: Jacob heard that Shechem had defiled his daughter Dinah, but since his sons were with his livestock in the field, he remained silent about it until they returned.
chapters.zh: 雅各听见示剑玷污了他的女儿底拿。那时他的儿子们正和群畜在田野，雅各就闭口不言，等他们回来。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Shechem’s father Hamor came to speak with Jacob.
chapters.zh: 示剑的父亲哈抹出来见雅各，要和他商议。

chapters.en: When Jacob’s sons heard what had happened, they returned from the field. They were filled with grief and fury, because Shechem had committed an outrage in Israel by lying with Jacob’s daughter—a thing that should not be done.
chapters.zh: 雅各的儿子们听见这事，就从田野回来，人人忿恨，十分恼怒；因示剑在以色列家做了丑事，与雅各的女儿行淫，这本是不该做的事。

chapters.en: But Hamor said to them, “My son Shechem longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as his wife.
chapters.zh: 哈抹和他们商议说：「我儿子示剑的心恋慕这女子，求你们将她给我的儿子为妻。

chapters.en: Intermarry with us; give us your daughters and take our daughters for yourselves.
chapters.zh: 你们与我们彼此结亲；你们可以把女儿给我们，也可以娶我们的女儿。

chapters.en: You may settle among us, and the land will be open to you. Live here, move about freely, and acquire your own property.”
chapters.zh: 你们与我们同住吧！这地都在你们面前，只管在此居住，做买卖，置产业。」

chapters.en: Then Shechem said to Dinah’s father and brothers, “Grant me this favor, and I will give you whatever you ask.
chapters.zh: 示剑对女儿的父亲和弟兄们说：「但愿我在你们眼前蒙恩，你们向我要什么，我必给你们。

chapters.en: Demand a high dowry and an expensive gift, and I will give you whatever you ask. Only give me the girl as my wife!”
chapters.zh: 任凭向我要多重的聘金和礼物，我必照你们所说的给你们；只要把女子给我为妻。」

chapters.en: But because Shechem had defiled their sister Dinah, Jacob’s sons answered him and his father Hamor deceitfully.
chapters.zh: 雅各的儿子们因为示剑玷污了他们的妹子底拿，就用诡诈的话回答示剑和他父亲哈抹，

chapters.en: “We cannot do such a thing,” they said. “To give our sister to an uncircumcised man would be a disgrace to us.
chapters.zh: 对他们说：「我们不能把我们的妹子给没有受割礼的人为妻，因为那是我们的羞辱。

chapters.en: We will consent to this on one condition, that you become circumcised like us—every one of your males.
chapters.zh: 惟有一件才可以应允：若你们所有的男丁都受割礼，和我们一样，

chapters.en: Then we will give you our daughters and take your daughters for ourselves. We will dwell among you and become one people.
chapters.zh: 我们就把女儿给你们，也娶你们的女儿；我们便与你们同住，两下成为一样的人民。

chapters.en: But if you will not agree to be circumcised, then we will take our sister and go.”
chapters.zh: 倘若你们不听从我们受割礼，我们就带着妹子走了。」

chapters.en: Their offer seemed good to Hamor and his son Shechem.
chapters.zh: 哈抹和他的儿子示剑喜欢这话。

chapters.en: The young man, who was the most respected of all his father’s household, did not hesitate to fulfill this request, because he was delighted with Jacob’s daughter.
chapters.zh: 那少年人做这事并不迟延，因为他喜爱雅各的女儿；他在他父亲家中也是人最尊重的。

chapters.en: So Hamor and his son Shechem went to the gate of their city and addressed the men of their city:
chapters.zh: 哈抹和他儿子示剑到本城的门口，对本城的人说：

chapters.en: “These men are at peace with us. Let them live and trade in our land; indeed, it is large enough for them. Let us take their daughters in marriage and give our daughters to them.
chapters.zh: 「这些人与我们和睦，不如许他们在这地居住，做买卖；这地也宽阔，足可容下他们。我们可以娶他们的女儿为妻，也可以把我们的女儿嫁给他们。

chapters.en: But only on this condition will the men agree to dwell with us and be one people: if all our men are circumcised as they are.
chapters.zh: 惟有一件事我们必须做，他们才肯应允和我们同住，成为一样的人民：就是我们中间所有的男丁都要受割礼，和他们一样。

chapters.en: Will not their livestock, their possessions, and all their animals become ours? Only let us consent to them, and they will dwell among us.”
chapters.zh: 他们的群畜、货财，和一切的牲口岂不都归我们吗？只要依从他们，他们就与我们同住。」

chapters.en: All the men who went out of the city gate listened to Hamor and his son Shechem, and every male of the city was circumcised.
chapters.zh: 凡从城门出入的人就都听从哈抹和他儿子示剑的话；于是凡从城门出入的男丁都受了割礼。

chapters.en: Three days later, while they were still in pain, two of Jacob’s sons (Dinah’s brothers Simeon and Levi) took their swords, went into the unsuspecting city, and slaughtered every male.
chapters.zh: 到第三天，众人正在疼痛的时候，雅各的两个儿子，就是底拿的哥哥西缅和利未，各拿刀剑，趁着众人想不到的时候来到城中，把一切男丁都杀了，

chapters.en: They killed Hamor and his son Shechem with their swords, took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.
chapters.zh: 又用刀杀了哈抹和他儿子示剑，把底拿从示剑家里带出来就走了。

chapters.en: Jacob’s other sons came upon the slaughter and looted the city, because their sister had been defiled.
chapters.zh: 雅各的儿子们因为他们的妹子受了玷污，就来到被杀的人那里，掳掠那城，

chapters.en: They took their flocks and herds and donkeys, and everything else in the city or in the field.
chapters.zh: 夺了他们的羊群、牛群，和驴，并城里田间所有的；

chapters.en: They carried off all their possessions and women and children, and they plundered everything in their houses.
chapters.zh: 又把他们一切货财、孩子、妇女，并各房中所有的，都掳掠去了。

chapters.en: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have brought trouble upon me by making me a stench to the Canaanites and Perizzites, the people of this land. We are few in number; if they unite against me and attack me, I and my household will be destroyed.”
chapters.zh: 雅各对西缅和利未说：「你们连累我，使我在这地的居民中，就是在迦南人和比利洗人中，有了臭名。我的人丁既然稀少，他们必聚集来击杀我，我和全家的人都必灭绝。」

chapters.en: But they replied, “Should he have treated our sister like a prostitute?”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「他岂可待我们的妹子如同妓女吗？」

chapters.en: Then God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and settle there. Build an altar there to the God who appeared to you when you fled from your brother Esau.”
chapters.zh: 上帝对雅各说：「起来！上伯特利去，住在那里；要在那里筑一座坛给上帝，就是你逃避你哥哥以扫的时候向你显现的那位。」

chapters.en: So Jacob told his household and all who were with him, “Get rid of the foreign gods that are among you. Purify yourselves and change your garments.
chapters.zh: 雅各就对他家中的人并一切与他同在的人说：「你们要除掉你们中间的外邦神，也要自洁，更换衣裳。

chapters.en: Then let us arise and go to Bethel. I will build an altar there to God, who answered me in my day of distress. He has been with me wherever I have gone.”
chapters.zh: 我们要起来，上伯特利去，在那里我要筑一座坛给上帝，就是在我遭难的日子应允我〔的祷告〕、在我行的路上保佑我的那位。」

chapters.en: So they gave Jacob all their foreign gods and all their earrings, and Jacob buried them under the oak near Shechem.
chapters.zh: 他们就把外邦人的神像和他们耳朵上的环子交给雅各；雅各都藏在示剑那里的橡树底下。

chapters.en: As they set out, a terror from God fell over the surrounding cities, so that they did not pursue Jacob’s sons.
chapters.zh: 他们便起行前往。上帝使那周围城邑的人都甚惊惧，就不追赶雅各的众子了。

chapters.en: So Jacob and everyone with him arrived in Luz (that is, Bethel) in the land of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 于是雅各和一切与他同在的人到了迦南地的路斯，就是伯特利。

chapters.en: There Jacob built an altar, and he called that place El-bethel, because it was there that God had revealed Himself to Jacob as he fled from his brother.
chapters.zh: 他在那里筑了一座坛，就给那地方起名叫伊勒‧伯特利〔注：就是伯特利之上帝的意思〕；因为他逃避他哥哥的时候，上帝在那里向他显现。

chapters.en: Now Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died and was buried under the oak below Bethel. So Jacob named it Allon-bacuth.
chapters.zh: 利百加的奶母底波拉死了，就葬在伯特利下边橡树底下；那棵树名叫亚伦‧巴古。

chapters.en: After Jacob had returned from Paddan-aram, God appeared to him again and blessed him.
chapters.zh: 雅各从巴旦‧亚兰回来，上帝又向他显现，赐福与他，

chapters.en: And God said to him, “Though your name is Jacob, you will no longer be called Jacob. Instead, your name will be Israel. ” So God named him Israel.
chapters.zh: 且对他说：「你的名原是雅各，从今以后不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列。」这样，他就改名叫以色列。

chapters.en: And God told him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation—even a company of nations—shall come from you, and kings shall descend from you.
chapters.zh: 上帝又对他说：「我是全能的上帝；你要生养众多，将来有一族和多国的民从你而生，又有君王从你而出。

chapters.en: The land that I gave to Abraham and Isaac I will give to you, and I will give this land to your descendants after you.”
chapters.zh: 我所赐给亚伯拉罕和以撒的地，我要赐给你与你的后裔。」

chapters.en: Then God went up from the place where He had spoken with him.
chapters.zh: 上帝就从那与雅各说话的地方升上去了。

chapters.en: So Jacob set up a pillar in the place where God had spoken with him—a stone marker—and he poured out a drink offering on it and anointed it with oil.
chapters.zh: 雅各便在那里立了一根石柱，在柱子上奠酒，浇油。

chapters.en: Jacob called the place where God had spoken with him Bethel.
chapters.zh: 雅各就给那地方起名叫伯特利。

chapters.en: Later, they set out from Bethel, and while they were still some distance from Ephrath, Rachel began to give birth, and her labor was difficult.
chapters.zh: 他们从伯特利起行，离以法他还有一段路程，拉结临产甚是艰难。

chapters.en: During her severe labor, the midwife said to her, “Do not be afraid, for you are having another son.”
chapters.zh: 正在艰难的时候，收生婆对她说：「不要怕，你又要得一个儿子了。」

chapters.en: And with her last breath—for she was dying—she named him Ben-oni. But his father called him Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 她将近于死，灵魂要走的时候，就给她儿子起名叫便‧俄尼；他父亲却给他起名叫便雅悯。

chapters.en: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).
chapters.zh: 拉结死了，葬在以法他的路旁；以法他就是伯利恒。

chapters.en: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave; it marks Rachel’s tomb to this day.
chapters.zh: 雅各在她的坟上立了一统碑，就是拉结的墓碑，到今日还在。

chapters.en: Israel again set out and pitched his tent beyond the Tower of Eder.
chapters.zh: 以色列起行前往，在以得台那边支搭帐棚。

chapters.en:
While Israel was living in that region, Reuben went in and slept with his father’s concubine Bilhah, and Israel heard about it.
Jacob had twelve sons:
chapters.zh: 以色列住在那地的时候，吕便去与他父亲的妾辟拉同寝，以色列也听见了。 雅各共有十二个儿子。

chapters.en: The sons of Leah were Reuben the firstborn of Jacob, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
chapters.zh: 利亚所生的是雅各的长子吕便，还有西缅、利未、犹大、以萨迦、西布伦。

chapters.en: The sons of Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 拉结所生的是约瑟、便雅悯。

chapters.en: The sons of Rachel’s maidservant Bilhah were Dan and Naphtali.
chapters.zh: 拉结的使女辟拉所生的是但、拿弗他利。

chapters.en:
And the sons of Leah’s maidservant Zilpah were Gad and Asher.
These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan-aram.
chapters.zh: 利亚的使女悉帕所生的是迦得、亚设。这是雅各在巴旦‧亚兰所生的儿子。

chapters.en: Jacob returned to his father Isaac at Mamre, near Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had stayed.
chapters.zh: 雅各来到他父亲以撒那里，到了基列‧亚巴的幔利，乃是亚伯拉罕和以撒寄居的地方；基列‧亚巴就是希伯崙。

chapters.en: And Isaac lived 180 years.
chapters.zh: 以撒共活了一百八十岁。

chapters.en: Then he breathed his last and died and was gathered to his people, old and full of years. And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
chapters.zh: 以撒年纪老迈，日子满足，气绝而死，归到他列祖〔注：原文是本民〕那里。他两个儿子以扫、雅各把他埋葬了。

chapters.en: This is the account of Esau (that is, Edom).
chapters.zh: 以扫就是以东，他的后代记在下面。

chapters.en: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah daughter of Elon the Hittite, Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite,
chapters.zh: 以扫娶迦南的女子为妻，就是赫人以伦的女儿亚大和希未人祭便的孙女、亚拿的女儿阿何利巴玛，

chapters.en: and Basemath daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth.
chapters.zh: 又娶了以实玛利的女儿、尼拜约的妹子巴实抹。

chapters.en: And Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, Basemath gave birth to Reuel,
chapters.zh: 亚大给以扫生了以利法；巴实抹生了流珥；

chapters.en: and Oholibamah gave birth to Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These were the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 阿何利巴玛生了耶乌施、雅兰、可拉。这都是以扫的儿子，是在迦南地生的。

chapters.en: Later, Esau took his wives and sons and daughters and all the people of his household, along with his livestock, all his other animals, and all the property he had acquired in Canaan, and he moved to a land far away from his brother Jacob.
chapters.zh: 以扫带着他的妻子、儿女，与家中一切的人口，并他的牛羊、牲畜，和一切货财，就是他在迦南地所得的，往别处去，离了他兄弟雅各。

chapters.en: For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together; the land where they stayed could not support them because of their livestock.
chapters.zh: 因为二人的财物群畜甚多，寄居的地方容不下他们，所以不能同居。

chapters.en: So Esau (that is, Edom) settled in the area of Mount Seir.
chapters.zh: 于是以扫住在西珥山里；以扫就是以东。

chapters.en: This is the account of Esau, the father of the Edomites, in the area of Mount Seir.
chapters.zh: 以扫是西珥山里以东人的始祖，他的后代记在下面。

chapters.en: These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz son of Esau’s wife Adah, and Reuel son of Esau’s wife Basemath.
chapters.zh: 以扫众子的名字如下。以扫的妻子亚大生以利法；以扫的妻子巴实抹生流珥。

chapters.en: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.
chapters.zh: 以利法的儿子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基纳斯。

chapters.en: Additionally, Timna, a concubine of Esau’s son Eliphaz, gave birth to Amalek. These are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Adah.
chapters.zh: 亭纳是以扫儿子以利法的妾；她给以利法生了亚玛力。这是以扫的妻子亚大的子孙。

chapters.en: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. They are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
chapters.zh: 流珥的儿子是拿哈、谢拉、沙玛、米撒。这是以扫妻子巴实抹的子孙。

chapters.en: These are the sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah (daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon) whom she bore to Esau: Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
chapters.zh: 以扫的妻子阿何利巴玛是祭便的孙女，亚拿的女儿；她给以扫生了耶乌施、雅兰、可拉。

chapters.en: These are the chiefs among the sons of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: Chiefs Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,
chapters.zh: 以扫子孙中作族长的记在下面。以扫的长子以利法的子孙中，有提幔族长、阿抹族长、洗玻族长、基纳斯族长、

chapters.en: Korah, Gatam, and Amalek. They are the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom, and they are the grandsons of Adah.
chapters.zh: 可拉族长、迦坦族长、亚玛力族长。这是在以东地从以利法所出的族长，都是亚大的子孙。

chapters.en: These are the sons of Esau’s son Reuel: Chiefs Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. They are the chiefs descended from Reuel in the land of Edom, and they are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
chapters.zh: 以扫的儿子流珥的子孙中，有拿哈族长、谢拉族长、沙玛族长、米撒族长。这是在以东地从流珥所出的族长，都是以扫妻子巴实抹的子孙。

chapters.en: These are the sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah: Chiefs Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. They are the chiefs descended from Esau’s wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
chapters.zh: 以扫的妻子阿何利巴玛的子孙中，有耶乌施族长、雅兰族长、可拉族长。这是从以扫妻子，亚拿的女儿，阿何利巴玛子孙中所出的族长。

chapters.en: All these are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and they were their chiefs.
chapters.zh: 以上的族长都是以扫的子孙；以扫就是以东。

chapters.en: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who were living in the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
chapters.zh: 那地原有的居民－何利人西珥的子孙记在下面：就是罗坍、朔巴、祭便、亚拿、

chapters.en: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. They are the chiefs of the Horites, the descendants of Seir in the land of Edom.
chapters.zh: 底顺、以察、底珊。这是从以东地的何利人西珥子孙中所出的族长。

chapters.en: The sons of Lotan were Hori and Hemam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
chapters.zh: 罗坍的儿子是何利、希幔；罗坍的妹子是亭纳。

chapters.en: These are the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
chapters.zh: 朔巴的儿子是亚勒文、玛拿辖、以巴录、示玻、阿南。

chapters.en: These are the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. (This is the Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness as he was pasturing the donkeys of his father Zibeon.)
chapters.zh: 祭便的儿子是亚雅、亚拿（当时在旷野放他父亲祭便的驴，遇着温泉的，就是这亚拿）。

chapters.en: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah daughter of Anah.
chapters.zh: 亚拿的儿子是底顺；亚拿的女儿是阿何利巴玛。

chapters.en: These are the sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
chapters.zh: 底顺的儿子是欣但、伊是班、益兰、基兰。

chapters.en: These are the sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
chapters.zh: 以察的儿子是辟罕、撒番、亚干。

chapters.en: These are the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
chapters.zh: 底珊的儿子是乌斯、亚兰。

chapters.en: These are the chiefs of the Horites: Chiefs Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
chapters.zh: 从何利人所出的族长记在下面：就是罗坍族长、朔巴族长、祭便族长、亚拿族长、

chapters.en: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. They are the chiefs of the Horites, according to their divisions in the land of Seir.
chapters.zh: 底顺族长、以察族长、底珊族长。这是从何利人所出的族长，都在西珥地，按着宗族作族长。

chapters.en: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites:
chapters.zh: 以色列人未有君王治理以先，在以东地作王的记在下面。

chapters.en: Bela son of Beor reigned in Edom; the name of his city was Dinhabah.
chapters.zh: 比珥的儿子比拉在以东作王，他的〔京〕城名叫亭哈巴。

chapters.en: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 比拉死了，波斯拉人谢拉的儿子约巴接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 约巴死了，提幔地的人户珊接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.
chapters.zh: 户珊死了，比达的儿子哈达接续他作王；这哈达就是在摩押地杀败米甸人的，他的〔京〕城名叫亚未得。

chapters.en: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 哈达死了，玛士利加人桑拉接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the Euphrates reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 桑拉死了，大河边的利河伯人扫罗接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 扫罗死了，亚革波的儿子巴勒‧哈南接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Baal-hanan son of Achbor died, Hadad reigned in his place. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
chapters.zh: 亚革波的儿子巴勒‧哈南死了，哈达接续他作王，他的〔京〕城名叫巴乌；他的妻子名叫米希她别，是米‧萨合的孙女，玛特列的女儿。

chapters.en: These are the names of Esau’s chiefs, according to their families and regions, by their names: Chiefs Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
chapters.zh: 从以扫所出的族长，按着他们的宗族、住处、名字记在下面：就是亭纳族长、亚勒瓦族长、耶帖族长、

chapters.en: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
chapters.zh: 阿何利巴玛族长、以拉族长、比嫩族长、

chapters.en: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
chapters.zh: 基纳斯族长、提幔族长、米比萨族长、

chapters.en: Magdiel, and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom, according to their settlements in the land they possessed. Esau was the father of the Edomites.
chapters.zh: 玛基叠族长、以兰族长。这是以东人在所得为业的地上，按着他们的住处。（所有的族长都是以东人的始祖以扫的后代。）

chapters.en: Now Jacob lived in the land where his father had resided, the land of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 雅各住在迦南地，就是他父亲寄居的地。

chapters.en: This is the account of Jacob. When Joseph was seventeen years old, he was tending the flock with his brothers, the sons of his father’s wives Bilhah and Zilpah, and he brought their father a bad report about them.
chapters.zh: 雅各的记略如下。 约瑟十七岁与他哥哥们一同牧羊。他是个童子，与他父亲的妾辟拉、悉帕的儿子们常在一处。约瑟将他哥哥们的恶行报给他们的父亲。

chapters.en: Now Israel loved Joseph more than his other sons, because Joseph had been born to him in his old age; so he made him a robe of many colors.
chapters.zh: 以色列原来爱约瑟过于爱他的众子，因为约瑟是他年老生的；他给约瑟做了一件彩衣。

chapters.en: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father loved him more than any of them, they hated him and could not speak a kind word to him.
chapters.zh: 约瑟的哥哥们见父亲爱约瑟过于爱他们，就恨约瑟，不与他说和睦的话。

chapters.en: Then Joseph had a dream, and when he told it to his brothers, they hated him even more.
chapters.zh: 约瑟做了一梦，告诉他哥哥们，他们就越发恨他。

chapters.en: He said to them, “Listen to this dream I had:
chapters.zh: 约瑟对他们说：「请听我所做的梦：

chapters.en: We were binding sheaves of grain in the field, and suddenly my sheaf rose and stood upright, while your sheaves gathered around and bowed down to mine.”
chapters.zh: 我们在田里捆禾稼，我的捆起来站着，你们的捆来围着我的捆下拜。」

chapters.en: “Do you intend to reign over us?” his brothers asked. “Will you actually rule us?” So they hated him even more because of his dream and his statements.
chapters.zh: 他的哥哥们回答说：「难道你真要作我们的王吗？难道你真要管辖我们吗？」他们就因为他的梦和他的话越发恨他。

chapters.en: Then Joseph had another dream and told it to his brothers. “Look,” he said, “I had another dream, and this time the sun and moon and eleven stars were bowing down to me.”
chapters.zh: 后来他又做了一梦，也告诉他的哥哥们说：「看哪，我又做了一梦，梦见太阳、月亮，与十一个星向我下拜。」

chapters.en: He told his father and brothers, but his father rebuked him and said, “What is this dream that you have had? Will your mother and brothers and I actually come and bow down to the ground before you?”
chapters.zh: 约瑟将这梦告诉他父亲和他哥哥们，他父亲就责备他说：「你做的这是什么梦！难道我和你母亲、你弟兄果然要来俯伏在地，向你下拜吗？」

chapters.en: And his brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept in mind what he had said.
chapters.zh: 他哥哥们都嫉妒他，他父亲却把这话存在心里。

chapters.en: Some time later, Joseph’s brothers had gone to pasture their father’s flocks near Shechem.
chapters.zh: 约瑟的哥哥们往示剑去放他们父亲的羊。

chapters.en:
Israel said to him, “Are not your brothers pasturing the flocks at Shechem? Get ready; I am sending you to them.”
“I am ready,” Joseph replied.
chapters.zh: 以色列对约瑟说：「你哥哥们不是在示剑放羊吗？你来，我要打发你往他们那里去。」约瑟说：「我在这里。」

chapters.en:
Then Israel told him, “Go now and see how your brothers and the flocks are faring, and bring word back to me.”
So he sent him off from the Valley of Hebron. And when Joseph arrived in Shechem,
chapters.zh: 以色列说：「你去看看你哥哥们平安不平安，群羊平安不平安，就回来报信给我」；于是打发他出希伯崙谷，他就往示剑去了。

chapters.en: a man found him wandering in the field and asked, “What are you looking for?”
chapters.zh: 有人遇见他在田野走迷了路，就问他说：「你找什么？」

chapters.en: “I am looking for my brothers,” Joseph replied. “Can you please tell me where they are pasturing their flocks?”
chapters.zh: 他说：「我找我的哥哥们，求你告诉我，他们在何处放羊。」

chapters.en: “They have moved on from here,” the man answered. “I heard them say, ‘Let us go to Dothan.’” So Joseph set out after his brothers and found them at Dothan.
chapters.zh: 那人说：「他们已经走了，我听见他们说要往多坍去。」约瑟就去追赶他哥哥们，遇见他们在多坍。

chapters.en: Now Joseph’s brothers saw him in the distance, and before he arrived, they plotted to kill him.
chapters.zh: 他们远远地看见他，趁他还没有走到跟前，大家就同谋要害死他，

chapters.en: “Here comes that dreamer!” they said to one another.
chapters.zh: 彼此说：「你看！那做梦的来了。

chapters.en: “Come now, let us kill him and throw him into one of the pits. We can say that a vicious animal has devoured him. Then we shall see what becomes of his dreams!”
chapters.zh: 来吧！我们将他杀了，丢在一个坑里，就说有恶兽把他吃了。我们且看他的梦将来怎么样。」

chapters.en: When Reuben heard this, he tried to rescue Joseph from their hands. “Let us not take his life,” he said.
chapters.zh: 吕便听见了，要救他脱离他们的手，说：「我们不可害他的性命」；

chapters.en: “Do not shed his blood. Throw him into this pit in the wilderness, but do not lay a hand on him.” Reuben said this so that he could rescue Joseph from their hands and return him to his father.
chapters.zh: 又说：「不可流〔他的〕血，可以把他丢在这野地的坑里，不可下手害他。」吕便的意思是要救他脱离他们的手，把他归还他的父亲。

chapters.en: So when Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped him of his robe—the robe of many colors he was wearing—
chapters.zh: 约瑟到了他哥哥们那里，他们就剥了他的外衣，就是他穿的那件彩衣，

chapters.en: and they took him and threw him into the pit. Now the pit was empty, with no water in it.
chapters.zh: 把他丢在坑里；那坑是空的，里头没有水。

chapters.en: And as they sat down to eat a meal, they looked up and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead. Their camels were carrying spices, balm, and myrrh on their way down to Egypt.
chapters.zh: 他们坐下吃饭，举目观看，见有一伙〔米甸的〕以实玛利人从基列来，用骆驼驮着香料、乳香、没药，要带下埃及去。

chapters.en: Then Judah said to his brothers, “What profit will we gain if we kill our brother and cover up his blood?
chapters.zh: 犹大对众弟兄说：「我们杀我们的兄弟，藏了他的血有什么益处呢？

chapters.en: Come, let us sell him to the Ishmaelites and not lay a hand on him; for he is our brother, our own flesh.” And they agreed.
chapters.zh: 我们不如将他卖给以实玛利人，不可下手害他；因为他是我们的兄弟，我们的骨肉。」众弟兄就听从了他。

chapters.en: So when the Midianite traders passed by, his brothers pulled Joseph out of the pit and sold him for twenty shekels of silver to the Ishmaelites, who took him to Egypt.
chapters.zh: 有些米甸的商人从那里经过，哥哥们就把约瑟从坑里拉上来，讲定二十舍客勒银子，把约瑟卖给以实玛利人。他们就把约瑟带到埃及去了。

chapters.en: When Reuben returned to the pit and saw that Joseph was not there, he tore his clothes,
chapters.zh: 吕便回到坑边，见约瑟不在坑里，就撕裂衣服，

chapters.en: returned to his brothers, and said, “The boy is gone! What am I going to do?”
chapters.zh: 回到兄弟们那里，说：「童子没有了。我往哪里去才好呢？」

chapters.en: Then they took Joseph’s robe, slaughtered a young goat, and dipped the robe in its blood.
chapters.zh: 他们宰了一只公山羊，把约瑟的那件彩衣染了血，

chapters.en: They sent the robe of many colors to their father and said, “We found this. Examine it to see whether it is your son’s robe or not.”
chapters.zh: 打发人送到他们的父亲那里，说：「我们捡了这个；请认一认是你儿子的外衣不是？」

chapters.en: His father recognized it and said, “It is my son’s robe! A vicious animal has devoured him. Joseph has surely been torn to pieces!”
chapters.zh: 他认得，就说：「这是我儿子的外衣。有恶兽把他吃了，约瑟被撕碎了！撕碎了！」

chapters.en: Then Jacob tore his clothes, put sackcloth around his waist, and mourned for his son many days.
chapters.zh: 雅各便撕裂衣服，腰间围上麻布，为他儿子悲哀了多日。

chapters.en: All his sons and daughters tried to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. “No,” he said. “I will go down to Sheol mourning for my son.” So his father wept for him.
chapters.zh: 他的儿女都起来安慰他，他却不肯受安慰，说：「我必悲哀着下阴间，到我儿子那里。」约瑟的父亲就为他哀哭。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, the Midianites sold Joseph in Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard.
chapters.zh: 米甸人带约瑟到埃及，把他卖给法老的内臣－护卫长波提乏。

chapters.en: About that time, Judah left his brothers and settled near a man named Hirah, an Adullamite.
chapters.zh: 那时，犹大离开他弟兄下去，到一个亚杜兰人名叫希拉的家里去。

chapters.en: There Judah saw the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua, and he took her as a wife and slept with her.
chapters.zh: 犹大在那里看见一个迦南人名叫书亚的女儿，就娶她为妻，与她同房，

chapters.en: So she conceived and gave birth to a son, and Judah named him Er.
chapters.zh: 她就怀孕生了儿子，犹大给他起名叫珥。

chapters.en: Again she conceived and gave birth to a son, and she named him Onan.
chapters.zh: 她又怀孕生了儿子，母亲给他起名叫俄南。

chapters.en: Then she gave birth to another son and named him Shelah; it was at Chezib that she gave birth to him.
chapters.zh: 她复又生了儿子，给他起名叫示拉。她生示拉的时候，犹大正在基悉。

chapters.en: Now Judah acquired a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
chapters.zh: 犹大为长子珥娶妻，名叫她玛。

chapters.en: But Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; so the LORD put him to death.
chapters.zh: 犹大的长子珥在耶和华眼中看为恶，耶和华就叫他死了。

chapters.en: Then Judah said to Onan, “Sleep with your brother’s wife. Perform your duty as her brother-in-law and raise up offspring for your brother.”
chapters.zh: 犹大对俄南说：「你当与你哥哥的妻子同房，向她尽你为弟的本分，为你哥哥生子立后。」

chapters.en: But Onan knew that the offspring would not belong to him; so whenever he would sleep with his brother’s wife, he would spill his seed on the ground so that he would not produce offspring for his brother.
chapters.zh: 俄南知道生子不归自己，所以同房的时候便遗在地，免得给他哥哥留后。

chapters.en: What he did was wicked in the sight of the LORD, so He put Onan to death as well.
chapters.zh: 俄南所做的在耶和华眼中看为恶，耶和华也就叫他死了。

chapters.en: Then Judah said to his daughter-in-law Tamar, “Live as a widow in your father’s house until my son Shelah grows up.” For he thought, “He may die too, like his brothers.” So Tamar went to live in her father’s house.
chapters.zh: 犹大心里说：「恐怕示拉也死，像他两个哥哥一样」，就对他儿妇她玛说：「你去，在你父亲家里守寡，等我儿子示拉长大。」她玛就回去，住在她父亲家里。

chapters.en: After a long time Judah’s wife, the daughter of Shua, died. When Judah had finished mourning, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite went up to his sheepshearers at Timnah.
chapters.zh: 过了许久，犹大的妻子书亚的女儿死了。犹大得了安慰，就和他朋友亚杜兰人希拉上亭拿去，到他剪羊毛的人那里。

chapters.en: When Tamar was told, “Your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep,”
chapters.zh: 有人告诉她玛说：「你的公公上亭拿剪羊毛去了。」

chapters.en: she removed her widow’s garments, covered her face with a veil to disguise herself, and sat at the entrance to Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah. For she saw that although Shelah had grown up, she had not been given to him as a wife.
chapters.zh: 她玛见示拉已经长大，还没有娶她为妻，就脱了她作寡妇的衣裳，用帕子蒙着脸，又遮住身体，坐在亭拿路上的伊拿印城门口。

chapters.en: When Judah saw her, he thought she was a prostitute because she had covered her face.
chapters.zh: 犹大看见她，以为是妓女，因为她蒙着脸。

chapters.en:
Not realizing that she was his daughter-in-law, he went over to her and said, “Come now, let me sleep with you.”
“What will you give me for sleeping with you?” she inquired.
chapters.zh: 犹大就转到她那里去，说：「来吧！让我与你同寝。」他原不知道是他的儿妇。她玛说：「你要与我同寝，把什么给我呢？」

chapters.en:
“I will send you a young goat from my flock,” Judah answered.
But she replied, “Only if you leave me something as a pledge until you send it.”
chapters.zh: 犹大说：「我从羊群里取一只山羊羔，打发人送来给你。」她玛说：「在未送以先，你愿意给我一个当头吗？」

chapters.en:
“What pledge should I give you?” he asked.
She answered, “Your seal and your cord, and the staff in your hand.” So he gave them to her and slept with her, and she became pregnant by him.
chapters.zh: 他说：「我给你什么当头呢？」她玛说：「你的印、你的带子，和你手里的杖。」犹大就给了她，与她同寝，她就从犹大怀了孕。

chapters.en: Then Tamar got up and departed. And she removed her veil and put on her widow’s garments again.
chapters.zh: 她玛起来走了，除去帕子，仍旧穿上作寡妇的衣裳。

chapters.en: Now when Judah sent his friend Hirah the Adullamite with the young goat to collect the items he had left with the woman, he could not find her.
chapters.zh: 犹大讬他朋友亚杜兰人送一只山羊羔去，要从那女人手里取回当头来，却找不着她，

chapters.en:
He asked the men of that place, “Where is the shrine prostitute who was beside the road at Enaim?”
“No shrine prostitute has been here,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 就问那地方的人说：「伊拿印路旁的妓女在哪里？」他们说：「这里并没有妓女。」

chapters.en: So Hirah returned to Judah and said, “I could not find her, and furthermore, the men of that place said, ‘No shrine prostitute has been here.’”
chapters.zh: 他回去见犹大说：「我没有找着她，并且那地方的人说：『这里没有妓女。』」

chapters.en: “Let her keep the items,” Judah replied. “Otherwise we will become a laughingstock. After all, I did send her this young goat, but you could not find her.”
chapters.zh: 犹大说：「我把这山羊羔送去了，你竟找不着她。任凭她拿去吧，免得我们被羞辱。」

chapters.en:
About three months later, Judah was told, “Your daughter-in-law Tamar has prostituted herself, and now she is pregnant.”
“Bring her out!” Judah replied. “Let her be burned to death!”
chapters.zh: 约过了三个月，有人告诉犹大说：「你的儿妇她玛作了妓女，且因行淫有了身孕。」犹大说：「拉出她来，把她烧了！」

chapters.en: As she was being brought out, Tamar sent a message to her father-in-law: “I am pregnant by the man to whom these items belong.” And she added, “Please examine them. Whose seal and cord and staff are these?”
chapters.zh: 她玛被拉出来的时候便打发人去见她公公，对他说：「这些东西是谁的，我就是从谁怀的孕。请你认一认，这印和带子并杖都是谁的？」

chapters.en: Judah recognized the items and said, “She is more righteous than I, since I did not give her to my son Shelah.” And he did not have relations with her again.
chapters.zh: 犹大承认说：「她比我更有义，因为我没有将她给我的儿子示拉。」从此犹大不再与她同寝了。

chapters.en: When the time came for Tamar to give birth, there were twins in her womb.
chapters.zh: 她玛将要生产，不料她腹里是一对双生。

chapters.en: And as she was giving birth, one of them put out his hand; so the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it around his wrist. “This one came out first,” she announced.
chapters.zh: 到生产的时候，一个孩子伸出一只手来；收生婆拿红线拴在他手上，说：「这是头生的。」

chapters.en: But when he pulled his hand back and his brother came out, she said, “You have broken out first!” So he was named Perez.
chapters.zh: 随后这孩子把手收回去，他哥哥生出来了；收生婆说：「你为什么抢着来呢？」因此给他起名叫法勒斯。

chapters.en: Then his brother came out with the scarlet thread around his wrist, and he was named Zerah.
chapters.zh: 后来，他兄弟那手上有红线的也生出来，就给他起名叫谢拉。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Joseph had been taken down to Egypt, where an Egyptian named Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard, bought him from the Ishmaelites who had taken him there.
chapters.zh: 约瑟被带下埃及去。有一个埃及人，是法老的内臣－护卫长波提乏，从那些带下他来的以实玛利人手下买了他去。

chapters.en: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he became a successful man, serving in the household of his Egyptian master.
chapters.zh: 约瑟住在他主人埃及人的家中，耶和华与他同在，他就百事顺利。

chapters.en: When his master saw that the LORD was with him and made him prosper in all he did,
chapters.zh: 他主人见耶和华与他同在，又见耶和华使他手里所办的尽都顺利，

chapters.en:
Joseph found favor in his sight and became his personal attendant.
Potiphar put him in charge of his household and entrusted him with everything he owned.
chapters.zh: 约瑟就在主人眼前蒙恩，伺候他主人，并且主人派他管理家务，把一切所有的都交在他手里。

chapters.en: From the time that he put Joseph in charge of his household and all he owned, the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s household on account of him. The LORD’s blessing was on everything he owned, both in his house and in his field.
chapters.zh: 自从主人派约瑟管理家务和他一切所有的，耶和华就因约瑟的缘故赐福与那埃及人的家；凡家里和田间一切所有的都蒙耶和华赐福。

chapters.en:
So Potiphar left all that he owned in Joseph’s care; he did not concern himself with anything except the food he ate.
Now Joseph was well-built and handsome,
chapters.zh: 波提乏将一切所有的都交在约瑟的手中，除了自己所吃的饭，别的事一概不知。 约瑟原来秀雅俊美。

chapters.en: and after some time his master’s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph and said, “Sleep with me.”
chapters.zh: 这事以后，约瑟主人的妻以目送情给约瑟，说：「你与我同寝吧！」

chapters.en: But he refused. “Look,” he said to his master’s wife, “with me here, my master does not concern himself with anything in his house, and he has entrusted everything he owns to my care.
chapters.zh: 约瑟不从，对他主人的妻说：「看哪，一切家务，我主人都不知道；他把所有的都交在我手里。

chapters.en: No one in this house is greater than I am. He has withheld nothing from me except you, because you are his wife. So how could I do such a great evil and sin against God?”
chapters.zh: 在这家里没有比我大的；并且他没有留下一样不交给我，只留下了你，因为你是他的妻子。我怎能作这大恶，得罪上帝呢？」

chapters.en: Although Potiphar’s wife spoke to Joseph day after day, he refused to go to bed with her or even be near her.
chapters.zh: 后来她天天和约瑟说，约瑟却不听从她，不与她同寝，也不和她在一处。

chapters.en: One day, however, Joseph went into the house to attend to his work, and not a single household servant was inside.
chapters.zh: 有一天，约瑟进屋里去办事，家中人没有一个在那屋里，

chapters.en: She grabbed Joseph by his cloak and said, “Sleep with me!” But leaving his cloak in her hand, he escaped and ran outside.
chapters.zh: 妇人就拉住他的衣裳，说：「你与我同寝吧！」约瑟把衣裳丢在妇人手里，跑到外边去了。

chapters.en: When she saw that he had left his cloak in her hand and had run out of the house,
chapters.zh: 妇人看见约瑟把衣裳丢在她手里跑出去了，

chapters.en: she called her household servants. “Look,” she said, “this Hebrew has been brought to us to make sport of us. He came to me so he could sleep with me, but I screamed as loud as I could.
chapters.zh: 就叫了家里的人来，对他们说：「你们看！他带了一个希伯来人进入我们家里，要戏弄我们。他到我这里来，要与我同寝，我就大声喊叫。

chapters.en: When he heard me scream for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house.”
chapters.zh: 他听见我放声喊起来，就把衣裳丢在我这里，跑到外边去了。」

chapters.en: So Potiphar’s wife kept Joseph’s cloak beside her until his master came home.
chapters.zh: 妇人把约瑟的衣裳放在自己那里，等着他主人回家，

chapters.en: Then she told him the same story: “The Hebrew slave you brought us came to me to make sport of me,
chapters.zh: 就对他如此如此说：「你所带到我们这里的那希伯来仆人进来要戏弄我，

chapters.en: but when I screamed for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house.”
chapters.zh: 我放声喊起来，他就把衣裳丢在我这里，跑出去了。」

chapters.en: When his master heard the story his wife told him, saying, “This is what your slave did to me,” he burned with anger.
chapters.zh: 约瑟的主人听见他妻子对他所说的话，说「你的仆人如此如此待我」，他就生气，

chapters.en:
So Joseph’s master took him and had him thrown into the prison where the king’s prisoners were confined.
While Joseph was there in the prison,
chapters.zh: 把约瑟下在监里，就是王的囚犯被囚的地方。于是约瑟在那里坐监。

chapters.en: the LORD was with him and extended kindness to him, granting him favor in the eyes of the prison warden.
chapters.zh: 但耶和华与约瑟同在，向他施恩，使他在司狱的眼前蒙恩。

chapters.en: And the warden put all the prisoners under Joseph’s care, so that he was responsible for all that was done in the prison.
chapters.zh: 司狱就把监里所有的囚犯都交在约瑟的手下；他们在那里所办的事都是经他的手。

chapters.en: The warden did not concern himself with anything under Joseph’s care, because the LORD was with Joseph and gave him success in whatever he did.
chapters.zh: 凡在约瑟手下的事，司狱一概不察，因为耶和华与约瑟同在；耶和华使他所做的尽都顺利。

chapters.en: Some time later, the king’s cupbearer and baker offended their master, the king of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，埃及王的酒政和膳长得罪了他们的主－埃及王，

chapters.en: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cupbearer and the chief baker,
chapters.zh: 法老就恼怒酒政和膳长这二臣，

chapters.en: and imprisoned them in the house of the captain of the guard, the same prison where Joseph was confined.
chapters.zh: 把他们下在护卫长府内的监里，就是约瑟被囚的地方。

chapters.en:
The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he became their personal attendant.
After they had been in custody for some time,
chapters.zh: 护卫长把他们交给约瑟，约瑟便伺候他们；他们有些日子在监里。

chapters.en: both of these men—the Egyptian king’s cupbearer and baker, who were being held in the prison—had a dream on the same night, and each dream had its own meaning.
chapters.zh: 被囚在监之埃及王的酒政和膳长二人同夜各做一梦，各梦都有讲解。

chapters.en: When Joseph came to them in the morning, he saw that they were distraught.
chapters.zh: 到了早晨，约瑟进到他们那里，见他们有愁闷的样子。

chapters.en: So he asked the officials of Pharaoh who were in custody with him in his master’s house, “Why are your faces so downcast today?”
chapters.zh: 他便问法老的二臣，就是与他同囚在他主人府里的，说：「你们今日为什么面带愁容呢？」

chapters.en:
“We both had dreams,” they replied, “but there is no one to interpret them.”
Then Joseph said to them, “Don’t interpretations belong to God? Tell me your dreams.”
chapters.zh: 他们对他说：「我们各人做了一梦，没有人能解。」约瑟说：「解梦不是出于上帝吗？请你们将梦告诉我。」

chapters.en: So the chief cupbearer told Joseph his dream: “In my dream there was a vine before me,
chapters.zh: 酒政便将他的梦告诉约瑟说：「我梦见在我面前有一棵葡萄树，

chapters.en: and on the vine were three branches. As it budded, its blossoms opened and its clusters ripened into grapes.
chapters.zh: 树上有三根枝子，好像发了芽，开了花，上头的葡萄都成熟了。

chapters.en: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand, and I took the grapes, squeezed them into his cup, and placed the cup in his hand.”
chapters.zh: 法老的杯在我手中，我就拿葡萄挤在法老的杯里，将杯递在他手中。」

chapters.en: Joseph replied, “This is the interpretation: The three branches are three days.
chapters.zh: 约瑟对他说：「你所做的梦是这样解：三根枝子就是三天；

chapters.en: Within three days Pharaoh will lift up your head and restore your position. You will put Pharaoh’s cup in his hand, just as you did when you were his cupbearer.
chapters.zh: 三天之内，法老必提你出监，叫你官复原职，你仍要递杯在法老的手中，和先前作他的酒政一样。

chapters.en: But when it goes well for you, please remember me and show me kindness by mentioning me to Pharaoh, that he might bring me out of this prison.
chapters.zh: 但你得好处的时候，求你记念我，施恩与我，在法老面前提说我，救我出这监牢。

chapters.en: For I was kidnapped from the land of the Hebrews, and even here I have done nothing for which they should have put me in this dungeon.”
chapters.zh: 我实在是从希伯来人之地被拐来的；我在这里也没有做过什么，叫他们把我下在监里。」

chapters.en: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was favorable, he said to Joseph, “I too had a dream: There were three baskets of white bread on my head.
chapters.zh: 膳长见梦解得好，就对约瑟说：「我在梦中见我头上顶着三筐白饼；

chapters.en: In the top basket were all sorts of baked goods for Pharaoh, but the birds were eating them out of the basket on my head.”
chapters.zh: 极上的筐子里有为法老烤的各样食物，有飞鸟来吃我头上筐子里的食物。」

chapters.en: Joseph replied, “This is the interpretation: The three baskets are three days.
chapters.zh: 约瑟说：「你的梦是这样解：三个筐子就是三天；

chapters.en: Within three days Pharaoh will lift off your head and hang you on a tree. Then the birds will eat the flesh of your body.”
chapters.zh: 三天之内，法老必斩断你的头，把你挂在木头上，必有飞鸟来吃你身上的肉。」

chapters.en: On the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, he held a feast for all his officials, and in their presence he lifted up the heads of the chief cupbearer and the chief baker.
chapters.zh: 到了第三天，是法老的生日，他为众臣仆设摆筵席，把酒政和膳长提出监来，

chapters.en: Pharaoh restored the chief cupbearer to his position, so that he once again placed the cup in Pharaoh’s hand.
chapters.zh: 使酒政官复原职，他仍旧递杯在法老手中；

chapters.en: But Pharaoh hanged the chief baker, just as Joseph had described to them in his interpretation.
chapters.zh: 但把膳长挂起来，正如约瑟向他们所解的话。

chapters.en: The chief cupbearer, however, did not remember Joseph; he forgot all about him.
chapters.zh: 酒政却不记念约瑟，竟忘了他。

chapters.en: After two full years had passed, Pharaoh had a dream: He was standing beside the Nile,
chapters.zh: 过了两年，法老做梦，梦见自己站在河边，

chapters.en: when seven cows, sleek and well-fed, came up from the river and began to graze among the reeds.
chapters.zh: 有七只母牛从河里上来，又美好又肥壮，在芦荻中吃〔草〕。

chapters.en: After them, seven other cows, sickly and thin, came up from the Nile and stood beside the well-fed cows on the bank of the river.
chapters.zh: 随后又有七只母牛从河里上来，又丑陋又干瘦，与那七只母牛一同站在河边。

chapters.en:
And the cows that were sickly and thin devoured the seven sleek, well-fed cows.
Then Pharaoh woke up,
chapters.zh: 这又丑陋又干瘦的七只母牛吃尽了那又美好又肥壮的七只母牛。法老就醒了。

chapters.en: but he fell back asleep and dreamed a second time: Seven heads of grain, plump and ripe, came up on one stalk.
chapters.zh: 他又睡着，第二回做梦，梦见一棵麦子长了七个穗子，又肥大又佳美，

chapters.en: After them, seven other heads of grain sprouted, thin and scorched by the east wind.
chapters.zh: 随后又长了七个穗子，又细弱又被东风吹焦了。

chapters.en: And the thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven plump, ripe ones. Then Pharaoh awoke and realized it was a dream.
chapters.zh: 这细弱的穗子吞了那七个又肥大又饱满的穗子。法老醒了，不料是个梦。

chapters.en: In the morning his spirit was troubled, so he summoned all the magicians and wise men of Egypt. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but no one could interpret them for him.
chapters.zh: 到了早晨，法老心里不安，就差人召了埃及所有的术士和博士来；法老就把所做的梦告诉他们，却没有人能给法老圆解。

chapters.en: Then the chief cupbearer said to Pharaoh, “Today I recall my failures.
chapters.zh: 那时酒政对法老说：「我今日想起我的罪来。

chapters.en: Pharaoh was once angry with his servants, and he put me and the chief baker in the custody of the captain of the guard.
chapters.zh: 从前法老恼怒臣仆，把我和膳长下在护卫长府内的监里。

chapters.en: One night both the chief baker and I had dreams, and each dream had its own meaning.
chapters.zh: 我们二人同夜各做一梦，各梦都有讲解。

chapters.en: Now a young Hebrew was there with us, a servant of the captain of the guard. We told him our dreams and he interpreted them for us individually.
chapters.zh: 在那里同着我们有一个希伯来的少年人，是护卫长的仆人，我们告诉他，他就把我们的梦圆解，是按着各人的梦圆解的。

chapters.en: And it happened to us just as he had interpreted: I was restored to my position, and the other man was hanged.”
chapters.zh: 后来正如他给我们圆解的成就了：我官复原职，膳长被挂起来了。」

chapters.en: So Pharaoh sent for Joseph, who was quickly brought out of the dungeon. After he had shaved and changed his clothes, he went in before Pharaoh.
chapters.zh: 法老遂即差人去召约瑟，他们便急忙带他出监，他就剃头，刮脸，换衣裳，进到法老面前。

chapters.en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I had a dream, and no one can interpret it. But I have heard it said of you that when you hear a dream you can interpret it.”
chapters.zh: 法老对约瑟说：「我做了一梦，没有人能解；我听见人说，你听了梦就能解。」

chapters.en: “I myself cannot do it,” Joseph replied, “but God will give Pharaoh a sound answer.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟回答法老说：「这不在乎我，上帝必将平安的话回答法老。」

chapters.en: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph: “In my dream I was standing on the bank of the Nile,
chapters.zh: 法老对约瑟说：「我梦见我站在河边，

chapters.en: when seven cows, well-fed and sleek, came up from the river and began to graze among the reeds.
chapters.zh: 有七只母牛从河里上来，又肥壮又美好，在芦荻中吃草。

chapters.en: After them, seven other cows—sickly, ugly, and thin—came up. I have never seen such ugly cows in all the land of Egypt!
chapters.zh: 随后又有七只母牛上来，又软弱又丑陋又干瘦，在埃及遍地，我没有见过这样不好的。

chapters.en: Then the thin, ugly cows devoured the seven well-fed cows that were there first.
chapters.zh: 这又干瘦又丑陋的母牛吃尽了那以先的七只肥母牛，

chapters.en: When they had devoured them, however, no one could tell that they had done so; their appearance was as ugly as it had been before. Then I awoke.
chapters.zh: 吃了以后却看不出是吃了，那丑陋的样子仍旧和先前一样。我就醒了。

chapters.en: In my dream I also saw seven heads of grain, plump and ripe, growing on a single stalk.
chapters.zh: 我又梦见一棵麦子，长了七个穗子，又饱满又佳美，

chapters.en: After them, seven other heads of grain sprouted—withered, thin, and scorched by the east wind.
chapters.zh: 随后又长了七个穗子，枯槁细弱，被东风吹焦了。

chapters.en:
And the thin heads of grain swallowed the seven plump ones.
I told this dream to the magicians, but no one could explain it to me.”
chapters.zh: 这些细弱的穗子吞了那七个佳美的穗子。我将这梦告诉了术士，却没有人能给我解说。」

chapters.en: At this, Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dreams of Pharaoh are one and the same. God has revealed to Pharaoh what He is about to do.
chapters.zh: 约瑟对法老说：「法老的梦乃是一个。上帝已将所要做的事指示法老了。

chapters.en: The seven good cows are seven years, and the seven ripe heads of grain are seven years. The dreams have the same meaning.
chapters.zh: 七只好母牛是七年，七个好穗子也是七年；这梦乃是一个。

chapters.en: Moreover, the seven thin, ugly cows that came up after them are seven years, and so are the seven worthless heads of grain scorched by the east wind—they are seven years of famine.
chapters.zh: 那随后上来的七只又干瘦又丑陋的母牛是七年，那七个虚空、被东风吹焦的穗子也是七年，都是七个荒年。

chapters.en: It is just as I said to Pharaoh: God has shown Pharaoh what He is about to do.
chapters.zh: 这就是我对法老所说，上帝已将所要做的事显明给法老了。

chapters.en: Behold, seven years of great abundance are coming throughout the land of Egypt,
chapters.zh: 埃及遍地必来七个大丰年，

chapters.en: but seven years of famine will follow them. Then all the abundance in the land of Egypt will be forgotten, and the famine will devastate the land.
chapters.zh: 随后又要来七个荒年，甚至在埃及地都忘了先前的丰收，全地必被饥荒所灭。

chapters.en: The abundance in the land will not be remembered, since the famine that follows it will be so severe.
chapters.zh: 因那以后的饥荒甚大，便不觉得先前的丰收了。

chapters.en: Moreover, because the dream was given to Pharaoh in two versions, the matter has been decreed by God, and He will carry it out shortly.
chapters.zh: 至于法老两回做梦，是因上帝命定这事，而且必速速成就。

chapters.en: Now, therefore, Pharaoh should look for a discerning and wise man and set him over the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 所以，法老当拣选一个有聪明有智慧的人，派他治理埃及地。

chapters.en: Let Pharaoh take action and appoint commissioners over the land to take a fifth of the harvest of Egypt during the seven years of abundance.
chapters.zh: 法老当这样行，又派官员管理这地。当七个丰年的时候，征收埃及地的五分之一，

chapters.en: Under the authority of Pharaoh, let them collect all the excess food from these good years, that they may come and lay up the grain to be preserved as food in the cities.
chapters.zh: 叫他们把将来丰年一切的粮食聚敛起来，积蓄五谷，收存在各城里做食物，归于法老的手下。

chapters.en: This food will be a reserve for the land during the seven years of famine to come upon the land of Egypt. Then the country will not perish in the famine.”
chapters.zh: 所积蓄的粮食可以防备埃及地将来的七个荒年，免得这地被饥荒所灭。」

chapters.en: This proposal pleased Pharaoh and all his officials.
chapters.zh: 法老和他一切臣仆都以这事为妙。

chapters.en: So Pharaoh asked them, “Can we find anyone like this man, in whom the Spirit of God abides?”
chapters.zh: 法老对臣仆说：「像这样的人，有上帝的灵在他里头，我们岂能找得着呢？」

chapters.en: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Since God has made all this known to you, there is no one as discerning and wise as you.
chapters.zh: 法老对约瑟说：「上帝既将这事都指示你，可见没有人像你这样有聪明有智慧。

chapters.en: You shall be in charge of my house, and all my people are to obey your commands. Only with regard to the throne will I be greater than you.”
chapters.zh: 你可以掌管我的家；我的民都必听从你的话。惟独在宝座上我比你大。」

chapters.en: Pharaoh also told Joseph, “I hereby place you over all the land of Egypt.”
chapters.zh: 法老又对约瑟说：「我派你治理埃及全地。」

chapters.en: Then Pharaoh removed the signet ring from his finger, put it on Joseph’s finger, clothed him in garments of fine linen, and placed a gold chain around his neck.
chapters.zh: 法老就摘下手上打印的戒指，戴在约瑟的手上，给他穿上细麻衣，把金鍊戴在他的颈项上，

chapters.en: He had Joseph ride in his second chariot, with men calling out before him, “Bow the knee!” So he placed him over all the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 又叫约瑟坐他的副车，喝道的在前呼叫说：「跪下。」这样，法老派他治理埃及全地。

chapters.en: And Pharaoh declared to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh, but without your permission, no one in all the land of Egypt shall lift his hand or foot.”
chapters.zh: 法老对约瑟说：「我是法老，在埃及全地，若没有你的命令，不许人擅自办事〔注：原文是动手动脚〕。」

chapters.en: Pharaoh gave Joseph the name Zaphenath-paneah, and he gave him Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, to be his wife. And Joseph took charge of all the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 法老赐名给约瑟，叫撒发那忒‧巴内亚，又将安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳给他为妻。约瑟就出去巡行埃及地。

chapters.en: Now Joseph was thirty years old when he entered the service of Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph left Pharaoh’s presence and traveled throughout the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 约瑟见埃及王法老的时候年三十岁。他从法老面前出去，遍行埃及全地。

chapters.en: During the seven years of abundance, the land brought forth bountifully.
chapters.zh: 七个丰年之内，地的出产极丰极盛〔注：原文是一把一把的〕，

chapters.en: During those seven years, Joseph collected all the excess food in the land of Egypt and stored it in the cities. In every city he laid up the food from the fields around it.
chapters.zh: 约瑟聚敛埃及地七个丰年一切的粮食，把粮食积存在各城里；各城周围田地的粮食都积存在本城里。

chapters.en: So Joseph stored up grain in such abundance, like the sand of the sea, that he stopped keeping track of it; for it was beyond measure.
chapters.zh: 约瑟积蓄五谷甚多，如同海边的沙，无法计算，因为谷不可胜数。

chapters.en: Before the years of famine arrived, two sons were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.
chapters.zh: 荒年未到以前，安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳给约瑟生了两个儿子。

chapters.en: Joseph named the firstborn Manasseh, saying, “God has made me forget all my hardship and all my father’s household.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟给长子起名叫玛拿西〔注：就是使之忘了的意思〕，因为〔他说〕：「上帝使我忘了一切的困苦和我父的全家。」

chapters.en: And the second son he named Ephraim, saying, “God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”
chapters.zh: 他给次子起名叫以法莲〔注：就是使之昌盛的意思〕，因为〔他说〕：「上帝使我在受苦的地方昌盛。」

chapters.en: When the seven years of abundance in the land of Egypt came to an end,
chapters.zh: 埃及地的七个丰年一完，

chapters.en: the seven years of famine began, just as Joseph had said. And although there was famine in every country, there was food throughout the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 七个荒年就来了。正如约瑟所说的，各地都有饥荒；惟独埃及全地有粮食。

chapters.en: When extreme hunger came to all the land of Egypt and the people cried out to Pharaoh for food, he told all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph and do whatever he tells you.”
chapters.zh: 及至埃及全地有了饥荒，众民向法老哀求粮食，法老对他们说：「你们往约瑟那里去，凡他所说的，你们都要做。」

chapters.en: When the famine had spread over all the land, Joseph opened up all the storehouses and sold grain to the Egyptians; for the famine was severe in the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 当时饥荒遍满天下，约瑟开了各处的仓，粜粮给埃及人；在埃及地饥荒甚大。

chapters.en: And every nation came to Joseph in Egypt to buy grain, because the famine was severe over all the earth.
chapters.zh: 各地的人都往埃及去，到约瑟那里籴粮，因为天下的饥荒甚大。

chapters.en: When Jacob learned that there was grain in Egypt, he said to his sons, “Why are you staring at one another?”
chapters.zh: 雅各见埃及有粮，就对儿子们说：「你们为什么彼此观望呢？

chapters.en: “Look,” he added, “I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there and buy some for us, so that we may live and not die.”
chapters.zh: 我听见埃及有粮，你们可以下去，从那里为我们籴些来，使我们可以存活，不至于死。」

chapters.en: So ten of Joseph’s brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.
chapters.zh: 于是，约瑟的十个哥哥都下埃及籴粮去了。

chapters.en: But Jacob did not send Joseph’s brother Benjamin with his brothers, for he said, “I am afraid that harm might befall him.”
chapters.zh: 但约瑟的兄弟便雅悯，雅各没有打发他和哥哥们同去，因为雅各说：「恐怕他遭害。」

chapters.en: So the sons of Israel were among those who came to buy grain, since the famine had also spread to the land of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 来籴粮的人中有以色列的儿子们，因为迦南地也有饥荒。

chapters.en: Now Joseph was the ruler of the land; he was the one who sold grain to all its people. So when his brothers arrived, they bowed down before him with their faces to the ground.
chapters.zh: 当时治理埃及地的是约瑟；粜粮给那地众民的就是他。约瑟的哥哥们来了，脸伏于地，向他下拜。

chapters.en:
And when Joseph saw his brothers, he recognized them, but he treated them as strangers and spoke harshly to them. “Where have you come from?” he asked.
“From the land of Canaan,” they replied. “We are here to buy food.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟看见他哥哥们，就认得他们，却装作生人，向他们说些严厉话，问他们说：「你们从哪里来？」他们说：「我们从迦南地来籴粮。」

chapters.en: Although Joseph recognized his brothers, they did not recognize him.
chapters.zh: 约瑟认得他哥哥们，他们却不认得他。

chapters.en: Joseph remembered his dreams about them and said, “You are spies! You have come to see if our land is vulnerable.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟想起从前所做的那两个梦，就对他们说：「你们是奸细，来窥探这地的虚实。」

chapters.en: “Not so, my lord,” they replied. “Your servants have come to buy food.
chapters.zh: 他们对他说：「我主啊，不是的。仆人们是籴粮来的。

chapters.en: We are all sons of one man. Your servants are honest men, not spies.”
chapters.zh: 我们都是一个人的儿子，是诚实人；仆人们并不是奸细。」

chapters.en: “No,” he told them. “You have come to see if our land is vulnerable.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟说：「不然，你们必是窥探这地的虚实来的。」

chapters.en: But they answered, “Your servants are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan. The youngest is now with our father, and one is no more.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「仆人们本是弟兄十二人，是迦南地一个人的儿子，顶小的现今在我们的父亲那里，有一个没有了。」

chapters.en: Then Joseph declared, “Just as I said, you are spies!
chapters.zh: 约瑟说：「我才说你们是奸细，这话实在不错。

chapters.en: And this is how you will be tested: As surely as Pharaoh lives, you shall not leave this place unless your youngest brother comes here.
chapters.zh: 我指着法老的性命起誓，若是你们的小兄弟不到这里来，你们就不得出这地方，从此就可以把你们证验出来了。

chapters.en: Send one of your number to get your brother; the rest of you will be confined so that the truth of your words may be tested. If they are untrue, then as surely as Pharaoh lives, you are spies!”
chapters.zh: 须要打发你们中间一个人去，把你们的兄弟带来。至于你们，都要囚在这里，好证验你们的话真不真，若不真，我指着法老的性命起誓，你们一定是奸细。」

chapters.en: So Joseph imprisoned them for three days,
chapters.zh: 于是约瑟把他们都下在监里三天。

chapters.en: and on the third day he said to them, “I fear God. So do this and you will live:
chapters.zh: 到第三天，约瑟对他们说：「我是敬畏上帝的；你们照我的话行就可以存活。

chapters.en: If you are honest, leave one of your brothers in custody while the rest of you go and take back grain to relieve the hunger of your households.
chapters.zh: 你们如果是诚实人，可以留你们中间的一个人囚在监里，但你们可以带着粮食回去，救你们家里的饥荒。

chapters.en:
Then bring your youngest brother to me so that your words can be verified, that you may not die.”
And to this they consented.
chapters.zh: 把你们的小兄弟带到我这里来，如此，你们的话便有证据，你们也不至于死。」他们就照样而行。

chapters.en: Then they said to one another, “Surely we are being punished because of our brother. We saw his anguish when he pleaded with us, but we would not listen. That is why this distress has come upon us.”
chapters.zh: 他们彼此说：「我们在兄弟身上实在有罪。他哀求我们的时候，我们见他心里的愁苦，却不肯听，所以这场苦难临到我们身上。」

chapters.en: And Reuben responded, “Didn’t I tell you not to sin against the boy? But you would not listen. Now we must account for his blood!”
chapters.zh: 吕便说：「我岂不是对你们说过，不可伤害那孩子吗？只是你们不肯听，所以流他血的罪向我们追讨。」

chapters.en: They did not realize that Joseph understood them, since there was an interpreter between them.
chapters.zh: 他们不知道约瑟听得出来，因为在他们中间用通事传话。

chapters.en: And he turned away from them and wept. When he turned back and spoke to them, he took Simeon from them and had him bound before their eyes.
chapters.zh: 约瑟转身退去，哭了一场，又回来对他们说话，就从他们中间挑出西缅来，在他们眼前把他捆绑。

chapters.en: Then Joseph gave orders to fill their bags with grain, to return each man’s silver to his sack, and to give them provisions for their journey. This order was carried out,
chapters.zh: 约瑟吩咐人把粮食装满他们的器具，把各人的银子归还在各人的口袋里，又给他们路上用的食物，人就照他的话办了。

chapters.en: and they loaded the grain on their donkeys and departed.
chapters.zh: 他们就把粮食驮在驴上，离开那里去了。

chapters.en: At the place where they lodged for the night, one of them opened his sack to get feed for his donkey, and he saw his silver in the mouth of the sack.
chapters.zh: 到了住宿的地方，他们中间有一个人打开口袋，要拿料餵驴，才看见自己的银子仍在口袋里，

chapters.en:
“My silver has been returned!” he said to his brothers. “It is here in my sack.”
Their hearts sank, and trembling, they turned to one another and said, “What is this that God has done to us?”
chapters.zh: 就对弟兄们说：「我的银子归还了，看哪，仍在我口袋里！」他们就提心吊胆，战战兢兢地彼此说：「这是上帝向我们做什么呢？」

chapters.en: When they reached their father Jacob in the land of Canaan, they described to him all that had happened to them:
chapters.zh: 他们来到迦南地、他们的父亲雅各那里，将所遭遇的事都告诉他，说：

chapters.en: “The man who is lord of the land spoke harshly to us and accused us of spying on the country.
chapters.zh: 「那地的主对我们说严厉的话，把我们当作窥探那地的奸细。

chapters.en: But we told him, ‘We are honest men, not spies.
chapters.zh: 我们对他说：『我们是诚实人，并不是奸细。

chapters.en: We are twelve brothers, sons of one father. One is no more, and the youngest is now with our father in the land of Canaan.’
chapters.zh: 我们本是弟兄十二人，都是一个父亲的儿子，有一个没有了，顶小的如今同我们的父亲在迦南地。』

chapters.en: Then the man who is lord of the land said to us, ‘This is how I will know whether you are honest: Leave one brother with me, take food to relieve the hunger of your households, and go.
chapters.zh: 那地的主对我们说：『若要我知道你们是诚实人，可以留下你们中间的一个人在我这里，你们可以带着〔粮食〕回去，救你们家里的饥荒。

chapters.en: But bring your youngest brother back to me so I will know that you are not spies but honest men. Then I will give your brother back to you, and you can trade in the land.’”
chapters.zh: 把你们的小兄弟带到我这里来，我便知道你们不是奸细，乃是诚实人。这样，我就把你们的弟兄交给你们，你们也可以在这地做买卖。』」

chapters.en: As they began emptying their sacks, there in each man’s sack was his bag of silver! And when they and their father saw the bags of silver, they were dismayed.
chapters.zh: 后来他们倒口袋，不料，各人的银包都在口袋里；他们和父亲看见银包就都害怕。

chapters.en: Their father Jacob said to them, “You have deprived me of my sons. Joseph is gone and Simeon is no more. Now you want to take Benjamin. Everything is going against me!”
chapters.zh: 他们的父亲雅各对他们说：「你们使我丧失我的儿子：约瑟没有了，西缅也没有了，你们又要将便雅悯带去；这些事都归到我身上了。」

chapters.en: Then Reuben said to his father, “You may kill my two sons if I fail to bring him back to you. Put him in my care, and I will return him.”
chapters.zh: 吕便对他父亲说：「我若不带他回来交给你，你可以杀我的两个儿子。只管把他交在我手里，我必带他回来交给你。」

chapters.en: But Jacob replied, “My son will not go down there with you, for his brother is dead, and he alone is left. If any harm comes to him on your journey, you will bring my gray hair down to Sheol in sorrow.”
chapters.zh: 雅各说：「我的儿子不可与你们一同下去；他哥哥死了，只剩下他，他若在你们所行的路上遭害，那便是你们使我白发苍苍、悲悲惨惨地下阴间去了。」

chapters.en: Now the famine was still severe in the land.
chapters.zh: 那地的饥荒甚大。

chapters.en: So when Jacob’s sons had eaten all the grain they had brought from Egypt, their father said to them, “Go back and buy us a little more food.”
chapters.zh: 他们从埃及带来的粮食吃尽了，他们的父亲就对他们说：「你们再去给我籴些粮来。」

chapters.en: But Judah replied, “The man solemnly warned us, ‘You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.’
chapters.zh: 犹大对他说：「那人谆谆地告诫我们说：『你们的兄弟若不与你们同来，你们就不得见我的面。』

chapters.en: If you will send our brother with us, we will go down and buy food for you.
chapters.zh: 你若打发我们的兄弟与我们同去，我们就下去给你籴粮；

chapters.en: But if you will not send him, we will not go; for the man told us, ‘You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.’”
chapters.zh: 你若不打发他去，我们就不下去，因为那人对我们说：『你们的兄弟若不与你们同来，你们就不得见我的面。』」

chapters.en: “Why did you bring this trouble upon me?” Israel asked. “Why did you tell the man you had another brother?”
chapters.zh: 以色列说：「你们为什么这样害我，告诉那人你们还有兄弟呢？」

chapters.en: They replied, “The man questioned us in detail about ourselves and our family: ‘Is your father still alive? Do you have another brother?’ And we answered him accordingly. How could we possibly know that he would say, ‘Bring your brother here’?”
chapters.zh: 他们回答说：「那人详细问到我们和我们的亲属，说：『你们的父亲还在吗？你们还有兄弟吗？』我们就按着他所问的告诉他，焉能知道他要说『必须把你们的兄弟带下来』呢？」

chapters.en: And Judah said to his father Israel, “Send the boy with me, and we will go at once, so that we may live and not die—neither we, nor you, nor our children.
chapters.zh: 犹大又对他父亲以色列说：「你打发童子与我同去，我们就起身下去，好叫我们和你，并我们的〔妇人〕孩子，都得存活，不至于死。

chapters.en: I will guarantee his safety. You may hold me personally responsible. If I do not bring him back and set him before you, then may I bear the guilt before you all my life.
chapters.zh: 我为他作保；你可以从我手中追讨，我若不带他回来交在你面前，我情愿永远担罪。

chapters.en: If we had not delayed, we could have come and gone twice by now.”
chapters.zh: 我们若没有耽搁，如今第二次都回来了。」

chapters.en: Then their father Israel said to them, “If it must be so, then do this: Put some of the best products of the land in your packs and carry them down as a gift for the man—a little balm and a little honey, spices and myrrh, pistachios and almonds.
chapters.zh: 他们的父亲以色列说：「若必须如此，你们就当这样行：可以将这地土产中最好的乳香、蜂蜜、香料、没药、榧子、杏仁都取一点，收在器具里，带下去送给那人作礼物，

chapters.en: Take double the silver with you so that you may return the silver that was put back into the mouths of your sacks. Perhaps it was a mistake.
chapters.zh: 又要手里加倍地带银子，并将归还在你们口袋内的银子仍带在手里；那或者是错了。

chapters.en: Take your brother as well, and return to the man at once.
chapters.zh: 也带着你们的兄弟，起身去见那人。

chapters.en: May God Almighty grant you mercy before the man, that he may release your other brother along with Benjamin. As for me, if I am bereaved, I am bereaved.”
chapters.zh: 但愿全能的上帝使你们在那人面前蒙怜悯，释放你们的那弟兄和便雅悯回来。我若丧了儿子，就丧了吧！」

chapters.en: So the men took these gifts, along with double the amount of silver, and Benjamin as well. Then they hurried down to Egypt and stood before Joseph.
chapters.zh: 于是，他们拿着那礼物，又手里加倍地带银子，并且带着便雅悯，起身下到埃及，站在约瑟面前。

chapters.en: When Joseph saw Benjamin with his brothers, he said to the steward of his house, “Take these men to my house. Slaughter an animal and prepare it, for they shall dine with me at noon.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟见便雅悯和他们同来，就对家宰说：「将这些人领到屋里。要宰杀牲畜，预备〔筵席〕，因为晌午这些人同我吃饭。」

chapters.en: The man did as Joseph had commanded and took the brothers to Joseph’s house.
chapters.zh: 家宰就遵着约瑟的命去行，领他们进约瑟的屋里。

chapters.en: But the brothers were frightened that they had been taken to Joseph’s house. “We have been brought here because of the silver that was returned in our bags the first time,” they said. “They intend to overpower us and take us as slaves, along with our donkeys.”
chapters.zh: 他们因为被领到约瑟的屋里，就害怕，说：「领我们到这里来，必是因为头次归还在我们口袋里的银子，找我们的错缝，下手害我们，强取我们为奴仆，抢夺我们的驴。」

chapters.en: So they approached Joseph’s steward and spoke to him at the entrance to the house.
chapters.zh: 他们就挨近约瑟的家宰，在屋门口和他说话，

chapters.en: “Please, sir,” they said, “we really did come down here the first time to buy food.
chapters.zh: 说：「我主啊，我们头次下来实在是要籴粮。

chapters.en: But when we came to the place we lodged for the night, we opened our sacks and, behold, each of us found his silver in the mouth of his sack! It was the full amount of our silver, and we have brought it back with us.
chapters.zh: 后来到了住宿的地方，我们打开口袋，不料，各人的银子，分量足数，仍在各人的口袋内，现在我们手里又带回来了。

chapters.en: We have brought additional silver with us to buy food. We do not know who put our silver in our sacks.”
chapters.zh: 另外又带下银子来籴粮。不知道先前谁把银子放在我们的口袋里。」

chapters.en: “It is fine,” said the steward. “Do not be afraid. Your God, the God of your father, gave you the treasure that was in your sacks. I received your silver.” Then he brought Simeon out to them.
chapters.zh: 家宰说：「你们可以放心，不要害怕，是你们的上帝和你们父亲的上帝赐给你们财宝在你们的口袋里；你们的银子，我早已收了。」他就把西缅带出来，交给他们。

chapters.en: And the steward took the men into Joseph’s house, gave them water to wash their feet, and provided food for their donkeys.
chapters.zh: 家宰就领他们进约瑟的屋里，给他们水洗脚，又给他们草料餵驴。

chapters.en: Since the brothers had been told that they were going to eat a meal there, they prepared their gift for Joseph’s arrival at noon.
chapters.zh: 他们就预备那礼物，等候约瑟晌午来，因为他们听见要在那里吃饭。

chapters.en: When Joseph came home, they presented him with the gifts they had brought, and they bowed to the ground before him.
chapters.zh: 约瑟来到家里，他们就把手中的礼物拿进屋去给他，又俯伏在地，向他下拜。

chapters.en: He asked if they were well, and then he asked, “How is your elderly father you told me about? Is he still alive?”
chapters.zh: 约瑟问他们好，又问：「你们的父亲－就是你们所说的那老人家平安吗？他还在吗？」

chapters.en: “Your servant our father is well,” they answered. “He is still alive.” And they bowed down to honor him.
chapters.zh: 他们回答说：「你仆人－我们的父亲平安；他还在。」于是他们低头下拜。

chapters.en: When Joseph looked up and saw his brother Benjamin, his own mother’s son, he asked, “Is this your youngest brother, the one you told me about?” Then he declared, “May God be gracious to you, my son.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟举目看见他同母的兄弟便雅悯，就说：「你们向我所说那顶小的兄弟就是这位吗？」又说：「小儿啊，愿上帝赐恩给你！」

chapters.en: Joseph hurried out because he was moved to tears for his brother, and he went to a private room to weep.
chapters.zh: 约瑟爱弟之情发动，就急忙寻找可哭之地，进入自己的屋里，哭了一场。

chapters.en: Then he washed his face and came back out. Regaining his composure, he said, “Serve the meal.”
chapters.zh: 他洗了脸出来，勉强隐忍，吩咐人摆饭。

chapters.en: They separately served Joseph, his brothers, and the Egyptians. They ate separately because the Egyptians would not eat with the Hebrews, since that was detestable to them.
chapters.zh: 他们就为约瑟单摆了一席，为那些人又摆了一席，也为和约瑟同吃饭的埃及人另摆了一席，因为埃及人不可和希伯来人一同吃饭；那原是埃及人所厌恶的。

chapters.en: They were seated before Joseph in order by age, from the firstborn to the youngest, and the men looked at one another in astonishment.
chapters.zh: 约瑟使众弟兄在他面前排列坐席，都按着长幼的次序，众弟兄就彼此诧异。

chapters.en: When the portions were served to them from Joseph’s table, Benjamin’s portion was five times larger than any of the others. So they feasted and drank freely with Joseph.
chapters.zh: 约瑟把他面前的食物分出来，送给他们；但便雅悯所得的比别人多五倍。他们就饮酒，和约瑟一同宴乐。

chapters.en: Then Joseph instructed his steward: “Fill the men’s sacks with as much food as they can carry, and put each one’s silver in the mouth of his sack.
chapters.zh: 约瑟吩咐家宰说：「把粮食装满这些人的口袋，尽着他们的驴所能驮的，又把各人的银子放在各人的口袋里，

chapters.en:
Put my cup, the silver one, in the mouth of the youngest one’s sack, along with the silver for his grain.”
So the steward did as Joseph had instructed.
chapters.zh: 并将我的银杯和那少年人籴粮的银子一同装在他的口袋里。」家宰就照约瑟所说的话行了；
