chapters.en: At daybreak, the men were sent on their way with their donkeys.
chapters.zh: 天一亮就打发那些人带着驴走了。

chapters.en: They had not gone far from the city when Joseph told his steward, “Pursue the men at once, and when you overtake them, ask, ‘Why have you repaid good with evil?
chapters.zh: 他们出城走了不远，约瑟对家宰说：「起来，追那些人去，追上了就对他们说：『你们为什么以恶报善呢？

chapters.en: Is this not the cup my master drinks from and uses for divination? What you have done is wicked!’”
chapters.zh: 这不是我主人饮酒的杯吗？岂不是他占卜用的吗？你们这样行是作恶了。』」

chapters.en: When the steward overtook them, he relayed these words to them.
chapters.zh: 家宰追上他们，将这些话对他们说了。

chapters.en: “Why does my lord say these things?” they asked. “Your servants could not possibly do such a thing.
chapters.zh: 他们回答说：「我主为什么说这样的话呢？你仆人断不能做这样的事。

chapters.en: We even brought back to you from the land of Canaan the silver we found in the mouths of our sacks. Why would we steal silver or gold from your master’s house?
chapters.zh: 你看，我们从前在口袋里所见的银子，尚且从迦南地带来还你，我们怎能从你主人家里偷窃金银呢？

chapters.en: If any of your servants is found to have it, he must die, and the rest will become slaves of my lord.”
chapters.zh: 你仆人中无论在谁那里搜出来，就叫他死，我们也作我主的奴仆。」

chapters.en: “As you say,” replied the steward. “But only the one who is found with the cup will be my slave, and the rest of you shall be free of blame.”
chapters.zh: 家宰说：「现在就照你们的话行吧！在谁那里搜出来，谁就作我的奴仆；其余的都没有罪。」

chapters.en: So each one quickly lowered his sack to the ground and opened it.
chapters.zh: 于是他们各人急忙把口袋卸在地下，各人打开口袋。

chapters.en: The steward searched, beginning with the oldest and ending with the youngest—and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.
chapters.zh: 家宰就搜查，从年长的起到年幼的为止，那杯竟在便雅悯的口袋里搜出来。

chapters.en: Then they all tore their clothes, loaded their donkeys, and returned to the city.
chapters.zh: 他们就撕裂衣服，各人把驮子抬在驴上，回城去了。

chapters.en: When Judah and his brothers arrived at Joseph’s house, he was still there, and they fell to the ground before him.
chapters.zh: 犹大和他弟兄们来到约瑟的屋中，约瑟还在那里，他们就在他面前俯伏于地。

chapters.en: “What is this deed you have done?” Joseph declared. “Do you not know that a man like me can surely divine the truth?”
chapters.zh: 约瑟对他们说：「你们做的是什么事呢？你们岂不知像我这样的人必能占卜吗？」

chapters.en: “What can we say to my lord?” Judah replied. “How can we plead? How can we justify ourselves? God has exposed the iniquity of your servants. We are now my lord’s slaves—both we and the one who was found with the cup.”
chapters.zh: 犹大说：「我们对我主说什么呢？还有什么话可说呢？我们怎能自己表白出来呢？上帝已经查出仆人的罪孽了。我们与那在他手中搜出杯来的都是我主的奴仆。」

chapters.en: But Joseph replied, “Far be it from me to do this. The man who was found with the cup will be my slave. The rest of you may return to your father in peace.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟说：「我断不能这样行！在谁的手中搜出杯来，谁就作我的奴仆；至于你们，可以平平安安地上你们父亲那里去。」

chapters.en: Then Judah approached Joseph and said, “Sir, please let your servant speak personally to my lord. Do not be angry with your servant, for you are equal to Pharaoh himself.
chapters.zh: 犹大挨近他，说：「我主啊，求你容仆人说一句话给我主听，不要向仆人发烈怒，因为你如同法老一样。

chapters.en: My lord asked his servants, ‘Do you have a father or a brother?’
chapters.zh: 我主曾问仆人们说：『你们有父亲有兄弟没有？』

chapters.en: And we answered, ‘We have an elderly father and a younger brother, the child of his old age. The boy’s brother is dead. He is the only one of his mother’s sons left, and his father loves him.’
chapters.zh: 我们对我主说：『我们有父亲，已经年老，还有他老年所生的一个小孩子。他哥哥死了，他母亲只撇下他一人，他父亲疼爱他。』

chapters.en: Then you told your servants, ‘Bring him down to me so that I can see him for myself.’
chapters.zh: 你对仆人说：『把他带到我这里来，叫我亲眼看看他。』

chapters.en: So we said to my lord, ‘The boy cannot leave his father. If he were to leave, his father would die.’
chapters.zh: 我们对我主说：『童子不能离开他父亲，若是离开，他父亲必死。』

chapters.en: But you said to your servants, ‘Unless your younger brother comes down with you, you will not see my face again.’
chapters.zh: 你对仆人说：『你们的小兄弟若不与你们一同下来，你们就不得再见我的面。』

chapters.en: Now when we returned to your servant my father, we relayed your words to him.
chapters.zh: 我们上到你仆人－我们父亲那里，就把我主的话告诉了他。

chapters.en: Then our father said, ‘Go back and buy us some food.’
chapters.zh: 我们的父亲说：『你们再去给我籴些粮来。』

chapters.en: But we answered, ‘We cannot go down there unless our younger brother goes with us. So if our younger brother is not with us, we cannot see the man.’
chapters.zh: 我们就说：『我们不能下去。我们的小兄弟若和我们同往，我们就可以下去。因为，小兄弟若不与我们同往，我们必不得见那人的面。』

chapters.en: And your servant my father said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.
chapters.zh: 你仆人－我父亲对我们说：『你们知道我的妻子给我生了两个儿子。

chapters.en: When one of them was gone, I said: “Surely he has been torn to pieces.” And I have not seen him since.
chapters.zh: 一个离开我出去了；我说他必是被撕碎了，直到如今我也没有见他。

chapters.en: Now if you also take this one from me and harm comes to him, you will bring my gray hair down to Sheol in sorrow.’
chapters.zh: 现在你们又要把这个带去离开我，倘若他遭害，那便是你们使我白发苍苍、悲悲惨惨地下阴间去了。』

chapters.en: So if the boy is not with us when I return to your servant, and if my father, whose life is wrapped up in the boy’s life,
chapters.zh: 我父亲的命与这童子的命相连。如今我回到你仆人－我父亲那里，若没有童子与我们同在，

chapters.en: sees that the boy is not with us, he will die. Then your servants will have brought the gray hair of your servant our father down to Sheol in sorrow.
chapters.zh: 我们的父亲见没有童子，他就必死。这便是我们使你仆人－我们的父亲白发苍苍、悲悲惨惨地下阴间去了。

chapters.en: Indeed, your servant guaranteed the boy’s safety to my father, saying, ‘If I do not return him to you, I will bear the guilt before you, my father, all my life.’
chapters.zh: 因为仆人曾向我父亲为这童子作保，说：『我若不带他回来交给父亲，我便在父亲面前永远担罪。』

chapters.en: Now please let your servant stay here as my lord’s slave in place of the boy. Let him return with his brothers.
chapters.zh: 现在求你容仆人住下，替这童子作我主的奴仆，叫童子和他哥哥们一同上去。

chapters.en: For how can I go back to my father without the boy? I could not bear to see the misery that would overwhelm him.”
chapters.zh: 若童子不和我同去，我怎能上去见我父亲呢？恐怕我看见灾祸临到我父亲身上。」

chapters.en:
Then Joseph could no longer control himself before all his attendants, and he cried out, “Send everyone away from me!”
So none of them were with Joseph when he made himself known to his brothers.
chapters.zh: 约瑟在左右站着的人面前情不自禁，吩咐一声说：「人都要离开我出去！」约瑟和弟兄们相认的时候并没有一人站在他面前。

chapters.en: But he wept so loudly that the Egyptians heard him, and Pharaoh’s household soon heard of it.
chapters.zh: 他就放声大哭；埃及人和法老家中的人都听见了。

chapters.en:
Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Is my father still alive?”
But they were unable to answer him, because they were terrified in his presence.
chapters.zh: 约瑟对他弟兄们说：「我是约瑟。我的父亲还在吗？」他弟兄不能回答，因为在他面前都惊惶。

chapters.en:
Then Joseph said to his brothers, “Please come near me.” And they did so.
“I am Joseph, your brother,” he said, “the one you sold into Egypt!
chapters.zh: 约瑟又对他弟兄们说：「请你们近前来。」他们就近前来。他说：「我是你们的兄弟约瑟，就是你们所卖到埃及的。

chapters.en: And now, do not be distressed or angry with yourselves that you sold me into this place, because it was to save lives that God sent me before you.
chapters.zh: 现在，不要因为把我卖到这里自忧自恨。这是上帝差我在你们以先来，为要保全生命。

chapters.en: For the famine has covered the land these two years, and there will be five more years without plowing or harvesting.
chapters.zh: 现在这地的饥荒已经二年了，还有五年不能耕种，不能收成。

chapters.en: God sent me before you to preserve you as a remnant on the earth and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
chapters.zh: 上帝差我在你们以先来，为要给你们存留余种在世上，又要大施拯救，保全你们的生命。

chapters.en: Therefore it was not you who sent me here, but God, who has made me a father to Pharaoh—lord of all his household and ruler over all the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 这样看来，差我到这里来的不是你们，乃是上帝。他又使我如法老的父，作他全家的主，并埃及全地的宰相。

chapters.en: Now return quickly to my father and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says: God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me without delay.
chapters.zh: 你们要赶紧上到我父亲那里，对他说：『你儿子约瑟这样说：上帝使我作全埃及的主，请你下到我这里来，不要耽延。

chapters.en: You shall settle in the land of Goshen and be near me—you and your children and grandchildren, your flocks and herds, and everything you own.
chapters.zh: 你和你的儿子孙子，连牛群羊群，并一切所有的，都可以住在歌珊地，与我相近。

chapters.en: And there I will provide for you, because there will be five more years of famine. Otherwise, you and your household and everything you own will come to destitution.’
chapters.zh: 我要在那里奉养你；因为还有五年的饥荒，免得你和你的眷属，并一切所有的，都败落了。』

chapters.en: Behold! You and my brother Benjamin can see that I, Joseph, am the one speaking with you.
chapters.zh: 况且你们的眼和我兄弟便雅悯的眼都看见是我亲口对你们说话。

chapters.en: Tell my father about all my splendor in Egypt and everything you have seen. And bring my father down here quickly.”
chapters.zh: 你们也要将我在埃及一切的荣耀和你们所看见的事都告诉我父亲，又要赶紧地将我父亲搬到我这里来。」

chapters.en: Then Joseph threw his arms around his brother Benjamin and wept, and Benjamin wept as they embraced.
chapters.zh: 于是约瑟伏在他兄弟便雅悯的颈项上哭，便雅悯也在他的颈项上哭。

chapters.en: Joseph kissed each of his brothers as he wept over them. And afterward his brothers talked with him.
chapters.zh: 他又与众弟兄亲嘴，抱着他们哭，随后他弟兄们就和他说话。

chapters.en: When the news reached Pharaoh’s house that Joseph’s brothers had come, Pharaoh and his servants were pleased.
chapters.zh: 这风声传到法老的宫里，说：「约瑟的弟兄们来了。」法老和他的臣仆都很喜欢。

chapters.en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do as follows: Load your animals and return to the land of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 法老对约瑟说：「你吩咐你的弟兄们说：『你们要这样行：把驮子抬在牲口上，起身往迦南地去。

chapters.en: Then bring your father and your families and return to me. I will give you the best of the land of Egypt, and you shall eat from the fat of the land.’
chapters.zh: 将你们的父亲和你们的眷属都搬到我这里来，我要把埃及地的美物赐给你们，你们也要吃这地肥美的出产。

chapters.en: You are also directed to tell them: ‘Take wagons from the land of Egypt for your young children and your wives, and bring your father and come back.
chapters.zh: 现在我吩咐你们要这样行：从埃及地带着车辆去，把你们的孩子和妻子，并你们的父亲都搬来。

chapters.en: But pay no regard to your belongings, for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours.’”
chapters.zh: 你们眼中不要爱惜你们的家具，因为埃及全地的美物都是你们的。』」

chapters.en: So the sons of Israel did as they were told. Joseph gave them wagons as Pharaoh had instructed, and he also gave them provisions for their journey.
chapters.zh: 以色列的儿子们就如此行。约瑟照着法老的吩咐给他们车辆和路上用的食物，

chapters.en: He gave new garments to each of them, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver and five sets of clothes.
chapters.zh: 又给他们各人一套衣服，惟独给便雅悯三百银子，五套衣服；

chapters.en: And he sent to his father the following: ten donkeys loaded with the best of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provisions for his father’s journey.
chapters.zh: 送给他父亲公驴十匹，驮着埃及的美物，母驴十匹，驮着粮食与饼和菜，为他父亲路上用。

chapters.en: Then Joseph sent his brothers on their way, and as they were leaving, he said to them, “Do not quarrel on the way!”
chapters.zh: 于是约瑟打发他弟兄们回去，又对他们说：「你们不要在路上相争。」

chapters.en: So the brothers went up out of Egypt and came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 他们从埃及上去，来到迦南地、他们的父亲雅各那里，

chapters.en:
“Joseph is still alive,” they said, “and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt!”
But Jacob was stunned, for he did not believe them.
chapters.zh: 告诉他说：「约瑟还在，并且作埃及全地的宰相。」雅各心里冰凉，因为不信他们。

chapters.en: However, when they relayed all that Joseph had told them, and when he saw the wagons that Joseph had sent to carry him back, the spirit of their father Jacob was revived.
chapters.zh: 他们便将约瑟对他们说的一切话都告诉了他。他们父亲雅各又看见约瑟打发来接他的车辆，心就苏醒了。

chapters.en: “Enough!” declared Israel. “My son Joseph is still alive! I will go to see him before I die.”
chapters.zh: 以色列说：「罢了！罢了！我的儿子约瑟还在，趁我未死以先，我要去见他一面。」

chapters.en: So Israel set out with all that he had, and when he came to Beersheba, he offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.
chapters.zh: 以色列带着一切所有的，起身来到别是巴，就献祭给他父亲以撒的上帝。

chapters.en:
And that night God spoke to Israel in a vision: “Jacob, Jacob!” He said.
“Here I am,” replied Jacob.
chapters.zh: 夜间，上帝在异象中对以色列说：「雅各！雅各！」他说：「我在这里。」

chapters.en: “I am God,” He said, “the God of your father. Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for I will make you into a great nation there.
chapters.zh: 上帝说：「我是上帝，就是你父亲的上帝。你下埃及去不要害怕，因为我必使你在那里成为大族。

chapters.en: I will go down with you to Egypt, and I will surely bring you back. And Joseph’s own hands will close your eyes.”
chapters.zh: 我要和你同下埃及去，也必定带你上来；约瑟必给你送终〔注：原文是将手按在你的眼睛上〕。」

chapters.en: Then Jacob departed from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel took their father Jacob in the wagons Pharaoh had sent to carry him, along with their children and wives.
chapters.zh: 雅各就从别是巴起行。以色列的儿子们使他们的父亲雅各和他们的妻子、儿女都坐在法老为雅各送来的车上。

chapters.en: They also took the livestock and possessions they had acquired in the land of Canaan, and Jacob and all his offspring went to Egypt.
chapters.zh: 他们又带着迦南地所得的牲畜、货财来到埃及。雅各和他的一切子孙都一同来了。

chapters.en: Jacob took with him to Egypt his sons and grandsons, and his daughters and granddaughters—all his offspring.
chapters.zh: 雅各把他的儿子、孙子、女儿、孙女，并他的子子孙孙，一同带到埃及。

chapters.en: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel (Jacob and his descendants) who went to Egypt: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.
chapters.zh: 来到埃及的以色列人名字记在下面。雅各和他的儿孙：雅各的长子是吕便。

chapters.en: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
chapters.zh: 吕便的儿子是哈诺、法路、希斯伦、迦米。

chapters.en: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.
chapters.zh: 西缅的儿子是耶母利、雅悯、阿辖、雅斤、琐辖，还有迦南女子所生的扫罗。

chapters.en: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
chapters.zh: 利未的儿子是革顺、哥辖、米拉利。

chapters.en:
The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
chapters.zh: 犹大的儿子是珥、俄南、示拉、法勒斯、谢拉；惟有珥与俄南死在迦南地。法勒斯的儿子是希斯崙、哈母勒。

chapters.en: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Job, and Shimron.
chapters.zh: 以萨迦的儿子是陀拉、普瓦、约伯、伸崙。

chapters.en: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
chapters.zh: 西布伦的儿子是西烈、以伦、雅利。

chapters.en: These are the sons of Leah born to Jacob in Paddan-aram, in addition to his daughter Dinah. The total number of sons and daughters was thirty-three.
chapters.zh: 这是利亚在巴旦‧亚兰给雅各所生的儿子，还有女儿底拿。儿孙共有三十三人。

chapters.en: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
chapters.zh: 迦得的儿子是洗非芸、哈基、书尼、以斯本、以利、亚罗底、亚列利。

chapters.en:
The children of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah.
The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.
chapters.zh: 亚设的儿子是音拿、亦施瓦、亦施韦、比利亚，还有他们的妹子西拉。比利亚的儿子是希别、玛结。

chapters.en: These are the sons of Jacob born to Zilpah—whom Laban gave to his daughter Leah—sixteen in all.
chapters.zh: 这是拉班给他女儿利亚的婢女悉帕从雅各所生的儿孙，共有十六人。

chapters.en: The sons of Jacob’s wife Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 雅各之妻拉结的儿子是约瑟和便雅悯。

chapters.en: Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph in the land of Egypt by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.
chapters.zh: 约瑟在埃及地生了玛拿西和以法莲，就是安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳给约瑟生的。

chapters.en: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯的儿子是比拉、比结、亚实别、基拉、乃幔、以希、罗实、母平、户平、亚勒。

chapters.en: These are the sons of Rachel born to Jacob—fourteen in all.
chapters.zh: 这是拉结给雅各所生的儿孙，共有十四人。

chapters.en: The son of Dan: Hushim.
chapters.zh: 但的儿子是户伸。

chapters.en: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
chapters.zh: 拿弗他利的儿子是雅薛、沽尼、耶色、示冷。

chapters.en: These are the sons of Jacob born to Bilhah, whom Laban gave to his daughter Rachel—seven in all.
chapters.zh: 这是拉班给他女儿拉结的婢女辟拉从雅各所生的儿孙，共有七人。

chapters.en: All those belonging to Jacob who came to Egypt—his direct descendants, besides the wives of Jacob’s sons—numbered sixty-six persons.
chapters.zh: 那与雅各同到埃及的，除了他儿妇之外，凡从他所生的，共有六十六人。

chapters.en: And with the two sons who had been born to Joseph in Egypt, the members of Jacob’s family who went to Egypt were seventy in all.
chapters.zh: 还有约瑟在埃及所生的两个儿子。雅各家来到埃及的共有七十人。

chapters.en: Now Jacob had sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph to get directions to Goshen. When Jacob’s family arrived in the land of Goshen,
chapters.zh: 雅各打发犹大先去见约瑟，请派人引路往歌珊去；于是他们来到歌珊地。

chapters.en: Joseph prepared his chariot and went there to meet his father Israel. Joseph presented himself to him, embraced him, and wept profusely.
chapters.zh: 约瑟套车往歌珊去，迎接他父亲以色列，及至见了面，就伏在父亲的颈项上，哭了许久。

chapters.en: Then Israel said to Joseph, “Finally I can die, now that I have seen your face and know that you are still alive!”
chapters.zh: 以色列对约瑟说：「我既得见你的面，知道你还在，就是死我也甘心。」

chapters.en: Joseph said to his brothers and to his father’s household, “I will go up and inform Pharaoh: ‘My brothers and my father’s household from the land of Canaan have come to me.
chapters.zh: 约瑟对他的弟兄和他父的全家说：「我要上去告诉法老，对他说：『我的弟兄和我父的全家从前在迦南地，现今都到我这里来了。

chapters.en: The men are shepherds; they raise livestock, and they have brought their flocks and herds and all that they own.’
chapters.zh: 他们本是牧羊的人，以养牲畜为业；他们把羊群牛群和一切所有的都带来了。』

chapters.en: When Pharaoh summons you and asks, ‘What is your occupation?’
chapters.zh: 等法老召你们的时候，问你们说：『你们以何事为业？』

chapters.en: you are to say, ‘Your servants have raised livestock ever since our youth—both we and our fathers.’ Then you will be allowed to settle in the land of Goshen, since all shepherds are detestable to the Egyptians.”
chapters.zh: 你们要说：『你的仆人，从幼年直到如今，都以养牲畜为业，连我们的祖宗也都以此为业。』这样，你们可以住在歌珊地，因为凡牧羊的都被埃及人所厌恶。」

chapters.en: So Joseph went and told Pharaoh: “My father and my brothers, with their flocks and herds and all they own, have come from the land of Canaan and are now in Goshen.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟进去告诉法老说：「我的父亲和我的弟兄带着羊群牛群，并一切所有的，从迦南地来了，如今在歌珊地。」

chapters.en: And he chose five of his brothers and presented them before Pharaoh.
chapters.zh: 约瑟从他弟兄中挑出五个人来，引他们去见法老。

chapters.en:
“What is your occupation?” Pharaoh asked Joseph’s brothers.
“Your servants are shepherds,” they replied, “both we and our fathers.”
chapters.zh: 法老问约瑟的弟兄说：「你们以何事为业？」他们对法老说：「你仆人是牧羊的，连我们的祖宗也是牧羊的。」

chapters.en: Then they said to Pharaoh, “We have come to live in the land for a time, because there is no pasture for the flocks of your servants, since the famine in the land of Canaan has been severe. So now, please allow your servants to settle in the land of Goshen.”
chapters.zh: 他们又对法老说：「迦南地的饥荒甚大，仆人的羊群没有草吃，所以我们来到这地寄居。现在求你容仆人住在歌珊地。」

chapters.en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Now that your father and brothers have come to you,
chapters.zh: 法老对约瑟说：「你父亲和你弟兄到你这里来了，

chapters.en: the land of Egypt is before you; settle your father and brothers in the best part of the land. They may dwell in the land of Goshen. And if you know of any talented men among them, put them in charge of my own livestock.”
chapters.zh: 埃及地都在你面前，只管叫你父亲和你弟兄住在国中最好的地；他们可以住在歌珊地。你若知道他们中间有什么能人，就派他们看管我的牲畜。」

chapters.en: Then Joseph brought in his father Jacob and presented him before Pharaoh, and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
chapters.zh: 约瑟领他父亲雅各进到法老面前，雅各就给法老祝福。

chapters.en: “How many years have you lived?” Pharaoh asked.
chapters.zh: 法老问雅各说：「你平生的年日是多少呢？」

chapters.en: “My travels have lasted 130 years,” Jacob replied. “My years have been few and hard, and they have not matched the years of the travels of my fathers.”
chapters.zh: 雅各对法老说：「我寄居在世的年日是一百三十岁，我平生的年日又少又苦，不及我列祖在世寄居的年日。」

chapters.en: Then Jacob blessed Pharaoh and departed from his presence.
chapters.zh: 雅各又给法老祝福，就从法老面前出去了。

chapters.en: So Joseph settled his father and brothers in the land of Egypt and gave them property in the best part of the land, the district of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
chapters.zh: 约瑟遵着法老的命，把埃及国最好的地，就是兰塞境内的地，给他父亲和弟兄居住，作为产业。

chapters.en: Joseph also provided his father and brothers and all his father’s household with food for their families.
chapters.zh: 约瑟用粮食奉养他父亲和他弟兄，并他父亲全家的眷属，都是照各家的人口奉养他们。

chapters.en: There was no food, however, in all that region, because the famine was so severe; the lands of Egypt and Canaan had been exhausted by the famine.
chapters.zh: 饥荒甚大，全地都绝了粮，甚至埃及地和迦南地〔的人〕因那饥荒的缘故都饿昏了。

chapters.en: Joseph collected all the money to be found in the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan in exchange for the grain they were buying, and he brought it into Pharaoh’s palace.
chapters.zh: 约瑟收聚了埃及地和迦南地所有的银子，就是众人籴粮的银子，约瑟就把那银子带到法老的宫里。

chapters.en: When the money from the lands of Egypt and Canaan was gone, all the Egyptians came to Joseph and said, “Give us food. Why should we die before your eyes? For our funds have run out!”
chapters.zh: 埃及地和迦南地的银子都花尽了，埃及众人都来见约瑟，说：「我们的银子都用尽了，求你给我们粮食，我们为什么死在你面前呢？」

chapters.en: “Then bring me your livestock,” said Joseph. “Since the money is gone, I will sell you food in exchange for your livestock.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟说：「若是银子用尽了，可以把你们的牲畜给我，我就为你们的牲畜给你们粮食。」

chapters.en: So they brought their livestock to Joseph, and he gave them food in exchange for their horses, their flocks and herds, and their donkeys. Throughout that year he provided them with food in exchange for all their livestock.
chapters.zh: 于是他们把牲畜赶到约瑟那里，约瑟就拿粮食换了他们的牛、羊、驴、马；那一年因换他们一切的牲畜，就用粮食养活他们。

chapters.en: When that year was over, they came to him the second year and said, “We cannot hide from our lord that our money is gone and all our livestock belongs to you. There is nothing left for our lord except our bodies and our land.
chapters.zh: 那一年过去，第二年他们又来见约瑟，说：「我们不瞒我主，我们的银子都花尽了，牲畜也都归了我主。我们在我主眼前，除了我们的身体和田地之外，一无所剩。

chapters.en: Why should we perish before your eyes—we and our land as well? Purchase us and our land in exchange for food. Then we, along with our land, will be slaves to Pharaoh. Give us seed that we may live and not die, and that the land may not become desolate.”
chapters.zh: 你何忍见我们人死地荒呢？求你用粮食买我们和我们的地，我们和我们的地就要给法老效力。又求你给我们种子，使我们得以存活，不致死亡，地土也不致荒凉。」

chapters.en: So Joseph acquired for Pharaoh all the land in Egypt; the Egyptians, one and all, sold their fields because the famine was so severe upon them. The land became Pharaoh’s,
chapters.zh: 于是，约瑟为法老买了埃及所有的地，埃及人因被饥荒所迫，各都卖了自己的田地；那地就都归了法老。

chapters.en: and Joseph reduced the people to servitude from one end of Egypt to the other.
chapters.zh: 至于百姓，约瑟叫他们，从埃及这边直到埃及那边，都各归各城。

chapters.en: However, he did not acquire the priests’ portion of the land, for it had been given to them by Pharaoh. They ate the rations that Pharaoh supplied; so they did not sell their land.
chapters.zh: 惟有祭司的地，约瑟没有买，因为祭司有从法老所得的常俸。他们吃法老所给的常俸，所以他们不卖自己的地。

chapters.en: Then Joseph said to the people, “Now that I have acquired you and your land for Pharaoh this day, here is seed for you to sow in the land.
chapters.zh: 约瑟对百姓说：「我今日为法老买了你们和你们的地，看哪，这里有种子给你们，你们可以种地。

chapters.en: At harvest time, you are to give a fifth of it to Pharaoh, and four-fifths will be yours as seed for the field and food for yourselves and your households and children.”
chapters.zh: 后来打粮食的时候，你们要把五分之一纳给法老，四分可以归你们做地里的种子，也做你们和你们家口孩童的食物。」

chapters.en: “You have saved our lives,” they said. “We have found favor in our lord’s eyes, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「你救了我们的性命。但愿我们在我主眼前蒙恩，我们就作法老的仆人。」

chapters.en: So Joseph established a law that a fifth of the produce belongs to Pharaoh, and it is in effect in the land of Egypt to this day. Only the priests’ land does not belong to Pharaoh.
chapters.zh: 于是约瑟为埃及地定下常例，直到今日：法老必得五分之一，惟独祭司的地不归法老。

chapters.en: Now the Israelites settled in the land of Egypt, in the region of Goshen. They acquired property there and became fruitful and increased greatly in number.
chapters.zh: 以色列人住在埃及的歌珊地。他们在那里置了产业，并且生育甚多。

chapters.en: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years, and the length of his life was 147 years.
chapters.zh: 雅各住在埃及地十七年，雅各平生的年日是一百四十七岁。

chapters.en: When the time drew near for Israel to die, he called his son Joseph and said to him, “If I have found favor in your eyes, put your hand under my thigh and promise to show me kindness and faithfulness. Do not bury me in Egypt,
chapters.zh: 以色列的死期临近了，他就叫了他儿子约瑟来，说：「我若在你眼前蒙恩，请你把手放在我大腿底下，用慈爱和诚实待我，请你不要将我葬在埃及。

chapters.en:
but when I lie down with my fathers, carry me out of Egypt and bury me with them.”
Joseph answered, “I will do as you have requested.”
chapters.zh: 我与我祖我父同睡的时候，你要将我带出埃及，葬在他们所葬的地方。」约瑟说：「我必遵着你的命而行。」

chapters.en:
“Swear to me,” Jacob said.
So Joseph swore to him, and Israel bowed in worship at the head of his bed.
chapters.zh: 雅各说：「你要向我起誓。」约瑟就向他起了誓，于是以色列在床头上〔注：或译：扶着杖头〕敬拜〔上帝〕。

chapters.en: Some time later Joseph was told, “Your father is ill.” So he set out with his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，有人告诉约瑟说：「你的父亲病了。」他就带着两个儿子玛拿西和以法莲同去。

chapters.en: When Jacob was told, “Your son Joseph has come to you,” Israel rallied his strength and sat up in bed.
chapters.zh: 有人告诉雅各说：「请看，你儿子约瑟到你这里来了。」以色列就勉强在床上坐起来。

chapters.en: Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and there He blessed me
chapters.zh: 雅各对约瑟说：「全能的上帝曾在迦南地的路斯向我显现，赐福与我，

chapters.en: and told me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful and multiply you; I will make you a multitude of peoples, and will give this land to your descendants after you as an everlasting possession.’
chapters.zh: 对我说：『我必使你生养众多，成为多民，又要把这地赐给你的后裔，永远为业。』

chapters.en: And now your two sons born to you in Egypt before I came to you here shall be reckoned as mine; Ephraim and Manasseh shall be mine, just as Reuben and Simeon are mine.
chapters.zh: 我未到埃及见你之先，你在埃及地所生的以法莲和玛拿西这两个儿子是我的，正如吕便和西缅是我的一样。

chapters.en: Any children born to you after them shall be yours, and they shall be called by the names of their brothers in the territory they inherit.
chapters.zh: 你在他们以后所生的就是你的，他们可以归于他们弟兄的名下得产业。

chapters.en: Now as for me, when I was returning from Paddan, to my sorrow Rachel died along the way in the land of Canaan, some distance from Ephrath. So I buried her there beside the road to Ephrath” (that is, Bethlehem).
chapters.zh: 至于我，我从巴旦来的时候，拉结死在我眼前，在迦南地的路上，离以法他还有一段路程，我就把她葬在以法他的路上（以法他就是伯利恒）。」

chapters.en: When Israel saw the sons of Joseph, he asked, “Who are these?”
chapters.zh: 以色列看见约瑟的两个儿子，就说：「这是谁？」

chapters.en:
Joseph said to his father, “They are the sons God has given me in this place.”
So Jacob said, “Please bring them to me, that I may bless them.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟对他父亲说：「这是上帝在这里赐给我的儿子。」以色列说：「请你领他们到我跟前，我要给他们祝福。」

chapters.en: Now Israel’s eyesight was poor because of old age; he could hardly see. Joseph brought his sons to him, and his father kissed them and embraced them.
chapters.zh: 以色列年纪老迈，眼睛昏花，不能看见。约瑟领他们到他跟前，他就和他们亲嘴，抱着他们。

chapters.en: “I never expected to see your face again,” Israel said to Joseph, “but now God has let me see your children as well.”
chapters.zh: 以色列对约瑟说：「我想不到得见你的面，不料，上帝又使我得见你的儿子。」

chapters.en: Then Joseph removed his sons from his father’s knees and bowed facedown.
chapters.zh: 约瑟把两个儿子从以色列两膝中领出来，自己就脸伏于地下拜。

chapters.en: And Joseph took both of them—with Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand—and brought them close to him.
chapters.zh: 随后，约瑟又拉着他们两个，以法莲在他的右手里，对着以色列的左手，玛拿西在他的左手里，对着以色列的右手，领他们到以色列的跟前。

chapters.en: But Israel stretched out his right hand and put it on the head of Ephraim, the younger; and crossing his hands, he put his left on Manasseh’s head, although Manasseh was the firstborn.
chapters.zh: 以色列伸出右手来，按在以法莲的头上（以法莲乃是次子），又剪搭过左手来，按在玛拿西的头上（玛拿西原是长子）。

chapters.en:
Then he blessed Joseph and said:
“May the God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has been my shepherd all my life to this day,
chapters.zh: 他就给约瑟祝福说：「愿我祖亚伯拉罕和我父以撒所事奉的上帝，就是一生牧养我直到今日的上帝，

chapters.en:
the angel who has redeemed me from all harm— may He bless these boys. And may they be called by my name and the names of my fathers Abraham and Isaac,
and may they grow into a multitude upon the earth.”
chapters.zh: 救赎我脱离一切患难的那使者，赐福与这两个童子。愿他们归在我的名下和我祖亚伯拉罕、我父以撒的名下。又愿他们在世界中生养众多。」

chapters.en: When Joseph saw that his father had placed his right hand on Ephraim’s head, he was displeased and took his father’s hand to move it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s.
chapters.zh: 约瑟见他父亲把右手按在以法莲的头上，就不喜悦，便提起他父亲的手，要从以法莲头上挪到玛拿西的头上。

chapters.en: “Not so, my father!” Joseph said. “This one is the firstborn; put your right hand on his head.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟对他父亲说：「我父，不是这样。这本是长子，求你把右手按在他的头上。」

chapters.en: But his father refused. “I know, my son, I know!” he said. “He too shall become a people, and he too shall be great; nevertheless, his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his offspring shall become a multitude of nations.”
chapters.zh: 他父亲不从，说：「我知道，我儿，我知道。他也必成为一族，也必昌大。只是他的兄弟将来比他还大；他兄弟的后裔要成为多族。」

chapters.en:
So that day Jacob blessed them and said:
“By you shall Israel pronounce this blessing: ‘May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh.’”
So he put Ephraim before Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 当日就给他们祝福说：「以色列人要指着你们祝福说：『愿上帝使你如以法莲、玛拿西一样。』」于是立以法莲在玛拿西以上。

chapters.en: Then Israel said to Joseph, “Look, I am about to die, but God will be with you and bring you back to the land of your fathers.
chapters.zh: 以色列又对约瑟说：「我要死了，但上帝必与你们同在，领你们回到你们列祖之地。

chapters.en: And to you, as one who is above your brothers, I give the ridge of land that I took from the Amorites with my sword and bow.”
chapters.zh: 并且我从前用弓用刀从亚摩利人手下夺的那块地，我都赐给你，使你比众弟兄多得一分。」

chapters.en: Then Jacob called for his sons and said, “Gather around so that I can tell you what will happen to you in the days to come:
chapters.zh: 雅各叫了他的儿子们来，说：「你们都来聚集，我好把你们日后必遇的事告诉你们。

chapters.en: Come together and listen, O sons of Jacob; listen to your father Israel.
chapters.zh: 雅各的儿子们，你们要聚集而听， 要听你们父亲以色列的话。

chapters.en: Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, excelling in honor, excelling in power.
chapters.zh: 吕便哪，你是我的长子， 是我力量强壮的时候生的， 本当大有尊荣，权力超众。

chapters.en: Uncontrolled as the waters, you will no longer excel, because you went up to your father’s bed, onto my couch, and defiled it.
chapters.zh: 但你〔放纵情欲，〕滚沸如水， 必不得居首位； 因为你上了你父亲的床， 污秽了我的榻。

chapters.en: Simeon and Levi are brothers; their swords are weapons of violence.
chapters.zh: 西缅和利未是弟兄； 他们的刀剑是残忍的器具。

chapters.en: May I never enter their council; may I never join their assembly. For they kill men in their anger, and hamstring oxen on a whim.
chapters.zh: 我的灵啊，不要与他们同谋； 我的心哪，不要与他们联络； 因为他们趁怒杀害人命， 任意砍断牛腿大筋。

chapters.en: Cursed be their anger, for it is strong, and their wrath, for it is cruel! I will disperse them in Jacob and scatter them in Israel.
chapters.zh: 他们的怒气暴烈可咒； 他们的忿恨残忍可诅。 我要使他们分居在雅各〔家里〕， 散住在以色列〔地中〕。

chapters.en:
Judah, your brothers shall praise you. Your hand shall be on the necks of your enemies;
your father’s sons shall bow down to you.
chapters.zh: 犹大啊，你弟兄们必赞美你； 你手必掐住仇敌的颈项； 你父亲的儿子们必向你下拜。

chapters.en: Judah is a young lion— my son, you return from the prey. Like a lion he crouches and lies down; like a lioness, who dares to rouse him?
chapters.zh: 犹大是个小狮子； 我儿啊，你抓了食便上去。 你屈下身去，卧如公狮， 蹲如母狮，谁敢惹你？

chapters.en: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the staff from between his feet, until Shiloh comes and the allegiance of the nations is his.
chapters.zh: 圭必不离犹大， 杖必不离他两脚之间， 直等细罗〔注：就是赐平安者〕来到， 万民都必归顺。

chapters.en: He ties his donkey to the vine, his colt to the choicest branch. He washes his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.
chapters.zh: 犹大把小驴拴在葡萄树上， 把驴驹拴在美好的葡萄树上。 他在葡萄酒中洗了衣服， 在葡萄汁中洗了袍褂。

chapters.en: His eyes are darker than wine, and his teeth are whiter than milk.
chapters.zh: 他的眼睛必因酒红润； 他的牙齿必因奶白亮。

chapters.en:
Zebulun shall dwell by the seashore and become a harbor for ships;
his border shall extend to Sidon.
chapters.zh: 西布伦必住在海口， 必成为停船的海口； 他的境界必延到西顿。

chapters.en: Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the sheepfolds.
chapters.zh: 以萨迦是个强壮的驴， 卧在羊圈之中。

chapters.en: He saw that his resting place was good and that his land was pleasant, so he bent his shoulder to the burden and submitted to labor as a servant.
chapters.zh: 他以安静为佳，以肥地为美， 便低肩背重，成为服苦的仆人。

chapters.en: Dan shall provide justice for his people as one of the tribes of Israel.
chapters.zh: 但必判断他的民， 作以色列支派之一。

chapters.en: He will be a snake by the road, a viper in the path that bites the horse’s heels so that its rider tumbles backward.
chapters.zh: 但必作道上的蛇，路中的虺， 咬伤马蹄，使骑马的坠落于后。

chapters.en: I await Your salvation, O LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我向来等候你的救恩。

chapters.en: Gad will be attacked by raiders, but he will attack their heels.
chapters.zh: 迦得必被敌军追逼， 他却要追逼他们的脚跟。

chapters.en: Asher’s food will be rich; he shall provide royal delicacies.
chapters.zh: 亚设之地必出肥美的粮食， 且出君王的美味。

chapters.en: Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns.
chapters.zh: 拿弗他利是被释放的母鹿； 他出嘉美的言语。

chapters.en:
Joseph is a fruitful vine— a fruitful vine by a spring,
whose branches scale the wall.
chapters.zh: 约瑟是多结果子的树枝， 是泉旁多结果的枝子； 他的枝条探出墙外。

chapters.en: The archers attacked him with bitterness; they aimed at him in hostility.
chapters.zh: 弓箭手将他苦害， 向他射箭，逼迫他。

chapters.en: Yet he steadied his bow, and his strong arms were tempered by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, in the name of the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel,
chapters.zh: 但他的弓仍旧坚硬； 他的手健壮敏捷。 这是因以色列的牧者，以色列的磐石－ 就是雅各的大能者。

chapters.en:
by the God of your father who helps you, and by the Almighty who blesses you, with blessings of the heavens above, with blessings of the depths below,
with blessings of the breasts and womb.
chapters.zh: 你父亲的上帝必帮助你； 那全能者必将天上所有的福， 地里所藏的福，以及生产乳养的福，都赐给你。

chapters.en:
The blessings of your father have surpassed the blessings of the ancient mountains
and the bounty of the everlasting hills. May they rest on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the prince of his brothers.
chapters.zh: 你父亲所祝的福 胜过我祖先所祝的福， 如永世的山岭，至极的边界； 这些福必降在约瑟的头上， 临到那与弟兄迥别之人的顶上。

chapters.en:
Benjamin is a ravenous wolf; in the morning he devours the prey,
in the evening he divides the plunder.”
chapters.zh: 便雅悯是个撕掠的狼， 早晨要吃他所抓的， 晚上要分他所夺的。」

chapters.en: These are the tribes of Israel, twelve in all, and this was what their father said to them. He blessed them, and he blessed each one with a suitable blessing.
chapters.zh: 这一切是以色列的十二支派；这也是他们的父亲对他们所说的话，为他们所祝的福，都是按着各人的福分为他们祝福。

chapters.en: Then Jacob instructed them, “I am about to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite.
chapters.zh: 他又嘱咐他们说：「我将要归到我列祖〔注：原文是本民〕那里，你们要将我葬在赫人以弗崙田间的洞里，与我祖我父在一处，

chapters.en: The cave is in the field of Machpelah near Mamre, in the land of Canaan. This is the field Abraham purchased from Ephron the Hittite as a burial site.
chapters.zh: 就是在迦南地幔利前、麦比拉田间的洞；那洞和田是亚伯拉罕向赫人以弗崙买来为业，作坟地的。

chapters.en: There Abraham and his wife Sarah are buried, there Isaac and his wife Rebekah are buried, and there I buried Leah.
chapters.zh: 他们在那里葬了亚伯拉罕和他妻子撒拉，又在那里葬了以撒和他的妻子利百加；我也在那里葬了利亚。

chapters.en: The field and the cave that is in it were purchased from the Hittites.”
chapters.zh: 那块田和田间的洞原是向赫人买的。」

chapters.en: When Jacob had finished instructing his sons, he pulled his feet into the bed and breathed his last, and he was gathered to his people.
chapters.zh: 雅各嘱咐众子已毕，就把脚收在床上，气绝而死，归他列祖〔注：原文是本民〕那里去了。

chapters.en: Then Joseph fell upon his father’s face, wept over him, and kissed him.
chapters.zh: 约瑟伏在他父亲的面上哀哭，与他亲嘴。

chapters.en: And Joseph directed the physicians in his service to embalm his father Israel. So they embalmed him,
chapters.zh: 约瑟吩咐伺候他的医生用香料薰他父亲，医生就用香料薰了以色列。

chapters.en: taking the forty days required to complete the embalming. And the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.
chapters.zh: 薰尸的常例是四十天；那四十天满了，埃及人为他哀哭了七十天。

chapters.en: When the days of mourning had passed, Joseph said to Pharaoh’s court, “If I have found favor in your eyes, please tell Pharaoh that
chapters.zh: 为他哀哭的日子过了，约瑟对法老家中的人说：「我若在你们眼前蒙恩，请你们报告法老说：

chapters.en: my father made me swear an oath when he said, ‘I am about to die. You must bury me in the tomb that I dug for myself in the land of Canaan.’ Now let me go and bury my father, and then return.”
chapters.zh: 『我父亲要死的时候叫我起誓说：你要将我葬在迦南地，在我为自己所掘的坟墓里。』现在求你让我上去葬我父亲，以后我必回来。」

chapters.en: Pharaoh replied, “Go up and bury your father, as he made you swear to do.”
chapters.zh: 法老说：「你可以上去，照着你父亲叫你起的誓，将他葬埋。」

chapters.en: Then Joseph went to bury his father, and all the servants of Pharaoh accompanied him—the elders of Pharaoh’s household and all the elders of the land of Egypt—
chapters.zh: 于是约瑟上去葬他父亲。与他一同上去的，有法老的臣仆和法老家中的长老，并埃及国的长老，

chapters.en: along with all of Joseph’s household, and his brothers, and his father’s household. Only their children and flocks and herds were left in Goshen.
chapters.zh: 还有约瑟的全家和他的弟兄们，并他父亲的眷属；只有他们的〔妇人〕孩子，和羊群牛群，都留在歌珊地。

chapters.en: Chariots and horsemen alike went up with him, and it was an exceedingly large procession.
chapters.zh: 又有车辆马兵，和他一同上去；那一帮人甚多。

chapters.en: When they reached the threshing floor of Atad, which is across the Jordan, they lamented and wailed loudly, and Joseph mourned for his father seven days.
chapters.zh: 他们到了约旦河外、亚达的禾场，就在那里大大地号咷痛哭。约瑟为他父亲哀哭了七天。

chapters.en: When the Canaanites of the land saw the mourning at the threshing floor of Atad, they said, “This is a solemn ceremony of mourning by the Egyptians.” Thus the place across the Jordan is called Abel-mizraim.
chapters.zh: 迦南的居民见亚达禾场上的哀哭，就说：「这是埃及人一场极大的哀哭。」因此那地方名叫亚伯‧麦西，是在约旦河东。

chapters.en: So Jacob’s sons did as he had charged them.
chapters.zh: 雅各的儿子们就遵着他父亲所吩咐的办了，

chapters.en: They carried him to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave at Machpelah in the field near Mamre, which Abraham had purchased from Ephron the Hittite as a burial site.
chapters.zh: 把他搬到迦南地，葬在幔利前、麦比拉田间的洞里；那洞和田是亚伯拉罕向赫人以弗崙买来为业，作坟地的。

chapters.en: After Joseph had buried his father, he returned to Egypt with his brothers and all who had gone with him to bury his father.
chapters.zh: 约瑟葬了他父亲以后，就和众弟兄，并一切同他上去葬他父亲的人，都回埃及去了。

chapters.en: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “What if Joseph bears a grudge? Then he will surely repay us for all the evil that we did to him.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟的哥哥们见父亲死了，就说：「或者约瑟怀恨我们，照着我们从前待他一切的恶足足地报复我们。」

chapters.en: So they sent word to Joseph, saying, “Before he died, your father commanded,
chapters.zh: 他们就打发人去见约瑟，说：「你父亲未死以先吩咐说：

chapters.en:
‘This is what you are to say to Joseph: I beg you, please forgive the transgression and sin of your brothers, for they did you wrong.’ So now, Joseph, please forgive the transgression of the servants of the God of your father.”
When their message came to him, Joseph wept.
chapters.zh: 『你们要对约瑟这样说：从前你哥哥们恶待你，求你饶恕他们的过犯和罪恶。』如今求你饶恕你父亲上帝之仆人的过犯。」他们对约瑟说这话，约瑟就哭了。

chapters.en: His brothers also came to him, bowed down before him, and said, “We are your slaves!”
chapters.zh: 他的哥哥们又来俯伏在他面前，说：「我们是你的仆人。」

chapters.en: But Joseph replied, “Do not be afraid. Am I in the place of God?
chapters.zh: 约瑟对他们说：「不要害怕，我岂能代替上帝呢？

chapters.en: As for you, what you intended against me for evil, God intended for good, in order to accomplish a day like this—to preserve the lives of many people.
chapters.zh: 从前你们的意思是要害我，但上帝的意思原是好的，要保全许多人的性命，成就今日的光景。

chapters.en: Therefore do not be afraid. I will provide for you and your little ones.” So Joseph reassured his brothers and spoke kindly to them.
chapters.zh: 现在你们不要害怕，我必养活你们和你们的〔妇人〕孩子。」于是约瑟用亲爱的话安慰他们。

chapters.en: Now Joseph and his father’s household remained in Egypt, and Joseph lived to the age of 110.
chapters.zh: 约瑟和他父亲的眷属都住在埃及。约瑟活了一百一十岁。

chapters.en: He saw Ephraim’s sons to the third generation, and indeed the sons of Machir son of Manasseh were brought up on Joseph’s knees.
chapters.zh: 约瑟得见以法莲第三代的子孙。玛拿西的孙子、玛吉的儿子也养在约瑟的膝上。

chapters.en: Then Joseph said to his brothers, “I am about to die, but God will surely visit you and bring you up from this land to the land He promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟对他弟兄们说：「我要死了，但上帝必定看顾你们，领你们从这地上去，到他起誓所应许给亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各之地。」

chapters.en: And Joseph made the sons of Israel take an oath and said, “God will surely attend to you, and then you must carry my bones up from this place.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟叫以色列的子孙起誓说：「上帝必定看顾你们；你们要把我的骸骨从这里搬上去。」

chapters.en: So Joseph died at the age of 110. And they embalmed his body and placed it in a coffin in Egypt.
chapters.zh: 约瑟死了，正一百一十岁。人用香料将他薰了，把他收殓在棺材里，停在埃及。

chapters.en: These are the names of the sons of Israel who went to Egypt with Jacob, each with his family:
chapters.zh: 以色列的众子，各带家眷，和雅各一同来到埃及。他们的名字记在下面。

chapters.en: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah;
chapters.zh: 有吕便、西缅、利未、犹大、

chapters.en: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin;
chapters.zh: 以萨迦、西布伦、便雅悯、

chapters.en:
Dan and Naphtali;
Gad and Asher.
chapters.zh: 但、拿弗他利、迦得、亚设。

chapters.en: The descendants of Jacob numbered seventy in all, including Joseph, who was already in Egypt.
chapters.zh: 凡从雅各而生的，共有七十人。约瑟已经在埃及。

chapters.en: Now Joseph and all his brothers and all that generation died,
chapters.zh: 约瑟和他的弟兄，并那一代的人，都死了。

chapters.en: but the Israelites were fruitful and increased rapidly; they multiplied and became exceedingly numerous, so that the land was filled with them.
chapters.zh: 以色列人生养众多，并且繁茂，极其强盛，满了那地。

chapters.en: Then a new king, who did not know Joseph, came to power in Egypt.
chapters.zh: 有不认识约瑟的新王起来，治理埃及，

chapters.en: “Look,” he said to his people, “the Israelites have become too numerous and too powerful for us.
chapters.zh: 对他的百姓说：「看哪，这以色列民比我们还多，又比我们强盛。

chapters.en: Come, let us deal shrewdly with them, or they will increase even more; and if a war breaks out, they may join our enemies, fight against us, and leave the country. ”
chapters.zh: 来吧，我们不如用巧计待他们，恐怕他们多起来，日后若遇什么争战的事，就连合我们的仇敌攻击我们，离开这地去了。」

chapters.en: So the Egyptians appointed taskmasters over the Israelites to oppress them with forced labor. As a result, they built Pithom and Rameses as store cities for Pharaoh.
chapters.zh: 于是埃及人派督工的辖制他们，加重担苦害他们。他们为法老建造两座积货城，就是比东和兰塞。

chapters.en: But the more they were oppressed, the more they multiplied and flourished; so the Egyptians came to dread the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 只是越发苦害他们，他们越发多起来，越发蔓延；埃及人就因以色列人愁烦。

chapters.en: They worked the Israelites ruthlessly
chapters.zh: 埃及人严严地使以色列人做工，

chapters.en: and made their lives bitter with hard labor in brick and mortar, and with all kinds of work in the fields. Every service they imposed was harsh.
chapters.zh: 使他们因做苦工觉得命苦；无论是和泥，是做砖，是做田间各样的工，在一切的工上都严严地待他们。

chapters.en: Then the king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives, whose names were Shiphrah and Puah,
chapters.zh: 有希伯来的两个收生婆，一名施弗拉，一名普阿；埃及王对她们说：

chapters.en: “When you help the Hebrew women give birth, observe them on the birthstools. If the child is a son, kill him; but if it is a daughter, let her live.”
chapters.zh: 「你们为希伯来妇人收生，看她们临盆的时候，若是男孩，就把他杀了；若是女孩，就留她存活。」

chapters.en: The midwives, however, feared God and did not do as the king of Egypt had instructed; they let the boys live.
chapters.zh: 但是收生婆敬畏上帝，不照埃及王的吩咐行，竟存留男孩的性命。

chapters.en: So the king of Egypt summoned the midwives and asked them, “Why have you done this? Why have you let the boys live?”
chapters.zh: 埃及王召了收生婆来，说：「你们为什么做这事，存留男孩的性命呢？」

chapters.en: The midwives answered Pharaoh, “The Hebrew women are not like the Egyptian women, for they are vigorous and give birth before a midwife arrives.”
chapters.zh: 收生婆对法老说：「因为希伯来妇人与埃及妇人不同；希伯来妇人本是健壮的〔注：原文是活泼的〕，收生婆还没有到，她们已经生产了。」

chapters.en: So God was good to the midwives, and the people multiplied and became even more numerous.
chapters.zh: 上帝厚待收生婆。以色列人多起来，极其强盛。

chapters.en: And because the midwives feared God, He gave them families of their own.
chapters.zh: 收生婆因为敬畏上帝，上帝便叫她们成立家室。

chapters.en: Then Pharaoh commanded all his people: “Every son born to the Hebrews you must throw into the Nile, but every daughter you may allow to live.”
chapters.zh: 法老吩咐他的众民说：「以色列人所生的男孩，你们都要丢在河里；一切的女孩，你们要存留她的性命。」

chapters.en: Now a man of the house of Levi married a Levite woman,
chapters.zh: 有一个利未家的人娶了一个利未女子为妻。

chapters.en: and she conceived and gave birth to a son. When she saw that he was a beautiful child, she hid him for three months.
chapters.zh: 那女人怀孕，生一个儿子，见他俊美，就藏了他三个月，

chapters.en: But when she could no longer hide him, she got him a papyrus basket and coated it with tar and pitch. Then she placed the child in the basket and set it among the reeds along the bank of the Nile.
chapters.zh: 后来不能再藏，就取了一个蒲草箱，抹上石漆和石油，将孩子放在里头，把箱子搁在河边的芦荻中。

chapters.en: And his sister stood at a distance to see what would happen to him.
chapters.zh: 孩子的姊姊远远站着，要知道他究竟怎么样。

chapters.en: Soon the daughter of Pharaoh went down to bathe in the Nile, and her attendants were walking along the riverbank. And when she saw the basket among the reeds, she sent her maidservant to retrieve it.
chapters.zh: 法老的女儿来到河边洗澡，她的使女们在河边行走。她看见箱子在芦荻中，就打发一个婢女拿来。

chapters.en: When she opened it, she saw the child, and behold, the little boy was crying. So she had compassion on him and said, “This is one of the Hebrew children.”
chapters.zh: 她打开箱子，看见那孩子。孩子哭了，她就可怜他，说：「这是希伯来人的一个孩子。」

chapters.en: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Shall I go and call one of the Hebrew women to nurse the child for you?”
chapters.zh: 孩子的姊姊对法老的女儿说：「我去在希伯来妇人中叫一个奶妈来，为你奶这孩子，可以不可以？」

chapters.en: “Go ahead,” Pharaoh’s daughter told her. And the girl went and called the boy’s mother.
chapters.zh: 法老的女儿说：「可以。」童女就去叫了孩子的母亲来。

chapters.en: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child and nurse him for me, and I will pay your wages.” So the woman took the boy and nursed him.
chapters.zh: 法老的女儿对她说：「你把这孩子抱去，为我奶他，我必给你工价。」妇人就抱了孩子去奶他。

chapters.en: When the child had grown older, she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses and explained, “I drew him out of the water.”
chapters.zh: 孩子渐长，妇人把他带到法老的女儿那里，就作了她的儿子。她给孩子起名叫摩西，意思说：「因我把他从水里拉出来。」

chapters.en: One day, after Moses had grown up, he went out to his own people and observed their hard labor. He saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew, one of his own people.
chapters.zh: 后来，摩西长大，他出去到他弟兄那里，看他们的重担，见一个埃及人打希伯来人的一个弟兄。

chapters.en: After looking this way and that and seeing no one, he struck down the Egyptian and hid his body in the sand.
chapters.zh: 他左右观看，见没有人，就把埃及人打死了，藏在沙土里。

chapters.en: The next day Moses went out and saw two Hebrews fighting. He asked the one in the wrong, “Why are you attacking your companion?”
chapters.zh: 第二天他出去，见有两个希伯来人争斗，就对那欺负人的说：「你为什么打你同族的人呢？」

chapters.en:
But the man replied, “Who made you ruler and judge over us? Are you planning to kill me as you killed the Egyptian? ”
Then Moses was afraid and thought, “This thing I have done has surely become known.”
chapters.zh: 那人说：「谁立你作我们的首领和审判官呢？难道你要杀我，像杀那埃及人吗？」摩西便惧怕，说：「这事必是被人知道了。」

chapters.en: When Pharaoh heard about this matter, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from Pharaoh and settled in the land of Midian, where he sat down beside a well.
chapters.zh: 法老听见这事，就想杀摩西，但摩西躲避法老，逃往米甸地居住。

chapters.en: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters, and they came to draw water and fill the troughs to water their father’s flock.
chapters.zh: 一日，他在井旁坐下。米甸的祭司有七个女儿；她们来打水，打满了槽，要饮父亲的群羊。

chapters.en: And when some shepherds came along and drove them away, Moses rose up to help them and watered their flock.
chapters.zh: 有牧羊的人来，把她们赶走了，摩西却起来帮助她们，又饮了她们的群羊。

chapters.en: When the daughters returned to their father Reuel, he asked them, “Why have you returned so early today?”
chapters.zh: 她们来到父亲流珥那里；他说：「今日你们为何来得这么快呢？」

chapters.en: “An Egyptian rescued us from the shepherds,” they replied. “He even drew water for us and watered the flock.”
chapters.zh: 她们说：「有一个埃及人救我们脱离牧羊人的手，并且为我们打水饮了群羊。」

chapters.en: “So where is he?” their father asked. “Why did you leave the man behind? Invite him to have something to eat.”
chapters.zh: 他对女儿们说：「那个人在哪里？你们为什么撇下他呢？你们去请他来吃饭。」

chapters.en: Moses agreed to stay with the man, and he gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses in marriage.
chapters.zh: 摩西甘心和那人同住；那人把他的女儿西坡拉给摩西为妻。

chapters.en: And she gave birth to a son, and Moses named him Gershom, saying, “I have become a foreigner in a foreign land.”
chapters.zh: 西坡拉生了一个儿子，摩西给他起名叫革舜，意思说：「因我在外邦作了寄居的。」

chapters.en: After a long time, the king of Egypt died. The Israelites groaned and cried out under their burden of slavery, and their cry for deliverance from bondage ascended to God.
chapters.zh: 过了多年，埃及王死了。以色列人因做苦工，就叹息哀求，他们的哀声达于上帝。

chapters.en: So God heard their groaning, and He remembered His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
chapters.zh: 上帝听见他们的哀声，就记念他与亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所立的约。

chapters.en: God saw the Israelites and took notice.
chapters.zh: 上帝看顾以色列人，也知道他们的〔苦情〕。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Moses was shepherding the flock of his father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian. He led the flock to the far side of the wilderness and came to Horeb, the mountain of God.
chapters.zh: 摩西牧养他岳父米甸祭司叶忒罗的羊群；一日领羊群往野外去，到了上帝的山，就是何烈山。

chapters.en: There the angel of the LORD appeared to him in a blazing fire from within a bush. Moses saw the bush ablaze with fire, but it was not consumed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者从荆棘里火焰中向摩西显现。摩西观看，不料，荆棘被火烧着，却没有烧毁。

chapters.en: So Moses thought, “I must go over and see this marvelous sight. Why is the bush not burning up?”
chapters.zh: 摩西说：「我要过去看这大异象，这荆棘为何没有烧坏呢？」

chapters.en:
When the LORD saw that he had gone over to look, God called out to him from within the bush, “Moses, Moses!”
“Here I am,” he answered.
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝见他过去要看，就从荆棘里呼叫说：「摩西！摩西！」他说：「我在这里。」

chapters.en: “Do not come any closer,” God said. “Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.”
chapters.zh: 上帝说：「不要近前来。当把你脚上的鞋脱下来，因为你所站之地是圣地」；

chapters.en:
Then He said, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.”
At this, Moses hid his face, for he was afraid to look at God.
chapters.zh: 又说：「我是你父亲的上帝，是亚伯拉罕的上帝，以撒的上帝，雅各的上帝。」摩西蒙上脸，因为怕看上帝。

chapters.en: The LORD said, “I have indeed seen the affliction of My people in Egypt. I have heard them crying out because of their oppressors, and I am aware of their sufferings.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我的百姓在埃及所受的困苦，我实在看见了；他们因受督工的辖制所发的哀声，我也听见了。我原知道他们的痛苦，

chapters.en: I have come down to rescue them from the hand of the Egyptians and to bring them up out of that land to a good and spacious land, a land flowing with milk and honey—the home of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
chapters.zh: 我下来是要救他们脱离埃及人的手，领他们出了那地，到美好、宽阔、流奶与蜜之地，就是到迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人之地。

chapters.en: And now the cry of the Israelites has reached Me, and I have seen how severely the Egyptians are oppressing them.
chapters.zh: 现在以色列人的哀声达到我耳中，我也看见埃及人怎样欺压他们。

chapters.en: Therefore, go! I am sending you to Pharaoh to bring My people the Israelites out of Egypt.”
chapters.zh: 故此，我要打发你去见法老，使你可以将我的百姓以色列人从埃及领出来。」

chapters.en: But Moses asked God, “Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh and bring the Israelites out of Egypt?”
chapters.zh: 摩西对上帝说：「我是什么人，竟能去见法老，将以色列人从埃及领出来呢？」

chapters.en: “I will surely be with you,” God said, “and this will be the sign to you that I have sent you: When you have brought the people out of Egypt, all of you will worship God on this mountain.”
chapters.zh: 上帝说：「我必与你同在。你将百姓从埃及领出来之后，你们必在这山上事奉我；这就是我打发你去的证据。」

chapters.en: Then Moses asked God, “Suppose I go to the Israelites and say to them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is His name?’ What should I tell them?”
chapters.zh: 摩西对上帝说：「我到以色列人那里，对他们说：『你们祖宗的上帝打发我到你们这里来。』他们若问我说：『他叫什么名字？』我要对他们说什么呢？」

chapters.en: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
chapters.zh: 上帝对摩西说：「我是自有永有的」；又说：「你要对以色列人这样说：『那自有的打发我到你们这里来。』」

chapters.en: God also told Moses, “Say to the Israelites, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob—has sent me to you.’ This is My name forever, and this is how I am to be remembered in every generation.
chapters.zh: 上帝又对摩西说：「你要对以色列人这样说：『耶和华－你们祖宗的上帝，就是亚伯拉罕的上帝，以撒的上帝，雅各的上帝，打发我到你们这里来。』耶和华是我的名，直到永远；这也是我的纪念，直到万代。

chapters.en: Go, assemble the elders of Israel and say to them, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers—the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—has appeared to me and said: I have surely attended to you and have seen what has been done to you in Egypt.
chapters.zh: 你去招聚以色列的长老，对他们说：『耶和华－你们祖宗的上帝，就是亚伯拉罕的上帝，以撒的上帝，雅各的上帝，向我显现，说：我实在眷顾了你们，我也〔看见〕埃及人怎样待你们。

chapters.en: And I have promised to bring you up out of your affliction in Egypt, into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites—a land flowing with milk and honey.’
chapters.zh: 我也说：要将你们从埃及的困苦中领出来，往迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的地去，就是到流奶与蜜之地。』

chapters.en: The elders of Israel will listen to what you say, and you must go with them to the king of Egypt and tell him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Now please let us take a three-day journey into the wilderness, so that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.’
chapters.zh: 他们必听你的话。你和以色列的长老要去见埃及王，对他说：『耶和华－希伯来人的上帝遇见了我们，现在求你容我们往旷野去，走三天的路程，为要祭祀耶和华－我们的上帝。』

chapters.en: But I know that the king of Egypt will not allow you to go unless a mighty hand compels him.
chapters.zh: 我知道虽用大能的手，埃及王也不容你们去。

chapters.en: So I will stretch out My hand and strike the Egyptians with all the wonders I will perform among them. And after that, he will release you.
chapters.zh: 我必伸手在埃及中间施行我一切的奇事，攻击那地，然后他才容你们去。

chapters.en: And I will grant this people such favor in the sight of the Egyptians that when you leave, you will not go away empty-handed.
chapters.zh: 我必叫你们在埃及人眼前蒙恩，你们去的时候就不至于空手而去。

chapters.en: Every woman shall ask her neighbor and any woman staying in her house for silver and gold jewelry and clothing, and you will put them on your sons and daughters. So you will plunder the Egyptians.”
chapters.zh: 但各妇女必向她的邻舍，并居住在她家里的女人，要金器银器和衣裳，好给你们的儿女穿戴。这样你们就把埃及人的〔财物〕夺去了。」

chapters.en: Then Moses answered, “What if they do not believe me or listen to my voice? For they may say, ‘The LORD has not appeared to you.’”
chapters.zh: 摩西回答说：「他们必不信我，也不听我的话，必说：『耶和华并没有向你显现。』」

chapters.en:
And the LORD asked him, “What is that in your hand?”
“A staff,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「你手里是什么？」他说：「是杖。」

chapters.en: “Throw it on the ground,” said the LORD. So Moses threw it on the ground, and it became a snake, and he ran from it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「丢在地上。」他一丢下去，就变作蛇；摩西便跑开。

chapters.en: “Stretch out your hand and grab it by the tail,” the LORD said to Moses, who reached out his hand and caught the snake, and it turned back into a staff in his hand.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「伸出手来，拿住牠的尾巴，牠必在你手中仍变为杖；

chapters.en: “This is so that they may believe that the LORD, the God of their fathers—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob—has appeared to you.”
chapters.zh: 如此好叫他们信耶和华－他们祖宗的上帝，就是亚伯拉罕的上帝，以撒的上帝，雅各的上帝，是向你显现了。」

chapters.en: Furthermore, the LORD said to Moses, “Put your hand inside your cloak. ” So he put his hand inside his cloak, and when he took it out, his hand was leprous, white as snow.
chapters.zh: 耶和华又对他说：「把手放在怀里。」他就把手放在怀里，及至抽出来，不料，手长了大痲疯，有雪〔那样〕白。

chapters.en:
“Put your hand back inside your cloak,” said the LORD.
So Moses put his hand back inside his cloak, and when he took it out, it was restored, like the rest of his skin.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「再把手放在怀里。」他就再把手放在怀里，及至从怀里抽出来，不料，手已经复原，与周身的肉一样；

chapters.en: And the LORD said, “If they refuse to believe you or heed the witness of the first sign, they may believe that of the second.
chapters.zh: 又说：「倘或他们不听你的话，也不信头一个神迹，他们必信第二个神迹。

chapters.en: But if they do not believe even these two signs or listen to your voice, take some water from the Nile and pour it on the dry ground. Then the water you take from the Nile will become blood on the ground.”
chapters.zh: 这两个神迹若都不信，也不听你的话，你就从河里取些水，倒在旱地上，你从河里取的水必在旱地上变作血。」

chapters.en: “Please, Lord,” Moses replied, “I have never been eloquent, neither in the past nor since You have spoken to Your servant, for I am slow of speech and tongue.”
chapters.zh: 摩西对耶和华说：「主啊，我素日不是能言的人，就是从你对仆人说话以后，也是这样。我本是拙口笨舌的。」

chapters.en: And the LORD said to him, “Who gave man his mouth? Or who makes the mute or the deaf, the sighted or the blind? Is it not I, the LORD?
chapters.zh: 耶和华对他说：「谁造人的口呢？谁使人口哑、耳聋、目明、眼瞎呢？岂不是我－耶和华吗？

chapters.en: Now go! I will help you as you speak, and I will teach you what to say.”
chapters.zh: 现在去吧，我必赐你口才，指教你所当说的话。」

chapters.en: But Moses replied, “Please, Lord, send someone else.”
chapters.zh: 摩西说：「主啊，你愿意打发谁，就打发谁去吧！」

chapters.en: Then the anger of the LORD burned against Moses, and He said, “Is not Aaron the Levite your brother? I know that he can speak well, and he is now on his way to meet you. When he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.
chapters.zh: 耶和华向摩西发怒说：「不是有你的哥哥利未人亚伦吗？我知道他是能言的；现在他出来迎接你，他一见你，心里就欢喜。

chapters.en: You are to speak to him and put the words in his mouth. I will help both of you to speak, and I will teach you what to do.
chapters.zh: 你要将当说的话传给他；我也要赐你和他口才，又要指教你们所当行的事。

chapters.en: He will speak to the people for you. He will be your spokesman, and it will be as if you were God to him.
chapters.zh: 他要替你对百姓说话；你要以他当作口，他要以你当作上帝。

chapters.en: But take this staff in your hand so you can perform signs with it.”
chapters.zh: 你手里要拿这杖，好行神迹。」

chapters.en:
Then Moses went back to his father-in-law Jethro and said to him, “Please let me return to my brothers in Egypt to see if they are still alive.”
“Go in peace,” Jethro replied.
chapters.zh: 于是，摩西回到他岳父叶忒罗那里，对他说：「求你容我回去见我在埃及的弟兄，看他们还在不在。」叶忒罗对摩西说：「你可以平平安安地去吧！」

chapters.en: Now the LORD had said to Moses in Midian, “Go back to Egypt, for all the men who sought to kill you are dead.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华在米甸对摩西说：「你要回埃及去，因为寻索你命的人都死了。」

chapters.en: So Moses took his wife and sons, put them on a donkey, and headed back to Egypt. And he took the staff of God in his hand.
chapters.zh: 摩西就带着妻子和两个儿子，叫他们骑上驴，回埃及地去。摩西手里拿着上帝的杖。

chapters.en: The LORD instructed Moses, “When you go back to Egypt, see that you perform before Pharaoh all the wonders that I have put within your power. But I will harden his heart so that he will not let the people go.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「你回到埃及的时候，要留意将我指示你的一切奇事行在法老面前。但我要使〔注：或译：任凭；下同〕他的心刚硬，他必不容百姓去。

chapters.en: Then tell Pharaoh that this is what the LORD says: ‘Israel is My firstborn son,
chapters.zh: 你要对法老说：『耶和华这样说：以色列是我的儿子，我的长子。

chapters.en: and I told you to let My son go so that he may worship Me. But since you have refused to let him go, behold, I will kill your firstborn son!’”
chapters.zh: 我对你说过：容我的儿子去，好事奉我。你还是不肯容他去。看哪，我要杀你的长子。』」

chapters.en: Now at a lodging place along the way, the LORD met Moses and was about to kill him.
chapters.zh: 摩西在路上住宿的地方，耶和华遇见他，想要杀他。

chapters.en: But Zipporah took a flint knife, cut off her son’s foreskin, and touched it to Moses’ feet. “Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me,” she said.
chapters.zh: 西坡拉就拿一块火石，割下他儿子的阳皮，丢在摩西脚前，说：「你真是我的血郎了。」

chapters.en: So the LORD let him alone. (When she said, “bridegroom of blood,” she was referring to the circumcision.)
chapters.zh: 这样，耶和华才放了他。西坡拉说：「你因割礼就是血郎了。」

chapters.en: Meanwhile, the LORD had said to Aaron, “Go and meet Moses in the wilderness.” So he went and met Moses at the mountain of God and kissed him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对亚伦说：「你往旷野去迎接摩西。」他就去，在上帝的山遇见摩西，和他亲嘴。

chapters.en: And Moses told Aaron everything the LORD had sent him to say, and all the signs He had commanded him to perform.
chapters.zh: 摩西将耶和华打发他所说的言语和嘱咐他所行的神迹都告诉了亚伦。

chapters.en: Then Moses and Aaron went and assembled all the elders of the Israelites,
chapters.zh: 摩西、亚伦就去招聚以色列的众长老。

chapters.en:
and Aaron relayed everything the LORD had said to Moses.
And Moses performed the signs before the people,
chapters.zh: 亚伦将耶和华对摩西所说的一切话述说了一遍，又在百姓眼前行了那些神迹，

chapters.en: and they believed. And when they heard that the LORD had attended to the Israelites and had seen their affliction, they bowed down and worshiped.
chapters.zh: 百姓就信了。以色列人听见耶和华眷顾他们，鉴察他们的困苦，就低头下拜。

chapters.en: After that, Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Let My people go, so that they may hold a feast to Me in the wilderness.’”
chapters.zh: 后来摩西、亚伦去对法老说：「耶和华－以色列的上帝这样说：『容我的百姓去，在旷野向我守节。』」

chapters.en: But Pharaoh replied, “Who is the LORD that I should obey His voice and let Israel go? I do not know the LORD, and I will not let Israel go.”
chapters.zh: 法老说：「耶和华是谁，使我听他的话，容以色列人去呢？我不认识耶和华，也不容以色列人去！」

chapters.en: “The God of the Hebrews has met with us,” they answered. “Please let us go on a three-day journey into the wilderness to sacrifice to the LORD our God, or He may strike us with plagues or with the sword.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「希伯来人的上帝遇见了我们。求你容我们往旷野去，走三天的路程，祭祀耶和华－我们的上帝，免得他用瘟疫、刀兵攻击我们。」

chapters.en: But the king of Egypt said to them, “Moses and Aaron, why do you draw the people away from their work? Get back to your labor!”
chapters.zh: 埃及王对他们说：「摩西、亚伦！你们为什么叫百姓旷工呢？你们去担你们的担子吧！」

chapters.en: Pharaoh also said, “Look, the people of the land are now numerous, and you would be stopping them from their labor.”
chapters.zh: 又说：「看哪，这地的以色列人如今众多，你们竟叫他们歇下担子！」

chapters.en: That same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their foremen:
chapters.zh: 当天，法老吩咐督工的和官长说：

chapters.en: “You shall no longer supply the people with straw for making bricks. They must go and gather their own straw.
chapters.zh: 「你们不可照常把草给百姓做砖，叫他们自己去捡草。

chapters.en: But require of them the same quota of bricks as before; do not reduce it. For they are lazy; that is why they are crying out, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to our God.’
chapters.zh: 他们素常做砖的数目，你们仍旧向他们要，一点不可减少；因为他们是懒惰的，所以呼求说：『容我们去祭祀我们的上帝。』

chapters.en: Make the work harder on the men so they will be occupied and pay no attention to these lies.”
chapters.zh: 你们要把更重的工夫加在这些人身上，叫他们劳碌，不听虚谎的言语。」

chapters.en: So the taskmasters and foremen of the people went out and said to them, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I am no longer giving you straw.
chapters.zh: 督工的和官长出来对百姓说：「法老这样说：『我不给你们草。

chapters.en: Go and get your own straw wherever you can find it; but your workload will in no way be reduced.’”
chapters.zh: 你们自己在哪里能找草，就往那里去找吧！但你们的工一点不可减少。』」

chapters.en: So the people scattered all over the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
chapters.zh: 于是百姓散在埃及遍地，捡碎诩当作草。

chapters.en: The taskmasters kept pressing them, saying, “Fulfill your quota each day, just as you did when straw was provided.”
chapters.zh: 督工的催着说：「你们一天当完一天的工，与先前有草一样。」

chapters.en: Then the Israelite foremen, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over the people, were beaten and asked, “Why have you not fulfilled your quota of bricks yesterday or today, as you did before?”
chapters.zh: 法老督工的，责打他所派以色列人的官长，说：「你们昨天今天为什么没有照向来的数目做砖、完你们的工作呢？」

chapters.en: So the Israelite foremen went and appealed to Pharaoh: “Why are you treating your servants this way?
chapters.zh: 以色列人的官长就来哀求法老说：「为什么这样待你的仆人？

chapters.en: No straw has been given to your servants, yet we are told, ‘Make bricks!’ Look, your servants are being beaten, but the fault is with your own people.”
chapters.zh: 督工的不把草给仆人，并且对我们说：『做砖吧！』看哪，你仆人挨了打，其实是你百姓的错。」

chapters.en: “You are slackers!” Pharaoh replied. “Slackers! That is why you keep saying, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to the LORD.’
chapters.zh: 但法老说：「你们是懒惰的！你们是懒惰的！所以说：『容我们去祭祀耶和华。』

chapters.en: Now get to work. You will be given no straw, yet you must deliver the full quota of bricks.”
chapters.zh: 现在你们去做工吧！草是不给你们的，砖却要如数交纳。」

chapters.en: The Israelite foremen realized they were in trouble when they were told, “You must not reduce your daily quota of bricks.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人的官长听说「你们每天做砖的工作一点不可减少」，就知道是遭遇祸患了。

chapters.en: When they left Pharaoh, they confronted Moses and Aaron, who stood waiting to meet them.
chapters.zh: 他们离了法老出来，正遇见摩西、亚伦站在对面，

chapters.en: “May the LORD look upon you and judge you,” the foremen said, “for you have made us a stench before Pharaoh and his officials; you have placed in their hand a sword to kill us!”
chapters.zh: 就向他们说：「愿耶和华鉴察你们，施行判断；因你们使我们在法老和他臣仆面前有了臭名，把刀递在他们手中杀我们。」

chapters.en: So Moses returned to the LORD and asked, “Lord, why have You brought trouble upon this people? Is this why You sent me?
chapters.zh: 摩西回到耶和华那里，说：「主啊，你为什么苦待这百姓呢？为什么打发我去呢？

chapters.en: Ever since I went to Pharaoh to speak in Your name, he has brought trouble on this people, and You have not delivered Your people in any way.”
chapters.zh: 自从我去见法老，奉你的名说话，他就苦待这百姓，你一点也没有拯救他们。」

chapters.en: But the LORD said to Moses, “Now you will see what I will do to Pharaoh, for because of My mighty hand he will let the people go; because of My strong hand he will drive them out of his land.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「现在你必看见我向法老所行的事，使他因我大能的手容以色列人去，且把他们赶出他的地。」

chapters.en: God also told Moses, “I am the LORD.
chapters.zh: 上帝晓谕摩西说：「我是耶和华。

chapters.en: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob as God Almighty, but by My name the LORD I did not make Myself known to them.
chapters.zh: 我从前向亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各显现为全能的上帝；至于我名耶和华，他们未曾知道。

chapters.en: I also established My covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan, the land where they lived as foreigners.
chapters.zh: 我与他们坚定所立的约，要把他们寄居的迦南地赐给他们。

chapters.en: Furthermore, I have heard the groaning of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians are enslaving, and I have remembered My covenant.
chapters.zh: 我也听见以色列人被埃及人苦待的哀声，我也记念我的约。

chapters.en: Therefore tell the Israelites: ‘I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians and deliver you from their bondage. I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with mighty acts of judgment.
chapters.zh: 所以你要对以色列人说：『我是耶和华；我要用伸出来的膀臂重重地刑罚埃及人，救赎你们脱离他们的重担，不做他们的苦工。

chapters.en: I will take you as My own people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who brought you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians.
chapters.zh: 我要以你们为我的百姓，我也要作你们的上帝。你们要知道我是耶和华－你们的上帝，是救你们脱离埃及人之重担的。

chapters.en: And I will bring you into the land that I swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will give it to you as a possession. I am the LORD!’”
chapters.zh: 我起誓应许给亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的那地，我要把你们领进去，将那地赐给你们为业。我是耶和华。』」

chapters.en: Moses relayed this message to the Israelites, but on account of their broken spirit and cruel bondage, they did not listen to him.
chapters.zh: 摩西将这话告诉以色列人，只是他们因苦工愁烦，不肯听他的话。

chapters.en: So the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “Go and tell Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the Israelites go out of his land.”
chapters.zh: 「你进去对埃及王法老说，要容以色列人出他的地。」

chapters.en: But in the LORD’s presence Moses replied, “If the Israelites will not listen to me, then why would Pharaoh listen to me, since I am unskilled in speech? ”
chapters.zh: 摩西在耶和华面前说：「以色列人尚且不听我的话，法老怎肯听我这拙口笨舌的人呢？」

chapters.en: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron and gave them a charge concerning both the Israelites and Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西、亚伦往以色列人和埃及王法老那里去，把以色列人从埃及地领出来。

chapters.en:
These were the heads of their fathers’ houses:
The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, were Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi. These were the clans of Reuben.
chapters.zh: 以色列人家长的名字记在下面。以色列长子吕便的儿子是哈诺、法路、希斯伦、迦米；这是吕便的各家。

chapters.en: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanite woman. These were the clans of Simeon.
chapters.zh: 西缅的儿子是耶母利、雅悯、阿辖、雅斤、琐辖，和迦南女子的儿子扫罗；这是西缅的各家。

chapters.en: These were the names of the sons of Levi according to their records: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. Levi lived 137 years.
chapters.zh: 利未众子的名字按着他们的后代记在下面：就是革顺、哥辖、米拉利。利未一生的岁数是一百三十七岁。

chapters.en: The sons of Gershon were Libni and Shimei, by their clans.
chapters.zh: 革顺的儿子按着家室是立尼、示每。

chapters.en: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. Kohath lived 133 years.
chapters.zh: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛。哥辖一生的岁数是一百三十三岁。

chapters.en:
The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi.
These were the clans of the Levites according to their records.
chapters.zh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利和母示；这是利未的家，都按着他们的后代。

chapters.en: And Amram married his father’s sister Jochebed, and she bore him Aaron and Moses. Amram lived 137 years.
chapters.zh: 暗兰娶了他父亲的妹妹约基别为妻，她给他生了亚伦和摩西。暗兰一生的岁数是一百三十七岁。

chapters.en: The sons of Izhar were Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri.
chapters.zh: 以斯哈的儿子是可拉、尼斐、细基利。

chapters.en: The sons of Uzziel were Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
chapters.zh: 乌薛的儿子是米沙利、以利撒反、西提利。

chapters.en: And Aaron married Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon, and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
chapters.zh: 亚伦娶了亚米拿达的女儿，拿顺的妹妹，以利沙巴为妻，她给他生了拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。

chapters.en: The sons of Korah were Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph. These were the clans of the Korahites.
chapters.zh: 可拉的儿子是亚惜、以利加拿、亚比亚撒；这是可拉的各家。

chapters.en:
Aaron’s son Eleazar married one of the daughters of Putiel, and she bore him Phinehas.
These were the heads of the Levite families by their clans.
chapters.zh: 亚伦的儿子以利亚撒娶了普铁的一个女儿为妻，她给他生了非尼哈。这是利未人的家长，都按着他们的家。

chapters.en: It was this Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, “Bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt by their divisions.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「将以色列人按着他们的军队从埃及地领出来。」这是对那亚伦、摩西说的。

chapters.en: Moses and Aaron were the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt in order to bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 对埃及王法老说要将以色列人从埃及领出来的，就是这摩西、亚伦。

chapters.en: Now on the day that the LORD spoke to Moses in Egypt,
chapters.zh: 当耶和华在埃及地对摩西说话的日子，

chapters.en: He said to him, “I am the LORD; tell Pharaoh king of Egypt everything I say to you.”
chapters.zh: 他向摩西说：「我是耶和华；我对你说的一切话，你都要告诉埃及王法老。」

chapters.en: But in the LORD’s presence Moses replied, “Since I am unskilled in speech, why would Pharaoh listen to me?”
chapters.zh: 摩西在耶和华面前说：「看哪，我是拙口笨舌的人，法老怎肯听我呢？」

chapters.en: The LORD answered Moses, “See, I have made you like God to Pharaoh, and your brother Aaron will be your prophet.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「我使你在法老面前代替上帝，你的哥哥亚伦是替你说话的。

chapters.en: You are to speak all that I command you, and your brother Aaron is to tell Pharaoh to let the Israelites go out of his land.
chapters.zh: 凡我所吩咐你的，你都要说。你的哥哥亚伦要对法老说，容以色列人出他的地。

chapters.en: But I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and though I will multiply My signs and wonders in the land of Egypt,
chapters.zh: 我要使法老的心刚硬，也要在埃及地多行神迹奇事。

chapters.en:
Pharaoh will not listen to you.
Then I will lay My hand on Egypt, and by mighty acts of judgment I will bring the divisions of My people the Israelites out of the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 但法老必不听你们；我要伸手重重地刑罚埃及，将我的军队以色列民从埃及地领出来。

chapters.en: And the Egyptians will know that I am the LORD, when I stretch out My hand against Egypt and bring the Israelites out from among them.”
chapters.zh: 我伸手攻击埃及，将以色列人从他们中间领出来的时候，埃及人就要知道我是耶和华。」

chapters.en: So Moses and Aaron did just as the LORD had commanded them.
chapters.zh: 摩西、亚伦这样行；耶和华怎样吩咐他们，他们就照样行了。

chapters.en: Moses was eighty years old and Aaron was eighty-three when they spoke to Pharaoh.
chapters.zh: 摩西、亚伦与法老说话的时候，摩西八十岁，亚伦八十三岁。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西、亚伦说：

chapters.en: “When Pharaoh tells you, ‘Perform a miracle,’ you are to say to Aaron, ‘Take your staff and throw it down before Pharaoh,’ and it will become a serpent. ”
chapters.zh: 「法老若对你们说：『你们行件奇事吧！』你就吩咐亚伦说：『把杖丢在法老面前，使杖变作蛇。』」

chapters.en: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and did just as the LORD had commanded. Aaron threw his staff down before Pharaoh and his officials, and it became a serpent.
chapters.zh: 摩西、亚伦进去见法老，就照耶和华所吩咐的行。亚伦把杖丢在法老和臣仆面前，杖就变作蛇。

chapters.en: But Pharaoh called the wise men and sorcerers and magicians of Egypt, and they also did the same things by their magic arts.
chapters.zh: 于是法老召了博士和术士来；他们是埃及行法术的，也用邪术照样而行。

chapters.en: Each one threw down his staff, and it became a serpent. But Aaron’s staff swallowed up the other staffs.
chapters.zh: 他们各人丢下自己的杖，杖就变作蛇；但亚伦的杖吞了他们的杖。

chapters.en: Still, Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he would not listen to them, just as the LORD had said.
chapters.zh: 法老心里刚硬，不肯听从摩西、亚伦，正如耶和华所说的。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is unyielding; he refuses to let the people go.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「法老心里固执，不肯容百姓去。

chapters.en: Go to Pharaoh in the morning as you see him walking out to the water. Wait on the bank of the Nile to meet him, and take in your hand the staff that was changed into a snake.
chapters.zh: 明日早晨，他出来往水边去，你要往河边迎接他，手里要拿着那变过蛇的杖，

chapters.en: Then say to him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to tell you: Let My people go, so that they may worship Me in the wilderness. But until now you have not listened.
chapters.zh: 对他说：『耶和华－希伯来人的上帝打发我来见你，说：容我的百姓去，好在旷野事奉我。到如今你还是不听。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: By this you will know that I am the LORD. Behold, with the staff in my hand I will strike the water of the Nile, and it will turn to blood.
chapters.zh: 耶和华这样说：我要用我手里的杖击打河中的水，水就变作血；因此，你必知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: The fish in the Nile will die, the river will stink, and the Egyptians will be unable to drink its water.’”
chapters.zh: 河里的鱼必死，河也要腥臭，埃及人就要厌恶吃这河里的水。』」

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Take your staff and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt—over their rivers and canals and ponds and all the reservoirs—that they may become blood.’ There will be blood throughout the land of Egypt, even in the vessels of wood and stone.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：「你对亚伦说：『把你的杖伸在埃及所有的水以上，就是在他们的江、河、池、塘以上，叫水都变作血。在埃及遍地，无论在木器中，石器中，都必有血。』」

chapters.en: Moses and Aaron did just as the LORD had commanded; in the presence of Pharaoh and his officials, Aaron raised the staff and struck the water of the Nile, and all the water was turned to blood.
chapters.zh: 摩西、亚伦就照耶和华所吩咐的行。亚伦在法老和臣仆眼前举杖击打河里的水，河里的水都变作血了。

chapters.en: The fish in the Nile died, and the river smelled so bad that the Egyptians could not drink its water. And there was blood throughout the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 河里的鱼死了，河也腥臭了，埃及人就不能吃这河里的水；埃及遍地都有了血。

chapters.en: But the magicians of Egypt did the same things by their magic arts. So Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the LORD had said.
chapters.zh: 埃及行法术的，也用邪术照样而行。法老心里刚硬，不肯听摩西、亚伦，正如耶和华所说的。

chapters.en: Instead, Pharaoh turned around, went into his palace, and did not take any of this to heart.
chapters.zh: 法老转身进宫，也不把这事放在心上。

chapters.en: So all the Egyptians dug around the Nile for water to drink, because they could not drink the water from the river.
chapters.zh: 埃及人都在河的两边挖地，要得水喝，因为他们不能喝这河里的水。

chapters.en: And seven full days passed after the LORD had struck the Nile.
chapters.zh: 耶和华击打河以后满了七天。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go to Pharaoh and tell him that this is what the LORD says: ‘Let My people go, so that they may worship Me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「你进去见法老，对他说：『耶和华这样说：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。

chapters.en: But if you refuse to let them go, I will plague your whole country with frogs.
chapters.zh: 你若不肯容他们去，我必使青蛙糟蹋你的四境。

chapters.en: The Nile will teem with frogs, and they will come into your palace and up to your bedroom and onto your bed, into the houses of your officials and your people, and into your ovens and kneading bowls.
chapters.zh: 河里要滋生青蛙；这青蛙要上来进你的宫殿和你的卧房，上你的床榻，进你臣仆的房屋，上你百姓的身上，进你的炉訿和你的抟面盆，

chapters.en: The frogs will come up on you and your people and all your officials.’”
chapters.zh: 又要上你和你百姓并你众臣仆的身上。』」

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your staff over the rivers and canals and ponds, and cause the frogs to come up onto the land of Egypt.’”
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：「你对亚伦说：『把你的杖伸在江、河、池以上，使青蛙到埃及地上来。』」

chapters.en: So Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs came up and covered the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 亚伦便伸杖在埃及的诸水以上，青蛙就上来，遮满了埃及地。

chapters.en: But the magicians did the same thing by their magic arts, and they also brought frogs up onto the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 行法术的也用他们的邪术照样而行，叫青蛙上了埃及地。

chapters.en: Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, “Pray to the LORD to take the frogs away from me and my people. Then I will let your people go, that they may sacrifice to the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 法老召了摩西、亚伦来，说：「请你们求耶和华使这青蛙离开我和我的民，我就容百姓去祭祀耶和华。」

chapters.en: Moses said to Pharaoh, “You may have the honor over me. When shall I pray for you and your officials and your people that the frogs (except for those in the Nile) may be taken away from you and your houses?”
chapters.zh: 摩西对法老说：「任凭你吧，我要何时为你和你的臣仆并你的百姓祈求，除灭青蛙离开你和你的宫殿只留在河里呢？」

chapters.en:
“Tomorrow,” Pharaoh answered.
“May it be as you say,” Moses replied, “so that you may know that there is no one like the LORD our God.
chapters.zh: 他说：「明天。」摩西说：「可以照你的话吧，好叫你知道没有像耶和华－我们上帝的。

chapters.en: The frogs will depart from you and your houses and your officials and your people; they will remain only in the Nile.”
chapters.zh: 青蛙要离开你和你的宫殿，并你的臣仆与你的百姓，只留在河里。」

chapters.en: After Moses and Aaron had left Pharaoh, Moses cried out to the LORD for help with the frogs that He had brought against Pharaoh.
chapters.zh: 于是摩西、亚伦离开法老出去。摩西为扰害法老的青蛙呼求耶和华。

chapters.en: And the LORD did as Moses requested, and the frogs in the houses, the courtyards, and the fields died.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就照摩西的话行。凡在房里、院中、田间的青蛙都死了。

chapters.en: They were piled into countless heaps, and there was a terrible stench in the land.
chapters.zh: 众人把青蛙聚拢成堆，遍地就都腥臭。

chapters.en: When Pharaoh saw that there was relief, however, he hardened his heart and would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the LORD had said.
chapters.zh: 但法老见灾祸松缓，就硬着心，不肯听他们，正如耶和华所说的。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your staff and strike the dust of the earth, that it may turn into swarms of gnats throughout the land of Egypt.’”
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「你对亚伦说：『伸出你的杖击打地上的尘土，使尘土在埃及遍地变作虱子〔注：或译：虼蚤；下同〕。』」

chapters.en: This they did, and when Aaron stretched out his hand with his staff and struck the dust of the earth, gnats came upon man and beast. All the dust of the earth turned into gnats throughout the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 他们就这样行。亚伦伸杖击打地上的尘土，就在人身上和牲畜身上有了虱子；埃及遍地的尘土都变成虱子了。

chapters.en: The magicians tried to produce gnats using their magic arts, but they could not. And the gnats remained on man and beast.
chapters.zh: 行法术的也用邪术要生出虱子来，却是不能。于是在人身上和牲畜身上都有了虱子。

chapters.en: “This is the finger of God,” the magicians said to Pharaoh. But Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he would not listen to them, just as the LORD had said.
chapters.zh: 行法术的就对法老说：「这是上帝的手段。」法老心里刚硬，不肯听摩西、亚伦，正如耶和华所说的。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Get up early in the morning, and when Pharaoh goes out to the water, stand before him and tell him that this is what the LORD says: ‘Let My people go, so that they may worship Me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「你清早起来，法老来到水边，你站在他面前，对他说：『耶和华这样说：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。

chapters.en: But if you will not let My people go, I will send swarms of flies upon you and your officials and your people and your houses. The houses of the Egyptians and even the ground where they stand will be full of flies.
chapters.zh: 你若不容我的百姓去，我要叫成群的苍蝇到你和你臣仆并你百姓的身上，进你的房屋，并且埃及人的房屋和他们所住的地都要满了成群的苍蝇。

chapters.en: But on that day I will give special treatment to the land of Goshen, where My people live; no swarms of flies will be found there. In this way you will know that I, the LORD, am in the land.
chapters.zh: 当那日，我必分别我百姓所住的歌珊地，使那里没有成群的苍蝇，好叫你知道我是天下的耶和华。

chapters.en: I will make a distinction between My people and your people. This sign will take place tomorrow.’”
chapters.zh: 我要将我的百姓和你的百姓分别出来。明天必有这神迹。』」

chapters.en: And the LORD did so. Thick swarms of flies poured into Pharaoh’s palace and into the houses of his officials. Throughout Egypt the land was ruined by swarms of flies.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就这样行。苍蝇成了大群，进入法老的宫殿，和他臣仆的房屋；埃及遍地就因这成群的苍蝇败坏了。

chapters.en: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, “Go, sacrifice to your God within this land.”
chapters.zh: 法老召了摩西、亚伦来，说：「你们去，在这地祭祀你们的上帝吧！」

chapters.en: But Moses replied, “It would not be right to do that, because the sacrifices we offer to the LORD our God would be detestable to the Egyptians. If we offer sacrifices that are detestable before the Egyptians, will they not stone us?
chapters.zh: 摩西说：「这样行本不相宜，因为我们要把埃及人所厌恶的祭祀耶和华－我们的上帝；若把埃及人所厌恶的在他们眼前献为祭，他们岂不拿石头打死我们吗？

chapters.en: We must make a three-day journey into the wilderness and sacrifice to the LORD our God as He commands us.”
chapters.zh: 我们要往旷野去，走三天的路程，照着耶和华－我们上帝所要吩咐我们的祭祀他。」

chapters.en: Pharaoh answered, “I will let you go and sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness, but you must not go very far. Now pray for me.”
chapters.zh: 法老说：「我容你们去，在旷野祭祀耶和华－你们的上帝；只是不要走得很远。求你们为我祈祷。」

chapters.en: “As soon as I leave you,” Moses said, “I will pray to the LORD, so that tomorrow the swarms of flies will depart from Pharaoh and his officials and his people. But Pharaoh must not act deceitfully again by refusing to let the people go and sacrifice to the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 摩西说：「我要出去求耶和华，使成群的苍蝇明天离开法老和法老的臣仆并法老的百姓；法老却不可再行诡诈，不容百姓去祭祀耶和华。」

chapters.en: Then Moses left Pharaoh and prayed to the LORD,
chapters.zh: 于是摩西离开法老去求耶和华。

chapters.en: and the LORD did as Moses requested. He removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh and his officials and his people; not one fly remained.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就照摩西的话行，叫成群的苍蝇离开法老和他的臣仆并他的百姓，一个也没有留下。
