chapters.zh: 当远离虚假的事。不可杀无辜和有义的人，因我必不以恶人为义。

chapters.en: Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the righteous.
chapters.zh: 不可受贿赂；因为贿赂能叫明眼人变瞎了，又能颠倒义人的话。

chapters.en: Do not oppress a foreign resident, since you yourselves know how it feels to be foreigners; for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 「不可欺压寄居的；因为你们在埃及地作过寄居的，知道寄居的心。」

chapters.en: For six years you are to sow your land and gather its produce,
chapters.zh: 「六年你要耕种田地，收藏土产，

chapters.en: but in the seventh year you must let it rest and lie fallow, so that the poor among your people may eat from the field and the wild animals may consume what they leave. Do the same with your vineyard and olive grove.
chapters.zh: 只是第七年要叫地歇息，不耕不种，使你民中的穷人有吃的；他们所剩下的，野兽可以吃。你的葡萄园和橄榄园也要照样办理。

chapters.en: For six days you are to do your work, but on the seventh day you must cease, so that your ox and your donkey may rest and the son of your maidservant may be refreshed, as well as the foreign resident.
chapters.zh: 「六日你要做工，第七日要安息，使牛、驴可以歇息，并使你婢女的儿子和寄居的都可以舒畅。

chapters.en: Pay close attention to everything I have said to you. You must not invoke the names of other gods; they must not be heard on your lips.
chapters.zh: 「凡我对你们说的话，你们要谨守。别神的名，你不可提，也不可从你口中传说。」

chapters.en: Three times a year you are to celebrate a feast to Me.
chapters.zh: 「一年三次，你要向我守节。

chapters.en: You are to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread as I commanded you: At the appointed time in the month of Abib you are to eat unleavened bread for seven days, because that was the month you came out of Egypt. No one may appear before Me empty-handed.
chapters.zh: 你要守除酵节，照我所吩咐你的，在亚笔月内所定的日期，吃无酵饼七天。谁也不可空手朝见我，因为你是这月出了埃及。

chapters.en:
You are also to keep the Feast of Harvest with the firstfruits of the produce from what you sow in the field.
And keep the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather your produce from the field.
chapters.zh: 又〔要守〕收割节，所收的是你田间所种、劳碌得来初熟之物。并在年底收藏，〔要守〕收藏节。

chapters.en: Three times a year all your males are to appear before the Lord GOD.
chapters.zh: 一切的男丁要一年三次朝见主耶和华。

chapters.en: You must not offer the blood of My sacrifices with anything leavened, nor may the fat of My feast remain until morning.
chapters.zh: 「不可将我祭牲的血和有酵的饼一同献上；也不可将我节上〔祭牲〕的脂油留到早晨。

chapters.en:
Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God.
You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.
chapters.zh: 「地里首先初熟之物要送到耶和华－你上帝的殿。 「不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。」

chapters.en: Behold, I am sending an angel before you to protect you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.
chapters.zh: 「看哪，我差遣使者在你前面，在路上保护你，领你到我所预备的地方去。

chapters.en: Pay attention to him and listen to his voice; do not defy him, for he will not forgive rebellion, since My Name is in him.
chapters.zh: 他是奉我名来的；你们要在他面前谨慎，听从他的话，不可惹〔注：或译：违背〕他，因为他必不赦免你们的过犯。

chapters.en: But if you will listen carefully to his voice and do everything I say, I will be an enemy to your enemies and a foe to your foes.
chapters.zh: 「你若实在听从他的话，照着我一切所说的去行，我就向你的仇敌作仇敌，向你的敌人作敌人。

chapters.en: For My angel will go before you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will annihilate them.
chapters.zh: 「我的使者要在你前面行，领你到亚摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、迦南人、希未人、耶布斯人那里去，我必将他们剪除。

chapters.en: You must not bow down to their gods or serve them or follow their practices. Instead, you are to demolish them and smash their sacred stones to pieces.
chapters.zh: 你不可跪拜他们的神，不可事奉他，也不可效法他们的行为，却要把神像尽行拆毁，打碎他们的柱像。

chapters.en: So you shall serve the LORD your God, and He will bless your bread and your water. And I will take away sickness from among you.
chapters.zh: 你们要事奉耶和华－你们的上帝，他必赐福与你的粮与你的水，也必从你们中间除去疾病。

chapters.en: No woman in your land will miscarry or be barren; I will fulfill the number of your days.
chapters.zh: 你境内必没有坠胎的，不生产的。我要使你满了你年日的数目。

chapters.en: I will send My terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter. I will make all your enemies turn and run.
chapters.zh: 凡你所到的地方，我要使那里的众民在你面前惊骇，扰乱，又要使你一切仇敌转背〔逃跑〕。

chapters.en: I will send the hornet before you to drive the Hivites and Canaanites and Hittites out of your way.
chapters.zh: 我要打发黄蜂飞在你前面，把希未人、迦南人、赫人撵出去。

chapters.en: I will not drive them out before you in a single year; otherwise the land would become desolate and wild animals would multiply against you.
chapters.zh: 我不在一年之内将他们从你面前撵出去，恐怕地成为荒凉，野地的兽多起来害你。

chapters.en: Little by little I will drive them out ahead of you, until you become fruitful and possess the land.
chapters.zh: 我要渐渐地将他们从你面前撵出去，等到你的人数加多，承受那地为业。

chapters.en: And I will establish your borders from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the Euphrates. For I will deliver the inhabitants into your hand, and you will drive them out before you.
chapters.zh: 我要定你的境界，从红海直到非利士海，又从旷野直到大河。我要将那地的居民交在你手中，你要将他们从你面前撵出去。

chapters.en: You shall make no covenant with them or with their gods.
chapters.zh: 不可和他们并他们的神立约。

chapters.en: They must not remain in your land, lest they cause you to sin against Me. For if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”
chapters.zh: 他们不可住在你的地上，恐怕他们使你得罪我。你若事奉他们的神，这必成为你的网罗。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD—you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of Israel’s elders—and you are to worship at a distance.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「你和亚伦、拿答、亚比户，并以色列长老中的七十人，都要上到我这里来，远远地下拜。

chapters.en: Moses alone shall approach the LORD, but the others must not come near. And the people may not go up with him.”
chapters.zh: 惟独你可以亲近耶和华；他们却不可亲近；百姓也不可和你一同上来。」

chapters.en: When Moses came and told the people all the words and ordinances of the LORD, they all responded with one voice: “All the words that the LORD has spoken, we will do.”
chapters.zh: 摩西下山，将耶和华的命令典章都述说与百姓听。众百姓齐声说：「耶和华所吩咐的，我们都必遵行。」

chapters.en:
And Moses wrote down all the words of the LORD.
Early the next morning he got up and built an altar at the base of the mountain, along with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.
chapters.zh: 摩西将耶和华的命令都写上。清早起来，在山下筑一座坛，按以色列十二支派立十二根柱子，

chapters.en: Then he sent out some young men of Israel, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as peace offerings to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 又打发以色列人中的少年人去献燔祭，又向耶和华献牛为平安祭。

chapters.en: Moses took half of the blood and put it in bowls, and the other half he splattered on the altar.
chapters.zh: 摩西将血一半盛在盆中，一半洒在坛上；

chapters.en: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it to the people, who replied, “All that the LORD has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient.”
chapters.zh: 又将约书念给百姓听。他们说：「耶和华所吩咐的，我们都必遵行。」

chapters.en: So Moses took the blood, splattered it on the people, and said, “This is the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words.”
chapters.zh: 摩西将血洒在百姓身上，说：「你看！这是立约的血，是耶和华按这一切话与你们立约〔的凭据〕。」

chapters.en: Then Moses went up with Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel,
chapters.zh: 摩西、亚伦、拿答、亚比户，并以色列长老中的七十人，都上了山。

chapters.en: and they saw the God of Israel. Under His feet was a work like a pavement made of sapphire, as clear as the sky itself.
chapters.zh: 他们看见以色列的上帝，他脚下仿佛有平铺的蓝宝石，如同天色明净。

chapters.en: But God did not lay His hand on the nobles of Israel; they saw Him, and they ate and drank.
chapters.zh: 他的手不加害在以色列的尊者身上。他们观看上帝；他们又吃又喝。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Come up to Me on the mountain and stay here, so that I may give you the tablets of stone, with the law and commandments I have written for their instruction.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「你上山到我这里来，住在这里，我要将石版并我所写的律法和诫命赐给你，使你可以教训百姓。」

chapters.en: So Moses set out with Joshua his attendant and went up on the mountain of God.
chapters.zh: 摩西和他的帮手约书亚起来，上了上帝的山。

chapters.en: And he said to the elders, “Wait here for us until we return to you. Aaron and Hur are here with you. Whoever has a dispute can go to them.”
chapters.zh: 摩西对长老说：「你们在这里等着，等到我们再回来，有亚伦、户珥与你们同在。凡有争讼的，都可以就近他们去。」

chapters.en: When Moses went up on the mountain, the cloud covered it,
chapters.zh: 摩西上山，有云彩把山遮盖。

chapters.en: and the glory of the LORD settled on Mount Sinai. For six days the cloud covered it, and on the seventh day the LORD called to Moses from within the cloud.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的荣耀停于西奈山；云彩遮盖山六天，第七天他从云中召摩西。

chapters.en: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like a consuming fire on the mountaintop in the eyes of the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的荣耀在山顶上，在以色列人眼前，形状如烈火。

chapters.en: Moses entered the cloud as he went up on the mountain, and he remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
chapters.zh: 摩西进入云中上山，在山上四十昼夜。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “Tell the Israelites to bring Me an offering. You are to receive My offering from every man whose heart compels him.
chapters.zh: 「你告诉以色列人当为我送礼物来；凡甘心乐意的，你们就可以收下归我。

chapters.en:
This is the offering you are to accept from them:
gold, silver, and bronze;
chapters.zh: 所要收的礼物：就是金、银、铜，

chapters.en:
blue, purple, and scarlet yarn;
fine linen and goat hair;
chapters.zh: 蓝色、紫色、朱红色〔线〕，细麻，山羊〔毛〕，

chapters.en:
ram skins dyed red and fine leather;
acacia wood;
chapters.zh: 染红的公羊皮，海狗皮，皂荚木，

chapters.en:
olive oil for the light;
spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;
chapters.zh: 点灯的油并做膏油和香的香料，

chapters.en: and onyx stones and gemstones to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.
chapters.zh: 红玛瑙与别样的宝石，可以镶嵌在以弗得和胸牌上。

chapters.en: And they are to make a sanctuary for Me, so that I may dwell among them.
chapters.zh: 又当为我造圣所，使我可以住在他们中间。

chapters.en: You must make the tabernacle and design all its furnishings according to the pattern I show you.
chapters.zh: 制造帐幕和其中的一切器具都要照我所指示你的样式。」

chapters.en: And they are to construct an ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
chapters.zh: 「要用皂荚木做一柜，长二肘半，宽一肘半，高一肘半。

chapters.en: Overlay it with pure gold both inside and out, and make a gold molding around it.
chapters.zh: 要里外包上精金，四围镶上金牙边。

chapters.en: Cast four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet, two rings on one side and two on the other.
chapters.zh: 也要铸四个金环，安在柜的四脚上；这边两环，那边两环。

chapters.en: And make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
chapters.zh: 要用皂荚木做两根杠，用金包裹。

chapters.en: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, in order to carry it.
chapters.zh: 要把杠穿在柜旁的环内，以便抬柜。

chapters.en: The poles are to remain in the rings of the ark; they must not be removed.
chapters.zh: 这杠要常在柜的环内，不可抽出来。

chapters.en: And place inside the ark the Testimony, which I will give you.
chapters.zh: 必将我所要赐给你的法〔版〕放在柜里。

chapters.en: And you are to construct a mercy seat of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
chapters.zh: 要用精金做施恩座〔注：施恩：或译蔽罪；下同〕，长二肘半，宽一肘半。

chapters.en: Make two cherubim of hammered gold at the ends of the mercy seat,
chapters.zh: 要用金子锤出两个基路伯来，安在施恩座的两头。

chapters.en: one cherub on one end and one on the other, all made from one piece of gold.
chapters.zh: 这头做一个基路伯，那头做一个基路伯，二基路伯要接连一块，在施恩座的两头。

chapters.en: And the cherubim are to have wings that spread upward, overshadowing the mercy seat. The cherubim are to face each other, looking toward the mercy seat.
chapters.zh: 二基路伯要高张翅膀，遮掩施恩座。基路伯要脸对脸，朝着施恩座。

chapters.en: Set the mercy seat atop the ark and put the Testimony that I will give you into the ark.
chapters.zh: 要将施恩座安在柜的上边，又将我所要赐给你的法〔版〕放在柜里。

chapters.en: And I will meet with you there above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the Testimony; I will speak with you about all that I command you regarding the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 我要在那里与你相会，又要从法柜施恩座上二基路伯中间，和你说我所要吩咐你传给以色列人的一切事。」

chapters.en: You are also to make a table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
chapters.zh: 「要用皂荚木做一张桌子，长二肘，宽一肘，高一肘半。

chapters.en: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it.
chapters.zh: 要包上精金，四围镶上金牙边。

chapters.en: And make a rim around it a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
chapters.zh: 桌子的四围各做一掌宽的横梁，横梁上镶着金牙边。

chapters.en: Make four gold rings for the table and fasten them to the four corners at its four legs.
chapters.zh: 要做四个金环，安在桌子的四角上，就是桌子四脚上的四角。

chapters.en: The rings are to be close to the rim, to serve as holders for the poles used to carry the table.
chapters.zh: 安环子的地方要挨近横梁，可以穿杠抬桌子。

chapters.en: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, so that the table may be carried with them.
chapters.zh: 要用皂荚木做两根杠，用金包裹，以便抬桌子。

chapters.en: You are also to make the plates and dishes, as well as the pitchers and bowls for pouring drink offerings. Make them out of pure gold.
chapters.zh: 要做桌子上的盘子、调羹，并奠〔酒〕的爵和瓶；这都要用精金制作。

chapters.en: And place the Bread of the Presence on the table before Me at all times.
chapters.zh: 又要在桌子上，在我面前，常摆陈设饼。」

chapters.en: Then you are to make a lampstand of pure, hammered gold. It shall be made of one piece, including its base and shaft, its cups, and its buds and petals.
chapters.zh: 「要用精金做一个灯台。灯台的座和干与杯、球、花，都要接连一块锤出来。

chapters.en: Six branches are to extend from the sides of the lampstand—three on one side and three on the other.
chapters.zh: 灯台两旁要杈出六个枝子：这旁三个，那旁三个。

chapters.en: There are to be three cups shaped like almond blossoms on the first branch, each with buds and petals, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches that extend from the lampstand.
chapters.zh: 这旁每枝上有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球，有花；那旁每枝上也有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球，有花。从灯台杈出来的六个枝子都是如此。

chapters.en: And on the lampstand there shall be four cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals.
chapters.zh: 灯台上有四个杯，形状像杏花，有球，有花。

chapters.en: For the six branches that extend from the lampstand, a bud must be under the first pair of branches, a bud under the second pair, and a bud under the third pair.
chapters.zh: 灯台每两个枝子以下有球与枝子接连一块。灯台出的六个枝子都是如此。

chapters.en: The buds and branches are to be all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.
chapters.zh: 球和枝子要接连一块，都是一块精金锤出来的。

chapters.en: Make seven lamps and set them up on the lampstand so that they illuminate the area in front of it.
chapters.zh: 要做灯台的七个灯盏。祭司要点这灯，使灯光对照。

chapters.en: The wick trimmers and their trays must be of pure gold.
chapters.zh: 灯台的蜡剪和蜡花盘也是要精金的。

chapters.en: The lampstand and all these utensils shall be made from a talent of pure gold.
chapters.zh: 做灯台和这一切的器具要用精金一他连得。

chapters.en: See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
chapters.zh: 要谨慎做这些物件，都要照着在山上指示你的样式。」

chapters.en: “You are to construct the tabernacle itself with ten curtains of finely spun linen, each with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and cherubim skillfully worked into them.
chapters.zh: 「你要用十幅幔子做帐幕。这些幔子要用撚的细麻和蓝色、紫色、朱红色〔线〕制造，并用巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。

chapters.en: Each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide —all curtains the same size.
chapters.zh: 每幅幔子要长二十八肘，宽四肘，幔子都要一样的尺寸。

chapters.en: Five of the curtains are to be joined together, and the other five joined as well.
chapters.zh: 这五幅幔子要幅幅相连；那五幅幔子也要幅幅相连。

chapters.en: Make loops of blue material on the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and do the same for the end curtain in the second set.
chapters.zh: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上要做蓝色的钮扣；在那相连的幔子末幅边上也要照样做。

chapters.en: Make fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set, so that the loops line up opposite one another.
chapters.zh: 要在这相连的幔子上做五十个钮扣；在那相连的幔子上也做五十个钮扣，都要两两相对。

chapters.en: Make fifty gold clasps as well, and join the curtains together with the clasps, so that the tabernacle will be a unit.
chapters.zh: 又要做五十个金钩，用钩使幔子相连，这才成了一个帐幕。

chapters.en: You are to make curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven curtains in all.
chapters.zh: 「你要用山羊〔毛〕织十一幅幔子，作为帐幕以上的罩棚。

chapters.en: Each of the eleven curtains is to be the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.
chapters.zh: 每幅幔子要长三十肘，宽四肘；十一幅幔子都要一样的尺寸。

chapters.en: Join five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another. Then fold the sixth curtain over double at the front of the tent.
chapters.zh: 要把五幅幔子连成一幅，又把六幅幔子连成一幅，这第六幅幔子要在罩棚的前面折上去。

chapters.en: Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and fifty loops along the edge of the corresponding curtain in the second set.
chapters.zh: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上要做五十个钮扣；在那相连的幔子〔末幅〕边上也做五十个钮扣。

chapters.en: Make fifty bronze clasps and put them through the loops to join the tent together as a unit.
chapters.zh: 又要做五十个铜钩，钩在钮扣中，使罩棚连成一个。

chapters.en: As for the overlap that remains of the tent curtains, the half curtain that is left over shall hang down over the back of the tabernacle.
chapters.zh: 罩棚的幔子所余那垂下来的半幅幔子，要垂在帐幕的后头。

chapters.en: And the tent curtains will be a cubit longer on either side, and the excess will hang over the sides of the tabernacle to cover it.
chapters.zh: 罩棚的幔子所余长的，这边一肘，那边一肘，要垂在帐幕的两旁，遮盖帐幕。

chapters.en: Also make a covering for the tent out of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of fine leather.
chapters.zh: 又要用染红的公羊皮做罩棚的盖；再用海狗皮做一层罩棚上的顶盖。

chapters.en: You are to construct upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
chapters.zh: 「你要用皂荚木做帐幕的竖板。

chapters.en: Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
chapters.zh: 每块要长十肘，宽一肘半；

chapters.en: Two tenons must be connected to each other for each frame. Make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
chapters.zh: 每块必有两榫相对。帐幕一切的板都要这样做。

chapters.en: Construct twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle,
chapters.zh: 帐幕的南面要做板二十块。

chapters.en: with forty silver bases under the twenty frames—two bases for each frame, one under each tenon.
chapters.zh: 在这二十块板底下要做四十个带卯的银座，两卯接这块板上的两榫，两卯接那块板上的两榫。

chapters.en: For the second side of the tabernacle, the north side, make twenty frames
chapters.zh: 帐幕第二面，就是北面，也要做板二十块

chapters.en: and forty silver bases—two bases under each frame.
chapters.zh: 和带卯的银座四十个；这板底下有两卯，那板底下也有两卯。

chapters.en: Make six frames for the rear of the tabernacle, the west side,
chapters.zh: 帐幕的后面，就是西面，要做板六块。

chapters.en: and two frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle,
chapters.zh: 帐幕后面的拐角要做板两块。

chapters.en: coupled together from bottom to top and fitted into a single ring. These will serve as the two corners.
chapters.zh: 板的下半截要双的，上半截要整的，直顶到第一个环子；两块都要这样做两个拐角。

chapters.en: So there are to be eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.
chapters.zh: 必有八块板和十六个带卯的银座；这板底下有两卯，那板底下也有两卯。

chapters.en: You are also to make five crossbars of acacia wood for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,
chapters.zh: 「你要用皂荚木做闩：为帐幕这面的板做五闩，

chapters.en: five for those on the other side, and five for those on the rear side of the tabernacle, to the west.
chapters.zh: 为帐幕那面的板做五闩，又为帐幕后面的板做五闩。

chapters.en: The central crossbar in the middle of the frames shall extend from one end to the other.
chapters.zh: 板腰间的中闩要从这一头通到那一头。

chapters.en: Overlay the frames with gold and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Also overlay the crossbars with gold.
chapters.zh: 板要用金子包裹，又要做板上的金环套闩；闩也要用金子包裹。

chapters.en: So you are to set up the tabernacle according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
chapters.zh: 要照着在山上指示你的样式立起帐幕。

chapters.en: Make a veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen, with cherubim skillfully worked into it.
chapters.zh: 「你要用蓝色、紫色、朱红色〔线〕，和撚的细麻织幔子，以巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。

chapters.en: Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood, overlaid with gold and standing on four silver bases.
chapters.zh: 要把幔子挂在四根包金的皂荚木柱子上，柱子上当有金钩，柱子安在四个带卯的银座上。

chapters.en: And hang the veil from the clasps and place the ark of the Testimony behind the veil. So the veil will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.
chapters.zh: 要使幔子垂在钩子下，把法柜抬进幔子内；这幔子要将圣所和至圣所隔开。

chapters.en: Put the mercy seat on the ark of the Testimony in the Most Holy Place.
chapters.zh: 又要把施恩座安在至圣所内的法柜上，

chapters.en: And place the table outside the veil on the north side of the tabernacle, and put the lampstand opposite the table, on the south side.
chapters.zh: 把桌子安在幔子外帐幕的北面；把灯台安在帐幕的南面，彼此相对。

chapters.en: For the entrance to the tent, you are to make a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen.
chapters.zh: 「你要拿蓝色、紫色、朱红色〔线〕，和撚的细麻，用绣花的手工织帐幕的门帘。

chapters.en: Make five posts of acacia wood for the curtain, overlay them with gold hooks, and cast five bronze bases for them.
chapters.zh: 要用皂荚木为帘子做五根柱子，用金子包裹。柱子上当有金钩；又要为柱子用铜铸造五个带卯的座。」

chapters.en: “You are to build an altar of acacia wood. The altar must be square, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high.
chapters.zh: 「你要用皂荚木做坛。这坛要四方的，长五肘，宽五肘，高三肘。

chapters.en: Make a horn on each of its four corners, so that the horns are of one piece, and overlay it with bronze.
chapters.zh: 要在坛的四拐角上做四个角，与坛接连一块，用铜把坛包裹。

chapters.en: Make all its utensils of bronze—its pots for removing ashes, its shovels, its sprinkling bowls, its meat forks, and its firepans.
chapters.zh: 要做盆，收去坛上的灰，又做铲子、盘子、肉锸子、火鼎；坛上一切的器具都用铜做。

chapters.en: Construct for it a grate of bronze mesh, and make a bronze ring at each of the four corners of the mesh.
chapters.zh: 要为坛做一个铜网，在网的四角上做四个铜环，

chapters.en: Set the grate beneath the ledge of the altar, so that the mesh comes halfway up the altar.
chapters.zh: 把网安在坛四面的围腰板以下，使网从下达到坛的半腰。

chapters.en: Additionally, make poles of acacia wood for the altar and overlay them with bronze.
chapters.zh: 又要用皂荚木为坛做杠，用铜包裹。

chapters.en: The poles are to be inserted into the rings so that the poles are on two sides of the altar when it is carried.
chapters.zh: 这杠要穿在坛两旁的环子内，用以抬坛。

chapters.en: Construct the altar with boards so that it is hollow. It is to be made just as you were shown on the mountain.
chapters.zh: 要用板做坛，坛是空的，都照着在山上指示你的样式做。」

chapters.en: You are also to make a courtyard for the tabernacle. On the south side of the courtyard make curtains of finely spun linen, a hundred cubits long on one side,
chapters.zh: 「你要做帐幕的院子。院子的南面要用撚的细麻做帷子，长一百肘。

chapters.en: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and silver hooks and bands on the posts.
chapters.zh: 帷子的柱子要二十根，带卯的铜座二十个。柱子上的钩子和杆子都要用银子做。

chapters.en: Likewise there are to be curtains on the north side, a hundred cubits long, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
chapters.zh: 北面也当有帷子，长一百肘，帷子的柱子二十根，带卯的铜座二十个。柱子上的钩子和杆子都要用银子做。

chapters.en: The curtains on the west side of the courtyard shall be fifty cubits wide, with ten posts and ten bases.
chapters.zh: 院子的西面当有帷子，宽五十肘，帷子的柱子十根，带卯的座十个。

chapters.en: The east side of the courtyard, toward the sunrise, is to be fifty cubits wide.
chapters.zh: 院子的东面要宽五十肘。

chapters.en: Make the curtains on one side fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases,
chapters.zh: 〔门〕这边的帷子要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，带卯的座三个。

chapters.en: and the curtains on the other side fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases.
chapters.zh: 〔门〕那边的帷子也要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，带卯的座三个。

chapters.en: The gate of the courtyard shall be twenty cubits long, with a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen. It shall have four posts and four bases.
chapters.zh: 院子的门当有帘子，长二十肘，要拿蓝色、紫色、朱红色〔线〕，和撚的细麻，用绣花的手工织成，柱子四根，带卯的座四个。

chapters.en: All the posts around the courtyard shall have silver bands, silver hooks, and bronze bases.
chapters.zh: 院子四围一切的柱子都要用银杆连络，柱子上的钩子要用银做，带卯的座要用铜做。

chapters.en: The entire courtyard shall be a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide, with curtains of finely spun linen five cubits high, and with bronze bases.
chapters.zh: 院子要长一百肘，宽五十肘，高五肘，帷子要用撚的细麻做，带卯的座要用铜做。

chapters.en: All the utensils of the tabernacle for every use, including all its tent pegs and the tent pegs of the courtyard, shall be made of bronze.
chapters.zh: 帐幕各样用处的器具，并帐幕一切的橛子，和院子里一切的橛子，都要用铜做。」

chapters.en: And you are to command the Israelites to bring you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to keep the lamps burning continually.
chapters.zh: 「你要吩咐以色列人，把那为点灯捣成的清橄榄油拿来给你，使灯常常点着。

chapters.en: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil that is in front of the Testimony, Aaron and his sons are to tend the lamps before the LORD from evening until morning. This is to be a permanent statute for the Israelites for the generations to come.
chapters.zh: 在会幕中法〔柜〕前的幔外，亚伦和他的儿子，从晚上到早晨，要在耶和华面前经理这灯。这要作以色列人世世代代永远的定例。」

chapters.en: “Next, have your brother Aaron brought to you from among the Israelites, along with his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, to serve Me as priests.
chapters.zh: 「你要从以色列人中，使你的哥哥亚伦和他的儿子拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛一同就近你，给我供祭司的职分。

chapters.en: Make holy garments for your brother Aaron, to give him glory and splendor.
chapters.zh: 你要给你哥哥亚伦做圣衣为荣耀，为华美。

chapters.en: You are to instruct all the skilled craftsmen, whom I have filled with a spirit of wisdom, to make garments for Aaron’s consecration, so that he may serve Me as priest.
chapters.zh: 又要吩咐一切心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的灵所充满的，给亚伦做衣服，使他分别为圣，可以给我供祭司的职分。

chapters.en: These are the garments that they shall make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban, and a sash. They are to make these holy garments for your brother Aaron and his sons, so that they may serve Me as priests.
chapters.zh: 所要做的就是胸牌、以弗得、外袍、杂色的内袍、冠冕、腰带，使你哥哥亚伦和他儿子〔穿〕这圣服，可以给我供祭司的职分。

chapters.en: They shall use gold, along with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen.
chapters.zh: 要用金〔线〕和蓝色、紫色、朱红色〔线〕，并细麻去做。

chapters.en: They are to make the ephod of finely spun linen embroidered with gold, and with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.
chapters.zh: 「他们要拿金〔线〕和蓝色、紫色、朱红色〔线〕，并撚的细麻，用巧匠的手工做以弗得。

chapters.en: It shall have two shoulder pieces attached at two of its corners, so it can be fastened.
chapters.zh: 以弗得当有两条肩带，接上两头，使它相连。

chapters.en: And the skillfully woven waistband of the ephod must be of one piece, of the same workmanship—with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.
chapters.zh: 其上巧工织的带子，要和以弗得一样的做法，用以束上，与以弗得接连一块，要用金〔线〕和蓝色、紫色、朱红色〔线〕，并撚的细麻做成。

chapters.en: Take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel:
chapters.zh: 要取两块红玛瑙，在上面刻以色列儿子的名字：

chapters.en: six of their names on one stone and the remaining six on the other, in the order of their birth.
chapters.zh: 六个名字在这块宝石上，六个名字在那块宝石上，都照他们生来的次序。

chapters.en: Engrave the names of the sons of Israel on the two stones the way a gem cutter engraves a seal. Then mount the stones in gold filigree settings.
chapters.zh: 要用刻宝石的手工，仿佛刻图书，按着以色列儿子的名字，刻这两块宝石，要镶在金槽上。

chapters.en: Fasten both stones on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel. Aaron is to bear their names on his two shoulders as a memorial before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 要将这两块宝石安在以弗得的两条肩带上，为以色列人做纪念石。亚伦要在两肩上担他们的名字，在耶和华面前作为纪念。

chapters.en: Fashion gold filigree settings
chapters.zh: 要用金子做二槽，

chapters.en: and two chains of pure gold, made of braided cord work; and attach these chains to the settings.
chapters.zh: 又拿精金，用拧工仿佛拧绳子，做两条鍊子，把这拧成的鍊子搭在二槽上。」

chapters.en: You are also to make a breastpiece of judgment with the same workmanship as the ephod. Construct it with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.
chapters.zh: 「你要用巧匠的手工做一个决断的胸牌。要和以弗得一样的做法：用金〔线〕和蓝色、紫色、朱红色〔线〕，并撚的细麻做成。

chapters.en: It must be square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.
chapters.zh: 这胸牌要四方的，叠为两层，长一虎口，宽一虎口。

chapters.en:
And mount on it a setting of gemstones, four rows of stones:
In the first row there shall be a ruby, a topaz, and an emerald;
chapters.zh: 要在上面镶宝石四行：第一行是红宝石、红璧玺、红玉；

chapters.en: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
chapters.zh: 第二行是绿宝石、蓝宝石、金钢石；

chapters.en: in the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
chapters.zh: 第三行是紫玛瑙、白玛瑙、紫晶；

chapters.en:
and in the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper.
Mount these stones in gold filigree settings.
chapters.zh: 第四行是水苍玉、红玛瑙、碧玉。这都要镶在金槽中。

chapters.en: The twelve stones are to correspond to the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.
chapters.zh: 这些宝石都要按着以色列十二个儿子的名字，仿佛刻图书，刻十二个支派的名字。

chapters.en: For the breastpiece, make braided chains like cords of pure gold.
chapters.zh: 要在胸牌上用精金拧成如绳的鍊子。

chapters.en: You are also to make two gold rings and fasten them to the two corners of the breastpiece.
chapters.zh: 在胸牌上也要做两个金环，安在胸牌的两头。

chapters.en: Then fasten the two gold chains to the two gold rings at the corners of the breastpiece,
chapters.zh: 要把那两条拧成的金鍊子，穿过胸牌两头的环子。

chapters.en: and fasten the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.
chapters.zh: 又要把鍊子的那两头接在两槽上，安在以弗得前面肩带上。

chapters.en: Make two more gold rings and attach them to the other two corners of the breastpiece, on the inside edge next to the ephod.
chapters.zh: 要做两个金环，安在胸牌的两头，在以弗得里面的边上。

chapters.en: Make two additional gold rings and attach them to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on its front, near its seam just above its woven waistband.
chapters.zh: 又要做两个金环，安在以弗得前面两条肩带的下边，挨近相接之处，在以弗得巧工织的带子以上。

chapters.en: The rings of the breastpiece shall be tied to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn, so that the breastpiece is above the waistband of the ephod and does not swing out from the ephod.
chapters.zh: 要用蓝细带子把胸牌的环子与以弗得的环子系住，使胸牌贴在以弗得巧工织的带子上，不可与以弗得离缝。

chapters.en: Whenever Aaron enters the Holy Place, he shall bear the names of the sons of Israel over his heart on the breastpiece of judgment, as a continual reminder before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 亚伦进圣所的时候，要将决断胸牌，就是刻着以色列儿子名字的，带在胸前，在耶和华面前常作纪念。

chapters.en: And place the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece of judgment, so that they will also be over Aaron’s heart whenever he comes before the LORD. Aaron will continually carry the judgment of the sons of Israel over his heart before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 又要将乌陵和土明放在决断的胸牌里；亚伦进到耶和华面前的时候，要带在胸前，在耶和华面前常将以色列人的决断牌带在胸前。」

chapters.en: You are to make the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth,
chapters.zh: 「你要做以弗得的外袍，颜色全是蓝的。

chapters.en: with an opening at its top in the center. Around the opening shall be a woven collar with an opening like that of a garment, so that it will not tear.
chapters.zh: 袍上要为头留一领口，口的周围织出领边来，仿佛铠甲的领口，免得破裂。

chapters.en: Make pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn all the way around the lower hem, with gold bells between them,
chapters.zh: 袍子周围底边上要用蓝色、紫色、朱红色〔线〕做石榴。在袍子周围的石榴中间要有金铃铛：

chapters.en: alternating the gold bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe.
chapters.zh: 一个金铃铛一个石榴，一个金铃铛一个石榴，在袍子周围的底边上。

chapters.en: Aaron must wear the robe whenever he ministers, and its sound will be heard when he enters or exits the sanctuary before the LORD, so that he will not die.
chapters.zh: 亚伦供职的时候要穿这袍子。他进圣所到耶和华面前，以及出来的时候，袍上的响声必被听见，使他不至于死亡。

chapters.en:
You are to make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it as on a seal:
HOLY TO THE LORD.
chapters.zh: 「你要用精金做一面牌，在上面按刻图书之法刻着『归耶和华为圣』。

chapters.en: Fasten to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban; it shall be on the front of the turban.
chapters.zh: 要用一条蓝细带子将牌系在冠冕的前面。

chapters.en: And it will be worn on Aaron’s forehead, so that he may bear the iniquity of the holy things that the sons of Israel consecrate with regard to all their holy gifts. It shall always be on his forehead, so that they may be acceptable before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这牌必在亚伦的额上，亚伦要担当干犯圣物〔条例〕的罪孽；这圣物是以色列人在一切的圣礼物上所分别为圣的。这牌要常在他的额上，使他们可以在耶和华面前蒙悦纳。

chapters.en: You are to weave the tunic with fine linen, make the turban of fine linen, and fashion an embroidered sash.
chapters.zh: 要用杂色细麻〔线〕织内袍，用细麻布做冠冕，又用绣花的手工做腰带。

chapters.en: Make tunics, sashes, and headbands for Aaron’s sons, to give them glory and splendor.
chapters.zh: 「你要为亚伦的儿子做内袍、腰带、裹头巾，为荣耀，为华美。

chapters.en: After you put these garments on your brother Aaron and his sons, anoint them, ordain them, and consecrate them so that they may serve Me as priests.
chapters.zh: 要把这些给你的哥哥亚伦和他的儿子穿戴，又要膏他们，将他们分别为圣，好给我供祭司的职分。

chapters.en: Make linen undergarments to cover their bare flesh, extending from waist to thigh.
chapters.zh: 要给他们做细麻布裤子，遮掩下体；裤子当从腰达到大腿。

chapters.en: Aaron and his sons must wear them whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister in the Holy Place, so that they will not incur guilt and die. This is to be a permanent statute for Aaron and his descendants.
chapters.zh: 亚伦和他儿子进入会幕，或就近坛，在圣所供职的时候必穿上，免得担罪而死。这要为亚伦和他的后裔作永远的定例。」

chapters.en: “Now this is what you are to do to consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve Me as priests: Take a young bull and two rams without blemish,
chapters.zh: 「你使亚伦和他儿子成圣，给我供祭司的职分，要如此行：取一只公牛犊，两只无残疾的公绵羊，

chapters.en: along with unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. Make them out of fine wheat flour,
chapters.zh: 无酵饼和调油的无酵饼，与抹油的无酵薄饼；这都要用细麦面做成。

chapters.en: put them in a basket, and present them in the basket, along with the bull and the two rams.
chapters.zh: 这饼要装在一个筐子里，连筐子带来，又把公牛和两只公绵羊牵来。

chapters.en: Then present Aaron and his sons at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.
chapters.zh: 要使亚伦和他儿子到会幕门口来，用水洗身。

chapters.en: Take the garments and clothe Aaron with the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod itself, and the breastplate. Fasten the ephod on him with its woven waistband.
chapters.zh: 要给亚伦穿上内袍和以弗得的外袍，并以弗得，又带上胸牌，束上以弗得巧工织的带子。

chapters.en: Put the turban on his head and attach the holy diadem to the turban.
chapters.zh: 把冠冕戴在他头上，将圣冠加在冠冕上，

chapters.en: Then take the anointing oil and anoint him by pouring it on his head.
chapters.zh: 就把膏油倒在他头上膏他。

chapters.en: Present his sons as well and clothe them with tunics.
chapters.zh: 要叫他的儿子来，给他们穿上内袍。

chapters.en: Wrap the sashes around Aaron and his sons and tie headbands on them. The priesthood shall be theirs by a permanent statute. In this way you are to ordain Aaron and his sons.
chapters.zh: 给亚伦和他儿子束上腰带，包上裹头巾，他们就凭永远的定例得了祭司的职任。又要将亚伦和他儿子分别为圣。

chapters.en: You are to present the bull at the front of the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on its head.
chapters.zh: 「你要把公牛牵到会幕前，亚伦和他儿子要按手在公牛的头上。

chapters.en: And you shall slaughter the bull before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
chapters.zh: 你要在耶和华面前，在会幕门口，宰这公牛。

chapters.en: Take some of the blood of the bull and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; then pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
chapters.zh: 要取些公牛的血，用指头抹在坛的四角上，把血都倒在坛脚那里。

chapters.en: Take all the fat that covers the entrails and the lobe of the liver, and both kidneys with the fat on them, and burn them on the altar.
chapters.zh: 要把一切盖脏的脂油与肝上的网子，并两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，都烧在坛上。

chapters.en: But burn the flesh of the bull and its hide and dung outside the camp; it is a sin offering.
chapters.zh: 只是公牛的皮、肉、粪都要用火烧在营外。这牛是赎罪祭。

chapters.en: Take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.
chapters.zh: 「你要牵一只公绵羊来，亚伦和他儿子要按手在这羊的头上。

chapters.en: You are to slaughter the ram, take its blood, and splatter it on all sides of the altar.
chapters.zh: 要宰这羊，把血洒在坛的周围。

chapters.en: Cut the ram into pieces, wash the entrails and legs, and place them with its head and other pieces.
chapters.zh: 要把羊切成块子，洗净五脏和腿，连块子带头，都放在一处。

chapters.en: Then burn the entire ram on the altar; it is a burnt offering to the LORD, a pleasing aroma, a food offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 要把全羊烧在坛上，是给耶和华献的燔祭，是献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。

chapters.en: Take the second ram, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on its head.
chapters.zh: 「你要将那一只公绵羊牵来，亚伦和他儿子要按手在羊的头上。

chapters.en: Slaughter the ram, take some of its blood, and put it on the right earlobes of Aaron and his sons, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Splatter the remaining blood on all sides of the altar.
chapters.zh: 你要宰这羊，取点血抹在亚伦的右耳垂上和他儿子的右耳垂上，又抹在他们右手的大拇指上和右脚的大拇指上；并要把血洒在坛的四围。

chapters.en: And take some of the blood on the altar and some of the anointing oil and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments, as well as on his sons and their garments. Then he and his garments will be consecrated, as well as his sons and their garments.
chapters.zh: 你要取点膏油和坛上的血，弹在亚伦和他的衣服上，并他儿子和他儿子的衣服上，他们和他们的衣服就一同成圣。

chapters.en: Take the fat from the ram, the fat tail, the fat covering the entrails, the lobe of the liver, both kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh (since this is a ram for ordination),
chapters.zh: 「你要取这羊的脂油和肥尾巴，并盖脏的脂油与肝上的网子，两个腰子和腰子上的脂油并右腿（这是承接圣职所献的羊）。

chapters.en: along with one loaf of bread, one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 再从耶和华面前装无酵饼的筐子中取一个饼，一个调油的饼和一个薄饼，

chapters.en: Put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and wave them before the LORD as a wave offering.
chapters.zh: 都放在亚伦的手上和他儿子的手上，作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇。

chapters.en: Then take them from their hands and burn them on the altar atop the burnt offering as a pleasing aroma before the LORD; it is a food offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 要从他们手中接过来，烧在耶和华面前坛上的燔祭上，是献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。

chapters.en: Take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s ordination and wave it before the LORD as a wave offering, and it will be your portion.
chapters.zh: 「你要取亚伦承接圣职所献公羊的胸，作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇，这就可以作你的分。

chapters.en: Consecrate for Aaron and his sons the breast of the wave offering that is waved and the thigh of the heave offering that is lifted up from the ram of ordination.
chapters.zh: 那摇祭的胸和举祭的腿，就是承接圣职所摇的、所举的，是归亚伦和他儿子的。这些你都要成为圣，

chapters.en: This will belong to Aaron and his sons as a regular portion from the Israelites, for it is the heave offering the Israelites will make to the LORD from their peace offerings.
chapters.zh: 作亚伦和他子孙从以色列人中永远所得的分，因为是举祭。这要从以色列人的平安祭中，作为献给耶和华的举祭。

chapters.en: The holy garments that belong to Aaron will belong to his sons after him, so they can be anointed and ordained in them.
chapters.zh: 「亚伦的圣衣要留给他的子孙，可以穿着受膏，又穿着承接圣职。

chapters.en: The son who succeeds him as priest and enters the Tent of Meeting to minister in the Holy Place must wear them for seven days.
chapters.zh: 他的子孙接续他当祭司的，每逢进会幕在圣所供职的时候，要穿七天。

chapters.en: You are to take the ram of ordination and boil its flesh in a holy place.
chapters.zh: 「你要将承接圣职所献公羊的肉煮在圣处。

chapters.en: At the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, Aaron and his sons are to eat the meat of the ram and the bread that is in the basket.
chapters.zh: 亚伦和他儿子要在会幕门口吃这羊的肉和筐内的饼。

chapters.en: They must eat those things by which atonement was made for their ordination and consecration. But no outsider may eat them, because these things are sacred.
chapters.zh: 他们吃那些赎罪之物，好承接圣职，使他们成圣；只是外人不可吃，因为这是圣物。

chapters.en: And if any of the meat of ordination or any bread is left until the morning, you are to burn up the remainder. It must not be eaten, because it is sacred.
chapters.zh: 那承接圣职所献的肉或饼，若有一点留到早晨，就要用火烧了，不可吃这物，因为是圣物。

chapters.en: This is what you are to do for Aaron and his sons based on all that I have commanded you, taking seven days to ordain them.
chapters.zh: 「你要这样照我一切所吩咐的，向亚伦和他儿子行承接圣职的礼七天。

chapters.en: Sacrifice a bull as a sin offering each day for atonement. Purify the altar by making atonement for it, and anoint it to consecrate it.
chapters.zh: 每天要献公牛一只为赎罪祭。你洁净坛的时候，坛就洁净了；且要用膏抹坛，使坛成圣。

chapters.en: For seven days you shall make atonement for the altar and consecrate it. Then the altar will become most holy; whatever touches the altar will be holy.
chapters.zh: 要洁净坛七天，使坛成圣，坛就成为至圣。凡挨着坛的都成为圣。」

chapters.en: This is what you are to offer regularly on the altar, each day: two lambs that are a year old.
chapters.zh: 「你每天所要献在坛上的就是两只一岁的羊羔；

chapters.en: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight.
chapters.zh: 早晨要献这一只，黄昏的时候要献那一只。

chapters.en: With the first lamb offer a tenth of an ephah of fine flour, mixed with a quarter hin of oil from pressed olives, and a drink offering of a quarter hin of wine.
chapters.zh: 和这一只羊羔同献的，要用细面〔伊法〕十分之一与捣成的油一欣四分之一调和，又用酒一欣四分之一作为奠祭。

chapters.en: And offer the second lamb at twilight with the same grain offering and drink offering as in the morning, as a pleasing aroma, a food offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 那一只羊羔要在黄昏的时候献上，照着早晨的素祭和奠祭的礼办理，作为献给耶和华馨香的火祭。

chapters.en: For the generations to come, this burnt offering shall be made regularly at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD, where I will meet you to speak with you.
chapters.zh: 这要在耶和华面前、会幕门口，作你们世世代代常献的燔祭。我要在那里与你们相会，和你们说话。

chapters.en: I will also meet with the Israelites there, and that place will be consecrated by My glory.
chapters.zh: 我要在那里与以色列人相会，〔会幕〕就要因我的荣耀成为圣。

chapters.en: So I will consecrate the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and I will consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve Me as priests.
chapters.zh: 我要使会幕和坛成圣，也要使亚伦和他的儿子成圣，给我供祭司的职分。

chapters.en: Then I will dwell among the Israelites and be their God.
chapters.zh: 我要住在以色列人中间，作他们的上帝。

chapters.en:
And they will know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt so that I might dwell among them.
I am the LORD their God.
chapters.zh: 他们必知道我是耶和华－他们的上帝，是将他们从埃及地领出来的，为要住在他们中间。我是耶和华－他们的上帝。」

chapters.en: “You are also to make an altar of acacia wood for the burning of incense.
chapters.zh: 「你要用皂荚木做一座烧香的坛。

chapters.en: It is to be square, a cubit long, a cubit wide, and two cubits high. Its horns must be of one piece.
chapters.zh: 这坛要四方的，长一肘，宽一肘，高二肘；坛的四角要与坛接连一块。

chapters.en: Overlay with pure gold the top and all the sides and horns, and make a molding of gold around it.
chapters.zh: 要用精金把坛的上面与坛的四围，并坛的四角，包裹；又要在坛的四围镶上金牙边。

chapters.en: And make two gold rings below the molding on opposite sides to hold the poles used to carry it.
chapters.zh: 要做两个金环安在牙子边以下，在坛的两旁，两根横撑上，作为穿杠的用处，以便抬坛。

chapters.en: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
chapters.zh: 要用皂荚木做杠，用金包裹。

chapters.en: Place the altar in front of the veil that is before the ark of the Testimony —before the mercy seat that is over the Testimony—where I will meet with you.
chapters.zh: 要把坛放在法柜前的幔子外，对着法〔柜〕上的施恩座，就是我要与你相会的地方。

chapters.en: And Aaron is to burn fragrant incense on it every morning when he tends the lamps.
chapters.zh: 亚伦在坛上要烧馨香料做的香；每早晨他收拾灯的时候，要烧这香。

chapters.en: When Aaron sets up the lamps at twilight, he must burn the incense perpetually before the LORD for the generations to come.
chapters.zh: 黄昏点灯的时候，他要在耶和华面前烧这香，作为世世代代常烧的香。

chapters.en: On this altar you must not offer unauthorized incense or a burnt offering or grain offering; nor are you to pour a drink offering on it.
chapters.zh: 在这坛上不可奉上异样的香，不可献燔祭、素祭，也不可浇上奠祭。

chapters.en: Once a year Aaron shall make atonement on the horns of the altar. Throughout your generations he shall make atonement on it annually with the blood of the sin offering of atonement. The altar is most holy to the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 亚伦一年一次要在坛的角上行赎罪之礼。他一年一次要用赎罪祭牲的血在坛上行赎罪之礼，作为世世代代的定例。这坛在耶和华面前为至圣。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “When you take a census of the Israelites to number them, each man must pay the LORD a ransom for his life when he is counted. Then no plague will come upon them when they are numbered.
chapters.zh: 「你要按以色列人被数的，计算总数，你数的时候，他们各人要为自己的生命把赎价奉给耶和华，免得数的时候在他们中间有灾殃。

chapters.en: Everyone who crosses over to those counted must pay a half shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs. This half shekel is an offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 凡过去归那些被数之人的，每人要按圣所的平，拿银子半舍客勒；这半舍客勒是奉给耶和华的礼物（一舍客勒是二十季拉）。

chapters.en: Everyone twenty years of age or older who crosses over must give this offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 凡过去归那些被数的人，从二十岁以外的，要将这礼物奉给耶和华。

chapters.en: In making the offering to the LORD to atone for your lives, the rich shall not give more than a half shekel, nor shall the poor give less.
chapters.zh: 他们为赎生命将礼物奉给耶和华，富足的不可多出，贫穷的也不可少出，各人要出半舍客勒。

chapters.en: Take the atonement money from the Israelites and use it for the service of the Tent of Meeting. It will serve as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD to make atonement for your lives.”
chapters.zh: 你要从以色列人收这赎罪银，作为会幕的使用，可以在耶和华面前为以色列人作纪念，赎生命。」

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “You are to make a bronze basin with a bronze stand for washing. Set it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it,
chapters.zh: 「你要用铜做洗濯盆和盆座，以便洗濯。要将盆放在会幕和坛的中间，在盆里盛水。

chapters.en: with which Aaron and his sons are to wash their hands and feet.
chapters.zh: 亚伦和他的儿子要在这盆里洗手洗脚。

chapters.en: Whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister by presenting a food offering to the LORD, they must wash with water so that they will not die.
chapters.zh: 他们进会幕，或是就近坛前供职给耶和华献火祭的时候，必用水洗濯，免得死亡。

chapters.en: Thus they are to wash their hands and feet so that they will not die; this shall be a permanent statute for Aaron and his descendants for the generations to come.”
chapters.zh: 他们洗手洗脚就免得死亡。这要作亚伦和他后裔世世代代永远的定例。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “Take the finest spices: 500 shekels of liquid myrrh, half that amount (250 shekels) of fragrant cinnamon, 250 shekels of fragrant cane,
chapters.zh: 「你要取上品的香料，就是流质的没药五百〔舍客勒〕，香肉桂一半，就是二百五十舍客勒，菖蒲二百五十舍客勒，

chapters.en: 500 shekels of cassia —all according to the sanctuary shekel—and a hin of olive oil.
chapters.zh: 桂皮五百舍客勒，都按着圣所的平，又取橄榄油一欣，

chapters.en: Prepare from these a sacred anointing oil, a fragrant blend, the work of a perfumer; it will be a sacred anointing oil.
chapters.zh: 按做香之法调和做成圣膏油。

chapters.en: Use this oil to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony,
chapters.zh: 要用这膏油抹会幕和法柜，

chapters.en: the table and all its utensils, the lampstand and its utensils, the altar of incense,
chapters.zh: 桌子与桌子的一切器具，灯台和灯台的器具，并香坛、

chapters.en: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the basin with its stand.
chapters.zh: 燔祭坛，和坛的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座。

chapters.en: You are to consecrate them so that they will be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.
chapters.zh: 要使这些物成为圣，好成为至圣；凡挨着的都成为圣。

chapters.en: Anoint Aaron and his sons and consecrate them to serve Me as priests.
chapters.zh: 要膏亚伦和他的儿子，使他们成为圣，可以给我供祭司的职分。

chapters.en: And you are to tell the Israelites, ‘This will be My sacred anointing oil for the generations to come.
chapters.zh: 你要对以色列人说：『这油，我要世世代代以为圣膏油。

chapters.en: It must not be used to anoint an ordinary man, and you must not make anything like it with the same formula. It is holy, and it must be holy to you.
chapters.zh: 不可倒在别人的身上，也不可按这调和之法做与此相似的。这膏油是圣的，你们也要以为圣。

chapters.en: Anyone who mixes perfume like it or puts it on an outsider shall be cut off from his people.’”
chapters.zh: 凡调和与此相似的，或将这膏膏在别人身上的，这人要从民中剪除。』」

chapters.en: The LORD also said to Moses, “Take fragrant spices—gum resin, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense—in equal measures,
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「你要取馨香的香料，就是拿他弗、施喜列、喜利比拿；这馨香的香料和净乳香各样要一般大的分量。

chapters.en: and make a fragrant blend of incense, the work of a perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.
chapters.zh: 你要用这些加上盐，按做香之法做成清净圣洁的香。

chapters.en: Grind some of it into fine powder and place it in front of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be most holy to you.
chapters.zh: 这香要取点捣得极细，放在会幕内、法〔柜〕前，我要在那里与你相会。你们要以这香为至圣。

chapters.en: You are never to use this formula to make incense for yourselves; you shall regard it as holy to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你们不可按这调和之法为自己做香；要以这香为圣，归耶和华。

chapters.en: Anyone who makes something like it to enjoy its fragrance shall be cut off from his people.”
chapters.zh: 凡做香和这香一样，为要闻香味的，这人要从民中剪除。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “See, I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
chapters.zh: 「看哪，犹大支派中，户珥的孙子、乌利的儿子比撒列，我已经提他的名召他。

chapters.en: And I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability, and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship,
chapters.zh: 我也以我的灵充满了他，使他有智慧，有聪明，有知识，能做各样的工，

chapters.en: to design artistic works in gold, silver, and bronze,
chapters.zh: 能想出巧工，用金、银、铜制造各物，

chapters.en: to cut gemstones for settings, and to carve wood, so that he may be a master of every craft.
chapters.zh: 又能刻宝石，可以镶嵌，能雕刻木头，能做各样的工。

chapters.en:
Moreover, I have selected Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, as his assistant.
I have also given skill to all the craftsmen, that they may fashion all that I have commanded you:
chapters.zh: 我分派但支派中、亚希撒抹的儿子亚何利亚伯与他同工。凡心里有智慧的，我更使他们有智慧，能做我一切所吩咐的，

chapters.en: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony and the mercy seat upon it, and all the other furnishings of the tent—
chapters.zh: 就是会幕和法柜，并其上的施恩座，与〔会〕幕中一切的器具，

chapters.en: the table with its utensils, the pure gold lampstand with all its utensils, the altar of incense,
chapters.zh: 桌子和桌子的器具，精〔金〕的灯台和灯台的一切器具并香坛，

chapters.en: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its stand—
chapters.zh: 燔祭坛和坛的一切器具，并洗濯盆与盆座，

chapters.en: as well as the woven garments, both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests,
chapters.zh: 精工做的礼服，和祭司亚伦并他儿子用以供祭司职分的圣衣，

chapters.en: in addition to the anointing oil and fragrant incense for the Holy Place. They are to make them according to all that I have commanded you.”
chapters.zh: 膏油和为圣所用馨香的香料。他们都要照我一切所吩咐的去做。」

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “Tell the Israelites, ‘Surely you must keep My Sabbaths, for this will be a sign between Me and you for the generations to come, so that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
chapters.zh: 「你要吩咐以色列人说：『你们务要守我的安息日；因为这是你我之间世世代代的证据，使你们知道我－耶和华是叫你们成为圣的。

chapters.en: Keep the Sabbath, for it is holy to you. Anyone who profanes it must surely be put to death. Whoever does any work on that day must be cut off from among his people.
chapters.zh: 所以你们要守安息日，以为圣日。凡干犯这日的，必要把他治死；凡在这日做工的，必从民中剪除。

chapters.en: For six days work may be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day must surely be put to death.
chapters.zh: 六日要做工，但第七日是安息圣日，是向耶和华守为圣的。凡在安息日做工的，必要把他治死。』

chapters.en: The Israelites must keep the Sabbath, celebrating it as a permanent covenant for the generations to come.
chapters.zh: 故此，以色列人要世世代代守安息日为永远的约。

chapters.en: It is a sign between Me and the Israelites forever; for in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, but on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed.’”
chapters.zh: 这是我和以色列人永远的证据；因为六日之内耶和华造天地，第七日便安息舒畅。」

chapters.en: When the LORD had finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, He gave him the two tablets of the Testimony, tablets of stone inscribed by the finger of God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在西奈山和摩西说完了话，就把两块法版交给他，是上帝用指头写的石版。

chapters.en: Now when the people saw that Moses was delayed in coming down from the mountain, they gathered around Aaron and said, “Come, make us gods who will go before us. As for this Moses who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him!”
chapters.zh: 百姓见摩西迟延不下山，就大家聚集到亚伦那里，对他说：「起来！为我们做神〔像〕，可以在我们前面引路；因为领我们出埃及地的那个摩西，我们不知道他遭了什么事。」

chapters.en: So Aaron told them, “Take off the gold earrings that are on your wives and sons and daughters, and bring them to me.”
chapters.zh: 亚伦对他们说：「你们去摘下你们妻子、儿女耳上的金环，拿来给我。」

chapters.en: Then all the people took off their gold earrings and brought them to Aaron.
chapters.zh: 百姓就都摘下他们耳上的金环，拿来给亚伦。

chapters.en: He took the gold from their hands, and with an engraving tool he fashioned it into a molten calf. And they said, “These, O Israel, are your gods, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt!”
chapters.zh: 亚伦从他们手里接过来，铸了一只牛犊，用雕刻的器具做成。他们就说：「以色列啊，这是领你出埃及地的神。」

chapters.en: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before the calf and proclaimed: “Tomorrow shall be a feast to the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 亚伦看见，就在牛犊面前筑坛，且宣告说：「明日要向耶和华守节。」

chapters.en: So the next day they arose, offered burnt offerings, and presented peace offerings. And the people sat down to eat and drink and got up to indulge in revelry.
chapters.zh: 次日清早，百姓起来献燔祭和平安祭，就坐下吃喝，起来玩耍。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go down at once, for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves.
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「下去吧，因为你的百姓，就是你从埃及地领出来的，已经败坏了。

chapters.en: How quickly they have turned aside from the way that I commanded them! They have made for themselves a molten calf and have bowed down to it. They have sacrificed to it and said, ‘These, O Israel, are your gods, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.’”
chapters.zh: 他们快快偏离了我所吩咐的道，为自己铸了一只牛犊，向它下拜献祭，说：『以色列啊，这就是领你出埃及地的神。』」

chapters.en: The LORD also said to Moses, “I have seen this people, and they are indeed a stiff-necked people.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「我看这百姓真是硬着颈项的百姓。

chapters.en: Now leave Me alone, so that My anger may burn against them and consume them. Then I will make you into a great nation.”
chapters.zh: 你且由着我，我要向他们发烈怒，将他们灭绝，使你的后裔成为大国。」

chapters.en: But Moses sought the favor of the LORD his God, saying, “O LORD, why does Your anger burn against Your people, whom You brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and a mighty hand?
chapters.zh: 摩西便恳求耶和华－他的上帝说：「耶和华啊，你为什么向你的百姓发烈怒呢？这百姓是你用大力和大能的手从埃及地领出来的。

chapters.en: Why should the Egyptians declare, ‘He brought them out with evil intent, to kill them in the mountains and wipe them from the face of the earth’? Turn from Your fierce anger and relent from doing harm to Your people.
chapters.zh: 为什么使埃及人议论说『他领他们出去，是要降祸与他们，把他们杀在山中，将他们从地上除灭』？求你转意，不发你的烈怒，后悔，不降祸与你的百姓。

chapters.en: Remember Your servants Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, to whom You swore by Your very self when You declared, ‘I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky, and I will give your descendants all this land that I have promised, and it shall be their inheritance forever.’”
chapters.zh: 求你记念你的仆人亚伯拉罕、以撒、以色列。你曾指着自己起誓说：『我必使你们的后裔像天上的星那样多，并且我所应许的这全地，必给你们的后裔，他们要永远承受为业。』」

chapters.en: So the LORD relented from the calamity He had threatened to bring on His people.
chapters.zh: 于是耶和华后悔，不把所说的祸降与他的百姓。

chapters.en: Then Moses turned and went down the mountain with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands. They were inscribed on both sides, front and back.
chapters.zh: 摩西转身下山，手里拿着两块法版。这版是两面写的，这面那面都有字，

chapters.en: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.
chapters.zh: 是上帝的工作，字是上帝写的，刻在版上。

chapters.en: When Joshua heard the sound of the people shouting, he said to Moses, “The sound of war is in the camp.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚一听见百姓呼喊的声音，就对摩西说：「在营里有争战的声音。」

chapters.en:
But Moses replied:
“It is neither the cry of victory nor the cry of defeat; I hear the sound of singing!”
chapters.zh: 摩西说：「这不是人打胜仗的声音，也不是人打败仗的声音；我所听见的乃是人歌唱的声音。」

chapters.en: As Moses approached the camp and saw the calf and the dancing, he burned with anger and threw the tablets out of his hands, shattering them at the base of the mountain.
chapters.zh: 摩西挨近营前就看见牛犊，又看见人跳舞，便发烈怒，把两块版扔在山下摔碎了，

chapters.en: Then he took the calf they had made, burned it in the fire, ground it to powder, and scattered the powder over the face of the water. Then he forced the Israelites to drink it.
chapters.zh: 又将他们所铸的牛犊用火焚烧，磨得粉碎，撒在水面上，叫以色列人喝。

chapters.en: “What did this people do to you,” Moses asked Aaron, “that you have led them into so great a sin?”
chapters.zh: 摩西对亚伦说：「这百姓向你做了什么？你竟使他们陷在大罪里！」

chapters.en: “Do not be enraged, my lord,” Aaron replied. “You yourself know that the people are intent on evil.
chapters.zh: 亚伦说：「求我主不要发烈怒。这百姓〔专于〕作恶，是你知道的。

chapters.en: They told me, ‘Make us gods who will go before us. As for this Moses who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him!’
chapters.zh: 他们对我说：『你为我们做神〔像〕，可以在我们前面引路；因为领我们出埃及地的那个摩西，我们不知道他遭了什么事。』

chapters.en: So I said to them, ‘Whoever has gold, let him take it off,’ and they gave it to me. And when I threw it into the fire, out came this calf!”
chapters.zh: 我对他们说：『凡有金环的可以摘下来』，他们就给了我。我把金环扔在火中，这牛犊便出来了。」

chapters.en: Moses saw that the people were out of control, for Aaron had let them run wild and become a laughingstock to their enemies.
chapters.zh: 摩西见百姓放肆（亚伦纵容他们，使他们在仇敌中间被讥刺），

chapters.en:
So Moses stood at the entrance to the camp and said, “Whoever is for the LORD, come to me.”
And all the Levites gathered around him.
chapters.zh: 就站在营门中，说：「凡属耶和华的，都〔要到〕我这里来！」于是利未的子孙都到他那里聚集。

chapters.en: He told them, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Each of you men is to fasten his sword to his side, go back and forth through the camp from gate to gate, and slay his brother, his friend, and his neighbor.’”
chapters.zh: 他对他们说：「耶和华－以色列的上帝这样说：『你们各人把刀跨在腰间，在营中往来，从这门到那门，各人杀他的弟兄与同伴并邻舍。』」

chapters.en: The Levites did as Moses commanded, and that day about three thousand of the people fell dead.
chapters.zh: 利未的子孙照摩西的话行了。那一天百姓中被杀的约有三千。

chapters.en: Afterward, Moses said, “Today you have been ordained for service to the LORD, since each man went against his son and his brother; so the LORD has bestowed a blessing on you this day.”
chapters.zh: 摩西说：「今天你们要自洁，归耶和华为圣，各人攻击他的儿子和弟兄，使耶和华赐福与你们。」

chapters.en: The next day Moses said to the people, “You have committed a great sin. Now I will go up to the LORD; perhaps I can make atonement for your sin.”
chapters.zh: 到了第二天，摩西对百姓说：「你们犯了大罪。我如今要上耶和华那里去，或者可以为你们赎罪。」

chapters.en: So Moses returned to the LORD and said, “Oh, what a great sin these people have committed! They have made gods of gold for themselves.
chapters.zh: 摩西回到耶和华那里，说：「唉！这百姓犯了大罪，为自己做了金像。

chapters.en: Yet now, if You would only forgive their sin.... But if not, please blot me out of the book that You have written.”
chapters.zh: 倘或你肯赦免他们的罪......不然，求你从你所写的册上涂抹我的名。」

chapters.en: The LORD replied to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against Me, I will blot out of My book.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「谁得罪我，我就从我的册上涂抹谁的名。

chapters.en: Now go, lead the people to the place I described. Behold, My angel shall go before you. But on the day I settle accounts, I will punish them for their sin.”
chapters.zh: 现在你去领这百姓，往我所告诉你的〔地方〕去，我的使者必在你前面引路；只是到我追讨的日子，我必追讨他们的罪。」

chapters.en: And the LORD sent a plague on the people because of what they had done with the calf that Aaron had made.
chapters.zh: 耶和华杀百姓的缘故是因他们同亚伦做了牛犊。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Leave this place, you and the people you brought up out of the land of Egypt, and go to the land that I promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob when I said, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「我曾起誓应许亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各说：『要将迦南地赐给你的后裔。』现在你和你从埃及地所领出来的百姓，要从这里往那地去。

chapters.en: And I will send an angel before you, and I will drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
chapters.zh: 我要差遣使者在你前面，撵出迦南人、亚摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，

chapters.en: Go up to a land flowing with milk and honey. But I will not go with you, because you are a stiff-necked people; otherwise, I might destroy you on the way.”
chapters.zh: 领你到那流奶与蜜之地。我自己不同你们上去；因为你们是硬着颈项的百姓，恐怕我在路上把你们灭绝。」

chapters.en: When the people heard this bad news, they went into mourning, and no one put on any of his jewelry.
chapters.zh: 百姓听见这凶信就悲哀，也没有人佩戴妆饰。

chapters.en: For the LORD had said to Moses, “Tell the Israelites, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I should go with you for a single moment, I would destroy you. Now take off your jewelry, and I will decide what to do with you.’”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「你告诉以色列人说：『〔耶和华说〕：你们是硬着颈项的百姓，我若一霎时临到你们中间，必灭绝你们。现在你们要把身上的妆饰摘下来，使我可以知道怎样待你们。』」

chapters.en: So the Israelites stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward.
chapters.zh: 以色列人从住何烈山以后，就把身上的妆饰摘得干净。

chapters.en: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it at a distance outside the camp. He called it the Tent of Meeting, and anyone inquiring of the LORD would go to the Tent of Meeting outside the camp.
chapters.zh: 摩西素常将帐棚支搭在营外，离营却远，他称这帐棚为会幕。凡求问耶和华的，就到营外的会幕那里去。

chapters.en: Then, whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people would stand at the entrances to their own tents and watch Moses until he entered the tent.
chapters.zh: 当摩西出营到〔会〕幕去的时候，百姓就都起来，各人站在自己帐棚的门口，望着摩西，直等到他进了〔会〕幕。

chapters.en: As Moses entered the tent, the pillar of cloud would come down and remain at the entrance, and the LORD would speak with Moses.
chapters.zh: 摩西进〔会〕幕的时候，云柱降下来，立在〔会〕幕的门前，〔耶和华〕便与摩西说话。

chapters.en: When all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance to the tent, they would stand up and worship, each one at the entrance to his own tent.
chapters.zh: 众百姓看见云柱立在〔会〕幕门前，就都起来，各人在自己帐棚的门口下拜。

chapters.en: Thus the LORD would speak to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. Then Moses would return to the camp, but his young assistant Joshua son of Nun would not leave the tent.
chapters.zh: 耶和华与摩西面对面说话，好像人与朋友说话一般。摩西转到营里去，惟有他的帮手－一个少年人嫩的儿子约书亚不离开〔会〕幕。

chapters.en: Then Moses said to the LORD, “Look, You have been telling me, ‘Lead this people up,’ but You have not let me know whom You will send with me. Yet You have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have found favor in My sight.’
chapters.zh: 摩西对耶和华说：「你吩咐我说：『将这百姓领上去』，却没有叫我知道你要打发谁与我同去，只说：『我按你的名认识你，你在我眼前也蒙了恩。』

chapters.en: Now if indeed I have found favor in Your sight, please let me know Your ways, that I may know You and find favor in Your sight. Remember that this nation is Your people.”
chapters.zh: 我如今若在你眼前蒙恩，求你将你的道指示我，使我可以认识你，好在你眼前蒙恩。求你想到这民是你的民。」

chapters.en: And the LORD answered, “My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我必亲自〔和你同〕去，使你得安息。」

chapters.en: “If Your Presence does not go with us,” Moses replied, “do not lead us up from here.
chapters.zh: 摩西说：「你若不亲自〔和我同〕去，就不要把我们从这里领上去。

chapters.en: For how then can it be known that Your people and I have found favor in Your sight, unless You go with us? How else will we be distinguished from all the other people on the face of the earth?”
chapters.zh: 人在何事上得以知道我和你的百姓在你眼前蒙恩呢？岂不是因你与我们同去、使我和你的百姓与地上的万民有分别吗？」

chapters.en: So the LORD said to Moses, “I will do this very thing you have asked, for you have found favor in My sight, and I know you by name.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「你这所求的我也要行；因为你在我眼前蒙了恩，并且我按你的名认识你。」

chapters.en: Then Moses said, “Please show me Your glory.”
chapters.zh: 摩西说：「求你显出你的荣耀给我看。」

chapters.en: “I will cause all My goodness to pass before you,” the LORD replied, “and I will proclaim My name—the LORD—in your presence. I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我要显我一切的恩慈，在你面前经过，宣告我的名。我要恩待谁就恩待谁；要怜悯谁就怜悯谁」；

chapters.en: But He added, “You cannot see My face, for no one can see Me and live.”
chapters.zh: 又说：「你不能看见我的面，因为人见我的面不能存活。」

chapters.en: The LORD continued, “There is a place near Me where you are to stand upon a rock,
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「看哪，在我这里有地方，你要站在磐石上。

chapters.en: and when My glory passes by, I will put you in a cleft of the rock and cover you with My hand until I have passed by.
chapters.zh: 我的荣耀经过的时候，我必将你放在磐石穴中，用我的手遮掩你，等我过去，

chapters.en: Then I will take My hand away, and you will see My back; but My face must not be seen.”
chapters.zh: 然后我要将我的手收回，你就得见我的背，却不得见我的面。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Chisel out two stone tablets like the originals, and I will write on them the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「你要凿出两块石版，和先前你摔碎的那版一样；其上的字我要写在这版上。

chapters.en: Be ready in the morning, and come up on Mount Sinai to present yourself before Me on the mountaintop.
chapters.zh: 明日早晨，你要预备好了，上西奈山，在山顶上站在我面前。

chapters.en: No one may go up with you; in fact, no one may be seen anywhere on the mountain—not even the flocks or herds may graze in front of the mountain.”
chapters.zh: 谁也不可和你一同上去，遍山都不可有人，在山根也不可叫羊群牛群吃草。」

chapters.en: So Moses chiseled out two stone tablets like the originals. He rose early in the morning, and taking the two stone tablets in his hands, he went up Mount Sinai as the LORD had commanded him.
chapters.zh: 摩西就凿出两块石版，和先前的一样。清晨起来，照耶和华所吩咐的上西奈山去，手里拿着两块石版。

chapters.en: And the LORD descended in a cloud, stood with him there, and proclaimed His name, the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在云中降临，和摩西一同站在那里，宣告耶和华的名。

chapters.en: Then the LORD passed in front of Moses and called out: “The LORD, the LORD God, is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness,
chapters.zh: 耶和华在他面前宣告〔说〕：「耶和华，耶和华，是有怜悯有恩典的上帝，不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱和诚实，

chapters.en: maintaining loving devotion to a thousand generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression, and sin. Yet He will by no means leave the guilty unpunished; He will visit the iniquity of the fathers on their children and grandchildren to the third and fourth generations.”
chapters.zh: 为千万人存留慈爱，赦免罪孽、过犯，和罪恶，万不以〔有罪的〕为无罪，必追讨他的罪，自父及子，直到三、四代。」

chapters.en: Moses immediately bowed down to the ground and worshiped.
chapters.zh: 摩西急忙伏地下拜，

chapters.en: “O Lord,” he said, “if I have indeed found favor in Your sight, my Lord, please go with us. Although this is a stiff-necked people, forgive our iniquity and sin, and take us as Your inheritance.”
chapters.zh: 说：「主啊，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你在我们中间同行，因为这是硬着颈项的百姓。又求你赦免我们的罪孽和罪恶，以我们为你的产业。」

chapters.en: And the LORD said, “Behold, I am making a covenant. Before all your people I will perform wonders that have never been done in any nation in all the world. All the people among whom you live will see the LORD’s work, for it is an awesome thing that I am doing with you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我要立约，要在百姓面前行奇妙的事，是在遍地万国中所未曾行的。在你四围的外邦人就要看见耶和华的作为，因我向你所行的是可畏惧的事。

chapters.en: Observe what I command you this day. I will drive out before you the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
chapters.zh: 「我今天所吩咐你的，你要谨守。我要从你面前撵出亚摩利人、迦南人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人。

chapters.en: Be careful not to make a treaty with the inhabitants of the land you are entering, lest they become a snare in your midst.
chapters.zh: 你要谨慎，不可与你所去那地的居民立约，恐怕成为你们中间的网罗；

chapters.en: Rather, you must tear down their altars, smash their sacred stones, and chop down their Asherah poles.
chapters.zh: 却要拆毁他们的祭坛，打碎他们的柱像，砍下他们的木偶。

chapters.en: For you must not worship any other god, for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.
chapters.zh: 不可敬拜别神；因为耶和华是忌邪的上帝，名为忌邪者。

chapters.en: Do not make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, for when they prostitute themselves to their gods and sacrifice to them, they will invite you, and you will eat their sacrifices.
chapters.zh: 只怕你与那地的居民立约，百姓随从他们的神，就行邪淫，祭祀他们的神，有人叫你，你便吃他的祭物，

chapters.en: And when you take some of their daughters as brides for your sons, their daughters will prostitute themselves to their gods and cause your sons to do the same.
chapters.zh: 又为你的儿子娶他们的女儿为妻，他们的女儿随从她们的神，就行邪淫，使你的儿子也随从她们的神行邪淫。

chapters.en: You shall make no molten gods for yourselves.
chapters.zh: 「不可为自己铸造神〔像〕。

chapters.en: You are to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread. For seven days at the appointed time in the month of Abib, you are to eat unleavened bread as I commanded you. For in the month of Abib you came out of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 「你要守除酵节，照我所吩咐你的，在亚笔月内所定的日期吃无酵饼七天，因为你是这亚笔月内出了埃及。

chapters.en: The first offspring of every womb belongs to Me, including all the firstborn males among your livestock, whether cattle or sheep.
chapters.zh: 凡头生的都是我的；一切牲畜头生的，无论是牛是羊，公的都是我的。

chapters.en: You must redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb; but if you do not redeem it, you are to break its neck. You must redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before Me empty-handed.
chapters.zh: 头生的驴要用羊羔代赎，若不代赎就要打折牠的颈项。凡头生的儿子都要赎出来。谁也不可空手朝见我。

chapters.en: Six days you shall labor, but on the seventh day you shall rest; even in the seasons of plowing and harvesting, you must rest.
chapters.zh: 「你六日要做工，第七日要安息，虽在耕种收割的时候也要安息。

chapters.en: And you are to celebrate the Feast of Weeks with the firstfruits of the wheat harvest, and the Feast of Ingathering at the turn of the year.
chapters.zh: 在收割初熟麦子的时候要守七七节；又在年底要守收藏节。

chapters.en: Three times a year all your males are to appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 你们一切男丁要一年三次朝见主耶和华－以色列的上帝。

chapters.en: For I will drive out the nations before you and enlarge your borders, and no one will covet your land when you go up three times a year to appear before the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 我要从你面前赶出外邦人，扩张你的境界。你一年三次上去朝见耶和华－你上帝的时候，必没有人贪慕你的地土。

chapters.en: Do not offer the blood of a sacrifice to Me along with anything leavened, and do not let any of the sacrifice from the Passover Feast remain until morning.
chapters.zh: 「你不可将我祭物的血和有酵的饼一同献上。逾越节的祭物也不可留到早晨。

chapters.en:
Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God.
You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.”
chapters.zh: 地里首先初熟之物要送到耶和华－你上帝的殿。不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。」

chapters.en: The LORD also said to Moses, “Write down these words, for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「你要将这些话写上，因为我是按这话与你和以色列人立约。」

chapters.en: So Moses was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant—the Ten Commandments.
chapters.zh: 摩西在耶和华那里四十昼夜，也不吃饭也不喝水。耶和华将这约的话，就是十条诫，写在两块版上。

chapters.en: And when Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands, he was unaware that his face had become radiant from speaking with the LORD.
chapters.zh: 摩西手里拿着两块法版下西奈山的时候，不知道自己的面皮因耶和华和他说话就发了光。

chapters.en: Aaron and all the Israelites looked at Moses, and behold, his face was radiant. And they were afraid to approach him.
chapters.zh: 亚伦和以色列众人看见摩西的面皮发光就怕挨近他。

chapters.en: But Moses called out to them; so Aaron and all the leaders of the congregation returned to him, and Moses spoke to them.
chapters.zh: 摩西叫他们来；于是亚伦和会众的官长都到他那里去，摩西就与他们说话。

chapters.en: And after this all the Israelites came near, and Moses commanded them to do everything that the LORD had told him on Mount Sinai.
chapters.zh: 随后以色列众人都近前来，他就把耶和华在西奈山与他所说的一切话都吩咐他们。

chapters.en: When Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil over his face.
chapters.zh: 摩西与他们说完了话就用帕子蒙上脸。

chapters.en: But whenever Moses went in before the LORD to speak with Him, he would remove the veil until he came out. And when he came out, he would tell the Israelites what he had been commanded,
chapters.zh: 但摩西进到耶和华面前与他说话就揭去帕子，及至出来的时候便将耶和华所吩咐的告诉以色列人。

chapters.en: and the Israelites would see that the face of Moses was radiant. So Moses would put the veil back over his face until he went in to speak with the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以色列人看见摩西的面皮发光。摩西又用帕子蒙上脸，等到他进去与耶和华说话〔就揭去帕子〕。

chapters.en: Then Moses assembled the whole congregation of Israel and said to them, “These are the things that the LORD has commanded you to do:
chapters.zh: 摩西招聚以色列全会众，对他们说：「这是耶和华所吩咐的话，叫你们照着行：

chapters.en: For six days work may be done, but the seventh day shall be your holy day, a Sabbath of complete rest to the LORD. Whoever does any work on that day must be put to death.
chapters.zh: 六日要做工，第七日乃为圣日，当向耶和华守为安息圣日。凡这日之内做工的，必把他治死。

chapters.en: Do not light a fire in any of your dwellings on the Sabbath day.”
chapters.zh: 当安息日，不可在你们一切的住处生火。」

chapters.en: Moses also told the whole congregation of Israel, “This is what the LORD has commanded:
chapters.zh: 摩西对以色列全会众说：「耶和华所吩咐的是这样：

chapters.en:
Take from among you an offering to the LORD. Let everyone whose heart is willing bring an offering to the LORD:
gold, silver, and bronze;
chapters.zh: 你们中间要拿礼物献给耶和华，凡乐意献的可以拿耶和华的礼物来，就是金、银、铜，

chapters.en:
blue, purple, and scarlet yarn;
fine linen and goat hair;
chapters.zh: 蓝色、紫色、朱红色〔线〕，细麻，山羊〔毛〕，

chapters.en:
ram skins dyed red and fine leather;
acacia wood;
chapters.zh: 染红的公羊皮，海狗皮，皂荚木，

chapters.en:
olive oil for the light;
spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;
chapters.zh: 点灯的油，并做膏油和香的香料，

chapters.en: and onyx stones and gemstones to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.
chapters.zh: 红玛瑙与别样的宝石，可以镶嵌在以弗得和胸牌上。」

chapters.en: Let every skilled craftsman among you come and make everything that the LORD has commanded:
chapters.zh: 「你们中间凡心里有智慧的都要来做耶和华一切所吩咐的：

chapters.en: the tabernacle with its tent and covering, its clasps and frames, its crossbars, posts, and bases;
chapters.zh: 就是帐幕和帐幕的罩棚，并帐幕的盖、钩子、板、闩、柱子、带卯的座，

chapters.en: the ark with its poles and mercy seat, and the veil to shield it;
chapters.zh: 柜和柜的杠，施恩座和遮掩〔柜〕的幔子，

chapters.en: the table with its poles, all its utensils, and the Bread of the Presence;
chapters.zh: 桌子和桌子的杠与桌子的一切器具，并陈设饼，

chapters.en: the lampstand for light with its accessories and lamps and oil for the light;
chapters.zh: 灯台和灯台的器具，灯盏并点灯的油，
香坛和坛的杠，膏油和馨香的香料，并帐幕门口的帘子，

chapters.en:
the altar of burnt offering with its bronze grate, its poles, and all its utensils;
the basin with its stand;
chapters.zh: 燔祭坛和坛的铜网，坛的杠并坛的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座，

chapters.en: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases, and the curtain for the gate of the courtyard;
chapters.zh: 院子的帷子和帷子的柱子，带卯的座和院子的门帘，

chapters.en: the tent pegs for the tabernacle and for the courtyard, along with their ropes;
chapters.zh: 帐幕的橛子并院子的橛子，和这两处的绳子，

chapters.en: and the woven garments for ministering in the holy place—both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests.”
chapters.zh: 精工做的礼服和祭司亚伦并他儿子在圣所用以供祭司职分的圣衣。」

chapters.en: Then the whole congregation of Israel withdrew from the presence of Moses.
chapters.zh: 以色列全会众从摩西面前退去。

chapters.en: And everyone whose heart stirred him and whose spirit prompted him came and brought an offering to the LORD for the work on the Tent of Meeting, for all its services, and for the holy garments.
chapters.zh: 凡心里受感和甘心乐意的都拿耶和华的礼物来，用以做会幕和其中一切的使用，又用以做圣衣。

chapters.en: So all who had willing hearts, both men and women, came and brought brooches and earrings, rings and necklaces, and all kinds of gold jewelry. And they all presented their gold as a wave offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 凡心里乐意献礼物的，连男带女，各将金器，就是胸前鍼、耳环〔注：或译：鼻环〕、打印的戒指，和手钏带来献给耶和华。

chapters.en: Everyone who had blue, purple, or scarlet yarn, or fine linen, goat hair, ram skins dyed red, or articles of fine leather, brought them.
chapters.zh: 凡有蓝色、紫色、朱红色〔线〕，细麻，山羊〔毛〕，染红的公羊皮，海狗皮的，都拿了来；

chapters.en: And all who could present an offering of silver or bronze brought it as a contribution to the LORD. Also, everyone who had acacia wood for any part of the service brought it.
chapters.zh: 凡献银子和铜给耶和华为礼物的都拿了来；凡有皂荚木可做什么使用的也拿了来。

chapters.en: Every skilled woman spun with her hands and brought what she had spun: blue, purple, or scarlet yarn, or fine linen.
chapters.zh: 凡心中有智慧的妇女亲手纺线，把所纺的蓝色、紫色、朱红色〔线〕，和细麻都拿了来。

chapters.en: And all the skilled women whose hearts were stirred spun the goat hair.
chapters.zh: 凡有智慧、心里受感的妇女就纺山羊〔毛〕。

chapters.en: The leaders brought onyx stones and gemstones to mount on the ephod and breastpiece,
chapters.zh: 众官长把红玛瑙和别样的宝石，可以镶嵌在以弗得与胸牌上的，都拿了来；

chapters.en: as well as spices and olive oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense.
chapters.zh: 又拿香料做香，拿油点灯，做膏油。

chapters.en: So all the men and women of the Israelites whose hearts prompted them brought a freewill offering to the LORD for all the work that the LORD through Moses had commanded them to do.
chapters.zh: 以色列人，无论男女，凡甘心乐意献礼物给耶和华的，都将礼物拿来，做耶和华藉摩西所吩咐的一切工。

chapters.en: Then Moses said to the Israelites, “See, the LORD has called by name Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
chapters.zh: 摩西对以色列人说：「犹大支派中，户珥的孙子、乌利的儿子比撒列，耶和华已经提他的名召他，

chapters.en: And He has filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability, and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship,
chapters.zh: 又以上帝的灵充满了他，使他有智慧、聪明、知识，能做各样的工，

chapters.en: to design artistic works in gold, silver, and bronze,
chapters.zh: 能想出巧工，用金、银、铜制造各物，

chapters.en: to cut gemstones for settings, and to carve wood, so that he may be a master of every artistic craft.
chapters.zh: 又能刻宝石，可以镶嵌，能雕刻木头，能做各样的巧工。

chapters.en: And the LORD has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach others.
chapters.zh: 耶和华又使他，和但支派中亚希撒抹的儿子亚何利亚伯，心里灵明，能教导人。

chapters.en: He has filled them with skill to do all kinds of work as engravers, designers, embroiderers in blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine linen, and as weavers—as artistic designers of every kind of craft.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使他们的心满有智慧，能做各样的工，无论是雕刻的工，巧匠的工，用蓝色、紫色、朱红色〔线〕，和细麻、绣花的工，并机匠的工，他们都能做，也能想出奇巧的工。

chapters.en: “So Bezalel, Oholiab, and every skilled person are to carry out everything commanded by the LORD, who has given them skill and ability to know how to perform all the work of constructing the sanctuary.”
chapters.zh: 「比撒列和亚何利亚伯，并一切心里有智慧的，就是蒙耶和华赐智慧聪明、叫他知道做圣所各样使用之工的，都要照耶和华所吩咐的做工。」

chapters.en: Then Moses summoned Bezalel, Oholiab, and every skilled person whom the LORD had gifted—everyone whose heart stirred him to come and do the work.
chapters.zh: 凡耶和华赐他心里有智慧、而且受感前来做这工的，摩西把他们和比撒列并亚何利亚伯一同召来。

chapters.en:
They received from Moses all the contributions that the Israelites had brought to carry out the service of constructing the sanctuary.
Meanwhile, the people continued to bring freewill offerings morning after morning,
chapters.zh: 这些人就从摩西收了以色列人为做圣所并圣所使用之工所拿来的礼物。百姓每早晨还把甘心献的礼物拿来。

chapters.en: so that all the skilled craftsmen who were doing all the work on the sanctuary left their work
chapters.zh: 凡做圣所一切工的智慧人各都离开他所做的工，

chapters.en: and said to Moses, “The people are bringing more than enough for doing the work the LORD has commanded us to do.”
chapters.zh: 来对摩西说：「百姓为耶和华吩咐使用之工所拿来的，富富有余。」

chapters.en: After Moses had given an order, they sent a proclamation throughout the camp: “No man or woman should make anything else as an offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing more,
chapters.zh: 摩西传命，他们就在全营中宣告说：「无论男女，不必再为圣所拿什么礼物来。」这样才拦住百姓不再拿礼物来。

chapters.en: since what they already had was more than enough to perform all the work.
chapters.zh: 因为他们所有的材料够做一切当做的物，而且有余。

chapters.en: All the skilled craftsmen among the workmen made the ten curtains for the tabernacle. They were made of finely spun linen, as well as blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, with cherubim skillfully worked into them.
chapters.zh: 他们中间，凡心里有智慧做工的，用十幅幔子做帐幕。这幔子是比撒列用撚的细麻和蓝色、紫色、朱红色〔线〕制造的，并用巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。

chapters.en: Each curtain was twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide; all the curtains were the same size.
chapters.zh: 每幅幔子长二十八肘，宽四肘，都是一样的尺寸。

chapters.en: And he joined five of the curtains together, and the other five he joined as well.
chapters.zh: 他使这五幅幔子幅幅相连，又使那五幅幔子幅幅相连；

chapters.en: He made loops of blue material on the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and also on the end curtain in the second set.
chapters.zh: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上做蓝色的钮扣，在那相连的幔子末幅边上也照样做；

chapters.en: He made fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set, so that the loops lined up opposite one another.
chapters.zh: 在这相连的幔子上做五十个钮扣，在那相连的幔子上也做五十个钮扣，都是两两相对；

chapters.en: He also made fifty gold clasps to join the curtains together, so that the tabernacle was a unit.
chapters.zh: 又做五十个金钩，使幔子相连。这才成了一个帐幕。

chapters.en: He then made curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven curtains in all.
chapters.zh: 他用山羊〔毛〕织十一幅幔子，作为帐幕以上的罩棚。

chapters.en: Each of the eleven curtains was the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.
chapters.zh: 每幅幔子长三十肘，宽四肘；十一幅幔子都是一样的尺寸。

chapters.en: He joined five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another.
chapters.zh: 他把五幅幔子连成一幅，又把六幅幔子连成一幅；

chapters.en: He made fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and fifty loops along the edge of the corresponding curtain in the second set.
chapters.zh: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上做五十个钮扣，在那相连的幔子〔末幅〕边上也做五十个钮扣；

chapters.en: He also made fifty bronze clasps to join the tent together as a unit.
chapters.zh: 又做五十个铜钩，使罩棚连成一个；

chapters.en: Additionally, he made for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of fine leather.
chapters.zh: 并用染红的公羊皮做罩棚的盖，再用海狗皮做一层罩棚上的顶盖。

chapters.en: Next, he constructed upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
chapters.zh: 他用皂荚木做帐幕的竖板。

chapters.en: Each frame was ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
chapters.zh: 每块长十肘，宽一肘半；

chapters.en: Two tenons were connected to each other for each frame. He made all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
chapters.zh: 每块有两榫相对。帐幕一切的板都是这样做。

chapters.en: He constructed twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle,
chapters.zh: 帐幕的南面做板二十块。
