chapters.en: This is how the lampstand was constructed: it was made of hammered gold from its base to its blossoms, fashioned according to the pattern the LORD had shown Moses.
chapters.zh: 这灯台的做法是用金子锤出来的，连座带花都是锤出来的。摩西制造灯台，是照耶和华所指示的样式。

chapters.en: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “Take the Levites from among the Israelites and make them ceremonially clean.
chapters.zh: 「你从以色列人中选出利未人来，洁净他们。

chapters.en: This is what you must do to cleanse them: Sprinkle them with the water of purification. Have them shave their whole bodies and wash their clothes, and so purify themselves.
chapters.zh: 洁净他们当这样行：用除罪水弹在他们身上，又叫他们用剃头刀刮全身，洗衣服，洁净自己。

chapters.en: Then have them take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and you are to take a second young bull for a sin offering.
chapters.zh: 然后叫他们取一只公牛犊，并同献的素祭，就是调油的细面；你要另取一只公牛犊作赎罪祭。

chapters.en: Bring the Levites before the Tent of Meeting and assemble the whole congregation of Israel.
chapters.zh: 将利未人奉到会幕前，招聚以色列全会众。

chapters.en: You are to present the Levites before the LORD and have the Israelites lay their hands upon them.
chapters.zh: 将利未人奉到耶和华面前，以色列人要按手在他们〔头〕上。

chapters.en: Aaron is to present the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the sons of Israel, so that they may perform the service of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 亚伦也将他们奉到耶和华面前，为以色列人当作摇祭，使他们好办耶和华的事。

chapters.en: And the Levites are to lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and offer to the LORD one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, to make atonement for the Levites.
chapters.zh: 利未人要按手在那两只牛的头上；你要将一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭，献给耶和华，为利未人赎罪。

chapters.en: You are to have the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons and then present them before the LORD as a wave offering.
chapters.zh: 你也要使利未人站在亚伦和他儿子面前，将他们当作摇祭奉给耶和华。

chapters.en: In this way you shall separate the Levites from the rest of the Israelites, and the Levites will belong to Me.
chapters.zh: 「这样，你从以色列人中将利未人分别出来，利未人便要归我。

chapters.en: After you have cleansed them and presented them as a wave offering, they may come to serve at the Tent of Meeting.
chapters.zh: 此后利未人要进去办会幕的事，你要洁净他们，将他们当作摇祭奉上；

chapters.en: For the Levites have been wholly given to Me from among the sons of Israel. I have taken them for Myself in place of all who come first from the womb, the firstborn of all the sons of Israel.
chapters.zh: 因为他们是从以色列人中全然给我的，我拣选他们归我，是代替以色列人中一切头生的。

chapters.en: For every firstborn male in Israel is Mine, both man and beast. I set them apart for Myself on the day I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 以色列人中一切头生的，连人带牲畜，都是我的。我在埃及地击杀一切头生的那天，将他们分别为圣归我。

chapters.en: But I have taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the sons of Israel.
chapters.zh: 我拣选利未人代替以色列人中一切头生的。

chapters.en: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and his sons from among the Israelites, to perform the service for the Israelites at the Tent of Meeting and to make atonement on their behalf, so that no plague will come against the Israelites when they approach the sanctuary.”
chapters.zh: 我从以色列人中将利未人当作赏赐给亚伦和他的儿子，在会幕中办以色列人的事，又为以色列人赎罪，免得他们挨近圣所，有灾殃临到他们中间。」

chapters.en: So Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of Israel did with the Levites everything that the LORD had commanded Moses they should do.
chapters.zh: 摩西、亚伦，并以色列全会众便向利未人如此行。凡耶和华指着利未人所吩咐摩西的，以色列人就向他们这样行。

chapters.en: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes, and Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the LORD. Aaron also made atonement for them to cleanse them.
chapters.zh: 于是利未人洁净自己，除了罪，洗了衣服；亚伦将他们当作摇祭奉到耶和华面前，又为他们赎罪，洁净他们。

chapters.en: After that, the Levites came to perform their service at the Tent of Meeting in the presence of Aaron and his sons. Thus they did with the Levites just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
chapters.zh: 然后利未人进去，在亚伦和他儿子面前，在会幕中办事。耶和华指着利未人怎样吩咐摩西，以色列人就怎样向他们行了。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “This applies to the Levites: Men twenty-five years of age or older shall enter to perform the service in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
chapters.zh: 「利未人是这样：从二十五岁以外，他们要前来任职，办会幕的事。

chapters.en: But at the age of fifty, they must retire from performing the work and no longer serve.
chapters.zh: 到了五十岁要停工退任，不再办事，

chapters.en: After that, they may assist their brothers in fulfilling their duties at the Tent of Meeting, but they themselves are not to do the work. This is how you are to assign responsibilities to the Levites.”
chapters.zh: 只要在会幕里，和他们的弟兄一同伺候，谨守所吩咐的，不再办事了。至于所吩咐利未人的，你要这样向他们行。」

chapters.en: In the first month of the second year after Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai:
chapters.zh: 以色列人出埃及地以后，第二年正月，耶和华在西奈的旷野吩咐摩西说：

chapters.en: “The Israelites are to observe the Passover at its appointed time.
chapters.zh: 「以色列人应当在所定的日期守逾越节，

chapters.en: You are to observe it at the appointed time, at twilight on the fourteenth day of this month, in accordance with its statutes and ordinances.”
chapters.zh: 就是本月十四日黄昏的时候，你们要在所定的日期守这节，要按这节的律例典章而守。」

chapters.en: So Moses told the Israelites to observe the Passover,
chapters.zh: 于是摩西吩咐以色列人守逾越节。

chapters.en: and they did so in the Wilderness of Sinai, at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
chapters.zh: 他们就在西奈的旷野，正月十四日黄昏的时候，守逾越节。凡耶和华所吩咐摩西的，以色列人都照样行了。

chapters.en: But there were some men who were unclean due to a dead body, so they could not observe the Passover on that day. And they came before Moses and Aaron that same day
chapters.zh: 有几个人因死尸而不洁净，不能在那日守逾越节。当日他们到摩西、亚伦面前，

chapters.en: and said to Moses, “We are unclean because of a dead body, but why should we be excluded from presenting the LORD’s offering with the other Israelites at the appointed time?”
chapters.zh: 说：「我们虽因死尸而不洁净，为何被阻止、不得同以色列人在所定的日期献耶和华的供物呢？」

chapters.en: “Wait here until I find out what the LORD commands concerning you,” Moses replied.
chapters.zh: 摩西对他们说：「你们暂且等候，我可以去听耶和华指着你们是怎样吩咐的。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：

chapters.en: “Tell the Israelites: ‘When any one of you or your descendants is unclean because of a dead body, or is away on a journey, he may still observe the Passover to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：你们和你们后代中，若有人因死尸而不洁净，或在远方行路，还要向耶和华守逾越节。

chapters.en: Such people are to observe it at twilight on the fourteenth day of the second month. They are to eat the lamb, together with unleavened bread and bitter herbs;
chapters.zh: 他们要在二月十四日黄昏的时候，守逾越节。要用无酵饼与苦菜，和逾越节〔的羊羔〕同吃。

chapters.en: they may not leave any of it until morning or break any of its bones. They must observe the Passover according to all its statutes.
chapters.zh: 一点不可留到早晨；羊羔的骨头一根也不可折断。他们要照逾越节的一切律例而守。

chapters.en: But if a man who is ceremonially clean and is not on a journey still fails to observe the Passover, he must be cut off from his people, because he did not present the LORD’s offering at its appointed time. That man will bear the consequences of his sin.
chapters.zh: 那洁净而不行路的人若推辞不守逾越节，那人要从民中剪除；因为他在所定的日期不献耶和华的供物，应该担当他的罪。

chapters.en: If a foreigner dwelling among you wants to observe the Passover to the LORD, he is to do so according to the Passover statute and its ordinances. You are to apply the same statute to both the foreigner and the native of the land.’”
chapters.zh: 若有外人寄居在你们中间，愿意向耶和华守逾越节，他要照逾越节的律例典章行，不管是寄居的是本地人，同归一例。」

chapters.en: On the day that the tabernacle, the Tent of the Testimony, was set up, the cloud covered it and appeared like fire above the tabernacle from evening until morning.
chapters.zh: 立起帐幕的那日，有云彩遮盖帐幕，就是法〔柜〕的帐幕；从晚上到早晨，云彩在其上，形状如火。

chapters.en: It remained that way continually; the cloud would cover the tabernacle by day, and at night it would appear like fire.
chapters.zh: 常是这样，云彩遮盖帐幕，夜间形状如火。

chapters.en: Whenever the cloud was lifted from above the Tent, the Israelites would set out, and wherever the cloud settled, there the Israelites would camp.
chapters.zh: 云彩几时从帐幕收上去，以色列人就几时起行；云彩在哪里停住，以色列人就在那里安营。

chapters.en: At the LORD’s command the Israelites set out, and at the LORD’s command they camped. As long as the cloud remained over the tabernacle, they remained encamped.
chapters.zh: 以色列人遵耶和华的吩咐起行，也遵耶和华的吩咐安营。云彩在帐幕上停住几时，他们就住营几时。

chapters.en: Even when the cloud lingered over the tabernacle for many days, the Israelites kept the LORD’s charge and did not set out.
chapters.zh: 云彩在帐幕上停留许多日子，以色列人就守耶和华所吩咐的不起行。

chapters.en: Sometimes the cloud remained over the tabernacle for only a few days, and they would camp at the LORD’s command and set out at the LORD’s command.
chapters.zh: 有时云彩在帐幕上几天，他们就照耶和华的吩咐住营，也照耶和华的吩咐起行。

chapters.en: Sometimes the cloud remained only from evening until morning, and when it lifted in the morning, they would set out. Whether it was by day or by night, when the cloud was taken up, they would set out.
chapters.zh: 有时从晚上到早晨，有这云彩〔在帐幕上〕；早晨云彩收上去，他们就起行。有时昼夜〔云彩停在帐幕上〕，收上去的时候，他们就起行。

chapters.en: Whether the cloud lingered for two days, a month, or longer, the Israelites camped and did not set out as long as the cloud remained over the tabernacle; but when it was lifted, they would set out.
chapters.zh: 云彩停留在帐幕上，无论是两天，是一月，是一年，以色列人就住营不起行；但云彩收上去，他们就起行。

chapters.en: They camped at the LORD’s command, and they set out at the LORD’s command; they carried out the LORD’s charge according to His command through Moses.
chapters.zh: 他们遵耶和华的吩咐安营，也遵耶和华的吩咐起行。他们守耶和华所吩咐的，都是凭耶和华吩咐摩西的。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “Make two trumpets of hammered silver to be used for calling the congregation and for having the camps set out.
chapters.zh: 「你要用银子做两枝号，都要锤出来的，用以招聚会众，并叫众营起行。

chapters.en: When both are sounded, the whole congregation is to assemble before you at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
chapters.zh: 吹这号的时候，全会众要到你那里，聚集在会幕门口。

chapters.en: But if only one is sounded, then the leaders, the heads of the clans of Israel, are to gather before you.
chapters.zh: 若单吹一枝，众首领，就是以色列军中的统领，要聚集到你那里。

chapters.en: When you sound short blasts, the camps that lie on the east side are to set out.
chapters.zh: 吹出大声的时候，东边安的营都要起行。

chapters.en: When you sound the short blasts a second time, the camps that lie on the south side are to set out. The blasts are to signal them to set out.
chapters.zh: 二次吹出大声的时候，南边安的营都要起行。他们将起行，必吹出大声。

chapters.en: To convene the assembly, you are to sound long blasts, not short ones.
chapters.zh: 但招聚会众的时候，你们要吹号，却不要吹出大声。

chapters.en: The sons of Aaron, the priests, are to sound the trumpets. This shall be a permanent statute for you and the generations to come.
chapters.zh: 亚伦子孙作祭司的要吹这号；这要作你们世世代代永远的定例。

chapters.en: When you enter into battle in your land against an adversary who attacks you, sound short blasts on the trumpets, and you will be remembered before the LORD your God and saved from your enemies.
chapters.zh: 你们在自己的地，与欺压你们的敌人打仗，就要用号吹出大声，便在耶和华－你们的上帝面前得蒙纪念，也蒙拯救脱离仇敌。

chapters.en: And on your joyous occasions, your appointed feasts, and the beginning of each month, you are to blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and peace offerings to serve as a reminder for you before your God. I am the LORD your God.”
chapters.zh: 在你们快乐的日子和节期，并月朔，献燔祭和平安祭，也要吹号，这都要在你们的上帝面前作为纪念。我是耶和华－你们的上帝。」

chapters.en: On the twentieth day of the second month of the second year, the cloud was lifted from above the tabernacle of the Testimony,
chapters.zh: 第二年二月二十日，云彩从法〔柜〕的帐幕收上去。

chapters.en: and the Israelites set out from the Wilderness of Sinai, traveling from place to place until the cloud settled in the Wilderness of Paran.
chapters.zh: 以色列人就按站往前行，离开西奈的旷野，云彩停住在巴兰的旷野。

chapters.en: They set out this first time according to the LORD’s command through Moses.
chapters.zh: 这是他们照耶和华藉摩西所吩咐的，初次往前行。

chapters.en: First, the divisions of the camp of Judah set out under their standard, with Nahshon son of Amminadab in command.
chapters.zh: 按着军队首先往前行的是犹大营的纛。统领军队的是亚米拿达的儿子拿顺。

chapters.en: Nethanel son of Zuar was over the division of the tribe of Issachar,
chapters.zh: 统领以萨迦支派军队的是苏押的儿子拿坦业。

chapters.en: and Eliab son of Helon was over the division of the tribe of Zebulun.
chapters.zh: 统领西布伦支派军队的是希伦的儿子以利押。

chapters.en: Then the tabernacle was taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites set out, transporting it.
chapters.zh: 帐幕拆卸，革顺的子孙和米拉利的子孙就抬着帐幕先往前行。

chapters.en: Then the divisions of the camp of Reuben set out under their standard, with Elizur son of Shedeur in command.
chapters.zh: 按着军队往前行的是吕便营的纛。统领军队的是示丢珥的儿子以利蓿。

chapters.en: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was over the division of the tribe of Simeon,
chapters.zh: 统领西缅支派军队的是苏利沙代的儿子示路蔑。

chapters.en: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was over the division of the tribe of Gad.
chapters.zh: 统领迦得支派军队的是丢珥的儿子以利雅萨。

chapters.en: Then the Kohathites set out, transporting the holy objects; the tabernacle was to be set up before their arrival.
chapters.zh: 哥辖人抬着圣物先往前行。他们未到以前，〔抬帐幕的〕已经把帐幕支好。

chapters.en: Next, the divisions of the camp of Ephraim set out under their standard, with Elishama son of Ammihud in command.
chapters.zh: 按着军队往前行的是以法莲营的纛，统领军队的是亚米忽的儿子以利沙玛。

chapters.en: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was over the division of the tribe of Manasseh,
chapters.zh: 统领玛拿西支派军队的是比大蓿的儿子迦玛列。

chapters.en: and Abidan son of Gideoni was over the division of the tribe of Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 统领便雅悯支派军队的是基多尼的儿子亚比但。

chapters.en: Finally, the divisions of the camp of Dan set out under their standard, serving as the rear guard for all units, with Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai in command.
chapters.zh: 在诸营末后的是但营的纛，按着军队往前行。统领军队的是亚米沙代的儿子亚希以谢。

chapters.en: Pagiel son of Ocran was over the division of the tribe of Asher,
chapters.zh: 统领亚设支派军队的是俄兰的儿子帕结。

chapters.en: and Ahira son of Enan was over the division of the tribe of Naphtali.
chapters.zh: 统领拿弗他利支派军队的是以南的儿子亚希拉。

chapters.en: This was the order of march for the Israelite divisions as they set out.
chapters.zh: 以色列人按着军队往前行，就是这样。

chapters.en: Then Moses said to Hobab, the son of Moses’ father-in-law Reuel the Midianite, “We are setting out for the place of which the LORD said: ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well, for the LORD has promised good things to Israel.”
chapters.zh: 摩西对他岳父〔注：或译：内兄〕－米甸人流珥的儿子何巴－说：「我们要行路，往耶和华所应许之地去；他曾说：『我要将这地赐给你们。』现在求你和我们同去，我们必厚待你，因为耶和华指着以色列人已经应许给好处。」

chapters.en: “I will not go,” Hobab replied. “Instead, I am going back to my own land and my own people.”
chapters.zh: 何巴回答说：「我不去；我要回本地本族那里去。」

chapters.en: “Please do not leave us,” Moses said, “since you know where we should camp in the wilderness, and you can serve as our eyes.
chapters.zh: 摩西说：「求你不要离开我们；因为你知道我们要在旷野安营，你可以当作我们的眼目。

chapters.en: If you come with us, we will share with you whatever good things the LORD gives us.”
chapters.zh: 你若和我们同去，将来耶和华有什么好处待我们，我们也必以什么好处待你。」

chapters.en: So they set out on a three-day journey from the mountain of the LORD, with the ark of the covenant of the LORD traveling ahead of them for those three days to seek a resting place for them.
chapters.zh: 以色列人离开耶和华的山，往前行了三天的路程；耶和华的约柜在前头行了三天的路程，为他们寻找安歇的地方。

chapters.en: And the cloud of the LORD was over them by day when they set out from the camp.
chapters.zh: 他们拔营往前行，日间有耶和华的云彩在他们以上。
约柜往前行的时候，摩西就说：「耶和华啊，求你兴起！愿你的仇敌四散！愿恨你的人从你面前逃跑！」

chapters.en:
And when it came to rest, he would say:
“Return, O LORD, to the countless thousands of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 约柜停住的时候，他就说：「耶和华啊，求你回到以色列的千万人中！」

chapters.en: Soon the people began to complain about their hardship in the hearing of the LORD, and when He heard them, His anger was kindled, and fire from the LORD blazed among them and consumed the outskirts of the camp.
chapters.zh: 众百姓发怨言，他们的恶语达到耶和华的耳中。耶和华听见了就怒气发作，使火在他们中间焚烧，直烧到营的边界。

chapters.en: And the people cried out to Moses, and he prayed to the LORD, and the fire died down.
chapters.zh: 百姓向摩西哀求，摩西祈求耶和华，火就熄了。

chapters.en: So that place was called Taberah, because the fire of the LORD had burned among them.
chapters.zh: 那地方便叫做他备拉，因为耶和华的火烧在他们中间。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, the rabble among them had a strong craving for other food, and again the Israelites wept and said, “Who will feed us meat?
chapters.zh: 他们中间的闲杂人大起贪欲的心；以色列人又哭号说：「谁给我们肉吃呢？

chapters.en: We remember the fish we ate freely in Egypt, along with the cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, and garlic.
chapters.zh: 我们记得，在埃及的时候不花钱就吃鱼，也记得有黄瓜、西瓜、韭菜、诔、蒜。

chapters.en: But now our appetite is gone; there is nothing to see but this manna!”
chapters.zh: 现在我们的心血枯竭了，除这吗哪以外，在我们眼前并没有别的东西。」

chapters.en: Now the manna resembled coriander seed, and its appearance was like that of gum resin.
chapters.zh: 这吗哪仿佛芫荽子，又好像珍珠。

chapters.en: The people walked around and gathered it, ground it on a handmill or crushed it in a mortar, then boiled it in a cooking pot or shaped it into cakes. It tasted like pastry baked with fine oil.
chapters.zh: 百姓周围行走，把吗哪收起来，或用磨推，或用臼捣，煮在锅中，又做成饼，滋味好像新油。

chapters.en: When the dew fell on the camp at night, the manna would fall with it.
chapters.zh: 夜间露水降在营中，吗哪也随着降下。）

chapters.en: Then Moses heard the people of family after family weeping at the entrances to their tents, and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly, and Moses was also displeased.
chapters.zh: 摩西听见百姓各在各家的帐棚门口哭号。耶和华的怒气便大发作，摩西就不喜悦。

chapters.en: So Moses asked the LORD, “Why have You brought this trouble on Your servant? Why have I not found favor in Your sight, that You have laid upon me the burden of all these people?
chapters.zh: 摩西对耶和华说：「你为何苦待仆人？我为何不在你眼前蒙恩，竟把这管理百姓的重任加在我身上呢？

chapters.en: Did I conceive all these people? Did I give them birth, so that You should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries an infant,’ to the land that You swore to give their fathers?
chapters.zh: 这百姓岂是我怀的胎，岂是我生下来的呢？你竟对我说：『把他们抱在怀里，如养育之父抱吃奶的孩子，直抱到你起誓应许给他们祖宗的地去。』

chapters.en: Where can I get meat for all these people? For they keep crying out to me, ‘Give us meat to eat!’
chapters.zh: 我从哪里得肉给这百姓吃呢？他们都向我哭号说：『你给我们肉吃吧！』

chapters.en: I cannot carry all these people by myself; it is too burdensome for me.
chapters.zh: 管理这百姓的责任太重了，我独自担当不起。

chapters.en: If this is how You are going to treat me, please kill me right now—if I have found favor in Your eyes—and let me not see my own wretchedness.”
chapters.zh: 你这样待我，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你立时将我杀了，不叫我见自己的苦情。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Bring Me seventy of the elders of Israel known to you as leaders and officers of the people. Bring them to the Tent of Meeting and have them stand there with you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「你从以色列的长老中招聚七十个人，就是你所知道作百姓的长老和官长的，到我这里来，领他们到会幕前，使他们和你一同站立。

chapters.en: And I will come down and speak with you there, and I will take some of the Spirit that is on you and put that Spirit on them. They will help you bear the burden of the people, so that you do not have to bear it by yourself.
chapters.zh: 我要在那里降临，与你说话，也要把降于你身上的灵分赐他们，他们就和你同当这管百姓的重任，免得你独自担当。

chapters.en: And say to the people: Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, and you will eat meat, because you have cried out in the hearing of the LORD, saying: ‘Who will feed us meat? For we were better off in Egypt!’ Therefore the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat.
chapters.zh: 又要对百姓说：『你们应当自洁，预备明天吃肉，因为你们哭号说：谁给我们肉吃！我们在埃及很好。这声音达到了耶和华的耳中，所以他必给你们肉吃。

chapters.en: You will eat it not for one or two days, nor for five or ten or twenty days,
chapters.zh: 你们不止吃一天、两天、五天、十天、二十天，

chapters.en: but for a whole month—until it comes out of your nostrils and makes you nauseous—because you have rejected the LORD, who is among you, and have cried out before Him, saying, ‘Why did we ever leave Egypt?’”
chapters.zh: 要吃一个整月，甚至肉从你们鼻孔里喷出来，使你们厌恶了，因为你们厌弃住在你们中间的耶和华，在他面前哭号说：我们为何出了埃及呢！』」

chapters.en: But Moses replied, “Here I am among 600,000 men on foot, yet You say, ‘I will give them meat, and they will eat for a month.’
chapters.zh: 摩西〔对耶和华〕说：「这与我同住的百姓、步行的男人有六十万，你还说：『我要把肉给他们，使他们可以吃一个整月。』

chapters.en: If all our flocks and herds were slaughtered for them, would they have enough? Or if all the fish in the sea were caught for them, would they have enough?”
chapters.zh: 难道给他们宰了羊群牛群，或是把海中所有的鱼都聚了来，就够他们吃吗？」

chapters.en: The LORD answered Moses, “Is the LORD’s arm too short? Now you will see whether or not My word will come to pass.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「耶和华的膀臂岂是缩短了吗？现在要看我的话向你应验不应验。」

chapters.en: So Moses went out and relayed to the people the words of the LORD, and he gathered seventy of the elders of the people and had them stand around the tent.
chapters.zh: 摩西出去，将耶和华的话告诉百姓，又招聚百姓的长老中七十个人来，使他们站在〔会〕幕的四围。

chapters.en: Then the LORD came down in the cloud and spoke to him, and He took some of the Spirit that was on Moses and placed that Spirit on the seventy elders. As the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied—but they never did so again.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在云中降临，对摩西说话，把降与他身上的灵分赐那七十个长老。灵停在他们身上的时候，他们就受感说话，以后却没有再说。

chapters.en: Two men, however, had remained in the camp—one named Eldad and the other Medad—and the Spirit rested on them. They were among those listed, but they had not gone out to the tent, and they prophesied in the camp.
chapters.zh: 但有两个人仍在营里，一个名叫伊利达，一个名叫米达。他们本是在那些被录的人中，却没有到〔会〕幕那里去。灵停在他们身上，他们就在营里说预言。

chapters.en: A young man ran and reported to Moses, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp.”
chapters.zh: 有个少年人跑来告诉摩西说：「伊利达、米达在营里说预言。」

chapters.en: Joshua son of Nun, the attendant to Moses since youth, spoke up and said, “Moses, my lord, stop them!”
chapters.zh: 摩西的帮手，嫩的儿子约书亚，就是摩西所拣选的一个人，说：「请我主摩西禁止他们。」

chapters.en: But Moses replied, “Are you jealous on my account? I wish that all the LORD’s people were prophets and that the LORD would place His Spirit on them!”
chapters.zh: 摩西对他说：「你为我的缘故嫉妒人吗？惟愿耶和华的百姓都受感说话！愿耶和华把他的灵降在他们身上！」

chapters.en: Then Moses returned to the camp, along with the elders of Israel.
chapters.zh: 于是，摩西和以色列的长老都回到营里去。

chapters.en: Now a wind sent by the LORD came up, drove in quail from the sea, and brought them near the camp, about two cubits above the surface of the ground, for a day’s journey in every direction around the camp.
chapters.zh: 有风从耶和华那里刮起，把鹌鹑由海面刮来，飞散在营边和营的四围；这边约有一天的路程，那边约有一天的路程，离地面约有二肘。

chapters.en: All that day and night, and all the next day, the people stayed up gathering the quail. No one gathered less than ten homers, and they spread them out all around the camp.
chapters.zh: 百姓起来，终日终夜，并次日一整天，捕取鹌鹑；至少的也取了十贺梅珥，为自己摆列在营的四围。

chapters.en: But while the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the anger of the LORD burned against the people, and the LORD struck them with a severe plague.
chapters.zh: 肉在他们牙齿之间尚未嚼烂，耶和华的怒气就向他们发作，用最重的灾殃击杀了他们。

chapters.en: So they called that place Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had craved other food.
chapters.zh: 那地方便叫做基博罗‧哈他瓦〔注：就是贪欲之人的坟墓〕，因为他们在那里葬埋那起贪欲之心的人。

chapters.en: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people moved on to Hazeroth, where they remained for some time.
chapters.zh: 百姓从基博罗‧哈他瓦走到哈洗录，就住在哈洗录。

chapters.en: Then Miriam and Aaron criticized Moses because of the Cushite woman he had married, for he had taken a Cushite wife.
chapters.zh: 摩西娶了古实女子为妻。米利暗和亚伦因他所娶的古实女子就毁谤他，说：

chapters.en: “Does the LORD speak only through Moses?” they said. “Does He not also speak through us?” And the LORD heard this.
chapters.zh: 「难道耶和华单与摩西说话，不也与我们说话吗？」这话耶和华听见了。

chapters.en: Now Moses was a very humble man, more so than any man on the face of the earth.
chapters.zh: （摩西为人极其谦和，胜过世上的众人。）

chapters.en: And suddenly the LORD said to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, “You three, come out to the Tent of Meeting.” So the three went out,
chapters.zh: 耶和华忽然对摩西、亚伦、米利暗说：「你们三个人都出来，到会幕这里。」他们三个人就出来了。

chapters.en: and the LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, stood at the entrance to the Tent, and summoned Aaron and Miriam. When both of them had stepped forward,
chapters.zh: 耶和华在云柱中降临，站在〔会〕幕门口，召亚伦和米利暗，二人就出来了。
耶和华说：「你们且听我的话：你们中间若有先知，我－耶和华必在异象中向他显现，在梦中与他说话。

chapters.en: But this is not so with My servant Moses; he is faithful in all My house.
chapters.zh: 我的仆人摩西不是这样；他是在我全家尽忠的。
我要与他面对面说话，乃是明说，不用谜语，并且他必见我的形像。你们毁谤我的仆人摩西，为何不惧怕呢？」

chapters.en: So the anger of the LORD burned against them, and He departed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就向他们二人发怒而去。

chapters.en: As the cloud lifted from above the Tent, suddenly Miriam became leprous, white as snow. Aaron turned toward her, saw that she was leprous,
chapters.zh: 云彩从〔会〕幕上挪开了，不料，米利暗长了大痲疯，有雪〔那样〕白。亚伦一看米利暗长了大痲疯，

chapters.en: and said to Moses, “My lord, please do not hold against us this sin we have so foolishly committed.
chapters.zh: 就对摩西说：「我主啊，求你不要因我们愚昧犯罪，便将这罪加在我们身上。

chapters.en: Please do not let her be like a stillborn infant whose flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”
chapters.zh: 求你不要使她像那出母腹、肉已半烂的死胎。」

chapters.en: So Moses cried out to the LORD, “O God, please heal her!”
chapters.zh: 于是摩西哀求耶和华说：「上帝啊，求你医治她！」

chapters.en: But the LORD answered Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, would she not have been in disgrace for seven days? Let her be confined outside the camp for seven days; after that she may be brought back in.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「她父亲若吐唾沫在她脸上，她岂不蒙羞七天吗？现在要把她在营外关锁七天，然后才可以领她进来。」

chapters.en: So Miriam was confined outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not move on until she was brought in again.
chapters.zh: 于是米利暗关锁在营外七天。百姓没有行路，直等到把米利暗领进来。

chapters.en: After that, the people set out from Hazeroth and camped in the Wilderness of Paran.
chapters.zh: 以后百姓从哈洗录起行，在巴兰的旷野安营。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “Send out for yourself men to spy out the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites. From each of their fathers’ tribes send one man who is a leader among them.”
chapters.zh: 「你打发人去窥探我所赐给以色列人的迦南地，他们每支派中要打发一个人，都要作首领的。」

chapters.en: So at the command of the LORD, Moses sent them out from the Wilderness of Paran. All the men were leaders of the Israelites,
chapters.zh: 摩西就照耶和华的吩咐从巴兰的旷野打发他们去；他们都是以色列人的族长。

chapters.en:
and these were their names:
From the tribe of Reuben, Shammua son of Zaccur;
chapters.zh: 他们的名字：属吕便支派的有撒刻的儿子沙母亚。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat son of Hori;
chapters.zh: 属西缅支派的有何利的儿子沙法。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;
chapters.zh: 属犹大支派的有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal son of Joseph;
chapters.zh: 属以萨迦支派的有约色的儿子以迦。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun;
chapters.zh: 属以法莲支派的有嫩的儿子何希阿。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Raphu;
chapters.zh: 属便雅悯支派的有拉孚的儿子帕提。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel son of Sodi;
chapters.zh: 属西布伦支派的有梭底的儿子迦叠。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Manasseh (a tribe of Joseph), Gaddi son of Susi;
chapters.zh: 约瑟的子孙，属玛拿西支派的有稣西的儿子迦底。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel son of Gemalli;
chapters.zh: 属但支派的有基玛利的儿子亚米利。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael;
chapters.zh: 属亚设支派的有米迦勒的儿子西帖。

chapters.en: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi son of Vophsi;
chapters.zh: 属拿弗他利支派的有缚西的儿子拿比。

chapters.en: and from the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Machi.
chapters.zh: 属迦得支派的有玛基的儿子臼利。

chapters.en: These were the names of the men Moses sent to spy out the land; and Moses gave to Hoshea son of Nun the name Joshua.
chapters.zh: 这就是摩西所打发、窥探那地之人的名字。摩西就称嫩的儿子何希阿为约书亚。

chapters.en: When Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, he told them, “Go up through the Negev and into the hill country.
chapters.zh: 摩西打发他们去窥探迦南地，说：「你们从南地上山地去，

chapters.en: See what the land is like and whether its people are strong or weak, few or many.
chapters.zh: 看那地如何，其中所住的民是强是弱，是多是少，

chapters.en: Is the land where they live good or bad? Are the cities where they dwell open camps or fortifications?
chapters.zh: 所住之地是好是歹，所住之处是营盘是坚城。

chapters.en: Is the soil fertile or unproductive? Are there trees in it or not? Be courageous and bring back some of the fruit of the land.” (It was the season for the first ripe grapes.)
chapters.zh: 又看那地土是肥美是瘠薄，其中有树木没有。你们要放开胆量，把那地的果子带些来。」（那时正是葡萄初熟的时候。）

chapters.en: So they went up and spied out the land from the Wilderness of Zin as far as Rehob, toward Lebo-hamath.
chapters.zh: 他们上去窥探那地，从寻的旷野到利合，直到哈马口。

chapters.en: They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, dwelled. It had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.
chapters.zh: 他们从南地上去，到了希伯崙；在那里有亚衲族人亚希幔、示筛、挞买。（原来希伯崙城被建造比埃及的锁安城早七年。）

chapters.en: When they came to the Valley of Eshcol, they cut down a branch with a single cluster of grapes, which they carried on a pole between two men. They also took some pomegranates and figs.
chapters.zh: 他们到了以实各谷，从那里砍了葡萄树的一枝，上头有一挂葡萄，两个人用杠抬着，又〔带了〕些石榴和无花果来。

chapters.en: Because of the cluster of grapes the Israelites cut there, that place was called the Valley of Eshcol.
chapters.zh: （因为以色列人从那里砍来的那挂葡萄，所以那地方叫做以实各谷。）

chapters.en: After forty days the men returned from spying out the land,
chapters.zh: 过了四十天，他们窥探那地才回来，

chapters.en: and they went back to Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of Israel in the Wilderness of Paran at Kadesh. They brought back a report for the whole congregation and showed them the fruit of the land.
chapters.zh: 到了巴兰旷野的加低斯，见摩西、亚伦，并以色列的全会众，回报摩西、亚伦，并全会众，又把那地的果子给他们看；

chapters.en: And they gave this account to Moses: “We went into the land to which you sent us, and indeed, it is flowing with milk and honey. Here is some of its fruit!
chapters.zh: 又告诉摩西说：「我们到了你所打发我们去的那地，果然是流奶与蜜之地；这就是那地的果子。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, the people living in the land are strong, and the cities are large and fortified. We even saw the descendants of Anak there.
chapters.zh: 然而住那地的民强壮，城邑也坚固宽大，并且我们在那里看见了亚衲族的人。

chapters.en: The Amalekites live in the land of the Negev; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites live in the hill country; and the Canaanites live by the sea and along the Jordan.”
chapters.zh: 亚玛力人住在南地；赫人、耶布斯人、亚摩利人住在山地；迦南人住在海边并约旦河旁。」

chapters.en: Then Caleb quieted the people before Moses and said, “We must go up and take possession of the land, for we can certainly conquer it!”
chapters.zh: 迦勒在摩西面前安抚百姓，说：「我们立刻上去得那地吧！我们足能得胜。」

chapters.en: But the men who had gone up with him replied, “We cannot go up against the people, for they are stronger than we are!”
chapters.zh: 但那些和他同去的人说：「我们不能上去攻击那民，因为他们比我们强壮。」

chapters.en: So they gave the Israelites a bad report about the land that they had spied out: “The land we explored devours its inhabitants, and all the people we saw there are great in stature.
chapters.zh: 探子〔中有〕人论到所窥探之地，向以色列人报恶信，说：「我们所窥探、经过之地是吞吃居民之地，我们在那里所看见的人民都身量高大。

chapters.en: We even saw the Nephilim there—the descendants of Anak that come from the Nephilim! We seemed like grasshoppers in our own sight, and we must have seemed the same to them!”
chapters.zh: 我们在那里看见亚衲族人，就是伟人；他们是伟人的后裔。据我们看，自己就如蚱蜢一样；据他们看，我们也是如此。」

chapters.en: Then the whole congregation lifted up their voices and cried out, and that night the people wept.
chapters.zh: 当下，全会众大声喧嚷；那夜百姓都哭号。

chapters.en: All the Israelites grumbled against Moses and Aaron, and the whole congregation said to them, “If only we had died in the land of Egypt, or if only we had died in this wilderness!
chapters.zh: 以色列众人向摩西、亚伦发怨言；全会众对他们说：「巴不得我们早死在埃及地，或是死在这旷野。

chapters.en: Why is the LORD bringing us into this land to fall by the sword? Our wives and children will become plunder. Would it not be better for us to go back to Egypt?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华为什么把我们领到那地，使我们倒在刀下呢？我们的妻子和孩子必被掳掠。我们回埃及去岂不好吗？」

chapters.en: So they said to one another, “Let us appoint a leader and return to Egypt.”
chapters.zh: 众人彼此说：「我们不如立一个首领回埃及去吧！」

chapters.en: Then Moses and Aaron fell facedown before the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel.
chapters.zh: 摩西、亚伦就俯伏在以色列全会众面前。

chapters.en: Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, who were among those who had spied out the land, tore their clothes
chapters.zh: 窥探地的人中，嫩的儿子约书亚和耶孚尼的儿子迦勒撕裂衣服，

chapters.en: and said to the whole congregation of Israel, “The land we passed through and explored is an exceedingly good land.
chapters.zh: 对以色列全会众说：「我们所窥探、经过之地是极美之地。

chapters.en: If the LORD delights in us, He will bring us into this land, a land flowing with milk and honey, and He will give it to us.
chapters.zh: 耶和华若喜悦我们，就必将我们领进那地，把地赐给我们；那地原是流奶与蜜之地。

chapters.en: Only do not rebel against the LORD, and do not be afraid of the people of the land, for they will be like bread for us. Their protection has been removed, and the LORD is with us. Do not be afraid of them!”
chapters.zh: 但你们不可背叛耶和华，也不要怕那地的居民；因为他们是我们的食物，并且荫庇他们的已经离开他们。有耶和华与我们同在，不要怕他们！」

chapters.en:
But the whole congregation threatened to stone Joshua and Caleb.
Then the glory of the LORD appeared to all the Israelites at the Tent of Meeting.
chapters.zh: 但全会众说：「拿石头打死他们〔二人〕。」忽然，耶和华的荣光在会幕中向以色列众人显现。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Moses, “How long will this people treat Me with contempt? How long will they refuse to believe in Me, despite all the signs I have performed among them?
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「这百姓藐视我要到几时呢？我在他们中间行了这一切神迹，他们还不信我要到几时呢？

chapters.en: I will strike them with a plague and destroy them—and I will make you into a nation greater and mightier than they are.”
chapters.zh: 我要用瘟疫击杀他们，使他们不得承受〔那地〕，叫你的后裔成为大国，比他们强胜。」

chapters.en: But Moses said to the LORD, “The Egyptians will hear of it, for by Your strength You brought this people from among them.
chapters.zh: 摩西对耶和华说：「埃及人必听见这事；因为你曾施展大能，将这百姓从他们中间领上来。

chapters.en: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have already heard that You, O LORD, are in the midst of this people, that You, O LORD, have been seen face to face, that Your cloud stands over them, and that You go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night.
chapters.zh: 埃及人要将这事传给迦南地的居民；那民已经听见你－耶和华是在这百姓中间；因为你面对面被人看见，有你的云彩停在他们以上。你日间在云柱中，夜间在火柱中，在他们前面行。

chapters.en: If You kill this people as one man, the nations who have heard of Your fame will say,
chapters.zh: 如今你若把这百姓杀了，如杀一人，那些听见你名声的列邦必议论说：

chapters.en: ‘Because the LORD was unable to bring this people into the land He swore to give them, He has slaughtered them in the wilderness.’
chapters.zh: 『耶和华因为不能把这百姓领进他向他们起誓应许之地，所以在旷野把他们杀了。』

chapters.en: So now I pray, may the power of my Lord be magnified, just as You have declared:
chapters.zh: 现在求主大显能力，照你所说过的话说：

chapters.en: ‘The LORD is slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion, forgiving iniquity and transgression. Yet He will by no means leave the guilty unpunished; He will visit the iniquity of the fathers upon their children to the third and fourth generation.’
chapters.zh: 『耶和华不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱，赦免罪孽和过犯；万不以〔有罪的〕为无罪，必追讨他的罪，自父及子，直到三、四代。』

chapters.en: Pardon, I pray, the iniquity of this people, in keeping with the greatness of Your loving devotion, just as You have forgiven them ever since they left Egypt.”
chapters.zh: 求你照你的大慈爱赦免这百姓的罪孽，好像你从埃及到如今常赦免他们一样。」

chapters.en: “I have pardoned them as you requested,” the LORD replied.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我照着你的话赦免了他们。

chapters.en: “Yet as surely as I live and as surely as the whole earth is filled with the glory of the LORD,
chapters.zh: 然我指着我的永生起誓，遍地要被我的荣耀充满。

chapters.en: not one of the men who have seen My glory and the signs I performed in Egypt and in the wilderness—yet have tested Me and disobeyed Me these ten times—
chapters.zh: 这些人虽看见我的荣耀和我在埃及与旷野所行的神迹，仍然试探我这十次，不听从我的话，

chapters.en: not one will ever see the land that I swore to give their fathers. None of those who have treated Me with contempt will see it.
chapters.zh: 他们断不得看见我向他们的祖宗所起誓应许之地。凡藐视我的，一个也不得看见；

chapters.en: But because My servant Caleb has a different spirit and has followed Me wholeheartedly, I will bring him into the land he has entered, and his descendants will inherit it.
chapters.zh: 惟独我的仆人迦勒，因他另有一个心志，专一跟从我，我就把他领进他所去过的那地；他的后裔也必得那地为业。

chapters.en: Now since the Amalekites and Canaanites are living in the valleys, turn back tomorrow and head for the wilderness along the route to the Red Sea. ”
chapters.zh: 亚玛力人和迦南人住在谷中，明天你们要转回，从红海的路往旷野去。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西、亚伦说：

chapters.en: “How long will this wicked congregation grumble against Me? I have heard the complaints that the Israelites are making against Me.
chapters.zh: 「这恶会众向我发怨言，〔我忍耐〕他们要到几时呢？以色列人向我所发的怨言，我都听见了。

chapters.en: So tell them: As surely as I live, declares the LORD, I will do to you exactly as I heard you say.
chapters.zh: 你们告诉他们，耶和华说：『我指着我的永生起誓，我必要照你们达到我耳中的话待你们。

chapters.en: Your bodies will fall in this wilderness—all who were numbered in the census, everyone twenty years of age or older—because you have grumbled against Me.
chapters.zh: 你们的尸首必倒在这旷野，并且你们中间凡被数点、从二十岁以外、向我发怨言的，

chapters.en: Surely none of you will enter the land in which I swore to settle you, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
chapters.zh: 必不得进我起誓应许叫你们住的那地；惟有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒和嫩的儿子约书亚才能进去。

chapters.en: But I will bring your children, whom you said would become plunder, into the land you have rejected—and they will enjoy it.
chapters.zh: 但你们的〔妇人〕孩子，就是你们所说、要被掳掠的，我必把他们领进去，他们就得知你们所厌弃的那地。

chapters.en: As for you, however, your bodies will fall in this wilderness.
chapters.zh: 至于你们，你们的尸首必倒在这旷野；

chapters.en: Your children will be shepherds in the wilderness for forty years, and they will suffer for your unfaithfulness until the last of your bodies lies in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 你们的儿女必在旷野飘流四十年，担当你们淫行的罪，直到你们的尸首在旷野消灭。

chapters.en: In keeping with the forty days you spied out the land, you shall bear your guilt forty years—a year for each day—and you will experience My alienation.
chapters.zh: 按你们窥探那地的四十日，一年顶一日，你们要担当罪孽四十年，就知道我与你们疏远了，

chapters.en: I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will surely do these things to this entire wicked congregation, which has conspired against Me. They will meet their end in the wilderness, and there they will die.”
chapters.zh: 我－耶和华说过，我总要这样待这一切聚集敌我的恶会众；他们必在这旷野消灭，在这里死亡。』」

chapters.en: So the men Moses had sent to spy out the land, who had returned and made the whole congregation grumble against him by bringing out a bad report about the land—
chapters.zh: 摩西所打发、窥探那地的人回来，报那地的恶信，叫全会众向摩西发怨言，

chapters.en: those men who had brought out the bad report about the land—were struck down by a plague before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这些报恶信的人都遭瘟疫，死在耶和华面前。

chapters.en: Of those men who had gone to spy out the land, only Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh remained alive.
chapters.zh: 其中惟有嫩的儿子约书亚和耶孚尼的儿子迦勒仍然存活。

chapters.en: And when Moses relayed these words to all the Israelites, the people mourned bitterly.
chapters.zh: 摩西将这些话告诉以色列众人，他们就甚悲哀。

chapters.en: Early the next morning they got up and went up toward the ridge of the hill country. “We have indeed sinned,” they said, “but we will go to the place the LORD has promised.”
chapters.zh: 清早起来，上山顶去，说：「我们在这里，我们有罪了；情愿上耶和华所应许的地方去。」

chapters.en: But Moses said, “Why are you transgressing the commandment of the LORD? This will not succeed!
chapters.zh: 摩西说：「你们为何违背耶和华的命令呢？这事不能顺利了。

chapters.en: Do not go up, lest you be struck down by your enemies, because the LORD is not among you.
chapters.zh: 不要上去；因为耶和华不在你们中间，恐怕你们被仇敌杀败了。

chapters.en: For there the Amalekites and Canaanites will face you, and you will fall by the sword. Because you have turned away from the LORD, He will not be with you.”
chapters.zh: 亚玛力人和迦南人都在你们面前，你们必倒在刀下；因你们退回不跟从耶和华，所以他必不与你们同在。」

chapters.en: But they dared to go up to the ridge of the hill country, though neither Moses nor the ark of the covenant of the LORD moved from the camp.
chapters.zh: 他们却擅敢上山顶去，然而耶和华的约柜和摩西没有出营。

chapters.en: Then the Amalekites and Canaanites who lived in that part of the hill country came down, attacked them, and routed them all the way to Hormah.
chapters.zh: 于是亚玛力人和住在那山上的迦南人都下来击打他们，把他们杀退了，直到何珥玛。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：

chapters.en: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: After you enter the land that I am giving you as a home
chapters.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：你们到了我所赐给你们居住的地，

chapters.en: and you present a food offering to the LORD from the herd or flock to produce a pleasing aroma to the LORD—either a burnt offering or a sacrifice, for a special vow or freewill offering or appointed feast—
chapters.zh: 若愿意从牛群羊群中取牛羊作火祭，献给耶和华，无论是燔祭是〔平安〕祭，为要还特许的愿，或是作甘心祭，或是逢你们节期献的，都要奉给耶和华为馨香〔之祭〕。

chapters.en: then the one presenting his offering to the LORD shall also present a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter hin of olive oil.
chapters.zh: 那献供物的就要将细面〔伊法〕十分之一，并油一欣四分之一，调和作素祭，献给耶和华。

chapters.en: With the burnt offering or sacrifice of each lamb, you are to prepare a quarter hin of wine as a drink offering.
chapters.zh: 无论是燔祭是〔平安〕祭，你要为每只绵羊羔，一同预备奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。

chapters.en: With a ram you are to prepare a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a third of a hin of olive oil,
chapters.zh: 为公绵羊预备细面〔伊法〕十分之二，并油一欣三分之一，调和作素祭，

chapters.en: and a third of a hin of wine as a drink offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 又用酒一欣三分之一作奠祭，献给耶和华为馨香〔之祭〕。

chapters.en: When you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering or sacrifice to fulfill a vow or as a peace offering to the LORD,
chapters.zh: 你预备公牛作燔祭，或是作平安祭，为要还特许的愿，或是作平安祭，献给耶和华，

chapters.en: present with the bull a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of olive oil.
chapters.zh: 就要把细面〔伊法〕十分之三，并油半欣，调和作素祭，和公牛一同献上，

chapters.en: Also present half a hin of wine as a drink offering. It is a food offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 又用酒半欣作奠祭，献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。

chapters.en: This is to be done for each bull, ram, lamb, or goat.
chapters.zh: 「献公牛、公绵羊、绵羊羔、山羊羔，每只都要这样办理。

chapters.en: This is how you must prepare each one, no matter how many.
chapters.zh: 照你们所预备的数目，按着只数都要这样办理。

chapters.en: Everyone who is native-born shall prepare these things in this way when he presents a food offering as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 凡本地人将馨香的火祭献给耶和华，都要这样办理。

chapters.en: And for the generations to come, if a foreigner residing with you or someone else among you wants to prepare a food offering as a pleasing aroma to the LORD, he is to do exactly as you do.
chapters.zh: 若有外人和你们同居，或有人世世代代住在你们中间，愿意将馨香的火祭献给耶和华，你们怎样办理，他也要照样办理。

chapters.en: The assembly is to have the same statute both for you and for the foreign resident; it is a permanent statute for the generations to come. You and the foreigner shall be the same before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 至于会众，你们和同居的外人都归一例，作为你们世世代代永远的定例，在耶和华面前，你们怎样，寄居的也要怎样。

chapters.en: The same law and the same ordinance will apply both to you and to the foreigner residing with you.”
chapters.zh: 你们并与你们同居的外人当有一样的条例，一样的典章。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：

chapters.en: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you enter the land to which I am bringing you
chapters.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：你们到了我所领你们进去的那地，

chapters.en: and you eat the food of the land, you shall lift up an offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 吃那地的粮食，就要把举祭献给耶和华。

chapters.en: From the first of your dough, you are to lift up a cake as a contribution; offer it just like an offering from the threshing floor.
chapters.zh: 你们要用初熟的麦子磨面，做饼当举祭奉献；你们举上，好像举禾场的举祭一样。

chapters.en: Throughout your generations, you are to give the LORD an offering from the first of your dough.
chapters.zh: 你们世世代代要用初熟的麦子磨面，当举祭献给耶和华。

chapters.en: Now if you stray unintentionally and do not obey all these commandments that the LORD has spoken to Moses—
chapters.zh: 「你们有错误的时候，不守耶和华所晓谕摩西的这一切命令，

chapters.en: all that the LORD has commanded you through Moses from the day the LORD gave them and continuing through the generations to come—
chapters.zh: 就是耶和华藉摩西一切所吩咐你们的，自那日以至你们的世世代代，

chapters.en: and if it was done unintentionally without the knowledge of the congregation, then the whole congregation is to prepare one young bull as a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD, with its grain offering and drink offering according to the regulation, and one male goat as a sin offering.
chapters.zh: 若有误行，是会众所不知道的，后来全会众就要将一只公牛犊作燔祭，并照典章把素祭和奠祭一同献给耶和华为馨香〔之祭〕，又献一只公山羊作赎罪祭。

chapters.en: The priest is to make atonement for the whole congregation of Israel, so that they may be forgiven; for the sin was unintentional and they have brought to the LORD a food offering and a sin offering, presented before the LORD for their unintentional sin.
chapters.zh: 祭司要为以色列全会众赎罪，他们就必蒙赦免，因为这是错误。他们又因自己的错误，把供物，就是向耶和华献的火祭和赎罪祭，一并奉到耶和华面前。

chapters.en: Then the whole congregation of Israel and the foreigners residing among them will be forgiven, since it happened to all the people unintentionally.
chapters.zh: 以色列全会众和寄居在他们中间的外人就必蒙赦免，因为这罪是百姓误犯的。

chapters.en: Also, if one person sins unintentionally, he is to present a year-old female goat as a sin offering.
chapters.zh: 「若有一个人误犯了罪，他就要献一岁的母山羊作赎罪祭。

chapters.en: And the priest shall make atonement before the LORD on behalf of the person who erred by sinning unintentionally; and when atonement has been made for him, he will be forgiven.
chapters.zh: 那误行的人犯罪的时候，祭司要在耶和华面前为他赎罪，他就必蒙赦免。

chapters.en: You shall have the same law for the one who acts in error, whether he is a native-born Israelite or a foreigner residing among you.
chapters.zh: 以色列中的本地人和寄居在他们中间的外人，若误行了什么事，必归一样的条例。

chapters.en: But the person who sins defiantly, whether a native or foreigner, blasphemes the LORD. That person shall be cut off from among his people.
chapters.zh: 但那擅敢行事的，无论是本地人是寄居的，他亵渎了耶和华，必从民中剪除。

chapters.en: He shall certainly be cut off, because he has despised the word of the LORD and broken His commandment; his guilt remains on him.”
chapters.zh: 因他藐视耶和华的言语，违背耶和华的命令，那人总要剪除；他的罪孽要归到他身上。」

chapters.en: While the Israelites were in the wilderness, a man was found gathering wood on the Sabbath day.
chapters.zh: 以色列人在旷野的时候，遇见一个人在安息日捡柴。

chapters.en: Those who found the man gathering wood brought him to Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation,
chapters.zh: 遇见他捡柴的人，就把他带到摩西、亚伦并全会众那里，

chapters.en: and because it had not been declared what should be done to him, they placed him in custody.
chapters.zh: 将他收在监内；因为当怎样办他，还没有指明。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Moses, “The man must surely be put to death. The whole congregation is to stone him outside the camp.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「总要把那人治死；全会众要在营外用石头把他打死。」

chapters.en: So the whole congregation took the man outside the camp and stoned him to death, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
chapters.zh: 于是全会众将他带到营外，用石头打死他，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them that throughout the generations to come they are to make for themselves tassels for the corners of their garments, with a blue cord on each tassel.
chapters.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人，叫他们世世代代在衣服边上做繸子，又在底边的繸子上钉一根蓝细带子。

chapters.en: These will serve as tassels for you to look at, so that you may remember all the commandments of the LORD, that you may obey them and not prostitute yourselves by following your own heart and your own eyes.
chapters.zh: 你们佩带这繸子，好叫你们看见就记念遵行耶和华一切的命令，不随从自己的心意、眼目行邪淫，像你们素常一样；

chapters.en: Then you will remember and obey all My commandments, and you will be holy to your God.
chapters.zh: 使你们记念遵行我一切的命令，成为圣洁，归与你们的上帝。

chapters.en: I am the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God. I am the LORD your God.”
chapters.zh: 「我是耶和华－你们的上帝，曾把你们从埃及地领出来，要作你们的上帝。我是耶和华－你们的上帝。」

chapters.en: Now Korah son of Izhar, the son of Kohath son of Levi, along with some Reubenites—Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, and On son of Peleth—conducted
chapters.zh: 利未的曾孙、哥辖的孙子、以斯哈的儿子可拉，和吕便子孙中以利押的儿子大坍、亚比兰，与比勒的儿子安，

chapters.en: a rebellion against Moses, along with 250 men of Israel renowned as leaders of the congregation and representatives in the assembly.
chapters.zh: 并以色列会中的二百五十个首领，就是有名望选入会中的人，在摩西面前一同起来，

chapters.en: They came together against Moses and Aaron and told them, “You have taken too much upon yourselves! For everyone in the entire congregation is holy, and the LORD is in their midst. Why then do you exalt yourselves above the assembly of the LORD?”
chapters.zh: 聚集攻击摩西、亚伦，说：「你们擅自专权！全会众个个既是圣洁，耶和华也在他们中间，你们为什么自高，超过耶和华的会众呢？」

chapters.en: When Moses heard this, he fell facedown.
chapters.zh: 摩西听见这话就俯伏在地，

chapters.en: Then he said to Korah and all his followers, “Tomorrow morning the LORD will reveal who belongs to Him and who is holy, and He will bring that person near to Himself. The one He chooses He will bring near to Himself.
chapters.zh: 对可拉和他一党的人说：「到了早晨，耶和华必指示谁是属他的，谁是圣洁的，就叫谁亲近他；他所拣选的是谁，必叫谁亲近他。

chapters.en: You, Korah, and all your followers are to do as follows: Take censers,
chapters.zh: 可拉啊，你们要这样行，你和你的一党要拿香炉来。

chapters.en: and tomorrow you are to place fire and incense in them in the presence of the LORD. Then the man the LORD chooses will be the one who is holy. It is you sons of Levi who have taken too much upon yourselves!”
chapters.zh: 明日，在耶和华面前，把火盛在炉中，把香放在其上。耶和华拣选谁，谁就为圣洁。你们这利未的子孙擅自专权了！」

chapters.en: Moses also said to Korah, “Now listen, you sons of Levi!
chapters.zh: 摩西又对可拉说：「利未的子孙哪，你们听我说！

chapters.en: Is it not enough for you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel and brought you near to Himself to perform the work at the LORD’s tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them?
chapters.zh: 以色列的上帝从以色列会中将你们分别出来，使你们亲近他，办耶和华帐幕的事，并站在会众面前替他们当差。

chapters.en: He has brought you near, you and all your fellow Levites, but you are seeking the priesthood as well.
chapters.zh: 耶和华又使你和你一切弟兄－利未的子孙－一同亲近他，这岂为小事？你们还要求祭司的职任吗？

chapters.en: Therefore, it is you and all your followers who have conspired against the LORD! As for Aaron, who is he that you should grumble against him?”
chapters.zh: 你和你一党的人聚集是要攻击耶和华。亚伦算什么，你们竟向他发怨言呢？」

chapters.en: Then Moses summoned Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, but they said, “We will not come!
chapters.zh: 摩西打发人去召以利押的儿子大坍、亚比兰。他们说：「我们不上去！

chapters.en: Is it not enough that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey to kill us in the wilderness? Must you also appoint yourself as ruler over us?
chapters.zh: 你将我们从流奶与蜜之地领上来，要在旷野杀我们，这岂为小事？你还要自立为王辖管我们吗？

chapters.en: Moreover, you have not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey or given us an inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you gouge out the eyes of these men? No, we will not come!”
chapters.zh: 并且你没有将我们领到流奶与蜜之地，也没有把田地和葡萄园给我们为业。难道你要剜这些人的眼睛吗？我们不上去！」

chapters.en: Then Moses became very angry and said to the LORD, “Do not regard their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them or mistreated a single one of them.”
chapters.zh: 摩西就甚发怒，对耶和华说：「求你不要享受他们的供物。我并没有夺过他们一匹驴，也没有害过他们一个人。」

chapters.en: And Moses said to Korah, “You and all your followers are to appear before the LORD tomorrow—you and they and Aaron.
chapters.zh: 摩西对可拉说：「明天，你和你一党的人，并亚伦，都要站在耶和华面前；

chapters.en: Each man is to take his censer, place incense in it, and present it before the LORD—250 censers. You and Aaron are to present your censers as well.”
chapters.zh: 各人要拿一个香炉，共二百五十个，把香放在上面，到耶和华面前。你和亚伦也各拿自己的香炉。」

chapters.en: So each man took his censer, put fire and incense in it, and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
chapters.zh: 于是他们各人拿一个香炉，盛上火，加上香，同摩西、亚伦站在会幕门前。

chapters.en: When Korah had gathered his whole assembly against them at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the glory of the LORD appeared to the whole congregation.
chapters.zh: 可拉招聚全会众到会幕门前，要攻击摩西、亚伦；耶和华的荣光就向全会众显现。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西、亚伦说：

chapters.en: “Separate yourselves from this congregation so that I may consume them in an instant.”
chapters.zh: 「你们离开这会众，我好在转眼之间把他们灭绝。」

chapters.en: But Moses and Aaron fell facedown and said, “O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, when one man sins, will You be angry with the whole congregation?”
chapters.zh: 摩西、亚伦就俯伏在地，说：「上帝，万人之灵的上帝啊，一人犯罪，你就要向全会众发怒吗？」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “Tell the congregation to move away from the dwellings of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.”
chapters.zh: 「你吩咐会众说：『你们离开可拉、大坍、亚比兰帐棚的四围。』」

chapters.en: So Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the elders of Israel followed him.
chapters.zh: 摩西起来，往大坍、亚比兰那里去；以色列的长老也随着他去。

chapters.en: And he warned the congregation, “Move away now from the tents of these wicked men. Do not touch anything that belongs to them, or you will be swept away because of all their sins.”
chapters.zh: 他吩咐会众说：「你们离开这恶人的帐棚吧，他们的物件，什么都不可摸，恐怕你们陷在他们的罪中，与他们一同消灭。」

chapters.en: So they moved away from the dwellings of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram. Meanwhile, Dathan and Abiram had come out and stood at the entrances to their tents with their wives and children and infants.
chapters.zh: 于是众人离开可拉、大坍、亚比兰帐棚的四围。大坍、亚比兰带着妻子、儿女、小孩子，都出来，站在自己的帐棚门口。

chapters.en: Then Moses said, “This is how you will know that the LORD has sent me to do all these things, for it was not my own doing:
chapters.zh: 摩西说：「我行的这一切事本不是凭我自己心意行的，乃是耶和华打发我行的，必有证据使你们知道。

chapters.en: If these men die a natural death, or if they suffer the fate of all men, then the LORD has not sent me.
chapters.zh: 这些人死若与世人无异，或是他们所遭的与世人相同，就不是耶和华打发我来的。

chapters.en: But if the LORD brings about something unprecedented, and the earth opens its mouth and swallows them and all that belongs to them so that they go down alive into Sheol, then you will know that these men have treated the LORD with contempt.”
chapters.zh: 倘若耶和华创作一件新事，使地开口，把他们和一切属他们的都吞下去，叫他们活活地坠落阴间，你们就明白这些人是藐视耶和华了。」

chapters.en: As soon as Moses had finished saying all this, the ground beneath them split open,
chapters.zh: 摩西刚说完了这一切话，他们脚下的地就开了口，

chapters.en: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and their households—all Korah’s men and all their possessions.
chapters.zh: 把他们和他们的家眷，并一切属可拉的人丁、财物，都吞下去。

chapters.en: They went down alive into Sheol with all they owned. The earth closed over them, and they vanished from the assembly.
chapters.zh: 这样，他们和一切属他们的，都活活地坠落阴间；地口在他们上头照旧合闭，他们就从会中灭亡。

chapters.en: At their cries, all the people of Israel who were around them fled, saying, “The earth may swallow us too!”
chapters.zh: 在他们四围的以色列众人听他们呼号，就都逃跑，说：「恐怕地也把我们吞下去。」

chapters.en: And fire came forth from the LORD and consumed the 250 men who were offering the incense.
chapters.zh: 又有火从耶和华那里出来，烧灭了那献香的二百五十个人。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “Tell Eleazar son of Aaron the priest to remove the censers from the flames and to scatter the coals far away, because the censers are holy.
chapters.zh: 「你吩咐祭司亚伦的儿子以利亚撒从火中捡起那些香炉来，把火撒在别处，因为那些香炉是圣的。

chapters.en: As for the censers of those who sinned at the cost of their own lives, hammer them into sheets to overlay the altar, for these were presented before the LORD, and so have become holy. They will serve as a sign to the Israelites.”
chapters.zh: 把那些犯罪、自害己命之人的香炉，叫人锤成片子，用以包坛。那些香炉本是他们在耶和华面前献过的，所以是圣的，并且可以给以色列人作记号。」

chapters.en: So Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers brought by those who had been burned up, and he had them hammered out to overlay the altar,
chapters.zh: 于是祭司以利亚撒将被烧之人所献的铜香炉拿来，人就锤出来，用以包坛，

chapters.en: just as the LORD commanded him through Moses. This was to be a reminder to the Israelites that no outsider who is not a descendant of Aaron should approach to offer incense before the LORD, lest he become like Korah and his followers.
chapters.zh: 给以色列人作纪念，使亚伦后裔之外的人不得近前来在耶和华面前烧香，免得他遭可拉和他一党所遭的。这乃是照耶和华藉着摩西所吩咐的。

chapters.en: The next day the whole congregation of Israel grumbled against Moses and Aaron, saying, “You have killed the LORD’s people!”
chapters.zh: 第二天，以色列全会众都向摩西、亚伦发怨言说：「你们杀了耶和华的百姓了。」

chapters.en: But when the congregation gathered against them, Moses and Aaron turned toward the Tent of Meeting, and suddenly the cloud covered it and the glory of the LORD appeared.
chapters.zh: 会众聚集攻击摩西、亚伦的时候，向会幕观看，不料，有云彩遮盖了，耶和华的荣光显现。

chapters.en: Then Moses and Aaron went to the front of the Tent of Meeting,
chapters.zh: 摩西、亚伦就来到会幕前。

chapters.en: and the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：

chapters.en: “Get away from this congregation so that I may consume them in an instant.” And Moses and Aaron fell facedown.
chapters.zh: 「你们离开这会众，我好在转眼之间把他们灭绝。」他们二人就俯伏于地。

chapters.en: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, place fire from the altar in it, and add incense. Go quickly to the congregation and make atonement for them, because wrath has come out from the LORD; the plague has begun.”
chapters.zh: 摩西对亚伦说：「拿你的香炉，把坛上的火盛在其中，又加上香，快快带到会众那里，为他们赎罪；因为有忿怒从耶和华那里出来，瘟疫已经发作了。」

chapters.en: So Aaron took the censer as Moses had ordered and ran into the midst of the assembly. And seeing that the plague had begun among the people, he offered the incense and made atonement for the people.
chapters.zh: 亚伦照着摩西所说的拿来，跑到会中，不料，瘟疫在百姓中已经发作了。他就加上香，为百姓赎罪。

chapters.en: He stood between the living and the dead, and the plague was halted.
chapters.zh: 他站在活人死人中间，瘟疫就止住了。

chapters.en: But those who died from the plague numbered 14,700, in addition to those who had died on account of Korah.
chapters.zh: 除了因可拉事情死的以外，遭瘟疫死的，共有一万四千七百人。

chapters.en: Then Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, since the plague had been halted.
chapters.zh: 亚伦回到会幕门口，到摩西那里，瘟疫已经止住了。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：

chapters.en: “Speak to the Israelites and take from them twelve staffs, one from the leader of each tribe. Write each man’s name on his staff,
chapters.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人，从他们手下取杖，每支派一根；从他们所有的首领，按着支派，共取十二根。你要将各人的名字写在各人的杖上，

chapters.en: and write Aaron’s name on the staff of Levi, because there must be one staff for the head of each tribe.
chapters.zh: 并要将亚伦的名字写在利未的杖上，因为各族长必有一根杖。

chapters.en: Place the staffs in the Tent of Meeting in front of the Testimony, where I meet with you.
chapters.zh: 你要把这些杖存在会幕内法〔柜〕前，就是我与你们相会之处。

chapters.en: The staff belonging to the man I choose will sprout, and I will rid Myself of the constant grumbling of the Israelites against you.”
chapters.zh: 后来我所拣选的那人，他的杖必发芽。这样，我必使以色列人向你们所发的怨言止息，不再达到我耳中。」

chapters.en: So Moses spoke to the Israelites, and each of their leaders gave him a staff—one for each of the leaders of their tribes, twelve staffs in all. And Aaron’s staff was among them.
chapters.zh: 于是摩西晓谕以色列人，他们的首领就把杖交给他，按着支派，每首领一根，共有十二根；亚伦的杖也在其中。

chapters.en: Then Moses placed the staffs before the LORD in the Tent of the Testimony.
chapters.zh: 摩西就把杖存在法〔柜〕的帐幕内，在耶和华面前。

chapters.en: The next day Moses entered the Tent of the Testimony and saw that Aaron’s staff, representing the house of Levi, had sprouted, put forth buds, blossomed, and produced almonds.
chapters.zh: 第二天，摩西进法〔柜〕的帐幕去。谁知利未族亚伦的杖已经发了芽，生了花苞，开了花，结了熟杏。

chapters.en: Then Moses brought out all the staffs from the LORD’s presence to all the Israelites. They saw them, and each man took his own staff.
chapters.zh: 摩西就把所有的杖从耶和华面前拿出来，给以色列众人看；他们看见了，各首领就把自己的杖拿去。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Put Aaron’s staff back in front of the Testimony, to be kept as a sign for the rebellious, so that you may put an end to their grumbling against Me, lest they die.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「把亚伦的杖还放在法〔柜〕前，给这些背叛之子留作记号。这样，你就使他们向我发的怨言止息，免得他们死亡。」

chapters.en: So Moses did as the LORD had commanded him.
chapters.zh: 摩西就这样行。耶和华怎样吩咐他，他就怎样行了。

chapters.en: Then the Israelites declared to Moses, “Look, we are perishing! We are lost; we are all lost!
chapters.zh: 以色列人对摩西说：「我们死啦！我们灭亡啦！都灭亡啦！

chapters.en: Anyone who comes near the tabernacle of the LORD will die. Are we all going to perish?”
chapters.zh: 凡挨近耶和华帐幕的是必死的。我们都要死亡吗？」

chapters.en: So the LORD said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your father’s house must bear the iniquity involving the sanctuary. And you and your sons alone must bear the iniquity involving your priesthood.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对亚伦说：「你和你的儿子，并你本族的人，要一同担当干犯圣所的罪孽。你和你的儿子也要一同担当干犯祭司职任的罪孽。

chapters.en: But bring with you also your brothers from the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, that they may join you and assist you and your sons before the Tent of the Testimony.
chapters.zh: 你要带你弟兄利未人，就是你祖宗支派的人前来，使他们与你联合，服事你，只是你和你的儿子，要一同在法〔柜〕的帐幕前〔供职〕。

chapters.en: And they shall attend to your duties and to all the duties of the Tent; but they must not come near to the furnishings of the sanctuary or the altar, or both they and you will die.
chapters.zh: 他们要守所吩咐你的，并守全帐幕，只是不可挨近圣所的器具和坛，免得他们和你们都死亡。

chapters.en: They are to join you and attend to the duties of the Tent of Meeting, doing all the work at the Tent; but no outsider may come near you.
chapters.zh: 他们要与你联合，也要看守会幕，办理帐幕一切的事，只是外人不可挨近你们。

chapters.en: And you shall attend to the duties of the sanctuary and of the altar, so that wrath may not fall on the Israelites again.
chapters.zh: 你们要看守圣所和坛，免得忿怒再临到以色列人。

chapters.en: Behold, I Myself have selected your fellow Levites from the Israelites as a gift to you, dedicated to the LORD to perform the service for the Tent of Meeting.
chapters.zh: 我已将你们的弟兄利未人从以色列人中拣选出来归耶和华，是给你们为赏赐的，为要办理会幕的事。

chapters.en: But only you and your sons shall attend to your priesthood for everything concerning the altar and what is inside the veil, and you are to perform that service. I am giving you the work of the priesthood as a gift, but any outsider who comes near the sanctuary must be put to death.”
chapters.zh: 你和你的儿子要为一切属坛和幔子内的事一同守祭司的职任。你们要这样供职；我将祭司的职任给你们当作赏赐事奉我。凡挨近的外人必被治死。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Aaron, “Behold, I have put you in charge of My offerings. As for all the sacred offerings of the Israelites, I have given them to you and your sons as a portion and a permanent statute.
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕亚伦说：「我已将归我的举祭，就是以色列人一切分别为圣的物，交给你经管；因你受过膏，把这些都赐给你和你的子孙，当作永得的分。

chapters.en: A portion of the most holy offerings reserved from the fire will be yours. From all the offerings they render to Me as most holy offerings, whether grain offerings or sin offerings or guilt offerings, that part belongs to you and your sons.
chapters.zh: 以色列人归给我至圣的供物，就是一切的素祭、赎罪祭、赎愆祭，其中所有〔存留〕不经火的，都为至圣之物，要归给你和你的子孙。

chapters.en: You are to eat it as a most holy offering, and every male may eat it. You shall regard it as holy.
chapters.zh: 你要拿这些当至圣物吃；凡男丁都可以吃。你当以此物为圣。

chapters.en: And this is yours as well: the offering of their gifts, along with all the wave offerings of the Israelites. I have given this to you and your sons and daughters as a permanent statute. Every ceremonially clean person in your household may eat it.
chapters.zh: 以色列人所献的举祭并摇祭都是你的；我已赐给你和你的儿女，当作永得的分；凡在你家中的洁净人都可以吃。

chapters.en: I give you all the freshest olive oil and all the finest new wine and grain that the Israelites give to the LORD as their firstfruits.
chapters.zh: 凡油中、新酒中、五谷中至好的，就是以色列人所献给耶和华初熟之物，我都赐给你。

chapters.en: The firstfruits of everything in their land that they bring to the LORD will belong to you. Every ceremonially clean person in your household may eat them.
chapters.zh: 凡从他们地上所带来给耶和华初熟之物也都要归与你。你家中的洁净人都可以吃。

chapters.en: Every devoted thing in Israel belongs to you.
chapters.zh: 以色列中一切永献的都必归与你。

chapters.en: The firstborn of every womb, whether man or beast, that is offered to the LORD belongs to you. But you must surely redeem every firstborn son and every firstborn male of unclean animals.
chapters.zh: 他们所有奉给耶和华的，连人带牲畜，凡头生的，都要归给你；只是人头生的，总要赎出来；不洁净牲畜头生的，也要赎出来。

chapters.en: You are to pay the redemption price for a month-old male according to your valuation: five shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel, which is twenty gerahs.
chapters.zh: 其中在一月之外所当赎的，要照你所估定的价，按圣所的平，用银子五舍客勒赎出来（一舍客勒是二十季拉）。

chapters.en: But you must not redeem the firstborn of an ox, a sheep, or a goat; they are holy. You are to splatter their blood on the altar and burn their fat as a food offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 只是头生的牛，或是头生的绵羊和山羊，必不可赎，都是圣的，要把牠的血洒在坛上，把牠的脂油焚烧，当作馨香的火祭献给耶和华。

chapters.en: And their meat belongs to you, just as the breast and right thigh of the wave offering belong to you.
chapters.zh: 牠的肉必归你，像被摇的胸、〔被举的〕右腿归你一样。

chapters.en: All the holy offerings that the Israelites present to the LORD I give to you and to your sons and daughters as a permanent statute. It is a permanent covenant of salt before the LORD for you and your offspring.”
chapters.zh: 凡以色列人所献给耶和华圣物中的举祭，我都赐给你和你的儿女，当作永得的分。这是给你和你的后裔、在耶和华面前作为永远的盐约〔注：盐就是不废坏的意思〕。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Aaron, “You will have no inheritance in their land, nor will you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对亚伦说：「你在以色列人的境内不可有产业，在他们中间也不可有分。我就是你的分，是你的产业。」

chapters.en: Behold, I have given to the Levites all the tithes in Israel as an inheritance in return for the work they do, the service of the Tent of Meeting.
chapters.zh: 「凡以色列中出产的十分之一，我已赐给利未的子孙为业；因他们所办的是会幕的事，所以赐给他们为酬他们的劳。

chapters.en: No longer may the Israelites come near to the Tent of Meeting, or they will incur guilt and die.
chapters.zh: 从今以后，以色列人不可挨近会幕，免得他们担罪而死。

chapters.en: The Levites are to perform the work of the Tent of Meeting, and they must bear their iniquity. This is a permanent statute for the generations to come. The Levites will not receive an inheritance among the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 惟独利未人要办会幕的事，担当罪孽；这要作你们世世代代永远的定例。他们在以色列人中不可有产业；

chapters.en: For I have given to the Levites as their inheritance the tithe that the Israelites present to the LORD as a contribution. That is why I told them that they would not receive an inheritance among the Israelites.”
chapters.zh: 因为以色列人中出产的十分之一，就是献给耶和华为举祭的，我已赐给利未人为业。所以我对他们说：『在以色列人中不可有产业。』」

chapters.en: And the LORD instructed Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：

chapters.en: “Speak to the Levites and tell them: ‘When you receive from the Israelites the tithe that I have given you as your inheritance, you must present part of it as an offering to the LORD—a tithe of the tithe.
chapters.zh: 「你晓谕利未人说：你们从以色列人中所取的十分之一，就是我给你们为业的，要再从那十分之一中取十分之一作为举祭献给耶和华，

chapters.en: Your offering will be reckoned to you as grain from the threshing floor or juice from the winepress.
chapters.zh: 这举祭要算为你们场上的谷，又如满酒醡的酒。

chapters.en: So you are to present an offering to the LORD from all the tithes you receive from the Israelites, and from these you are to give the LORD’s offering to Aaron the priest.
chapters.zh: 这样，你们从以色列人中所得的十分之一也要作举祭献给耶和华，从这十分之一中，将所献给耶和华的举祭归给祭司亚伦。

chapters.en: You must present the offering due the LORD from all the best of every gift, the holiest part of it.’
chapters.zh: 奉给你们的一切礼物，要从其中将至好的，就是分别为圣的，献给耶和华为举祭。

chapters.en: Therefore say to the Levites, ‘When you have presented the best part, it will be reckoned to you as the produce of the threshing floor or winepress.
chapters.zh: 所以你要对利未人说：你们从其中将至好的举起，这就算为你们场上的粮，又如酒醡的酒。

chapters.en: And you and your households may eat the rest of it anywhere; it is the compensation for your work at the Tent of Meeting.
chapters.zh: 你们和你们家属随处可以吃；这原是你们的赏赐，是酬你们在会幕里办事的劳。

chapters.en: Once you have presented the best part of it, you will not incur guilt because of it. But you must not defile the sacred offerings of the Israelites, or else you will die.’”
chapters.zh: 你们从其中将至好的举起，就不致因这物担罪。你们不可亵渎以色列人的圣物，免得死亡。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西、亚伦说：

chapters.en: “This is the statute of the law that the LORD has commanded: Instruct the Israelites to bring you an unblemished red heifer that has no defect and has never been placed under a yoke.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华命定律法中的一条律例乃是这样说：你要吩咐以色列人，把一只没有残疾、未曾负轭、纯红的母牛牵到你这里来，

chapters.en: Give it to Eleazar the priest, and he will have it brought outside the camp and slaughtered in his presence.
chapters.zh: 交给祭司以利亚撒；他必牵到营外，人就把牛宰在他面前。

chapters.en: Eleazar the priest is to take some of its blood on his finger and sprinkle it seven times toward the front of the Tent of Meeting.
chapters.zh: 祭司以利亚撒要用指头蘸这牛的血，向会幕前面弹七次。

chapters.en: Then the heifer must be burned in his sight. Its hide, its flesh, and its blood are to be burned, along with its dung.
chapters.zh: 人要在他眼前把这母牛焚烧；牛的皮、肉、血、粪都要焚烧。

chapters.en: The priest is to take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet wool and throw them onto the burning heifer.
chapters.zh: 祭司要把香柏木、牛膝草、朱红色〔线〕都丢在烧牛的火中。

chapters.en: Then the priest must wash his clothes and bathe his body in water; after that he may enter the camp, but he will be ceremonially unclean until evening.
chapters.zh: 祭司必不洁净到晚上，要洗衣服，用水洗身，然后可以进营。

chapters.en: The one who burned the heifer must also wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and he too will be ceremonially unclean until evening.
chapters.zh: 烧牛的人必不洁净到晚上，也要洗衣服，用水洗身。

chapters.en: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to gather up the ashes of the heifer and store them in a ceremonially clean place outside the camp. They must be kept by the congregation of Israel for preparing the water of purification; this is for purification from sin.
chapters.zh: 必有一个洁净的人收起母牛的灰，存在营外洁净的地方，为以色列会众调做除污秽的水。这本是除罪的。

chapters.en: The man who has gathered up the ashes of the heifer must also wash his clothes, and he will be ceremonially unclean until evening. This is a permanent statute for the Israelites and for the foreigner residing among them.
chapters.zh: 收起母牛灰的人必不洁净到晚上，要洗衣服。这要给以色列人和寄居在他们中间的外人作为永远的定例。」

chapters.en: Whoever touches any dead body will be unclean for seven days.
chapters.zh: 「摸了人死尸的，就必七天不洁净。

chapters.en: He must purify himself with the water on the third day and on the seventh day; then he will be clean. But if he does not purify himself on the third and seventh days, he will not be clean.
chapters.zh: 那人到第三天要用这除污秽的水洁净自己，第七天就洁净了。他若在第三天不洁净自己，第七天就不洁净了。

chapters.en: Anyone who touches a human corpse and fails to purify himself defiles the tabernacle of the LORD. That person must be cut off from Israel. He remains unclean, because the water of purification has not been sprinkled on him, and his uncleanness is still on him.
chapters.zh: 凡摸了人死尸、不洁净自己的，就玷污了耶和华的帐幕，这人必从以色列中剪除；因为那除污秽的水没有洒在他身上，他就为不洁净，污秽还在他身上。

chapters.en: This is the law when a person dies in a tent: Everyone who enters the tent and everyone already in the tent will be unclean for seven days,
chapters.zh: 「人死在帐棚里的条例乃是这样：凡进那帐棚的，和一切在帐棚里的，都必七天不洁净。

chapters.en: and any open container without a lid fastened on it is unclean.
chapters.zh: 凡敞口的器皿，就是没有扎上盖的，也是不洁净。

chapters.en: Anyone in the open field who touches someone who has been killed by the sword or has died of natural causes, or anyone who touches a human bone or a grave, will be unclean for seven days.
chapters.zh: 无论何人在田野里摸了被刀杀的，或是尸首，或是人的骨头，或是坟墓，就要七天不洁净。

chapters.en: For the purification of the unclean person, take some of the ashes of the burnt sin offering, put them in a jar, and pour fresh water over them.
chapters.zh: 要为这不洁净的人拿些烧成的除罪灰放在器皿里，倒上活水。

chapters.en: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to take some hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle the tent, all the furnishings, and the people who were there. He is also to sprinkle the one who touched a bone, a grave, or a person who has died or been slain.
chapters.zh: 必当有一个洁净的人拿牛膝草蘸在这水中，把水洒在帐棚上，和一切器皿并帐棚内的众人身上，又洒在摸了骨头，或摸了被杀的，或摸了自死的，或摸了坟墓的那人身上。

chapters.en: The man who is ceremonially clean is to sprinkle the unclean person on the third day and on the seventh day. After he purifies the unclean person on the seventh day, the one being cleansed must wash his clothes and bathe in water, and that evening he will be clean.
chapters.zh: 第三天和第七天，洁净的人要洒水在不洁净的人身上，第七天就使他成为洁净。那人要洗衣服，用水洗澡，到晚上就洁净了。

chapters.en: But if a person who is unclean does not purify himself, he will be cut off from the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD. The water of purification has not been sprinkled on him; he is unclean.
chapters.zh: 「但那污秽而不洁净自己的，要将他从会中剪除，因为他玷污了耶和华的圣所。除污秽的水没有洒在他身上，他是不洁净的。

chapters.en: This is a permanent statute for the people: The one who sprinkles the water of purification must wash his clothes, and whoever touches the water of purification will be unclean until evening.
chapters.zh: 这要给你们作为永远的定例。并且那洒除污秽水的人要洗衣服。凡摸除污秽水的，必不洁净到晚上。

chapters.en: Anything the unclean person touches will become unclean, and anyone who touches it will be unclean until evening.”
chapters.zh: 不洁净人所摸的一切物就不洁净；摸了这物的人必不洁净到晚上。」

chapters.en: In the first month, the whole congregation of Israel entered the Wilderness of Zin and stayed in Kadesh. There Miriam died and was buried.
chapters.zh: 正月间，以色列全会众到了寻的旷野，就住在加低斯。米利暗死在那里，就葬在那里。

chapters.en: Now there was no water for the congregation, so they gathered against Moses and Aaron.
chapters.zh: 会众没有水喝，就聚集攻击摩西、亚伦。

chapters.en: The people quarreled with Moses and said, “If only we had perished with our brothers before the LORD!
chapters.zh: 百姓向摩西争闹说：「我们的弟兄曾死在耶和华面前，我们恨不得与他们同死。

chapters.en: Why have you brought the LORD’s assembly into this wilderness for us and our livestock to die here?
chapters.zh: 你们为何把耶和华的会众领到这旷野、使我们和牲畜都死在这里呢？

chapters.en: Why have you led us up out of Egypt to bring us to this wretched place? It is not a place of grain, figs, vines, or pomegranates—and there is no water to drink!”
chapters.zh: 你们为何逼着我们出埃及、领我们到这坏地方呢？这地方不好撒种，也没有无花果树、葡萄树、石榴树，又没有水喝。」

chapters.en: Then Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. They fell facedown, and the glory of the LORD appeared to them.
chapters.zh: 摩西、亚伦离开会众，到会幕门口，俯伏在地；耶和华的荣光向他们显现。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “Take the staff and assemble the congregation. You and your brother Aaron are to speak to the rock while they watch, and it will pour out its water. You will bring out water from the rock and provide drink for the congregation and their livestock.”
chapters.zh: 「你拿着杖去，和你的哥哥亚伦招聚会众，在他们眼前吩咐磐石发出水来，水就从磐石流出，给会众和他们的牲畜喝。」

chapters.en: So Moses took the staff from the LORD’s presence, just as he had been commanded.
chapters.zh: 于是摩西照耶和华所吩咐的，从耶和华面前取了杖去。

chapters.en: Then Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly in front of the rock, and Moses said to them, “Listen now, you rebels, must we bring you water out of this rock?”
chapters.zh: 摩西、亚伦就招聚会众到磐石前。摩西说：「你们这些背叛的人听我说：我为你们使水从这磐石中流出来吗？」

chapters.en: Then Moses raised his hand and struck the rock twice with his staff, so that a great amount of water gushed out, and the congregation and their livestock were able to drink.
chapters.zh: 摩西举手，用杖击打磐石两下，就有许多水流出来，会众和他们的牲畜都喝了。

chapters.en: But the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you did not trust Me to show My holiness in the sight of the Israelites, you will not bring this assembly into the land that I have given them.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西、亚伦说：「因为你们不信我，不在以色列人眼前尊我为圣，所以你们必不得领这会众进我所赐给他们的地去。」

chapters.en: These were the waters of Meribah, where the Israelites quarreled with the LORD, and He showed His holiness among them.
chapters.zh: 这水名叫米利巴水〔注：米利巴就是争闹的意思〕，是因以色列人向耶和华争闹，耶和华就在他们面前显为圣。

chapters.en: From Kadesh, Moses sent messengers to tell the king of Edom, “This is what your brother Israel says: You know all the hardship that has befallen us,
chapters.zh: 摩西从加低斯差遣使者去见以东王，说：「你的弟兄以色列人这样说：『我们所遭遇的一切艰难，

chapters.en: how our fathers went down to Egypt, where we lived many years. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers,
chapters.zh: 就是我们的列祖下到埃及，我们在埃及久住；埃及人恶待我们的列祖和我们，

chapters.en:
and when we cried out to the LORD, He heard our voice, sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt.
Now look, we are in Kadesh, a city on the edge of your territory.
chapters.zh: 我们哀求耶和华的时候，他听了我们的声音，差遣使者把我们从埃及领出来。这事你都知道。如今，我们在你边界上的城加低斯。

chapters.en: Please let us pass through your land. We will not go through any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will stay on the King’s Highway; we will not turn to the right or to the left until we have passed through your territory.”
chapters.zh: 求你容我们从你的地经过。我们不走田间和葡萄园，也不喝井里的水，只走大道〔注：原文是王道〕，不偏左右，直到过了你的境界。』」

chapters.en: But Edom answered, “You may not travel through our land, or we will come out and confront you with the sword.”
chapters.zh: 以东〔王〕说：「你不可从我的〔地〕经过，免得我带刀出去攻击你。」

chapters.en: “We will stay on the main road,” the Israelites replied, “and if we or our herds drink your water, we will pay for it. There will be no problem; only let us pass through on foot.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人说：「我们要走大道上去；我们和牲畜若喝你的水，必给你价值。不求别的，只求你容我们步行过去。」

chapters.en: But Edom insisted, “You may not pass through.” And they came out to confront the Israelites with a large army and a strong hand.
chapters.zh: 以东〔王〕说：「你们不可经过！」就率领许多人出来，要用强硬的手攻击以色列人。

chapters.en: So Edom refused to allow Israel to pass through their territory, and Israel turned away from them.
chapters.zh: 这样，以东〔王〕不肯容以色列人从他的境界过去。于是他们转去，离开他。

chapters.en: After they had set out from Kadesh, the whole congregation of Israel came to Mount Hor.
chapters.zh: 以色列全会众从加低斯起行，到了何珥山。

chapters.en: And at Mount Hor, near the border of the land of Edom, the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
chapters.zh: 耶和华在附近以东边界的何珥山上晓谕摩西、亚伦说：

chapters.en: “Aaron will be gathered to his people; he will not enter the land that I have given the Israelites, because both of you rebelled against My command at the waters of Meribah.
chapters.zh: 「亚伦要归到他列祖〔注：原文是本民〕那里。他必不得入我所赐给以色列人的地；因为在米利巴水，你们违背了我的命。

chapters.en: Take Aaron and his son Eleazar and bring them up Mount Hor.
chapters.zh: 你带亚伦和他的儿子以利亚撒上何珥山，

chapters.en: Remove Aaron’s priestly garments and put them on his son Eleazar. Aaron will be gathered to his people and will die there.”
chapters.zh: 把亚伦的〔圣〕衣脱下来，给他的儿子以利亚撒穿上；亚伦必死在那里，归〔他列祖〕。」

chapters.en: So Moses did as the LORD had commanded, and they climbed Mount Hor in the sight of the whole congregation.
chapters.zh: 摩西就照耶和华所吩咐的行。三人当着会众的眼前上了何珥山。

chapters.en: After Moses had removed Aaron’s garments and put them on his son Eleazar, Aaron died there on top of the mountain. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
chapters.zh: 摩西把亚伦的〔圣〕衣脱下来，给他的儿子以利亚撒穿上，亚伦就死在山顶那里。于是摩西和以利亚撒下了山。

chapters.en: When the whole congregation saw that Aaron had died, the entire house of Israel mourned for him thirty days.
chapters.zh: 全会众，就是以色列全家，见亚伦已经死了，便都为亚伦哀哭了三十天。

chapters.en: When the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev, heard that Israel was coming along the road to Atharim, he attacked Israel and captured some prisoners.
chapters.zh: 住南地的迦南人亚拉得王，听说以色列人从亚他林路来，就和以色列人争战，掳了他们几个人。

chapters.en: So Israel made a vow to the LORD: “If You will deliver this people into our hands, we will devote their cities to destruction. ”
chapters.zh: 以色列人向耶和华发愿说：「你若将这民交付我手，我就把他们的城邑尽行毁灭。」

chapters.en: And the LORD heard Israel’s plea and delivered up the Canaanites. Israel devoted them and their cities to destruction; so they named the place Hormah.
chapters.zh: 耶和华应允了以色列人，把迦南人交付他们，他们就把迦南人和迦南人的城邑尽行毁灭。那地方的名便叫何珥玛〔注：就是毁灭的意思〕。

chapters.en: Then they set out from Mount Hor along the route to the Red Sea, in order to bypass the land of Edom. But the people grew impatient on the journey
chapters.zh: 他们从何珥山起行，往红海那条路走，要绕过以东地。百姓因这路难行，心中甚是烦躁，

chapters.en: and spoke against God and against Moses: “Why have you led us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? There is no bread or water, and we detest this wretched food!”
chapters.zh: 就怨讟上帝和摩西说：「你们为什么把我们从埃及领出来、使我们死在旷野呢？这里没有粮，没有水，我们的心厌恶这淡薄的食物。」

chapters.en: So the LORD sent venomous snakes among the people, and many of the Israelites were bitten and died.
chapters.zh: 于是耶和华使火蛇进入百姓中间，蛇就咬他们。以色列人中死了许多。

chapters.en: Then the people came to Moses and said, “We have sinned by speaking against the LORD and against you. Intercede with the LORD so He will take the snakes away from us.” So Moses interceded for the people.
chapters.zh: 百姓到摩西那里，说：「我们怨讟耶和华和你，有罪了。求你祷告耶和华，叫这些蛇离开我们。」于是摩西为百姓祷告。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Make a fiery serpent and mount it on a pole. When anyone who is bitten looks at it, he will live.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「你制造一条火蛇，挂在杆子上；凡被咬的，一望这蛇，就必得活。」

chapters.en: So Moses made a bronze snake and mounted it on a pole. If anyone who was bitten looked at the bronze snake, he would live.
chapters.zh: 摩西便制造一条铜蛇，挂在杆子上；凡被蛇咬的，一望这铜蛇就活了。

chapters.en: Then the Israelites set out and camped at Oboth.
chapters.zh: 以色列人起行，安营在阿伯。

chapters.en: They journeyed from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim in the wilderness opposite Moab to the east.
chapters.zh: 又从阿伯起行，安营在以耶‧亚巴琳，与摩押相对的旷野，向日出之地。

chapters.en: From there they set out and camped in the Valley of Zered.
chapters.zh: 从那里起行，安营在撒烈谷。

chapters.en:
From there they moved on and camped on the other side of the Arnon, in the wilderness that extends into the Amorite territory.
Now the Arnon is the border between the Moabites and the Amorites.
chapters.zh: 从那里起行，安营在亚嫩河那边。这亚嫩河是在旷野，从亚摩利的境界流出来的；原来亚嫩河是摩押的边界，在摩押和亚摩利人搭界的地方。

chapters.en:
Therefore it is stated in the Book of the Wars of the LORD:
“Waheb in Suphah and the wadis of the Arnon,
