chapters.zh: 所以耶和华的战记上说：「苏法的哇哈伯与亚嫩河的谷，

chapters.en:
even the slopes of the wadis that extend to the site of Ar
and lie along the border of Moab.”
chapters.zh: 并向亚珥城众谷的下坡，是靠近摩押的境界。」

chapters.en: From there they went on to Beer, the well where the LORD said to Moses, “Gather the people so that I may give them water.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人从那里〔起行〕，到了比珥〔注：就是井的意思〕。从前耶和华吩咐摩西说：「招聚百姓，我好给他们水喝」，说的就是这井。

chapters.en:
Then Israel sang this song:
“Spring up, O well, all of you sing to it!
chapters.zh: 当时，以色列人唱歌说： 井啊，涌上水来！ 你们要向这井歌唱。

chapters.en:
The princes dug the well; the nobles of the people hollowed it out with their scepters and with their staffs.”
From the wilderness the Israelites went on to Mattanah,
chapters.zh: 这井是首领和民中的尊贵人 用圭用杖所挖所掘的。 以色列人从旷野往玛他拿去，

chapters.en: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel, and from Nahaliel to Bamoth,
chapters.zh: 从玛他拿到拿哈列，从拿哈列到巴末，

chapters.en: and from Bamoth to the valley in Moab where the top of Pisgah overlooks the wasteland.
chapters.zh: 从巴末到摩押地的谷，又到那下望旷野之毗斯迦的山顶。

chapters.en: Then Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
chapters.zh: 以色列人差遣使者去见亚摩利人的王西宏，说：

chapters.en: “Let us pass through your land. We will not turn aside into any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will stay on the King’s Highway until we have passed through your territory.”
chapters.zh: 「求你容我们从你的地经过；我们不偏入田间和葡萄园，也不喝井里的水，只走大道〔注：原文是王道〕，直到过了你的境界。」

chapters.en: But Sihon would not let Israel pass through his territory. Instead, he gathered his whole army and went out to confront Israel in the wilderness. When he came to Jahaz, he fought against Israel.
chapters.zh: 西宏不容以色列人从他的境界经过，就招聚他的众民出到旷野，要攻击以色列人，到了雅杂与以色列人争战。

chapters.en: And Israel put him to the sword and took possession of his land, from the Arnon to the Jabbok—but only up to the border of the Ammonites, because it was fortified.
chapters.zh: 以色列人用刀杀了他，得了他的地，从亚嫩河到雅博河，直到亚扪人的〔境界〕，因为亚扪人的境界多有坚垒。

chapters.en: Israel captured all the cities of the Amorites and occupied them, including Heshbon and all its villages.
chapters.zh: 以色列人夺取这一切的城邑，也住亚摩利人的城邑，就是希实本与希实本的一切乡村。

chapters.en: Heshbon was the city of Sihon king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab and taken all his land as far as the Arnon.
chapters.zh: 这希实本是亚摩利王西宏的〔京〕城；西宏曾与摩押的先王争战，从他手中夺取了全地，直到亚嫩河。

chapters.en:
That is why the poets say:
“Come to Heshbon, let it be rebuilt; let the city of Sihon be restored.
chapters.zh: 所以那些作诗歌的说： 你们来到希实本； 愿西宏的城被修造，被建立。

chapters.en: For a fire went out from Heshbon, a blaze from the city of Sihon. It consumed Ar of Moab, the rulers of Arnon’s heights.
chapters.zh: 因为有火从希实本发出， 有火焰出于西宏的城， 烧尽摩押的亚珥和亚嫩河邱坛的祭司〔注：祭司原文是主〕。

chapters.en:
Woe to you, O Moab! You are destroyed, O people of Chemosh! He gave up his sons as refugees, and his daughters into captivity
to Sihon king of the Amorites.
chapters.zh: 摩押啊，你有祸了！ 基抹的民哪，你们灭亡了！ 基抹的男子逃奔， 女子被掳，交付亚摩利的王西宏。

chapters.en: But we have overthrown them; Heshbon is destroyed as far as Dibon. We demolished them as far as Nophah, which reaches to Medeba. ”
chapters.zh: 我们射了他们； 希实本直到底本尽皆毁灭。 我们使地变成荒场，直到挪法； 这挪法直〔延〕到米底巴。

chapters.en: So Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.
chapters.zh: 这样，以色列人就住在亚摩利人之地。

chapters.en: After Moses had sent spies to Jazer, Israel captured its villages and drove out the Amorites who were there.
chapters.zh: 摩西打发人去窥探雅谢，以色列人就佔了雅谢的镇市，赶出那里的亚摩利人。

chapters.en: Then they turned and went up the road to Bashan, and Og king of Bashan and his whole army came out to meet them in battle at Edrei.
chapters.zh: 以色列人转回，向巴珊去。巴珊王噩和他的众民都出来，在以得来与他们交战。

chapters.en: But the LORD said to Moses, “Do not fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, along with all his people and his land. Do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「不要怕他！因我已将他和他的众民，并他的地，都交在你手中；你要待他像从前待住希实本的亚摩利王西宏一般。」

chapters.en: So they struck down Og, along with his sons and his whole army, until no remnant was left. And they took possession of his land.
chapters.zh: 于是他们杀了他和他的众子，并他的众民，没有留下一个，就得了他的地。

chapters.en: Then the Israelites traveled on and camped in the plains of Moab near the Jordan, across from Jericho.
chapters.zh: 以色列人起行，在摩押平原、约旦河东，对着耶利哥安营。

chapters.en: Now Balak son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites,
chapters.zh: 以色列人向亚摩利人所行的一切事，西拨的儿子巴勒都看见了。

chapters.en: and Moab was terrified of the people because they were numerous. Indeed, Moab dreaded the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 摩押人因以色列民甚多，就大大惧怕，心内忧急，

chapters.en:
So the Moabites said to the elders of Midian, “This horde will devour everything around us, as an ox licks up the grass of the field.”
Since Balak son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time,
chapters.zh: 对米甸的长老说：「现在这众人要把我们四围所有的一概餂尽，就如牛餂尽田间的草一般。」那时西拨的儿子巴勒作摩押王。

chapters.en:
he sent messengers to summon Balaam son of Beor at Pethor, which is by the Euphrates in the land of his people.
“Behold, a people has come out of Egypt,” said Balak. “They cover the face of the land and have settled next to me.
chapters.zh: 他差遣使者往大河边的毗夺去，到比珥的儿子巴兰本乡那里，召巴兰来，说：「有一宗民从埃及出来，遮满地面，与我对居。

chapters.en: So please come now and put a curse on this people, because they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I may be able to defeat them and drive them out of the land; for I know that those you bless are blessed, and those you curse are cursed.”
chapters.zh: 这民比我强盛，现在求你来为我咒诅他们，或者我能得胜，攻打他们，赶出此地。因为我知道，你为谁祝福，谁就得福；你咒诅谁，谁就受咒诅。」

chapters.en: The elders of Moab and Midian departed with the fees for divination in hand. They came to Balaam and relayed to him the words of Balak.
chapters.zh: 摩押的长老和米甸的长老手里拿着卦金，到了巴兰那里，将巴勒的话都告诉了他。

chapters.en: “Spend the night here,” Balaam replied, “and I will give you the answer that the LORD speaks to me.” So the princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.
chapters.zh: 巴兰说：「你们今夜在这里住宿，我必照耶和华所晓谕我的回报你们。」摩押的使臣就在巴兰那里住下了。

chapters.en: Then God came to Balaam and asked, “Who are these men with you?”
chapters.zh: 上帝临到巴兰那里，说：「在你这里的人都是谁？」

chapters.en: And Balaam said to God, “Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, sent me this message:
chapters.zh: 巴兰回答说：「是摩押王西拨的儿子巴勒打发人到我这里来，〔说〕：

chapters.en: ‘Behold, a people has come out of Egypt, and they cover the face of the land. Now come and put a curse on them for me. Perhaps I may be able to fight against them and drive them away.’”
chapters.zh: 『从埃及出来的民遮满地面，你来为我咒诅他们，或者我能与他们争战，把他们赶出去。』」

chapters.en: But God said to Balaam, “Do not go with them. You are not to curse this people, for they are blessed.”
chapters.zh: 上帝对巴兰说：「你不可同他们去，也不可咒诅那民，因为那民是蒙福的。」

chapters.en: So Balaam got up the next morning and said to Balak’s princes, “Go back to your homeland, because the LORD has refused to let me go with you.”
chapters.zh: 巴兰早晨起来，对巴勒的使臣说：「你们回本地去吧，因为耶和华不容我和你们同去。」

chapters.en: And the princes of Moab arose, returned to Balak, and said, “Balaam refused to come with us.”
chapters.zh: 摩押的使臣就起来，回巴勒那里去，说：「巴兰不肯和我们同来。」

chapters.en: Then Balak sent other princes, more numerous and more distinguished than the first messengers.
chapters.zh: 巴勒又差遣使臣，比先前的又多又尊贵。

chapters.en: They came to Balaam and said, “This is what Balak son of Zippor says: ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me,
chapters.zh: 他们到了巴兰那里，对他说：「西拨的儿子巴勒这样说：『求你不容什么事拦阻你不到我这里来，

chapters.en: for I will honor you richly and do whatever you say. So please come and put a curse on this people for me!’”
chapters.zh: 因为我必使你得极大的尊荣。你向我要什么，我就给你什么；只求你来为我咒诅这民。』」

chapters.en: But Balaam replied to the servants of Balak, “If Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not do anything small or great to go beyond the command of the LORD my God.
chapters.zh: 巴兰回答巴勒的臣仆说：「巴勒就是将他满屋的金银给我，我行大事小事也不得越过耶和华－我上帝的命。

chapters.en: So now, please stay here overnight as the others did, that I may find out what else the LORD has to tell me.”
chapters.zh: 现在我请你们今夜在这里住宿，等我得知耶和华还要对我说什么。」

chapters.en: That night God came to Balaam and said, “Since these men have come to summon you, get up and go with them, but you must only do what I tell you.”
chapters.zh: 当夜，上帝临到巴兰那里，说：「这些人若来召你，你就起来同他们去，你只要遵行我对你所说的话。」

chapters.en: So in the morning Balaam got up, saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.
chapters.zh: 巴兰早晨起来，备上驴，和摩押的使臣一同去了。

chapters.en: Then God’s anger was kindled because Balaam was going along, and the angel of the LORD stood in the road to oppose him. Balaam was riding his donkey, and his two servants were with him.
chapters.zh: 上帝因他去就发了怒；耶和华的使者站在路上敌挡他。他骑着驴，有两个仆人跟随他。

chapters.en: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand, she turned off the path and went into a field. So Balaam beat her to return her to the path.
chapters.zh: 驴看见耶和华的使者站在路上，手里有拔出来的刀，就从路上跨进田间，巴兰便打驴，要叫牠回转上路。

chapters.en: Then the angel of the LORD stood in a narrow passage between two vineyards, with walls on either side.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者就站在葡萄园的窄路上；这边有墙，那边也有墙。

chapters.en: And the donkey saw the angel of the LORD and pressed herself against the wall, crushing Balaam’s foot against it. So he beat her once again.
chapters.zh: 驴看见耶和华的使者，就贴靠墙，将巴兰的脚挤伤了；巴兰又打驴。

chapters.en: And the angel of the LORD moved on ahead and stood in a narrow place where there was no room to turn to the right or left.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者又往前去，站在狭窄之处，左右都没有转折的地方。

chapters.en: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, she lay down under Balaam, and he became furious and beat her with his staff.
chapters.zh: 驴看见耶和华的使者，就卧在巴兰底下，巴兰发怒，用杖打驴。

chapters.en: Then the LORD opened the donkey’s mouth, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you that you have beaten me these three times?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华叫驴开口，对巴兰说：「我向你行了什么，你竟打我这三次呢？」

chapters.en: Balaam answered the donkey, “You have made a fool of me! If I had a sword in my hand, I would kill you right now!”
chapters.zh: 巴兰对驴说：「因为你戏弄我，我恨不能手中有刀，把你杀了。」

chapters.en:
But the donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not the donkey you have ridden all your life until today? Have I ever treated you this way before?”
“No,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 驴对巴兰说：「我不是你从小时直到今日所骑的驴吗？我素常向你这样行过吗？」巴兰说：「没有。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD opened Balaam’s eyes, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand. And Balaam bowed low and fell facedown.
chapters.zh: 当时，耶和华使巴兰的眼目明亮，他就看见耶和华的使者站在路上，手里有拔出来的刀，巴兰便低头俯伏在地。

chapters.en: The angel of the LORD asked him, “Why have you beaten your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out to oppose you, because your way is perverse before me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者对他说：「你为何这三次打你的驴呢？我出来敌挡你，因你所行的，在我面前偏僻。

chapters.en: The donkey saw me and turned away from me these three times. If she had not turned away, then by now I would surely have killed you and let her live.”
chapters.zh: 驴看见我就三次从我面前偏过去；驴若没有偏过去，我早把你杀了，留牠存活。」

chapters.en: “I have sinned,” Balaam said to the angel of the LORD, “for I did not realize that you were standing in the road to confront me. And now, if this is displeasing in your sight, I will go back home.”
chapters.zh: 巴兰对耶和华的使者说：「我有罪了。我不知道你站在路上阻挡我；你若不喜欢我去，我就转回。」

chapters.en: But the angel of the LORD said to Balaam, “Go with the men, but you are to speak only what I tell you.” So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者对巴兰说：「你同这些人去吧！你只要说我对你说的话。」于是巴兰同着巴勒的使臣去了。

chapters.en: When Balak heard that Balaam was coming, he went out to meet him at the Moabite city on the Arnon border, at the edge of his territory.
chapters.zh: 巴勒听见巴兰来了，就往摩押〔京〕城去迎接他；这城是在边界上，在亚嫩河旁。

chapters.en: And he said to Balaam, “Did I not send you an urgent summons? Why did you not come to me? Am I really not able to reward you richly?”
chapters.zh: 巴勒对巴兰说：「我不是急急地打发人到你那里去召你吗？你为何不到我这里来呢？我岂不能使你得尊荣吗？」

chapters.en: “See, I have come to you,” Balaam replied, “but can I say just anything? I must speak only the word that God puts in my mouth.”
chapters.zh: 巴兰说：「我已经到你这里来了！现在我岂能擅自说什么呢？上帝将什么话传给我，我就说什么。」

chapters.en: So Balaam accompanied Balak, and they came to Kiriath-huzoth.
chapters.zh: 巴兰和巴勒同行，来到基列‧胡琐。

chapters.en: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and he gave portions to Balaam and the princes who were with him.
chapters.zh: 巴勒宰了〔注：原文是献〕牛羊，送给巴兰和陪伴的使臣。

chapters.en: The next morning, Balak took Balaam and brought him up to Bamoth-baal. From there he could see the outskirts of the camp of the people.
chapters.zh: 到了早晨，巴勒领巴兰到巴力的高处；巴兰从那里观看以色列〔营〕的边界。

chapters.en: Then Balaam said to Balak, “Build for me seven altars here, and prepare for me seven bulls and seven rams.”
chapters.zh: 巴兰对巴勒说：「你在这里给我筑七座坛，为我预备七只公牛，七只公羊。」

chapters.en: So Balak did as Balaam had instructed, and Balak and Balaam offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
chapters.zh: 巴勒照巴兰的话行了。巴勒和巴兰在每座坛上献一只公牛，一只公羊。

chapters.en:
“Stay here by your burnt offering while I am gone,” Balaam said to Balak. “Perhaps the LORD will meet with me. And whatever He reveals to me, I will tell you.”
So Balaam went off to a barren height,
chapters.zh: 巴兰对巴勒说：「你站在你的燔祭旁边，我且往前去，或者耶和华来迎见我。他指示我什么，我必告诉你。」于是巴兰上一净光的高处。

chapters.en: and God met with him. “I have set up seven altars,” Balaam said, “and on each altar I have offered a bull and a ram.”
chapters.zh: 上帝迎见巴兰；巴兰说：「我预备了七座坛，在每座坛上献了一只公牛，一只公羊。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD put a message in Balaam’s mouth, saying, “Return to Balak and give him this message.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华将话传给巴兰，又说：「你回到巴勒那里，要如此如此说。」

chapters.en: So he returned to Balak, who was standing there beside his burnt offering, with all the princes of Moab.
chapters.zh: 他就回到巴勒那里，见他同摩押的使臣都站在燔祭旁边。

chapters.en:
And Balaam lifted up an oracle, saying:
“Balak brought me from Aram, the king of Moab from the mountains of the east. ‘Come,’ he said, ‘put a curse on Jacob for me; come and denounce Israel!’
chapters.zh: 巴兰便题起诗歌说： 巴勒引我出亚兰， 摩押王引我出东山，〔说〕： 来啊，为我咒诅雅各； 来啊，怒骂以色列。

chapters.en: How can I curse those whom God has not cursed? How can I denounce those whom the LORD has not denounced?
chapters.zh: 上帝没有咒诅的，我焉能咒诅？ 耶和华没有怒骂的，我焉能怒骂？

chapters.en: For I see them from atop the rocky cliffs, and I watch them from the hills. Behold, a people dwelling apart, not reckoning themselves among the nations.
chapters.zh: 我从高峰看他，从小山望他； 这是独居的民，不列在万民中。

chapters.en: Who can count the dust of Jacob or number even a fourth of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous; let my end be like theirs!”
chapters.zh: 谁能数点雅各的尘土？ 谁能计算以色列的四分之一？ 我愿如义人之死而死； 我愿如义人之终而终。

chapters.en: Then Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I brought you here to curse my enemies, and behold, you have only blessed them!”
chapters.zh: 巴勒对巴兰说：「你向我做的是什么事呢？我领你来咒诅我的仇敌，不料，你竟为他们祝福。」

chapters.en: But Balaam replied, “Should I not speak exactly what the LORD puts in my mouth?”
chapters.zh: 他回答说：「耶和华传给我的话，我能不谨慎传说吗？」

chapters.en: Then Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place where you can see them. You will only see the outskirts of their camp—not all of them. And from there, curse them for me.”
chapters.zh: 巴勒说：「求你同我往别处去，在那里可以看见他们；你不能全看见，只能看见他们边界上的人。在那里要为我咒诅他们。」

chapters.en: So Balak took him to the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, where he built seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
chapters.zh: 于是领巴兰到了琐腓田，上了毗斯迦山顶，筑了七座坛；每座坛上献一只公牛，一只公羊。

chapters.en: Balaam said to Balak, “Stay here beside your burnt offering while I meet the LORD over there.”
chapters.zh: 巴兰对巴勒说：「你站在这燔祭旁边，等我往那边去迎见〔耶和华〕。」

chapters.en: And the LORD met with Balaam and put a message in his mouth, saying, “Return to Balak and speak what I tell you.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华临到巴兰那里，将话传给他；又说：「你回到巴勒那里，要如此如此说。」

chapters.en:
So he returned to Balak, who was standing there by his burnt offering with the princes of Moab.
“What did the LORD say?” Balak asked.
chapters.zh: 他就回到巴勒那里，见他站在燔祭旁边；摩押的使臣也和他在一处。巴勒问他说：「耶和华说了什么话呢？」

chapters.en:
Then Balaam lifted up an oracle, saying:
“Arise, O Balak, and listen; give ear to me, O son of Zippor.
chapters.zh: 巴兰就题诗歌说： 巴勒，你起来听； 西拨的儿子，你听我言。

chapters.en: God is not a man, that He should lie, or a son of man, that He should change His mind. Does He speak and not act? Does He promise and not fulfill?
chapters.zh: 上帝非人，必不致说谎， 也非人子，必不致后悔。 他说话岂不照着行呢？ 他发言岂不要成就呢？

chapters.en: I have indeed received a command to bless; He has blessed, and I cannot change it.
chapters.zh: 我奉〔命〕祝福； 上帝也曾赐福，此事我不能翻转。

chapters.en: He considers no disaster for Jacob; He sees no trouble for Israel. The LORD their God is with them, and the shout of the King is among them.
chapters.zh: 他未见雅各中有罪孽， 也未见以色列中有奸恶。 耶和华－他的上帝和他同在； 有欢呼王的声音在他们中间。

chapters.en: God brought them out of Egypt with strength like a wild ox.
chapters.zh: 上帝领他们出埃及； 他们似乎有野牛之力。

chapters.en: For there is no spell against Jacob and no divination against Israel. It will now be said of Jacob and Israel, ‘What great things God has done!’
chapters.zh: 断没有法术可以害雅各， 也没有占卜可以害以色列。 现在必有人论及雅各，就是论及以色列说： 上帝为他行了何等的大事！

chapters.en: Behold, the people rise like a lioness; they rouse themselves like a lion, not resting until they devour their prey and drink the blood of the slain.”
chapters.zh: 这民起来，仿佛母狮， 挺身，好像公狮， 未曾吃野食， 未曾喝被伤者之血，决不躺卧。

chapters.en: Now Balak said to Balaam, “Then neither curse them at all nor bless them at all!”
chapters.zh: 巴勒对巴兰说：「你一点不要咒诅他们，也不要为他们祝福。」

chapters.en: But Balaam replied, “Did I not tell you that whatever the LORD says, I must do?”
chapters.zh: 巴兰回答巴勒说：「我岂不是告诉你说『凡耶和华所说的，我必须遵行』吗？」

chapters.en: “Please come,” said Balak, “I will take you to another place. Perhaps it will please God that you curse them for me from there.”
chapters.zh: 巴勒对巴兰说：「来吧，我领你往别处去，或者上帝喜欢你在那里为我咒诅他们。」

chapters.en: And Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, which overlooks the wasteland.
chapters.zh: 巴勒就领巴兰到那下望旷野的毗珥〔山〕顶上。

chapters.en: Then Balaam said, “Build for me seven altars here, and prepare for me seven bulls and seven rams.”
chapters.zh: 巴兰对巴勒说：「你在这里为我筑七座坛，又在这里为我预备七只公牛，七只公羊。」

chapters.en: So Balak did as Balaam had instructed, and he offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
chapters.zh: 巴勒就照巴兰的话行，在每座坛上献一只公牛，一只公羊。

chapters.en: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he did not seek omens as on previous occasions, but he turned his face toward the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 巴兰见耶和华喜欢赐福与以色列，就不像前两次去求法术，却面向旷野。

chapters.en: When Balaam looked up and saw Israel encamped tribe by tribe, the Spirit of God came upon him,
chapters.zh: 巴兰举目，看见以色列人照着支派居住。上帝的灵就临到他身上，

chapters.en:
and he lifted up an oracle, saying:
“This is the prophecy of Balaam son of Beor, the prophecy of a man whose eyes are open,
chapters.zh: 他便题起诗歌说： 比珥的儿子巴兰说， 眼目闭住〔注：或译：睁开〕的人说，

chapters.en:
the prophecy of one who hears the words of God, who sees a vision from the Almighty,
who bows down with eyes wide open:
chapters.zh: 得听上帝的言语， 得见全能者的异象， 眼目睁开而仆倒的人说：

chapters.en: How lovely are your tents, O Jacob, your dwellings, O Israel!
chapters.zh: 雅各啊，你的帐棚何等华美！ 以色列啊，你的帐幕何其华丽！

chapters.en: They spread out like palm groves, like gardens beside a stream, like aloes the LORD has planted, like cedars beside the waters.
chapters.zh: 如接连的山谷， 如河旁的园子， 如耶和华所栽的沉香树， 如水边的香柏木。

chapters.en: Water will flow from his buckets, and his seed will have abundant water. His king will be greater than Agag, and his kingdom will be exalted.
chapters.zh: 水要从他的桶里流出； 种子要撒在多水之处。 他的王必超过亚甲； 他的国必要振兴。

chapters.en: God brought him out of Egypt with strength like a wild ox, to devour hostile nations and crush their bones, to pierce them with arrows.
chapters.zh: 上帝领他出埃及； 他似乎有野牛之力。 他要吞吃敌国， 折断他们的骨头， 用箭射透他们。

chapters.en: He crouches, he lies down like a lion, like a lioness—who dares to rouse him? Blessed are those who bless you and cursed are those who curse you.”
chapters.zh: 他蹲如公狮， 卧如母狮，谁敢惹他？ 凡给你祝福的，愿他蒙福； 凡咒诅你的，愿他受咒诅。

chapters.en: Then Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together and said to Balaam, “I summoned you to curse my enemies, but behold, you have persisted in blessing them these three times.
chapters.zh: 巴勒向巴兰生气，就拍起手来，对巴兰说：「我召你来为我咒诅仇敌，不料，你这三次竟为他们祝福。

chapters.en: Therefore, flee at once to your home! I said I would reward you richly, but instead the LORD has denied your reward.”
chapters.zh: 如今你快回本地去吧！我想使你得大尊荣，耶和华却阻止你不得尊荣。」

chapters.en: Balaam answered Balak, “Did I not already tell the messengers you sent me
chapters.zh: 巴兰对巴勒说：「我岂不是对你所差遣到我那里的使者说：

chapters.en: that even if Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not do anything of my own accord, good or bad, to go beyond the command of the LORD? I must speak whatever the LORD says.
chapters.zh: 『巴勒就是将他满屋的金银给我，我也不得越过耶和华的命，凭自己的心意行好行歹。耶和华说什么，我就要说什么』？」

chapters.en: Now I am going back to my people, but come, let me warn you what this people will do to your people in the days to come.”
chapters.zh: 「现在我要回本族去。你来，我告诉你这民日后要怎样待你的民。」

chapters.en:
Then Balaam lifted up an oracle, saying,
“This is the prophecy of Balaam son of Beor, the prophecy of a man whose eyes are open,
chapters.zh: 他就题起诗歌说： 比珥的儿子巴兰说： 眼目闭住〔注：或译：睁开〕的人说，

chapters.en: the prophecy of one who hears the words of God, who has knowledge from the Most High, who sees a vision from the Almighty, who bows down with eyes wide open:
chapters.zh: 得听上帝的言语， 明白至高者的意旨， 看见全能者的异象， 眼目睁开而仆倒的人说：

chapters.en: I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near. A star will come forth from Jacob, and a scepter will arise from Israel. He will crush the skulls of Moab and strike down all the sons of Sheth.
chapters.zh: 我看他却不在现时； 我望他却不在近日。 有星要出于雅各，有杖要兴于以色列， 必打破摩押的四角，毁坏扰乱之子。

chapters.en:
Edom will become a possession, as will Seir, his enemy;
but Israel will perform with valor.
chapters.zh: 他必得以东为基业， 又得仇敌之地西珥为产业； 以色列必行事勇敢。

chapters.en: A ruler will come from Jacob and destroy the survivors of the city.”
chapters.zh: 有一位出于雅各的，必掌大权； 他要除灭城中的余民。

chapters.en:
Then Balaam saw Amalek and lifted up an oracle, saying:
“Amalek was first among the nations, but his end is destruction.”
chapters.zh: 巴兰观看亚玛力，就题起诗歌说： 亚玛力原为诸国之首， 但他终必沉沦。

chapters.en:
Next he saw the Kenites and lifted up an oracle, saying:
“Your dwelling place is secure, and your nest is set in a cliff.
chapters.zh: 巴兰观看基尼人，就题起诗歌说： 你的住处本是坚固； 你的窝巢做在巖穴中。

chapters.en: Yet Kain will be destroyed when Asshur takes you captive.”
chapters.zh: 然而基尼必至衰微， 直到亚述把你掳去。

chapters.en:
Once more Balaam lifted up an oracle, saying:
“Ah, who can live unless God has ordained it?
chapters.zh: 巴兰又题起诗歌说： 哀哉！上帝行这事，谁能得活？

chapters.en:
Ships will come from the coasts of Cyprus; they will subdue Asshur and Eber,
but they too will perish forever.”
chapters.zh: 必有人乘船从基提界〔而来〕， 苦害亚述，苦害希伯； 他也必至沉沦。

chapters.en: Then Balaam arose and returned to his homeland, and Balak also went on his way.
chapters.zh: 于是巴兰起来，回他本地去；巴勒也回去了。

chapters.en: While Israel was staying in Shittim, the men began to indulge in sexual immorality with the daughters of Moab,
chapters.zh: 以色列人住在什亭，百姓与摩押女子行起淫乱。

chapters.en: who also invited them to the sacrifices for their gods. And the people ate and bowed down to these gods.
chapters.zh: 因为这女子叫百姓来，一同给她们的神献祭，百姓就吃〔她们的祭物〕，跪拜她们的神。

chapters.en: So Israel joined in worshiping Baal of Peor, and the anger of the LORD burned against them.
chapters.zh: 以色列人与巴力‧毗珥连合，耶和华的怒气就向以色列人发作。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Take all the leaders of the people and execute them in broad daylight before the LORD, so that His fierce anger may turn away from Israel.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「将百姓中所有的族长在我面前对着日头悬挂，使我向以色列人所发的怒气可以消了。」

chapters.en: So Moses told the judges of Israel, “Each of you must kill all of his men who have joined in worshiping Baal of Peor.”
chapters.zh: 于是摩西吩咐以色列的审判官说：「凡属你们的人，有与巴力‧毗珥连合的，你们各人要把他们杀了。」

chapters.en: Just then an Israelite man brought to his family a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses and the whole congregation of Israel while they were weeping at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
chapters.zh: 摩西和以色列全会众正在会幕门前哭泣的时候，谁知，有以色列中的一个人，当他们眼前，带着一个米甸女人到他弟兄那里去。

chapters.en: On seeing this, Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, got up from the assembly, took a spear in his hand,
chapters.zh: 祭司亚伦的孙子，以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈看见了，就从会中起来，手里拿着枪，

chapters.en:
followed the Israelite into his tent, and drove the spear through both of them—through the Israelite and on through the belly of the woman.
So the plague against the Israelites was halted,
chapters.zh: 跟随那以色列人进亭子里去，便将以色列人和那女人由腹中刺透。这样，在以色列人中瘟疫就止息了。

chapters.en: but those who died in the plague numbered 24,000.
chapters.zh: 那时遭瘟疫死的，有二万四千人。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned My wrath away from the Israelites; for he was zealous for My sake among them, so that I did not consume the Israelites in My zeal.
chapters.zh: 「祭司亚伦的孙子，以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈，使我向以色列人所发的怒消了；因他在他们中间，以我的忌邪为心，使我不在忌邪中把他们除灭。

chapters.en: Declare, therefore, that I am granting him My covenant of peace.
chapters.zh: 因此，你要说：『我将我平安的约赐给他。

chapters.en: It will be a covenant of permanent priesthood for him and his descendants, because he was zealous for his God and made atonement for the Israelites.”
chapters.zh: 这约要给他和他的后裔，作为永远当祭司职任的约；因他为上帝有忌邪的心，为以色列人赎罪。』」

chapters.en: The name of the Israelite who was slain with the Midianite woman was Zimri son of Salu, the leader of a Simeonite family.
chapters.zh: 那与米甸女人一同被杀的以色列人，名叫心利，是撒路的儿子，是西缅一个宗族的首领。

chapters.en: And the name of the slain Midianite woman was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur, a tribal chief of a Midianite family.
chapters.zh: 那被杀的米甸女人，名叫哥斯比，是苏珥的女儿；这苏珥是米甸一个宗族的首领。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “Attack the Midianites and strike them dead.
chapters.zh: 「你要扰害米甸人，击杀他们；

chapters.en: For they assailed you deceitfully when they seduced you in the matter of Peor and their sister Cozbi, the daughter of the Midianite leader, the woman who was killed on the day the plague came because of Peor.”
chapters.zh: 因为他们用诡计扰害你们，在毗珥的事上和他们的姊妹、米甸首领的女儿哥斯比的事上，用这诡计诱惑了你们；这哥斯比，当瘟疫流行的日子，因毗珥的事被杀了。」

chapters.en: After the plague had ended, the LORD said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron the priest,
chapters.zh: 瘟疫之后，耶和华晓谕摩西和祭司亚伦的儿子以利亚撒说：

chapters.en: “Take a census of the whole congregation of Israel by the houses of their fathers—all those twenty years of age or older who can serve in the army of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 「你们要将以色列全会众，按他们的宗族，凡以色列中从二十岁以外、能出去打仗的，计算总数。」

chapters.en: So on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho, Moses and Eleazar the priest issued the instruction,
chapters.zh: 摩西和祭司以利亚撒在摩押平原与耶利哥相对的约旦河边向以色列人说：

chapters.en:
“Take a census of the men twenty years of age or older, as the LORD has commanded Moses.”
And these were the Israelites who came out of the land of Egypt:
chapters.zh: 「将你们中间从二十岁以外的〔计算总数〕」；是照耶和华吩咐出埃及地的摩西和以色列人的话。

chapters.en:
Reuben was the firstborn of Israel. These were the descendants of Reuben:
The Hanochite clan from Hanoch,
the Palluite clan from Pallu,
chapters.zh: 以色列的长子是吕便。吕便的众子：属哈诺的，有哈诺族；属法路的，有法路族；

chapters.en:
the Hezronite clan from Hezron,
and the Carmite clan from Carmi.
chapters.zh: 属希斯伦的，有希斯伦族；属迦米的，有迦米族；

chapters.en: These were the clans of Reuben, and their registration numbered 43,730.
chapters.zh: 这就是吕便的各族；其中被数的，共有四万三千七百三十名。

chapters.en: Now the son of Pallu was Eliab,
chapters.zh: 法路的儿子是以利押。

chapters.en:
and the sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram.
It was Dathan and Abiram, chosen by the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and Aaron with the followers of Korah who rebelled against the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以利押的众子是尼母利、大坍、亚比兰。这大坍、亚比兰，就是从会中选召的，与可拉一党同向耶和华争闹的时候也向摩西、亚伦争闹；

chapters.en: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them along with Korah, whose followers died when the fire consumed 250 men. They serve as a warning sign.
chapters.zh: 地便开口吞了他们，和可拉、可拉的党类一同死亡。那时火烧灭了二百五十个人；他们就作了警戒。

chapters.en: However, the line of Korah did not die out.
chapters.zh: 然而可拉的众子没有死亡。

chapters.en:
These were the descendants of Simeon by their clans:
The Nemuelite clan from Nemuel,
the Jaminite clan from Jamin,
the Jachinite clan from Jachin,
chapters.zh: 按着家族，西缅的众子：属尼母利的，有尼母利族；属雅悯的，有雅悯族；属雅斤的，有雅斤族；

chapters.en:
the Zerahite clan from Zerah,
and the Shaulite clan from Shaul.
chapters.zh: 属谢拉的，有谢拉族；属扫罗的，有扫罗族。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Simeon, and there were 22,200 men.
chapters.zh: 这就是西缅的各族，共有二万二千二百名。

chapters.en:
These were the descendants of Gad by their clans:
The Zephonite clan from Zephon,
the Haggite clan from Haggi,
the Shunite clan from Shuni,
chapters.zh: 按着家族，迦得的众子：属洗分的，有洗分族；属哈基的，有哈基族；属书尼的，有书尼族；

chapters.en:
the Oznite clan from Ozni,
the Erite clan from Eri,
chapters.zh: 属阿斯尼的，有阿斯尼族；属以利的，有以利族；

chapters.en:
the Arodite clan from Arod,
and the Arelite clan from Areli.
chapters.zh: 属亚律的，有亚律族；属亚列利的，有亚列利族。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Gad, and their registration numbered 40,500.
chapters.zh: 这就是迦得子孙的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有四万零五百名。

chapters.en: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan, but they died in the land of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 犹大的儿子是珥和俄南。这珥和俄南死在迦南地。

chapters.en:
These were the descendants of Judah by their clans:
The Shelanite clan from Shelah,
the Perezite clan from Perez,
and the Zerahite clan from Zerah.
chapters.zh: 按着家族，犹大〔其余〕的众子：属示拉的，有示拉族；属法勒斯的，有法勒斯族；属谢拉的，有谢拉族。

chapters.en:
And these were the descendants of Perez:
the Hezronite clan from Hezron
and the Hamulite clan from Hamul.
chapters.zh: 法勒斯的儿子：属希斯崙的，有希斯崙族；属哈母勒的，有哈母勒族。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Judah, and their registration numbered 76,500.
chapters.zh: 这就是犹大的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有七万六千五百名。

chapters.en:
These were the descendants of Issachar by their clans:
The Tolaite clan from Tola,
the Punite clan from Puvah,
chapters.zh: 按着家族，以萨迦的众子：属陀拉的，有陀拉族；属普瓦的，有普瓦族；

chapters.en:
the Jashubite clan from Jashub,
and the Shimronite clan from Shimron.
chapters.zh: 属雅述的，有雅述族；属伸崙的，有伸崙族。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Issachar, and their registration numbered 64,300.
chapters.zh: 这就是以萨迦的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有六万四千三百名。

chapters.en:
These were the descendants of Zebulun by their clans:
The Seredite clan from Sered,
the Elonite clan from Elon,
and the Jahleelite clan from Jahleel.
chapters.zh: 按着家族，西布伦的众子：属西烈的，有西烈族；属以伦的，有以伦族；属雅利的，有雅利族。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Zebulun, and their registration numbered 60,500.
chapters.zh: 这就是西布伦的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有六万零五百名。

chapters.en: The descendants of Joseph included the clans of Manasseh and Ephraim.
chapters.zh: 按着家族，约瑟的儿子有玛拿西、以法莲。

chapters.en:
These were the descendants of Manasseh:
The Machirite clan from Machir, the father of Gilead,
and the Gileadite clan from Gilead.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西的众子：属玛吉的，有玛吉族；玛吉生基列；属基列的，有基列族。

chapters.en:
These were the descendants of Gilead:
the Iezerite clan from Iezer,
the Helekite clan from Helek,
chapters.zh: 基列的众子：属伊以谢的，有伊以谢族；属希勒的，有希勒族；

chapters.en:
the Asrielite clan from Asriel,
the Shechemite clan from Shechem,
chapters.zh: 属亚斯烈的，有亚斯烈族；属示剑的，有示剑族；

chapters.en:
the Shemidaite clan from Shemida,
and the Hepherite clan from Hepher.
chapters.zh: 属示米大的，有示米大族；属希弗的，有希弗族。

chapters.en: Now Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons but only daughters. The names of his daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
chapters.zh: 希弗的儿子：西罗非哈没儿子，只有女儿。西罗非哈女儿的名字就是玛拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Manasseh, and their registration numbered 52,700.
chapters.zh: 这就是玛拿西的各族；他们中间被数的，共有五万二千七百名。

chapters.en:
These were the descendants of Ephraim by their clans:
The Shuthelahite clan from Shuthelah,
the Becherite clan from Becher,
and the Tahanite clan from Tahan.
chapters.zh: 按着家族，以法莲的众子：属书提拉的，有书提拉族；属比结的，有比结族；属他罕的，有他罕族。

chapters.en: And the descendants of Shuthelah were the Eranite clan from Eran.
chapters.zh: 书提拉的众子：属以兰的，有以兰族。

chapters.en:
These were the clans of Ephraim, and their registration numbered 32,500.
These clans were the descendants of Joseph.
chapters.zh: 这就是以法莲子孙的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有三万二千五百名。按着家族，这都是约瑟的子孙。

chapters.en:
These were the descendants of Benjamin by their clans:
The Belaite clan from Bela,
the Ashbelite clan from Ashbel,
the Ahiramite clan from Ahiram,
chapters.zh: 按着家族，便雅悯的众子：属比拉的，有比拉族；属亚实别的，有亚实别族；属亚希兰的，有亚希兰族；

chapters.en:
the Shuphamite clan from Shupham,
and the Huphamite clan from Hupham.
chapters.zh: 属书反的，有书反族；属户反的，有户反族。

chapters.en: And the descendants of Bela from Ard and Naaman were the Ardite clan from Ard and the Naamite clan from Naaman.
chapters.zh: 比拉的众子是亚勒、乃幔。〔属亚勒的〕，有亚勒族；属乃幔的，有乃幔族。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Benjamin, and their registration numbered 45,600.
chapters.zh: 按着家族，这就是便雅悯的子孙，其中被数的，共有四万五千六百名。

chapters.en:
These were the descendants of Dan by their clans:
The Shuhamite clan from Shuham.
These were the clans of Dan.
chapters.zh: 按着家族，但的众子：属书含的，有书含族。按着家族，这就是但的各族。

chapters.en: All of them were Shuhamite clans, and their registration numbered 64,400.
chapters.zh: 照其中被数的，书含所有的各族，共有六万四千四百名。

chapters.en:
These were the descendants of Asher by their clans:
The Imnite clan from Imnah,
the Ishvite clan from Ishvi,
and the Beriite clan from Beriah.
chapters.zh: 按着家族，亚设的众子：属音拿的，有音拿族；属亦施韦的，有亦施韦族；属比利亚的，有比利亚族。

chapters.en:
And these were the descendants of Beriah:
the Heberite clan from Heber
and the Malchielite clan from Malchiel.
chapters.zh: 比利亚的众子：属希别的，有希别族；属玛结的，有玛结族。

chapters.en: And the name of Asher’s daughter was Serah.
chapters.zh: 亚设的女儿名叫西拉。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Asher, and their registration numbered 53,400.
chapters.zh: 这就是亚设子孙的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有五万三千四百名。

chapters.en:
These were the descendants of Naphtali by their clans:
The Jahzeelite clan from Jahzeel,
the Gunite clan from Guni,
chapters.zh: 按着家族，拿弗他利的众子：属雅薛的，有雅薛族；属沽尼的，有沽尼族；

chapters.en:
the Jezerite clan from Jezer,
and the Shillemite clan from Shillem.
chapters.zh: 属耶色的，有耶色族；属示冷的，有示冷族。

chapters.en: These were the clans of Naphtali, and their registration numbered 45,400.
chapters.zh: 按着家族，这就是拿弗他利的各族；他们中间被数的，共有四万五千四百名。

chapters.en: These men of Israel numbered 601,730 in all.
chapters.zh: 以色列人中被数的，共有六十万零一千七百三十名。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “The land is to be divided among the tribes as an inheritance, according to the number of names.
chapters.zh: 「你要按着人名的数目将地分给这些人为业。

chapters.en: Increase the inheritance for a large tribe and decrease it for a small one; each tribe is to receive its inheritance according to the number of those registered.
chapters.zh: 人多的，你要把产业多分给他们；人少的，你要把产业少分给他们；要照被数的人数，把产业分给各人。

chapters.en: Indeed, the land must be divided by lot; they shall receive their inheritance according to the names of the tribes of their fathers.
chapters.zh: 虽是这样，还要拈鬮分地。他们要按着祖宗各支派的名字承受为业。

chapters.en: Each inheritance is to be divided by lot among the larger and smaller tribes.”
chapters.zh: 要按着所拈的鬮，看人数多，人数少，把产业分给他们。」

chapters.en:
Now these were the Levites numbered by their clans:
The Gershonite clan from Gershon,
the Kohathite clan from Kohath,
and the Merarite clan from Merari.
chapters.zh: 利未人，按着他们的各族被数的：属革顺的，有革顺族；属哥辖的，有哥辖族；属米拉利的，有米拉利族。

chapters.en:
These were the families of the Levites:
The Libnite clan,
the Hebronite clan,
the Mahlite clan,
the Mushite clan,
and the Korahite clan.
Now Kohath was the father of Amram,
chapters.zh: 利未的各族有立尼族、希伯伦族、玛利族、母示族、可拉族。哥辖生暗兰。

chapters.en: and Amram’s wife was named Jochebed. She was also a daughter of Levi, born to Levi in Egypt. To Amram she bore Aaron, Moses, and their sister Miriam.
chapters.zh: 暗兰的妻名叫约基别，是利未女子，生在埃及。她给暗兰生了亚伦、摩西，并他们的姊姊米利暗。

chapters.en: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar were born to Aaron,
chapters.zh: 亚伦生拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。

chapters.en: but Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 拿答、亚比户在耶和华面前献凡火的时候就死了。

chapters.en: The registration of the Levites totaled 23,000, every male a month old or more; they were not numbered among the other Israelites, because no inheritance was given to them among the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 利未人中，凡一个月以外、被数的男丁，共有二万三千。他们本来没有数在以色列人中；因为在以色列人中，没有分给他们产业。

chapters.en: These were the ones numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest when they counted the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho.
chapters.zh: 这些就是被摩西和祭司以利亚撒所数的；他们在摩押平原与耶利哥相对的约旦河边数点以色列人。

chapters.en: Among all these, however, there was not one who had been numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest when they counted the Israelites in the Wilderness of Sinai.
chapters.zh: 但被数的人中，没有一个是摩西和祭司亚伦从前在西奈的旷野所数的以色列人，

chapters.en: For the LORD had told them that they would surely die in the wilderness. Not one was left except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华论到他们说：「他们必要死在旷野。」所以，除了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒和嫩的儿子约书亚以外，连一个人也没有存留。

chapters.en: Now the daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, belonged to the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph. These were the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah. They approached
chapters.zh: 属约瑟的儿子玛拿西的各族，有玛拿西的玄孙，玛吉的曾孙，基列的孙子，希弗的儿子西罗非哈的女儿，名叫玛拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒。她们前来，

chapters.en: the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders, and the whole congregation, and said,
chapters.zh: 站在会幕门口，在摩西和祭司以利亚撒，并众首领与全会众面前，说：

chapters.en: “Our father died in the wilderness, but he was not among the followers of Korah who gathered together against the LORD. Instead, he died because of his own sin, and he had no sons.
chapters.zh: 「我们的父亲死在旷野。他不与可拉同党聚集攻击耶和华，是在自己罪中死的；他也没有儿子。

chapters.en: Why should the name of our father disappear from his clan because he had no sons? Give us property among our father’s brothers.”
chapters.zh: 为什么因我们的父亲没有儿子就把他的名从他族中除掉呢？求你们在我们父亲的弟兄中分给我们产业。」

chapters.en: So Moses brought their case before the LORD,
chapters.zh: 于是，摩西将她们的案件呈到耶和华面前。

chapters.en: and the LORD answered him,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak correctly. You certainly must give them property as an inheritance among their father’s brothers and transfer their father’s inheritance to them.
chapters.zh: 「西罗非哈的女儿说得有理。你定要在她们父亲的弟兄中，把地分给她们为业；要将她们父亲的产业归给她们。

chapters.en: Furthermore, you shall say to the Israelites, ‘If a man dies and leaves no son, you are to transfer his inheritance to his daughter.
chapters.zh: 你也要晓谕以色列人说：『人若死了没有儿子，就要把他的产业归给他的女儿。

chapters.en: If he has no daughter, give his inheritance to his brothers.
chapters.zh: 他若没有女儿，就要把他的产业给他的弟兄。

chapters.en: If he has no brothers, give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
chapters.zh: 他若没有弟兄，就要把他的产业给他父亲的弟兄。

chapters.en: And if his father has no brothers, give his inheritance to the next of kin from his clan, that he may take possession of it. This is to be a statutory ordinance for the Israelites, as the LORD has commanded Moses.’”
chapters.zh: 他父亲若没有弟兄，就要把他的产业给他族中最近的亲属，他便要得为业。』这要作以色列人的律例典章，是照耶和华吩咐摩西的。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go up this mountain of the Abarim range and see the land that I have given the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「你上这亚巴琳山，观看我所赐给以色列人的地。

chapters.en: After you have seen it, you too will be gathered to your people, as your brother Aaron was;
chapters.zh: 看了以后，你也必归到你列祖〔注：原文是本民〕那里，像你哥哥亚伦一样。

chapters.en: for when the congregation contended in the Wilderness of Zin, both of you rebelled against My command to show My holiness in their sight regarding the waters.” Those were the waters of Meribah in Kadesh, in the Wilderness of Zin.
chapters.zh: 因为你们在寻的旷野，当会众争闹的时候，违背了我的命，没有在〔涌〕水之地、会众眼前尊我为圣。」（这水就是寻的旷野加低斯米利巴水。）

chapters.en: So Moses appealed to the LORD,
chapters.zh: 摩西对耶和华说：

chapters.en: “May the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation
chapters.zh: 「愿耶和华万人之灵的上帝，立一个人治理会众，

chapters.en: who will go out and come in before them, and who will lead them out and bring them in, so that the congregation of the LORD will not be like sheep without a shepherd.”
chapters.zh: 可以在他们面前出入，也可以引导他们，免得耶和华的会众如同没有牧人的羊群一般。」

chapters.en: And the LORD replied to Moses, “Take Joshua son of Nun, a man with the Spirit in him, and lay your hands on him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「嫩的儿子约书亚是心中有〔圣〕灵的；你将他领来，按手在他〔头〕上，

chapters.en: Have him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole congregation, and commission him in their sight.
chapters.zh: 使他站在祭司以利亚撒和全会众面前，嘱咐他，

chapters.en: Confer on him some of your authority, so that the whole congregation of Israel will obey him.
chapters.zh: 又将你的尊荣给他几分，使以色列全会众都听从他。

chapters.en: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who will seek counsel for him before the LORD by the judgment of the Urim. At his command, he and all the Israelites with him—the entire congregation—will go out and come in.”
chapters.zh: 他要站在祭司以利亚撒面前；以利亚撒要凭乌陵的判断，在耶和华面前为他求问。他和以色列全会众都要遵以利亚撒的命出入。」

chapters.en: Moses did as the LORD had commanded him. He took Joshua, had him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole congregation,
chapters.zh: 于是摩西照耶和华所吩咐的将约书亚领来，使他站在祭司以利亚撒和全会众面前，

chapters.en: and laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD had instructed through Moses.
chapters.zh: 按手在他〔头〕上，嘱咐他，是照耶和华藉摩西所说的话。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “Command the Israelites and say to them: See that you present to Me at its appointed time the food for My food offerings, as a pleasing aroma to Me.
chapters.zh: 「你要吩咐以色列人说：『献给我的供物，就是献给我作馨香火祭的食物，你们要按日期献给我』；

chapters.en: And tell them that this is the food offering you are to present to the LORD as a regular burnt offering each day: two unblemished year-old male lambs.
chapters.zh: 又要对他们说：你们要献给耶和华的火祭，就是没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔，每日两只，作为常献的燔祭。

chapters.en: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight,
chapters.zh: 早晨要献一只，黄昏的时候要献一只；

chapters.en: along with a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with a quarter hin of oil from pressed olives.
chapters.zh: 又用细面伊法十分之一，并捣成的油一欣四分之一，调和作为素祭。

chapters.en: This is a regular burnt offering established at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, a food offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这是西奈山所命定为常献的燔祭，是献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。

chapters.en: The drink offering accompanying each lamb shall be a quarter hin. Pour out the offering of fermented drink to the LORD in the sanctuary area.
chapters.zh: 为这一只羊羔，要同献奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。在圣所中，你要将醇酒奉给耶和华为奠祭。

chapters.en: And offer the second lamb at twilight, with the same grain offering and drink offering as in the morning. It is a food offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 晚上，你要献那一只羊羔，必照早晨的素祭和同献的奠祭献上，作为馨香的火祭，献给耶和华。」

chapters.en: On the Sabbath day, present two unblemished year-old male lambs, accompanied by a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, as well as a drink offering.
chapters.zh: 「当安息日，要献两只没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔，并用调油的细面〔伊法〕十分之二为素祭，又将同献的奠祭献上。

chapters.en: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
chapters.zh: 这是每安息日献的燔祭；那常献的燔祭和同献的奠祭在外。」

chapters.en: At the beginning of every month, you are to present to the LORD a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
chapters.zh: 「每月朔，你们要将两只公牛犊，一只公绵羊，七只没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔，献给耶和华为燔祭。

chapters.en: along with three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with the ram,
chapters.zh: 每只公牛要用调油的细面〔伊法〕十分之三作为素祭；那只公羊也用调油的细面〔伊法〕十分之二作为素祭；

chapters.en: and a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with each lamb. This is a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, a food offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 每只羊羔要用调油的细面〔伊法〕十分之一作为素祭和馨香的燔祭，是献给耶和华的火祭。

chapters.en: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine with each bull, a third of a hin with the ram, and a quarter hin with each lamb. This is the monthly burnt offering to be made at each new moon throughout the year.
chapters.zh: 一只公牛要奠酒半欣，一只公羊要奠酒一欣三分之一，一只羊羔也奠酒一欣四分之一。这是每月的燔祭，一年之中要月月如此。

chapters.en: In addition to the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the LORD as a sin offering.
chapters.zh: 又要将一只公山羊为赎罪祭，献给耶和华；要献在常献的燔祭和同献的奠祭以外。」

chapters.en: The fourteenth day of the first month is the LORD’s Passover.
chapters.zh: 「正月十四日是耶和华的逾越节。

chapters.en: On the fifteenth day of this month, there shall be a feast; for seven days unleavened bread is to be eaten.
chapters.zh: 这月十五日是节期，要吃无酵饼七日。

chapters.en: On the first day there is to be a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.
chapters.zh: 第一日当有圣会；什么劳碌的工都不可做。

chapters.en: Present to the LORD a food offering, a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished.
chapters.zh: 当将公牛犊两只，公绵羊一只，一岁的公羊羔七只，都要没有残疾的，用火献给耶和华为燔祭。

chapters.en: The grain offering shall consist of fine flour mixed with oil; offer three-tenths of an ephah with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram,
chapters.zh: 同献的素祭用调油的细面；为一只公牛要献〔伊法〕十分之三；为一只公羊要献〔伊法〕十分之二；

chapters.en: and a tenth of an ephah with each of the seven lambs.
chapters.zh: 为那七只羊羔，每只要献〔伊法〕十分之一。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.
chapters.zh: 并献一只公山羊作赎罪祭，为你们赎罪。

chapters.en: You are to present these in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.
chapters.zh: 你们献这些，要在早晨常献的燔祭以外。

chapters.en: Offer the same food each day for seven days as a food offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD. It is to be offered with its drink offering and the regular burnt offering.
chapters.zh: 一连七日，每日要照这例把馨香火祭的食物献给耶和华，是在常献的燔祭和同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: On the seventh day you shall hold a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.
chapters.zh: 第七日当有圣会，什么劳碌的工都不可做。」

chapters.en: On the day of firstfruits, when you present an offering of new grain to the LORD during the Feast of Weeks, you are to hold a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.
chapters.zh: 「七七〔节〕庄稼初熟，你们献新素祭给耶和华的日子，当有圣会；什么劳碌的工都不可做。

chapters.en: Present a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old as a pleasing aroma to the LORD,
chapters.zh: 只要将公牛犊两只，公绵羊一只，一岁的公羊羔七只，作为馨香的燔祭献给耶和华。

chapters.en: together with their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with oil—three-tenths of an ephah with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram,
chapters.zh: 同献的素祭用调油的细面；为每只公牛要献〔伊法〕十分之三；为一只公羊要献〔伊法〕十分之二；

chapters.en: and a tenth of an ephah with each of the seven lambs.
chapters.zh: 为那七只羊羔，每只要献〔伊法〕十分之一。

chapters.en: Include one male goat to make atonement for you.
chapters.zh: 并献一只公山羊为你们赎罪。

chapters.en: Offer them with their drink offerings in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering. The animals must be unblemished.
chapters.zh: 这些，你们要献在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外，都要没有残疾的。」

chapters.en: “On the first day of the seventh month, you are to hold a sacred assembly, and you must not do any regular work. This will be a day for you to sound the trumpets.
chapters.zh: 「七月初一日，你们当有圣会；什么劳碌的工都不可做，是你们当守为吹角的日子。

chapters.en: As a pleasing aroma to the LORD, you are to present a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
chapters.zh: 你们要将公牛犊一只，公绵羊一只，没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔七只，作为馨香的燔祭献给耶和华。

chapters.en: together with their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with oil—three-tenths of an ephah with the bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram,
chapters.zh: 同献的素祭用调油的细面；为一只公牛要献〔伊法〕十分之三；为一只公羊要献〔伊法〕十分之二；

chapters.en: and a tenth of an ephah with each of the seven male lambs.
chapters.zh: 为那七只羊羔，每只要献〔伊法〕十分之一。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.
chapters.zh: 又献一只公山羊作赎罪祭，为你们赎罪。

chapters.en: These are in addition to the monthly and daily burnt offerings with their prescribed grain offerings and drink offerings. They are a pleasing aroma, a food offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这些是在月朔的燔祭和同献的素祭，并常献的燔祭与同献的素祭，以及照例同献的奠祭以外，都作为馨香的火祭献给耶和华。」

chapters.en: On the tenth day of this seventh month, you are to hold a sacred assembly, and you shall humble yourselves; you must not do any work.
chapters.zh: 「七月初十日，你们当有圣会；要刻苦己心，什么工都不可做。

chapters.en: Present as a pleasing aroma to the LORD a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
chapters.zh: 只要将公牛犊一只，公绵羊一只，一岁的公羊羔七只，都要没有残疾的，作为馨香的燔祭献给耶和华。

chapters.en: together with their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with oil—three-tenths of an ephah with the bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram,
chapters.zh: 同献的素祭用调油的细面：为一只公牛要献〔伊法〕十分之三；为一只公羊要献〔伊法〕十分之二；

chapters.en: and a tenth of an ephah with each of the seven lambs.
chapters.zh: 为那七只羊羔，每只要献〔伊法〕十分之一。

chapters.en: Include one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement and the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offerings.
chapters.zh: 又献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在赎罪祭和常献的燔祭，与同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。」

chapters.en: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, you are to hold a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work, and you shall observe a feast to the LORD for seven days.
chapters.zh: 「七月十五日，你们当有圣会；什么劳碌的工都不可做，要向耶和华守节七日。

chapters.en: As a pleasing aroma to the LORD, you are to present a food offering, a burnt offering of thirteen young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
chapters.zh: 又要将公牛犊十三只，公绵羊两只，一岁的公羊羔十四只，都要没有残疾的，用火献给耶和华为馨香的燔祭。

chapters.en: along with the grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil with each of the thirteen bulls, two-tenths of an ephah with each of the two rams,
chapters.zh: 同献的素祭用调油的细面；为那十三只公牛，每只要献〔伊法〕十分之三；为那两只公羊，每只要献〔伊法〕十分之二；

chapters.en: and a tenth of an ephah with each of the fourteen lambs.
chapters.zh: 为那十四只羊羔，每只要献〔伊法〕十分之一。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
chapters.zh: 并献一只公山羊为赎罪祭，这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: On the second day you are to present twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
chapters.zh: 「第二日〔要献〕公牛犊十二只，公绵羊两只，没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔十四只；

chapters.en: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
chapters.zh: 并为公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
chapters.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: On the third day you are to present eleven bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
chapters.zh: 「第三日〔要献〕公牛十一只，公羊两只，没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔十四只；

chapters.en: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
chapters.zh: 并为公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
chapters.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: On the fourth day you are to present ten bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
chapters.zh: 「第四日〔要献〕公牛十只，公羊两只，没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔十四只；

chapters.en: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
chapters.zh: 并为公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
chapters.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: On the fifth day you are to present nine bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
chapters.zh: 「第五日〔要献〕公牛九只，公羊两只，没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔十四只；

chapters.en: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
chapters.zh: 并为公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
chapters.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: On the sixth day you are to present eight bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
chapters.zh: 「第六日〔要献〕公牛八只，公羊两只，没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔十四只；

chapters.en: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
chapters.zh: 并为公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
chapters.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: On the seventh day you are to present seven bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
chapters.zh: 「第七日〔要献〕公牛七只，公羊两只，没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔十四只；

chapters.en: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
chapters.zh: 并为公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
chapters.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: On the eighth day you are to hold a solemn assembly; you must not do any regular work.
chapters.zh: 「第八日你们当有严肃会；什么劳碌的工都不可做；

chapters.en: As a pleasing aroma to the LORD, you are to present a food offering, a burnt offering of one bull, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
chapters.zh: 只要将公牛一只，公羊一只，没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔七只作火祭，献给耶和华为馨香的燔祭；

chapters.en: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
chapters.zh: 并为公牛、公羊，和羊羔，按数照例，献同献的素祭和同献的奠祭。

chapters.en: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
chapters.zh: 又要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭。这是在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外。

chapters.en: You are to present these offerings to the LORD at your appointed times, in addition to your vow and freewill offerings, whether burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings, or peace offerings.”
chapters.zh: 「这些祭要在你们的节期献给耶和华，都在所许的愿并甘心所献的以外，作为你们的燔祭、素祭、奠祭，和平安祭。」

chapters.en: So Moses spoke all this to the Israelites just as the LORD had commanded him.
chapters.zh: 于是，摩西照耶和华所吩咐他的一切话告诉以色列人。

chapters.en: Then Moses said to the heads of the tribes of Israel, “This is what the LORD has commanded:
chapters.zh: 摩西晓谕以色列各支派的首领说：「耶和华所吩咐的乃是这样：

chapters.en: If a man makes a vow to the LORD or swears an oath to obligate himself by a pledge, he must not break his word; he must do everything he has promised.
chapters.zh: 人若向耶和华许愿或起誓，要约束自己，就不可食言，必要按口中所出的一切话行。

chapters.en: And if a woman in her father’s house during her youth makes a vow to the LORD or obligates herself by a pledge,
chapters.zh: 女子年幼、还在父家的时候，若向耶和华许愿，要约束自己，

chapters.en: and her father hears about her vow or pledge but says nothing to her, then all the vows or pledges by which she has bound herself shall stand.
chapters.zh: 她父亲也听见她所许的愿并约束自己的话，却向她默默不言，她所许的愿并约束自己的话就都要为定。

chapters.en: But if her father prohibits her on the day he hears about it, then none of the vows or pledges by which she has bound herself shall stand. The LORD will absolve her because her father has prohibited her.
chapters.zh: 但她父亲听见的日子若不应承她所许的愿和约束自己的话，就都不得为定；耶和华也必赦免她，因为她父亲不应承。

chapters.en: If a woman marries while under a vow or rash promise by which she has bound herself,
chapters.zh: 她若出了嫁，有愿在身，或是口中出了约束自己的冒失话，

chapters.en: and her husband hears of it but says nothing to her on that day, then the vows or pledges by which she has bound herself shall stand.
chapters.zh: 她丈夫听见的日子，却向她默默不言，她所许的愿并约束自己的话就都要为定。

chapters.en: But if her husband prohibits her when he hears of it, he nullifies the vow that binds her or the rash promise she has made, and the LORD will absolve her.
chapters.zh: 但她丈夫听见的日子，若不应承，就算废了她所许的愿和她出口约束自己的冒失话；耶和华也必赦免她。

chapters.en: Every vow a widow or divorced woman pledges to fulfill is binding on her.
chapters.zh: 寡妇或是被休的妇人所许的愿，就是她约束自己的话，都要为定。

chapters.en: If a woman in her husband’s house has made a vow or put herself under an obligation with an oath,
chapters.zh: 她若在丈夫家里许了愿或起了誓，约束自己，

chapters.en: and her husband hears of it but says nothing to her and does not prohibit her, then all the vows or pledges by which she has bound herself shall stand.
chapters.zh: 丈夫听见，却向她默默不言，也没有不应承，她所许的愿并约束自己的话就都要为定。

chapters.en: But if her husband nullifies them on the day he hears of them, then nothing that came from her lips, whether her vows or pledges, shall stand. Her husband has nullified them, and the LORD will absolve her.
chapters.zh: 丈夫听见的日子，若把这两样全废了，妇人口中所许的愿或是约束自己的话就都不得为定，〔因〕她丈夫已经把这两样废了；耶和华也必赦免她。

chapters.en: Her husband may confirm or nullify any vow or any sworn pledge to deny herself.
chapters.zh: 凡她所许的愿和刻苦约束自己所起的誓，她丈夫可以坚定，也可以废去。

chapters.en: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he confirms all the vows and pledges that bind her. He has confirmed them, because he said nothing to her on the day he heard about them.
chapters.zh: 倘若她丈夫天天向她默默不言，就算是坚定她所许的愿和约束自己的话；因丈夫听见的日子向她默默不言，就使这两样坚定。

chapters.en: But if he nullifies them after he hears of them, then he will bear her iniquity.”
chapters.zh: 但她丈夫听见以后，若使这两样全废了，就要担当妇人的罪孽。」

chapters.en: These are the statutes that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the relationship between a man and his wife, and between a father and a young daughter still in his home.
chapters.zh: 这是丈夫待妻子，父亲待女儿，女儿年幼、还在父家，耶和华所吩咐摩西的律例。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：

chapters.en: “Take vengeance on the Midianites for the Israelites. After that, you will be gathered to your people.”
chapters.zh: 「你要在米甸人身上报以色列人的仇，后来要归到你列祖〔注：原文是本民〕那里。」

chapters.en: So Moses told the people, “Arm some of your men for war, that they may go against the Midianites and execute the LORD’s vengeance on them.
chapters.zh: 摩西吩咐百姓说：「要从你们中间叫人带兵器出去攻击米甸，好在米甸人身上为耶和华报仇。

chapters.en: Send into battle a thousand men from each tribe of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 从以色列众支派中，每支派要打发一千人去打仗。」

chapters.en: So a thousand men were recruited from each tribe of Israel—twelve thousand armed for war.
chapters.zh: 于是从以色列千万人中，每支派交出一千人，共一万二千人，带着兵器预备打仗。

chapters.en: And Moses sent the thousand from each tribe into battle, along with Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest, who took with him the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for signaling.
chapters.zh: 摩西就打发每支派的一千人去打仗，并打发祭司以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈同去；非尼哈手里拿着圣所的器皿和吹大声的号筒。

chapters.en: Then they waged war against Midian, as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they killed every male.
chapters.zh: 他们就照耶和华所吩咐摩西的，与米甸人打仗，杀了所有的男丁。

chapters.en: Among the slain were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba—the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword.
chapters.zh: 在所杀的人中，杀了米甸的五王，就是以未、利金、苏珥、户珥、利巴，又用刀杀了比珥的儿子巴兰。

chapters.en: The Israelites captured the Midianite women and their children, and they plundered all their herds, flocks, and goods.
chapters.zh: 以色列人掳了米甸人的妇女孩子，并将他们的牲畜、羊群，和所有的财物都夺了来，当作掳物，

chapters.en: Then they burned all the cities where the Midianites had lived, as well as all their encampments,
chapters.zh: 又用火焚烧他们所住的城邑和所有的营寨，

chapters.en: and carried away all the plunder and spoils, both people and animals.
chapters.zh: 把一切所夺的、所掳的，连人带牲畜都带了去，

chapters.en: They brought the captives, spoils, and plunder to Moses, to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of Israel at the camp on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan across from Jericho.
chapters.zh: 将所掳的人，所夺的牲畜、财物，都带到摩押平原，在约旦河边与耶利哥相对的营盘，交给摩西和祭司以利亚撒，并以色列的会众。

chapters.en: And Moses, Eleazar the priest, and all the leaders of the congregation went to meet them outside the camp.
chapters.zh: 摩西和祭司以利亚撒，并会众一切的首领，都出到营外迎接他们。

chapters.en: But Moses was angry with the officers of the army—the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds—who were returning from the battle.
chapters.zh: 摩西向打仗回来的军长，就是千夫长、百夫长，发怒，

chapters.en: “Have you spared all the women?” he asked them.
chapters.zh: 对他们说：「你们要存留这一切妇女的活命吗？

chapters.en: “Look, these women caused the sons of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to turn unfaithfully against the LORD at Peor, so that the plague struck the congregation of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这些妇女因巴兰的计谋，叫以色列人在毗珥的事上得罪耶和华，以致耶和华的会众遭遇瘟疫。

chapters.en: So now, kill all the boys, as well as every woman who has had relations with a man,
chapters.zh: 所以，你们要把一切的男孩和所有已嫁的女子都杀了。

chapters.en: but spare for yourselves every girl who has never had relations with a man.
chapters.zh: 但女孩子中，凡没有出嫁的，你们都可以存留她的活命。

chapters.en: All of you who have killed a person or touched the dead are to remain outside the camp for seven days. On the third day and the seventh day you are to purify both yourselves and your captives.
chapters.zh: 你们要在营外驻扎七日；凡杀了人的，和一切摸了被杀的，并你们所掳来的人口，第三日，第七日，都要洁净自己，

chapters.en: And purify every garment and leather good, everything made of goat’s hair, and every article of wood.”
chapters.zh: 也要因一切的衣服、皮物、山羊〔毛〕织的物，和各样的木器，洁净自己。」

chapters.en: Then Eleazar the priest said to the soldiers who had gone into battle, “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses:
chapters.zh: 祭司以利亚撒对打仗回来的兵丁说：「耶和华所吩咐摩西律法中的条例乃是这样：

chapters.en: Only the gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, and lead—
chapters.zh: 金、银、铜、铁、锡、铅，

chapters.en: everything that can withstand the fire—must be put through the fire, and it will be clean. But it must still be purified with the water of purification. And everything that cannot withstand the fire must pass through the water.
chapters.zh: 凡能见火的，你们要叫它经火就为洁净，然而还要用除污秽的水洁净它；凡不能见火的，你们要叫它过水。

chapters.en: On the seventh day you are to wash your clothes, and you will be clean. After that you may enter the camp.”
chapters.zh: 第七日，你们要洗衣服，就为洁净，然后可以进营。」

chapters.en: The LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “You and Eleazar the priest and the family heads of the congregation are to take a count of what was captured, both of man and beast.
chapters.zh: 「你和祭司以利亚撒，并会众的各族长，要计算所掳来的人口和牲畜的总数。

chapters.en: Then divide the captives between the troops who went out to battle and the rest of the congregation.
chapters.zh: 把所掳来的分作两半：一半归与出去打仗的精兵，一半归与全会众。

chapters.en: Set aside a tribute for the LORD from what belongs to the soldiers who went into battle: one out of every five hundred, whether persons, cattle, donkeys, or sheep.
chapters.zh: 又要从出去打仗所得的人口、牛、驴、羊群中，每五百取一，作为贡物奉给耶和华。

chapters.en: Take it from their half and give it to Eleazar the priest as an offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 从他们一半之中，要取出来交给祭司以利亚撒，作为耶和华的举祭。

chapters.en: From the Israelites’ half, take one out of every fifty, whether persons, cattle, donkeys, sheep, or other animals, and give them to the Levites who keep charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 从以色列人的一半之中，就是从人口、牛、驴、羊群、各样牲畜中，每五十取一，交给看守耶和华帐幕的利未人。」

chapters.en: So Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD had commanded Moses,
chapters.zh: 于是摩西和祭司以利亚撒照耶和华所吩咐摩西的行了。

chapters.en:
and this plunder remained from the spoils the soldiers had taken:
675,000 sheep,
chapters.zh: 除了兵丁所夺的财物以外，所掳来的：羊六十七万五千只；

chapters.en: 72,000 cattle,
chapters.zh: 牛七万二千只；

chapters.en: 61,000 donkeys,
chapters.zh: 驴六万一千匹；

chapters.en: and 32,000 women who had not slept with a man.
chapters.zh: 女人共三万二千口，都是没有出嫁的。

chapters.en:
This was the half portion for those who had gone to war:
337,500 sheep,
chapters.zh: 出去打仗之人的分，就是他们所得的那一半，共计羊三十三万七千五百只，

chapters.en: including a tribute to the LORD of 675,
chapters.zh: 从其中归耶和华为贡物的，有六百七十五只；

chapters.en: 36,000 cattle, including a tribute to the LORD of 72,
chapters.zh: 牛三万六千只，从其中归耶和华为贡物的，有七十二只；

chapters.en: 30,500 donkeys, including a tribute to the LORD of 61,
chapters.zh: 驴三万零五百匹，从其中归耶和华为贡物的，有六十一匹；

chapters.en: and 16,000 people, including a tribute to the LORD of 32.
chapters.zh: 人一万六千口，从其中归耶和华的，有三十二口。

chapters.en: Moses gave the tribute to Eleazar the priest as an offering for the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
chapters.zh: 摩西把贡物，就是归与耶和华的举祭，交给祭司以利亚撒，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。

chapters.en: From the Israelites’ half, which Moses had set apart from the men who had gone to war,
chapters.zh: 以色列人所得的那一半，就是摩西从打仗的人取来分给他们的。

chapters.en:
this half belonged to the congregation:
337,500 sheep,
chapters.zh: （会众的那一半有：羊三十三万七千五百只；

chapters.en: 36,000 cattle,
chapters.zh: 牛三万六千只；

chapters.en: 30,500 donkeys,
chapters.zh: 驴三万零五百匹；

chapters.en: and 16,000 people.
chapters.zh: 人一万六千口。）

chapters.en: From the Israelites’ half, Moses took one out of every fifty persons and animals and gave them to the Levites who kept charge of the tabernacle of the LORD, as the LORD had commanded him.
chapters.zh: 无论是人口是牲畜，摩西每五十取一，交给看守耶和华帐幕的利未人，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。

chapters.en: Then the officers who were over the units of the army—the commanders of thousands and of hundreds—approached Moses
chapters.zh: 带领千军的各军长，就是千夫长、百夫长，都近前来见摩西，

chapters.en: and said, “Your servants have counted the soldiers under our command, and not one of us is missing.
chapters.zh: 对他说：「仆人权下的兵已经计算总数，并不短少一人。

chapters.en: So we have brought to the LORD an offering of the gold articles each man acquired—armlets, bracelets, rings, earrings, and necklaces—to make atonement for ourselves before the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 如今我们将各人所得的金器，就是脚鍊子、镯子、打印的戒指、耳环、手钏，都送来为耶和华的供物，好在耶和华面前为我们的生命赎罪。」

chapters.en: So Moses and Eleazar the priest received from them all the articles made out of gold.
chapters.zh: 摩西和祭司以利亚撒就收了他们的金子，都是打成的器皿。

chapters.en: All the gold that the commanders of thousands and of hundreds presented as an offering to the LORD weighed 16,750 shekels.
chapters.zh: 千夫长、百夫长所献给耶和华为举祭的金子共有一万六千七百五十舍客勒。

chapters.en: Each of the soldiers had taken plunder for himself.
chapters.zh: 各兵丁都为自己夺了财物。

chapters.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from the commanders of thousands and of hundreds and brought it into the Tent of Meeting as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 摩西和祭司以利亚撒收了千夫长、百夫长的金子，就带进会幕，在耶和华面前作为以色列人的纪念。

chapters.en: Now the Reubenites and Gadites, who had very large herds and flocks, surveyed the lands of Jazer and Gilead, and they saw that the region was suitable for livestock.
chapters.zh: 吕便子孙和迦得子孙的牲畜极其众多；他们看见雅谢地和基列地是可牧放牲畜之地，

chapters.en: So the Gadites and Reubenites came to Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the leaders of the congregation, and said,
chapters.zh: 就来见摩西和祭司以利亚撒，并会众的首领，说：

chapters.en: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
chapters.zh: 「亚大录、底本、雅谢、宁拉、希实本、以利亚利、示班、尼波、比稳，

chapters.en: which the LORD conquered before the congregation of Israel, are suitable for livestock—and your servants have livestock.”
chapters.zh: 就是耶和华在以色列会众前面所攻取之地，是可牧放牲畜之地，你仆人也有牲畜」；

chapters.en: “If we have found favor in your sight,” they said, “let this land be given to your servants as a possession. Do not make us cross the Jordan.”
chapters.zh: 又说：「我们若在你眼前蒙恩，求你把这地给我们为业，不要领我们过约旦河。」

chapters.en: But Moses asked the Gadites and Reubenites, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?
chapters.zh: 摩西对迦得子孙和吕便子孙说：「难道你们的弟兄去打仗，你们竟坐在这里吗？

chapters.en: Why are you discouraging the Israelites from crossing into the land that the LORD has given them?
chapters.zh: 你们为何使以色列人灰心丧胆、不过去进入耶和华所赐给他们的那地呢？

chapters.en: This is what your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to inspect the land.
chapters.zh: 我先前从加低斯‧巴尼亚打发你们先祖去窥探那地，他们也是这样行。

chapters.en: For when your fathers went up to the Valley of Eshcol and saw the land, they discouraged the Israelites from entering the land that the LORD had given them.
chapters.zh: 他们上以实各谷，去窥探那地回来的时候，使以色列人灰心丧胆，不进入耶和华所赐给他们的地。

chapters.en: So the anger of the LORD was kindled that day, and He swore an oath, saying,
chapters.zh: 当日，耶和华的怒气发作，就起誓说：

chapters.en: ‘Because they did not follow Me wholeheartedly, not one of the men twenty years of age or older who came out of Egypt will see the land that I swore to give Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—
chapters.zh: 『凡从埃及上来、二十岁以外的人断不得看见我对亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许之地，因为他们没有专心跟从我。

chapters.en: not one except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun—because they did follow the LORD wholeheartedly.’
chapters.zh: 惟有基尼洗族耶孚尼的儿子迦勒和嫩的儿子约书亚可以看见，因为他们专心跟从我。』

chapters.en: The anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until the whole generation who had done evil in His sight was gone.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，使他们在旷野飘流四十年，等到在耶和华眼前行恶的那一代人都消灭了。

chapters.en: Now behold, you, a brood of sinners, have risen up in place of your fathers to further stoke the burning anger of the LORD against Israel.
chapters.zh: 谁知，你们起来接续先祖，增添罪人的数目，使耶和华向以色列大发烈怒。

chapters.en: For if you turn away from following Him, He will once again leave this people in the wilderness, and you will be the cause of their destruction.”
chapters.zh: 你们若退后不跟从他，他还要把以色列人撇在旷野，便是你们使这众民灭亡。」

chapters.en: Then the Gadites and Reubenites approached Moses and said, “We want to build sheepfolds here for our livestock and cities for our little ones.
chapters.zh: 两支派的人挨近摩西，说：「我们要在这里为牲畜垒圈，为〔妇人〕孩子造城。

chapters.en: But we will arm ourselves and be ready to go ahead of the Israelites until we have brought them into their place. Meanwhile, our little ones will remain in the fortified cities for protection from the inhabitants of the land.
chapters.zh: 我们自己要带兵器行在以色列人的前头，好把他们领到他们的地方；但我们的〔妇人〕孩子，因这地居民的缘故，要住在坚固的城内。

chapters.en: We will not return to our homes until every Israelite has taken possession of his inheritance.
chapters.zh: 我们不回家，直等到以色列人各承受自己的产业。

chapters.en: Yet we will not have an inheritance with them across the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on the east side of the Jordan.”
chapters.zh: 我们不和他们在约旦河那边一带之地同受产业，因为我们的产业是坐落在约旦河东边这里。」

chapters.en: Moses replied, “If you will do this—if you will arm yourselves before the LORD for battle,
chapters.zh: 摩西对他们说：「你们若这样行，在耶和华面前带着兵器出去打仗，

chapters.en: and if every one of your armed men crosses the Jordan before the LORD, until He has driven His enemies out before Him,
chapters.zh: 所有带兵器的人都要在耶和华面前过约旦河，等他赶出他的仇敌，

chapters.en: then when the land is subdued before the LORD, you may return and be free of obligation to the LORD and to Israel. And this land will belong to you as a possession before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 那地被耶和华制伏了，然后你们可以回来，向耶和华和以色列才为无罪，这地也必在耶和华面前归你们为业。

chapters.en: But if you do not do this, you will certainly sin against the LORD—and be assured that your sin will find you out.
chapters.zh: 倘若你们不这样行，就得罪耶和华，要知道你们的罪必追上你们。

chapters.en: Build cities for your little ones and folds for your flocks, but do what you have promised.”
chapters.zh: 如今你们口中所出的，只管去行，为你们的〔妇人〕孩子造城，为你们的羊群垒圈。」

chapters.en: The Gadites and Reubenites said to Moses, “Your servants will do just as our lord commands.
chapters.zh: 迦得子孙和吕便子孙对摩西说：「仆人要照我主所吩咐的去行。

chapters.en: Our children, our wives, our livestock, and all our animals will remain here in the cities of Gilead.
chapters.zh: 我们的妻子、孩子、羊群，和所有的牲畜都要留在基列的各城。

chapters.en: But your servants are equipped for war, and every man will cross over to the battle before the LORD, just as our lord says.”
chapters.zh: 但你的仆人，凡带兵器的，都要照我主所说的话，在耶和华面前过去打仗。」

chapters.en: So Moses gave orders about them to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua son of Nun, and to the family leaders of the tribes of Israel.
chapters.zh: 于是，摩西为他们嘱咐祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列众支派的族长，说：

chapters.en: And Moses said to them, “If the Gadites and Reubenites cross the Jordan with you, with every man armed for battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you are to give them the land of Gilead as a possession.
chapters.zh: 「迦得子孙和吕便子孙，凡带兵器在耶和华面前去打仗的，若与你们一同过约旦河，那地被你们制伏了，你们就要把基列地给他们为业。

chapters.en: But if they do not arm themselves and go across with you, then they must accept their possession among you in the land of Canaan.”
chapters.zh: 倘若他们不带兵器和你们一同过去，就要在迦南地你们中间得产业。」

chapters.en: The Gadites and Reubenites replied, “As the LORD has spoken to your servants, so we will do.
chapters.zh: 迦得子孙和吕便子孙回答说：「耶和华怎样吩咐仆人，仆人就怎样行。

chapters.en: We will cross over into the land of Canaan armed before the LORD, that we may have our inheritance on this side of the Jordan.”
chapters.zh: 我们要带兵器，在耶和华面前过去，进入迦南地，只是约旦河这边、我们所得为业之地〔仍归〕我们。」

chapters.en: So Moses gave to the Gadites, to the Reubenites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan—the land including its cities and the territory surrounding them.
chapters.zh: 摩西将亚摩利王西宏的国和巴珊王噩的国，连那地和周围的城邑，都给了迦得子孙和吕便子孙，并约瑟的儿子玛拿西半个支派。

chapters.en: And the Gadites built up Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
chapters.zh: 迦得子孙建造底本、亚他录、亚罗珥、

chapters.en: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
chapters.zh: 亚他录‧朔反、雅谢、约比哈、

chapters.en: Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran as fortified cities, and they built folds for their flocks.
chapters.zh: 伯‧宁拉、伯‧哈兰，都是坚固城。他们又垒羊圈。

chapters.en: The Reubenites built up Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
chapters.zh: 吕便子孙建造希实本、以利亚利、基列亭、

chapters.en: as well as Nebo and Baal-meon (whose names were changed), and Sibmah. And they renamed the cities they rebuilt.
chapters.zh: 尼波、巴力‧免、西比玛（尼波、巴力‧免，名字是改了的），又给他们所建造的城另起别名。

chapters.en: The descendants of Machir son of Manasseh went to Gilead, captured it, and drove out the Amorites who were there.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西的儿子玛吉，他的子孙往基列去，佔了那地，赶出那里的亚摩利人。

chapters.en: So Moses gave Gilead to the clan of Machir son of Manasseh, and they settled there.
chapters.zh: 摩西将基列赐给玛拿西的儿子玛吉，他〔子孙〕就住在那里。

chapters.en: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, went and captured their villages and called them Havvoth-jair.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西的子孙睚珥去佔了基列的村庄，就称这些村庄为哈倭特‧睚珥。

chapters.en: And Nobah went and captured Kenath and its villages and called it Nobah, after his own name.
chapters.zh: 挪巴去佔了基纳和基纳的乡村，就按自己的名称基纳为挪巴。

chapters.en: These are the journeys of the Israelites when they came out of the land of Egypt by their divisions under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.
chapters.zh: 以色列人按着军队，在摩西、亚伦的手下出埃及地所行的路程〔注：或译：站口；下同〕记在下面。

chapters.en: At the LORD’s command, Moses recorded the stages of their journey. These are the stages listed by their starting points:
chapters.zh: 摩西遵着耶和华的吩咐记载他们所行的路程，其路程乃是这样：

chapters.en: On the fifteenth day of the first month, on the day after the Passover, the Israelites set out from Rameses. They marched out defiantly in full view of all the Egyptians,
chapters.zh: 正月十五日，就是逾越节的次日，以色列人从兰塞起行，在一切埃及人眼前昂然无惧地出去。

chapters.en: who were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck down among them; for the LORD had executed judgment against their gods.
chapters.zh: 那时，埃及人正葬埋他们的长子，就是耶和华在他们中间所击杀的；耶和华也败坏他们的神。

chapters.en: The Israelites set out from Rameses and camped at Succoth.
chapters.zh: 以色列人从兰塞起行，安营在疏割。

chapters.en: They set out from Succoth and camped at Etham, on the edge of the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 从疏割起行，安营在旷野边的以倘。

chapters.en: They set out from Etham and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, opposite Baal-zephon, and they camped near Migdol.
chapters.zh: 从以倘起行，转到比‧哈希录，是在巴力‧洗分对面，就在密夺安营。

chapters.en: They set out from Pi-hahiroth and crossed through the sea, into the wilderness, and they journeyed three days into the Wilderness of Etham and camped at Marah.
chapters.zh: 从比‧哈希录对面起行，经过海中到了〔书珥〕旷野，又在伊坦的旷野走了三天的路程，就安营在玛拉。

chapters.en: They set out from Marah and came to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.
chapters.zh: 从玛拉起行，来到以琳（以琳有十二股水泉，七十棵棕树），就在那里安营。

chapters.en: They set out from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.
chapters.zh: 从以琳起行，安营在红海边。

chapters.en: They set out from the Red Sea and camped in the Desert of Sin.
chapters.zh: 从红海边起行，安营在汛的旷野。

chapters.en: They set out from the Desert of Sin and camped at Dophkah.
chapters.zh: 从汛的旷野起行，安营在脱加。

chapters.en: They set out from Dophkah and camped at Alush.
chapters.zh: 从脱加起行，安营在亚录。

chapters.en: They set out from Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
chapters.zh: 从亚录起行，安营在利非订；在那里，百姓没有水喝。

chapters.en: They set out from Rephidim and camped in the Wilderness of Sinai.
chapters.zh: 从利非订起行，安营在西奈的旷野。

chapters.en: They set out from the Wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth-hattaavah.
chapters.zh: 从西奈的旷野起行，安营在基博罗‧哈他瓦。

chapters.en: They set out from Kibroth-hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.
chapters.zh: 从基博罗‧哈他瓦起行，安营在哈洗录。

chapters.en: They set out from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.
chapters.zh: 从哈洗录起行，安营在利提玛。

chapters.en: They set out from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon-perez.
chapters.zh: 从利提玛起行，安营在临门‧帕烈。

chapters.en: They set out from Rimmon-perez and camped at Libnah.
chapters.zh: 从临门‧帕烈起行，安营在立拿。

chapters.en: They set out from Libnah and camped at Rissah.
chapters.zh: 从立拿起行，安营在勒撒。

chapters.en: They set out from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.
chapters.zh: 从勒撒起行，安营在基希拉他。

chapters.en: They set out from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.
chapters.zh: 从基希拉他起行，安营在沙斐山。

chapters.en: They set out from Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.
chapters.zh: 从沙斐山起行，安营在哈拉大。

chapters.en: They set out from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.
chapters.zh: 从哈拉大起行，安营在玛吉希录。

chapters.en: They set out from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.
chapters.zh: 从玛吉希录起行，安营在他哈。

chapters.en: They set out from Tahath and camped at Terah.
chapters.zh: 从他哈起行，安营在他拉。

chapters.en: They set out from Terah and camped at Mithkah.
chapters.zh: 从他拉起行，安营在密加。

chapters.en: They set out from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.
chapters.zh: 从密加起行，安营在哈摩拿。

chapters.en: They set out from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.
chapters.zh: 从哈摩拿起行，安营在摩西录。

chapters.en: They set out from Moseroth and camped at Bene-jaakan.
chapters.zh: 从摩西录起行，安营在比尼‧亚干。

chapters.en: They set out from Bene-jaakan and camped at Hor-haggidgad.
chapters.zh: 从比尼‧亚干起行，安营在曷‧哈及甲。

chapters.en: They set out from Hor-haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.
chapters.zh: 从曷‧哈及甲起行，安营在约巴他。

chapters.en: They set out from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.
chapters.zh: 从约巴他起行，安营在阿博拿。

chapters.en: They set out from Abronah and camped at Ezion-geber.
chapters.zh: 从阿博拿起行，安营在以旬‧迦别。

chapters.en: They set out from Ezion-geber and camped at Kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin.
chapters.zh: 从以旬‧迦别起行，安营在寻的旷野，就是加低斯。

chapters.en: They set out from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the outskirts of the land of Edom.
chapters.zh: 从加低斯起行，安营在何珥山，以东地的边界。

chapters.en: At the LORD’s command, Aaron the priest climbed Mount Hor and died there on the first day of the fifth month, in the fortieth year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 以色列人出了埃及地后四十年，五月初一日，祭司亚伦遵着耶和华的吩咐上何珥山，就死在那里。

chapters.en: Aaron was 123 years old when he died on Mount Hor.
chapters.zh: 亚伦死在何珥山的时候年一百二十三岁。

chapters.en: Now the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev in the land of Canaan, heard that the Israelites were coming.
chapters.zh: 住在迦南南地的迦南人亚拉得王听说以色列人来了。

chapters.en: And the Israelites set out from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.
chapters.zh: 以色列人从何珥山起行，安营在撒摩拿。

chapters.en: They set out from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
chapters.zh: 从撒摩拿起行，安营在普嫩。

chapters.en: They set out from Punon and camped at Oboth.
chapters.zh: 从普嫩起行，安营在阿伯。

chapters.en: They set out from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim on the border of Moab.
chapters.zh: 从阿伯起行，安营在以耶‧亚巴琳，摩押的边界。

chapters.en: They set out from Iyim and camped at Dibon-gad.
chapters.zh: 从以耶‧亚巴琳起行，安营在底本‧迦得。

chapters.en: They set out from Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.
chapters.zh: 从底本‧迦得起行，安营在亚门‧低比拉太音。

chapters.en: They set out from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim facing Nebo.
chapters.zh: 从亚门‧低比拉太音起行，安营在尼波对面的亚巴琳山里。

chapters.en: They set out from the mountains of Abarim and camped on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
chapters.zh: 从亚巴琳山起行，安营在摩押平原－约旦河边、耶利哥对面。

chapters.en: And there on the plains of Moab they camped by the Jordan, from Beth-jeshimoth to Abel-shittim.
chapters.zh: 他们在摩押平原沿约旦河边安营，从伯‧耶施末直到亚伯‧什亭。

chapters.en: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华在摩押平原－约旦河边、耶利哥对面晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
chapters.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人说：你们过约旦河进迦南地的时候，

chapters.en: you must drive out before you all the inhabitants of the land, destroy all their carved images and cast idols, and demolish all their high places.
chapters.zh: 就要从你们面前赶出那里所有的居民，毁灭他们一切錾成的〔石〕像和他们一切铸成的偶像，又拆毁他们一切的邱坛。

chapters.en: You are to take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given you the land to possess.
chapters.zh: 你们要夺那地，住在其中，因我把那地赐给你们为业。

chapters.en: And you are to divide the land by lot according to your clans. Give a larger inheritance to a larger clan and a smaller inheritance to a smaller one. Whatever falls to each one by lot will be his. You will receive an inheritance according to the tribes of your fathers.
chapters.zh: 你们要按家室拈鬮，承受那地；人多的，要把产业多分给他们；人少的，要把产业少分给他们。拈出何地给何人，就要归何人。你们要按宗族的支派承受。
