chapters.en: But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land before you, those you allow to remain will become barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides; they will harass you in the land where you settle.
chapters.zh: 倘若你们不赶出那地的居民，所容留的居民就必作你们眼中的刺，肋下的荆棘，也必在你们所住的地上扰害你们。

chapters.en: And then I will do to you what I had planned to do to them.”
chapters.zh: 而且我素常有意怎样待他们，也必照样待你们。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “Command the Israelites and say to them: When you enter the land of Canaan, it will be allotted to you as an inheritance with these boundaries:
chapters.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人说：你们到了迦南地，就是归你们为业的迦南四境之地，

chapters.en: Your southern border will extend from the Wilderness of Zin along the border of Edom. On the east, your southern border will run from the end of the Salt Sea,
chapters.zh: 南角要从寻的旷野，贴着以东的边界；南界要从盐海东头起，

chapters.en: cross south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, continue to Zin, and go south of Kadesh-barnea. Then it will go on to Hazar-addar and proceed to Azmon,
chapters.zh: 绕到亚克拉滨坡的南边，接连到寻，直通到加低斯‧巴尼亚的南边，又通到哈萨‧亚达，接连到押们，

chapters.en: where it will turn from Azmon, join the Brook of Egypt, and end at the Sea.
chapters.zh: 从押们转到埃及小河，直通到海为止。

chapters.en: Your western border will be the coastline of the Great Sea; this will be your boundary on the west.
chapters.zh: 「西边要以大海为界；这就是你们的西界。

chapters.en: Your northern border will run from the Great Sea directly to Mount Hor,
chapters.zh: 「北界要从大海起，划到何珥山，

chapters.en: and from Mount Hor to Lebo-hamath, then extend to Zedad,
chapters.zh: 从何珥山划到哈马口，通到西达达，

chapters.en: continue to Ziphron, and end at Hazar-enan. This will be your boundary on the north.
chapters.zh: 又通到西斐崙，直到哈萨‧以难。这要作你们的北界。

chapters.en: And your eastern border will run straight from Hazar-enan to Shepham,
chapters.zh: 「你们要从哈萨‧以难划到示番为东界。

chapters.en: then go down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain and continue along the slopes east of the Sea of Chinnereth.
chapters.zh: 这界要从示番下到亚延东边的利比拉，又要达到基尼烈湖的东边。

chapters.en:
Then the border will go down along the Jordan and end at the Salt Sea.
This will be your land, defined by its borders on all sides.”
chapters.zh: 这界要下到约旦河，通到盐海为止。这四围的边界以内，要作你们的地。」

chapters.en: So Moses commanded the Israelites, “Apportion this land by lot as an inheritance. The LORD has commanded that it be given to the nine and a half tribes.
chapters.zh: 摩西吩咐以色列人说：「这地就是耶和华吩咐拈鬮给九个半支派承受为业的；

chapters.en: For the tribes of the Reubenites and Gadites, along with the half-tribe of Manasseh, have already received their inheritance.
chapters.zh: 因为吕便支派和迦得支派按着宗族受了产业，玛拿西半个支派也受了产业。

chapters.en: These two and a half tribes have received their inheritance across the Jordan from Jericho, toward the sunrise.”
chapters.zh: 这两个半支派已经在耶利哥对面、约旦河东、向日出之地受了产业。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “These are the names of the men who are to assign the land as an inheritance for you: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun.
chapters.zh: 「要给你们分地为业之人的名字是祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚。

chapters.en: Appoint one leader from each tribe to distribute the land.
chapters.zh: 又要从每支派中选一个首领帮助他们。

chapters.en:
These are their names:
Caleb son of Jephunneh from the tribe of Judah;
chapters.zh: 这些人的名字：犹大支派有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒。

chapters.en: Shemuel son of Ammihud from the tribe of Simeon;
chapters.zh: 西缅支派有亚米忽的儿子示母利。

chapters.en: Elidad son of Chislon from the tribe of Benjamin;
chapters.zh: 便雅悯支派有基斯伦的儿子以利达。

chapters.en: Bukki son of Jogli, a leader from the tribe of Dan;
chapters.zh: 但支派有一个首领，约利的儿子布基。

chapters.en: Hanniel son of Ephod, a leader from the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph;
chapters.zh: 约瑟的子孙玛拿西支派有一个首领，以弗的儿子汉聂。

chapters.en: Kemuel son of Shiphtan, a leader from the tribe of Ephraim;
chapters.zh: 以法莲支派有一个首领，拾弗但的儿子基母利。

chapters.en: Eli-zaphan son of Parnach, a leader from the tribe of Zebulun;
chapters.zh: 西布伦支派有一个首领，帕纳的儿子以利撒番。

chapters.en: Paltiel son of Azzan, a leader from the tribe of Issachar;
chapters.zh: 以萨迦支派有一个首领，阿散的儿子帕铁。

chapters.en: Ahihud son of Shelomi, a leader from the tribe of Asher;
chapters.zh: 亚设支派有一个首领，示罗米的儿子亚希忽。

chapters.en: and Pedahel son of Ammihud, a leader from the tribe of Naphtali.”
chapters.zh: 拿弗他利支派有一个首领，亚米忽的儿子比大黑。」

chapters.en: These are the ones whom the LORD commanded to apportion the inheritance to the Israelites in the land of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 这些人就是耶和华所吩咐、在迦南地把产业分给以色列人的。

chapters.en: Again the LORD spoke to Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho:
chapters.zh: 耶和华在摩押平原－约旦河边、耶利哥对面晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “Command the Israelites to give, from the inheritance they will possess, cities for the Levites to live in and pasturelands around the cities.
chapters.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人，要从所得为业的地中把些城给利未人居住，也要把这城四围的郊野给利未人。

chapters.en: The cities will be for them to live in, and the pasturelands will be for their herds, their flocks, and all their other livestock.
chapters.zh: 这城邑要归他们居住，城邑的郊野可以牧养他们的牛羊和各样的牲畜，又可以安置他们的财物。

chapters.en: The pasturelands around the cities you are to give the Levites will extend a thousand cubits from the wall on every side.
chapters.zh: 你们给利未人的郊野，要从城根起，四围往外量一千肘。

chapters.en: You are also to measure two thousand cubits outside the city on the east, two thousand on the south, two thousand on the west, and two thousand on the north, with the city in the center. These areas will serve as larger pasturelands for the cities.
chapters.zh: 另外东量二千肘，南量二千肘，西量二千肘，北量二千肘，为边界，城在当中；这要归他们作城邑的郊野。

chapters.en: Six of the cities you give the Levites are to be appointed as cities of refuge, to which a manslayer may flee. In addition to these, give the Levites forty-two other cities.
chapters.zh: 你们给利未人的城邑，其中当有六座逃城，使误杀人的可以逃到那里。此外还要给他们四十二座城。

chapters.en: The total number of cities you give the Levites will be forty-eight, with their corresponding pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 你们要给利未人的城，共有四十八座，连城带郊野〔都要给他们〕。

chapters.en: The cities that you apportion from the territory of the Israelites should be given to the Levites in proportion to the inheritance of each tribe: more from a larger tribe and less from a smaller one.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人所得的地业从中要把些城邑给〔利未人〕；人多的就多给，人少的就少给；各〔支派〕要按所承受为业之地把城邑给利未人。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

chapters.en: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
chapters.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人说：你们过约旦河，进了迦南地，

chapters.en: designate cities to serve as your cities of refuge, so that a person who kills someone unintentionally may flee there.
chapters.zh: 就要分出几座城，为你们作逃城，使误杀人的可以逃到那里。

chapters.en: You are to have these cities as a refuge from the avenger, so that the manslayer will not die until he stands trial before the assembly.
chapters.zh: 这些城可以作逃避报仇人的城，使误杀人的不至于死，等他站在会众面前听审判。

chapters.en: The cities you select will be your six cities of refuge.
chapters.zh: 你们所分出来的城，要作六座逃城。

chapters.en: Select three cities across the Jordan and three in the land of Canaan as cities of refuge.
chapters.zh: 在约旦河东要分出三座城，在迦南地也要分出三座城，都作逃城。

chapters.en: These six cities will serve as a refuge for the Israelites and for the foreigner or stranger among them, so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally may flee there.
chapters.zh: 这六座城要给以色列人和他们中间的外人，并寄居的，作为逃城，使误杀人的都可以逃到那里。

chapters.en: If, however, anyone strikes a person with an iron object and kills him, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.
chapters.zh: 「倘若人用铁器打人，以致打死，他就是故杀人的；故杀人的必被治死。

chapters.en: Or if anyone has in his hand a stone of deadly size, and he strikes and kills another, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.
chapters.zh: 若用可以打死人的石头打死了人，他就是故杀人的；故杀人的必被治死。

chapters.en: If anyone has in his hand a deadly object of wood, and he strikes and kills another, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.
chapters.zh: 若用可以打死人的木器打死了人，他就是故杀人的；故杀人的必被治死。

chapters.en: The avenger of blood is to put the murderer to death; when he finds him, he is to kill him.
chapters.zh: 报血仇的必亲自杀那故杀人的，一遇见就杀他。

chapters.en: Likewise, if anyone maliciously pushes another or intentionally throws an object at him and kills him,
chapters.zh: 人若因怨恨把人推倒，或是埋伏往人身上扔物，以致于死，

chapters.en: or if in hostility he strikes him with his hand and he dies, the one who struck him must surely be put to death; he is a murderer. When the avenger of blood finds the murderer, he is to kill him.
chapters.zh: 或是因仇恨用手打人，以致于死，那打人的必被治死。他是故杀人的；报血仇的一遇见就杀他。

chapters.en: But if anyone pushes a person suddenly, without hostility, or throws an object at him unintentionally,
chapters.zh: 「倘若人没有仇恨，忽然将人推倒，或是没有埋伏把物扔在人身上，

chapters.en: or without looking drops a heavy stone that kills him, but he was not an enemy and did not intend to harm him,
chapters.zh: 或是没有看见的时候用可以打死人的石头扔在人身上，以致于死，本来与他无仇，也无意害他。

chapters.en: then the congregation must judge between the slayer and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.
chapters.zh: 会众就要照典章，在打死人的和报血仇的中间审判。

chapters.en: The assembly is to protect the manslayer from the hand of the avenger of blood. Then the assembly will return him to the city of refuge to which he fled, and he must live there until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
chapters.zh: 会众要救这误杀人的脱离报血仇人的手，也要使他归入逃城。他要住在其中，直等到受圣膏的大祭司死了。

chapters.en: But if the manslayer ever goes outside the limits of the city of refuge to which he fled
chapters.zh: 但误杀人的，无论什么时候，若出了逃城的境外，

chapters.en: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of his city of refuge and kills him, then the avenger will not be guilty of bloodshed,
chapters.zh: 报血仇的在逃城境外遇见他，将他杀了，报血仇的就没有流血之罪。

chapters.en: because the manslayer must remain in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. Only after the death of the high priest may he return to the land he owns.
chapters.zh: 因为误杀人的该住在逃城里，等到大祭司死了。大祭司死了以后，误杀人的才可以回到他所得为业之地。

chapters.en: This will be a statutory ordinance for you for the generations to come, wherever you live.
chapters.zh: 这在你们一切的住处，要作你们世世代代的律例典章。

chapters.en: If anyone kills a person, the murderer is to be put to death on the testimony of the witnesses. But no one is to be put to death based on the testimony of a lone witness.
chapters.zh: 「无论谁故杀人，要凭几个见证人的口把那故杀人的杀了，只是不可凭一个见证的口叫人死。

chapters.en: You are not to accept a ransom for the life of a murderer who deserves to die; he must surely be put to death.
chapters.zh: 故杀人、犯死罪的，你们不可收赎价代替他的命；他必被治死。

chapters.en: Nor should you accept a ransom for the person who flees to a city of refuge and allow him to return and live on his own land before the death of the high priest.
chapters.zh: 那逃到逃城的人，你们不可为他收赎价，使他在大祭司未死以先再来住在本地。

chapters.en: Do not pollute the land where you live, for bloodshed pollutes the land, and no atonement can be made for the land on which the blood is shed, except by the blood of the one who shed it.
chapters.zh: 这样，你们就不污秽所住之地，因为血是污秽地的；若有在地上流人血的，非流那杀人者的血，那地就不得洁净〔注：原文是赎〕。

chapters.en: Do not defile the land where you live and where I dwell. For I, the LORD, dwell among the Israelites.”
chapters.zh: 你们不可玷污所住之地，就是我住在其中之地，因为我－耶和华住在以色列人中间。」

chapters.en: Now the family heads of the clan of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh, one of the clans of Joseph, approached Moses and the leaders who were the heads of the Israelite families and addressed them,
chapters.zh: 约瑟的后裔，玛拿西的孙子，玛吉的儿子基列，他子孙中的诸族长来到摩西和作首领的以色列人族长面前，说：

chapters.en: saying, “When the LORD commanded my lord to give the land as an inheritance to the Israelites by lot, He also commanded him to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华曾吩咐我主拈鬮分给以色列人为业，我主也受了耶和华的吩咐将我们兄弟西罗非哈的产业分给他的众女儿。

chapters.en: But if they marry any of the men from the other tribes of Israel, their inheritance will be withdrawn from the portion of our fathers and added to the tribe into which they marry. So our allotted inheritance would be taken away.
chapters.zh: 她们若嫁以色列〔别〕支派的人，就必将我们祖宗所遗留的产业加在她们丈夫支派的产业中。这样，我们拈鬮所得的产业就要减少了。

chapters.en: And when the Jubilee for the Israelites comes, their inheritance will be added to the tribe into which they marry and taken away from the tribe of our fathers.”
chapters.zh: 到了以色列人的禧年，这女儿的产业就必加在她们丈夫支派的产业上。这样，我们祖宗支派的产业就减少了。」

chapters.en: So at the word of the LORD, Moses commanded the Israelites: “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks correctly.
chapters.zh: 摩西照耶和华的话吩咐以色列人说：「约瑟支派的人说得有理。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD has commanded concerning the daughters of Zelophehad: They may marry anyone they please, provided they marry within a clan of the tribe of their father.
chapters.zh: 论到西罗非哈的众女儿，耶和华这样吩咐说：她们可以随意嫁人，只是要嫁同宗支派的人。

chapters.en: No inheritance in Israel may be transferred from tribe to tribe, because each of the Israelites is to retain the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
chapters.zh: 这样，以色列人的产业就不从这支派归到那支派，因为以色列人要各守各祖宗支派的产业。

chapters.en: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance from any Israelite tribe must marry within a clan of the tribe of her father, so that every Israelite will possess the inheritance of his fathers.
chapters.zh: 凡在以色列支派中得了产业的女子必作同宗支派人的妻，好叫以色列人各自承受他祖宗的产业。

chapters.en: No inheritance may be transferred from one tribe to another, for each tribe of Israel must retain its inheritance.”
chapters.zh: 这样，他们的产业就不从这支派归到那支派，因为以色列支派的人要各守各的产业。」

chapters.en: So the daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD had commanded Moses.
chapters.zh: 耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，西罗非哈的众女儿就怎样行。

chapters.en: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to cousins on their father’s side.
chapters.zh: 西罗非哈的女儿玛拉、得撒、曷拉、密迦、挪阿都嫁了他们伯叔的儿子。

chapters.en: They married within the clans of the descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained within the tribe of their father’s clan.
chapters.zh: 她们嫁入约瑟儿子、玛拿西子孙的族中；她们的产业仍留在同宗支派中。

chapters.en: These are the commandments and ordinances that the LORD gave the Israelites through Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
chapters.zh: 这是耶和华在摩押平原－约旦河边、耶利哥对面－藉着摩西所吩咐以色列人的命令典章。

chapters.en: These are the words that Moses spoke to all Israel in the wilderness east of the Jordan—in the Arabah opposite Suph—between Paran and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
chapters.zh: 以下所记的是摩西在约旦河东的旷野、疏弗对面的亚拉巴－就是巴兰、陀弗、拉班、哈洗录、底撒哈中间－向以色列众人所说的话。

chapters.en: It is an eleven-day journey from Horeb to Kadesh-barnea by way of Mount Seir.
chapters.zh: （从何烈山经过西珥山到加低斯‧巴尼亚有十一天的〔路程〕。）

chapters.en: In the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses proclaimed to the Israelites all that the LORD had commanded him concerning them.
chapters.zh: 出埃及第四十年十一月初一日，摩西照耶和华藉着他所吩咐以色列人的话都晓谕他们。

chapters.en: This was after he had defeated Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and then at Edrei had defeated Og king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth.
chapters.zh: 那时，他已经击杀了住希实本的亚摩利王西宏和住以得来、亚斯他录的巴珊王噩。

chapters.en: On the east side of the Jordan in the land of Moab, Moses began to explain this law, saying:
chapters.zh: 摩西在约旦河东的摩押地讲律法说：

chapters.en: The LORD our God said to us at Horeb: “You have stayed at this mountain long enough.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华－我们的上帝在何烈山晓谕我们说：你们在这山上住的日子够了；

chapters.en: Resume your journey and go to the hill country of the Amorites; go to all the neighboring peoples in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the foothills, in the Negev, and along the seacoast to the land of the Canaanites and to Lebanon, as far as the great River Euphrates.
chapters.zh: 要起行转到亚摩利人的山地和靠近这山地的各处，就是亚拉巴、山地、高原、南地，沿海一带迦南人的地，并黎巴嫩山又到幼发拉底大河。

chapters.en: See, I have placed the land before you. Enter and possess the land that the LORD swore He would give to your fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and to their descendants after them.”
chapters.zh: 如今我将这地摆在你们面前；你们要进去得这地，就是耶和华向你们列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许赐给他们和他们后裔为业之地。」

chapters.en: At that time I said to you, “I cannot carry the burden for you alone.
chapters.zh: 「那时，我对你们说：『管理你们的重任，我独自担当不起。

chapters.en: The LORD your God has multiplied you, so that today you are as numerous as the stars in the sky.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你们的上帝使你们多起来。看哪，你们今日像天上的星那样多。

chapters.en: May the LORD, the God of your fathers, increase you a thousand times over and bless you as He has promised.
chapters.zh: 惟愿耶和华－你们列祖的上帝使你们比如今更多千倍，照他所应许你们的话赐福与你们。

chapters.en: But how can I bear your troubles, burdens, and disputes all by myself?
chapters.zh: 但你们的麻烦，和管理你们的重任，并你们的争讼，我独自一人怎能担当得起呢？

chapters.en: Choose for yourselves wise, understanding, and respected men from each of your tribes, and I will appoint them as your leaders.”
chapters.zh: 你们要按着各支派选举有智慧、有见识、为众人所认识的，我立他们为你们的首领。』

chapters.en: And you answered me and said, “What you propose to do is good.”
chapters.zh: 你们回答我说：『照你所说的行了为妙。』

chapters.en: So I took the leaders of your tribes, wise and respected men, and appointed them as leaders over you—as commanders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens, and as officers for your tribes.
chapters.zh: 我便将你们各支派的首领，有智慧、为众人所认识的，照你们的支派，立他们为官长、千夫长、百夫长、五十夫长、十夫长，管理你们。

chapters.en: At that time I charged your judges: “Hear the disputes between your brothers, and judge fairly between a man and his brother or a foreign resident.
chapters.zh: 「当时，我嘱咐你们的审判官说：『你们听讼，无论是弟兄彼此争讼，是与同居的外人争讼，都要按公义判断。

chapters.en: Show no partiality in judging; hear both small and great alike. Do not be intimidated by anyone, for judgment belongs to God. And bring to me any case too difficult for you, and I will hear it.”
chapters.zh: 审判的时候，不可看人的外貌；听讼不可分贵贱，不可惧怕人，因为审判是属乎上帝的。若有难断的案件，可以呈到我这里，我就判断。』

chapters.en: And at that time I commanded you all the things you were to do.
chapters.zh: 那时，我将你们所当行的事都吩咐你们了。」

chapters.en: And just as the LORD our God had commanded us, we set out from Horeb and went toward the hill country of the Amorites, through all the vast and terrifying wilderness you have seen. When we reached Kadesh-barnea,
chapters.zh: 「我们照着耶和华－我们上帝所吩咐的从何烈山起行，经过你们所看见那大而可怕的旷野，往亚摩利人的山地去，到了加低斯‧巴尼亚。

chapters.en: I said: “You have reached the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God is giving us.
chapters.zh: 我对你们说：『你们已经到了耶和华－我们上帝所赐给我们的亚摩利人之山地。

chapters.en: See, the LORD your God has placed the land before you. Go up and take possession of it as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has told you. Do not be afraid or discouraged.”
chapters.zh: 看哪，耶和华－你的上帝已将那地摆在你面前，你要照耶和华－你列祖的上帝所说的上去得那地为业；不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。』

chapters.en: Then all of you approached me and said, “Let us send men ahead of us to search out the land and bring us word of what route to follow and which cities to enter.”
chapters.zh: 你们都就近我来说：『我们要先打发人去，为我们窥探那地，将我们上去该走何道，必进何城，都回报我们。』

chapters.en: The plan seemed good to me, so I selected twelve men from among you, one from each tribe.
chapters.zh: 这话我以为美，就从你们中间选了十二个人，每支派一人。

chapters.en: They left and went up into the hill country, and came to the Valley of Eshcol and spied out the land.
chapters.zh: 于是他们起身上山地去，到以实各谷，窥探那地。

chapters.en: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands, carried it down to us, and brought us word: “It is a good land that the LORD our God is giving us.”
chapters.zh: 他们手里拿着那地的果子下来，到我们那里，回报说：『耶和华－我们的上帝所赐给我们的是美地。』

chapters.en: But you were unwilling to go up; you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 「你们却不肯上去，竟违背了耶和华－你们上帝的命令，

chapters.en: You grumbled in your tents and said, “Because the LORD hates us, He has brought us out of the land of Egypt to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to be annihilated.
chapters.zh: 在帐棚内发怨言说：『耶和华因为恨我们，所以将我们从埃及地领出来，要交在亚摩利人手中，除灭我们。

chapters.en: Where can we go? Our brothers have made our hearts melt, saying: ‘The people are larger and taller than we are; the cities are large, with walls up to the heavens. We even saw the descendants of the Anakim there.’”
chapters.zh: 我们上哪里去呢？我们的弟兄使我们的心消化，说那〔地的〕民比我们又大又高，城邑又广大又坚固，高得顶天，并且我们在那里看见亚衲族的人。』

chapters.en: So I said to you: “Do not be terrified or afraid of them!
chapters.zh: 我就对你们说：『不要惊恐，也不要怕他们。

chapters.en: The LORD your God, who goes before you, will fight for you, just as you saw Him do for you in Egypt
chapters.zh: 在你们前面行的耶和华－你们的上帝必为你们争战，正如他在埃及和旷野，在你们眼前所行的一样。

chapters.en: and in the wilderness, where the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, all the way by which you traveled until you reached this place.”
chapters.zh: 你们在旷野所行的路上，也曾见耶和华－你们的上帝抚养你们，如同人抚养儿子一般，直等你们来到这地方。』

chapters.en: But in spite of all this, you did not trust the LORD your God,
chapters.zh: 你们在这事上却不信耶和华－你们的上帝。

chapters.en: who went before you on the journey, in the fire by night and in the cloud by day, to seek out a place for you to camp and to show you the road to travel.
chapters.zh: 他在路上，在你们前面行，为你们找安营的地方；夜间在火〔柱〕里，日间在云〔柱〕里，指示你们所当行的路。」

chapters.en: When the LORD heard your words, He grew angry and swore an oath, saying,
chapters.zh: 「耶和华听见你们这话，就发怒，起誓说：

chapters.en: “Not one of the men of this evil generation shall see the good land I swore to give your fathers,
chapters.zh: 『这恶世代的人，连一个也不得见我起誓应许赐给你们列祖的美地；

chapters.en: except Caleb son of Jephunneh. He will see it, and I will give him and his descendants the land on which he has set foot, because he followed the LORD wholeheartedly.”
chapters.zh: 惟有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒必得看见，并且我要将他所踏过的地赐给他和他的子孙，因为他专心跟从我。』

chapters.en: The LORD was also angry with me on your account, and He said, “Not even you shall enter the land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华为你的缘故也向我发怒，说：『你必不得进入那地。

chapters.en: Joshua son of Nun, who stands before you, will enter it. Encourage him, for he will enable Israel to inherit the land.
chapters.zh: 伺候你、嫩的儿子约书亚，他必得进入那地；你要勉励他，因为他要使以色列人承受那地为业。

chapters.en: And the little ones you said would become captives—your children who on that day did not know good from evil—will enter the land that I will give them, and they will possess it.
chapters.zh: 并且你们的〔妇人〕孩子，就是你们所说、必被掳掠的，和今日不知善恶的儿女，必进入那地。我要将那地赐给他们，他们必得为业。

chapters.en: But you are to turn back and head for the wilderness along the route to the Red Sea. ”
chapters.zh: 至于你们，要转回，从红海的路往旷野去。』

chapters.en: “We have sinned against the LORD,” you replied. “We will go up and fight, as the LORD our God has commanded us.” Then each of you put on his weapons of war, thinking it easy to go up into the hill country.
chapters.zh: 「那时，你们回答我说：『我们得罪了耶和华，情愿照耶和华－我们上帝一切所吩咐的上去争战。』于是你们各人带着兵器，争先上山地去了。

chapters.en: But the LORD said to me, “Tell them not to go up and fight, for I am not with you to keep you from defeat by your enemies.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐我说：『你对他们说：不要上去，也不要争战；因我不在你们中间，恐怕你们被仇敌杀败了。』

chapters.en: So I spoke to you, but you would not listen. You rebelled against the command of the LORD and presumptuously went up into the hill country.
chapters.zh: 我就告诉了你们，你们却不听从，竟违背耶和华的命令，擅自上山地去了。

chapters.en: Then the Amorites who lived in the hills came out against you and chased you like a swarm of bees. They routed you from Seir all the way to Hormah.
chapters.zh: 住那山地的亚摩利人就出来攻击你们，追赶你们，如蜂拥一般，在西珥杀退你们，直到何珥玛。

chapters.en: And you returned and wept before the LORD, but He would not listen to your voice or give ear to you.
chapters.zh: 你们便回来，在耶和华面前哭号；耶和华却不听你们的声音，也不向你们侧耳。

chapters.en: For this reason you stayed in Kadesh for a long time—a very long time.
chapters.zh: 于是你们在加低斯住了许多日子。」

chapters.en: Then we turned back and headed for the wilderness by way of the Red Sea, as the LORD had instructed me, and for many days we wandered around Mount Seir.
chapters.zh: 「此后，我们转回，从红海的路往旷野去，是照耶和华所吩咐我的。我们在西珥山绕行了许多日子。

chapters.en: At this time the LORD said to me,
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说：

chapters.en: “You have been wandering around this hill country long enough; turn to the north
chapters.zh: 『你们绕行这山的日子够了，要转向北去。

chapters.en: and command the people: ‘You will pass through the territory of your brothers, the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. They will be afraid of you, so you must be very careful.
chapters.zh: 你吩咐百姓说：你们弟兄以扫的子孙住在西珥，你们要经过他们的境界。他们必惧怕你们，所以你们要分外谨慎。

chapters.en: Do not provoke them, for I will not give you any of their land, not even a footprint, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau as his possession.
chapters.zh: 不可与他们争战；他们的地，连脚掌可踏之处，我都不给你们，因我已将西珥山赐给以扫为业。

chapters.en: You are to pay them in silver for the food you eat and the water you drink.’”
chapters.zh: 你们要用钱向他们买粮吃，也要用钱向他们买水喝。

chapters.en: Indeed, the LORD your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has watched over your journey through this vast wilderness. The LORD your God has been with you these forty years, and you have lacked nothing.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华－你的上帝在你手里所办的一切事上已赐福与你。你走这大旷野，他都知道了。这四十年，耶和华－你的上帝常与你同在，故此你一无所缺。』

chapters.en: So we passed by our brothers, the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. We turned away from the Arabah road, which comes up from Elath and Ezion-geber, and traveled along the road of the Wilderness of Moab.
chapters.zh: 「于是，我们离了我们弟兄以扫子孙所住的西珥，从亚拉巴的路，经过以拉他、以旬‧迦别，转向摩押旷野的路去。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to me, “Do not harass the Moabites or provoke them to war, for I will not give you any of their land, because I have given Ar to the descendants of Lot as their possession.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐我说：『不可扰害摩押人，也不可与他们争战。他们的地，我不赐给你为业，因我已将亚珥赐给罗得的子孙为业。』

chapters.en: (The Emites used to live there, a people great and many, as tall as the Anakites.
chapters.zh: （先前，有以米人住在那里，民数众多，身体高大，像亚衲人一样。

chapters.en: Like the Anakites, they were also regarded as Rephaim, though the Moabites called them Emites.
chapters.zh: 这以米人像亚衲人；也算为利乏音人；摩押人称他们为以米人。

chapters.en: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the descendants of Esau drove them out. They destroyed the Horites from before them and settled in their place, just as Israel did in the land that the LORD gave them as their possession.)
chapters.zh: 先前，何利人也住在西珥，但以扫的子孙将他们除灭，得了他们的地，接着居住，就如以色列在耶和华赐给他为业之地所行的一样。）

chapters.en:
“Now arise and cross over the Brook of Zered.”
So we crossed over the Brook of Zered.
chapters.zh: 现在，起来过撒烈溪！于是我们过了撒烈溪。

chapters.en: The time we spent traveling from Kadesh-barnea until we crossed over the Brook of Zered was thirty-eight years, until that entire generation of fighting men had perished from the camp, as the LORD had sworn to them.
chapters.zh: 自从离开加低斯‧巴尼亚，到过了撒烈溪的时候，共有三十八年，等那世代的兵丁都从营中灭尽，正如耶和华向他们所起的誓。

chapters.en: Indeed, the LORD’s hand was against them, to eliminate them from the camp, until they had all perished.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的手也攻击他们，将他们从营中除灭，直到灭尽。

chapters.en: Now when all the fighting men among the people had died,
chapters.zh: 「兵丁从民中都灭尽死亡以后，

chapters.en: the LORD said to me,
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐我说：

chapters.en: “Today you are going to cross the border of Moab at Ar.
chapters.zh: 『你今天要从摩押的境界亚珥经过，

chapters.en: But when you get close to the Ammonites, do not harass them or provoke them, for I will not give you any of the land of the Ammonites. I have given it to the descendants of Lot as their possession.”
chapters.zh: 走近亚扪人之地，不可扰害他们，也不可与他们争战。亚扪人的地，我不赐给你们为业，因我已将那地赐给罗得的子孙为业。』

chapters.en: (That too was regarded as the land of the Rephaim, who used to live there, though the Ammonites called them Zamzummites.
chapters.zh: （那地也算为利乏音人之地，先前利乏音人住在那里，亚扪人称他们为散送冥。

chapters.en: They were a people great and many, as tall as the Anakites. But the LORD destroyed them from before the Ammonites, who drove them out and settled in their place,
chapters.zh: 那民众多，身体高大，像亚衲人一样，但耶和华从亚扪人面前除灭他们，亚扪人就得了他们的地，接着居住。

chapters.en: just as He had done for the descendants of Esau who lived in Seir, when He destroyed the Horites from before them. They drove them out and have lived in their place to this day.
chapters.zh: 正如耶和华从前为住西珥的以扫子孙将何利人从他们面前除灭、他们得了何利人的地、接着居住一样，直到今日。

chapters.en: And the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza, were destroyed by the Caphtorites, who came out of Caphtor and settled in their place.)
chapters.zh: 从迦斐讬出来的迦斐讬人将先前住在乡村直到迦萨的亚卫人除灭，接着居住。）

chapters.en: “Arise, set out, and cross the Arnon Valley. See, I have delivered into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land. Begin to take possession of it and engage him in battle.
chapters.zh: 你们起来前往，过亚嫩谷；我已将亚摩利人希实本王西宏和他的地交在你手中，你要与他争战，得他的地为业。

chapters.en: This very day I will begin to put the dread and fear of you upon all the nations under heaven. They will hear the reports of you and tremble in anguish because of you.”
chapters.zh: 从今日起，我要使天下万民听见你的名声都惊恐惧怕，且因你发颤伤恸。」

chapters.en: So from the Wilderness of Kedemoth I sent messengers with an offer of peace to Sihon king of Heshbon, saying,
chapters.zh: 「我从基底莫的旷野差遣使者去见希实本王西宏，用和睦的话说：

chapters.en: “Let us pass through your land; we will stay on the main road. We will not turn to the right or to the left.
chapters.zh: 『求你容我从你的地经过，只走大道，不偏左右。

chapters.en: You can sell us food to eat and water to drink in exchange for silver. Only let us pass through on foot,
chapters.zh: 你可以卖粮给我吃，也可以卖水给我喝，只要容我步行过去，

chapters.en: just as the descendants of Esau who live in Seir and the Moabites who live in Ar did for us, until we cross the Jordan into the land that the LORD our God is giving us.”
chapters.zh: 就如住西珥的以扫子孙和住亚珥的摩押人待我一样，等我过了约旦河，好进入耶和华－我们上帝所赐给我们的地。』

chapters.en: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass through, for the LORD your God had made his spirit stubborn and his heart obstinate, that He might deliver him into your hand, as is the case this day.
chapters.zh: 但希实本王西宏不容我们从他那里经过；因为耶和华－你的上帝使他心中刚硬，性情顽梗，为要将他交在你手中，像今日一样。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to me, “See, I have begun to deliver Sihon and his land over to you. Now begin to conquer and possess his land.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说：『从此起首，我要将西宏和他的地交给你；你要得他的地为业。』

chapters.en: So Sihon and his whole army came out for battle against us at Jahaz.
chapters.zh: 那时，西宏和他的众民出来攻击我们，在雅杂与我们交战。

chapters.en: And the LORD our God delivered him over to us, and we defeated him and his sons and his whole army.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－我们的上帝将他交给我们，我们就把他和他的儿子，并他的众民，都击杀了。

chapters.en: At that time we captured all his cities and devoted to destruction the people of every city, including women and children. We left no survivors.
chapters.zh: 我们夺了他的一切城邑，将有人烟的各城，连女人带孩子，尽都毁灭，没有留下一个。

chapters.en: We carried off for ourselves only the livestock and the plunder from the cities we captured.
chapters.zh: 惟有牲畜和所夺的各城，并其中的财物，都取为自己的掠物。

chapters.en: From Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along with the city in the valley, even as far as Gilead, not one city had walls too high for us. The LORD our God gave us all of them.
chapters.zh: 从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中的城，直到基列，耶和华－我们的上帝都交给我们了，没有一座城高得使我们不能攻取的。

chapters.en: But you did not go near the land of the Ammonites, or the land along the banks of the Jabbok River, or the cities of the hill country, or any place that the LORD our God had forbidden.
chapters.zh: 惟有亚扪人之地，凡靠近雅博河的地，并山地的城邑，与耶和华－我们上帝所禁止我们去的地方，都没有挨近。」

chapters.en: Then we turned and went up the road to Bashan, and Og king of Bashan and his whole army came out to meet us in battle at Edrei.
chapters.zh: 「以后，我们转回，向巴珊去。巴珊王噩和他的众民都出来，在以得来与我们交战。

chapters.en: But the LORD said to me, “Do not fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, along with all his people and his land. Do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说：『不要怕他！因我已将他和他的众民，并他的地，都交在你手中；你要待他像从前待住希实本的亚摩利王西宏一样。』

chapters.en: So the LORD our God also delivered Og king of Bashan and his whole army into our hands. We struck them down until no survivor was left.
chapters.zh: 于是耶和华－我们的上帝也将巴珊王噩和他的众民都交在我们手中；我们杀了他们，没有留下一个。

chapters.en: At that time we captured all sixty of his cities. There was not a single city we failed to take—the entire region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
chapters.zh: 那时，我们夺了他所有的城，共有六十座，没有一座城不被我们所夺。这为亚珥歌伯的全境，就是巴珊地噩王的国。

chapters.en: All these cities were fortified with high walls and gates and bars, and there were many more unwalled villages.
chapters.zh: 这些城都有坚固的高墙，有门有闩。此外还有许多无城墙的乡村。

chapters.en: We devoted them to destruction, as we had done to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children of every city.
chapters.zh: 我们将这些都毁灭了，像从前待希实本王西宏一样，把有人烟的各城，连女人带孩子，尽都毁灭；

chapters.en: But all the livestock and plunder of the cities we carried off for ourselves.
chapters.zh: 惟有一切牲畜和城中的财物都取为自己的掠物。

chapters.en: At that time we took from the two kings of the Amorites the land across the Jordan, from the Arnon Valley as far as Mount Hermon—
chapters.zh: 那时，我们从约旦河东两个亚摩利王的手将亚嫩谷直到黑门山之地夺过来

chapters.en: which the Sidonians call Sirion but the Amorites call Senir—
chapters.zh: （这黑门山，西顿人称为西连，亚摩利人称为示尼珥），

chapters.en: all the cities of the plateau, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as the cities of Salecah and Edrei in the kingdom of Og.
chapters.zh: 就是夺了平原的各城、基列全地、巴珊全地，直到撒迦和以得来，都是巴珊王噩国内的城邑。

chapters.en: (For only Og king of Bashan had remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. His bed of iron, nine cubits long and four cubits wide, is still in Rabbah of the Ammonites.)
chapters.zh: （利乏音人所剩下的只有巴珊王噩。他的床是铁的，长九肘，宽四肘，都是以人肘为度。现今岂不是在亚扪人的拉巴吗？）」

chapters.en: So at that time we took possession of this land. To the Reubenites and Gadites I gave the land beyond Aroer along the Arnon Valley, and half the hill country of Gilead, along with its cities.
chapters.zh: 「那时，我们得了这地。从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥起，我将基列山地的一半，并其中的城邑，都给了吕便人和迦得人。

chapters.en: To the half-tribe of Manasseh I gave the rest of Gilead and all of Bashan, the kingdom of Og. (The entire region of Argob, the whole territory of Bashan, used to be called the land of the Rephaim.)
chapters.zh: 其余的基列地和巴珊全地，就是噩王的国，我给了玛拿西半支派。亚珥歌伯全地乃是巴珊全地；这叫做利乏音人之地。

chapters.en: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, took the whole region of Argob as far as the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites. He renamed Bashan after himself, Havvoth-jair, by which it is called to this day.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西的子孙睚珥佔了亚珥歌伯全境，直到基述人和玛迦人的交界，就按自己的名称这巴珊地为哈倭特‧睚珥，直到今日。

chapters.en: To Machir I gave Gilead,
chapters.zh: 我又将基列给了玛吉。

chapters.en: and to the Reubenites and Gadites I gave the territory from Gilead to the Arnon Valley (the middle of the valley was the border) and up to the Jabbok River, the border of the Ammonites.
chapters.zh: 从基列到亚嫩谷，以谷中为界，直到亚扪人交界的雅博河，我给了吕便人和迦得人，

chapters.en: The Jordan River in the Arabah bordered it from Chinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea ) with the slopes of Pisgah to the east.
chapters.zh: 又将亚拉巴和靠近约旦河之地，从基尼烈直到亚拉巴海，就是盐海，并毗斯迦山根东边之地，〔都给了他们〕。

chapters.en: At that time I commanded you: “The LORD your God has given you this land to possess. All your men of valor are to cross over, armed for battle, ahead of your brothers, the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 「那时，我吩咐你们说：『耶和华－你们的上帝已将这地赐给你们为业；你们所有的勇士都要带着兵器，在你们的弟兄以色列人前面过去。

chapters.en: But your wives, your children, and your livestock—I know that you have much livestock—may remain in the cities I have given you,
chapters.zh: 但你们的妻子、孩子、牲畜（我知道你们有许多的牲畜）可以住在我所赐给你们的各城里。

chapters.en: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers as He has to you, and they too have taken possession of the land that the LORD your God is giving them across the Jordan. Then each of you may return to the possession I have given you.”
chapters.zh: 等到你们弟兄在约旦河那边，也得耶和华－你们上帝所赐给他们的地，又使他们得享平安，与你们一样，你们才可以回到我所赐给你们为业之地。』

chapters.en: And at that time I commanded Joshua: “Your own eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. The LORD will do the same to all the kingdoms you are about to enter.
chapters.zh: 那时我吩咐约书亚说：『你亲眼看见了耶和华－你上帝向这二王所行的；耶和华也必向你所要去的各国照样行。

chapters.en: Do not be afraid of them, for the LORD your God Himself will fight for you.”
chapters.zh: 你不要怕他们，因那为你争战的是耶和华－你的上帝。』」

chapters.en: At that time I also pleaded with the LORD:
chapters.zh: 「那时，我恳求耶和华说：

chapters.en: “O Lord GOD, You have begun to show Your greatness and power to Your servant. For what god in heaven or on earth can perform such works and mighty acts as Yours?
chapters.zh: 『主耶和华啊，你已将你的大力大能显给仆人看。在天上，在地下，有什么神能像你行事、像你有大能的作为呢？

chapters.en: Please let me cross over and see the good land beyond the Jordan—that pleasant hill country as well as Lebanon!”
chapters.zh: 求你容我过去，看约旦河那边的美地，就是那佳美的山地和黎巴嫩。』

chapters.en: But the LORD was angry with me on account of you, and He would not listen to me. “That is enough,” the LORD said to me. “Do not speak to Me again about this matter.
chapters.zh: 但耶和华因你们的缘故向我发怒，不应允我，对我说：『罢了！你不要向我再提这事。

chapters.en: Go to the top of Pisgah and look to the west and north and south and east. See the land with your own eyes, for you will not cross this Jordan.
chapters.zh: 你且上毗斯迦山顶去，向东、西、南、北举目观望，因为你必不能过这约旦河。

chapters.en: But commission Joshua, encourage him, and strengthen him, for he will cross over ahead of the people and enable them to inherit the land that you will see.”
chapters.zh: 你却要嘱咐约书亚，勉励他，使他胆壮；因为他必在这百姓前面过去，使他们承受你所要观看之地。』

chapters.en: So we stayed in the valley opposite Beth-peor.
chapters.zh: 于是我们住在伯‧毗珥对面的谷中。」

chapters.en: Hear now, O Israel, the statutes and ordinances I am teaching you to follow, so that you may live and may enter and take possession of the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, is giving you.
chapters.zh: 「以色列人哪，现在我所教训你们的律例典章，你们要听从遵行，好叫你们存活，得以进入耶和华－你们列祖之上帝所赐给你们的地，承受为业。

chapters.en: You must not add to or subtract from what I command you, so that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God that I am giving you.
chapters.zh: 所吩咐你们的话，你们不可加添，也不可删减，好叫你们遵守我所吩咐的，就是耶和华－你们上帝的命令。

chapters.en: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did at Baal-peor, for the LORD your God destroyed from among you all who followed Baal of Peor.
chapters.zh: 耶和华因巴力‧毗珥的事所行的，你们亲眼看见了。凡随从巴力‧毗珥的人，耶和华－你们的上帝都从你们中间除灭了。

chapters.en: But you who held fast to the LORD your God are alive to this day, every one of you.
chapters.zh: 惟有你们专靠耶和华－你们上帝的人，今日全都存活。

chapters.en: See, I have taught you statutes and ordinances just as the LORD my God has commanded me, so that you may follow them in the land that you are about to enter and possess.
chapters.zh: 我照着耶和华－我上帝所吩咐的将律例典章教训你们，使你们在所要进去得为业的地上遵行。

chapters.en: Observe them carefully, for this will show your wisdom and understanding in the sight of the peoples, who will hear of all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”
chapters.zh: 所以你们要谨守遵行；这就是你们在万民眼前的智慧、聪明。他们听见这一切律例，必说：『这大国的人真是有智慧，有聪明！』

chapters.en: For what nation is great enough to have a god as near to them as the LORD our God is to us whenever we call on Him?
chapters.zh: 哪一大国的人有神与他们相近，像耶和华－我们的上帝、在我们求告他的时候与我们相近呢？

chapters.en: And what nation is great enough to have righteous statutes and ordinances like this entire law I set before you today?
chapters.zh: 又哪一大国有这样公义的律例典章、像我今日在你们面前所陈明的这一切律法呢？

chapters.en: Only be on your guard and diligently watch yourselves, so that you do not forget the things your eyes have seen, and so that they do not slip from your heart as long as you live. Teach them to your children and grandchildren.
chapters.zh: 「你只要谨慎，殷勤保守你的心灵，免得忘记你亲眼所看见的事，又免得你一生、这事离开你的心；总要传给你的子子孙孙。

chapters.en: The day you stood before the LORD your God at Horeb, the LORD said to me, “Gather the people before Me to hear My words, so that they may learn to fear Me all the days they live on the earth, and that they may teach them to their children.”
chapters.zh: 你在何烈山站在耶和华－你上帝面前的那日，耶和华对我说：『你为我招聚百姓，我要叫他们听见我的话，使他们存活在世的日子，可以学习敬畏我，又可以教训儿女这样行。』

chapters.en: You came near and stood at the base of the mountain, a mountain blazing with fire to the heavens, with black clouds and deep darkness.
chapters.zh: 那时你们近前来，站在山下；山上有火焰冲天，并有昏黑、密云、幽暗。

chapters.en: And the LORD spoke to you out of the fire. You heard the sound of the words but saw no form; there was only a voice.
chapters.zh: 耶和华从火焰中对你们说话，你们只听见声音，却没有看见形像。

chapters.en: He declared to you His covenant, which He commanded you to follow—the Ten Commandments that He wrote on two tablets of stone.
chapters.zh: 他将所吩咐你们当守的约指示你们，就是十条诫，并将这诫写在两块石版上。

chapters.en: At that time the LORD commanded me to teach you the statutes and ordinances you are to follow in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.
chapters.zh: 那时耶和华又吩咐我将律例典章教训你们，使你们在所要过去得为业的地上遵行。」

chapters.en: So since you saw no form of any kind on the day the LORD spoke to you out of the fire at Horeb, be careful
chapters.zh: 「所以，你们要分外谨慎；因为耶和华在何烈山、从火中对你们说话的那日，你们没有看见什么形像。

chapters.en: that you do not act corruptly and make an idol for yourselves of any form or shape, whether in the likeness of a male or female,
chapters.zh: 惟恐你们败坏自己，雕刻偶像，仿佛什么男像女像，

chapters.en: of any beast that is on the earth or bird that flies in the air,
chapters.zh: 或地上走兽的像，或空中飞鸟的像，

chapters.en: or of any creature that crawls on the ground or fish that is in the waters below.
chapters.zh: 或地上爬物的像，或地底下水中鱼的像。

chapters.en: When you look to the heavens and see the sun and moon and stars—all the host of heaven—do not be enticed to bow down and worship what the LORD your God has apportioned to all the nations under heaven.
chapters.zh: 又恐怕你向天举目观看，见耶和华－你的上帝为天下万民所摆列的日月星，就是天上的万象，自己便被勾引敬拜事奉它。

chapters.en: Yet the LORD has taken you and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be the people of His inheritance, as you are today.
chapters.zh: 耶和华将你们从埃及领出来，脱离铁炉，要特作自己产业的子民，像今日一样。

chapters.en: The LORD, however, was angry with me on account of you, and He swore that I would not cross the Jordan to enter the good land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.
chapters.zh: 耶和华又因你们的缘故向我发怒，起誓必不容我过约旦河，也不容我进入耶和华－你上帝所赐你为业的那美地。

chapters.en: For I will not be crossing the Jordan, because I must die in this land. But you shall cross over and take possession of that good land.
chapters.zh: 我只得死在这地，不能过约旦河；但你们必过去得那美地。

chapters.en: Be careful that you do not forget the covenant of the LORD your God that He made with you; do not make an idol for yourselves in the form of anything He has forbidden you.
chapters.zh: 你们要谨慎，免得忘记耶和华－你们上帝与你们所立的约，为自己雕刻偶像，就是耶和华－你上帝所禁止你做的偶像；

chapters.en: For the LORD your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华－你的上帝乃是烈火，是忌邪的上帝。

chapters.en: After you have children and grandchildren and you have been in the land a long time, if you then act corruptly and make an idol of any form—doing evil in the sight of the LORD your God and provoking Him to anger—
chapters.zh: 「你们在那地住久了，生子生孙，就雕刻偶像，仿佛什么形像，败坏自己，行耶和华－你上帝眼中看为恶的事，惹他发怒。

chapters.en: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you this day that you will quickly perish from the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess. You will not live long upon it, but will be utterly destroyed.
chapters.zh: 我今日呼天唤地向你们作见证，你们必在过约旦河得为业的地上速速灭尽！你们不能在那地上长久，必尽行除灭。

chapters.en: Then the LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and only a few of you will survive among the nations to which the LORD will drive you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必使你们分散在万民中；在他所领你们到的万国里，你们剩下的人数稀少。

chapters.en: And there you will serve man-made gods of wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or eat or smell.
chapters.zh: 在那里，你们必事奉人手所造的神，就是用木石造成、不能看、不能听、不能吃、不能闻的神。

chapters.en: But if from there you will seek the LORD your God, you will find Him if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul.
chapters.zh: 但你们在那里必寻求耶和华－你的上帝。你尽心尽性寻求他的时候，就必寻见。

chapters.en: When you are in distress and all these things have happened to you, then in later days you will return to the LORD your God and listen to His voice.
chapters.zh: 日后你遭遇一切患难的时候，你必归回耶和华－你的上帝，听从他的话。

chapters.en: For the LORD your God is a merciful God; He will not abandon you or destroy you or forget the covenant with your fathers, which He swore to them by oath.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你上帝原是有怜悯的上帝；他总不撇下你，不灭绝你，也不忘记他起誓与你列祖所立的约。

chapters.en: Indeed, ask now from one end of the heavens to the other about the days that long preceded you, from the day that God created man on earth: Has anything as great as this ever happened or been reported?
Has a people ever heard the voice of God speaking out of the fire, as you have, and lived?
chapters.zh: 「你且考察在你以前的世代，自上帝造人在世以来，从天这边到天那边，曾有何民听见上帝在火中说话的声音，像你听见还能存活呢？这样的大事何曾有、何曾听见呢？

chapters.en: Or has any god tried to take as his own a nation out of another nation—by trials, signs, wonders, and war, by a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and by great terrors—as the LORD your God did for you in Egypt, before your eyes?
chapters.zh: 上帝何曾从别的国中将一国的人民领出来，用试验、神迹、奇事、争战、大能的手，和伸出来的膀臂，并大可畏的事，像耶和华－你们的上帝在埃及，在你们眼前为你们所行的一切事呢？

chapters.en: You were shown these things so that you would know that the LORD is God; there is no other besides Him.
chapters.zh: 这是显给你看，要使你知道，惟有耶和华－他是上帝，除他以外，再无别神。

chapters.en: He let you hear His voice from heaven to discipline you, and on earth He showed you His great fire, and you heard His words out of the fire.
chapters.zh: 他从天上使你听见他的声音，为要教训你，又在地上使你看见他的烈火，并且听见他从火中所说的话。

chapters.en: Because He loved your fathers, He chose their descendants after them and brought you out of Egypt by His presence and great power,
chapters.zh: 因他爱你的列祖，所以拣选他们的后裔，用大能亲自领你出了埃及，

chapters.en: to drive out before you nations greater and mightier than you, and to bring you into their land and give it to you for your inheritance, as it is this day.
chapters.zh: 要将比你强大的国民从你面前赶出，领你进去，将他们的地赐你为业，像今日一样。

chapters.en: Know therefore this day and take to heart that the LORD is God in heaven above and on the earth below; there is no other.
chapters.zh: 所以，今日你要知道，也要记在心上，天上地下惟有耶和华他是上帝，除他以外，再无别神。

chapters.en: Keep His statutes and commandments, which I am giving you today, so that you and your children after you may prosper, and that you may live long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you for all time.
chapters.zh: 我今日将他的律例诫命晓谕你，你要遵守，使你和你的子孙可以得福，并使你的日子在耶和华－你上帝所赐的地上得以长久。」

chapters.en: Then Moses set aside three cities across the Jordan to the east
chapters.zh: 「那时，摩西在约旦河东，向日出之地，分定三座城，

chapters.en:
to which a manslayer could flee after killing his neighbor unintentionally without prior malice.
To save one’s own life, he could flee to one of these cities:
chapters.zh: 使那素无仇恨、无心杀了人的，可以逃到这三城之中的一座城，就得存活：

chapters.en: Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau belonging to the Reubenites, Ramoth in Gilead belonging to the Gadites, or Golan in Bashan belonging to the Manassites.
chapters.zh: 为吕便人分定旷野平原的比悉；为迦得人分定基列的拉末；为玛拿西人分定巴珊的哥兰。」

chapters.en: This is the law that Moses set before the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 摩西在以色列人面前所陈明的律法－

chapters.en: These are the testimonies, statutes, and ordinances that Moses proclaimed to them after they had come out of Egypt,
chapters.zh: 就是摩西在以色列人出埃及后所传给他们的法度、律例、典章；

chapters.en: while they were in the valley across the Jordan facing Beth-peor in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon and was defeated by Moses and the Israelites after they had come out of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 在约旦河东伯‧毗珥对面的谷中，在住希实本、亚摩利王西宏之地；这西宏是摩西和以色列人出埃及后所击杀的。

chapters.en: They took possession of the land belonging to Sihon and to Og king of Bashan—the two Amorite kings across the Jordan to the east—
chapters.zh: 他们得了他的地，又得了巴珊王噩的地，就是两个亚摩利王，在约旦河东向日出之地。

chapters.en: extending from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley as far as Mount Siyon (that is, Hermon),
chapters.zh: 从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥，直到西云山，就是黑门山。

chapters.en: including all the Arabah on the east side of the Jordan and as far as the Sea of the Arabah, below the slopes of Pisgah.
chapters.zh: 还有约旦河东的全亚拉巴，直到亚拉巴海，靠近毗斯迦山根。

chapters.en:
Then Moses summoned all Israel and said to them:
Hear, O Israel, the statutes and ordinances that I declare in your hearing this day. Learn them and observe them carefully.
chapters.zh: 摩西将以色列众人召了来，对他们说：「以色列人哪，我今日晓谕你们的律例典章，你们要听，可以学习，谨守遵行。

chapters.en: The LORD our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－我们的上帝在何烈山与我们立约。

chapters.en: He did not make this covenant with our fathers, but with all of us who are alive here today.
chapters.zh: 这约不是与我们列祖立的，乃是与我们今日在这里存活之人立的。

chapters.en: The LORD spoke with you face to face out of the fire on the mountain.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在山上，从火中，面对面与你们说话－

chapters.en: At that time I was standing between the LORD and you to declare to you the word of the LORD, because you were afraid of the fire and would not go up the mountain. And He said:
chapters.zh: 那时我站在耶和华和你们中间，要将耶和华的话传给你们；因为你们惧怕那火，没有上山－说：

chapters.en: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
chapters.zh: 「『我是耶和华－你的上帝，曾将你从埃及地为奴之家领出来。

chapters.en: You shall have no other gods before Me.
chapters.zh: 「『除了我以外，你不可有别的神。

chapters.en: You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above, on the earth below, or in the waters beneath.
chapters.zh: 「『不可为自己雕刻偶像，也不可做什么〔形像〕，仿佛上天、下地和地底下、水中的〔百物〕。

chapters.en: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on their children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,
chapters.zh: 不可跪拜那些像，也不可事奉它，因为我耶和华－你的上帝是忌邪的上帝。恨我的，我必追讨他的罪，自父及子，直到三、四代；

chapters.en: but showing loving devotion to a thousand generations of those who love Me and keep My commandments.
chapters.zh: 爱我、守我诫命的，我必向他们发慈爱，直到千代。

chapters.en: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not leave anyone unpunished who takes His name in vain.
chapters.zh: 「『不可妄称耶和华－你上帝的名；因为妄称耶和华名的，耶和华必不以他为无罪。

chapters.en: Observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy, as the LORD your God has commanded you.
chapters.zh: 「『当照耶和华－你上帝所吩咐的守安息日为圣日。

chapters.en: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,
chapters.zh: 六日要劳碌做你一切的工，

chapters.en: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, on which you must not do any work—neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant, nor your ox or donkey or any of your livestock, nor the foreigner within your gates, so that your manservant and maidservant may rest as you do.
chapters.zh: 但第七日是向耶和华－你上帝当守的安息日。〔这一日〕，你和你的儿女、仆婢、牛、驴、牲畜，并在你城里寄居的客旅，无论何工都不可做，使你的仆婢可以和你一样安息。

chapters.en: Remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD your God brought you out of there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. That is why the LORD your God has commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
chapters.zh: 你也要记念你在埃及地作过奴仆；耶和华－你上帝用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂将你从那里领出来。因此，耶和华－你的上帝吩咐你守安息日。

chapters.en: Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God has commanded you, so that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
chapters.zh: 「『当照耶和华－你上帝所吩咐的孝敬父母，使你得福，并使你的日子在耶和华－你上帝所赐你的地上得以长久。

chapters.en: You shall not murder.
chapters.zh: 「『不可杀人。

chapters.en: You shall not commit adultery.
chapters.zh: 「『不可奸淫。

chapters.en: You shall not steal.
chapters.zh: 「『不可偷盗。

chapters.en: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.
chapters.zh: 「『不可作假见证陷害人。

chapters.en: You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. You shall not covet your neighbor’s house or field, or his manservant or maidservant, or his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.”
chapters.zh: 「『不可贪恋人的妻子；也不可贪图人的房屋、田地、仆婢、牛、驴，并他一切所有的。』

chapters.en: The LORD spoke these commandments in a loud voice to your whole assembly out of the fire, the cloud, and the deep darkness on the mountain; He added nothing more. And He wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me.
chapters.zh: 「这些话是耶和华在山上，从火中、云中、幽暗中，大声晓谕你们全会众的；此外并没有添别的话。他就把这话写在两块石版上，交给我了。」

chapters.en: And when you heard the voice out of the darkness while the mountain was blazing with fire, all the heads of your tribes and your elders approached me,
chapters.zh: 「那时，火焰烧山，你们听见从黑暗中出来的声音；你们支派中所有的首领和长老都来就近我，

chapters.en: and you said, “Behold, the LORD our God has shown us His glory and greatness, and we have heard His voice out of the fire. Today we have seen that a man can live even if God speaks with him.
chapters.zh: 说：『看哪，耶和华－我们上帝将他的荣光和他的大能显给我们看，我们又听见他的声音从火中出来。今日我们得见上帝与人说话，人还存活。

chapters.en: But now, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us, and we will die, if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any longer.
chapters.zh: 现在这大火将要烧灭我们，我们何必冒死呢？若再听见耶和华－我们上帝的声音就必死亡。

chapters.en: For who of all flesh has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the fire, as we have, and survived?
chapters.zh: 凡属血气的，曾有何人听见永生上帝的声音从火中出来，像我们听见还能存活呢？

chapters.en: Go near and listen to all that the LORD our God says. Then you can tell us everything the LORD our God tells you; we will listen and obey.”
chapters.zh: 求你近前去，听耶和华－我们上帝所要说的一切话，将他对你说的话都传给我们，我们就听从遵行。』

chapters.en: And the LORD heard the words you spoke to me, and He said to me, “I have heard the words that these people have spoken to you. They have done well in all that they have spoken.
chapters.zh: 「你们对我说的话，耶和华都听见了。耶和华对我说：『这百姓的话，我听见了；他们所说的都是。

chapters.en: If only they had such a heart to fear Me and keep all My commandments always, so that it might be well with them and with their children forever.
chapters.zh: 惟愿他们存这样的心敬畏我，常遵守我的一切诫命，使他们和他们的子孙永远得福。

chapters.en: Go and tell them: ‘Return to your tents.’
chapters.zh: 你去对他们说：你们回帐棚去吧！

chapters.en: But you stand here with Me, that I may speak to you all the commandments and statutes and ordinances you are to teach them to follow in the land that I am giving them to possess.”
chapters.zh: 至于你，可以站在我这里，我要将一切诫命、律例、典章传给你；你要教训他们，使他们在我赐他们为业的地上遵行。』

chapters.en: So be careful to do as the LORD your God has commanded you; you are not to turn aside to the right or to the left.
chapters.zh: 所以，你们要照耶和华－你们上帝所吩咐的谨守遵行，不可偏离左右。

chapters.en: You must walk in all the ways that the LORD your God has commanded you, so that you may live and prosper and prolong your days in the land that you will possess.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你们上帝所吩咐你们行的，你们都要去行，使你们可以存活得福，并使你们的日子在所要承受的地上得以长久。」

chapters.en: These are the commandments and statutes and ordinances that the LORD your God has instructed me to teach you to follow in the land that you are about to enter and possess,
chapters.zh: 「这是耶和华－你们上帝所吩咐教训你们的诫命、律例、典章，使你们在所要过去得为业的地上遵行，

chapters.en: so that you and your children and grandchildren may fear the LORD your God all the days of your lives by keeping all His statutes and commandments that I give you, and so that your days may be prolonged.
chapters.zh: 好叫你和你子子孙孙一生敬畏耶和华－你的上帝，谨守他的一切律例诫命，就是我所吩咐你的，使你的日子得以长久。

chapters.en: Hear, O Israel, and be careful to observe them, so that you may prosper and multiply greatly in a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.
chapters.zh: 以色列啊，你要听，要谨守遵行，使你可以在那流奶与蜜之地得以享福，人数极其增多，正如耶和华－你列祖的上帝所应许你的。

chapters.en: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is One.
chapters.zh: 「以色列啊，你要听！耶和华－我们上帝是独一的主。

chapters.en: And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
chapters.zh: 你要尽心、尽性、尽力爱耶和华－你的上帝。

chapters.en: These words I am commanding you today are to be upon your hearts.
chapters.zh: 我今日所吩咐你的话都要记在心上，

chapters.en: And you shall teach them diligently to your children and speak of them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.
chapters.zh: 也要殷勤教训你的儿女。无论你坐在家里，行在路上，躺下，起来，都要谈论。

chapters.en: Tie them as reminders on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.
chapters.zh: 也要系在手上为记号，戴在额上为经文；

chapters.en: Write them on the doorposts of your houses and on your gates.
chapters.zh: 又要写在你房屋的门框上，并你的城门上。」

chapters.en: And when the LORD your God brings you into the land He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, that He would give you—a land with great and splendid cities that you did not build,
chapters.zh: 「耶和华－你的上帝领你进他向你列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许给你的地。那里有城邑，又大又美，非你所建造的；

chapters.en: with houses full of every good thing with which you did not fill them, with wells that you did not dig, and with vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant—and when you eat and are satisfied,
chapters.zh: 有房屋，装满各样美物，非你所装满的；有凿成的水井，非你所凿成的；还有葡萄园、橄榄园，非你所栽种的；你吃了而且饱足。

chapters.en: be careful not to forget the LORD who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
chapters.zh: 那时你要谨慎，免得你忘记将你从埃及地、为奴之家领出来的耶和华。

chapters.en: Fear the LORD your God, serve Him only, and take your oaths in His name.
chapters.zh: 你要敬畏耶和华－你的上帝，事奉他，指着他的名起誓。

chapters.en: Do not follow other gods, the gods of the peoples around you.
chapters.zh: 不可随从别神，就是你们四围国民的神；

chapters.en: For the LORD your God, who is among you, is a jealous God. Otherwise the anger of the LORD your God will be kindled against you, and He will wipe you off the face of the earth.
chapters.zh: 因为在你们中间的耶和华－你上帝是忌邪的上帝，惟恐耶和华－你上帝的怒气向你发作，就把你从地上除灭。

chapters.en: Do not test the LORD your God as you tested Him at Massah.
chapters.zh: 「你们不可试探耶和华－你们的上帝，像你们在玛撒那样试探他。

chapters.en: You are to diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God and the testimonies and statutes He has given you.
chapters.zh: 要留意遵守耶和华－你们上帝所吩咐的诫命、法度、律例。

chapters.en: Do what is right and good in the sight of the LORD, so that it may be well with you and that you may enter and possess the good land that the LORD your God swore to give your fathers,
chapters.zh: 耶和华眼中看为正、看为善的，你都要遵行，使你可以享福，并可以进去得耶和华向你列祖起誓应许的那美地，

chapters.en: driving out all your enemies before you, as the LORD has said.
chapters.zh: 照耶和华所说的，从你面前撵出你的一切仇敌。

chapters.en: In the future, when your son asks, “What is the meaning of the decrees and statutes and ordinances that the LORD our God has commanded you?”
chapters.zh: 「日后，你的儿子问你说：『耶和华－我们上帝吩咐你们的这些法度、律例、典章是什么意思呢？』

chapters.en: then you are to tell him, “We were slaves of Pharaoh in Egypt, but the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
chapters.zh: 你就告诉你的儿子说：『我们在埃及作过法老的奴仆；耶和华用大能的手将我们从埃及领出来，

chapters.en: Before our eyes the LORD inflicted great and devastating signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his household.
chapters.zh: 在我们眼前，将重大可怕的神迹奇事施行在埃及地和法老并他全家的身上，

chapters.en: But He brought us out from there to lead us in and give us the land that He had sworn to our fathers.
chapters.zh: 将我们从那里领出来，要领我们进入他向我们列祖起誓应许之地，把这地赐给我们。

chapters.en: And the LORD commanded us to observe all these statutes and to fear the LORD our God, that we may always be prosperous and preserved, as we are to this day.
chapters.zh: 耶和华又吩咐我们遵行这一切律例，要敬畏耶和华－我们的上帝，使我们常得好处，蒙他保全我们的生命，像今日一样。

chapters.en: And if we are careful to observe every one of these commandments before the LORD our God, as He has commanded us, then that will be our righteousness.”
chapters.zh: 我们若照耶和华－我们上帝所吩咐的一切诫命谨守遵行，这就是我们的义了。』」

chapters.en: When the LORD your God brings you into the land that you are entering to possess, and He drives out before you many nations—the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, seven nations larger and stronger than you—
chapters.zh: 「耶和华－你上帝领你进入要得为业之地，从你面前赶出许多国民，就是赫人、革迦撒人、亚摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，共七国的民，都比你强大。

chapters.en: and when the LORD your God has delivered them over to you to defeat them, then you must devote them to complete destruction. Make no treaty with them and show them no mercy.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你上帝将他们交给你击杀，那时你要把他们灭绝净尽，不可与他们立约，也不可怜恤他们。

chapters.en: Do not intermarry with them. Do not give your daughters to their sons or take their daughters for your sons,
chapters.zh: 不可与他们结亲。不可将你的女儿嫁他们的儿子，也不可叫你的儿子娶他们的女儿；

chapters.en: because they will turn your sons away from following Me to serve other gods. Then the anger of the LORD will burn against you, and He will swiftly destroy you.
chapters.zh: 因为他必使你儿子转离不跟从主，去事奉别神，以致耶和华的怒气向你们发作，就速速地将你们灭绝。

chapters.en: Instead, this is what you are to do to them: tear down their altars, smash their sacred pillars, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their idols in the fire.
chapters.zh: 你们却要这样待他们：拆毁他们的祭坛，打碎他们的柱像，砍下他们的木偶，用火焚烧他们雕刻的偶像。

chapters.en: For you are a people holy to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you to be a people for His prized possession out of all peoples on the face of the earth.
chapters.zh: 因为你归耶和华－你上帝为圣洁的民；耶和华－你上帝从地上的万民中拣选你，特作自己的子民。

chapters.en: The LORD did not set His affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than the other peoples, for you were the fewest of all peoples.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华专爱你们，拣选你们，并非因你们的人数多于别民，原来你们的人数在万民中是最少的。

chapters.en: But because the LORD loved you and kept the oath He swore to your fathers, He brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the house of slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 只因耶和华爱你们，又因要守他向你们列祖所起的誓，就用大能的手领你们出来，从为奴之家救赎你们脱离埃及王法老的手。

chapters.en: Know therefore that the LORD your God is God, the faithful God who keeps His covenant of loving devotion for a thousand generations of those who love Him and keep His commandments.
chapters.zh: 所以，你要知道耶和华－你的上帝，他是上帝，是信实的上帝；向爱他、守他诫命的人守约，施慈爱，直到千代；

chapters.en: But those who hate Him He repays to their faces with destruction; He will not hesitate to repay to his face the one who hates Him.
chapters.zh: 向恨他的人当面报应他们，将他们灭绝。凡恨他的人必报应他们，决不迟延。

chapters.en: So keep the commandments and statutes and ordinances that I am giving you to follow this day.
chapters.zh: 所以，你要谨守遵行我今日所吩咐你的诫命、律例、典章。」

chapters.en: If you listen to these ordinances and keep them carefully, then the LORD your God will keep His covenant and the loving devotion that He swore to your fathers.
chapters.zh: 「你们果然听从这些典章，谨守遵行，耶和华－你上帝就必照他向你列祖所起的誓守约，施慈爱。

chapters.en: He will love you and bless you and multiply you. He will bless the fruit of your womb and the produce of your land—your grain, new wine, and oil, the young of your herds and the lambs of your flocks—in the land that He swore to your fathers to give you.
chapters.zh: 他必爱你，赐福与你，使你人数增多，也必在他向你列祖起誓应许给你的地上赐福与你身所生的，地所产的，并你的五谷、新酒，和油，以及牛犊、羊羔。

chapters.en: You will be blessed above all peoples; among you there will be no barren man or woman or livestock.
chapters.zh: 你必蒙福胜过万民；你们的男女没有不能生养的，牲畜也没有不能生育的。

chapters.en: And the LORD will remove from you all sickness. He will not lay upon you any of the terrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but He will inflict them on all who hate you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必使一切的病症离开你；你所知道埃及各样的恶疾，他不加在你身上，只加在一切恨你的人身上。

chapters.en: You must destroy all the peoples the LORD your God will deliver to you. Do not look on them with pity. Do not worship their gods, for that will be a snare to you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你上帝所要交给你的一切人民，你要将他们除灭；你眼不可顾惜他们。你也不可事奉他们的神，因这必成为你的网罗。

chapters.en: You may say in your heart, “These nations are greater than we are; how can we drive them out?”
chapters.zh: 「你若心里说，这些国的民比我更多，我怎能赶出他们呢？

chapters.en: But do not be afraid of them. Be sure to remember what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and all Egypt:
chapters.zh: 你不要惧怕他们，要牢牢记念耶和华－你上帝向法老和埃及全地所行的事，

chapters.en: the great trials that you saw, the signs and wonders, and the mighty hand and outstretched arm by which the LORD your God brought you out. The LORD your God will do the same to all the peoples you now fear.
chapters.zh: 就是你亲眼所看见的大试验、神迹、奇事，和大能的手，并伸出来的膀臂，都是耶和华－你上帝领你出来所用的。耶和华－你上帝必照样待你所惧怕的一切人民。

chapters.en: Moreover, the LORD your God will send the hornet against them until even the survivors hiding from you have perished.
chapters.zh: 并且耶和华－你上帝必打发黄蜂飞到他们中间，直到那剩下而藏躲的人从你面前灭亡。

chapters.en: Do not be terrified by them, for the LORD your God, who is among you, is a great and awesome God.
chapters.zh: 你不要因他们惊恐，因为耶和华－你上帝在你们中间是大而可畏的上帝。

chapters.en: The LORD your God will drive out these nations before you little by little. You will not be enabled to eliminate them all at once, or the wild animals would multiply around you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你上帝必将这些国的民从你面前渐渐赶出；你不可把他们速速灭尽，恐怕野地的兽多起来害你。

chapters.en: But the LORD your God will give them over to you and throw them into great confusion, until they are destroyed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你上帝必将他们交给你，大大地扰乱他们，直到他们灭绝了；

chapters.en: He will hand their kings over to you, and you will wipe out their names from under heaven. No one will be able to stand against you; you will annihilate them.
chapters.zh: 又要将他们的君王交在你手中，你就使他们的名从天下消灭。必无一人能在你面前站立得住，直到你将他们灭绝了。

chapters.en: You must burn up the images of their gods; do not covet the silver and gold that is on them or take it for yourselves, or you will be ensnared by it; for it is detestable to the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 他们雕刻的神像，你们要用火焚烧；其上的金银，你不可贪图，也不可收取，免得你因此陷入网罗；这原是耶和华－你上帝所憎恶的。

chapters.en: And you must not bring any detestable thing into your house, or you, like it, will be set apart for destruction. You are to utterly detest and abhor it, because it is set apart for destruction.
chapters.zh: 可憎的物，你不可带进家去；不然，你就成了当毁灭的，与那物一样。你要十分厌恶，十分憎嫌，因为这是当毁灭的物。」

chapters.en: You must carefully follow every commandment I am giving you today, so that you may live and multiply, and enter and possess the land that the LORD swore to give your fathers.
chapters.zh: 「我今日所吩咐的一切诫命，你们要谨守遵行，好叫你们存活，人数增多，且进去得耶和华向你们列祖起誓应许的那地。

chapters.en: Remember that these forty years the LORD your God led you all the way in the wilderness, so that He might humble you and test you in order to know what was in your heart, whether or not you would keep His commandments.
chapters.zh: 你也要记念耶和华－你的上帝在旷野引导你这四十年，是要苦炼你，试验你，要知道你心内如何，肯守他的诫命不肯。

chapters.en: He humbled you, and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat, which neither you nor your fathers had known, so that you might understand that man does not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他苦炼你，任你饥饿，将你和你列祖所不认识的吗哪赐给你吃，使你知道，人活着不是单靠食物，乃是靠耶和华口里所出的一切话。

chapters.en: Your clothing did not wear out and your feet did not swell during these forty years.
chapters.zh: 这四十年，你的衣服没有穿破，你的脚也没有肿。

chapters.en: So know in your heart that just as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.
chapters.zh: 你当心里思想，耶和华－你上帝管教你，好像人管教儿子一样。

chapters.en: Therefore you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, walking in His ways and fearing Him.
chapters.zh: 你要谨守耶和华－你上帝的诫命，遵行他的道，敬畏他。

chapters.en: For the LORD your God is bringing you into a good land, a land of brooks and fountains and springs that flow through the valleys and hills;
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华－你上帝领你进入美地，那地有河，有泉，有源，从山谷中流出水来。

chapters.en: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive oil and honey;
chapters.zh: 那地有小麦、大麦、葡萄树、无花果树、石榴树、橄榄树，和蜜。

chapters.en: a land where you will eat food without scarcity, where you will lack nothing; a land whose rocks are iron and whose hills are ready to be mined for copper.
chapters.zh: 你在那地不缺食物，一无所缺。那地的石头是铁，山内可以挖铜。

chapters.en: When you eat and are satisfied, you are to bless the LORD your God for the good land that He has given you.
chapters.zh: 你吃得饱足，就要称颂耶和华－你的上帝，因他将那美地赐给你了。」

chapters.en: Be careful not to forget the LORD your God by failing to keep His commandments and ordinances and statutes, which I am giving you this day.
chapters.zh: 「你要谨慎，免得忘记耶和华－你的上帝，不守他的诫命、典章、律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的；

chapters.en: Otherwise, when you eat and are satisfied, when you build fine houses in which to dwell,
chapters.zh: 恐怕你吃得饱足，建造美好的房屋居住，

chapters.en: and when your herds and flocks grow large and your silver and gold increase and all that you have is multiplied,
chapters.zh: 你的牛羊加多，你的金银增添，并你所有的全都加增，

chapters.en: then your heart will become proud, and you will forget the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
chapters.zh: 你就心高气傲，忘记耶和华－你的上帝，就是将你从埃及地为奴之家领出来的，

chapters.en: He led you through the vast and terrifying wilderness with its venomous snakes and scorpions, a thirsty and waterless land. He brought you water from the rock of flint.
chapters.zh: 引你经过那大而可怕的旷野，〔那里〕有火蛇、蠍子、干旱无水之地。他曾为你使水从坚硬的磐石中流出来，

chapters.en: He fed you in the wilderness with manna that your fathers had not known, in order to humble you and test you, so that in the end He might cause you to prosper.
chapters.zh: 又在旷野将你列祖所不认识的吗哪赐给你吃，是要苦炼你，试验你，叫你终久享福；

chapters.en: You might say in your heart, “The power and strength of my hands have made this wealth for me.”
chapters.zh: 〔恐怕〕你心里说：『这货财是我力量、我能力得来的。』

chapters.en: But remember that it is the LORD your God who gives you the power to gain wealth, in order to confirm His covenant that He swore to your fathers even to this day.
chapters.zh: 你要记念耶和华－你的上帝，因为得货财的力量是他给你的，为要坚定他向你列祖起誓所立的约，像今日一样。

chapters.en: If you ever forget the LORD your God and go after other gods to worship and bow down to them, I testify against you today that you will surely perish.
chapters.zh: 你若忘记耶和华－你的上帝，随从别神，事奉敬拜，你们必定灭亡；这是我今日警戒你们的。

chapters.en: Like the nations that the LORD has destroyed before you, so you will perish if you do not obey the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在你们面前怎样使列国的民灭亡，你们也必照样灭亡，因为你们不听从耶和华－你们上帝的话。」

chapters.en: Hear, O Israel: Today you are about to cross the Jordan to go in and dispossess nations greater and stronger than you, with large cities fortified to the heavens.
chapters.zh: 「以色列啊，你当听！你今日要过约旦河，进去赶出比你强大的国民，得着广大坚固、高得顶天的城邑。

chapters.en: The people are strong and tall, the descendants of the Anakim. You know about them, and you have heard it said, “Who can stand up to the sons of Anak?”
chapters.zh: 那民是亚衲族的人，又大又高，是你所知道的；也曾听见有人指着他们说：『谁能在亚衲族人面前站立得住呢？』

chapters.en: But understand that today the LORD your God goes across ahead of you as a consuming fire; He will destroy them and subdue them before you. And you will drive them out and annihilate them swiftly, as the LORD has promised you.
chapters.zh: 你今日当知道，耶和华－你的上帝在你前面过去，如同烈火，要灭绝他们，将他们制伏在你面前。这样，你就要照耶和华所说的赶出他们，使他们速速灭亡。

chapters.en: When the LORD your God has driven them out before you, do not say in your heart, “Because of my righteousness the LORD has brought me in to possess this land.” Rather, the LORD is driving out these nations before you because of their wickedness.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华－你的上帝将这些国民从你面前撵出以后，你心里不可说：『耶和华将我领进来得这地是因我的义。』其实，耶和华将他们从你面前赶出去是因他们的恶。

chapters.en: It is not because of your righteousness or uprightness of heart that you are going in to possess their land, but it is because of their wickedness that the LORD your God is driving out these nations before you, to keep the promise He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
chapters.zh: 你进去得他们的地，并不是因你的义，也不是因你心里正直，乃是因这些国民的恶，耶和华－你的上帝将他们从你面前赶出去，又因耶和华要坚定他向你列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓所应许的话。

chapters.en: Understand, then, that it is not because of your righteousness that the LORD your God is giving you this good land to possess, for you are a stiff-necked people.
chapters.zh: 「你当知道，耶和华－你上帝将这美地赐你为业，并不是因你的义；你本是硬着颈项的百姓。

chapters.en: Remember this, and never forget how you provoked the LORD your God in the wilderness. From the day you left the land of Egypt until you reached this place, you have been rebelling against the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你当记念不忘，你在旷野怎样惹耶和华－你上帝发怒。自从你出了埃及地的那日，直到你们来到这地方，你们时常悖逆耶和华。

chapters.en: At Horeb you provoked the LORD, and He was angry enough to destroy you.
chapters.zh: 你们在何烈山又惹耶和华发怒；他恼怒你们，要灭绝你们。

chapters.en: When I went up on the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant that the LORD made with you, I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I ate no bread and drank no water.
chapters.zh: 我上了山，要领受两块石版，就是耶和华与你们立约的版。那时我在山上住了四十昼夜，没有吃饭，也没有喝水。

chapters.en: Then the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, inscribed by the finger of God with the exact words that the LORD spoke to you out of the fire on the mountain on the day of the assembly.
chapters.zh: 耶和华把那两块石版交给我，是上帝用指头写的。版上〔所写的〕是照耶和华在大会的日子、在山上、从火中对你们所说的一切话。

chapters.en: And at the end of forty days and forty nights, the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant.
chapters.zh: 过了四十昼夜，耶和华把那两块石版，就是约版，交给我。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to me, “Get up and go down from here at once, for your people, whom you brought out of Egypt, have corrupted themselves. How quickly they have turned aside from the way that I commanded them! They have made for themselves a molten image.”
chapters.zh: 对我说：『你起来，赶快下去！因为你从埃及领出来的百姓已经败坏了自己；他们快快地偏离了我所吩咐的道，为自己铸成了偶像。』

chapters.en: The LORD also said to me, “I have seen this people, and they are indeed a stiff-necked people.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华又对我说：『我看这百姓是硬着颈项的百姓。

chapters.en: Leave Me alone, so that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under heaven. Then I will make you into a nation mightier and greater than they are.”
chapters.zh: 你且由着我，我要灭绝他们，将他们的名从天下涂抹，使你的后裔比他们成为更大更强的国。』

chapters.en: So I went back down the mountain while it was blazing with fire, with the two tablets of the covenant in my hands.
chapters.zh: 于是我转身下山，山被火烧着，两块约版在我两手之中。

chapters.en: And I saw how you had sinned against the LORD your God; you had made for yourselves a molten calf. You had turned aside quickly from the way that the LORD had commanded you.
chapters.zh: 我一看见你们得罪了耶和华－你们的上帝，铸成了牛犊，快快地偏离了耶和华所吩咐你们的道，

chapters.en: So I took the two tablets and threw them out of my hands, shattering them before your eyes.
chapters.zh: 我就把那两块版从我手中扔下去，在你们眼前摔碎了。

chapters.en: Then I fell down before the LORD for forty days and forty nights, as I had done the first time. I did not eat bread or drink water because of all the sin you had committed in doing what was evil in the sight of the LORD and provoking Him to anger.
chapters.zh: 因你们所犯的一切罪，行了耶和华眼中看为恶的事，惹他发怒，我就像从前俯伏在耶和华面前四十昼夜，没有吃饭，也没有喝水。

chapters.en: For I was afraid of the anger and wrath that the LORD had directed against you, enough to destroy you. But the LORD listened to me this time as well.
chapters.zh: 我因耶和华向你们大发烈怒，要灭绝你们，就甚害怕；但那次耶和华又应允了我。

chapters.en: The LORD was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him, but at that time I also prayed for Aaron.
chapters.zh: 耶和华也向亚伦甚是发怒，要灭绝他；那时我又为亚伦祈祷。

chapters.en: And I took that sinful thing, the calf you had made, and burned it in the fire. Then I crushed it and ground it to powder as fine as dust, and I cast it into the stream that came down from the mountain.
chapters.zh: 我把那叫你们犯罪所铸的牛犊用火焚烧，又捣碎磨得很细，以致细如灰尘，我就把这灰尘撒在从山上流下来的溪水中。

chapters.en: You continued to provoke the LORD at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah.
chapters.zh: 「你们在他备拉、玛撒、基博罗‧哈他瓦又惹耶和华发怒。

chapters.en:
And when the LORD sent you out from Kadesh-barnea, He said, “Go up and possess the land that I have given you.”
But you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God. You neither believed Him nor obeyed Him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华打发你们离开加低斯‧巴尼亚，说：『你们上去得我所赐给你们的地。』那时你们违背了耶和华－你们上帝的命令，不信服他，不听从他的话。

chapters.en: You have been rebelling against the LORD since the day I came to know you.
chapters.zh: 自从我认识你们以来，你们常常悖逆耶和华。

chapters.en: So I fell down before the LORD for forty days and forty nights, because the LORD had said He would destroy you.
chapters.zh: 「我因耶和华说要灭绝你们，就在耶和华面前照旧俯伏四十昼夜。

chapters.en: And I prayed to the LORD and said, “O Lord GOD, do not destroy Your people, Your inheritance, whom You redeemed through Your greatness and brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
chapters.zh: 我祈祷耶和华说：『主耶和华啊，求你不要灭绝你的百姓。他们是你的产业，是你用大力救赎的，用大能从埃及领出来的。

chapters.en: Remember Your servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Overlook the stubbornness of this people and the wickedness of their sin.
chapters.zh: 求你记念你的仆人亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各，不要想念这百姓的顽梗、邪恶、罪过，

chapters.en: Otherwise, those in the land from which You brought us out will say, ‘Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land He had promised them, and because He hated them, He has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.’
chapters.zh: 免得你领我们出来的那地之人说，耶和华因为不能将这百姓领进他所应许之地，又因恨他们，所以领他们出去，要在旷野杀他们。

chapters.en: But they are Your people, Your inheritance, whom You brought out by Your great power and outstretched arm.”
chapters.zh: 其实他们是你的百姓，你的产业，是你用大能和伸出来的膀臂领出来的。』」

chapters.en: At that time the LORD said to me, “Chisel out two stone tablets like the originals, come up to Me on the mountain, and make an ark of wood.
chapters.zh: 「那时，耶和华吩咐我说：『你要凿出两块石版，和先前的一样，上山到我这里来，又要做一木柜。

chapters.en: And I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke; and you are to place them in the ark.”
chapters.zh: 你先前摔碎的那版，其上的字我要写在这版上；你要将这版放在柜中。』

chapters.en: So I made an ark of acacia wood, chiseled out two stone tablets like the originals, and went up the mountain with the two tablets in my hands.
chapters.zh: 于是我用皂荚木做了一柜，又凿出两块石版，和先前的一样，手里拿这两块版上山去了。

chapters.en: And the LORD wrote on the tablets what had been written previously, the Ten Commandments that He had spoken to you on the mountain out of the fire on the day of the assembly. The LORD gave them to me,
chapters.zh: 耶和华将那大会之日、在山上从火中所传与你们的十条诫，照先前所写的，写在这版上，将版交给我了。

chapters.en: and I went back down the mountain and placed the tablets in the ark I had made, as the LORD had commanded me; and there they have remained.
chapters.zh: 我转身下山，将这版放在我所做的柜中，现今还在那里，正如耶和华所吩咐我的。」

chapters.en: The Israelites traveled from Beeroth Bene-jaakan to Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and Eleazar his son succeeded him as priest.
chapters.zh: （以色列人从比罗比尼‧亚干〔注：或译：亚干井〕起行，到了摩西拉。亚伦死在那里，就葬在那里。他儿子以利亚撒接续他供祭司的职分。

chapters.en: From there they traveled to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land with streams of water.
chapters.zh: 他们从那里起行，到了谷歌大，又从谷歌大到了有溪水之地的约巴他。

chapters.en: At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to serve Him, and to pronounce blessings in His name, as they do to this day.
chapters.zh: 那时，耶和华将利未支派分别出来，抬耶和华的约柜，又侍立在耶和华面前事奉他，奉他的名祝福，直到今日。

chapters.en: That is why Levi has no portion or inheritance among his brothers; the LORD is his inheritance, as the LORD your God promised him.
chapters.zh: 所以利未人在他弟兄中无分无业，耶和华是他的产业，正如耶和华－你上帝所应许他的。）

chapters.en: I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights, like the first time, and that time the LORD again listened to me and agreed not to destroy you.
chapters.zh: 「我又像从前在山上住了四十昼夜。那次耶和华也应允我，不忍将你灭绝。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to me, “Get up. Continue your journey ahead of the people, that they may enter and possess the land that I swore to their fathers to give them.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐我说：『你起来引导这百姓，使他们进去得我向他们列祖起誓应许所赐之地。』」

chapters.en: And now, O Israel, what does the LORD your God ask of you but to fear the LORD your God by walking in all His ways, to love Him, to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,
chapters.zh: 「以色列啊，现在耶和华－你上帝向你所要的是什么呢？只要你敬畏耶和华－你的上帝，遵行他的道，爱他，尽心尽性事奉他，

chapters.en: and to keep the commandments and statutes of the LORD that I am giving you this day for your own good?
chapters.zh: 遵守他的诫命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的，为要叫你得福。

chapters.en: Behold, to the LORD your God belong the heavens, even the highest heavens, and the earth and everything in it.
chapters.zh: 看哪，天和天上的天，地和地上所有的，都属耶和华－你的上帝。

chapters.en: Yet the LORD has set His affection on your fathers and loved them. And He has chosen you, their descendants after them, above all the peoples, even to this day.
chapters.zh: 耶和华但喜悦你的列祖，爱他们，从万民中拣选他们的后裔，就是你们，像今日一样。

chapters.en: Circumcise your hearts, therefore, and stiffen your necks no more.
chapters.zh: 所以你们要将心里的污秽除掉，不可再硬着颈项。

chapters.en: For the LORD your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great, mighty, and awesome God, showing no partiality and accepting no bribe.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华－你们的上帝－他是万神之神，万主之主，至大的上帝，大有能力，大而可畏，不以貌取人，也不受贿赂。

chapters.en: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow, and He loves the foreigner, giving him food and clothing.
chapters.zh: 他为孤儿寡妇伸冤，又怜爱寄居的，赐给他衣食。

chapters.en: So you also must love the foreigner, since you yourselves were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 所以你们要怜爱寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

chapters.en: You are to fear the LORD your God and serve Him. Hold fast to Him and take your oaths in His name.
chapters.zh: 你要敬畏耶和华－你的上帝，事奉他，专靠他，也要指着他的名起誓。

chapters.en: He is your praise and He is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome wonders that your eyes have seen.
chapters.zh: 他是你所赞美的，是你的上帝，为你做了那大而可畏的事，是你亲眼所看见的。

chapters.en: Your fathers went down to Egypt, seventy in all, and now the LORD your God has made you as numerous as the stars in the sky.
chapters.zh: 你的列祖七十人下埃及；现在耶和华－你的上帝使你如同天上的星那样多。」

chapters.en: You shall therefore love the LORD your God and always keep His charge, His statutes, His ordinances, and His commandments.
chapters.zh: 「你要爱耶和华－你的上帝，常守他的吩咐、律例、典章、诫命。

chapters.en: Know this day that it is not your children who have known and seen the discipline of the LORD your God: His greatness, His mighty hand, and His outstretched arm;
chapters.zh: 你们今日当知道，我本不是和你们的儿女〔说话〕；因为他们不知道，也没有看见耶和华－你们上帝的管教、威严、大能的手，和伸出来的膀臂，

chapters.en: the signs and works He did in Egypt to Pharaoh king of Egypt and all his land;
chapters.zh: 并他在埃及中向埃及王法老和其全地所行的神迹奇事；

chapters.en: what He did to the Egyptian army and horses and chariots when He made the waters of the Red Sea engulf them as they pursued you, and how He destroyed them completely, even to this day;
chapters.zh: 也没有看见他怎样待埃及的军兵、车马，他们追赶你们的时候，耶和华怎样使红海的水淹没他们，将他们灭绝，直到今日，

chapters.en: what He did for you in the wilderness until you reached this place;
chapters.zh: 并他在旷野怎样待你们，以致你们来到这地方；
