chapters.en: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
chapters.zh: 「『与异母同父，或异父同母的姊妹行淫的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』

chapters.en: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his mother-in-law.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
chapters.zh: 「『与岳母行淫的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』

chapters.en: ‘Cursed is he who strikes down his neighbor in secret.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
chapters.zh: 「『暗中杀人的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』

chapters.en: ‘Cursed is he who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
chapters.zh: 「『受贿赂害死无辜之人的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』

chapters.en: ‘Cursed is he who does not put the words of this law into practice.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
chapters.zh: 「『不坚守遵行这律法言语的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』」

chapters.en: “Now if you faithfully obey the voice of the LORD your God and are careful to follow all His commandments I am giving you today, the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.
chapters.zh: 「你若留意听从耶和华－你上帝的话，谨守遵行他的一切诫命，就是我今日所吩咐你的，他必使你超乎天下万民之上。

chapters.en: And all these blessings will come upon you and overtake you, if you will obey the voice of the LORD your God:
chapters.zh: 你若听从耶和华－你上帝的话，这以下的福必追随你，临到你身上：

chapters.en: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the country.
chapters.zh: 你在城里必蒙福，在田间也必蒙福。

chapters.en:
The fruit of your womb will be blessed, as well as the produce of your land and the offspring of your livestock— the calves of your herds
and the lambs of your flocks.
chapters.zh: 你身所生的，地所产的，牲畜所下的，以及牛犊、羊羔，都必蒙福。

chapters.en: Your basket and kneading bowl will be blessed.
chapters.zh: 你的筐子和你的抟面盆都必蒙福。

chapters.en: You will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out.
chapters.zh: 你出也蒙福，入也蒙福。

chapters.en: The LORD will cause the enemies who rise up against you to be defeated before you. They will march out against you in one direction but flee from you in seven.
chapters.zh: 「仇敌起来攻击你，耶和华必使他们在你面前被你杀败；他们从一条路来攻击你，必从七条路逃跑。

chapters.en: The LORD will decree a blessing on your barns and on everything to which you put your hand; the LORD your God will bless you in the land He is giving you.
chapters.zh: 在你仓房里，并你手所办的一切事上，耶和华所命的福必临到你。耶和华－你上帝也要在所给你的地上赐福与你。

chapters.en: The LORD will establish you as His holy people, just as He has sworn to you, if you keep the commandments of the LORD your God and walk in His ways.
chapters.zh: 你若谨守耶和华－你上帝的诫命，遵行他的道，他必照着向你所起的誓立你作为自己的圣民。

chapters.en: Then all the peoples of the earth will see that you are called by the name of the LORD, and they will stand in awe of you.
chapters.zh: 天下万民见你归在耶和华的名下，就要惧怕你。

chapters.en: The LORD will make you prosper abundantly—in the fruit of your womb, the offspring of your livestock, and the produce of your land—in the land that the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.
chapters.zh: 你在耶和华向你列祖起誓应许赐你的地上，他必使你身所生的，牲畜所下的，地所产的，都绰绰有余。

chapters.en: The LORD will open the heavens, His abundant storehouse, to send rain on your land in season and to bless all the work of your hands. You will lend to many nations, but borrow from none.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必为你开天上的府库，按时降雨在你的地上。在你手里所办的一切事上赐福与你。你必借给许多国民，却不致向他们借贷。

chapters.en: The LORD will make you the head and not the tail; you will only move upward and never downward, if you hear and carefully follow the commandments of the LORD your God, which I am giving you today.
Do not turn aside to the right or to the left from any of the words I command you today, and do not go after other gods to serve them.
chapters.zh: 你若听从耶和华－你上帝的诫命，就是我今日所吩咐你的，谨守遵行，不偏左右，也不随从事奉别神，耶和华就必使你作首不作尾，但居上不居下。」

chapters.en: If, however, you do not obey the LORD your God by carefully following all His commandments and statutes I am giving you today, all these curses will come upon you and overtake you:
chapters.zh: 「你若不听从耶和华－你上帝的话，不谨守遵行他的一切诫命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的，这以下的咒诅都必追随你，临到你身上：

chapters.en: You will be cursed in the city and cursed in the country.
chapters.zh: 你在城里必受咒诅，在田间也必受咒诅。

chapters.en: Your basket and kneading bowl will be cursed.
chapters.zh: 你的筐子和你的抟面盆都必受咒诅。

chapters.en: The fruit of your womb will be cursed, as well as the produce of your land, the calves of your herds, and the lambs of your flocks.
chapters.zh: 你身所生的，地所产的，以及牛犊、羊羔，都必受咒诅。

chapters.en: You will be cursed when you come in and cursed when you go out.
chapters.zh: 你出也受咒诅，入也受咒诅。

chapters.en: The LORD will send curses upon you, confusion and reproof in all to which you put your hand, until you are destroyed and quickly perish because of the wickedness you have committed in forsaking Him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华因你行恶离弃他，必在你手里所办的一切事上，使咒诅、扰乱、责罚临到你，直到你被毁灭，速速地灭亡。

chapters.en: The LORD will make the plague cling to you until He has exterminated you from the land that you are entering to possess.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必使瘟疫贴在你身上，直到他将你从所进去得为业的地上灭绝。

chapters.en: The LORD will strike you with wasting disease, with fever and inflammation, with scorching heat and drought, and with blight and mildew; these will pursue you until you perish.
chapters.zh: 耶和华要用痨病、热病、火症、疟疾、刀剑、旱〔风〕〔注：或译：干旱〕、霉烂攻击你。这都要追赶你，直到你灭亡。

chapters.en: The sky over your head will be bronze, and the earth beneath you iron.
chapters.zh: 你头上的天要变为铜，脚下的地要变为铁。

chapters.en: The LORD will turn the rain of your land into dust and powder; it will descend on you from the sky until you are destroyed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华要使那降在你地上的雨变为尘沙，从天临在你身上，直到你灭亡。

chapters.en: The LORD will cause you to be defeated before your enemies. You will march out against them in one direction but flee from them in seven. You will be an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华必使你败在仇敌面前，你从一条路去攻击他们，必从七条路逃跑。你必在天下万国中抛来抛去。

chapters.en: Your corpses will be food for all the birds of the air and beasts of the earth, with no one to scare them away.
chapters.zh: 你的尸首必给空中的飞鸟和地上的走兽作食物，并无人鬨赶。

chapters.en: The LORD will afflict you with the boils of Egypt, with tumors and scabs and itch from which you cannot be cured.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必用埃及人的疮并痔疮、牛皮癣与疥攻击你，使你不能医治。

chapters.en: The LORD will afflict you with madness, blindness, and confusion of mind,
chapters.zh: 耶和华必用癫狂、眼瞎、心惊攻击你。

chapters.en: and at noon you will grope about like a blind man in the darkness. You will not prosper in your ways. Day after day you will be oppressed and plundered, with no one to save you.
chapters.zh: 你必在午间摸索，好像瞎子在暗中摸索一样。你所行的必不亨通，时常遭遇欺压、抢夺，无人搭救。

chapters.en: You will be pledged in marriage to a woman, but another man will violate her. You will build a house but will not live in it. You will plant a vineyard but will not enjoy its fruit.
chapters.zh: 你聘定了妻，别人必与她同房；你建造房屋，不得住在其内；你栽种葡萄园，也不得用其中的果子。

chapters.en: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes, but you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be taken away and not returned to you. Your flock will be given to your enemies, and no one will save you.
chapters.zh: 你的牛在你眼前宰了，你必不得吃牠的肉；你的驴在你眼前被抢夺，不得归还；你的羊归了仇敌，无人搭救。

chapters.en: Your sons and daughters will be given to another nation, while your eyes grow weary looking for them day after day, with no power in your hand.
chapters.zh: 你的儿女必归与别国的民；你的眼目终日切望，甚至失明，你手中无力拯救。

chapters.en: A people you do not know will eat the produce of your land and of all your toil. All your days you will be oppressed and crushed.
chapters.zh: 你的土产和你劳碌得来的，必被你所不认识的国民吃尽。你时常被欺负，受压制，

chapters.en: You will be driven mad by the sights you see.
chapters.zh: 甚至你因眼中所看见的，必致疯狂。

chapters.en: The LORD will afflict you with painful, incurable boils on your knees and thighs, from the soles of your feet to the top of your head.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必攻击你，使你膝上腿上，从脚掌到头顶，长毒疮无法医治。

chapters.en: The LORD will bring you and the king you appoint to a nation neither you nor your fathers have known, and there you will worship other gods—gods of wood and stone.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华必将你和你所立的王领到你和你列祖素不认识的国去；在那里你必事奉木头石头的神。

chapters.en: You will become an object of horror, scorn, and ridicule among all the nations to which the LORD will drive you.
chapters.zh: 你在耶和华领你到的各国中，要令人惊骇、笑谈、讥诮。

chapters.en: You will sow much seed in the field but harvest little, because the locusts will consume it.
chapters.zh: 你带到田间的种子虽多，收进来的却少，因为被蝗虫吃了。

chapters.en: You will plant and cultivate vineyards, but will neither drink the wine nor gather the grapes, because worms will eat them.
chapters.zh: 你栽种、修理葡萄园，却不得收〔葡萄〕，也不得喝〔葡萄〕酒，因为被虫子吃了。

chapters.en: You will have olive trees throughout your territory but will never anoint yourself with oil, because the olives will drop off.
chapters.zh: 你全境有橄榄树，却不得其油抹身，因为树上的橄榄不熟自落了。

chapters.en: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not remain yours, because they will go into captivity.
chapters.zh: 你生儿养女，却不算是你的，因为必被掳去。

chapters.en: Swarms of locusts will consume all your trees and the produce of your land.
chapters.zh: 你所有的树木和你地里的出产必被蝗虫所吃。

chapters.en: The foreigner living among you will rise higher and higher above you, while you sink down lower and lower.
chapters.zh: 在你中间寄居的，必渐渐上升，比你高而又高；你必渐渐下降，低而又低。

chapters.en: He will lend to you, but you will not lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.
chapters.zh: 他必借给你，你却不能借给他；他必作首，你必作尾。

chapters.en: All these curses will come upon you. They will pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, since you did not obey the LORD your God and keep the commandments and statutes He gave you.
chapters.zh: 这一切咒诅必追随你，赶上你，直到你灭亡；因为你不听从耶和华－你上帝的话，不遵守他所吩咐的诫命律例。

chapters.en: These curses will be a sign and a wonder upon you and your descendants forever.
chapters.zh: 这些咒诅必在你和你后裔的身上成为异迹奇事，直到永远！

chapters.en: Because you did not serve the LORD your God with joy and gladness of heart in all your abundance,
chapters.zh: 「因为你富有的时候，不欢心乐意地事奉耶和华－你的上帝，

chapters.en: you will serve your enemies the LORD will send against you in famine, thirst, nakedness, and destitution. He will place an iron yoke on your neck until He has destroyed you.
chapters.zh: 所以你必在饥饿、干渴、赤露、缺乏之中事奉耶和华所打发来攻击你的仇敌。他必把铁轭加在你的颈项上，直到将你灭绝。

chapters.en: The LORD will bring a nation from afar, from the ends of the earth, to swoop down upon you like an eagle—a nation whose language you will not understand,
chapters.zh: 「耶和华要从远方、地极带一国的民，如鹰飞来攻击你。这民的言语，你不懂得。

chapters.en: a ruthless nation with no respect for the old and no pity for the young.
chapters.zh: 这民的面貌凶恶，不顾恤年老的，也不恩待年少的。

chapters.en: They will eat the offspring of your livestock and the produce of your land until you are destroyed. They will leave you no grain or new wine or oil, no calves of your herds or lambs of your flocks, until they have caused you to perish.
chapters.zh: 他们必吃你牲畜所下的和你地土所产的，直到你灭亡。你的五谷、新酒，和油，以及牛犊、羊羔，都不给你留下，直到将你灭绝。

chapters.en: They will besiege all the cities throughout your land, until the high and fortified walls in which you trust have fallen. They will besiege all your cities throughout the land that the LORD your God has given you.
chapters.zh: 他们必将你困在你各城里，直到你所倚靠、高大坚固的城墙都被攻塌。他们必将你困在耶和华－你上帝所赐你遍地的各城里。

chapters.en: Then you will eat the fruit of your womb, the flesh of the sons and daughters whom the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you.
chapters.zh: 你在仇敌围困窘迫之中，必吃你本身所生的，就是耶和华－你上帝所赐给你的儿女之肉。

chapters.en: The most gentle and refined man among you will begrudge his brother, the wife he embraces, and the rest of his children who have survived,
chapters.zh: 你们中间，柔弱娇嫩的人必恶眼看他弟兄和他怀中的妻，并他余剩的儿女；

chapters.en: refusing to share with any of them the flesh of his children he will eat because he has nothing left in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you within all your gates.
chapters.zh: 甚至在你受仇敌围困窘迫的城中，他要吃儿女的肉，不肯分一点给他的亲人，因为他一无所剩。

chapters.en: The most gentle and refined woman among you, so gentle and refined she would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground, will begrudge the husband she embraces and her son and daughter
chapters.zh: 你们中间，柔弱娇嫩的妇人，是因娇嫩柔弱不肯把脚踏地的，必恶眼看她怀中的丈夫和她的儿女。

chapters.en: the afterbirth that comes from between her legs and the children she bears, because she will secretly eat them for lack of anything else in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you within your gates.
chapters.zh: 她两腿中间出来的婴孩与她所要生的儿女，她因缺乏一切就要在你受仇敌围困窘迫的城中将他们暗暗地吃了。

chapters.en: If you are not careful to observe all the words of this law which are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and awesome name—the LORD your God—
He will bring upon you and your descendants extraordinary disasters, severe and lasting plagues, and terrible and chronic sicknesses.
chapters.zh: 「这书上所写律法的一切话是叫你敬畏耶和华－你上帝可荣可畏的名。你若不谨守遵行，耶和华就必将奇灾，就是至大至长的灾，至重至久的病，加在你和你后裔的身上，

chapters.en: He will afflict you again with all the diseases you dreaded in Egypt, and they will cling to you.
chapters.zh: 也必使你所惧怕、埃及人的病都临到你，贴在你身上，

chapters.en: The LORD will also bring upon you every sickness and plague not recorded in this Book of the Law, until you are destroyed.
chapters.zh: 又必将没有写在这律法书上的各样疾病、灾殃降在你身上，直到你灭亡。

chapters.en: You who were as numerous as the stars in the sky will be left few in number, because you would not obey the voice of the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 你们先前虽然像天上的星那样多，却因不听从耶和华－你上帝的话，所剩的人数就稀少了。

chapters.en: Just as it pleased the LORD to make you prosper and multiply, so also it will please Him to annihilate you and destroy you. And you will be uprooted from the land you are entering to possess.
chapters.zh: 先前耶和华怎样喜悦善待你们，使你们众多，也要照样喜悦毁灭你们，使你们灭亡；并且你们从所要进去得的地上必被拔除。

chapters.en: Then the LORD will scatter you among all the nations, from one end of the earth to the other, and there you will worship other gods, gods of wood and stone, which neither you nor your fathers have known.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必使你们分散在万民中，从地这边到地那边，你必在那里事奉你和你列祖素不认识、木头石头的神。

chapters.en: Among those nations you will find no repose, not even a resting place for the sole of your foot. There the LORD will give you a trembling heart, failing eyes, and a despairing soul.
chapters.zh: 在那些国中，你必不得安逸，也不得落脚之地；耶和华却使你在那里心中跳动，眼目失明，精神消耗。

chapters.en: So your life will hang in doubt before you, and you will be afraid night and day, never certain of survival.
chapters.zh: 你的性命必悬悬无定；你昼夜恐惧，自料性命难保。

chapters.en: In the morning you will say, ‘If only it were evening!’ and in the evening you will say, ‘If only it were morning!’—because of the dread in your hearts of the terrifying sights you will see.
chapters.zh: 你因心里所恐惧的，眼中所看见的，早晨必说，巴不得到晚上才好；晚上必说，巴不得到早晨才好。

chapters.en: The LORD will return you to Egypt in ships by a route that I said you should never see again. There you will sell yourselves to your enemies as male and female slaves, but no one will buy you.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华必使你坐船回埃及去，走我曾告诉你不得再见的路；在那里你必卖己身与仇敌作奴婢，却无人买。」

chapters.en: These are the words of the covenant that the LORD commanded Moses to make with the Israelites in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant He had made with them at Horeb.
chapters.zh: 这是耶和华在摩押地吩咐摩西与以色列人立约的话，是在他和他们于何烈山所立的约之外。

chapters.en: Moses summoned all Israel and proclaimed to them, “You have seen with your own eyes everything the LORD did in Egypt to Pharaoh, to all his officials, and to all his land.
chapters.zh: 摩西召了以色列众人来，对他们说：「耶和华在埃及地，在你们眼前向法老和他众臣仆，并他全地所行的一切事，你们都看见了，

chapters.en: You saw with your own eyes the great trials, and those miraculous signs and wonders.
chapters.zh: 就是你亲眼看见的大试验和神迹，并那些大奇事。

chapters.en: Yet to this day the LORD has not given you a mind to understand, eyes to see, or ears to hear.
chapters.zh: 但耶和华到今日没有使你们心能明白，眼能看见，耳能听见。

chapters.en: For forty years I led you in the wilderness, yet your clothes and sandals did not wear out.
chapters.zh: 我领你们在旷野四十年，你们身上的衣服并没有穿破，脚上的鞋也没有穿坏。

chapters.en: You ate no bread and drank no wine or strong drink, so that you might know that I am the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 你们没有吃饼，也没有喝清酒浓酒。这要使你们知道，耶和华是你们的上帝。

chapters.en: When you reached this place, Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out against us in battle, but we defeated them.
chapters.zh: 你们来到这地方，希实本王西宏、巴珊王噩都出来与我们交战，我们就击杀了他们，

chapters.en: We took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 取了他们的地给吕便支派、迦得支派，和玛拿西半支派为业。

chapters.en: So keep and follow the words of this covenant, that you may prosper in all you do.
chapters.zh: 所以你们要谨守遵行这约的话，好叫你们在一切所行的事上亨通。

chapters.en: All of you are standing today before the LORD your God—you leaders of tribes, elders, officials, and all the men of Israel,
your children and wives, and the foreigners in your camps who cut your wood and draw your water—
chapters.zh: 「今日，你们的首领、族长〔注：原文是支派〕、长老、官长、以色列的男丁，你们的妻子儿女，和营中寄居的，以及为你们劈柴挑水的人，都站在耶和华－你们的上帝面前，

chapters.en: so that you may enter into the covenant of the LORD your God, which He is making with you today, and into His oath,
chapters.zh: 为要你顺从耶和华－你上帝今日与你所立的约，向你所起的誓。

chapters.en: and so that He may establish you today as His people, and He may be your God as He promised you and as He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
chapters.zh: 这样，他要照他向你所应许的话，又向你列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所起的誓，今日立你作他的子民，他作你的上帝。

chapters.en: I am making this covenant and this oath not only with you,
chapters.zh: 我不但与你们立这约，起这誓，

chapters.en: but also with those who are standing here with us today in the presence of the LORD our God, as well as with those who are not here today.
chapters.zh: 凡与我们一同站在耶和华－我们上帝面前的，并今日不在我们这里的人，我也与他们立这约，起这誓。

chapters.en: For you yourselves know how we lived in the land of Egypt and how we passed through the nations on the way here.
chapters.zh: 「我们曾住过埃及地，也从列国经过；这是你们知道的。

chapters.en: You saw the abominations and idols among them made of wood and stone, of silver and gold.
chapters.zh: 你们也看见他们中间可憎之物，并他们木、石、金、银的偶像。

chapters.en: Make sure there is no man or woman, clan or tribe among you today whose heart turns away from the LORD our God to go and worship the gods of those nations. Make sure there is no root among you that bears such poisonous and bitter fruit,
chapters.zh: 惟恐你们中间，或男或女，或族长或支派长，今日心里偏离耶和华－我们的上帝，去事奉那些国的神；又怕你们中间有〔恶〕根生出苦菜和茵蔯来，

chapters.en:
because when such a person hears the words of this oath, he invokes a blessing on himself, saying, ‘I will have peace, even though I walk in the stubbornness of my own heart.’
This will bring disaster on the watered land as well as the dry.
chapters.zh: 听见这咒诅的话，心里仍是自夸说：『我虽然行事心里顽梗，连累众人，却还是平安。』

chapters.en: The LORD will never be willing to forgive him. Instead, His anger and jealousy will burn against that man, and every curse written in this book will fall upon him. The LORD will blot out his name from under heaven
chapters.zh: 耶和华必不饶恕他；耶和华的怒气与愤恨要向他发作，如烟冒出，将这书上所写的一切咒诅都加在他身上。耶和华又要从天下涂抹他的名，

chapters.en: and single him out from all the tribes of Israel for disaster, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this Book of the Law.
chapters.zh: 也必照着写在律法书上、约中的一切咒诅将他从以色列众支派中分别出来，使他受祸。

chapters.en: Then the generation to come—your sons who follow you and the foreigner who comes from a distant land—will see the plagues of the land and the sicknesses the LORD has inflicted on it.
chapters.zh: 你们的后代，就是以后兴起来的子孙，和远方来的外人，看见这地的灾殃，并耶和华所降与这地的疾病，

chapters.en: All its soil will be a burning waste of sulfur and salt, unsown and unproductive, with no plant growing on it, just like the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which the LORD overthrew in His fierce anger.
chapters.zh: 又看见遍地有硫磺，有盐卤，有火迹，没有耕种，没有出产，连草都不生长－好像耶和华在忿怒中所倾覆的所多玛、蛾摩拉、押玛、洗扁一样－

chapters.en: So all the nations will ask, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land? Why this great outburst of anger?’
chapters.zh: 所看见的人，连万国人，都必问说：『耶和华为何向此地这样行呢？这样大发烈怒是什么意思呢？』

chapters.en: And the people will answer, ‘It is because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD, the God of their fathers, which He made with them when He brought them out of the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 人必回答说：『是因这地的人离弃了耶和华－他们列祖的上帝，领他们出埃及地的时候与他们所立的约，

chapters.en: They went and served other gods, and they worshiped gods they had not known—gods that the LORD had not given to them.
chapters.zh: 去事奉敬拜素不认识的别神，是耶和华所未曾给他们安排的。

chapters.en: Therefore the anger of the LORD burned against this land, and He brought upon it every curse written in this book.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华的怒气向这地发作，将这书上所写的一切咒诅都降在这地上。

chapters.en: The LORD uprooted them from their land in His anger, rage, and great wrath, and He cast them into another land, where they are today.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华在怒气、忿怒、大恼恨中将他们从本地拔出来，扔在别的地上，像今日一样。』

chapters.en: The secret things belong to the LORD our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our children forever, so that we may follow all the words of this law.
chapters.zh: 「隐祕的事是属耶和华－我们上帝的；惟有明显的事是永远属我们和我们子孙的，好叫我们遵行这律法上的一切话。」

chapters.en: “When all these things come upon you—the blessings and curses I have set before you—and you call them to mind in all the nations to which the LORD your God has banished you,
chapters.zh: 「我所陈明在你面前的这一切咒诅都临到你身上；你在耶和华－你上帝追赶你到的万国中必心里追念祝福的话；

chapters.en: and when you and your children return to the LORD your God and obey His voice with all your heart and all your soul according to everything I am giving you today,
chapters.zh: 你和你的子孙若尽心尽性归向耶和华－你的上帝，照着我今日一切所吩咐的听从他的话；

chapters.en: then He will restore you from captivity and have compassion on you and gather you from all the nations to which the LORD your God has scattered you.
chapters.zh: 那时，耶和华－你的上帝必怜恤你，救回你这被掳的子民；耶和华－你的上帝要回转过来，从分散你到的万民中将你招聚回来。

chapters.en: Even if you have been banished to the farthest horizon, He will gather you and return you from there.
chapters.zh: 你被赶散的人，就是在天涯的，耶和华－你的上帝也必从那里将你招聚回来。

chapters.en: And the LORD your God will bring you into the land your fathers possessed, and you will take possession of it. He will cause you to prosper and multiply more than your fathers.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你的上帝必领你进入你列祖所得的地，使你可以得着；又必善待你，使你的人数比你列祖众多。

chapters.en: The LORD your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, and you will love Him with all your heart and with all your soul, so that you may live.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你上帝必将你心里和你后裔心里的污秽除掉，好叫你尽心尽性爱耶和华－你的上帝，使你可以存活。

chapters.en: Then the LORD your God will put all these curses upon your enemies who hate you and persecute you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你的上帝必将这一切咒诅加在你仇敌和恨恶你、逼迫你的人身上。

chapters.en: And you will again obey the voice of the LORD and follow all His commandments I am giving you today.
chapters.zh: 你必归回，听从耶和华的话，遵行他的一切诫命，就是我今日所吩咐你的。

chapters.en: So the LORD your God will make you abound in all the work of your hands and in the fruit of your womb, the offspring of your livestock, and the produce of your land. Indeed, the LORD will again delight in your prosperity, as He delighted in that of your fathers,
if you obey the LORD your God by keeping His commandments and statutes that are written in this Book of the Law, and if you turn to Him with all your heart and with all your soul.
chapters.zh: 你若听从耶和华－你上帝的话，谨守这律法书上所写的诫命律例，又尽心尽性归向耶和华－你的上帝，他必使你手里所办的一切事，并你身所生的，牲畜所下的，地土所产的，都绰绰有余；因为耶和华必再喜悦你，降福与你，像从前喜悦你列祖一样。

chapters.en: For this commandment I give you today is not too difficult for you or beyond your reach.
chapters.zh: 「我今日所吩咐你的诫命不是你难行的，也不是离你远的；

chapters.en: It is not in heaven, that you should need to ask, ‘Who will ascend into heaven to get it for us and proclaim it, that we may obey it?’
chapters.zh: 不是在天上，使你说：『谁替我们上天取下来，使我们听见可以遵行呢？』

chapters.en: And it is not beyond the sea, that you should need to ask, ‘Who will cross the sea to get it for us and proclaim it, that we may obey it?’
chapters.zh: 也不是在海外，使你说：『谁替我们过海取了来，使我们听见可以遵行呢？』

chapters.en: But the word is very near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart, so that you may obey it.
chapters.zh: 这话却离你甚近，就在你口中，在你心里，使你可以遵行。

chapters.en: See, I have set before you today life and prosperity, as well as death and disaster.
chapters.zh: 「看哪，我今日将生与福，死与祸，陈明在你面前。

chapters.en: For I am commanding you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in His ways, and to keep His commandments, statutes, and ordinances, so that you may live and increase, and the LORD your God may bless you in the land that you are entering to possess.
chapters.zh: 吩咐你爱耶和华－你的上帝，遵行他的道，谨守他的诫命、律例、典章，使你可以存活，人数增多，耶和华－你上帝就必在你所要进去得为业的地上赐福与你。

chapters.en: But if your heart turns away and you do not listen, but are drawn away to bow down to other gods and worship them,
chapters.zh: 倘若你心里偏离，不肯听从，却被勾引去敬拜事奉别神，

chapters.en: I declare to you today that you will surely perish; you shall not prolong your days in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.
chapters.zh: 我今日明明告诉你们，你们必要灭亡；在你过约旦河、进去得为业的地上，你的日子必不长久。

chapters.en: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you today that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing. Therefore choose life, so that you and your descendants may live,
chapters.zh: 我今日呼天唤地向你作见证；我将生死祸福陈明在你面前，所以你要拣选生命，使你和你的后裔都得存活；

chapters.en: and that you may love the LORD your God, obey Him, and hold fast to Him. For He is your life, and He will prolong your life in the land that the LORD swore to give to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.”
chapters.zh: 且爱耶和华－你的上帝，听从他的话，专靠他；因为他是你的生命，你的日子长久也在乎他。这样，你就可以在耶和华向你列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许所赐的地上居住。」

chapters.en: When Moses had finished speaking these words to all Israel,
chapters.zh: 摩西去告诉以色列众人

chapters.en: he said to them, “I am now a hundred and twenty years old; I am no longer able to come and go, and the LORD has said to me, ‘You shall not cross the Jordan.’
chapters.zh: 说：「我现在一百二十岁了，不能照常出入；耶和华也曾对我说：『你必不得过这约旦河。』

chapters.en: The LORD your God Himself will cross over ahead of you. He will destroy these nations before you, and you will dispossess them. Joshua will cross ahead of you, as the LORD has said.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你们的上帝必引导你们过去，将这些国民在你们面前灭绝，你们就得他们的地。约书亚必引导你们过去，正如耶和华所说的。

chapters.en: And the LORD will do to them as He did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, when He destroyed them along with their land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必待他们，如同从前待他所灭绝的亚摩利二王西宏与噩以及他们的国一样。

chapters.en: The LORD will deliver them over to you, and you must do to them exactly as I have commanded you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必将他们交给你们；你们要照我所吩咐的一切命令待他们。

chapters.en: Be strong and courageous; do not be afraid or terrified of them, for it is the LORD your God who goes with you; He will never leave you nor forsake you.”
chapters.zh: 你们当刚强壮胆，不要害怕，也不要畏惧他们，因为耶和华－你的上帝和你同去。他必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。」

chapters.en: Then Moses called for Joshua and said to him in the presence of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you will go with this people into the land that the LORD swore to their fathers to give them, and you shall give it to them as an inheritance.
chapters.zh: 摩西召了约书亚来，在以色列众人眼前对他说：「你当刚强壮胆！因为，你要和这百姓一同进入耶和华向他们列祖起誓应许所赐之地；你也要使他们承受那地为业。

chapters.en: The LORD Himself goes before you; He will be with you. He will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid or discouraged.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华必在你前面行；他必与你同在，必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。」

chapters.en: So Moses wrote down this law and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and to all the elders of Israel.
chapters.zh: 摩西将这律法写出来，交给抬耶和华约柜的祭司利未子孙和以色列的众长老。

chapters.en: Then Moses commanded them, “At the end of every seven years, at the appointed time in the year of remission of debt, during the Feast of Tabernacles,
chapters.zh: 摩西吩咐他们说：「每逢七年的末一年，就在豁免年的定期住棚节的时候，

chapters.en: when all Israel comes before the LORD your God at the place He will choose, you are to read this law in the hearing of all Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列众人来到耶和华－你上帝所选择的地方朝见他。那时，你要在以色列众人面前将这律法念给他们听。

chapters.en: Assemble the people—men, women, children, and the foreigners within your gates—so that they may listen and learn to fear the LORD your God and to follow carefully all the words of this law.
chapters.zh: 要招聚他们男、女、孩子，并城里寄居的，使他们听，使他们学习，好敬畏耶和华－你们的上帝，谨守、遵行这律法的一切话，

chapters.en: Then their children who do not know the law will listen and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as you live in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.”
chapters.zh: 也使他们未曾晓得〔这律法〕的儿女得以听见，学习敬畏耶和华－你们的上帝，在你们过约旦河要得为业之地，存活的日子，常常这样行。」

chapters.en:
Then the LORD said to Moses, “Behold, the time of your death is near. Call Joshua and present yourselves at the Tent of Meeting, so that I may commission him.”
So Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves at the Tent of Meeting.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「你的死期临近了；要召约书亚来，你们二人站在会幕里，我好嘱咐他。」于是摩西和约书亚去站在会幕里。

chapters.en: Then the LORD appeared at the tent in a pillar of cloud, and the cloud stood over the entrance to the tent.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在〔会〕幕里云柱中显现，云柱停在〔会〕幕门以上。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Moses, “You will soon rest with your fathers, and these people will rise up and prostitute themselves with the foreign gods of the land they are entering. They will forsake Me and break the covenant I have made with them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华又对摩西说：「你必和你列祖同睡。这百姓要起来，在他们所要去的地上，在那地的人中，随从外邦神行邪淫，离弃我，违背我与他们所立的约。

chapters.en:
On that day My anger will burn against them, and I will abandon them and hide My face from them, so that they will be consumed, and many troubles and afflictions will befall them.
On that day they will say, ‘Have not these disasters come upon us because our God is no longer with us?’
chapters.zh: 那时，我的怒气必向他们发作；我也必离弃他们，掩面不顾他们，以致他们被吞灭，并有许多的祸患灾难临到他们。那日他们必说：『这些祸患临到我们，岂不是因我们的上帝不在我们中间吗？』

chapters.en: And on that day I will surely hide My face because of all the evil they have done by turning to other gods.
chapters.zh: 那时，因他们偏向别神所行的一切恶，我必定掩面不顾他们。

chapters.en: Now therefore, write down for yourselves this song and teach it to the Israelites; have them recite it, so that it may be a witness for Me against them.
chapters.zh: 现在你要写一篇歌，教导以色列人，传给他们，使这歌见证他们的不是；

chapters.en: When I have brought them into the land that I swore to give their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey, they will eat their fill and prosper. Then they will turn to other gods and worship them, and they will reject Me and break My covenant.
chapters.zh: 因为我将他们领进我向他们列祖起誓应许那流奶与蜜之地，他们在那里吃得饱足，身体肥胖，就必偏向别神，事奉他们，藐视我，背弃我的约。

chapters.en: And when many troubles and afflictions have come upon them, this song will testify against them, because it will not be forgotten from the lips of their descendants. For I know their inclination, even before I bring them into the land that I swore to give them.”
chapters.zh: 那时，有许多祸患灾难临到他们，这歌必在他们面前作见证，他们后裔的口中必念诵不忘。我未领他们到我所起誓应许之地以先，他们所怀的意念我都知道了。」

chapters.en: So that very day Moses wrote down this song and taught it to the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 当日摩西就写了一篇歌，教导以色列人。

chapters.en: Then the LORD commissioned Joshua son of Nun and said, “Be strong and courageous, for you will bring the Israelites into the land that I swore to give them, and I will be with you.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华嘱咐嫩的儿子约书亚说：「你当刚强壮胆，因为你必领以色列人进我所起誓应许他们的地；我必与你同在。」

chapters.en: When Moses had finished writing in a book the words of this law from beginning to end,
chapters.zh: 摩西将这律法的话写在书上，及至写完了，

chapters.en: he gave this command to the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD:
chapters.zh: 就吩咐抬耶和华约柜的利未人说：

chapters.en: “Take this Book of the Law and place it beside the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, so that it may remain there as a witness against you.
chapters.zh: 「将这律法书放在耶和华－你们上帝的约柜旁，可以在那里见证以色列人的不是；

chapters.en: For I know how rebellious and stiff-necked you are. If you are already rebelling against the LORD while I am still alive, how much more will you rebel after my death!
chapters.zh: 因为我知道你们是悖逆的，是硬着颈项的。我今日还活着与你们同在，你们尚且悖逆耶和华，何况我死后呢？

chapters.en: Assemble before me all the elders of your tribes and all your officers so that I may speak these words in their hearing and call heaven and earth to witness against them.
chapters.zh: 你们要将你们支派的众长老和官长都招聚了来，我好将这些话说与他们听，并呼天唤地见证他们的不是。

chapters.en: For I know that after my death you will become utterly corrupt and turn from the path I have commanded you. And in the days to come, disaster will befall you because you will do evil in the sight of the LORD to provoke Him to anger by the work of your hands.”
chapters.zh: 我知道我死后，你们必全然败坏，偏离我所吩咐你们的道，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，以手所做的惹他发怒；日后必有祸患临到你们。」

chapters.en: Then Moses recited aloud to the whole assembly of Israel the words of this song from beginning to end:
chapters.zh: 摩西将这一篇歌的话都说与以色列全会众听。

chapters.en: Give ear, O heavens, and I will speak; hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
chapters.zh: 诸天哪，侧耳，我要说话； 愿地也听我口中的言语。

chapters.en: Let my teaching fall like rain and my speech settle like dew, like gentle rain on new grass, like showers on tender plants.
chapters.zh: 我的教训要淋漓如雨； 我的言语要滴落如露， 如细雨降在嫩草上， 如甘霖降在菜蔬中。

chapters.en: For I will proclaim the name of the LORD. Ascribe greatness to our God!
chapters.zh: 我要宣告耶和华的名； 你们要将大德归与我们的上帝。

chapters.en: He is the Rock, His work is perfect; all His ways are just. A God of faithfulness without injustice, righteous and upright is He.
chapters.zh: 他是磐石，他的作为完全； 他所行的无不公平， 是诚实无伪的上帝， 又公义，又正直。

chapters.en:
His people have acted corruptly toward Him; the blemish on them is not that of His children,
but of a perverse and crooked generation.
chapters.zh: 这乖僻弯曲的世代向他行事邪僻； 有这弊病就不是他的儿女。

chapters.en: Is this how you repay the LORD, O foolish and senseless people? Is He not your Father and Creator? Has He not made you and established you?
chapters.zh: 愚昧无知的民哪，你们这样报答耶和华吗？ 他岂不是你的父、将你买来的吗？ 他是制造你、建立你的。

chapters.en: Remember the days of old; consider the years long past. Ask your father, and he will tell you, your elders, and they will inform you.
chapters.zh: 你当追想上古之日， 思念历代之年； 问你的父亲，他必指示你； 问你的长者，他必告诉你。

chapters.en: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when He divided the sons of man, He set the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the sons of God.
chapters.zh: 至高者将地业赐给列邦，将世人分开， 就照以色列人的数目立定万民的疆界。

chapters.en: But the LORD’s portion is His people, Jacob His allotted inheritance.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的分本是他的百姓； 他的产业本是雅各。

chapters.en: He found him in a desert land, in a barren, howling wilderness; He surrounded him, He instructed him, He guarded him as the apple of His eye.
chapters.zh: 耶和华遇见他在旷野－ 荒凉野兽吼叫之地， 就环绕他，看顾他， 保护他，如同保护眼中的瞳人。

chapters.en: As an eagle stirs up its nest and hovers over its young, He spread His wings to catch them and carried them on His pinions.
chapters.zh: 又如鹰搅动巢窝， 在雏鹰以上两翅扇展， 接取雏鹰，背在两翼之上。

chapters.en: The LORD alone led him, and no foreign god was with him.
chapters.zh: 这样，耶和华独自引导他， 并无外邦神与他同在。

chapters.en: He made him ride on the heights of the land and fed him the produce of the field. He nourished him with honey from the rock and oil from the flinty crag,
chapters.zh: 耶和华使他乘驾地的高处， 得吃田间的土产； 又使他从磐石中咂蜜， 从坚石中吸油；

chapters.en: with curds from the herd and milk from the flock, with the fat of lambs, with rams from Bashan, and goats, with the choicest grains of wheat. From the juice of the finest grapes you drank the wine.
chapters.zh: 也吃牛的奶油， 羊的奶，羊羔的脂油， 巴珊所出的公绵羊和山羊， 与上好的麦子， 也喝葡萄汁酿的酒。

chapters.en: But Jeshurun grew fat and kicked— becoming fat, bloated, and gorged. He abandoned the God who made him and scorned the Rock of his salvation.
chapters.zh: 但耶书崙渐渐肥胖，粗壮， 光润，踢跳，〔奔跑〕， 便离弃造他的上帝， 轻看救他的磐石；

chapters.en: They provoked His jealousy with foreign gods; they enraged Him with abominations.
chapters.zh: 敬拜别〔神〕，触动上帝的愤恨， 行可憎恶的事，惹了他的怒气。

chapters.en: They sacrificed to demons, not to God, to gods they had not known, to newly arrived gods, which your fathers did not fear.
chapters.zh: 所祭祀的鬼魔并非真神， 乃是素不认识的神， 是近来新兴的， 是你列祖所不畏惧的。

chapters.en: You ignored the Rock who brought you forth; you forgot the God who gave you birth.
chapters.zh: 你轻忽生你的磐石， 忘记产你的上帝。

chapters.en: When the LORD saw this, He rejected them, provoked to anger by His sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 耶和华看见他的儿女惹动他， 就厌恶〔他们〕，说：

chapters.en: He said: “I will hide My face from them; I will see what will be their end. For they are a perverse generation— children of unfaithfulness.
chapters.zh: 我要向他们掩面， 看他们的结局如何。 他们本是极乖僻的族类， 心中无诚实的儿女。

chapters.en: They have provoked My jealousy by that which is not God; they have enraged Me with their worthless idols. So I will make them jealous by those who are not a people; I will make them angry by a nation without understanding.
chapters.zh: 他们以那「不算为神」的触动我的愤恨， 以虚无〔的神〕惹了我的怒气。 我也要以那「不成子民」的触动他们的愤恨， 以愚昧的国民惹了他们的怒气。

chapters.en: For a fire has been kindled by My anger, and it burns to the depths of Sheol; it consumes the earth and its produce, and scorches the foundations of the mountains.
chapters.zh: 因为在我怒中有火烧起， 直烧到极深的阴间， 把地和地的出产尽都焚烧， 山的根基也烧着了。

chapters.en: I will heap disasters upon them; I will spend My arrows against them.
chapters.zh: 我要将祸患堆在他们身上， 把我的箭向他们射尽。

chapters.en: They will be wasted from hunger and ravaged by pestilence and bitter plague; I will send the fangs of wild beasts against them, with the venom of vipers that slither in the dust.
chapters.zh: 〔他们必〕因饥饿消瘦， 被炎热苦毒吞灭。 我要打发野兽用牙齿咬他们， 并土中腹行的，用毒气害他们。

chapters.en: Outside, the sword will take their children, and inside, terror will strike the young man and the young woman, the infant and the gray-haired man.
chapters.zh: 外头有刀剑，内室有惊恐， 使人丧亡，使少男、童女、 吃奶的、白发的，〔尽都灭绝〕。

chapters.en: I would have said that I would cut them to pieces and blot out their memory from mankind,
chapters.zh: 我说，我必将他们分散远方， 使他们的名号从人间除灭。

chapters.en: if I had not dreaded the taunt of the enemy, lest their adversaries misunderstand and say: ‘Our own hand has prevailed; it was not the LORD who did all this.’”
chapters.zh: 惟恐仇敌惹动我， 只怕敌人错看，说：是我们手的能力， 并非耶和华所行的。

chapters.en: Israel is a nation devoid of counsel, with no understanding among them.
chapters.zh: 因为以色列民毫无计谋， 心中没有聪明。

chapters.en: If only they were wise, they would understand it; they would comprehend their fate.
chapters.zh: 惟愿他们有智慧， 能明白这事，肯思念他们的结局。

chapters.en: How could one man pursue a thousand, or two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, unless the LORD had given them up?
chapters.zh: 若不是他们的磐石卖了他们， 若不是耶和华交出他们， 一人焉能追赶他们千人？ 二人焉能使万人逃跑呢？

chapters.en: For their rock is not like our Rock, even our enemies concede.
chapters.zh: 据我们的仇敌自己断定， 他们的磐石不如我们的磐石。

chapters.en: But their vine is from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poisonous; their clusters are bitter.
chapters.zh: 他们的葡萄树是所多玛的葡萄树， 蛾摩拉田园所生的； 他们的葡萄是毒葡萄， 全挂都是苦的。

chapters.en: Their wine is the venom of serpents, the deadly poison of cobras.
chapters.zh: 他们的酒是大蛇的毒气， 是虺蛇残害的恶毒。

chapters.en: “Have I not stored up these things, sealed up within My vaults?
chapters.zh: 这不都是积蓄在我这里， 封锁在我府库中吗？

chapters.en: Vengeance is Mine; I will repay. In due time their foot will slip; for their day of disaster is near, and their doom is coming quickly.”
chapters.zh: 他们失脚的时候，伸冤报应在我； 因他们遭灾的日子近了； 那要临在他们身上的必速速来到。

chapters.en: For the LORD will vindicate His people and have compassion on His servants when He sees that their strength is gone and no one remains, slave or free.
chapters.zh: 耶和华见他百姓毫无能力， 无论困住的、自由的都没有〔剩下〕， 就必为他们伸冤， 为他的仆人后悔。

chapters.en: He will say: “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,
chapters.zh: 他必说：他们的神， 他们所投靠的磐石，

chapters.en: which ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise up and help you; let them give you shelter!
chapters.zh: 就是向来吃他们祭牲的脂油， 喝他们奠祭之酒的，在哪里呢？ 他可以兴起帮助你们， 护卫你们。

chapters.en: See now that I am He; there is no God besides Me. I bring death and I give life; I wound and I heal, and there is no one who can deliver from My hand.
chapters.zh: 你们如今要知道： 我，惟有我是上帝； 在我以外并无别神。 我使人死，我使人活； 我损伤，我也医治， 并无人能从我手中救出来。

chapters.en: For I lift up My hand to heaven and declare: As surely as I live forever,
chapters.zh: 我向天举手说： 我凭我的永生起誓：

chapters.en: when I sharpen My flashing sword, and My hand grasps it in judgment, I will take vengeance on My adversaries and repay those who hate Me.
chapters.zh: 我若磨我闪亮的刀， 手掌审判之权， 就必报复我的敌人， 报应恨我的人。

chapters.en: I will make My arrows drunk with blood, while My sword devours flesh— the blood of the slain and captives, the heads of the enemy leaders.”
chapters.zh: 我要使我的箭饮血饮醉， 就是被杀被掳之人的血。 我的刀要吃肉， 乃是仇敌中首领之头的肉。

chapters.en: Rejoice, O heavens, with Him, and let all God’s angels worship Him. Rejoice, O nations, with His people; for He will avenge the blood of His children. He will take vengeance on His adversaries and repay those who hate Him; He will cleanse His land and His people.
chapters.zh: 你们外邦人当与主的百姓一同欢呼； 因他要伸他仆人流血的冤， 报应他的敌人， 洁净他的地，救赎他的百姓。

chapters.en: Then Moses came with Joshua son of Nun and recited all the words of this song in the hearing of the people.
chapters.zh: 摩西和嫩的儿子约书亚去将这歌的一切话说给百姓听。

chapters.en: When Moses had finished reciting all these words to all Israel,
chapters.zh: 摩西向以色列众人说完了这一切的话，

chapters.en: he said to them, “Take to heart all the words I have solemnly declared to you this day, so that you may command your children to carefully follow all the words of this law.
chapters.zh: 又说：「我今日所警教你们的，你们都要放在心上；要吩咐你们的子孙谨守遵行这律法上的话。

chapters.en: For they are not idle words to you, because they are your life, and by them you will live long in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.”
chapters.zh: 因为这不是虚空、与你们无关的事，乃是你们的生命；在你们过约旦河要得为业的地上必因这事日子得以长久。」

chapters.en: On that same day the LORD said to Moses,
chapters.zh: 当日，耶和华吩咐摩西说：

chapters.en: “Go up into the Abarim Range to Mount Nebo, in the land of Moab across from Jericho, and view the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites as their own possession.
chapters.zh: 「你上这亚巴琳山中的尼波山去，在摩押地与耶利哥相对，观看我所要赐给以色列人为业的迦南地。

chapters.en: And there on the mountain that you climb, you will die and be gathered to your people, just as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people.
chapters.zh: 你必死在你所登的山上，归你列祖〔注：原文是本民〕去，像你哥哥亚伦死在何珥山上，归他的列祖一样。

chapters.en: For at the waters of Meribah-kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin, both of you broke faith with Me among the Israelites by failing to treat Me as holy in their presence.
chapters.zh: 因为你们在寻的旷野，加低斯的米利巴水，在以色列人中没有尊我为圣，得罪了我。

chapters.en: Although you shall see from a distance the land that I am giving the Israelites, you shall not enter it.”
chapters.zh: 我所赐给以色列人的地，你可以远远地观看，却不得进去。」

chapters.en: This is the blessing that Moses the man of God pronounced upon the Israelites before his death.
chapters.zh: 以下是神人摩西在未死之先为以色列人所祝的福：

chapters.en:
He said:
“The LORD came from Sinai and dawned upon us from Seir; He shone forth from Mount Paran and came with myriads of holy ones,
with flaming fire at His right hand.
chapters.zh: 他说：耶和华从西奈而来， 从西珥向他们显现， 从巴兰山发出光辉， 从万万圣者中来临， 从他右手为百姓传出烈火的律法。

chapters.en: Surely You love the people; all the holy ones are in Your hand, and they sit down at Your feet; each receives Your words—
chapters.zh: 他疼爱百姓； 众圣徒都在他手中。 他们坐在他的脚下， 领受他的言语。

chapters.en: the law that Moses gave us, the possession of the assembly of Jacob.
chapters.zh: 摩西将律法传给我们， 作为雅各会众的产业。

chapters.en:
So the LORD became King in Jeshurun when the leaders of the people gathered,
when the tribes of Israel came together.
chapters.zh: 百姓的众首领， 以色列的各支派， 一同聚会的时候， 耶和华〔注：原文是他〕在耶书崙中为王。

chapters.en: Let Reuben live and not die, nor his men be few.”
chapters.zh: 愿吕便存活，不致死亡； 愿他人数不致稀少。

chapters.en:
And concerning Judah he said:
“O LORD, hear the cry of Judah and bring him to his people. With his own hands he defends his cause, but may You be a help against his foes.”
chapters.zh: 为犹大祝福说： 求耶和华俯听犹大的声音， 引导他归于本族； 他曾用手为自己争战， 你必帮助他攻击敌人。

chapters.en:
Concerning Levi he said:
“Give Your Thummim to Levi and Your Urim to Your godly one, whom You tested at Massah and contested at the waters of Meribah.
chapters.zh: 论利未说： 〔耶和华啊〕，你的土明和乌陵 都在你的虔诚人那里。 你在玛撒曾试验他， 在米利巴水与他争论。

chapters.en: He said of his father and mother, ‘I do not consider them.’ He disregarded his brothers and did not know his own sons, for he kept Your word and maintained Your covenant.
chapters.zh: 他论自己的父母说： 我未曾看见； 他也不承认弟兄， 也不认识自己的儿女。 这是因利未人遵行你的话， 谨守你的约。

chapters.en: He will teach Your ordinances to Jacob and Your law to Israel; he will set incense before You and whole burnt offerings on Your altar.
chapters.zh: 他们要将你的典章教训雅各， 将你的律法教训以色列。 他们要把香焚在你面前， 把全牲的燔祭献在你的坛上。

chapters.en: Bless his substance, O LORD, and accept the work of his hands. Smash the loins of those who rise against him, and of his foes so they can rise no more.”
chapters.zh: 求耶和华降福在他的财物上， 悦纳他手里所办的事。 那些起来攻击他和恨恶他的人， 愿你刺透他们的腰， 使他们不得再起来。

chapters.en:
Concerning Benjamin he said:
“May the beloved of the LORD rest secure in Him; God shields him all day long, and upon His shoulders he rests.”
chapters.zh: 论便雅悯说： 耶和华所亲爱的必同耶和华安然居住； 耶和华终日遮蔽他，也住在他两肩之中。

chapters.en:
Concerning Joseph he said:
“May his land be blessed by the LORD with the precious dew from heaven above
and the deep waters that lie beneath,
chapters.zh: 论约瑟说： 愿他的地蒙耶和华赐福， 得天上的宝物、甘露， 以及地里所藏的泉水；

chapters.en: with the bountiful harvest from the sun and the abundant yield of the seasons,
chapters.zh: 得太阳所晒熟的美果， 月亮所养成的宝物；

chapters.en: with the best of the ancient mountains and the bounty of the everlasting hills,
chapters.zh: 得上古之山的至宝， 永世之岭的宝物；

chapters.en: with the choice gifts of the land and everything in it, and with the favor of Him who dwelt in the burning bush. May these rest on the head of Joseph and crown the brow of the prince of his brothers.
chapters.zh: 得地和其中所充满的宝物， 并住荆棘中上主的喜悦。 愿〔这些福〕都归于约瑟的头上， 归于那与弟兄迥别之人的顶上。

chapters.en: His majesty is like a firstborn bull, and his horns are like those of a wild ox. With them he will gore the nations, even to the ends of the earth. Such are the myriads of Ephraim, and such are the thousands of Manasseh.”
chapters.zh: 他为牛群中头生的，有威严； 他的角是野牛的角， 用以牴触万邦，直到地极。 这角是以法莲的万万， 玛拿西的千千。

chapters.en:
Concerning Zebulun he said:
“Rejoice, Zebulun, in your journeys, and Issachar, in your tents.
chapters.zh: 论西布伦说： 西布伦哪，你出外可以欢喜。 以萨迦啊，在你帐棚里可以快乐。

chapters.en: They will call the peoples to a mountain; there they will offer sacrifices of righteousness. For they will feast on the abundance of the seas and the hidden treasures of the sand.”
chapters.zh: 他们要将列邦召到山上， 在那里献公义的祭； 因为他们要吸取海里的丰富， 并沙中所藏的珍宝。

chapters.en:
Concerning Gad he said:
“Blessed is he who enlarges the domain of Gad! He lies down like a lion and tears off an arm or a head.
chapters.zh: 论迦得说： 使迦得扩张的应当称颂！ 迦得住如母狮； 他撕裂膀臂，连头顶也撕裂。

chapters.en:
He chose the best land for himself, because a ruler’s portion was reserved for him there. He came with the leaders of the people; he administered the LORD’s justice
and His ordinances for Israel.”
chapters.zh: 他为自己选择头一段地， 因在那里有设立律法者的分存留。 他与百姓的首领同来； 他施行耶和华的公义 和耶和华与以色列所立的典章。

chapters.en:
Concerning Dan he said:
“Dan is a lion’s cub, leaping out of Bashan.”
chapters.zh: 论但说： 但为小狮子， 从巴珊跳出来。

chapters.en:
Concerning Naphtali he said:
“Naphtali is abounding with favor, full of the blessing of the LORD; he shall take possession of the sea and the south.”
chapters.zh: 论拿弗他利说： 拿弗他利啊，你足沾恩惠， 满得耶和华的福， 可以得西方和南方为业。

chapters.en:
And concerning Asher he said:
“May Asher be the most blessed of sons; may he be the most favored among his brothers
and dip his foot in oil.
chapters.zh: 论亚设说： 愿亚设享受多子的福乐， 得他弟兄的喜悦， 可以把脚蘸在油中。

chapters.en: May the bolts of your gate be iron and bronze, and may your strength match your days.”
chapters.zh: 你的门闩〔注：或译：鞋〕是铜的，铁的。 你的日子如何，你的力量也必如何。

chapters.en:
“There is none like the God of Jeshurun, who rides the heavens to your aid,
and the clouds in His majesty.
chapters.zh: 耶书崙哪，没有能比上帝的。 他为帮助你，乘在天空， 显其威荣，驾行穹苍。

chapters.en: The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He drives out the enemy before you, giving the command, ‘Destroy him!’
chapters.zh: 永生的上帝是〔你的〕居所； 他永久的膀臂在你以下。 他在你前面撵出仇敌， 说：毁灭吧。

chapters.en: So Israel dwells securely; the fountain of Jacob lives untroubled in a land of grain and new wine, where even the heavens drip with dew.
chapters.zh: 以色列安然居住； 雅各的本源独居五谷新酒之地。 他的天也滴甘露。

chapters.en: Blessed are you, O Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD? He is the shield that protects you, the sword in which you boast. Your enemies will cower before you, and you shall trample their high places.”
chapters.zh: 以色列啊，你是有福的！ 谁像你这蒙耶和华所拯救的百姓呢？ 他是你的盾牌，帮助你， 是你威荣的刀剑。 你的仇敌必投降你； 你必踏在他们的高处。

chapters.en: Then Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, which faces Jericho. And the LORD showed him the whole land—from Gilead as far as Dan,
chapters.zh: 摩西从摩押平原登尼波山，上了那与耶利哥相对的毗斯迦山顶。耶和华把基列全地直到但，

chapters.en: all of Naphtali, the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, all the land of Judah as far as the Western Sea,
chapters.zh: 拿弗他利全地，以法莲、玛拿西的地，犹大全地直到西海，

chapters.en: the Negev, and the region from the Valley of Jericho (the City of Palms) all the way to Zoar.
chapters.zh: 南地和棕树城耶利哥的平原，直到琐珥，都指给他看。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to him, “This is the land that I swore to give Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob when I said, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’ I have let you see it with your own eyes, but you will not cross into it.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对他说：「这就是我向亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许之地，说：『我必将这地赐给你的后裔。』现在我使你眼睛看见了，你却不得过到那里去。」

chapters.en: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, as the LORD had said.
chapters.zh: 于是，耶和华的仆人摩西死在摩押地，正如耶和华所说的。

chapters.en: And He buried him in a valley in the land of Moab facing Beth-peor, and no one to this day knows the location of his grave.
chapters.zh: 耶和华将他埋葬在摩押地、伯‧毗珥对面的谷中，只是到今日没有人知道他的坟墓。

chapters.en: Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died, yet his eyes were not weak, and his vitality had not diminished.
chapters.zh: 摩西死的时候年一百二十岁；眼目没有昏花，精神没有衰败。

chapters.en: The Israelites grieved for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the time of weeping and mourning for Moses came to an end.
chapters.zh: 以色列人在摩押平原为摩西哀哭了三十日，为摩西居丧哀哭的日子就满了。

chapters.en: Now Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him. So the Israelites obeyed him and did as the LORD had commanded Moses.
chapters.zh: 嫩的儿子约书亚；因为摩西曾按手在他〔头〕上，就被智慧的灵充满，以色列人便听从他，照着耶和华吩咐摩西的行了。

chapters.en: Since that time, no prophet has risen in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face—
chapters.zh: 以后以色列中再没有兴起先知像摩西的。他是耶和华面对面所认识的。

chapters.en: no prophet who did all the signs and wonders that the LORD sent Moses to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh and to all his officials and all his land,
chapters.zh: 耶和华打发他在埃及地向法老和他的一切臣仆，并他的全地，行各样神迹奇事，

chapters.en: and no prophet who performed all the mighty acts of power and awesome deeds that Moses did in the sight of all Israel.
chapters.zh: 又在以色列众人眼前显大能的手，行一切大而可畏的事。

chapters.en: Now after the death of His servant Moses, the LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ assistant, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的仆人摩西死了以后，耶和华晓谕摩西的帮手，嫩的儿子约书亚，说：

chapters.en: “Moses My servant is dead. Now therefore arise, you and all these people, and cross over the Jordan into the land that I am giving to the children of Israel.
chapters.zh: 「我的仆人摩西死了。现在你要起来，和众百姓过这约旦河，往我所要赐给以色列人的地去。

chapters.en: I have given you every place where the sole of your foot will tread, just as I promised to Moses.
chapters.zh: 凡你们脚掌所踏之地，我都照着我所应许摩西的话赐给你们了。

chapters.en: Your territory shall extend from the wilderness and Lebanon to the great River Euphrates—all the land of the Hittites—and west as far as the Great Sea.
chapters.zh: 从旷野和这黎巴嫩，直到幼发拉底大河，赫人的全地，又到大海日落之处，都要作你们的境界。

chapters.en: No one shall stand against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so will I be with you; I will never leave you nor forsake you.
chapters.zh: 你平生的日子，必无一人能在你面前站立得住。我怎样与摩西同在，也必照样与你同在；我必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。

chapters.en: Be strong and courageous, for you shall give these people the inheritance of the land that I swore to their fathers I would give them.
chapters.zh: 你当刚强壮胆！因为你必使这百姓承受那地为业，就是我向他们列祖起誓应许赐给他们的地。

chapters.en: Above all, be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe all the law that My servant Moses commanded you. Do not turn from it to the right or to the left, so that you may prosper wherever you go.
chapters.zh: 只要刚强，大大壮胆，谨守遵行我仆人摩西所吩咐你的一切律法，不可偏离左右，使你无论往哪里去，都可以顺利。

chapters.en: This Book of the Law must not depart from your mouth; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. For then you will prosper and succeed in all you do.
chapters.zh: 这律法书不可离开你的口，总要昼夜思想，好使你谨守遵行这书上所写的一切话。如此，你的道路就可以亨通，凡事顺利。

chapters.en: Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”
chapters.zh: 我岂没有吩咐你吗？你当刚强壮胆！不要惧怕，也不要惊惶；因为你无论往哪里去，耶和华－你的上帝必与你同在。」

chapters.en: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people:
chapters.zh: 于是，约书亚吩咐百姓的官长说：

chapters.en: “Go through the camp and tell the people, ‘Prepare your provisions, for within three days you will cross the Jordan to go in and take possession of the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess.’”
chapters.zh: 「你们要走遍营中，吩咐百姓说：『当预备食物；因为三日之内你们要过这约旦河，进去得耶和华－你们上帝赐你们为业之地。』」

chapters.en: But to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said,
chapters.zh: 约书亚对吕便人、迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人说：

chapters.en: “Remember what Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you when he said, ‘The LORD your God will give you rest, and He will give you this land.’
chapters.zh: 「你们要追念耶和华的仆人摩西所吩咐你们的话说：『耶和华－你们的上帝使你们得享平安，也必将这地赐给你们。』

chapters.en: Your wives, your young children, and your livestock may remain in the land that Moses gave you on this side of the Jordan. But all your mighty men of valor must be armed for battle to cross over ahead of your brothers and help them,
chapters.zh: 你们的妻子、孩子，和牲畜都可以留在约旦河东、摩西所给你们的地；但你们中间一切大能的勇士都要带着兵器在你们的弟兄前面过去，帮助他们，

chapters.en: until the LORD gives them rest as He has done for you, and your brothers also possess the land that the LORD your God is giving them. Then you may return to the land of your inheritance and take possession of that which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the east side of the Jordan.”
chapters.zh: 等到耶和华使你们的弟兄像你们一样得享平安，并且得着耶和华－你们上帝所赐他们为业之地，那时才可以回你们所得之地，承受为业，就是耶和华的仆人摩西在约旦河东、向日出之地所给你们的。」

chapters.en: So they answered Joshua, “Everything you have commanded us we will do, and everywhere you send us we will go.
chapters.zh: 他们回答约书亚说：「你所吩咐我们行的，我们都必行；你所差遣我们去的，我们都必去。

chapters.en: Just as we obeyed Moses in all things, so we will obey you. And may the LORD your God be with you, as He was with Moses.
chapters.zh: 我们从前在一切事上怎样听从摩西，现在也必照样听从你；惟愿耶和华－你的上帝与你同在，像与摩西同在一样。

chapters.en: Anyone who rebels against your order and does not obey your words, all that you command him, will be put to death. Above all, be strong and courageous!”
chapters.zh: 无论什么人违背你的命令，不听从你所吩咐他的一切话，就必治死他。你只要刚强壮胆！」

chapters.en: Then Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim, saying, “Go, inspect the land, especially Jericho.” So they went and entered the house of a prostitute named Rahab and stayed there.
chapters.zh: 当下，嫩的儿子约书亚从什亭暗暗打发两个人作探子，吩咐说：「你们去窥探那地和耶利哥。」于是二人去了，来到一个妓女名叫喇合的家里，就在那里躺卧。

chapters.en: And it was reported to the king of Jericho: “Behold, some men of Israel have come here tonight to spy out the land.”
chapters.zh: 有人告诉耶利哥王说：「今夜有以色列人来到这里窥探此地。」

chapters.en: So the king of Jericho sent to Rahab and said, “Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house, for they have come to spy out the whole land.”
chapters.zh: 耶利哥王打发人去见喇合说：「那来到你这里、进了你家的人要交出来，因为他们来窥探全地。」

chapters.en: But the woman had taken the two men and hidden them. So she said, “Yes, the men did come to me, but I did not know where they had come from.
chapters.zh: 女人将二人隐藏，就回答说：「那人果然到我这里来；他们是哪里来的我却不知道。

chapters.en: At dusk, when the gate was about to close, the men went out, and I do not know which way they went. Pursue them quickly, and you may catch them!”
chapters.zh: 天黑、要关城门的时候，他们出去了，往哪里去我却不知道。你们快快地去追赶，就必追上。」

chapters.en: (But Rahab had taken them up to the roof and hidden them among the stalks of flax that she had laid out there.)
chapters.zh: （先是女人领二人上了房顶，将他们藏在那里所摆的麻诩中。）

chapters.en: So the king’s men set out in pursuit of the spies along the road to the fords of the Jordan, and as soon as they had gone out, the gate was shut.
chapters.zh: 那些人就往约旦河的渡口追赶他们去了。追赶他们的人一出去，城门就关了。

chapters.en: Before the spies lay down for the night, Rahab went up on the roof
chapters.zh: 二人还没有躺卧，女人就上房顶，到他们那里，

chapters.en: and said to them, “I know that the LORD has given you this land and that the fear of you has fallen on us, so that all who dwell in the land are melting in fear of you.
chapters.zh: 对他们说：「我知道耶和华已经把这地赐给你们，并且因你们的缘故我们都惊慌了。这地的一切居民在你们面前〔心〕都消化了；

chapters.en: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the waters of the Red Sea before you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to Sihon and Og, the two kings of the Amorites across the Jordan, whom you devoted to destruction.
chapters.zh: 因为我们听见你们出埃及的时候，耶和华怎样在你们前面使红海的水干了，并且你们怎样待约旦河东的两个亚摩利王西宏和噩，将他们尽行毁灭。

chapters.en: When we heard this, our hearts melted and everyone’s courage failed because of you, for the LORD your God is God in the heavens above and on the earth below.
chapters.zh: 我们一听见这些事，心就消化了。因你们的缘故，并无一人有胆气。耶和华－你们的上帝本是上天下地的上帝。

chapters.en: Now therefore, please swear to me by the LORD that you will indeed show kindness to my family, because I showed kindness to you. Give me a sure sign
chapters.zh: 现在我既是恩待你们，求你们指着耶和华向我起誓，也要恩待我父家，并给我一个实在的证据，

chapters.en: that you will spare the lives of my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them, and that you will deliver us from death.”
chapters.zh: 要救活我的父母、弟兄、姊妹，和一切属他们的，拯救我们性命不死。」

chapters.en: “Our lives for your lives!” the men agreed. “If you do not report our mission, we will show you kindness and faithfulness when the LORD gives us the land.”
chapters.zh: 二人对她说：「你若不洩漏我们这件事，我们情愿替你们死。耶和华将这地赐给我们的时候，我们必以慈爱诚实待你。」

chapters.en: Then Rahab let them down by a rope through the window, since the house where she lived was built into the wall of the city.
chapters.zh: 于是女人用绳子将二人从窗户里缒下去；因她的房子是在城墙边上，她也住在城墙上。

chapters.en: “Go to the hill country,” she said, “so that your pursuers will not find you. Hide yourselves there for three days until they have returned; then go on your way.”
chapters.zh: 她对他们说：「你们且往山上去，恐怕追赶的人碰见你们；要在那里隐藏三天，等追赶的人回来，然后才可以走你们的路。」

chapters.en: The men said to her, “We will not be bound by this oath you made us swear
chapters.zh: 二人对她说：「〔你要这样行〕。〔不然〕，你叫我们所起的誓就与我们无干了。

chapters.en: unless, when we enter the land, you have tied this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and unless you have brought your father and mother and brothers and all your family into your house.
chapters.zh: 我们来到这地的时候，你要把这条朱红线绳系在缒我们下去的窗户上，并要使你的父母、弟兄，和你父的全家都聚集在你家中。

chapters.en: If anyone goes out the door of your house into the street, his blood will be on his own head, and we will be innocent. But if a hand is laid on anyone with you in the house, his blood will be on our heads.
chapters.zh: 凡出了你家门往街上去的，他的罪〔注：原文是血〕必归到自己的头上，与我们无干了。凡在你家里的，若有人下手害他，流他血的罪就归到我们的头上。

chapters.en: And if you report our mission, we will be released from the oath you made us swear.”
chapters.zh: 你若洩漏我们这件事，你叫我们所起的誓就与我们无干了。」

chapters.en: “Let it be as you say,” she replied, and she sent them away. And when they had gone, she tied the scarlet cord in the window.
chapters.zh: 女人说：「照你们的话行吧！」于是打发他们去了，又把朱红线绳系在窗户上。

chapters.en: So the spies went out into the hill country and stayed there three days, until their pursuers had returned without finding them, having searched all along the road.
chapters.zh: 二人到山上，在那里住了三天，等着追赶的人回去了。追赶的人一路找他们，却找不着。

chapters.en: Then the two men started back, came down from the hill country, and crossed the river. So they came to Joshua son of Nun and reported all that had happened to them.
chapters.zh: 二人就下山回来，过了〔河〕，到嫩的儿子约书亚那里，向他述说所遭遇的一切事；

chapters.en: “The LORD has surely delivered the entire land into our hands,” they said to Joshua. “Indeed, all who dwell in the land are melting in fear of us.”
chapters.zh: 又对约书亚说：「耶和华果然将那全地交在我们手中；那地的一切居民在我们面前〔心〕都消化了。」

chapters.en: Early the next morning Joshua got up and left Shittim with all the Israelites. They went as far as the Jordan, where they camped before crossing over.
chapters.zh: 约书亚清早起来，和以色列众人都离开什亭，来到约旦河，就住在那里，等候过河。

chapters.en: After three days the officers went through the camp
chapters.zh: 过了三天，官长走遍营中，

chapters.en: and commanded the people: “When you see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God being carried by the Levitical priests, you are to set out from your positions and follow it.
chapters.zh: 吩咐百姓说：「你们看见耶和华－你们上帝的约柜，又见祭司利未人抬着，就要离开所住的地方，跟着约柜去。

chapters.en: But keep a distance of about two thousand cubits between yourselves and the ark. Do not go near it, so that you can see the way to go, since you have never traveled this way before.”
chapters.zh: 只是你们和约柜相离要量二千肘，不可与约柜相近，使你们知道所当走的路，因为这条路你们向来没有走过。」

chapters.en: Then Joshua told the people, “Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚吩咐百姓说：「你们要自洁，因为明天耶和华必在你们中间行奇事。」

chapters.en: And he said to the priests, “Take the ark of the covenant and go on ahead of the people.” So they carried the ark of the covenant and went ahead of them.
chapters.zh: 约书亚又吩咐祭司说：「你们抬起约柜，在百姓前头过去。」于是他们抬起约柜，在百姓前头走。

chapters.en: Now the LORD said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to exalt you in the sight of all Israel, so they may know that I am with you just as I was with Moses.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对约书亚说：「从今日起，我必使你在以色列众人眼前尊大，使他们知道我怎样与摩西同在，也必照样与你同在。

chapters.en: Command the priests carrying the ark of the covenant: ‘When you reach the edge of the waters, stand in the Jordan.’”
chapters.zh: 你要吩咐抬约柜的祭司说：『你们到了约旦河的水边上，就要在约旦河水里站住。』」

chapters.en: So Joshua told the Israelites, “Come here and listen to the words of the LORD your God.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚对以色列人说：「你们近前来，听耶和华－你们上帝的话。」

chapters.en: He continued, “This is how you will know that the living God is among you and that He will surely drive out before you the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites.
Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth will go ahead of you into the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 约书亚说：「看哪，普天下主的约柜必在你们前头过去，到约旦河里，因此你们就知道在你们中间有永生上帝；并且他必在你们面前赶出迦南人、赫人、希未人、比利洗人、革迦撒人、亚摩利人、耶布斯人。

chapters.en: Now choose twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one from each tribe.
chapters.zh: 你们现在要从以色列支派中拣选十二个人，每支派一人，

chapters.en: When the feet of the priests who carry the ark of the LORD—the Lord of all the earth—touch down in the waters of the Jordan, its flowing waters will be cut off and will stand up in a heap.”
chapters.zh: 等到抬普天下主耶和华〔约〕柜的祭司把脚站在约旦河水里，约旦河的水，就是从上往下流的水，必然断绝，立起成垒。」

chapters.en: So when the people broke camp to cross the Jordan, the priests carried the ark of the covenant ahead of them.
chapters.zh: 百姓离开帐棚要过约旦河的时候，抬约柜的祭司乃在百姓的前头。

chapters.en: Now the Jordan overflows its banks throughout the harvest season. But as soon as the priests carrying the ark reached the Jordan and their feet touched the water’s edge,
chapters.zh: 他们到了约旦河，脚一入水（原来约旦河水在收割的日子涨过两岸），

chapters.en: the flowing water stood still. It backed up as far upstream as Adam, a city in the area of Zarethan, while the water flowing toward the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea ) was completely cut off. So the people crossed over opposite Jericho.
chapters.zh: 那从上往下流的水便在极远之地、撒拉但旁的亚当城那里停住，立起成垒；那往亚拉巴的海，就是盐海，下流的水全然断绝。于是百姓在耶利哥的对面过去了。

chapters.en: The priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan, while all Israel crossed over the dry ground, until the entire nation had crossed the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 抬耶和华约柜的祭司在约旦河中的干地上站定，以色列众人都从干地上过去，直到国民尽都过了约旦河。

chapters.en: When the whole nation had finished crossing the Jordan, the LORD said to Joshua,
chapters.zh: 国民尽都过了约旦河，耶和华就对约书亚说：

chapters.en: “Choose twelve men from among the people, one from each tribe,
chapters.zh: 「你从民中要拣选十二个人，每支派一人，

chapters.en: and command them: ‘Take up for yourselves twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan where the priests were standing, carry them with you, and set them down in the place where you spend the night.’”
chapters.zh: 吩咐他们说：『你们从这里，从约旦河中、祭司脚站定的地方，取十二块石头带过去，放在你们今夜要住宿的地方。』」

chapters.en: So Joshua summoned the twelve men he had appointed from the Israelites, one from each tribe,
chapters.zh: 于是，约书亚将他从以色列人中所预备的那十二个人，每支派一人，都召了来。

chapters.en: and said to them, “Cross over before the ark of the LORD your God into the middle of the Jordan. Each of you is to take a stone upon his shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of Israel,
chapters.zh: 对他们说：「你们下约旦河中，过到耶和华－你们上帝的约柜前头，按着以色列人十二支派的数目，每人取一块石头扛在肩上。

chapters.en: to serve as a sign among you. In the future, when your children ask, ‘What do these stones mean to you?’
chapters.zh: 这些石头在你们中间可以作为证据。日后，你们的子孙问你们说：『这些石头是什么意思？』

chapters.en: you are to tell them, ‘The waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD. When it crossed the Jordan, the waters were cut off.’ Therefore these stones will be a memorial to the Israelites forever.”
chapters.zh: 你们就对他们说：『这是因为约旦河的水在耶和华的约柜前断绝；约柜过约旦河的时候，约旦河的水就断绝了。这些石头要作以色列人永远的纪念。』」

chapters.en: Thus the Israelites did as Joshua had commanded them. They took up twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, one for each tribe of Israel, just as the LORD had told Joshua; and they carried them to the camp, where they set them down.
chapters.zh: 以色列人就照约书亚所吩咐的，按着以色列人支派的数目，从约旦河中取了十二块石头，都遵耶和华所吩咐约书亚的行了。他们把石头带过去，到他们所住宿的地方，就放在那里。

chapters.en: Joshua also set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, in the place where the priests who carried the ark of the covenant stood. And the stones are there to this day.
chapters.zh: 约书亚另把十二块石头立在约旦河中，在抬约柜的祭司脚站立的地方；直到今日，那石头还在那里。

chapters.en: Now the priests who carried the ark remained standing in the middle of the Jordan until the people had completed everything the LORD had commanded Joshua to tell them, just as Moses had directed Joshua. The people hurried across,
chapters.zh: 抬〔约〕柜的祭司站在约旦河中，等到耶和华晓谕约书亚吩咐百姓的事办完了，是照摩西所吩咐约书亚的一切话。 于是百姓急速过去了。

chapters.en: and after everyone had finished crossing, the priests with the ark of the LORD crossed in the sight of the people.
chapters.zh: 众百姓尽都过了河，耶和华的〔约〕柜和祭司就在百姓面前过去。

chapters.en: The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over before the Israelites, armed for battle as Moses had instructed them.
chapters.zh: 吕便人、迦得人、玛拿西半支派的人都照摩西所吩咐他们的，带着兵器在以色列人前头过去。

chapters.en: About 40,000 troops armed for battle crossed over before the LORD into the plains of Jericho.
chapters.zh: 约有四万人都准备打仗，在耶和华面前过去，到耶利哥的平原，等候上阵。

chapters.en: On that day the LORD exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel, and they revered him all the days of his life, just as they had revered Moses.
chapters.zh: 当那日，耶和华使约书亚在以色列众人眼前尊大。在他平生的日子，百姓敬畏他，像从前敬畏摩西一样。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Joshua,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕约书亚说：

chapters.en: “Command the priests who carry the ark of the Testimony to come up from the Jordan.”
chapters.zh: 「你吩咐抬法柜的祭司从约旦河里上来。」

chapters.en: So Joshua commanded the priests, “Come up from the Jordan.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚就吩咐祭司说：「你们从约旦河里上来。」

chapters.en: When the priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD came up out of the Jordan and their feet touched the dry land, the waters of the Jordan returned to their course and overflowed all the banks as before.
chapters.zh: 抬耶和华约柜的祭司从约旦河里上来，脚掌刚落旱地，约旦河的水就流到原处，仍旧涨过两岸。

chapters.en: On the tenth day of the first month the people went up from the Jordan and camped at Gilgal on the eastern border of Jericho.
chapters.zh: 正月初十日，百姓从约旦河里上来，就在吉甲，在耶利哥的东边安营。

chapters.en: And there at Gilgal Joshua set up the twelve stones they had taken from the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 他们从约旦河中取来的那十二块石头，约书亚就立在吉甲，

chapters.en: Then Joshua said to the Israelites, “In the future, when your children ask their fathers, ‘What is the meaning of these stones?’
chapters.zh: 对以色列人说：「日后你们的子孙问他们的父亲说：『这些石头是什么意思？』

chapters.en: you are to tell them, ‘Israel crossed the Jordan on dry ground.’
chapters.zh: 你们就告诉他们说：『以色列人曾走干地过这约旦河；

chapters.en: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of the Jordan before you until you had crossed over, just as He did to the Red Sea, which He dried up before us until we had crossed over.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华－你们的上帝在你们前面使约旦河的水干了，等着你们过来，就如耶和华－你们的上帝从前在我们前面使红海干了，等着我们过来一样，

chapters.en: He did this so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the hand of the LORD is mighty, and so that you may always fear the LORD your God.”
chapters.zh: 要使地上万民都知道，耶和华的手大有能力，也要使你们永远敬畏耶和华－你们的上帝。』」

chapters.en: Now when all the Amorite kings west of the Jordan and all the Canaanite kings along the coast heard how the LORD had dried up the waters of the Jordan before the Israelites until they had crossed over, their hearts melted and their spirits failed for fear of the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 约旦河西亚摩利人的诸王和靠海迦南人的诸王，听见耶和华在以色列人前面使约旦河的水干了，等到我们过去，他们的心因以色列人的缘故就消化了，不再有胆气。

chapters.en: At that time the LORD said to Joshua, “Make flint knives and circumcise the sons of Israel once again. ”
chapters.zh: 那时，耶和华吩咐约书亚说：「你制造火石刀，第二次给以色列人行割礼。」

chapters.en: So Joshua made flint knives and circumcised the sons of Israel at Gibeath-haaraloth.
chapters.zh: 约书亚就制造了火石刀，在「除皮山」那里给以色列人行割礼。

chapters.en: Now this is why Joshua circumcised them: All those who came out of Egypt—all the men of war—had died on the journey in the wilderness after they had left Egypt.
chapters.zh: 约书亚行割礼的缘故，是因为从埃及出来的众民，就是一切能打仗的男丁，出了埃及以后，都死在旷野的路上。

chapters.en: Though all who had come out were circumcised, none of those born in the wilderness on the journey from Egypt had been circumcised.
chapters.zh: 因为出来的众民都受过割礼；惟独出埃及以后、在旷野的路上所生的众民都没有受过割礼。

chapters.en: For the Israelites had wandered in the wilderness forty years, until all the nation’s men of war who had come out of Egypt had died, since they did not obey the LORD. So the LORD vowed never to let them see the land He had sworn to their fathers to give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
chapters.zh: 以色列人在旷野走了四十年，等到国民，就是出埃及的兵丁，都消灭了，因为他们没有听从耶和华的话。耶和华曾向他们起誓，必不容他们看见耶和华向他们列祖起誓、应许赐给我们的地，就是流奶与蜜之地。

chapters.en: And He raised up their sons in their place, and these were the ones Joshua circumcised. Until this time they were still uncircumcised, since they had not been circumcised along the way.
chapters.zh: 他们的子孙，就是耶和华所兴起来接续他们的，都没有受过割礼；因为在路上没有给他们行割礼，约书亚这才给他们行了。

chapters.en: And after all the nation had been circumcised, they stayed there in the camp until they were healed.
chapters.zh: 国民都受完了割礼，就住在营中自己的地方，等到痊愈了。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you.” So that place has been called Gilgal to this day.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对约书亚说：「我今日将埃及的羞辱从你们身上滚去了。」因此，那地方名叫吉甲〔注：就是滚的意思〕，直到今日。

chapters.en: On the evening of the fourteenth day of the month, while the Israelites were camped at Gilgal on the plains of Jericho, they kept the Passover.
chapters.zh: 以色列人在吉甲安营。正月十四日晚上，在耶利哥的平原守逾越节。

chapters.en: The day after the Passover, on that very day, they ate unleavened bread and roasted grain from the produce of the land.
chapters.zh: 逾越节的次日，他们就吃了那地的出产；正当那日吃无酵饼和烘的谷。

chapters.en: And the day after they had eaten from the produce of the land, the manna ceased. There was no more manna for the Israelites, so that year they began to eat the crops of the land of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 他们吃了那地的出产，第二日吗哪就止住了，以色列人也不再有吗哪了。那一年，他们却吃迦南地的出产。

chapters.en: Now when Joshua was near Jericho, he looked up and saw a man standing in front of him with a drawn sword in His hand. Joshua approached Him and asked, “Are You for us or for our enemies?”
chapters.zh: 约书亚靠近耶利哥的时候，举目观看，不料，有一个人手里有拔出来的刀，对面站立。约书亚到他那里，问他说：「你是帮助我们呢，是帮助我们敌人呢？」

chapters.en:
“Neither,” He replied. “I have now come as Commander of the LORD’s army.”
Then Joshua fell facedown in reverence and asked Him, “What does my Lord have to say to His servant?”
chapters.zh: 他回答说：「不是的，我来是要作耶和华军队的元帅。」约书亚就俯伏在地下拜，说：「我主有什么话吩咐仆人。」

chapters.en:
The Commander of the LORD’s army replied, “Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy.”
And Joshua did so.
chapters.zh: 耶和华军队的元帅对约书亚说：「把你脚上的鞋脱下来，因为你所站的地方是圣的。」约书亚就照着行了。

chapters.en: Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the Israelites. No one went out and no one came in.
chapters.zh: 耶利哥的城门因以色列人就关得严紧，无人出入。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Joshua, “Behold, I have delivered Jericho into your hand, along with its king and its mighty men of valor.
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕约书亚说：「看哪，我已经把耶利哥和耶利哥的王，并大能的勇士，都交在你手中。

chapters.en: March around the city with all the men of war, circling the city one time. Do this for six days.
chapters.zh: 你们的一切兵丁要围绕这城，〔一日〕围绕一次，六日都要这样行。

chapters.en: Have seven priests carry seven rams’ horns in front of the ark. Then on the seventh day, march around the city seven times, while the priests blow the horns.
chapters.zh: 七个祭司要拿七个羊角走在〔约〕柜前。到第七日，你们要绕城七次，祭司也要吹角。

chapters.en: And when there is a long blast of the ram’s horn and you hear its sound, have all the people give a mighty shout. Then the wall of the city will collapse and all your people will charge straight into the city. ”
chapters.zh: 他们吹的角声拖长，你们听见角声，众百姓要大声呼喊，城墙就必塌陷，各人都要往前直上。」

chapters.en: So Joshua son of Nun summoned the priests and said, “Take up the ark of the covenant and have seven priests carry seven rams’ horns in front of the ark of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 嫩的儿子约书亚召了祭司来，吩咐他们说：「你们抬起约柜来，要有七个祭司拿七个羊角走在耶和华的〔约〕柜前」；

chapters.en: And he told the people, “Advance and march around the city, with the armed troops going ahead of the ark of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 又对百姓说：「你们前去绕城，带兵器的要走在耶和华的〔约〕柜前。」

chapters.en: After Joshua had spoken to the people, seven priests carrying seven rams’ horns before the LORD advanced and blew the horns, and the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.
chapters.zh: 约书亚对百姓说完了话，七个祭司拿七个羊角走在耶和华面前吹角；耶和华的约柜在他们后面跟随。

chapters.en: While the horns continued to sound, the armed troops marched ahead of the priests who blew the horns, and the rear guard followed the ark.
chapters.zh: 带兵器的走在吹角的祭司前面，后队随着〔约〕柜行。〔祭司〕一面走一面吹。

chapters.en: But Joshua had commanded the people: “Do not give a battle cry or let your voice be heard; do not let one word come out of your mouth until the day I tell you to shout. Then you are to shout!”
chapters.zh: 约书亚吩咐百姓说：「你们不可呼喊，不可出声，连一句话也不可出你们的口，等到我吩咐你们呼喊的日子，那时才可以呼喊。」

chapters.en: So he had the ark of the LORD carried around the city, circling it once. And the people returned to the camp and spent the night there.
chapters.zh: 这样，他使耶和华的〔约〕柜绕城，把城绕了一次；众人回到营里，就在营里住宿。

chapters.en: Joshua got up early the next morning, and the priests took the ark of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 约书亚清早起来，祭司又抬起耶和华的〔约〕柜。

chapters.en: And the seven priests carrying seven rams’ horns kept marching ahead of the ark of the LORD and blowing the horns. The armed troops went in front of them and the rear guard followed the ark of the LORD, while the horns kept sounding.
chapters.zh: 七个祭司拿七个羊角在耶和华的〔约〕柜前，时常行走吹角；带兵器的在他们前面走，后队随着耶和华的〔约〕柜行。〔祭司〕一面走一面吹。

chapters.en: So on the second day they marched around the city once and returned to the camp. They did this for six days.
chapters.zh: 第二日，众人把城绕了一次，就回营里去。六日都是这样行。

chapters.en: Then on the seventh day, they got up at dawn and marched around the city seven times in the same manner. That was the only day they circled the city seven times.
chapters.zh: 第七日清早，黎明的时候，他们起来，照样绕城七次；惟独这日把城绕了七次。

chapters.en: After the seventh time around, the priests blew the horns, and Joshua commanded the people, “Shout! For the LORD has given you the city!
chapters.zh: 到了第七次，祭司吹角的时候，约书亚吩咐百姓说：「呼喊吧，因为耶和华已经把城交给你们了！

chapters.en: Now the city and everything in it must be devoted to the LORD for destruction. Only Rahab the prostitute and all those with her in her house will live, because she hid the spies we sent.
chapters.zh: 这城和其中所有的都要在耶和华面前毁灭；只有妓女喇合与她家中所有的可以存活，因为她隐藏了我们所打发的使者。

chapters.en: But keep away from the things devoted to destruction, lest you yourself be set apart for destruction. If you take any of these, you will set apart the camp of Israel for destruction and bring disaster upon it.
chapters.zh: 至于你们，务要谨慎，不可取那当灭的物，恐怕你们取了那当灭的物就连累以色列的全营，使全营受咒诅。

chapters.en: For all the silver and gold and all the articles of bronze and iron are holy to the LORD; they must go into His treasury.”
chapters.zh: 惟有金子、银子，和铜铁的器皿都要归耶和华为圣，必入耶和华的库中。」

chapters.en: So when the rams’ horns sounded, the people shouted. When they heard the blast of the horn, the people gave a great shout, and the wall collapsed. Then all the people charged straight into the city and captured it.
chapters.zh: 于是百姓呼喊，〔祭司〕也吹角。百姓听见角声，便大声呼喊，城墙就塌陷，百姓便上去进城，各人往前直上，将城夺取；

chapters.en: With the edge of the sword they devoted to destruction everything in the city—man and woman, young and old, oxen, sheep, and donkeys.
chapters.zh: 又将城中所有的，不拘男女老少，牛羊和驴，都用刀杀尽。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Joshua told the two men who had spied out the land, “Go into the house of the prostitute and bring out the woman and all who are with her, just as you promised her.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚吩咐窥探地的两个人说：「你们进那妓女的家，照着你们向她所起的誓，将那女人和她所有的都从那里带出来。」

chapters.en: So the young spies went in and brought out Rahab, her father and mother and brothers, and all who belonged to her. They brought out her whole family and settled them outside the camp of Israel.
chapters.zh: 当探子的两个少年人就进去，将喇合与她的父母、弟兄，和她所有的，并她一切的亲眷，都带出来，安置在以色列的营外。

chapters.en: Then the Israelites burned up the city and everything in it. However, they put the silver and gold and articles of bronze and iron into the treasury of the LORD’s house.
chapters.zh: 众人就用火将城和其中所有的焚烧了；惟有金子、银子，和铜铁的器皿都放在耶和华殿的库中。

chapters.en: And Joshua spared Rahab the prostitute, with her father’s household and all who belonged to her, because she hid the men Joshua had sent to spy out Jericho. So she has lived among the Israelites to this day.
chapters.zh: 约书亚却把妓女喇合与她父家，并她所有的，都救活了；因为她隐藏了约书亚所打发窥探耶利哥的使者，她就住在以色列中，直到今日。

chapters.en:
At that time Joshua invoked this solemn oath:
“Cursed before the LORD is the man who rises up and rebuilds this city, Jericho; at the cost of his firstborn he will lay its foundations; at the cost of his youngest he will set up its gates.”
chapters.zh: 当时，约书亚叫众人起誓说：「有兴起重修这耶利哥城的人，当在耶和华面前受咒诅。 他立根基的时候，必丧长子， 安门的时候，必丧幼子。」

chapters.en: So the LORD was with Joshua, and his fame spread throughout the land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华与约书亚同在，约书亚的声名传扬遍地。

chapters.en: The Israelites, however, acted unfaithfully regarding the things devoted to destruction. Achan son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of what was set apart. So the anger of the LORD burned against the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 以色列人在当灭的物上犯了罪；因为犹大支派中，谢拉的曾孙，撒底的孙子，迦米的儿子亚干取了当灭的物；耶和华的怒气就向以色列人发作。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is near Beth-aven to the east of Bethel, and told them, “Go up and spy out the land.” So the men went up and spied out Ai.
chapters.zh: 当下，约书亚从耶利哥打发人往伯特利东边、靠近伯‧亚文的艾城去，吩咐他们说：「你们上去窥探那地。」他们就上去窥探艾城。

chapters.en: On returning to Joshua, they reported, “There is no need to send all the people; two or three thousand men are enough to go up and attack Ai. Since the people of Ai are so few, you need not wear out all our people there.”
chapters.zh: 他们回到约书亚那里，对他说：「众民不必都上去，只要二三千人上去就能攻取艾城；不必劳累众民都去，因为那里的人少。」

chapters.en: So about three thousand men went up, but they fled before the men of Ai.
chapters.zh: 于是民中约有三千人上那里去，竟在艾城人面前逃跑了。

chapters.en: And the men of Ai struck down about thirty-six of them, chasing them from the gate as far as the quarries and striking them down on the slopes. So the hearts of the people melted and became like water.
chapters.zh: 艾城的人击杀了他们三十六人，从城门前追赶他们，直到示巴琳，在下坡杀败他们；众民的心就消化如水。

chapters.en: Then Joshua tore his clothes and fell facedown before the ark of the LORD until evening, as did the elders of Israel; and they all sprinkled dust on their heads.
chapters.zh: 约书亚便撕裂衣服；他和以色列的长老把灰撒在头上，在耶和华的〔约〕柜前俯伏在地，直到晚上。

chapters.en: “O, Lord GOD,” Joshua said, “why did You ever bring this people across the Jordan to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to be destroyed? If only we had been content to stay on the other side of the Jordan!
chapters.zh: 约书亚说：「哀哉！主耶和华啊，你为什么竟领这百姓过约旦河，将我们交在亚摩利人的手中，使我们灭亡呢？我们不如住在约旦河那边倒好。

chapters.en: O Lord, what can I say, now that Israel has turned its back and run from its enemies?
chapters.zh: 主啊，以色列人既在仇敌面前转背〔逃跑〕，我还有什么可说的呢？

chapters.en: When the Canaanites and all who live in the land hear about this, they will surround us and wipe out our name from the earth. Then what will You do for Your great name?”
chapters.zh: 迦南人和这地一切的居民听见了就必围困我们，将我们的名从地上除灭。那时你为你的大名要怎样行呢？」

chapters.en: But the LORD said to Joshua, “Stand up! Why have you fallen on your face?
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐约书亚说：「起来！你为何这样俯伏在地呢？
