chapters.en: Israel has sinned; they have transgressed My covenant that I commanded them, and they have taken some of what was devoted to destruction. Indeed, they have stolen and lied, and they have put these things with their own possessions.
chapters.zh: 以色列人犯了罪，违背了我所吩咐他们的约，取了当灭的物；又偷窃，又行诡诈，又把那当灭的放在他们的家具里。

chapters.en: This is why the Israelites cannot stand against their enemies. They will turn their backs and run from their enemies, because they themselves have been set apart for destruction. I will no longer be with you unless you remove from among you whatever is devoted to destruction.
chapters.zh: 因此，以色列人在仇敌面前站立不住。他们在仇敌面前转背〔逃跑〕，是因成了被咒诅的；你们若不把当灭的物从你们中间除掉，我就不再与你们同在了。

chapters.en: Get up and consecrate the people, saying, ‘Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Among you, O Israel, there are things devoted to destruction. You cannot stand against your enemies until you remove them.
chapters.zh: 你起来，叫百姓自洁，对他们说：『你们要自洁，预备明天，因为耶和华－以色列的上帝这样说：以色列啊，你们中间有当灭的物，你们若不除掉，在仇敌面前必站立不住！』

chapters.en: In the morning you must present yourselves tribe by tribe. The tribe that the LORD selects shall come forward clan by clan, and the clan that the LORD selects shall come forward family by family, and the family that the LORD selects shall come forward man by man.
chapters.zh: 到了早晨，你们要按着支派近前来；耶和华所取的支派，要按着宗族近前来；耶和华所取的宗族，要按着家室近前来；耶和华所取的家室，要按着人丁，一个一个地近前来。

chapters.en: The one who is caught with the things devoted to destruction must be burned, along with all that belongs to him, because he has transgressed the covenant of the LORD and committed an outrage in Israel.’”
chapters.zh: 被取的人有当灭的物在他那里，他和他所有的必被火焚烧；因他违背了耶和华的约，又因他在以色列中行了愚妄的事。」

chapters.en: So Joshua arose early the next morning and had Israel come forward tribe by tribe, and the tribe of Judah was selected.
chapters.zh: 于是，约书亚清早起来，使以色列人按着支派近前来，取出来的是犹大支派；

chapters.en: He had the clans of Judah come forward, and the clan of the Zerahites was selected. He had the clan of the Zerahites come forward, and the family of Zabdi was selected.
chapters.zh: 使犹大支派〔注：原文是宗族〕近前来，就取了谢拉的宗族；使谢拉的宗族，按着〔家室〕人丁，一个一个地近前来，取出来的是撒底；

chapters.en: And he had the family of Zabdi come forward man by man, and Achan son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was selected.
chapters.zh: 使撒底的家室，按着人丁，一个一个地近前来，就取出犹大支派的人谢拉的曾孙，撒底的孙子，迦米的儿子亚干。

chapters.en: So Joshua said to Achan, “My son, give glory to the LORD, the God of Israel, and make a confession to Him. I urge you to tell me what you have done; do not hide it from me.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚对亚干说：「我儿，我劝你将荣耀归给耶和华－以色列的上帝，在他面前认罪，将你所做的事告诉我，不要向我隐瞒。」

chapters.en: “It is true,” Achan replied, “I have sinned against the LORD, the God of Israel. This is what I did:
chapters.zh: 亚干回答约书亚说：「我实在得罪了耶和华－以色列的上帝。我所做的事如此如此：

chapters.en: When I saw among the spoils a beautiful cloak from Shinar, two hundred shekels of silver, and a bar of gold weighing fifty shekels, I coveted them and took them. They are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath.”
chapters.zh: 我在所夺的财物中看见一件美好的示拿衣服，二百舍客勒银子，一条金子重五十舍客勒，我就贪爱这些物件，便拿去了。现今藏在我帐棚内的地里，银子在衣服底下。」

chapters.en: So Joshua sent messengers who ran to the tent, and there it all was, hidden in his tent, with the silver underneath.
chapters.zh: 约书亚就打发人跑到亚干的帐棚里。那件衣服果然藏在他帐棚内，银子在底下。

chapters.en: They took the things from inside the tent, brought them to Joshua and all the Israelites, and spread them out before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们就从帐棚里取出来，拿到约书亚和以色列众人那里，放在耶和华面前。

chapters.en: Then Joshua, together with all Israel, took Achan son of Zerah, the silver, the cloak, the bar of gold, his sons and daughters, his oxen and donkeys and sheep, his tent, and everything else he owned, and brought them to the Valley of Achor.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人把谢拉的曾孙亚干和那银子、那件衣服、那条金子，并亚干的儿女、牛、驴、羊、帐棚，以及他所有的，都带到亚割谷去。

chapters.en: “Why have you brought this trouble upon us?” said Joshua. “Today the LORD will bring trouble upon you!” And all Israel stoned him to death. Then they stoned the others and burned their bodies.
chapters.zh: 约书亚说：「你为什么连累我们呢？今日耶和华必叫你受连累。」于是以色列众人用石头打死他，将石头扔在其上，又用火焚烧他所有的〔注：原文是他们〕。

chapters.en: And they heaped over Achan a large pile of rocks that remains to this day. So the LORD turned from His burning anger. Therefore that place is called the Valley of Achor to this day.
chapters.zh: 众人在亚干身上堆成一大堆石头，直存到今日。于是耶和华转意，不发他的烈怒。因此那地方名叫亚割谷〔注：就是连累的意思〕，直到今日。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid or discouraged. Take the whole army with you, and go up and attack Ai. See, I have delivered into your hand the king of Ai, his people, his city, and his land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对约书亚说：「不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。你起来，率领一切兵丁上艾城去，我已经把艾城的王和他的民、他的城，并他的地，都交在你手里。

chapters.en: And you shall do to Ai and its king as you did to Jericho and its king, except that you may carry off their plunder and livestock for yourselves. Set up an ambush behind the city.”
chapters.zh: 你怎样待耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也当照样待艾城和艾城的王。只是城内所夺的财物和牲畜，你们可以取为自己的掠物。你要在城后设下伏兵。」

chapters.en: So Joshua and the whole army set out to attack Ai. Joshua chose 30,000 mighty men of valor and sent them out at night
chapters.zh: 于是，约书亚和一切兵丁都起来，要上艾城去。约书亚选了三万大能的勇士，夜间打发他们前往，

chapters.en: with these orders: “Pay attention. You are to lie in ambush behind the city, not too far from it. All of you must be ready.
chapters.zh: 吩咐他们说：「你们要在城后埋伏，不可离城太远，都要各自准备。

chapters.en: Then I and all the troops with me will advance on the city. When they come out against us as they did the first time, we will flee from them.
chapters.zh: 我与我所带领的众民要向城前往。城里的人像初次出来攻击我们的时候，我们就在他们面前逃跑，

chapters.en: They will pursue us until we have drawn them away from the city, for they will say, ‘The Israelites are running away from us as they did before.’ So as we flee from them,
chapters.zh: 他们必出来追赶我们，直到我们引诱他们离开城；因为他们必说：『这些人像初次在我们面前逃跑。』所以我们要在他们面前逃跑，

chapters.en: you are to rise from the ambush and seize the city, for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.
chapters.zh: 你们就从埋伏的地方起来，夺取那城，因为耶和华－你们的上帝必把城交在你们手里。

chapters.en: And when you have taken the city, set it on fire. Do as the LORD has commanded! See, I have given you orders.”
chapters.zh: 你们夺了城以后，就放火烧城，要照耶和华的话行。这是我吩咐你们的。」

chapters.en: So Joshua sent them out, and they went to the place of ambush and lay in wait between Bethel and Ai, to the west of Ai. But Joshua spent that night among the people.
chapters.zh: 约书亚打发他们前往，他们就上埋伏的地方去，住在伯特利和艾城的中间，就是在艾城的西边。这夜约书亚却在民中住宿。

chapters.en: Joshua got up early the next morning and mobilized his men, and he and the elders of Israel marched before them up to Ai.
chapters.zh: 约书亚清早起来，点齐百姓，他和以色列的长老在百姓前面上艾城去。

chapters.en: Then all the troops who were with him marched up and approached the city. They arrived in front of Ai and camped to the north of it, with the valley between them and the city.
chapters.zh: 众民，就是他所带领的兵丁，都上去，向前直往，来到城前，在艾城北边安营。在约书亚和艾城中间有一山谷。

chapters.en: Now Joshua had taken about five thousand men and set up an ambush between Bethel and Ai, to the west of the city.
chapters.zh: 他挑了约有五千人，使他们埋伏在伯特利和艾城的中间，就是在艾城的西边，

chapters.en: So the forces were stationed with the main camp to the north of the city and the rear guard to the west of the city. And that night Joshua went into the valley.
chapters.zh: 于是安置了百姓，就是城北的全军和城西的伏兵。这夜约书亚进入山谷之中。

chapters.en: When the king of Ai saw the Israelites, he hurried out early in the morning with the men of the city to engage them in battle at an appointed place overlooking the Arabah. But he did not know that an ambush had been set up against him behind the city.
chapters.zh: 艾城的王看见〔这景况〕，就和全城的人，清早急忙起来，按所定的时候，出到亚拉巴前，要与以色列人交战；王却不知道在城后有伏兵。

chapters.en: Joshua and all Israel let themselves be beaten back before them, and they fled toward the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人在他们面前装败，往那通旷野的路逃跑。

chapters.en: Then all the men of Ai were summoned to pursue them, and they followed Joshua and were drawn away from the city.
chapters.zh: 城内的众民都被招聚，追赶他们；艾城人追赶的时候，就被引诱离开城。

chapters.en: Not a man was left in Ai or Bethel who did not go out after Israel, leaving the city wide open while they pursued Israel.
chapters.zh: 艾城和伯特利城没有一人不出来追赶以色列人的，撇了敞开的城门，去追赶以色列人。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Hold out your battle lance toward Ai, for into your hand I will deliver the city.” So Joshua held out his battle lance toward Ai,
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐约书亚说：「你向艾城伸出手里的短枪，因为我要将城交在你手里。」约书亚就向城伸出手里的短枪。

chapters.en: and as soon as he did so, the men in ambush rose quickly from their position. They rushed forward, entered the city, captured it, and immediately set it on fire.
chapters.zh: 他一伸手，伏兵就从埋伏的地方急忙起来，夺了城，跑进城去，放火焚烧。

chapters.en: When the men of Ai turned and looked back, the smoke of the city was rising into the sky. They could not escape in any direction, and the troops who had fled to the wilderness now turned against their pursuers.
chapters.zh: 艾城的人回头一看，不料，城中烟气冲天，他们就无力向左向右逃跑。那往旷野逃跑的百姓便转身攻击追赶他们的人。

chapters.en: When Joshua and all Israel saw that the men in ambush had captured the city and that smoke was rising from it, they turned around and struck down the men of Ai.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人见伏兵已经夺了城，城中烟气飞腾，就转身回去，击杀艾城的人。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, those in the ambush came out of the city against them, and the men of Ai were trapped between the Israelite forces on both sides. So Israel struck them down until no survivor or fugitive remained.
chapters.zh: 伏兵也出城迎击艾城人，艾城人就困在以色列人中间，前后都是以色列人。于是以色列人击杀他们，没有留下一个，也没有一个逃脱的，

chapters.en: But they took the king of Ai alive and brought him to Joshua.
chapters.zh: 生擒了艾城的王，将他解到约书亚那里。

chapters.en: When Israel had finished killing all the men of Ai who had pursued them into the field and wilderness, and when every last one of them had fallen by the sword, all the Israelites returned to Ai and put it to the sword as well.
chapters.zh: 以色列人在田间和旷野杀尽所追赶一切艾城的居民。艾城人倒在刀下，直到灭尽；以色列众人就回到艾城，用刀杀了城中的人。

chapters.en: A total of twelve thousand men and women fell that day—all the people of Ai.
chapters.zh: 当日杀毙的人，连男带女共有一万二千，就是艾城所有的人。

chapters.en: Joshua did not draw back the hand that held his battle lance until he had devoted to destruction all who lived in Ai.
chapters.zh: 约书亚没有收回手里所伸出来的短枪，直到把艾城的一切居民尽行杀灭。

chapters.en: Israel took for themselves only the cattle and plunder of that city, as the LORD had commanded Joshua.
chapters.zh: 惟独城中的牲畜和财物，以色列人都取为自己的掠物，是照耶和华所吩咐约书亚的话。

chapters.en: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a permanent heap of ruins, a desolation to this day.
chapters.zh: 约书亚将艾城焚烧，使城永为高堆、荒场，直到今日；

chapters.en: He hung the king of Ai on a tree until evening, and at sunset Joshua commanded that they take down the body from the tree and throw it down at the entrance of the city gate. And over it they raised a large pile of rocks, which remains to this day.
chapters.zh: 又将艾城王挂在树上，直到晚上。日落的时候，约书亚吩咐人把尸首从树上取下来，丢在城门口，在尸首上堆成一大堆石头，直存到今日。

chapters.en: At that time Joshua built an altar on Mount Ebal to the LORD, the God of Israel,
chapters.zh: 那时，约书亚在以巴路山上为耶和华－以色列的上帝筑一座坛，

chapters.en: just as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded the Israelites. He built it according to what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses: “an altar of uncut stones on which no iron tool has been used.” And on it they offered burnt offerings to the LORD, and they sacrificed peace offerings.
chapters.zh: 是用没有动过铁器的整石头筑的，照着耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐以色列人的话，正如摩西律法书上所写的。众人在这坛上给耶和华奉献燔祭和平安祭。

chapters.en: And there in the presence of the Israelites, Joshua inscribed on the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he had written.
chapters.zh: 约书亚在那里，当着以色列人面前，将摩西所写的律法抄写在石头上。

chapters.en: All Israel, foreigners and citizens alike, with their elders, officers, and judges, stood on both sides of the ark of the covenant of the LORD facing the Levitical priests who carried it. Half of the people stood in front of Mount Gerizim and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded earlier, to bless the people of Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列众人，无论是本地人、是寄居的，和长老、官长，并审判官，都站在〔约〕柜两旁，在抬耶和华约柜的祭司利未人面前，一半对着基利心山，一半对着以巴路山，为以色列民祝福，正如耶和华仆人摩西先前所吩咐的。

chapters.en: Afterward, Joshua read aloud all the words of the law—the blessings and the curses—according to all that is written in the Book of the Law.
chapters.zh: 随后，约书亚将律法上祝福、咒诅的话，照着律法书上一切所写的，都宣读了一遍。

chapters.en: There was not a word of all that Moses had commanded that Joshua failed to read before the whole assembly of Israel, including the women, the little ones, and the foreigners who lived among them.
chapters.zh: 摩西所吩咐的一切话，约书亚在以色列全会众和妇女、孩子，并他们中间寄居的外人面前，没有一句不宣读的。

chapters.en: Now when news of this reached all the kings west of the Jordan—those in the hill country, the foothills, and all along the coast of the Great Sea toward Lebanon (the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites)—
chapters.zh: 约旦河西，住山地、高原，并对着黎巴嫩〔山〕沿大海一带的诸王，就是赫人、亚摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的诸王，听见这事，

chapters.en: they came together to wage war against Joshua and Israel.
chapters.zh: 就都聚集，同心合意地要与约书亚和以色列人争战。

chapters.en: But the people of Gibeon, having heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai,
chapters.zh: 基遍的居民听见约书亚向耶利哥和艾城所行的事，

chapters.en: acted deceptively and set out as envoys, carrying on their donkeys worn-out sacks and old wineskins, cracked and mended.
chapters.zh: 就设诡计，假充使者，拿旧口袋和破裂缝补的旧皮酒袋驮在驴上，

chapters.en: They put worn, patched sandals on their feet and threadbare clothing on their bodies, and their whole supply of bread was dry and moldy.
chapters.zh: 将补过的旧鞋穿在脚上，把旧衣服穿在身上；他们所带的饼都是干的，长了霉了。

chapters.en: They went to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal and said to him and the men of Israel, “We have come from a distant land; please make a treaty with us.”
chapters.zh: 他们到吉甲营中见约书亚，对他和以色列人说：「我们是从远方来的，现在求你与我们立约。」

chapters.en: But the men of Israel said to the Hivites, “Perhaps you dwell near us. How can we make a treaty with you?”
chapters.zh: 以色列人对这些希未人说：「只怕你们是住在我们中间的；若是这样，怎能和你们立约呢？」

chapters.en:
“We are your servants,” they said to Joshua.
Then Joshua asked them, “Who are you and where have you come from?”
chapters.zh: 他们对约书亚说：「我们是你的仆人。」约书亚问他们说：「你们是什么人？是从哪里来的？」

chapters.en: “Your servants have come from a very distant land,” they replied, “because of the fame of the LORD your God. For we have heard the reports about Him: all that He did in Egypt,
chapters.zh: 他们回答说：「仆人从极远之地而来，是因听见耶和华－你上帝的名声和他在埃及所行的一切事，

chapters.en: and all that He did to the two kings of the Amorites beyond the Jordan—Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth.
chapters.zh: 并他向约旦河东的两个亚摩利王，就是希实本王西宏和在亚斯他录的巴珊王噩一切所行的事。

chapters.en: So the elders and inhabitants of our land told us, ‘Take provisions for your journey; go to meet them and say to them: We are your servants. Please make a treaty with us.’
chapters.zh: 我们的长老和我们那地的一切居民对我们说：『你们手里要带着路上用的食物去迎接以色列人，对他们说：我们是你们的仆人；现在求你们与我们立约。』

chapters.en: This bread of ours was warm when we packed it at home on the day we left to come to you. But look, it is now dry and moldy.
chapters.zh: 我们出来要往你们这里来的日子，从家里带出来的这饼还是热的；看哪，现在都干了，长了霉了。

chapters.en: These wineskins were new when we filled them, but look, they are cracked. And these clothes and sandals are worn out from our very long journey.”
chapters.zh: 这皮酒袋，我们盛酒的时候还是新的；看哪，现在已经破裂。我们这衣服和鞋，因为道路甚远，也都穿旧了。」

chapters.en: Then the men of Israel sampled their provisions but did not seek the counsel of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以色列人受了他们些食物，并没有求问耶和华。

chapters.en: And Joshua made a treaty of peace with them to let them live, and the leaders of the congregation swore an oath to them.
chapters.zh: 于是约书亚与他们讲和，与他们立约，容他们活着；会众的首领也向他们起誓。

chapters.en: Three days after they had made the treaty with the Gibeonites, the Israelites learned that they were neighbors, living among them.
chapters.zh: 以色列人与他们立约之后，过了三天才听见他们是近邻，住在以色列人中间的。

chapters.en: So the Israelites set out and on the third day arrived at their cities—Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath-jearim.
chapters.zh: 以色列人起行，第三天到了他们的城邑，就是基遍、基非拉、比录、基列‧耶琳。

chapters.en: But the Israelites did not attack them, because the leaders of the congregation had sworn an oath to them by the LORD, the God of Israel. And the whole congregation grumbled against the leaders.
chapters.zh: 因为会众的首领已经指着耶和华－以色列的上帝向他们起誓，所以以色列人不击杀他们；全会众就向首领发怨言。

chapters.en: All the leaders answered, “We have sworn an oath to them by the LORD, the God of Israel, and now we cannot touch them.
chapters.zh: 众首领对全会众说：「我们已经指着耶和华－以色列的上帝向他们起誓，现在我们不能害他们。

chapters.en: This is how we will treat them: We will let them live, so that no wrath will fall on us because of the oath we swore to them.”
chapters.zh: 我们要如此待他们，容他们活着，免得有忿怒因我们所起的誓临到我们身上。」

chapters.en: They continued, “Let them live, but let them be woodcutters and water carriers for the whole congregation.” So the leaders kept their promise.
chapters.zh: 首领又对会众说：「要容他们活着。」于是他们为全会众作了劈柴挑水的人，正如首领对他们所说的话。

chapters.en: Then Joshua summoned the Gibeonites and said, “Why did you deceive us by telling us you live far away from us, when in fact you live among us?
chapters.zh: 约书亚召了他们来，对他们说：「为什么欺哄我们说『我们离你们甚远』呢？其实你们是住在我们中间。

chapters.en: Now therefore you are under a curse and will perpetually serve as woodcutters and water carriers for the house of my God.”
chapters.zh: 现在你们是被咒诅的！你们中间的人必断不了作奴仆，为我上帝的殿作劈柴挑水的人。」

chapters.en: The Gibeonites answered, “Your servants were told clearly that the LORD your God had commanded His servant Moses to give you all the land and wipe out all its inhabitants before you. So we greatly feared for our lives because of you, and that is why we have done this.
chapters.zh: 他们回答约书亚说：「因为有人实在告诉你的仆人，耶和华－你的上帝曾吩咐他的仆人摩西，把这全地赐给你们，并在你们面前灭绝这地的一切居民，所以我们为你们的缘故甚怕丧命，就行了这事。

chapters.en: Now we are in your hands. Do to us whatever seems good and right to you.”
chapters.zh: 现在我们在你手中，你以怎样待我们为善为正，就怎样做吧！」

chapters.en: So Joshua did this and delivered them from the hands of the Israelites, and they did not kill the Gibeonites.
chapters.zh: 于是约书亚这样待他们，救他们脱离以色列人的手，以色列人就没有杀他们。

chapters.en: On that day he made them woodcutters and water carriers, as they are to this day for the congregation of the LORD and for the altar at the place He would choose.
chapters.zh: 当日约书亚使他们在耶和华所要选择的地方，为会众和耶和华的坛作劈柴挑水的人，直到今日。

chapters.en: Now Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had captured Ai and devoted it to destruction —doing to Ai and its king as he had done to Jericho and its king—and that the people of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and were living near them.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷王亚多尼‧洗德听见约书亚夺了艾城，尽行毁灭，怎样待耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也照样待艾城和艾城的王，又听见基遍的居民与以色列人立了和约，住在他们中间，

chapters.en: So Adoni-zedek and his people were greatly alarmed, because Gibeon was a great city, like one of the royal cities; it was larger than Ai, and all its men were mighty.
chapters.zh: 就甚惧怕；因为基遍是一座大城，如都城一般，比艾城更大，并且城内的人都是勇士。

chapters.en: Therefore Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent word to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish, and Debir king of Eglon, saying,
chapters.zh: 所以耶路撒冷王亚多尼‧洗德打发人去见希伯崙王何咸、耶末王毗兰、拉吉王雅非亚，和伊矶伦王底璧，说：

chapters.en: “Come up and help me. We will attack Gibeon, because they have made peace with Joshua and the Israelites.”
chapters.zh: 「求你们上来帮助我，我们好攻打基遍，因为他们与约书亚和以色列人立了和约。」

chapters.en: So the five kings of the Amorites—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon—joined forces and advanced with all their armies. They camped before Gibeon and made war against it.
chapters.zh: 于是五个亚摩利王，就是耶路撒冷王、希伯崙王、耶末王、拉吉王、伊矶伦王，大家聚集，率领他们的众军上去，对着基遍安营，攻打基遍。

chapters.en: Then the men of Gibeon sent word to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal: “Do not abandon your servants. Come quickly and save us! Help us, because all the kings of the Amorites from the hill country have joined forces against us.”
chapters.zh: 基遍人就打发人往吉甲的营中去见约书亚，说：「你不要袖手不顾你的仆人，求你速速上来拯救我们，帮助我们，因为住山地亚摩利人的诸王都聚集攻击我们。」

chapters.en: So Joshua and his whole army, including all the mighty men of valor, came from Gilgal.
chapters.zh: 于是约书亚和他一切兵丁，并大能的勇士，都从吉甲上去。

chapters.en: The LORD said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them, for I have delivered them into your hand. Not one of them shall stand against you.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对约书亚说：「不要怕他们；因为我已将他们交在你手里，他们无一人能在你面前站立得住。」

chapters.en: After marching all night from Gilgal, Joshua caught them by surprise.
chapters.zh: 约书亚就终夜从吉甲上去，猛然临到他们那里。

chapters.en: And the LORD threw them into confusion before Israel, who defeated them in a great slaughter at Gibeon, pursued them along the ascent to Beth-horon, and struck them down as far as Azekah and Makkedah.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使他们在以色列人面前溃乱。约书亚在基遍大大地杀败他们，追赶他们，在伯‧和崙的上坡路击杀他们，直到亚西加和玛基大。

chapters.en: As they fled before Israel along the descent from Beth-horon to Azekah, the LORD cast down on them large hailstones from the sky, and more of them were killed by the hailstones than by the swords of the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 他们在以色列人面前逃跑，正在伯‧和崙下坡的时候，耶和华从天上降大冰雹〔注：原文是石头〕在他们身上，直降到亚西加，打死他们。被冰雹打死的，比以色列人用刀杀死的还多。

chapters.en:
On the day that the LORD gave the Amorites over to the Israelites, Joshua spoke to the LORD in the presence of Israel:
“O sun, stand still over Gibeon, O moon, over the Valley of Aijalon.”
chapters.zh: 当耶和华将亚摩利人交付以色列人的日子，约书亚就祷告耶和华，在以色列人眼前说： 日头啊，你要停在基遍； 月亮啊，你要止在亚雅崙谷。

chapters.en:
So the sun stood still and the moon stopped until the nation took vengeance upon its enemies.
Is this not written in the Book of Jashar?
“So the sun stopped in the middle of the sky and delayed going down about a full day.”
chapters.zh: 于是日头停留，月亮止住， 直等国民向敌人报仇。 这事岂不是写在雅煞珥书上吗？日头在天当中停住，不急速下落，约有一日之久。

chapters.en: There has been no day like it before or since, when the LORD listened to the voice of a man, because the LORD fought for Israel.
chapters.zh: 在这日以前，这日以后，耶和华听人的祷告，没有像这日的，是因耶和华为以色列争战。

chapters.en: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人回到吉甲的营中。

chapters.en: Now the five kings had fled and hidden in the cave at Makkedah.
chapters.zh: 那五王逃跑，藏在玛基大洞里。

chapters.en: And Joshua was informed: “The five kings have been found; they are hiding in the cave at Makkedah.”
chapters.zh: 有人告诉约书亚说：「那五王已经找到了，都藏在玛基大洞里。」

chapters.en: So Joshua said, “Roll large stones against the mouth of the cave, and post men there to guard them.
chapters.zh: 约书亚说：「你们把几块大石头滚到洞口，派人看守，

chapters.en: But you, do not stop there. Pursue your enemies and attack them from behind. Do not let them reach their cities, for the LORD your God has delivered them into your hand.”
chapters.zh: 你们却不可耽延，要追赶你们的仇敌，击杀他们尽后边的人，不容他们进自己的城邑，因为耶和华－你们的上帝已经把他们交在你们手里。」

chapters.en: So Joshua and the Israelites continued to inflict a terrible slaughter until they had finished them off, and the remaining survivors retreated to the fortified cities.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列人大大杀败他们，直到将他们灭尽；其中剩下的人都进了坚固的城。

chapters.en: The whole army returned safely to Joshua in the camp at Makkedah, and no one dared to utter a word against the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 众百姓就安然回玛基大营中，到约书亚那里。没有一人敢向以色列人饶舌。

chapters.en: Then Joshua said, “Open the mouth of the cave and bring those five kings out to me.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚说：「打开洞口，将那五王从洞里带出来，领到我面前。」

chapters.en: So they brought the five kings out of the cave—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon.
chapters.zh: 众人就这样行，将那五王，就是耶路撒冷王、希伯崙王、耶末王、拉吉王、伊矶伦王，从洞里带出来，领到约书亚面前。

chapters.en:
When they had brought the kings to Joshua, he summoned all the men of Israel and said to the army commanders who had accompanied him, “Come here and put your feet on the necks of these kings.”
So the commanders came forward and put their feet on their necks.
chapters.zh: 带出那五王到约书亚面前的时候，约书亚就召了以色列众人来，对那些和他同去的军长说：「你们近前来，把脚踏在这些王的颈项上。」他们就近前来，把脚踏在这些王的颈项上。

chapters.en: “Do not be afraid or discouraged,” Joshua said. “Be strong and courageous, for the LORD will do this to all the enemies you fight.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚对他们说：「你们不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。应当刚强壮胆，因为耶和华必这样待你们所要攻打的一切仇敌。」

chapters.en: After this, Joshua struck down and killed the kings, and he hung their bodies on five trees and left them there until evening.
chapters.zh: 随后约书亚将这五王杀死，挂在五棵树上。他们就在树上直挂到晚上。

chapters.en: At sunset Joshua ordered that they be taken down from the trees and thrown into the cave in which they had hidden. Then large stones were placed against the mouth of the cave, and the stones are there to this day.
chapters.zh: 日头要落的时候，约书亚一吩咐，人就把尸首从树上取下来，丢在他们藏过的洞里，把几块大石头放在洞口，直存到今日。

chapters.en: On that day Joshua captured Makkedah and put it to the sword, along with its king. He devoted to destruction everyone in the city, leaving no survivors. So he did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.
chapters.zh: 当日，约书亚夺了玛基大，用刀击杀城中的人和王；将其中一切人口尽行杀灭，没有留下一个。他待玛基大王，像从前待耶利哥王一样。

chapters.en: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Makkedah to Libnah and fought against Libnah.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人从玛基大往立拿去，攻打立拿。

chapters.en: And the LORD also delivered that city and its king into the hand of Israel, and Joshua put all the people to the sword, leaving no survivors. And he did to the king of Libnah as he had done to the king of Jericho.
chapters.zh: 耶和华将立拿和立拿的王也交在以色列人手里。约书亚攻打这城，用刀击杀了城中的一切人口，没有留下一个。他待立拿王，像从前待耶利哥王一样。

chapters.en: And Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Libnah to Lachish. They laid siege to it and fought against it.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人从立拿往拉吉去，对着拉吉安营，攻打这城。

chapters.en: And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, and Joshua captured it on the second day. He put all the people to the sword, just as he had done to Libnah.
chapters.zh: 耶和华将拉吉交在以色列人的手里。第二天约书亚就夺了拉吉，用刀击杀了城中的一切人口，是照他向立拿一切所行的。

chapters.en: At that time Horam king of Gezer went to help Lachish, but Joshua struck him down along with his people, leaving no survivors.
chapters.zh: 那时基色王荷兰上来帮助拉吉，约书亚就把他和他的民都击杀了，没有留下一个。

chapters.en: So Joshua moved on from Lachish to Eglon, and all Israel with him. They laid siege to it and fought against it.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人从拉吉往伊矶伦去，对着伊矶伦安营，攻打这城。

chapters.en: That day they captured Eglon and put it to the sword, and Joshua devoted to destruction everyone in the city, just as he had done to Lachish.
chapters.zh: 当日就夺了城，用刀击杀了城中的人。那日，约书亚将城中的一切人口尽行杀灭，是照他向拉吉一切所行的。

chapters.en: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon to Hebron and fought against it.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人从伊矶伦上希伯崙去，攻打这城，

chapters.en: They captured it and put to the sword its king, all its villages, and all the people. Joshua left no survivors, just as he had done at Eglon; he devoted to destruction Hebron and everyone in it.
chapters.zh: 就夺了希伯崙和属希伯崙的诸城邑，用刀将城中的人与王，并那些城邑中的人口，都击杀了，没有留下一个，是照他向伊矶伦所行的，把城中的一切人口尽行杀灭。

chapters.en: Finally Joshua and all Israel with him turned toward Debir and fought against it.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列众人回到底璧，攻打这城，

chapters.en: And they captured Debir, its king, and all its villages. They put them to the sword and devoted to destruction everyone in the city, leaving no survivors. Joshua did to Debir and its king as he had done to Hebron and as he had done to Libnah and its king.
chapters.zh: 就夺了底璧和属底璧的城邑，又擒获底璧的王，用刀将这些城中的人口尽行杀灭，没有留下一个。他待底璧和底璧王，像从前待希伯崙和立拿与立拿王一样。

chapters.en: So Joshua conquered the whole region—the hill country, the Negev, the foothills, and the slopes, together with all their kings—leaving no survivors. He devoted to destruction everything that breathed, just as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded.
chapters.zh: 这样，约书亚击杀全地的人，就是山地、南地、高原、山坡的人，和那些地的诸王，没有留下一个。将凡有气息的尽行杀灭，正如耶和华－以色列的上帝所吩咐的。

chapters.en: Joshua conquered the area from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza, and the whole region of Goshen as far as Gibeon.
chapters.zh: 约书亚从加低斯‧巴尼亚攻击到迦萨，又攻击歌珊全地，直到基遍。

chapters.en: And because the LORD, the God of Israel, fought for Israel, Joshua captured all these kings and their land in one campaign.
chapters.zh: 约书亚一时杀败了这些王，并夺了他们的地，因为耶和华－以色列的上帝为以色列争战。

chapters.en: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.
chapters.zh: 于是约书亚和以色列众人回到吉甲的营中。

chapters.en: Now when Jabin king of Hazor heard about these things, he sent word to Jobab king of Madon; to the kings of Shimron and Achshaph;
chapters.zh: 夏琐王耶宾听见这事，就打发人去见玛顿王约巴、伸崙王、押煞王，

chapters.en: to the kings of the north in the mountains, in the Arabah south of Chinnereth, in the foothills, and in Naphoth-dor to the west;
chapters.zh: 与北方山地、基尼烈南边的亚拉巴高原，并西边多珥山冈的诸王；

chapters.en: to the Canaanites in the east and west; to the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, and Jebusites in the hill country; and to the Hivites at the foot of Hermon in the land of Mizpah.
chapters.zh: 又去见东方和西方的迦南人，与山地的亚摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、耶布斯人，并黑门山根米斯巴地的希未人。

chapters.en: So these kings came out with all their armies, a multitude as numerous as the sand on the seashore, along with a great number of horses and chariots.
chapters.zh: 这些王和他们的众军都出来，人数多如海边的沙，并有许多马匹车辆。

chapters.en: All these kings joined forces and encamped at the waters of Merom to fight against Israel.
chapters.zh: 这诸王会合，来到米伦水边，一同安营，要与以色列人争战。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them, for by this time tomorrow I will deliver all of them slain before Israel. You are to hamstring their horses and burn up their chariots.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对约书亚说：「你不要因他们惧怕。明日这时，我必将他们交付以色列人全然杀了。你要砍断他们马的蹄筋，用火焚烧他们的车辆。」

chapters.en: So by the waters of Merom, Joshua and his whole army came upon them suddenly and attacked them,
chapters.zh: 于是约书亚率领一切兵丁，在米伦水边突然向前攻打他们。

chapters.en: and the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who struck them down and pursued them all the way to Greater Sidon and Misrephoth-maim, and eastward as far as the Valley of Mizpeh. They struck them down, leaving no survivors.
chapters.zh: 耶和华将他们交在以色列人手里，以色列人就击杀他们，追赶他们到西顿大城，到米斯利弗‧玛音，直到东边米斯巴的平原，将他们击杀，没有留下一个。

chapters.en: Joshua treated them as the LORD had told him; he hamstrung their horses and burned up their chariots.
chapters.zh: 约书亚就照耶和华所吩咐他的去行，砍断他们马的蹄筋，用火焚烧他们的车辆。

chapters.en: At that time Joshua turned back and captured Hazor and put its king to the sword, because Hazor was formerly the head of all these kingdoms.
chapters.zh: 当时，约书亚转回夺了夏琐，用刀击杀夏琐王。（素来夏琐在这诸国中是为首的。）

chapters.en: The Israelites put everyone in Hazor to the sword, devoting them to destruction. Nothing that breathed remained, and Joshua burned down Hazor itself.
chapters.zh: 以色列人用刀击杀城中的人口，将他们尽行杀灭；凡有气息的没有留下一个。约书亚又用火焚烧夏琐。

chapters.en: Joshua captured all these kings and their cities and put them to the sword. He devoted them to destruction, as Moses the LORD’s servant had commanded.
chapters.zh: 约书亚夺了这些王的一切城邑，擒获其中的诸王，用刀击杀他们，将他们尽行杀灭，正如耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐的。

chapters.en: Yet Israel did not burn any of the cities built on their mounds, except Hazor, which Joshua burned.
chapters.zh: 至于造在山冈上的城，除了夏琐以外，以色列人都没有焚烧。约书亚只将夏琐焚烧了。

chapters.en: The Israelites took for themselves all the plunder and livestock of these cities, but they put all the people to the sword until they had completely destroyed them, not sparing anyone who breathed.
chapters.zh: 那些城邑所有的财物和牲畜，以色列人都取为自己的掠物；惟有一切人口都用刀击杀，直到杀尽；凡有气息的没有留下一个。

chapters.en: As the LORD had commanded His servant Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua. That is what Joshua did, leaving nothing undone of all that the LORD had commanded Moses.
chapters.zh: 耶和华怎样吩咐他仆人摩西，摩西就照样吩咐约书亚，约书亚也照样行。凡耶和华所吩咐摩西的，约书亚没有一件懈怠不行的。

chapters.en: So Joshua took this entire region: the hill country, all the Negev, all the land of Goshen, the western foothills, the Arabah, and the mountains of Israel and their foothills,
chapters.zh: 约书亚夺了那全地，就是山地、一带南地、歌珊全地、高原、亚拉巴、以色列的山地，和山下的高原。

chapters.en: from Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir, as far as Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon at the foot of Mount Hermon. He captured all their kings and struck them down, putting them to death.
chapters.zh: 从上西珥的哈拉山，直到黑门山下黎巴嫩平原的巴力‧迦得，并且擒获那些地的诸王，将他们杀死。

chapters.en: Joshua waged war against all these kings for a long period of time.
chapters.zh: 约书亚和这诸王争战了许多年日。

chapters.en: No city made peace with the Israelites except the Hivites living in Gibeon; all others were taken in battle.
chapters.zh: 除了基遍的希未人之外，没有一城与以色列人讲和的，都是以色列人争战夺来的。

chapters.en: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts to engage Israel in battle, so that they would be set apart for destruction and would receive no mercy, being annihilated as the LORD had commanded Moses.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华的意思是要使他们心里刚硬，来与以色列人争战，好叫他们尽被杀灭，不蒙怜悯，正如耶和华所吩咐摩西的。

chapters.en: At that time Joshua proceeded to eliminate the Anakim from the hill country of Hebron, Debir, and Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah and of Israel. Joshua devoted them to destruction, along with their cities.
chapters.zh: 当时约书亚来到，将住山地、希伯崙、底璧、亚拿伯、犹大山地、以色列山地所有的亚衲族人剪除了。约书亚将他们和他们的城邑尽都毁灭。

chapters.en: No Anakim were left in the land of the Israelites; only in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod did any survive.
chapters.zh: 在以色列人的地没有留下一个亚衲族人，只在迦萨、迦特，和亚实突有留下的。

chapters.en: So Joshua took the entire land, in keeping with all that the LORD had spoken to Moses. And Joshua gave it as an inheritance to Israel according to the allotments to their tribes. Then the land had rest from war.
chapters.zh: 这样，约书亚照着耶和华所吩咐摩西的一切话夺了那全地，就按着以色列支派的宗族将地分给他们为业。于是国中太平，没有争战了。

chapters.en: Now these are the kings of the land whom the Israelites struck down and whose lands they took beyond the Jordan to the east, from the Arnon Valley to Mount Hermon, including all the Arabah eastward:
chapters.zh: 以色列人在约旦河外向日出之地击杀二王，得他们的地，就是从亚嫩谷直到黑门山，并东边的全亚拉巴之地。

chapters.en: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon. He ruled from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along the middle of the valley, up to the Jabbok River (the border of the Ammonites), that is, half of Gilead,
chapters.zh: 这二王，有住希实本、亚摩利人的王西宏。他所管之地是从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中的〔城〕，并基列一半，直到亚扪人的境界，雅博河

chapters.en: as well as the Arabah east of the Sea of Chinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea ), eastward through Beth-jeshimoth, and southward below the slopes of Pisgah.
chapters.zh: 与〔约旦河〕东边的亚拉巴，直到基尼烈海，又到亚拉巴的海，就是盐海，通伯‧耶西末的路，以及南方，直到毗斯迦的山根。

chapters.en: And Og king of Bashan, one of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived in Ashtaroth and Edrei.
chapters.zh: 又有巴珊王噩。他是利乏音人所剩下的，住在亚斯他录和以得来。

chapters.en: He ruled over Mount Hermon, Salecah, all of Bashan up to the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and half of Gilead to the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
chapters.zh: 他所管之地是黑门山、撒迦、巴珊全地，直到基述人和玛迦人的境界，并基列一半，直到希实本王西宏的境界。

chapters.en: Moses, the servant of the LORD, and the Israelites had struck them down and given their land as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 这二王是耶和华仆人摩西和以色列人所击杀的；耶和华仆人摩西将他们的地赐给吕便人、迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人为业。

chapters.en: And these are the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites conquered beyond the Jordan to the west, from Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir (according to the allotments to the tribes of Israel, Joshua gave them as an inheritance
chapters.zh: 约书亚和以色列人在约旦河西击杀了诸王。他们的地是从黎巴嫩平原的巴力‧迦得，直到上西珥的哈拉山。约书亚就将那地按着以色列支派的宗族分给他们为业，

chapters.en: the hill country, the foothills, the Arabah, the slopes, the wilderness, and the Negev—the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites):
chapters.zh: 就是赫人、亚摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的山地、高原亚拉巴、山坡、旷野，和南地。

chapters.en:
the king of Jericho, one;
the king of Ai, which is near Bethel, one;
chapters.zh: 〔他们的王〕：一个是耶利哥王，一个是靠近伯特利的艾城王，

chapters.en:
the king of Jerusalem, one;
the king of Hebron, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是耶路撒冷王，一个是希伯崙王，

chapters.en:
the king of Jarmuth, one;
the king of Lachish, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是耶末王，一个是拉吉王，

chapters.en:
the king of Eglon, one;
the king of Gezer, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是伊矶伦王，一个是基色王，

chapters.en:
the king of Debir, one;
the king of Geder, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是底璧王，一个是基德王，

chapters.en:
the king of Hormah, one;
the king of Arad, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是何珥玛王，一个是亚拉得王，

chapters.en:
the king of Libnah, one;
the king of Adullam, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是立拿王，一个是亚杜兰王，

chapters.en:
the king of Makkedah, one;
the king of Bethel, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是玛基大王，一个是伯特利王，

chapters.en:
the king of Tappuah, one;
the king of Hepher, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是他普亚王，一个是希弗王，

chapters.en:
the king of Aphek, one;
the king of Lasharon, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是亚弗王，一个是拉沙崙王，

chapters.en:
the king of Madon, one;
the king of Hazor, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是玛顿王，一个是夏琐王，

chapters.en:
the king of Shimron-meron, one;
the king of Achshaph, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是伸崙‧米崙王，一个是押煞王，

chapters.en:
the king of Taanach, one;
the king of Megiddo, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是他纳王，一个是米吉多王，

chapters.en:
the king of Kedesh, one;
the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是基低斯王，一个是靠近迦密的约念王，

chapters.en:
the king of Dor in Naphath-dor, one;
the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one;
chapters.zh: 一个是多珥山冈的多珥王，一个是吉甲的戈印王，

chapters.en:
and the king of Tirzah, one.
So there were thirty-one kings in all.
chapters.zh: 一个是得撒王；共计三十一个王。

chapters.en: Now Joshua was old and well along in years, and the LORD said to him, “You are old and well along in years, but very much of the land remains to be possessed.
chapters.zh: 约书亚年纪老迈，耶和华对他说：「你年纪老迈了，还有许多未得之地，

chapters.en:
This is the land that remains:
All the territory of the Philistines and the Geshurites,
chapters.zh: 就是非利士人的全境和基述人的全地。

chapters.en: from the Shihor east of Egypt to the territory of Ekron on the north (considered to be Canaanite territory)—that of the five Philistine rulers of Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron, as well as that of the Avvites;
chapters.zh: 从埃及前的西曷河往北，直到以革伦的境界，就算属迦南人之地。有非利士人五个首领所管的迦萨人、亚实突人、亚实基伦人、迦特人、以革伦人〔之地〕，并有南方亚卫人之地。

chapters.en: to the south, all the land of the Canaanites, from Mearah of the Sidonians to Aphek, as far as the border of the Amorites;
chapters.zh: 又有迦南人的全地，并属西顿人的米亚拉到亚弗，直到亚摩利人的境界。

chapters.en:
the land of the Gebalites;
and all Lebanon to the east, from Baal-gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo-hamath.
chapters.zh: 还有迦巴勒人之地，并向日出的全黎巴嫩，就是从黑门山根的巴力‧迦得，直到哈马口。

chapters.en: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim—all the Sidonians—I Myself will drive out before the Israelites. Be sure to divide it by lot as an inheritance to Israel, as I have commanded you.
chapters.zh: 山地的一切居民，从黎巴嫩直到米斯利弗‧玛音，就是所有的西顿人，我必在以色列人面前赶出他们去。你只管照我所吩咐的，将这地拈鬮分给以色列人为业。

chapters.en: Now therefore divide this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”
chapters.zh: 现在你要把这地分给九个支派和玛拿西半个支派为业。」

chapters.en: The other half of Manasseh, along with the Reubenites and Gadites, had received the inheritance Moses had given them beyond the Jordan to the east, just as Moses the servant of the LORD had assigned to them:
chapters.zh: 玛拿西那半支派和吕便、迦得二支派已经受了产业，就是耶和华的仆人摩西在约旦河东所赐给他们的：

chapters.en: The area from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along with the city in the middle of the valley, the whole plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon,
chapters.zh: 是从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中的城，并米底巴的全平原，直到底本，

chapters.en: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites who reigned in Heshbon, as far as the border of the Ammonites;
chapters.zh: 和在希实本作王亚摩利王西宏的诸城，直到亚扪人的境界；

chapters.en: also Gilead and the territory of the Geshurites and Maacathites, all of Mount Hermon, and all Bashan as far as Salecah—
chapters.zh: 又有基列地、基述人、玛迦人的地界，并黑门全山、巴珊全地，直到撒迦；

chapters.en:
the whole kingdom of Og in Bashan, who had reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei and had remained as a remnant of the Rephaim.
Moses had struck them down and dispossessed them,
chapters.zh: 又有巴珊王噩的全国－他在亚斯他录和以得来作王（利乏音人所存留的只剩下他）。这些地的人都是摩西所击杀、所赶逐的。

chapters.en: but the Israelites did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites. So Geshur and Maacath dwell among the Israelites to this day.
chapters.zh: 以色列人却没有赶逐基述人、玛迦人；这些人仍住在以色列中，直到今日。

chapters.en: To the tribe of Levi, however, Moses had given no inheritance. The food offerings to the LORD, the God of Israel, are their inheritance, just as He had promised them.
chapters.zh: 只是利未支派，摩西〔注：原文是他〕没有把产业分给他们。他们的产业乃是献与耶和华－以色列上帝的火祭，正如耶和华所应许他们的。

chapters.en: This is what Moses had given to the clans of the tribe of Reuben:
chapters.zh: 摩西按着吕便支派的宗族分给他们〔产业〕。

chapters.en: The territory from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along with the city in the middle of the valley, to the whole plateau beyond Medeba,
chapters.zh: 他们的境界是亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中的城，靠近米底巴的全平原；

chapters.en: to Heshbon and all its cities on the plateau, including Dibon, Bamoth-baal, Beth-baal-meon,
chapters.zh: 希实本并属希实本平原的各城，底本、巴末‧巴力、伯‧巴力‧勉、

chapters.en: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
chapters.zh: 雅杂、基底莫、米法押、

chapters.en: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth-shahar on the hill in the valley,
chapters.zh: 基列亭、西比玛、谷中山的细列‧哈沙辖、

chapters.en: Beth-peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth—
chapters.zh: 伯‧毗珥、毗斯迦山坡、伯‧耶西末；

chapters.en: all the cities of the plateau and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon until Moses killed him and the chiefs of Midian (Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba), the princes of Sihon who lived in the land.
chapters.zh: 平原的各城，并亚摩利王西宏的全国。这西宏曾在希实本作王，摩西把他和米甸的族长以未、利金、苏珥、户珥、利巴击杀了；这都是住那地属西宏为首领的。

chapters.en: The Israelites also killed the diviner Balaam son of Beor along with the others they put to the sword.
chapters.zh: 那时以色列人在所杀的人中，也用刀杀了比珥的儿子术士巴兰。

chapters.en:
And the border of the Reubenites was the bank of the Jordan.
This was the inheritance of the clans of the Reubenites, including the cities and villages.
chapters.zh: 吕便人的境界就是约旦河与靠近约旦河的地。以上是吕便人按着宗族所得为业的诸城，并属城的村庄。

chapters.en: This is what Moses had given to the clans of the tribe of Gad:
chapters.zh: 摩西按着迦得支派的宗族分给他们〔产业〕。

chapters.en: The territory of Jazer, all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the Ammonites as far as Aroer, near Rabbah;
chapters.zh: 他们的境界是雅谢和基列的各城，并亚扪人的一半地，直到拉巴前的亚罗珥；

chapters.en: the territory from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;
chapters.zh: 从希实本到拉抹‧米斯巴和比多宁，又从玛哈念到底璧的境界，

chapters.en: and in the valley, Beth-haram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, with the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon (the territory on the east side of the Jordan up to the edge of the Sea of Chinnereth ).
chapters.zh: 并谷中的伯‧亚兰、伯‧宁拉、疏割、撒分，就是希实本王西宏国中的余地，以及约旦河与靠近约旦河的地，直到基尼烈海的极边，都在约旦河东。

chapters.en: This was the inheritance of the clans of the Gadites, including the cities and villages.
chapters.zh: 以上是迦得人按着宗族所得为业的诸城，并属城的村庄。

chapters.en: This is what Moses had given to the clans of the half-tribe of Manasseh, that is, to half the tribe of the descendants of Manasseh:
chapters.zh: 摩西把〔产业〕分给玛拿西半支派，是按着玛拿西半支派的宗族所分的。

chapters.en: The territory from Mahanaim through all Bashan—all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, including all the towns of Jair that are in Bashan, sixty cities;
chapters.zh: 他们的境界是从玛哈念起，包括巴珊全地，就是巴珊王噩的全国，并在巴珊、睚珥的一切城邑，共六十个。

chapters.en:
half of Gilead; and Ashtaroth and Edrei, the royal cities of Og in Bashan.
All this was for the clans of the descendants of Machir son of Manasseh, that is, half of the descendants of Machir.
chapters.zh: 基列的一半，并亚斯他录、以得来，就是属巴珊王噩国的二城，是按着宗族给玛拿西的儿子玛吉的一半子孙。

chapters.en: These were the portions Moses had given them on the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan, east of Jericho.
chapters.zh: 以上是摩西在约旦河东对着耶利哥的摩押平原所分给他们的产业。

chapters.en: To the tribe of Levi, however, Moses had given no inheritance. The LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, just as He had promised them.
chapters.zh: 只是利未支派，摩西没有把产业分给他们。耶和华－以色列的上帝是他们的产业，正如耶和华所应许他们的。

chapters.en: Now these are the portions that the Israelites inherited in the land of Canaan, as distributed by Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the families of the tribes of Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列人在迦南地所得的产业，就是祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列各支派的族长所分给他们的，都记在下面，

chapters.en: Their inheritance was assigned by lot for the nine and a half tribes, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.
chapters.zh: 是照耶和华藉摩西所吩咐的，把产业拈鬮分给九个半支派。

chapters.en: For Moses had given the inheritance east of the Jordan to the other two and a half tribes. But he granted no inheritance among them to the Levites.
chapters.zh: 原来，摩西在约旦河东已经把产业分给那两个半支派，只是在他们中间没有把产业分给利未人。

chapters.en: The descendants of Joseph became two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. And no portion of the land was given to the Levites, except for cities in which to live, along with pasturelands for their flocks and herds.
chapters.zh: 因为约瑟的子孙是两个支派，就是玛拿西和以法莲，所以没有把地分给利未人，但给他们城邑居住，并城邑的郊野，可以牧养他们的牲畜，安置他们的财物。

chapters.en: So the Israelites did as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they divided the land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，以色列人就照样行，把地分了。

chapters.en: Then the sons of Judah approached Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know what the LORD said to Moses the man of God at Kadesh-barnea about you and me.
chapters.zh: 那时，犹大人来到吉甲见约书亚，有基尼洗族耶孚尼的儿子迦勒对约书亚说：「耶和华在加低斯‧巴尼亚指着我与你对神人摩西所说的话，你都知道了。

chapters.en: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land, and I brought back to him an honest report.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的仆人摩西从加低斯‧巴尼亚打发我窥探这地，那时我正四十岁；我按着心意回报他。

chapters.en: Although my brothers who went with me made the hearts of the people melt with fear, I remained loyal to the LORD my God.
chapters.zh: 然而，同我上去的众弟兄使百姓的心消化；但我专心跟从耶和华－我的上帝。

chapters.en: On that day Moses swore to me, saying, ‘Surely the land on which you have set foot will be an inheritance to you and your children forever, because you have wholly followed the LORD my God.’
chapters.zh: 当日摩西起誓说：『你脚所踏之地定要归你和你的子孙永远为业，因为你专心跟从耶和华－我的上帝。』

chapters.en: Now behold, as the LORD promised, He has kept me alive these forty-five years since He spoke this word to Moses, while Israel wandered in the wilderness. So here I am today, eighty-five years old,
chapters.zh: 自从耶和华对摩西说这话的时候，耶和华照他所应许的使我存活这四十五年；其间以色列人在旷野行走。看哪，现今我八十五岁了，

chapters.en: still as strong today as I was the day Moses sent me out. As my strength was then, so it is now for war, for going out, and for coming in.
chapters.zh: 我还是强壮，像摩西打发我去的那天一样；无论是争战，是出入，我的力量那时如何，现在还是如何。

chapters.en: Now therefore give me this hill country that the LORD promised me on that day, for you yourself heard then that the Anakim were there, with great and fortified cities. Perhaps with the LORD’s help I will drive them out, as the LORD has spoken.”
chapters.zh: 求你将耶和华那日应许我的这山地给我；那里有亚衲族人，并宽大坚固的城，你也曾听见了。或者耶和华照他所应许的与我同在，我就把他们赶出去。」

chapters.en: Then Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and gave him Hebron as his inheritance.
chapters.zh: 于是约书亚为耶孚尼的儿子迦勒祝福，将希伯崙给他为业。

chapters.en: Therefore Hebron belongs to Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite as an inheritance to this day, because he wholly followed the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 所以希伯崙作了基尼洗族耶孚尼的儿子迦勒的产业，直到今日，因为他专心跟从耶和华－以色列的上帝。

chapters.en:
(Hebron used to be called Kiriath-arba, after Arba, the greatest man among the Anakim.)
Then the land had rest from war.
chapters.zh: 希伯崙从前名叫基列‧亚巴；亚巴是亚衲族中最尊大的人。于是国中太平，没有争战了。

chapters.en: Now the allotment for the clans of the tribe of Judah extended to the border of Edom, to the Wilderness of Zin at the extreme southern boundary:
chapters.zh: 犹大支派按着宗族拈鬮所得之地是在尽南边，到以东的交界，向南直到寻的旷野。

chapters.en: Their southern border started at the bay on the southern tip of the Salt Sea,
chapters.zh: 他们的南界是从盐海的尽边，就是从朝南的海汊起，

chapters.en: proceeded south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, continued on to Zin, went over to the south of Kadesh-barnea, ran past Hezron up to Addar, and curved toward Karka.
chapters.zh: 通到亚克拉滨坡的南边，接连到寻，上到加低斯‧巴尼亚的南边，又过希斯崙，上到亚达珥，绕到甲加，

chapters.en: It proceeded to Azmon, joined the Brook of Egypt, and ended at the Sea. This was their southern border.
chapters.zh: 接连到押们，通到埃及小河，直通到海为止。这就是他们的南界。

chapters.en:
The eastern border was the Salt Sea as far as the mouth of the Jordan.
The northern border started from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan,
chapters.zh: 东界是从盐海〔南边〕到约旦河口。北界是从约旦河口的海汊起，

chapters.en: went up to Beth-hoglah, proceeded north of Beth-arabah, and went up to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
chapters.zh: 上到伯‧曷拉，过伯‧亚拉巴的北边，上到吕便之子波罕的磐石；

chapters.en: Then the border went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor, turning north to Gilgal, which faces the Ascent of Adummim south of the ravine. It continued along the waters of En-shemesh and came out at En-rogel.
chapters.zh: 从亚割谷往北，上到底璧，直向河南亚都冥坡对面的吉甲；又接连到隐‧示麦泉，直通到隐‧罗结，

chapters.en: From there the border went up the Valley of Ben-hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusites (that is, Jerusalem) and ascended to the top of the hill that faces the Valley of Hinnom on the west, at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.
chapters.zh: 上到欣嫩子谷，贴近耶布斯的南界（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷）；又上到欣嫩谷西边的山顶，就是在利乏音谷极北的边界；

chapters.en: From the hilltop the border curved to the spring of the Waters of Nephtoah, proceeded to the cities of Mount Ephron, and then bent around toward Baalah (that is, Kiriath-jearim).
chapters.zh: 又从山顶延到尼弗多亚的水源，通到以弗崙山的城邑，又延到巴拉（巴拉就是基列‧耶琳）；

chapters.en: The border curled westward from Baalah to Mount Seir, ran along the northern slope of Mount Jearim (that is, Chesalon), went down to Beth-shemesh, and crossed to Timnah.
chapters.zh: 又从巴拉往西绕到西珥山，接连到耶琳山的北边（耶琳就是基撒崙）；又下到伯‧示麦过亭纳，

chapters.en: Then it went out to the northern slope of Ekron, curved toward Shikkeron, proceeded to Mount Baalah, went on to Jabneel, and ended at the Sea.
chapters.zh: 通到以革伦北边，延到施基崙，接连到巴拉山；又通到雅比聂，直通到海为止。

chapters.en:
And the western border was the coastline of the Great Sea.
These are the boundaries around the clans of the descendants of Judah.
chapters.zh: 西界就是大海和靠近大海之地。这是犹大人按着宗族〔所得之地〕四围的交界。

chapters.en: According to the LORD’s command to him, Joshua gave Caleb son of Jephunneh a portion among the sons of Judah—Kiriath-arba, that is, Hebron. (Arba was the forefather of Anak.)
chapters.zh: 约书亚照耶和华所吩咐的，将犹大人中的一段地，就是基列‧亚巴，分给耶孚尼的儿子迦勒。亚巴是亚衲族的始祖（基列‧亚巴就是希伯崙）。

chapters.en: And Caleb drove out from there the three sons of Anak—the descendants of Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
chapters.zh: 迦勒就从那里赶出亚衲族的三个族长，就是示筛、亚希幔、挞买；

chapters.en: From there he marched against the inhabitants of Debir (formerly known as Kiriath-sepher).
chapters.zh: 又从那里上去，攻击底璧的居民。（这底璧从前名叫基列‧西弗。）

chapters.en: And Caleb said, “To the man who strikes down Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage.”
chapters.zh: 迦勒说：「谁能攻打基列‧西弗将城夺取，我就把我女儿押撒给他为妻。」

chapters.en: So Othniel son of Caleb’s brother Kenaz captured the city, and Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to him in marriage.
chapters.zh: 迦勒兄弟基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂夺取了那城，迦勒就把女儿押撒给他为妻。

chapters.en: One day Acsah came to Othniel and urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What do you desire?”
chapters.zh: 押撒过门的时候，劝丈夫向她父亲求一块田，押撒一下驴，迦勒问她说：「你要什么？」

chapters.en:
“Give me a blessing,” she answered. “Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me springs of water as well.”
So Caleb gave her both the upper and lower springs.
chapters.zh: 她说：「求你赐福给我，你既将我安置在南地，求你也给我水泉。」她父亲就把上泉下泉赐给她。

chapters.en: This is the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Judah.
chapters.zh: 以下是犹大支派按着宗族所得的产业。

chapters.en:
These were the southernmost cities of the tribe of Judah in the Negev toward the border of Edom:
Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
chapters.zh: 犹大支派尽南边的城邑，与以东交界相近的，就是甲薛、以得、雅姑珥、

chapters.en: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,
chapters.zh: 基拿、底摩拿、亚大达、

chapters.en: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,
chapters.zh: 基低斯、夏琐、以提楠、

chapters.en: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,
chapters.zh: 西弗、提鍊、比亚绿、

chapters.en: Hazor-hadattah, Kerioth-hezron (that is, Hazor),
chapters.zh: 夏琐‧哈大他、加略‧希斯崙（加略‧希斯崙就是夏琐）、

chapters.en: Amam, Shema, Moladah,
chapters.zh: 亚曼、示玛、摩拉大、

chapters.en: Hazar-gaddah, Heshmon, Beth-pelet,
chapters.zh: 哈萨‧迦大、黑实门、伯‧帕列、

chapters.en: Hazar-shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,
chapters.zh: 哈萨‧书亚、别是巴、比斯约他、

chapters.en: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,
chapters.zh: 巴拉、以因、以森、

chapters.en: Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,
chapters.zh: 伊勒多腊、基失、何珥玛、

chapters.en: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,
chapters.zh: 洗革拉、麦玛拿、三撒拿、

chapters.en: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon—twenty-nine cities in all, along with their villages.
chapters.zh: 利巴勿、实忻、亚因、临门，共二十九座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en:
These were in the foothills:
Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,
chapters.zh: 在高原有以实陶、琐拉、亚实拿、

chapters.en: Zanoah, En-gannim, Tappuah, Enam,
chapters.zh: 撒挪亚、隐‧干宁、他普亚、以楠、

chapters.en: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,
chapters.zh: 耶末、亚杜兰、梭哥、亚西加、

chapters.en: Shaaraim, Adithaim, and Gederah (or Gederothaim)—fourteen cities, along with their villages.
chapters.zh: 沙拉音、亚底他音、基底拉、基底罗他音，共十四座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal-gad,
chapters.zh: 又有洗楠、哈大沙、麦大‧迦得、

chapters.en: Dilan, Mizpeh, Joktheel,
chapters.zh: 底连、米斯巴、约帖、

chapters.en: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,
chapters.zh: 拉吉、波斯加、伊矶伦、

chapters.en: Cabbon, Lahmas, Chitlish,
chapters.zh: 迦本、拉幔、基提利、

chapters.en: Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah—sixteen cities, along with their villages.
chapters.zh: 基低罗、伯‧大衮、拿玛、玛基大，共十六座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,
chapters.zh: 又有立拿、以帖、亚珊、

chapters.en: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
chapters.zh: 益弗他、亚实拿、尼悉、

chapters.en: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah—nine cities, along with their villages.
chapters.zh: 基伊拉、亚革悉、玛利沙，共九座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: Ekron, with its towns and villages;
chapters.zh: 又有以革伦和属以革伦的镇市村庄；

chapters.en: from Ekron to the sea, all the cities near Ashdod, along with their villages;
chapters.zh: 从以革伦直到海，一切靠近亚实突之地，并属其地的村庄。

chapters.en: Ashdod, with its towns and villages; Gaza, with its towns and villages, as far as the Brook of Egypt and the coastline of the Great Sea.
chapters.zh: 亚实突和属亚实突的镇市村庄；迦萨和属迦萨的镇市村庄；直到埃及小河，并大海和靠近大海之地。

chapters.en:
These were in the hill country:
Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,
chapters.zh: 在山地有沙密、雅提珥、梭哥、

chapters.en: Dannah, Kiriath-sannah (that is, Debir),
chapters.zh: 大拿、基列‧萨拿（基列‧萨拿就是底璧）、

chapters.en: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,
chapters.zh: 亚拿伯、以实提莫、亚念、

chapters.en: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh—eleven cities, along with their villages.
chapters.zh: 歌珊、何伦、基罗，共十一座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,
chapters.zh: 又有亚拉、度玛、以珊、

chapters.en: Janim, Beth-tappuah, Aphekah,
chapters.zh: 雅农、伯‧他普亚、亚非加、

chapters.en: Humtah, Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), and Zior—nine cities, along with their villages.
chapters.zh: 宏他、基列‧亚巴（基列‧亚巴就是希伯崙）、洗珥，共九座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah,
chapters.zh: 又有玛云、迦密、西弗、淤他、

chapters.en: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,
chapters.zh: 耶斯列、约甸、撒挪亚、

chapters.en: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah—ten cities, along with their villages.
chapters.zh: 该隐、基比亚、亭纳，共十座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: Halhul, Beth-zur, Gedor,
chapters.zh: 又有哈忽、伯‧夙、基突、

chapters.en: Maarath, Beth-anoth, and Eltekon—six cities, along with their villages.
chapters.zh: 玛腊、伯‧亚诺、伊勒提君，共六座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), and Rabbah—two cities, along with their villages.
chapters.zh: 又有基列‧巴力（基列‧巴力就是基列‧耶琳）、拉巴，共两座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en:
These were in the wilderness:
Beth-arabah, Middin, Secacah,
chapters.zh: 在旷野有伯‧亚拉巴、密丁、西迦迦、

chapters.en: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En-gedi—six cities, along with their villages.
chapters.zh: 匿珊、盐城、隐‧基底，共六座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: But the descendants of Judah could not drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem. So to this day the Jebusites live there among the descendants of Judah.
chapters.zh: 至于住耶路撒冷的耶布斯人，犹大人不能把他们赶出去，耶布斯人却在耶路撒冷与犹大人同住，直到今日。

chapters.en: The allotment for the descendants of Joseph extended from the Jordan at Jericho to the waters of Jericho on the east, through the wilderness that goes up from Jericho into the hill country of Bethel.
chapters.zh: 约瑟的子孙拈鬮所得之地是从靠近耶利哥的约旦河起，以耶利哥东边的水为界：从耶利哥上去，通过山地的旷野，到伯特利；

chapters.en: It went on from Bethel (that is, Luz) and proceeded to the border of the Archites in Ataroth.
chapters.zh: 又从伯特利到路斯，接连到亚基人的境界，至亚他绿；

chapters.en: Then it descended westward to the border of the Japhletites as far as the border of Lower Beth-horon and on to Gezer, and it ended at the Sea.
chapters.zh: 又往西下到押利提人的境界，到下伯‧和崙的境界，直到基色，通到海为止。

chapters.en: So Ephraim and Manasseh, the sons of Joseph, received their inheritance.
chapters.zh: 约瑟的儿子玛拿西、以法莲就得了他们的地业。

chapters.en:
This was the territory of the descendants of Ephraim by their clans:
The border of their inheritance went from Ataroth-addar in the east to Upper Beth-horon
chapters.zh: 以法莲子孙的境界，按着宗族所得的，记在下面：他们地业的东界是亚他绿‧亚达到上伯‧和崙；

chapters.en: and out toward the Sea. From Michmethath on the north it turned eastward toward Taanath-shiloh and passed by it to Janoah on the east.
chapters.zh: 往西通到北边的密米他，又向东绕到他纳‧示罗，又接连到雅挪哈的东边；

chapters.en: From Janoah it went down to Ataroth and Naarah, and then reached Jericho and came out at the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 从雅挪哈下到亚他绿，又到拿拉，达到耶利哥，通到约旦河为止；

chapters.en:
From Tappuah the border went westward to the Brook of Kanah and ended at the Sea.
This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Ephraim,
chapters.zh: 从他普亚往西，到加拿河，直通到海为止。这就是以法莲支派按着宗族所得的地业。

chapters.en: along with all the cities and villages set apart for the descendants of Ephraim within the inheritance of Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 另外在玛拿西人地业中得了些城邑和属城的村庄。这都是分给以法莲子孙的。

chapters.en: But they did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer. So the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites to this day, but they are forced laborers.
chapters.zh: 他们没有赶出住基色的迦南人；迦南人却住在以法莲人中间，成为做苦工的仆人，直到今日。

chapters.en: Now this was the allotment for the tribe of Manasseh as Joseph’s firstborn son, namely for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh and father of the Gileadites, who had received Gilead and Bashan because Machir was a man of war.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西是约瑟的长子，他的支派拈鬮所得之地记在下面。至于玛拿西的长子基列之父〔注：或译：主〕玛吉，因为是勇士就得了基列和巴珊。

chapters.en: So this allotment was for the rest of the descendants of Manasseh—the clans of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher, and Shemida. These are the other male descendants of the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西其余的子孙，按着宗族〔拈鬮分地〕，就是亚比以谢子孙，希勒子孙，亚斯列子孙，示剑子孙，希弗子孙，示米大子孙；这些按着宗族，都是约瑟儿子玛拿西子孙的男丁。

chapters.en: But Zelophehad son of Hepher (the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh) had no sons but only daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西的玄孙，玛吉的曾孙，基列的孙子，希弗的儿子西罗非哈没有儿子，只有女儿。他的女儿名叫玛拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒；

chapters.en:
They approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders, and said, “The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.”
So Joshua gave them an inheritance among their father’s brothers, in keeping with the command of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 她们来到祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚并众首领面前，说：「耶和华曾吩咐摩西在我们弟兄中分给我们产业。」于是约书亚照耶和华所吩咐的，在她们伯叔中，把产业分给她们。

chapters.en: Thus ten shares fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan beyond the Jordan,
chapters.zh: 除了约旦河东的基列和巴珊地之外，还有十分地归玛拿西，

chapters.en: because the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance among his sons. And the land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 因为玛拿西的孙女们在玛拿西的孙子中得了产业。基列地是属玛拿西其余的子孙。

chapters.en: Now the border of Manasseh went from Asher to Michmethath near Shechem, then southward to include the inhabitants of En-tappuah.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西的境界：从亚设起，到示剑前的密米他，往北到隐‧他普亚居民〔之地〕。

chapters.en: The region of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, but Tappuah itself, on the border of Manasseh, belonged to Ephraim.
chapters.zh: 他普亚地归玛拿西，只是玛拿西境界上的他普亚〔城〕归以法莲子孙。

chapters.en: From there the border continued southward to the Brook of Kanah. There were cities belonging to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh, but the border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook and ended at the Sea.
chapters.zh: 其界下到加拿河的南边。在玛拿西城邑中的这些城邑都归以法莲。玛拿西的地界是在河北直通到海为止；

chapters.en: Ephraim’s territory was to the south, and Manasseh’s was to the north, having the Sea as its border and adjoining Asher on the north and Issachar on the east.
chapters.zh: 南归以法莲，北归玛拿西，以海为界；北边到亚设，东边到以萨迦。

chapters.en: Within Issachar and Asher, Manasseh was assigned Beth-shean, Ibleam, Dor (that is, Naphath), Endor, Taanach, and Megiddo, each with their surrounding settlements.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西在以萨迦和亚设境内，有伯‧善和属伯‧善的镇市，以伯莲和属以伯莲的镇市，多珥的居民和属多珥的镇市；又有三处山冈，就是隐‧多珥和属隐‧多珥的镇市；他纳的居民和属他纳的镇市，米吉多的居民和属米吉多的镇市。

chapters.en: But the descendants of Manasseh were unable to occupy these cities, because the Canaanites were determined to stay in this land.
chapters.zh: 只是玛拿西子孙不能赶出这些城的〔居民〕，迦南人偏要住在那地。

chapters.en: However, when the Israelites grew stronger, they put the Canaanites to forced labor; but they failed to drive them out completely.
chapters.zh: 及至以色列人强盛了，就使迦南人做苦工，没有把他们全然赶出。

chapters.en: Then the sons of Joseph said to Joshua, “Why have you given us only one portion as an inheritance? We have many people, because the LORD has blessed us abundantly.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟的子孙对约书亚说：「耶和华到如今既然赐福与我们，我们也族大人多，你为什么仅将一鬮一段之地分给我们为业呢？」

chapters.en: Joshua answered them, “If you have so many people that the hill country of Ephraim is too small for you, go to the forest and clear for yourself an area in the land of the Perizzites and the Rephaim.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚说：「你们如果族大人多，嫌以法莲山地窄小，就可以上比利洗人、利乏音人之地，在树林中砍伐〔树木〕。」

chapters.en: “The hill country is not enough for us,” they replied, “and all the Canaanites who live in the valley have iron chariots, both in Beth-shean with its towns and in the Valley of Jezreel.”
chapters.zh: 约瑟的子孙说：「那山地容不下我们，并且住平原的迦南人，就是住伯‧善和属伯‧善的镇市，并住耶斯列平原的人，都有铁车。」

chapters.en: So Joshua said to the house of Joseph—to Ephraim and Manasseh—“You have many people and great strength. You shall not have just one allotment,
chapters.zh: 约书亚对约瑟家，就是以法莲和玛拿西人，说：「你是族大人多，并且强盛，不可仅有一鬮之地，

chapters.en: because the hill country will be yours as well. It is a forest; clear it, and its farthest limits will be yours. Although the Canaanites have iron chariots and although they are strong, you can drive them out.”
chapters.zh: 山地也要归你，虽是树林，你也可以砍伐；靠近之地必归你。迦南人虽有铁车，虽是强盛，你也能把他们赶出去。」

chapters.en: Then the whole congregation of Israel assembled at Shiloh and set up the Tent of Meeting there. And though the land was subdued before them,
chapters.zh: 以色列的全会众都聚集在示罗，把会幕设立在那里，那地已经被他们制伏了。

chapters.en: there were still seven tribes of Israel who had not yet received their inheritance.
chapters.zh: 以色列人中其余的七个支派还没有分给他们地业。

chapters.en: So Joshua said to the Israelites, “How long will you put off entering and possessing the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you?
chapters.zh: 约书亚对以色列人说：「耶和华－你们列祖的上帝所赐给你们的地，你们耽延不去得，要到几时呢？

chapters.en: Appoint three men from each tribe, and I will send them out to survey the land and map it out, according to the inheritance of each. Then they will return to me
chapters.zh: 你们每支派当选举三个人，我要打发他们去，他们就要起身走遍那地，按着各支派〔应得的〕地业写明〔注：或译：画图〕，就回到我这里来。

chapters.en: and divide the land into seven portions. Judah shall remain in their territory in the south, and the house of Joseph shall remain in their territory in the north.
chapters.zh: 他们要将地分做七分；犹大仍在南方，住在他的境内。约瑟家仍在北方，住在他的境内。

chapters.en: When you have mapped out the seven portions of land and brought it to me, I will cast lots for you here in the presence of the LORD our God.
chapters.zh: 你们要将地分做七分，写明了拿到我这里来。我要在耶和华－我们上帝面前，为你们拈鬮。

chapters.en: The Levites, however, have no portion among you, because their inheritance is the priesthood of the LORD. And Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh have already received the inheritance that Moses the servant of the LORD gave them beyond the Jordan to the east.”
chapters.zh: 利未人在你们中间没有分，因为供耶和华祭司的职任就是他们的产业。迦得支派、吕便支派，和玛拿西半支派已经在约旦河东得了地业，就是耶和华仆人摩西所给他们的。」

chapters.en: As the men got up to go out, Joshua commanded them to map out the land, saying, “Go and survey the land, map it out, and return to me. Then I will cast lots for you here in Shiloh in the presence of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 划地势的人起身去的时候，约书亚嘱咐他们说：「你们去走遍那地，划明地势，就回到我这里来。我要在示罗这里，耶和华面前，为你们拈鬮。」

chapters.en: So the men departed and went throughout the land, mapping it city by city into seven portions. Then they returned with the document to Joshua at the camp in Shiloh.
chapters.zh: 他们就去了，走遍那地，按着城邑分做七分，写在册子上，回到示罗营中见约书亚。

chapters.en: And Joshua cast lots for them in the presence of the LORD at Shiloh, where he distributed the land to the Israelites according to their divisions.
chapters.zh: 约书亚就在示罗，耶和华面前，为他们拈鬮。约书亚在那里，按着以色列人的支派，将地分给他们。

chapters.en: The first lot came up for the clans of the tribe of Benjamin. Their allotted territory lay between the tribes of Judah and Joseph:
chapters.zh: 便雅悯支派，按着宗族拈鬮所得之地，是在犹大、约瑟子孙中间。

chapters.en: On the north side their border began at the Jordan, went up past the northern slope of Jericho, headed west through the hill country, and came out at the wilderness of Beth-aven.
chapters.zh: 他们的北界是从约旦河起，往上贴近耶利哥的北边；又往西通过山地，直到伯‧亚文的旷野；

chapters.en: From there the border crossed over to the southern slope of Luz (that is, Bethel) and went down to Ataroth-addar on the hill south of Lower Beth-horon.
chapters.zh: 从那里往南接连到路斯，贴近路斯（路斯就是伯特利），又下到亚他绿‧亚达，靠近下伯‧和崙南边的山；

chapters.en: On the west side the border curved southward from the hill facing Beth-horon on the south and came out at Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), a city of the sons of Judah. This was the western side.
chapters.zh: 从〔那里〕往西，又转向南，从伯‧和崙南对面的山，直达到犹大人的城基列‧巴力（基列‧巴力就是基列‧耶琳）；这是西界。

chapters.en: On the south side the border began at the outskirts of Kiriath-jearim and extended westward to the spring at the Waters of Nephtoah.
chapters.zh: 南界是从基列‧耶琳的尽边起，往西达到尼弗多亚的水源；

chapters.en: Then it went down to the foot of the hill that faces the Valley of Ben-hinnom at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim and ran down the Valley of Hinnom toward the southern slope of the Jebusites and downward to En-rogel.
chapters.zh: 又下到欣嫩子谷对面山的尽边，就是利乏音谷北边的山；又下到欣嫩谷，贴近耶布斯的南边；又下到隐‧罗结；

chapters.en: From there it curved northward and proceeded to En-shemesh and on to Geliloth facing the Ascent of Adummim, and continued down to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
chapters.zh: 又往北通到隐‧示麦，达到亚都冥坡对面的基利绿；又下到吕便之子波罕的磐石；

chapters.en: Then it went on to the northern slope of Beth-arabah and went down into the valley.
chapters.zh: 又接连到亚拉巴对面，往北下到亚拉巴；

chapters.en: The border continued to the northern slope of Beth-hoglah and came out at the northern bay of the Salt Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan. This was the southern border.
chapters.zh: 又接连到伯‧曷拉的北边，直通到盐海的北汊，就是约旦河的南头；这是南界。

chapters.en:
On the east side the border was the Jordan.
These were the borders around the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 东界是约旦河。这是便雅悯人按着宗族，照他们四围的交界所得的地业。

chapters.en:
These were the cities of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin:
Jericho, Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz,
chapters.zh: 便雅悯支派按着宗族所得的城邑就是：耶利哥、伯‧曷拉、伊麦‧基悉、

chapters.en: Beth-arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,
chapters.zh: 伯‧亚拉巴、洗玛脸、伯特利、

chapters.en: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,
chapters.zh: 亚文、巴拉、俄弗拉、

chapters.en: Chephar-ammoni, Ophni, and Geba—twelve cities, along with their villages.
chapters.zh: 基法‧阿摩尼、俄弗尼、迦巴，共十二座城，还有属城的村庄；

chapters.en: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
chapters.zh: 又有基遍、拉玛、比录、

chapters.en: Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah,
chapters.zh: 米斯巴、基非拉、摩撒、

chapters.en: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,
chapters.zh: 利坚、伊利毗勒、他拉拉、

chapters.en:
Zelah, Haeleph, Jebus (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah, and Kiriath-jearim —fourteen cities, along with their villages.
This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 洗拉、以利弗、耶布斯（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷）、基比亚、基列，共十四座城，还有属城的村庄。这是便雅悯人按着宗族所得的地业。

chapters.en:
The second lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Simeon:
Their inheritance lay within the territory of Judah
chapters.zh: 为西缅支派的人，按着宗族，拈出第二鬮。他们所得的地业是在犹大人地业中间。

chapters.en: and included Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,
chapters.zh: 他们所得为业之地就是：别是巴（或名示巴）、摩拉大、

chapters.en: Hazar-shual, Balah, Ezem,
chapters.zh: 哈萨‧书亚、巴拉、以森、

chapters.en: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
chapters.zh: 伊利多拉、比土力、何珥玛、

chapters.en: Ziklag, Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susah,
chapters.zh: 洗革拉、伯‧玛加博、哈萨‧苏撒、

chapters.en: Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen—thirteen cities, along with their villages.
chapters.zh: 伯‧利巴勿、沙鲁险，共十三座城，还有属城的村庄；

chapters.en: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan—four cities, along with their villages,
chapters.zh: 又有亚因、利门、以帖、亚珊，共四座城，还有属城的村庄；

chapters.en:
and all the villages surrounding these cities as far as Baalath-beer (Ramah of the Negev).
This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Simeon.
chapters.zh: 并有这些城邑四围一切的村庄，直到巴拉‧比珥，就是南地的拉玛。这是西缅支派按着宗族所得的地业。

chapters.en: The inheritance of the Simeonites was taken from the territory of Judah, because the share for Judah’s descendants was too large for them. So the Simeonites received an inheritance within Judah’s portion.
chapters.zh: 西缅人的地业是从犹大人地业中得来的；因为犹大人的分过多，所以西缅人在他们的地业中得了地业。

chapters.en:
The third lot came up for the clans of the tribe of Zebulun:
The border of their inheritance stretched as far as Sarid.
chapters.zh: 为西布伦人，按着宗族，拈出第三鬮。他们地业的境界是到撒立；

chapters.en: It went up westward to Maralah, reached Dabbesheth, and met the brook east of Jokneam.
chapters.zh: 往西上到玛拉拉，达到大巴设，又达到约念前的河；

chapters.en: From Sarid it turned eastward along the border of Chisloth-tabor and went on to Daberath and up to Japhia.
chapters.zh: 又从撒立往东转向日出之地，到吉斯绿‧他泊的境界，又通到大比拉，上到雅非亚；

chapters.en: From there it crossed eastward to Gath-hepher and to Eth-kazin; it extended to Rimmon and curved around toward Neah.
chapters.zh: 从那里往东，接连到迦特‧希弗，至以特‧加汛，通到临门，临门延到尼亚；

chapters.en: Then the border circled around the north side of Neah to Hannathon and ended at the Valley of Iphtah-el.
chapters.zh: 又绕过尼亚的北边，转到哈拿顿，通到伊弗他‧伊勒谷。

chapters.en: It also included Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem. There were twelve cities, along with their villages.
chapters.zh: 还有加他、拿哈拉、伸崙、以大拉、伯利恒，共十二座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Zebulun, including these cities and their villages.
chapters.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是西布伦人按着宗族所得的地业。

chapters.en: The fourth lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Issachar:
chapters.zh: 为以萨迦人，按着宗族，拈出第四鬮。

chapters.en: Their territory included Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,
chapters.zh: 他们的境界是到耶斯列、基苏律、书念、

chapters.en: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,
chapters.zh: 哈弗连、示按、亚拿哈拉、

chapters.en: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,
chapters.zh: 拉璧、基善、亚别、

chapters.en: Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez.
chapters.zh: 利篾、隐‧干宁、隐‧哈大、伯‧帕薛；

chapters.en: The border reached Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth-shemesh, and ended at the Jordan. There were sixteen cities, along with their villages.
chapters.zh: 又达到他泊、沙哈洗玛、伯‧示麦，直通到约旦河为止，共十六座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Issachar, including these cities and their villages.
chapters.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是以萨迦支派按着宗族所得的地业。

chapters.en: The fifth lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Asher:
chapters.zh: 为亚设支派，按着宗族，拈出第五鬮。

chapters.en: Their territory included Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,
chapters.zh: 他们的境界是黑甲、哈利、比田、押煞、

chapters.en: Allammelech, Amad, and Mishal. On the west the border touched Carmel and Shihor-libnath,
chapters.zh: 亚拉米勒、亚末、米沙勒；往西达到迦密，又到希曷‧立纳，

chapters.en: then turned eastward toward Beth-dagon, touched Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtah-el, and went north to Beth-emek and Neiel, passing Cabul on the left.
chapters.zh: 转向日出之地，到伯‧大衮，达到细步纶；往北到伊弗他‧伊勒谷，到伯‧以墨和尼业，也通到迦步勒的左边；

chapters.en: It went on to Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, as far as Greater Sidon.
chapters.zh: 又到义伯崙、利合、哈们、加拿，直到西顿大城；

chapters.en: The border then turned back toward Ramah as far as the fortified city of Tyre, turned toward Hosah, and came out at the Sea in the region of Achzib,
chapters.zh: 转到拉玛和坚固城泰尔；又转到何萨，靠近亚革悉一带地方，直通到海；

chapters.en: Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob. There were twenty-two cities, along with their villages.
chapters.zh: 又有乌玛、亚弗、利合，共二十二座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Asher, including these cities and their villages.
chapters.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是亚设支派按着宗族所得的地业。

chapters.en: The sixth lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Naphtali:
chapters.zh: 为拿弗他利人，按着宗族，拈出第六鬮。

chapters.en: Their border started at Heleph and the great tree of Zaanannim, passing Adami-nekeb and Jabneel as far as Lakkum and ending at the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 他们的境界是从希利弗从撒拿音的橡树，从亚大米‧尼吉和雅比聂，直到拉共，通到约旦河；

chapters.en: Then the border turned westward to Aznoth-tabor and ran from there to Hukkok, touching Zebulun on the south side, Asher on the west, and Judah at the Jordan on the east.
chapters.zh: 又转向西到亚斯纳‧他泊，从那里通到户割，南边到西布伦，西边到亚设，又向日出之地，达到约旦河那里的犹大。

chapters.en: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,
chapters.zh: 坚固的城就是：西丁、侧耳、哈末、拉甲、基尼烈、

chapters.en: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,
chapters.zh: 亚大玛、拉玛、夏琐、

chapters.en: Kedesh, Edrei, En-hazor,
chapters.zh: 基低斯、以得来、隐‧夏琐、

chapters.en: Iron, Migdal-el, Horem, Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh. There were nineteen cities, along with their villages.
chapters.zh: 以利稳、密大‧伊勒、和琏、伯‧亚纳、伯‧示麦，共十九座城，还有属城的村庄。

chapters.en: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Naphtali, including these cities and their villages.
chapters.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是拿弗他利支派按着宗族所得的地业。

chapters.en: The seventh lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Dan:
chapters.zh: 为但支派，按着宗族，拈出第七鬮。

chapters.en: The territory of their inheritance included Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir-shemesh,
chapters.zh: 他们地业的境界是琐拉、以实陶、伊珥‧示麦、

chapters.en: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,
chapters.zh: 沙拉宾、亚雅崙、伊提拉、

chapters.en: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
chapters.zh: 以伦、亭拿他、以革伦、

chapters.en: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,
chapters.zh: 伊利提基、基比顿、巴拉、

chapters.en: Jehud, Bene-berak, Gath-rimmon,
chapters.zh: 伊胡得、比尼‧比拉、迦特‧临门、

chapters.en: Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, including the territory across from Joppa.
chapters.zh: 美‧耶昆、拉昆，并约帕对面的地界。

chapters.en: (Later, when the territory of the Danites was lost to them, they went up and fought against Leshem, captured it, and put it to the sword. So they took possession of Leshem, settled there, and renamed it after their father Dan.)
chapters.zh: 但人的地界越过原得的地界；因为但人上去攻取利善，用刀击杀城中的人，得了那城，住在其中，以他们先祖但的名将利善改名为但。

chapters.en: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Dan, including these cities and their villages.
chapters.zh: 这些城并属城的村庄就是但支派按着宗族所得的地业。

chapters.en: When they had finished distributing the land into its territories, the Israelites gave Joshua son of Nun an inheritance among them,
chapters.zh: 以色列人按着境界分完了地业，就在他们中间将地给嫩的儿子约书亚为业，

chapters.en: as the LORD had commanded. They gave him the city of Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim, as he requested. He rebuilt the city and settled in it.
chapters.zh: 是照耶和华的吩咐，将约书亚所求的城，就是以法莲山地的亭拿‧西拉城，给了他。他就修那城，住在其中。

chapters.en: These are the inheritances that Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the families distributed by lot to the tribes of Israel at Shiloh before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing up the land.
chapters.zh: 这就是祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列各支派的族长，在示罗会幕门口，耶和华面前，拈鬮所分的地业。这样，他们把地分完了。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Joshua,
chapters.zh: 耶和华晓谕约书亚说：

chapters.en: “Tell the Israelites to designate the cities of refuge, as I instructed you through Moses,
chapters.zh: 「你吩咐以色列人说：你们要照着我藉摩西所晓谕你们的，为自己设立逃城，

chapters.en: so that anyone who kills another unintentionally or accidentally may flee there. These will be your refuge from the avenger of blood.
chapters.zh: 使那无心而误杀人的，可以逃到那里。这些城可以作你们逃避报血仇人的地方。

chapters.en: When someone flees to one of these cities, stands at the entrance of the city gate, and states his case before its elders, they are to bring him into the city and give him a place to live among them.
chapters.zh: 那杀人的要逃到这些城中的一座城，站在城门口，将他的事情说给城内的长老们听。他们就把他收进城里，给他地方，使他住在他们中间。

chapters.en: Now if the avenger of blood pursues him, they must not surrender the manslayer into his hand, because that man killed his neighbor accidentally without prior malice.
chapters.zh: 若是报血仇的追了他来，长老不可将他交在报血仇的手里；因为他是素无仇恨，无心杀了人的。

chapters.en: He is to stay in that city until he stands trial before the assembly and until the death of the high priest serving at that time. Then the manslayer may return to his own home in the city from which he fled.”
chapters.zh: 他要住在那城里，站在会众面前听审判，等到那时的大祭司死了，杀人的才可以回到本城本家，就是他所逃出来的那城。」

chapters.en: So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.
chapters.zh: 于是，以色列人在拿弗他利山地分定加利利的基低斯；在以法莲山地分定示剑；在犹大山地分定基列‧亚巴（基列‧亚巴就是希伯崙）；

chapters.en: And beyond the Jordan, east of Jericho, they designated Bezer on the wilderness plateau from the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead from the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan from the tribe of Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 又在约旦河外耶利哥东，从吕便支派中，在旷野的平原，设立比悉；从迦得支派中设立基列的拉末；从玛拿西支派中设立巴珊的哥兰。

chapters.en: These are the cities appointed for all the Israelites and foreigners among them, so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally may flee there and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood prior to standing trial before the assembly.
chapters.zh: 这都是为以色列众人和在他们中间寄居的外人所分定的城邑，使误杀人的都可以逃到那里，不死在报血仇人的手中，等他站在会众面前〔听审判〕。

chapters.en: Now the family heads of the Levites approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the other tribes of Israel
chapters.zh: 那时，利未人的众族长来到祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列各支派的族长面前，

chapters.en: at Shiloh in the land of Canaan and said to them, “The LORD commanded through Moses that we be given cities in which to live, together with pasturelands for our livestock.”
chapters.zh: 在迦南地的示罗对他们说：「从前耶和华藉着摩西吩咐给我们城邑居住，并城邑的郊野可以牧养我们的牲畜。」

chapters.en: So by the command of the LORD, the Israelites gave the Levites these cities and their pasturelands out of their own inheritance:
chapters.zh: 于是以色列人照耶和华所吩咐的，从自己的地业中，将以下所记的城邑和城邑的郊野给了利未人。

chapters.en: The first lot came out for the Kohathite clans. The Levites who were descendants of Aaron the priest received thirteen cities by lot from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 为哥辖族拈鬮：利未人的祭司、亚伦的子孙，从犹大支派、西缅支派、便雅悯支派的地业中，按鬮得了十三座城。

chapters.en: The remaining descendants of Kohath received ten cities by lot from the tribes of Ephraim, Dan, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 哥辖其余的子孙，从以法莲支派、但支派、玛拿西半支派的地业中，按鬮得了十座城。

chapters.en: The descendants of Gershon received thirteen cities by lot from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
chapters.zh: 革顺的子孙，从以萨迦支派、亚设支派、拿弗他利支派、住巴珊的玛拿西半支派的地业中，按鬮得了十三座城。

chapters.en: And the descendants of Merari received twelve cities from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
chapters.zh: 米拉利的子孙，按着宗族，从吕便支派、迦得支派、西布伦支派的地业中，〔按鬮〕得了十二座城。

chapters.en: So the Israelites allotted to the Levites these cities, together with their pasturelands, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.
chapters.zh: 以色列人照着耶和华藉摩西所吩咐的，将这些城邑和城邑的郊野，按鬮分给利未人。

chapters.en: From the tribes of Judah and Simeon, they designated these cities by name
to the descendants of Aaron from the Kohathite clans of the Levites, because the first lot fell to them:
chapters.zh: 从犹大支派、西缅支派的地业中，将以下所记的城给了利未支派哥辖宗族亚伦的子孙；因为给他们拈出头一鬮，

chapters.en: They gave them Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), with its surrounding pasturelands, in the hill country of Judah. (Arba was the father of Anak.)
chapters.zh: 将犹大山地的基列‧亚巴和四围的郊野给了他们。亚巴是亚衲族的始祖。（基列‧亚巴就是希伯崙）。

chapters.en: But they had given the fields and villages around the city to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his possession.
chapters.zh: 惟将属城的田地和村庄给了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒为业。

chapters.en: So to the descendants of Aaron the priest they gave these cities, together with their pasturelands: Hebron, a city of refuge for the manslayer, Libnah,
chapters.zh: 以色列人将希伯崙，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了祭司亚伦的子孙；又给他们立拿和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Jattir, Eshtemoa,
chapters.zh: 雅提珥和属城的郊野，以实提莫和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Holon, Debir,
chapters.zh: 何崙和属城的郊野，底璧和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Ain, Juttah, and Beth-shemesh—nine cities from these two tribes, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 亚因和属城的郊野，淤他和属城的郊野，伯‧示麦和属城的郊野，共九座城，都是从这二支派中分出来的。

chapters.en: And from the tribe of Benjamin they gave them Gibeon, Geba,
chapters.zh: 又从便雅悯支派的地业中给了他们基遍和属城的郊野，迦巴和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Anathoth, and Almon—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 亚拿突和属城的郊野，亚勒们和属城的郊野，共四座城。

chapters.en: In all, thirteen cities, together with their pasturelands, were given to the priests, the descendants of Aaron.
chapters.zh: 亚伦子孙作祭司的共有十三座城，还有属城的郊野。

chapters.en:
The remaining Kohathite clans of the Levites were allotted these cities:
From the tribe of Ephraim
chapters.zh: 利未〔支派〕中哥辖的宗族，就是哥辖其余的子孙，拈鬮所得的城有从以法莲支派中分出来的。

chapters.en: they were given Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim (a city of refuge for the manslayer), Gezer,
chapters.zh: 以色列人将以法莲山地的示剑，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了他们；又给他们基色和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Kibzaim, and Beth-horon—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 基伯先和属城的郊野，伯‧和崙和属城的郊野，共四座城；

chapters.en: From the tribe of Dan they were given Elteke, Gibbethon,
chapters.zh: 又从但支派的地业中给了他们伊利提基和属城的郊野，基比顿和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Aijalon, and Gath-rimmon—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 亚雅崙和属城的郊野，迦特‧临门和属城的郊野，共四座城；
