chapters.en: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Taanach and Gath-rimmon—two cities, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 又从玛拿西半支派的地业中给了他们他纳和属城的郊野，迦特‧临门和属城的郊野，共两座城。

chapters.en: In all, ten cities, together with their pasturelands, were given to the rest of the Kohathite clans.
chapters.zh: 哥辖其余的子孙共有十座城，还有属城的郊野。

chapters.en:
This is what the Levite clans of the Gershonites were given:
From the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Golan in Bashan, a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Beeshterah—two cities, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 以色列人又从玛拿西半支派的地业中将巴珊的哥兰，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了利未支派革顺的子孙；又给他们比‧施提拉和属城的郊野，共两座城；

chapters.en: From the tribe of Issachar they were given Kishion, Daberath,
chapters.zh: 又从以萨迦支派的地业中给了他们基善和属城的郊野，大比拉和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Jarmuth, and En-gannim—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 耶末和属城的郊野，隐‧干宁和属城的郊野，共四座城；

chapters.en: From the tribe of Asher they were given Mishal, Abdon,
chapters.zh: 又从亚设支派的地业中给了他们米沙勒和属城的郊野，押顿和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Helkath, and Rehob—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 黑甲和属城的郊野，利合和属城的郊野，共四座城；

chapters.en: And from the tribe of Naphtali they were given Kedesh in Galilee (a city of refuge for the manslayer), Hammoth-dor, and Kartan—three cities, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 又从拿弗他利支派的地业中将加利利的基低斯，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了他们；又给他们哈末‧多珥和属城的郊野，加珥坦和属城的郊野，共三座城。

chapters.en: In all, thirteen cities, together with their pasturelands, were given to the Gershonite clans.
chapters.zh: 革顺人按着宗族〔所得的〕城，共十三座，还有属城的郊野。

chapters.en:
This is what the Merarite clan (the rest of the Levites) were given:
From the tribe of Zebulun they were given Jokneam, Kartah,
chapters.zh: 其余利未支派米拉利子孙，从西布伦支派的地业中所得的，就是约念和属城的郊野，加珥他和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Dimnah, and Nahalal—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 丁拿和属城的郊野，拿哈拉和属城的郊野，共四座城；

chapters.en: From the tribe of Reuben they were given Bezer, Jahaz,
chapters.zh: 又从吕便支派的地业中给了他们比悉和属城的郊野，雅杂和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Kedemoth, and Mephaath—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 基底莫和属城的郊野，米法押和属城的郊野，共四座城；

chapters.en: And from the tribe of Gad they were given Ramoth in Gilead, a city of refuge for the manslayer, Mahanaim,
chapters.zh: 又从迦得支派的地业中，将基列的拉末，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了他们；又给他们玛哈念和属城的郊野，

chapters.en: Heshbon, and Jazer—four cities in all, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 希实本和属城的郊野，雅谢和属城的郊野，共四座城。

chapters.en: In all, twelve cities were allotted to the clans of Merari, the remaining Levite clans.
chapters.zh: 其余利未支派的人，就是米拉利的子孙，按着宗族拈鬮所得的，共十二座城。

chapters.en: For the Levites, then, there were forty-eight cities in all, together with their pasturelands, within the territory of the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 利未人在以色列人的地业中所得的城，共四十八座，并有属城的郊野。

chapters.en: Each of these cities had its own surrounding pasturelands; this was true for all the cities.
chapters.zh: 这些城四围都有属城的郊野，城城都是如此。

chapters.en: Thus the LORD gave Israel all the land He had sworn to give their fathers, and they took possession of it and settled in it.
chapters.zh: 这样，耶和华将从前向他们列祖起誓所应许的全地赐给以色列人，他们就得了为业，住在其中。

chapters.en: And the LORD gave them rest on every side, just as He had sworn to their fathers. None of their enemies could stand against them, for the LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.
chapters.zh: 耶和华照着向他们列祖起誓所应许的一切话，使他们四境平安；他们一切仇敌中，没有一人在他们面前站立得住。耶和华把一切仇敌都交在他们手中。

chapters.en: Not one of all the LORD’s good promises to the house of Israel had failed; everything was fulfilled.
chapters.zh: 耶和华应许赐福给以色列家的话一句也没有落空，都应验了。

chapters.en: Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh
chapters.zh: 当时，约书亚召了吕便人、迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人来，

chapters.en: and told them, “You have done all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and you have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you.
chapters.zh: 对他们说：「耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐你们的，你们都遵守了；我所吩咐你们的，你们也都听从了。

chapters.en: All this time you have not deserted your brothers, up to this very day, but have kept the charge given you by the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 你们这许多日子，总没有撇离你们的弟兄，直到今日，并守了耶和华－你们上帝所吩咐你们当守的。

chapters.en: And now that the LORD your God has given your brothers rest as He promised them, you may return to your homes in the land that Moses the servant of the LORD gave you across the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 如今耶和华－你们上帝照着他所应许的，使你们弟兄得享平安，现在可以转回你们的帐棚，到耶和华的仆人摩西在约旦河东所赐你们为业之地。

chapters.en: But be very careful to observe the commandment and the law that Moses the servant of the LORD gave you: to love the LORD your God, to walk in all His ways, to keep His commandments, to hold fast to Him, and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul.”
chapters.zh: 只要切切地谨慎遵行耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐你们的诫命律法，爱耶和华－你们的上帝，行他一切的道，守他的诫命，专靠他，尽心尽性事奉他。」

chapters.en: So Joshua blessed them and sent them on their way, and they went to their homes.
chapters.zh: 于是约书亚为他们祝福，打发他们去，他们就回自己的帐棚去了。

chapters.en: (To the half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given land in Bashan, and to the other half Joshua gave land on the west side of the Jordan among their brothers.) When Joshua sent them to their homes he blessed them,
chapters.zh: 玛拿西那半支派，摩西早已在巴珊分给他们〔地业〕。这半支派，约书亚在约旦河西，在他们弟兄中，分给他们〔地业〕。约书亚打发他们回帐棚的时候为他们祝福，

chapters.en: saying, “Return to your homes with your great wealth, with immense herds of livestock, with silver, gold, bronze, iron, and very many clothes. Divide with your brothers the spoil of your enemies.”
chapters.zh: 对他们说：「你们带许多财物，许多牲畜和金、银、铜、铁，并许多衣服，回你们的帐棚去，要将你们从仇敌夺来的物，与你们众弟兄同分。」

chapters.en: So the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh left the Israelites at Shiloh in the land of Canaan to return to their own land of Gilead, which they had acquired according to the command of the LORD through Moses.
chapters.zh: 于是吕便人、迦得人、玛拿西半支派的人从迦南地的示罗起行，离开以色列人，回往他们得为业的基列地，就是照耶和华藉摩西所吩咐的得了为业之地。

chapters.en: And when they came to Geliloth near the Jordan in the land of Canaan, the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an imposing altar there by the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 吕便人、迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人到了靠近约旦河的一带迦南地，就在约旦河那里筑了一座坛；那坛看着高大。

chapters.en: Then the Israelites received the report: “Behold, the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar on the border of the land of Canaan, at Geliloth near the Jordan on the Israelite side.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人听说吕便人、迦得人、玛拿西半支派的人靠近约旦河边，在迦南地属以色列人的那边筑了一座坛。

chapters.en: And when they heard this, the whole congregation of Israel assembled at Shiloh to go to war against them.
chapters.zh: 全会众一听见，就聚集在示罗，要上去攻打他们。

chapters.en: The Israelites sent Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest to the land of Gilead, to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 以色列人打发祭司以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈，往基列地去见吕便人、迦得人、玛拿西半支派的人；

chapters.en: With him they sent ten chiefs—one family leader from each tribe of Israel, each the head of a family among the clans of Israel.
chapters.zh: 又打发十个首领与非尼哈同去，就是以色列每支派的一个首领，都是以色列军中的统领。

chapters.en: They went to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh in the land of Gilead and said to them,
chapters.zh: 他们到了基列地，见吕便人、迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人，对他们说：

chapters.en: “This is what the whole congregation of the LORD says: ‘What is this breach of faith you have committed today against the God of Israel by turning away from the LORD and building for yourselves an altar, that you might rebel against the LORD this day?
chapters.zh: 「耶和华全会众这样说，你们今日转去不跟从耶和华，干犯以色列的上帝，为自己筑一座坛，悖逆了耶和华，这犯的是什么罪呢？

chapters.en: Was not the sin of Peor enough for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day? It even brought a plague upon the congregation of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 从前〔拜〕毗珥的罪孽还算小吗？虽然瘟疫临到耶和华的会众，到今日我们还没有洗净这罪。

chapters.en: And now, would you turn away from the LORD? If you rebel today against the LORD, tomorrow He will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.
chapters.zh: 你们今日竟转去不跟从耶和华吗？你们今日既悖逆耶和华，明日他必向以色列全会众发怒。

chapters.en: If indeed the land of your inheritance is unclean, then cross over to the land of the LORD’s possession, where the LORD’s tabernacle stands, and take possession of it among us. But do not rebel against the LORD or against us by building for yourselves an altar other than the altar of the LORD our God.
chapters.zh: 你们所得为业之地，若嫌不洁净，就可以过到耶和华之地，就是耶和华的帐幕所住之地，在我们中间得地业。只是不可悖逆耶和华，也不可得罪我们，在耶和华－我们上帝的坛以外为自己筑坛。

chapters.en: Was not Achan son of Zerah unfaithful regarding what was set apart for destruction, bringing wrath upon the whole congregation of Israel? Yet it was not only Achan who perished because of his sin!’”
chapters.zh: 从前谢拉的曾孙亚干岂不是在那当灭的物上犯了罪，就有忿怒临到以色列全会众吗？那人在所犯的罪中不独一人死亡。」

chapters.en: Then the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered the leaders of the clans of Israel:
chapters.zh: 于是吕便人、迦得人、玛拿西半支派的人回答以色列军中的统领说：

chapters.en: “The LORD, the Mighty One, is God! The LORD, the Mighty One, is God! He knows, and may Israel also know. If this was in rebellion or breach of faith against the LORD, do not spare us today.
chapters.zh: 「大能者上帝耶和华！大能者上帝耶和华！他是知道的！以色列人也必知道！我们若有悖逆的意思，或是干犯耶和华（愿你今日不保佑我们），

chapters.en: If we have built for ourselves an altar to turn away from Him and to offer burnt offerings and grain offerings on it, or to sacrifice peace offerings on it, may the LORD Himself hold us accountable.
chapters.zh: 为自己筑坛，要转去不跟从耶和华，或是要将燔祭、素祭、平安祭献在坛上，愿耶和华亲自讨我们的罪。

chapters.en: But in fact we have done this for fear that in the future your descendants might say to ours, ‘What have you to do with the LORD, the God of Israel?
chapters.zh: 我们行这事并非无故，是特意做的，说：恐怕日后你们的子孙对我们的子孙说：『你们与耶和华－以色列的上帝有何关涉呢？

chapters.en: For the LORD has made the Jordan a border between us and you Reubenites and Gadites. You have no share in the LORD!’ So your descendants could cause ours to stop fearing the LORD.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华把约旦河定为我们和你们这吕便人、迦得人的交界，你们与耶和华无分了。』这样，你们的子孙就使我们的子孙不再敬畏耶和华了。

chapters.en: That is why we said, ‘Let us take action and build an altar for ourselves, but not for burnt offerings or sacrifices.
chapters.zh: 因此我们说：『不如为自己筑一座坛，不是为献燔祭，也不是为献〔别的〕祭，

chapters.en: Rather, let it be a witness between us and you and the generations to come, that we will worship the LORD in His presence with our burnt offerings, sacrifices, and peace offerings.’ Then in the future, your descendants cannot say to ours, ‘You have no share in the LORD!’
chapters.zh: 乃是为你我中间和你我后人中间作证据，好叫我们也在耶和华面前献燔祭、平安祭，和〔别的〕祭事奉他，免得你们的子孙日后对我们的子孙说，你们与耶和华无分了。』

chapters.en: Therefore we said, ‘If they ever say this to us or to our descendants, we will answer: Look at the replica of the altar of the LORD that our fathers made, not for burnt offerings or sacrifices, but as a witness between us and you.’
chapters.zh: 所以我们说：『日后你们对我们，或对我们的后人这样说，我们就可以回答说，你们看我们列祖所筑的坛是耶和华坛的样式；这并不是为献燔祭，也不是为献〔别的〕祭，乃是为作你我中间的证据。』

chapters.en: Far be it from us to rebel against the LORD and turn away from Him today by building an altar for burnt offerings, grain offerings, or sacrifices, other than the altar of the LORD our God, which stands before His tabernacle.”
chapters.zh: 我们在耶和华－我们上帝帐幕前的坛以外，另筑一座坛，为献燔祭、素祭，和〔别的〕祭，悖逆耶和华，今日转去不跟从他，我们断没有这个意思。」

chapters.en: When Phinehas the priest and the chiefs of the congregation—the heads of Israel’s clans who were with him—heard what the descendants of Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh had to say, they were satisfied.
chapters.zh: 祭司非尼哈与会中的首领，就是与他同来以色列军中的统领，听见吕便人、迦得人、玛拿西人所说的话，就都以为美。

chapters.en: Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest said to the descendants of Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh, “Today we know that the LORD is among us, because you have not committed this breach of faith against Him. Consequently, you have delivered the Israelites from the hand of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 祭司以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈对吕便人、迦得人、玛拿西人说：「今日我们知道耶和华在我们中间，因为你们没有向他犯了这罪。现在你们救以色列人脱离耶和华的手了。」

chapters.en: Then Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest, together with the other leaders, returned to the Israelites in the land of Canaan and brought back a report regarding the Reubenites and Gadites in the land of Gilead.
chapters.zh: 祭司以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈与众首领离了吕便人、迦得人，从基列地回往迦南地，到了以色列人那里，〔便将这事〕回报他们。

chapters.en: The Israelites were satisfied with the report, and they blessed God and spoke no more about going to war against them to destroy the land where the Reubenites and Gadites lived.
chapters.zh: 以色列人以这事为美，就称颂上帝，不再提上去攻打吕便人、迦得人、毁坏他们所住的地了。

chapters.en: So the Reubenites and Gadites named the altar Witness, for they said, “It is a witness between us that the LORD is God.”
chapters.zh: 吕便人、迦得人给坛起名叫〔证坛〕，意思说：这坛在我们中间证明耶和华是上帝。

chapters.en: A long time after the LORD had given Israel rest from all the enemies around them, when Joshua was old and well along in years,
chapters.zh: 耶和华使以色列人安静，不与四围的一切仇敌争战，已经多日。约书亚年纪老迈，

chapters.en: he summoned all Israel, including its elders, leaders, judges, and officers. “I am old and well along in years,” he said,
chapters.zh: 就把以色列众人的长老、族长、审判官，并官长都召了来，对他们说：「我年纪已经老迈。

chapters.en: “and you have seen everything that the LORD your God has done to all these nations for your sake, because it was the LORD your God who fought for you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你们的上帝因你们的缘故向那些国所行的一切事，你们亲眼看见了，因那为你们争战的是耶和华－你们的上帝。

chapters.en: See, I have allotted as an inheritance to your tribes these remaining nations, including all the nations I have already cut off, from the Jordan westward to the Great Sea.
chapters.zh: 我所剪除和所剩下的各国，从约旦河起到日落之处的大海，我已经拈鬮分给你们各支派为业。

chapters.en: The LORD your God will push them out of your way and drive them out before you, so that you can take possession of their land, as the LORD your God promised you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你们的上帝必将他们从你们面前赶出去，使他们离开你们，你们就必得他们的地为业，正如耶和华－你们的上帝所应许的。

chapters.en: Be very strong, then, so that you can keep and obey all that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, not turning aside from it to the right or to the left.
chapters.zh: 所以，你们要大大壮胆，谨守遵行写在摩西律法书上的一切话，不可偏离左右。

chapters.en: So you are not to associate with these nations that remain among you. You must not call on the names of their gods or swear by them, and you must not serve them or bow down to them.
chapters.zh: 不可与你们中间所剩下的这些国民搀杂。他们的神，你们不可提他的名，不可指着他起誓，也不可事奉、叩拜；

chapters.en: Instead, you shall hold fast to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day.
chapters.zh: 只要照着你们到今日所行的，专靠耶和华－你们的上帝。

chapters.en: The LORD has driven out great and powerful nations before you, and to this day no one can stand against you.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华已经把又大又强的国民从你们面前赶出；直到今日，没有一人在你们面前站立得住。

chapters.en: One of you can put a thousand to flight, because the LORD your God fights for you, just as He promised.
chapters.zh: 你们一人必追赶千人，因耶和华－你们的上帝照他所应许的，为你们争战。

chapters.en: Therefore watch yourselves carefully, that you love the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 你们要分外谨慎，爱耶和华－你们的上帝。

chapters.en: For if you turn away and cling to the rest of these nations that remain among you, and if you intermarry and associate with them,
chapters.zh: 你们若稍微转去，与你们中间所剩下的这些国民联络，彼此结亲，互相往来，

chapters.en: know for sure that the LORD your God will no longer drive out these nations before you. Instead, they will become for you a snare and a trap, a scourge in your sides and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land that the LORD your God has given you.
chapters.zh: 你们要确实知道，耶和华－你们的上帝必不再将他们从你们眼前赶出；他们却要成为你们的网罗、机槛、肋上的鞭、眼中的刺，直到你们在耶和华－你们上帝所赐的这美地上灭亡。

chapters.en: Now behold, today I am going the way of all the earth, and you know with all your heart and soul that not one of the good promises the LORD your God made to you has failed. Everything was fulfilled for you; not one promise has failed.
chapters.zh: 「我现在要走世人必走的路。你们是一心一意地知道，耶和华－你们上帝所应许赐福与你们的话没有一句落空，都应验在你们身上了。

chapters.en: But just as every good thing the LORD your God promised you has come to pass, likewise the LORD will bring upon you the calamity He has threatened, until He has destroyed you from this good land He has given you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你们上帝所应许的一切福气怎样临到你们身上，耶和华也必照样使各样祸患临到你们身上，直到把你们从耶和华－你们上帝所赐的这美地上除灭。

chapters.en: If you transgress the covenant of the LORD your God, which He commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them, then the anger of the LORD will burn against you, and you will quickly perish from this good land He has given you.”
chapters.zh: 你们若违背耶和华－你们上帝吩咐你们所守的约，去事奉别神，叩拜他，耶和华的怒气必向你们发作，使你们在他所赐的美地上速速灭亡。」

chapters.en: Then Joshua assembled all the tribes of Israel at Shechem. He summoned the elders, leaders, judges, and officers of Israel, and they presented themselves before God.
chapters.zh: 约书亚将以色列的众支派聚集在示剑，召了以色列的长老、族长、审判官，并官长来，他们就站在上帝面前。

chapters.en: And Joshua said to all the people, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Long ago your fathers, including Terah the father of Abraham and Nahor, lived beyond the Euphrates and worshiped other gods.
chapters.zh: 约书亚对众民说：「耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：『古时你们的列祖，就是亚伯拉罕和拿鹤的父亲他拉，住在大河那边事奉别神，

chapters.en: But I took your father Abraham from beyond the Euphrates and led him through all the land of Canaan, and I multiplied his descendants. I gave him Isaac,
chapters.zh: 我将你们的祖宗亚伯拉罕从大河那边带来，领他走遍迦南全地，又使他的子孙众多，把以撒赐给他；

chapters.en: and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau Mount Seir to possess, but Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.
chapters.zh: 又把雅各和以扫赐给以撒，将西珥山赐给以扫为业；后来雅各和他的子孙下到埃及去了。

chapters.en: Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I afflicted the Egyptians by what I did there, and afterward I brought you out.
chapters.zh: 我差遣摩西、亚伦，并照我在埃及中所行的降灾与埃及，然后把你们领出来。

chapters.en: When I brought your fathers out of Egypt and you reached the Red Sea, the Egyptians pursued them with chariots and horsemen as far as the Red Sea.
chapters.zh: 我领你们列祖出埃及，他们就到了红海；埃及人带领车辆马兵追赶你们列祖到红海。

chapters.en: So your fathers cried out to the LORD, and He put darkness between you and the Egyptians, over whom He brought the sea and engulfed them. Your very eyes saw what I did to the Egyptians. Then you lived in the wilderness for a long time.
chapters.zh: 你们列祖哀求耶和华，他就使你们和埃及人中间黑暗了，又使海水淹没埃及人。我在埃及所行的事，你们亲眼见过。你们在旷野也住了许多年日。

chapters.en: Later, I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived beyond the Jordan. They fought against you, but I delivered them into your hand, that you should possess their land when I destroyed them before you.
chapters.zh: 我领你们到约旦河东亚摩利人所住之地。他们与你们争战，我将他们交在你们手中，你们便得了他们的地为业；我也在你们面前将他们灭绝。

chapters.en: Then Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, set out to fight against Israel. He sent for Balaam son of Beor to curse you,
chapters.zh: 那时，摩押王西拨的儿子巴勒起来攻击以色列人，打发人召了比珥的儿子巴兰来咒诅你们。

chapters.en: but I would not listen to Balaam. So he blessed you again and again, and I delivered you from his hand.
chapters.zh: 我不肯听巴兰的话，所以他倒为你们连连祝福。这样，我便救你们脱离巴勒的手。

chapters.en: After this, you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho. The people of Jericho fought against you, as did the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I delivered them into your hand.
chapters.zh: 你们过了约旦河，到了耶利哥；耶利哥人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、迦南人、赫人、革迦撒人、希未人、耶布斯人都与你们争战；我把他们交在你们手里。

chapters.en: I sent the hornet ahead of you, and it drove out the two Amorite kings before you, but not by your own sword or bow.
chapters.zh: 我打发黄蜂飞在你们前面，将亚摩利人的二王从你们面前撵出，并不是用你的刀，也不是用你的弓。

chapters.en: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities that you did not build, and now you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.’
chapters.zh: 我赐给你们地土，非你们所修治的；我赐给你们城邑，非你们所建造的。你们就住在其中，又得吃非你们所栽种的葡萄园、橄榄园的果子。』

chapters.en: Now, therefore, fear the LORD and serve Him in sincerity and truth; cast aside the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates and in Egypt, and serve the LORD.
chapters.zh: 「现在你们要敬畏耶和华，诚心实意地事奉他，将你们列祖在大河那边和在埃及所事奉的神除掉，去事奉耶和华。

chapters.en: But if it is unpleasing in your sight to serve the LORD, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living. As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!”
chapters.zh: 若是你们以事奉耶和华为不好，今日就可以选择所要事奉的：是你们列祖在大河那边所事奉的神呢？是你们所住这地的亚摩利人的神呢？至于我和我家，我们必定事奉耶和华。」

chapters.en: The people replied, “Far be it from us to forsake the LORD to serve other gods!
chapters.zh: 百姓回答说：「我们断不敢离弃耶和华去事奉别神；

chapters.en: For the LORD our God brought us and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, and performed these great signs before our eyes. He also protected us throughout our journey and among all the nations through which we traveled.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华－我们的上帝曾将我们和我们列祖从埃及地的为奴之家领出来，在我们眼前行了那些大神迹，在我们所行的道上，所经过的诸国，都保护了我们。

chapters.en: And the LORD drove out before us all the nations, including the Amorites who lived in the land. We too will serve the LORD, because He is our God!”
chapters.zh: 耶和华又把住此地的亚摩利人都从我们面前赶出去。所以，我们必事奉耶和华，因为他是我们的上帝。」

chapters.en: But Joshua said to the people, “You are not able to serve the LORD, for He is a holy God; He is a jealous God; He will not forgive your rebellion or your sins.
chapters.zh: 约书亚对百姓说：「你们不能事奉耶和华；因为他是圣洁的上帝，是忌邪的上帝，必不赦免你们的过犯罪恶。

chapters.en: If you forsake the LORD and serve foreign gods, He will turn and bring disaster on you and consume you, even after He has been good to you.”
chapters.zh: 你们若离弃耶和华去事奉外邦神，耶和华在降福之后，必转而降祸与你们，把你们灭绝。」

chapters.en: “No!” replied the people. “We will serve the LORD!”
chapters.zh: 百姓回答约书亚说：「不然，我们定要事奉耶和华。」

chapters.en:
Then Joshua told them, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the LORD.”
“We are witnesses!” they said.
chapters.zh: 约书亚对百姓说：「你们选定耶和华，要事奉他，你们自己作见证吧！」他们说：「我们愿意作见证。」

chapters.en: “Now, therefore,” he said, “get rid of the foreign gods among you and incline your hearts to the LORD, the God of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚说：「你们现在要除掉你们中间的外邦神，专心归向耶和华－以色列的上帝。」

chapters.en: So the people said to Joshua, “We will serve the LORD our God and obey His voice.”
chapters.zh: 百姓回答约书亚说：「我们必事奉耶和华－我们的上帝，听从他的话。」

chapters.en: On that day Joshua made a covenant for the people, and there at Shechem he established for them a statute and ordinance.
chapters.zh: 当日，约书亚就与百姓立约，在示剑为他们立定律例典章。

chapters.en: Joshua recorded these things in the Book of the Law of God. Then he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak that was near the sanctuary of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 约书亚将这些话都写在上帝的律法书上，又将一块大石头立在橡树下耶和华的圣所旁边。

chapters.en: And Joshua said to all the people, “You see this stone. It will be a witness against us, for it has heard all the words the LORD has spoken to us, and it will be a witness against you if you ever deny your God.”
chapters.zh: 约书亚对百姓说：「看哪，这石头可以向我们作见证；因为是听见了耶和华所吩咐我们的一切话，倘或你们背弃你们的上帝，这石头就可以向你们作见证〔注：倘或…见证：或译所以要向你们作见证，免得你们背弃耶和华－你们的上帝〕。」

chapters.en: Then Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.
chapters.zh: 于是约书亚打发百姓各归自己的地业去了。

chapters.en: Some time later, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of 110.
chapters.zh: 这些事以后，耶和华的仆人嫩的儿子约书亚，正一百一十岁，就死了。

chapters.en: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
chapters.zh: 以色列人将他葬在他地业的境内，就是在以法莲山地的亭拿‧西拉，在迦实山的北边。

chapters.en: Israel had served the LORD throughout the days of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had experienced all the works that the LORD had done for Israel.
chapters.zh: 约书亚在世和约书亚死后，那些知道耶和华为以色列人所行诸事的长老还在的时候，以色列人事奉耶和华。

chapters.en: And the bones of Joseph, which the Israelites had brought up out of Egypt, were buried at Shechem in the plot of land that Jacob had purchased from the sons of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for a hundred pieces of silver. So it became an inheritance for Joseph’s descendants.
chapters.zh: 以色列人从埃及所带来约瑟的骸骨，葬埋在示剑，就是在雅各从前用一百块〔银子〕向示剑的父亲、哈抹的子孙所买的那块地里；这就作了约瑟子孙的产业。

chapters.en: Eleazar son of Aaron also died, and they buried him at Gibeah, which had been given to his son Phinehas in the hill country of Ephraim.
chapters.zh: 亚伦的儿子以利亚撒也死了，就把他葬在他儿子非尼哈所得以法莲山地的小山上。

chapters.en: After the death of Joshua, the Israelites inquired of the LORD, “Who will be the first to go up and fight for us against the Canaanites?”
chapters.zh: 约书亚死后，以色列人求问耶和华说：「我们中间谁当首先上去攻击迦南人，与他们争战？」

chapters.en: “Judah shall go up,” answered the LORD. “Indeed, I have delivered the land into their hands.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「犹大当先上去，我已将那地交在他手中。」

chapters.en: Then the men of Judah said to their brothers the Simeonites, “Come up with us to our allotted territory, and let us fight against the Canaanites. And we likewise will go with you to your territory.” So the Simeonites went with them.
chapters.zh: 犹大对他哥哥西缅说：「请你同我到拈鬮所得之地去，好与迦南人争战；以后我也同你到你拈鬮所得之地去。」于是西缅与他同去。

chapters.en: When Judah attacked, the LORD delivered the Canaanites and Perizzites into their hands, and they struck down ten thousand men at Bezek.
chapters.zh: 犹大就上去；耶和华将迦南人和比利洗人交在他们手中。他们在比色击杀了一万人，

chapters.en: And there they found Adoni-bezek and fought against him, striking down the Canaanites and Perizzites.
chapters.zh: 又在那里遇见亚多尼‧比色，与他争战，杀败迦南人和比利洗人。

chapters.en: As Adoni-bezek fled, they pursued him, seized him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.
chapters.zh: 亚多尼‧比色逃跑；他们追赶，拿住他，砍断他手脚的大拇指。

chapters.en: Then Adoni-bezek said, “Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off have gathered the scraps under my table. As I have done to them, so God has repaid me.” And they brought him to Jerusalem, where he died.
chapters.zh: 亚多尼‧比色说：「从前有七十个王，手脚的大拇指都被〔我〕砍断，在我桌子底下拾取〔零碎食物〕。现在上帝按着我所行的报应我了。」于是他们将亚多尼‧比色带到耶路撒冷，他就死在那里。

chapters.en: Then the men of Judah fought against Jerusalem and captured it. They put the city to the sword and set it on fire.
chapters.zh: 犹大人攻打耶路撒冷，将城攻取，用刀杀了城内的人，并且放火烧城。

chapters.en: Afterward, the men of Judah marched down to fight against the Canaanites living in the hill country, in the Negev, and in the foothills.
chapters.zh: 后来犹大人下去，与住山地、南地，和高原的迦南人争战。

chapters.en: Judah also marched against the Canaanites who were living in Hebron (formerly known as Kiriath-arba), and they struck down Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
chapters.zh: 犹大人去攻击住希伯崙的迦南人，杀了示筛、亚希幔、挞买。希伯崙从前名叫基列‧亚巴。

chapters.en: From there they marched against the inhabitants of Debir (formerly known as Kiriath-sepher).
chapters.zh: 他们从那里去攻击底壁的居民；底壁从前名叫基列‧西弗。

chapters.en: And Caleb said, “To the man who strikes down Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage.”
chapters.zh: 迦勒说：「谁能攻打基列‧西弗，将城夺取，我就把我女儿押撒给他为妻。」

chapters.en: So Othniel son of Caleb’s younger brother Kenaz captured the city, and Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to him in marriage.
chapters.zh: 迦勒兄弟基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂夺取了那城，迦勒就把女儿押撒给他为妻。

chapters.en: One day Acsah came to Othniel and urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What do you desire?”
chapters.zh: 押撒过门的时候，劝丈夫向她父亲求一块田。押撒一下驴，迦勒问她说：「你要什么？」

chapters.en:
“Give me a blessing,” she answered. “Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me springs of water as well.”
So Caleb gave her both the upper and lower springs.
chapters.zh: 她说：「求你赐福给我，你既将我安置在南地，求你也给我水泉。」迦勒就把上泉下泉赐给她。

chapters.en: Now the descendants of Moses’ father-in-law, the Kenite, went up with the men of Judah from the City of Palms to the Wilderness of Judah in the Negev near Arad. They went to live among the people.
chapters.zh: 摩西的内兄〔注：或译：岳父〕是基尼人，他的子孙与犹大人一同离了棕树城，往亚拉得以南的犹大旷野去，就住在民中。

chapters.en: Then the men of Judah went with their brothers the Simeonites, attacked the Canaanites living in Zephath, and devoted the city to destruction. So it was called Hormah.
chapters.zh: 犹大和他哥哥西缅同去，击杀了住洗法的迦南人，将城尽行毁灭，那城的名便叫何珥玛。

chapters.en: And Judah also captured Gaza, Ashkelon, and Ekron—each with its territory.
chapters.zh: 犹大又取了迦萨和迦萨的四境，亚实基伦和亚实基伦的四境，以革伦和以革伦的四境。

chapters.en: The LORD was with Judah, and they took possession of the hill country; but they could not drive out the inhabitants of the plains because they had chariots of iron.
chapters.zh: 耶和华与犹大同在，犹大就赶出山地的〔居民〕，只是不能赶出平原的居民，因为他们有铁车。

chapters.en: Just as Moses had promised, Judah gave Hebron to Caleb, who drove out the descendants of the three sons of Anak.
chapters.zh: 以色列人照摩西所说的，将希伯崙给了迦勒；迦勒就从那里赶出亚衲族的三个族长。

chapters.en: The Benjamites, however, failed to drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem. So to this day the Jebusites live there among the Benjamites.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯人没有赶出住耶路撒冷的耶布斯人。耶布斯人仍在耶路撒冷与便雅悯人同住，直到今日。

chapters.en: The house of Joseph also attacked Bethel, and the LORD was with them.
chapters.zh: 约瑟家也上去攻打伯特利；耶和华与他们同在。

chapters.en: They sent spies to Bethel (formerly known as Luz),
chapters.zh: 约瑟家打发人去窥探伯特利（那城起先名叫路斯）。

chapters.en: and when the spies saw a man coming out of the city, they said to him, “Please show us how to get into the city, and we will treat you kindly.”
chapters.zh: 窥探的人看见一个人从城里出来，就对他说：「求你将进城的路指示我们，我们必恩待你。」

chapters.en: So the man showed them the entrance to the city, and they put the city to the sword but released that man and all his family.
chapters.zh: 那人将进城的路指示他们，他们就用刀击杀了城中的居民，但将那人和他全家放去。

chapters.en: And the man went to the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called it Luz, which is its name to this day.
chapters.zh: 那人往赫人之地去，筑了一座城，起名叫路斯。那城到如今还叫这名。

chapters.en: At that time Manasseh failed to drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shean, Taanach, Dor, Ibleam, Megiddo, and their villages; for the Canaanites were determined to dwell in that land.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西没有赶出伯‧善和属伯‧善乡村的〔居民〕，他纳和属他纳乡村的〔居民〕，多珥和属多珥乡村的居民，以伯莲和属以伯莲乡村的居民，米吉多和属米吉多乡村的居民；迦南人却执意住在那些地方。

chapters.en: When Israel became stronger, they pressed the Canaanites into forced labor, but they never drove them out completely.
chapters.zh: 及至以色列强盛了，就使迦南人做苦工，没有把他们全然赶出。

chapters.en: Ephraim also failed to drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer; so the Canaanites continued to dwell among them in Gezer.
chapters.zh: 以法莲没有赶出住基色的迦南人。于是迦南人仍住在基色，在以法莲中间。

chapters.en: Zebulun failed to drive out the inhabitants of Kitron and Nahalol; so the Canaanites lived among them and served as forced laborers.
chapters.zh: 西布伦没有赶出基伦的居民和拿哈拉的居民。于是迦南人仍住在西布伦中间，成了服苦的人。

chapters.en: Asher failed to drive out the inhabitants of Acco, Sidon, Ahlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphik, and Rehob.
chapters.zh: 亚设没有赶出亚柯和西顿的居民，亚黑拉和亚革悉的居民，黑巴、亚弗革与利合的居民。

chapters.en: So the Asherites lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land, because they did not drive them out.
chapters.zh: 于是，亚设因为没有赶出那地的迦南人，就住在他们中间。

chapters.en: Naphtali failed to drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath. So the Naphtalites also lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land, but the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath served them as forced laborers.
chapters.zh: 拿弗他利没有赶出伯‧示麦和伯‧亚纳的居民，于是拿弗他利就住在那地的迦南人中间；然而伯‧示麦和伯‧亚纳的居民成了服苦的人。

chapters.en: The Amorites forced the Danites into the hill country and did not allow them to come down into the plain.
chapters.zh: 亚摩利人强逼但人住在山地，不容他们下到平原；

chapters.en: And the Amorites were determined to dwell in Mount Heres, Aijalon, and Shaalbim. But when the house of Joseph grew in strength, they pressed the Amorites into forced labor.
chapters.zh: 亚摩利人却执意住在希烈山和亚雅崙并沙宾。然而约瑟家胜了他们，使他们成了服苦的人。

chapters.en: And the border of the Amorites extended from the Ascent of Akrabbim to Sela and beyond.
chapters.zh: 亚摩利人的境界，是从亚克拉滨坡，从西拉而上。

chapters.en: Now the angel of the LORD went up from Gilgal to Bochim and said, “I brought you up out of Egypt and led you into the land that I had promised to your fathers, and I said, ‘I will never break My covenant with you,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者从吉甲上到波金，对〔以色列〕人说：「我使你们从埃及上来，领你们到我向你们列祖起誓应许之地。我又说：『我永不废弃与你们所立的约。

chapters.en:
and you are not to make a covenant with the people of this land, but you shall tear down their altars.’
Yet you have not obeyed My voice. What is this you have done?
chapters.zh: 你们也不可与这地的居民立约，要拆毁他们的祭坛。你们竟没有听从我的话！为何这样行呢？』

chapters.en: So now I tell you that I will not drive out these people before you; they will be thorns in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.”
chapters.zh: 因此我又说：『我必不将他们从你们面前赶出；他们必作你们肋下的〔荆棘〕。他们的神必作你们的网罗。』」

chapters.en: When the angel of the LORD had spoken these words to all the Israelites, the people lifted up their voices and wept.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者向以色列众人说这话的时候，百姓就放声而哭；

chapters.en: So they called that place Bochim and offered sacrifices there to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 于是给那地方起名叫波金〔注：就是哭的意思〕。众人在那里向耶和华献祭。

chapters.en: After Joshua had dismissed the people, the Israelites went out to take possession of the land, each to his own inheritance.
chapters.zh: 从前约书亚打发以色列百姓去的时候，他们各归自己的地业，占据地土。

chapters.en: And the people served the LORD throughout the days of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him, who had seen all the great works that the LORD had done for Israel.
chapters.zh: 约书亚在世和约书亚死后，那些见耶和华为以色列人所行大事的长老还在的时候，百姓都事奉耶和华。

chapters.en: And Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of 110.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的仆人、嫩的儿子约书亚，正一百一十岁就死了。

chapters.en: They buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath-heres in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
chapters.zh: 以色列人将他葬在他地业的境内，就是在以法莲山地的亭拿‧希烈，在迦实山的北边。

chapters.en: After that whole generation had also been gathered to their fathers, another generation rose up who did not know the LORD or the works that He had done for Israel.
chapters.zh: 那世代的人也都归了自己的列祖。后来有别的世代兴起，不知道耶和华，也不知道耶和华为以色列人所行的事。

chapters.en: And the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD and served the Baals.
chapters.zh: 以色列人行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，去事奉诸巴力，

chapters.en: Thus they forsook the LORD, the God of their fathers, who had brought them out of the land of Egypt, and they followed after various gods of the peoples around them. They bowed down to them and provoked the LORD to anger,
chapters.zh: 离弃了领他们出埃及地的耶和华－他们列祖的上帝，去叩拜别神，就是四围列国的神，惹耶和华发怒；

chapters.en: for they forsook Him and served Baal and the Ashtoreths.
chapters.zh: 并离弃耶和华，去事奉巴力和亚斯她录。

chapters.en: Then the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He delivered them into the hands of those who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, whom they were no longer able to resist.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，就把他们交在抢夺他们的人手中，又将他们付与四围仇敌的手中，甚至他们在仇敌面前再不能站立得住。

chapters.en: Wherever Israel marched out, the hand of the LORD was against them to bring calamity, just as He had sworn to them. So they were greatly distressed.
chapters.zh: 他们无论往何处去，耶和华都以灾祸攻击他们，正如耶和华所说的话，又如耶和华向他们所起的誓；他们便极其困苦。

chapters.en: Then the LORD raised up judges, who saved them from the hands of those who plundered them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华兴起士师，士师就拯救他们脱离抢夺他们人的手。

chapters.en: Israel, however, did not listen to their judges. Instead, they prostituted themselves with other gods and bowed down to them. They quickly turned from the way of their fathers, who had walked in obedience to the LORD’s commandments; they did not do as their fathers had done.
chapters.zh: 他们却不听从士师，竟随从叩拜别神，行了邪淫，速速地偏离他们列祖所行的道，不如他们列祖顺从耶和华的命令。

chapters.en: Whenever the LORD raised up a judge for the Israelites, He was with that judge and saved them from the hands of their enemies while the judge was still alive; for the LORD was moved to pity by their groaning under those who oppressed them and afflicted them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华为他们兴起士师，就与那士师同在。士师在世的一切日子，耶和华拯救他们脱离仇敌的手。他们因受欺压扰害，就哀声叹气，所以耶和华后悔了。

chapters.en: But when the judge died, the Israelites became even more corrupt than their fathers, going after other gods to serve them and bow down to them. They would not give up their evil practices and stubborn ways.
chapters.zh: 及至士师死后，他们就转去行恶，比他们列祖更甚，去事奉叩拜别神，总不断绝顽梗的恶行。

chapters.en: So the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He said, “Because this nation has transgressed the covenant I laid down for their fathers and has not heeded My voice,
chapters.zh: 于是耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作。他说：「因这民违背我吩咐他们列祖所守的约，不听从我的话，

chapters.en: I will no longer drive out before them any of the nations Joshua left when he died.
chapters.zh: 所以约书亚死的时候所剩下的各族，我必不再从他们面前赶出，

chapters.en: In this way I will test whether Israel will keep the way of the LORD by walking in it as their fathers did.”
chapters.zh: 为要借此试验以色列人，看他们肯照他们列祖谨守遵行我的道不肯。」

chapters.en: That is why the LORD had left those nations in place and had not driven them out immediately by delivering them into the hand of Joshua.
chapters.zh: 这样耶和华留下各族，不将他们速速赶出，也没有交付约书亚的手。

chapters.en: These are the nations that the LORD left to test all the Israelites who had not known any of the wars in Canaan,
chapters.zh: 耶和华留下这几族，为要试验那不曾知道与迦南争战之事的以色列人，

chapters.en: if only to teach warfare to the subsequent generations of Israel, especially to those who had not known it formerly:
chapters.zh: 好叫以色列的后代又知道又学习未曾晓得的战事。

chapters.en: the five rulers of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived in the mountains of Lebanon from Mount Baal-hermon to Lebo-hamath.
chapters.zh: 所〔留下的〕就是非利士的五个首领和一切迦南人、西顿人，并住黎巴嫩山的希未人，从巴力‧黑们山直到哈马口。

chapters.en: These nations were left to test the Israelites, to find out whether they would keep the commandments of the LORD, which He had given their fathers through Moses.
chapters.zh: 留〔下〕这几族，为要试验以色列人，知道他们肯听从耶和华藉摩西吩咐他们列祖的诫命不肯。

chapters.en: Thus the Israelites continued to live among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
chapters.zh: 以色列人竟住在迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人中间，

chapters.en: And they took the daughters of these people in marriage, gave their own daughters to their sons, and served their gods.
chapters.zh: 娶他们的女儿为妻，将自己的女儿嫁给他们的儿子，并事奉他们的神。

chapters.en: So the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD; they forgot the LORD their God and served the Baals and the Asherahs.
chapters.zh: 以色列人行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，忘记耶和华－他们的上帝，去事奉诸巴力和亚舍拉，

chapters.en: Then the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He sold them into the hand of Cushan-rishathaim king of Aram-naharaim, and the Israelites served him eight years.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，就把他们交在美索不达米亚王古珊‧利萨田的手中。以色列人服事古珊‧利萨田八年。

chapters.en: But when the Israelites cried out to the LORD, He raised up Othniel son of Caleb’s younger brother Kenaz as a deliverer to save them.
chapters.zh: 以色列人呼求耶和华的时候，耶和华就为他们兴起一位拯救者救他们，就是迦勒兄弟基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂。

chapters.en: The Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he became Israel’s judge and went out to war. And the LORD delivered Cushan-rishathaim king of Aram into the hand of Othniel, who prevailed against him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的灵降在他身上，他就作了以色列的士师，出去争战。耶和华将美索不达米亚王古珊‧利萨田交在他手中，他便胜了古珊‧利萨田。

chapters.en: So the land had rest for forty years, until Othniel son of Kenaz died.
chapters.zh: 于是国中太平四十年。基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂死了。

chapters.en: Once again the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD. So He gave Eglon king of Moab power over Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，耶和华就使摩押王伊矶伦强盛，攻击以色列人。

chapters.en: After enlisting the Ammonites and Amalekites to join forces with him, Eglon attacked and defeated Israel, taking possession of the City of Palms.
chapters.zh: 伊矶伦招聚亚扪人和亚玛力人，去攻打以色列人，占据棕树城。

chapters.en: The Israelites served Eglon king of Moab eighteen years.
chapters.zh: 于是以色列人服事摩押王伊矶伦十八年。

chapters.en: And again they cried out to the LORD, and He raised up Ehud son of Gera, a left-handed Benjamite, as their deliverer. So they sent him with tribute to Eglon king of Moab.
chapters.zh: 以色列人呼求耶和华的时候，耶和华就为他们兴起一位拯救者，就是便雅悯人基拉的儿子以笏；他是左手便利的。以色列人讬他送礼物给摩押王伊矶伦。

chapters.en: Now Ehud had made for himself a double-edged sword a cubit long. He strapped it to his right thigh under his cloak
chapters.zh: 以笏打了一把两刃的剑，长一肘，带在右腿上衣服里面。

chapters.en: and brought the tribute to Eglon king of Moab, who was an obese man.
chapters.zh: 他将礼物献给摩押王伊矶伦（原来伊矶伦极其肥胖）；

chapters.en: After Ehud had finished presenting the tribute, he ushered out those who had carried it.
chapters.zh: 以笏献完礼物，便将抬礼物的人打发走了，

chapters.en:
But upon reaching the idols near Gilgal, he himself turned back and said, “I have a secret message for you, O king.”
“Silence,” said the king, and all his attendants left him.
chapters.zh: 自己却从靠近吉甲凿石之地回来，说：「王啊，我有一件机密事奏告你。」王说：「回避吧！」于是左右侍立的人都退去了。

chapters.en: Then Ehud approached him while he was sitting alone in the coolness of his upper room. “I have a word from God for you,” Ehud said, and the king rose from his seat.
chapters.zh: 以笏来到王面前；王独自一人坐在凉楼上。以笏说：「我奉上帝的命报告你一件事。」王就从座位上站起来。

chapters.en: And Ehud reached with his left hand, pulled the sword from his right thigh, and plunged it into Eglon’s belly.
chapters.zh: 以笏便伸左手，从右腿上拔出剑来，刺入王的肚腹，

chapters.en: Even the handle sank in after the blade, and Eglon’s fat closed in over it, so that Ehud did not withdraw the sword from his belly. And Eglon’s bowels emptied.
chapters.zh: 连剑把都刺进去了。剑被肥肉夹住，他没有从王的肚腹拔出来，且穿通了后身。

chapters.en: Then Ehud went out through the porch, closing and locking the doors of the upper room behind him.
chapters.zh: 以笏就出到游廊，将楼门尽都关锁。

chapters.en: After Ehud was gone, Eglon’s servants came in and found the doors of the upper room locked. “He must be relieving himself in the cool room,” they said.
chapters.zh: 以笏出来之后，王的仆人到了，看见楼门关锁，就说：「他必是在楼上大解。」

chapters.en: So they waited until they became worried and saw that he had still not opened the doors of the upper room. Then they took the key and opened the doors—and there was their lord lying dead on the floor.
chapters.zh: 他们等烦了，见仍不开楼门，就拿钥匙开了，不料，他们的主人已死，倒在地上。

chapters.en: Ehud, however, had escaped while the servants waited. He passed by the idols and escaped to Seirah.
chapters.zh: 他们耽延的时候，以笏就逃跑了，经过凿石之地，逃到西伊拉；

chapters.en: On arriving in Seirah, he blew the ram’s horn throughout the hill country of Ephraim. The Israelites came down with him from the hills, and he became their leader.
chapters.zh: 到了，就在以法莲山地吹角。以色列人随着他下了山地，他在前头引路，

chapters.en:
“Follow me,” he told them, “for the LORD has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.”
So they followed him down and seized the fords of the Jordan leading to Moab, and they did not allow anyone to cross over.
chapters.zh: 对他们说：「你们随我来，因为耶和华已经把你们的仇敌摩押人交在你们手中。」于是他们跟着他下去，把守约旦河的渡口，不容摩押一人过去。

chapters.en: At that time they struck down about ten thousand Moabites, all robust and valiant men. Not one of them escaped.
chapters.zh: 那时击杀了摩押人约有一万，都是强壮的勇士，没有一人逃脱。

chapters.en: So Moab was subdued under the hand of Israel that day, and the land had rest for eighty years.
chapters.zh: 这样，摩押就被以色列人制伏了。国中太平八十年。

chapters.en: After Ehud came Shamgar son of Anath. And he too saved Israel, striking down six hundred Philistines with an oxgoad.
chapters.zh: 以笏之后，有亚拿的儿子珊迦，他用赶牛的棍子打死六百非利士人。他也救了以色列人。

chapters.en: After Ehud died, the Israelites again did evil in the sight of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以笏死后，以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，

chapters.en: So the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor. The commander of his forces was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth-hagoyim.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就把他们付与在夏琐作王的迦南王耶宾手中；他的将军是西西拉，住在外邦人的夏罗设。

chapters.en: Then the Israelites cried out to the LORD, because Jabin had nine hundred chariots of iron, and he had harshly oppressed the Israelites for twenty years.
chapters.zh: 耶宾王有铁车九百辆。他大大欺压以色列人二十年，以色列人就呼求耶和华。

chapters.en: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, was judging Israel at that time.
chapters.zh: 有一位女先知名叫底波拉，是拉比多的妻，当时作以色列的士师。

chapters.en: And she would sit under the Palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, where the Israelites would go up to her for judgment.
chapters.zh: 她住在以法莲山地拉玛和伯特利中间，在底波拉的棕树下。以色列人都上她那里去听判断。

chapters.en: She summoned Barak son of Abinoam from Kedesh in Naphtali and said to him, “Surely the LORD, the God of Israel, is commanding you: ‘Go and march to Mount Tabor, taking with you ten thousand men of Naphtali and Zebulun.
chapters.zh: 她打发人从拿弗他利的基低斯将亚比挪菴的儿子巴拉召了来，对他说：「耶和华－以色列的上帝吩咐你说：『你率领一万拿弗他利和西布伦人上他泊山去。

chapters.en: And I will draw out Sisera the commander of Jabin’s army, his chariots, and his troops to the River Kishon, and I will deliver him into your hand.’”
chapters.zh: 我必使耶宾的将军西西拉率领他的车辆和全军往基顺河，到你那里去；我必将他交在你手中。』」

chapters.en: Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.”
chapters.zh: 巴拉说：「你若同我去，我就去；你若不同我去，我就不去。」

chapters.en: “I will certainly go with you,” Deborah replied, “but the road you are taking will bring you no honor, because the LORD will be selling Sisera into the hand of a woman.” So Deborah got up and went with Barak to Kedesh,
chapters.zh: 底波拉说：「我必与你同去，只是你在所行的路上得不着荣耀，因为耶和华要将西西拉交在一个妇人手里。」于是底波拉起来，与巴拉一同往基低斯去了。

chapters.en: where he summoned Zebulun and Naphtali. Ten thousand men followed him, and Deborah also went with him.
chapters.zh: 巴拉就招聚西布伦人和拿弗他利人到基低斯，跟他上去的有一万人。底波拉也同他上去。

chapters.en: Now Heber the Kenite had moved away from the Kenites, the descendants of Hobab the father-in-law of Moses, and had pitched his tent by the great tree of Zaanannim, which was near Kedesh.
chapters.zh: 摩西岳父〔注：或译：内兄〕何巴的后裔，基尼人希百曾离开基尼族，到靠近基低斯、撒拿音的橡树旁支搭帐棚。

chapters.en: When Sisera was told that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up Mount Tabor,
chapters.zh: 有人告诉西西拉说：「亚比挪菴的儿子巴拉已经上他泊山了。」

chapters.en: he summoned all nine hundred of his iron chariots and all the men with him, from Harosheth-hagoyim to the River Kishon.
chapters.zh: 西西拉就聚集所有的铁车九百辆和跟随他的全军，从外邦人的夏罗设出来，到了基顺河。

chapters.en:
Then Deborah said to Barak, “Arise, for this is the day that the LORD has delivered Sisera into your hand. Has not the LORD gone before you?”
So Barak came down from Mount Tabor with ten thousand men following him.
chapters.zh: 底波拉对巴拉说：「你起来，今日就是耶和华将西西拉交在你手的日子。耶和华岂不在你前头行吗？」于是巴拉下了他泊山，跟随他有一万人。

chapters.en: And in front of him the LORD routed with the sword Sisera, all his charioteers, and all his army. Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled on foot.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使西西拉和他一切车辆全军溃乱，在巴拉面前被刀杀败；西西拉下车步行逃跑。

chapters.en: Then Barak pursued the chariots and army as far as Harosheth-hagoyim, and the whole army of Sisera fell by the sword; not a single man was left.
chapters.zh: 巴拉追赶车辆、军队，直到外邦人的夏罗设。西西拉的全军都倒在刀下，没有留下一人。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Sisera had fled on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, because there was peace between Jabin king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
chapters.zh: 只有西西拉步行逃跑，到了基尼人希百之妻雅亿的帐棚，因为夏琐王耶宾与基尼人希百家和好。

chapters.en: Jael went out to greet Sisera and said to him, “Come in, my lord. Come in with me. Do not be afraid.” So he entered her tent, and she covered him with a blanket.
chapters.zh: 雅亿出来迎接西西拉，对他说：「请我主进来，不要惧怕」；西西拉就进了她的帐棚。雅亿用被将他遮盖。

chapters.en: Sisera said to her, “Please give me a little water to drink, for I am thirsty.” So she opened a container of milk, gave him a drink, and covered him again.
chapters.zh: 西西拉对雅亿说：「我渴了，求你给我一点水喝。」雅亿就打开皮袋，给他奶子喝，仍旧把他遮盖。

chapters.en: “Stand at the entrance to the tent,” he said, “and if anyone comes and asks you, ‘Is there a man here?’ say, ‘No.’”
chapters.zh: 西西拉又对雅亿说：「请你站在帐棚门口，若有人来问你说：『有人在这里没有？』你就说：『没有。』」

chapters.en: But as he lay sleeping from exhaustion, Heber’s wife Jael took a tent peg, grabbed a hammer, and went silently to Sisera. She drove the peg through his temple and into the ground, and he died.
chapters.zh: 西西拉疲乏沉睡。希百的妻雅亿取了帐棚的橛子，手里拿着锤子，轻悄悄地到他旁边，将橛子从他鬓边钉进去，钉入地里。西西拉就死了。

chapters.en: When Barak arrived in pursuit of Sisera, Jael went out to greet him and said to him, “Come, and I will show you the man you are seeking.” So he went in with her, and there lay Sisera dead, with a tent peg through his temple.
chapters.zh: 巴拉追赶西西拉的时候，雅亿出来迎接他说：「来吧，我将你所寻找的人给你看。」他就进入帐棚，看见西西拉已经死了，倒在地上，橛子还在他鬓中。

chapters.en: On that day God subdued Jabin king of Canaan before the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 这样，上帝使迦南王耶宾被以色列人制伏了。

chapters.en: And the hand of the Israelites grew stronger and stronger against Jabin king of Canaan until they destroyed him.
chapters.zh: 从此以色列人的手越发有力，胜了迦南王耶宾，直到将他灭绝了。

chapters.en: On that day Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang this song:
chapters.zh: 那时，底波拉和亚比挪菴的儿子巴拉作歌，说：

chapters.en:
“When the princes take the lead in Israel, when the people volunteer,
bless the LORD.
chapters.zh: 因为以色列中有军长率领， 百姓也甘心牺牲自己， 你们应当颂赞耶和华！

chapters.en: Listen, O kings! Give ear, O princes! I will sing to the LORD; I will sing praise to the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 君王啊，要听！ 王子啊，要侧耳而听！ 我要向耶和华歌唱； 我要歌颂耶和华－以色列的上帝。

chapters.en: O LORD, when You went out from Seir, when You marched from the land of Edom, the earth trembled, the heavens poured out rain, and the clouds poured down water.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你从西珥出来， 由以东地行走。 那时地震天漏， 云也落〔雨〕。

chapters.en: The mountains quaked before the LORD, the One of Sinai, before the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 山见耶和华的面就震动， 西奈山见耶和华－以色列上帝的面也是如此。

chapters.en: In the days of Shamgar son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were deserted and the travelers took the byways.
chapters.zh: 在亚拿之子珊迦的时候， 又在雅亿的日子， 大道无人行走， 都是绕道而行。

chapters.en: Life in the villages ceased; it ended in Israel, until I, Deborah, arose, a mother in Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列中的官长停职， 直到我底波拉兴起， 等我兴起作以色列的母。

chapters.en: When they chose new gods, then war came to their gates. Not a shield or spear was found among forty thousand in Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列人选择新神， 争战的事就临到城门。 那时，以色列四万人中 岂能见盾牌枪矛呢？

chapters.en:
My heart is with the princes of Israel, with the volunteers among the people.
Bless the LORD!
chapters.zh: 我心倾向以色列的首领， 他们在民中甘心牺牲自己。 你们应当颂赞耶和华！

chapters.en:
You who ride white donkeys, who sit on saddle blankets,
and you who travel the road, ponder
chapters.zh: 骑白驴的、坐绣花毯子的、行路的， 你们都当传扬！

chapters.en:
the voices of the singers at the watering places. There they shall recount the righteous acts of the LORD, the righteous deeds of His villagers in Israel.
Then the people of the LORD went down to the gates:
chapters.zh: 在远离弓箭响声打水之处， 人必述说耶和华公义的作为， 就是他治理以色列公义的作为。 那时耶和华的民下到城门。

chapters.en: ‘Awake, awake, O Deborah! Awake, awake, sing a song! Arise, O Barak, and take hold of your captives, O son of Abinoam!’
chapters.zh: 底波拉啊，兴起！兴起！ 你当兴起，兴起，唱歌。 亚比挪菴的儿子巴拉啊，你当奋兴， 掳掠你的敌人。

chapters.en: Then the survivors came down to the nobles; the people of the LORD came down to me against the mighty.
chapters.zh: 那时有余剩的贵胄和百姓一同下来； 耶和华降临，为我攻击勇士。

chapters.en: Some came from Ephraim, with their roots in Amalek; Benjamin came with your people after you. The commanders came down from Machir, the bearers of the marshal’s staff from Zebulun.
chapters.zh: 有根本在亚玛力〔人的地〕， 从以法莲〔下来〕的； 便雅悯在民中跟随你。 有掌权的从玛吉下来； 有持杖检点民数的从西布伦下来；

chapters.en:
The princes of Issachar were with Deborah, and Issachar was with Barak,
rushing into the valley at his heels. In the clans of Reuben there was great indecision.
chapters.zh: 以萨迦的首领与底波拉同来； 以萨迦怎样，巴拉也怎样。 众人都跟随巴拉冲下平原； 在吕便的溪水旁有心中定大志的。

chapters.en: Why did you sit among the sheepfolds to hear the whistling for the flocks? In the clans of Reuben there was great indecision.
chapters.zh: 你为何坐在羊圈内 听群中吹笛的声音呢？ 在吕便的溪水旁有心中设大谋的。

chapters.en: Gilead remained beyond the Jordan. Dan, why did you linger by the ships? Asher stayed at the coast and remained in his harbors.
chapters.zh: 基列人安居在约旦河外。 但人为何等在船上？ 亚设人在海口静坐， 在港口安居。

chapters.en: Zebulun was a people who risked their lives; Naphtali, too, on the heights of the battlefield.
chapters.zh: 西布伦人是拼命敢死的； 拿弗他利人在田野的高处也是如此。

chapters.en: Kings came and fought; then the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by the waters of Megiddo, but they took no plunder of silver.
chapters.zh: 君王都来争战。 那时迦南诸王在米吉多水旁的他纳争战， 却未得掳掠银钱。

chapters.en: From the heavens the stars fought; from their courses they fought against Sisera.
chapters.zh: 星宿从天上争战， 从其轨道攻击西西拉。

chapters.en:
The River Kishon swept them away, the ancient river, the River Kishon.
March on, O my soul, in strength!
chapters.zh: 基顺古河把敌人冲没； 我的灵啊，应当努力前行。

chapters.en: Then the hooves of horses thundered— the mad galloping of his stallions.
chapters.zh: 那时壮马驰驱， 踢跳，奔腾。

chapters.en: ‘Curse Meroz,’ says the angel of the LORD. ‘Bitterly curse her inhabitants; for they did not come to help the LORD, to help the LORD against the mighty.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者说： 应当咒诅米罗斯， 大大咒诅其中的居民； 因为他们不来帮助耶和华， 不来帮助耶和华攻击勇士。

chapters.en:
Most blessed among women is Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite,
most blessed of tent-dwelling women.
chapters.zh: 愿基尼人希百的妻雅亿比众妇人多得福气， 比住帐棚的妇人更蒙福祉。

chapters.en: He asked for water, and she gave him milk. In a magnificent bowl she brought him curds.
chapters.zh: 西西拉求水， 雅亿给他奶子， 用宝贵的盘子给他奶油。

chapters.en: She reached for the tent peg, her right hand for the workman’s hammer. She struck Sisera and crushed his skull; she shattered and pierced his temple.
chapters.zh: 雅亿左手拿着帐棚的橛子， 右手拿着匠人的锤子， 击打西西拉， 打伤他的头， 把他的鬓角打破穿通。

chapters.en: At her feet he collapsed, he fell, there he lay still; at her feet he collapsed, he fell; where he collapsed, there he fell dead.
chapters.zh: 西西拉在她脚前曲身仆倒， 在她脚前曲身倒卧； 在那里曲身，就在那里死亡。

chapters.en: Sisera’s mother looked through the window; she peered through the lattice and lamented: ‘Why is his chariot so long in coming? What has delayed the clatter of his chariots?’
chapters.zh: 西西拉的母亲从窗户里往外观看， 从窗櫺中呼叫说： 他的战车为何耽延不来呢？ 他的车轮为何行得慢呢？

chapters.en: Her wisest ladies answer; indeed she keeps telling herself,
chapters.zh: 聪明的宫女安慰她〔注：原文是回答她〕， 她也自言自语地说：

chapters.en:
‘Are they not finding and dividing the spoil— a girl or two for each warrior, a plunder of dyed garments for Sisera, the spoil of embroidered garments
for the neck of the looter?’
chapters.zh: 他们莫非得财而分？ 每人得了一两个女子？ 西西拉得了彩衣为掳物， 得绣花的彩衣为掠物。 这彩衣两面绣花， 乃是披在被掳之人颈项上的。

chapters.en:
So may all Your enemies perish, O LORD! But may those who love You shine like the sun at its brightest.”
And the land had rest for forty years.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊， 愿你的仇敌都这样灭亡！ 愿爱你的人如日头出现，光辉烈烈！ 这样，国中太平四十年。

chapters.en: Again the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD; so He delivered them into the hand of Midian for seven years,
chapters.zh: 以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，耶和华就把他们交在米甸人手里七年。

chapters.en: and the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel. Because of the Midianites, the Israelites prepared shelters for themselves in the mountains, caves, and strongholds.
chapters.zh: 米甸人压制以色列人；以色列人因为米甸人，就在山中挖穴、挖洞、建造营寨。

chapters.en: Whenever the Israelites planted their crops, the Midianites, Amalekites, and other people of the east would come up and invade them,
chapters.zh: 以色列人每逢撒种之后，米甸人、亚玛力人，和东方人都上来攻打他们，

chapters.en: encamping against them as far as Gaza and destroying the produce of the land. They left Israel with no sustenance, neither sheep nor oxen nor donkeys.
chapters.zh: 对着他们安营，毁坏土产，直到迦萨，没有给以色列人留下食物，牛、羊、驴也没有留下；

chapters.en: For the Midianites came with their livestock and their tents like a great swarm of locusts. They and their camels were innumerable, and they entered the land to ravage it.
chapters.zh: 因为那些人带着牲畜帐棚来，像蝗虫那样多，人和骆驼无数，都进入国内，毁坏全地。

chapters.en: Israel was greatly impoverished by Midian, and the Israelites cried out to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以色列人因米甸人的缘故，极其穷乏，就呼求耶和华。

chapters.en: Now when the Israelites cried out to the LORD because of Midian,
chapters.zh: 以色列人因米甸人的缘故，呼求耶和华，

chapters.en: He sent them a prophet, who told them, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I brought you up out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就差遣先知到以色列人那里，对他们说：「耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：『我曾领你们从埃及上来，出了为奴之家，

chapters.en: I delivered you out of the hands of Egypt and all your oppressors. I drove them out before you and gave you their land.
chapters.zh: 救你们脱离埃及人的手，并脱离一切欺压你们之人的手，把他们从你们面前赶出，将他们的地赐给你们』；

chapters.en: And I said to you: ‘I am the LORD your God. You must not fear the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell.’ But you did not obey Me.”
chapters.zh: 又对你们说：『我是耶和华－你们的上帝。你们住在亚摩利人的地，不可敬畏他们的神。你们竟不听从我的话。』」

chapters.en: Then the angel of the LORD came and sat down under the oak in Ophrah that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite, where his son Gideon was threshing wheat in a winepress to hide it from the Midianites.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者到了俄弗拉，坐在亚比以谢族人约阿施的橡树下。约阿施的儿子基甸正在酒醡那里打麦子，为要防备米甸人。

chapters.en: And the angel of the LORD appeared to Gideon and said, “The LORD is with you, O mighty man of valor.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者向基甸显现，对他说：「大能的勇士啊，耶和华与你同在！」

chapters.en: “Please, my Lord,” Gideon replied, “if the LORD is with us, why has all this happened to us? And where are all His wonders of which our fathers told us, saying, ‘Has not the LORD brought us up out of Egypt?’ But now the LORD has forsaken us and delivered us into the hand of Midian.”
chapters.zh: 基甸说：「主啊，耶和华若与我们同在，我们何致遭遇这一切事呢？我们的列祖不是向我们说『耶和华领我们从埃及上来』吗？他那样奇妙的作为在哪里呢？现在他却丢弃我们，将我们交在米甸人手里。」

chapters.en: The LORD turned to him and said, “Go in the strength you have and save Israel from the hand of Midian. Am I not sending you?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华观看基甸，说：「你靠着你这能力去从米甸人手里拯救以色列人，不是我差遣你去的吗？」

chapters.en: “Please, my Lord,” Gideon replied, “how can I save Israel? Indeed, my clan is the weakest in Manasseh, and I am the youngest in my father’s house.”
chapters.zh: 基甸说：「主啊，我有何能拯救以色列人呢？我家在玛拿西支派中是至贫穷的。我在我父家是至微小的。」

chapters.en: “Surely I will be with you,” the LORD replied, “and you will strike down all the Midianites as one man.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对他说：「我与你同在，你就必击打米甸人，如击打一人一样。」

chapters.en: Gideon answered, “If I have found favor in Your sight, give me a sign that it is You speaking with me.
chapters.zh: 基甸说：「我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你给我一个证据，使我知道与我说话的就是主。

chapters.en:
Please do not depart from this place until I return to You. Let me bring my offering and set it before You.”
And the LORD said, “I will stay until you return.”
chapters.zh: 求你不要离开这里，等我归回将礼物带来供在你面前。」主说：「我必等你回来。」

chapters.en: So Gideon went in and prepared a young goat and unleavened bread and an ephah of flour. He placed the meat in a basket and the broth in a pot and brought them out to present to Him under the oak.
chapters.zh: 基甸去预备了一只山羊羔，用一伊法细面做了无酵饼，将肉放在筐内，把汤盛在壶中，带到橡树下，献在使者面前。

chapters.en: And the angel of God said to him, “Take the meat and the unleavened bread, lay them on this rock, and pour out the broth.” And Gideon did so.
chapters.zh: 上帝的使者吩咐基甸说：「将肉和无酵饼放在这磐石上，把汤倒出来。」他就这样行了。

chapters.en: Then the angel of the LORD extended the tip of the staff that was in his hand and touched the meat and the unleavened bread. And fire flared from the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened bread. Then the angel of the LORD vanished from his sight.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者伸出手内的杖，杖头挨了肉和无酵饼，就有火从磐石中出来，烧尽了肉和无酵饼。耶和华的使者也就不见了。

chapters.en: When Gideon realized that it was the angel of the LORD, he said, “Oh no, Lord GOD! I have seen the angel of the LORD face to face!”
chapters.zh: 基甸见他是耶和华的使者，就说：「哀哉！主耶和华啊，我不好了，因为我觌面看见耶和华的使者。」

chapters.en: But the LORD said to him, “Peace be with you. Do not be afraid, for you will not die.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对他说：「你放心，不要惧怕，你必不致死。」

chapters.en: So Gideon built an altar to the LORD there and called it The LORD Is Peace. To this day it stands in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
chapters.zh: 于是基甸在那里为耶和华筑了一座坛，起名叫「耶和华沙龙」〔注：就是耶和华赐平安的意思〕。（这坛在亚比以谢族的俄弗拉直到如今。）

chapters.en: On that very night the LORD said to Gideon, “Take your father’s young bull and a second bull seven years old, tear down your father’s altar to Baal, and cut down the Asherah pole beside it.
chapters.zh: 当那夜，耶和华吩咐基甸说：「你取你父亲的牛来，就是〔注：或译：和〕那七岁的第二只牛，并拆毁你父亲为巴力所筑的坛，砍下坛旁的木偶，

chapters.en: Then build a proper altar to the LORD your God on the top of this stronghold. And with the wood of the Asherah pole you cut down, take the second bull and offer it as a burnt offering.”
chapters.zh: 在这磐石〔注：原文是保障〕上整整齐齐地为耶和华－你的上帝筑一座坛，将第二只牛献为燔祭，用你所砍下的木偶作柴。」

chapters.en: So Gideon took ten of his servants and did as the LORD had told him. But because he was too afraid of his father’s household and the men of the city, he did it by night rather than in the daytime.
chapters.zh: 基甸就从他仆人中挑了十个人，照着耶和华吩咐他的行了。他因怕父家和本城的人，不敢在白昼行这事，就在夜间行了。

chapters.en: When the men of the city got up in the morning, there was Baal’s altar torn down, with the Asherah pole cut down beside it and the second bull offered up on the newly built altar.
chapters.zh: 城里的人清早起来，见巴力的坛拆毁，坛旁的木偶砍下，第二只牛献在新筑的坛上，

chapters.en:
“Who did this?” they said to one another.
And after they had investigated thoroughly, they were told, “Gideon son of Joash did it.”
chapters.zh: 就彼此说：「这事是谁做的呢？」他们访查之后，就说：「这是约阿施的儿子基甸做的。」

chapters.en: Then the men of the city said to Joash, “Bring out your son. He must die, because he has torn down Baal’s altar and cut down the Asherah pole beside it.”
chapters.zh: 城里的人对约阿施说：「将你儿子交出来，好治死他；因为他拆毁了巴力的坛，砍下坛旁的木偶。」

chapters.en: But Joash said to all who stood against him, “Are you contending for Baal? Are you trying to save him? Whoever pleads his case will be put to death by morning! If Baal is a god, let him contend for himself with the one who has torn down his altar.”
chapters.zh: 约阿施回答站着攻击他的众人说：「你们是为巴力争论吗？你们要救他吗？谁为他争论，趁早将谁治死！巴力若果是神，有人拆毁他的坛，让他为自己争论吧！」

chapters.en: So on that day Gideon was called Jerubbaal, that is to say, “Let Baal contend with him,” because he had torn down Baal’s altar.
chapters.zh: 所以当日人称基甸为耶路‧巴力，意思说：「他拆毁巴力的坛，让巴力与他争论。」

chapters.en: Then all the Midianites, Amalekites, and other people of the east gathered together, crossed over the Jordan, and camped in the Valley of Jezreel.
chapters.zh: 那时，米甸人、亚玛力人，和东方人都聚集过河，在耶斯列平原安营。

chapters.en: So the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, who blew the ram’s horn and rallied the Abiezrites behind him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的灵降在基甸身上，他就吹角；亚比以谢族都聚集跟随他。

chapters.en: Calling them to arms, Gideon sent messengers throughout Manasseh, as well as Asher, Zebulun, and Naphtali, so that they came up to meet him.
chapters.zh: 他打发人走遍玛拿西地，玛拿西人也聚集跟随他；又打发人去见亚设人、西布伦人、拿弗他利人，他们也都出来与他们会合。

chapters.en: Then Gideon said to God, “If You are going to save Israel by my hand, as You have said,
chapters.zh: 基甸对上帝说：「你若果照着所说的话，藉我手拯救以色列人，

chapters.en: then behold, I will place a fleece of wool on the threshing floor. If there is dew only on the fleece and all the ground is dry, then I will know that You are going to save Israel by my hand, as You have said.”
chapters.zh: 我就把一团羊毛放在禾场上：若单是羊毛上有露水，别的地方都是干的，我就知道你必照着所说的话，藉我手拯救以色列人。」

chapters.en: And that is what happened. When Gideon arose the next morning, he squeezed the fleece and wrung out the dew—a bowlful of water.
chapters.zh: 次日早晨基甸起来，见果然是这样；将羊毛挤一挤，从羊毛中拧出满盆的露水来。

chapters.en: Then Gideon said to God, “Do not be angry with me; let me speak one more time. Please allow me one more test with the fleece. This time let it be dry, and the ground covered with dew.”
chapters.zh: 基甸又对上帝说：「求你不要向我发怒，我再说这一次：让我将羊毛再试一次。但愿羊毛是干的，别的地方都有露水。」

chapters.en: And that night God did so. Only the fleece was dry, and dew covered the ground.
chapters.zh: 这夜上帝也如此行：独羊毛上是干的，别的地方都有露水。

chapters.en: Early in the morning Jerubbaal (that is, Gideon) and all the men with him camped beside the spring of Harod. And the camp of Midian was north of them in the valley near the hill of Moreh.
chapters.zh: 耶路‧巴力就是基甸，他和一切跟随的人早晨起来，在哈律泉旁安营。米甸营在他们北边的平原，靠近摩利冈。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Gideon, “You have too many men for Me to deliver Midian into their hands, lest Israel glorify themselves over Me, saying, ‘My own hand has saved me.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华对基甸说：「跟随你的人过多，我不能将米甸人交在他们手中，免得以色列人向我夸大，说：『是我们自己的手救了我们。』

chapters.en:
Now, therefore, proclaim in the hearing of the men: ‘Whoever is fearful and trembling may turn back and leave Mount Gilead.’”
So twenty-two thousand of them turned back, but ten thousand remained.
chapters.zh: 现在你要向这些人宣告说：『凡惧怕胆怯的，可以离开基列山回去。』」于是有二万二千人回去，只剩下一万。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Gideon, “There are still too many men. Take them down to the water, and I will sift them for you there. If I say to you, ‘This one shall go with you,’ he shall go. But if I say, ‘This one shall not go with you,’ he shall not go.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对基甸说：「人还是过多；你要带他们下到水旁，我好在那里为你试试他们。我指点谁说：『这人可以同你去』，他就可以同你去；我指点谁说：『这人不可同你去』，他就不可同你去。」

chapters.en: So Gideon brought the men down to the water, and the LORD said to him, “Separate those who lap the water with their tongues like a dog from those who kneel to drink.”
chapters.zh: 基甸就带他们下到水旁。耶和华对基甸说：「凡用舌头舔水，像狗舔的，要使他单站在一处；凡跪下喝水的，也要使他单站在一处。」

chapters.en: And the number of those who lapped the water with their hands to their mouths was three hundred men; all the others knelt to drink.
chapters.zh: 于是用手捧着舔水的有三百人，其余的都跪下喝水。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Gideon, “With the three hundred men who lapped the water I will save you and deliver the Midianites into your hand. But all the others are to go home.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对基甸说：「我要用这舔水的三百人拯救你们，将米甸人交在你手中；其余的人都可以各归各处去。」

chapters.en: So Gideon sent the rest of the Israelites to their tents but kept the three hundred men, who took charge of the provisions and rams’ horns of the others. And the camp of Midian lay below him in the valley.
chapters.zh: 这三百人就带着食物和角；其余的以色列人，基甸都打发他们各归各的帐棚，只留下这三百人。米甸营在他下边的平原里。

chapters.en: That night the LORD said to Gideon, “Get up and go down against the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.
chapters.zh: 当那夜，耶和华吩咐基甸说：「起来，下到〔米甸〕营里去，因我已将他们交在你手中。

chapters.en: But if you are afraid to do so, then go down to the camp with your servant Purah
chapters.zh: 倘若你怕下去，就带你的仆人普拉下到那营里去。

chapters.en: and listen to what they are saying. Then your hands will be strengthened to attack the camp.” So he went with Purah his servant to the outposts where armed men were guarding the camp.
chapters.zh: 你必听见他们所说的，然后你就有胆量下去攻营。」于是基甸带着仆人普拉下到营旁。

chapters.en: Now the Midianites, Amalekites, and all the other people of the east had settled in the valley like a swarm of locusts, and their camels were as countless as the sand on the seashore.
chapters.zh: 米甸人、亚玛力人，和一切东方人都布散在平原，如同蝗虫那样多。他们的骆驼无数，多如海边的沙。

chapters.en: And as Gideon arrived, a man was telling his friend about a dream. “Behold, I had a dream,” he said, “and I saw a loaf of barley bread come tumbling into the Midianite camp. It struck the tent so hard that the tent overturned and collapsed.”
chapters.zh: 基甸到了，就听见一人将梦告诉同伴说：「我做了一梦，梦见一个大麦饼滚入米甸营中，到了帐幕，将帐幕撞倒，帐幕就翻转倾覆了。」

chapters.en: His friend replied: “This is nothing less than the sword of Gideon son of Joash, the Israelite. God has delivered Midian and the whole camp into his hand.”
chapters.zh: 那同伴说：「这不是别的，乃是以色列人约阿施的儿子基甸的刀；上帝已将米甸和全军都交在他的手中。」

chapters.en: When Gideon heard the dream and its interpretation, he bowed in worship. He returned to the camp of Israel and said, “Get up, for the LORD has delivered the camp of Midian into your hand.”
chapters.zh: 基甸听见这梦和梦的讲解，就敬拜〔上帝〕，回到以色列营中，说：「起来吧！耶和华已将米甸的军队交在你们手中了。」

chapters.en: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies and gave each man a ram’s horn in one hand and a large jar in the other, containing a torch.
chapters.zh: 于是基甸将三百人分作三队，把角和空瓶交在各人手里（瓶内都藏着火把），

chapters.en: “Watch me and do as I do,” Gideon said. “When I come to the outskirts of the camp, do exactly as I do.
chapters.zh: 吩咐他们说：「你们要看我行事：我到了营的旁边怎样行，你们也要怎样行。

chapters.en: When I and all who are with me blow our horns, then you are also to blow your horns from all around the camp and shout, ‘For the LORD and for Gideon!’”
chapters.zh: 我和一切跟随我的人吹角的时候，你们也要在营的四围吹角，〔喊叫〕说：『耶和华和基甸〔的刀〕！』」

chapters.en: Gideon and the hundred men with him reached the outskirts of the camp at the beginning of the middle watch, just after the changing of the guard. They blew their horns and broke the jars that were in their hands.
chapters.zh: 基甸和跟随他的一百人，在三更之初才换更的时候，来到营旁，就吹角，打破手中的瓶。

chapters.en: The three companies blew their horns and shattered their jars. Holding the torches in their left hands and the horns in their right hands, they shouted, “A sword for the LORD and for Gideon!”
chapters.zh: 三队的人就都吹角，打破瓶子，左手拿着火把，右手拿着角，喊叫说：「耶和华和基甸的刀！」

chapters.en: Each Israelite took his position around the camp, and the entire Midianite army fled, crying out as they ran.
chapters.zh: 他们在营的四围各站各的地方；全营的人都乱窜。三百人吶喊，使他们逃跑。

chapters.en: And when the three hundred rams’ horns sounded, the LORD set all the men in the camp against one another with their swords. The army fled to Beth-shittah toward Zererah as far as the border of Abel-meholah near Tabbath.
chapters.zh: 三百人就吹角，耶和华使全营的人用刀互相击杀，逃到西利拉的伯‧哈示他，直逃到靠近他巴的亚伯‧米何拉。

chapters.en: Then the men of Israel were called out from Naphtali, Asher, and all Manasseh, and they pursued the Midianites.
chapters.zh: 以色列人就从拿弗他利、亚设，和玛拿西全地聚集来追赶米甸人。

chapters.en: Gideon sent messengers throughout the hill country of Ephraim to say, “Come down against the Midianites and seize the waters of the Jordan ahead of them as far as Beth-barah.” So all the men of Ephraim were called out, and they captured the waters of the Jordan as far as Beth-barah.
chapters.zh: 基甸打发人走遍以法莲山地，说：「你们下来攻击米甸人，争先把守约旦河的渡口，直到伯‧巴拉。」于是以法莲的众人聚集，把守约旦河的渡口，直到伯‧巴拉，

chapters.en: They also captured Oreb and Zeeb, the two princes of Midian; and they killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb and Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb. So they pursued the Midianites and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side of the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 捉住了米甸人的两个首领：一名俄立，一名西伊伯；将俄立杀在俄立磐石上，将西伊伯杀在西伊伯酒醡那里；又追赶米甸人，将俄立和西伊伯的首级带过约旦河，到基甸那里。

chapters.en: Then the men of Ephraim said to Gideon, “Why have you done this to us? Why did you fail to call us when you went to fight against Midian?” And they contended with him violently.
chapters.zh: 以法莲人对基甸说：「你去与米甸人争战，没有招我们同去，为什么这样待我们呢？」他们就与基甸大大地争吵。

chapters.en: But Gideon answered them, “Now what have I accomplished compared to you? Are not the gleanings of Ephraim better than the grape harvest of Abiezer?
chapters.zh: 基甸对他们说：「我所行的岂能比你们所行的呢？以法莲拾取剩下的葡萄不强过亚比以谢所摘的葡萄吗？

chapters.en: God has delivered Oreb and Zeeb, the two princes of Midian, into your hand. What was I able to do compared to you?” When he had said this, their anger against him subsided.
chapters.zh: 上帝已将米甸人的两个首领俄立和西伊伯交在你们手中；我所行的岂能比你们所行的呢？」基甸说了这话，以法莲人的怒气就消了。

chapters.en: Then Gideon and his three hundred men came to the Jordan and crossed it, exhausted yet still in pursuit.
chapters.zh: 基甸和跟随他的三百人到约旦河过渡，虽然疲乏，还是追赶。

chapters.en: So Gideon said to the men of Succoth, “Please give my troops some bread, for they are exhausted, and I am still pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”
chapters.zh: 基甸对疏割人说：「求你们拿饼来给跟随我的人吃，因为他们疲乏了；我们追赶米甸人的两个王西巴和撒慕拿。」

chapters.en: But the leaders of Succoth asked, “Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna already in your possession, that we should give bread to your army?”
chapters.zh: 疏割人的首领回答说：「西巴和撒慕拿已经在你手里，你使我们将饼给你的军兵吗？」

chapters.en: “Very well,” Gideon replied, “when the LORD has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, I will tear your flesh with the thorns and briers of the wilderness!”
chapters.zh: 基甸说：「耶和华将西巴和撒慕拿交在我手之后，我就用野地的荆条和枳棘打伤你们。」

chapters.en: From there he went up to Penuel and asked the same from them, but the men of Penuel gave the same response as the men of Succoth.
chapters.zh: 基甸从那里上到毗努伊勒，对那里的人也是这样说；毗努伊勒人也与疏割人回答他的话一样。

chapters.en: So Gideon told the men of Penuel, “When I return in triumph, I will tear down this tower!”
chapters.zh: 他向毗努伊勒人说：「我平平安安回来的时候，我必拆毁这楼。」

chapters.en: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor with their army of about fifteen thousand men—all that were left of the armies of the people of the east. A hundred and twenty thousand swordsmen had already fallen.
chapters.zh: 那时西巴和撒慕拿，并跟随他们的军队都在加各，约有一万五千人，就是东方人全军所剩下的；已经被杀约有十二万拿刀的。

chapters.en: And Gideon went up by way of the caravan route east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and he attacked their army, taking them by surprise.
chapters.zh: 基甸就由挪巴和约比哈东边，从住帐棚人的路上去，杀败了米甸人的军兵，因为他们坦然无惧。

chapters.en: When Zebah and Zalmunna fled, Gideon pursued and captured these two kings of Midian, routing their entire army.
chapters.zh: 西巴和撒慕拿逃跑；基甸追赶他们，捉住米甸的二王西巴和撒慕拿，惊散全军。

chapters.en: After this, Gideon son of Joash returned from the battle along the Ascent of Heres.
chapters.zh: 约阿施的儿子基甸由希列斯坡从阵上回来，

chapters.en: There he captured a young man of Succoth and interrogated him. The young man wrote down for him the names of the seventy-seven leaders and elders of Succoth.
chapters.zh: 捉住疏割的一个少年人，问他：「疏割的首领长老是谁？」他就将首领长老七十七个人的名字写出来。

chapters.en: And Gideon went to the men of Succoth and said, “Here are Zebah and Zalmunna, about whom you taunted me, saying, ‘Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna already in your possession, that we should give bread to your weary men?’”
chapters.zh: 基甸到了疏割，对那里的人说：「你们从前讥诮我说：『西巴和撒慕拿已经在你手里，你使我们将饼给〔跟随〕你的疲乏人吗？』现在西巴和撒慕拿在这里。」

chapters.en: Then he took the elders of the city, and using the thorns and briers of the wilderness, he disciplined the men of Succoth.
chapters.zh: 于是捉住那城内的长老，用野地的荆条和枳棘责打〔注：原文是指教〕疏割人；

chapters.en: He also pulled down the tower of Penuel and killed the men of the city.
chapters.zh: 又拆了毗努伊勒的楼，杀了那城里的人。

chapters.en:
Next, Gideon asked Zebah and Zalmunna, “What kind of men did you kill at Tabor?”
“Men like you,” they answered, “each one resembling the son of a king.”
chapters.zh: 基甸问西巴和撒慕拿说：「你们在他泊山所杀的人是什么样式？」回答说：「他们好像你，各人都有王子的样式。」

chapters.en: “They were my brothers,” Gideon replied, “the sons of my mother! As surely as the LORD lives, if you had let them live, I would not kill you.”
chapters.zh: 基甸说：「他们是我同母的弟兄，我指着永生的耶和华起誓，你们从前若存留他们的性命，我如今就不杀你们了。」

chapters.en: So he said to Jether, his firstborn, “Get up and kill them.” But the young man did not draw his sword; he was fearful because he was still a youth.
chapters.zh: 于是对他的长子益帖说：「你起来杀他们。」但益帖因为是童子，害怕，不敢拔刀。

chapters.en: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, “Get up and kill us yourself, for as the man is, so is his strength.” So Gideon got up and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and he took the crescent ornaments from the necks of their camels.
chapters.zh: 西巴和撒慕拿说：「你自己起来杀我们吧！因为人如何，力量也是如何。」基甸就起来，杀了西巴和撒慕拿，夺获他们骆驼项上戴的月牙圈。

chapters.en: Then the Israelites said to Gideon, “Rule over us—you and your son and grandson—for you have saved us from the hand of Midian.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人对基甸说：「你既救我们脱离米甸人的手，愿你和你的儿孙管理我们。」

chapters.en: But Gideon replied, “I will not rule over you, nor will my son. The LORD shall rule over you.”
chapters.zh: 基甸说：「我不管理你们，我的儿子也不管理你们，惟有耶和华管理你们。」

chapters.en: Then he added, “Let me make a request of you, that each of you give me an earring from his plunder.” (For the enemies had gold earrings because they were Ishmaelites.)
chapters.zh: 基甸又对他们说：「我有一件事求你们：请你们各人将所夺的耳环给我。」（原来仇敌是以实玛利人，都是戴金耳环的。）

chapters.en:
“We will give them gladly,” they replied.
So they spread out a garment, and each man threw an earring from his plunder onto it.
chapters.zh: 他们说：「我们情愿给你」，就铺开一件外衣，各人将所夺的耳环丢在其上。

chapters.en: The weight of the gold earrings he had requested was 1,700 shekels, in addition to the crescent ornaments, the pendants, the purple garments of the kings of Midian, and the chains from the necks of their camels.
chapters.zh: 基甸所要出来的金耳环重一千七百〔舍客勒〕金子。此外还有米甸王所戴的月环、耳坠，和所穿的紫色衣服，并骆驼项上的〔金〕鍊子。

chapters.en: From all this Gideon made an ephod, which he placed in Ophrah, his hometown. But soon all Israel prostituted themselves by worshiping it there, and it became a snare to Gideon and his household.
chapters.zh: 基甸以此制造了一个以弗得，设立在本城俄弗拉。后来以色列人拜那以弗得行了邪淫；这就作了基甸和他全家的网罗。

chapters.en: In this way Midian was subdued before the Israelites and did not raise its head again. So the land had rest for forty years in the days of Gideon,
chapters.zh: 这样，米甸人被以色列人制伏了，不敢再抬头。基甸还在的日子，国中太平四十年。

chapters.en: and he—Jerubbaal son of Joash—returned home and settled down.
chapters.zh: 约阿施的儿子耶路‧巴力回去，住在自己家里。

chapters.en: Gideon had seventy sons of his own, since he had many wives.
chapters.zh: 基甸有七十个亲生的儿子，因为他有许多的妻。

chapters.en: His concubine, who dwelt in Shechem, also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.
chapters.zh: 他的妾住在示剑，也给他生了一个儿子。基甸与他起名叫亚比米勒。

chapters.en: Later, Gideon son of Joash died at a ripe old age and was buried in the tomb of his father Joash in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
chapters.zh: 约阿施的儿子基甸，年纪老迈而死，葬在亚比以谢族的俄弗拉，在他父亲约阿施的坟墓里。

chapters.en: And as soon as Gideon was dead, the Israelites turned and prostituted themselves with the Baals, and they set up Baal-berith as their god.
chapters.zh: 基甸死后，以色列人又去随从诸巴力行邪淫，以巴力‧比利土为他们的神。

chapters.en: The Israelites failed to remember the LORD their God who had delivered them from the hands of all their enemies on every side.
chapters.zh: 以色列人不记念耶和华－他们的上帝，就是拯救他们脱离四围仇敌之手的，

chapters.en: They did not show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal (that is, Gideon) for all the good things he had done for Israel.
chapters.zh: 也不照着耶路‧巴力，就是基甸向他们所施的恩惠厚待他的家。

chapters.en: Now Abimelech son of Jerubbaal went to his mother’s brothers at Shechem and said to them and to all the clan of his mother,
chapters.zh: 耶路‧巴力的儿子亚比米勒到了示剑见他的众母舅，对他们和他外祖全家的人说：

chapters.en: “Please ask all the leaders of Shechem, ‘Is it better for you that seventy men, all the sons of Jerubbaal, rule over you, or just one man?’ Remember that I am your own flesh and blood.”
chapters.zh: 「请你们问示剑的众人说，是耶路‧巴力的众子七十人都管理你们好呢？还是一人管理你们好呢？你们又要记念我是你们的骨肉。」

chapters.en: And when his mother’s brothers spoke all these words about him in the presence of all the leaders of Shechem, their hearts were inclined to follow Abimelech, for they said, “He is our brother.”
chapters.zh: 他的众母舅便将这一切话为他说给示剑人听，示剑人的心就归向亚比米勒。他们说：「他原是我们的弟兄」；

chapters.en: So they gave him seventy shekels of silver from the temple of Baal-berith, with which Abimelech hired some worthless and reckless men to follow him.
chapters.zh: 就从巴力‧比利土的庙中取了七十〔舍客勒〕银子给亚比米勒；亚比米勒用以雇了些匪徒跟随他。

chapters.en: He went to his father’s house in Ophrah, and on one stone murdered his seventy brothers, the sons of Jerubbaal. But Jotham, the youngest son of Jerubbaal, survived, because he hid himself.
chapters.zh: 他往俄弗拉到他父亲的家，将他弟兄、耶路‧巴力的众子七十人都杀在一块磐石上；只剩下耶路‧巴力的小儿子约坦，因为他躲藏了。

chapters.en: Then all the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo gathered beside the oak at the pillar in Shechem and proceeded to make Abimelech their king.
chapters.zh: 示剑人和米罗人都一同聚集，往示剑橡树旁的柱子那里，立亚比米勒为王。

chapters.en:
When this was reported to Jotham, he climbed to the top of Mount Gerizim, raised his voice, and cried out:
“Listen to me, O leaders of Shechem, and may God listen to you.
chapters.zh: 有人将这事告诉约坦，他就去站在基利心山顶上，向众人大声喊叫说：「示剑人哪，你们要听我的话，上帝也就听你们的话。

chapters.en: One day the trees set out to anoint a king for themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’
chapters.zh: 有一时，树木要膏一树为王，管理他们，就去对橄榄树说：『请你作我们的王。』

chapters.en: But the olive tree replied, ‘Should I stop giving my oil that honors both God and man, to hold sway over the trees?’
chapters.zh: 橄榄树回答说：『我岂肯止住供奉神和尊重人的油，飘飖在众树之上呢？』

chapters.en: Then the trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and reign over us.’
chapters.zh: 树木对无花果树说：『请你来作我们的王。』

chapters.en: But the fig tree replied, ‘Should I stop giving my sweetness and my good fruit, to hold sway over the trees?’
chapters.zh: 无花果树回答说：『我岂肯止住所结甜美的果子，飘飖在众树之上呢？』

chapters.en: Then the trees said to the grapevine, ‘Come and reign over us.’
chapters.zh: 树木对葡萄树说：『请你来作我们的王。』

chapters.en: But the grapevine replied, ‘Should I stop giving my wine that cheers both God and man, to hold sway over the trees?’
chapters.zh: 葡萄树回答说：『我岂肯止住使神和人喜乐的新酒，飘飖在众树之上呢？』

chapters.en: Finally all the trees said to the thornbush, ‘Come and reign over us.’
chapters.zh: 众树对荆棘说：『请你来作我们的王。』

chapters.en:
But the thornbush replied, ‘If you really are anointing me as king over you,
come and find refuge in my shade. But if not, may fire come out of the thornbush and consume the cedars of Lebanon.’
chapters.zh: 荆棘回答说：『你们若诚诚实实地膏我为王，就要投在我的荫下；不然，愿火从荆棘里出来，烧灭黎巴嫩的香柏树。』

chapters.en: Now if you have acted faithfully and honestly in making Abimelech king, if you have done well by Jerubbaal and his family, and if you have done to him as he deserves—
chapters.zh: 「现在你们立亚比米勒为王，若按诚实正直善待耶路‧巴力和他的全家，这就是酬他的劳。

chapters.en: for my father fought for you and risked his life to deliver you from the hand of Midian,
chapters.zh: 从前我父冒死为你们争战，救了你们脱离米甸人的手。

chapters.en: but you have risen up against my father’s house this day and killed his seventy sons on a single stone, and you have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the leaders of Shechem because he is your brother—
chapters.zh: 你们如今起来攻击我的父家，将他众子七十人杀在一块磐石上，又立他婢女所生的儿子亚比米勒为示剑人的王；他原是你们的弟兄。

chapters.en: if you have acted faithfully and honestly toward Jerubbaal and his house this day, then may you rejoice in Abimelech, and he in you.
chapters.zh: 你们如今若按诚实正直待耶路‧巴力和他的家，就可因亚比米勒得欢乐，他也可因你们得欢乐；

chapters.en: But if not, may fire come from Abimelech and consume the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo, and may fire come from the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo and consume Abimelech.”
chapters.zh: 不然，愿火从亚比米勒发出，烧灭示剑人和米罗众人，又愿火从示剑人和米罗人中出来，烧灭亚比米勒。」

chapters.en: Then Jotham ran away, escaping to Beer, and he lived there for fear of his brother Abimelech.
chapters.zh: 约坦因怕他弟兄亚比米勒，就逃跑，来到比珥，住在那里。

chapters.en: After Abimelech had reigned over Israel for three years,
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒管理以色列人三年。

chapters.en: God sent a spirit of animosity between Abimelech and the leaders of Shechem and caused them to treat Abimelech deceitfully,
chapters.zh: 上帝使恶魔降在亚比米勒和示剑人中间，示剑人就以诡诈待亚比米勒。

chapters.en: in order that the crime against the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come to justice and their blood be avenged on their brother Abimelech and on the leaders of Shechem, who had helped him murder his brothers.
