chapters.zh: 这是要叫耶路‧巴力七十个儿子所受的残害归与他们的哥哥亚比米勒，又叫那流他们血的罪归与帮助他杀弟兄的示剑人。

chapters.en: The leaders of Shechem set up an ambush against Abimelech on the hilltops, and they robbed all who passed by them on the road. So this was reported to Abimelech.
chapters.zh: 示剑人在山顶上设埋伏，等候亚比米勒。凡从他们那里经过的人，他们就抢夺。有人将这事告诉亚比米勒。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Gaal son of Ebed came with his brothers and crossed into Shechem, and the leaders of Shechem put their confidence in him.
chapters.zh: 以别的儿子迦勒和他的弟兄来到示剑，示剑人都信靠他。

chapters.en: And after they had gone out into the fields, gathered grapes from their vineyards, and trodden them, they held a festival and went into the house of their god; and as they ate and drank, they cursed Abimelech.
chapters.zh: 示剑人出城到田间去，摘下葡萄，踹酒，设摆筵宴，进他们神的庙中吃喝，咒诅亚比米勒。

chapters.en: Then Gaal son of Ebed said, “Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? Is he not the son of Jerubbaal, and is not Zebul his officer? You are to serve the men of Hamor, the father of Shechem. Why should we serve Abimelech?
chapters.zh: 以别的儿子迦勒说：「亚比米勒是谁？示剑是谁？使我们服事他呢？他不是耶路‧巴力的儿子吗？他的帮手不是西布勒吗？你们可以服事示剑的父亲哈抹的后裔。我们为何服事亚比米勒呢？

chapters.en: If only this people were under my authority, I would remove Abimelech; I would say to him, ‘Muster your army and come out!’”
chapters.zh: 惟愿这民归我的手下，我就除掉亚比米勒。」迦勒又对亚比米勒说：「增添你的军兵出来吧。」

chapters.en: When Zebul the governor of the city heard the words of Gaal son of Ebed, he burned with anger.
chapters.zh: 邑宰西布勒听见以别的儿子迦勒的话，就发怒，

chapters.en: So he covertly sent messengers to Abimelech to say, “Look, Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem and are stirring up the city against you.
chapters.zh: 悄悄地打发人去见亚比米勒，说：「以别的儿子迦勒和他的弟兄到了示剑，煽惑城中的民攻击你。

chapters.en: Now then, tonight you and the people with you are to come and lie in wait in the fields.
chapters.zh: 现在你和跟随你的人今夜起来，在田间埋伏。

chapters.en: And in the morning at sunrise, get up and advance against the city. When Gaal and his men come out against you, do to them whatever you are able.”
chapters.zh: 到早晨太阳一出，你就起来闯城。迦勒和跟随他的人出来攻击你的时候，你便向他们见机而做。」

chapters.en: So Abimelech and all his troops set out by night and lay in wait against Shechem in four companies.
chapters.zh: 于是，亚比米勒和跟随他的众人夜间起来，分作四队，埋伏等候示剑人。

chapters.en: Now Gaal son of Ebed went out and stood at the entrance of the city gate just as Abimelech and his men came out from their hiding places.
chapters.zh: 以别的儿子迦勒出去，站在城门口。亚比米勒和跟随他的人从埋伏之处起来。

chapters.en:
When Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, “Look, people are coming down from the mountains!”
But Zebul replied, “The shadows of the mountains look like men to you.”
chapters.zh: 迦勒看见那些人，就对西布勒说：「看哪，有人从山顶上下来了。」西布勒说：「你看见山的影子，以为是人。」

chapters.en: Then Gaal spoke up again, “Look, people are coming down from the center of the land, and one company is coming by way of the Diviners’ Oak. ”
chapters.zh: 迦勒又说：「看哪，有人从高处下来，又有一队从米恶尼尼橡树的路上而来。」

chapters.en: “Where is your gloating now?” Zebul replied. “You said, ‘Who is Abimelech that we should serve him?’ Are these not the people you ridiculed? Go out now and fight them!”
chapters.zh: 西布勒对他说：「你曾说，亚比米勒是谁，叫我们服事他？你所〔夸〕的口在哪里呢？这不是你所藐视的民吗？你现在出去，与他们交战吧！」

chapters.en: So Gaal went out before the leaders of Shechem and fought against Abimelech,
chapters.zh: 于是迦勒率领示剑人出去，与亚比米勒交战。

chapters.en: but Abimelech pursued him, and Gaal fled before him. And many Shechemites fell wounded all the way to the entrance of the gate.
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒追赶迦勒；迦勒在他面前逃跑，有许多受伤仆倒的，直到城门。

chapters.en: Abimelech stayed in Arumah, and Zebul drove Gaal and his brothers out of Shechem.
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒住在亚鲁玛。西布勒赶出迦勒和他弟兄，不准他们住在示剑。

chapters.en: The next day the people of Shechem went out into the fields, and this was reported to Abimelech.
chapters.zh: 次日，民出到田间，有人告诉亚比米勒；

chapters.en: So he took his men, divided them into three companies, and lay in wait in the fields. When he saw the people coming out of the city, he rose up against them and attacked them.
chapters.zh: 他就把他的人分作三队，埋伏在田间，看见示剑人从城里出来，就起来击杀他们。

chapters.en: Then Abimelech and the companies with him rushed forward and took their stand at the entrance of the city gate. The other two companies rushed against all who were in the fields and struck them down.
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒和跟随他的一队向前闯去，站在城门口；那两队直闯到田间，击杀了众人。

chapters.en: And all that day Abimelech fought against the city until he had captured it and killed its people. Then he demolished the city and sowed it with salt.
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒整天攻打城，将城夺取，杀了其中的居民，将城拆毁，撒上了盐。

chapters.en: On hearing of this, all the leaders in the tower of Shechem entered the inner chamber of the temple of El-berith.
chapters.zh: 示剑楼的人听见了，就躲入巴力‧比利土庙的卫所。

chapters.en: And when Abimelech was told that all the leaders in the tower of Shechem were gathered there,
chapters.zh: 有人告诉亚比米勒说：「示剑楼的人都聚在一处。」

chapters.en: he and all his men went up to Mount Zalmon. Abimelech took his axe in his hand and cut a branch from the trees, which he lifted to his shoulder, saying to his men, “Hurry and do what you have seen me do.”
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒和跟随他的人就都上撒们山。亚比米勒手拿斧子，砍下一根树枝，扛在肩上，对跟随他的人说：「你们看我所行的，也当赶紧照样行。」

chapters.en: So each man also cut his own branch and followed Abimelech. Then they piled the branches against the inner chamber and set it on fire above them, killing everyone in the tower of Shechem, about a thousand men and women.
chapters.zh: 众人就各砍一枝，跟随亚比米勒，把树枝堆在卫所的四围，放火烧了卫所，以致示剑楼的人都死了，男女约有一千。

chapters.en: Then Abimelech went to Thebez, encamped against it, and captured it.
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒到提备斯，向提备斯安营，就攻取了那城。

chapters.en: But there was a strong tower inside the city, and all the men, women, and leaders of the city fled there. They locked themselves in and went up to the roof of the tower.
chapters.zh: 城中有一座坚固的楼；城里的众人，无论男女，都逃进楼去，关上门，上了楼顶。

chapters.en: When Abimelech came to attack the tower, he approached its entrance to set it on fire.
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒到了楼前攻打，挨近楼门，要用火焚烧。

chapters.en: But a woman dropped an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, crushing his skull.
chapters.zh: 有一个妇人把一块上磨石抛在亚比米勒的头上，打破了他的脑骨。

chapters.en:
He quickly called his armor-bearer, saying, “Draw your sword and kill me, lest they say of me, ‘A woman killed him.’”
So Abimelech’s armor-bearer ran his sword through him, and he died.
chapters.zh: 他就急忙喊叫拿他兵器的少年人，对他说：「拔出你的刀来，杀了我吧！免得人议论我说，他为一个妇人所杀。」于是少年人把他刺透，他就死了。

chapters.en: And when the Israelites saw that Abimelech was dead, they all went home.
chapters.zh: 以色列人见亚比米勒死了，便各回自己的地方去了。

chapters.en: In this way God repaid the wickedness that Abimelech had done to his father in murdering his seventy brothers.
chapters.zh: 这样，上帝报应亚比米勒向他父亲所行的恶，就是杀了弟兄七十个人的恶。

chapters.en: And God also brought all the wickedness of the men of Shechem back upon their own heads. So the curse of Jotham son of Jerubbaal came upon them.
chapters.zh: 示剑人的一切恶，上帝也都报应在他们头上；耶路‧巴力的儿子约坦的咒诅归到他们身上了。

chapters.en: After the time of Abimelech, a man of Issachar, Tola son of Puah, the son of Dodo, rose up to save Israel. He lived in Shamir, in the hill country of Ephraim.
chapters.zh: 亚比米勒以后，有以萨迦人朵多的孙子、普瓦的儿子陀拉兴起，拯救以色列人。他住在以法莲山地的沙密。

chapters.en: Tola judged Israel twenty-three years, and when he died, he was buried in Shamir.
chapters.zh: 陀拉作以色列的士师二十三年，就死了，葬在沙密。

chapters.en: Tola was followed by Jair the Gileadite, who judged Israel twenty-two years.
chapters.zh: 在他以后有基列人睚珥兴起，作以色列的士师二十二年。

chapters.en: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkeys. And they had thirty towns in the land of Gilead, which to this day are called Havvoth-jair.
chapters.zh: 他有三十个儿子，骑着三十匹驴驹。他们有三十座城邑，叫作哈倭特‧睚珥，直到如今，都是在基列地。

chapters.en: When Jair died, he was buried in Kamon.
chapters.zh: 睚珥死了，就葬在加们。

chapters.en: And again the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD. They served the Baals, the Ashtoreths, the gods of Aram, Sidon, and Moab, and the gods of the Ammonites and Philistines. Thus they forsook the LORD and did not serve Him.
chapters.zh: 以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，去事奉诸巴力和亚斯她录，并亚兰的神、西顿的神、摩押的神、亚扪人的神、非利士人的神，离弃耶和华，不事奉他。

chapters.en: So the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He sold them into the hands of the Philistines and Ammonites,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，就把他们交在非利士人和亚扪人的手中。

chapters.en: who that very year harassed and oppressed the Israelites, and they did so for eighteen years to all the Israelites on the other side of the Jordan in Gilead, the land of the Amorites.
chapters.zh: 从那年起，他们扰害欺压约旦河那边、住亚摩利人之基列地的以色列人，共有十八年。

chapters.en: The Ammonites also crossed the Jordan to fight against Judah, Benjamin, and the house of Ephraim, and Israel was in deep distress.
chapters.zh: 亚扪人又渡过约旦河去攻打犹大和便雅悯，并以法莲族。以色列人就甚觉窘迫。

chapters.en: Then the Israelites cried out to the LORD, saying, “We have sinned against You, for we have indeed forsaken our God and served the Baals.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人哀求耶和华说：「我们得罪了你；因为离弃了我们上帝，去事奉诸巴力。」

chapters.en: The LORD replied, “When the Egyptians, Amorites, Ammonites, Philistines,
chapters.zh: 耶和华对以色列人说：「我岂没有〔救过你们〕脱离埃及人、亚摩利人、亚扪人，和非利士人吗？

chapters.en: Sidonians, Amalekites, and Maonites oppressed you and you cried out to Me, did I not save you from their hands?
chapters.zh: 西顿人、亚玛力人、马云人也都欺压你们；你们哀求我，我也拯救你们脱离他们的手。

chapters.en: But you have forsaken Me and served other gods, so I will no longer save you.
chapters.zh: 你们竟离弃我，事奉别神！所以我不再救你们了。

chapters.en: Go and cry out to the gods you have chosen. Let them save you in your time of trouble.”
chapters.zh: 你们去哀求所选择的神；你们遭遇急难的时候，让他救你们吧！」

chapters.en: “We have sinned,” the Israelites said to the LORD. “Deal with us as You see fit; but please deliver us today!”
chapters.zh: 以色列人对耶和华说：「我们犯罪了，任凭你随意待我们吧！只求你今日拯救我们。」

chapters.en: So they put away the foreign gods from among them and served the LORD, and He could no longer bear the misery of Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列人就除掉他们中间的外邦神，事奉耶和华。耶和华因以色列人受的苦难，就心中担忧。

chapters.en: Then the Ammonites were called to arms and camped in Gilead, and the Israelites assembled and camped at Mizpah.
chapters.zh: 当时亚扪人聚集，安营在基列。以色列人也聚集，安营在米斯巴。

chapters.en: And the rulers of Gilead said to one another, “Whoever will launch the attack against the Ammonites will be the head of all who live in Gilead.”
chapters.zh: 基列的民和众首领彼此商议说：「谁能先去攻打亚扪人，谁必作基列一切居民的领袖。」

chapters.en: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor; he was the son of a prostitute, and Gilead was his father.
chapters.zh: 基列人耶弗他是个大能的勇士，是妓女的儿子。耶弗他是基列所生的。

chapters.en: And Gilead’s wife bore him sons who grew up, drove Jephthah out, and said to him, “You shall have no inheritance in our father’s house, because you are the son of another woman.”
chapters.zh: 基列的妻也生了几个儿子：他妻所生的儿子长大了，就赶逐耶弗他，说：「你不可在我们父家承受产业，因为你是妓女的儿子。」

chapters.en: So Jephthah fled from his brothers and settled in the land of Tob, where worthless men gathered around him and traveled with him.
chapters.zh: 耶弗他就逃避他的弟兄，去住在陀伯地，有些匪徒到他那里聚集，与他一同出入。

chapters.en: Some time later, when the Ammonites fought against Israel
chapters.zh: 过了些日子，亚扪人攻打以色列。

chapters.en: and made war with them, the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah from the land of Tob.
chapters.zh: 亚扪人攻打以色列的时候，基列的长老到陀伯地去，要叫耶弗他回来；

chapters.en: “Come,” they said, “be our commander, so that we can fight against the Ammonites.”
chapters.zh: 对耶弗他说：「请你来作我们的元帅，我们好与亚扪人争战。」

chapters.en: Jephthah replied to the elders of Gilead, “Did you not hate me and expel me from my father’s house? Why then have you come to me now, when you are in distress?”
chapters.zh: 耶弗他回答基列的长老说：「从前你们不是恨我、赶逐我出离父家吗？现在你们遭遇急难为何到我这里来呢？」

chapters.en: They answered Jephthah, “This is why we now turn to you, that you may go with us, fight the Ammonites, and become leader over all of us who live in Gilead.”
chapters.zh: 基列的长老回答耶弗他说：「现在我们到你这里来，是要你同我们去，与亚扪人争战；你可以作基列一切居民的领袖。」

chapters.en: But Jephthah asked them, “If you take me back to fight the Ammonites and the LORD gives them to me, will I really be your leader?”
chapters.zh: 耶弗他对基列的长老说：「你们叫我回去，与亚扪人争战，耶和华把他交给我，我可以作你们的领袖吗？」

chapters.en: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “The LORD is our witness if we do not do as you say.”
chapters.zh: 基列的长老回答耶弗他说：「有耶和华在你我中间作见证，我们必定照你的话行。」

chapters.en: So Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him their leader and commander. And Jephthah repeated all his terms in the presence of the LORD at Mizpah.
chapters.zh: 于是耶弗他同基列的长老回去，百姓就立耶弗他作领袖、作元帅。耶弗他在米斯巴将自己的一切话陈明在耶和华面前。

chapters.en: Then Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the Ammonites, saying, “What do you have against me that you have come to fight against my land?”
chapters.zh: 耶弗他打发使者去见亚扪人的王，说：「你与我有什么相干，竟来到我国中攻打我呢？」

chapters.en: The king of the Ammonites answered Jephthah’s messengers, “When Israel came up out of Egypt, they seized my land, from the Arnon to the Jabbok and all the way to the Jordan. Now, therefore, restore it peaceably.”
chapters.zh: 亚扪人的王回答耶弗他的使者说：「因为以色列人从埃及上来的时候占据我的地，从亚嫩河到雅博河，直到约旦河。现在你要好好地将这〔地〕归还吧！」

chapters.en: Jephthah again sent messengers to the king of the Ammonites
chapters.zh: 耶弗他又打发使者去见亚扪人的王，

chapters.en: to tell him, “This is what Jephthah says: Israel did not take away the land of Moab or of the Ammonites.
chapters.zh: 对他说：「耶弗他如此说，以色列人并没有占据摩押地和亚扪人的地。

chapters.en: But when Israel came up out of Egypt, they traveled through the wilderness to the Red Sea and came to Kadesh.
chapters.zh: 以色列人从埃及上来乃是经过旷野到红海，来到加低斯，

chapters.en: Then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, ‘Please let us pass through your land,’ but the king of Edom would not listen. They also sent messengers to the king of Moab, but he would not consent. So Israel stayed in Kadesh.
chapters.zh: 就打发使者去见以东王，说：『求你容我从你的地经过。』以东王却不应允。又照样打发使者去见摩押王，他也不允准。以色列人就住在加低斯。

chapters.en: Then Israel traveled through the wilderness and bypassed the lands of Edom and Moab. They came to the east side of the land of Moab and camped on the other side of the Arnon. But they did not enter the territory of Moab, since the Arnon was its border.
chapters.zh: 他们又经过旷野，绕着以东和摩押地，从摩押地的东边过来，在亚嫩河边安营，并没有入摩押的境内，因为亚嫩河是摩押的边界。

chapters.en: And Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, and said to him, ‘Please let us pass through your land into our own place.’
chapters.zh: 以色列人打发使者去见亚摩利王西宏，就是希实本的王，对他说：『求你容我们从你的地经过，往我们自己的地方去。』

chapters.en: But Sihon would not trust Israel to pass through his territory. So he gathered all his people, encamped in Jahaz, and fought with Israel.
chapters.zh: 西宏却不信服以色列人，不容他们经过他的境界，乃招聚他的众民在雅杂安营，与以色列人争战。

chapters.en: Then the LORD, the God of Israel, delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, who defeated them. So Israel took possession of all the land of the Amorites who inhabited that country,
chapters.zh: 耶和华－以色列的上帝将西宏和他的众民都交在以色列人手中，以色列人就击杀他们，得了亚摩利人的全地：

chapters.en: seizing all the land from the Arnon to the Jabbok and from the wilderness to the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 从亚嫩河到雅博河，从旷野直到约旦河。

chapters.en: Now since the LORD, the God of Israel, has driven out the Amorites from before His people Israel, should you now possess it?
chapters.zh: 耶和华－以色列的上帝在他百姓以色列面前赶出亚摩利人，你竟要得他们的地吗？

chapters.en: Do you not possess whatever your god Chemosh grants you? So also, we possess whatever the LORD our God has granted us.
chapters.zh: 你的神基抹所赐你的地你不是得为业吗？耶和华－我们的上帝在我们面前所赶出的人，我们就得他的地。

chapters.en: Are you now so much better than Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever contend with Israel or fight against them?
chapters.zh: 难道你比摩押王西拨的儿子巴勒还强吗？他曾与以色列人争竞，或是与他们争战吗？

chapters.en: For three hundred years Israel has lived in Heshbon, Aroer, and their villages, as well as all the cities along the banks of the Arnon. Why did you not take them back during that time?
chapters.zh: 以色列人住希实本和属希实本的乡村，亚罗珥和属亚罗珥的乡村，并沿亚嫩河的一切城邑，已经有三百年了；在这三百年之内，你们为什么没有取回这些地方呢？

chapters.en: I have not sinned against you, but you have done me wrong by waging war against me. May the LORD, the Judge, decide today between the Israelites and the Ammonites.”
chapters.zh: 原来我没有得罪你，你却攻打我，恶待我。愿审判人的耶和华今日在以色列人和亚扪人中间判断是非。」

chapters.en: But the king of the Ammonites paid no heed to the message Jephthah sent him.
chapters.zh: 但亚扪人的王不肯听耶弗他打发人说的话。

chapters.en: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed through Gilead and Manasseh, then through Mizpah of Gilead. And from there he advanced against the Ammonites.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的灵降在耶弗他身上，他就经过基列和玛拿西，来到基列的米斯巴，又从米斯巴来到亚扪人那里。

chapters.en: Jephthah made this vow to the LORD: “If indeed You will deliver the Ammonites into my hand,
chapters.zh: 耶弗他就向耶和华许愿，说：「你若将亚扪人交在我手中，

chapters.en: then whatever comes out the door of my house to greet me on my triumphant return from the Ammonites will belong to the LORD, and I will offer it up as a burnt offering.”
chapters.zh: 我从亚扪人那里平平安安回来的时候，无论什么人，先从我家门出来迎接我，就必归你，我也必将他献上为燔祭。」

chapters.en: So Jephthah crossed over to the Ammonites to fight against them, and the LORD delivered them into his hand.
chapters.zh: 于是耶弗他往亚扪人那里去，与他们争战；耶和华将他们交在他手中，

chapters.en: With a great blow he devastated twenty cities from Aroer to the vicinity of Minnith, as far as Abel-keramim. So the Ammonites were subdued before the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 他就大大杀败他们，从亚罗珥到米匿，直到亚备勒‧基拉明，攻取了二十座城。这样亚扪人就被以色列人制伏了。

chapters.en: And when Jephthah returned home to Mizpah, there was his daughter coming out to meet him with tambourines and dancing! She was his only child; he had no son or daughter besides her.
chapters.zh: 耶弗他回米斯巴到了自己的家，不料，他女儿拿着鼓跳舞出来迎接他，是他独生的，此外无儿无女。

chapters.en: As soon as Jephthah saw her, he tore his clothes and said, “No! Not my daughter! You have brought me to my knees! You have brought great misery upon me, for I have given my word to the LORD and cannot take it back.”
chapters.zh: 耶弗他看见她，就撕裂衣服，说：「哀哉！我的女儿啊，你使我甚是愁苦，叫我作难了；因为我已经向耶和华开口〔许愿〕，不能挽回。」

chapters.en: “My father,” she replied, “you have given your word to the LORD. Do to me as you have said, for the LORD has avenged you of your enemies, the Ammonites.”
chapters.zh: 他女儿回答说：「父啊，你既向耶和华开口，就当照你口中所说的向我行，因耶和华已经在仇敌亚扪人身上为你报仇」；

chapters.en: She also said to her father, “Let me do this one thing: Let me wander for two months through the mountains with my friends and mourn my virginity.”
chapters.zh: 又对父亲说：「有一件事求你允准：容我去两个月，与同伴在山上，好哀哭我终为处女。」

chapters.en:
“Go,” he said. And he sent her away for two months.
So she left with her friends and mourned her virginity upon the mountains.
chapters.zh: 耶弗他说：「你去吧！」就容她去两个月。她便和同伴去了，在山上为她终为处女哀哭。

chapters.en:
After two months, she returned to her father, and he did to her as he had vowed. And she had never had relations with a man.
So it has become a custom in Israel
chapters.zh: 两月已满，她回到父亲那里，父亲就照所许的愿向她行了。女儿终身没有亲近男子。

chapters.en: that each year the young women of Israel go out for four days to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite.
chapters.zh: 此后以色列中有个规矩，每年以色列的女子去为基列人耶弗他的女儿哀哭四天。

chapters.en: Then the men of Ephraim assembled and crossed the Jordan to Zaphon. They said to Jephthah, “Why have you crossed over to fight the Ammonites without calling us to go with you? We will burn your house down with you inside!”
chapters.zh: 以法莲人聚集，到了北方，对耶弗他说：「你去与亚扪人争战，为什么没有招我们同去呢？我们必用火烧你和你的房屋。」

chapters.en: But Jephthah replied, “My people and I had a serious conflict with the Ammonites, and when I called, you did not save me out of their hands.
chapters.zh: 耶弗他对他们说：「我和我的民与亚扪人大大争战；我招你们来，你们竟没有来救我脱离他们的手。

chapters.en: When I saw that you would not save me, I risked my life and crossed over to the Ammonites, and the LORD delivered them into my hand. Why then have you come today to fight against me?”
chapters.zh: 我见你们不来救我，我就拼命前去攻击亚扪人，耶和华将他们交在我手中。你们今日为什么上我这里来攻打我呢？」

chapters.en: Jephthah then gathered all the men of Gilead and fought against Ephraim. And the men of Gilead struck them down because the Ephraimites had said, “You Gileadites are fugitives in Ephraim, living in the territories of Ephraim and Manasseh.”
chapters.zh: 于是耶弗他招聚基列人，与以法莲人争战。基列人击杀以法莲人，是因他们说：「你们基列人在以法莲、玛拿西中间，不过是以法莲逃亡的人。」

chapters.en:
The Gileadites captured the fords of the Jordan leading to Ephraim, and whenever a fugitive from Ephraim would say, “Let me cross over,” the Gileadites would ask him, “Are you an Ephraimite?”
If he answered, “No,”
chapters.zh: 基列人把守约旦河的渡口，不容以法莲人过去。以法莲逃走的人若说：「容我过去。」基列人就问他说：「你是以法莲人不是？」他若说：「不是」，

chapters.en:
they told him, “Please say Shibboleth.”
If he said, “Sibboleth,” because he could not pronounce it correctly, they seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan. So at that time 42,000 Ephraimites were killed.
chapters.zh: 就对他说：「你说『示播列』。」以法莲人因为咬不真字音，便说「西播列」。基列人就将他拿住，杀在约旦河的渡口。那时以法莲人被杀的有四万二千人。

chapters.en: Jephthah judged Israel six years, and when he died, he was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.
chapters.zh: 耶弗他作以色列的士师六年。基列人耶弗他死了，葬在基列的一座城里。

chapters.en: After Jephthah, Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.
chapters.zh: 耶弗他以后，有伯利恒人以比赞作以色列的士师。

chapters.en: He had thirty sons, as well as thirty daughters whom he gave in marriage to men outside his clan; and for his sons he brought back thirty wives from elsewhere. Ibzan judged Israel seven years.
chapters.zh: 他有三十个儿子，三十个女儿；女儿都嫁出去了。他给众子从外乡娶了三十个媳妇。他作以色列的士师七年。

chapters.en: Then Ibzan died, and he was buried in Bethlehem.
chapters.zh: 以比赞死了，葬在伯利恒。

chapters.en: After Ibzan, Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel ten years.
chapters.zh: 以比赞之后，有西布伦人以伦，作以色列的士师十年。

chapters.en: Then Elon the Zebulunite died, and he was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
chapters.zh: 西布伦人以伦死了，葬在西布伦地的亚雅崙。

chapters.en: After Elon, Abdon son of Hillel, from Pirathon, judged Israel.
chapters.zh: 以伦之后，有比拉顿人希列的儿子押顿作以色列的士师。

chapters.en: He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy donkeys. And he judged Israel eight years.
chapters.zh: 他有四十个儿子，三十个孙子，骑着七十匹驴驹。押顿作以色列的士师八年。

chapters.en: Then Abdon son of Hillel, from Pirathon, died, and he was buried at Pirathon in Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.
chapters.zh: 比拉顿人希列的儿子押顿死了，葬在以法莲地的比拉顿，在亚玛力人的山地。

chapters.en: Again the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD, so He delivered them into the hand of the Philistines for forty years.
chapters.zh: 以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，耶和华将他们交在非利士人手中四十年。

chapters.en: Now there was a man from Zorah named Manoah, from the clan of the Danites, whose wife was barren and had no children.
chapters.zh: 那时，有一个琐拉人，是属但族的，名叫玛挪亚。他的妻不怀孕，不生育。

chapters.en: The angel of the LORD appeared to the woman and said to her, “It is true that you are barren and have no children; but you will conceive and give birth to a son.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者向那妇人显现，对她说：「向来你不怀孕，不生育，如今你必怀孕生一个儿子。

chapters.en: Now please be careful not to drink wine or strong drink, and not to eat anything unclean.
chapters.zh: 所以你当谨慎，清酒浓酒都不可喝，一切不洁之物也不可吃。

chapters.en: For behold, you will conceive and give birth to a son. And no razor shall touch his head, because the boy will be a Nazirite to God from the womb, and he will begin the deliverance of Israel from the hand of the Philistines.”
chapters.zh: 你必怀孕生一个儿子，不可用剃头刀剃他的头，因为这孩子一出胎就归上帝作拿细耳人。他必起首拯救以色列人脱离非利士人的手。」

chapters.en: So the woman went and told her husband, “A man of God came to me. His appearance was like the angel of God, exceedingly awesome. I did not ask him where he came from, and he did not tell me his name.
chapters.zh: 妇人就回去对丈夫说：「有一个神人到我面前来，他的相貌如上帝使者的相貌，甚是可畏。我没有问他从哪里来，他也没有将他的名告诉我，

chapters.en: But he said to me, ‘Behold, you will conceive and give birth to a son. Now, therefore, do not drink wine or strong drink, and do not eat anything unclean, because the boy will be a Nazirite to God from the womb until the day of his death.’”
chapters.zh: 却对我说：『你要怀孕生一个儿子，所以清酒浓酒都不可喝，一切不洁之物也不可吃；因为这孩子从出胎一直到死，必归上帝作拿细耳人。』」

chapters.en: Then Manoah prayed to the LORD, “Please, O Lord, let the man of God You sent us come to us again to teach us how to raise the boy who is to be born.”
chapters.zh: 玛挪亚就祈求耶和华说：「主啊，求你再差遣那神人到我们这里来，好指教我们怎样待这将要生的孩子。」

chapters.en: And God listened to the voice of Manoah, and the angel of God returned to the woman as she was sitting in the field; but her husband Manoah was not with her.
chapters.zh: 上帝应允玛挪亚的话；妇人正坐在田间的时候，上帝的使者又到她那里，她丈夫玛挪亚却没有同她在一处。

chapters.en: The woman ran quickly to tell her husband, “Behold, the man who came to me the other day has reappeared!”
chapters.zh: 妇人急忙跑去告诉丈夫说：「那日到我面前来的人，又向我显现。」

chapters.en:
So Manoah got up and followed his wife. When he came to the man, he asked, “Are you the man who spoke to my wife?”
“I am,” he said.
chapters.zh: 玛挪亚起来跟随他的妻来到那人面前，对他说：「与这妇人说话的就是你吗？」他说：「是我。」

chapters.en: Then Manoah asked, “When your words come to pass, what will be the boy’s rule of life and mission?”
chapters.zh: 玛挪亚说：「愿你的话应验！我们当怎样待这孩子，他后来当怎样呢？」

chapters.en: So the angel of the LORD answered Manoah, “Your wife is to do everything I told her.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者对玛挪亚说：「我告诉妇人的一切事，她都当谨慎。

chapters.en: She must not eat anything that comes from the vine, nor drink any wine or strong drink, nor eat anything unclean. She must do everything I have commanded her.”
chapters.zh: 葡萄树所结的都不可吃，清酒浓酒都不可喝，一切不洁之物也不可吃。凡我所吩咐的，她都当遵守。」

chapters.en: “Please stay here,” Manoah said to the angel of the LORD, “and we will prepare a young goat for you.”
chapters.zh: 玛挪亚对耶和华的使者说：「求你容我们款留你，好为你预备一只山羊羔。」

chapters.en: And the angel of the LORD replied, “Even if I stay, I will not eat your food. But if you prepare a burnt offering, offer it to the LORD.” For Manoah did not know that it was the angel of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者对玛挪亚说：「你虽然款留我，我却不吃你的食物，你若预备燔祭就当献与耶和华。」原来玛挪亚不知道他是耶和华的使者。

chapters.en: Then Manoah said to the angel of the LORD, “What is your name, so that we may honor you when your word comes to pass?”
chapters.zh: 玛挪亚对耶和华的使者说：「请将你的名告诉我，到你话应验的时候，我们好尊敬你。」

chapters.en: “Why do you ask my name,” said the angel of the LORD, “since it is beyond comprehension?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者对他说：「你何必问我的名，我名是奇妙的。」

chapters.en: Then Manoah took a young goat and a grain offering and offered them on a rock to the LORD. And as Manoah and his wife looked on, the LORD did a marvelous thing.
chapters.zh: 玛挪亚将一只山羊羔和素祭在磐石上献与耶和华，〔使者〕行奇妙的事；玛挪亚和他的妻观看，

chapters.en:
When the flame went up from the altar to the sky, the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame.
When Manoah and his wife saw this, they fell facedown to the ground.
chapters.zh: 见火焰从坛上往上升，耶和华的使者在坛上的火焰中也升上去了。玛挪亚和他的妻看见，就俯伏于地。

chapters.en: And when the angel of the LORD did not appear again to Manoah and his wife, Manoah realized that it had been the angel of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者不再向玛挪亚和他的妻显现，玛挪亚才知道他是耶和华的使者。

chapters.en: “We are going to die,” he said to his wife, “for we have seen God!”
chapters.zh: 玛挪亚对他的妻说：「我们必要死，因为看见了上帝。」

chapters.en: But his wife replied, “If the LORD had intended to kill us, He would not have accepted the burnt offering and the grain offering from our hands, nor would He have shown us all these things or spoken to us this way.”
chapters.zh: 他的妻却对他说：「耶和华若要杀我们，必不从我们手里收纳燔祭和素祭，并不将这一切事指示我们，今日也不将这些话告诉我们。」

chapters.en: So the woman gave birth to a son and named him Samson. The boy grew, and the LORD blessed him.
chapters.zh: 后来妇人生了一个儿子，给他起名叫参孙。孩子长大，耶和华赐福与他。

chapters.en: And the Spirit of the LORD began to stir him at Mahaneh-dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
chapters.zh: 在玛哈尼‧但，就是琐拉和以实陶中间，耶和华的灵才感动他。

chapters.en: One day Samson went down to Timnah, where he saw a young Philistine woman.
chapters.zh: 参孙下到亭拿，在那里看见一个女子，是非利士人的女儿。

chapters.en: So he returned and told his father and mother, “I have seen a daughter of the Philistines in Timnah. Now get her for me as a wife.”
chapters.zh: 参孙上来禀告他父母说：「我在亭拿看见一个女子，是非利士人的女儿，愿你们给我娶来为妻。」

chapters.en:
But his father and mother replied, “Can’t you find a young woman among your relatives or among any of our people? Must you go to the uncircumcised Philistines to get a wife?”
But Samson told his father, “Get her for me, for she is pleasing to my eyes.”
chapters.zh: 他父母说：「在你弟兄的女儿中，或在本国的民中，岂没有一个女子，何致你去在未受割礼的非利士人中娶妻呢？」参孙对他父亲说：「愿你给我娶那女子，因我喜悦她。」

chapters.en: (Now his father and mother did not know this was from the LORD, who was seeking an occasion to move against the Philistines; for at that time the Philistines were ruling over Israel.)
chapters.zh: 他的父母却不知道这事是出于耶和华，因为他找机会攻击非利士人。那时，非利士人辖制以色列人。

chapters.en: Then Samson went down to Timnah with his father and mother and came to the vineyards of Timnah. Suddenly a young lion came roaring at him,
chapters.zh: 参孙跟他父母下亭拿去，到了亭拿的葡萄园，见有一只少壮狮子向他吼叫。

chapters.en: and the Spirit of the LORD came powerfully upon him, and he tore the lion apart with his bare hands as one would tear a young goat. But he did not tell his father or mother what he had done.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的灵大大感动参孙，他虽然手无器械，却将狮子撕裂，如同撕裂山羊羔一样。他行这事并没有告诉父母。

chapters.en: Then Samson continued on his way down and spoke to the woman, because she was pleasing to his eyes.
chapters.zh: 参孙下去与女子说话，就喜悦她；

chapters.en: When Samson returned later to take her, he left the road to see the lion’s carcass, and in it was a swarm of bees, along with their honey.
chapters.zh: 过了些日子，再下去要娶那女子，转向道旁要看死狮，见有一群蜂子和蜜在死狮之内，

chapters.en: So he scooped some honey into his hands and ate it as he went along. And when he returned to his father and mother, he gave some to them and they ate it. But he did not tell them that he had taken the honey from the lion’s carcass.
chapters.zh: 就用手取蜜，且吃且走；到了父母那里，给他父母，他们也吃了；只是没有告诉这蜜是从死狮之内取来的。

chapters.en: Then his father went to visit the woman, and Samson prepared a feast there, as was customary for the bridegroom.
chapters.zh: 他父亲下去见女子。参孙在那里设摆筵宴，因为向来少年人都有这个规矩。

chapters.en: And when the Philistines saw him, they selected thirty men to accompany him.
chapters.zh: 众人看见参孙，就请了三十个人陪伴他。

chapters.en: “Let me tell you a riddle,” Samson said to them. “If you can solve it for me within the seven days of the feast, I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty sets of clothes.
chapters.zh: 参孙对他们说：「我给你们出一个谜语，你们在七日筵宴之内，若能猜出意思告诉我，我就给你们三十件里衣，三十套衣裳；

chapters.en:
But if you cannot solve it, you must give me thirty linen garments and thirty sets of clothes.”
“Tell us your riddle,” they replied. “Let us hear it.”
chapters.zh: 你们若不能猜出意思告诉我，你们就给我三十件里衣，三十套衣裳。」他们说：「请将谜语说给我们听。」

chapters.en:
So he said to them:
“Out of the eater came something to eat, and out of the strong came something sweet.”
For three days they were unable to explain the riddle.
chapters.zh: 参孙对他们说： 吃的从吃者出来； 甜的从强者出来。 他们三日不能猜出谜语的意思。

chapters.en: So on the fourth day they said to Samson’s wife, “Entice your husband to explain the riddle to us, or we will burn you and your father’s household to death. Did you invite us here to rob us?”
chapters.zh: 到第七天，他们对参孙的妻说：「你诓哄你丈夫，探出谜语的意思告诉我们，免得我们用火烧你和你父家。你们请了我们来，是要夺我们所有的吗？」

chapters.en:
Then Samson’s wife came to him, weeping, and said, “You hate me! You do not really love me! You have posed to my people a riddle, but have not explained it to me.”
“Look,” he said, “I have not even explained it to my father or mother, so why should I explain it to you?”
chapters.zh: 参孙的妻在丈夫面前啼哭说：「你是恨我，不是爱我，你给我本国的人出谜语，却没有将意思告诉我。」参孙回答说：「连我父母我都没有告诉，岂可告诉你呢？」

chapters.en: She wept the whole seven days of the feast, and finally on the seventh day, because she had pressed him so much, he told her the answer. And in turn she explained the riddle to her people.
chapters.zh: 七日筵宴之内，她在丈夫面前啼哭，到第七天逼着他，他才将谜语的意思告诉他妻，他妻就告诉本国的人。

chapters.en:
Before sunset on the seventh day, the men of the city said to Samson:
“What is sweeter than honey? And what is stronger than a lion?”
So he said to them:
“If you had not plowed with my heifer, you would not have solved my riddle!”
chapters.zh: 到第七天，日头未落以前，那城里的人对参孙说： 有什么比蜜还甜呢？ 有什么比狮子还强呢？ 参孙对他们说： 你们若非用我的母牛犊耕地， 就猜不出我谜语的意思来。

chapters.en: Then the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, killed thirty of their men, took their apparel, and gave their clothes to those who had solved the riddle. And burning with anger, Samson returned to his father’s house,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的灵大大感动参孙，他就下到亚实基伦，击杀了三十个人，夺了他们的衣裳，将〔衣裳〕给了猜出谜语的人。参孙发怒，就上父家去了。

chapters.en: and his wife was given to one of the men who had accompanied him.
chapters.zh: 参孙的妻便归了参孙的陪伴，就是作过他朋友的。

chapters.en: Later on, at the time of the wheat harvest, Samson took a young goat and went to visit his wife. “I want to go to my wife in her room,” he said. But her father would not let him enter.
chapters.zh: 过了些日子，到割麦子的时候，参孙带着一只山羊羔去看他的妻，说：「我要进内室见我的妻。」他岳父不容他进去，

chapters.en: “I was sure that you thoroughly hated her,” said her father, “so I gave her to one of the men who accompanied you. Is not her younger sister more beautiful than she? Please take her instead.”
chapters.zh: 说：「我估定你是极其恨她，因此我将她给了你的陪伴。她的妹子不是比她还美丽吗？你可以娶来代替她吧！」

chapters.en: Samson said to them, “This time I will be blameless in doing harm to the Philistines.”
chapters.zh: 参孙说：「这回我加害于非利士人不算有罪。」

chapters.en: Then Samson went out and caught three hundred foxes. And he took torches, turned the foxes tail-to-tail, and fastened a torch between each pair of tails.
chapters.zh: 于是参孙去捉了三百只狐狸〔注：或译：野狗〕，将狐狸尾巴一对一对地捆上，将火把捆在两条尾巴中间，

chapters.en: Then he lit the torches and released the foxes into the standing grain of the Philistines, burning up the piles of grain and the standing grain, as well as the vineyards and olive groves.
chapters.zh: 点着火把，就放狐狸进入非利士人站着的禾稼，将堆集的禾捆和未割的禾稼，并橄榄园尽都烧了。

chapters.en:
“Who did this?” the Philistines demanded.
“It was Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite,” they were told. “For his wife was given to his companion.”
So the Philistines went up and burned her and her father to death.
chapters.zh: 非利士人说：「这事是谁做的呢？」有人说：「是亭拿人的女婿参孙，因为他岳父将他的妻给了他的陪伴。」于是非利士人上去，用火烧了妇人和她的父亲。

chapters.en: And Samson told them, “Because you have done this, I will not rest until I have taken vengeance upon you.”
chapters.zh: 参孙对非利士人说：「你们既然这样行，我必向你们报仇才肯罢休。」

chapters.en: And he struck them ruthlessly with a great slaughter, and then went down and stayed in the cave at the rock of Etam.
chapters.zh: 参孙就大大击杀他们，连腿带腰都砍断了。他便下去，住在以坦磐的穴内。

chapters.en: Then the Philistines went up, camped in Judah, and deployed themselves near the town of Lehi.
chapters.zh: 非利士人上去安营在犹大，布散在利希。

chapters.en:
“Why have you attacked us?” said the men of Judah.
The Philistines replied, “We have come to arrest Samson and pay him back for what he has done to us.”
chapters.zh: 犹大人说：「你们为何上来攻击我们呢？」他们说：「我们上来是要捆绑参孙；他向我们怎样行，我们也要向他怎样行。」

chapters.en:
In response, three thousand men of Judah went to the cave at the rock of Etam, and they asked Samson, “Do you not realize that the Philistines rule over us? What have you done to us?”
“I have done to them what they did to me,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 于是有三千犹大人下到以坦磐的穴内，对参孙说：「非利士人辖制我们，你不知道吗？你向我们行的是什么事呢？」他回答说：「他们向我怎样行，我也要向他们怎样行。」

chapters.en:
But they said to him, “We have come down to arrest you and hand you over to the Philistines.”
Samson replied, “Swear to me that you will not kill me yourselves.”
chapters.zh: 犹大人对他说：「我们下来是要捆绑你，将你交在非利士人手中。」参孙说：「你们要向我起誓，应承你们自己不害死我。」

chapters.en: “No,” they answered, “we will not kill you, but we will tie you up securely and hand you over to them.” So they bound him with two new ropes and led him up from the rock.
chapters.zh: 他们说：「我们断不杀你，只要将你捆绑交在非利士人手中。」于是用两条新绳捆绑参孙，将他从以坦磐带上去。

chapters.en: When Samson arrived in Lehi, the Philistines came out shouting against him. And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him. The ropes on his arms became like burnt flax, and the bonds broke loose from his hands.
chapters.zh: 参孙到了利希，非利士人都迎着喧嚷。耶和华的灵大大感动参孙，他臂上的绳就像火烧的麻一样，他的绑绳都从他手上脱落下来。

chapters.en: He found the fresh jawbone of a donkey, reached out his hand and took it, and struck down a thousand men.
chapters.zh: 他见一块未干的驴腮骨，就伸手拾起来，用以击杀一千人。

chapters.en:
Then Samson said:
“With the jawbone of a donkey I have piled them into heaps. With the jawbone of a donkey I have slain a thousand men.”
chapters.zh: 参孙说： 我用驴腮骨杀人成堆， 用驴腮骨杀了一千人。

chapters.en: And when Samson had finished speaking, he cast the jawbone from his hand; and he named that place Ramath-lehi.
chapters.zh: 说完这话，就把那腮骨从手里抛出去了。那地便叫拉末‧利希。

chapters.en: And being very thirsty, Samson cried out to the LORD, “You have accomplished this great deliverance through Your servant. Must I now die of thirst and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?”
chapters.zh: 参孙甚觉口渴，就求告耶和华说：「你既藉仆人的手施行这么大的拯救，岂可任我渴死、落在未受割礼的人手中呢？」

chapters.en: So God opened up the hollow place in Lehi, and water came out of it. When Samson drank, his strength returned, and he was revived. That is why he named it En-hakkore, and it remains in Lehi to this day.
chapters.zh: 上帝就使利希的洼处裂开，有水从其中涌出来。参孙喝了，精神复原；因此那泉名叫隐‧哈歌利，那泉直到今日还在利希。

chapters.en: And Samson judged Israel for twenty years in the days of the Philistines.
chapters.zh: 当非利士人辖制以色列人的时候，参孙作以色列的士师二十年。

chapters.en: One day Samson went to Gaza, where he saw a prostitute and went in to spend the night with her.
chapters.zh: 参孙到了迦萨，在那里看见一个妓女，就与她亲近。

chapters.en: When the Gazites heard that Samson was there, they surrounded that place and lay in wait for him all night at the city gate. They were quiet throughout the night, saying, “Let us wait until dawn; then we will kill him.”
chapters.zh: 有〔人告诉〕迦萨人说：「参孙到这里来了！」他们就把他团团围住，终夜在城门悄悄埋伏，说：「等到天亮我们便杀他。」

chapters.en: But Samson lay there only until midnight, when he got up, took hold of the doors of the city gate and both gateposts, and pulled them out, bar and all. Then he put them on his shoulders and took them to the top of the mountain overlooking Hebron.
chapters.zh: 参孙睡到半夜，起来，将城门的门扇、门框、门闩，一齐拆下来，扛在肩上，扛到希伯崙前的山顶上。

chapters.en: Some time later, Samson fell in love with a woman in the Valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
chapters.zh: 后来，参孙在梭烈谷喜爱一个妇人，名叫大利拉。

chapters.en: The lords of the Philistines went to her and said, “Entice him and find out the source of his great strength and how we can overpower him to tie him up and subdue him. Then each one of us will give you eleven hundred shekels of silver. ”
chapters.zh: 非利士人的首领上去见那妇人，对她说：「求你诓哄参孙，探探他因何有这么大的力气，我们用何法能胜他，捆绑克制他。我们就每人给你一千一百〔舍客勒〕银子。」

chapters.en: So Delilah said to Samson, “Please tell me the source of your great strength and how you can be tied up and subdued.”
chapters.zh: 大利拉对参孙说：「求你告诉我，你因何有这么大的力气，当用何法捆绑克制你。」

chapters.en: Samson told her, “If they tie me up with seven fresh bowstrings that have not been dried, I will become as weak as any other man.”
chapters.zh: 参孙回答说：「人若用七条未干的青绳子捆绑我，我就软弱像别人一样。」

chapters.en: So the lords of the Philistines brought her seven fresh bowstrings that had not been dried, and she tied him up with them.
chapters.zh: 于是非利士人的首领拿了七条未干的青绳子来，交给妇人，她就用绳子捆绑参孙。

chapters.en:
While the men were hidden in her room, she called out, “Samson, the Philistines are here!”
But he snapped the bowstrings like a strand of yarn seared by a flame. So the source of his strength remained unknown.
chapters.zh: 有人预先埋伏在妇人的内室里。妇人说：「参孙哪，非利士人拿你来了！」参孙就挣断绳子，如挣断经火的麻线一般。这样，他力气〔的根由〕人还是不知道。

chapters.en: Then Delilah said to Samson, “You have mocked me and lied to me! Now please tell me how you can be tied up.”
chapters.zh: 大利拉对参孙说：「你欺哄我，向我说谎言。现在求你告诉我当用何法捆绑你。」

chapters.en: He replied, “If they tie me up with new ropes that have never been used, I will become as weak as any other man.”
chapters.zh: 参孙回答说：「人若用没有使过的新绳捆绑我，我就软弱像别人一样。」

chapters.en:
So Delilah took new ropes, tied him up with them, and called out, “Samson, the Philistines are here!”
But while the men were hidden in her room, he snapped the ropes off his arms like they were threads.
chapters.zh: 大利拉就用新绳捆绑他，对他说：「参孙哪，非利士人拿你来了！」有人预先埋伏在内室里。参孙将臂上的绳挣断了，如挣断一条线一样。

chapters.en:
Then Delilah said to Samson, “You have mocked me and lied to me all along! Tell me how you can be tied up.”
He told her, “If you weave the seven braids of my head into the web of a loom and tighten it with a pin, I will become as weak as any other man. ”
chapters.zh: 大利拉对参孙说：「你到如今还是欺哄我，向我说谎言。求你告诉我，当用何法捆绑你。」参孙回答说：「你若将我头上的七条发绺，与纬线同织〔就可以了〕。」

chapters.en:
So while he slept, Delilah took the seven braids of his hair and wove them into the web. Then she tightened it with a pin and called to him, “Samson, the Philistines are here!”
But he awoke from his sleep and pulled out the pin with the loom and the web.
chapters.zh: 于是大利拉将他的发绺与纬线同织，用橛子钉住，对他说：「参孙哪，非利士人拿你来了！」参孙从睡中醒来，将机上的橛子和纬线一齐都拔出来了。

chapters.en: “How can you say, ‘I love you,’” she asked, “when your heart is not with me? This is the third time you have mocked me and failed to reveal to me the source of your great strength!”
chapters.zh: 大利拉对参孙说：「你既不与我同心，怎么说你爱我呢？你这三次欺哄我，没有告诉我，你因何有这么大的力气。」

chapters.en: Finally, after she had pressed him daily with her words and pleaded until he was sick to death,
chapters.zh: 大利拉天天用话催逼他，甚至他心里烦闷要死。

chapters.en: Samson told her all that was in his heart: “My hair has never been cut, because I have been a Nazirite to God from my mother’s womb. If I am shaved, my strength will leave me, and I will become as weak as any other man.”
chapters.zh: 参孙就把心中所藏的都告诉了她，对她说：「向来人没有用剃头刀剃我的头，因为我自出母胎就归上帝作拿细耳人；若剃了我的头发，我的力气就离开我，我便软弱像别人一样。」

chapters.en:
When Delilah realized that he had revealed to her all that was in his heart, she sent this message to the lords of the Philistines: “Come up once more, for he has revealed to me all that is in his heart.”
Then the lords of the Philistines came to her, bringing the money in their hands.
chapters.zh: 大利拉见他把心中所藏的都告诉了她，就打发人到非利士人的首领那里，对他们说：「他已经把心中所藏的都告诉了我，请你们再上来一次。」于是非利士人的首领手里拿着银子，上到妇人那里。

chapters.en: And having lulled him to sleep on her lap, she called a man to shave off the seven braids of his head. In this way she began to subdue him, and his strength left him.
chapters.zh: 大利拉使参孙枕着她的膝睡觉，叫了一个人来剃除他头上的七条发绺。于是大利拉克制他，他的力气就离开他了。

chapters.en:
Then she called out, “Samson, the Philistines are here!”
When Samson awoke from his sleep, he thought, “I will escape as I did before and shake myself free.” But he did not know that the LORD had departed from him.
chapters.zh: 大利拉说：「参孙哪，非利士人拿你来了！」参孙从睡中醒来，心里说：「我要像前几次出去活动身体」；他却不知道耶和华已经离开他了。

chapters.en: Then the Philistines seized him, gouged out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, where he was bound with bronze shackles and forced to grind grain in the prison.
chapters.zh: 非利士人将他拿住，剜了他的眼睛，带他下到迦萨，用铜鍊拘索他；他就在监里推磨。

chapters.en: However, the hair of his head began to grow back after it had been shaved.
chapters.zh: 然而他的头发被剃之后，又渐渐长起来了。

chapters.en: Now the lords of the Philistines gathered together to offer a great sacrifice to their god Dagon. They rejoiced and said, “Our god has delivered Samson our enemy into our hands.”
chapters.zh: 非利士人的首领聚集，要给他们的神大衮献大祭，并且欢乐，因为他们说：「我们的神将我们的仇敌参孙交在我们手中了。」

chapters.en:
And when the people saw him, they praised their god, saying:
“Our god has delivered into our hands our enemy who destroyed our land
and multiplied our dead.”
chapters.zh: 众人看见参孙，就赞美他们的神说：「我们的神将毁坏我们地、杀害我们许多人的仇敌交在我们手中了。」

chapters.en: And while their hearts were merry, they said, “Call for Samson to entertain us.” So they called Samson out of the prison to entertain them. And they stationed him between the pillars.
chapters.zh: 他们正宴乐的时候，就说：「叫参孙来，在我们面前戏耍戏耍。」于是将参孙从监里提出来，他就在众人面前戏耍。他们使他站在两柱中间。

chapters.en: Samson said to the servant who held his hand, “Lead me where I can feel the pillars supporting the temple, so I can lean against them.”
chapters.zh: 参孙向拉他手的童子说：「求你让我摸着托房的柱子，我要靠一靠。」

chapters.en: Now the temple was full of men and women; all the lords of the Philistines were there, and about three thousand men and women were on the roof watching Samson entertain them.
chapters.zh: 那时房内充满男女，非利士人的众首领也都在那里。房的平顶上约有三千男女观看参孙戏耍。

chapters.en: Then Samson called out to the LORD: “O Lord GOD, please remember me. Strengthen me, O God, just once more, so that with one vengeful blow I may pay back the Philistines for my two eyes.”
chapters.zh: 参孙求告耶和华说：「主耶和华啊，求你眷念我。上帝啊，求你赐我这一次的力量，使我在非利士人身上报那剜我双眼的仇。」

chapters.en: And Samson reached out for the two central pillars supporting the temple. Bracing himself against them with his right hand on one pillar and his left hand on the other,
chapters.zh: 参孙就抱住托房的那两根柱子：左手抱一根，右手抱一根，

chapters.en:
Samson said, “Let me die with the Philistines.”
Then he pushed with all his might, and the temple fell on the lords and all the people in it. So in his death he killed more than he had killed in his life.
chapters.zh: 说：「我情愿与非利士人同死！」就尽力屈身，房子倒塌，压住首领和房内的众人。这样，参孙死时所杀的人比活着所杀的还多。

chapters.en: Then Samson’s brothers and his father’s family came down, carried him back, and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of his father Manoah. And he had judged Israel twenty years.
chapters.zh: 参孙的弟兄和他父的全家都下去取他的尸首，抬上来葬在琐拉和以实陶中间，在他父玛挪亚的坟墓里。参孙作以色列的士师二十年。

chapters.en: Now a man named Micah from the hill country of Ephraim
chapters.zh: 以法莲山地有一个人名叫米迦。

chapters.en:
said to his mother, “The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from you and about which I heard you utter a curse—I have the silver here with me; I took it.”
Then his mother said, “Blessed be my son by the LORD!”
chapters.zh: 他对母亲说：「你那一千一百〔舍客勒〕银子被人拿去，你因此咒诅，并且告诉了我。看哪，这银子在我这里，是我拿去了。」他母亲说：「我儿啊，愿耶和华赐福与你！」

chapters.en: And when he had returned the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, she said, “I wholly dedicate the silver to the LORD for my son’s benefit, to make a graven image and a molten idol. Therefore I will now return it to you.”
chapters.zh: 米迦就把这一千一百〔舍客勒〕银子还他母亲。他母亲说：「我分出这银子来为你献给耶和华，好雕刻一个像，铸成一个像。现在我还是交给你。」

chapters.en: So he returned the silver to his mother, and she took two hundred shekels of silver and gave them to a silversmith, who made them into a graven image and a molten idol. And they were placed in the house of Micah.
chapters.zh: 米迦将银子还他母亲，他母亲将二百〔舍客勒〕银子交给银匠，雕刻一个像，铸成一个像，安置在米迦的屋内。

chapters.en: Now this man Micah had a shrine, and he made an ephod and some household idols, and ordained one of his sons as his priest.
chapters.zh: 这米迦有了神堂，又制造以弗得和家中的神像，分派他一个儿子作祭司。

chapters.en: In those days there was no king in Israel; everyone did what was right in his own eyes.
chapters.zh: 那时以色列中没有王，各人任意而行。

chapters.en: And there was a young Levite from Bethlehem in Judah who had been residing within the clan of Judah.
chapters.zh: 犹大的伯利恒有一个少年人，是犹大族的利未人，他在那里寄居。

chapters.en: This man left the city of Bethlehem in Judah to settle where he could find a place. And as he traveled, he came to Micah’s house in the hill country of Ephraim.
chapters.zh: 这人离开犹大的伯利恒城，要找一个可住的〔地方〕。行路的时候，到了以法莲山地，走到米迦的家。

chapters.en:
“Where are you from?” Micah asked him.
“I am a Levite from Bethlehem in Judah,” he replied, “and I am on my way to settle wherever I can find a place.”
chapters.zh: 米迦问他说：「你从哪里来？」他回答说：「从犹大的伯利恒来。我是利未人，要找一个可住的〔地方〕。」

chapters.en:
“Stay with me,” Micah said to him, “and be my father and priest, and I will give you ten shekels of silver per year, a suit of clothes, and your provisions.”
So the Levite went in
chapters.zh: 米迦说：「你可以住在我这里，我以你为父、为祭司。我每年给你十〔舍客勒〕银子，一套衣服和度日的食物。」利未人就进了他的家。

chapters.en: and agreed to stay with him, and the young man became like a son to Micah.
chapters.zh: 利未人情愿与那人同住；那人看这少年人如自己的儿子一样。

chapters.en: Micah ordained the Levite, and the young man became his priest and lived in his house.
chapters.zh: 米迦分派这少年的利未人作祭司，他就住在米迦的家里。

chapters.en: Then Micah said, “Now I know that the LORD will be good to me, because a Levite has become my priest.”
chapters.zh: 米迦说：「现在我知道耶和华必赐福与我，因我有一个利未人作祭司。」

chapters.en: In those days there was no king in Israel, and the tribe of the Danites was looking for territory to occupy. For up to that time they had not come into an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.
chapters.zh: 那时，以色列中没有王。但支派的人仍是寻地居住；因为到那日子，他们还没有在以色列支派中得地为业。

chapters.en:
So the Danites sent out five men from their clans, men of valor from Zorah and Eshtaol, to spy out the land and explore it. “Go and explore the land,” they told them.
The men entered the hill country of Ephraim and came to the house of Micah, where they spent the night.
chapters.zh: 但人从琐拉和以实陶打发本族中的五个勇士，去仔细窥探那地，吩咐他们说：「你们去窥探那地。」他们来到以法莲山地，进了米迦的住宅，就在那里住宿。

chapters.en: And while they were near Micah’s house, they recognized the voice of the young Levite; so they went over and asked him, “Who brought you here? What are you doing in this place? Why are you here?”
chapters.zh: 他们临近米迦的住宅，听出那少年利未人的口音来，就进去问他说：「谁领你到这里来？你在这里做什么？你在这里得什么？」

chapters.en: “Micah has done this and that for me,” he replied, “and he has hired me to be his priest.”
chapters.zh: 他回答说：「米迦待我如此如此，请我作祭司。」

chapters.en: Then they said to him, “Please inquire of God to determine whether we will have a successful journey.”
chapters.zh: 他们对他说：「请你求问上帝，使我们知道所行的道路通达不通达。」

chapters.en: And the priest told them, “Go in peace. The LORD is watching over your journey.”
chapters.zh: 祭司对他们说：「你们可以平平安安地去，你们所行的道路是在耶和华面前的。」

chapters.en: So the five men departed and came to Laish, where they saw that the people were living securely, like the Sidonians, quiet and unsuspecting. There was nothing lacking in the land and no oppressive ruler. And they were far away from the Sidonians and had no alliance with anyone.
chapters.zh: 五人就走了，来到拉亿，见那里的民安居无虑，如同西顿人安居一样。在那地没有人掌权扰乱他们；他们离西顿人也远，与别人没有来往。

chapters.en: When the men returned to Zorah and Eshtaol, their brothers asked them, “What did you find?”
chapters.zh: 五人回到琐拉和以实陶，见他们的弟兄；弟兄问他们说：「你们有什么话？」

chapters.en: They answered, “Come on, let us go up against them, for we have seen the land, and it is very good. Why would you fail to act? Do not hesitate to go there and take possession of the land!
chapters.zh: 他们回答说：「起来，我们上去攻击他们吧！我们已经窥探那地，见那地甚好。你们为何静坐不动呢？要急速前往得那地为业，不可迟延。

chapters.en: When you enter, you will come to an unsuspecting people and a spacious land, for God has delivered it into your hand. It is a place where nothing on earth is lacking.”
chapters.zh: 你们到了那里，必看见安居无虑的民，地也宽阔。上帝已将那地交在你们手中；那地百物俱全，一无所缺。」

chapters.en: So six hundred Danites departed from Zorah and Eshtaol, armed with weapons of war.
chapters.zh: 于是但族中的六百人，各带兵器，从琐拉和以实陶前往，

chapters.en: They went up and camped at Kiriath-jearim in Judah. That is why the place west of Kiriath-jearim is called Mahaneh-dan to this day.
chapters.zh: 上到犹大的基列‧耶琳，在基列‧耶琳后边安营。因此那地方名叫玛哈尼‧但，直到今日。

chapters.en: And from there they traveled to the hill country of Ephraim and came to Micah’s house.
chapters.zh: 他们从那里往以法莲山地去，来到米迦的住宅。

chapters.en: Then the five men who had gone to spy out the land of Laish said to their brothers, “Did you know that one of these houses has an ephod, household gods, a graven image, and a molten idol? Now think about what you should do.”
chapters.zh: 从前窥探拉亿地的五个人对他们的弟兄说：「这宅子里有以弗得和家中的神像，并雕刻的像与铸成的像，你们知道吗？现在你们要想一想当怎样行。」

chapters.en: So they turned aside there and went to the home of the young Levite, the house of Micah, and greeted him.
chapters.zh: 五人就进入米迦的住宅，到了那少年利未人的房内问他好。

chapters.en: The six hundred Danites stood at the entrance of the gate, armed with their weapons of war.
chapters.zh: 那六百但人各带兵器，站在门口。

chapters.en: And the five men who had gone to spy out the land went inside and took the graven image, the ephod, the household idols, and the molten idol, while the priest stood at the entrance of the gate with the six hundred armed men.
chapters.zh: 窥探地的五个人走进去，将雕刻的像、以弗得、家中的神像，并铸成的像，都拿了去。祭司和带兵器的六百人，一同站在门口。

chapters.en: When they entered Micah’s house and took the graven image, the ephod, the household idols, and the molten idol, the priest said to them, “What are you doing?”
chapters.zh: 那五个人进入米迦的住宅，拿出雕刻的像、以弗得、家中的神像，并铸成的像，祭司就问他们说：「你们做什么呢？」

chapters.en: “Be quiet,” they told him. “Put your hand over your mouth and come with us and be a father and a priest to us. Is it better for you to be a priest for the house of one person or a priest for a tribe and family in Israel?”
chapters.zh: 他们回答说：「不要作声，用手捂口，跟我们去吧！我们必以你为父、为祭司。你作一家的祭司好呢？还是作以色列一族一支派的祭司好呢？」

chapters.en: So the priest was glad and took the ephod, the household idols, and the graven image, and went with the people.
chapters.zh: 祭司心里喜悦，便拿着以弗得和家中的神像，并雕刻的像，进入他们中间。

chapters.en: Putting their small children, their livestock, and their possessions in front of them, they turned and departed.
chapters.zh: 他们就转身离开那里，妻子、儿女、牲畜、财物都在前头。

chapters.en: After they were some distance from Micah’s house, the men in the houses near Micah’s house mobilized and overtook the Danites.
chapters.zh: 离米迦的住宅已远，米迦的近邻都聚集来，追赶但人，

chapters.en: When they called out after them, the Danites turned to face them and said to Micah, “What is the matter with you that you have called out such a company?”
chapters.zh: 呼叫但人。但人回头问米迦说：「你聚集这许多人来做什么呢？」

chapters.en: He replied, “You took the gods I had made, and my priest, and went away. What else do I have? How can you say to me, ‘What is the matter with you?’”
chapters.zh: 米迦说：「你们将我所做的神像和祭司都带了去，我还有所剩的吗？怎么还问我说『做什么』呢？」

chapters.en: The Danites said to him, “Do not raise your voice against us, or angry men will attack you, and you and your family will lose your lives.”
chapters.zh: 但人对米迦说：「你不要使我们听见你的声音，恐怕有性暴的人攻击你，以致你和你的全家尽都丧命。」

chapters.en: So the Danites went on their way, and Micah turned to go back home, because he saw that they were too strong for him.
chapters.zh: 但人还是走他们的路。米迦见他们的势力比自己强盛，就转身回家去了。

chapters.en: After they had taken Micah’s idols and his priest, they went to Laish, to a quiet and unsuspecting people, and they struck them with their swords and burned down the city.
chapters.zh: 但人将米迦所做的〔神像〕和他的祭司都带到拉亿，见安居无虑的民，就用刀杀了那民，又放火烧了那城，

chapters.en:
There was no one to deliver them, because the city was far from Sidon and had no alliance with anyone; it was in a valley near Beth-rehob.
And the Danites rebuilt the city and lived there.
chapters.zh: 并无人搭救；因为离西顿远，他们又与别人没有来往。城在平原，那平原靠近伯‧利合。但人又在那里修城居住，

chapters.en: They named it Dan, after their forefather Dan, who was born to Israel—though the city was formerly named Laish.
chapters.zh: 照着他们始祖以色列之子但的名字，给那城起名叫但；原先那城名叫拉亿。

chapters.en: The Danites set up idols for themselves, and Jonathan son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests for the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.
chapters.zh: 但人就为自己设立那雕刻的像。摩西的孙子、革舜的儿子约拿单，和他的子孙作但支派的祭司，直到那地遭掳掠的日子。

chapters.en: So they set up for themselves Micah’s graven image, and it was there the whole time the house of God was in Shiloh.
chapters.zh: 上帝的殿在示罗多少日子，但人为自己设立米迦所雕刻的像也在〔但〕多少日子。

chapters.en: Now in those days, when there was no king in Israel, a Levite who lived in the remote hill country of Ephraim took for himself a concubine from Bethlehem in Judah.
chapters.zh: 当以色列中没有王的时候，有住以法莲山地那边的一个利未人，娶了一个犹大伯利恒的女子为妾。

chapters.en:
But she was unfaithful to him and left him to return to her father’s house in Bethlehem in Judah.
After she had been there four months,
chapters.zh: 妾行淫离开丈夫，回犹大的伯利恒，到了父家，在那里住了四个月。

chapters.en: her husband got up and went after her to speak kindly to her and bring her back, taking his servant and a pair of donkeys. So the girl brought him into her father’s house, and when her father saw him, he gladly welcomed him.
chapters.zh: 她丈夫起来，带着一个仆人、两匹驴去见她，用好话劝她回来。女子就引丈夫进入父家。她父见了那人，便欢欢喜喜地迎接。

chapters.en: His father-in-law, the girl’s father, persuaded him to stay, so he remained with him three days, eating, drinking, and lodging there.
chapters.zh: 那人的岳父，就是女子的父亲，将那人留下住了三天。于是二人一同吃喝、住宿。

chapters.en: On the fourth day, they got up early in the morning and prepared to depart, but the girl’s father said to his son-in-law, “Refresh your heart with a morsel of bread, and then you can go.”
chapters.zh: 到第四天，利未人清早起来要走，女子的父亲对女婿说：「请你吃点饭，加添心力，然后可以行路。」

chapters.en: So they sat down and the two of them ate and drank together. Then the girl’s father said to the man, “Please agree to stay overnight and let your heart be merry.”
chapters.zh: 于是二人坐下一同吃喝。女子的父亲对那人说：「请你再住一夜，畅快你的心。」

chapters.en: The man got up to depart, but his father-in-law persuaded him, so he stayed there that night.
chapters.zh: 那人起来要走，他岳父强留他，他又住了一宿。

chapters.en: On the fifth day, he got up early in the morning to depart, but the girl’s father said, “Please refresh your heart.” So they waited until late afternoon and the two of them ate.
chapters.zh: 到第五天，他清早起来要走，女子的父亲说：「请你〔吃点饭〕，加添心力，等到日头偏西再走。」于是二人一同吃饭。

chapters.en: When the man got up to depart with his concubine and his servant, his father-in-law, the girl’s father, said to him, “Look, the day is drawing to a close. Please spend the night. See, the day is almost over. Spend the night here, that your heart may be merry. Then you can get up early tomorrow for your journey home.”
chapters.zh: 那人同他的妾和仆人起来要走，他岳父，就是女子的父亲，对他说：「看哪，日头偏西了，请你再住一夜；天快晚了，可以在这里住宿，畅快你的心。明天早早起行回家去。」

chapters.en: But the man was unwilling to spend the night. He got up and departed, and arrived opposite Jebus (that is, Jerusalem), with his two saddled donkeys and his concubine.
chapters.zh: 那人不愿再住一夜，就备上那两匹驴，带着妾起身走了，来到耶布斯的对面（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷。）

chapters.en: When they were near Jebus and the day was almost gone, the servant said to his master, “Please, let us stop at this Jebusite city and spend the night here.”
chapters.zh: 临近耶布斯的时候，日头快要落了，仆人对主人说：「我们不如进这耶布斯人的城里住宿。」

chapters.en: But his master replied, “We will not turn aside to the city of foreigners, where there are no Israelites. We will go on to Gibeah.”
chapters.zh: 主人回答说：「我们不可进不是以色列人住的外邦城，不如过到基比亚去」；

chapters.en: He continued, “Come, let us try to reach one of these towns to spend the night in Gibeah or Ramah.”
chapters.zh: 又对仆人说：「我们可以到一个地方，或住在基比亚，或住在拉玛。」

chapters.en: So they continued on their journey, and the sun set as they neared Gibeah in Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 他们就往前走。将到便雅悯的基比亚，日头已经落了；

chapters.en: They stopped to go in and lodge in Gibeah. The Levite went in and sat down in the city square, but no one would take them into his home for the night.
chapters.zh: 他们进入基比亚要在那里住宿，就坐在城里的街上，因为无人接他们进家住宿。

chapters.en: That evening an old man from the hill country of Ephraim, who was residing in Gibeah (the men of that place were Benjamites), came in from his work in the field.
chapters.zh: 晚上，有一个老年人从田间做工回来。他原是以法莲山地的人，住在基比亚；那地方的人却是便雅悯人。

chapters.en: When he looked up and saw the traveler in the city square, the old man asked, “Where are you going, and where have you come from?”
chapters.zh: 老年人举目看见客人〔坐〕在城里的街上，就问他说：「你从哪里来？要往哪里去？」

chapters.en: The Levite replied, “We are traveling from Bethlehem in Judah to the remote hill country of Ephraim, where I am from. I went to Bethlehem in Judah, and now I am going to the house of the LORD; but no one has taken me into his home,
chapters.zh: 他回答说：「我们从犹大的伯利恒来，要往以法莲山地那边去。我原是那里的人，到过犹大的伯利恒，现在我往耶和华的殿去，在这里无人接我进他的家。

chapters.en: even though there is both straw and feed for our donkeys, and bread and wine for me and the maidservant and young man with me. There is nothing that we, your servants, lack.”
chapters.zh: 其实我有粮草可以餵驴，我与我的妾，并我的仆人，有饼有酒，并不缺少什么。」

chapters.en: “Peace to you,” said the old man. “Let me supply everything you need. Only do not spend the night in the square.”
chapters.zh: 老年人说：「愿你平安！你所需用的我都给你，只是不可在街上过夜。」

chapters.en: So he brought him to his house and fed his donkeys. And they washed their feet and ate and drank.
chapters.zh: 于是领他们到家里，餵上驴，他们就洗脚吃喝。

chapters.en: While they were enjoying themselves, suddenly the wicked men of the city surrounded the house. Pounding on the door, they said to the old man who owned the house, “Bring out the man who came to your house, so we can have relations with him!”
chapters.zh: 他们心里正欢畅的时候，城中的匪徒围住房子，连连叩门，对房主老人说：「你把那进你家的人带出来，我们要与他交合。」

chapters.en: The owner of the house went out and said to them, “No, my brothers, do not do this wicked thing! After all, this man is a guest in my house. Do not commit this outrage.
chapters.zh: 那房主出来对他们说：「弟兄们哪，不要这样作恶；这人既然进了我的家，你们就不要行这丑事。

chapters.en: Look, let me bring out my virgin daughter and the man’s concubine, and you can use them and do with them as you wish. But do not do such a vile thing to this man.”
chapters.zh: 我有个女儿，还是处女，并有这人的妾，我将她们领出来任凭你们玷辱她们，只是向这人不可行这样的丑事。」

chapters.en: But the men would not listen to him. So the Levite took his concubine and sent her outside to them, and they raped her and abused her throughout the night, and at dawn they let her go.
chapters.zh: 那些人却不听从他的话。那人就把他的妾拉出去交给他们，他们便与她交合，终夜凌辱她，直到天色快亮才放她去。

chapters.en: Early that morning, the woman went back to the house where her master was staying, collapsed at the doorway, and lay there until it was light.
chapters.zh: 天快亮的时候，妇人回到她主人住宿的房门前，就仆倒在地，直到天亮。

chapters.en: In the morning, when her master got up and opened the doors of the house to go out on his journey, there was his concubine, collapsed in the doorway of the house, with her hands on the threshold.
chapters.zh: 早晨，她的主人起来开了房门，出去要行路，不料那妇人仆倒在房门前，两手搭在门槛上；

chapters.en: “Get up,” he told her. “Let us go.” But there was no response. So the man put her on his donkey and set out for home.
chapters.zh: 就对妇人说：「起来，我们走吧！」妇人却不回答。那人便将她驮在驴上，起身回本处去了。

chapters.en: When he reached his house, he picked up a knife, took hold of his concubine, cut her limb by limb into twelve pieces, and sent her throughout the territory of Israel.
chapters.zh: 到了家里，用刀将妾的尸身切成十二块，使人拿着传送以色列的四境。

chapters.en: And everyone who saw it said, “Nothing like this has been seen or done from the day the Israelites came out of the land of Egypt until this day. Think it over, take counsel, and speak up!”
chapters.zh: 凡看见的人都说：「从以色列人出埃及地，直到今日，这样的事没有行过，也没有见过。现在应当思想，大家商议〔当怎样办理〕。」

chapters.en: Then all the Israelites from Dan to Beersheba and from the land of Gilead came out, and the congregation assembled as one man before the LORD at Mizpah.
chapters.zh: 于是以色列从但到别是巴，以及住基列地的众人都出来，如同一人，聚集在米斯巴耶和华面前。

chapters.en: The leaders of all the people and all the tribes of Israel presented themselves in the assembly of God’s people: 400,000 men on foot, armed with swords.
chapters.zh: 以色列民的首领，就是各支派的军长，都站在上帝百姓的会中；拿刀的步兵共有四十万。

chapters.en: (Meanwhile the Benjamites heard that the Israelites had gone up to Mizpah.) And the Israelites asked, “Tell us, how did this wicked thing happen?”
chapters.zh: 以色列人上到米斯巴，便雅悯人都听见了。以色列人说：「请你将这件恶事的情由对我们说明。」

chapters.en: So the Levite, the husband of the murdered woman, answered: “I and my concubine came to Gibeah in Benjamin to spend the night.
chapters.zh: 那利未人，就是被害之妇人的丈夫，回答说：「我和我的妾到了便雅悯的基比亚住宿。

chapters.en: And during the night, the men of Gibeah rose up against me and surrounded the house. They intended to kill me, but they abused my concubine, and she died.
chapters.zh: 基比亚人夜间起来，围了我住的房子，想要杀我，又将我的妾强奸致死。

chapters.en: Then I took my concubine, cut her into pieces, and sent her throughout the land of Israel’s inheritance, because they had committed a lewd and disgraceful act in Israel.
chapters.zh: 我就把我妾的尸身切成块子，使人拿着传送以色列得为业的全地，因为基比亚人在以色列中行了兇淫丑恶的事。

chapters.en: Behold, all you Israelites, give your advice and verdict here and now.”
chapters.zh: 你们以色列人都当筹划商议。」

chapters.en: Then all the people stood as one man and said, “Not one of us will return to his tent or to his house.
chapters.zh: 众民都起来如同一人，说：「我们连一人都不回自己帐棚、自己房屋去。

chapters.en: Now this is what we will do to Gibeah: We will go against it as the lot dictates.
chapters.zh: 我们向基比亚人必这样行，照所掣的籤去攻击他们。

chapters.en: We will take ten men out of every hundred from all the tribes of Israel, and a hundred out of every thousand, and a thousand out of every ten thousand, to supply provisions for the army when they go to Gibeah in Benjamin to punish them for the atrocity they have committed in Israel.”
chapters.zh: 我们要在以色列各支派中，一百人挑取十人，一千人挑取百人，一万人挑取千人，为民运粮，等大众到了便雅悯的基比亚，就照基比亚人在以色列中所行的丑事征伐他们。」

chapters.en: So all the men of Israel gathered as one man, united against the city.
chapters.zh: 于是以色列众人彼此连合如同一人，聚集攻击那城。

chapters.en: And the tribes of Israel sent men throughout the tribe of Benjamin, saying, “What is this wickedness that has occurred among you?
chapters.zh: 以色列众支派打发人去，问便雅悯支派的各家说：「你们中间怎么做了这样的恶事呢？

chapters.en:
Hand over the wicked men of Gibeah so we can put them to death and purge Israel of this evil.”
But the Benjamites refused to heed the voice of their fellow Israelites.
chapters.zh: 现在你们要将基比亚的那些匪徒交出来，我们好治死他们，从以色列中除掉这恶。」便雅悯人却不肯听从他们弟兄以色列人的话。

chapters.en: And from their cities they came together at Gibeah to go out and fight against the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯人从他们的各城里出来，聚集到了基比亚，要与以色列人打仗。

chapters.en: On that day the Benjamites mobilized 26,000 swordsmen from their cities, in addition to the 700 select men of Gibeah.
chapters.zh: 那时便雅悯人从各城里点出拿刀的，共有二万六千；另外还有基比亚人点出七百精兵。

chapters.en: Among all these soldiers there were 700 select left-handers, each of whom could sling a stone at a hair without missing.
chapters.zh: 在众军之中有拣选的七百精兵，都是左手便利的，能用机弦甩石打人，毫发不差。

chapters.en: The Israelites, apart from Benjamin, mobilized 400,000 swordsmen, each one an experienced warrior.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯人之外，点出以色列人拿刀的，共有四十万，都是战士。

chapters.en:
The Israelites set out, went up to Bethel, and inquired of God, “Who of us shall go up first to fight against the Benjamites?”
“Judah will be first,” the LORD replied.
chapters.zh: 以色列人就起来，到伯特利去求问上帝说：「我们中间谁当首先上去与便雅悯人争战呢？」耶和华说：「犹大当先〔上去〕。」

chapters.en: The next morning the Israelites set out and camped near Gibeah.
chapters.zh: 以色列人早晨起来，对着基比亚安营。

chapters.en: And the men of Israel went out to fight against Benjamin and took up their battle positions at Gibeah.
chapters.zh: 以色列人出来，要与便雅悯人打仗，就在基比亚前摆阵。

chapters.en: And the Benjamites came out of Gibeah and cut down 22,000 Israelites on the battlefield that day.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯人就从基比亚出来，当日杀死以色列人二万二千。

chapters.en: But the Israelite army took courage and again took their battle positions in the same place where they had arrayed themselves on the first day.
chapters.zh: 以色列人彼此奋勇，仍在头一日摆阵的地方又摆阵。

chapters.en:
They went up and wept before the LORD until evening, inquiring of Him, “Should we again draw near for battle against our brothers the Benjamites?”
And the LORD answered, “Go up against them.”
chapters.zh: 未摆阵之先，以色列人上去，在耶和华面前哭号，直到晚上，求问耶和华说：「我们再去与我们弟兄便雅悯人打仗可以不可以？」耶和华说：「可以上去攻击他们。」

chapters.en: On the second day the Israelites advanced against the Benjamites.
chapters.zh: 第二日，以色列人就上前攻击便雅悯人。

chapters.en: That same day the Benjamites came out against them from Gibeah and cut down another 18,000 Israelites, all of them armed with swords.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯人也在这日从基比亚出来，与以色列人接战，又杀死他们一万八千，都是拿刀的。

chapters.en: Then the Israelites, all the people, went up to Bethel, where they sat weeping before the LORD. That day they fasted until evening and presented burnt offerings and peace offerings to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以色列众人就上到伯特利，坐在耶和华面前哭号，当日禁食直到晚上；又在耶和华面前献燔祭和平安祭。

chapters.en: And the Israelites inquired of the LORD. (In those days the ark of the covenant of God was there,

and Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, served before it.) The Israelites asked, “Should we again go out to battle against our brothers the Benjamites, or should we stop?”
The LORD answered, “Fight, for tomorrow I will deliver them into your hand.”
chapters.zh: 那时，上帝的约柜在那里；亚伦的孙子、以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈侍立在约柜前。以色列人问耶和华说：「我们当再出去与我们弟兄便雅悯人打仗呢？还是罢兵呢？」耶和华说：「你们当上去，因为明日我必将他们交在你们手中。」

chapters.en: So Israel set up an ambush around Gibeah.
chapters.zh: 以色列人在基比亚的四围设下伏兵。

chapters.en: On the third day the Israelites went up against the Benjamites and arrayed themselves against Gibeah as they had done before.
chapters.zh: 第三日，以色列人又上去攻击便雅悯人，在基比亚前摆阵，与前两次一样。

chapters.en: The Benjamites came out against them and were drawn away from the city. They began to attack the people as before, killing about thirty men of Israel in the fields and on the roads, one of which led up to Bethel and the other to Gibeah.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯人也出来迎敌，就被引诱离城；在田间两条路上，一通伯特利，一通基比亚，像前两次，动手杀死以色列人约有三十个。

chapters.en:
“We are defeating them as before,” said the Benjamites.
But the Israelites said, “Let us retreat and draw them away from the city onto the roads.”
chapters.zh: 便雅悯人说：「他们仍旧败在我们面前。」但以色列人说：「我们不如逃跑，引诱他们离开城到路上来。」

chapters.en: So all the men of Israel got up from their places and arrayed themselves at Baal-tamar, and the Israelites in ambush charged from their positions west of Gibeah.
chapters.zh: 以色列众人都起来，在巴力‧他玛摆阵，以色列的伏兵从马利‧迦巴埋伏的地方冲上前去。

chapters.en: Then 10,000 select men from all Israel made a frontal assault against Gibeah, and the battle was fierce. But the Benjamites did not realize that disaster was upon them.
chapters.zh: 有以色列人中的一万精兵，来到基比亚前接战，势派甚是凶猛；便雅悯人却不知道灾祸临近了。

chapters.en: The LORD defeated Benjamin in the presence of Israel, and on that day the Israelites slaughtered 25,100 Benjamites, all armed with swords.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使以色列人杀败便雅悯人。那日，以色列人杀死便雅悯人二万五千一百，都是拿刀的。

chapters.en:
Then the Benjamites realized they had been defeated.
Now the men of Israel had retreated before Benjamin because they were relying on the ambush they had set against Gibeah.
chapters.zh: 于是便雅悯人知道自己败了。先是以色列人；因为靠着在基比亚前所设的伏兵，就在便雅悯人面前诈败。

chapters.en: The men in ambush rushed suddenly against Gibeah; they advanced and put the whole city to the sword.
chapters.zh: 伏兵急忙闯进基比亚，用刀杀死全城的人。

chapters.en: The men of Israel had arranged a signal with the men in ambush: When they sent up a great cloud of smoke from the city,
chapters.zh: 以色列人预先同伏兵约定在城内放火，以烟气上腾为号。

chapters.en:
the men of Israel would turn in the battle.
When the Benjamites had begun to strike them down, killing about thirty men of Israel, they said, “They are defeated before us as in the first battle.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人临退阵的时候，便雅悯人动手杀死以色列人，约有三十个，就说：「他们仍像前次被我们杀败了。」

chapters.en: But when the column of smoke began to go up from the city, the Benjamites looked behind them and saw the whole city going up in smoke.
chapters.zh: 当烟气如柱从城中上腾的时候，便雅悯人回头观看，见全城的〔烟气〕冲天。

chapters.en: Then the men of Israel turned back on them, and the men of Benjamin were terrified when they realized that disaster had come upon them.
chapters.zh: 以色列人又转身回来，便雅悯人就甚惊惶，因为看见灾祸临到自己了。

chapters.en: So they fled before the men of Israel toward the wilderness, but the battle overtook them, and the men coming out of the cities struck them down there.
chapters.zh: 他们在以色列人面前转身往旷野逃跑；以色列人在后面追杀。那从各城里出来的，也都夹攻杀灭他们。

chapters.en: They surrounded the Benjamites, pursued them, and easily overtook them in the vicinity of Gibeah on the east.
chapters.zh: 以色列人围绕便雅悯人，追赶他们，在他们歇脚之处、对着日出之地的基比亚践踏他们。

chapters.en: And 18,000 Benjamites fell, all men of valor.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯人死了的有一万八千，都是勇士。

chapters.en: Then the Benjamites turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, and Israel cut down 5,000 men on the roads. And they overtook them at Gidom and struck down 2,000 more.
chapters.zh: 其余的人转身向旷野逃跑，往临门磐去。以色列人在道路上杀了他们五千人，如拾取遗穗一样，追到基顿又杀了他们二千人。

chapters.en: That day 25,000 Benjamite swordsmen fell, all men of valor.
chapters.zh: 那日便雅悯死了的共有二万五千人，都是拿刀的勇士。

chapters.en: But 600 men turned and fled into the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, where they stayed four months.
chapters.zh: 只剩下六百人，转身向旷野逃跑，到了临门磐，就在那里住了四个月。

chapters.en: And the men of Israel turned back against the other Benjamites and put to the sword all the cities, including the animals and everything else they found. And they burned down all the cities in their path.
chapters.zh: 以色列人又转到便雅悯地，将各城的人和牲畜，并一切所遇见的，都用刀杀尽，又放火烧了一切城邑。

chapters.en: Now the men of Israel had sworn an oath at Mizpah, saying, “Not one of us will give his daughter in marriage to a Benjamite.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人在米斯巴曾起誓说：「我们都不将女儿给便雅悯人为妻。」

chapters.en: So the people came to Bethel and sat there before God until evening, lifting up their voices and weeping bitterly.
chapters.zh: 以色列人来到伯特利，坐在上帝面前直到晚上，放声痛哭，

chapters.en: “Why, O LORD God of Israel,” they cried out, “has this happened in Israel? Today in Israel one tribe is missing!”
chapters.zh: 说：「耶和华－以色列的上帝啊，为何以色列中有这样缺了一支派的事呢？」

chapters.en: The next day the people got up early, built an altar there, and presented burnt offerings and peace offerings.
chapters.zh: 次日清早，百姓起来，在那里筑了一座坛，献燔祭和平安祭。

chapters.en: The Israelites asked, “Who among all the tribes of Israel did not come to the assembly before the LORD?” For they had taken a solemn oath that anyone who failed to come up before the LORD at Mizpah would surely be put to death.
chapters.zh: 以色列人彼此问说：「以色列各支派中，谁没有同会众上到耶和华面前来呢？」先是以色列人起过大誓说，凡不上米斯巴到耶和华面前来的，必将他治死。

chapters.en: And the Israelites grieved for their brothers, the Benjamites, and said, “Today a tribe is cut off from Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列人为他们的弟兄便雅悯后悔，说：「如今以色列中绝了一个支派了。

chapters.en: What should we do about wives for the survivors, since we have sworn by the LORD not to give them our daughters in marriage?”
chapters.zh: 我们既在耶和华面前起誓说，必不将我们的女儿给便雅悯人为妻，现在我们当怎样办理、使他们剩下的人有妻呢？」

chapters.en: So they asked, “Which one of the tribes of Israel failed to come up before the LORD at Mizpah?” And, in fact, no one from Jabesh-gilead had come to the camp for the assembly.
chapters.zh: 又彼此问说：「以色列支派中谁没有上米斯巴到耶和华面前来呢？」他们就查出基列‧雅比没有一人进营到会众那里；

chapters.en: For when the people were counted, none of the residents of Jabesh-gilead were there.
chapters.zh: 因为百姓被数的时候，没有一个基列‧雅比人在那里。

chapters.en: So the congregation sent 12,000 of their most valiant men and commanded them: “Go and put to the sword those living in Jabesh-gilead, including women and children.
chapters.zh: 会众就打发一万二千大勇士，吩咐他们说：「你们去用刀将基列‧雅比人连妇女带孩子都击杀了。

chapters.en: This is what you are to do: Devote to destruction every male, as well as every female who has had relations with a man.”
chapters.zh: 所当行的就是这样：要将一切男子和已嫁的女子尽行杀戮。」

chapters.en: So they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young women who had not had relations with a man, and they brought them to the camp at Shiloh in the land of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 他们在基列‧雅比人中，遇见了四百个未嫁的处女，就带到迦南地的示罗营里。

chapters.en: Then the whole congregation sent a message of peace to the Benjamites who were at the rock of Rimmon.
chapters.zh: 全会众打发人到临门磐的便雅悯人那里，向他们说和睦的话。

chapters.en: And at that time the Benjamites returned and were given the women who were spared from Jabesh-gilead. But there were not enough women for all of them.
chapters.zh: 当时便雅悯人回来了，以色列人就把所存活基列‧雅比的女子给他们为妻，还是不够。

chapters.en: The people grieved for Benjamin, because the LORD had made a void in the tribes of Israel.
chapters.zh: 百姓为便雅悯人后悔，因为耶和华使以色列人缺了一个支派〔注：原文是使以色列中有了破口〕。

chapters.en: Then the elders of the congregation said, “What should we do about wives for those who remain, since the women of Benjamin have been destroyed?”
chapters.zh: 会中的长老说：「便雅悯中的女子既然除灭了，我们当怎样办理、使那余剩的人有妻呢？」

chapters.en: They added, “There must be heirs for the survivors of Benjamin, so that a tribe of Israel will not be wiped out.
chapters.zh: 又说：「便雅悯逃脱的人当有地业，免得以色列中涂抹了一个支派。

chapters.en:
But we cannot give them our daughters as wives.”
For the Israelites had sworn, “Cursed is he who gives a wife to a Benjamite.”
chapters.zh: 只是我们不能将自己的女儿给他们为妻；因为以色列人曾起誓说，有将女儿给便雅悯人为妻的，必受咒诅。」

chapters.en: “But look,” they said, “there is a yearly feast to the LORD in Shiloh, which is north of Bethel east of the road that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and south of Lebonah.”
chapters.zh: 他们又说：「在利波拿以南，伯特利以北，在示剑大路以东的示罗，年年有耶和华的节期」；

chapters.en: So they commanded the Benjamites: “Go, hide in the vineyards
chapters.zh: 就吩咐便雅悯人说：「你们去，在葡萄园中埋伏。

chapters.en: and watch. When you see the daughters of Shiloh come out to perform their dances, each of you is to come out of the vineyards, catch for himself a wife from the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 若看见示罗的女子出来跳舞，就从葡萄园出来，在示罗的女子中各抢一个为妻，回便雅悯地去。

chapters.en: When their fathers or brothers come to us to complain, we will tell them, ‘Do us a favor by helping them, since we did not get wives for each of them in the war. Since you did not actually give them your daughters, you have no guilt.’”
chapters.zh: 他们的父亲或是弟兄若来与我们争竞，我们就说：『求你们看我们的情面，施恩给这些人，因我们在争战的时候没有给他们留下女子为妻。这也不是你们将女子给他们的；若是你们给的，就算有罪。』」

chapters.en: The Benjamites did as instructed and carried away the number of women they needed from the dancers they caught. They went back to their own inheritance, rebuilt their cities, and settled in them.
chapters.zh: 于是便雅悯人照样而行，按着他们的数目从跳舞的女子中抢去为妻，就回自己的地业去，又重修城邑居住。

chapters.en: And at that time, each of the Israelites returned from there to his own tribe and clan, each to his own inheritance.
chapters.zh: 当时以色列人离开那里，各归本支派、本宗族、本地业去了。

chapters.en: In those days there was no king in Israel; everyone did what was right in his own eyes.
chapters.zh: 那时，以色列中没有王，各人任意而行。

chapters.en: In the days when the judges ruled, there was a famine in the land. And a certain man from Bethlehem in Judah, with his wife and two sons, went to reside in the land of Moab.
chapters.zh: 当士师秉政的时候，国中遭遇饥荒。在犹大的伯利恒，有一个人带着妻子和两个儿子往摩押地去寄居。

chapters.en: The man’s name was Elimelech, his wife’s name was Naomi, and the names of his two sons were Mahlon and Chilion. They were Ephrathites from Bethlehem in Judah, and they entered the land of Moab and settled there.
chapters.zh: 这人名叫以利米勒，他的妻名叫拿俄米；他两个儿子，一个名叫玛伦，一个名叫基连，都是犹大伯利恒的以法他人。他们到了摩押地，就住在那里。

chapters.en: Then Naomi’s husband Elimelech died, and she was left with her two sons,
chapters.zh: 后来拿俄米的丈夫以利米勒死了，剩下妇人和她两个儿子。

chapters.en:
who took Moabite women as their wives, one named Orpah and the other named Ruth.
And after they had lived in Moab about ten years,
chapters.zh: 这两个儿子娶了摩押女子为妻，一个名叫俄珥巴，一个名叫路得，在那里住了约有十年。

chapters.en: both Mahlon and Chilion also died, and Naomi was left without her two sons and without her husband.
chapters.zh: 玛伦和基连二人也死了，剩下拿俄米，没有丈夫，也没有儿子。

chapters.en: When Naomi heard in Moab that the LORD had attended to His people by providing them with food, she and her daughters-in-law prepared to leave the land of Moab.
chapters.zh: 她就与两个儿妇起身，要从摩押地归回；因为她在摩押地听见耶和华眷顾自己的百姓，赐粮食与他们。

chapters.en: Accompanied by her two daughters-in-law, she left the place where she had been living and set out on the road leading back to the land of Judah.
chapters.zh: 于是她和两个儿妇起行离开所住的地方，要回犹大地去。

chapters.en: Then Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, “Go back, each of you to your mother’s home. May the LORD show you loving devotion, as you have shown to your dead and to me.
chapters.zh: 拿俄米对两个儿妇说：「你们各人回娘家去吧。愿耶和华恩待你们，像你们恩待已死的人与我一样！

chapters.en:
May the LORD enable each of you to find rest in the home of your new husband.”
And she kissed them as they wept aloud
chapters.zh: 愿耶和华使你们各在新夫家中得平安！」于是拿俄米与她们亲嘴。她们就放声而哭，

chapters.en: and said, “Surely we will return with you to your people.”
chapters.zh: 说：「不然，我们必与你一同回你本国去。」

chapters.en: But Naomi replied, “Return home, my daughters. Why would you go with me? Are there still sons in my womb to become your husbands?
chapters.zh: 拿俄米说：「我女儿们哪，回去吧！为何要跟我去呢？我还能生子作你们的丈夫吗？

chapters.en: Return home, my daughters. Go on, for I am too old to have another husband. Even if I thought there was hope for me to have a husband tonight and to bear sons,
chapters.zh: 我女儿们哪，回去吧！我年纪老迈，不能再有丈夫；即或说，我还有指望，今夜有丈夫可以生子，

chapters.en: would you wait for them to grow up? Would you refrain from having husbands? No, my daughters, it is much more bitter for me than for you, because the hand of the LORD has gone out against me.”
chapters.zh: 你们岂能等着他们长大呢？你们岂能等着他们不嫁别人呢？我女儿们哪，不要这样。我为你们的缘故甚是愁苦，因为耶和华伸手攻击我。」

chapters.en: Again they wept aloud, and Orpah kissed her mother-in-law goodbye, but Ruth clung to her.
chapters.zh: 两个儿妇又放声而哭，俄珥巴与婆婆亲嘴〔而别〕，只是路得舍不得拿俄米。

chapters.en: “Look,” said Naomi, “your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and her gods; follow her back home.”
chapters.zh: 拿俄米说：「看哪，你嫂子已经回她本国和她〔所拜〕的神那里去了，你也跟着你嫂子回去吧！」

chapters.en:
But Ruth replied:
“Do not urge me to leave you or to turn from following you. For wherever you go, I will go, and wherever you live, I will live; your people will be my people, and your God will be my God.
chapters.zh: 路得说：「不要催我回去不跟随你。你往哪里去，我也往那里去；你在哪里住宿，我也在那里住宿；你的国就是我的国，你的上帝就是我的上帝。

chapters.en: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May the LORD punish me, and ever so severely, if anything but death separates you and me.”
chapters.zh: 你在哪里死，我也在那里死，也葬在那里。除非死能使你我相离！不然，愿耶和华重重地降罚与我。」

chapters.en: When Naomi saw that Ruth was determined to go with her, she stopped trying to persuade her.
chapters.zh: 拿俄米见路得定意要跟随自己去，就不再劝她了。

chapters.en: So Naomi and Ruth traveled until they came to Bethlehem. When they entered Bethlehem, the whole town was stirred because of them, and the women of the town exclaimed, “Can this be Naomi?”
chapters.zh: 于是二人同行，来到伯利恒。她们到了伯利恒，合城的人就都惊讶。妇女们说：「这是拿俄米吗？」

chapters.en: “Do not call me Naomi, ” she replied. “Call me Mara, because the Almighty has dealt quite bitterly with me.
chapters.zh: 拿俄米对她们说：「不要叫我拿俄米〔注：就是甜的意思〕，要叫我玛拉〔注：就是苦的意思〕，因为全能者使我受了大苦。

chapters.en: I went away full, but the LORD has brought me back empty. Why call me Naomi? After all, the LORD has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me.”
chapters.zh: 我满满地出去，耶和华使我空空地回来。耶和华降祸与我；全能者使我受苦。既是这样，你们为何还叫我拿俄米呢？」

chapters.en: So Naomi returned from the land of Moab with her daughter-in-law Ruth the Moabitess. And they arrived in Bethlehem at the beginning of the barley harvest.
chapters.zh: 拿俄米和她儿妇摩押女子路得，从摩押地回来到伯利恒，正是动手割大麦的时候。

chapters.en: Now Naomi had a relative on her husband’s side, a prominent man of noble character from the clan of Elimelech, whose name was Boaz.
chapters.zh: 拿俄米的丈夫以利米勒的亲族中，有一个人名叫波阿斯，是个大财主。

chapters.en:
