And Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Please let me go into the fields and glean heads of grain after someone in whose sight I may find favor.”
“Go ahead, my daughter,” Naomi replied.
chapters.zh: 摩押女子路得对拿俄米说：「容我往田间去，我蒙谁的恩，就在谁的身后拾取麦穗。」拿俄米说：「女儿啊，你只管去。」

chapters.en: So Ruth departed and went out into the field and gleaned after the harvesters. And she happened to come to the part of the field belonging to Boaz, who was from the clan of Elimelech.
chapters.zh: 路得就去了，来到田间，在收割的人身后拾取麦穗。她恰巧到了以利米勒本族的人波阿斯那块田里。

chapters.en:
Just then Boaz arrived from Bethlehem and said to the harvesters, “The LORD be with you.”
“The LORD bless you,” they replied.
chapters.zh: 波阿斯正从伯利恒来，对收割的人说：「愿耶和华与你们同在！」他们回答说：「愿耶和华赐福与你！」

chapters.en: And Boaz asked the foreman of his harvesters, “Whose young woman is this?”
chapters.zh: 波阿斯问监管收割的仆人说：「那是谁家的女子？」

chapters.en: The foreman answered, “She is the Moabitess who returned with Naomi from the land of Moab.
chapters.zh: 监管收割的仆人回答说：「是那摩押女子，跟随拿俄米从摩押地回来的。

chapters.en: She has said, ‘Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves after the harvesters.’ So she came out and has continued from morning until now, except that she rested a short time in the shelter.”
chapters.zh: 她说：『请你容我跟着收割的人拾取打捆剩下的麦穗。』她从早晨直到如今，除了在屋子里坐一会儿，常在这里。」

chapters.en: Then Boaz said to Ruth, “Listen, my daughter. Do not go and glean in another field, and do not go away from this place, but stay here close to my servant girls.
chapters.zh: 波阿斯对路得说：「女儿啊，听我说，不要往别人田里拾取麦穗，也不要离开这里，要常与我使女们在一处。

chapters.en: Let your eyes be on the field they are harvesting, and follow along after these girls. Indeed, I have ordered the young men not to touch you. And when you are thirsty, go and drink from the jars the young men have filled.”
chapters.zh: 我的仆人在那块田收割，你就跟着他们去。我已经吩咐仆人不可欺负你；你若渴了，就可以到器皿那里喝仆人打来的水。」

chapters.en: At this, she fell on her face, bowing low to the ground, and said to him, “Why have I found such favor in your eyes that you should take notice of me, even though I am a foreigner?”
chapters.zh: 路得就俯伏在地叩拜，对他说：「我既是外邦人，怎么蒙你的恩，这样顾恤我呢？」

chapters.en: Boaz replied, “I have been made fully aware of all you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, how you left your father and mother and the land of your birth, and how you came to a people you did not know before.
chapters.zh: 波阿斯回答说：「自从你丈夫死后，凡你向婆婆所行的，并你离开父母和本地，到素不认识的民中，这些事人全都告诉我了。

chapters.en: May the LORD repay your work, and may you receive a rich reward from the LORD, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have taken refuge.”
chapters.zh: 愿耶和华照你所行的赏赐你。你来投靠耶和华－以色列上帝的翅膀下，愿你满得他的赏赐。」

chapters.en: “My lord,” she said, “may I continue to find favor in your eyes, for you have comforted and spoken kindly to your maidservant, though I am not like one of your servant girls.”
chapters.zh: 路得说：「我主啊，愿在你眼前蒙恩。我虽然不及你的一个使女，你还用慈爱的话安慰我的心。」

chapters.en: At mealtime Boaz said to her, “Come over here; have some bread and dip it into the vinegar sauce.” So she sat down beside the harvesters, and he offered her roasted grain, and she ate and was satisfied and had some left over.
chapters.zh: 到了吃饭的时候，波阿斯对路得说：「你到这里来吃饼，将饼蘸在醋里。」路得就在收割的人旁边坐下；他们把烘了的穗子递给她。她吃饱了，还有余剩的。

chapters.en: When Ruth got up to glean, Boaz ordered his young men, “Even if she gathers among the sheaves, do not insult her.
chapters.zh: 她起来又拾取麦穗，波阿斯吩咐仆人说：「她就是在捆中拾取麦穗，也可以容她，不可羞辱她；

chapters.en: Rather, pull out for her some stalks from the bundles and leave them for her to gather. Do not rebuke her.”
chapters.zh: 并要从捆里抽出些来，留在地下任她拾取，不可叱吓她。」

chapters.en: So Ruth gathered grain in the field until evening. And when she beat out what she had gleaned, it was about an ephah of barley.
chapters.zh: 这样，路得在田间拾取麦穗，直到晚上，将所拾取的打了，约有一伊法大麦。

chapters.en: She picked up the grain and went into the town, where her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned. And she brought out what she had saved from her meal and gave it to Naomi.
chapters.zh: 她就把所拾取的带进城去给婆婆看，又把她吃饱了所剩的给了婆婆。

chapters.en:
Then her mother-in-law asked her, “Where did you glean today, and where did you work? Blessed be the man who noticed you.”
So she told her mother-in-law where she had worked. “The name of the man I worked with today is Boaz,” she said.
chapters.zh: 婆婆问她说：「你今日在哪里拾取麦穗，在哪里做工呢？愿那顾恤你的得福。」路得就告诉婆婆说：「我今日在一个名叫波阿斯的人那里做工。」

chapters.en: Then Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, “May he be blessed by the LORD, who has not withdrawn His kindness from the living or the dead.” Naomi continued, “The man is a close relative. He is one of our kinsman-redeemers. ”
chapters.zh: 拿俄米对儿妇说：「愿那人蒙耶和华赐福，因为他不断地恩待活人死人。」拿俄米又说：「那是我们本族的人，是一个至近的亲属。」

chapters.en: Then Ruth the Moabitess said, “He also told me, ‘Stay with my young men until they have finished gathering all my harvest.’”
chapters.zh: 摩押女子路得说：「他对我说：『你要紧随我的仆人〔拾取麦穗〕，直等他们收完了我的庄稼。』」

chapters.en: And Naomi said to her daughter-in-law Ruth, “My daughter, it is good for you to work with his young women, so that nothing will happen to you in another field.”
chapters.zh: 拿俄米对儿妇路得说：「女儿啊，你跟着他的使女出去，不叫人遇见你在别人田间，这才为好。」

chapters.en: So Ruth stayed close to the servant girls of Boaz to glean grain until the barley and wheat harvests were finished. And she lived with her mother-in-law.
chapters.zh: 于是路得与波阿斯的使女常在一处拾取麦穗，直到收完了大麦和小麦。路得仍与婆婆同住。

chapters.en: One day Ruth’s mother-in-law Naomi said to her, “My daughter, should I not seek a resting place for you, that it may be well with you?
chapters.zh: 路得的婆婆拿俄米对她说：「女儿啊，我不当为你找个安身之处，使你享福吗？

chapters.en: Now is not Boaz, with whose servant girls you have been working, a relative of ours? In fact, tonight he is winnowing barley on the threshing floor.
chapters.zh: 你与波阿斯的使女常在一处，波阿斯不是我们的亲族吗？他今夜在场上簸大麦；

chapters.en: Therefore wash yourself, put on perfume, and wear your best clothes. Go down to the threshing floor, but do not let the man know you are there until he has finished eating and drinking.
chapters.zh: 你要沐浴抹膏，换上衣服，下到场上，却不要使那人认出你来。你等他吃喝完了，

chapters.en: When he lies down, note the place where he lies. Then go in and uncover his feet, and lie down, and he will explain to you what you should do.”
chapters.zh: 到他睡的时候，你看准他睡的地方，就进去掀开他脚上的被，躺卧在那里，他必告诉你所当做的事。」

chapters.en: “I will do everything you say,” Ruth answered.
chapters.zh: 路得说：「凡你所吩咐的，我必遵行。」

chapters.en: So she went down to the threshing floor and did everything her mother-in-law had instructed her to do.
chapters.zh: 路得就下到场上，照她婆婆所吩咐她的而行。

chapters.en: After Boaz had finished eating and drinking and was in good spirits, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain. Then Ruth went in secretly, uncovered his feet, and lay down.
chapters.zh: 波阿斯吃喝完了，心里欢畅，就去睡在麦堆旁边。路得便悄悄地来掀开他脚上的被，躺卧在那里。

chapters.en: At midnight, Boaz was startled, turned over, and there lying at his feet was a woman!
chapters.zh: 到了夜半，那人忽然惊醒，翻过身来，不料有女子躺在他的脚下。

chapters.en:
“Who are you?” he asked.
“I am your servant Ruth,” she replied. “Spread the corner of your garment over me, for you are a kinsman-redeemer. ”
chapters.zh: 他就说：「你是谁？」回答说：「我是你的婢女路得。求你用你的衣襟遮盖我，因为你是我一个至近的亲属。」

chapters.en: Then Boaz said, “May the LORD bless you, my daughter. You have shown more kindness now than before, because you have not run after the younger men, whether rich or poor.
chapters.zh: 波阿斯说：「女儿啊，愿你蒙耶和华赐福。你末后的恩比先前更大；因为少年人无论贫富，你都没有跟从。

chapters.en: And now do not be afraid, my daughter. I will do for you whatever you request, since all my fellow townspeople know that you are a woman of noble character.
chapters.zh: 女儿啊，现在不要惧怕，凡你所说的，我必照着行；我本城的人都知道你是个贤德的女子。

chapters.en: Yes, it is true that I am a kinsman-redeemer, but there is a redeemer nearer than I.
chapters.zh: 我实在是你一个至近的亲属，只是还有一个人比我更近。

chapters.en: Stay here tonight, and in the morning, if he wants to redeem you, good. Let him redeem you. But if he does not want to redeem you, as surely as the LORD lives, I will. Now lie here until morning.”
chapters.zh: 你今夜在这里住宿，明早他若肯为你尽亲属的本分，就由他吧！倘若不肯，我指着永生的耶和华起誓，我必为你尽了本分，你只管躺到天亮。」

chapters.en:
So she lay down at his feet until morning, but she got up before anyone else could recognize her.
Then Boaz said, “Do not let it be known that a woman came to the threshing floor.”
chapters.zh: 路得便在他脚下躺到天快亮，人彼此不能辨认的时候就起来了。波阿斯说：「不可使人知道有女子到场上来」；

chapters.en: And he told her, “Bring the shawl you are wearing and hold it out.” When she did so, he poured in six measures of barley and placed it on her. Then he went into the city.
chapters.zh: 又对路得说：「打开你所披的外衣。」她打开了，波阿斯就撮了六〔簸箕〕大麦，帮她扛在肩上，她便进城去了。

chapters.en:
When Ruth returned to her mother-in-law, Naomi asked her, “How did it go, my daughter?”
Then Ruth told her all that Boaz had done for her.
chapters.zh: 路得回到婆婆那里，婆婆说：「女儿啊，怎么样了？」路得就将那人向她所行的述说了一遍，

chapters.en: And she said, “He gave me these six measures of barley, for he said, ‘Do not go back to your mother-in-law empty-handed.’”
chapters.zh: 又说：「那人给了我六〔簸箕〕大麦，对我说：『你不可空手回去见你的婆婆。』」

chapters.en: “Wait, my daughter,” said Naomi, “until you find out how things go, for he will not rest unless he has resolved the matter today.”
chapters.zh: 婆婆说：「女儿啊，你只管安坐等候，看这事怎样成就，因为那人今日不办成这事必不休息。」

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Boaz went to the gate and sat down there. Soon the kinsman-redeemer of whom he had spoken came along, and Boaz said, “Come over here, my friend, and sit down.” So he went over and sat down.
chapters.zh: 波阿斯到了城门，坐在那里，恰巧波阿斯所说的那至近的亲属经过。波阿斯说：「某人哪，你来坐在这里。」他就来坐下。

chapters.en: Then Boaz took ten of the elders of the city and said, “Sit here,” and they did so.
chapters.zh: 波阿斯又从本城的长老中拣选了十人，对他们说：「请你们坐在这里。」他们就都坐下。

chapters.en: And he said to the kinsman-redeemer, “Naomi, who has returned from the land of Moab, is selling the piece of land that belonged to our brother Elimelech.
chapters.zh: 波阿斯对那至近的亲属说：「从摩押地回来的拿俄米，现在要卖我们族兄以利米勒的那块地；

chapters.en:
I thought I should inform you that you may buy it back in the presence of those seated here and in the presence of the elders of my people. If you want to redeem it, do so. But if you will not redeem it, tell me so I may know, because there is no one but you to redeem it, and I am next after you.”
“I will redeem it,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 我想当赎那块地的是你，其次是我，以外再没有别人了。你可以在这里的人面前和我本国的长老面前说明，你若肯赎就赎，若不肯赎就告诉我。」那人回答说：「我肯赎。」

chapters.en: Then Boaz said, “On the day you buy the land from Naomi and also from Ruth the Moabitess, you must also acquire the widow of the deceased in order to raise up the name of the deceased on his inheritance.”
chapters.zh: 波阿斯说：「你从拿俄米手中买这地的时候，也当娶〔注：原文是买；十节同〕死人的妻摩押女子路得，使死人在产业上存留他的名。」

chapters.en: The kinsman-redeemer replied, “I cannot redeem it myself, or I would jeopardize my own inheritance. Take my right of redemption, because I cannot redeem it.”
chapters.zh: 那人说：「这样我就不能赎了，恐怕于我的产业有碍。你可以赎我所当赎的，我不能赎了。」

chapters.en: Now in former times in Israel, concerning the redemption or exchange of property, to make any matter legally binding a man would remove his sandal and give it to the other party, and this was a confirmation in Israel.
chapters.zh: 从前，在以色列中要定夺什么事，或赎回，或交易，这人就脱鞋给那人。以色列人都以此为证据。

chapters.en: So the kinsman-redeemer removed his sandal and said to Boaz, “Buy it for yourself.”
chapters.zh: 那人对波阿斯说：「你自己买吧！」于是将鞋脱下来了。

chapters.en: At this, Boaz said to the elders and all the people, “You are witnesses today that I am buying from Naomi all that belonged to Elimelech, Chilion, and Mahlon.
chapters.zh: 波阿斯对长老和众民说：「你们今日作见证，凡属以利米勒和基连、玛伦的，我都从拿俄米手中置买了；

chapters.en: Moreover, I have acquired Ruth the Moabitess, Mahlon’s widow, as my wife, to raise up the name of the deceased through his inheritance, so that his name will not disappear from among his brothers or from the gate of his home. You are witnesses today.”
chapters.zh: 又娶了玛伦的妻摩押女子路得为妻，好在死人的产业上存留他的名，免得他的名在本族本乡灭没。你们今日可以作见证。」

chapters.en: “We are witnesses,” said the elders and all the people at the gate. “May the LORD make the woman entering your home like Rachel and Leah, who together built up the house of Israel. May you be prosperous in Ephrathah and famous in Bethlehem.
chapters.zh: 在城门坐着的众民和长老都说：「我们作见证。愿耶和华使进你家的这女子，像建立以色列家的拉结、利亚二人一样。又愿你在以法他得亨通，在伯利恒得名声。

chapters.en: And may your house become like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, because of the offspring the LORD will give you by this young woman.”
chapters.zh: 愿耶和华从这少年女子赐你后裔，使你的家像她玛从犹大所生法勒斯的家一般。」

chapters.en: So Boaz took Ruth, and she became his wife. And when he had relations with her, the LORD enabled her to conceive, and she gave birth to a son.
chapters.zh: 于是，波阿斯娶了路得为妻，与她同房。耶和华使她怀孕生了一个儿子。

chapters.en: Then the women said to Naomi, “Blessed be the LORD, who has not left you this day without a kinsman-redeemer. May his name become famous in Israel.
chapters.zh: 妇人们对拿俄米说：「耶和华是应当称颂的！因为今日没有撇下你，使你无至近的亲属。愿这孩子在以色列中得名声。

chapters.en: He will renew your life and sustain you in your old age. For your daughter-in-law, who loves you and is better to you than seven sons, has given him birth.”
chapters.zh: 他必提起你的精神，奉养你的老，因为是爱慕你的那儿妇所生的。有这儿妇比有七个儿子还好！」

chapters.en: And Naomi took the child, placed him on her lap, and became a nurse to him.
chapters.zh: 拿俄米就把孩子抱在怀中，作他的养母。

chapters.en: The neighbor women said, “A son has been born to Naomi,” and they named him Obed. He became the father of Jesse, the father of David.
chapters.zh: 邻舍的妇人说：「拿俄米得孩子了！」就给孩子起名叫俄备得。这俄备得是耶西的父，耶西是大卫的父。

chapters.en:
Now these are the generations of Perez:
Perez was the father of Hezron,
chapters.zh: 法勒斯的后代记在下面：法勒斯生希斯崙；

chapters.en:
Hezron was the father of Ram,
Ram was the father of Amminadab,
chapters.zh: 希斯崙生兰；兰生亚米拿达；

chapters.en:
Amminadab was the father of Nahshon,
Nahshon was the father of Salmon,
chapters.zh: 亚米拿达生拿顺；拿顺生撒门；

chapters.en:
Salmon was the father of Boaz,
Boaz was the father of Obed,
chapters.zh: 撒门生波阿斯；波阿斯生俄备得；

chapters.en:
Obed was the father of Jesse,
and Jesse was the father of David.
chapters.zh: 俄备得生耶西；耶西生大卫。

chapters.en: Now there was a man named Elkanah who was from Ramathaim-zophim in the hill country of Ephraim. He was the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.
chapters.zh: 以法莲山地的拉玛‧琐非有一个以法莲人，名叫以利加拿，是苏弗的玄孙，讬户的曾孙，以利户的孙子，耶罗罕的儿子。

chapters.en: He had two wives, one named Hannah and the other Peninnah. And Peninnah had children, but Hannah had none.
chapters.zh: 他有两个妻：一名哈拿，一名毗尼拿。毗尼拿有儿女，哈拿没有儿女。

chapters.en: Year after year Elkanah would go up from his city to worship and sacrifice to the LORD of Hosts at Shiloh, where Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, were priests to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这人每年从本城上到示罗，敬拜祭祀万军之耶和华；在那里有以利的两个儿子何弗尼、非尼哈当耶和华的祭司。

chapters.en: And whenever the day came for Elkanah to present his sacrifice, he would give portions to his wife Peninnah and to all her sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 以利加拿每逢献祭的日子，将〔祭肉〕分给他的妻毗尼拿和毗尼拿所生的儿女；

chapters.en: But to Hannah he would give a double portion, for he loved her even though the LORD had closed her womb.
chapters.zh: 给哈拿的却是双分，因为他爱哈拿。无奈耶和华不使哈拿生育。

chapters.en: Because the LORD had closed Hannah’s womb, her rival would provoke her viciously to taunt her.
chapters.zh: 毗尼拿见耶和华不使哈拿生育，就作她的对头，大大激动她，要使她生气。

chapters.en: And this went on year after year. Whenever Hannah went up to the house of the LORD, her rival taunted her until she wept and would not eat.
chapters.zh: 每年上到耶和华殿的时候，以利加拿都以双分给哈拿；毗尼拿仍是激动她，以致她哭泣不吃饭。

chapters.en: “Hannah, why are you crying?” her husband Elkanah asked. “Why won’t you eat? Why is your heart so grieved? Am I not better to you than ten sons?”
chapters.zh: 她丈夫以利加拿对她说：「哈拿啊，你为何哭泣，不吃饭，心里愁闷呢？有我不比十个儿子还好吗？」

chapters.en: So after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh, Hannah stood up. Now Eli the priest was sitting on a chair by the doorpost of the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们在示罗吃喝完了，哈拿就站起来。祭司以利在耶和华殿的门框旁边，坐在自己的位上。

chapters.en: In her bitter distress, Hannah prayed to the LORD and wept with many tears.
chapters.zh: 哈拿心里愁苦，就痛痛哭泣，祈祷耶和华，

chapters.en: And she made a vow, saying, “O LORD of Hosts, if only You will look upon the affliction of Your maidservant and remember me, not forgetting Your maidservant but giving her a son, then I will dedicate him to the LORD all the days of his life, and no razor shall ever touch his head.”
chapters.zh: 许愿说：「万军之耶和华啊，你若垂顾婢女的苦情，眷念不忘婢女，赐我一个儿子，我必使他终身归与耶和华，不用剃头刀剃他的头。」

chapters.en: As Hannah kept on praying before the LORD, Eli watched her mouth.
chapters.zh: 哈拿在耶和华面前不住地祈祷，以利定睛看她的嘴。

chapters.en:
Hannah was praying in her heart, and though her lips were moving, her voice could not be heard.
So Eli thought she was drunk
chapters.zh: （原来哈拿心中默祷，只动嘴唇，不出声音，因此以利以为她喝醉了。）

chapters.en: and said to her, “How long will you be drunk? Put away your wine!”
chapters.zh: 以利对她说：「你要醉到几时呢？你不应该喝酒。」

chapters.en: “No, my lord,” Hannah replied. “I am a woman troubled in spirit. I have not had any wine or strong drink, but I have poured out my soul before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 哈拿回答说：「主啊，不是这样。我是心里愁苦的妇人，清酒浓酒都没有喝，但在耶和华面前倾心吐意。

chapters.en: Do not take your servant for a wicked woman, for all this time I have been praying out of the depth of my anguish and grief.”
chapters.zh: 不要将婢女看作不正经的女子。我因被人激动，愁苦太多，所以祈求到如今。」

chapters.en: “Go in peace,” Eli replied, “and may the God of Israel grant the petition you have asked of Him.”
chapters.zh: 以利说：「你可以平平安安地回去。愿以色列的上帝允准你向他所求的！」

chapters.en: “May your maidservant find favor with you,” said Hannah. Then she went on her way, and she began to eat, and her face was no longer downcast.
chapters.zh: 哈拿说：「愿婢女在你眼前蒙恩。」于是妇人走去吃饭，面上再不带愁容了。

chapters.en:
The next morning they got up early to bow in worship before the LORD, and then they returned home to Ramah.
And Elkanah had relations with his wife Hannah, and the LORD remembered her.
chapters.zh: 次日清早，他们起来，在耶和华面前敬拜，就回拉玛。到了家里，以利加拿和妻哈拿同房，耶和华顾念哈拿，

chapters.en: So in the course of time, Hannah conceived and gave birth to a son. She named him Samuel, saying, “Because I have asked for him from the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 哈拿就怀孕。日期满足，生了一个儿子，给他起名叫撒母耳，〔说〕：「这是我从耶和华那里求来的。」

chapters.en: Then Elkanah and all his house went up to make the annual sacrifice to the LORD and to fulfill his vow,
chapters.zh: 以利加拿和他全家都上示罗去，要向耶和华献年祭，并还所许的愿。

chapters.en: but Hannah did not go. “After the boy is weaned,” she said to her husband, “I will take him to appear before the LORD and to stay there permanently.”
chapters.zh: 哈拿却没有上去，对丈夫说：「等孩子断了奶，我便带他上去朝见耶和华，使他永远住在那里。」

chapters.en:
“Do what you think is best,” her husband Elkanah replied, “and stay here until you have weaned him. Only may the LORD confirm His word.”
So Hannah stayed and nursed her son until she had weaned him.
chapters.zh: 她丈夫以利加拿说：「就随你的意行吧！可以等儿子断了奶。但愿耶和华应验他的话。」于是妇人在家里乳养儿子，直到断了奶；

chapters.en: Once she had weaned him, Hannah took the boy with her, along with a three-year-old bull, an ephah of flour, and a skin of wine. Though the boy was still young, she brought him to the house of the LORD at Shiloh.
chapters.zh: 既断了奶，就把孩子带上示罗，到了耶和华的殿；又带了三只公牛，一伊法细面，一皮袋酒。（那时，孩子还小。）

chapters.en: And when they had slaughtered the bull, they brought the boy to Eli.
chapters.zh: 宰了一只公牛，就领孩子到以利面前。

chapters.en: “Please, my lord,” said Hannah, “as surely as you live, my lord, I am the woman who stood here beside you praying to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 妇人说：「主啊，我敢在你面前起誓，从前在你这里站着祈求耶和华的那妇人，就是我。

chapters.en: I prayed for this boy, and since the LORD has granted me what I asked of Him,
chapters.zh: 我祈求为要得这孩子；耶和华已将我所求的赐给我了。

chapters.en:
I now dedicate the boy to the LORD. For as long as he lives, he is dedicated to the LORD.”
So they worshiped the LORD there.
chapters.zh: 所以，我将这孩子归与耶和华，使他终身归与耶和华。」 于是在那里敬拜耶和华。

chapters.en:
At that time Hannah prayed:
“My heart rejoices in the LORD; my horn is exalted in the LORD. My mouth speaks boldly against my enemies, for I rejoice in Your salvation.
chapters.zh: 哈拿祷告说： 我的心因耶和华快乐； 我的角因耶和华高举。 我的口向仇敌张开； 我因耶和华的救恩欢欣。

chapters.en:
There is no one holy like the LORD. Indeed, there is no one besides You!
And there is no Rock like our God.
chapters.zh: 只有耶和华为圣； 除他以外没有可比的， 也没有磐石像我们的上帝。

chapters.en: Do not boast so proudly, or let arrogance come from your mouth, for the LORD is a God who knows, and by Him actions are weighed.
chapters.zh: 人不要夸口说骄傲的话， 也不要出狂妄的言语； 因耶和华是大有智识的上帝， 人的行为被他衡量。

chapters.en: The bows of the mighty are broken, but the feeble are equipped with strength.
chapters.zh: 勇士的弓都已折断； 跌倒的人以力量束腰。

chapters.en: The well-fed hire themselves out for food, but the starving hunger no more. The barren woman gives birth to seven, but she who has many sons pines away.
chapters.zh: 素来饱足的，反作用人求食； 饥饿的，再不饥饿。 不生育的，生了七个儿子； 多有儿女的，反倒衰微。

chapters.en: The LORD brings death and gives life; He brings down to Sheol and raises up.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使人死，也使人活， 使人下阴间，也使人往上升。

chapters.en: The LORD sends poverty and wealth; He humbles and He exalts.
chapters.zh: 他使人贫穷，也使人富足， 使人卑微，也使人高贵。

chapters.en:
He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap. He seats them among princes and bestows on them a throne of honor.
For the foundations of the earth are the LORD’s, and upon them He has set the world.
chapters.zh: 他从灰尘里抬举贫寒人， 从粪堆中提拔穷乏人， 使他们与王子同坐， 得着荣耀的座位。 地的柱子属于耶和华； 他将世界立在其上。

chapters.en:
He guards the steps of His faithful ones, but the wicked perish in darkness;
for by his own strength shall no man prevail.
chapters.zh: 他必保护圣民的脚步， 使恶人在黑暗中寂然不动； 人都不能靠力量得胜。

chapters.en:
Those who oppose the LORD will be shattered. He will thunder from heaven against them. The LORD will judge the ends of the earth and will give power to His king.
He will exalt the horn of His anointed.”
chapters.zh: 与耶和华争竞的，必被打碎； 耶和华必从天上以雷攻击他， 必审判地极的人， 将力量赐与所立的王， 高举受膏者的角。

chapters.en: Then Elkanah went home to Ramah, but the boy began ministering to the LORD before Eli the priest.
chapters.zh: 以利加拿往拉玛回家去了。那孩子在祭司以利面前事奉耶和华。

chapters.en: Now the sons of Eli were wicked men; they had no regard for the LORD
chapters.zh: 以利的两个儿子是恶人，不认识耶和华。

chapters.en:
or for the custom of the priests with the people.
When any man offered a sacrifice, the servant of the priest would come with a three-pronged meat fork while the meat was boiling
chapters.zh: 这二祭司待百姓是这样的规矩：凡有人献祭，正煮肉的时候，祭司的仆人就来，手拿三齿的叉子，

chapters.en: and plunge it into the pan or kettle or cauldron or cooking pot. And the priest would claim for himself whatever the meat fork brought up. This is how they treated all the Israelites who came to Shiloh.
chapters.zh: 将叉子往罐里，或鼎里，或釜里，或锅里一插，插上来的肉，祭司都取了去。凡上到示罗的以色列人，他们都是这样看待。

chapters.en: Even before the fat was burned, the servant of the priest would come and say to the man who was sacrificing, “Give the priest some meat to roast, because he will not accept boiled meat from you, but only raw.”
chapters.zh: 又在未烧脂油以前，祭司的仆人就来对献祭的人说：「将肉给祭司，叫他烤吧。他不要煮过的，要生的。」

chapters.en: And if any man said to him, “The fat must be burned first; then you may take whatever you want,” the servant would reply, “No, you must give it to me right now. If you refuse, I will take it by force!”
chapters.zh: 献祭的人若说：「必须先烧脂油，然后你可以随意取肉。」仆人就说：「你立时给我，不然我便抢去。」

chapters.en: Thus the sin of these young men was severe in the sight of the LORD, for they were treating the LORD’s offering with contempt.
chapters.zh: 如此，这二少年人的罪在耶和华面前甚重了，因为他们藐视耶和华的祭物〔注：或译：他们使人厌弃给耶和华献祭〕。

chapters.en: Now Samuel was ministering before the LORD—a boy wearing a linen ephod.
chapters.zh: 那时，撒母耳还是孩子，穿着细麻布的以弗得，侍立在耶和华面前。

chapters.en: Each year his mother would make him a little robe and bring it to him when she went with her husband to offer the annual sacrifice.
chapters.zh: 他母亲每年为他做一件小外袍，同着丈夫上来献年祭的时候带来给他。

chapters.en: And Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife, saying, “May the LORD give you children by this woman in place of the one she dedicated to the LORD. ” Then they would go home.
chapters.zh: 以利为以利加拿和他的妻祝福，说：「愿耶和华由这妇人再赐你后裔，代替你从耶和华求来的孩子。」他们就回本乡去了。

chapters.en:
So the LORD attended to Hannah, and she conceived and gave birth to three sons and two daughters.
Meanwhile, the boy Samuel grew up in the presence of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华眷顾哈拿，她就怀孕生了三个儿子，两个女儿。那孩子撒母耳在耶和华面前渐渐长大。

chapters.en: Now Eli was very old, and he heard about everything his sons were doing to all Israel and how they were sleeping with the women who served at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
chapters.zh: 以利年甚老迈，听见他两个儿子待以色列众人的事，又听见他们与会幕门前伺候的妇人苟合，

chapters.en: “Why are you doing these things?” Eli said to his sons. “I hear about your wicked deeds from all these people.
chapters.zh: 他就对他们说：「你们为何行这样的事呢？我从这众百姓听见你们的恶行。

chapters.en: No, my sons; it is not a good report I hear circulating among the LORD’s people.
chapters.zh: 我儿啊，不可这样！我听见你们的风声不好，你们使耶和华的百姓犯了罪。

chapters.en:
If a man sins against another man, God can intercede for him; but if a man sins against the LORD, who can intercede for him?”
But they would not listen to their father, since the LORD intended to put them to death.
chapters.zh: 人若得罪人，有士师审判他；人若得罪耶和华，谁能为他祈求呢？」然而他们还是不听父亲的话，因为耶和华想要杀他们。

chapters.en: And the boy Samuel continued to grow in stature and in favor with the LORD and with man.
chapters.zh: 孩子撒母耳渐渐长大，耶和华与人越发喜爱他。

chapters.en: Then a man of God came to Eli and told him, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Did I not clearly reveal Myself to your father’s house when they were in Egypt under Pharaoh’s house?
chapters.zh: 有神人来见以利，对他说：「耶和华如此说：『你祖父在埃及法老家〔作奴仆〕的时候，我不是向他们显现吗？

chapters.en: And out of all the tribes of Israel I selected your father to be My priest, to offer sacrifices on My altar, to burn incense, and to wear an ephod in My presence. I also gave to the house of your father all the food offerings of the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 在以色列众支派中，我不是拣选人作我的祭司，使他烧香，在我坛上献祭，在我面前穿以弗得，又将以色列人所献的火祭都赐给你父家吗？

chapters.en: Why then do you kick at My sacrifice and offering that I have prescribed for My dwelling place? You have honored your sons more than Me by fattening yourselves with the best of all the offerings of My people Israel.’
chapters.zh: 我所吩咐献在我居所的祭物，你们为何践踏？尊重你的儿子过于尊重我，将我民以色列所献美好的祭物肥己呢？』

chapters.en:
Therefore, the LORD, the God of Israel, declares:
‘I did indeed say that your house and the house of your father
would walk before Me forever.
But now the LORD declares: Far be it from Me! For I will honor those who honor Me, but those who despise Me will be disdained.
chapters.zh: 因此，耶和华－以色列的上帝说：『我曾说，你和你父家必永远行在我面前；现在我却说，决不容你们这样行。因为尊重我的，我必重看他；藐视我的，他必被轻视。

chapters.en: Behold, the days are coming when I will cut off your strength and the strength of your father’s house, so that no one in it will reach old age.
chapters.zh: 日子必到，我要折断你的膀臂和你父家的膀臂，使你家中没有一个老年人。

chapters.en: You will see distress in My dwelling place. Despite all that is good in Israel, no one in your house will ever again reach old age.
chapters.zh: 在〔上帝〕使以色列人享福的时候，你必看见我居所的败落。在你家中必永远没有一个老年人。

chapters.en: And every one of you that I do not cut off from My altar, I will cause your eyes to fail and your heart to grieve. All your descendants will die by the sword of men.
chapters.zh: 我必不从我坛前灭尽你家中的人；那未灭的必使你眼目干瘪、心中忧伤。你家中所生的人都必死在中年。

chapters.en: And this sign shall come to you concerning your two sons Hophni and Phinehas: They will both die on the same day.
chapters.zh: 你的两个儿子何弗尼、非尼哈所遭遇的事可作你的证据：他们二人必一日同死。

chapters.en: Then I will raise up for Myself a faithful priest. He will do whatever is in My heart and mind. And I will build for him an enduring house, and he will walk before My anointed one for all time.
chapters.zh: 我要为自己立一个忠心的祭司；他必照我的心意而行。我要为他建立坚固的家；他必永远行在我的受膏者面前。

chapters.en: And everyone left in your house will come and bow down to him for a piece of silver or a morsel of bread, pleading, “Please appoint me to some priestly office so that I can eat a piece of bread.”’”
chapters.zh: 你家所剩下的人都必来叩拜他，求块银子，求个饼，说：求你赐我祭司的职分，好叫我得点饼吃。』」

chapters.en:
And the boy Samuel ministered to the LORD before Eli.
Now in those days the word of the LORD was rare, and visions were scarce.
chapters.zh: 童子撒母耳在以利面前事奉耶和华。当那些日子，耶和华的言语稀少，不常有默示。

chapters.en: And at that time Eli, whose eyesight had grown so dim that he could not see, was lying in his room.
chapters.zh: 一日，以利睡卧在自己的地方；他眼目昏花，看不分明。

chapters.en: Before the lamp of God had gone out, Samuel was lying down in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God was located.
chapters.zh: 上帝的灯在上帝耶和华殿内〔约〕柜那里，还没有熄灭，撒母耳已经睡了。

chapters.en: Then the LORD called to Samuel, and he answered, “Here I am.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华呼唤撒母耳。撒母耳说：「我在这里！」

chapters.en:
He ran to Eli and said, “Here I am, for you have called me.”
“I did not call,” Eli replied. “Go back and lie down.”
So he went and lay down.
chapters.zh: 就跑到以利那里，说：「你呼唤我？我在这里。」以利回答说：「我没有呼唤你，你去睡吧。」他就去睡了。

chapters.en:
Once again the LORD called, “Samuel!”
So Samuel got up, went to Eli, and said, “Here I am, for you have called me.”
“My son, I did not call,” Eli replied. “Go back and lie down.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华又呼唤撒母耳。撒母耳起来，到以利那里，说：「你呼唤我？我在这里。」以利回答说：「我的儿，我没有呼唤你，你去睡吧。」

chapters.en: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD, because the word of the LORD had not yet been revealed to him.
chapters.zh: 那时撒母耳还未认识耶和华，也未得耶和华的默示。

chapters.en:
Once again, for the third time, the LORD called to Samuel. He got up, went to Eli, and said, “Here I am, for you have called me.”
Then Eli realized that it was the LORD who was calling the boy.
chapters.zh: 耶和华第三次呼唤撒母耳。撒母耳起来，到以利那里，说：「你又呼唤我？我在这里。」以利才明白是耶和华呼唤童子。

chapters.en:
“Go and lie down,” he said to Samuel, “and if He calls you, say, ‘Speak, LORD, for Your servant is listening.’”
So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
chapters.zh: 因此以利对撒母耳说：「你仍去睡吧；若再呼唤你，你就说：『耶和华啊，请说，仆人敬听！』」撒母耳就去，仍睡在原处。

chapters.en:
Then the LORD came and stood there, calling as before, “Samuel! Samuel!”
And Samuel answered, “Speak, for Your servant is listening.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华又来站着，像前三次呼唤说：「撒母耳啊！撒母耳啊！」撒母耳回答说：「请说，仆人敬听！」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Samuel, “I am about to do something in Israel at which the ears of all who hear it will tingle.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对撒母耳说：「我在以色列中必行一件事，叫听见的人都必耳鸣。

chapters.en: On that day I will carry out against Eli everything I have spoken about his house, from beginning to end.
chapters.zh: 我指着以利家所说的话，到了时候，我必始终应验在以利身上。

chapters.en: I told him that I would judge his house forever for the iniquity of which he knows, because his sons blasphemed God and he did not restrain them.
chapters.zh: 我曾告诉他必永远降罚与他的家，因他知道儿子作孽，自招咒诅，却不禁止他们。

chapters.en: Therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli, ‘The iniquity of Eli’s house shall never be atoned for by sacrifice or offering.’”
chapters.zh: 所以我向以利家起誓说：『以利家的罪孽，虽献祭奉礼物，永不能得赎去。』」

chapters.en: Samuel lay down until the morning; then he opened the doors of the house of the LORD. He was afraid to tell Eli the vision,
chapters.zh: 撒母耳睡到天亮，就开了耶和华的殿门，不敢将默示告诉以利。

chapters.en:
but Eli called to him and said, “Samuel, my son.”
“Here I am,” answered Samuel.
chapters.zh: 以利呼唤撒母耳说：「我儿撒母耳啊！」撒母耳回答说：「我在这里！」

chapters.en: “What was the message He gave you?” Eli asked. “Do not hide it from me. May God punish you, and ever so severely, if you hide from me anything He said to you.”
chapters.zh: 以利说：「〔耶和华〕对你说什么，你不要向我隐瞒；你若将上帝对你所说的隐瞒一句，愿他重重地降罚与你。」

chapters.en:
So Samuel told him everything and did not hide a thing from him.
“He is the LORD,” replied Eli. “Let Him do what is good in His eyes.”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳就把一切话都告诉了以利，并没有隐瞒。以利说：「这是出于耶和华，愿他凭自己的意旨而行。」

chapters.en: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and He let none of Samuel’s words fall to the ground.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳长大了，耶和华与他同在，使他所说的话一句都不落空。

chapters.en: So all Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew that Samuel was confirmed as a prophet of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 从但到别是巴所有的以色列人都知道耶和华立撒母耳为先知。

chapters.en: And the LORD continued to appear at Shiloh, because there He revealed Himself to Samuel by His word.
chapters.zh: 耶和华又在示罗显现；因为耶和华将自己的话默示撒母耳，撒母耳就把这话传遍以色列地。

chapters.en:
Thus the word of Samuel came to all Israel.
Now the Israelites went out to meet the Philistines in battle and camped at Ebenezer, while the Philistines camped at Aphek.
chapters.zh: 以色列人出去与非利士人打仗，安营在以便以谢；非利士人安营在亚弗。

chapters.en: The Philistines arrayed themselves against Israel, and as the battle spread, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who struck down about four thousand men on the battlefield.
chapters.zh: 非利士人向以色列人摆阵。两军交战的时候，以色列人败在非利士人面前；非利士人在战场上杀了他们的军兵约有四千人。

chapters.en: When the troops returned to the camp, the elders of Israel asked, “Why has the LORD brought defeat on us before the Philistines today? Let us bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD from Shiloh, so that it may go with us to save us from the hand of our enemies.”
chapters.zh: 百姓回到营里，以色列的长老说：「耶和华今日为何使我们败在非利士人面前呢？我们不如将耶和华的约柜从示罗抬到我们这里来，好在我们中间救我们脱离敌人的手。」

chapters.en: So the people sent men to Shiloh, and they brought back the ark of the covenant of the LORD of Hosts, who sits enthroned between the cherubim. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.
chapters.zh: 于是百姓打发人到示罗，从那里将坐在二基路伯上万军之耶和华的约柜抬来。以利的两个儿子何弗尼、非尼哈与上帝的约柜同来。

chapters.en: When the ark of the covenant of the LORD entered the camp, all the Israelites raised such a great shout that the ground shook.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的约柜到了营中，以色列众人就大声欢呼，地便震动。

chapters.en:
On hearing the noise of the shout, the Philistines asked, “What is this loud shouting in the camp of the Hebrews?”
And when they realized that the ark of the LORD had entered the camp,
chapters.zh: 非利士人听见欢呼的声音，就说：「在希伯来人营里大声欢呼，是什么缘故呢？」随后就知道耶和华的〔约〕柜到了营中。

chapters.en: the Philistines were afraid. “The gods have entered their camp!” they said. “Woe to us, for nothing like this has happened before.
chapters.zh: 非利士人就惧怕起来，说：「有神到了他们营中」；又说：「我们有祸了！向来不曾有这样的事。

chapters.en: Woe to us! Who will deliver us from the hand of these mighty gods? These are the gods who struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 我们有祸了！谁能救我们脱离这些大能之神的手呢？从前在旷野用各样灾殃击打埃及人的，就是这些神。

chapters.en: Take courage and be men, O Philistines! Otherwise, you will serve the Hebrews just as they served you. Now be men and fight!”
chapters.zh: 非利士人哪，你们要刚强，要作大丈夫，免得作希伯来人的奴仆，如同他们作你们的奴仆一样。你们要作大丈夫，与他们争战。」

chapters.en: So the Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and each man fled to his tent. The slaughter was very great—thirty thousand foot soldiers of Israel fell.
chapters.zh: 非利士人和以色列人打仗，以色列人败了，各向各家奔逃，被杀的人甚多，以色列的步兵仆倒了三万。

chapters.en: The ark of God was captured, and Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, died.
chapters.zh: 上帝的〔约〕柜被掳去，以利的两个儿子何弗尼、非尼哈也都被杀了。

chapters.en: That same day a Benjamite ran from the battle line all the way to Shiloh, with his clothes torn and dirt on his head.
chapters.zh: 当日，有一个便雅悯人从阵上逃跑，衣服撕裂，头蒙灰尘，来到示罗。

chapters.en:
When he arrived, there was Eli, sitting on his chair beside the road and watching, because his heart trembled for the ark of God.
When the man entered the city to give a report, the whole city cried out.
chapters.zh: 到了的时候，以利正在道旁坐在自己的位上观望，为上帝的〔约〕柜心里担忧。那人进城报信，合城的人就都呼喊起来。

chapters.en:
Eli heard the outcry and asked, “Why this commotion?”
So the man hurried over and reported to Eli.
chapters.zh: 以利听见呼喊的声音就问说：「这喧嚷是什么缘故呢？」那人急忙来报信给以利。

chapters.en: Now Eli was ninety-eight years old, and his gaze was fixed because he could not see.
chapters.zh: 那时以利九十八岁了，眼目发直，不能看见。

chapters.en:
“I have just come from the battle,” the man said to Eli. “I fled from there today.”
“What happened, my son?” Eli asked.
chapters.zh: 那人对以利说：「我是从阵上来的，今日我从阵上逃回。」以利说：「我儿，事情怎样？」

chapters.en: The messenger answered, “Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has been a great slaughter among the people. Your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, are both dead, and the ark of God has been captured.”
chapters.zh: 报信的回答说：「以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，民中被杀的甚多！你的两个儿子何弗尼、非尼哈也都死了，并且上帝的〔约〕柜被掳去。」

chapters.en: As soon as the ark of God was mentioned, Eli fell backward from his chair by the city gate, and being old and heavy, he broke his neck and died. And Eli had judged Israel forty years.
chapters.zh: 他一提上帝的〔约〕柜，以利就从他的位上往后跌倒，在门旁折断颈项而死；因为他年纪老迈，身体沉重。以利作以色列的士师四十年。

chapters.en: Now Eli’s daughter-in-law, the wife of Phinehas, was pregnant and about to give birth. When she heard the news of the capture of God’s ark and the deaths of her father-in-law and her husband, she collapsed and gave birth, for her labor pains overtook her.
chapters.zh: 以利的儿妇、非尼哈的妻怀孕将到产期，她听见上帝的〔约〕柜被掳去，公公和丈夫都死了，就猛然疼痛，曲身生产；

chapters.en:
As she was dying, the women attending to her said, “Do not be afraid, for you have given birth to a son!”
But she did not respond or pay any heed.
chapters.zh: 将要死的时候，旁边站着的妇人们对她说：「不要怕！你生了男孩子了。」她却不回答，也不放在心上。

chapters.en: And she named the boy Ichabod, saying, “The glory has departed from Israel,” because the ark of God had been captured and her father-in-law and her husband had been killed.
chapters.zh: 她给孩子起名叫以迦博，说：「荣耀离开以色列了！」这是因上帝的〔约〕柜被掳去，又因她公公和丈夫都死了。

chapters.en: “The glory has departed from Israel,” she said, “for the ark of God has been captured.”
chapters.zh: 她又说：「荣耀离开以色列，因为上帝的约柜被掳去了。」

chapters.en: After the Philistines had captured the ark of God, they took it from Ebenezer to Ashdod,
chapters.zh: 非利士人将上帝的〔约〕柜从以便以谢抬到亚实突。

chapters.en: carried it into the temple of Dagon, and set it beside his statue.
chapters.zh: 非利士人将上帝的〔约〕柜抬进大衮庙，放在大衮的旁边。

chapters.en: When the people of Ashdod got up early the next morning, there was Dagon, fallen on his face before the ark of the LORD. So they took Dagon and returned him to his place.
chapters.zh: 次日清早，亚实突人起来，见大衮仆倒在耶和华的〔约〕柜前，脸伏于地，就把大衮仍立在原处。

chapters.en: But when they got up early the next morning, there was Dagon, fallen on his face before the ark of the LORD, with his head and his hands broken off and lying on the threshold. Only the torso remained.
chapters.zh: 又次日清早起来，见大衮仆倒在耶和华的〔约〕柜前，脸伏于地，并且大衮的头和两手都在门槛上折断，只剩下大衮的〔残体〕。

chapters.en: That is why, to this day, the priests of Dagon and all who enter the temple of Dagon in Ashdod do not step on the threshold.
chapters.zh: （因此，大衮的祭司和一切进亚实突、大衮庙的人都不踏大衮庙的门槛，直到今日。）

chapters.en: Now the hand of the LORD was heavy on the people of Ashdod and its vicinity, ravaging them and afflicting them with tumors.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的手重重加在亚实突人身上，败坏他们，使他们生痔疮。亚实突和亚实突的四境都是如此。

chapters.en: And when the men of Ashdod saw what was happening, they said, “The ark of the God of Israel must not stay here with us, because His hand is heavy upon us and upon our god Dagon.”
chapters.zh: 亚实突人见这光景，就说：「以色列上帝的〔约〕柜不可留在我们这里，因为他的手重重加在我们和我们神大衮的身上」；

chapters.en:
So they called together all the rulers of the Philistines and asked, “What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel?”
“It must be moved to Gath,” they replied. So they carried away the ark of the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 就打发人去请非利士的众首领来聚集，问他们说：「我们向以色列上帝的〔约〕柜应当怎样行呢？」他们回答说：「可以将以色列上帝的〔约〕柜运到迦特去。」于是将以色列上帝的〔约〕柜运到那里去。

chapters.en: But after they had moved the ark to Gath, the LORD’s hand was also against that city, throwing it into great confusion and afflicting the men of the city, both young and old, with an outbreak of tumors.
chapters.zh: 运到之后，耶和华的手攻击那城，使那城的人大大惊慌，无论大小都生痔疮。

chapters.en: So they sent the ark of God to Ekron, but as it arrived, the Ekronites cried out, “They have brought us the ark of the God of Israel in order to kill us and our people!”
chapters.zh: 他们就把上帝的〔约〕柜送到以革伦。上帝的〔约〕柜到了，以革伦人就喊嚷起来说：「他们将以色列上帝的〔约〕柜运到我们这里，要害我们和我们的众民！」

chapters.en:
Then the Ekronites called together all the rulers of the Philistines and said, “Send away the ark of the God of Israel. It must return to its place, so that it will not kill us and our people!”
For a deadly confusion had pervaded the city; the hand of God was very heavy upon it.
chapters.zh: 于是打发人去请非利士的众首领来，说：「愿你们将以色列上帝的〔约〕柜送回原处，免得害了我们和我们的众民！」原来上帝的手重重攻击那城，城中的人有因惊慌而死的；

chapters.en: Those who did not die were afflicted with tumors, and the outcry of the city went up to heaven.
chapters.zh: 未曾死的人都生了痔疮。合城呼号，声音上达于天。

chapters.en: When the ark of the LORD had been in the land of the Philistines seven months,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的〔约〕柜在非利士人之地七个月。

chapters.en: the Philistines summoned the priests and diviners, saying, “What shall we do with the ark of the LORD? Tell us how to send it back to its place.”
chapters.zh: 非利士人将祭司和占卜的聚了来，问他们说：「我们向耶和华的〔约〕柜应当怎样行？请指示我们用何法将〔约〕柜送回原处。」

chapters.en: They replied, “If you return the ark of the God of Israel, do not send it away empty, but by all means return it to Him with a guilt offering. Then you will be healed, and you will understand why His hand has not been lifted from you.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「若要将以色列上帝的〔约〕柜送回去，不可空空地送去，必要给他献赔罪的礼物，然后你们可得痊愈，并知道他的手为何不离开你们。」

chapters.en:
“What guilt offering should we send back to Him?” asked the Philistines.
“Five gold tumors and five gold rats,” they said, “according to the number of rulers of the Philistines, since the same plague has struck both you and your rulers.
chapters.zh: 非利士人说：「应当用什么献为赔罪的礼物呢？」他们回答说：「当照非利士首领的数目，用五个金痔疮，五个金老鼠，因为在你们众人和你们首领的身上都是一样的灾。

chapters.en: Make images of your tumors and of the rats that are ravaging the land. Give glory to the God of Israel, and perhaps He will lift His hand from you and your gods and your land.
chapters.zh: 所以当制造你们痔疮的像和毁坏你们田地老鼠的像，并要归荣耀给以色列的上帝，或者他向你们和你们的神，并你们的田地，把手放轻些。

chapters.en: Why harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened theirs? When He afflicted them, did they not send the people out so they could go on their way?
chapters.zh: 你们为何硬着心像埃及人和法老一样呢？上帝在埃及人中间行奇事，埃及人岂不释放以色列人，他们就去了吗？

chapters.en: Now, therefore, prepare one new cart with two milk cows that have never been yoked. Hitch the cows to the cart, but take their calves away and pen them up.
chapters.zh: 现在你们应当造一辆新车，将两只未曾负轭有乳的母牛套在车上，使牛犊回家去，离开母牛。

chapters.en:
Take the ark of the LORD, set it on the cart, and in a chest beside it put the gold objects you are sending back to Him as a guilt offering.
Then send the ark on its way,
chapters.zh: 把耶和华的〔约〕柜放在车上，将所献赔罪的金物装在匣子里，放在柜旁，将柜送去。

chapters.en: but keep watching it. If it goes up the road to its homeland, toward Beth-shemesh, it is the LORD who has brought on us this great disaster. But if it does not, then we will know that it was not His hand that punished us and that it happened by chance.”
chapters.zh: 你们要看看：车若直行以色列的境界到伯‧示麦去，这大灾就是耶和华降在我们身上的；若不然，便可以知道不是他的手击打我们，是我们偶然遇见的。」

chapters.en: So the men did as instructed. They took two milk cows, hitched them to the cart, and penned up their calves.
chapters.zh: 非利士人就这样行：将两只有乳的母牛套在车上，将牛犊关在家里，

chapters.en: Then they put the ark of the LORD on the cart, along with the chest containing the gold rats and the images of the tumors.
chapters.zh: 把耶和华的〔约〕柜和装金老鼠并金痔疮像的匣子都放在车上。

chapters.en: And the cows headed straight up the road toward Beth-shemesh, staying on that one highway and lowing as they went, never straying to the right or to the left. The rulers of the Philistines followed behind them to the border of Beth-shemesh.
chapters.zh: 牛直行大道，往伯‧示麦去，一面走一面叫，不偏左右。非利士的首领跟在后面，直到伯‧示麦的境界。

chapters.en: Now the people of Beth-shemesh were harvesting wheat in the valley, and when they looked up and saw the ark, they were overjoyed at the sight.
chapters.zh: 伯‧示麦人正在平原收割麦子，举目看见〔约〕柜，就欢喜了。

chapters.en: The cart came to the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh and stopped there near a large rock. The people chopped up the cart and offered the cows as a burnt offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 车到了伯‧示麦人约书亚的田间，就站住了。在那里有一块大磐石，他们把车劈了，将两只母牛献给耶和华为燔祭。

chapters.en: And the Levites took down the ark of the LORD and the chest containing the gold objects, and they placed them on the large rock. That day the men of Beth-shemesh offered burnt offerings and made sacrifices to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 利未人将耶和华的〔约〕柜和装金物的匣子拿下来，放在大磐石上。当日伯‧示麦人将燔祭和〔平安〕祭献给耶和华。

chapters.en: And when the five rulers of the Philistines saw this, they returned to Ekron that same day.
chapters.zh: 非利士人的五个首领看见，当日就回以革伦去了。

chapters.en: As a guilt offering to the LORD, the Philistines had sent back one gold tumor for each city: Ashdod, Gaza, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron.
chapters.zh: 非利士人献给耶和华作赔罪的金痔疮像，就是这些：一个是为亚实突，一个是为迦萨，一个是为亚实基伦，一个是为迦特，一个是为以革伦。

chapters.en: The number of gold rats also corresponded to the number of Philistine cities belonging to the five rulers—the fortified cities and their outlying villages. And the large rock on which they placed the ark of the LORD stands to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh.
chapters.zh: 金老鼠的数目是照非利士五个首领的城邑，就是坚固的城邑和乡村，以及大磐石。这磐石是放耶和华〔约〕柜的，到今日还在伯‧示麦人约书亚的田间。

chapters.en: But God struck down some of the people of Beth-shemesh because they looked inside the ark of the LORD. He struck down seventy men, and the people mourned because the LORD had struck them with a great slaughter.
chapters.zh: 耶和华因伯‧示麦人擅观他的〔约〕柜，就击杀了他们七十人；那时有五万人在那里〔注：原文是七十人加五万人〕。百姓因耶和华大大击杀他们，就哀哭了。

chapters.en: The men of Beth-shemesh asked, “Who can stand in the presence of the LORD, this holy God? To whom should the ark go up from here?”
chapters.zh: 伯‧示麦人说：「谁能在耶和华这圣洁的上帝面前侍立呢？这〔约〕柜可以从我们这里送到谁那里去呢？」

chapters.en: So they sent messengers to the people of Kiriath-jearim, saying, “The Philistines have returned the ark of the LORD. Come down and take it up with you.”
chapters.zh: 于是打发人去见基列‧耶琳的居民，说：「非利士人将耶和华的〔约〕柜送回来了，你们下来将〔约〕柜接到你们那里去吧！」

chapters.en: Then the men of Kiriath-jearim came for the ark of the LORD and took it into Abinadab’s house on the hill. And they consecrated his son Eleazar to guard the ark of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 基列‧耶琳人就下来，将耶和华的〔约〕柜接上去，放在山上亚比拿达的家中，分派他儿子以利亚撒看守耶和华的〔约〕柜。

chapters.en: And from that day a long time passed, twenty years in all, as the ark remained at Kiriath-jearim. And all the house of Israel mournfully sought the LORD.
chapters.zh: 〔约〕柜在基列‧耶琳许久。过了二十年，以色列全家都倾向耶和华。

chapters.en: Then Samuel said to all the house of Israel, “If you are returning to the LORD with all your hearts, then put away the foreign gods and Ashtoreths among you, prepare your hearts for the LORD, and serve Him only. And He will deliver you from the hand of the Philistines.”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对以色列全家说：「你们若一心归顺耶和华，就要把外邦的神和亚斯她录从你们中间除掉，专心归向耶和华，单单地事奉他。他必救你们脱离非利士人的手。」

chapters.en: So the Israelites put away the Baals and Ashtoreths and served only the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以色列人就除掉诸巴力和亚斯她录，单单地事奉耶和华。

chapters.en: Then Samuel said, “Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to the LORD on your behalf.”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳说：「要使以色列众人聚集在米斯巴，我好为你们祷告耶和华。」

chapters.en: When they had gathered at Mizpah, they drew water and poured it out before the LORD. On that day they fasted, and there they confessed, “We have sinned against the LORD.” And Samuel judged the Israelites at Mizpah.
chapters.zh: 他们就聚集在米斯巴，打水浇在耶和华面前，当日禁食，说：「我们得罪了耶和华。」于是撒母耳在米斯巴审判以色列人。

chapters.en: When the Philistines heard that the Israelites had gathered at Mizpah, their rulers marched up toward Israel. And when the Israelites learned of this, they feared the Philistines
chapters.zh: 非利士人听见以色列人聚集在米斯巴，非利士的首领就上来要攻击以色列人。以色列人听见，就惧怕非利士人。

chapters.en: and said to Samuel, “Do not stop crying out to the LORD our God for us, that He may save us from the hand of the Philistines.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人对撒母耳说：「愿你不住地为我们呼求耶和华－我们的上帝，救我们脱离非利士人的手。」

chapters.en: Then Samuel took a suckling lamb and offered it as a whole burnt offering to the LORD. He cried out to the LORD on behalf of Israel, and the LORD answered him.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳就把一只吃奶的羊羔献与耶和华作全牲的燔祭，为以色列人呼求耶和华；耶和华就应允他。

chapters.en: As the Philistines drew near to fight against Israel, Samuel was offering up the burnt offering. But that day the LORD thundered loudly against the Philistines and threw them into such confusion that they fled before Israel.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳正献燔祭的时候，非利士人前来要与以色列人争战。当日，耶和华大发雷声，惊乱非利士人，他们就败在以色列人面前。

chapters.en: Then the men of Israel charged out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, striking them down all the way to an area below Beth-car.
chapters.zh: 以色列人从米斯巴出来，追赶非利士人，击杀他们，直到伯‧甲的下边。

chapters.en: Afterward, Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and Shen. He named it Ebenezer, saying, “Thus far the LORD has helped us.”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳将一块石头立在米斯巴和善的中间，给石头起名叫以便以谢，说：「到如今耶和华都帮助我们。」

chapters.en: So the Philistines were subdued, and they stopped invading the territory of Israel. And the hand of the LORD was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.
chapters.zh: 从此，非利士人就被制伏，不敢再入以色列人的境内。撒母耳作士师的时候，耶和华的手攻击非利士人。

chapters.en: The cities from Ekron to Gath, which the Philistines had taken, were restored to Israel, who also delivered the surrounding territory from the hand of the Philistines. And there was peace between the Israelites and the Amorites.
chapters.zh: 非利士人所取以色列人的城邑，从以革伦直到迦特，都归以色列人了。属这些城的四境，以色列人也从非利士人手下收回。那时以色列人与亚摩利人和好。

chapters.en: So Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳平生作以色列的士师。

chapters.en: Every year he would go on a circuit from Bethel to Gilgal to Mizpah, judging Israel in all these places.
chapters.zh: 他每年巡行到伯特利、吉甲、米斯巴，在这几处审判以色列人。

chapters.en: Then he would return to Ramah because his home was there, and there he judged Israel and built an altar to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 随后回到拉玛，因为他的家在那里；也在那里审判以色列人，且为耶和华筑了一座坛。

chapters.en: When Samuel grew old, he appointed his sons as judges over Israel.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳年纪老迈，就立他儿子作以色列的士师。

chapters.en: The name of his firstborn son was Joel, and the name of his second was Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.
chapters.zh: 长子名叫约珥，次子名叫亚比亚；他们在别是巴作士师。

chapters.en: But his sons did not walk in his ways; they turned aside toward dishonest gain, accepting bribes and perverting justice.
chapters.zh: 他儿子不行他的道，贪图财利，收受贿赂，屈枉正直。

chapters.en: So all the elders of Israel gathered together and came to Samuel at Ramah.
chapters.zh: 以色列的长老都聚集，来到拉玛见撒母耳，

chapters.en: “Look,” they said, “you are old, and your sons do not walk in your ways. Now appoint a king to judge us like all the other nations.”
chapters.zh: 对他说：「你年纪老迈了，你儿子不行你的道。现在求你为我们立一个王治理我们，像列国一样。」

chapters.en: But when they said, “Give us a king to judge us,” their demand was displeasing in the sight of Samuel; so he prayed to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳不喜悦他们说「立一个王治理我们」，他就祷告耶和华。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they say to you. For it is not you they have rejected, but they have rejected Me as their king.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对撒母耳说：「百姓向你说的一切话，你只管依从；因为他们不是厌弃你，乃是厌弃我，不要我作他们的王。

chapters.en: Just as they have done from the day I brought them up out of Egypt until this day, forsaking Me and serving other gods, so they are doing to you.
chapters.zh: 自从我领他们出埃及到如今，他们常常离弃我，事奉别神。现在他们向你所行的，是照他们素来所行的。

chapters.en: Now listen to their voice; but you must solemnly warn them and show them the manner of the king who will reign over them.”
chapters.zh: 故此你要依从他们的话，只是当警戒他们，告诉他们将来那王怎样管辖他们。」

chapters.en: So Samuel spoke all the words of the LORD to the people who were asking him for a king.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳将耶和华的话都传给求他立王的百姓，说：

chapters.en: He said, “This will be the manner of the king who will reign over you: He will take your sons and appoint them to serve his own chariots and horses, and to run in front of his chariots.
chapters.zh: 「管辖你们的王必这样行：他必派你们的儿子为他赶车、跟马，奔走在车前；

chapters.en: He will appoint some for himself as commanders of thousands and of fifties, and others to plow his ground, to reap his harvest, and to make his weapons of war and equipment for his chariots.
chapters.zh: 又派他们作千夫长、五十夫长，为他耕种田地，收割庄稼，打造军器和车上的器械；

chapters.en: And he will take your daughters to be perfumers, cooks, and bakers.
chapters.zh: 必取你们的女儿为他制造香膏，做饭烤饼；

chapters.en: He will take the best of your fields and vineyards and olive groves and give them to his servants.
chapters.zh: 也必取你们最好的田地、葡萄园、橄榄园赐给他的臣仆。

chapters.en: He will take a tenth of your grain and grape harvest and give it to his officials and servants.
chapters.zh: 你们的粮食和葡萄园所出的，他必取十分之一给他的太监和臣仆；

chapters.en: And he will take your menservants and maidservants and your best cattle and donkeys and put them to his own use.
chapters.zh: 又必取你们的仆人婢女，健壮的少年人和你们的驴，供他的差役。

chapters.en: He will take a tenth of your flocks, and you yourselves will become his slaves.
chapters.zh: 你们的羊群他必取十分之一，你们也必作他的仆人。

chapters.en: When that day comes, you will beg for relief from the king you have chosen, but the LORD will not answer you on that day.”
chapters.zh: 那时你们必因所选的王哀求耶和华，耶和华却不应允你们。」

chapters.en: Nevertheless, the people refused to listen to Samuel. “No!” they said. “We must have a king over us.
chapters.zh: 百姓竟不肯听撒母耳的话，说：「不然！我们定要一个王治理我们，

chapters.en: Then we will be like all the other nations, with a king to judge us, to go out before us, and to fight our battles.”
chapters.zh: 使我们像列国一样，有王治理我们，统领我们，为我们争战。」

chapters.en: Samuel listened to all the words of the people and repeated them in the hearing of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳听见百姓这一切话，就将这话陈明在耶和华面前。

chapters.en:
“Listen to their voice,” the LORD said to Samuel. “Appoint a king for them.”
Then Samuel told the men of Israel, “Everyone must go back to his city.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对撒母耳说：「你只管依从他们的话，为他们立王。」撒母耳对以色列人说：「你们各归各城去吧！」

chapters.en: Now there was a Benjamite, a powerful man, whose name was Kish son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah of Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 有一个便雅悯人，名叫基士，是便雅悯人亚斐亚的玄孙，比歌拉的曾孙，洗罗的孙子，亚别的儿子，是个大能的勇士〔注：或译：大财主〕。

chapters.en: And he had a son named Saul, choice and handsome, without equal among the Israelites—a head taller than any of the people.
chapters.zh: 他有一个儿子，名叫扫罗，又健壮、又俊美，在以色列人中没有一个能比他的；身体比众民高过一头。

chapters.en: One day the donkeys of Saul’s father Kish wandered off, and Kish said to his son Saul, “Take one of the servants and go look for the donkeys.”
chapters.zh: 扫罗的父亲基士丢了几头驴，他就吩咐儿子扫罗说：「你带一个仆人去寻找驴。」

chapters.en: So Saul passed through the hill country of Ephraim and then through the land of Shalishah, but they did not find the donkeys. He and the servant went through the region of Shaalim, but they were not there. Then they went through the land of Benjamin, and still they did not find them.
chapters.zh: 扫罗就走过以法莲山地，又过沙利沙地，都没有找着；又过沙琳地，驴也不在那里；又过便雅悯地，还没有找着。

chapters.en: When they reached the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant, “Come, let us go back, or my father will stop worrying about the donkeys and start worrying about us.”
chapters.zh: 到了苏弗地，扫罗对跟随他的仆人说：「我们不如回去，恐怕我父亲不为驴挂心，反为我们担忧。」

chapters.en: “Look,” said the servant, “in this city there is a man of God who is highly respected; everything he says surely comes to pass. Let us go there now. Perhaps he will tell us which way to go.”
chapters.zh: 仆人说：「这城里有一位神人，是众人所尊重的，凡他所说的全都应验。我们不如往他那里去，或者他能将我们当走的路指示我们。」

chapters.en: “If we do go,” Saul replied, “what can we give the man? For the bread in our packs is gone, and there is no gift to take to the man of God. What do we have?”
chapters.zh: 扫罗对仆人说：「我们若去，有什么可以送那人呢？我们囊中的食物都吃尽了，也没有礼物可以送那神人，我们还有什么没有？」

chapters.en: The servant answered him again. “Look,” he said, “I have here in my hand a quarter shekel of silver. I will give it to the man of God, and he will tell us our way.”
chapters.zh: 仆人回答扫罗说：「我手里有银子一舍客勒的四分之一，可以送那神人，请他指示我们当走的路。」

chapters.en: (Formerly in Israel, a man on his way to inquire of God would say, “Come, let us go to the seer.” For the prophet of today was formerly called the seer.)
chapters.zh: （从前以色列中，若有人去问上帝，就说：「我们问先见去吧！」现在称为「先知」的，从前称为「先见」。）

chapters.en: “Good,” said Saul to his servant. “Come, let us go.” So they set out for the city where the man of God was.
chapters.zh: 扫罗对仆人说：「你说的是，我们可以去。」于是他们往神人所住的城里去了。

chapters.en: And as they were climbing the hill to the city, they met some young women coming out to draw water and asked, “Is the seer here?”
chapters.zh: 他们上坡要进城，就遇见几个少年女子出来打水，问她们说：「先见在这里没有？」

chapters.en: “Yes, he is ahead of you,” they answered. “Hurry now, for today he has come to the city because the people have a sacrifice on the high place.
chapters.zh: 女子回答说：「在这里，他在你们前面。快去吧！他今日正到城里，因为今日百姓要在邱坛献祭。

chapters.en: As soon as you enter the city, you will find him before he goes up to the high place to eat. The people will not eat until he comes, because he must bless the sacrifice; after that, the guests will eat. Go up at once; you will find him.”
chapters.zh: 在他还没有上邱坛吃祭物之先，你们一进城必遇见他；因他未到，百姓不能吃，必等他先祝祭，然后请的客才吃。现在你们上去，这时候必遇见他。」

chapters.en: So Saul and his servant went up toward the city, and as they were entering it, there was Samuel coming toward them on his way up to the high place.
chapters.zh: 二人就上去；将进城的时候，撒母耳正迎着他们来，要上邱坛去。

chapters.en: Now on the day before Saul’s arrival, the LORD had revealed to Samuel,
chapters.zh: 扫罗未到的前一日，耶和华已经指示撒母耳说：

chapters.en: “At this time tomorrow I will send you a man from the land of Benjamin, and you are to anoint him ruler over My people Israel; he will save them from the hand of the Philistines. For I have looked upon My people, because their cry has come to Me.”
chapters.zh: 「明日这时候，我必使一个人从便雅悯地到你这里来，你要膏他作我民以色列的君。他必救我民脱离非利士人的手；因我民的哀声上达于我，我就眷顾他们。」

chapters.en: When Samuel saw Saul, the LORD told him, “Here is the man of whom I spoke; he shall rule over My people.”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳看见扫罗的时候，耶和华对他说：「看哪，这人就是我对你所说的，他必治理我的民。」

chapters.en: Saul approached Samuel in the gateway and asked, “Would you please tell me where the seer’s house is?”
chapters.zh: 扫罗在城门里走到撒母耳跟前，说：「请告诉我，先见的寓所在哪里？」

chapters.en: “I am the seer,” Samuel replied. “Go up before me to the high place, for you shall eat with me today. And when I send you off in the morning, I will tell you all that is in your heart.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳回答说：「我就是先见。你在我前面上邱坛去，因为你们今日必与我同席；明日早晨我送你去，将你心里的事都告诉你。

chapters.en: As for the donkeys you lost three days ago, do not worry about them, for they have been found. And upon whom is all the desire of Israel, if not upon you and all your father’s house?”
chapters.zh: 至于你前三日所丢的那几头驴，你心里不必挂念，已经找着了。以色列众人所仰慕的是谁呢？不是仰慕你和你父的全家吗？」

chapters.en: Saul replied, “Am I not a Benjamite from the smallest tribe of Israel, and is not my clan the least of all the clans of Benjamin? So why would you say such a thing to me?”
chapters.zh: 扫罗说：「我不是以色列支派中至小的便雅悯人吗？我家不是便雅悯支派中至小的家吗？你为何对我说这样的话呢？」

chapters.en: Then Samuel took Saul and his servant, brought them into the hall, and seated them in the place of honor among those who were invited—about thirty in all.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳领扫罗和他仆人进了客堂，使他们在请来的客中坐首位；客约有三十个人。

chapters.en: And Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the portion I gave you and told you to set aside.”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对厨役说：「我交给你收存的那一分〔祭肉〕现在可以拿来。」

chapters.en: So the cook picked up the leg and what was attached to it and set it before Saul. Then Samuel said, “Here is what was kept back. It was set apart for you. Eat, for it has been kept for you for this occasion, from the time I said, ‘I have invited the people.’” So Saul dined with Samuel that day.
chapters.zh: 厨役就把收存的腿拿来，摆在扫罗面前，撒母耳说：「这是所留下的，放在你面前。吃吧！因我请百姓的时候，特意为你存留这肉到此时。」 当日，扫罗就与撒母耳同席。

chapters.en: And after they had come down from the high place into the city, Samuel spoke with Saul on the roof of his house.
chapters.zh: 众人从邱坛下来进城，撒母耳和扫罗在房顶上说话。

chapters.en: They got up early in the morning, and just before dawn Samuel called to Saul on the roof, “Get ready, and I will send you on your way!” So Saul got ready, and both he and Samuel went outside together.
chapters.zh: 次日清早起来，黎明的时候，扫罗在房顶上。撒母耳呼叫他说：「起来吧，我好送你回去。」扫罗就起来，和撒母耳一同出去。

chapters.en: As they were going down to the edge of the city, Samuel said to Saul, “Tell the servant to go on ahead of us, but you stay for a while, and I will reveal to you the word of God.” So the servant went on.
chapters.zh: 二人下到城角，撒母耳对扫罗说：「要吩咐仆人先走（仆人就先走了）；你且站在这里，等我将上帝的话传与你听。」

chapters.en: Then Samuel took a flask of oil, poured it on Saul’s head, kissed him, and said, “Has not the LORD anointed you ruler over His inheritance?
chapters.zh: 撒母耳拿瓶膏油倒在扫罗的头上，与他亲嘴，说：「这不是耶和华膏你作他产业的君吗？

chapters.en: When you leave me today, you will find two men at Rachel’s tomb in Zelzah on the border of Benjamin. They will say to you, ‘The donkeys you seek have been found, and now your father has stopped worrying about the donkeys and started worrying about you, asking, “What should I do about my son?”’
chapters.zh: 你今日与我离别之后，在便雅悯境内的泄撒，靠近拉结的坟墓，要遇见两个人。他们必对你说：『你去找的那几头驴已经找着了。现在你父亲不为驴挂心，反为你担忧，说：我为儿子怎么才好呢？』

chapters.en: Then you will go on from there until you come to the Oak of Tabor. Three men going up to God at Bethel will meet you there, one carrying three young goats, another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a skin of wine.
chapters.zh: 你从那里往前行，到了他泊的橡树那里，必遇见三个往伯特利去拜上帝的人：一个带着三只山羊羔，一个带着三个饼，一个带着一皮袋酒。

chapters.en: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, which you will accept from their hands.
chapters.zh: 他们必问你安，给你两个饼，你就从他们手中接过来。

chapters.en: After that you will come to Gibeah of God, where the Philistines have an outpost. As you approach the city, you will meet a group of prophets coming down from the high place, preceded by harps, tambourines, flutes, and lyres, and they will be prophesying.
chapters.zh: 此后你到上帝的山，在那里有非利士人的防兵。你到了城的时候，必遇见一班先知从邱坛下来，前面有鼓瑟的、击鼓的、吹笛的、弹琴的，他们都受感说话。

chapters.en: Then the Spirit of the LORD will rush upon you, and you will prophesy with them; and you will be transformed into a different person.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的灵必大大感动你，你就与他们一同受感说话；你要变为新人。

chapters.en: When these signs have come, do as the occasion demands, for God is with you.
chapters.zh: 这兆头临到你，你就可以趁时而做，因为上帝与你同在。

chapters.en: And you shall go before me to Gilgal, and surely I will come to you to offer burnt offerings and to sacrifice peace offerings. Wait seven days until I come to you and show you what you are to do.”
chapters.zh: 你当在我以先下到吉甲，我也必下到那里献燔祭和平安祭。你要等候七日，等我到了那里，指示你当行的事。」

chapters.en: As Saul turned to leave Samuel, God changed Saul’s heart, and all the signs came to pass that day.
chapters.zh: 扫罗转身离别撒母耳，上帝就赐他一个新心。当日这一切兆头都应验了。

chapters.en: When Saul and his servant arrived at Gibeah, a group of prophets met him. Then the Spirit of God rushed upon him, and he prophesied along with them.
chapters.zh: 扫罗到了那山，有一班先知遇见他，上帝的灵大大感动他，他就在先知中受感说话。

chapters.en: When all those who had formerly known Saul saw him prophesying with the prophets, they asked one another, “What has happened to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?”
chapters.zh: 素来认识扫罗的，看见他和先知一同受感说话，就彼此说：「基士的儿子遇见什么了？扫罗也列在先知中吗？」

chapters.en: Then a man who lived there replied, “And who is their father?” So the saying became a proverb: “Is Saul also among the prophets?”
chapters.zh: 那地方有一个人说：「这些人的父亲是谁呢？」此后有句俗语说：「扫罗也列在先知中吗？」

chapters.en: And when Saul had finished prophesying, he went up to the high place.
chapters.zh: 扫罗受感说话已毕，就上邱坛去了。

chapters.en:
Now Saul’s uncle asked him and his servant, “Where did you go?”
“To look for the donkeys,” Saul replied. “When we saw they were not to be found, we went to Samuel.”
chapters.zh: 扫罗的叔叔问扫罗和他仆人说：「你们往哪里去了？」回答说：「找驴去了。我们见没有驴，就到了撒母耳那里。」

chapters.en: “Tell me,” Saul’s uncle asked, “what did Samuel say to you?”
chapters.zh: 扫罗的叔叔说：「请将撒母耳向你们所说的话告诉我。」

chapters.en: And Saul replied, “He assured us that the donkeys had been found.” But Saul did not tell his uncle what Samuel had said about the kingship.
chapters.zh: 扫罗对他叔叔说：「他明明地告诉我们驴已经找着了。」至于撒母耳所说的国事，扫罗却没有告诉叔叔。

chapters.en: After this, Samuel summoned the people to the LORD at Mizpah
chapters.zh: 撒母耳将百姓招聚到米斯巴耶和华那里，

chapters.en: and said to the Israelites, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I brought Israel up out of Egypt, and I rescued you from the hands of the Egyptians and of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.’
chapters.zh: 对他们说：「耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：『我领你们以色列人出埃及，救你们脱离埃及人的手，又救你们脱离欺压你们各国之人的手。』

chapters.en: But today you have rejected your God, who saves you from all your troubles and afflictions, and you have said to Him, ‘No, set a king over us.’ Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes and clans.”
chapters.zh: 你们今日却厌弃了救你们脱离一切灾难的上帝，说：『求你立一个王治理我们。』现在你们应当按着支派、宗族都站在耶和华面前。」

chapters.en: Thus Samuel had all the tribes of Israel come forward, and the tribe of Benjamin was selected.
chapters.zh: 于是，撒母耳使以色列众支派近前来掣签，就掣出便雅悯支派来；

chapters.en: Then he had the tribe of Benjamin come forward by its clans, and the clan of Matri was selected. Finally, Saul son of Kish was selected. But when they looked for him, they could not find him.
chapters.zh: 又使便雅悯支派按着宗族近前来，就掣出玛特利族，从其中又掣出基士的儿子扫罗。众人寻找他却寻不着，

chapters.en:
So again they inquired of the LORD, “Has the man come here yet?”
And the LORD replied, “Behold, he has hidden himself among the baggage.”
chapters.zh: 就问耶和华说：「那人到这里来了没有？」耶和华说：「他藏在器具中了。」

chapters.en: So they ran and brought Saul, and when he stood among the people, he was a head taller than any of the others.
chapters.zh: 众人就跑去从那里领出他来。他站在百姓中间，身体比众民高过一头。

chapters.en:
Samuel said to all the people, “Do you see the one the LORD has chosen? There is no one like him among all the people.”
And all the people shouted, “Long live the king!”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对众民说：「你们看耶和华所拣选的人，众民中有可比他的吗？」众民就大声欢呼说：「愿王万岁！」

chapters.en: Then Samuel explained to the people the rights of kingship. He wrote them on a scroll and laid it up before the LORD. And Samuel sent all the people away, each to his own home.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳将国法对百姓说明，又记在书上，放在耶和华面前，然后遣散众民，各回各家去了。

chapters.en: Saul also went to his home in Gibeah, and the men of valor whose hearts God had touched went with him.
chapters.zh: 扫罗往基比亚回家去，有上帝感动的一群人跟随他。

chapters.en: But some worthless men said, “How can this man save us?” So they despised him and brought him no gifts; but Saul remained silent about it.
chapters.zh: 但有些匪徒说：「这人怎能救我们呢？」就藐视他，没有送他礼物；扫罗却不理会。

chapters.en: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up and laid siege to Jabesh-gilead. All the men of Jabesh said to him, “Make a treaty with us, and we will serve you.”
chapters.zh: 亚扪人〔的王〕拿辖上来，对着基列‧雅比安营。雅比众人对拿辖说：「你与我们立约，我们就服事你。」

chapters.en: But Nahash the Ammonite replied, “I will make a treaty with you on one condition, that I may put out everyone’s right eye and bring reproach upon all Israel.”
chapters.zh: 亚扪人拿辖说：「你们若由我剜出你们各人的右眼，以此凌辱以色列众人，我就与你们立约。」

chapters.en: “Hold off for seven days,” replied the elders of Jabesh, “and let us send messengers throughout Israel. If there is no one to save us, we will surrender to you.”
chapters.zh: 雅比的长老对他说：「求你宽容我们七日，等我们打发人往以色列的全境去；若没有人救我们，我们就出来归顺你。」

chapters.en: When the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul and relayed these words in the hearing of the people, they all wept aloud.
chapters.zh: 使者到了扫罗住的基比亚，将这话说给百姓听，百姓就都放声而哭。

chapters.en: Just then Saul was returning from the field, behind his oxen. “What troubles the people?” asked Saul. “Why are they weeping?” And they relayed to him the words of the men from Jabesh.
chapters.zh: 扫罗正从田间赶牛回来，问说：「百姓为什么哭呢？」众人将雅比人的话告诉他。

chapters.en: When Saul heard their words, the Spirit of God rushed upon him, and he burned with great anger.
chapters.zh: 扫罗听见这话，就被上帝的灵大大感动，甚是发怒。

chapters.en:
He took a pair of oxen, cut them into pieces, and sent them by messengers throughout the land of Israel, proclaiming, “This is what will be done to the oxen of anyone who does not march behind Saul and Samuel.”
Then the terror of the LORD fell upon the people, and they came out together as one man.
chapters.zh: 他将一对牛切成块子，托付使者传送以色列的全境，说：「凡不出来跟随扫罗和撒母耳的，也必这样切开他的牛。」于是耶和华使百姓惧怕，他们就都出来，如同一人。

chapters.en: And when Saul numbered them at Bezek, there were 300,000 Israelites and 30,000 men of Judah.
chapters.zh: 扫罗在比色数点他们：以色列人有三十万，犹大人有三万。

chapters.en:
So they said to the messengers who had come, “Tell the men of Jabesh-gilead: ‘Deliverance will be yours tomorrow by the time the sun is hot.’”
And when the messengers relayed this to the men of Jabesh, they rejoiced.
chapters.zh: 众人对那使者说：「你们要回复基列‧雅比人说，明日太阳近午的时候，你们必得解救。」使者回去告诉雅比人，他们就欢喜了。

chapters.en: Then the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, “Tomorrow we will come out, and you can do with us whatever seems good to you.”
chapters.zh: 于是雅比人对亚扪人说：「明日我们出来归顺你们，你们可以随意待我们。」

chapters.en: The next day Saul organized the troops into three divisions, and during the morning watch they invaded the camp of the Ammonites and slaughtered them, until the hottest part of the day. And the survivors were so scattered that no two of them were left together.
chapters.zh: 第二日，扫罗将百姓分为三队，在晨更的时候入了亚扪人的营，击杀他们直到太阳近午，剩下的人都逃散，没有二人同在一处的。

chapters.en: Then the people said to Samuel, “Who said that Saul should not reign over us? Bring those men here so we can kill them!”
chapters.zh: 百姓对撒母耳说：「那说『扫罗岂能管理我们』的是谁呢？可以将他交出来，我们好杀死他。」

chapters.en: But Saul ordered, “No one shall be put to death this day, for today the LORD has worked salvation in Israel.”
chapters.zh: 扫罗说：「今日耶和华在以色列中施行拯救，所以不可杀人。」

chapters.en: Then Samuel said to the people, “Come, let us go to Gilgal and renew the kingship there.”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对百姓说：「我们要往吉甲去，在那里立国。」

chapters.en: So all the people went to Gilgal and confirmed Saul as king in the presence of the LORD. There they sacrificed peace offerings before the LORD, and Saul and all the Israelites rejoiced greatly.
chapters.zh: 众百姓就到了吉甲那里，在耶和华面前立扫罗为王，又在耶和华面前献平安祭。扫罗和以色列众人大大欢喜。

chapters.en: Then Samuel said to all Israel, “I have listened to your voice in all that you have said to me, and I have set over you a king.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对以色列众人说：「你们向我所求的，我已应允了，为你们立了一个王；

chapters.en: Now here is the king walking before you, and I am old and gray, and my sons are here with you. I have walked before you from my youth until this day.
chapters.zh: 现在有这王在你们前面行。我已年老发白，我的儿子都在你们这里。我从幼年直到今日都在你们前面行。

chapters.en: Here I am. Bear witness against me before the LORD and before His anointed: Whose ox or donkey have I taken? Whom have I cheated or oppressed? From whose hand have I accepted a bribe and closed my eyes? Tell me, and I will restore it to you.”
chapters.zh: 我在这里，你们要在耶和华和他的受膏者面前给我作见证。我夺过谁的牛，抢过谁的驴，欺负过谁，虐待过谁，从谁手里受过贿赂因而眼瞎呢？若有，我必偿还。」

chapters.en: “You have not cheated us or oppressed us,” they replied, “nor have you taken anything from the hand of man.”
chapters.zh: 众人说：「你未曾欺负我们，虐待我们，也未曾从谁手里受过什么。」

chapters.en:
Samuel said to them, “The LORD is a witness against you, and His anointed is a witness today, that you have not found anything in my hand.”
“He is a witness,” they replied.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对他们说：「你们在我手里没有找着什么，有耶和华和他的受膏者今日为证。」他们说：「愿他为证。」

chapters.en: Then Samuel said to the people, “The LORD is the One who appointed Moses and Aaron, and who brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对百姓说：「从前立摩西、亚伦，又领你们列祖出埃及地的是耶和华。

chapters.en: Now present yourselves, so that I may confront you before the LORD with all the righteous acts He has done for you and your fathers.
chapters.zh: 现在你们要站住，等我在耶和华面前对你们讲论耶和华向你们和你们列祖所行一切公义的事。

chapters.en: When Jacob went to Egypt, your fathers cried out to the LORD, and He sent them Moses and Aaron, who brought your fathers out of Egypt and settled them in this place.
chapters.zh: 从前雅各到了埃及，后来你们列祖呼求耶和华，耶和华就差遣摩西、亚伦领你们列祖出埃及，使他们在这地方居住。

chapters.en: But they forgot the LORD their God, and He sold them into the hand of Sisera the commander of the army of Hazor, and into the hands of the Philistines and the king of Moab, who fought against them.
chapters.zh: 他们却忘记耶和华－他们的上帝，他就把他们付与夏琐将军西西拉的手里，和非利士人并摩押王的手里。于是这些人常来攻击他们。

chapters.en: Then they cried out to the LORD and said, ‘We have sinned, for we have forsaken the LORD and served the Baals and Ashtoreths. Now deliver us from the hands of our enemies, that we may serve You.’
chapters.zh: 他们就呼求耶和华说：『我们离弃耶和华，事奉巴力和亚斯她录，是有罪了。现在求你救我们脱离仇敌的手，我们必事奉你。』

chapters.en: So the LORD sent Jerubbaal, Barak, Jephthah, and Samuel, and He delivered you from the hands of your enemies on every side, and you dwelt securely.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就差遣耶路‧巴力、比但、耶弗他、撒母耳救你们脱离四围仇敌的手，你们才安然居住。

chapters.en: But when you saw that Nahash king of the Ammonites was moving against you, you said to me, ‘No, we must have a king to rule over us’—even though the LORD your God was your king.
chapters.zh: 你们见亚扪人的王拿辖来攻击你们，就对我说：『我们定要一个王治理我们。』其实耶和华－你们的上帝是你们的王。

chapters.en: Now here is the king you have chosen, the one you requested. Behold, the LORD has placed a king over you.
chapters.zh: 现在，你们所求所选的王在这里。看哪，耶和华已经为你们立王了。

chapters.en: If you fear the LORD and serve Him and obey His voice, and if you do not rebel against the command of the LORD, and if both you and the king who rules over you follow the LORD your God, then all will be well.
chapters.zh: 你们若敬畏耶和华，事奉他，听从他的话，不违背他的命令，你们和治理你们的王也都顺从耶和华－你们的上帝就好了。

chapters.en: But if you disobey the LORD and rebel against His command, then the hand of the LORD will be against you as it was against your fathers.
chapters.zh: 倘若不听从耶和华的话，违背他的命令，耶和华的手必攻击你们，像从前攻击你们列祖一样。

chapters.en: Now, therefore, present yourselves and see this great thing that the LORD will do before your eyes.
chapters.zh: 现在你们要站住，看耶和华在你们眼前要行一件大事。

chapters.en: Is it not the wheat harvest today? I will call on the LORD to send thunder and rain, so that you will know and see what a great evil you have committed in the sight of the LORD by asking for a king.”
chapters.zh: 这不是割麦子的时候吗？我求告耶和华，他必打雷降雨，使你们又知道又看出，你们求立王的事是在耶和华面前犯大罪了。」

chapters.en:
So Samuel called to the LORD, and on that day the LORD sent thunder and rain.
As a result, all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.
chapters.zh: 于是撒母耳求告耶和华，耶和华就在这日打雷降雨，众民便甚惧怕耶和华和撒母耳。

chapters.en: They pleaded with Samuel, “Pray to the LORD your God for your servants so that we will not die! For we have added to all our sins the evil of asking for a king.”
chapters.zh: 众民对撒母耳说：「求你为仆人们祷告耶和华－你的上帝，免得我们死亡；因为我们求立王的事正是罪上加罪了。」

chapters.en: “Do not be afraid,” Samuel replied. “Even though you have committed all this evil, do not turn aside from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对百姓说：「不要惧怕！你们虽然行了这恶，却不要偏离耶和华，只要尽心事奉他。

chapters.en: Do not turn aside after worthless things that cannot profit you or deliver you, for they are empty.
chapters.zh: 若偏离〔耶和华〕去顺从那不能救人的虚神是无益的。

chapters.en: Indeed, for the sake of His great name, the LORD will not abandon His people, because He was pleased to make you His own.
chapters.zh: 耶和华既喜悦选你们作他的子民，就必因他的大名不撇弃你们。

chapters.en: As for me, far be it from me that I should sin against the LORD by ceasing to pray for you. And I will continue to teach you the good and right way.
chapters.zh: 至于我，断不停止为你们祷告，以致得罪耶和华。我必以善道正路指教你们。

chapters.en: Above all, fear the LORD and serve Him faithfully with all your heart; consider what great things He has done for you.
chapters.zh: 只要你们敬畏耶和华，诚诚实实地尽心事奉他，想念他向你们所行的事何等大。

chapters.en: But if you persist in doing evil, both you and your king will be swept away.”
chapters.zh: 你们若仍然作恶，你们和你们的王必一同灭亡。」

chapters.en: Saul was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned over Israel forty-two years.
chapters.zh: 扫罗登基年〔四十岁〕；作以色列王二年的时候，

chapters.en: He chose for himself three thousand men of Israel: Two thousand were with Saul at Michmash and in the hill country of Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin. And the rest of the troops he sent away, each to his own home.
chapters.zh: 就从以色列中拣选了三千人：二千跟随扫罗在密抹和伯特利山，一千跟随约拿单在便雅悯的基比亚；其余的人扫罗都打发各回各家去了。

chapters.en: Then Jonathan attacked the Philistine outpost at Geba, and the Philistines heard about it. So Saul blew the ram’s horn throughout the land, saying, “Let the Hebrews hear!”
chapters.zh: 约拿单攻击在迦巴的非利士人的防营，非利士人听见了。扫罗就在遍地吹角，意思说，要使希伯来人听见。

chapters.en: And all Israel heard the news: “Saul has attacked an outpost of the Philistines, and now Israel has become a stench to the Philistines!” Then the people were summoned to join Saul at Gilgal.
chapters.zh: 以色列众人听见扫罗攻击非利士人的防营，又听见以色列人为非利士人所憎恶，就跟随扫罗聚集在吉甲。

chapters.en: Now the Philistines assembled to fight against Israel with three thousand chariots, six thousand horsemen, and troops as numerous as the sand on the seashore. They went up and camped at Michmash, east of Beth-aven.
chapters.zh: 非利士人聚集，要与以色列人争战，有车三万辆，马兵六千，步兵像海边的沙那样多，就上来在伯‧亚文东边的密抹安营。

chapters.en: Seeing that they were in danger because their troops were hard-pressed, the men of Israel hid in caves and thickets, among the rocks, and in cellars and cisterns.
chapters.zh: 以色列百姓见自己危急窘迫，就藏在山洞、丛林、石穴、隐密处，和坑中。

chapters.en: Some Hebrews even crossed the Jordan into the land of Gad and Gilead. Saul, however, remained at Gilgal, and all his troops were quaking in fear.
chapters.zh: 有些希伯来人过了约旦河，逃到迦得和基列地。扫罗还是在吉甲，百姓都战战兢兢地跟随他。

chapters.en: And Saul waited seven days for the time appointed by Samuel, but Samuel did not come to Gilgal, and the troops began to desert Saul.
chapters.zh: 扫罗照着撒母耳所定的日期等了七日。撒母耳还没有来到吉甲，百姓也离开扫罗散去了。

chapters.en: So he said, “Bring me the burnt offering and the peace offerings.” And he offered up the burnt offering.
chapters.zh: 扫罗说：「把燔祭和平安祭带到我这里来。」扫罗就献上燔祭。

chapters.en: Just as he finished offering the burnt offering, Samuel arrived, and Saul went out to greet him.
chapters.zh: 刚献完燔祭，撒母耳就到了。扫罗出去迎接他，要问他好。

chapters.en:
“What have you done?” Samuel asked.
And Saul replied, “When I saw that the troops were deserting me, and that you did not come at the appointed time and the Philistines were gathering at Michmash,
chapters.zh: 撒母耳说：「你做的是什么事呢？」扫罗说：「因为我见百姓离开我散去，你也不照所定的日期来到，而且非利士人聚集在密抹。

chapters.en: I thought, ‘Now the Philistines will descend upon me at Gilgal, and I have not sought the favor of the LORD.’ So I felt compelled to offer the burnt offering.”
chapters.zh: 所以我心里说：恐怕我没有祷告耶和华。非利士人下到吉甲攻击我，我就勉强献上燔祭。」

chapters.en: “You have acted foolishly,” Samuel declared. “You have not kept the command that the LORD your God gave you; if you had, the LORD would have established your kingdom over Israel for all time.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对扫罗说：「你做了糊涂事了，没有遵守耶和华－你上帝所吩咐你的命令。若遵守，耶和华必在以色列中坚立你的王位，直到永远。

chapters.en: But now your kingdom will not endure; the LORD has sought a man after His own heart and appointed him ruler over His people, because you have not kept the command of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 现在你的王位必不长久。耶和华已经寻着一个合他心意的人，立他作百姓的君，因为你没有遵守耶和华所吩咐你的。」

chapters.en: Then Samuel set out from Gilgal and went up to Gibeah in Benjamin. And Saul numbered the troops who were with him, about six hundred men.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳就起来，从吉甲上到便雅悯的基比亚。 扫罗数点跟随他的，约有六百人。

chapters.en: Now Saul and Jonathan his son and the troops with them were staying in Geba of Benjamin, while the Philistines camped at Michmash.
chapters.zh: 扫罗和他儿子约拿单，并跟随他们的人，都住在便雅悯的迦巴；但非利士人安营在密抹。

chapters.en: And raiders went out of the Philistine camp in three divisions. One headed toward Ophrah in the land of Shual,
chapters.zh: 有掠兵从非利士营中出来，分为三队：一队往俄弗拉向书亚地去，

chapters.en: another toward Beth-horon, and the third down the border road overlooking the Valley of Zeboim facing the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 一队往伯‧和崙去，一队往洗波音谷对面的地境向旷野去。

chapters.en: And no blacksmith could be found in all the land of Israel, because the Philistines had said, “The Hebrews must not be allowed to make swords or spears.”
chapters.zh: 那时，以色列全地没有一个铁匠；因为非利士人说，恐怕希伯来人制造刀枪。

chapters.en: Instead, all the Israelites would go down to the Philistines to sharpen their plowshares, mattocks, axes, and sickles.
chapters.zh: 以色列人要磨锄、诓、斧、铲，就下到非利士人那里去磨。

chapters.en: The charge was a pim for sharpening a plowshare or mattock, a third of a shekel for sharpening a pitchfork or an axe, and a third of a shekel for repointing an oxgoad.
chapters.zh: 但有锉可以锉铲、诓、三齿叉、斧子，并赶牛锥。

chapters.en: So on the day of battle not a sword or spear could be found in the hands of the troops with Saul and Jonathan; only Saul and his son Jonathan had weapons.
chapters.zh: 所以到了争战的日子，跟随扫罗和约拿单的人没有一个手里有刀有枪的，惟独扫罗和他儿子约拿单有。

chapters.en: And a garrison of the Philistines had gone out to the pass at Michmash.
chapters.zh: 非利士人的一队防兵到了密抹的隘口。

chapters.en: One day Jonathan son of Saul said to the young man bearing his armor, “Come, let us cross over to the Philistine outpost on the other side.” But Jonathan did not tell his father.
chapters.zh: 有一日，扫罗的儿子约拿单对拿他兵器的少年人说：「我们不如过到那边，到非利士人的防营那里去。」但他没有告诉父亲。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Saul was staying under the pomegranate tree in Migron on the outskirts of Gibeah. And the troops who were with him numbered about six hundred men,
chapters.zh: 扫罗在基比亚的尽边，坐在米矶崙的石榴树下，跟随他的约有六百人。

chapters.en: including Ahijah, who was wearing an ephod. He was the son of Ichabod’s brother Ahitub son of Phinehas, the son of Eli the priest of the LORD in Shiloh. But the troops did not know that Jonathan had left.
chapters.zh: 在那里有亚希突的儿子亚希亚，穿着以弗得。（亚希突是以迦博的哥哥，非尼哈的儿子，以利的孙子。以利从前在示罗作耶和华的祭司。）约拿单去了，百姓却不知道。

chapters.en: Now there were cliffs on both sides of the pass that Jonathan intended to cross to reach the Philistine outpost. One was named Bozez and the other Seneh.
chapters.zh: 约拿单要从隘口过到非利士防营那里去。这隘口两边各有一个山峰：一名播薛，一名西尼；

chapters.en: One cliff stood to the north toward Michmash, and the other to the south toward Geba.
chapters.zh: 一峰向北，与密抹相对，一峰向南，与迦巴相对。

chapters.en: Jonathan said to the young man bearing his armor, “Come, let us cross over to the outpost of these uncircumcised men. Perhaps the LORD will work on our behalf. Nothing can hinder the LORD from saving, whether by many or by few.”
chapters.zh: 约拿单对拿兵器的少年人说：「我们不如过到未受割礼人的防营那里去，或者耶和华为我们施展能力；因为耶和华使人得胜，不在乎人多人少。」

chapters.en: His armor-bearer replied, “Do all that is in your heart. Go ahead; I am with you heart and soul.”
chapters.zh: 拿兵器的对他说：「随你的心意行吧。你可以上去，我必跟随你，与你同心。」
