chapters.en: Blessed is your discernment, and blessed are you, because today you kept me from bloodshed and from avenging myself by my own hand.
chapters.zh: 你和你的见识也当称赞；因为你今日拦阻我亲手报仇、流人的血。

chapters.en: Otherwise, as surely as the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, who has restrained me from harming you, if you had not come quickly to meet me, then surely no male belonging to Nabal would have been left alive by morning light.”
chapters.zh: 我指着阻止我加害于你的耶和华－以色列永生的上帝起誓，你若不速速地来迎接我，到明日早晨，凡属拿八的男丁必定不留一个。」

chapters.en: Then David accepted from her hand what she had brought him, and he said to her, “Go home in peace. See, I have heeded your voice and granted your request.”
chapters.zh: 大卫受了亚比该送来的礼物，就对她说：「我听了你的话，准了你的情面，你可以平平安安地回家吧！」

chapters.en: When Abigail returned to Nabal, there he was in the house, holding a feast fit for a king, in high spirits and very drunk. So she told him nothing until morning light.
chapters.zh: 亚比该到拿八那里，见他在家里设摆筵席，如同王的筵席；拿八快乐大醉。亚比该无论大小事都没有告诉他，就等到次日早晨。

chapters.en: In the morning when Nabal was sober, his wife told him about these events, and his heart failed within him, and he became like a stone.
chapters.zh: 到了早晨，拿八醒了酒，他的妻将这些事都告诉他，他就魂不附体，身僵如石头一般。

chapters.en: About ten days later, the LORD struck Nabal dead.
chapters.zh: 过了十天，耶和华击打拿八，他就死了。

chapters.en:
On hearing that Nabal was dead, David said, “Blessed be the LORD, who has upheld my cause against the reproach of Nabal and has restrained His servant from evil. For the LORD has brought the wickedness of Nabal down upon his own head.”
Then David sent word to Abigail, asking her to become his wife.
chapters.zh: 大卫听见拿八死了，就说：「应当称颂耶和华，因他伸了拿八羞辱我的冤，又阻止仆人行恶；也使拿八的恶归到拿八的头上。」于是大卫打发人去，与亚比该说，要娶她为妻。

chapters.en: When his servants came to Abigail at Carmel, they said, “David has sent us to take you as his wife.”
chapters.zh: 大卫的仆人到了迦密见亚比该，对她说：「大卫打发我们来见你，想要娶你为妻。」

chapters.en: She arose, bowed facedown, and said, “Here is your servant, ready to serve and to wash the feet of my lord’s servants.”
chapters.zh: 亚比该就起来，俯伏在地，说：「我情愿作婢女，洗我主仆人的脚。」

chapters.en: So Abigail hurried and got on a donkey, and attended by five of her maidens, she followed David’s messengers and became his wife.
chapters.zh: 亚比该立刻起身，骑上驴，带着五个使女，跟从大卫的使者去了，就作了大卫的妻。

chapters.en: David had also married Ahinoam of Jezreel. So she and Abigail were both his wives.
chapters.zh: 大卫先娶了耶斯列人亚希暖，她们二人都作了他的妻。

chapters.en: But Saul had given his daughter Michal, David’s wife, to Palti son of Laish, who was from Gallim.
chapters.zh: 扫罗已将他的女儿米甲，就是大卫的妻，给了迦琳人拉亿的儿子帕提为妻。

chapters.en: Then the Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah and said, “Is not David hiding on the hill of Hachilah, opposite Jeshimon?”
chapters.zh: 西弗人到基比亚见扫罗，说：「大卫不是在旷野前的哈基拉山藏着吗？」

chapters.en: So Saul, accompanied by three thousand chosen men of Israel, went down to the Wilderness of Ziph to search for David there.
chapters.zh: 扫罗就起身，带领以色列人中挑选的三千精兵下到西弗的旷野，要在那里寻索大卫。

chapters.en: Saul camped beside the road at the hill of Hachilah opposite Jeshimon, but David was living in the wilderness. When he realized that Saul had followed him there,
chapters.zh: 扫罗在旷野前的哈基拉山，在道路上安营。大卫住在旷野，听说扫罗到旷野来追寻他，

chapters.en: David sent out spies to verify that Saul had arrived.
chapters.zh: 就打发人去探听，便知道扫罗果然来到。

chapters.en: Then David set out and went to the place where Saul had camped. He saw the place where Saul and Abner son of Ner, the general of his army, had lain down. Saul was lying inside the inner circle of the camp, with the troops camped around him.
chapters.zh: 大卫起来，到扫罗安营的地方，看见扫罗和他的元帅尼珥的儿子押尼珥睡卧之处；扫罗睡在辎重营里，百姓安营在他周围。

chapters.en:
And David asked Ahimelech the Hittite and Abishai son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, “Who will go down with me to Saul in the camp?”
“I will go with you,” answered Abishai.
chapters.zh: 大卫对赫人亚希米勒和洗鲁雅的儿子约押的兄弟亚比筛说：「谁同我下到扫罗营里去？」亚比筛说：「我同你下去。」

chapters.en: That night David and Abishai came to the troops, and Saul was lying there asleep in the inner circle of the camp, with his spear stuck in the ground by his head. And Abner and the troops were lying around him.
chapters.zh: 于是大卫和亚比筛夜间到了百姓那里，见扫罗睡在辎重营里；他的枪在头旁，插在地上。押尼珥和百姓睡在他周围。

chapters.en: Abishai said to David, “Today God has delivered your enemy into your hand. Now, therefore, please let me thrust the spear through him into the ground with one stroke. I will not need to strike him twice!”
chapters.zh: 亚比筛对大卫说：「现在上帝将你的仇敌交在你手里，求你容我拿枪将他刺透在地，一刺就成，不用再刺。」

chapters.en: But David said to Abishai, “Do not destroy him, for who can extend a hand against the LORD’s anointed and be guiltless?”
chapters.zh: 大卫对亚比筛说：「不可害死他。有谁伸手害耶和华的受膏者而无罪呢？」

chapters.en: David added, “As surely as the LORD lives, the LORD Himself will strike him down; either his day will come and he will die, or he will go into battle and perish.
chapters.zh: 大卫又说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓，他或被耶和华击打，或是死期到了，或是出战阵亡；

chapters.en: But the LORD forbid that I should extend my hand against the LORD’s anointed. Instead, take the spear and water jug by his head, and let us go.”
chapters.zh: 我在耶和华面前，万不敢伸手害耶和华的受膏者。现在你可以将他头旁的枪和水瓶拿来，我们就走。」

chapters.en: So David took the spear and water jug by Saul’s head, and they departed. No one saw them or knew about it, nor did anyone wake up; they all remained asleep, because a deep sleep from the LORD had fallen on them.
chapters.zh: 大卫从扫罗的头旁拿了枪和水瓶，二人就走了，没有人看见，没有人知道，也没有人醒起，都睡着了，因为耶和华使他们沉沉地睡了。

chapters.en: Then David crossed to the other side and stood atop the mountain at a distance; there was a wide gulf between them.
chapters.zh: 大卫过到那边去，远远地站在山顶上，与他们相离甚远。

chapters.en:
And David shouted to the troops and to Abner son of Ner, “Will you not answer me, Abner?”
“Who are you who calls to the king?” Abner replied.
chapters.zh: 大卫呼叫百姓和尼珥的儿子押尼珥说：「押尼珥啊，你为何不答应呢？」押尼珥说：「你是谁？竟敢呼叫王呢？」

chapters.en: So David said to Abner, “You are a man, aren’t you? And who in Israel is your equal? Why then did you not protect your lord the king when one of the people came to destroy him?
chapters.zh: 大卫对押尼珥说：「你不是个勇士吗？以色列中谁能比你呢？民中有人进来要害死王－你的主，你为何没有保护王－你的主呢？

chapters.en: This thing you have done is not good. As surely as the LORD lives, all of you deserve to die, since you did not protect your lord, the LORD’s anointed. Now look around. Where are the king’s spear and water jug that were by his head?”
chapters.zh: 你这样是不好的！我指着永生的耶和华起誓，你们都是该死的；因为没有保护你们的主，就是耶和华的受膏者。现在你看看王头旁的枪和水瓶在哪里。」

chapters.en:
Then Saul recognized David’s voice and asked, “Is that your voice, David my son?”
“It is my voice, my lord and king,” David said.
chapters.zh: 扫罗听出是大卫的声音，就说：「我儿大卫，这是你的声音吗？」大卫说：「主－我的王啊，是我的声音」；

chapters.en: And he continued, “Why is my lord pursuing his servant? What have I done? What evil is in my hand?
chapters.zh: 又说：「我做了什么？我手里有什么恶事？我主竟追赶仆人呢？

chapters.en: Now please, may my lord the king hear the words of his servant: If the LORD has stirred you up against me, then may He accept an offering. But if men have done it, may they be cursed in the presence of the LORD! For today they have driven me away from sharing in the inheritance of the LORD, saying, ‘Go, serve other gods.’
chapters.zh: 求我主我王听仆人的话：若是耶和华激发你攻击我，愿耶和华收纳祭物；若是人激发你，愿他在耶和华面前受咒诅；因为他现今赶逐我，不容我在耶和华的产业上有分，说：『你去事奉别神吧！』

chapters.en: So do not let my blood fall to the ground far from the presence of the LORD. For the king of Israel has come out to look for a flea, like one who hunts a partridge in the mountains.”
chapters.zh: 现在求王不要使我的血流在离耶和华远的地方。以色列王出来是寻找一个虼蚤，如同人在山上猎取一个鹧鸪一般。」

chapters.en: Then Saul replied, “I have sinned. Come back, David my son. I will never harm you again, because today you considered my life precious. I have played the fool and have committed a grave error!”
chapters.zh: 扫罗说：「我有罪了！我儿大卫，你可以回来，因你今日看我的性命为宝贵；我必不再加害于你。我是糊涂人，大大错了。」

chapters.en: “Here is the king’s spear,” David answered. “Let one of the young men come over and get it.
chapters.zh: 大卫说：「王的枪在这里，可以吩咐一个仆人过来拿去。

chapters.en: May the LORD repay every man for his righteousness and faithfulness. For the LORD delivered you into my hand today, but I would not extend my hand against the LORD’s anointed.
chapters.zh: 今日耶和华将王交在我手里，我却不肯伸手害耶和华的受膏者。耶和华必照各人的公义诚实报应他。

chapters.en: As surely as I valued your life today, so may the LORD value my life and rescue me from all trouble.”
chapters.zh: 我今日重看你的性命，愿耶和华也重看我的性命，并且拯救我脱离一切患难。」

chapters.en:
Saul said to him, “May you be blessed, David my son. You will accomplish great things and will surely prevail.”
So David went on his way, and Saul returned home.
chapters.zh: 扫罗对大卫说：「我儿大卫，愿你得福！你必做大事，也必得胜。」于是大卫起行，扫罗回他的本处去了。

chapters.en: David, however, said to himself, “One of these days now I will be swept away by the hand of Saul. There is nothing better for me than to escape to the land of the Philistines. Then Saul will stop searching for me all over Israel, and I will slip out of his hand.”
chapters.zh: 大卫心里说：「必有一日我死在扫罗手里，不如逃奔非利士地去。扫罗见我不在以色列的境内，就必绝望，不再寻索我；这样我可以脱离他的手。」

chapters.en: So David set out with his six hundred men and went to Achish son of Maoch, the king of Gath.
chapters.zh: 于是大卫起身，和跟随他的六百人投奔迦特王－玛俄的儿子亚吉去了。

chapters.en: David and his men settled in Gath with Achish. Each man had his family with him, and David had his two wives: Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail of Carmel, the widow of Nabal.
chapters.zh: 大卫和他的两个妻，就是耶斯列人亚希暖和作过拿八妻的迦密人亚比该，并跟随他的人，连各人的眷属，都住在迦特的亚吉那里。

chapters.en: And when Saul learned that David had fled to Gath, he no longer searched for him.
chapters.zh: 有人告诉扫罗说：「大卫逃到迦特。」扫罗就不再寻索他了。

chapters.en: Then David said to Achish, “If I have found favor in your eyes, let me be assigned a place in one of the outlying towns, so I can live there. For why should your servant live in the royal city with you?”
chapters.zh: 大卫对亚吉说：「我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你在京外的城邑中赐我一个地方居住。仆人何必与王同住京都呢？」

chapters.en: That day Achish gave him Ziklag, and to this day it still belongs to the kings of Judah.
chapters.zh: 当日亚吉将洗革拉赐给他，因此洗革拉属犹大王，直到今日。

chapters.en: And the time that David lived in Philistine territory amounted to a year and four months.
chapters.zh: 大卫在非利士地住了一年零四个月。

chapters.en: Now David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites. (From ancient times these people had inhabited the land extending to Shur and Egypt.)
chapters.zh: 大卫和跟随他的人上去，侵夺基述人、基色人、亚玛力人之地。这几族历来住在那地，从书珥直到埃及。

chapters.en:
Whenever David attacked a territory, he did not leave a man or woman alive, but he took the flocks and herds, the donkeys, camels, and clothing.
Then he would return to Achish,
chapters.zh: 大卫击杀那地的人，无论男女都没有留下一个，又夺获牛、羊、骆驼、驴，并衣服，回来见亚吉。

chapters.en:
who would ask him, “What have you raided today?”
And David would reply, “The Negev of Judah,” or “The Negev of Jerahmeel,” or “The Negev of the Kenites.”
chapters.zh: 亚吉说：「你们今日侵夺了什么地方呢？」大卫说：「侵夺了犹大的南方、耶拉篾的南方、基尼的南方。」

chapters.en: David did not leave a man or woman alive to be brought to Gath, for he said, “Otherwise they will report us, saying, ‘This is what David did.’” And this was David’s custom the whole time he lived in Philistine territory.
chapters.zh: 无论男女，大卫没有留下一个带到迦特来。他说：「恐怕他们将我们的事告诉人，说大卫住在非利士地的时候常常这样行。」

chapters.en: So Achish trusted David, thinking, “Since he has made himself an utter stench to his people Israel, he will be my servant forever.”
chapters.zh: 亚吉信了大卫，心里说：「大卫使本族以色列人憎恶他，所以他必永远作我的仆人了。」

chapters.en: Now in those days the Philistines gathered their forces for warfare against Israel. So Achish said to David, “You must understand that you and your men are to go out to battle with me.”
chapters.zh: 那时，非利士人聚集军旅，要与以色列人打仗。亚吉对大卫说：「你当知道，你和跟随你的人都要随我出战。」

chapters.en:
David replied, “Then you will come to know what your servant can do.”
“Very well,” said Achish. “I will make you my bodyguard for life.”
chapters.zh: 大卫对亚吉说：「仆人所能做的事，王必知道。」亚吉对大卫说：「这样，我立你永远作我的护卫长。」

chapters.en: Now by this time Samuel had died, and all Israel had mourned for him and buried him in Ramah, his own city. And Saul had removed the mediums and spiritists from the land.
chapters.zh: 那时撒母耳已经死了，以色列众人为他哀哭，葬他在拉玛，就是在他本城里。扫罗曾在国内不容有交鬼的和行巫术的人。

chapters.en: The Philistines gathered together and camped at Shunem, while Saul gathered all Israel and camped at Gilboa.
chapters.zh: 非利士人聚集，来到书念安营；扫罗聚集以色列众人在基利波安营。

chapters.en: When Saul saw the Philistine army, he was afraid and trembled violently.
chapters.zh: 扫罗看见非利士的军旅就惧怕，心中发颤。

chapters.en: He inquired of the LORD, but the LORD did not answer him by dreams or Urim or prophets.
chapters.zh: 扫罗求问耶和华，耶和华却不藉梦，或乌陵，或先知回答他。

chapters.en:
Then Saul said to his servants, “Find me a woman who is a medium, so I can go and consult her.”
“There is a medium at Endor,” his servants replied.
chapters.zh: 扫罗吩咐臣仆说：「当为我找一个交鬼的妇人，我好去问她。」臣仆说：「在隐‧多珥有一个交鬼的妇人。」

chapters.en: So Saul disguised himself by putting on different clothes, and he set out with two of his men. They came to the woman at night, and Saul said, “Consult a spirit for me. Bring up for me the one I name.”
chapters.zh: 于是扫罗改了装，穿上别的衣服，带着两个人，夜里去见那妇人。扫罗说：「求你用交鬼的法术，将我所告诉你的死人，为我招上来。」

chapters.en: But the woman replied, “Surely you know what Saul has done, how he has killed the mediums and spiritists in the land. Why have you set a trap to get me killed?”
chapters.zh: 妇人对他说：「你知道扫罗从国中剪除交鬼的和行巫术的。你为何陷害我的性命，使我死呢？」

chapters.en: Then Saul swore to her by the LORD: “As surely as the LORD lives, no punishment shall come upon you for this.”
chapters.zh: 扫罗向妇人指着耶和华起誓说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓，你必不因这事受刑。」

chapters.en:
“Whom shall I bring up for you?” the woman asked.
“Bring up Samuel,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 妇人说：「我为你招谁上来呢？」回答说：「为我招撒母耳上来。」

chapters.en: But when the woman saw Samuel, she cried out in a loud voice and said to Saul, “Why have you deceived me? You are Saul!”
chapters.zh: 妇人看见撒母耳，就大声呼叫，对扫罗说：「你是扫罗，为什么欺哄我呢？」

chapters.en:
“Do not be afraid,” the king replied. “What do you see?”
“I see a god coming up out of the earth,” the woman answered.
chapters.zh: 王对妇人说：「不要惧怕，你看见了什么呢？」妇人对扫罗说：「我看见有神从地里上来。」

chapters.en:
“What does he look like?” asked Saul.
“An old man is coming up,” she replied. “And he is wearing a robe.”
So Saul knew that it was Samuel, and he bowed facedown in reverence.
chapters.zh: 扫罗说：「他是怎样的形状？」妇人说：「有一个老人上来，身穿长衣。」扫罗知道是撒母耳，就屈身，脸伏于地下拜。

chapters.en:
Then Samuel said to Saul, “Why have you disturbed me by bringing me up?”
“I am deeply distressed,” replied Saul. “The Philistines are fighting against me, and God has turned away from me. He no longer answers me, either by prophets or by dreams. So I have called on you to tell me what to do.”
chapters.zh: 撒母耳对扫罗说：「你为什么搅扰我，招我上来呢？」扫罗回答说：「我甚窘急；因为非利士人攻击我，上帝也离开我，不再藉先知或梦回答我。因此请你上来，好指示我应当怎样行。」

chapters.en: “Why do you consult me,” asked Samuel, “since the LORD has turned away from you and become your enemy?
chapters.zh: 撒母耳说：「耶和华已经离开你，且与你为敌，你何必问我呢？

chapters.en: He has done exactly what He spoke through me: The LORD has torn the kingdom out of your hand and given it to your neighbor David.
chapters.zh: 耶和华照他藉我说的话，已经从你手里夺去国权，赐与别人，就是大卫。

chapters.en: Because you did not obey the LORD or carry out His burning anger against Amalek, the LORD has done this to you today.
chapters.zh: 因你没有听从耶和华的命令；他恼怒亚玛力人，你没有灭绝他们，所以今日耶和华向你这样行，

chapters.en: Moreover, the LORD will deliver Israel with you into the hand of the Philistines, and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me. And the LORD will deliver the army of Israel into the hand of the Philistines.”
chapters.zh: 并且耶和华必将你和以色列人交在非利士人的手里。明日你和你众子必与我在一处了；耶和华必将以色列的军兵交在非利士人手里。」

chapters.en: Immediately Saul fell flat on the ground, terrified by the words of Samuel. And his strength was gone, because he had not eaten anything all that day and night.
chapters.zh: 扫罗猛然仆倒，挺身在地，因撒母耳的话甚是惧怕；那一昼一夜，没有吃什么，就毫无气力。

chapters.en: When the woman came to Saul and saw how distraught he was, she said to him, “Look, your maidservant has obeyed your voice. I took my life in my hands and did as you told me.
chapters.zh: 妇人到扫罗面前，见他极其惊恐，对他说：「婢女听从你的话，不顾惜自己的性命，遵从你所吩咐的。

chapters.en: Now please listen to your servant and let me set a morsel of bread before you so you may eat and have the strength to go on your way.”
chapters.zh: 现在求你听婢女的话，容我在你面前摆上一点食物，你吃了，可以有气力行路。」

chapters.en: Saul refused, saying, “I will not eat.” But his servants joined the woman in urging him, and he heeded their voice. He got up from the ground and sat on the bed.
chapters.zh: 扫罗不肯，说：「我不吃。」但他的仆人和妇人再三劝他，他才听了他们的话，从地上起来，坐在床上。

chapters.en: The woman had a fattened calf at her house, and she quickly slaughtered it. She also took flour, kneaded it, and baked unleavened bread.
chapters.zh: 妇人急忙将家里的一只肥牛犊宰了，又拿面抟成无酵饼烤了，

chapters.en: She served it to Saul and his servants, and they ate. And that night they got up and left.
chapters.zh: 摆在扫罗和他仆人面前。他们吃完，当夜就起身走了。

chapters.en: Now the Philistines brought all their forces together at Aphek, while Israel camped by the spring in Jezreel.
chapters.zh: 非利士人将他们的军旅聚到亚弗；以色列人在耶斯列的泉旁安营。

chapters.en: As the Philistine leaders marched out with their units of hundreds and thousands, David and his men marched behind them with Achish.
chapters.zh: 非利士人的首领各率军队，或百或千，挨次前进；大卫和跟随他的人同着亚吉跟在后边。

chapters.en:
Then the commanders of the Philistines asked, “What about these Hebrews?”
Achish replied, “Is this not David, the servant of King Saul of Israel? He has been with me all these days, even years, and from the day he defected until today I have found no fault in him.”
chapters.zh: 非利士人的首领说：「这些希伯来人〔在这里〕做什么呢？」亚吉对他们说：「这不是以色列王扫罗的臣子大卫吗？他在我这里有些年日了。自从他投降我直到今日，我未曾见他有过错。」

chapters.en: But the commanders of the Philistines were angry with Achish and told him, “Send that man back and let him return to the place you assigned him. He must not go down with us into battle only to become our adversary during the war. What better way for him to regain the favor of his master than with the heads of our men?
chapters.zh: 非利士人的首领向亚吉发怒，对他说：「你要叫这人回你所安置他的地方，不可叫他同我们出战，恐怕他在阵上反为我们的敌人。他用什么与他主人复和呢？岂不是用我们这些人的首级吗？

chapters.en:
Is this not the David about whom they sing in their dances:
‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands’?”
chapters.zh: 从前以色列的妇女跳舞唱和说：『扫罗杀死千千，大卫杀死万万』，所说的不是这个大卫吗？」

chapters.en: So Achish summoned David and told him, “As surely as the LORD lives, you have been upright, and it seems right in my sight that you should march in and out with me in the army, because I have found no fault in you from the day you came to me until this day. But you are not good in the sight of the leaders.
chapters.zh: 亚吉叫大卫来，对他说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓，你是正直人。你随我在军中出入，我看你甚好。自从你投奔我到如今，我未曾见你有什么过失；只是众首领不喜悦你。

chapters.en: Therefore turn back now and go in peace, so that you will not do anything to displease the leaders of the Philistines.”
chapters.zh: 现在你可以平平安安地回去，免得非利士人的首领不欢喜你。」

chapters.en: “But what have I done?” David replied. “What have you found against your servant, from the day I came to you until today, to keep me from going along to fight against the enemies of my lord the king?”
chapters.zh: 大卫对亚吉说：「我做了什么呢？自从仆人到你面前，直到今日，你查出我有什么过错，使我不去攻击主－我王的仇敌呢？」

chapters.en: Achish replied, “I know that you are as pleasing in my sight as an angel of God. But the commanders of the Philistines have said, ‘He must not go into battle with us.’
chapters.zh: 亚吉说：「我知道你在我眼前是好人，如同上帝的使者一般；只是非利士人的首领说：『这人不可同我们出战。』

chapters.en: Now then, get up early in the morning, along with your master’s servants who came with you, and go as soon as it is light.”
chapters.zh: 故此你和跟随你的人，就是你本主的仆人，要明日早晨起来，等到天亮回去吧！」

chapters.en: So David and his men got up early in the morning to return to the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.
chapters.zh: 于是大卫和跟随他的人早晨起来，回往非利士地去。非利士人也上耶斯列去了。

chapters.en: On the third day David and his men arrived in Ziklag, and the Amalekites had raided the Negev, attacked Ziklag, and burned it down.
chapters.zh: 第三日，大卫和跟随他的人到了洗革拉。亚玛力人已经侵夺南地，攻破洗革拉，用火焚烧，

chapters.en: They had taken captive the women and all who were there, both young and old. They had not killed anyone, but had carried them off as they went on their way.
chapters.zh: 掳了城内的妇女和其中的大小人口，却没有杀一个，都带着走了。

chapters.en: When David and his men came to the city, they found it burned down and their wives and sons and daughters taken captive.
chapters.zh: 大卫和跟随他的人到了那城，不料，城已烧毁，他们的妻子儿女都被掳去了。

chapters.en: So David and the troops with him lifted up their voices and wept until they had no strength left to weep.
chapters.zh: 大卫和跟随他的人就放声大哭，直哭得没有气力。

chapters.en: David’s two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel, had been taken captive.
chapters.zh: 大卫的两个妻－耶斯列人亚希暖和作过拿八妻的迦密人亚比该，也被掳去了。

chapters.en: And David was greatly distressed because the people spoke of stoning him, because the soul of every man grieved for his sons and daughters. But David found strength in the LORD his God.
chapters.zh: 大卫甚是焦急，因众人为自己的儿女苦恼，说：「要用石头打死他。」大卫却倚靠耶和华－他的上帝，心里坚固。

chapters.en:
Then David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, “Bring me the ephod.”
So Abiathar brought it to him,
chapters.zh: 大卫对亚希米勒的儿子祭司亚比亚他说：「请你将以弗得拿过来。」亚比亚他就将以弗得拿到大卫面前。

chapters.en:
and David inquired of the LORD: “Should I pursue these raiders? Will I overtake them?”
“Pursue them,” the LORD replied, “for you will surely overtake them and rescue the captives.”
chapters.zh: 大卫求问耶和华说：「我追赶敌军，追得上追不上呢？」耶和华说：「你可以追，必追得上，都救得回来。」

chapters.en: So David and his six hundred men went to the Brook of Besor, where some stayed behind
chapters.zh: 于是，大卫和跟随他的六百人来到比梭溪；有不能前去的就留在那里。

chapters.en: because two hundred men were too exhausted to cross the brook. But David and four hundred men continued in pursuit.
chapters.zh: 大卫却带着四百人往前追赶，有二百人疲乏，不能过比梭溪，所以留在那里。

chapters.en: Now his men found an Egyptian in the field and brought him to David. They gave the man water to drink and food to eat—
chapters.zh: 这四百人在田野遇见一个埃及人，就带他到大卫面前，给他饼吃，给他水喝，

chapters.en: a piece of a fig cake and two clusters of raisins. So he ate and was revived, for he had not had any food or water for three days and three nights.
chapters.zh: 又给他一块无花果饼，两个葡萄饼。他吃了，就精神复原；因为他三日三夜没有吃饼，没有喝水。

chapters.en:
Then David asked him, “To whom do you belong, and where are you from?”
“I am an Egyptian,” he replied, “the slave of an Amalekite. My master abandoned me three days ago when I fell ill.
chapters.zh: 大卫问他说：「你是属谁的？你是哪里的人？」他回答说：「我是埃及的少年人，是亚玛力人的奴仆；因我三日前患病，我主人就把我撇弃了。

chapters.en: We raided the Negev of the Cherethites, the territory of Judah, and the Negev of Caleb, and we burned down Ziklag.”
chapters.zh: 我们侵夺了基利提的南方和属犹大的地，并迦勒地的南方，又用火烧了洗革拉。」

chapters.en:
“Will you lead me to these raiders?” David asked.
And the man replied, “Swear to me by God that you will not kill me or deliver me into the hand of my master, and I will lead you to them.”
chapters.zh: 大卫问他说：「你肯领我们到敌军那里不肯？」他回答说：「你要向我指着上帝起誓，不杀我，也不将我交在我主人手里，我就领你下到敌军那里。」

chapters.en: So he led David down, and there were the Amalekites spread out over all the land, eating, drinking, and celebrating the great amount of plunder they had taken from the land of the Philistines and the land of Judah.
chapters.zh: 那人领大卫下去，见他们散在地上，吃喝跳舞，因为从非利士地和犹大地所掳来的财物甚多。

chapters.en: And David struck them down from twilight until the evening of the next day. Not a man escaped, except four hundred young men who fled, riding off on camels.
chapters.zh: 大卫从黎明直到次日晚上，击杀他们，除了四百骑骆驼的少年人之外，没有一个逃脱的。

chapters.en: So David recovered everything the Amalekites had taken, including his two wives.
chapters.zh: 亚玛力人所掳去的财物，大卫全都夺回，并救回他的两个妻来。

chapters.en: Nothing was missing, young or old, son or daughter, or any of the plunder the Amalekites had taken. David brought everything back.
chapters.zh: 凡亚玛力人所掳去的，无论大小、儿女、财物，大卫都夺回来，没有失落一个。

chapters.en: And he took all the flocks and herds, which his men drove ahead of the other livestock, calling out, “This is David’s plunder!”
chapters.zh: 大卫所夺来的牛群羊群，跟随他的人赶在〔原有的〕群畜前边，说：「这是大卫的掠物。」

chapters.en: When David came to the two hundred men who had been too exhausted to follow him and who were left behind at the Brook of Besor, they came out to meet him and the troops with him. As David approached the men, he greeted them,
chapters.zh: 大卫到了那疲乏不能跟随、留在比梭溪的二百人那里。他们出来迎接大卫并跟随的人。大卫前来问他们安。

chapters.en: but all the wicked and worthless men among those who had gone with David said, “Because they did not go with us, we will not share with them the plunder we recovered, except for each man’s wife and children. They may take them and go.”
chapters.zh: 跟随大卫人中的恶人和匪类说：「这些人既然没有和我们同去，我们所夺的财物就不分给他们，只将他们各人的妻子儿女给他们，使他们带去就是了。」

chapters.en: But David said, “My brothers, you must not do this with what the LORD has given us. He has protected us and delivered into our hands the raiders who came against us.
chapters.zh: 大卫说：「弟兄们，耶和华所赐给我们的，不可不分给他们；因为他保佑我们，将那攻击我们的敌军交在我们手里。

chapters.en: Who will listen to your proposal? The share of the one who went to battle will match the share of the one who stayed with the supplies. They will share alike.”
chapters.zh: 这事谁肯依从你们呢？上阵的得多少，看守器具的也得多少；应当大家平分。」

chapters.en: And so it has been from that day forward. David established this statute and ordinance for Israel to this very day.
chapters.zh: 大卫定此为以色列的律例典章，从那日直到今日。

chapters.en: When David arrived in Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to his friends, the elders of Judah, saying, “Here is a gift for you from the plunder of the LORD’s enemies.”
chapters.zh: 大卫到了洗革拉，从掠物中取些送给他朋友犹大的长老，说：「这是从耶和华仇敌那里夺来的，送你们为礼物。」

chapters.en: He sent gifts to those in Bethel, Ramoth Negev, and Jattir;
chapters.zh: 他送礼物给住伯特利的，南地拉末的，雅提珥的；

chapters.en: to those in Aroer, Siphmoth, and Eshtemoa;
chapters.zh: 住亚罗珥的，息末的，以实提莫的；

chapters.en: to those in Racal and in the cities of the Jerahmeelites and Kenites;
chapters.zh: 住拉哈勒的，耶拉篾各城的，基尼各城的；

chapters.en: to those in Hormah, Bor-ashan, and Athach;
chapters.zh: 住何珥玛的，歌拉珊的，亚挞的；

chapters.en: and to those in Hebron and in all the places where David and his men had roamed.
chapters.zh: 住希伯崙的，并大卫和跟随他的人素来所到之处的人。

chapters.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel fled before them, and many fell slain on Mount Gilboa.
chapters.zh: 非利士人与以色列人争战。以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，在基利波有被杀仆倒的。

chapters.en: The Philistines hotly pursued Saul and his sons, and they killed Saul’s sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
chapters.zh: 非利士人紧追扫罗和他儿子们，就杀了扫罗的儿子约拿单、亚比拿达、麦基舒亚。

chapters.en: When the battle intensified against Saul, the archers overtook him and wounded him critically.
chapters.zh: 势派甚大，扫罗被弓箭手追上，射伤甚重，

chapters.en:
Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, “Draw your sword and run me through with it, or these uncircumcised men will come and run me through and torture me!”
But his armor-bearer was terrified and refused to do it. So Saul took his own sword and fell on it.
chapters.zh: 就吩咐拿他兵器的人说：「你拔出刀来，将我刺死，免得那些未受割礼的人来刺我，凌辱我。」但拿兵器的人甚惧怕，不肯刺他；扫罗就自己伏在刀上死了。

chapters.en: When his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his own sword and died with him.
chapters.zh: 拿兵器的人见扫罗已死，也伏在刀上死了。

chapters.en: So Saul, his three sons, his armor-bearer, and all his men died together that same day.
chapters.zh: 这样，扫罗和他三个儿子，与拿他兵器的人，以及跟随他的人，都一同死亡。

chapters.en: When the Israelites along the valley and those on the other side of the Jordan saw that the army of Israel had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their cities and ran away. So the Philistines came and occupied their cities.
chapters.zh: 住平原那边并约旦河西的以色列人，见以色列军兵逃跑，扫罗和他儿子都死了，也就弃城逃跑。非利士人便来住在其中。

chapters.en: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
chapters.zh: 次日，非利士人来剥那被杀之人的衣服，看见扫罗和他三个儿子仆倒在基利波山，

chapters.en: They cut off Saul’s head, stripped off his armor, and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to proclaim the news in the temples of their idols and among their people.
chapters.zh: 就割下他的首级，剥了他的军装，打发人到〔注：或译：送到〕非利士地的四境，报信与他们庙里的偶像和众民；

chapters.en: They put his armor in the temple of the Ashtoreths and hung his body on the wall of Beth-shan.
chapters.zh: 又将扫罗的军装放在亚斯她录庙里，将他的尸身钉在伯‧珊的城墙上。

chapters.en: When the people of Jabesh-gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
chapters.zh: 基列‧雅比的居民听见非利士人向扫罗所行的事，

chapters.en:
all their men of valor set out, journeyed all night, and retrieved the bodies of Saul and his sons from the wall of Beth-shan.
When they arrived at Jabesh, they burned the bodies there.
chapters.zh: 他们中间所有的勇士就起身，走了一夜，将扫罗和他儿子的尸身从伯‧珊城墙上取下来，送到雅比那里，用火烧了；

chapters.en: Then they took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and they fasted seven days.
chapters.zh: 将他们骸骨葬在雅比的垂丝柳树下，就禁食七日。

chapters.en: After the death of Saul, David returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites and stayed in Ziklag two days.
chapters.zh: 扫罗死后，大卫击杀亚玛力人回来，在洗革拉住了两天。

chapters.en: On the third day a man with torn clothes and dust on his head arrived from Saul’s camp. When he came to David, he fell to the ground to pay him homage.
chapters.zh: 第三天，有一人从扫罗的营里出来，衣服撕裂，头蒙灰尘，到大卫面前伏地叩拜。

chapters.en:
“Where have you come from?” David asked.
“I have escaped from the Israelite camp,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 大卫问他说：「你从哪里来？」他说：「我从以色列的营里逃来。」

chapters.en:
“What was the outcome?” David asked. “Please tell me.”
“The troops fled from the battle,” he replied. “Many of them fell and died. And Saul and his son Jonathan are also dead.”
chapters.zh: 大卫又问他说：「事情怎样？请你告诉我。」他回答说：「百姓从阵上逃跑，也有许多人仆倒死亡；扫罗和他儿子约拿单也死了。」

chapters.en: Then David asked the young man who had brought him the report, “How do you know that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?”
chapters.zh: 大卫问报信的少年人说：「你怎么知道扫罗和他儿子约拿单死了呢？」

chapters.en: “I happened to be on Mount Gilboa,” he replied, “and there was Saul, leaning on his spear, with the chariots and the cavalry closing in on him.
chapters.zh: 报信的少年人说：「我偶然到基利波山，看见扫罗伏在自己枪上，有战车、马兵紧紧地追他。

chapters.en: When he turned around and saw me, he called out to me, and I answered, ‘Here I am!’
chapters.zh: 他回头看见我，就呼叫我。我说：『我在这里。』

chapters.en:
‘Who are you?’ he asked.
So I told him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’
chapters.zh: 他问我说：『你是什么人？』我说：『我是亚玛力人。』

chapters.en: Then he begged me, ‘Stand over me and kill me, for agony has seized me, but my life still lingers.’
chapters.zh: 他说：『请你来，将我杀死；因为痛苦抓住我，我的生命尚存。』

chapters.en: So I stood over him and killed him, because I knew that after he had fallen he could not survive. And I took the crown that was on his head and the band that was on his arm, and I have brought them here to my lord.”
chapters.zh: 我准知他仆倒必不能活，就去将他杀死，把他头上的冠冕、臂上的镯子拿到我主这里。」

chapters.en: Then David took hold of his own clothes and tore them, and all the men who were with him did the same.
chapters.zh: 大卫就撕裂衣服，跟随他的人也是如此，

chapters.en: They mourned and wept and fasted until evening for Saul and his son Jonathan, and for the people of the LORD and the house of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.
chapters.zh: 而且悲哀哭号，禁食到晚上，是因扫罗和他儿子约拿单，并耶和华的民以色列家的人，倒在刀下。

chapters.en:
And David inquired of the young man who had brought him the report, “Where are you from?”
“I am the son of a foreigner,” he answered. “I am an Amalekite.”
chapters.zh: 大卫问报信的少年人说：「你是哪里的人？」他说：「我是亚玛力客人的儿子。」

chapters.en: So David asked him, “Why were you not afraid to lift your hand to destroy the LORD’s anointed?”
chapters.zh: 大卫说：「你伸手杀害耶和华的受膏者，怎么不畏惧呢？」

chapters.en: Then David summoned one of the young men and said, “Go, execute him!” So the young man struck him down, and he died.
chapters.zh: 大卫叫了一个少年人来，说：「你去杀他吧！」

chapters.en: For David had said to the Amalekite, “Your blood be on your own head because your own mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I killed the LORD’s anointed.’”
chapters.zh: 大卫对他说：「你流人血的罪归到自己的头上，因为你亲口作见证说：『我杀了耶和华的受膏者。』」少年人就把他杀了。

chapters.en: Then David took up this lament for Saul and his son Jonathan,
chapters.zh: 大卫作哀歌，吊扫罗和他儿子约拿单，

chapters.en: and he ordered that the sons of Judah be taught the Song of the Bow. It is written in the Book of Jashar:
chapters.zh: 且吩咐将这歌教导犹大人。这歌名叫「弓歌」，写在雅煞珥书上。

chapters.en: “Your glory, O Israel, lies slain on your heights. How the mighty have fallen!
chapters.zh: 〔歌中说〕：以色列啊， 你尊荣者在山上被杀！ 大英雄何竟死亡！

chapters.en: Tell it not in Gath; proclaim it not in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, and the daughters of the uncircumcised exult.
chapters.zh: 不要在迦特报告； 不要在亚实基伦街上传扬； 免得非利士的女子欢乐； 免得未受割礼之人的女子矜夸。

chapters.en:
O mountains of Gilboa, may you have no dew or rain,
no fields yielding offerings of grain. For there the shield of the mighty was defiled, the shield of Saul, no longer anointed with oil.
chapters.zh: 基利波山哪，愿你那里没有雨露！ 愿你田地无土产可作供物！ 因为英雄的盾牌在那里被污丢弃； 扫罗的盾牌仿佛未曾抹油。

chapters.en: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan did not retreat, and the sword of Saul did not return empty.
chapters.zh: 约拿单的弓箭非流敌人的血不退缩； 扫罗的刀剑非剖勇士的油不收回。

chapters.en: Saul and Jonathan, beloved and delightful in life, were not divided in death. They were swifter than eagles; they were stronger than lions.
chapters.zh: 扫罗和约拿单－ 活时相悦相爱，死时也不分离 －他们比鹰更快，比狮子还强。

chapters.en: O daughters of Israel, weep for Saul, who clothed you in scarlet and luxury, who decked your garments with ornaments of gold.
chapters.zh: 以色列的女子啊，当为扫罗哭号！ 他曾使你们穿朱红色的美衣， 使你们衣服有黄金的妆饰。

chapters.en: How the mighty have fallen in the thick of battle! Jonathan lies slain on your heights.
chapters.zh: 英雄何竟在阵上仆倒！ 约拿单何竟在山上被杀！

chapters.en: I grieve for you, Jonathan, my brother. You were delightful to me; your love to me was extraordinary, surpassing the love of women.
chapters.zh: 我兄约拿单哪，我为你悲伤！ 我甚喜悦你！ 你向我发的爱情奇妙非常， 过于妇女的爱情。

chapters.en: How the mighty have fallen, and the weapons of war have perished!”
chapters.zh: 英雄何竟仆倒！ 战具何竟灭没！

chapters.en:
Some time later, David inquired of the LORD, “Should I go up to one of the towns of Judah?”
“Go up,” the LORD answered.
Then David asked, “Where should I go?”
“To Hebron,” replied the LORD.
chapters.zh: 此后，大卫问耶和华说：「我上犹大的一个城去可以吗？」耶和华说：「可以。」大卫说：「我上哪一个城去呢？」耶和华说：「上希伯崙去。」

chapters.en: So David went there with his two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel.
chapters.zh: 于是大卫和他的两个妻－一个是耶斯列人亚希暖，一个是作过迦密人拿八妻的亚比该－都上那里去了。

chapters.en: David also took the men who were with him, each with his household, and they settled in the towns near Hebron.
chapters.zh: 大卫也将跟随他的人和他们各人的眷属一同带上去，住在希伯崙的城邑中。

chapters.en: Then the men of Judah came to Hebron, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, “It was the men of Jabesh-gilead who buried Saul.”
chapters.zh: 犹大人来到希伯崙，在那里膏大卫作犹大家的王。 有人告诉大卫说：「葬埋扫罗的是基列‧雅比人。」

chapters.en: So David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh-gilead to tell them, “The LORD bless you, because you showed this kindness to Saul your lord when you buried him.
chapters.zh: 大卫就差人去见基列‧雅比人，对他们说：「你们厚待你们的主－扫罗，将他葬埋。愿耶和华赐福与你们！

chapters.en: Now may the LORD show you loving devotion and faithfulness, and I will also show you the same favor because you have done this.
chapters.zh: 你们既行了这事，愿耶和华以慈爱诚实待你们，我也要为此厚待你们。

chapters.en: Now then, be strong and courageous, for though Saul your lord is dead, the house of Judah has anointed me as their king.”
chapters.zh: 现在你们的主－扫罗死了，犹大家已经膏我作他们的王，所以你们要刚强奋勇。」

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Abner son of Ner, the commander of Saul’s army, took Saul’s son Ish-bosheth, moved him to Mahanaim,
chapters.zh: 扫罗的元帅尼珥的儿子押尼珥，曾将扫罗的儿子伊施波设带过〔河〕，到玛哈念，

chapters.en: and made him king over Gilead, Asher, Jezreel, Ephraim, and Benjamin—over all Israel.
chapters.zh: 立他作王，治理基列、亚书利、耶斯列、以法莲、便雅悯，和以色列众人。

chapters.en:
Saul’s son Ish-bosheth was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned for two years.
The house of Judah, however, followed David.
chapters.zh: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设登基的时候年四十岁，作以色列王二年；惟独犹大家归从大卫。

chapters.en: And the length of time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
chapters.zh: 大卫在希伯崙作犹大家的王，共七年零六个月。

chapters.en: One day Abner son of Ner and the servants of Ish-bosheth son of Saul marched out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
chapters.zh: 尼珥的儿子押尼珥和扫罗的儿子伊施波设的仆人从玛哈念出来，往基遍去。

chapters.en: So Joab son of Zeruiah and the servants of David marched out and met them by the pool of Gibeon. And the two groups took up positions on opposite sides of the pool.
chapters.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押和大卫的仆人也出来，在基遍池旁与他们相遇；一班坐在池这边，一班坐在池那边。

chapters.en:
Then Abner said to Joab, “Let us have the young men get up and compete before us.”
“Let them get up,” Joab replied.
chapters.zh: 押尼珥对约押说：「让少年人起来，在我们面前戏耍吧！」约押说：「可以。」

chapters.en: So they got up and were counted off—twelve for Benjamin and Ish-bosheth son of Saul, and twelve for David.
chapters.zh: 就按着定数起来：属扫罗儿子伊施波设的便雅悯人过去十二名，大卫的仆人也过去十二名，

chapters.en: Then each man grabbed his opponent by the head and thrust his sword into his opponent’s side, and they all fell together. So this place, which is in Gibeon, is called Helkath-hazzurim.
chapters.zh: 彼此揪头，用刀刺肋，一同仆倒。所以，那地叫做希利甲‧哈素林，就在基遍。

chapters.en: The battle that day was intense, and Abner and the men of Israel were defeated by the servants of David.
chapters.zh: 那日的战事凶猛，押尼珥和以色列人败在大卫的仆人面前。

chapters.en: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Now Asahel was fleet of foot like a wild gazelle,
chapters.zh: 在那里有洗鲁雅的三个儿子：约押、亚比筛、亚撒黑。亚撒黑脚快如野鹿一般；

chapters.en: and he chased Abner, not turning to the right or to the left in his pursuit.
chapters.zh: 亚撒黑追赶押尼珥，直追赶他不偏左右。

chapters.en:
And Abner glanced back and said, “Is that you, Asahel?”
“It is,” Asahel replied.
chapters.zh: 押尼珥回头说：「你是亚撒黑吗？」回答说：「是。」

chapters.en:
So Abner told him, “Turn to your right or to your left, seize one of the young men, and take his equipment for yourself.”
But Asahel would not stop chasing him.
chapters.zh: 押尼珥对他说：「你或转向左转向右，拿住一个少年人，剥去他的战衣。」亚撒黑却不肯转开不追赶他。

chapters.en: Once again, Abner warned Asahel, “Stop chasing me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How could I show my face to your brother Joab?”
chapters.zh: 押尼珥又对亚撒黑说：「你转开不追赶我吧！我何必杀你呢？若杀你，有什么脸见你哥哥约押呢？」

chapters.en: But Asahel refused to turn away. So Abner thrust the butt of his spear into his stomach, and it came out his back, and he fell dead on the spot. And every man paused when he came to the place where Asahel had fallen and died.
chapters.zh: 亚撒黑仍不肯转开。故此，押尼珥就用枪鐏刺入他的肚腹，甚至枪从背后透出，亚撒黑就在那里仆倒而死。众人赶到亚撒黑仆倒而死的地方，就都站住。

chapters.en: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner. By sunset, they had gone as far as the hill of Ammah opposite Giah on the way to the wilderness of Gibeon.
chapters.zh: 约押和亚比筛追赶押尼珥，日落的时候，到了通基遍旷野的路旁，基亚对面的亚玛山。

chapters.en: The Benjamites rallied to Abner, formed a single unit, and took their stand atop a hill.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯人聚集，跟随押尼珥站在一个山顶上。

chapters.en: Then Abner called out to Joab: “Must the sword devour forever? Do you not realize that this will only end in bitterness? How long before you tell the troops to stop pursuing their brothers?”
chapters.zh: 押尼珥呼叫约押说：「刀剑岂可永远杀人吗？你岂不知终久必有苦楚吗？你要等何时才叫百姓回去、不追赶弟兄呢？」

chapters.en: “As surely as God lives,” Joab replied, “if you had not spoken up, the troops would have continued pursuing their brothers until morning.”
chapters.zh: 约押说：「我指着永生的上帝起誓：你若不说〔戏耍的〕那句话，今日早晨百姓就回去，不追赶弟兄了。」

chapters.en: So Joab blew the ram’s horn, and all the troops stopped; they no longer pursued Israel or continued to fight.
chapters.zh: 于是约押吹角，众民就站住，不再追赶以色列人，也不再打仗了。

chapters.en: And all that night Abner and his men marched through the Arabah. They crossed the Jordan, marched all morning, and arrived at Mahanaim.
chapters.zh: 押尼珥和跟随他的人整夜经过亚拉巴，过约旦河，走过毕伦，到了玛哈念。

chapters.en:
When Joab returned from pursuing Abner, he gathered all the troops.
In addition to Asahel, nineteen of David’s servants were missing,
chapters.zh: 约押追赶押尼珥回来，聚集众民，见大卫的仆人中缺少了十九个人和亚撒黑。

chapters.en: but they had struck down 360 Benjamites who were with Abner.
chapters.zh: 但大卫的仆人杀了便雅悯人和跟随押尼珥的人，共三百六十名。

chapters.en: And they took Asahel and buried him in his father’s tomb in Bethlehem. Then Joab and his men marched all night and reached Hebron at daybreak.
chapters.zh: 众人将亚撒黑送到伯利恒，葬在他父亲的坟墓里。约押和跟随他的人走了一夜，天亮的时候到了希伯崙。

chapters.en: Now the war between the house of Saul and the house of David was protracted. And David grew stronger and stronger, while the house of Saul grew weaker and weaker.
chapters.zh: 扫罗家和大卫家争战许久。大卫家日见强盛；扫罗家日见衰弱。

chapters.en:
And sons were born to David in Hebron:
His firstborn was Amnon, by Ahinoam of Jezreel;
chapters.zh: 大卫在希伯崙得了几个儿子：长子暗嫩是耶斯列人亚希暖所生的；

chapters.en:
his second was Chileab, by Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel;
his third was Absalom, the son of Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur;
chapters.zh: 次子基利押〔注：在历代上三章一节作但以利〕是作过迦密人拿八的妻亚比该所生的；三子押沙龙是基述王达买的女儿玛迦所生的；

chapters.en:
his fourth was Adonijah, the son of Haggith;
his fifth was Shephatiah, the son of Abital;
chapters.zh: 四子亚多尼雅是哈及所生的；五子示法提雅是亚比她所生的；

chapters.en:
and his sixth was Ithream, by David’s wife Eglah.
These sons were born to David in Hebron.
chapters.zh: 六子以特念是大卫的妻以格拉所生的。大卫这六个儿子都是在希伯崙生的。

chapters.en: During the war between the house of Saul and the house of David, Abner had continued to strengthen his position in the house of Saul.
chapters.zh: 扫罗家和大卫家争战的时候，押尼珥在扫罗家大有权势。

chapters.en: Now Saul had a concubine named Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah. So Ish-bosheth questioned Abner, “Why did you sleep with my father’s concubine?”
chapters.zh: 扫罗有一妃嫔，名叫利斯巴，是爱亚的女儿。一日，伊施波设对押尼珥说：「你为什么与我父的妃嫔同房呢？」

chapters.en: Abner was furious over Ish-bosheth’s accusation. “Am I the head of a dog that belongs to Judah?” he asked. “All this time I have been loyal to the house of your father Saul, to his brothers, and to his friends. I have not delivered you into the hand of David, but now you accuse me of wrongdoing with this woman!
chapters.zh: 押尼珥因伊施波设的话就甚发怒，说：「我岂是犹大的狗头呢？我恩待你父扫罗的家和他的弟兄、朋友，不将你交在大卫手里，今日你竟为这妇人责备我吗？

chapters.en: May God punish Abner, and ever so severely, if I do not do for David what the LORD has sworn to him:
to transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul and to establish the throne of David over Israel and Judah, from Dan to Beersheba.”
chapters.zh: 我若不照着耶和华起誓应许大卫的话行，废去扫罗的位，建立大卫的位，使他治理以色列和犹大，从但直到别是巴，愿上帝重重地降罚与我！」

chapters.en: And for fear of Abner, Ish-bosheth did not dare to say another word to him.
chapters.zh: 伊施波设惧怕押尼珥，不敢回答一句。

chapters.en: Then Abner sent messengers on his behalf to say to David, “To whom does the land belong? Make your covenant with me, and surely my hand will be with you to bring all Israel over to you.”
chapters.zh: 押尼珥打发人去见大卫，替他说：「这国归谁呢？」又说：「你与我立约，我必帮助你，使以色列人都归服你。」

chapters.en: “Good,” replied David, “I will make a covenant with you. But there is one thing I require of you: Do not appear before me unless you bring Saul’s daughter Michal when you come to see me.”
chapters.zh: 大卫说：「好！我与你立约。但有一件，你来见我面的时候，若不将扫罗的女儿米甲带来，必不得见我的面。」

chapters.en: Then David sent messengers to say to Ish-bosheth son of Saul, “Give me back my wife, Michal, whom I betrothed to myself for a hundred Philistine foreskins.”
chapters.zh: 大卫就打发人去见扫罗的儿子伊施波设，说：「你要将我的妻米甲归还我；她是我从前用一百非利士人的阳皮所聘定的。」

chapters.en: So Ish-bosheth sent and took Michal from her husband Paltiel son of Laish.
chapters.zh: 伊施波设就打发人去，将米甲从拉亿的儿子、她丈夫帕铁那里接回来。

chapters.en: Her husband followed her, weeping all the way to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, “Go back.” So he returned home.
chapters.zh: 米甲的丈夫跟着她，一面走一面哭，直跟到巴户琳。押尼珥说：「你回去吧！」帕铁就回去了。

chapters.en: Now Abner conferred with the elders of Israel and said, “In the past you sought David as your king.
chapters.zh: 押尼珥对以色列长老说：「从前你们愿意大卫作王治理你们，

chapters.en: Now take action, because the LORD has said to David, ‘Through My servant David I will save My people Israel from the hands of the Philistines and of all their enemies.’”
chapters.zh: 现在你们可以照心愿而行。因为耶和华曾论到大卫说：『我必藉我仆人大卫的手，救我民以色列脱离非利士人和众仇敌的手。』」

chapters.en: Abner also spoke to the Benjamites. Then he went to Hebron to tell David all that seemed good to Israel and to the whole house of Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 押尼珥也用这话说给便雅悯人听，又到希伯崙，将以色列人和便雅悯全家一切所喜悦的事说给大卫听。

chapters.en: When Abner and twenty of his men came to David at Hebron, David held a feast for them.
chapters.zh: 押尼珥带着二十个人来到希伯崙见大卫，大卫就为押尼珥和他带来的人设摆筵席。

chapters.en:
Then Abner said to David, “Let me go at once, and I will gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may rule over all that your heart desires.”
So David dismissed Abner, and he went in peace.
chapters.zh: 押尼珥对大卫说：「我要起身去招聚以色列众人来见我主我王，与你立约，你就可以照着心愿作王。」于是大卫送押尼珥去，押尼珥就平平安安地去了。

chapters.en: Just then David’s soldiers and Joab returned from a raid, bringing with them a great plunder. But Abner was not with David in Hebron, because David had sent him on his way in peace.
chapters.zh: 约押和大卫的仆人攻击敌军，带回许多的掠物。那时押尼珥不在希伯崙大卫那里，因大卫已经送他去，他也平平安安地去了。

chapters.en: When Joab and all his troops arrived, he was informed, “Abner son of Ner came to see the king, who sent him on his way in peace.”
chapters.zh: 约押和跟随他的全军到了，就有人告诉约押说：「尼珥的儿子押尼珥来见王，王送他去，他也平平安安地去了。」

chapters.en: So Joab went to the king and said, “What have you done? Look, Abner came to you. Why did you dismiss him? Now he is getting away!
chapters.zh: 约押去见王说：「你这是做什么呢？押尼珥来见你，你为何送他去，他就踪影不见了呢？

chapters.en: Surely you realize that Abner son of Ner came to deceive you and to track your movements and all that you are doing.”
chapters.zh: 你当晓得，尼珥的儿子押尼珥来是要诓哄你，要知道你的出入和你一切所行的事。」

chapters.en: As soon as Joab had left David, he sent messengers after Abner, who brought him back from the well of Sirah. But David was unaware of it.
chapters.zh: 约押从大卫那里出来，就打发人去追赶押尼珥，在西拉井追上他，将他带回来，大卫却不知道。

chapters.en: When Abner returned to Hebron, Joab pulled him aside into the gateway, as if to speak to him privately, and there Joab stabbed him in the stomach. So Abner died on account of the blood of Joab’s brother Asahel.
chapters.zh: 押尼珥回到希伯崙，约押领他到城门的甕洞，假作要与他说机密话，就在那里刺透他的肚腹，他便死了。这是报杀他兄弟亚撒黑的仇。

chapters.en: Afterward, David heard about this and said, “I and my kingdom are forever guiltless before the LORD concerning the blood of Abner son of Ner.
chapters.zh: 大卫听见了，就说：「流尼珥的儿子押尼珥的血，这罪在耶和华面前必永不归我和我的国。

chapters.en: May it whirl over the head of Joab and over the entire house of his father, and may the house of Joab never be without one having a discharge or skin disease, or one who leans on a staff or falls by the sword or lacks food.”
chapters.zh: 愿流他血的罪归到约押头上和他父的全家；又愿约押家不断有患漏症的，长大痲疯的，架柺而行的，被刀杀死的，缺乏饮食的。」

chapters.en: (Joab and his brother Abishai murdered Abner because he had killed their brother Asahel in the battle at Gibeon.)
chapters.zh: 约押和他兄弟亚比筛杀了押尼珥，是因押尼珥在基遍争战的时候杀了他们的兄弟亚撒黑。

chapters.en: Then David ordered Joab and all the people with him, “Tear your clothes, put on sackcloth, and mourn before Abner.” And King David himself walked behind the funeral bier.
chapters.zh: 大卫吩咐约押和跟随他的众人说：「你们当撕裂衣服，腰束麻布，在押尼珥〔棺〕前哀哭。」大卫王也跟在棺后。

chapters.en: When they buried Abner in Hebron, the king wept aloud at Abner’s tomb, and all the people wept.
chapters.zh: 他们将押尼珥葬在希伯崙。王在押尼珥的墓旁放声而哭，众民也都哭了。

chapters.en:
And the king sang this lament for Abner:
“Should Abner die the death of a fool?
chapters.zh: 王为押尼珥举哀，说： 押尼珥何竟像愚顽人死呢？

chapters.en:
Your hands were not bound, your feet were not fettered. As a man falls before the wicked, so also you fell.”
And all the people wept over him even more.
chapters.zh: 你手未曾捆绑，脚未曾锁住。 你死，如人死在罪孽之辈手下一样。 于是众民又为押尼珥哀哭。

chapters.en: Then all the people came and urged David to eat something while it was still day, but David took an oath, saying, “May God punish me, and ever so severely, if I taste bread or anything else before the sun sets!”
chapters.zh: 日头未落的时候，众民来劝大卫吃饭，但大卫起誓说：「我若在日头未落以前吃饭，或吃别物，愿上帝重重地降罚与我！」

chapters.en: All the people took note and were pleased. In fact, everything the king did pleased them.
chapters.zh: 众民知道了就都喜悦。凡王所行的，众民无不喜悦。

chapters.en: So on that day all the troops and all Israel were convinced that the king had no part in the murder of Abner son of Ner.
chapters.zh: 那日，以色列众民才知道杀尼珥的儿子押尼珥并非出于王意。

chapters.en: Then the king said to his servants, “Do you not realize that a great prince has fallen today in Israel?
chapters.zh: 王对臣仆说：「你们岂不知今日以色列人中死了一个作元帅的大丈夫吗？

chapters.en: And I am weak this day, though anointed as king, and these men, the sons of Zeruiah, are too fierce for me. May the LORD repay the evildoer according to his evil!”
chapters.zh: 我虽然受膏为王，今日还是软弱；这洗鲁雅的两个儿子比我刚强。愿耶和华照着恶人所行的恶报应他。」

chapters.en: Now when Ish-bosheth son of Saul heard that Abner had died in Hebron, he lost courage, and all Israel was dismayed.
chapters.zh: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设听见押尼珥死在希伯崙，手就发软；以色列众人也都惊惶。

chapters.en: Saul’s son had two men who were leaders of raiding parties. One was named Baanah and the other Rechab; they were sons of Rimmon the Beerothite of the tribe of Benjamin—Beeroth is considered part of Benjamin,
chapters.zh: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设有两个军长，一名巴拿，一名利甲，是便雅悯支派、比录人临门的儿子。比录也属便雅悯。

chapters.en: because the Beerothites fled to Gittaim and have lived there as foreigners to this day.
chapters.zh: 比录人早先逃到基他音，在那里寄居，直到今日。

chapters.en: And Jonathan son of Saul had a son who was lame in his feet. He was five years old when the report about Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel. His nurse picked him up and fled, but as she was hurrying to escape, he fell and became lame. His name was Mephibosheth.
chapters.zh: 扫罗的儿子约拿单有一个儿子名叫米非波设，是瘸腿的。扫罗和约拿单〔死亡〕的消息从耶斯列传到的时候，他才五岁。他乳母抱着他逃跑；因为跑得太急，孩子掉在地上，腿就瘸了。

chapters.en: Now Rechab and Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, set out and arrived at the house of Ish-bosheth in the heat of the day, while the king was taking his midday nap.
chapters.zh: 一日，比录人临门的两个儿子利甲和巴拿出去，约在午热的时候到了伊施波设的家；伊施波设正睡午觉。

chapters.en: They entered the interior of the house as if to get some wheat, and they stabbed him in the stomach. Then Rechab and his brother Baanah slipped away.
chapters.zh: 他们进了房子，假作要取麦子，就刺透伊施波设的肚腹，逃跑了。

chapters.en: They had entered the house while Ish-bosheth was lying on his bed, and having stabbed and killed him, they beheaded him, took his head, and traveled all night by way of the Arabah.
chapters.zh: 他们进房子的时候，伊施波设正在卧房里躺在床上，他们将他杀死，割了他的首级，拿着首级在亚拉巴走了一夜，

chapters.en: They brought the head of Ish-bosheth to David at Hebron and said to the king, “Here is the head of Ish-bosheth son of Saul, your enemy who sought your life. Today the LORD has granted vengeance to my lord the king against Saul and his offspring.”
chapters.zh: 将伊施波设的首级拿到希伯崙见大卫王，说：「王的仇敌扫罗曾寻索王的性命。看哪，这是他儿子伊施波设的首级；耶和华今日为我主我王在扫罗和他后裔的身上报了仇。」

chapters.en: But David answered Rechab and his brother Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, “As surely as the LORD lives, who has redeemed my life from all distress,
chapters.zh: 大卫对比录人临门的儿子利甲和他兄弟巴拿说：「我指着救我性命脱离一切苦难、永生的耶和华起誓：

chapters.en: when someone told me, ‘Look, Saul is dead,’ and thought he was a bearer of good news, I seized him and put him to death at Ziklag. That was his reward for his news!
chapters.zh: 从前有人报告我说，扫罗死了，他自以为报好消息；我就拿住他，将他杀在洗革拉，这就作了他报消息的赏赐。

chapters.en: How much more, when wicked men kill a righteous man in his own house and on his own bed, shall I not now require his blood from your hands and remove you from the earth!”
chapters.zh: 何况恶人将义人杀在他的床上，我岂不向你们讨流他血的罪、从世上除灭你们呢？」

chapters.en: So David commanded his young men, and they killed Rechab and Baanah. They cut off their hands and feet and hung their bodies by the pool in Hebron, but they took the head of Ish-bosheth and buried it in Abner’s tomb in Hebron.
chapters.zh: 于是大卫吩咐少年人将他们杀了，砍断他们的手脚，挂在希伯崙的池旁，却将伊施波设的首级葬在希伯崙押尼珥的坟墓里。

chapters.en: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and said, “Here we are, your own flesh and blood.
chapters.zh: 以色列众支派来到希伯崙见大卫，说：「我们原是你的骨肉。

chapters.en: Even in times past, while Saul was king over us, you were the one who led Israel out and brought them back. And to you the LORD said, ‘You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be ruler over them.’”
chapters.zh: 从前扫罗作我们王的时候，率领以色列人出入的是你；耶和华也曾应许你说：『你必牧养我的民以色列，作以色列的君。』」

chapters.en: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, where King David made with them a covenant before the LORD. And they anointed him king over Israel.
chapters.zh: 于是以色列的长老都来到希伯崙见大卫王，大卫在希伯崙耶和华面前与他们立约，他们就膏大卫作以色列的王。

chapters.en: David was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned forty years.
chapters.zh: 大卫登基的时候年三十岁，在位四十年；

chapters.en: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.
chapters.zh: 在希伯崙作犹大王七年零六个月，在耶路撒冷作以色列和犹大王三十三年。

chapters.en: Now the king and his men marched to Jerusalem against the Jebusites who inhabited the land. The Jebusites said to David: “You will never get in here. Even the blind and lame can repel you.” For they thought, “David cannot get in here.”
chapters.zh: 大卫和跟随他的人到了耶路撒冷，要攻打住那地方的耶布斯人。耶布斯人对大卫说：「你若不赶出瞎子、瘸子，必不能进这地方」；心里想大卫决不能进去。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion (that is, the City of David).
chapters.zh: 然而大卫攻取锡安的保障，就是大卫的城。

chapters.en: On that day he said, “Whoever attacks the Jebusites must use the water shaft to reach the lame and blind who are despised by David. ” That is why it is said, “The blind and the lame will never enter the palace.”
chapters.zh: 当日，大卫说：「谁攻打耶布斯人，当上水沟〔攻打〕我心里所恨恶的瘸子、瞎子。」从此有俗语说：「在那里有瞎子、瘸子，他不能进屋去。」

chapters.en: So David took up residence in the fortress and called it the City of David. He built it up all the way around, from the supporting terraces inward.
chapters.zh: 大卫住在保障里，给保障起名叫大卫城。大卫又从米罗以里，周围筑墙。

chapters.en: And David became greater and greater, for the LORD God of Hosts was with him.
chapters.zh: 大卫日见强盛，因为耶和华－万军之上帝与他同在。

chapters.en: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David, along with cedar logs, carpenters, and stonemasons, and they built a palace for David.
chapters.zh: 泰尔王希兰将香柏木运到大卫那里，又差遣使者和木匠、石匠给大卫建造宫殿。

chapters.en: And David realized that the LORD had established him as king over Israel and had exalted his kingdom for the sake of His people Israel.
chapters.zh: 大卫就知道耶和华坚立他作以色列王，又为自己的民以色列使他的国兴旺。

chapters.en: After he had arrived from Hebron, David took more concubines and wives from Jerusalem, and more sons and daughters were born to him.
chapters.zh: 大卫离开希伯崙之后，在耶路撒冷又立后妃，又生儿女。

chapters.en: These are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
chapters.zh: 在耶路撒冷所生的儿子是沙母亚、朔罢、拿单、所罗门、

chapters.en: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,
chapters.zh: 益辖、以利书亚、尼斐、雅非亚、

chapters.en: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
chapters.zh: 以利沙玛、以利雅大、以利法列。

chapters.en: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over Israel, they all went in search of him; but David learned of this and went down to the stronghold.
chapters.zh: 非利士人听见人膏大卫作以色列王，非利士众人就上来寻索大卫；大卫听见，就下到保障。

chapters.en: Now the Philistines had come and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim.
chapters.zh: 非利士人来了，布散在利乏音谷。

chapters.en:
So David inquired of the LORD, “Should I go up against the Philistines? Will You deliver them into my hand?”
“Go up,” replied the LORD, “for I will surely deliver the Philistines into your hand.”
chapters.zh: 大卫求问耶和华说：「我可以上去攻打非利士人吗？你将他们交在我手里吗？」耶和华说：「你可以上去，我必将非利士人交在你手里。」

chapters.en: So David went to Baal-perazim, where he defeated the Philistines and said, “Like a bursting flood, the LORD has burst out against my enemies before me.” So he called that place Baal-perazim.
chapters.zh: 大卫来到巴力‧毗拉心，在那里击杀非利士人，说：「耶和华在我面前冲破敌人，如同水冲去一般。」因此称那地方为巴力‧毗拉心。

chapters.en: There the Philistines abandoned their idols, and David and his men carried them away.
chapters.zh: 非利士人将偶像撇在那里，大卫和跟随他的人拿去了。

chapters.en: Once again the Philistines came up and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim.
chapters.zh: 非利士人又上来，布散在利乏音谷。

chapters.en: So David inquired of the LORD, who answered, “Do not march straight up, but circle around behind them and attack them in front of the balsam trees.
chapters.zh: 大卫求问耶和华；耶和华说：「不要一直地上去，要转到他们后头，从桑林对面攻打他们。

chapters.en: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, move quickly, because this will mean that the LORD has gone out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines.”
chapters.zh: 你听见桑树梢上有脚步的声音，就要急速前去，因为那时耶和华已经在你前头去攻打非利士人的军队。」

chapters.en: So David did as the LORD had commanded him, and he struck down the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.
chapters.zh: 大卫就遵着耶和华所吩咐的去行，攻打非利士人，从迦巴直到基色。

chapters.en: David again assembled the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand in all.
chapters.zh: 大卫又聚集以色列中所有挑选的人三万。

chapters.en: And he and all his troops set out for Baale of Judah to bring up from there the ark of God, which is called by the Name— the name of the LORD of Hosts, who is enthroned between the cherubim that are on it.
chapters.zh: 大卫起身，率领跟随他的众人前往，要从巴拉‧犹大将上帝的〔约〕柜运来；这〔约〕柜就是坐在二基路伯上万军之耶和华留名的〔约〕柜。

chapters.en: They set the ark of God on a new cart and brought it from the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill. Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, were guiding the new cart,
chapters.zh: 他们将上帝的〔约〕柜从冈上亚比拿达的家里抬出来，放在新车上；亚比拿达的两个儿子乌撒和亚希约赶这新车。

chapters.en: bringing with it the ark of God. And Ahio was walking in front of the ark.
chapters.zh: 他们将上帝的〔约〕柜从冈上亚比拿达家里抬出来的时候，亚希约在柜前行走。

chapters.en: David and all the house of Israel were celebrating before the LORD with all kinds of wood instruments, harps, stringed instruments, tambourines, sistrums, and cymbals.
chapters.zh: 大卫和以色列的全家在耶和华面前，用松木制造的各样〔乐器〕和琴、瑟、鼓、钹、锣，作乐跳舞。

chapters.en: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached out and took hold of the ark of God, because the oxen had stumbled.
chapters.zh: 到了拿艮的禾场，因为牛失前蹄〔注：或译：惊跳〕，乌撒就伸〔手〕扶住上帝的〔约〕柜。

chapters.en: And the anger of the LORD burned against Uzzah, and God struck him down on the spot for his irreverence, and he died there beside the ark of God.
chapters.zh: 上帝耶和华向乌撒发怒，因这错误击杀他，他就死在上帝的〔约〕柜旁。

chapters.en: Then David became angry because the LORD had burst forth against Uzzah. So he named that place Perez-uzzah, as it is called to this day.
chapters.zh: 大卫因耶和华击杀〔注：原文是闯杀〕乌撒，心里愁烦，就称那地方为毗列斯‧乌撒，直到今日。

chapters.en: That day David feared the LORD and asked, “How can the ark of the LORD ever come to me?”
chapters.zh: 那日，大卫惧怕耶和华，说：「耶和华的〔约〕柜怎可运到我这里来？」

chapters.en: So he was unwilling to move the ark of the LORD to the City of David; instead, he took it aside to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
chapters.zh: 于是大卫不肯将耶和华的〔约〕柜运进大卫的城，却运到迦特人俄别‧以东的家中。

chapters.en: Thus the ark of the LORD remained in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite for three months, and the LORD blessed him and all his household.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的〔约〕柜在迦特人俄别‧以东家中三个月；耶和华赐福给俄别‧以东和他的全家。

chapters.en:
Now it was reported to King David, “The LORD has blessed the house of Obed-edom and all that belongs to him, because of the ark of God.”
So David went and had the ark of God brought up from the house of Obed-edom into the City of David with rejoicing.
chapters.zh: 有人告诉大卫王说：「耶和华因为〔约〕柜赐福给俄别‧以东的家和一切属他的。」大卫就去，欢欢喜喜地将上帝的〔约〕柜从俄别‧以东家中抬到大卫的城里。

chapters.en: When those carrying the ark of the LORD had advanced six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.
chapters.zh: 抬耶和华〔约〕柜的人走了六步，大卫就献牛与肥羊为祭。

chapters.en: And David, wearing a linen ephod, danced with all his might before the LORD,
chapters.zh: 大卫穿着细麻布的以弗得，在耶和华面前极力跳舞。

chapters.en: while he and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the LORD with shouting and the sounding of the ram’s horn.
chapters.zh: 这样，大卫和以色列的全家欢呼吹角，将耶和华的〔约〕柜抬上来。

chapters.en: As the ark of the LORD was entering the City of David, Saul’s daughter Michal looked down from a window and saw King David leaping and dancing before the LORD, and she despised him in her heart.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的〔约〕柜进了大卫城的时候，扫罗的女儿米甲从窗户里观看，见大卫王在耶和华面前踊跃跳舞，心里就轻视他。

chapters.en: So they brought the ark of the LORD and set it in its place inside the tent that David had pitched for it. Then David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 众人将耶和华的〔约〕柜请进去，安放在所预备的地方，就是在大卫所搭的帐幕里。大卫在耶和华面前献燔祭和平安祭。

chapters.en: When David had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 大卫献完了燔祭和平安祭，就奉万军之耶和华的名给民祝福，

chapters.en: Then he distributed to every man and woman among the multitude of Israel a loaf of bread, a date cake, and a raisin cake. And all the people departed, each to his own home.
chapters.zh: 并且分给以色列众人，无论男女，每人一个饼，一块〔肉〕，一个葡萄饼；众人就各回各家去了。

chapters.en: When David returned home to bless his own household, Saul’s daughter Michal came out to meet him. “How the king of Israel has distinguished himself today!” she said. “He has uncovered himself today in the sight of the maidservants of his subjects, like a vulgar person would do.”
chapters.zh: 大卫回家要给眷属祝福；扫罗的女儿米甲出来迎接他，说：「以色列王今日在臣仆的婢女眼前露体，如同一个轻贱人无耻露体一样，有好大的荣耀啊！」

chapters.en: But David said to Michal, “I was dancing before the LORD, who chose me over your father and all his house when He appointed me ruler over the LORD’s people Israel. I will celebrate before the LORD,
chapters.zh: 大卫对米甲说：「这是在耶和华面前；耶和华已拣选我，废了你父和你父的全家，立我作耶和华民以色列的君，所以我必在耶和华面前跳舞。

chapters.en: and I will humiliate and humble myself even more than this. Yet I will be honored by the maidservants of whom you have spoken.”
chapters.zh: 我也必更加卑微，自己看为轻贱。你所说的那些婢女，她们倒要尊敬我。」

chapters.en: And Michal the daughter of Saul had no children to the day of her death.
chapters.zh: 扫罗的女儿米甲，直到死日，没有生养儿女。

chapters.en: After the king had settled into his palace and the LORD had given him rest from all his enemies around him,
chapters.zh: 王住在自己宫中，耶和华使他安靖，不被四围的仇敌扰乱。

chapters.en: he said to Nathan the prophet, “Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of God remains in a tent.”
chapters.zh: 那时，王对先知拿单说：「看哪，我住在香柏木的宫中，上帝的〔约〕柜反在幔子里。」

chapters.en: And Nathan replied to the king, “Go and do all that is in your heart, for the LORD is with you.”
chapters.zh: 拿单对王说：「你可以照你的心意而行，因为耶和华与你同在。」

chapters.en: But that night the word of the LORD came to Nathan, saying,
chapters.zh: 当夜，耶和华的话临到拿单说：

chapters.en: “Go and tell My servant David that this is what the LORD says: Are you the one to build for Me a house to dwell in?
chapters.zh: 「你去告诉我仆人大卫，说耶和华如此说：『你岂可建造殿宇给我居住呢？

chapters.en: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought the Israelites up out of Egypt until this day, but I have moved about with a tent as My dwelling.
chapters.zh: 自从我领以色列人出埃及直到今日，我未曾住过殿宇，常在会幕和帐幕中行走。

chapters.en: In all My journeys with all the Israelites, have I ever asked any of the leaders I appointed to shepherd My people Israel, ‘Why haven’t you built Me a house of cedar?’
chapters.zh: 凡我同以色列人所走的地方，我何曾向以色列一支派〔的士师〕，就是我吩咐牧养我民以色列的说：你们为何不给我建造香柏木的殿宇呢？』

chapters.en: Now then, you are to tell My servant David that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: I took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be the ruler over My people Israel.
chapters.zh: 「现在，你要告诉我仆人大卫，说万军之耶和华如此说：『我从羊圈中将你召来，叫你不再跟从羊群，立你作我民以色列的君。

chapters.en: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you. Now I will make for you a name like that of the greatest in the land.
chapters.zh: 你无论往哪里去，我常与你同在，剪除你的一切仇敌。我必使你得大名，好像世上大大有名的人一样。

chapters.en: And I will provide a place for My people Israel and will plant them so that they may dwell in a place of their own and be disturbed no more. No longer will the sons of wickedness oppress them as they did at the beginning
chapters.zh: 我必为我民以色列选定一个地方，栽培他们，使他们住自己的地方，不再迁移；凶恶之子也不像从前扰害他们，

chapters.en:
and have done since the day I appointed judges over My people Israel. I will give you rest from all your enemies.
The LORD declares to you that He Himself will establish a house for you.
chapters.zh: 并不像我命士师治理我民以色列的时候一样。我必使你安靖，不被一切仇敌扰乱，并且我－耶和华应许你，必为你建立家室。

chapters.en: And when your days are fulfilled and you rest with your fathers, I will raise up your descendant after you, who will come from your own body, and I will establish his kingdom.
chapters.zh: 你寿数满足、与你列祖同睡的时候，我必使你的后裔接续你的位；我也必坚定他的国。

chapters.en: He will build a house for My Name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.
chapters.zh: 他必为我的名建造殿宇；我必坚定他的国位，直到永远。

chapters.en: I will be his Father, and he will be My son. When he does wrong, I will discipline him with the rod of men and with the blows of the sons of men.
chapters.zh: 我要作他的父，他要作我的子；他若犯了罪，我必用人的杖责打他，用人的鞭责罚他。

chapters.en: But My loving devotion will never be removed from him as I removed it from Saul, whom I removed from before you.
chapters.zh: 但我的慈爱仍不离开他，像离开在你面前所废弃的扫罗一样。

chapters.en: Your house and kingdom will endure forever before Me, and your throne will be established forever.”
chapters.zh: 你的家和你的国必在我〔注：原文是你〕面前永远坚立。你的国位也必坚定，直到永远。』」

chapters.en: So Nathan relayed to David all the words of this entire revelation.
chapters.zh: 拿单就按这一切话，照这默示，告诉大卫。

chapters.en: Then King David went in, sat before the LORD, and said, “Who am I, O Lord GOD, and what is my house, that You have brought me this far?
chapters.zh: 于是大卫王进去，坐在耶和华面前，说：「主耶和华啊，我是谁？我的家算什么？你竟使我到这地步呢？

chapters.en: And as if this was a small thing in Your eyes, O Lord GOD, You have also spoken about the future of the house of Your servant. Is this Your custom with man, O Lord GOD?
chapters.zh: 主耶和华啊，这在你眼中还看为小，又应许你仆人的家至于久远。主耶和华啊，这岂是人所常遇的事吗？

chapters.en: What more can David say to You? For You know Your servant, O Lord GOD.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华啊，我还有何言可以对你说呢？因为你知道你的仆人。

chapters.en: For the sake of Your word and according to Your own heart, You have accomplished this great thing and revealed it to Your servant.
chapters.zh: 你行这大事使仆人知道，是因你所应许的话，也是照你的心意。

chapters.en: How great You are, O Lord GOD! For there is none like You, and there is no God but You, according to everything we have heard with our own ears.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华啊，你本为大，照我们耳中听见，没有可比你的；除你以外再无上帝。

chapters.en: And who is like Your people Israel—the one nation on earth whom God went out to redeem as a people for Himself and to make a name for Himself? You performed great and awesome wonders by driving out nations and their gods from before Your people, whom You redeemed for Yourself from Egypt.
chapters.zh: 世上有何民能比你的民以色列呢？你从埃及救赎他们作自己的子民，又在你赎出来的民面前行大而可畏的事，〔驱逐〕列邦人和他们的神，显出你的大名。

chapters.en: For You have established Your people Israel as Your very own forever, and You, O LORD, have become their God.
chapters.zh: 你曾坚立你的民以色列作你的子民，直到永远；你－耶和华也作了他们的上帝。

chapters.en: And now, O LORD God, confirm forever the word You have spoken concerning Your servant and his house. Do as You have promised,
chapters.zh: 「耶和华上帝啊，你所应许仆人和仆人家的话，求你坚定，直到永远；照你所说的而行。

chapters.en: so that Your name will be magnified forever when it is said, ‘The LORD of Hosts is God over Israel.’ And the house of Your servant David will be established before You.
chapters.zh: 愿人永远尊你的名为大，说：『万军之耶和华是治理以色列的上帝。』这样，你仆人大卫的家必在你面前坚立。

chapters.en: For You, O LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, have revealed this to Your servant when You said, ‘I will build a house for you.’ Therefore Your servant has found the courage to offer this prayer to You.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝啊，因你启示你的仆人说：『我必为你建立家室』，所以仆人大胆向你如此祈祷。

chapters.en: And now, O Lord GOD, You are God! Your words are true, and You have promised this goodness to Your servant.
chapters.zh: 「主耶和华啊，惟有你是上帝。你的话是真实的；你也应许将这福气赐给仆人。

chapters.en: Now therefore, may it please You to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue forever before You. For You, O Lord GOD, have spoken, and with Your blessing the house of Your servant will be blessed forever.”
chapters.zh: 现在求你赐福与仆人的家，可以永存在你面前。主耶和华啊，这是你所应许的。愿你永远赐福与仆人的家！」

chapters.en: Some time later, David defeated the Philistines, subdued them, and took Metheg-ammah from the hand of the Philistines.
chapters.zh: 此后，大卫攻打非利士人，把他们治服，从他们手下夺取了京城的权柄〔注：原文是母城的嚼环〕；

chapters.en: David also defeated the Moabites, made them lie down on the ground, and measured them off with a cord. He measured off with two lengths those to be put to death, and with one length those to be spared. So the Moabites became subject to David and brought him tribute.
chapters.zh: 又攻打摩押人，使他们躺卧在地上，用绳量一量：量二绳的杀了，量一绳的存留。摩押人就归服大卫，给他进贡。

chapters.en: David also defeated Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah, who had marched out to restore his dominion along the Euphrates River.
chapters.zh: 琐巴王利合的儿子哈大底谢往大河去，要夺回他的国权。大卫就攻打他，

chapters.en: David captured from him a thousand chariots, seven thousand charioteers, and twenty thousand foot soldiers, and he hamstrung all the horses except a hundred he kept for the chariots.
chapters.zh: 擒拿了他的马兵一千七百，步兵二万，将拉战车的马砍断蹄筋，但留下一百辆车的马。

chapters.en: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand of their men.
chapters.zh: 大马士革的亚兰人来帮助琐巴王哈大底谢，大卫就杀了亚兰人二万二千。

chapters.en: Then he placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to David and brought him tribute. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
chapters.zh: 于是大卫在大马士革的亚兰地设立防营，亚兰人就归服他，给他进贡。大卫无论往哪里去，耶和华都使他得胜。

chapters.en: And David took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 他夺了哈大底谢臣仆所拿的金盾牌，带到耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: And from Betah and Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a large amount of bronze.
chapters.zh: 大卫王又从属哈大底谢的比他和比罗他城中夺取了许多的铜。

chapters.en: When King Toi of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer,
chapters.zh: 哈马王陀以听见大卫杀败哈大底谢的全军，

chapters.en: he sent his son Joram to greet King David and bless him for fighting and defeating Hadadezer, who had been at war with Toi. Joram brought with him articles of silver and gold and bronze,
chapters.zh: 就打发他儿子约兰去见大卫王，问他的安，为他祝福，因为他杀败了哈大底谢（原来陀以与哈大底谢常常争战）。约兰带了金银铜的器皿来，

chapters.en: and King David dedicated these to the LORD, along with the silver and gold he had dedicated from all the nations he had subdued—
chapters.zh: 大卫王将这些器皿和他治服各国所得来的金银都分别为圣，献给耶和华，

chapters.en: from Edom and Moab, from the Ammonites and Philistines and Amalekites, and from the spoil of Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
chapters.zh: 就是从亚兰、摩押、亚扪、非利士、亚玛力人所得来的，以及从琐巴王利合的儿子哈大底谢所掠之物。

chapters.en: And David made a name for himself when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
chapters.zh: 大卫在盐谷击杀了亚兰〔注：或译：以东，见诗篇六十篇诗题〕一万八千人回来，就得了大名；

chapters.en: He placed garrisons throughout Edom, and all the Edomites were subject to David. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
chapters.zh: 又在以东全地设立防营，以东人就都归服大卫。大卫无论往哪里去，耶和华都使他得胜。

chapters.en: Thus David reigned over all Israel and administered justice and righteousness for all his people:
chapters.zh: 大卫作以色列众人的王，又向众民秉公行义。

chapters.en:
Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army;
Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the recorder;
chapters.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押作元帅；亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官；

chapters.en:
Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests;
Seraiah was the scribe;
chapters.zh: 亚希突的儿子撒督和亚比亚他的儿子亚希米勒作祭司〔长〕；西莱雅作书记；

chapters.en:
Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and Pelethites;
and David’s sons were priestly leaders.
chapters.zh: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅统辖基利提人和比利提人。大卫的众子都作领袖。

chapters.en: Then David asked, “Is there anyone left from the house of Saul to whom I can show kindness for the sake of Jonathan?”
chapters.zh: 大卫问说：「扫罗家还有剩下的人没有？我要因约拿单的缘故向他施恩。」

chapters.en:
And there was a servant of the house of Saul named Ziba. They summoned him to David, and the king inquired, “Are you Ziba?”
“I am your servant,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 扫罗家有一个仆人，名叫洗巴，有人叫他来见大卫，王问他说：「你是洗巴吗？」回答说：「仆人是。」

chapters.en:
So the king asked, “Is there anyone left of the house of Saul to whom I can show the kindness of God?”
Ziba answered, “There is still Jonathan’s son, who is lame in both feet.”
chapters.zh: 王说：「扫罗家还有人没有？我要照上帝的慈爱恩待他。」洗巴对王说：「还有约拿单的一个儿子，是瘸腿的。」

chapters.en:
“Where is he?” replied the king.
And Ziba said, “Indeed, he is in Lo-debar at the house of Machir son of Ammiel.”
chapters.zh: 王说：「他在哪里？」洗巴对王说：「他在罗‧底巴，亚米利的儿子玛吉家里。」

chapters.en: So King David had him brought from the house of Machir son of Ammiel in Lo-debar.
chapters.zh: 于是大卫王打发人去，从罗‧底巴亚米利的儿子玛吉家里召了他来。

chapters.en:
And when Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, he fell facedown in reverence.
Then David said, “Mephibosheth!”
“I am your servant,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 扫罗的孙子、约拿单的儿子米非波设来见大卫，伏地叩拜。大卫说：「米非波设！」米非波设说：「仆人在此。」

chapters.en: “Do not be afraid,” said David, “for surely I will show you kindness for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will restore to you all the land of your grandfather Saul, and you will always eat at my table.”
chapters.zh: 大卫说：「你不要惧怕，我必因你父亲约拿单的缘故施恩与你，将你祖父扫罗的一切田地都归还你；你也可以常与我同席吃饭。」

chapters.en: Mephibosheth bowed down and said, “What is your servant, that you should show regard for a dead dog like me?”
chapters.zh: 米非波设又叩拜，说：「仆人算什么，不过如死狗一般，竟蒙王这样眷顾！」

chapters.en: Then the king summoned Saul’s servant Ziba and said to him, “I have given to your master’s grandson all that belonged to Saul and to all his house.
chapters.zh: 王召了扫罗的仆人洗巴来，对他说：「我已将属扫罗和他的一切家产都赐给你主人的儿子了。

chapters.en:
You and your sons and servants are to work the ground for him and bring in the harvest, so that your master’s grandson may have food to eat. But Mephibosheth, your master’s grandson, is always to eat at my table.”
Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
chapters.zh: 你和你的众子、仆人要为你主人的儿子米非波设耕种田地，把所产的拿来供他食用；他却要常与我同席吃饭。」洗巴有十五个儿子，二十个仆人。

chapters.en:
And Ziba said to the king, “Your servant will do all that my lord the king has commanded.”
So Mephibosheth ate at David’s table like one of the king’s own sons.
chapters.zh: 洗巴对王说：「凡我主我王吩咐仆人的，仆人都必遵行。」王又说：「米非波设必与我同席吃饭，如王的儿子一样。」

chapters.en: And Mephibosheth had a young son named Mica, and all who dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants of Mephibosheth.
chapters.zh: 米非波设有一个小儿子，名叫米迦。凡住在洗巴家里的人都作了米非波设的仆人。

chapters.en: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, because he always ate at the king’s table, and he was lame in both feet.
chapters.zh: 于是米非波设住在耶路撒冷，常与王同席吃饭。他两腿都是瘸的。

chapters.en: Some time later, the king of the Ammonites died and was succeeded by his son Hanun.
chapters.zh: 此后，亚扪人的王死了，他儿子哈嫩接续他作王。

chapters.en:
And David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash, just as his father showed kindness to me.”
So David sent some of his servants to console Hanun concerning his father. But when they arrived in the land of the Ammonites,
chapters.zh: 大卫说：「我要照哈嫩的父亲拿辖厚待我的恩典厚待哈嫩。」于是大卫差遣臣仆，为他丧父安慰他。大卫的臣仆到了亚扪人的境内。

chapters.en: the princes of the Ammonites said to Hanun their lord, “Just because David has sent you comforters, do you really believe he is showing respect for your father? Has not David instead sent his servants to explore the city, spy it out, and overthrow it?”
chapters.zh: 但亚扪人的首领对他们的主哈嫩说：「大卫差人来安慰你，你想他是尊敬你父亲吗？他差臣仆来不是详察窥探、要倾覆这城吗？」

chapters.en: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved off half of each man’s beard, cut off their garments at the hips, and sent them away.
chapters.zh: 哈嫩便将大卫臣仆的胡须剃去一半，又割断他们下半截的衣服，使他们露出下体，打发他们回去。

chapters.en: When this was reported to David, he sent messengers to meet the men, since they had been thoroughly humiliated. The king told them, “Stay in Jericho until your beards have grown back, and then return.”
chapters.zh: 有人告诉大卫，他就差人去迎接他们，（因为他们甚觉羞耻），告诉他们说：「可以住在耶利哥，等到胡须长起再回来。」

chapters.en: When the Ammonites realized that they had become a stench to David, they hired twenty thousand Aramean foot soldiers from Beth-rehob and Zoba, as well as a thousand men from the king of Maacah and twelve thousand men from Tob.
chapters.zh: 亚扪人知道大卫憎恶他们，就打发人去，招募伯‧利合的亚兰人和琐巴的亚兰人，步兵二万，与玛迦王的人一千、陀伯人一万二千。

chapters.en: On hearing this, David sent Joab and the entire army of mighty men.
chapters.zh: 大卫听见了，就差派约押统带勇猛的全军出去。

chapters.en: The Ammonites marched out and arrayed themselves for battle at the entrance of the city gate, while the Arameans of Zobah and Rehob and the men of Tob and Maacah were by themselves in the open country.
chapters.zh: 亚扪人出来，在城门前摆阵；琐巴与利合的亚兰人、陀伯人，并玛迦人，另在郊野摆阵。

chapters.en: When Joab saw the battle lines before him and behind him, he selected some of the best men of Israel and arrayed them against the Arameans.
chapters.zh: 约押看见敌人在他前后摆阵，就从以色列军中挑选精兵，使他们对着亚兰人摆阵。

chapters.en: And he placed the rest of the troops under the command of his brother Abishai, who arrayed them against the Ammonites.
chapters.zh: 其余的兵交与他兄弟亚比筛，对着亚扪人摆阵。

chapters.en: “If the Arameans are too strong for me,” said Joab, “then you will come to my rescue. And if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will come to your rescue.
chapters.zh: 约押对亚比筛说：「亚兰人若强过我，你就来帮助我；亚扪人若强过你，我就去帮助你。

chapters.en: Be strong and let us fight bravely for our people and for the cities of our God. May the LORD do what is good in His sight.”
chapters.zh: 我们都当刚强，为本国的民和上帝的城邑作大丈夫。愿耶和华凭他的意旨而行！」

chapters.en: So Joab and his troops advanced to fight the Arameans, who fled before him.
chapters.zh: 于是，约押和跟随他的人前进攻打亚兰人；亚兰人在约押面前逃跑。

chapters.en: When the Ammonites saw that the Arameans had fled, they too fled before Abishai, and they entered the city. So Joab returned from fighting against the Ammonites and came to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 亚扪人见亚兰人逃跑，他们也在亚比筛面前逃跑进城。约押就离开亚扪人那里，回耶路撒冷去了。

chapters.en: When the Arameans saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they regrouped.
chapters.zh: 亚兰人见自己被以色列人打败，就又聚集。

chapters.en: Hadadezer sent messengers to bring more Arameans from beyond the Euphrates, and they came to Helam with Shobach the commander of Hadadezer’s army leading them.
chapters.zh: 哈大底谢差遣人，将大河那边的亚兰人调来；他们到了希兰，哈大底谢的将军朔法率领他们。

chapters.en: When this was reported to David, he gathered all Israel, crossed the Jordan, and went to Helam. Then the Arameans arrayed themselves against David and fought against him.
chapters.zh: 有人告诉大卫，他就聚集以色列众人，过约旦河，来到希兰。亚兰人迎着大卫摆阵，与他打仗。

chapters.en: But the Arameans fled before Israel, and David killed seven hundred charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers. He also struck down Shobach the commander of their army, who died there.
chapters.zh: 亚兰人在以色列人面前逃跑；大卫杀了亚兰七百辆战车〔的人〕，四万马兵，又杀了亚兰的将军朔法。

chapters.en: When all the kings who were subject to Hadadezer saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they made peace with Israel and became subject to them. So the Arameans were afraid to help the Ammonites anymore.
chapters.zh: 属哈大底谢的诸王见自己被以色列人打败，就与以色列人和好，归服他们。于是亚兰人不敢再帮助亚扪人了。

chapters.en: In the spring, at the time when kings march out to war, David sent out Joab and his servants with the whole army of Israel. They destroyed the Ammonites and besieged Rabbah, but David remained in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 过了一年，到列王出战的时候，大卫又差派约押，率领臣仆和以色列众人出〔战〕。他们就打败亚扪人，围攻拉巴。大卫仍住在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: One evening David got up from his bed and strolled around on the roof of the palace. And from the roof he saw a woman bathing—a very beautiful woman.
chapters.zh: 一日，太阳平西，大卫从床上起来，在王宫的平顶上游行，看见一个妇人沐浴，容貌甚美，

chapters.en: So David sent and inquired about the woman, and he was told, “This is Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam and the wife of Uriah the Hittite.”
chapters.zh: 大卫就差人打听那妇人是谁。有人说：「她是以连的女儿，赫人乌利亚的妻拔示巴。」

chapters.en: Then David sent messengers to get her, and when she came to him, he slept with her. (Now she had just purified herself from her uncleanness.) Then she returned home.
chapters.zh: 大卫差人去，将妇人接来；那时她的月经才得洁净。她来了，大卫与她同房，她就回家去了。

chapters.en: And the woman conceived and sent word to David, saying, “I am pregnant.”
chapters.zh: 于是她怀了孕，打发人去告诉大卫说：「我怀了孕。」

chapters.en: At this, David sent orders to Joab: “Send me Uriah the Hittite.” So Joab sent him to David.
chapters.zh: 大卫差人到约押那里，〔说〕：「你打发赫人乌利亚到我这里来。」约押就打发乌利亚去见大卫。

chapters.en: When Uriah came to him, David asked how Joab and the troops were doing and how the war was going.
chapters.zh: 乌利亚来了，大卫问约押好，也问兵好，又问争战的事怎样。

chapters.en:
Then he said to Uriah, “Go down to your house and wash your feet.”
So Uriah left the palace, and a gift from the king followed him.
chapters.zh: 大卫对乌利亚说：「你回家去，洗洗脚吧！」乌利亚出了王宫，随后王送他一分〔食〕物。

chapters.en: But Uriah slept at the door of the palace with all his master’s servants; he did not go down to his house.
chapters.zh: 乌利亚却和他主人的仆人一同睡在宫门外，没有回家去。

chapters.en:
And David was told, “Uriah did not go home.”
“Haven’t you just arrived from a journey?” David asked Uriah. “Why didn’t you go home?”
chapters.zh: 有人告诉大卫说：「乌利亚没有回家去。」大卫就问乌利亚说：「你从远路上来，为什么不回家去呢？」

chapters.en: Uriah answered, “The ark and Israel and Judah are dwelling in tents, and my master Joab and his soldiers are camped in the open field. How can I go to my house to eat and drink and sleep with my wife? As surely as you live, and as your soul lives, I will not do such a thing!”
chapters.zh: 乌利亚对大卫说：「〔约〕柜和以色列与犹大兵都住在棚里，我主约押和我主〔注：或译：王〕的仆人都在田野安营，我岂可回家吃喝、与妻子同寝呢？我敢在王面前起誓〔注：原文是我指着王和王的性命起誓〕：我决不行这事！」

chapters.en: “Stay here one more day,” David said to Uriah, “and tomorrow I will send you back.” So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day and the next.
chapters.zh: 大卫吩咐乌利亚说：「你今日仍住在这里，明日我打发你去。」于是乌利亚那日和次日住在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Then David invited Uriah to eat and drink with him, and he got Uriah drunk. And in the evening Uriah went out to lie down on his cot with his master’s servants, but he did not go home.
chapters.zh: 大卫召了乌利亚来，叫他在自己面前吃喝，使他喝醉。到了晚上，乌利亚出去与他主的仆人一同住宿，还没有回到家里去。

chapters.en: The next morning David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it with Uriah.
