chapters.zh: 当日，王因耶和华殿前的铜坛太小，容不下燔祭、素祭，和平安祭牲的脂油，便将耶和华殿前院子当中分别为圣，在那里献燔祭、素祭，和平安祭牲的脂油。

chapters.en: So at that time Solomon and all Israel with him—a great assembly of people from Lebo-hamath to the Brook of Egypt—kept the feast before the LORD our God for seven days and seven more days—fourteen days in all.
chapters.zh: 那时，所罗门和以色列众人，就是从哈马口直到埃及小河所有的以色列人，都聚集成为大会，在耶和华－我们的上帝面前守节七日又七日，共十四日。

chapters.en: On the fifteenth day Solomon sent the people away. So they blessed the king and went home, joyful and glad in heart for all the good things that the LORD had done for His servant David and for His people Israel.
chapters.zh: 第八日，王遣散众民；他们都为王祝福。因见耶和华向他仆人大卫和他民以色列所施的一切恩惠，就都心中喜乐，各归各家去了。

chapters.en: Now when Solomon had finished building the house of the LORD and the royal palace, and had achieved all that he had desired to do,
chapters.zh: 所罗门建造耶和华殿和王宫，并一切所愿意建造的都完毕了，

chapters.en: the LORD appeared to him a second time, as He had appeared to him at Gibeon.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就二次向所罗门显现，如先前在基遍向他显现一样，

chapters.en:
And the LORD said to him:
“I have heard your prayer and petition before Me. I have consecrated this temple, which you have built, by putting My Name there forever; My eyes and My heart will be there for all time.
chapters.zh: 对他说：「你向我所祷告祈求的，我都应允了。我已将你所建的这殿分别为圣，使我的名永远在其中；我的眼、我的心也必常在那里。

chapters.en: And as for you, if you walk before Me as your father David walked, with a heart of integrity and uprightness, doing all I have commanded you, and if you keep My statutes and ordinances,
chapters.zh: 你若效法你父大卫，存诚实正直的心行在我面前，遵行我一切所吩咐你的，谨守我的律例典章，

chapters.en: then I will establish your royal throne over Israel forever, as I promised your father David when I said, ‘You will never fail to have a man on the throne of Israel.’
chapters.zh: 我就必坚固你的国位在以色列中，直到永远，正如我应许你父大卫说：『你〔的子孙〕必不断人坐以色列的国位。』

chapters.en: But if indeed you or your sons turn away from following Me and do not keep the commandments and statutes I have set before you, and if you go off to serve and worship other gods,
chapters.zh: 倘若你们和你们的子孙转去不跟从我，不守我指示你们的诫命律例，去事奉敬拜别神，

chapters.en: then I will cut off Israel from the land that I have given them, and I will banish from My presence this temple I have sanctified for My Name. Then Israel will become an object of scorn and ridicule among all peoples.
chapters.zh: 我就必将以色列人从我赐给他们的地上剪除，并且我为己名所分别为圣的殿也必舍弃不顾，使以色列人在万民中作笑谈，被讥诮。

chapters.en: And when this temple has become a heap of rubble, all who pass by it will be appalled and will hiss and say, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land and to this temple?’
chapters.zh: 这殿虽然甚高，将来经过的人必惊讶、嗤笑，说：『耶和华为何向这地和这殿如此行呢？』

chapters.en: And others will answer, ‘Because they have forsaken the LORD their God who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them—because of this, the LORD has brought all this disaster upon them.’”
chapters.zh: 人必回答说：『是因此地的人离弃领他们列祖出埃及地之耶和华－他们的上帝，去亲近别神，事奉敬拜他，所以耶和华使这一切灾祸临到他们。』」

chapters.en: Now at the end of the twenty years during which Solomon built these two houses, the house of the LORD and the royal palace,
chapters.zh: 所罗门建造耶和华殿和王宫，这两所二十年才完毕了。

chapters.en: King Solomon gave twenty towns in the land of Galilee to Hiram king of Tyre, who had supplied him with cedar and cypress logs and gold for his every desire.
chapters.zh: 泰尔王希兰曾照所罗门所要的，资助他香柏木、松木，和金子；所罗门王就把加利利地的二十座城给了希兰。

chapters.en: So Hiram went out from Tyre to inspect the towns that Solomon had given him, but he was not pleased with them.
chapters.zh: 希兰从泰尔出来，察看所罗门给他的城邑，就不喜悦，

chapters.en: “What are these towns you have given me, my brother?” asked Hiram, and he called them the Land of Cabul, as they are called to this day.
chapters.zh: 说：「我兄啊，你给我的是什么城邑呢？」他就给这城邑之地起名叫迦步勒，直到今日。

chapters.en: And Hiram had sent the king 120 talents of gold.
chapters.zh: 希兰给所罗门一百二十他连得金子。

chapters.en: This is the account of the forced labor that King Solomon imposed to build the house of the LORD, his own palace, the supporting terraces, and the wall of Jerusalem, as well as Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王挑取服苦的人，是为建造耶和华的殿、自己的宫、米罗、耶路撒冷的城墙、夏琐、米吉多，并基色。

chapters.en: Pharaoh king of Egypt had attacked and captured Gezer. He had set it on fire, killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and given it as a dowry to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.
chapters.zh: 先前埃及王法老上来攻取基色，用火焚烧，杀了城内居住的迦南人，将城赐给他女儿所罗门的妻作妆奁。

chapters.en: So Solomon rebuilt Gezer, Lower Beth-horon,
chapters.zh: 所罗门建造基色、下伯‧和崙、

chapters.en: Baalath, and Tamar in the Wilderness of Judah,
chapters.zh: 巴拉，并国中旷野里的达莫，

chapters.en: as well as all the store cities that Solomon had for his chariots and horses —whatever he desired to build in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and throughout the land of his dominion.
chapters.zh: 又建造所有的积货城，并屯车和马兵的城，与耶路撒冷、黎巴嫩，以及自己治理的全国中所愿建造的。

chapters.en: As for all the people who remained of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites (the people who were not Israelites)—
chapters.zh: 至于国中所剩下不属以色列人的亚摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，

chapters.en: their descendants who remained in the land, those whom the Israelites were unable to devote to destruction —Solomon conscripted these people to be forced laborers, as they are to this day.
chapters.zh: 就是以色列人不能灭尽的，所罗门挑取他们的后裔作服苦的奴仆，直到今日。

chapters.en: But Solomon did not consign any of the Israelites to slavery, because they were his men of war, his servants, his officers, his captains, and the commanders of his chariots and cavalry.
chapters.zh: 惟有以色列人，所罗门不使他们作奴仆，乃是作他的战士、臣仆、统领、军长、车兵长、马兵长。

chapters.en: They were also the chief officers over Solomon’s projects: 550 supervisors over the people who did the work.
chapters.zh: 所罗门有五百五十督工的，监管工人。

chapters.en: As soon as Pharaoh’s daughter had come up from the City of David to the palace that Solomon had built for her, he built the supporting terraces.
chapters.zh: 法老的女儿从大卫城搬到〔所罗门〕为她建造的宫里。那时，所罗门才建造米罗。

chapters.en: Three times a year Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar he had built for the LORD, burning incense with them before the LORD. So he completed the temple.
chapters.zh: 所罗门每年三次在他为耶和华所筑的坛上献燔祭和平安祭，又在耶和华面前〔的坛上〕烧香。这样，他建造殿的工程完毕了。

chapters.en: King Solomon also assembled a fleet of ships at Ezion-geber, which is near Eloth in Edom, on the shore of the Red Sea.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王在以东地红海边，靠近以禄的以旬‧迦别制造船只。

chapters.en: And Hiram sent his servants, sailors who knew the sea, to serve in the fleet with Solomon’s servants.
chapters.zh: 希兰差遣他的仆人，就是熟悉泛海的船家，与所罗门的仆人一同坐船航海。

chapters.en: They sailed to Ophir and imported gold from there—420 talents —and delivered it to Solomon.
chapters.zh: 他们到了俄斐，从那里得了四百二十他连得金子，运到所罗门王那里。

chapters.en: Now when the queen of Sheba heard about the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to test him with difficult questions.
chapters.zh: 示巴女王听见所罗门因耶和华之名所得的名声，就来要用难解的话试问所罗门。

chapters.en:
She arrived in Jerusalem with a very large caravan—with camels bearing spices, gold in great abundance, and precious stones.
And she came to Solomon and spoke to him all that was on her mind.
chapters.zh: 跟随她到耶路撒冷的人甚多，又有骆驼驮着香料、宝石，和许多金子。她来见了所罗门王，就把心里所有的对所罗门都说出来。

chapters.en: And Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too difficult for the king to explain.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王将她所问的都答上了，没有一句不明白、不能答的。

chapters.en: When the queen of Sheba saw all the wisdom of Solomon, the palace he had built,
chapters.zh: 示巴女王见所罗门大有智慧，和他所建造的宫室，

chapters.en: the food at his table, the seating of his servants, the service and attire of his attendants, his cupbearers, and the burnt offerings he presented at the house of the LORD, it took her breath away.
chapters.zh: 席上的珍馐美味，群臣分列而坐，仆人两旁侍立，以及他们的衣服装饰和酒政的〔衣服装饰〕，又见他上耶和华殿的台阶〔注：或译：他在耶和华殿里所献的燔祭〕，就诧异得神不守舍；

chapters.en: She said to the king, “The report I heard in my own country about your words and wisdom is true.
chapters.zh: 对王说：「我在本国里所听见论到你的事和你的智慧实在是真的！

chapters.en: But I did not believe these things until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not even half was told to me. Your wisdom and prosperity have far exceeded the report I heard.
chapters.zh: 我先不信那些话，及至我来亲眼见了才知道人所告诉我的还不到一半。你的智慧和你的福分越过我所听见的风声。

chapters.en: How blessed are your men! How blessed are these servants of yours who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom!
chapters.zh: 你的臣子、你的仆人常侍立在你面前听你智慧的话是有福的！

chapters.en: Blessed be the LORD your God, who has delighted in you to set you on the throne of Israel. Because of the LORD’s eternal love for Israel, He has made you king to carry out justice and righteousness.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你的上帝是应当称颂的！他喜悦你，使你坐以色列的国位；因为他永远爱以色列，所以立你作王，使你秉公行义。」

chapters.en: Then she gave the king 120 talents of gold, a great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again were spices in such abundance brought in as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
chapters.zh: 于是，示巴女王将一百二十他连得金子和宝石，与极多的香料，送给所罗门王。她送给王的香料，以后奉来的不再有这样多。

chapters.en: (The fleet of Hiram that brought gold from Ophir also brought from Ophir a great cargo of almug wood and precious stones.
chapters.zh: （希兰的船只从俄斐运了金子来，又从俄斐运了许多檀香木〔注：或译：乌木；下同〕和宝石来。

chapters.en: The king made the almug wood into steps for the house of the LORD and for the king’s palace, and into lyres and harps for the singers. Never before had such almug wood been brought in, nor has such been seen again to this day.)
chapters.zh: 王用檀香木为耶和华殿和王宫做栏杆，又为歌唱的人做琴瑟。以后再没有这样的檀香木进国来，也没有人看见过，直到如今。）

chapters.en: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired—whatever she asked—besides what he had given her out of his royal bounty. Then she left and returned to her own country, along with her servants.
chapters.zh: 示巴女王一切所要所求的，所罗门王都送给她，另外照自己的厚意餽送她。于是女王和她臣仆转回本国去了。

chapters.en: The weight of gold that came to Solomon each year was 666 talents,
chapters.zh: 所罗门每年所得的金子共有六百六十六他连得。

chapters.en: not including the revenue from the merchants, traders, and all the Arabian kings and governors of the land.
chapters.zh: 另外还有商人和杂族〔注：杂族在历代下九章十四节是阿拉伯〕的诸王，与国中的省长〔所进的金子〕。

chapters.en: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred shekels of gold went into each shield.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王用锤出来的金子打成挡牌二百面，每面用金子六百舍客勒；

chapters.en: He also made three hundred small shields of hammered gold; three minas of gold went into each shield. And the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
chapters.zh: 又用锤出来的金子打成盾牌三百面，每面用金子三弥那，都放在黎巴嫩林宫里。

chapters.en: Additionally, the king made a great throne of ivory and overlaid it with pure gold.
chapters.zh: 王用象牙制造一个宝座，用精金包裹。

chapters.en: The throne had six steps, and its back had a rounded top. There were armrests on both sides of the seat, with a lion standing beside each armrest.
chapters.zh: 宝座有六层台阶，座的后背是圆的，两旁有扶手，靠近扶手有两个狮子站立。

chapters.en: Twelve lions stood on the six steps, one at either end of each step. Nothing like this had ever been made for any kingdom.
chapters.zh: 六层台阶上有十二个狮子站立，每层有两个：左边一个，右边一个；在列国中没有这样做的。

chapters.en: All King Solomon’s drinking cups were gold, and all the utensils of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. There was no silver, because it was accounted as nothing in the days of Solomon.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王一切的饮器都是金子的。黎巴嫩林宫里的一切器皿都是精金的。所罗门年间，银子算不了什么。

chapters.en: For the king had the ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s fleet, and once every three years the ships of Tarshish would arrive bearing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
chapters.zh: 因为王有他施船只与希兰的船只一同航海，三年一次，装载金银、象牙、猿猴、孔雀回来。

chapters.en: So King Solomon surpassed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王的财宝与智慧胜过天下的列王。

chapters.en: The whole world sought an audience with Solomon to hear the wisdom that God had put in his heart.
chapters.zh: 普天下的王都求见所罗门，要听上帝赐给他智慧的话。

chapters.en: Year after year, each visitor would bring his tribute: articles of silver and gold, clothing, weapons, spices, horses, and mules.
chapters.zh: 他们各带贡物，就是金器、银器、衣服、军械、香料、骡马，每年有一定之例。

chapters.en: Solomon accumulated 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horses, which he stationed in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 所罗门聚集战车马兵，有战车一千四百辆，马兵一万二千名，安置在屯车的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那里。

chapters.en: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as abundant as sycamore in the foothills.
chapters.zh: 王在耶路撒冷使银子多如石头，香柏木多如高原的桑树。

chapters.en: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and Kue; the royal merchants purchased them from Kue.
chapters.zh: 所罗门的马是从埃及带来的，是王的商人一群一群按着定价买来的。

chapters.en: A chariot could be imported from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty. Likewise, they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Aram.
chapters.zh: 从埃及买来的车，每辆价银六百〔舍客勒〕，马每匹一百五十〔舍客勒〕。赫人诸王和亚兰诸王所买的车马，也是按这价值经他们手买来的。

chapters.en: King Solomon, however, loved many foreign women along with the daughter of Pharaoh—women of Moab, Ammon, Edom, and Sidon, as well as Hittite women.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王在法老的女儿之外，又宠爱许多外邦女子，就是摩押女子、亚扪女子、以东女子、西顿女子、赫人女子。

chapters.en: These women were from the nations about which the LORD had told the Israelites, “You must not intermarry with them, for surely they will turn your hearts after their gods.” Yet Solomon clung to these women in love.
chapters.zh: 论到这些国的人，耶和华曾晓谕以色列人说：「你们不可与她们往来相通，因为她们必诱惑你们的心去随从她们的神。」所罗门却恋爱这些女子。

chapters.en: He had seven hundred wives of royal birth and three hundred concubines—and his wives turned his heart away.
chapters.zh: 所罗门有妃七百，都是公主；还有嫔三百。这些妃嫔诱惑他的心。

chapters.en: For when Solomon grew old, his wives turned his heart after other gods, and he was not wholeheartedly devoted to the LORD his God, as his father David had been.
chapters.zh: 所罗门年老的时候，他的妃嫔诱惑他的心去随从别神，不效法他父亲大卫诚诚实实地顺服耶和华－他的上帝。

chapters.en: Solomon followed Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians and Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
chapters.zh: 因为所罗门随从西顿人的女神亚斯她录和亚扪人可憎的神米勒公。

chapters.en: So Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD; unlike his father David, he did not follow the LORD completely.
chapters.zh: 所罗门行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不效法他父亲大卫专心顺从耶和华。

chapters.en: At that time on a hill east of Jerusalem, Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab and for Molech the abomination of the Ammonites.
chapters.zh: 所罗门为摩押可憎的神基抹和亚扪人可憎的神摩洛，在耶路撒冷对面的山上建筑邱〔坛〕。

chapters.en: He did the same for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.
chapters.zh: 他为那些向自己的神烧香献祭的外邦女子，就是他娶来的妃嫔也是这样行。

chapters.en: Now the LORD grew angry with Solomon, because his heart had turned away from the LORD, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice.
chapters.zh: 耶和华向所罗门发怒，因为他的心偏离向他两次显现的耶和华－以色列的上帝。

chapters.en: Although He had warned Solomon explicitly not to follow other gods, Solomon did not keep the LORD’s command.
chapters.zh: 耶和华曾吩咐他不可随从别神，他却没有遵守耶和华所吩咐的。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Solomon, “Because you have done this and have not kept My covenant and My statutes, which I have commanded you, I will tear the kingdom away from you and give it to your servant.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华对他说：「你既行了这事，不遵守我所吩咐你守的约和律例，我必将你的国夺回，赐给你的臣子。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, for the sake of your father David, I will not do it during your lifetime; I will tear it out of the hand of your son.
chapters.zh: 然而，因你父亲大卫的缘故，我不在你活着的日子行这事，必从你儿子的手中将国夺回。

chapters.en: Yet I will not tear the whole kingdom away from him. I will give one tribe to your son for the sake of My servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem, which I have chosen.”
chapters.zh: 只是我不将全国夺回，要因我仆人大卫和我所选择的耶路撒冷，还留一支派给你的儿子。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD raised up against Solomon an adversary, Hadad the Edomite, from the royal line of Edom.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使以东人哈达兴起，作所罗门的敌人；他是以东王的后裔。

chapters.en: Earlier, when David was in Edom, Joab the commander of the army had gone to bury the dead and had struck down every male in Edom.
chapters.zh: 先前大卫攻击以东，元帅约押上去葬埋阵亡的人，将以东的男丁都杀了。

chapters.en: Joab and all Israel had stayed there six months, until he had killed every male in Edom.
chapters.zh: 约押和以色列众人在以东住了六个月，直到将以东的男丁尽都剪除。

chapters.en: But Hadad, still just a young boy, had fled to Egypt, along with some Edomites who were servants of his father.
chapters.zh: 那时哈达还是幼童；他和他父亲的臣仆，几个以东人逃往埃及。

chapters.en: Hadad and his men set out from Midian and went to Paran. They took men from Paran with them and went to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave Hadad a house and land and provided him with food.
chapters.zh: 他们从米甸起行，到了巴兰；从巴兰带着几个人来到埃及见埃及王法老；法老为他派定粮食，又给他房屋田地。

chapters.en: There Hadad found such great favor in the sight of Pharaoh that he gave to him in marriage the sister of Queen Tahpenes, his own wife.
chapters.zh: 哈达在法老面前大蒙恩惠，以致法老将王后答比匿的妹子赐他为妻。

chapters.en: And the sister of Tahpenes bore Hadad a son named Genubath. Tahpenes herself weaned him in Pharaoh’s palace, and Genubath lived there among the sons of Pharaoh.
chapters.zh: 答比匿的妹子给哈达生了一个儿子，名叫基努拔。答比匿使基努拔在法老的宫里断奶，基努拔就与法老的众子一同住在法老的宫里。

chapters.en: When Hadad heard in Egypt that David had rested with his fathers and that Joab, the commander of the army, was dead, he said to Pharaoh, “Let me go, that I may return to my own country.”
chapters.zh: 哈达在埃及听见大卫与他列祖同睡，元帅约押也死了，就对法老说：「求王容我回本国去。」

chapters.en:
But Pharaoh asked him, “What have you lacked here with me that you suddenly want to go back to your own country?”
“Nothing,” Hadad replied, “but please let me go.”
chapters.zh: 法老对他说：「你在我这里有什么缺乏，你竟要回你本国去呢？」他回答说：「我没有缺乏什么，只是求王容我回去。」

chapters.en: And God raised up against Solomon another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his master, Hadadezer king of Zobah,
chapters.zh: 上帝又使以利亚大的儿子利逊兴起，作所罗门的敌人。他先前逃避主人琐巴王哈大底谢。

chapters.en: and had gathered men to himself. When David killed the Zobaites, Rezon captained a band of raiders and went to Damascus, where they settled and gained control.
chapters.zh: 大卫击杀琐巴人的时候，利逊招聚了一群人，自己作他们的头目，往大马士革居住，在那里作王。

chapters.en: Rezon was Israel’s enemy throughout the days of Solomon, adding to the trouble caused by Hadad. So Rezon ruled over Aram with hostility toward Israel.
chapters.zh: 所罗门活着的时候，哈达为患之外，利逊也作以色列的敌人。他恨恶以色列人，且作了亚兰人的王。

chapters.en: Now Jeroboam son of Nebat was an Ephraimite from Zeredah whose mother was a widow named Zeruah. Jeroboam was a servant of Solomon, but he rebelled against the king,
chapters.zh: 所罗门的臣仆、尼八的儿子耶罗波安也举手攻击王。他是以法莲支派的洗利达人，他母亲是寡妇，名叫洗鲁阿。

chapters.en:
and this is the account of his rebellion against the king.
Solomon had built the supporting terraces and repaired the gap in the wall of the city of his father David.
chapters.zh: 他举手攻击王的缘故，乃由先前所罗门建造米罗，修补他父亲大卫城的破口。

chapters.en: Now Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor. So when Solomon noticed that the young man was industrious, he put him in charge of the whole labor force of the house of Joseph.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安是大有才能的人。所罗门见这少年人殷勤，就派他监管约瑟家的一切工程。

chapters.en: During that time, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite met Jeroboam on the road as he was going out of Jerusalem. Now Ahijah had wrapped himself in a new cloak, and the two of them were alone in the open field.
chapters.zh: 一日，耶罗波安出了耶路撒冷，示罗人先知亚希雅在路上遇见他；〔亚希雅〕身上穿着一件新衣。他们二人在田野，以外并无别人。

chapters.en: And Ahijah took hold of the new cloak he was wearing, tore it into twelve pieces,
chapters.zh: 亚希雅将自己穿的那件新衣撕成十二片，

chapters.en: and said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces for yourself, for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and I will give you ten tribes.
chapters.zh: 对耶罗波安说：「你可以拿十片。耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：『我必将国从所罗门手里夺回，将十个支派赐给你。

chapters.en: But one tribe will remain for the sake of My servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel.
chapters.zh: （我因仆人大卫和我在以色列众支派中所选择的耶路撒冷城的缘故，仍给所罗门留一个支派。）

chapters.en: For they have forsaken Me to worship Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the Ammonites. They have not walked in My ways, nor done what is right in My eyes, nor kept My statutes and judgments, as Solomon’s father David did.
chapters.zh: 因为他离弃我，敬拜西顿人的女神亚斯她录、摩押的神基抹，和亚扪人的神米勒公，没有遵从我的道，行我眼中看为正的事，〔守〕我的律例典章，像他父亲大卫一样。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, I will not take the whole kingdom out of Solomon’s hand, because I have made him ruler all the days of his life for the sake of David My servant, whom I chose because he kept My commandments and statutes.
chapters.zh: 但我不从他手里将全国夺回；使他终身为君，是因我所拣选的仆人大卫谨守我的诫命律例。

chapters.en: But I will take ten tribes of the kingdom from the hand of his son and give them to you.
chapters.zh: 我必从他儿子的手里将国夺回，以十个支派赐给你，

chapters.en: I will give one tribe to his son, so that My servant David will always have a lamp before Me in Jerusalem, the city where I chose to put My Name.
chapters.zh: 还留一个支派给他的儿子，使我仆人大卫在我所选择立我名的耶路撒冷城里，在我面前长有灯光。

chapters.en: But as for you, I will take you, and you shall reign over all that your heart desires, and you will be king over Israel.
chapters.zh: 我必拣选你，使你照心里一切所愿的，作王治理以色列。

chapters.en: If you listen to all that I command you, walk in My ways, and do what is right in My sight in order to keep My statutes and commandments as My servant David did, then I will be with you. I will build you a lasting dynasty just as I built for David, and I will give Israel to you.
chapters.zh: 你若听从我一切所吩咐你的，遵行我的道，行我眼中看为正的事，谨守我的律例诫命，像我仆人大卫所行的，我就与你同在，为你立坚固的家，像我为大卫所立的一样，将以色列人赐给你。

chapters.en: Because of this, I will humble David’s descendants—but not forever.’”
chapters.zh: 我必因所罗门所行的使大卫后裔受患难，但不至于永远。』」

chapters.en: Solomon therefore sought to kill Jeroboam. But Jeroboam arose and fled to Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, where he remained until the death of Solomon.
chapters.zh: 所罗门因此想要杀耶罗波安。耶罗波安却起身逃往埃及；到了埃及王示撒那里，就住在埃及，直到所罗门死了。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Solomon—all that he did, as well as his wisdom—are they not written in the Book of the Acts of Solomon?
chapters.zh: 所罗门其余的事，凡他所行的和他的智慧都写在所罗门记上。

chapters.en: Thus the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
chapters.zh: 所罗门在耶路撒冷作以色列众人的王共四十年。

chapters.en: And Solomon rested with his fathers and was buried in the city of his father David. And his son Rehoboam reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 所罗门与他列祖同睡，葬在他父亲大卫的城里。他儿子罗波安接续他作王。

chapters.en: Then Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had gone there to make him king.
chapters.zh: 罗波安往示剑去；因为以色列人都到了示剑要立他作王。

chapters.en: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard about this, he was still in Egypt where he had fled from King Solomon and had been living ever since.
chapters.zh: 尼八的儿子耶罗波安先前躲避所罗门王，逃往埃及，住在那里（他听见这事。）

chapters.en: So they sent for Jeroboam, and he and the whole assembly of Israel came to Rehoboam and said,
chapters.zh: 以色列人打发人去请他来，他就和以色列会众都来见罗波安，对他说：

chapters.en: “Your father put a heavy yoke on us. But now you must lighten the burden of your father’s service and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you.”
chapters.zh: 「你父亲使我们负重轭，〔做苦工〕，现在求你使我们做的苦工、负的重轭轻松些，我们就事奉你。」

chapters.en: Rehoboam answered, “Go away for three days and then return to me.” So the people departed.
chapters.zh: 罗波安对他们说：「你们暂且去，第三日再来见我。」民就去了。

chapters.en: Then King Rehoboam consulted with the elders who had served his father Solomon during his lifetime. “How do you advise me to respond to these people?” he asked.
chapters.zh: 罗波安之父所罗门在世的日子，有侍立在他面前的老年人，罗波安王和他们商议，说：「你们给我出个什么主意，我好回复这民。」

chapters.en: They replied, “If you will be a servant to these people and serve them this day, and if you will respond by speaking kind words to them, they will be your servants forever.”
chapters.zh: 老年人对他说：「现在王若服事这民如仆人，用好话回答他们，他们就永远作王的仆人。」

chapters.en: But Rehoboam rejected the advice of the elders; instead, he consulted the young men who had grown up with him and served him.
chapters.zh: 王却不用老年人给他出的主意，就和那些与他一同长大、在他面前侍立的少年人商议，

chapters.en: He asked them, “What message do you advise that we send back to these people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Lighten the yoke your father put on us’?”
chapters.zh: 说：「这民对我说：『你父亲使我们负重轭，求你使我们轻松些。』你们给我出个什么主意，我好回复他们。」

chapters.en: The young men who had grown up with him replied, “This is how you should answer these people who said to you, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but you must make it lighter.’ This is what you should tell them: ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist!
chapters.zh: 那同他长大的少年人说：「这民对王说：『你父亲使我们负重轭，求你使我们轻松些。』王要对他们如此说：『我的小拇指头比我父亲的腰还粗。

chapters.en: Whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.’”
chapters.zh: 我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭！我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蠍子〔鞭〕责打你们！』」

chapters.en: After three days, Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam, since the king had said, “Come back to me on the third day.”
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安和众百姓遵着罗波安王所说「你们第三日再来见我」的那话，第三日他们果然来了。

chapters.en: And the king answered the people harshly. He rejected the advice of the elders
chapters.zh: 王用严厉的话回答百姓，不用老年人给他所出的主意，

chapters.en: and spoke to them as the young men had advised, saying, “Whereas my father made your yoke heavy, I will add to your yoke. Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.”
chapters.zh: 照着少年人所出的主意对民说：「我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭！我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蠍子〔鞭〕责打你们！」

chapters.en: So the king did not listen to the people, and indeed this turn of events was from the LORD, to fulfill the word He had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through Ahijah the Shilonite.
chapters.zh: 王不肯依从百姓，这事乃出于耶和华，为要应验他藉示罗人亚希雅对尼八的儿子耶罗波安所说的话。

chapters.en:
When all Israel saw that the king had refused to listen to them, they answered the king:
“What portion do we have in David, and what inheritance in the son of Jesse? To your tents, O Israel! Look now to your own house, O David!”
So the Israelites went home,
chapters.zh: 以色列众民见王不依从他们，就对王说： 我们与大卫有什么分儿呢？ 与耶西的儿子并没有关涉。 以色列人哪，各回各家去吧！ 大卫家啊，自己顾自己吧！ 于是，以色列人都回自己家里去了，

chapters.en: but Rehoboam still reigned over the Israelites living in the cities of Judah.
chapters.zh: 惟独住犹大城邑的以色列人，罗波安仍作他们的王。

chapters.en: Then King Rehoboam sent out Adoram, who was in charge of the forced labor, but all Israel stoned him to death. And King Rehoboam mounted his chariot in haste and escaped to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 罗波安王差遣掌管服苦之人的亚多兰往以色列人那里去，以色列人就用石头打死他。罗波安王急忙上车，逃回耶路撒冷去了。

chapters.en: So to this day Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David.
chapters.zh: 这样，以色列人背叛大卫家，直到今日。

chapters.en: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they summoned him to the assembly and made him king over all Israel. Only the tribe of Judah followed the house of David.
chapters.zh: 以色列众人听见耶罗波安回来了，就打发人去请他到会众面前，立他作以色列众人的王。除了犹大支派以外，没有顺从大卫家的。

chapters.en: And when Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mobilized the whole house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin—180,000 chosen warriors—to fight against the house of Israel and restore the kingdom to Rehoboam son of Solomon.
chapters.zh: 罗波安来到耶路撒冷，招聚犹大全家和便雅悯支派的人共十八万，都是挑选的战士，要与以色列家争战，好将国夺回，再归所罗门的儿子罗波安。

chapters.en: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God:
chapters.zh: 但上帝的话临到神人示玛雅，说：

chapters.en: “Tell Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah, all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and the rest of the people
chapters.zh: 「你去告诉所罗门的儿子犹大王罗波安和犹大、便雅悯全家，并其余的民说：

chapters.en:
that this is what the LORD says: ‘You are not to go up and fight against your brothers, the Israelites. Each of you must return home, for this is My doing.’”
So they listened to the word of the LORD and turned back according to the word of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 『耶和华如此说：你们不可上去与你们的弟兄以色列人争战。各归各家去吧！因为这事出于我。』」众人就听从耶和华的话，遵着耶和华的命回去了。

chapters.en: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim and lived there. And from there he went out and built Penuel.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安在以法莲山地建筑示剑，就住在其中；又从示剑出去，建筑毗努伊勒。

chapters.en: Jeroboam said in his heart, “Now the kingdom might revert to the house of David.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安心里说：「恐怕这国仍归大卫家；

chapters.en: If these people go up to offer sacrifices in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, their hearts will return to their lord, Rehoboam king of Judah; then they will kill me and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.”
chapters.zh: 这民若上耶路撒冷去，在耶和华的殿里献祭，他们的心必归向他们的主－犹大王罗波安，就把我杀了，仍归犹大王罗波安。」

chapters.en: After seeking advice, the king made two golden calves and said to the people, “Going up to Jerusalem is too much for you. Here, O Israel, are your gods, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.”
chapters.zh: 〔耶罗波安〕王就筹划定妥，铸造了两个金牛犊，对众民说：「以色列人哪，你们上耶路撒冷去实在是难；这就是领你们出埃及地的神。」

chapters.en: One calf he set up in Bethel, and the other in Dan.
chapters.zh: 他就把牛犊一只安在伯特利，一只安在但。

chapters.en: And this thing became a sin; the people walked as far as Dan to worship before one of the calves.
chapters.zh: 这事叫百姓陷在罪里，因为他们往但去〔拜那牛犊〕。

chapters.en: Jeroboam also built shrines on the high places and appointed from every class of people priests who were not Levites.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安在邱坛那里建殿，将那不属利未人的凡民立为祭司。

chapters.en: And Jeroboam ordained a feast on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, like the feast that was in Judah, and he offered sacrifices on the altar; he made this offering in Bethel to sacrifice to the calves he had set up, and he installed priests in Bethel for the high places he had set up.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安定八月十五日为节期，像在犹大的节期一样，自己上坛〔献祭〕。他在伯特利也这样向他所铸的牛犊献祭，又将立为邱坛的祭司安置在伯特利。

chapters.en: On the fifteenth day of the eighth month, a month of his own choosing, Jeroboam offered sacrifices on the altar he had set up in Bethel. So he ordained a feast for the Israelites, offered sacrifices on the altar, and burned incense.
chapters.zh: 他在八月十五日，就是他私自所定的月日，为以色列人立作节期的日子，在伯特利上坛烧香。

chapters.en: Suddenly, as Jeroboam was standing beside the altar to burn incense, there came a man of God from Judah to Bethel by the word of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 那时，有一个神人奉耶和华的命从犹大来到伯特利。耶罗波安正站在坛旁要烧香；

chapters.en: And he cried out against the altar by the word of the LORD, “O altar, O altar, this is what the LORD says: ‘A son named Josiah will be born to the house of David, and upon you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense upon you, and human bones will be burned upon you.’”
chapters.zh: 神人奉耶和华的命向坛呼叫，说：「坛哪，坛哪！耶和华如此说：大卫家里必生一个儿子，名叫约西亚，他必将邱坛的祭司，就是在你上面烧香的，杀在你上面，人的骨头也必烧在你上面。」

chapters.en: That day the man of God gave a sign, saying, “The LORD has spoken this sign: ‘Surely the altar will be split apart, and the ashes upon it will be poured out.’”
chapters.zh: 当日，神人设个预兆，说：「这坛必破裂，坛上的灰必倾撒，这是耶和华说的预兆。」

chapters.en: Now when King Jeroboam, who was at the altar in Bethel, heard the word that the man of God had cried out against it, he stretched out his hand and said, “Seize him!” But the hand he stretched out toward him withered, so that he could not pull it back.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安王听见神人向伯特利的坛所呼叫的话，就从坛上伸手，说：「拿住他吧！」王向神人所伸的手就枯干了，不能弯回；

chapters.en: And the altar was split apart, and the ashes poured out, according to the sign that the man of God had given by the word of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 坛也破裂了，坛上的灰倾撒了，正如神人奉耶和华的命所设的预兆。

chapters.en:
Then the king responded to the man of God, “Intercede with the LORD your God and pray for me that my hand may be restored.”
So the man of God interceded with the LORD, and the king’s hand was restored to him as it was before.
chapters.zh: 王对神人说：「请你为我祷告，求耶和华－你上帝的恩典使我的手复原。」于是神人祈祷耶和华，王的手就复了原，仍如寻常一样。

chapters.en: Then the king said to the man of God, “Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward.”
chapters.zh: 王对神人说：「请你同我回去〔吃饭〕，加添心力，我也必给你赏赐。」

chapters.en: But the man of God replied, “If you were to give me half your possessions, I still would not go with you, nor would I eat bread or drink water in this place.
chapters.zh: 神人对王说：「你就是把你的宫一半给我，我也不同你进去，也不在这地方吃饭喝水；

chapters.en: For this is what I was commanded by the word of the LORD: ‘You must not eat bread or drink water or return by the way you came.’”
chapters.zh: 因为有耶和华的话嘱咐我，说不可在伯特利吃饭喝水，也不可从你去的原路回来。」

chapters.en: So the man of God went another way and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel.
chapters.zh: 于是神人从别的路回去，不从伯特利来的原路回去。

chapters.en: Now a certain old prophet was living in Bethel, and his sons came and told him all the deeds that the man of God had done that day in Bethel. They also told their father the words that the man had spoken to the king.
chapters.zh: 有一个老先知住在伯特利，他儿子们来，将神人当日在伯特利所行的一切事和向王所说的话都告诉了父亲。

chapters.en:
“Which way did he go?” their father asked.
And his sons showed him the way taken by the man of God, who had come from Judah.
chapters.zh: 父亲问他们说：「神人从哪条路去了呢？」儿子们〔就告诉他〕；原来他们看见那从犹大来的神人所去的路。

chapters.en:
So the prophet said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.”
Then they saddled the donkey for him, and he mounted it
chapters.zh: 老先知就吩咐他儿子们说：「你们为我备驴。」他们备好了驴，他就骑上，

chapters.en:
and went after the man of God. He found him sitting under an oak tree and asked, “Are you the man of God who came from Judah?”
“I am,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 去追赶神人，遇见他坐在橡树底下，就问他说：「你是从犹大来的神人不是？」他说：「是。」

chapters.en: So the prophet said to the man of God, “Come home with me and eat some bread.”
chapters.zh: 老先知对他说：「请你同我回家吃饭。」

chapters.en: But the man replied, “I cannot go home with you, and I will not eat bread or drink water with you in this place.
chapters.zh: 神人说：「我不可同你回去进你的家，也不可在这里同你吃饭喝水；

chapters.en: For I have been told by the word of the LORD: ‘You must not eat bread or drink water there or return by the way you came.’”
chapters.zh: 因为有耶和华的话嘱咐我说：『你在那里不可吃饭喝水，也不可从你去的原路回来。』」

chapters.en:
Then the prophet replied, “I too am a prophet like you, and an angel spoke to me by the word of the LORD, saying, ‘Bring him back with you to your house, so that he may eat bread and drink water.’”
The old prophet was lying to him,
chapters.zh: 老先知对他说：「我也是先知，和你一样。有天使奉耶和华的命对我说：『你去把他带回你的家，叫他吃饭喝水。』」这都是老先知诓哄他。

chapters.en: but the man of God went back with him, ate bread in his house, and drank water.
chapters.zh: 于是神人同老先知回去，在他家里吃饭喝水。

chapters.en: While they were sitting at the table, the word of the LORD came to the prophet who had brought him back,
chapters.zh: 二人坐席的时候，耶和华的话临到那带神人回来的先知，

chapters.en: and the prophet cried out to the man of God who had come from Judah, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Because you have defied the word of the LORD and have not kept the commandment that the LORD your God gave you,
chapters.zh: 他就对那从犹大来的神人说：「耶和华如此说：你既违背耶和华的话，不遵守耶和华－你上帝的命令，

chapters.en: but you went back and ate bread and drank water in the place where He told you not to do so, your body shall never reach the tomb of your fathers.’”
chapters.zh: 反倒回来，在耶和华禁止你吃饭喝水的地方吃了喝了，因此你的尸身不得入你列祖的坟墓。」

chapters.en: And after the man of God had finished eating and drinking, the old prophet who had brought him back saddled the donkey for him.
chapters.zh: 吃喝完了，老先知为所带回来的先知备驴。

chapters.en: As he went on his way, a lion met him on the road and killed him, and his body was left lying in the road, with the donkey and the lion standing beside it.
chapters.zh: 他就去了，在路上有个狮子遇见他，将他咬死，尸身倒在路上，驴站在尸身旁边，狮子也站在尸身旁边。

chapters.en: And there were men passing by who saw the body lying in the road with the lion standing beside it, and they went and reported this in the city where the old prophet lived.
chapters.zh: 有人从那里经过，看见尸身倒在路上，狮子站在尸身旁边，就来到老先知所住的城里述说这事。

chapters.en: When the prophet who had brought him back from his journey heard this, he said, “It is the man of God who disobeyed the command of the LORD. Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion, and it has mauled him and killed him, according to the word that the LORD had spoken to him.”
chapters.zh: 那带神人回来的先知听见这事，就说：「这是那违背了耶和华命令的神人，所以耶和华把他交给狮子；狮子抓伤他，咬死他，是应验耶和华对他说的话。」

chapters.en: Then the old prophet instructed his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled it,
chapters.zh: 老先知就吩咐他儿子们说：「你们为我备驴。」他们就备了驴。

chapters.en: and he went and found the body lying in the road, with the donkey and the lion standing beside it. The lion had not eaten the body or mauled the donkey.
chapters.zh: 他去了，看见神人的尸身倒在路上，驴和狮子站在尸身旁边，狮子却没有吃尸身，也没有抓伤驴。

chapters.en: So the old prophet lifted up the body of the man of God, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back to his own city to mourn for him and bury him.
chapters.zh: 老先知就把神人的尸身驮在驴上，带回自己的城里，要哀哭他，葬埋他；

chapters.en: Then he laid the body in his own tomb, and they lamented over him, “Oh, my brother!”
chapters.zh: 就把他的尸身葬在自己的坟墓里，哀哭他，〔说〕：「哀哉！我兄啊。」

chapters.en: After he had buried him, the prophet said to his sons, “When I die, you must bury me in the tomb where the man of God is buried. Lay my bones beside his bones,
chapters.zh: 安葬之后，老先知对他儿子们说：「我死了，你们要葬我在神人的坟墓里，使我的尸骨靠近他的尸骨，

chapters.en: for the message that he cried out by the word of the LORD against the altar in Bethel and against all the shrines on the high places in the cities of Samaria will surely come to pass.”
chapters.zh: 因为他奉耶和华的命指着伯特利的坛和撒马利亚各城有邱坛之殿所说的话必定应验。」

chapters.en: Even after these events, Jeroboam did not repent of his evil ways, but again he appointed priests for the high places from every class of people. He ordained anyone who desired to be a priest of the high places.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，耶罗波安仍不离开他的恶道，将凡民立为邱坛的祭司；凡愿意的，他都分别为圣，立为邱坛的祭司。

chapters.en: And this was the sin of the house of Jeroboam that led to its extermination and destruction from the face of the earth.
chapters.zh: 这事叫耶罗波安的家陷在罪里，甚至他的家从地上除灭了。

chapters.en: At that time Abijah son of Jeroboam became ill,
chapters.zh: 那时，耶罗波安的儿子亚比雅病了。

chapters.en: and Jeroboam said to his wife, “Now get up, disguise yourself so they will not recognize you as my wife, and go to Shiloh. For Ahijah the prophet is there; it was he who spoke about my kingship over this people.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安对他的妻说：「你可以起来改装，使人不知道你是耶罗波安的妻，往示罗去，在那里有先知亚希雅。他曾告诉我说，你必作这民的王。

chapters.en: Take with you ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will become of the boy.”
chapters.zh: 现在你要带十个饼，与几个薄饼，和一瓶蜜去见他，他必告诉你儿子将要怎样。」

chapters.en: Jeroboam’s wife did as instructed; she arose and went to Shiloh and arrived at Ahijah’s house. Now Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were dim because of his age.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安的妻就这样行，起身往示罗去，到了亚希雅的家。亚希雅因年纪老迈，眼目发直，不能看见。

chapters.en: But the LORD had said to Ahijah, “Behold, the wife of Jeroboam is coming to ask you about her son, for he is ill. You are to say such and such to her, because when she arrives, she will be disguised.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华先晓谕亚希雅说：「耶罗波安的妻要来问你，因她儿子病了，你当如此如此告诉她。她进来的时候必装作别的妇人。」

chapters.en: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet entering the door, he said, “Come in, wife of Jeroboam! Why are you disguised? For I have been sent to you with bad news.
chapters.zh: 她刚进门，亚希雅听见她脚步的响声，就说：「耶罗波安的妻，进来吧！你为何装作别的妇人呢？我奉差遣将凶事告诉你。

chapters.en: Go, tell Jeroboam that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I raised you up from among the people and appointed you ruler over My people Israel.
chapters.zh: 你回去告诉耶罗波安〔说〕：『耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：我从民中将你高举，立你作我民以色列的君，

chapters.en: I tore the kingdom away from the house of David and gave it to you. But you have not been like My servant David, who kept My commandments and followed Me with all his heart, doing only what was right in My eyes.
chapters.zh: 将国从大卫家夺回赐给你；你却不效法我仆人大卫，遵守我的诫命，一心顺从我，行我眼中看为正的事。

chapters.en: You have done more evil than all who came before you. You have proceeded to make for yourself other gods and molten images to provoke Me, and you have flung Me behind your back.
chapters.zh: 你竟行恶，比那在你以先的更甚，为自己立了别神，铸了偶像，惹我发怒，将我丢在背后。

chapters.en:
Because of all this, behold, I am bringing disaster on the house of Jeroboam:
I will cut off from Jeroboam every male, both slave and free,
in Israel; I will burn up the house of Jeroboam as one burns up dung until it is gone!
chapters.zh: 因此，我必使灾祸临到耶罗波安的家，将属耶罗波安的男丁，无论困住的、自由的都从以色列中剪除，必除尽耶罗波安的家，如人除尽粪土一般。

chapters.en: Anyone belonging to Jeroboam who dies in the city will be eaten by dogs, and anyone who dies in the field will be eaten by the birds of the air.’ For the LORD has spoken.
chapters.zh: 凡属耶罗波安的人，死在城中的必被狗吃，死在田野的必被空中的鸟吃。这是耶和华说的。』

chapters.en: As for you, get up and go home. When your feet enter the city, the child will die.
chapters.zh: 所以你起身回家去吧！你的脚一进城，你儿子就必死了。

chapters.en: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him. For this is the only one belonging to Jeroboam who will receive a proper burial, because only in him has the LORD, the God of Israel, found any good in the house of Jeroboam.
chapters.zh: 以色列众人必为他哀哭，将他葬埋。凡属耶罗波安的人，惟有他得入坟墓；因为在耶罗波安的家中，只有他向耶和华－以色列的上帝显出善行。

chapters.en: Moreover, the LORD will raise up for Himself a king over Israel who will cut off the house of Jeroboam. This is the day—yes, even today!
chapters.zh: 耶和华必另立一王治理以色列。到了日期，他必剪除耶罗波安的家；那日期已经到了。

chapters.en: For the LORD will strike Israel as a reed is shaken in the water. He will uproot Israel from this good land that He gave their fathers, and He will scatter them beyond the Euphrates, because they have made their Asherah poles, provoking the LORD to anger.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必击打以色列人，使他们摇动，像水中的芦苇一般；又将他们从耶和华赐给他们列祖的美地上拔出来，分散在大河那边；因为他们做木偶，惹耶和华发怒。

chapters.en: So He will give Israel over on account of the sins Jeroboam has committed and has caused Israel to commit.”
chapters.zh: 因耶罗波安所犯的罪，又使以色列人陷在罪里，耶和华必将以色列人交给〔仇敌〕。」

chapters.en: Then Jeroboam’s wife got up and departed for Tirzah, and as soon as she stepped over the threshold of the house, the boy died.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安的妻起身回去，到了得撒，刚到门槛，儿子就死了。

chapters.en: And they buried him, and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word that the LORD had spoken through His servant Ahijah the prophet.
chapters.zh: 以色列众人将他葬埋，为他哀哭，正如耶和华藉他仆人先知亚希雅所说的话。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he waged war and how he reigned, they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安其余的事，他怎样争战，怎样作王，都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: And the length of Jeroboam’s reign was twenty-two years, and he rested with his fathers, and his son Nadab reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安作王二十二年，就与他列祖同睡。他儿子拿答接续他作王。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Rehoboam son of Solomon reigned in Judah. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the LORD had chosen from all the tribes of Israel in which to put His Name. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonite.
chapters.zh: 所罗门的儿子罗波安作犹大王。他登基的时候年四十一岁，在耶路撒冷，就是耶和华从以色列众支派中所选择立他名的城，作王十七年。罗波安的母亲名叫拿玛，是亚扪人。

chapters.en: And Judah did evil in the sight of the LORD, and by the sins they committed they provoked Him to jealous anger more than all their fathers had done.
chapters.zh: 犹大人行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，犯罪触动他的愤恨，比他们列祖更甚。

chapters.en: They also built for themselves high places, sacred pillars, and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.
chapters.zh: 因为他们在各高冈上，各青翠树下筑坛，立柱像和木偶。

chapters.en: There were even male shrine prostitutes in the land. They imitated all the abominations of the nations the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 国中也有娈童。犹大人效法耶和华在以色列人面前所赶出的外邦人，行一切可憎恶的事。

chapters.en: In the fifth year of Rehoboam’s reign, Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 罗波安王第五年，埃及王示撒上来攻取耶路撒冷，

chapters.en: He seized the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the royal palace. He took everything, including all the gold shields that Solomon had made.
chapters.zh: 夺了耶和华殿和王宫里的宝物，尽都带走，又夺去所罗门制造的金盾牌。

chapters.en: Then King Rehoboam made bronze shields in their place and committed them to the care of the captains of the guard on duty at the entrance to the royal palace.
chapters.zh: 罗波安王制造铜盾牌代替那金盾牌，交给守王宫门的护卫长看守。

chapters.en: And whenever the king entered the house of the LORD, the guards would bear the shields, and later they would return them to the guardroom.
chapters.zh: 王每逢进耶和华的殿，护卫兵就拿这盾牌，随后仍将盾牌送回，放在护卫房。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, along with all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 罗波安其余的事，凡他所行的，都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam throughout their days.
chapters.zh: 罗波安与耶罗波安时常争战。

chapters.en: And Rehoboam rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David; his mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonite. And his son Abijam reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 罗波安与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他母亲名叫拿玛，是亚扪人。他儿子亚比央〔注：又名亚比雅〕接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam son of Nebat, Abijam became king of Judah,
chapters.zh: 尼八的儿子耶罗波安王十八年，亚比央登基作犹大王，

chapters.en: and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother’s name was Maacah daughter of Abishalom.
chapters.zh: 在耶路撒冷作王三年。他母亲名叫玛迦，是押沙龙的女儿。

chapters.en: And Abijam walked in all the sins that his father before him had committed, and his heart was not as fully devoted to the LORD his God as the heart of David his forefather had been.
chapters.zh: 亚比央行他父亲在他以前所行的一切恶，他的心不像他祖大卫的心，诚诚实实地顺服耶和华－他的上帝。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, for the sake of David, the LORD his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem by raising up a son to succeed him and to make Jerusalem strong.
chapters.zh: 然而耶和华－他的上帝因大卫的缘故，仍使他在耶路撒冷有灯光，叫他儿子接续他作王，坚立耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: For David had done what was right in the eyes of the LORD and had not turned aside from anything the LORD commanded all the days of his life, except in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
chapters.zh: 因为大卫除了赫人乌利亚那件事，都是行耶和华眼中看为正的事，一生没有违背耶和华一切所吩咐的。

chapters.en: And there was war between the houses of Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of Abijam’s life.
chapters.zh: 罗波安在世的日子常与耶罗波安争战。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Abijam, along with all his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
chapters.zh: 亚比央其余的事，凡他所行的，都写在犹大列王记上。亚比央常与耶罗波安争战。

chapters.en: And Abijam rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David, and his son Asa reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 亚比央与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫的城里。他儿子亚撒接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam’s reign over Israel, Asa became king of Judah,
chapters.zh: 以色列王耶罗波安二十年，亚撒登基作犹大王，

chapters.en: and he reigned in Jerusalem forty-one years. His grandmother’s name was Maacah daughter of Abishalom.
chapters.zh: 在耶路撒冷作王四十一年。他祖母名叫玛迦，是押沙龙的女儿。

chapters.en: And Asa did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, as his father David had done.
chapters.zh: 亚撒效法他祖大卫行耶和华眼中看为正的事，

chapters.en: He banished the male shrine prostitutes from the land and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
chapters.zh: 从国中除去娈童，又除掉他列祖所造的一切偶像；

chapters.en: He also removed his grandmother Maacah from her position as queen mother because she had made a detestable Asherah pole. Asa chopped down the pole and burned it in the Kidron Valley.
chapters.zh: 并且贬了他祖母玛迦太后的位，因她造了可憎的偶像亚舍拉。亚撒砍下她的偶像，烧在汲沦溪边，

chapters.en: The high places were not removed, but Asa’s heart was fully devoted to the LORD all his days.
chapters.zh: 只是邱坛还没有废去。亚撒一生却向耶和华存诚实的心。

chapters.en: And he brought into the house of the LORD the silver and gold and the articles that he and his father had dedicated.
chapters.zh: 亚撒将他父亲所分别为圣与自己所分别为圣的金银和器皿都奉到耶和华的殿里。

chapters.en: Now there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel throughout their days.
chapters.zh: 亚撒和以色列王巴沙在世的日子常常争战。

chapters.en: Baasha king of Israel went to war against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah.
chapters.zh: 以色列王巴沙上来要攻击犹大，修筑拉玛，不许人从犹大王亚撒那里出入。

chapters.en: So Asa withdrew all the silver and gold that remained in the treasuries of the house of the LORD and the royal palace. He entrusted it to his servants and sent them with this message to Ben-hadad son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, the king of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus:
chapters.zh: 于是亚撒将耶和华殿和王宫府库里所剩下的金银都交在他臣仆手中，打发他们往住大马士革的亚兰王－希旬的孙子、他伯利们的儿子便‧哈达那里去，

chapters.en: “Let there be a treaty between me and you as there was between my father and your father. See, I have sent you a gift of silver and gold. Now go and break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, so that he will withdraw from me.”
chapters.zh: 说：「你父曾与我父立约，我与你也要立约。现在我将金银送你为礼物，求你废掉你与以色列王巴沙所立的约，使他离开我。」

chapters.en: And Ben-hadad listened to King Asa and sent the commanders of his armies against the cities of Israel, conquering Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maacah, and the whole land of Naphtali, including the region of Chinnereth.
chapters.zh: 便‧哈达听从亚撒王的话，派军长去攻击以色列的城邑；他们就攻破以云、但、亚伯‧伯‧玛迦、基尼烈全境、拿弗他利全境。

chapters.en: When Baasha learned of this, he stopped fortifying Ramah and withdrew to Tirzah.
chapters.zh: 巴沙听见，就停工不修筑拉玛了，仍住在得撒。

chapters.en: Then King Asa summoned all the men of Judah, with no exceptions, and they carried away the stones of Ramah and the timbers Baasha had used for building. And with these materials King Asa built up Geba of Benjamin, as well as Mizpah.
chapters.zh: 于是亚撒王宣告犹大众人，不准一个推辞，吩咐他们将巴沙修筑拉玛所用的石头、木头都运去，用以修筑便雅悯的迦巴和米斯巴。

chapters.en: Now the rest of the acts of Asa, along with all his might, all his accomplishments, and the cities he built, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah? In his old age, however, he became diseased in his feet.
chapters.zh: 亚撒其余的事，凡他所行的，并他的勇力与他所建筑的城邑，都写在犹大列王记上。亚撒年老的时候，脚上有病。

chapters.en: And Asa rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the city of his father David, and his son Jehoshaphat reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 亚撒与他列祖同睡，葬在他祖大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子约沙法接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the second year of Asa’s reign over Judah, Nadab son of Jeroboam became king of Israel, and he reigned two years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒第二年，耶罗波安的儿子拿答登基作以色列王共二年，

chapters.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and walked in the way of his father and in his sin, which he had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.zh: 拿答行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，行他父亲所行的，犯他父亲使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。

chapters.en: Then Baasha son of Ahijah of the house of Issachar conspired against Nadab, and Baasha struck him down at Gibbethon of the Philistines while Nadab and all Israel were besieging the city.
chapters.zh: 以萨迦人亚希雅的儿子巴沙背叛拿答，在非利士的基比顿杀了他。那时拿答和以色列众人正围困基比顿。

chapters.en: In the third year of Asa’s reign over Judah, Baasha killed Nadab and reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 在犹大王亚撒第三年巴沙杀了他，篡了他的位。

chapters.en: As soon as Baasha became king, he struck down the entire household of Jeroboam. He did not leave to Jeroboam anyone who breathed, but destroyed them all according to the word that the LORD had spoken through His servant Ahijah the Shilonite,
chapters.zh: 巴沙一作王就杀了耶罗波安的全家，凡有气息的没有留下一个，都灭尽了，正应验耶和华藉他仆人示罗人亚希雅所说的话。

chapters.en: because of the sins Jeroboam had committed and had caused Israel to commit, and because he had provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger.
chapters.zh: 这是因为耶罗波安所犯的罪使以色列人陷在罪里，惹动耶和华－以色列上帝的怒气。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Nadab, along with all his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 拿答其余的事，凡他所行的，都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel throughout their days.
chapters.zh: 亚撒和以色列王巴沙在世的日子常常争战。

chapters.en: In the third year of Asa’s reign over Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah became king of all Israel, and he reigned in Tirzah twenty-four years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒第三年，亚希雅的儿子巴沙在得撒登基作以色列众人的王共二十四年。

chapters.en: And Baasha did evil in the sight of the LORD and walked in the way of Jeroboam and in his sin, which he had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，行耶罗波安所行的道，犯他使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Jehu son of Hanani against Baasha, saying:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到哈拿尼的儿子耶户，责备巴沙说：

chapters.en: “Even though I lifted you out of the dust and made you ruler over My people Israel, you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have caused My people Israel to sin and to provoke Me to anger by their sins.
chapters.zh: 「我既从尘埃中提拔你，立你作我民以色列的君，你竟行耶罗波安所行的道，使我民以色列陷在罪里，惹我发怒，

chapters.en: So now I will consume Baasha and his house, and I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat:
chapters.zh: 我必除尽你和你的家，使你的家像尼八的儿子耶罗波安的家一样。

chapters.en: Anyone belonging to Baasha who dies in the city will be eaten by dogs, and anyone who dies in the field will be eaten by the birds of the air.”
chapters.zh: 凡属巴沙的人，死在城中的必被狗吃，死在田野的必被空中的鸟吃。」

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Baasha, along with his accomplishments and might, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 巴沙其余的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力，都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: And Baasha rested with his fathers and was buried in Tirzah, and his son Elah reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 巴沙与他列祖同睡，葬在得撒。他儿子以拉接续他作王。

chapters.en: Moreover, the word of the LORD came through the prophet Jehu son of Hanani against Baasha and his house, because of all the evil he had done in the sight of the LORD, provoking Him to anger with the work of his hands and becoming like the house of Jeroboam, and also because Baasha had struck down the house of Jeroboam.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到哈拿尼的儿子先知耶户，责备巴沙和他的家，因他行耶和华眼中看为恶的一切事，以他手所做的惹耶和华发怒，像耶罗波安的家一样，又因他杀了耶罗波安的全家。

chapters.en: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa’s reign over Judah, Elah son of Baasha became king of Israel, and he reigned in Tirzah two years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒二十六年，巴沙的儿子以拉在得撒登基作以色列王共二年。

chapters.en: However, while Elah was in Tirzah getting drunk in the house of Arza the steward of his household there, Elah’s servant Zimri, the commander of half his chariots, conspired against him.
chapters.zh: 有管理他一半战车的臣子心利背叛他。当他在得撒家宰亚杂家里喝醉的时候，

chapters.en: So in the twenty-seventh year of Asa’s reign over Judah, Zimri went in, struck Elah down, and killed him. And Zimri reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 心利就进去杀了他，篡了他的位。这是犹大王亚撒二十七年的事。

chapters.en: As soon as Zimri began to reign and was seated on the throne, he struck down the entire household of Baasha. He did not leave a single male, whether a kinsman or friend.
chapters.zh: 心利一坐王位就杀了巴沙的全家，连他的亲属、朋友也没有留下一个男丁。

chapters.en: So Zimri destroyed the entire household of Baasha, according to the word that the LORD had spoken against Baasha through Jehu the prophet.
chapters.zh: 心利这样灭绝巴沙的全家，正如耶和华藉先知耶户责备巴沙的话。

chapters.en: This happened because of all the sins Baasha and his son Elah had committed and had caused Israel to commit, provoking the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger with their worthless idols.
chapters.zh: 这是因巴沙和他儿子以拉的一切罪，就是他们使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，以虚无〔的神〕惹耶和华－以色列上帝的怒气。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Elah, along with all his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 以拉其余的事，凡他所行的，都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa’s reign over Judah, Zimri reigned in Tirzah for seven days. Now the troops were encamped against Gibbethon of the Philistines,
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒二十七年，心利在得撒作王七日。那时民正安营围攻非利士的基比顿。

chapters.en: and the people in the camp heard that Zimri had conspired against the king and struck him down. So there in the camp that very day, all Israel proclaimed Omri, the commander of the army, king over Israel.
chapters.zh: 民在营中听说心利背叛，又杀了王，故此以色列众人当日在营中立元帅暗利作以色列王。

chapters.en: Then Omri and all the Israelites marched up from Gibbethon and besieged Tirzah.
chapters.zh: 暗利率领以色列众人，从基比顿上去，围困得撒。

chapters.en: When Zimri saw that the city was captured, he entered the citadel of the royal palace and burned it down upon himself. So he died
chapters.zh: 心利见城破失，就进了王宫的卫所，放火焚烧宫殿，自焚而死。

chapters.en: because of the sins he had committed, doing evil in the sight of the LORD and following the example of Jeroboam and the sin he had committed and had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.zh: 这是因他犯罪，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，行耶罗波安所行的，犯他使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Zimri and the treason he committed, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 心利其余的事和他背叛的情形都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: At that time the people of Israel were divided: Half of the people supported Tibni son of Ginath as king, and half supported Omri.
chapters.zh: 那时，以色列民分为两半：一半随从基纳的儿子提比尼，要立他作王；一半随从暗利。

chapters.en: But the followers of Omri proved stronger than those of Tibni son of Ginath. So Tibni died and Omri became king.
chapters.zh: 但随从暗利的民胜过随从基纳的儿子提比尼的民。提比尼死了，暗利就作了王。

chapters.en: In the thirty-first year of Asa’s reign over Judah, Omri became king of Israel, and he reigned twelve years, six of them in Tirzah.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒三十一年，暗利登基作以色列王共十二年；在得撒作王六年。

chapters.en: He bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver and built a city there, calling it Samaria after the name of Shemer, who had owned the hill.
chapters.zh: 暗利用二他连得银子向撒玛买了撒马利亚山，在山上造〔城〕，就按着山的原主撒玛的名，给所造的城起名叫撒马利亚。

chapters.en: But Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD and acted more wickedly than all who were before him.
chapters.zh: 暗利行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，比他以前的列王作恶更甚。

chapters.en: For he walked in all the ways of Jeroboam son of Nebat and in his sins, which he caused Israel to commit, provoking the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger with their worthless idols.
chapters.zh: 因他行了尼八的儿子耶罗波安所行的，犯他使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，以虚无〔的神〕惹耶和华－以色列上帝的怒气。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Omri, along with his accomplishments and the might he exercised, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 暗利其余的事和他所显出的勇力都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: And Omri rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria, and his son Ahab reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 暗利与他列祖同睡，葬在撒马利亚。他儿子亚哈接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa’s reign over Judah, Ahab son of Omri became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria twenty-two years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒三十八年，暗利的儿子亚哈登基作了以色列王。暗利的儿子亚哈在撒马利亚作以色列王二十二年。

chapters.en: However, Ahab son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD, more than all who were before him.
chapters.zh: 暗利的儿子亚哈行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，比他以前的列王更甚，

chapters.en: And as if it were not enough for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, he even married Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and he then proceeded to serve and worship Baal.
chapters.zh: 犯了尼八的儿子耶罗波安所犯的罪；他还以为轻，又娶了西顿王谒巴力的女儿耶洗别为妻，去事奉敬拜巴力，

chapters.en: First, Ahab set up an altar for Baal in the temple of Baal that he had built in Samaria.
chapters.zh: 在撒马利亚建造巴力的庙，在庙里为巴力筑坛。

chapters.en: Then he set up an Asherah pole. Thus Ahab did more to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel before him.
chapters.zh: 亚哈又做亚舍拉，他所行的惹耶和华－以色列上帝的怒气，比他以前的以色列诸王更甚。

chapters.en: In Ahab’s days, Hiel the Bethelite rebuilt Jericho. At the cost of Abiram his firstborn he laid its foundation, and at the cost of Segub his youngest he set up its gates, according to the word that the LORD had spoken through Joshua son of Nun.
chapters.zh: 亚哈〔在位〕的时候，有伯特利人希伊勒重修耶利哥〔城〕；立根基的时候，丧了长子亚比兰；安门的时候，丧了幼子西割，正如耶和华藉嫩的儿子约书亚所说的话。

chapters.en: Now Elijah the Tishbite, who was among the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As surely as the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there will be neither dew nor rain in these years except at my word!”
chapters.zh: 基列寄居的提斯比人以利亚对亚哈说：「我指着所事奉永生耶和华－以色列的上帝起誓，这几年我若不祷告，必不降露，不下雨。」

chapters.en: Then a revelation from the LORD came to Elijah:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到以利亚说：

chapters.en: “Leave here, turn eastward, and hide yourself by the Brook of Cherith, east of the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 「你离开这里往东去，藏在约旦河东边的基立溪旁。

chapters.en: And you are to drink from the brook, and I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”
chapters.zh: 你要喝那溪里的水，我已吩咐乌鸦在那里供养你。」

chapters.en: So Elijah did what the LORD had told him, and he went and lived by the Brook of Cherith, east of the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 于是以利亚照着耶和华的话，去住在约旦河东的基立溪旁。

chapters.en: The ravens would bring him bread and meat in the morning and evening, and he would drink from the brook.
chapters.zh: 乌鸦早晚给他叼饼和肉来，他也喝那溪里的水。

chapters.en: Some time later, however, the brook dried up because there had been no rain in the land.
chapters.zh: 过了些日子，溪水就干了，因为雨没有下在地上。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到他说：

chapters.en: “Get up and go to Zarephath of Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to provide for you.”
chapters.zh: 「你起身往西顿的撒勒法〔注：撒勒法与路加福音四章二十六节同〕去，住在那里；我已吩咐那里的一个寡妇供养你。」

chapters.en: So Elijah got up and went to Zarephath. When he arrived at the city gate, there was a widow gathering sticks. Elijah called to her and said, “Please bring me a little water in a cup, so that I may drink.”
chapters.zh: 以利亚就起身往撒勒法去。到了城门，见有一个寡妇在那里捡柴，以利亚呼叫她说：「求你用器皿取点水来给我喝。」

chapters.en: And as she was going to get it, he called to her and said, “Please bring me a piece of bread.”
chapters.zh: 她去取水的时候，以利亚又呼叫她说：「也求你拿点饼来给我！」

chapters.en: But she replied, “As surely as the LORD your God lives, I have no bread—only a handful of flour in a jar and a little oil in a jug. Look, I am gathering a couple of sticks to take home and prepare a meal for myself and my son, so that we may eat it and die.”
chapters.zh: 她说：「我指着永生耶和华－你的上帝起誓，我没有饼，坛内只有一把面，瓶里只有一点油；我现在找两根柴，回家要为我和我儿子做〔饼〕；我们吃了，死就死吧！」

chapters.en: “Do not be afraid,” Elijah said to her. “Go and do as you have said. But first make me a small cake of bread from what you have, and bring it out to me. Afterward, make some for yourself and your son,
chapters.zh: 以利亚对她说：「不要惧怕！可以照你所说的去做吧！只要先为我做一个小饼拿来给我，然后为你和你的儿子做饼。

chapters.en: for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘The jar of flour will not be exhausted and the jug of oil will not run dry until the day the LORD sends rain upon the face of the earth.’”
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：坛内的面必不减少，瓶里的油必不缺短，直到耶和华使雨降在地上的日子。」

chapters.en: So she went and did according to the word of Elijah, and there was food every day for Elijah and the woman and her household.
chapters.zh: 妇人就照以利亚的话去行。她和她家中的人，并以利亚，吃了许多日子。

chapters.en: The jar of flour was not exhausted and the jug of oil did not run dry, according to the word that the LORD had spoken through Elijah.
chapters.zh: 坛内的面果不减少，瓶里的油也不缺短，正如耶和华借以利亚所说的话。

chapters.en: Later, the son of the woman who owned the house became ill, and his sickness grew worse and worse, until no breath remained in him.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，作那家主母的妇人，她儿子病了；病得甚重，以致身无气息。

chapters.en: “O man of God,” said the woman to Elijah, “what have you done to me? Have you come to remind me of my iniquity and cause the death of my son?”
chapters.zh: 妇人对以利亚说：「神人哪，我与你何干？你竟到我这里来，使〔上帝〕想念我的罪，以致我的儿子死呢？」

chapters.en:
But Elijah said to her, “Give me your son.”
So he took him from her arms, carried him to the upper room where he was staying, and laid him on his own bed.
chapters.zh: 以利亚对她说：「把你儿子交给我。」以利亚就从妇人怀中将孩子接过来，抱到他所住的楼中，放在自己的床上，

chapters.en: Then he cried out to the LORD, “O LORD my God, have You also brought tragedy on this widow who has opened her home to me, by causing her son to die?”
chapters.zh: 就求告耶和华说：「耶和华－我的上帝啊，我寄居在这寡妇的家里，你就降祸与她，使她的儿子死了吗？」

chapters.en: Then he stretched himself out over the child three times and cried out to the LORD, “O LORD my God, please let this boy’s life return to him!”
chapters.zh: 以利亚三次伏在孩子的身上，求告耶和华说：「耶和华－我的上帝啊，求你使这孩子的灵魂仍入他的身体！」

chapters.en: And the LORD listened to the voice of Elijah, and the child’s life returned to him, and he lived.
chapters.zh: 耶和华应允以利亚的话，孩子的灵魂仍入他的身体，他就活了。

chapters.en: Then Elijah took the child, brought him down from the upper room into the house, and gave him to his mother. “Look, your son is alive,” Elijah declared.
chapters.zh: 以利亚将孩子从楼上抱下来，进屋子交给他母亲，说：「看哪，你的儿子活了！」

chapters.en: Then the woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God and that the word of the LORD from your mouth is truth.”
chapters.zh: 妇人对以利亚说：「现在我知道你是神人，耶和华藉你口所说的话是真的。」

chapters.en: After a long time, in the third year of the drought, the word of the LORD came to Elijah: “Go and present yourself to Ahab, and I will send rain upon the face of the earth.”
chapters.zh: 过了许久，到第三年，耶和华的话临到以利亚说：「你去，使亚哈得见你；我要降雨在地上。」

chapters.en: So Elijah went to present himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria,
chapters.zh: 以利亚就去，要使亚哈得见他。那时，撒马利亚有大饥荒；

chapters.en:
and Ahab summoned Obadiah, who was in charge of the palace.
(Now Obadiah greatly feared the LORD,
chapters.zh: 亚哈将他的家宰俄巴底召了来。（俄巴底甚是敬畏耶和华，

chapters.en: for when Jezebel had slaughtered the prophets of the LORD, Obadiah had taken a hundred prophets and hidden them, fifty men per cave, providing them with food and water.)
chapters.zh: 耶洗别杀耶和华众先知的时候，俄巴底将一百个先知藏了，每五十人藏在一个洞里，拿饼和水供养他们。）

chapters.en: Then Ahab said to Obadiah, “Go throughout the land to every spring and every valley. Perhaps we will find grass to keep the horses and mules alive so that we will not have to destroy any livestock.”
chapters.zh: 亚哈对俄巴底说：「我们走遍这地，到一切水泉旁和一切溪边，或者找得着青草，可以救活骡马，免得绝了牲畜。」

chapters.en: So they divided the land to explore. Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went the other way by himself.
chapters.zh: 于是二人分地游行，亚哈独走一路，俄巴底独走一路。

chapters.en: Now as Obadiah went on his way, Elijah suddenly met him. When Obadiah recognized him, he fell facedown and said, “Is it you, my lord Elijah?”
chapters.zh: 俄巴底在路上恰与以利亚相遇，俄巴底认出他来，就俯伏在地，说：「你是我主以利亚不是？」

chapters.en: “It is I,” he answered. “Go tell your master, ‘Elijah is here!’”
chapters.zh: 回答说：「是。你去告诉你主人说，以利亚〔在这里〕。」

chapters.en: But Obadiah replied, “How have I sinned, that you are handing your servant over to Ahab to put me to death?
chapters.zh: 俄巴底说：「仆人有什么罪，你竟要将我交在亚哈手里，使他杀我呢？

chapters.en: As surely as the LORD your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent someone to search for you. When they said, ‘He is not here,’ he made that kingdom or nation swear that they had not found you.
chapters.zh: 我指着永生耶和华－你的上帝起誓，无论哪一邦哪一国，我主都打发人去找你。若说你没有在那里，就必使那邦那国的人起誓说，实在是找不着你。

chapters.en: And now you say, ‘Go tell your master that Elijah is here!’
chapters.zh: 现在你说，要去告诉你主人说，以利亚〔在这里〕；

chapters.en: I do not know where the Spirit of the LORD may carry you off when I leave you. Then when I go and tell Ahab and he does not find you, he will kill me. But I, your servant, have feared the LORD from my youth.
chapters.zh: 恐怕我一离开你，耶和华的灵就提你到我所不知道的地方去。这样，我去告诉亚哈，他若找不着你，就必杀我；仆人却是自幼敬畏耶和华的。

chapters.en: Was it not reported to my lord what I did when Jezebel slaughtered the prophets of the LORD? I hid a hundred prophets of the LORD, fifty men per cave, and I provided them with food and water.
chapters.zh: 耶洗别杀耶和华众先知的时候，我将耶和华的一百个先知藏了，每五十人藏在一个洞里，拿饼和水供养他们，岂没有人将这事告诉我主吗？

chapters.en: And now you say, ‘Go tell your lord that Elijah is here!’ He will kill me!”
chapters.zh: 现在你说，要去告诉你主人说，以利亚〔在这里〕，他必杀我。」

chapters.en: Then Elijah said, “As surely as the LORD of Hosts lives, before whom I stand, I will present myself to Ahab today.”
chapters.zh: 以利亚说：「我指着所事奉永生的万军之耶和华起誓，我今日必使亚哈得见我。」

chapters.en: So Obadiah went to inform Ahab, who went to meet Elijah.
chapters.zh: 于是俄巴底去迎着亚哈，告诉他；亚哈就去迎着以利亚。

chapters.en: When Ahab saw Elijah, he said to him, “Is that you, O troubler of Israel?”
chapters.zh: 亚哈见了以利亚，便说：「使以色列遭灾的就是你吗？」

chapters.en: “I have not troubled Israel,” Elijah replied, “but you and your father’s house have, for you have forsaken the commandments of the LORD and have followed the Baals.
chapters.zh: 以利亚说：「使以色列遭灾的不是我，乃是你和你父家；因为你们离弃耶和华的诫命，去随从巴力。

chapters.en: Now summon all Israel to meet me on Mount Carmel, along with the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of Asherah who eat at Jezebel’s table.”
chapters.zh: 现在你当差遣人，招聚以色列众人和事奉巴力的那四百五十个先知，并耶洗别所供养事奉亚舍拉的那四百个先知，使他们都上迦密山去见我。」

chapters.en: So Ahab summoned all the Israelites and assembled the prophets on Mount Carmel.
chapters.zh: 亚哈就差遣人招聚以色列众人和先知都上迦密山。

chapters.en:
Then Elijah approached all the people and said, “How long will you waver between two opinions? If the LORD is God, follow Him. But if Baal is God, follow him.”
But the people did not answer a word.
chapters.zh: 以利亚前来对众民说：「你们心持两意要到几时呢？若耶和华是上帝，就当顺从耶和华；若巴力是上帝，就当顺从巴力。」众民一言不答。

chapters.en: Then Elijah said to the people, “I am the only remaining prophet of the LORD, but Baal has four hundred and fifty prophets.
chapters.zh: 以利亚对众民说：「作耶和华先知的只剩下我一个人；巴力的先知却有四百五十个人。

chapters.en: Get two bulls for us. Let the prophets of Baal choose one bull for themselves, cut it into pieces, and place it on the wood but not light the fire. And I will prepare the other bull and place it on the wood but not light the fire.
chapters.zh: 当给我们两只牛犊，巴力的先知可以挑选一只，切成块子，放在柴上，不要点火；我也预备一只牛犊放在柴上，也不点火。

chapters.en:
Then you may call on the name of your god, and I will call on the name of the LORD. The God who answers by fire, He is God.”
And all the people answered, “What you say is good.”
chapters.zh: 你们求告你们神的名，我也求告耶和华的名。那降火显应的神，就是上帝。」众民回答说：「这话甚好。」

chapters.en: Then Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Since you are so numerous, choose for yourselves one bull and prepare it first. Then call on the name of your god, but do not light the fire.”
chapters.zh: 以利亚对巴力的先知说：「你们既是人多，当先挑选一只牛犊，预备好了，就求告你们神的名，却不要点火。」

chapters.en:
And they took the bull that was given them, prepared it, and called on the name of Baal from morning until noon, shouting, “O Baal, answer us!”
But there was no sound, and no one answered as they leaped around the altar they had made.
chapters.zh: 他们将所得的牛犊预备好了，从早晨到午间，求告巴力的名说：「巴力啊，求你应允我们！」却没有声音，没有应允的。他们在所筑的坛四围踊跳。

chapters.en: At noon Elijah began to taunt them, saying, “Shout louder, for he is a god! Perhaps he is deep in thought, or occupied, or on a journey. Perhaps he is sleeping and must be awakened!”
chapters.zh: 到了正午，以利亚嬉笑他们，说：「大声求告吧！因为他是神，他或默想，或走到一边，或行路，或睡觉，你们当叫醒他。」

chapters.en: So they shouted louder and cut themselves with knives and lances, as was their custom, until the blood gushed over them.
chapters.zh: 他们大声求告，按着他们的规矩，用刀枪自割、自刺，直到身体流血。

chapters.en: Midday passed, and they kept on raving until the time of the evening sacrifice. But there was no response; no one answered, no one paid attention.
chapters.zh: 从午后直到献晚祭的时候，他们狂呼乱叫，却没有声音，没有应允的，也没有理会的。

chapters.en: Then Elijah said to all the people, “Come near to me.” So all the people approached him, and he repaired the altar of the LORD that had been torn down.
chapters.zh: 以利亚对众民说：「你们到我这里来。」众民就到他那里。他便重修已经毁坏耶和华的坛。

chapters.en: And Elijah took twelve stones, one for each tribe of the sons of Jacob, to whom the word of the LORD had come and said, “Israel shall be your name.”
chapters.zh: 以利亚照雅各子孙支派的数目，取了十二块石头（耶和华的话曾临到雅各说：「你的名要叫以色列」），

chapters.en: And with the stones, Elijah built an altar in the name of the LORD. Then he dug a trench around the altar large enough to hold two seahs of seed.
chapters.zh: 用这些石头为耶和华的名筑一座坛，在坛的四围挖沟，可容谷种二细亚，

chapters.en: Next, he arranged the wood, cut up the bull, placed it on the wood,
chapters.zh: 又在坛上摆好了柴，把牛犊切成块子放在柴上，对众人说：「你们用四个桶盛满水，倒在燔祭和柴上」；

chapters.en:
and said, “Fill four waterpots and pour the water on the offering and on the wood.”
“Do it a second time,” he said, and they did it a second time.
“Do it a third time,” he said, and they did it a third time.
chapters.zh: 又说：「倒第二次。」他们就倒第二次；又说：「倒第三次。」他们就倒第三次。

chapters.en: So the water ran down around the altar and even filled the trench.
chapters.zh: 水流在坛的四围，沟里也满了水。

chapters.en: At the time of the evening sacrifice, Elijah the prophet approached the altar and said, “O LORD, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, let it be known this day that You are God in Israel and that I am Your servant and have done all these things at Your command.
chapters.zh: 到了献〔晚〕祭的时候，先知以利亚近前来，说：「亚伯拉罕、以撒、以色列的上帝，耶和华啊，求你今日使人知道你是以色列的上帝，也知道我是你的仆人，又是奉你的命行这一切事。

chapters.en: Answer me, O LORD! Answer me, so that this people will know that You, the LORD, are God, and that You have turned their hearts back again.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你应允我，应允我！使这民知道你－耶和华是上帝，又知道是你叫这民的心回转。」

chapters.en: Then the fire of the LORD fell and consumed the sacrifice, the wood, the stones, and the dust, and it licked up the water in the trench.
chapters.zh: 于是，耶和华降下火来，烧尽燔祭、木柴、石头、尘土，又烧干沟里的水。

chapters.en: When all the people saw this, they fell facedown and said, “The LORD, He is God! The LORD, He is God!”
chapters.zh: 众民看见了，就俯伏在地，说：「耶和华是上帝！耶和华是上帝！」

chapters.en: Then Elijah ordered them, “Seize the prophets of Baal! Do not let a single one escape.” So they seized them, and Elijah brought them down to the Kishon Valley and slaughtered them there.
chapters.zh: 以利亚对他们说：「拿住巴力的先知，不容一人逃脱！」众人就拿住他们。以利亚带他们到基顺河边，在那里杀了他们。

chapters.en: And Elijah said to Ahab, “Go up, eat and drink, for there is the sound of a heavy rain.”
chapters.zh: 以利亚对亚哈说：「你现在可以上去吃喝，因为有多雨的响声了。」

chapters.en: So Ahab went up to eat and drink. But Elijah climbed to the summit of Carmel, bent down on the ground, and put his face between his knees.
chapters.zh: 亚哈就上去吃喝。以利亚上了迦密山顶，屈身在地，将脸伏在两膝之中；

chapters.en:
“Go and look toward the sea,” he said to his servant.
So the servant went and looked, and he said, “There is nothing there.”
Seven times Elijah said, “Go back.”
chapters.zh: 对仆人说：「你上去，向海观看。」仆人就上去观看，说：「没有什么。」他说：「你再去观看。」如此七次。

chapters.en:
On the seventh time the servant reported, “There is a cloud as small as a man’s hand rising from the sea.”
And Elijah replied, “Go and tell Ahab, ‘Prepare your chariot and go down before the rain stops you.’”
chapters.zh: 第七次仆人说：「我看见有一小片云从海里上来，不过如人手那样大。」以利亚说：「你上去告诉亚哈，当套车下去，免得被雨阻挡。」

chapters.en: Meanwhile, the sky grew dark with clouds and wind, and a heavy rain began to fall. So Ahab rode away and went to Jezreel.
chapters.zh: 霎时间，天因风云黑暗，降下大雨。亚哈就坐车往耶斯列去了。

chapters.en: And the hand of the LORD came upon Elijah, and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran ahead of Ahab all the way to Jezreel.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的灵〔注：原文是手〕降在以利亚身上，他就束上腰，奔在亚哈前头，直到耶斯列的城门。

chapters.en: Now Ahab told Jezebel everything that Elijah had done and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.
chapters.zh: 亚哈将以利亚一切所行的和他用刀杀众先知的事都告诉耶洗别。

chapters.en: So Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, “May the gods deal with me, and ever so severely, if by this time tomorrow I have not made your life like the lives of those you killed!”
chapters.zh: 耶洗别就差遣人去见以利亚，告诉他说：「明日约在这时候，我若不使你的性命像那些人的性命一样，愿神明重重地降罚与我。」

chapters.en: And Elijah was afraid and ran for his life. When he came to Beersheba in Judah, he left his servant there,
chapters.zh: 以利亚见这光景就起来逃命，到了犹大的别是巴，将仆人留在那里，

chapters.en: while he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness. He sat down under a broom tree and prayed that he might die. “I have had enough, LORD,” he said. “Take my life, for I am no better than my fathers.”
chapters.zh: 自己在旷野走了一日的路程，来到一棵罗腾树下〔注：罗腾，小树名，松类；下同〕，就坐在那里求死，说：「耶和华啊，罢了！求你取我的性命，因为我不胜于我的列祖。」

chapters.en:
Then he lay down under the broom tree and fell asleep.
Suddenly an angel touched him and said, “Get up and eat.”
chapters.zh: 他就躺在罗腾树下，睡着了。有一个天使拍他，说：「起来吃吧！」

chapters.en: And he looked around, and there by his head was a cake of bread baked over hot coals, and a jar of water. So he ate and drank and lay down again.
chapters.zh: 他观看，见头旁有一瓶水与炭火烧的饼，他就吃了喝了，仍然躺下。

chapters.en: A second time the angel of the LORD returned and touched him, saying, “Get up and eat, or the journey will be too much for you.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者第二次来拍他，说：「起来吃吧！因为你当走的路甚远。」

chapters.en: So he got up and ate and drank. And strengthened by that food, he walked forty days and forty nights until he reached Horeb, the mountain of God.
chapters.zh: 他就起来吃了喝了，仗着这饮食的力，走了四十昼夜，到了上帝的山，就是何烈山。

chapters.en: There Elijah entered a cave and spent the night. And the word of the LORD came to him, saying, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”
chapters.zh: 他在那里进了一个洞，就住在洞中。耶和华的话临到他说：「以利亚啊，你在这里做什么？」

chapters.en: “I have been very zealous for the LORD, the God of Hosts,” he replied, “but the Israelites have forsaken Your covenant, torn down Your altars, and killed Your prophets with the sword. I am the only one left, and they are seeking my life as well.”
chapters.zh: 他说：「我为耶和华－万军之上帝大发热心；因为以色列人背弃了你的约，毁坏了你的坛，用刀杀了你的先知，只剩下我一个人，他们还要寻索我的命。」

chapters.en:
Then the LORD said, “Go out and stand on the mountain before the LORD. Behold, the LORD is about to pass by.”
And a great and mighty wind tore into the mountains and shattered the rocks before the LORD, but the LORD was not in the wind.
After the wind there was an earthquake, but the LORD was not in the earthquake.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「你出来站在山上，在我面前。」那时耶和华从那里经过，在他面前有烈风大作，崩山碎石，耶和华却不在风中；风后地震，耶和华却不在其中；

chapters.en:
After the earthquake there was a fire, but the LORD was not in the fire.
And after the fire came a still, small voice.
chapters.zh: 地震后有火，耶和华也不在火中；火后有微小的声音。

chapters.en: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his cloak and went out and stood at the mouth of the cave. Suddenly a voice came to him and said, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”
chapters.zh: 以利亚听见，就用外衣蒙上脸，出来站在洞口。有声音向他说：「以利亚啊，你在这里做什么？」

chapters.en: “I have been very zealous for the LORD, the God of Hosts,” he replied, “but the Israelites have forsaken Your covenant, torn down Your altars, and killed Your prophets with the sword. I am the only one left, and they are seeking my life as well.”
chapters.zh: 他说：「我为耶和华－万军之上帝大发热心；因为以色列人背弃了你的约，毁坏了你的坛，用刀杀了你的先知，只剩下我一个人，他们还要寻索我的命。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to him, “Go back by the way you came, and go to the Desert of Damascus. When you arrive, you are to anoint Hazael as king over Aram.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对他说：「你回去，从旷野往大马士革去。到了那里，就要膏哈薛作亚兰王，

chapters.en: You are also to anoint Jehu son of Nimshi as king over Israel and Elisha son of Shaphat from Abel-meholah to succeed you as prophet.
chapters.zh: 又膏宁示的孙子耶户作以色列王，并膏亚伯‧米何拉人沙法的儿子以利沙作先知接续你。

chapters.en: Then Jehu will put to death whoever escapes the sword of Hazael, and Elisha will put to death whoever escapes the sword of Jehu.
chapters.zh: 将来躲避哈薛之刀的，必被耶户所杀；躲避耶户之刀的，必被以利沙所杀。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, I have reserved seven thousand in Israel—all whose knees have not bowed to Baal and whose mouths have not kissed him.”
chapters.zh: 但我在以色列人中〔为自己〕留下七千人，是未曾向巴力屈膝的，未曾与巴力亲嘴的。」

chapters.en: So Elijah departed and found Elisha son of Shaphat. He was plowing with twelve teams of oxen, and he was with the twelfth team. Elijah passed by him and threw his cloak around him.
chapters.zh: 于是，以利亚离开那里走了，遇见沙法的儿子以利沙耕地；在他前头有十二对〔牛〕，自己赶着第十二对。以利亚到他那里去，将自己的外衣搭在他身上。

chapters.en:
So Elisha left the oxen, ran after Elijah, and said, “Please let me kiss my father and mother goodbye, and then I will follow you.”
“Go on back,” Elijah replied, “for what have I done to you?”
chapters.zh: 以利沙就离开牛，跑到以利亚那里，说：「求你容我先与父母亲嘴，然后我便跟随你。」以利亚对他说：「你回去吧，我向你做了什么呢？」

chapters.en: So Elisha turned back from him, took his pair of oxen, and slaughtered them. Using the oxen’s equipment for fuel, he cooked the meat and gave it to the people, and they ate. Then he set out to follow and serve Elijah.
chapters.zh: 以利沙就离开他回去，宰了一对牛，用套牛的器具煮肉给民吃，随后就起身跟随以利亚，服事他。

chapters.en: Now Ben-hadad king of Aram assembled his entire army. Accompanied by thirty-two kings with their horses and chariots, he marched up, besieged Samaria, and waged war against it.
chapters.zh: 亚兰王便‧哈达聚集他的全军，率领三十二个王，带着车马上来围攻撒马利亚；

chapters.en: Then he sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel,
chapters.zh: 又差遣使者进城见以色列王亚哈，对他说：「便‧哈达如此说：

chapters.en: saying, “This is what Ben-hadad says: ‘Your silver and gold are mine, and your best wives and children are mine!’”
chapters.zh: 你的金银都要归我，你妻子儿女中最美的也要归我。」

chapters.en: And the king of Israel replied, “Just as you say, my lord the king: I am yours, along with all that I have.”
chapters.zh: 以色列王回答说：「我主我王啊，可以依着你的话，我与我所有的都归你。」

chapters.en: The messengers came back and said, “This is what Ben-hadad says: ‘I have sent to you to demand your silver, your gold, your wives, and your children.
chapters.zh: 使者又来说：「便‧哈达如此说：我已差遣人去见你，要你将你的金银、妻子、儿女都给我。

chapters.en: But about this time tomorrow I will send my servants to search your palace and the houses of your servants. They will seize and carry away all that is precious to you.’”
chapters.zh: 但明日约在这时候，我还要差遣臣仆到你那里，搜查你的家和你仆人的家，将你眼中一切所喜爱的都拿了去。」

chapters.en: Then the king of Israel summoned all the elders of the land and said, “Please take note and see that this man is looking for trouble, for when he demanded my wives, my children, my silver, and my gold, I did not deny him.”
chapters.zh: 以色列王召了国中的长老来，对他们说：「请你们看看，这人是怎样地谋害〔我〕，他先差遣人到我这里来，要我的妻子、儿女，和金银，我并没有推辞他。」

chapters.en: And the elders and the people all said, “Do not listen to him or consent to his terms.”
chapters.zh: 长老和百姓对王说：「不要听从他，也不要应允他。」

chapters.en:
So Ahab answered the messengers of Ben-hadad, “Tell my lord the king, ‘All that you demanded of your servant the first time I will do, but this thing I cannot do.’”
So the messengers departed and relayed the message to Ben-hadad.
chapters.zh: 故此，以色列王对便‧哈达的使者说：「你们告诉我主我王说：王头一次差遣人向仆人所要的，仆人都依从；但这次所要的，我不能依从。」使者就去回复便‧哈达。

chapters.en: Then Ben-hadad sent another message to Ahab: “May the gods deal with me, and ever so severely, if enough dust remains of Samaria for each of my men to have a handful.”
chapters.zh: 便‧哈达又差遣人去见亚哈说：「撒马利亚的尘土若够跟从我的人每人捧一捧的，愿神明重重地降罚与我！」
