chapters.en: And the king of Israel replied, “Tell him: ‘The one putting on his armor should not boast like one taking it off.’”
chapters.zh: 以色列王说：「你告诉他说，才顶〔盔〕贯〔甲〕的，休要像摘〔盔〕卸〔甲〕的夸口。」

chapters.en: Ben-hadad received this message while he and the kings were drinking in their tents, and he said to his servants, “Take your positions.” So they stationed themselves against the city.
chapters.zh: 便‧哈达和诸王正在帐幕里喝酒，听见这话，就对他臣仆说：「摆队吧！」他们就摆队攻城。

chapters.en: Meanwhile a prophet approached Ahab king of Israel and declared, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Do you see this entire great army? Behold, I will deliver it into your hand this very day, and you will know that I am the LORD.’”
chapters.zh: 有一个先知来见以色列王亚哈，说：「耶和华如此说：『这一大群人你看见了吗？今日我必将他们交在你手里，你就知道我是耶和华。』」

chapters.en:
“By whom?” Ahab asked.
And the prophet replied, “This is what the LORD says: ‘By the young officers of the district governors.’”
“Who will start the battle?” asked Ahab.
“You will,” answered the prophet.
chapters.zh: 亚哈说：「藉着谁呢？」他回答说：「耶和华说，藉着跟从省长的少年人。」亚哈说：「要谁率领呢？」他说：「要你亲自率领。」

chapters.en: So Ahab assembled the young officers of the district governors, and there were 232 men. And after them, he assembled the rest of the Israelite troops, 7,000 in all.
chapters.zh: 于是亚哈数点跟从省长的少年人，共有二百三十二名，后又数点以色列的众兵，共有七千名。

chapters.en: They marched out at noon while Ben-hadad and the 32 kings allied with him were in their tents getting drunk.
chapters.zh: 午间，他们就出城；便‧哈达和帮助他的三十二个王正在帐幕里痛饮。

chapters.en:
And the young officers of the district governors marched out first.
Now Ben-hadad had sent out scouts, who reported to him, “Men are marching out of Samaria.”
chapters.zh: 跟从省长的少年人先出城；便‧哈达差遣人去〔探望〕，他们回报说：「有人从撒马利亚出来了。」

chapters.en: “If they have marched out in peace,” he said, “take them alive. Even if they have marched out for war, take them alive.”
chapters.zh: 他说：「他们若为讲和出来，要活捉他们；若为打仗出来，也要活捉他们。」

chapters.en: Meanwhile, these young officers of the district governors marched out of the city, with the army behind them,
chapters.zh: 跟从省长的少年人出城，军兵跟随他们；

chapters.en: and each one struck down his opponent. So the Arameans fled, with the Israelites in pursuit. But Ben-hadad king of Aram escaped on horseback with the cavalry.
chapters.zh: 各人遇见敌人就杀。亚兰人逃跑，以色列人追赶他们；亚兰王便‧哈达骑着马和马兵一同逃跑。

chapters.en: Then the king of Israel marched out and attacked the horses and chariots, inflicting a great slaughter on the Arameans.
chapters.zh: 以色列王出城攻打车马，大大击杀亚兰人。

chapters.en: Afterward, the prophet approached the king of Israel and said, “Go and strengthen your position, and take note what you must do, for in the spring the king of Aram will come up against you.”
chapters.zh: 那先知来见以色列王，对他说：「你当自强，留心怎样防备；因为到明年这时候，亚兰王必上来攻击你。」

chapters.en: Meanwhile, the servants of the king of Aram said to him, “Their gods are gods of the hills. That is why they prevailed over us. Instead, we should fight them on the plains; surely then we will prevail.
chapters.zh: 亚兰王的臣仆对亚兰王说：「以色列人的神是山神，所以他们胜过我们；但在平原与他们打仗，我们必定得胜。

chapters.en: So do this: Dismiss all the kings from their positions and replace them with other officers.
chapters.zh: 王当这样行：把诸王革去，派军长代替他们，

chapters.en:
And you must raise an army like the one you have lost—horse for horse and chariot for chariot—so we can fight the Israelites on the plain, where we will surely prevail.”
And the king approved their plan and acted accordingly.
chapters.zh: 又照着王丧失军兵之数，再招募一军，马补马，车补车，我们在平原与他们打仗，必定得胜。」王便听臣仆的话去行。

chapters.en: In the spring, Ben-hadad mobilized the Arameans and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.
chapters.zh: 次年，便‧哈达果然点齐亚兰人上亚弗去，要与以色列人打仗。

chapters.en:
The Israelites also mobilized, gathered supplies, and marched out to meet them.
The Israelites camped before them like two small flocks of goats, while the Arameans covered the countryside.
chapters.zh: 以色列人也点齐军兵，预备食物，迎着亚兰人出去，对着他们安营，好像两小群山羊羔；亚兰人却满了地面。

chapters.en: Then the man of God approached the king of Israel and said, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Because the Arameans have said that the LORD is a god of the hills and not of the valleys, I will deliver all this great army into your hand. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’”
chapters.zh: 有神人来见以色列王，说：「耶和华如此说：『亚兰人既说我－耶和华是山神，不是平原的神，所以我必将这一大群人都交在你手中，你们就知道我是耶和华。』」

chapters.en: For seven days the armies camped opposite each other, and on the seventh day the battle ensued, and the Israelites struck down the Arameans—a hundred thousand foot soldiers in one day.
chapters.zh: 以色列人与亚兰人相对安营七日，到第七日两军交战；那一日以色列人杀了亚兰人步兵十万，

chapters.en: The rest of them fled into the city of Aphek, where the wall fell on twenty-seven thousand of the remaining men. Ben-hadad also fled to the city and hid in an inner room.
chapters.zh: 其余的逃入亚弗城；城墙塌倒，压死剩下的二万七千人。 便‧哈达也逃入城，藏在严密的屋子里。

chapters.en: Then the servants of Ben-hadad said to him, “Look now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful. Let us go out to the king of Israel with sackcloth around our waists and ropes around our heads. Perhaps he will spare your life.”
chapters.zh: 他的臣仆对他说：「我们听说以色列王都是仁慈的王，现在我们不如腰束麻布，头套绳索，出去投降以色列王，或者他存留王的性命。」

chapters.en:
So with sackcloth around their waists and ropes around their heads, they went to the king of Israel and said, “Your servant Ben-hadad says, ‘Please spare my life.’”
And the king answered, “Is he still alive? He is my brother.”
chapters.zh: 于是他们腰束麻布，头套绳索，去见以色列王，说：「王的仆人便‧哈达说，求王存留我的性命。」亚哈说：「他还活着吗？他是我的兄弟。」

chapters.en:
Now the men were looking for a sign of hope, and they quickly grasped at this word and replied, “Yes, your brother Ben-hadad.”
“Go and get him!” said the king.
Then Ben-hadad came out, and Ahab had him come up into his chariot.
chapters.zh: 这些人留心探出他的口气来，便急忙就着他的话说：「便‧哈达是王的兄弟！」王说：「你们去请他来。」便‧哈达出来见王，王就请他上车。

chapters.en:
Ben-hadad said to him, “I will restore the cities my father took from your father; you may set up your own marketplaces in Damascus, as my father did in Samaria.”
“By this treaty I release you,” Ahab replied. So he made a treaty with him and sent him away.
chapters.zh: 便‧哈达对王说：「我父从你父那里所夺的城邑，我必归还。你可以在大马士革立街市，像我父在撒马利亚所立的一样。」亚哈说：「我照此立约，放你回去」，就与他立约，放他去了。

chapters.en:
Meanwhile, by the word of the LORD, one of the sons of the prophets said to his companion, “Strike me, please!”
But the man refused to strike him.
chapters.zh: 有先知的一个门徒奉耶和华的命对他的同伴说：「你打我吧！」那人不肯打他。

chapters.en:
Then the prophet said to him, “Because you have not obeyed the voice of the LORD, as soon as you depart from me a lion will kill you.”
And when he left, a lion found him and killed him.
chapters.zh: 他就对那人说：「你既不听从耶和华的话，你一离开我，必有狮子咬死你。」那人一离开他，果然遇见狮子，把他咬死了。

chapters.en:
Then the prophet found another man and said, “Strike me, please!”
So the man struck him and wounded him,
chapters.zh: 先知的门徒又遇见一个人，对他说：「你打我吧！」那人就打他，将他打伤。

chapters.en: and the prophet went and waited on the road for the king, disguising himself with a bandage over his eyes.
chapters.zh: 他就去了，用头巾蒙眼，改换面目，在路旁等候王。

chapters.en: As the king passed by, he cried out to the king: “Your servant had marched out into the middle of the battle, when suddenly a man came over with a captive and told me, ‘Guard this man! If he goes missing for any reason, your life will be exchanged for his life, or you will weigh out a talent of silver. ’
chapters.zh: 王从那里经过，他向王呼叫说：「仆人在阵上的时候，有人带了一个人来，对我说：『你看守这人，若把他失了，你的性命必代替他的性命；不然，你必交出一他连得银子来。』

chapters.en:
But while your servant was busy here and there, the man disappeared.”
And the king of Israel said to him, “So shall your judgment be; you have pronounced it on yourself.”
chapters.zh: 仆人正在忙乱之间，那人就不见了。」以色列王对他说：「你自己定妥了，必照样判断你。」

chapters.en: Then the prophet quickly removed the bandage from his eyes, and the king of Israel recognized him as one of the prophets.
chapters.zh: 他急忙除掉蒙眼的头巾，以色列王就认出他是一个先知。

chapters.en: And the prophet said to the king, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Because you have let slip from your hand the man I had devoted to destruction, your life will be exchanged for his life, and your people for his people.’”
chapters.zh: 他对王说：「耶和华如此说：『因你将我定要灭绝的人放去，你的命就必代替他的命，你的民也必代替他的民。』」

chapters.en: Sullen and angry, the king of Israel went home to Samaria.
chapters.zh: 于是以色列王闷闷不乐地回到撒马利亚，进了他的宫。

chapters.en: Some time after these events, Naboth the Jezreelite owned a vineyard in Jezreel next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，又有一事。耶斯列人拿伯在耶斯列有一个葡萄园，靠近撒马利亚王亚哈的宫。

chapters.en: So Ahab said to Naboth, “Give me your vineyard to use as a vegetable garden, since it is next to my palace. I will give you a better vineyard in its place—or if you prefer, I will give you its value in silver.”
chapters.zh: 亚哈对拿伯说：「你将你的葡萄园给我作菜园，因为是靠近我的宫；我就把更好的葡萄园换给你，或是你要银子，我就按着价值给你。」

chapters.en: But Naboth replied, “The LORD forbid that I should give you the inheritance of my fathers.”
chapters.zh: 拿伯对亚哈说：「我敬畏耶和华，万不敢将我先人留下的产业给你。」

chapters.en: So Ahab went to his palace, sullen and angry because Naboth the Jezreelite had told him, “I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers.” He lay down on his bed, turned his face away, and refused to eat.
chapters.zh: 亚哈因耶斯列人拿伯说「我不敢将我先人留下的产业给你」，就闷闷不乐地回宫，躺在床上，转脸向内，也不吃饭。

chapters.en: Soon his wife Jezebel came in and asked, “Why are you so sullen that you refuse to eat?”
chapters.zh: 王后耶洗别来问他说：「你为什么心里这样忧闷，不吃饭呢？」

chapters.en: Ahab answered, “Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite and told him, ‘Give me your vineyard for silver, or if you wish, I will give you another vineyard in its place.’ And he replied, ‘I will not give you my vineyard!’”
chapters.zh: 他回答说：「因我向耶斯列人拿伯说：『你将你的葡萄园给我，我给你价银，或是你愿意，我就把〔别的〕葡萄园换给你』；他却说：『我不将我的葡萄园给你。』」

chapters.en: But his wife Jezebel said to him, “Do you not reign over Israel? Get up, eat some food, and be cheerful, for I will get you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.”
chapters.zh: 王后耶洗别对亚哈说：「你现在是治理以色列国不是？只管起来，心里畅畅快快地吃饭，我必将耶斯列人拿伯的葡萄园给你。」

chapters.en: Then Jezebel wrote letters in Ahab’s name, sealed them with his seal, and sent them to the elders and nobles who lived with Naboth in his city.
chapters.zh: 于是讬亚哈的名写信，用王的印印上，送给那些与拿伯同城居住的长老贵胄。

chapters.en:
In the letters she wrote:
“Proclaim a fast and give Naboth a seat of honor among the people.
chapters.zh: 信上写着说：「你们当宣告禁食，叫拿伯坐在民间的高位上，

chapters.en: But seat two scoundrels opposite him and have them testify, ‘You have cursed both God and the king!’ Then take him out and stone him to death.”
chapters.zh: 又叫两个匪徒坐在拿伯对面，作见证告他说：『你谤渎上帝和王了』；随后就把他拉出去用石头打死。」

chapters.en: So the elders and nobles who lived in Naboth’s city did as Jezebel had instructed in the letters she had written to them.
chapters.zh: 那些与拿伯同城居住的长老贵胄得了耶洗别的信，就照信而行，

chapters.en: They proclaimed a fast and gave Naboth a seat of honor among the people.
chapters.zh: 宣告禁食，叫拿伯坐在民间的高位上。

chapters.en:
And the two scoundrels came in and sat opposite Naboth, and these men testified against him before the people, saying, “Naboth has cursed both God and the king!”
So they took him outside the city and stoned him to death.
chapters.zh: 有两个匪徒来，坐在拿伯的对面，当着众民作见证告他说：「拿伯谤渎上帝和王了！」众人就把他拉到城外，用石头打死。

chapters.en: Then they sent word to Jezebel: “Naboth has been stoned to death.”
chapters.zh: 于是打发人去见耶洗别，说：「拿伯被石头打死了。」

chapters.en: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned to death, she said to Ahab, “Get up and take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, who refused to give it to you for silver. For Naboth is no longer alive, but dead.”
chapters.zh: 耶洗别听见拿伯被石头打死，就对亚哈说：「你起来得耶斯列人拿伯不肯为价银给你的葡萄园吧！现在他已经死了。」

chapters.en: And when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, he got up and went down to take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.
chapters.zh: 亚哈听见拿伯死了，就起来，下去要得耶斯列人拿伯的葡萄园。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到提斯比人以利亚说：

chapters.en: “Get up and go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who is in Samaria. See, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone to take possession of it.
chapters.zh: 「你起来，去见住撒马利亚的以色列王亚哈，他下去要得拿伯的葡萄园，现今正在那园里。

chapters.en:
Tell him that this is what the LORD says: ‘Have you not murdered a man and seized his land?’
Then tell him that this is also what the LORD says: ‘In the place where the dogs licked up the blood of Naboth, there also the dogs will lick up your blood—yes, yours!’ ”
chapters.zh: 你要对他说：『耶和华如此说：你杀了人，又得他的产业吗？』又要对他说：『耶和华如此说：狗在何处舔拿伯的血，也必在何处舔你的血。』」

chapters.en:
When Elijah arrived, Ahab said to him, “So you have found me out, my enemy.”
He replied, “I have found you out because you have sold yourself to do evil in the sight of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 亚哈对以利亚说：「我仇敌啊，你找到我吗？」他回答说：「我找到你了；因为你卖了自己，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
‘I will bring calamity on you and consume your descendants; I will cut off from Ahab every male in Israel, both slave and free.
chapters.zh: 〔耶和华说〕：『我必使灾祸临到你，将你除尽。凡属你的男丁，无论困住的、自由的，都从以色列中剪除。

chapters.en: I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat and like that of Baasha son of Ahijah, because you have provoked My anger and caused Israel to sin.’
chapters.zh: 我必使你的家像尼八的儿子耶罗波安的家，又像亚希雅的儿子巴沙的家；因为你惹我发怒，又使以色列人陷在罪里。』

chapters.en:
And the LORD also speaks concerning Jezebel:
‘The dogs will devour Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.’
chapters.zh: 论到耶洗别，耶和华也说：『狗在耶斯列的外郭必吃耶洗别的肉。

chapters.en: Anyone belonging to Ahab who dies in the city will be eaten by dogs, and anyone who dies in the field will be eaten by the birds of the air.”
chapters.zh: 凡属亚哈的人，死在城中的必被狗吃，死在田野的必被空中的鸟吃。』」

chapters.en: (Surely there was never one like Ahab, who sold himself to do evil in the sight of the LORD, incited by his wife Jezebel.
chapters.zh: （从来没有像亚哈的，因他自卖，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，受了王后耶洗别的耸动；

chapters.en: He committed the most detestable acts by going after idols, just like the Amorites whom the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.)
chapters.zh: 就照耶和华在以色列人面前所赶出的亚摩利人，行了最可憎恶的事，信从偶像。）

chapters.en: When Ahab heard these words, he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, and fasted. He lay down in sackcloth and walked around meekly.
chapters.zh: 亚哈听见这话，就撕裂衣服，禁食，身穿麻布，睡卧也穿着麻布，并且缓缓而行。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到提斯比人以利亚说：

chapters.en: “Have you seen how Ahab has humbled himself before Me? Because he has humbled himself before Me, I will not bring the calamity during his days, but I will bring it upon his house in the days of his son.”
chapters.zh: 「亚哈在我面前这样自卑，你看见了吗？因他在我面前自卑，他还在世的时候，我不降这祸；到他儿子的时候，我必降这祸与他的家。」

chapters.en: Then three years passed without war between Aram and Israel.
chapters.zh: 亚兰国和以色列国三年没有争战。

chapters.en: However, in the third year, Jehoshaphat king of Judah went down to visit the king of Israel,
chapters.zh: 到第三年，犹大王约沙法下去见以色列王。

chapters.en: who said to his servants, “Do you not know that Ramoth-gilead is ours, but we have failed to take it from the hand of the king of Aram?”
chapters.zh: 以色列王对臣仆说：「你们不知道基列的拉末是属我们的吗？我们岂可静坐不动，不从亚兰王手里夺回来吗？」

chapters.en:
So he asked Jehoshaphat, “Will you go with me to fight against Ramoth-gilead?”
Jehoshaphat answered the king of Israel, “I am as you are, my people are your people, and my horses are your horses.”
chapters.zh: 亚哈问约沙法说：「你肯同我去攻取基列的拉末吗？」约沙法对以色列王说：「你我不分彼此，我的民与你的民一样，我的马与你的马一样。」

chapters.en: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for the word of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 约沙法对以色列王说：「请你先求问耶和华。」

chapters.en:
So the king of Israel assembled the prophets, about four hundred men, and asked them, “Should I go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or should I refrain?”
“Go up,” they replied, “and the Lord will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
chapters.zh: 于是以色列王招聚先知，约有四百人，问他们说：「我上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以？」他们说：「可以上去，因为主必将那城交在王的手里。」

chapters.en: But Jehoshaphat asked, “Is there not still a prophet of the LORD here of whom we can inquire?”
chapters.zh: 约沙法说：「这里不是还有耶和华的先知，我们可以求问他吗？」

chapters.en:
The king of Israel answered, “There is still one man through whom we can inquire of the LORD, but I hate him because he never prophesies anything good for me, but only bad. He is Micaiah son of Imlah.”
“The king should not say that!” Jehoshaphat replied.
chapters.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说：「还有一个人，是音拉的儿子米该雅，我们可以讬他求问耶和华。只是我恨他；因为他指着我所说的预言，不说吉语，单说凶言。」约沙法说：「王不必这样说。」

chapters.en: So the king of Israel called one of his officials and said, “Bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once.”
chapters.zh: 以色列王就召了一个太监来，说：「你快去，将音拉的儿子米该雅召来。」

chapters.en: Dressed in royal attire, the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting on their thrones at the threshing floor by the entrance of the gate of Samaria, with all the prophets prophesying before them.
chapters.zh: 以色列王和犹大王约沙法在撒马利亚城门前的空场上，各穿朝服，坐在位上，所有的先知都在他们面前说预言。

chapters.en: Now Zedekiah son of Chenaanah had made for himself iron horns and declared, “This is what the LORD says: ‘With these you shall gore the Arameans until they are finished off.’”
chapters.zh: 基拿拿的儿子西底家造了两个铁角，说：「耶和华如此说：『你要用这角牴触亚兰人，直到将他们灭尽。』」

chapters.en: And all the prophets were prophesying the same, saying, “Go up to Ramoth-gilead and triumph, for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
chapters.zh: 所有的先知也都这样预言说：「可以上基列的拉末去，必然得胜，因为耶和华必将那城交在王的手中。」

chapters.en: Then the messenger who had gone to call Micaiah instructed him, “Behold now, with one accord the words of the prophets are favorable to the king. So please let your words be like theirs, and speak favorably.”
chapters.zh: 那去召米该雅的使者对米该雅说：「众先知一口同音地都向王说吉言，你不如与他们说一样的话，也说吉言。」

chapters.en: But Micaiah said, “As surely as the LORD lives, I will speak whatever the LORD tells me.”
chapters.zh: 米该雅说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓，耶和华对我说什么，我就说什么。」

chapters.en:
When Micaiah arrived, the king asked him, “Micaiah, should we go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or should we refrain?”
“Go up and triumph,” Micaiah replied, “for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
chapters.zh: 米该雅到王面前，王问他说：「米该雅啊，我们上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以？」他回答说：「可以上去，必然得胜，耶和华必将那城交在王的手中。」

chapters.en: But the king said to him, “How many times must I make you swear not to tell me anything but the truth in the name of the LORD?”
chapters.zh: 王对他说：「我当嘱咐你几次，你才奉耶和华的名向我说实话呢？」

chapters.en:
So Micaiah declared:
“I saw all Israel scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd. And the LORD said, ‘These people have no master; let each one return home in peace.’”
chapters.zh: 米该雅说：「我看见以色列众民散在山上，如同没有牧人的羊群一般。耶和华说：『这民没有主人，他们可以平平安安地各归各家去。』」

chapters.en: Then the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Did I not tell you that he never prophesies good for me, but only bad?”
chapters.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说：「我岂没有告诉你，这人指着我所说的预言，不说吉语单说凶言吗？」

chapters.en: Micaiah continued, “Therefore hear the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on His throne, and all the host of heaven standing by Him on His right and on His left.
chapters.zh: 米该雅说：「你要听耶和华的话！我看见耶和华坐在宝座上，天上的万军侍立在他左右。

chapters.en:
And the LORD said, ‘Who will entice Ahab to march up and fall at Ramoth-gilead?’
And one suggested this, and another that.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：『谁去引诱亚哈上基列的拉末去阵亡呢？』这个就这样说，那个就那样说。

chapters.en:
Then a spirit came forward, stood before the LORD, and said, ‘I will entice him.’
‘By what means?’ asked the LORD.
chapters.zh: 随后有一个神灵出来，站在耶和华面前，说：『我去引诱他。』

chapters.en:
And he replied, ‘I will go out and be a lying spirit in the mouths of all his prophets.’
‘You will surely entice him and prevail,’ said the LORD. ‘Go and do it.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华问他说：『你用何法呢？』他说：『我去，要在他众先知口中作谎言的灵。』耶和华说：『这样，你必能引诱他，你去如此行吧！』

chapters.en: So you see, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouths of all these prophets of yours, and the LORD has pronounced disaster against you.”
chapters.zh: 现在耶和华使谎言的灵入了你这些先知的口，并且耶和华已经命定降祸与你。」

chapters.en: Then Zedekiah son of Chenaanah went up, struck Micaiah in the face, and demanded, “Which way did the Spirit of the LORD go when He departed from me to speak with you?”
chapters.zh: 基拿拿的儿子西底家前来，打米该雅的脸，说：「耶和华的灵从哪里离开我与你说话呢？」

chapters.en: Micaiah replied, “You will soon see, on that day when you go and hide in an inner room.”
chapters.zh: 米该雅说：「你进严密的屋子藏躲的那日，就必看见了。」

chapters.en: And the king of Israel declared, “Take Micaiah and return him to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son,
chapters.zh: 以色列王说：「将米该雅带回，交给邑宰亚们和王的儿子约阿施，说

chapters.en: and tell them that this is what the king says: ‘Put this man in prison and feed him only bread and water until I return safely.’”
chapters.zh: 王如此说，把这个人下在监里，使他受苦，吃不饱喝不足，等候我平平安安地回来。」

chapters.en: But Micaiah replied, “If you ever return safely, the LORD has not spoken through me.” Then he added, “Take heed, all you people!”
chapters.zh: 米该雅说：「你若能平平安安地回来，那就是耶和华没有藉我说这话了」；又说：「众民哪，你们都要听！」

chapters.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.
chapters.zh: 以色列王和犹大王约沙法上基列的拉末去了。

chapters.en: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself and go into battle, but you wear your royal robes.” So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into battle.
chapters.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说：「我要改装上阵，你可以仍穿王服。」以色列王就改装上阵。

chapters.en: Now the king of Aram had ordered his thirty-two chariot commanders, “Do not fight with anyone, small or great, except the king of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 先是亚兰王吩咐他的三十二个车兵长说：「他们的〔兵将〕，无论大小，你们都不可与他们争战，只要与以色列王争战。」

chapters.en: When the chariot commanders saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “Surely this is the king of Israel!” So they turned to fight against him, but Jehoshaphat cried out.
chapters.zh: 车兵长看见约沙法，便说：「这必是以色列王！」就转过去与他争战，约沙法便呼喊。

chapters.en: And when the chariot commanders saw that he was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.
chapters.zh: 车兵长见不是以色列王，就转去不追他了。

chapters.en: However, a certain man drew his bow without taking special aim, and he struck the king of Israel between the joints of his armor. So the king said to his charioteer, “Turn around and take me out of the battle, for I am badly wounded!”
chapters.zh: 有一人随便开弓，恰巧射入以色列王的甲缝里。王对赶车的说：「我受了重伤，你转过车来，拉我出阵吧！」

chapters.en: The battle raged throughout that day, and the king was propped up in his chariot facing the Arameans. And the blood from his wound ran out onto the floor of the chariot, and that evening he died.
chapters.zh: 那日，阵势越战越猛，有人扶王站在车上，抵挡亚兰人。到晚上，王就死了，血从伤处流在车中。

chapters.en:
As the sun was setting, the cry rang out in the army:
“Every man to his own city, and every man to his own land!”
chapters.zh: 约在日落的时候，有号令传遍军中，说：「各归本城，各归本地吧！」

chapters.en: So the king died and was brought to Samaria, where they buried him.
chapters.zh: 王既死了，众人将他送到撒马利亚，就葬在那里；

chapters.en: And the chariot was washed at the pool of Samaria where the prostitutes bathed, and the dogs licked up Ahab’s blood, according to the word that the LORD had spoken.
chapters.zh: 又有人把他的车洗在撒马利亚的池旁（妓女〔在那里〕洗澡），狗来舔他的血，正如耶和华所说的话。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Ahab, along with all his accomplishments and the ivory palace and all the cities he built, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 亚哈其余的事，凡他所行的和他所修造的象牙宫，并所建筑的一切城邑，都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: And Ahab rested with his fathers, and his son Ahaziah reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 亚哈与他列祖同睡。他儿子亚哈谢接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the fourth year of Ahab’s reign over Israel, Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king of Judah.
chapters.zh: 以色列王亚哈第四年，亚撒的儿子约沙法登基作了犹大王。

chapters.en: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-five years. His mother’s name was Azubah daughter of Shilhi.
chapters.zh: 约沙法登基的时候年三十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十五年。他母亲名叫阿苏巴，乃示利希的女儿。

chapters.en:
And Jehoshaphat walked in all the ways of his father Asa; he did not turn away from them, but did what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
The high places, however, were not removed; the people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.
chapters.zh: 约沙法行他父亲亚撒所行的道，不偏离左右，行耶和华眼中看为正的事；只是邱坛还没有废去，百姓仍在那里献祭烧香。

chapters.en: Jehoshaphat also made peace with the king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 约沙法与以色列王和好。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, along with the might he exercised and how he waged war, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 约沙法其余的事和他所显出的勇力，并他怎样争战，都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: He banished from the land the male shrine prostitutes who remained from the days of his father Asa.
chapters.zh: 约沙法将他父亲亚撒在世所剩下的娈童都从国中除去了。

chapters.en: And there was no king in Edom; a deputy served as king.
chapters.zh: 那时以东没有王，有总督治理。

chapters.en: Jehoshaphat built ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they never set sail, because they were wrecked at Ezion-geber.
chapters.zh: 约沙法制造他施船只，要往俄斐去，将金子运来；只是没有去，因为船在以旬‧迦别破坏了。

chapters.en: At that time Ahaziah son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “Let my servants sail with your servants,” but Jehoshaphat refused.
chapters.zh: 亚哈的儿子亚哈谢对约沙法说：「容我的仆人和你的仆人坐船同去吧！」约沙法却不肯。

chapters.en: And Jehoshaphat rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the city of his father David. And his son Jehoram reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 约沙法与列祖同睡。葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子约兰接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat’s reign over Judah, Ahaziah son of Ahab became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria two years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王约沙法十七年，亚哈的儿子亚哈谢在撒马利亚登基，作以色列王共二年。

chapters.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and walked in the ways of his father and mother and of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused Israel to sin.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他的父母，又行尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的事。

chapters.en: Ahaziah served and worshiped Baal, provoking the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger, just as his father had done.
chapters.zh: 他照他父亲一切所行的，事奉敬拜巴力，惹耶和华－以色列上帝的怒气。

chapters.en: After the death of Ahab, Moab rebelled against Israel.
chapters.zh: 亚哈死后，摩押背叛以色列。

chapters.en: Now Ahaziah had fallen through the lattice of his upper room in Samaria and injured himself. So he sent messengers and instructed them: “Go inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I will recover from this injury.”
chapters.zh: 亚哈谢在撒马利亚，一日从楼上的栏杆里掉下来，就病了；于是差遣使者说：「你们去问以革伦的神巴力‧西卜，我这病能好不能好。」

chapters.en: But the angel of the LORD said to Elijah the Tishbite, “Go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria and ask them, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are on your way to inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron?’
chapters.zh: 但耶和华的使者对提斯比人以利亚说：「你起来，去迎着撒马利亚王的使者，对他们说：『你们去问以革伦神巴力‧西卜，岂因以色列中没有上帝吗？』

chapters.en:
Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘You will not get up from the bed on which you are lying. You will surely die.’”
So Elijah departed.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华如此说：『你必不下你所上的床，必定要死！』」以利亚就去了。

chapters.en: When the messengers returned to the king, he asked them, “Why have you returned?”
chapters.zh: 使者回来见王，王问他们说：「你们为什么回来呢？」

chapters.en: They replied, “A man came up to meet us and said, ‘Go back to the king who sent you and tell him that this is what the LORD says: Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are sending these men to inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not get up from the bed on which you are lying. You will surely die.’”
chapters.zh: 使者回答说：「有一个人迎着我们来，对我们说：『你们回去见差你们来的王，对他说：耶和华如此说，你差人去问以革伦神巴力‧西卜，岂因以色列中没有上帝吗？所以你必不下所上的床，必定要死。』」

chapters.en: The king asked them, “What sort of man came up to meet you and spoke these words to you?”
chapters.zh: 王问他们说：「迎着你们来告诉你们这话的，是怎样的人？」

chapters.en:
“He was a hairy man, ” they answered, “with a leather belt around his waist.”
“It was Elijah the Tishbite,” said the king.
chapters.zh: 回答说：「他身穿毛衣，腰束皮带。」王说：「这必是提斯比人以利亚。」

chapters.en: Then King Ahaziah sent to Elijah a captain with his company of fifty men. So the captain went up to Elijah, who was sitting on top of a hill, and said to him, “Man of God, the king declares, ‘Come down!’”
chapters.zh: 于是，王差遣五十夫长，带领五十人去见以利亚，他就上到以利亚那里；以利亚正坐在山顶上。五十夫长对他说：「神人哪，王吩咐你下来！」

chapters.en:
Elijah answered the captain, “If I am a man of God, may fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men.”
And fire came down from heaven and consumed the captain and his fifty men.
chapters.zh: 以利亚回答说：「我若是神人，愿火从天上降下来，烧灭你和你那五十人！」于是有火从天上降下来，烧灭五十夫长和他那五十人。

chapters.en: So the king sent to Elijah another captain with his fifty men. And the captain said to Elijah, “Man of God, the king declares, ‘Come down at once!’”
chapters.zh: 王第二次差遣一个五十夫长，带领五十人去见以利亚。五十夫长对以利亚说：「神人哪，王吩咐你快快下来！」

chapters.en:
Again Elijah replied, “If I am a man of God, may fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men.”
And the fire of God came down from heaven and consumed the captain and his fifty men.
chapters.zh: 以利亚回答说：「我若是神人，愿火从天上降下来，烧灭你和你那五十人！」于是上帝的火从天上降下来，烧灭五十夫长和他那五十人。

chapters.en: So the king sent a third captain with his fifty men. And the third captain went up, fell on his knees before Elijah, and begged him, “Man of God, may my life and the lives of these fifty servants of yours please be precious in your sight.
chapters.zh: 王第三次差遣一个五十夫长，带领五十人去。这五十夫长上去，双膝跪在以利亚面前，哀求他说：「神人哪，愿我的性命和你这五十个仆人的性命在你眼前看为宝贵！

chapters.en: Behold, fire has come down from heaven and consumed the first two captains of fifty, with all their men. But now may my life be precious in your sight.”
chapters.zh: 已经有火从天上降下来，烧灭前两次来的五十夫长和他们各自带的五十人；现在愿我的性命在你眼前看为宝贵！」

chapters.en:
Then the angel of the LORD said to Elijah, “Go down with him. Do not be afraid of him.”
So Elijah got up and went down with him to the king.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者对以利亚说：「你同着他下去，不要怕他！」以利亚就起来，同着他下去见王，

chapters.en: And Elijah said to King Ahaziah, “This is what the LORD says: Is there really no God in Israel for you to inquire of His word? Is that why you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not get up from the bed on which you are lying. You will surely die.”
chapters.zh: 对王说：「耶和华如此说：『你差人去问以革伦神巴力‧西卜，岂因以色列中没有上帝可以求问吗？所以你必不下所上的床，必定要死！』」

chapters.en: So Ahaziah died according to the word of the LORD that Elijah had spoken. And since he had no son, Jehoram succeeded him in the second year of the reign of Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat over Judah.
chapters.zh: 亚哈谢果然死了，正如耶和华借以利亚所说的话。因他没有儿子，〔他兄弟〕约兰接续他作王，正在犹大王约沙法的儿子约兰第二年。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Ahaziah, along with his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 亚哈谢其余所行的事都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: Shortly before the LORD took Elijah up to heaven in a whirlwind, Elijah and Elisha were on their way from Gilgal,
chapters.zh: 耶和华要用旋风接以利亚升天的时候，以利亚与以利沙从吉甲前往。

chapters.en:
and Elijah said to Elisha, “Please stay here, for the LORD has sent me on to Bethel.”
But Elisha replied, “As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live, I will not leave you.”
So they went down to Bethel.
chapters.zh: 以利亚对以利沙说：「耶和华差我往伯特利去，你可以在这里等候。」以利沙说：「我指着永生的耶和华，又敢在你面前起誓，我必不离开你。」于是二人下到伯特利。

chapters.en:
Then the sons of the prophets at Bethel came out to Elisha and said, “Do you know that the LORD will take your master away from you today?”
“Yes, I know,” he replied. “Do not speak of it.”
chapters.zh: 住伯特利的先知门徒出来见以利沙，对他说：「耶和华今日要接你的师傅离开你，你知道不知道？」他说：「我知道，你们不要作声。」

chapters.en:
And Elijah said to Elisha, “Please stay here, for the LORD has sent me on to Jericho.”
But Elisha replied, “As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live, I will not leave you.”
So they went to Jericho.
chapters.zh: 以利亚对以利沙说：「耶和华差遣我往耶利哥去，你可以在这里等候。」以利沙说：「我指着永生的耶和华，又敢在你面前起誓，我必不离开你。」于是二人到了耶利哥。

chapters.en:
Then the sons of the prophets at Jericho came up to Elisha and said, “Do you know that the LORD will take your master away from you today?”
“Yes, I know,” he replied. “Do not speak of it.”
chapters.zh: 住耶利哥的先知门徒就近以利沙，对他说：「耶和华今日要接你的师傅离开你，你知道不知道？」他说：「我知道，你们不要作声。」

chapters.en:
And Elijah said to Elisha, “Please stay here, for the LORD has sent me on to the Jordan.”
But Elisha replied, “As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live, I will not leave you.”
So the two of them went on.
chapters.zh: 以利亚对以利沙说：「耶和华差遣我往约旦河去，你可以在这里等候。」以利沙说：「我指着永生的耶和华，又敢在你面前起誓，我必不离开你。」于是二人一同前往。

chapters.en: Then a company of fifty of the sons of the prophets went and stood at a distance, facing Elijah and Elisha as the two of them stood by the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 有先知门徒去了五十人，远远地站在他们对面；二人在约旦河边站住。

chapters.en: And Elijah took his cloak, rolled it up, and struck the waters, which parted to the right and to the left, so that the two of them crossed over on dry ground.
chapters.zh: 以利亚将自己的外衣卷起来，用以打水，水就左右分开，二人走干地而过。

chapters.en:
After they had crossed over, Elijah said to Elisha, “Tell me, what can I do for you before I am taken away from you?”
“Please, let me inherit a double portion of your spirit,” Elisha replied.
chapters.zh: 过去之后，以利亚对以利沙说：「我未曾被接去离开你，你要我为你做什么，只管求我。」以利沙说：「愿〔感动〕你的灵加倍地感动我。」

chapters.en: “You have requested a difficult thing,” said Elijah. “Nevertheless, if you see me as I am taken from you, it will be yours. But if not, then it will not be so.”
chapters.zh: 以利亚说：「你所求的难得。〔虽然如此〕，我被接去离开你的时候，你若看见我，就必得着；不然，必得不着了。」

chapters.en: As they were walking along and talking together, suddenly a chariot of fire with horses of fire appeared and separated the two of them, and Elijah went up into heaven in a whirlwind.
chapters.zh: 他们正走着说话，忽有火车火马将二人隔开，以利亚就乘旋风升天去了。

chapters.en: As Elisha watched, he cried out, “My father, my father, the chariots and horsemen of Israel!” And he saw Elijah no more. So taking hold of his own clothes, he tore them in two.
chapters.zh: 以利沙看见，就呼叫说：「我父啊！我父啊！以色列的战车马兵啊！」以后不再见他了。 于是以利沙把自己的衣服撕为两片。

chapters.en: Elisha also picked up the cloak that had fallen from Elijah, and he went back and stood on the bank of the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 他拾起以利亚身上掉下来的外衣，回去站在约旦河边。

chapters.en:
Then he took the cloak of Elijah that had fallen from him and struck the waters. “Where now is the LORD, the God of Elijah?” he asked.
And when he had struck the waters, they parted to the right and to the left, and Elisha crossed over.
chapters.zh: 他用以利亚身上掉下来的外衣打水，说：「耶和华－以利亚的上帝在哪里呢？」打水之后，水也左右分开，以利沙就过来了。

chapters.en: When the sons of the prophets who were watching him from Jericho saw what had happened, they said, “The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha.” And they went to meet him and bowed down to the ground before him.
chapters.zh: 住耶利哥的先知门徒从对面看见他，就说：「〔感动〕以利亚的灵感动以利沙了。」他们就来迎接他，在他面前俯伏于地，

chapters.en:
“Look now,” they said to Elisha, “we your servants have fifty valiant men. Please let them go and search for your master. Perhaps the Spirit of the LORD has taken him up and put him on one of the mountains or in one of the valleys.”
“Do not send them,” Elisha replied.
chapters.zh: 对他说：「仆人们这里有五十个壮士，求你容他们去寻找你师傅，或者耶和华的灵将他提起来，投在某山某谷。」以利沙说：「你们不必打发人去。」

chapters.en:
But when they pressed him to the point of embarrassment, he said, “Send them.”
And they sent fifty men, who searched for three days but did not find Elijah.
chapters.zh: 他们再三催促他，他难以推辞，就说：「你们打发人去吧！」他们便打发五十人去，寻找了三天，也没有找着。

chapters.en: When they returned to Elisha, who was staying in Jericho, he said to them, “Didn’t I tell you not to go?”
chapters.zh: 以利沙仍然在耶利哥等候他们回到他那里；他对他们说：「我岂没有告诉你们不必去吗？」

chapters.en: Then the men of the city said to Elisha, “Please note, our lord, that the city’s location is good, as you can see. But the water is bad and the land is unfruitful.”
chapters.zh: 耶利哥城的人对以利沙说：「这城的地势美好，我主看见了；只是水恶劣，土产不熟而落。」

chapters.en:
“Bring me a new bowl,” he replied, “and put some salt in it.”
So they brought it to him,
chapters.zh: 以利沙说：「你们拿一个新瓶来，装盐给我」；他们就拿来给他。

chapters.en: and Elisha went out to the spring, cast the salt into it, and said, “This is what the LORD says: ‘I have healed this water. No longer will it cause death or unfruitfulness. ’”
chapters.zh: 他出到水源，将盐倒在水中，说：「耶和华如此说：『我治好了这水，从此必不再使人死，也不再使地土不生产。』」

chapters.en: And the waters there have been healthy to this day, according to the word spoken by Elisha.
chapters.zh: 于是那水治好了，直到今日，正如以利沙所说的。

chapters.en: From there, Elisha went up to Bethel, and as he was walking up the road, a group of boys came out of the city and jeered at him, chanting, “Go up, you baldhead! Go up, you baldhead!”
chapters.zh: 以利沙从那里上伯特利去，正上去的时候，有些童子从城里出来，戏笑他说：「秃头的上去吧！秃头的上去吧！」

chapters.en:
Then he turned around, looked at them, and called down a curse on them in the name of the LORD.
Suddenly two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of the boys.
chapters.zh: 他回头看见，就奉耶和华的名咒诅他们。于是有两个母熊从林中出来，撕裂他们中间四十二个童子。

chapters.en: And Elisha went on to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.
chapters.zh: 以利沙从伯特利上迦密山，又从迦密山回到撒马利亚。

chapters.en: In the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat’s reign over Judah, Jehoram son of Ahab became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria twelve years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王约沙法十八年，亚哈的儿子约兰在撒马利亚登基作了以色列王十二年。

chapters.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, but not as his father and mother had done. He removed the sacred pillar of Baal that his father had made.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，但不致像他父母所行的，因为除掉他父所造巴力的柱像。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, he clung to the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit; he did not turn away from them.
chapters.zh: 然而，他贴近尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，总不离开。

chapters.en: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder, and he would render to the king of Israel a hundred thousand lambs and the wool of a hundred thousand rams.
chapters.zh: 摩押王米沙牧养许多羊，〔每年〕将十万羊羔的毛和十万公绵羊的毛给以色列王进贡。

chapters.en: But after the death of Ahab, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 亚哈死后，摩押王背叛以色列王。

chapters.en: So at that time King Jehoram set out from Samaria and mobilized all Israel.
chapters.zh: 那时约兰王出撒马利亚，数点以色列众人。

chapters.en:
And he sent a message to Jehoshaphat king of Judah: “The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me to fight against Moab?”
“I will go,” replied Jehoshaphat. “I am as you are, my people are your people, and my horses are your horses.”
chapters.zh: 前行的时候，差人去见犹大王约沙法，说：「摩押王背叛我，你肯同我去攻打摩押吗？」他说：「我肯上去，你我不分彼此，我的民与你的民一样，我的马与你的马一样。」

chapters.en:
Then he asked, “Which way shall we go up?”
“By way of the Desert of Edom,” replied Joram.
chapters.zh: 约兰说：「我们从哪条路上去呢？」回答说：「从以东旷野的路上去。」

chapters.en: So the king of Israel, the king of Judah, and the king of Edom set out, and after they had traveled a roundabout route for seven days, they had no water for their army or for their animals.
chapters.zh: 于是，以色列王和犹大王，并以东王，都一同去绕行七日的路程；军队和所带的牲畜没有水喝。

chapters.en: “Alas,” said the king of Israel, “for the LORD has summoned these three kings to deliver them into the hand of Moab!”
chapters.zh: 以色列王说：「哀哉！耶和华招聚我们这三王，乃要交在摩押人的手里。」

chapters.en:
But Jehoshaphat asked, “Is there no prophet of the LORD here? Let us inquire of the LORD through him.”
And one of the servants of the king of Israel answered, “Elisha son of Shaphat is here. He used to pour water on the hands of Elijah. ”
chapters.zh: 约沙法说：「这里不是有耶和华的先知吗？我们可以讬他求问耶和华。」以色列王的一个臣子回答说：「这里有沙法的儿子以利沙，就是从前服事以利亚的〔注：原文是倒水在以利亚手上的〕。」

chapters.en: Jehoshaphat affirmed, “The word of the LORD is with him.” So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
chapters.zh: 约沙法说：「他必有耶和华的话。」于是以色列王和约沙法，并以东王都下去见他。

chapters.en:
Elisha, however, said to the king of Israel, “What have we to do with each other? Go to the prophets of your father and of your mother!”
“No,” replied the king of Israel, “for it is the LORD who has summoned these three kings to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”
chapters.zh: 以利沙对以色列王说：「我与你何干？去问你父亲的先知和你母亲的先知吧！」以色列王对他说：「不要这样说，耶和华招聚我们这三王，乃要交在摩押人的手里。」

chapters.en: Then Elisha said, “As surely as the LORD of Hosts lives, before whom I stand, were it not for my regard for the presence of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, I would not look at you or acknowledge you.
chapters.zh: 以利沙说：「我指着所事奉永生的万军耶和华起誓，我若不看犹大王约沙法的情面，必不理你，不顾你。

chapters.en:
But now, bring me a harpist. ”
And while the harpist played, the hand of the LORD came upon Elisha
chapters.zh: 现在你们给我找一个弹琴的来。」弹琴的时候，耶和华的灵〔注：原文是手〕就降在以利沙身上。

chapters.en: and he said, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Dig this valley full of ditches.’
chapters.zh: 他便说：「耶和华如此说：『你们要在这谷中满处挖沟；

chapters.en: For the LORD says, ‘You will not see wind or rain, but the valley will be filled with water, and you will drink—you and your cattle and your animals.’
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华如此说：你们虽不见风，不见雨，这谷必满了水，使你们和牲畜有水喝。』

chapters.en: This is a simple matter in the sight of the LORD, and He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.
chapters.zh: 在耶和华眼中这还算为小事，他也必将摩押人交在你们手中。

chapters.en: And you shall attack every fortified city and every city of importance. You shall cut down every good tree, stop up every spring, and ruin every good field with stones.”
chapters.zh: 你们必攻破一切坚城美邑，砍伐各种佳树，塞住一切水泉，用石头糟踏一切美田。」

chapters.en: The next morning, at the time of the morning sacrifice, water suddenly flowed from the direction of Edom and filled the land.
chapters.zh: 次日早晨，约在献祭的时候，有水从以东而来，遍地就满了水。

chapters.en: Now all the Moabites had heard that the kings had come up to fight against them. So all who could bear arms, young and old, were summoned and stationed at the border.
chapters.zh: 摩押众人听见这三王上来要与他们争战，凡能顶盔贯甲的，无论老少，尽都聚集站在边界上。

chapters.en: When they got up early in the morning, the sun was shining on the water, and it looked as red as blood to the Moabites across the way.
chapters.zh: 次日早晨，日光照在水上，摩押人起来，看见对面水红如血，

chapters.en: “This is blood!” they exclaimed. “The kings have clashed swords and slaughtered one another. Now to the plunder, Moab!”
chapters.zh: 就说：「这是血啊！必是三王互相击杀，俱都灭亡。摩押人哪，我们现在去抢夺财物吧！」

chapters.en: But when the Moabites came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and attacked them, and they fled before them. So the Israelites invaded their land and struck down the Moabites.
chapters.zh: 摩押人到了以色列营，以色列人就起来攻打他们，以致他们在以色列人面前逃跑。以色列人往前追杀摩押人，直杀入摩押的境内，

chapters.en: They destroyed the cities, and each man threw stones on every good field until it was covered. They stopped up every spring and cut down every good tree. Only Kir-haraseth was left with stones in place, but men with slings surrounded it and attacked it as well.
chapters.zh: 拆毁摩押的城邑，各人抛石填满一切美田，塞住一切水泉，砍伐各种佳树，只剩下吉珥‧哈列设的石〔墙〕；甩石的兵在四围攻打那城。

chapters.en: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too fierce for him, he took with him seven hundred swordsmen to break through to the king of Edom, but they could not prevail.
chapters.zh: 摩押王见阵势甚大，难以对敌，就率领七百拿刀的兵，要冲过阵去到以东王那里，却是不能；

chapters.en:
So he took his firstborn son, who was to succeed him, and offered him as a burnt offering on the city wall.
And there was great fury against the Israelites, so they withdrew and returned to their own land.
chapters.zh: 便将那应当接续他作王的长子，在城上献为燔祭。以色列人遭遇〔耶和华的〕大怒〔注：或译：招人痛恨〕，于是三王离开摩押王，各回本国去了。

chapters.en: Now the wife of one of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, “Your servant, my husband, is dead, and you know that your servant feared the LORD. And now his creditor is coming to take my two children as his slaves!”
chapters.zh: 有一个先知门徒的妻哀求以利沙说：「你仆人－我丈夫死了，他敬畏耶和华是你所知道的。现在有债主来，要取我两个儿子作奴仆。」

chapters.en:
“How can I help you?” asked Elisha. “Tell me, what do you have in the house?”
She answered, “Your servant has nothing in the house but a jar of oil.”
chapters.zh: 以利沙问她说：「我可以为你做什么呢？你告诉我，你家里有什么？」她说：「婢女家中除了一瓶油之外，没有什么。」

chapters.en: “Go,” said Elisha, “borrow empty jars from all your neighbors. Do not gather just a few.
chapters.zh: 以利沙说：「你去，向你众邻舍借空器皿，不要少借；

chapters.en: Then go inside, shut the door behind you and your sons, and pour oil into all these jars, setting the full ones aside.”
chapters.zh: 回到家里，关上门，你和你儿子在里面将油倒在所有的器皿里，倒满了的放在一边。」

chapters.en: So she left him, and after she had shut the door behind her and her sons, they kept bringing jars to her, and she kept pouring.
chapters.zh: 于是，妇人离开以利沙去了，关上门，自己和儿子在里面；儿子把〔器皿〕拿来，她就倒油。

chapters.en:
When all the jars were full, she said to her son, “Bring me another.”
But he replied, “There are no more jars.” Then the oil stopped flowing.
chapters.zh: 器皿都满了，她对儿子说：「再给我拿器皿来。」儿子说：「再没有器皿了。」油就止住了。

chapters.en: She went and told the man of God, and he said, “Go, sell the oil, and pay your debt. Then you and your sons can live on the remainder.”
chapters.zh: 妇人去告诉神人，神人说：「你去卖油还债，所剩的你和你儿子可以靠着度日。」

chapters.en: One day Elisha went to Shunem, and a prominent woman who lived there persuaded him to have a meal. So whenever he would pass by, he would stop there to eat.
chapters.zh: 一日，以利沙走到书念，在那里有一个大户的妇人强留他吃饭。此后，以利沙每从那里经过就进去吃饭。

chapters.en: Then the woman said to her husband, “Behold, now I know that the one who often comes our way is a holy man of God.
chapters.zh: 妇人对丈夫说：「我看出那常从我们这里经过的是圣洁的神人。

chapters.en: Please let us make a small room upstairs and put in it a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp for him. Then when he comes to us, he can stay there.”
chapters.zh: 我们可以为他在墙上盖一间小楼，在其中安放床榻、桌子、椅子、灯台，他来到我们这里，就可以住在其间。」

chapters.en: One day Elisha came to visit and went to his upper room to lie down.
chapters.zh: 一日，以利沙来到那里，就进了那楼躺卧。

chapters.en:
And he said to Gehazi his servant, “Call the Shunammite woman.”
And when he had called her, she stood before him,
chapters.zh: 以利沙吩咐仆人基哈西说：「你叫这书念妇人来。」他就把妇人叫了来，妇人站在以利沙面前。

chapters.en:
and Elisha said to Gehazi, “Now tell her, ‘Look, you have gone to all this trouble for us. What can we do for you? Can we speak on your behalf to the king or the commander of the army?’”
“I have a home among my own people,” she replied.
chapters.zh: 以利沙吩咐仆人说：「你对她说：你既为我们费了许多心思，可以为你做什么呢？你向王或元帅有所求的没有？」她回答说：「我在我本乡安居无事。」

chapters.en:
So he asked, “Then what should be done for her?”
“Well, she has no son,” Gehazi replied, “and her husband is old.”
chapters.zh: 以利沙〔对仆人〕说：「究竟当为她做什么呢？」基哈西说：「她没有儿子，她丈夫也老了。」

chapters.en:
“Call her,” said Elisha.
So Gehazi called her, and she stood in the doorway.
chapters.zh: 以利沙说：「再叫她来。」于是叫了她来，她就站在门口。

chapters.en:
And Elisha declared, “At this time next year, you will hold a son in your arms.”
“No, my lord,” she said. “Do not lie to your maidservant, O man of God.”
chapters.zh: 以利沙说：「明年到这时候，你必抱一个儿子。」她说：「神人，我主啊，不要那样欺哄婢女。」

chapters.en: But the woman did conceive, and at that time the next year she gave birth to a son, just as Elisha had told her.
chapters.zh: 妇人果然怀孕，到了那时候，生了一个儿子，正如以利沙所说的。

chapters.en: And the child grew, and one day he went out to his father, who was with the harvesters.
chapters.zh: 孩子渐渐长大，一日到他父亲和收割的人那里，

chapters.en:
“My head! My head!” he complained to his father.
So his father told a servant, “Carry him to his mother.”
chapters.zh: 他对父亲说：「我的头啊，我的头啊！」他父亲对仆人说：「把他抱到他母亲那里。」

chapters.en: After the servant had picked him up and carried him to his mother, the boy sat on her lap until noon, and then he died.
chapters.zh: 仆人抱去，交给他母亲；孩子坐在母亲的膝上，到晌午就死了。

chapters.en: And she went up and laid him on the bed of the man of God. Then she shut the door and went out.
chapters.zh: 他母亲抱他上了楼，将他放在神人的床上，关上〔门〕出来，

chapters.en: And the woman called her husband and said, “Please send me one of the servants and one of the donkeys, that I may go quickly to the man of God and return.”
chapters.zh: 呼叫她丈夫说：「你叫一个仆人给我牵一匹驴来，我要快快地去见神人，就回来。」

chapters.en:
“Why would you go to him today?” he replied. “It is not a New Moon or a Sabbath.”
“Everything is all right,” she said.
chapters.zh: 丈夫说：「今日不是月朔，也不是安息日，你为何要去见他呢？」妇人说：「平安无事。」

chapters.en: Then she saddled the donkey and told her servant, “Drive onward; do not slow the pace for me unless I tell you.”
chapters.zh: 于是备上驴，对仆人说：「你快快赶着走，我若不吩咐你，就不要迟慢。」

chapters.en:
So she set out and went to the man of God at Mount Carmel.
When the man of God saw her at a distance, he said to his servant Gehazi, “Look, there is the Shunammite woman.
chapters.zh: 妇人就往迦密山去见神人。 神人远远地看见她，对仆人基哈西说：「看哪，书念的妇人来了！

chapters.en:
Please run out now to meet her and ask, ‘Are you all right? Is your husband all right? Is your child all right?’”
And she answered, “Everything is all right.”
chapters.zh: 你跑去迎接她，问她说：你平安吗？你丈夫平安吗？孩子平安吗？」她说：「平安。」

chapters.en: When she reached the man of God at the mountain, she clung to his feet. Gehazi came over to push her away, but the man of God said, “Leave her alone, for her soul is in deep distress, and the LORD has hidden it from me and has not told me.”
chapters.zh: 妇人上了山，到神人那里，就抱住神人的脚。基哈西前来要推开她，神人说：「由她吧！因为她心里愁苦，耶和华向我隐瞒，没有指示我。」

chapters.en: Then she said, “Did I ask you for a son, my lord? Didn’t I say, ‘Do not deceive me?’”
chapters.zh: 妇人说：「我何尝向我主求过儿子呢？我岂没有说过，不要欺哄我吗？」

chapters.en: So Elisha said to Gehazi, “Tie up your garment, take my staff in your hand, and go! If you meet anyone, do not greet him, and if anyone greets you, do not answer him. Then lay my staff on the boy’s face.”
chapters.zh: 以利沙吩咐基哈西说：「你束上腰，手拿我的杖前去；若遇见人，不要向他问安；人若向你问安，也不要回答；要把我的杖放在孩子脸上。」

chapters.en: And the mother of the boy said, “As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live, I will not leave you.” So he got up and followed her.
chapters.zh: 孩子的母亲说：「我指着永生的耶和华，又敢在你面前起誓，我必不离开你。」于是以利沙起身，随着她去了。

chapters.en: Gehazi went on ahead of them and laid the staff on the boy’s face, but there was no sound or response. So he went back to meet Elisha and told him, “The boy has not awakened.”
chapters.zh: 基哈西先去，把杖放在孩子脸上，却没有声音，也没有动静。基哈西就迎着以利沙回来，告诉他说：「孩子还没有醒过来。」

chapters.en: When Elisha reached the house, there was the boy lying dead on his bed.
chapters.zh: 以利沙来到，进了屋子，看见孩子死了，放在自己的床上。

chapters.en: So he went in, closed the door behind the two of them, and prayed to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他就关上门，只有自己和孩子在里面，他便祈祷耶和华，

chapters.en: Then Elisha got on the bed and lay on the boy, mouth to mouth, eye to eye, and hand to hand. As he stretched himself out over him, the boy’s body became warm.
chapters.zh: 上床伏在孩子身上，口对口，眼对眼，手对手；既伏在孩子身上，孩子的身体就渐渐温和了。

chapters.en: Elisha turned away and paced back and forth across the room. Then he got on the bed and stretched himself out over the boy again, and the boy sneezed seven times and opened his eyes.
chapters.zh: 然后他下来，在屋里来往走了一趟，又上去伏在孩子身上，孩子打了七个喷嚏，就睁开眼睛了。

chapters.en:
Elisha summoned Gehazi and said, “Call the Shunammite woman.” So he called her and she came.
Then Elisha said, “Pick up your son.”
chapters.zh: 以利沙叫基哈西说：「你叫这书念妇人来」；于是叫了她来。以利沙说：「将你儿子抱起来。」

chapters.en: She came in, fell at his feet, and bowed to the ground. Then she picked up her son and went out.
chapters.zh: 妇人就进来，在以利沙脚前俯伏于地，抱起她儿子出去了。

chapters.en: When Elisha returned to Gilgal, there was a famine in the land. As the sons of the prophets were sitting at his feet, he said to his attendant, “Put on the large pot and boil some stew for the sons of the prophets.”
chapters.zh: 以利沙又来到吉甲，那地正有饥荒。先知门徒坐在他面前，他吩咐仆人说：「你将大锅放在火上，给先知门徒熬汤。」

chapters.en: One of them went out to the field to gather herbs, and he found a wild vine from which he gathered as many wild gourds as his garment could hold. Then he came back and cut them up into the pot of stew, though no one knew what they were.
chapters.zh: 有一个人去到田野掐菜，遇见一棵野瓜籐，就摘了一兜野瓜回来，切了搁在熬汤的锅中，因为他们不知道是什么东西；

chapters.en: And they poured it out for the men to eat, but when they tasted the stew they cried out, “There is death in the pot, O man of God!” And they could not eat it.
chapters.zh: 倒出来给众人吃，吃的时候，都喊叫说：「神人哪，锅中有致死的毒物！」所以众人不能吃了。

chapters.en: Then Elisha said, “Get some flour.” He threw it into the pot and said, “Pour it out for the people to eat.” And there was nothing harmful in the pot.
chapters.zh: 以利沙说：「拿点面来」，就把面撒在锅中，说：「倒出来，给众人吃吧！」锅中就没有毒了。

chapters.en:
Now a man from Baal-shalishah came to the man of God with a sack of twenty loaves of barley bread from the first ripe grain.
“Give it to the people to eat,” said Elisha.
chapters.zh: 有一个人从巴力‧沙利沙来，带着初熟大麦做的饼二十个，并新穗子，装在口袋里送给神人。神人说：「把这些给众人吃。」

chapters.en:
But his servant asked, “How am I to set twenty loaves before a hundred men?”
“Give it to the people to eat,” said Elisha, “for this is what the LORD says: ‘They will eat and have some left over.’”
chapters.zh: 仆人说：「这一点岂可摆给一百人吃呢？」以利沙说：「你只管给众人吃吧！因为耶和华如此说，众人必吃了，还剩下。」

chapters.en: So he set it before them, and they ate and had some left over, according to the word of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 仆人就摆在众人面前，他们吃了，果然还剩下，正如耶和华所说的。

chapters.en: Now Naaman, the commander of the army of the king of Aram, was a great man in his master’s sight and highly regarded, for through him the LORD had given victory to Aram. And he was a mighty man of valor, but he was a leper.
chapters.zh: 亚兰王的元帅乃缦在他主人面前为尊为大，因耶和华曾藉他使亚兰人得胜；他又是大能的勇士，只是长了大痲疯。

chapters.en: At this time the Arameans had gone out in bands and had taken a young girl from the land of Israel, and she was serving Naaman’s wife.
chapters.zh: 先前亚兰人成群地出去，从以色列国掳了一个小女子，这女子就服事乃缦的妻。

chapters.en: She said to her mistress, “If only my master would go to the prophet who is in Samaria, he would cure him of his leprosy.”
chapters.zh: 她对主母说：「巴不得我主人去见撒马利亚的先知，必能治好他的大痲疯。」

chapters.en: And Naaman went and told his master what the girl from the land of Israel had said.
chapters.zh: 乃缦进去，告诉他主人说，以色列国的女子如此如此说。

chapters.en:
“Go now,” said the king of Aram, “and I will send you with a letter to the king of Israel.”
So Naaman departed, taking with him ten talents of silver, six thousand shekels of gold, and ten sets of clothing.
chapters.zh: 亚兰王说：「你可以去，我也达信于以色列王。」于是乃缦带银子十他连得，金子六千〔舍客勒〕，衣裳十套，就去了；

chapters.en: And the letter that he took to the king of Israel stated: “With this letter I am sending my servant Naaman, so that you may cure him of his leprosy.”
chapters.zh: 且带信给以色列王，信上说：「我打发臣仆乃缦去见你，你接到这信，就要治好他的大痲疯。」

chapters.en: When the king of Israel read the letter, he tore his clothes and asked, “Am I God, killing and giving life, that this man expects me to cure a leper? Surely you can see that he is seeking a quarrel with me!”
chapters.zh: 以色列王看了信就撕裂衣服，说：「我岂是上帝，能使人死使人活呢？这人竟打发人来，叫我治好他的大痲疯。你们看一看，这人何以寻隙攻击我呢？」

chapters.en: Now when Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes, he sent a message to the king: “Why have you torn your clothes? Please let the man come to me, and he will know that there is a prophet in Israel.”
chapters.zh: 神人以利沙听见以色列王撕裂衣服，就打发人去见王，说：「你为什么撕了衣服呢？可使那人到我这里来，他就知道以色列中有先知了。」

chapters.en: So Naaman came with his horses and chariots and stood at the door of Elisha’s house.
chapters.zh: 于是，乃缦带着车马到了以利沙的家，站在门前。

chapters.en: Then Elisha sent him a messenger, who said, “Go and wash yourself seven times in the Jordan, and your flesh will be restored, and you will be clean.”
chapters.zh: 以利沙打发一个使者，对乃缦说：「你去在约旦河中沐浴七回，你的肉就必复原，而得洁净。」

chapters.en: But Naaman went away angry, saying, “I thought that he would surely come out, stand and call on the name of the LORD his God, and wave his hand over the spot to cure my leprosy.
chapters.zh: 乃缦却发怒走了，说：「我想他必定出来见我，站着求告耶和华－他上帝的名，在患处以上摇手，治好这大痲疯。

chapters.en: Are not the Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Could I not have washed in them and been cleansed?” So he turned and went away in a rage.
chapters.zh: 大马士革的河亚罢拿和法珥法岂不比以色列的一切水更好吗？我在那里沐浴不得洁净吗？」于是气忿忿地转身去了。

chapters.en: Naaman’s servants, however, approached him and said, “My father, if the prophet had told you to do some great thing, would you not have done it? How much more, then, when he tells you, ‘Wash and be cleansed’?”
chapters.zh: 他的仆人进前来，对他说：「我父啊，先知若吩咐你做一件大事，你岂不做吗？何况说你去沐浴而得洁净呢？」

chapters.en: So Naaman went down and dipped himself in the Jordan seven times, according to the word of the man of God, and his flesh was restored and became like that of a little child, and he was clean.
chapters.zh: 于是乃缦下去，照着神人的话，在约旦河里沐浴七回；他的肉复原，好像小孩子的肉，他就洁净了。

chapters.en: Then Naaman and all his attendants went back to the man of God, stood before him, and declared, “Now I know for sure that there is no God in all the earth except in Israel. So please accept a gift from your servant.”
chapters.zh: 乃缦带着一切跟随他的人，回到神人那里，站在他面前，说：「如今我知道，除了以色列之外，普天下没有上帝。现在求你收点仆人的礼物。」

chapters.en: But Elisha replied, “As surely as the LORD lives, before whom I stand, I will not accept it.” And although Naaman urged him to accept it, he refused.
chapters.zh: 以利沙说：「我指着所事奉永生的耶和华起誓，我必不受。」乃缦再三地求他，他却不受。

chapters.en: “If you will not,” said Naaman, “please let me, your servant, be given as much soil as a pair of mules can carry. For your servant will never again make a burnt offering or a sacrifice to any other god but the LORD.
chapters.zh: 乃缦说：「你若不肯受，请将两骡子驮的土赐给仆人。从今以后，仆人必不再将燔祭或〔平安〕祭献与别神，只献给耶和华。

chapters.en: Yet may the LORD forgive your servant this one thing: When my master goes into the temple of Rimmon to worship there, and he leans on my arm, and I bow down in the temple of Rimmon, may the LORD forgive your servant in this matter.”
chapters.zh: 惟有一件事，愿耶和华饶恕你仆人：我主人进临门庙叩拜的时候，我用手搀他在临门庙，我也屈身。我在临门庙屈身的这事，愿耶和华饶恕我。」

chapters.en:
“Go in peace,” said Elisha.
But after Naaman had traveled a short distance,
chapters.zh: 以利沙对他说：「你可以平平安安地回去！」 乃缦就离开他去了；走了不远，

chapters.en: Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, “Look, my master has spared this Aramean, Naaman, by not accepting what he brought. As surely as the LORD lives, I will run after him and get something from him.”
chapters.zh: 神人以利沙的仆人基哈西〔心里〕说：「我主人不愿从这亚兰人乃缦手里受他带来的礼物，我指着永生的耶和华起誓，我必跑去追上他，向他要些。」

chapters.en: So Gehazi pursued Naaman. And when Naaman saw him running toward him, he got down from the chariot to meet him and asked, “Is everything all right?”
chapters.zh: 于是基哈西追赶乃缦。乃缦看见有人追赶，就急忙下车迎着他，说：「都平安吗？」

chapters.en: “Everything is all right,” Gehazi replied. “My master has sent me to say, ‘Look, two young men from the sons of the prophets have just now come to me from the hill country of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and two sets of clothing.’”
chapters.zh: 说：「都平安。我主人打发我来说：『刚才有两个少年人，是先知门徒，从以法莲山地来见我，请你赐他们一他连得银子，两套衣裳。』」

chapters.en: But Naaman insisted, “Please, take two talents.” And he urged Gehazi to accept them. Then he tied up two talents of silver in two bags along with two sets of clothing and gave them to two of his servants, who carried them ahead of Gehazi.
chapters.zh: 乃缦说：「请受二他连得」；再三地请受，便将二他连得银子装在两个口袋里，又将两套衣裳交给两个仆人；他们就在基哈西前头抬着走。

chapters.en: When Gehazi came to the hill, he took the gifts from the servants and stored them in the house. Then he dismissed the men, and they departed.
chapters.zh: 到了山冈，基哈西从他们手中接过来，放在屋里，打发他们回去。

chapters.en:
When Gehazi went in and stood before his master, Elisha asked him, “Gehazi, where have you been?”
“Your servant did not go anywhere,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 基哈西进去，站在他主人面前。以利沙问他说：「基哈西你从哪里来？」回答说：「仆人没有往哪里去。」

chapters.en: But Elisha questioned him, “Did not my spirit go with you when the man got down from his chariot to meet you? Is this the time to accept money and clothing, olive groves and vineyards, sheep and oxen, menservants and maidservants?
chapters.zh: 以利沙对他说：「那人下车转回迎你的时候，我的心岂没有去呢？这岂是受银子、衣裳、〔买〕橄榄园、葡萄园、牛羊、仆婢的时候呢？

chapters.en:
Therefore, the leprosy of Naaman will cling to you and your descendants forever!”
And as Gehazi left his presence, he was leprous—as white as snow.
chapters.zh: 因此，乃缦的大痲疯必沾染你和你的后裔，直到永远。」基哈西从以利沙面前退出去，就长了大痲疯，像雪〔那样白〕。

chapters.en: Now the sons of the prophets said to Elisha, “Please take note that the place where we meet with you is too small for us.
chapters.zh: 先知门徒对以利沙说：「看哪，我们同你所住的地方过于窄小，

chapters.en:
Please let us go to the Jordan, where each of us can get a log so we can build ourselves a place to live there.”
“Go,” said Elisha.
chapters.zh: 求你容我们往约旦河去，各人从那里取一根木料建造房屋居住。」他说：「你们去吧！」

chapters.en:
Then one of them said, “Please come with your servants.”
“I will come,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 有一人说：「求你与仆人同去。」回答说：「我可以去。」

chapters.en: So Elisha went with them, and when they came to the Jordan, they began to cut down some trees.
chapters.zh: 于是以利沙与他们同去。到了约旦河，就砍伐树木。

chapters.en: As one of them was cutting down a tree, the iron axe head fell into the water. “Oh, my master,” he cried out, “it was borrowed!”
chapters.zh: 有一人砍树的时候，斧头掉在水里，他就呼叫说：「哀哉！我主啊，这斧子是借的。」

chapters.en:
“Where did it fall?” asked the man of God.
And when he showed him the place, the man of God cut a stick, threw it there, and made the iron float.
chapters.zh: 神人问说：「掉在哪里了？」他将那地方指给以利沙看。以利沙砍了一根木头，抛在水里，斧头就漂上来了。

chapters.en: “Lift it out,” he said, and the man reached out his hand and took it.
chapters.zh: 以利沙说：「拿起来吧！」那人就伸手拿起来了。

chapters.en: Now the king of Aram was at war against Israel. After consulting with his servants, he said, “My camp will be in such and such a place.”
chapters.zh: 亚兰王与以色列人争战，和他的臣仆商议说：「我要在某处某处安营。」

chapters.en: Then the man of God sent word to the king of Israel: “Be careful not to pass by this place, for the Arameans are going down there.”
chapters.zh: 神人打发人去见以色列王，说：「你要谨慎，不要从某处经过，因为亚兰人从那里下来了。」

chapters.en: So the king of Israel sent word to the place the man of God had pointed out. Time and again Elisha warned the king, so that he was on his guard in such places.
chapters.zh: 以色列王差人去〔窥探〕神人所告诉所警戒他去的地方，就防备未受其害，不止一两次。

chapters.en: For this reason the king of Aram became enraged and called his servants to demand of them, “Tell me, which one of us is on the side of the king of Israel?”
chapters.zh: 亚兰王因这事心里惊疑，召了臣仆来，对他们说：「我们这里有谁帮助以色列王，你们不指给我吗？」

chapters.en: But one of his servants replied, “No one, my lord the king. For Elisha, the prophet in Israel, tells the king of Israel the very words you speak in your bedroom.”
chapters.zh: 有一个臣仆说：「我主，我王！无人帮助他，只有以色列中的先知以利沙，将王在卧房所说的话告诉以色列王了。」

chapters.en:
So the king said, “Go and see where he is, that I may send men to capture him.”
On receiving the report, “Elisha is in Dothan,”
chapters.zh: 王说：「你们去探他在哪里，我好打发人去捉拿他。」有人告诉王说：「他在多坍。」

chapters.en: the king of Aram sent horses, chariots, and a great army. They went there by night and surrounded the city.
chapters.zh: 王就打发车马和大军往那里去，夜间到了，围困那城。

chapters.en: When the servant of the man of God got up and went out early in the morning, behold, an army with horses and chariots had surrounded the city. So he asked Elisha, “Oh, my master, what are we to do?”
chapters.zh: 神人的仆人清早起来出去，看见车马军兵围困了城。仆人对神人说：「哀哉！我主啊，我们怎样行才好呢？」

chapters.en: “Do not be afraid,” Elisha answered, “for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”
chapters.zh: 神人说：「不要惧怕！与我们同在的比与他们同在的更多。」

chapters.en:
Then Elisha prayed, “O LORD, please open his eyes that he may see.”
And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man, and he saw that the hills were full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.
chapters.zh: 以利沙祷告说：「耶和华啊，求你开这少年人的眼目，使他能看见。」耶和华开他的眼目，他就看见满山有火车火马围绕以利沙。

chapters.en: As the Arameans came down against him, Elisha prayed to the LORD, “Please strike these people with blindness.” So He struck them with blindness, according to the word of Elisha.
chapters.zh: 敌人下到以利沙那里，以利沙祷告耶和华说：「求你使这些人的眼目昏迷。」耶和华就照以利沙的话，使他们的眼目昏迷。

chapters.en: And Elisha told them, “This is not the way, and this is not the city. Follow me, and I will take you to the man you are seeking.” And he led them to Samaria.
chapters.zh: 以利沙对他们说：「这不是那道，也不是那城；你们跟我去，我必领你们到所寻找的人那里。」于是领他们到了撒马利亚。

chapters.en:
When they had entered Samaria, Elisha said, “O LORD, open the eyes of these men that they may see.”
Then the LORD opened their eyes, and they looked around and discovered that they were in Samaria.
chapters.zh: 他们进了撒马利亚，以利沙〔祷告〕说：「耶和华啊，求你开这些人的眼目，使他们能看见。」耶和华开他们的眼目，他们就看见了，不料，是在撒马利亚的城中。

chapters.en: And when the king of Israel saw them, he asked Elisha, “My father, shall I kill them? Shall I kill them?”
chapters.zh: 以色列王见了他们，就问以利沙说：「我父啊，我可以击杀他们吗？」

chapters.en: “Do not kill them,” he replied. “Would you kill those you have captured with your own sword or bow? Set food and water before them, that they may eat and drink and then return to their master.”
chapters.zh: 回答说：「不可击杀他们！就是你用刀用弓掳来的，岂可击杀他们吗〔注：或译：也不可击杀，何况这些人呢〕？当在他们面前设摆饮食，使他们吃喝回到他们的主人那里。」

chapters.en: So the king prepared a great feast for them, and after they had finished eating and drinking, he sent them away, and they returned to their master. And the Aramean raiders did not come into the land of Israel again.
chapters.zh: 王就为他们预备了许多食物；他们吃喝完了，打发他们回到他们主人那里。从此，亚兰军不再犯以色列境了。

chapters.en: Some time later, Ben-hadad king of Aram assembled his entire army and marched up to besiege Samaria.
chapters.zh: 此后，亚兰王便‧哈达聚集他的全军，上来围困撒马利亚。

chapters.en: So there was a great famine in Samaria. Indeed, they besieged the city so long that a donkey’s head sold for eighty shekels of silver, and a quarter cab of dove’s dung sold for five shekels of silver.
chapters.zh: 于是撒马利亚被围困，有饥荒，甚至一个驴头值银八十〔舍客勒〕，二升鸽子粪值银五〔舍客勒〕。

chapters.en: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried out to him, “Help me, my lord the king!”
chapters.zh: 一日，以色列王在城上经过，有一个妇人向他呼叫说：「我主，我王啊！求你帮助。」

chapters.en: He answered, “If the LORD does not help you, where can I find help for you? From the threshing floor or the winepress?”
chapters.zh: 王说：「耶和华不帮助你，我从何处帮助你？是从禾场，是从酒醡呢？」

chapters.en:
Then the king asked her, “What is the matter?”
And she answered, “This woman said to me, ‘Give up your son, that we may eat him, and tomorrow we will eat my son.’
chapters.zh: 王问妇人说：「你有什么苦处？」她回答说：「这妇人对我说：『将你的儿子取来，我们今日可以吃，明日可以吃我的儿子。』

chapters.en: So we boiled my son and ate him, and the next day I said to her, ‘Give up your son, that we may eat him.’ But she had hidden her son.”
chapters.zh: 我们就煮了我的儿子吃了。次日我对她说：『要将你的儿子取来，我们可以吃。』她却将她的儿子藏起来了。」

chapters.en: When the king heard the words of the woman, he tore his clothes. And as he passed by on the wall, the people saw the sackcloth under his clothes next to his skin.
chapters.zh: 王听见妇人的话，就撕裂衣服；（王在城上经过）百姓看见王贴身穿着麻衣。

chapters.en: He announced, “May God punish me, and ever so severely, if the head of Elisha son of Shaphat remains on his shoulders through this day!”
chapters.zh: 王说：「我今日若容沙法的儿子以利沙的头仍在他项上，愿上帝重重地降罚与我！」

chapters.en: Now Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. The king sent a messenger ahead, but before he arrived, Elisha said to the elders, “Do you see how this murderer has sent someone to cut off my head? Look, when the messenger comes, shut the door to keep him out. Is not the sound of his master’s footsteps behind him?”
chapters.zh: 那时，以利沙正坐在家中，长老也与他同坐。〔王〕打发一个伺候他的人去；他还没有到，以利沙对长老说：「你们看这凶手之子，打发人来斩我的头；你们看着使者来到，就关上门，用门将他推出去。在他后头不是有他主人脚步的响声吗？」

chapters.en: While Elisha was still speaking with them, the messenger came down to him. And the king said, “This calamity is from the LORD. Why should I wait for the LORD any longer?”
chapters.zh: 正说话的时候，使者来到，〔王也到了〕，说：「这灾祸是从耶和华那里来的，我何必再仰望耶和华呢？」

chapters.en: Then Elisha said, “Hear the word of the LORD! This is what the LORD says: ‘About this time tomorrow at the gate of Samaria, a seah of fine flour will sell for a shekel, and two seahs of barley will sell for a shekel.’”
chapters.zh: 以利沙说：「你们要听耶和华的话，耶和华如此说：明日约到这时候，在撒马利亚城门口，一细亚细面要〔卖〕银一舍客勒，二细亚大麦也要〔卖〕银一舍客勒。」

chapters.en:
But the officer on whose arm the king leaned answered the man of God, “Look, even if the LORD were to make windows in heaven, could this really happen?”
“You will see it with your own eyes,” replied Elisha, “but you will not eat any of it.”
chapters.zh: 有一个搀扶王的军长对神人说：「即便耶和华使天开了窗户，也不能有这事。」以利沙说：「你必亲眼看见，却不得吃。」

chapters.en: Now there were four men with leprosy at the entrance of the city gate, and they said to one another, “Why just sit here until we die?
chapters.zh: 在城门那里有四个长大痲疯的人，他们彼此说：「我们为何坐在这里等死呢？

chapters.en: If we say, ‘Let us go into the city,’ we will die there from the famine in the city; but if we sit here, we will also die. So come now, let us go over to the camp of the Arameans. If they let us live, we will live; if they kill us, we will die.”
chapters.zh: 我们若说，进城去吧！城里有饥荒，必死在那里；若在这里坐着不动，也必是死。来吧，我们去投降亚兰人的军队，他们若留我们的活命，就活着；若杀我们，就死了吧！」

chapters.en: So they arose at twilight and went to the camp of the Arameans. But when they came to the outskirts of the camp, there was not a man to be found.
chapters.zh: 黄昏的时候，他们起来往亚兰人的营盘去；到了营边，不见一人在那里。

chapters.en: For the Lord had caused the Arameans to hear the sound of chariots, horses, and a great army, so that they said to one another, “Look, the king of Israel must have hired the kings of the Hittites and Egyptians to attack us.”
chapters.zh: 因为主使亚兰人的军队听见车马的声音，是大军的声音；他们就彼此说：「这必是以色列王贿买赫人的诸王和埃及人的诸王来攻击我们。」

chapters.en: Thus the Arameans had arisen and fled at twilight, abandoning their tents and horses and donkeys. The camp was intact, and they had run for their lives.
chapters.zh: 所以，在黄昏的时候他们起来逃跑，撇下帐棚、马、驴，营盘照旧，只顾逃命。

chapters.en: When the lepers reached the edge of the camp, they went into a tent to eat and drink. Then they carried off the silver, gold, and clothing, and went and hid them. On returning, they entered another tent, carried off some items from there, and hid them.
chapters.zh: 那些长大痲疯的到了营边，进了帐棚，吃了喝了，且从其中拿出金银和衣服来，去收藏了；回来又进了一座帐棚，从其中拿出财物来去收藏了。

chapters.en: Finally, they said to one another, “We are not doing what is right. Today is a day of good news. If we are silent and wait until morning light, our sin will overtake us. Now, therefore, let us go and tell the king’s household.”
chapters.zh: 那时，他们彼此说：「我们所做的不好！今日是有好信息的日子，我们竟不作声！若等到天亮，罪必临到我们。来吧，我们与王家报信去！」

chapters.en: So they went and called out to the gatekeepers of the city, saying, “We went to the Aramean camp and no one was there—not a trace—only tethered horses and donkeys, and the tents were intact.”
chapters.zh: 他们就去叫守城门的，告诉他们说：「我们到了亚兰人的营，不见一人在那里，也无人声，只有拴着的马和驴，帐棚都照旧。」

chapters.en: The gatekeepers shouted the news, and it was reported to the king’s household.
chapters.zh: 守城门的叫了众守门的人来，他们就进去与王家报信。

chapters.en: So the king got up in the night and said to his servants, “Let me tell you what the Arameans have done to us. They know we are starving, so they have left the camp to hide in the field, thinking, ‘When they come out of the city, we will take them alive and enter the city.’”
chapters.zh: 王夜间起来，对臣仆说：「我告诉你们亚兰人向我们如何行。他们知道我们饥饿，所以离营，埋伏在田野，说：『以色列人出城的时候，我们就活捉他们，得以进城。』」

chapters.en: But one of his servants replied, “Please, have scouts take five of the horses that remain in the city. Their plight will be no worse than all the Israelites who are left here. You can see that all the Israelites here are doomed. So let us send them and find out.”
chapters.zh: 有一个臣仆对王说：「我们不如用城里剩下之马中的五匹马（马和城里剩下的以色列人都是一样，快要灭绝），打发人去窥探。」

chapters.en: Then the scouts took two chariots with horses, and the king sent them after the Aramean army, saying, “Go and see.”
chapters.zh: 于是取了两辆车和马，王差人去追寻亚兰军，说：「你们去窥探窥探。」

chapters.en: And they tracked them as far as the Jordan, and indeed, the whole way was littered with the clothing and equipment the Arameans had thrown off in haste. So the scouts returned and told the king.
chapters.zh: 他们就追寻到约旦河，看见满道上都是亚兰人急跑时丢弃的衣服器具，使者就回来报告王。

chapters.en: Then the people went out and plundered the camp of the Arameans. It was then that a seah of fine flour sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley sold for a shekel, according to the word of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 众人就出去，掳掠亚兰人的营盘。于是一细亚细面〔卖〕银一舍客勒，二细亚大麦也〔卖〕银一舍客勒，正如耶和华所说的。

chapters.en: Now the king had appointed the officer on whose arm he leaned to be in charge of the gate, but the people trampled him in the gateway, and he died, just as the man of God had foretold when the king had come to him.
chapters.zh: 王派搀扶他的那军长在城门口弹压，众人在那里将他践踏，他就死了，正如神人在王下来见他的时候所说的。

chapters.en: It happened just as the man of God had told the king: “About this time tomorrow at the gate of Samaria, two seahs of barley will sell for a shekel, and a seah of fine flour will sell for a shekel.”
chapters.zh: 神人曾对王说：「明日约到这时候，在撒马利亚城门口，二细亚大麦要〔卖〕银一舍客勒，一细亚细面也要〔卖〕银一舍客勒。」

chapters.en:
And the officer had answered the man of God, “Look, even if the LORD were to make windows in heaven, could this really happen?”
So Elisha had replied, “You will see it with your own eyes, but you will not eat any of it!”
chapters.zh: 那军长对神人说：「即便耶和华使天开了窗户，也不能有这事。」神人说：「你必亲眼看见，却不得吃。」

chapters.en: And that is just what happened to him. The people trampled him in the gateway, and he died.
chapters.zh: 这话果然应验在他身上；因为众人在城门口将他践踏，他就死了。

chapters.en: Now Elisha had said to the woman whose son he had restored to life, “Arise, you and your household; go and live as a foreigner wherever you can. For the LORD has decreed that a seven-year famine will come to the land.”
chapters.zh: 以利沙曾对所救活之子的那妇人说：「你和你的全家要起身往你可住的地方去住，因为耶和华命饥荒降在这地七年。」

chapters.en: So the woman had proceeded to do as the man of God had instructed. And she and her household lived as foreigners for seven years in the land of the Philistines.
chapters.zh: 妇人就起身，照神人的话带着全家往非利士地去，住了七年。

chapters.en: At the end of seven years, when the woman returned from the land of the Philistines, she went to the king to appeal for her house and her land.
chapters.zh: 七年完了，那妇人从非利士地回来，就出去为自己的房屋田地哀告王。

chapters.en: Now the king had been speaking to Gehazi, the servant of the man of God, saying, “Please relate to me all the great things Elisha has done.”
chapters.zh: 那时王正与神人的仆人基哈西说：「请你将以利沙所行的一切大事告诉我。」

chapters.en: And Gehazi was telling the king how Elisha had brought the dead back to life. Just then the woman whose son Elisha had revived came to appeal to the king for her house and her land. So Gehazi said, “My lord the king, this is the woman, and this is the son Elisha restored to life.”
chapters.zh: 基哈西告诉王以利沙如何使死人复活，恰巧以利沙所救活、她儿子的那妇人为自己的房屋田地来哀告王。基哈西说：「我主我王，这就是那妇人，这是她的儿子，就是以利沙所救活的。」

chapters.en: When the king asked the woman, she confirmed it. So the king appointed for her an officer, saying, “Restore all that was hers, along with all the proceeds of the field from the day that she left the country until now.”
chapters.zh: 王问那妇人，她就把那事告诉王。于是王为她派一个太监，说：「凡属这妇人的都还给她，自从她离开本地直到今日，她田地的出产也都还给她。」

chapters.en: Then Elisha came to Damascus while Ben-hadad king of Aram was sick, and the king was told, “The man of God has come here.”
chapters.zh: 以利沙来到大马士革，亚兰王便‧哈达正患病。有人告诉王说：「神人来到这里了。」

chapters.en: So the king said to Hazael, “Take a gift in your hand, go to meet the man of God, and inquire of the LORD through him, ‘Will I recover from this illness?’”
chapters.zh: 王就吩咐哈薛说：「你带着礼物去见神人，讬他求问耶和华，我这病能好不能好？」

chapters.en: So Hazael went to meet Elisha, taking with him a gift of forty camel loads of every good thing from Damascus. And he went in and stood before him and said, “Your son Ben-hadad king of Aram has sent me to ask, ‘Will I recover from this illness?’”
chapters.zh: 于是哈薛用四十个骆驼，驮着大马士革的各样美物为礼物，去见以利沙。到了他那里，站在他面前，说：「你儿子亚兰王便‧哈达打发我来见你，他问说：『我这病能好不能好？』」

chapters.en: Elisha answered, “Go and tell him, ‘You will surely recover.’ But the LORD has shown me that in fact he will die.”
chapters.zh: 以利沙对哈薛说：「你回去告诉他说，这病必能好；但耶和华指示我，他必要死。」

chapters.en: Elisha fixed his gaze steadily on him until Hazael became uncomfortable. Then the man of God began to weep.
chapters.zh: 神人定睛看着哈薛，甚至他惭愧。神人就哭了；

chapters.en:
“Why is my lord weeping?” asked Hazael.
“Because I know the evil you will do to the Israelites,” Elisha replied. “You will set fire to their fortresses, kill their young men with the sword, dash their little ones to pieces, and rip open their pregnant women.”
chapters.zh: 哈薛说：「我主为什么哭？」回答说：「因为我知道你必苦害以色列人，用火焚烧他们的保障，用刀杀死他们的壮丁，摔死他们的婴孩，剖开他们的孕妇。」

chapters.en:
“But how could your servant, a mere dog, do such a monstrous thing?” said Hazael.
And Elisha answered, “The LORD has shown me that you will be king over Aram.”
chapters.zh: 哈薛说：「你仆人算什么，不过是一条狗，焉能行这大事呢？」以利沙回答说：「耶和华指示我，你必作亚兰王。」

chapters.en:
So Hazael left Elisha and went to his master, who asked him, “What did Elisha say to you?”
And he replied, “He told me that you would surely recover.”
chapters.zh: 哈薛离开以利沙，回去见他的主人。主人问他说：「以利沙对你说什么？」回答说：「他告诉我你必能好。」

chapters.en:
But the next day Hazael took a thick cloth, dipped it in water, and spread it over the king’s face.
So Ben-hadad died, and Hazael reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 次日，哈薛拿被窝浸在水中，蒙住王的脸，王就死了。于是哈薛篡了他的位。

chapters.en: In the fifth year of the reign of Joram son of Ahab over Israel, Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat succeeded his father as king of Judah.
chapters.zh: 以色列王亚哈的儿子约兰第五年，犹大王约沙法还在位的时候，约沙法的儿子约兰登基作了犹大王。

chapters.en: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years.
chapters.zh: 约兰登基的时候年三十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王八年。

chapters.en: And Jehoram walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, just as the house of Ahab had done. For he married a daughter of Ahab and did evil in the sight of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他行以色列诸王所行的，与亚哈家一样；因为他娶了亚哈的女儿为妻，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事。

chapters.en: Yet for the sake of His servant David, the LORD was unwilling to destroy Judah, since He had promised to maintain a lamp for David and his descendants forever.
chapters.zh: 耶和华却因他仆人大卫的缘故，仍不肯灭绝犹大，照他所应许大卫的话，永远赐灯光与他的子孙。

chapters.en: In the days of Jehoram, Edom rebelled against the hand of Judah and appointed their own king.
chapters.zh: 约兰年间，以东人背叛犹大，脱离他的权下，自己立王。

chapters.en: So Jehoram crossed over to Zair with all his chariots. When the Edomites surrounded him and his chariot commanders, he rose up and attacked by night. His troops, however, fled to their homes.
chapters.zh: 约兰率领所有的战车往撒益去，夜间起来，攻打围困他的以东人和车〔兵〕长；犹大兵就逃跑，各回各家去了。

chapters.en: So to this day Edom has been in rebellion against the hand of Judah. Likewise, Libnah rebelled at the same time.
chapters.zh: 这样，以东人背叛犹大，脱离他的权下，直到今日。那时立拿人也背叛了。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoram, along with all his accomplishments, are they not written in the book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 约兰其余的事，凡他所行的，都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: And Jehoram rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David. And his son Ahaziah reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 约兰与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子亚哈谢接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the twelfth year of the reign of Joram son of Ahab over Israel, Ahaziah son of Jehoram became king of Judah.
chapters.zh: 以色列王亚哈的儿子约兰十二年，犹大王约兰的儿子亚哈谢登基。

chapters.en: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem one year. His mother’s name was Athaliah, the granddaughter of Omri king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 他登基的时候年二十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王一年。他母亲名叫亚她利雅，是以色列王暗利的孙女。

chapters.en: And Ahaziah walked in the ways of the house of Ahab and did evil in the sight of the LORD like the house of Ahab, for he was a son-in-law of the house of Ahab.
chapters.zh: 亚哈谢效法亚哈家行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，与亚哈家一样，因为他是亚哈家的女婿。

chapters.en: Then Ahaziah went with Joram son of Ahab to fight against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth-gilead, and the Arameans wounded Joram.
chapters.zh: 他与亚哈的儿子约兰同往基列的拉末去，与亚兰王哈薛争战。亚兰人打伤了约兰，

chapters.en: So King Joram returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds that the Arameans had inflicted on him at Ramah when he fought against Hazael king of Aram. Then Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to Jezreel to visit Joram son of Ahab, because Joram had been wounded.
chapters.zh: 约兰王回到耶斯列，医治在拉末与亚兰王哈薛打仗的时候所受的伤。犹大王约兰的儿子亚哈谢因为亚哈的儿子约兰病了，就下到耶斯列看望他。

chapters.en: Now Elisha the prophet summoned one of the sons of the prophets and said to him, “Tuck your cloak under your belt, take this flask of oil, and go to Ramoth-gilead.
chapters.zh: 先知以利沙叫了一个先知门徒来，吩咐他说：「你束上腰，手拿这瓶膏油往基列的拉末去。

chapters.en: When you arrive, look for Jehu son of Jehoshaphat, the son of Nimshi. Go in, get him away from his companions, and take him to an inner room.
chapters.zh: 到了那里，要寻找宁示的孙子、约沙法的儿子耶户，使他从同僚中起来，带他进严密的屋子，

chapters.en: Then take the flask of oil, pour it on his head, and declare, ‘This is what the LORD says: I anoint you king over Israel.’ Then open the door and run. Do not delay!”
chapters.zh: 将瓶里的膏油倒在他头上，说：『耶和华如此说：我膏你作以色列王。』〔说完了〕，就开门逃跑，不要迟延。」

chapters.en: So the young prophet went to Ramoth-gilead,
chapters.zh: 于是那少年先知往基列的拉末去了。

chapters.en:
and when he arrived, the army commanders were sitting there. “I have a message for you, commander,” he said.
“For which of us?” asked Jehu.
“For you, commander,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 到了那里，看见众军长都坐着，就说：「将军哪，我有话对你说。」耶户说：「我们众人里，你要对哪一个说呢？」回答说：「将军哪，我要对你说。」

chapters.en: So Jehu got up and went into the house, where the young prophet poured the oil on his head and declared, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I anoint you king over the LORD’s people Israel.
chapters.zh: 耶户就起来，进了屋子，少年人将膏油倒在他头上，对他说：「耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：『我膏你作耶和华民以色列的王。

chapters.en: And you are to strike down the house of your master Ahab, so that I may avenge the blood of My servants the prophets and the blood of all the servants of the LORD shed by the hand of Jezebel.
chapters.zh: 你要击杀你主人亚哈的全家，我好在耶洗别身上伸我仆人众先知和耶和华一切仆人流血的冤。

chapters.en: The whole house of Ahab will perish, and I will cut off from Ahab every male, both slave and free, in Israel.
chapters.zh: 亚哈全家必都灭亡，凡属亚哈的男丁，无论是困住的、自由的，我必从以色列中剪除，

chapters.en: I will make the house of Ahab like the houses of Jeroboam son of Nebat and Baasha son of Ahijah.
chapters.zh: 使亚哈的家像尼八儿子耶罗波安的家，又像亚希雅儿子巴沙的家。

chapters.en:
And on the plot of ground at Jezreel the dogs will devour Jezebel, and there will be no one to bury her.’”
Then the young prophet opened the door and ran.
chapters.zh: 耶洗别必在耶斯列田里被狗所吃，无人葬埋。』」〔说完了〕，少年人就开门逃跑了。

chapters.en:
When Jehu went out to the servants of his master, they asked, “Is everything all right? Why did this madman come to you?”
“You know his kind and their babble,” he replied.
chapters.zh: 耶户出来，回到他主人的臣仆那里，有一人问他说：「平安吗？这狂妄的人来见你有什么事呢？」回答说：「你们认得那人，也知道他说什么。」

chapters.en:
