“That is a lie!” they said. “Tell us now!”
So Jehu answered, “He talked to me about this and that, saying, ‘This is what the LORD says: I anoint you king over Israel.’”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「这是假话，你据实地告诉我们。」回答说：「他如此如此对我说。他说：『耶和华如此说：我膏你作以色列王。』」

chapters.en: Quickly, each man took his garment and put it under Jehu on the bare steps. Then they blew the ram’s horn and proclaimed, “Jehu is king!”
chapters.zh: 他们就急忙各将自己的衣服铺在上层台阶，使耶户坐在其上；他们吹角，说：「耶户作王了！」

chapters.en:
Thus Jehu son of Jehoshaphat, the son of Nimshi, conspired against Joram.
(Now Joram and all Israel had been defending Ramoth-gilead against Hazael king of Aram,
chapters.zh: 这样，宁示的孙子、约沙法的儿子耶户背叛约兰。先是约兰和以色列众人因为亚兰王哈薛的缘故，把守基列的拉末；

chapters.en:
but King Joram had returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds he had suffered at the hands of the Arameans in the battle against Hazael their king.)
So Jehu said, “If you commanders wish to make me king, then do not let anyone escape from the city to go and tell it in Jezreel.”
chapters.zh: 但约兰王回到耶斯列，医治与亚兰王哈薛打仗所受的伤。耶户说：「若合你们的意思，就不容人逃出城往耶斯列报信去。」

chapters.en: Then Jehu got into his chariot and went to Jezreel, because Joram was laid up there. And Ahaziah king of Judah had gone down to see him.
chapters.zh: 于是耶户坐车往耶斯列去，因为约兰病卧在那里。犹大王亚哈谢已经下去看望他。

chapters.en:
Now the watchman standing on the tower in Jezreel saw Jehu’s troops approaching, and he called out, “I see a company of troops!”
“Choose a rider,” Joram commanded. “Send him out to meet them and ask, ‘Have you come in peace?’”
chapters.zh: 有一个守望的人站在耶斯列的楼上，看见耶户带着一群人来，就说：「我看见一群人。」约兰说：「打发一个骑马的去迎接他们，问说：平安不平安？」

chapters.en:
So a horseman rode off to meet Jehu and said, “This is what the king asks: ‘Have you come in peace?’”
“What do you know about peace?” Jehu replied. “Fall in behind me.”
And the watchman reported, “The messenger reached them, but he is not coming back.”
chapters.zh: 骑马的就去迎接耶户，说：「王问说，平安不平安？」耶户说：「平安不平安与你何干？你转在我后头吧！」守望的人又说：「使者到了他们那里，却不回来。」

chapters.en:
So the king sent out a second horseman, who went to them and said, “This is what the king asks: ‘Have you come in peace?’”
“What do you know about peace?” Jehu replied. “Fall in behind me.”
chapters.zh: 王又打发一个骑马的去。这人到了他们那里，说：「王问说，平安不平安？」耶户说：「平安不平安与你何干？你转在我后头吧！」

chapters.en: Again the watchman reported, “He reached them, but he is not coming back. And the charioteer is driving like Jehu son of Nimshi —he is driving like a madman!”
chapters.zh: 守望的人又说：「他到了他们那里，也不回来；车赶得甚猛，像宁示的孙子耶户的赶法。」

chapters.en:
“Harness!” Joram shouted, and they harnessed his chariot.
Then Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah set out, each in his own chariot, and met Jehu on the property of Naboth the Jezreelite.
chapters.zh: 约兰吩咐说：「套车！」人就给他套车。以色列王约兰和犹大王亚哈谢各坐自己的车出去迎接耶户，在耶斯列人拿伯的田那里遇见他。

chapters.en:
When Joram saw Jehu, he asked, “Have you come in peace, Jehu?”
“How can there be peace,” he replied, “as long as the idolatry and witchcraft of your mother Jezebel abound?”
chapters.zh: 约兰见耶户就说：「耶户啊，平安吗？」耶户说：「你母亲耶洗别的淫行邪术这样多，焉能平安呢？」

chapters.en: Joram turned around and fled, calling out to Ahaziah, “Treachery, Ahaziah!”
chapters.zh: 约兰就转车逃跑，对亚哈谢说：「亚哈谢啊，反了！」

chapters.en: Then Jehu drew his bow and shot Joram between the shoulders. The arrow pierced his heart, and he slumped down in his chariot.
chapters.zh: 耶户开满了弓，射中约兰的脊背，箭从心窝穿出，约兰就仆倒在车上。

chapters.en: And Jehu said to Bidkar his officer, “Pick him up and throw him into the field of Naboth the Jezreelite. For remember that when you and I were riding together behind his father Ahab, the LORD lifted up this burden against him:
chapters.zh: 耶户对他的军长毕甲说：「你把他抛在耶斯列人拿伯的田间。你当追想，你我一同坐车跟随他父亚哈的时候，耶和华对亚哈所说的预言，

chapters.en: ‘As surely as I saw the blood of Naboth and the blood of his sons yesterday, declares the LORD, so will I repay you on this plot of ground, declares the LORD.’ Now then, according to the word of the LORD, pick him up and throw him on the plot of ground.”
chapters.zh: 说：『我昨日看见拿伯的血和他众子的血，我必在这块田上报应你。』这是耶和华说的，现在你要照着耶和华的话，把他抛在这田间。」

chapters.en:
When King Ahaziah of Judah saw this, he fled up the road toward Beth-haggan.
And Jehu pursued him, shouting, “Shoot him too!”
So they shot Ahaziah in his chariot on the Ascent of Gur, near Ibleam, and he fled to Megiddo and died there.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚哈谢见这光景，就从园亭之路逃跑。耶户追赶他，说：「把这人也杀在车上。」到了靠近以伯莲的姑珥坡上〔击伤了他〕。他逃到米吉多，就死在那里。

chapters.en: Then his servants carried him by chariot to Jerusalem and buried him with his fathers in his tomb in the City of David.
chapters.zh: 他的臣仆用车将他的尸首送到耶路撒冷，葬在大卫城他自己的坟墓里，与他列祖同葬。

chapters.en: (In the eleventh year of Joram son of Ahab, Ahaziah had become king over Judah.)
chapters.zh: 亚哈谢登基作犹大王的时候，是在亚哈的儿子约兰第十一年。

chapters.en: Now when Jehu arrived in Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it. So she painted her eyes, adorned her head, and looked down from a window.
chapters.zh: 耶户到了耶斯列；耶洗别听见就擦粉、梳头，从窗户里往外观看。

chapters.en: And as Jehu entered the gate, she asked, “Have you come in peace, O Zimri, murderer of your master?”
chapters.zh: 耶户进门的时候，耶洗别说：「杀主人的心利啊，平安吗？」

chapters.en:
He looked up at the window and called out, “Who is on my side? Who?”
And two or three eunuchs looked down at him.
chapters.zh: 耶户抬头向窗户观看，说：「谁顺从我？」有两三个太监从窗户往外看他。

chapters.en:
“Throw her down!” yelled Jehu.
So they threw her down, and her blood splattered on the wall and on the horses as they trampled her underfoot.
chapters.zh: 耶户说：「把她扔下来！」他们就把她扔下来。她的血溅在墙上和马上；于是把她践踏了。

chapters.en: Then Jehu went in and ate and drank. “Take care of this cursed woman,” he said, “and bury her, for she was the daughter of a king.”
chapters.zh: 耶户进去，吃了喝了，吩咐说：「你们把这被咒诅的妇人葬埋了，因为她是王的女儿。」

chapters.en: But when they went out to bury her, they found nothing but her skull, her feet, and the palms of her hands.
chapters.zh: 他们就去葬埋她，只寻得她的头骨和脚，并手掌。

chapters.en: So they went back and told Jehu, who replied, “This is the word of the LORD, which He spoke through His servant Elijah the Tishbite: ‘On the plot of ground at Jezreel the dogs will devour the flesh of Jezebel.
chapters.zh: 他们回去告诉耶户，耶户说：「这正应验耶和华藉他仆人提斯比人以利亚所说的话，说：『在耶斯列田间，狗必吃耶洗别的肉；

chapters.en: And Jezebel’s body will lie like dung in the field on the plot of ground at Jezreel, so that no one can say: This is Jezebel.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶洗别的尸首必在耶斯列田间如同粪土，甚至人不能说这是耶洗别。』」

chapters.en: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. So Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria to the officials of Jezreel, to the elders, and to the guardians of the sons of Ahab, saying:
chapters.zh: 亚哈有七十个儿子在撒马利亚。耶户写信送到撒马利亚，通知耶斯列的首领，就是长老和教养亚哈〔众子〕的人，说：

chapters.en: “When this letter arrives, since your master’s sons are with you and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city and weaponry,
chapters.zh: 「你们那里既有你们主人的众子和车马、器械、坚固城，

chapters.en: select the best and most worthy son of your master, set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.”
chapters.zh: 接了这信，就可以在你们主人的众子中选择一个贤能合宜的，使他坐他父亲的位，你们也可以为你们主人的家争战。」

chapters.en: But they were terrified and reasoned, “If two kings could not stand against him, how can we?”
chapters.zh: 他们却甚惧怕，彼此说：「二王在他面前尚且站立不住，我们怎能站得住呢？」

chapters.en: So the palace administrator, the overseer of the city, the elders, and the guardians sent a message to Jehu: “We are your servants, and we will do whatever you say. We will not make anyone king. Do whatever is good in your sight.”
chapters.zh: 家宰、邑宰，和长老，并教养〔众子〕的人，打发人去见耶户，说：「我们是你的仆人，凡你所吩咐我们的都必遵行，我们不立谁作王，你看怎样好就怎样行。」

chapters.en:
Then Jehu wrote them a second letter and said: “If you are on my side, and if you will obey me, then bring the heads of your master’s sons to me at Jezreel by this time tomorrow.”
Now the sons of the king, seventy in all, were being brought up by the leading men of the city.
chapters.zh: 耶户又给他们写信说：「你们若归顺我，听从我的话，明日这时候，要将你们主人众子的首级带到耶斯列来见我。」那时王的儿子七十人都住在教养他们那城中的尊贵人家里。

chapters.en: And when the letter arrived, they took the sons of the king and slaughtered all seventy of them. They put their heads in baskets and sent them to Jehu at Jezreel.
chapters.zh: 信一到，他们就把王的七十个儿子杀了，将首级装在筐里，送到在耶斯列的耶户那里。

chapters.en:
When the messenger arrived, he told Jehu, “They have brought the heads of the sons of the king.”
And Jehu ordered, “Pile them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until morning.”
chapters.zh: 有使者来告诉耶户说：「他们将王众子的首级送来了。」耶户说：「将首级在城门口堆作两堆，搁到明日。」

chapters.en: The next morning, Jehu went out and stood before all the people and said, “You are innocent. It was I who conspired against my master and killed him. But who killed all these?
chapters.zh: 次日早晨，耶户出来，站着对众民说：「你们都是公义的，我背叛我主人，将他杀了；这些人却是谁杀的呢？

chapters.en: Know, then, that not a word the LORD has spoken against the house of Ahab will fail, for the LORD has done what He promised through His servant Elijah.”
chapters.zh: 由此可知，耶和华指着亚哈家所说的话一句没有落空，因为耶和华藉他仆人以利亚所说的话都成就了。」

chapters.en: So Jehu killed everyone in Jezreel who remained of the house of Ahab, as well as all his great men and close friends and priests, leaving him without a single survivor.
chapters.zh: 凡亚哈家在耶斯列所剩下的人和他的大臣、密友、祭司，耶户尽都杀了，没有留下一个。

chapters.en: Then Jehu set out toward Samaria. At Beth-eked of the Shepherds,
chapters.zh: 耶户起身往撒马利亚去。在路上、牧人剪羊毛之处，

chapters.en:
Jehu met some relatives of Ahaziah king of Judah and asked, “Who are you?”
“We are relatives of Ahaziah,” they answered, “and we have come down to greet the sons of the king and of the queen mother.”
chapters.zh: 遇见犹大王亚哈谢的弟兄，问他们说：「你们是谁？」回答说：「我们是亚哈谢的弟兄，现在下去要问王和太后的众子安。」

chapters.en: Then Jehu ordered, “Take them alive.” So his men took them alive, then slaughtered them at the well of Beth-eked—forty-two men. He spared none of them.
chapters.zh: 耶户吩咐说：「活捉他们！」跟从的人就活捉了他们，将他们杀在剪羊毛之处的坑边，共四十二人，没有留下一个。

chapters.en:
When he left there, he found Jehonadab son of Rechab, who was coming to meet him. Jehu greeted him and asked, “Is your heart as true to mine as my heart is to yours?”
“It is!” Jehonadab replied.
“If it is,” said Jehu, “give me your hand.”
So he gave him his hand, and Jehu helped him into his chariot,
chapters.zh: 耶户从那里前行，恰遇利甲的儿子约拿达来迎接他，耶户问他安，对他说：「你诚心待我像我诚心待你吗？」约拿达回答说：「是。」耶户说：「若是这样，你向我伸手」，他就伸手；耶户拉他上车。

chapters.en: saying, “Come with me and see my zeal for the LORD!” So he had him ride in his chariot.
chapters.zh: 耶户说：「你和我同去，看我为耶和华怎样热心」；于是请他坐在车上，

chapters.en: When Jehu came to Samaria, he struck down everyone belonging to Ahab who remained there, until he had destroyed them, according to the word that the LORD had spoken to Elijah.
chapters.zh: 到了撒马利亚，就把撒马利亚的亚哈家剩下的人都杀了，直到灭尽，正如耶和华对以利亚所说的。

chapters.en: Then Jehu brought all the people together and said, “Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him a lot.
chapters.zh: 耶户招聚众民，对他们说：「亚哈事奉巴力还冷淡，耶户却更热心。

chapters.en:
Now, therefore, summon to me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests. See that no one is missing, for I have a great sacrifice for Baal. Whoever is missing will not live.”
But Jehu was acting deceptively in order to destroy the servants of Baal.
chapters.zh: 现在我要给巴力献大祭。应当叫巴力的众先知和一切拜巴力的人，并巴力的众祭司，都到我这里来，不可缺少一个；凡不来的必不得活。」耶户这样行，是用诡计要杀尽拜巴力的人。

chapters.en: And Jehu commanded, “Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal.” So they announced it.
chapters.zh: 耶户说：「要为巴力宣告严肃会！」于是宣告了。

chapters.en: Then Jehu sent word throughout Israel, and all the servants of Baal came; there was not a man who failed to show. They entered the temple of Baal, and it was filled from end to end.
chapters.zh: 耶户差人走遍以色列地；凡拜巴力的人都来齐了，没有一个不来的。他们进了巴力庙，巴力庙中从前边直到后边都满了人。

chapters.en: And Jehu said to the keeper of the wardrobe, “Bring out garments for all the servants of Baal.” So he brought out garments for them.
chapters.zh: 耶户吩咐掌管礼服的人说：「拿出礼服来，给一切拜巴力的人穿。」他就拿出礼服来给了他们。

chapters.en: Next, Jehu and Jehonadab son of Rechab entered the temple of Baal, and Jehu said to the servants of Baal, “Look around to see that there are no servants of the LORD here among you—only servants of Baal.”
chapters.zh: 耶户和利甲的儿子约拿达进了巴力庙，对拜巴力的人说：「你们察看察看，在你们这里不可有耶和华的仆人，只可容留拜巴力的人。」

chapters.en: And they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had stationed eighty men outside and warned them, “If anyone allows one of the men I am delivering into your hands to escape, he will forfeit his life for theirs.”
chapters.zh: 耶户和约拿达进去，献〔平安〕祭和燔祭。 耶户先安派八十人在庙外，吩咐说：「我将这些人交在你们手中，若有一人脱逃，〔谁放的〕必叫他偿命！」

chapters.en:
When he had finished making the burnt offering, Jehu said to the guards and officers, “Go in and kill them. Do not let anyone out.”
So the guards and officers put them to the sword, threw the bodies out, and went into the inner room of the temple of Baal.
chapters.zh: 耶户献完了燔祭，就〔出来〕吩咐护卫兵和众军长说：「你们进去杀他们，不容一人出来！」护卫兵和军长就用刀杀他们，将尸首抛出去，便到巴力庙的城去了，

chapters.en: They brought out the sacred pillar of the temple of Baal and burned it.
chapters.zh: 将巴力庙中的柱像都拿出来烧了；

chapters.en: They also demolished the sacred pillar of Baal. Then they tore down the temple of Baal and made it into a latrine, which it is to this day.
chapters.zh: 毁坏了巴力柱像，拆毁了巴力庙作为厕所，直到今日。

chapters.en: Thus Jehu eradicated Baal from Israel,
chapters.zh: 这样，耶户在以色列中灭了巴力。

chapters.en: but he did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit—the worship of the golden calves at Bethel and Dan.
chapters.zh: 只是耶户不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，就是拜伯特利和但的金牛犊。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, the LORD said to Jehu, “Because you have done well in carrying out what is right in My sight and have done to the house of Ahab all that was in My heart, four generations of your sons will sit on the throne of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对耶户说：「因你办好我眼中看为正的事，照我的心意待亚哈家，你的子孙必接续你坐以色列的国位，直到四代。」

chapters.en: Yet Jehu was not careful to follow the instruction of the LORD, the God of Israel, with all his heart. He did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.zh: 只是耶户不尽心遵守耶和华－以色列上帝的律法，不离开耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。

chapters.en: In those days the LORD began to reduce the size of Israel. Hazael defeated the Israelites throughout their territory
chapters.zh: 在那些日子，耶和华才割裂以色列国，使哈薛攻击以色列的境界，

chapters.en: from the Jordan eastward through all the land of Gilead (the region of Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh), and from Aroer by the Arnon Valley through Gilead to Bashan.
chapters.zh: 乃是约旦河东、基列全地，从靠近亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥起，就是基列和巴珊的迦得人、吕便人、玛拿西人之地。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Jehu, along with all his accomplishments and all his might, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 耶户其余的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: And Jehu rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoahaz reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 耶户与他列祖同睡，葬在撒马利亚；他儿子约哈斯接续他作王。

chapters.en: So the duration of Jehu’s reign over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.
chapters.zh: 耶户在撒马利亚作以色列王二十八年。

chapters.en: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she proceeded to annihilate all the royal heirs.
chapters.zh: 亚哈谢的母亲亚她利雅见她儿子死了，就起来剿灭王室。

chapters.en: But Jehosheba daughter of King Joram, the sister of Ahaziah, took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the sons of the king who were being murdered. She put him and his nurse in a bedroom to hide him from Athaliah, and he was not killed.
chapters.zh: 但约兰王的女儿，亚哈谢的妹子约示巴，将亚哈谢的儿子约阿施从那被杀的王子中偷出来，把他和他的乳母都〔藏〕在卧房里，躲避亚她利雅，免得被杀。

chapters.en: And Joash remained hidden with his nurse in the house of the LORD for six years while Athaliah ruled the land.
chapters.zh: 约阿施和他的乳母藏在耶和华的殿里六年；亚她利雅篡了国位。

chapters.en:
Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada sent for the commanders of hundreds, the Carites, and the guards, and had them brought into the house of the LORD. There he made a covenant with them and put them under oath.
He showed them the king’s son
chapters.zh: 第七年，耶何耶大打发人叫迦利人〔注：或译：亲兵〕和护卫兵的众百夫长来，领他们进了耶和华的殿，与他们立约，使他们在耶和华殿里起誓，又将王的儿子指给他们看，

chapters.en: and commanded them, “This is what you are to do: A third of you who come on duty on the Sabbath shall guard the royal palace,
chapters.zh: 吩咐他们说：「你们当这样行：凡安息日进班的三分之一要看守王宫，

chapters.en: a third shall be at the gate of Sur, and a third at the gate behind the guards. You are to take turns guarding the temple—
chapters.zh: 三分之一要在苏珥门，三分之一要在护卫兵院的后门。这样把守王宫，拦阻闲人。

chapters.en: the two divisions that would go off duty on the Sabbath are to guard the house of the LORD for the king.
chapters.zh: 你们安息日所有出班的三分之二要在耶和华的殿里护卫王；

chapters.en: You must surround the king with weapons in hand, and anyone who approaches the ranks must be put to death. You must stay close to the king wherever he goes.”
chapters.zh: 各人手拿兵器，四围护卫王。凡擅入你们班次的必当治死，王出入的时候，你们当跟随他。」

chapters.en: So the commanders of hundreds did everything that Jehoiada the priest had ordered. Each of them took his men—those coming on duty on the Sabbath and those going off duty—and came to Jehoiada the priest.
chapters.zh: 众百夫长就照着祭司耶何耶大一切所吩咐的去行，各带所管安息日进班出班的人来见祭司耶何耶大。

chapters.en: Then the priest gave to the commanders of hundreds the spears and shields of King David from the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 祭司便将耶和华殿里所藏大卫王的枪和盾牌交给百夫长。

chapters.en: And the guards stood with weapons in hand surrounding the king by the altar and the temple, from the south side to the north side of the temple.
chapters.zh: 护卫兵手中各拿兵器，在坛和殿那里，从殿右直到殿左，站在王子的四围。

chapters.en: Then Jehoiada brought out the king’s son, put the crown on him, presented him with the Testimony, and proclaimed him king. They anointed him, and the people clapped their hands and declared, “Long live the king!”
chapters.zh: 祭司领王子出来，给他戴上冠冕，将律法〔书交给他〕，膏他作王；众人就拍掌说：「愿王万岁！」

chapters.en: When Athaliah heard the noise from the guards and the people, she went out to the people in the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 亚她利雅听见护卫兵和民的声音，就到民那里，进耶和华的殿，

chapters.en:
And she looked out and saw the king standing by the pillar, according to the custom. The officers and trumpeters were beside the king, and all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets.
Then Athaliah tore her clothes and screamed, “Treason! Treason!”
chapters.zh: 看见王照例站在柱旁，百夫长和吹号的人侍立在王左右，国中的众民欢乐吹号；亚她利雅就撕裂衣服，喊叫说：「反了！反了！」

chapters.en: And Jehoiada the priest ordered the commanders of hundreds in charge of the army, “Bring her out between the ranks, and put to the sword anyone who follows her.” For the priest had said, “She must not be put to death in the house of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 祭司耶何耶大吩咐管辖军兵的百夫长说：「将她赶出班外，凡跟随她的必用刀杀死！」因为祭司说「不可在耶和华殿里杀她」，

chapters.en: So they seized Athaliah as she reached the horses’ entrance to the palace grounds, and there she was put to death.
chapters.zh: 众兵就闪开让她去；她从马路上王宫去，便在那里被杀。

chapters.en: Then Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people that they would be the LORD’s people. He also made a covenant between the king and the people.
chapters.zh: 耶何耶大使王和民与耶和华立约，作耶和华的民；又使王与民立约。

chapters.en:
So all the people of the land went to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols to pieces, and they killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.
And Jehoiada the priest posted guards for the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 于是国民都到巴力庙，拆毁了庙，打碎坛和像，又在坛前将巴力的祭司玛坦杀了。祭司耶何耶大派官看守耶和华的殿，

chapters.en:
He took with him the commanders of hundreds, the Carites, the guards, and all the people of the land, and they brought the king down from the house of the LORD and entered the royal palace by way of the Gate of the Guards.
Then Joash took his seat on the royal throne,
chapters.zh: 又率领百夫长和迦利人〔注：或译：亲兵〕与护卫兵，以及国中的众民，请王从耶和华殿下来，由护卫兵的门进入王宫，他就坐了王位。

chapters.en: and all the people of the land rejoiced. And the city was quiet, because Athaliah had been put to the sword at the royal palace.
chapters.zh: 国民都欢乐，合城都安静。众人已将亚她利雅在王宫那里用刀杀了。

chapters.en: Joash was seven years old when he became king.
chapters.zh: 约阿施登基的时候年方七岁。

chapters.en: In the seventh year of Jehu, Joash became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother’s name was Zibiah; she was from Beersheba.
chapters.zh: 耶户第七年，约阿施登基，在耶路撒冷作王四十年。他母亲名叫西比亚，是别是巴人。

chapters.en: And Joash did what was right in the eyes of the LORD all the days he was instructed by Jehoiada the priest.
chapters.zh: 约阿施在祭司耶何耶大教训他的时候，就行耶和华眼中看为正的事；

chapters.en: Nevertheless, the high places were not removed; the people continued sacrificing and burning incense there.
chapters.zh: 只是邱坛还没有废去，百姓仍在那里献祭烧香。

chapters.en: Then Joash said to the priests, “Collect all the money brought as sacred gifts into the house of the LORD—the census money, the money from vows, and the money brought voluntarily into the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 约阿施对众祭司说：「凡奉到耶和华殿分别为圣之物所值通用的银子，或各人当纳的身价，或乐意奉到耶和华殿的银子，

chapters.en: Let every priest receive it from his constituency, and let it be used to repair any damage found in the temple.”
chapters.zh: 你们当从所认识的人收了来，修理殿的一切破坏之处。」

chapters.en: By the twenty-third year of the reign of Joash, however, the priests had not yet repaired the damage to the temple.
chapters.zh: 无奈到了约阿施王二十三年，祭司仍未修理殿的破坏之处。

chapters.en: So King Joash called Jehoiada and the other priests and said, “Why have you not repaired the damage to the temple? Now, therefore, take no more money from your constituency, but hand it over for the repair of the temple.”
chapters.zh: 所以约阿施王召了大祭司耶何耶大和众祭司来，对他们说：「你们怎么不修理殿的破坏之处呢？从今以后，你们不要从所认识的人再收银子，要将所收的交出来，修理殿的破坏之处。」

chapters.en: So the priests agreed that they would not receive money from the people and that they would not repair the temple themselves.
chapters.zh: 众祭司答应不再收百姓的银子，也不修理殿的破坏之处。

chapters.en: Then Jehoiada the priest took a chest, bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar on the right side as one enters the house of the LORD. There the priests who guarded the threshold put all the money brought into the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 祭司耶何耶大取了一个柜子，在柜盖上钻了一个窟窿，放于坛旁，在进耶和华殿的右边；守门的祭司将奉到耶和华殿的一切银子投在柜里。

chapters.en: Whenever they saw that there was a large amount of money in the chest, the royal scribe and the high priest would go up, count the money brought into the house of the LORD, and tie it up in bags.
chapters.zh: 他们见柜里的银子多了，便叫王的书记和大祭司上来，将耶和华殿里的银子数算包起来。

chapters.en: Then they would put the counted money into the hands of those who supervised the work on the house of the LORD, who in turn would pay those doing the work—the carpenters, builders,
chapters.zh: 把所平的银子交给督工的，就是耶和华殿里办事的人；他们把银子转交修理耶和华殿的木匠和工人，

chapters.en: masons, and stonecutters. They also purchased timber and dressed stone to repair the damage to the house of the LORD, and they paid the other expenses of the temple repairs.
chapters.zh: 并瓦匠、石匠，又买木料和凿成的石头，修理耶和华殿的破坏之处，以及修理殿的各样使用。

chapters.en: However, the money brought into the house of the LORD was not used for making silver basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, trumpets, or any articles of gold or silver for the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 但那奉到耶和华殿的银子，没有用以做耶和华殿里的银杯、蜡剪、碗、号，和别样的金银器皿，

chapters.en: Instead, it was paid to those doing the work, and with it they repaired the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 乃将那银子交给督工的人修理耶和华的殿；

chapters.en: No accounting was required from the men who received the money to pay the workmen, because they acted with integrity.
chapters.zh: 且将银子交给办事的人转交做工的人，不与他们算账，因为他们办事诚实。

chapters.en: The money from the guilt offerings and sin offerings was not brought into the house of the LORD; it belonged to the priests.
chapters.zh: 惟有赎愆祭、赎罪祭的银子没有奉到耶和华的殿，都归祭司。

chapters.en: At that time Hazael king of Aram marched up and fought against Gath and captured it. Then he decided to attack Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 那时，亚兰王哈薛上来攻打迦特，攻取了，就定意上来攻打耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: So King Joash of Judah took all the sacred objects dedicated by his fathers—Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and Ahaziah, the kings of Judah—along with his own consecrated items and all the gold found in the treasuries of the house of the LORD and the royal palace, and he sent them to Hazael king of Aram. So Hazael withdrew from Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 犹大王约阿施将他列祖犹大王约沙法、约兰、亚哈谢所分别为圣的物和自己所分别为圣的物，并耶和华殿与王宫府库里所有的金子都送给亚兰王哈薛；哈薛就不上耶路撒冷来了。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Joash, along with all his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 约阿施其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: And the servants of Joash rose up and formed a conspiracy and killed him at Beth-millo, on the road down to Silla.
chapters.zh: 约阿施的臣仆起来背叛，在下悉拉的米罗宫那里将他杀了。

chapters.en: His servants Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer struck him down, and he died. And they buried him with his fathers in the City of David, and his son Amaziah reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 杀他的那臣仆就是示米押的儿子约撒甲和朔默的儿子约萨拔。众人将他葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子亚玛谢接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the twenty-third year of the reign of Joash son of Ahaziah over Judah, Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria seventeen years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚哈谢的儿子约阿施二十三年，耶户的儿子约哈斯在撒马利亚登基作以色列王十七年。

chapters.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and followed the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit; he did not turn away from them.
chapters.zh: 约哈斯行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，总不离开。

chapters.en: So the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He delivered them continually into the hands of Hazael king of Aram and his son Ben-hadad.
chapters.zh: 于是，耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，将他们屡次交在亚兰王哈薛和他儿子便‧哈达的手里。

chapters.en: Then Jehoahaz sought the favor of the LORD, and the LORD listened to him because He saw the oppression that the king of Aram had inflicted on Israel.
chapters.zh: 约哈斯恳求耶和华，耶和华就应允他，因为见以色列人所受亚兰王的欺压。

chapters.en: So the LORD gave Israel a deliverer, and they escaped the power of the Arameans. Then the people of Israel lived in their own homes as they had before.
chapters.zh: 耶和华赐给以色列人一位拯救者，使他们脱离亚兰人的手；于是以色列人仍旧安居在家里。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, they did not turn away from the sins that the house of Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit, but they continued to walk in them. The Asherah pole even remained standing in Samaria.
chapters.zh: 然而他们不离开耶罗波安家使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，仍然去行，并且在撒马利亚留下亚舍拉。

chapters.en: Jehoahaz had no army left, except fifty horsemen, ten chariots, and ten thousand foot soldiers, because the king of Aram had destroyed them and made them like the dust at threshing.
chapters.zh: 亚兰王灭绝约哈斯的民，践踏他们如禾场上的尘沙，只给约哈斯留下五十马兵，十辆战车，一万步兵。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, along with all his accomplishments and his might, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 约哈斯其余的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: And Jehoahaz rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria. And his son Jehoash reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 约哈斯与他列祖同睡，葬在撒马利亚。他儿子约阿施接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the thirty-seventh year of the reign of Joash over Judah, Jehoash son of Jehoahaz became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned sixteen years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王约阿施三十七年，约哈斯的儿子约阿施在撒马利亚登基作以色列王十六年。

chapters.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and did not turn away from all the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit, but he walked in them.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的一切罪，仍然去行。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoash, along with all his accomplishments and his might, including his war against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 约阿施其余的事，凡他所行的和他与犹大王亚玛谢争战的勇力，都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: And Jehoash rested with his fathers, and Jeroboam succeeded him on the throne. Jehoash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
chapters.zh: 约阿施与他列祖同睡，耶罗波安坐了他的位。约阿施与以色列诸王一同葬在撒马利亚。

chapters.en: When Elisha had fallen sick with the illness from which he would die, Jehoash king of Israel came down to him and wept over him, saying, “My father, my father, the chariots and horsemen of Israel!”
chapters.zh: 以利沙得了必死的病，以色列王约阿施下来看他，伏在他脸上哭泣，说：「我父啊！我父啊！以色列的战车马兵啊！」

chapters.en:
Elisha told him, “Take a bow and some arrows.”
So Jehoash took a bow and some arrows.
chapters.zh: 以利沙对他说：「你取弓箭来。」王就取了弓箭来；

chapters.en:
Then Elisha said to the king of Israel, “Put your hand on the bow.”
So the king put his hand on the bow, and Elisha put his hands on the king’s hands.
chapters.zh: 又对以色列王说：「你用手拿弓。」王就用手拿〔弓〕。以利沙按手在王的手上，

chapters.en:
“Open the east window,” said Elisha.
So he opened it and Elisha said, “Shoot!” So he shot.
And Elisha declared:
“This is the LORD’s arrow of victory, the arrow of victory over Aram, for you shall strike the Arameans in Aphek until you have put an end to them.”
chapters.zh: 说：「你开朝东的窗户。」他就开了。以利沙说：「射箭吧！」他就射箭。以利沙说：「这是耶和华的得胜箭，就是战胜亚兰人的箭；因为你必在亚弗攻打亚兰人，直到灭尽他们。」

chapters.en:
Then Elisha said, “Take the arrows!”
So he took them, and Elisha said to the king of Israel, “Strike the ground!”
So he struck the ground three times and stopped.
chapters.zh: 以利沙又说：「取几枝箭来。」他就取了来。以利沙说：「打地吧！」他打了三次，便止住了。

chapters.en: But the man of God was angry with him and said, “You should have struck the ground five or six times. Then you would have struck down Aram until you had put an end to it. But now you will strike down Aram only three times.”
chapters.zh: 神人向他发怒，说：「应当击打五六次，就能攻打亚兰人直到灭尽；现在只能打败亚兰人三次。」

chapters.en:
And Elisha died and was buried.
Now the Moabite raiders used to come into the land every spring.
chapters.zh: 以利沙死了，人将他葬埋。到了新年，有一群摩押人犯境，

chapters.en: Once, as the Israelites were burying a man, suddenly they saw a band of raiders, so they threw the man’s body into Elisha’s tomb. And as soon as his body touched the bones of Elisha, the man was revived and stood up on his feet.
chapters.zh: 有人正葬死人，忽然看见一群人，就把死人抛在以利沙的坟墓里，一碰着以利沙的骸骨，死人就复活，站起来了。

chapters.en: And Hazael king of Aram oppressed Israel throughout the reign of Jehoahaz.
chapters.zh: 约哈斯年间，亚兰王哈薛屡次欺压以色列人。

chapters.en: But the LORD was gracious to Israel and had compassion on them, and He turned toward them because of His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. And to this day, the LORD has been unwilling to destroy them or cast them from His presence.
chapters.zh: 耶和华却因与亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所立的约，仍施恩给以色列人，怜恤他们，眷顾他们，不肯灭尽他们，尚未赶逐他们离开自己面前。

chapters.en: When Hazael king of Aram died, his son Ben-hadad reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 亚兰王哈薛死了，他儿子便‧哈达接续他作王。

chapters.en: Then Jehoash son of Jehoahaz took back from Ben-hadad son of Hazael the cities that Hazael had taken in battle from his father Jehoahaz. Jehoash defeated Ben-hadad three times, and so recovered the cities of Israel.
chapters.zh: 从前哈薛和约阿施的父亲约哈斯争战，攻取了些城邑，现在约哈斯的儿子约阿施三次打败哈薛的儿子便‧哈达，就收回了以色列的城邑。

chapters.en: In the second year of the reign of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz over Israel, Amaziah son of Joash became king of Judah.
chapters.zh: 以色列王约哈斯的儿子约阿施第二年，犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢登基。

chapters.en: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan; she was from Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 他登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他母亲名叫约耶但，是耶路撒冷人。

chapters.en: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, but not as his father David had done. He did everything as his father Joash had done.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢行耶和华眼中看为正的事，但不如他祖大卫，乃效法他父约阿施一切所行的；

chapters.en: Nevertheless, the high places were not taken away, and the people continued sacrificing and burning incense on the high places.
chapters.zh: 只是邱坛还没有废去，百姓仍在那里献祭烧香。

chapters.en: As soon as the kingdom was firmly in his grasp, Amaziah executed the servants who had murdered his father the king.
chapters.zh: 国一坚定，就把杀他父王的臣仆杀了，

chapters.en: Yet he did not put the sons of the murderers to death, but acted according to what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, where the LORD commanded: “Fathers must not be put to death for their children, and children must not be put to death for their fathers; each is to die for his own sin.”
chapters.zh: 却没有治死杀王之人的儿子，是照摩西律法书上耶和华所吩咐的说：「不可因子杀父，也不可因父杀子，各人要为本身的罪而死。」

chapters.en: Amaziah struck down 10,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt. He took Sela in battle and called it Joktheel, which is its name to this very day.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢在盐谷杀了以东人一万，又攻取了西拉，改名叫约帖，直到今日。

chapters.en: Then Amaziah sent messengers to the king of Israel Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu. “Come, let us meet face to face,” he said.
chapters.zh: 那时，亚玛谢差遣使者去见耶户的孙子约哈斯的儿子以色列王约阿施，说：「你来，我们二人相见〔于战场〕。」

chapters.en: But Jehoash king of Israel replied to Amaziah king of Judah: “A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle.
chapters.zh: 以色列王约阿施差遣使者去见犹大王亚玛谢，说：「黎巴嫩的蒺藜差遣使者去见黎巴嫩的香柏树，说：将你的女儿给我儿子为妻。后来黎巴嫩有一个野兽经过，把蒺藜践踏了。

chapters.en: You have indeed defeated Edom, and your heart has become proud. Glory in that and stay at home. Why should you stir up trouble so that you fall—you and Judah with you?”
chapters.zh: 你打败了以东人就心高气傲，你以此为荣耀，在家里安居就罢了，为何要惹祸，使自己和犹大国一同败亡呢？」

chapters.en: But Amaziah would not listen, so Jehoash king of Israel advanced. He and King Amaziah of Judah faced each other at Beth-shemesh in Judah.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢却不肯听这话。于是以色列王约阿施上来，在犹大的伯‧示麦与犹大王亚玛谢相见〔于战场〕。

chapters.en: And Judah was routed before Israel, and every man fled to his home.
chapters.zh: 犹大人败在以色列人面前，各自逃回家里去了。

chapters.en:
There at Beth-shemesh, Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Ahaziah.
Then Jehoash went to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate—a section of four hundred cubits.
chapters.zh: 以色列王约阿施在伯‧示麦擒住亚哈谢的孙子、约阿施的儿子犹大王亚玛谢，就来到耶路撒冷，拆毁耶路撒冷的城墙，从以法莲门直到角门共四百肘，

chapters.en: He took all the gold and silver and all the articles found in the house of the LORD and in the treasuries of the royal palace, as well as some hostages. Then he returned to Samaria.
chapters.zh: 又将耶和华殿里与王宫府库里所有的金银和器皿都拿了去，并带人去为质，就回撒马利亚去了。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoash, along with his accomplishments, his might, and how he waged war against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 约阿施其余所行的事和他的勇力，并与犹大王亚玛谢争战的事，都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: And Jehoash rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. And his son Jeroboam reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 约阿施与他列祖同睡，葬在撒马利亚，以色列诸王的坟地里。他儿子耶罗波安接续他作王。

chapters.en: Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列王约哈斯的儿子约阿施死后，犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢又活了十五年。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Amaziah, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢其余的事都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: And conspirators plotted against Amaziah in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish. But men were sent after him to Lachish, and they killed him there.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷有人背叛亚玛谢，他就逃到拉吉；叛党却打发人到拉吉将他杀了。

chapters.en: They carried him back on horses and buried him in Jerusalem with his fathers in the City of David.
chapters.zh: 人就用马将他的尸首驮到耶路撒冷，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。

chapters.en: Then all the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
chapters.zh: 犹大众民立亚玛谢的儿子亚撒利雅〔注：又名乌西雅〕接续他父作王，那时他年十六岁。

chapters.en: Azariah was the one who rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah after King Amaziah rested with his fathers.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢与他列祖同睡之后，亚撒利雅收回以拉他仍归犹大，又重新修理。

chapters.en: In the fifteenth year of the reign of Amaziah son of Joash over Judah, Jeroboam son of Jehoash became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria forty-one years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢十五年，以色列王约阿施的儿子耶罗波安在撒马利亚登基，作王四十一年。

chapters.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and did not turn away from all the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的一切罪。

chapters.en: This Jeroboam restored the boundary of Israel from Lebo-hamath to the Sea of the Arabah, according to the word that the LORD, the God of Israel, had spoken through His servant Jonah son of Amittai, the prophet from Gath-hepher.
chapters.zh: 他收回以色列边界之地，从哈马口直到亚拉巴海，正如耶和华－以色列的上帝藉他仆人迦特希弗人亚米太的儿子先知约拿所说的。

chapters.en: For the LORD saw that the affliction of the Israelites, both slave and free, was very bitter. There was no one to help Israel,
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华看见以色列人甚是艰苦，无论困住的、自由的都没有了，也无人帮助以色列人。

chapters.en: and since the LORD had said that He would not blot out the name of Israel from under heaven, He saved them by the hand of Jeroboam son of Jehoash.
chapters.zh: 耶和华并没有说要将以色列的名从天下涂抹，乃藉约阿施的儿子耶罗波安拯救他们。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, along with all his accomplishments and might, and how he waged war and recovered both Damascus and Hamath for Israel from Judah, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安其余的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力，他怎样争战，怎样收回大马士革和〔先前属〕犹大的哈马归以色列，都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: And Jeroboam rested with his fathers, the kings of Israel. And his son Zechariah reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安与他列祖以色列诸王同睡。他儿子撒迦利雅接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam’s reign over Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah became king of Judah.
chapters.zh: 以色列王耶罗波安二十七年，犹大王亚玛谢的儿子亚撒利雅登基，

chapters.en: He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother’s name was Jecoliah; she was from Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 他登基的时候年十六岁，在耶路撒冷作王五十二年。他母亲名叫耶可利雅，是耶路撒冷人。

chapters.en: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done.
chapters.zh: 亚撒利雅行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他父亲亚玛谢一切所行的；

chapters.en: Nevertheless, the high places were not taken away; the people continued sacrificing and burning incense there.
chapters.zh: 只是邱坛还没有废去，百姓仍在那里献祭烧香。

chapters.en: And the LORD afflicted the king with leprosy until the day he died, so that he lived in a separate house while his son Jotham had charge of the palace and governed the people of the land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华降灾与王，使他长大痲疯，直到死日，他就住在别的宫里。他的儿子约坦管理家事，治理国民。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Azariah, along with all his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 亚撒利雅其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: And Azariah rested with his fathers and was buried near them in the City of David. And his son Jotham reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 亚撒利雅与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子约坦接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah’s reign over Judah, Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria six months.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒利雅三十八年，耶罗波安的儿子撒迦利雅在撒马利亚作以色列王六个月。

chapters.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, as his fathers had done. He did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他列祖所行的，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。

chapters.en: Then Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against Zechariah, struck him down and killed him in front of the people, and reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 雅比的儿子沙龙背叛他，在百姓面前击杀他，篡了他的位。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Zechariah, they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
chapters.zh: 撒迦利雅其余的事都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: So the word of the LORD spoken to Jehu was fulfilled: “Four generations of your sons will sit on the throne of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 这是从前耶和华应许耶户说：「你的子孙必坐以色列的国位直到四代。」这话果然应验了。

chapters.en: In the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah’s reign over Judah, Shallum son of Jabesh became king, and he reigned in Samaria one full month.
chapters.zh: 犹大王乌西雅〔注：就是亚撒利雅〕三十九年，雅比的儿子沙龙登基在撒马利亚作王一个月。

chapters.en: Then Menahem son of Gadi went up from Tirzah to Samaria, struck down and killed Shallum son of Jabesh, and reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 迦底的儿子米拿现从得撒上撒马利亚，杀了雅比的儿子沙龙，篡了他的位。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Shallum, along with the conspiracy he led, they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
chapters.zh: 沙龙其余的事和他背叛的情形都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: At that time Menahem, starting from Tirzah, attacked Tiphsah and everyone in its vicinity, because they would not open their gates. So he attacked Tiphsah and ripped open all the pregnant women.
chapters.zh: 那时米拿现从得撒起攻打提斐萨和其四境，击杀城中一切的人，剖开其中所有的孕妇，都因他们没有给他开城。

chapters.en: In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah’s reign over Judah, Menahem son of Gadi became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria ten years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒利雅三十九年，迦底的儿子米拿现登基，在撒马利亚作以色列王十年。

chapters.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and throughout his reign he did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，终身不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。

chapters.en: Then Pul king of Assyria invaded the land, and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver in order to gain his support and strengthen his own grip on the kingdom.
chapters.zh: 亚述王普勒来攻击以色列国，米拿现给他一千他连得银子，请普勒帮助他坚定国位。

chapters.en: Menahem exacted this money from each of the wealthy men of Israel—fifty shekels of silver from each man—to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria withdrew and did not remain in the land.
chapters.zh: 米拿现向以色列一切大富户索要银子，使他们各出五十舍客勒，就给了亚述王。于是亚述王回去，不在国中停留。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Menahem, along with all his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
chapters.zh: 米拿现其余的事，凡他所行的都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: And Menahem rested with his fathers, and his son Pekahiah reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 米拿现与他列祖同睡。他儿子比加辖接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the fiftieth year of Azariah’s reign over Judah, Pekahiah son of Menahem became king of Israel and reigned in Samaria two years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒利雅五十年，米拿现的儿子比加辖在撒马利亚登基作以色列王二年。

chapters.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。

chapters.en: Then his officer, Pekah son of Remaliah, conspired against him along with Argob, Arieh, and fifty men of Gilead. And at the citadel of the king’s palace in Samaria, Pekah struck down and killed Pekahiah and reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 比加辖的将军、利玛利的儿子比加背叛他，在撒马利亚王宫里的卫所杀了他。亚珥歌伯和亚利耶并基列的五十人帮助比加；比加击杀他，篡了他的位。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, along with all his accomplishments, they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
chapters.zh: 比加辖其余的事，凡他所行的都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: In the fifty-second year of Azariah’s reign over Judah, Pekah son of Remaliah became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria twenty years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚撒利雅五十二年，利玛利的儿子比加在撒马利亚登基作以色列王二十年。

chapters.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。

chapters.en: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria came and captured Ijon, Abel-beth-maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, and Galilee, including all the land of Naphtali, and he took the people as captives to Assyria.
chapters.zh: 以色列王比加年间，亚述王提革拉‧毗列色来夺了以云、亚伯‧伯‧玛迦、亚挪、基低斯、夏琐、基列、加利利，和拿弗他利全地，将这些地方的居民都掳到亚述去了。

chapters.en: Then Hoshea son of Elah led a conspiracy against Pekah son of Remaliah. In the twentieth year of Jotham son of Uzziah, Hoshea attacked Pekah, killed him, and reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅的儿子约坦二十年，以拉的儿子何细亚背叛利玛利的儿子比加，击杀他，篡了他的位。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Pekah, along with all his accomplishments, they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
chapters.zh: 比加其余的事，凡他所行的都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: In the second year of the reign of Pekah son of Remaliah over Israel, Jotham son of Uzziah became king of Judah.
chapters.zh: 以色列王利玛利的儿子比加第二年，犹大王乌西雅的儿子约坦登基。

chapters.en: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. His mother’s name was Jerusha daughter of Zadok.
chapters.zh: 他登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年。他母亲名叫耶路沙，是撒督的女儿。

chapters.en: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Uzziah had done.
chapters.zh: 约坦行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他父亲乌西雅一切所行的；

chapters.en:
Nevertheless, the high places were not taken away; the people continued sacrificing and burning incense there.
Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 只是邱坛还没有废去，百姓仍在那里献祭烧香。约坦建立耶和华殿的上门。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Jotham, along with his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 约坦其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: (In those days the LORD began to send Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah against Judah.)
chapters.zh: 在那些日子，耶和华才使亚兰王利汛和利玛利的儿子比加去攻击犹大。

chapters.en: And Jotham rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David his father. And his son Ahaz reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 约坦与他列祖同睡，葬在他祖大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子亚哈斯接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the seventeenth year of Pekah son of Remaliah, Ahaz son of Jotham became king of Judah.
chapters.zh: 利玛利的儿子比加十七年，犹大王约坦的儿子亚哈斯登基。

chapters.en: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. And unlike David his father, he did not do what was right in the eyes of the LORD his God.
chapters.zh: 他登基的时候年二十岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年；不像他祖大卫行耶和华－他上帝眼中看为正的事，

chapters.en: Instead, he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel and even sacrificed his son in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 却效法以色列诸王所行的，又照着耶和华从以色列人面前赶出的外邦人所行可憎的事，使他的儿子经火，

chapters.en: And he sacrificed and burned incense on the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.
chapters.zh: 并在邱坛上、山冈上、各青翠树下献祭烧香。

chapters.en: Then Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to wage war against Jerusalem. They besieged Ahaz but could not overcome him.
chapters.zh: 亚兰王利汛和以色列王利玛利的儿子比加上来攻打耶路撒冷，围困亚哈斯，却不能胜他。

chapters.en: At that time Rezin king of Aram recovered Elath for Aram, drove out the men of Judah, and sent the Edomites into Elath, where they live to this day.
chapters.zh: 当时亚兰王利汛收回以拉他归与亚兰，将犹大人从以拉他赶出去。亚兰人〔注：有译以东人的〕就来到以拉他，住在那里，直到今日。

chapters.en: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me from the hands of the kings of Aram and Israel, who are rising up against me.”
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯差遣使者去见亚述王提革拉‧毗列色，说：「我是你的仆人、你的儿子。现在亚兰王和以色列王攻击我，求你来救我脱离他们的手。」

chapters.en: Ahaz also took the silver and gold found in the house of the LORD and in the treasuries of the king’s palace, and he sent it as a gift to the king of Assyria.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯将耶和华殿里和王宫府库里所有的金银都送给亚述王为礼物。

chapters.en: So the king of Assyria responded to him, marched up to Damascus, and captured it. He took its people to Kir as captives and put Rezin to death.
chapters.zh: 亚述王应允了他，就上去攻打大马士革，将城攻取，杀了利汛，把〔居民〕掳到吉珥。

chapters.en: Then King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria. On seeing the altar in Damascus, King Ahaz sent Uriah the priest a model of the altar and complete plans for its construction.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯王上大马士革去迎接亚述王提革拉‧毗列色，在大马士革看见一座坛，就照坛的规模样式作法〔画了图样〕，送到祭司乌利亚那里。

chapters.en: And Uriah the priest built the altar according to all the instructions King Ahaz had sent from Damascus, and he completed it before King Ahaz returned.
chapters.zh: 祭司乌利亚照着亚哈斯王从大马士革送来的图样，在亚哈斯王没有从大马士革回来之先，建筑一座坛。

chapters.en: When the king came back from Damascus and saw the altar, he approached it and presented offerings on it.
chapters.zh: 王从大马士革回来看见坛，就近前来，在坛上献祭；

chapters.en: He offered his burnt offering and his grain offering, poured out his drink offering, and splattered the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.
chapters.zh: 烧燔祭、素祭、浇奠祭，将平安祭牲的血洒在坛上，

chapters.en: He also took the bronze altar that stood before the LORD from the front of the temple (between the new altar and the house of the LORD) and he put it on the north side of the new altar.
chapters.zh: 又将耶和华面前的铜坛从耶和华殿和〔新〕坛的中间搬到〔新〕坛的北边。

chapters.en: Then King Ahaz commanded Uriah the priest, “Offer on the great altar the morning burnt offering, the evening grain offering, and the king’s burnt offering and grain offering, as well as the burnt offerings, grain offerings, and drink offerings of all the people of the land. Splatter on the altar all the blood of the burnt offerings and sacrifices. But I will use the bronze altar to seek guidance.”
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯王吩咐祭司乌利亚说：「早晨的燔祭、晚上的素祭，王的燔祭、素祭，国内众民的燔祭、素祭、奠祭都要烧在大坛上。燔祭牲和〔平安〕祭牲的血也要洒在这坛上，只是铜坛我要用以求问〔耶和华〕。」

chapters.en: So Uriah the priest did just as King Ahaz had commanded.
chapters.zh: 祭司乌利亚就照着亚哈斯王所吩咐的行了。

chapters.en: King Ahaz also cut off the frames of the movable stands and removed the bronze basin from each of them. He took down the Sea from the bronze oxen that were under it and put it on a stone base.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯王打掉盆座〔四面镶着〕的心子，把盆从座上挪下来，又将铜海从驮海的铜牛上搬下来，放在铺石地；

chapters.en: And on account of the king of Assyria, he removed the Sabbath canopy they had built in the temple and closed the royal entryway outside the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 又因亚述王的缘故，将耶和华殿为安息日所盖的廊子和王从外入殿的廊子挪移，围绕耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Ahaz, along with his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯其余所行的事都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: And Ahaz rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David, and his son Hezekiah reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子希西家接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the twelfth year of the reign of Ahaz over Judah, Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria nine years.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚哈斯十二年，以拉的儿子何细亚在撒马利亚登基作以色列王九年。

chapters.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, but not like the kings of Israel who preceded him.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，只是不像在他以前的以色列诸王。

chapters.en: Shalmaneser king of Assyria attacked him, and Hoshea became his vassal and paid him tribute.
chapters.zh: 亚述王撒缦以色上来攻击何细亚，何细亚就服事他，给他进贡。

chapters.en: But the king of Assyria discovered that Hoshea had conspired to send envoys to King So of Egypt, and that he had not paid tribute to the king of Assyria as in previous years. Therefore the king of Assyria arrested Hoshea and put him in prison.
chapters.zh: 何细亚背叛，差人去见埃及王梭，不照往年所行的与亚述王进贡。亚述王知道了，就把他锁禁，囚在监里。

chapters.en: Then the king of Assyria invaded the whole land, marched up to Samaria, and besieged it for three years.
chapters.zh: 亚述王上来攻击以色列遍地，上到撒马利亚，围困三年。

chapters.en: In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria and carried away the Israelites to Assyria, where he settled them in Halah, in Gozan by the Habor River, and in the cities of the Medes.
chapters.zh: 何细亚第九年亚述王攻取了撒马利亚，将以色列人掳到亚述，把他们安置在哈腊与歌散的哈博河边，并米底亚人的城邑。

chapters.en: All this happened because the people of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, who had brought them out of the land of Egypt from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt. They had worshiped other gods
chapters.zh: 这是因以色列人得罪那领他们出埃及地、脱离埃及王法老手的耶和华－他们的上帝，去敬畏别神，

chapters.en: and walked in the customs of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the Israelites, as well as in the practices introduced by the kings of Israel.
chapters.zh: 随从耶和华在他们面前所赶出外邦人的风俗和以色列诸王所立的条规。

chapters.en: The Israelites secretly did things against the LORD their God that were not right. From watchtower to fortified city, they built high places in all their cities.
chapters.zh: 以色列人暗中行不正的事，违背耶和华－他们的上帝，在他们所有的城邑，从瞭望楼直到坚固城，建筑邱坛；

chapters.en: They set up for themselves sacred pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.
chapters.zh: 在各高冈上、各青翠树下立柱像和木偶；

chapters.en: They burned incense on all the high places like the nations that the LORD had driven out before them. They did wicked things, provoking the LORD to anger.
chapters.zh: 在邱坛上烧香，效法耶和华在他们面前赶出的外邦人所行的，又行恶事惹动耶和华的怒气；

chapters.en: They served idols, although the LORD had told them, “You shall not do this thing.”
chapters.zh: 且事奉偶像，就是耶和华警戒他们不可行的。

chapters.en: Yet through all His prophets and seers, the LORD warned Israel and Judah, saying, “Turn from your wicked ways and keep My commandments and statutes, according to the entire Law that I commanded your fathers and delivered to you through My servants the prophets.”
chapters.zh: 但耶和华藉众先知、先见劝戒以色列人和犹大人说：「当离开你们的恶行，谨守我的诫命律例，遵行我吩咐你们列祖，并藉我仆人众先知所传给你们的律法。」

chapters.en: But they would not listen, and they stiffened their necks like their fathers, who did not believe the LORD their God.
chapters.zh: 他们却不听从，竟硬着颈项，效法他们列祖，不信服耶和华－他们的上帝，

chapters.en: They rejected His statutes and the covenant He had made with their fathers, as well as the decrees He had given them. They pursued worthless idols and became worthless themselves, going after the surrounding nations that the LORD had commanded them not to imitate.
chapters.zh: 厌弃他的律例和他与他们列祖所立的约，并劝戒他们的话，随从虚无〔的神〕，自己成为虚妄，效法周围的外邦人，就是耶和华嘱咐他们不可效法的；

chapters.en: They abandoned all the commandments of the LORD their God and made for themselves two cast idols of calves and an Asherah pole. They bowed down to all the host of heaven and served Baal.
chapters.zh: 离弃耶和华－他们上帝的一切诫命，为自己铸了两个牛犊的像，立了亚舍拉，敬拜天上的万象，事奉巴力，

chapters.en: They sacrificed their sons and daughters in the fire and practiced divination and soothsaying. They devoted themselves to doing evil in the sight of the LORD, provoking Him to anger.
chapters.zh: 又使他们的儿女经火，用占卜，行法术卖了自己，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，惹动他的怒气。

chapters.en: So the LORD was very angry with Israel, and He removed them from His presence. Only the tribe of Judah remained,
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华向以色列人大大发怒，从自己面前赶出他们，只剩下犹大一个支派。

chapters.en: and even Judah did not keep the commandments of the LORD their God, but lived according to the customs Israel had introduced.
chapters.zh: 犹大人也不遵守耶和华－他们上帝的诫命，随从以色列人所立的条规。

chapters.en: So the LORD rejected all the descendants of Israel. He afflicted them and delivered them into the hands of plunderers, until He had banished them from His presence.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就厌弃以色列全族，使他们受苦，把他们交在抢夺他们的人手中，以致赶出他们离开自己面前，

chapters.en: When the LORD had torn Israel away from the house of David, they made Jeroboam son of Nebat king, and Jeroboam led Israel away from following the LORD and caused them to commit a great sin.
chapters.zh: 将以色列国从大卫家夺回；他们就立尼八的儿子耶罗波安作王。耶罗波安引诱以色列人不随从耶和华，陷在大罪里。

chapters.en: The Israelites persisted in all the sins that Jeroboam had committed and did not turn away from them.
chapters.zh: 以色列人犯耶罗波安所犯的一切罪，总不离开，

chapters.en: Finally, the LORD removed Israel from His presence, as He had declared through all His servants the prophets. So Israel was exiled from their homeland into Assyria, where they are to this day.
chapters.zh: 以致耶和华从自己面前赶出他们，正如藉他仆人众先知所说的。这样，以色列人从本地被掳到亚述，直到今日。

chapters.en: Then the king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim and settled them in the towns of Samaria to replace the Israelites. They took possession of Samaria and lived in its towns.
chapters.zh: 亚述王从巴比伦、古他、亚瓦、哈马，和西法瓦音迁移人来，安置在撒马利亚的城邑，代替以色列人；他们就得了撒马利亚，住在其中。

chapters.en: Now when the settlers first lived there, they did not worship the LORD, so He sent lions among them, which killed some of them.
chapters.zh: 他们才住那里的时候，不敬畏耶和华，所以耶和华叫狮子进入他们中间，咬死了些人。

chapters.en: So they spoke to the king of Assyria, saying, “The peoples that you have removed and placed in the cities of Samaria do not know the requirements of the God of the land. Because of this, He has sent lions among them, which are indeed killing them off.”
chapters.zh: 有人告诉亚述王说：「你所迁移安置在撒马利亚各城的那些民，不知道那地之神的规矩，所以那神叫狮子进入他们中间，咬死他们。」

chapters.en: Then the king of Assyria commanded: “Send back one of the priests you carried off from Samaria, and have him go back to live there and teach the requirements of the God of the land.”
chapters.zh: 亚述王就吩咐说：「叫所掳来的祭司回去一个，使他住在那里，将那地之神的规矩指教那些民。」

chapters.en: Thus one of the priests they had carried away came and lived in Bethel, and he began to teach them how they should worship the LORD.
chapters.zh: 于是有一个从撒马利亚掳去的祭司回来，住在伯特利，指教他们怎样敬畏耶和华。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, the people of each nation continued to make their own gods in the cities where they had settled, and they set them up in the shrines that the people of Samaria had made on the high places.
chapters.zh: 然而，各族之人在所住的城里各为自己制造神像，安置在撒马利亚人所造有邱坛的殿中。

chapters.en: The men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth, the men of Cuth made Nergal, the men of Hamath made Ashima,
chapters.zh: 巴比伦人造疏割‧比讷像；古他人造匿甲像；哈马人造亚示玛像；

chapters.en: the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech the gods of Sepharvaim.
chapters.zh: 亚瓦人造匿哈和他珥他像；西法瓦音人用火焚烧儿女，献给西法瓦音的神亚得米勒和亚拿米勒。

chapters.en: So the new residents worshiped the LORD, but they also appointed for themselves priests of all sorts to serve in the shrines of the high places.
chapters.zh: 他们惧怕耶和华，也从他们中间立邱坛的祭司，为他们在有邱坛的殿中献祭。

chapters.en: They worshiped the LORD, but they also served their own gods according to the customs of the nations from which they had been carried away.
chapters.zh: 他们又惧怕耶和华，又事奉自己的神，从何邦迁移，就随何邦的风俗。

chapters.en: To this day they are still practicing their former customs. None of them worship the LORD or observe the statutes, ordinances, laws, and commandments that the LORD gave the descendants of Jacob, whom He named Israel.
chapters.zh: 他们直到如今仍照先前的风俗去行，不〔专心〕敬畏耶和华，不〔全〕守自己的规矩、典章，也不遵守耶和华吩咐雅各后裔的律法、诫命。（雅各，就是从前耶和华起名叫以色列的。）

chapters.en: For the LORD had made a covenant with the Israelites and commanded them, “Do not worship other gods or bow down to them; do not serve them or sacrifice to them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华曾与他们立约，嘱咐他们说：「不可敬畏别神，不可跪拜事奉他，也不可向他献祭。

chapters.en: Instead, worship the LORD, who brought you out of the land of Egypt with great power and an outstretched arm. You are to bow down to Him and offer sacrifices to Him.
chapters.zh: 但那用大能和伸出来的膀臂领你们出埃及地的耶和华，你们当敬畏，跪拜，向他献祭。

chapters.en: And you must always be careful to observe the statutes, ordinances, laws, and commandments He wrote for you. Do not worship other gods.
chapters.zh: 他给你们写的律例、典章、律法、诫命，你们应当永远谨守遵行，不可敬畏别神。

chapters.en: Do not forget the covenant I have made with you. Do not worship other gods,
chapters.zh: 我－〔耶和华〕与你们所立的约你们不可忘记，也不可敬畏别神。

chapters.en: but worship the LORD your God, and He will deliver you from the hands of all your enemies.”
chapters.zh: 但要敬畏耶和华－你们的上帝，他必救你们脱离一切仇敌的手。」

chapters.en: But they would not listen, and they persisted in their former customs.
chapters.zh: 他们却不听从，仍照先前的风俗去行。

chapters.en: So these nations worshiped the LORD but also served their idols, and to this day their children and grandchildren continue to do as their fathers did.
chapters.zh: 如此这些民又惧怕耶和华，又事奉他们的偶像。他们子子孙孙也都照样行，效法他们的祖宗，直到今日。

chapters.en: In the third year of the reign of Hoshea son of Elah over Israel, Hezekiah son of Ahaz became king of Judah.
chapters.zh: 以色列王以拉的儿子何细亚第三年，犹大王亚哈斯的儿子希西家登基。

chapters.en: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Abi, the daughter of Zechariah.
chapters.zh: 他登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他母亲名叫亚比，是撒迦利雅的女儿。

chapters.en: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father David had done.
chapters.zh: 希西家行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他祖大卫一切所行的。

chapters.en: He removed the high places, shattered the sacred pillars, and cut down the Asherah poles. He also demolished the bronze snake called Nehushtan that Moses had made, for up to that time the Israelites had burned incense to it.
chapters.zh: 他废去邱坛，毁坏柱像，砍下木偶，打碎摩西所造的铜蛇，因为到那时以色列人仍向铜蛇烧香。希西家叫铜蛇为铜块〔注：或译：人称铜蛇为铜像〕。

chapters.en: Hezekiah trusted in the LORD, the God of Israel. No king of Judah was like him, either before him or after him.
chapters.zh: 希西家倚靠耶和华－以色列的上帝，在他前后的犹大列王中没有一个及他的。

chapters.en: He remained faithful to the LORD and did not turn from following Him; he kept the commandments that the LORD had given Moses.
chapters.zh: 因为他专靠耶和华，总不离开，谨守耶和华所吩咐摩西的诫命。

chapters.en: And the LORD was with Hezekiah, and he prospered wherever he went. He rebelled against the king of Assyria and refused to serve him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华与他同在，他无论往何处去尽都亨通。他背叛、不肯事奉亚述王。

chapters.en: He defeated the Philistines as far as Gaza and its borders, from watchtower to fortified city.
chapters.zh: 希西家攻击非利士人，直到迦萨，并迦萨的四境，从瞭望楼到坚固城。

chapters.en: In the fourth year of Hezekiah’s reign, which was the seventh year of the reign of Hoshea son of Elah over Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria marched against Samaria and besieged it.
chapters.zh: 希西家王第四年，就是以色列王以拉的儿子何细亚第七年，亚述王撒缦以色上来围困撒马利亚；

chapters.en:
And at the end of three years, the Assyrians captured it.
So Samaria was captured in the sixth year of Hezekiah, which was the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 过了三年就攻取了城。希西家第六年，以色列王何细亚第九年，撒马利亚被攻取了。

chapters.en: The king of Assyria exiled the Israelites to Assyria and settled them in Halah, in Gozan by the Habor River, and in the cities of the Medes.
chapters.zh: 亚述王将以色列人掳到亚述，把他们安置在哈腊与歌散的哈博河边，并米底亚人的城邑；

chapters.en: This happened because they did not listen to the voice of the LORD their God, but violated His covenant—all that Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded—and would neither listen nor obey.
chapters.zh: 都因他们不听从耶和华－他们上帝的话，违背他的约，就是耶和华仆人摩西吩咐他们所当守的。

chapters.en: In the fourteenth year of Hezekiah’s reign, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked and captured all the fortified cities of Judah.
chapters.zh: 希西家王十四年，亚述王西拿基立上来攻击犹大的一切坚固城，将城攻取。

chapters.en:
So Hezekiah king of Judah sent word to the king of Assyria at Lachish, saying, “I have done wrong; withdraw from me, and I will pay whatever you demand from me.”
And the king of Assyria exacted from Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
chapters.zh: 犹大王希西家差人往拉吉去见亚述王，说：「我有罪了，求你离开我；凡你罚我的，我必承当。」于是亚述王罚犹大王希西家银子三百他连得，金子三十他连得。

chapters.en: Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the LORD and in the treasuries of the royal palace.
chapters.zh: 希西家就把耶和华殿里和王宫府库里所有的银子都给了〔他〕。

chapters.en: At that time Hezekiah stripped the gold with which he had plated the doors and doorposts of the temple of the LORD, and he gave it to the king of Assyria.
chapters.zh: 那时，犹大王希西家将耶和华殿门上的〔金子〕和他自己包在柱上的〔金子〕都刮下来，给了亚述王。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, the king of Assyria sent the Tartan, the Rabsaris, and the Rabshakeh, along with a great army, from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. They advanced up to Jerusalem and stationed themselves by the aqueduct of the upper pool, on the road to the Launderer’s Field.
chapters.zh: 亚述王从拉吉差遣他珥探、拉伯撒利，和拉伯沙基率领大军往耶路撒冷，到希西家王那里去。他们上到耶路撒冷，就站在上池的水沟旁，在漂布地的大路上。

chapters.en: Then they called for the king. And Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebnah the scribe, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder, went out to them.
chapters.zh: 他们呼叫王的时候，就有希勒家的儿子家宰以利亚敬，并书记舍伯那和亚萨的儿子史官约亚，出来见他们。

chapters.en: The Rabshakeh said to them, “Tell Hezekiah that this is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: What is the basis of this confidence of yours?
chapters.zh: 拉伯沙基说：「你们去告诉希西家说，亚述大王如此说：『你所倚靠的有什么可仗赖的呢？

chapters.en: You claim to have a strategy and strength for war, but these are empty words. In whom are you now trusting, that you have rebelled against me?
chapters.zh: 你说有打仗的计谋和能力，〔我看〕不过是虚话。你到底倚靠谁才背叛我呢？

chapters.en: Look now, you are trusting in Egypt, that splintered reed of a staff that will pierce the hand of anyone who leans on it. Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.
chapters.zh: 看哪，你所倚靠的埃及是那压伤的苇杖；人若靠这杖，就必刺透他的手。埃及王法老向一切倚靠他的人也是这样。

chapters.en: But if you say to me, ‘We trust in the LORD our God,’ is He not the One whose high places and altars Hezekiah has removed, saying to Judah and Jerusalem: ‘You must worship before this altar in Jerusalem’?
chapters.zh: 你们若对我说：我们倚靠耶和华－我们的上帝，希西家岂不是将上帝的邱坛和祭坛废去，且对犹大和耶路撒冷的人说：你们当在耶路撒冷这坛前敬拜吗？

chapters.en: Now, therefore, make a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria. I will give you two thousand horses—if you can put riders on them!
chapters.zh: 现在你把当头给我主亚述王，我给你二千匹马，看你这一面骑马的人够不够。

chapters.en: For how can you repel a single officer among the least of my master’s servants when you depend on Egypt for chariots and horsemen?
chapters.zh: 若不然，怎能打败我主臣仆中最小的军长呢？你竟倚靠埃及的战车马兵吗？

chapters.en: So now, was it apart from the LORD that I have come up against this place to destroy it? The LORD Himself said to me, ‘Go up against this land and destroy it.’”
chapters.zh: 现在我上来攻击毁灭这地，岂没有耶和华的意思吗？耶和华吩咐我说：你上去攻击毁灭这地吧！』」

chapters.en: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah, along with Shebnah and Joah, said to the Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, since we understand it. Do not speak with us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people on the wall.”
chapters.zh: 希勒家的儿子以利亚敬和舍伯那，并约亚，对拉伯沙基说：「求你用亚兰言语和仆人说话，因为我们懂得；不要用犹大言语和我们说话，达到城上百姓的耳中。」

chapters.en: But the Rabshakeh replied, “Has my master sent me to speak these words only to you and your master, and not to the men sitting on the wall, who are destined with you to eat their own dung and drink their own urine?”
chapters.zh: 拉伯沙基说：「我主差遣我来，岂是单对你和你的主说这些话吗？不也是对这些坐在城上、要与你们一同吃自己粪、喝自己尿的人说吗？」

chapters.en: Then the Rabshakeh stood and called out loudly in Hebrew: “Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria!
chapters.zh: 于是拉伯沙基站着，用犹大言语大声喊着说：「你们当听亚述大王的话！

chapters.en: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you; he cannot deliver you from my hand.
chapters.zh: 王如此说：『你们不要被希西家欺哄了；因他不能救你们脱离我的手。

chapters.en: Do not let Hezekiah persuade you to trust in the LORD when he says, ‘The LORD will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.’
chapters.zh: 也不要听希西家使你们倚靠耶和华，说耶和华必要拯救我们，这城必不交在亚述王的手中。』

chapters.en: Do not listen to Hezekiah, for this is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me. Then every one of you will eat from his own vine and his own fig tree and drink water from his own cistern,
chapters.zh: 不要听希西家的话！因亚述王如此说：『你们要与我和好，出来投降我，各人就可以吃自己葡萄树和无花果树的果子，喝自己井里的水。

chapters.en: until I come and take you away to a land like your own—a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive trees and honey—so that you may live and not die. But do not listen to Hezekiah, for he misleads you when he says, ‘The LORD will deliver us.’
chapters.zh: 等我来领你们到一个地方与你们本地一样，就是有五谷和新酒之地，有粮食和葡萄园之地，有橄榄树和蜂蜜之地，好使你们存活，不至于死。希西家劝导你们，说耶和华必拯救我们；你们不要听他的话。

chapters.en: Has the god of any nation ever delivered his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?
chapters.zh: 列国的神有哪一个救他本国脱离亚述王的手呢？

chapters.en: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?
chapters.zh: 哈马、亚珥拔的神在哪里呢？西法瓦音、希拿、以瓦的神在哪里呢？他们曾救撒马利亚脱离我的手吗？

chapters.en: Who among all the gods of these lands has delivered his land from my hand? How then can the LORD deliver Jerusalem from my hand?”
chapters.zh: 这些国的神有谁曾救自己的国脱离我的手呢？难道耶和华能救耶路撒冷脱离我的手吗？』」

chapters.en: But the people remained silent and did not answer a word, for Hezekiah had commanded, “Do not answer him.”
chapters.zh: 百姓静默不言，并不回答一句，因为王曾吩咐说：「不要回答他。」

chapters.en: Then Hilkiah’s son Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the scribe, and Asaph’s son Joah the recorder came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and they relayed to him the words of the Rabshakeh.
chapters.zh: 当下，希勒家的儿子家宰以利亚敬和书记舍伯那，并亚萨的儿子史官约亚，都撕裂衣服，来到希西家那里，将拉伯沙基的话告诉了他。

chapters.en: On hearing this report, King Hezekiah tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, and entered the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 希西家王听见，就撕裂衣服，披上麻布，进了耶和华的殿；

chapters.en: And he sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the scribe, and the leading priests, all wearing sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz
chapters.zh: 使家宰以利亚敬和书记舍伯那，并祭司中的长老，都披上麻布，去见亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚，

chapters.en: to tell him, “This is what Hezekiah says: Today is a day of distress, rebuke, and disgrace; for children have come to the point of birth, but there is no strength to deliver them.
chapters.zh: 对他说：「希西家如此说：『今日是急难、责罚、凌辱的日子，就如妇人将要生产婴孩，却没有力量生产。

chapters.en: Perhaps the LORD your God will hear all the words of the Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to defy the living God, and He will rebuke him for the words that the LORD your God has heard. Therefore lift up a prayer for the remnant that still survives.”
chapters.zh: 或者耶和华－你的上帝听见拉伯沙基的一切话，就是他主人亚述王打发他来辱骂永生上帝的话，耶和华－你的上帝听见这话，就发斥责。故此，求你为余剩的民扬声祷告。』」

chapters.en: So the servants of King Hezekiah went to Isaiah,
chapters.zh: 希西家王的臣仆就去见以赛亚。

chapters.en: who replied, “Tell your master that this is what the LORD says: ‘Do not be afraid of the words you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed Me.
chapters.zh: 以赛亚对他们说：「要这样对你们的主人说，耶和华如此说：『你听见亚述王的仆人亵渎我的话，不要惧怕。

chapters.en: Behold, I will put a spirit in him so that he will hear a rumor and return to his own land, where I will cause him to fall by the sword.’”
chapters.zh: 我必惊动〔注：原文是使灵进入〕他的心，他要听见风声就归回本地。我必使他在那里倒在刀下。』」

chapters.en: When the Rabshakeh heard that the king of Assyria had left Lachish, he withdrew and found the king fighting against Libnah.
chapters.zh: 拉伯沙基回去，正遇见亚述王攻打立拿，原来他早听见亚述王拔营离开拉吉。

chapters.en:
Now Sennacherib had been warned about Tirhakah king of Cush: “Look, he has set out to fight against you.”
So Sennacherib again sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
chapters.zh: 亚述王听见人论古实王特哈加说：「他出来要与你争战。」于是亚述王又打发使者去见希西家，吩咐他们说：

chapters.en:
“Give this message to Hezekiah king of Judah:
‘Do not let your God, in whom you trust, deceive you by saying that Jerusalem will not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
chapters.zh: 「你们对犹大王希西家如此说：『不要听你所倚靠的上帝欺哄你，说耶路撒冷必不交在亚述王的手中。

chapters.en: Surely you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the other countries, devoting them to destruction. Will you then be spared?
chapters.zh: 你总听说亚述诸王向列国所行的，乃是尽行灭绝，难道你还能得救吗？

chapters.en: Did the gods of the nations destroyed by my fathers rescue those nations—the gods of Gozan, Haran, and Rezeph, and of the people of Eden in Telassar?
chapters.zh: 我列祖所毁灭的，就是歌散、哈兰、利色，和属提‧拉撒的伊甸人，这些国的神何曾拯救这些国呢？

chapters.en: Where are the kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah?’”
chapters.zh: 哈马的王、亚珥拔的王、西法瓦音城的王、希拿，和以瓦的王都在哪里呢？』」

chapters.en: So Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers, read it, and went up to the house of the LORD and spread it out before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 希西家从使者手里接过书信来，看完了，就上耶和华的殿，将书信在耶和华面前展开。

chapters.en:
And Hezekiah prayed before the LORD:
“O LORD, God of Israel, enthroned between the cherubim, You alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You made the heavens and the earth.
chapters.zh: 希西家向耶和华祷告说：「坐在二基路伯上耶和华－以色列的上帝啊，你是天下万国的上帝，你曾创造天地。

chapters.en: Incline Your ear, O LORD, and hear; open Your eyes, O LORD, and see. Listen to the words that Sennacherib has sent to defy the living God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你侧耳而听！耶和华啊，求你睁眼而看！要听西拿基立打发使者来辱骂永生上帝的话。

chapters.en: Truly, O LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste these nations and their lands.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，亚述诸王果然使列国和列国之地变为荒凉，

chapters.en: They have cast their gods into the fire and destroyed them, for they were not gods, but only wood and stone—the work of human hands.
chapters.zh: 将列国的神像都扔在火里；因为它本不是神，乃是人手所造的，是木头石头的，所以灭绝它。

chapters.en: And now, O LORD our God, please save us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that You alone, O LORD, are God.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华－我们的上帝啊，现在求你救我们脱离亚述王的手，使天下万国都知道惟独你－耶和华是上帝！」

chapters.en: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent a message to Hezekiah: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I have heard your prayer concerning Sennacherib king of Assyria.
chapters.zh: 亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚就打发人去见希西家，说：「耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：『你既然求我攻击亚述王西拿基立，我已听见了。』

chapters.en:
This is the word that the LORD has spoken against him:
‘The Virgin Daughter of Zion despises you and mocks you; the Daughter of Jerusalem shakes her head behind you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华论他这样说： 锡安的处女藐视你，嗤笑你； 耶路撒冷的女子向你摇头。

chapters.en: Whom have you taunted and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes in pride? Against the Holy One of Israel!
chapters.zh: 你辱骂谁？亵渎谁？ 扬起声来，高举眼目攻击谁呢？ 乃是攻击以色列的圣者！

chapters.en:
Through your servants you have taunted the Lord, and you have said:
“With my many chariots I have ascended to the heights of the mountains, to the remote peaks of Lebanon. I have cut down its tallest cedars, the finest of its cypresses. I have reached its farthest outposts, the densest of its forests.
chapters.zh: 你藉你的使者辱骂主， 并说：我率领许多战车上山顶， 到黎巴嫩极深之处； 我要砍伐其中高大的香柏树和佳美的松树； 我必上极高之处，进入肥田的树林。

chapters.en: I have dug wells and drunk foreign waters. With the soles of my feet I have dried up all the streams of Egypt.”
chapters.zh: 我已经在外邦挖井喝水； 我必用脚掌踏干埃及的一切河。

chapters.en: Have you not heard? Long ago I ordained it; in days of old I planned it. Now I have brought it to pass, that you should crush fortified cities into piles of rubble.
chapters.zh: 〔耶和华说〕，我早先所做的， 古时所立的，就是现在藉你 使坚固城荒废，变为乱堆， 这事你岂没有听见吗？

chapters.en: Therefore their inhabitants, devoid of power, are dismayed and ashamed. They are like plants in the field, tender green shoots, grass on the rooftops, scorched before it is grown.
chapters.zh: 所以其中的居民力量甚小， 惊惶羞愧。 他们像野草，像青菜， 如房顶上的草， 又如未长成而枯干的禾稼。

chapters.en:
But I know your sitting down, your going out and coming in,
and your raging against Me.
chapters.zh: 你坐下，你出去，你进来， 你向我发烈怒，我都知道。

chapters.en: Because your rage and arrogance against Me have reached My ears, I will put My hook in your nose and My bit in your mouth; I will send you back the way you came.’
chapters.zh: 因你向我发烈怒， 又因你狂傲〔的话〕达到我耳中， 我就要用钩子钩上你的鼻子， 把嚼环放在你口里， 使你从你来的路转回去。

chapters.en:
And this will be a sign to you, O Hezekiah:
This year you will eat what grows on its own, and in the second year what springs from the same. But in the third year you will sow and reap; you will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
chapters.zh: 「以色列人哪，我赐你们一个证据：你们今年要吃自生的，明年也要吃自长的；至于后年，你们要耕种收割，栽植葡萄园，吃其中的果子。

chapters.en:
And the surviving remnant of the house of Judah will again take root below
and bear fruit above.
chapters.zh: 犹大家所逃脱余剩的，仍要往下扎根，向上结果。

chapters.en: For a remnant will go forth from Jerusalem, and survivors from Mount Zion. The zeal of the LORD of Hosts will accomplish this.
chapters.zh: 必有余剩的民从耶路撒冷而出；必有逃脱的人从锡安山而来。耶和华的热心必成就这事。

chapters.en:
So this is what the LORD says about the king of Assyria:
‘He will not enter this city or shoot an arrow into it. He will not come before it with a shield or build up a siege ramp against it.
chapters.zh: 「所以，耶和华论亚述王如此说：『他必不得来到这城，也不在这里射箭，不得拿盾牌到城前，也不筑垒攻城。

chapters.en: He will go back the way he came, and he will not enter this city, declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他从哪条路来，必从那条路回去，必不得来到这城。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: I will defend this city and save it for My own sake and for the sake of My servant David.’”
chapters.zh: 因我为自己的缘故，又为我仆人大卫的缘故，必保护拯救这城。』」

chapters.en: And that very night the angel of the LORD went out and struck down 185,000 men in the camp of the Assyrians. When the people got up the next morning, there were all the dead bodies!
chapters.zh: 当夜，耶和华的使者出去，在亚述营中杀了十八万五千人。清早有人起来，一看，都是死尸了。

chapters.en: So Sennacherib king of Assyria broke camp and withdrew. He returned to Nineveh and stayed there.
chapters.zh: 亚述王西拿基立就拔营回去，住在尼尼微。

chapters.en: One day, while he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer put him to the sword and escaped to the land of Ararat. And his son Esar-haddon reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 一日在他的神尼斯洛庙里叩拜，〔他儿子〕亚得米勒和沙利色用刀杀了他，就逃到亚拉腊地。他儿子以撒哈顿接续他作王。

chapters.en: In those days Hezekiah became mortally ill. The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz came to him and said, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Put your house in order, for you are about to die; you will not recover.’”
chapters.zh: 那时，希西家病得要死。亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚去见他，对他说：「耶和华如此说：『你当留遗命与你的家，因为你必死，不能活了。』」

chapters.en: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD, saying,
chapters.zh: 希西家就转脸朝墙，祷告耶和华说：

chapters.en: “Please, O LORD, remember how I have walked before You faithfully and with wholehearted devotion; I have done what is good in Your sight.” And Hezekiah wept bitterly.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华啊，求你记念我在你面前怎样存完全的心，按诚实行事，又做你眼中所看为善的。」希西家就痛哭了。

chapters.en: Before Isaiah had left the middle courtyard, the word of the LORD came to him, saying,
chapters.zh: 以赛亚出来，还没有到中院〔注：院：或译城〕，耶和华的话就临到他，说：

chapters.en: “Go back and tell Hezekiah the leader of My people that this is what the LORD, the God of your father David, says: ‘I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears. I will surely heal you. On the third day from now you will go up to the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 「你回去告诉我民的君希西家说：耶和华－你祖大卫的上帝如此说：『我听见了你的祷告，看见了你的眼泪，我必医治你；到第三日，你必上到耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: I will add fifteen years to your life. And I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city for My sake and for the sake of My servant David.’”
chapters.zh: 我必加增你十五年的寿数，并且我要救你和这城脱离亚述王的手。我为自己和我仆人大卫的缘故，必保护这城。』」

chapters.en: Then Isaiah said, “Prepare a poultice of figs.” So they brought it and applied it to the boil, and Hezekiah recovered.
chapters.zh: 以赛亚说：「当取一块无花果饼来。」人就取了来，贴在疮上，王便痊愈了。

chapters.en: Now Hezekiah had asked Isaiah, “What will be the sign that the LORD will heal me and that I will go up to the house of the LORD on the third day?”
chapters.zh: 希西家问以赛亚说：「耶和华必医治我，到第三日，我能上耶和华的殿，有什么兆头呢？」

chapters.en: And Isaiah had replied, “This will be a sign to you from the LORD that He will do what He has promised: Would you like the shadow to go forward ten steps, or back ten steps?”
chapters.zh: 以赛亚说：「耶和华必成就他所说的。这是他给你的兆头：你要日影向前进十度呢？是要往后退十度呢？」

chapters.en: “It is easy for the shadow to lengthen ten steps,” answered Hezekiah, “but not for it to go back ten steps.”
chapters.zh: 希西家回答说：「日影向前进十度容易，我要日影往后退十度。」

chapters.en: So Isaiah the prophet called out to the LORD, and He brought the shadow back the ten steps it had descended on the stairway of Ahaz.
chapters.zh: 先知以赛亚求告耶和华，耶和华就使亚哈斯的日晷向前进的日影，往后退了十度。

chapters.en: At that time Merodach-baladan son of Baladan king of Babylon sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah, for he had heard about Hezekiah’s illness.
chapters.zh: 那时，巴比伦王巴拉但的儿子米罗达‧巴拉但听见希西家病而痊愈，就送书信和礼物给他。

chapters.en: And Hezekiah received the envoys and showed them all that was in his treasure house—the silver, the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, as well as his armory—all that was found in his storehouses. There was nothing in his palace or in all his dominion that Hezekiah did not show them.
chapters.zh: 希西家听从使者的话，就把他宝库的金子、银子、香料、贵重的膏油，和他武库的一切军器，并他所有的财宝，都给他们看。他家中和他全国之内，希西家没有一样不给他们看的。

chapters.en:
Then the prophet Isaiah went to King Hezekiah and asked, “Where did those men come from, and what did they say to you?”
“They came from a distant land,” Hezekiah replied, “from Babylon.”
chapters.zh: 于是先知以赛亚来见希西家王，问他说：「这些人说什么？他们从哪里来见你？」希西家说：「他们从远方的巴比伦来。」

chapters.en:
“What have they seen in your palace?” Isaiah asked.
“They have seen everything in my palace,” answered Hezekiah. “There is nothing among my treasures that I did not show them.”
chapters.zh: 以赛亚说：「他们在你家里看见了什么？」希西家说：「凡我家中所有的，他们都看见了；我财宝中没有一样不给他们看的。」

chapters.en: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of the LORD:
chapters.zh: 以赛亚对希西家说：「你要听耶和华的话，

chapters.en: The time will surely come when everything in your palace and all that your fathers have stored up until this day will be carried off to Babylon. Nothing will be left, says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 日子必到，凡你家里所有的，并你列祖积蓄到如今的，都要被掳到巴比伦去，不留下一样。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: And some of your descendants, your own flesh and blood, will be taken away to be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.”
chapters.zh: 并且从你本身所生的众子，其中必有被掳去在巴比伦王宫里当太监的。」

chapters.en: But Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “The word of the LORD that you have spoken is good.” For he thought, “Will there not at least be peace and security in my lifetime?”
chapters.zh: 希西家对以赛亚说：「你所说耶和华的话甚好！若在我的年日中有太平和稳固的景况，岂不是好吗？」

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, along with all his might and how he constructed the pool and the tunnel to bring water into the city, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 希西家其余的事和他的勇力，他怎样挖池、挖沟、引水入城，都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: And Hezekiah rested with his fathers, and his son Manasseh reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 希西家与他列祖同睡。他儿子玛拿西接续他作王。

chapters.en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-five years. His mother’s name was Hephzibah.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西登基的时候年十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王五十五年。他母亲名叫协西巴。

chapters.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD by following the abominations of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法耶和华在以色列人面前赶出的外邦人所行可憎的事。
