chapters.en: For he rebuilt the high places that his father Hezekiah had destroyed, and he raised up altars for Baal. He made an Asherah pole, as King Ahab of Israel had done, and he worshiped and served all the host of heaven.
chapters.zh: 重新建筑他父希西家所毁坏的邱坛，又为巴力筑坛，做亚舍拉像，效法以色列王亚哈所行的，且敬拜事奉天上的万象；

chapters.en: Manasseh also built altars in the house of the LORD, of which the LORD had said, “In Jerusalem I will put My Name.”
chapters.zh: 在耶和华殿宇中筑坛。耶和华曾指着这殿说：「我必立我的名在耶路撒冷。」

chapters.en: In both courtyards of the house of the LORD, he built altars to all the host of heaven.
chapters.zh: 他在耶和华殿的两院中为天上的万象筑坛，

chapters.en: He sacrificed his own son in the fire, practiced sorcery and divination, and consulted mediums and spiritists. He did great evil in the sight of the LORD, provoking Him to anger.
chapters.zh: 并使他的儿子经火，又观兆，用法术，立交鬼的和行巫术的，多行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，惹动他的怒气；

chapters.en: Manasseh even took the carved Asherah pole he had made and set it up in the temple, of which the LORD had said to David and his son Solomon, “In this temple and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will establish My Name forever.
chapters.zh: 又在殿内立雕刻的亚舍拉像。耶和华曾对大卫和他儿子所罗门说：「我在以色列众支派中所选择的耶路撒冷和这殿，必立我的名，直到永远。

chapters.en: I will never again cause the feet of the Israelites to wander from the land that I gave to their fathers, if only they are careful to do all I have commanded them—the whole Law that My servant Moses commanded them.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人若谨守遵行我一切所吩咐他们的和我仆人摩西所吩咐他们的一切律法，我就不再使他们挪移离开我所赐给他们列祖之地。」

chapters.en: But the people did not listen and Manasseh led them astray, so that they did greater evil than the nations that the LORD had destroyed before the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 他们却不听从。玛拿西引诱他们行恶，比耶和华在以色列人面前所灭的列国更甚。

chapters.en: And the LORD spoke through His servants the prophets, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华藉他仆人众先知说：

chapters.en: “Since Manasseh king of Judah has committed all these abominations, acting more wickedly than the Amorites who preceded him, and with his idols has caused Judah to sin,
chapters.zh: 「因犹大王玛拿西行这些可憎的恶事比先前亚摩利人所行的更甚，使犹大人拜他的偶像，陷在罪里；

chapters.en: this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I am bringing such calamity upon Jerusalem and Judah that the news will reverberate in the ears of all who hear it.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：我必降祸与耶路撒冷和犹大，叫一切听见的人无不耳鸣。

chapters.en: I will stretch out over Jerusalem the measuring line used against Samaria and the plumb line used against the house of Ahab, and I will wipe out Jerusalem as one wipes out a bowl—wiping it and turning it upside down.
chapters.zh: 我必用量撒马利亚的准绳和亚哈家的线铊拉在耶路撒冷上，必擦净耶路撒冷，如人擦盘，将盘倒扣。

chapters.en: So I will forsake the remnant of My inheritance and deliver them into the hands of their enemies. And they will become plunder and spoil to all their enemies,
chapters.zh: 我必弃掉所余剩的子民〔注：原文是产业〕，把他们交在仇敌手中，使他们成为一切仇敌掳掠之物；

chapters.en: because they have done evil in My sight and have provoked Me to anger from the day their fathers came out of Egypt until this day.’”
chapters.zh: 是因他们自从列祖出埃及直到如今，常行我眼中看为恶的事，惹动我的怒气。」

chapters.en: Moreover, Manasseh shed so much innocent blood that he filled Jerusalem from end to end, in addition to the sin that he had caused Judah to commit, doing evil in the sight of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，使犹大人陷在罪里，又流许多无辜人的血，充满了耶路撒冷，从这边直到那边。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Manasseh, along with all his accomplishments and the sin that he committed, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 玛拿西其余的事，凡他所行的和他所犯的罪都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: And Manasseh rested with his fathers and was buried in his palace garden, the garden of Uzza. And his son Amon reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西与他列祖同睡，葬在自己宫院乌撒的园内；他儿子亚们接续他作王。

chapters.en: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem two years. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth daughter of Haruz; she was from Jotbah.
chapters.zh: 亚们登基的时候年二十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王二年。他母亲名叫米舒利密，是约提巴人哈鲁斯的女儿。

chapters.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, as his father Manasseh had done.
chapters.zh: 亚们行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，与他父亲玛拿西所行的一样；

chapters.en: He walked in all the ways of his father, and he served and worshiped the idols his father had served.
chapters.zh: 行他父亲一切所行的，敬奉他父亲所敬奉的偶像，

chapters.en: He abandoned the LORD, the God of his fathers, and did not walk in the way of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 离弃耶和华－他列祖的上帝，不遵行耶和华的道。

chapters.en: Then the servants of Amon conspired against him and killed the king in his palace.
chapters.zh: 亚们王的臣仆背叛他，在宫里杀了他。

chapters.en: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon, and they made his son Josiah king in his place.
chapters.zh: 但国民杀了那些背叛亚们王的人，立他儿子约西亚接续他作王。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Amon, along with his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 亚们其余所行的事都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: And he was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, and his son Josiah reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 亚们葬在乌撒的园内自己的坟墓里。他儿子约西亚接续他作王。

chapters.en: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years. His mother’s name was Jedidah daughter of Adaiah; she was from Bozkath.
chapters.zh: 约西亚登基的时候年八岁，在耶路撒冷作王三十一年。他母亲名叫耶底大，是波斯加人亚大雅的女儿。

chapters.en: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD and walked in all the ways of his father David; he did not turn aside to the right or to the left.
chapters.zh: 约西亚行耶和华眼中看为正的事，行他祖大卫一切所行的，不偏左右。

chapters.en: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, King Josiah sent the scribe, Shaphan son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, to the house of the LORD, saying,
chapters.zh: 约西亚王十八年，王差遣米书兰的孙子、亚萨利的儿子－书记沙番上耶和华殿去，吩咐他说：

chapters.en: “Go up to Hilkiah the high priest and have him count the money that has been brought into the house of the LORD, which the doorkeepers have collected from the people.
chapters.zh: 「你去见大祭司希勒家，使他将奉到耶和华殿的银子，就是守门的从民中收聚的银子，数算数算，

chapters.en: And let them deliver it into the hands of the supervisors of those doing the work on the house of the LORD, who in turn are to give it to the workmen repairing the damages to the house of the LORD—
chapters.zh: 交给耶和华殿里办事的人，使他们转交耶和华殿里做工的人，好修理殿的破坏之处，

chapters.en: to the carpenters, builders, and masons—to buy timber and dressed stone to repair the temple.
chapters.zh: 就是转交木匠和工人，并瓦匠，又买木料和凿成的石头修理殿宇，

chapters.en: But they need not account for the money put into their hands, since they work with integrity.”
chapters.zh: 将银子交在办事的人手里，不与他们算帐，因为他们办事诚实。」

chapters.en: Then Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the LORD!” And he gave it to Shaphan, who read it.
chapters.zh: 大祭司希勒家对书记沙番说：「我在耶和华殿里得了律法书。」希勒家将书递给沙番，沙番就看了。

chapters.en: And Shaphan the scribe went to the king and reported, “Your servants have paid out the money that was found in the temple and have put it into the hands of the workers and supervisors of the house of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 书记沙番到王那里，回复王说：「你的仆人已将殿里的银子倒出数算，交给耶和华殿里办事的人了。」

chapters.en: Moreover, Shaphan the scribe told the king, “Hilkiah the priest has given me a book.” And Shaphan read it in the presence of the king.
chapters.zh: 书记沙番又对王说：「祭司希勒家递给我一卷书。」沙番就在王面前读那书。

chapters.en: When the king heard the words of the Book of the Law, he tore his clothes
chapters.zh: 王听见律法书上的话，便撕裂衣服，

chapters.en: and commanded Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Achbor son of Micaiah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the servant of the king:
chapters.zh: 吩咐祭司希勒家与沙番的儿子亚希甘、米该亚的儿子亚革波、书记沙番和王的臣仆亚撒雅，说：

chapters.en: “Go and inquire of the LORD for me, for the people, and for all Judah concerning the words in this book that has been found. For great is the wrath of the LORD that burns against us because our fathers have not obeyed the words of this book by doing all that is written about us.”
chapters.zh: 「你们去为我、为民、为犹大众人，以这书上的话求问耶和华；因为我们列祖没有听从这书上的言语，没有遵着书上所吩咐我们的去行，耶和华就向我们大发烈怒。」

chapters.en: So Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah went and spoke to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, the keeper of the wardrobe. She lived in Jerusalem, in the Second District.
chapters.zh: 于是，祭司希勒家和亚希甘、亚革波、沙番、亚撒雅都去见女先知户勒大。户勒大是掌管礼服沙龙的妻；沙龙是哈珥哈斯的孙子、特瓦的儿子。户勒大住在耶路撒冷第二区。他们请问于她。

chapters.en: And Huldah said to them, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Tell the man who sent you
chapters.zh: 她对他们说：「耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：『你们可以回复那差遣你们来见我的人说，

chapters.en: that this is what the LORD says: I am about to bring calamity on this place and on its people, according to all the words of the book that the king of Judah has read,
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：我必照着犹大王所读那书上的一切话，降祸与这地和其上的居民。

chapters.en: because they have forsaken Me and burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke Me to anger with all the works of their hands. My wrath will be kindled against this place and will not be quenched.’
chapters.zh: 因为他们离弃我，向别神烧香，用他们手所做的惹我发怒，所以我的忿怒必向这地发作，总不止息。』

chapters.en: But as for the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, tell him that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘As for the words that you heard,
chapters.zh: 然而，差遣你们来求问耶和华的犹大王，你们要这样回复他说：『耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：至于你所听见的话，

chapters.en: because your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before the LORD when you heard what I spoke against this place and against its people, that they would become a desolation and a curse, and because you have torn your clothes and wept before Me, I have heard you,’ declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 就是听见我指着这地和其上的居民所说、要使这地变为荒场、民受咒诅的话，你便心里敬服，在我面前自卑，撕裂衣服，向我哭泣，因此我应允了你。这是我－耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
‘Therefore I will indeed gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes will not see all the calamity that I will bring on this place.’”
So they brought her answer back to the king.
chapters.zh: 我必使你平平安安地归到坟墓到你列祖那里；我要降与这地的一切灾祸，你也不致亲眼看见。』」他们就回复王去了。

chapters.en: Then the king summoned all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 王差遣人招聚犹大和耶路撒冷的众长老来。

chapters.en: And he went up to the house of the LORD with all the people of Judah and Jerusalem, as well as the priests and the prophets—all the people small and great—and in their hearing he read all the words of the Book of the Covenant that had been found in the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 王和犹大众人与耶路撒冷的居民，并祭司、先知，和所有的百姓，无论大小，都一同上到耶和华的殿；王就把耶和华殿里所得的约书念给他们听。

chapters.en: So the king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the LORD to follow the LORD and to keep His commandments, decrees, and statutes with all his heart and all his soul, and to carry out the words of the covenant that were written in this book. And all the people entered into the covenant.
chapters.zh: 王站在柱旁，在耶和华面前立约，要尽心尽性地顺从耶和华，遵守他的诫命、法度、律例，成就这书上所记的约言。众民都服从这约。

chapters.en: Then the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, the priests second in rank, and the doorkeepers to remove from the temple of the LORD all the articles made for Baal, Asherah, and all the host of heaven. And he burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron and carried their ashes to Bethel.
chapters.zh: 王吩咐大祭司希勒家和副祭司，并把门的，将那为巴力和亚舍拉，并天上万象所造的器皿，都从耶和华殿里搬出来，在耶路撒冷外汲沦溪旁的田间烧了，把灰拿到伯特利去。

chapters.en: Josiah also did away with the idolatrous priests ordained by the kings of Judah to burn incense on the high places of the cities of Judah and in the places all around Jerusalem—those who had burned incense to Baal, to the sun and moon, to the constellations, and to all the host of heaven.
chapters.zh: 从前犹大列王所立拜偶像的祭司，在犹大城邑的邱坛和耶路撒冷的周围烧香，现在王都废去，又废去向巴力和日、月、行星〔注：或译：十二宫〕，并天上万象烧香的人；

chapters.en: He brought the Asherah pole from the house of the LORD to the Kidron Valley outside Jerusalem, and there he burned it, ground it to powder, and threw its dust on the graves of the common people.
chapters.zh: 又从耶和华殿里将亚舍拉搬到耶路撒冷外汲沦溪边焚烧，打碎成灰，将灰撒在平民的坟上；

chapters.en: He also tore down the quarters of the male shrine prostitutes that were in the house of the LORD, where the women had woven tapestries for Asherah.
chapters.zh: 又拆毁耶和华殿里娈童的屋子，就是妇女为亚舍拉织帐子的屋子，

chapters.en: Then Josiah brought all the priests from the cities of Judah and desecrated the high places, from Geba to Beersheba, where the priests had burned incense. He tore down the high places of the gates at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which was to the left of the city gate.
chapters.zh: 并且从犹大的城邑带众祭司来，污秽祭司烧香的邱坛，从迦巴直到别是巴，又拆毁城门旁的邱坛，这邱坛在邑宰约书亚门前，进城门的左边。

chapters.en: Although the priests of the high places did not come up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, they ate unleavened bread with their fellow priests.
chapters.zh: 但是邱坛的祭司不登耶路撒冷耶和华的坛，只在他们弟兄中间吃无酵饼。

chapters.en: He also desecrated Topheth in the Valley of Ben-hinnom so that no one could sacrifice his son or daughter in the fire to Molech.
chapters.zh: 又污秽欣嫩子谷的陀斐特，不许人在那里使儿女经火献给摩洛；

chapters.en: And he removed from the entrance to the house of the LORD the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun. They were in the court near the chamber of an official named Nathan-melech. And Josiah burned up the chariots of the sun.
chapters.zh: 又将犹大列王在耶和华殿门旁、太监拿单‧米勒靠近游廊的屋子、向日头所献的马废去，且用火焚烧日车。

chapters.en: He pulled down the altars that the kings of Judah had set up on the roof near the upper chamber of Ahaz, and the altars that Manasseh had set up in the two courtyards of the house of the LORD. The king pulverized them there and threw their dust into the Kidron Valley.
chapters.zh: 犹大列王在亚哈斯楼顶上所筑的坛和玛拿西在耶和华殿两院中所筑的坛，王都拆毁打碎了，就把灰倒在汲沦溪中。

chapters.en: The king also desecrated the high places east of Jerusalem, to the south of the Mount of Corruption, which King Solomon of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
chapters.zh: 从前以色列王所罗门在耶路撒冷前、邪僻山右边为西顿人可憎的神亚斯她录、摩押人可憎的神基抹、亚扪人可憎的神米勒公所筑的邱坛，王都污秽了，

chapters.en: He smashed the sacred pillars to pieces, cut down the Asherah poles, and covered the sites with human bones.
chapters.zh: 又打碎柱像，砍下木偶，将人的骨头充满了那地方。

chapters.en: He even pulled down the altar at Bethel, the high place set up by Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused Israel to sin. Then he burned the high place, ground it to powder, and burned the Asherah pole.
chapters.zh: 他将伯特利的坛，就是叫以色列人陷在罪里、尼八的儿子耶罗波安所筑的那坛，都拆毁焚烧，打碎成灰，并焚烧了亚舍拉。

chapters.en: And as Josiah turned, he saw the tombs there on the hillside, and he sent someone to take the bones out of the tombs, and he burned them on the altar to defile it, according to the word of the LORD proclaimed by the man of God who had foretold these things.
chapters.zh: 约西亚回头，看见山上的坟墓，就打发人将坟墓里的骸骨取出来，烧在坛上，污秽了坛，正如从前神人宣传耶和华的话。

chapters.en:
Then the king asked, “What is this monument I see?”
And the men of the city replied, “It is the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and proclaimed these things that you have done to the altar of Bethel.”
chapters.zh: 约西亚问说：「我所看见的是什么碑？」那城里的人回答说：「先前有神人从犹大来，预先说王现在向伯特利坛所行的事，这就是他的墓碑。」

chapters.en:
“Let him rest,” said Josiah. “Do not let anyone disturb his bones.”
So they left his bones undisturbed, along with those of the prophet who had come from Samaria.
chapters.zh: 约西亚说：「由他吧！不要挪移他的骸骨。」他们就不动他的骸骨，也不动从撒马利亚来那先知的骸骨。

chapters.en: Just as Josiah had done at Bethel, so also in the cities of Samaria he removed all the shrines of the high places set up by the kings of Israel who had provoked the LORD to anger.
chapters.zh: 从前以色列诸王在撒马利亚的城邑建筑邱坛的殿，惹动〔耶和华〕的怒气，现在约西亚都废去了，就如他在伯特利所行的一般；

chapters.en: On the altars he slaughtered all the priests of the high places, and he burned human bones on them. Then he returned to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 又将邱坛的祭司都杀在坛上，并在坛上烧人的骨头，就回耶路撒冷去了。

chapters.en: The king commanded all the people, “Keep the Passover of the LORD your God, as it is written in this Book of the Covenant.”
chapters.zh: 王吩咐众民说：「你们当照这约书上所写的，向耶和华－你们的上帝守逾越节。」

chapters.en: No such Passover had been observed from the days of the judges who had governed Israel through all the days of the kings of Israel and Judah.
chapters.zh: 自从士师治理以色列人和以色列王、犹大王的时候，〔直到如今〕，实在没有守过这样的逾越节；

chapters.en: But in the eighteenth year of Josiah’s reign, this Passover was observed to the LORD in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 只有约西亚王十八年在耶路撒冷向耶和华守这逾越节。

chapters.en: Furthermore, Josiah removed the mediums and spiritists, the household gods and idols, and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem. He did this to carry out the words of the law written in the book that Hilkiah the priest had found in the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 凡犹大国和耶路撒冷所有交鬼的、行巫术的，与家中的神像和偶像，并一切可憎之物，约西亚尽都除掉，成就了祭司希勒家在耶和华殿里所得律法书上所写的话。

chapters.en: Neither before nor after Josiah was there any king like him, who turned to the LORD with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his strength, according to all the Law of Moses.
chapters.zh: 在约西亚以前没有王像他尽心、尽性、尽力地归向耶和华，遵行摩西的一切律法；在他以后也没有兴起一个王像他。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, the LORD did not turn away from the fury of His burning anger, which was kindled against Judah because of all that Manasseh had done to provoke Him to anger.
chapters.zh: 然而，耶和华向犹大所发猛烈的怒气仍不止息，是因玛拿西诸事惹动他。

chapters.en: For the LORD had said, “I will remove Judah from My sight, just as I removed Israel. I will reject this city Jerusalem, which I chose, and the temple of which I said, ‘My Name shall be there.’”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我必将犹大人从我面前赶出，如同赶出以色列人一般；我必弃掉我从前所选择的这城－耶路撒冷和我所说立我名的殿。」

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Josiah and all his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 约西亚其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: During Josiah’s reign, Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt marched up to help the king of Assyria at the Euphrates River. King Josiah went out to confront him, but Neco faced him and killed him at Megiddo.
chapters.zh: 约西亚年间，埃及王法老尼哥上到幼发拉底河攻击亚述王；约西亚王去抵挡他。埃及王遇见约西亚在米吉多，就杀了他。

chapters.en: From Megiddo his servants carried his body in a chariot, brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own tomb. Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz son of Josiah, anointed him, and made him king in place of his father.
chapters.zh: 他的臣仆用车将他的尸首从米吉多送到耶路撒冷，葬在他自己的坟墓里。国民膏约西亚的儿子约哈斯接续他父亲作王。

chapters.en: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.
chapters.zh: 约哈斯登基的时候年二十三岁，在耶路撒冷作王三个月。他母亲名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。

chapters.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, just as his fathers had done.
chapters.zh: 约哈斯行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他列祖一切所行的。

chapters.en: And Pharaoh Neco imprisoned Jehoahaz at Riblah in the land of Hamath so that he could not reign in Jerusalem, and he imposed on Judah a levy of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
chapters.zh: 法老尼哥将约哈斯锁禁在哈马地的利比拉，不许他在耶路撒冷作王，又罚〔犹大〕国银子一百他连得，金子一他连得。

chapters.en: Then Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim son of Josiah king in place of his father Josiah, and he changed Eliakim’s name to Jehoiakim. But Neco took Jehoahaz and carried him off to Egypt, where he died.
chapters.zh: 法老尼哥立约西亚的儿子以利亚敬接续他父亲约西亚作王，给他改名叫约雅敬，却将约哈斯带到埃及，他就死在那里。

chapters.en: So Jehoiakim paid the silver and gold to Pharaoh Neco, but to meet Pharaoh’s demand he taxed the land and exacted the silver and the gold from the people, each according to his wealth.
chapters.zh: 约雅敬将金银给法老，遵着法老的命向国民征取金银，按着各人的力量派定，索要金银，好给法老尼哥。

chapters.en: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Zebidah daughter of Pedaiah; she was from Rumah.
chapters.zh: 约雅敬登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母亲名叫西布大，是鲁玛人毗大雅的女儿。

chapters.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, just as his fathers had done.
chapters.zh: 约雅敬行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他列祖一切所行的。

chapters.en: During Jehoiakim’s reign, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded. So Jehoiakim became his vassal for three years, until he turned and rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar.
chapters.zh: 约雅敬年间，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒上〔到犹大〕；约雅敬服事他三年，然后背叛他。

chapters.en: And the LORD sent Chaldean, Aramean, Moabite, and Ammonite raiders against Jehoiakim in order to destroy Judah, according to the word that the LORD had spoken through His servants the prophets.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使迦勒底军、亚兰军、摩押军，和亚扪人的军来攻击约雅敬，毁灭犹大，正如耶和华藉他仆人众先知所说的。

chapters.en: Surely this happened to Judah at the LORD’s command, to remove them from His presence because of the sins of Manasseh and all that he had done,
chapters.zh: 这祸临到犹大人，诚然是耶和华所命的，要将他们从自己面前赶出，是因玛拿西所犯的一切罪；

chapters.en: and also for the innocent blood he had shed. For he had filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the LORD was unwilling to forgive.
chapters.zh: 又因他流无辜人的血，充满了耶路撒冷；耶和华决不肯赦免。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, along with all his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
chapters.zh: 约雅敬其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: And Jehoiakim rested with his fathers, and his son Jehoiachin reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 约雅敬与他列祖同睡。他儿子约雅斤接续他作王。

chapters.en: Now the king of Egypt did not march out of his land again, because the king of Babylon had taken all his territory, from the Brook of Egypt to the Euphrates River.
chapters.zh: 埃及王不再从他国中出来；因为巴比伦王将埃及王所管之地，从埃及小河直到幼发拉底河都夺去了。

chapters.en: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta daughter of Elnathan; she was from Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 约雅斤登基的时候年十八岁，在耶路撒冷作王三个月。他母亲名叫尼护施她，是耶路撒冷人以利拿单的女儿。

chapters.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, just as his father had done.
chapters.zh: 约雅斤行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他父亲一切所行的。

chapters.en: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched up to Jerusalem, and the city came under siege.
chapters.zh: 那时，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的军兵上到耶路撒冷，围困城。

chapters.en: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it.
chapters.zh: 当他军兵围困城的时候，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒就亲自来了。

chapters.en:
Jehoiachin king of Judah, his mother, his servants, his commanders, and his officials all surrendered to the king of Babylon.
So in the eighth year of his reign, the king of Babylon took him captive.
chapters.zh: 犹大王约雅斤和他母亲、臣仆、首领、太监一同出城，投降巴比伦王；巴比伦王便拿住他。那时是巴比伦王第八年。

chapters.en: As the LORD had declared, Nebuchadnezzar also carried off all the treasures from the house of the LORD and the royal palace, and he cut into pieces all the gold articles that Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王将耶和华殿和王宫里的宝物都拿去了，将以色列王所罗门所造耶和华殿里的金器都毁坏了，正如耶和华所说的；

chapters.en: He carried into exile all Jerusalem—all the commanders and mighty men of valor, all the craftsmen and metalsmiths—ten thousand captives in all. Only the poorest people of the land remained.
chapters.zh: 又将耶路撒冷的众民和众首领，并所有大能的勇士，共一万人，连一切木匠、铁匠都掳了去；除了国中极贫穷的人以外，没有剩下的；

chapters.en: Nebuchadnezzar carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, as well as the king’s mother, his wives, his officials, and the leading men of the land. He took them into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 并将约雅斤和王母、后妃、太监，与国中的大官，都从耶路撒冷掳到巴比伦去了；

chapters.en: The king of Babylon also brought into exile to Babylon all seven thousand men of valor and a thousand craftsmen and metalsmiths—all strong and fit for battle.
chapters.zh: 又将一切勇士七千人和木匠、铁匠一千人，都是能上阵的勇士，全掳到巴比伦去了。

chapters.en: Then the king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s uncle, king in his place and changed his name to Zedekiah.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王立〔约雅斤〕的叔叔玛探雅代替他作王，给玛探雅改名叫西底家。

chapters.en: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.
chapters.zh: 西底家登基的时候年二十一岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母亲名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。

chapters.en: And Zedekiah did evil in the sight of the LORD, just as Jehoiakim had done.
chapters.zh: 西底家行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，是照约雅敬一切所行的。

chapters.en:
For because of the anger of the LORD, all this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until He finally banished them from His presence.
And Zedekiah also rebelled against the king of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 因此耶和华的怒气在耶路撒冷和犹大发作，以致将人民从自己面前赶出。

chapters.en: So in the ninth year of Zedekiah’s reign, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his entire army. They encamped outside the city and built a siege wall all around it.
chapters.zh: 西底家背叛巴比伦王。他作王第九年十月初十日，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领全军来攻击耶路撒冷，对城安营，四围筑垒攻城。

chapters.en: And the city was kept under siege until King Zedekiah’s eleventh year.
chapters.zh: 于是城被围困，直到西底家王十一年。

chapters.en: By the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine in the city was so severe that the people of the land had no food.
chapters.zh: 四月初九日，城里有大饥荒，甚至百姓都没有粮食。

chapters.en:
Then the city was breached; and though the Chaldeans had surrounded the city, all the men of war fled by night by way of the gate between the two walls near the king’s garden.
They headed toward the Arabah,
chapters.zh: 城被攻破，一切兵丁就在夜间从靠近王园两城中间的门〔逃跑〕。迦勒底人正在四围攻城，〔王〕就向亚拉巴逃走。

chapters.en: but the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king and overtook him in the plains of Jericho, and his whole army deserted him.
chapters.zh: 迦勒底的军队追赶王，在耶利哥的平原追上他；他的全军都离开他四散了。

chapters.en: The Chaldeans seized the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah, where they pronounced judgment on him.
chapters.zh: 迦勒底人就拿住王，带他到在利比拉的巴比伦王那里审判他。

chapters.en: And they slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. Then they put out his eyes, bound him with bronze shackles, and took him to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 在西底家眼前杀了他的众子，并且剜了西底家的眼睛，用铜鍊锁着他，带到巴比伦去。

chapters.en: On the seventh day of the fifth month, in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar’s reign over Babylon, Nebuzaradan captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, entered Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初七日，巴比伦王的臣仆、护卫长尼布撒拉旦来到耶路撒冷，

chapters.en: He burned down the house of the LORD, the royal palace, and all the houses of Jerusalem—every significant building.
chapters.zh: 用火焚烧耶和华的殿和王宫，又焚烧耶路撒冷的房屋，就是各大户家的房屋。

chapters.en: And the whole army of the Chaldeans under the captain of the guard broke down the walls around Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 跟从护卫长迦勒底的全军就拆毁耶路撒冷四围的城墙。

chapters.en: Then Nebuzaradan captain of the guard carried into exile the people who remained in the city, along with the deserters who had defected to the king of Babylon and the rest of the population.
chapters.zh: 那时护卫长尼布撒拉旦将城里所剩下的百姓，并已经投降巴比伦王的人，以及大众所剩下的人，都掳去了。

chapters.en: But the captain of the guard left behind some of the poorest of the land to tend the vineyards and fields.
chapters.zh: 但护卫长留下些民中最穷的，使他们修理葡萄园，耕种田地。

chapters.en: Moreover, the Chaldeans broke up the bronze pillars and stands and the bronze Sea in the house of the LORD, and they carried the bronze to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 耶和华殿的铜柱，并耶和华殿的〔盆〕座和铜海，迦勒底人都打碎了，将那铜运到巴比伦去了，

chapters.en: They also took away the pots, shovels, wick trimmers, dishes, and all the articles of bronze used in the temple service.
chapters.zh: 又带去锅、铲子、蜡剪、调羹，并所用的一切铜器，

chapters.en: The captain of the guard also took away the censers and sprinkling bowls—anything made of pure gold or fine silver.
chapters.zh: 火鼎、碗，无论金的银的，护卫长也都带去了。

chapters.en: As for the two pillars, the Sea, and the movable stands that Solomon had made for the house of the LORD, the weight of the bronze from all these articles was beyond measure.
chapters.zh: 所罗门为耶和华殿所造的两根〔铜〕柱、一个〔铜〕海，和几个〔盆〕座，这一切的铜，多得无法可称。

chapters.en: Each pillar was eighteen cubits tall. The bronze capital atop one pillar was three cubits high, with a network of bronze pomegranates all around. The second pillar, with its network, was similar.
chapters.zh: 这一根柱子高十八肘，柱上有铜顶，高三肘；铜顶的周围有网子和石榴，都是铜的。那一根柱子，照此一样，也有网子。

chapters.en: The captain of the guard also took away Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the priest of second rank, and the three doorkeepers.
chapters.zh: 护卫长拿住大祭司西莱雅、副祭司西番亚，和三个把门的，

chapters.en: Of those still in the city, he took a court official who had been appointed over the men of war, as well as five royal advisors. He also took the scribe of the captain of the army, who had enlisted the people of the land, and sixty men who were found in the city.
chapters.zh: 又从城中拿住一个管理兵丁的官〔注：或译：太监〕，并在城里所遇常见王面的五个人和检点国民军长的书记，以及城里遇见的国民六十个人。

chapters.en: Nebuzaradan captain of the guard took them and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
chapters.zh: 护卫长尼布撒拉旦将这些人带到在利比拉的巴比伦王那里。

chapters.en: There at Riblah in the land of Hamath, the king of Babylon struck them down and put them to death. So Judah was taken into exile, away from its own land.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王就把他们击杀在哈马地的利比拉。这样，犹大人被掳去离开本地。

chapters.en: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, over the people he had left behind in the land of Judah.
chapters.zh: 至于犹大国剩下的民，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒所剩下的，巴比伦王立了沙番的孙子、亚希甘的儿子基大利作他们的省长。

chapters.en: When all the commanders of the armies and their men heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah as governor, they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah—Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah son of the Maacathite, as well as their men.
chapters.zh: 众军长和属他们的人听见巴比伦王立了基大利作省长，于是军长尼探雅的儿子以实玛利、加利亚的儿子约哈难、尼陀法人单户蔑的儿子西莱雅、玛迦人的儿子雅撒尼亚，和属他们的人都到米斯巴见基大利。

chapters.en: And Gedaliah took an oath before them and their men, assuring them, “Do not be afraid of the servants of the Chaldeans. Live in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.”
chapters.zh: 基大利向他们和属他们的人起誓说：「你们不必惧怕迦勒底臣仆，只管住在这地服事巴比伦王，就可以得福。」

chapters.en: In the seventh month, however, Ishmael son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, who was a member of the royal family, came with ten men and struck down and killed Gedaliah, along with the Judeans and Chaldeans who were with him at Mizpah.
chapters.zh: 七月间，宗室以利沙玛的孙子、尼探雅的儿子以实玛利带着十个人来，杀了基大利和同他在米斯巴的犹大人与迦勒底人。

chapters.en: Then all the people small and great, together with the commanders of the army, arose and fled to Egypt for fear of the Chaldeans.
chapters.zh: 于是众民，无论大小，连众军长；因为惧怕迦勒底人，都起身往埃及去了。

chapters.en: On the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month of the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Judah’s King Jehoiachin, in the year Evil-merodach became king of Babylon, he released King Jehoiachin of Judah from prison.
chapters.zh: 犹大王约雅斤被掳后三十七年，巴比伦王以未‧米罗达元年十二月二十七日，使犹大王约雅斤抬头，提他出监；

chapters.en: And he spoke kindly to Jehoiachin and set his throne above the thrones of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.
chapters.zh: 又对他说恩言，使他的位高过与他一同在巴比伦众王的位，

chapters.en: So Jehoiachin changed out of his prison clothes, and he dined regularly at the king’s table for the rest of his life.
chapters.zh: 给他脱了囚服。他终身常在〔巴比伦〕王面前吃饭。

chapters.en: And the king provided Jehoiachin a daily portion for the rest of his life.
chapters.zh: 王赐他所需用的食物，日日赐他一分，终身都是这样。

chapters.en: Adam, Seth, Enosh,
chapters.zh: 亚当〔生〕塞特；塞特〔生〕以挪士；

chapters.en: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
chapters.zh: 以挪士〔生〕该南；该南〔生〕玛勒列；玛勒列〔生〕雅列；

chapters.en: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, Noah.
chapters.zh: 雅列〔生〕以诺；以诺〔生〕玛土撒拉；玛土撒拉〔生〕拉麦；

chapters.en:
The sons of Noah:
Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
chapters.zh: 拉麦〔生〕挪亚；挪亚〔生〕闪、含、雅弗。

chapters.en:
The sons of Japheth:
Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
chapters.zh: 雅弗的儿子是歌篾、玛各、玛代、雅完、土巴、米设、提拉。

chapters.en: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
chapters.zh: 歌篾的儿子是亚实基拿、低法〔注：在创世记十章三节是利法〕、陀迦玛。

chapters.en: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites.
chapters.zh: 雅完的儿子是以利沙、他施、基提、多单〔注：有作罗单的〕。

chapters.en:
The sons of Ham:
Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
chapters.zh: 含的儿子是古实、麦西、弗、迦南。

chapters.en:
The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca.
The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
chapters.zh: 古实的儿子是西巴、哈腓拉、撒弗他、拉玛、撒弗提迦。拉玛的儿子是示巴、底但。

chapters.en: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one on the earth.
chapters.zh: 古实生宁录；他为世上英雄之首。

chapters.en: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, the Anamites, the Lehabites, the Naphtuhites,
chapters.zh: 麦西生路低人、亚拿米人、利哈比人、拿弗土希人、

chapters.en: the Pathrusites, the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorites.
chapters.zh: 帕斯鲁细人、迦斯路希人、迦斐讬人；从迦斐讬出来的有非利士人。

chapters.en: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
chapters.zh: 迦南生长子西顿，又生赫

chapters.en: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
chapters.zh: 和耶布斯人、亚摩利人、革迦撒人、

chapters.en: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
chapters.zh: 希未人、亚基人、西尼人、

chapters.en: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.
chapters.zh: 亚瓦底人、洗玛利人，并哈马人。

chapters.en:
The sons of Shem:
Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.
The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
chapters.zh: 闪的儿子是以拦、亚述、亚法撒、路德、亚兰、乌斯、户勒、基帖、米设〔注：在创世记十章二十三节是玛施〕。

chapters.en: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
chapters.zh: 亚法撒生沙拉；沙拉生希伯。

chapters.en: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.
chapters.zh: 希伯生了两个儿子：一个名叫法勒〔注：就是分的意思〕，因为那时人就分地居住；法勒的兄弟名叫约坍。

chapters.en: And Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
chapters.zh: 约坍生亚摩答、沙列、哈萨玛非、耶拉、

chapters.en: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
chapters.zh: 哈多兰、乌萨、德拉、

chapters.en: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
chapters.zh: 以巴录、亚比玛利、示巴、

chapters.en: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
chapters.zh: 阿斐、哈腓拉、约巴。这都是约坍的儿子。

chapters.en: So from Shem came Arphaxad, Shelah,
chapters.zh: 闪〔生〕亚法撒；亚法撒〔生〕沙拉；

chapters.en: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
chapters.zh: 沙拉〔生〕希伯；希伯〔生〕法勒；法勒〔生〕拉吴；

chapters.en: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
chapters.zh: 拉吴〔生〕西鹿；西鹿〔生〕拿鹤；拿鹤〔生〕他拉；

chapters.en: and Abram (that is, Abraham).
chapters.zh: 他拉〔生〕亚伯兰，亚伯兰就是亚伯拉罕。

chapters.en: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕的儿子是以撒、以实玛利。

chapters.en:
These are their genealogies:
Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
chapters.zh: 以实玛利的儿子记在下面：以实玛利的长子是尼拜约，其次是基达、押德别、米比衫、

chapters.en: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
chapters.zh: 米施玛、度玛、玛撒、哈达、提玛、

chapters.en: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.
chapters.zh: 伊突、拿非施、基底玛。这都是以实玛利的儿子。

chapters.en:
The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine:
Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
The sons of Jokshan:
Sheba and Dedan.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕的妾基土拉所生的儿子，就是心兰、约珊、米但、米甸、伊施巴、书亚。约珊的儿子是示巴、底但。

chapters.en:
The sons of Midian:
Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah.
All of these were Keturah’s sons.
chapters.zh: 米甸的儿子是以法、以弗、哈诺、亚比大、以勒大。这都是基土拉的子孙。

chapters.en:
Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac:
Esau and Israel.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕生以撒；以撒的儿子是以扫和以色列。

chapters.en:
The sons of Esau:
Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
chapters.zh: 以扫的儿子是以利法、流珥、耶乌施、雅兰、可拉。

chapters.en: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz; and by Timna, Amalek.
chapters.zh: 以利法的儿子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基纳斯、亭纳、亚玛力。

chapters.en: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
chapters.zh: 流珥的儿子是拿哈、谢拉、沙玛、米撒。

chapters.en:
The sons of Seir:
Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
chapters.zh: 西珥的儿子是罗坍、朔巴、祭便、亚拿、底顺、以察、底珊。

chapters.en: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
chapters.zh: 罗坍的儿子是何利、荷幔；罗坍的妹子是亭纳。

chapters.en:
The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
chapters.zh: 朔巴的儿子是亚勒文、玛拿辖、以巴录、示非、阿南。祭便的儿子是亚雅、亚拿。

chapters.en:
The son of Anah: Dishon.
The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
chapters.zh: 亚拿的儿子是底顺。底顺的儿子是哈默兰、伊是班、益兰、基兰。

chapters.en:
The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
chapters.zh: 以察的儿子是辟罕、撒番、亚干。底珊的儿子是乌斯、亚兰。

chapters.en:
These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites:
Bela son of Beor. His city was named Dinhabah.
chapters.zh: 以色列人未有君王治理之先，在以东地作王的记在下面：有比珥的儿子比拉，他的〔京〕城名叫亭哈巴。

chapters.en: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 比拉死了，波斯拉人谢拉的儿子约巴接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 约巴死了，提幔地的人户珊接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.
chapters.zh: 户珊死了，比达的儿子哈达接续他作王。这哈达就是在摩押地杀败米甸人的，他的〔京〕城名叫亚未得。

chapters.en: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 哈达死了，玛士利加人桑拉接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the Euphrates reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 桑拉死了，大河边的利河伯人扫罗接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 扫罗死了，亚革波的儿子巴勒‧哈南接续他作王。

chapters.en: When Baal-hanan died, Hadad reigned in his place. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
chapters.zh: 巴勒‧哈南死了，哈达接续他作王。他的〔京〕城名叫巴伊，他的妻子名叫米希她别，是米‧萨合的孙女，玛特列的女儿。

chapters.en:
Then Hadad died.
Now the chiefs of Edom were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
chapters.zh: 哈达死了，以东人的族长有亭纳族长、亚勒瓦族长、耶帖族长、

chapters.en: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
chapters.zh: 亚何利巴玛族长、以拉族长、比嫩族长、

chapters.en: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
chapters.zh: 基纳斯族长、提幔族长、米比萨族长、

chapters.en: Magdiel, and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
chapters.zh: 玛基叠族长、以兰族长。这都是以东人的族长。

chapters.en:
These were the sons of Israel:
Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
chapters.zh: 以色列的儿子是吕便、西缅、利未、犹大、以萨迦、西布伦、

chapters.en: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
chapters.zh: 但、约瑟、便雅悯、拿弗他利、迦得、亚设。

chapters.en:
The sons of Judah:
Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by Bath-shua the Canaanite. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD. So the LORD put him to death.
chapters.zh: 犹大的儿子是珥、俄南、示拉，这三人是迦南人书亚女儿所生的。犹大的长子珥在耶和华眼中看为恶，耶和华就使他死了。

chapters.en: Tamar, Judah’s daughter-in-law, bore to him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.
chapters.zh: 犹大的儿妇她玛给犹大生法勒斯和谢拉。犹大共有五个儿子。

chapters.en:
The sons of Perez:
Hezron and Hamul.
chapters.zh: 法勒斯的儿子是希斯崙、哈母勒。

chapters.en:
The sons of Zerah:
Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara —five in all.
chapters.zh: 谢拉的儿子是心利、以探、希幔、甲各、大拉〔注：就是达大〕，共五人。

chapters.en:
The son of Carmi:
Achar, who brought trouble upon Israel by violating the ban on devoted things.
chapters.zh: 迦米的儿子是亚干，这亚干在当灭的物上犯了罪，连累了以色列人。

chapters.en:
The son of Ethan:
Azariah.
chapters.zh: 以探的儿子是亚撒利雅。

chapters.en:
The sons who were born to Hezron:
Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
chapters.zh: 希斯崙所生的儿子是耶拉篾、兰、基路拜。

chapters.en: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, a leader of the descendants of Judah.
chapters.zh: 兰生亚米拿达；亚米拿达生拿顺。拿顺作犹大人的首领。

chapters.en: Nahshon was the father of Salmon, and Salmon was the father of Boaz.
chapters.zh: 拿顺生撒门；撒门生波阿斯；

chapters.en: Boaz was the father of Obed, and Obed was the father of Jesse.
chapters.zh: 波阿斯生俄备得；俄备得生耶西；

chapters.en: Jesse was the father of Eliab his firstborn; Abinadab was born second, Shimea third,
chapters.zh: 耶西生长子以利押，次子亚比拿达，三子示米亚〔注：示米亚就是沙玛，见撒母耳上十六章九节〕，

chapters.en: Nethanel fourth, Raddai fifth,
chapters.zh: 四子拿坦业，五子拉代，

chapters.en: Ozem sixth, and David seventh.
chapters.zh: 六子阿鲜，七子大卫。

chapters.en: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the three sons of Zeruiah were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
chapters.zh: 他们的姊妹是洗鲁雅和亚比该。洗鲁雅的儿子是亚比筛、约押、亚撒黑，共三人。

chapters.en: Abigail was the mother of Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.
chapters.zh: 亚比该生亚玛撒；亚玛撒的父亲是以实玛利人益帖。

chapters.en: Caleb son of Hezron had children by his wife Azubah and by Jerioth. These were the sons of Azubah: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
chapters.zh: 希斯崙的儿子迦勒娶阿苏巴和耶略为妻，阿苏巴的儿子是耶设、朔罢、押墩。

chapters.en: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore to him Hur.
chapters.zh: 阿苏巴死了，迦勒又娶以法她，生了户珥。

chapters.en: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri was the father of Bezalel.
chapters.zh: 户珥生乌利；乌利生比撒列。

chapters.en: Later, Hezron slept with the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead. He had married her when he was sixty years old, and she bore to him Segub.
chapters.zh: 希斯崙正六十岁娶了基列父亲玛吉的女儿，与她同房；玛吉的女儿生了西割；

chapters.en: Segub was the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
chapters.zh: 西割生睚珥。睚珥在基列地有二十三个城邑。

chapters.en: But Geshur and Aram captured Havvoth-jair, along with Kenath and its sixty surrounding villages. All these were descendants of Machir the father of Gilead.
chapters.zh: 后来基述人和亚兰人夺了睚珥的城邑，并基纳和其乡村，共六十个。这都是基列父亲玛吉之子的。

chapters.en: After Hezron died in Caleb-ephrathah, his wife Abijah bore to him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
chapters.zh: 希斯崙在迦勒‧以法他死后，他的妻亚比雅给他生了亚施户；亚施户是提哥亚的父亲。

chapters.en:
The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron:
Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
chapters.zh: 希斯崙的长子耶拉篾生长子兰，又生布拿、阿连、阿鲜、亚希雅。

chapters.en: Jerahmeel had another wife named Atarah, who was the mother of Onam.
chapters.zh: 耶拉篾又娶一妻名叫亚她拉，是阿南的母亲。

chapters.en:
The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel:
Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
chapters.zh: 耶拉篾长子兰的儿子是玛斯、雅悯、以结。

chapters.en:
The sons of Onam:
Shammai and Jada.
The sons of Shammai:
Nadab and Abishur.
chapters.zh: 阿南的儿子是沙买、雅大。沙买的儿子是拿答、亚比述。

chapters.en: Abishur’s wife was named Abihail, and she bore to him Ahban and Molid.
chapters.zh: 亚比述的妻名叫亚比孩，亚比孩给他生了亚办和摩利。

chapters.en:
The sons of Nadab:
Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.
chapters.zh: 拿答的儿子是西列、亚遍；西列死了没有儿子。

chapters.en:
The son of Appaim:
Ishi.
The son of Ishi:
Sheshan.
The son of Sheshan:
Ahlai.
chapters.zh: 亚遍的儿子是以示；以示的儿子是示珊；示珊的儿子是亚来。

chapters.en:
The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai:
Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.
chapters.zh: 沙买兄弟雅大的儿子是益帖、约拿单；益帖死了没有儿子。

chapters.en:
The sons of Jonathan:
Peleth and Zaza.
These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.
chapters.zh: 约拿单的儿子是比勒、撒萨。这都是耶拉篾的子孙。

chapters.en: Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. He also had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.
chapters.zh: 示珊没有儿子，只有女儿。示珊有一个仆人名叫耶哈，是埃及人。

chapters.en: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore to him Attai.
chapters.zh: 示珊将女儿给了仆人耶哈为妻，给他生了亚太。

chapters.en: Attai was the father of Nathan, Nathan was the father of Zabad,
chapters.zh: 亚太生拿单；拿单生撒拔；

chapters.en: Zabad was the father of Ephlal, Ephlal was the father of Obed,
chapters.zh: 撒拔生以弗拉；以弗拉生俄备得；

chapters.en: Obed was the father of Jehu, Jehu was the father of Azariah,
chapters.zh: 俄备得生耶户；耶户生亚撒利雅；

chapters.en: Azariah was the father of Helez, Helez was the father of Elasah,
chapters.zh: 亚撒利雅生希利斯；希利斯生以利亚萨；

chapters.en: Elasah was the father of Sismai, Sismai was the father of Shallum,
chapters.zh: 以利亚萨生西斯买；西斯买生沙龙；

chapters.en: Shallum was the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.
chapters.zh: 沙龙生耶加米雅；耶加米雅生以利沙玛。

chapters.en:
The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel:
Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and Mareshah his second son, who was the father of Hebron.
chapters.zh: 耶拉篾兄弟迦勒的长子米沙，是西弗之祖玛利沙的儿子，是希伯崙之祖。

chapters.en:
The sons of Hebron:
Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
chapters.zh: 希伯崙的儿子是可拉、他普亚、利肯、示玛。

chapters.en: Shema was the father of Raham the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem was the father of Shammai.
chapters.zh: 示玛生拉含，是约干之祖。利肯生沙买。

chapters.en: The son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
chapters.zh: 沙买的儿子是玛云；玛云是伯‧夙之祖。

chapters.en: Caleb’s concubine Ephah was the mother of Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.
chapters.zh: 迦勒的妾以法生哈兰、摩撒、迦谢；哈兰生迦卸。

chapters.en:
The sons of Jahdai:
Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
chapters.zh: （雅代的儿子是利健、约坦、基珊、毗力、以法、沙亚弗。）

chapters.en: Caleb’s concubine Maacah was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah.
chapters.zh: 迦勒的妾玛迦生示别、特哈拿，

chapters.en: She was also the mother of Shaaph father of Madmannah, and of Sheva father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb’s daughter was Acsah.
chapters.zh: 又生麦玛拿之祖沙亚弗、抹比拿和基比亚之祖示法。迦勒的女儿是押撒。

chapters.en:
These were the descendants of Caleb.
The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah:
Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim,
chapters.zh: 迦勒的子孙就是以法她的长子、户珥的儿子，记在下面：基列‧耶琳之祖朔巴，

chapters.en: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
chapters.zh: 伯利恒之祖萨玛，伯迦得之祖哈勒。

chapters.en:
These were the descendants of Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim:
Haroeh, half the Manahathites,
chapters.zh: 基列‧耶琳之祖朔巴的子孙是哈罗以和一半米努‧哈人〔注：米努‧哈人就是玛拿哈人〕。

chapters.en: and the clans of Kiriath-jearim—the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites, and Mishraites. From these descended the Zorathites and Eshtaolites.
chapters.zh: 基列‧耶琳的诸族是以帖人、布特人、舒玛人、密来人，又从这些族中生出琐拉人和以实陶人来。

chapters.en:
The descendants of Salma:
Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, half the Manahathites, the Zorites,
chapters.zh: 萨玛的子孙是伯利恒人、尼陀法人、亚他绿‧伯‧约押人、一半玛拿哈人、琐利人，

chapters.en: and the clans of the scribes who lived at Jabez—the Tirathites, Shimeathites, and Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
chapters.zh: 和住雅比斯众文士家的特拉人、示米押人、苏甲人。这都是基尼人利甲家之祖哈末所生的。
大卫在希伯崙所生的儿子记在下面：长子暗嫩是耶斯列人亚希暖生的。次子但以利是迦密人亚比该生的。

chapters.en:
the third was Absalom the son of Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur;
the fourth was Adonijah the son of Haggith;
chapters.zh: 三子押沙龙是基述王达买的女儿玛迦生的。四子亚多尼雅是哈及生的。

chapters.en:
the fifth was Shephatiah by Abital;
and the sixth was Ithream by his wife Eglah.
chapters.zh: 五子示法提雅是亚比她生的。六子以特念是大卫的妻以格拉生的。

chapters.en:
These six sons were born to David in Hebron, where he reigned seven years and six months.
And David reigned in Jerusalem thirty-three years,
chapters.zh: 这六人都是大卫在希伯崙生的。大卫在希伯崙作王七年零六个月，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。

chapters.en:
and these sons were born to him in Jerusalem:
Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. These four were born to him by Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel.
chapters.zh: 大卫在耶路撒冷所生的儿子是示米亚、朔罢、拿单、所罗门。这四人是亚米利的女儿拔‧书亚生的。

chapters.en: David’s other sons were Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet,
chapters.zh: 还有益辖、以利沙玛、以利法列、

chapters.en: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
chapters.zh: 挪迦、尼斐、雅非亚、

chapters.en: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet—nine in all.
chapters.zh: 以利沙玛、以利雅大、以利法列，共九人。

chapters.en: These were all the sons of David, besides the sons by his concubines. And Tamar was their sister.
chapters.zh: 这都是大卫的儿子，还有他们的妹子她玛，妃嫔的儿子不在其内。

chapters.en:
Solomon’s son was Rehoboam:
Abijah was his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
chapters.zh: 所罗门的儿子是罗波安；罗波安的儿子是亚比雅；亚比雅的儿子是亚撒；亚撒的儿子是约沙法；

chapters.en: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
chapters.zh: 约沙法的儿子是约兰；约兰的儿子是亚哈谢；亚哈谢的儿子是约阿施；

chapters.en: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
chapters.zh: 约阿施的儿子是亚玛谢；亚玛谢的儿子是亚撒利雅；亚撒利雅的儿子是约坦；

chapters.en: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
chapters.zh: 约坦的儿子是亚哈斯；亚哈斯的儿子是希西家；希西家的儿子是玛拿西；

chapters.en: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西的儿子是亚们；亚们的儿子是约西亚；

chapters.en:
The sons of Josiah:
Johanan was the firstborn, Jehoiakim the second, Zedekiah the third, and Shallum the fourth.
chapters.zh: 约西亚的长子是约哈难，次子是约雅敬，三子是西底家，四子是沙龙。

chapters.en:
The successors of Jehoiakim:
Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah.
chapters.zh: 约雅敬的儿子是耶哥尼雅和西底家。

chapters.en:
The descendants of Jeconiah the captive:
Shealtiel his son,
chapters.zh: 耶哥尼雅被掳。他的儿子是撒拉铁、

chapters.en: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
chapters.zh: 玛基兰、毗大雅、示拿萨、耶加米、何沙玛、尼大比雅。

chapters.en:
The sons of Pedaiah:
Zerubbabel and Shimei.
The children of Zerubbabel:
Meshullam and Hananiah, their sister Shelomith,
chapters.zh: 毗大雅的儿子是所罗巴伯、示每。所罗巴伯的儿子是米书兰、哈拿尼雅，他们的妹子名叫示罗密。

chapters.en: and five others: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed.
chapters.zh: 米书兰的儿子是哈舒巴、阿黑、比利家、哈撒底、于沙‧希悉，共五人。

chapters.en:
The descendants of Hananiah:
Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, and the sons of Rephaiah, of Arnan, of Obadiah, and of Shecaniah.
chapters.zh: 哈拿尼雅的儿子是毗拉提、耶筛亚。还有利法雅的众子，亚珥难的众子，俄巴底亚的众子，示迦尼的众子。

chapters.en:
The six descendants of Shecaniah were Shemaiah and his sons:
Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
chapters.zh: 示迦尼的儿子是示玛雅；示玛雅的儿子是哈突、以甲、巴利亚、尼利雅、沙法，共六人。

chapters.en:
The sons of Neariah:
Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam—three in all.
chapters.zh: 尼利雅的儿子是以利约乃、希西家、亚斯利干，共三人。

chapters.en:
The sons of Elioenai:
Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani—seven in all.
chapters.zh: 以利约乃的儿子是何大雅、以利亚实、毗莱雅、阿谷、约哈难、第莱雅、阿拿尼，共七人。

chapters.en:
The descendants of Judah:
Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
chapters.zh: 犹大的儿子是法勒斯、希斯崙、迦米、户珥、朔巴。

chapters.en: Reaiah son of Shobal was the father of Jahath, and Jahath was the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.
chapters.zh: 朔巴的儿子利亚雅生雅哈；雅哈生亚户买和拉哈。这是琐拉人的诸族。

chapters.en: These were the sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. And their sister was named Hazzelelponi.
chapters.zh: 以坦之祖的儿子是耶斯列、伊施玛、伊得巴；他们的妹子名叫哈悉勒玻尼。

chapters.en:
Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer was the father of Hushah.
These were the descendants of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah and the father of Bethlehem.
chapters.zh: 基多之祖是毗努伊勒。户沙之祖是以谢珥。这都是伯利恒之祖以法她的长子户珥所生的。

chapters.en: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
chapters.zh: 提哥亚之祖亚施户有两个妻子：一名希拉，一名拿拉。

chapters.en: Naarah bore to him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the descendants of Naarah.
chapters.zh: 拿拉给亚施户生亚户撒、希弗、提米尼、哈辖斯他利。这都是拿拉的儿子。

chapters.en: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan,
chapters.zh: 希拉的儿子是洗列、琐辖、伊提南。

chapters.en: and Koz, who was the father of Anub and Zobebah and of the clans of Aharhel son of Harum.
chapters.zh: 哥斯生亚诺、琐比巴，并哈崙儿子亚哈黑的诸族。

chapters.en: Now Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him in pain.”
chapters.zh: 雅比斯比他众弟兄更尊贵，他母亲给他起名叫雅比斯，意思说：我生他甚是痛苦。

chapters.en:
And Jabez called out to the God of Israel, “If only You would bless me and enlarge my territory! May Your hand be with me and keep me from harm, so that I will be free from pain.”
And God granted the request of Jabez.
chapters.zh: 雅比斯求告以色列的上帝说：「甚愿你赐福与我，扩张我的境界，常与我同在，保佑我不遭患难，不受艰苦。」上帝就应允他所求的。

chapters.en: Chelub the brother of Shuhah was the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
chapters.zh: 书哈的弟兄基绿生米黑，米黑是伊施屯之祖。

chapters.en: Eshton was the father of Beth-rapha, of Paseah, and of Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These were the men of Recah.
chapters.zh: 伊施屯生伯拉巴、巴西亚，并珥拿辖之祖提欣拿，这都是利迦人。

chapters.en:
The sons of Kenaz:
Othniel and Seraiah.
The sons of Othniel:
Hathath and Meonothai.
chapters.zh: 基纳斯的儿子是俄陀聂、西莱雅。俄陀聂的儿子是哈塔。

chapters.en: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah, and Seraiah was the father of Joab, the father of those living in Ge-harashim, which was given this name because its people were craftsmen.
chapters.zh: 悯挪太生俄弗拉；西莱雅生革‧夏纳欣人之祖约押。他们都是匠人。

chapters.en:
The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh:
Iru, Elah, and Naam.
The son of Elah:
Kenaz.
chapters.zh: 耶孚尼的儿子是迦勒；迦勒的儿子是以路、以拉、拿安。以拉的儿子是基纳斯。

chapters.en:
The sons of Jehallelel:
Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
chapters.zh: 耶哈利勒的儿子是西弗、西法、提利、亚撒列。

chapters.en:
The sons of Ezrah:
Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon.
And Mered’s wife Bithiah gave birth to Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

These were the children of Pharaoh’s daughter Bithiah.
Mered also took a Judean wife, who gave birth to Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.
chapters.zh: 以斯拉的儿子是益帖、米列、以弗、雅伦。米列娶法老女儿比提雅为妻，生米利暗、沙买，和以实提摩之祖益巴。米列又娶犹大女子为妻，生基多之祖雅列，梭哥之祖希伯，和撒挪亚之祖耶古铁。

chapters.en: The sons of Hodiah’s wife, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and of Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
chapters.zh: 荷第雅的妻是拿含的妹子，她所生的儿子是迦米人基伊拉和玛迦人以实提摩之祖。

chapters.en:
The sons of Shimon:
Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon.
The descendants of Ishi:
Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.
chapters.zh: 示门的儿子是暗嫩、林拿、便‧哈南、提伦。 以示的儿子是梭黑与便‧梭黑。

chapters.en:
The sons of Shelah son of Judah:
Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah and the clans of the linen workers at Beth-ashbea,
chapters.zh: 犹大的儿子是示拉；示拉的儿子是利迦之祖珥，玛利沙之祖拉大，和属亚实比族织细麻布的各家。

chapters.en: Jokim, the men of Cozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who ruled in Moab and Jashubi-lehem. (These names are from ancient records.)
chapters.zh: 还有约敬、哥西巴人、约阿施、萨拉，就是在摩押地掌权的，又有雅叔比利恒。这都是古时所记载的。

chapters.en: These were the potters who lived at Netaim and Gederah. They lived there in the service of the king.
chapters.zh: 这些人都是窑匠，是尼他应和基低拉的居民；与王同处，为王做工。

chapters.en:
The descendants of Simeon:
Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
chapters.zh: 西缅的儿子是尼母利、雅悯、雅立、谢拉、扫罗。

chapters.en:
The sons of Shaul:
Shallum, Mibsam, and Mishma.
chapters.zh: 扫罗的儿子是沙龙；沙龙的儿子是米比衫；米比衫的儿子是米施玛；

chapters.en:
The sons of Mishma:
Hammuel, Zaccur, and Shimei.
chapters.zh: 米施玛的儿子是哈母利；哈母利的儿子是撒刻；撒刻的儿子是示每。

chapters.en: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers did not have many children, so their whole clan did not become as numerous as the sons of Judah.
chapters.zh: 示每有十六个儿子，六个女儿，他弟兄的儿女不多，他们各家不如犹大族的人丁增多。

chapters.en: They lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual,
chapters.zh: 西缅人住在别是巴、摩拉大、哈萨‧书亚、

chapters.en: Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,
chapters.zh: 辟拉、以森、陀腊、

chapters.en: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,
chapters.zh: 彼土利、何珥玛、洗革拉、

chapters.en: Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, and Shaaraim. These were their cities until the reign of David.
chapters.zh: 伯‧玛嘉博、哈萨‧苏撒、伯‧比利、沙拉音，这些城邑直到大卫作王的时候都是属西缅人的。

chapters.en: And their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan—five towns—
chapters.zh: 他们的五个城邑是以坦、亚因、临门、陀健、亚珊；

chapters.en: and all their surrounding villages as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept a genealogical record:
chapters.zh: 还有属城的乡村，直到巴力。这是他们的住处，他们都有家谱。

chapters.en: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah,
chapters.zh: 还有米所巴、雅米勒、亚玛谢的儿子约沙、

chapters.en: Joel, Jehu son of Joshibiah (son of Seraiah, son of Asiel),
chapters.zh: 约珥、约示比的儿子耶户；约示比是西莱雅的儿子；西莱雅是亚薛的儿子。

chapters.en: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
chapters.zh: 还有以利约乃、雅哥巴、约朔海、亚帅雅、亚底业、耶西篾、比拿雅、

chapters.en: and Ziza son of Shiphi (son of Allon, son of Jedaiah, son of Shimri, son of Shemaiah).
chapters.zh: 示非的儿子细撒。示非是亚龙的儿子；亚龙是耶大雅的儿子；耶大雅是申利的儿子；申利是示玛雅的儿子。

chapters.en: These men listed by name were the leaders of their clans. Their families increased greatly,
chapters.zh: 以上所记的人名都是作族长的，他们宗族的人数增多。

chapters.en: and they journeyed to the entrance of Gedor, to the east side of the valley, in search of pasture for their flocks.
chapters.zh: 他们往平原东边基多口去，寻找牧放羊群的草场，

chapters.en: There they found rich, good pasture, and the land was spacious, peaceful, and quiet; for some Hamites had lived there formerly.
chapters.zh: 寻得肥美的草场地，又宽阔又平静。从前住那里的是含族的人。

chapters.en: These who were noted by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. They attacked the Hamites in their dwellings as well as the Meunites who were there, devoting them to destruction even to this day. Then they settled in their place, because there was pasture for their flocks.
chapters.zh: 以上录名的人，在犹大王希西家年间，来攻击含族人的帐棚和那里所有的米乌尼人，将他们灭尽，就住在他们的地方，直到今日，因为那里有草场可以牧放羊群。

chapters.en: And five hundred of these Simeonites led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, went to Mount Seir
chapters.zh: 这西缅人中，有五百人上西珥山，率领他们的是以示的儿子毗拉提、尼利雅、利法雅，和乌薛，

chapters.en: and struck down the remnant of the Amalekites who had escaped. And they have lived there to this day.
chapters.zh: 杀了逃脱剩下的亚玛力人，就住在那里直到今日。

chapters.en: These were the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel. Though he was the firstborn, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph son of Israel, because Reuben defiled his father’s bed. So he is not reckoned according to birthright.
chapters.zh: 以色列的长子原是吕便；因他污秽了父亲的床，他长子的名分就归了约瑟。只是按家谱他不算长子。

chapters.en: And though Judah prevailed over his brothers and a ruler came from him, the birthright belonged to Joseph.
chapters.zh: 犹大胜过一切弟兄，君王也是从他而出；长子的名分却归约瑟。

chapters.en:
The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel:
Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
chapters.zh: 以色列长子吕便的儿子是哈诺、法路、希斯伦、迦米。

chapters.en:
The descendants of Joel:
Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
chapters.zh: 约珥的儿子是示玛雅；示玛雅的儿子是歌革；歌革的儿子是示每；

chapters.en: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
chapters.zh: 示每的儿子是米迦；米迦的儿子是利亚雅；利亚雅的儿子是巴力；

chapters.en:
and Beerah his son, whom Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria carried into exile.
Beerah was a leader of the Reubenites.
chapters.zh: 巴力的儿子是备拉。这备拉作吕便支派的首领，被亚述王提革拉‧毗列色掳去。

chapters.en:
His relatives by their clans are recorded in their genealogy:
Jeiel the chief, Zechariah,
chapters.zh: 他的弟兄照着宗族，按着家谱作族长的是耶利、撒迦利雅、比拉。

chapters.en: and Bela son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel. They settled in Aroer and as far as Nebo and Baal-meon.
chapters.zh: 比拉是亚撒的儿子；亚撒是示玛的儿子；示玛是约珥的儿子；约珥所住的地方是从亚罗珥直到尼波和巴力‧免，

chapters.en: They also settled in the east as far as the edge of the desert that extends to the Euphrates River, because their livestock had increased in the land of Gilead.
chapters.zh: 又向东延到幼发拉底河这边的旷野，因为他们在基列地牲畜增多。

chapters.en: During the days of Saul they waged war against the Hagrites, who were defeated at their hands, and they occupied the dwellings of the Hagrites throughout the region east of Gilead.
chapters.zh: 扫罗年间，他们与夏甲人争战，夏甲人倒在他们手下，他们就在基列东边的全地，住在夏甲人的帐棚里。

chapters.en: The descendants of Gad lived next to the Reubenites in the land of Bashan, as far as Salecah:
chapters.zh: 迦得的子孙在吕便对面，住在巴珊地，延到撒迦。

chapters.en: Joel was the chief, Shapham the second, then Jaanai and Shaphat, who lived in Bashan.
chapters.zh: 他们中间有作族长的约珥，有作副族长的沙番，还有雅乃和住在巴珊的沙法。

chapters.en: Their kinsmen by families were Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber—seven in all.
chapters.zh: 他们族弟兄是米迦勒、米书兰、示巴、约赖、雅干、细亚、希伯，共七人。

chapters.en: These were the sons of Abihail son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz.
chapters.zh: 这都是亚比孩的儿子。亚比孩是户利的儿子；户利是耶罗亚的儿子；耶罗亚是基列的儿子；基列是米迦勒的儿子；米迦勒是耶示筛的儿子；耶示筛是耶哈多的儿子；耶哈多是布斯的儿子。

chapters.en: Ahi son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, was head of their family.
chapters.zh: 还有古尼的孙子、押比叠的儿子亚希。这都是作族长的。

chapters.en: They lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its towns, and throughout the pasturelands of Sharon.
chapters.zh: 他们住在基列与巴珊和巴珊的乡村，并沙崙的郊野，直到四围的交界。

chapters.en: All of them were recorded in the genealogies during the reigns of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 这些人在犹大王约坦并在以色列王耶罗波安年间，都载入家谱。

chapters.en: The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh had 44,760 warriors—valiant men who carried the shield and sword, drew the bow, and were trained for battle.
chapters.zh: 吕便人、迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人，能拿盾牌和刀剑、拉弓射箭、出征善战的勇士共有四万四千七百六十名。

chapters.en: They waged war against the Hagrites, as well as Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
chapters.zh: 他们与夏甲人、伊突人、拿非施人、挪答人争战。

chapters.en: And because they cried out to God in battle, they were helped against their enemies, and the Hagrites and all their allies were delivered into their hands. Because they put their trust in God, He answered their prayers.
chapters.zh: 他们得了〔上帝的〕帮助，夏甲人和跟随夏甲的人都交在他们手中；因为他们在阵上呼求上帝，倚赖上帝，上帝就应允他们。

chapters.en: They seized the livestock of the Hagrites—50,000 camels, 250,000 sheep, and 2,000 donkeys. They also took 100,000 captives,
chapters.zh: 他们掳掠了夏甲人的牲畜，有骆驼五万，羊二十五万，驴二千；又有人十万。

chapters.en: and many others fell slain, because the battle belonged to God. And they occupied the land until the exile.
chapters.zh: 敌人被杀仆倒的甚多，因为这争战是出乎上帝。他们就住在敌人的地上，直到被掳的时候。

chapters.en: Now the people of the half-tribe of Manasseh were numerous. They settled in the land from Bashan to Baal-hermon (that is, Senir, also known as Mount Hermon).
chapters.zh: 玛拿西半支派的人住在那地。从巴珊延到巴力‧黑们、示尼珥与黑门山。

chapters.en:
These were the heads of their families:
Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel.
They were mighty men of valor, famous men, and heads of their families.
chapters.zh: 他们的族长是以弗、以示、以列、亚斯列、耶利米、何达威雅、雅叠，都是大能的勇士，是有名的人，也是作族长的。

chapters.en: But they were unfaithful to the God of their fathers, and they prostituted themselves with the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.
chapters.zh: 他们得罪了他们列祖的上帝，随从那地之民的神行邪淫；这民就是上帝在他们面前所除灭的。

chapters.en: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria (that is, Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria) to take the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh into exile. And he brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the river of Gozan, where they remain to this day.
chapters.zh: 故此，以色列的上帝激动亚述王普勒和亚述王提革拉‧毗列色的心，他们就把吕便人、迦得人、玛拿西半支派的人掳到哈腊、哈博、哈拉与歌散河边，直到今日还在那里。

chapters.en:
The sons of Levi:
Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
chapters.zh: 利未的儿子是革顺、哥辖、米拉利。

chapters.en:
The sons of Kohath:
Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
chapters.zh: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛。

chapters.en:
The children of Amram:
Aaron, Moses, and Miriam.
The sons of Aaron:
Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
chapters.zh: 暗兰的儿子是亚伦、摩西，还有女儿米利暗。亚伦的儿子是拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。

chapters.en:
Eleazar was the father of Phinehas,
Phinehas was the father of Abishua,
chapters.zh: 以利亚撒生非尼哈；非尼哈生亚比书；

chapters.en:
Abishua was the father of Bukki,
Bukki was the father of Uzzi,
chapters.zh: 亚比书生布基；布基生乌西；

chapters.en:
Uzzi was the father of Zerahiah,
Zerahiah was the father of Meraioth,
chapters.zh: 乌西生西拉希雅；西拉希雅生米拉约；

chapters.en:
Meraioth was the father of Amariah,
Amariah was the father of Ahitub,
chapters.zh: 米拉约生亚玛利雅；亚玛利雅生亚希突；

chapters.en:
Ahitub was the father of Zadok,
Zadok was the father of Ahimaaz,
chapters.zh: 亚希突生撒督；撒督生亚希玛斯；

chapters.en:
Ahimaaz was the father of Azariah,
Azariah was the father of Johanan,
chapters.zh: 亚希玛斯生亚撒利雅；亚撒利雅生约哈难；

chapters.en: Johanan was the father of Azariah, who served as priest in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem,
chapters.zh: 约哈难生亚撒利雅（这亚撒利雅在所罗门于耶路撒冷所建造的殿中，供祭司的职分）；

chapters.en:
Azariah was the father of Amariah,
Amariah was the father of Ahitub,
chapters.zh: 亚撒利雅生亚玛利雅；亚玛利雅生亚希突；

chapters.en:
Ahitub was the father of Zadok,
Zadok was the father of Shallum,
chapters.zh: 亚希突生撒督；撒督生沙龙；

chapters.en:
Shallum was the father of Hilkiah,
Hilkiah was the father of Azariah,
chapters.zh: 沙龙生希勒家；希勒家生亚撒利雅；

chapters.en:
Azariah was the father of Seraiah,
and Seraiah was the father of Jehozadak.
chapters.zh: 亚撒利雅生西莱雅；西莱雅生约萨答。

chapters.en: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
chapters.zh: 当耶和华藉尼布甲尼撒的手掳掠犹大和耶路撒冷人的时候，这约萨答也被〔掳去〕。

chapters.en:
The sons of Levi:
Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
chapters.zh: 利未的儿子是革顺、哥辖、米拉利。

chapters.en:
These are the names of the sons of Gershom:
Libni and Shimei.
chapters.zh: 革顺的儿子名叫立尼、示每。

chapters.en:
The sons of Kohath:
Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
chapters.zh: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛。

chapters.en:
The sons of Merari:
Mahli and Mushi.
These are the clans of the Levites listed according to their fathers:
chapters.zh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利、母示。这是按着利未人宗族分的各家。

chapters.en:
Of Gershom:
Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
chapters.zh: 革顺的儿子是立尼；立尼的儿子是雅哈；雅哈的儿子是薪玛；

chapters.en: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
chapters.zh: 薪玛的儿子是约亚；约亚的儿子是易多；易多的儿子是谢拉；谢拉的儿子是耶特赖。

chapters.en:
The descendants of Kohath:
Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
chapters.zh: 哥辖的儿子是亚米拿达；亚米拿达的儿子是可拉；可拉的儿子是亚惜；

chapters.en: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
chapters.zh: 亚惜的儿子是以利加拿；以利加拿的儿子是以比雅撒；以比雅撒的儿子是亚惜；

chapters.en: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
chapters.zh: 亚惜的儿子是他哈；他哈的儿子是乌列；乌列的儿子是乌西雅；乌西雅的儿子是少罗。

chapters.en:
The descendants of Elkanah:
Amasai, Ahimoth,
chapters.zh: 以利加拿的儿子是亚玛赛和亚希摩。

chapters.en: Elkanah his son, Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
chapters.zh: 亚希摩的儿子是以利加拿；以利加拿的儿子是琐菲；琐菲的儿子是拿哈；

chapters.en: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.
chapters.zh: 拿哈的儿子是以利押；以利押的儿子是耶罗罕；耶罗罕的儿子是以利加拿；以利加拿的儿子是撒母耳。

chapters.en:
The sons of Samuel:
Joel his firstborn and Abijah his second son.
chapters.zh: 撒母耳的长子是约珥，次子是亚比亚。

chapters.en:
The descendants of Merari:
Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
chapters.zh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利；抹利的儿子是立尼；立尼的儿子是示每；示每的儿子是乌撒；

chapters.en: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, and Asaiah his son.
chapters.zh: 乌撒的儿子是示米亚；示米亚的儿子是哈基雅；哈基雅的儿子是亚帅雅。

chapters.en: These are the men David put in charge of the music in the house of the LORD after the ark rested there.
chapters.zh: 约柜安设之后，大卫派人在耶和华殿中管理歌唱的事。

chapters.en: They ministered with song before the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, until Solomon built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem. And they performed their duties according to the regulations given them.
chapters.zh: 他们就在会幕前当歌唱的差，及至所罗门在耶路撒冷建造了耶和华的殿，他们便按着班次供职。

chapters.en:
These are the men who served, together with their sons.
From the Kohathites:
Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
chapters.zh: 供职的人和他们的子孙记在下面： 哥辖的子孙中有歌唱的希幔。希幔是约珥的儿子；约珥是撒母耳的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
chapters.zh: 撒母耳是以利加拿的儿子；以利加拿是耶罗罕的儿子；耶罗罕是以列的儿子；以列是陀亚的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
chapters.zh: 陀亚是苏弗的儿子；苏弗是以利加拿的儿子；以利加拿是玛哈的儿子；玛哈是亚玛赛的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
chapters.zh: 亚玛赛是以利加拿的儿子；以利加拿是约珥的儿子；约珥是亚撒利雅的儿子；亚撒利雅是西番雅的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
chapters.zh: 西番雅是他哈的儿子；他哈是亚惜的儿子；亚惜是以比雅撒的儿子；以比雅撒是可拉的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
chapters.zh: 可拉是以斯哈的儿子；以斯哈是哥辖的儿子；哥辖是利未的儿子；利未是以色列的儿子。

chapters.en:
Heman’s kinsman was Asaph, who served at his right hand:
Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,
chapters.zh: 希幔的族兄亚萨是比利家的儿子，亚萨在希幔右边供职。比利家是示米亚的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
chapters.zh: 示米亚是米迦勒的儿子；米迦勒是巴西雅的儿子；巴西雅是玛基雅的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
chapters.zh: 玛基雅是伊特尼的儿子；伊特尼是谢拉的儿子；谢拉是亚大雅的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
chapters.zh: 亚大雅是以探的儿子；以探是薪玛的儿子；薪玛是示每的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
chapters.zh: 示每是雅哈的儿子；雅哈是革顺的儿子。革顺是利未的儿子。

chapters.en:
On the left were their kinsmen, the sons of Merari:
Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
chapters.zh: 他们的族弟兄米拉利的子孙，在他们左边供职的有以探。以探是基示的儿子；基示是亚伯底的儿子；亚伯底是玛鹿的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
chapters.zh: 玛鹿是哈沙比雅的儿子；哈沙比雅是亚玛谢的儿子；亚玛谢是希勒家的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
chapters.zh: 希勒家是暗西的儿子；暗西是巴尼的儿子；巴尼是沙麦的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
chapters.zh: 沙麦是末力的儿子；末力是母示的儿子；母示是米拉利的儿子；米拉利是利未的儿子。

chapters.en: Their fellow Levites were assigned to every kind of service of the tabernacle, the house of God.
chapters.zh: 他们的族弟兄利未人也被派办上帝殿中的一切事。

chapters.en: But Aaron and his sons did all the work of the Most Holy Place. They presented the offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
chapters.zh: 亚伦和他的子孙在燔祭坛和香坛上献祭烧香，又在至圣所办理一切的事，为以色列人赎罪，是照上帝仆人摩西所吩咐的。

chapters.en:
These were the descendants of Aaron:
Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
chapters.zh: 亚伦的儿子是以利亚撒；以利亚撒的儿子是非尼哈；非尼哈的儿子是亚比书；

chapters.en: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
chapters.zh: 亚比书的儿子是布基；布基的儿子是乌西；乌西的儿子是西拉希雅；

chapters.en: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
chapters.zh: 西拉希雅的儿子是米拉约；米拉约的儿子是亚玛利雅；亚玛利雅的儿子是亚希突；

chapters.en: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.
chapters.zh: 亚希突的儿子是撒督；撒督的儿子是亚希玛斯。

chapters.en: Now these were the territories assigned to the descendants of Aaron from the Kohathite clan for their settlements, because the first lot fell to them:
chapters.zh: 他们的住处按着境内的营寨，记在下面：哥辖族亚伦的子孙〔先〕拈鬮得地，

chapters.en: They were given Hebron in the land of Judah and its surrounding pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 在犹大地中得了希伯崙和四围的郊野；

chapters.en: But the fields and villages around the city were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
chapters.zh: 只是属城的田地和村庄都为耶孚尼的儿子迦勒所得。

chapters.en: So the descendants of Aaron were given Hebron (a city of refuge), Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa,
chapters.zh: 亚伦的子孙得了逃城希伯崙，又得了立拿与其郊野，雅提珥、以实提莫与其郊野；

chapters.en: Hilen, Debir,
chapters.zh: 希崙与其郊野，底璧与其郊野，

chapters.en: Ashan, Juttah, and Beth-shemesh, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 亚珊与其郊野，伯‧示麦与其郊野。

chapters.en: And from the tribe of Benjamin they were given Gibeon, Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth, together with their pasturelands. So they had thirteen cities in all among their families.
chapters.zh: 在便雅悯支派的地中，得了迦巴与其郊野，阿勒篾与其郊野，亚拿突与其郊野。他们诸家所得的城共十三座。

chapters.en: To the rest of the Kohathites, ten cities were allotted from the half-tribe of Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 哥辖族其余的人又拈鬮，在玛拿西半支派的地中得了十座城。

chapters.en: The Gershomites, according to their clans, were allotted thirteen cities from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Manasseh in Bashan.
chapters.zh: 革顺族按着宗族，在以萨迦支派的地中，亚设支派的地中，拿弗他利支派的地中，巴珊内玛拿西支派的地中，得了十三座城。

chapters.en: The Merarites, according to their clans, were allotted twelve cities from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
chapters.zh: 米拉利族按着宗族拈鬮，在吕便支派的地中，迦得支派的地中，西布伦支派的地中，得了十二座城。

chapters.en: So the Israelites gave to the Levites these cities and their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 以色列人将这些城与其郊野给了利未人。

chapters.en: They assigned by lot the cities named above from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 这以上录名的城，在犹大、西缅、便雅悯三支派的地中，以色列人拈鬮给了他们。

chapters.en: And some of the clans of the Kohathites were given cities from the tribe of Ephraim for their territory:
chapters.zh: 哥辖族中有几家在以法莲支派的地中也得了城邑，

chapters.en: They were given Shechem (a city of refuge) with its pasturelands in the hill country of Ephraim, and Gezer,
chapters.zh: 在以法莲山地得了逃城示剑与其郊野，又得了基色与其郊野，

chapters.en: Jokmeam, Beth-horon,
chapters.zh: 约缅与其郊野，伯‧和崙与其郊野，

chapters.en: Aijalon, and Gath-rimmon, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 亚雅崙与其郊野，迦特‧临门与其郊野。

chapters.en: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh the rest of the clans of the Kohathites were given Aner and Bileam, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 哥辖族其余的人在玛拿西半支派的地中得了亚乃与其郊野，比连与其郊野。

chapters.en:
The Gershomites received the following:
From the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Golan in Bashan and also Ashtaroth, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 革顺族在玛拿西半支派的地中得了巴珊的哥兰与其郊野，亚斯他录与其郊野；

chapters.en: From the tribe of Issachar they were given Kedesh, Daberath,
chapters.zh: 又在以萨迦支派的地中得了基低斯与其郊野，大比拉与其郊野，

chapters.en: Ramoth, and Anem, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 拉末与其郊野，亚年与其郊野；

chapters.en: From the tribe of Asher they were given Mashal, Abdon,
chapters.zh: 在亚设支派的地中得了玛沙与其郊野，押顿与其郊野，

chapters.en: Hukok, and Rehob, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 户割与其郊野，利合与其郊野；

chapters.en: And from the tribe of Naphtali they were given Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 在拿弗他利支派的地中得了加利利的基低斯与其郊野，哈们与其郊野，基列亭与其郊野。

chapters.en:
The Merarites (the rest of the Levites) received the following:
From the tribe of Zebulun they were given Rimmono and Tabor, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 还有米拉利族的人在西布伦支派的地中得了临摩挪与其郊野，他泊与其郊野；

chapters.en: From the tribe of Reuben east of the Jordan opposite Jericho they were given Bezer in the wilderness, Jahzah,
chapters.zh: 又在耶利哥的约旦河东，在吕便支派的地中得了旷野的比悉与其郊野，雅哈撒与其郊野，

chapters.en: Kedemoth, and Mephaath, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 基底莫与其郊野，米法押与其郊野；

chapters.en: And from the tribe of Gad they were given Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim,
chapters.zh: 又在迦得支派的地中得了基列的拉末与其郊野，玛哈念与其郊野，

chapters.en: Heshbon, and Jazer, together with their pasturelands.
chapters.zh: 希实本与其郊野，雅谢与其郊野。

chapters.en:
The sons of Issachar:
Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron—four in all.
chapters.zh: 以萨迦的儿子是陀拉、普瓦、雅述〔注：在创世记第四十六章十三节是约伯〕、伸崙，共四人。

chapters.en:
The sons of Tola:
Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, the heads of their families. In the days of David, 22,600 descendants of Tola were numbered in their genealogies as mighty men of valor.
chapters.zh: 陀拉的儿子是乌西、利法雅、耶勒、雅买、易伯散、示母利，都是陀拉的族长，是大能的勇士。到大卫年间，他们的人数共有二万二千六百名。

chapters.en:
The son of Uzzi:
Izrahiah.
The sons of Izrahiah:
Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah. All five of them were chiefs.
chapters.zh: 乌西的儿子是伊斯拉希；伊斯拉希的儿子是米迦勒、俄巴底亚、约珥、伊示雅，共五人，都是族长。

chapters.en: In addition to them, according to their genealogy, they had 36,000 troops for battle, for they had many wives and children.
chapters.zh: 他们所率领的，按着宗族出战的军队，共有三万六千人，因为他们的妻和子众多。

chapters.en: Their kinsmen belonging to all the families of Issachar who were mighty men of valor totaled 87,000, as listed in their genealogies.
chapters.zh: 他们的族弟兄在以萨迦各族中都是大能的勇士，按着家谱计算共有八万七千人。

chapters.en:
The three sons of Benjamin:
Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯〔的儿子〕是比拉、比结、耶叠，共三人。

chapters.en:
The sons of Bela:
Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, heads of their families—five in all. There were 22,034 mighty men of valor listed in their genealogies.
chapters.zh: 比拉的儿子是以斯本、乌西、乌薛、耶利摩、以利，共五人，都是族长，是大能的勇士。按着家谱计算，他们的子孙共有二万二千零三十四人。

chapters.en:
The sons of Becher:
Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth; all these were Becher’s sons.
chapters.zh: 比结的儿子是细米拉、约阿施、以利以谢、以利约乃、暗利、耶利摩、亚比雅、亚拿突、亚拉篾。这都是比结的儿子。

chapters.en: Their genealogies were recorded according to the heads of their families—20,200 mighty men of valor.
chapters.zh: 他们都是族长，是大能的勇士。按着家谱计算，他们的子孙共有二万零二百人。

chapters.en:
The son of Jediael:
Bilhan.
The sons of Bilhan:
Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
chapters.zh: 耶叠的儿子是比勒罕；比勒罕的儿子是耶乌施、便雅悯、以忽、基拿拿、细坦、他施、亚希沙哈。

chapters.en: All these sons of Jediael were heads of their families, mighty men of valor; there were 17,200 fit for battle.
chapters.zh: 这都是耶叠的儿子，都是族长，是大能的勇士；他们的子孙能上阵打仗的，共有一万七千二百人。

chapters.en: The Shuppites and Huppites were descendants of Ir, and the Hushites were descendants of Aher.
chapters.zh: 还有以珥的儿子书品、户品，并亚黑的儿子户伸。

chapters.en:
The sons of Naphtali:
Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum —the descendants of Bilhah.
chapters.zh: 拿弗他利的儿子是雅薛、沽尼、耶色、沙龙。这都是辟拉的子孙。

chapters.en:
The descendants of Manasseh:
Asriel through his Aramean concubine. She also gave birth to Machir the father of Gilead.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西的儿子亚斯列是他妾亚兰人所生的，又生了基列之父玛吉。

chapters.en:
Machir took a wife from among the Huppites and Shuppites. The name of his sister was Maacah.
Another descendant was named Zelophehad, who had only daughters.
chapters.zh: 玛吉娶的妻是户品、书品的妹子，名叫玛迦。玛拿西的次子名叫西罗非哈；西罗非哈但有几个女儿。

chapters.en: Machir’s wife Maacah gave birth to a son, and she named him Peresh. His brother was named Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rekem.
chapters.zh: 玛吉的妻玛迦生了一个儿子，起名叫毗利施。毗利施的兄弟名叫示利施；示利施的儿子是乌兰和利金。

chapters.en:
The son of Ulam:
Bedan.
These were the sons of Gilead son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 乌兰的儿子是比但。这都是基列的子孙。基列是玛吉的儿子，玛吉是玛拿西的儿子。

chapters.en: His sister Hammolecheth gave birth to Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
chapters.zh: 基列的妹子哈摩利吉生了伊施荷、亚比以谢、玛拉。

chapters.en:
And these were the sons of Shemida:
Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
chapters.zh: （示米大的儿子是亚现、示剑、利克希、阿尼安。）

chapters.en:
The descendants of Ephraim:
Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,
chapters.zh: 以法莲的儿子是书提拉；书提拉的儿子是比列；比列的儿子是他哈；他哈的儿子是以拉大；以拉大的儿子是他哈；

chapters.en:
Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son.
Ezer and Elead were killed by the natives of Gath, because they went down to steal their livestock.
chapters.zh: 他哈的儿子是撒拔；撒拔的儿子是书提拉。以法莲又生以谢、以列；这二人因为下去夺取迦特人的牲畜，被本地的迦特人杀了。

chapters.en: Their father Ephraim mourned for many days, and his relatives came to comfort him.
chapters.zh: 他们的父亲以法莲为他们悲哀了多日，他的弟兄都来安慰他。

chapters.en: And again he slept with his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. So he named him Beriah, because tragedy had come upon his house.
chapters.zh: 以法莲与妻同房，他妻就怀孕生了一子，以法莲因为家里遭祸，就给这儿子起名叫比利亚。

chapters.en: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Lower and Upper Beth-horon, as well as Uzzen-sheerah.
chapters.zh: 他的女儿名叫舍伊拉，就是建筑上伯‧和崙、下伯‧和崙与乌羨‧舍伊拉的。

chapters.en: Additionally, Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,
chapters.zh: 比利亚的儿子是利法和利悉。利悉的儿子是他拉；他拉的儿子是他罕；

chapters.en: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
chapters.zh: 他罕的儿子是拉但；拉但的儿子是亚米忽；亚米忽的儿子是以利沙玛；

chapters.en: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.
chapters.zh: 以利沙玛的儿子是嫩；嫩的儿子是约书亚。

chapters.en: Their holdings and settlements included Bethel and its villages, Naaran to the east, Gezer and its villages to the west, and Shechem and its villages as far as Ayyah and its villages.
chapters.zh: 以法莲人的地业和住处是伯特利与其村庄；东边拿兰，西边基色与其村庄；示剑与其村庄，直到迦萨与其村庄；

chapters.en: And along the borders of Manasseh were Beth-shean, Taanach, Megiddo, and Dor, together with their villages. The descendants of Joseph son of Israel lived in these towns.
chapters.zh: 还有靠近玛拿西人的境界，伯‧善与其村庄；他纳与其村庄；米吉多与其村庄；多珥与其村庄。以色列儿子约瑟的子孙住在这些地方。

chapters.en:
The children of Asher:
Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah.
chapters.zh: 亚设的儿子是音拿、亦施瓦、亦施韦、比利亚，还有他们的妹子西拉。

chapters.en:
The sons of Beriah:
Heber, as well as Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
chapters.zh: 比利亚的儿子是希别、玛结；玛结是比撒威的父亲。

chapters.en: Heber was the father of Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and of their sister Shua.
chapters.zh: 希别生雅弗勒、朔默、何坦，和他们的妹子书雅。

chapters.en:
The sons of Japhlet:
Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These were Japhlet’s sons.
chapters.zh: 雅弗勒的儿子是巴萨、宾哈、亚施法。这都是雅弗勒的儿子。

chapters.en:
The sons of Shemer:
Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
chapters.zh: 朔默的儿子是亚希、罗迦、耶户巴、亚兰。

chapters.en:
The sons of his brother Helem:
Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
chapters.zh: 朔默兄弟希连的儿子是琐法、音那、示利斯、亚抹。

chapters.en:
The sons of Zophah:
Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
chapters.zh: 琐法的儿子是书亚、哈尼弗、书阿勒、比利、音拉、

chapters.en: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
chapters.zh: 比悉、河得、珊玛、施沙、益兰、比拉。

chapters.en:
The sons of Jether:
Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
chapters.zh: 益帖的儿子是耶孚尼、毗斯巴、亚拉。

chapters.en:
The sons of Ulla:
Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
chapters.zh: 乌拉的儿子是亚拉、汉尼业、利写。

chapters.en: All these were the descendants of Asher—heads of their families, choice and mighty men of valor, and chiefs among the leaders. The number of men fit for battle, recorded in their genealogies, was 26,000.
chapters.zh: 这都是亚设的子孙，都是族长，是精壮大能的勇士，也是首领中的头目，按着家谱计算，他们的子孙能出战的共有二万六千人。

chapters.en: Benjamin was the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,
chapters.zh: 便雅悯的长子比拉，次子亚实别，三子亚哈拉，

chapters.en: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
chapters.zh: 四子挪哈，五子拉法。

chapters.en:
The sons of Bela:
Addar, Gera, Abihud,
chapters.zh: 比拉的儿子是亚大、基拉、亚比忽、

chapters.en: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
chapters.zh: 亚比书、乃幔、亚何亚、

chapters.en: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
chapters.zh: 基拉、示孚汛、户兰。

chapters.en: These were the descendants of Ehud who were the heads of the families living in Geba and were exiled to Manahath:
chapters.zh: 以忽的儿子作迦巴居民的族长，被掳到玛拿辖；

chapters.en: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them into exile and who was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
chapters.zh: 以忽的儿子乃幔、亚希亚、基拉也被掳去。基拉生乌撒、亚希忽。

chapters.en: Shaharaim had sons in the country of Moab after he had divorced his wives Hushim and Baara.
chapters.zh: 沙哈连休他二妻户伸和巴拉之后，在摩押地生了儿子。

chapters.en:
His sons by his wife Hodesh:
Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,
chapters.zh: 他与妻贺得同房，生了约巴、洗比雅、米沙、玛拉干、

chapters.en: Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of families.
chapters.zh: 耶乌斯、沙迦、米玛。他这些儿子都是族长。

chapters.en:
He also had sons by Hushim:
Abitub and Elpaal.
chapters.zh: 他的妻户伸给他生的儿子有亚比突、以利巴力。

chapters.en:
The sons of Elpaal:
Eber, Misham, Shemed (who built Ono and Lod with its villages),
chapters.zh: 以利巴力的儿子是希伯、米珊、沙麦。沙麦建立阿挪和罗德二城与其村庄。

chapters.en: and Beriah and Shema (who were the heads of families living in Aijalon and who drove out the inhabitants of Gath).
chapters.zh: 又有比利亚和示玛是亚雅崙居民的族长，是驱逐迦特人的。

chapters.en: Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,
chapters.zh: 亚希约、沙煞、耶利末、

chapters.en: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,
chapters.zh: 西巴第雅、亚拉得、亚得、

chapters.en: Michael, Ishpah, and Joha were the sons of Beriah.
chapters.zh: 米迦勒、伊施巴、约哈都是比利亚的儿子。

chapters.en: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,
chapters.zh: 西巴第雅、米书兰、希西基、希伯、

chapters.en: Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal.
chapters.zh: 伊施米莱、伊斯利亚、约巴都是以利巴力的儿子。

chapters.en: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,
chapters.zh: 雅金、细基利、撒底、

chapters.en: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,
chapters.zh: 以利乃、洗勒太、以列、

chapters.en: Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei.
chapters.zh: 亚大雅、比拉雅、申拉都是示每的儿子。

chapters.en: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,
chapters.zh: 伊施班、希伯、以列、

chapters.en: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,
chapters.zh: 亚伯顿、细基利、哈难、

chapters.en: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,
