chapters.zh: 哈拿尼雅、以拦、安陀提雅、

chapters.en: Iphdeiah, and Penuel were the sons of Shashak.
chapters.zh: 伊弗底雅、毗努伊勒都是沙煞的儿子。

chapters.en: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,
chapters.zh: 珊示莱、示哈利、亚他利雅、

chapters.en: Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri were the sons of Jeroham.
chapters.zh: 雅利西、以利亚、细基利都是耶罗罕的儿子。

chapters.en: All these were heads of families, the chiefs according to their genealogies, and they lived in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 这些人都是著名的族长，住在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maacah,
chapters.zh: 在基遍住的有基遍的父亲耶利。他的妻名叫玛迦；

chapters.en: and Abdon was his firstborn son, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,
chapters.zh: 他长子是亚伯顿。他又生苏珥、基士、巴力、拿答、

chapters.en: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
chapters.zh: 基多、亚希约、撒迦、米基罗。

chapters.en: and Mikloth, who was the father of Shimeah. They too lived alongside their relatives in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 米基罗生示米暗。这些人和他们的弟兄在耶路撒冷对面居住。

chapters.en: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish was the father of Saul, and Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
chapters.zh: 尼珥生基士；基士生扫罗；扫罗生约拿单、麦基舒亚、亚比拿达、伊施‧巴力。

chapters.en:
The son of Jonathan:
Merib-baal, and Merib-baal was the father of Micah.
chapters.zh: 约拿单的儿子是米力‧巴力〔注：在撒母耳下四章四节是米非波设〕；米力‧巴力生米迦。

chapters.en:
The sons of Micah:
Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
chapters.zh: 米迦的儿子是毗敦、米勒、他利亚、亚哈斯；

chapters.en: Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah, Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri, and Zimri was the father of Moza.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯生耶何阿达；耶何阿达生亚拉篾、亚斯玛威、心利；心利生摩撒；

chapters.en: Moza was the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
chapters.zh: 摩撒生比尼亚；比尼亚的儿子是拉法；拉法的儿子是以利亚萨；以利亚萨的儿子是亚悉。

chapters.en:
Azel had six sons, and these were their names:
Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
chapters.zh: 亚悉有六个儿子，他们的名字是亚斯利干、波基路、以实玛利、示亚利雅、俄巴底雅、哈难。这都是亚悉的儿子。

chapters.en:
The sons of his brother Eshek:
Ulam was his firstborn, Jeush second, and Eliphelet third.
chapters.zh: 亚悉兄弟以设的长子是乌兰，次子耶乌施，三子是以利法列。

chapters.en:
The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and they had many sons and grandsons—150 in all.
All these were the descendants of Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 乌兰的儿子都是大能的勇士，是弓箭手，他们有许多的子孙，共一百五十名，都是便雅悯人。

chapters.en: So all Israel was recorded in the genealogies written in the Book of the Kings of Israel. But Judah was exiled to Babylon because of their unfaithfulness.
chapters.zh: 以色列人都按家谱计算，写在以色列诸王记上。犹大人因犯罪就被掳到巴比伦。

chapters.en: Now the first to resettle their own property in their cities were Israelites, priests, Levites, and temple servants.
chapters.zh: 先从巴比伦回来，住在自己地业城邑中的有以色列人、祭司、利未人、尼提宁〔的首领〕。

chapters.en: Some of the descendants of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh lived in Jerusalem:
chapters.zh: 住在耶路撒冷的有犹大人、便雅悯人、以法莲人、玛拿西人。

chapters.en: Uthai son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, a descendant of Perez son of Judah.
chapters.zh: 犹大儿子法勒斯的子孙中有乌太。乌太是亚米忽的儿子；亚米忽是暗利的儿子；暗利是音利的儿子；音利是巴尼的儿子。

chapters.en:
From the Shilonites:
Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
chapters.zh: 示罗的子孙中有长子亚帅雅和他的众子。

chapters.en:
From the Zerahites:
Jeuel and 690 relatives.
chapters.zh: 谢拉的子孙中有耶乌利和他的弟兄，共六百九十人。

chapters.en:
From the Benjamites:
Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;
chapters.zh: 便雅悯人中有哈西努的曾孙、何达威雅的孙子、米书兰的儿子撒路，
又有耶罗罕的儿子伊比尼雅，米基立的孙子、乌西的儿子以拉，伊比尼雅的曾孙、流珥的孙子、示法提雅的儿子米书兰，

chapters.en: and 956 of their relatives according to their genealogy. All these men were heads of their families.
chapters.zh: 和他们的族弟兄，按着家谱〔计算〕共有九百五十六名。这些人都是他们的族长。

chapters.en:
From the priests:
Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, and Jachin;
chapters.zh: 祭司中有耶大雅、耶何雅立、雅斤，

chapters.en: Azariah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the chief official of God’s temple;
chapters.zh: 还有管理上帝殿希勒家的儿子亚萨利雅。希勒家是米书兰的儿子；米书兰是撒督的儿子；撒督是米拉约的儿子；米拉约是亚希突的儿子。

chapters.en:
Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah;
Maasai son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
chapters.zh: 有玛基雅的曾孙、巴施户珥的孙子、耶罗罕的儿子亚大雅，又有亚第业的儿子玛赛；亚第业是雅希细拉的儿子；雅希细拉是米书兰的儿子；米书兰是米实利密的儿子；米实利密是音麦的儿子。

chapters.en: and 1,760 of their relatives, the heads of their families, able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
chapters.zh: 他们和众弟兄都是族长，共有一千七百六十人，是善于做上帝殿使用之工的。

chapters.en:
From the Levites:
Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, a descendant of Merari;
chapters.zh: 利未人米拉利的子孙中，有哈沙比雅的曾孙、押利甘的孙子、哈述的儿子示玛雅。

chapters.en: Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
chapters.zh: 有拔巴甲、黑勒施、迦拉，并亚萨的曾孙、细基利的孙子、米迦的儿子玛探雅，

chapters.en:
Obadiah son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun;
and Berechiah son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
chapters.zh: 又有耶杜顿的曾孙、迦拉的孙子、示玛雅的儿子俄巴底，还有以利加拿的孙子、亚撒的儿子比利家。他们都住在尼陀法人的村庄。
守门的是沙龙、亚谷、达们、亚希幔，和他们的弟兄；沙龙为长。

chapters.en: he was previously stationed at the King’s Gate on the east side. These were the gatekeepers from the camp of the Levites.
chapters.zh: 从前这些人看守朝东的王门，如今是利未营中守门的。

chapters.en: Shallum son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his relatives from the Korahites were assigned to guard the thresholds of the Tent, just as their fathers had been assigned to guard the entrance to the dwelling of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 可拉的曾孙、以比雅撒的孙子、可利的儿子沙龙，和他的族弟兄可拉人都管理使用之工，并守会幕的门。他们的祖宗曾管理耶和华的营盘，又把守营门。

chapters.en: In earlier times Phinehas son of Eleazar had been in charge of the gatekeepers, and the LORD was with him.
chapters.zh: 从前以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈管理他们，耶和华也与他同在。

chapters.en: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was the gatekeeper at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
chapters.zh: 米施利米雅的儿子撒迦利雅是看守会幕之门的。

chapters.en: The number of those chosen to be gatekeepers at the thresholds was 212. They were registered by genealogy in their villages. David and Samuel the seer had appointed them to their positions of trust.
chapters.zh: 被选守门的人共有二百一十二名。他们在自己的村庄，按着家谱计算，是大卫和先见撒母耳所派当这紧要职任的。

chapters.en: So they and their descendants were assigned to guard the gates of the house of the LORD—the house called the Tent.
chapters.zh: 他们和他们的子孙按着班次看守耶和华殿的门，就是会幕的门。

chapters.en: The gatekeepers were stationed on the four sides: east, west, north, and south.
chapters.zh: 在东西南北，四方都有守门的。

chapters.en: Their relatives came from their villages at fixed times to serve with them for seven-day periods.
chapters.zh: 他们的族弟兄住在村庄，每七日来与他们换班。

chapters.en: But the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were entrusted with the rooms and the treasuries of the house of God.
chapters.zh: 这四个门领都是利未人，各有紧要的职任，看守上帝殿的仓库。

chapters.en: They would spend the night stationed around the house of God, because they were responsible for guarding it and opening it every morning.
chapters.zh: 他们住在上帝殿的四围，是因委托他们守殿，要每日早晨开门。

chapters.en: Some of them were in charge of the articles used in worship, to count them whenever they were brought in or taken out.
chapters.zh: 利未人中有管理使用器皿的，按着数目拿出拿入；

chapters.en: Others were put in charge of the furnishings and other articles of the sanctuary, as well as the fine flour, wine, oil, frankincense, and spices.
chapters.zh: 又有人管理器具和圣所的器皿，并细面、酒、油、乳香、香料。

chapters.en: And some of the sons of the priests mixed the spices.
chapters.zh: 祭司中有人用香料做膏油。

chapters.en: A Levite named Mattithiah, the firstborn son of Shallum the Korahite, was entrusted with baking the bread.
chapters.zh: 利未人玛他提雅是可拉族沙龙的长子，他紧要的职任是管理盘中烤的物。

chapters.en: Some of their Kohathite relatives were responsible for preparing the rows of the showbread every Sabbath.
chapters.zh: 他们族弟兄哥辖子孙中，有管理陈设饼的，每安息日预备摆列。

chapters.en: Those who were musicians, the heads of Levite families, stayed in the temple chambers and were exempt from other duties because they were on duty day and night.
chapters.zh: 歌唱的有利未人的族长，住在〔属殿的〕房屋，昼夜供职，不做别样的工。

chapters.en: All these were heads of Levite families, chiefs according to their genealogies, and they lived in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 以上都是利未人著名的族长，住在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maacah.
chapters.zh: 在基遍住的有基遍的父亲耶利。他的妻名叫玛迦；

chapters.en: Abdon was his firstborn son, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
chapters.zh: 他长子是亚伯顿。他又生苏珥、基士、巴力、尼珥、拿答、

chapters.en: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.
chapters.zh: 基多、亚希约、撒迦利雅、米基罗。

chapters.en: Mikloth was the father of Shimeam. They too lived alongside their relatives in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 米基罗生示米暗。这些人和他们的弟兄在耶路撒冷对面居住。

chapters.en: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish was the father of Saul, and Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
chapters.zh: 尼珥生基士；基士生扫罗；扫罗生约拿单、麦基舒亚、亚比拿达、伊施‧巴力。

chapters.en:
The son of Jonathan:
Merib-baal, who was the father of Micah.
chapters.zh: 约拿单的儿子是米力‧巴力〔注：就是米非波设〕；米力‧巴力生米迦。

chapters.en:
The sons of Micah:
Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
chapters.zh: 米迦的儿子是毗敦、米勒、他利亚、亚哈斯。

chapters.en: Ahaz was the father of Jarah; Jarah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri was the father of Moza.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯生雅拉；雅拉生亚拉篾、亚斯玛威、心利；心利生摩撒；

chapters.en: Moza was the father of Binea. Rephaiah was his son, Elasah his son, and Azel his son.
chapters.zh: 摩撒生比尼亚；比尼亚生利法雅；利法雅的儿子是以利亚萨；以利亚萨的儿子是亚悉。

chapters.en:
And Azel had six sons, and these were their names:
Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
chapters.zh: 亚悉有六个儿子，他们的名字是亚斯利干、波基路、以实玛利、示亚利雅、俄巴底雅、哈难。这都是亚悉的儿子。

chapters.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel fled before them, and many fell slain on Mount Gilboa.
chapters.zh: 非利士人与以色列人争战，以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，在基利波山有被杀仆倒的。

chapters.en: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and his sons, and they killed Saul’s sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
chapters.zh: 非利士人紧追扫罗和他儿子们，就杀了扫罗的儿子约拿单、亚比拿达、麦基舒亚。

chapters.en: When the battle intensified against Saul, the archers overtook him and wounded him.
chapters.zh: 势派甚大，扫罗被弓箭手追上，射伤甚重，

chapters.en:
Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, “Draw your sword and run me through with it, or these uncircumcised men will come and torture me!”
But his armor-bearer was terrified and refused to do it. So Saul took his own sword and fell on it.
chapters.zh: 就吩咐拿他兵器的人说：「你拔出刀来，将我刺死，免得那些未受割礼的人来凌辱我。」但拿兵器的人甚惧怕，不肯刺他；

chapters.en: When his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his own sword and died.
chapters.zh: 扫罗就自己伏在刀上死了。拿兵器的人见扫罗已死，也伏在刀上死了。

chapters.en: So Saul died together with his three sons and all his house.
chapters.zh: 这样，扫罗和他三个儿子，并他的全家都一同死亡。

chapters.en: When all the Israelites in the valley saw that the army had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their cities and ran away. So the Philistines came and occupied their cities.
chapters.zh: 住平原的以色列众人见以色列军兵逃跑，扫罗和他儿子都死了，也就弃城逃跑，非利士人便来住在其中。

chapters.en: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
chapters.zh: 次日，非利士人来剥那被杀之人的衣服，看见扫罗和他儿子仆倒在基利波山，

chapters.en: They stripped Saul, cut off his head, took his armor, and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to proclaim the news in the temple of their idols and among their people.
chapters.zh: 就剥了他的军装，割下他的首级，打发人到〔注：到：或译送到〕非利士地的四境报信与他们的偶像和众民，

chapters.en: They put his armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of Dagon.
chapters.zh: 又将扫罗的军装放在他们神的庙里，将他的首级钉在大衮庙中。

chapters.en: When all the people of Jabesh-gilead heard about everything the Philistines had done to Saul,
chapters.zh: 基列‧雅比人听见非利士人向扫罗所行的一切事，

chapters.en: all their men of valor set out and retrieved the bodies of Saul and his sons and brought them to Jabesh. And they buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh and fasted seven days.
chapters.zh: 他们中间所有的勇士就起身前去，将扫罗和他儿子的尸身送到雅比，将他们的尸骨葬在雅比的橡树下，就禁食七日。

chapters.en: So Saul died for his unfaithfulness to the LORD, because he did not keep the word of the LORD and even consulted a medium for guidance,
chapters.zh: 这样，扫罗死了。因为他干犯耶和华，没有遵守耶和华的命；又因他求问交鬼的妇人，

chapters.en: and he failed to inquire of the LORD. So the LORD put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.
chapters.zh: 没有求问耶和华，所以耶和华使他被杀，把国归于耶西的儿子大卫。

chapters.en: Then all Israel came together to David at Hebron and said, “Here we are, your own flesh and blood.
chapters.zh: 以色列众人聚集到希伯崙见大卫，说：「我们原是你的骨肉。

chapters.en: Even in times past, while Saul was king, you were the one who led Israel out and brought them back. And the LORD your God said, ‘You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be ruler over them.’”
chapters.zh: 从前扫罗作王的时候，率领以色列人出入的是你；耶和华－你的上帝也曾应许你说：『你必牧养我的民以色列，作以色列的君。』」

chapters.en: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, where David made a covenant with them before the LORD. And they anointed him king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD through Samuel.
chapters.zh: 于是以色列的长老都来到希伯崙见大卫王。大卫在希伯崙耶和华面前与他们立约，他们就膏大卫作以色列的王，是照耶和华藉撒母耳所说的话。

chapters.en: Then David and all the Israelites marched to Jerusalem (that is, Jebus), where the Jebusites inhabited the land.
chapters.zh: 大卫和以色列众人到了耶路撒冷，就是耶布斯；那时耶布斯人住在那里。

chapters.en:
The people of Jebus said to David, “You will never get in here.”
Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion (that is, the City of David).
chapters.zh: 耶布斯人对大卫说：「你决不能进这地方。」然而大卫攻取锡安的保障，就是大卫的城。

chapters.en:
Now David had said, “Whoever is the first to strike down a Jebusite will become chief commander.”
And Joab son of Zeruiah went up first, and he became the chief.
chapters.zh: 大卫说：「谁先攻打耶布斯人，必作首领元帅。」洗鲁雅的儿子约押先上去，就作了元帅。

chapters.en: So David took up residence in the fortress; that is why it was called the City of David.
chapters.zh: 大卫住在保障里，所以那保障叫作大卫城。

chapters.en: He built up the city around it, from the supporting terraces to the surrounding wall, while Joab restored the rest of the city.
chapters.zh: 大卫又从米罗起，四围建筑城墙，其余的是约押修理。

chapters.en: And David became greater and greater, for the LORD of Hosts was with him.
chapters.zh: 大卫日见强盛，因为万军之耶和华与他同在。

chapters.en: Now these were the chiefs of David’s mighty men, who, together with all Israel, bolstered and strengthened his kingdom, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
chapters.zh: 以下记录跟随大卫勇士的首领，就是奋勇帮助他得国、照着耶和华吩咐以色列人的话、与以色列人一同立他作王的。

chapters.en:
This is the list of David’s mighty men:
Jashobeam son of Hachmoni was chief of the officers; he wielded his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed at one time.
chapters.zh: 大卫勇士的数目记在下面：哈革摩尼的儿子雅朔班，他是军长的统领，一时举枪杀了三百人。

chapters.en: Next in command was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men.
chapters.zh: 其次是亚合人朵多的儿子以利亚撒，他是三个勇士里的一个。

chapters.en: He was with David at Pas-dammim when the Philistines gathered there for battle. At a place with a field full of barley, the troops fled from the Philistines.
chapters.zh: 他从前与大卫在巴斯‧达闵，非利士人聚集要打仗。那里有一块长满大麦的田，众民就在非利士人面前逃跑；

chapters.en: But Eleazar and David stationed themselves in the middle of the field and defended it. They struck down the Philistines, and the LORD brought about a great victory.
chapters.zh: 这勇士便站在那田间击杀非利士人，救护了那田。耶和华使以色列人大获全胜。

chapters.en: Three of the thirty chief men went down to David, to the rock at the cave of Adullam, while a company of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.
chapters.zh: 三十个勇士中的三个人下到磐石那里，进了亚杜兰洞见大卫；非利士的军队在利乏音谷安营。

chapters.en: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was at Bethlehem.
chapters.zh: 那时大卫在山寨，非利士人的防营在伯利恒。

chapters.en: David longed for water and said, “Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!”
chapters.zh: 大卫渴想，说：「甚愿有人将伯利恒城门旁井里的水打来给我喝！」

chapters.en: So the Three broke through the Philistine camp, drew water from the well at the gate of Bethlehem, and brought it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out to the LORD,
chapters.zh: 这三个勇士就闯过非利士人的营盘，从伯利恒城门旁的井里打水，拿来奉给大卫。他却不肯喝，将水奠在耶和华面前，

chapters.en:
saying, “Far be it from me, my God, to do this! How can I drink the blood of these men who risked their lives?” Because they had brought it at the risk of their lives, David refused to drink it.
Such were the exploits of the three mighty men.
chapters.zh: 说：「我的上帝啊，这三个人冒死去打水，这水好像他们的血一般，我断不敢喝！」如此，大卫不肯喝。这是三个勇士所做的事。

chapters.en: Now Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the Three, and he wielded his spear against three hundred men, killed them, and won a name along with the Three.
chapters.zh: 约押的兄弟亚比筛是这三个勇士的首领；他举枪杀了三百人，就在三个勇士里得了名。

chapters.en: He was doubly honored above the Three, and he became their commander, even though he was not included among the Three.
chapters.zh: 他在这三个勇士里是最尊贵的，所以作他们的首领；只是不及前三个勇士。

chapters.en: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada was a man of valor from Kabzeel, a man of many exploits. He struck down two champions of Moab, and on a snowy day he went down into a pit and killed a lion.
chapters.zh: 有甲薛勇士耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅行过大能的事：他杀了摩押人亚利伊勒的两个〔儿子〕，又在下雪的时候下坑里去杀了一个狮子，

chapters.en: He also struck down an Egyptian, a huge man five cubits tall. Although the Egyptian had a spear like a weaver’s beam in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club, snatched the spear from his hand, and killed the Egyptian with his own spear.
chapters.zh: 又杀了一个埃及人。埃及人身高五肘，手里拿着枪，枪杆粗如织布的机轴；比拿雅只拿着棍子下去，从埃及人手里夺过枪来，用那枪将他刺死。

chapters.en: These were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada, who won a name along with the three mighty men.
chapters.zh: 这是耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅所行的事，就在三个勇士里得了名。

chapters.en: He was most honored among the Thirty, but he did not become one of the Three. And David appointed him over his guard.
chapters.zh: 他比那三十个勇士都尊贵，只是不及前三个勇士。大卫立他作护卫长。

chapters.en:
Now these were the mighty men:
Asahel the brother of Joab,
Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
chapters.zh: 军中的勇士有约押的兄弟亚撒黑，伯利恒人朵多的儿子伊勒哈难，

chapters.en:
Shammoth the Harorite,
Helez the Pelonite,
chapters.zh: 哈律人沙玛，比伦人希利斯，

chapters.en:
Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
Abiezer the Anathothite,
chapters.zh: 提哥亚人益吉的儿子以拉，亚拿突人亚比以谢，

chapters.en:
Sibbecai the Hushathite,
Ilai the Ahohite,
chapters.zh: 户沙人西比该，亚合人以来，

chapters.en:
Maharai the Netophathite,
Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite,
chapters.zh: 尼陀法人玛哈莱，尼陀法人巴拿的儿子希立，

chapters.en:
Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah of the Benjamites,
Benaiah the Pirathonite,
chapters.zh: 便雅悯族基比亚人利拜的儿子以太，比拉顿人比拿雅，

chapters.en:
Hurai from the brooks of Gaash,
Abiel the Arbathite,
chapters.zh: 迦实溪人户莱，亚拉巴人亚比，

chapters.en:
Azmaveth the Baharumite,
Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
chapters.zh: 巴路米人押斯玛弗，沙本人以利雅哈巴，

chapters.en:
the sons of Hashem the Gizonite,
Jonathan son of Shagee the Hararite,
chapters.zh: 基孙人哈深的众子，哈拉人沙基的儿子约拿单，

chapters.en:
Ahiam son of Sachar the Hararite,
Eliphal son of Ur,
chapters.zh: 哈拉人沙甲的儿子亚希暗，吾珥的儿子以利法勒，

chapters.en:
Hepher the Mecherathite,
Ahijah the Pelonite,
chapters.zh: 米基拉人希弗，比伦人亚希雅，

chapters.en:
Hezro the Carmelite,
Naarai son of Ezbai,
chapters.zh: 迦密人希斯罗，伊斯拜的儿子拿莱，

chapters.en:
Joel the brother of Nathan,
Mibhar son of Hagri,
chapters.zh: 拿单的兄弟约珥，哈基利的儿子弥伯哈，

chapters.en:
Zelek the Ammonite,
Naharai the Beerothite, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah,
chapters.zh: 亚扪人洗勒，比录人拿哈莱（拿哈莱是给洗鲁雅的儿子约押拿兵器的），

chapters.en:
Ira the Ithrite,
Gareb the Ithrite,
chapters.zh: 以帖人以拉，以帖人迦立，

chapters.en:
Uriah the Hittite,
Zabad son of Ahlai,
chapters.zh: 赫人乌利亚，亚莱的儿子撒拔，

chapters.en: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, chief of the Reubenites, and the thirty with him,
chapters.zh: 吕便人示撒的儿子亚第拿（他是吕便支派中的一个族长，率领三十人），

chapters.en:
Hanan son of Maacah,
Joshaphat the Mithnite,
chapters.zh: 玛迦的儿子哈难，弥特尼人约沙法，

chapters.en:
Uzzia the Ashterathite,
Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
chapters.zh: 亚施他拉人乌西亚，亚罗珥人何坦的儿子沙玛、耶利，

chapters.en: Jediael son of Shimri and his brother Joha the Tizite,
chapters.zh: 提洗人申利的儿子耶叠和他的兄弟约哈，

chapters.en:
Eliel the Mahavite,
Jeribai and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam,
Ithmah the Moabite,
chapters.zh: 玛哈未人以利业，伊利拿安的儿子耶利拜、约沙未雅，摩押人伊特玛、

chapters.en: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
chapters.zh: 以利业、俄备得，并米琐八人雅西业。

chapters.en: Now these were the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he was still banished from the presence of Saul son of Kish (they were among the mighty men who helped him in battle;
chapters.zh: 大卫因怕基士的儿子扫罗，躲在洗革拉的时候，有勇士到他那里帮助他打仗。

chapters.en: they were archers using both the right and left hands to sling stones and shoot arrows; and they were Saul’s kinsmen from Benjamin):
chapters.zh: 他们善于拉弓，能用左右两手甩石射箭，都是便雅悯人扫罗的族弟兄。
为首的是亚希以谢，其次是约阿施，都是基比亚人示玛的儿子。还有亚斯玛威的儿子耶薛和毗力，又有比拉迦，并亚拿突人耶户，

chapters.en:
Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the Thirty and a leader over the Thirty;
Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, and Jozabad the Gederathite;
chapters.zh: 基遍人以实买雅（他在三十人中是勇士，管理他们），且有耶利米、雅哈悉、约哈难，和基得拉人约撒拔、

chapters.en: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite;
chapters.zh: 伊利乌赛、耶利摩、比亚利雅、示玛利雅，哈律弗人示法提雅，

chapters.en: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, who were Korahites;
chapters.zh: 可拉人以利加拿、耶西亚、亚萨列、约以谢、雅朔班，

chapters.en: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.
chapters.zh: 基多人耶罗罕的儿子犹拉和西巴第雅。

chapters.en: Some Gadites defected to David at his stronghold in the wilderness. They were mighty men of valor, trained for battle, experts with the shield and spear, whose faces were like the faces of lions and who were as swift as gazelles on the mountains:
chapters.zh: 迦得支派中有人到旷野的山寨投奔大卫，都是大能的勇士，能拿盾牌和枪的战士。他们的面貌好像狮子，快跑如同山上的鹿。

chapters.en: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second in command, Eliab the third,
chapters.zh: 第一以薛，第二俄巴底雅，第三以利押，

chapters.en: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
chapters.zh: 第四弥施玛拿，第五耶利米，

chapters.en: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
chapters.zh: 第六亚太，第七以利业，

chapters.en: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
chapters.zh: 第八约哈难，第九以利萨巴，

chapters.en: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbanai the eleventh.
chapters.zh: 第十耶利米，第十一末巴奈。

chapters.en: These Gadites were army commanders, the least of whom was a match for a hundred, and the greatest for a thousand.
chapters.zh: 这都是迦得人中的军长，至小的能抵一百人，至大的能抵一千人。

chapters.en: These are the ones who crossed the Jordan in the first month when it was overflowing all its banks, and they put to flight all those in the valleys, both to the east and to the west.
chapters.zh: 正月，约旦河水涨过两岸的时候，他们过河，使一切住平原的人东奔西逃。

chapters.en: Other Benjamites and some men from Judah also came to David in his stronghold.
chapters.zh: 又有便雅悯和犹大人到山寨大卫那里。

chapters.en: And David went out to meet them, saying, “If you have come to me in peace to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my enemies when my hands are free of violence, may the God of our fathers see it and judge you.”
chapters.zh: 大卫出去迎接他们，对他们说：「你们若是和和平平地来帮助我，我心就与你们相契；你们若是将我这无罪的人卖在敌人手里，愿我们列祖的上帝察看责罚。」

chapters.en:
Then the Spirit came upon Amasai, the chief of the Thirty, and he said:
“We are yours, O David! We are with you, O son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers,
for your God helps you.”
So David received them and made them leaders of his troops.
chapters.zh: 那时〔上帝〕的灵感动那三十个勇士的首领亚玛撒，〔他就说〕： 大卫啊，我们是归于你的！ 耶西的儿子啊，我们是帮助你的！ 愿你平平安安， 愿帮助你的也都平安！ 因为你的上帝帮助你。 大卫就收留他们，立他们作军长。

chapters.en: Some from Manasseh defected to David when he went with the Philistines to fight against Saul. (They did not help the Philistines because the Philistine rulers consulted and sent David away, saying, “It will cost us our heads if he defects to his master Saul.”)
chapters.zh: 大卫从前与非利士人同去，要与扫罗争战，有些玛拿西人来投奔大卫，他们却没有帮助非利士人；因为非利士人的首领商议，打发他们回去，说：「恐怕大卫拿我们的首级，归降他的主人扫罗。」

chapters.en:
When David went to Ziklag, these men of Manasseh defected to him:
Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, chiefs of thousands in Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 大卫往洗革拉去的时候，有玛拿西人的千夫长押拿、约撒拔、耶叠、米迦勒、约撒拔、以利户、洗勒太都来投奔他。

chapters.en: They helped David against the raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and commanders in the army.
chapters.zh: 这些人帮助大卫攻击群贼；他们都是大能的勇士，且作军长。

chapters.en: For at that time men came to David day after day to help him, until he had a great army, like the army of God.
chapters.zh: 那时天天有人来帮助大卫，以致成了大军，如上帝的军一样。

chapters.en: Now these are the numbers of men armed for battle who came to David at Hebron to turn Saul’s kingdom over to him, in accordance with the word of the LORD:
chapters.zh: 预备打仗的兵来到希伯崙见大卫，要照着耶和华的话将扫罗的国位归与大卫。他们的数目如下：

chapters.en: From Judah: 6,800 armed troops bearing shields and spears.
chapters.zh: 犹大支派，拿盾牌和枪预备打仗的有六千八百人。

chapters.en: From Simeon: 7,100 mighty men of valor, ready for battle.
chapters.zh: 西缅支派，能上阵大能的勇士有七千一百人。

chapters.en: From Levi: 4,600,
chapters.zh: 利未支派有四千六百人。

chapters.en: including Jehoiada, leader of the house of Aaron, with 3,700 men,
chapters.zh: 耶何耶大是亚伦〔家〕的首领，跟从他的有三千七百人。

chapters.en: and Zadok, a mighty young man of valor, with 22 commanders from his own family.
chapters.zh: 还有少年大能的勇士撒督，同着他的有族长二十二人。

chapters.en: From Benjamin, the kinsmen of Saul: 3,000, most of whom had remained loyal to the house of Saul up to that time.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯支派，扫罗的族弟兄也有三千人，他们向来大半归顺扫罗家。

chapters.en: From Ephraim: 20,800 mighty men of valor, famous among their own clans.
chapters.zh: 以法莲支派大能的勇士，在本族著名的有二万零八百人。

chapters.en: From the half-tribe of Manasseh: 18,000 designated by name to come and make David king.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西半支派，册上有名的共一万八千人，都来立大卫作王。

chapters.en: From Issachar, men who understood the times and knew what Israel should do: 200 chiefs with all their kinsmen at their command.
chapters.zh: 以萨迦支派，有二百族长都通达时务，知道以色列人所当行的；他们族弟兄都听从他们的命令。

chapters.en: From Zebulun: 50,000 fit for service, trained for battle with all kinds of weapons of war, who with one purpose were devoted to David.
chapters.zh: 西布伦支派，能上阵用各样兵器打仗、行伍整齐、不生二心的有五万人。

chapters.en: From Naphtali: 1,000 commanders, accompanied by 37,000 men with shield and spear.
chapters.zh: 拿弗他利支派，有一千军长；跟从他们、拿盾牌和枪的有三万七千人。

chapters.en: From Dan: 28,600 prepared for battle.
chapters.zh: 但支派，能摆阵的有二万八千六百人。

chapters.en: From Asher: 40,000 fit for service, prepared for battle.
chapters.zh: 亚设支派，能上阵打仗的有四万人。

chapters.en: And from east of the Jordan, from Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh there: 120,000 armed with every kind of weapon of war.
chapters.zh: 约旦河东的吕便支派、迦得支派、玛拿西半支派，拿着各样兵器打仗的有十二万人。

chapters.en: All these men of war, arrayed for battle, came to Hebron fully determined to make David king over all Israel. And all the rest of the Israelites were of one mind to make David king.
chapters.zh: 以上都是能守行伍的战士，他们都诚心来到希伯崙，要立大卫作以色列的王。以色列其余的人也都一心要立大卫作王。

chapters.en: They spent three days there eating and drinking with David, for their relatives had provided for them.
chapters.zh: 他们在那里三日，与大卫一同吃喝，因为他们的族弟兄给他们预备了。

chapters.en: And their neighbors from as far away as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali came bringing food on donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen—abundant supplies of flour, fig cakes and raisin cakes, wine and oil, oxen and sheep. Indeed, there was joy in Israel.
chapters.zh: 靠近他们的人以及以萨迦、西布伦、拿弗他利人将许多面饼、无花果饼、干葡萄、酒、油，用驴、骆驼、骡子、牛驮来，又带了许多的牛和羊来，因为以色列人甚是欢乐。

chapters.en: Then David conferred with all his leaders, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds.
chapters.zh: 大卫与千夫长、百夫长，就是一切首领商议。

chapters.en: And he said to the whole assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if this is of the LORD our God, let us send word far and wide to the rest of our brothers in all the land of Israel, and also to the priests and Levites in their cities and pasturelands, so that they may join us.
chapters.zh: 大卫对以色列全会众说：「你们若以为美，见这事是出于耶和华－我们的上帝，我们就差遣人走遍以色列地，见我们未来的弟兄，又见住在有郊野之城的祭司利未人，使他们都到这里来聚集。

chapters.en: Then let us bring back the ark of our God, for we did not inquire of Him in the days of Saul.”
chapters.zh: 我们要把上帝的〔约〕柜运到我们这里来；因为在扫罗年间，我们没有在〔约〕柜前求问〔上帝〕。」

chapters.en: And because this proposal seemed right to all the people, the whole assembly agreed to it.
chapters.zh: 全会众都说可以如此行；这事在众民眼中都看为好。

chapters.en: So David assembled all Israel, from the River Shihor in Egypt to Lebo-hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.
chapters.zh: 于是，大卫将以色列人从埃及的西曷河直到哈马口都招聚了来，要从基列‧耶琳将上帝的〔约〕柜运来。

chapters.en: David and all Israel went up to Baalah of Judah (that is, Kiriath-jearim) to bring up from there the ark of God the LORD, who is enthroned between the cherubim—the ark that is called by the Name.
chapters.zh: 大卫率领以色列众人上到巴拉，就是属犹大的基列‧耶琳，要从那里将〔约〕柜运来。这〔约〕柜就是坐在二基路伯上耶和华上帝留名的〔约〕柜。

chapters.en: So they carried the ark of God from the house of Abinadab on a new cart, with Uzzah and Ahio guiding the cart.
chapters.zh: 他们将上帝的〔约〕柜从亚比拿达的家里抬出来，放在新车上。乌撒和亚希约赶车。

chapters.en: David and all the Israelites were celebrating before God with all their might, with songs and on harps and lyres, with tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
chapters.zh: 大卫和以色列众人在上帝前用琴、瑟、锣、鼓、号作乐，极力跳舞歌唱。

chapters.en: When they came to the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzzah reached out and took hold of the ark, because the oxen had stumbled.
chapters.zh: 到了基顿〔注：在撒母耳下六章六节是拿艮〕的禾场；因为牛失前蹄〔注：或译：惊跳〕，乌撒就伸手扶住〔约〕柜。

chapters.en: And the anger of the LORD burned against Uzzah, and He struck him down because he had put his hand on the ark. So he died there before God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华向他发怒，因他伸手扶住〔约〕柜击杀他，他就死在上帝面前。

chapters.en: Then David became angry because the LORD had burst forth against Uzzah. So he named that place Perez-uzzah, as it is called to this day.
chapters.zh: 大卫因耶和华击杀〔注：原文是闯杀〕乌撒，心里愁烦，就称那地方为毗列斯‧乌撒，直到今日。

chapters.en: That day David feared God and asked, “How can I ever bring the ark of God to me?”
chapters.zh: 那日，大卫惧怕上帝，说：「上帝的〔约〕柜怎可运到我这里来？」

chapters.en: So he did not move the ark with him to the City of David; instead, he took it aside to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
chapters.zh: 于是大卫不将〔约〕柜运进大卫的城，却运到迦特人俄别‧以东的家中。

chapters.en: Thus the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house for three months, and the LORD blessed his household and everything he owned.
chapters.zh: 上帝的〔约〕柜在俄别‧以东家中三个月，耶和华赐福给俄别‧以东的家和他一切所有的。

chapters.en: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David, along with cedar logs, stonemasons, and carpenters, to build a palace for him.
chapters.zh: 泰尔王希兰将香柏木运到大卫那里，又差遣使者和石匠、木匠给大卫建造宫殿。

chapters.en: And David realized that the LORD had established him as king over Israel and had highly exalted his kingdom for the sake of His people Israel.
chapters.zh: 大卫就知道耶和华坚立他作以色列王，又为自己的民以色列，使他的国兴旺。

chapters.en: And David took more wives in Jerusalem and became the father of more sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 大卫在耶路撒冷又立后妃，又生儿女。

chapters.en: These are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
chapters.zh: 在耶路撒冷所生的众子是沙母亚、朔罢、拿单、所罗门、

chapters.en: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
chapters.zh: 益辖、以利书亚、以法列、

chapters.en: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
chapters.zh: 挪迦、尼斐、雅非亚、

chapters.en: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.
chapters.zh: 以利沙玛、比利雅大、以利法列。

chapters.en: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, they all went in search of him; but David learned of this and went out to face them.
chapters.zh: 非利士人听见大卫受膏作以色列众人的王，非利士众人就上来寻索大卫。大卫听见，就出去迎敌。

chapters.en: Now the Philistines had come and raided the Valley of Rephaim.
chapters.zh: 非利士人来了，布散在利乏音谷。

chapters.en:
So David inquired of God, “Should I go up against the Philistines? Will You deliver them into my hand?”
“Go,” replied the LORD, “for I will deliver them into your hand.”
chapters.zh: 大卫求问上帝，说：「我可以上去攻打非利士人吗？你将他们交在我手里吗？」耶和华说：「你可以上去，我必将他们交在你手里。」

chapters.en: So David and his men went up to Baal-perazim, where he defeated the Philistines and said, “Like a bursting flood, God has burst out against my enemies by my hand.” So they called that place Baal-perazim.
chapters.zh: 非利士人来到巴力‧毗拉心，大卫在那里杀败他们。大卫说：「上帝藉我的手冲破敌人，如同水冲去一般」；因此称那地方为巴力‧毗拉心。

chapters.en: There the Philistines abandoned their gods, and David ordered that they be burned in the fire.
chapters.zh: 非利士人将神像撇在那里，大卫吩咐人用火焚烧了。

chapters.en: Once again the Philistines raided the valley.
chapters.zh: 非利士人又布散在利乏音谷。

chapters.en: So David again inquired of God, who answered him, “Do not march up after them, but circle around them and attack them in front of the balsam trees.
chapters.zh: 大卫又求问上帝。上帝说：「不要一直地上去，要转到他们后头，从桑林对面攻打他们。

chapters.en: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, move out to battle, because this will mean that God has gone out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines.”
chapters.zh: 你听见桑树梢上有脚步的声音，就要出战，因为上帝已经在你前头去攻打非利士人的军队。」

chapters.en: So David did as God had commanded him, and they struck down the army of the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.
chapters.zh: 大卫就遵着上帝所吩咐的，攻打非利士人的军队，从基遍直到基色。

chapters.en: And David’s fame went out into every land, and the LORD caused all nations to fear him.
chapters.zh: 于是大卫的名传扬到列国，耶和华使列国都惧怕他。

chapters.en: David constructed buildings for himself in the City of David, and he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.
chapters.zh: 大卫在大卫城为自己建造宫殿，又为上帝的〔约〕柜预备地方，支搭帐幕。

chapters.en: Then David said, “No one but the Levites may carry the ark of God, because the LORD has chosen them to carry the ark of the LORD and to minister before Him forever.”
chapters.zh: 那时大卫说：「除了利未人之外，无人可抬上帝的〔约〕柜；因为耶和华拣选他们抬上帝的〔约〕柜，且永远事奉他。」

chapters.en: And David assembled all Israel in Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the LORD to the place he had prepared for it.
chapters.zh: 大卫招聚以色列众人到耶路撒冷，要将耶和华的〔约〕柜抬到他所预备的地方。

chapters.en: Then he gathered together the descendants of Aaron and the Levites:
chapters.zh: 大卫又聚集亚伦的子孙和利未人。

chapters.en: From the Kohathites, Uriel the chief and 120 of his relatives;
chapters.zh: 哥辖子孙中有族长乌列和他的弟兄一百二十人。

chapters.en: from the Merarites, Asaiah the chief and 220 of his relatives;
chapters.zh: 米拉利子孙中有族长亚帅雅和他的弟兄二百二十人。

chapters.en: from the Gershomites, Joel the chief and 130 of his relatives;
chapters.zh: 革顺子孙中有族长约珥和他的弟兄一百三十人。

chapters.en: from the Elizaphanites, Shemaiah the chief and 200 of his relatives;
chapters.zh: 以利撒反子孙中有族长示玛雅和他的弟兄二百人。

chapters.en: from the Hebronites, Eliel the chief and 80 of his relatives;
chapters.zh: 希伯崙子孙中有族长以列和他的弟兄八十人。

chapters.en: and from the Uzzielites, Amminadab the chief and 112 of his relatives.
chapters.zh: 乌薛子孙中有族长亚米拿达和他的弟兄一百一十二人。

chapters.en: David summoned the priests Zadok and Abiathar and the Levites Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.
chapters.zh: 大卫将祭司撒督和亚比亚他，并利未人乌列、亚帅雅、约珥、示玛雅、以列、亚米拿达召来，

chapters.en: And he said to them, “You are the heads of the Levitical families. You and your relatives must consecrate yourselves so that you may bring the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, to the place I have prepared for it.
chapters.zh: 对他们说：「你们是利未人的族长，你们和你们的弟兄应当自洁，好将耶和华－以色列上帝的〔约〕柜抬到我所预备的地方。

chapters.en: It was because you Levites were not with us the first time that the LORD our God burst forth in anger against us. For we did not consult Him about the proper order.”
chapters.zh: 因你们先前没有〔抬这约柜〕，按定例求问耶和华－我们的上帝，所以他刑罚〔注：原文是闯杀〕我们。」

chapters.en: So the priests and Levites consecrated themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 于是祭司利未人自洁，好将耶和华－以色列上帝的〔约〕柜抬上来。

chapters.en: And the Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders with the poles, as Moses had commanded in accordance with the word of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 利未子孙就用杠，肩抬上帝的〔约〕柜，是照耶和华藉摩西所吩咐的。

chapters.en: David also told the leaders of the Levites to appoint their relatives as singers to lift up their voices with joy, accompanied by musical instruments—harps, lyres, and cymbals.
chapters.zh: 大卫吩咐利未人的族长，派他们歌唱的弟兄用琴瑟和钹作乐，欢欢喜喜地大声歌颂。

chapters.en: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel; from his brothers, Asaph son of Berechiah; from their brothers the Merarites, Ethan son of Kushaiah;
chapters.zh: 于是利未人派约珥的儿子希幔和他弟兄中比利家的儿子亚萨，并他们族弟兄米拉利子孙里古沙雅的儿子以探。

chapters.en: and with them their brothers next in rank: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, and the gatekeepers Obed-edom and Jeiel.
chapters.zh: 其次还有他们的弟兄撒迦利雅、便雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、乌尼、以利押、比拿雅、玛西雅、玛他提雅、以利斐利户、弥克尼雅，并守门的俄别‧以东和耶利。

chapters.en: The musicians Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were to sound the bronze cymbals.
chapters.zh: 这样，派歌唱的希幔、亚萨、以探敲铜钹，大发响声；

chapters.en: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah were to play the harps according to Alamoth.
chapters.zh: 派撒迦利雅、雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、乌尼、以利押、玛西雅、比拿雅鼓瑟，调用女音；

chapters.en: And Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah were to lead the music with lyres according to Sheminith.
chapters.zh: 又派玛他提雅、以利斐利户、弥克尼雅、俄别‧以东、耶利、亚撒西雅领首弹琴，调用第八。

chapters.en: Chenaniah the head Levite was the director of the music because he was highly skilled.
chapters.zh: 利未人的族长基拿尼雅是歌唱人的首领，又教训人歌唱，因为他精通此事。

chapters.en: Berechiah and Elkanah were to be guardians of the ark.
chapters.zh: 比利家、以利加拿是〔约〕柜前守门的。

chapters.en: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer—the priests—were to blow the trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-edom and Jehiah were also to be guardians of the ark.
chapters.zh: 祭司示巴尼、约沙法、拿坦业、亚玛赛、撒迦利雅、比拿亚、以利以谢在上帝的〔约〕柜前吹号。俄别‧以东和耶希亚也是〔约〕柜前守门的。

chapters.en: So David, the elders of Israel, and the commanders of thousands went with rejoicing to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the house of Obed-edom.
chapters.zh: 于是，大卫和以色列的长老，并千夫长都去从俄别‧以东的家欢欢喜喜地将耶和华的约柜抬上来。

chapters.en: And because God helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
chapters.zh: 上帝赐恩与抬耶和华约柜的利未人，他们就献上七只公牛，七只公羊。

chapters.en: Now David was dressed in a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who were carrying the ark, as well as the singers and Chenaniah, the director of music for the singers. David also wore a linen ephod.
chapters.zh: 大卫和抬〔约〕柜的利未人，并歌唱人的首领基拿尼雅，以及歌唱的人，都穿着细麻布的外袍；大卫另外穿着细麻布的以弗得。

chapters.en: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, with the sounding of rams’ horns and trumpets, and with cymbals and the music of harps and lyres.
chapters.zh: 这样，以色列众人欢呼吹角、吹号、敲钹、鼓瑟、弹琴，大发响声，将耶和华的约柜抬上来。

chapters.en: As the ark of the covenant of the LORD was entering the City of David, Saul’s daughter Michal looked down from a window and saw King David dancing and celebrating, and she despised him in her heart.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的约柜进了大卫城的时候，扫罗的女儿米甲从窗户里观看，见大卫王踊跃跳舞，心里就轻视他。

chapters.en: So they brought the ark of God and placed it inside the tent that David had pitched for it. And they presented burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
chapters.zh: 众人将上帝的〔约〕柜请进去，安放在大卫所搭的帐幕里，就在上帝面前献燔祭和平安祭。

chapters.en: When David had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 大卫献完了燔祭和平安祭，就奉耶和华的名给民祝福，

chapters.en: Then he distributed to every man and woman of Israel a loaf of bread, a date cake, and a raisin cake.
chapters.zh: 并且分给以色列人，无论男女，每人一个饼，一块〔肉〕，一个葡萄饼。

chapters.en: David appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, to celebrate, to give thanks, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 大卫派几个利未人在耶和华的〔约〕柜前事奉，颂扬，称谢，赞美耶和华－以色列的上帝：

chapters.en: Asaph was the chief, Zechariah was second, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, and Jeiel. They were to play the harps and lyres, while Asaph sounded the cymbals
chapters.zh: 为首的是亚萨，其次是撒迦利雅、雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、玛他提雅、以利押、比拿雅、俄别‧以东、耶利，鼓瑟弹琴；惟有亚萨敲钹，大发响声；

chapters.en: and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel blew the trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God.
chapters.zh: 祭司比拿雅和雅哈悉常在上帝的约柜前吹号。

chapters.en: On that day David first committed to Asaph and his associates this song of thanksgiving to the LORD:
chapters.zh: 那日，大卫初次藉亚萨和他的弟兄以诗歌称颂耶和华，〔说〕：

chapters.en: “Give thanks to the LORD; call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
chapters.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，求告他的名， 在万民中传扬他的作为！

chapters.en: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.
chapters.zh: 要向他唱诗、歌颂， 谈论他一切奇妙的作为。

chapters.en: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
chapters.zh: 要以他的圣名夸耀； 寻求耶和华的人，心中应当欢喜。

chapters.en: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
chapters.zh: 要寻求耶和华与他的能力， 时常寻求他的面。

chapters.en: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,
O offspring of His servant Israel, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
chapters.zh: 他仆人以色列的后裔， 他所拣选雅各的子孙哪， 你们要记念他奇妙的作为和他的奇事， 并他口中的判语。

chapters.en: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.
chapters.zh: 他是耶和华－我们的上帝， 全地都有他的判断。

chapters.en: Remember His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—
chapters.zh: 你们要记念他的约，直到永远； 他所吩咐的话，直到千代，

chapters.en: the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.
chapters.zh: 就是与亚伯拉罕所立的约， 向以撒所起的誓。

chapters.en: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
chapters.zh: 他又将这约向雅各定为律例， 向以色列定为永远的约，

chapters.en: ‘I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.’
chapters.zh: 说：我必将迦南地赐给你， 作你产业的分。

chapters.en: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land,
chapters.zh: 当时你们人丁有限，数目稀少， 并且在那地为寄居的；

chapters.en: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
chapters.zh: 他们从这邦游到那邦， 从这国行到那国。

chapters.en: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:
chapters.zh: 耶和华不容什么人欺负他们， 为他们的缘故责备君王，

chapters.en: ‘Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!’
chapters.zh: 说：不可难为我受膏的人， 也不可恶待我的先知！

chapters.en: Sing to the LORD, all the earth. Proclaim His salvation day after day.
chapters.zh: 全地都要向耶和华歌唱！ 天天传扬他的救恩，

chapters.en: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all peoples.
chapters.zh: 在列邦中述说他的荣耀， 在万民中述说他的奇事。

chapters.en: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华为大，当受极大的赞美； 他在万神之上，当受敬畏。

chapters.en: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is the LORD who made the heavens.
chapters.zh: 外邦的神都属虚无， 惟独耶和华创造诸天。

chapters.en: Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and joy fill His dwelling.
chapters.zh: 有尊荣和威严在他面前， 有能力和喜乐在他圣所。

chapters.en: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
chapters.zh: 民中的万族啊， 你们要将荣耀能力归给耶和华，都归给耶和华！

chapters.en: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and come before Him. Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness;
chapters.zh: 要将耶和华的名所当得的荣耀归给他， 拿供物来奉到他面前； 当以圣洁的〔注：的：或译为〕妆饰敬拜耶和华。

chapters.en: tremble before Him, all the earth. The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
chapters.zh: 全地要在他面前颤抖， 世界也坚定不得动摇。

chapters.en: Let the heavens be glad, and the earth rejoice. Let them say among the nations, ‘The LORD reigns!’
chapters.zh: 愿天欢喜，愿地快乐； 愿人在列邦中说： 耶和华作王了！

chapters.en: Let the sea resound, and all that fills it; let the fields exult, and all that is in them.
chapters.zh: 愿海和其中所充满的澎湃； 愿田和其中所有的都欢乐。

chapters.en: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for He is coming to judge the earth.
chapters.zh: 那时，林中的树木都要在耶和华面前欢呼， 因为他来要审判全地。

chapters.en: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 应当称谢耶和华； 因他本为善，他的慈爱永远长存！

chapters.en: Then cry out: ‘Save us, O God of our salvation; gather and deliver us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.’
chapters.zh: 要说：拯救我们的上帝啊，求你救我们， 聚集我们，使我们脱离外邦， 我们好称赞你的圣名，以赞美你为夸胜。

chapters.en:
Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.”
Then all the people said, “Amen!” and “Praise the LORD!”
chapters.zh: 耶和华－以色列的上帝， 从亘古直到永远，是应当称颂的！ 众民都说：「阿们！」并且赞美耶和华。

chapters.en: So David left Asaph and his associates there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to minister there regularly according to the daily requirements,
chapters.zh: 大卫派亚萨和他的弟兄在约柜前常常事奉耶和华，一日尽一日的职分；

chapters.en: along with Obed-edom and his sixty-eight relatives. Obed-edom son of Jeduthun, and also Hosah, were to be gatekeepers.
chapters.zh: 又派俄别‧以东和他的弟兄六十八人，与耶杜顿的儿子俄别‧以东，并何萨作守门的；

chapters.en: And David left Zadok the priest and his fellow priests before the tabernacle of the LORD at the high place in Gibeon
to regularly present burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offerings, morning and evening, according to all that was written in the Law of the LORD, which He had commanded Israel to keep.
chapters.zh: 且派祭司撒督和他弟兄众祭司在基遍的邱坛、耶和华的帐幕前燔祭坛上，每日早晚，照着耶和华律法书上所吩咐以色列人的，常给耶和华献燔祭。

chapters.en: With them were Heman, Jeduthun, and the rest of those chosen and designated by name to give thanks to the LORD, for “His loving devotion endures forever.”
chapters.zh: 与他们一同被派的有希幔、耶杜顿，和其余被选名字录在册上的，称谢耶和华，因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: Heman and Jeduthun had with them trumpets and cymbals for the music and instruments for the songs of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were stationed at the gate.
chapters.zh: 希幔、耶杜顿同着他们吹号、敲钹，大发响声，并用别的乐器随着歌颂上帝。耶杜顿的子孙作守门的。

chapters.en: Then all the people departed for their homes, and David returned home to bless his household.
chapters.zh: 于是众民各归各家；大卫也回去为家眷祝福。

chapters.en: After David had settled into his palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, “Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of the covenant of the LORD is under a tent.”
chapters.zh: 大卫住在自己宫中，对先知拿单说：「看哪，我住在香柏木的宫中，耶和华的约柜反在幔子里。」

chapters.en: And Nathan replied to David, “Do all that is in your heart, for God is with you.”
chapters.zh: 拿单对大卫说：「你可以照你的心意而行，因为上帝与你同在。」

chapters.en: But that night the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
chapters.zh: 当夜，上帝的话临到拿单，说：

chapters.en: “Go and tell My servant David that this is what the LORD says: You are not the one to build Me a house in which to dwell.
chapters.zh: 「你去告诉我仆人大卫，说耶和华如此说：『你不可建造殿宇给我居住。

chapters.en: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought Israel up out of Egypt until this day, but I have moved from tent to tent and dwelling to dwelling.
chapters.zh: 自从我领以色列人出埃及，直到今日，我未曾住过殿宇，乃从这会幕到那会幕，从这帐幕〔到那帐幕〕。

chapters.en: In all My journeys with all the Israelites, have I ever asked any of the leaders I appointed to shepherd My people, ‘Why haven’t you built Me a house of cedar?’
chapters.zh: 凡我同以色列人所走的地方，我何曾向以色列的一个士师，就是我吩咐牧养我民的说：你为何不给我建造香柏木的殿宇呢？』

chapters.en: Now then, you are to tell My servant David that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: I took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be the ruler over My people Israel.
chapters.zh: 现在你要告诉我仆人大卫，说万军之耶和华如此说：『我从羊圈中将你召来，叫你不再跟从羊群，立你作我民以色列的君。

chapters.en: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you. Now I will make for you a name like that of the greatest in the land.
chapters.zh: 你无论往哪里去，我常与你同在，剪除你的一切仇敌；我必使你得大名，好像世上大大有名的人一样。

chapters.en: And I will provide a place for My people Israel and will plant them so that they may dwell in a place of their own and be disturbed no more. No longer will the sons of wickedness oppress them as they did at the beginning
chapters.zh: 我必为我民以色列选定一个地方，栽培他们，使他们住自己的地方，不再迁移；凶恶之子也不像从前扰害他们，

chapters.en:
and have done since the day I appointed judges over My people Israel. And I will subdue all your enemies.
Moreover, I declare to you that the LORD will build a house for you.
chapters.zh: 并不像我命士师治理我民以色列的时候一样。我必治服你的一切仇敌，并且我－耶和华应许你，必为你建立家室。

chapters.en: And when your days are fulfilled and you go to be with your fathers, I will raise up your descendant after you, one of your own sons, and I will establish his kingdom.
chapters.zh: 你寿数满足归你列祖的时候，我必使你的后裔接续你的位，我也必坚定他的国。

chapters.en: He will build a house for Me, and I will establish his throne forever.
chapters.zh: 他必为我建造殿宇；我必坚定他的国位直到永远。

chapters.en: I will be his Father, and he will be My son. And I will never remove My loving devotion from him as I removed it from your predecessor.
chapters.zh: 我要作他的父，他要作我的子；并不使我的慈爱离开他，像离开在你以前的扫罗一样。

chapters.en: But I will set him over My house and My kingdom forever, and his throne will be established forever.”
chapters.zh: 我却要将他永远坚立在我家里和我国里；他的国位也必坚定，直到永远。』」

chapters.en: So Nathan relayed to David all the words of this entire revelation.
chapters.zh: 拿单就按这一切话，照这默示告诉大卫。

chapters.en: Then King David went in, sat before the LORD, and said, “Who am I, O LORD God, and what is my house, that You have brought me this far?
chapters.zh: 于是大卫王进去，坐在耶和华面前，说：「耶和华上帝啊，我是谁，我的家算什么，你竟使我到这地步呢？

chapters.en: And as if this was a small thing in Your eyes, O God, You have spoken about the future of the house of Your servant and have regarded me as a man of great distinction, O LORD God.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，这在你眼中还看为小，又应许你仆人的家至于久远。耶和华上帝啊，你看顾我好像看顾高贵的人。

chapters.en: What more can David say to You for honoring Your servant? For You know Your servant,
chapters.zh: 你加于仆人的尊荣，我还有何言可说呢？因为你知道你的仆人。

chapters.en: O LORD. For the sake of Your servant and according to Your own heart, You have accomplished this great thing and made known all these great promises.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你行了这大事，并且显明出来，是因你仆人的缘故，也是照你的心意。

chapters.en: O LORD, there is none like You, and there is no God but You, according to everything we have heard with our own ears.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，照我们耳中听见，没有可比你的，除你以外再无上帝。

chapters.en: And who is like Your people Israel—the one nation on earth whom God went out to redeem as a people for Himself? You made a name for Yourself through great and awesome wonders by driving out nations from before Your people, whom You redeemed from Egypt.
chapters.zh: 世上有何民能比你的民以色列呢？你上帝从埃及救赎他们作自己的子民，又在你赎出来的民面前行大而可畏的事，驱逐列邦人，显出你的大名。

chapters.en: For You have made Your people Israel Your very own forever, and You, O LORD, have become their God.
chapters.zh: 你使以色列人作你的子民，直到永远；你－耶和华也作他们的上帝。

chapters.en: And now, O LORD, let the word You have spoken concerning Your servant and his house be established forever. Do as You have promised,
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你所应许仆人和仆人家的话，求你坚定，直到永远，照你所说的而行。

chapters.en: so that Your name will be established and magnified forever when it is said, ‘The LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, is God over Israel.’ And may the house of Your servant David be established before You.
chapters.zh: 愿你的名永远坚立，被尊为大，说：『万军之耶和华是以色列的上帝，是治理以色列的上帝。』这样，你仆人大卫的家必在你面前坚立。

chapters.en: For You, my God, have revealed to Your servant that You will build a house for him. Therefore Your servant has found the courage to pray before You.
chapters.zh: 我的上帝啊，因你启示仆人说，我必为你建立家室，所以仆人大胆在你面前祈祷。

chapters.en: And now, O LORD, You are God! And You have promised this goodness to Your servant.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，惟有你是上帝，你也应许将这福气赐给仆人。

chapters.en: So now You have been pleased to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue forever before You. For You, O LORD, have blessed it, and it will be blessed forever.”
chapters.zh: 现在你喜悦赐福与仆人的家，可以永存在你面前。耶和华啊，你已经赐福，还要赐福到永远。」

chapters.en: Some time later, David defeated the Philistines, subdued them, and took Gath and its villages from the hand of the Philistines.
chapters.zh: 此后，大卫攻打非利士人，把他们治服，从他们手下夺取了迦特和属迦特的村庄；

chapters.en: David also defeated the Moabites, and they became subject to David and brought him tribute.
chapters.zh: 又攻打摩押，摩押人就归服大卫，给他进贡。

chapters.en: As far as Hamath, David also defeated King Hadadezer of Zobah, who had marched out to establish his dominion along the Euphrates River.
chapters.zh: 琐巴王哈大利谢〔注：在撒母耳下八章三节是哈大底谢〕往幼发拉底河去，要坚定自己的国权，大卫就攻打他，直到哈马，

chapters.en: David captured from him a thousand chariots, seven thousand charioteers, and twenty thousand foot soldiers, and he hamstrung all the horses except a hundred he kept for the chariots.
chapters.zh: 夺了他的战车一千，马兵七千，步兵二万，将拉战车的马砍断蹄筋，但留下一百辆车的马。

chapters.en: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand of their men.
chapters.zh: 大马士革的亚兰人来帮助琐巴王哈大利谢，大卫就杀了亚兰人二万二千。

chapters.en: Then he placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to David and brought him tribute. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
chapters.zh: 于是大卫在大马士革的亚兰地设立〔防营〕，亚兰人就归服他，给他进贡。大卫无论往哪里去，耶和华都使他得胜。

chapters.en: And David took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 他夺了哈大利谢臣仆所拿的金盾牌带到耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: And from Tibhath and Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took a large amount of bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze Sea, the pillars, and various bronze articles.
chapters.zh: 大卫又从属哈大利谢的提巴〔注：或译：比他〕和均二城中夺取了许多的铜。后来所罗门用此制造铜海、铜柱，和一切的铜器。

chapters.en: When King Tou of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
chapters.zh: 哈马王陀乌听见大卫杀败琐巴王哈大利谢的全军，

chapters.en: he sent his son Hadoram to greet King David and bless him for fighting and defeating Hadadezer, who had been at war with Tou. Hadoram brought all kinds of articles of gold and silver and bronze,
chapters.zh: 就打发他儿子哈多兰去见大卫王，问他的安，为他祝福，因为他杀败了哈大利谢（原来陀乌与哈大利谢常常争战）。哈多兰带了金银铜的各样器皿来。

chapters.en: and King David dedicated these to the LORD, along with the silver and gold he had carried off from all these nations—from Edom and Moab, and from the Ammonites, Philistines, and Amalekites.
chapters.zh: 大卫王将这些器皿，并从各国夺来的金银，就是从以东、摩押、亚扪、非利士、亚玛力人所夺来的，都分别为圣献给耶和华。

chapters.en: Moreover, Abishai son of Zeruiah struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
chapters.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子亚比筛在盐谷击杀了以东一万八千人。

chapters.en: He placed garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites were subject to David. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
chapters.zh: 大卫在以东地设立防营，以东人就都归服他。大卫无论往哪里去，耶和华都使他得胜。

chapters.en: Thus David reigned over all Israel and administered justice and righteousness for all his people:
chapters.zh: 大卫作以色列众人的王，又向众民秉公行义。

chapters.en:
Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army;
Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the recorder;
chapters.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押作元帅；亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官；

chapters.en:
Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests;
Shavsha was the scribe;
chapters.zh: 亚希突的儿子撒督和亚比亚他的儿子亚希米勒作祭司〔长〕；沙威沙作书记；

chapters.en:
Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and Pelethites;
and David’s sons were chief officials at the king’s side.
chapters.zh: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅统辖基利提人和比利提人。大卫的众子都在王的左右作领袖。

chapters.en: Some time later, Nahash king of the Ammonites died and was succeeded by his son.
chapters.zh: 此后，亚扪人的王拿辖死了，他儿子接续他作王。

chapters.en:
And David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.”
So David sent messengers to console Hanun concerning his father. But when David’s servants arrived in the land of the Ammonites to console him,
chapters.zh: 大卫说：「我要照哈嫩的父亲拿辖厚待我的恩典厚待哈嫩。」于是大卫差遣使者为他丧父安慰他。大卫的臣仆到了亚扪人的境内见哈嫩，要安慰他，

chapters.en: the princes of the Ammonites said to Hanun, “Just because David has sent you comforters, do you really believe he is showing respect for your father? Have not his servants come to you to explore the land, spy it out, and overthrow it?”
chapters.zh: 但亚扪人的首领对哈嫩说：「大卫差人来安慰你，你想他是尊敬你父亲吗？他的臣仆来见你不是为详察窥探、倾覆这地吗？」

chapters.en: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved their beards, cut off their garments at the hips, and sent them away.
chapters.zh: 哈嫩便将大卫臣仆〔的胡须〕剃去〔一半〕，又割断他们下半截的衣服，使他们露出下体，打发他们回去。

chapters.en: When someone came and told David about his men, he sent messengers to meet them, since the men had been thoroughly humiliated. The king told them, “Stay in Jericho until your beards have grown back, and then return.”
chapters.zh: 有人将臣仆所遇的事告诉大卫，他就差人去迎接他们，因为他们甚觉羞耻；告诉他们说：「可以住在耶利哥，等到胡须长起再回来。」

chapters.en: When the Ammonites realized that they had become a stench to David, Hanun and the Ammonites sent a thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Aram-naharaim, Aram-maacah, and Zobah.
chapters.zh: 亚扪人知道大卫憎恶他们，哈嫩和亚扪人就打发人拿一千他连得银子，从美索不达米亚、亚兰、玛迦、琐巴雇战车和马兵，

chapters.en: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, as well as the king of Maacah with his troops, who came and camped near Medeba while the Ammonites were mustered from their cities and marched out for battle.
chapters.zh: 于是雇了三万二千辆战车和玛迦王并他的军兵；他们来安营在米底巴前。亚扪人也从他们的城里出来，聚集交战。

chapters.en: On hearing this, David sent Joab and the entire army of mighty men.
chapters.zh: 大卫听见了，就差派约押统带勇猛的全军出去。

chapters.en: The Ammonites marched out and arrayed themselves for battle at the entrance to the city, while the kings who had come stayed by themselves in the open country.
chapters.zh: 亚扪人出来在城门前摆阵，所来的诸王另在郊野摆阵。

chapters.en: When Joab saw the battle lines before him and behind him, he selected some of the best men of Israel and arrayed them against the Arameans.
chapters.zh: 约押看见敌人在他前后摆阵，就从以色列军中挑选精兵，使他们对着亚兰人摆阵；

chapters.en: And he placed the rest of the troops under the command of his brother Abishai, who arrayed them against the Ammonites.
chapters.zh: 其余的兵交与他兄弟亚比筛，对着亚扪人摆阵。

chapters.en: “If the Arameans are too strong for me,” said Joab, “then you will come to my rescue. And if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will come to your rescue.
chapters.zh: 约押对亚比筛说：「亚兰人若强过我，你就来帮助我；亚扪人若强过你，我就去帮助你。

chapters.en: Be strong and let us fight bravely for our people and for the cities of our God. May the LORD do what is good in His sight.”
chapters.zh: 我们都当刚强，为本国的民和上帝的城邑作大丈夫，愿耶和华凭他的意旨而行。」

chapters.en: So Joab and his troops advanced to fight the Arameans, who fled before him.
chapters.zh: 于是约押和跟随他的人前进攻打亚兰人；亚兰人在约押面前逃跑。

chapters.en: When the Ammonites saw that the Arameans had fled, they too fled before Joab’s brother Abishai, and they entered the city. So Joab went back to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 亚扪人见亚兰人逃跑，他们也在约押的兄弟亚比筛面前逃跑进城。约押就回耶路撒冷去了。

chapters.en: When the Arameans saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they sent messengers to bring more Arameans from beyond the Euphrates, with Shophach the commander of Hadadezer’s army leading them.
chapters.zh: 亚兰人见自己被以色列人打败，就打发使者将大河那边的亚兰人调来，哈大利谢的将军朔法率领他们。

chapters.en: When this was reported to David, he gathered all Israel, crossed the Jordan, advanced toward the Arameans, and arrayed for battle against them. When David lined up to engage them in battle, they fought against him.
chapters.zh: 有人告诉大卫，他就聚集以色列众人过约旦河，来到亚兰人那里，迎着他们摆阵。大卫既摆阵攻击亚兰人，亚兰人就与他打仗。

chapters.en: But the Arameans fled before Israel, and David killed seven thousand of their charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers. He also killed Shophach the commander of their army.
chapters.zh: 亚兰人在以色列人面前逃跑。大卫杀了亚兰七千辆战车〔的人〕，四万步兵，又杀了亚兰的将军朔法。

chapters.en: When Hadadezer’s subjects saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and became subject to him. So the Arameans were unwilling to help the Ammonites anymore.
chapters.zh: 属哈大利谢〔的诸王〕见自己被以色列人打败，就与大卫和好，归服他。于是亚兰人不敢再帮助亚扪人了。

chapters.en: In the spring, at the time when kings march out to war, Joab led out the army and ravaged the land of the Ammonites. He came to Rabbah and besieged it, but David remained in Jerusalem. And Joab attacked Rabbah and demolished it.
chapters.zh: 过了一年，到列王出战的时候，约押率领军兵毁坏亚扪人的地，围攻拉巴；大卫仍住在耶路撒冷。约押攻打拉巴，将城倾覆。

chapters.en: Then David took the crown from the head of their king. It was found to weigh a talent of gold and was set with precious stones, and it was placed on David’s head. And David took a great amount of plunder from the city.
chapters.zh: 大卫夺了亚扪人之王所戴的金冠冕〔注：王：或译玛勒堪。玛勒堪即米勒公，是亚扪族之神名〕，其上的金子重一他连得，又嵌着宝石；人将这冠冕戴在大卫头上。大卫从城里夺了许多财物，

chapters.en: David brought out the people who were there and put them to work with saws, iron picks, and axes. And he did the same to all the Ammonite cities. Then David and all his troops returned to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 将城里的人拉出来，放在锯下，或铁耙下，或〔铁〕斧下〔注：或译：强他们用锯，或用打粮食的铁器，或用铁斧做工〕，大卫待亚扪各城的居民都是如此。其后大卫和众军都回耶路撒冷去了。

chapters.en: Some time later, war broke out with the Philistines at Gezer. At that time Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, a descendant of the Rephaim, and the Philistines were subdued.
chapters.zh: 后来，以色列人在基色与非利士人打仗。户沙人西比该杀了伟人的一个儿子细派，非利士人就被制伏了。

chapters.en: Once again there was a battle with the Philistines, and Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
chapters.zh: 又与非利士人打仗。睚珥的儿子伊勒哈难杀了迦特人歌利亚的兄弟拉哈米；这人的枪杆粗如织布的机轴。

chapters.en: And there was also a battle at Gath, where there was a man of great stature with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot—twenty-four in all. He too was descended from Rapha,
chapters.zh: 又在迦特打仗。那里有一个身量高大的人，手脚都是六指，共有二十四个指头，他也是伟人的儿子。

chapters.en: and when he taunted Israel, Jonathan the son of David’s brother Shimei killed him.
chapters.zh: 这人向以色列人骂阵，大卫的哥哥示米亚的儿子约拿单就杀了他。

chapters.en: So these descendants of Rapha in Gath fell at the hands of David and his servants.
chapters.zh: 这三个人是迦特伟人的儿子，都死在大卫和他仆人的手下。

chapters.en: Then Satan rose up against Israel and incited David to take a census of Israel.
chapters.zh: 撒但起来攻击以色列人，激动大卫数点他们。

chapters.en: So David said to Joab and the commanders of the troops, “Go and count the Israelites from Beersheba to Dan and bring me a report, so that I may know their number.”
chapters.zh: 大卫就吩咐约押和民中的首领说：「你们去数点以色列人，从别是巴直到但，回来告诉我，我好知道他们的数目。」

chapters.en: But Joab replied, “May the LORD multiply His troops a hundred times over. My lord the king, are they not all servants of my lord? Why does my lord want to do this? Why should he bring guilt on Israel?”
chapters.zh: 约押说：「愿耶和华使他的百姓比现在加增百倍。我主我王啊，他们不都是你的仆人吗？我主为何吩咐行这事，为何使以色列人陷在罪里呢？」

chapters.en: Nevertheless, the king’s word prevailed against Joab. So Joab departed and traveled throughout Israel, and then he returned to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 但王的命令胜过约押。约押就出去，走遍以色列地，回到耶路撒冷，

chapters.en: And Joab reported to David the total number of the troops. In all Israel there were 1,100,000 men who drew the sword, including 470,000 in Judah.
chapters.zh: 将百姓的总数奏告大卫：以色列人拿刀的有一百一十万；犹大人拿刀的有四十七万。

chapters.en: But Joab did not include Levi and Benjamin in the count, because the king’s command was detestable to him.
chapters.zh: 惟有利未人和便雅悯人没有数在其中，因为约押厌恶王的这命令。

chapters.en: This command was also evil in the sight of God; so He struck Israel.
chapters.zh: 上帝不喜悦这数点百姓的事，便降灾给以色列人。

chapters.en: Then David said to God, “I have sinned greatly because I have done this thing. Now I beg You to take away the iniquity of Your servant, for I have acted very foolishly.”
chapters.zh: 大卫祷告上帝说：「我行这事大有罪了！现在求你除掉仆人的罪孽，因我所行的甚是愚昧。」

chapters.en: And the LORD instructed Gad, David’s seer,
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐大卫的先见迦得说：

chapters.en: “Go and tell David that this is what the LORD says: ‘I am offering you three options. Choose one of them, and I will carry it out against you.’”
chapters.zh: 「你去告诉大卫说，耶和华如此说：我有三样灾，随你选择一样，我好降与你。」

chapters.en: So Gad went and said to David, “This is what the LORD says: ‘You must choose
chapters.zh: 于是，迦得来见大卫，对他说：「耶和华如此说：『你可以随意选择：

chapters.en: between three years of famine, three months of being swept away before your enemies and overtaken by their swords, or three days of the sword of the LORD—days of plague upon the land, with the angel of the LORD ravaging every part of Israel.’ Now then, decide how I should reply to Him who sent me.”
chapters.zh: 或三年的饥荒；或败在你敌人面前，被敌人的刀追杀三个月；或在你国中有耶和华的刀，就是三日的瘟疫，耶和华的使者在以色列的四境施行毁灭。』现在你要想一想，我好回复那差我来的。」

chapters.en: David answered Gad, “I am deeply distressed. Please, let me fall into the hand of the LORD, for His mercies are very great; but do not let me fall into the hands of men.”
chapters.zh: 大卫对迦得说：「我甚为难。我愿落在耶和华的手里，因为他有丰盛的怜悯；我不愿落在人的手里。」

chapters.en: So the LORD sent a plague upon Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell dead.
chapters.zh: 于是，耶和华降瘟疫与以色列人，以色列人就死了七万。

chapters.en:
Then God sent an angel to destroy Jerusalem, but as the angel was doing so, the LORD saw it and relented from the calamity, and He said to the angel who was destroying the people, “Enough! Withdraw your hand now!”
At that time the angel of the LORD was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
chapters.zh: 上帝差遣使者去灭耶路撒冷，刚要灭的时候，耶和华看见后悔，就不降这灾了，吩咐灭城的天使说：「够了，住手吧！」那时，耶和华的使者站在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场那里。

chapters.en: When David lifted up his eyes and saw the angel of the LORD standing between heaven and earth, with a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem, David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell facedown.
chapters.zh: 大卫举目，看见耶和华的使者站在天地间，手里有拔出来的刀，伸在耶路撒冷以上。大卫和长老都身穿麻衣，面伏于地。

chapters.en: And David said to God, “Was it not I who gave the order to count the people? I am the one who has sinned and acted wickedly. But these sheep, what have they done? O LORD my God, please let Your hand fall upon me and my father’s house, but do not let this plague remain upon Your people.”
chapters.zh: 大卫祷告上帝说：「吩咐数点百姓的不是我吗？我犯了罪，行了恶，但这群羊做了什么呢？愿耶和华－我上帝的手攻击我和我的父家，不要攻击你的民，降瘟疫与他们。」

chapters.en: Then the angel of the LORD ordered Gad to tell David to go up and build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者吩咐迦得去告诉大卫，叫他上去，在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场上为耶和华筑一座坛；

chapters.en: So David went up at the word that Gad had spoken in the name of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 大卫就照着迦得奉耶和华名所说的话上去了。

chapters.en: Now Ornan was threshing wheat when he turned and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves.
chapters.zh: 那时阿珥楠正打麦子，回头看见天使，就和他四个儿子都藏起来了。

chapters.en: David came to Ornan, and when Ornan looked out and saw David, he left the threshing floor and bowed facedown before David.
chapters.zh: 大卫到了阿珥楠那里，阿珥楠看见大卫，就从禾场上出去，脸伏于地，向他下拜。

chapters.en: Then David said to Ornan, “Grant me the site of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to the LORD. Sell it to me for the full price, so that the plague upon the people may be halted.”
chapters.zh: 大卫对阿珥楠说：「你将这禾场与相连之地卖给我，我必给你足价，我好在其上为耶和华筑一座坛，使民间的瘟疫止住。」

chapters.en: Ornan said to David, “Take it! May my lord the king do whatever seems good to him. Look, I will give the oxen for the burnt offerings, the threshing sledges for the wood, and the wheat for the grain offering—I will give it all.”
chapters.zh: 阿珥楠对大卫说：「你可以用这禾场，愿我主我王照你所喜悦的去行。我也将牛给你作燔祭，把打粮的器具当柴烧，拿麦子作素祭。这些我都送给你。」

chapters.en: “No,” replied King David, “I insist on paying the full price, for I will not take for the LORD what belongs to you, nor will I offer burnt offerings that cost me nothing.”
chapters.zh: 大卫王对阿珥楠说：「不然！我必要用足价向你买。我不用你的物献给耶和华，也不用白得之物献为燔祭。」

chapters.en: So David paid Ornan six hundred shekels of gold for the site.
chapters.zh: 于是大卫为那块地平了六百舍客勒金子给阿珥楠。

chapters.en: And there he built an altar to the LORD and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. He called upon the LORD, who answered him with fire from heaven on the altar of burnt offering.
chapters.zh: 大卫在那里为耶和华筑了一座坛，献燔祭和平安祭，求告耶和华。耶和华就应允他，使火从天降在燔祭坛上。

chapters.en: Then the LORD spoke to the angel, who put his sword back into its sheath.
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐使者，他就收刀入鞘。

chapters.en: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he offered sacrifices there.
chapters.zh: 那时，大卫见耶和华在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场上应允了他，就在那里献祭。

chapters.en: For the tabernacle of the LORD that Moses had made in the wilderness and the altar of burnt offering were presently at the high place in Gibeon,
chapters.zh: 摩西在旷野所造之耶和华的帐幕和燔祭坛都在基遍的高处；

chapters.en: but David could not go before it to inquire of God, because he was afraid of the sword of the angel of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 只是大卫不敢前去求问上帝，因为惧怕耶和华使者的刀。

chapters.en: Then David said, “Here shall be the house of the LORD God, as well as the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”
chapters.zh: 大卫说：「这就是耶和华上帝的殿，为以色列人献燔祭的坛。」

chapters.en: So David gave orders to gather the foreigners in the land of Israel, from whom he appointed stonecutters to prepare finished stones for building the house of God.
chapters.zh: 大卫吩咐聚集住以色列地的外邦人，从其中派石匠凿石头，要建造上帝的殿。

chapters.en: David provided a large quantity of iron to make the nails for the doors of the gateways and for the fittings, together with more bronze than could be weighed
chapters.zh: 大卫预备许多铁做门上的钉子和钩子，又预备许多铜，多得无法可称；

chapters.en: and more cedar logs than could be counted; for the Sidonians and Tyrians had brought a large quantity of cedar logs to David.
chapters.zh: 又预备无数的香柏木，因为西顿人和泰尔人给大卫运了许多香柏木来。

chapters.en: And David said, “My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent—famous and glorious throughout all lands. Therefore I must make preparations for it.” So David made lavish preparations before his death.
chapters.zh: 大卫说：「我儿子所罗门还年幼娇嫩，要为耶和华建造的殿宇必须高大辉煌，使名誉荣耀传遍万国；所以我要为殿预备材料。」于是，大卫在未死之先预备的材料甚多。

chapters.en: Then David called for his son Solomon and instructed him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 大卫召了他儿子所罗门来，嘱咐他给耶和华－以色列的上帝建造殿宇，

chapters.en: “My son,” said David to Solomon, “it was in my heart to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God,
chapters.zh: 对所罗门说：「我儿啊，我心里本想为耶和华－我上帝的名建造殿宇，

chapters.en: but this word of the LORD came to me: ‘You have shed much blood and waged great wars. You are not to build a house for My Name because you have shed so much blood on the ground before Me.
chapters.zh: 只是耶和华的话临到我说：『你流了多人的血，打了多次大仗，你不可为我的名建造殿宇，因为你在我眼前使多人的血流在地上。

chapters.en: But a son will be born to you who will be a man of rest. I will give him rest from all his enemies on every side; for his name will be Solomon, and I will grant to Israel peace and quiet during his reign.
chapters.zh: 你要生一个儿子，他必作太平的人；我必使他安静，不被四围的仇敌扰乱。他的名要叫所罗门〔注：就是太平的意思〕。他在位的日子，我必使以色列人平安康泰。

chapters.en: He is the one who will build a house for My Name. He will be My son, and I will be his Father. And I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’
chapters.zh: 他必为我的名建造殿宇。他要作我的子；我要作他的父。他作以色列王；我必坚定他的国位，直到永远。』

chapters.en: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you, and may you succeed in building the house of the LORD your God, as He said you would.
chapters.zh: 我儿啊，现今愿耶和华与你同在，使你亨通，照他指着你说的话，建造耶和华－你上帝的殿。

chapters.en: Above all, may the LORD give you insight and understanding when He puts you in command over Israel, so that you may keep the Law of the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 但愿耶和华赐你聪明智慧，好治理以色列国，遵行耶和华－你上帝的律法。

chapters.en: Then you will succeed, if you carefully follow the statutes and ordinances that the LORD commanded Moses for Israel. Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or discouraged.
chapters.zh: 你若谨守遵行耶和华藉摩西吩咐以色列的律例典章，就得亨通。你当刚强壮胆，不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。

chapters.en: Now behold, I have taken great pains to provide for the house of the LORD—100,000 talents of gold, 1,000,000 talents of silver, and bronze and iron too great to be weighed. I have also provided timber and stone, and you may add to them.
chapters.zh: 我在困难之中为耶和华的殿预备了金子十万他连得，银子一百万他连得，铜和铁多得无法可称；我也预备了木头、石头，你还可以增添。

chapters.en: You also have many workers: stonecutters, masons, carpenters, and men skilled in every kind of work—
chapters.zh: 你有许多匠人，就是石匠、木匠，和一切能做各样工的巧匠，

chapters.en: in gold and silver, bronze and iron—craftsmen beyond number. Now begin the work, and may the LORD be with you.”
chapters.zh: 并有无数的金银铜铁。你当起来办事，愿耶和华与你同在。」

chapters.en: Then David ordered all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon:
chapters.zh: 大卫又吩咐以色列的众首领帮助他儿子所罗门，〔说〕：

chapters.en: “Is not the LORD your God with you, and has He not granted you rest on every side? For He has given the inhabitants of the land into my hand, and the land has been subdued before the LORD and His people.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华－你们的上帝不是与你们同在吗？不是叫你们四围都平安吗？因他已将这地的居民交在我手中，这地就在耶和华与他百姓面前制伏了。

chapters.en: Now set your heart and soul to seek the LORD your God. Begin building the sanctuary of the LORD God, so that you may bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD and the holy articles of God into the temple that will be built for the Name of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 现在你们应当立定心意，寻求耶和华－你们的神；也当起来建造耶和华上帝的圣所，好将耶和华的约柜和供奉上帝的圣器皿都搬进为耶和华名建造的殿里。」

chapters.en: When David was old and full of years, he installed his son Solomon as king over Israel.
chapters.zh: 大卫年纪老迈，日子满足，就立他儿子所罗门作以色列的王。

chapters.en: Then he gathered all the leaders of Israel, as well as the priests and Levites.
chapters.zh: 大卫招聚以色列的众首领和祭司利未人。

chapters.en: The Levites thirty years of age or older were counted, and the total number of men was 38,000.
chapters.zh: 利未人从三十岁以外的都被数点，他们男丁的数目共有三万八千；

chapters.en: “Of these,” said David, “24,000 are to oversee the work of the house of the LORD, 6,000 are to be officers and judges,
chapters.zh: 其中有二万四千人管理耶和华殿的事，有六千人作官长和士师，

chapters.en: 4,000 are to be gatekeepers, and 4,000 are to praise the LORD with the instruments I have made for giving praise.”
chapters.zh: 有四千人作守门的，又有四千人用大卫所做的乐器颂赞耶和华。

chapters.en:
Then David divided the Levites into divisions according to the sons of Levi:
Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
chapters.zh: 大卫将利未人革顺、哥辖、米拉利的子孙分了班次。

chapters.en: The Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
chapters.zh: 革顺的子孙有拉但和示每。

chapters.en: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the first, Zetham, and Joel—three in all.
chapters.zh: 拉但的长子是耶歇，还有细坦和约珥，共三人。

chapters.en: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran—three in all. These were the heads of the families of Ladan.
chapters.zh: 示每的儿子是示罗密、哈薛、哈兰三人。这是拉但族的族长。

chapters.en: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These were the sons of Shimei—four in all.
chapters.zh: 示每的儿子是雅哈、细拿、耶乌施、比利亚共四人。

chapters.en: Jahath was the first and Zizah was the second; but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons, so they were counted as one family and received a single assignment.
chapters.zh: 雅哈是长子，细撒是次子。但耶乌施和比利亚的子孙不多，所以算为一族。

chapters.en: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel—four in all.
chapters.zh: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛共四人。

chapters.en: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were set apart forever to consecrate the most holy things, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister before Him, and to pronounce blessings in His name forever.
chapters.zh: 暗兰的儿子是亚伦、摩西。亚伦和他的子孙分出来，好分别至圣的物，在耶和华面前烧香、事奉他，奉他的名祝福，直到永远。

chapters.en: As for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.
chapters.zh: 至于神人摩西，他的子孙名字记在利未支派的册上。

chapters.en: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
chapters.zh: 摩西的儿子是革舜和以利以谢。

chapters.en: The descendants of Gershom: Shebuel was the first.
chapters.zh: 革舜的长子是细布业；

chapters.en: The descendants of Eliezer: Rehabiah was the first. Eliezer did not have any other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very numerous.
chapters.zh: 以利以谢的儿子是利哈比雅。以利以谢没有别的儿子，但利哈比雅的子孙甚多。

chapters.en: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith was the first.
chapters.zh: 以斯哈的长子是示罗密。

chapters.en: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah was the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
chapters.zh: 希伯伦的长子是耶利雅，次子是亚玛利亚，三子是雅哈悉，四子是耶加面。

chapters.en: The sons of Uzziel: Micah was the first and Isshiah the second.
chapters.zh: 乌薛的长子是米迦，次子是耶西雅。

chapters.en:
The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi.
The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
chapters.zh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利、母示。抹利的儿子是以利亚撒、基士。

chapters.en: Eleazar died without having any sons; he had only daughters. Their cousins, the sons of Kish, married them.
chapters.zh: 以利亚撒死了，没有儿子，只有女儿，他们本族基士的儿子娶了她们为妻。

chapters.en: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth —three in all.
chapters.zh: 母示的儿子是末力、以得、耶利摩共三人。

chapters.en: These were the descendants of Levi by their families—the heads of families, registered individually by name—those twenty years of age or older who worked in the service of the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以上利未子孙作族长的，照着男丁的数目，从二十岁以外，都办耶和华殿的事务。

chapters.en: For David had said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to His people and has come to dwell in Jerusalem forever.
chapters.zh: 大卫说：「耶和华－以色列的上帝已经使他的百姓平安，他永远住在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: So now the Levites no longer need to carry the tabernacle or any of the articles for its service.”
chapters.zh: 利未人不必再抬帐幕和其中所用的一切器皿了。」

chapters.en: For according to the final instructions of David, the Levites twenty years of age or older were counted,
chapters.zh: 照着大卫临终所吩咐的，利未人从二十岁以外的都被数点。

chapters.en: but their duty was to assist the descendants of Aaron with the service of the house of the LORD, being responsible for the courts and chambers, the purification of all the holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God,
chapters.zh: 他们的职任是服事亚伦的子孙，在耶和华的殿和院子，并屋中办事，洁净一切圣物，就是办上帝殿的事务，

chapters.en: as well as for the rows of the showbread, the fine flour for the grain offering, the wafers of unleavened bread, the baking, the mixing, and all measurements of quantity and size.
chapters.zh: 并管理陈设饼，素祭的细面，或无酵薄饼，或用盘烤，或用油调和的物，又管理各样的升斗尺度；

chapters.en: They were also to stand every morning to give thanks and praise to the LORD, and likewise in the evening.
chapters.zh: 每日早晚，站立称谢赞美耶和华，

chapters.en: Whenever burnt offerings were presented to the LORD on the Sabbaths, New Moons, and appointed feasts, they were to serve regularly before the LORD in the numbers prescribed for them.
chapters.zh: 又在安息日、月朔，并节期，按数照例，将燔祭常常献给耶和华；

chapters.en: So the Levites were to carry out the responsibilities for the Tent of Meeting and the Holy Place, and, under their brothers the descendants of Aaron, the service of the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 又看守会幕和圣所，并守〔耶和华〕吩咐他们弟兄亚伦子孙的，办耶和华殿的事。

chapters.en: These were the divisions of the descendants of Aaron. The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
chapters.zh: 亚伦子孙的班次记在下面：亚伦的儿子是拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。

chapters.en: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father did, and they had no sons; so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
chapters.zh: 拿答、亚比户死在他们父亲之先，没有留下儿子；故此，以利亚撒、以他玛供祭司的职分。

chapters.en: With the help of Eleazar’s descendant Zadok and Ithamar’s descendant Ahimelech, David divided them according to the offices of their service.
chapters.zh: 以利亚撒的子孙撒督和以他玛的子孙亚希米勒，同着大卫将他们的族弟兄分成班次。

chapters.en: Since more leaders were found among Eleazar’s descendants than those of Ithamar, they were divided accordingly. There were sixteen heads of families from the descendants of Eleazar and eight from the descendants of Ithamar.
chapters.zh: 以利亚撒子孙中为首的比以他玛子孙中为首的更多，分班如下：以利亚撒的子孙中有十六个族长，以他玛的子孙中有八个族长；

chapters.en: Thus they were divided by lot, for there were officers of the sanctuary and officers of God among both Eleazar’s and Ithamar’s descendants.
chapters.zh: 都掣签分立，彼此一样。在圣所和上帝面前作首领的有以利亚撒的子孙，也有以他玛的子孙。

chapters.en: The scribe, Shemaiah son of Nethanel, a Levite, recorded their names in the presence of the king and of the officers: Zadok the priest, Ahimelech son of Abiathar, and the heads of families of the priests and the Levites—one family being taken from Eleazar, and then one from Ithamar.
chapters.zh: 作书记的利未人拿坦业的儿子示玛雅在王和首领，与祭司撒督、亚比亚他的儿子亚希米勒，并祭司利未人的族长面前记录他们的名字。在以利亚撒的子孙中取一族，在以他玛的子孙中取一族。

chapters.en:
The first lot fell to Jehoiarib,
the second to Jedaiah,
chapters.zh: 掣签的时候，第一掣出来的是耶何雅立，第二是耶大雅，

chapters.en:
the third to Harim,
the fourth to Seorim,
chapters.zh: 第三是哈琳，第四是梭琳，

chapters.en:
the fifth to Malchijah,
the sixth to Mijamin,
chapters.zh: 第五是玛基雅，第六是米雅民，

chapters.en:
the seventh to Hakkoz,
the eighth to Abijah,
chapters.zh: 第七是哈歌斯，第八是亚比雅，

chapters.en:
the ninth to Jeshua,
the tenth to Shecaniah,
chapters.zh: 第九是耶书亚，第十是示迦尼，

chapters.en:
the eleventh to Eliashib,
the twelfth to Jakim,
chapters.zh: 第十一是以利亚实，第十二是雅金，

chapters.en:
the thirteenth to Huppah,
the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
chapters.zh: 第十三是胡巴，第十四是耶是比押，

chapters.en:
the fifteenth to Bilgah,
the sixteenth to Immer,
chapters.zh: 第十五是璧迦，第十六是音麦，

chapters.en:
the seventeenth to Hezir,
the eighteenth to Happizzez,
chapters.zh: 第十七是希悉，第十八是哈辟悉，

chapters.en:
the nineteenth to Pethahiah,
the twentieth to Jehezkel,
chapters.zh: 第十九是毗他希雅，第二十是以西结，

chapters.en:
the twenty-first to Jachin,
the twenty-second to Gamul,
chapters.zh: 第二十一是雅斤，第二十二是迦末，

chapters.en:
the twenty-third to Delaiah,
and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
chapters.zh: 第二十三是第来雅，第二十四是玛西亚。

chapters.en: This was their appointed order for service when they entered the house of the LORD, according to the regulations prescribed for them by their forefather Aaron, as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
chapters.zh: 这就是他们的班次，要照耶和华－以色列的上帝藉他们祖宗亚伦所吩咐的条例进入耶和华的殿办理事务。
利未其余的子孙如下：暗兰的子孙里有书巴业；书巴业的子孙里有耶希底亚。

chapters.en: As for Rehabiah, from his sons: The first was Isshiah.
chapters.zh: 利哈比雅的子孙里有长子伊示雅。

chapters.en:
From the Izharites: Shelomoth;
from the sons of Shelomoth: Jahath.
chapters.zh: 以斯哈的子孙里有示罗摩；示罗摩的子孙里有雅哈。

chapters.en: From the sons of Hebron: Jeriah was the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
chapters.zh: 〔希伯伦的〕子孙里有〔长子〕耶利雅，次子亚玛利亚，三子雅哈悉，四子耶加面。

chapters.en:
From the sons of Uzziel: Micah;
from the sons of Micah: Shamir.
chapters.zh: 乌薛的子孙里有米迦；米迦的子孙里有沙密。

chapters.en:
The brother of Micah: Isshiah;
from the sons of Isshiah: Zechariah.
chapters.zh: 米迦的兄弟是伊示雅；伊示雅的子孙里有撒迦利雅。

chapters.en:
The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi.
The son of Jaaziah: Beno.
chapters.zh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利、母示、〔雅西雅〕；雅西雅的儿子有比挪；

chapters.en: The descendants of Merari from Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
chapters.zh: 米拉利的子孙里有雅西雅的儿子比挪、朔含、撒刻、伊比利。
