chapters.en: From Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
chapters.zh: 抹利的儿子是以利亚撒；以利亚撒没有儿子。

chapters.en: From Kish: Jerahmeel the son of Kish.
chapters.zh: 基士的子孙里有耶拉篾。

chapters.en:
And the sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth.
These were the sons of the Levites, according to their families.
chapters.zh: 母示的儿子是末力、以得、耶利摩。按着宗族这都是利未的子孙。

chapters.en: As their brothers the descendants of Aaron did, they also cast lots in the presence of King David and of Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the families of the priests and Levites—the family heads and their younger brothers alike.
chapters.zh: 他们在大卫王和撒督，并亚希米勒与祭司利未人的族长面前掣签，正如他们弟兄亚伦的子孙一般。各族的长者与兄弟没有分别。

chapters.en: Additionally, David and the commanders of the army set apart some of the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to prophesy with the accompaniment of lyres, harps, and cymbals. The following is the list of the men who performed this service:
chapters.zh: 大卫和众首领分派亚萨、希幔，并耶杜顿的子孙弹琴、鼓瑟、敲钹、唱歌〔注：原文是说预言；本章同〕。他们供职的人数记在下面：

chapters.en: From the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah. These sons of Asaph were under the direction of Asaph, who prophesied under the direction of the king.
chapters.zh: 亚萨的儿子撒刻、约瑟、尼探雅、亚萨利拉都归亚萨指教，遵王的旨意唱歌。

chapters.en: From the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah—six in all—under the direction of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with the harp, giving thanks and praise to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶杜顿的儿子基大利、西利、耶筛亚、哈沙比雅、玛他提雅、示每共六人，都归他们父亲耶杜顿指教，弹琴，唱歌，称谢，颂赞耶和华。

chapters.en: From the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.
chapters.zh: 希幔的儿子布基雅、玛探雅、乌薛、细布业、耶利摩、哈拿尼雅、哈拿尼、以利亚他、基大利提、罗幔提‧以谢、约施比加沙、玛罗提、何提、玛哈秀；

chapters.en: All these sons of Heman the king’s seer were given him through the promises of God to exalt him, for God had given Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
chapters.zh: 这都是希幔的儿子，吹角颂赞。希幔奉上帝之命作王的先见。上帝赐给希幔十四个儿子，三个女儿，

chapters.en:
All these were under the direction of their fathers for the music of the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps, and lyres, for the service of the house of God.
Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman were under the direction of the king.
chapters.zh: 都归他们父亲指教，在耶和华的殿唱歌、敲钹、弹琴、鼓瑟，办上帝殿的事务。亚萨、耶杜顿、希幔都是王所命定的。

chapters.en: Together with their relatives, who were all trained and skillful in the songs of the LORD, they numbered 288.
chapters.zh: 他们和他们的弟兄学习颂赞耶和华；善于歌唱的共有二百八十八人。

chapters.en: They cast lots for their duties, young and old alike, teacher as well as pupil.
chapters.zh: 这些人无论大小，为师的、为徒的，都一同掣签分了班次。

chapters.en:
The first lot, which was for Asaph, fell to Joseph, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
the second to Gedaliah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 掣签的时候，第一掣出来的是亚萨的儿子约瑟。第二是基大利；他和他弟兄并儿子共十二人。

chapters.en: the third to Zaccur, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第三是撒刻；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the fourth to Izri, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第四是伊洗利；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第五是尼探雅；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第六是布基雅；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the seventh to Jesarelah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第七是耶萨利拉；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第八是耶筛亚；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第九是玛探雅；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the tenth to Shimei, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第十是示每；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第十一是亚萨烈；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第十二是哈沙比雅；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the thirteenth to Shubael, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第十三是书巴业；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the fourteenth to Mattithiah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第十四是玛他提雅；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第十五是耶利摩；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第十六是哈拿尼雅；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第十七是约施比加沙；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第十八是哈拿尼；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第十九是玛罗提；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第二十是以利亚他；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第二十一是何提；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第二十二是基大利提；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
chapters.zh: 第二十三是玛哈秀；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en: and the twenty-fourth to Romamti-ezer, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all.
chapters.zh: 第二十四是罗幔提‧以谢；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。

chapters.en:
These were the divisions of the gatekeepers:
From the Korahites: Meshelemiah son of Kore, one of the sons of Asaph.
chapters.zh: 守门的班次记在下面：可拉族亚萨的子孙中，有可利的儿子米施利米雅。

chapters.en: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
chapters.zh: 米施利米雅的长子是撒迦利亚，次子是耶叠，三子是西巴第雅，四子是耶提聂，

chapters.en: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.
chapters.zh: 五子是以拦，六子是约哈难，七子是以利约乃。

chapters.en: And Obed-edom also had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sachar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,
chapters.zh: 俄别‧以东的长子是示玛雅，次子是约萨拔，三子是约亚，四子是沙甲，五子是拿坦业，

chapters.en: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth. For God had blessed Obed-edom.
chapters.zh: 六子是亚米利，七子是以萨迦，八子是毗乌利太，因为上帝赐福与俄别‧以东。

chapters.en: Also to his son Shemaiah were born sons who ruled over their families because they were strong, capable men.
chapters.zh: 他的儿子示玛雅有几个儿子，都是大能的壮士，掌管父亲的家。

chapters.en: Shemaiah’s sons were Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad; his brothers were Elihu and Semachiah, also capable men.
chapters.zh: 示玛雅的儿子是俄得尼、利法益、俄备得、以利萨巴。以利萨巴的弟兄是壮士，还有以利户和西玛迦。

chapters.en: All these were descendants of Obed-edom; they and their sons and brothers were capable men with strength to do the work—62 in all from Obed-edom.
chapters.zh: 这都是俄别‧以东的子孙，他们和他们的儿子并弟兄，都是善于办事的壮士。俄别‧以东的子孙共六十二人。

chapters.en: Meshelemiah also had sons and brothers who were capable men—18 in all.
chapters.zh: 米施利米雅的儿子和弟兄都是壮士，共十八人。

chapters.en: Hosah the Merarite also had sons: Shimri the first (although he was not the firstborn, his father had appointed him as the first),
chapters.zh: 米拉利子孙何萨有几个儿子：长子是申利，他原不是长子，是他父亲立他作长子。

chapters.en: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. The sons and brothers of Hosah numbered 13 in all.
chapters.zh: 次子是希勒家，三子是底巴利雅，四子是撒迦利亚。何萨的儿子并弟兄共十三人。

chapters.en: These divisions of the gatekeepers, through their chief men, had duties for ministering in the house of the LORD, just as their relatives did.
chapters.zh: 这些人都是守门的班长，与他们的弟兄一同在耶和华殿里按班供职。

chapters.en: They cast lots for each gate, according to their families, young and old alike.
chapters.zh: 他们无论大小，都按着宗族掣签分守各门。

chapters.en:
The lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemiah.
Then lots were cast for his son Zechariah, a wise counselor, and the lot for the North Gate fell to him.
chapters.zh: 掣签守东门的是示利米雅；他的儿子撒迦利亚是精明的谋士，掣签守北门。

chapters.en: The lot for the South Gate fell to Obed-edom, and the lot for the storehouses to his sons.
chapters.zh: 俄别‧以东守南门，他的儿子守库房。

chapters.en:
The lots for the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the ascending highway fell to Shuppim and Hosah.
There were guards stationed at every watch.
chapters.zh: 书聘与何萨守西门，在靠近沙利基门、通着往上去的街道上，班与班相对。

chapters.en: Each day there were six Levites on the east, four on the north, four on the south, and two pairs at the storehouse.
chapters.zh: 每日东门有六个利未人，北门有四个，南门有四个，库房有两个，又有两个轮班替换。

chapters.en: As for the court on the west, there were four at the highway and two at the court.
chapters.zh: 在西面街道上有四个，在游廊上有两个。

chapters.en: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers who were descendants of Korah and Merari.
chapters.zh: 以上是可拉子孙和米拉利子孙守门的班次。

chapters.en: Now their fellow Levites were in charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries of the dedicated things.
chapters.zh: 利未子孙中有亚希雅掌管上帝殿的府库和圣物的府库。

chapters.en: From the descendants of Ladan, who were Gershonites through Ladan and heads of the families of Ladan the Gershonite, were Jehieli,
chapters.zh: 革顺族、拉但子孙里，作族长的是革顺族拉但的子孙耶希伊利。

chapters.en: the sons of Jehieli, Zetham, and his brother Joel. They were in charge of the treasuries of the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶希伊利的儿子西坦和他兄弟约珥掌管耶和华殿里的府库。

chapters.en: From the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
chapters.zh: 暗兰族、以斯哈族、希伯伦族、乌泄族〔也有职分〕。

chapters.en: Shebuel, a descendant of Gershom son of Moses, was the officer in charge of the treasuries.
chapters.zh: 摩西的孙子、革舜的儿子细布业掌管府库。

chapters.en: His relatives through Eliezer included Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
chapters.zh: 还有他的弟兄以利以谢。以利以谢的儿子是利哈比雅；利哈比雅的儿子是耶筛亚；耶筛亚的儿子是约兰；约兰的儿子是细基利；细基利的儿子是示罗密。

chapters.en: This Shelomith and his brothers were in charge of all the treasuries for the things dedicated by King David, by the heads of families who were the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and by the army commanders.
chapters.zh: 这示罗密和他的弟兄掌管府库的圣物，就是大卫王和众族长、千夫长、百夫长，并军长所分别为圣的物。

chapters.en: They had dedicated some of the plunder from their battles to the repair of the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们将争战时所夺的财物分别为圣，以备修造耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: Everything that had been dedicated by Samuel the seer, Saul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner, and Joab son of Zeruiah, along with everything else that was dedicated, was under the care of Shelomith and his brothers.
chapters.zh: 先见撒母耳、基士的儿子扫罗、尼珥的儿子押尼珥、洗鲁雅的儿子约押所分别为圣的物都归示罗密和他的弟兄掌管。

chapters.en: From the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons had the outside duties as officers and judges over Israel.
chapters.zh: 以斯哈族有基拿尼雅和他众子作官长和士师，管理以色列的外事。

chapters.en: From the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his relatives, 1,700 capable men, had charge of the affairs of Israel west of the Jordan for all the work of the LORD and for the service of the king.
chapters.zh: 希伯伦族有哈沙比雅和他弟兄一千七百人，都是壮士，在约旦河西、以色列地办理耶和华与王的事。

chapters.en: As for the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to the genealogies of his ancestors. In the fortieth year of David’s reign the records were searched, and strong, capable men were found among the Hebronites at Jazer in Gilead.
chapters.zh: 希伯伦族中有耶利雅作族长。大卫作王第四十年，在基列的雅谢，从这族中寻得大能的勇士。

chapters.en: Among Jerijah’s relatives there were 2,700 capable men who were heads of families. King David appointed them over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.
chapters.zh: 耶利雅的弟兄有二千七百人，都是壮士，且作族长；大卫王派他们在吕便支派、迦得支派、玛拿西半支派中办理上帝和王的事。

chapters.en: This is the list of the Israelites—the heads of families, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in every matter concerning the divisions on rotating military duty each month throughout the year. There were 24,000 men in each division:
chapters.zh: 以色列人的族长、千夫长、百夫长，和官长都分定班次，每班是二万四千人，周年按月轮流，替换出入服事王。

chapters.en: Jashobeam son of Zabdiel was in charge of the first division, which was assigned the first month. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.zh: 正月第一班的班长是撒巴第业的儿子雅朔班；他班内有二万四千人。

chapters.en: He was a descendant of Perez and chief of all the army commanders for the first month.
chapters.zh: 他是法勒斯的子孙，统管正月〔班〕的一切军长。

chapters.en: Dodai the Ahohite was in charge of the division for the second month, and Mikloth was the leader. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.zh: 二月的班长是亚哈希人朵代，还有副官密基罗；他班内有二万四千人。

chapters.en: The third army commander, as chief for the third month, was Benaiah son of Jehoiada the priest. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.zh: 三月第三班的班长〔注：原文是军长；下同〕是祭司耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅；他班内有二万四千人。

chapters.en: This Benaiah was mighty among the Thirty and was over the Thirty, and his son Ammizabad was in charge of his division.
chapters.zh: 这比拿雅是那三十人中的勇士，管理那三十人；他班内又有他儿子暗米萨拔。

chapters.en: The fourth, for the fourth month, was Joab’s brother Asahel, and his son Zebadiah was commander after him. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.zh: 四月第四班的班长是约押的兄弟亚撒黑。接续他的是他儿子西巴第雅；他班内有二万四千人。

chapters.en: The fifth, for the fifth month, was the commander Shamhuth the Izrahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.zh: 五月第五班的班长是伊斯拉人珊合；他班内有二万四千人。

chapters.en: The sixth, for the sixth month, was Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.zh: 六月第六班的班长是提哥亚人益吉的儿子以拉；他班内有二万四千人。

chapters.en: The seventh, for the seventh month, was Helez the Pelonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.zh: 七月第七班的班长是以法莲族比伦人希利斯；他班内有二万四千人。

chapters.en: The eighth, for the eighth month, was Sibbecai the Hushathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.zh: 八月第八班的班长是谢拉族户沙人西比该；他班内有二万四千人。

chapters.en: The ninth, for the ninth month, was Abiezer the Anathothite, a Benjamite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.zh: 九月第九班的班长是便雅悯族亚拿突人亚比以谢；他班内有二万四千人。

chapters.en: The tenth, for the tenth month, was Maharai the Netophathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.zh: 十月第十班的班长是谢拉族尼陀法人玛哈莱；他班内有二万四千人。

chapters.en: The eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Benaiah the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.zh: 十一月第十一班的班长是以法莲族比拉顿人比拿雅；他班内有二万四千人。

chapters.en: The twelfth, for the twelfth month, was Heldai the Netophathite, from the family of Othniel. There were 24,000 men in his division.
chapters.zh: 十二月第十二班的班长是俄陀聂族尼陀法人黑玳；他班内有二万四千人。
管理以色列众支派的记在下面：管吕便人的是细基利的儿子以利以谢；管西缅人的是玛迦的儿子示法提雅；

chapters.en:
over Levi was Hashabiah son of Kemuel;
over Aaron was Zadok;
chapters.zh: 管利未人的是基母利的儿子哈沙比雅；管亚伦子孙的是撒督；

chapters.en:
over Judah was Elihu, one of David’s brothers;
over Issachar was Omri son of Michael;
chapters.zh: 管犹大人的是大卫的一个哥哥以利户；管以萨迦人的是米迦勒的儿子暗利；

chapters.en:
over Zebulun was Ishmaiah son of Obadiah;
over Naphtali was Jerimoth son of Azriel;
chapters.zh: 管西布伦人的是俄巴第雅的儿子伊施玛雅；管拿弗他利人的是亚斯列的儿子耶利摩；

chapters.en:
over the Ephraimites was Hoshea son of Azaziah;
over one of the half-tribes of Manasseh was Joel son of Pedaiah;
chapters.zh: 管以法莲人的是阿撒细雅的儿子何细亚；管玛拿西半支派的是毗大雅的儿子约珥；

chapters.en:
over the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead was Iddo son of Zechariah;
over Benjamin was Jaasiel son of Abner;
chapters.zh: 管基列地玛拿西那半支派的是撒迦利亚的儿子易多；管便雅悯人的是押尼珥的儿子雅西业；

chapters.en:
and over Dan was Azarel son of Jeroham.
These were the leaders of the tribes of Israel.
chapters.zh: 管但人的是耶罗罕的儿子亚萨列。以上是以色列众支派的首领。

chapters.en: David did not count the men aged twenty or under, because the LORD had said that He would make Israel as numerous as the stars of the sky.
chapters.zh: 以色列人二十岁以内的，大卫没有记其数目；因耶和华曾应许说，必加增以色列人如天上的星那样多。

chapters.en: Joab son of Zeruiah began to count the men but did not finish. For because of this census wrath came upon Israel, and the number was not entered in the Book of the Chronicles of King David.
chapters.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押动手数点，当时〔耶和华〕的烈怒临到以色列人；因此，没有点完，数目也没有写在大卫王记上。

chapters.en:
Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the royal storehouses.
Jonathan son of Uzziah was in charge of the storehouses in the country, in the cities, in the villages, and in the fortresses.
chapters.zh: 掌管王府库的是亚叠的儿子押斯马威。掌管田野城邑村庄保障之仓库的是乌西雅的儿子约拿单。

chapters.en: Ezri son of Chelub was in charge of the workers in the fields who tilled the soil.
chapters.zh: 掌管耕田种地的是基绿的儿子以斯利。

chapters.en:
Shimei the Ramathite was in charge of the vineyards.
Zabdi the Shiphmite was in charge of the produce of the vineyards for the wine vats.
chapters.zh: 掌管葡萄园的是拉玛人示每。掌管葡萄园酒窖的是实弗米人撒巴底。

chapters.en:
Baal-hanan the Gederite was in charge of the olive and sycamore trees in the foothills.
Joash was in charge of the stores of olive oil.
chapters.zh: 掌管高原橄榄树和桑树的是基第利人巴勒‧哈南。掌管油库的是约阿施。

chapters.en:
Shitrai the Sharonite was in charge of the herds grazing in Sharon.
Shaphat son of Adlai was in charge of the herds in the valleys.
chapters.zh: 掌管沙崙牧放牛群的是沙崙人施提赉。掌管山谷牧养牛群的是亚第赉的儿子沙法。

chapters.en:
Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels.
Jehdeiah the Meronothite was in charge of the donkeys.
chapters.zh: 掌管驼〔群〕的是以实玛利人阿比勒。掌管驴〔群〕的是米崙人耶希底亚。掌管羊群的是夏甲人雅悉。

chapters.en:
Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the flocks.
All these officials were in charge of King David’s property.
chapters.zh: 这都是给大卫王掌管产业的。

chapters.en:
David’s uncle Jonathan was a counselor; he was a man of insight and a scribe.
Jehiel son of Hachmoni attended to the sons of the king.
chapters.zh: 大卫的叔叔约拿单作谋士；这人有智慧，又作书记。哈摩尼的儿子耶歇作王众子的师傅。

chapters.en:
Ahithophel was the king’s counselor.
Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.
chapters.zh: 亚希多弗也作王的谋士。亚基人户筛作王的陪伴。

chapters.en:
Ahithophel was succeeded by Jehoiada son of Benaiah, then by Abiathar.
Joab was the commander of the king’s army.
chapters.zh: 亚希多弗之后，有比拿雅的儿子耶何耶大和亚比亚他接续他〔作谋士〕。约押作王的元帅。

chapters.en: Now David summoned all the leaders of Israel to Jerusalem: the leaders of the tribes, the leaders of the divisions in the king’s service, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and the officials in charge of all the property and cattle of the king and his sons, along with the court officials and mighty men—every mighty man of valor.
chapters.zh: 大卫招聚以色列各支派的首领和轮班服事王的军长，与千夫长、百夫长，掌管王和王子产业牲畜的，并太监，以及大能的勇士，都到耶路撒冷来。

chapters.en: Then King David rose to his feet and said, “Listen to me, my brothers and my people. It was in my heart to build a house as a resting place for the ark of the covenant of the LORD and as a footstool for our God. I had made preparations to build it,
chapters.zh: 大卫王就站起来，说：「我的弟兄，我的百姓啊，你们当听我言，我心里本想建造殿宇，安放耶和华的约柜，作为我上帝的脚凳；我已经预备建造的材料。

chapters.en: but God said to me, ‘You are not to build a house for My Name, because you are a man of war who has shed blood.’
chapters.zh: 只是上帝对我说：『你不可为我的名建造殿宇；因你是战士，流了人的血。』

chapters.en: Yet the LORD, the God of Israel, chose me out of all my father’s house to be king over Israel forever. For He chose Judah as leader, and from the house of Judah He chose my father’s household, and from my father’s sons He was pleased to make me king over all Israel.
chapters.zh: 然而，耶和华－以色列的上帝在我父的全家拣选我作以色列的王，直到永远。因他拣选犹大为首领；在犹大支派中拣选我父家，在我父的众子里喜悦我，立我作以色列众人的王。

chapters.en: And of all my sons—for the LORD has given me many sons—He has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.
chapters.zh: 耶和华赐我许多儿子，在我儿子中拣选所罗门坐耶和华的国位，治理以色列人。

chapters.en: And He said to me, ‘Solomon your son is the one who will build My house and My courts, for I have chosen him as My son, and I will be his Father.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说：『你儿子所罗门必建造我的殿和院宇；因为我拣选他作我的子，我也必作他的父。

chapters.en: I will establish his kingdom forever, if he resolutely carries out My commandments and ordinances, as is being done this day.’
chapters.zh: 他若恒久遵行我的诫命典章如今日一样，我就必坚定他的国位，直到永远。』

chapters.en: So now in the sight of all Israel, the assembly of the LORD, and in the hearing of our God, keep and seek out all the commandments of the LORD your God, so that you may possess this good land and leave it as an inheritance to your descendants forever.
chapters.zh: 现今在耶和华的会中，以色列众人眼前所说的，我们的上帝也听见了。你们应当寻求耶和华－你们上帝的一切诫命，谨守遵行，如此你们可以承受这美地，遗留给你们的子孙，永远为业。

chapters.en: As for you, Solomon my son, know the God of your father and serve Him wholeheartedly and with a willing mind, for the LORD searches every heart and understands the intent of every thought. If you seek Him, He will be found by you; but if you forsake Him, He will reject you forever.
chapters.zh: 「我儿所罗门哪，你当认识耶和华－你父的上帝，诚心乐意地事奉他；因为他鉴察众人的心，知道一切心思意念。你若寻求他，他必使你寻见；你若离弃他，他必永远丢弃你。

chapters.en: Consider now that the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong and do it.”
chapters.zh: 你当谨慎，因耶和华拣选你建造殿宇作为圣所。你当刚强去行。」

chapters.en: Then David gave his son Solomon the plans for the portico of the temple, its buildings, storehouses, upper rooms, inner rooms, and the room for the mercy seat.
chapters.zh: 大卫将〔殿的〕游廊、旁屋、府库、楼房、内殿，和施恩所的样式指示他儿子所罗门，

chapters.en: The plans contained everything David had in mind for the courts of the house of the LORD, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of the house of God and of the dedicated things,
chapters.zh: 又将被灵感动所得的样式，就是耶和华上帝殿的院子、周围的房屋、殿的府库，和圣物府库的一切样式都指示他；

chapters.en: for the divisions of the priests and Levites, for all the work of service in the house of the LORD, and for all the articles of service in the house of the LORD:
chapters.zh: 又指示他祭司和利未人的班次与耶和华殿里各样的工作，并耶和华殿里一切器皿的样式，

chapters.en:
the weight of all the gold articles for every kind of service;
the weight of all the silver articles for every kind of service;
chapters.zh: 以及各样应用金器的分两和各样应用银器的分两，

chapters.en:
the weight of the gold lampstands and their lamps, including the weight of each lampstand and its lamps;
the weight of each silver lampstand and its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand;
chapters.zh: 金灯台和金灯的分两，银灯台和银灯的分两，轻重各都合宜；

chapters.en: the weight of gold for each table of showbread, and of silver for the silver tables;
chapters.zh: 陈设饼金桌子的分两，银桌子的分两，
精金的肉叉子、盘子，和爵的分两，各金碗与各银碗的分两，

chapters.en:
the weight of the refined gold for the altar of incense;
and the plans for the chariot of the gold cherubim that spread their wings and overshadowed the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 精金香坛的分两，并用金子做基路伯〔注：原文是用金子做车式的基路伯〕；基路伯张开〔翅膀〕，遮掩耶和华的约柜。

chapters.en: “All this,” said David, “all the details of this plan, the LORD has made clear to me in writing by His hand upon me.”
chapters.zh: 〔大卫〕说：「这一切工作的样式都是耶和华用手划出来使我明白的。」

chapters.en: David also said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Do not be afraid or discouraged, for the LORD God, my God, is with you. He will neither fail you nor forsake you before all the work for the service of the house of the LORD is finished.
chapters.zh: 大卫又对他儿子所罗门说：「你当刚强壮胆去行！不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。因为耶和华上帝就是我的上帝，与你同在；他必不撇下你，也不丢弃你，直到耶和华殿的工作都完毕了。

chapters.en: The divisions of the priests and Levites are ready for all the service of the house of God, and every willing man of every skill will be at your disposal for the work. The officials and all the people are fully at your command.”
chapters.zh: 有祭司和利未人的各班，为要办理上帝殿各样的事，又有灵巧的人在各样的工作上乐意帮助你；并有众首领和众民一心听从你的命令。」

chapters.en: Then King David said to the whole assembly, “My son Solomon, the one whom God has chosen, is young and inexperienced. The task is great because this palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.
chapters.zh: 大卫王对会众说：「我儿子所罗门是上帝特选的，还年幼娇嫩；这工程甚大，因这殿不是为人，乃是为耶和华上帝建造的。

chapters.en: Now with all my ability I have made provision for the house of my God—gold for the gold articles, silver for the silver, bronze for the bronze, iron for the iron, and wood for the wood, as well as onyx for the settings, turquoise, stones of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and slabs of marble—all in abundance.
chapters.zh: 我为我上帝的殿已经尽力，预备金子做金器，银子做银器，铜做铜器，铁做铁器，木做木器，还有红玛瑙可镶嵌的宝石，彩石和一切的宝石，并许多汉白玉。

chapters.en: Moreover, because of my delight in the house of my God, I now give for it my personal treasures of gold and silver, over and above all that I have provided for this holy temple:
chapters.zh: 且因我心中爱慕我上帝的殿，就在预备建造圣殿的材料之外，又将我自己积蓄的金银献上，建造我上帝的殿，

chapters.en: three thousand talents of gold (the gold of Ophir) and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the buildings,
chapters.zh: 就是俄斐金三千他连得、精鍊的银子七千他连得，以贴殿墙。

chapters.en: for the gold work and the silver work, and for all the work to be done by the craftsmen. Now who is willing to consecrate himself to the LORD today?”
chapters.zh: 金子做金器，银子做银器，并藉匠人的手制造一切。今日有谁乐意将自己献给耶和华呢？」

chapters.en: Then the leaders of the families, the officers of the tribes of Israel, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and the officials in charge of the king’s work gave willingly.
chapters.zh: 于是，众族长和以色列各支派的首领、千夫长、百夫长，并监管王工的官长，都乐意献上。

chapters.en: Toward the service of God’s house they gave 5,000 talents and 10,000 darics of gold, 10,000 talents of silver, 18,000 talents of bronze, and 100,000 talents of iron.
chapters.zh: 他们为上帝殿的使用献上金子五千他连得零一万达利克，银子一万他连得，铜一万八千他连得，铁十万他连得。

chapters.en: Whoever had precious stones gave them to the treasury of the house of the LORD, under the care of Jehiel the Gershonite.
chapters.zh: 凡有〔宝〕石的都交给革顺人耶歇，送入耶和华殿的府库。

chapters.en: And the people rejoiced at the willing response of their leaders, for they had given to the LORD freely and wholeheartedly. And King David also rejoiced greatly.
chapters.zh: 因这些人诚心乐意献给耶和华，百姓就欢喜，大卫王也大大欢喜。

chapters.en:
Then David blessed the LORD in the sight of all the assembly and said:
“May You be blessed, O LORD, God of our father Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.
chapters.zh: 所以，大卫在会众面前称颂耶和华说：「耶和华－我们的父，以色列的上帝是应当称颂，直到永永远远的！

chapters.en:
Yours, O LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the splendor and the majesty, for everything in heaven and on earth belongs to You.
Yours, O LORD, is the kingdom, and You are exalted as head over all.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，尊大、能力、荣耀、强胜、威严都是你的；凡天上地下的都是你的；国度也是你的，并且你为至高，为万有之首。

chapters.en: Both riches and honor come from You, and You are the ruler over all. In Your hands are power and might to exalt and give strength to all.
chapters.zh: 丰富尊荣都从你而来，你也治理万物。在你手里有大能大力，使人尊大强盛都出于你。

chapters.en: Now therefore, our God, we give You thanks, and we praise Your glorious name.
chapters.zh: 我们的上帝啊，现在我们称谢你，赞美你荣耀之名！

chapters.en: But who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to give as generously as this? For everything comes from You, and from Your own hand we have given to You.
chapters.zh: 「我算什么，我的民算什么，竟能如此乐意奉献？因为万物都从你而来，我们把从你而得的献给你。

chapters.en: For we are foreigners and strangers in Your presence, as were all our forefathers. Our days on earth are like a shadow, without hope.
chapters.zh: 我们在你面前是客旅，是寄居的，与我们列祖一样。我们在世的日子如影儿，不能长存〔注：或译：没有长存的指望〕。

chapters.en: O LORD our God, from Your hand comes all this abundance that we have provided to build You a house for Your holy Name, and all of it belongs to You.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－我们的上帝啊，我们预备这许多材料，要为你的圣名建造殿宇，都是从你而来，都是属你的。

chapters.en: I know, my God, that You test the heart and delight in uprightness. All these things I have given willingly and with an upright heart, and now I have seen Your people who are present here giving joyfully and willingly to You.
chapters.zh: 我的上帝啊，我知道你察验人心，喜悦正直；我以正直的心乐意献上这一切物。现在我喜欢见你的民在这里都乐意奉献与你。

chapters.en: O LORD, God of our fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, keep this desire forever in the intentions of the hearts of Your people, and direct their hearts toward You.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－我们列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、以色列的上帝啊，求你使你的民常存这样的心思意念，坚定他们的心归向你，

chapters.en: And give my son Solomon a whole heart to keep and carry out all Your commandments, decrees, and statutes, and to build Your palace for which I have made provision.”
chapters.zh: 又求你赐我儿子所罗门诚实的心，遵守你的命令、法度、律例，成就这一切的事，用我所预备的建造殿宇。」

chapters.en:
Then David said to the whole assembly, “Bless the LORD your God.”
So the whole assembly blessed the LORD, the God of their fathers. They bowed down and paid homage to the LORD and to the king.
chapters.zh: 大卫对全会众说：「你们应当称颂耶和华－你们的上帝。」于是会众称颂耶和华－他们列祖的上帝，低头拜耶和华与王。

chapters.en: The next day they offered sacrifices and presented burnt offerings to the LORD: a thousand bulls, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, along with their drink offerings, and other sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.
chapters.zh: 次日，他们向耶和华献〔平安〕祭和燔祭，就是献公牛一千只，公绵羊一千只，羊羔一千只，并同献的奠祭；又为以色列众人献许多的祭。那日，他们在耶和华面前吃喝，大大欢乐。

chapters.en:
That day they ate and drank with great joy in the presence of the LORD.
Then, for a second time, they designated David’s son Solomon as king, anointing him before the LORD as ruler, and Zadok as the priest.
chapters.zh: 他们奉耶和华的命再膏大卫的儿子所罗门作王，又膏撒督作祭司。

chapters.en: So Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king in place of his father David. He prospered, and all Israel obeyed him.
chapters.zh: 于是所罗门坐在耶和华所赐的位上，接续他父亲大卫作王，万事亨通；以色列众人也都听从他。

chapters.en: All the officials and mighty men, as well as all of King David’s sons, pledged their allegiance to King Solomon.
chapters.zh: 众首领和勇士，并大卫王的众子，都顺服所罗门王。

chapters.en: The LORD highly exalted Solomon in the sight of all Israel and bestowed on him royal majesty such as had not been bestowed on any king in Israel before him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使所罗门在以色列众人眼前甚为尊大，极其威严，胜过在他以前的以色列王。

chapters.en: David son of Jesse was king over all Israel.
chapters.zh: 耶西的儿子大卫作以色列众人的王，

chapters.en: The length of David’s reign over Israel was forty years—seven years in Hebron and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 作王共四十年：在希伯崙作王七年，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。

chapters.en: He died at a ripe old age, full of years, riches, and honor, and his son Solomon reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 他年纪老迈，日子满足，享受丰富、尊荣，就死了。他儿子所罗门接续他作王。

chapters.en: Now the acts of King David, from first to last, are indeed written in the Chronicles of Samuel the Seer, the Chronicles of Nathan the Prophet, and the Chronicles of Gad the Seer,
chapters.zh: 大卫王始终的事都写在先见撒母耳的书上和先知拿单并先见迦得的书上。

chapters.en: together with all the details of his reign, his might, and the circumstances that came upon him and Israel and all the kingdoms of the lands.
chapters.zh: 他的国事和他的勇力，以及他和以色列并列国所经过的事都写在这书上。

chapters.en: Now Solomon son of David established himself securely over his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him and highly exalted him.
chapters.zh: 大卫的儿子所罗门国位坚固；耶和华－他的上帝与他同在，使他甚为尊大。

chapters.en: Then Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, to the judges, and to every leader in all Israel—the heads of the families.
chapters.zh: 所罗门吩咐以色列众人，就是千夫长、百夫长、审判官、首领与族长都来。

chapters.en: And Solomon and the whole assembly went to the high place at Gibeon because it was the location of God’s Tent of Meeting, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 所罗门和会众都往基遍的邱坛去，因那里有上帝的会幕，就是耶和华仆人摩西在旷野所制造的。

chapters.en: Now David had brought the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim to the place he had prepared for it, because he had pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 只是上帝的〔约〕柜，大卫已经从基列‧耶琳搬到他所预备的〔地方〕，因他曾在耶路撒冷为〔约〕柜支搭了帐幕，

chapters.en: But the bronze altar made by Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, was in Gibeon before the tabernacle of the LORD. So Solomon and the assembly inquired of Him there.
chapters.zh: 并且户珥的孙子、乌利的儿子比撒列所造的铜坛也在基遍耶和华的会幕前。所罗门和会众都就近坛前。

chapters.en: Solomon offered sacrifices there before the LORD on the bronze altar at the Tent of Meeting, where he offered a thousand burnt offerings.
chapters.zh: 所罗门上到耶和华面前会幕的铜坛那里，献一千牺牲为燔祭。

chapters.en: That night God appeared to Solomon and said, “Ask, and I will give it to you!”
chapters.zh: 当夜，上帝向所罗门显现，对他说：「你愿我赐你什么，你可以求。」

chapters.en: Solomon replied to God: “You have shown much loving devotion to my father David, and You have made me king in his place.
chapters.zh: 所罗门对上帝说：「你曾向我父大卫大施慈爱，使我接续他作王。

chapters.en: Now, O LORD God, let Your promise to my father David be fulfilled. For You have made me king over a people as numerous as the dust of the earth.
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝啊，现在求你成就向我父大卫所应许的话；因你立我作这民的王，他们如同地上尘沙那样多。

chapters.en: Now grant me wisdom and knowledge, so that I may lead this people. For who is able to govern this great people of Yours?”
chapters.zh: 求你赐我智慧聪明，我好在这民前出入；不然，谁能判断这众多的民呢？」

chapters.en: God said to Solomon, “Since this was in your heart instead of requesting riches or wealth or honor for yourself or death for your enemies—and since you have not even requested long life but have asked for wisdom and knowledge to govern My people over whom I have made you king—
chapters.zh: 上帝对所罗门说：「我已立你作我民的王。你既有这心意，并不求资财、丰富、尊荣，也不求灭绝那恨你之人的性命，又不求大寿数，只求智慧聪明好判断我的民；

chapters.en: therefore wisdom and knowledge have been granted to you. And I will also give you riches and wealth and honor unlike anything given to the kings before you or after you.”
chapters.zh: 我必赐你智慧聪明，也必赐你资财、丰富、尊荣。在你以前的列王都没有这样，在你以后也必没有这样的。」

chapters.en: So Solomon went to Jerusalem from the high place in Gibeon, from before the Tent of Meeting, and he reigned over Israel.
chapters.zh: 于是，所罗门从基遍邱坛会幕前回到耶路撒冷，治理以色列人。

chapters.en: Solomon accumulated 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horses, which he stationed in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 所罗门聚集战车马兵，有战车一千四百辆，马兵一万二千名，安置在屯车的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那里。

chapters.en: The king made silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as abundant as sycamore in the foothills.
chapters.zh: 王在耶路撒冷使金银多如石头，香柏木多如高原的桑树。

chapters.en: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and Kue; the royal merchants purchased them from Kue.
chapters.zh: 所罗门的马是从埃及带来的，是王的商人一群一群按着定价买来的。

chapters.en: A chariot could be imported from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty. Likewise, they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Aram.
chapters.zh: 他们从埃及买来的车，每辆价银六百〔舍客勒〕，马每匹一百五十舍客勒。赫人诸王和亚兰诸王所买的车马，也是按这价值经他们手买来的。

chapters.en: Now Solomon purposed to build a house for the Name of the LORD and a royal palace for himself.
chapters.zh: 所罗门定意要为耶和华的名建造殿宇，又为自己的国建造宫室。

chapters.en: So he conscripted 70,000 porters, 80,000 stonecutters in the mountains, and 3,600 supervisors.
chapters.zh: 所罗门就挑选七万扛抬的，八万在山上凿石头的，三千六百督工的。

chapters.en:
Then Solomon sent word to Hiram king of Tyre:
“Do for me as you did for my father David when you sent him cedars to build himself a house to live in.
chapters.zh: 所罗门差人去见泰尔王希兰，说：「你曾运香柏木与我父大卫建宫居住，〔求你也这样待我〕。

chapters.en: Behold, I am about to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God to dedicate to Him for burning fragrant incense before Him, for displaying the showbread continuously, and for making burnt offerings every morning and evening as well as on the Sabbaths, New Moons, and appointed feasts of the LORD our God. This is ordained for Israel forever.
chapters.zh: 我要为耶和华－我上帝的名建造殿宇，分别为圣献给他，在他面前焚烧美香，常摆陈设饼，每早晚、安息日、月朔，并耶和华－我们上帝所定的节期献燔祭。这是以色列人永远的〔定例〕。

chapters.en: The house that I am building will be great, for our God is greater than all gods.
chapters.zh: 我所要建造的殿宇甚大；因为我们的上帝至大，超乎诸神。

chapters.en: But who is able to build a house for Him, since the heavens, even the highest heavens, cannot contain Him? Who then am I, that I should build a house for Him, except as a place to burn sacrifices before Him?
chapters.zh: 天和天上的天，尚且不足他居住的，谁能为他建造殿宇呢？我是谁？能为他建造殿宇吗？不过在他面前烧香而已。

chapters.en: Send me, therefore, a craftsman skilled in engraving to work with gold and silver, with bronze and iron, and with purple, crimson, and blue yarn. He will work with my craftsmen in Judah and Jerusalem, whom my father David provided.
chapters.zh: 现在求你差一个巧匠来，就是善用金、银、铜、铁，和紫色、朱红色、蓝色〔线〕，并精于雕刻之工的巧匠，与我父大卫在犹大和耶路撒冷所预备的巧匠一同做工；

chapters.en: Send me also cedar, cypress, and algum logs from Lebanon, for I know that your servants have skill to cut timber there. And indeed, my servants will work with yours
chapters.zh: 又求你从黎巴嫩运些香柏木、松木、檀香木到我这里来，因我知道你的仆人善于砍伐黎巴嫩的树木。我的仆人也必与你的仆人同工。

chapters.en: to prepare for me timber in abundance, because the temple I am building will be great and wonderful.
chapters.zh: 这样，可以给我预备许多的木料，因我要建造的殿宇高大出奇。

chapters.en: I will pay your servants, the woodcutters, 20,000 cors of ground wheat, 20,000 cors of barley, 20,000 baths of wine, and 20,000 baths of olive oil. ”
chapters.zh: 你的仆人砍伐树木，我必给他们打好了的小麦二万歌珥，大麦二万歌珥，酒二万罢特，油二万罢特。」

chapters.en:
Then Hiram king of Tyre wrote a letter in reply to Solomon:
“Because the LORD loves His people, He has set you over them as king.”
chapters.zh: 泰尔王希兰写信回答所罗门说：「耶和华因为爱他的子民，所以立你作他们的王」；

chapters.en:
And Hiram added:
“Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who made the heavens and the earth! He has given King David a wise son with insight and understanding, who will build a temple for the LORD and a royal palace for himself.
chapters.zh: 又说：「创造天地的耶和华－以色列的上帝是应当称颂的！他赐给大卫王一个有智慧的儿子，使他有谋略聪明，可以为耶和华建造殿宇，又为自己的国建造宫室。

chapters.en: So now I am sending you Huram-abi, a skillful man endowed with creativity.
chapters.zh: 「现在我打发一个精巧有聪明的人去，他是我父亲希兰所用的，

chapters.en: He is the son of a woman from the daughters of Dan, and his father is a man of Tyre. He is skilled in work with gold and silver, bronze and iron, stone and wood, purple, blue, and crimson yarn, and fine linen. He is experienced in every kind of engraving and can execute any design that is given him. He will work with your craftsmen and with those of my lord, your father David.
chapters.zh: 是但〔支派〕一个妇人的儿子。他父亲是泰尔人，他善用金、银、铜、铁、石、木，和紫色、蓝色、朱红色〔线〕与细麻制造各物，并精于雕刻，又能想出各样的巧工。请你派定这人，与你的巧匠和你父－我主大卫的巧匠一同做工。

chapters.en: Now let my lord send to his servants the wheat, barley, olive oil, and wine he promised.
chapters.zh: 我主所说的小麦、大麦、酒、油，愿我主运来给众仆人。

chapters.en: We will cut logs from Lebanon, as many as you need, and we will float them to you as rafts by sea down to Joppa. Then you can take them up to Jerusalem.”
chapters.zh: 我们必照你所需用的，从黎巴嫩砍伐树木，扎成筏子，浮海运到约帕；你可以从那里运到耶路撒冷。」

chapters.en: Solomon numbered all the foreign men in the land of Israel following the census his father David had conducted, and there were found to be 153,600 in all.
chapters.zh: 所罗门仿照他父大卫数点住在以色列地所有寄居的外邦人，共有十五万三千六百名；

chapters.en: Solomon made 70,000 of them porters, 80,000 stonecutters in the mountains, and 3,600 supervisors.
chapters.zh: 使七万人扛抬材料，八万人在山上凿石头，三千六百人督理工作。

chapters.en: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD had appeared to his father David. This was the place that David had prepared on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
chapters.zh: 所罗门就在耶路撒冷、〔耶和华〕向他父大卫显现的摩利亚山上，就是耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场上、大卫所指定的地方预备好了，开工建造耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: Solomon began construction on the second day of the second month in the fourth year of his reign.
chapters.zh: 所罗门作王第四年二月初二日开工建造。

chapters.en: The foundation that Solomon laid for the house of God was sixty cubits long and twenty cubits wide, according to the old standard.
chapters.zh: 所罗门建筑上帝殿的根基，乃是这样：长六十肘，宽二十肘，都按着古时的尺寸。

chapters.en: The portico at the front, extending across the width of the temple, was twenty cubits long and twenty cubits high. He overlaid the inside with pure gold.
chapters.zh: 殿前的廊子长二十肘，与殿的宽窄一样，高一百二十肘；里面贴上精金。

chapters.en: He paneled the main room with cypress, which he overlaid with fine gold and decorated with palm trees and chains.
chapters.zh: 大殿〔的墙〕都用松木板遮蔽，又贴了精金，上面雕刻棕树和鍊子；

chapters.en: He adorned the temple with precious stones for beauty, and its gold was from Parvaim.
chapters.zh: 又用宝石装饰殿〔墙〕，使殿华美；所用的金子都是巴瓦音的金子。

chapters.en: He overlaid its beams, thresholds, walls, and doors with gold, and he carved cherubim on the walls.
chapters.zh: 又用金子贴殿和殿的栋梁、门槛、墙壁、门扇；墙上雕刻基路伯。

chapters.en: Then he made the Most Holy Place; its length corresponded to the width of the temple—twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide. And he overlaid the inside with six hundred talents of fine gold.
chapters.zh: 又建造至圣所，长二十肘，与殿的宽窄一样，宽也是二十肘；贴上精金，共用金子六百他连得。

chapters.en: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He also overlaid the upper rooms with gold.
chapters.zh: 金钉重五十舍客勒。楼房都贴上金子。

chapters.en: In the Most Holy Place he made two cherubim of sculptured work, and he overlaid them with gold.
chapters.zh: 在至圣所按造像的法子造两个基路伯，用金子包裹。

chapters.en: The total wingspan of the cherubim was twenty cubits. One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long and touched the wall of the temple, and its other wing was five cubits long and touched the wing of the other cherub.
chapters.zh: 两个基路伯的翅膀共长二十肘。这〔基路伯〕的一个翅膀长五肘，挨着殿这边的墙；那一个翅膀也长五肘，与那基路伯翅膀相接。

chapters.en: The wing of the second cherub also measured five cubits and touched the wall of the temple, while its other wing measured five cubits and touched the wing of the first cherub.
chapters.zh: 那基路伯的一个翅膀长五肘，挨着殿那边的墙；那一个翅膀也长五肘，与这基路伯的翅膀相接。

chapters.en: So the total wingspan of these cherubim was twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, facing the main room.
chapters.zh: 两个基路伯张开翅膀，共长二十肘，面向〔外〕殿而立。

chapters.en: He made the veil of blue, purple, and crimson yarn and fine linen, with cherubim woven into it.
chapters.zh: 又用蓝色、紫色、朱红色〔线〕和细麻织幔子，在其上绣出基路伯来。

chapters.en: In front of the temple he made two pillars, which together were thirty-five cubits high, each with a capital on top measuring five cubits.
chapters.zh: 在殿前造了两根柱子，高三十五肘；每柱顶高五肘。

chapters.en: He made interwoven chains and put them on top of the pillars. He made a hundred pomegranates and fastened them into the chainwork.
chapters.zh: 又〔照〕圣所内〔鍊子〕的样式做鍊子，安在柱顶上；又做一百石榴，安在鍊子上。

chapters.en: Then he set up the pillars in front of the temple, one on the south and one on the north. The pillar on the south he named Jachin, and the pillar on the north he named Boaz.
chapters.zh: 将两根柱子立在殿前，一根在右边，一根在左边；右边的起名叫雅斤，左边的起名叫波阿斯。

chapters.en: He made a bronze altar twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.
chapters.zh: 他又制造一座铜坛，长二十肘，宽二十肘，高十肘；

chapters.en: He also made the Sea of cast metal. It was circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim, five cubits in height, and thirty cubits in circumference.
chapters.zh: 又铸一个〔铜〕海，样式是圆的，高五肘，径十肘，围三十肘；

chapters.en: Below the rim, figures of oxen encircled it, ten per cubit all the way around the Sea, cast in two rows as a part of the Sea.
chapters.zh: 海周围有野瓜〔注：野瓜：原文是牛〕的样式，每肘十瓜，共有两行，是铸海的时候铸上的；

chapters.en: The Sea stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east. The Sea rested on them, with all their hindquarters toward the center.
chapters.zh: 有十二只〔铜〕牛驮海：三只向北，三只向西，三只向南，三只向东；海在牛上，牛尾向内；

chapters.en: It was a handbreadth thick, and its rim was fashioned like the brim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It could hold three thousand baths.
chapters.zh: 海厚一掌，边如杯边，又如百合花，可容三千罢特；

chapters.en: He also made ten basins for washing and placed five on the south side and five on the north. The parts of the burnt offering were rinsed in them, but the priests used the Sea for washing.
chapters.zh: 又制造十个盆：五个放在右边，五个放在左边，献燔祭所用之物都洗在其内；但海是为祭司沐浴的。

chapters.en: He made ten gold lampstands according to their specifications and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north.
chapters.zh: 他又照所定的样式造十个金灯台，放在殿里：五个在右边，五个在左边；

chapters.en: Additionally, he made ten tables and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north. He also made a hundred gold bowls.
chapters.zh: 又造十张桌子，放在殿里：五张在右边，五张在左边；又造一百个金碗；

chapters.en: He made the courtyard of the priests and the large court with its doors, and he overlaid the doors with bronze.
chapters.zh: 又建立祭司院和大院，并院门，用铜包裹门扇；

chapters.en: He put the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner.
chapters.zh: 将海安在〔殿门的〕右边，就是南边。

chapters.en:
Additionally, Huram made the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls.
So Huram finished the work that he had undertaken for King Solomon in the house of God:
chapters.zh: 户兰又造了盆、铲、碗。这样，他为所罗门王做完了上帝殿的工。
〔所造的〕就是：两根柱子和柱上两个如球的顶，并两个盖柱顶的网子

chapters.en: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network covering both the bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars);
chapters.zh: 和四百石榴，安在两个网子上（每网两行盖着两个柱上如球的顶）。

chapters.en:
the stands;
the basins on the stands;
chapters.zh: 盆座和其上的盆，

chapters.en:
the Sea;
the twelve oxen underneath the Sea;
chapters.zh: 海和海下的十二只牛，

chapters.en:
and the pots, shovels, meat forks, and all the other articles.
All these objects that Huram-abi made for King Solomon for the house of the LORD were of polished bronze.
chapters.zh: 盆、铲子、肉锸子，与耶和华殿里的一切器皿，都是巧匠户兰用光亮的铜为所罗门王造成的，

chapters.en: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Succoth and Zeredah.
chapters.zh: 是在约旦平原疏割和撒利但中间藉胶泥铸成的。

chapters.en: Solomon made all these articles in such great abundance that the weight of the bronze could not be determined.
chapters.zh: 所罗门制造的这一切甚多，铜的轻重无法可查。
所罗门又造上帝殿里的金坛和陈设饼的桌子，

chapters.en: the lampstands of pure gold and their lamps, to burn in front of the inner sanctuary as prescribed;
chapters.zh: 并精金的灯台和灯盏，可以照例点在内殿前。

chapters.en: the flowers, lamps, and tongs of gold—of purest gold;
chapters.zh: 灯台上的花和灯盏，并蜡剪都是金的，且是纯金的；

chapters.en:
the wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, ladles, and censers of pure gold;
and the gold doors of the temple: the inner doors to the Most Holy Place as well as the doors of the main hall.
chapters.zh: 又用精金制造镊子、盘子、调羹、火鼎。至于殿门和至圣所的门扇，并殿的门扇，都是金子妆饰的。

chapters.en:
So all the work that Solomon had performed for the house of the LORD was completed.
Then Solomon brought in the items his father David had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and all the furnishings—and he placed them in the treasuries of the house of God.
chapters.zh: 所罗门做完了耶和华殿的一切工，就把他父大卫分别为圣的金银和器皿都带来，放在上帝殿的府库里。

chapters.en: At that time Solomon assembled in Jerusalem the elders of Israel—all the tribal heads and family leaders of the Israelites—to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from Zion, the City of David.
chapters.zh: 那时，所罗门将以色列的长老、各支派的首领，并以色列的族长招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和华的约柜从大卫城－就是锡安－运上来。

chapters.en: So all the men of Israel came together to the king at the feast in the seventh month.
chapters.zh: 于是以色列众人在七月节〔前〕都聚集到王那里。

chapters.en: When all the elders of Israel had arrived, the Levites took up the ark,
chapters.zh: 以色列众长老来到，利未人便抬起〔约〕柜。

chapters.en: and they brought up the ark and the Tent of Meeting with all its sacred furnishings. The Levitical priests carried them up.
chapters.zh: 祭司利未人将〔约〕柜运上来，又将会幕和会幕的一切圣器具都带上来。

chapters.en: There, before the ark, King Solomon and the whole congregation of Israel who had assembled with him sacrificed so many sheep and oxen that they could not be counted or numbered.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王和聚集到他那里的以色列全会众都在〔约〕柜前献牛羊为祭，多得不可胜数。

chapters.en: Then the priests brought the ark of the covenant of the LORD to its place in the inner sanctuary of the temple, the Most Holy Place, beneath the wings of the cherubim.
chapters.zh: 祭司将耶和华的〔约〕柜抬进内殿，就是至圣所，放在两个基路伯的翅膀底下。

chapters.en: For the cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark and overshadowed the ark and its poles.
chapters.zh: 基路伯张着翅膀在〔约〕柜之上，遮掩〔约〕柜和抬柜的杠。

chapters.en: The poles of the ark extended far enough that their ends were visible from in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from outside the Holy Place; and they are there to this day.
chapters.zh: 这杠甚长，杠头在内殿前可以看见，在殿外却不能看见，直到如今还在那里。

chapters.en: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets that Moses had placed in it at Horeb, where the LORD had made a covenant with the Israelites after they had come out of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 〔约〕柜里惟有两块石版，就是以色列人出埃及后，耶和华与他们立约的时候，摩西在何烈山所放的。除此以外，并无别物。

chapters.en: Now all the priests who were present had consecrated themselves regardless of their divisions. And when the priests came out of the Holy Place,
chapters.zh: 当时，在那里所有的祭司都已自洁，并不分班供职。

chapters.en: all the Levitical singers—Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and relatives—stood on the east side of the altar, dressed in fine linen and playing cymbals, harps, and lyres, accompanied by 120 priests sounding trumpets.
chapters.zh: 他们出圣所的时候，歌唱的利未人亚萨、希幔、耶杜顿，和他们的众子众弟兄都穿细麻布衣服，站在坛的东边，敲钹、鼓瑟、弹琴，同着他们有一百二十个祭司吹号。

chapters.en:
The trumpeters and singers joined together to praise and thank the LORD with one voice. They lifted up their voices, accompanied by trumpets, cymbals, and musical instruments, in praise to the LORD:
“For He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.”
And the temple, the house of the LORD, was filled with a cloud
chapters.zh: 吹号的、歌唱的都一齐发声，声合为一，赞美感谢耶和华。吹号、敲钹，用各种乐器，扬声赞美耶和华〔说〕： 耶和华本为善， 他的慈爱永远长存！ 那时，耶和华的殿有云充满，

chapters.en: so that the priests could not stand there to minister because of the cloud. For the glory of the LORD filled the house of God.
chapters.zh: 甚至祭司不能站立供职，因为耶和华的荣光充满了上帝的殿。

chapters.en:
Then Solomon declared:
“The LORD has said that He would dwell in the thick cloud.
chapters.zh: 那时，所罗门说： 耶和华曾说他必住在幽暗之处。

chapters.en: But I have built You an exalted house, a place for You to dwell forever.”
chapters.zh: 但我已经建造殿宇作你的居所， 为你永远的住处。

chapters.en: And as the whole assembly of Israel stood there, the king turned around and blessed them all
chapters.zh: 王转脸为以色列会众祝福，以色列会众就都站立。

chapters.en:
and said:
“Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who has fulfilled with His own hand what He spoke with His mouth to my father David, saying,
chapters.zh: 所罗门说：「耶和华－以色列的上帝是应当称颂的！因他亲口向我父大卫所应许的，也亲手成就了。

chapters.en: ‘Since the day I brought My people out of the land of Egypt, I have not chosen a city from any tribe of Israel in which to build a house so that My Name would be there, nor have I chosen anyone to be ruler over My people Israel.
chapters.zh: 他说：『自从我领我民出埃及地以来，我未曾在以色列众支派中选择一城建造殿宇为我名的居所，也未曾拣选一人作我民以色列的君；

chapters.en: But now I have chosen Jerusalem for My Name to be there, and I have chosen David to be over My people Israel.’
chapters.zh: 但选择耶路撒冷为我名的居所，又拣选大卫治理我民以色列。』」

chapters.en: Now it was in the heart of my father David to build a house for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 所罗门说：「我父大卫曾立意要为耶和华－以色列上帝的名建殿，

chapters.en: But the LORD said to my father David, ‘Since it was in your heart to build a house for My Name, you have done well to have this in your heart.
chapters.zh: 耶和华却对我父大卫说：『你立意要为我的名建殿，这意思甚好；

chapters.en: Nevertheless, you are not the one to build it; but your son, your own offspring, will build the house for My Name.’
chapters.zh: 只是你不可建殿，惟你所生的儿子必为我名建殿。』

chapters.en: Now the LORD has fulfilled the word that He spoke. I have succeeded my father David, and I sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised. I have built the house for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 「现在耶和华成就了他所应许的话，使我接续我父大卫坐以色列的国位，是照耶和华所说的，又为耶和华－以色列上帝的名建造了殿。

chapters.en: And there I have placed the ark, which contains the covenant of the LORD that He made with the children of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 我将〔约〕柜安置在其中，柜内有耶和华的约，就是他与以色列人所立的约。」

chapters.en: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in front of the whole assembly of Israel and spread out his hands.
chapters.zh: 所罗门当着以色列会众，站在耶和华的坛前，举起手来，

chapters.en: Now Solomon had made a bronze platform five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high and had placed it in the middle of the courtyard. He stood on it, knelt down before the whole assembly of Israel, spread out his hands toward heaven,
chapters.zh: （所罗门曾造一个铜台，长五肘，宽五肘，高三肘，放在院中）就站在台上，当着以色列的会众跪下，向天举手，

chapters.en:
and said:
“O LORD, God of Israel, there is no God like You in heaven or on earth, keeping Your covenant of loving devotion with Your servants who walk before You with all their hearts.
chapters.zh: 说：「耶和华－以色列的上帝啊，天上地下没有神可比你的！你向那尽心行在你面前的仆人守约施慈爱；

chapters.en: You have kept Your promise to Your servant, my father David. What You spoke with Your mouth You have fulfilled with Your hand this day.
chapters.zh: 向你仆人－我父大卫所应许的话现在应验了。你亲口应许，亲手成就，正如今日一样。

chapters.en: Therefore now, O LORD, God of Israel, keep for Your servant, my father David, what You promised when You said: ‘You will never fail to have a man to sit before Me on the throne of Israel, if only your descendants guard their way to walk in My law as you have walked before Me.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华－以色列的上帝啊，你所应许你仆人－我父大卫的话说：『你的子孙若谨慎自己的行为，遵守我的律法，像你在我面前所行的一样，就不断人坐以色列的国位。』现在求你应验这话。

chapters.en: And now, O LORD, God of Israel, please confirm what You promised to Your servant David.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－以色列的上帝啊，求你成就向你仆人大卫所应许的话。

chapters.en: But will God indeed dwell with man upon the earth? The heavens, even the highest heavens, cannot contain You, much less this temple I have built.
chapters.zh: 「上帝果真与世人同住在地上吗？看哪，天和天上的天尚且不足你居住的，何况我所建的这殿呢？

chapters.en: Yet regard the prayer and plea of Your servant, O LORD my God, so that You may hear the cry and the prayer that Your servant is praying before You.
chapters.zh: 惟求耶和华－我的上帝垂顾仆人的祷告祈求，俯听仆人在你面前的祈祷呼吁。

chapters.en: May Your eyes be open toward this temple day and night, toward the place where You said You would put Your Name, so that You may hear the prayer that Your servant prays toward this place.
chapters.zh: 愿你昼夜看顾这殿，就是你应许立为你名的居所；求你垂听仆人向此处祷告的话。

chapters.en: Hear the plea of Your servant and of Your people Israel when they pray toward this place. May You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place. May You hear and forgive.
chapters.zh: 你仆人和你民以色列向此处祈祷的时候，求你从天上你的居所垂听，垂听而赦免。

chapters.en: When a man sins against his neighbor and is required to take an oath, and he comes to take an oath before Your altar in this temple,
chapters.zh: 「人若得罪邻舍，有人叫他起誓，他来到这殿，在你的坛前起誓，

chapters.en: then may You hear from heaven and act. May You judge Your servants, condemning the wicked man by bringing down on his own head what he has done, and justifying the righteous man by rewarding him according to his righteousness.
chapters.zh: 求你从天上垂听，判断你的仆人，定恶人有罪，照他所行的报应在他头上；定义人有理，照他的义赏赐他。

chapters.en: When Your people Israel are defeated before an enemy because they have sinned against You, and they return to You and confess Your name, praying and pleading before You in this temple,
chapters.zh: 「你的民以色列若得罪你，败在仇敌面前，又回心转意承认你的名，在这殿里向你祈求祷告，

chapters.en: then may You hear from heaven and forgive the sin of Your people Israel. May You restore them to the land You gave to them and their fathers.
chapters.zh: 求你从天上垂听，赦免你民以色列的罪，使他们归回你赐给他们和他们列祖之地。

chapters.en: When the skies are shut and there is no rain because Your people have sinned against You, and they pray toward this place and confess Your name, and they turn from their sins because You have afflicted them,
chapters.zh: 「你的民因得罪你，你惩罚他们，使天闭塞不下雨，他们若向此处祷告，承认你的名，离开他们的罪，

chapters.en: then may You hear from heaven and forgive the sin of Your servants, Your people Israel, so that You may teach them the good way in which they should walk. May You send rain on the land that You gave Your people as an inheritance.
chapters.zh: 求你在天上垂听，赦免你仆人和你民以色列的罪，将当行的善道指教他们，且降雨在你的地，就是你赐给你民为业之地。

chapters.en: When famine or plague comes upon the land, or blight or mildew or locusts or grasshoppers, or when their enemies besiege them in their cities, whatever plague or sickness may come,
chapters.zh: 「国中若有饥荒、瘟疫、旱风、霉烂、蝗虫、蚂蚱，或有仇敌犯境，围困城邑，无论遭遇什么灾祸疾病，

chapters.en: then may whatever prayer or plea Your people Israel make—each knowing his own afflictions and spreading out his hands toward this temple—
chapters.zh: 你的民以色列，或是众人，或是一人，自觉灾祸甚苦，向这殿举手，无论祈求什么，祷告什么，

chapters.en: be heard by You from heaven, Your dwelling place. And may You forgive and repay each man according to all his ways, since You know his heart—for You alone know the hearts of men—
chapters.zh: 求你从天上你的居所垂听赦免。你是知道人心的，要照各人所行的待他们（惟有你知道世人的心），

chapters.en: so that they may fear You and walk in Your ways all the days they live in the land that You gave to our fathers.
chapters.zh: 使他们在你赐给我们列祖之地上一生一世敬畏你，遵行你的道。

chapters.en: And as for the foreigner who is not of Your people Israel but has come from a distant land because of Your great name and Your mighty hand and outstretched arm—when he comes and prays toward this temple,
chapters.zh: 「论到不属你民以色列的外邦人，为你的大名和大能的手，并伸出来的膀臂，从远方而来，向这殿祷告，

chapters.en: then may You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place, and do according to all for which the foreigner calls to You. Then all the peoples of the earth will know Your name and fear You, as do Your people Israel, and they will know that this house I have built is called by Your Name.
chapters.zh: 求你从天上你的居所垂听，照着外邦人所祈求的而行，使天下万民都认识你的名，敬畏你，像你的民以色列一样，又使他们知道我建造的这殿是称为你名下的。

chapters.en: When Your people go to war against their enemies, wherever You send them, and when they pray to You in the direction of this city You have chosen and the house I have built for Your Name,
chapters.zh: 「你的民若奉你的差遣，无论往何处去与仇敌争战，向你所选择的城与我为你名所建造的殿祷告，

chapters.en: then may You hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and may You uphold their cause.
chapters.zh: 求你从天上垂听他们的祷告祈求，使他们得胜。

chapters.en: When they sin against You—for there is no one who does not sin—and You become angry with them and deliver them to an enemy who takes them as captives to a land far or near,
chapters.zh: 「你的民若得罪你（世上没有不犯罪的人），你向他们发怒，将他们交给仇敌掳到或远或近之地；

chapters.en: and when they come to their senses in the land to which they were taken, and they repent and plead with You in the land of their captors, saying, ‘We have sinned and done wrong; we have acted wickedly,’
chapters.zh: 他们若在掳到之地想起罪来，回心转意，恳求你说：『我们有罪了，我们悖逆了，我们作恶了』；

chapters.en: and when they return to You with all their heart and soul in the land of the enemies who took them captive, and when they pray in the direction of the land that You gave to their fathers, the city You have chosen, and the house I have built for Your Name,
chapters.zh: 他们若在掳到之地尽心尽性归服你，又向自己的地，就是你赐给他们列祖之地和你所选择的城，并我为你名所建造的殿祷告，

chapters.en: then may You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place, their prayer and pleas, and may You uphold their cause. May You forgive Your people who sinned against You.
chapters.zh: 求你从天上你的居所垂听你民的祷告祈求，为他们伸冤，赦免他们的过犯。

chapters.en: Now, my God, may Your eyes be open and Your ears attentive to the prayer offered in this place.
chapters.zh: 「我的上帝啊，现在求你睁眼看，侧耳听在此处所献的祷告。

chapters.en: Now therefore, arise, O LORD God, and enter Your resting place, You and the ark of Your might. May Your priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and may Your godly ones rejoice in goodness.
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝啊，求你起来， 和你有能力的〔约〕柜同入安息之所。 耶和华上帝啊，愿你的祭司披上救恩； 愿你的圣民蒙福欢乐。

chapters.en: O LORD God, do not reject Your anointed one. Remember Your loving devotion to Your servant David.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝啊，求你不要厌弃你的受膏者， 要记念向你仆人大卫所施的慈爱。」

chapters.en: When Solomon had finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices, and the glory of the LORD filled the temple.
chapters.zh: 所罗门祈祷已毕，就有火从天上降下来，烧尽燔祭和别的祭。耶和华的荣光充满了殿；

chapters.en: The priests were unable to enter the house of the LORD, because the glory of the LORD had filled it.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华的荣光充满了耶和华殿，所以祭司不能进殿。

chapters.en:
When all the Israelites saw the fire coming down and the glory of the LORD above the temple, they bowed down on the pavement with their faces to the ground, and they worshiped and gave thanks to the LORD:
“For He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.”
chapters.zh: 那火降下、耶和华的荣光在殿上的时候，以色列众人看见，就在铺石地俯伏叩拜，称谢耶和华〔说〕： 耶和华本为善， 他的慈爱永远长存！

chapters.en: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 王和众民在耶和华面前献祭。

chapters.en: And King Solomon offered a sacrifice of 22,000 oxen and 120,000 sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王用牛二万二千，羊十二万献祭。这样，王和众民为上帝的殿行奉献之礼。

chapters.en: The priests stood at their posts, as did the Levites with the musical instruments of the LORD, which King David had made for giving thanks to the LORD and with which David had offered praise, saying, “For His loving devotion endures forever.” Across from the Levites, the priests sounded trumpets, and all the Israelites were standing.
chapters.zh: 祭司侍立，各供其职；利未人也拿着耶和华的乐器，就是大卫王造出来、藉利未人颂赞耶和华的。（他的慈爱永远长存！）祭司在众人面前吹号，以色列人都站立。

chapters.en: Then Solomon consecrated the middle of the courtyard in front of the house of the LORD, and there he offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings, since the bronze altar he had made could not hold all these offerings.
chapters.zh: 所罗门因他所造的铜坛容不下燔祭、素祭，和脂油，便将耶和华殿前院子当中分别为圣，在那里献燔祭和平安祭牲的脂油。

chapters.en: So at that time Solomon and all Israel with him—a very great assembly of people from Lebo-hamath to the Brook of Egypt—kept the feast for seven days.
chapters.zh: 那时所罗门和以色列众人，就是从哈马口直到埃及小河，所有的以色列人都聚集成为大会，守节七日。

chapters.en: On the eighth day they held a solemn assembly, for the dedication of the altar had lasted seven days, and the feast seven days more.
chapters.zh: 第八日设立严肃会，行奉献坛的礼七日，守节七日。

chapters.en: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month, Solomon sent the people away to their homes, joyful and glad of heart for the good things that the LORD had done for David, for Solomon, and for His people Israel.
chapters.zh: 七月二十三日，王遣散众民；他们因见耶和华向大卫和所罗门与他民以色列所施的恩惠，就都心中喜乐，各归各家去了。

chapters.en: When Solomon had finished the house of the LORD and the royal palace, successfully carrying out all that was in his heart to do for the house of the LORD and for his own palace,
chapters.zh: 所罗门造成了耶和华殿和王宫；在耶和华殿和王宫凡他心中所要做的，都顺顺利利地做成了。

chapters.en:
the LORD appeared to him at night and said to him:
“I have heard your prayer and have chosen this place for Myself as a house of sacrifice.
chapters.zh: 夜间耶和华向所罗门显现，对他说：「我已听了你的祷告，也选择这地方作为祭祀我的殿宇。

chapters.en: If I close the sky so there is no rain, or if I command the locust to devour the land, or if I send a plague among My people,
chapters.zh: 我若使天闭塞不下雨，或使蝗虫吃这地的出产，或使瘟疫流行在我民中，

chapters.en: and if My people who are called by My name humble themselves and pray and seek My face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, forgive their sin, and heal their land.
chapters.zh: 这称为我名下的子民，若是自卑、祷告，寻求我的面，转离他们的恶行，我必从天上垂听，赦免他们的罪，医治他们的地。

chapters.en: Now My eyes will be open and My ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.
chapters.zh: 我必睁眼看、侧耳听在此处所献的祷告。

chapters.en: For I have now chosen and consecrated this temple so that My Name may be there forever. My eyes and My heart will be there for all time.
chapters.zh: 现在我已选择这殿，分别为圣，使我的名永在其中，我的眼、我的心也必常在那里。

chapters.en: And as for you, if you walk before Me as your father David walked, doing all I have commanded you, and if you keep My statutes and ordinances,
chapters.zh: 你若在我面前效法你父大卫所行的，遵行我一切所吩咐你的，谨守我的律例典章，

chapters.en: then I will establish your royal throne, as I covenanted with your father David when I said, ‘You will never fail to have a man to rule over Israel.’
chapters.zh: 我就必坚固你的国位，正如我与你父大卫所立的约，说：『你〔的子孙〕必不断人作以色列的王。』

chapters.en: But if you turn away and forsake the statutes and commandments I have set before you, and if you go off to serve and worship other gods,
chapters.zh: 「倘若你们转去丢弃我指示你们的律例诫命，去事奉敬拜别神，

chapters.en: then I will uproot Israel from the soil I have given them, and I will banish from My presence this temple I have sanctified for My Name. I will make it an object of scorn and ridicule among all the peoples.
chapters.zh: 我就必将以色列人从我赐给他们的地上拔出根来，并且我为己名所分别为圣的殿也必舍弃不顾，使他在万民中作笑谈，被讥诮。

chapters.en: And when this temple has become a heap of rubble, all who pass by it will be appalled and say, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land and to this temple?’
chapters.zh: 这殿虽然甚高，将来经过的人必惊讶说：『耶和华为何向这地和这殿如此行呢？』

chapters.en: And others will answer, ‘Because they have forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them—because of this, He has brought all this disaster upon them.’”
chapters.zh: 人必回答说：『是因此地的人离弃耶和华－他们列祖的上帝，就是领他们出埃及地的上帝，去亲近别神，敬拜事奉他，所以耶和华使这一切灾祸临到他们。』」

chapters.en: Now at the end of the twenty years during which Solomon had built the house of the LORD and his own palace,
chapters.zh: 所罗门建造耶和华殿和王宫，二十年才完毕了。

chapters.en: Solomon rebuilt the cities Hiram had given him and settled Israelites there.
chapters.zh: 以后所罗门重新修筑希兰送给他的那些城邑，使以色列人住在那里。

chapters.en: Then Solomon went to Hamath-zobah and captured it.
chapters.zh: 所罗门往哈马琐巴去，攻取了那地方。

chapters.en: He built Tadmor in the wilderness, in addition to all the store cities that he had built in Hamath.
chapters.zh: 所罗门建造旷野里的达莫，又建造哈马所有的积货城，

chapters.en: He rebuilt Upper and Lower Beth-horon as fortified cities with walls, gates, and bars,
chapters.zh: 又建造上伯‧和崙、下伯‧和崙作为保障，都有墙，有门，有闩；

chapters.en: as well as Baalath, all the store cities that belonged to Solomon, and all the cities for his chariots and horses —whatever he desired to build in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and throughout the land of his dominion.
chapters.zh: 又建造巴拉和所有的积货城，并屯车辆马兵的城，与耶路撒冷、黎巴嫩，以及自己治理的全国中所愿意建造的。

chapters.en: As for all the people who remained of the Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites (these people were not Israelites)—
chapters.zh: 至于国中所剩下不属以色列人的赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，

chapters.en: their descendants who remained in the land, those whom the Israelites had not destroyed—Solomon conscripted these people to be forced laborers, as they are to this day.
chapters.zh: 就是以色列人未曾灭绝的，所罗门挑取他们的后裔作服苦的〔奴仆〕，直到今日。

chapters.en: But Solomon did not consign any of the Israelites to slave labor, because they were his men of war, the leaders of his captains, and the commanders of his chariots and cavalry.
chapters.zh: 惟有以色列人，所罗门不使他们当奴仆做工，乃是作他的战士、军长的统领、车兵长、马兵长。

chapters.en: They were also the chief officers for King Solomon: 250 supervisors.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王有二百五十督工的，监管工人。

chapters.en: Solomon brought the daughter of Pharaoh up from the City of David to the palace he had built for her. For he said, “My wife must not live in the house of David king of Israel, because the places the ark of the LORD has entered are holy.”
chapters.zh: 所罗门将法老的女儿带出大卫城，上到为她建造的宫里；因所罗门说：「耶和华〔约〕柜所到之处都为圣地，所以我的妻不可住在以色列王大卫的宫里。」

chapters.en: At that time Solomon offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of the LORD he had built in front of the portico.
chapters.zh: 所罗门在耶和华的坛上，就是在廊子前他所筑的坛上，与耶和华献燔祭；

chapters.en: He observed the daily requirement for offerings according to the commandment of Moses for Sabbaths, New Moons, and the three annual appointed feasts—the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Tabernacles.
chapters.zh: 又遵着摩西的吩咐在安息日、月朔，并一年三节，就是除酵节、七七节、住棚节，献每日所当献的祭。

chapters.en: In keeping with the ordinances of his father David, Solomon appointed the divisions of the priests over their service, and the Levites for their duties to offer praise and to minister before the priests according to the daily requirement. He also appointed gatekeepers by their divisions at each gate, for this had been the command of David, the man of God.
chapters.zh: 所罗门照着他父大卫所定的例，派定祭司的班次，使他们各供己事，又使利未人各尽其职，赞美〔耶和华〕，在祭司面前做每日所当做的；又派守门的按着班次看守各门，因为神人大卫是这样吩咐的。

chapters.en: They did not turn aside from the king’s command regarding the priests or the Levites in any matter, including that of the treasuries.
chapters.zh: 王所吩咐众祭司和利未人的，无论是管府库或办别的事，他们都不违背。

chapters.en: Thus all the work of Solomon was carried out, from the day the foundation was laid for the house of the LORD until it was finished. So the house of the LORD was completed.
chapters.zh: 所罗门建造耶和华的殿，从立根基直到成功的日子，工料俱备。这样，耶和华的殿全然完毕。

chapters.en: Then Solomon went to Ezion-geber and to Eloth on the coast of Edom.
chapters.zh: 那时，所罗门往以东地靠海的以旬‧迦别和以禄去。

chapters.en: So Hiram sent him ships captained by his servants, along with crews of experienced sailors. They went with Solomon’s servants to Ophir and acquired from there 450 talents of gold, which they delivered to King Solomon.
chapters.zh: 希兰差遣他的臣仆，将船只和熟悉泛海的仆人送到所罗门那里。他们同着所罗门的仆人到了俄斐，得了四百五十他连得金子，运到所罗门王那里。

chapters.en:
Now when the queen of Sheba heard about the fame of Solomon, she came to test him with difficult questions. She arrived in Jerusalem with a very large caravan—with camels bearing spices, gold in abundance, and precious stones.
And she came to Solomon and spoke with him about all that was on her mind.
chapters.zh: 示巴女王听见所罗门的名声，就来到耶路撒冷，要用难解的话试问所罗门；跟随她的人甚多，又有骆驼驮着香料、宝石，和许多金子。她来见了所罗门，就把心里所有的对所罗门都说出来。

chapters.en: And Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too difficult for him to explain.
chapters.zh: 所罗门将她所问的都答上了，没有一句不明白、不能答的。

chapters.en: When the queen of Sheba saw the wisdom of Solomon, the palace he had built,
chapters.zh: 示巴女王见所罗门的智慧和他所建造的宫室、

chapters.en: the food at his table, the seating of his servants, the service and attire of his attendants, the attire of his cupbearers, and the burnt offerings he presented at the house of the LORD, it took her breath away.
chapters.zh: 席上的珍馐美味、群臣分列而坐、仆人两旁侍立，以及他们的衣服装饰、酒政，和酒政的衣服装饰，又见他上耶和华殿的台阶，就诧异得神不守舍，

chapters.en: She said to the king, “The report I heard in my own country about your words and wisdom is true.
chapters.zh: 对王说：「我在本国里所听见论到你的事和你的智慧实在是真的！

chapters.en: But I did not believe the reports until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not half of the greatness of your wisdom was told to me. You have far exceeded the report I heard.
chapters.zh: 我先不信那些话，及至我来亲眼见了，才知道你的大智慧；人所告诉我的，还不到一半；你的实迹越过我所听见的名声。

chapters.en: How blessed are your men! How blessed are these servants of yours who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom!
chapters.zh: 你的群臣、你的仆人常侍立在你面前听你智慧的话是有福的。

chapters.en: Blessed be the LORD your God, who has delighted in you to set you on His throne to be king for the LORD your God. Because your God loved Israel enough to establish them forever, He has made you king over them to carry out justice and righteousness.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你的上帝是应当称颂的！他喜悦你，使你坐他的国位，为耶和华－你的上帝作王；因为你的上帝爱以色列人，要永远坚立他们，所以立你作他们的王，使你秉公行义。」

chapters.en: Then she gave the king 120 talents of gold, a great quantity of spices, and precious stones. There had never been such spices as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
chapters.zh: 于是示巴女王将一百二十他连得金子和宝石，与极多的香料送给所罗门王；她送给王的香料，〔以后〕再没有这样的。

chapters.en: (The servants of Hiram and of Solomon who brought gold from Ophir also brought algum wood and precious stones.
chapters.zh: 希兰的仆人和所罗门的仆人从俄斐运了金子来，也运了檀香木〔注：或译：乌木；下同〕和宝石来。

chapters.en: The king made the algum wood into steps for the house of the LORD and for the king’s palace, and into lyres and harps for the singers. Never before had anything like them been seen in the land of Judah.)
chapters.zh: 王用檀香木为耶和华殿和王宫做台，又为歌唱的人做琴瑟；犹大地从来没有见过这样的。

chapters.en: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired—whatever she asked—far more than she had brought the king. Then she left and returned to her own country, along with her servants.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王按示巴女王所带来的，还她礼物，另外照她一切所要所求的，都送给她。于是女王和她臣仆转回本国去了。

chapters.en: The weight of gold that came to Solomon each year was 666 talents,
chapters.zh: 所罗门每年所得的金子共有六百六十六他连得，

chapters.en: not including the revenue from the merchants and traders. And all the Arabian kings and governors of the land also brought gold and silver to Solomon.
chapters.zh: 另外还有商人所进的金子，并且阿拉伯诸王与〔属〕国的省长都带金银给所罗门。

chapters.en: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred shekels of hammered gold went into each shield.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王用锤出来的金子打成挡牌二百面，每面用金子六百〔舍客勒〕；

chapters.en: He also made three hundred small shields of hammered gold; three hundred shekels of gold went into each shield. And the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
chapters.zh: 又用锤出来的金子打成盾牌三百面，每面用金子三百〔舍客勒〕，都放在黎巴嫩林宫里。

chapters.en: Additionally, the king made a great throne of ivory and overlaid it with pure gold.
chapters.zh: 王用象牙制造一个大宝座，用精金包裹。

chapters.en: The throne had six steps, and a footstool of gold was attached to it. There were armrests on both sides of the seat, with a lion standing beside each armrest.
chapters.zh: 宝座有六层台阶，又有金脚凳，与宝座相连。宝座两旁有扶手，靠近扶手有两个狮子站立。

chapters.en: Twelve lions stood on the six steps, one at either end of each step. Nothing like this had ever been made for any kingdom.
chapters.zh: 六层台阶上有十二个狮子站立，每层有两个：左边一个，右边一个；在列国中没有这样做的。

chapters.en: All King Solomon’s drinking cups were gold, and all the utensils of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. There was no silver, because it was accounted as nothing in the days of Solomon.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王一切的饮器都是金的，黎巴嫩林宫里的一切器皿都是精金的。所罗门年间，银子算不了什么。

chapters.en: For the king had the ships of Tarshish that went with Hiram’s servants, and once every three years the ships of Tarshish would arrive bearing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
chapters.zh: 因为王的船只与希兰的仆人一同往他施去；他施船只三年一次装载金、银、象牙、猿猴、孔雀回来。

chapters.en: So King Solomon surpassed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
chapters.zh: 所罗门王的财宝与智慧胜过天下的列王。

chapters.en: All the kings of the earth sought an audience with Solomon to hear the wisdom that God had put in his heart.
chapters.zh: 普天下的王都求见所罗门，要听上帝赐给他智慧的话。

chapters.en: Year after year, each visitor would bring his tribute: articles of silver and gold, clothing, weapons, spices, horses, and mules.
chapters.zh: 他们各带贡物，就是金器、银器、衣服、军械、香料、骡马，每年有一定之例。

chapters.en: Solomon had 4,000 stalls for horses and chariots, and 12,000 horses, which he stationed in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 所罗门有套车的马四千棚，有马兵一万二千，安置在屯车的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那里。

chapters.en: He reigned over all the kings from the Euphrates to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 所罗门统管诸王，从大河到非利士地，直到埃及的边界。

chapters.en: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as abundant as sycamore in the foothills.
chapters.zh: 王在耶路撒冷使银子多如石头，香柏木多如高原的桑树。

chapters.en: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from all the lands.
chapters.zh: 有人从埃及和各国为所罗门赶马群来。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Solomon, from beginning to end, are they not written in the Records of Nathan the Prophet, in the Prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the Visions of Iddo the Seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat?
chapters.zh: 所罗门其余的事，自始至终，不都写在先知拿单的书上和示罗人亚希雅的预言书上，并先见易多论尼八儿子耶罗波安的默示书上吗？

chapters.en: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
chapters.zh: 所罗门在耶路撒冷作以色列众人的王共四十年。

chapters.en: And Solomon rested with his fathers and was buried in the city of his father David. And his son Rehoboam reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 所罗门与他列祖同睡，葬在他父大卫城里。他儿子罗波安接续他作王。

chapters.en: Then Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had gone there to make him king.
chapters.zh: 罗波安往示剑去，因为以色列人都到了示剑，要立他作王。

chapters.en: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard about this, he returned from Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon.
chapters.zh: 尼八的儿子耶罗波安先前躲避所罗门王，逃往埃及，住在那里；他听见这事，就从埃及回来。

chapters.en: So they sent for Jeroboam, and he and all Israel came to Rehoboam and said,
chapters.zh: 以色列人打发人去请他，他就和以色列众人来见罗波安，对他说：

chapters.en: “Your father put a heavy yoke on us. But now you must lighten the burden of your father’s service and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you.”
chapters.zh: 「你父亲使我们负重轭〔做苦工〕，现在求你使我们做的苦工负的重轭轻松些，我们就事奉你。」

chapters.en: Rehoboam answered, “Come back to me in three days.” So the people departed.
chapters.zh: 罗波安对他们说：「第三日再来见我吧！」民就去了。

chapters.en: Then King Rehoboam consulted with the elders who had served his father Solomon during his lifetime. “How do you advise me to respond to these people?” he asked.
chapters.zh: 罗波安之父所罗门在世的日子，有侍立在他面前的老年人，罗波安王和他们商议，说：「你们给我出个什么主意，我好回复这民。」

chapters.en: They replied, “If you will be kind to these people and please them by speaking kind words to them, they will be your servants forever.”
chapters.zh: 老年人对他说：「王若恩待这民，使他们喜悦，用好话回复他们，他们就永远作王的仆人。」

chapters.en: But Rehoboam rejected the advice of the elders; instead, he consulted the young men who had grown up with him and served him.
chapters.zh: 王却不用老年人给他出的主意，就和那些与他一同长大、在他面前侍立的少年人商议，

chapters.en: He asked them, “What message do you advise that we send back to these people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Lighten the yoke your father put on us’?”
chapters.zh: 说：「这民对我说：『你父亲使我们负重轭，求你使我们轻松些』；你们给我出个什么主意，我好回复他们。」

chapters.en: The young men who had grown up with him replied, “This is how you should answer these people who said to you, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but you must make it lighter.’ This is what you should tell them: ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist!
chapters.zh: 那同他长大的少年人说：「这民对王说：『你父亲使我们负重轭，求你使我们轻松些』；王要对他们如此说：『我的小拇指比我父亲的腰还粗；

chapters.en: Whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.’”
chapters.zh: 我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭；我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蠍子〔鞭责打你们〕。』」

chapters.en: After three days, Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam, since the king had said, “Come back to me on the third day.”
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安和众百姓遵着罗波安王所说「你们第三日再来见我」的那话，第三日他们果然来了。

chapters.en: And the king answered them harshly. King Rehoboam rejected the advice of the elders
chapters.zh: 罗波安王用严厉的话回复他们，不用老年人所出的主意，

chapters.en: and spoke to them as the young men had advised, saying, “Whereas my father made your yoke heavy, I will add to your yoke. Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.”
chapters.zh: 照着少年人所出的主意对他们说：「我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭；我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蠍子〔鞭责打你们〕。」

chapters.en: So the king did not listen to the people, and indeed this turn of events was from God, in order that the LORD might fulfill the word that He had spoken through Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam son of Nebat.
chapters.zh: 王不肯依从百姓；这事乃出于上帝，为要应验耶和华藉示罗人亚希雅对尼八儿子耶罗波安所说的话。

chapters.en:
When all Israel saw that the king had refused to listen to them, they answered the king:
“What portion do we have in David, and what inheritance in the son of Jesse? To your tents, O Israel! Look now to your own house, O David!”
So all the Israelites went home,
chapters.zh: 以色列众民见王不依从他们，就对王说： 我们与大卫有什么分儿呢？ 与耶西的儿子并没有关涉！ 以色列人哪，各回各家去吧！ 大卫家啊，自己顾自己吧！ 于是，以色列众人都回自己家里去了。

chapters.en: but Rehoboam still reigned over the Israelites living in the cities of Judah.
chapters.zh: 惟独住在犹大城邑的以色列人，罗波安仍作他们的王。

chapters.en: Then King Rehoboam sent out Hadoram, who was in charge of the forced labor, but the Israelites stoned him to death. And King Rehoboam mounted his chariot in haste and escaped to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 罗波安王差遣掌管服苦之人的哈多兰往以色列人那里去，以色列人就用石头打死他。罗波安王急忙上车，逃回耶路撒冷去了。

chapters.en: So to this day Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David.
chapters.zh: 这样，以色列人背叛大卫家，直到今日。

chapters.en: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mobilized the house of Judah and Benjamin—180,000 chosen warriors—to fight against Israel and restore the kingdom to Rehoboam.
chapters.zh: 罗波安来到耶路撒冷，招聚犹大家和便雅悯家，共十八万人，都是挑选的战士，要与以色列人争战，好将国夺回再归自己。

chapters.en: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God:
chapters.zh: 但耶和华的话临到神人示玛雅说：

chapters.en: “Tell Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah and all the Israelites in Judah and Benjamin
chapters.zh: 「你去告诉所罗门的儿子犹大王罗波安和住犹大、便雅悯的以色列众人说，

chapters.en:
that this is what the LORD says: ‘You are not to go up and fight against your brothers. Each of you must return home, for this is My doing.’”
So they listened to the words of the LORD and turned back from going against Jeroboam.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：『你们不可上去与你们的弟兄争战，各归各家去吧！因为这事出于我。』」众人就听从耶和华的话归回，不去与耶罗波安争战。

chapters.en: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, and he built up cities for defense in Judah.
chapters.zh: 罗波安住在耶路撒冷，在犹大地修筑城邑，

chapters.en: He built up Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
chapters.zh: 为保障修筑伯利恒、以坦、提哥亚、

chapters.en: Beth-zur, Soco, Adullam,
chapters.zh: 伯‧夙、梭哥、亚杜兰、

chapters.en: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
chapters.zh: 迦特、玛利沙、西弗、

chapters.en: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
chapters.zh: 亚多莱音、拉吉、亚西加、

chapters.en: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, the fortified cities in Judah and Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 琐拉、亚雅崙、希伯崙。这都是犹大和便雅悯的坚固城。

chapters.en: He strengthened their fortifications and put officers in them, with supplies of food, oil, and wine.
chapters.zh: 罗波安又坚固各处的保障，在其中安置军长，又预备下粮食、油、酒。

chapters.en: He also put shields and spears in all the cities and strengthened them greatly. So Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.
chapters.zh: 他在各城里〔预备〕盾牌和枪，且使城极其坚固。犹大和便雅悯都归了他。

chapters.en: Moreover, the priests and Levites from all their districts throughout Israel stood with Rehoboam.
chapters.zh: 以色列全地的祭司和利未人都从四方来归罗波安。

chapters.en: For the Levites left their pasturelands and their possessions and went to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons had rejected them as priests of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 利未人撇下他们的郊野和产业，来到犹大与耶路撒冷，是因耶罗波安和他的儿子拒绝他们，不许他们供祭司职分事奉耶和华。

chapters.en: And Jeroboam appointed his own priests for the high places and for the goat demons and calf idols he had made.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安为邱坛、为鬼魔〔注：原文是公山羊〕、为自己所铸造的牛犊设立祭司。

chapters.en: Those from every tribe of Israel who had set their hearts to seek the LORD their God followed the Levites to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the LORD, the God of their fathers.
chapters.zh: 以色列各支派中，凡立定心意寻求耶和华－以色列上帝的，都随从利未人，来到耶路撒冷祭祀耶和华－他们列祖的上帝。

chapters.en: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah and supported Rehoboam son of Solomon for three years, because they walked for three years in the way of David and Solomon.
chapters.zh: 这样，就坚固犹大国，使所罗门的儿子罗波安强盛三年，因为他们三年遵行大卫和所罗门的道。
