chapters.en: And Rehoboam married Mahalath, who was the daughter of David’s son Jerimoth and of Abihail, the daughter of Jesse’s son Eliab.
chapters.zh: 罗波安娶大卫儿子耶利摩的女儿玛哈拉为妻，又娶耶西儿子以利押的女儿亚比孩为妻。

chapters.en: She bore sons to him: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
chapters.zh: 从她生了几个儿子，就是耶乌施、示玛利雅、撒罕。

chapters.en: After her, he married Maacah daughter of Absalom, and she bore to him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
chapters.zh: 后来又娶押沙龙的女儿玛迦〔注：十三章二节是乌列的女儿米该亚〕，从她生了亚比雅、亚太、细撒、示罗密。

chapters.en: Rehoboam loved Maacah daughter of Absalom more than all his wives and concubines. In all, he had eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and he was the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.
chapters.zh: 罗波安娶十八个妻，立六十个妾，生二十八个儿子，六十个女儿；他却爱押沙龙的女儿玛迦，比爱别的妻妾更甚。

chapters.en: Rehoboam appointed Abijah son of Maacah as chief prince among his brothers, intending to make him king.
chapters.zh: 罗波安立玛迦的儿子亚比雅作太子，在他弟兄中为首，因为〔想要〕立他接续作王。

chapters.en: Rehoboam also acted wisely by dispersing some of his sons throughout the districts of Judah and Benjamin, and to all the fortified cities. He gave them abundant provisions and sought many wives for them.
chapters.zh: 罗波安办事精明，使他众子分散在犹大和便雅悯全地各坚固城里，又赐他们许多粮食，〔为他们〕多寻妻子。

chapters.en: After Rehoboam had established his sovereignty and royal power, he and all Israel with him forsook the Law of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 罗波安的国坚立，他强盛的时候就离弃耶和华的律法，以色列人也都随从他。

chapters.en: In the fifth year of Rehoboam’s reign, because they had been unfaithful to the LORD, Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem
chapters.zh: 罗波安王第五年，埃及王示撒上来攻打耶路撒冷，因为王和民得罪了耶和华。

chapters.en: with 1,200 chariots, 60,000 horsemen, and countless troops who came with him out of Egypt—Libyans, Sukkites, and Cushites.
chapters.zh: 示撒带战车一千二百辆，马兵六万，并且跟从他出埃及的路比人、苏基人，和古实人，多得不可胜数。

chapters.en: He captured the fortified cities of Judah and came as far as Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 他攻取了犹大的坚固城，就来到耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Then Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and the leaders of Judah who had gathered at Jerusalem because of Shishak, and he said to them, “This is what the LORD says: ‘You have forsaken Me; therefore, I have forsaken you into the hand of Shishak.’”
chapters.zh: 那时，犹大的首领因为示撒就聚集在耶路撒冷。有先知示玛雅去见罗波安和众首领，对他们说：「耶和华如此说：『你们离弃了我，所以我使你们落在示撒手里。』」

chapters.en: So the leaders of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said, “The LORD is righteous.”
chapters.zh: 于是王和以色列的众首领都自卑说：「耶和华是公义的。」

chapters.en: When the LORD saw that they had humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, “They have humbled themselves; I will not destroy them, but will soon grant them deliverance. My wrath will not be poured out on Jerusalem through Shishak.
chapters.zh: 耶和华见他们自卑，耶和华的话就临到示玛雅说：「他们既自卑，我必不灭绝他们；必使他们略得拯救，我不藉着示撒的手将我的怒气倒在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, they will become his servants, so that they may learn the difference between serving Me and serving the kings of other lands.”
chapters.zh: 然而他们必作示撒的仆人，好叫他们知道，服事我与服事外邦人有何分别。」

chapters.en: So King Shishak of Egypt attacked Jerusalem and seized the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the royal palace. He took everything, including the gold shields that Solomon had made.
chapters.zh: 于是，埃及王示撒上来攻取耶路撒冷，夺了耶和华殿和王宫里的宝物，尽都带走，又夺去所罗门制造的金盾牌。

chapters.en: Then King Rehoboam made bronze shields in their place and committed them to the care of the captains of the guard on duty at the entrance to the royal palace.
chapters.zh: 罗波安王制造铜盾牌代替那金盾牌，交给守王宫门的护卫长看守。

chapters.en: And whenever the king entered the house of the LORD, the guards would go with him, bearing the shields, and later they would return them to the guardroom.
chapters.zh: 王每逢进耶和华的殿，护卫兵就拿这盾牌，随后仍将盾牌送回，放在护卫房。

chapters.en: Because Rehoboam humbled himself, the anger of the LORD turned away from him, and He did not destroy him completely. Indeed, conditions were good in Judah.
chapters.zh: 王自卑的时候，耶和华的怒气就转消了，不将他灭尽，并且在犹大中间也有善益的事。

chapters.en: Thus King Rehoboam established himself in Jerusalem and reigned. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the LORD had chosen from all the tribes of Israel in which to put His Name. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonite.
chapters.zh: 罗波安王自强，在耶路撒冷作王。他登基的时候年四十一岁，在耶路撒冷，就是耶和华从以色列众支派中所选择立他名的城，作王十七年。罗波安的母亲名叫拿玛，是亚扪人。

chapters.en: And Rehoboam did evil because he did not set his heart to seek the LORD.
chapters.zh: 罗波安行恶，因他不立定心意寻求耶和华。

chapters.en: Now the acts of Rehoboam, from first to last, are they not written in the records of Shemaiah the Prophet and of Iddo the Seer concerning the genealogies? There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam throughout their days.
chapters.zh: 罗波安所行的事，自始至终不都写在先知示玛雅和先见易多的史记上吗？罗波安与耶罗波安时常争战。

chapters.en: And Rehoboam rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David. And his son Abijah reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 罗波安与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城里。他儿子亚比雅接续他作王。

chapters.en: In the eighteenth year of Jeroboam’s reign, Abijah became king of Judah,
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安王十八年，亚比雅登基作犹大王，

chapters.en:
and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother’s name was Micaiah daughter of Uriel; she was from Gibeah.
And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
chapters.zh: 在耶路撒冷作王三年。他母亲名叫米该亚〔注：又作玛迦〕，是基比亚人乌列的女儿。 亚比雅常与耶罗波安争战。

chapters.en: Abijah went into battle with an army of 400,000 chosen men, while Jeroboam drew up in formation against him with 800,000 chosen and mighty men of valor.
chapters.zh: 有一次亚比雅率领挑选的兵四十万摆阵，都是勇敢的战士；耶罗波安也挑选大能的勇士八十万，对亚比雅摆阵。

chapters.en: Then Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim in the hill country of Ephraim and said, “Hear me, O Jeroboam and all Israel!
chapters.zh: 亚比雅站在以法莲山地中的洗玛脸山上，说：「耶罗波安和以色列众人哪，要听我说！

chapters.en: Do you not know that the LORD, the God of Israel, has given the kingship of Israel to David and his descendants forever by a covenant of salt ?
chapters.zh: 耶和华－以色列的上帝曾立盐约〔注：盐就是不废坏的意思〕，将以色列国永远赐给大卫和他的子孙，你们不知道吗？

chapters.en: Yet Jeroboam son of Nebat, a servant of Solomon son of David, rose up and rebelled against his master.
chapters.zh: 无奈大卫儿子所罗门的臣仆、尼八儿子耶罗波安起来背叛他的主人。

chapters.en: Then worthless and wicked men gathered around him to resist Rehoboam son of Solomon when he was young, inexperienced, and unable to resist them.
chapters.zh: 有些无赖的匪徒聚集跟从他，逞强攻击所罗门的儿子罗波安；那时罗波安还幼弱，不能抵挡他们。

chapters.en: And now you think you can resist the kingdom of the LORD, which is in the hands of David’s descendants. You are indeed a vast army, and you have with you the golden calves that Jeroboam made for you as gods.
chapters.zh: 「现在你们有意抗拒大卫子孙手下所治耶和华的国，你们的人也甚多，你们那里又有耶罗波安为你们所造当作神的金牛犊。

chapters.en: But did you not drive out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites? And did you not make priests for yourselves as do the peoples of other lands? Now whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams can become a priest of things that are not gods.
chapters.zh: 你们不是驱逐耶和华的祭司亚伦的后裔和利未人吗？不是照着外邦人的恶俗为自己立祭司吗？无论何人牵一只公牛犊、七只公绵羊将自己分别出来，就可作虚无之神的祭司。

chapters.en: But as for us, the LORD is our God. We have not forsaken Him; the priests who minister to the LORD are sons of Aaron, and the Levites attend to their duties.
chapters.zh: 至于我们，耶和华是我们的上帝，我们并没有离弃他。我们有事奉耶和华的祭司，都是亚伦的后裔，并有利未人各尽其职，

chapters.en: Every morning and every evening they present burnt offerings and fragrant incense to the LORD. They set out the rows of showbread on the ceremonially clean table, and every evening they light the lamps of the gold lampstand. We are carrying out the requirements of the LORD our God, while you have forsaken Him.
chapters.zh: 每日早晚向耶和华献燔祭，烧美香，又在精〔金〕的桌子上摆陈设饼；又有金灯台和灯盏，每晚点起，因为我们遵守耶和华－我们上帝的命；惟有你们离弃了他。

chapters.en: Now behold, God Himself is with us as our head, and His priests with their trumpets sound the battle call against you. O children of Israel, do not fight against the LORD, the God of your fathers, for you will not succeed.”
chapters.zh: 率领我们的是上帝，我们这里也有上帝的祭司拿号向你们吹出大声。以色列人哪，不要与耶和华－你们列祖的上帝争战，因你们必不能亨通。」

chapters.en: Now Jeroboam had sent troops around to ambush from the rear, so that while he was in front of Judah, the ambush was behind them.
chapters.zh: 耶罗波安却在犹大人的后头设伏兵。这样，以色列人在犹大人的前头，伏兵在犹大人的后头。

chapters.en: When Judah turned and discovered that the battle was both before and behind them, they cried out to the LORD. Then the priests blew the trumpets,
chapters.zh: 犹大人回头观看，见前后都有敌兵，就呼求耶和华，祭司也吹号。

chapters.en: and the men of Judah raised the battle cry. And when they raised the cry, God routed Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
chapters.zh: 于是犹大人吶喊；犹大人吶喊的时候，上帝就使耶罗波安和以色列众人败在亚比雅与犹大人面前。

chapters.en: So the Israelites fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hands.
chapters.zh: 以色列人在犹大人面前逃跑，上帝将他们交在犹大人手里。

chapters.en: Then Abijah and his people struck them with a mighty blow, and 500,000 chosen men of Israel fell slain.
chapters.zh: 亚比雅和他的军兵大大杀戮以色列人，以色列人仆倒死亡的精兵有五十万。

chapters.en: Thus the Israelites were subdued at that time, and the men of Judah prevailed because they relied on the LORD, the God of their fathers.
chapters.zh: 那时，以色列人被制伏了，犹大人得胜，是因倚靠耶和华－他们列祖的上帝。

chapters.en: Abijah pursued Jeroboam and captured some cities from him: Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephron, along with their villages.
chapters.zh: 亚比雅追赶耶罗波安，攻取了他的几座城，就是伯特利和属伯特利的镇市，耶沙拿和属耶沙拿的镇市，以法拉音〔注：或译：以弗伦〕和属以法拉音的镇市。

chapters.en: Jeroboam did not again recover his power during the days of Abijah, and the LORD struck him down and he died.
chapters.zh: 亚比雅在世的时候，耶罗波安不能再强盛；耶和华攻击他，他就死了。

chapters.en: But Abijah grew strong, married fourteen wives, and became the father of twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.
chapters.zh: 亚比雅却渐渐强盛，娶妻妾十四个，生了二十二个儿子，十六个女儿。

chapters.en: Now the rest of the acts of Abijah, along with his ways and his words, are written in the Treatise of the Prophet Iddo.
chapters.zh: 亚比雅其余的事和他的言行都写在先知易多的传上。

chapters.en: Then Abijah rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David. And his son Asa reigned in his place, and in his days the land was at peace for ten years.
chapters.zh: 亚比雅与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城里。他儿子亚撒接续他作王。亚撒年间，国中太平十年。

chapters.en: And Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God.
chapters.zh: 亚撒行耶和华－他上帝眼中看为善为正的事，

chapters.en: He removed the foreign altars and high places, shattered the sacred pillars, and chopped down the Asherah poles.
chapters.zh: 除掉外邦神的坛和邱坛，打碎柱像，砍下木偶，

chapters.en: He commanded the people of Judah to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, and to observe the law and the commandments.
chapters.zh: 吩咐犹大人寻求耶和华－他们列祖的上帝，遵行他的律法、诫命；

chapters.en: He also removed the high places and incense altars from all the cities of Judah, and under him the kingdom was at peace.
chapters.zh: 又在犹大各城邑除掉邱坛和日像，那时国享太平；

chapters.en: Because the land was at peace, Asa built fortified cities in Judah. In those days no one made war with him, because the LORD had given him rest.
chapters.zh: 又在犹大建造了几座坚固城。国中太平数年，没有战争，因为耶和华赐他平安。

chapters.en: So he said to the people of Judah, “Let us build these cities and surround them with walls and towers, with doors and bars. The land is still ours because we have sought the LORD our God. We have sought Him, and He has given us rest on every side.” So they built and prospered.
chapters.zh: 他对犹大人说：「我们要建造这些城邑，四围筑墙，盖楼，安门，做闩；地还属我们，是因寻求耶和华－我们的上帝；我们既寻求他，他就赐我们四境平安。」于是建造城邑，诸事亨通。

chapters.en: Asa had an army of 300,000 men from Judah bearing large shields and spears, and 280,000 men from Benjamin bearing small shields and drawing the bow. All these were mighty men of valor.
chapters.zh: 亚撒的军兵，出自犹大拿盾牌拿枪的三十万人；出自便雅悯拿盾牌拉弓的二十八万人。这都是大能的勇士。

chapters.en: Then Zerah the Cushite came against them with an army of 1,000,000 men and 300 chariots, and they advanced as far as Mareshah.
chapters.zh: 有古实王谢拉率领军兵一百万，战车三百辆，出来攻击犹大人，到了玛利沙。

chapters.en: So Asa marched out against him and lined up in battle formation in the Valley of Zephathah near Mareshah.
chapters.zh: 于是亚撒出去与他迎敌，就在玛利沙的洗法谷彼此摆阵。

chapters.en: Then Asa cried out to the LORD his God: “O LORD, there is no one besides You to help the powerless against the mighty. Help us, O LORD our God, for we rely on You, and in Your name we have come against this multitude. O LORD, You are our God. Do not let a mere mortal prevail against You.”
chapters.zh: 亚撒呼求耶和华－他的上帝说：「耶和华啊，惟有你能帮助软弱的，胜过强盛的。耶和华－我们的上帝啊，求你帮助我们；因为我们仰赖你，奉你的名来攻击这大军。耶和华啊，你是我们的上帝，不要容人胜过你。」

chapters.en: So the LORD struck down the Cushites before Asa and Judah, and the Cushites fled.
chapters.zh: 于是耶和华使古实人败在亚撒和犹大人面前，古实人就逃跑了；

chapters.en: Then Asa and his army pursued them as far as Gerar. The Cushites fell and could not recover, for they were crushed before the LORD and His army. So the people of Judah carried off a great amount of plunder
chapters.zh: 亚撒和跟随他的军兵追赶他们，直到基拉耳。古实人被杀的甚多，不能再强盛，因为败在耶和华与他军兵面前。犹大人就夺了许多财物，

chapters.en: and attacked all the cities around Gerar, because the terror of the LORD had fallen upon them. They plundered all the cities, since there was much plunder there.
chapters.zh: 又打破基拉耳四围的城邑；耶和华使其中的人都甚恐惧。犹大人又将所有的城掳掠一空，因其中的财物甚多，

chapters.en: They also attacked the tents of the herdsmen and carried off many sheep and camels. Then they returned to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 又毁坏了群畜的圈，夺取许多的羊和骆驼，就回耶路撒冷去了。

chapters.en: Now the Spirit of God came upon Azariah son of Oded.
chapters.zh: 上帝的灵感动俄德的儿子亚撒利雅。

chapters.en: So he went out to meet Asa and said to him, “Listen to me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin. The LORD is with you when you are with Him. If you seek Him, He will be found by you, but if you forsake Him, He will forsake you.
chapters.zh: 他出来迎接亚撒，对他说：「亚撒和犹大、便雅悯众人哪，要听我说：你们若顺从耶和华，耶和华必与你们同在；你们若寻求他，就必寻见；你们若离弃他，他必离弃你们。

chapters.en: For many years Israel has been without the true God, without a priest to instruct them, and without the law.
chapters.zh: 以色列人不信真神，没有训诲的祭司，也没有律法，已经好久了；

chapters.en: But in their distress they turned to the LORD, the God of Israel, and sought Him, and He was found by them.
chapters.zh: 但他们在急难的时候归向耶和华－以色列的上帝，寻求他，他就被他们寻见。

chapters.en: In those days there was no safety for travelers, because the residents of the lands had many conflicts.
chapters.zh: 那时，出入的人不得平安，列国的居民都遭大乱；

chapters.en: Nation was crushed by nation, and city by city, for God afflicted them with all kinds of adversity.
chapters.zh: 这国攻击那国，这城攻击那城，互相破坏，因为上帝用各样灾难扰乱他们。

chapters.en: But as for you, be strong; do not be discouraged, for your work will be rewarded.”
chapters.zh: 现在你们要刚强，不要手软，因你们所行的必得赏赐。」

chapters.en: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Azariah son of Oded the prophet, he took courage and removed the detestable idols from the whole land of Judah and Benjamin and from the cities he had captured in the hill country of Ephraim. He then restored the altar of the LORD that was in front of the portico of the LORD’s temple.
chapters.zh: 亚撒听见这话和俄德〔儿子〕先知亚撒利雅的预言，就壮起胆来，在犹大、便雅悯全地，并以法莲山地所夺的各城，将可憎之物尽都除掉，又在耶和华〔殿〕的廊前重新修筑耶和华的坛；

chapters.en: And he assembled all Judah and Benjamin, along with those from the tribes of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon who had settled among them, for great numbers had come over to him from Israel when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.
chapters.zh: 又招聚犹大、便雅悯的众人，并他们中间寄居的以法莲人、玛拿西人、西缅人。有许多以色列人归降亚撒，因见耶和华－他的上帝与他同在。

chapters.en: So they gathered together in Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.
chapters.zh: 亚撒十五年三月，他们都聚集在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: At that time they sacrificed to the LORD seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep from all the plunder they had brought back.
chapters.zh: 当日他们从所取的掳物中，将牛七百只、羊七千只献给耶和华。

chapters.en: Then they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and soul.
chapters.zh: 他们就立约，要尽心尽性地寻求耶和华－他们列祖的上帝。

chapters.en: And whoever would not seek the LORD, the God of Israel, would be put to death, whether young or old, man or woman.
chapters.zh: 凡不寻求耶和华－以色列上帝的，无论大小、男女，必被治死。

chapters.en: They took an oath to the LORD with a loud voice, with shouting, trumpets, and rams’ horns.
chapters.zh: 他们就大声欢呼，吹号吹角，向耶和华起誓。

chapters.en: And all Judah rejoiced over the oath, for they had sworn it with all their heart. They had sought Him earnestly, and He was found by them. So the LORD gave them rest on every side.
chapters.zh: 犹大众人为所起的誓欢喜；因他们是尽心起誓，尽意寻求耶和华，耶和华就被他们寻见，且赐他们四境平安。

chapters.en: King Asa also removed his grandmother Maacah from her position as queen mother because she had made a detestable Asherah pole. Asa chopped down the pole, crushed it, and burned it in the Kidron Valley.
chapters.zh: 亚撒王贬了他祖母玛迦太后的位，因她造了可憎的偶像亚舍拉。亚撒砍下她的偶像，捣得粉碎，烧在汲沦溪边。

chapters.en: The high places were not removed from Israel, but Asa’s heart was fully devoted all his days.
chapters.zh: 只是邱坛还没有从以色列中废去，然而亚撒的心一生诚实。

chapters.en: And he brought into the house of God the silver and gold and the articles that he and his father had dedicated.
chapters.zh: 亚撒将他父所分别为圣、与自己所分别为圣的金银和器皿都奉到上帝的殿里。

chapters.en: And there was no war until the thirty-fifth year of Asa’s reign.
chapters.zh: 从这时直到亚撒三十五年，都没有争战的事。

chapters.en: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa’s reign, Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah.
chapters.zh: 亚撒三十六年，以色列王巴沙上来攻击犹大，修筑拉玛，不许人从犹大王亚撒那里出入。

chapters.en: So Asa withdrew the silver and gold from the treasuries of the house of the LORD and the royal palace, and he sent it with this message to Ben-hadad king of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus:
chapters.zh: 于是亚撒从耶和华殿和王宫的府库里拿出金银来，送与住大马士革的亚兰王便‧哈达，说：

chapters.en: “Let there be a treaty between me and you as there was between my father and your father. See, I have sent you silver and gold. Now go and break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, so that he will withdraw from me.”
chapters.zh: 「你父曾与我父立约，我与你也要立约。现在我将金银送给你，求你废掉你与以色列王巴沙所立的约，使他离开我。」

chapters.en: And Ben-hadad listened to King Asa and sent the commanders of his armies against the cities of Israel, conquering Ijon, Dan, Abel-maim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.
chapters.zh: 便‧哈达听从亚撒王的话，派军长去攻击以色列的城邑。他们就攻破以云、但、亚伯‧玛音，和拿弗他利一切的积货城。

chapters.en: When Baasha learned of this, he stopped fortifying Ramah and abandoned his work.
chapters.zh: 巴沙听见就停工，不修筑拉玛了。

chapters.en: Then King Asa brought all the men of Judah, and they carried away the stones of Ramah and the timbers Baasha had used for building. And with these materials he built up Geba and Mizpah.
chapters.zh: 于是亚撒王率领犹大众人，将巴沙修筑拉玛所用的石头、木头都运去，用以修筑迦巴和米斯巴。

chapters.en: At that time Hanani the seer came to King Asa of Judah and told him, “Because you have relied on the king of Aram and not on the LORD your God, the army of the king of Aram has escaped from your hand.
chapters.zh: 那时，先见哈拿尼来见犹大王亚撒，对他说：「因你仰赖亚兰王，没有仰赖耶和华－你的上帝，所以亚兰王的军兵脱离了你的手。

chapters.en: Were not the Cushites and Libyans a vast army with many chariots and horsemen? Yet because you relied on the LORD, He delivered them into your hand.
chapters.zh: 古实人、路比人的军队不是甚大吗？战车马兵不是极多吗？只因你仰赖耶和华，他便将他们交在你手里。

chapters.en: For the eyes of the LORD roam to and fro over all the earth, to show Himself strong on behalf of those whose hearts are fully devoted to Him. You have acted foolishly in this matter. From now on, therefore, you will be at war.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华的眼目遍察全地，要显大能帮助向他心存诚实的人。你这事行得愚昧；此后，你必有争战的事。」

chapters.en: Asa was angry with the seer and became so enraged over this matter that he put the man in prison. And at the same time Asa oppressed some of the people.
chapters.zh: 亚撒因此恼恨先见，将他囚在监里。那时亚撒也虐待一些人民。

chapters.en: Now the acts of Asa, from beginning to end, are indeed written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
chapters.zh: 亚撒所行的事，自始至终都写在犹大和以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign, Asa became diseased in his feet, and his disease became increasingly severe. Yet even in his illness he did not seek the LORD, but only the physicians.
chapters.zh: 亚撒作王三十九年，他脚上有病，而且甚重。病的时候没有求耶和华，只求医生。

chapters.en: So in the forty-first year of his reign, Asa died and rested with his fathers.
chapters.zh: 他作王四十一年而死，与他列祖同睡，

chapters.en: And he was buried in the tomb that he had cut out for himself in the City of David. They laid him on a bier that was full of spices and various blended perfumes; then they made a great fire in his honor.
chapters.zh: 葬在大卫城自己所凿的坟墓里，放在床上，其床堆满各样馨香的香料，就是按做香的作法调和的香料，又为他烧了许多的物件。

chapters.en: Asa’s son Jehoshaphat reigned in his place, and he strengthened himself against Israel.
chapters.zh: 亚撒的儿子约沙法接续他作王，奋勇自强，防备以色列人，

chapters.en: He stationed troops in every fortified city of Judah and put garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.
chapters.zh: 安置军兵在犹大一切坚固城里，又安置防兵在犹大地和他父亚撒所得以法莲的城邑中。

chapters.en: Now the LORD was with Jehoshaphat because he walked in the earlier ways of his father David. He did not seek the Baals,
chapters.zh: 耶和华与约沙法同在；因为他行他祖大卫初行的道，不寻求巴力，

chapters.en: but he sought the God of his father and walked by His commandments rather than the practices of Israel.
chapters.zh: 只寻求他父亲的上帝，遵行他的诫命，不效法以色列人的行为。

chapters.en: So the LORD established the kingdom in his hand, and all Judah brought him tribute, so that he had an abundance of riches and honor.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华坚定他的国，犹大众人给他进贡；约沙法大有尊荣资财。

chapters.en: And his heart took delight in the ways of the LORD; furthermore, he removed the high places and Asherah poles from Judah.
chapters.zh: 他高兴遵行耶和华的道，并且从犹大除掉一切邱坛和木偶。

chapters.en: In the third year of his reign, Jehoshaphat sent his officials Ben-hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah to teach in the cities of Judah,
chapters.zh: 他作王第三年，就差遣臣子便‧亥伊勒、俄巴底、撒迦利雅、拿坦业、米该亚往犹大各城去教训百姓。

chapters.en: accompanied by certain Levites—Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah—along with the priests Elishama and Jehoram.
chapters.zh: 同着他们有利未人示玛雅、尼探雅、西巴第雅、亚撒黑、示米拉末、约拿单、亚多尼雅、多比雅、驼‧巴多尼雅，又有祭司以利沙玛、约兰同着他们。

chapters.en: They taught throughout Judah, taking with them the Book of the Law of the LORD. They went throughout the towns of Judah and taught the people.
chapters.zh: 他们带着耶和华的律法书，走遍犹大各城教训百姓。

chapters.en: And the dread of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that surrounded Judah, so that they did not make war against Jehoshaphat.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使犹大四围的列国都甚恐惧，不敢与约沙法争战。

chapters.en: Some Philistines also brought gifts and silver as tribute to Jehoshaphat, and the Arabs brought him 7,700 rams and 7,700 goats from their flocks.
chapters.zh: 有些非利士人与约沙法送礼物，纳贡银。阿拉伯人也送他公绵羊七千七百只，公山羊七千七百只。

chapters.en: Jehoshaphat grew stronger and stronger, and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah
chapters.zh: 约沙法日渐强大，在犹大建造营寨和积货城。

chapters.en: and kept vast supplies in the cities of Judah. He also had warriors in Jerusalem who were mighty men of valor.
chapters.zh: 他在犹大城邑中有许多工程，又在耶路撒冷有战士，就是大能的勇士。
他们的数目，按着宗族，记在下面：犹大族的千夫长押拿为首率领大能的勇士－三十万；

chapters.en: next to him, Jehohanan the commander, and with him 280,000;
chapters.zh: 其次是，千夫长约哈难率领〔大能的勇士〕－二十八万；

chapters.en: and next to him, Amasiah son of Zichri, the volunteer for the LORD, and with him 200,000 mighty men of valor.
chapters.zh: 其次是，细基利的儿子亚玛斯雅（他为耶和华牺牲自己）率领大能的勇士－二十万。

chapters.en:
From Benjamin:
Eliada, a mighty man of valor, and with him 200,000 armed with bows and shields;
chapters.zh: 便雅悯族，是大能的勇士以利雅大率领拿弓箭和盾牌的－二十万；

chapters.en: and next to him, Jehozabad, and with him 180,000 armed for battle.
chapters.zh: 其次是，约萨拔率领预备打仗的－十八万。

chapters.en: These were the men who served the king, besides those he stationed in the fortified cities throughout Judah.
chapters.zh: 这都是伺候王的，还有王在犹大全地坚固城所安置的不在其内。

chapters.en: Now Jehoshaphat had an abundance of riches and honor, and he allied himself with Ahab by marriage.
chapters.zh: 约沙法大有尊荣资财，就与亚哈结亲。

chapters.en: And some years later he went down to visit Ahab in Samaria, where Ahab sacrificed many sheep and cattle for him and the people with him and urged him to march up to Ramoth-gilead.
chapters.zh: 过了几年，他下到撒马利亚去见亚哈；亚哈为他和跟从他的人宰了许多牛羊，劝他与自己同去攻取基列的拉末。

chapters.en:
Ahab king of Israel asked Jehoshaphat king of Judah, “Will you go with me against Ramoth-gilead?”
And Jehoshaphat replied, “I am as you are, and my people are your people; we will join you in the war.”
chapters.zh: 以色列王亚哈问犹大王约沙法说：「你肯同我去攻取基列的拉末吗？」他回答说：「你我不分彼此，我的民与你的民一样，必与你同去争战。」

chapters.en: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for the word of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 约沙法对以色列王说：「请你先求问耶和华。」

chapters.en:
So the king of Israel assembled the prophets, four hundred men, and asked them, “Should we go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or should we refrain?”
“Go up,” they replied, “and God will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
chapters.zh: 于是以色列王招聚先知四百人，问他们说：「我们上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以？」他们说：「可以上去，因为上帝必将那城交在王的手里。」

chapters.en: But Jehoshaphat asked, “Is there not still a prophet of the LORD here of whom we can inquire?”
chapters.zh: 约沙法说：「这里不是还有耶和华的先知，我们可以求问他吗？」

chapters.en:
The king of Israel answered, “There is still one man through whom we can inquire of the LORD, but I hate him because he never prophesies anything good for me, but only bad. He is Micaiah son of Imlah.”
“The king should not say that!” Jehoshaphat replied.
chapters.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说：「还有一个人，是音拉的儿子米该雅。我们可以讬他求问耶和华，只是我恨他；因为他指着我所说的预言，不说吉语，常说凶言。」约沙法说：「王不必这样说。」

chapters.en: So the king of Israel called one of his officials and said, “Bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once.”
chapters.zh: 以色列王就召了一个太监来，说：「你快去将音拉的儿子米该雅召来。」

chapters.en: Dressed in royal attire, the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting on their thrones at the threshing floor by the entrance of the gate of Samaria, with all the prophets prophesying before them.
chapters.zh: 以色列王和犹大王约沙法在撒马利亚城门前的空场上，各穿朝服坐在位上，所有的先知都在他们面前说预言。

chapters.en: Now Zedekiah son of Chenaanah had made for himself iron horns and declared, “This is what the LORD says: ‘With these you shall gore the Arameans until they are finished off.’”
chapters.zh: 基拿拿的儿子西底家造了两个铁角，说：「耶和华如此说：『你要用这角牴触亚兰人，直到将他们灭尽。』」

chapters.en: And all the prophets were prophesying the same, saying, “Go up to Ramoth-gilead and triumph, for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
chapters.zh: 所有的先知也都这样预言说：「可以上基列的拉末去，必然得胜，因为耶和华必将那城交在王的手中。」

chapters.en: Then the messenger who had gone to call Micaiah instructed him, “Behold, with one accord the words of the prophets are favorable to the king. So please let your words be like theirs, and speak favorably.”
chapters.zh: 那去召米该雅的使者对米该雅说：「众先知一口同音地都向王说吉言，你不如与他们说一样的话，也说吉言。」

chapters.en: But Micaiah said, “As surely as the LORD lives, I will speak whatever my God tells me.”
chapters.zh: 米该雅说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓，我的上帝说什么，我就说什么。」

chapters.en:
When Micaiah arrived, the king asked him, “Micaiah, should we go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or should we refrain?”
“Go up and triumph,” Micaiah replied, “for they will be delivered into your hand.”
chapters.zh: 米该雅到王面前，王问他说：「米该雅啊，我们上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以？」他说：「可以上去，必然得胜，敌人必交在你们手里。」

chapters.en: But the king said to him, “How many times must I make you swear not to tell me anything but the truth in the name of the LORD?”
chapters.zh: 王对他说：「我当嘱咐你几次，你才奉耶和华的名向我说实话呢？」

chapters.en:
So Micaiah declared:
“I saw all Israel scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd. And the LORD said, ‘These people have no master; let each one return home in peace.’”
chapters.zh: 米该雅说：「我看见以色列众民散在山上，如同没有牧人的羊群一般。耶和华说：『这民没有主人，他们可以平平安安地各归各家去。』」

chapters.en: Then the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Did I not tell you that he never prophesies good for me, but only bad?”
chapters.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说：「我岂没有告诉你，这人指着我所说的预言，不说吉语，单说凶言吗？」

chapters.en: Micaiah continued, “Therefore hear the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on His throne, and all the host of heaven standing on His right and on His left.
chapters.zh: 米该雅说：「你们要听耶和华的话。我看见耶和华坐在宝座上，天上的万军侍立在他左右。

chapters.en:
And the LORD said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel to march up and fall at Ramoth-gilead?’
And one suggested this, and another that.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：『谁去引诱以色列王亚哈上基列的拉末去阵亡呢？』这个就这样说，那个就那样说。

chapters.en:
Then a spirit came forward, stood before the LORD, and said, ‘I will entice him.’
‘By what means?’ asked the LORD.
chapters.zh: 随后，有一个神灵出来，站在耶和华面前说：『我去引诱他。』耶和华问他说：『你用何法呢？』

chapters.en:
And he replied, ‘I will go out and be a lying spirit in the mouths of all his prophets.’
‘You will surely entice him and prevail,’ said the LORD. ‘Go and do it.’
chapters.zh: 他说：『我去，要在他众先知口中作谎言的灵。』耶和华说：『这样，你必能引诱他，你去如此行吧！』

chapters.en: So you see, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouths of these prophets of yours, and the LORD has pronounced disaster against you.”
chapters.zh: 现在耶和华使谎言的灵入了你这些先知的口，并且耶和华已经命定降祸与你。」

chapters.en: Then Zedekiah son of Chenaanah went up, struck Micaiah in the face, and demanded, “Which way did the Spirit of the LORD go when He departed from me to speak with you?”
chapters.zh: 基拿拿的儿子西底家前来打米该雅的脸，说：「耶和华的灵从哪里离开我与你说话呢？」

chapters.en: Micaiah replied, “You will soon see, on that day when you go and hide in an inner room.”
chapters.zh: 米该雅说：「你进严密的屋子藏躲的那日，就必看见了。」

chapters.en: And the king of Israel declared, “Take Micaiah and return him to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son,
chapters.zh: 以色列王说：「将米该雅带回，交给邑宰亚们和王的儿子约阿施，说：

chapters.en: and tell them that this is what the king says: ‘Put this man in prison and feed him only bread and water until I return safely.’”
chapters.zh: 『王如此说：把这个人下在监里，使他受苦，吃不饱喝不足，等候我平平安安地回来。』」

chapters.en: But Micaiah replied, “If you ever return safely, the LORD has not spoken through me.” Then he added, “Take heed, all you people!”
chapters.zh: 米该雅说：「你若能平安回来，那就是耶和华没有藉我说这话了」；又说：「众民哪，你们都要听！」

chapters.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.
chapters.zh: 以色列王和犹大王约沙法上基列的拉末去了。

chapters.en: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself and go into battle, but you wear your royal robes.” So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into battle.
chapters.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说：「我要改装上阵，你可以仍穿王服。」于是以色列王改装，他们就上阵去了。

chapters.en: Now the king of Aram had ordered his chariot commanders, “Do not fight with anyone, small or great, except the king of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 先是亚兰王吩咐车兵长说：「他们的〔兵将〕，无论大小，你们都不可与他们争战，只要与以色列王争战。」

chapters.en: When the chariot commanders saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “This is the king of Israel!” So they turned to fight against him, but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him. God drew them away from him.
chapters.zh: 车兵长看见约沙法便说，这必是以色列王，就转过去与他争战。约沙法一呼喊，耶和华就帮助他，上帝又感动他们离开他。

chapters.en: And when the chariot commanders saw that he was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.
chapters.zh: 车兵长见不是以色列王，就转去不追他了。

chapters.en: However, a certain man drew his bow without taking special aim, and he struck the king of Israel between the joints of his armor. So the king said to his charioteer, “Turn around and take me out of the battle, for I am badly wounded!”
chapters.zh: 有一人随便开弓，恰巧射入以色列王的甲缝里。王对赶车的说：「我受了重伤，你转过车来，拉我出阵吧！」

chapters.en: The battle raged throughout that day, and the king of Israel propped himself up in his chariot facing the Arameans until evening. And at sunset he died.
chapters.zh: 那日阵势越战越猛，以色列王勉强站在车上抵挡亚兰人，直到晚上。约在日落的时候，王就死了。

chapters.en: When Jehoshaphat king of Judah had returned safely to his home in Jerusalem,
chapters.zh: 犹大王约沙法平平安安地回耶路撒冷，到宫里去了。

chapters.en: Jehu son of Hanani the seer went out to confront him and said to King Jehoshaphat, “Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the LORD? Because of this, the wrath of the LORD is upon you.
chapters.zh: 先见哈拿尼的儿子耶户出来迎接约沙法王，对他说：「你岂当帮助恶人，爱那恨恶耶和华的人呢？因此耶和华的忿怒临到你。

chapters.en: However, some good is found in you, for you have removed the Asherah poles from the land and have set your heart on seeking God.”
chapters.zh: 然而你还有善行，因你从国中除掉木偶，立定心意寻求上帝。」

chapters.en: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, and once again he went out among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim and turned them back to the LORD, the God of their fathers.
chapters.zh: 约沙法住在耶路撒冷，以后又出巡民间，从别是巴直到以法莲山地，引导民归向耶和华－他们列祖的上帝；

chapters.en: He appointed judges in the land, in each of the fortified cities of Judah.
chapters.zh: 又在犹大国中遍地的坚固城里设立审判官，

chapters.en: Then he said to the judges, “Consider carefully what you do, for you are not judging for man, but for the LORD, who is with you when you render judgment.
chapters.zh: 对他们说：「你们办事应当谨慎；因为你们判断不是为人，乃是为耶和华。判断的时候，他必与你们同在。

chapters.en: And now, may the fear of the LORD be upon you. Be careful what you do, for with the LORD our God there is no injustice or partiality or bribery.”
chapters.zh: 现在你们应当敬畏耶和华，谨慎办事；因为耶和华－我们的上帝没有不义，不偏待人，也不受贿赂。」

chapters.en: Moreover, Jehoshaphat appointed in Jerusalem some of the Levites, priests, and heads of the Israelite families to judge on behalf of the LORD and to settle disputes. And they lived in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 约沙法从利未人和祭司，并以色列族长中派定人，在耶路撒冷为耶和华判断，听〔民间的〕争讼，就回耶路撒冷去了。

chapters.en: He commanded them, saying, “You must serve faithfully and wholeheartedly in the fear of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 约沙法嘱咐他们说：「你们当敬畏耶和华，忠心诚实办事。

chapters.en: For every dispute that comes before you from your brothers who dwell in their cities—whether it regards bloodshed or some other violation of law, commandments, statutes, or ordinances—you are to warn them, so that they will not incur guilt before the LORD and wrath will not come upon you and your brothers. Do this, and you will not incur guilt.
chapters.zh: 住在各城里你们的弟兄，若有争讼的事来到你们这里，或为流血，或犯律法、诫命、律例、典章，你们要警戒他们，免得他们得罪耶和华，以致他的忿怒临到你们和你们的弟兄；这样行，你们就没有罪了。

chapters.en: Note that Amariah, the chief priest, will be over you in all that pertains to the LORD, and Zebadiah son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, in all that pertains to the king. And the Levites will serve as officers before you. Act resolutely; may the LORD be with the upright!”
chapters.zh: 凡属耶和华的事，有大祭司亚玛利雅管理你们；凡属王的事，有犹大支派的族长以实玛利的儿子西巴第雅管理你们；在你们面前有利未人作官长。你们应当壮胆办事，愿耶和华与善人同在。」

chapters.en: After this, the Moabites and Ammonites, together with some of the Meunites, came to make war against Jehoshaphat.
chapters.zh: 此后，摩押人和亚扪人，又有米乌尼人，一同来攻击约沙法。

chapters.en: Then some men came and told Jehoshaphat, “A vast army is coming against you from Edom, from beyond the Sea; they are already in Hazazon-tamar” (that is, En-gedi).
chapters.zh: 有人来报告约沙法说：「从海外亚兰〔注：又作以东〕那边有大军来攻击你，如今他们在哈洗逊‧他玛，就是隐‧基底。」

chapters.en: Jehoshaphat was alarmed and set his face to seek the LORD. And he proclaimed a fast throughout Judah.
chapters.zh: 约沙法便惧怕，定意寻求耶和华，在犹大全地宣告禁食。

chapters.en: So the people of Judah gathered to seek the LORD, and indeed, they came from all the cities of Judah to seek Him.
chapters.zh: 于是犹大人聚会，求耶和华〔帮助〕。犹大各城都有人出来寻求耶和华。

chapters.en: Then Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem in the house of the LORD in front of the new courtyard
chapters.zh: 约沙法就在犹大和耶路撒冷的会中，站在耶和华殿的新院前，

chapters.en: and said, “O LORD, God of our fathers, are You not the God who is in heaven, and do You not rule over all the kingdoms of the nations? Power and might are in Your hand, and no one can stand against You.
chapters.zh: 说：「耶和华－我们列祖的上帝啊，你不是天上的上帝吗？你不是万邦万国的主宰吗？在你手中有大能大力，无人能抵挡你。

chapters.en: Our God, did You not drive out the inhabitants of this land before Your people Israel and give it forever to the descendants of Abraham Your friend?
chapters.zh: 我们的上帝啊，你不是曾在你民以色列人面前驱逐这地的居民，将这地赐给你朋友亚伯拉罕的后裔永远为业吗？

chapters.en: They have lived in the land and have built in it a sanctuary for Your Name, saying,
chapters.zh: 他们住在这地，又为你的名建造圣所，说：

chapters.en: ‘If disaster comes upon us—whether sword or judgment, plague or famine—we will stand before this temple and before You, for Your Name is in this temple. We will cry out to You in our distress, and You will hear us and save us.’
chapters.zh: 『倘有祸患临到我们，或刀兵灾殃，或瘟疫饥荒，我们在急难的时候，站在这殿前向你呼求，你必垂听而拯救，因为你的名在这殿里。』

chapters.en: And now, here are the men of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, whom You did not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt. So Israel turned away from them and did not destroy them.
chapters.zh: 从前以色列人出埃及地的时候，你不容以色列人侵犯亚扪人、摩押人，和西珥山人，以色列人就离开他们，不灭绝他们。

chapters.en: See how they are repaying us by coming to drive us out of the possession that You gave us as an inheritance.
chapters.zh: 看哪，他们怎样报复我们，要来驱逐我们出离你的地，就是你赐给我们为业之地。

chapters.en: Our God, will You not judge them? For we are powerless before this vast army that comes against us. We do not know what to do, but our eyes are upon You.”
chapters.zh: 我们的上帝啊，你不惩罚他们吗？因为我们无力抵挡这来攻击我们的大军，我们也不知道怎样行，我们的眼目单仰望你。」

chapters.en: Meanwhile all the men of Judah, with their wives and children and little ones, were standing before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 犹大众人和他们的婴孩、妻子、儿女都站在耶和华面前。

chapters.en: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jahaziel son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite from Asaph’s descendants, as he stood in the midst of the assembly.
chapters.zh: 那时，耶和华的灵在会中临到利未人亚萨的后裔－玛探雅的玄孙，耶利的曾孙，比拿雅的孙子，撒迦利雅的儿子雅哈悉。

chapters.en: And he said, “Listen, all you people of Judah and Jerusalem! Listen, King Jehoshaphat! This is what the LORD says: ‘Do not be afraid or discouraged because of this vast army, for the battle does not belong to you, but to God.
chapters.zh: 他说：「犹大众人、耶路撒冷的居民，和约沙法王，你们请听。耶和华对你们如此说：『不要因这大军恐惧惊惶；因为胜败不在乎你们，乃在乎上帝。

chapters.en: Tomorrow you are to march down against them. You will see them coming up the Ascent of Ziz, and you will find them at the end of the valley facing the Wilderness of Jeruel.
chapters.zh: 明日你们要下去迎敌，他们是从洗斯坡上来，你们必在耶鲁伊勒旷野前的谷口遇见他们。

chapters.en: You need not fight this battle. Take up your positions, stand firm, and see the salvation of the LORD on your behalf, O Judah and Jerusalem. Do not be afraid or discouraged. Go out and face them tomorrow, for the LORD is with you.’”
chapters.zh: 犹大和耶路撒冷人哪，这次你们不要争战，要摆阵站着，看耶和华为你们施行拯救。不要恐惧，也不要惊惶。明日当出去迎敌，因为耶和华与你们同在。』」

chapters.en: Then Jehoshaphat bowed facedown, and all the people of Judah and Jerusalem fell down before the LORD to worship Him.
chapters.zh: 约沙法就面伏于地，犹大众人和耶路撒冷的居民也俯伏在耶和华面前，叩拜耶和华。

chapters.en: And the Levites from the Kohathites and Korahites stood up to praise the LORD, the God of Israel, shouting in a very loud voice.
chapters.zh: 哥辖族和可拉族的利未人都起来，用极大的声音赞美耶和华以色列的上帝。

chapters.en: Early in the morning they got up and left for the Wilderness of Tekoa. As they set out, Jehoshaphat stood up and said, “Hear me, O people of Judah and Jerusalem. Believe in the LORD your God, and you will be upheld; believe in His prophets, and you will succeed.”
chapters.zh: 次日清早，众人起来往提哥亚的旷野去。出去的时候，约沙法站着说：「犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民哪，要听我说：信耶和华－你们的上帝就必立稳；信他的先知就必亨通。」

chapters.en:
Then Jehoshaphat consulted with the people and appointed those who would sing to the LORD and praise the splendor of His holiness. As they went out before the army, they were singing:
“Give thanks to the LORD, for His loving devotion endures forever.”
chapters.zh: 约沙法既与民商议了，就设立歌唱的人，颂赞耶和华，使他们穿上圣洁的礼服，走在军前赞美耶和华说：「当称谢耶和华，因他的慈爱永远长存！」

chapters.en: The moment they began their shouts and praises, the LORD set ambushes against the men of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir who had come against Judah, and they were defeated.
chapters.zh: 众人方唱歌赞美的时候，耶和华就派伏兵击杀那来攻击犹大人的亚扪人、摩押人，和西珥山人，他们就被打败了。

chapters.en: The Ammonites and Moabites rose up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir, devoting them to destruction. And when they had finished off the inhabitants of Seir, they helped to destroy one another.
chapters.zh: 因为亚扪人和摩押人起来，击杀住西珥山的人，将他们灭尽；灭尽住西珥山的人之后，他们又彼此自相击杀。

chapters.en: When the men of Judah came to a place overlooking the wilderness, they looked for the vast army, but there were only corpses lying on the ground; no one had escaped.
chapters.zh: 犹大人来到旷野的望楼，向那大军观看，见尸横遍地，没有一个逃脱的。

chapters.en: Then Jehoshaphat and his people went to carry off the plunder, and they found on the bodies an abundance of goods and valuables —more than they could carry away. They were gathering the plunder for three days because there was so much.
chapters.zh: 约沙法和他的百姓就来收取敌人的财物，在尸首中见了许多财物、珍宝，他们剥脱下来的多得不可携带；因为甚多，直收取了三日。

chapters.en: On the fourth day they assembled in the Valley of Beracah, where they blessed the LORD. Therefore that place is called the Valley of Beracah to this day.
chapters.zh: 第四日众人聚集在比拉迦谷〔注：就是称颂的意思〕，在那里称颂耶和华。因此那地方名叫比拉迦谷，直到今日。

chapters.en: Then all the men of Judah and Jerusalem, with Jehoshaphat at their head, returned joyfully to Jerusalem, for the LORD had made them rejoice over their enemies.
chapters.zh: 犹大人和耶路撒冷人都欢欢喜喜地回耶路撒冷，约沙法率领他们；因为耶和华使他们战胜仇敌，就欢喜快乐。

chapters.en: So they entered Jerusalem and went into the house of the LORD with harps, lyres, and trumpets.
chapters.zh: 他们弹琴、鼓瑟、吹号来到耶路撒冷，进了耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: And the fear of God came upon all the kingdoms of the lands when they heard that the LORD had fought against the enemies of Israel.
chapters.zh: 列邦诸国听见耶和华战败以色列的仇敌，就甚惧怕。

chapters.en: Then Jehoshaphat’s kingdom was at peace, for his God had given him rest on every side.
chapters.zh: 这样，约沙法的国得享太平，因为上帝赐他四境平安。

chapters.en: So Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah. He was thirty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-five years. His mother’s name was Azubah daughter of Shilhi.
chapters.zh: 约沙法作犹大王，登基的时候年三十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十五年。他母亲名叫阿苏巴，乃示利希的女儿。

chapters.en: And Jehoshaphat walked in the way of his father Asa and did not turn away from it; he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 约沙法效法他父亚撒所行的，不偏左右，行耶和华眼中看为正的事。

chapters.en: The high places, however, were not removed; the people had not yet set their hearts on the God of their fathers.
chapters.zh: 只是邱坛还没有废去，百姓也没有立定心意归向他们列祖的上帝。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, from beginning to end, they are indeed written in the Chronicles of Jehu son of Hanani, which are recorded in the Book of the Kings of Israel.
chapters.zh: 约沙法其余的事，自始至终都写在哈拿尼的儿子耶户的书上，也载入以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: Later, Jehoshaphat king of Judah made an alliance with Ahaziah king of Israel, who acted wickedly.
chapters.zh: 此后，犹大王约沙法与以色列王亚哈谢交好；亚哈谢行恶太甚。

chapters.en: They agreed to make ships to go to Tarshish, and these were built in Ezion-geber.
chapters.zh: 二王合伙造船要往他施去，遂在以旬‧迦别造船。

chapters.en:
Then Eliezer son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, “Because you have allied yourself with Ahaziah, the LORD has destroyed your works.”
So the ships were wrecked and were unable to sail to Tarshish.
chapters.zh: 那时玛利沙人、多大瓦的儿子以利以谢向约沙法预言说：「因你与亚哈谢交好，耶和华必破坏你所造的。」后来那船果然破坏，不能往他施去了。

chapters.en: And Jehoshaphat rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David. And his son Jehoram reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 约沙法与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子约兰接续他作王。

chapters.en: Jehoram’s brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat, were Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah; these were all sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 约兰有几个兄弟，就是约沙法的儿子亚撒利雅、耶歇、撒迦利雅、亚撒利雅、米迦勒、示法提雅。这都是犹大王约沙法的儿子。

chapters.en: Their father had given them many gifts of silver and gold and precious things, as well as the fortified cities in Judah; but he gave the kingdom to Jehoram because he was the firstborn.
chapters.zh: 他们的父亲将许多金银、财宝，和犹大地的坚固城赐给他们；但将国赐给约兰，因为他是长子。

chapters.en: When Jehoram had established himself over his father’s kingdom, he strengthened himself by putting to the sword all his brothers along with some of the princes of Israel.
chapters.zh: 约兰兴起坐他父的位，奋勇自强，就用刀杀了他的众兄弟和以色列的几个首领。

chapters.en: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years.
chapters.zh: 约兰登基的时候年三十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王八年。

chapters.en: And Jehoram walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, just as the house of Ahab had done. For he married a daughter of Ahab and did evil in the sight of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他行以色列诸王的道，与亚哈家一样；因他娶了亚哈的女儿为妻，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事。

chapters.en: Yet the LORD was unwilling to destroy the house of David, because of the covenant He had made with David, and since He had promised to maintain a lamp for David and his descendants forever.
chapters.zh: 耶和华却因自己与大卫所立的约，不肯灭大卫的家，照他所应许的，永远赐灯光与大卫和他的子孙。

chapters.en: In the days of Jehoram, Edom rebelled against the hand of Judah and appointed their own king.
chapters.zh: 约兰年间，以东人背叛犹大，脱离他的权下，自己立王。

chapters.en: So Jehoram crossed into Edom with his officers and all his chariots. When the Edomites surrounded him and his chariot commanders, he rose up and attacked by night.
chapters.zh: 约兰就率领军长和所有的战车，夜间起来，攻击围困他的以东人和车兵长。

chapters.en: So to this day Edom has been in rebellion against the hand of Judah. Likewise, Libnah rebelled against his hand at the same time, because Jehoram had forsaken the LORD, the God of his fathers.
chapters.zh: 这样，以东人背叛犹大，脱离他的权下，直到今日。那时，立拿人也背叛了，因为约兰离弃耶和华－他列祖的上帝。

chapters.en: Jehoram had also built high places on the hills of Judah; he had caused the people of Jerusalem to prostitute themselves and had led Judah astray.
chapters.zh: 他又在犹大诸山建筑邱坛，使耶路撒冷的居民行邪淫，诱惑犹大人。

chapters.en:
Then a letter came to Jehoram from Elijah the prophet, which stated:
“This is what the LORD, the God of your father David, says:
‘You have not walked in the ways of your father Jehoshaphat or of Asa king of Judah,
chapters.zh: 先知以利亚达信与约兰说：「耶和华－你祖大卫的上帝如此说：『因为你不行你父约沙法和犹大王亚撒的道，

chapters.en: but you have walked in the ways of the kings of Israel and have caused Judah and the people of Jerusalem to prostitute themselves, just as the house of Ahab prostituted itself. You have also killed your brothers, your father’s family, who were better than you.
chapters.zh: 乃行以色列诸王的道，使犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民行邪淫，像亚哈家一样，又杀了你父家比你好的诸兄弟。

chapters.en: So behold, the LORD is about to strike your people, your sons, your wives, and all your possessions with a serious blow.
chapters.zh: 故此，耶和华降大灾与你的百姓和你的妻子、儿女，并你一切所有的。

chapters.en: And day after day you yourself will suffer from a severe illness, a disease of your bowels, until it causes your bowels to come out.’”
chapters.zh: 你的肠子必患病，日加沉重，以致你的肠子坠落下来。』」

chapters.en: Then the LORD stirred against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines and Arabs who lived near the Cushites.
chapters.zh: 以后，耶和华激动非利士人和靠近古实的阿拉伯人来攻击约兰。

chapters.en: So they went to war against Judah, invaded it, and carried off all the possessions found in the king’s palace, along with his sons and wives; not a son was left to him except Jehoahaz, his youngest.
chapters.zh: 他们上来攻击犹大，侵入境内，掳掠了王宫里所有的财货和他的妻子、儿女，除了他小儿子约哈斯〔注：又名亚哈谢〕之外，没有留下一个儿子。

chapters.en: After all this, the LORD afflicted Jehoram with an incurable disease of the bowels.
chapters.zh: 这些事以后，耶和华使约兰的肠子患不能医治的病。

chapters.en: This continued day after day until two full years had passed. Finally, his intestines came out because of his disease, and he died in severe pain. And his people did not make a fire in his honor as they had done for his fathers.
chapters.zh: 他患此病缠绵日久，过了二年，肠子坠落下来，病重而死。他的民没有为他烧什么物件，像从前为他列祖所烧的一样。

chapters.en: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years. He died, to no one’s regret, and was buried in the City of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.
chapters.zh: 约兰登基的时候年三十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王八年。他去世无人思慕，众人葬他在大卫城，只是不在列王的坟墓里。

chapters.en: Then the people of Jerusalem made Ahaziah, the youngest son of Jehoram, king in his place, since the raiders who had come into the camp with the Arabs had killed all the older sons. So Ahaziah son of Jehoram became king of Judah.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷的居民立约兰的小儿子亚哈谢接续他作王；因为跟随阿拉伯人来攻营的军兵曾杀了亚哈谢的众兄长。这样，犹大王约兰的儿子亚哈谢作了王。

chapters.en: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem one year. His mother’s name was Athaliah, the granddaughter of Omri.
chapters.zh: 亚哈谢登基的时候年四十二岁〔注：列王下八章二十六节是二十二岁〕，在耶路撒冷作王一年。他母亲名叫亚她利雅，是暗利的孙女。

chapters.en: Ahaziah also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab, for his mother was his counselor in wickedness.
chapters.zh: 亚哈谢也行亚哈家的道；因为他母亲给他主谋，使他行恶。

chapters.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, as the house of Ahab had done, for to his destruction they were his counselors after the death of his father.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，像亚哈家一样；因他父亲死后有亚哈家的人给他主谋，以致败坏。

chapters.en: Ahaziah also followed their counsel and went with Joram son of Ahab king of Israel to fight against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth-gilead. But the Arameans wounded Joram.
chapters.zh: 他听从亚哈家的计谋，同以色列王亚哈的儿子约兰往基列的拉末去，与亚兰王哈薛争战；亚兰人打伤了约兰。

chapters.en: So he returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds they had inflicted on him at Ramah when he fought against Hazael king of Aram. Then Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to Jezreel to visit Joram son of Ahab, because Joram had been wounded.
chapters.zh: 约兰回到耶斯列，医治在拉末与亚兰王哈薛打仗所受的伤，犹大王约兰的儿子亚撒利雅〔注：就是亚哈谢〕因为亚哈的儿子约兰病了，就下到耶斯列看望他。

chapters.en: Ahaziah’s downfall came from God when he went to visit Joram. When Ahaziah arrived, he went out with Joram to meet Jehu son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to destroy the house of Ahab.
chapters.zh: 亚哈谢去见约兰就被害了，这是出乎上帝；因为他到了，就同约兰出去攻击宁示的孙子耶户。这耶户是耶和华所膏、使他剪除亚哈家的。

chapters.en: So while Jehu was executing judgment on the house of Ahab, he found the rulers of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah’s brothers who were serving Ahaziah, and he killed them.
chapters.zh: 耶户讨亚哈家罪的时候，遇见犹大的众首领和亚哈谢的众姪子服事亚哈谢，就把他们都杀了。

chapters.en:
Then Jehu looked for Ahaziah, and Jehu’s soldiers captured him while he was hiding in Samaria. So Ahaziah was brought to Jehu and put to death. They buried him, for they said, “He is the grandson of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart.”
So no one was left from the house of Ahaziah with the strength to rule the kingdom.
chapters.zh: 亚哈谢藏在撒马利亚，耶户寻找他，众人将他拿住，送到耶户那里，就杀了他，将他葬埋；因他们说，他是那尽心寻求耶和华之约沙法的儿子。这样，亚哈谢的家无力保守国权。

chapters.en: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she proceeded to annihilate all the royal heirs of the house of Judah.
chapters.zh: 亚哈谢的母亲亚她利雅见她儿子死了，就起来剿灭犹大王室。

chapters.en: But Jehoshabeath daughter of King Jehoram took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the sons of the king who were being murdered, and she put him and his nurse in a bedroom. Because Jehoshabeath, the daughter of King Jehoram and the wife of Jehoiada the priest, was Ahaziah’s sister, she hid Joash from Athaliah so that she could not kill him.
chapters.zh: 但王的女儿约示巴将亚哈谢的儿子约阿施从那被杀的王子中偷出来，把他和他的乳母都藏在卧房里。约示巴是约兰王的女儿，亚哈谢的妹子，祭司耶何耶大的妻。她收藏约阿施，躲避亚她利雅，免得被杀。

chapters.en: And Joash remained hidden with them in the house of God for six years while Athaliah ruled the land.
chapters.zh: 约阿施和她们一同藏在上帝殿里六年；亚她利雅篡了国位。

chapters.en: Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthened himself and made a covenant with the commanders of hundreds—with Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zichri.
chapters.zh: 第七年，耶何耶大奋勇自强，将百夫长耶罗罕的儿子亚撒利雅，约哈难的儿子以实玛利，俄备得的儿子亚撒利雅，亚大雅的儿子玛西雅，细基利的儿子以利沙法召来，与他们立约。

chapters.en: So they went throughout Judah and gathered the Levites from all the cities of Judah and the heads of the families of Israel. And when they came to Jerusalem,
chapters.zh: 他们走遍犹大，从犹大各城里招聚利未人和以色列的众族长到耶路撒冷来。

chapters.en:
the whole assembly made a covenant with the king in the house of God.
“Behold, the king’s son!” said Jehoiada. “He must reign, just as the LORD promised concerning the descendants of David.
chapters.zh: 会众在上帝殿里与王立约。耶何耶大对他们说：「看哪，王的儿子必当作王，正如耶和华指着大卫子孙所应许的话」；

chapters.en: This is what you are to do: A third of you priests and Levites who come on duty on the Sabbath shall keep watch at the doors,
chapters.zh: 又说：「你们当这样行：祭司和利未人凡安息日进班的，三分之一要把守各门，

chapters.en: a third shall be at the royal palace, and a third at the Foundation Gate, while all the others are to be in the courtyards of the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 三分之一要在王宫，三分之一要在基址门；众百姓要在耶和华殿的院内。

chapters.en: No one is to enter the house of the LORD except the priests and those Levites who serve; they may enter because they are consecrated, but all the people are to obey the requirement of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 除了祭司和供职的利未人之外，不准别人进耶和华的殿；惟独他们可以进去，因为他们圣洁。众百姓要遵守耶和华所吩咐的。

chapters.en: The Levites must surround the king with weapons in hand, and anyone who enters the temple must be put to death. You must stay close to the king wherever he goes.”
chapters.zh: 利未人要手中各拿兵器，四围护卫王；凡擅入殿宇的，必当治死。王出入的时候，你们当跟随他。」

chapters.en: So the Levites and all Judah did everything that Jehoiada the priest had ordered. Each of them took his men—those coming on duty on the Sabbath and those going off duty—for Jehoiada the priest had not released any of the divisions.
chapters.zh: 利未人和犹大众人都照着祭司耶何耶大一切所吩咐的去行，各带所管安息日进班出班的人来，因为祭司耶何耶大不许他们下班。

chapters.en: Then Jehoiada the priest gave to the commanders of hundreds the spears and the large and small shields of King David that were in the house of God.
chapters.zh: 祭司耶何耶大便将上帝殿里所藏大卫王的枪、盾牌、挡牌交给百夫长，

chapters.en: He stationed all the troops, with their weapons in hand, surrounding the king by the altar and the temple, from the south side to the north side of the temple.
chapters.zh: 又分派众民手中各拿兵器，在坛和殿那里，从殿右直到殿左，站在王子的四围；

chapters.en: Then Jehoiada and his sons brought out the king’s son, put the crown on him, presented him with the Testimony, and proclaimed him king. They anointed him and shouted, “Long live the king!”
chapters.zh: 于是领王子出来，给他戴上冠冕，将律法〔书交给他〕，立他作王。耶何耶大和众子膏他，众人说：「愿王万岁！」

chapters.en: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and cheering the king, she went out to them in the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 亚她利雅听见民奔走赞美王的声音，就到民那里，进耶和华的殿，

chapters.en:
And she looked and saw the king standing by his pillar at the entrance. The officers and trumpeters were beside the king, and all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets, while the singers with musical instruments were leading the praises.
Then Athaliah tore her clothes and screamed, “Treason, treason!”
chapters.zh: 看见王站在〔殿〕门的柱旁，百夫长和吹号的人侍立在王左右，国民都欢乐吹号，又有歌唱的，用各样的乐器领人歌唱赞美；亚她利雅就撕裂衣服，喊叫说：「反了！反了！」

chapters.en: And Jehoiada the priest sent out the commanders of hundreds in charge of the army, saying, “Bring her out between the ranks, and put to the sword anyone who follows her.” For the priest had said, “She must not be put to death in the house of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 祭司耶何耶大带管辖军兵的百夫长出来，吩咐他们说：「将她赶到班外，凡跟随她的必用刀杀死！」因为祭司说：「不可在耶和华殿里杀她。」

chapters.en: So they seized Athaliah as she reached the entrance of the Horse Gate on the palace grounds, and there they put her to death.
chapters.zh: 众兵就闪开，让她去；她走到王宫的马门，便在那里把她杀了。

chapters.en: Then Jehoiada made a covenant between himself and the king and the people that they would be the LORD’s people.
chapters.zh: 耶何耶大与众民和王立约，都要作耶和华的民。

chapters.en: So all the people went to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols to pieces and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.
chapters.zh: 于是众民都到巴力庙，拆毁了庙，打碎坛和像，又在坛前将巴力的祭司玛坦杀了。

chapters.en: Moreover, Jehoiada put the oversight of the house of the LORD into the hands of the Levitical priests, whom David had appointed over the house of the LORD, to offer burnt offerings to the LORD as written in the Law of Moses, with rejoicing and song, as ordained by David.
chapters.zh: 耶何耶大派官看守耶和华的殿，是在祭司利未人手下。这祭司利未人是大卫分派在耶和华殿中、照摩西律法上所写的，给耶和华献燔祭，又按大卫所定的例，欢乐歌唱；

chapters.en: He stationed gatekeepers at the gates of the house of the LORD, so that no one who was in any way unclean could enter.
chapters.zh: 且设立守门的把守耶和华殿的各门，无论为何事，不洁净的人都不准进去。

chapters.en: And he took with him the commanders of hundreds, the nobles, the rulers of the people, and all the people of the land, and they brought the king down from the house of the LORD and entered the royal palace through the Upper Gate. They seated King Joash on the royal throne,
chapters.zh: 又率领百夫长和贵胄，与民间的官长，并国中的众民，请王从耶和华殿下来，由上门进入王宫，立王坐在国位上。

chapters.en: and all the people of the land rejoiced. And the city was quiet, because Athaliah had been put to the sword.
chapters.zh: 国民都欢乐，合城都安静。众人已将亚她利雅用刀杀了。

chapters.en: Joash was seven years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother’s name was Zibiah; she was from Beersheba.
chapters.zh: 约阿施登基的时候年七岁，在耶路撒冷作王四十年。他母亲名叫西比亚，是别是巴人。

chapters.en: And Joash did what was right in the eyes of the LORD all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
chapters.zh: 祭司耶何耶大在世的时候，约阿施行耶和华眼中看为正的事。

chapters.en: Jehoiada took for him two wives, and he had sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 耶何耶大为他娶了两个妻，并且生儿养女。

chapters.en: Some time later, Joash set his heart on repairing the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 此后，约阿施有意重修耶和华的殿，

chapters.en:
So he gathered the priests and Levites and said, “Go out to the cities of Judah and collect the money due annually from all Israel, to repair the house of your God. Do it quickly.”
The Levites, however, did not make haste.
chapters.zh: 便召聚众祭司和利未人，吩咐他们说：「你们要往犹大各城去，使以色列众人捐纳银子，每年可以修理你们上帝的殿；你们要急速办理这事。」只是利未人不急速办理。

chapters.en: So the king called Jehoiada the high priest and said, “Why have you not required the Levites to bring from Judah and Jerusalem the tax imposed by Moses the servant of the LORD and by the assembly of Israel for the Tent of the Testimony?”
chapters.zh: 王召了大祭司耶何耶大来，对他说：「从前耶和华的仆人摩西，为法〔柜〕的帐幕与以色列会众所定的捐项，你为何不叫利未人〔照这例〕从犹大和耶路撒冷带来〔作殿的费用呢〕？」

chapters.en: For the sons of that wicked woman Athaliah had broken into the house of God and had even used the sacred objects of the house of the LORD for the Baals.
chapters.zh: （因为那恶妇亚她利雅的众子曾拆毁上帝的殿，又用耶和华殿中分别为圣的物供奉巴力。）

chapters.en: At the king’s command a chest was made and placed outside, at the gate of the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 于是王下令，众人做了一柜，放在耶和华殿的门外，

chapters.en: And a proclamation was issued in Judah and Jerusalem that they were to bring to the LORD the tax imposed by Moses the servant of God on Israel in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 又通告犹大和耶路撒冷的百姓，要将上帝仆人摩西在旷野所吩咐以色列人的捐项给耶和华送来。

chapters.en: All the officers and all the people rejoiced and brought their contributions, and they dropped them in the chest until it was full.
chapters.zh: 众首领和百姓都欢欢喜喜地将银子送来，投入柜中，直到捐完。

chapters.en: Whenever the chest was brought by the Levites to the king’s overseers and they saw that there was a large amount of money, the royal scribe and the officer of the high priest would come and empty the chest and carry it back to its place. They did this daily and gathered the money in abundance.
chapters.zh: 利未人见银子多了，就把柜抬到王所派的司事面前；王的书记和大祭司的属员来将柜倒空，仍放在原处。日日都是这样，积蓄的银子甚多。

chapters.en: Then the king and Jehoiada would give the money to those who supervised the labor on the house of the LORD to hire stonecutters and carpenters to restore the house of the LORD, as well as workers in iron and bronze to repair the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 王与耶何耶大将银子交给耶和华殿里办事的人，他们就雇了石匠、木匠重修耶和华的殿，又雇了铁匠、铜匠修理耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: So the workmen labored, and in their hands the repair work progressed. They restored the house of God according to its specifications, and they reinforced it.
chapters.zh: 工人操作，渐渐修成，将上帝殿修造得与从前一样，而且甚是坚固。

chapters.en:
When they were finished, they brought the rest of the money to the king and Jehoiada, and with it were made articles for the house of the LORD—utensils for the service and for the burnt offerings, dishes, and other objects of gold and silver.
Throughout the days of Jehoiada, burnt offerings were presented regularly in the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 工程完了，他们就把其余的银子拿到王与耶何耶大面前，用以制造耶和华殿供奉所用的器皿和调羹，并金银的器皿。 耶何耶大在世的时候，众人常在耶和华殿里献燔祭。

chapters.en: When Jehoiada was old and full of years, he died at the age of 130.
chapters.zh: 耶何耶大年纪老迈，日子满足而死。死的时候年一百三十岁，

chapters.en: And Jehoiada was buried with the kings in the City of David, because he had done what was good in Israel for God and His temple.
chapters.zh: 葬在大卫城列王的坟墓里；因为他在以色列人中行善，又事奉上帝，修理上帝的殿。

chapters.en: After the death of Jehoiada, however, the officials of Judah came and paid homage to the king, and he listened to them.
chapters.zh: 耶何耶大死后，犹大的众首领来朝拜王；王就听从他们。

chapters.en: They abandoned the house of the LORD, the God of their fathers, and served the Asherah poles and idols. So wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this guilt of theirs.
chapters.zh: 他们离弃耶和华－他们列祖上帝的殿，去事奉亚舍拉和偶像；因他们这罪，就有忿怒临到犹大和耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, the LORD sent prophets to bring the people back to Him and to testify against them, but they would not listen.
chapters.zh: 但上帝仍遣先知到他们那里，引导他们归向耶和华。这先知警戒他们，他们却不肯听。

chapters.en: Then the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest, who stood up before the people and said to them, “This is what God says: ‘Why do you transgress the commandments of the LORD so that you cannot prosper? Because you have forsaken the LORD, He has forsaken you.’”
chapters.zh: 那时，上帝的灵感动祭司耶何耶大的儿子撒迦利亚，他就站在上面对民说：「上帝如此说：你们为何干犯耶和华的诫命，以致不得亨通呢？因为你们离弃耶和华，所以他也离弃你们。」

chapters.en: But they conspired against Zechariah, and by order of the king, they stoned him in the courtyard of the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 众民同心谋害撒迦利亚，就照王的吩咐，在耶和华殿的院内用石头打死他。

chapters.en: Thus King Joash failed to remember the kindness that Zechariah’s father Jehoiada had extended to him. Instead, Joash killed Jehoiada’s son. As he lay dying, Zechariah said, “May the LORD see this and call you to account.”
chapters.zh: 这样，约阿施王不想念撒迦利亚的父亲耶何耶大向自己所施的恩，杀了他的儿子。撒迦利亚临死的时候说：「愿耶和华鉴察伸冤！」

chapters.en: In the spring, the army of Aram went to war against Joash. They entered Judah and Jerusalem and destroyed all the leaders of the people, and they sent all the plunder to their king in Damascus.
chapters.zh: 满了一年，亚兰的军兵上来攻击约阿施，来到犹大和耶路撒冷，杀了民中的众首领，将所掠的财货送到大马士革王那里。

chapters.en: Although the Aramean army had come with only a few men, the LORD delivered into their hand a very great army. Because Judah had forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers, judgment was executed on Joash.
chapters.zh: 亚兰的军兵虽来了一小队，耶和华却将大队的军兵交在他们手里，是因犹大人离弃耶和华－他们列祖的上帝，所以藉亚兰人惩罚约阿施。

chapters.en: And when the Arameans had withdrawn, they left Joash severely wounded. His own servants conspired against him for shedding the blood of the son of Jehoiada the priest, and they killed him on his bed. So he died and was buried in the City of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.
chapters.zh: 亚兰人离开约阿施的时候，他患重病；臣仆背叛他，要报祭司耶何耶大儿子流血之仇，杀他在床上，葬他在大卫城，只是不葬在列王的坟墓里。

chapters.en: Those who conspired against Joash were Zabad son of Shimeath the Ammonitess and Jehozabad son of Shimrith the Moabitess.
chapters.zh: 背叛他的是亚扪妇人示米押的儿子撒拔和摩押妇人示米利的儿子约萨拔。

chapters.en: The accounts of the sons of Joash and the many pronouncements about him, and of the restoration of the house of God, are indeed written in the Treatise of the Book of the Kings. And his son Amaziah reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 至于他的众子和他所受的警戒，并他重修上帝殿的事，都写在列王的传上。他儿子亚玛谢接续他作王。

chapters.en: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan; she was from Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他母亲名叫约耶但，是耶路撒冷人。

chapters.en: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, but not wholeheartedly.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢行耶和华眼中看为正的事，只是心不专诚。

chapters.en: As soon as the kingdom was firmly in his grasp, Amaziah executed the servants who had murdered his father the king.
chapters.zh: 国一坚定，就把杀他父王的臣仆杀了，

chapters.en: Yet he did not put their sons to death, but acted according to what is written in the Law, in the Book of Moses, where the LORD commanded: “Fathers must not be put to death for their children, and children must not be put to death for their fathers; each is to die for his own sin.”
chapters.zh: 却没有治死他们的儿子，是照摩西律法书上耶和华所吩咐的说：「不可因子杀父，也不可因父杀子，各人要为本身的罪而死。」

chapters.en: Then Amaziah gathered the people of Judah and assigned them according to their families to commanders of thousands and of hundreds. And he numbered those twenty years of age or older throughout Judah and Benjamin and found 300,000 chosen men able to serve in the army, bearing the spear and shield.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢招聚犹大人，按着犹大和便雅悯的宗族设立千夫长、百夫长，又数点人数，从二十岁以外，能拿枪拿盾牌出去打仗的精兵共有三十万；

chapters.en: He also hired 100,000 mighty men of valor from Israel for a hundred talents of silver.
chapters.zh: 又用银子一百他连得，从以色列招募了十万大能的勇士。

chapters.en: But a man of God came to him and said, “O king, do not let the army of Israel go with you, for the LORD is not with Israel—not with any of the Ephraimites.
chapters.zh: 有一个神人来见亚玛谢，对他说：「王啊，不要使以色列的军兵与你同去，因为耶和华不与以色列人以法莲的后裔同在。

chapters.en: Even if you go and fight bravely in battle, God will overthrow you before the enemy, for God has power to help and power to overthrow.”
chapters.zh: 你若一定要去，就奋勇争战吧！但上帝必使你败在敌人面前；因为上帝能助人得胜，也能使人倾败。」

chapters.en:
Amaziah asked the man of God, “What should I do about the hundred talents I have given to the troops of Israel?”
And the man of God replied, “The LORD is able to give you much more than this.”
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢问神人说：「我给了以色列军的那一百他连得银子怎么样呢？」神人回答说：「耶和华能把更多的赐给你。」

chapters.en: So Amaziah dismissed the troops who had come to him from Ephraim and sent them home. And they were furious with Judah and returned home in great anger.
chapters.zh: 于是亚玛谢将那从以法莲来的军兵分别出来，叫他们回家去。故此，他们甚恼怒犹大人，气忿忿地回家去了。

chapters.en: Amaziah, however, summoned his strength and led his troops to the Valley of Salt, where he struck down 10,000 men of Seir,
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢壮起胆来，率领他的民到盐谷，杀了西珥人一万。

chapters.en: and the army of Judah also captured 10,000 men alive. They took them to the top of a cliff and threw them down so that all were dashed to pieces.
chapters.zh: 犹大人又生擒了一万带到山崖上，从那里把他们扔下去，以致他们都摔碎了。

chapters.en: Meanwhile the troops that Amaziah had dismissed from battle raided the cities of Judah, from Samaria to Beth-horon. They struck down 3,000 people and carried off a great deal of plunder.
chapters.zh: 但亚玛谢所打发回去、不许一同出征的那些军兵攻打犹大各城，从撒马利亚直到伯‧和崙，杀了三千人，抢了许多财物。

chapters.en: When Amaziah returned from the slaughter of the Edomites, he brought back the gods of the Seirites, set them up as his own gods, bowed before them, and burned sacrifices to them.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢杀了以东人回来，就把西珥的神像带回，立为自己的神，在它面前叩拜烧香。

chapters.en: Therefore the anger of the LORD burned against Amaziah, and He sent him a prophet, who said, “Why have you sought this people’s gods, which could not deliver them from your hand?”
chapters.zh: 因此，耶和华的怒气向亚玛谢发作，就差一个先知去见他，说：「这些神不能救它的民脱离你的手，你为何寻求它呢？」

chapters.en:
While he was still speaking, the king asked, “Have we made you the counselor to the king? Stop! Why be struck down?”
So the prophet stopped, but he said, “I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not heeded my advice.”
chapters.zh: 先知与王说话的时候，王对他说：「谁立你作王的谋士呢？你住口吧！为何找打呢？」先知就止住了，又说：「你行这事，不听从我的劝戒，我知道上帝定意要灭你。」

chapters.en: Then Amaziah king of Judah took counsel and sent word to the king of Israel Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu. “Come, let us meet face to face,” he said.
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚玛谢〔与群臣〕商议，就差遣使者去见耶户的孙子、约哈斯的儿子、以色列王约阿施，说：「你来，我们二人相见〔于战场〕。」

chapters.en: But Jehoash king of Israel replied to Amaziah king of Judah: “A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle.
chapters.zh: 以色列王约阿施差遣使者去见犹大王亚玛谢，说：「黎巴嫩的蒺藜差遣使者去见黎巴嫩的香柏树，说：『将你的女儿给我儿子为妻。』后来黎巴嫩有一个野兽经过，把蒺藜践踏了。

chapters.en: You have said, ‘Look, I have defeated Edom,’ and your heart has become proud and boastful. Now stay at home. Why should you stir up trouble so that you fall—you and Judah with you?”
chapters.zh: 你说：『看哪，我打败了以东人』，你就心高气傲，以致矜夸。你在家里安居就罢了，为何要惹祸使自己和犹大国一同败亡呢？」

chapters.en: But Amaziah would not listen, for this had come from God in order to deliver them into the hand of Jehoash, because they had sought the gods of Edom.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢却不肯听从。这是出乎上帝，好将他们交在〔敌人〕手里，因为他们寻求以东的神。

chapters.en: So Jehoash king of Israel advanced, and he and Amaziah king of Judah faced each other at Beth-shemesh in Judah.
chapters.zh: 于是以色列王约阿施上来，在犹大的伯‧示麦与犹大王亚玛谢相见〔于战场〕。

chapters.en: And Judah was routed before Israel, and every man fled to his own home.
chapters.zh: 犹大人败在以色列人面前，各自逃回家里去了。

chapters.en:
There at Beth-shemesh, Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz.
Then Jehoash brought him to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate—a section of four hundred cubits.
chapters.zh: 以色列王约阿施在伯‧示麦擒住约哈斯〔注：就是亚哈谢〕的孙子、约阿施的儿子、犹大王亚玛谢，将他带到耶路撒冷，又拆毁耶路撒冷的城墙，从以法莲门直到角门，共四百肘；

chapters.en: He took all the gold and silver and all the articles found in the house of God with Obed-edom and in the treasuries of the royal palace, as well as some hostages. Then he returned to Samaria.
chapters.zh: 又将俄别‧以东所看守上帝殿里的一切金银和器皿，与王宫里的财宝都拿了去，并带人去为质，就回撒马利亚去了。

chapters.en: Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列王约哈斯的儿子约阿施死后，犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢又活了十五年。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Amaziah, from beginning to end, are they not written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel?
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢其余的事，自始至终不都写在犹大和以色列诸王记上吗？

chapters.en: From the time that Amaziah turned from following the LORD, a conspiracy was formed against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish. But men were sent after him to Lachish, and they killed him there.
chapters.zh: 自从亚玛谢离弃耶和华之后，在耶路撒冷有人背叛他，他就逃到拉吉；叛党却打发人到拉吉，将他杀了。

chapters.en: They carried him back on horses and buried him with his fathers in the City of Judah.
chapters.zh: 人就用马将他的尸首驮回，葬在犹大〔京〕城他列祖的坟地里。

chapters.en: All the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
chapters.zh: 犹大众民立亚玛谢的儿子乌西雅〔注：又名亚撒利雅〕接续他父作王，那时他年十六岁。

chapters.en: Uzziah was the one who rebuilt Eloth and restored it to Judah after King Amaziah rested with his fathers.
chapters.zh: （亚玛谢与他列祖同睡之后，乌西雅收回以禄仍归犹大，又重新修理。）

chapters.en: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother’s name was Jecoliah; she was from Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅登基的时候年十六岁，在耶路撒冷作王五十二年。他母亲名叫耶可利雅，是耶路撒冷人。

chapters.en: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他父亚玛谢一切所行的；

chapters.en: He sought God throughout the days of Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God. And as long as he sought the LORD, God gave him success.
chapters.zh: 通晓上帝默示，撒迦利亚在世的时候，乌西雅定意寻求上帝；他寻求耶和华，上帝就使他亨通。

chapters.en: Uzziah went out to wage war against the Philistines, and he tore down the walls of Gath, Jabneh, and Ashdod. Then he built cities near Ashdod and among the Philistines.
chapters.zh: 他出去攻击非利士人，拆毁了迦特城、雅比尼城，和亚实突城；在非利士人中，在亚实突境内，又建筑了些城。

chapters.en: God helped him against the Philistines, against the Arabs living in Gur-baal, and against the Meunites.
chapters.zh: 上帝帮助他攻击非利士人和住在姑珥‧巴力的阿拉伯人，并米乌尼人。

chapters.en: The Ammonites brought tribute to Uzziah, and his fame spread as far as the border of Egypt, for he had become exceedingly powerful.
chapters.zh: 亚扪人给乌西雅进贡。他的名声传到埃及，因他甚是强盛。

chapters.en: Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate, the Valley Gate, and the angle in the wall, and he fortified them.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅在耶路撒冷的角门和谷门，并〔城墙〕转弯之处，建筑城楼，且甚坚固；

chapters.en: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns. And since he was a lover of the soil, he had farmers and vinedressers in the hill country and in the fertile fields.
chapters.zh: 又在旷野与高原和平原，建筑望楼，挖了许多井，因他的牲畜甚多；又在山地和佳美之地，有农夫和修理葡萄园的人，因为他喜悦农事。

chapters.en: Uzziah had an army ready for battle that went out to war by assigned divisions, as recorded by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer under the direction of Hananiah, one of the royal officers.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅又有军兵，照书记耶利和官长玛西雅所数点的，在王的一个将军哈拿尼雅手下，分队出战。

chapters.en: The total number of family leaders of the mighty men of valor was 2,600.
chapters.zh: 族长、大能勇士的总数共有二千六百人，

chapters.en: Under their authority was an army of 307,500 trained for war, a powerful force to support the king against his enemies.
chapters.zh: 他们手下的军兵共有三十万七千五百人，都有大能，善于争战，帮助王攻击仇敌。

chapters.en: Uzziah supplied the entire army with shields, spears, helmets, armor, bows, and slingstones.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅为全军预备盾牌、枪、盔、甲、弓，和甩石的机弦，

chapters.en: And in Jerusalem he made skillfully designed devices to shoot arrows and catapult large stones from the towers and corners. So his fame spread far and wide, for he was helped tremendously until he became powerful.
chapters.zh: 又在耶路撒冷使巧匠做机器，安在城楼和角楼上，用以射箭发石。乌西雅的名声传到远方；因为他得了非常的帮助，甚是强盛。

chapters.en: But when Uzziah became powerful, his arrogance led to his own destruction. He was unfaithful to the LORD his God, for he entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense.
chapters.zh: 他既强盛，就心高气傲，以致行事邪僻，干犯耶和华－他的上帝，进耶和华的殿，要在香坛上烧香。

chapters.en: Then Azariah the priest, along with eighty brave priests of the LORD, went in after him.
chapters.zh: 祭司亚撒利雅率领耶和华勇敢的祭司八十人，跟随他进去。

chapters.en: They took their stand against King Uzziah and said, “Uzziah, you have no right to offer incense to the LORD. Only the priests, the descendants of Aaron, are consecrated to burn incense. Leave the sanctuary, for you have acted unfaithfully; you will not receive honor from the LORD God.”
chapters.zh: 他们就阻挡乌西雅王，对他说：「乌西雅啊，给耶和华烧香不是你的事，乃是亚伦子孙承接圣职祭司的事。你出圣殿吧！因为你犯了罪。你行这事，耶和华上帝必不使你得荣耀。」

chapters.en: Uzziah, with a censer in his hand to offer incense, was enraged. But while he raged against the priests in their presence in the house of the LORD before the altar of incense, leprosy broke out on his forehead.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅就发怒，手拿香炉要烧香。他向祭司发怒的时候，在耶和华殿中香坛旁众祭司面前，额上忽然发出大痲疯。

chapters.en: When Azariah the chief priest and all the priests turned to him and saw his leprous forehead, they rushed him out. Indeed, he himself hurried to get out, because the LORD had afflicted him.
chapters.zh: 大祭司亚撒利雅和众祭司观看，见他额上发出大痲疯，就催他出殿；他自己也急速出去，因为耶和华降灾与他。

chapters.en: So King Uzziah was a leper until the day of his death. He lived in isolation, leprous and cut off from the house of the LORD, while his son Jotham had charge of the royal palace and governed the people of the land.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅王长大痲疯直到死日，因此住在别的宫里，与耶和华的殿隔绝。他儿子约坦管理家事，治理国民。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Uzziah, from beginning to end, they are recorded by the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅其余的事，自始至终都是亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚所记的。

chapters.en: And Uzziah rested with his fathers and was buried near them in a field of burial that belonged to the kings, for the people said, “He was a leper.” And his son Jotham reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅与他列祖同睡，葬在王陵的田间他列祖的坟地里；因为人说，他是长大痲疯的。他儿子约坦接续他作王。

chapters.en: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. His mother’s name was Jerushah daughter of Zadok.
chapters.zh: 约坦登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年，他母亲名叫耶路沙，是撒督的女儿。

chapters.en: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Uzziah had done. In addition, he did not enter the temple of the LORD. But the people still behaved corruptly.
chapters.zh: 约坦行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他父乌西雅一切所行的，只是不入耶和华的殿。百姓还行邪僻的事。

chapters.en: Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the house of the LORD, and he worked extensively on the wall at the hill of Ophel.
chapters.zh: 约坦建立耶和华殿的上门，在俄斐勒城上多有建造，

chapters.en: He also built cities in the hill country of Judah and fortresses and towers in the forests.
chapters.zh: 又在犹大山地建造城邑，在树林中建筑营寨和高楼。

chapters.en: Jotham waged war against the king of the Ammonites and defeated them, and that year they gave him a hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat, and ten thousand cors of barley. They paid him the same in the second and third years.
chapters.zh: 约坦与亚扪人的王打仗胜了他们，当年他们进贡银一百他连得，小麦一万歌珥，大麦一万歌珥；第二年、第三年也是这样。

chapters.en: So Jotham grew powerful because he ordered his ways before the LORD his God.
chapters.zh: 约坦在耶和华－他上帝面前行正道，以致日渐强盛。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Jotham, along with all his wars and his ways, they are indeed written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
chapters.zh: 约坦其余的事和一切争战，并他的行为，都写在以色列和犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years.
chapters.zh: 他登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年。

chapters.en: And Jotham rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David. And his son Ahaz reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 约坦与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城里。他儿子亚哈斯接续他作王。

chapters.en: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. And unlike David his father, he did not do what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯登基的时候年二十岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年；不像他祖大卫行耶和华眼中看为正的事，

chapters.en: Instead, he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel and even made cast images of the Baals.
chapters.zh: 却行以色列诸王的道，又铸造巴力的像，

chapters.en: Moreover, Ahaz burned incense in the Valley of Ben-hinnom and sacrificed his sons in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 并且在欣嫩子谷烧香，用火焚烧他的儿女，行耶和华在以色列人面前所驱逐的外邦人那可憎的事；

chapters.en: And he sacrificed and burned incense on the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.
chapters.zh: 并在邱坛上、山冈上、各青翠树下献祭烧香。

chapters.en:
So the LORD his God delivered Ahaz into the hand of the king of Aram, who attacked him and took many captives to Damascus.
Ahaz was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who struck him with great force.
chapters.zh: 所以，耶和华－他的上帝将他交在亚兰王手里。亚兰王打败他，掳了他许多的民，带到大马士革去。上帝又将他交在以色列王手里，以色列王向他大行杀戮。

chapters.en: For in one day Pekah son of Remaliah killed 120,000 valiant men in Judah. This happened because they had forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers.
chapters.zh: 利玛利的儿子比加一日杀了犹大人十二万，都是勇士，因为他们离弃了耶和华－他们列祖的上帝。

chapters.en: Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the son of the king, Azrikam the governor of the palace, and Elkanah the second to the king.
chapters.zh: 有一个以法莲中的勇士，名叫细基利，杀了王的儿子玛西雅和管理王宫的押斯利甘，并宰相以利加拿。

chapters.en: Then the Israelites took 200,000 captives from their kinsmen—women, sons, and daughters. They also carried off a great deal of plunder and brought it to Samaria.
chapters.zh: 以色列人掳了他们的弟兄，连妇人带儿女共有二十万，又掠了许多的财物，带到撒马利亚去了。

chapters.en: But a prophet of the LORD named Oded was there, and he went out to meet the army that returned to Samaria. “Look,” he said to them, “because of His wrath against Judah, the LORD, the God of your fathers, has delivered them into your hand. But you have slaughtered them in a rage that reaches up to heaven.
chapters.zh: 但那里有耶和华的一个先知，名叫俄德，出来迎接往撒马利亚去的军兵，对他们说：「因为耶和华－你们列祖的上帝恼怒犹大人，所以将他们交在你们手里，你们竟怒气冲天，大行杀戮。

chapters.en: And now you intend to reduce to slavery the men and women of Judah and Jerusalem. But are you not also guilty before the LORD your God?
chapters.zh: 如今你们又有意强逼犹大人和耶路撒冷人作你们的奴婢，你们岂不也有得罪耶和华－你们上帝的事吗？

chapters.en: Now therefore, listen to me and return the captives you took from your kinsmen, for the fierce anger of the LORD is upon you.”
chapters.zh: 现在你们当听我说，要将掳来的弟兄释放回去，因为耶和华向你们已经大发烈怒。」

chapters.en: Then some of the leaders of the Ephraimites —Azariah son of Jehohanan, Berechiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai—stood in opposition to those arriving from the war.
chapters.zh: 于是，以法莲人的几个族长－就是约哈难的儿子亚撒利雅、米实利末的儿子比利家、沙龙的儿子耶希西家、哈得莱的儿子亚玛撒－起来拦挡出兵回来的人，

chapters.en: “You must not bring the captives here,” they said, “for you are proposing to bring guilt upon us from the LORD and to add to our sins and our guilt. For our guilt is great, and fierce anger is upon Israel.”
chapters.zh: 对他们说：「你们不可带进这被掳的人来！你们想要使我们得罪耶和华，加增我们的罪恶过犯？因为我们的罪过甚大，已经有烈怒临到以色列人了。」

chapters.en: So the armed men left the captives and the plunder before the leaders and all the assembly.
chapters.zh: 于是带兵器的人将掳来的人口和掠来的财物都留在众首领和会众的面前。

chapters.en: Then the men who were designated by name arose, took charge of the captives, and provided from the plunder clothing for the naked. They clothed them, gave them sandals and food and drink, anointed their wounds, and put all the feeble on donkeys. So they brought them to Jericho, the City of Palms, to their brothers. Then they returned to Samaria.
chapters.zh: 以上提名的那些人就站起，使被掳的人前来；其中有赤身的，就从所掠的财物中拿出衣服和鞋来，给他们穿，又给他们吃喝，用膏抹他们；其中有软弱的，就使他们骑驴，送到棕树城耶利哥他们弟兄那里；随后就回撒马利亚去了。

chapters.en: At that time King Ahaz sent for help from the king of Assyria.
chapters.zh: 那时，亚哈斯王差遣人去见亚述诸王，求他们帮助；

chapters.en: The Edomites had again come and attacked Judah and carried away captives.
chapters.zh: 因为以东人又来攻击犹大，掳掠子民。

chapters.en: The Philistines had also raided the cities of the foothills and the Negev of Judah, capturing and occupying Beth-shemesh, Aijalon, and Gederoth, as well as Soco, Timnah, and Gimzo with their villages.
chapters.zh: 非利士人也来侵占高原和犹大南方的城邑，取了伯‧示麦、亚雅崙、基低罗，梭哥和属梭哥的乡村，亭纳和属亭纳的乡村，瑾锁和属瑾锁的乡村，就住在那里。

chapters.en: For the LORD humbled Judah because Ahaz king of Israel had thrown off restraint in Judah and had been most unfaithful to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 因为以色列王亚哈斯在犹大放肆，大大干犯耶和华，所以耶和华使犹大卑微。
