chapters.en: Then Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria came to Ahaz but afflicted him rather than strengthening him.
chapters.zh: 亚述王提革拉‧毗列色上来，却没有帮助他，反倒欺凌他。

chapters.en: Although Ahaz had taken a portion from the house of the LORD, from the royal palace, and from the princes and had presented it to the king of Assyria, it did not help him.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯从耶和华殿里和王宫中，并首领家内所取的财宝给了亚述王，这也无济于事。

chapters.en: In the time of his distress, King Ahaz became even more unfaithful to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这亚哈斯王在急难的时候，越发得罪耶和华。

chapters.en: He sacrificed to the gods of Damascus, who had defeated him, and he said, “Because the gods of the kings of Aram have helped them, I will sacrifice to them that they may help me.” But these gods were the downfall of Ahaz and of all Israel.
chapters.zh: 他祭祀攻击他的大马士革之神，说：「因为亚兰王的神帮助他们，我也献祭与他，他好帮助我。」但那些神使他和以色列众人败亡了。

chapters.en: Then Ahaz gathered up the articles of the house of God, cut them into pieces, shut the doors of the house of the LORD, and set up altars of his own on every street corner in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯将上帝殿里的器皿都聚了来，毁坏了，且封锁耶和华殿的门；在耶路撒冷各处的拐角建筑祭坛，

chapters.en: In every city of Judah he built high places to offer incense to other gods, and so he provoked the LORD, the God of his fathers.
chapters.zh: 又在犹大各城建立邱坛，与别神烧香，惹动耶和华－他列祖上帝的怒气。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Ahaz and all his ways, from beginning to end, they are indeed written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯其余的事和他的行为，自始至终都写在犹大和以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: And Ahaz rested with his fathers and was buried in the city of Jerusalem, but he was not placed in the tombs of the kings of Israel. And his son Hezekiah reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 亚哈斯与他列祖同睡，葬在耶路撒冷城里，没有送入以色列诸王的坟墓中。他儿子希西家接续他作王。

chapters.en: Hezekiah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.
chapters.zh: 希西家登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他母亲名叫亚比雅，是撒迦利雅的女儿。

chapters.en: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father David had done.
chapters.zh: 希西家行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他祖大卫一切所行的。

chapters.en: In the first month of the first year of his reign, Hezekiah opened and repaired the doors of the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 元年正月，开了耶和华殿的门，重新修理。

chapters.en: Then he brought in the priests and Levites and gathered them in the square on the east side.
chapters.zh: 他召众祭司和利未人来，聚集在东边的宽阔处，

chapters.en: “Listen to me, O Levites,” he said. “Consecrate yourselves now and consecrate the house of the LORD, the God of your fathers. Remove from the Holy Place every impurity.
chapters.zh: 对他们说：「利未人哪，当听我说：现在你们要洁净自己，又洁净耶和华－你们列祖上帝的殿，从圣所中除去污秽之物。

chapters.en: For our fathers were unfaithful and did evil in the sight of the LORD our God. They abandoned Him, turned their faces away from the dwelling place of the LORD, and turned their backs on Him.
chapters.zh: 我们列祖犯了罪，行耶和华－我们上帝眼中看为恶的事，离弃他，转脸背向他的居所，

chapters.en: They also shut the doors of the portico and extinguished the lamps. They did not burn incense or present burnt offerings in the Holy Place of the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 封锁廊门，吹灭灯火，不在圣所中向以色列上帝烧香，或献燔祭。

chapters.en: Therefore, the wrath of the LORD has fallen upon Judah and Jerusalem, and He has made them an object of terror, horror, and scorn, as you can see with your own eyes.
chapters.zh: 因此，耶和华的忿怒临到犹大和耶路撒冷，将其中的人抛来抛去，令人惊骇、嗤笑，正如你们亲眼所见的。

chapters.en: For behold, this is why our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and daughters and wives are in captivity.
chapters.zh: 所以我们的祖宗倒在刀下，我们的妻子儿女也被掳掠。

chapters.en: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with the LORD, the God of Israel, so that His fierce anger will turn away from us.
chapters.zh: 现在我心中有意与耶和华－以色列的上帝立约，好使他的烈怒转离我们。

chapters.en: Now, my sons, do not be negligent, for the LORD has chosen you to stand before Him, to serve Him, to minister before Him, and to burn incense.”
chapters.zh: 我的众子啊，现在不要懈怠；因为耶和华拣选你们站在他面前事奉他，与他烧香。」
于是，利未人哥辖的子孙、亚玛赛的儿子玛哈，亚撒利雅的儿子约珥；米拉利的子孙、亚伯底的儿子基士，耶哈利勒的儿子亚撒利雅；革顺的子孙、薪玛的儿子约亚，约亚的儿子伊甸；

chapters.en:
Shimri and Jeuel from the Elizaphanites;
Zechariah and Mattaniah from the Asaphites;
chapters.zh: 以利撒反的子孙申利和耶利；亚萨的子孙撒迦利雅和玛探雅；

chapters.en:
Jehiel and Shimei from the Hemanites;
and Shemaiah and Uzziel from the Jeduthunites.
chapters.zh: 希幔的子孙耶歇和示每；耶杜顿的子孙示玛雅和乌薛；

chapters.en: When they had assembled their brothers and consecrated themselves, they went in to cleanse the house of the LORD, according to the command of the king by the words of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 起来聚集他们的弟兄，洁净自己，照着王的吩咐、耶和华的命令，进去洁净耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: So the priests went inside the house of the LORD to cleanse it, and they brought out to the courtyard all the unclean things that they found in the temple of the LORD. Then the Levites took these things and carried them out to the Kidron Valley.
chapters.zh: 祭司进入耶和华的殿要洁净殿，将殿中所有污秽之物搬到耶和华殿的院内，利未人接去，搬到外头汲沦溪边。

chapters.en: They began the consecration on the first day of the first month, and on the eighth day of the month they reached the portico of the LORD. For eight more days they consecrated the house of the LORD itself, finishing on the sixteenth day of the first month.
chapters.zh: 从正月初一日洁净起，初八日到了耶和华的殿廊，用八日的工夫洁净耶和华的殿，到正月十六日才洁净完了。

chapters.en: Then they went in to King Hezekiah and reported, “We have cleansed the entire house of the LORD, the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the table of the showbread with all its utensils.
chapters.zh: 于是，他们晋见希西家王，说：「我们已将耶和华的全殿和燔祭坛，并坛的一切器皿、陈设饼的桌子，与桌子的一切器皿都洁净了；

chapters.en: Moreover, we have prepared and consecrated all the articles that King Ahaz in his unfaithfulness cast aside during his reign. They are now in front of the altar of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 并且亚哈斯王在位犯罪的时候所废弃的器皿，我们预备齐全，且洁净了，现今都在耶和华的坛前。」

chapters.en: Early the next morning King Hezekiah gathered the city officials and went up to the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 希西家王清早起来，聚集城里的首领都上耶和华的殿；

chapters.en: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats as a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And the king commanded the priests, the descendants of Aaron, to offer them on the altar of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 牵了七只公牛，七只公羊，七只羊羔，七只公山羊，要为国、为殿、为犹大人作赎罪祭。王吩咐亚伦的子孙众祭司，献在耶和华的坛上，

chapters.en: So they slaughtered the bulls, and the priests took the blood and splattered it on the altar. They slaughtered the rams and splattered the blood on the altar. And they slaughtered the lambs and splattered the blood on the altar.
chapters.zh: 就宰了公牛，祭司接血洒在坛上，宰了公羊，把血洒在坛上，又宰了羊羔，也把血洒在坛上；

chapters.en: Then they brought the goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly, who laid their hands on them.
chapters.zh: 把那作赎罪祭的公山羊牵到王和会众面前，他们就按手在其上。

chapters.en: And the priests slaughtered the goats and put their blood on the altar for a sin offering, to make atonement for all Israel, because the king had ordered the burnt offering and the sin offering for all Israel.
chapters.zh: 祭司宰了羊，将血献在坛上作赎罪祭，为以色列众人赎罪，因为王吩咐将燔祭和赎罪祭为以色列众人〔献上〕。

chapters.en: Hezekiah stationed the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps, and lyres according to the command of David, of Gad the king’s seer, and of Nathan the prophet. For the command had come from the LORD through His prophets.
chapters.zh: 王又派利未人在耶和华殿中敲钹，鼓瑟，弹琴，乃照大卫和他先见迦得，并先知拿单所吩咐的，就是耶和华藉先知所吩咐的。

chapters.en: The Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.
chapters.zh: 利未人拿大卫的乐器，祭司拿号，一同站立。

chapters.en: And Hezekiah ordered that the burnt offering be sacrificed on the altar. When the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD and the trumpets began as well, accompanied by the instruments of David king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 希西家吩咐在坛上献燔祭，燔祭一献，就唱赞美耶和华的歌，用号，并用以色列王大卫的乐器相和。

chapters.en: The whole assembly was worshiping, the singers were singing, and the trumpeters were playing. All this continued until the burnt offering was completed.
chapters.zh: 会众都敬拜，歌唱的歌唱，吹号的吹号，如此直到燔祭献完了。

chapters.en: When the offerings were completed, the king and all those present with him bowed down and worshiped.
chapters.zh: 献完了祭，王和一切跟随的人都俯伏敬拜。

chapters.en: Then King Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to sing praises to the LORD in the words of David and of Asaph the seer. So they sang praises with gladness and bowed down and worshiped.
chapters.zh: 希西家王与众首领又吩咐利未人用大卫和先见亚萨的诗词颂赞耶和华；他们就欢欢喜喜地颂赞耶和华，低头敬拜。

chapters.en:
Then Hezekiah said, “Now that you have consecrated yourselves to the LORD, come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings to the house of the LORD.”
So the assembly brought sacrifices and thank offerings, and all whose hearts were willing brought burnt offerings.
chapters.zh: 希西家说：「你们既然归耶和华为圣，就要前来把祭物和感谢祭奉到耶和华殿里。」会众就把祭物和感谢祭奉来，凡甘心乐意的也将燔祭奉来。

chapters.en: The number of burnt offerings the assembly brought was seventy bulls, a hundred rams, and two hundred lambs; all these were for a burnt offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 会众所奉的燔祭如下：公牛七十只，公羊一百只，羊羔二百只，这都是作燔祭献给耶和华的；

chapters.en: And the consecrated offerings were six hundred bulls and three thousand sheep.
chapters.zh: 又有分别为圣之物，公牛六百只，绵羊三千只。

chapters.en: However, since there were not enough priests to skin all the burnt offerings, their Levite brothers helped them until the work was finished and until the priests had consecrated themselves. For the Levites had been more diligent in consecrating themselves than the priests had been.
chapters.zh: 但祭司太少，不能剥尽燔祭牲的皮，所以他们的弟兄利未人帮助他们，直等燔祭的事完了，又等〔别的〕祭司自洁了；因为利未人诚心自洁，胜过祭司。

chapters.en: Furthermore, the burnt offerings were abundant, along with the fat of the peace offerings and the drink offerings for the burnt offerings. So the service of the house of the LORD was established.
chapters.zh: 燔祭和平安祭牲的脂油，并燔祭同献的奠祭甚多。这样，耶和华殿中的事务俱都齐备了〔注：或译：就整顿了〕。

chapters.en: Then Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced at what God had prepared for the people, because everything had been accomplished so quickly.
chapters.zh: 这事办的甚速，希西家和众民都喜乐，是因上帝为众民所预备的。

chapters.en: Then Hezekiah sent word throughout all Israel and Judah, and he also wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasseh inviting them to come to the house of the LORD in Jerusalem to keep the Passover of the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 希西家差遣人去见以色列和犹大众人，又写信给以法莲和玛拿西人，叫他们到耶路撒冷耶和华的殿，向耶和华－以色列的上帝守逾越节；

chapters.en: For the king and his officials and the whole assembly in Jerusalem had decided to keep the Passover in the second month,
chapters.zh: 因为王和众首领，并耶路撒冷全会众已经商议，要在二月内守逾越节。

chapters.en: since they had been unable to keep it at the regular time, because not enough priests had consecrated themselves and the people had not been gathered in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 正月〔注：原文是那时〕间他们不能守；因为自洁的祭司尚不敷用，百姓也没有聚集在耶路撒冷；

chapters.en: This plan pleased the king and the whole assembly.
chapters.zh: 王与全会众都以这事为善。

chapters.en: So they established a decree to circulate a proclamation throughout Israel, from Beersheba to Dan, that the people should come to keep the Passover of the LORD, the God of Israel, in Jerusalem. For they had not observed it in great numbers as prescribed.
chapters.zh: 于是定了命令，传遍以色列，从别是巴直到但，使他们都来，在耶路撒冷向耶和华－以色列的上帝守逾越节；因为照所写的例，守这节的不多了〔注：或译：因为民许久没有照所写的例守节了〕。

chapters.en:
At the command of the king, the couriers went throughout Israel and Judah with letters from the king and his officials, which read:
“Children of Israel, return to the LORD, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, so that He may return to those of you who remain, who have escaped the grasp of the kings of Assyria.
chapters.zh: 驿卒就把王和众首领的信，遵着王命传遍以色列和犹大。信内说：「以色列人哪，你们当转向耶和华－亚伯拉罕、以撒、以色列的上帝，好叫他转向你们这脱离亚述王手的余民。

chapters.en: Do not be like your fathers and brothers who were unfaithful to the LORD, the God of their fathers, so that He made them an object of horror, as you can see.
chapters.zh: 你们不要效法你们列祖和你们的弟兄；他们干犯耶和华－他们列祖的上帝，以致耶和华丢弃他们，使他们败亡〔注：或译：令人惊骇〕，正如你们所见的。

chapters.en: Now do not stiffen your necks as your fathers did. Submit to the LORD and come to His sanctuary, which He has consecrated forever. Serve the LORD your God, so that His fierce anger will turn away from you.
chapters.zh: 现在不要像你们列祖硬着颈项，只要归顺耶和华，进入他的圣所，就是永远成圣的居所；又要事奉耶和华－你们的上帝，好使他的烈怒转离你们。

chapters.en: For if you return to the LORD, your brothers and sons will receive mercy in the presence of their captors and will return to this land. For the LORD your God is gracious and merciful; He will not turn His face away from you if you return to Him.”
chapters.zh: 你们若转向耶和华，你们的弟兄和儿女必在掳掠他们的人面前蒙怜恤，得以归回这地，因为耶和华－你们的上帝有恩典、施怜悯。你们若转向他，他必不转脸不顾你们。」

chapters.en: And the couriers traveled from city to city through the land of Ephraim and Manasseh as far as Zebulun, but the people scorned and mocked them.
chapters.zh: 驿卒就由这城跑到那城，传遍了以法莲、玛拿西，直到西布伦。那里的人却戏笑他们，讥诮他们。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, some from Asher, Manasseh, and Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 然而亚设、玛拿西、西布伦中也有人自卑，来到耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Moreover, the power of God was on the people in Judah to give them one heart to obey the command of the king and his officials according to the word of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 上帝也感动犹大人，使他们一心遵行王与众首领凭耶和华之言所发的命令。

chapters.en: In the second month, a very great assembly gathered in Jerusalem to celebrate the Feast of Unleavened Bread.
chapters.zh: 二月，有许多人在耶路撒冷聚集，成为大会，要守除酵节。

chapters.en: They proceeded to remove the altars in Jerusalem and to take away the incense altars and throw them into the Kidron Valley.
chapters.zh: 他们起来，把耶路撒冷的祭坛和烧香的坛尽都除去，抛在汲沦溪中。

chapters.en: And on the fourteenth day of the second month they slaughtered the Passover lamb. The priests and Levites were ashamed, and they consecrated themselves and brought burnt offerings to the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 二月十四日，宰了逾越节〔的羊羔〕。祭司与利未人觉得惭愧，就洁净自己，把燔祭奉到耶和华殿中，

chapters.en: They stood at their prescribed posts, according to the Law of Moses the man of God. The priests splattered the blood, which they received from the hand of the Levites.
chapters.zh: 遵着神人摩西的律法，照例站在自己的地方；祭司从利未人手里〔接过〕血来，洒在坛上。

chapters.en: Since there were many in the assembly who had not consecrated themselves, the Levites were in charge of slaughtering the Passover lambs for every unclean person to consecrate the lambs to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 会中有许多人尚未自洁，所以利未人为一切不洁之人宰逾越节〔的羊羔〕，使他们在耶和华面前成为圣洁。

chapters.en: A large number of the people—many from Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun—had not purified themselves, yet they ate the Passover, contrary to what was written. But Hezekiah interceded for them, saying, “May the LORD, who is good, provide atonement for everyone
who sets his heart on seeking God—the LORD, the God of his fathers—even if he is not cleansed according to the purification rules of the sanctuary.”
chapters.zh: 以法莲、玛拿西、以萨迦、西布伦有许多人尚未自洁，他们却也吃逾越节〔的羊羔〕，不合所记录的定例。希西家为他们祷告说：「凡专心寻求上帝，就是耶和华－他列祖之上帝的，虽不照着圣所洁净之礼〔自洁〕，求至善的耶和华也饶恕他。」

chapters.en: And the LORD heard Hezekiah and healed the people.
chapters.zh: 耶和华垂听希西家的祷告，就饶恕〔注：原文是医治〕百姓。

chapters.en: The Israelites who were present in Jerusalem celebrated the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days with great joy, and the Levites and priests praised the LORD day after day, accompanied by loud instruments of praise to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 在耶路撒冷的以色列人大大喜乐，守除酵节七日。利未人和祭司用响亮的乐器，日日颂赞耶和华。

chapters.en: And Hezekiah encouraged all the Levites who performed skillfully before the LORD. For seven days they ate their assigned portion, sacrificing peace offerings and giving thanks to the LORD, the God of their fathers.
chapters.zh: 希西家慰劳一切善于〔事奉〕耶和华的利未人。于是众人吃节筵七日，又献平安祭，且向耶和华－他们列祖的上帝认罪。

chapters.en: The whole assembly agreed to observe seven more days, so they observed seven days with joy.
chapters.zh: 全会众商议，要再守节七日；于是欢欢喜喜地又守节七日。

chapters.en: For Hezekiah king of Judah contributed a thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep for the assembly, and the officials contributed a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep for the assembly, and a great number of priests consecrated themselves.
chapters.zh: 犹大王希西家赐给会众公牛一千只，羊七千只为祭物；众首领也赐给会众公牛一千只，羊一万只，并有许多的祭司洁净自己。

chapters.en: Then the whole assembly of Judah rejoiced along with the priests and Levites and the whole assembly that had come from Israel, including the foreigners who had come from Israel and those who lived in Judah.
chapters.zh: 犹大全会众、祭司、利未人，并那从以色列地来的会众和寄居的人，以及犹大寄居的人，尽都喜乐。

chapters.en: So there was great rejoicing in Jerusalem, for nothing like this had happened there since the days of Solomon son of David king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 这样，在耶路撒冷大有喜乐，自从以色列王大卫儿子所罗门的时候，在耶路撒冷没有这样的喜乐。

chapters.en: Then the priests and the Levites stood to bless the people, and God heard their voice, and their prayer came into His holy dwelling place in heaven.
chapters.zh: 那时，祭司、利未人起来，为民祝福。他们的声音蒙上帝垂听，他们的祷告达到天上的圣所。

chapters.en: When all this had ended, the Israelites in attendance went out to the cities of Judah and broke up the sacred pillars, chopped down the Asherah poles, and tore down the high places and altars throughout Judah and Benjamin, as well as in Ephraim and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the Israelites returned to their cities, each to his own property.
chapters.zh: 这事既都完毕，在那里的以色列众人就到犹大的城邑，打碎柱像，砍断木偶，又在犹大、便雅悯、以法莲、玛拿西遍地将邱坛和祭坛拆毁净尽。于是以色列众人各回各城，各归各地。

chapters.en: Hezekiah reestablished the divisions of the priests and Levites—each of them according to their duties as priests or Levites—for the burnt offerings and peace offerings, for ministry, for giving thanks, and for singing praises at the gates of the LORD’s dwelling.
chapters.zh: 希西家派定祭司利未人的班次，各按各职献燔祭和平安祭，又在耶和华殿〔注：原文是营〕门内事奉，称谢颂赞〔耶和华〕。

chapters.en: The king contributed from his own possessions for the regular morning and evening burnt offerings and for the burnt offerings on the Sabbaths, New Moons, and appointed feasts, as written in the Law of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 王又从自己的产业中定出分来为燔祭，就是早晚的燔祭和安息日、月朔，并节期的燔祭，都是按耶和华律法上所载的；

chapters.en: Moreover, he commanded the people living in Jerusalem to make a contribution for the priests and Levites so that they could devote themselves to the Law of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 又吩咐住耶路撒冷的百姓将祭司、利未人所应得的分给他们，使他们专心遵守耶和华的律法。

chapters.en: As soon as the order went out, the Israelites generously provided the firstfruits of the grain, new wine, oil, and honey, and of all the produce of the field, and they brought in an abundance—a tithe of everything.
chapters.zh: 谕旨一出，以色列人就把初熟的五谷、新酒、油、蜜，和田地的出产多多送来，又把各物的十分之一送来的极多。

chapters.en: And the Israelites and Judahites who lived in the cities of Judah also brought a tithe of their herds and flocks and a tithe of the holy things consecrated to the LORD their God, and they laid them in large heaps.
chapters.zh: 住犹大各城的以色列人和犹大人也将牛羊的十分之一，并分别为圣归耶和华－他们上帝之物，就是十分取一之物，尽都送来，积成堆垒；

chapters.en: In the third month they began building up the heaps, and they finished in the seventh month.
chapters.zh: 从三月积起，到七月才完。

chapters.en: When Hezekiah and his officials came and viewed the heaps, they blessed the LORD and His people Israel.
chapters.zh: 希西家和众首领来，看见堆垒，就称颂耶和华，又为耶和华的民以色列人祝福。

chapters.en: Then Hezekiah questioned the priests and Levites about the heaps,
chapters.zh: 希西家向祭司、利未人查问这堆垒。

chapters.en: and Azariah, the chief priest of the household of Zadok, answered him, “Since the people began to bring their contributions into the house of the LORD, we have had enough to eat, and there is plenty left over, because the LORD has blessed His people; this great abundance is what is left over.”
chapters.zh: 撒督家的大祭司亚撒利雅回答说：「自从〔民〕将供物送到耶和华殿以来，我们不但吃饱，且剩下的甚多；因为耶和华赐福给他的民，所剩下的才这样丰盛。」

chapters.en: Then Hezekiah commanded them to prepare storerooms in the house of the LORD, and they did so.
chapters.zh: 希西家吩咐在耶和华殿里预备仓房，他们就预备了。

chapters.en: And they faithfully brought in the contributions, tithes, and dedicated gifts. Conaniah the Levite was the officer in charge of them, and his brother Shimei was second.
chapters.zh: 他们诚心将供物和十分取一之物，并分别为圣之物，都搬入仓内。利未人歌楠雅掌管这事，他兄弟示每为副管。

chapters.en: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah were overseers under the authority of Conaniah and his brother Shimei, by appointment of King Hezekiah and of Azariah the chief official of the house of God.
chapters.zh: 耶歇、亚撒细雅、拿哈、亚撒黑、耶利末、约撒拔、以列、伊斯玛基雅、玛哈、比拿雅都是督理，在歌楠雅和他兄弟示每的手下，是希西家王和管理上帝殿的亚撒利雅所派的。

chapters.en: Kore son of Imnah the Levite, the keeper of the East Gate, was in charge of the freewill offerings given to God, distributing the contributions to the LORD and the consecrated gifts.
chapters.zh: 守东门的利未人音拿的儿子可利，掌管乐意献与上帝的礼物，发放献与耶和华的供物和至圣的物。

chapters.en: Under his authority, Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah faithfully distributed portions to their fellow priests in their cities, according to their divisions, old and young alike.
chapters.zh: 在他手下有伊甸、诖雅诖、耶书亚、示玛雅、亚玛利雅、示迦尼雅，在祭司的各城里供紧要的职任，无论弟兄大小，都按着班次分给他们。

chapters.en: In addition, they distributed portions to the males registered by genealogy who were three years of age or older—to all who would enter the house of the LORD for their daily duties for service in the responsibilities of their divisions—
chapters.zh: 按家谱，三岁以外的男丁，凡每日进耶和华殿、按班次供职的，也分给他；

chapters.en: and to the priests enrolled according to their families in the genealogy, as well as to the Levites twenty years of age or older, according to their responsibilities and divisions.
chapters.zh: 又按宗族家谱分给祭司，按班次职任分给二十岁以外的利未人，

chapters.en: The genealogy included all the little ones, wives, sons, and daughters of the whole assembly. For they had faithfully consecrated themselves as holy.
chapters.zh: 又按家谱计算，分给他们会中的妻子、儿女；因他们身供要职，自洁成圣。

chapters.en: As for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, who lived on the farmlands around each of their cities or in any other city, men were designated by name to distribute a portion to every male among the priests and to every Levite listed by the genealogies.
chapters.zh: 按名派定的人要把应得的分给亚伦子孙，住在各城郊野、祭司所有的男丁和一切载入家谱的利未人。

chapters.en: So this is what Hezekiah did throughout Judah. He did what was good and upright and true before the LORD his God.
chapters.zh: 希西家在犹大遍地这样办理，行耶和华－他上帝眼中看为善为正为忠的事。

chapters.en: He acted with all his heart in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law and the commandments, in order to seek his God. And so he prospered.
chapters.zh: 凡他所行的，无论是办上帝殿的事，是遵律法守诫命，是寻求他的上帝，都是尽心去行，无不亨通。

chapters.en: After all these acts of faithfulness, Sennacherib king of Assyria came and invaded Judah. He laid siege to the fortified cities, intending to conquer them for himself.
chapters.zh: 这虔诚的事以后，亚述王西拿基立来侵入犹大，围困一切坚固城，想要攻破占据。

chapters.en: When Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come to make war against Jerusalem,
chapters.zh: 希西家见西拿基立来，定意要攻打耶路撒冷，

chapters.en: he consulted with his leaders and mighty men about stopping up the waters of the springs outside the city, and they helped him carry it out.
chapters.zh: 就与首领和勇士商议，塞住城外的泉源；他们就都帮助他。

chapters.en: Many people assembled and stopped up all the springs and the stream that flowed through the land. “Why should the kings of Assyria come and find plenty of water?” they said.
chapters.zh: 于是有许多人聚集，塞了一切泉源，并通流国中的小河，说：「亚述王来，为何让他得着许多水呢？」

chapters.en: Then Hezekiah worked resolutely to rebuild all the broken sections of the wall and to raise up towers on it. He also built an outer wall and reinforced the supporting terraces of the City of David, and he produced an abundance of weapons and shields.
chapters.zh: 希西家力图自强，就修筑所有拆毁的城墙，高与城楼相齐；在城外又筑一城，坚固大卫城的米罗，制造了许多军器、盾牌；

chapters.en: Hezekiah appointed military commanders over the people and gathered the people in the square of the city gate. Then he encouraged them, saying,
chapters.zh: 设立军长管理百姓，将他们招聚在城门的宽阔处，用话勉励他们，说：

chapters.en: “Be strong and courageous! Do not be afraid or discouraged before the king of Assyria and the vast army with him, for there is a greater One with us than with him.
chapters.zh: 「你们当刚强壮胆，不要因亚述王和跟随他的大军恐惧、惊慌；因为与我们同在的，比与他们同在的更大。

chapters.en:
With him is only the arm of flesh, but with us is the LORD our God to help us and to fight our battles.”
So the people were strengthened by the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.
chapters.zh: 与他们同在的是肉臂，与我们同在的是耶和华－我们的上帝，他必帮助我们，为我们争战。」百姓就靠犹大王希西家的话，安然无惧了。

chapters.en: Later, as Sennacherib king of Assyria and all his forces besieged Lachish, he sent his servants to Jerusalem with a message for King Hezekiah of Judah and all the people of Judah who were in Jerusalem:
chapters.zh: 此后，亚述王西拿基立和他的全军攻打拉吉，就差遣臣仆到耶路撒冷见犹大王希西家和一切在耶路撒冷的犹大人，说：

chapters.en: “This is what Sennacherib king of Assyria says: What is the basis of your confidence, that you remain in Jerusalem under siege?
chapters.zh: 「亚述王西拿基立如此说：『你们倚靠什么，还在耶路撒冷受困呢？

chapters.en: Is not Hezekiah misleading you to give you over to death by famine and thirst when he says, ‘The LORD our God will deliver us from the hand of the king of Assyria?’
chapters.zh: 希西家对你们说「耶和华－我们的上帝必救我们脱离亚述王的手」，这不是诱惑你们，使你们受饥渴而死吗？

chapters.en: Did not Hezekiah himself remove His high places and His altars and say to Judah and Jerusalem, ‘You must worship before one altar, and on it you shall burn sacrifices’?
chapters.zh: 这希西家岂不是废去耶和华的邱坛和祭坛，吩咐犹大与耶路撒冷的人说「你们当在一个坛前敬拜，在其上烧香」吗？

chapters.en: Do you not know what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of the lands? Have the gods of these nations ever been able to deliver their land from my hand?
chapters.zh: 我与我列祖向列邦所行的，你们岂不知道吗？列邦的神何尝能救自己的国脱离我手呢？

chapters.en: Who among all the gods of these nations that my fathers devoted to destruction has been able to deliver his people from my hand? How then can your God deliver you from my hand?
chapters.zh: 我列祖所灭的国，那些神中谁能救自己的民脱离我手呢？难道你们的神能救你们脱离我手吗？

chapters.en: So now, do not let Hezekiah deceive you, and do not let him mislead you like this. Do not believe him, for no god of any nation or kingdom has been able to deliver his people from my hand or from the hand of my fathers. How much less will your God deliver you from my hand!”
chapters.zh: 所以你们不要叫希西家这样欺哄诱惑你们，也不要信他；因为没有一国一邦的神能救自己的民脱离我手和我列祖的手，何况你们的神更不能救你们脱离我的手。』」

chapters.en: And the servants of Sennacherib spoke further against the LORD God and against His servant Hezekiah.
chapters.zh: 西拿基立的臣仆还有别的话毁谤耶和华上帝和他仆人希西家。

chapters.en: He also wrote letters mocking the LORD, the God of Israel, and saying against Him: “Just as the gods of the nations did not deliver their people from my hand, so the God of Hezekiah will not deliver His people from my hand.”
chapters.zh: 西拿基立也写信毁谤耶和华－以色列的上帝说：「列邦的神既不能救他的民脱离我手，希西家的神也不能救他的民脱离我手了。」

chapters.en: Then the Assyrians called out loudly in Hebrew to the people of Jerusalem who were on the wall, to frighten and terrify them in order to capture the city.
chapters.zh: 亚述王的臣仆用犹大言语向耶路撒冷城上的民大声呼叫，要惊吓他们，扰乱他们，以便取城。

chapters.en: They spoke against the God of Jerusalem as they had spoken against the gods of the peoples of the earth—the work of human hands.
chapters.zh: 他们论耶路撒冷的上帝，如同论世上人手所造的神一样。

chapters.en: In response, King Hezekiah and the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz cried out to heaven in prayer,
chapters.zh: 希西家王和亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚因此祷告，向天呼求。

chapters.en: and the LORD sent an angel who annihilated every mighty man of valor and every leader and commander in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he withdrew to his own land in disgrace. And when he entered the temple of his god, some of his own sons struck him down with the sword.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就差遣一个使者进入亚述王营中，把所有大能的勇士和官长、将帅尽都灭了。亚述王满面含羞地回到本国，进了他神的庙中，有他亲生的〔儿子〕在那里用刀杀了他。

chapters.en: So the LORD saved Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem from the hands of King Sennacherib of Assyria and all others, and He gave them rest on every side.
chapters.zh: 这样，耶和华救希西家和耶路撒冷的居民脱离亚述王西拿基立的手，也脱离一切〔仇敌〕的手，又赐他们四境平安。

chapters.en: Many brought offerings to Jerusalem for the LORD and valuable gifts for Hezekiah king of Judah, and from then on he was exalted in the eyes of all nations.
chapters.zh: 有许多人到耶路撒冷，将供物献与耶和华，又将宝物送给犹大王希西家。此后，希西家在列邦人的眼中看为尊大。

chapters.en: In those days Hezekiah became mortally ill. So he prayed to the LORD, who spoke to him and gave him a sign.
chapters.zh: 那时希西家病得要死，就祷告耶和华，耶和华应允他，赐他一个兆头。

chapters.en: But because his heart was proud, Hezekiah did not repay the favor shown to him. Therefore wrath came upon him and upon Judah and Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 希西家却没有照他所蒙的恩报答〔耶和华〕；因他心里骄傲，所以忿怒要临到他和犹大并耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Then Hezekiah humbled the pride of his heart—he and the people of Jerusalem—so that the wrath of the LORD did not come upon them during the days of Hezekiah.
chapters.zh: 但希西家和耶路撒冷的居民觉得心里骄傲，就一同自卑，以致耶和华的忿怒在希西家的日子没有临到他们。

chapters.en: Hezekiah had very great riches and honor, and he made treasuries for his silver, gold, precious stones, spices, shields, and all kinds of valuable articles.
chapters.zh: 希西家大有尊荣资财，建造府库，收藏金银、宝石、香料、盾牌，和各样的宝器，

chapters.en: He also made storehouses for the harvest of grain and new wine and oil, stalls for all kinds of livestock, and pens for the flocks.
chapters.zh: 又建造仓房，收藏五谷、新酒，和油，又为各类牲畜盖棚立圈；

chapters.en: He made cities for himself, and he acquired herds of sheep and cattle in abundance, for God gave him very great wealth.
chapters.zh: 并且建立城邑，还有许多的羊群牛群，因为上帝赐他极多的财产。

chapters.en: It was Hezekiah who blocked the upper outlet of the Spring of Gihon and channeled it down to the west side of the City of David. And Hezekiah prospered in all that he did.
chapters.zh: 这希西家也塞住基训的上源，引水直下，流在大卫城的西边。希西家所行的事尽都亨通。

chapters.en: And so when ambassadors of the rulers of Babylon were sent to him to inquire about the wonder that had happened in the land, God left him alone to test him, that He might know all that was in Hezekiah’s heart.
chapters.zh: 惟有一件事，就是巴比伦王差遣使者来见希西家，访问国中所现的奇事；这件事上帝离开他，要试验他，好知道他心内如何。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Hezekiah and his deeds of loving devotion, they are indeed written in the vision of the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
chapters.zh: 希西家其余的事和他的善行都写在亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚的默示书上和犹大、以色列的诸王记上。

chapters.en: And Hezekiah rested with his fathers and was buried in the upper tombs of David’s descendants. All Judah and the people of Jerusalem paid him honor at his death. And his son Manasseh reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 希西家与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫子孙的高陵上。他死的时候，犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民都尊敬他。他儿子玛拿西接续他作王。

chapters.en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-five years.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西登基的时候年十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王五十五年。

chapters.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD by following the abominations of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法耶和华在以色列人面前赶出的外邦人那可憎的事，

chapters.en: For he rebuilt the high places that his father Hezekiah had torn down, and he raised up altars for the Baals and made Asherah poles. And he worshiped and served all the host of heaven.
chapters.zh: 重新建筑他父希西家所拆毁的邱坛，又为巴力筑坛，做木偶，且敬拜事奉天上的万象，

chapters.en: Manasseh also built altars in the house of the LORD, of which the LORD had said, “My Name will remain in Jerusalem forever.”
chapters.zh: 在耶和华的殿宇中筑坛－耶和华曾指着这殿说：「我的名必永远在耶路撒冷。」

chapters.en: In both courtyards of the house of the LORD, he built altars to all the host of heaven.
chapters.zh: 他在耶和华殿的两院中为天上的万象筑坛，

chapters.en: He sacrificed his sons in the fire in the Valley of Ben-hinnom. He practiced sorcery, divination, and witchcraft, and consulted mediums and spiritists. He did great evil in the sight of the LORD, provoking Him to anger.
chapters.zh: 并在欣嫩子谷使他的儿女经火，又观兆，用法术，行邪术，立交鬼的和行巫术的，多行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，惹动他的怒气，

chapters.en: Manasseh even took the carved image he had made and set it up in the house of God, of which God had said to David and his son Solomon, “In this temple and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will establish My Name forever.
chapters.zh: 又在上帝殿内立雕刻的偶像。上帝曾对大卫和他儿子所罗门说：「我在以色列各支派中所选择的耶路撒冷和这殿，必立我的名直到永远。

chapters.en: I will never again cause the feet of the Israelites to leave the land that I assigned to your fathers, if only they are careful to do all that I have commanded them through Moses—all the laws, statutes, and judgments.”
chapters.zh: 以色列人若谨守遵行我藉摩西所吩咐他们的一切法度、律例、典章，我就不再使他们挪移离开我所赐给他们列祖之地。」

chapters.en: So Manasseh led the people of Judah and Jerusalem astray, so that they did greater evil than the nations that the LORD had destroyed before the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西引诱犹大和耶路撒冷的居民，以致他们行恶比耶和华在以色列人面前所灭的列国更甚。

chapters.en: And the LORD spoke to Manasseh and his people, but they did not listen.
chapters.zh: 耶和华警戒玛拿西和他的百姓，他们却是不听。

chapters.en: So the LORD brought against them the military commanders of the king of Assyria, who captured Manasseh, put a hook in his nose, bound him with bronze shackles, and took him to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华使亚述王的将帅来攻击他们，用铙钩钩住玛拿西，用铜鍊锁住他，带到巴比伦去。

chapters.en: And in his distress, Manasseh sought the favor of the LORD his God and earnestly humbled himself before the God of his fathers.
chapters.zh: 他在急难的时候，就恳求耶和华－他的上帝，且在他列祖的上帝面前极其自卑。

chapters.en: And when he prayed to Him, the LORD received his plea and heard his petition. So He brought him back to Jerusalem and to his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD is God.
chapters.zh: 他祈祷耶和华，耶和华就允准他的祈求，垂听他的祷告，使他归回耶路撒冷，仍坐国位。玛拿西这才知道惟独耶和华是上帝。

chapters.en: After this, Manasseh rebuilt the outer wall of the City of David from west of Gihon in the valley to the entrance of the Fish Gate, and he brought it around the hill of Ophel and heightened it considerably. He also stationed military commanders in all the fortified cities of Judah.
chapters.zh: 此后，玛拿西在大卫城外，从谷内基训西边直到鱼门口，建筑城墙，环绕俄斐勒，这墙筑得甚高；又在犹大各坚固城内设立勇敢的军长；

chapters.en: He removed the foreign gods and the idol from the house of the LORD, along with all the altars he had built on the temple mount and in Jerusalem, and he dumped them outside the city.
chapters.zh: 并除掉外邦人的神像与耶和华殿中的偶像，又将他在耶和华殿的山上和耶路撒冷所筑的各坛都拆毁抛在城外；

chapters.en: Then he restored the altar of the LORD and sacrificed peace offerings and thank offerings on it, and he told Judah to serve the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 重修耶和华的祭坛，在坛上献平安祭、感谢祭，吩咐犹大人事奉耶和华－以色列的上帝。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, the people still sacrificed at the high places, but only to the LORD their God.
chapters.zh: 百姓却仍在邱坛上献祭，只献给耶和华－他们的上帝。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Manasseh, along with his prayer to his God and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, they are indeed written in the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西其余的事和祷告他上帝的话，并先见奉耶和华－以色列上帝的名警戒他的言语，都写在以色列诸王记上。

chapters.en: His prayer and how God received his plea, as well as all his sin and unfaithfulness, and the sites where he built high places and set up Asherah poles and idols before he humbled himself, they are indeed written in the Records of the Seers.
chapters.zh: 他的祷告，与〔上帝〕怎样应允他，他未自卑以前的罪愆过犯，并在何处建筑邱坛，设立亚舍拉和雕刻的偶像，都写在何赛的书上。

chapters.en: And Manasseh rested with his fathers and was buried at his palace. And his son Amon reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 玛拿西与他列祖同睡，葬在自己的宫院里。他儿子亚们接续他作王。

chapters.en: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem two years.
chapters.zh: 亚们登基的时候年二十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王二年。

chapters.en:
And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, as his father Manasseh had done.
Amon served and sacrificed to all the idols that his father Manasseh had made,
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他父玛拿西所行的，祭祀事奉他父玛拿西所雕刻的偶像，

chapters.en: but he did not humble himself before the LORD as his father Manasseh had done; instead, Amon increased his guilt.
chapters.zh: 不在耶和华面前像他父玛拿西自卑。这亚们所犯的罪越犯越大。

chapters.en: Then the servants of Amon conspired against him and killed him in his palace.
chapters.zh: 他的臣仆背叛，在宫里杀了他。

chapters.en: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon, and they made his son Josiah king in his place.
chapters.zh: 但国民杀了那些背叛亚们王的人，立他儿子约西亚接续他作王。

chapters.en: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years.
chapters.zh: 约西亚登基的时候年八岁，在耶路撒冷作王三十一年。

chapters.en: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD and walked in the ways of his father David; he did not turn aside to the right or to the left.
chapters.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他祖大卫所行的，不偏左右。

chapters.en: In the eighth year of his reign, while he was still young, Josiah began to seek the God of his father David, and in the twelfth year he began to cleanse Judah and Jerusalem of the high places, the Asherah poles, the carved idols, and the cast images.
chapters.zh: 他作王第八年，尚且年幼，就寻求他祖大卫的上帝。到了十二年才洁净犹大和耶路撒冷，除掉邱坛、木偶、雕刻的像，和铸造的像。

chapters.en: Then in his presence the altars of the Baals were torn down, and he cut to pieces the incense altars that were above them. He shattered the Asherah poles, the carved idols, and the cast images, crushed them to dust, and scattered them over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.
chapters.zh: 众人在他面前拆毁巴力的坛，砍断坛上高高的日像，又把木偶和雕刻的像，并铸造的像打碎成灰，撒在祭偶像人的坟上，

chapters.en: Then he burned the bones of the priests on their altars. So he cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 将他们祭司的骸骨烧在坛上，洁净了犹大和耶路撒冷；

chapters.en: Josiah did the same in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, as far as Naphtali, and in the ruins around them.
chapters.zh: 又在玛拿西、以法莲、西缅、拿弗他利各城，和四围破坏之处，〔都这样行〕；

chapters.en: He tore down the altars and Asherah poles, crushed the idols to powder, and cut to pieces all the incense altars throughout the land of Israel. Then he returned to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 又拆毁祭坛，把木偶和雕刻的像打碎成灰，砍断以色列遍地所有的日像，就回耶路撒冷去了。

chapters.en: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, in order to cleanse the land and the temple, Josiah sent Shaphan son of Azaliah, Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah son of Joahaz, the recorder, to repair the house of the LORD his God.
chapters.zh: 约西亚王十八年，净地净殿之后，就差遣亚萨利雅的儿子沙番、邑宰玛西雅、约哈斯的儿子史官约亚去修理耶和华－他上帝的殿。

chapters.en: So they went to Hilkiah the high priest and gave him the money that had been brought into the house of God, which the Levites who guarded the doors had collected from the people of Manasseh and Ephraim, from all the remnant of Israel, from all Judah and Benjamin, and from the people of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 他们就去见大祭司希勒家，将奉到上帝殿的银子交给他；这银子是看守殿门的利未人从玛拿西、以法莲，和一切以色列剩下的人，以及犹大、便雅悯众人，并耶路撒冷的居民收来的。

chapters.en: They put it into the hands of those supervising the work in the house of the LORD, who in turn gave it to the workmen restoring and repairing the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 又将这银子交给耶和华殿里督工的，转交修理耶和华殿的工匠，

chapters.en: They also gave money to the carpenters and builders to buy dressed stone, as well as timbers for couplings and beams for the buildings that the kings of Judah had allowed to deteriorate.
chapters.zh: 就是交给木匠、石匠，买凿成的石头和架木与栋梁，修犹大王所毁坏的殿。

chapters.en: And the men did the work faithfully. The Levites overseeing them were Jahath and Obadiah, descendants of Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam, descendants of Kohath. Other Levites, all skilled with musical instruments,
chapters.zh: 这些人办事诚实，督工的是利未人米拉利的子孙雅哈、俄巴底；督催的是哥辖的子孙撒迦利亚、米书兰；还有善于作乐的利未人。

chapters.en: were over the laborers and supervised all who did the work, task by task. Some of the Levites were secretaries, officers, and gatekeepers.
chapters.zh: 他们又监管扛抬的人，督催一切做工的。利未人中也有作书记、作司事、作守门的。

chapters.en: While they were bringing out the money that had been taken into the house of the LORD, Hilkiah the priest found the Book of the Law of the LORD given by Moses.
chapters.zh: 他们将奉到耶和华殿的银子运出来的时候，祭司希勒家〔偶然〕得了摩西所传耶和华的律法书。

chapters.en: And Hilkiah said to Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the LORD!” And he gave it to Shaphan.
chapters.zh: 希勒家对书记沙番说：「我在耶和华殿里得了律法书。」遂将书递给沙番。

chapters.en: Then Shaphan brought the book to the king and reported, “Your servants are doing all that has been placed in their hands.
chapters.zh: 沙番把书拿到王那里，回复王说：「凡交给仆人们办的都办理了。

chapters.en: They have paid out the money that was found in the house of the LORD and have put it into the hands of the supervisors and workers.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华殿里的银子倒出来，交给督工的和匠人的手里了。」

chapters.en: Moreover, Shaphan the scribe told the king, “Hilkiah the priest has given me a book.” And Shaphan read it in the presence of the king.
chapters.zh: 书记沙番又对王说：「祭司希勒家递给我一卷书。」沙番就在王面前读那书。

chapters.en: When the king heard the words of the Law, he tore his clothes
chapters.zh: 王听见律法上的话，就撕裂衣服，

chapters.en: and commanded Hilkiah, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Abdon son of Micah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the servant of the king:
chapters.zh: 吩咐希勒家与沙番的儿子亚希甘、米迦的儿子亚比顿、书记沙番，和王的臣仆亚撒雅说：

chapters.en: “Go and inquire of the LORD for me and for those remaining in Israel and Judah concerning the words in the book that has been found. For great is the wrath of the LORD that has been poured out on us because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD by doing all that is written in this book.”
chapters.zh: 「你们去为我、为以色列和犹大剩下的人，以这书上的话求问耶和华；因我们列祖没有遵守耶和华的言语，没有照这书上所记的去行，耶和华的烈怒就倒在我们身上。」

chapters.en: So Hilkiah and those the king had designated went and spoke to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, the keeper of the wardrobe. She lived in Jerusalem, in the Second District.
chapters.zh: 于是，希勒家和王所派的众人都去见女先知户勒大。户勒大是掌管礼服沙龙的妻，沙龙是哈斯拉的孙子、特瓦的儿子。户勒大住在耶路撒冷第二区；他们请问于她。

chapters.en: And Huldah said to them, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Tell the man who sent you
chapters.zh: 她对他们说：「耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：『你们可以回复那差遣你们来见我的人说，

chapters.en: that this is what the LORD says: I am about to bring calamity on this place and on its people, according to all the curses written in the book that has been read in the presence of the king of Judah,
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：我必照着在犹大王面前所读那书上的一切咒诅，降祸与这地和其上的居民；

chapters.en: because they have forsaken Me and burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke Me to anger with all the works of their hands. My wrath will be poured out upon this place and will not be quenched.’
chapters.zh: 因为他们离弃我，向别神烧香，用他们手所做的惹我发怒，所以我的忿怒〔如火〕倒在这地上，总不熄灭。』

chapters.en: But as for the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, tell him that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘As for the words that you heard,
chapters.zh: 然而差遣你们来求问耶和华的犹大王，你们要这样回复他说：『耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：至于你所听见的话，

chapters.en: because your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before God when you heard His words against this place and against its people, and because you have humbled yourself before Me and have torn your clothes and wept before Me, I have heard you,’ declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 就是听见我指着这地和其上居民所说的话，你便心里敬服，在我面前自卑，撕裂衣服，向我哭泣，因此我应允了你。这是我－耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
‘Now I will indeed gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes will not see all the calamity that I will bring on this place and on its people.’”
So they brought her answer back to the king.
chapters.zh: 我必使你平平安安地归到坟墓，到你列祖那里，我要降与这地和其上居民的一切灾祸，你也不致亲眼看见。』」他们就回复王去了。

chapters.en: Then the king summoned all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 王差遣人招聚犹大和耶路撒冷的众长老来。

chapters.en: And he went up to the house of the LORD with all the people of Judah and Jerusalem, as well as the priests and the Levites—all the people great and small—and in their hearing he read all the words of the Book of the Covenant that had been found in the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 王和犹大众人，与耶路撒冷的居民，并祭司利未人，以及所有的百姓，无论大小，都一同上到耶和华的殿；王就把殿里所得的约书念给他们听。

chapters.en: So the king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the LORD to follow the LORD and to keep His commandments, decrees, and statutes with all his heart and all his soul, and to carry out the words of the covenant that were written in this book.
chapters.zh: 王站在他的地位上，在耶和华面前立约，要尽心尽性地顺从耶和华，遵守他的诫命、法度、律例，成就这书上所记的约言；

chapters.en: Then he had everyone in Jerusalem and Benjamin take a stand in agreement to it. So all the people of Jerusalem carried out the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.
chapters.zh: 又使住耶路撒冷和便雅悯的人都服从〔这约〕。于是耶路撒冷的居民都遵行他们列祖之上帝的约。

chapters.en: And Josiah removed all the abominations from all the lands belonging to the Israelites, and he required everyone in Israel to serve the LORD their God. Throughout his reign they did not turn aside from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.
chapters.zh: 约西亚从以色列各处将一切可憎之物尽都除掉，使以色列境内的人都事奉耶和华－他们的上帝。约西亚在世的日子，就跟从耶和华－他们列祖的上帝，总不离开。

chapters.en: Then Josiah kept the Passover to the LORD in Jerusalem, and the Passover lamb was slaughtered on the fourteenth day of the first month.
chapters.zh: 约西亚在耶路撒冷向耶和华守逾越节。正月十四日，就宰了逾越节〔的羊羔〕。

chapters.en: He appointed the priests to their duties and encouraged them in the service of the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 王分派祭司各尽其职，又勉励他们办耶和华殿中的事；

chapters.en: To the Levites who taught all Israel and were holy to the LORD, Josiah said: “Put the holy ark in the temple built by Solomon son of David king of Israel. It is not to be carried around on your shoulders. Now serve the LORD your God and His people Israel.
chapters.zh: 又对那归耶和华为圣、教训以色列人的利未人说：「你们将圣〔约〕柜安放在以色列王大卫儿子所罗门建造的殿里，不必再用肩扛抬。现在要事奉耶和华－你们的上帝，服事他的民以色列。

chapters.en: Prepare yourselves by families in your divisions, according to the instructions written by David king of Israel and Solomon his son.
chapters.zh: 你们应当按着宗族，照着班次，遵以色列王大卫和他儿子所罗门所写的，自己预备。

chapters.en: Moreover, stand in the Holy Place by the divisions of the families of your kinsmen the lay people, and by the divisions of the families of the Levites.
chapters.zh: 要按着你们的弟兄，这民宗族的班次，站在圣所，〔每班中〕要利未宗族的几个人。

chapters.en: Slaughter the Passover lambs, consecrate yourselves, and make preparations for your fellow countrymen to carry out the word of the LORD given by Moses.”
chapters.zh: 要宰逾越节〔的羊羔〕，洁净自己，为你们的弟兄预备了，好遵守耶和华藉摩西所吩咐的话。」

chapters.en: From his own flocks and herds Josiah contributed 30,000 lambs and goats plus 3,000 bulls for the Passover offerings for all the people who were present.
chapters.zh: 约西亚从群畜中赐给在那里所有的人民，绵羊羔和山羊羔三万只，牛三千只，作逾越节的祭物；这都是出自王的产业中。

chapters.en: His officials also contributed willingly to the people and priests and Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, the chief officials of the house of God, gave the priests 2,600 Passover offerings and 300 bulls.
chapters.zh: 约西亚的众首领也乐意将牺牲给百姓和祭司利未人；又有管理上帝殿的希勒家、撒迦利亚、耶歇将〔羊羔〕二千六百只，牛三百只，给祭司作逾越节的祭物。

chapters.en: Additionally, Conaniah and his brothers Shemaiah and Nethanel, as well as Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad, officers of the Levites, contributed to the Levites 5,000 Passover offerings and 500 bulls.
chapters.zh: 利未人的族长歌楠雅和他两个兄弟示玛雅、拿坦业，与哈沙比雅、耶利、约撒拔将〔羊羔〕五千只，牛五百只，给利未人作逾越节的祭物。

chapters.en: So the service was prepared; the priests stood in their places and the Levites in their divisions according to the king’s command.
chapters.zh: 这样，供献的事齐备了。祭司站在自己的地方，利未人按着班次站立，都是照王所吩咐的。

chapters.en: And they slaughtered the Passover lambs, while the priests splattered the blood handed to them and the Levites skinned the animals.
chapters.zh: 利未人宰了逾越节〔的羊羔〕，祭司从他们手里〔接过血来〕洒在坛上；利未人剥皮，

chapters.en: They set aside the burnt offerings to be given to the divisions of the families of the people to offer to the LORD, as it is written in the Book of Moses. And they did the same with the bulls.
chapters.zh: 将燔祭搬来，按着宗族的班次分给众民，好照摩西书上所写的，献给耶和华；献牛也是这样。

chapters.en: They roasted the Passover animals on the fire according to the regulation, and they boiled the other holy offerings in pots, kettles, and bowls and quickly brought them to all the people.
chapters.zh: 他们按着常例，用火烤逾越节的〔羊羔〕。别的圣物用锅，用釜，用罐煮了，速速地送给众民。

chapters.en: Afterward, they made preparations for themselves and for the priests, since the priests, the descendants of Aaron, were offering up burnt offerings and fat until nightfall. So the Levites made preparations for themselves and for the priests, the descendants of Aaron.
chapters.zh: 然后为自己和祭司预备〔祭物〕；因为祭司亚伦的子孙献燔祭和脂油，直到晚上。所以利未人为自己和祭司亚伦的子孙，预备〔祭物〕。

chapters.en: The singers, the descendants of Asaph, were at their stations according to the command of David, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer. And the gatekeepers at each gate did not need to leave their posts, because their fellow Levites made preparations for them.
chapters.zh: 歌唱的亚萨之子孙，照着大卫、亚萨、希幔，和王的先见耶杜顿所吩咐的，站在自己的地位上。守门的看守各门，不用离开他们的职事，因为他们的弟兄利未人给他们预备〔祭物〕。

chapters.en: So on that day the entire service of the LORD was carried out for celebrating the Passover and offering burnt offerings on the altar of the LORD, according to the command of King Josiah.
chapters.zh: 当日，供奉耶和华的事齐备了，就照约西亚王的吩咐守逾越节，献燔祭在耶和华的坛上。

chapters.en: The Israelites who were present also observed the Passover at that time, as well as the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days.
chapters.zh: 当时在耶路撒冷的以色列人守逾越节，又守除酵节七日。

chapters.en: No such Passover had been observed in Israel since the days of Samuel the prophet. None of the kings of Israel ever observed a Passover like the one that Josiah observed with the priests, the Levites, all Judah, the Israelites who were present, and the people of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 自从先知撒母耳以来，在以色列中没有守过这样的逾越节，以色列诸王也没有守过，像约西亚、祭司、利未人、在那里的犹大人，和以色列人，以及耶路撒冷居民所守的逾越节。

chapters.en: In the eighteenth year of Josiah’s reign, this Passover was observed.
chapters.zh: 这逾越节是约西亚作王十八年守的。

chapters.en: After all this, when Josiah had set the temple in order, Neco king of Egypt marched up to fight at Carchemish by the Euphrates, and Josiah went out to confront him.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，约西亚修完了殿，有埃及王尼哥上来，要攻击靠近幼发拉底河的迦基米施；约西亚出去抵挡他。

chapters.en: But Neco sent messengers to him, saying, “What is the issue between you and me, O king of Judah? I have not come against you today, but I am fighting another dynasty, and God has told me to hurry. So stop opposing God, who is with me, or He will destroy you!”
chapters.zh: 他差遣使者来见约西亚，说：「犹大王啊，我与你何干？我今日来不是要攻击你，乃是要攻击与我争战之家，并且上帝吩咐我速行，你不要〔干预〕上帝的事，免得他毁灭你，因为上帝是与我同在。」

chapters.en: Josiah, however, did not turn away from him; instead, in order to engage him in battle, he disguised himself. He did not listen to Neco’s words from the mouth of God, but went to fight him on the Plain of Megiddo.
chapters.zh: 约西亚却不肯转去离开他，改装要与他打仗，不听从上帝藉尼哥之口所说的话，便来到米吉多平原争战。

chapters.en: There the archers shot King Josiah, who said to his servants, “Take me away, for I am badly wounded!”
chapters.zh: 弓箭手射中约西亚王。王对他的臣仆说：「我受了重伤，你拉我出阵吧！」

chapters.en: So his servants took him out of his chariot, put him in his second chariot, and brought him to Jerusalem, where he died. And Josiah was buried in the tomb of his fathers, and all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for him.
chapters.zh: 他的臣仆扶他下了战车，上了次车，送他到耶路撒冷，他就死了，葬在他列祖的坟墓里。犹大人和耶路撒冷人都为他悲哀。

chapters.en: Then Jeremiah lamented over Josiah, and to this day all the male and female singers recite laments over Josiah. They established them as a statute for Israel, and indeed they are written in the Book of Laments.
chapters.zh: 耶利米为约西亚作哀歌。所有歌唱的男女也唱哀歌，追悼约西亚，直到今日；而且在以色列中成了定例。这歌载在哀歌书上。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Josiah and his deeds of loving devotion according to what is written in the Law of the LORD—
chapters.zh: 约西亚其余的事和他遵着耶和华律法上所记而行的善事，

chapters.en: his acts from beginning to end—they are indeed written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
chapters.zh: 并他自始至终所行的，都写在以色列和犹大列王记上。

chapters.en: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz son of Josiah and made him king in Jerusalem in place of his father.
chapters.zh: 国民立约西亚的儿子约哈斯在耶路撒冷接续他父作王。

chapters.en: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months.
chapters.zh: 约哈斯登基的时候年二十三岁，在耶路撒冷作王三个月。

chapters.en: And the king of Egypt dethroned him in Jerusalem and imposed on Judah a levy of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
chapters.zh: 埃及王在耶路撒冷废了他，又罚〔犹大〕国银子一百他连得，金子一他连得。

chapters.en: Then Neco king of Egypt made Eliakim brother of Jehoahaz king over Judah and Jerusalem, and he changed Eliakim’s name to Jehoiakim. But Neco took Eliakim’s brother Jehoahaz and carried him off to Egypt.
chapters.zh: 埃及王尼哥立约哈斯的哥哥以利雅敬作犹大和耶路撒冷的王，改名叫约雅敬，又将约哈斯带到埃及去了。

chapters.en: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. And he did evil in the sight of the LORD his God.
chapters.zh: 约雅敬登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年，行耶和华－他上帝眼中看为恶的事。

chapters.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jehoiakim and bound him with bronze shackles to take him to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒上来攻击他，用铜鍊锁着他，要将他带到巴比伦去。

chapters.en: Nebuchadnezzar also took to Babylon some of the articles from the house of the LORD, and he put them in his temple in Babylon.
chapters.zh: 尼布甲尼撒又将耶和华殿里的器皿带到巴比伦，放在他神的庙里〔注：或译：自己的宫里〕。

chapters.en: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, the abominations he committed, and all that was found against him, they are indeed written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah. And his son Jehoiachin reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 约雅敬其余的事和他所行可憎的事，并他一切的行为，都写在以色列和犹大列王记上。他儿子约雅斤接续他作王。

chapters.en: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months and ten days. And he did evil in the sight of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 约雅斤登基的时候年八岁〔注：在列王下二十四章八节是十八岁〕，在耶路撒冷作王三个月零十天，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事。

chapters.en: In the spring, King Nebuchadnezzar summoned Jehoiachin and brought him to Babylon, along with the articles of value from the house of the LORD. And he made Jehoiachin’s relative Zedekiah king over Judah and Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 过了一年，尼布甲尼撒差遣人将约雅斤和耶和华殿里各样宝贵的器皿带到巴比伦，就立约雅斤的叔叔〔注：原文是兄〕西底家作犹大和耶路撒冷的王。

chapters.en: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years.
chapters.zh: 西底家登基的时候年二十一岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年，

chapters.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD his God and did not humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet, who spoke for the LORD.
chapters.zh: 行耶和华－他上帝眼中看为恶的事。先知耶利米以耶和华的话劝他，他仍不在耶利米面前自卑。

chapters.en: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God. But Zedekiah stiffened his neck and hardened his heart against turning to the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 尼布甲尼撒曾使他指着上帝起誓，他却背叛，强项硬心，不归服耶和华－以色列的上帝。

chapters.en: Furthermore, all the leaders of the priests and the people multiplied their unfaithful deeds, following all the abominations of the nations, and they defiled the house of the LORD, which He had consecrated in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 众祭司长和百姓也大大犯罪，效法外邦人一切可憎的事，污秽耶和华在耶路撒冷分别为圣的殿。

chapters.en: Again and again the LORD, the God of their fathers, sent word to His people through His messengers because He had compassion on them and on His dwelling place.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－他们列祖的上帝因为爱惜自己的民和他的居所，从早起来差遣使者去警戒他们。

chapters.en: But they mocked the messengers of God, despising His words and scoffing at His prophets, until the wrath of the LORD against His people was stirred up beyond remedy.
chapters.zh: 他们却嘻笑上帝的使者，藐视他的言语，讥诮他的先知，以致耶和华的忿怒向他的百姓发作，无法可救。

chapters.en: So He brought up against them the king of the Chaldeans, who put their young men to the sword in the sanctuary, sparing neither young men nor young women, neither elderly nor infirm. God gave them all into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar,
chapters.zh: 所以，耶和华使迦勒底人的王来攻击他们，在他们圣殿里用刀杀了他们的壮丁，不怜恤他们的少男处女、老人白叟。耶和华将他们都交在迦勒底王手里。

chapters.en: who carried off everything to Babylon—all the articles of the house of God, both large and small, and the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king and his officials.
chapters.zh: 迦勒底王将上帝殿里的大小器皿与耶和华殿里的财宝，并王和众首领的财宝，都带到巴比伦去了。

chapters.en: Then the Chaldeans set fire to the house of God and broke down the wall of Jerusalem. They burned down all the palaces and destroyed every article of value.
chapters.zh: 迦勒底人焚烧上帝的殿，拆毁耶路撒冷的城墙，用火烧了城里的宫殿，毁坏了城里宝贵的器皿。

chapters.en: Those who escaped the sword were carried by Nebuchadnezzar into exile in Babylon, and they became servants to him and his sons until the kingdom of Persia came to power.
chapters.zh: 凡脱离刀剑的，迦勒底王都掳到巴比伦去，作他和他子孙的仆婢，直到波斯国兴起来。

chapters.en: So the land enjoyed its Sabbath rest all the days of the desolation, until seventy years were completed, in fulfillment of the word of the LORD spoken through Jeremiah.
chapters.zh: 这就应验耶和华藉耶利米口所说的话：地享受安息；因为地土荒凉便守安息，直满了七十年。

chapters.en: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, to fulfill the word of the LORD spoken through Jeremiah, the LORD stirred the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia to send a proclamation throughout his kingdom and to put it in writing as follows:
chapters.zh: 波斯王塞鲁士元年，耶和华为要应验藉耶利米口所说的话，就激动波斯王塞鲁士的心，使他下诏通告全国，说：

chapters.en:
“This is what Cyrus king of Persia says:
‘The LORD, the God of heaven, who has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, has appointed me to build a house for Him at Jerusalem in Judah.
Whoever among you belongs to His people, may the LORD his God be with him, and may he go up.’”
chapters.zh: 「波斯王塞鲁士如此说：耶和华－天上的上帝已将天下万国赐给我，又嘱咐我在犹大的耶路撒冷为他建造殿宇。你们中间凡作他子民的，可以上去，愿耶和华－他的上帝与他同在。」

chapters.en: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, to fulfill the word of the LORD spoken through Jeremiah, the LORD stirred the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia to send a proclamation throughout his kingdom and to put it in writing as follows:
chapters.zh: 波斯王塞鲁士元年，耶和华为要应验藉耶利米口所说的话，就激动波斯王塞鲁士的心，使他下诏通告全国说：

chapters.en:
“This is what Cyrus king of Persia says:
‘The LORD, the God of heaven, who has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, has appointed me to build a house for Him at Jerusalem in Judah.
chapters.zh: 「波斯王塞鲁士如此说：『耶和华天上的上帝已将天下万国赐给我，又嘱咐我在犹大的耶路撒冷为他建造殿宇。

chapters.en: Whoever among you belongs to His people, may his God be with him, and may he go to Jerusalem in Judah and build the house of the LORD, the God of Israel; He is the God who is in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 在你们中间凡作他子民的，可以上犹大的耶路撒冷，在耶路撒冷重建耶和华－以色列上帝的殿（只有他是上帝）。愿上帝与这人同在。

chapters.en: And let every survivor, wherever he lives, be assisted by the men of that region with silver, gold, goods, and livestock, along with a freewill offering for the house of God in Jerusalem.’”
chapters.zh: 凡剩下的人，无论寄居何处，那地的人要用金银、财物、牲畜帮助他，另外也要为耶路撒冷上帝的殿甘心献上礼物。』」

chapters.en: So the family heads of Judah and Benjamin, along with the priests and Levites—everyone whose spirit God had stirred—prepared to go up and rebuild the house of the LORD in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 于是，犹大和便雅悯的族长、祭司、利未人，就是一切被上帝激动他心的人，都起来要上耶路撒冷去建造耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: And all their neighbors supported them with articles of silver and gold, with goods and livestock, and with valuables, in addition to all their freewill offerings.
chapters.zh: 他们四围的人就拿银器、金子、财物、牲畜、珍宝帮助他们〔注：原文是坚固他们的手〕，另外还有甘心献的礼物。

chapters.en: King Cyrus also brought out the articles belonging to the house of the LORD that Nebuchadnezzar had carried away from Jerusalem and placed in the temple of his gods.
chapters.zh: 塞鲁士王也将耶和华殿的器皿拿出来，这器皿是尼布甲尼撒从耶路撒冷掠来、放在自己神之庙中的。

chapters.en: Cyrus king of Persia had them brought out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, who counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.
chapters.zh: 波斯王塞鲁士派库官米提利达将这器皿拿出来，按数交给犹大的首领设巴萨。

chapters.en:
This was the inventory:
30 gold dishes,
1,000 silver dishes,
29 silver utensils,
chapters.zh: 器皿的数目记在下面：金盘三十个，银盘一千个，刀二十九把，

chapters.en:
30 gold bowls,
410 matching silver bowls,
and 1,000 other articles.
chapters.zh: 金碗三十个，银碗之次的四百一十个，别样的器皿一千件。

chapters.en: In all, there were 5,400 gold and silver articles. Sheshbazzar brought all these along when the exiles went up from Babylon to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 金银器皿共有五千四百件。被掳的人从巴比伦上耶路撒冷的时候，设巴萨将这一切都带上来。

chapters.en: Now these are the people of the province who came up from the captivity of the exiles carried away to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar its king. They returned to Jerusalem and Judah, each to his own town,
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒从前掳到巴比伦之犹大省的人，现在他们的子孙从被掳到之地回耶路撒冷和犹大，各归本城。

chapters.en:
accompanied by Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, and Baanah.
This is the count of the men of Israel:
chapters.zh: 他们是同着所罗巴伯、耶书亚、尼希米、西莱雅、利来雅、末底改、必珊、米斯拔、比革瓦伊、利宏、巴拿回来的。

chapters.en: the descendants of Parosh, 2,172;
chapters.zh: 以色列人民的数目记在下面：巴录的子孙二千一百七十二名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Shephatiah, 372;
chapters.zh: 示法提雅的子孙三百七十二名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Arah, 775;
chapters.zh: 亚拉的子孙七百七十五名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Pahath-moab (through the line of Jeshua and Joab), 2,812;
chapters.zh: 巴赫‧摩押的后裔，就是耶书亚和约押的子孙二千八百一十二名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Elam, 1,254;
chapters.zh: 以拦的子孙一千二百五十四名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Zattu, 945;
chapters.zh: 萨土的子孙九百四十五名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Zaccai, 760;
chapters.zh: 萨改的子孙七百六十名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Bani, 642;
chapters.zh: 巴尼的子孙六百四十二名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Bebai, 623;
chapters.zh: 比拜的子孙六百二十三名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Azgad, 1,222;
chapters.zh: 押甲的子孙一千二百二十二名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Adonikam, 666;
chapters.zh: 亚多尼干的子孙六百六十六名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Bigvai, 2,056;
chapters.zh: 比革瓦伊的子孙二千零五十六名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Adin, 454;
chapters.zh: 亚丁的子孙四百五十四名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Ater (through Hezekiah), 98;
chapters.zh: 亚特的后裔，就是希西家的子孙九十八名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Bezai, 323;
chapters.zh: 比赛的子孙三百二十三名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Jorah, 112;
chapters.zh: 约拉的子孙一百一十二名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Hashum, 223;
chapters.zh: 哈顺的子孙二百二十三名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Gibbar, 95;
chapters.zh: 吉罢珥人九十五名；

chapters.en: the men of Bethlehem, 123;
chapters.zh: 伯利恒人一百二十三名；

chapters.en: the men of Netophah, 56;
chapters.zh: 尼陀法人五十六名；

chapters.en: the men of Anathoth, 128;
chapters.zh: 亚拿突人一百二十八名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Azmaveth, 42;
chapters.zh: 亚斯玛弗人四十二名；

chapters.en: the men of Kiriath-jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, 743;
chapters.zh: 基列‧耶琳人、基非拉人、比录人共七百四十三名；

chapters.en: the men of Ramah and Geba, 621;
chapters.zh: 拉玛人、迦巴人共六百二十一名；

chapters.en: the men of Michmash, 122;
chapters.zh: 默玛人一百二十二名；

chapters.en: the men of Bethel and Ai, 223;
chapters.zh: 伯特利人、艾人共二百二十三名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Nebo, 52;
chapters.zh: 尼波人五十二名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Magbish, 156;
chapters.zh: 末必人一百五十六名；

chapters.en: the descendants of the other Elam, 1,254;
chapters.zh: 别的以拦子孙一千二百五十四名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Harim, 320;
chapters.zh: 哈琳的子孙三百二十名；

chapters.en: the men of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, 725;
chapters.zh: 罗德人、哈第人、阿挪人共七百二十五名；

chapters.en: the men of Jericho, 345;
chapters.zh: 耶利哥人三百四十五名；

chapters.en: and the descendants of Senaah, 3,630.
chapters.zh: 西拿人三千六百三十名。

chapters.en:
The priests:
The descendants of Jedaiah (through the house of Jeshua), 973;
chapters.zh: 祭司：耶书亚家耶大雅的子孙九百七十三名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Immer, 1,052;
chapters.zh: 音麦的子孙一千零五十二名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Pashhur, 1,247;
chapters.zh: 巴施户珥的子孙一千二百四十七名；

chapters.en: and the descendants of Harim, 1,017.
chapters.zh: 哈琳的子孙一千零一十七名。

chapters.en:
The Levites:
the descendants of Jeshua and Kadmiel (through the line of Hodaviah ), 74.
chapters.zh: 利未人：何达威雅的后裔，就是耶书亚和甲篾的子孙七十四名。

chapters.en:
The singers:
the descendants of Asaph, 128.
chapters.zh: 歌唱的：亚萨的子孙一百二十八名。

chapters.en:
The gatekeepers:
the descendants of Shallum,
the descendants of Ater,
the descendants of Talmon,
the descendants of Akkub,
the descendants of Hatita,
and the descendants of Shobai,
139 in all.
chapters.zh: 守门的：沙龙的子孙、亚特的子孙、达们的子孙、亚谷的子孙、哈底大的子孙、朔拜的子孙，共一百三十九名。

chapters.en:
The temple servants:
the descendants of Ziha,
the descendants of Hasupha,
the descendants of Tabbaoth,
chapters.zh: 尼提宁〔注：就是殿役〕：西哈的子孙、哈苏巴的子孙、答巴俄的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Keros,
the descendants of Siaha,
the descendants of Padon,
chapters.zh: 基绿的子孙、西亚的子孙、巴顿的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Lebanah,
the descendants of Hagabah,
the descendants of Akkub,
chapters.zh: 利巴拿的子孙、哈迦巴的子孙、亚谷的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Hagab,
the descendants of Shalmai,
the descendants of Hanan,
chapters.zh: 哈甲的子孙、萨买的子孙、哈难的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Giddel,
the descendants of Gahar,
the descendants of Reaiah,
chapters.zh: 吉德的子孙、迦哈的子孙、利亚雅的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Rezin,
the descendants of Nekoda,
the descendants of Gazzam,
chapters.zh: 利汛的子孙、尼哥大的子孙、迦散的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Uzza,
the descendants of Paseah,
the descendants of Besai,
chapters.zh: 乌撒的子孙、巴西亚的子孙、比赛的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Asnah,
the descendants of Meunim,
the descendants of Nephusim,
chapters.zh: 押拿的子孙、米乌宁的子孙、尼普心的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Bakbuk,
the descendants of Hakupha,
the descendants of Harhur,
chapters.zh: 巴卜的子孙、哈古巴的子孙、哈忽的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Bazluth,
the descendants of Mehida,
the descendants of Harsha,
chapters.zh: 巴洗律的子孙、米希大的子孙、哈沙的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Barkos,
the descendants of Sisera,
the descendants of Temah,
chapters.zh: 巴柯的子孙、西西拉的子孙、答玛的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Neziah,
and the descendants of Hatipha.
chapters.zh: 尼细亚的子孙、哈提法的子孙。

chapters.en:
The descendants of the servants of Solomon:
the descendants of Sotai,
the descendants of Hassophereth,
the descendants of Peruda,
chapters.zh: 所罗门仆人的后裔，就是琐太的子孙、琐斐列的子孙、比路大的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Jaala,
the descendants of Darkon,
the descendants of Giddel,
chapters.zh: 雅拉的子孙、达昆的子孙、吉德的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Shephatiah,
the descendants of Hattil,
the descendants of Pochereth-hazzebaim,
and the descendants of Ami.
chapters.zh: 示法提雅的子孙、哈替的子孙、玻黑列‧哈斯巴音的子孙、亚米的子孙。

chapters.en: The temple servants and descendants of the servants of Solomon numbered 392 in all.
chapters.zh: 尼提宁和所罗门仆人的后裔共三百九十二名。

chapters.en: The following came up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer, but they could not prove that their families were descended from Israel:
chapters.zh: 从特‧米拉、特‧哈萨、基绿、押但、音麦上来的，不能指明他们的宗族谱系是以色列人不是；

chapters.en:
the descendants of Delaiah,
the descendants of Tobiah,
and the descendants of Nekoda,
652 in all.
chapters.zh: 他们是第来雅的子孙、多比雅的子孙、尼哥大的子孙，共六百五十二名。

chapters.en:
And from among the priests: the descendants of Hobaiah,
the descendants of Hakkoz,
and the descendants of Barzillai (who had married a daughter of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by their name).
chapters.zh: 祭司中，哈巴雅的子孙、哈哥斯的子孙、巴西莱的子孙；因为他们的先祖娶了基列人巴西莱的女儿为妻，所以起名叫巴西莱。

chapters.en: These men searched for their family records, but they could not find them and so were excluded from the priesthood as unclean.
chapters.zh: 这三家的人在族谱之中寻查自己的谱系，却寻不着，因此算为不洁，不准供祭司的职任。

chapters.en: The governor ordered them not to eat the most holy things until there was a priest to consult the Urim and Thummim.
chapters.zh: 省长对他们说：「不可吃至圣的物，直到有用乌陵和土明决疑的祭司兴起来。」

chapters.en: The whole assembly numbered 42,360,
chapters.zh: 会众共有四万二千三百六十名。

chapters.en: in addition to their 7,337 menservants and maidservants, as well as their 200 male and female singers.
chapters.zh: 此外，还有他们的仆婢七千三百三十七名，又有歌唱的男女二百名。

chapters.en: They had 736 horses, 245 mules,
chapters.zh: 他们有马七百三十六匹，骡子二百四十五匹，

chapters.en: 435 camels, and 6,720 donkeys.
chapters.zh: 骆驼四百三十五只，驴六千七百二十匹。

chapters.en: When they arrived at the house of the LORD in Jerusalem, some of the heads of the families gave freewill offerings to rebuild the house of God on its original site.
chapters.zh: 有些族长到了耶路撒冷耶和华殿的地方，便为上帝的殿甘心献上礼物，要重新建造。

chapters.en: According to their ability, they gave to the treasury for this work 61,000 darics of gold, 5,000 minas of silver, and 100 priestly garments.
chapters.zh: 他们量力捐入工程库的金子六万一千达利克，银子五千弥拿，并祭司的礼服一百件。

chapters.en: So the priests, the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, along with some of the people, settled in their own towns; and the rest of the Israelites settled in their towns.
chapters.zh: 于是祭司、利未人、民中的一些人、歌唱的、守门的、尼提宁，并以色列众人，各住在自己的城里。

chapters.en: By the seventh month, the Israelites had settled in their towns, and the people assembled as one man in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 到了七月，以色列人住在各城；那时他们如同一人，聚集在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Then Jeshua son of Jozadak and his fellow priests, along with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and his associates, began to build the altar of the God of Israel to sacrifice burnt offerings on it, as it is written in the Law of Moses the man of God.
chapters.zh: 约萨达儿子耶书亚和他的弟兄众祭司，并撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯与他的弟兄，都起来建筑以色列上帝的坛，要照神人摩西律法书上所写的，在坛上献燔祭。

chapters.en: They set up the altar on its foundation and sacrificed burnt offerings on it to the LORD—both the morning and evening burnt offerings—even though they feared the people of the land.
chapters.zh: 他们在原有的根基上筑坛，因惧怕邻国的民，又在其上向耶和华早晚献燔祭，

chapters.en: They also celebrated the Feast of Tabernacles in accordance with what is written, and they offered burnt offerings daily based on the number prescribed for each day.
chapters.zh: 又照律法书上所写的守住棚节，按数照例〔献〕每日所当献的燔祭；

chapters.en: After that, they presented the regular burnt offerings and those for New Moons and for all the appointed sacred feasts of the LORD, as well as all the freewill offerings brought to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 其后献常献的燔祭，并在月朔与耶和华的一切圣节献祭，又向耶和华献各人的甘心祭。

chapters.en: On the first day of the seventh month, the Israelites began to offer burnt offerings to the LORD, although the foundation of the temple of the LORD had not been laid.
chapters.zh: 从七月初一日起，他们就向耶和华献燔祭。但耶和华殿的根基尚未立定。

chapters.en: They gave money to the masons and carpenters, and food and drink and oil to the people of Sidon and Tyre to bring cedar logs from Lebanon to Joppa by sea, as authorized by Cyrus king of Persia.
chapters.zh: 他们又将银子给石匠、木匠，把粮食、酒、油给西顿人、泰尔人，使他们将香柏树从黎巴嫩运到海里，浮海运到约帕，是照波斯王塞鲁士所允准的。

chapters.en: In the second month of the second year after they had arrived at the house of God in Jerusalem, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Jeshua son of Jozadak, and the rest of their associates including the priests, the Levites, and all who had returned to Jerusalem from the captivity, began the work. They appointed Levites twenty years of age or older to supervise the construction of the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 百姓到了耶路撒冷上帝殿的地方。第二年二月，撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯，约萨达的儿子耶书亚和其余的弟兄，就是祭司、利未人，并一切被掳归回耶路撒冷的人，都兴工建造；又派利未人，从二十岁以外的，督理建造耶和华殿的工作。

chapters.en: So Jeshua and his sons and brothers, Kadmiel and his sons (descendants of Yehudah), and the sons of Henadad and their sons and brothers—all Levites—joined together to supervise those working on the house of God.
chapters.zh: 于是犹大〔注：在二章四十节作何达威雅〕的后裔，就是耶书亚和他的子孙与弟兄，甲篾和他的子孙，利未人希拿达的子孙与弟兄，都一同起来，督理那在上帝殿做工的人。

chapters.en: When the builders had laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD, the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites (the sons of Asaph) with cymbals, took their positions to praise the LORD, as David king of Israel had prescribed.
chapters.zh: 匠人立耶和华殿根基的时候，祭司皆穿礼服吹号，亚萨的子孙利未人敲钹，照以色列王大卫所定的例，都站着赞美耶和华。

chapters.en:
And they sang responsively with praise and thanksgiving to the LORD:
“For He is good; for His loving devotion to Israel endures forever.”
Then all the people gave a great shout of praise to the LORD, because the foundation of the house of the LORD had been laid.
chapters.zh: 他们彼此唱和，赞美称谢耶和华〔说〕： 他本为善， 他向以色列人永发慈爱。 他们赞美耶和华的时候，众民大声呼喊，因耶和华殿的根基已经立定。

chapters.en: But many of the older priests, Levites, and family heads who had seen the first temple wept loudly when they saw the foundation of this temple. Still, many others shouted joyfully.
chapters.zh: 然而有许多祭司、利未人、族长，就是见过旧殿的老年人，现在亲眼看见立这殿的根基，便大声哭号，也有许多人大声欢呼，

chapters.en: The people could not distinguish the shouts of joy from the sound of weeping, because the people were making so much noise. And the sound was heard from afar.
chapters.zh: 甚至百姓不能分辨欢呼的声音和哭号的声音；因为众人大声呼喊，声音听到远处。

chapters.en: When the enemies of Judah and Benjamin heard that the exiles were building a temple for the LORD, the God of Israel,
chapters.zh: 犹大和便雅悯的敌人听说被掳归回的人为耶和华－以色列的上帝建造殿宇，

chapters.en: they approached Zerubbabel and the heads of the families, saying, “Let us build with you because, like you, we seek your God and have been sacrificing to Him since the time of King Esar-haddon of Assyria, who brought us here.”
chapters.zh: 就去见所罗巴伯和以色列的族长，对他们说：「请容我们与你们一同建造；因为我们寻求你们的上帝，与你们一样。自从亚述王以撒哈顿带我们上这地以来，我们常祭祀上帝。」

chapters.en: But Zerubbabel, Jeshua, and the other heads of the families of Israel replied, “You have no part with us in building a house for our God, since we alone must build it for the LORD, the God of Israel, as Cyrus king of Persia has commanded us.”
chapters.zh: 但所罗巴伯、耶书亚，和其余以色列的族长对他们说：「我们建造上帝的殿与你们无干，我们自己为耶和华－以色列的上帝协力建造，是照波斯王塞鲁士所吩咐的。」

chapters.en: Then the people of the land set out to discourage the people of Judah and make them afraid to build.
chapters.zh: 那地的民，就在犹大人建造的时候，使他们的手发软，扰乱他们；

chapters.en: They hired counselors against them to frustrate their plans throughout the reign of Cyrus king of Persia and down to the reign of Darius king of Persia.
chapters.zh: 从波斯王塞鲁士年间，直到波斯王大流士登基的时候，贿买谋士，要败坏他们的谋算。

chapters.en: At the beginning of the reign of Xerxes, an accusation was lodged against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 在亚哈随鲁才登基的时候，上本控告犹大和耶路撒冷的居民。

chapters.en: And in the days of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of his associates wrote a letter to Artaxerxes. It was written in Aramaic and then translated.
chapters.zh: 亚达薛西年间，比施兰、米特利达、他别，和他们的同党上本奏告波斯王亚达薛西。本章是用亚兰〔文字〕，亚兰〔方言〕。

chapters.en: Rehum the commander and Shimshai the scribe wrote the letter against Jerusalem to King Artaxerxes as follows:
chapters.zh: 省长利宏、书记伸帅要控告耶路撒冷人，也上本奏告亚达薛西王。

chapters.en: From Rehum the commander, Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their associates—the judges and officials over Tripolis, Persia, Erech and Babylon, the Elamites of Susa,
chapters.zh: 省长利宏、书记伸帅，和同党的底拿人、亚法萨提迦人、他毗拉人、亚法撒人、亚基卫人、巴比伦人、书珊迦人、底亥人、以拦人，

chapters.en: and the rest of the peoples whom the great and honorable Ashurbanipal deported and settled in the cities of Samaria and elsewhere west of the Euphrates.
chapters.zh: 和尊大的亚斯那巴所迁移、安置在撒马利亚城，并大河西一带地方的人等，

chapters.en:
(This is the text of the letter they sent to him.)
To King Artaxerxes,
From your servants, the men west of the Euphrates:
chapters.zh: 上奏亚达薛西王说：「河西的臣民云云：

chapters.en: Let it be known to the king that the Jews who came from you to us have returned to Jerusalem and are rebuilding that rebellious and wicked city. They are restoring its walls and repairing its foundations.
chapters.zh: 王该知道，从王那里上到我们这里的犹大人，已经到耶路撒冷重建这反叛恶劣的城，筑立根基，建造城墙。

chapters.en: Let it now be known to the king that if that city is rebuilt and its walls are restored, they will not pay tribute, duty, or toll, and the royal treasury will suffer.
chapters.zh: 如今王该知道，他们若建造这城，城墙完毕就不再与王进贡，交课，纳税，终久王必受亏损。

chapters.en: Now because we are in the service of the palace and it is not fitting for us to allow the king to be dishonored, we have sent to inform the king
chapters.zh: 我们既食御盐，不忍见王吃亏，因此奏告于王。

chapters.en: that a search should be made of the record books of your fathers. In these books you will discover and verify that the city is a rebellious city, harmful to kings and provinces, inciting sedition from ancient times. That is why this city was destroyed.
chapters.zh: 请王考察先王的实录，必在其上查知这城是反叛的城，与列王和各省有害；自古以来，其中常有悖逆的事，因此这城曾被拆毁。

chapters.en: We advise the king that if this city is rebuilt and its walls are restored, you will have no dominion west of the Euphrates.
chapters.zh: 我们谨奏王知，这城若再建造，城墙完毕，河西之地王就无分了。」

chapters.en:
Then the king sent this reply:
To Rehum the commander, Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of your associates living in Samaria and elsewhere in the region west of the Euphrates:
Greetings.
chapters.zh: 那时王谕覆省长利宏、书记伸帅，和他们的同党，就是住撒马利亚并河西一带地方的人，说：「愿你们平安云云。

chapters.en: The letter you sent us has been translated and read in my presence.
chapters.zh: 你们所上的本，已经明读在我面前。

chapters.en: I issued a decree, and a search was conducted. It was discovered that this city has revolted against kings from ancient times, engaging in rebellion and sedition.
chapters.zh: 我已命人考查，得知此城古来果然背叛列王，其中常有反叛悖逆的事。

chapters.en: And mighty kings have ruled over Jerusalem and exercised authority over the whole region west of the Euphrates; and tribute, duty, and toll were paid to them.
chapters.zh: 从前耶路撒冷也有大君王统管河西全〔地〕，人就给他们进贡，交课，纳税。

chapters.en: Now, therefore, issue an order for these men to stop, so that this city will not be rebuilt until I so order.
chapters.zh: 现在你们要出告示命这些人停工，使这城不得建造，等我降旨。

chapters.en: See that you do not neglect this matter. Why allow this threat to increase and the royal interests to suffer?
chapters.zh: 你们当谨慎，不可迟延，为何容害加重，使王受亏损呢？」

chapters.en: When the text of the letter from King Artaxerxes was read to Rehum, Shimshai the scribe, and their associates, they went immediately to the Jews in Jerusalem and forcibly stopped them.
chapters.zh: 亚达薛西王的上谕读在利宏和书记伸帅，并他们的同党面前，他们就急忙往耶路撒冷去见犹大人，用势力强迫他们停工。

chapters.en: Thus the construction of the house of God in Jerusalem ceased, and it remained at a standstill until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
chapters.zh: 于是，在耶路撒冷上帝殿的工程就停止了，直停到波斯王大流士第二年。

chapters.en: Later, the prophets Haggai and Zechariah son of Iddo prophesied to the Jews in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, who was over them.
chapters.zh: 那时，先知哈该和易多的孙子撒迦利亚奉以色列上帝的名向犹大和耶路撒冷的犹大人说劝勉的话。

chapters.en: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Jeshua son of Jozadak rose up and began to rebuild the house of God in Jerusalem. And the prophets of God were with them, helping them.
chapters.zh: 于是撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约萨达的儿子耶书亚都起来动手建造耶路撒冷上帝的殿，有上帝的先知在那里帮助他们。

chapters.en: At that time Tattenai the governor of the region west of the Euphrates, Shethar-bozenai, and their associates went to the Jews and asked, “Who authorized you to rebuild this temple and restore this structure?”
chapters.zh: 当时河西的总督达乃和示他‧波斯乃，并他们的同党来问说：「谁降旨让你们建造这殿，修成这墙呢？」

chapters.en: They also asked, “What are the names of the men who are constructing this building?”
chapters.zh: 我们便告诉他们建造这殿的人叫什么名字。

chapters.en: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, so that they were not stopped until a report was sent to Darius and written instructions about this matter were returned.
chapters.zh: 上帝的眼目看顾犹大的长老，以致总督等没有叫他们停工，直到这事奏告大流士，得着他的回谕。

chapters.en: This is the text of the letter that Tattenai the governor of the region west of the Euphrates, Shethar-bozenai, and their associates, the officials in the region, sent to King Darius.
chapters.zh: 河西的总督达乃和示他‧波斯乃，并他们的同党，就是住河西的亚法萨迦人，上本奏告大流士王。

chapters.en:
The report they sent him read as follows:
To King Darius:
All peace.
chapters.zh: 本上写着说：「愿大流士王诸事平安。

chapters.en: Let it be known to the king that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God. The people are rebuilding it with large stones and placing timbers in the walls. This work is being carried out diligently and is prospering in their hands.
chapters.zh: 王该知道，我们往犹大省去，到了至大上帝的殿，这殿是用大石建造的。梁木插入墙内，工作甚速，他们手下亨通。

chapters.en: So we questioned the elders and asked, “Who authorized you to rebuild this temple and restore this structure?”
chapters.zh: 我们就问那些长老说：『谁降旨让你们建造这殿，修成这墙呢？』

chapters.en: We also asked for their names, so that we could write down the names of their leaders for your information.
chapters.zh: 又问他们的名字，要记录他们首领的名字，奏告于王。

chapters.en:
And this is the answer they returned:
“We are servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and completed.
chapters.zh: 他们回答说：『我们是天地之上帝的仆人，重建前多年所建造的殿，就是以色列的一位大君王建造修成的。

chapters.en: But since our fathers angered the God of heaven, He delivered them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean who destroyed this temple and carried away the people to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 只因我们列祖惹天上的上帝发怒，上帝把他们交在迦勒底人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中，他就拆毁这殿，又将百姓掳到巴比伦。

chapters.en: In the first year of his reign, however, Cyrus king of Babylon issued a decree to rebuild this house of God.
chapters.zh: 然而巴比伦王塞鲁士元年，他降旨允准建造上帝的这殿。

chapters.en: He also removed from the temple of Babylon the gold and silver articles belonging to the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar had taken and carried there from the temple in Jerusalem. King Cyrus gave these articles to a man named Sheshbazzar, whom he appointed governor
chapters.zh: 上帝殿中的金、银器皿，就是尼布甲尼撒从耶路撒冷的殿中掠去带到巴比伦庙里的，塞鲁士王从巴比伦庙里取出来，交给派为省长的，名叫设巴萨，

chapters.en: and instructed, ‘Take these articles, put them in the temple in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be rebuilt on its original site.’
chapters.zh: 对他说可以将这些器皿带去，放在耶路撒冷的殿中，在原处建造上帝的殿。

chapters.en: So this Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundation of the house of God in Jerusalem, and from that time until now it has been under construction, but it has not yet been completed.”
chapters.zh: 于是这设巴萨来建立耶路撒冷上帝殿的根基。这殿从那时直到如今尚未造成。』

chapters.en: Now, therefore, if it pleases the king, let a search be made of the royal archives in Babylon to see if King Cyrus did indeed issue a decree to rebuild the house of God in Jerusalem. Then let the king send us his decision in this matter.
chapters.zh: 现在王若以为美，请察巴比伦王的府库，看塞鲁士王降旨允准在耶路撒冷建造上帝的殿没有，王的心意如何？请降旨晓谕我们。」
