chapters.en: Thus King Darius ordered a search of the archives stored in the treasury of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 于是大流士王降旨，要寻察典籍库内，就是在巴比伦藏宝物之处；

chapters.en:
And a scroll was found in the fortress of Ecbatana, in the province of Media, with the following written on it:
Memorandum:
chapters.zh: 在米底亚省亚马他城的宫内寻得一卷，其中记着说：

chapters.en:
In the first year of King Cyrus, he issued a decree concerning the house of God in Jerusalem:
Let the house be rebuilt as a place for offering sacrifices, and let its foundations be firmly laid. It is to be sixty cubits high and sixty cubits wide,
chapters.zh: 「塞鲁士王元年，他降旨论到耶路撒冷上帝的殿，要建造这殿为献祭之处，坚立殿的根基。殿高六十肘，宽六十肘，

chapters.en: with three layers of cut stones and one of timbers. The costs are to be paid from the royal treasury.
chapters.zh: 用三层大石头，一层新木头，经费要出于王库；

chapters.en: Furthermore, the gold and silver articles of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple in Jerusalem and carried to Babylon, must also be returned to the temple in Jerusalem and deposited in the house of God.
chapters.zh: 并且上帝殿的金银器皿，就是尼布甲尼撒从耶路撒冷的殿中掠到巴比伦的，要归还带到耶路撒冷的殿中，各按原处放在上帝的殿里。」

chapters.en:
Therefore Darius decreed:
To Tattenai governor of the region west of the Euphrates, Shethar-bozenai, and your associates and officials in the region:
You must stay away from that place!
chapters.zh: 「现在河西的总督达乃和示他‧波斯乃，并你们的同党，就是住河西的亚法萨迦人，你们当远离他们。

chapters.en: Leave this work on the house of God alone. Let the governor and elders of the Jews rebuild this house of God on its original site.
chapters.zh: 不要拦阻上帝殿的工作，任凭犹大人的省长和犹大人的长老在原处建造上帝的这殿。

chapters.en:
I hereby decree what you must do for these elders of the Jews who are rebuilding this house of God:
The cost is to be paid in full to these men from the royal treasury out of the taxes of the provinces west of the Euphrates, so that the work will not be hindered.
chapters.zh: 我又降旨，吩咐你们向犹大人的长老为建造上帝的殿当怎样行，就是从河西的款项中，急速拨取贡银作他们的经费，免得耽误工作。

chapters.en: Whatever is needed—young bulls, rams, and lambs for burnt offerings to the God of heaven, as well as wheat, salt, wine, and oil, as requested by the priests in Jerusalem—must be given to them daily without fail.
chapters.zh: 他们与天上的上帝献燔祭所需用的公牛犊、公绵羊、绵羊羔，并所用的麦子、盐、酒、油，都要照耶路撒冷祭司的话，每日供给他们，不得有误；

chapters.en: Then they will be able to offer sacrifices of a sweet aroma to the God of heaven and to pray for the lives of the king and his sons.
chapters.zh: 好叫他们献馨香的祭给天上的上帝，又为王和王众子的寿命祈祷。

chapters.en: I also decree that if any man interferes with this directive, a beam is to be torn from his house and raised up, and he is to be impaled on it. And his own house shall be made a pile of rubble for this offense.
chapters.zh: 我再降旨，无论谁更改这命令，必从他房屋中拆出一根梁来，把他举起，悬在其上，又使他的房屋成为粪堆。

chapters.en:
May God, who has caused His Name to dwell there, overthrow any king or people who lifts a hand to alter this decree or to destroy this house of God in Jerusalem.
I, Darius, have issued the decree. Let it be carried out with diligence.
chapters.zh: 若有王和民伸手更改这〔命令〕，拆毁这殿，愿那使耶路撒冷的殿作为他名居所的上帝将他们灭绝。我－大流士降这旨意，当速速遵行。」

chapters.en: In response, Tattenai the governor of the region west of the Euphrates, Shethar-bozenai, and their associates diligently carried out what King Darius had decreed.
chapters.zh: 于是，河西总督达乃和示他‧波斯乃，并他们的同党，因大流士王所发的命令，就急速遵行。

chapters.en:
So the Jewish elders built and prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah son of Iddo.
They finished building according to the command of the God of Israel and the decrees of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes, kings of Persia.
chapters.zh: 犹大长老因先知哈该和易多的孙子撒迦利亚所说劝勉的话就建造这殿，凡事亨通。他们遵着以色列上帝的命令和波斯王塞鲁士、大流士、亚达薛西的旨意，建造完毕。

chapters.en: And this temple was completed on the third day of the month of Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of King Darius.
chapters.zh: 大流士王第六年，亚达月初三日，这殿修成了。

chapters.en: Then the people of Israel—the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the exiles—celebrated the dedication of the house of God with joy.
chapters.zh: 以色列的祭司和利未人，并其余被掳归回的人都欢欢喜喜地行奉献上帝殿的礼。

chapters.en: For the dedication of the house of God they offered a hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs, and a sin offering for all Israel of twelve male goats, one for each tribe of Israel.
chapters.zh: 行奉献上帝殿的礼就献公牛一百只，公绵羊二百只，绵羊羔四百只，又照以色列支派的数目献公山羊十二只，为以色列众人作赎罪祭；

chapters.en: They also appointed the priests by their divisions and the Levites by their groups to the service of God in Jerusalem, according to what is written in the Book of Moses.
chapters.zh: 且派祭司和利未人按着班次在耶路撒冷事奉上帝，是照摩西〔律法〕书上所写的。

chapters.en: On the fourteenth day of the first month, the exiles kept the Passover.
chapters.zh: 正月十四日，被掳归回的人守逾越节。

chapters.en:
All the priests and Levites had purified themselves and were ceremonially clean.
And the Levites slaughtered the Passover lamb for all the exiles, for their priestly brothers, and for themselves.
chapters.zh: 原来，祭司和利未人一同自洁，无一人不洁净。利未人为被掳归回的众人和他们的弟兄众祭司，并为自己宰逾越节〔的羊羔〕。

chapters.en: The Israelites who had returned from exile ate it, together with all who had separated themselves from the uncleanness of the peoples of the land to seek the LORD, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 从掳到之地归回的以色列人和一切除掉所染外邦人污秽、归附他们、要寻求耶和华－以色列上帝的人都吃〔这羊羔〕，

chapters.en: For seven days they kept the Feast of Unleavened Bread with joy, because the LORD had made them joyful and turned the heart of the king of Assyria toward them to strengthen their hands in the work on the house of the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 欢欢喜喜地守除酵节七日；因为耶和华使他们欢喜，又使亚述王的心转向他们，坚固他们的手，作以色列上帝殿的工程。

chapters.en: Many years later, during the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,
chapters.zh: 这事以后，波斯王亚达薛西年间，有个以斯拉，他是西莱雅的儿子，西莱雅是亚撒利雅的儿子，亚撒利雅是希勒家的儿子，

chapters.en: the son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,
chapters.zh: 希勒家是沙龙的儿子，沙龙是撒督的儿子，撒督是亚希突的儿子，

chapters.en: the son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,
chapters.zh: 亚希突是亚玛利雅的儿子，亚玛利雅是亚撒利雅的儿子，亚撒利雅是米拉约的儿子，

chapters.en: the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,
chapters.zh: 米拉约是西拉希雅的儿子，西拉希雅是乌西的儿子，乌西是布基的儿子，

chapters.en: the son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest—
chapters.zh: 布基是亚比书的儿子，亚比书是非尼哈的儿子，非尼哈是以利亚撒的儿子，以利亚撒是大祭司亚伦的儿子。

chapters.en:
this Ezra came up from Babylon. He was a scribe skilled in the Law of Moses, which the LORD, the God of Israel, had given.
The king had granted Ezra all his requests, for the hand of the LORD his God was upon him.
chapters.zh: 这以斯拉从巴比伦上来，他是敏捷的文士，通达耶和华－以色列上帝所赐摩西的律法书。王允准他一切所求的，是因耶和华－他上帝的手帮助他。

chapters.en: So in the seventh year of King Artaxerxes, he went up to Jerusalem with some of the Israelites, including priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, and temple servants.
chapters.zh: 亚达薛西王第七年，以色列人、祭司、利未人、歌唱的、守门的、尼提宁，有上耶路撒冷的。

chapters.en: Ezra arrived in Jerusalem in the fifth month of the seventh year of the king.
chapters.zh: 王第七年五月，以斯拉到了耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: He had begun the journey from Babylon on the first day of the first month, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month, for the gracious hand of his God was upon him.
chapters.zh: 正月初一日，他从巴比伦起程；因他上帝施恩的手帮助他，五月初一日就到了耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: For Ezra had set his heart to study the Law of the LORD, to practice it, and to teach its statutes and ordinances in Israel.
chapters.zh: 以斯拉定志考究遵行耶和华的律法，又将律例典章教训以色列人。

chapters.en: This is the text of the letter King Artaxerxes had given to Ezra the priest and scribe, an expert in the commandments and statutes of the LORD to Israel:
chapters.zh: 祭司以斯拉是通达耶和华诫命和赐以色列之律例的文士。亚达薛西王赐给他们谕旨，上面写着说：

chapters.en:
Artaxerxes, king of kings.
To Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven:
Greetings.
chapters.zh: 「诸王之王亚达薛西，达于祭司以斯拉通达天上上帝律法大德的文士，云云。

chapters.en: I hereby decree that any volunteers among the Israelites in my kingdom, including the priests and Levites, may go up with you to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 住在我国中的以色列人、祭司、利未人，凡甘心上耶路撒冷去的，我降旨准他们与你同去。

chapters.en: You are sent by the king and his seven counselors to evaluate Judah and Jerusalem according to the Law of your God, which is in your hand.
chapters.zh: 王与七个谋士既然差你去，照你手中上帝的律法书察问犹大和耶路撒冷的景况；

chapters.en: Moreover, you are to take with you the silver and gold that the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose dwelling is in Jerusalem,
chapters.zh: 又带金银，就是王和谋士甘心献给住耶路撒冷、以色列上帝的，

chapters.en: together with all the silver and gold you may find in all the province of Babylon, as well as the freewill offerings of the people and priests to the house of their God in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 并带你在巴比伦全省所得的金银，和百姓、祭司乐意献给耶路撒冷－他们上帝殿的礼物。

chapters.en: With this money, therefore, you are to buy as many bulls, rams, and lambs as needed, together with their grain offerings and drink offerings, and offer them on the altar at the house of your God in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 所以你当用这金银，急速买公牛、公绵羊、绵羊羔，和同献的素祭奠祭之物，献在耶路撒冷－你们上帝殿的坛上。

chapters.en: You and your brothers may do whatever seems best with the rest of the silver and gold, according to the will of your God.
chapters.zh: 剩下的金银，你和你的弟兄看着怎样好，就怎样用，总要遵着你们上帝的旨意。

chapters.en: You must deliver to the God of Jerusalem all the articles given to you for the service of the house of your God.
chapters.zh: 所交给你上帝殿中使用的器皿，你要交在耶路撒冷上帝面前。

chapters.en: And if anything else is needed for the house of your God that you may have occasion to supply, you may pay for it from the royal treasury.
chapters.zh: 你上帝殿里若再有需用的经费，你可以从王的府库里支取。

chapters.en: I, King Artaxerxes, decree to all the treasurers west of the Euphrates: Whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven, may require of you, it must be provided promptly,
chapters.zh: 「我－亚达薛西王又降旨与河西的一切库官，说：『通达天上上帝律法的文士祭司以斯拉，无论向你们要什么，你们要速速地备办，

chapters.en: up to a hundred talents of silver, a hundred cors of wheat, a hundred baths of wine, a hundred baths of olive oil, and salt without limit.
chapters.zh: 就是银子直到一百他连得，麦子一百柯珥，酒一百罢特，油一百罢特，盐不计其数，也要给他。

chapters.en: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven must be done diligently for His house. For why should wrath fall on the realm of the king and his sons?
chapters.zh: 凡天上之上帝所吩咐的，当为天上上帝的殿详细办理。为何使忿怒临到王和王众子的国呢？

chapters.en: And be advised that you have no authority to impose tribute, duty, or toll on any of the priests, Levites, singers, doorkeepers, temple servants, or other servants of this house of God.
chapters.zh: 我又晓谕你们，至于祭司、利未人、歌唱的、守门的，和尼提宁，并在上帝殿当差的人，不可叫他们进贡，交课，纳税。』

chapters.en: And you, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God, which you possess, are to appoint magistrates and judges to judge all the people west of the Euphrates—all who know the laws of your God. And you are to teach these laws to anyone who does not know them.
chapters.zh: 「以斯拉啊，要照着你上帝赐你的智慧，将所有明白你上帝律法的人立为士师、审判官，治理河西的百姓，使他们教训一切不明白〔上帝〕律法的人。

chapters.en: If anyone does not keep the law of your God and the law of the king, let a strict judgment be executed against him, whether death, banishment, confiscation of property, or imprisonment.
chapters.zh: 凡不遵行你上帝律法和王命令的人就当速速定他的罪，或治死，或充军，或抄家，或囚禁。」

chapters.en: Blessed be the LORD, the God of our fathers, who has put into the heart of the king to so honor the house of the LORD in Jerusalem,
chapters.zh: 以斯拉说：「耶和华－我们列祖的上帝是应当称颂的！因他使王起这心意修饰耶路撒冷耶和华的殿，

chapters.en:
and who has shown me favor before the king, his counselors, and all his powerful officials.
And because the hand of the LORD my God was upon me, I took courage and gathered the leaders of Israel to return with me.
chapters.zh: 又在王和谋士，并大能的军长面前施恩于我。因耶和华－我上帝的手帮助我，我就得以坚强，从以色列中招聚首领，与我一同上来。」

chapters.en: These are the family heads and genealogical records of those who returned with me from Babylon during the reign of King Artaxerxes:
chapters.zh: 当亚达薛西王年间，同我从巴比伦上来的人，他们的族长和他们的家谱记在下面：
属非尼哈的子孙有革顺；属以他玛的子孙有但以理；属大卫的子孙有哈突；

chapters.en:
of the descendants of Shecaniah;
from the descendants of Parosh, Zechariah, and with him were registered 150 men;
chapters.zh: 属巴录的后裔，就是示迦尼的子孙有撒迦利亚，同着他，按家谱计算，男丁一百五十人；

chapters.en: from the descendants of Pahath-Moab, Eliehoenai son of Zerahiah, and with him 200 men;
chapters.zh: 属巴赫‧摩押的子孙有西拉希雅的儿子以利约乃，同着他有男丁二百；

chapters.en: from the descendants of Zattu, Shecaniah son of Jahaziel, and with him 300 men;
chapters.zh: 属示迦尼的子孙有雅哈悉的儿子，同着他有男丁三百；

chapters.en: from the descendants of Adin, Ebed son of Jonathan, and with him 50 men;
chapters.zh: 属亚丁的子孙有约拿单的儿子以别，同着他有男丁五十；

chapters.en: from the descendants of Elam, Jeshaiah son of Athaliah, and with him 70 men;
chapters.zh: 属以拦的子孙有亚他利雅的儿子耶筛亚，同着他有男丁七十；

chapters.en: from the descendants of Shephatiah, Zebadiah son of Michael, and with him 80 men;
chapters.zh: 属示法提雅的子孙有米迦勒的儿子西巴第雅，同着他有男丁八十；

chapters.en: from the descendants of Joab, Obadiah son of Jehiel, and with him 218 men;
chapters.zh: 属约押的子孙有耶歇的儿子俄巴底亚，同着他有男丁二百一十八；

chapters.en: from the descendants of Bani, Shelomith son of Josiphiah, and with him 160 men;
chapters.zh: 属示罗密的子孙有约细斐的儿子，同着他有男丁一百六十；

chapters.en: from the descendants of Bebai, Zechariah son of Bebai, and with him 28 men;
chapters.zh: 属比拜的子孙有比拜的儿子撒迦利亚，同着他有男丁二十八；

chapters.en: from the descendants of Azgad, Johanan son of Hakkatan, and with him 110 men;
chapters.zh: 属押甲的子孙有哈加坦的儿子约哈难，同着他有男丁一百一十；

chapters.en: from the later descendants of Adonikam, these were their names: Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them 60 men;
chapters.zh: 属亚多尼干的子孙，就是末尾的，他们的名字是以利法列、耶利、示玛雅，同着他们有男丁六十；

chapters.en: and from the descendants of Bigvai, both Uthai and Zaccur, and with them 70 men.
chapters.zh: 属比革瓦伊的子孙有乌太和撒布，同着他们有男丁七十。

chapters.en: Now I assembled these exiles at the canal that flows to Ahava, and we camped there three days. And when I searched among the people and priests, I found no Levites there.
chapters.zh: 我招聚这些人在流入亚哈瓦的河边，我们在那里住了三日。我查看百姓和祭司，见没有利未人在那里，

chapters.en: Then I summoned the leaders: Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam, as well as the teachers Joiarib and Elnathan.
chapters.zh: 就召首领以利以谢、亚列、示玛雅、以利拿单、雅立、以利拿单、拿单、撒迦利亚、米书兰，又召教习约雅立和以利拿单。

chapters.en: And I sent them to Iddo, the leader at Casiphia, with a message for him and his kinsmen, the temple servants at Casiphia, that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God.
chapters.zh: 我打发他们往迦西斐雅地方去见那里的首领易多，又告诉他们当向易多和他的弟兄尼提宁说什么话，叫他们为我们上帝的殿带使用的人来。

chapters.en: And since the gracious hand of our God was upon us, they brought us Sherebiah—a man of insight from the descendants of Mahli son of Levi, the son of Israel—along with his sons and brothers, 18 men;
chapters.zh: 蒙我们上帝施恩的手帮助我们，他们在以色列的曾孙、利未的孙子、抹利的后裔中带一个通达人来；还有示利比和他的众子与弟兄共一十八人。

chapters.en: also Hashabiah, together with Jeshaiah, from the descendants of Merari, and his brothers and their sons, 20 men.
chapters.zh: 又有哈沙比雅，同着他有米拉利的子孙耶筛亚，并他的众子和弟兄共二十人。

chapters.en: They also brought 220 of the temple servants, all designated by name. David and the officials had appointed them to assist the Levites.
chapters.zh: 从前大卫和众首领派尼提宁服事利未人，现在从这尼提宁中也带了二百二十人来，都是按名指定的。

chapters.en: And there by the Ahava Canal I proclaimed a fast, so that we might humble ourselves before our God and ask Him for a safe journey for us and our children, with all our possessions.
chapters.zh: 那时，我在亚哈瓦河边宣告禁食，为要在我们上帝面前克苦己心，求他使我们和〔妇人〕孩子，并一切所有的，都得平坦的道路。

chapters.en: For I was ashamed to ask the king for an escort of soldiers and horsemen to protect us from our enemies on the road, since we had told him, “The hand of our God is gracious to all who seek Him, but His great anger is against all who forsake Him.”
chapters.zh: 我求王拨步兵马兵帮助我们抵挡路上的仇敌，本以为羞耻；因我曾对王说：「我们上帝施恩的手必帮助一切寻求他的；但他的能力和忿怒必攻击一切离弃他的。」

chapters.en: So we fasted and petitioned our God about this, and He granted our request.
chapters.zh: 所以我们禁食祈求我们的上帝，他就应允了我们。

chapters.en: Then I set apart twelve of the leading priests, together with Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers,
chapters.zh: 我分派祭司长十二人，就是示利比、哈沙比雅，和他们的弟兄十人，

chapters.en: and I weighed out to them the contribution of silver and gold and the articles that the king, his counselors, his leaders, and all the Israelites there had offered for the house of our God.
chapters.zh: 将王和谋士、军长，并在那里的以色列众人为我们上帝殿所献的金银和器皿，都秤了交给他们。

chapters.en: I weighed out into their hands 650 talents of silver, articles of silver weighing 100 talents, 100 talents of gold,
chapters.zh: 我秤了交在他们手中的银子有六百五十他连得；银器重一百他连得；金子一百他连得；

chapters.en: 20 gold bowls valued at 1,000 darics, and two articles of fine polished bronze, as precious as gold.
chapters.zh: 金碗二十个，重一千达利克；上等光铜的器皿两个，宝贵如金。

chapters.en: Then I told them, “You are holy to the LORD, and these articles are holy. The silver and gold are a freewill offering to the LORD, the God of your fathers.
chapters.zh: 我对他们说：「你们归耶和华为圣，器皿也为圣；金银是甘心献给耶和华－你们列祖之上帝的。

chapters.en: Guard them carefully until you weigh them out in the chambers of the house of the LORD in Jerusalem before the leading priests, Levites, and heads of the Israelite families.”
chapters.zh: 你们当警醒看守，直到你们在耶路撒冷耶和华殿的库内，在祭司长和利未族长，并以色列的各族长面前过了秤。」

chapters.en: So the priests and Levites took charge of the silver and gold and sacred articles that had been weighed out to be taken to the house of our God in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 于是，祭司、利未人按着分量接受金银和器皿，要带到耶路撒冷我们上帝的殿里。

chapters.en: On the twelfth day of the first month we set out from the Ahava Canal to go to Jerusalem, and the hand of our God was upon us to protect us from the hands of the enemies and bandits along the way.
chapters.zh: 正月十二日，我们从亚哈瓦河边起行，要往耶路撒冷去。我们上帝的手保佑我们，救我们脱离仇敌和路上埋伏之人的手。

chapters.en: So we arrived at Jerusalem and rested there for three days.
chapters.zh: 我们到了耶路撒冷，在那里住了三日。

chapters.en: On the fourth day, in the house of our God, we weighed out the silver and gold and sacred articles into the hand of Meremoth son of Uriah, the priest. Eleazar son of Phinehas was with him, along with the Levites Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.
chapters.zh: 第四日，在我们上帝的殿里把金银和器皿都秤了，交在祭司乌利亚的儿子米利末的手中。同着他有非尼哈的儿子以利亚撒，还有利未人耶书亚的儿子约撒拔和宾内的儿子挪亚底。

chapters.en: Everything was verified by number and weight, and the total weight was recorded at that time.
chapters.zh: 当时都点了数目，按着分量写在册上。

chapters.en: Then the exiles who had returned from captivity sacrificed burnt offerings to the God of Israel: 12 bulls for all Israel, 96 rams, 77 lambs, and a sin offering of 12 male goats. All this was a burnt offering to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 从掳到之地归回的人向以色列的上帝献燔祭，就是为以色列众人献公牛十二只，公绵羊九十六只，绵羊羔七十七只，又献公山羊十二只作赎罪祭，这都是向耶和华焚献的。

chapters.en: They also delivered the king’s edicts to the royal satraps and governors of the region west of the Euphrates, who proceeded to assist the people and the house of God.
chapters.zh: 他们将王的谕旨交给王所派的总督与河西的省长，他们就帮助百姓，又供给上帝殿里所需用的。

chapters.en: After these things had been accomplished, the leaders approached me and said, “The people of Israel, including the priests and Levites, have not kept themselves separate from the surrounding peoples whose abominations are like those of the Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians, and Amorites.
chapters.zh: 这事做完了，众首领来见我，说：「以色列民和祭司并利未人，没有离绝迦南人、赫人、比利洗人、耶布斯人、亚扪人、摩押人、埃及人、亚摩利人，仍效法这些国的民，行可憎的事。

chapters.en: Indeed, the Israelites have taken some of their daughters as wives for themselves and their sons, so that the holy seed has been mixed with the people of the land. And the leaders and officials have taken the lead in this unfaithfulness!”
chapters.zh: 因他们为自己和儿子娶了这些外邦女子为妻，以致圣洁的种类和这些国的民混杂；而且首领和官长在这事上为罪魁。」

chapters.en: When I heard this report, I tore my tunic and cloak, pulled out some hair from my head and beard, and sat down in horror.
chapters.zh: 我一听见这事，就撕裂衣服和外袍，拔了头发和胡须，惊惧忧闷而坐。

chapters.en: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel gathered around me because of the unfaithfulness of the exiles, while I sat there in horror until the evening offering.
chapters.zh: 凡为以色列上帝言语战兢的，都因这被掳归回之人所犯的罪聚集到我这里来。我就惊惧忧闷而坐，直到献晚祭的时候。

chapters.en: At the evening offering, I got up from my humiliation with my tunic and cloak torn, and I fell on my knees, spread out my hands to the LORD my God,
chapters.zh: 献晚祭的时候我起来，心中愁苦，穿着撕裂的衣袍，双膝跪下向耶和华－我的上帝举手，

chapters.en:
and said:
“O my God, I am ashamed and embarrassed to lift up my face to You, my God, because our iniquities are higher than our heads, and our guilt has reached the heavens.
chapters.zh: 说：「我的上帝啊，我抱愧蒙羞，不敢向我上帝仰面；因为我们的罪孽灭顶，我们的罪恶滔天。

chapters.en: From the days of our fathers to this day, our guilt has been great. Because of our iniquities, we and our kings and priests have been delivered into the hands of the kings of the earth and subjected to the sword and to captivity, to pillage and humiliation, as we are this day.
chapters.zh: 从我们列祖直到今日，我们的罪恶甚重；因我们的罪孽，我们和君王、祭司都交在外邦列王的手中，杀害、掳掠、抢夺、脸上蒙羞正如今日的光景。

chapters.en: But now, for a brief moment, grace has come from the LORD our God to preserve for us a remnant and to give us a stake in His holy place. Even in our bondage, our God has given us new life and light to our eyes.
chapters.zh: 现在耶和华－我们的上帝暂且施恩与我们，给我们留些逃脱的人，使我们〔安稳〕如钉子钉在他的圣所，我们的上帝好光照我们的眼目，使我们在受辖制之中稍微复兴。

chapters.en: Though we are slaves, our God has not forsaken us in our bondage, but He has extended to us grace in the sight of the kings of Persia, giving us new life to rebuild the house of our God and repair its ruins, and giving us a wall of protection in Judah and Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 我们是奴仆，然而在受辖制之中，我们的上帝仍没有丢弃我们，在波斯王眼前向我们施恩，叫我们复兴，能重建我们上帝的殿，修其毁坏之处，使我们在犹大和耶路撒冷有墙垣。

chapters.en: And now, our God, what can we say after this? For we have forsaken the commandments
chapters.zh: 「我们的上帝啊，既是如此，我们还有什么话可说呢？因为我们已经离弃你的命令，

chapters.en: that You gave through Your servants the prophets, saying: ‘The land that you are entering to possess is a land polluted by the impurity of its peoples and the abominations with which they have filled it from end to end.
chapters.zh: 就是你藉你仆人众先知所吩咐的说：『你们要去得为业之地是污秽之地；因列国之民的污秽和可憎的事，叫全地从这边直到那边满了污秽。

chapters.en: Now, therefore, do not give your daughters in marriage to their sons or take their daughters for your sons. Never seek their peace or prosperity, so that you may be strong and may eat the good things of the land, leaving it as an inheritance to your sons forever.’
chapters.zh: 所以不可将你们的女儿嫁他们的儿子，也不可为你们的儿子娶他们的女儿，永不可求他们的平安和他们的利益，这样你们就可以强盛，吃这地的美物，并遗留这地给你们的子孙永远为业。』

chapters.en: After all that has come upon us because of our evil deeds and our great guilt (though You, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserve and have given us such a remnant as this),
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，我们因自己的恶行和大罪，遭遇了这一切的事，并且你刑罚我们轻于我们罪所当得的，又给我们留下这些人。

chapters.en: shall we again break Your commandments and intermarry with the peoples who commit these abominations? Would You not become so angry with us as to wipe us out, leaving no remnant or survivor?
chapters.zh: 我们岂可再违背你的命令，与这行可憎之事的民结亲呢？〔若这样行〕，你岂不向我们发怒，将我们灭绝，以致没有一个剩下逃脱的人吗？

chapters.en: O LORD, God of Israel, You are righteous! For we remain this day as a remnant. Here we are before You in our guilt, though because of it no one can stand before You.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华－以色列的上帝啊，因你是公义的，我们这剩下的人才得逃脱，正如今日的光景。看哪，我们在你面前有罪恶，因此无人在你面前站立得住。」

chapters.en: While Ezra prayed and made this confession, weeping and falling facedown before the house of God, a very large assembly of Israelites—men, women, and children—gathered around him, and the people wept bitterly as well.
chapters.zh: 以斯拉祷告，认罪，哭泣，俯伏在上帝殿前的时候，有以色列中的男女孩童聚集到以斯拉那里，成了大会，众民无不痛哭。

chapters.en: Then Shecaniah son of Jehiel, an Elamite, said to Ezra: “We have been unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women from the people of the land, yet in spite of this, there is hope for Israel.
chapters.zh: 属以拦的子孙、耶歇的儿子示迦尼对以斯拉说：「我们在此地娶了外邦女子为妻，干犯了我们的上帝，然而以色列人还有指望。

chapters.en: So now let us make a covenant before our God to send away all the foreign wives and their children, according to the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the command of our God. Let it be done according to the Law.
chapters.zh: 现在当与我们的上帝立约，休这一切的妻，离绝她们所生的，照着我主和那因上帝命令战兢之人所议定的，按律法而行。

chapters.en: Get up, for this matter is your responsibility, and we will support you. Be strong and take action!”
chapters.zh: 你起来，这是你当办的事，我们必帮助你，你当奋勉而行。」

chapters.en: So Ezra got up and made the leading priests, Levites, and all Israel take an oath to do what had been said. And they took the oath.
chapters.zh: 以斯拉便起来，使祭司长和利未人，并以色列众人起誓说，必照这话去行；他们就起了誓。

chapters.en: Then Ezra withdrew from before the house of God and walked to the chamber of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. And while he stayed there, he ate no food and drank no water, because he was mourning over the unfaithfulness of the exiles.
chapters.zh: 以斯拉从上帝殿前起来，进入以利亚实的儿子约哈难的屋里，到了那里不吃饭，也不喝水；因为被掳归回之人所犯的罪，心里悲伤。

chapters.en: And a proclamation was issued throughout Judah and Jerusalem that all the exiles should gather at Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 他们通告犹大和耶路撒冷被掳归回的人，叫他们在耶路撒冷聚集。

chapters.en: Whoever failed to appear within three days would forfeit all his property, according to the counsel of the leaders and elders, and would himself be expelled from the assembly of the exiles.
chapters.zh: 凡不遵首领和长老所议定、三日之内不来的，就必抄他的家，使他离开被掳归回之人的会。

chapters.en: So within the three days, all the men of Judah and Benjamin assembled in Jerusalem, and on the twentieth day of the ninth month, all the people sat in the square at the house of God, trembling regarding this matter and because of the heavy rain.
chapters.zh: 于是，犹大和便雅悯众人，三日之内都聚集在耶路撒冷。那日正是九月二十日，众人都坐在上帝殿前的宽阔处；因这事，又因下大雨，就都战兢。

chapters.en: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have been unfaithful by marrying foreign women, adding to the guilt of Israel.
chapters.zh: 祭司以斯拉站起来，对他们说：「你们有罪了；因你们娶了外邦的女子为妻，增添以色列人的罪恶。

chapters.en: Now, therefore, make a confession to the LORD, the God of your fathers, and do His will. Separate yourselves from the people of the land and from your foreign wives.”
chapters.zh: 现在当向耶和华－你们列祖的上帝认罪，遵行他的旨意，离绝这些国的民和外邦的女子。」

chapters.en: And the whole assembly responded in a loud voice: “Truly we must do as you say!
chapters.zh: 会众都大声回答说：「我们必照着你的话行，

chapters.en: But there are many people here, and it is the rainy season. We are not able to stay out in the open. Nor is this the work of one or two days, for we have transgressed greatly in this matter.
chapters.zh: 只是百姓众多，又逢大雨的时令，我们不能站在外头，这也不是一两天办完的事，因我们在这事上犯了大罪；

chapters.en: Let our leaders represent the whole assembly. Then let everyone in our towns who has married a foreign woman come at an appointed time, together with the elders and judges of each town, until the fierce anger of our God in this matter is turned away from us.”
chapters.zh: 不如为全会众派首领办理。凡我们城邑中娶外邦女子为妻的，当按所定的日期，同着本城的长老和士师而来，直到办完这事，上帝的烈怒就转离我们了。」

chapters.en: (Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah, supported by Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite, opposed this plan.)
chapters.zh: 惟有亚撒黑的儿子约拿单，特瓦的儿子雅哈谢阻挡〔注：或译：总办〕这事，并有米书兰和利未人沙比太帮助他们。

chapters.en: So the exiles did as proposed. Ezra the priest selected men who were family heads, each of them identified by name, to represent their families. On the first day of the tenth month they launched the investigation,
chapters.zh: 被掳归回的人如此而行。祭司以斯拉和些族长按着宗族都指名见派；在十月初一日，一同在座查办这事，

chapters.en: and by the first day of the first month they had dealt with all the men who had married foreign women.
chapters.zh: 到正月初一日，才查清娶外邦女子的人数。

chapters.en:
Among the descendants of the priests who had married foreign women were found these descendants of Jeshua son of Jozadak and his brothers:
Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.
chapters.zh: 在祭司中查出娶外邦女子为妻的，就是耶书亚的子孙约萨达的儿子，和他弟兄玛西雅、以利以谢、雅立、基大利；

chapters.en: They pledged to send their wives away, and for their guilt they presented a ram from the flock as a guilt offering.
chapters.zh: 他们便应许必休他们的妻。他们因有罪，就〔献〕群中的一只公绵羊赎罪。

chapters.en:
From the descendants of Immer:
Hanani and Zebadiah.
chapters.zh: 音麦的子孙中，有哈拿尼、西巴第雅。

chapters.en:
From the descendants of Harim:
Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.
chapters.zh: 哈琳的子孙中，有玛西雅、以利雅、示玛雅、耶歇、乌西雅。

chapters.en:
From the descendants of Pashhur:
Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
chapters.zh: 巴施户珥的子孙中，有以利约乃、玛西雅、以实玛利、拿坦业、约撒拔、以利亚撒。

chapters.en:
Among the Levites:
Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (that is, Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
chapters.zh: 利未人中，有约撒拔、示每、基拉雅（基拉雅就是基利他），还有毗他希雅、犹大、以利以谢。

chapters.en:
From the singers:
Eliashib.
From the gatekeepers:
Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
chapters.zh: 歌唱的人中有以利亚实。守门的人中，有沙龙、提联、乌利。

chapters.en:
And among the other Israelites, from the descendants of Parosh:
Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah.
chapters.zh: 以色列人巴录的子孙中，有拉米、耶西雅、玛基雅、米雅民、以利亚撒、玛基雅、比拿雅。

chapters.en:
From the descendants of Elam:
Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.
chapters.zh: 以拦的子孙中，有玛他尼、撒迦利亚、耶歇、押底、耶利末、以利雅。

chapters.en:
From the descendants of Zattu:
Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.
chapters.zh: 萨土的子孙中，有以利约乃、以利亚实、玛他尼、耶利末、撒拔、亚西撒。

chapters.en:
From the descendants of Bebai:
Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.
chapters.zh: 比拜的子孙中，有约哈难、哈拿尼雅、萨拜、亚勒。

chapters.en:
From the descendants of Bani:
Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.
chapters.zh: 巴尼的子孙中，有米书兰、玛鹿、亚大雅、雅述、示押、耶利末。

chapters.en:
From the descendants of Pahath-moab:
Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.
chapters.zh: 巴赫‧摩押的子孙中，有阿底拿、基拉、比拿雅、玛西雅、玛他尼、比撒列、宾内、玛拿西。

chapters.en:
From the descendants of Harim:
Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
chapters.zh: 哈琳的子孙中，有以利以谢、伊示雅、玛基雅、示玛雅、西缅、

chapters.en: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯、玛鹿、示玛利雅。

chapters.en:
From the descendants of Hashum:
Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.
chapters.zh: 哈顺的子孙中，有玛特乃、玛达他、撒拔、以利法列、耶利买、玛拿西、示每。

chapters.en:
From the descendants of Bani:
Maadai, Amram, Uel,
chapters.zh: 巴尼的子孙中，有玛玳、暗兰、乌益、

chapters.en: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,
chapters.zh: 比拿雅、比底雅、基禄、

chapters.en: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
chapters.zh: 瓦尼雅、米利末、以利亚实、

chapters.en: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasu.
chapters.zh: 玛他尼、玛特乃、雅扫、

chapters.en:
From the descendants of Binnui:
Shimei,
chapters.zh: 巴尼、宾内、示每、

chapters.en: Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,
chapters.zh: 示利米雅、拿单、亚大雅、

chapters.en: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
chapters.zh: 玛拿底拜、沙赛、沙赖、

chapters.en: Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,
chapters.zh: 亚萨利、示利米雅、示玛利雅、

chapters.en: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.
chapters.zh: 沙龙、亚玛利雅、约瑟。

chapters.en:
And from the descendants of Nebo:
Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah.
chapters.zh: 尼波的子孙中，有耶利、玛他提雅、撒拔、西比拿、雅玳、约珥、比拿雅。

chapters.en: All these men had married foreign women, and some of them had children by these wives.
chapters.zh: 这些人都娶了外邦女子为妻，其中也有生了儿女的。

chapters.en:
These are the words of Nehemiah son of Hacaliah:
In the month of Chislev, in the twentieth year, while I was in the citadel of Susa,
chapters.zh: 哈迦利亚的儿子尼希米的言语如下： 亚达薛西王二十年基斯流月，我在书珊城的宫中。

chapters.en: Hanani, one of my brothers, arrived with men from Judah. So I questioned them about the remnant of the Jews who had survived the exile, and also about Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 那时，有我一个弟兄哈拿尼，同着几个人从犹大来。我问他们那些被掳归回、剩下逃脱的犹大人和耶路撒冷的光景。

chapters.en: And they told me, “The remnant who survived the exile are there in the province, in great trouble and disgrace. The wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and its gates have been burned with fire.”
chapters.zh: 他们对我说：「那些被掳归回剩下的人在犹大省遭大难，受凌辱；并且耶路撒冷的城墙拆毁，城门被火焚烧。」

chapters.en: When I heard these words, I sat down and wept. I mourned for days, fasting and praying before the God of heaven.
chapters.zh: 我听见这话，就坐下哭泣，悲哀几日，在天上的上帝面前禁食祈祷，说：

chapters.en:
Then I said:
“O LORD, God of heaven, the great and awesome God who keeps His covenant of loving devotion with those who love Him and keep His commandments,
chapters.zh: 「耶和华－天上的上帝，大而可畏的上帝啊，你向爱你、守你诫命的人守约施慈爱。

chapters.en:
let Your eyes be open and Your ears attentive to hear the prayer that I, Your servant, now pray before You day and night for Your servants, the Israelites.
I confess the sins that we Israelites have committed against You. Both I and my father’s house have sinned.
chapters.zh: 愿你睁眼看，侧耳听，你仆人昼夜在你面前为你众仆人以色列民的祈祷，承认我们以色列人向你所犯的罪；我与我父家都有罪了。

chapters.en: We have behaved corruptly against You and have not kept the commandments, statutes, and ordinances that You gave Your servant Moses.
chapters.zh: 我们向你所行的甚是邪恶，没有遵守你藉着仆人摩西所吩咐的诫命、律例、典章。

chapters.en: Remember, I pray, the word that You commanded Your servant Moses when You said, ‘If you are unfaithful, I will scatter you among the nations,
chapters.zh: 求你记念所吩咐你仆人摩西的话，说：『你们若犯罪，我就把你们分散在万民中；

chapters.en: but if you return to Me and keep and practice My commandments, then even if your exiles have been banished to the farthest horizon, I will gather them from there and bring them to the place I have chosen as a dwelling for My Name.’
chapters.zh: 但你们若归向我，谨守遵行我的诫命，你们被赶散的人虽在天涯，我也必从那里将他们招聚回来，带到我所选择立为我名的居所。』

chapters.en: They are Your servants and Your people. You redeemed them by Your great power and mighty hand.
chapters.zh: 这都是你的仆人、你的百姓，就是你用大力和大能的手所救赎的。

chapters.en:
O Lord, may Your ear be attentive to my prayer and to the prayers of Your servants who delight to revere Your name. Give Your servant success this day, I pray, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man.”
(At that time I was the cupbearer to the king.)
chapters.zh: 主啊，求你侧耳听你仆人的祈祷，和喜爱敬畏你名众仆人的祈祷，使你仆人现今亨通，在王面前蒙恩。」 我是作王酒政的。

chapters.en: Now in the month of Nisan, in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, when wine was set before him, I took the wine and gave it to the king. I had never been sad in his presence,
chapters.zh: 亚达薛西王二十年尼散月，在王面前摆酒，我拿起酒来奉给王。我素来在王面前没有愁容。

chapters.en:
so the king said to me, “Why is your face sad, though you are not ill? This could only be sadness of the heart.”
I was overwhelmed with fear
chapters.zh: 王对我说：「你既没有病，为什么面带愁容呢？这不是别的，必是你心中愁烦。」于是我甚惧怕。

chapters.en: and replied to the king, “May the king live forever! Why should I not be sad when the city where my fathers are buried lies in ruins, and its gates have been destroyed by fire?”
chapters.zh: 我对王说：「愿王万岁！我列祖坟墓所在的那城荒凉，城门被火焚烧，我岂能面无愁容吗？」

chapters.en:
“What is your request?” replied the king.
So I prayed to the God of heaven
chapters.zh: 王问我说：「你要求什么？」于是我〔默〕祷天上的上帝。

chapters.en: and answered the king, “If it pleases the king, and if your servant has found favor in your sight, I ask that you send me to Judah, to the city where my fathers are buried, so that I may rebuild it.”
chapters.zh: 我对王说：「仆人若在王眼前蒙恩，王若喜欢，求王差遣我往犹大，到我列祖坟墓所在的那城去，我好重新建造。」

chapters.en: Then the king, with the queen seated beside him, asked me, “How long will your journey take, and when will you return?” So it pleased the king to send me, and I set a time.
chapters.zh: 那时王后坐在王的旁边。王问我说：「你去要多少日子？几时回来？」我就定了日期。于是王喜欢差遣我去。

chapters.en: I also said to him, “If it pleases the king, may letters be given to me for the governors west of the Euphrates, so that they will grant me safe passage until I reach Judah.
chapters.zh: 我又对王说：「王若喜欢，求王赐我诏书，通知大河西的省长准我经过，直到犹大；

chapters.en:
And may I have a letter to Asaph, keeper of the king’s forest, so that he will give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel to the temple, for the city wall, and for the house I will occupy.”
And because the gracious hand of my God was upon me, the king granted my requests.
chapters.zh: 又赐诏书，通知管理王园林的亚萨，使他给我木料，做属殿营楼之门的横梁和城墙，与我自己房屋使用的。」王就允准我，因我上帝施恩的手帮助我。

chapters.en: Then I went to the governors west of the Euphrates and gave them the king’s letters. The king had also sent army officers and cavalry with me.
chapters.zh: 王派了军长和马兵护送我。我到了河西的省长那里，将王的诏书交给他们。

chapters.en: But when Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about this, they were deeply disturbed that someone had come to seek the well-being of the Israelites.
chapters.zh: 和伦人参巴拉，并为奴的亚扪人多比雅，听见有人来为以色列人求好处，就甚恼怒。

chapters.en: After I had arrived in Jerusalem and had been there three days,
chapters.zh: 我到了耶路撒冷，在那里住了三日。

chapters.en: I set out at night with a few men. I did not tell anyone what my God had laid on my heart to do for Jerusalem. The only animal with me was the one on which I was riding.
chapters.zh: 我夜间起来，有几个人也一同起来；但上帝使我心里要为耶路撒冷做什么事，我并没有告诉人。除了我骑的牲口以外，也没有别的牲口在我那里。

chapters.en: So I went out at night through the Valley Gate toward the Well of the Serpent and the Dung Gate, and I inspected the walls of Jerusalem that had been broken down and the gates that had been destroyed by fire.
chapters.zh: 当夜我出了谷门，往野狗井去〔注：野狗：或译龙〕，到了粪厂门，察看耶路撒冷的城墙，见城墙拆毁，城门被火焚烧。

chapters.en: Then I went on to the Fountain Gate and the King’s Pool, but there was no room for the animal under me to get through;
chapters.zh: 我又往前，到了泉门和王池，但所骑的牲口没有地方过去。

chapters.en: so I went up the valley by night and inspected the wall. Then I headed back and reentered through the Valley Gate.
chapters.zh: 于是夜间沿溪而上，察看城墙，又转身进入谷门，就回来了。

chapters.en: The officials did not know where I had gone or what I was doing, for I had not yet told the Jews or priests or nobles or officials or any other workers.
chapters.zh: 我往哪里去，我做什么事，官长都不知道。我还没有告诉犹大平民、祭司、贵胄、官长，和其余做工的人。

chapters.en: Then I said to them, “You see the trouble we are in. Jerusalem lies in ruins, and its gates have been burned down. Come, let us rebuild the wall of Jerusalem, so that we will no longer be a disgrace.”
chapters.zh: 以后，我对他们说：「我们所遭的难，耶路撒冷怎样荒凉，城门被火焚烧，你们都看见了。来吧，我们重建耶路撒冷的城墙，免得再受凌辱！」

chapters.en:
I also told them about the gracious hand of my God upon me, and what the king had said to me.
“Let us start rebuilding,” they replied, and they set their hands to this good work.
chapters.zh: 我告诉他们我上帝施恩的手怎样帮助我，并王对我所说的话。他们就说：「我们起来建造吧！」于是他们奋勇做这善工。

chapters.en: But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite official, and Geshem the Arab heard about this, they mocked us and ridiculed us, saying, “What is this you are doing? Are you rebelling against the king?”
chapters.zh: 但和伦人参巴拉，并为奴的亚扪人多比雅和阿拉伯人基善听见就嗤笑我们，藐视我们，说：「你们做什么呢？要背叛王吗？」

chapters.en: So I answered them and said, “The God of heaven is the One who will grant us success. We, His servants, will start rebuilding, but you have no portion, right, or claim in Jerusalem.”
chapters.zh: 我回答他们说：「天上的上帝必使我们亨通。我们作他仆人的，要起来建造；你们却在耶路撒冷无分、无权、无纪念。」

chapters.en: At the Sheep Gate, Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests began rebuilding. They dedicated it and installed its doors. After building as far as the Tower of the Hundred and the Tower of Hananel, they dedicated the wall.
chapters.zh: 那时，大祭司以利亚实和他的弟兄众祭司起来建立羊门，分别为圣，安立门扇，〔又筑城墙〕到哈米亚楼，直到哈楠业楼，分别为圣。

chapters.en: The men of Jericho built next to Eliashib, and Zaccur son of Imri built next to them.
chapters.zh: 其次是耶利哥人建造。其次是音利的儿子撒刻建造。

chapters.en: The Fish Gate was rebuilt by the sons of Hassenaah. They laid its beams and installed its doors, bolts, and bars.
chapters.zh: 哈西拿的子孙建立鱼门，架横梁、安门扇，和闩锁。

chapters.en: Next to them, Meremoth son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, made repairs. Next to him, Meshullam son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel, made repairs; and next to him, Zadok son of Baana made repairs as well.
chapters.zh: 其次是哈哥斯的孙子、乌利亚的儿子米利末修造。其次是米示萨别的孙子、比利迦的儿子米书兰修造。其次是巴拿的儿子撒督修造。

chapters.en: Next to him, the Tekoites made repairs, but their nobles did not put their shoulders to the work under their supervisors.
chapters.zh: 其次是提哥亚人修造；但是他们的贵胄不用肩〔注：原文是颈项〕担他们主的工作。

chapters.en: The Jeshanah Gate was repaired by Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah. They laid its beams and installed its doors, bolts, and bars.
chapters.zh: 巴西亚的儿子耶何耶大与比所玳的儿子米书兰修造古门，架横梁，安门扇和闩锁。

chapters.en: Next to them, repairs were made by Melatiah the Gibeonite, Jadon the Meronothite, and the men of Gibeon and Mizpah, who were under the authority of the governor of the region west of the Euphrates.
chapters.zh: 其次是基遍人米拉提，米伦人雅顿与基遍人，并属河西总督所管的米斯巴人修造。

chapters.en: Next to them, Uzziel son of Harhaiah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs. And next to him, Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made repairs. They fortified Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.
chapters.zh: 其次是银匠哈海雅的儿子乌薛修造。其次是做香的哈拿尼雅修造。这些人修坚耶路撒冷，直到宽墙。

chapters.en: Next to them, Rephaiah son of Hur, ruler of a half-district of Jerusalem, made repairs;
chapters.zh: 其次是管理耶路撒冷一半、户珥的儿子利法雅修造。

chapters.en: next to him, Jedaiah son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house; and next to him, Hattush son of Hashabneiah made repairs.
chapters.zh: 其次是哈路抹的儿子耶大雅对着自己的房屋修造。其次是哈沙尼的儿子哈突修造。

chapters.en: Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath-moab repaired another section, as well as the Tower of the Ovens.
chapters.zh: 哈琳的儿子玛基雅和巴赫‧摩押的儿子哈述修造一段，并修造炉楼。

chapters.en: And next to them, Shallum son of Hallohesh, ruler of the other half-district of Jerusalem, made repairs, with the help of his daughters.
chapters.zh: 其次是管理耶路撒冷那一半、哈罗黑的儿子沙龙和他的女儿们修造。

chapters.en: The Valley Gate was repaired by Hanun and the residents of Zanoah. They rebuilt it, installed its doors, bolts, and bars, and repaired a thousand cubits of the wall as far as the Dung Gate.
chapters.zh: 哈嫩和撒挪亚的居民修造谷门，立门，安门扇和闩锁，又建筑城墙一千肘，直到粪厂门。

chapters.en: The Dung Gate was repaired by Malchijah son of Rechab, ruler of the district of Beth-haccherem. He rebuilt it and installed its doors, bolts, and bars.
chapters.zh: 管理伯‧哈基琳、利甲的儿子玛基雅修造粪厂门，立门，安门扇和闩锁。

chapters.en: The Fountain Gate was repaired by Shallun son of Col-hozeh, ruler of the district of Mizpah. He rebuilt it, roofed it, and installed its doors, bolts, and bars. He also repaired the wall of the Pool of Shelah near the king’s garden, as far as the stairs that descend from the City of David.
chapters.zh: 管理米斯巴、各荷西的儿子沙崙修造泉门，立门，盖门顶，安门扇和闩锁，又修造靠近王园西罗亚池的墙垣，直到那从大卫城下来的台阶。

chapters.en: Beyond him, Nehemiah son of Azbuk, ruler of a half-district of Beth-zur, made repairs up to a point opposite the tombs of David, as far as the artificial pool and the House of the Mighty.
chapters.zh: 其次是管理伯‧夙一半、押卜的儿子尼希米修造，直到大卫坟地的对面，又到挖成的池子，并勇士的房屋。

chapters.en: Next to him, the Levites made repairs under Rehum son of Bani, and next to him, Hashabiah, ruler of a half-district of Keilah, made repairs for his district.
chapters.zh: 其次是利未人巴尼的儿子利宏修造。其次是管理基伊拉一半、哈沙比雅为他所管的本境修造。

chapters.en: Next to him, their countrymen made repairs under Binnui son of Henadad, ruler of the other half-district of Keilah.
chapters.zh: 其次是利未人弟兄中管理基伊拉那一半、希拿达的儿子巴瓦伊修造。

chapters.en: And next to him, Ezer son of Jeshua, ruler of Mizpah, repaired another section opposite the ascent to the armory, near the angle in the wall.
chapters.zh: 其次是管理米斯巴、耶书亚的儿子以谢修造一段，对着武库的上坡、〔城墙〕转弯之处。

chapters.en: Next to him, Baruch son of Zabbai diligently repaired another section, from the angle to the doorway of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
chapters.zh: 其次是萨拜的儿子巴录竭力修造一段，从〔城墙〕转弯，直到大祭司以利亚实的府门。

chapters.en: Next to him, Meremoth son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, repaired another section, from the doorway of the house of Eliashib to the end of the house.
chapters.zh: 其次是哈哥斯的孙子、乌利亚的儿子米利末修造一段，从以利亚实的府门，直到以利亚实府的尽头。

chapters.en: And next to him, the priests from the surrounding area made repairs.
chapters.zh: 其次是住平原的祭司修造。

chapters.en: Beyond them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs in front of their house, and next to them, Azariah son of Maaseiah, the son of Ananiah, made repairs beside his house.
chapters.zh: 其次是便雅悯与哈述对着自己的房屋修造。其次是亚难尼的孙子、玛西雅的儿子亚撒利雅在靠近自己的房屋修造。

chapters.en: After him, Binnui son of Henadad repaired another section, from the house of Azariah to the angle and the corner,
chapters.zh: 其次是希拿达的儿子宾内修造一段，从亚撒利雅的房屋直到〔城墙〕转弯，又到城角。

chapters.en: and Palal son of Uzai made repairs opposite the angle and the tower that juts out from the upper palace of the king near the courtyard of the guard. Next to him, Pedaiah son of Parosh
chapters.zh: 乌赛的儿子巴拉〔修造〕对着〔城墙〕的转弯和王上宫凸出来的城楼，靠近护卫院的那一段。其次是巴录的儿子毗大雅〔修造〕。

chapters.en: and the temple servants living on the hill of Ophel made repairs opposite the Water Gate toward the east and the tower that juts out.
chapters.zh: （尼提宁住在俄斐勒，直到朝东水门的对面和凸出来的城楼。）

chapters.en: And next to them, the Tekoites repaired another section, from a point opposite the great tower that juts out to the wall of Ophel.
chapters.zh: 其次是提哥亚人又修一段，对着那凸出来的大楼，直到俄斐勒的墙。

chapters.en: Above the Horse Gate, each of the priests made repairs in front of his own house.
chapters.zh: 从马门往上，众祭司各对自己的房屋修造。

chapters.en: Next to them, Zadok son of Immer made repairs opposite his house, and next to him, Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, the guard of the East Gate, made repairs.
chapters.zh: 其次是音麦的儿子撒督对着自己的房屋修造。其次是守东门、示迦尼的儿子示玛雅修造。

chapters.en: Next to him, Hananiah son of Shelemiah, as well as Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another section. Next to them, Meshullam son of Berechiah made repairs opposite his own quarters.
chapters.zh: 其次是示利米雅的儿子哈拿尼雅和萨拉的第六子哈嫩又修一段。其次是比利迦的儿子米书兰对着自己的房屋修造。

chapters.en: Next to him, Malchijah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs as far as the house of the temple servants and the merchants, opposite the Inspection Gate, and as far as the upper room above the corner.
chapters.zh: 其次是银匠玛基雅修造到尼提宁和商人的房屋，对着哈米弗甲门，直到城的角楼。

chapters.en: And between the upper room above the corner and the Sheep Gate, the goldsmiths and merchants made repairs.
chapters.zh: 银匠与商人在城的角楼和羊门中间修造。

chapters.en: Now when Sanballat heard that we were rebuilding the wall, he was furious and filled with indignation. He ridiculed the Jews
chapters.zh: 参巴拉听见我们修造城墙就发怒，大大恼恨，嗤笑犹大人，

chapters.en: before his associates and the army of Samaria, saying, “What are these feeble Jews doing? Can they restore the wall by themselves? Will they offer sacrifices? Will they complete it in a day? Can they bring these burnt stones back to life from the mounds of rubble?”
chapters.zh: 对他弟兄和撒马利亚的军兵说：「这些软弱的犹大人做什么呢？要保护自己吗？要献祭吗？要一日成功吗？要从土堆里拿出火烧的石头再立墙吗？」

chapters.en: Then Tobiah the Ammonite, who was beside him, said, “If even a fox were to climb up on what they are building, it would break down their wall of stones!”
chapters.zh: 亚扪人多比雅站在旁边，说：「他们所修造的石墙，就是狐狸上去也必跐倒。」

chapters.en: Hear us, O God, for we are despised. Turn their scorn back upon their own heads, and let them be taken as plunder to a land of captivity.
chapters.zh: 我们的上帝啊，求你垂听，因为我们被藐视。求你使他们的毁谤归于他们的头上，使他们在掳到之地作为掠物。

chapters.en: Do not cover up their iniquity or let their sin be blotted out from Your sight, for they have provoked the builders.
chapters.zh: 不要遮掩他们的罪孽，不要使他们的罪恶从你面前涂抹，因为他们在修造的人眼前惹动你的怒气。

chapters.en: So we rebuilt the wall until all of it was joined together up to half its height, for the people had a mind to work.
chapters.zh: 这样，我们修造城墙，城墙就都连络，高至一半，因为百姓专心做工。

chapters.en: When Sanballat and Tobiah, together with the Arabs, Ammonites, and Ashdodites, heard that the repair to the walls of Jerusalem was progressing and that the gaps were being closed, they were furious,
chapters.zh: 参巴拉、多比雅、阿拉伯人、亚扪人、亚实突人听见修造耶路撒冷城墙，着手进行堵塞破裂的地方，就甚发怒。

chapters.en: and all of them conspired to come and fight against Jerusalem and create a hindrance.
chapters.zh: 大家同谋要来攻击耶路撒冷，使城内扰乱。

chapters.en: So we prayed to our God and posted a guard against them day and night.
chapters.zh: 然而，我们祷告我们的上帝，又因他们的缘故，就派人看守，昼夜防备。

chapters.en:
Meanwhile, the people of Judah said:
“The strength of the laborer fails, and there is so much rubble that we will never be able to rebuild the wall.”
chapters.zh: 犹大人说：「灰土尚多，扛抬的人力气已经衰败，所以我们不能建造城墙。」

chapters.en: And our enemies said, “Before they know or see a thing, we will come into their midst, kill them, and put an end to the work.”
chapters.zh: 我们的敌人且说：「趁他们不知不见，我们进入他们中间，杀他们，使工作止住。」

chapters.en: At that time the Jews who lived nearby came and told us ten times over, “Wherever you turn, they will attack us.”
chapters.zh: 那靠近敌人居住的犹大人十次从各处来见我们，说：「你们必要回到我们那里。」

chapters.en: So I stationed men behind the lowest sections of the wall, at the vulnerable areas. I stationed them by families with their swords, spears, and bows.
chapters.zh: 所以我使百姓各按宗族拿刀、拿枪、拿弓站在城墙后边低洼的空处。

chapters.en: After I had made an inspection, I stood up and said to the nobles, the officials, and the rest of the people, “Do not be afraid of them. Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons and your daughters, your wives and your homes.”
chapters.zh: 我察看了，就起来对贵胄、官长，和其余的人说：「不要怕他们！当记念主是大而可畏的。你们要为弟兄、儿女、妻子、家产争战。」

chapters.en: When our enemies heard that we were aware of their scheme and that God had frustrated it, each of us returned to his own work on the wall.
chapters.zh: 仇敌听见我们知道他们的心意，见上帝也破坏他们的计谋，〔就不来了〕。我们都回到城墙那里，各做各的工。

chapters.en:
And from that day on, half of my servants did the work while the other half held spears, shields, bows, and armor.
The officers stationed themselves behind all the people of Judah
chapters.zh: 从那日起，我的仆人一半做工，一半拿枪、拿盾牌、拿弓、穿〔注：或译：拿〕铠甲，官长都站在犹大众人的后边。

chapters.en: who were rebuilding the wall. The laborers who carried materials worked with one hand and held a weapon with the other.
chapters.zh: 修造城墙的，扛抬材料的，都一手做工一手拿兵器。

chapters.en: And each of the builders worked with his sword strapped at his side. But the trumpeter stayed beside me.
chapters.zh: 修造的人都腰间佩刀修造，吹角的人在我旁边。

chapters.en: Then I said to the nobles, the officials, and the rest of the people: “The work is great and extensive, and we are spread out far from one another along the wall.
chapters.zh: 我对贵胄、官长，和其余的人说：「这工程浩大，我们在城墙上相离甚远；

chapters.en: Wherever you hear the sound of the horn, rally to us there. Our God will fight for us!”
chapters.zh: 你们听见角声在哪里，就聚集到我们那里去。我们的上帝必为我们争战。」

chapters.en: So we continued the work, while half of the men held spears from the break of dawn until the stars came out.
chapters.zh: 于是，我们做工，一半拿兵器，从天亮直到星宿出现的时候。

chapters.en: At that time I also said to the people, “Let every man and his servant spend the night inside Jerusalem, so that they can stand guard by night and work by day.”
chapters.zh: 那时，我又对百姓说：「各人和他的仆人当在耶路撒冷住宿，好在夜间保守我们，白昼做工。」

chapters.en: So neither I nor my brothers nor my servants nor the guards with me changed out of our clothes; each carried his weapon, even to go for water.
chapters.zh: 这样，我和弟兄仆人，并跟从我的护兵都不脱衣服，出去打水也带兵器。

chapters.en: About that time there was a great outcry from the people and their wives against their fellow Jews.
chapters.zh: 百姓和他们的妻大大呼号，埋怨他们的弟兄犹大人。

chapters.en: Some were saying, “We and our sons and daughters are numerous. We must get grain in order to eat and stay alive.”
chapters.zh: 有的说：「我们和儿女人口众多，要去得粮食度命」；

chapters.en: Others were saying, “We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our homes to get grain during the famine.”
chapters.zh: 有的说：「我们典了田地、葡萄园、房屋，要得粮食充饥」；

chapters.en: Still others were saying, “We have borrowed money to pay the king’s tax on our fields and vineyards.
chapters.zh: 有的说：「我们已经指着田地、葡萄园，借了钱给王纳税。

chapters.en: We and our children are just like our countrymen and their children, yet we are subjecting our sons and daughters to slavery. Some of our daughters are already enslaved, but we are powerless to redeem them because our fields and vineyards belong to others.”
chapters.zh: 我们的身体与我们弟兄的身体一样；我们的儿女与他们的儿女一般。现在我们将要使儿女作人的仆婢，我们的女儿已有为婢的；我们并无力拯救，因为我们的田地、葡萄园已经归了别人。」

chapters.en: When I heard their outcry and these complaints, I became extremely angry,
chapters.zh: 我听见他们呼号说这些话，便甚发怒。

chapters.en:
and after serious thought I rebuked the nobles and officials, saying, “You are exacting usury from your own brothers!”
So I called a large assembly against them
chapters.zh: 我心里筹划，就斥责贵胄和官长说：「你们各人向弟兄取利！」于是我招聚大会攻击他们。

chapters.en:
and said, “We have done our best to buy back our Jewish brothers who were sold to foreigners, but now you are selling your own brothers, that they may be sold back to us!”
But they remained silent, for they could find nothing to say.
chapters.zh: 我对他们说：「我们尽力赎回我们弟兄，就是卖与外邦的犹大人；你们还要卖弟兄，使我们赎回来吗？」他们就静默不语，无话可答。

chapters.en: So I continued, “What you are doing is not right. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God to avoid the reproach of our foreign enemies?
chapters.zh: 我又说：「你们所行的不善！你们行事不当敬畏我们的上帝吗？不然，难免我们的仇敌外邦人毁谤我们。

chapters.en: I, as well as my brothers and my servants, have been lending the people money and grain. Please, let us stop this usury.
chapters.zh: 我和我的弟兄与仆人也将银钱粮食借给百姓；我们大家都当免去利息。

chapters.en: Please restore to them immediately their fields, vineyards, olive groves, and houses, along with the percentage of the money, grain, new wine, and oil that you have been assessing them.”
chapters.zh: 如今我劝你们将他们的田地、葡萄园、橄榄园、房屋，并向他们所取的银钱、粮食、新酒，和油，百分之一的利息都归还他们。」

chapters.en:
“We will restore it,” they replied, “and will require nothing more from them. We will do as you say.”
So I summoned the priests and required of the nobles and officials an oath that they would do what they had promised.
chapters.zh: 众人说：「我们必归还，不再向他们索要，必照你的话行。」我就召了祭司来，叫众人起誓，必照着所应许的而行。

chapters.en:
I also shook out the folds of my robe and said, “May God likewise shake out of his house and possessions every man who does not keep this promise. May such a man be shaken out and have nothing!”
The whole assembly said, “Amen,” and they praised the LORD. And the people did as they had promised.
chapters.zh: 我也抖着胸前的衣襟，说：「凡不成就这应许的，愿上帝照样抖他离开家产和他劳碌得来的，直到抖空了。」会众都说：「阿们！」又赞美耶和华。百姓就照着所应许的去行。

chapters.en: Furthermore, from the day King Artaxerxes appointed me to be their governor in the land of Judah, from his twentieth year until his thirty-second year (twelve years total), neither I nor my brothers ate the food allotted to the governor.
chapters.zh: 自从我奉派作犹大地的省长，就是从亚达薛西王二十年直到三十二年，共十二年之久，我与我弟兄都没有吃省长的俸禄。

chapters.en: The governors before me had heavily burdened the people, taking from them bread and wine plus forty shekels of silver. Their servants also oppressed the people. But I did not do this, because of my fear of God.
chapters.zh: 在我以前的省长加重百姓的担子，〔每日〕索要粮食和酒，并银子四十舍客勒，就是他们的仆人也辖制百姓；但我因敬畏上帝不这样行。

chapters.en: Instead, I devoted myself to the construction of the wall, and all my servants were gathered there for the work; we did not acquire any land.
chapters.zh: 并且我恒心修造城墙，并没有置买田地；我的仆人也都聚集在那里做工。

chapters.en: There were 150 Jews and officials at my table, besides the guests from the surrounding nations.
chapters.zh: 除了从四围外邦中来的犹大人以外，有犹大平民和官长一百五十人在我席上吃饭。

chapters.en: Each day one ox, six choice sheep, and some fowl were prepared for me, and once every ten days an abundance of all kinds of wine was provided. But I did not demand the food allotted to the governor, because the burden on the people was so heavy.
chapters.zh: 每日预备一只公牛，六只肥羊，又预备些飞禽；每十日一次，多预备各样的酒。虽然如此，我并不要省长的俸禄，因为百姓服役甚重。

chapters.en: Remember me favorably, O my God, for all that I have done for this people.
chapters.zh: 我的上帝啊，求你记念我为这百姓所行的一切事，施恩与我。

chapters.en: When Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arab, and the rest of our enemies heard that I had rebuilt the wall and not a gap was left—though to that time I had not yet installed the doors in the gates—
chapters.zh: 参巴拉、多比雅、阿拉伯人基善和我们其余的仇敌听见我已经修完了城墙，其中没有破裂之处（那时我还没有安门扇）的，

chapters.en:
Sanballat and Geshem sent me this message: “Come, let us meet together in one of the villages on the plain of Ono.”
But they were planning to harm me.
chapters.zh: 参巴拉和基善就打发人来见我，说：「请你来，我们在阿挪平原的一个村庄相会。」他们却想害我。

chapters.en: So I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work and cannot come down. Why should the work stop while I leave it to go down to you?”
chapters.zh: 于是我差遣人去见他们，说：「我现在办理大工，不能下去。焉能停工下去见你们呢？」

chapters.en: Four times they sent me the same message, and each time I gave the same reply.
chapters.zh: 他们这样四次打发人来见我，我都如此回答他们。

chapters.en: The fifth time, Sanballat sent me this same message by his young servant, who had in his hand an unsealed letter
chapters.zh: 参巴拉第五次打发仆人来见我，手里拿着未封的信，

chapters.en:
that read:
“It is reported among the nations—and Geshem agrees—that you and the Jews are plotting to revolt, and this is why you are building the wall. According to these reports, you are to become their king,
chapters.zh: 信上写着说：「外邦人中有风声，迦施慕〔注：就是基善，见二章十九节〕也说，你和犹大人谋反，修造城墙，你要作他们的王；

chapters.en: and you have even appointed prophets in Jerusalem to proclaim on your behalf: ‘There is a king in Judah.’ Soon these rumors will reach the ears of the king. So come, let us confer together.”
chapters.zh: 你又派先知在耶路撒冷指着你宣讲，说在犹大有王。现在这话必传与王知；所以请你来，与我们彼此商议。」

chapters.en: Then I sent him this reply: “There is nothing to these rumors you are spreading; you are inventing them in your own mind.”
chapters.zh: 我就差遣人去见他，说：「你所说的这事，一概没有，是你心里捏造的。」

chapters.en:
For they were all trying to frighten us, saying, “Their hands will be weakened in the work, and it will never be finished.”
But now, my God, strengthen my hands.
chapters.zh: 他们都要使我们惧怕，意思说，他们的手必软弱，以致工作不能成就。〔上帝啊〕，求你坚固我的手。

chapters.en:
Later, I went to the house of Shemaiah son of Delaiah, the son of Mehetabel, who was confined to his house. He said:
“Let us meet at the house of God inside the temple. Let us shut the temple doors because they are coming to kill you—
by night they are coming to kill you!”
chapters.zh: 我到了米希大别的孙子、第来雅的儿子示玛雅家里；那时，他闭门不出。他说：「我们不如在上帝的殿里会面，将殿门关锁；因为他们要来杀你，就是夜里来杀你。」

chapters.en: But I replied, “Should a man like me run away? Should one like me go into the temple to save his own life? I will not go!”
chapters.zh: 我说：「像我这样的人岂要逃跑呢？像我这样的人岂能进入殿里保全生命呢？我不进去！」

chapters.en: I realized that God had not sent him, but that he had uttered this prophecy against me because Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
chapters.zh: 我看明上帝没有差遣他，是他自己说这话攻击我，是多比雅和参巴拉贿买了他。

chapters.en: He had been hired to intimidate me so that I would sin by doing as he suggested, so they could give me a bad name in order to discredit me.
chapters.zh: 贿买他的缘故，是要叫我惧怕，依从他犯罪，他们好传扬恶言毁谤我。

chapters.en: O my God, remember Tobiah and Sanballat for what they have done, and also Noadiah the prophetess and the other prophets who tried to intimidate me.
chapters.zh: 我的上帝啊，多比雅、参巴拉、女先知挪亚底，和其余的先知要叫我惧怕，求你记念他们所行的这些事。

chapters.en: So the wall was completed in fifty-two days, on the twenty-fifth of Elul.
chapters.zh: 以禄〔月〕二十五〔日〕，城墙修完了，共修了五十二天。

chapters.en: When all our enemies heard about this, all the surrounding nations were afraid and disheartened, for they realized that this task had been accomplished by our God.
chapters.zh: 我们一切仇敌、四围的外邦人听见了便惧怕，愁眉不展；因为见这工作完成是出乎我们的上帝。

chapters.en: Also in those days, the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah’s letters kept coming to them.
chapters.zh: 在那些日子，犹大的贵胄屡次寄信与多比雅，多比雅也来〔信〕与他们。

chapters.en: For many in Judah were bound by oath to him, since he was a son-in-law of Shecaniah son of Arah, and his son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah.
chapters.zh: 在犹大有许多人与多比雅结盟；因他是亚拉的儿子，示迦尼的女婿，并且他的儿子约哈难娶了比利迦儿子米书兰的女儿为妻。

chapters.en: Moreover, these nobles kept reporting to me Tobiah’s good deeds, and they relayed my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to intimidate me.
chapters.zh: 他们常在我面前说多比雅的善行，也将我的话传与他。多比雅又常寄信来，要叫我惧怕。

chapters.en: When the wall had been rebuilt and I had set the doors in place, the gatekeepers, singers, and Levites were appointed.
chapters.zh: 城墙修完，我安了门扇，守门的、歌唱的，和利未人都已派定。

chapters.en: Then I put my brother Hanani in charge of Jerusalem, along with Hananiah the commander of the fortress, because he was a faithful man who feared God more than most.
chapters.zh: 我就派我的弟兄哈拿尼和营楼的宰官哈拿尼雅管理耶路撒冷；因为哈拿尼雅是忠信的，又敬畏上帝过于众人。

chapters.en: And I told them, “Do not open the gates of Jerusalem until the sun is hot. While the guards are on duty, keep the doors shut and securely fastened. And appoint the residents of Jerusalem as guards, some at their posts and some at their own homes.”
chapters.zh: 我吩咐他们说：「等到太阳上升才可开耶路撒冷的城门；人尚看守的时候就要关门上闩；也当派耶路撒冷的居民各按班次看守自己房屋对面之处。」

chapters.en: Now the city was large and spacious, but there were few people in it, and the houses had not yet been rebuilt.
chapters.zh: 城是广大，其中的民却稀少，房屋还没有建造。

chapters.en: Then my God put it into my heart to assemble the nobles, the officials, and the people to be enrolled by genealogy. I found the genealogical register of those who had first returned, and I found the following written in it:
chapters.zh: 我的上帝感动我心，招聚贵胄、官长，和百姓，要照家谱计算。我找着第一次上来之人的家谱，其上写着：

chapters.en: These are the people of the province who came up from the captivity of the exiles carried away to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar its king. They returned to Jerusalem and Judah, each to his own town,
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒从前掳去犹大省的人，现在他们的子孙从被掳到之地回耶路撒冷和犹大，各归本城。

chapters.en:
accompanied by Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah.
This is the count of the men of Israel:
chapters.zh: 他们是同着所罗巴伯、耶书亚、尼希米、亚撒利雅、拉米、拿哈玛尼、末底改、必珊、米斯毗列、比革瓦伊、尼宏、巴拿回来的。

chapters.en: the descendants of Parosh, 2,172;
chapters.zh: 以色列人民的数目记在下面：巴录的子孙二千一百七十二名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Shephatiah, 372;
chapters.zh: 示法提雅的子孙三百七十二名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Arah, 652;
chapters.zh: 亚拉的子孙六百五十二名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Pahath-moab (through the line of Jeshua and Joab), 2,818;
chapters.zh: 巴赫‧摩押的后裔，就是耶书亚和约押的子孙二千八百一十八名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Elam, 1,254;
chapters.zh: 以拦的子孙一千二百五十四名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Zattu, 845;
chapters.zh: 萨土的子孙八百四十五名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Zaccai, 760;
chapters.zh: 萨改的子孙七百六十名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Binnui, 648;
chapters.zh: 宾内的子孙六百四十八名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Bebai, 628;
chapters.zh: 比拜的子孙六百二十八名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Azgad, 2,322;
chapters.zh: 押甲的子孙二千三百二十二名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Adonikam, 667;
chapters.zh: 亚多尼干的子孙六百六十七名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Bigvai, 2,067;
chapters.zh: 比革瓦伊的子孙二千零六十七名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Adin, 655;
chapters.zh: 亚丁的子孙六百五十五名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Ater (through Hezekiah), 98;
chapters.zh: 亚特的后裔，就是希西家的子孙九十八名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Hashum, 328;
chapters.zh: 哈顺的子孙三百二十八名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Bezai, 324;
chapters.zh: 比赛的子孙三百二十四名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Hariph, 112;
chapters.zh: 哈拉的子孙一百一十二名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Gibeon, 95;
chapters.zh: 基遍人九十五名；

chapters.en: the men of Bethlehem and Netophah, 188;
chapters.zh: 伯利恒人和尼陀法人共一百八十八名；

chapters.en: the men of Anathoth, 128;
chapters.zh: 亚拿突人一百二十八名；

chapters.en: the men of Beth-azmaveth, 42;
chapters.zh: 伯‧亚斯玛弗人四十二名；

chapters.en: the men of Kiriath-jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, 743;
chapters.zh: 基列‧耶琳人、基非拉人、比录人共七百四十三名；

chapters.en: the men of Ramah and Geba, 621;
chapters.zh: 拉玛人和迦巴人共六百二十一名；

chapters.en: the men of Michmash, 122;
chapters.zh: 默玛人一百二十二名；

chapters.en: the men of Bethel and Ai, 123;
chapters.zh: 伯特利人和艾人共一百二十三名；

chapters.en: the men of the other Nebo, 52;
chapters.zh: 别的尼波人五十二名；

chapters.en: the descendants of the other Elam, 1,254;
chapters.zh: 别的以拦子孙一千二百五十四名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Harim, 320;
chapters.zh: 哈琳的子孙三百二十名；

chapters.en: the men of Jericho, 345;
chapters.zh: 耶利哥人三百四十五名；

chapters.en: the men of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, 721;
chapters.zh: 罗德人、哈第人、阿挪人共七百二十一名；

chapters.en: and the descendants of Senaah, 3,930.
chapters.zh: 西拿人三千九百三十名。

chapters.en:
The priests:
the descendants of Jedaiah (through the house of Jeshua), 973;
chapters.zh: 祭司：耶书亚家，耶大雅的子孙九百七十三名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Immer, 1,052;
chapters.zh: 音麦的子孙一千零五十二名；

chapters.en: the descendants of Pashhur, 1,247;
chapters.zh: 巴施户珥的子孙一千二百四十七名；

chapters.en: and the descendants of Harim, 1,017.
chapters.zh: 哈琳的子孙一千零一十七名。

chapters.en:
The Levites:
the descendants of Jeshua (through Kadmiel, through the line of Hodevah ), 74.
chapters.zh: 利未人：何达威的后裔，就是耶书亚和甲篾的子孙七十四名。

chapters.en:
The singers:
the descendants of Asaph, 148.
chapters.zh: 歌唱的：亚萨的子孙一百四十八名。

chapters.en:
The gatekeepers:
the descendants of Shallum,
the descendants of Ater,
the descendants of Talmon,
the descendants of Akkub,
the descendants of Hatita,
and the descendants of Shobai,
138 in all.
chapters.zh: 守门的：沙龙的子孙、亚特的子孙、达们的子孙、亚谷的子孙、哈底大的子孙、朔拜的子孙，共一百三十八名。

chapters.en:
The temple servants:
the descendants of Ziha,
the descendants of Hasupha,
the descendants of Tabbaoth,
chapters.zh: 尼提宁〔注：就是殿役〕：西哈的子孙、哈苏巴的子孙、答巴俄的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Keros,
the descendants of Sia,
the descendants of Padon,
chapters.zh: 基绿的子孙、西亚的子孙、巴顿的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Lebanah,
the descendants of Hagabah,
the descendants of Shalmai,
chapters.zh: 利巴拿的子孙、哈迦巴的子孙、萨买的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Hanan,
the descendants of Giddel,
the descendants of Gahar,
chapters.zh: 哈难的子孙、吉德的子孙、迦哈的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Reaiah,
the descendants of Rezin,
the descendants of Nekoda,
chapters.zh: 利亚雅的子孙、利汛的子孙、尼哥大的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Gazzam,
the descendants of Uzza,
the descendants of Paseah,
chapters.zh: 迦散的子孙、乌撒的子孙、巴西亚的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Besai,
the descendants of Meunim,
the descendants of Nephushesim,
chapters.zh: 比赛的子孙、米乌宁的子孙、尼普心的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Bakbuk,
the descendants of Hakupha,
the descendants of Harhur,
chapters.zh: 巴卜的子孙、哈古巴的子孙、哈忽的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Bazlith,
the descendants of Mehida,
the descendants of Harsha,
chapters.zh: 巴洗律的子孙、米希大的子孙、哈沙的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Barkos,
the descendants of Sisera,
the descendants of Temah,
chapters.zh: 巴柯的子孙、西西拉的子孙、答玛的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Neziah,
and the descendants of Hatipha.
chapters.zh: 尼细亚的子孙、哈提法的子孙。

chapters.en:
The descendants of the servants of Solomon:
the descendants of Sotai,
the descendants of Sophereth,
the descendants of Perida,
chapters.zh: 所罗门仆人的后裔，就是琐太的子孙、琐斐列的子孙、比路大的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Jaala,
the descendants of Darkon,
the descendants of Giddel,
chapters.zh: 雅拉的子孙、达昆的子孙、吉德的子孙、

chapters.en:
the descendants of Shephatiah,
the descendants of Hattil,
the descendants of Pochereth-hazzebaim,
and the descendants of Amon.
chapters.zh: 示法提雅的子孙、哈替的子孙、玻黑列‧哈斯巴音的子孙、亚们的子孙。

chapters.en: The temple servants and descendants of the servants of Solomon numbered 392 in all.
chapters.zh: 尼提宁和所罗门仆人的后裔共三百九十二名。

chapters.en: The following came up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer, but they could not prove that their families were descended from Israel:
chapters.zh: 从特米拉、特哈萨、基绿、亚顿、音麦上来的，不能指明他们的宗族谱系是以色列人不是；

chapters.en:
the descendants of Delaiah,
the descendants of Tobiah,
and the descendants of Nekoda,
642 in all.
chapters.zh: 他们是第莱雅的子孙、多比雅的子孙、尼哥大的子孙，共六百四十二名。

chapters.en:
And from among the priests: the descendants of Hobaiah,
the descendants of Hakkoz,
and the descendants of Barzillai (who had married a daughter of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by their name).
chapters.zh: 祭司中，哈巴雅的子孙、哈哥斯的子孙、巴西莱的子孙；因为他们的先祖娶了基列人巴西莱的女儿为妻，所以起名叫巴西莱。

chapters.en: These men searched for their family records, but they could not find them and so were excluded from the priesthood as unclean.
chapters.zh: 这三家的人在族谱之中寻查自己的谱系，却寻不着，因此算为不洁，不准供祭司的职任。

chapters.en: The governor ordered them not to eat the most holy things until there was a priest to consult the Urim and Thummim.
chapters.zh: 省长对他们说：「不可吃至圣的物，直到有用乌陵和土明决疑的祭司兴起来。」

chapters.en: The whole assembly numbered 42,360,
chapters.zh: 会众共有四万二千三百六十名。

chapters.en: in addition to their 7,337 menservants and maidservants, as well as their 245 male and female singers.
chapters.zh: 此外，还有他们的仆婢七千三百三十七名，又有歌唱的男女二百四十五名。

chapters.en: They had 736 horses, 245 mules,
chapters.zh: 他们有马七百三十六匹，骡子二百四十五匹，

chapters.en: 435 camels, and 6,720 donkeys.
chapters.zh: 骆驼四百三十五只，驴六千七百二十匹。

chapters.en: Some of the heads of the families contributed to the project. The governor gave to the treasury 1,000 darics of gold, 50 bowls, and 530 priestly garments.
chapters.zh: 有些族长为工程捐助。省长捐入库中的金子一千达利克，碗五十个，祭司的礼服五百三十件。

chapters.en: And some of the heads of the families gave to the treasury for the project 20,000 darics of gold and 2,200 minas of silver.
chapters.zh: 又有族长捐入工程库的金子二万达利克，银子二千二百弥拿。

chapters.en: The rest of the people gave a total of 20,000 darics of gold, 2,000 minas of silver, and 67 priestly garments.
chapters.zh: 其余百姓所捐的金子二万达利克，银子二千弥拿，祭司的礼服六十七件。

chapters.en: So the priests, Levites, gatekeepers, singers, and temple servants, along with some of the people and the rest of the Israelites, settled in their own towns. And by the seventh month the Israelites had settled in their towns.
chapters.zh: 于是祭司、利未人、守门的、歌唱的、民中的一些人、尼提宁，并以色列众人，各住在自己的城里。

chapters.en: At that time all the people gathered together in the square before the Water Gate, and they asked Ezra the scribe to bring out the Book of the Law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded for Israel.
chapters.zh: 到了七月，以色列人住在自己的城里。那时，他们如同一人聚集在水门前的宽阔处，请文士以斯拉将耶和华藉摩西传给以色列人的律法书带来。

chapters.en: On the first day of the seventh month, Ezra the priest brought the Law before the assembly of men and women and all who could listen and understand.
chapters.zh: 七月初一日，祭司以斯拉将律法书带到听了能明白的男女会众面前。

chapters.en:
So Ezra read it aloud from daybreak until noon as he faced the square before the Water Gate, in front of the men and women and those who could understand.
And all the people listened attentively to the Book of the Law.
chapters.zh: 在水门前的宽阔处，从清早到晌午，在众男女、一切听了能明白的人面前读这律法书。众民侧耳而听。

chapters.en: Ezra the scribe stood on a high wooden platform built for this occasion. At his right side stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, and at his left were Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hash-baddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
chapters.zh: 文士以斯拉站在为这事特备的木台上。玛他提雅、示玛、亚奈雅、乌利亚、希勒家，和玛西雅站在他的右边；毗大雅、米沙利、玛基雅、哈顺、哈拔大拿、撒迦利亚，和米书兰站在他的左边。

chapters.en: Ezra opened the book in full view of all the people, since he was standing above them all, and as he opened it, all the people stood up.
chapters.zh: 以斯拉站在众民以上，在众民眼前展开这书。他一展开，众民就都站起来。

chapters.en: Then Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God, and with their hands uplifted, all the people said, “Amen, Amen!” Then they bowed down and worshiped the LORD with their faces to the ground.
chapters.zh: 以斯拉称颂耶和华至大的上帝；众民都举手应声说：「阿们！阿们！」就低头，面伏于地，敬拜耶和华。

chapters.en: The Levites—Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, and Pelaiah—instructed the people in the Law as they stood in their places.
chapters.zh: 耶书亚、巴尼、示利比、雅悯、亚谷、沙比太、荷第雅、玛西雅、基利他、亚撒利雅、约撒拔、哈难、毗莱雅，和利未人使百姓明白律法；百姓都〔站〕在自己的地方。

chapters.en: So they read from the Book of the Law of God, explaining it and giving insight, so that the people could understand what was being read.
chapters.zh: 他们清清楚楚地念上帝的律法书，讲明意思，使百姓明白所念的。

chapters.en:
Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who were instructing the people said to all of them, “This day is holy to the LORD your God. Do not mourn or weep.”
For all the people were weeping as they heard the words of the Law.
chapters.zh: 省长尼希米和作祭司的文士以斯拉，并教训百姓的利未人，对众民说：「今日是耶和华－你们上帝的圣日，不要悲哀哭泣。」〔这是〕因为众民听见律法书上的话都哭了；

chapters.en: Then Nehemiah told them, “Go and eat what is rich, drink what is sweet, and send out portions to those who have nothing prepared, since today is holy to our Lord. Do not grieve, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.”
chapters.zh: 又对他们说：「你们去吃肥美的，喝甘甜的，有不能预备的就分给他，因为今日是我们主的圣日。你们不要忧愁，因靠耶和华而得的喜乐是你们的力量。」

chapters.en: And the Levites calmed all the people, saying, “Be still, since today is holy. Do not grieve.”
chapters.zh: 于是利未人使众民静默，说：「今日是圣日；不要作声，也不要忧愁。」

chapters.en: Then all the people began to eat and drink, to send out portions, and to rejoice greatly, because they understood the words that had been made known to them.
chapters.zh: 众民都去吃喝，也分给人，大大快乐，因为他们明白所教训他们的话。

chapters.en: On the second day of the month, the heads of all the families, along with the priests and Levites, gathered around Ezra the scribe to study the words of the Law.
chapters.zh: 次日，众民的族长、祭司，和利未人都聚集到文士以斯拉那里，要留心听律法上的话。

chapters.en: And they found written in the Law, which the LORD had commanded through Moses, that the Israelites were to dwell in booths during the feast of the seventh month,
chapters.zh: 他们见律法上写着，耶和华藉摩西吩咐以色列人要在七月节住棚，

chapters.en: and that they should proclaim this message and spread it throughout their towns and in Jerusalem, saying, “Go out to the hill country and bring back branches of olive, wild olive, myrtle, palm, and other leafy trees, to make booths, as it is written.”
chapters.zh: 并要在各城和耶路撒冷宣传报告说：「你们当上山，将橄榄树、野橄榄树、番石榴树、棕树，和各样茂密树的枝子取来，照着所写的搭棚。」

chapters.en: And the people went out, brought back branches, and made booths on their own rooftops, in their courtyards, in the courts of the house of God, and in the squares by the Water Gate and by the Gate of Ephraim.
chapters.zh: 于是百姓出去，取了树枝来，各人在自己的房顶上，或院内，或上帝殿的院内，或水门的宽阔处，或以法莲门的宽阔处搭棚。

chapters.en: The whole assembly that had returned from exile made booths and lived in them. From the days of Joshua son of Nun until that day, the Israelites had not celebrated like this. And there was great rejoicing.
chapters.zh: 从掳到之地归回的全会众就搭棚，住在棚里。从嫩的儿子约书亚的时候直到这日，以色列人没有这样行。于是众人大大喜乐。

chapters.en: Day after day, from the first day to the last, Ezra read from the Book of the Law of God. The Israelites kept the feast for seven days, and on the eighth day they held an assembly, according to the ordinance.
chapters.zh: 从头一天直到末一天，以斯拉每日念上帝的律法书。众人守节七日，第八日照例有严肃会。

chapters.en: On the twenty-fourth day of the same month, the Israelites gathered together, fasting and wearing sackcloth, with dust on their heads.
chapters.zh: 这月二十四日，以色列人聚集禁食，身穿麻衣，头蒙灰尘。

chapters.en: Those of Israelite descent separated themselves from all the foreigners, and they stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their fathers.
chapters.zh: 以色列人〔注：人：原文是种类〕就与一切外邦人离绝，站着承认自己的罪恶和列祖的罪孽。

chapters.en: While they stood in their places, they read from the Book of the Law of the LORD their God for a quarter of the day, and they spent another quarter of the day in confession and worship of the LORD their God.
chapters.zh: 那日的四分之一站在自己的地方念耶和华－他们上帝的律法书，又四分之一认罪，敬拜耶和华－他们的上帝。

chapters.en: And the Levites—Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani—stood on the raised platform and cried out in a loud voice to the LORD their God.
chapters.zh: 耶书亚、巴尼、甲篾、示巴尼、布尼、示利比、巴尼、基拿尼站在利未人的台上，大声哀求耶和华－他们的上帝。

chapters.en:
Then the Levites—Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah—said, “Stand up and bless the LORD your God from everlasting to everlasting:
Blessed be Your glorious name, and may it be exalted
above all blessing and praise.
chapters.zh: 利未人耶书亚、甲篾、巴尼、哈沙尼、示利比、荷第雅、示巴尼、毗他希雅说：「你们要站起来称颂耶和华－你们的上帝，永世无尽。耶和华啊，你荣耀之名是应当称颂的！超乎一切称颂和赞美。」

chapters.en:
You alone are the LORD. You created the heavens, the highest heavens with all their host, the earth and all that is on it,
the seas and all that is in them. You give life to all things, and the host of heaven worships You.
chapters.zh: 「你，惟独你是耶和华！你造了天和天上的天，并天上的万象，地和地上的万物，海和海中所有的；这一切都是你所保存的。天军也都敬拜你。

chapters.en: You are the LORD, the God who chose Abram, who brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans and gave him the name Abraham.
chapters.zh: 你是耶和华上帝，曾拣选亚伯兰，领他出迦勒底的吾珥，给他改名叫亚伯拉罕。

chapters.en:
You found his heart faithful before You, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites and Hittites, of the Amorites and Perizzites,
of the Jebusites and Girgashites— to give it to his descendants. You have kept Your promise,
because You are righteous.
chapters.zh: 你见他在你面前心里诚实，就与他立约，应许把迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、耶布斯人、革迦撒人之地赐给他的后裔，且应验了你的话，因为你是公义的。

chapters.en: You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt; You heard their cry at the Red Sea.
chapters.zh: 「你曾看见我们列祖在埃及所受的困苦，垂听他们在红海边的哀求，

chapters.en: You performed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, all his officials, and all the people of his land, for You knew they had acted with arrogance against our fathers. You made a name for Yourself that endures to this day.
chapters.zh: 就施行神迹奇事在法老和他一切臣仆，并他国中的众民身上。你也得了名声，正如今日一样，因为你知道他们向我们列祖行事狂傲。

chapters.en: You divided the sea before them, and they crossed through it on dry ground. You hurled their pursuers into the depths like a stone into raging waters.
chapters.zh: 你又在我们列祖面前把海分开，使他们在海中行走干地，将追赶他们的人抛在深海，如石头抛在大水中；

chapters.en: You led them with a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night, to light for them the way in which they should travel.
chapters.zh: 并且白昼用云柱引导他们，黑夜用火柱照亮他们当行的路。

chapters.en: You came down on Mount Sinai and spoke with them from heaven. You gave them just ordinances, true laws, and good statutes and commandments.
chapters.zh: 你也降临在西奈山，从天上与他们说话，赐给他们正直的典章、真实的律法、美好的条例与诫命，

chapters.en:
You revealed to them Your holy Sabbath and gave them commandments and statutes and laws
through Your servant Moses.
chapters.zh: 又使他们知道你的安息圣日，并藉你仆人摩西传给他们诫命、条例、律法。

chapters.en: In their hunger You gave them bread from heaven; in their thirst You brought them water from the rock. You told them to go in and possess the land that You had sworn to give them.
chapters.zh: 从天上赐下粮食充他们的饥，从磐石使水流出解他们的渴，又吩咐他们进去得你起誓应许赐给他们的地。

chapters.en: But they and our fathers became arrogant and stiff-necked and did not obey Your commandments.
chapters.zh: 「但我们的列祖行事狂傲，硬着颈项不听从你的诫命；

chapters.en: They refused to listen and failed to remember the wonders You performed among them. They stiffened their necks and appointed a leader to return them to their bondage in Egypt. But You are a forgiving God, gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and rich in loving devotion, and You did not forsake them.
chapters.zh: 不肯顺从，也不记念你在他们中间所行的奇事，竟硬着颈项，居心背逆，自立首领，要回他们为奴之地。但你是乐意饶恕人，有恩典，有怜悯，不轻易发怒，有丰盛慈爱的上帝，并不丢弃他们。

chapters.en: Even when they cast for themselves an image of a calf and said, ‘This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt,’ and when they committed terrible blasphemies,
chapters.zh: 他们虽然铸了一只牛犊，彼此说『这是领你出埃及的神』，因而大大惹动你的怒气；

chapters.en: You in Your great compassion did not forsake them in the wilderness. By day the pillar of cloud never turned away from guiding them on their path; and by the night the pillar of fire illuminated the way they should go.
chapters.zh: 你还是大施怜悯，在旷野不丢弃他们。白昼，云柱不离开他们，仍引导他们行路；黑夜，火柱也不离开他们，仍照亮他们当行的路。

chapters.en:
You gave Your good Spirit to instruct them. You did not withhold Your manna from their mouths,
and You gave them water for their thirst.
chapters.zh: 你也赐下你良善的灵教训他们；未尝不赐吗哪使他们糊口，并赐水解他们的渴。

chapters.en: For forty years You sustained them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing. Their clothes did not wear out and their feet did not swell.
chapters.zh: 在旷野四十年，你养育他们，他们就一无所缺：衣服没有穿破，脚也没有肿。

chapters.en: You gave them kingdoms and peoples and allotted to them every corner of the land. So they took the land of Sihon king of Heshbon and of Og king of Bashan.
chapters.zh: 并且你将列国之地照分赐给他们，他们就得了西宏之地、希实本王之地，和巴珊王噩之地。

chapters.en: You multiplied their descendants like the stars of heaven and brought them to the land You had told their fathers to enter and possess.
chapters.zh: 你也使他们的子孙多如天上的星，带他们到你所应许他们列祖进入得为业之地。

chapters.en: So their descendants went in and possessed the land; You subdued before them the Canaanites dwelling in the land. You delivered into their hands the kings and peoples of the land, to do with them as they wished.
chapters.zh: 这样，他们进去得了那地，你在他们面前制伏那地的居民，就是迦南人；将迦南人和其君王，并那地的居民，都交在他们手里，让他们任意而待。

chapters.en: They captured fortified cities and fertile land and took houses full of all goods, wells already dug, vineyards, olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate and were filled; they grew fat and delighted in Your great goodness.
chapters.zh: 他们得了坚固的城邑、肥美的地土、充满各样美物的房屋、凿成的水井、葡萄园、橄榄园，并许多果木树。他们就吃而得饱，身体肥胖，因你的大恩，心中快乐。

chapters.en:
But they were disobedient and rebelled against You; they flung Your law behind their backs. They killed Your prophets, who had admonished them to return to You.
They committed terrible blasphemies.
chapters.zh: 「然而，他们不顺从，竟背叛你，将你的律法丢在背后，杀害那劝他们归向你的众先知，大大惹动你的怒气。

chapters.en:
So You delivered them into the hands of enemies who oppressed them,
and in their time of distress they cried out to You. From heaven You heard them, and in Your great compassion You gave them deliverers
who saved them from the hands of their enemies.
chapters.zh: 所以你将他们交在敌人的手中，磨难他们。他们遭难的时候哀求你，你就从天上垂听，照你的大怜悯赐给他们拯救者，救他们脱离敌人的手。

chapters.en: But as soon as they had rest, they again did evil in Your sight. So You abandoned them to the hands of their enemies, who had dominion over them. When they cried out to You again, You heard from heaven, and You delivered them many times in Your compassion.
chapters.zh: 但他们得平安之后，又在你面前行恶，所以你丢弃他们在仇敌的手中，使仇敌辖制他们。然而他们转回哀求你，你仍从天上垂听，屡次照你的怜悯拯救他们，

chapters.en: You admonished them to turn back to Your law, but they were arrogant and disobeyed Your commandments. They sinned against Your ordinances, by which a man will live if he practices them. They turned a stubborn shoulder; they stiffened their necks and would not obey.
chapters.zh: 又警戒他们，要使他们归服你的律法。他们却行事狂傲，不听从你的诫命，干犯你的典章（人若遵行就必因此活着），扭转肩头，硬着颈项，不肯听从。
