chapters.zh: 清洁的人，你以清洁待他； 乖僻的人，你以弯曲待他。

chapters.en: For You save an afflicted people, but You humble those with haughty eyes.
chapters.zh: 困苦的百姓，你必拯救； 高傲的眼目，你必使他降卑。

chapters.en: For You, O LORD, light my lamp; my God lights up my darkness.
chapters.zh: 你必点着我的灯； 耶和华－我的上帝必照明我的黑暗。

chapters.en: For in You I can charge an army, and with my God I can scale a wall.
chapters.zh: 我藉着你冲入敌军， 藉着我的上帝跳过墙垣。

chapters.en:
As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless.
He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
chapters.zh: 至于上帝，他的道是完全的； 耶和华的话是炼净的。 凡投靠他的，他便作他们的盾牌。

chapters.en: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?
chapters.zh: 除了耶和华，谁是上帝呢？ 除了我们的上帝，谁是磐石呢？

chapters.en: It is God who arms me with strength and makes my way clear.
chapters.zh: 惟有那以力量束我的腰、 使我行为完全的，他是上帝。

chapters.en: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.
chapters.zh: 他使我的脚快如母鹿的〔蹄〕， 又使我在高处安稳。

chapters.en: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
chapters.zh: 他教导我的手能以争战， 甚至我的膀臂能开铜弓。

chapters.en:
You have given me Your shield of salvation; Your right hand upholds me,
and Your gentleness exalts me.
chapters.zh: 你把你的救恩给我作盾牌； 你的右手扶持我； 你的温和使我为大。

chapters.en: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.
chapters.zh: 你使我脚下的地步宽阔； 我的脚未曾滑跌。

chapters.en: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.
chapters.zh: 我要追赶我的仇敌，并要追上他们； 不将他们灭绝，我总不归回。

chapters.en: I crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.
chapters.zh: 我要打伤他们，使他们不能起来； 他们必倒在我的脚下。

chapters.en: You have armed me with strength for battle; You have subdued my foes beneath me.
chapters.zh: 因为你曾以力量束我的腰，使我能争战； 你也使那起来攻击我的都服在我以下。

chapters.en: You have made my enemies retreat before me; I destroyed those who hated me.
chapters.zh: 你又使我的仇敌在我面前转背逃跑， 叫我能以剪除那恨我的人。

chapters.en: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them— to the LORD, but He did not answer.
chapters.zh: 他们呼求，却无人拯救； 就是呼求耶和华，他也不应允。

chapters.en: I ground them as dust in the face of the wind; I trampled them like mud in the streets.
chapters.zh: 我捣碎他们，如同风前的灰尘， 倒出他们，如同街上的泥土。

chapters.en:
You have delivered me from the strife of the people; You have made me the head of nations;
a people I had not known shall serve me.
chapters.zh: 你救我脱离百姓的争竞， 立我作列国的元首； 我素不认识的民必事奉我。

chapters.en: When they hear me, they obey me; foreigners cower before me.
chapters.zh: 他们一听见我的名声就必顺从我； 外邦人要投降我。

chapters.en: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.
chapters.zh: 外邦人要衰残， 战战兢兢地出他们的营寨。

chapters.en: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may the God of my salvation be exalted—
chapters.zh: 耶和华是活〔神〕。 愿我的磐石被人称颂； 愿救我的上帝被人尊崇。

chapters.en: the God who avenges me and subdues nations beneath me,
chapters.zh: 这位上帝，就是那为我伸冤、 使众民服在我以下的。

chapters.en: who delivers me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.
chapters.zh: 你救我脱离仇敌， 又把我举起，高过那些起来攻击我的； 你救我脱离强暴的人。

chapters.en: Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，因此我要在外邦中称谢你， 歌颂你的名。

chapters.en:
Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed,
to David and his descendants forever.
chapters.zh: 耶和华赐极大的救恩给他〔所立〕的王， 施慈爱给他的受膏者， 就是给大卫和他的后裔，直到永远。

chapters.en: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.
chapters.zh: 诸天述说上帝的荣耀； 穹苍传扬他的手段。

chapters.en: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.
chapters.zh: 这日到那日发出言语； 这夜到那夜传出知识。

chapters.en: Without speech or language, without a sound to be heard,
chapters.zh: 无言无语， 也无声音可听。

chapters.en:
their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.
In the heavens He has pitched a tent for the sun.
chapters.zh: 它的量带通遍天下， 它的言语传到地极。 上帝在其间为太阳安设帐幕；

chapters.en: Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course,
chapters.zh: 太阳如同新郎出洞房， 又如勇士欢然奔路。

chapters.en:
it rises at one end of the heavens and runs its circuit to the other;
nothing is deprived of its warmth.
chapters.zh: 它从天这边出来，绕到天那边， 没有一物被隐藏不得它的热气。

chapters.en: The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的律法全备，能苏醒人心； 耶和华的法度确定，能使愚人有智慧。

chapters.en: The precepts of the LORD are right, bringing joy to the heart; the commandments of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的训词正直，能快活人的心； 耶和华的命令清洁，能明亮人的眼目。

chapters.en: The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever; the judgments of the LORD are true, being altogether righteous.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的道理洁净，存到永远； 耶和华的典章真实，全然公义－

chapters.en: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.
chapters.zh: 都比金子可羨慕，且比极多的精金可羨慕； 比蜜甘甜，且比蜂房下滴的蜜甘甜。

chapters.en: By them indeed Your servant is warned; in keeping them is great reward.
chapters.zh: 况且你的仆人因此受警戒， 守着这些便有大赏。

chapters.en: Who can discern his own errors? Cleanse me from my hidden faults.
chapters.zh: 谁能知道〔自己的〕错失呢？ 愿你赦免我隐而未现的〔过错〕。

chapters.en: Keep Your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless and cleansed of great transgression.
chapters.zh: 求你拦阻仆人不犯任意妄为的罪， 不容这罪辖制我， 我便完全，免犯大罪。

chapters.en: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－我的磐石，我的救赎主啊， 愿我口中的言语、心里的意念在你面前蒙悦纳。

chapters.en: May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
chapters.zh: 愿耶和华在你遭难的日子应允你； 愿名为雅各上帝的高举你。

chapters.en: May He send you help from the sanctuary and sustain you from Zion.
chapters.zh: 愿他从圣所救助你， 从锡安坚固你，

chapters.en: May He remember all your gifts and look favorably on your burnt offerings. Selah
chapters.zh: 记念你的一切供献， 悦纳你的燔祭，（细拉）

chapters.en: May He give you the desires of your heart and make all your plans succeed.
chapters.zh: 将你心所愿的赐给你， 成就你的一切筹算。

chapters.en:
May we shout for joy at your victory and raise a banner in the name of our God.
May the LORD grant all your petitions.
chapters.zh: 我们要因你的救恩夸胜， 要奉我们上帝的名竖立旌旗。 愿耶和华成就你一切所求的！

chapters.en:
Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He answers him from His holy heaven
with the saving power of His right hand.
chapters.zh: 现在我知道耶和华救护他的受膏者， 必从他的圣天上应允他， 用右手的能力救护他。

chapters.en: Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
chapters.zh: 有人〔靠〕车，有人〔靠〕马， 但我们要提到耶和华－我们上帝的名。

chapters.en: They collapse and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.
chapters.zh: 他们都屈身仆倒， 我们却起来，立得正直。

chapters.en: O LORD, save the king. Answer us on the day we call.
chapters.zh: 求耶和华施行拯救； 我们呼求的时候，愿王应允我们！

chapters.en: O LORD, the king rejoices in Your strength. How greatly he exults in Your salvation!
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，王必因你的能力欢喜； 因你的救恩，他的快乐何其大！

chapters.en: You have granted his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah
chapters.zh: 他心里所愿的，你已经赐给他； 他嘴唇所求的，你未尝不应允。（细拉）

chapters.en: For You welcomed him with rich blessings; You placed on his head a crown of pure gold.
chapters.zh: 你以美福迎接他， 把精金的冠冕戴在他头上。

chapters.en: He asked You for life, and You granted it— length of days, forever and ever.
chapters.zh: 他向你求寿，你便赐给他， 就是日子长久，直到永远。

chapters.en: Great is his glory in Your salvation; You bestow on him splendor and majesty.
chapters.zh: 他因你的救恩大有荣耀； 你又将尊荣威严加在他身上。

chapters.en: For You grant him blessings forever; You cheer him with joy in Your presence.
chapters.zh: 你使他有洪福，直到永远， 又使他在你面前欢喜快乐。

chapters.en:
For the king trusts in the LORD; through the loving devotion of the Most High,
he will not be shaken.
chapters.zh: 王倚靠耶和华， 因至高者的慈爱必不摇动。

chapters.en: Your hand will apprehend all Your enemies; Your right hand will seize those who hate You.
chapters.zh: 你的手要搜出你的一切仇敌； 你的右手要搜出那些恨你的人。

chapters.en:
You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing.
In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and the fire will consume them.
chapters.zh: 你发怒的时候，要使他们如在炎热的火炉中。 耶和华要在他的震怒中吞灭他们； 那火要把他们烧尽了。

chapters.en: You will wipe their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from the sons of men.
chapters.zh: 你必从世上灭绝他们的子孙〔注：原文是果子〕， 从人间灭绝他们的后裔。

chapters.en: Though they intend You harm, the schemes they devise will not prevail.
chapters.zh: 因为他们有意加害于你； 他们想出计谋，却不能做成。

chapters.en: For You will put them to flight when Your bow is trained upon them.
chapters.zh: 你必使他们转背逃跑， 向他们的脸搭箭在弦。

chapters.en: Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，愿你因自己的能力显为至高！ 这样，我们就唱诗，歌颂你的大能。

chapters.en: My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Why are You so far from saving me, so far from my words of groaning?
chapters.zh: 我的上帝，我的上帝！为什么离弃我？ 〔为什么〕远离不救我？不听我唉哼的言语？

chapters.en: I cry out by day, O my God, but You do not answer, and by night, but I have no rest.
chapters.zh: 我的上帝啊，我白日呼求，你不应允， 夜间呼求，并不住声。

chapters.en: Yet You are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.
chapters.zh: 但你是圣洁的， 是用以色列的赞美为宝座〔注：或译：居所〕的。

chapters.en: In You our fathers trusted; they trusted and You delivered them.
chapters.zh: 我们的祖宗倚靠你； 他们倚靠你，你便解救他们。

chapters.en: They cried out to You and were set free; they trusted in You and were not disappointed.
chapters.zh: 他们哀求你，便蒙解救； 他们倚靠你，就不羞愧。

chapters.en: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by men and despised by the people.
chapters.zh: 但我是虫，不是人， 被众人羞辱，被百姓藐视。

chapters.en: All who see me mock me; they sneer and shake their heads:
chapters.zh: 凡看见我的都嗤笑我； 他们撇嘴摇头，〔说〕：

chapters.en: “He trusts in the LORD, let the LORD deliver him; let the LORD rescue him, since He delights in him.”
chapters.zh: 他把〔自己〕交讬耶和华，耶和华可以救他吧！ 耶和华既喜悦他，可以搭救他吧！

chapters.en: Yet You brought me forth from the womb; You made me secure at my mother’s breast.
chapters.zh: 但你是叫我出母腹的； 我在母怀里，你就使我有倚靠的心。

chapters.en: From birth I was cast upon You; from my mother’s womb You have been my God.
chapters.zh: 我自出母胎就被交在你手里； 从我母亲生我，你就是我的上帝。

chapters.en:
Be not far from me, for trouble is near
and there is no one to help.
chapters.zh: 求你不要远离我！ 因为急难临近了，没有人帮助我。

chapters.en: Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.
chapters.zh: 有许多公牛围绕我， 巴珊大力的公牛四面困住我。

chapters.en: They open their jaws against me like lions that roar and maul.
chapters.zh: 牠们向我张口， 好像抓撕吼叫的狮子。

chapters.en: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are disjointed. My heart is like wax; it melts away within me.
chapters.zh: 我如水被倒出来； 我的骨头都脱了节； 我心在我里面如蜡镕化。

chapters.en:
My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth.
You lay me in the dust of death.
chapters.zh: 我的精力枯干，如同瓦片； 我的舌头贴在我牙床上。 你将我安置在死地的尘土中。

chapters.en:
For dogs surround me; a band of evil men encircles me;
they have pierced my hands and feet.
chapters.zh: 犬类围着我，恶党环绕我； 他们扎了我的手，我的脚。

chapters.en: I can count all my bones; they stare and gloat over me.
chapters.zh: 我的骨头，我都能数过； 他们瞪着眼看我。

chapters.en: They divide my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing.
chapters.zh: 他们分我的外衣， 为我的里衣拈鬮。

chapters.en: But You, O LORD, be not far off; O my Strength, come quickly to help me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要远离我！ 我的救主啊，求你快来帮助我！

chapters.en: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of wild dogs.
chapters.zh: 求你救我的灵魂脱离刀剑， 救我的生命〔注：生命：原文是独一者〕脱离犬类，

chapters.en: Save me from the mouth of the lion; at the horns of the wild oxen You have answered me!
chapters.zh: 救我脱离狮子的口； 你已经应允我，使我脱离野牛的角。

chapters.en: I will proclaim Your name to my brothers; I will praise You in the assembly.
chapters.zh: 我要将你的名传与我的弟兄， 在会中我要赞美你。

chapters.en:
You who fear the LORD, praise Him! All descendants of Jacob, honor Him!
All offspring of Israel, revere Him!
chapters.zh: 你们敬畏耶和华的人要赞美他！ 雅各的后裔都要荣耀他！ 以色列的后裔都要惧怕他！

chapters.en: For He has not despised or detested the torment of the afflicted. He has not hidden His face from him, but has attended to his cry for help.
chapters.zh: 因为他没有藐视憎恶受苦的人， 也没有向他掩面； 那受苦之人呼吁的时候，他就垂听。

chapters.en: My praise for You resounds in the great assembly; I will fulfill my vows before those who fear You.
chapters.zh: 我在大会中赞美你的话是从你而来的； 我要在敬畏耶和华的人面前还我的愿。

chapters.en:
The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the LORD will praise Him.
May your hearts live forever!
chapters.zh: 谦卑的人必吃得饱足； 寻求耶和华的人必赞美他。 愿你们的心永远活着！

chapters.en: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.
chapters.zh: 地的四极都要想念耶和华，并且归顺他； 列国的万族都要在你面前敬拜。

chapters.en: For dominion belongs to the LORD and He rules over the nations.
chapters.zh: 因为国权是耶和华的； 他是管理万国的。

chapters.en:
All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before Him—
even those unable to preserve their lives.
chapters.zh: 地上一切丰肥的人必吃喝而敬拜； 凡下到尘土中－不能存活自己性命的人 －都要在他面前下拜。

chapters.en: Posterity will serve Him; they will declare the Lord to a new generation.
chapters.zh: 他必有后裔事奉他； 主所行的事必传与后代。

chapters.en:
They will come and proclaim His righteousness to a people yet unborn—
all that He has done.
chapters.zh: 他们必来把他的公义传给将要生的民， 言明这事是他所行的。

chapters.en: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是我的牧者， 我必不致缺乏。

chapters.en: He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters.
chapters.zh: 他使我躺卧在青草地上， 领我在可安歇的水边。

chapters.en:
He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness
for the sake of His name.
chapters.zh: 他使我的灵魂苏醒， 为自己的名引导我走义路。

chapters.en: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
chapters.zh: 我虽然行过死荫的〔幽〕谷， 也不怕遭害， 因为你与我同在； 你的杖，你的竿，都安慰我。

chapters.en: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
chapters.zh: 在我敌人面前，你为我摆设筵席； 你用油膏了我的头，使我的〔福〕杯满溢。

chapters.en: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
chapters.zh: 我一生一世必有恩惠慈爱随着我； 我且要住在耶和华的殿中，直到永远。

chapters.en: The earth is the LORD’s, and the fullness thereof, the world and all who dwell therein.
chapters.zh: 地和其中所充满的， 世界和住在其间的，都属耶和华。

chapters.en: For He has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters.
chapters.zh: 他把地建立在海上， 安定在大水之上。

chapters.en: Who may ascend the hill of the LORD? Who may stand in His holy place?
chapters.zh: 谁能登耶和华的山？ 谁能站在他的圣所？

chapters.en:
He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol
or swear deceitfully.
chapters.zh: 就是手洁心清，不向虚妄， 起誓不怀诡诈的人。

chapters.en: He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation.
chapters.zh: 他必蒙耶和华赐福， 又蒙救他的上帝使他成义。

chapters.en: Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O God of Jacob. Selah
chapters.zh: 这是寻求耶和华的族类， 是寻求你面的雅各。（细拉）

chapters.en:
Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors,
that the King of Glory may enter!
chapters.zh: 众城门哪，你们要抬起头来！ 永久的门户，你们要被举起！ 那荣耀的王将要进来！

chapters.en:
Who is this King of Glory? The LORD strong and mighty,
the LORD mighty in battle.
chapters.zh: 荣耀的王是谁呢？ 就是有力有能的耶和华， 在战场上有能的耶和华！

chapters.en:
Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors,
that the King of Glory may enter!
chapters.zh: 众城门哪，你们要抬起头来！ 永久的门户，你们要把头抬起！ 那荣耀的王将要进来！

chapters.en:
Who is He, this King of Glory? The LORD of Hosts—
He is the King of Glory. Selah
chapters.zh: 荣耀的王是谁呢？ 万军之耶和华， 他是荣耀的王！（细拉）

chapters.en: To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul;
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我的心仰望你。

chapters.en: in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.
chapters.zh: 我的上帝啊，我素来倚靠你； 求你不要叫我羞愧， 不要叫我的仇敌向我夸胜。

chapters.en: Surely none who wait for You will be put to shame; but those who engage in treachery without cause will be disgraced.
chapters.zh: 凡等候你的必不羞愧； 惟有那无故行奸诈的必要羞愧。

chapters.en: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你将你的道指示我， 将你的路教训我！

chapters.en:
Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation;
all day long I wait for You.
chapters.zh: 求你以你的真理引导我，教训我， 因为你是救我的上帝。 我终日等候你。

chapters.en: Remember, O LORD, Your compassion and loving devotion, for they are from age to age.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你记念你的怜悯和慈爱， 因为这是亘古以来所常有的。

chapters.en: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my rebellious acts; remember me according to Your loving devotion, because of Your goodness, O LORD.
chapters.zh: 求你不要记念我幼年的罪愆和我的过犯； 耶和华啊，求你因你的恩惠，按你的慈爱记念我。

chapters.en: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore He shows sinners the way.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是良善正直的， 所以他必指示罪人走〔正〕路。

chapters.en: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them His way.
chapters.zh: 他必按公平引领谦卑人， 将他的道教训他们。

chapters.en: All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful to those who keep His covenant and His decrees.
chapters.zh: 凡遵守他的约和他法度的人， 耶和华都以慈爱诚实待他。

chapters.en: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, forgive my iniquity, for it is great.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你因你的名赦免我的罪， 因为我的罪重大。

chapters.en: Who is the man who fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the path chosen for him.
chapters.zh: 谁敬畏耶和华， 耶和华必指示他当选择的道路。

chapters.en: His soul will dwell in prosperity, and his descendants will inherit the land.
chapters.zh: 他必安然居住； 他的后裔必承受地土。

chapters.en: The LORD confides in those who fear Him, and reveals His covenant to them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华与敬畏他的人亲密； 他必将自己的约指示他们。

chapters.en: My eyes are always on the LORD, for He will free my feet from the mesh.
chapters.zh: 我的眼目时常仰望耶和华， 因为他必将我的脚从网里拉出来。

chapters.en: Turn to me and be gracious, for I am lonely and afflicted.
chapters.zh: 求你转向我，怜恤我， 因为我是孤独困苦。

chapters.en: The troubles of my heart increase; free me from my distress.
chapters.zh: 我心里的愁苦甚多， 求你救我脱离我的祸患。

chapters.en: Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.
chapters.zh: 求你看顾我的困苦，我的艰难， 赦免我一切的罪。

chapters.en: Consider my enemies, for they are many, and they hate me with vicious hatred.
chapters.zh: 求你察看我的仇敌， 因为他们人多，并且痛痛地恨我。

chapters.en:
Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame,
for I take refuge in You.
chapters.zh: 求你保护我的性命，搭救我， 使我不致羞愧，因为我投靠你。

chapters.en: May integrity and uprightness preserve me, because I wait for You.
chapters.zh: 愿纯全、正直保守我， 因为我等候你。

chapters.en: Redeem Israel, O God, from all its distress.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你救赎以色列脱离他一切的愁苦。

chapters.en:
Vindicate me, O LORD!
For I have walked with integrity; I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你为我伸冤， 因我向来行事纯全； 我又倚靠耶和华，并不摇动。

chapters.en: Test me, O LORD, and try me; examine my heart and mind.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你察看我，试验我， 熬炼我的肺腑心肠。

chapters.en: For Your loving devotion is before my eyes, and I have walked in Your truth.
chapters.zh: 因为你的慈爱常在我眼前， 我也按你的真理而行。

chapters.en: I do not sit with deceitful men, nor keep company with hypocrites.
chapters.zh: 我没有和虚谎人同坐， 也不与瞒哄人的同群。

chapters.en: I hate the mob of evildoers, and refuse to sit with the wicked.
chapters.zh: 我恨恶恶人的会， 必不与恶人同坐。

chapters.en: I wash my hands in innocence that I may go about Your altar, O LORD,
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我要洗手表明无辜， 才环绕你的祭坛；

chapters.en: to raise my voice in thanksgiving and declare all Your wonderful works.
chapters.zh: 我好发称谢的声音， 也要述说你一切奇妙的作为。

chapters.en: O LORD, I love the house where You dwell, the place where Your glory resides.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我喜爱你所住的殿 和你显荣耀的居所。

chapters.en: Do not take my soul away with sinners, or my life with men of bloodshed,
chapters.zh: 不要把我的灵魂和罪人一同除掉； 不要把我的性命和流人血的一同除掉。

chapters.en: in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.
chapters.zh: 他们的手中有奸恶， 右手满有贿赂。

chapters.en: But I will walk with integrity; redeem me and be merciful to me.
chapters.zh: 至于我，却要行事纯全； 求你救赎我，怜恤我！

chapters.en: My feet stand on level ground; in the congregations I will bless the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我的脚站在平坦地方； 在众会中我要称颂耶和华！

chapters.en: The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— whom shall I dread?
chapters.zh: 耶和华是我的亮光，是我的拯救， 我还怕谁呢？ 耶和华是我性命的保障〔注：或译：力量〕， 我还惧谁呢？

chapters.en: When the wicked came upon me to devour my flesh, my enemies and foes stumbled and fell.
chapters.zh: 那作恶的就是我的仇敌， 前来吃我肉的时候就绊跌仆倒。

chapters.en: Though an army encamps around me, my heart will not fear; though a war breaks out against me, I will keep my trust.
chapters.zh: 虽有军兵安营攻击我，我的心也不害怕； 虽然兴起刀兵攻击我，我必仍旧安稳。

chapters.en: One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.
chapters.zh: 有一件事，我曾求耶和华，我仍要寻求： 就是一生一世住在耶和华的殿中， 瞻仰他的荣美，在他的殿里求问。

chapters.en: For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; He will set me high upon a rock.
chapters.zh: 因为我遭遇患难，他必暗暗地保守我； 在他亭子里，把我藏在他帐幕的隐密处， 将我高举在磐石上。

chapters.en: Then my head will be held high above my enemies around me. At His tabernacle I will offer sacrifices with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 现在我得以昂首，高过四面的仇敌。 我要在他的帐幕里欢然献祭； 我要唱诗歌颂耶和华。

chapters.en: Hear, O LORD, my voice when I call; be merciful and answer me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我用声音呼吁的时候，求你垂听； 并求你怜恤我，应允我。

chapters.en: My heart said, “Seek His face.” Your face, O LORD, I will seek.
chapters.zh: 〔你说〕：你们当寻求我的面。 那时我心向你说：耶和华啊， 你的面我正要寻求。

chapters.en:
Hide not Your face from me, nor turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my helper; do not leave me or forsake me,
O God of my salvation.
chapters.zh: 不要向我掩面。 不要发怒赶逐仆人， 你向来是帮助我的。 救我的上帝啊，不要丢掉我， 也不要离弃我。

chapters.en: Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will receive me.
chapters.zh: 我父母离弃我， 耶和华必收留我。

chapters.en:
Teach me Your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path,
because of my oppressors.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你将你的道指教我， 因我仇敌的缘故引导我走平坦的路。

chapters.en:
Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me,
breathing out violence.
chapters.zh: 求你不要把我交给敌人，遂其所愿； 因为妄作见证的和口吐凶言的，起来攻击我。

chapters.en:
Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD
in the land of the living.
chapters.zh: 我若不信在活人之地得见耶和华的恩惠， 〔就早已丧胆了〕。

chapters.en:
Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous.
Wait patiently for the LORD!
chapters.zh: 要等候耶和华！ 当壮胆，坚固你的心！ 我再说，要等候耶和华！

chapters.en: To You, O LORD, I call; be not deaf to me, O my Rock. For if You remain silent, I will be like those descending to the Pit.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我要求告你！ 我的磐石啊，不要向我缄默！ 倘若你向我闭口， 我就如将死的人一样。

chapters.en: Hear my cry for mercy when I call to You for help, when I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.
chapters.zh: 我呼求你，向你至圣所举手的时候， 求你垂听我恳求的声音！

chapters.en: Do not drag me away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbors while malice is in their hearts.
chapters.zh: 不要把我和恶人并作孽的一同除掉； 他们与邻舍说和平话，心里却是奸恶。

chapters.en: Repay them according to their deeds and for their works of evil. Repay them for what their hands have done; bring back on them what they deserve.
chapters.zh: 愿你按着他们所做的， 并他们所行的恶事待他们。 愿你照着他们手所做的待他们， 将他们所应得的报应加给他们。

chapters.en: Since they show no regard for the works of the LORD or what His hands have done, He will tear them down and never rebuild them.
chapters.zh: 他们既然不留心耶和华所行的和他手所做的， 他就必毁坏他们，不建立他们。

chapters.en: Blessed be the LORD, for He has heard my cry for mercy.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的， 因为他听了我恳求的声音。

chapters.en: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是我的力量，是我的盾牌； 我心里倚靠他就得帮助。 所以我心中欢乐， 我必用诗歌颂赞他。

chapters.en: The LORD is the strength of His people, a stronghold of salvation for His anointed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是他百姓的力量， 又是他受膏者得救的保障。

chapters.en: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; shepherd them and carry them forever.
chapters.zh: 求你拯救你的百姓，赐福给你的产业， 牧养他们，扶持他们，直到永远。

chapters.en: Ascribe to the LORD, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
chapters.zh: 上帝的众子啊，你们要将荣耀、能力归给耶和华， 归给耶和华！

chapters.en: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.
chapters.zh: 要将耶和华的名所当得的荣耀归给他， 以圣洁的〔注：的：或译为〕妆饰敬拜耶和华。

chapters.en:
The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders;
the LORD is heard over many waters.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的声音发在水上； 荣耀的上帝打雷， 耶和华打雷在大水之上。

chapters.en: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的声音大有能力； 耶和华的声音满有威严。

chapters.en: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的声音震破香柏树； 耶和华震碎黎巴嫩的香柏树。

chapters.en: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.
chapters.zh: 他也使之跳跃如牛犊， 使黎巴嫩和西连跳跃如野牛犊。

chapters.en: The voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的声音使火焰分岔。

chapters.en: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的声音震动旷野； 耶和华震动加低斯的旷野。

chapters.en:
The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare.
And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”
chapters.zh: 耶和华的声音惊动母鹿落胎， 树木也脱落净光。 凡在他殿中的，都称说〔他的〕荣耀。

chapters.en: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.
chapters.zh: 洪水泛滥之时，耶和华坐着〔为王〕； 耶和华坐着为王，直到永远。

chapters.en: The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必赐力量给他的百姓； 耶和华必赐平安的福给他的百姓。

chapters.en: I will exalt You, O LORD, for You have lifted me up and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我要尊崇你， 因为你曾提拔我，不叫仇敌向我夸耀。

chapters.en: O LORD my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－我的上帝啊， 我曾呼求你，你医治了我。

chapters.en: O LORD, You pulled me up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你曾把我的灵魂从阴间救上来， 使我存活，不至于下坑。

chapters.en: Sing to the LORD, O you His saints, and praise His holy name.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们要歌颂他， 称赞他可记念的圣〔名〕。

chapters.en: For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
chapters.zh: 因为，他的怒气不过是转眼之间； 他的恩典乃是一生之久。 一宿虽然有哭泣， 早晨便必欢呼。

chapters.en: In prosperity I said, “I will never be shaken.”
chapters.zh: 至于我，我凡事平顺，便说： 我永不动摇。

chapters.en:
O LORD, You favored me; You made my mountain stand strong.
When You hid Your face, I was dismayed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你曾施恩，叫我的〔江〕山稳固； 你掩了面，我就惊惶。

chapters.en: To You, O LORD, I called, and I begged my Lord for mercy:
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我曾求告你； 我向耶和华恳求，〔说〕：

chapters.en: “What gain is there in my bloodshed, in my descent to the Pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?
chapters.zh: 我被害流血，下到坑中，有什么益处呢？ 尘土岂能称赞你，传说你的诚实吗？

chapters.en: Hear me, O LORD, and have mercy; O LORD, be my helper.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你应允我，怜恤我！ 耶和华啊，求你帮助我！

chapters.en: You turned my mourning into dancing; You peeled off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,
chapters.zh: 你已将我的哀哭变为跳舞， 将我的麻衣脱去，给我披上喜乐，

chapters.en: that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks forever.
chapters.zh: 好叫我的灵〔注：原文是荣耀〕歌颂你，并不住声。 耶和华－我的上帝啊，我要称谢你，直到永远！

chapters.en:
In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame;
save me by Your righteousness.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我投靠你； 求你使我永不羞愧； 凭你的公义搭救我！

chapters.en: Incline Your ear to me; come quickly to my rescue. Be my rock of refuge, the stronghold of my deliverance.
chapters.zh: 求你侧耳而听， 快快救我！ 作我坚固的磐石， 拯救我的保障！

chapters.en: For You are my rock and my fortress; lead me and guide me for the sake of Your name.
chapters.zh: 因为你是我的巖石，我的山寨； 所以，求你为你名的缘故引导我，指点我。

chapters.en: You free me from the net laid out for me, for You are my refuge.
chapters.zh: 求你救我脱离人为我暗设的网罗， 因为你是我的保障。

chapters.en: Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD, God of truth.
chapters.zh: 我将我的灵魂交在你手里； 耶和华诚实的上帝啊，你救赎了我。

chapters.en: I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but in the LORD I trust.
chapters.zh: 我恨恶那信奉虚无〔之神〕的人； 我却倚靠耶和华。

chapters.en:
I will be glad and rejoice in Your loving devotion, for You have seen my affliction;
You have known the anguish of my soul.
chapters.zh: 我要为你的慈爱高兴欢喜； 因为你见过我的困苦，知道我心中的艰难。

chapters.en: You have not delivered me to the enemy; You have set my feet in the open.
chapters.zh: 你未曾把我交在仇敌手里； 你使我的脚站在宽阔之处。

chapters.en: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你怜恤我， 因为我在急难之中； 我的眼睛因忧愁而干瘪， 连我的身心也不安舒。

chapters.en: For my life is consumed with grief and my years with groaning; my iniquity has drained my strength, and my bones are wasting away.
chapters.zh: 我的生命为愁苦所消耗； 我的年岁为叹息所旷废。 我的力量因我的罪孽衰败； 我的骨头也枯干。

chapters.en: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends— they flee when they see me on the street.
chapters.zh: 我因一切敌人成了羞辱， 在我的邻舍跟前更甚； 那认识我的都惧怕我， 在外头看见我的都躲避我。

chapters.en: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind. I am like a broken vessel.
chapters.zh: 我被人忘记，如同死人，无人记念； 我好像破碎的器皿。

chapters.en: For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side. They conspire against me and plot to take my life.
chapters.zh: 我听见了许多人的谗谤， 四围都是惊吓； 他们一同商议攻击我的时候， 就图谋要害我的性命。

chapters.en: But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我仍旧倚靠你； 我说：你是我的上帝。

chapters.en:
My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies
and from those who pursue me.
chapters.zh: 我终身的事在你手中； 求你救我脱离仇敌的手和那些逼迫我的人。

chapters.en: Make Your face shine on Your servant; save me by Your loving devotion.
chapters.zh: 求你使你的脸光照仆人， 凭你的慈爱拯救我。

chapters.en: O LORD, let me not be ashamed, for I have called on You. Let the wicked be put to shame; let them lie silent in Sheol.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你叫我不致羞愧， 因为我曾呼吁你； 求你使恶人羞愧， 使他们在阴间缄默无声。

chapters.en:
May lying lips be silenced— lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous,
full of pride and contempt.
chapters.zh: 那撒谎的人逞骄傲轻慢， 出狂妄的话攻击义人； 愿他的嘴哑而无言。

chapters.en: How great is Your goodness which You have laid up for those who fear You, which You have bestowed before the sons of men on those who take refuge in You!
chapters.zh: 敬畏你、投靠你的人，你为他们所积存的， 在世人面前所施行的恩惠是何等大呢！

chapters.en: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.
chapters.zh: 你必把他们藏在你面前的隐密处， 免得遇见人的计谋； 你必暗暗地保守他们在亭子里， 免受口舌的争闹。

chapters.en:
Blessed be the LORD, for He has shown me His loving devotion
in a city under siege.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的， 因为他在坚固城里向我施展奇妙的慈爱。

chapters.en: In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from Your sight!” But You heard my plea for mercy when I called to You for help.
chapters.zh: 至于我，我曾急促地说： 我从你眼前被隔绝。 然而，我呼求你的时候， 你仍听我恳求的声音。

chapters.en:
Love the LORD, all His saints. The LORD preserves the faithful,
but fully repays the arrogant.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们都要爱他！ 耶和华保护诚实人， 足足报应行事骄傲的人。

chapters.en: Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.
chapters.zh: 凡仰望耶和华的人， 你们都要壮胆，坚固你们的心！

chapters.en: Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
chapters.zh: 得赦免其过、遮盖其罪的， 这人是有福的！

chapters.en:
Blessed is the man whose iniquity the LORD does not count against him,
in whose spirit there is no deceit.
chapters.zh: 凡心里没有诡诈、耶和华不算为有罪的， 这人是有福的！

chapters.en: When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.
chapters.zh: 我闭口不认罪的时候， 因终日唉哼而骨头枯干。

chapters.en: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah
chapters.zh: 黑夜白日，你的手在我身上沉重； 我的精液耗尽，如同夏天的干旱。（细拉）

chapters.en: Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah
chapters.zh: 我向你陈明我的罪， 不隐瞒我的恶。 我说：我要向耶和华承认我的过犯， 你就赦免我的罪恶。（细拉）

chapters.en: Therefore let all the godly pray to You while You may be found. Surely when great waters rise, they will not come near.
chapters.zh: 为此，凡虔诚人都当趁你可寻找的时候祷告你； 大水泛溢的时候，必不能到他那里。

chapters.en:
You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble;
You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah
chapters.zh: 你是我藏身之处； 你必保佑我脱离苦难， 以得救的乐歌四面环绕我。（细拉）

chapters.en: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.
chapters.zh: 我要教导你，指示你当行的路； 我要定睛在你身上劝戒你。

chapters.en: Do not be like the horse or mule, which have no understanding; they must be controlled with bit and bridle to make them come to you.
chapters.zh: 你不可像那无知的骡马， 必用嚼环辔头勒住牠； 不然，就不能驯服。

chapters.en: Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.
chapters.zh: 恶人必多受苦楚； 惟独倚靠耶和华的必有慈爱四面环绕他。

chapters.en: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.
chapters.zh: 你们义人应当靠耶和华欢喜快乐； 你们心里正直的人都当欢呼。

chapters.en: Rejoice in the LORD, O righteous ones; it is fitting for the upright to praise Him.
chapters.zh: 义人哪，你们应当靠耶和华欢乐； 正直人的赞美是合宜的。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to Him with ten strings.
chapters.zh: 你们应当弹琴称谢耶和华， 用十弦瑟歌颂他。

chapters.en: Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of joy.
chapters.zh: 应当向他唱新歌， 弹得巧妙，声音洪亮。

chapters.en: For the word of the LORD is upright, and all His work is trustworthy.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华的言语正直； 凡他所做的尽都诚实。

chapters.en: The LORD loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of His loving devotion.
chapters.zh: 他喜爱仁义公平； 遍地满了耶和华的慈爱。

chapters.en: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all the stars by the breath of His mouth.
chapters.zh: 诸天藉耶和华的命而造； 万象藉他口中的气而成。

chapters.en: He piles up the waters of the sea; He puts the depths into storehouses.
chapters.zh: 他聚集海水如垒， 收藏深洋在库房。

chapters.en: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world revere Him.
chapters.zh: 愿全地都敬畏耶和华！ 愿世上的居民都惧怕他！

chapters.en: For He spoke, and it came to be; He commanded, and it stood firm.
chapters.zh: 因为他说有，就有， 命立，就立。

chapters.en: The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations; He thwarts the devices of the peoples.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使列国的筹算归于无有， 使众民的思念无有功效。

chapters.en: The counsel of the LORD stands forever, the purposes of His heart to all generations.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的筹算永远立定； 他心中的思念万代常存。

chapters.en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people He has chosen as His inheritance!
chapters.zh: 以耶和华为上帝的，那国是有福的！ 他所拣选为自己产业的，那民是有福的！

chapters.en: The LORD looks down from heaven; He sees all the sons of men.
chapters.zh: 耶和华从天上观看； 他看见一切的世人。

chapters.en: From His dwelling place He gazes on all who inhabit the earth.
chapters.zh: 从他的居所往外察看地上一切的居民－

chapters.en: He shapes the hearts of each; He considers all their works.
chapters.zh: 他是那造成他们众人心的， 留意他们一切作为的。

chapters.en: No king is saved by his vast army; no warrior is delivered by his great strength.
chapters.zh: 君王不能因兵多得胜； 勇士不能因力大得救。

chapters.en: A horse is a vain hope for salvation; even its great strength cannot save.
chapters.zh: 靠马得救是枉然的； 马也不能因力大救人。

chapters.en: Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him, on those whose hope is in His loving devotion
chapters.zh: 耶和华的眼目看顾敬畏他的人 和仰望他慈爱的人，

chapters.en: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.
chapters.zh: 要救他们的命脱离死亡， 并使他们在饥荒中存活。

chapters.en: Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.
chapters.zh: 我们的心向来等候耶和华； 他是我们的帮助，我们的盾牌。

chapters.en: For our hearts rejoice in Him, since we trust in His holy name.
chapters.zh: 我们的心必靠他欢喜， 因为我们向来倚靠他的圣名。

chapters.en: May Your loving devotion rest on us, O LORD, as we put our hope in You.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你照着我们所仰望你的， 向我们施行慈爱！

chapters.en: I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.
chapters.zh: 我要时时称颂耶和华； 赞美他的话必常在我口中。

chapters.en: My soul boasts in the LORD; let the oppressed hear and rejoice.
chapters.zh: 我的心必因耶和华夸耀； 谦卑人听见就要喜乐。

chapters.en: Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.
chapters.zh: 你们和我当称耶和华为大， 一同高举他的名。

chapters.en: I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.
chapters.zh: 我曾寻求耶和华，他就应允我， 救我脱离了一切的恐惧。

chapters.en: Those who look to Him are radiant with joy; their faces shall never be ashamed.
chapters.zh: 凡仰望他的，便有光荣； 他们的脸必不蒙羞。

chapters.en: This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.
chapters.zh: 我这困苦人呼求，耶和华便垂听， 救我脱离一切患难。

chapters.en: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, and he delivers them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者在敬畏他的人四围安营， 搭救他们。

chapters.en: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
chapters.zh: 你们要尝尝〔主恩的滋味〕，便知道他是美善； 投靠他的人有福了！

chapters.en: Fear the LORD, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们当敬畏他， 因敬畏他的一无所缺。

chapters.en: Young lions go lacking and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.
chapters.zh: 少壮狮子还缺食忍饿， 但寻求耶和华的什么好处都不缺。

chapters.en: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 众弟子啊，你们当来听我的话！ 我要将敬畏耶和华的道教训你们。

chapters.en: Who is the man who delights in life, who desires to see good days?
chapters.zh: 有何人喜好存活， 爱慕〔长〕寿，得享美福，

chapters.en: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from deceitful speech.
chapters.zh: 就要禁止舌头不出恶言， 嘴唇不说诡诈的话。

chapters.en: Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
chapters.zh: 要离恶行善， 寻求和睦，一心追赶。

chapters.en: The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的眼目看顾义人； 他的耳朵听他们的呼求。

chapters.en: But the face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to wipe out all memory of them from the earth.
chapters.zh: 耶和华向行恶的人变脸， 要从世上除灭他们的名号。

chapters.en: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.
chapters.zh: 〔义人〕呼求，耶和华听见了， 便救他们脱离一切患难。

chapters.en: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
chapters.zh: 耶和华靠近伤心的人， 拯救灵性痛悔的人。

chapters.en: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.
chapters.zh: 义人多有苦难， 但耶和华救他脱离这一切，

chapters.en: He protects all his bones; not one of them will be broken.
chapters.zh: 又保全他一身的骨头， 连一根也不折断。

chapters.en: Evil will slay the wicked, and the haters of the righteous will be condemned.
chapters.zh: 恶必害死恶人； 恨恶义人的，必被定罪。

chapters.en: The LORD redeems His servants, and none who take refuge in Him will be condemned.
chapters.zh: 耶和华救赎他仆人的灵魂； 凡投靠他的，必不致定罪。

chapters.en: Contend with my opponents, O LORD; fight against those who fight against me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，与我相争的，求你与他们相争！ 与我相战的，求你与他们相战！

chapters.en: Take up Your shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.
chapters.zh: 拿着大小的盾牌， 起来帮助我。

chapters.en: Draw the spear and javelin against my pursuers; say to my soul: “I am your salvation.”
chapters.zh: 抽出枪来，挡住那追赶我的； 求你对我的灵魂说：我是拯救你的。

chapters.en: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.
chapters.zh: 愿那寻索我命的，蒙羞受辱！ 愿那谋害我的，退后羞愧！

chapters.en: May they be like chaff in the wind, as the angel of the LORD drives them away.
chapters.zh: 愿他们像风前的糠， 有耶和华的使者赶逐他们。

chapters.en: May their path be dark and slick, as the angel of the LORD pursues.
chapters.zh: 愿他们的道路又暗又滑， 有耶和华的使者追赶他们。

chapters.en: For without cause they laid their net for me; without reason they dug a pit for my soul.
chapters.zh: 因他们无故地为我暗设网罗， 无故地挖坑，要害我的性命。

chapters.en:
May ruin befall them by surprise; may the net they hid ensnare them;
may they fall into the hazard they created.
chapters.zh: 愿灾祸忽然临到他身上！ 愿他暗设的网缠住自己！ 愿他落在其中遭灾祸！

chapters.en: Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and exult in His salvation.
chapters.zh: 我的心必靠耶和华快乐， 靠他的救恩高兴。

chapters.en: All my bones will exclaim, “Who is like You, O LORD, who delivers the afflicted from the aggressor, the poor and needy from the robber?”
chapters.zh: 我的骨头都要说： 耶和华啊，谁能像你 救护困苦人脱离那比他强壮的， 救护困苦穷乏人脱离那抢夺他的？

chapters.en: Hostile witnesses come forward; they make charges I know nothing about.
chapters.zh: 凶恶的见证人起来， 盘问我所不知道的事。

chapters.en: They repay me evil for good, to the bereavement of my soul.
chapters.zh: 他们向我以恶报善， 使我的灵魂孤苦。

chapters.en: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth; I humbled myself with fasting, but my prayers returned unanswered.
chapters.zh: 至于我，当他们有病的时候， 我便穿麻衣，禁食，刻苦己心； 我所求的都归到自己的怀中。

chapters.en: I paced about as for my friend or brother; I was bowed down with grief, like one mourning for his mother.
chapters.zh: 我这样行，好像他是我的朋友，我的弟兄； 我屈身悲哀，如同人为母亲哀痛。

chapters.en: But when I stumbled, they assembled in glee; they gathered together against me. Assailants I did not know slandered me without ceasing.
chapters.zh: 我在患难中，他们却欢喜，大家聚集。 我所不认识的那些下流人聚集攻击我； 他们不住地把我撕裂。

chapters.en: Like godless jesters at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.
chapters.zh: 他们如同席上好嬉笑的狂妄人向我咬牙。

chapters.en:
How long, O Lord, will You look on? Rescue my soul from their ravages,
my precious life from these lions.
chapters.zh: 主啊，你看着不理要到几时呢？ 求你救我的灵魂脱离他们的残害！ 救我的生命〔注：生命：原文是独一者〕脱离少壮狮子！

chapters.en: Then I will give You thanks in the great assembly; I will praise You among many people.
chapters.zh: 我在大会中要称谢你， 在众民中要赞美你。

chapters.en: Let not my enemies gloat over me without cause, nor those who hate me without reason wink in malice.
chapters.zh: 求你不容那无理与我为仇的向我夸耀！ 不容那无故恨我的向我挤眼！

chapters.en:
For they do not speak peace, but they devise deceitful schemes
against those who live quietly in the land.
chapters.zh: 因为他们不说和平话， 倒想出诡诈的言语害地上的安静人。

chapters.en: They gape at me and say, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen!”
chapters.zh: 他们大大张口攻击我，说： 阿哈，阿哈，我们的眼已经看见了！

chapters.en: O LORD, You have seen it; be not silent. O Lord, be not far from me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你已经看见了，求你不要闭口！ 主啊，求你不要远离我！

chapters.en: Awake and rise to my defense, to my cause, my God and my Lord!
chapters.zh: 我的上帝我的主啊，求你奋兴醒起， 判清我的事，伸明我的冤！

chapters.en: Vindicate me by Your righteousness, O LORD my God, and do not let them gloat over me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－我的上帝啊，求你按你的公义判断我， 不容他们向我夸耀！

chapters.en: Let them not say in their hearts, “Aha, just what we wanted!” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up!”
chapters.zh: 不容他们心里说：阿哈，遂我们的心愿了！ 不容他们说：我们已经把他吞了！

chapters.en: May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.
chapters.zh: 愿那喜欢我遭难的一同抱愧蒙羞！ 愿那向我妄自尊大的披惭愧，蒙羞辱！

chapters.en: May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being.”
chapters.zh: 愿那喜悦我冤屈得伸的〔注：冤屈得伸：原文是公义〕欢呼快乐； 愿他们常说：当尊耶和华为大！ 耶和华喜悦他的仆人平安。

chapters.en: Then my tongue will proclaim Your righteousness and Your praises all day long.
chapters.zh: 我的舌头要终日论说你的公义， 时常赞美你。

chapters.en: An oracle is in my heart regarding the transgression of the wicked man: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
chapters.zh: 恶人的罪过在他心里说： 我眼中不怕上帝！

chapters.en: For his eyes are too full of conceit to detect or hate his own sin.
chapters.zh: 他自夸自媚， 以为他的罪孽终不显露，不被恨恶。

chapters.en: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; he has ceased to be wise and well-doing.
chapters.zh: 他口中的言语尽是罪孽诡诈； 他与智慧善行已经断绝。

chapters.en:
Even on his bed he plots wickedness; he sets himself on a path that is not good;
he fails to reject evil.
chapters.zh: 他在床上图谋罪孽， 定意行不善的道，不憎恶恶事。

chapters.en: Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你的慈爱上及诸天； 你的信实达到穹苍。

chapters.en:
Your righteousness is like the highest mountains; Your judgments are like the deepest sea.
O LORD, You preserve man and beast.
chapters.zh: 你的公义好像高山； 你的判断如同深渊。 耶和华啊，人民、牲畜，你都救护。

chapters.en:
How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge
in the shadow of Your wings!
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你的慈爱何其宝贵！ 世人投靠在你翅膀的荫下。

chapters.en: They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.
chapters.zh: 他们必因你殿里的肥甘得以饱足； 你也必叫他们喝你乐河的〔水〕。

chapters.en: For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.
chapters.zh: 因为，在你那里有生命的源头； 在你的光中，我们必得见光。

chapters.en: Extend Your loving devotion to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.
chapters.zh: 愿你常施慈爱给认识你的人， 常以公义待心里正直的人。

chapters.en: Let not the foot of the proud come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.
chapters.zh: 不容骄傲人的脚践踏我； 不容凶恶人的手赶逐我。

chapters.en: There the evildoers lie fallen, thrown down and unable to rise.
chapters.zh: 在那里，作孽的人已经仆倒； 他们被推倒，不能再起来。

chapters.en: Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.
chapters.zh: 不要为作恶的心怀不平， 也不要向那行不义的生出嫉妒。

chapters.en: For they wither quickly like grass and wilt like tender plants.
chapters.zh: 因为他们如草快被割下， 又如青菜快要枯干。

chapters.en: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
chapters.zh: 你当倚靠耶和华而行善， 住在地上，以他的信实为粮；

chapters.en: Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
chapters.zh: 又要以耶和华为乐， 他就将你心里所求的赐给你。

chapters.en: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.
chapters.zh: 当将你的事交讬耶和华， 并倚靠他，他就必成全。

chapters.en: He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, your justice like the noonday sun.
chapters.zh: 他要使你的公义如光发出， 使你的公平明如正午。

chapters.en: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.
chapters.zh: 你当默然倚靠耶和华，耐性等候他； 不要因那道路通达的和那恶谋成就的心怀不平。

chapters.en: Refrain from anger and abandon wrath; do not fret—it can only bring harm.
chapters.zh: 当止住怒气，离弃忿怒； 不要心怀不平，以致作恶。

chapters.en: For the evildoers will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.
chapters.zh: 因为作恶的必被剪除； 惟有等候耶和华的必承受地土。

chapters.en: Yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.
chapters.zh: 还有片时，恶人要归于无有； 你就是细察他的住处也要归于无有。

chapters.en: But the meek will inherit the land and delight in abundant prosperity.
chapters.zh: 但谦卑人必承受地土， 以丰盛的平安为乐。

chapters.en: The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them,
chapters.zh: 恶人设谋害义人， 又向他咬牙。

chapters.en: but the Lord laughs, seeing that their day is coming.
chapters.zh: 主要笑他， 因见他〔受罚〕的日子将要来到。

chapters.en: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.
chapters.zh: 恶人已经弓上弦，刀出鞘， 要打倒困苦穷乏的人， 要杀害行动正直的人。

chapters.en: But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.
chapters.zh: 他们的刀必刺入自己的心； 他们的弓必被折断。

chapters.en: Better is the little of the righteous than the abundance of many who are wicked.
chapters.zh: 一个义人所有的虽少， 强过许多恶人的富余。

chapters.en: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
chapters.zh: 因为恶人的膀臂必被折断； 但耶和华是扶持义人。

chapters.en: The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.
chapters.zh: 耶和华知道完全人的日子； 他们的产业要存到永远。

chapters.en: In the time of evil they will not be ashamed, and in the days of famine they will be satisfied.
chapters.zh: 他们在急难的时候不致羞愧， 在饥荒的日子必得饱足。

chapters.en: But the wicked and enemies of the LORD will perish like the glory of the fields. They will vanish; like smoke they will fade away.
chapters.zh: 恶人却要灭亡。 耶和华的仇敌要像羊羔的脂油〔注：或译：像草地的华美〕； 他们要消灭，要如烟消灭。

chapters.en: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous are gracious and giving.
chapters.zh: 恶人借贷而不偿还； 义人却恩待人，并且施舍。

chapters.en: Surely those He blesses will inherit the land, but the cursed will be destroyed.
chapters.zh: 蒙耶和华赐福的必承受地土； 被他咒诅的必被剪除。

chapters.en: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.
chapters.zh: 义人的脚步被耶和华立定； 他的道路，耶和华也喜爱。

chapters.en: Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed, for the LORD is holding his hand.
chapters.zh: 他虽失脚也不致全身仆倒， 因为耶和华用手搀扶他〔注：或译：搀扶他的手〕。

chapters.en:
I once was young and now am old, yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned
or their children begging for bread.
chapters.zh: 我从前年幼，现在年老， 却未见过义人被弃， 也未见过他的后裔讨饭。

chapters.en: They are ever generous and quick to lend, and their children are a blessing.
chapters.zh: 他终日恩待人，借给人； 他的后裔也蒙福！

chapters.en: Turn away from evil and do good, so that you will abide forever.
chapters.zh: 你当离恶行善， 就可永远〔安〕居。

chapters.en: For the LORD loves justice and will not forsake His saints. They are preserved forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.
chapters.zh: 因为，耶和华喜爱公平， 不撇弃他的圣民； 他们永蒙保佑， 但恶人的后裔必被剪除。

chapters.en: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.
chapters.zh: 义人必承受地土， 永居其上。

chapters.en: The mouth of the righteous man utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
chapters.zh: 义人的口谈论智慧； 他的舌头讲说公平。

chapters.en: The law of his God is in his heart; his steps do not falter.
chapters.zh: 上帝的律法在他心里； 他的脚总不滑跌。

chapters.en: Though the wicked lie in wait for the righteous, and seek to slay them,
chapters.zh: 恶人窥探义人， 想要杀他。

chapters.en: the LORD will not leave them in their power or let them be condemned under judgment.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必不撇他在恶人手中； 当审判的时候，也不定他的罪。

chapters.en: Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
chapters.zh: 你当等候耶和华，遵守他的道， 他就抬举你，使你承受地土； 恶人被剪除的时候，你必看见。

chapters.en: I have seen a wicked, ruthless man flourishing like a well-rooted native tree,
chapters.zh: 我见过恶人大有势力， 好像一棵青翠树在本土生发。

chapters.en: yet he passed away and was no more; though I searched, he could not be found.
chapters.zh: 有人从那里经过，不料，他没有了； 我也寻找他，却寻不着。

chapters.en: Consider the blameless and observe the upright, for posterity awaits the man of peace.
chapters.zh: 你要细察那完全人，观看那正直人， 因为和平人有〔好〕结局。

chapters.en: But the transgressors will all be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.
chapters.zh: 至于犯法的人，必一同灭绝； 恶人终必剪除。

chapters.en: The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; He is their stronghold in time of trouble.
chapters.zh: 但义人得救是由于耶和华； 他在患难时作他们的营寨。

chapters.en:
The LORD helps and delivers them; He rescues and saves them from the wicked,
because they take refuge in Him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华帮助他们，解救他们； 他解救他们脱离恶人，把他们救出来， 因为他们投靠他。

chapters.en: O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要在怒中责备我， 不要在烈怒中惩罚我！

chapters.en: For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.
chapters.zh: 因为，你的箭射入我身； 你的手压住我。

chapters.en: There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.
chapters.zh: 因你的恼怒，我的肉无一完全； 因我的罪过，我的骨头也不安宁。

chapters.en: For my iniquities have overwhelmed me; they are a burden too heavy to bear.
chapters.zh: 我的罪孽高过我的头， 如同重担叫我担当不起。

chapters.en: My wounds are foul and festering because of my sinful folly.
chapters.zh: 因我的愚昧， 我的伤发臭流脓。

chapters.en: I am bent and brought low; all day long I go about mourning.
chapters.zh: 我疼痛，大大拳曲， 终日哀痛。

chapters.en: For my loins are full of burning pain, and no soundness remains in my body.
chapters.zh: 我满腰是火； 我的肉无一完全。

chapters.en: I am numb and badly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.
chapters.zh: 我被压伤，身体疲倦； 因心里不安，我就唉哼。

chapters.en: O Lord, my every desire is before You; my groaning is not hidden from You.
chapters.zh: 主啊，我的心愿都在你面前； 我的叹息不向你隐瞒。

chapters.en: My heart pounds, my strength fails, and even the light of my eyes has faded.
chapters.zh: 我心跳动，我力衰微， 连我眼中的光也没有了。

chapters.en: My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.
chapters.zh: 我的良朋密友因我的灾病都躲在旁边站着； 我的亲戚本家也远远地站立。

chapters.en:
Those who seek my life lay snares; those who wish me harm speak destruction,
plotting deceit all day long.
chapters.zh: 那寻索我命的设下网罗； 那想要害我的口出恶言， 终日思想诡计。

chapters.en: But like a deaf man, I do not hear; and like a mute man, I do not open my mouth.
chapters.zh: 但我如聋子不听， 像哑巴不开口。

chapters.en: I am like a man who cannot hear, whose mouth offers no reply.
chapters.zh: 我如不听见的人， 口中没有回话。

chapters.en: I wait for You, O LORD; You will answer, O Lord my God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我仰望你！ 主－我的上帝啊，你必应允我！

chapters.en: For I said, “Let them not gloat over me— those who taunt me when my foot slips.”
chapters.zh: 我曾说：恐怕他们向我夸耀； 我失脚的时候，他们向我夸大。

chapters.en: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever with me.
chapters.zh: 我几乎跌倒； 我的痛苦常在我面前。

chapters.en: Yes, I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.
chapters.zh: 我要承认我的罪孽； 我要因我的罪忧愁。

chapters.en: Many are my enemies without cause, and many hate me without reason.
chapters.zh: 但我的仇敌又活泼又强壮， 无理恨我的增多了。

chapters.en: Those who repay my good with evil attack me for pursuing the good.
chapters.zh: 以恶报善的与我作对， 因我是追求良善。

chapters.en: Do not forsake me, O LORD; be not far from me, O my God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要撇弃我！ 我的上帝啊，求你不要远离我！

chapters.en: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.
chapters.zh: 拯救我的主啊，求你快快帮助我！

chapters.en: I said, “I will watch my ways so that I will not sin with my tongue; I will guard my mouth with a muzzle as long as the wicked are present.”
chapters.zh: 我曾说：我要谨慎我的言行， 免得我舌头犯罪； 恶人在我面前的时候， 我要用嚼环勒住我的口。

chapters.en:
I was speechless and still; I remained silent, even from speaking good,
and my sorrow was stirred.
chapters.zh: 我默然无声，连好话也不出口； 我的愁苦就发动了，

chapters.en:
My heart grew hot within me; as I mused, the fire burned.
Then I spoke with my tongue:
chapters.zh: 我的心在我里面发热。 我默想的时候，火就烧起， 我便用舌头说话。

chapters.en:
“Show me, O LORD, my end and the measure of my days.
Let me know how fleeting my life is.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你叫我晓得我身之终！ 我的寿数几何？ 叫我知道我的生命不长！

chapters.en: You, indeed, have made my days as handbreadths, and my lifetime as nothing before You. Truly each man at his best exists as but a breath. Selah
chapters.zh: 你使我的年日窄如手掌； 我一生的年数，在你面前如同无有。 各人最稳妥的时候，真是全然虚幻。（细拉）

chapters.en: Surely every man goes about like a phantom; surely he bustles in vain; he heaps up riches not knowing who will haul them away.
chapters.zh: 世人行动实系幻影。 他们忙乱，真是枉然； 积蓄〔财宝〕，不知将来有谁收取。

chapters.en: And now, O Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in You.
chapters.zh: 主啊，如今我等什么呢？ 我的指望在乎你！

chapters.en: Deliver me from all my transgressions; do not make me the reproach of fools.
chapters.zh: 求你救我脱离一切的过犯， 不要使我受愚顽人的羞辱。

chapters.en:
I have become mute; I do not open my mouth
because of what You have done.
chapters.zh: 因我所遭遇的是出于你， 我就默然不语。

chapters.en: Remove Your scourge from me; I am perishing by the force of Your hand.
chapters.zh: 求你把你的责罚从我身上免去； 因你手的责打，我便消灭。

chapters.en:
You discipline and correct a man for his iniquity, consuming like a moth what he holds dear;
surely each man is but a vapor. Selah
chapters.zh: 你因人的罪恶惩罚他的时候， 叫他的笑容〔注：的笑容：或译所喜爱的〕消灭，如〔衣〕被虫所咬。 世人真是虚幻！（细拉）

chapters.en:
Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear to my cry for help; do not be deaf to my weeping. For I am a foreigner dwelling with You,
a stranger like all my fathers.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你听我的祷告， 留心听我的呼求！ 我流泪，求你不要静默无声！ 因为我在你面前是客旅， 是寄居的，像我列祖一般。

chapters.en:
Turn Your gaze away from me, that I may again be cheered
before I depart and am no more.”
chapters.zh: 求你宽容我， 使我在去而不返之先可以力量复原。

chapters.en: I waited patiently for the LORD; He inclined to me and heard my cry.
chapters.zh: 我曾耐性等候耶和华； 他垂听我的呼求。

chapters.en: He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.
chapters.zh: 他从祸坑里， 从淤泥中，把我拉上来， 使我的脚立在磐石上， 使我脚步稳当。

chapters.en: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他使我口唱新歌， 就是赞美我们上帝的话。 许多人必看见而惧怕， 并要倚靠耶和华。

chapters.en: Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.
chapters.zh: 那倚靠耶和华、 不理会狂傲和偏向虚假之辈的， 这人便为有福！

chapters.en: Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us— none can compare to You— if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－我的上帝啊，你所行的奇事， 并你向我们所怀的意念甚多，不能向你陈明； 若要陈明，其事不可胜数。

chapters.en: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but my ears You have opened. Burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not require.
chapters.zh: 祭物和礼物，你不喜悦； 你已经开通我的耳朵。 燔祭和赎罪祭非你所要。

chapters.en: Then I said, “Here I am, I have come— it is written about me in the scroll:
chapters.zh: 那时我说：看哪，我来了！ 我的事在经卷上已经记载了。

chapters.en: I delight to do Your will, O my God; Your law is within my heart.”
chapters.zh: 我的上帝啊，我乐意照你的旨意行； 你的律法在我心里。

chapters.en:
I proclaim righteousness in the great assembly; behold, I do not seal my lips,
as You, O LORD, do know.
chapters.zh: 我在大会中宣传公义的佳音； 我必不止住我的嘴唇。 耶和华啊，这是你所知道的。

chapters.en: I have not covered up Your righteousness in my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and salvation; I have not concealed Your loving devotion and faithfulness from the great assembly.
chapters.zh: 我未曾把你的公义藏在心里； 我已陈明你的信实和你的救恩； 我在大会中未曾隐瞒你的慈爱和诚实。

chapters.en: O LORD, do not withhold Your mercy from me; Your loving devotion and faithfulness will always guard me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要向我止住你的慈悲！ 愿你的慈爱和诚实常常保佑我！

chapters.en: For evils without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, so that I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has failed within me.
chapters.zh: 因有无数的祸患围困我， 我的罪孽追上了我，使我不能昂首； 这罪孽比我的头发还多， 我就心寒胆战。

chapters.en: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; hurry, O LORD, to help me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你开恩搭救我！ 耶和华啊，求你速速帮助我！

chapters.en: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.
chapters.zh: 愿那些寻找我、要灭我命的，一同抱愧蒙羞！ 愿那些喜悦我受害的，退后受辱！

chapters.en: May those who say to me, “Aha, aha!” be appalled at their own shame.
chapters.zh: 愿那些对我说阿哈、阿哈的， 因羞愧而败亡！

chapters.en: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The LORD be magnified!”
chapters.zh: 愿一切寻求你的，因你高兴欢喜！ 愿那些喜爱你救恩的，常说：当尊耶和华为大！

chapters.en: But I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my helper and deliverer; O my God, do not delay.
chapters.zh: 但我是困苦穷乏的，主仍顾念我； 你是帮助我的，搭救我的。 上帝啊，求你不要耽延！

chapters.en: Blessed is the one who cares for the poor; the LORD will deliver him in the day of trouble.
chapters.zh: 眷顾贫穷的有福了！ 他遭难的日子，耶和华必搭救他。

chapters.en: The LORD will protect and preserve him; He will bless him in the land and refuse to give him over to the will of his foes.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必保全他，使他存活； 他必在地上享福。 求你不要把他交给仇敌，遂其所愿。

chapters.en: The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness and restore him from his bed of sickness.
chapters.zh: 他病重在榻，耶和华必扶持他； 他在病中，你必给他铺床。

chapters.en: I said, “O LORD, be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against You.”
chapters.zh: 我曾说：耶和华啊，求你怜恤我，医治我！ 因为我得罪了你。

chapters.en: My enemies say with malice: “When will he die and be forgotten?”
chapters.zh: 我的仇敌用恶言议论我〔说〕： 他几时死，他的名才灭亡呢？

chapters.en:
My visitor speaks falsehood; he gathers slander in his heart;
he goes out and spreads it abroad.
chapters.zh: 他来看〔我〕就说假话； 他心存奸恶，走到外边才说出来。

chapters.en: All who hate me whisper against me; they imagine the worst for me:
chapters.zh: 一切恨我的，都交头接耳地议论我； 他们设计要害我。

chapters.en: “A vile disease has been poured into him; he will never get up from where he lies!”
chapters.zh: 〔他们说〕：有怪病贴在他身上； 他已躺卧，必不能再起来。

chapters.en:
Even my close friend whom I trusted, the one who shared my bread,
has lifted up his heel against me.
chapters.zh: 连我知己的朋友， 我所倚靠、吃过我饭的也用脚踢我。

chapters.en: But You, O LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, that I may repay them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你怜恤我， 使我起来，好报复他们！

chapters.en: By this I know that You delight in me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.
chapters.zh: 因我的仇敌不得向我夸胜， 我从此便知道你喜爱我。

chapters.en: In my integrity You uphold me and set me in Your presence forever.
chapters.zh: 你因我纯正就扶持我， 使我永远站在你的面前。

chapters.en:
Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.
Amen and Amen.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－以色列的上帝是应当称颂的， 从亘古直到永远。阿们！阿们！

chapters.en: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，我的心切慕你， 如鹿切慕溪水。

chapters.en: My soul thirsts for God, the living God. When shall I come and appear in God’s presence?
chapters.zh: 我的心渴想上帝，就是永生上帝； 我几时得朝见上帝呢？

chapters.en: My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”
chapters.zh: 我昼夜以眼泪当饮食； 人不住地对我说：你的上帝在哪里呢？

chapters.en: These things come to mind as I pour out my soul: how I walked with the multitude, leading the festive procession to the house of God with shouts of joy and praise.
chapters.zh: 我从前与众人同往， 用欢呼称赞的声音 领他们到上帝的殿里，大家守节。 我追想这些事， 我的心极其悲伤。

chapters.en: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.
chapters.zh: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？ 为何在我里面烦躁？ 应当仰望上帝，因他笑脸帮助我； 我还要称赞他。

chapters.en: O my God, my soul despairs within me. Therefore I remember You from the land of Jordan and the peaks of Hermon— even from Mount Mizar.
chapters.zh: 我的上帝啊，我的心在我里面忧闷， 所以我从约旦地， 从黑门岭，从米萨山记念你。

chapters.en: Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.
chapters.zh: 你的瀑布发声，深渊就与深渊响应； 你的波浪洪涛漫过我身。

chapters.en:
The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me
as a prayer to the God of my life.
chapters.zh: 白昼，耶和华必向我施慈爱； 黑夜，我要歌颂祷告赐我生命的上帝。

chapters.en: I say to God my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”
chapters.zh: 我要对上帝－我的磐石说： 你为何忘记我呢？ 我为何因仇敌的欺压时常哀痛呢？

chapters.en: Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
chapters.zh: 我的敌人辱骂我， 好像打碎我的骨头， 不住地对我说： 你的上帝在哪里呢？

chapters.en: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
chapters.zh: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？ 为何在我里面烦躁？ 应当仰望上帝，因我还要称赞他。 他是我脸上的光荣〔注：原文是帮助〕，是我的上帝。

chapters.en:
Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation;
deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你伸我的冤， 向不虔诚的国为我辨屈； 求你救我脱离诡诈不义的人。

chapters.en: For You are the God of my refuge. Why have You rejected me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?
chapters.zh: 因为你是赐我力量的上帝，为何丢弃我呢？ 我为何因仇敌的欺压时常哀痛呢？

chapters.en: Send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain and to the place where You dwell.
chapters.zh: 求你发出你的亮光和真实，好引导我， 带我到你的圣山，到你的居所！

chapters.en: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my greatest joy. I will praise You with the harp, O God, my God.
chapters.zh: 我就走到上帝的祭坛， 到我最喜乐的上帝那里。 上帝啊，我的上帝， 我要弹琴称赞你！

chapters.en: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
chapters.zh: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？ 为何在我里面烦躁？ 应当仰望上帝，因我还要称赞他。 他是我脸上的光荣〔注：原文是帮助〕，是我的上帝。

chapters.en: We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us the work You did in their days, in the days of old.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你在古时， 我们列祖的日子所行的事， 我们亲耳听见了； 我们的列祖也给我们述说过。

chapters.en: With Your hand You drove out the nations and planted our fathers there; You crushed the peoples and cast them out.
chapters.zh: 你曾用手赶出外邦人， 却栽培了我们列祖； 你苦待列邦， 却叫我们列祖发达。

chapters.en:
For it was not by their sword that they took the land; their arm did not bring them victory. It was by Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your face,
because You favored them.
chapters.zh: 因为他们不是靠自己的刀剑得地土， 也不是靠自己的膀臂得胜， 乃是靠你的右手、你的膀臂， 和你脸上的亮光， 因为你喜悦他们。

chapters.en: You are my King, O God, who ordains victories for Jacob.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你是我的王； 求你出令使雅各得胜。

chapters.en: Through You we repel our foes; through Your name we trample our enemies.
chapters.zh: 我们靠你要推倒我们的敌人， 靠你的名要践踏那起来攻击我们的人。

chapters.en: For I do not trust in my bow, nor does my sword save me.
chapters.zh: 因为，我必不靠我的弓； 我的刀也不能使我得胜。

chapters.en: For You save us from our enemies; You put those who hate us to shame.
chapters.zh: 惟你救了我们脱离敌人， 使恨我们的人羞愧。

chapters.en: In God we have boasted all day long, and Your name we will praise forever. Selah
chapters.zh: 我们终日因上帝夸耀， 还要永远称谢你的名。（细拉）

chapters.en: But You have rejected and humbled us; You no longer go forth with our armies.
chapters.zh: 但如今你丢弃了我们，使我们受辱， 不和我们的军兵同去。

chapters.en: You have made us retreat from the foe, and those who hate us have plundered us.
chapters.zh: 你使我们向敌人转身退后； 那恨我们的人任意抢夺。

chapters.en: You have given us up as sheep to be devoured; You have scattered us among the nations.
chapters.zh: 你使我们当作快要被吃的羊， 把我们分散在列邦中。

chapters.en: You sell Your people for nothing; no profit do You gain from their sale.
chapters.zh: 你卖了你的子民也不赚利， 所得的价值并不加添你的〔资财〕。

chapters.en: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and derision to those around us.
chapters.zh: 你使我们受邻国的羞辱， 被四围的人嗤笑讥刺。

chapters.en: You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.
chapters.zh: 你使我们在列邦中作了笑谈， 使众民向我们摇头。

chapters.en: All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face,
chapters.zh: 我的凌辱终日在我面前， 我脸上的羞愧将我遮蔽，

chapters.en: at the voice of the scorner and reviler, because of the enemy, bent on revenge.
chapters.zh: 都因那辱骂毁谤人的声音， 又因仇敌和报仇人的缘故。

chapters.en:
All this has come upon us, though we have not forgotten You
or betrayed Your covenant.
chapters.zh: 这都临到我们身上， 我们却没有忘记你， 也没有违背你的约。

chapters.en: Our hearts have not turned back; our steps have not strayed from Your path.
chapters.zh: 我们的心没有退后； 我们的脚也没有偏离你的路。

chapters.en: But You have crushed us in the lair of jackals; You have covered us with deepest darkness.
chapters.zh: 你在野狗之处压伤我们， 用死荫遮蔽我们。

chapters.en: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,
chapters.zh: 倘若我们忘了上帝的名， 或向别神举手，

chapters.en: would not God have discovered, since He knows the secrets of the heart?
chapters.zh: 上帝岂不鉴察这事吗？ 因为他晓得人心里的隐秘。

chapters.en: Yet for Your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.
chapters.zh: 我们为你的缘故终日被杀； 人看我们如将宰的羊。

chapters.en: Wake up, O Lord! Why are You sleeping? Arise! Do not reject us forever.
chapters.zh: 主啊，求你睡醒，为何尽睡呢？ 求你兴起，不要永远丢弃〔我们〕！

chapters.en: Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression?
chapters.zh: 你为何掩面， 不顾我们所遭的苦难和所受的欺压？

chapters.en: For our soul has sunk to the dust; our bodies cling to the earth.
chapters.zh: 我们的性命伏于尘土； 我们的肚腹紧贴地面。

chapters.en: Rise up; be our help! Redeem us on account of Your loving devotion.
chapters.zh: 求你起来帮助我们！ 凭你的慈爱救赎我们！

chapters.en:
My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses to the king;
my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.
chapters.zh: 我心里涌出美辞； 我论到我为王做的事， 我的舌头是快手笔。

chapters.en:
You are the most handsome of men; grace has anointed your lips;
therefore God has blessed you forever.
chapters.zh: 你比世人更美； 在你嘴里满有恩惠； 所以上帝赐福给你，直到永远。

chapters.en: Strap your sword at your side, O mighty warrior; appear in your majesty and splendor.
chapters.zh: 大能者啊，愿你腰间佩刀， 大有荣耀和威严！

chapters.en:
In your splendor ride forth in victory on behalf of truth and humility and justice;
may your right hand show your awesome deeds.
chapters.zh: 为真理、谦卑、公义赫然坐车前往，无不得胜； 你的右手必显明可畏的事。

chapters.en: Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s foes; the nations fall beneath your feet.
chapters.zh: 你的箭锋快，射中王敌之心； 万民仆倒在你以下。

chapters.en: Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你的宝座是永永远远的； 你的国权是正直的。

chapters.en: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.
chapters.zh: 你喜爱公义，恨恶罪恶； 所以上帝－就是你的上帝－用喜乐油膏你， 胜过膏你的同伴。

chapters.en:
All your garments are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia;
from palaces of ivory the harps make you glad.
chapters.zh: 你的衣服都有没药、沉香、肉桂〔的香气〕； 象牙宫中有丝弦乐器的声音使你欢喜。

chapters.en:
The daughters of kings are among your honored women; the queen stands at your right hand,
adorned with the gold of Ophir.
chapters.zh: 有君王的女儿在你尊贵妇女之中； 王后佩戴俄斐金饰站在你右边。

chapters.en: Listen, O daughter! Consider and incline your ear: Forget your people and your father’s house,
chapters.zh: 女子啊，你要听，要想，要侧耳而听！ 不要记念你的民和你的父家，

chapters.en: and the king will desire your beauty; bow to him, for he is your lord.
chapters.zh: 王就羨慕你的美貌； 因为他是你的主，你当敬拜他。

chapters.en: The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; men of wealth will seek your favor.
chapters.zh: 泰尔的民〔注：原文是女子〕〔必来〕送礼； 民中的富足人也必向你求恩。

chapters.en: All glorious is the princess in her chamber; her gown is embroidered with gold.
chapters.zh: 王女在〔宫〕里极其荣华； 她的衣服是用金〔线〕绣的。

chapters.en: In colorful garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions are brought before you.
chapters.zh: 她要穿锦绣的衣服，被引到王前； 随从她的陪伴童女也要被带到你面前。

chapters.en: They are led in with joy and gladness; they enter the palace of the king.
chapters.zh: 她们要欢喜快乐被引导； 她们要进入王宫。

chapters.en: Your sons will succeed your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.
chapters.zh: 你的子孙要接续你的列祖； 你要立他们在全地作王。

chapters.en: I will commemorate your name through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you forever and ever.
chapters.zh: 我必叫你的名被万代记念， 所以万民要永永远远称谢你。

chapters.en: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
chapters.zh: 上帝是我们的避难所，是我们的力量， 是〔我们〕在患难中随时的帮助。

chapters.en: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas,
chapters.zh: 所以，地虽改变， 山虽摇动到海心，

chapters.en: though their waters roar and foam and the mountains quake in the surge. Selah
chapters.zh: 其中的水虽匉訇翻腾， 山虽因海涨而战抖， 我们也不害怕。（细拉）

chapters.en: There is a river whose streams delight the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.
chapters.zh: 有一道河，这河的分汊使上帝的城欢喜； 这城就是至高者居住的圣所。

chapters.en: God is within her; she will not be moved. God will help her when morning dawns.
chapters.zh: 上帝在其中，城必不动摇； 到天一亮，上帝必帮助这城。

chapters.en: Nations rage, kingdoms crumble; the earth melts when He lifts His voice.
chapters.zh: 外邦喧嚷，列国动摇； 上帝发声，地便镕化。

chapters.en: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华与我们同在； 雅各的上帝是我们的避难所！（细拉）

chapters.en: Come, see the works of the LORD, who brings devastation upon the earth.
chapters.zh: 你们来看耶和华的作为， 看他使地怎样荒凉。

chapters.en:
He makes wars to cease throughout the earth; He breaks the bow and shatters the spear;
He burns the shields in the fire.
chapters.zh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极； 他折弓、断枪，把战车焚烧在火中。

chapters.en:
“Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations,
I will be exalted over the earth.”
chapters.zh: 你们要休息，要知道我是上帝！ 我必在外邦中被尊崇，在遍地上也被尊崇。

chapters.en: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华与我们同在； 雅各的上帝是我们的避难所！

chapters.en: Clap your hands, all you peoples; shout unto God with a voice of triumph.
chapters.zh: 万民哪，你们都要拍掌！ 要用夸胜的声音向上帝呼喊！

chapters.en: How awesome is the LORD Most High, the great King over all the earth!
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华至高者是可畏的； 他是治理全地的大君王。

chapters.en: He subdues nations beneath us, and peoples under our feet.
chapters.zh: 他叫万民服在我们以下， 又叫列邦服在我们脚下。

chapters.en: He chooses our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom He loves. Selah
chapters.zh: 他为我们选择产业， 就是他所爱之雅各的荣耀。（细拉）

chapters.en: God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the LORD with the sound of the horn.
chapters.zh: 上帝上升，有喊声相送； 耶和华上升，有角声相送。

chapters.en: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises!
chapters.zh: 你们要向上帝歌颂，歌颂！ 向我们王歌颂，歌颂！

chapters.en: For God is King of all the earth; sing to Him a psalm of praise.
chapters.zh: 因为上帝是全地的王； 你们要用悟性歌颂。

chapters.en: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on His holy throne.
chapters.zh: 上帝作王治理万国； 上帝坐在他的圣宝座上。

chapters.en: The nobles of the nations have assembled as the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth belong to God; He is highly exalted.
chapters.zh: 列邦的君王聚集要作亚伯拉罕之上帝的民。 因为世界的盾牌是属上帝的； 他为至高！

chapters.en: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, His holy mountain.
chapters.zh: 耶和华本为大！ 在我们上帝的城中， 在他的圣山上，该受大赞美。

chapters.en: Beautiful in loftiness, the joy of all the earth, like the peaks of Zaphon is Mount Zion, the city of the great King.
chapters.zh: 锡安山－大君王的城， 在北面居高华美， 为全地所喜悦。

chapters.en: God is in her citadels; He has shown Himself to be a fortress.
chapters.zh: 上帝在其宫中， 自显为避难所。

chapters.en: For behold, the kings assembled; they all advanced together.
chapters.zh: 看哪，众王会合， 一同经过。

chapters.en: They saw and were astounded; they fled in terror.
chapters.zh: 他们见了这城就惊奇丧胆， 急忙逃跑。

chapters.en: Trembling seized them there, anguish like a woman in labor.
chapters.zh: 他们在那里被战兢疼痛抓住， 好像产难的妇人一样。

chapters.en: With a wind from the east You wrecked the ships of Tarshish.
chapters.zh: 〔上帝啊〕，你用东风打破他施的船只。

chapters.en: As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of Hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish her forever. Selah
chapters.zh: 我们在万军之耶和华的城中 －就是我们上帝的城中－所看见的， 正如我们所听见的。 上帝必坚立这城，直到永远。（细拉）

chapters.en: Within Your temple, O God, we contemplate Your loving devotion.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，我们在你的殿中想念你的慈爱。

chapters.en:
Your name, O God, like Your praise, reaches to the ends of the earth;
Your right hand is full of righteousness.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你受的赞美正与你的名相称，直到地极！ 你的右手满了公义。

chapters.en:
Mount Zion is glad, the daughters of Judah rejoice,
on account of Your judgments.
chapters.zh: 因你的判断，锡安山应当欢喜， 犹大的城邑〔注：原文是女子〕应当快乐。

chapters.en: March around Zion, encircle her, count her towers,
chapters.zh: 你们当周游锡安， 四围旋绕，数点城楼，

chapters.en: consider her ramparts, tour her citadels, that you may tell the next generation.
chapters.zh: 细看她的外郭， 察看她的宫殿， 为要传说到后代。

chapters.en: For this God is our God forever and ever; He will be our guide even till death.
chapters.zh: 因为这上帝永永远远为我们的上帝； 他必作我们引路的，直到死时。

chapters.en: Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all inhabitants of the world,
chapters.zh: 万民哪，你们都当听这话！ 世上一切的居民，

chapters.en: both low and high, rich and poor alike.
chapters.zh: 无论上流下流，富足贫穷， 都当留心听！

chapters.en: My mouth will impart wisdom, and the meditation of my heart will bring understanding.
chapters.zh: 我口要说智慧的言语； 我心要想通达的道理。

chapters.en: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will express my riddle with the harp:
chapters.zh: 我要侧耳听比喻， 用琴解谜语。

chapters.en: Why should I fear in times of trouble, when wicked usurpers surround me?
chapters.zh: 在患难的日子，奸恶随我脚跟，四面环绕我， 我何必惧怕？

chapters.en: They trust in their wealth and boast in their great riches.
chapters.zh: 那些倚仗财货自夸钱财多的人，

chapters.en: No man can possibly redeem his brother or pay his ransom to God.
chapters.zh: 一个也无法赎自己的弟兄， 也不能替他将赎价给上帝，

chapters.en: For the redemption of his soul is costly, and never can payment suffice,
that he should live on forever and not see decay.
chapters.zh: 叫他长远活着，不见朽坏； 因为赎他生命的价值极贵， 只可永远罢休。

chapters.en:
For it is clear that wise men die, and the foolish and the senseless both perish
and leave their wealth to others.
chapters.zh: 他必见智慧人死， 又见愚顽人和畜类人一同灭亡， 将他们的财货留给别人。

chapters.en:
Their graves are their eternal homes— their dwellings for endless generations—
even though their lands were their namesakes.
chapters.zh: 他们心里思想： 他们的家室必永存， 住宅必留到万代； 他们以自己的名称自己的地。

chapters.en: But a man, despite his wealth, cannot endure; he is like the beasts that perish.
chapters.zh: 但人居尊贵中不能长久， 如同死亡的畜类一样。

chapters.en: This is the fate of the foolish and their followers who endorse their sayings. Selah
chapters.zh: 他们行的这道本为自己的愚昧； 但他们以后的人还佩服他们的话语。（细拉）

chapters.en:
Like sheep they are destined for Sheol. Death will be their shepherd. The upright will rule them in the morning, and their form will decay in Sheol,
far from their lofty abode.
chapters.zh: 他们如同羊群派定下阴间； 死亡必作他们的牧者。 到了早晨，正直人必管辖他们； 他们的美容必被阴间所灭，以致无处可存。

chapters.en: But God will redeem my life from Sheol, for He will surely take me to Himself. Selah
chapters.zh: 只是上帝必救赎我的灵魂脱离阴间的权柄， 因他必收纳我。（细拉）

chapters.en: Do not be afraid when a man grows rich, when the splendor of his house increases.
chapters.zh: 见人发财、家室增荣的时候， 你不要惧怕；

chapters.en: For when he dies, he will carry nothing away; his abundance will not follow him down.
chapters.zh: 因为，他死的时候什么也不能带去； 他的荣耀不能随他下去。

chapters.en: Though in his lifetime he blesses his soul— and men praise you when you prosper—
chapters.zh: 他活着的时候，虽然自夸为有福 （你若利己，人必夸奖你）；

chapters.en: he will join the generation of his fathers, who will never see the light of day.
chapters.zh: 他仍必归到他历代的祖宗那里， 永不见光。

chapters.en: A man who has riches without understanding is like the beasts that perish.
chapters.zh: 人在尊贵中而不醒悟， 就如死亡的畜类一样。

chapters.en:
The Mighty One, God the LORD, speaks and summons the earth
from where the sun rises to where it sets.
chapters.zh: 大能者上帝－耶和华已经发言招呼天下， 从日出之地到日落之处。

chapters.en: From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines forth.
chapters.zh: 从全美的锡安中， 上帝已经发光了。

chapters.en:
Our God approaches and will not be silent! Consuming fire precedes Him,
and a tempest rages around Him.
chapters.zh: 我们的上帝要来，决不闭口。 有烈火在他面前吞灭； 有暴风在他四围大刮。

chapters.en: He summons the heavens above, and the earth, that He may judge His people:
chapters.zh: 他招呼上天下地， 为要审判他的民，

chapters.en: “Gather to Me My saints, who made a covenant with Me by sacrifice.”
chapters.zh: 说：招聚我的圣民到我这里来， 就是那些用祭物与我立约的人。

chapters.en: And the heavens proclaim His righteousness, for God Himself is Judge. Selah
chapters.zh: 诸天必表明他的公义， 因为上帝是施行审判的。（细拉）

chapters.en:
“Hear, O My people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you:
I am God, your God.
chapters.zh: 我的民哪，你们当听我的话！ 以色列啊，我要劝戒你； 我是上帝，是你的上帝！

chapters.en: I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices, and your burnt offerings are ever before Me.
chapters.zh: 我并不因你的祭物责备你； 你的燔祭常在我面前。

chapters.en: I have no need for a bull from your stall or goats from your pens,
chapters.zh: 我不从你家中取公牛， 也不从你圈内取山羊；

chapters.en: for every beast of the forest is Mine— the cattle on a thousand hills.
chapters.zh: 因为，树林中的百兽是我的， 千山上的牲畜也是我的。

chapters.en: I know every bird in the mountains, and the creatures of the field are Mine.
chapters.zh: 山中的飞鸟，我都知道； 野地的走兽也都属我。

chapters.en: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is Mine, and the fullness thereof.
chapters.zh: 我若是饥饿，我不用告诉你， 因为世界和其中所充满的都是我的。

chapters.en: Do I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
chapters.zh: 我岂吃公牛的肉呢？ 我岂喝山羊的血呢？

chapters.en: Sacrifice a thank offering to God, and fulfill your vows to the Most High.
chapters.zh: 你们要以感谢为祭献与上帝， 又要向至高者还你的愿，

chapters.en: Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor Me.”
chapters.zh: 并要在患难之日求告我； 我必搭救你，你也要荣耀我。

chapters.en:
To the wicked, however, God says, “What right have you to recite My statutes
and to bear My covenant on your lips?
chapters.zh: 但上帝对恶人说：你怎敢传说我的律例， 口中提到我的约呢？

chapters.en: For you hate My instruction and cast My words behind you.
chapters.zh: 其实你恨恶管教， 将我的言语丢在背后。

chapters.en: When you see a thief, you befriend him, and throw in your lot with adulterers.
chapters.zh: 你见了盗贼就乐意与他同伙， 又与行奸淫的人一同有分。

chapters.en: You unleash your mouth for evil and harness your tongue to deceit.
chapters.zh: 你口任说恶言； 你舌编造诡诈。

chapters.en: You sit and malign your brother; you slander your own mother’s son.
chapters.zh: 你坐着毁谤你的兄弟， 谗毁你亲母的儿子。

chapters.en: You have done these things, and I kept silent; you thought I was just like you. But now I rebuke you and accuse you to your face.
chapters.zh: 你行了这些事，我还闭口不言， 你想我恰和你一样； 其实我要责备你，将这些事摆在你眼前。

chapters.en:
Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you to pieces,
with no one to rescue you:
chapters.zh: 你们忘记上帝的，要思想这事， 免得我把你们撕碎，无人搭救。

chapters.en:
He who sacrifices a thank offering honors Me, and to him who rightly orders his way,
I will show the salvation of God.”
chapters.zh: 凡以感谢献上为祭的便是荣耀我； 那按正路而行的，我必使他得着我的救恩。

chapters.en: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your loving devotion; according to Your great compassion, blot out my transgressions.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你按你的慈爱怜恤我！ 按你丰盛的慈悲涂抹我的过犯！

chapters.en: Wash me clean of my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.
chapters.zh: 求你将我的罪孽洗除净尽， 并洁除我的罪！

chapters.en: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.
chapters.zh: 因为，我知道我的过犯； 我的罪常在我面前。

chapters.en: Against You, You only, have I sinned and done what is evil in Your sight, so that You may be proved right when You speak and blameless when You judge.
chapters.zh: 我向你犯罪，惟独得罪了你； 在你眼前行了这恶， 以致你责备我的时候显为公义， 判断我的时候显为清正。

chapters.en: Surely I was brought forth in iniquity; I was sinful when my mother conceived me.
chapters.zh: 我是在罪孽里生的， 在我母亲怀胎的时候就有了罪。

chapters.en: Surely You desire truth in the inmost being; You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
chapters.zh: 你所喜爱的是内里诚实； 你在我隐密处，必使我得智慧。

chapters.en: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
chapters.zh: 求你用牛膝草洁净我，我就干净； 求你洗涤我，我就比雪更白。

chapters.en: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones You have crushed rejoice.
chapters.zh: 求你使我得听欢喜快乐〔的声音〕， 使你所压伤的骨头可以踊跃。
