chapters.en: Hide Your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquities.
chapters.zh: 求你掩面不看我的罪， 涂抹我一切的罪孽。

chapters.en: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你为我造清洁的心， 使我里面重新有正直〔注：或译：坚定〕的灵。

chapters.en: Cast me not away from Your presence; take not Your Holy Spirit from me.
chapters.zh: 不要丢弃我，使我离开你的面； 不要从我收回你的圣灵。

chapters.en: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and sustain me with a willing spirit.
chapters.zh: 求你使我仍得救恩之乐， 赐我乐意的灵扶持我，

chapters.en: Then I will teach transgressors Your ways, and sinners will return to You.
chapters.zh: 我就把你的道指教有过犯的人， 罪人必归顺你。

chapters.en:
Deliver me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation,
and my tongue will sing of Your righteousness.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你是拯救我的上帝； 求你救我脱离流人血的罪！ 我的舌头就高声歌唱你的公义。

chapters.en: O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.
chapters.zh: 主啊，求你使我嘴唇张开， 我的口便传扬赞美你的话！

chapters.en: For You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; You take no pleasure in burnt offerings.
chapters.zh: 你本不喜爱祭物，若喜爱，我就献上； 燔祭，你也不喜悦。

chapters.en:
The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart,
O God, You will not despise.
chapters.zh: 〔上帝所要〕的祭就是忧伤的灵； 上帝啊，忧伤痛悔的心，你必不轻看。

chapters.en: In Your good pleasure, cause Zion to prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 求你随你的美意善待锡安， 建造耶路撒冷的城墙。

chapters.en:
Then You will delight in righteous sacrifices, in whole burnt offerings;
then bulls will be offered on Your altar.
chapters.zh: 那时，你必喜爱公义的祭 和燔祭并全牲的燔祭； 那时，人必将公牛献在你坛上。

chapters.en: Why do you boast of evil, O mighty man? The loving devotion of God endures all day long.
chapters.zh: 勇士啊，你为何以作恶自夸？ 上帝的慈爱是常存的。

chapters.en:
Your tongue devises destruction like a sharpened razor,
O worker of deceit.
chapters.zh: 你的舌头邪恶诡诈， 好像剃头刀，快利伤人。

chapters.en: You love evil more than good, falsehood more than speaking truth. Selah
chapters.zh: 你爱恶胜似爱善， 又爱说谎，不爱说公义。（细拉）

chapters.en: You love every word that devours, O deceitful tongue.
chapters.zh: 诡诈的舌头啊， 你爱说一切毁灭的话！

chapters.en:
Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin; He will snatch you up and tear you away from your tent;
He will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah
chapters.zh: 上帝也要毁灭你，直到永远； 他要把你拿去，从你的帐棚中抽出， 从活人之地将你拔出。（细拉）

chapters.en: The righteous will see and fear; they will mock the evildoer, saying,
chapters.zh: 义人要看见而惧怕， 并要笑他，

chapters.en: “Look at the man who did not make God his refuge, but trusted in the abundance of his wealth and strengthened himself by destruction.”
chapters.zh: 说：看哪，这就是那不以上帝为他力量的人， 只倚仗他丰富的财物，在邪恶上坚立自己。

chapters.en: But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in the loving devotion of God forever and ever.
chapters.zh: 至于我，就像上帝殿中的青橄榄树； 我永永远远倚靠上帝的慈爱。

chapters.en:
I will praise You forever, because You have done it. I will wait on Your name— for it is good—
in the presence of Your saints.
chapters.zh: 我要称谢你，直到永远， 因为你行了这事。 我也要在你圣民面前仰望你的名； 这名本为美好。

chapters.en:
The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.”
They are corrupt; their ways are vile. There is no one who does good.
chapters.zh: 愚顽人心里说：没有上帝。 他们都是邪恶，行了可憎恶的罪孽； 没有一个人行善。

chapters.en: God looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.
chapters.zh: 上帝从天上垂看世人，要看有明白的没有？ 有寻求他的没有？

chapters.en: All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
chapters.zh: 他们各人都退后，一同变为污秽； 并没有行善的，连一个也没有。

chapters.en:
Will the workers of iniquity never learn?
They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon God.
chapters.zh: 作孽的没有知识吗？ 他们吞吃我的百姓如同吃饭一样，并不求告上帝。

chapters.en: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to fear. For God has scattered the bones of those who besieged you. You put them to shame, for God has despised them.
chapters.zh: 他们在无可惧怕之处就大大害怕， 因为上帝把那安营攻击你之人的骨头散开了。 你使他们蒙羞，因为上帝弃绝了他们。

chapters.en:
Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion!
When God restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!
chapters.zh: 但愿以色列的救恩从锡安而出。 上帝救回他被掳的子民那时， 雅各要快乐，以色列要欢喜。

chapters.en: Save me, O God, by Your name, and vindicate me by Your might!
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你以你的名救我， 凭你的大能为我伸冤。

chapters.en: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你听我的祷告， 留心听我口中的言语。

chapters.en:
For strangers rise up against me, and ruthless men seek my life—
men with no regard for God. Selah
chapters.zh: 因为，外人起来攻击我， 强暴人寻索我的命； 他们眼中没有上帝。（细拉）

chapters.en: Surely God is my helper; the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.
chapters.zh: 上帝是帮助我的，是扶持我命的。

chapters.en: He will reward my enemies with evil. In Your faithfulness, destroy them.
chapters.zh: 他要报应我仇敌所行的恶； 求你凭你的诚实灭绝他们。

chapters.en: Freely I will sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O LORD, for it is good.
chapters.zh: 我要把甘心祭献给你。 耶和华啊，我要称赞你的名；这名本为美好。

chapters.en: For He has delivered me from every trouble, and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.
chapters.zh: 他从一切的急难中把我救出来； 我的眼睛也看见了我仇敌〔遭报〕。

chapters.en: Listen to my prayer, O God, and do not ignore my plea.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你留心听我的祷告， 不要隐藏不听我的恳求！

chapters.en: Attend to me and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and distraught
chapters.zh: 求你侧耳听我，应允我。 我哀叹不安，发声唉哼，

chapters.en: at the voice of the enemy, at the pressure of the wicked. For they bring down disaster upon me and resent me in their anger.
chapters.zh: 都因仇敌的声音，恶人的欺压； 因为他们将罪孽加在我身上，发怒气逼迫我。

chapters.en: My heart pounds within me, and the terrors of death assail me.
chapters.zh: 我心在我里面甚是疼痛； 死的惊惶临到我身。

chapters.en: Fear and trembling grip me, and horror has overwhelmed me.
chapters.zh: 恐惧战兢归到我身； 惊恐漫过了我。

chapters.en: I said, “Oh, that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away and find rest.
chapters.zh: 我说：但愿我有翅膀像鸽子， 我就飞去，得享安息。

chapters.en: How far away I would flee! In the wilderness I would remain. Selah
chapters.zh: 我必远游， 宿在旷野。（细拉）

chapters.en: I would hurry to my shelter, far from this raging tempest.”
chapters.zh: 我必速速逃到避所， 脱离狂风暴雨。

chapters.en: O Lord, confuse and confound their speech, for I see violence and strife in the city.
chapters.zh: 主啊，求你吞灭他们，变乱他们的舌头！ 因为我在城中见了强暴争竞的事。

chapters.en: Day and night they encircle the walls, while malice and trouble lie within.
chapters.zh: 他们在城墙上昼夜绕行； 在城内也有罪孽和奸恶。

chapters.en: Destruction is within; oppression and deceit never leave the streets.
chapters.zh: 邪恶在其中； 欺压和诡诈不离街市。

chapters.en: For it is not an enemy who insults me; that I could endure. It is not a foe who rises against me; from him I could hide.
chapters.zh: 原来不是仇敌辱骂我， 若是仇敌，还可忍耐； 也不是恨我的人向我狂大， 若是恨我的人就必躲避他。

chapters.en: But it is you, a man like myself, my companion and close friend.
chapters.zh: 不料是你；你原与我平等， 是我的同伴，是我知己的朋友！

chapters.en: We shared sweet fellowship together; we walked with the crowd into the house of God.
chapters.zh: 我们素常彼此谈论，以为甘甜； 我们与群众在上帝的殿中同行。

chapters.en:
Let death seize them by surprise; let them go down to Sheol alive,
for evil is with them in their homes.
chapters.zh: 愿死亡忽然临到他们！ 愿他们活活地下入阴间！ 因为他们的住处，他们的心中，都是邪恶。

chapters.en: But I call to God, and the LORD saves me.
chapters.zh: 至于我，我要求告上帝； 耶和华必拯救我。

chapters.en: Morning, noon, and night, I cry out in distress, and He hears my voice.
chapters.zh: 我要晚上、早晨、晌午哀声悲叹； 他也必听我的声音。

chapters.en:
He redeems my soul in peace from the battle waged against me,
even though many oppose me.
chapters.zh: 他救赎我命脱离攻击我的人， 使我得享平安， 因为与我〔相争的〕人甚多。

chapters.en: God will hear and humiliate them— the One enthroned for the ages— Selah because they do not change and they have no fear of God.
chapters.zh: 那没有更变、不敬畏上帝的人， 从太古常存的上帝必听见而苦待他。

chapters.en: My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.
chapters.zh: 他背了约， 伸手攻击与他和好的人。

chapters.en: His speech is smooth as butter, but war is in his heart. His words are softer than oil, yet they are swords unsheathed.
chapters.zh: 他的口如奶油光滑， 他的心却怀着争战； 他的话比油柔和， 其实是拔出来的刀。

chapters.en:
Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you;
He will never let the righteous be shaken.
chapters.zh: 你要把你的重担卸给耶和华， 他必抚养你； 他永不叫义人动摇。

chapters.en:
But You, O God, will bring them down to the Pit of destruction; men of bloodshed and deceit will not live out half their days.
But I will trust in You.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你必使恶人下入灭亡的坑； 流人血、行诡诈的人必活不到半世， 但我要倚靠你。

chapters.en:
Be merciful to me, O God, for men are hounding me;
all day they press their attack.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你怜悯我，因为人要把我吞了， 终日攻击欺压我。

chapters.en: My enemies pursue me all day long, for many proudly assail me.
chapters.zh: 我的仇敌终日要把我吞了， 因逞骄傲攻击我的人甚多。

chapters.en: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
chapters.zh: 我惧怕的时候要倚靠你。

chapters.en: In God, whose word I praise— in God I trust. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
chapters.zh: 我倚靠上帝，我要赞美他的话； 我倚靠上帝，必不惧怕。 血气之辈能把我怎么样呢？

chapters.en: All day long they twist my words; all their thoughts are on my demise.
chapters.zh: 他们终日颠倒我的话； 他们一切的心思都是要害我。

chapters.en:
They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps
while they wait to take my life.
chapters.zh: 他们聚集，埋伏窥探我的脚踪， 等候要害我的命。

chapters.en: In spite of such sin, will they escape? In Your anger, O God, cast down the nations.
chapters.zh: 他们岂能因罪孽逃脱吗？ 上帝啊，求你在怒中使众民堕落！

chapters.en:
You have taken account of my wanderings. Put my tears in Your bottle—
are they not in Your book?
chapters.zh: 我几次流离，你都记数； 求你把我眼泪装在你的皮袋里。 这不都记在你册子上吗？

chapters.en:
Then my enemies will retreat on the day I cry for help.
By this I will know that God is on my side.
chapters.zh: 我呼求的日子，我的仇敌都要转身退后。 上帝帮助我，这是我所知道的。

chapters.en: In God, whose word I praise, in the LORD, whose word I praise,
chapters.zh: 我倚靠上帝，我要赞美他的话； 我倚靠耶和华，我要赞美他的话。

chapters.en: in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
chapters.zh: 我倚靠上帝，必不惧怕。 人能把我怎么样呢？

chapters.en: Your vows are upon me, O God; I will render thank offerings to You.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，我向你所许的愿在我身上； 我要将感谢祭献给你。

chapters.en: For You have delivered my soul from death, and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.
chapters.zh: 因为你救我的命脱离死亡。 你岂不是〔救护〕我的脚不跌倒、 使我在生命光中行在上帝面前吗？

chapters.en: Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy, for in You my soul takes refuge. In the shadow of Your wings I will take shelter until the danger has passed.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你怜悯我，怜悯我！ 因为我的心投靠你。 我要投靠在你翅膀的荫下， 等到灾害过去。

chapters.en: I cry out to God Most High, to God who fulfills His purpose for me.
chapters.zh: 我要求告至高的上帝， 就是为我成全〔诸事〕的上帝。

chapters.en: He reaches down from heaven and saves me; He rebukes those who trample me. Selah God sends forth His loving devotion and His truth.
chapters.zh: 那要吞我的人辱骂我的时候， 上帝从天上必施恩救我， 也必向我发出慈爱和诚实。

chapters.en: My soul is among the lions; I lie down with ravenous beasts— with men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.
chapters.zh: 我的性命在狮子中间； 我躺卧在性如烈火的世人当中。 他们的牙齿是枪、箭； 他们的舌头是快刀。

chapters.en: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，愿你崇高过于诸天！ 愿你的荣耀高过全地！

chapters.en: They spread a net for my feet; my soul was despondent. They dug a pit before me, but they themselves have fallen into it! Selah
chapters.zh: 他们为我的脚设下网罗，压制我的心； 他们在我面前挖了坑，自己反掉在其中。（细拉）

chapters.en: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing and make music.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，我心坚定，我心坚定； 我要唱诗，我要歌颂！

chapters.en:
Awake, my glory! Awake, O harp and lyre!
I will awaken the dawn.
chapters.zh: 我的灵〔注：原文是荣耀〕啊，你当醒起！ 琴瑟啊，你们当醒起！ 我自己要极早醒起！

chapters.en: I will praise You, O Lord, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
chapters.zh: 主啊，我要在万民中称谢你， 在列邦中歌颂你！

chapters.en: For Your loving devotion reaches to the heavens, and Your faithfulness to the clouds.
chapters.zh: 因为，你的慈爱高及诸天； 你的诚实达到穹苍。

chapters.en: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，愿你崇高过于诸天！ 愿你的荣耀高过全地！

chapters.en: Do you indeed speak justly, O rulers? Do you judge uprightly, O sons of men?
chapters.zh: 世人哪，你们默然不语，真合公义吗？ 施行审判，岂按正直吗？

chapters.en: No, in your hearts you devise injustice; with your hands you mete out violence on the earth.
chapters.zh: 不然！你们是心中作恶； 你们在地上秤出你们手所行的强暴。

chapters.en: The wicked are estranged from the womb; the liars go astray from birth.
chapters.zh: 恶人一出母胎就〔与〕上帝疏远， 一离母腹便走错路，说谎话。

chapters.en: Their venom is like the venom of a snake, like a cobra that shuts its ears,
chapters.zh: 他们的毒气好像蛇的毒气； 他们好像塞耳的聋虺，

chapters.en: refusing to hear the tune of the charmer who skillfully weaves his spell.
chapters.zh: 不听行法术的声音， 虽用极灵的咒语也是不听。

chapters.en: O God, shatter their teeth in their mouths; O LORD, tear out the fangs of the lions.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你敲碎他们口中的牙！ 耶和华啊，求你敲掉少壮狮子的大牙！

chapters.en: May they vanish like water that runs off; when they draw the bow, may their arrows be blunted.
chapters.zh: 愿他们消灭，如急流的水一般； 他们瞅准射箭的时候，愿箭头仿佛砍断。

chapters.en:
Like a slug that dissolves in its slime, like a woman’s stillborn child,
may they never see the sun.
chapters.zh: 愿他们像蜗牛消化过去， 又像妇人坠落未见天日的胎。

chapters.en:
Before your pots can feel the burning thorns— whether green or dry—
He will sweep them away.
chapters.zh: 你们用荆棘烧火，锅还未热， 他要用旋风把青的和烧着的一齐刮去。

chapters.en: The righteous will rejoice when they see they are avenged; they will wash their feet in the blood of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 义人见〔仇敌〕遭报就欢喜， 要在恶人的血中洗脚。

chapters.en:
Then men will say, “There is surely a reward for the righteous!
There is surely a God who judges the earth!”
chapters.zh: 因此，人必说：义人诚然有善报； 在地上果有施行判断的上帝！

chapters.en: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; protect me from those who rise against me.
chapters.zh: 我的上帝啊，求你救我脱离仇敌， 把我安置在高处，得脱那些起来攻击我的人。

chapters.en: Deliver me from workers of iniquity, and save me from men of bloodshed.
chapters.zh: 求你救我脱离作孽的人 和喜爱流人血的人！

chapters.en:
See how they lie in wait for me. Fierce men conspire against me
for no transgression or sin of my own, O LORD.
chapters.zh: 因为，他们埋伏要害我的命； 有能力的人聚集来攻击我。 耶和华啊，这不是为我的过犯， 也不是为我的罪愆。

chapters.en:
For no fault of my own, they move swiftly to attack me.
Arise to help me, and take notice.
chapters.zh: 我虽然无过，他们预备整齐，跑来攻击我。 求你兴起鉴察，帮助我！

chapters.en:
O LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, rouse Yourself to punish all the nations;
show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah
chapters.zh: 万军之上帝－耶和华以色列的上帝啊！ 求你兴起，惩治万邦！ 不要怜悯行诡诈的恶人！（细拉）

chapters.en: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.
chapters.zh: 他们晚上转回， 叫号如狗，围城绕行。

chapters.en:
See what they spew from their mouths— sharp words from their lips:
“For who can hear us?”
chapters.zh: 他们口中喷吐〔恶言〕，嘴里有刀； 〔他们说〕：有谁听见？

chapters.en: But You, O LORD, laugh at them; You scoff at all the nations.
chapters.zh: 但你－耶和华必笑话他们； 你要嗤笑万邦。

chapters.en: I will keep watch for You, O my strength, because You, O God, are my fortress.
chapters.zh: 我的力量啊，我必仰望你， 因为上帝是我的高台。

chapters.en: My God of loving devotion will come to meet me; God will let me stare down my foes.
chapters.zh: 我的上帝要以慈爱迎接我； 上帝要叫我看见我仇敌〔遭报〕。

chapters.en:
Do not kill them, or my people will forget. Scatter them by Your power, and bring them down,
O Lord, our shield.
chapters.zh: 不要杀他们，恐怕我的民忘记。 主啊，你是我们的盾牌； 求你用你的能力使他们四散， 且降为卑。

chapters.en: By the sins of their mouths and the words of their lips, let them be trapped in their pride, in the curses and lies they utter.
chapters.zh: 因他们口中的罪和嘴里的言语， 并咒骂虚谎的话， 愿他们在骄傲之中被缠住了。

chapters.en: Consume them in wrath; consume them till they are no more, so it may be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob. Selah
chapters.zh: 求你发怒，使他们消灭， 以致归于无有， 叫他们知道上帝在雅各中间掌权， 直到地极。（细拉）

chapters.en:
They return in the evening, snarling like dogs
and prowling around the city.
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，任凭他们转回； 任凭他们叫号如狗，围城绕行。

chapters.en: They scavenge for food, and growl if they are not satisfied.
chapters.zh: 他们必走来走去，寻找食物， 若不得饱就终夜在外。

chapters.en: But I will sing of Your strength and proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning. For You are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.
chapters.zh: 但我要歌颂你的力量， 早晨要高唱你的慈爱； 因为你作过我的高台， 在我急难的日子作过我的避难所。

chapters.en:
To You, O my strength, I sing praises, for You, O God, are my fortress,
my God of loving devotion.
chapters.zh: 我的力量啊，我要歌颂你； 因为上帝是我的高台， 是赐恩与我的上帝。

chapters.en: You have rejected us, O God; You have broken us; You have been angry; restore us!
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你丢弃了我们，使我们破败； 你向我们发怒，求你使我们复兴！

chapters.en: You have shaken the land and torn it open. Heal its fractures, for it is quaking.
chapters.zh: 你使地震动，而且崩裂； 求你将裂口医好，因为地摇动。

chapters.en: You have shown Your people hardship; we are staggered from the wine You made us drink.
chapters.zh: 你叫你的民遇见艰难； 你叫我们喝那使人东倒西歪的酒。

chapters.en: You have raised a banner for those who fear You, that they may flee the bow. Selah
chapters.zh: 你把旌旗赐给敬畏你的人， 可以为真理扬起来。（细拉）

chapters.en: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
chapters.zh: 求你应允我们，用右手拯救我们， 好叫你所亲爱的人得救。

chapters.en: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
chapters.zh: 上帝已经指着他的圣洁说〔注：说：或译应许我〕：我要欢乐； 我要分开示剑，丈量疏割谷。

chapters.en: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
chapters.zh: 基列是我的，玛拿西也是我的。 以法莲是护卫我头的； 犹大是我的杖。

chapters.en:
Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal;
over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
chapters.zh: 摩押是我的沐浴盆； 我要向以东抛鞋。 非利士啊，你还能因我欢呼吗？

chapters.en: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
chapters.zh: 谁能领我进坚固城？ 谁能引我到以东地？

chapters.en: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你不是丢弃了我们吗？ 上帝啊，你不和我们的军兵同去吗？

chapters.en: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
chapters.zh: 求你帮助我们攻击敌人， 因为人的帮助是枉然的。

chapters.en: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
chapters.zh: 我们倚靠上帝才得施展大能， 因为践踏我们敌人的就是他。

chapters.en: Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你听我的呼求， 侧耳听我的祷告！

chapters.en: From the ends of the earth I call out to You whenever my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
chapters.zh: 我心里发昏的时候， 我要从地极求告你。 求你领我到那比我更高的磐石！

chapters.en: For You have been my refuge, a tower of strength against the enemy.
chapters.zh: 因为你作过我的避难所， 作过我的坚固台，脱离仇敌。

chapters.en: Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah
chapters.zh: 我要永远住在你的帐幕里！ 我要投靠在你翅膀下的隐密处！（细拉）

chapters.en:
For You have heard my vows, O God; You have given me the inheritance
reserved for those who fear Your name.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你原是听了我所许的愿； 你将产业赐给敬畏你名的人。

chapters.en: Increase the days of the king’s life; may his years span many generations.
chapters.zh: 你要加添王的寿数； 他的年岁必存到世世。

chapters.en:
May he sit enthroned in God’s presence forever; appoint Your loving devotion
and Your faithfulness to guard him.
chapters.zh: 他必永远坐在上帝面前； 愿你预备慈爱和诚实保佑他！

chapters.en: Then I will ever sing praise to Your name and fulfill my vows day by day.
chapters.zh: 这样，我要歌颂你的名，直到永远， 好天天还我所许的愿。

chapters.en: In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him.
chapters.zh: 我的心默默无声，专等候上帝； 我的救恩是从他〔而来〕。

chapters.en:
He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress;
I will never be shaken.
chapters.zh: 惟独他是我的磐石，我的拯救； 他是我的高台，我必不很动摇。

chapters.en: How long will you threaten a man? Will all of you throw him down like a leaning wall or a tottering fence?
chapters.zh: 你们大家攻击一人，把他毁坏， 如同毁坏歪斜的墙、将倒的壁，要到几时呢？

chapters.en: They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch; they delight in lies; with their mouths they bless, but inwardly they curse. Selah
chapters.zh: 他们彼此商议，专要从他的尊位上把他推下； 他们喜爱谎话，口虽祝福，心却咒诅。（细拉）

chapters.en: Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.
chapters.zh: 我的心哪，你当默默无声，专等候上帝， 因为我的盼望是从他〔而来〕。

chapters.en: He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.
chapters.zh: 惟独他是我的磐石，我的拯救； 他是我的高台，我必不动摇。

chapters.en: My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.
chapters.zh: 我的拯救、我的荣耀都在乎上帝； 我力量的磐石、我的避难所都在乎上帝。

chapters.en:
Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him.
God is our refuge. Selah
chapters.zh: 你们众民当时时倚靠他， 在他面前倾心吐意； 上帝是我们的避难所。（细拉）

chapters.en: Lowborn men are but a vapor; the exalted are but a lie. Weighed on the scale, they go up; together they are but a vapor.
chapters.zh: 下流人真是虚空； 上流人也是虚假； 放在天平里就必浮起； 他们一共比空气还轻。

chapters.en: Place no trust in extortion or false hope in stolen goods. If your riches increase, do not set your heart upon them.
chapters.zh: 不要仗势欺人， 也不要因抢夺而骄傲； 若财宝加增，不要放在心上。

chapters.en: God has spoken once; I have heard this twice: that power belongs to God,
chapters.zh: 上帝说了一次、两次，我都听见： 就是能力都属乎上帝。

chapters.en: and loving devotion to You, O Lord. For You will repay each man according to his deeds.
chapters.zh: 主啊，慈爱也是属乎你， 因为你照着各人所行的报应他。

chapters.en:
O God, You are my God. Earnestly I seek You;
my soul thirsts for You. My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你是我的上帝， 我要切切地寻求你， 在干旱疲乏无水之地，我渴想你； 我的心切慕你。

chapters.en: So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory.
chapters.zh: 我在圣所中曾如此瞻仰你， 为要见你的能力和你的荣耀。

chapters.en: Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.
chapters.zh: 因你的慈爱比生命更好， 我的嘴唇要颂赞你。

chapters.en: So I will bless You as long as I live; in Your name I will lift my hands.
chapters.zh: 我还活的时候要这样称颂你； 我要奉你的名举手。

chapters.en: My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods; with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.
When I remember You on my bed, I think of You through the watches of the night.
chapters.zh: 我在床上记念你， 在夜更的时候思想你； 我的心就像饱足了骨髓肥油， 我也要以欢乐的嘴唇赞美你。

chapters.en: For You are my help; I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings.
chapters.zh: 因为你曾帮助我， 我就在你翅膀的荫下欢呼。

chapters.en: My soul clings to You; Your right hand upholds me.
chapters.zh: 我心紧紧地跟随你； 你的右手扶持我。

chapters.en: But those who seek my life to destroy it will go into the depths of the earth.
chapters.zh: 但那些寻索要灭我命的人 必往地底下去；

chapters.en: They will fall to the power of the sword; they will become a portion for foxes.
chapters.zh: 他们必被刀剑所杀， 被野狗所吃。

chapters.en:
But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by Him will exult,
for the mouths of liars will be shut.
chapters.zh: 但是王必因上帝欢喜。 凡指着他发誓的必要夸口， 因为说谎之人的口必被塞住。

chapters.en: Hear, O God, my voice of complaint; preserve my life from dread of the enemy.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，我哀叹的时候，求你听我的声音！ 求你保护我的性命，不受仇敌的惊恐！

chapters.en: Hide me from the scheming of the wicked, from the mob of workers of iniquity,
chapters.zh: 求你把我隐藏， 使我脱离作恶之人的暗谋和作孽之人的扰乱。

chapters.en: who sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their bitter words like arrows,
chapters.zh: 他们磨舌如刀， 发出苦毒的言语，好像比准了的箭，

chapters.en: ambushing the innocent in seclusion, shooting suddenly, without fear.
chapters.zh: 要在暗地射完全人； 他们忽然射他，并不惧怕。

chapters.en:
They hold fast to their evil purpose; they speak of hiding their snares.
“Who will see them?” they say.
chapters.zh: 他们彼此勉励设下恶计； 他们商量暗设网罗， 说：谁能看见？

chapters.en:
They devise injustice and say, “We have perfected a secret plan.”
For the inner man and the heart are mysterious.
chapters.zh: 他们图谋奸恶， 〔说〕：我们是极力图谋的。 他们各人的意念心思是深的。

chapters.en: But God will shoot them with arrows; suddenly they will be wounded.
chapters.zh: 但上帝要射他们； 他们忽然被箭射伤。

chapters.en:
They will be made to stumble, their own tongues turned against them.
All who see will shake their heads.
chapters.zh: 他们必然绊跌，被自己的舌头所害； 凡看见他们的必都摇头。

chapters.en:
Then all mankind will fear and proclaim the work of God;
so they will ponder what He has done.
chapters.zh: 众人都要害怕， 要传扬上帝的工作， 并且明白他的作为。

chapters.en:
Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in Him;
let all the upright in heart exult.
chapters.zh: 义人必因耶和华欢喜，并要投靠他； 凡心里正直的人都要夸口。

chapters.en: Praise awaits You, O God, in Zion; to You our vows will be fulfilled.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，锡安的人都等候赞美你； 所许的愿也要向你偿还。

chapters.en: O You who listen to prayer, all people will come to You.
chapters.zh: 听祷告的〔主〕啊， 凡有血气的都要来就你。

chapters.en: When iniquities prevail against me, You atone for our transgressions.
chapters.zh: 罪孽胜了我； 至于我们的过犯，你都要赦免。

chapters.en: Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts! We are filled with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.
chapters.zh: 你所拣选、使他亲近你、住在你院中的， 这人便为有福！ 我们必因你居所、你圣殿的美福知足了。

chapters.en: With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.
chapters.zh: 拯救我们的上帝啊，你必以威严秉公义应允我们； 你本是一切地极和海上远处的人所倚靠的。

chapters.en: You formed the mountains by Your power, having girded Yourself with might.
chapters.zh: 他既以大能束腰， 就用力量安定诸山，

chapters.en:
You stilled the roaring of the seas, the pounding of their waves,
and the tumult of the nations.
chapters.zh: 使诸海的响声和其中波浪的响声， 并万民的喧哗，都平静了。

chapters.en: Those who live far away fear Your wonders; You make the dawn and sunset shout for joy.
chapters.zh: 住在地极的人因你的神迹惧怕； 你使日出日落之地都欢呼。

chapters.en:
You attend to the earth and water it; with abundance You enrich it. The streams of God are full of water, for You prepare our grain
by providing for the earth.
chapters.zh: 你眷顾地，降下透雨， 使地大得肥美。 上帝的河满了水； 你这样浇灌了地， 好为人预备五谷。

chapters.en: You soak its furrows and level its ridges; You soften it with showers and bless its growth.
chapters.zh: 你浇透地的诓沟，润平诓脊， 降甘霖，使地软和； 其中发长的，蒙你赐福。

chapters.en: You crown the year with Your bounty, and Your paths overflow with plenty.
chapters.zh: 你以恩典为年岁的冠冕； 你的路径都滴下脂油，

chapters.en: The pastures of the wilderness overflow; the hills are robed with joy.
chapters.zh: 滴在旷野的草场上。 小山以欢乐束腰；

chapters.en: The pastures are clothed with flocks, and the valleys are decked with grain. They shout in triumph; indeed, they sing.
chapters.zh: 草场以羊群为衣； 谷中也长满了五谷。 这一切都欢呼歌唱。

chapters.en: Make a joyful noise to God, all the earth!
chapters.zh: 全地都当向上帝欢呼！

chapters.en: Sing the glory of His name; make His praise glorious.
chapters.zh: 歌颂他名的荣耀！ 用赞美的言语将他的荣耀发明！

chapters.en:
Say to God, “How awesome are Your deeds! So great is Your power
that Your enemies cower before You.
chapters.zh: 当对上帝说：你的作为何等可畏！ 因你的大能，仇敌要投降你。

chapters.en:
All the earth bows down to You; they sing praise to You;
they sing praise to Your name.” Selah
chapters.zh: 全地要敬拜你，歌颂你， 要歌颂你的名。（细拉）

chapters.en: Come and see the works of God; how awesome are His deeds toward mankind.
chapters.zh: 你们来看上帝所行的， 他向世人所做之事是可畏的。

chapters.en:
He turned the sea into dry land; they passed through the waters on foot;
there we rejoiced in Him.
chapters.zh: 他将海变成干地，众民步行过河； 我们在那里因他欢喜。

chapters.en:
He rules forever by His power; His eyes watch the nations.
Do not let the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah
chapters.zh: 他用权能治理〔万民〕，直到永远。 他的眼睛鉴察列邦； 悖逆的人不可自高。（细拉）

chapters.en: Bless our God, O peoples; let the sound of His praise be heard.
chapters.zh: 万民哪，你们当称颂我们的上帝， 使人得听赞美他的声音。

chapters.en: He preserves our lives and keeps our feet from slipping.
chapters.zh: 他使我们的性命存活， 也不叫我们的脚摇动。

chapters.en: For You, O God, have tested us; You have refined us like silver.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你曾试验我们， 熬炼我们，如熬炼银子一样。

chapters.en: You led us into the net; You laid burdens on our backs.
chapters.zh: 你使我们进入网罗， 把重担放在我们的身上。

chapters.en:
You let men ride over our heads; we went through fire and water,
but You brought us into abundance.
chapters.zh: 你使人坐车轧我们的头； 我们经过水火， 你却使我们到丰富之地。

chapters.en: I will enter Your house with burnt offerings; I will fulfill my vows to You—
chapters.zh: 我要用燔祭进你的殿， 向你还我的愿，

chapters.en: the vows that my lips promised and my mouth spoke in my distress.
chapters.zh: 就是在急难时我嘴唇所发的、 口中所许的。

chapters.en:
I will offer You fatlings as burnt offerings, with the fragrant smoke of rams;
I will offer bulls and goats. Selah
chapters.zh: 我要把肥牛作燔祭， 将公羊的香祭献给你， 又把公牛和山羊献上。（细拉）

chapters.en: Come and listen, all you who fear God, and I will declare what He has done for me.
chapters.zh: 凡敬畏上帝的人，你们都来听！ 我要述说他为我所行的事。

chapters.en: I cried out to Him with my mouth and praised Him with my tongue.
chapters.zh: 我曾用口求告他； 我的舌头也称他为高。

chapters.en: If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
chapters.zh: 我若心里注重罪孽， 主必不听。

chapters.en: But God has surely heard; He has attended to the sound of my prayer.
chapters.zh: 但上帝实在听见了； 他侧耳听了我祷告的声音。

chapters.en: Blessed be God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld from me His loving devotion!
chapters.zh: 上帝是应当称颂的！ 他并没有推却我的祷告， 也没有叫他的慈爱离开我。

chapters.en: May God be gracious to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah
chapters.zh: 愿上帝怜悯我们，赐福与我们， 用脸光照我们，（细拉）

chapters.en: that Your ways may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.
chapters.zh: 好叫世界得知你的道路， 万国得知你的救恩。

chapters.en: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，愿列邦称赞你！ 愿万民都称赞你！

chapters.en:
Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for You judge the peoples justly
and lead the nations of the earth. Selah
chapters.zh: 愿万国都快乐欢呼； 因为你必按公正审判万民， 引导世上的万国。（细拉）

chapters.en: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，愿列邦称赞你！ 愿万民都称赞你！

chapters.en: The earth has yielded its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.
chapters.zh: 地已经出了土产； 上帝－就是我们的上帝要赐福与我们。

chapters.en: God blesses us, that all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
chapters.zh: 上帝要赐福与我们； 地的四极都要敬畏他！

chapters.en: God arises. His enemies are scattered, and those who hate Him flee His presence.
chapters.zh: 愿上帝兴起，使他的仇敌四散， 叫那恨他的人从他面前逃跑。

chapters.en: As smoke is blown away, You will drive them out; as wax melts before the fire, the wicked will perish in the presence of God.
chapters.zh: 他们被驱逐，如烟被〔风〕吹散； 恶人见上帝之面而消灭，如蜡被火镕化。

chapters.en:
But the righteous will be glad and rejoice before God;
they will celebrate with joy.
chapters.zh: 惟有义人必然欢喜， 在上帝面前高兴快乐。

chapters.en:
Sing to God! Sing praises to His name. Exalt Him who rides on the clouds — His name is the LORD—
and rejoice before Him.
chapters.zh: 你们当向上帝唱诗，歌颂他的名； 为那坐车行过旷野的修平大路。 他的名是耶和华， 要在他面前欢乐！

chapters.en:
A father of the fatherless and a defender of widows
is God in His holy habitation.
chapters.zh: 上帝在他的圣所作孤儿的父， 作寡妇的伸冤者。

chapters.en:
God settles the lonely in families; He leads the prisoners out to prosperity,
but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
chapters.zh: 上帝叫孤独的有家， 使被囚的出来享福； 惟有悖逆的住在干燥之地。

chapters.en: O God, when You went out before Your people, when You marched through the wasteland, Selah
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你曾在你百姓前头出来， 在旷野行走。（细拉）

chapters.en:
the earth shook and the heavens poured down rain before God, the One on Sinai,
before God, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 那时，地见上帝的面而震动，天也落雨； 西奈山见以色列上帝的面也震动。

chapters.en: You sent abundant rain, O God; You refreshed Your weary inheritance.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你降下大雨； 你产业〔以色列〕疲乏的时候，你使他坚固。

chapters.en: Your flock settled therein; O God, from Your bounty You provided for the poor.
chapters.zh: 你的会众住在其中； 上帝啊，你的恩惠是为困苦人预备的。

chapters.en: The Lord gives the command; a great company of women proclaim it:
chapters.zh: 主发命令， 传好信息的妇女成了大群。

chapters.en: “Kings and their armies flee in haste; she who waits at home divides the plunder.
chapters.zh: 统兵的君王逃跑了，逃跑了； 在家等候的妇女分受所夺的。

chapters.en:
Though you lie down among the sheepfolds, the wings of the dove are covered with silver,
and her feathers with shimmering gold.”
chapters.zh: 你们安卧在羊圈的时候， 好像鸽子的翅膀镀白银，翎毛镀黄金一般。

chapters.en: When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like the snow falling on Zalmon.
chapters.zh: 全能者在境内赶散列王的时候， 势如飘雪在撒们。

chapters.en: A mountain of God is Mount Bashan; a mountain of many peaks is Mount Bashan.
chapters.zh: 巴珊山是上帝的山； 巴珊山是多峰多岭的山。

chapters.en:
Why do you gaze in envy, O mountains of many peaks? This is the mountain God chose for His dwelling,
where the LORD will surely dwell forever.
chapters.zh: 你们多峰多岭的山哪， 为何斜看上帝所愿居住的山？ 耶和华必住这山，直到永远！

chapters.en: The chariots of God are tens of thousands— thousands of thousands are they; the Lord is in His sanctuary as He was at Sinai.
chapters.zh: 上帝的车辇累万盈千； 主在其中，好像在西奈圣山一样。

chapters.en:
You have ascended on high; You have led captives away. You have received gifts from men, even from the rebellious,
that the LORD God may dwell there.
chapters.zh: 你已经升上高天，掳掠仇敌； 你在人间，就是在悖逆的人间，受了供献， 叫耶和华上帝可以与他们同住。

chapters.en:
Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden,
the God of our salvation. Selah
chapters.zh: 天天背负我们重担的主， 就是拯救我们的上帝， 是应当称颂的！（细拉）

chapters.en: Our God is a God of deliverance; the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death.
chapters.zh: 上帝是为我们施行诸般救恩的上帝； 人能脱离死亡是在乎主耶和华。

chapters.en: Surely God will crush the heads of His enemies, the hairy crowns of those who persist in guilty ways.
chapters.zh: 但上帝要打破他仇敌的头， 就是那常犯罪之人的发顶。

chapters.en: The Lord said, “I will retrieve them from Bashan, I will bring them up from the depths of the sea,
chapters.zh: 主说：我要使众民从巴珊而归， 使他们从深海而回，

chapters.en:
that your foot may be dipped in the blood of your foes—
the tongues of your dogs in the same.”
chapters.zh: 使你打碎仇敌，你的脚踹在血中， 使你狗的舌头从其中得分。

chapters.en: They have seen Your procession, O God— the march of my God and King into the sanctuary.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你是我的上帝，我的王； 人已经看见你行走，进入圣所。

chapters.en:
The singers lead the way, the musicians follow after,
among the maidens playing tambourines.
chapters.zh: 歌唱的行在前，作乐的随在后， 都在击鼓的童女中间。

chapters.en: Bless God in the great congregation; bless the LORD from the fountain of Israel.
chapters.zh: 从以色列源头而来的， 当在各会中称颂主上帝！

chapters.en:
There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them, the princes of Judah in their company,
the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.
chapters.zh: 在那里，有统管他们的小便雅悯， 有犹大的首领和他们的群众， 有西布伦的首领， 有拿弗他利的首领。

chapters.en:
Summon Your power, O God; show Your strength, O God,
which You have exerted on our behalf.
chapters.zh: 以色列的能力是上帝所赐的； 上帝啊，求你坚固你为我们所成全的事！

chapters.en: Because of Your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring You gifts.
chapters.zh: 因你耶路撒冷的殿， 列王必带贡物献给你。

chapters.en: Rebuke the beast in the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations, until it submits, bringing bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.
chapters.zh: 求你叱喝芦苇中的野兽和群公牛， 并列邦中的牛犊。 把银块踹在脚下； 上帝已经赶散好争战的列邦。

chapters.en: Envoys will arrive from Egypt; Cush will stretch out her hands to God.
chapters.zh: 埃及的公侯要出来朝见上帝； 古实人要急忙举手〔祷告〕。

chapters.en: Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth; sing praises to the Lord— Selah
chapters.zh: 世上的列国啊，你们要向上帝歌唱； 愿你们歌颂主！

chapters.en: to Him who rides upon the highest heavens of old; behold, His mighty voice resounds.
chapters.zh: 歌颂那自古驾行在诸天以上的〔主〕！ 他发出声音，是极大的声音。

chapters.en:
Ascribe the power to God, whose majesty is over Israel,
whose strength is in the skies.
chapters.zh: 你们要将能力归给上帝。 他的威荣在以色列之上； 他的能力是在穹苍。

chapters.en:
O God, You are awesome in Your sanctuary; the God of Israel Himself
gives strength and power to His people.
Blessed be God!
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你从圣所显为可畏； 以色列的上帝是那将力量权能赐给他百姓的。 上帝是应当称颂的！

chapters.en: Save me, O God, for the waters are up to my neck.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你救我！ 因为众水要淹没我。

chapters.en: I have sunk into the miry depths, where there is no footing; I have drifted into deep waters, where the flood engulfs me.
chapters.zh: 我陷在深淤泥中，没有立脚之地； 我到了深水中，大水漫过我身。

chapters.en: I am weary from my crying; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
chapters.zh: 我因呼求困乏，喉咙发干； 我因等候上帝，眼睛失明。

chapters.en: Those who hate me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are those who would destroy me— my enemies for no reason. Though I did not steal, I must repay.
chapters.zh: 无故恨我的，比我头发还多； 无理与我为仇、要把我剪除的，甚为强盛。 我没有抢夺的，要叫我偿还。

chapters.en: You know my folly, O God, and my guilt is not hidden from You.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，我的愚昧，你原知道； 我的罪愆不能隐瞒。

chapters.en: May those who hope in You not be ashamed through me, O Lord GOD of Hosts; may those who seek You not be dishonored through me, O God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 万军的主－耶和华啊， 求你叫那等候你的，不要因我蒙羞！ 以色列的上帝啊， 求你叫那寻求你的，不要因我受辱！

chapters.en: For I have endured scorn for Your sake, and shame has covered my face.
chapters.zh: 因我为你的缘故受了辱骂， 满面羞愧。

chapters.en: I have become a stranger to my brothers and a foreigner to my mother’s sons,
chapters.zh: 我的弟兄看我为外路人； 我的同胞看我为外邦人。

chapters.en: because zeal for Your house has consumed me, and the insults of those who insult You have fallen on me.
chapters.zh: 因我为你的殿心里焦急，如同火烧， 并且辱骂你人的辱骂都落在我身上。

chapters.en: I wept and fasted, but it brought me reproach.
chapters.zh: 我哭泣，以禁食〔刻苦〕我心； 这倒算为我的羞辱。

chapters.en: I made sackcloth my clothing, and I was sport to them.
chapters.zh: 我拿麻布当衣裳， 就成了他们的笑谈。

chapters.en: Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of drunkards.
chapters.zh: 坐在城门口的谈论我； 酒徒也以我为歌曲。

chapters.en: But my prayer to You, O LORD, is for a time of favor. In Your abundant loving devotion, O God, answer me with Your sure salvation.
chapters.zh: 但我在悦纳的时候向你－耶和华祈祷。 上帝啊，求你按你丰盛的慈爱， 凭你拯救的诚实应允我！

chapters.en: Rescue me from the mire and do not let me sink; deliver me from my foes and out of the deep waters.
chapters.zh: 求你搭救我出离淤泥， 不叫我陷在其中； 求你使我脱离那些恨我的人， 使我出离深水。

chapters.en:
Do not let the floods engulf me or the depths swallow me up;
let not the Pit close its mouth over me.
chapters.zh: 求你不容大水漫过我， 不容深渊吞灭我， 不容坑坎在我以上合口。

chapters.en:
Answer me, O LORD, for Your loving devotion is good;
turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你应允我！ 因为你的慈爱本为美好； 求你按你丰盛的慈悲回转眷顾我！

chapters.en:
Hide not Your face from Your servant, for I am in distress.
Answer me quickly!
chapters.zh: 不要掩面不顾你的仆人； 我是在急难之中，求你速速地应允我！

chapters.en: Draw near to my soul and redeem me; ransom me because of my foes.
chapters.zh: 求你亲近我，救赎我！ 求你因我的仇敌把我赎回！

chapters.en: You know my reproach, my shame and disgrace. All my adversaries are before You.
chapters.zh: 你知道我受的辱骂、欺凌、羞辱； 我的敌人都在你面前。

chapters.en: Insults have broken my heart, and I am in despair. I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found no one.
chapters.zh: 辱骂伤破了我的心， 我又满了忧愁。 我指望有人体恤，却没有一个； 我指望有人安慰，却找不着一个。

chapters.en: They poisoned my food with gall and gave me vinegar to quench my thirst.
chapters.zh: 他们拿苦胆给我当食物； 我渴了，他们拿醋给我喝。

chapters.en: May their table become a snare; may it be a retribution and a trap.
chapters.zh: 愿他们的筵席在他们面前变为网罗， 在他们平安的时候变为机槛。

chapters.en: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.
chapters.zh: 愿他们的眼睛昏矇，不得看见； 愿你使他们的腰常常战抖。

chapters.en: Pour out Your wrath upon them, and let Your burning anger overtake them.
chapters.zh: 求你将你的恼恨倒在他们身上， 叫你的烈怒追上他们。

chapters.en: May their place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in their tents.
chapters.zh: 愿他们的住处变为荒场； 愿他们的帐棚无人居住。

chapters.en: For they persecute the one You struck and recount the pain of those You wounded.
chapters.zh: 因为，你所击打的，他们就逼迫； 你所击伤的，他们戏说他的愁苦。

chapters.en: Add iniquity to their iniquity; let them not share in Your righteousness.
chapters.zh: 愿你在他们的罪上加罪， 不容他们在你面前称义。

chapters.en: May they be blotted out of the Book of Life and not listed with the righteous.
chapters.zh: 愿他们从生命册上被涂抹， 不得记录在义人之中。

chapters.en: But I am in pain and distress; let Your salvation protect me, O God.
chapters.zh: 但我是困苦忧伤的； 上帝啊，愿你的救恩将我安置在高处。

chapters.en: I will praise God’s name in song and exalt Him with thanksgiving.
chapters.zh: 我要以诗歌赞美上帝的名， 以感谢称他为大！

chapters.en: And this will please the LORD more than an ox, more than a bull with horns and hooves.
chapters.zh: 这便叫耶和华喜悦，胜似献牛， 或是献有角有蹄的公牛。

chapters.en: The humble will see and rejoice. You who seek God, let your hearts be revived!
chapters.zh: 谦卑的人看见了就喜乐； 寻求上帝的人，愿你们的心苏醒。

chapters.en: For the LORD listens to the needy and does not despise His captive people.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华听了穷乏人， 不藐视被囚的人。

chapters.en: Let heaven and earth praise Him, the seas and everything that moves in them.
chapters.zh: 愿天和地、 洋海和其中一切的动物都赞美他！

chapters.en:
For God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah,
that they may dwell there and possess it.
chapters.zh: 因为上帝要拯救锡安，建造犹大的城邑； 他的民要在那里居住，得以为业。

chapters.en: The descendants of His servants will inherit it, and those who love His name will settle in it.
chapters.zh: 他仆人的后裔要承受为业； 爱他名的人也要住在其中。

chapters.en: Make haste, O God, to deliver me! Hurry, O LORD, to help me!
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你〔快快〕搭救我！ 耶和华啊，求你速速帮助我！

chapters.en: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.
chapters.zh: 愿那些寻索我命的，抱愧蒙羞； 愿那些喜悦我遭害的，退后受辱。

chapters.en: May those who say, “Aha, aha!” retreat because of their shame.
chapters.zh: 愿那些对我说阿哈、阿哈的， 因羞愧退后。

chapters.en: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “Let God be magnified!”
chapters.zh: 愿一切寻求你的，因你高兴欢喜； 愿那些喜爱你救恩的，常说：当尊上帝为大！

chapters.en: But I am poor and needy; hurry to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.
chapters.zh: 但我是困苦穷乏的； 上帝啊，求你速速到我这里来！ 你是帮助我的，搭救我的。 耶和华啊，求你不要耽延！

chapters.en: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我投靠你； 求你叫我永不羞愧！

chapters.en: In Your justice, rescue and deliver me; incline Your ear and save me.
chapters.zh: 求你凭你的公义搭救我，救拔我； 侧耳听我，拯救我！

chapters.en: Be my rock of refuge, where I can always go. Give the command to save me, for You are my rock and my fortress.
chapters.zh: 求你作我常住的磐石； 你已经命定要救我， 因为你是我的巖石，我的山寨。

chapters.en: Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless.
chapters.zh: 我的上帝啊，求你救我脱离恶人的手， 脱离不义和残暴之人的手。

chapters.en: For You are my hope, O Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
chapters.zh: 主－耶和华啊，你是我所盼望的； 从我年幼，你是我所倚靠的。

chapters.en:
I have leaned on You since birth; You pulled me from my mother’s womb.
My praise is always for You.
chapters.zh: 我从出母胎被你扶持； 使我出母腹的是你。 我必常常赞美你！

chapters.en: I have become a portent to many, but You are my strong refuge.
chapters.zh: 许多人以我为怪， 但你是我坚固的避难所。

chapters.en: My mouth is filled with Your praise and with Your splendor all day long.
chapters.zh: 你的赞美，你的荣耀 终日必满了我的口。

chapters.en: Do not discard me in my old age; do not forsake me when my strength fails.
chapters.zh: 我年老的时候，求你不要丢弃我！ 我力气衰弱的时候，求你不要离弃我！

chapters.en: For my enemies speak against me, and those who lie in wait for my life conspire,
chapters.zh: 我的仇敌议论我； 那些窥探要害我命的彼此商议，

chapters.en:
saying, “God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him,
for there is no one to rescue him.”
chapters.zh: 说：上帝已经离弃他； 我们追赶他，捉拿他吧！ 因为没有人搭救。

chapters.en: Be not far from me, O God. Hurry, O my God, to help me.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你不要远离我！ 我的上帝啊，求你速速帮助我！

chapters.en: May the accusers of my soul be ashamed and consumed; may those who seek my harm be covered with scorn and disgrace.
chapters.zh: 愿那与我性命为敌的，羞愧被灭； 愿那谋害我的，受辱蒙羞。

chapters.en: But I will always hope and will praise You more and more.
chapters.zh: 我却要常常盼望， 并要越发赞美你。

chapters.en:
My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long,
though I cannot know their full measure.
chapters.zh: 我的口终日要述说你的公义和你的救恩， 因我不计其数。

chapters.en: I will come in the strength of the Lord GOD; I will proclaim Your righteousness—Yours alone.
chapters.zh: 我要来〔说〕主－耶和华大能的事； 我单要提说你的公义。

chapters.en: O God, You have taught me from my youth, and to this day I proclaim Your marvelous deeds.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，自我年幼时，你就教训我； 直到如今，我传扬你奇妙的作为。

chapters.en: Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, O God, until I proclaim Your power to the next generation, Your might to all who are to come.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，我到年老发白的时候， 求你不要离弃我！ 等我将你的能力指示下代， 将你的大能指示后世的人。

chapters.en:
Your righteousness reaches to the heavens, O God, You who have done great things.
Who, O God, is like You?
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你的公义甚高； 行过大事的上帝啊，谁能像你！

chapters.en: Though You have shown me many troubles and misfortunes, You will revive me once again. Even from the depths of the earth You will bring me back up.
chapters.zh: 你是叫我们多经历重大急难的， 必使我们复活， 从地的深处救上来。

chapters.en: You will increase my honor and comfort me once again.
chapters.zh: 求你使我越发昌大， 又转来安慰我。

chapters.en: So I will praise You with the harp for Your faithfulness, O my God; I will sing praise to You with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.
chapters.zh: 我的上帝啊，我要鼓瑟称赞你， 称赞你的诚实！ 以色列的圣者啊，我要弹琴歌颂你！

chapters.en: When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy, along with my soul, which You have redeemed.
chapters.zh: 我歌颂你的时候， 我的嘴唇和你所赎我的灵魂都必欢呼；

chapters.en: My tongue will indeed proclaim Your righteousness all day long, for those who seek my harm are disgraced and confounded.
chapters.zh: 并且我的舌头必终日讲论你的公义， 因为那些谋害我的人已经蒙羞受辱了。

chapters.en: Endow the king with Your justice, O God, and the son of the king with Your righteousness.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你将判断的权柄赐给王， 将公义赐给王的儿子。

chapters.en: May he judge Your people with righteousness and Your afflicted with justice.
chapters.zh: 他要按公义审判你的民， 按公平审判你的困苦人。

chapters.en: May the mountains bring peace to the people, and the hills bring righteousness.
chapters.zh: 大山小山都要因公义使民得享平安。

chapters.en:
May he vindicate the afflicted among the people; may he save the children of the needy
and crush the oppressor.
chapters.zh: 他必为民中的困苦人伸冤， 拯救穷乏之辈， 压碎那欺压人的。

chapters.en:
May they fear him as long as the sun shines, as long as the moon remains,
through all generations.
chapters.zh: 太阳还存，月亮还在， 人要敬畏你，直到万代！

chapters.en: May he be like rain that falls on freshly cut grass, like spring showers that water the earth.
chapters.zh: 他必降临，像雨降在已割的草〔地〕上， 如甘霖滋润田地。

chapters.en:
May the righteous flourish in his days and prosperity abound
until the moon is no more.
chapters.zh: 在他的日子，义人要发旺， 大有平安，好像月亮长存。

chapters.en: May he rule from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.
chapters.zh: 他要执掌权柄，从这海直到那海， 从大河直到地极。

chapters.en: May the nomads bow before him, and his enemies lick the dust.
chapters.zh: 住在旷野的，必在他面前下拜； 他的仇敌必要舔土。

chapters.en: May the kings of Tarshish and distant shores bring tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba offer gifts.
chapters.zh: 他施和海岛的王要进贡； 示巴和西巴的王要献礼物。

chapters.en: May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him.
chapters.zh: 诸王都要叩拜他； 万国都要事奉他。

chapters.en: For he will deliver the needy who cry out and the afflicted who have no helper.
chapters.zh: 因为，穷乏人呼求的时候，他要搭救； 没有人帮助的困苦人，他也要搭救。

chapters.en: He will take pity on the poor and needy and save the lives of the oppressed.
chapters.zh: 他要怜恤贫寒和穷乏的人， 拯救穷苦人的性命。

chapters.en: He will redeem them from oppression and violence, for their blood is precious in his sight.
chapters.zh: 他要救赎他们脱离欺压和强暴； 他们的血在他眼中看为宝贵。

chapters.en: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him; may they bless him all day long.
chapters.zh: 他们要存活。 示巴的金子要奉给他； 人要常常为他祷告，终日称颂他。

chapters.en: May there be an abundance of grain in the land; may it sway atop the hills. May its fruit trees flourish like the forests of Lebanon, the people of its cities like the grass of the field.
chapters.zh: 在地的山顶上，五谷必然茂盛〔注：或译：有一把五谷〕； 所结的谷实要响动，如黎巴嫩〔的树林〕； 城里的人要发旺，如地上的草。

chapters.en: May his name endure forever; may his name continue as long as the sun shines. In him may all nations be blessed; may they call him blessed.
chapters.zh: 他的名要存到永远， 要留传如日之久。 人要因他蒙福； 万国要称他有福。

chapters.en: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
chapters.zh: 独行奇事的耶和华－以色列的上帝 是应当称颂的！

chapters.en:
And blessed be His glorious name forever; may all the earth be filled with His glory.
Amen and amen.
chapters.zh: 他荣耀的名也当称颂，直到永远。 愿他的荣耀充满全地！ 阿们！阿们！

chapters.en: Thus conclude the prayers of David son of Jesse.
chapters.zh: 耶西的儿子－大卫的祈祷完毕。

chapters.en: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
chapters.zh: 上帝实在恩待以色列那些清心的人！

chapters.en: But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled; my steps had nearly slipped.
chapters.zh: 至于我，我的脚几乎失闪； 我的脚险些滑跌。

chapters.en: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 我见恶人和狂傲人享平安就心怀不平。

chapters.en: They have no struggle in their death; their bodies are well-fed.
chapters.zh: 他们死的时候没有疼痛； 他们的力气却也壮实。

chapters.en: They are free of the burdens others carry; they are not afflicted like other men.
chapters.zh: 他们不像别人受苦， 也不像别人遭灾。

chapters.en: Therefore pride is their necklace; a garment of violence covers them.
chapters.zh: 所以，骄傲如链子戴在他们的项上； 强暴像衣裳遮住他们的身体。

chapters.en: From their prosperity proceeds iniquity; the imaginations of their hearts run wild.
chapters.zh: 他们的眼睛因体胖而凸出； 他们所得的，过于心里所想的。

chapters.en: They mock and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.
chapters.zh: 他们讥笑人，凭恶意说欺压人的话； 他们说话自高。

chapters.en: They set their mouths against the heavens, and their tongues strut across the earth.
chapters.zh: 他们的口亵渎上天； 他们的舌毁谤全地。

chapters.en: So their people return to this place and drink up waters in abundance.
chapters.zh: 所以上帝的民归到这里， 喝尽了满〔杯的苦〕水。

chapters.en: The wicked say, “How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?”
chapters.zh: 他们说：上帝怎能晓得？ 至高者岂有知识呢？

chapters.en: Behold, these are the wicked— always carefree as they increase their wealth.
chapters.zh: 看哪，这就是恶人； 他们既是常享安逸，财宝便加增。

chapters.en: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure; in innocence I have washed my hands.
chapters.zh: 我实在徒然洁净了我的心， 徒然洗手表明无辜。

chapters.en: For I am afflicted all day long and punished every morning.
chapters.zh: 因为，我终日遭灾难； 每早晨受惩治。

chapters.en: If I had said, “I will speak this way,” then I would have betrayed Your children.
chapters.zh: 我若说，我要这样讲， 这就是以奸诈待你的众子。

chapters.en: When I tried to understand all this, it was troublesome in my sight
chapters.zh: 我思索怎能明白这事， 眼看实系为难，

chapters.en: until I entered God’s sanctuary; then I discerned their end.
chapters.zh: 等我进了上帝的圣所， 思想他们的结局。

chapters.en: Surely You set them on slick ground; You cast them down into ruin.
chapters.zh: 你实在把他们安在滑地， 使他们掉在沉沦之中。

chapters.en: How suddenly they are laid waste, completely swept away by terrors!
chapters.zh: 他们转眼之间成了何等的荒凉！ 他们被惊恐灭尽了。

chapters.en: Like one waking from a dream, so You, O Lord, awaken and despise their form.
chapters.zh: 人睡醒了，怎样看梦； 主啊，你醒了也必照样轻看他们的影像。

chapters.en: When my heart was grieved and I was pierced within,
chapters.zh: 因而，我心里发酸， 肺腑被刺。

chapters.en: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before You.
chapters.zh: 我这样愚昧无知， 在你面前如畜类一般。

chapters.en: Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.
chapters.zh: 然而，我常与你同在； 你搀着我的右手。

chapters.en: You guide me with Your counsel, and later receive me in glory.
chapters.zh: 你要以你的训言引导我， 以后必接我到荣耀里。

chapters.en: Whom have I in heaven but You? And on earth I desire no one besides You.
chapters.zh: 除你以外，在天上我有谁呢？ 除你以外，在地上我也没有所爱慕的。

chapters.en:
My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart
and my portion forever.
chapters.zh: 我的肉体和我的心肠衰残； 但上帝是我心里的力量， 又是我的福分，直到永远。

chapters.en: Those far from You will surely perish; You destroy all who are unfaithful to You.
chapters.zh: 远离你的，必要死亡； 凡离弃你行邪淫的，你都灭绝了。

chapters.en:
But as for me, it is good to draw near to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge,
that I may proclaim all Your works.
chapters.zh: 但我亲近上帝是与我有益； 我以主耶和华为我的避难所， 好叫我述说你一切的作为。

chapters.en:
Why have You rejected us forever, O God? Why does Your anger smolder
against the sheep of Your pasture?
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你为何永远丢弃我们呢？ 你为何向你草场的羊发怒，如烟冒出呢？

chapters.en: Remember Your congregation, which You purchased long ago and redeemed as the tribe of Your inheritance— Mount Zion, where You dwell.
chapters.zh: 求你记念你古时所得来的会众， 就是你所赎、作你产业支派的， 并记念你向来所居住的锡安山。

chapters.en: Turn Your steps to the everlasting ruins, to everything in the sanctuary the enemy has destroyed.
chapters.zh: 求你举步去看那日久荒凉之地， 仇敌在圣所中所行的一切恶事。

chapters.en: Your foes have roared within Your meeting place; they have unfurled their banners as signs,
chapters.zh: 你的敌人在你会中吼叫； 他们竖了自己的旗为记号。

chapters.en: like men wielding axes in a thicket of trees
chapters.zh: 他们好像人扬起斧子， 砍伐林中的树。

chapters.en: and smashing all the carvings with hatchets and picks.
chapters.zh: 圣所中一切雕刻的， 他们现在用斧子锤子打坏了。

chapters.en: They have burned Your sanctuary to the ground; they have defiled the dwelling place of Your Name.
chapters.zh: 他们用火焚烧你的圣所， 亵渎你名的居所，〔拆毁〕到地。

chapters.en: They said in their hearts, “We will crush them completely.” They burned down every place where God met us in the land.
chapters.zh: 他们心里说：我们要尽行毁灭； 他们就在遍地把上帝的会所都烧毁了。

chapters.en:
There are no signs for us to see. There is no longer any prophet.
And none of us knows how long this will last.
chapters.zh: 我们不见我们的标帜，不再有先知； 我们内中也没有人知道〔这灾祸〕要到几时呢！

chapters.en: How long, O God, will the enemy taunt You? Will the foe revile Your name forever?
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，敌人辱骂要到几时呢？ 仇敌亵渎你的名要到永远吗？

chapters.en: Why do You withdraw Your strong right hand? Stretch it out to destroy them!
chapters.zh: 你为什么缩回你的右手？ 求你从怀中伸出来，毁灭他们。

chapters.en: Yet God is my King from ancient times, working salvation on the earth.
chapters.zh: 上帝自古以来为我的王， 在地上施行拯救。

chapters.en: You divided the sea by Your strength; You smashed the heads of the dragons of the sea;
chapters.zh: 你曾用能力将海分开， 将水中大鱼的头打破。

chapters.en: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; You fed him to the creatures of the desert.
chapters.zh: 你曾砸碎鳄鱼的头， 把牠给旷野的禽兽〔注：禽兽：原文是民〕为食物。

chapters.en: You broke open the fountain and the flood; You dried up the ever-flowing rivers.
chapters.zh: 你曾分裂磐石，水便成了溪河； 你使长流的江河干了。

chapters.en: The day is Yours, and also the night; You established the moon and the sun.
chapters.zh: 白昼属你，黑夜也属你； 亮光和日头是你所预备的。

chapters.en: You set all the boundaries of the earth; You made the summer and winter.
chapters.zh: 地的一切疆界是你所立的； 夏天和冬天是你所定的。

chapters.en: Remember how the enemy has mocked You, O LORD, how a foolish people has spurned Your name.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，仇敌辱骂， 愚顽民亵渎了你的名，求你记念这事。

chapters.en: Do not deliver the soul of Your dove to beasts; do not forget the lives of Your afflicted forever.
chapters.zh: 不要将你斑鸠的性命交给野兽； 不要永远忘记你困苦人的性命。

chapters.en: Consider Your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.
chapters.zh: 求你顾念所立的约， 因为地上黑暗之处都满了强暴的居所。

chapters.en: Do not let the oppressed retreat in shame; may the poor and needy praise Your name.
chapters.zh: 不要叫受欺压的人蒙羞回去； 要叫困苦穷乏的人赞美你的名。

chapters.en: Rise up, O God; defend Your cause! Remember how the fool mocks You all day long.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你起来为自己伸诉！ 要记念愚顽人怎样终日辱骂你。

chapters.en: Do not disregard the clamor of Your adversaries, the uproar of Your enemies that ascends continually.
chapters.zh: 不要忘记你敌人的声音； 那起来敌你之人的喧哗时常上升。

chapters.en:
We give thanks to You, O God; we give thanks, for Your Name is near.
The people declare Your wondrous works.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，我们称谢你，我们称谢你！ 因为你的名相近，人都述说你奇妙的作为。

chapters.en: “When I choose a time, I will judge fairly.
chapters.zh: 我到了所定的日期， 必按正直施行审判。

chapters.en: When the earth and all its dwellers quake, it is I who bear up its pillars. Selah
chapters.zh: 地和其上的居民都消化了； 我曾立了地的柱子。（细拉）

chapters.en: I say to the proud, ‘Do not boast,’ and to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up your horn.
chapters.zh: 我对狂傲人说：不要行事狂傲！ 对凶恶人说：不要举角！

chapters.en: Do not lift up your horn against heaven or speak with an outstretched neck.’”
chapters.zh: 不要把你们的角高举； 不要挺着颈项说话。

chapters.en: For exaltation comes neither from east nor west, nor out of the desert,
chapters.zh: 因为高举非从东，非从西， 也非从南而来。

chapters.en: but it is God who judges; He brings down one and exalts another.
chapters.zh: 惟有上帝断定； 他使这人降卑，使那人升高。

chapters.en:
For a cup is in the hand of the LORD, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours from His cup, and all the wicked of the earth
drink it down to the dregs.
chapters.zh: 耶和华手里有杯， 其中的酒起沫，杯内满了搀杂的酒； 他倒出来， 地上的恶人必都喝这酒的渣滓，而且喝尽。

chapters.en: But I will proclaim Him forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.
chapters.zh: 但我要宣扬，直到永远！ 我要歌颂雅各的上帝！

chapters.en: “All the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous will be exalted.”
chapters.zh: 恶人一切的角，我要砍断； 惟有义人的角必被高举。

chapters.en: God is known in Judah; His name is great in Israel.
chapters.zh: 在犹大，上帝为人所认识； 在以色列，他的名为大。

chapters.en: His tent is in Salem, His dwelling place in Zion.
chapters.zh: 在撒冷有他的帐幕； 在锡安有他的居所。

chapters.en: There He shattered the flaming arrows, the shield and sword and weapons of war. Selah
chapters.zh: 他在那里折断弓上的火箭， 并盾牌、刀剑，和争战〔的兵器〕。（细拉）

chapters.en: You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains filled with game.
chapters.zh: 你从有野食之山而来， 有光华和荣美。

chapters.en: The valiant lie plundered; they sleep their last sleep. No men of might could lift a hand.
chapters.zh: 心中勇敢的人都被抢夺； 他们睡了长觉，没有一个英雄能措手。

chapters.en: At Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both horse and rider lie stunned.
chapters.zh: 雅各的上帝啊，你的斥责一发， 〔坐〕车的、〔骑〕马的都沉睡了。

chapters.en: You alone are to be feared. When You are angry, who can stand before You?
chapters.zh: 惟独你是可畏的！ 你怒气一发，谁能在你面前站得住呢？

chapters.en: From heaven You pronounced judgment, and the earth feared and was still
when God rose up to judge, to save all the lowly of the earth. Selah
chapters.zh: 你从天上使人听判断。 上帝起来施行审判， 要救地上一切谦卑的人； 那时地就惧怕而静默。（细拉）

chapters.en: Even the wrath of man shall praise You; with the survivors of wrath You will clothe Yourself.
chapters.zh: 人的忿怒要成全你的荣美； 人的余怒，你要禁止。

chapters.en:
Make and fulfill your vows to the LORD your God; let all the neighboring lands bring tribute
to Him who is to be feared.
chapters.zh: 你们许愿，当向耶和华－你们的上帝还愿； 在他四面的人都当拿贡物献给那可畏的主。

chapters.en: He breaks the spirits of princes; He is feared by the kings of the earth.
chapters.zh: 他要挫折王子的骄气； 他向地上的君王显威可畏。

chapters.en: I cried out to God; I cried aloud to God to hear me.
chapters.zh: 我要向上帝发声呼求； 我向上帝发声，他必留心听我。

chapters.en:
In the day of trouble I sought the Lord; through the night my outstretched hands did not grow weary;
my soul refused to be comforted.
chapters.zh: 我在患难之日寻求主； 我在夜间不住地举手祷告； 我的心不肯受安慰。

chapters.en: I remembered You, O God, and I groaned; I mused and my spirit grew faint. Selah
chapters.zh: 我想念上帝，就烦燥不安； 我沉吟悲伤，心便发昏。（细拉）

chapters.en: You have kept my eyes from closing; I am too troubled to speak.
chapters.zh: 你叫我不能闭眼； 我烦乱不安，甚至不能说话。

chapters.en: I considered the days of old, the years long in the past.
chapters.zh: 我追想古时之日， 上古之年。

chapters.en: At night I remembered my song; in my heart I mused, and my spirit pondered:
chapters.zh: 我想起我夜间的歌曲，扪心自问； 我心里也仔细省察。

chapters.en: “Will the Lord spurn us forever and never show His favor again?
chapters.zh: 难道主要永远丢弃〔我〕， 不再施恩吗？

chapters.en: Is His loving devotion gone forever? Has His promise failed for all time?
chapters.zh: 难道他的慈爱永远穷尽， 他的应许世世废弃吗？

chapters.en: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has His anger shut off His compassion?” Selah
chapters.zh: 难道上帝忘记开恩， 因发怒就止住他的慈悲吗？（细拉）

chapters.en: So I said, “I am grieved that the right hand of the Most High has changed.”
chapters.zh: 我便说：这是我的懦弱， 〔但我要追念〕至高者〔显出〕右手之年代。

chapters.en: I will remember the works of the LORD; yes, I will remember Your wonders of old.
chapters.zh: 我要提说耶和华所行的； 我要记念你古时的奇事。

chapters.en: I will reflect on all You have done and ponder Your mighty deeds.
chapters.zh: 我也要思想你的经营， 默念你的作为。

chapters.en: Your way, O God, is holy. What god is so great as our God?
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你的作为是洁净的； 有何神大如上帝呢？

chapters.en: You are the God who works wonders; You display Your strength among the peoples.
chapters.zh: 你是行奇事的上帝； 你曾在列邦中彰显你的能力。

chapters.en: With power You redeemed Your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah
chapters.zh: 你曾用你的膀臂赎了你的民， 就是雅各和约瑟的子孙。（细拉）

chapters.en:
The waters saw You, O God; the waters saw You and swirled;
even the depths were shaken.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，诸水见你， 一见就都惊惶； 深渊也都战抖。

chapters.en:
The clouds poured down water; the skies resounded with thunder;
Your arrows flashed back and forth.
chapters.zh: 云中倒出水来； 天空发出响声； 你的箭也飞行四方。

chapters.en:
Your thunder resounded in the whirlwind; the lightning lit up the world;
the earth trembled and quaked.
chapters.zh: 你的雷声在旋风中； 电光照亮世界； 大地战抖震动。

chapters.en:
Your path led through the sea, Your way through the mighty waters,
but Your footprints were not to be found.
chapters.zh: 你的道在海中； 你的路在大水中； 你的脚踪无人知道。

chapters.en: You led Your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
chapters.zh: 你曾藉摩西和亚伦的手引导你的百姓， 好像羊群一般。

chapters.en: Give ear, O my people, to my instruction; listen to the words of my mouth.
chapters.zh: 我的民哪，你们要留心听我的训诲， 侧耳听我口中的话。

chapters.en: I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the beginning,
chapters.zh: 我要开口说比喻； 我要说出古时的谜语，

chapters.en: that we have heard and known and our fathers have relayed to us.
chapters.zh: 是我们所听见、所知道的， 也是我们的祖宗告诉我们的。

chapters.en: We will not hide them from their children but will declare to the next generation the praises of the LORD and His might and the wonders He has performed.
chapters.zh: 我们不将这些事向他们的子孙隐瞒， 要将耶和华的美德和他的能力， 并他奇妙的作为，述说给后代听。

chapters.en: For He established a testimony in Jacob and appointed a law in Israel, which He commanded our fathers to teach to their children,
chapters.zh: 因为，他在雅各中立法度， 在以色列中设律法； 是他吩咐我们祖宗要传给子孙的，

chapters.en:
that the coming generation would know them— even children yet to be born—
to arise and tell their own children
chapters.zh: 使将要生的后代子孙可以晓得； 他们也要起来告诉他们的子孙，

chapters.en:
that they should put their confidence in God, not forgetting His works,
but keeping His commandments.
chapters.zh: 好叫他们仰望上帝， 不忘记上帝的作为， 惟要守他的命令。

chapters.en: Then they will not be like their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, whose heart was not loyal, whose spirit was not faithful to God.
chapters.zh: 不要像他们的祖宗， 是顽梗悖逆、居心不正之辈， 向着上帝，心不诚实。

chapters.en: The archers of Ephraim turned back on the day of battle.
chapters.zh: 以法莲的子孙带着兵器，拿着弓， 临阵之日转身退后。

chapters.en: They failed to keep God’s covenant and refused to live by His law.
chapters.zh: 他们不遵守上帝的约， 不肯照他的律法行；

chapters.en: They forgot what He had done, the wonders He had shown them.
chapters.zh: 又忘记他所行的 和他显给他们奇妙的作为。

chapters.en: He worked wonders before their fathers in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.
chapters.zh: 他在埃及地，在琐安田， 在他们祖宗的眼前施行奇事。

chapters.en: He split the sea and brought them through; He set the waters upright like a wall.
chapters.zh: 他将海分裂，使他们过去， 又叫水立起如垒。

chapters.en: He led them with a cloud by day and with a light of fire all night.
chapters.zh: 他白日用云彩， 终夜用火光引导他们。

chapters.en: He split the rocks in the wilderness and gave them drink as abundant as the seas.
chapters.zh: 他在旷野分裂磐石， 多多地给他们水喝，如从深渊而出。

chapters.en: He brought streams from the stone and made water flow down like rivers.
chapters.zh: 他使水从磐石涌出， 叫水如江河下流。

chapters.en: But they continued to sin against Him, rebelling in the desert against the Most High.
chapters.zh: 他们却仍旧得罪他， 在干燥之地悖逆至高者。

chapters.en: They willfully tested God by demanding the food they craved.
chapters.zh: 他们心中试探上帝， 随自己所欲的求食物，

chapters.en: They spoke against God, saying, “Can God really prepare a table in the wilderness?
chapters.zh: 并且妄论上帝说： 上帝在旷野岂能摆设筵席吗？

chapters.en: When He struck the rock, water gushed out and torrents raged. But can He also give bread or supply His people with meat?”
chapters.zh: 他曾击打磐石，使水涌出，成了江河； 他还能赐粮食吗？ 还能为他的百姓预备肉吗？

chapters.en: Therefore the LORD heard and was filled with wrath; so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and His anger flared against Israel,
chapters.zh: 所以，耶和华听见就发怒； 有烈火向雅各烧起； 有怒气向以色列上腾；

chapters.en: because they did not believe God or rely on His salvation.
chapters.zh: 因为他们不信服上帝， 不倚赖他的救恩。

chapters.en: Yet He commanded the clouds above and opened the doors of the heavens.
chapters.zh: 他却吩咐天空， 又敞开天上的门，

chapters.en: He rained down manna for them to eat; He gave them grain from heaven.
chapters.zh: 降吗哪，像雨给他们吃， 将天上的粮食赐给他们。

chapters.en: Man ate the bread of angels; He sent them food in abundance.
chapters.zh: 各人〔注：或译：人〕吃大能者的食物； 他赐下粮食，使他们饱足。

chapters.en: He stirred the east wind from the heavens and drove the south wind by His might.
chapters.zh: 他领东风起在天空， 又用能力引了南风来。

chapters.en: He rained meat on them like dust, and winged birds like the sand of the sea.
chapters.zh: 他降肉，像雨在他们当中，多如尘土， 又降飞鸟，多如海沙，

chapters.en: He felled them in the midst of their camp, all around their dwellings.
chapters.zh: 落在他们的营中， 在他们住处的四面。

chapters.en: So they ate and were well filled, for He gave them what they craved.
chapters.zh: 他们吃了，而且饱足； 这样就随了他们所欲的。

chapters.en: Yet before they had filled their desire, with the food still in their mouths,
chapters.zh: 他们贪而无厌， 食物还在他们口中的时候，

chapters.en:
God’s anger flared against them, and He put to death their strongest
and subdued the young men of Israel.
chapters.zh: 上帝的怒气就向他们上腾， 杀了他们内中的肥壮人， 打倒以色列的少年人。

chapters.en: In spite of all this, they kept on sinning; despite His wonderful works, they did not believe.
chapters.zh: 虽是这样，他们仍旧犯罪， 不信他奇妙的作为。

chapters.en: So He ended their days in futility, and their years in sudden terror.
chapters.zh: 因此，他叫他们的日子全归虚空， 叫他们的年岁尽属惊恐。

chapters.en: When He slew them, they would seek Him; they repented and searched for God.
chapters.zh: 他杀他们的时候，他们才求问他， 回心转意，切切地寻求上帝。

chapters.en: And they remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer.
chapters.zh: 他们也追念上帝是他们的磐石， 至高的上帝是他们的救赎主。

chapters.en: But they deceived Him with their mouths, and lied to Him with their tongues.
chapters.zh: 他们却用口谄媚他， 用舌向他说谎。

chapters.en: Their hearts were disloyal to Him, and they were unfaithful to His covenant.
chapters.zh: 因他们的心向他不正， 在他的约上也不忠心。

chapters.en: And yet He was compassionate; He forgave their iniquity and did not destroy them. He often restrained His anger and did not unleash His full wrath.
chapters.zh: 但他有怜悯， 赦免他们的罪孽， 不灭绝他们， 而且屡次消他的怒气， 不发尽他的忿怒。

chapters.en: He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return.
chapters.zh: 他想到他们不过是血气， 是一阵去而不返的风。

chapters.en: How often they disobeyed Him in the wilderness and grieved Him in the desert!
chapters.zh: 他们在旷野悖逆他， 在荒地叫他担忧，何其多呢！

chapters.en: Again and again they tested God and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
chapters.zh: 他们再三试探上帝， 惹动以色列的圣者。

chapters.en: They did not remember His power — the day He redeemed them from the adversary,
chapters.zh: 他们不追念他的能力〔注：原文是手〕 和赎他们脱离敌人的日子；

chapters.en: when He performed His signs in Egypt and His wonders in the fields of Zoan.
chapters.zh: 他怎样在埃及地显神迹， 在琐安田显奇事，

chapters.en: He turned their rivers to blood, and from their streams they could not drink.
chapters.zh: 把他们的江河并河汊的水都变为血， 使他们不能喝。

chapters.en: He sent swarms of flies that devoured them, and frogs that devastated them.
chapters.zh: 他叫苍蝇成群落在他们当中，嘬尽他们， 又叫青蛙灭了他们，

chapters.en: He gave their crops to the grasshopper, the fruit of their labor to the locust.
chapters.zh: 把他们的土产交给蚂蚱， 把他们辛苦得来的交给蝗虫。

chapters.en: He killed their vines with hailstones and their sycamore-figs with sleet.
chapters.zh: 他降冰雹打坏他们的葡萄树， 下严霜打坏他们的桑树，

chapters.en: He abandoned their cattle to the hail and their livestock to bolts of lightning.
chapters.zh: 又把他们的牲畜交给冰雹， 把他们的群畜交给闪电。

chapters.en:
He unleashed His fury against them, wrath, indignation, and calamity—
a band of destroying angels.
chapters.zh: 他使猛烈的怒气和忿怒、恼恨、苦难 成了一群降灾的使者，临到他们。

chapters.en:
He cleared a path for His anger; He did not spare them from death
but delivered their lives to the plague.
chapters.zh: 他为自己的怒气修平了路， 将他们交给瘟疫， 使他们死亡，

chapters.en: He struck all the firstborn of Egypt, the virility in the tents of Ham.
chapters.zh: 在埃及击杀一切长子， 在含的帐棚中击杀他们强壮时头生的。

chapters.en: He led out His people like sheep and guided them like a flock in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 他却领出自己的民如羊， 在旷野引他们如羊群。

chapters.en: He led them safely, so they did not fear, but the sea engulfed their enemies.
chapters.zh: 他领他们稳稳妥妥地，使他们不致害怕； 海却淹没他们的仇敌。

chapters.en: He brought them to His holy land, to the mountain His right hand had acquired.
chapters.zh: 他带他们到自己圣地的边界， 到他右手所得的这山地。

chapters.en:
He drove out nations before them and apportioned their inheritance;
He settled the tribes of Israel in their tents.
chapters.zh: 他在他们面前赶出外邦人， 用绳子将外邦的地量给他们为业， 叫以色列支派的人住在他们的帐棚里。

chapters.en: But they tested and disobeyed God Most High, for they did not keep His decrees.
chapters.zh: 他们仍旧试探、悖逆至高的上帝， 不守他的法度，

chapters.en: They turned back and were faithless like their fathers, twisted like a faulty bow.
chapters.zh: 反倒退后，行诡诈，像他们的祖宗一样； 他们改变，如同翻背的弓。

chapters.en: They enraged Him with their high places and provoked His jealousy with their idols.
chapters.zh: 因他们的邱坛惹了他的怒气； 因他们雕刻的偶像触动他的愤恨。

chapters.en: On hearing it, God was furious and rejected Israel completely.
chapters.zh: 上帝听见就发怒， 极其憎恶以色列人。

chapters.en: He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent He had pitched among men.
chapters.zh: 甚至他离弃示罗的帐幕， 就是他在人间所搭的帐棚；

chapters.en: He delivered His strength to captivity, and His splendor to the hand of the adversary.
chapters.zh: 又将他的约柜〔注：原文是能力〕交与人掳去， 将他的荣耀交在敌人手中；

chapters.en: He surrendered His people to the sword because He was enraged by His heritage.
chapters.zh: 并将他的百姓交与刀剑， 向他的产业发怒。

chapters.en: Fire consumed His young men, and their maidens were left without wedding songs.
chapters.zh: 少年人被火烧灭； 处女也无喜歌。

chapters.en: His priests fell by the sword, but their widows could not lament.
chapters.zh: 祭司倒在刀下， 寡妇却不哀哭。

chapters.en: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep, like a mighty warrior overcome by wine.
chapters.zh: 那时，主像世人睡醒， 像勇士饮酒呼喊。

chapters.en: He beat back His foes; He put them to everlasting shame.
chapters.zh: 他就打退了他的敌人， 叫他们永蒙羞辱；

chapters.en: He rejected the tent of Joseph and refused the tribe of Ephraim.
chapters.zh: 并且他弃掉约瑟的帐棚， 不拣选以法莲支派，

chapters.en: But He chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which He loved.
chapters.zh: 却拣选犹大支派－他所喜爱的锡安山；

chapters.en: He built His sanctuary like the heights, like the earth He has established forever.
chapters.zh: 盖造他的圣所，好像高峰， 又像他建立永存之地；

chapters.en: He chose David His servant and took him from the sheepfolds;
chapters.zh: 又拣选他的仆人大卫， 从羊圈中将他召来，

chapters.en:
from tending the ewes He brought him to be shepherd of His people Jacob,
of Israel His inheritance.
chapters.zh: 叫他不再跟从那些带奶的母羊， 为要牧养自己的百姓雅各 和自己的产业以色列。

chapters.en: So David shepherded them with integrity of heart and guided them with skillful hands.
chapters.zh: 于是，他按心中的纯正牧养他们， 用手中的巧妙引导他们。

chapters.en:
The nations, O God, have invaded Your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple
and reduced Jerusalem to rubble.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，外邦人进入你的产业， 污秽你的圣殿，使耶路撒冷变成荒堆，

chapters.en:
They have given the corpses of Your servants as food to the birds of the air,
the flesh of Your saints to the beasts of the earth.
chapters.zh: 把你仆人的尸首交与天空的飞鸟为食， 把你圣民的肉交与地上的野兽，

chapters.en:
They have poured out their blood like water all around Jerusalem,
and there is no one to bury the dead.
chapters.zh: 在耶路撒冷周围流他们的血如水， 无人葬埋。

chapters.en: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scorn and derision to those around us.
chapters.zh: 我们成为邻国的羞辱， 成为我们四围人的嗤笑讥刺。

chapters.en:
How long, O LORD? Will You be angry forever?
Will Your jealousy burn like fire?
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，这到几时呢？ 你要动怒到永远吗？ 你的愤恨要如火焚烧吗？

chapters.en: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You, on the kingdoms that refuse to call on Your name,
chapters.zh: 愿你将你的忿怒倒在那不认识你的外邦 和那不求告你名的国度。

chapters.en: for they have devoured Jacob and devastated his homeland.
chapters.zh: 因为他们吞了雅各， 把他的住处变为荒场。

chapters.en:
Do not hold past sins against us; let Your compassion come quickly,
for we are brought low.
chapters.zh: 求你不要记念我们先祖的罪孽，向我们追讨； 愿你的慈悲快迎着我们， 因为我们落到极卑微的地步。

chapters.en: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; deliver us and atone for our sins, for the sake of Your name.
chapters.zh: 拯救我们的上帝啊，求你因你名的荣耀帮助我们！ 为你名的缘故搭救我们，赦免我们的罪。

chapters.en: Why should the nations ask, “Where is their God?” Before our eyes, make known among the nations Your vengeance for the bloodshed of Your servants.
chapters.zh: 为何容外邦人说「他们的上帝在哪里」呢？ 愿你使外邦人知道你在我们眼前 伸你仆人流血的冤。

chapters.en: May the groans of the captives reach You; by the strength of Your arm preserve those condemned to death.
chapters.zh: 愿被囚之人的叹息达到你面前； 愿你按你的大能力存留那些将要死的人。

chapters.en: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors sevenfold the reproach they hurled at You, O Lord.
chapters.zh: 主啊，愿你将我们邻邦所羞辱你的羞辱 加七倍归到他们身上。

chapters.en: Then we Your people, the sheep of Your pasture, will thank You forever; from generation to generation we will declare Your praise.
chapters.zh: 这样，你的民，你草场的羊， 要称谢你，直到永远； 要述说赞美你的话，直到万代。

chapters.en: Hear us, O Shepherd of Israel, who leads Joseph like a flock; You who sit enthroned between the cherubim, shine forth
chapters.zh: 领约瑟如领羊群之以色列的牧者啊，求你留心听！ 坐在二基路伯上的啊，求你发出光来！

chapters.en: before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Rally Your mighty power and come to save us.
chapters.zh: 在以法莲、便雅悯、玛拿西前面 施展你的大能，来救我们。

chapters.en:
Restore us, O God, and cause Your face to shine upon us,
that we may be saved.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你使我们回转〔注：或译：复兴〕， 使你的脸发光，我们便要得救！

chapters.en:
O LORD God of Hosts, how long will Your anger smolder
against the prayers of Your people?
chapters.zh: 耶和华－万军之上帝啊， 你向你百姓的祷告发怒，要到几时呢？

chapters.en: You fed them with the bread of tears and made them drink the full measure of their tears.
chapters.zh: 你以眼泪当食物给他们吃， 又多量出眼泪给他们喝。

chapters.en: You make us contend with our neighbors; our enemies mock us.
chapters.zh: 你使邻邦因我们纷争； 我们的仇敌彼此戏笑。

chapters.en:
Restore us, O God of Hosts, and cause Your face to shine upon us,
that we may be saved.
chapters.zh: 万军之上帝啊，求你使我们回转， 使你的脸发光，我们便要得救！

chapters.en: You uprooted a vine from Egypt; You drove out the nations and transplanted it.
chapters.zh: 你从埃及挪出一棵葡萄树， 赶出外邦人，把这树栽上。

chapters.en: You cleared the ground for it, and it took root and filled the land.
chapters.zh: 你在这树根前预备了〔地方〕， 它就深深扎根，爬满了地。

chapters.en: The mountains were covered by its shade, and the mighty cedars with its branches.
chapters.zh: 它的影子遮满了山， 枝子好像佳美的香柏树。

chapters.en: It sent out its branches to the Sea, and its shoots toward the River.
chapters.zh: 它发出枝子，长到大海， 发出蔓子，延到大河。

chapters.en: Why have You broken down its walls, so that all who pass by pick its fruit?
chapters.zh: 你为何拆毁这树的篱笆， 任凭一切过路的人摘取？

chapters.en: The boar from the forest ravages it, and the creatures of the field feed upon it.
chapters.zh: 林中出来的野猪把它糟踏； 野地的走兽拿它当食物。

chapters.en: Return, O God of Hosts, we pray! Look down from heaven and see! Attend to this vine—
chapters.zh: 万军之上帝啊，求你回转！ 从天上垂看，眷顾这葡萄树，

chapters.en:
the root Your right hand has planted,
the son You have raised up for Yourself.
chapters.zh: 保护你右手所栽的 和你为自己所坚固的枝子。

chapters.en: Your vine has been cut down and burned; they perish at the rebuke of Your countenance.
chapters.zh: 这树已经被火焚烧，被刀砍伐； 他们因你脸上的怒容就灭亡了。

chapters.en: Let Your hand be upon the man at Your right hand, on the son of man You have raised up for Yourself.
chapters.zh: 愿你的手扶持你右边的人， 就是你为自己所坚固的人子。

chapters.en: Then we will not turn away from You; revive us, and we will call on Your name.
chapters.zh: 这样，我们便不退后离开你； 求你救活我们，我们就要求告你的名。

chapters.en:
Restore us, O LORD God of Hosts; cause Your face to shine upon us,
that we may be saved.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－万军之上帝啊，求你使我们回转， 使你的脸发光，我们便要得救！

chapters.en: Sing for joy to God our strength; make a joyful noise to the God of Jacob.
chapters.zh: 你们当向上帝－我们的力量大声欢呼， 向雅各的上帝发声欢乐！

chapters.en: Lift up a song, strike the tambourine, play the sweet-sounding harp and lyre.
chapters.zh: 唱起诗歌，打手鼓， 弹美琴与瑟。

chapters.en: Sound the ram’s horn at the New Moon, and at the full moon on the day of our Feast.
chapters.zh: 当在月朔并月望－ 我们过节的日期吹角，

chapters.en: For this is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
chapters.zh: 因这是为以色列定的律例， 是雅各上帝的典章。

chapters.en:
He ordained it as a testimony for Joseph when he went out over the land of Egypt,
where I heard an unfamiliar language:
chapters.zh: 他去攻击埃及地的时候， 在约瑟中间立此为证。 我〔在那里〕听见我所不明白的言语：

chapters.en: “I relieved his shoulder of the burden; his hands were freed from the basket.
chapters.zh: 〔上帝说〕：我使你的肩得脱重担， 你的手放下筐子。

chapters.en:
You called out in distress, and I rescued you; I answered you from the cloud of thunder;
I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah
chapters.zh: 你在急难中呼求，我就搭救你； 我在雷的隐密处应允你， 在米利巴水那里试验你。（细拉）

chapters.en: Hear, O My people, and I will warn you: O Israel, if only you would listen to Me!
chapters.zh: 我的民哪，你当听，我要劝戒你； 以色列啊，甚愿你肯听从我。

chapters.en: There must be no strange god among you, nor shall you bow to a foreign god.
chapters.zh: 在你当中，不可有别的神； 外邦的神，你也不可下拜。

chapters.en: I am the LORD your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open wide your mouth, and I will fill it.
chapters.zh: 我是耶和华－你的上帝， 曾把你从埃及地领上来； 你要大大张口，我就给你充满。

chapters.en: But My people would not listen to Me, and Israel would not obey Me.
chapters.zh: 无奈，我的民不听我的声音； 以色列全不理我。

chapters.en: So I gave them up to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.
chapters.zh: 我便任凭他们心里刚硬， 随自己的计谋而行。

chapters.en: If only My people would listen to Me, if Israel would follow My ways,
chapters.zh: 甚愿我的民肯听从我， 以色列肯行我的道，

chapters.en: how soon I would subdue their enemies and turn My hand against their foes!
chapters.zh: 我便速速治服他们的仇敌， 反手攻击他们的敌人。

chapters.en: Those who hate the LORD would feign obedience, and their doom would last forever.
chapters.zh: 恨耶和华的人必来投降， 但他的百姓必永久长存。

chapters.en: But I would feed you the finest wheat; with honey from the rock I would satisfy you.”
chapters.zh: 他也必拿上好的麦子给他们吃， 又拿从磐石出的蜂蜜叫他们饱足。

chapters.en: God presides in the divine assembly; He renders judgment among the gods:
chapters.zh: 上帝站在有权力者的会中， 在诸神中行审判，

chapters.en: “How long will you judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked? Selah
chapters.zh: 说：你们审判不秉公义， 徇恶人的情面，要到几时呢？（细拉）

chapters.en: Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless; uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed.
chapters.zh: 你们当为贫寒的人和孤儿伸冤； 当为困苦和穷乏的人施行公义。

chapters.en: Rescue the weak and needy; save them from the hand of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 当保护贫寒和穷乏的人， 救他们脱离恶人的手。

chapters.en:
They do not know or understand; they wander in the darkness;
all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
chapters.zh: 你们仍不知道，也不明白， 在黑暗中走来走去； 地的根基都摇动了。

chapters.en: I have said, ‘You are gods; you are all sons of the Most High.’
chapters.zh: 我曾说：你们是神， 都是至高者的儿子。

chapters.en: But like mortals you will die, and like rulers you will fall.”
chapters.zh: 然而，你们要死，与世人一样， 要仆倒，像王子中的一位。

chapters.en: Arise, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are Your inheritance.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你起来审判世界， 因为你要得万邦为业。

chapters.en: O God, be not silent; be not speechless; be not still, O God.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你不要静默！ 上帝啊，求你不要闭口，也不要不作声！

chapters.en: See how Your enemies rage, how Your foes have reared their heads.
chapters.zh: 因为你的仇敌喧嚷， 恨你的抬起头来。

chapters.en: With cunning they scheme against Your people and conspire against those You cherish,
chapters.zh: 他们同谋奸诈要害你的百姓， 彼此商议要害你所隐藏的人。

chapters.en: saying, “Come, let us erase them as a nation; may the name of Israel be remembered no more.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：来吧，我们将他们剪灭， 使他们不再成国！ 使以色列的名不再被人记念！

chapters.en: For with one mind they plot together; they form an alliance against You—
chapters.zh: 他们同心商议， 彼此结盟，要抵挡你，

chapters.en: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,
chapters.zh: 就是住帐棚的以东人和以实玛利人， 摩押和夏甲人，

chapters.en: of Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, of Philistia with the people of Tyre.
chapters.zh: 迦巴勒、亚扪， 和亚玛力、非利士并泰尔的居民。

chapters.en: Even Assyria has joined them, lending strength to the sons of Lot. Selah
chapters.zh: 亚述也与他们连合； 他们作罗得子孙的帮手。（细拉）

chapters.en: Do to them as You did to Midian, as to Sisera and Jabin at the River Kishon,
chapters.zh: 求你待他们，如待米甸， 如在基顺河待西西拉和耶宾一样。

chapters.en: who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground.
chapters.zh: 他们在隐‧多珥灭亡， 成了地上的粪土。

chapters.en: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, and all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
chapters.zh: 求你叫他们的首领像俄立和西伊伯， 叫他们的王子都像西巴和撒慕拿。

chapters.en: who said, “Let us possess for ourselves the pastures of God.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：我们要得上帝的住处， 作为自己的产业。

chapters.en: Make them like tumbleweed, O my God, like chaff before the wind.
chapters.zh: 我的上帝啊，求你叫他们像旋风的尘土， 像风前的碎诩。

chapters.en: As fire consumes a forest, as a flame sets the mountains ablaze,
chapters.zh: 火怎样焚烧树林， 火焰怎样烧着山岭，

chapters.en: so pursue them with Your tempest, and terrify them with Your storm.
chapters.zh: 求你也照样用狂风追赶他们， 用暴雨恐吓他们。

chapters.en: Cover their faces with shame, that they may seek Your name, O LORD.
chapters.zh: 愿你使他们满面羞耻， 好叫他们寻求你－耶和华的名！

chapters.en: May they be ever ashamed and terrified; may they perish in disgrace.
chapters.zh: 愿他们永远羞愧惊惶！ 愿他们惭愧灭亡！

chapters.en:
May they know that You alone, whose name is the LORD,
are Most High over all the earth.
chapters.zh: 使他们知道：惟独你－ 名为耶和华的－是全地以上的至高者！

chapters.en: How lovely is Your dwelling place, O LORD of Hosts!
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华啊， 你的居所何等可爱！

chapters.en: My soul longs, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
chapters.zh: 我羨慕渴想耶和华的院宇； 我的心肠，我的肉体向永生上帝呼吁〔注：或译：欢呼〕。

chapters.en: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she places her young near Your altars, O LORD of Hosts, my King and my God.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华－我的王，我的上帝啊， 在你祭坛那里，麻雀为自己找着房屋， 燕子为自己找着菢雏之窝。

chapters.en: How blessed are those who dwell in Your house! They are ever praising You. Selah
chapters.zh: 如此住在你殿中的便为有福！ 他们仍要赞美你。（细拉）
