chapters.en: Blessed are those whose strength is in You, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.
chapters.zh: 靠你有力量、心中想往锡安大道的， 这人便为有福！

chapters.en:
As they pass through the Valley of Baca, they make it a place of springs;
even the autumn rain covers it with pools.
chapters.zh: 他们经过「流泪谷」，叫这谷变为泉源之地； 并有秋雨之福盖满了全谷。

chapters.en: They go from strength to strength, until each appears before God in Zion.
chapters.zh: 他们行走，力上加力， 各人到锡安朝见上帝。

chapters.en: O LORD God of Hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah
chapters.zh: 耶和华－万军之上帝啊，求你听我的祷告！ 雅各的上帝啊，求你留心听！（细拉）

chapters.en: Take notice of our shield, O God, and look with favor on the face of Your anointed.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你是我们的盾牌； 求你垂顾观看你受膏者的面！

chapters.en: For better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 在你的院宇住一日， 胜似〔在别处住〕千日； 宁可在我上帝殿中看门， 不愿住在恶人的帐棚里。

chapters.en: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华－上帝是日头，是盾牌， 要赐下恩惠和荣耀。 他未尝留下一样好处不给那些行动正直的人。

chapters.en: O LORD of Hosts, how blessed is the man who trusts in You!
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华啊， 倚靠你的人便为有福！

chapters.en: You showed favor to Your land, O LORD; You restored Jacob from captivity.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你已经向你的地施恩， 救回被掳的雅各。

chapters.en: You forgave the iniquity of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah
chapters.zh: 你赦免了你百姓的罪孽， 遮盖了他们一切的过犯。（细拉）

chapters.en: You withheld all Your fury; You turned from Your burning anger.
chapters.zh: 你收转了所发的忿怒 和你猛烈的怒气。

chapters.en: Restore us, O God of our salvation, and put away Your displeasure toward us.
chapters.zh: 拯救我们的上帝啊，求你使我们回转， 叫你的恼恨向我们止息。

chapters.en: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?
chapters.zh: 你要向我们发怒到永远吗？ 你要将你的怒气延留到万代吗？

chapters.en: Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?
chapters.zh: 你不再将我们救活， 使你的百姓靠你欢喜吗？

chapters.en: Show us Your loving devotion, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你使我们得见你的慈爱， 又将你的救恩赐给我们。

chapters.en:
I will listen to what God the LORD will say; for He will surely speak peace to His people and His saints;
He will not let them return to folly.
chapters.zh: 我要听上帝－耶和华所说的话； 因为他必应许将平安赐给他的百姓－他的圣民； 他们却不可再转去妄行。

chapters.en: Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that His glory may dwell in our land.
chapters.zh: 他的救恩诚然与敬畏他的人相近， 叫荣耀住在我们的地上。

chapters.en: Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together; righteousness and peace have kissed.
chapters.zh: 慈爱和诚实彼此相遇； 公义和平安彼此相亲。

chapters.en: Faithfulness sprouts from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.
chapters.zh: 诚实从地而生； 公义从天而现。

chapters.en: The LORD will indeed provide what is good, and our land will yield its increase.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必将好处赐给〔我们〕； 我们的地也要〔多〕出土产。

chapters.en: Righteousness will go before Him to prepare the way for His steps.
chapters.zh: 公义要行在他面前， 叫他的脚踪成为〔可走的〕路。

chapters.en: Incline Your ear, O LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你侧耳应允我， 因我是困苦穷乏的。

chapters.en: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You are my God; save Your servant who trusts in You.
chapters.zh: 求你保存我的性命，因我是虔诚人。 我的上帝啊，求你拯救这倚靠你的仆人！

chapters.en: Be merciful to me, O Lord, for I call to You all day long.
chapters.zh: 主啊，求你怜悯我， 因我终日求告你。

chapters.en: Bring joy to Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
chapters.zh: 主啊，求你使仆人心里欢喜， 因为我的心仰望你。

chapters.en: For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.
chapters.zh: 主啊，你本为良善，乐意饶恕人， 有丰盛的慈爱赐给凡求告你的人。

chapters.en: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and attend to my plea for mercy.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你留心听我的祷告， 垂听我恳求的声音。

chapters.en: In the day of my distress I call on You, because You answer me.
chapters.zh: 我在患难之日要求告你， 因为你必应允我。

chapters.en: O Lord, there is none like You among the gods, nor any works like Yours.
chapters.zh: 主啊，诸神之中没有可比你的； 你的作为也无可比。

chapters.en:
All the nations You have made will come and bow before You, O Lord,
and they will glorify Your name.
chapters.zh: 主啊，你所造的万民都要来敬拜你； 他们也要荣耀你的名。

chapters.en: For You are great and perform wonders; You alone are God.
chapters.zh: 因你为大，且行奇妙的事； 惟独你是上帝。

chapters.en: Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你将你的道指教我； 我要照你的真理行； 求你使我专心敬畏你的名！

chapters.en: I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.
chapters.zh: 主－我的上帝啊，我要一心称赞你； 我要荣耀你的名，直到永远。

chapters.en: For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.
chapters.zh: 因为，你向我发的慈爱是大的； 你救了我的灵魂免入极深的阴间。

chapters.en:
The arrogant rise against me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life;
they have no regard for You.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，骄傲的人起来攻击我， 又有一党强横的人寻索我的命； 他们没有将你放在眼中。

chapters.en: But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.
chapters.zh: 主啊，你是有怜悯有恩典的上帝， 不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱和诚实。

chapters.en:
Turn to me and have mercy; grant Your strength to Your servant;
save the son of Your maidservant.
chapters.zh: 求你向我转脸，怜恤我， 将你的力量赐给仆人，救你婢女的儿子。

chapters.en:
Show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed;
for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
chapters.zh: 求你向我显出恩待我的凭据， 叫恨我的人看见便羞愧， 因为你－耶和华帮助我，安慰我。

chapters.en: He has founded His city on the holy mountains.
chapters.zh: 耶和华所立的根基在圣山上。

chapters.en: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
chapters.zh: 他爱锡安的门， 胜于爱雅各一切的住处。

chapters.en: Glorious things are ascribed to you, O city of God. Selah
chapters.zh: 上帝的城啊， 有荣耀的事乃指着你说的。（细拉）

chapters.en: “I will mention Rahab and Babylon among those who know Me— along with Philistia, Tyre, and Cush — when I say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’”
chapters.zh: 我要提起拉哈伯和巴比伦人， 是在认识我之中的； 看哪，非利士和泰尔并古实人， 个个生在那里。

chapters.en:
And it will be said of Zion: “This one and that one were born in her,
and the Most High Himself will establish her.”
chapters.zh: 论到锡安，必说： 这一个、那一个都生在其中， 而且至高者必亲自坚立这城。

chapters.en: The LORD will record in the register of the peoples: “This one was born in Zion.” Selah
chapters.zh: 当耶和华记录万民的时候， 他要点出这一个生在那里。（细拉）

chapters.en: Singers and pipers will proclaim, “All my springs of joy are in You.”
chapters.zh: 歌唱的，跳舞的，都〔要说〕： 我的泉源都在你里面。

chapters.en: O LORD, the God of my salvation, day and night I cry out before You.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－拯救我的上帝啊， 我昼夜在你面前呼吁。

chapters.en: May my prayer come before You; incline Your ear to my cry.
chapters.zh: 愿我的祷告达到你面前； 求你侧耳听我的呼求！

chapters.en: For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol.
chapters.zh: 因为我心里满了患难； 我的性命临近阴间。

chapters.en: I am counted among those descending to the Pit. I am like a man without strength.
chapters.zh: 我算和下坑的人同列， 如同无力〔注：或译：没有帮助〕的人一样。

chapters.en: I am forsaken among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom You remember no more, who are cut off from Your care.
chapters.zh: 我被丢在死人中， 好像被杀的人躺在坟墓里。 他们是你不再记念的， 与你隔绝了。

chapters.en: You have laid me in the lowest Pit, in the darkest of the depths.
chapters.zh: 你把我放在极深的坑里， 在黑暗地方，在深处。

chapters.en: Your wrath weighs heavily upon me; all Your waves have submerged me. Selah
chapters.zh: 你的忿怒重压我身； 你用一切的波浪困住我。（细拉）

chapters.en:
You have removed my friends from me; You have made me repulsive to them;
I am confined and cannot escape.
chapters.zh: 你把我所认识的隔在远处， 使我为他们所憎恶； 我被拘困，不得出来。

chapters.en:
My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD;
I spread out my hands to You.
chapters.zh: 我的眼睛因困苦而干瘪。 耶和华啊，我天天求告你，向你举手。

chapters.en: Do You work wonders for the dead? Do departed spirits rise up to praise You? Selah
chapters.zh: 你岂要行奇事给死人看吗？ 难道阴魂还能起来称赞你吗？（细拉）

chapters.en: Can Your loving devotion be proclaimed in the grave, Your faithfulness in Abaddon ?
chapters.zh: 岂能在坟墓里述说你的慈爱吗？ 岂能在灭亡中述说你的信实吗？

chapters.en: Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, or Your righteousness in the land of oblivion?
chapters.zh: 你的奇事岂能在幽暗里被知道吗？ 你的公义岂能在忘记之地被知道吗？

chapters.en: But to You, O LORD, I cry for help; in the morning my prayer comes before You.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我呼求你； 我早晨的祷告要达到你面前。

chapters.en: Why, O LORD, do You reject me? Why do You hide Your face from me?
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你为何丢弃我？ 为何掩面不顾我？

chapters.en: From my youth I was afflicted and near death. I have borne Your terrors; I am in despair.
chapters.zh: 我自幼受苦，几乎死亡； 我受你的惊恐，甚至慌张。

chapters.en: Your wrath has swept over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.
chapters.zh: 你的烈怒漫过我身； 你的惊吓把我剪除。

chapters.en: All day long they engulf me like water; they enclose me on every side.
chapters.zh: 这些终日如水环绕我， 一齐都来围困我。

chapters.en: You have removed my beloved and my friend; darkness is my closest companion.
chapters.zh: 你把我的良朋密友隔在远处， 使我所认识的人进入黑暗里。

chapters.en: I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.
chapters.zh: 我要歌唱耶和华的慈爱，直到永远； 我要用口将你的信实传与万代。

chapters.en: For I have said, “Loving devotion is built up forever; in the heavens You establish Your faithfulness.”
chapters.zh: 因我曾说：〔你的〕慈悲必建立到永远； 你的信实必坚立在天上。

chapters.en: You said, “I have made a covenant with My chosen one, I have sworn to David My servant:
chapters.zh: 我与我所拣选的人立了约， 向我的仆人大卫起了誓：

chapters.en: ‘I will establish your offspring forever and build up your throne for all generations.’” Selah
chapters.zh: 我要建立你的后裔，直到永远； 要建立你的宝座，直到万代。（细拉）

chapters.en:
The heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD— Your faithfulness as well—
in the assembly of the holy ones.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，诸天要称赞你的奇事； 在圣者的会中，要称赞你的信实。

chapters.en: For who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?
chapters.zh: 在天空谁能比耶和华呢？ 神的众子中，谁能像耶和华呢？

chapters.en: In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared, and awesome above all who surround Him.
chapters.zh: 他在圣者的会中，是大有威严的上帝， 比一切在他四围的更可畏惧。

chapters.en: O LORD God of Hosts, who is like You? O mighty LORD, Your faithfulness surrounds You.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－万军之上帝啊， 哪一个大能者像你耶和华？ 你的信实是在你的四围。

chapters.en: You rule the raging sea; when its waves mount up, You still them.
chapters.zh: 你管辖海的狂傲； 波浪翻腾，你就使它平静了。

chapters.en: You crushed Rahab like a carcass; You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.
chapters.zh: 你打碎了拉哈伯，似乎是已杀的人； 你用有能的膀臂打散了你的仇敌。

chapters.en: The heavens are Yours, and also the earth. The earth and its fullness You founded.
chapters.zh: 天属你，地也属你； 世界和其中所充满的都为你所建立。

chapters.en: North and south You created; Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name.
chapters.zh: 南北为你所创造； 他泊和黑门都因你的名欢呼。

chapters.en: Mighty is Your arm; strong is Your hand. Your right hand is exalted.
chapters.zh: 你有大能的膀臂； 你的手有力，你的右手也高举。

chapters.en: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.
chapters.zh: 公义和公平是你宝座的根基； 慈爱和诚实行在你前面。

chapters.en: Blessed are those who know the joyful sound, who walk, O LORD, in the light of Your presence.
chapters.zh: 知道〔向你〕欢呼的，那民是有福的！ 耶和华啊，他们在你脸上的光里行走。

chapters.en: They rejoice in Your name all day long, and in Your righteousness they exult.
chapters.zh: 他们因你的名终日欢乐， 因你的公义得以高举。

chapters.en: For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is exalted.
chapters.zh: 你是他们力量的荣耀； 因为你喜悦我们，我们的角必被高举。

chapters.en: Surely our shield belongs to the LORD, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.
chapters.zh: 我们的盾牌属耶和华； 我们的王属以色列的圣者。

chapters.en: You once spoke in a vision; to Your godly ones You said, “I have bestowed help on a warrior; I have exalted one chosen from the people.
chapters.zh: 当时，你在异象中晓谕你的圣民，说： 我已把救助之力加在那有能者的身上； 我高举那从民中所拣选的。

chapters.en: I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.
chapters.zh: 我寻得我的仆人大卫， 用我的圣膏膏他。

chapters.en: My hand will sustain him; surely My arm will strengthen him.
chapters.zh: 我的手必使他坚立； 我的膀臂也必坚固他。

chapters.en: No enemy will exact tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.
chapters.zh: 仇敌必不勒索他； 凶恶之子也不苦害他。

chapters.en: I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him.
chapters.zh: 我要在他面前打碎他的敌人， 击杀那恨他的人。

chapters.en: My faithfulness and loving devotion will be with him, and through My name his horn will be exalted.
chapters.zh: 只是我的信实和我的慈爱要与他同在； 因我的名，他的角必被高举。

chapters.en: I will set his hand over the sea, and his right hand upon the rivers.
chapters.zh: 我要使他的〔左〕手伸到海上， 右手伸到河上。

chapters.en: He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock of my salvation.’
chapters.zh: 他要称呼我说：你是我的父， 是我的上帝，是拯救我的磐石。

chapters.en: I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
chapters.zh: 我也要立他为长子， 为世上最高的君王。

chapters.en: I will forever preserve My loving devotion for him, and My covenant with him will stand fast.
chapters.zh: 我要为他存留我的慈爱，直到永远； 我与他立的约必要坚定。

chapters.en: I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.
chapters.zh: 我也要使他的后裔存到永远， 使他的宝座如天之久。

chapters.en: If his sons forsake My law and do not walk in My judgments,
chapters.zh: 倘若他的子孙离弃我的律法， 不照我的典章行，

chapters.en: if they violate My statutes and fail to keep My commandments,
chapters.zh: 背弃我的律例， 不遵守我的诫命，

chapters.en: I will attend to their transgression with the rod, and to their iniquity with stripes.
chapters.zh: 我就要用杖责罚他们的过犯， 用鞭责罚他们的罪孽。

chapters.en: But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.
chapters.zh: 只是我必不将我的慈爱全然收回， 也必不叫我的信实废弃。

chapters.en: I will not violate My covenant or alter the utterance of My lips.
chapters.zh: 我必不背弃我的约， 也不改变我口中所出的。

chapters.en: Once and for all I have sworn by My holiness— I will not lie to David—
chapters.zh: 我一次指着自己的圣洁起誓： 我决不向大卫说谎！

chapters.en: his offspring shall endure forever, and his throne before Me like the sun,
chapters.zh: 他的后裔要存到永远； 他的宝座在我面前如日之恒一般，

chapters.en: like the moon, established forever, a faithful witness in the sky.” Selah
chapters.zh: 又如月亮永远坚立， 如天上确实的见证。（细拉）

chapters.en: Now, however, You have spurned and rejected him; You are enraged by Your anointed one.
chapters.zh: 但你恼怒你的受膏者， 就丢掉弃绝他。

chapters.en: You have renounced the covenant with Your servant and sullied his crown in the dust.
chapters.zh: 你厌恶了与仆人所立的约， 将他的冠冕践踏于地。

chapters.en: You have broken down all his walls; You have reduced his strongholds to rubble.
chapters.zh: 你拆毁了他一切的篱笆， 使他的保障变为荒场。

chapters.en: All who pass by plunder him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.
chapters.zh: 凡过路的人都抢夺他； 他成为邻邦的羞辱。

chapters.en: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; You have made all his enemies rejoice.
chapters.zh: 你高举了他敌人的右手； 你叫他一切的仇敌欢喜。

chapters.en: You have bent the edge of his sword and have not sustained him in battle.
chapters.zh: 你叫他的刀剑卷刃， 叫他在争战之中站立不住。

chapters.en: You have ended his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.
chapters.zh: 你使他的光辉止息， 将他的宝座推倒于地。

chapters.en: You have cut short the days of his youth; You have covered him with shame. Selah
chapters.zh: 你减少他青年的日子， 又使他蒙羞。（细拉）

chapters.en:
How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever?
Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，这要到几时呢？ 你要将自己隐藏到永远吗？ 你的忿怒如火焚烧要到几时呢？

chapters.en: Remember the briefness of my lifespan! For what futility You have created all men!
chapters.zh: 求你想念我的时候是何等的短少； 你创造世人，要使他们归何等的虚空呢？

chapters.en: What man can live and never see death? Can he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah
chapters.zh: 谁能常活免死、 救他的灵魂脱离阴间的权柄呢？（细拉）

chapters.en: Where, O Lord, is Your loving devotion of old, which You faithfully swore to David?
chapters.zh: 主啊，你从前凭你的信实 向大卫立誓要施行的慈爱在哪里呢？

chapters.en: Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Your servants, which I bear in my heart from so many people—
chapters.zh: 主啊，求你记念仆人们所受的羞辱， 记念我怎样将一切强盛民的〔羞辱〕存在我怀里。

chapters.en: how Your enemies have taunted, O LORD, and have mocked every step of Your anointed one!
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你的仇敌用这羞辱羞辱了你的仆人， 羞辱了你受膏者的脚踪。

chapters.en:
Blessed be the LORD forever!
Amen and amen.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的，直到永远。 阿们！阿们！

chapters.en: Lord, You have been our dwelling place through all generations.
chapters.zh: 主啊，你世世代代作我们的居所。

chapters.en: Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.
chapters.zh: 诸山未曾生出， 地与世界你未曾造成， 从亘古到永远，你是上帝。

chapters.en: You return man to dust, saying, “Return, O sons of mortals.”
chapters.zh: 你使人归于尘土，说： 你们世人要归回。

chapters.en:
For in Your sight a thousand years are but a day that passes,
or a watch of the night.
chapters.zh: 在你看来，千年如已过的昨日， 又如夜间的一更。

chapters.en: You sweep them away in their sleep; they are like the new grass of the morning—
chapters.zh: 你叫他们如水冲去； 他们如睡一觉。 早晨，他们如生长的草，

chapters.en: in the morning it springs up new, but by evening it fades and withers.
chapters.zh: 早晨发芽生长， 晚上割下枯干。

chapters.en: For we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath.
chapters.zh: 我们因你的怒气而消灭， 因你的忿怒而惊惶。

chapters.en: You have set our iniquities before You, our secret sins in the light of Your presence.
chapters.zh: 你将我们的罪孽摆在你面前， 将我们的隐恶摆在你面光之中。

chapters.en: For all our days decline in Your fury; we finish our years with a sigh.
chapters.zh: 我们经过的日子都在你震怒之下； 我们度尽的年岁好像一声叹息。

chapters.en: The length of our days is seventy years— or eighty if we are strong— yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.
chapters.zh: 我们一生的年日是七十岁， 若是强壮可到八十岁； 但其中所矜夸的不过是劳苦愁烦， 转眼成空，我们便如飞而去。

chapters.en: Who knows the power of Your anger? Your wrath matches the fear You are due.
chapters.zh: 谁晓得你怒气的权势？ 谁按着你该受的敬畏晓得你的忿怒呢？

chapters.en: So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.
chapters.zh: 求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子， 好叫我们得着智慧的心。

chapters.en: Return, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我们要等到几时呢？ 求你转回，为你的仆人后悔。

chapters.en: Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.
chapters.zh: 求你使我们早早饱得你的慈爱， 好叫我们一生一世欢呼喜乐。

chapters.en: Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
chapters.zh: 求你照着你使我们受苦的日子， 和我们遭难的年岁，叫我们喜乐。

chapters.en: May Your work be shown to Your servants, and Your splendor to their children.
chapters.zh: 愿你的作为向你仆人显现； 愿你的荣耀向他们子孙显明。

chapters.en:
May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us; establish for us the work of our hands—
yes, establish the work of our hands!
chapters.zh: 愿主－我们上帝的荣美归于我们身上。 愿你坚立我们手所做的工； 我们手所做的工，愿你坚立。

chapters.en: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
chapters.zh: 住在至高者隐密处的， 必住在全能者的荫下。

chapters.en: I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
chapters.zh: 我要论到耶和华说： 他是我的避难所，是我的山寨， 是我的上帝，是我所倚靠的。

chapters.en:
Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler,
and from the deadly plague.
chapters.zh: 他必救你脱离捕鸟人的网罗 和毒害的瘟疫。

chapters.en:
He will cover you with His feathers; under His wings you will find refuge;
His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.
chapters.zh: 他必用自己的翎毛遮蔽你； 你要投靠在他的翅膀底下； 他的诚实是大小的盾牌。

chapters.en: You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
chapters.zh: 你必不怕黑夜的惊骇， 或是白日飞的箭，

chapters.en: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the calamity that destroys at noon.
chapters.zh: 也不怕黑夜行的瘟疫， 或是午间灭人的毒病。

chapters.en:
Though a thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand,
no harm will come near you.
chapters.zh: 虽有千人仆倒在你旁边， 万人仆倒在你右边， 这灾却不得临近你。

chapters.en: You will only see it with your eyes and witness the punishment of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 你惟亲眼观看， 见恶人遭报。

chapters.en: Because you have made the LORD your dwelling— my refuge, the Most High—
chapters.zh: 耶和华是我的避难所； 你已将至高者当你的居所，

chapters.en: no evil will befall you, no plague will approach your tent.
chapters.zh: 祸患必不临到你， 灾害也不挨近你的帐棚。

chapters.en: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
chapters.zh: 因他要为你吩咐他的使者， 在你行的一切道路上保护你。

chapters.en: They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
chapters.zh: 他们要用手托着你， 免得你的脚碰在石头上。

chapters.en: You will tread on the lion and cobra; you will trample the young lion and serpent.
chapters.zh: 你要踹在狮子和虺蛇的身上， 践踏少壮狮子和大蛇。

chapters.en: “Because he loves Me, I will deliver him; because he knows My name, I will protect him.
chapters.zh: 上帝〔说〕：因为他专心爱我，我就要搭救他； 因为他知道我的名，我要把他安置在高处。

chapters.en: When he calls out to Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him and honor him.
chapters.zh: 他若求告我，我就应允他； 他在急难中，我要与他同在； 我要搭救他，使他尊贵。

chapters.en: With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”
chapters.zh: 我要使他足享长寿， 将我的救恩显明给他。

chapters.en: It is good to praise the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High,
chapters.zh: 称谢耶和华！ 歌颂你至高者的名！

chapters.en: to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning and Your faithfulness at night
with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.
chapters.zh: 用十弦的乐器和瑟， 用琴弹幽雅的声音， 早晨传扬你的慈爱； 每夜传扬你的信实。 这本为美事。

chapters.en: For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds; I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.
chapters.zh: 因你－耶和华藉着你的作为叫我高兴， 我要因你手的工作欢呼。

chapters.en: How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你的工作何其大！ 你的心思极其深！

chapters.en: A senseless man does not know, and a fool does not understand,
chapters.zh: 畜类人不晓得； 愚顽人也不明白。

chapters.en:
that though the wicked sprout like grass, and all evildoers flourish,
they will be forever destroyed.
chapters.zh: 恶人茂盛如草， 一切作孽之人发旺的时候， 正是他们要灭亡， 直到永远。

chapters.en: But You, O LORD, are exalted forever!
chapters.zh: 惟你－耶和华是至高， 直到永远。

chapters.en:
For surely Your enemies, O LORD, surely Your enemies will perish;
all evildoers will be scattered.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你的仇敌都要灭亡； 一切作孽的也要离散。

chapters.en: But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; with fine oil I have been anointed.
chapters.zh: 你却高举了我的角，如野牛的角； 我是被新油膏了的。

chapters.en: My eyes see the downfall of my enemies; my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes.
chapters.zh: 我眼睛看见仇敌〔遭报〕； 我耳朵听见那些起来攻击我的恶人〔受罚〕。

chapters.en: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
chapters.zh: 义人要发旺如棕树， 生长如黎巴嫩的香柏树。

chapters.en: Planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.
chapters.zh: 他们栽于耶和华的殿中， 发旺在我们上帝的院里。

chapters.en: In old age they will still bear fruit; healthy and green they will remain,
chapters.zh: 他们年老的时候仍要结果子， 要满了汁浆而常发青，

chapters.en: to proclaim, “The LORD is upright; He is my Rock, and in Him there is no unrighteousness.”
chapters.zh: 好显明耶和华是正直的。 他是我的磐石，在他毫无不义。

chapters.en: The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
chapters.zh: 耶和华作王！ 他以威严为衣穿上； 耶和华以能力为衣，以能力束腰， 世界就坚定，不得动摇。

chapters.en: Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.
chapters.zh: 你的宝座从太初立定； 你从亘古就有。

chapters.en:
The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice;
the seas lift up their pounding waves.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，大水扬起， 大水发声，波浪澎湃。

chapters.en:
Above the roar of many waters— the mighty breakers of the sea—
the LORD on high is majestic.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在高处大有能力， 胜过诸水的响声，洋海的大浪。

chapters.en:
Your testimonies are fully confirmed; holiness adorns Your house, O LORD,
for all the days to come.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你的法度最的确； 你的殿永称为圣，是合宜的。

chapters.en: O LORD, God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, shine forth.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你是伸冤的上帝； 伸冤的上帝啊，求你发出光来！

chapters.en: Rise up, O Judge of the earth; render a reward to the proud.
chapters.zh: 审判世界的主啊，求你挺身而立， 使骄傲人受应得的报应！

chapters.en: How long will the wicked, O LORD, how long will the wicked exult?
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，恶人夸胜要到几时呢？ 要到几时呢？

chapters.en: They pour out arrogant words; all workers of iniquity boast.
chapters.zh: 他们絮絮叨叨说傲慢的话； 一切作孽的人都自己夸张。

chapters.en: They crush Your people, O LORD; they oppress Your heritage.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，他们强压你的百姓， 苦害你的产业。

chapters.en: They kill the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.
chapters.zh: 他们杀死寡妇和寄居的， 又杀害孤儿。

chapters.en: They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：耶和华必不看见； 雅各的上帝必不思念。

chapters.en: Take notice, O senseless among the people! O fools, when will you be wise?
chapters.zh: 你们民间的畜类人当思想； 你们愚顽人到几时才有智慧呢？

chapters.en: He who affixed the ear, can He not hear? He who formed the eye, can He not see?
chapters.zh: 造耳朵的，难道自己不听见吗？ 造眼睛的，难道自己不看见吗？

chapters.en: He who admonishes the nations, does He not discipline? He who teaches man, does He lack knowledge?
chapters.zh: 管教列邦的，就是叫人得知识的， 难道自己不惩治人吗？

chapters.en: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
chapters.zh: 耶和华知道人的意念是虚妄的。

chapters.en: Blessed is the man You discipline, O LORD, and teach from Your law,
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你所管教、 用律法所教训的人是有福的！

chapters.en: to grant him relief from days of trouble, until a pit is dug for the wicked.
chapters.zh: 你使他在遭难的日子得享平安； 惟有恶人陷在所挖的坑中。

chapters.en: For the LORD will not forsake His people; He will never abandon His heritage.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华必不丢弃他的百姓， 也不离弃他的产业。

chapters.en: Surely judgment will again be righteous, and all the upright in heart will follow it.
chapters.zh: 审判要转向公义； 心里正直的，必都随从。

chapters.en: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand for me against the workers of iniquity?
chapters.zh: 谁肯为我起来攻击作恶的？ 谁肯为我站起抵挡作孽的？

chapters.en: Unless the LORD had been my helper, I would soon have dwelt in the abode of silence.
chapters.zh: 若不是耶和华帮助我， 我就住在寂静之中了。

chapters.en: If I say, “My foot is slipping,” Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.
chapters.zh: 我正说我失了脚， 耶和华啊，那时你的慈爱扶助我。

chapters.en: When anxiety overwhelms me, Your consolation delights my soul.
chapters.zh: 我心里多忧多疑， 你安慰我，就使我欢乐。

chapters.en: Can a corrupt throne be Your ally— one devising mischief by decree?
chapters.zh: 那藉着律例架弄残害、 在位上行奸恶的，岂能与你相交吗？

chapters.en: They band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.
chapters.zh: 他们大家聚集攻击义人， 将无辜的人定为死罪。

chapters.en: But the LORD has been my stronghold, and my God is my rock of refuge.
chapters.zh: 但耶和华向来作了我的高台； 我的上帝作了我投靠的磐石。

chapters.en:
He will bring upon them their own iniquity and destroy them for their wickedness.
The LORD our God will destroy them.
chapters.zh: 他叫他们的罪孽归到他们身上。 他们正在行恶之中，他要剪除他们； 耶和华－我们的上帝要把他们剪除。

chapters.en: Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout to the Rock of our salvation!
chapters.zh: 来啊，我们要向耶和华歌唱， 向拯救我们的磐石欢呼！

chapters.en: Let us enter His presence with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to Him in song.
chapters.zh: 我们要来感谢他， 用诗歌向他欢呼！

chapters.en: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华为大上帝， 为大王，超乎万神之上。

chapters.en: In His hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to Him.
chapters.zh: 地的深处在他手中； 山的高峰也属他。

chapters.en: The sea is His, for He made it, and His hands formed the dry land.
chapters.zh: 海洋属他，是他造的； 旱地也是他手造成的。

chapters.en: O come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.
chapters.zh: 来啊，我们要屈身敬拜， 在造我们的耶和华面前跪下。

chapters.en:
For He is our God, and we are the people of His pasture,
the sheep under His care.
Today, if you hear His voice,
chapters.zh: 因为他是我们的上帝； 我们是他草场的羊，是他手下的民。 惟愿你们今天听他的话：

chapters.en: do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah, in the day at Massah in the wilderness,
chapters.zh: 你们不可硬着心，像当日在米利巴， 就是在旷野的玛撒。

chapters.en: where your fathers tested and tried Me, though they had seen My work.
chapters.zh: 那时，你们的祖宗试我探我， 并且观看我的作为。

chapters.en:
For forty years I was angry with that generation, and I said, “They are a people whose hearts go astray,
and they have not known My ways.”
chapters.zh: 四十年之久，我厌烦那世代，说： 这是心里迷糊的百姓， 竟不晓得我的作为！

chapters.en: So I swore on oath in My anger, “They shall never enter My rest.”
chapters.zh: 所以，我在怒中起誓，说： 他们断不可进入我的安息！

chapters.en: Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.
chapters.zh: 你们要向耶和华唱新歌！ 全地都要向耶和华歌唱！

chapters.en: Sing to the LORD, bless His name; proclaim His salvation day after day.
chapters.zh: 要向耶和华歌唱，称颂他的名！ 天天传扬他的救恩！

chapters.en: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all peoples.
chapters.zh: 在列邦中述说他的荣耀！ 在万民中述说他的奇事！

chapters.en: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华为大，当受极大的赞美； 他在万神之上，当受敬畏。

chapters.en: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is the LORD who made the heavens.
chapters.zh: 外邦的神都属虚无； 惟独耶和华创造诸天。

chapters.en: Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and beauty fill His sanctuary.
chapters.zh: 有尊荣和威严在他面前； 有能力与华美在他圣所。

chapters.en: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
chapters.zh: 民中的万族啊，你们要将荣耀、能力归给耶和华， 都归给耶和华！

chapters.en: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and enter His courts.
chapters.zh: 要将耶和华的名所当得的荣耀归给他， 拿供物来进入他的院宇。

chapters.en: Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness; tremble before Him, all the earth.
chapters.zh: 当以圣洁的〔注：的：或译为〕妆饰敬拜耶和华； 全地要在他面前战抖！

chapters.en:
Declare among the nations: “The LORD reigns!” The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved;
He will judge the peoples with equity.
chapters.zh: 人在列邦中要说：耶和华作王！ 世界就坚定，不得动摇； 他要按公正审判众民。

chapters.en: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice; let the sea resound, and all that fills it.
chapters.zh: 愿天欢喜，愿地快乐！ 愿海和其中所充满的澎湃！

chapters.en: Let the fields exult, and all that is in them. Then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy
chapters.zh: 愿田和其中所有的都欢乐！ 那时，林中的树木都要在耶和华面前欢呼。

chapters.en: before the LORD, for He is coming— He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in His faithfulness.
chapters.zh: 因为他来了，他来要审判全地。 他要按公义审判世界， 按他的信实审判万民。

chapters.en: The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the distant shores be glad.
chapters.zh: 耶和华作王！愿地快乐！ 愿众海岛欢喜！

chapters.en: Clouds and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation.
chapters.zh: 密云和幽暗在他的四围； 公义和公平是他宝座的根基。

chapters.en: Fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side.
chapters.zh: 有烈火在他前头行， 烧灭他四围的敌人。

chapters.en: His lightning illuminates the world; the earth sees and trembles.
chapters.zh: 他的闪电光照世界， 大地看见便震动。

chapters.en:
The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD,
before the Lord of all the earth.
chapters.zh: 诸山见耶和华的面， 就是全地之主的面，便消化如蜡。

chapters.en: The heavens proclaim His righteousness; all the peoples see His glory.
chapters.zh: 诸天表明他的公义； 万民看见他的荣耀。

chapters.en:
All worshipers of images are put to shame— those who boast in idols.
Worship Him, all you gods!
chapters.zh: 愿一切事奉雕刻的偶像、 靠虚无〔之神〕自夸的，都蒙羞愧。 万神哪，你们都当拜他。

chapters.en:
Zion hears and rejoices, and the towns of Judah exult
because of Your judgments, O LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，锡安听见你的判断就欢喜； 犹大的城邑〔注：原文是女子〕也都快乐。

chapters.en: For You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.
chapters.zh: 因为你－耶和华至高，超乎全地； 你被尊崇，远超万神之上。

chapters.en:
Hate evil, O you who love the LORD! He preserves the souls of His saints;
He delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 你们爱耶和华的，都当恨恶罪恶； 他保护圣民的性命， 搭救他们脱离恶人的手。

chapters.en: Light shines on the righteous, gladness on the upright in heart.
chapters.zh: 散布亮光是为义人； 预备喜乐是为正直人。

chapters.en: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous ones, and praise His holy name.
chapters.zh: 你们义人当靠耶和华欢喜， 称谢他可记念的圣〔名〕。

chapters.en: Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory.
chapters.zh: 你们要向耶和华唱新歌！ 因为他行过奇妙的事； 他的右手和圣臂施行救恩。

chapters.en: The LORD has proclaimed His salvation and revealed His righteousness to the nations.
chapters.zh: 耶和华发明了他的救恩， 在列邦人眼前显出公义；

chapters.en: He has remembered His love and faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
chapters.zh: 记念他向以色列家所发的慈爱，所凭的信实。 地的四极都看见我们上帝的救恩。

chapters.en: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth—let your cry ring out, and sing praises!
chapters.zh: 全地都要向耶和华欢乐； 要发起大声，欢呼歌颂！

chapters.en: Sing praises to the LORD with the lyre, in melodious song with the harp.
chapters.zh: 要用琴歌颂耶和华， 用琴和诗歌的声音歌颂他！

chapters.en: With trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn shout for joy before the LORD, the King.
chapters.zh: 用号和角声， 在大君王耶和华面前欢呼！

chapters.en: Let the sea resound, and all that fills it, the world, and all who dwell in it.
chapters.zh: 愿海和其中所充满的澎湃； 世界和住在其间的也要发声。

chapters.en: Let the rivers clap their hands, let the mountains sing together for joy
chapters.zh: 愿大水拍手； 愿诸山在耶和华面前一同欢呼；

chapters.en: before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.
chapters.zh: 因为他来要审判遍地。 他要按公义审判世界， 按公正审判万民。

chapters.en: The LORD reigns; let the nations tremble! He is enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake!
chapters.zh: 耶和华作王；万民当战抖！ 他坐在二基路伯上，地当动摇。

chapters.en: Great is the LORD in Zion; He is exalted above all the peoples.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在锡安为大； 他超乎万民之上。

chapters.en: Let them praise Your great and awesome name— He is holy!
chapters.zh: 他们当称赞他大而可畏的名； 他本为圣！

chapters.en: The mighty King loves justice. You have established equity; You have exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob.
chapters.zh: 王有能力，喜爱公平，坚立公正， 在雅各中施行公平和公义。

chapters.en:
Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool;
He is holy!
chapters.zh: 你们当尊崇耶和华－我们的上帝， 在他脚凳前下拜。 他本为圣！

chapters.en:
Moses and Aaron were among His priests; Samuel was among those who called on His name.
They called to the LORD and He answered.
chapters.zh: 在他的祭司中有摩西和亚伦； 在求告他名的人中有撒母耳。 他们求告耶和华，他就应允他们。

chapters.en: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept His decrees and the statutes He gave them.
chapters.zh: 他在云柱中对他们说话； 他们遵守他的法度和他所赐给他们的律例。

chapters.en:
O LORD our God, You answered them. You were a forgiving God to them,
yet an avenger of their misdeeds.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－我们的上帝啊，你应允他们； 你是赦免他们的上帝， 却按他们所行的报应他们。

chapters.en:
Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain,
for the LORD our God is holy.
chapters.zh: 你们要尊崇耶和华－我们的上帝， 在他的圣山下拜， 因为耶和华－我们的上帝本为圣！

chapters.en: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.
chapters.zh: 普天下当向耶和华欢呼！

chapters.en: Serve the LORD with gladness; come into His presence with joyful songs.
chapters.zh: 你们当乐意事奉耶和华， 当来向他歌唱！

chapters.en:
Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His;
we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.
chapters.zh: 你们当晓得耶和华是上帝！ 我们是他造的，也是属他的； 我们是他的民，也是他草场的羊。

chapters.en:
Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise;
give thanks to Him and bless His name.
chapters.zh: 当称谢进入他的门； 当赞美进入他的院。 当感谢他，称颂他的名！

chapters.en:
For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever;
His faithfulness continues to all generations.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华本为善。 他的慈爱存到永远； 他的信实直到万代。

chapters.en: I will sing of Your loving devotion and justice; to You, O LORD, I will sing praises.
chapters.zh: 我要歌唱慈爱和公平； 耶和华啊，我要向你歌颂！

chapters.en: I will ponder the way that is blameless— when will You come to me? I will walk in my house with integrity of heart.
chapters.zh: 我要用智慧行完全的道。 你几时到我这里来呢？ 我要存完全的心行在我家中。

chapters.en: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.
chapters.zh: 邪僻的事，我都不摆在我眼前； 悖逆人所做的事，我甚恨恶， 不容沾在我身上。

chapters.en: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know nothing of evil.
chapters.zh: 弯曲的心思，我必远离； 一切的恶人〔注：或译：恶事〕，我不认识。

chapters.en: Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not endure.
chapters.zh: 在暗中谗谤他邻居的，我必将他灭绝； 眼目高傲、心里骄纵的，我必不容他。

chapters.en: My eyes favor the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he who walks in the way of integrity shall minister to me.
chapters.zh: 我眼要看国中的诚实人，叫他们与我同住； 行为完全的，他要伺候我。

chapters.en: No one who practices deceit shall dwell in my house; no one who tells lies shall stand in my presence.
chapters.zh: 行诡诈的，必不得住在我家里； 说谎话的，必不得立在我眼前。

chapters.en: Every morning I will remove all the wicked of the land, that I may cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我每日早晨要灭绝国中所有的恶人， 好把一切作孽的从耶和华的城里剪除。

chapters.en: Hear my prayer, O LORD; let my cry for help come before You.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你听我的祷告， 容我的呼求达到你面前！

chapters.en: Do not hide Your face from me in my day of distress. Incline Your ear to me; answer me quickly when I call.
chapters.zh: 我在急难的日子，求你向我侧耳； 不要向我掩面！ 我呼求的日子，求你快快应允我！

chapters.en: For my days vanish like smoke, and my bones burn like glowing embers.
chapters.zh: 因为，我的年日如烟云消灭； 我的骨头如火把烧着。

chapters.en: My heart is afflicted, and withered like grass; I even forget to eat my bread.
chapters.zh: 我的心被伤，如草枯干， 甚至我忘记吃饭。

chapters.en: Through my loud groaning my skin hangs on my bones.
chapters.zh: 因我唉哼的声音， 我的肉紧贴骨头。

chapters.en: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.
chapters.zh: 我如同旷野的鹈鹕； 我好像荒场的鸮鸟。

chapters.en: I lie awake; I am like a lone bird on a housetop.
chapters.zh: 我警醒不睡； 我像房顶上孤单的麻雀。

chapters.en: All day long my enemies taunt me; they ridicule me and curse me.
chapters.zh: 我的仇敌终日辱骂我； 向我猖狂的人指着我赌咒。

chapters.en: For I have eaten ashes like bread and mixed my drink with tears
chapters.zh: 我吃过炉灰，如同吃饭； 我所喝的与眼泪搀杂。

chapters.en: because of Your indignation and wrath, for You have picked me up and cast me aside.
chapters.zh: 这都因你的恼恨和忿怒； 你把我拾起来，又把我摔下去。

chapters.en: My days are like lengthening shadows, and I wither away like grass.
chapters.zh: 我的年日如日影偏斜； 我也如草枯干。

chapters.en: But You, O LORD, sit enthroned forever; Your renown endures to all generations.
chapters.zh: 惟你－耶和华必存到永远； 你可记念的〔名〕也存到万代。

chapters.en:
You will rise up and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show her favor—
the appointed time has come.
chapters.zh: 你必起来怜恤锡安， 因现在是可怜她的时候， 日期已经到了。

chapters.en: For Your servants delight in her stones and take pity on her dust.
chapters.zh: 你的仆人原来喜悦她的石头， 可怜她的尘土。

chapters.en: So the nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth will fear Your glory.
chapters.zh: 列国要敬畏耶和华的名； 世上诸王都敬畏你的荣耀。

chapters.en: For the LORD will rebuild Zion; He has appeared in His glory.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华建造了锡安， 在他荣耀里显现。

chapters.en: He will turn toward the prayer of the destitute; He will not despise their prayer.
chapters.zh: 他垂听穷人的祷告， 并不藐视他们的祈求。

chapters.en: Let this be written for the generation to come, so that a people not yet created may praise the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这必为后代的人记下， 将来受造的民要赞美耶和华。

chapters.en: For He looked down from the heights of His sanctuary; the LORD gazed out from heaven to earth
chapters.zh: 因为，他从至高的圣所垂看； 耶和华从天向地观察，

chapters.en: to hear a prisoner’s groaning, to release those condemned to death,
chapters.zh: 要垂听被囚之人的叹息， 要释放将要死的人，

chapters.en: that they may proclaim the name of the LORD in Zion and praise Him in Jerusalem,
chapters.zh: 使人在锡安传扬耶和华的名， 在耶路撒冷传扬赞美他的话，

chapters.en: when peoples and kingdoms assemble to serve the LORD.
chapters.zh: 就是在万民和列国 聚会事奉耶和华的时候。

chapters.en: He has broken my strength on the way; He has cut short my days.
chapters.zh: 他使我的力量中道衰弱， 使我的年日短少。

chapters.en: I say: “O my God, do not take me in the midst of my days! Your years go on through all generations.
chapters.zh: 我说：我的上帝啊， 不要使我中年去世。 你的年数世世无穷！

chapters.en: In the beginning You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
chapters.zh: 你起初立了地的根基； 天也是你手所造的。

chapters.en: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing You will change them, and they will be passed on.
chapters.zh: 天地都要灭没，你却要长存； 天地都要如外衣渐渐旧了。 你要将天地如里衣更换， 天地就都改变了。

chapters.en: But You remain the same, and Your years will never end.
chapters.zh: 惟有你永不改变； 你的年数没有穷尽。

chapters.en: The children of Your servants will dwell securely, and their descendants will be established before You.”
chapters.zh: 你仆人的子孙要长存； 他们的后裔要坚立在你面前。

chapters.en: Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.
chapters.zh: 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！ 凡在我里面的，也要称颂他的圣名！

chapters.en: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds—
chapters.zh: 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！ 不可忘记他的一切恩惠！

chapters.en: He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases,
chapters.zh: 他赦免你的一切罪孽， 医治你的一切疾病。

chapters.en: who redeems your life from the Pit and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion,
chapters.zh: 他救赎你的命脱离死亡， 以仁爱和慈悲为你的冠冕。

chapters.en: who satisfies you with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
chapters.zh: 他用美物使你所愿的得以知足， 以致你如鹰返老还童。

chapters.en: The LORD executes righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华施行公义， 为一切受屈的人伸冤。

chapters.en: He made known His ways to Moses, His deeds to the people of Israel.
chapters.zh: 他使摩西知道他的法则， 叫以色列人晓得他的作为。

chapters.en: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.
chapters.zh: 耶和华有怜悯，有恩典， 不轻易发怒，且有丰盛的慈爱。

chapters.en: He will not always accuse us, nor harbor His anger forever.
chapters.zh: 他不长久责备， 也不永远怀〔怒〕。

chapters.en: He has not dealt with us according to our sins or repaid us according to our iniquities.
chapters.zh: 他没有按我们的罪过待我们， 也没有照我们的罪孽报应我们。

chapters.en: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.
chapters.zh: 天离地何等的高， 他的慈爱向敬畏他的人也是何等的大！

chapters.en: As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
chapters.zh: 东离西有多远， 他叫我们的过犯离我们也有多远！

chapters.en: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.
chapters.zh: 父亲怎样怜恤他的儿女， 耶和华也怎样怜恤敬畏他的人！

chapters.en: For He knows our frame; He is mindful that we are dust.
chapters.zh: 因为他知道我们的本体， 思念我们不过是尘土。

chapters.en: As for man, his days are like grass— he blooms like a flower of the field;
chapters.zh: 至于世人，他的年日如草一样。 他发旺如野地的花，

chapters.en: when the wind passes over, it vanishes, and its place remembers it no more.
chapters.zh: 经风一吹，便归无有； 它的原处也不再认识它。

chapters.en:
But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD
extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their children’s children—
chapters.zh: 但耶和华的慈爱归于敬畏他的人， 从亘古到永远； 他的公义也归于子子孙孙－

chapters.en:
to those who keep His covenant
and remember to obey His precepts.
chapters.zh: 就是那些遵守他的约、 记念他的训词而遵行的人。

chapters.en: The LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over all.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在天上立定宝座； 他的权柄〔注：原文是国〕统管万有。

chapters.en:
Bless the LORD, all His angels mighty in strength who carry out His word,
who hearken to the voice of His command.
chapters.zh: 听从他命令、成全他旨意、 有大能的天使，都要称颂耶和华！

chapters.en: Bless the LORD, all His hosts, you servants who do His will.
chapters.zh: 你们作他的诸军，作他的仆役， 行他所喜悦的，都要称颂耶和华！

chapters.en:
Bless the LORD, all His works in all places of His dominion.
Bless the LORD, O my soul!
chapters.zh: 你们一切被他造的， 在他所治理的各处， 都要称颂耶和华！ 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！

chapters.en:
Bless the LORD, O my soul!
O LORD my God, You are very great; You are clothed with splendor and majesty.
chapters.zh: 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！ 耶和华－我的上帝啊，你为至大！ 你以尊荣威严为衣服，

chapters.en: He wraps Himself in light as with a garment; He stretches out the heavens like a tent,
chapters.zh: 披上亮光，如披外袍， 铺张穹苍，如铺幔子，

chapters.en: laying the beams of His chambers in the waters above, making the clouds His chariot, walking on the wings of the wind.
chapters.zh: 在水中立楼阁的栋梁， 用云彩为车辇， 藉着风的翅膀而行，

chapters.en: He makes the winds His messengers, flames of fire His servants.
chapters.zh: 以风为使者， 以火焰为仆役，

chapters.en: He set the earth on its foundations, never to be moved.
chapters.zh: 将地立在根基上， 使地永不动摇。

chapters.en: You covered it with the deep like a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
chapters.zh: 你用深水遮盖地面，犹如衣裳； 诸水高过山岭。

chapters.en: At Your rebuke the waters fled; at the sound of Your thunder they hurried away—
chapters.zh: 你的斥责一发，水便奔逃； 你的雷声一发，水便奔流。

chapters.en: the mountains rose and the valleys sank to the place You assigned for them—
chapters.zh: 诸山升上，诸谷沉下〔注：或译：随山上翻，随谷下流〕， 归你为它所安定之地。

chapters.en: You set a boundary they cannot cross, that they may never again cover the earth.
chapters.zh: 你定了界限，使水不能过去， 不再转回遮盖地面。

chapters.en: He sends forth springs in the valleys; they flow between the mountains.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使泉源涌在山谷， 流在山间，

chapters.en: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
chapters.zh: 使野地的走兽有水喝， 野驴得解其渴。

chapters.en: The birds of the air nest beside the springs; they sing among the branches.
chapters.zh: 天上的飞鸟在水旁住宿， 在树枝上啼叫。

chapters.en: He waters the mountains from His chambers; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of His works.
chapters.zh: 他从楼阁中浇灌山岭； 因他作为的功效，地就丰足。

chapters.en:
He makes the grass grow for the livestock and provides crops for man to cultivate,
bringing forth food from the earth:
chapters.zh: 他使草生长，给六畜吃， 使菜蔬发长，供给人用， 使人从地里能得食物，

chapters.en:
wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil that makes his face to shine,
and bread that sustains his heart.
chapters.zh: 又得酒能悦人心， 得油能润人面， 得粮能养人心。

chapters.en: The trees of the LORD have their fill, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,
chapters.zh: 佳美的树木，就是黎巴嫩的香柏树， 是耶和华所栽种的，都满了〔汁浆〕。

chapters.en: where the birds build their nests; the stork makes her home in the cypresses.
chapters.zh: 雀鸟在其上搭窝； 至于鹤，松树是牠的房屋。

chapters.en: The high mountains are for the wild goats, the cliffs a refuge for the rock badgers.
chapters.zh: 高山为野山羊〔的住所〕； 巖石为沙番的藏处。

chapters.en: He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows when to set.
chapters.zh: 你安置月亮为定节令； 日头自知沉落。

chapters.en: You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest prowl.
chapters.zh: 你造黑暗为夜， 林中的百兽就都爬出来。

chapters.en: The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.
chapters.zh: 少壮狮子吼叫，要抓食， 向上帝寻求食物。

chapters.en: The sun rises, and they withdraw; they lie down in their dens.
chapters.zh: 日头一出，兽便躲避， 卧在洞里。

chapters.en: Man goes forth to his work and to his labor until evening.
chapters.zh: 人出去做工， 劳碌直到晚上。

chapters.en:
How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all;
the earth is full of Your creatures.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你所造的何其多！ 都是你用智慧造成的； 遍地满了你的丰富。

chapters.en:
Here is the sea, vast and wide, teeming with creatures beyond number,
living things both great and small.
chapters.zh: 那里有海，又大又广； 其中有无数的动物， 大小活物都有。

chapters.en: There the ships pass, and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.
chapters.zh: 那里有船行走， 有你所造的鳄鱼游泳在其中。

chapters.en: All creatures look to You to give them their food in due season.
chapters.zh: 这都仰望你按时给牠食物。

chapters.en: When You give it to them, they gather it up; when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good things.
chapters.zh: 你给牠们，牠们便拾起来； 你张手，牠们饱得美食。

chapters.en: When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.
chapters.zh: 你掩面，牠们便惊惶； 你收回牠们的气，牠们就死亡，归于尘土。

chapters.en: When You send Your Spirit, they are created, and You renew the face of the earth.
chapters.zh: 你发出你的灵，牠们便受造； 你使地面更换为新。

chapters.en: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in His works.
chapters.zh: 愿耶和华的荣耀存到永远！ 愿耶和华喜悦自己所造的！

chapters.en: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.
chapters.zh: 他看地，地便震动； 他摸山，山就冒烟。

chapters.en: I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
chapters.zh: 我要一生向耶和华唱诗！ 我还活的时候，要向我上帝歌颂！

chapters.en: May my meditation be pleasing to Him, for I rejoice in the LORD.
chapters.zh: 愿他以我的默念为甘甜！ 我要因耶和华欢喜！

chapters.en:
May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more.
Bless the LORD, O my soul.
Hallelujah!
chapters.zh: 愿罪人从世上消灭！ 愿恶人归于无有！ 我的心哪，要称颂耶和华！ 你们要赞美耶和华〔注：原文是哈利路亚；下同〕！

chapters.en: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
chapters.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，求告他的名， 在万民中传扬他的作为！

chapters.en: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.
chapters.zh: 要向他唱诗歌颂， 谈论他一切奇妙的作为！

chapters.en: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
chapters.zh: 要以他的圣名夸耀！ 寻求耶和华的人，心中应当欢喜！

chapters.en: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
chapters.zh: 要寻求耶和华与他的能力， 时常寻求他的面。

chapters.en: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,
O offspring of His servant Abraham, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
chapters.zh: 他仆人亚伯拉罕的后裔， 他所拣选雅各的子孙哪， 你们要记念他奇妙的作为和他的奇事， 并他口中的判语。

chapters.en: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.
chapters.zh: 他是耶和华－我们的上帝； 全地都有他的判断。

chapters.en: He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—
chapters.zh: 他记念他的约，直到永远； 他所吩咐的话，直到千代－

chapters.en: the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.
chapters.zh: 就是与亚伯拉罕所立的〔约〕， 向以撒所起的誓。

chapters.en: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
chapters.zh: 他又将这约向雅各定为律例， 向以色列定为永远的约，

chapters.en: “I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.”
chapters.zh: 说：我必将迦南地赐给你， 作你产业的分。

chapters.en: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land,
chapters.zh: 当时，他们人丁有限，数目稀少， 并且在那地为寄居的。

chapters.en: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
chapters.zh: 他们从这邦游到那邦， 从这国行到那国。

chapters.en: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:
chapters.zh: 他不容什么人欺负他们， 为他们的缘故责备君王，

chapters.en: “Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!”
chapters.zh: 说：不可难为我受膏的人， 也不可恶待我的先知。

chapters.en: He called down famine on the land and cut off all their supplies of food.
chapters.zh: 他命饥荒降在那地上， 将所倚靠的粮食全行断绝，

chapters.en: He sent a man before them— Joseph, sold as a slave.
chapters.zh: 在他们以先打发一个人去 －约瑟被卖为奴仆。

chapters.en: They bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons,
chapters.zh: 人用脚镣伤他的脚； 他被铁〔鍊〕捆拘。

chapters.en: until his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话试炼他， 直等到他所说的应验了。

chapters.en: The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.
chapters.zh: 王打发人把他解开， 就是治理众民的，把他释放，

chapters.en: He made him master of his household, ruler over all his substance,
chapters.zh: 立他作王家之主， 掌管他一切所有的，

chapters.en: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.
chapters.zh: 使他随意捆绑他的臣宰， 将智慧教导他的长老。

chapters.en: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.
chapters.zh: 以色列也到了埃及； 雅各在含地寄居。

chapters.en: And the LORD made His people very fruitful, more numerous than their foes,
chapters.zh: 耶和华使他的百姓生养众多， 使他们比敌人强盛，

chapters.en: whose hearts He turned to hate His people, to conspire against His servants.
chapters.zh: 使敌人的心转去恨他的百姓， 并用诡计待他的仆人。

chapters.en: He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron, whom He had chosen.
chapters.zh: 他打发他的仆人摩西 和他所拣选的亚伦，

chapters.en: They performed His miraculous signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
chapters.zh: 在敌人中间显他的神迹， 在含地显他的奇事。

chapters.en: He sent darkness, and it became dark— yet they defied His words.
chapters.zh: 他命黑暗，就有黑暗； 没有违背他话的。

chapters.en: He turned their waters to blood and caused their fish to die.
chapters.zh: 他叫埃及的水变为血， 叫他们的鱼死了。

chapters.en: Their land teemed with frogs, even in their royal chambers.
chapters.zh: 在他们的地上以及王宫的内室， 青蛙多多滋生。

chapters.en: He spoke, and insects swarmed— gnats throughout their country.
chapters.zh: 他说一声，苍蝇就成群而来， 并有虱子进入他们四境。

chapters.en: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning throughout their land.
chapters.zh: 他给他们降下冰雹为雨， 在他们的地上降下火焰。

chapters.en: He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.
chapters.zh: 他也击打他们的葡萄树和无花果树， 毁坏他们境内的树木。

chapters.en: He spoke, and the locusts came— young locusts without number.
chapters.zh: 他说一声，就有蝗虫蚂蚱上来， 不计其数，

chapters.en: They devoured every plant in their land and consumed the produce of their soil.
chapters.zh: 吃尽了他们地上各样的菜蔬 和田地的出产。

chapters.en: Then He struck all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigor.
chapters.zh: 他又击杀他们国内一切的长子， 就是他们强壮时头生的。

chapters.en: He brought Israel out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled.
chapters.zh: 他领自己的百姓带银子金子出来； 他支派中没有一个软弱的。

chapters.en: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the dread of Israel had fallen on them.
chapters.zh: 他们出来的时候，埃及人便欢喜； 原来埃及人惧怕他们。

chapters.en: He spread a cloud as a covering and a fire to light up the night.
chapters.zh: 他铺张云彩当遮盖， 夜间使火光照。

chapters.en: They asked, and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
chapters.zh: 他们一求，他就使鹌鹑飞来， 并用天上的粮食叫他们饱足。

chapters.en: He opened a rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.
chapters.zh: 他打开磐石，水就涌出； 在干旱之处，水流成河。

chapters.en: For He remembered His holy promise to Abraham His servant.
chapters.zh: 这都因他记念他的圣言 和他的仆人亚伯拉罕。

chapters.en: He brought forth His people with rejoicing, His chosen with shouts of joy.
chapters.zh: 他带领百姓欢乐而出， 带领选民欢呼前往。

chapters.en: He gave them the lands of the nations, that they might inherit the fruit of others’ labor,
chapters.zh: 他将列国的地赐给他们， 他们便承受众民劳碌得来的，

chapters.en:
that they might keep His statutes and obey His laws.
Hallelujah!
chapters.zh: 好使他们遵他的律例， 守他的律法。 你们要赞美耶和华！

chapters.en:
Hallelujah!
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 要称谢耶和华，因他本为善； 他的慈爱永远长存！

chapters.en: Who can describe the mighty acts of the LORD or fully proclaim His praise?
chapters.zh: 谁能传说耶和华的大能？ 谁能表明他一切的美德？

chapters.en: Blessed are those who uphold justice, who practice righteousness at all times.
chapters.zh: 凡遵守公平、常行公义的， 这人便为有福！

chapters.en: Remember me, O LORD, in Your favor to Your people; visit me with Your salvation,
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你用恩惠待你的百姓； 求你也用这恩惠记念我，开你的救恩眷顾我，

chapters.en:
that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, and rejoice in the gladness of Your nation,
and give glory with Your inheritance.
chapters.zh: 使我见你选民的福， 乐你国民的乐， 与你的产业一同夸耀。

chapters.en: We have sinned like our fathers; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.
chapters.zh: 我们与我们的祖宗一同犯罪； 我们作了孽，行了恶。

chapters.en: Our fathers in Egypt did not grasp Your wonders or remember Your abundant kindness; but they rebelled by the sea, there at the Red Sea.
chapters.zh: 我们的祖宗在埃及不明白你的奇事， 不记念你丰盛的慈爱， 反倒在红海行了悖逆。

chapters.en: Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His power known.
chapters.zh: 然而，他因自己的名拯救他们， 为要彰显他的大能，

chapters.en: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He led them through the depths as through a desert.
chapters.zh: 并且斥责红海，海便干了； 他带领他们经过深处，如同经过旷野。

chapters.en: He saved them from the hand that hated them; He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
chapters.zh: 他拯救他们脱离恨他们人的手， 从仇敌手中救赎他们。

chapters.en: The waters covered their foes; not one of them remained.
chapters.zh: 水淹没他们的敌人， 没有一个存留。

chapters.en: Then they believed His promises and sang His praise.
chapters.zh: 那时，他们才信了他的话， 歌唱赞美他。

chapters.en: Yet they soon forgot His works and failed to wait for His counsel.
chapters.zh: 等不多时，他们就忘了他的作为， 不仰望他的指教，

chapters.en: They craved intensely in the wilderness and tested God in the desert.
chapters.zh: 反倒在旷野大起欲心， 在荒地试探上帝。

chapters.en: So He granted their request, but sent a wasting disease upon them.
chapters.zh: 他将他们所求的赐给他们， 却使他们的心灵软弱。

chapters.en: In the camp they envied Moses, as well as Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们又在营中嫉妒摩西 和耶和华的圣者亚伦。

chapters.en: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it covered the assembly of Abiram.
chapters.zh: 地裂开，吞下大坍， 掩盖亚比兰一党的人。

chapters.en: Then fire blazed through their company; flames consumed the wicked.
chapters.zh: 有火在他们的党中发起； 有火焰烧毁了恶人。

chapters.en: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped a molten image.
chapters.zh: 他们在何烈山造了牛犊， 叩拜铸成的像。

chapters.en: They exchanged their Glory for the image of a grass-eating ox.
chapters.zh: 如此将他们荣耀〔的主〕 换为吃草之牛的像，

chapters.en: They forgot God their Savior, who did great things in Egypt,
chapters.zh: 忘了上帝－他们的救主； 他曾在埃及行大事，

chapters.en: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.
chapters.zh: 在含地行奇事， 在红海行可畏的事。

chapters.en: So He said He would destroy them— had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach to divert His wrath from destroying them.
chapters.zh: 所以，他说要灭绝他们； 若非有他所拣选的摩西站在当中〔注：原文是破口〕， 使他的忿怒转消， 恐怕他就灭绝他们。

chapters.en: They despised the pleasant land; they did not believe His promise.
chapters.zh: 他们又藐视那美地， 不信他的话，

chapters.en: They grumbled in their tents and did not listen to the voice of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 在自己帐棚内发怨言， 不听耶和华的声音。

chapters.en: So He raised His hand and swore to cast them down in the wilderness,
chapters.zh: 所以，他对他们起誓： 必叫他们倒在旷野，

chapters.en: to disperse their offspring among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
chapters.zh: 叫他们的后裔倒在列国之中， 分散在各地。

chapters.en: They yoked themselves to Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods.
chapters.zh: 他们又与巴力‧毗珥连合， 且吃了祭死神〔注：或译：人〕的物。

chapters.en: So they provoked the LORD to anger with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
chapters.zh: 他们这样行，惹耶和华发怒， 便有瘟疫流行在他们中间。

chapters.en: But Phinehas stood and intervened, and the plague was restrained.
chapters.zh: 那时，非尼哈站起，刑罚恶人， 瘟疫这才止息。

chapters.en: It was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.
chapters.zh: 那就算为他的义， 世世代代，直到永远。

chapters.en: At the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD, and trouble came to Moses because of them.
chapters.zh: 他们在米利巴水又叫耶和华发怒， 甚至摩西也受了亏损，

chapters.en: For they rebelled against His Spirit, and Moses spoke rashly with his lips.
chapters.zh: 是因他们惹动他的灵， 摩西〔注：原文是他〕用嘴说了急躁的话。

chapters.en: They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them,
chapters.zh: 他们不照耶和华所吩咐的 灭绝外邦人，

chapters.en: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.
chapters.zh: 反与他们混杂相合， 学习他们的行为，

chapters.en: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.
chapters.zh: 事奉他们的偶像， 这就成了自己的网罗，

chapters.en: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
chapters.zh: 把自己的儿女祭祀鬼魔，

chapters.en: They shed innocent blood— the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.
chapters.zh: 流无辜人的血， 就是自己儿女的血， 把他们祭祀迦南的偶像， 那地就被血污秽了。

chapters.en: They defiled themselves by their actions and prostituted themselves by their deeds.
chapters.zh: 这样，他们被自己所做的污秽了， 在行为上犯了邪淫。

chapters.en: So the anger of the LORD burned against His people, and He abhorred His own inheritance.
chapters.zh: 所以，耶和华的怒气向他的百姓发作， 憎恶他的产业，

chapters.en: He delivered them into the hand of the nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.
chapters.zh: 将他们交在外邦人的手里； 恨他们的人就辖制他们。

chapters.en: Their enemies oppressed them and subdued them under their hand.
chapters.zh: 他们的仇敌也欺压他们， 他们就伏在敌人手下。

chapters.en:
Many times He rescued them, but they were bent on rebellion
and sank down in their iniquity.
chapters.zh: 他屡次搭救他们， 他们却设谋背逆， 因自己的罪孽降为卑下。

chapters.en: Nevertheless He heard their cry; He took note of their distress.
chapters.zh: 然而，他听见他们哀告的时候， 就眷顾他们的急难，

chapters.en: And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.
chapters.zh: 为他们记念他的约， 照他丰盛的慈爱后悔。

chapters.en: He made them objects of compassion to all who held them captive.
chapters.zh: 他也使他们在凡掳掠他们的人面前蒙怜恤。

chapters.en: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－我们的上帝啊，求你拯救我们， 从外邦中招聚我们， 我们好称赞你的圣名， 以赞美你为夸胜。

chapters.en:
Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.
Let all the people say, “Amen!”
Hallelujah!
chapters.zh: 耶和华－以色列的上帝是应当称颂的， 从亘古直到永远。 愿众民都说：阿们！ 你们要赞美耶和华！

chapters.en: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善； 他的慈爱永远长存！

chapters.en: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy
chapters.zh: 愿耶和华的赎民说这话， 就是他从敌人手中所救赎的，

chapters.en: and gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.
chapters.zh: 从各地，从东从西， 从南从北，所招聚来的。

chapters.en: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no path to a city in which to dwell.
chapters.zh: 他们在旷野荒地漂流， 寻不见可住的城邑，

chapters.en: They were hungry and thirsty; their soul fainted within them.
chapters.zh: 又饥又渴， 心里发昏。

chapters.en: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He delivered them from their distress.
chapters.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华； 他从他们的祸患中搭救他们，

chapters.en: He led them on a straight path to reach a city where they could live.
chapters.zh: 又领他们行走直路， 使他们往可居住的城邑。

chapters.en: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
chapters.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱 和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他；

chapters.en: For He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.
chapters.zh: 因他使心里渴慕的人得以知足， 使心里饥饿的人得饱美物。

chapters.en: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and chains,
chapters.zh: 那些坐在黑暗中、死荫里的人 被困苦和铁〔鍊〕捆锁，

chapters.en: because they rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High.
chapters.zh: 是因他们违背上帝的话语， 藐视至高者的旨意。

chapters.en: He humbled their hearts with hard labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.
chapters.zh: 所以，他用劳苦治服他们的心； 他们仆倒，无人扶助。

chapters.en: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
chapters.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华； 他从他们的祸患中拯救他们。

chapters.en: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death and broke away their chains.
chapters.zh: 他从黑暗中和死荫里领他们出来， 折断他们的绑索。

chapters.en: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
chapters.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱 和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他；

chapters.en: For He has broken down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.
chapters.zh: 因为他打破了铜门， 砍断了铁闩。

chapters.en: Fools, in their rebellious ways, and through their iniquities, suffered affliction.
chapters.zh: 愚妄人因自己的过犯 和自己的罪孽便受苦楚。

chapters.en: They loathed all food and drew near to the gates of death.
chapters.zh: 他们心里厌恶各样的食物， 就临近死门。

chapters.en: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
chapters.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华； 他从他们的祸患中拯救他们。

chapters.en: He sent forth His word and healed them; He rescued them from the Pit.
chapters.zh: 他发命医治他们， 救他们脱离死亡。

chapters.en: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
chapters.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱 和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他。

chapters.en: Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and declare His works with rejoicing.
chapters.zh: 愿他们以感谢为祭献给他， 欢呼述说他的作为！

chapters.en: Others went out to sea in ships, conducting trade on the mighty waters.
chapters.zh: 在海上坐船， 在大水中经理事务的，

chapters.en: They saw the works of the LORD, and His wonders in the deep.
chapters.zh: 他们看见耶和华的作为， 并他在深水中的奇事。

chapters.en: For He spoke and raised a tempest that lifted the waves of the sea.
chapters.zh: 因他一吩咐，狂风就起来， 海中的波浪也扬起。

chapters.en: They mounted up to the heavens, then sunk to the depths; their courage melted in their anguish.
chapters.zh: 他们上到天空，下到海底； 他们的心因患难便消化。

chapters.en: They reeled and staggered like drunkards, and all their skill was useless.
chapters.zh: 他们摇摇晃晃，东倒西歪，好像醉酒的人； 他们的智慧无法可施。

chapters.en: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.
chapters.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华， 他从他们的祸患中领出他们来。

chapters.en: He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
chapters.zh: 他使狂风止息， 波浪就平静。

chapters.en: They rejoiced in the silence, and He guided them to the harbor they desired.
chapters.zh: 风息浪静，他们便欢喜； 他就引他们到所愿去的海口。

chapters.en: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
chapters.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱 和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他。

chapters.en: Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people and praise Him in the council of the elders.
chapters.zh: 愿他们在民的会中尊崇他， 在长老的位上赞美他！

chapters.en: He turns rivers into deserts, springs of water into thirsty ground,
chapters.zh: 他使江河变为旷野， 叫水泉变为干渴之地，

chapters.en: and fruitful land into fields of salt, because of the wickedness of its dwellers.
chapters.zh: 使肥地变为碱地； 这都因其间居民的罪恶。

chapters.en: He turns a desert into pools of water and a dry land into flowing springs.
chapters.zh: 他使旷野变为水潭， 叫旱地变为水泉。

chapters.en: He causes the hungry to settle there, that they may establish a city in which to dwell.
chapters.zh: 他使饥饿的人住在那里， 好建造可住的城邑，

chapters.en: They sow fields and plant vineyards that yield a fruitful harvest.
chapters.zh: 又种田地，栽葡萄园， 得享所出的土产。

chapters.en: He blesses them, and they multiply greatly; He does not let their herds diminish.
chapters.zh: 他又赐福给他们，叫他们生养众多， 也不叫他们的牲畜减少。

chapters.en: When they are decreased and humbled by oppression, evil, and sorrow,
chapters.zh: 他们又因暴虐、患难、愁苦， 就减少且卑下。

chapters.en: He pours out contempt on the nobles and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.
chapters.zh: 他使君王蒙羞被辱， 使他们在荒废无路之地漂流。

chapters.en: But He lifts the needy from affliction and increases their families like flocks.
chapters.zh: 他却将穷乏人安置在高处，脱离苦难， 使他的家属多如羊群。

chapters.en: The upright see and rejoice, and all iniquity shuts its mouth.
chapters.zh: 正直人看见就欢喜； 罪孽之辈必塞口无言。

chapters.en: Let him who is wise pay heed to these things and consider the loving devotion of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 凡有智慧的，必在这些事上留心， 也必思想耶和华的慈爱。

chapters.en: My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，我心坚定； 我口〔注：原文是荣耀〕要唱诗歌颂！

chapters.en: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
chapters.zh: 琴瑟啊，你们当醒起！ 我自己要极早醒起！

chapters.en: I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我要在万民中称谢你， 在列邦中歌颂你！

chapters.en: For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
chapters.zh: 因为，你的慈爱大过诸天； 你的诚实达到穹苍。

chapters.en: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，愿你崇高过于诸天！ 愿你的荣耀高过全地！

chapters.en: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
chapters.zh: 求你应允我们，用右手拯救我们， 好叫你所亲爱的人得救。

chapters.en: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
chapters.zh: 上帝已经指着他的圣洁说〔注：说：或译应许我〕： 我要欢乐；我要分开示剑， 丈量疏割谷。

chapters.en: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
chapters.zh: 基列是我的； 玛拿西是我的； 以法莲是护卫我头的； 犹大是我的杖；

chapters.en:
Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal;
over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
chapters.zh: 摩押是我的沐浴盆； 我要向以东抛鞋； 我必因胜非利士呼喊。

chapters.en: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
chapters.zh: 谁能领我进坚固城？ 谁能引我到以东地？

chapters.en: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你不是丢弃了我们吗？ 上帝啊，你不和我们的军兵同去吗？

chapters.en: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
chapters.zh: 求你帮助我们攻击敌人， 因为人的帮助是枉然的。

chapters.en: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
chapters.zh: 我们倚靠上帝才得施展大能， 因为践踏我们敌人的就是他。

chapters.en: O God of my praise, be not silent.
chapters.zh: 我所赞美的上帝啊， 求你不要闭口不言。

chapters.en: For wicked and deceitful mouths open against me; they speak against me with lying tongues.
chapters.zh: 因为恶人的嘴和诡诈人的口已经张开攻击我； 他们用撒谎的舌头对我说话。

chapters.en: They surround me with hateful words and attack me without cause.
chapters.zh: 他们围绕我，说怨恨的话， 又无故地攻打我。

chapters.en: In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.
chapters.zh: 他们与我为敌以报我爱， 但我〔专心〕祈祷。

chapters.en: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
chapters.zh: 他们向我以恶报善， 以恨报爱。

chapters.en: Set over him a wicked man; let an accuser stand at his right hand.
chapters.zh: 愿你派一个恶人辖制他， 派一个对头站在他右边！

chapters.en: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayer be regarded as sin.
chapters.zh: 他受审判的时候， 愿他出来担当罪名！ 愿他的祈祷反成为罪！

chapters.en: May his days be few; may another take his position.
chapters.zh: 愿他的年日短少！ 愿别人得他的职分！

chapters.en: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.
chapters.zh: 愿他的儿女为孤儿， 他的妻子为寡妇！

chapters.en: May his children wander as beggars, seeking sustenance far from their ruined homes.
chapters.zh: 愿他的儿女漂流讨饭， 从他们荒凉之处出来求〔食〕！

chapters.en: May the creditor seize all he owns, and strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.
chapters.zh: 愿强暴的债主牢笼他一切所有的！ 愿外人抢他劳碌得来的！

chapters.en: May there be no one to extend kindness to him, and no one to favor his fatherless children.
chapters.zh: 愿无人向他延绵施恩！ 愿无人可怜他的孤儿！

chapters.en: May his descendants be cut off; may their name be blotted out from the next generation.
chapters.zh: 愿他的后人断绝， 名字被涂抹，不传于下代！

chapters.en: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, and the sin of his mother never be blotted out.
chapters.zh: 愿他祖宗的罪孽被耶和华记念！ 愿他母亲的罪过不被涂抹！

chapters.en: May their sins always remain before the LORD, that He may cut off their memory from the earth.
chapters.zh: 愿这些罪常在耶和华面前， 使他的名号断绝于世！

chapters.en:
For he never thought to show kindness, but pursued the poor and needy and brokenhearted,
even to their death.
chapters.zh: 因为他不想施恩， 却逼迫困苦穷乏的和伤心的人， 要把他们治死。

chapters.en: The cursing that he loved, may it fall on him; the blessing in which he refused to delight, may it be far from him.
chapters.zh: 他爱咒骂，咒骂就临到他； 他不喜爱福乐，福乐就与他远离！

chapters.en:
The cursing that he wore like a coat, may it soak into his body like water,
and into his bones like oil.
chapters.zh: 他拿咒骂当衣服穿上； 这咒骂就如水进他里面， 像油入他的骨头。

chapters.en: May it be like a robe wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.
chapters.zh: 愿这咒骂当他遮身的衣服， 当他常束的腰带！

chapters.en: May this be the LORD’s reward to my accusers, to those who speak evil against me.
chapters.zh: 这就是我对头和用恶言议论我的人 从耶和华那里所受的报应。

chapters.en:
But You, O GOD, the Lord, deal kindly with me for the sake of Your name;
deliver me by the goodness of Your loving devotion.
chapters.zh: 主－耶和华啊，求你为你的名〔恩〕待我； 因你的慈爱美好，求你搭救我！

chapters.en: For I am poor and needy; my heart is wounded within me.
chapters.zh: 因为我困苦穷乏， 内心受伤。

chapters.en: I am fading away like a lengthening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.
chapters.zh: 我如日影渐渐偏斜而去； 我如蝗虫被抖出来。

chapters.en: My knees are weak from fasting, and my body grows lean and gaunt.
chapters.zh: 我因禁食，膝骨软弱； 我身上的肉也渐渐瘦了。

chapters.en: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.
chapters.zh: 我受他们的羞辱， 他们看见我便摇头。

chapters.en: Help me, O LORD my God; save me according to Your loving devotion.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－我的上帝啊，求你帮助我， 照你的慈爱拯救我，

chapters.en: Let them know that this is Your hand, that You, O LORD, have done it.
chapters.zh: 使他们知道这是你的手， 是你－耶和华所行的事。

chapters.en:
Though they curse, You will bless. When they rise up, they will be put to shame,
but Your servant will rejoice.
chapters.zh: 任凭他们咒骂，惟愿你赐福； 他们几时起来就必蒙羞， 你的仆人却要欢喜。

chapters.en: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace; may they wear their shame like a robe.
chapters.zh: 愿我的对头披戴羞辱！ 愿他们以自己的羞愧为外袍遮身！

chapters.en: With my mouth I will thank the LORD profusely; I will praise Him in the presence of many.
chapters.zh: 我要用口极力称谢耶和华； 我要在众人中间赞美他；

chapters.en: For He stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save him from the condemners of his soul.
chapters.zh: 因为他必站在穷乏人的右边， 要救他脱离审判他灵魂的人。

chapters.en: The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我主说： 你坐在我的右边， 等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。

chapters.en: The LORD extends Your mighty scepter from Zion: “Rule in the midst of Your enemies.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华必使你从锡安伸出能力的杖来； 你要在你仇敌中掌权。

chapters.en: Your people shall be willing on Your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, to You belongs the dew of Your youth.
chapters.zh: 当你掌权的日子〔注：或译：行军的日子〕， 你的民要以圣洁的妆饰为衣〔注：或译：以圣洁为妆饰〕， 甘心牺牲自己； 你的民多如清晨的甘露〔注：或译：你少年时光耀如清晨的甘露〕。

chapters.en: The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华起了誓，决不后悔，〔说〕： 你是照着麦基洗德的等次永远为祭司。

chapters.en: The Lord is at Your right hand; He will crush kings in the day of His wrath.
chapters.zh: 在你右边的主， 当他发怒的日子，必打伤列王。

chapters.en: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead; He will crush the leaders far and wide.
chapters.zh: 他要在列邦中刑罚〔恶人〕， 尸首就遍满〔各处〕； 他要在许多国中打破〔仇敌的〕头。

chapters.en: He will drink from the brook by the road; therefore He will lift up His head.
chapters.zh: 他要喝路旁的河水， 因此必抬起头来。

chapters.en:
Hallelujah!
I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 我要在正直人的大会中，并公会中， 一心称谢耶和华。

chapters.en: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的作为本为大； 凡喜爱的都必考察。

chapters.en: Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他所行的是尊荣和威严； 他的公义存到永远。

chapters.en: He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
chapters.zh: 他行了奇事，使人记念； 耶和华有恩惠，有怜悯。

chapters.en: He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.
chapters.zh: 他赐粮食给敬畏他的人； 他必永远记念他的约。

chapters.en: He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.
chapters.zh: 他向百姓显出大能的作为， 把外邦的地赐给他们为业。

chapters.en: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.
chapters.zh: 他手所行的是诚实公平； 他的训词都是确实的，

chapters.en: They are upheld forever and ever, enacted in truth and uprightness.
chapters.zh: 是永永远远坚定的， 是按诚实正直设立的。

chapters.en:
He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever;
holy and awesome is His name.
chapters.zh: 他向百姓施行救赎， 命定他的约，直到永远； 他的名圣而可畏。

chapters.en:
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding.
His praise endures forever!
chapters.zh: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的开端； 凡遵行〔他命令〕的是聪明人。 耶和华是永远当赞美的！

chapters.en:
Hallelujah!
Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments.
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 敬畏耶和华，甚喜爱他命令的， 这人便为有福！

chapters.en: His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
chapters.zh: 他的后裔在世必强盛； 正直人的后代必要蒙福。

chapters.en: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他家中有货物，有钱财； 他的公义存到永远。

chapters.en: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright— for the gracious, compassionate, and righteous.
chapters.zh: 正直人在黑暗中，有光向他发现； 他有恩惠，有怜悯，有公义。

chapters.en: It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely, whose affairs are guided by justice.
chapters.zh: 施恩与人、借贷与人的，这人事情顺利； 他被审判的时候要诉明自己的冤。

chapters.en: Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.
chapters.zh: 他永不动摇； 义人被记念，直到永远。

chapters.en: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他必不怕凶恶的信息； 他心坚定，倚靠耶和华。

chapters.en: His heart is assured; he does not fear, until he looks in triumph on his foes.
chapters.zh: 他心确定，总不惧怕， 直到他看见敌人〔遭报〕。

chapters.en:
He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor; his righteousness endures forever;
his horn will be lifted high in honor.
chapters.zh: 他施舍〔钱财〕，赒济贫穷； 他的仁义存到永远。 他的角必被高举，大有荣耀。

chapters.en:
The wicked man will see and be grieved; he will gnash his teeth and waste away;
the desires of the wicked will perish.
chapters.zh: 恶人看见便恼恨，必咬牙而消化； 恶人的心愿要归灭绝。

chapters.en:
Hallelujah!
Give praise, O servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 耶和华的仆人哪，你们要赞美， 赞美耶和华的名！

chapters.en: Blessed be the name of the LORD both now and forevermore.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的名是应当称颂的， 从今时直到永远！

chapters.en: From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD is praised.
chapters.zh: 从日出之地到日落之处， 耶和华的名是应当赞美的！

chapters.en: The LORD is exalted over all the nations, His glory above the heavens.
chapters.zh: 耶和华超乎万民之上； 他的荣耀高过诸天。

chapters.en: Who is like the LORD our God, the One enthroned on high?
chapters.zh: 谁像耶和华－我们的上帝呢？ 他坐在至高之处，

chapters.en: He humbles Himself to behold the heavens and the earth.
chapters.zh: 自己谦卑， 观看天上地下的事。

chapters.en: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the dump
chapters.zh: 他从灰尘里抬举贫寒人， 从粪堆中提拔穷乏人，

chapters.en: to seat them with nobles, with the princes of His people.
chapters.zh: 使他们与王子同坐， 就是与本国的王子同坐。

chapters.en:
He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother to her children.
Hallelujah!
chapters.zh: 他使不能生育的妇人安居家中， 为多子的乐母。 你们要赞美耶和华！

chapters.en: When Israel departed from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,
chapters.zh: 以色列出了埃及， 雅各家离开说异言之民；

chapters.en: Judah became God’s sanctuary, Israel His dominion.
chapters.zh: 那时，犹大为主的圣所， 以色列为他所治理的国度。

chapters.en: The sea observed and fled; the Jordan turned back;
chapters.zh: 沧海看见就奔逃； 约旦河也倒流。

chapters.en: the mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.
chapters.zh: 大山踊跃，如公羊； 小山跳舞，如羊羔。

chapters.en: Why was it, O sea, that you fled, O Jordan, that you turned back,
chapters.zh: 沧海啊，你为何奔逃？ 约旦哪，你为何倒流？

chapters.en: O mountains, that you skipped like rams, O hills, like lambs?
chapters.zh: 大山哪，你为何踊跃，如公羊？ 小山哪，你为何跳舞，如羊羔？

chapters.en: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
chapters.zh: 大地啊，你因见主的面， 就是雅各上帝的面，便要震动。

chapters.en: who turned the rock into a pool, the flint into a fountain of water!
chapters.zh: 他叫磐石变为水池， 叫坚石变为泉源。

chapters.en: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name be the glory, because of Your loving devotion, because of Your faithfulness.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，荣耀不要归与我们， 不要归与我们； 要因你的慈爱和诚实归在你的名下！

chapters.en: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”
chapters.zh: 为何容外邦人说： 他们的上帝在哪里呢？

chapters.en: Our God is in heaven; He does as He pleases.
chapters.zh: 然而，我们的上帝在天上， 都随自己的意旨行事。

chapters.en: Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
chapters.zh: 他们的偶像是金的，银的， 是人手所造的，

chapters.en: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
chapters.zh: 有口却不能言， 有眼却不能看，

chapters.en: they have ears, but cannot hear; they have noses, but cannot smell;
chapters.zh: 有耳却不能听， 有鼻却不能闻，

chapters.en:
they have hands, but cannot feel; they have feet, but cannot walk;
they cannot even clear their throats.
chapters.zh: 有手却不能摸， 有脚却不能走， 有喉咙也不能出声。

chapters.en: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
chapters.zh: 造他的要和他一样； 凡靠他的也要如此。

chapters.en: O Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
chapters.zh: 以色列啊，你要倚靠耶和华！ 他是你的帮助和你的盾牌。

chapters.en: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
chapters.zh: 亚伦家啊，你们要倚靠耶和华！ 他是你们的帮助和你们的盾牌。

chapters.en: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
chapters.zh: 你们敬畏耶和华的，要倚靠耶和华！ 他是你们的帮助和你们的盾牌。

chapters.en: The LORD is mindful of us; He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron;
chapters.zh: 耶和华向来眷念我们； 他还要赐福〔给我们〕： 要赐福给以色列的家， 赐福给亚伦的家。

chapters.en: He will bless those who fear the LORD— small and great alike.
chapters.zh: 凡敬畏耶和华的，无论大小， 主必赐福给他。

chapters.en: May the LORD give you increase, both you and your children.
chapters.zh: 愿耶和华叫你们 和你们的子孙日见加增。

chapters.en: May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
chapters.zh: 你们蒙了造天地之耶和华的福！

chapters.en: The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to mankind.
chapters.zh: 天，是耶和华的天； 地，他却给了世人。

chapters.en: It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor any who descend into silence.
chapters.zh: 死人不能赞美耶和华； 下到寂静中的也都不能。

chapters.en:
But it is we who will bless the LORD, both now and forevermore.
Hallelujah!
chapters.zh: 但我们要称颂耶和华， 从今时直到永远。 你们要赞美耶和华！

chapters.en: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice— my appeal for mercy.
chapters.zh: 我爱耶和华， 因为他听了我的声音和我的恳求。

chapters.en: Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.
chapters.zh: 他既向我侧耳， 我一生要求告他。

chapters.en:
The ropes of death entangled me; the anguish of Sheol overcame me;
I was confronted by trouble and sorrow.
chapters.zh: 死亡的绳索缠绕我； 阴间的痛苦抓住我； 我遭遇患难愁苦。

chapters.en: Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, deliver my soul!”
chapters.zh: 那时，我便求告耶和华的名，说： 耶和华啊，求你救我的灵魂！

chapters.en: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.
chapters.zh: 耶和华有恩惠，有公义； 我们的上帝以怜悯为怀。

chapters.en: The LORD preserves the simplehearted; I was helpless, and He saved me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华保护愚人； 我落到卑微的地步，他救了我。

chapters.en: Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.
chapters.zh: 我的心哪！你要仍归安乐， 因为耶和华用厚恩待你。
