chapters.en: For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
chapters.zh: 主啊，你救我的命免了死亡， 救我的眼免了流泪， 救我的脚免了跌倒。

chapters.en: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
chapters.zh: 我要在耶和华面前行活人之路。

chapters.en: I believed, therefore I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”
chapters.zh: 我因信，所以如此说话； 我受了极大的困苦。

chapters.en: In my alarm I said, “All men are liars!”
chapters.zh: 我曾急促地说： 人都是说谎的！

chapters.en: How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me?
chapters.zh: 我拿什么报答耶和华向我所赐的一切厚恩？

chapters.en: I will lift the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我要举起救恩的杯， 称扬耶和华的名。

chapters.en: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people.
chapters.zh: 我要在他众民面前向耶和华还我的愿。

chapters.en: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His saints.
chapters.zh: 在耶和华眼中， 看圣民之死极为宝贵。

chapters.en:
Truly, O LORD, I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant;
You have broken my bonds.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我真是你的仆人； 我是你的仆人，是你婢女的儿子。 你已经解开我的绑索。

chapters.en: I will offer to You a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我要以感谢为祭献给你， 又要求告耶和华的名。

chapters.en: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people,

in the courts of the LORD’s house, in your midst, O Jerusalem.
Hallelujah!
chapters.zh: 我要在他众民面前， 在耶和华殿的院内， 在耶路撒冷当中， 向耶和华还我的愿。 你们要赞美耶和华！

chapters.en: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples!
chapters.zh: 万国啊，你们都当赞美耶和华！ 万民哪，你们都当颂赞他！

chapters.en:
For great is His loving devotion toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever.
Hallelujah!
chapters.zh: 因为他向我们大施慈爱； 耶和华的诚实存到永远。 你们要赞美耶和华！

chapters.en: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善； 他的慈爱永远长存！

chapters.en: Let Israel say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
chapters.zh: 愿以色列说： 他的慈爱永远长存！

chapters.en: Let the house of Aaron say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
chapters.zh: 愿亚伦的家说： 他的慈爱永远长存！

chapters.en: Let those who fear the LORD say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
chapters.zh: 愿敬畏耶和华的说： 他的慈爱永远长存！

chapters.en: In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free.
chapters.zh: 我在急难中求告耶和华，他就应允我， 把我〔安置〕在宽阔之地。

chapters.en: The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
chapters.zh: 有耶和华帮助我，我必不惧怕， 人能把我怎么样呢？

chapters.en: The LORD is on my side; He is my helper. Therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me.
chapters.zh: 在那帮助我的人中，有耶和华帮助我， 所以我要看见那恨我的人〔遭报〕。

chapters.en: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.
chapters.zh: 投靠耶和华，强似倚赖人；

chapters.en: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.
chapters.zh: 投靠耶和华，强似倚赖王子。

chapters.en: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
chapters.zh: 万民围绕我， 我靠耶和华的名必剿灭他们。

chapters.en: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
chapters.zh: 他们环绕我，围困我， 我靠耶和华的名必剿灭他们。

chapters.en:
They swarmed around me like bees, but they were extinguished like burning thorns;
in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
chapters.zh: 他们如同蜂子围绕我， 好像烧荆棘的火，必被熄灭； 我靠耶和华的名，必剿灭他们。

chapters.en: I was pushed so hard I was falling, but the LORD helped me.
chapters.zh: 你推我，要叫我跌倒， 但耶和华帮助了我。

chapters.en: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是我的力量，是我的诗歌； 他也成了我的拯救。

chapters.en: Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!
chapters.zh: 在义人的帐棚里，有欢呼拯救的声音； 耶和华的右手施展大能。

chapters.en: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!”
chapters.zh: 耶和华的右手高举； 耶和华的右手施展大能。

chapters.en: I will not die, but I will live and proclaim what the LORD has done.
chapters.zh: 我必不致死，仍要存活， 并要传扬耶和华的作为。

chapters.en: The LORD disciplined me severely, but He has not given me over to death.
chapters.zh: 耶和华虽严严地惩治我， 却未曾将我交于死亡。

chapters.en: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 给我敞开义门； 我要进去称谢耶和华！

chapters.en: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous shall enter through it.
chapters.zh: 这是耶和华的门； 义人要进去！

chapters.en: I will give You thanks, for You have answered me, and You have become my salvation.
chapters.zh: 我要称谢你，因为你已经应允我， 又成了我的拯救！

chapters.en: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
chapters.zh: 匠人所弃的石头 已成了房角的头块石头。

chapters.en: This is from the LORD, and it is marvelous in our eyes.
chapters.zh: 这是耶和华所做的， 在我们眼中看为希奇。

chapters.en: This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
chapters.zh: 这是耶和华所定的日子， 我们在其中要高兴欢喜！

chapters.en: O LORD, save us, we pray. We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper!
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你拯救！ 耶和华啊，求你使我们亨通！

chapters.en: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.
chapters.zh: 奉耶和华名来的是应当称颂的！ 我们从耶和华的殿中为你们祝福！

chapters.en: The LORD is God; He has made His light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是上帝； 他光照了我们。 理当用绳索把祭牲拴住， 〔牵〕到坛角那里。

chapters.en: You are my God, and I will give You thanks. You are my God, and I will exalt You.
chapters.zh: 你是我的上帝，我要称谢你！ 你是我的上帝，我要尊崇你！

chapters.en: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善； 他的慈爱永远长存！

chapters.en: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 行为完全、遵行耶和华律法的， 这人便为有福！

chapters.en: Blessed are those who keep His testimonies and seek Him with all their heart.
chapters.zh: 遵守他的法度、一心寻求他的， 这人便为有福！

chapters.en: They do no iniquity; they walk in His ways.
chapters.zh: 这人不做非义的事， 但遵行他的道。

chapters.en: You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你曾将你的训词吩咐我们， 为要我们殷勤遵守。

chapters.en: Oh, that my ways were committed to keeping Your statutes!
chapters.zh: 但愿我行事坚定， 得以遵守你的律例。

chapters.en: Then I would not be ashamed when I consider all Your commandments.
chapters.zh: 我看重你的一切命令， 就不至于羞愧。

chapters.en: I will praise You with an upright heart when I learn Your righteous judgments.
chapters.zh: 我学了你公义的判语， 就要以正直的心称谢你。

chapters.en: I will keep Your statutes; do not utterly forsake me.
chapters.zh: 我必守你的律例； 求你总不要丢弃我！

chapters.en: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.
chapters.zh: 少年人用什么洁净他的行为呢？ 是要遵行你的话！

chapters.en: With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.
chapters.zh: 我一心寻求了你； 求你不要叫我偏离你的命令。

chapters.en: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
chapters.zh: 我将你的话藏在心里， 免得我得罪你。

chapters.en: Blessed are You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你是应当称颂的！ 求你将你的律例教训我！

chapters.en: With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth.
chapters.zh: 我用嘴唇传扬你口中的一切典章。

chapters.en: I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies as much as in all riches.
chapters.zh: 我喜悦你的法度， 如同喜悦一切的财物。

chapters.en: I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways.
chapters.zh: 我要默想你的训词， 看重你的道路。

chapters.en: I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.
chapters.zh: 我要在你的律例中自乐； 我不忘记你的话。

chapters.en: Deal bountifully with Your servant, that I may live and keep Your word.
chapters.zh: 求你用厚恩待你的仆人，使我存活， 我就遵守你的话。

chapters.en: Open my eyes that I may see wondrous things from Your law.
chapters.zh: 求你开我的眼睛， 使我看出你律法中的奇妙。

chapters.en: I am a stranger on the earth; do not hide Your commandments from me.
chapters.zh: 我是在地上作寄居的； 求你不要向我隐瞒你的命令！

chapters.en: My soul is consumed with longing for Your judgments at all times.
chapters.zh: 我时常切慕你的典章， 甚至心碎。

chapters.en: You rebuke the arrogant— the cursed who stray from Your commandments.
chapters.zh: 受咒诅、偏离你命令的骄傲人， 你已经责备他们。

chapters.en: Remove my scorn and contempt, for I have kept Your testimonies.
chapters.zh: 求你除掉我所受的羞辱和藐视， 因我遵守你的法度。

chapters.en: Though rulers sit and slander me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.
chapters.zh: 虽有首领坐着妄论我， 你仆人却思想你的律例。

chapters.en: Your testimonies are indeed my delight; they are my counselors.
chapters.zh: 你的法度是我所喜乐的， 是我的谋士。

chapters.en: My soul cleaves to the dust; revive me according to Your word.
chapters.zh: 我的性命几乎归于尘土； 求你照你的话将我救活！

chapters.en: I recounted my ways, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.
chapters.zh: 我述说我所行的，你应允了我； 求你将你的律例教训我！

chapters.en: Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.
chapters.zh: 求你使我明白你的训词， 我就思想你的奇事。

chapters.en: My soul melts with sorrow; strengthen me according to Your word.
chapters.zh: 我的心因愁苦而消化； 求你照你的话使我坚立！

chapters.en: Remove me from the path of deceit and graciously grant me Your law.
chapters.zh: 求你使我离开奸诈的道， 开恩将你的律法赐给我！

chapters.en: I have chosen the way of truth; I have set Your ordinances before me.
chapters.zh: 我拣选了忠信的道， 将你的典章摆在〔我面前〕。

chapters.en: I cling to Your testimonies, O LORD; let me not be put to shame.
chapters.zh: 我持守你的法度； 耶和华啊，求你不要叫我羞愧！

chapters.en: I run in the path of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart.
chapters.zh: 你开广我心的时候， 我就往你命令的道上直奔。

chapters.en: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep them to the end.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你将你的律例指教我， 我必遵守到底！

chapters.en: Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.
chapters.zh: 求你赐我悟性，我便遵守你的律法， 且要一心遵守。

chapters.en: Direct me in the path of Your commandments, for there I find delight.
chapters.zh: 求你叫我遵行你的命令， 因为这是我所喜乐的。

chapters.en: Turn my heart to Your testimonies and not to covetous gain.
chapters.zh: 求你使我的心趋向你的法度， 不趋向非义之财。

chapters.en: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; revive me with Your word.
chapters.zh: 求你叫我转眼不看虚假， 又叫我在你的道中生活。

chapters.en: Establish Your word to Your servant, to produce reverence for You.
chapters.zh: 你向敬畏你的人所应许的话， 求你向仆人坚定！

chapters.en: Turn away the disgrace I dread, for Your judgments are good.
chapters.zh: 求你使我所怕的羞辱远离我， 因你的典章本为美。

chapters.en: How I long for Your precepts! Revive me in Your righteousness.
chapters.zh: 我羨慕你的训词； 求你使我在你的公义上生活！

chapters.en: May Your loving devotion come to me, O LORD, Your salvation, according to Your promise.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，愿你照你的话，使你的慈爱， 就是你的救恩，临到我身上，

chapters.en: Then I can answer him who taunts, for I trust in Your word.
chapters.zh: 我就有话回答那羞辱我的， 因我倚靠你的话。

chapters.en: Never take Your word of truth from my mouth, for I hope in Your judgments.
chapters.zh: 求你叫真理的话总不离开我口， 因我仰望你的典章。

chapters.en: I will always obey Your law, forever and ever.
chapters.zh: 我要常守你的律法， 直到永永远远。

chapters.en: And I will walk in freedom, for I have sought Your precepts.
chapters.zh: 我要自由而行〔注：或译：我要行在宽阔之地〕， 因我素来考究你的训词。

chapters.en: I will speak of Your testimonies before kings, and I will not be ashamed.
chapters.zh: 我也要在君王面前论说你的法度， 并不至于羞愧。

chapters.en: I delight in Your commandments because I love them.
chapters.zh: 我要在你的命令中自乐； 这命令素来是我所爱的。

chapters.en: I lift up my hands to Your commandments, which I love, and I meditate on Your statutes.
chapters.zh: 我又要遵行〔注：原文是举手〕你的命令， 这命令素来是我所爱的； 我也要思想你的律例。

chapters.en: Remember Your word to Your servant, upon which You have given me hope.
chapters.zh: 求你记念向你仆人〔所应许〕的话， 叫我有盼望。

chapters.en: This is my comfort in affliction, that Your promise has given me life.
chapters.zh: 这话将我救活了； 我在患难中，因此得安慰。

chapters.en: The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn from Your law.
chapters.zh: 骄傲的人甚侮慢我， 我却未曾偏离你的律法。

chapters.en: I remember Your judgments of old, O LORD, and in them I find comfort.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我记念你从古以来的典章， 就得了安慰。

chapters.en: Rage has taken hold of me because of the wicked who reject Your law.
chapters.zh: 我见恶人离弃你的律法， 就怒气发作，犹如火烧。

chapters.en: Your statutes are songs to me in the house of my pilgrimage.
chapters.zh: 我在世寄居， 素来以你的律例为诗歌。

chapters.en: In the night, O LORD, I remember Your name, that I may keep Your law.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我夜间记念你的名， 遵守你的律法。

chapters.en: This is my practice, for I obey Your precepts.
chapters.zh: 我所以如此， 是因我守你的训词。

chapters.en: The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是我的福分； 我曾说，我要遵守你的言语。

chapters.en: I have sought Your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to Your promise.
chapters.zh: 我一心求过你的恩； 愿你照你的话怜悯我！

chapters.en: I considered my ways and turned my steps to Your testimonies.
chapters.zh: 我思想我所行的道， 就转步归向你的法度。

chapters.en: I hurried without hesitating to keep Your commandments.
chapters.zh: 我急忙遵守你的命令， 并不迟延。

chapters.en: Though the ropes of the wicked bind me, I do not forget Your law.
chapters.zh: 恶人的绳索缠绕我， 我却没有忘记你的律法。

chapters.en: At midnight I rise to give You thanks for Your righteous judgments.
chapters.zh: 我因你公义的典章， 半夜必起来称谢你。

chapters.en: I am a friend to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts.
chapters.zh: 凡敬畏你、守你训词的人， 我都与他作伴。

chapters.en: The earth is filled with Your loving devotion, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你的慈爱遍满大地； 求你将你的律例教训我！

chapters.en: You are good to Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你向来是照你的话善待仆人。

chapters.en: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in Your commandments.
chapters.zh: 求你将精明和知识赐给我， 因我信了你的命令。

chapters.en: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I keep Your word.
chapters.zh: 我未受苦以先走迷了路， 现在却遵守你的话。

chapters.en: You are good, and You do what is good; teach me Your statutes.
chapters.zh: 你本为善，所行的也善； 求你将你的律例教训我！

chapters.en: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep Your precepts with all my heart.
chapters.zh: 骄傲人编造谎言攻击我， 我却要一心守你的训词。

chapters.en: Their hearts are callous and insensitive, but I delight in Your law.
chapters.zh: 他们心蒙脂油， 我却喜爱你的律法。

chapters.en: It was good for me to be afflicted, that I might learn Your statutes.
chapters.zh: 我受苦是与我有益， 为要使我学习你的律例。

chapters.en: The law from Your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
chapters.zh: 你口中的训言〔注：或译：律法〕与我有益， 胜于千万的金银。

chapters.en: Your hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding to learn Your commandments.
chapters.zh: 你的手制造我，建立我； 求你赐我悟性，可以学习你的命令！

chapters.en: May those who fear You see me and rejoice, for I have hoped in Your word.
chapters.zh: 敬畏你的人见我就要欢喜， 因我仰望你的话。

chapters.en: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我知道你的判语是公义的； 你使我受苦是以诚实待我。

chapters.en: May Your loving devotion comfort me, I pray, according to Your promise to Your servant.
chapters.zh: 求你照着〔应许〕仆人的话， 以慈爱安慰我。

chapters.en: May Your compassion come to me, that I may live, for Your law is my delight.
chapters.zh: 愿你的慈悲临到我，使我存活， 因你的律法是我所喜爱的。

chapters.en: May the arrogant be put to shame for subverting me with a lie; I will meditate on Your precepts.
chapters.zh: 愿骄傲人蒙羞，因为他们无理地倾覆我； 但我要思想你的训词。

chapters.en: May those who fear You turn to me, those who know Your testimonies.
chapters.zh: 愿敬畏你的人归向我， 他们就知道你的法度。

chapters.en: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame.
chapters.zh: 愿我的心在你的律例上完全， 使我不致蒙羞。

chapters.en: My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.
chapters.zh: 我心渴想你的救恩， 仰望你的应许。

chapters.en: My eyes fail, looking for Your promise; I ask, “When will You comfort me?”
chapters.zh: 我因盼望你的应许眼睛失明，说： 你何时安慰我？

chapters.en: Though I am like a wineskin dried up by smoke, I do not forget Your statutes.
chapters.zh: 我好像烟薰的皮袋， 却不忘记你的律例。

chapters.en: How many days must Your servant wait? When will You execute judgment on my persecutors?
chapters.zh: 你仆人的年日有多少呢？ 你几时向逼迫我的人施行审判呢？

chapters.en: The arrogant have dug pits for me in violation of Your law.
chapters.zh: 不从你律法的骄傲人为我掘了坑。

chapters.en: All Your commandments are faithful; I am persecuted without cause—help me!
chapters.zh: 你的命令尽都诚实； 他们无理地逼迫我，求你帮助我！

chapters.en: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken Your precepts.
chapters.zh: 他们几乎把我从世上灭绝， 但我没有离弃你的训词。

chapters.en: Revive me according to Your loving devotion, that I may obey the testimony of Your mouth.
chapters.zh: 求你照你的慈爱将我救活， 我就遵守你口中的法度。

chapters.en: Your word, O LORD, is everlasting; it is firmly fixed in the heavens.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你的话安定在天， 直到永远。

chapters.en: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; You established the earth, and it endures.
chapters.zh: 你的诚实存到万代； 你坚定了地，地就长存。

chapters.en: Your ordinances stand to this day, for all things are servants to You.
chapters.zh: 天地照你的安排存到今日； 万物都是你的仆役。

chapters.en: If Your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.
chapters.zh: 我若不是喜爱你的律法， 早就在苦难中灭绝了！

chapters.en: I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have revived me.
chapters.zh: 我永不忘记你的训词， 因你用这训词将我救活了。

chapters.en: I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.
chapters.zh: 我是属你的，求你救我， 因我寻求了你的训词。

chapters.en: The wicked wait to destroy me, but I will ponder Your testimonies.
chapters.zh: 恶人等待我，要灭绝我， 我却要揣摩你的法度。

chapters.en: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but Your commandment is without limit.
chapters.zh: 我看万事尽都有限， 惟有你的命令极其宽广。

chapters.en: Oh, how I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation.
chapters.zh: 我何等爱慕你的律法， 终日不住地思想。

chapters.en: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are always with me.
chapters.zh: 你的命令常存在我心里， 使我比仇敌有智慧。

chapters.en: I have more insight than all my teachers, for Your testimonies are my meditation.
chapters.zh: 我比我的师傅更通达， 因我思想你的法度。

chapters.en: I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.
chapters.zh: 我比年老的更明白， 因我守了你的训词。

chapters.en: I have kept my feet from every evil path, that I may keep Your word.
chapters.zh: 我禁止我脚走一切的邪路， 为要遵守你的话。

chapters.en: I have not departed from Your ordinances, for You Yourself have taught me.
chapters.zh: 我没有偏离你的典章， 因为你教训了我。

chapters.en: How sweet are Your words to my taste— sweeter than honey in my mouth!
chapters.zh: 你的言语在我上膛何等甘美， 在我口中比蜜更甜！

chapters.en: I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way.
chapters.zh: 我藉着你的训词得以明白， 所以我恨一切的假道。

chapters.en: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
chapters.zh: 你的话是我脚前的灯， 是我路上的光。

chapters.en: I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep Your righteous judgments.
chapters.zh: 你公义的典章，我曾起誓遵守， 我必按誓而行。

chapters.en: I am severely afflicted, O LORD; revive me through Your word.
chapters.zh: 我甚是受苦； 耶和华啊，求你照你的话将我救活！

chapters.en: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你悦纳我口中的赞美为供物， 又将你的典章教训我！

chapters.en: I constantly take my life in my hands, yet I do not forget Your law.
chapters.zh: 我的性命常在危险之中， 我却不忘记你的律法。

chapters.en: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from Your precepts.
chapters.zh: 恶人为我设下网罗， 我却没有偏离你的训词。

chapters.en: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
chapters.zh: 我以你的法度为永远的产业， 因这是我心中所喜爱的。

chapters.en: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes, even to the very end.
chapters.zh: 我的心专向你的律例， 永远遵行，一直到底。

chapters.en: The double-minded I despise, but Your law I love.
chapters.zh: 心怀二意的人为我所恨； 但你的律法为我所爱。

chapters.en: You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.
chapters.zh: 你是我藏身之处，又是我的盾牌； 我甚仰望你的话语。

chapters.en: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God.
chapters.zh: 作恶的人哪，你们离开我吧！ 我好遵守我上帝的命令。

chapters.en: Sustain me as You promised, that I may live; let me not be ashamed of my hope.
chapters.zh: 求你照你的话扶持我，使我存活， 也不叫我因失望而害羞。

chapters.en: Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.
chapters.zh: 求你扶持我，我便得救， 时常看重你的律例。

chapters.en: You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.
chapters.zh: 凡偏离你律例的人，你都轻弃他们， 因为他们的诡诈必归虚空。

chapters.en: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.
chapters.zh: 凡地上的恶人，你除掉他，好像除掉渣滓； 因此我爱你的法度。

chapters.en: My flesh trembles in awe of You; I stand in fear of Your judgments.
chapters.zh: 我因惧怕你，肉就发抖； 我也怕你的判语。

chapters.en: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.
chapters.zh: 我行过公平和公义， 求你不要撇下我给欺压我的人！

chapters.en: Ensure Your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.
chapters.zh: 求你为仆人作保，使我得好处， 不容骄傲人欺压我！

chapters.en: My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation, and for Your righteous promise.
chapters.zh: 我因盼望你的救恩 和你公义的话眼睛失明。

chapters.en: Deal with Your servant according to Your loving devotion, and teach me Your statutes.
chapters.zh: 求你照你的慈爱待仆人， 将你的律例教训我。

chapters.en: I am Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.
chapters.zh: 我是你的仆人，求你赐我悟性， 使我得知你的法度。

chapters.en: It is time for the LORD to act, for they have broken Your law.
chapters.zh: 这是耶和华降罚的时候， 因人废了你的律法。

chapters.en: Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, even the purest gold.
chapters.zh: 所以，我爱你的命令胜于金子， 更胜于精金。

chapters.en: Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way.
chapters.zh: 你一切的训词，在万事上我都以为正直； 我却恨恶一切假道。

chapters.en: Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore I obey them.
chapters.zh: 你的法度奇妙， 所以我一心谨守。

chapters.en: The unfolding of Your words gives light; it informs the simple.
chapters.zh: 你的言语一解开就发出亮光， 使愚人通达。

chapters.en: I open my mouth and pant, longing for Your commandments.
chapters.zh: 我张口而气喘， 因我切慕你的命令。

chapters.en: Turn to me and show me mercy, as You do to those who love Your name.
chapters.zh: 求你转向我，怜悯我， 好像你素常待那些爱你名的人。

chapters.en: Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.
chapters.zh: 求你用你的话使我脚步稳当， 不许什么罪孽辖制我。

chapters.en: Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.
chapters.zh: 求你救我脱离人的欺压， 我要遵守你的训词。

chapters.en: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.
chapters.zh: 求你用脸光照仆人， 又将你的律例教训我。

chapters.en: My eyes shed streams of tears because Your law is not obeyed.
chapters.zh: 我的眼泪下流成河， 因为他们不守你的律法。

chapters.en: Righteous are You, O LORD, and upright are Your judgments.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你是公义的； 你的判语也是正直的！

chapters.en: The testimonies You have laid down are righteous and altogether faithful.
chapters.zh: 你所命定的法度是凭公义和至诚。

chapters.en: My zeal has consumed me because my foes forget Your words.
chapters.zh: 我心焦急，如同火烧， 因我敌人忘记你的言语。

chapters.en: Your promise is completely pure; therefore Your servant loves it.
chapters.zh: 你的话极其精炼， 所以你的仆人喜爱。

chapters.en: I am lowly and despised, but I do not forget Your precepts.
chapters.zh: 我微小，被人藐视， 却不忘记你的训词。

chapters.en: Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.
chapters.zh: 你的公义永远长存； 你的律法尽都真实。

chapters.en: Trouble and distress have found me, but Your commandments are my delight.
chapters.zh: 我遭遇患难愁苦， 你的命令却是我所喜爱的。

chapters.en: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.
chapters.zh: 你的法度永远是公义的； 求你赐我悟性，我就活了。

chapters.en: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD! I will obey Your statutes.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我一心呼吁你； 求你应允我，我必谨守你的律例！

chapters.en: I call to You; save me, that I may keep Your testimonies.
chapters.zh: 我向你呼吁，求你救我！ 我要遵守你的法度。

chapters.en: I rise before dawn and cry for help; in Your word I have put my hope.
chapters.zh: 我趁天未亮呼求； 我仰望了你的言语。

chapters.en: My eyes anticipate the watches of night, that I may meditate on Your word.
chapters.zh: 我趁夜更未换将眼睁开， 为要思想你的话语。

chapters.en: Hear my voice, O LORD, according to Your loving devotion; give me life according to Your justice.
chapters.zh: 求你照你的慈爱听我的声音； 耶和华啊，求你照你的典章将我救活！

chapters.en: Those who follow after wickedness draw near; they are far from Your law.
chapters.zh: 追求奸恶的人临近了； 他们远离你的律法。

chapters.en: You are near, O LORD, and all Your commandments are true.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你与我相近； 你一切的命令尽都真实！

chapters.en: Long ago I learned from Your testimonies that You have established them forever.
chapters.zh: 我因〔学〕你的法度， 久已知道是你永远立定的。

chapters.en: Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law.
chapters.zh: 求你看顾我的苦难，搭救我， 因我不忘记你的律法。

chapters.en: Defend my cause and redeem me; revive me according to Your word.
chapters.zh: 求你为我辨屈，救赎我， 照你的话将我救活。

chapters.en: Salvation is far from the wicked because they do not seek Your statutes.
chapters.zh: 救恩远离恶人， 因为他们不寻求你的律例。

chapters.en: Great are Your mercies, O LORD; revive me according to Your ordinances.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你的慈悲本为大； 求你照你的典章将我救活。

chapters.en: Though my persecutors and foes are many, I have not turned from Your testimonies.
chapters.zh: 逼迫我的，抵挡我的，很多， 我却没有偏离你的法度。

chapters.en: I look on the faithless with loathing because they do not keep Your word.
chapters.zh: 我看见奸恶的人就甚憎恶， 因为他们不遵守你的话。

chapters.en: Consider how I love Your precepts, O LORD; give me life according to Your loving devotion.
chapters.zh: 你看我怎样爱你的训词！ 耶和华啊，求你照你的慈爱将我救活！

chapters.en: The entirety of Your word is truth, and all Your righteous judgments endure forever.
chapters.zh: 你话的总纲是真实； 你一切公义的典章是永远长存。

chapters.en: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart fears only Your word.
chapters.zh: 首领无故地逼迫我， 但我的心畏惧你的言语。

chapters.en: I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great spoil.
chapters.zh: 我喜爱你的话， 好像人得了许多掳物。

chapters.en: I hate and abhor falsehood, but Your law I love.
chapters.zh: 谎话是我所恨恶所憎嫌的； 惟你的律法是我所爱的。

chapters.en: Seven times a day I praise You for Your righteous judgments.
chapters.zh: 我因你公义的典章一天七次赞美你。

chapters.en: Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your law; nothing can make them stumble.
chapters.zh: 爱你律法的人有大平安， 什么都不能使他们绊脚。

chapters.en: I wait for Your salvation, O LORD, and I carry out Your commandments.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我仰望了你的救恩， 遵行了你的命令。

chapters.en: I obey Your testimonies and love them greatly.
chapters.zh: 我心里守了你的法度； 这法度我甚喜爱。

chapters.en: I obey Your precepts and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You.
chapters.zh: 我遵守了你的训词和法度， 因我一切所行的都在你面前。

chapters.en: May my cry come before You, O LORD; give me understanding according to Your word.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，愿我的呼吁达到你面前， 照你的话赐我悟性。

chapters.en: May my plea come before You; rescue me according to Your promise.
chapters.zh: 愿我的恳求达到你面前， 照你的话搭救我。

chapters.en: My lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes.
chapters.zh: 愿我的嘴发出赞美的话， 因为你将律例教训我。

chapters.en: My tongue sings of Your word, for all Your commandments are righteous.
chapters.zh: 愿我的舌头歌唱你的话， 因你一切的命令尽都公义。

chapters.en: May Your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts.
chapters.zh: 愿你用手帮助我， 因我拣选了你的训词。

chapters.en: I long for Your salvation, O LORD, and Your law is my delight.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我切慕你的救恩！ 你的律法也是我所喜爱的。

chapters.en: Let me live to praise You; may Your judgments sustain me.
chapters.zh: 愿我的性命存活，得以赞美你！ 愿你的典章帮助我！

chapters.en: I have strayed like a lost sheep; seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments.
chapters.zh: 我如亡羊走迷了路，求你寻找仆人， 因我不忘记你的命令。

chapters.en: In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.
chapters.zh: 我在急难中求告耶和华， 他就应允我。

chapters.en: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你救我脱离说谎的嘴唇和诡诈的舌头！

chapters.en:
What will He do to you, and what will be added to you,
O deceitful tongue?
chapters.zh: 诡诈的舌头啊，要给你什么呢？ 要拿什么加给你呢？

chapters.en: Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!
chapters.zh: 就是勇士的利箭和罗腾木〔注：小树名，松类〕的炭火。

chapters.en: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!
chapters.zh: 我寄居在米设， 住在基达帐棚之中，有祸了！

chapters.en: Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.
chapters.zh: 我与那恨恶和睦的人许久同住。

chapters.en: I am in favor of peace; but when I speak, they want war.
chapters.zh: 我愿和睦， 但我发言，他们就要争战。

chapters.en: I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?
chapters.zh: 我要向山举目； 我的帮助从何而来？

chapters.en: My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
chapters.zh: 我的帮助 从造天地的耶和华而来。

chapters.en: He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.
chapters.zh: 他必不叫你的脚摇动； 保护你的必不打盹！

chapters.en: Behold, the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
chapters.zh: 保护以色列的， 也不打盹也不睡觉。

chapters.en: The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand.
chapters.zh: 保护你的是耶和华； 耶和华在你右边荫庇你。

chapters.en: The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.
chapters.zh: 白日，太阳必不伤你； 夜间，月亮必不害你。

chapters.en: The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.
chapters.zh: 耶和华要保护你，免受一切的灾害； 他要保护你的性命。

chapters.en: The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.
chapters.zh: 你出你入，耶和华要保护你， 从今时直到永远。

chapters.en: I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 人对我说：我们往耶和华的殿去， 我就欢喜。

chapters.en: Our feet are standing in your gates, O Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷啊， 我们的脚站在你的门内。

chapters.en: Jerusalem is built up as a city united together,
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷被建造， 如同连络整齐的一座城。

chapters.en: where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 众支派，就是耶和华的支派，上那里去， 按以色列的常例〔注：或译：作以色列的证据〕称赞耶和华的名。

chapters.en: For there the thrones of judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David.
chapters.zh: 因为在那里设立审判的宝座， 就是大卫家的宝座。

chapters.en: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you prosper.
chapters.zh: 你们要为耶路撒冷求平安！ 耶路撒冷啊，爱你的人必然兴旺！

chapters.en: May there be peace within your walls, and prosperity inside your fortresses.”
chapters.zh: 愿你城中平安！ 愿你宫内兴旺！

chapters.en: For the sake of my brothers and friends, I will say, “Peace be within you.”
chapters.zh: 因我弟兄和同伴的缘故，我要说： 愿平安在你中间！

chapters.en: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your prosperity.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华－我们上帝殿的缘故， 我要为你求福！

chapters.en: I lift up my eyes to You, the One enthroned in heaven.
chapters.zh: 坐在天上的〔主〕啊， 我向你举目。

chapters.en: As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maidservant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes are on the LORD our God until He shows us mercy.
chapters.zh: 看哪，仆人的眼睛怎样望主人的手， 使女的眼睛怎样望主母的手， 我们的眼睛也照样望耶和华－我们的上帝， 直到他怜悯我们。

chapters.en: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy, for we have endured much contempt.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你怜悯我们，怜悯我们！ 因为我们被藐视，已到极处。

chapters.en: We have endured much scorn from the arrogant, much contempt from the proud.
chapters.zh: 我们被那些安逸人的讥诮 和骄傲人的藐视，已到极处。

chapters.en: If the LORD had not been on our side— let Israel now declare—
chapters.zh: 以色列人要说： 若不是耶和华帮助我们，

chapters.en: if the LORD had not been on our side when men attacked us,
chapters.zh: 若不是耶和华帮助我们， 当人起来攻击我们、

chapters.en: when their anger flared against us, then they would have swallowed us alive,
chapters.zh: 向我们发怒的时候， 就把我们活活地吞了。

chapters.en: then the floods would have engulfed us, then the torrent would have overwhelmed us,
chapters.zh: 那时，波涛必漫过我们， 河水必淹没我们，

chapters.en: then the raging waters would have swept us away.
chapters.zh: 狂傲的水必淹没我们。

chapters.en: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as prey to their teeth.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的！ 他没有把我们当野食交给他们吞吃〔注：原文是牙齿〕。

chapters.en: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; the net is torn, and we have slipped away.
chapters.zh: 我们好像雀鸟，从捕鸟人的网罗里逃脱； 网罗破裂，我们逃脱了。

chapters.en: Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
chapters.zh: 我们得帮助， 是在乎〔倚靠〕造天地之耶和华的名。

chapters.en: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.
chapters.zh: 倚靠耶和华的人 好像锡安山，永不动摇。

chapters.en:
As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people,
both now and forevermore.
chapters.zh: 众山怎样围绕耶路撒冷， 耶和华也照样围绕他的百姓， 从今时直到永远。

chapters.en: For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous will not put forth their hands to injustice.
chapters.zh: 恶人的杖不常落在义人的分上， 免得义人伸手作恶。

chapters.en: Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, and to the upright in heart.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你善待那些为善 和心里正直的人。

chapters.en:
But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers.
Peace be upon Israel.
chapters.zh: 至于那偏行弯曲道路的人， 耶和华必使他和作恶的人一同出去〔受刑〕。 愿平安归于以色列！

chapters.en: When the LORD restored the captives of Zion, we were like dreamers.
chapters.zh: 当耶和华将那些被掳的带回锡安的时候， 我们好像做梦的人。

chapters.en: Then our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with shouts of joy. Then it was said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
chapters.zh: 我们满口喜笑、 满舌欢呼的时候， 外邦中就有人说： 耶和华为他们行了大事！

chapters.en: The LORD has done great things for us; we are filled with joy.
chapters.zh: 耶和华果然为我们行了大事， 我们就欢喜。

chapters.en: Restore our captives, O LORD, like streams in the Negev.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你使我们被掳的人归回， 好像南地的河水复流。

chapters.en: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
chapters.zh: 流泪撒种的， 必欢呼收割！

chapters.en: He who goes out weeping, bearing a trail of seed, will surely return with shouts of joy, carrying sheaves of grain.
chapters.zh: 那带种流泪出去的， 必要欢欢乐乐地带禾捆回来！

chapters.en: Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain; unless the LORD protects the city, its watchmen stand guard in vain.
chapters.zh: 若不是耶和华建造房屋， 建造的人就枉然劳力； 若不是耶和华看守城池， 看守的人就枉然警醒。

chapters.en: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for bread to eat— for He gives sleep to His beloved.
chapters.zh: 你们清晨早起，夜晚安歇， 吃劳碌得来的饭，本是枉然； 惟有耶和华所亲爱的，必叫他安然睡觉。

chapters.en: Children are indeed a heritage from the LORD, and the fruit of the womb is His reward.
chapters.zh: 儿女是耶和华所赐的产业； 所怀的胎是他所给的赏赐。

chapters.en: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, so are children born in one’s youth.
chapters.zh: 少年时〔所生〕的儿女 好像勇士手中的箭。

chapters.en: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. He will not be put to shame when he confronts the enemies at the gate.
chapters.zh: 箭袋充满的人便为有福； 他们在城门口和仇敌说话的时候， 必不至于羞愧。

chapters.en: Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!
chapters.zh: 凡敬畏耶和华、 遵行他道的人便为有福！

chapters.en: For when you eat the fruit of your labor, blessings and prosperity will be yours.
chapters.zh: 你要吃劳碌得来的； 你要享福，事情顺利。

chapters.en: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house, your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table.
chapters.zh: 你妻子在你的内室，好像多结果子的葡萄树； 你儿女围绕你的桌子，好像橄榄栽子。

chapters.en: In this way indeed shall blessing come to the man who fears the LORD.
chapters.zh: 看哪，敬畏耶和华的人必要这样蒙福！

chapters.en:
May the LORD bless you from Zion, that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem
all the days of your life,
chapters.zh: 愿耶和华从锡安赐福给你！ 愿你一生一世看见耶路撒冷的好处！

chapters.en:
that you may see your children’s children.
Peace be upon Israel!
chapters.zh: 愿你看见你儿女的儿女！ 愿平安归于以色列！

chapters.en: Many a time they have persecuted me from my youth— let Israel now declare—
chapters.zh: 以色列当说：从我幼年以来， 敌人屡次苦害我，

chapters.en: many a time they have persecuted me from my youth, but they have not prevailed against me.
chapters.zh: 从我幼年以来，敌人屡次苦害我， 却没有胜了我。

chapters.en: The plowmen plowed over my back; they made their furrows long.
chapters.zh: 〔如同〕扶诓的在我背上扶诓而耕， 耕的诓沟甚长。

chapters.en: The LORD is righteous; He has cut me from the cords of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是公义的； 他砍断了恶人的绳索。

chapters.en: May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.
chapters.zh: 愿恨恶锡安的都蒙羞退后！

chapters.en: May they be like grass on the rooftops, which withers before it can grow,
chapters.zh: 愿他们像房顶上的草， 未长成而枯干，

chapters.en: unable to fill the hands of the reaper, or the arms of the binder of sheaves.
chapters.zh: 收割的不够一把， 捆禾的也不满怀。

chapters.en:
May none who pass by say to them, “The blessing of the LORD be on you;
we bless you in the name of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 过路的也不说： 愿耶和华所赐的福归与你们！ 我们奉耶和华的名给你们祝福！

chapters.en: Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我从深处向你求告！

chapters.en: O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
chapters.zh: 主啊，求你听我的声音！ 愿你侧耳听我恳求的声音！

chapters.en: If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?
chapters.zh: 主－耶和华啊，你若究察罪孽， 谁能站得住呢？

chapters.en: But with You there is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.
chapters.zh: 但在你有赦免之恩， 要叫人敬畏你。

chapters.en: I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
chapters.zh: 我等候耶和华，我的心等候； 我也仰望他的话。

chapters.en:
My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning—
more than watchmen wait for the morning.
chapters.zh: 我的心〔等候〕主， 胜于守夜的，〔等候〕天亮， 〔胜于〕守夜的，〔等候〕天亮。

chapters.en:
O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion,
and with Him is redemption in abundance.
chapters.zh: 以色列啊，你当仰望耶和华！ 因他有慈爱，有丰盛的救恩。

chapters.en: And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity.
chapters.zh: 他必救赎以色列脱离一切的罪孽。

chapters.en: My heart is not proud, O LORD, my eyes are not haughty. I do not aspire to great things or matters too lofty for me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我的心不狂傲， 我的眼不高大； 重大和测不透的事， 我也不敢行。

chapters.en:
Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; like a weaned child with his mother,
like a weaned child is my soul within me.
chapters.zh: 我的心平稳安静， 好像断过奶的孩子在他母亲的怀中； 我的心在我里面真像断过奶的孩子。

chapters.en: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, both now and forevermore.
chapters.zh: 以色列啊，你当仰望耶和华， 从今时直到永远！

chapters.en: O LORD, remember on behalf of David all the hardships he endured,
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你记念大卫所受的一切苦难！

chapters.en: how he swore an oath to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
chapters.zh: 他怎样向耶和华起誓， 向雅各的大能者许愿，

chapters.en: “I will not enter my house or get into my bed,
chapters.zh: 说：我必不进我的帐幕， 也不上我的床榻；

chapters.en: I will not give sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,
chapters.zh: 我不容我的眼睛睡觉， 也不容我的眼目打盹；

chapters.en: until I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob. ”
chapters.zh: 直等我为耶和华寻得所在， 为雅各的大能者寻得居所。

chapters.en: We heard that the ark was in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.
chapters.zh: 我们听说〔约柜〕在以法他， 我们在基列‧耶琳就寻见了。

chapters.en: Let us go to His dwelling place; let us worship at His footstool.
chapters.zh: 我们要进他的居所， 在他脚凳前下拜。

chapters.en: Arise, O LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你兴起， 和你有能力的〔约〕柜同入安息之所！

chapters.en: May Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and Your saints shout for joy.
chapters.zh: 愿你的祭司披上公义！ 愿你的圣民欢呼！

chapters.en: For the sake of Your servant David, do not reject Your anointed one.
chapters.zh: 求你因你仆人大卫的缘故， 不要厌弃你的受膏者！

chapters.en: The LORD swore an oath to David, a promise He will not revoke: “One of your descendants I will place on your throne.
chapters.zh: 耶和华向大卫、凭诚实起了誓， 必不反覆，〔说〕： 我要使你所生的 坐在你的宝座上。

chapters.en: If your sons keep My covenant and the testimony I will teach them, then their sons will also sit on your throne forever and ever.”
chapters.zh: 你的众子若守我的约 和我所教训他们的法度， 他们的子孙必永远坐在你的宝座上。

chapters.en: For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired it for His home:
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华拣选了锡安， 愿意当作自己的居所，

chapters.en: “This is My resting place forever and ever; here I will dwell, for I have desired this home.
chapters.zh: 说：这是我永远安息之所； 我要住在这里， 因为是我所愿意的。

chapters.en: I will bless her with abundant provisions; I will satisfy her poor with bread.
chapters.zh: 我要使其中的粮食丰满， 使其中的穷人饱足。

chapters.en: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will sing out in joy.
chapters.zh: 我要使祭司披上救恩， 圣民大声欢呼！

chapters.en: There I will make a horn grow for David; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed one.
chapters.zh: 我要叫大卫的角在那里发生； 我为我的受膏者预备明灯。

chapters.en: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but the crown upon him will gleam.”
chapters.zh: 我要使他的仇敌披上羞耻； 但他的冠冕要在头上发光。

chapters.en: Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!
chapters.zh: 看哪，弟兄和睦同居 是何等地善，何等地美！

chapters.en: It is like fine oil on the head, running down on the beard, running down Aaron’s beard over the collar of his robes.
chapters.zh: 这好比那贵重的油〔浇〕在亚伦的头上， 流到胡须，又流到他的衣襟；

chapters.en: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.
chapters.zh: 又好比黑门的甘露降在锡安山； 因为在那里有耶和华所命定的福， 就是永远的生命。

chapters.en: Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD!
chapters.zh: 耶和华的仆人夜间站在耶和华殿中的， 你们当称颂耶和华！

chapters.en: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD!
chapters.zh: 你们当向圣所举手， 称颂耶和华！

chapters.en: May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
chapters.zh: 愿造天地的耶和华， 从锡安赐福给你们！

chapters.en:
Hallelujah!
Praise the name of the LORD. Give praise, O servants of the LORD,
who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 你们要赞美耶和华的名！ 耶和华的仆人站在耶和华殿中； 站在我们上帝殿院中的，你们要赞美他！

chapters.en: Hallelujah, for the LORD is good; sing praises to His name, for it is lovely.
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 耶和华本为善； 要歌颂他的名， 因为这是美好的。

chapters.en: For the LORD has chosen Jacob as His own, Israel as His treasured possession.
chapters.zh: 耶和华拣选雅各归自己， 拣选以色列特作自己的子民。

chapters.en: For I know that the LORD is great; our Lord is above all gods.
chapters.zh: 原来我知道耶和华为大， 也知道我们的主超乎万神之上。

chapters.en:
The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth,
in the seas and in all their depths.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在天上，在地下， 在海中，在一切的深处， 都随自己的意旨而行。

chapters.en: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
chapters.zh: 他使云雾从地极上腾， 造电随雨而闪， 从府库中带出风来。

chapters.en: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, of both man and beast.
chapters.zh: 他将埃及头生的， 连人带牲畜都击杀了。

chapters.en: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
chapters.zh: 埃及啊，他施行神迹奇事， 在你当中，在法老和他一切臣仆身上。

chapters.en: He struck down many nations and slaughtered mighty kings:
chapters.zh: 他击杀许多的民， 又杀戮大能的王，

chapters.en:
Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan,
and all the kings of Canaan.
chapters.zh: 就是亚摩利王西宏和巴珊王噩， 并迦南一切的国王，

chapters.en: He gave their land as an inheritance, as a heritage to His people Israel.
chapters.zh: 将他们的地赏赐他的百姓以色列为业。

chapters.en: Your name, O LORD, endures forever, Your renown, O LORD, through all generations.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你的名存到永远！ 耶和华啊，你可记念的名存到万代！

chapters.en: For the LORD will vindicate His people and will have compassion on His servants.
chapters.zh: 耶和华要为他的百姓伸冤， 为他的仆人后悔。

chapters.en: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
chapters.zh: 外邦的偶像是金的，银的， 是人手所造的；

chapters.en: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
chapters.zh: 有口却不能言， 有眼却不能看，

chapters.en: they have ears, but cannot hear; nor is there breath in their mouths.
chapters.zh: 有耳却不能听， 口中也没有气息。

chapters.en: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
chapters.zh: 造他的要和他一样， 凡靠他的也要如此。

chapters.en: O house of Israel, bless the LORD; O house of Aaron, bless the LORD;
chapters.zh: 以色列家啊，你们要称颂耶和华！ 亚伦家啊，你们要称颂耶和华！

chapters.en: O house of Levi, bless the LORD; you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!
chapters.zh: 利未家啊，你们要称颂耶和华！ 你们敬畏耶和华的，要称颂耶和华！

chapters.en:
Blessed be the LORD from Zion— He who dwells in Jerusalem.
Hallelujah!
chapters.zh: 住在耶路撒冷的耶和华 该从锡安受称颂。 你们要赞美耶和华！

chapters.en: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善； 他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: Give thanks to the God of gods. His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 你们要称谢万神之神， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: Give thanks to the Lord of lords. His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 你们要称谢万主之主， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: He alone does great wonders. His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 〔称谢〕那独行大奇事的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: By His insight He made the heavens. His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 〔称谢〕那用智慧造天的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: He spread out the earth upon the waters. His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 〔称谢〕那铺地在水以上的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: He made the great lights— His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 〔称谢〕那造成大光的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: the sun to rule the day, His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他造日头管白昼， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: the moon and stars to govern the night. His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他造月亮星宿管黑夜， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 〔称谢〕那击杀埃及人之长子的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: and brought Israel out from among them His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他领以色列人从他们中间出来， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他施展大能的手和伸出来的膀臂， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: He divided the Red Sea in two His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 〔称谢〕那分裂红海的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: and led Israel through the midst, His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他领以色列从其中经过， 因他的慈爱永远长存；

chapters.en: but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea. His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 却把法老和他的军兵推翻在红海里， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: He led His people through the wilderness. His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 〔称谢〕那引导自己的民行走旷野的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: He struck down great kings His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 〔称谢〕那击杀大君王的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: and slaughtered mighty kings— His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他杀戮有名的君王， 因他的慈爱永远长存；

chapters.en: Sihon king of the Amorites His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 就是杀戮亚摩利王西宏， 因他的慈爱永远长存；

chapters.en: and Og king of Bashan— His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 又杀巴珊王噩， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: and He gave their land as an inheritance, His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他将他们的地赐他的百姓为业， 因他的慈爱永远长存；

chapters.en: a heritage to His servant Israel. His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 就是赐他的仆人以色列为业， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: He remembered us in our low estate His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他顾念我们在卑微的地步， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: and freed us from our enemies. His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他救拔我们脱离敌人， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: He gives food to every creature. His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 他赐粮食给凡有血气的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: Give thanks to the God of heaven! His loving devotion endures forever.
chapters.zh: 你们要称谢天上的上帝， 因他的慈爱永远长存。

chapters.en: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.
chapters.zh: 我们曾在巴比伦的河边坐下， 一追想锡安就哭了。

chapters.en: There on the willows we hung our harps,
chapters.zh: 我们把琴挂在那里的柳树上；

chapters.en:
for there our captors requested a song; our tormentors demanded songs of joy:
“Sing us a song of Zion.”
chapters.zh: 因为在那里，掳掠我们的要我们唱歌， 抢夺我们的〔要我们〕作乐，〔说〕： 给我们唱一首锡安歌吧！

chapters.en: How can we sing a song of the LORD in a foreign land?
chapters.zh: 我们怎能在外邦唱耶和华的歌呢？

chapters.en: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, may my right hand cease to function.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，我若忘记你， 情愿我的右手忘记〔技巧〕！

chapters.en: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not exalt Jerusalem as my greatest joy!
chapters.zh: 我若不记念你， 若不看耶路撒冷过于我所最喜乐的， 情愿我的舌头贴于上膛！

chapters.en: Remember, O LORD, the sons of Edom on the day Jerusalem fell: “Destroy it,” they said, “tear it down to its foundations!”
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷〔遭难〕的日子， 以东人说：拆毁！拆毁！ 直拆到根基！ 耶和华啊，求你记念这仇！

chapters.en: O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, blessed is he who repays you as you have done to us.
chapters.zh: 将要被灭的巴比伦城啊〔注：城：原文是女子〕， 报复你像你待我们的，那人便为有福！

chapters.en: Blessed is he who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.
chapters.zh: 拿你的婴孩摔在磐石上的， 那人便为有福！

chapters.en: I give You thanks with all my heart; before the gods I sing Your praises.
chapters.zh: 我要一心称谢你， 在诸神面前歌颂你。

chapters.en:
I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name
for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.
chapters.zh: 我要向你的圣殿下拜， 为你的慈爱和诚实称赞你的名； 因你使你的话显为大， 过于你所应许的〔注：或译：超乎你的名声〕。

chapters.en: On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.
chapters.zh: 我呼求的日子，你就应允我， 鼓励我，使我心里有能力。

chapters.en: All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD, when they hear the words of Your mouth.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，地上的君王都要称谢你， 因他们听见了你口中的言语。

chapters.en: They will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.
chapters.zh: 他们要歌颂耶和华的作为， 因耶和华大有荣耀。

chapters.en:
Though the LORD is on high, He attends to the lowly;
but the proud He knows from afar.
chapters.zh: 耶和华虽高，仍看顾低微的人； 他却从远处看出骄傲的人。

chapters.en: If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.
chapters.zh: 我虽行在患难中，你必将我救活； 我的仇敌发怒，你必伸手抵挡他们； 你的右手也必救我。

chapters.en:
The LORD will fulfill His purpose for me.
O LORD, Your loving devotion endures forever— do not abandon the works of Your hands.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必成全关乎我的事； 耶和华啊，你的慈爱永远长存！ 求你不要离弃你手所造的。

chapters.en: O LORD, You have searched me and known me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你已经鉴察我，认识我。

chapters.en: You know when I sit and when I rise; You understand my thoughts from afar.
chapters.zh: 我坐下，我起来，你都晓得； 你从远处知道我的意念。

chapters.en: You search out my path and my lying down; You are aware of all my ways.
chapters.zh: 我行路，我躺卧，你都细察； 你也深知我一切所行的。

chapters.en: Even before a word is on my tongue, You know all about it, O LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我舌头上的话， 你没有一句不知道的。

chapters.en: You hem me in behind and before; You have laid Your hand upon me.
chapters.zh: 你在我前后环绕我， 按手在我身上。

chapters.en: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.
chapters.zh: 〔这样的〕知识奇妙，是我不能测的， 至高，是我不能及的。

chapters.en: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?
chapters.zh: 我往哪里去躲避你的灵？ 我往哪里逃、躲避你的面？

chapters.en: If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.
chapters.zh: 我若升到天上，你在那里； 我若在阴间下榻，你也在那里。

chapters.en: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle by the farthest sea,
chapters.zh: 我若展开清晨的翅膀， 〔飞〕到海极居住，

chapters.en: even there Your hand will guide me; Your right hand will hold me fast.
chapters.zh: 就是在那里，你的手必引导我； 你的右手也必扶持我。

chapters.en: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light become night around me”—
chapters.zh: 我若说：黑暗必定遮蔽我， 我周围的亮光必成为黑夜；

chapters.en:
even the darkness is not dark to You, but the night shines like the day,
for darkness is as light to You.
chapters.zh: 黑暗也不能遮蔽我，使你不见， 黑夜却如白昼发亮。 黑暗和光明，〔在你看〕都是一样。

chapters.en: For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
chapters.zh: 我的肺腑是你所造的； 我在母腹中，你已覆庇我。

chapters.en: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.
chapters.zh: 我要称谢你，因我受造，奇妙可畏； 你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

chapters.en: My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.
chapters.zh: 我在暗中受造，在地的深处被联络； 那时，我的形体并不向你隐藏。

chapters.en: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be.
chapters.zh: 我未成形的体质，你的眼早已看见了； 你所定的日子，我尚未度一日〔注：或译：我被造的肢体尚未有其一〕， 你都写在你的册上了。

chapters.en: How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你的意念向我何等宝贵！ 其数何等众多！

chapters.en: If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.
chapters.zh: 我若数点，比海沙更多； 我睡醒的时候，仍和你同在。

chapters.en: O God, that You would slay the wicked— away from me, you bloodthirsty men—
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，你必要杀戮恶人； 所以，你们好流人血的，离开我去吧！

chapters.en: who speak of You deceitfully; Your enemies take Your name in vain.
chapters.zh: 因为他们说恶言顶撞你； 你的仇敌也妄称〔你的名〕。

chapters.en: Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD, and detest those who rise against You?
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，恨恶你的，我岂不恨恶他们吗？ 攻击你的，我岂不憎嫌他们吗？

chapters.en: I hate them with perfect hatred; I count them as my enemies.
chapters.zh: 我切切地恨恶他们， 以他们为仇敌。

chapters.en: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns.
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，求你鉴察我，知道我的心思， 试炼我，知道我的意念，

chapters.en: See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.
chapters.zh: 看在我里面有什么恶行没有， 引导我走永生的道路。

chapters.en: Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你拯救我脱离凶恶的人， 保护我脱离强暴的人！

chapters.en: who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long.
chapters.zh: 他们心中图谋奸恶， 常常聚集要争战。

chapters.en: They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah
chapters.zh: 他们使舌头尖利如蛇， 嘴里有虺蛇的毒气。（细拉）

chapters.en: Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你拯救我脱离恶人的手， 保护我脱离强暴的人！ 他们图谋推我跌倒。

chapters.en:
The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path,
and lures are set out for me. Selah
chapters.zh: 骄傲人为我暗设网罗和绳索； 他们在路旁铺下网，设下圈套。（细拉）

chapters.en: I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.
chapters.zh: 我曾对耶和华说：你是我的上帝。 耶和华啊，求你留心听我恳求的声音！

chapters.en: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.
chapters.zh: 主－耶和华、我救恩的力量啊， 在争战的日子，你遮蔽了我的头。

chapters.en:
Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; do not promote their evil plans,
lest they be exalted. Selah
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要遂恶人的心愿； 不要成就他们的计谋，〔恐怕〕他们自高。（细拉）

chapters.en: May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.
chapters.zh: 至于那些昂首围困我的人， 愿他们嘴唇的奸恶陷害〔注：原文是遮蔽〕自己！

chapters.en:
May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire,
into the miry pits, never to rise again.
chapters.zh: 愿火炭落在他们身上！ 愿他们被丢在火中， 抛在深坑里，不能再起来。

chapters.en: May no slanderer be established in the land; may calamity hunt down the man of violence.
chapters.zh: 说恶言的人在地上必坚立不住； 祸患必猎取强暴的人，将他打倒。

chapters.en: I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.
chapters.zh: 我知道耶和华必为困苦人伸冤， 必为穷乏人辨屈。

chapters.en: Surely the righteous will praise Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.
chapters.zh: 义人必要称赞你的名； 正直人必住在你面前。

chapters.en: I call upon You, O LORD; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to You.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我曾求告你， 求你快快临到我这里！ 我求告你的时候， 愿你留心听我的声音！

chapters.en: May my prayer be set before You like incense; my uplifted hands, like the evening offering.
chapters.zh: 愿我的祷告如香陈列在你面前！ 愿我举手〔祈求〕，如献晚祭！

chapters.en: Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; keep watch at the door of my lips.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你禁止我的口， 把守我的嘴！

chapters.en: Do not let my heart be drawn to any evil thing or take part in works of wickedness with men who do iniquity; let me not feast on their delicacies.
chapters.zh: 求你不叫我的心偏向邪恶， 以致我和作孽的人同行恶事； 也不叫我吃他们的美食。

chapters.en: Let the righteous man strike me; let his rebuke be an act of loving devotion. It is oil for my head; let me not refuse it. For my prayer is ever against the deeds of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 任凭义人击打我，〔这算为〕仁慈； 任凭他责备我，〔这算为〕头上的膏油； 我的头不要躲闪。 正在他们行恶的时候，我仍要祈祷。

chapters.en:
When their rulers are thrown down from the cliffs, the people will listen to my words,
for they are pleasant.
chapters.zh: 他们的审判官被扔在巖下； 众人要听我的话，因为这话甘甜。

chapters.en: As when one plows and breaks up the soil, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
chapters.zh: 我们的骨头散在墓旁， 好像人耕田、刨地的土块。

chapters.en: But my eyes are fixed on You, O GOD the Lord. In You I seek refuge; do not leave my soul defenseless.
chapters.zh: 主－耶和华啊，我的眼目仰望你； 我投靠你，求你不要将我撇得孤苦！

chapters.en: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, and from the lures of evildoers.
chapters.zh: 求你保护我脱离恶人为我设的网罗 和作孽之人的圈套！

chapters.en: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.
chapters.zh: 愿恶人落在自己的网里， 我却得以逃脱。

chapters.en: I cry aloud to the LORD; I lift my voice to the LORD for mercy.
chapters.zh: 我发声哀告耶和华， 发声恳求耶和华。

chapters.en: I pour out my complaint before Him; I reveal my trouble to Him.
chapters.zh: 我在他面前吐露我的苦情， 陈说我的患难。

chapters.en: Although my spirit grows faint within me, You know my way. Along the path I travel they have hidden a snare for me.
chapters.zh: 我的灵在我里面发昏的时候， 你知道我的道路。 在我行的路上， 敌人为我暗设网罗。

chapters.en: Look to my right and see; no one attends to me. There is no refuge for me; no one cares for my soul.
chapters.zh: 求你向我右边观看， 因为没有人认识我； 我无处避难， 也没有人眷顾我。

chapters.en: I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我曾向你哀求。 我说：你是我的避难所； 在活人之地，你是我的福分。

chapters.en: Listen to my cry, for I am brought quite low. Rescue me from my pursuers, for they are too strong for me.
chapters.zh: 求你侧耳听我的呼求， 因我落到极卑之地； 求你救我脱离逼迫我的人， 因为他们比我强盛。

chapters.en: Free my soul from prison, that I may praise Your name. The righteous will gather around me because of Your goodness to me.
chapters.zh: 求你领我出离被囚之地， 我好称赞你的名。 义人必环绕我， 因为你是用厚恩待我。

chapters.en:
O LORD, hear my prayer. In Your faithfulness, give ear to my plea;
in Your righteousness, answer me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你听我的祷告， 留心听我的恳求， 凭你的信实和公义应允我。

chapters.en: Do not bring Your servant into judgment, for no one alive is righteous before You.
chapters.zh: 求你不要审问仆人； 因为在你面前，凡活着的人没有一个是义的。

chapters.en: For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushing my life to the ground, making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead.
chapters.zh: 原来仇敌逼迫我， 将我打倒在地， 使我住在幽暗之处， 像死了许久的人一样。

chapters.en: My spirit grows faint within me; my heart is dismayed inside me.
chapters.zh: 所以，我的灵在我里面发昏； 我的心在我里面悽惨。

chapters.en:
I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Your works;
I consider the work of Your hands.
chapters.zh: 我追想古时之日， 思想你的一切作为， 默念你手的工作。

chapters.en: I stretch out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You like a parched land. Selah
chapters.zh: 我向你举手； 我的心〔渴想〕你， 如干旱之地〔盼雨〕一样。（细拉）

chapters.en: Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你速速应允我！ 我心神耗尽！ 不要向我掩面， 免得我像那些下坑的人一样。

chapters.en: Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.
chapters.zh: 求你使我清晨得听你慈爱〔之言〕， 因我倚靠你； 求你使我知道当行的路， 因我的心仰望你。

chapters.en: Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD; I flee to You for refuge.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你救我脱离我的仇敌！ 我往你那里藏身。

chapters.en: Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God. May Your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
chapters.zh: 求你指教我遵行你的旨意， 因你是我的上帝。 你的灵本为善； 求你引我到平坦之地。

chapters.en: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, revive me. In Your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你为你的名将我救活， 凭你的公义，将我从患难中领出来，

chapters.en: And in Your loving devotion, cut off my enemies. Destroy all who afflict me, for I am Your servant.
chapters.zh: 凭你的慈爱剪除我的仇敌， 灭绝一切苦待我的人， 因我是你的仆人。

chapters.en:
Blessed be the LORD, my Rock, who trains my hands for war,
my fingers for battle.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－我的磐石是应当称颂的！ 他教导我的手争战， 教导我的指头打仗。

chapters.en: He is my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer. He is my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.
chapters.zh: 他是我慈爱〔的主〕，我的山寨， 我的高台，我的救主， 我的盾牌，是我所投靠的； 他使我的百姓服在我以下。

chapters.en: O LORD, what is man, that You regard him, the son of man that You think of him?
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，人算什么，你竟认识他！ 世人算什么，你竟顾念他！

chapters.en: Man is like a breath; his days are like a passing shadow.
chapters.zh: 人好像一口气； 他的年日如同影儿快快过去。

chapters.en: Part Your heavens, O LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, that they may smoke.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你使天下垂，亲自降临， 摸山，山就冒烟。

chapters.en: Flash forth Your lightning and scatter them; shoot Your arrows and rout them.
chapters.zh: 求你发出闪电，使他们四散， 射出你的箭，使他们扰乱。

chapters.en: Reach down from on high; set me free and rescue me from the deep waters, from the grasp of foreigners,
chapters.zh: 求你从上伸手救拔我， 救我出离大水， 救我脱离外邦人的手。

chapters.en: whose mouths speak falsehood, whose right hands are deceitful.
chapters.zh: 他们的口说谎话； 他们的右手起假誓。

chapters.en: I will sing to You a new song, O God; on a harp of ten strings I will make music to You—
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，我要向你唱新歌， 用十弦瑟向你歌颂。

chapters.en: to Him who gives victory to kings, who frees His servant David from the deadly sword.
chapters.zh: 你是那拯救君王的； 你是那救仆人大卫脱离害命之刀的。

chapters.en: Set me free and rescue me from the grasp of foreigners, whose mouths speak falsehood, whose right hands are deceitful.
chapters.zh: 求你救拔我， 救我脱离外邦人的手。 他们的口说谎话； 他们的右手起假誓。

chapters.en: Then our sons will be like plants nurtured in their youth, our daughters like corner pillars carved to adorn a palace.
chapters.zh: 我们的儿子从幼年好像树栽子长大； 我们的女儿如同殿角石， 是按建宫的样式凿成的。

chapters.en: Our storehouses will be full, supplying all manner of produce; our flocks will bring forth thousands, tens of thousands in our fields.
chapters.zh: 我们的仓盈满，能出各样的粮食； 我们的羊在田间孳生千万。

chapters.en: Our oxen will bear great loads. There will be no breach in the walls, no going into captivity, and no cry of lament in our streets.
chapters.zh: 我们的牛驮着满驮， 没有人闯进来〔抢夺〕， 也没有人出去〔争战〕； 我们的街市上也没有哭号的声音。

chapters.en: Blessed are the people of whom this is so; blessed are the people whose God is the LORD.
chapters.zh: 遇见这光景的百姓便为有福！ 有耶和华为他们的上帝，这百姓便为有福！

chapters.en: I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.
chapters.zh: 我的上帝我的王啊，我要尊崇你！ 我要永永远远称颂你的名！

chapters.en: Every day I will bless You, and I will praise Your name forever and ever.
chapters.zh: 我要天天称颂你， 也要永永远远赞美你的名！

chapters.en: Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; His greatness is unsearchable.
chapters.zh: 耶和华本为大，该受大赞美； 其大无法测度。

chapters.en: One generation will commend Your works to the next, and will proclaim Your mighty acts—
chapters.zh: 这代要对那代颂赞你的作为， 也要传扬你的大能。

chapters.en: the glorious splendor of Your majesty. And I will meditate on Your wondrous works.
chapters.zh: 我要默念你威严的尊荣 和你奇妙的作为。

chapters.en: They will proclaim the power of Your awesome deeds, and I will declare Your greatness.
chapters.zh: 人要传说你可畏之事的能力； 我也要传扬你的大德。

chapters.en: They will extol the fame of Your abundant goodness and sing joyfully of Your righteousness.
chapters.zh: 他们记念你的大恩就要传出来， 并要歌唱你的公义。

chapters.en: The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion.
chapters.zh: 耶和华有恩惠，有怜悯， 不轻易发怒，大有慈爱。

chapters.en: The LORD is good to all; His compassion rests on all He has made.
chapters.zh: 耶和华善待万民； 他的慈悲覆庇他一切所造的。

chapters.en: All You have made will give You thanks, O LORD, and Your saints will bless You.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你一切所造的都要称谢你； 你的圣民也要称颂你，

chapters.en: They will tell of the glory of Your kingdom and speak of Your might,
chapters.zh: 传说你国的荣耀， 谈论你的大能，

chapters.en: to make known to men Your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of Your kingdom.
chapters.zh: 好叫世人知道你大能的作为， 并你国度威严的荣耀。

chapters.en: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Your dominion endures through all generations. The LORD is faithful in all His words and kind in all His actions.
chapters.zh: 你的国是永远的国！ 你执掌的权柄存到万代！

chapters.en: The LORD upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.
chapters.zh: 凡跌倒的，耶和华将他们扶持； 凡被压下的，将他们扶起。

chapters.en: The eyes of all look to You, and You give them their food in season.
chapters.zh: 万民都举目仰望你； 你随时给他们食物。

chapters.en: You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
chapters.zh: 你张手， 使有生气的都随愿饱足。

chapters.en: The LORD is righteous in all His ways and kind in all His deeds.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在他一切所行的，无不公义； 在他一切所做的都有慈爱。

chapters.en: The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.
chapters.zh: 凡求告耶和华的，就是诚心求告他的， 耶和华便与他们相近。

chapters.en: He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him; He hears their cry and saves them.
chapters.zh: 敬畏他的，他必成就他们的心愿， 也必听他们的呼求，拯救他们。

chapters.en: The LORD preserves all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy.
chapters.zh: 耶和华保护一切爱他的人， 却要灭绝一切的恶人。

chapters.en:
My mouth will declare the praise of the LORD; let every creature bless His holy name
forever and ever.
chapters.zh: 我的口要说出赞美耶和华的话； 惟愿凡有血气的都永永远远称颂他的圣名。

chapters.en:
Hallelujah!
Praise the LORD, O my soul.
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 我的心哪，你要赞美耶和华！

chapters.en: I will praise the LORD all my life; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.
chapters.zh: 我一生要赞美耶和华！ 我还活的时候要歌颂我的上帝！

chapters.en: Put not your trust in princes, in mortal man, who cannot save.
chapters.zh: 你们不要倚靠君王，不要倚靠世人； 他一点不能帮助。

chapters.en: When his spirit departs, he returns to the ground; on that very day his plans perish.
chapters.zh: 他的气一断，就归回尘土； 他所打算的，当日就消灭了。

chapters.en: Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God,
chapters.zh: 以雅各的上帝为帮助、 仰望耶和华－他上帝的，这人便为有福！

chapters.en:
the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them.
He remains faithful forever.
chapters.zh: 耶和华造天、地、海，和其中的万物； 他守诚实，直到永远。

chapters.en: He executes justice for the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets the prisoners free,
chapters.zh: 他为受屈的伸冤， 赐食物与饥饿的。 耶和华释放被囚的；

chapters.en: the LORD opens the eyes of the blind, the LORD lifts those who are weighed down, the LORD loves the righteous.
chapters.zh: 耶和华开了瞎子的〔眼睛〕； 耶和华扶起被压下的人。 耶和华喜爱义人。

chapters.en:
The LORD protects foreigners; He sustains the fatherless and the widow,
but the ways of the wicked He frustrates.
chapters.zh: 耶和华保护寄居的， 扶持孤儿和寡妇， 却使恶人的道路弯曲。

chapters.en:
The LORD reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations.
Hallelujah!
chapters.zh: 耶和华要作王，直到永远！ 锡安哪，你的上帝要作王，直到万代！ 你们要赞美耶和华！

chapters.en:
Hallelujah!
How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and lovely to praise Him!
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 因歌颂我们的上帝为善为美； 赞美的话是合宜的。

chapters.en: The LORD builds up Jerusalem; He gathers the exiles of Israel.
chapters.zh: 耶和华建造耶路撒冷， 聚集以色列中被赶散的人。

chapters.en: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
chapters.zh: 他医好伤心的人， 裹好他们的伤处。

chapters.en: He determines the number of the stars; He calls them each by name.
chapters.zh: 他数点星宿的数目， 一一称它的名。

chapters.en: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding has no limit.
chapters.zh: 我们的主为大，最有能力； 他的智慧无法测度。

chapters.en: The LORD sustains the humble, but casts the wicked to the ground.
chapters.zh: 耶和华扶持谦卑人， 将恶人倾覆于地。

chapters.en: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; make music on the harp to our God,
chapters.zh: 你们要以感谢向耶和华歌唱， 用琴向我们的上帝歌颂。

chapters.en:
who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth,
who makes grass to grow on the hills.
chapters.zh: 他用云遮天，为地降雨， 使草生长在山上。

chapters.en: He provides food for the animals, and for the young ravens when they call.
chapters.zh: 他赐食给走兽 和啼叫的小乌鸦。

chapters.en: He does not delight in the strength of the horse; He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
chapters.zh: 他不喜悦马的力〔大〕， 不喜爱人的腿〔快〕。

chapters.en: The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him, who hope in His loving devotion.
chapters.zh: 耶和华喜爱敬畏他 和盼望他慈爱的人。

chapters.en: Exalt the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise your God, O Zion!
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，你要颂赞耶和华！ 锡安哪，你要赞美你的上帝！

chapters.en: For He strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses the children within you.
chapters.zh: 因为他坚固了你的门闩， 赐福给你中间的儿女。

chapters.en: He makes peace at your borders; He fills you with the finest wheat.
chapters.zh: 他使你境内平安， 用上好的麦子使你满足。

chapters.en: He sends forth His command to the earth; His word runs swiftly.
chapters.zh: 他发命在地； 他的话颁行最快。

chapters.en: He spreads the snow like wool; He scatters the frost like ashes;
chapters.zh: 他降雪如羊毛， 撒霜如炉灰。

chapters.en: He casts forth His hail like pebbles. Who can withstand His icy blast?
chapters.zh: 他掷下冰雹如碎渣； 他发出寒冷，谁能当得起呢？

chapters.en: He sends forth His word and melts them; He unleashes His winds, and the waters flow.
chapters.zh: 他一出令，这些就都消化； 他使风刮起，水便流动。

chapters.en: He declares His word to Jacob, His statutes and judgments to Israel.
chapters.zh: 他将他的道指示雅各， 将他的律例典章指示以色列。

chapters.en:
He has done this for no other nation; they do not know His judgments.
Hallelujah!
chapters.zh: 别国他都没有这样待过； 至于他的典章，他们向来没有知道。 你们要赞美耶和华！

chapters.en:
Hallelujah!
Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise Him in the highest places.
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 从天上赞美耶和华， 在高处赞美他！

chapters.en: Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His heavenly hosts.
chapters.zh: 他的众使者都要赞美他！ 他的诸军都要赞美他！

chapters.en: Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all you shining stars.
chapters.zh: 日头月亮，你们要赞美他！ 放光的星宿，你们都要赞美他！

chapters.en: Praise Him, O highest heavens, and you waters above the skies.
chapters.zh: 天上的天和天上的水， 你们都要赞美他！

chapters.en: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for He gave the command and they were created.
chapters.zh: 愿这些都赞美耶和华的名！ 因他一吩咐便都造成。

chapters.en: He established them forever and ever; He issued a decree that will never pass away.
chapters.zh: 他将这些立定，直到永永远远； 他定了命，不能废去〔注：或译：越过〕。

chapters.en: Praise the LORD from the earth, all great sea creatures and ocean depths,
chapters.zh: 所有在地上的， 大鱼和一切深洋，

chapters.en: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, powerful wind fulfilling His word,
chapters.zh: 火与冰雹，雪和雾气， 成就他命的狂风，

chapters.en: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
chapters.zh: 大山和小山， 结果的树木和一切香柏树，

chapters.en: wild animals and all cattle, crawling creatures and flying birds,
chapters.zh: 野兽和一切牲畜， 昆虫和飞鸟，

chapters.en: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all rulers of the earth,
chapters.zh: 世上的君王和万民， 首领和世上一切审判官，

chapters.en: young men and maidens, old and young together.
chapters.zh: 少年人和处女， 老年人和孩童， 都当赞美耶和华！

chapters.en:
Let them praise the name of the LORD, for His name alone is exalted;
His splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
chapters.zh: 愿这些都赞美耶和华的名！ 因为独有他的名被尊崇； 他的荣耀在天地之上。

chapters.en:
He has raised up a horn for His people, the praise of all His saints,
of Israel, a people near to Him.
Hallelujah!
chapters.zh: 他将他百姓的角高举， 因此他〔注：或译：他使〕一切圣民以色列人， 就是与他相近的百姓，都赞美他！ 你们要赞美耶和华！

chapters.en:
Hallelujah!
Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise in the assembly of the godly.
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 向耶和华唱新歌， 在圣民的会中赞美他！

chapters.en: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the children of Zion rejoice in their King.
chapters.zh: 愿以色列因造他的主欢喜！ 愿锡安的民因他们的王快乐！

chapters.en: Let them praise His name with dancing, and make music to Him with tambourine and harp.
chapters.zh: 愿他们跳舞赞美他的名， 击鼓弹琴歌颂他！

chapters.en: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the afflicted with salvation.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华喜爱他的百姓； 他要用救恩当作谦卑人的妆饰。

chapters.en: Let the saints exult in glory; let them shout for joy upon their beds.
chapters.zh: 愿圣民因〔所得的〕荣耀高兴！ 愿他们在床上欢呼！

chapters.en: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a double-edged sword in their hands,
chapters.zh: 愿他们口中称赞上帝为高， 手里有两刃的刀，

chapters.en: to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,
chapters.zh: 为要报复列邦， 刑罚万民。

chapters.en: to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with shackles of iron,
chapters.zh: 要用鍊子捆他们的君王， 用铁镣锁他们的大臣；

chapters.en:
to execute the judgment written against them. This honor is for all His saints.
Hallelujah!
chapters.zh: 要在他们身上施行所记录的审判。 他的圣民都有这荣耀。 你们要赞美耶和华！

chapters.en:
Hallelujah!
Praise God in His sanctuary. Praise Him in His mighty heavens.
chapters.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 在上帝的圣所赞美他！ 在他显能力的穹苍赞美他！

chapters.en: Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him for His excellent greatness.
chapters.zh: 要因他大能的作为赞美他， 按着他极美的大德赞美他！

chapters.en: Praise Him with the sound of the horn; praise Him with the harp and lyre.
chapters.zh: 要用角声赞美他， 鼓瑟弹琴赞美他！

chapters.en: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; praise Him with strings and flute.
chapters.zh: 击鼓跳舞赞美他！ 用丝弦的乐器和箫〔的声音〕赞美他！

chapters.en: Praise Him with clashing cymbals; praise Him with resounding cymbals.
chapters.zh: 用大响的钹赞美他！ 用高声的钹赞美他！

chapters.en:
Let everything that has breath praise the LORD!
Hallelujah!
chapters.zh: 凡有气息的都要赞美耶和华！ 你们要赞美耶和华！

chapters.en: These are the proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel,
chapters.zh: 以色列王大卫儿子所罗门的箴言：

chapters.en: for gaining wisdom and discipline, for comprehending words of insight,
chapters.zh: 要使人晓得智慧和训诲， 分辨通达的言语，

chapters.en: and for receiving instruction in wise living and in righteousness, justice, and equity.
chapters.zh: 使人处事领受智慧、 仁义、公平、正直的训诲，

chapters.en: To impart prudence to the simple and knowledge and discretion to the young,
chapters.zh: 使愚人灵明， 使少年人有知识和谋略，

chapters.en: let the wise listen and gain instruction, and the discerning acquire wise counsel
chapters.zh: 使智慧人听见，增长学问， 使聪明人得着智谋，

chapters.en: by understanding the proverbs and parables, the sayings and riddles of the wise.
chapters.zh: 使人明白箴言和譬喻， 懂得智慧人的言词和谜语。

chapters.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.
chapters.zh: 敬畏耶和华是知识的开端； 愚妄人藐视智慧和训诲。

chapters.en: Listen, my son, to your father’s instruction, and do not forsake the teaching of your mother.
chapters.zh: 我儿，要听你父亲的训诲， 不可离弃你母亲的法则〔注：或译：指教〕；

chapters.en: For they are a garland of grace on your head and a pendant around your neck.
chapters.zh: 因为这要作你头上的华冠， 你项上的〔金〕鍊。

chapters.en: My son, if sinners entice you, do not yield to them.
chapters.zh: 我儿，恶人若引诱你， 你不可随从。

chapters.en: If they say, “Come along, let us lie in wait for blood, let us ambush the innocent without cause,
chapters.zh: 他们若说：你与我们同去， 我们要埋伏流人之血， 要蹲伏害无罪之人；

chapters.en: let us swallow them alive like Sheol, and whole like those descending into the Pit.
chapters.zh: 我们好像阴间，把他们活活吞下； 他们如同下坑的人， 被我们囫囵吞了；

chapters.en: We will find all manner of precious goods; we will fill our houses with plunder.
chapters.zh: 我们必得各样宝物， 将所掳来的，装满房屋；

chapters.en: Throw in your lot with us; let us all share one purse”—
chapters.zh: 你与我们大家同分， 我们共用一个囊袋；

chapters.en: my son, do not walk the road with them or set foot upon their path.
chapters.zh: 我儿，不要与他们同行一道， 禁止你脚走他们的路。

chapters.en: For their feet run to evil, and they are swift to shed blood.
chapters.zh: 因为，他们的脚奔跑行恶； 他们急速流人的血，

chapters.en: How futile it is to spread the net where any bird can see it!
chapters.zh: 好像飞鸟， 网罗设在眼前仍不躲避。

chapters.en: But they lie in wait for their own blood; they ambush their own lives.
chapters.zh: 这些人埋伏，是为自流己血； 蹲伏，是为自害己命。

chapters.en: Such is the fate of all who are greedy, whose unjust gain takes the lives of its possessors.
chapters.zh: 凡贪恋财利的，所行之路都是如此； 这贪恋之心乃夺去得财者之命。

chapters.en: Wisdom calls out in the street, she lifts her voice in the square;
chapters.zh: 智慧在街市上呼喊， 在宽阔处发声，

chapters.en: in the main concourse she cries aloud, at the city gates she makes her speech:
chapters.zh: 在热闹街头喊叫， 在城门口，在城中发出言语，

chapters.en:
“How long, O simple ones, will you love your simple ways? How long will scoffers delight in their scorn
and fools hate knowledge?
chapters.zh: 说：你们愚昧人喜爱愚昧， 亵慢人喜欢亵慢， 愚顽人恨恶知识，要到几时呢？

chapters.en:
If you had repented at my rebuke, then surely I would have poured out my spirit on you;
I would have made my words known to you.
chapters.zh: 你们当因我的责备回转； 我要将我的灵浇灌你们， 将我的话指示你们。

chapters.en: Because you refused my call, and no one took my outstretched hand,
chapters.zh: 我呼唤，你们不肯听从； 我伸手，无人理会；

chapters.en: because you neglected all my counsel, and wanted none of my correction,
chapters.zh: 反轻弃我一切的劝戒， 不肯受我的责备。

chapters.en: in turn I will mock your calamity; I will sneer when terror strikes you,
chapters.zh: 你们遭灾难，我就发笑； 惊恐临到你们，我必嗤笑。

chapters.en:
when your dread comes like a storm, and your destruction like a whirlwind,
when distress and anguish overwhelm you.
chapters.zh: 惊恐临到你们，好像狂风； 灾难来到，如同暴风； 急难痛苦临到你们身上。

chapters.en: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer; they will earnestly seek me, but will not find me.
chapters.zh: 那时，你们必呼求我，我却不答应， 恳切地寻找我，却寻不见。

chapters.en: For they hated knowledge and chose not to fear the LORD.
chapters.zh: 因为，你们恨恶知识， 不喜爱敬畏耶和华，

chapters.en: They accepted none of my counsel; they despised all my reproof.
chapters.zh: 不听我的劝戒， 藐视我一切的责备，

chapters.en: So they will eat the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
chapters.zh: 所以必吃自结的果子， 充满自设的计谋。

chapters.en: For the waywardness of the simple will slay them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them.
chapters.zh: 愚昧人背道，必杀己身； 愚顽人安逸，必害己命。

chapters.en: But whoever listens to me will dwell in safety, secure from the fear of evil.”
chapters.zh: 惟有听从我的，必安然居住， 得享安静，不怕灾祸。

chapters.en: My son, if you accept my words and hide my commandments within you,
chapters.zh: 我儿，你若领受我的言语， 存记我的命令，

chapters.en: if you incline your ear to wisdom and direct your heart to understanding,
chapters.zh: 侧耳听智慧， 专心求聪明，

chapters.en: if you truly call out to insight and lift your voice to understanding,
chapters.zh: 呼求明哲， 扬声求聪明，

chapters.en: if you seek it like silver and search it out like hidden treasure,
chapters.zh: 寻找它，如寻找银子， 搜求它，如搜求隐藏的珍宝，

chapters.en: then you will discern the fear of the LORD and discover the knowledge of God.
chapters.zh: 你就明白敬畏耶和华， 得以认识上帝。

chapters.en: For the LORD gives wisdom; from His mouth come knowledge and understanding.
chapters.zh: 因为，耶和华赐人智慧； 知识和聪明都由他口而出。

chapters.en: He stores up sound wisdom for the upright; He is a shield to those who walk with integrity,
chapters.zh: 他给正直人存留真智慧， 给行为纯正的人作盾牌，

chapters.en: to guard the paths of justice and protect the way of His saints.
chapters.zh: 为要保守公平人的路， 护庇虔敬人的道。

chapters.en: Then you will discern righteousness and justice and equity—every good path.
chapters.zh: 你也必明白仁义、公平、 正直、一切的善道。

chapters.en: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will delight your soul.
chapters.zh: 智慧必入你心； 你的灵要以知识为美。

chapters.en: Discretion will watch over you, and understanding will guard you,
chapters.zh: 谋略必护卫你； 聪明必保守你，

chapters.en: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the man who speaks perversity,
chapters.zh: 要救你脱离恶道〔注：或译：恶人的道〕， 脱离说乖谬话的人。

chapters.en: from those who leave the straight paths to walk in the ways of darkness,
chapters.zh: 那等人舍弃正直的路， 行走黑暗的道，

chapters.en: from those who enjoy doing evil and rejoice in the twistedness of evil,
chapters.zh: 欢喜作恶， 喜爱恶〔人〕的乖僻，

chapters.en: whose paths are crooked and whose ways are devious.
chapters.zh: 在他们的道中弯曲， 在他们的路上偏僻。

chapters.en: It will rescue you from the forbidden woman, from the stranger with seductive words
chapters.zh: 智〔慧〕要救你脱离淫妇， 就是那油嘴滑舌的外女。

chapters.en: who abandons the partner of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.
chapters.zh: 她离弃幼年的配偶， 忘了上帝的盟约。

chapters.en: For her house sinks down to death, and her tracks to the departed spirits.
chapters.zh: 她的家陷入死地； 她的路偏向阴间。

chapters.en: None who go to her return or negotiate the paths of life.
chapters.zh: 凡到她那里去的，不得转回， 也得不着生命的路。

chapters.en: So you will follow in the ways of the good, and keep to the paths of the righteous.
chapters.zh: 〔智慧〕必使你行善人的道， 守义人的路。

chapters.en: For the upright will inhabit the land, and the blameless will remain in it;
chapters.zh: 正直人必在世上居住； 完全人必在地上存留。

chapters.en: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful will be uprooted.
chapters.zh: 惟有恶人必然剪除； 奸诈的，必然拔出。

chapters.en: My son, do not forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments;
chapters.zh: 我儿，不要忘记我的法则〔注：或译：指教〕； 你心要谨守我的诫命；

chapters.en: for they will add length to your days, years and peace to your life.
chapters.zh: 因为它必将长久的日子， 生命的年数与平安，加给你。

chapters.en:
Never let loving devotion or faithfulness leave you; bind them around your neck,
write them on the tablet of your heart.
chapters.zh: 不可使慈爱、诚实离开你， 要系在你颈项上，刻在你心版上。

chapters.en: Then you will find favor and high regard in the sight of God and man.
chapters.zh: 这样，你必在上帝和世人眼前 蒙恩宠，有聪明。

chapters.en: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding;
chapters.zh: 你要专心仰赖耶和华， 不可倚靠自己的聪明，

chapters.en: in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.
chapters.zh: 在你一切所行的事上都要认定他， 他必指引你的路。

chapters.en: Be not wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and turn away from evil.
chapters.zh: 不要自以为有智慧； 要敬畏耶和华，远离恶事。

chapters.en: This will bring healing to your body and refreshment to your bones.
chapters.zh: 这便医治你的肚脐， 滋润你的百骨。

chapters.en: Honor the LORD with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your crops;
chapters.zh: 你要以财物 和一切初熟的土产尊荣耶和华。

chapters.en: then your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
chapters.zh: 这样，你的仓房必充满有余； 你的酒醡有新酒盈溢。

chapters.en: My son, do not reject the discipline of the LORD, and do not loathe His rebuke;
chapters.zh: 我儿，你不可轻看耶和华的管教〔注：或译：惩治〕， 也不可厌烦他的责备；

chapters.en: for the LORD disciplines the one He loves, as does a father the son in whom he delights.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华所爱的，他必责备， 正如父亲责备所喜爱的儿子。

chapters.en: Blessed is the man who finds wisdom, the man who acquires understanding,
chapters.zh: 得智慧，得聪明的， 这人便为有福。

chapters.en: for she is more profitable than silver, and her gain is better than fine gold.
chapters.zh: 因为得智慧胜过得银子， 其利益强如精金，

chapters.en: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire compares with her.
chapters.zh: 比珍珠〔注：或译：红宝石〕宝贵； 你一切所喜爱的，都不足与比较。
