like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我这样说： 我要安静，在我的居所观看， 如同日光中的清热， 又如露水的云雾在收割的热天。

chapters.en: For before the harvest, when the blossom is gone and the flower becomes a ripening grape, He will cut off the shoots with a pruning knife and remove and discard the branches.
chapters.zh: 收割之先，花开已谢， 花也成了将熟的葡萄； 他必用镰刀削去嫩枝， 又砍掉蔓延的枝条，

chapters.en: They will all be left to the mountain birds of prey, and to the beasts of the land. The birds will feed on them in summer, and all the wild animals in winter.
chapters.zh: 都要撇给山间的鸷鸟和地上的野兽。 夏天，鸷鸟要宿在其上； 冬天，野兽都卧在其中。

chapters.en:
At that time gifts will be brought to the LORD of Hosts— from a people tall and smooth-skinned, from a people widely feared, from a powerful nation of strange speech, whose land is divided by rivers—
to Mount Zion, the place of the Name of the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 到那时，这高大光滑的民， 就是从开国以来极其可畏、 分〔地界〕践踏〔人〕的， 他们的地有江河分开； 他们必将礼物奉给万军之耶和华， 就是奉到锡安山－ 耶和华安置他名的地方。

chapters.en:
This is the burden against Egypt:
Behold, the LORD rides on a swift cloud; He is coming to Egypt. The idols of Egypt will tremble before Him, and the hearts of the Egyptians will melt within them.
chapters.zh: 论埃及的默示： 看哪，耶和华乘驾快云， 临到埃及。 埃及的偶像在他面前战兢； 埃及人的心在里面消化。

chapters.en:
“So I will incite Egyptian against Egyptian; brother will fight against brother, neighbor against neighbor,
city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.
chapters.zh: 我必激动埃及人攻击埃及人－ 弟兄攻击弟兄， 邻舍攻击邻舍； 这城攻击那城， 这国攻击那国。

chapters.en: Then the spirit of the Egyptians will be emptied out from among them, and I will frustrate their plans, so that they will resort to idols and spirits of the dead, to mediums and spiritists.
chapters.zh: 埃及人的心神必在里面耗尽； 我必败坏他们的谋略。 他们必求问偶像和念咒的、 交鬼的、行巫术的。

chapters.en: I will deliver the Egyptians into the hands of a harsh master, and a fierce king will rule over them,” declares the Lord GOD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 我必将埃及人交在残忍主的手中； 强暴王必辖制他们。 这是主－万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: The waters of the Nile will dry up, and the riverbed will be parched and empty.
chapters.zh: 海中的水必绝尽， 河也消没干涸。

chapters.en:
The canals will stink; the streams of Egypt will trickle and dry up;
the reeds and rushes will wither.
chapters.zh: 江河要变臭； 埃及的河水都必减少枯干。 苇子和芦荻都必衰残；

chapters.en: The bulrushes by the Nile, by the mouth of the river, and all the fields sown along the Nile, will wither, blow away, and be no more.
chapters.zh: 靠尼罗河旁的草田， 并沿尼罗河所种的田，都必枯干。 〔庄稼〕被〔风〕吹去，归于无有。

chapters.en:
Then the fishermen will mourn, all who cast a hook into the Nile will lament,
and those who spread nets on the waters will pine away.
chapters.zh: 打鱼的必哀哭。 在尼罗河一切钓鱼的必悲伤； 在水上撒网的必都衰弱。

chapters.en: The workers in flax will be dismayed, and the weavers of fine linen will turn pale.
chapters.zh: 用梳好的麻造物的 和织白布的都必羞愧；

chapters.en: The workers in cloth will be dejected, and all the hired workers will be sick at heart.
chapters.zh: 国柱必被打碎， 所有佣工的，心必愁烦。

chapters.en:
The princes of Zoan are mere fools; Pharaoh’s wise counselors give senseless advice. How can you say to Pharaoh, “I am one of the wise,
a son of eastern kings”?
chapters.zh: 琐安的首领极其愚昧； 法老大有智慧的谋士， 所筹划的成为愚谋。 你们怎敢对法老说： 我是智慧人的子孙， 我是古王的后裔？

chapters.en:
Where are your wise men now? Let them tell you and reveal
what the LORD of Hosts has planned against Egypt.
chapters.zh: 你的智慧人在哪里呢？ 万军之耶和华向埃及所定的旨意， 他们可以知道，可以告诉你吧！

chapters.en: The princes of Zoan have become fools; the princes of Memphis are deceived. The cornerstones of her tribes have led Egypt astray.
chapters.zh: 琐安的首领都变为愚昧； 挪弗的首领都受了迷惑。 当埃及支派房角石的， 使埃及人走错了路。

chapters.en: The LORD has poured into her a spirit of confusion. Egypt has been led astray in all she does, as a drunkard staggers through his own vomit.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使乖谬的灵搀入埃及中间； 首领使埃及一切所做的都有差错， 好像醉酒之人呕吐的时候东倒西歪一样。

chapters.en: There is nothing Egypt can do— head or tail, palm or reed.
chapters.zh: 埃及中，无论是头与尾， 棕枝与芦苇，所做之工都不成就。

chapters.en: In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will tremble with fear beneath the uplifted hand of the LORD of Hosts, when He brandishes it against them.
chapters.zh: 到那日，埃及人必像妇人一样，他们必因万军之耶和华在埃及以上所抡的手，战兢惧怕。

chapters.en: The land of Judah will bring terror to Egypt; whenever Judah is mentioned, Egypt will tremble over what the LORD of Hosts has planned against it.
chapters.zh: 犹大地必使埃及惊恐，向谁提起犹大地，谁就惧怕。这是因万军之耶和华向埃及所定的旨意。

chapters.en: In that day five cities in the land of Egypt will speak the language of Canaan and swear allegiance to the LORD of Hosts. One of them will be called the City of the Sun.
chapters.zh: 当那日，埃及地必有五城的人说迦南的方言，又指着万军之耶和华起誓。有一城必称为「灭亡城」。

chapters.en: In that day there will be an altar to the LORD in the center of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the LORD near her border.
chapters.zh: 当那日，在埃及地中必有为耶和华筑的一座坛；在埃及的边界上必有为耶和华〔立〕的一根柱。

chapters.en: It will be a sign and a witness to the LORD of Hosts in the land of Egypt. When they cry out to the LORD because of their oppressors, He will send them a savior and defender to rescue them.
chapters.zh: 这都要在埃及地为万军之耶和华作记号和证据。埃及人因为受人的欺压哀求耶和华，他就差遣一位救主作护卫者，拯救他们。

chapters.en: The LORD will make Himself known to Egypt, and on that day Egypt will acknowledge the LORD. They will worship with sacrifices and offerings; they will make vows to the LORD and fulfill them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必被埃及人所认识。在那日，埃及人必认识耶和华，也要献祭物和供物敬拜他，并向耶和华许愿还愿。

chapters.en: And the LORD will strike Egypt with a plague; He will strike them but heal them. They will turn to the LORD, and He will hear their prayers and heal them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必击打埃及，又击打又医治，埃及人就归向耶和华。他必应允他们的祷告，医治他们。

chapters.en: In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria. The Assyrians will go to Egypt, and the Egyptians to Assyria. The Egyptians and Assyrians will worship together.
chapters.zh: 当那日，必有从埃及通亚述去的大道。亚述人要进入埃及，埃及人也进入亚述；埃及人要与亚述人一同敬拜〔耶和华〕。

chapters.en: In that day Israel will join a three-party alliance with Egypt and Assyria—a blessing upon the earth.
chapters.zh: 当那日，以色列必与埃及、亚述三国一律，使地上的人得福；

chapters.en: The LORD of Hosts will bless them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt My people, Assyria My handiwork, and Israel My inheritance.”
chapters.zh: 因为万军之耶和华赐福给他们，说：「埃及－我的百姓，亚述－我手的工作，以色列－我的产业，都有福了！」

chapters.en: Before the year that the chief commander, sent by Sargon king of Assyria, came to Ashdod and attacked and captured it,
chapters.zh: 亚述王撒珥根打发他珥探到亚实突的那年，他珥探就攻打亚实突，将城攻取。

chapters.en:
the LORD had already spoken through Isaiah son of Amoz, saying, “Go, remove the sackcloth from your waist and the sandals from your feet.”
And Isaiah did so, walking around naked and barefoot.
chapters.zh: 那时，耶和华晓谕亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚说：「你去解掉你腰间的麻布，脱下你脚上的鞋。」以赛亚就这样做，露身赤脚行走。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said, “Just as My servant Isaiah has gone naked and barefoot for three years as a sign and omen against Egypt and Cush,
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我仆人以赛亚怎样露身赤脚行走三年，作为关乎埃及和古实的预兆奇迹。

chapters.en: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Cush, young and old alike, naked and barefoot, with bared buttocks—to Egypt’s shame.
chapters.zh: 照样，亚述王也必掳去埃及人，掠去古实人，无论老少，都露身赤脚，现出下体，使埃及蒙羞。

chapters.en: Those who made Cush their hope and Egypt their boast will be dismayed and ashamed.
chapters.zh: 以色列人必因所仰望的古实，所夸耀的埃及，惊惶羞愧。

chapters.en: And on that day the dwellers of this coastland will say, ‘See what has happened to our source of hope, those to whom we fled for help and deliverance from the king of Assyria! How then can we escape?’”
chapters.zh: 「那时，这沿海一带的居民必说：『看哪，我们素所仰望的，就是我们为脱离亚述王逃往求救的，不过是如此！我们怎能逃脱呢？』」

chapters.en:
This is the burden against the Desert by the Sea:
Like whirlwinds sweeping through the Negev, an invader comes from the desert,
from a land of terror.
chapters.zh: 论海旁旷野的默示： 有〔仇敌〕从旷野，从可怕之地而来， 好像南方的旋风，猛然扫过。

chapters.en:
A dire vision is declared to me: “The traitor still betrays,
and the destroyer still destroys. Go up, O Elam! Lay siege, O Media! I will put an end to all her groaning.”
chapters.zh: 令人悽惨的异象已默示于我。 诡诈的行诡诈，毁灭的行毁灭。 以拦哪，你要上去！ 米底亚啊，你要围困！ 〔主说〕：我使一切叹息止住。

chapters.en: Therefore my body is filled with anguish. Pain grips me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am bewildered to hear, I am dismayed to see.
chapters.zh: 所以，我满腰疼痛； 痛苦将我抓住， 好像产难的妇人一样。 我疼痛甚至不能听； 我惊惶甚至不能看。

chapters.en: My heart falters; fear makes me tremble. The twilight I desired has turned to horror.
chapters.zh: 我心慌张，惊恐威吓我。 我所羨慕的黄昏，变为我的战兢。

chapters.en:
They prepare a table, they lay out a carpet, they eat, they drink!
Rise up, O princes, oil the shields!
chapters.zh: 他们摆设筵席， 派人守望，又吃又喝。 首领啊，你们起来， 用油抹盾牌。

chapters.en:
For this is what the Lord says to me:
“Go, post a lookout and have him report what he sees.
chapters.zh: 主对我如此说： 你去设立守望的， 使他将所看见的述说。

chapters.en:
When he sees chariots with teams of horsemen, riders on donkeys, riders on camels,
he must be alert, fully alert.”
chapters.zh: 他看见军队， 就是骑马的一对一对地来， 又看见驴队，骆驼队， 就要侧耳细听。

chapters.en:
Then the lookout shouted:
“Day after day, my lord, I stand on the watchtower; night after night I stay at my post.
chapters.zh: 他像狮子吼叫，〔说〕： 主啊，我白日常站在望楼上， 整夜立在我守望所。

chapters.en:
Look, here come the riders, horsemen in pairs.”
And one answered, saying:
“Fallen, fallen is Babylon! All the images of her gods
lie shattered on the ground!”
chapters.zh: 看哪，有一队军兵骑着马， 一对一对地来。 他就说：巴比伦倾倒了！倾倒了！ 他一切雕刻的神像都打碎于地。

chapters.en: O my people, crushed on the threshing floor, I tell you what I have heard from the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 我被打的禾稼，我场上的谷啊， 我从万军之耶和华－ 以色列的上帝那里所听见的，都告诉你们了。

chapters.en:
This is the burden against Dumah:
One calls to me from Seir, “Watchman, what is left of the night?
Watchman, what is left of the night?”
chapters.zh: 论度玛的默示： 有人声从西珥呼问我〔说〕： 守望的啊，夜里如何？ 守望的啊，夜里如何？

chapters.en: The watchman replies, “Morning has come, but also the night. If you would inquire, then inquire. Come back yet again.”
chapters.zh: 守望的说： 早晨将到，黑夜也来。 你们若要问就可以问， 可以回头再来。

chapters.en:
This is the burden against Arabia:
In the thickets of Arabia you must lodge, O caravans of Dedanites.
chapters.zh: 论阿拉伯的默示： 底但结伴的客旅啊， 你们必在阿拉伯的树林中住宿。

chapters.en:
Bring water for the thirsty, O dwellers of Tema;
meet the refugees with food.
chapters.zh: 提玛地的居民拿水来，送给口渴的， 拿饼来迎接逃避的。

chapters.en: For they flee from the sword— the sword that is drawn— from the bow that is bent, and from the stress of battle.
chapters.zh: 因为他们逃避刀剑和出了鞘的刀， 并上了弦的弓与刀兵的重灾。

chapters.en: For this is what the Lord says to me: “Within one year, as a hired worker would count it, all the glory of Kedar will be gone.
chapters.zh: 主对我这样说：「一年之内，照雇工的年数，基达的一切荣耀必归于无有。

chapters.en:
The remaining archers, the warriors of Kedar, will be few.”
For the LORD, the God of Israel, has spoken.
chapters.zh: 弓箭手所余剩的，就是基达人的勇士，必然稀少，因为这是耶和华－以色列的上帝说的。」

chapters.en:
This is the burden against the Valley of Vision:
What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the rooftops,
chapters.zh: 论异象谷的默示： 有什么事使你这〔满城的人〕都上房顶呢？

chapters.en:
O city of commotion, O town of revelry?
Your slain did not die by the sword, nor were they killed in battle.
chapters.zh: 你这满处吶喊、大有喧哗的城， 欢乐的邑啊， 你中间被杀的并不是被刀杀， 也不是因打仗死亡。

chapters.en: All your rulers have fled together, captured without a bow. All your fugitives were captured together, having fled to a distant place.
chapters.zh: 你所有的官长一同逃跑， 都为弓箭手所捆绑。 你中间一切被找到的都一同被捆绑； 他们本是逃往远方的。

chapters.en: Therefore I said, “Turn away from me, let me weep bitterly! Do not try to console me over the destruction of the daughter of my people.”
chapters.zh: 所以我说：你们转眼不看我， 我要痛哭。 不要因我众民〔注：原文是民女〕的毁灭， 就竭力安慰我。

chapters.en: For the Lord GOD of Hosts has set a day of tumult and trampling and confusion in the Valley of Vision— of breaking down the walls and crying to the mountains.
chapters.zh: 因为主－万军之耶和华使「异象谷」 有溃乱、践踏、烦扰的日子。 城被攻破， 哀声达到山间。

chapters.en: Elam takes up a quiver, with chariots and horsemen, and Kir uncovers the shield.
chapters.zh: 以拦带着箭袋， 还有坐战车的和马兵； 吉珥揭开盾牌。

chapters.en: Your choicest valleys are full of chariots, and horsemen are posted at the gates.
chapters.zh: 你嘉美的谷遍满战车， 也有马兵在城门前排列。

chapters.en:
He has uncovered the defenses of Judah.
On that day you looked to the weapons in the House of the Forest.
chapters.zh: 他去掉犹大的遮盖。 那日，你就仰望林库内的军器。

chapters.en: You saw that there were many breaches in the walls of the City of David. You collected water from the lower pool.
chapters.zh: 你们看见大卫城的破口很多，便聚积下池的水，

chapters.en: You counted the houses of Jerusalem and tore them down to strengthen the wall.
chapters.zh: 又数点耶路撒冷的房屋，将房屋拆毁，修补城墙，

chapters.en: You built a reservoir between the walls for the waters of the ancient pool, but you did not look to the One who made it, or consider Him who planned it long ago.
chapters.zh: 又在两道城墙中间挖一个聚水池可盛旧池的水，却不仰望做这事的主，也不顾念从古定这事的。

chapters.en: On that day the Lord GOD of Hosts called for weeping and wailing, for shaven heads and the wearing of sackcloth.
chapters.zh: 当那日，主－万军之耶和华叫人哭泣哀号， 头上光秃，身披麻布。

chapters.en: But look, there is joy and gladness, butchering of cattle and slaughtering of sheep, eating of meat and drinking of wine: “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die!”
chapters.zh: 谁知，人倒欢喜快乐， 宰牛杀羊，吃肉喝酒，〔说〕： 我们吃喝吧！因为明天要死了。

chapters.en:
The LORD of Hosts has revealed in my hearing:
“Until your dying day, this sin of yours will never be atoned for,” says the Lord GOD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华亲自默示我〔说〕： 这罪孽直到你们死，断不得赦免！ 这是主－万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is what the Lord GOD of Hosts says: “Go, say to Shebna, the steward in charge of the palace:
chapters.zh: 主－万军之耶和华这样说：「你去见掌银库的，就是家宰舍伯那，〔对他说〕：

chapters.en: What are you doing here, and who authorized you to carve out a tomb for yourself here—to chisel your tomb in the height and cut your resting place in the rock?
chapters.zh: 『你在这里做什么呢？有什么人竟在这里凿坟墓，就是在高处为自己凿坟墓，在磐石中为自己凿出安身之所？

chapters.en: Look, O mighty man! The LORD is about to shake you violently. He will take hold of you,
chapters.zh: 看哪，耶和华必像〔大有力的〕人，将你紧紧缠裹，竭力抛去。

chapters.en: roll you into a ball, and sling you into a wide land. There you will die, and there your glorious chariots will remain—a disgrace to the house of your master.
chapters.zh: 他必将你滚成一团，〔抛〕在宽阔之地，好像抛球一样。你这主人家的羞辱，必在那里坐你荣耀的车，也必在那里死亡。

chapters.en: I will remove you from office, and you will be ousted from your position.
chapters.zh: 我必赶逐你离开官职；你必从你的原位撤下。』

chapters.en: On that day I will summon My servant, Eliakim son of Hilkiah.
chapters.zh: 「到那日，我必召我仆人希勒家的儿子以利亚敬来，

chapters.en: I will clothe him with your robe and tie your sash around him. I will put your authority in his hand, and he will be a father to the dwellers of Jerusalem and to the house of Judah.
chapters.zh: 将你的外袍给他穿上，将你的腰带给他系紧，将你的政权交在他手中。他必作耶路撒冷居民和犹大家的父。

chapters.en: I will place on his shoulder the key to the house of David. What he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.
chapters.zh: 我必将大卫家的钥匙放在他肩头上。他开，无人能关；他关，无人能开。

chapters.en: I will drive him like a peg into a firm place, and he will be a throne of glory for the house of his father.
chapters.zh: 我必将他〔安稳〕，像钉子钉在坚固处；他必作为他父家荣耀的宝座。

chapters.en: So they will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house: the descendants and the offshoots—all the lesser vessels, from bowls to every kind of jar.
chapters.zh: 他父家所有的荣耀，连儿女带子孙，都挂在他身上，好像一切小器皿，从杯子到酒瓶挂上一样。

chapters.en:
In that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, the peg driven into a firm place will give way; it will be sheared off and fall, and the load upon it will be cut down.”
Indeed, the LORD has spoken.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说：当那日，钉在坚固处的钉子必压斜，被砍断落地；挂在其上的重担必被剪断。因为这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en:
This is the burden against Tyre:
Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for Tyre is laid waste,
without house or harbor. Word has reached them from the land of Cyprus.
chapters.zh: 论泰尔的默示： 他施的船只都要哀号； 因为泰尔变为荒场， 甚至没有房屋，没有可进之路。 这消息是从基提地得来的。

chapters.en:
Be silent, O dwellers of the coastland, you merchants of Sidon,
whose traders have crossed the sea.
chapters.zh: 沿海的居民， 就是素来靠航海西顿的商家得丰盛的， 你们当静默无言。

chapters.en: On the great waters came the grain of Shihor; the harvest of the Nile was the revenue of Tyre; she was the merchant of the nations.
chapters.zh: 在大水之上， 西曷的粮食、 尼罗河的庄稼是泰尔的进项； 她作列国的大码头。

chapters.en: Be ashamed, O Sidon, the stronghold of the sea, for the sea has spoken: “I have not been in labor or given birth. I have not raised young men or brought up young women.”
chapters.zh: 西顿哪，你当惭愧； 因为大海说， 就是海中的保障说： 我没有劬劳，也没有生产， 没有养育男子，也没有抚养童女。

chapters.en: When the report reaches Egypt, they will writhe in agony over the news of Tyre.
chapters.zh: 这风声传到埃及； 埃及人为泰尔的风声极其疼痛。

chapters.en: Cross over to Tarshish; wail, O inhabitants of the coastland!
chapters.zh: 泰尔人哪，你们当过到他施去； 沿海的居民哪，你们都当哀号。

chapters.en: Is this your jubilant city, whose origin is from antiquity, whose feet have taken her to settle far away?
chapters.zh: 这是你们欢乐的城， 从上古而有的吗？ 其中的居民往远方寄居。

chapters.en: Who planned this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, whose traders are princes, whose merchants are renowned on the earth?
chapters.zh: 泰尔本是赐冠冕的。 她的商家是王子； 她的买卖人是世上的尊贵人。 遭遇如此是谁定的呢？

chapters.en:
The LORD of Hosts planned it, to defile all its glorious beauty,
to disgrace all the renowned of the earth.
chapters.zh: 是万军之耶和华所定的！ 为要污辱一切高傲的荣耀， 使地上一切的尊贵人被藐视。

chapters.en: Cultivate your land like the Nile, O Daughter of Tarshish; there is no longer a harbor.
chapters.zh: 他施的民〔注：原文是女〕哪， 可以流行你的地，好像尼罗河； 不再有腰带拘紧你。

chapters.en: The LORD has stretched out His hand over the sea; He has made kingdoms tremble. He has given a command that the strongholds of Canaan be destroyed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华已经向海伸手， 震动列国。 至于迦南， 他已经吩咐拆毁其中的保障。

chapters.en: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, O oppressed Virgin Daughter of Sidon. Get up and cross over to Cyprus— even there you will find no rest.”
chapters.zh: 他又说：受欺压西顿的居民〔注：原文是处女〕哪， 你必不得再欢乐。 起来！过到基提去； 就是在那里也不得安歇。

chapters.en:
Look at the land of the Chaldeans — a people now of no account. The Assyrians destined it for the desert creatures; they set up their siege towers and stripped its palaces.
They brought it to ruin.
chapters.zh: （看哪，迦勒底人之地向来没有这民，这国是亚述人为住旷野的人所立的。现在他们建筑戍楼，拆毁泰尔的宫殿，使她成为荒凉。）

chapters.en: Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for your harbor has been destroyed!
chapters.zh: 他施的船只都要哀号， 因为你们的保障变为荒场。

chapters.en: At that time Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years—the span of a king’s life. But at the end of seventy years, it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the harlot:
chapters.zh: 到那时，泰尔必被忘记七十年，照着一王的年日。七十年后，泰尔的景况必像妓女所唱的歌：

chapters.en:
“Take up your harp, stroll through the city,
O forgotten harlot. Make sweet melody, sing many a song,
so you will be remembered.”
chapters.zh: 你这被忘记的妓女啊， 拿琴周流城内， 巧弹多唱，使人再想念你。

chapters.en: And at the end of seventy years, the LORD will restore Tyre. Then she will return to hire as a prostitute and sell herself to all the kingdoms on the face of the earth.
chapters.zh: 七十年后，耶和华必眷顾泰尔，她就仍得利息〔注：原文是雇价；下同〕，与地上的万国交易〔注：原文是行淫〕。

chapters.en: Yet her profits and wages will be set apart to the LORD; they will not be stored or saved, for her profit will go to those who live before the LORD, for abundant food and fine clothing.
chapters.zh: 她的货财和利息要归耶和华为圣，必不积攒存留；因为她的货财必为住在耶和华面前的人所得，使他们吃饱，穿耐久的衣服。

chapters.en: Behold, the LORD lays waste the earth and leaves it in ruins. He will twist its surface and scatter its inhabitants—
chapters.zh: 看哪，耶和华使地空虚，变为荒凉； 又翻转大地，将居民分散。

chapters.en:
people and priest alike, servant and master, maid and mistress, buyer and seller,
lender and borrower, creditor and debtor.
chapters.zh: 那时百姓怎样，祭司也怎样； 仆人怎样，主人也怎样； 婢女怎样，主母也怎样； 买物的怎样，卖物的也怎样； 放债的怎样，借债的也怎样； 取利的怎样，出利的也怎样。

chapters.en: The earth will be utterly laid waste and thoroughly plundered. For the LORD has spoken this word.
chapters.zh: 地必全然空虚，尽都荒凉； 因为这话是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
The earth mourns and withers; the world languishes and fades;
the exalted of the earth waste away.
chapters.zh: 地上悲哀衰残， 世界败落衰残； 地上居高位的人也败落了。

chapters.en: The earth is defiled by its people; they have transgressed the laws; they have overstepped the decrees and broken the everlasting covenant.
chapters.zh: 地被其上的居民污秽； 因为他们犯了律法， 废了律例，背了永约。

chapters.en: Therefore a curse has consumed the earth, and its inhabitants must bear the guilt; the earth’s dwellers have been burned, and only a few survive.
chapters.zh: 所以，地被咒诅吞灭； 住在其上的显为有罪。 地上的居民被火焚烧， 剩下的人稀少。

chapters.en: The new wine dries up, the vine withers. All the merrymakers now groan.
chapters.zh: 新酒悲哀，葡萄树衰残； 心中欢乐的俱都叹息。

chapters.en:
The joyful tambourines have ceased; the noise of revelers has stopped;
the joyful harp is silent.
chapters.zh: 击鼓之乐止息； 宴乐人的声音完毕， 弹琴之乐也止息了。

chapters.en: They no longer sing and drink wine; strong drink is bitter to those who consume it.
chapters.zh: 人必不得饮酒唱歌； 喝浓酒的，必以为苦。

chapters.en: The city of chaos is shattered; every house is closed to entry.
chapters.zh: 荒凉的城拆毁了； 各家关门闭户，使人都不得进去。

chapters.en:
In the streets they cry out for wine. All joy turns to gloom;
rejoicing is exiled from the land.
chapters.zh: 在街上因酒有悲叹的声音； 一切喜乐变为昏暗； 地上的欢乐归于无有。

chapters.en: The city is left in ruins; its gate is reduced to rubble.
chapters.zh: 城中只有荒凉； 城门拆毁净尽。

chapters.en: So will it be on the earth and among the nations, like a harvested olive tree, like a gleaning after a grape harvest.
chapters.zh: 在地上的万民中， 必像打过的橄榄树， 又像已摘的葡萄所剩无几。

chapters.en: They raise their voices, they shout for joy; from the west they proclaim the majesty of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这些人要高声欢呼； 他们为耶和华的威严，从海那里扬起声来。

chapters.en:
Therefore glorify the LORD in the east. Extol the name of the LORD, the God of Israel
in the islands of the sea.
chapters.zh: 因此，你们要在东方荣耀耶和华， 在众海岛荣耀耶和华－以色列上帝的名。

chapters.en:
From the ends of the earth we hear singing: “Glory to the Righteous One.”
But I said, “I am wasting away! I am wasting away! Woe is me.” The treacherous betray; the treacherous deal in treachery.
chapters.zh: 我们听见从地极有人歌唱，〔说〕： 荣耀归于义人。 我却说：我消灭了！ 我消灭了，我有祸了！ 诡诈的行诡诈； 诡诈的大行诡诈。

chapters.en: Terror and pit and snare await you, O dweller of the earth.
chapters.zh: 地上的居民哪， 恐惧、陷坑、网罗都临近你。

chapters.en:
Whoever flees the sound of panic will fall into the pit, and whoever climbs from the pit will be caught in the snare.
For the windows of heaven are open, and the foundations of the earth are shaken.
chapters.zh: 躲避恐惧声音的必坠入陷坑； 从陷坑上来的必被网罗缠住； 因为〔天〕上的窗户都开了， 地的根基也震动了。

chapters.en:
The earth is utterly broken apart, the earth is split open,
the earth is shaken violently.
chapters.zh: 地全然破坏，尽都崩裂， 大大地震动了。

chapters.en: The earth staggers like a drunkard and sways like a shack. Earth’s rebellion weighs it down, and it falls, never to rise again.
chapters.zh: 地要东倒西歪，好像醉酒的人； 又摇来摇去，好像吊床。 罪过在其上沉重， 必然塌陷，不能复起。

chapters.en:
In that day the LORD will punish the host of heaven above
and the kings of the earth below.
chapters.zh: 到那日，耶和华在高处必惩罚高处的众军， 在地上必惩罚地上的列王。

chapters.en: They will be gathered together like prisoners in a pit. They will be confined to a dungeon and punished after many days.
chapters.zh: 他们必被聚集，像囚犯被聚在牢狱中， 并要囚在监牢里， 多日之后便被讨罪〔注：或译：眷顾〕。

chapters.en:
The moon will be confounded and the sun will be ashamed; for the LORD of Hosts will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem,
and before His elders with great glory.
chapters.zh: 那时，月亮要蒙羞，日头要惭愧； 因为万军之耶和华必在锡安山， 在耶路撒冷作王； 在〔敬畏〕他的长老面前，必有荣耀。

chapters.en:
O LORD, You are my God!
I will exalt You; I will praise Your name. For You have worked wonders— plans formed long ago—
in perfect faithfulness.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你是我的上帝； 我要尊崇你，我要称赞你的名。 因为你以忠信诚实行过奇妙的事， 成就你古时所定的。

chapters.en: Indeed, You have made the city a heap of rubble, the fortified town a ruin. The fortress of strangers is a city no more; it will never be rebuilt.
chapters.zh: 你使城变为乱堆， 使坚固城变为荒场， 使外邦人宫殿的城不再为城， 永远不再建造。

chapters.en: Therefore, a strong people will honor You. The cities of ruthless nations will revere You.
chapters.zh: 所以，刚强的民必荣耀你； 强暴之国的城必敬畏你。

chapters.en: For You have been a refuge for the poor, a stronghold for the needy in distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat. For the breath of the ruthless is like rain against a wall,
chapters.zh: 因为当强暴人催逼人的时候， 如同暴风直吹墙壁， 你就作贫穷人的保障， 作困乏人急难中的保障， 作躲暴风之处， 作避炎热的阴凉。

chapters.en: like heat in a dry land. You subdue the uproar of foreigners. As the shade of a cloud cools the heat, so the song of the ruthless is silenced.
chapters.zh: 你要压制外邦人的喧哗， 好像干燥地的热气下落； 禁止强暴人的凯歌， 好像热气被云影消化。

chapters.en: On this mountain the LORD of Hosts will prepare a lavish banquet for all the peoples, a feast of aged wine, of choice meat, of finely aged wine.
chapters.zh: 在这山上，万军之耶和华必为万民用肥甘设摆筵席，用陈酒和满髓的肥甘，并澄清的陈酒，设摆筵席。

chapters.en:
On this mountain He will swallow up the shroud that enfolds all peoples,
the sheet that covers all nations;
chapters.zh: 他又必在这山上除灭遮盖万民之物和遮蔽万国蒙脸的帕子。

chapters.en: He will swallow up death forever. The Lord GOD will wipe away the tears from every face and remove the disgrace of His people from the whole earth. For the LORD has spoken.
chapters.zh: 他已经吞灭死亡直到永远。主耶和华必擦去各人脸上的眼泪，又除掉普天下他百姓的羞辱，因为这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: And in that day it will be said, “Surely this is our God; we have waited for Him, and He has saved us. This is the LORD for whom we have waited. Let us rejoice and be glad in His salvation.”
chapters.zh: 到那日，人必说：「看哪，这是我们的上帝；我们素来等候他，他必拯救我们。这是耶和华，我们素来等候他，我们必因他的救恩欢喜快乐。」

chapters.en: For the hand of the LORD will rest on this mountain. But Moab will be trampled in his place as straw is trodden into the dung pile.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的手必按在这山上；摩押人在所居之地必被践踏，好像干草被践踏在粪池的水中。

chapters.en: He will spread out his hands within it, as a swimmer spreads his arms to swim. His pride will be brought low, despite the skill of his hands.
chapters.zh: 他必在其中伸开手，好像洑水的伸开手洑水一样；但〔耶和华〕必使他的骄傲和他手所行的诡计一并败落。

chapters.en: The high-walled fortress will be brought down, cast to the ground, into the dust.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使你城上的坚固高台倾倒，拆平，直到尘埃。

chapters.en:
In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah:
We have a strong city; salvation is established as its walls and ramparts.
chapters.zh: 当那日，在犹大地人必唱这歌〔说〕： 我们有坚固的城。 耶和华要将救恩定为城墙，为外郭。

chapters.en: Open the gates so a righteous nation may enter— one that remains faithful.
chapters.zh: 敞开城门， 使守信的义民得以进入。

chapters.en: You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
chapters.zh: 坚心倚赖〔你的〕， 你必保守他十分平安， 因为他倚靠你。

chapters.en: Trust in the LORD forever, because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal.
chapters.zh: 你们当倚靠耶和华直到永远， 因为耶和华是永久的磐石。

chapters.en: For He has humbled those who dwell on high; He lays the lofty city low. He brings it down to the ground; He casts it into the dust.
chapters.zh: 他使住高处的与高城一并败落， 将城拆毁，拆平，直到尘埃，

chapters.en:
Feet trample it down— the feet of the oppressed,
the steps of the poor.
chapters.zh: 要被脚践踏， 就是被困苦人的脚和穷乏人的脚践踏。

chapters.en: The path of the righteous is level; You clear a straight path for the upright.
chapters.zh: 义人的道是正直的； 你为正直的〔主〕，必修平义人的路。

chapters.en: Yes, we wait for You, O LORD; we walk in the path of Your judgments. Your name and renown are the desire of our souls.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我们在你行审判的路上等候你； 我们心里所羨慕的是你的名， 就是你那可记念的〔名〕。

chapters.en: My soul longs for You in the night; indeed, my spirit seeks You at dawn. For when Your judgments come upon the earth, the people of the world learn righteousness.
chapters.zh: 夜间，我心中羨慕你； 我里面的灵切切寻求你。 因为你在世上行审判的时候， 地上的居民就学习公义。

chapters.en: Though grace is shown to the wicked man, he does not learn righteousness. In the land of righteousness he acts unjustly and fails to see the majesty of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以恩惠待恶人， 他仍不学习公义； 在正直的地上，他必行事不义， 也不注意耶和华的威严。

chapters.en: O LORD, Your hand is upraised, but they do not see it. They will see Your zeal for Your people and be put to shame. The fire set for Your enemies will consume them!
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你的手高举， 他们仍然不看； 却要看你为百姓发的热心，因而抱愧， 并且有火烧灭你的敌人。

chapters.en:
O LORD, You will establish peace for us. For all that we have accomplished,
You have done for us.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你必派定我们得平安， 因为我们所做的事都是你给我们成就的。

chapters.en: O LORD our God, other lords besides You have ruled over us, but Your name alone do we confess.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－我们的上帝啊， 在你以外曾有别的主管辖我们， 但我们专要倚靠你，提你的名。

chapters.en: The dead will not live; the departed spirits will not rise. Therefore You have punished and destroyed them; You have wiped out all memory of them.
chapters.zh: 他们死了，必不能再活； 他们去世，必不能再起； 因为你刑罚他们，毁灭他们， 他们的名号就全然消灭。

chapters.en: You have enlarged the nation, O LORD; You have enlarged the nation. You have gained glory for Yourself; You have extended all the borders of the land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你增添国民， 你增添国民； 你得了荣耀， 又扩张地的四境。

chapters.en: O LORD, they sought You in their distress; when You disciplined them, they poured out a quiet prayer.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，他们在急难中寻求你； 你的惩罚临到他们身上， 他们就倾心吐胆祷告你。

chapters.en:
As a woman with child about to give birth writhes and cries out in pain,
so were we in Your presence, O LORD.
chapters.zh: 妇人怀孕，临产疼痛， 在痛苦之中喊叫； 耶和华啊，我们在你面前也是如此。

chapters.en: We were with child; we writhed in pain; but we gave birth to wind. We have given no salvation to the earth, nor brought any life into the world.
chapters.zh: 我们也曾怀孕疼痛， 所产的竟像风一样。 我们在地上未曾行什么拯救的事； 世上的居民也未曾败落。

chapters.en: Your dead will live; their bodies will rise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust! For your dew is like the dew of the morning, and the earth will bring forth her dead.
chapters.zh: 死人〔注：原文是你的死人〕要复活， 尸首〔注：原文是我的尸首〕要兴起。 睡在尘埃的啊，要醒起歌唱！ 因你的甘露〔好像〕菜蔬上的甘露， 地也要交出死人来。

chapters.en: Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourselves a little while until the wrath has passed.
chapters.zh: 我的百姓啊，你们要来进入内室， 关上门，隐藏片时， 等到忿怒过去。

chapters.en: For behold, the LORD is coming out of His dwelling to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth will reveal her bloodshed and will no longer conceal her slain.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华从他的居所出来， 要刑罚地上居民的罪孽。 地也必露出其中的血， 不再掩盖被杀的人。

chapters.en: In that day the LORD will take His sharp, great, and mighty sword, and bring judgment on Leviathan the fleeing serpent —Leviathan the coiling serpent—and He will slay the dragon of the sea.
chapters.zh: 到那日，耶和华必用他刚硬有力的大刀刑罚鳄鱼－就是那快行的蛇，刑罚鳄鱼－就是那曲行的蛇，并杀海中的大鱼。

chapters.en:
In that day:
“Sing about a fruitful vineyard.
chapters.zh: 当那日，有出酒的葡萄园， 你们要指这园唱歌〔说〕：

chapters.en:
I, the LORD, am its keeper;
I water it continually. I guard it night and day so no one can disturb it;
chapters.zh: 我－耶和华是看守葡萄园的； 我必时刻浇灌， 昼夜看守， 免得有人损害。

chapters.en:
I am not angry. If only thorns and briers confronted Me, I would march and trample them,
I would burn them to the ground.
chapters.zh: 我心中不存忿怒。 惟愿荆棘蒺藜与我交战， 我就勇往直前， 把它一同焚烧。

chapters.en:
Or let them lay claim to My protection; let them make peace with Me—
yes, let them make peace with Me.”
chapters.zh: 不然，让它持住我的能力， 使它与我和好， 愿它与我和好。

chapters.en:
In the days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will bud and blossom
and fill the whole world with fruit.
chapters.zh: 将来雅各要扎根， 以色列要发芽开花； 他们的果实必充满世界。

chapters.en: Has the LORD struck Israel as He struck her oppressors? Was she killed like those who slayed her?
chapters.zh: 主击打他们， 岂像击打那些击打他们的人吗？ 他们被杀戮， 岂像被他们所杀戮的吗？

chapters.en:
By warfare and exile You contended with her and removed her with a fierce wind,
as on the day the east wind blows.
chapters.zh: 你打发他们去， 是相机宜与他们相争； 刮东风的日子， 就用暴风将他们逐去。

chapters.en: Therefore Jacob’s guilt will be atoned for, and the full fruit of the removal of his sin will be this: When he makes all the altar stones like crushed bits of chalk, no Asherah poles or incense altars will remain standing.
chapters.zh: 所以，雅各的罪孽得赦免， 他的罪过得除掉的果效，全在乎此： 就是他叫祭坛的石头变为打碎的灰石， 以致木偶和日像不再立起。

chapters.en: For the fortified city lies deserted— a homestead abandoned, a wilderness forsaken. There the calves graze, and there they lie down; they strip its branches bare.
chapters.zh: 因为坚固城变为凄凉， 成了撇下离弃的居所，像旷野一样； 牛犊必在那里吃草， 在那里躺卧，并吃尽其中的树枝。

chapters.en: When its limbs are dry, they are broken off. Women come and use them for kindling; for this is a people without understanding. Therefore their Maker has no compassion on them, and their Creator shows them no favor.
chapters.zh: 枝条枯干，必被折断； 妇女要来点火烧着。 因为这百姓蒙昧无知， 所以，创造他们的必不怜恤他们； 造成他们的也不施恩与他们。

chapters.en: In that day the LORD will thresh from the flowing Euphrates to the Wadi of Egypt, and you, O Israelites, will be gathered one by one.
chapters.zh: 以色列人哪，到那日，耶和华必从大河，直到埃及小河，将你们一一地收集，如同人打树拾果一样。

chapters.en: And in that day a great ram’s horn will sound, and those who were perishing in Assyria will come forth with those who were exiles in Egypt. And they will worship the LORD on the holy mountain in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 当那日，必大发角声，在亚述地将要灭亡的，并在埃及地被赶散的，都要来，他们就在耶路撒冷圣山上敬拜耶和华。

chapters.en: Woe to the majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards, to the fading flower of his glorious splendor, set on the summit above the fertile valley, the pride of those overcome by wine.
chapters.zh: 祸哉！以法莲的酒徒， 住在肥美谷的山上， 他们心里高傲， 以所夸的为冠冕， 〔犹如〕将残之花。

chapters.en:
Behold, the Lord has one who is strong and mighty. Like a hailstorm or destructive tempest, like a driving rain or flooding downpour,
he will smash that crown to the ground.
chapters.zh: 看哪，主有一大能大力者， 像一阵冰雹， 像毁灭的暴风， 像涨溢的大水， 他必用手将〔冠冕〕摔落于地。

chapters.en: The majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards will be trampled underfoot.
chapters.zh: 以法莲高傲的酒徒， 他的冠冕必被踏在脚下。

chapters.en: The fading flower of his beautiful splendor, set on the summit above the fertile valley, will be like a ripe fig before the summer harvest: Whoever sees it will take it in his hand and swallow it.
chapters.zh: 那荣美将残之花， 就是在肥美谷山上的， 必像夏令以前初熟的无花果； 看见这果的就注意， 一到手中就吞吃了。

chapters.en: On that day the LORD of Hosts will be a crown of glory, a diadem of splendor to the remnant of His people,
chapters.zh: 到那日，万军之耶和华 必作他余剩之民的荣冠华冕，

chapters.en: a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and a strength to those who repel the onslaught at the gate.
chapters.zh: 也作了在位上行审判者公平之灵， 并城门口打退仇敌者的力量。

chapters.en: These also stagger from wine and stumble from strong drink: Priests and prophets reel from strong drink and are befuddled by wine. They stumble because of strong drink, muddled in their visions and stumbling in their judgments.
chapters.zh: 就是这〔地的〕人也因酒摇摇晃晃， 因浓酒东倒西歪。 祭司和先知因浓酒摇摇晃晃， 被酒所困， 因浓酒东倒西歪。 他们错解默示， 谬行审判。

chapters.en: For all their tables are covered with vomit; there is not a place without filth.
chapters.zh: 因为各席上满了呕吐的污秽， 无一处〔干净〕。

chapters.en: Whom is He trying to teach? To whom is He explaining His message? To infants just weaned from milk? To babies removed from the breast?
chapters.zh: 〔讥诮先知的说〕： 他要将知识指教谁呢？ 要使谁明白传言呢？ 是那刚断奶离怀的吗？
他竟命上加命，令上加令， 律上加律，例上加例， 这里一点，那里一点。

chapters.en: Indeed, with mocking lips and foreign tongues, He will speak to this people
chapters.zh: 〔先知说〕：不然，主要藉异邦人的嘴唇 和外邦人的舌头对这百姓说话。

chapters.en:
to whom He has said: “This is the place of rest, let the weary rest; this is the place of repose.”
But they would not listen.
chapters.zh: 他曾对他们说： 你们要使疲乏人得安息， 这样才得安息，才得舒畅， 他们却不肯听。
所以，耶和华向他们说的话是 命上加命，令上加令， 律上加律，例上加例， 这里一点，那里一点， 以致他们前行仰面跌倒， 而且跌碎，并陷入网罗被缠住。

chapters.en: Therefore hear the word of the LORD, O scoffers who rule this people in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 所以，你们这些亵慢的人， 就是辖管住在耶路撒冷这百姓的， 要听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: For you said, “We have made a covenant with death; we have fashioned an agreement with Sheol. When the overwhelming scourge passes through it will not touch us, because we have made lies our refuge and falsehood our hiding place.”
chapters.zh: 你们曾说： 我们与死亡立约， 与阴间结盟； 敌军〔注：原文是鞭子〕〔如水〕涨漫经过的时候， 必不临到我们； 因我们以谎言为避所， 在虚假以下藏身。

chapters.en:
So this is what the Lord GOD says:
“See, I lay a stone in Zion, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation; the one who believes will never be shaken.
chapters.zh: 所以，主耶和华如此说： 看哪，我在锡安放一块石头作为根基， 是试验过的石头， 是稳固根基，宝贵的房角〔石〕； 信靠的人必不着急。

chapters.en: I will make justice the measuring line and righteousness the level. Hail will sweep away your refuge of lies, and water will flood your hiding place.
chapters.zh: 我必以公平为准绳， 以公义为线铊。 冰雹必冲去谎言的避所； 大水必漫过藏身之处。

chapters.en: Your covenant with death will be dissolved, and your agreement with Sheol will not stand. When the overwhelming scourge passes through, you will be trampled by it.
chapters.zh: 你们与死亡所立的约必然废掉， 与阴间所结的盟必立不住。 敌军〔注：原文是鞭子〕〔如水〕涨漫经过的时候， 你们必被他践踏；

chapters.en:
As often as it passes through, it will carry you away; it will sweep through morning after morning, by day and by night.”
The understanding of this message will bring sheer terror.
chapters.zh: 每逢经过必将你们掳去。 因为每早晨他必经过， 白昼黑夜都必如此。 明白传言的必受惊恐。

chapters.en: Indeed, the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket too small to wrap around you.
chapters.zh: 原来，床榻短，使人不能舒身； 被窝窄，使人不能遮体。

chapters.en: For the LORD will rise up as at Mount Perazim. He will rouse Himself as in the Valley of Gibeon, to do His work, His strange work, and to perform His task, His disturbing task.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必兴起，像在毗拉心山； 他必发怒，像在基遍谷， 好做成他的工，就是非常的工； 成就他的事，就是奇异的事。

chapters.en: So now, do not mock, or your shackles will become heavier. Indeed, I have heard from the Lord GOD of Hosts a decree of destruction against the whole land.
chapters.zh: 现在你们不可亵慢， 恐怕捆你们的绑索更结实了； 因为我从主－万军之耶和华那里听见， 已经决定在全地上施行灭绝的事。

chapters.en: Listen and hear my voice. Pay attention and hear what I say.
chapters.zh: 你们当侧耳听我的声音， 留心听我的言语。

chapters.en: Does the plowman plow for planting every day? Does he continuously loosen and harrow the soil?
chapters.zh: 那耕地为要撒种的， 岂是常常耕地呢？ 岂是常常开垦耙地呢？

chapters.en: When he has leveled its surface, does he not sow caraway and scatter cumin? He plants wheat in rows and barley in plots, and rye within its border.
chapters.zh: 他拉平了地面， 岂不就撒种小茴香， 播种大茴香， 按行列种小麦， 在定处种大麦， 在田边种粗麦呢？

chapters.en: For his God instructs and teaches him properly.
chapters.zh: 因为他的上帝教导他务农相宜， 并且指教他。

chapters.en: Surely caraway is not threshed with a sledge, and the wheel of a cart is not rolled over the cumin. But caraway is beaten out with a stick, and cumin with a rod.
chapters.zh: 原来打小茴香，不用尖利的器具， 轧大茴香，也不用碌碡〔注：原文是车轮；下同〕； 但用杖打小茴香， 用棍打大茴香。

chapters.en: Grain for bread must be ground, but it is not endlessly threshed. Though the wheels of the cart roll over it, the horses do not crush it.
chapters.zh: 做饼的〔粮食〕是用磨磨碎， 因它不必常打； 虽用碌碡和马打散， 却不磨它。

chapters.en:
This also comes from the LORD of Hosts, who is wonderful in counsel
and excellent in wisdom.
chapters.zh: 这也是出于万军之耶和华－ 他的谋略奇妙； 他的智慧广大。

chapters.en: Woe to you, O Ariel, the city of Ariel where David camped! Year upon year let your festivals recur.
chapters.zh: 唉！亚利伊勒，亚利伊勒， 大卫安营的城， 任凭你年上加年， 节期照常周流。

chapters.en:
And I will constrain Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation;
she will be like an altar hearth before Me.
chapters.zh: 我终必使亚利伊勒困难； 她必悲伤哀号， 我却仍以她为亚利伊勒。

chapters.en:
I will camp in a circle around you; I will besiege you with towers
and set up siege works against you.
chapters.zh: 我必四围安营攻击你， 屯兵围困你， 筑垒攻击你。

chapters.en: You will be brought low, you will speak from the ground, and out of the dust your words will be muffled. Your voice will be like a spirit from the ground; your speech will whisper out of the dust.
chapters.zh: 你必败落，从地中说话； 你的言语必微细出于尘埃。 你的声音必像那交鬼者的声音出于地； 你的言语低低微微出于尘埃。

chapters.en: But your many foes will be like fine dust, the multitude of the ruthless like blowing chaff. Then suddenly, in an instant,
chapters.zh: 你仇敌的群众，却要像细尘； 强暴人的群众，也要像飞糠。 这事必顷刻之间忽然临到。

chapters.en: you will be visited by the LORD of Hosts with thunder and earthquake and loud noise, with windstorm and tempest and consuming flame of fire.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华必用雷轰、地震、大声、旋风、暴风， 并吞灭的火焰，向她讨罪。

chapters.en: All the many nations going out to battle against Ariel— even all who war against her, laying siege and attacking her— will be like a dream, like a vision in the night,
chapters.zh: 那时，攻击亚利伊勒列国的群众， 就是一切攻击亚利伊勒和她的保障， 并使她困难的， 必如梦景，如夜间的异象；

chapters.en: as when a hungry man dreams he is eating, then awakens still hungry; as when a thirsty man dreams he is drinking, then awakens faint and parched. So will it be for all the many nations who go to battle against Mount Zion.
chapters.zh: 又必像饥饿的人梦中吃饭， 醒了仍觉腹空； 或像口渴的人梦中喝水， 醒了仍觉发昏，心里想喝。 攻击锡安山列国的群众也必如此。

chapters.en: Stop and be astonished; blind yourselves and be sightless; be drunk, but not with wine; stagger, but not from strong drink.
chapters.zh: 你们等候惊奇吧！ 你们宴乐昏迷吧！ 他们醉了，却非因酒； 他们东倒西歪，却非因浓酒。

chapters.en: For the LORD has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep. He has shut your eyes, O prophets; He has covered your heads, O seers.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华将沉睡的灵浇灌你们， 封闭你们的眼， 蒙盖你们的头。 你们的眼就是先知； 你们的头就是先见。

chapters.en: And the entire vision will be to you like the words sealed in a scroll. If it is handed to someone to read, he will say, “I cannot, because it is sealed.”
chapters.zh: 所有的默示，你们看如封住的书卷，人将这书卷交给识字的，说：「请念吧！」他说：「我不能念，因为是封住了。」

chapters.en: Or if the scroll is handed to one unable to read, he will say, “I cannot read.”
chapters.zh: 又将这书卷交给不识字的人，说：「请念吧！」他说：「我不识字。」

chapters.en:
Therefore the Lord said:
“These people draw near to Me with their mouths and honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me. Their worship of Me is but rules taught by men.
chapters.zh: 主说：因为这百姓亲近我， 用嘴唇尊敬我， 心却远离我； 他们敬畏我， 不过是领受人的吩咐。

chapters.en: Therefore I will again confound these people with wonder upon wonder. The wisdom of the wise will vanish, and the intelligence of the intelligent will be hidden. ”
chapters.zh: 所以，我在这百姓中要行奇妙的事， 就是奇妙又奇妙的事。 他们智慧人的智慧必然消灭， 聪明人的聪明必然隐藏。

chapters.en: Woe to those who dig deep to hide their plans from the LORD. In darkness they do their works and say, “Who sees us, and who will know?”
chapters.zh: 祸哉！那些向耶和华深藏谋略的， 又在暗中行事，说： 谁看见我们呢？ 谁知道我们呢？

chapters.en: You have turned things upside down, as if the potter were regarded as clay. Shall what is formed say to him who formed it, “He did not make me”? Can the pottery say of the potter, “He has no understanding”?
chapters.zh: 你们把事颠倒了， 岂可看窑匠如泥吗？ 被制作的物岂可论制作物的说： 他没有制作我？ 或是被创造的物论造物的说： 他没有聪明？

chapters.en:
In a very short time, will not Lebanon become an orchard,
and the orchard seem like a forest?
chapters.zh: 黎巴嫩变为肥田， 肥田看如树林， 不是只有一点点时候吗？

chapters.en: On that day the deaf will hear the words of the scroll, and out of the deep darkness the eyes of the blind will see.
chapters.zh: 那时，聋子必听见这书上的话； 瞎子的眼必从迷矇黑暗中得以看见。

chapters.en: The humble will increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
chapters.zh: 谦卑人必因耶和华增添欢喜； 人间贫穷的必因以色列的圣者快乐。

chapters.en: For the ruthless will vanish, the mockers will disappear, and all who look for evil will be cut down—
chapters.zh: 因为，强暴人已归无有， 亵慢人已经灭绝， 一切找机会作孽的都被剪除。

chapters.en: those who indict a man with a word, who ensnare the mediator at the gate, and who with false charges deprive the innocent of justice.
chapters.zh: 他们在争讼的事上定〔无罪的〕为有罪， 为城门口责备人的设下网罗， 用虚无的事屈枉义人。

chapters.en:
Therefore the LORD who redeemed Abraham says of the house of Jacob:
“No longer will Jacob be ashamed and no more will his face grow pale.
chapters.zh: 所以，救赎亚伯拉罕的耶和华 论雅各家如此说： 雅各必不再羞愧， 面容也不致变色。

chapters.en: For when he sees his children around him, the work of My hands, they will honor My name, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and they will stand in awe of the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 但他看见他的众子， 就是我手的工作在他那里， 他们必尊我的名为圣， 必尊雅各的圣者为圣， 必敬畏以色列的上帝。

chapters.en: Then the wayward in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will accept instruction.”
chapters.zh: 心中迷糊的必得明白； 发怨言的必受训诲。

chapters.en:
“Woe to the rebellious children,” declares the LORD, “to those who carry out a plan that is not Mine, who form an alliance, but against My will,
heaping up sin upon sin.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说： 祸哉！这悖逆的儿女。 他们同谋，却不由于我， 结盟，却不由于我的灵， 以致罪上加罪；

chapters.en: They set out to go down to Egypt without asking My advice, to seek shelter under Pharaoh’s protection and take refuge in Egypt’s shade.
chapters.zh: 起身下埃及去，并没有求问我； 要靠法老的力量加添自己的力量， 并投在埃及的荫下。

chapters.en: But Pharaoh’s protection will become your shame, and the refuge of Egypt’s shade your disgrace.
chapters.zh: 所以，法老的力量必作你们的羞辱； 投在埃及的荫下，要为你们的惭愧。

chapters.en: For though their princes are at Zoan and their envoys have arrived in Hanes,
chapters.zh: 他们的首领已在琐安； 他们的使臣到了哈内斯。

chapters.en: everyone will be put to shame because of a people useless to them. They bring neither help nor benefit, but only shame and disgrace.”
chapters.zh: 他们必因那不利于他们的民蒙羞。 那民并非帮助，也非利益， 只作羞耻凌辱。

chapters.en:
This is the burden against the beasts of the Negev:
Through a land of hardship and distress, of lioness and lion,
of viper and flying serpent, they carry their wealth on the backs of donkeys and their treasures on the humps of camels,
to a people of no profit to them.
chapters.zh: 论南方牲畜的默示： 他们把财物驮在驴驹的脊背上， 将宝物驮在骆驼的肉鞍上， 经过艰难困苦之地， 就是公狮、母狮、蝮蛇、火焰的飞龙之地， 往那不利于他们的民那里去。

chapters.en:
Egypt’s help is futile and empty; therefore I have called her
Rahab Who Sits Still.
chapters.zh: 埃及的帮助是徒然无益的； 所以我称她为「坐而不动的拉哈伯」。

chapters.en: Go now, write it on a tablet in their presence and inscribe it on a scroll; it will be for the days to come, a witness forever and ever.
chapters.zh: 现今你去， 在他们面前将这话刻在版上， 写在书上， 以便传留后世，直到永永远远。

chapters.en: These are rebellious people, deceitful children, children unwilling to obey the LORD’s instruction.
chapters.zh: 因为他们是悖逆的百姓、说谎的儿女， 不肯听从耶和华训诲的儿女。

chapters.en: They say to the seers, “Stop seeing visions!” and to the prophets, “Do not prophesy to us the truth! Speak to us pleasant words; prophesy illusions.
chapters.zh: 他们对先见说：不要望见〔不吉利的事〕， 对先知说：不要向我们讲正直的话； 要向我们说柔和的话， 言虚幻的事。

chapters.en: Get out of the way; turn off the road. Rid us of the Holy One of Israel!”
chapters.zh: 你们要离弃正道，偏离直路， 不要在我们面前再提说以色列的圣者。

chapters.en:
Therefore this is what the Holy One of Israel says:
“Because you have rejected this message, trusting in oppression and relying on deceit,
chapters.zh: 所以，以色列的圣者如此说： 因为你们藐视这〔训诲的〕话， 倚赖欺压和乖僻，以此为可靠的，

chapters.en: this iniquity of yours is like a breach about to fail, a bulge in a high wall, whose collapse will come suddenly— in an instant!
chapters.zh: 故此，这罪孽在你们身上， 好像将要破裂凸出来的高墙， 顷刻之间忽然坍塌；

chapters.en:
It will break in pieces like a potter’s jar, shattered so that no fragment can be found. Not a shard will be found in the dust large enough to scoop the coals from a hearth
or to skim the water from a cistern.”
chapters.zh: 要被打碎，好像把窑匠的瓦器打碎， 毫不顾惜， 甚至碎块中找不到一片可用以从炉内取火， 从池中舀水。

chapters.en:
For the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, has said:
“By repentance and rest you would be saved; your strength would lie in quiet confidence— but you were not willing.”
chapters.zh: 主耶和华－以色列的圣者曾如此说： 你们得救在乎归回安息； 你们得力在乎平静安稳； 你们竟自不肯。

chapters.en: “No,” you say, “we will flee on horses.” Therefore you will flee! “We will ride swift horses,” but your pursuers will be faster.
chapters.zh: 你们却说：不然，我们要骑马奔走。 所以你们必然奔走； 又说：我们要骑飞快的〔牲口〕。 所以追赶你们的，也必飞快。

chapters.en: A thousand will flee at the threat of one; at the threat of five you will all flee, until you are left alone like a pole on a mountaintop, like a banner on a hill.
chapters.zh: 一人叱喝，必令千人〔逃跑〕； 五人叱喝，你们都必逃跑； 以致剩下的，好像山顶的旗杆， 冈上的大旗。

chapters.en: Therefore the LORD longs to be gracious to you; therefore He rises to show you compassion, for the LORD is a just God. Blessed are all who wait for Him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必然等候，要施恩给你们； 必然兴起，好怜悯你们。 因为耶和华是公平的上帝； 凡等候他的都是有福的！

chapters.en: O people in Zion who dwell in Jerusalem, you will weep no more. He will surely be gracious when you cry for help; when He hears, He will answer you.
chapters.zh: 百姓必在锡安、在耶路撒冷居住；你不再哭泣。主必因你哀求的声音施恩给你；他听见的时候就必应允你。

chapters.en: The Lord will give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, but your Teacher will no longer hide Himself—with your own eyes you will see Him.
chapters.zh: 主虽然以艰难给你当饼，以困苦给你当水，你的教师却不再隐藏；你眼必看见你的教师。

chapters.en: And whether you turn to the right or to the left, your ears will hear this command behind you: “This is the way. Walk in it.”
chapters.zh: 你或向左或向右，你必听见后边有声音说：「这是正路，要行在其间。」

chapters.en: So you will desecrate your silver-plated idols and your gold-plated images. You will throw them away like menstrual cloths, saying to them, “Be gone!”
chapters.zh: 你雕刻偶像所包的银子和铸造偶像所镀的金子，你要玷污，要抛弃，好像污秽之物，对偶像说：「去吧！」

chapters.en: Then He will send rain for the seed that you have sown in the ground, and the food that comes from your land will be rich and plentiful. On that day your cattle will graze in open pastures.
chapters.zh: 你将种子撒在地里，主必降雨在其上，并使地所出的粮肥美丰盛。到那时，你的牲畜必在宽阔的草场吃草。

chapters.en: The oxen and donkeys that work the ground will eat salted fodder, winnowed with shovel and pitchfork.
chapters.zh: 耕地的牛和驴驹必吃加盐的料；这料是用木锨和杈子扬净的。

chapters.en: And from every high mountain and every raised hill, streams of water will flow in the day of great slaughter, when the towers fall.
chapters.zh: 在大行杀戮的日子，高台倒塌的时候，各高山冈陵必有川流河涌。

chapters.en: The light of the moon will be as bright as the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter—like the light of seven days—on the day that the LORD binds up the brokenness of His people and heals the wounds He has inflicted.
chapters.zh: 当耶和华缠裹他百姓的损处，医治他民鞭伤的日子，月光必像日光，日光必加七倍，像七日的光一样。

chapters.en: Behold, the Name of the LORD comes from afar, with burning anger and dense smoke. His lips are full of fury, and His tongue is like a consuming fire.
chapters.zh: 看哪，耶和华的名从远方来， 怒气烧起，密烟上腾。 他的嘴唇满有忿恨； 他的舌头像吞灭的火。

chapters.en: His breath is like a rushing torrent that rises to the neck. He comes to sift the nations in a sieve of destruction; He bridles the jaws of the peoples to lead them astray.
chapters.zh: 他的气如涨溢的河水，直涨到颈项， 要用毁灭的筛箩筛净列国， 并且在众民的口中必有使人错行的嚼环。

chapters.en: You will sing as on the night of a holy festival, and your heart will rejoice like one who walks to the music of a flute, going up to the mountain of the LORD, to the Rock of Israel.
chapters.zh: 你们必唱歌，像守圣节的夜间一样，并且心中喜乐，像人吹笛，上耶和华的山，到以色列的磐石那里。

chapters.en: And the LORD will cause His majestic voice to be heard and His mighty arm to be revealed, striking in angry wrath with a flame of consuming fire, and with cloudburst, storm, and hailstones.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必使人听他威严的声音，又显他降罚的膀臂和他怒中的忿恨，并吞灭的火焰与霹雷、暴风、冰雹。

chapters.en: For Assyria will be shattered at the voice of the LORD; He will strike them with His scepter.
chapters.zh: 亚述人必因耶和华的声音惊惶；耶和华必用杖击打他。

chapters.en: And with every stroke of the rod of punishment that the LORD brings down on them, the tambourines and lyres will sound as He battles with weapons brandished.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必将命定的杖加在他身上；每打一下，人必击鼓弹琴。打仗的时候，耶和华必抡起〔手〕来，与他交战。

chapters.en: For Topheth has long been prepared; it has been made ready for the king. Its funeral pyre is deep and wide, with plenty of fire and wood. The breath of the LORD, like a torrent of burning sulfur, sets it ablaze.
chapters.zh: 原来陀斐特又深又宽，早已为王预备好了；其中堆的是火与许多木柴。耶和华的气如一股硫磺火使他着起来。

chapters.en: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, who rely on horses, who trust in their abundance of chariots and in their multitude of horsemen. They do not look to the Holy One of Israel; they do not seek the LORD.
chapters.zh: 祸哉！那些下埃及求帮助的， 是因仗赖马匹，倚靠甚多的车辆， 并倚靠强壮的马兵， 却不仰望以色列的圣者， 也不求问耶和华。

chapters.en: Yet He too is wise and brings disaster; He does not call back His words. He will rise up against the house of the wicked and against the allies of evildoers.
chapters.zh: 其实，耶和华有智慧； 他必降灾祸， 并不反悔自己的话， 却要兴起攻击那作恶之家， 又攻击那作孽帮助人的。

chapters.en: But the Egyptians are men, not God; their horses are flesh, not spirit. When the LORD stretches out His hand, the helper will stumble, and the one he helps will fall; both will perish together.
chapters.zh: 埃及人不过是人，并不是上帝； 他们的马不过是血肉，并不是灵。 耶和华一伸手，那帮助人的必绊跌， 那受帮助的也必跌倒，都一同灭亡。

chapters.en:
For this is what the LORD has said to me:
“Like a lion roaring or a young lion over its prey— and though a band of shepherds is called out against it, it is not terrified by their shouting
or subdued by their clamor— so the LORD of Hosts will come down to do battle on Mount Zion and its heights.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我如此说： 狮子和少壮狮子护食咆哮， 就是喊许多牧人来攻击牠， 牠总不因他们的声音惊惶， 也不因他们的喧哗缩伏。 如此，万军之耶和华 也必降临在锡安山冈上争战。

chapters.en: Like birds hovering overhead, so the LORD of Hosts will protect Jerusalem. He will shield it and deliver it; He will pass over it and preserve it.”
chapters.zh: 雀鸟怎样扇翅〔覆雏〕， 万军之耶和华也要照样保护耶路撒冷。 他必保护拯救， 要越门保守。

chapters.en: Return to the One against whom you have so blatantly rebelled, O children of Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列人哪，你们深深地悖逆耶和华，现今要归向他。

chapters.en: For on that day, every one of you will reject the idols of silver and gold that your own hands have sinfully made.
chapters.zh: 到那日，各人必将他金偶像银偶像，就是亲手所造、陷自己在罪中的，都抛弃了。

chapters.en: “Then Assyria will fall, but not by the sword of man; a sword will devour them, but not one made by mortals. They will flee before the sword, and their young men will be put to forced labor.
chapters.zh: 亚述人必倒在刀下，并非人的刀； 有刀要将他吞灭，并非人的刀。 他必逃避这刀； 他的少年人必成为服苦的。

chapters.en: Their rock will pass away for fear, and their princes will panic at the sight of the battle standard,” declares the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, whose furnace is in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 他的磐石必因惊吓挪去； 他的首领必因大旗惊惶。 这是那有火在锡安、 有炉在耶路撒冷的耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Behold, a king will reign in righteousness, and princes will rule with justice.
chapters.zh: 看哪，必有一王凭公义行政； 必有首领藉公平掌权。

chapters.en: Each will be like a shelter from the wind, a refuge from the storm, like streams of water in a dry land, like the shadow of a great rock in an arid land.
chapters.zh: 必有一人像避风所和避暴雨的隐密处， 又像河流在干旱之地， 像大磐石的影子在疲乏之地。

chapters.en: Then the eyes of those who see will no longer be closed, and the ears of those who hear will listen.
chapters.zh: 那能看的人，眼不再昏迷； 能听的人，耳必得听闻。

chapters.en: The mind of the rash will know and understand, and the stammering tongue will speak clearly and fluently.
chapters.zh: 冒失人的心必明白知识； 结吧人的舌必说话通快。

chapters.en: No longer will a fool be called noble, nor a scoundrel be respected.
chapters.zh: 愚顽人不再称为高明； 吝啬人不再称为大方。

chapters.en: For a fool speaks foolishness; his mind plots iniquity. He practices ungodliness and speaks falsely about the LORD; he leaves the hungry empty and deprives the thirsty of drink.
chapters.zh: 因为愚顽人必说愚顽话， 心里想作罪孽， 惯行亵渎的事， 说错谬的话攻击耶和华， 使饥饿的人无食可吃， 使口渴的人无水可喝。

chapters.en:
The weapons of the scoundrel are destructive; he hatches plots to destroy the poor with lies,
even when the plea of the needy is just.
chapters.zh: 吝啬人所用的法子是恶的； 他图谋恶计， 用谎言毁灭谦卑人； 穷乏人讲公理的时候， 他也是这样行。

chapters.en: But a noble man makes honorable plans; he stands up for worthy causes.
chapters.zh: 高明人却谋高明事， 在高明事上也必永存。

chapters.en: Stand up, you complacent women; listen to me. Give ear to my word, you overconfident daughters.
chapters.zh: 安逸的妇女啊，起来听我的声音！ 无虑的女子啊，侧耳听我的言语！

chapters.en: In a little more than a year you will tremble, O secure ones. For the grape harvest will fail and the fruit harvest will not arrive.
chapters.zh: 无虑的女子啊，再过一年多，必受骚扰； 因为无葡萄可摘， 无果子〔注：或译：禾稼〕可收。

chapters.en: Shudder, you ladies of leisure; tremble, you daughters of complacency. Strip yourselves bare and put sackcloth around your waists.
chapters.zh: 安逸的妇女啊，要战兢； 无虑的女子啊，要受骚扰。 脱去衣服，赤着身体， 腰束〔麻布〕。

chapters.en: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vines,
chapters.zh: 她们必为美好的田地 和多结果的葡萄树，搥胸哀哭。

chapters.en: and for the land of my people, overgrown with thorns and briers— even for every house of merriment in this city of revelry.
chapters.zh: 荆棘蒺藜必长在我百姓的地上， 又长在欢乐的城中和一切快乐的房屋上。

chapters.en:
For the palace will be forsaken, the busy city abandoned. The hill and the watchtower will become caves forever— the delight of wild donkeys
and a pasture for flocks—
chapters.zh: 因为宫殿必被撇下， 多民的城必被离弃； 山冈望楼永为洞穴， 作野驴所喜乐的， 为羊群的草场。

chapters.en:
until the Spirit is poured out upon us from on high.
Then the desert will be an orchard, and the orchard will seem like a forest.
chapters.zh: 等到〔圣〕灵从上浇灌我们， 旷野就变为肥田， 肥田看如树林。

chapters.en: Then justice will inhabit the wilderness, and righteousness will dwell in the fertile field.
chapters.zh: 那时，公平要居在旷野； 公义要居在肥田。

chapters.en: The work of righteousness will be peace; the service of righteousness will be quiet confidence forever.
chapters.zh: 公义的果效必是平安； 公义的效验必是平稳，直到永远。

chapters.en: Then my people will dwell in a peaceful place, in safe and secure places of rest.
chapters.zh: 我的百姓必住在平安的居所， 安稳的住处，平静的安歇所。

chapters.en: But hail will level the forest, and the city will sink to the depths.
chapters.zh: （但要降冰雹打倒树林； 城必全然拆平。）

chapters.en: Blessed are those who sow beside abundant waters, who let the ox and donkey range freely.
chapters.zh: 你们在各水边撒种、 牧放牛驴的有福了！

chapters.en: Woe to you, O destroyer never destroyed, O traitor never betrayed! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed. When you have finished betraying, you will be betrayed.
chapters.zh: 祸哉！你这毁灭人的， 自己倒不被毁灭； 行事诡诈的， 人倒不以诡诈待你。 你毁灭罢休了， 自己必被毁灭； 你行完了诡诈， 人必以诡诈待你。

chapters.en: O LORD, be gracious to us! We wait for You. Be our strength every morning and our salvation in time of trouble.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你施恩于我们； 我们等候你。 求你每早晨作我们的膀臂， 遭难的时候为我们的拯救。

chapters.en: The peoples flee the thunder of Your voice; the nations scatter when You rise.
chapters.zh: 喧嚷的响声一发，众民奔逃； 你一兴起，列国四散。

chapters.en: Your spoil, O nations, is gathered as by locusts; like a swarm of locusts men sweep over it.
chapters.zh: 你们所掳的必被敛尽， 好像蚂蚱吃〔注：原文是敛〕尽〔禾稼〕。 人要蹦在其上，好像蝗虫一样。

chapters.en: The LORD is exalted, for He dwells on high; He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
chapters.zh: 耶和华被尊崇，因他居在高处； 他以公平公义充满锡安。

chapters.en:
He will be the sure foundation for your times, a storehouse of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge.
The fear of the LORD is Zion’s treasure.
chapters.zh: 你一生一世必得安稳－ 有丰盛的救恩， 并智慧和知识； 你以敬畏耶和华为至宝。

chapters.en: Behold, their valiant ones cry aloud in the streets; the envoys of peace weep bitterly.
chapters.zh: 看哪，他们的豪杰在外头哀号； 求和的使臣痛痛哭泣。

chapters.en:
The highways are deserted; travel has ceased. The treaty has been broken, the witnesses are despised,
and human life is disregarded.
chapters.zh: 大路荒凉，行人止息； 〔敌人〕背约， 藐视城邑， 不顾人民。

chapters.en: The land mourns and languishes; Lebanon is ashamed and decayed. Sharon is like a desert; Bashan and Carmel shake off their leaves.
chapters.zh: 地上悲哀衰残； 黎巴嫩羞愧枯干； 沙崙像旷野； 巴珊和迦密〔的树林〕凋残。

chapters.en: “Now I will arise,” says the LORD. “Now I will lift Myself up. Now I will be exalted.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说： 现在我要起来； 我要兴起； 我要勃然而兴。

chapters.en: You conceive chaff; you give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will consume you.
chapters.zh: 你们要怀的是糠秕， 要生的是碎诩； 你们的气就是吞灭自己的火。

chapters.en: The peoples will be burned to ashes, like thorns cut down and set ablaze.
chapters.zh: 列邦必像已烧的石灰， 像已割的荆棘在火中焚烧。

chapters.en: You who are far off, hear what I have done; you who are near, acknowledge My might.”
chapters.zh: 你们远方的人当听我所行的； 你们近处的人当承认我的大能。

chapters.en: The sinners in Zion are afraid; trembling grips the ungodly: “Who of us can dwell with a consuming fire? Who of us can dwell with everlasting flames?”
chapters.zh: 锡安中的罪人都惧怕； 不敬虔的人被战兢抓住。 我们中间谁能与吞灭的火同住？ 我们中间谁能与永火同住呢？

chapters.en: He who walks righteously and speaks with sincerity, who refuses gain from extortion, whose hand never takes a bribe, who stops his ears against murderous plots and shuts his eyes tightly against evil—
chapters.zh: 行事公义、说话正直、 憎恶欺压的财利、 摆手不受贿赂、 塞耳不听流血的话， 闭眼不看邪恶事的，

chapters.en: he will dwell on the heights; the mountain fortress will be his refuge; his food will be provided and his water assured.
chapters.zh: 他必居高处； 他的保障是磐石的坚垒； 他的粮必不缺乏〔注：原文是赐给〕； 他的水必不断绝。

chapters.en: Your eyes will see the King in His beauty and behold a land that stretches afar.
chapters.zh: 你的眼必见王的荣美， 必见辽阔之地。

chapters.en:
Your mind will ponder the former terror: “Where is he who tallies? Where is he who weighs?
Where is he who counts the towers?”
chapters.zh: 你的心必思想那惊吓的事， 〔自问说〕：记数目的在哪里呢？ 平〔贡银〕的在哪里呢？ 数戍楼的在哪里呢？

chapters.en:
You will no longer see the insolent, a people whose speech is unintelligible,
who stammer in a language you cannot understand.
chapters.zh: 你必不见那强暴的民， 就是说话深奥，你不能明白， 言语呢喃，你不能懂得的。

chapters.en: Look upon Zion, the city of our appointed feasts. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a peaceful pasture, a tent that does not wander; its tent pegs will not be pulled up, nor will any of its cords be broken.
chapters.zh: 你要看锡安－我们守圣节的城！ 你的眼必见耶路撒冷为安静的居所， 为不挪移的帐幕， 橛子永不拔出， 绳索一根也不折断。

chapters.en: But there the Majestic One, our LORD, will be for us a place of rivers and wide canals, where no galley with oars will row, and no majestic vessel will pass.
chapters.zh: 在那里，耶和华必显威严与我们同在， 当作江河宽阔之地； 其中必没有荡桨摇橹的船来往， 也没有威武的船经过。

chapters.en: For the LORD is our Judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our King. It is He who will save us.
chapters.zh: 因为，耶和华是审判我们的； 耶和华是给我们设律法的； 耶和华是我们的王； 他必拯救我们。

chapters.en: Your ropes are slack; they cannot secure the mast or spread the sail. Then an abundance of spoils will be divided, and even the lame will carry off plunder.
chapters.zh: 你的绳索松开： 不能栽稳桅杆， 也不能扬起篷来。 那时许多掳来的物被分了； 瘸腿的把掠物夺去了。

chapters.en:
And no resident of Zion will say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell there
will be forgiven of iniquity.
chapters.zh: 城内居民必不说：我病了； 其中居住的百姓，罪孽都赦免了。

chapters.en: Come near, O nations, to listen; pay attention, O peoples. Let the earth hear, and all that fills it, the world and all that springs from it.
chapters.zh: 列国啊，要近前来听！ 众民哪，要侧耳而听！ 地和其上所充满的， 世界和其中一切所出的都应当听！

chapters.en: The LORD is angry with all the nations and furious with all their armies. He will devote them to destruction; He will give them over to slaughter.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华向万国发忿恨， 向他们的全军发烈怒， 将他们灭尽，交出他们受杀戮。

chapters.en:
Their slain will be left unburied, and the stench of their corpses will rise;
the mountains will flow with their blood.
chapters.zh: 被杀的必然抛弃， 尸首臭气上腾； 诸山被他们的血融化。

chapters.en:
All the stars of heaven will be dissolved. The skies will be rolled up like a scroll, and all their stars will fall like withered leaves from the vine,
like foliage from the fig tree.
chapters.zh: 天上的万象都要消没； 天被卷起，好像书卷。 其上的万象要残败， 像葡萄树的叶子残败， 又像无花果树的〔叶子〕残败一样。

chapters.en:
When My sword has drunk its fill in the heavens, then it will come down upon Edom,
upon the people I have devoted to destruction.
chapters.zh: 因为我的刀在天上已经喝足； 这刀必临到以东和我所咒诅的民， 要施行审判。

chapters.en: The sword of the LORD is bathed in blood. It drips with fat— with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams. For the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的刀满了血， 用脂油和羊羔、公山羊的血， 并公绵羊腰子的脂油滋润的； 因为耶和华在波斯拉有献祭的事， 在以东地大行杀戮。

chapters.en: And the wild oxen will fall with them, the young bulls with the strong ones. Their land will be drenched with blood, and their soil will be soaked with fat.
chapters.zh: 野牛、牛犊，和公牛要一同下来。 他们的地喝醉了血； 他们的尘土因脂油肥润。

chapters.en: For the LORD has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华有报仇之日， 为锡安的争辩有报应之年。

chapters.en:
Edom’s streams will be turned to tar, and her soil to sulfur;
her land will become a blazing pitch.
chapters.zh: 以东的河水要变为石油， 尘埃要变为硫磺； 地土成为烧着的石油，

chapters.en: It will not be quenched—day or night. Its smoke will ascend forever. From generation to generation it will lie desolate; no one will ever again pass through it.
chapters.zh: 昼夜总不熄灭， 烟气永远上腾， 必世世代代成为荒废， 永永远远无人经过。

chapters.en:
The desert owl and screech owl will possess it, and the great owl and raven will dwell in it.
The LORD will stretch out over Edom a measuring line of chaos
and a plumb line of destruction.
chapters.zh: 鹈鹕、箭猪却要得为业； 猫头鹰、乌鸦要住在其间。 耶和华必将空虚的准绳， 混沌的线铊，拉在其上。

chapters.en: No nobles will be left to proclaim a king, and all her princes will come to nothing.
chapters.zh: 以东人要召贵胄来治国； 那里却无一个， 首领也都归于无有。

chapters.en: Her towers will be overgrown with thorns, her fortresses with thistles and briers. She will become a haunt for jackals, an abode for ostriches.
chapters.zh: 以东的宫殿要长荆棘； 保障要长蒺藜和刺草； 要作野狗的住处， 鸵鸟的居所。

chapters.en: The desert creatures will meet with hyenas, and one wild goat will call to another. There the night creature will settle and find her place of repose.
chapters.zh: 旷野的走兽要和豺狼相遇； 野山羊要与伴偶对叫。 夜间的怪物必在那里栖身， 自找安歇之处。

chapters.en:
There the owl will make her nest; she will lay and hatch her eggs
and gather her brood under her shadow. Even there the birds of prey will gather, each with its mate.
chapters.zh: 箭蛇要在那里做窝， 下蛋，菢蛋，生子， 聚子在其影下； 鹞鹰各与伴偶聚集在那里。

chapters.en:
Search and read the scroll of the LORD:
Not one of these will go missing, not one will lack her mate, because He has ordered it by His mouth, and He will gather them by His Spirit.
chapters.zh: 你们要查考宣读耶和华的书。 这都无一缺少， 无一没有伴偶； 因为我的口已经吩咐， 他的灵将牠们聚集。

chapters.en: He has allotted their portion; His hand has distributed it by measure. They will possess it forever; they will dwell in it from generation to generation.
chapters.zh: 他也为牠们拈鬮， 又亲手用准绳给牠们分地； 牠们必永得为业， 世世代代住在其间。

chapters.en: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad; the desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.
chapters.zh: 旷野和干旱之地必然欢喜； 沙漠也必快乐； 又像玫瑰开花，

chapters.en: It will bloom profusely and rejoice with joy and singing. The glory of Lebanon will be given to it, the splendor of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the glory of the LORD, the splendor of our God.
chapters.zh: 必开花繁盛， 乐上加乐，而且欢呼。 黎巴嫩的荣耀， 并迦密与沙崙的华美，必赐给它。 人必看见耶和华的荣耀， 我们上帝的华美。

chapters.en: Strengthen the limp hands and steady the feeble knees!
chapters.zh: 你们要使软弱的手坚壮， 无力的膝稳固。

chapters.en: Say to those with anxious hearts: “Be strong, do not fear! Behold, your God will come with vengeance. With divine retribution He will come to save you.”
chapters.zh: 对胆怯的人说： 你们要刚强，不要惧怕。 看哪，你们的上帝必来报仇， 必来施行极大的报应； 他必来拯救你们。

chapters.en: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened and the ears of the deaf unstopped.
chapters.zh: 那时，瞎子的眼必睁开； 聋子的耳必开通。

chapters.en: Then the lame will leap like a deer and the mute tongue will shout for joy. For waters will gush forth in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.
chapters.zh: 那时，瘸子必跳跃像鹿； 哑巴的舌头必能歌唱。 在旷野必有水发出； 在沙漠必有河涌流。

chapters.en: The parched ground will become a pool, the thirsty land springs of water. In the haunt where jackals once lay, there will be grass and reeds and papyrus.
chapters.zh: 发光的沙〔注：或译：蜃楼〕要变为水池； 干渴之地要变为泉源。 在野狗躺卧之处， 必有青草、芦苇，和蒲草。

chapters.en:
And there will be a highway called the Way of Holiness. The unclean will not travel it— only those who walk in the Way—
and fools will not stray onto it.
chapters.zh: 在那里必有一条大道， 称为圣路。 污秽人不得经过， 必专为赎民行走； 行路的人虽愚昧， 也不致失迷。

chapters.en: No lion will be there, and no vicious beast will go up on it. Such will not be found there, but the redeemed will walk upon it.
chapters.zh: 在那里必没有狮子， 猛兽也不登这路； 在那里都遇不见， 只有赎民在那里行走。

chapters.en:
So the redeemed of the LORD will return and enter Zion with singing,
crowned with everlasting joy. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee.
chapters.zh: 并且耶和华救赎的民必归回， 歌唱来到锡安； 永乐必归到他们的头上； 他们必得着欢喜快乐， 忧愁叹息尽都逃避。

chapters.en: In the fourteenth year of Hezekiah’s reign, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked and captured all the fortified cities of Judah.
chapters.zh: 希西家王十四年，亚述王西拿基立上来攻击犹大的一切坚固城，将城攻取。

chapters.en: And the king of Assyria sent the Rabshakeh, with a great army, from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. And he stopped by the aqueduct of the upper pool, on the road to the Launderer’s Field.
chapters.zh: 亚述王从拉吉差遣拉伯沙基率领大军往耶路撒冷，到希西家王那里去。他就站在上池的水沟旁，在漂布地的大路上。

chapters.en: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the scribe, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder, went out to him.
chapters.zh: 于是希勒家的儿子家宰以利亚敬，并书记舍伯那和亚萨的儿子史官约亚，出来见拉伯沙基。

chapters.en: The Rabshakeh said to them, “Tell Hezekiah that this is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: What is the basis of this confidence of yours?
chapters.zh: 拉伯沙基对他们说：「你们去告诉希西家说，亚述大王如此说：『你所倚靠的有什么可仗赖的呢？

chapters.en: You claim to have a strategy and strength for war, but these are empty words. In whom are you now trusting, that you have rebelled against me?
chapters.zh: 你说，有打仗的计谋和能力，我看不过是虚话。你到底倚靠谁才背叛我呢？

chapters.en: Look now, you are trusting in Egypt, that splintered reed of a staff that will pierce the hand of anyone who leans on it. Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.
chapters.zh: 看哪，你所倚靠的埃及是那压伤的苇杖，人若靠这杖，就必刺透他的手。埃及王法老向一切倚靠他的人也是这样。

chapters.en: But if you say to me, ‘We trust in the LORD our God,’ is He not the One whose high places and altars Hezekiah has removed, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, ‘You must worship before this altar’?
chapters.zh: 你若对我说：我们倚靠耶和华－我们的上帝。希西家岂不是将上帝的邱坛和祭坛废去，且对犹大和耶路撒冷的人说：你们当在这坛前敬拜吗？

chapters.en: Now, therefore, make a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria. I will give you two thousand horses—if you can put riders on them!
chapters.zh: 现在你把当头给我主亚述王，我给你二千匹马，看你这一面骑马的人够不够。

chapters.en: For how can you repel a single officer among the least of my master’s servants when you depend on Egypt for chariots and horsemen?
chapters.zh: 若不然，怎能打败我主臣仆中最小的军长呢？你竟倚靠埃及的战车马兵吗？

chapters.en: So now, was it apart from the LORD that I have come up against this land to destroy it? The LORD Himself said to me, ‘Go up against this land and destroy it.’”
chapters.zh: 现在我上来攻击毁灭这地，岂没有耶和华的意思吗？耶和华吩咐我说，你上去攻击毁灭这地吧！』」

chapters.en: Then Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to the Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, since we understand it. Do not speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people on the wall.”
chapters.zh: 以利亚敬、舍伯那、约亚对拉伯沙基说：「求你用亚兰言语和仆人说话，因为我们懂得；不要用犹大言语和我们说话，达到城上百姓的耳中。」

chapters.en: But the Rabshakeh replied, “Has my master sent me to speak these words only to you and your master, and not to the men sitting on the wall, who are destined with you to eat their own dung and drink their own urine?”
chapters.zh: 拉伯沙基说：「我主差遣我来，岂是单对你和你的主说这些话吗？不也是对这些坐在城上、要与你们一同吃自己粪喝自己尿的人说吗？」

chapters.en: Then the Rabshakeh stood and called out loudly in Hebrew: “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!
chapters.zh: 于是，拉伯沙基站着，用犹大言语大声喊着说：「你们当听亚述大王的话。

chapters.en: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he cannot deliver you.
chapters.zh: 王如此说：『你们不要被希西家欺哄了，因他不能拯救你们。

chapters.en: Do not let Hezekiah persuade you to trust in the LORD when he says, ‘The LORD will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.’
chapters.zh: 也不要听希西家使你们倚靠耶和华说：耶和华必要拯救我们，这城必不交在亚述王的手中。』

chapters.en: Do not listen to Hezekiah, for this is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me. Then every one of you will eat from his own vine and his own fig tree, and drink water from his own cistern,
chapters.zh: 不要听希西家的话，因亚述王如此说：『你们要与我和好。出来投降我，各人就可以吃自己葡萄树和无花果树的果子，喝自己井里的水。

chapters.en: until I come and take you away to a land like your own—a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
chapters.zh: 等我来领你们到一个地方，与你们本地一样，就是有五谷和新酒之地，有粮食和葡萄园之地。

chapters.en: Do not let Hezekiah mislead you when he says, ‘The LORD will deliver us.’ Has the god of any nation ever delivered his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?
chapters.zh: 你们要谨防，恐怕希西家劝导你们说：耶和华必拯救我们。列国的神有哪一个救他本国脱离亚述王的手呢？

chapters.en: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?
chapters.zh: 哈马和亚珥拔的神在哪里呢？西法瓦音的神在哪里呢？他们曾救撒马利亚脱离我的手吗？

chapters.en: Who among all the gods of these lands has delivered his land from my hand? How then can the LORD deliver Jerusalem from my hand?”
chapters.zh: 这些国的神有谁曾救自己的国脱离我的手呢？难道耶和华能救耶路撒冷脱离我的手吗？』」

chapters.en: But the people remained silent and did not answer a word, for Hezekiah had commanded, “Do not answer him.”
chapters.zh: 百姓静默不言，并不回答一句，因为王曾吩咐说：「不要回答他。」

chapters.en: Then Hilkiah’s son Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the scribe, and Asaph’s son Joah the recorder came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and they relayed to him the words of the Rabshakeh.
chapters.zh: 当下希勒家的儿子家宰以利亚敬和书记舍伯那，并亚萨的儿子史官约亚，都撕裂衣服，来到希西家那里，将拉伯沙基的话告诉了他。

chapters.en: On hearing this report, King Hezekiah tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, and entered the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 希西家王听见就撕裂衣服，披上麻布，进了耶和华的殿，

chapters.en: And he sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the scribe, and the leading priests, all wearing sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz
chapters.zh: 使家宰以利亚敬和书记舍伯那，并祭司中的长老，都披上麻布，去见亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚，

chapters.en: to tell him, “This is what Hezekiah says: Today is a day of distress, rebuke, and disgrace; for children have come to the point of birth, but there is no strength to deliver them.
chapters.zh: 对他说：「希西家如此说：『今日是急难、责罚、凌辱的日子，就如妇人将要生产婴孩，却没有力量生产。

chapters.en: Perhaps the LORD your God will hear the words of the Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to defy the living God, and He will rebuke him for the words that the LORD your God has heard. Therefore lift up a prayer for the remnant that still survives.”
chapters.zh: 或者耶和华－你的上帝听见拉伯沙基的话，就是他主人亚述王打发他来辱骂永生上帝的话；耶和华－你的上帝听见这话就发斥责。故此，求你为余剩的民扬声祷告。』」

chapters.en: So the servants of King Hezekiah went to Isaiah,
chapters.zh: 希西家王的臣仆就去见以赛亚。

chapters.en: who replied, “Tell your master that this is what the LORD says: ‘Do not be afraid of the words you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed Me.
chapters.zh: 以赛亚对他们说：「要这样对你们的主人说，耶和华如此说：『你听见亚述王的仆人亵渎我的话，不要惧怕。

chapters.en: Behold, I will put a spirit in him so that he will hear a rumor and return to his own land, where I will cause him to fall by the sword.’”
chapters.zh: 我必惊动〔注：原文是使灵进入〕他的心；他要听见风声就归回本地，我必使他在那里倒在刀下。』」

chapters.en: When the Rabshakeh heard that the king of Assyria had left Lachish, he withdrew and found the king fighting against Libnah.
chapters.zh: 拉伯沙基回去，正遇见亚述王攻打立拿；原来他早听见亚述王拔营离开拉吉。

chapters.en:
Now Sennacherib had been warned about Tirhakah king of Cush: “He has set out to fight against you.”
On hearing this, Sennacherib sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
chapters.zh: 亚述王听见人论古实王特哈加说：「他出来要与你争战。」亚述王一听见，就打发使者去见希西家，吩咐他们说：

chapters.en:
“Give this message to Hezekiah king of Judah:
‘Do not let your God, in whom you trust, deceive you by saying that Jerusalem will not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
chapters.zh: 「你们对犹大王希西家如此说：『不要听你所倚靠的上帝欺哄你说：耶路撒冷必不交在亚述王的手中。

chapters.en: Surely you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the other countries, devoting them to destruction. Will you then be spared?
chapters.zh: 你总听说亚述诸王向列国所行的乃是尽行灭绝，难道你还能得救吗？

chapters.en: Did the gods of the nations destroyed by my fathers rescue those nations—the gods of Gozan, Haran, and Rezeph, and of the people of Eden in Telassar?
chapters.zh: 我列祖所毁灭的，就是歌散、哈兰、利色，和属提‧拉撒的伊甸人；这些国的神何曾拯救这些国呢？

chapters.en: Where are the kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah?’”
chapters.zh: 哈马的王，亚珥拔的王，西法瓦音城的王，希拿和以瓦的王，都在哪里呢？』」

chapters.en: So Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers, read it, and went up to the house of the LORD and spread it out before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 希西家从使者手里接过书信来，看完了，就上耶和华的殿，将书信在耶和华面前展开。

chapters.en: And Hezekiah prayed to the LORD:
chapters.zh: 希西家向耶和华祷告说：

chapters.en: “O LORD of Hosts, God of Israel, enthroned above the cherubim, You alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You made the heavens and the earth.
chapters.zh: 「坐在二基路伯上万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝啊，你－惟有你是天下万国的上帝，你曾创造天地。

chapters.en: Incline Your ear, O LORD, and hear; open Your eyes, O LORD, and see. Listen to all the words that Sennacherib has sent to defy the living God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你侧耳而听；耶和华啊，求你睁眼而看，要听西拿基立的一切话，他是打发使者来辱骂永生上帝的。

chapters.en: Truly, O LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all these countries and their lands.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，亚述诸王果然使列国和列国之地变为荒凉，

chapters.en: They have cast their gods into the fire and destroyed them, for they were not gods, but only wood and stone—the work of human hands.
chapters.zh: 将列国的神像都扔在火里；因为他本不是神，乃是人手所造的，是木头、石头的，所以灭绝他。

chapters.en: And now, O LORD our God, save us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that You alone, O LORD, are God. ”
chapters.zh: 耶和华－我们的上帝啊，现在求你救我们脱离亚述王的手，使天下万国都知道惟有你是耶和华。」

chapters.en: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent a message to Hezekiah: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Because you have prayed to Me concerning Sennacherib king of Assyria,
chapters.zh: 亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚就打发人去见希西家，说：「耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说，你既然求我攻击亚述王西拿基立，

chapters.en:
this is the word that the LORD has spoken against him:
‘The Virgin Daughter of Zion despises you and mocks you; the Daughter of Jerusalem shakes her head behind you.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华论他这样说： 锡安的处女藐视你，嗤笑你； 耶路撒冷的女子向你摇头。

chapters.en: Whom have you taunted and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes in pride? Against the Holy One of Israel!
chapters.zh: 你辱骂谁，亵渎谁？ 扬起声来，高举眼目攻击谁呢？ 乃是攻击以色列的圣者。

chapters.en: Through your servants you have taunted the Lord, and you have said: “With my many chariots I have ascended to the heights of the mountains, to the remote peaks of Lebanon. I have cut down its tallest cedars, the finest of its cypresses. I have reached its farthest heights, the densest of its forests.
chapters.zh: 你藉你的臣仆辱骂主说： 我率领许多战车上山顶， 到黎巴嫩极深之处； 我要砍伐其中高大的香柏树 和佳美的松树。 我必上极高之处， 进入肥田的树林。

chapters.en: I have dug wells and drunk foreign waters. With the soles of my feet I have dried up all the streams of Egypt.”
chapters.zh: 我已经挖井喝水； 我必用脚掌踏干埃及的一切河。

chapters.en: Have you not heard? Long ago I ordained it; in days of old I planned it. Now I have brought it to pass, that you should crush fortified cities into piles of rubble.
chapters.zh: 〔耶和华说〕：你岂没有听见 我早先所做的、古时所立的吗？ 现在藉你使坚固城荒废，变为乱堆。

chapters.en: Therefore their inhabitants, devoid of power, are dismayed and ashamed. They are like plants in the field, tender green shoots, grass on the rooftops, scorched before it is grown.
chapters.zh: 所以其中的居民力量甚小， 惊惶羞愧。 他们像野草，像青菜， 如房顶上的草， 又如田间未长成的〔禾稼〕。

chapters.en:
But I know your sitting down, your going out and coming in,
and your raging against Me.
chapters.zh: 你坐下，你出去，你进来， 你向我发烈怒，我都知道。

chapters.en: Because your rage and arrogance against Me have reached My ears, I will put My hook in your nose and My bit in your mouth; I will send you back the way you came.’
chapters.zh: 因你向我发烈怒， 又因你狂傲〔的话〕达到我耳中， 我就要用钩子钩上你的鼻子， 把嚼环放在你口里， 使你从原路转回去。

chapters.en:
And this will be a sign to you, O Hezekiah:
This year you will eat what grows on its own, and in the second year what springs from the same. But in the third year you will sow and reap; you will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
chapters.zh: 「以色列人哪，我赐你们一个证据：你们今年要吃自生的，明年也要吃自长的，至于后年，你们要耕种收割，栽植葡萄园，吃其中的果子。

chapters.en:
And the surviving remnant of the house of Judah will again take root below
and bear fruit above.
chapters.zh: 犹大家所逃脱余剩的，仍要往下扎根，向上结果。

chapters.en: For a remnant will go forth from Jerusalem, and survivors from Mount Zion. The zeal of the LORD of Hosts will accomplish this.
chapters.zh: 必有余剩的民从耶路撒冷而出；必有逃脱的人从锡安山而来。万军之耶和华的热心必成就这事。

chapters.en:
So this is what the LORD says about the king of Assyria:
‘He will not enter this city or shoot an arrow into it. He will not come before it with a shield or build up a siege ramp against it.
chapters.zh: 「所以耶和华论亚述王如此说：他必不得来到这城，也不在这里射箭，不得拿盾牌到城前，也不筑垒攻城。

chapters.en: He will go back the way he came, and he will not enter this city,’ declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他从哪条路来，必从那条路回去，必不得来到这城。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: ‘I will defend this city and save it for My own sake and for the sake of My servant David.’”
chapters.zh: 因我为自己的缘故，又为我仆人大卫的缘故，必保护拯救这城。」

chapters.en: Then the angel of the LORD went out and struck down 185,000 men in the camp of the Assyrians. When the people got up the next morning, there were all the dead bodies!
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者出去，在亚述营中杀了十八万五千人。清早有人起来一看，都是死尸了。

chapters.en: So Sennacherib king of Assyria broke camp and withdrew. He returned to Nineveh and stayed there.
chapters.zh: 亚述王西拿基立就拔营回去，住在尼尼微。

chapters.en: One day, while he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer put him to the sword and escaped to the land of Ararat. And his son Esar-haddon reigned in his place.
chapters.zh: 一日在他的神－尼斯洛庙里叩拜，他儿子亚得米勒和沙利色用刀杀了他，就逃到亚拉腊地。他儿子以撒哈顿接续他作王。

chapters.en: In those days Hezekiah became mortally ill. The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz came to him and said, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Put your house in order, for you are about to die; you will not recover.’”
chapters.zh: 那时希西家病得要死，亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚去见他，对他说：「耶和华如此说：你当留遗命与你的家，因为你必死不能活了。」

chapters.en: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD,
chapters.zh: 希西家就转脸朝墙，祷告耶和华说：

chapters.en: saying, “Please, O LORD, remember how I have walked before You faithfully and with wholehearted devotion; I have done what is good in Your sight.” And Hezekiah wept bitterly.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华啊，求你记念我在你面前怎样存完全的心，按诚实行事，又做你眼中所看为善的。」希西家就痛哭了。

chapters.en: And the word of the LORD came to Isaiah, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到以赛亚说：

chapters.en: “Go and tell Hezekiah that this is what the LORD, the God of your father David, says: ‘I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears. Behold, I will add fifteen years to your life.
chapters.zh: 「你去告诉希西家说，耶和华－你祖大卫的上帝如此说：我听见了你的祷告，看见了你的眼泪。我必加增你十五年的寿数；

chapters.en: And I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city.
