chapters.zh: 并且我要救你和这城脱离亚述王的手，也要保护这城。

chapters.en: This will be a sign to you from the LORD that He will do what He has promised:
chapters.zh: 「我－耶和华必成就我所说的。我先给你一个兆头，

chapters.en:
I will make the sun’s shadow that falls on the stairway of Ahaz go back ten steps.’”
So the sunlight went back the ten steps it had descended.
chapters.zh: 就是叫亚哈斯的日晷，向前进的日影往后退十度。」于是，前进的日影果然在日晷上往后退了十度。

chapters.en: This is a writing by Hezekiah king of Judah after his illness and recovery:
chapters.zh: 犹大王希西家患病已经痊愈，就作诗说：

chapters.en:
I said, “In the prime of my life I must go through the gates of Sheol
and be deprived of the remainder of my years.”
chapters.zh: 我说：正在我中年〔注：或译：晌午〕之日 必进入阴间的门； 我余剩的年岁不得享受。

chapters.en: I said, “I will never again see the LORD, even the LORD, in the land of the living; I will no longer look on mankind with those who dwell in this world.
chapters.zh: 我说：我必不得见耶和华， 就是在活人之地不见耶和华； 我与世上的居民不再见面。

chapters.en:
My dwelling has been picked up and removed from me like a shepherd’s tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver; He cuts me off from the loom;
from day until night You make an end of me.
chapters.zh: 我的住处被迁去离开我， 好像牧人的帐棚一样； 我将性命卷起， 像织布的卷布一样。 耶和华必将我从机头剪断， 从早到晚，他要使我完结。

chapters.en:
I composed myself until the morning. Like a lion He breaks all my bones;
from day until night You make an end of me.
chapters.zh: 我使自己安静直到天亮； 他像狮子折断我一切的骨头， 从早到晚，他要使我完结。

chapters.en: I chirp like a swallow or crane; I moan like a dove. My eyes grow weak as I look upward. O Lord, I am oppressed; be my security.”
chapters.zh: 我像燕子呢喃， 像白鹤鸣叫， 又像鸽子哀鸣； 我因仰观，眼睛困倦。 耶和华啊，我受欺压， 求你为我作保。

chapters.en: What can I say? He has spoken to me, and He Himself has done this. I will walk slowly all my years because of the anguish of my soul.
chapters.zh: 我可说什么呢？ 他应许我的，也给我成就了。 我因心里的苦楚， 在一生的年日必悄悄而行。

chapters.en: O Lord, by such things men live, and in all of them my spirit finds life. You have restored me to health and have let me live.
chapters.zh: 主啊，人得存活乃在乎此。 我灵存活也全在此。 所以求你使我痊愈，仍然存活。

chapters.en: Surely for my own welfare I had such great anguish; but Your love has delivered me from the pit of oblivion, for You have cast all my sins behind Your back.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我受大苦，本为使我得平安； 你因爱我的灵魂〔注：或译：生命〕便救我脱离败坏的坑， 因为你将我一切的罪扔在你的背后。

chapters.en: For Sheol cannot thank You; Death cannot praise You. Those who descend to the Pit cannot hope for Your faithfulness.
chapters.zh: 原来，阴间不能称谢你， 死亡不能颂扬你； 下坑的人不能盼望你的诚实。

chapters.en: The living, only the living, can thank You, as I do today; fathers will tell their children about Your faithfulness.
chapters.zh: 只有活人，活人必称谢你， 像我今日称谢你一样。 为父的，必使儿女知道你的诚实。

chapters.en: The LORD will save me; we will play songs on stringed instruments all the days of our lives in the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华〔肯〕救我， 所以，我们要一生一世 在耶和华殿中 用丝弦的乐器唱我的诗歌。

chapters.en: Now Isaiah had said, “Prepare a lump of pressed figs and apply it to the boil, and he will recover.”
chapters.zh: 以赛亚说：「当取一块无花果饼来，贴在疮上，王必痊愈。」

chapters.en: And Hezekiah had asked, “What will be the sign that I will go up to the house of the LORD?”
chapters.zh: 希西家问说：「我能上耶和华的殿，有什么兆头呢？」

chapters.en: At that time Merodach-baladan son of Baladan king of Babylon sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah, for he had heard about Hezekiah’s illness and recovery.
chapters.zh: 那时，巴比伦王巴拉但的儿子米罗达‧巴拉但听见希西家病而痊愈，就送书信和礼物给他。

chapters.en: And Hezekiah welcomed the envoys gladly and showed them what was in his treasure house—the silver, the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, as well as his entire armory—all that was found in his storehouses. There was nothing in his palace or in all his dominion that Hezekiah did not show them.
chapters.zh: 希西家喜欢见使者，就把自己宝库的金子、银子、香料、贵重的膏油，和他武库的一切军器，并所有的财宝都给他们看；他家中和全国之内，希西家没有一样不给他们看的。

chapters.en:
Then the prophet Isaiah went to King Hezekiah and asked, “Where did those men come from, and what did they say to you?”
“They came to me from a distant land,” Hezekiah replied, “from Babylon.”
chapters.zh: 于是先知以赛亚来见希西家王，问他说：「这些人说什么？他们从哪里来见你？」希西家说：「他们从远方的巴比伦来见我。」

chapters.en:
“What have they seen in your palace?” Isaiah asked.
“They have seen everything in my palace,” answered Hezekiah. “There is nothing among my treasures that I did not show them.”
chapters.zh: 以赛亚说：「他们在你家里看见了什么？」希西家说：「凡我家中所有的，他们都看见了；我财宝中没有一样不给他们看的。」

chapters.en: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of the LORD of Hosts:
chapters.zh: 以赛亚对希西家说：「你要听万军之耶和华的话：

chapters.en: The time will surely come when everything in your palace and all that your fathers have stored up until this day will be carried off to Babylon. Nothing will be left, says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 日子必到，凡你家里所有的，并你列祖积蓄到如今的，都要被掳到巴比伦去，不留下一样；这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: And some of your descendants, your own flesh and blood, will be taken away to be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.”
chapters.zh: 并且从你本身所生的众子，其中必有被掳去、在巴比伦王宫里当太监的。」

chapters.en: But Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “The word of the LORD that you have spoken is good.” For he thought, “At least there will be peace and security in my lifetime.”
chapters.zh: 希西家对以赛亚说：「你所说耶和华的话甚好，因为在我的年日中必有太平和稳固的景况。」

chapters.en: “Comfort, comfort My people,” says your God.
chapters.zh: 你们的上帝说： 你们要安慰，安慰我的百姓。

chapters.en: “Speak tenderly to Jerusalem, and proclaim to her that her forced labor has been completed; her iniquity has been pardoned. For she has received from the hand of the LORD double for all her sins.”
chapters.zh: 要对耶路撒冷说安慰的话， 又向她宣告〔说〕， 她争战的日子已满了； 她的罪孽赦免了； 她为自己的一切罪， 从耶和华手中加倍受罚。

chapters.en:
A voice of one calling:
“Prepare the way for the LORD in the wilderness; make a straight highway for our God in the desert.
chapters.zh: 有人声喊着说： 在旷野预备耶和华的路〔注：或译：在旷野，有人声喊着说：当预备耶和华的路〕， 在沙漠地修平我们上帝的道。

chapters.en: Every valley shall be lifted up, and every mountain and hill made low; the uneven ground will become smooth, and the rugged land a plain.
chapters.zh: 一切山洼都要填满， 大小山冈都要削平； 高高低低的要改为平坦， 崎崎岖岖的必成为平原。

chapters.en: And the glory of the LORD will be revealed, and all humanity together will see it.” For the mouth of the LORD has spoken.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的荣耀必然显现； 凡有血气的必一同看见； 因为这是耶和华亲口说的。

chapters.en: A voice says, “Cry out!” And I asked, “What should I cry out?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field.
chapters.zh: 有人声说：你喊叫吧！ 有一个说：我喊叫什么呢？ 〔说〕：凡有血气的尽都如草； 他的美容都像野地的花。

chapters.en:
The grass withers and the flowers fall when the breath of the LORD blows on them;
indeed, the people are grass.
chapters.zh: 草必枯干，花必凋残， 因为耶和华的气吹在其上； 百姓诚然是草。

chapters.en: The grass withers and the flowers fall, but the word of our God stands forever.”
chapters.zh: 草必枯干，花必凋残， 惟有我们上帝的话必永远立定。

chapters.en: Go up on a high mountain, O Zion, herald of good news. Raise your voice loudly, O Jerusalem, herald of good news. Lift it up, do not be afraid! Say to the cities of Judah, “Here is your God!”
chapters.zh: 报好信息给锡安的啊， 你要登高山； 报好信息给耶路撒冷的啊， 你要极力扬声。 扬声不要惧怕， 对犹大的城邑说： 看哪，你们的上帝！

chapters.en: Behold, the Lord GOD comes with might, and His arm establishes His rule. His reward is with Him, and His recompense accompanies Him.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华必像大能者临到； 他的膀臂必为他掌权。 他的赏赐在他那里； 他的报应在他面前。

chapters.en: He tends His flock like a shepherd; He gathers the lambs in His arms and carries them close to His heart. He gently leads the nursing ewes.
chapters.zh: 他必像牧人牧养自己的羊群， 用膀臂聚集羊羔抱在怀中， 慢慢引导那乳养小羊的。

chapters.en:
Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, or marked off the heavens with the span of his hand? Who has held the dust of the earth in a basket, or weighed the mountains on a scale
and the hills with a balance?
chapters.zh: 谁曾用手心量诸水， 用手虎口量苍天， 用升斗盛大地的尘土， 用秤称山岭， 用天平平冈陵呢？

chapters.en: Who has directed the Spirit of the LORD, or informed Him as His counselor?
chapters.zh: 谁曾测度耶和华的心〔注：或译：谁曾指示耶和华的灵〕， 或作他的谋士指教他呢？

chapters.en: Whom did He consult to enlighten Him, and who taught Him the paths of justice? Who imparted knowledge to Him and showed Him the way of understanding?
chapters.zh: 他与谁商议，谁教导他， 谁将公平的路指示他， 又将知识教训他， 将通达的道指教他呢？

chapters.en:
Surely the nations are like a drop in a bucket; they are considered a speck of dust on the scales;
He lifts up the islands like fine dust.
chapters.zh: 看哪，万民都像水桶的一滴， 又算如天平上的微尘； 他举起众海岛，好像极微之物。

chapters.en: Lebanon is not sufficient for fuel, nor its animals enough for a burnt offering.
chapters.zh: 黎巴嫩〔的树林〕不够当柴烧； 其中的走兽也不够作燔祭。

chapters.en: All the nations are as nothing before Him; He regards them as nothingness and emptiness.
chapters.zh: 万民在他面前好像虚无， 被他看为不及虚无，乃为虚空。

chapters.en: To whom will you liken God? To what image will you compare Him?
chapters.zh: 你们究竟将谁比上帝， 用什么形像与上帝比较呢？

chapters.en:
To an idol that a craftsman casts and a metalworker overlays with gold
and fits with silver chains?
chapters.zh: 偶像是匠人铸造， 银匠用金包裹， 〔为它〕铸造银鍊。

chapters.en: One lacking such an offering chooses wood that will not rot. He seeks a skilled craftsman to set up an idol that will not topple.
chapters.zh: 穷乏献不起〔这样〕供物的， 就拣选不能朽坏的树木， 为自己寻找巧匠， 立起不能摇动的偶像。

chapters.en: Do you not know? Have you not heard? Has it not been declared to you from the beginning? Have you not understood since the foundation of the earth?
chapters.zh: 你们岂不曾知道吗？ 你们岂不曾听见吗？ 从起初岂没有人告诉你们吗？ 自从立地的根基， 你们岂没有明白吗？

chapters.en: He sits enthroned above the circle of the earth; its dwellers are like grasshoppers. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in.
chapters.zh: 上帝坐在地球大圈之上； 地上的居民好像蝗虫。 他铺张穹苍如幔子， 展开诸天如可住的帐棚。

chapters.en: He brings the princes to nothing and makes the rulers of the earth meaningless.
chapters.zh: 他使君王归于虚无， 使地上的审判官成为虚空。

chapters.en: No sooner are they planted, no sooner are they sown, no sooner have their stems taken root in the ground, than He blows on them and they wither, and a whirlwind sweeps them away like stubble.
chapters.zh: 他们是刚才〔注：或译：不曾；下同〕栽上， 刚才种上， 根也刚才扎在地里， 他一吹在其上，便都枯干； 旋风将他们吹去，像碎诩一样。

chapters.en: “To whom will you liken Me, or who is My equal?” asks the Holy One.
chapters.zh: 那圣者说：你们将谁比我， 叫他与我相等呢？

chapters.en: Lift up your eyes on high: Who created all these? He leads forth the starry host by number; He calls each one by name. Because of His great power and mighty strength, not one of them is missing.
chapters.zh: 你们向上举目， 看谁创造这万象， 按数目领出， 他一一称其名； 因他的权能， 又因他的大能大力， 连一个都不缺。

chapters.en: Why do you say, O Jacob, and why do you assert, O Israel, “My way is hidden from the LORD, and my claim is ignored by my God”?
chapters.zh: 雅各啊，你为何说， 我的道路向耶和华隐藏？ 以色列啊，你为何言， 我的冤屈上帝并不查问？

chapters.en: Do you not know? Have you not heard? The LORD is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He will not grow tired or weary; His understanding is beyond searching out.
chapters.zh: 你岂不曾知道吗？ 你岂不曾听见吗？ 永在的上帝耶和华，创造地极的〔主〕， 并不疲乏，也不困倦； 他的智慧无法测度。

chapters.en: He gives power to the faint and increases the strength of the weak.
chapters.zh: 疲乏的，他赐能力； 软弱的，他加力量。

chapters.en: Even youths grow tired and weary, and young men stumble and fall.
chapters.zh: 就是少年人也要疲乏困倦； 强壮的也必全然跌倒。

chapters.en: But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.
chapters.zh: 但那等候耶和华的必重新得力。 他们必如鹰展翅上腾； 他们奔跑却不困倦， 行走却不疲乏。

chapters.en: “Be silent before Me, O islands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come forward and testify; let us together draw near for judgment.
chapters.zh: 众海岛啊，当在我面前静默； 众民当重新得力， 都要近前来才可以说话， 我们可以彼此辩论。

chapters.en: Who has aroused one from the east and called him to his feet in righteousness ? He hands nations over to him and subdues kings before him. He turns them to dust with his sword, to windblown chaff with his bow.
chapters.zh: 谁从东方兴起一人， 凭公义召他来到脚前呢？ 耶和华将列国交给他， 使他管辖君王， 把他们如灰尘交与他的刀， 如风吹的碎诩交与他的弓。

chapters.en: He pursues them, going on safely, hardly touching the path with his feet.
chapters.zh: 他追赶他们， 走他所未走的道， 坦然前行。

chapters.en: Who has performed this and carried it out, calling forth the generations from the beginning? I, the LORD—the first and the last— I am He.”
chapters.zh: 谁行做成就这事， 从起初宣召历代呢？ 就是我－耶和华！ 我是首先的， 也与末后的同在。

chapters.en:
The islands see and fear; the ends of the earth tremble.
They approach and come forward.
chapters.zh: 海岛看见就都害怕； 地极也都战兢， 就近前来。

chapters.en: Each one helps the other and says to his brother, “Be strong!”
chapters.zh: 他们各人帮助邻舍， 〔各人〕对弟兄说：壮胆吧！

chapters.en:
The craftsman encourages the goldsmith, and he who wields the hammer
cheers him who strikes the anvil, saying of the welding, “It is good.” He nails it down so it will not be toppled.
chapters.zh: 木匠勉励银匠， 用锤打光的勉励打砧的， 论銲工说，銲得好； 又用钉子钉稳，免得〔偶像〕动摇。

chapters.en:
“But you, O Israel, My servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen,
descendant of Abraham My friend—
chapters.zh: 惟你以色列－我的仆人， 雅各－我所拣选的， 我朋友亚伯拉罕的后裔，

chapters.en: I brought you from the ends of the earth and called you from its farthest corners. I said, ‘You are My servant.’ I have chosen and not rejected you.
chapters.zh: 你是我从地极所领〔注：原文是抓〕来的， 从地角所召来的， 且对你说：你是我的仆人； 我拣选你，并不弃绝你。

chapters.en: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.
chapters.zh: 你不要害怕，因为我与你同在； 不要惊惶，因为我是你的上帝。 我必坚固你，我必帮助你； 我必用我公义的右手扶持你。

chapters.en: Behold, all who rage against you will be ashamed and disgraced; those who contend with you will be reduced to nothing and will perish.
chapters.zh: 凡向你发怒的必都抱愧蒙羞； 与你相争的必如无有，并要灭亡。

chapters.en: You will seek them but will not find them. Those who wage war against you will come to nothing.
chapters.zh: 与你争竞的，你要找他们也找不着； 与你争战的必如无有，成为虚无。

chapters.en: For I am the LORD your God, who takes hold of your right hand and tells you: Do not fear, I will help you.
chapters.zh: 因为我耶和华－ 你的上帝必搀扶你的右手， 对你说：不要害怕！ 我必帮助你。

chapters.en: Do not fear, O Jacob, you worm, O few men of Israel. I will help you,” declares the LORD. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
chapters.zh: 你这虫雅各和你们以色列人， 不要害怕！ 耶和华说：我必帮助你。 你的救赎主就是以色列的圣者。

chapters.en: Behold, I will make you into a threshing sledge, new and sharp, with many teeth. You will thresh the mountains and crush them, and reduce the hills to chaff.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我已使你成为 有快齿打粮的新器具； 你要把山岭打得粉碎， 使冈陵如同糠秕。

chapters.en: You will winnow them, and a wind will carry them away; a gale will scatter them. But you will rejoice in the LORD; you will glory in the Holy One of Israel.
chapters.zh: 你要把它簸扬，风要吹去； 旋风要把它刮散。 你倒要以耶和华为喜乐， 以以色列的圣者为夸耀。

chapters.en: The poor and needy seek water, but there is none; their tongues are parched with thirst. I, the LORD, will answer them; I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
chapters.zh: 困苦穷乏人寻求水却没有； 他们因口渴，舌头干燥。 我－耶和华必应允他们； 我－以色列的上帝必不离弃他们。

chapters.en: I will open rivers on the barren heights, and fountains in the middle of the valleys. I will turn the desert into a pool of water, and the dry land into flowing springs.
chapters.zh: 我要在净光的高处开江河， 在谷中开泉源； 我要使沙漠变为水池， 使干地变为涌泉。

chapters.en: I will plant cedars in the wilderness, acacias, myrtles, and olive trees. I will set cypresses in the desert, elms and boxwood together,
chapters.zh: 我要在旷野种上香柏树、 皂荚树、番石榴树，和野橄榄树。 我在沙漠要把松树、杉树， 并黄杨树一同栽植；

chapters.en: so that all may see and know, may consider and understand, that the hand of the LORD has done this and the Holy One of Israel has created it.”
chapters.zh: 好叫人看见、知道、 思想、明白； 这是耶和华的手所做的， 是以色列的圣者所造的。

chapters.en: “Present your case,” says the LORD. “Submit your arguments,” says the King of Jacob.
chapters.zh: 耶和华〔对假神〕说： 你们要呈上你们的案件； 雅各的君说： 你们要声明你们确实的理由。

chapters.en: “Let them come and tell us what will happen. Tell the former things, so that we may reflect on them and know the outcome. Or announce to us what is coming.
chapters.zh: 可以声明，指示我们将来必遇的事， 说明先前的是什么事， 好叫我们思索，得知事的结局， 或者把将来的事指示我们。

chapters.en: Tell us the things that are to come, so that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do something good or evil, that we may look on together in dismay.
chapters.zh: 要说明后来的事， 好叫我们知道你们是神。 你们或降福，或降祸， 使我们惊奇，一同观看。

chapters.en:
Behold, you are nothing and your work is of no value.
Anyone who chooses you is detestable.
chapters.zh: 看哪，你们属乎虚无； 你们的作为也属乎虚空。 那选择你们的是可憎恶的。

chapters.en: I have raised up one from the north, and he has come— one from the east who calls on My name. He will march over rulers as if they were mortar, like a potter who treads the clay.
chapters.zh: 我从北方兴起一人； 他是求告我名的， 从日出之地而来。 他必临到掌权的， 好像临到灰泥， 仿佛窑匠踹泥一样。

chapters.en: Who has declared this from the beginning, so that we may know, and from times past, so that we may say: ‘He was right’? No one announced it, no one foretold it, no one heard your words.
chapters.zh: 谁从起初指明这事，使我们知道呢？ 谁从先前说明，使我们说〔他〕不错呢？ 谁也没有指明； 谁也没有说明； 谁也没有听见你们的话。

chapters.en: I was the first to tell Zion: ‘Look, here they are!’ And I gave to Jerusalem a herald of good news.
chapters.zh: 我首先对锡安〔说〕： 看哪，我要将一位报好信息的赐给耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: When I look, there is no one; there is no counselor among them; when I ask them, they have nothing to say.
chapters.zh: 我看的时候并没有人； 我问的时候， 他们中间也没有谋士可以回答一句。

chapters.en:
See, they are all a delusion; their works amount to nothing;
their images are as empty as the wind.
chapters.zh: 看哪，他们和他们的工作都是虚空， 且是虚无。 他们所铸的偶像都是风， 都是虚的。

chapters.en: “Here is My Servant, whom I uphold, My Chosen One, in whom My soul delights. I will put My Spirit on Him, and He will bring justice to the nations.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我的仆人－ 我所扶持所拣选、心里所喜悦的！ 我已将我的灵赐给他； 他必将公理传给外邦。

chapters.en: He will not cry out or raise His voice, nor make His voice heard in the streets.
chapters.zh: 他不喧嚷，不扬声， 也不使街上听见他的声音。

chapters.en:
A bruised reed He will not break and a smoldering wick He will not extinguish;
He will faithfully bring forth justice.
chapters.zh: 压伤的芦苇，他不折断； 将残的灯火，他不吹灭。 他凭真实将公理传开。

chapters.en:
He will not grow weak or discouraged before He has established justice on the earth.
In His law the islands will put their hope.”
chapters.zh: 他不灰心，也不丧胆， 直到他在地上设立公理； 海岛都等候他的训诲。

chapters.en: This is what God the LORD says— He who created the heavens and stretched them out, who spread out the earth and its offspring, who gives breath to the people on it and life to those who walk in it:
chapters.zh: 创造诸天，铺张穹苍， 将地和地所出的一并铺开， 赐气息给地上的众人， 又赐灵性给行在其上之人的上帝耶和华， 他如此说：

chapters.en: “I, the LORD, have called you for a righteous purpose, and I will take hold of your hand. I will keep you and appoint you to be a covenant for the people and a light to the nations,
chapters.zh: 我－耶和华凭公义召你， 必搀扶你的手，保守你， 使你作众民的中保〔注：中保：原文是约〕， 作外邦人的光，

chapters.en: to open the eyes of the blind, to bring prisoners out of the dungeon and those sitting in darkness out from the prison house.
chapters.zh: 开瞎子的眼， 领被囚的出牢狱， 领坐黑暗的出监牢。

chapters.en: I am the LORD; that is My name! I will not yield My glory to another or My praise to idols.
chapters.zh: 我是耶和华，这是我的名； 我必不将我的荣耀归给假神， 也不将我的称赞归给雕刻的偶像。

chapters.en: Behold, the former things have happened, and now I declare new things. Before they spring forth I proclaim them to you.”
chapters.zh: 看哪，先前的事已经成就， 现在我将新事说明， 这事未发以先，我就说给你们听。

chapters.en: Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise from the ends of the earth— you who go down to the sea, and all that is in it, you islands, and all who dwell in them.
chapters.zh: 航海的和海中所有的， 海岛和其上的居民， 都当向耶和华唱新歌， 从地极赞美他。

chapters.en: Let the desert and its cities raise their voices; let the villages of Kedar cry aloud. Let the people of Sela sing for joy; let them cry out from the mountaintops.
chapters.zh: 旷野和其中的城邑， 并基达人居住的村庄都当扬声； 西拉的居民当欢呼， 在山顶上吶喊。

chapters.en: Let them give glory to the LORD and declare His praise in the islands.
chapters.zh: 他们当将荣耀归给耶和华， 在海岛中传扬他的颂赞。

chapters.en: The LORD goes forth like a mighty one; He stirs up His zeal like a warrior. He shouts; yes, He roars in triumph over His enemies:
chapters.zh: 耶和华必像勇士出去， 必像战士激动热心， 要喊叫，大声吶喊， 要用大力攻击仇敌。

chapters.en: “I have kept silent from ages past; I have remained quiet and restrained. But now I will groan like a woman in labor; I will at once gasp and pant.
chapters.zh: 我许久闭口不言，静默不语； 〔现在〕我要喊叫，像产难的妇人； 我要急气而喘哮。

chapters.en: I will lay waste the mountains and hills and dry up all their vegetation. I will turn the rivers into dry land and drain the marshes.
chapters.zh: 我要使大山小冈变为荒场， 使其上的花草都枯干； 我要使江河变为洲岛， 使水池都干涸。

chapters.en: I will lead the blind by a way they did not know; I will guide them on unfamiliar paths. I will turn darkness into light before them and rough places into level ground. These things I will do for them, and I will not forsake them.
chapters.zh: 我要引瞎子行不认识的道， 领他们走不知道的路； 在他们面前使黑暗变为光明， 使弯曲变为平直。 这些事我都要行， 并不离弃他们。

chapters.en:
But those who trust in idols and say to molten images, ‘You are our gods!’
will be turned back in utter shame.
chapters.zh: 倚靠雕刻的偶像， 对铸造的偶像说： 你是我们的神； 这等人要退后，全然蒙羞。

chapters.en: Listen, you deaf ones; look, you blind ones, that you may see!
chapters.zh: 你们这耳聋的，听吧！ 你们这眼瞎的，看吧！ 使你们能看见。

chapters.en: Who is blind but My servant, or deaf like the messenger I am sending? Who is blind like My covenant partner, or blind like the servant of the LORD?
chapters.zh: 谁比我的仆人眼瞎呢？ 谁比我差遣的使者耳聋呢？ 谁瞎眼像那〔与我〕和好的？ 谁瞎眼像耶和华的仆人呢？

chapters.en: Though seeing many things, you do not keep watch. Though your ears are open, you do not hear.”
chapters.zh: 你看见许多事却不领会， 耳朵开通却不听见。

chapters.en: The LORD was pleased, for the sake of His righteousness, to magnify His law and make it glorious.
chapters.zh: 耶和华因自己公义的缘故， 喜欢使律法〔注：或译：训诲〕为大，为尊。

chapters.en: But this is a people plundered and looted, all trapped in caves or imprisoned in dungeons. They have become plunder with no one to rescue them, and loot with no one to say, “Send them back!”
chapters.zh: 但这百姓是被抢被夺的， 都牢笼在坑中，隐藏在狱里； 他们作掠物，无人拯救， 作掳物，无人说交还。

chapters.en: Who among you will pay attention to this? Who will listen and obey hereafter?
chapters.zh: 你们中间谁肯侧耳听此， 谁肯留心而听，以防将来呢？

chapters.en: Who gave Jacob up for spoil, and Israel to the plunderers? Was it not the LORD, against whom we have sinned? They were unwilling to walk in His ways, and they would not obey His law.
chapters.zh: 谁将雅各交出当作掳物， 将以色列交给抢夺的呢？ 岂不是耶和华吗？ 就是我们所得罪的那位。 他们不肯遵行他的道， 也不听从他的训诲。

chapters.en: So He poured out on them His furious anger and the fierceness of battle. It enveloped them in flames, but they did not understand; it consumed them, but they did not take it to heart.
chapters.zh: 所以，他将猛烈的怒气和争战的勇力 倾倒在以色列的身上。 在他四围如火着起，他还不知道， 烧着他，他也不介意。

chapters.en:
But now, this is what the LORD says— He who created you, O Jacob,
and He who formed you, O Israel:
“Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine!
chapters.zh: 雅各啊，创造你的耶和华， 以色列啊，造成你的那位， 现在如此说： 你不要害怕！因为我救赎了你。 我曾提你的名召你，你是属我的。

chapters.en:
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and when you go through the rivers, they will not overwhelm you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be scorched;
the flames will not set you ablaze.
chapters.zh: 你从水中经过，我必与你同在； 你诜过江河，水必不漫过你； 你从火中行过，必不被烧， 火焰也不着在你身上。

chapters.en: For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I give Egypt for your ransom, Cush and Seba in your place.
chapters.zh: 因为我是耶和华－你的上帝， 是以色列的圣者－你的救主； 我已经使埃及作你的赎价， 使古实和西巴代替你。

chapters.en: Because you are precious and honored in My sight, and because I love you, I will give men in exchange for you and nations in place of your life.
chapters.zh: 因我看你为宝为尊； 又因我爱你， 所以我使人代替你， 使列邦人替换你的生命。

chapters.en:
Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bring your offspring from the east
and gather you from the west.
chapters.zh: 不要害怕，因我与你同在； 我必领你的后裔从东方来， 又从西方招聚你。

chapters.en: I will say to the north, ‘Give them up!’ and to the south, ‘Do not hold them back!’ Bring My sons from afar, and My daughters from the ends of the earth—
chapters.zh: 我要对北方说，交出来！ 对南方说，不要拘留！ 将我的众子从远方带来， 将我的众女从地极领回，

chapters.en: everyone called by My name and created for My glory, whom I have indeed formed and made.”
chapters.zh: 就是凡称为我名下的人， 是我为自己的荣耀创造的， 是我所做成，所造作的。

chapters.en: Bring out a people who have eyes but are blind, and who have ears but are deaf.
chapters.zh: 你要将有眼而瞎、 有耳而聋的民都带出来！

chapters.en: All the nations gather together and the peoples assemble. Who among them can declare this, and proclaim to us the former things? Let them present their witnesses to vindicate them, so that others may hear and say, “It is true.”
chapters.zh: 任凭万国聚集； 任凭众民会合。 其中谁能将此声明， 并将先前的事说给我们听呢？ 他们可以带出见证来，自显为是； 或者他们听见便说：这是真的。

chapters.en: “You are My witnesses,” declares the LORD, “and My servant whom I have chosen, so that you may consider and believe Me and understand that I am He. Before Me no god was formed, and after Me none will come.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：你们是我的见证， 我所拣选的仆人。 既是这样，便可以知道，且信服我， 又明白我就是耶和华。 在我以前没有真神〔注：真：原文是造作的〕； 在我以后也必没有。

chapters.en: I, yes I, am the LORD, and there is no Savior but Me.
chapters.zh: 惟有我是耶和华； 除我以外没有救主。

chapters.en: I alone decreed and saved and proclaimed— I, and not some foreign god among you. So you are My witnesses,” declares the LORD, “that I am God.
chapters.zh: 我曾指示，我曾拯救，我曾说明， 并且在你们中间没有别神。 所以耶和华说： 你们是我的见证。 我也是上帝；

chapters.en:
Even from eternity I am He, and none can deliver out of My hand.
When I act, who can reverse it?”
chapters.zh: 自从有日子以来，我就是上帝； 谁也不能救人脱离我手。 我要行事谁能阻止呢？

chapters.en:
Thus says the LORD your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel:
“For your sake, I will send to Babylon and bring them all as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships in which they rejoice.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你们的救赎主、 以色列的圣者如此说： 因你们的缘故， 我已经打发人到巴比伦去； 并且我要使迦勒底人如逃民， 都坐自己喜乐的船下来。

chapters.en: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, and your King.”
chapters.zh: 我是耶和华－你们的圣者， 是创造以色列的，是你们的君王。

chapters.en: Thus says the LORD, who makes a way in the sea and a path through the surging waters,
chapters.zh: 耶和华在沧海中开道， 在大水中开路，

chapters.en: who brings out the chariots and horses, the armies and warriors together, to lie down, never to rise again; to be extinguished, snuffed out like a wick:
chapters.zh: 使车辆、马匹、军兵、勇士都出来， 一同躺下，不再起来； 他们灭没，好像熄灭的灯火。

chapters.en: “Do not call to mind the former things; pay no attention to the things of old.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 你们不要记念从前的事， 也不要思想古时的事。

chapters.en: Behold, I am about to do something new; even now it is coming. Do you not see it? Indeed, I will make a way in the wilderness and streams in the desert.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我要做一件新事； 如今要发现，你们岂不知道吗？ 我必在旷野开道路， 在沙漠开江河。

chapters.en:
The beasts of the field will honor Me, the jackals and the ostriches, because I provide water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert,
to give drink to My chosen people.
chapters.zh: 野地的走兽必尊重我； 野狗和鸵鸟也必如此。 因我使旷野有水， 使沙漠有河， 好赐给我的百姓、我的选民喝。

chapters.en: The people I formed for Myself will declare My praise.
chapters.zh: 这百姓是我为自己所造的， 好述说我的美德。

chapters.en: But you have not called on Me, O Jacob, because you have grown weary of Me, O Israel.
chapters.zh: 雅各啊，你并没有求告我； 以色列啊，你倒厌烦我。

chapters.en: You have not brought Me sheep for burnt offerings, nor honored Me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.
chapters.zh: 你没有将你的羊带来给我作燔祭， 也没有用祭物尊敬我； 我没有因供物使你服劳， 也没有因乳香使你厌烦。

chapters.en: You have not bought Me sweet cane with your silver, nor satisfied Me with the fat of your sacrifices. But you have burdened Me with your sins; you have wearied Me with your iniquities.
chapters.zh: 你没有用银子为我买菖蒲， 也没有用祭物的脂油使我饱足； 倒使我因你的罪恶服劳， 使我因你的罪孽厌烦。

chapters.en:
I, yes I, am He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake
and remembers your sins no more.
chapters.zh: 惟有我为自己的缘故涂抹你的过犯； 我也不记念你的罪恶。

chapters.en: Remind Me, let us argue the matter together. State your case, so that you may be vindicated.
chapters.zh: 你要提醒我，你我可以一同辩论； 你可以将〔你的理〕陈明，自显为义。

chapters.en: Your first father sinned, and your spokesmen rebelled against Me.
chapters.zh: 你的始祖犯罪； 你的师傅违背我。

chapters.en: So I will disgrace the princes of your sanctuary, and I will devote Jacob to destruction and Israel to reproach.”
chapters.zh: 所以，我要辱没圣所的首领， 使雅各成为咒诅， 使以色列成为辱骂。

chapters.en: But now listen, O Jacob My servant, Israel, whom I have chosen.
chapters.zh: 我的仆人雅各， 我所拣选的以色列啊， 现在你当听。

chapters.en: This is the word of the LORD, your Maker, who formed you from the womb and who will help you: “Do not be afraid, O Jacob My servant, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
chapters.zh: 造作你，又从你出胎造就你， 并要帮助你的耶和华如此说： 我的仆人雅各， 我所拣选的耶书崙哪， 不要害怕！

chapters.en: For I will pour water on the thirsty land, and currents on the dry ground. I will pour out My Spirit on your descendants, and My blessing on your offspring.
chapters.zh: 因为我要将水浇灌口渴的人， 将河浇灌干旱之地。 我要将我的灵浇灌你的后裔， 将我的福浇灌你的子孙。

chapters.en: They will sprout among the grass like willows by flowing streams.
chapters.zh: 他们要发生在草中， 像溪水旁的柳树。

chapters.en: One will say, ‘I belong to the LORD,’ another will call himself by the name of Jacob, and still another will write on his hand, ‘The LORD’s,’ and will take the name of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 这个要说：我是属耶和华的； 那个要以雅各的名自称； 又一个要亲手写：归耶和华的〔注：或译：在手上写归耶和华〕， 并自称为以色列。

chapters.en:
Thus says the LORD, the King and Redeemer of Israel, the LORD of Hosts:
“I am the first and I am the last, and there is no God but Me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－以色列的君， 以色列的救赎主－万军之耶和华如此说： 我是首先的，我是末后的； 除我以外再没有〔真〕神。

chapters.en: Who then is like Me? Let him say so! Let him declare his case before Me, since I established an ancient people. Let him foretell the things to come, and what is to take place.
chapters.zh: 自从我设立古时的民， 谁能像我宣告，并且指明，又为自己陈说呢？ 让他将未来的事和必成的事说明。

chapters.en: Do not tremble or fear. Have I not told you and declared it long ago? You are My witnesses! Is there any God but Me? There is no other Rock; I know not one.”
chapters.zh: 你们不要恐惧，也不要害怕。 我岂不是从上古就说明指示你们吗？ 并且你们是我的见证！ 除我以外，岂有〔真〕神吗？ 诚然没有磐石，我不知道一个！

chapters.en: All makers of idols are nothing, and the things they treasure are worthless. Their witnesses fail to see or comprehend, so they are put to shame.
chapters.zh: 制造雕刻偶像的尽都虚空；他们所喜悦的都无益处；他们的见证无所看见，无所知晓，他们便觉羞愧。

chapters.en: Who fashions a god or casts an idol which profits him nothing?
chapters.zh: 谁制造神像，铸造无益的偶像？

chapters.en: Behold, all his companions will be put to shame, for the craftsmen themselves are only human. Let them all assemble and take their stand; they will all be brought to terror and shame.
chapters.zh: 看哪，他的同伴都必羞愧。工匠也不过是人，任他们聚会，任他们站立，都必惧怕，一同羞愧。

chapters.en: The blacksmith takes a tool and labors over the coals; he fashions an idol with hammers and forges it with his strong arms. Yet he grows hungry and loses his strength; he fails to drink water and grows faint.
chapters.zh: 铁匠把铁在火炭中烧热，用锤打铁器，用他有力的膀臂锤成；他饥饿而无力，不喝水而发倦。

chapters.en:
The woodworker extends a measuring line; he marks it out with a stylus; he shapes it with chisels and outlines it with a compass. He fashions it in the likeness of man, like man in all his glory,
that it may dwell in a shrine.
chapters.zh: 木匠拉线，用笔划出样子，用铇子铇成形状，用圆尺划了模样，仿照人的体态，做成人形，好住在房屋中。

chapters.en: He cuts down cedars or retrieves a cypress or oak. He lets it grow strong among the trees of the forest. He plants a laurel, and the rain makes it grow.
chapters.zh: 他砍伐香柏树，又取柞〔注：或译：青桐〕树和橡树，在树林中选定了一棵。他栽种松树，得雨长养。

chapters.en: It serves as fuel for man. He takes some of it to warm himself, and he kindles a fire and bakes his bread. He also fashions it into a god and worships it; he makes an idol and bows down to it.
chapters.zh: 这树，人可用以烧火；他自己取些烤火，又烧着烤饼，而且做神像跪拜，做雕刻的偶像向它叩拜。

chapters.en:
He burns half of it in the fire, and he roasts meat on that half. He eats the roast and is satisfied. Indeed, he warms himself and says,
“Ah! I am warm; I see the fire.”
chapters.zh: 他把一分烧在火中，把一分烤肉吃饱。自己烤火说：「啊哈，我暖和了，我见火了。」

chapters.en: From the rest he makes a god, his graven image. He bows down to it and worships; he prays to it and says, “Save me, for you are my god.”
chapters.zh: 他用剩下的做了一神，就是雕刻的偶像。他向这偶像俯伏叩拜，祷告它说：「求你拯救我，因你是我的神。」

chapters.en:
They do not comprehend or discern, for He has shut their eyes so they cannot see
and closed their minds so they cannot understand.
chapters.zh: 他们不知道，也不思想；因为耶和华闭住他们的眼，不能看见，塞住他们的心，不能明白。

chapters.en:
And no one considers in his heart, no one has the knowledge or insight to say, “I burned half of it in the fire, and I baked bread on its coals;
I roasted meat and I ate. Shall I make something detestable with the rest of it? Shall I bow down to a block of wood?”
chapters.zh: 谁心里也不醒悟，也没有知识，没有聪明，能说：「我曾拿一分在火中烧了，在炭火上烤过饼；我也烤过肉吃。这剩下的，我岂要做可憎的物吗？我岂可向木触子叩拜呢？」

chapters.en: He feeds on ashes. His deluded heart has led him astray, and he cannot deliver himself or say, “Is not this thing in my right hand a lie?”
chapters.zh: 他以灰为食，心中昏迷，使他偏邪，他不能自救，也不能说：「我右手中岂不是有虚谎吗？」

chapters.en: Remember these things, O Jacob, for you are My servant, O Israel. I have made you, and you are My servant; O Israel, I will never forget you.
chapters.zh: 雅各，以色列啊， 你是我的仆人，要记念这些事。 以色列啊，你是我的仆人， 我造就你必不忘记你。

chapters.en:
I have blotted out your transgressions like a cloud, and your sins like a mist.
Return to Me, for I have redeemed you.
chapters.zh: 我涂抹了你的过犯，像厚云〔消散〕； 我涂抹了你的罪恶，如薄云〔灭没〕。 你当归向我，因我救赎了你。

chapters.en: Sing for joy, O heavens, for the LORD has done this; shout aloud, O depths of the earth. Break forth in song, O mountains, you forests and all your trees. For the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and revealed His glory in Israel.
chapters.zh: 诸天哪，应当歌唱， 因为耶和华做成这事。 地的深处啊，应当欢呼； 众山应当发声歌唱； 树林和其中所有的树都当如此！ 因为耶和华救赎了雅各， 并要因以色列荣耀自己。

chapters.en:
Thus says the LORD, your Redeemer who formed you from the womb:
“I am the LORD, who has made all things, who alone stretched out the heavens, who by Myself spread out the earth,
chapters.zh: 从你出胎，造就你的救赎主－耶和华如此说： 我－耶和华是创造万物的， 是独自铺张诸天、铺开大地的。 谁与我同在呢？

chapters.en: who foils the signs of false prophets and makes fools of diviners, who confounds the wise and turns their knowledge into nonsense,
chapters.zh: 使说假话的兆头失效， 使占卜的癫狂， 使智慧人退后， 使他的知识变为愚拙；

chapters.en: who confirms the message of His servant and fulfills the counsel of His messengers, who says of Jerusalem, ‘She will be inhabited,’ and of the cities of Judah, ‘They will be rebuilt, and I will restore their ruins,’
chapters.zh: 使我仆人的话语立定， 我使者的谋算成就。 论到耶路撒冷说：必有人居住； 论到犹大的城邑说：必被建造， 其中的荒场我也必兴起。

chapters.en: who says to the depths of the sea, ‘Be dry, and I will dry up your currents,’
chapters.zh: 对深渊说：你干了吧！ 我也要使你的江河干涸。

chapters.en: who says of Cyrus, ‘My shepherd will fulfill all that I desire,’ who says of Jerusalem, ‘She will be rebuilt,’ and of the temple, ‘Let its foundation be laid.’”
chapters.zh: 论塞鲁士说：〔他是〕我的牧人， 必成就我所喜悦的， 必下令建造耶路撒冷， 发命立稳圣殿的根基。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says to Cyrus His anointed, whose right hand I have grasped to subdue nations before him, to disarm kings, to open the doors before him, so that the gates will not be shut:
chapters.zh: 我－耶和华所膏的塞鲁士； 我搀扶他的右手， 使列国降伏在他面前。 我也要放松列王的腰带， 使城门在他面前敞开， 不得关闭。 我对他如此说：

chapters.en: “I will go before you and level the mountains; I will break down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.
chapters.zh: 我必在你前面行， 修平崎岖之地。 我必打破铜门， 砍断铁闩。

chapters.en: I will give you the treasures of darkness and the riches hidden in secret places, so that you may know that I am the LORD, the God of Israel, who calls you by name.
chapters.zh: 我要将暗中的宝物和隐密的财宝赐给你， 使你知道提名召你的， 就是我－耶和华、以色列的上帝。

chapters.en:
For the sake of Jacob My servant and Israel My chosen one, I call you by name; I have given you a title of honor,
though you have not known Me.
chapters.zh: 因我仆人雅各， 我所拣选以色列的缘故， 我就提名召你； 你虽不认识我， 我也加给你名号。

chapters.en: I am the LORD, and there is no other; there is no God but Me. I will equip you for battle, though you have not known Me,
chapters.zh: 我是耶和华，在我以外并没有别神； 除了我以外再没有上帝。 你虽不认识我， 我必给你束腰。

chapters.en: so that all may know, from where the sun rises to where it sets, that there is none but Me; I am the LORD, and there is no other.
chapters.zh: 从日出之地到日落之处 使人都知道除了我以外，没有别神。 我是耶和华； 在我以外并没有别神。

chapters.en:
I form the light and create the darkness; I bring prosperity and create calamity.
I, the LORD, do all these things.
chapters.zh: 我造光，又造暗； 我施平安，又降灾祸； 造作这一切的是我－耶和华。

chapters.en:
Drip down, O heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness. Let the earth open up that salvation may sprout and righteousness spring up with it;
I, the LORD, have created it.
chapters.zh: 诸天哪，自上而滴， 穹苍降下公义； 地面开裂，产出救恩， 使公义一同发生； 这都是我－耶和华所造的。

chapters.en: Woe to him who quarrels with his Maker— one clay pot among many. Does the clay ask the potter, ‘What are you making?’ Does your work say, ‘He has no hands’?
chapters.zh: 祸哉，那与造他的主争论的！ 他不过是地上瓦片中的一块瓦片。 泥土岂可对抟弄它的说：你做什么呢？ 所做的物岂可说：你没有手呢？

chapters.en: Woe to him who says to his father, ‘What have you begotten?’ or to his mother, ‘What have you brought forth?’”
chapters.zh: 祸哉，那对父亲说： 你生的是什么呢？ 或对母亲〔注：原文是妇人〕说： 你产的是什么呢？

chapters.en:
Thus says the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, and its Maker:
“Concerning things to come, do you question Me about My sons, or instruct Me in the work of My hands?
chapters.zh: 耶和华－以色列的圣者， 就是造就以色列的如此说： 将来的事，你们可以问我； 至于我的众子，并我手的工作， 你们可以求我命定〔注：原文是吩咐我〕。

chapters.en: It is I who made the earth and created man upon it. It was My hands that stretched out the heavens, and I ordained all their host.
chapters.zh: 我造地，又造人在地上。 我亲手铺张诸天； 天上万象也是我所命定的。

chapters.en: I will raise up Cyrus in righteousness, and I will make all his ways straight. He will rebuild My city and set My exiles free, but not for payment or reward, says the LORD of Hosts.”
chapters.zh: 我凭公义兴起塞鲁士〔注：原文是他〕， 又要修直他一切道路。 他必建造我的城， 释放我被掳的民； 不是为工价，也不是为赏赐。 这是万军之耶和华说的。
耶和华如此说： 埃及劳碌得来的和古实的货物必归你； 身量高大的西巴人必投降你，也要属你。 他们必带着锁鍊过来随从你， 又向你下拜，祈求你〔说〕： 上帝真在你们中间，此外再没有别神； 再没有别的上帝。

chapters.en: Truly You are a God who hides Himself, O God of Israel, the Savior.
chapters.zh: 救主－以色列的上帝啊， 你实在是自隐的上帝。

chapters.en: They will all be put to shame and humiliated; the makers of idols will depart together in disgrace.
chapters.zh: 凡制造偶像的都必抱愧蒙羞， 都要一同归于惭愧。

chapters.en: But Israel will be saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation; you will not be put to shame or humiliated, to ages everlasting.
chapters.zh: 惟有以色列必蒙耶和华的拯救， 得永远的救恩。 你们必不蒙羞，也不抱愧， 直到永世无尽。

chapters.en:
For thus says the LORD, who created the heavens—He is God; He formed the earth and fashioned it; He established it; He did not create it to be empty, but formed it to be inhabited:
“I am the LORD, and there is no other.
chapters.zh: 创造诸天的耶和华， 制造成全大地的上帝， 他创造坚定大地， 并非使地荒凉， 是要给人居住。 他如此说： 我是耶和华，再没有别神。

chapters.en: I have not spoken in secret, from a place in a land of darkness. I did not say to the descendants of Jacob, ‘Seek Me in a wasteland.’ I, the LORD, speak the truth; I say what is right.
chapters.zh: 我没有在隐密黑暗之地说话； 我没有对雅各的后裔说： 你们寻求我是徒然的。 我－耶和华所讲的是公义， 所说的是正直。

chapters.en: Come, gather together, and draw near, you fugitives from the nations. Ignorant are those who carry idols of wood and pray to a god that cannot save.
chapters.zh: 你们从列国逃脱的人， 要一同聚集前来。 那些抬着雕刻木偶、 祷告不能救人之神的， 毫无知识。

chapters.en: Speak up and present your case— yes, let them take counsel together. Who foretold this long ago? Who announced it from ancient times? Was it not I, the LORD? There is no other God but Me, a righteous God and Savior; there is none but Me.
chapters.zh: 你们要述说陈明〔你们的理〕， 让他们彼此商议。 谁从古时指明？ 谁从上古述说？ 不是我－耶和华吗？ 除了我以外，再没有上帝； 我是公义的上帝，又是救主； 除了我以外，再没有别神。

chapters.en: Turn to Me and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
chapters.zh: 地极〔的人〕都当仰望我， 就必得救； 因为我是上帝，再没有别神。

chapters.en:
By Myself I have sworn; truth has gone out from My mouth,
a word that will not be revoked: Every knee will bow before Me, every tongue will swear allegiance.
chapters.zh: 我指着自己起誓， 我口所出的话是凭公义，并不反回： 万膝必向我跪拜； 万口必凭我起誓。

chapters.en:
Surely they will say of Me, ‘In the LORD alone are righteousness and strength.’”
All who rage against Him will come to Him and be put to shame.
chapters.zh: 人论我说， 公义、能力，惟独在乎耶和华； 人都必归向他。 凡向他发怒的必至蒙羞。

chapters.en: In the LORD all descendants of Israel will be justified and will exult.
chapters.zh: 以色列的后裔都必因耶和华得称为义， 并要夸耀。

chapters.en: Bel crouches; Nebo cowers. Their idols weigh down beasts and cattle. The images you carry are burdensome, a load to the weary animal.
chapters.zh: 彼勒屈身，尼波弯腰； 巴比伦的偶像驮在兽和牲畜上。 他们所抬的如今成了重驮， 使〔牲畜〕疲乏，

chapters.en:
The gods cower; they crouch together, unable to relieve the burden;
but they themselves go into captivity.
chapters.zh: 都一同弯腰屈身， 不能保全重驮， 自己倒被掳去。

chapters.en: “Listen to Me, O house of Jacob, all the remnant of the house of Israel, who have been sustained from the womb, carried along since birth.
chapters.zh: 雅各家，以色列家一切余剩的要听我言： 你们自从生下，就蒙〔我〕保抱， 自从出胎，便蒙〔我〕怀搋。

chapters.en: Even to your old age, I will be the same, and I will bear you up when you turn gray. I have made you, and I will carry you; I will sustain you and deliver you.
chapters.zh: 直到你们年老，我仍这样； 直到你们发白，我仍怀搋。 我已造作，也必保抱； 我必怀抱，也必拯救。

chapters.en: To whom will you liken Me or count Me equal? To whom will you compare Me, that we should be alike?
chapters.zh: 你们将谁与我相比，与我同等， 可以与我比较，使我们相同呢？

chapters.en: They pour out their bags of gold and weigh out silver on scales; they hire a goldsmith to fashion it into a god, so they can bow down and worship.
chapters.zh: 那从囊中抓金子， 用天平平银子的人， 雇银匠制造神像， 他们又俯伏，又叩拜。

chapters.en: They lift it to their shoulder and carry it along; they set it in its place, and there it stands, not budging from that spot. They cry out to it, but it does not answer; it saves no one from his troubles.
chapters.zh: 他们将神像抬起，扛在肩上， 安置在定处，它就站立， 不离本位； 人呼求它，它不能答应， 也不能救人脱离患难。

chapters.en: Remember this and be brave; take it to heart, you transgressors!
chapters.zh: 你们当想念这事，自己作大丈夫。 悖逆的人哪，要心里思想。

chapters.en:
Remember what happened long ago, for I am God, and there is no other;
I am God, and there is none like Me.
chapters.zh: 你们要追念上古的事。 因为我是上帝，并无别神； 〔我是〕上帝，再没有能比我的。

chapters.en: I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times what is still to come. I say, ‘My purpose will stand, and all My good pleasure I will accomplish.’
chapters.zh: 我从起初指明末后的事， 从古时言明未成的事， 说：我的筹算必立定； 凡我所喜悦的，我必成就。

chapters.en: I summon a bird of prey from the east, a man for My purpose from a far-off land. Truly I have spoken, and truly I will bring it to pass. I have planned it, and I will surely do it.
chapters.zh: 我召鸷鸟从东方来， 召那成就我筹算的人从远方来。 我已说出，也必成就； 我已谋定，也必做成。

chapters.en: Listen to Me, you stubborn people, far removed from righteousness:
chapters.zh: 你们这些心中顽梗、 远离公义的，当听我言。

chapters.en: I am bringing My righteousness near; it is not far away, and My salvation will not be delayed. I will grant salvation to Zion and adorn Israel with My splendor.
chapters.zh: 我使我的公义临近，必不远离。 我的救恩必不迟延； 我要为以色列－我的荣耀， 在锡安施行救恩。

chapters.en: “Go down and sit in the dust, O Virgin Daughter of Babylon. Sit on the ground without a throne, O Daughter of the Chaldeans! For you will no longer be called tender or delicate.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦的处女啊， 下来坐在尘埃； 迦勒底的闺女啊， 没有宝座，要坐在地上； 因为你不再称为柔弱娇嫩的。

chapters.en: Take millstones and grind flour; remove your veil; strip off your skirt, bare your thigh, and wade through the streams.
chapters.zh: 要用磨磨面， 揭去帕子， 脱去长衣，露腿诜河。

chapters.en: Your nakedness will be uncovered and your shame will be exposed. I will take vengeance; I will spare no one.”
chapters.zh: 你的下体必被露出； 你的丑陋必被看见。 我要报仇， 谁也不宽容。

chapters.en: Our Redeemer—the LORD of Hosts is His name— is the Holy One of Israel.
chapters.zh: 我们救赎主的名是 万军之耶和华－以色列的圣者。

chapters.en: “Sit in silence and go into darkness, O Daughter of the Chaldeans. For you will no longer be called the queen of kingdoms.
chapters.zh: 迦勒底的闺女啊， 你要默然静坐，进入暗中， 因为你不再称为列国的主母。

chapters.en:
I was angry with My people; I profaned My heritage,
and I placed them under your control. You showed them no mercy; even on the elderly you laid a most heavy yoke.
chapters.zh: 我向我的百姓发怒， 使我的产业被亵渎， 将他们交在你手中， 你毫不怜悯他们， 把极重的轭加在老年人身上。

chapters.en:
You said, ‘I will be queen forever.’ You did not take these things to heart
or consider their outcome.
chapters.zh: 你自己说：我必永为主母， 所以你不将这事放在心上， 也不思想这事的结局。

chapters.en: So now hear this, O lover of luxury who sits securely, who says to herself, ‘I am, and there is none besides me. I will never be a widow or know the loss of children.’
chapters.zh: 你这专好宴乐、安然居住的， 现在当听这话。 你心中说：惟有我， 除我以外再没有别的。 我必不致寡居， 也不遭丧子之事。

chapters.en: These two things will overtake you in a moment, in a single day: loss of children, and widowhood. They will come upon you in full measure, in spite of your many sorceries and the potency of your spells.
chapters.zh: 哪知，丧子、寡居这两件事 在一日转眼之间必临到你； 正在你多行邪术、广施符咒的时候， 这两件事必全然临到你身上。

chapters.en: You were secure in your wickedness; you said, ‘No one sees me.’ Your wisdom and knowledge led you astray; you told yourself, ‘I am, and there is none besides me.’
chapters.zh: 你素来倚仗自己的恶行，说： 无人看见我。 你的智慧聪明使你偏邪， 并且你心里说：惟有我， 除我以外再没有别的。

chapters.en: But disaster will come upon you; you will not know how to charm it away. A calamity will befall you that you will be unable to ward off. Devastation will happen to you suddenly and unexpectedly.
chapters.zh: 因此，祸患要临到你身； 你不知何时发现〔注：或译：如何驱逐〕， 灾害落在你身上， 你也不能除掉； 所不知道的毁灭也必忽然临到你身。

chapters.en: So take your stand with your spells and with your many sorceries, with which you have wearied yourself from your youth. Perhaps you will succeed; perhaps you will inspire terror!
chapters.zh: 站起来吧！ 用你从幼年劳神施行的符咒和你许多的邪术； 或者可得益处， 或者可得强胜。

chapters.en: You are wearied by your many counselors; let them come forward now and save you— your astrologers who observe the stars, who monthly predict your fate.
chapters.zh: 你筹划太多，以致疲倦。 让那些观天象的，看星宿的， 在月朔说预言的，都站起来， 救你脱离所要临到你的事。

chapters.en: Surely they are like stubble; the fire will burn them up. They cannot deliver themselves from the power of the flame. There will be no coals to warm them or fire to sit beside.
chapters.zh: 他们要像碎诩被火焚烧， 不能救自己脱离火焰之力； 这火并非可烤的炭火， 也不是可以坐在其前的火。

chapters.en: This is what they are to you— those with whom you have labored and traded from youth— each one strays in his own direction; not one of them can save you.
chapters.zh: 你所劳神的事都要这样与你〔无益〕； 从幼年与你贸易的也都各奔各乡，无人救你。

chapters.en: “Listen to this, O house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, who have descended from the line of Judah, who swear by the name of the LORD, who invoke the God of Israel— but not in truth or righteousness—
chapters.zh: 雅各家，称为以色列名下， 从犹大水源出来的，当听我言！ 你们指着耶和华的名起誓， 提说以色列的上帝， 却不凭诚实，不凭公义。

chapters.en:
who indeed call yourselves after the holy city and lean on the God of Israel;
the LORD of Hosts is His name.
chapters.zh: 他们自称为圣城的人， 所倚靠的是 名为万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝。

chapters.en:
I foretold the former things long ago; they came out of My mouth and I proclaimed them.
Suddenly I acted, and they came to pass.
chapters.zh: 主说：早先的事，我从古时说明， 已经出了我的口， 也是我所指示的； 我忽然行做，事便成就。

chapters.en: For I knew that you are stubborn; your neck is iron and your forehead is bronze.
chapters.zh: 因为我素来知道你是顽梗的－ 你的颈项是铁的； 你的额是铜的。

chapters.en: Therefore I declared it to you long ago; I announced it before it came to pass, so that you could not claim, ‘My idol has done this; my carved image and molten god has ordained it.’
chapters.zh: 所以，我从古时将这事给你说明， 在未成以先指示你， 免得你说：这些事是我的偶像所行的， 是我雕刻的偶像和我铸造的偶像所命定的。

chapters.en:
You have heard these things; look at them all. Will you not acknowledge them?
From now on I will tell you of new things, hidden things unknown to you.
chapters.zh: 你已经听见，现在要看见这一切； 你不说明吗？ 从今以后，我将新事， 就是你所不知道的隐密事指示你。

chapters.en: They are created now, and not long ago; you have not heard of them before today. So you cannot claim, ‘I already knew them!’
chapters.zh: 这事是现今造的，并非从古就有； 在今日以先，你也未曾听见， 免得你说：这事我早已知道了。

chapters.en: You have never heard; you have never understood; for a long time your ears have not been open. For I knew how deceitful you are; you have been called a rebel from birth.
chapters.zh: 你未曾听见，未曾知道； 你的耳朵从来未曾开通。 我原知道你行事极其诡诈， 你自从出胎以来， 便称为悖逆的。

chapters.en:
For the sake of My name I will delay My wrath; for the sake of My praise I will restrain it,
so that you will not be cut off.
chapters.zh: 我为我的名暂且忍怒， 为我的颂赞向你容忍， 不将你剪除。

chapters.en: See, I have refined you, but not as silver; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.
chapters.zh: 我熬炼你，却不像熬炼银子； 你在苦难的炉中，我拣选你。

chapters.en:
For My own sake, My very own sake, I will act; for how can I let Myself be defamed?
I will not yield My glory to another.
chapters.zh: 我为自己的缘故必行这事， 我焉能使〔我的名〕被亵渎？ 我必不将我的荣耀归给假神。

chapters.en: Listen to Me, O Jacob, and Israel, whom I have called: I am He; I am the first, and I am the last.
chapters.zh: 雅各－我所选召的以色列啊， 当听我言： 我是耶和华， 我是首先的，也是末后的。

chapters.en: Surely My own hand founded the earth, and My right hand spread out the heavens; when I summon them, they stand up together.
chapters.zh: 我手立了地的根基； 我右手铺张诸天； 我一招呼便都立住。

chapters.en: Come together, all of you, and listen: Which of the idols has foretold these things? The LORD’s chosen ally will carry out His desire against Babylon, and His arm will be against the Chaldeans.
chapters.zh: 你们都当聚集而听， 他们〔注：或译：偶像〕内中谁说过这些事？ 耶和华所爱的人必向巴比伦行他所喜悦的事； 他的膀臂也要〔加在〕迦勒底人身上。

chapters.en: I, even I, have spoken; yes, I have called him. I have brought him, and he will succeed in his mission.
chapters.zh: 惟有我曾说过，我又选召他， 领他来，他的道路就必亨通。

chapters.en:
Come near to Me and listen to this:
From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time it happened, I was there.”
And now the Lord GOD has sent me, accompanied by His Spirit.
chapters.zh: 你们要就近我来听这话： 我从起头并未曾在隐密处说话； 自从有这事，我就在那里。 现在，主耶和华差遣我和他的灵来〔注：或译：耶和华和他的灵差遣我来〕。

chapters.en:
Thus says the LORD your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel:
“I am the LORD your God, who teaches you for your benefit,
who directs you in the way you should go.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你的救赎主， 以色列的圣者如此说： 我是耶和华－你的上帝， 教训你，使你得益处， 引导你所当行的路。

chapters.en:
If only you had paid attention to My commandments, your peace would have been like a river,
and your righteousness like waves of the sea.
chapters.zh: 甚愿你素来听从我的命令！ 你的平安就如河水； 你的公义就如海浪。

chapters.en: Your descendants would have been as countless as the sand, and your offspring as numerous as its grains; their name would never be cut off or eliminated from My presence.”
chapters.zh: 你的后裔也必多如〔海〕沙； 你腹中所生的也必多如沙粒。 他的名在我面前必不剪除， 也不灭绝。

chapters.en: Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! Declare it with a shout of joy, proclaim it, let it go out to the ends of the earth, saying, “The LORD has redeemed His servant Jacob!”
chapters.zh: 你们要从巴比伦出来， 从迦勒底人中逃脱， 以欢呼的声音传扬说： 耶和华救赎了他的仆人雅各！ 你们要将这事宣扬到地极。

chapters.en:
They did not thirst when He led them through the deserts; He made water flow for them from the rock;
He split the rock, and water gushed out.
chapters.zh: 耶和华引导他们经过沙漠。 他们并不干渴； 他为他们使水从磐石而流， 分裂磐石，水就涌出。

chapters.en: “There is no peace,” says the LORD, “for the wicked.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说： 恶人必不得平安！

chapters.en:
Listen to Me, O islands; pay attention, O distant peoples:
The LORD called Me from the womb; from the body of My mother He named Me.
chapters.zh: 众海岛啊，当听我言！ 远方的众民哪，留心而听！ 自我出胎，耶和华就选召我； 自出母腹，他就提我的名。

chapters.en: He made My mouth like a sharp sword; He hid Me in the shadow of His hand. He made Me like a polished arrow; He hid Me in His quiver.
chapters.zh: 他使我的口如快刀， 将我藏在他手荫之下； 又使我成为磨亮的箭， 将我藏在他箭袋之中；

chapters.en: He said to Me, “You are My Servant, Israel, in whom I will display My glory.”
chapters.zh: 对我说：你是我的仆人以色列； 我必因你得荣耀。

chapters.en: But I said, “I have labored in vain, I have spent My strength in futility and vanity; yet My vindication is with the LORD, and My reward is with My God.”
chapters.zh: 我却说：我劳碌是徒然； 我尽力是虚无虚空。 然而，我〔当得〕的理必在耶和华那里； 我的赏赐必在我上帝那里。

chapters.en: And now says the LORD, who formed Me from the womb to be His Servant, to bring Jacob back to Him, that Israel might be gathered to Him— for I am honored in the sight of the LORD, and My God is My strength—
chapters.zh: 耶和华从我出胎，造就我作他的仆人， 要使雅各归向他， 使以色列到他那里聚集。 原来耶和华看我为尊贵； 我的上帝也成为我的力量。

chapters.en:
He says: “It is not enough for You to be My Servant, to raise up the tribes of Jacob,
and to restore the protected ones of Israel. I will also make You a light for the nations, to bring My salvation to the ends of the earth.”
chapters.zh: 现在他说：你作我的仆人， 使雅各众支派复兴， 使以色列中得保全的归回尚为小事， 我还要使你作外邦人的光， 叫你施行我的救恩，直到地极。

chapters.en:
Thus says the LORD, the Redeemer and Holy One of Israel, to Him who was despised and abhorred by the nation, to the Servant of rulers:
“Kings will see You and rise, and princes will bow down, because of the LORD, who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen You.”
chapters.zh: 救赎主－以色列的圣者耶和华 对那被人所藐视、本国所憎恶、 官长所虐待的如此说： 君王要看见就站起， 首领也要下拜； 都因信实的耶和华， 就是拣选你－以色列的圣者。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“In the time of favor I will answer You, and in the day of salvation I will help You; I will keep You and appoint You to be a covenant for the people, to restore the land, to apportion its desolate inheritances,
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 在悦纳的时候，我应允了你； 在拯救的日子，我济助了你。 我要保护你， 使你作众民的中保〔注：中保：原文是约〕； 复兴遍地， 使人承受荒凉之地为业。

chapters.en: to say to the prisoners, ‘Come out,’ and to those in darkness, ‘Show yourselves.’ They will feed along the pathways, and find pasture on every barren hill.
chapters.zh: 对那被捆绑的人说：出来吧！ 对那在黑暗的人说：显露吧！ 他们在路上必得饮食， 在一切净光的高处必有食物。

chapters.en: They will not hunger or thirst, nor will scorching heat or sun beat down on them. For He who has compassion on them will guide them and lead them beside springs of water.
chapters.zh: 不饥不渴， 炎热和烈日必不伤害他们； 因为怜恤他们的必引导他们， 领他们到水泉旁边。

chapters.en: I will turn all My mountains into roads, and My highways will be raised up.
chapters.zh: 我必使我的众山成为大道； 我的大路也被修高。

chapters.en:
Behold, they will come from far away, from the north and from the west,
and from the land of Aswan. ”
chapters.zh: 看哪，这些从远方来； 这些从北方、从西方来； 这些从秦〔注：原文是希尼〕国来。

chapters.en: Shout for joy, O heavens; rejoice, O earth; break forth in song, O mountains! For the LORD has comforted His people, and He will have compassion on His afflicted ones.
chapters.zh: 诸天哪，应当欢呼！ 大地啊，应当快乐！ 众山哪，应当发声歌唱！ 因为耶和华已经安慰他的百姓， 也要怜恤他困苦之民。

chapters.en: But Zion said, “The LORD has forsaken me; the Lord has forgotten me!”
chapters.zh: 锡安说：耶和华离弃了我； 主忘记了我。

chapters.en: “Can a woman forget her nursing child, or lack compassion for the son of her womb? Even if she could forget, I will not forget you!
chapters.zh: 妇人焉能忘记她吃奶的婴孩， 不怜恤她所生的儿子？ 即或有忘记的， 我却不忘记你。

chapters.en: Behold, I have inscribed you on the palms of My hands; your walls are ever before Me.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我将你铭刻在我掌上； 你的墙垣常在我眼前。

chapters.en: Your builders hasten back; your destroyers and wreckers depart from you.
chapters.zh: 你的儿女必急速〔归回〕； 毁坏你的，使你荒废的，必都离你出去，

chapters.en:
Lift up your eyes and look around. They all gather together; they come to you. As surely as I live,” declares the LORD, “you will wear them all as jewelry
and put them on like a bride.
chapters.zh: 你举目向四方观看； 他们都聚集来到你这里。 耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓： 你必要以他们为妆饰佩戴， 以他们为华带束腰，像新妇一样。

chapters.en: For your ruined and desolate places and your ravaged land will now indeed be too small for your people, and those who devoured you will be far away.
chapters.zh: 至于你荒废凄凉之处， 并你被毁坏之地， 现今众民居住必显为太窄； 吞灭你的必离你遥远。

chapters.en: Yet the children of your bereavement will say in your hearing, ‘This place is too small for us; make room for us to live here.’
chapters.zh: 你必听见丧子之后所生的儿女说： 这地方我居住太窄， 求你给我地方居住。

chapters.en:
Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who has begotten these for me? I was bereaved and barren; I was exiled and rejected.
So who has reared them? Look, I was left all alone, so where did they come from?’”
chapters.zh: 那时你心里必说：我既丧子独居， 是被掳的，漂流在外。 谁给我生这些？ 谁将这些养大呢？ 撇下我一人独居的时候， 这些在哪里呢？

chapters.en:
This is what the Lord GOD says:
“Behold, I will lift up My hand to the nations, and raise My banner to the peoples. They will bring your sons in their arms and carry your daughters on their shoulders.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说： 我必向列国举手， 向万民竖立大旗； 他们必将你的众子怀中抱来， 将你的众女肩上扛来。

chapters.en: Kings will be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow to you facedown and lick the dust at your feet. Then you will know that I am the LORD; those who hope in Me will never be put to shame.”
chapters.zh: 列王必作你的养父； 王后必作你的乳母。 他们必将脸伏地，向你下拜， 并舔你脚上的尘土。 你便知道我是耶和华； 等候我的必不致羞愧。

chapters.en: Can the plunder be snatched from the mighty, or the captives of a tyrant be delivered?
chapters.zh: 勇士抢去的岂能夺回？ 该掳掠的岂能解救吗？

chapters.en:
Indeed, this is what the LORD says:
“Even the captives of the mighty will be taken away, and the plunder of the tyrant will be retrieved; I will contend with those who contend with you, and I will save your children.
chapters.zh: 但耶和华如此说： 就是勇士所掳掠的，也可以夺回； 强暴人所抢的，也可以解救。 与你相争的，我必与他相争； 我要拯救你的儿女。

chapters.en:
I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh; they will be drunk on their own blood, as with wine. Then all mankind will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and your Redeemer,
the Mighty One of Jacob.”
chapters.zh: 并且我必使那欺压你的吃自己的肉， 也要以自己的血喝醉，好像喝甜酒一样。 凡有血气的必都知道我－耶和华是你的救主， 是你的救赎主，是雅各的大能者。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“Where is your mother’s certificate of divorce with which I sent her away? Or to which of My creditors did I sell you? Look, you were sold for your iniquities, and for your transgressions your mother was sent away.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 我休你们的母亲， 休书在哪里呢？ 我将你们卖给我哪一个债主呢？ 你们被卖，是因你们的罪孽； 你们的母亲被休，是因你们的过犯。

chapters.en: Why was no one there when I arrived? Why did no one answer when I called? Is My hand too short to redeem you? Or do I lack the strength to deliver you? Behold, My rebuke dries up the sea; I turn the rivers into a desert; the fish rot for lack of water and die of thirst.
chapters.zh: 我来的时候，为何无人〔等候〕呢？ 我呼唤的时候，为何无人答应呢？ 我的膀臂岂是缩短、不能救赎吗？ 我岂无拯救之力吗？ 看哪，我一斥责，海就干了； 我使江河变为旷野； 其中的鱼因无水腥臭，干渴而死。

chapters.en: I clothe the heavens in black and make sackcloth their covering.”
chapters.zh: 我使诸天以黑暗为衣服， 以麻布为遮盖。

chapters.en:
The Lord GOD has given Me the tongue of discipleship,
to sustain the weary with a word. He awakens Me morning by morning; He awakens My ear to listen as a disciple.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华赐我受教者的舌头， 使我知道怎样用言语扶助疲乏的人。 主每早晨提醒， 提醒我的耳朵， 使我能听，像受教者一样。

chapters.en:
The Lord GOD has opened My ears, and I have not been rebellious,
nor have I turned back.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华开通我的耳朵； 我并没有违背，也没有退后。

chapters.en:
I offered My back to those who struck Me, and My cheeks to those who tore out My beard.
I did not hide My face from scorn and spittle.
chapters.zh: 人打我的背，我任他打； 人拔我腮颊的胡须，我由他拔； 人辱我，吐我，我并不掩面。

chapters.en: Because the Lord GOD helps Me, I have not been disgraced; therefore I have set My face like flint, and I know that I will not be put to shame.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华必帮助我， 所以我不抱愧。 我硬着脸面好像坚石； 我也知道我必不致蒙羞。

chapters.en:
The One who vindicates Me is near. Who will dare to contend with Me?
Let us confront each other! Who has a case against Me? Let him approach Me!
chapters.zh: 称我为义的与我相近； 谁与我争论， 可以与我一同站立； 谁与我作对， 可以就近我来。

chapters.en: Surely the Lord GOD helps Me. Who is there to condemn Me? See, they will all wear out like a garment; the moths will devour them.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华要帮助我； 谁能定我有罪呢？ 他们都像衣服渐渐旧了， 为蛀虫所咬。

chapters.en: Who among you fears the LORD and obeys the voice of His Servant? Who among you walks in darkness and has no light? Let him trust in the name of the LORD; let him lean on his God.
chapters.zh: 你们中间谁是敬畏耶和华、 听从他仆人之话的？ 这人行在暗中，没有亮光。 当倚靠耶和华的名， 仗赖自己的上帝。

chapters.en: Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who array yourselves with firebrands, walk in the light of your fire and of the firebrands you have lit! This is what you will receive from My hand: You will lie down in a place of torment.
chapters.zh: 凡你们点火，用火把围绕自己的 可以行在你们的火焰里， 并你们所点的火把中。 这是我手所定的： 你们必躺在悲惨之中。

chapters.en: “Listen to Me, you who pursue righteousness, you who seek the LORD: Look to the rock from which you were cut, and to the quarry from which you were hewn.
chapters.zh: 你们这追求公义、 寻求耶和华的，当听我言！ 你们要追想被凿而出的磐石， 被挖而出的巖穴。

chapters.en: Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah who gave you birth. When I called him, he was but one; then I blessed him and multiplied him.
chapters.zh: 要追想你们的祖宗亚伯拉罕 和生养你们的撒拉； 因为亚伯拉罕独自一人的时候， 我选召他，赐福与他， 使他〔人数〕增多。

chapters.en: For the LORD will comfort Zion and will look with compassion on all her ruins; He will make her wilderness like Eden and her desert like the garden of the LORD. Joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and melodious song.
chapters.zh: 耶和华已经安慰锡安 和锡安一切的荒场， 使旷野像伊甸， 使沙漠像耶和华的园囿； 在其中必有欢喜、快乐、感谢， 和歌唱的声音。

chapters.en:
Pay attention to Me, My people, and listen to Me, My nation; for a law will go out from Me, and My justice will become a light to the nations;
I will bring it about quickly.
chapters.zh: 我的百姓啊，要向我留心； 我的国民哪，要向我侧耳； 因为训诲必从我而出； 我必坚定我的公理为万民之光。

chapters.en:
My righteousness draws near, My salvation is on the way,
and My arms will bring justice to the nations. The islands will look for Me and wait in hope for My arm.
chapters.zh: 我的公义临近； 我的救恩发出。 我的膀臂要审判万民； 海岛都要等候我，倚赖我的膀臂。

chapters.en:
Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth below; for the heavens will vanish like smoke, the earth will wear out like a garment,
and its people will die like gnats. But My salvation will last forever, and My righteousness will never fail.
chapters.zh: 你们要向天举目， 观看下地； 因为天必像烟云消散， 地必如衣服渐渐旧了； 其上的居民也要如此死亡〔注：如此死亡：或译像蠓虫死亡〕。 惟有我的救恩永远长存； 我的公义也不废掉。

chapters.en: Listen to Me, you who know what is right, you people with My law in your hearts: Do not fear the scorn of men; do not be broken by their insults.
chapters.zh: 知道公义、将我训诲存在心中的民， 要听我言！ 不要怕人的辱骂， 也不要因人的毁谤惊惶。

chapters.en: For the moth will devour them like a garment, and the worm will eat them like wool. But My righteousness will last forever, My salvation through all generations.”
chapters.zh: 因为蛀虫必咬他们，好像咬衣服； 虫子必咬他们，如同咬羊绒。 惟有我的公义永远长存， 我的救恩直到万代。

chapters.en: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD. Wake up as in days past, as in generations of old. Was it not You who cut Rahab to pieces, who pierced through the dragon?
chapters.zh: 耶和华的膀臂啊，兴起！兴起！ 以能力为衣穿上， 像古时的年日、上古的世代兴起一样。 从前砍碎拉哈伯、 刺透大鱼的，不是你吗？

chapters.en: Was it not You who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep, who made a road in the depths of the sea for the redeemed to cross over?
chapters.zh: 使海与深渊的水干涸、 使海的深处变为赎民经过之路的， 不是你吗？

chapters.en:
So the redeemed of the LORD will return and enter Zion with singing,
crowned with everlasting joy. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee.
chapters.zh: 耶和华救赎的民必归回， 歌唱来到锡安； 永乐必归到他们的头上。 他们必得着欢喜快乐； 忧愁叹息尽都逃避。

chapters.en:
“I, even I, am He who comforts you. Why should you be afraid of mortal man,
of a son of man who withers like grass?
chapters.zh: 惟有我，是安慰你们的。 你是谁，竟怕那必死的人？ 怕那要变如草的世人？

chapters.en:
But you have forgotten the LORD, your Maker, who stretched out the heavens
and laid the foundations of the earth. You live in terror all day long because of the fury of the oppressor who is bent on destruction. But where is the fury of the oppressor?
chapters.zh: 却忘记铺张诸天、立定地基、 创造你的耶和华？ 又因欺压者图谋毁灭要发的暴怒， 整天害怕， 其实那欺压者的暴怒在哪里呢？

chapters.en:
The captive will soon be freed; he will not die in the dungeon,
and his bread will not be lacking.
chapters.zh: 被掳去的快得释放， 必不死而下坑； 他的食物也不致缺乏。

chapters.en:
For I am the LORD your God who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar—
the LORD of Hosts is His name.
chapters.zh: 我是耶和华－你的上帝－ 搅动大海，使海中的波浪匉訇－ 万军之耶和华是我的名。

chapters.en: I have put My words in your mouth, and covered you with the shadow of My hand, to establish the heavens, to found the earth, and to say to Zion, ‘You are My people.’”
chapters.zh: 我将我的话传给你， 用我的手影遮蔽你， 为要栽定诸天，立定地基， 又对锡安说：你是我的百姓。

chapters.en: Awake, awake! Rise up, O Jerusalem, you who have drunk from the hand of the LORD the cup of His fury; you who have drained the goblet to the dregs— the cup that makes men stagger.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，兴起！ 兴起！站起来！ 你从耶和华手中喝了他忿怒之杯， 喝了那使人东倒西歪的爵，以致喝尽。

chapters.en: Among all the sons she bore, there is no one to guide her; among all the sons she brought up, there is no one to take her hand.
chapters.zh: 她所生育的诸子中，没有一个引导她的； 她所养大的诸子中，没有一个搀扶她的。

chapters.en:
These pairs have befallen you: devastation and destruction,
famine and sword. Who will grieve for you? Who can comfort you?
chapters.zh: 荒凉、毁灭、饥荒、刀兵， 这几样临到你， 谁为你举哀？ 我如何能安慰你呢？

chapters.en:
Your sons have fainted; they lie at the head of every street,
like an antelope in a net. They are full of the wrath of the LORD, the rebuke of your God.
chapters.zh: 你的众子发昏， 在各市口上躺卧， 好像黄羊在网罗之中， 都满了耶和华的忿怒 －你上帝的斥责。

chapters.en: Therefore now hear this, you afflicted one, drunken, but not with wine.
chapters.zh: 因此，你这困苦却非因酒而醉的， 要听我言。

chapters.en:
Thus says your Lord, the LORD, even your God, who defends His people:
“See, I have removed from your hand the cup of staggering. From that goblet, the cup of My fury, you will never drink again.
chapters.zh: 你的主耶和华－ 就是为他百姓辨屈的上帝如此说： 看哪，我已将那使人东倒西歪的杯， 就是我忿怒的爵， 从你手中接过来； 你必不致再喝。

chapters.en: I will place it in the hands of your tormentors, who told you: ‘Lie down, so we can walk over you,’ so that you made your back like the ground, like a street to be traversed.”
chapters.zh: 我必将这杯递在苦待你的人手中； 他们曾对你说：你屈身， 由我们践踏过去吧！ 你便以背为地， 好像街市，任人经过。

chapters.en: Awake, awake, clothe yourself with strength, O Zion! Put on your garments of splendor, O Jerusalem, holy city! For the uncircumcised and unclean will no longer enter you.
chapters.zh: 锡安哪，兴起！兴起！ 披上你的能力！ 圣城耶路撒冷啊，穿上你华美的衣服！ 因为从今以后， 未受割礼、不洁净的必不再进入你中间。

chapters.en: Shake off your dust! Rise up and sit on your throne, O Jerusalem. Remove the chains from your neck, O captive Daughter of Zion.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，要抖下尘土！ 起来坐〔在位上〕！ 锡安被掳的居民〔注：原文是女子〕哪， 要解开你颈项的锁鍊！

chapters.en:
For this is what the LORD says:
“You were sold for nothing, and without money you will be redeemed.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：「你们是无价被卖的，也必无银被赎。

chapters.en:
For this is what the Lord GOD says:
“At first My people went down to Egypt to live, then Assyria oppressed them without cause.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说：起先我的百姓下到埃及，在那里寄居，又有亚述人无故欺压他们。

chapters.en:
And now what have I here? declares the LORD. For My people have been taken without cause; those who rule them taunt,
declares the LORD, and My name is blasphemed continually all day long.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：我的百姓既是无价被掳去，如今我在这里做什么呢？耶和华说：辖制他们的人呼叫，我的名整天受亵渎。

chapters.en: Therefore My people will know My name; therefore they will know on that day that I am He who speaks. Here I am!”
chapters.zh: 所以，我的百姓必知道我的名；到那日〔他们必知道〕说这话的就是我。看哪，是我！」

chapters.en:
How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of those who bring good news, who proclaim peace, who bring good tidings, who proclaim salvation,
who say to Zion, “Your God reigns!”
chapters.zh: 那报佳音，传平安， 报好信，传救恩的， 对锡安说：你的上帝作王了！ 这人的脚登山何等佳美！

chapters.en: Listen! Your watchmen lift up their voices, together they shout for joy. For every eye will see when the LORD returns to Zion.
chapters.zh: 听啊，你守望之人的声音， 他们扬起声来，一同歌唱； 因为耶和华归回锡安的时候， 他们必亲眼看见。

chapters.en: Break forth in joy, sing together, O ruins of Jerusalem, for the LORD has comforted His people; He has redeemed Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷的荒场啊， 要发起欢声，一同歌唱； 因为耶和华安慰了他的百姓， 救赎了耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: The LORD has bared His holy arm in the sight of all the nations; all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在万国眼前露出圣臂； 地极的人都看见我们上帝的救恩了。

chapters.en: Depart, depart, go out from there! Touch no unclean thing; come out from it, purify yourselves, you who carry the vessels of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你们离开吧！离开吧！ 从巴比伦出来。 不要沾不洁净的物； 要从其中出来。 你们扛抬耶和华器皿的人哪， 务要自洁。

chapters.en: For you will not leave in a hurry nor flee in haste, for the LORD goes before you, and the God of Israel is your rear guard.
chapters.zh: 你们出来必不致急忙， 也不致奔逃。 因为，耶和华必在你们前头行； 以色列的上帝必作你们的后盾。

chapters.en: Behold, My Servant will prosper; He will be raised and lifted up and highly exalted.
chapters.zh: 我的仆人行事必有智慧〔注：或译：行事通达〕， 必被高举上升， 且成为至高。

chapters.en:
Just as many were appalled at Him — His appearance was disfigured beyond that of any man,
and His form was marred beyond human likeness—
chapters.zh: 许多人因他〔注：原文是你〕惊奇； 他的面貌比别人憔悴； 他的形容比世人枯槁。

chapters.en: so He will sprinkle many nations. Kings will shut their mouths because of Him. For they will see what they have not been told, and they will understand what they have not heard.
chapters.zh: 这样，他必洗净〔注：或译：鼓动〕许多国民； 君王要向他闭口。 因所未曾传与他们的，他们必看见； 未曾听见的，他们要明白。

chapters.en: Who has believed our message? And to whom has the arm of the LORD been revealed?
chapters.zh: 我们所传的〔注：或译：所传与我们的〕有谁信呢？ 耶和华的膀臂向谁显露呢？

chapters.en: He grew up before Him like a tender shoot, and like a root out of dry ground. He had no stately form or majesty to attract us, no beauty that we should desire Him.
chapters.zh: 他在耶和华面前生长如嫩芽， 像根出于干地。 他无佳形美容； 我们看见他的时候， 也无美貌使我们羨慕他。

chapters.en: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of sorrows, acquainted with grief. Like one from whom men hide their faces, He was despised, and we esteemed Him not.
chapters.zh: 他被藐视，被人厌弃； 多受痛苦，常经忧患。 他被藐视， 好像被人掩面不看的一样； 我们也不尊重他。

chapters.en: Surely He took up our infirmities and carried our sorrows; yet we considered Him stricken, struck down by God, and afflicted.
chapters.zh: 他诚然担当我们的忧患， 背负我们的痛苦； 我们却以为他受责罚， 被上帝击打苦待了。

chapters.en: But He was pierced for our transgressions, He was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was upon Him, and by His stripes we are healed.
chapters.zh: 哪知他为我们的过犯受害， 为我们的罪孽压伤。 因他受的刑罚，我们得平安； 因他受的鞭伤，我们得医治。

chapters.en: We all like sheep have gone astray, each one has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid upon Him the iniquity of us all.
chapters.zh: 我们都如羊走迷； 各人偏行己路； 耶和华使我们众人的罪孽都归在他身上。

chapters.en:
He was oppressed and afflicted, yet He did not open His mouth. He was led like a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is silent,
so He did not open His mouth.
chapters.zh: 他被欺压， 在受苦的时候却不开口〔注：或译：他受欺压，却自卑不开口〕； 他像羊羔被牵到宰杀之地， 又像羊在剪毛的人手下无声， 他也是这样不开口。

chapters.en: By oppression and judgment He was taken away, and who can recount His descendants? For He was cut off from the land of the living; He was stricken for the transgression of My people.
chapters.zh: 因受欺压和审判，他被夺去， 至于他同世的人，谁想他受鞭打、 从活人之地被剪除， 是因我百姓的罪过呢？

chapters.en: He was assigned a grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in His death, although He had done no violence, nor was any deceit in His mouth.
chapters.zh: 他虽然未行强暴， 口中也没有诡诈， 人还使他与恶人同埋； 谁知死的时候与财主同葬。

chapters.en:
Yet it was the LORD’s will to crush Him and to cause Him to suffer; and when His soul is made a guilt offering, He will see His offspring, He will prolong His days,
and the good pleasure of the LORD will prosper in His hand.
chapters.zh: 耶和华却定意〔注：或译：喜悦〕将他压伤， 使他受痛苦。 耶和华以他为赎罪祭〔注：或译：他献本身为赎罪祭〕。 他必看见后裔，并且延长年日。 耶和华所喜悦的事必在他手中亨通。

chapters.en: After the anguish of His soul, He will see the light of life and be satisfied. By His knowledge My righteous Servant will justify many, and He will bear their iniquities.
chapters.zh: 他必看见自己劳苦的功效， 便心满意足。 有许多人因认识我的义仆得称为义； 并且他要担当他们的罪孽。

chapters.en: Therefore I will allot Him a portion with the great, and He will divide the spoils with the strong, because He has poured out His life unto death, and He was numbered with the transgressors. Yet He bore the sin of many and made intercession for the transgressors.
chapters.zh: 所以，我要使他与位大的同分， 与强盛的均分掳物。 因为他将命倾倒，以致于死； 他也被列在罪犯之中。 他却担当多人的罪， 又为罪犯代求。

chapters.en: “Shout for joy, O barren woman, who bears no children; break forth in song and cry aloud, you who have never travailed; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你这不怀孕、不生养的要歌唱； 你这未曾经过产难的要发声歌唱，扬声欢呼； 因为没有丈夫的比有丈夫的儿女更多。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
“Enlarge the site of your tent, stretch out the curtains of your dwellings,
do not hold back. Lengthen your ropes and drive your stakes in deep.
chapters.zh: 要扩张你帐幕之地， 张大你居所的幔子，不要限止； 要放长你的绳子， 坚固你的橛子。

chapters.en:
For you will spread out to the right and left; your descendants will dispossess the nations
and inhabit the desolate cities.
chapters.zh: 因为你要向左向右开展； 你的后裔必得多国为业， 又使荒凉的城邑有人居住。

chapters.en: Do not be afraid, for you will not be put to shame; do not be intimidated, for you will not be humiliated. For you will forget the shame of your youth and will remember no more the reproach of your widowhood.
chapters.zh: 不要惧怕，因你必不致蒙羞； 也不要抱愧，因你必不致受辱。 你必忘记幼年的羞愧， 不再记念你寡居的羞辱。

chapters.en: For your husband is your Maker— the LORD of Hosts is His name— the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; He is called the God of all the earth.
chapters.zh: 因为造你的是你的丈夫； 万军之耶和华是他的名。 救赎你的是以色列的圣者； 他必称为全地之上帝。

chapters.en: For the LORD has called you back, like a wife deserted and wounded in spirit, like the rejected wife of one’s youth,” says your God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华召你， 如召被离弃心中忧伤的妻， 就是幼年所娶被弃的妻。 这是你上帝所说的。

chapters.en: “For a brief moment I forsook you, but with great compassion I will bring you back.
chapters.zh: 我离弃你不过片时， 却要施大恩将你收回。

chapters.en: In a surge of anger I hid My face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you,” says the LORD your Redeemer.
chapters.zh: 我的怒气涨溢， 顷刻之间向你掩面， 却要以永远的慈爱怜恤你。 这是耶和华－你的救赎主说的。

chapters.en:
“For to Me this is like the days of Noah, when I swore that the waters of Noah
would never again cover the earth. So I have sworn that I will not be angry with you or rebuke you.
chapters.zh: 这事在我好像挪亚的洪水。 我怎样起誓不再使挪亚的洪水漫过遍地， 我也照样起誓不再向你发怒， 也不斥责你。

chapters.en:
Though the mountains may be removed and the hills may be shaken, My loving devotion will not depart from you, and My covenant of peace will not be broken,”
says the LORD, who has compassion on you.
chapters.zh: 大山可以挪开， 小山可以迁移； 但我的慈爱必不离开你； 我平安的约也不迁移。 这是怜恤你的耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “O afflicted city, lashed by storms, without solace, surely I will set your stones in antimony and lay your foundations with sapphires.
chapters.zh: 你这受困苦、被风飘荡不得安慰的人哪， 我必以彩色安置你的石头， 以蓝宝石立定你的根基；

chapters.en:
I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels,
and all your walls of precious stones.
chapters.zh: 又以红宝石造你的女墙， 以红玉造你的城门， 以宝石造你四围的边界〔注：或译：外郭〕。

chapters.en: Then all your sons will be taught by the LORD, and great will be their prosperity.
chapters.zh: 你的儿女都要受耶和华的教训； 你的儿女必大享平安。

chapters.en:
In righteousness you will be established, far from oppression,
for you will have no fear. Terror will be far removed, for it will not come near you.
chapters.zh: 你必因公义得坚立， 必远离欺压，不致害怕； 你必远离惊吓，惊吓必不临近你。

chapters.en: If anyone attacks you, it is not from Me; whoever assails you will fall before you.
chapters.zh: 即或有人聚集，却不由于我； 凡聚集攻击你的，必因你仆倒〔注：或译：投降你〕。

chapters.en:
Behold, I have created the craftsman who fans the coals into flame
and forges a weapon fit for its task; and I have created the destroyer to wreak havoc.
chapters.zh: 吹嘘炭火、打造合用器械的铁匠是我所造； 残害人、行毁灭的也是我所造。

chapters.en: No weapon formed against you shall prosper, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their vindication is from Me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 凡为攻击你造成的器械必不利用； 凡在审判时兴起用舌攻击你的， 你必定他为有罪。 这是耶和华仆人的产业， 是他们从我所得的义。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Come, all you who are thirsty, come to the waters; and you without money, come, buy, and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without money and without cost!
chapters.zh: 你们一切干渴的都当就近水来； 没有银钱的也可以来。 你们都来，买了吃； 不用银钱，不用价值， 也来买酒和奶。

chapters.en: Why spend money on that which is not bread, and your labor on that which does not satisfy? Listen carefully to Me, and eat what is good, and your soul will delight in the richest of foods.
chapters.zh: 你们为何花钱〔注：原文是平银〕买那不足为食物的？ 用劳碌得来的买那不使人饱足的呢？ 你们要留意听我的话就能吃那美物， 得享肥甘，心中喜乐。

chapters.en: Incline your ear and come to Me; listen, so that your soul may live. I will make with you an everlasting covenant— My loving devotion promised to David.
chapters.zh: 你们当就近我来； 侧耳而听，就必得活。 我必与你们立永约， 就是〔应许〕大卫那可靠的恩典。

chapters.en: Behold, I have made him a witness to the nations, a leader and commander of the peoples.
chapters.zh: 我已立他作万民的见证， 为万民的君王和司令。

chapters.en: Surely you will summon a nation you do not know, and nations who do not know you will run to you. For the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, has bestowed glory on you.”
chapters.zh: 你素不认识的国民，你也必召来； 素不认识你的国民也必向你奔跑， 都因耶和华－你的上帝以色列的圣者， 因为他已经荣耀你。

chapters.en: Seek the LORD while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.
chapters.zh: 当趁耶和华可寻找的时候寻找他， 相近的时候求告他。

chapters.en: Let the wicked man forsake his way and the unrighteous man his thoughts; let him return to the LORD, that He may have compassion, and to our God, for He will freely pardon.
chapters.zh: 恶人当离弃自己的道路； 不义的人当除掉自己的意念。 归向耶和华，耶和华就必怜恤他； 当归向我们的上帝，因为上帝必广行赦免。

chapters.en: “For My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways My ways,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：我的意念非同你们的意念； 我的道路非同你们的道路。

chapters.en:
“For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so My ways are higher than your ways
and My thoughts than your thoughts.
chapters.zh: 天怎样高过地， 照样，我的道路高过你们的道路； 我的意念高过你们的意念。

chapters.en: For just as rain and snow fall from heaven and do not return without watering the earth, making it bud and sprout, and providing seed to sow and food to eat,
chapters.zh: 雨雪从天而降，并不返回， 却滋润地土，使地上发芽结实， 使撒种的有种，使要吃的有粮。

chapters.en: so My word that proceeds from My mouth will not return to Me empty, but it will accomplish what I please, and it will prosper where I send it.
chapters.zh: 我口所出的话也必如此， 决不徒然返回， 却要成就我所喜悦的， 在我发他去成就〔注：发他去成就：或译所命定〕的事上必然亨通。

chapters.en: You will indeed go out with joy and be led forth in peace; the mountains and hills will burst into song before you, and all the trees of the field will clap their hands.
chapters.zh: 你们必欢欢喜喜而出来， 平平安安蒙引导。 大山小山必在你们面前发声歌唱； 田野的树木也都拍掌。

chapters.en: Instead of the thornbush, the cypress will grow, and instead of the brier, the myrtle will spring up; this will make a name for the LORD, an everlasting sign, never to be destroyed.”
chapters.zh: 松树长出，代替荆棘； 番石榴长出，代替蒺藜。 这要为耶和华留名， 作为永远的证据，不能剪除。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“Maintain justice and do what is right, for My salvation is coming soon,
and My righteousness will be revealed.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 你们当守公平，行公义； 因我的救恩临近， 我的公义将要显现。

chapters.en: Blessed is the man who does this, and the son of man who holds it fast, who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it and keeps his hand from doing any evil.”
chapters.zh: 谨守安息日而不干犯， 禁止己手而不作恶； 如此行、如此持守的人便为有福。

chapters.en: Let no foreigner who has joined himself to the LORD say, “The LORD will utterly exclude me from His people.” And let the eunuch not say, “I am but a dry tree.”
chapters.zh: 与耶和华联合的外邦人不要说： 耶和华必定将我从他民中分别出来。 太监也不要说：我是枯树。

chapters.en:
For this is what the LORD says:
“To the eunuchs who keep My Sabbaths, who choose what pleases Me
and hold fast to My covenant—
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华如此说： 那些谨守我的安息日， 拣选我所喜悦的事， 持守我约的太监，

chapters.en:
I will give them, in My house and within My walls, a memorial and a name
better than that of sons and daughters. I will give them an everlasting name that will not be cut off.
chapters.zh: 我必使他们在我殿中， 在我墙内，有记念，有名号， 比有儿女的更美。 我必赐他们永远的名，不能剪除。

chapters.en: And the foreigners who join themselves to the LORD to minister to Him, to love the name of the LORD, and to be His servants— all who keep the Sabbath without profaning it and who hold fast to My covenant—
chapters.zh: 还有那些与耶和华联合的外邦人， 要事奉他，要爱耶和华的名， 要作他的仆人－ 就是凡守安息日不干犯， 又持守他〔注：原文是我〕约的人。

chapters.en: I will bring them to My holy mountain and make them joyful in My house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and sacrifices will be accepted on My altar, for My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations.”
chapters.zh: 我必领他们到我的圣山， 使他们在祷告我的殿中喜乐。 他们的燔祭和〔平安〕祭， 在我坛上必蒙悦纳， 因我的殿必称为万民祷告的殿。

chapters.en:
Thus declares the Lord GOD, who gathers the dispersed of Israel:
“I will gather to them still others besides those already gathered.”
chapters.zh: 主耶和华， 就是招聚以色列被赶散的，说： 在这被招聚的人以外， 我还要招聚〔别人〕归并他们。

chapters.en: Come, all you beasts of the field; eat greedily, all you beasts of the forest.
chapters.zh: 田野的诸兽都来吞吃吧！ 林中的诸兽也要如此。

chapters.en: Israel’s watchmen are blind, they are all oblivious; they are all mute dogs, they cannot bark; they are dreamers lying around, loving to slumber.
chapters.zh: 他看守的人是瞎眼的， 都没有知识， 都是哑巴狗，不能叫唤； 但知做梦，躺卧，贪睡，

chapters.en:
Like ravenous dogs, they are never satisfied. They are shepherds with no discernment; they all turn to their own way,
each one seeking his own gain:
chapters.zh: 这些狗贪食，不知饱足。 这些牧人不能明白－ 各人偏行己路， 各从各方求自己的利益。

chapters.en: “Come, let me get the wine, let us imbibe the strong drink, and tomorrow will be like today, only far better!”
chapters.zh: 他们说：来吧！我去拿酒， 我们饱饮浓酒； 明日必和今日一样， 就是〔宴乐〕无量极大之日。

chapters.en: The righteous perish, and no one takes it to heart; devout men are taken away, while no one considers that the righteous are taken away from the presence of evil.
chapters.zh: 义人死亡， 无人放在心上； 虔诚人被收去， 无人思念。 这义人被收去是免了〔将来的〕祸患；

chapters.en: Those who walk uprightly enter into peace; they find rest, lying down in death.
chapters.zh: 他们得享〔注：原文是进入〕平安。 素行正直的，各人在坟里〔注：原文是床上〕安歇。

chapters.en: “But come here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes!
chapters.zh: 你们这些巫婆的儿子， 奸夫和妓女的种子， 都要前来！
