chapters.en: Whom are you mocking? At whom do you sneer and stick out your tongue? Are you not children of transgression, offspring of deceit,
chapters.zh: 你们向谁戏笑？ 向谁张口吐舌呢？ 你们岂不是悖逆的儿女， 虚谎的种类呢？

chapters.en: who burn with lust among the oaks, under every luxuriant tree, who slaughter your children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?
chapters.zh: 你们在橡树中间，在各青翠树下欲火攻心； 在山谷间，在石穴下杀了儿女；

chapters.en:
Your portion is among the smooth stones of the valley; indeed, they are your lot. Even to them you have poured out a drink offering and offered a grain offering.
Should I relent because of these?
chapters.zh: 在谷中光滑〔石头〕里有你的分。 这些就是你所得的分； 你也向他浇了奠祭，献了供物， 因这事我岂能容忍吗？

chapters.en: On a high and lofty hill you have made your bed, and there you went up to offer sacrifices.
chapters.zh: 你在高而又高的山上安设床榻， 也上那里去献祭。

chapters.en: Behind the door and doorpost you have set up your memorial. Forsaking Me, you uncovered your bed; you climbed up and opened it wide. And you have made a pact with those whose bed you have loved; you have gazed upon their nakedness.
chapters.zh: 你在门后，在门框后， 立起你的纪念； 向外人赤露，又上去扩张床榻， 与他们立约； 你在那里看见他们的床就甚喜爱。

chapters.en: You went to Molech with oil and multiplied your perfumes. You have sent your envoys a great distance; you have descended even to Sheol itself.
chapters.zh: 你把油带到王那里， 又多加香料， 打发使者往远方去， 自卑自贱直到阴间，

chapters.en: You are wearied by your many journeys, but you did not say, “There is no hope!” You found renewal of your strength; therefore you did not grow weak.
chapters.zh: 你因路远疲倦， 却不说这是枉然； 你〔以为〕有复兴之力， 所以不觉疲惫。

chapters.en:
Whom have you dreaded and feared, so that you lied and failed
to remember Me or take this to heart? Is it not because I have long been silent that you do not fear Me?
chapters.zh: 你怕谁？因谁恐惧？ 竟说谎，不记念我， 又不将这事放在心上。 我不是许久闭口不言， 你仍不怕我吗？

chapters.en: I will expose your righteousness and your works, and they will not profit you.
chapters.zh: 我要指明你的公义； 至于你所行的都必与你无益。

chapters.en: When you cry out, let your companies of idols deliver you! Yet the wind will carry off all of them, a breath will take them away. But he who seeks refuge in Me will inherit the land and possess My holy mountain.”
chapters.zh: 你哀求的时候， 让你所聚集的拯救你吧！ 风要把他们刮散， 一口气要把他们都吹去。 但那投靠我的必得地土， 必承受我的圣山为业。

chapters.en:
And it will be said,
“Build it up, build it up, prepare the way, take every obstacle out of the way of My people.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华要说： 你们修筑修筑，预备道路， 将绊脚石从我百姓的路中除掉。

chapters.en:
For thus says the One who is high and lifted up, who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy:
“I dwell in a high and holy place, and with the oppressed and humble in spirit, to restore the spirit of the lowly and revive the heart of the contrite.
chapters.zh: 因为那至高至上、永远长存〔注：原文是住在永远〕 名为圣者的如此说： 我住在至高至圣的所在， 也与心灵痛悔谦卑的人同居； 要使谦卑人的灵苏醒， 也使痛悔人的心苏醒。

chapters.en: For I will not accuse you forever, nor will I always be angry; for then the spirit of man would grow weak before Me— the breath of life I have made.
chapters.zh: 我必不永远相争，也不长久发怒， 恐怕我所造的人与灵性都必发昏。

chapters.en: I was enraged by his sinful greed, so I struck him and hid My face in anger; yet he kept turning back to the desires of his heart.
chapters.zh: 因他贪婪的罪孽，我就发怒击打他； 我向他掩面发怒， 他却仍然随心背道。

chapters.en: I have seen his ways, but I will heal him; I will guide him and restore comfort to him and his mourners,
chapters.zh: 我看见他所行的道，也要医治他； 又要引导他， 使他和那一同伤心的人再得安慰。

chapters.en: bringing praise to their lips. Peace, peace to those far and near,” says the LORD, “and I will heal them.”
chapters.zh: 我造就嘴唇的果子； 愿平安康泰归与远处的人， 也归与近处的人； 并且我要医治他。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
But the wicked are like the storm-tossed sea, for it cannot be still,
and its waves churn up mire and muck.
chapters.zh: 惟独恶人，好像翻腾的海， 不得平静； 其中的水常涌出污秽和淤泥来。

chapters.en: “There is no peace,” says my God, “for the wicked.”
chapters.zh: 我的上帝说：恶人必不得平安！

chapters.en: “Cry aloud, do not hold back! Raise your voice like a ram’s horn. Declare to My people their transgression and to the house of Jacob their sins.
chapters.zh: 你要大声喊叫，不可止息； 扬起声来，好像吹角。 向我百姓说明他们的过犯； 向雅各家说明他们的罪恶。

chapters.en: For day after day they seek Me and delight to know My ways, like a nation that does what is right and does not forsake the justice of their God. They ask Me for righteous judgments; they delight in the nearness of God.”
chapters.zh: 他们天天寻求我， 乐意明白我的道， 好像行义的国民， 不离弃他们上帝的典章， 向我求问公义的判语， 喜悦亲近上帝。

chapters.en:
“Why have we fasted, and You have not seen? Why have we humbled ourselves, and You have not noticed?”
“Behold, on the day of your fast, you do as you please, and you oppress all your workers.
chapters.zh: 他们说：我们禁食，你为何不看见呢？ 我们刻苦己心，你为何不理会呢？ 看哪，你们禁食的日子仍求利益， 勒逼人为你们做苦工。

chapters.en: You fast with contention and strife to strike viciously with your fist. You cannot fast as you do today and have your voice be heard on high.
chapters.zh: 你们禁食，却互相争竞， 以凶恶的拳头打人。 你们今日禁食， 不得使你们的声音听闻于上。

chapters.en: Is this the fast I have chosen: a day for a man to deny himself, to bow his head like a reed, and to spread out sackcloth and ashes? Will you call this a fast and a day acceptable to the LORD?
chapters.zh: 这样禁食岂是我所拣选、 使人刻苦己心的日子吗？ 岂是叫人垂头像苇子， 用麻布和炉灰铺在他以下吗？ 你这可称为禁食、为耶和华所悦纳的日子吗？

chapters.en:
Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen: to break the chains of wickedness,
to untie the cords of the yoke, to set the oppressed free and tear off every yoke?
chapters.zh: 我所拣选的禁食不是要松开凶恶的绳， 解下轭上的索， 使被欺压的得自由， 折断一切的轭吗？

chapters.en:
Isn’t it to share your bread with the hungry, to bring the poor and homeless into your home,
to clothe the naked when you see him, and not to turn away from your own flesh and blood?
chapters.zh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人， 将飘流的穷人接到你家中， 见赤身的给他〔衣服〕遮体， 顾恤自己的骨肉而不掩藏吗？

chapters.en: Then your light will break forth like the dawn, and your healing will come quickly. Your righteousness will go before you, and the glory of the LORD will be your rear guard.
chapters.zh: 这样，你的光就必发现如早晨的光； 你所得的医治要速速发明。 你的公义必在你前面行； 耶和华的荣光必作你的后盾。

chapters.en: Then you will call, and the LORD will answer; you will cry out, and He will say, ‘Here I am.’ If you remove the yoke from your midst, the pointing of the finger and malicious talk,
chapters.zh: 那时你求告，耶和华必应允； 你呼求，他必说：我在这里。 你若从你中间除掉〔重〕轭 和指摘人的指头，并发恶言的事，

chapters.en: and if you give yourself to the hungry and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will go forth in the darkness, and your night will be like noonday.
chapters.zh: 你心若向饥饿的人发怜悯， 使困苦的人得满足， 你的光就必在黑暗中发现； 你的幽暗必变如正午。

chapters.en:
The LORD will always guide you; He will satisfy you in a sun-scorched land
and strengthen your frame. You will be like a well-watered garden, like a spring whose waters never fail.
chapters.zh: 耶和华也必时常引导你， 在干旱之地使你心满意足， 骨头强壮。 你必像浇灌的园子， 又像水流不绝的泉源。

chapters.en: Your people will rebuild the ancient ruins; you will restore the age-old foundations; you will be called Repairer of the Breach, Restorer of the Streets of Dwelling.
chapters.zh: 那些出于你的人必修造久已荒废之处； 你要建立〔拆毁〕累代的根基。 你必称为补破口的， 和重修路径与人居住的。

chapters.en: If you turn your foot from breaking the Sabbath, from doing as you please on My holy day, if you call the Sabbath a delight, and the LORD’s holy day honorable, if you honor it by not going your own way or seeking your own pleasure or speaking idle words,
chapters.zh: 你若在安息日掉转〔注：或译：谨慎〕你的脚步， 在我圣日不以〔操作〕为喜乐， 称安息日为可喜乐的， 称耶和华的圣日为可尊重的； 而且尊敬这日， 不办自己的私事， 不随自己的私意， 不说自己的私话，

chapters.en:
then you will delight yourself in the LORD, and I will make you ride on the heights of the land
and feed you with the heritage of your father Jacob.” For the mouth of the LORD has spoken.
chapters.zh: 你就以耶和华为乐。 耶和华要使你乘驾地的高处， 又以你祖雅各的产业养育你。 这是耶和华亲口说的。

chapters.en: Surely the arm of the LORD is not too short to save, nor His ear too dull to hear.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的膀臂并非缩短，不能拯救， 耳朵并非发沉，不能听见，

chapters.en: But your iniquities have built barriers between you and your God, and your sins have hidden His face from you, so that He does not hear.
chapters.zh: 但你们的罪孽使你们与上帝隔绝； 你们的罪恶使他掩面不听你们。

chapters.en: For your hands are stained with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, and your tongue mutters injustice.
chapters.zh: 因你们的手被血沾染， 你们的指头被罪孽沾污， 你们的嘴唇说谎言， 你们的舌头出恶语。

chapters.en: No one calls for justice; no one pleads his case honestly. They rely on empty pleas; they tell lies; they conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity.
chapters.zh: 无一人按公义告状， 无一人凭诚实辩白； 都倚靠虚妄，说谎言。 所怀的是毒害； 所生的是罪孽。

chapters.en: They hatch the eggs of vipers and weave a spider’s web. Whoever eats their eggs will die; crack one open, and a viper is hatched.
chapters.zh: 他们菢毒蛇蛋， 结蜘蛛网； 人吃这蛋必死。 这蛋被踏，必出蝮蛇。

chapters.en: Their cobwebs cannot be made into clothing, and they cannot cover themselves with their works. Their deeds are sinful deeds, and acts of violence are in their hands.
chapters.zh: 所结的网不能成为衣服； 所做的也不能遮盖自己。 他们的行为都是罪孽； 手所做的都是强暴。

chapters.en: Their feet run to evil; they are swift to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are sinful thoughts; ruin and destruction lie in their wake.
chapters.zh: 他们的脚奔跑行恶； 他们急速流无辜人的血； 意念都是罪孽， 所经过的路都荒凉毁灭。

chapters.en: The way of peace they have not known, and there is no justice in their tracks. They have turned them into crooked paths; no one who treads on them will know peace.
chapters.zh: 平安的路，他们不知道； 所行的事没有公平。 他们为自己修弯曲的路； 凡行此路的都不知道平安。

chapters.en: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness does not reach us. We hope for light, but there is darkness; for brightness, but we walk in gloom.
chapters.zh: 因此，公平离我们远， 公义追不上我们。 我们指望光亮，却是黑暗， 指望光明，却行幽暗。

chapters.en: Like the blind, we feel our way along the wall, groping like those without eyes. We stumble at midday as in the twilight; among the vigorous we are like the dead.
chapters.zh: 我们摸索墙壁，好像瞎子； 我们摸索，如同无目之人。 我们晌午绊脚，如在黄昏一样； 我们在肥壮人中，像死人一般。

chapters.en: We all growl like bears and moan like doves. We hope for justice, but find none, for salvation, but it is far from us.
chapters.zh: 我们咆哮如熊， 哀鸣如鸽； 指望公平，却是没有； 指望救恩，却远离我们。

chapters.en: For our transgressions are multiplied before You, and our sins testify against us. Our transgressions are indeed with us, and we know our iniquities:
chapters.zh: 我们的过犯在你面前增多， 罪恶作见证告我们； 过犯与我们同在。 至于我们的罪孽，我们都知道：

chapters.en: rebelling and denying the LORD, turning away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering lies from the heart.
chapters.zh: 就是悖逆、不认识耶和华， 转去不跟从我们的上帝， 说欺压和叛逆的话， 心怀谎言，随即说出。

chapters.en: So justice is turned away, and righteousness stands at a distance. For truth has stumbled in the public square, and honesty cannot enter.
chapters.zh: 并且公平转而退后， 公义站在远处； 诚实在街上仆倒， 正直也不得进入。

chapters.en:
Truth is missing, and whoever turns from evil becomes prey.
The LORD looked and was displeased that there was no justice.
chapters.zh: 诚实少见； 离恶的人反成掠物。 那时，耶和华看见没有公平， 甚不喜悦。

chapters.en: He saw that there was no man; He was amazed that there was no one to intercede. So His own arm brought salvation, and His own righteousness sustained Him.
chapters.zh: 他见无人〔拯救〕， 无人代求，甚为诧异， 就用自己的膀臂施行拯救， 以公义扶持自己。

chapters.en: He put on righteousness like a breastplate, and the helmet of salvation on His head; He put on garments of vengeance and wrapped Himself in a cloak of zeal.
chapters.zh: 他以公义为铠甲〔注：或译：护心镜〕， 以拯救为头盔， 以报仇为衣服， 以热心为外袍。

chapters.en:
So He will repay according to their deeds: fury to His enemies,
retribution to His foes,
and recompense to the islands.
chapters.zh: 他必按人的行为施报， 恼怒他的敌人， 报复他的仇敌， 向众海岛施行报应。

chapters.en:
So shall they fear the name of the LORD where the sun sets,
and His glory where it rises. For He will come like a raging flood, driven by the breath of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 如此，人从日落之处必敬畏耶和华的名， 从日出之地也必敬畏他的荣耀； 因为仇敌好像急流的河水冲来， 是耶和华之气所驱逐的。

chapters.en: “The Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who turn from transgression, ” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 必有一位救赎主来到锡安－ 雅各族中转离过犯的人那里。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “As for Me, this is My covenant with them,” says the LORD. “My Spirit will not depart from you, and My words that I have put in your mouth will not depart from your mouth or from the mouths of your children and grandchildren, from now on and forevermore,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「至于我与他们所立的约乃是这样：我加给你的灵，传给你的话，必不离你的口，也不离你后裔与你后裔之后裔的口，从今直到永远；这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD rises upon you.
chapters.zh: 兴起，发光！因为你的光已经来到！ 耶和华的荣耀发现照耀你。

chapters.en: For behold, darkness covers the earth, and thick darkness is over the peoples; but the LORD will rise upon you, and His glory will appear over you.
chapters.zh: 看哪，黑暗遮盖大地， 幽暗遮盖万民， 耶和华却要显现照耀你； 他的荣耀要现在你身上。

chapters.en: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawn.
chapters.zh: 万国要来就你的光； 君王要来就你发现的光辉。

chapters.en: Lift up your eyes and look around: They all gather and come to you; your sons will come from afar, and your daughters will be carried on the arm.
chapters.zh: 你举目向四方观看； 众人都聚集来到你这里。 你的众子从远方而来； 你的众女也被怀抱而来。

chapters.en: Then you will look and be radiant, and your heart will tremble and swell with joy, because the riches of the sea will be brought to you, and the wealth of the nations will come to you.
chapters.zh: 那时，你看见就有光荣； 你心又跳动又宽畅； 因为大海丰盛的〔货物〕必转来归你； 列国的财宝也必来归你。

chapters.en:
Caravans of camels will cover your land, young camels of Midian and Ephah, and all from Sheba will come, bearing gold and frankincense
and proclaiming the praises of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 成群的骆驼， 并米甸和以法的独峰驼必遮满你； 示巴的众人都必来到； 要奉上黄金乳香， 又要传说耶和华的赞美。

chapters.en: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered to you; the rams of Nebaioth will serve you and go up on My altar with acceptance; I will adorn My glorious house.
chapters.zh: 基达的羊群都必聚集到你这里， 尼拜约的公羊要供你使用， 在我坛上必蒙悦纳； 我必荣耀我荣耀的殿。

chapters.en: Who are these who fly like clouds, like doves to their shelters?
chapters.zh: 那些飞来如云、 又如鸽子向窗户飞回的是谁呢？

chapters.en:
Surely the islands will wait for Me, with the ships of Tarshish in the lead, to bring your children from afar, with their silver and gold, to the honor of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel,
for He has glorified you.
chapters.zh: 众海岛必等候我， 首先是他施的船只， 将你的众子连他们的金银从远方一同带来， 都为耶和华－你上帝的名， 又为以色列的圣者， 因为他已经荣耀了你。

chapters.en: Foreigners will rebuild your walls, and their kings will serve you. Although I struck you in anger, yet in favor I will show you mercy.
chapters.zh: 外邦人必建筑你的城墙； 他们的王必服事你。 我曾发怒击打你， 现今却施恩怜恤你。

chapters.en: Your gates will always stand open; they will never be shut, day or night, so that the wealth of the nations may be brought into you, with their kings being led in procession.
chapters.zh: 你的城门必时常开放， 昼夜不关； 使人把列国的财物带来归你， 并将他们的君王牵引而来。

chapters.en: For the nation or kingdom that will not serve you will perish; it will be utterly destroyed.
chapters.zh: 哪一邦哪一国不事奉你，就必灭亡， 也必全然荒废。

chapters.en: The glory of Lebanon will come to you— its cypress, elm, and boxwood together— to adorn the place of My sanctuary, and I will glorify the place of My feet.
chapters.zh: 黎巴嫩的荣耀， 就是松树、杉树、黄杨树， 都必一同归你， 为要修饰我圣所之地； 我也要使我脚踏之处得荣耀。

chapters.en: The sons of your oppressors will come and bow down to you; all who reviled you will fall facedown at your feet and call you the City of the LORD, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
chapters.zh: 素来苦待你的，他的子孙都必屈身来就你； 藐视你的，都要在你脚下跪拜。 他们要称你为「耶和华的城」， 为「以色列圣者的锡安」。

chapters.en: Whereas you have been forsaken and despised, with no one passing through, I will make you an everlasting pride, a joy from age to age.
chapters.zh: 你虽然被撇弃被厌恶， 甚至无人经过， 我却使你变为永远的荣华， 成为累代的喜乐。

chapters.en: You will drink the milk of nations and nurse at the breasts of royalty; you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
chapters.zh: 你也必吃万国的奶， 又吃君王的奶。 你便知道我－耶和华是你的救主， 是你的救赎主，雅各的大能者。

chapters.en: Instead of bronze I will bring you gold; I will bring silver in place of iron, bronze instead of wood, and iron instead of stones. I will appoint peace as your governor and righteousness as your ruler.
chapters.zh: 我要拿金子代替铜， 拿银子代替铁， 拿铜代替木头， 拿铁代替石头； 并要以和平为你的官长， 以公义为你的监督。

chapters.en: No longer will violence be heard in your land, nor ruin or destruction within your borders. But you will name your walls Salvation and your gates Praise.
chapters.zh: 你地上不再听见强暴的事， 境内不再听见荒凉毁灭的事。 你必称你的墙为「拯救」， 称你的门为「赞美」。

chapters.en: No longer will the sun be your light by day, nor the brightness of the moon shine on your night; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your splendor.
chapters.zh: 日头不再作你白昼的光； 月亮也不再发光照耀你。 耶和华却要作你永远的光； 你上帝要为你的荣耀。

chapters.en: Your sun will no longer set, and your moon will not wane; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and the days of your sorrow will cease.
chapters.zh: 你的日头不再下落； 你的月亮也不退缩； 因为耶和华必作你永远的光。 你悲哀的日子也完毕了。

chapters.en:
Then all your people will be righteous; they will possess the land forever; they are the branch of My planting, the work of My hands,
so that I may be glorified.
chapters.zh: 你的居民都成为义人， 永远得地为业； 是我种的栽子，我手的工作， 使我得荣耀。

chapters.en: The least of you will become a thousand, and the smallest a mighty nation. I am the LORD; in its time I will accomplish it quickly.
chapters.zh: 至小的〔族〕要加增千倍； 微弱的国必成为强盛。 我－耶和华要按定期速成这事。

chapters.en:
The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me, because the LORD has anointed Me
to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives
and freedom to the prisoners,
chapters.zh: 主耶和华的灵在我身上； 因为耶和华用膏膏我， 叫我传好信息给谦卑的人〔注：或译：传福音给贫穷的人〕， 差遣我医好伤心的人， 报告被掳的得释放， 被囚的出〔监牢〕；

chapters.en:
to proclaim the year of the LORD’s favor and the day of our God’s vengeance,
to comfort all who mourn,
chapters.zh: 报告耶和华的恩年， 和我们上帝报仇的日子； 安慰一切悲哀的人，

chapters.en: to console the mourners in Zion— to give them a crown of beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, and a garment of praise for a spirit of despair. So they will be called oaks of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that He may be glorified.
chapters.zh: 赐华冠与锡安悲哀的人，代替灰尘； 喜乐油代替悲哀； 赞美衣代替忧伤之灵； 使他们称为「公义树」， 是耶和华所栽的，叫他得荣耀。

chapters.en: They will rebuild the ancient ruins; they will restore the places long devastated; they will renew the ruined cities, the desolations of many generations.
chapters.zh: 他们必修造已久的荒场， 建立先前凄凉之处， 重修历代荒凉之城。

chapters.en: Strangers will stand and feed your flocks, and foreigners will be your plowmen and vinedressers.
chapters.zh: 那时，外人必起来牧放你们的羊群； 外邦人必作你们耕种田地的， 修理葡萄园的。

chapters.en: But you will be called the priests of the LORD; they will speak of you as ministers of our God; you will feed on the wealth of nations, and you will boast in their riches.
chapters.zh: 你们倒要称为耶和华的祭司； 人必称你们为我们上帝的仆役。 你们必吃用列国的财物， 因得他们的荣耀自夸。

chapters.en: Instead of shame, My people will have a double portion, and instead of humiliation, they will rejoice in their share; and so they will inherit a double portion in their land, and everlasting joy will be theirs.
chapters.zh: 你们〔必得〕加倍〔的好处〕，代替所受的羞辱； 分中所得的喜乐，必代替所受的凌辱。 在境内必得加倍〔的产业〕； 永远之乐必归与你们〔注：原文是他们〕。

chapters.en: For I, the LORD, love justice; I hate robbery and iniquity; in My faithfulness I will give them their recompense and make an everlasting covenant with them.
chapters.zh: 因为我－耶和华喜爱公平， 恨恶抢夺和罪孽； 我要凭诚实施行报应， 并要与我的百姓立永约。

chapters.en: Their descendants will be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge that they are a people the LORD has blessed.
chapters.zh: 他们的后裔必在列国中被人认识； 他们的子孙在众民中也是如此。 凡看见他们的必认他们是耶和华赐福的后裔。

chapters.en: I will rejoice greatly in the LORD, my soul will exult in my God; for He has clothed me with garments of salvation and wrapped me in a robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom wears a priestly headdress, as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
chapters.zh: 我因耶和华大大欢喜； 我的心靠上帝快乐。 因他以拯救为衣给我穿上， 以公义为袍给我披上， 好像新郎戴上华冠， 又像新妇佩戴妆饰。

chapters.en: For as the earth brings forth its growth, and as a garden enables seed to spring up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.
chapters.zh: 田地怎样使百谷发芽， 园子怎样使所种的发生， 主耶和华必照样 使公义和赞美在万民中发出。

chapters.en: For Zion’s sake I will not keep silent, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not keep still, until her righteousness shines like a bright light, her salvation like a blazing torch.
chapters.zh: 我因锡安必不静默， 为耶路撒冷必不息声， 直到他的公义如光辉发出， 他的救恩如明灯发亮。

chapters.en: Nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name that the mouth of the LORD will bestow.
chapters.zh: 列国必见你的公义； 列王必见你的荣耀。 你必得新名的称呼， 是耶和华亲口所起的。

chapters.en: You will be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, a royal diadem in the palm of your God.
chapters.zh: 你在耶和华的手中要作为华冠， 在你上帝的掌上必作为冕旒。

chapters.en: No longer will you be called Forsaken, nor your land named Desolate; but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for the LORD will take delight in you, and your land will be His bride.
chapters.zh: 你必不再称为「撇弃的」； 你的地也不再称为「荒凉的」。 你却要称为「我所喜悦的」； 你的地也必称为「有夫之妇」。 因为耶和华喜悦你， 你的地也必归他。

chapters.en: For as a young man marries a young woman, so your sons will marry you; and as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you.
chapters.zh: 少年人怎样娶处女， 你的众民〔注：民：原文是子〕也要照样娶你； 新郎怎样喜悦新妇， 你的上帝也要照样喜悦你。

chapters.en: On your walls, O Jerusalem, I have posted watchmen; they will never be silent day or night. You who call on the LORD shall take no rest for yourselves,
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷啊， 我在你城上设立守望的， 他们昼夜必不静默。 呼吁耶和华的，你们不要歇息，

chapters.en:
nor give Him any rest until He establishes Jerusalem
and makes her the praise of the earth.
chapters.zh: 也不要使他歇息， 直等他建立耶路撒冷， 使耶路撒冷在地上成为可赞美的。

chapters.en: The LORD has sworn by His right hand and by His mighty arm: “Never again will I give your grain to your enemies for food, nor will foreigners drink the new wine for which you have toiled.
chapters.zh: 耶和华指着自己的右手和大能的膀臂起誓说： 我必不再将你的五谷给你仇敌作食物； 外邦人也不再喝你劳碌得来的新酒。

chapters.en: For those who harvest grain will eat it and praise the LORD, and those who gather grapes will drink the wine in My holy courts.”
chapters.zh: 惟有那收割的要吃，并赞美耶和华； 那聚敛的要在我圣所的院内喝。

chapters.en:
Go out, go out through the gates; prepare the way for the people! Build it up, build up the highway; clear away the stones;
raise a banner for the nations!
chapters.zh: 你们当从门经过经过， 预备百姓的路； 修筑修筑大道， 捡去石头， 为万民竖立大旗，

chapters.en: Behold, the LORD has proclaimed to the ends of the earth, “Say to Daughter Zion: See, your Savior comes! Look, His reward is with Him, and His recompense goes before Him.”
chapters.zh: 看哪，耶和华曾宣告到地极， 对锡安的居民〔注：原文是女子〕说： 你的拯救者来到。 他的赏赐在他那里； 他的报应在他面前。

chapters.en: And they will be called the Holy People, the Redeemed of The LORD; and you will be called Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken.
chapters.zh: 人必称他们为「圣民」，为「耶和华的赎民」； 你也必称为「被眷顾、不撇弃的城」。

chapters.en:
Who is this coming from Edom, from Bozrah with crimson-stained garments? Who is this robed in splendor, marching in the greatness of His strength?
“It is I, proclaiming vindication, mighty to save.”
chapters.zh: 这从以东的波斯拉来， 穿红衣服， 装扮华美， 能力广大， 大步行走的是谁呢？ 就是我， 是凭公义说话， 以大能施行拯救。

chapters.en: Why are Your clothes red, and Your garments like one who treads the winepress?
chapters.zh: 你的装扮为何有红色？ 你的衣服为何像踹酒醡的呢？

chapters.en: “I have trodden the winepress alone, and no one from the nations was with Me. I trampled them in My anger and trod them down in My fury; their blood spattered My garments, and all My clothes were stained.
chapters.zh: 我独自踹酒醡； 众民中无一人与我同在。 我发怒将他们踹下， 发烈怒将他们践踏。 他们的血溅在我衣服上， 并且污染了我一切的衣裳。

chapters.en: For the day of vengeance was in My heart, and the year of My redemption had come.
chapters.zh: 因为，报仇之日在我心中； 救赎我民之年已经来到。

chapters.en: I looked, but there was no one to help; I was appalled that no one assisted. So My arm brought Me salvation, and My own wrath upheld Me.
chapters.zh: 我仰望，见无人帮助； 我诧异，没有人扶持。 所以，我自己的膀臂为我施行拯救； 我的烈怒将我扶持。

chapters.en:
I trampled the nations in My anger; in My wrath I made them drunk
and poured out their blood on the ground.”
chapters.zh: 我发怒，踹下众民； 发烈怒，使他们沉醉， 又将他们的血倒在地上。

chapters.en:
I will make known the LORD’s loving devotion and His praiseworthy acts, because of all that the LORD has done for us— the many good things for the house of Israel
according to His great compassion and loving devotion.
chapters.zh: 我要照耶和华一切所赐给我们的， 提起他的慈爱和美德， 并他向以色列家所施的大恩； 这恩是照他的怜恤 和丰盛的慈爱赐给他们的。

chapters.en:
For He said, “They are surely My people, sons who will not be disloyal.”
So He became their Savior.
chapters.zh: 他说：他们诚然是我的百姓， 不行虚假的子民； 这样，他就作了他们的救主。

chapters.en:
In all their distress, He too was afflicted, and the Angel of His Presence saved them. In His love and compassion He redeemed them; He lifted them up and carried them
all the days of old.
chapters.zh: 他们在一切苦难中， 他也同受苦难； 并且他面前的使者拯救他们； 他以慈爱和怜悯救赎他们； 在古时的日子常保抱他们，怀搋他们。

chapters.en: But they rebelled and grieved His Holy Spirit. So He turned and became their enemy, and He Himself fought against them.
chapters.zh: 他们竟悖逆，使主的圣灵担忧。 他就转作他们的仇敌， 亲自攻击他们。

chapters.en: Then His people remembered the days of old, the days of Moses. Where is He who brought them through the sea with the shepherds of His flock? Where is the One who set His Holy Spirit among them,
chapters.zh: 那时，他们〔注：原文是他〕想起古时的日子－ 摩西和他百姓，〔说〕： 将百姓和牧养他全群的人 从海里领上来的在哪里呢？ 将他的圣灵降在他们中间的在哪里呢？

chapters.en: who sent His glorious arm to lead them by the right hand of Moses, who divided the waters before them to gain for Himself everlasting renown,
chapters.zh: 使他荣耀的膀臂在摩西的右手边行动， 在他们前面将水分开， 要建立自己永远的名，

chapters.en:
who led them through the depths like a horse in the wilderness,
so that they did not stumble?
chapters.zh: 带领他们经过深处， 如马行走旷野， 使他们不致绊跌的在哪里呢？

chapters.en: Like cattle going down to the valley, the Spirit of the LORD gave them rest. You led Your people this way to make for Yourself a glorious name.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的灵使他们得安息， 仿佛牲畜下到山谷； 照样，你也引导你的百姓， 要建立自己荣耀的名。

chapters.en: Look down from heaven and see, from Your holy and glorious habitation. Where are Your zeal and might? Your yearning and compassion for me are restrained.
chapters.zh: 求你从天上垂顾， 从你圣洁荣耀的居所观看。 你的热心和你大能的作为在哪里呢？ 你爱慕的心肠和怜悯向我们止住了。

chapters.en:
Yet You are our Father, though Abraham does not know us
and Israel does not acknowledge us. You, O LORD, are our Father; our Redeemer from Everlasting is Your name.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕虽然不认识我们， 以色列也不承认我们， 你却是我们的父。 耶和华啊，你是我们的父； 从万古以来，你名称为「我们的救赎主」。

chapters.en: Why, O LORD, do You make us stray from Your ways and harden our hearts from fearing You? Return, for the sake of Your servants, the tribes of Your heritage.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你为何使我们走差离开你的道， 使我们心里刚硬、不敬畏你呢？ 求你为你仆人， 为你产业支派的缘故，转回来。

chapters.en: For a short while Your people possessed Your holy place, but our enemies have trampled Your sanctuary.
chapters.zh: 你的圣民不过暂时得这产业； 我们的敌人已经践踏你的圣所。

chapters.en: We have become like those You never ruled, like those not called by Your name.
chapters.zh: 我们好像你未曾治理的人， 又像未曾得称你名下的人。

chapters.en: If only You would rend the heavens and come down, so that mountains would quake at Your presence,
chapters.zh: 愿你裂天而降； 愿山在你面前震动－

chapters.en: as fire kindles the brushwood and causes the water to boil, to make Your name known to Your enemies, so that the nations will tremble at Your presence!
chapters.zh: 好像火烧干柴， 又像火将水烧开， 使你敌人知道你的名， 使列国在你面前发颤！

chapters.en: When You did awesome works that we did not expect, You came down, and the mountains trembled at Your presence.
chapters.zh: 你曾行我们不能逆料可畏的事。 那时你降临，山岭在你面前震动。

chapters.en: From ancient times no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides You, who acts on behalf of those who wait for Him.
chapters.zh: 从古以来，人未曾听见、未曾耳闻、未曾眼见 在你以外有什么神为等候他的人行事。

chapters.en: You welcome those who gladly do right, who remember Your ways. Surely You were angry, for we sinned. How can we be saved if we remain in our sins?
chapters.zh: 你迎接那欢喜行义、记念你道的人； 你曾发怒，我们〔仍〕犯罪； 这景况已久，我们还能得救吗？

chapters.en: Each of us has become like something unclean, and all our righteous acts are like filthy rags; we all wither like a leaf, and our iniquities carry us away like the wind.
chapters.zh: 我们都像不洁净的人； 所有的义都像污秽的衣服。 我们都像叶子渐渐枯干； 我们的罪孽好像风把我们吹去。

chapters.en: No one calls on Your name or strives to take hold of You. For You have hidden Your face from us and delivered us into the hand of our iniquity.
chapters.zh: 并且无人求告你的名； 无人奋力抓住你。 原来你掩面不顾我们， 使我们因罪孽消化。

chapters.en:
But now, O LORD, You are our Father; we are the clay, and You are the potter;
we are all the work of Your hand.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，现在你仍是我们的父！ 我们是泥，你是窑匠； 我们都是你手的工作。

chapters.en: Do not be angry, O LORD, beyond measure; do not remember our iniquity forever. Oh, look upon us, we pray; we are all Your people!
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要大发震怒， 也不要永远记念罪孽。 求你垂顾我们， 我们都是你的百姓。

chapters.en: Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wasteland and Jerusalem a desolation.
chapters.zh: 你的圣邑变为旷野。 锡安变为旷野； 耶路撒冷成为荒场。

chapters.en: Our holy and beautiful temple, where our fathers praised You, has been burned with fire, and all that was dear to us lies in ruins.
chapters.zh: 我们圣洁华美的殿－ 就是我们列祖赞美你的所在被火焚烧； 我们所羨慕的美地尽都荒废。

chapters.en: After all this, O LORD, will You restrain Yourself? Will You keep silent and afflict us beyond measure?
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，有这些事，你还忍得住吗？ 你仍静默使我们深受苦难吗？

chapters.en: “I revealed Myself to those who did not ask for Me; I was found by those who did not seek Me. To a nation that did not call My name, I said, ‘Here I am! Here I am!’
chapters.zh: 素来没有访问〔我的〕，现在求问我； 没有寻找我的，我叫他们遇见； 没有称为我名下的，我对他们说： 我在这里！我在这里！

chapters.en: All day long I have held out My hands to an obstinate people who walk in the wrong path, who follow their own imaginations,
chapters.zh: 我整天伸手招呼那悖逆的百姓； 他们随自己的意念行不善之道。

chapters.en:
to a people who continually provoke Me to My face, sacrificing in the gardens
and burning incense on altars of brick,
chapters.zh: 这百姓时常当面惹我发怒； 在园中献祭， 在坛〔注：原文是砖〕上烧香；

chapters.en: sitting among the graves, spending nights in secret places, eating the meat of pigs and polluted broth from their bowls.
chapters.zh: 在坟墓间坐着， 在隐密处住宿， 吃猪肉； 他们器皿中有可憎之物做的汤；

chapters.en: They say, ‘Keep to yourself; do not come near me, for I am holier than you!’ Such people are smoke in My nostrils, a fire that burns all day long.
chapters.zh: 且对人说：你站开吧！ 不要挨近我，因为我比你圣洁。 〔主说〕：这些人是我鼻中的烟， 是整天烧着的火。

chapters.en:
Behold, it is written before Me: I will not keep silent, but I will repay;
I will pay it back into their laps,

both for your iniquities and for those of your fathers,” says the LORD. “Because they burned incense on the mountains and scorned Me on the hills, I will measure into their laps full payment for their former deeds.”
chapters.zh: 看哪，这都写在我面前。 我必不静默，必施行报应， 必将你们的罪孽和你们列祖的罪孽， 就是在山上烧香， 在冈上亵渎我的罪孽， 一同报应在他们后人怀中， 我先要把他们所行的量给他们； 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“As the new wine is found in a cluster of grapes, and men say, ‘Do not destroy it, for it contains a blessing,’ so I will act on behalf of My servants; I will not destroy them all.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：葡萄中寻得新酒， 人就说：不要毁坏， 因为福在其中。 我因我仆人的缘故也必照样而行， 不将他们全然毁灭。

chapters.en: And I will bring forth descendants from Jacob, and heirs from Judah; My elect will possess My mountains, and My servants will dwell there.
chapters.zh: 我必从雅各中领出后裔， 从犹大中领出承受我众山的。 我的选民必承受； 我的仆人要在那里居住。

chapters.en:
Sharon will become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a resting place for herds,
for My people who seek Me.
chapters.zh: 沙崙〔平原〕必成为羊群的圈； 亚割谷必成为牛群躺卧之处， 都为寻求我的民所得。

chapters.en: But you who forsake the LORD, who forget My holy mountain, who set a table for Fortune and fill bowls of mixed wine for Destiny,
chapters.zh: 但你们这些离弃耶和华、 忘记我的圣山、给时运摆筵席〔注：原文是桌子〕、 给天命盛满调和酒的，

chapters.en: I will destine you for the sword, and you will all kneel down to be slaughtered, because I called and you did not answer, I spoke and you did not listen; you did evil in My sight and chose that in which I did not delight.”
chapters.zh: 我要命定你们归在刀下， 都必屈身被杀； 因为我呼唤，你们没有答应； 我说话，你们没有听从； 反倒行我眼中看为恶的， 拣选我所不喜悦的。

chapters.en:
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says:
“My servants will eat, but you will go hungry; My servants will drink, but you will go thirsty; My servants will rejoice, but you will be put to shame.
chapters.zh: 所以，主耶和华如此说： 我的仆人必得吃，你们却饥饿； 我的仆人必得喝，你们却干渴； 我的仆人必欢喜，你们却蒙羞。

chapters.en:
My servants will shout for joy with a glad heart, but you will cry out with a heavy heart
and wail with a broken spirit.
chapters.zh: 我的仆人因心中高兴欢呼， 你们却因心中忧愁哀哭， 又因心里忧伤哀号。

chapters.en: You will leave behind your name as a curse for My chosen ones, and the Lord GOD will slay you; but to His servants He will give another name.
chapters.zh: 你们必留下自己的名， 为我选民指着赌咒。 主耶和华必杀你们， 另起别名称呼他的仆人。

chapters.en: Whoever invokes a blessing in the land will do so by the God of truth, and whoever takes an oath in the land will swear by the God of truth. For the former troubles will be forgotten and hidden from My sight.
chapters.zh: 这样，在地上为自己求福的， 必凭真实的上帝求福； 在地上起誓的， 必指真实的上帝起誓。 因为，从前的患难已经忘记， 也从我眼前隐藏了。

chapters.en: For behold, I will create new heavens and a new earth. The former things will not be remembered, nor will they come to mind.
chapters.zh: 看哪！我造新天新地； 从前的事不再被记念，也不再追想。

chapters.en: But be glad and rejoice forever in what I create; for I will create Jerusalem to be a joy and its people to be a delight.
chapters.zh: 你们当因我所造的永远欢喜快乐； 因我造耶路撒冷为人所喜， 造其中的居民为人所乐。

chapters.en: I will rejoice in Jerusalem and take delight in My people. The sounds of weeping and crying will no longer be heard in her.
chapters.zh: 我必因耶路撒冷欢喜， 因我的百姓快乐； 其中必不再听见哭泣的声音和哀号的声音。

chapters.en:
No longer will a nursing infant live but a few days, or an old man fail to live out his years. For the youth will die at a hundred years, and he who fails to reach a hundred
will be considered accursed.
chapters.zh: 其中必没有数日〔夭亡〕的婴孩， 也没有寿数不满的老者； 因为百岁死的仍算孩童， 有百岁〔死〕的罪人算被咒诅。

chapters.en: They will build houses and dwell in them; they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
chapters.zh: 他们要建造房屋，自己居住； 栽种葡萄园，吃其中的果子。

chapters.en: No longer will they build houses for others to inhabit, nor plant for others to eat. For as is the lifetime of a tree, so will be the days of My people, and My chosen ones will fully enjoy the work of their hands.
chapters.zh: 他们建造的，别人不得住； 他们栽种的，别人不得吃； 因为我民的日子必像树木的日子； 我选民亲手劳碌得来的必长久享用。

chapters.en: They will not labor in vain or bear children doomed to disaster; for they will be a people blessed by the LORD— they and their descendants with them.
chapters.zh: 他们必不徒然劳碌， 所生产的，也不遭灾害， 因为都是蒙耶和华赐福的后裔； 他们的子孙也是如此。

chapters.en: Even before they call, I will answer, and while they are still speaking, I will hear.
chapters.zh: 他们尚未求告，我就应允； 正说话的时候，我就垂听。

chapters.en:
The wolf and the lamb will feed together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox, but the food of the serpent will be dust. They will neither harm nor destroy
on all My holy mountain,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 豺狼必与羊羔同食； 狮子必吃草与牛一样； 尘土必作蛇的食物。 在我圣山的遍处， 这一切都不伤人，不害物。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“Heaven is My throne, and earth is My footstool. What kind of house will you build for Me? Or where will My place of repose be?
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 天是我的座位； 地是我的脚凳。 你们要为我造何等的殿宇？ 哪里是我安息的地方呢？

chapters.en:
Has not My hand made all these things? And so they came into being,” declares the LORD. “This is the one I will esteem: he who is humble and contrite in spirit,
who trembles at My word.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：这一切都是我手所造的， 所以就都有了。 但我所看顾的， 就是虚心〔注：原文是贫穷〕痛悔、 因我话而战兢的人。

chapters.en: Whoever slaughters an ox is like one who slays a man; whoever sacrifices a lamb is like one who breaks a dog’s neck; whoever presents a grain offering is like one who offers pig’s blood; whoever offers frankincense is like one who blesses an idol. Indeed, they have chosen their own ways and delighted in their abominations.
chapters.zh: 〔假冒为善的〕宰牛，好像杀人， 献羊羔，好像打折狗项， 献供物，好像献猪血， 烧乳香，好像称颂偶像。 这等人拣选自己的道路， 心里喜悦行可憎恶的事。

chapters.en: So I will choose their punishment and I will bring terror upon them, because I called and no one answered, I spoke and no one listened. But they did evil in My sight and chose that in which I did not delight.”
chapters.zh: 我也必拣选迷惑他们的事， 使他们所惧怕的临到他们； 因为我呼唤，无人答应； 我说话，他们不听从； 反倒行我眼中看为恶的， 拣选我所不喜悦的。

chapters.en:
You who tremble at His word, hear the word of the LORD:
“Your brothers who hate you and exclude you because of My name have said, ‘Let the LORD be glorified that we may see your joy!’
But they will be put to shame.”
chapters.zh: 你们因耶和华言语战兢的人当听他的话： 你们的弟兄－就是恨恶你们， 因我名赶出你们的，曾说： 愿耶和华得荣耀， 使我们得见你们的喜乐； 但蒙羞的究竟是他们！

chapters.en: Hear the uproar from the city; listen to the voice from the temple! It is the voice of the LORD, repaying His enemies what they deserve!
chapters.zh: 有喧哗的声音出自城中！ 有声音出于殿中！ 是耶和华向仇敌施行报应的声音！

chapters.en: “Before she was in labor, she gave birth; before she was in pain, she delivered a boy.
chapters.zh: 锡安未曾劬劳就生产， 未觉疼痛就生出男孩。

chapters.en: Who has heard of such as this? Who has seen such things? Can a country be born in a day or a nation be delivered in an instant? Yet as soon as Zion was in labor, she gave birth to her children.
chapters.zh: 国岂能一日而生？ 民岂能一时而产？ 因为锡安一劬劳便生下儿女， 这样的事谁曾听见？ 谁曾看见呢？

chapters.en: Shall I bring a baby to the point of birth and not deliver it?” says the LORD. “Or will I who deliver close the womb?” says your God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：我既使她临产， 岂不使她生产呢？ 你的上帝说：我既使她生产， 岂能使她闭〔胎〕不生呢？

chapters.en: Be glad for Jerusalem and rejoice over her, all who love her. Rejoice greatly with her, all who mourn over her,
chapters.zh: 你们爱慕耶路撒冷的 都要与她一同欢喜快乐； 你们为她悲哀的 都要与她一同乐上加乐；

chapters.en: so that you may nurse and be satisfied at her comforting breasts; you may drink deeply and delight yourselves in her glorious abundance.
chapters.zh: 使你们在她安慰的怀中吃奶得饱， 使他们得她丰盛的荣耀， 犹如挤奶，满心喜乐。

chapters.en:
For this is what the LORD says:
“I will extend peace to her like a river, and the wealth of nations like a flowing stream; you will nurse and be carried on her arm, and bounced upon her knees.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 我要使平安延及她，好像江河， 使列国的荣耀延及她，如同涨溢的河。 你们要〔从中〕享受〔注：原文是咂〕； 你们必蒙抱在肋旁，摇弄在膝上。

chapters.en:
As a mother comforts her son, so will I comfort you,
and you will be consoled over Jerusalem.”
chapters.zh: 母亲怎样安慰儿子，我就照样安慰你们； 你们也必因〔注：或译：在〕耶路撒冷得安慰。

chapters.en: When you see, you will rejoice, and you will flourish like grass; then the hand of the LORD will be revealed to His servants, but His wrath will be shown to His enemies.
chapters.zh: 你们看见，就心中快乐； 你们的骨头必得滋润像嫩草一样； 而且耶和华的手向他仆人所行的必被人知道； 他也要向仇敌发恼恨。

chapters.en: For behold, the LORD will come with fire— His chariots are like a whirlwind— to execute His anger with fury and His rebuke with flames of fire.
chapters.zh: 看哪，耶和华必在火中降临； 他的车辇像旋风， 以烈怒施行报应， 以火焰施行责罚；

chapters.en:
For by fire and by His sword, the LORD will execute judgment on all flesh,
and many will be slain by the LORD.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华在一切有血气的人身上， 必以火与刀施行审判； 被耶和华所杀的必多。

chapters.en: “Those who consecrate and purify themselves to enter the groves—to follow one in the center of those who eat the flesh of swine and vermin and rats—will perish together,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 「那些分别为圣、洁净自己的，进入园内跟在其中一个人的后头，吃猪肉和仓鼠并可憎之物，他们必一同灭绝；这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “And I, knowing their deeds and thoughts, am coming to gather all nations and tongues, and they will come and see My glory.
chapters.zh: 「〔我知道〕他们的行为和他们的意念。〔时候〕将到，我必将万民万族〔注：族：原文是舌〕聚来，看见我的荣耀，

chapters.en:
I will establish a sign among them, and I will send survivors from among them to the nations—to Tarshish, Put, and the archers of Lud; to Tubal, Javan, and the islands far away who have not heard of My fame or seen My glory.
So they will proclaim My glory among the nations.
chapters.zh: 我要显神迹〔注：或译：记号〕在他们中间。逃脱的，我要差到列国去，就是到他施、普勒、拉弓的路德和土巴、雅完，并素来没有听见我名声、没有看见我荣耀辽远的海岛；他们必将我的荣耀传扬在列国中。

chapters.en: And they will bring all your brothers from all the nations as a gift to the LORD on horses and chariots and wagons, on mules and camels, to My holy mountain Jerusalem,” says the LORD, “just as the Israelites bring an offering in a clean vessel to the house of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 他们必将你们的弟兄从列国中送回，使他们或骑马，或坐车，坐轿，骑骡子，骑独峰驼，到我的圣山耶路撒冷，作为供物献给耶和华，好像以色列人用洁净的器皿盛供物奉到耶和华的殿中；这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “And I will select some of them as priests and Levites,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：我也必从他们中间取人为祭司，为利未人。」

chapters.en: “For just as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, will endure before Me,” declares the LORD, “so your descendants and your name will endure.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：我所要造的新天新地， 怎样在我面前长存； 你们的后裔和你们的名字也必照样长存。

chapters.en: From one New Moon to another and from one Sabbath to another, all mankind will come to worship before Me,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 每逢月朔、安息日， 凡有血气的必来在我面前下拜。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “As they go forth, they will see the corpses of the men who have rebelled against Me; for their worm will never die, their fire will never be quenched, and they will be a horror to all mankind.”
chapters.zh: 他们必出去观看那些违背我人的尸首； 因为他们的虫是不死的； 他们的火是不灭的； 凡有血气的都必憎恶他们。

chapters.en: These are the words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, one of the priests in Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯地亚拿突城的祭司中，希勒家的儿子耶利米的话记在下面。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to Jeremiah in the thirteenth year of the reign of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah,
chapters.zh: 犹大王亚们的儿子约西亚在位十三年，耶和华的话临到耶利米。

chapters.en: and through the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, until the fifth month of the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah, when the people of Jerusalem went into exile.
chapters.zh: 从犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬在位的时候，直到犹大王约西亚的儿子西底家在位的末年，就是十一年五月间耶路撒冷人被掳的时候，耶和华的话也常临到耶利米。

chapters.en: The word of the LORD came to me, saying:
chapters.zh: 耶利米说，耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en:
“Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, and before you were born I set you apart
and appointed you as a prophet to the nations.”
chapters.zh: 我未将你造在腹中，我已晓得你； 你未出母胎，我已分别你为圣； 我已派你作列国的先知。

chapters.en: “Ah, Lord GOD,” I said, “I surely do not know how to speak, for I am only a child!”
chapters.zh: 我就说：主耶和华啊，我不知怎样说，因为我是年幼的。

chapters.en:
But the LORD told me:
“Do not say, ‘I am only a child.’ For to everyone I send you, you must go, and all that I command you, you must speak.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说： 你不要说我是年幼的， 因为我差遣你到谁那里去，你都要去； 我吩咐你说什么话，你都要说。

chapters.en: Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you to deliver you,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你不要惧怕他们， 因为我与你同在， 要拯救你。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
Then the LORD reached out His hand, touched my mouth, and said to me:
“Behold, I have put My words in your mouth.
chapters.zh: 于是耶和华伸手按我的口，对我说： 我已将当说的话传给你。

chapters.en:
See, I have appointed you today over nations and kingdoms to uproot and tear down, to destroy and overthrow,
to build and plant.”
chapters.zh: 看哪，我今日立你在列邦列国之上， 为要施行拔出、拆毁、毁坏、倾覆， 又要建立、栽植。

chapters.en:
And the word of the LORD came to me, asking, “Jeremiah, what do you see?”
“I see a branch of an almond tree,” I replied.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：「耶利米，你看见什么？」我说：「我看见一根杏树枝。」

chapters.en: “You have observed correctly,” said the LORD, “for I am watching over My word to accomplish it.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说：「你看得不错；因为我留意保守我的话，使得成就。」

chapters.en:
Again the word of the LORD came to me, asking, “What do you see?”
“I see a boiling pot,” I replied, “and it is tilting toward us from the north.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话第二次临到我说：「你看见什么？」我说：「我看见一个烧开的锅，从北而倾。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to me, “Disaster from the north will be poured out on all who live in the land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说：「必有灾祸从北方发出，临到这地的一切居民。」

chapters.en:
For I am about to summon all the clans and kingdoms of the north,” declares the LORD.
“Their kings will come and set up their thrones at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem. They will attack all her surrounding walls and all the other cities of Judah.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「看哪，我要召北方列国的众族；他们要来，各安座位在耶路撒冷的城门口，周围攻击城墙，又要攻击犹大的一切城邑。

chapters.en:
I will pronounce My judgments against them for all their wickedness, because they have forsaken Me, and they have burned incense to other gods
and worshiped the works of their own hands.
chapters.zh: 至于这民的一切恶，就是离弃我、向别神烧香、跪拜自己手所造的，我要发出我的判语，攻击他们。

chapters.en: Get yourself ready. Stand up and tell them everything that I command you. Do not be intimidated by them, or I will terrify you before them.
chapters.zh: 所以你当束腰，起来将我所吩咐你的一切话告诉他们；不要因他们惊惶，免得我使你在他们面前惊惶。

chapters.en: Now behold, this day I have made you like a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, its officials, its priests, and the people of the land.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我今日使你成为坚城、铁柱、铜墙，与全地和犹大的君王、首领、祭司，并地上的众民反对。

chapters.en: They will fight against you but will never overcome you, since I am with you to deliver you,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们要攻击你，却不能胜你；因为我与你同在，要拯救你。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en:
“Go and proclaim in the hearing of Jerusalem that this is what the LORD says:
‘I remember the devotion of your youth, your love as a bride, how you followed Me in the wilderness, in a land not sown.
chapters.zh: 「你去向耶路撒冷人的耳中喊叫说，耶和华如此说： 你幼年的恩爱， 婚姻的爱情， 你怎样在旷野， 在未曾耕种之地跟随我， 我都记得。

chapters.en: Israel was holy to the LORD, the firstfruits of His harvest. All who devoured her were found guilty; disaster came upon them,’” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 那时以色列归耶和华为圣， 作为土产初熟的果子； 凡吞吃它的必算为有罪， 灾祸必临到他们。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Hear the word of the LORD, O house of Jacob, and all you families of the house of Israel.
chapters.zh: 雅各家、以色列家的各族啊，你们当听耶和华的话。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“What fault did your fathers find in Me that they strayed so far from Me? They followed worthless idols, and became worthless themselves.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 你们的列祖见我有什么不义， 竟远离我，随从虚无的神， 自己成为虚妄的呢？

chapters.en: They did not ask, ‘Where is the LORD who brought us up from the land of Egypt, who led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and pits, a land of drought and darkness, a land where no one travels and no one lives?’
chapters.zh: 他们也不说： 那领我们从埃及地上来， 引导我们经过旷野， 沙漠有深坑之地， 和干旱死荫、无人经过、 无人居住之地的耶和华在哪里呢？

chapters.en: I brought you into a fertile land to eat its fruit and bounty, but you came and defiled My land and made My inheritance detestable.
chapters.zh: 我领你们进入肥美之地， 使你们得吃其中的果子和美物； 但你们进入的时候就玷污我的地， 使我的产业成为可憎的。

chapters.en: The priests did not ask, ‘Where is the LORD?’ The experts in the law no longer knew Me, and the leaders rebelled against Me. The prophets prophesied by Baal and followed useless idols.
chapters.zh: 祭司都不说，耶和华在哪里呢？ 传讲律法的都不认识我。 官长违背我； 先知藉巴力说预言， 随从无益的〔神〕。

chapters.en: Therefore, I will contend with you again, declares the LORD, and I will bring a case against your children’s children.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：我因此必与你们争辩， 也必与你们的子孙争辩。

chapters.en: Cross over to the coasts of Cyprus and take a look; send to Kedar and consider carefully; see if there has ever been anything like this:
chapters.zh: 你们且过到基提海岛去察看， 打发人往基达去留心查考， 看曾有这样的事没有。

chapters.en: Has a nation ever changed its gods? (Yet they are not gods at all.) But My people have exchanged their Glory for useless idols.
chapters.zh: 岂有一国换了〔他的〕神吗？ 其实这不是神！ 但我的百姓将他们的荣耀换了那无益的〔神〕。

chapters.en: Be stunned by this, O heavens; be shocked and utterly appalled,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 诸天哪，要因此惊奇， 极其恐慌，甚为凄凉！ 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
“For My people have committed two evils:
They have forsaken Me, the fountain of living water, and they have dug their own cisterns— broken cisterns that cannot hold water.
chapters.zh: 因为我的百姓做了两件恶事， 就是离弃我这活水的泉源， 为自己凿出池子， 是破裂不能存水的池子。

chapters.en:
Is Israel a slave? Was he born into slavery?
Why then has he become prey?
chapters.zh: 以色列是仆人吗？ 是家中生的〔奴仆〕吗？ 为何成为掠物呢？

chapters.en: The young lions have roared at him; they have sounded their voices. They have laid waste his land; his cities lie in ruins, without inhabitant.
chapters.zh: 少壮狮子向他咆哮，大声吼叫， 使他的地荒凉； 城邑也都焚烧，无人居住。

chapters.en: The men of Memphis and Tahpanhes have shaved the crown of your head.
chapters.zh: 挪弗人和答比匿人也打破你的头顶。

chapters.en:
Have you not brought this on yourself by forsaking the LORD your God
when He led you in the way?
chapters.zh: 这事临到你身上，不是你自招的吗？ 不是因耶和华－你上帝引你行路的时候， 你离弃他吗？

chapters.en: Now what will you gain on your way to Egypt to drink the waters of the Nile ? What will you gain on your way to Assyria to drink the waters of the Euphrates ?
chapters.zh: 现今你为何在埃及路上要喝西曷的水呢？ 你为何在亚述路上要喝大河的水呢？

chapters.en: Your own evil will discipline you; your own apostasies will reprimand you. Consider and realize how evil and bitter it is for you to forsake the LORD your God and to have no fear of Me,” declares the Lord GOD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 你自己的恶必惩治你； 你背道的事必责备你。 由此可知可见，你离弃耶和华－你的上帝， 不存敬畏我的心， 乃为恶事，为苦事。 这是主－万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
“For long ago you broke your yoke and tore off your chains,
saying, ‘I will not serve!’ Indeed, on every high hill and under every green tree
you lay down as a prostitute.
chapters.zh: 我在古时折断你的轭，解开你的绳索。 你说：我必不事奉〔耶和华〕； 因为你在各高冈上、各青翠树下屈身行淫〔注：或译：我在古时折断你的轭，解开你的绳索，你就说：我必不事奉别神。谁知你在各高冈上、各青翠树下仍屈身行淫〕。

chapters.en: I had planted you like a choice vine from the very best seed. How could you turn yourself before Me into a rotten, wild vine?
chapters.zh: 然而，我栽你是上等的葡萄树， 全然是真种子； 你怎么向我变为外邦葡萄树的坏枝子呢？

chapters.en: Although you wash with lye and use an abundance of soap, the stain of your guilt is still before Me,” declares the Lord GOD.
chapters.zh: 你虽用碱、多用肥皂洗濯， 你罪孽的痕迹仍然在我面前显出。 这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “How can you say, ‘I am not defiled; I have not run after the Baals’? Look at your behavior in the valley; acknowledge what you have done. You are a swift young she-camel galloping here and there,
chapters.zh: 你怎能说： 我没有玷污、没有随从众巴力？ 你看你谷中的路，就知道你所行的如何。 你是快行的独峰驼，狂奔乱走。

chapters.en:
a wild donkey at home in the wilderness, sniffing the wind in the heat of her desire.
Who can restrain her passion? All who seek her need not weary themselves; in mating season they will find her.
chapters.zh: 你是野驴，惯在旷野， 欲心发动就吸风； 起性的时候谁能使牠转去呢？ 凡寻找牠的必不致疲乏； 在牠的月份必能寻见。

chapters.en:
You should have kept your feet from going bare and your throat from being thirsty. But you said, ‘It is hopeless! For I love foreign gods,
and I must go after them.’
chapters.zh: 我〔说〕：你不要使脚上无鞋， 喉咙干渴。 你倒说：这是枉然。 我喜爱别〔神〕，我必随从他们。

chapters.en: As the thief is ashamed when he is caught, so the house of Israel is disgraced. They, their kings, their officials, their priests, and their prophets
chapters.zh: 贼被捉拿，怎样羞愧， 以色列家和他们的君王、首领、 祭司、先知也都照样羞愧。

chapters.en: say to a tree, ‘You are my father,’ and to a stone, ‘You gave me birth.’ They have turned their backs to Me and not their faces. Yet in the time of trouble, they say, ‘Rise up and save us!’
chapters.zh: 他们向木头说：你是我的父； 向石头说：你是生我的。 他们以背向我， 不以面向我； 及至遭遇患难的时候却说： 起来拯救我们。

chapters.en:
But where are the gods you made for yourselves? Let them rise up in your time of trouble
and save you if they can; for your gods are as numerous as your cities, O Judah.
chapters.zh: 你为自己做的神在哪里呢？ 你遭遇患难的时候， 叫他们起来拯救你吧！ 犹大啊，你神的数目与你城的数目相等。

chapters.en: Why do you bring a case against Me? You have all rebelled against Me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说： 你们为何与我争辩呢？ 你们都违背了我。

chapters.en: “I have struck your sons in vain; they accepted no discipline. Your own sword has devoured your prophets like a voracious lion.”
chapters.zh: 我责打你们的儿女是徒然的， 他们不受惩治。 你们自己的刀吞灭你们的先知， 好像残害的狮子。
这世代的人哪， 你们要看明耶和华的话。 我岂向以色列作旷野呢？ 或作幽暗之地呢？ 我的百姓为何说： 我们脱离约束，再不归向你了？

chapters.en: Does a maiden forget her jewelry or a bride her wedding sash? Yet My people have forgotten Me for days without number.
chapters.zh: 处女岂能忘记她的妆饰呢？ 新妇岂能忘记她的美衣呢？ 我的百姓却忘记了我无数的日子！

chapters.en:
How skillfully you pursue love! Even the most immoral of women
could learn from your ways.
chapters.zh: 你怎么修饰你的道路要求爱情呢？ 就是恶劣的妇人你也叫她们行你的路。

chapters.en:
Moreover, your skirts are stained with the blood of the innocent poor,
though you did not find them breaking in.
But in spite of all these things
chapters.zh: 并且你的衣襟上有无辜穷人的血； 〔你杀他们〕并不是遇见他们挖窟窿， 乃是因这一切的事。

chapters.en:
you say, ‘I am innocent.
Surely His anger will turn from me.’ Behold, I will judge you, because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’
chapters.zh: 你还说：我无辜； 耶和华的怒气必定向我消了。 看哪，我必审问你； 因你自说：我没有犯罪。

chapters.en: How impulsive you are, constantly changing your ways! You will be disappointed by Egypt just as you were by Assyria.
chapters.zh: 你为何东跑西奔要更换你的路呢？ 你必因埃及蒙羞， 像从前因亚述蒙羞一样。

chapters.en: Moreover, you will leave that place with your hands on your head, for the LORD has rejected those you trust; you will not prosper by their help.”
chapters.zh: 你也必两手抱头从埃及出来； 因为耶和华已经弃绝你所倚靠的， 你必不因他们得顺利。

chapters.en: “If a man divorces his wife and she leaves him to marry another, can he ever return to her? Would not such a land be completely defiled? But you have played the harlot with many lovers— and you would return to Me?” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 有话说：人若休妻， 妻离他而去，作了别人的妻， 前夫岂能再收回她来？ 〔若收回她来〕，那地岂不是大大玷污了吗？ 但你和许多亲爱的行邪淫， 还可以归向我。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Lift up your eyes to the barren heights and see. Is there any place where you have not been violated? You sat beside the highways waiting for your lovers, like a nomad in the desert. You have defiled the land with your prostitution and wickedness.
chapters.zh: 你向净光的高处举目观看， 你在何处没有淫行呢？ 你坐在道旁等候， 好像阿拉伯人在旷野〔埋伏〕一样， 并且你的淫行邪恶玷污了全地。

chapters.en: Therefore the showers have been withheld, and no spring rains have fallen. Yet you have the brazen look of a prostitute; you refuse to be ashamed.
chapters.zh: 因此甘霖停止， 春〔注：原文是晚〕雨不降。 你还是有娼妓之脸， 不顾羞耻。

chapters.en: Have you not just called to Me, ‘My Father, You are my friend from youth.
chapters.zh: 从今以后，你岂不向我呼叫〔说〕： 我父啊，你是我幼年的恩主。

chapters.en: Will He be angry forever? Will He be indignant to the end?’ This you have spoken, but you keep doing all the evil you can.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华岂永远怀〔怒〕，存留到底吗？ 看哪，你又发恶言又行坏事， 随自己的私意而行〔注：或译：你虽这样说，还是行恶放纵欲心〕。」

chapters.en: Now in the days of King Josiah, the LORD said to me, “Have you seen what faithless Israel has done? She has gone up on every high hill and under every green tree to prostitute herself there.
chapters.zh: 约西亚王在位的时候，耶和华又对我说：「背道的以色列所行的，你看见没有？她上各高山，在各青翠树下行淫。

chapters.en: I thought that after she had done all these things, she would return to Me. But she did not return, and her unfaithful sister Judah saw it.
chapters.zh: 她行这些事以后，我说她必归向我，她却不归向我。她奸诈的妹妹犹大也看见了。

chapters.en: She saw that because faithless Israel had committed adultery, I gave her a certificate of divorce and sent her away. Yet that unfaithful sister Judah had no fear and prostituted herself as well.
chapters.zh: 背道的以色列行淫，我为这缘故给她休书休她；我看见她奸诈的妹妹犹大，还不惧怕，也去行淫。

chapters.en: Indifferent to her own infidelity, Israel had defiled the land and committed adultery with stones and trees.
chapters.zh: 因以色列轻忽了她的淫乱，和石头木头行淫，地就被玷污了。

chapters.en: Yet in spite of all this, her unfaithful sister Judah did not return to Me with all her heart, but only in pretense,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 虽有这一切的事，她奸诈的妹妹犹大还不一心归向我，不过是假意归我。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: And the LORD said to me, “Faithless Israel has shown herself more righteous than unfaithful Judah.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说：「背道的以色列比奸诈的犹大还显为义。

chapters.en:
Go, proclaim this message toward the north:
‘Return, O faithless Israel,’ declares the LORD. ‘I will no longer look on you with anger, for I am merciful,’ declares the LORD. ‘I will not be angry forever.
chapters.zh: 你去向北方宣告说： 耶和华说：背道的以色列啊，回来吧！ 我必不怒目看你们； 因为我是慈爱的， 我必不永远存〔怒〕。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
Only acknowledge your guilt, that you have rebelled against the LORD your God. You have scattered your favors to foreign gods under every green tree
and have not obeyed My voice,’” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 只要承认你的罪孽， 就是你违背耶和华－你的上帝， 在各青翠树下向别〔神〕东奔西跑， 没有听从我的话。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Return, O faithless children,” declares the LORD, “for I am your master, and I will take you—one from a city and two from a family—and bring you to Zion.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：背道的儿女啊，回来吧！ 因为我作你们的丈夫， 并且我必将你们从一城取一人， 从一族取两人，带到锡安。

chapters.en: Then I will give you shepherds after My own heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.”
chapters.zh: 我也必将合我心的牧者赐给你们。他们必以知识和智慧牧养你们。」

chapters.en: “In those days, when you multiply and increase in the land,” declares the LORD, “they will no longer discuss the ark of the covenant of the LORD. It will never come to mind, and no one will remember it or miss it, nor will another one be made.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「你们在国中生养众多；当那些日子，人必不再提说耶和华的约柜，不追想，不记念，不觉缺少，也不再制造。

chapters.en: At that time they will call Jerusalem The Throne of the LORD, and all the nations will be gathered in Jerusalem to honor the name of the LORD. They will no longer follow the stubbornness of their evil hearts.
chapters.zh: 那时，人必称耶路撒冷为耶和华的宝座；万国必到耶路撒冷，在耶和华〔立〕名〔的地方〕聚集。他们必不再随从自己顽梗的恶心行事。

chapters.en: In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel, and they will come together from the land of the north to the land that I gave to your fathers as an inheritance.
chapters.zh: 当那些日子，犹大家要和以色列家同行，从北方之地一同来到我赐给你们列祖为业之地。」

chapters.en: Then I said, ‘How I long to make you My sons and give you a desirable land, the most beautiful inheritance of all the nations!’ I thought you would call Me ‘Father’ and never turn away from following Me.
chapters.zh: 我说：我怎样将你安置在儿女之中， 赐给你美地， 就是万国中肥美的产业。 我又说：你们必称我为父， 也不再转去不跟从我。

chapters.en: But as a woman may betray her husband, so you have betrayed Me, O house of Israel,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以色列家，你们向我行诡诈， 真像妻子行诡诈离开她丈夫一样。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: A voice is heard on the barren heights, the children of Israel weeping and begging for mercy, because they have perverted their ways and forgotten the LORD their God.
chapters.zh: 在净光的高处听见人声， 就是以色列人哭泣恳求之声， 乃因他们走弯曲之道， 忘记耶和华－他们的上帝。

chapters.en:
“Return, O faithless children, and I will heal your faithlessness.”
“Here we are. We come to You, for You are the LORD our God.
chapters.zh: 你们这背道的儿女啊，回来吧！ 我要医治你们背道的病。 看哪，我们来到你这里， 因你是耶和华－我们的上帝。

chapters.en: Surely deception comes from the hills, and commotion from the mountains. Surely the salvation of Israel is in the LORD our God.
chapters.zh: 〔仰望〕从小山或从大山的喧嚷中〔得帮助〕， 真是枉然的。 以色列得救，诚然在乎耶和华－我们的上帝。

chapters.en: From our youth, that shameful god has consumed what our fathers have worked for— their flocks and herds, their sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 从我们幼年以来，那可耻的〔偶像〕将我们列祖所劳碌得来的羊群、牛群，和他们的儿女都吞吃了。

chapters.en: Let us lie down in our shame; let our disgrace cover us. We have sinned against the LORD our God, both we and our fathers; from our youth even to this day we have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God.”
chapters.zh: 我们在羞耻中躺卧吧！愿惭愧将我们遮盖；因为从立国〔注：原文是幼年〕以来，我们和我们的列祖常常得罪耶和华－我们的上帝，没有听从耶和华－我们上帝的话。

chapters.en: “If you will return, O Israel, return to Me,” declares the LORD. “If you will remove your detestable idols from My sight and no longer waver,
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：以色列啊， 你若回来归向我， 若从我眼前除掉你可憎的〔偶像〕， 你就不被迁移。

chapters.en: and if you can swear, ‘As surely as the LORD lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness, then the nations will be blessed by Him, and in Him they will glory.”
chapters.zh: 你必凭诚实、公平、公义， 指着永生的耶和华起誓； 列国必因耶和华称自己为有福， 也必因他夸耀。

chapters.en:
For this is what the LORD says to the men of Judah and Jerusalem:
“Break up your unplowed ground, and do not sow among the thorns.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对犹大和耶路撒冷人如此说： 要开垦你们的荒地， 不要撒种在荆棘中。

chapters.en:
Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and remove the foreskins of your hearts,
O men of Judah and people of Jerusalem. Otherwise, My wrath will break out like fire and burn with no one to extinguish it,
because of your evil deeds.”
chapters.zh: 犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民哪， 你们当自行割礼，归耶和华， 将心里的污秽除掉； 恐怕我的忿怒因你们的恶行发作， 如火着起， 甚至无人能以熄灭！

chapters.en:
Announce in Judah, proclaim in Jerusalem, and say:
“Blow the ram’s horn throughout the land. Cry aloud and say, ‘Assemble yourselves and let us flee to the fortified cities.’
chapters.zh: 你们当传扬在犹大， 宣告在耶路撒冷说： 你们当在国中吹角，高声呼叫说： 你们当聚集！ 我们好进入坚固城！

chapters.en: Raise a signal flag toward Zion. Seek refuge! Do not delay! For I am bringing disaster from the north, and terrible destruction.
chapters.zh: 应当向锡安竖立大旗。 要逃避，不要迟延， 因我必使灾祸与大毁灭从北方来到。

chapters.en: A lion has gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations has set out. He has left his lair to lay waste your land. Your cities will be reduced to ruins and lie uninhabited.
chapters.zh: 有狮子从密林中上来， 是毁坏列国的。 牠已经动身出离本处， 要使你的地荒凉， 使你的城邑变为荒场无人居住。

chapters.en: So put on sackcloth, mourn and wail, for the fierce anger of the LORD has not turned away from us.”
chapters.zh: 因此，你们当腰束麻布，大声哀号， 因为耶和华的烈怒没有向我们转消。

chapters.en: “In that day,” declares the LORD, “the king and officials will lose their courage. The priests will tremble in fear, and the prophets will be astounded.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「到那时，君王和首领的心都要消灭；祭司都要惊奇，先知都要诧异。」

chapters.en: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD, how completely You have deceived this people and Jerusalem by saying, ‘You will have peace,’ while a sword is at our throats.”
chapters.zh: 我说：「哀哉！主耶和华啊，你真是大大地欺哄这百姓和耶路撒冷，说：『你们必得平安。』其实刀剑害及性命了。」

chapters.en: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, “A searing wind from the barren heights in the desert blows toward the daughter of My people, but not to winnow or to sift;
chapters.zh: 那时，必有话对这百姓和耶路撒冷说：「有一阵热风从旷野净光的高处向我的众民〔注：原文是民女〕刮来，不是为簸扬，也不是为扬净。

chapters.en: a wind too strong for that comes from Me. Now I also pronounce judgments against them.”
chapters.zh: 必有一阵更大的风从这些地方为我刮来；现在我又必发出判语，攻击他们。」

chapters.en: Behold, he advances like the clouds, his chariots like the whirlwind. His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us, for we are ruined!
chapters.zh: 看哪，仇敌必如云上来； 他的战车如旋风， 他的马匹比鹰更快。 我们有祸了！ 我们败落了！

chapters.en: Wash the evil from your heart, O Jerusalem, so that you may be saved. How long will you harbor wicked thoughts within you?
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，你当洗去心中的恶， 使你可以得救。 恶念存在你心里要到几时呢？

chapters.en: For a voice resounds from Dan, proclaiming disaster from the hills of Ephraim.
chapters.zh: 有声音从但传扬， 从以法莲山报祸患。

chapters.en: Warn the nations now! Proclaim to Jerusalem: “A besieging army comes from a distant land; they raise their voices against the cities of Judah.
chapters.zh: 你们当传给列国， 报告攻击耶路撒冷的事说： 有探望的人从远方来到， 向犹大的城邑大声吶喊。

chapters.en: They surround her like men guarding a field, because she has rebelled against Me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们周围攻击耶路撒冷， 好像看守田园的， 因为她背叛了我。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Your ways and deeds have brought this upon you. This is your punishment; how bitter it is, because it pierces to the heart!”
chapters.zh: 你的行动，你的作为，招惹这事； 这是你罪恶的结果， 实在是苦， 是害及你心了！

chapters.en: My anguish, my anguish! I writhe in pain! Oh, the pain in my chest! My heart pounds within me; I cannot be silent. For I have heard the sound of the horn, the alarm of battle.
chapters.zh: 我的肺腑啊，我的肺腑啊，我心疼痛！ 我心在我里面烦躁不安。 我不能静默不言， 因为我已经听见角声和打仗的喊声。

chapters.en: Disaster after disaster is proclaimed, for the whole land is laid waste. My tents are destroyed in an instant, my curtains in a moment.
chapters.zh: 毁坏的信息连络不绝， 因为全地荒废。 我的帐棚忽然毁坏； 我的幔子顷刻破裂。

chapters.en: How long must I see the signal flag and hear the sound of the horn?
chapters.zh: 我看见大旗，听见角声， 要到几时呢？

chapters.en: “For My people are fools; they have not known Me. They are foolish children, without understanding. They are skilled in doing evil, but they know not how to do good.”
chapters.zh: 〔耶和华说〕：我的百姓愚顽，不认识我； 他们是愚昧无知的儿女， 有智慧行恶，没有知识行善。

chapters.en: I looked at the earth, and it was formless and void; I looked to the heavens, and they had no light.
chapters.zh: 〔先知说〕：我观看地， 不料，地是空虚混沌； 我观看天，天也无光。

chapters.en:
I looked at the mountains, and behold, they were quaking;
all the hills were swaying.
chapters.zh: 我观看大山，不料，尽都震动， 小山也都摇来摇去。

chapters.en: I looked, and no man was left; all the birds of the air had fled.
chapters.zh: 我观看，不料，无人； 空中的飞鸟也都躲避。

chapters.en: I looked, and the fruitful land was a desert. All its cities were torn down before the LORD, before His fierce anger.
chapters.zh: 我观看，不料，肥田变为荒地； 一切城邑在耶和华面前， 因他的烈怒都被拆毁。

chapters.en:
For this is what the LORD says:
“The whole land will be desolate, but I will not finish its destruction.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：全地必然荒凉， 我却不毁灭净尽。

chapters.en: Therefore the earth will mourn and the heavens above will grow dark. I have spoken, I have planned, and I will not relent or turn back.”
chapters.zh: 因此，地要悲哀， 在上的天也必黑暗； 因为我言已出，我意已定， 必不后悔，也不转意不做。

chapters.en: Every city flees at the sound of the horseman and archer. They enter the thickets and climb among the rocks. Every city is abandoned; no inhabitant is left.
chapters.zh: 各城的人因马兵和弓箭手的响声就都逃跑， 进入密林，爬上磐石； 各城被撇下， 无人住在其中。

chapters.en: And you, O devastated one, what will you do, though you dress yourself in scarlet, though you adorn yourself with gold jewelry, though you enlarge your eyes with paint? You adorn yourself in vain; your lovers despise you; they want to take your life.
chapters.zh: 你凄凉的时候要怎样行呢？ 你虽穿上朱红〔衣服〕， 佩戴黄金装饰， 用颜料修饰眼目， 这样标致是枉然的！ 恋爱〔你的〕藐视你， 并且寻索你的性命。

chapters.en: For I hear a cry like a woman in labor, a cry of anguish like one bearing her first child— the cry of the Daughter of Zion gasping for breath, stretching out her hands to say, “Woe is me, for my soul faints before the murderers!”
chapters.zh: 我听见有声音，仿佛妇人产难的声音， 好像生头胎疼痛〔的声音〕， 是锡安女子〔注：就是指民的意思〕的声音； 她喘着气、挓挲手， 〔说〕：我有祸了！ 在杀人的跟前，我的心发昏了。

chapters.en: “Go up and down the streets of Jerusalem. Look now and take note; search her squares. If you can find a single person, anyone who acts justly, anyone who seeks the truth, then I will forgive the city.
chapters.zh: 你们当在耶路撒冷的街上跑来跑去， 在宽阔处寻找， 看看有一人行公义求诚实没有？ 〔若有〕，我就赦免这城。

chapters.en: Although they say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives,’ they are swearing falsely.”
chapters.zh: 其中的人虽然指着永生的耶和华起誓， 所起的誓实在是假的。

chapters.en: O LORD, do not Your eyes look for truth? You struck them, but they felt no pain. You finished them off, but they refused to accept discipline. They have made their faces harder than stone and refused to repent.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你的眼目不是看顾诚实吗？ 你击打他们，他们却不伤恸； 你毁灭他们，他们仍不受惩治。 他们使脸刚硬过于磐石， 不肯回头。

chapters.en: Then I said, “They are only the poor; they have played the fool, for they do not know the way of the LORD, the justice of their God.
chapters.zh: 我说：这些人实在是贫穷的，是愚昧的， 因为不晓得耶和华的作为 和他们上帝的法则。

chapters.en:
I will go to the powerful and speak to them. Surely they know the way of the LORD, the justice of their God.”
But they too, with one accord, had broken the yoke and torn off the chains.
chapters.zh: 我要去见尊大的人，对他们说话， 因为他们晓得耶和华的作为 和他们上帝的法则。 哪知，这些人齐心将轭折断， 挣开绳索。

chapters.en: Therefore a lion from the forest will strike them down, a wolf from the desert will ravage them. A leopard will lie in wait near their cities, and everyone who ventures out will be torn to pieces. For their rebellious acts are many, and their unfaithful deeds are numerous.
chapters.zh: 因此，林中的狮子必害死他们； 晚上〔注：或译：野地〕的豺狼必灭绝他们； 豹子要在城外窥伺他们。 凡出城的必被撕碎； 因为他们的罪过极多， 背道的事也加增了。

chapters.en:
“Why should I forgive you? Your children have forsaken Me
and sworn by gods that are not gods. I satisfied their needs, yet they committed adultery and assembled at the houses of prostitutes.
chapters.zh: 我怎能赦免你呢？ 你的儿女离弃我， 又指着那不是神的起誓。 我使他们饱足， 他们就行奸淫， 成群地聚集在娼妓家里。

chapters.en: They are well-fed, lusty stallions, each neighing after his neighbor’s wife.
chapters.zh: 他们像餵饱的马到处乱跑， 各向他邻舍的妻发嘶声。

chapters.en: Should I not punish them for these things?” declares the LORD. “Should I not avenge Myself on such a nation as this?
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：我岂不因这些事讨罪呢？ 岂不报复这样的国民呢？

chapters.en: Go up through her vineyards and ravage them, but do not finish them off. Strip off her branches, for they do not belong to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你们要上她〔葡萄园〕的墙施行毁坏， 但不可毁坏净尽， 只可除掉她的枝子， 因为不属耶和华。

chapters.en: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have been utterly unfaithful to Me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 原来以色列家和犹大家大行诡诈攻击我。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
They have lied about the LORD and said:
“He will not do anything; harm will not come to us; we will not see sword or famine.
chapters.zh: 他们不认耶和华，说： 这并不是他， 灾祸必不临到我们； 刀剑和饥荒，我们也看不见。

chapters.en:
The prophets are but wind, for the word is not in them.
So let their own predictions befall them. ”
chapters.zh: 先知〔的话〕必成为风； 道也不在他们里面。 这〔灾〕必临到他们身上。

chapters.en:
Therefore this is what the LORD God of Hosts says:
“Because you have spoken this word, I will make My words a fire in your mouth
and this people the wood it consumes.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华－万军之上帝如此说： 因为百姓说这话， 我必使我的话在你口中为火，使他们为柴； 这火便将他们烧灭。

chapters.en: Behold, I am bringing a distant nation against you, O house of Israel,” declares the LORD. “It is an established nation, an ancient nation, a nation whose language you do not know and whose speech you do not understand.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：以色列家啊， 我必使一国的民从远方来攻击你， 是强盛的国， 是从古而有的国。 他们的言语你不晓得， 他们的话你不明白。

chapters.en: Their quivers are like open graves; they are all mighty men.
chapters.zh: 他们的箭袋是敞开的坟墓； 他们都是勇士。

chapters.en: They will devour your harvest and food; they will consume your sons and daughters; they will eat up your flocks and herds; they will feed on your vines and fig trees. With the sword they will destroy the fortified cities in which you trust.”
chapters.zh: 他们必吃尽你的庄稼和你的粮食， 是你儿女该吃的； 必吃尽你的牛羊， 吃尽你的葡萄和无花果； 又必用刀毁坏你所倚靠的坚固城。

chapters.en: “Yet even in those days,” declares the LORD, “I will not make a full end of you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「就是到那时，我也不将你们毁灭净尽。

chapters.en: And when the people ask, ‘For what offense has the LORD our God done all these things to us?’ You are to tell them, ‘Just as you have forsaken Me and served foreign gods in your land, so will you serve foreigners in a land that is not your own.’”
chapters.zh: 百姓若说：『耶和华－我们的上帝为什么向我们行这一切事呢？』你就对他们说：『你们怎样离弃耶和华〔注：原文是我〕，在你们的地上事奉外邦神，也必照样在不属你们的地上事奉外邦人。』」

chapters.en: Declare this in the house of Jacob and proclaim it in Judah:
chapters.zh: 当传扬在雅各家， 报告在犹大说：

chapters.en: “Hear this, O foolish and senseless people, who have eyes but do not see, who have ears but do not hear.
chapters.zh: 愚昧无知的百姓啊， 你们有眼不看， 有耳不听， 现在当听这话。

chapters.en:
Do you not fear Me?” declares the LORD. “Do you not tremble before Me, the One who set the sand as the boundary for the sea,
an enduring barrier it cannot cross? The waves surge, but they cannot prevail. They roar but cannot cross it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：你们怎么不惧怕我呢？ 我以永远的定例， 用沙为海的界限， 〔水〕不得越过。 因此，你们在我面前还不战兢吗？ 波浪虽然翻腾，却不能逾越； 虽然匉訇，却不能过去。

chapters.en: But these people have stubborn and rebellious hearts. They have turned aside and gone away.
chapters.zh: 但这百姓有背叛忤逆的心； 他们叛〔我〕而去，

chapters.en: They have not said in their hearts, ‘Let us fear the LORD our God, who gives the rains, both autumn and spring, in season, who keeps for us the appointed weeks of harvest.’
chapters.zh: 心内也不说： 我们应当敬畏耶和华－我们的上帝； 他按时赐雨，就是秋雨春雨， 又为我们定收割的节令，永存不废。

chapters.en: Your iniquities have diverted these from you; your sins have deprived you of My bounty.
chapters.zh: 你们的罪孽使这些事转离你们； 你们的罪恶使你们不能得福。

chapters.en:
For among My people are wicked men; they watch like fowlers lying in wait;
they set a trap to catch men.
chapters.zh: 因为在我民中有恶人。 他们埋伏窥探，好像捕鸟的人； 他们设立圈套陷害人。

chapters.en:
Like cages full of birds, so their houses are full of deceit.
Therefore they have become powerful and rich.
chapters.zh: 笼内怎样满了雀鸟， 他们的房中也照样充满诡诈； 所以他们得成为大，而且富足。

chapters.en: They have grown fat and sleek, and have excelled in the deeds of the wicked. They have not taken up the cause of the fatherless, that they might prosper; nor have they defended the rights of the needy.
chapters.zh: 他们肥胖光润， 作恶过甚，不为人伸冤！ 就是不为孤儿伸冤， 不使他亨通， 也不为穷人辨屈。

chapters.en: Should I not punish them for these things?” declares the LORD. “Should I not avenge Myself on such a nation as this?
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：我岂不因这些事讨罪呢？ 岂不报复这样的国民呢？

chapters.en: A horrible and shocking thing has happened in the land.
chapters.zh: 国中有可惊骇、可憎恶的事：

chapters.en: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority. My people love it so, but what will you do in the end?
chapters.zh: 就是先知说假预言， 祭司藉他们把持权柄； 我的百姓也喜爱这些事， 到了结局你们怎样行呢？

chapters.en: “Run for cover, O sons of Benjamin; flee from Jerusalem! Sound the ram’s horn in Tekoa; send up a signal over Beth-haccherem, for disaster looms from the north, even great destruction.
chapters.zh: 便雅悯人哪，你们要逃出耶路撒冷， 在提哥亚吹角， 在伯‧哈基琳立号旗； 因为有灾祸与大毁灭从北方张望。

chapters.en: Though she is beautiful and delicate, I will destroy the Daughter of Zion.
chapters.zh: 那秀美娇嫩的锡安女子〔注：就是指民的意思〕， 我必剪除。

chapters.en: Shepherds and their flocks will come against her; they will pitch their tents all around her, each tending his own portion:
chapters.zh: 牧人必引他们的羊群到她那里， 在她周围支搭帐棚， 各在自己〔所佔〕之地〔使羊〕吃草。

chapters.en: ‘Prepare for battle against her; rise up, let us attack at noon. Woe to us, for the daylight is fading; the evening shadows grow long.
chapters.zh: 你们要准备攻击她。 起来吧，我们可以趁午时上去。 哀哉！日已渐斜， 晚影拖长了。

chapters.en: Rise up, let us attack by night and destroy her fortresses!’”
chapters.zh: 起来吧，我们夜间上去， 毁坏她的宫殿。

chapters.en:
For this is what the LORD of Hosts says:
“Cut down the trees and raise a siege ramp against Jerusalem. This city must be punished; there is nothing but oppression in her midst.
chapters.zh: 因为万军之耶和华如此说： 你们要砍伐树木， 筑垒攻打耶路撒冷。 这就是那该罚的城， 其中尽是欺压。

chapters.en: As a well gushes its water, so she pours out her evil. Violence and destruction resound in her; sickness and wounds are ever before Me.
chapters.zh: 井怎样涌出水来， 这城也照样涌出恶来； 在其间常听见有强暴毁灭的事， 病患损伤也常在我面前。

chapters.en: Be forewarned, O Jerusalem, or I will turn away from you; I will make you a desolation, a land without inhabitant.”
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，你当受教， 免得我心与你生疏， 免得我使你荒凉， 成为无人居住之地。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD of Hosts says:
“Glean the remnant of Israel as thoroughly as a vine. Pass your hand once more like a grape gatherer over the branches.”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华曾如此说： 敌人必掳尽以色列剩下的民， 如同摘净葡萄一样。 你要像摘葡萄的人摘了又摘，回手放在筐子里。

chapters.en: To whom can I give this warning? Who will listen to me? Look, their ears are closed, so they cannot hear. See, the word of the LORD has become offensive to them; they find no pleasure in it.
chapters.zh: 现在我可以向谁说话作见证，使他们听呢？ 他们的耳朵未受割礼，不能听见。 看哪，耶和华的话他们以为羞辱， 不以为喜悦。

chapters.en:
But I am full of the LORD’s wrath; I am tired of holding it back.
“Pour it out on the children in the street, and on the young men gathered together. For both husband and wife will be captured, the old and the very old alike.
chapters.zh: 因此我被耶和华的忿怒充满，难以含忍。 我要倾在街中的孩童和聚会的少年人身上， 连夫带妻， 并年老的与日子满足的都必被擒拿。

chapters.en: Their houses will be turned over to others, their fields and wives as well, for I will stretch out My hand against the inhabitants of the land,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们的房屋、田地， 和妻子都必转归别人； 我要伸手攻击这地的居民。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “For from the least of them to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; from prophet to priest, all practice deceit.
chapters.zh: 因为他们从最小的到至大的都一味地贪婪， 从先知到祭司都行事虚谎。

chapters.en: They dress the wound of My people with very little care, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there is no peace at all.
chapters.zh: 他们轻轻忽忽地医治我百姓的损伤， 说：平安了！平安了！ 其实没有平安。

chapters.en:
Are they ashamed of the abomination they have committed? No, they have no shame at all;
they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; when I punish them, they will collapse,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们行可憎的事知道惭愧吗？ 不然，他们毫不惭愧， 也不知羞耻。 因此，他们必在仆倒的人中仆倒； 我向他们讨罪的时候， 他们必致跌倒。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“Stand at the crossroads and look. Ask for the ancient paths: ‘Where is the good way?’ Then walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it!’
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 你们当站在路上察看， 访问古道， 哪是善道，便行在其间； 这样，你们心里必得安息。 他们却说：我们不行〔在其间〕。

chapters.en:
I appointed watchmen over you and said, ‘Listen for the sound of the ram’s horn.’
But they answered, ‘We will not listen!’
chapters.zh: 我设立守望的人照管你们， 〔说〕：要听角声。 他们却说：我们不听。

chapters.en:
Therefore hear, O nations, and learn, O congregations,
what will happen to them.
chapters.zh: 列国啊，因此你们当听！ 会众啊，要知道他们必遭遇的事。

chapters.en: Hear, O earth! I am bringing disaster on this people, the fruit of their own schemes, because they have paid no attention to My word and have rejected My instruction.
chapters.zh: 地啊，当听！ 我必使灾祸临到这百姓， 就是他们意念所结的果子； 因为他们不听从我的言语， 至于我的训诲〔注：或译：律法〕，他们也厌弃了。

chapters.en: What use to Me is frankincense from Sheba or sweet cane from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable; your sacrifices do not please Me.”
chapters.zh: 从示巴出的乳香， 从远方出的菖蒲〔注：或译：甘蔗〕 奉来给我有何益呢？ 你们的燔祭不蒙悦纳； 你们的〔平安〕祭，我也不喜悦。
所以耶和华如此说： 我要将绊脚石放在这百姓前面。 父亲和儿子要一同跌在其上； 邻舍与朋友也都灭亡。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“Behold, an army is coming from the land of the north; a great nation is stirred up from the ends of the earth.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 看哪，有一种民从北方而来， 并有一大国被激动，从地极来到。

chapters.en: They grasp the bow and spear; they are cruel and merciless. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride upon horses, lined up like men in formation against you, O Daughter of Zion.”
chapters.zh: 他们拿弓和枪， 性情残忍，不施怜悯； 他们的声音像海浪匉訇。 锡安城〔注：原文是女子〕啊， 他们骑马都摆队伍， 如上战场的人要攻击你。

chapters.en: We have heard the report; our hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped us, pain like that of a woman in labor.
chapters.zh: 我们听见他们的风声，手就发软； 痛苦将我们抓住， 疼痛仿佛产难的妇人。

chapters.en: Do not go out to the fields; do not walk the road. For the enemy has a sword; terror is on every side.
chapters.zh: 你们不要往田野去， 也不要行在路上， 因四围有仇敌的刀剑和惊吓。

chapters.en: O daughter of my people, dress yourselves in sackcloth and roll in ashes. Mourn with bitter wailing, as you would for an only son, for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.
chapters.zh: 我民〔注：原文是民女〕哪，应当腰束麻布，滚在灰中。 你要悲伤，如丧独生子痛痛哭号， 因为灭命的要忽然临到我们。

chapters.en: “I have appointed you to examine My people like ore, so you may know and try their ways.
chapters.zh: 我使你在我民中为高台〔注：或译：试验人的〕，为保障， 使你知道试验他们的行动。

chapters.en: All are hardened rebels, walking around as slanderers. They are bronze and iron; all of them are corrupt.
chapters.zh: 他们都是极悖逆的， 往来谗谤人。 他们是铜是铁， 都行坏事。

chapters.en: The bellows blow fiercely, blasting away the lead with fire. The refining proceeds in vain, for the wicked are not purged.
chapters.zh: 风箱吹火，铅被烧毁； 他们炼而又炼，终是徒然； 因为恶劣的还未除掉。

chapters.en: They are called rejected silver, because the LORD has rejected them.”
chapters.zh: 人必称他们为被弃的银渣， 因为耶和华已经弃掉他们。

chapters.en: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说：

chapters.en: “Stand in the gate of the house of the LORD and proclaim this message: Hear the word of the LORD, all you people of Judah who enter through these gates to worship the LORD.
chapters.zh: 「你当站在耶和华殿的门口，在那里宣传这话说：你们进这些门敬拜耶和华的一切犹大人，当听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: Thus says the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel: Correct your ways and deeds, and I will let you live in this place.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：你们改正行动作为，我就使你们在这地方仍然居住。

chapters.en:
Do not trust in deceptive words, saying:
‘This is the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD,
the temple of the LORD.’
chapters.zh: 你们不要倚靠虚谎的话，说：『这些是耶和华的殿，是耶和华的殿，是耶和华的殿！』

chapters.en: For if you really correct your ways and deeds, if you act justly toward one another,
chapters.zh: 「你们若实在改正行动作为，在人和邻舍中间诚然施行公平，

chapters.en: if you no longer oppress the foreigner and the fatherless and the widow, and if you no longer shed innocent blood in this place or follow other gods to your own harm,
chapters.zh: 不欺压寄居的和孤儿寡妇，在这地方不流无辜人的血，也不随从别神陷害自己，

chapters.en: then I will let you live in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers forever and ever.
chapters.zh: 我就使你们在这地方仍然居住，就是我古时所赐给你们列祖的地，直到永远。

chapters.en: But look, you keep trusting in deceptive words to no avail.
chapters.zh: 「看哪，你们倚靠虚谎无益的话。

chapters.en: Will you steal and murder, commit adultery and perjury, burn incense to Baal, and follow other gods that you have not known,
chapters.zh: 你们偷盗，杀害，奸淫，起假誓，向巴力烧香，并随从素不认识的别神，

chapters.en: and then come and stand before Me in this house, which bears My Name, and say, ‘We are delivered, so we can continue with all these abominations’?
chapters.zh: 且来到这称为我名下的殿，在我面前敬拜；又说：『我们可以自由了。』你们这样的举动是要行那些可憎的事吗？

chapters.en: Has this house, which bears My Name, become a den of robbers in your sight? Yes, I too have seen it, declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这称为我名下的殿在你们眼中岂可看为贼窝吗？我都看见了。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: But go now to the place in Shiloh where I first made a dwelling for My Name, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of My people Israel.
chapters.zh: 你们且往示罗去，就是我先前立为我名的居所，察看我因这百姓以色列的罪恶向那地所行的如何。」

chapters.en: And now, because you have done all these things, declares the LORD, and because I have spoken to you again and again but you would not listen, and I have called to you but you would not answer,
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「现在因你们行了这一切的事，我也从早起来警戒你们，你们却不听从；呼唤你们，你们却不答应。

chapters.en: therefore what I did to Shiloh I will now do to the house that bears My Name, the house in which you trust, the place that I gave to you and your fathers.
chapters.zh: 所以我要向这称为我名下、你们所倚靠的殿，与我所赐给你们和你们列祖的地施行，照我从前向示罗所行的一样。

chapters.en: And I will cast you out of My presence, just as I have cast out all your brothers, all the descendants of Ephraim.
chapters.zh: 我必将你们从我眼前赶出，正如赶出你们的众弟兄，就是以法莲的一切后裔。」
