chapters.en: As for you, do not pray for these people, do not offer a plea or petition on their behalf, and do not beg Me, for I will not listen to you.
chapters.zh: 「所以，你不要为这百姓祈祷；不要为他们呼求祷告，也不要向我为他们祈求，因我不听允你。

chapters.en: Do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
chapters.zh: 他们在犹大城邑中和耶路撒冷街上所行的，你没有看见吗？

chapters.en: The sons gather wood, the fathers light the fire, and the women knead the dough to make cakes for the Queen of Heaven; they pour out drink offerings to other gods to provoke Me to anger.
chapters.zh: 孩子捡柴，父亲烧火，妇女抟面做饼，献给天后，又向别神浇奠祭，惹我发怒。」

chapters.en: But am I the One they are provoking? declares the LORD. Is it not themselves they spite, to their own shame?
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「他们岂是惹我发怒呢？不是自己惹祸，以致脸上惭愧吗？」

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, My anger and My fury will be poured out on this place, on man and beast, on the trees of the field and the produce of the land, and it will burn and not be extinguished.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：「看哪，我必将我的怒气和忿怒倾在这地方的人和牲畜身上，并田野的树木和地里的出产上，必〔如火〕着起，不能熄灭。」

chapters.en: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Add your burnt offerings to your other sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves!
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：「你们将燔祭加在〔平安〕祭上，吃肉吧！

chapters.en: For when I brought your fathers out of the land of Egypt, I did not merely command them about burnt offerings and sacrifices,
chapters.zh: 因为我将你们列祖从埃及地领出来的那日，燔祭〔平安〕祭的事我并没有提说，也没有吩咐他们。

chapters.en: but this is what I commanded them: Obey Me, and I will be your God, and you will be My people. You must walk in all the ways I have commanded you, so that it may go well with you.
chapters.zh: 我只吩咐他们这一件说：『你们当听从我的话，我就作你们的上帝，你们也作我的子民。你们行我所吩咐的一切道，就可以得福。』

chapters.en: Yet they did not listen or incline their ear, but they followed the stubborn inclinations of their own evil hearts. They went backward and not forward.
chapters.zh: 他们却不听从，不侧耳而听，竟随从〔自己〕的计谋和顽梗的恶心，向后不向前。

chapters.en: From the day your fathers came out of the land of Egypt until this day, I have sent you all My servants the prophets again and again.
chapters.zh: 自从你们列祖出埃及地的那日，直到今日，我差遣我的仆人众先知到你们那里去，每日从早起来差遣他们。

chapters.en: Yet they would not listen to Me or incline their ear, but they stiffened their necks and did more evil than their fathers.
chapters.zh: 你们却不听从，不侧耳而听，竟硬着颈项行恶，比你们列祖更甚。

chapters.en: When you tell them all these things, they will not listen to you. When you call to them, they will not answer.
chapters.zh: 「你要将这一切的话告诉他们，他们却不听从；呼唤他们，他们却不答应。

chapters.en: Therefore you must say to them, ‘This is the nation that would not listen to the voice of the LORD their God and would not receive correction. Truth has perished; it has disappeared from their lips.
chapters.zh: 你要对他们说：这就是不听从耶和华－他们上帝的话、不受教训的国民；从他们的口中，诚实灭绝了。」

chapters.en: Cut off your hair and throw it away. Raise up a lamentation on the barren heights, for the LORD has rejected and forsaken the generation of His wrath.’
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，要剪发抛弃， 在净光的高处举哀； 因为耶和华丢掉离弃了惹他忿怒的世代。

chapters.en: For the people of Judah have done evil in My sight, declares the LORD. They have set up their abominations in the house that bears My Name, and so have defiled it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「犹大人行我眼中看为恶的事，将可憎之物设立在称为我名下的殿中，污秽这殿。

chapters.en: They have built the high places of Topheth in the Valley of Ben-hinnom so they could burn their sons and daughters in the fire—something I never commanded, nor did it even enter My mind.
chapters.zh: 他们在欣嫩子谷建筑陀斐特的邱坛，好在火中焚烧自己的儿女。这并不是我所吩咐的，也不是我心所起的意。」

chapters.en: So behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when this place will no longer be called Topheth and the Valley of Ben-hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter. For they will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「因此，日子将到，这地方不再称为陀斐特和欣嫩子谷，反倒称为杀戮谷。因为要在陀斐特葬埋〔尸首〕，甚至无处〔可葬〕；

chapters.en: The corpses of this people will become food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth, and there will be no one to scare them away.
chapters.zh: 并且这百姓的尸首必给空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽作食物，并无人鬨赶。

chapters.en: I will remove from the cities of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem the sounds of joy and gladness and the voices of the bride and bridegroom, for the land will become a wasteland.”
chapters.zh: 那时，我必使犹大城邑中和耶路撒冷街上，欢喜和快乐的声音，新郎和新妇的声音，都止息了，因为地必成为荒场。」

chapters.en: “At that time,” declares the LORD, “the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of the officials, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the people of Jerusalem will be removed from their graves.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「到那时，人必将犹大王的骸骨和他首领的骸骨、祭司的骸骨、先知的骸骨，并耶路撒冷居民的骸骨，都从坟墓中取出来，

chapters.en: They will be exposed to the sun and moon, and to all the host of heaven which they have loved, served, followed, consulted, and worshiped. Their bones will not be gathered up or buried, but will become like dung lying on the ground.
chapters.zh: 抛散在日头、月亮，和天上众星之下，就是他们从前所喜爱、所事奉、所随从、所求问、所敬拜的。这些骸骨不再收殓，不再葬埋，必在地面上成为粪土；

chapters.en: And wherever I have banished them, the remnant of this evil family will choose death over life,” declares the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 并且这恶族所剩下的民在我所赶他们到的各处，宁可拣死不拣生。这是万军之耶和华说的。」

chapters.en:
So you are to tell them this is what the LORD says:
“Do men fall and not get up again? Does one turn away and not return?
chapters.zh: 你要对他们说，耶和华如此说： 人跌倒，不再起来吗？ 人转去，不再转来吗？

chapters.en: Why then have these people turned away? Why does Jerusalem always turn away? They cling to deceit; they refuse to return.
chapters.zh: 这耶路撒冷的民，为何恒久背道呢？ 他们守定诡诈，不肯回头。

chapters.en: I have listened and heard; they do not speak what is right. No one repents of his wickedness, asking, ‘What have I done?’ Everyone has pursued his own course like a horse charging into battle.
chapters.zh: 我留心听，听见他们说不正直的话。 无人悔改恶行，说： 我做的是什么呢？ 他们各人转奔己路， 如马直闯战场。

chapters.en: Even the stork in the sky knows her appointed seasons. The turtledove, the swift, and the thrush keep their time of migration, but My people do not know the requirements of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 空中的鹳鸟知道〔来去的〕定期； 斑鸠燕子与白鹤也守候当来的时令； 我的百姓却不知道耶和华的法则。

chapters.en: How can you say, ‘We are wise, and the Law of the LORD is with us,’ when in fact the lying pen of the scribes has produced a deception?
chapters.zh: 你们怎么说：我们有智慧， 耶和华的律法在我们这里？ 看哪，文士的假笔舞弄虚假。

chapters.en: The wise will be put to shame; they will be dismayed and trapped. Since they have rejected the word of the LORD, what wisdom do they really have?
chapters.zh: 智慧人惭愧，惊惶，被擒拿； 他们弃掉耶和华的话， 心里还有什么智慧呢？

chapters.en: Therefore I will give their wives to other men and their fields to new owners. For from the least of them to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; from prophet to priest, all practice deceit.
chapters.zh: 所以我必将他们的妻子给别人， 将他们的田地给别人为业； 因为他们从最小的到至大的都一味地贪婪， 从先知到祭司都行事虚谎。

chapters.en: They dress the wound of the daughter of My people with very little care, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there is no peace at all.
chapters.zh: 他们轻轻忽忽地医治我百姓的损伤，说： 平安了！平安了！ 其实没有平安。
他们行可憎的事知道惭愧吗？ 不然，他们毫不惭愧， 也不知羞耻。 因此他们必在仆倒的人中仆倒； 我向他们讨罪的时候， 他们必致跌倒。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: I will take away their harvest, declares the LORD. There will be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the tree, and even the leaf will wither. Whatever I have given them will be lost to them.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：我必使他们全然灭绝； 葡萄树上必没有葡萄， 无花果树上必没有果子， 叶子也必枯干。 我所赐给他们的， 必离开他们过去。

chapters.en: Why are we just sitting here? Gather together, let us flee to the fortified cities and perish there, for the LORD our God has doomed us. He has given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我们为何静坐不动呢？ 我们当聚集，进入坚固城， 在那里静默不言； 因为耶和华－我们的上帝使我们静默不言， 又将苦胆水给我们喝， 都因我们得罪了耶和华。

chapters.en: We hoped for peace, but no good has come, for a time of healing, but there was only terror.
chapters.zh: 我们指望平安， 却得不着好处； 指望痊愈的时候， 不料，受了惊惶。

chapters.en: The snorting of enemy horses is heard from Dan. At the sound of the neighing of mighty steeds, the whole land quakes. They come to devour the land and everything in it, the city and all who dwell in it.
chapters.zh: 听见从但那里敌人的马喷鼻气， 他的壮马发嘶声， 全地就都震动； 因为他们来吞灭这地和其上所有的， 吞灭这城与其中的居民。

chapters.en:
“For behold, I will send snakes among you, vipers that cannot be charmed,
and they will bite you,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我必使毒蛇到你们中间， 是不服法术的， 必咬你们。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: My sorrow is beyond healing; my heart is faint within me.
chapters.zh: 我有忧愁，愿能自慰； 我心在我里面发昏。

chapters.en:
Listen to the cry of the daughter of my people from a land far away:
“Is the LORD no longer in Zion? Is her King no longer there?”
“Why have they provoked Me to anger with their carved images,
with their worthless foreign idols?”
chapters.zh: 听啊，是我百姓的哀声从极远之地而来， 〔说〕：耶和华不在锡安吗？ 锡安的王不在其中吗？ 〔耶和华说〕：他们为什么以雕刻的偶像 和外邦虚无〔的神〕惹我发怒呢？

chapters.en: “The harvest has passed, the summer has ended, but we have not been saved.”
chapters.zh: 麦秋已过，夏令已完， 我们还未得救！

chapters.en: For the brokenness of the daughter of my people I am crushed. I mourn; horror has gripped me.
chapters.zh: 〔先知说〕：因我百姓的损伤， 我也受了损伤。 我哀痛，惊惶将我抓住。

chapters.en: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is no physician there? Why then has the health of the daughter of my people not been restored?
chapters.zh: 在基列岂没有乳香呢？ 在那里岂没有医生呢？ 我百姓为何不得痊愈呢？

chapters.en: Oh, that my head were a spring of water, and my eyes a fountain of tears! I would weep day and night over the slain daughter of my people.
chapters.zh: 但愿我的头为水， 我的眼为泪的泉源， 我好为我百姓〔注：原文是民女；七节同〕中被杀的人昼夜哭泣。

chapters.en: If only I had a traveler’s lodge in the wilderness, I would abandon my people and depart from them, for they are all adulterers, a crowd of faithless people.
chapters.zh: 惟愿我在旷野有行路人住宿之处， 使我可以离开我的民出去； 因他们都是行奸淫的， 是行诡诈的一党。

chapters.en: “They bend their tongues like bows; lies prevail over truth in the land. For they proceed from evil to evil, and they do not take Me into account,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们弯起舌头像弓一样， 为要说谎话。 他们在国中增长势力， 不是为行诚实， 乃是恶上加恶， 并不认识我。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Let everyone guard against his neighbor; do not trust any brother, for every brother deals craftily, and every friend spreads slander.
chapters.zh: 你们各人当谨防邻舍， 不可信靠弟兄； 因为弟兄尽行欺骗， 邻舍都往来谗谤人。

chapters.en: Each one betrays his friend; no one tells the truth. They have taught their tongues to lie; they wear themselves out committing iniquity.
chapters.zh: 他们各人欺哄邻舍，不说真话； 他们教舌头学习说谎， 劳劳碌碌地作孽。

chapters.en: You dwell in the midst of deception; in their deceit they refuse to know Me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你的住处在诡诈的人中； 他们因行诡诈，不肯认识我。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts says:
“Behold, I will refine them and test them, for what else can I do
because of the daughter of My people?
chapters.zh: 所以万军之耶和华如此说： 看哪，我要将他们镕化熬炼； 不然，我因我百姓〔的罪〕该怎样行呢？

chapters.en: Their tongues are deadly arrows; they speak deception. With his mouth a man speaks peace to his neighbor, but in his heart he sets a trap for him.
chapters.zh: 他们的舌头是毒箭，说话诡诈； 人与邻舍口说和平话， 心却谋害他。

chapters.en: Should I not punish them for these things? declares the LORD. Should I not avenge Myself on such a nation as this?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：我岂不因这些事讨他们的罪呢？ 岂不报复这样的国民呢？

chapters.en: I will take up a weeping and wailing for the mountains, a dirge over the wilderness pasture, for they have been scorched so no one passes through, and the lowing of cattle is not heard. Both the birds of the air and the beasts have fled; they have gone away.
chapters.zh: 我要为山岭哭泣悲哀， 为旷野的草场扬声哀号； 因为都已干焦，甚至无人经过。 人也听不见牲畜鸣叫， 空中的飞鸟和〔地上的〕野兽都已逃去。

chapters.en: “And I will make Jerusalem a heap of rubble, a haunt for jackals; and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”
chapters.zh: 我必使耶路撒冷变为乱堆，为野狗的住处， 也必使犹大的城邑变为荒场，无人居住。

chapters.en: Who is the man wise enough to understand this? To whom has the mouth of the LORD spoken, that he may explain it? Why is the land destroyed and scorched like a desert, so no one can pass through it?
chapters.zh: 谁是智慧人，可以明白这事？耶和华的口向谁说过，使他可以传说？遍地为何灭亡，干焦好像旷野，甚至无人经过呢？

chapters.en: And the LORD answered, “It is because they have forsaken My law, which I set before them; they have not walked in it or obeyed My voice.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「因为这百姓离弃我在他们面前所设立的律法，没有遵行，也没有听从我的话；

chapters.en: Instead, they have followed the stubbornness of their hearts and gone after the Baals, as their fathers taught them.”
chapters.zh: 只随从自己顽梗的心行事，照他们列祖所教训的随从众巴力。」

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will feed this people wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.
chapters.zh: 所以万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：「看哪，我必将茵蔯给这百姓吃，又将苦胆水给他们喝。

chapters.en: I will scatter them among the nations that neither they nor their fathers have known, and I will send a sword after them until I have finished them off.”
chapters.zh: 我要把他们散在列邦中，就是他们和他们列祖素不认识的列邦。我也要使刀剑追杀他们，直到将他们灭尽。」

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD of Hosts says:
“Take note, and summon the wailing women; send for the most skillful among them.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说： 你们应当思想， 将〔善〕唱哀歌的妇女召来， 又打发人召善〔哭〕的妇女来，

chapters.en: Let them come quickly and take up a lament over us, that our eyes may overflow with tears, and our eyelids may gush with water.
chapters.zh: 叫她们速速为我们举哀， 使我们眼泪汪汪， 使我们的眼皮涌出水来。

chapters.en: For the sound of wailing is heard from Zion: ‘How devastated we are! How great is our shame! For we have abandoned the land because our dwellings have been torn down.’”
chapters.zh: 因为听见哀声出于锡安，〔说〕： 我们怎样败落了！ 我们大大地惭愧！ 我们撇下地土； 人也拆毁了我们的房屋。

chapters.en: Now, O women, hear the word of the LORD. Open your ears to the word of His mouth. Teach your daughters to wail, and one another to lament.
chapters.zh: 妇女们哪，你们当听耶和华的话， 领受他口中的言语； 又当教导你们的儿女举哀， 各人教导邻舍唱哀歌。

chapters.en: For death has climbed in through our windows; it has entered our fortresses to cut off the children from the streets, the young men from the town squares.
chapters.zh: 因为死亡上来， 进了我们的窗户， 入了我们的宫殿； 要从外边剪除孩童， 从街上剪除少年人。

chapters.en:
Declare that this is what the LORD says:
“The corpses of men will fall like dung upon the open field, like newly cut grain behind the reaper, with no one to gather it.”
chapters.zh: 你当说，耶和华如此说： 人的尸首必倒在田野像粪土， 又像收割的人遗落的一把〔禾稼〕， 无人收取。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“Let not the wise man boast in his wisdom, nor the strong man in his strength,
nor the wealthy man in his riches.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：「智慧人不要因他的智慧夸口，勇士不要因他的勇力夸口，财主不要因他的财物夸口。

chapters.en: But let him who boasts boast in this, that he understands and knows Me, that I am the LORD, who exercises loving devotion, justice and righteousness on the earth— for I delight in these things,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 夸口的却因他有聪明，认识我是耶和华，又知道我喜悦在世上施行慈爱、公平，和公义，以此夸口。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: “Behold, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will punish all who are circumcised only in the flesh—
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「看哪，日子将到，我要刑罚一切受过割礼、〔心〕却未受割礼的，

chapters.en: Egypt, Judah, Edom, Ammon, Moab, and all the inhabitants of the desert who clip the hair of their temples. For all these nations are uncircumcised, and the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart.”
chapters.zh: 就是埃及、犹大、以东、亚扪人、摩押人，和一切住在旷野剃周围〔头发〕的；因为列国人都没有受割礼，以色列人心中也没有受割礼。」

chapters.en: Hear the word that the LORD speaks to you, O house of Israel.
chapters.zh: 以色列家啊，要听耶和华对你们所说的话。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“Do not learn the ways of the nations or be terrified by the signs in the heavens,
though the nations themselves are terrified by them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 你们不要效法列国的行为， 也不要为天象惊惶， 因列国为此事惊惶。

chapters.en: For the customs of the peoples are worthless; they cut down a tree from the forest; it is shaped with a chisel by the hands of a craftsman.
chapters.zh: 众民的风俗是虚空的； 他们在树林中用斧子砍伐一棵树， 匠人用手工造成〔偶像〕。

chapters.en:
They adorn it with silver and gold and fasten it with hammer and nails,
so that it will not totter.
chapters.zh: 他们用金银妆饰它， 用钉子和锤子钉稳， 使它不动摇。

chapters.en: Like scarecrows in a cucumber patch, their idols cannot speak. They must be carried because they cannot walk. Do not fear them, for they can do no harm, and neither can they do any good.”
chapters.zh: 它好像棕树，是镟成的， 不能说话，不能行走， 必须有人抬着。 你们不要怕它； 它不能降祸， 也无力降福。

chapters.en: There is none like You, O LORD. You are great, and Your name is mighty in power.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，没有能比你的！ 你本为大，有大能大力的名。

chapters.en:
Who would not fear You, O King of nations? This is Your due. For among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms,
there is none like You.
chapters.zh: 万国的王啊，谁不敬畏你？ 敬畏你本是合宜的； 因为在列国的智慧人中， 虽有政权的尊荣， 也不能比你。

chapters.en: But they are altogether senseless and foolish, instructed by worthless idols made of wood!
chapters.zh: 他们尽都是畜类，是愚昧的。 偶像的训诲算什么呢？ 偶像不过是木头。

chapters.en: Hammered silver is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz— the work of a craftsman from the hands of a goldsmith. Their clothes are blue and purple, all fashioned by skilled workers.
chapters.zh: 有银子打成片，是从他施带来的， 并有从乌法来的金子， 都是匠人和银匠的手工， 又有蓝色紫色料的衣服， 都是巧匠的工作。

chapters.en: But the LORD is the true God; He is the living God and eternal King. The earth quakes at His wrath, and the nations cannot endure His indignation.
chapters.zh: 惟耶和华是真上帝， 是活上帝，是永远的王。 他一发怒，大地震动； 他一恼恨，列国都担当不起。

chapters.en: Thus you are to tell them: “These gods, who have made neither the heavens nor the earth, will perish from this earth and from under these heavens.”
chapters.zh: （你们要对他们如此说：不是那创造天地的神，必从地上从天下被除灭！）

chapters.en:
The LORD made the earth by His power; He established the world by His wisdom
and stretched out the heavens by His understanding.
chapters.zh: 耶和华用能力创造大地， 用智慧建立世界， 用聪明铺张穹苍。

chapters.en: When He thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
chapters.zh: 他一发声，空中便有多水激动； 他使云雾从地极上腾； 他造电随雨而闪， 从他府库中带出风来。

chapters.en: Every man is senseless and devoid of knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols. For his molten images are a fraud, and there is no breath in them.
chapters.zh: 各人都成了畜类，毫无知识； 各银匠都因他雕刻的偶像羞愧。 他所铸的偶像本是虚假的， 其中并无气息，

chapters.en: They are worthless, a work to be mocked. In the time of their punishment they will perish.
chapters.zh: 都是虚无的， 是迷惑人的工作； 到追讨的时候必被除灭。

chapters.en: The Portion of Jacob is not like these, for He is the Maker of all things, and Israel is the tribe of His inheritance— the LORD of Hosts is His name.
chapters.zh: 雅各的分不像这些， 因他是造作万有的〔主〕。 以色列也是他产业的支派， 万军之耶和华是他的名。

chapters.en: Gather up your belongings from this land, you who live under siege.
chapters.zh: 受围困的人哪，当收拾你的财物， 从国中带出去。

chapters.en:
For this is what the LORD says:
“Behold, at this time I will sling out the inhabitants of the land and bring distress upon them so that they may be captured.”
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华如此说： 这时候，我必将此地的居民， 好像用机弦甩出去， 又必加害在他们身上， 使他们觉悟。

chapters.en: Woe to me because of my brokenness; my wound is grievous! But I said, “This is truly my sickness, and I must bear it.”
chapters.zh: 民〔说〕：祸哉！我受损伤； 我的伤痕极其重大。 我却说：这真是我的痛苦， 必须忍受。

chapters.en: My tent is destroyed, and all its ropes are snapped. My sons have departed from me and are no more. I have no one left to pitch my tent or set up my curtains.
chapters.zh: 我的帐棚毁坏； 我的绳索折断。 我的儿女离我出去，没有了。 无人再支搭我的帐棚，挂起我的幔子。

chapters.en: For the shepherds have become senseless; they do not seek the LORD. Therefore they have not prospered, and all their flock is scattered.
chapters.zh: 因为牧人都成为畜类， 没有求问耶和华， 所以不得顺利； 他们的羊群也都分散。

chapters.en: Listen! The sound of a report is coming— a great commotion from the land to the north. It will make the cities of Judah a desolation, a haunt for jackals.
chapters.zh: 有风声！看哪，〔敌人〕来了！ 有大扰乱从北方出来， 要使犹大城邑变为荒凉， 成为野狗的住处。

chapters.en: I know, O LORD, that a man’s way is not his own; no one who walks directs his own steps.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我晓得人的道路不由自己， 行路的人也不能定自己的脚步。

chapters.en: Correct me, O LORD, but only with justice— not in Your anger, or You will bring me to nothing.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你从宽惩治我， 不要在你的怒中惩治我， 恐怕使我归于无有。

chapters.en:
Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You, and on the families that do not call on Your name. For they have devoured Jacob; they have consumed him and finished him off;
they have devastated his homeland.
chapters.zh: 愿你将忿怒倾在不认识你的列国中， 和不求告你名的各族上； 因为他们吞了雅各，不但吞了，而且灭绝， 把他的住处变为荒场。

chapters.en: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说：

chapters.en: “Listen to the words of this covenant and tell them to the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 「当听这约的话，告诉犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民，

chapters.en: You must tell them that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Cursed is the man who does not obey the words of this covenant,
chapters.zh: 对他们说，耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：不听从这约之话的人必受咒诅。

chapters.en: which I commanded your forefathers when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace, saying, ‘Obey Me, and do everything I command you, and you will be My people, and I will be your God.’
chapters.zh: 这约是我将你们列祖从埃及地领出来、脱离铁炉的那日所吩咐他们的，说：『你们要听从我的话，照我一切所吩咐的去行。』这样，你们就作我的子民，我也作你们的上帝；

chapters.en:
This was in order to establish the oath I swore to your forefathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is to this day.”
“Amen, LORD,” I answered.
chapters.zh: 我好坚定向你们列祖所起的誓，给他们流奶与蜜之地，正如今日一样。」我就回答说：「耶和华啊，阿们！」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying: Hear the words of this covenant and carry them out.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说：「你要在犹大城邑中和耶路撒冷街市上，宣告这一切话说：你们当听从遵行这约的话。

chapters.en: For from the time I brought your fathers out of the land of Egypt until today, I strongly warned them again and again, saying, ‘Obey My voice.’
chapters.zh: 因为我将你们列祖从埃及地领出来的那日，直到今日，都是从早起来，切切诰诫他们说：『你们当听从我的话。』

chapters.en: Yet they would not obey or incline their ears, but each one followed the stubbornness of his evil heart. So I brought on them all the curses of this covenant I had commanded them to follow but they did not keep.”
chapters.zh: 他们却不听从，不侧耳而听，竟随从自己顽梗的恶心去行。所以我使这约中一切〔咒诅〕的话临到他们身上；这约是我吩咐他们行的，他们却不去行。」

chapters.en: And the LORD told me, “There is a conspiracy among the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说：「在犹大人和耶路撒冷居民中有同谋背叛的事。

chapters.en: They have returned to the sins of their forefathers who refused to obey My words. They have followed other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken the covenant I made with their fathers.
chapters.zh: 他们转去效法他们的先祖，不肯听我的话，犯罪作孽，又随从别神，事奉它。以色列家和犹大家背了我与他们列祖所立的约。」

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘I am about to bring upon them a disaster that they cannot escape. They will cry out to Me, but I will not listen to them.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华如此说：「我必使灾祸临到他们，是他们不能逃脱的。他们必向我哀求，我却不听。

chapters.en: Then the cities of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to which they have been burning incense, but these gods certainly will not save them in their time of disaster.
chapters.zh: 那时，犹大城邑的人和耶路撒冷的居民要去哀求他们烧香所供奉的神；只是遭难的时候，这些神毫不拯救他们。

chapters.en: Your gods are indeed as numerous as your cities, O Judah; the altars of shame you have set up—the altars to burn incense to Baal—are as many as the streets of Jerusalem.’
chapters.zh: 犹大啊，你神的数目与你城的数目相等；你为那可耻的巴力所筑烧香的坛也与耶路撒冷街道的数目相等。

chapters.en: As for you, do not pray for these people. Do not raise up a cry or a prayer on their behalf, for I will not be listening when they call out to Me in their time of disaster.
chapters.zh: 「所以你不要为这百姓祈祷，不要为他们呼求祷告；因为他们遭难向我哀求的时候，我必不应允。

chapters.en: What right has My beloved in My house, having carried out so many evil schemes? Can consecrated meat avert your doom? When you are wicked, then you rejoice.
chapters.zh: 我所亲爱的，既行许多淫乱，圣肉也离了你，你在我殿中做什么呢？你作恶就喜乐。

chapters.en: The LORD once called you a flourishing olive tree, beautiful with well-formed fruit. But with a mighty roar He will set it on fire, and its branches will be consumed.
chapters.zh: 从前耶和华给你起名叫青橄榄树，又华美又结好果子；如今他用鬨嚷之声，点火在其上，枝子也被折断。

chapters.en: The LORD of Hosts, who planted you, has decreed disaster against you on account of the evil that the house of Israel and the house of Judah have brought upon themselves, provoking Me to anger by burning incense to Baal.”
chapters.zh: 原来栽培你的万军之耶和华已经说，要降祸攻击你，是因以色列家和犹大家行恶，向巴力烧香，惹我发怒，是自作自受。」

chapters.en: And the LORD informed me, so I knew. Then You showed me their deeds.
chapters.zh: 耶和华指示我，我就知道； 你将他们所行的给我指明。

chapters.en:
For I was like a gentle lamb led to slaughter; I did not know that they had plotted against me: “Let us destroy the tree with its fruit; let us cut him off from the land of the living,
that his name may be remembered no more.”
chapters.zh: 我却像柔顺的羊羔被牵到宰杀之地； 我并不知道他们设计谋害我， 〔说〕：我们把树连果子都灭了吧！ 将他从活人之地剪除， 使他的名不再被纪念。

chapters.en: O LORD of Hosts, who judges righteously, who examines the heart and mind, let me see Your vengeance upon them, for to You I have committed my cause.
chapters.zh: 按公义判断、察验人肺腑心肠的万军之耶和华啊， 我却要见你在他们身上报仇， 因我将我的案件向你禀明了。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning the people of Anathoth who are seeking your life and saying, “You must not prophesy in the name of the LORD, or you will die by our hand.”
chapters.zh: 所以，耶和华论到寻索你命的亚拿突人如此说：「他们说：你不要奉耶和华的名说预言，免得你死在我们手中。

chapters.en: So this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “I will punish them. Their young men will die by the sword, their sons and daughters by famine.
chapters.zh: 所以万军之耶和华如此说：看哪，我必刑罚他们；他们的少年人必被刀剑杀死，他们的儿女必因饥荒灭亡，

chapters.en: There will be no remnant, for I will bring disaster on the people of Anathoth in the year of their punishment.”
chapters.zh: 并且没有余剩的人留给他们；因为在追讨之年，我必使灾祸临到亚拿突人。」

chapters.en:
Righteous are You, O LORD, when I plead before You. Yet about Your judgments I wish to contend with You:
Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all the faithless live at ease?
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我与你争辩的时候， 你显为义； 但有一件，我还要与你理论： 恶人的道路为何亨通呢？ 大行诡诈的为何得安逸呢？

chapters.en: You planted them, and they have taken root. They have grown and produced fruit. You are ever on their lips, but far from their hearts.
chapters.zh: 你栽培了他们， 他们也扎了根， 长大，而且结果。 他们的口是与你相近， 心却与你远离。

chapters.en: But You know me, O LORD; You see me and test my heart toward You. Drag away the wicked like sheep to the slaughter and set them apart for the day of carnage.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你晓得我，看见我， 察验我向你是怎样的心。 求你将他们拉出来， 好像将宰的羊， 叫他们等候杀戮的日子。

chapters.en: How long will the land mourn and the grass of every field be withered? Because of the evil of its residents, the animals and birds have been swept away, for the people have said, “He cannot see what our end will be.”
chapters.zh: 这地悲哀， 通国的青草枯干，要到几时呢？ 因其上居民的恶行， 牲畜和飞鸟都灭绝了。 他们曾说：他看不见我们的结局。

chapters.en:
“If you have raced with men on foot and they have worn you out,
how can you compete with horses? If you stumble in a peaceful land, how will you do in the thickets of the Jordan?
chapters.zh: 〔耶和华说〕：你若与步行的人同跑， 尚且觉累， 怎能与马赛跑呢？ 你在平安之地，虽然安稳， 在约旦河边的丛林要怎样行呢？

chapters.en: Even your brothers— your own father’s household— even they have betrayed you; even they have cried aloud against you. Do not trust them, though they speak well of you.
chapters.zh: 因为连你弟兄和你父家都用奸诈待你。 他们也在你后边大声喊叫， 虽向你说好话， 你也不要信他们。

chapters.en: I have forsaken My house; I have abandoned My inheritance. I have given the beloved of My soul into the hands of her enemies.
chapters.zh: 我离了我的殿宇， 撇弃我的产业， 将我心里所亲爱的交在她仇敌的手中。

chapters.en: My inheritance has become to Me like a lion in the forest. She has roared against Me; therefore I hate her.
chapters.zh: 我的产业向我如林中的狮子， 她发声攻击我， 因此我恨恶她。

chapters.en:
Is not My inheritance to Me like a speckled bird of prey
with other birds of prey circling against her? Go, gather all the beasts of the field; bring them to devour her.
chapters.zh: 我的产业向我岂如斑点的鸷鸟呢？ 鸷鸟岂在她四围攻击她呢？ 你们要去聚集田野的百兽， 带来吞吃吧！

chapters.en: Many shepherds have destroyed My vineyard; they have trampled My plot of ground. They have turned My pleasant field into a desolate wasteland.
chapters.zh: 许多牧人毁坏我的葡萄园， 践踏我的分， 使我美好的分变为荒凉的旷野。

chapters.en: They have made it a desolation; desolate before Me, it mourns. All the land is laid waste, but no man takes it to heart.
chapters.zh: 他们使地荒凉； 地既荒凉，便向我悲哀。 全地荒凉，因无人介意。

chapters.en:
Over all the barren heights in the wilderness the destroyers have come, for the sword of the LORD devours from one end of the earth to the other.
No flesh has peace.
chapters.zh: 灭命的都来到旷野中一切净光的高处； 耶和华的刀从地这边直到地那边尽行杀灭。 凡有血气的都不得平安。

chapters.en: They have sown wheat but harvested thorns. They have exhausted themselves to no avail. Bear the shame of your harvest because of the fierce anger of the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 他们种的是麦子， 收的是荆棘； 劳劳苦苦却毫无益处。 因耶和华的烈怒， 你们必为自己的土产羞愧。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “As for all My evil neighbors who attack the inheritance that I bequeathed to My people Israel, I am about to uproot them from their land, and I will uproot the house of Judah from among them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：「一切恶邻，就是占据我使百姓以色列所承受产业的，我要将他们拔出本地，又要将犹大家从他们中间拔出来。

chapters.en: But after I have uprooted them, I will once again have compassion on them and return each one to his inheritance and to his land.
chapters.zh: 我拔出他们以后，我必转过来怜悯他们，把他们再带回来，各归本业，各归故土。

chapters.en: And if they will diligently learn the ways of My people and swear by My name, saying, ‘As surely as the LORD lives’—just as they once taught My people to swear by Baal—then they will be established among My people.
chapters.zh: 他们若殷勤学习我百姓的道，指着我的名起誓〔说〕：『我指着永生的耶和华起誓』，正如他们从前教我百姓指着巴力起誓，他们就必建立在我百姓中间。

chapters.en: But if they will not obey, then I will uproot that nation; I will uproot it and destroy it, declares the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 他们若是不听，我必拔出那国，拔出而且毁灭。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: This is what the LORD said to me: “Go and buy yourself a linen loincloth and put it around your waist, but do not let it touch water.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我如此说：「你去买一根麻布带子束腰，不可放在水中。」

chapters.en: So I bought a loincloth in accordance with the word of the LORD, and I put it around my waist.
chapters.zh: 我就照着耶和华的话，买了一根带子束腰。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me a second time:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话第二次临到我说：

chapters.en: “Take the loincloth that you bought and are wearing, and go at once to Perath and hide it there in a crevice of the rocks.”
chapters.zh: 「要拿着你所买的腰带，就是你腰上的带子，起来往幼发拉底河去，将腰带藏在那里的磐石穴中。」

chapters.en: So I went and hid it at Perath, as the LORD had commanded me.
chapters.zh: 我就去，照着耶和华所吩咐我的，将腰带藏在幼发拉底河边。

chapters.en: Many days later the LORD said to me, “Arise, go to Perath, and get the loincloth that I commanded you to hide there.”
chapters.zh: 过了多日，耶和华对我说：「你起来往幼发拉底河去，将我吩咐你藏在那里的腰带取出来。」

chapters.en: So I went to Perath and dug up the loincloth, and I took it from the place where I had hidden it. But now it was ruined—of no use at all.
chapters.zh: 我就往幼发拉底河去，将腰带从我所藏的地方刨出来，见腰带已经变坏，毫无用了。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD says: In the same way I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华如此说：我必照样败坏犹大的骄傲和耶路撒冷的大骄傲。

chapters.en: These evil people, who refuse to listen to My words, who follow the stubbornness of their own hearts, and who go after other gods to serve and worship them, they will be like this loincloth—of no use at all.
chapters.zh: 这恶民不肯听我的话，按自己顽梗的心而行，随从别神，事奉敬拜，他们也必像这腰带变为无用。」

chapters.en: For just as a loincloth clings to a man’s waist, so I have made the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah cling to Me, declares the LORD, so that they might be My people for My renown and praise and glory. But they did not listen.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「腰带怎样紧贴人腰，照样，我也使以色列全家和犹大全家紧贴我，好叫他们属我为子民，使我得名声，得颂赞，得荣耀；他们却不肯听。」

chapters.en:
Therefore you are to tell them that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Every wineskin shall be filled with wine.’
And when they reply, ‘Don’t we surely know that every wineskin should be filled with wine?’
chapters.zh: 「所以你要对他们说：『耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：各坛都要盛满了酒。』他们必对你说：『我们岂不确知各坛都要盛满了酒呢？』

chapters.en: then you are to tell them that this is what the LORD says: ‘I am going to fill with drunkenness all who live in this land—the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the people of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 你就要对他们说：『耶和华如此说：我必使这地的一切居民，就是坐大卫宝座的君王和祭司，与先知，并耶路撒冷的一切居民，都酩酊大醉。』」

chapters.en: I will smash them against one another, fathers and sons alike, declares the LORD. I will allow no mercy or pity or compassion to keep Me from destroying them.’”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我要使他们彼此相碰，就是父与子彼此相碰；我必不可怜，不顾惜，不怜悯，以致灭绝他们。」

chapters.en: Listen and give heed. Do not be arrogant, for the LORD has spoken.
chapters.zh: 你们当听，当侧耳而听。 不要骄傲，因为耶和华已经说了。

chapters.en: Give glory to the LORD your God before He brings darkness, before your feet stumble on the dusky mountains. You wait for light, but He turns it into deep gloom and thick darkness.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你们的上帝未使黑暗来到， 你们的脚未在昏暗山上绊跌之先， 当将荣耀归给他； 免得你们盼望光明， 他使光明变为死荫， 成为幽暗。

chapters.en: But if you do not listen, I will weep in secret because of your pride. My eyes will overflow with tears, because the LORD’s flock has been taken captive.
chapters.zh: 你们若不听这话， 我必因〔你们的〕骄傲在暗地哭泣； 我眼必痛哭流泪， 因为耶和华的群众被掳去了。

chapters.en: Say to the king and to the queen mother: “Take a lowly seat, for your glorious crowns have fallen from your heads.”
chapters.zh: 你要对君王和太后说： 你们当自卑，坐在下边； 因你们的头巾， 就是你们的华冠，已经脱落了。

chapters.en: The cities of the Negev have been shut tight, and no one can open them. All Judah has been carried into exile, wholly taken captive.
chapters.zh: 南方的城尽都关闭， 无人开放； 犹大全被掳掠， 且掳掠净尽。

chapters.en: Lift up your eyes and see those coming from the north. Where is the flock entrusted to you, the sheep that were your pride?
chapters.zh: 你们要举目观看从北方来的人。 先前赐给你的群众， 就是你佳美的群众， 如今在哪里呢？

chapters.en: What will you say when He sets over you close allies whom you yourself trained? Will not pangs of anguish grip you, as they do a woman in labor?
chapters.zh: 耶和华立你自己所交的朋友为首，辖制你， 那时你还有什么话说呢？ 痛苦岂不将你抓住像产难的妇人吗？

chapters.en:
And if you ask yourself, “Why has this happened to me?” It is because of the magnitude of your iniquity that your skirts have been stripped off
and your body has been exposed.
chapters.zh: 你若心里说：这一切事为何临到我呢？ 你的衣襟揭起， 你的脚跟受伤， 是因你的罪孽甚多。

chapters.en: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? Neither are you able to do good— you who are accustomed to doing evil.
chapters.zh: 古实人岂能改变皮肤呢？ 豹岂能改变斑点呢？ 若能，你们这习惯行恶的便能行善了。

chapters.en: “I will scatter you like chaff driven by the desert wind.
chapters.zh: 所以我必用旷野的风吹散他们， 像吹过的碎诩一样。

chapters.en: This is your lot, the portion I have measured to you,” declares the LORD, “because you have forgotten Me and trusted in falsehood.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：这是你所当得的， 是我量给你的分； 因为你忘记我， 倚靠虚假〔注：或译：偶像〕。

chapters.en: So I will pull your skirts up over your face, that your shame may be seen.
chapters.zh: 所以我要揭起你的衣襟， 蒙在你脸上， 显出你的丑陋。

chapters.en: Your adulteries and lustful neighings, your shameless prostitution on the hills and in the fields— I have seen your detestable acts. Woe to you, O Jerusalem! How long will you remain unclean?”
chapters.zh: 你那些可憎恶之事－ 就是在田野的山上行奸淫， 发嘶声，做淫乱的事－ 我都看见了。 耶路撒冷啊，你有祸了！ 你不肯洁净，还要到几时呢？

chapters.en: This is the word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:
chapters.zh: 耶和华论到干旱〔之灾〕的话临到耶利米：

chapters.en: “Judah mourns and her gates languish. Her people wail for the land, and a cry goes up from Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 犹大悲哀，城门衰败。 众人披上黑衣坐在地上； 耶路撒冷的哀声上达。

chapters.en:
The nobles send their servants for water; they go to the cisterns, but find no water;
their jars return empty. They are ashamed and humiliated; they cover their heads.
chapters.zh: 他们的贵胄打发家僮打水； 他们来到水池， 见没有水，就拿着空器皿， 蒙羞惭愧，抱头而回。

chapters.en: The ground is cracked because no rain has fallen on the land. The farmers are ashamed; they cover their heads.
chapters.zh: 耕地的也蒙羞抱头； 因为无雨降在地上， 地都干裂。

chapters.en: Even the doe in the field deserts her newborn fawn because there is no grass.
chapters.zh: 田野的母鹿生下小鹿，就撇弃， 因为无草。

chapters.en:
Wild donkeys stand on barren heights; they pant for air like jackals;
their eyes fail for lack of pasture.”
chapters.zh: 野驴站在净光的高处，喘气好像野狗； 因为无草，眼目失明。

chapters.en: Although our iniquities testify against us, O LORD, act for the sake of Your name. Indeed, our rebellions are many; we have sinned against You.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我们的罪孽虽然作见证告我们， 还求你为你名的缘故行事。 我们本是多次背道，得罪了你。

chapters.en: O Hope of Israel, its Savior in times of distress, why are You like a stranger in the land, like a traveler who stays but a night?
chapters.zh: 以色列所盼望、在患难时作他救主的啊， 你为何在这地像寄居的， 又像行路的只住一宵呢？

chapters.en:
Why are You like a man taken by surprise, like a warrior powerless to save? Yet You are among us, O LORD, and we are called by Your name.
Do not forsake us!
chapters.zh: 你为何像受惊的人， 像不能救人的勇士呢？ 耶和华啊，你仍在我们中间； 我们也称为你名下的人， 求你不要离开我们。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says about this people:
“Truly they love to wander; they have not restrained their feet. So the LORD does not accept them; He will now remember their iniquity
and punish them for their sins.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对这百姓如此说： 这百姓喜爱妄行〔注：原文是飘流〕， 不禁止脚步， 所以耶和华不悦纳他们。 现今要记念他们的罪孽， 追讨他们的罪恶。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to me, “Do not pray for the well-being of this people.
chapters.zh: 耶和华又对我说：「不要为这百姓祈祷求好处。

chapters.en: Although they may fast, I will not listen to their cry; although they may offer burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them. Instead, I will finish them off by sword and famine and plague.”
chapters.zh: 他们禁食的时候，我不听他们的呼求；他们献燔祭和素祭，我也不悦纳；我却要用刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫灭绝他们。」

chapters.en: “Ah, Lord GOD!” I replied, “Look, the prophets are telling them, ‘You will not see the sword or suffer famine, but I will give you lasting peace in this place.’”
chapters.zh: 我就说：「唉！主耶和华啊，那些先知常对他们说：『你们必不看见刀剑，也不遭遇饥荒；耶和华要在这地方赐你们长久的平安。』」

chapters.en: “The prophets are prophesying lies in My name,” replied the LORD. “I did not send them or appoint them or speak to them. They are prophesying to you a false vision, a worthless divination, the futility and delusion of their own minds.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说：「那些先知讬我的名说假预言，我并没有打发他们，没有吩咐他们，也没有对他们说话；他们向你们预言的，乃是虚假的异象和占卜，并虚无的事，以及本心的诡诈。

chapters.en:
Therefore this is what the LORD says about the prophets who prophesy in My name: I did not send them, yet they say, ‘No sword or famine will touch this land.’
By sword and famine these very prophets will meet their end!
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华如此说：论到讬我名说预言的那些先知，我并没有打发他们；他们还说这地不能有刀剑饥荒，其实那些先知必被刀剑饥荒灭绝。

chapters.en: And the people to whom they prophesy will be thrown into the streets of Jerusalem because of famine and sword. There will be no one to bury them or their wives, their sons or their daughters. I will pour out their own evil upon them.
chapters.zh: 听他们说预言的百姓必因饥荒刀剑抛在耶路撒冷的街道上，无人葬埋。他们连妻子带儿女，都是如此。我必将他们的恶倒在他们身上〔注：或译：我必使他们罪恶的报应临到他们身上〕。」

chapters.en:
You are to speak this word to them:
‘My eyes overflow with tears; day and night they do not cease, for the virgin daughter of my people has been shattered by a crushing blow,
a severely grievous wound.
chapters.zh: 你要将这话对他们说： 愿我眼泪汪汪， 昼夜不息， 因为我百姓〔注：原文是民的处女〕受了裂口破坏的大伤。

chapters.en: If I go out to the country, I see those slain by the sword; if I enter the city, I see those ravaged by famine! For both prophet and priest travel to a land they do not know.’”
chapters.zh: 我若出往田间， 就见有被刀杀的； 我若进入城内， 就见有因饥荒患病的； 连先知带祭司在国中往来， 也是毫无知识〔注：或译：不知怎样才好〕。

chapters.en: Have You rejected Judah completely? Do You despise Zion? Why have You stricken us so that we are beyond healing? We hoped for peace, but no good has come, and for the time of healing, but there was only terror.
chapters.zh: 你全然弃掉犹大吗？ 你心厌恶锡安吗？ 为何击打我们，以致无法医治呢？ 我们指望平安，却得不着好处； 指望痊愈，不料，受了惊惶。

chapters.en:
We acknowledge our wickedness, O LORD, the guilt of our fathers;
indeed, we have sinned against You.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我们承认自己的罪恶， 和我们列祖的罪孽， 因我们得罪了你。

chapters.en: For the sake of Your name do not despise us; do not disgrace Your glorious throne. Remember Your covenant with us; do not break it.
chapters.zh: 求你为你名的缘故， 不厌恶我们， 不辱没你荣耀的宝座。 求你追念， 不要背了与我们所立的约。

chapters.en:
Can the worthless idols of the nations bring rain? Do the skies alone send showers? Is this not by You, O LORD our God? So we put our hope in You,
for You have done all these things.
chapters.zh: 外邦人虚无〔的神〕中有能降雨的吗？ 天能自降甘霖吗？ 耶和华－我们的上帝啊， 能如此的不是你吗？ 所以，我们仍要等候你， 因为这一切都是你所造的。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to me: “Even if Moses and Samuel should stand before Me, My heart would not go out to this people. Send them from My presence, and let them go!
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说：「虽有摩西和撒母耳站在我面前〔代求〕，我的心也不顾惜这百姓。你将他们从我眼前赶出，叫他们去吧！

chapters.en:
If they ask you, ‘Where shall we go?’ you are to tell them that this is what the LORD says:
‘Those destined for death, to death; those destined for the sword, to the sword; those destined for famine, to famine; and those destined for captivity, to captivity.’
chapters.zh: 他们问你说：『我们往哪里去呢？』你便告诉他们，耶和华如此说： 定为死亡的，必致死亡； 定为刀杀的，必交刀杀； 定为饥荒的，必遭饥荒； 定为掳掠的，必被掳掠。」

chapters.en: I will appoint over them four kinds of destroyers, declares the LORD: the sword to kill, the dogs to drag away, and the birds of the air and beasts of the earth to devour and destroy.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我命定四样害他们，就是刀剑杀戮、狗类撕裂、空中的飞鸟，和地上的野兽吞吃毁灭；

chapters.en: I will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth because of what Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah did in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 又必使他们在天下万国中抛来抛去，都因犹大王希西家的儿子玛拿西在耶路撒冷所行的事。」

chapters.en: Who will have pity on you, O Jerusalem? Who will mourn for you? Who will turn aside to ask about your welfare?
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，谁可怜你呢？ 谁为你悲伤呢？ 谁转身问你的安呢？

chapters.en:
You have forsaken Me, declares the LORD. You have turned your back. So I will stretch out My hand against you and I will destroy you;
I am weary of showing compassion.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：你弃绝了我， 转身退后； 因此我伸手攻击你，毁坏你。 我后悔甚不耐烦。

chapters.en: I will scatter them with a winnowing fork at the gates of the land. I will bereave and destroy My people who have not turned from their ways.
chapters.zh: 我在境内各城门口〔注：或译：我在这地边界的关口〕， 用簸箕簸了我的百姓， 使他们丧掉儿女。 我毁灭他们， 他们仍不转离所行的道。

chapters.en: I will make their widows more numerous than the sand of the sea. I will bring a destroyer at noon against the mothers of young men. I will suddenly bring upon them anguish and dismay.
chapters.zh: 他们的寡妇在我面前比海沙更多； 我使灭命的午间来， 攻击少年人的母亲， 使痛苦惊吓忽然临到她身上。

chapters.en: The mother of seven will grow faint; she will breathe her last breath. Her sun will set while it is still day; she will be disgraced and humiliated. And the rest I will put to the sword in the presence of their enemies,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 生过七子的妇人力衰气绝； 尚在白昼，日头忽落； 她抱愧蒙羞。 其余的人， 我必在他们敌人跟前，交与刀剑。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Woe to me, my mother, that you have borne me, a man of strife and conflict in all the land. I have neither lent nor borrowed, yet everyone curses me.
chapters.zh: 我的母亲哪，我有祸了！因你生我作为遍地相争相竞的人。我素来没有借贷与人，人也没有借贷与我，人人〔却〕都咒骂我。

chapters.en:
The LORD said:
“Surely I will deliver you for a good purpose; surely I will intercede with your enemy in your time of trouble, in your time of distress.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我必要坚固你，使你得好处。灾祸苦难临到的时候，我必要使仇敌央求你。

chapters.en: Can anyone smash iron— iron from the north—or bronze?
chapters.zh: （人岂能将铜与铁，就是北方的铁折断呢？）

chapters.en: Your wealth and your treasures I will give up as plunder, without charge for all your sins within all your borders.
chapters.zh: 「我必因你在四境之内所犯的一切罪，把你的货物财宝当掠物，白白地交给〔仇敌〕。

chapters.en: Then I will enslave you to your enemies in a land you do not know, for My anger will kindle a fire that will burn against you.”
chapters.zh: 我也必使仇敌带〔这掠物〕到你所不认识的地去，因我怒中起的火要将你们焚烧。」

chapters.en:
You understand, O LORD; remember me and attend to me. Avenge me against my persecutors. In Your patience, do not take me away.
Know that I endure reproach for Your honor.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你是知道的； 求你记念我，眷顾我， 向逼迫我的人为我报仇； 不要向他们忍怒取我〔的命〕， 要知道我为你的缘故受了凌辱。

chapters.en:
Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words became my joy
and my heart’s delight. For I bear Your name, O LORD God of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－万军之上帝啊， 我得着你的言语就〔当食物〕吃了； 你的言语是我心中的欢喜快乐， 因我是称为你名下的人。

chapters.en: I never sat with the band of revelers, nor did I celebrate with them. Because Your hand was on me, I sat alone, for You have filled me with indignation.
chapters.zh: 我没有坐在宴乐人的会中， 也没有欢乐； 我因你的感动〔注：原文是手〕独自静坐， 因你使我满心愤恨。

chapters.en:
Why is my pain unending, and my wound incurable,
refusing to be healed? You have indeed become like a mirage to me— water that is not there.
chapters.zh: 我的痛苦为何长久不止呢？ 我的伤痕为何无法医治、不能痊愈呢？ 难道你待我有诡诈，像流干的河道吗？

chapters.en:
Therefore this is what the LORD says:
“If you return, I will restore you; you will stand in My presence. And if you speak words that are noble instead of worthless, you will be My spokesman. It is they who must turn to you, but you must not turn to them.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：你若归回， 我就将你再带来， 使你站在我面前； 你若将宝贵的和下贱的分别出来， 你就可以当作我的口。 他们必归向你， 你却不可归向他们。

chapters.en: Then I will make you a wall to this people, a fortified wall of bronze; they will fight against you but will not overcome you, for I am with you to save and deliver you, declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必使你向这百姓成为坚固的铜墙； 他们必攻击你，却不能胜你； 因我与你同在，要拯救你，搭救你。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: I will deliver you from the hand of the wicked and redeem you from the grasp of the ruthless.”
chapters.zh: 我必搭救你脱离恶人的手， 救赎你脱离强暴人的手。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：

chapters.en: “You must not marry or have sons or daughters in this place.”
chapters.zh: 「你在这地方不可娶妻，生儿养女。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD says concerning the sons and daughters born in this place, and the mothers who bore them, and the fathers who fathered them in this land:
chapters.zh: 因为论到在这地方所生的儿女，又论到在这国中生养他们的父母，耶和华如此说：

chapters.en: “They will die from deadly diseases. They will not be mourned or buried, but will lie like dung on the ground. They will be finished off by sword and famine, and their corpses will become food for the birds of the air and beasts of the earth.”
chapters.zh: 他们必死得甚苦，无人哀哭，必不得葬埋，必在地上像粪土，必被刀剑和饥荒灭绝；他们的尸首必给空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽作食物。」

chapters.en: Indeed, this is what the LORD says: “Do not enter a house where there is a funeral meal. Do not go to mourn or show sympathy, for I have removed from this people My peace, My loving devotion, and My compassion,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：「不要进入丧家，不要去哀哭，也不要为他们悲伤，因我已将我的平安、慈爱、怜悯从这百姓夺去了。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Both great and small will die in this land. They will not be buried or mourned, nor will anyone cut himself or shave his head for them.
chapters.zh: 连大带小，都必在这地死亡，不得葬埋。人必不为他们哀哭，不用刀划身，也不使头光秃。

chapters.en: No food will be offered to comfort those who mourn the dead; not even a cup of consolation will be given for the loss of a father or mother.
chapters.zh: 他们有丧事，人必不为他们擘〔饼〕，因死人安慰他们；他们丧父丧母，人也不给他们一杯酒安慰他们。

chapters.en: You must not enter a house where there is feasting and sit down with them to eat and drink.
chapters.zh: 你不可进入宴乐的家，与他们同坐吃喝。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am going to remove from this place, before your very eyes and in your days, the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of the bride and bridegroom.
chapters.zh: 因为万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：你们还活着的日子在你们眼前，我必使欢喜和快乐的声音，新郎和新妇的声音，从这地方止息了。

chapters.en: When you tell these people all these things, they will ask you, ‘Why has the LORD pronounced all this great disaster against us? What is our iniquity? What is the sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?’
chapters.zh: 「你将这一切的话指示这百姓。他们问你说：『耶和华为什么说，要降这大灾祸攻击我们呢？我们有什么罪孽呢？我们向耶和华－我们的上帝犯了什么罪呢？』

chapters.en: Then you are to answer them: ‘It is because your fathers have forsaken Me, declares the LORD, and followed other gods, and served and worshiped them. They abandoned Me and did not keep My instruction.
chapters.zh: 你就对他们说：『耶和华说：因为你们列祖离弃我，随从别神，事奉敬拜，不遵守我的律法，

chapters.en: And you have done more evil than your fathers. See how each of you follows the stubbornness of his evil heart instead of obeying Me.
chapters.zh: 而且你们行恶比你们列祖更甚；因为各人随从自己顽梗的恶心行事，甚至不听从我，

chapters.en: So I will cast you out of this land into a land that neither you nor your fathers have known. There you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.’
chapters.zh: 所以我必将你们从这地赶出，直赶到你们和你们列祖素不认识的地。你们在那里必昼夜事奉别神，因为我必不向你们施恩。』」

chapters.en: Yet behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when they will no longer say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of Egypt.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「日子将到，人必不再指着那领以色列人从埃及地上来之永生的耶和华起誓，

chapters.en: Instead they will say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of the north and all the other lands to which He had banished them.’ For I will return them to their land that I gave to their forefathers.
chapters.zh: 却要指着那领以色列人从北方之地，并赶他们到的各国上来之永生的耶和华起誓，并且我要领他们再入我从前赐给他们列祖之地。」

chapters.en: But for now I will send for many fishermen, declares the LORD, and they will catch them. After that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them down on every mountain and hill, even from the clefts of the rocks.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我要召许多打鱼的把以色列人打上来，然后我要召许多打猎的，从各山上、各冈上、各石穴中猎取他们。

chapters.en: For My eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from My face, and their guilt is not concealed from My eyes.
chapters.zh: 因我的眼目察看他们的一切行为；他们不能在我面前遮掩，他们的罪孽也不能在我眼前隐藏。

chapters.en: And I will first repay them double their iniquity and their sin, because they have defiled My land with the carcasses of their detestable idols, and they have filled My inheritance with their abominations.”
chapters.zh: 我先要加倍报应他们的罪孽和罪恶；因为他们用可憎之尸玷污我的地土，又用可厌之物充满我的产业。」

chapters.en: O LORD, my strength and my fortress, my refuge in the day of distress, the nations will come to You from the ends of the earth, and they will say, “Our fathers inherited nothing but lies, worthless idols of no benefit at all.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你是我的力量， 是我的保障； 在苦难之日是我的避难所。 列国人必从地极来到你这里， 说：我们列祖所承受的， 不过是虚假，是虚空无益之物。

chapters.en: Can man make gods for himself? Such are not gods!”
chapters.zh: 人岂可为自己制造神呢？ 其实这不是神。

chapters.en:
“Therefore behold, I will inform them, and this time I will make them know
My power and My might; then they will know that My name is the LORD.
chapters.zh: 〔耶和华〕说：「我要使他们知道，就是这一次使他们知道我的手和我的能力。他们就知道我的名是耶和华了。」

chapters.en: “The sin of Judah is written with an iron stylus, engraved with a diamond point on the tablets of their hearts and on the horns of their altars.
chapters.zh: 犹大的罪是用铁笔、用金钢钻记录的，铭刻在他们的心版上和坛角上。

chapters.en: Even their children remember their altars and Asherah poles by the green trees and on the high hills.
chapters.zh: 他们的儿女记念他们高冈上、青翠树旁的坛和木偶。

chapters.en:
O My mountain in the countryside, I will give over your wealth
and all your treasures as plunder, because of the sin of your high places, within all your borders.
chapters.zh: 我田野的山哪，我必因你在四境之内所犯的罪，把你的货物、财宝，并邱坛当掠物交给〔仇敌〕；

chapters.en: And you yourself will relinquish the inheritance that I gave you. I will enslave you to your enemies in a land that you do not know, for you have kindled My anger; it will burn forever.”
chapters.zh: 并且你因自己〔的罪〕必失去我所赐给你的产业。我也必使你在你所不认识的地上服事你的仇敌；因为你使我怒中起火，直烧到永远。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind, who makes mere flesh his strength
and turns his heart from the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 倚靠人血肉的膀臂， 心中离弃耶和华的， 那人有祸了！

chapters.en: He will be like a shrub in the desert; he will not see when prosperity comes. He will dwell in the parched places of the desert, in a salt land where no one lives.
chapters.zh: 因他必像沙漠的杜松， 不见福乐来到， 却要住旷野干旱之处， 无人居住的碱地。

chapters.en: But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in Him.
chapters.zh: 倚靠耶和华、以耶和华为可靠的， 那人有福了！

chapters.en: He is like a tree planted by the waters that sends out its roots toward the stream. It does not fear when the heat comes, and its leaves are always green. It does not worry in a year of drought, nor does it cease to produce fruit.
chapters.zh: 他必像树栽于水旁， 在河边扎根， 炎热来到，并不惧怕， 叶子仍必青翠， 在干旱之年毫无挂虑， 而且结果不止。

chapters.en:
The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure.
Who can understand it?
chapters.zh: 人心比万物都诡诈， 坏到极处， 谁能识透呢？

chapters.en: I, the LORD, search the heart; I examine the mind to reward a man according to his way, by what his deeds deserve.
chapters.zh: 我－耶和华是鉴察人心、试验人肺腑的， 要照各人所行的和他做事的结果报应他。

chapters.en: Like a partridge hatching eggs it did not lay is the man who makes a fortune unjustly. In the middle of his days his riches will desert him, and in the end he will be the fool.”
chapters.zh: 那不按正道得财的， 好像鹧鸪菢不是自己下的〔蛋〕； 到了中年，那财都必离开他， 他终久成为愚顽人。

chapters.en: A glorious throne, exalted from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.
chapters.zh: 我们的圣所是荣耀的宝座， 从太初〔安置〕在高处。

chapters.en:
O LORD, the hope of Israel, all who abandon You will be put to shame. All who turn away will be written in the dust, for they have abandoned the LORD,
the fountain of living water.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－以色列的盼望啊， 凡离弃你的必致蒙羞。 〔耶和华说〕：离开我的， 他们的〔名字〕必写在土里， 因为他们离弃我这活水的泉源。

chapters.en:
Heal me, O LORD, and I will be healed; save me, and I will be saved,
for You are my praise.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你医治我，我便痊愈， 拯救我，我便得救； 因你是我所赞美的。

chapters.en:
Behold, they keep saying to me, “Where is the word of the LORD?
Let it come now!”
chapters.zh: 他们对我说：耶和华的话在哪里呢？ 叫这话应验吧！

chapters.en: But I have not run away from being Your shepherd; I have not desired the day of despair. You know that the utterance of my lips was spoken in Your presence.
chapters.zh: 至于我，那跟从你作牧人〔的职分〕， 我并没有急忙离弃， 也没有想那灾殃的日子； 这是你知道的。 我口中所出的言语都在你面前。

chapters.en: Do not become a terror to me; You are my refuge in the day of disaster.
chapters.zh: 不要使我因你惊恐； 当灾祸的日子，你是我的避难所。

chapters.en: Let my persecutors be put to shame, but do not let me be put to shame. Let them be terrified, but do not let me be terrified. Bring upon them the day of disaster and shatter them with double destruction.
chapters.zh: 愿那些逼迫我的蒙羞， 却不要使我蒙羞； 使他们惊惶， 却不要使我惊惶； 使灾祸的日子临到他们， 以加倍的毁坏毁坏他们。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD said to me: “Go and stand at the gate of the people, through which the kings of Judah go in and out; and stand at all the other gates of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我如此说：「你去站在平民的门口，就是犹大君王出入的门，又站在耶路撒冷的各门口，

chapters.en: Say to them, ‘Hear the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, all people of Judah and Jerusalem who enter through these gates.
chapters.zh: 对他们说：『你们这犹大君王和犹大众人，并耶路撒冷的一切居民，凡从这些门进入的都当听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: Take heed for yourselves; do not carry a load or bring it through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：你们要谨慎，不要在安息日担什么担子进入耶路撒冷的各门；

chapters.en: You must not carry a load out of your houses or do any work on the Sabbath day, but you must keep the Sabbath day holy, just as I commanded your forefathers.
chapters.zh: 也不要在安息日从家中担出担子去。无论何工都不可做，只要以安息日为圣日，正如我所吩咐你们列祖的。』

chapters.en: Yet they would not listen or incline their ear, but they stiffened their necks and would not listen or receive My discipline.
chapters.zh: 他们却不听从，不侧耳而听，竟硬着颈项不听，不受教训。」

chapters.en: If, however, you listen carefully to Me, says the LORD, and bring no load through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, and keep the Sabbath day holy, and do no work on it,
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「你们若留意听从我，在安息日不担什么担子进入这城的各门，只以安息日为圣日，在那日无论何工都不做；

chapters.en: then kings and princes will enter through the gates of this city. They will sit on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses with their officials, along with the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem, and this city will be inhabited forever.
chapters.zh: 那时就有坐大卫宝座的君王和首领，他们与犹大人，并耶路撒冷的居民，或坐车，或骑马，进入这城的各门，而且这城必存到永远。

chapters.en: And people will come from the cities of Judah and the places around Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin, and from the foothills, the hill country, and the Negev, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifices, grain offerings and frankincense, and thank offerings to the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 也必有人从犹大城邑和耶路撒冷四围的各处，从便雅悯地、高原、山地，并南地而来，都带燔祭、〔平安祭〕、素祭，和乳香，并感谢〔祭〕，到耶和华的殿去。

chapters.en: But if you do not listen to Me to keep the Sabbath day holy by not carrying a load while entering the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle an unquenchable fire in its gates to consume the citadels of Jerusalem.’”
chapters.zh: 你们若不听从我，不以安息日为圣日，仍在安息日担担子，进入耶路撒冷的各门，我必在各门中点火；这火也必烧毁耶路撒冷的宫殿，不能熄灭。」

chapters.en: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说：

chapters.en: “Go down at once to the potter’s house, and there I will give you My message.”
chapters.zh: 「你起来，下到窑匠的家里去，我在那里要使你听我的话。」

chapters.en: So I went down to the potter’s house and saw him working at the wheel.
chapters.zh: 我就下到窑匠的家里去，正遇他转轮做器皿。

chapters.en: But the vessel that he was shaping from the clay became flawed in his hand; so he formed it into another vessel, as it seemed best for him to do.
chapters.zh: 窑匠用泥做的器皿，在他手中做坏了，他又用这泥另做别的器皿；窑匠看怎样好，就怎样做。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话就临到我说：

chapters.en: “O house of Israel, declares the LORD, can I not treat you as this potter treats his clay? Just like clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in My hand, O house of Israel.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华说：以色列家啊，我待你们，岂不能照这窑匠弄泥吗？以色列家啊，泥在窑匠的手中怎样，你们在我的手中也怎样。

chapters.en: At any time I might announce that a nation or kingdom will be uprooted, torn down, and destroyed.
chapters.zh: 我何时论到一邦或一国说，要拔出、拆毁、毁坏；

chapters.en: But if that nation I warned turns from its evil, then I will relent of the disaster I had planned to bring.
chapters.zh: 我所说的那一邦，若是转意离开他们的恶，我就必后悔，不将我想要施行的灾祸降与他们。

chapters.en: And if at another time I announce that I will build up and establish a nation or kingdom,
chapters.zh: 我何时论到一邦或一国说，要建立、栽植；

chapters.en: and if it does evil in My sight and does not listen to My voice, then I will relent of the good I had intended for it.
chapters.zh: 他们若行我眼中看为恶的事，不听从我的话，我就必后悔，不将我所说的福气赐给他们。

chapters.en: Now therefore, tell the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem that this is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I am planning a disaster for you and devising a plan against you. Turn now, each of you, from your evil ways, and correct your ways and deeds.’
chapters.zh: 现在你要对犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民说：『耶和华如此说：我造出灾祸攻击你们，定意刑罚你们。你们各人当回头离开所行的恶道，改正你们的行动作为。』

chapters.en: But they will reply, ‘It is hopeless. We will follow our own plans, and each of us will act according to the stubbornness of his evil heart.’”
chapters.zh: 「他们却说：『这是枉然。我们要照自己的计谋去行。』各人随自己顽梗的恶心做事。」

chapters.en:
Therefore this is what the LORD says:
“Inquire among the nations: Who has ever heard things like these?
Virgin Israel has done a most terrible thing.
chapters.zh: 所以，耶和华如此说： 你们且往各国访问， 有谁听见这样的事？ 以色列民〔注：原文是处女〕行了一件极可憎恶的事。

chapters.en: Does the snow of Lebanon ever leave its rocky slopes? Or do its cool waters flowing from a distance ever run dry?
chapters.zh: 黎巴嫩的雪从田野的磐石上岂能断绝呢？ 从远处流下的凉水岂能干涸呢？

chapters.en:
Yet My people have forgotten Me. They burn incense to worthless idols
that make them stumble in their ways, leaving the ancient roads to walk on rutted bypaths
instead of on the highway.
chapters.zh: 我的百姓竟忘记我， 向假〔神〕烧香， 使他们在所行的路上，在古道上绊跌， 使他们行没有修筑的斜路，

chapters.en: They have made their land a desolation, a perpetual object of scorn; all who pass by will be appalled and shake their heads.
chapters.zh: 以致他们的地令人惊骇， 常常嗤笑； 凡经过这地的必惊骇摇头。

chapters.en: I will scatter them before the enemy like the east wind. I will show them My back and not My face in the day of their calamity.”
chapters.zh: 我必在仇敌面前分散他们， 好像用东风吹散一样。 遭难的日子，我必以背向他们， 不以面向他们。

chapters.en: Then some said, “Come, let us make plans against Jeremiah, for the law will never be lost to the priest, nor counsel to the wise, nor an oracle to the prophet. Come, let us denounce him and pay no heed to any of his words.”
chapters.zh: 他们就说：「来吧！我们可以设计谋害耶利米；因为我们有祭司讲律法，智慧人设谋略，先知说预言，都不能断绝。来吧！我们可以用舌头击打他，不要理会他的一切话。」

chapters.en: Attend to me, O LORD. Hear what my accusers are saying!
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你理会我， 且听那些与我争竞之人的话。

chapters.en:
Should good be repaid with evil? Yet they have dug a pit for me. Remember how I stood before You to speak good on their behalf,
to turn Your wrath from them.
chapters.zh: 岂可以恶报善呢？ 他们竟挖坑要害我的性命！ 求你记念我怎样站在你面前为他们代求， 要使你的忿怒向他们转消。

chapters.en:
Therefore, hand their children over to famine; pour out the power of the sword upon them. Let their wives become childless and widowed; let their husbands be slain by disease,
their young men struck down by the sword in battle.
chapters.zh: 故此，愿你将他们的儿女交与饥荒和刀剑； 愿他们的妻无子，且作寡妇； 又愿他们的男人被死亡所灭， 他们的少年人在阵上被刀击杀。

chapters.en: Let a cry be heard from their houses when You suddenly bring raiders against them, for they have dug a pit to capture me and have hidden snares for my feet.
chapters.zh: 你使敌军忽然临到他们的时候， 愿人听见哀声从他们的屋内发出； 因他们挖坑要捉拿我， 暗设网罗要绊我的脚。

chapters.en:
But You, O LORD, know all their deadly plots against me. Do not wipe out their guilt
or blot out their sin from Your sight. Let them be overthrown before You; deal with them in the time of Your anger.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，他们要杀我的那一切计谋， 你都知道。 不要赦免他们的罪孽， 也不要从你面前涂抹他们的罪恶， 要叫他们在你面前跌倒； 愿你发怒的时候罚办他们。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “Go and buy a clay jar from a potter. Take some of the elders of the people and leaders of the priests,
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：「你去买窑匠的瓦瓶，又带百姓中的长老和祭司中的长老，

chapters.en:
and go out to the Valley of Ben-hinnom near the entrance of the Potsherd Gate.
Proclaim there the words I speak to you,
chapters.zh: 出去到欣嫩子谷、哈珥西〔注：就是瓦片的意思〕的门口那里，宣告我所吩咐你的话，

chapters.en: saying, ‘Hear the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah and residents of Jerusalem. This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am going to bring such disaster on this place that the ears of all who hear of it will ring,
chapters.zh: 说：『犹大君王和耶路撒冷的居民哪，当听耶和华的话。万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：我必使灾祸临到这地方，凡听见的人都必耳鸣；

chapters.en: because they have abandoned Me and made this a foreign place. They have burned incense in this place to other gods that neither they nor their fathers nor the kings of Judah have ever known. They have filled this place with the blood of the innocent.
chapters.zh: 因为他们和他们列祖，并犹大君王离弃我，将这地方看为平常，在这里向素不认识的别神烧香，又使这地方满了无辜人的血，

chapters.en: They have built high places to Baal on which to burn their children in the fire as offerings to Baal—something I never commanded or mentioned, nor did it even enter My mind.
chapters.zh: 又建筑巴力的邱坛，好在火中焚烧自己的儿子，作为燔祭献给巴力。这不是我所吩咐的，不是我所提说的，也不是我心所起的意。

chapters.en: So behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when this place will no longer be called Topheth or the Valley of Ben-hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：因此，日子将到，这地方不再称为陀斐特和欣嫩子谷，反倒称为杀戮谷。

chapters.en: And in this place I will ruin the plans of Judah and Jerusalem. I will make them fall by the sword before their enemies, by the hands of those who seek their lives, and I will give their carcasses as food to the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth.
chapters.zh: 我必在这地方使犹大和耶路撒冷的计谋落空，也必使他们在仇敌面前倒于刀下，并寻索其命的人手下。他们的尸首，我必给空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽作食物。

chapters.en: I will make this city a desolation and an object of scorn. All who pass by will be appalled and will scoff at all her wounds.
chapters.zh: 我必使这城令人惊骇嗤笑；凡经过的人，必因这城所遭的灾惊骇嗤笑。

chapters.en: I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and daughters, and they will eat one another’s flesh in the siege and distress inflicted on them by their enemies who seek their lives.’
chapters.zh: 我必使他们在围困窘迫之中，就是仇敌和寻索其命的人窘迫他们的时候，各人吃自己儿女的肉和朋友的肉。』

chapters.en: Then you are to shatter the jar in the presence of the men who accompany you,
chapters.zh: 「你要在同去的人眼前打碎那瓶，

chapters.en: and you are to proclaim to them that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: I will shatter this nation and this city, like one shatters a potter’s jar that can never again be repaired. They will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room to bury them.
chapters.zh: 对他们说：『万军之耶和华如此说：我要照样打碎这民和这城，正如人打碎窑匠的瓦器，以致不能再囫囵。并且人要在陀斐特葬埋〔尸首〕，甚至无处可葬。

chapters.en: This is what I will do to this place and to its residents, declares the LORD. I will make this city like Topheth.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：我必向这地方和其中的居民如此行，使这城与陀斐特一样。

chapters.en: The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah will be defiled like that place, Topheth—all the houses on whose rooftops they burned incense to all the host of heaven and poured out drink offerings to other gods.”
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷的房屋和犹大君王的宫殿是已经被玷污的，就是他们在其上向天上的万象烧香、向别神浇奠祭的宫殿房屋，都必与陀斐特一样。』」

chapters.en: Then Jeremiah returned from Topheth, where the LORD had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the courtyard of the house of the LORD and proclaimed to all the people,
chapters.zh: 耶利米从陀斐特－就是耶和华差他去说预言的地方－回来，站在耶和华殿的院中，对众人说：

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I am about to bring on this city and on all the villages around it every disaster I have pronounced against them, because they have stiffened their necks so as not to heed My words.’”
chapters.zh: 「万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：我必使我所说的一切灾祸临到这城和属城的一切城邑，因为他们硬着颈项不听我的话。」

chapters.en: When Pashhur the priest, the son of Immer and the chief official in the house of the LORD, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things,
chapters.zh: 祭司音麦的儿子巴施户珥作耶和华殿的总管，听见耶利米预言这些事，

chapters.en: he had Jeremiah the prophet beaten and put in the stocks at the Upper Gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他就打先知耶利米，用耶和华殿里便雅悯高门内的枷，将他枷在那里。

chapters.en: The next day, when Pashhur released Jeremiah from the stocks, Jeremiah said to him, “The LORD does not call you Pashhur, but Magor-missabib.
chapters.zh: 次日，巴施户珥将耶利米开枷释放。于是耶利米对他说：「耶和华不是叫你的名为巴施户珥，乃是叫你玛歌珥‧米撒毕〔注：就是四面惊吓的意思〕，

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD says: ‘I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends. They will fall by the sword of their enemies before your very eyes. And I will hand Judah over to the king of Babylon, and he will carry them away to Babylon and put them to the sword.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华如此说：『我必使你自觉惊吓，你也必使众朋友惊吓；他们必倒在仇敌的刀下，你也必亲眼看见；我必将犹大人全交在巴比伦王的手中，他要将他们掳到巴比伦去，也要用刀将他们杀戮。

chapters.en: I will give away all the wealth of this city—all its products and valuables, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah—to their enemies. They will plunder them, seize them, and carry them off to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 并且我要将这城中的一切货财和劳碌得来的，并一切珍宝，以及犹大君王所有的宝物，都交在他们仇敌的手中；仇敌要当作掠物带到巴比伦去。

chapters.en: And you, Pashhur, and all who live in your house, will go into captivity. You will go to Babylon, and there you will die and be buried—you and all your friends to whom you have prophesied these lies.’”
chapters.zh: 你这巴施户珥和一切住在你家中的人都必被掳去；你和你的众朋友，就是你向他们说假预言的，都必到巴比伦去，要死在那里，葬在那里。』」

chapters.en: You have deceived me, O LORD, and I was deceived. You have overcome me and prevailed. I am a laughingstock all day long; everyone mocks me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你曾劝导我， 我也听了你的劝导。 你比我有力量，且胜了我。 我终日成为笑话， 人人都戏弄我。

chapters.en: For whenever I speak, I cry out; I proclaim violence and destruction. For the word of the LORD has become to me a reproach and derision all day long.
chapters.zh: 我每逢讲论的时候，就发出哀声， 我喊叫说：有强暴和毁灭！ 因为耶和华的话终日成了我的凌辱、讥刺。

chapters.en: If I say, “I will not mention Him or speak any more in His name,” His message becomes a fire burning in my heart, shut up in my bones, and I become weary of holding it in, and I cannot prevail.
chapters.zh: 我若说：我不再提耶和华， 也不再奉他的名讲论， 我便心里觉得 似乎有烧着的火闭塞在我骨中， 我就含忍不住，不能自禁。

chapters.en:
For I have heard the whispering of many: “Terror is on every side!
Report him; let us report him!” All my trusted friends watch for my fall: “Perhaps he will be deceived so that we may prevail against him
and take our vengeance upon him.”
chapters.zh: 我听见了许多人的谗谤， 四围都是惊吓； 就是我知己的朋友也都窥探我， 愿我跌倒，〔说〕： 告他吧，我们也要告他！ 或者他被引诱， 我们就能胜他， 在他身上报仇。

chapters.en: But the LORD is with me like a fearsome warrior. Therefore, my persecutors will stumble and will not prevail. Since they have not succeeded, they will be utterly put to shame, with an everlasting disgrace that will never be forgotten.
chapters.zh: 然而，耶和华与我同在， 好像甚可怕的勇士。 因此，逼迫我的必都绊跌， 不能得胜； 他们必大大蒙羞， 就是受永不忘记的羞辱， 因为他们行事没有智慧。

chapters.en: O LORD of Hosts, who examines the righteous, who sees the heart and mind, let me see Your vengeance upon them, for to You I have committed my cause.
chapters.zh: 试验义人、察看人肺腑心肠的万军之耶和华啊， 求你容我见你在他们身上报仇， 因我将我的案件向你禀明了。

chapters.en: Sing to the LORD! Praise the LORD! For He rescues the life of the needy from the hands of evildoers.
chapters.zh: 你们要向耶和华唱歌； 赞美耶和华！ 因他救了穷人的性命脱离恶人的手。

chapters.en: Cursed be the day I was born! May the day my mother bore me never be blessed.
chapters.zh: 愿我生的那日受咒诅； 愿我母亲产我的那日不蒙福！

chapters.en:
Cursed be the man who brought my father the news, saying, “A son is born to you,”
bringing him great joy.
chapters.zh: 给我父亲报信说「你得了儿子」， 使我父亲甚欢喜的， 愿那人受咒诅。

chapters.en: May that man be like the cities that the LORD overthrew without compassion. May he hear an outcry in the morning and a battle cry at noon,
chapters.zh: 愿那人像耶和华所倾覆而不后悔的城邑； 愿他早晨听见哀声， 晌午听见吶喊；

chapters.en:
because he did not kill me in the womb so that my mother might have been my grave,
and her womb forever enlarged.
chapters.zh: 因他在我未出胎的时候不杀我， 使我母亲成了我的坟墓， 胎就时常重大。

chapters.en:
Why did I come out of the womb to see only trouble and sorrow,
and to end my days in shame?
chapters.zh: 我为何出胎见劳碌愁苦， 使我的年日因羞愧消灭呢？

chapters.en: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur son of Malchijah and the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. They said,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米。那时，西底家王打发玛基雅的儿子巴施户珥和玛西雅的儿子祭司西番雅去见耶利米，说：

chapters.en: “Please inquire of the LORD on our behalf, since Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is waging war against us. Perhaps the LORD will perform for us something like all His past wonders, so that Nebuchadnezzar will withdraw from us.”
chapters.zh: 「请你为我们求问耶和华；因为巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来攻击我们，或者耶和华照他一切奇妙的作为待我们，使巴比伦王离开我们上去。」

chapters.en: But Jeremiah answered, “You are to tell Zedekiah that
chapters.zh: 耶利米对他们说：「你们当对西底家这样说：

chapters.en: this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I will turn against you the weapons of war in your hands, with which you are fighting the king of Babylon and the Chaldeans who besiege you outside the wall, and I will assemble their forces in the center of this city.
chapters.zh: 『耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：我要使你们手中的兵器，就是你们在城外与巴比伦王和围困你们的迦勒底人打仗的兵器翻转过来，又要使这些都聚集在这城中。

chapters.en: And I Myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and a mighty arm, with anger, fury, and great wrath.
chapters.zh: 并且我要在怒气、忿怒，和大恼恨中，用伸出来的手，并大能的膀臂，亲自攻击你们；

chapters.en: I will strike down the residents of this city, both man and beast. They will die in a terrible plague.’
chapters.zh: 又要击打这城的居民，连人带牲畜都必遭遇大瘟疫死亡。

chapters.en: ‘After that,’ declares the LORD, ‘I will hand over Zedekiah king of Judah, his officers, and the people in this city who survive the plague and sword and famine, to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and to their enemies who seek their lives. He will put them to the sword; he will not spare them or show pity or compassion.’
chapters.zh: 以后我要将犹大王西底家和他的臣仆百姓，就是在城内，从瘟疫、刀剑、饥荒中剩下的人，都交在巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中和他们仇敌，并寻索其命的人手中。巴比伦王必用刀击杀他们，不顾惜，不可怜，不怜悯。这是耶和华说的。』

chapters.en: Furthermore, you are to tell this people that this is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.
chapters.zh: 「你要对这百姓说：『耶和华如此说：看哪，我将生命的路和死亡的路摆在你们面前。

chapters.en: Whoever stays in this city will die by sword and famine and plague, but whoever goes out and surrenders to the Chaldeans who besiege you will live; he will retain his life like a spoil of war.
chapters.zh: 住在这城里的必遭刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫而死；但出去归降围困你们迦勒底人的必得存活，要以自己的命为掠物。

chapters.en: For I have set My face against this city to bring disaster and not good, declares the LORD. It will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, who will destroy it with fire.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：我向这城变脸，降祸不降福；这城必交在巴比伦王的手中，他必用火焚烧。』」

chapters.en: Moreover, tell the house of the king of Judah to hear the word of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 「至于犹大王的家，你们当听耶和华的话。

chapters.en:
O house of David, this is what the LORD says:
‘Administer justice every morning, and rescue the victim of robbery from the hand of his oppressor, or My wrath will go forth like fire and burn with no one to extinguish it because of their evil deeds.
chapters.zh: 大卫家啊，耶和华如此说： 你们每早晨要施行公平， 拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手， 恐怕我的忿怒因你们的恶行发作， 如火着起，甚至无人能以熄灭。

chapters.en:
Behold, I am against you who dwell above the valley, atop the rocky plateau—
declares the LORD— you who say, “Who can come against us? Who can enter our dwellings?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：住山谷和平原磐石上的居民， 你们说：谁能下来攻击我们？ 谁能进入我们的住处呢？ 看哪，我与你们为敌。

chapters.en: I will punish you as your deeds deserve, declares the LORD. I will kindle a fire in your forest that will consume everything around you.’”
chapters.zh: 耶和华又说： 我必按你们做事的结果刑罚你们； 我也必使火在耶路撒冷的林中着起， 将她四围所有的尽行烧灭。」

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “Go down to the palace of the king of Judah and proclaim this message there,
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：「你下到犹大王的宫中，在那里说这话，

chapters.en: saying, ‘Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, who sits on the throne of David—you and your officials and your people who enter these gates.
chapters.zh: 说：『坐大卫宝座的犹大王啊，你和你的臣仆，并进入城门的百姓，都当听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: Administer justice and righteousness. Rescue the victim of robbery from the hand of his oppressor. Do no wrong or violence to the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow. Do not shed innocent blood in this place.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手，不可亏负寄居的和孤儿寡妇，不可以强暴待他们，在这地方也不可流无辜人的血。

chapters.en: For if you will indeed carry out these commands, then kings who sit on David’s throne will enter through the gates of this palace riding on chariots and horses—they and their officials and their people.
chapters.zh: 你们若认真行这事，就必有坐大卫宝座的君王和他的臣仆百姓，或坐车或骑马，从这城的各门进入。

chapters.en: But if you do not obey these words, then I swear by Myself, declares the LORD, that this house will become a pile of rubble.’”
chapters.zh: 你们若不听这些话，耶和华说：我指着自己起誓，这城必变为荒场。』

chapters.en:
For this is what the LORD says concerning the house of the king of Judah:
“You are like Gilead to Me, like the summit of Lebanon; but I will surely turn you into a desert, like cities that are uninhabited.
chapters.zh: 耶和华论到犹大王的家如此说： 我看你如基列， 如黎巴嫩顶； 然而，我必使你变为旷野， 为无人居住的城邑。

chapters.en: I will appoint destroyers against you, each man with his weapons, and they will cut down the choicest of your cedars and throw them into the fire.
chapters.zh: 我要预备行毁灭的人， 各拿器械攻击你； 他们要砍下你佳美的香柏树， 扔在火中。

chapters.en: And many nations will pass by this city and ask one another, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this great city?’
chapters.zh: 「许多国的民要经过这城，各人对邻舍说：『耶和华为何向这大城如此行呢？』

chapters.en: Then people will reply, ‘Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD their God and have worshiped and served other gods.’”
chapters.zh: 他们必回答说：『是因离弃了耶和华－他们上帝的约，事奉敬拜别神。』」

chapters.en:
Do not weep for him who is dead; do not mourn his loss. Weep bitterly for him who is exiled, for he will never return
to see his native land.
chapters.zh: 不要为死人哭号； 不要为他悲伤， 却要为离家出外的人大大哭号； 因为他不得再回来， 也不得再见他的本国。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD says concerning Shallum son of Josiah, king of Judah, who succeeded his father Josiah but has gone forth from this place: “He will never return,
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华论到从这地方出去的犹大王约西亚的儿子沙龙〔注：在列王下二十三章三十节名约哈斯〕，就是接续他父亲约西亚作王的，这样说：「他必不得再回到这里来，

chapters.en: but he will die in the place to which he was exiled; he will never see this land again.”
chapters.zh: 却要死在被掳去的地方，必不得再见这地。」

chapters.en: “Woe to him who builds his palace by unrighteousness, and his upper rooms without justice, who makes his countrymen serve without pay, and fails to pay their wages,
chapters.zh: 那行不义盖房、行不公造楼、 白白使用人的手工不给工价的有祸了！

chapters.en:
who says, ‘I will build myself a great palace, with spacious upper rooms.’ So he cuts windows in it, panels it with cedar,
and paints it with vermilion.
chapters.zh: 他说：我要为自己盖广大的房、宽敞的楼， 为自己开窗户。 这楼房的护墙板是香柏木的， 楼房是丹色油漆的。

chapters.en: Does it make you a king to excel in cedar? Did not your father have food and drink? He administered justice and righteousness, and so it went well with him.
chapters.zh: 难道你作王是在乎〔造〕香柏木〔楼房〕争胜吗？ 你的父亲岂不是也吃也喝、 也施行公平和公义吗？ 那时他得了福乐。

chapters.en: He took up the cause of the poor and needy, and so it went well with him. Is this not what it means to know Me?” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他为困苦和穷乏人伸冤， 那时就得了福乐。 认识我不在乎此吗？ 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “But your eyes and heart are set on nothing except your own dishonest gain, on shedding innocent blood, on practicing extortion and oppression.”
chapters.zh: 惟有你的眼和你的心专顾贪婪， 流无辜人的血， 行欺压和强暴。

chapters.en:
Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:
“They will not mourn for him: ‘Alas, my brother! Alas, my sister!’ They will not mourn for him: ‘Alas, my master! Alas, his splendor!’
chapters.zh: 所以，耶和华论到犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬如此说： 人必不为他举哀〔说〕： 哀哉！我的哥哥； 或说：哀哉！我的姊姊； 也不为他举哀〔说〕： 哀哉！我的主； 或说：哀哉！我主的荣华。

chapters.en: He will be buried like a donkey, dragged away and thrown outside the gates of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 他被埋葬，好像埋驴一样， 要拉出去扔在耶路撒冷的城门之外。

chapters.en: Go up to Lebanon and cry out; raise your voice in Bashan; cry out from Abarim, for all your lovers have been crushed.
chapters.zh: 你要上黎巴嫩哀号， 在巴珊扬声， 从亚巴琳哀号， 因为你所亲爱的都毁灭了。

chapters.en: I warned you when you were secure. You said, ‘I will not listen.’ This has been your way from youth, that you have not obeyed My voice.
chapters.zh: 你兴盛的时候，我对你说话； 你却说：我不听。 你自幼年以来总是这样， 不听从我的话。

chapters.en: The wind will drive away all your shepherds, and your lovers will go into captivity. Then you will be ashamed and humiliated because of all your wickedness.
chapters.zh: 你的牧人要被风吞吃， 你所亲爱的必被掳去； 那时你必因你一切的恶抱愧蒙羞。

chapters.en: O inhabitant of Lebanon, nestled in the cedars, how you will groan when pangs of anguish come upon you, agony like a woman in labor.”
chapters.zh: 你这住黎巴嫩、在香柏树上搭窝的， 有痛苦临到你， 好像疼痛临到产难的妇人， 那时你何等可怜！

chapters.en: “As surely as I live,” declares the LORD, “even if you, Coniah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, were a signet ring on My right hand, I would pull you off.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「犹大王约雅敬的儿子哥尼雅〔注：又名耶哥尼雅；下同〕，虽是我右手上带印的戒指，我凭我的永生起誓，也必将你从其上摘下来，

chapters.en: In fact, I will hand you over to those you dread, who want to take your life—to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and to the Chaldeans.
chapters.zh: 并且我必将你交给寻索你命的人和你所惧怕的人手中，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒和迦勒底人的手中。

chapters.en: I will hurl you and the mother who gave you birth into another land, where neither of you were born—and there you both will die.
chapters.zh: 我也必将你和生你的母亲赶到别国，并不是你们生的地方；你们必死在那里，

chapters.en: You will never return to the land for which you long.”
chapters.zh: 但心中甚想归回之地，必不得归回。」

chapters.en: Is this man Coniah a despised and shattered pot, a jar that no one wants? Why are he and his descendants hurled out and cast into a land they do not know?
chapters.zh: 哥尼雅这人是被轻看、破坏的器皿吗？ 是无人喜爱的器皿吗？ 他和他的后裔为何被赶到不认识之地呢？

chapters.en: O land, land, land, hear the word of the LORD!
chapters.zh: 地啊，地啊，地啊，当听耶和华的话！

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“Enroll this man as childless, a man who will not prosper in his lifetime. None of his descendants will prosper to sit on the throne of David
or to rule again in Judah.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 要写明这人算为无子， 是平生不得亨通的； 因为他后裔中再无一人得亨通， 能坐在大卫的宝座上治理犹大。

chapters.en: “Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of My pasture!” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「那些残害、赶散我草场之羊的牧人有祸了！」

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says about the shepherds who tend My people: “You have scattered My flock and driven them away, and have not attended to them. Behold, I will attend to you for the evil of your deeds, declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－以色列的上帝斥责那些牧养他百姓的牧人，如此说：「你们赶散我的羊群，并没有看顾他们；我必讨你们这行恶的罪。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Then I Myself will gather the remnant of My flock from all the lands to which I have banished them, and I will return them to their pasture, where they will be fruitful and multiply.
chapters.zh: 我要将我羊群中所余剩的，从我赶他们到的各国内招聚出来，领他们归回本圈；他们也必生养众多。

chapters.en: I will raise up shepherds over them who will tend them, and they will no longer be afraid or dismayed, nor will any go missing, declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必设立照管他们的牧人，牧养他们。他们不再惧怕，不再惊惶，也不缺少一个；这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch, and He will reign wisely as King and will administer justice and righteousness in the land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「日子将到，我要给大卫兴起一个公义的苗裔；他必掌王权，行事有智慧，在地上施行公平和公义。

chapters.en: In His days Judah will be saved, and Israel will dwell securely. And this is His name by which He will be called: The LORD Our Righteousness.
chapters.zh: 在他的日子，犹大必得救，以色列也安然居住。他的名必称为『耶和华－我们的义』。」
