chapters.en: So behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when they will no longer say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of Egypt.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「日子将到，人必不再指着那领以色列人从埃及地上来永生的耶和华起誓，

chapters.en: Instead they will say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought and led the descendants of the house of Israel up out of the land of the north and all the other lands to which He had banished them.’ Then they will dwell once more in their own land.”
chapters.zh: 却要指着那领以色列家的后裔从北方和赶他们到的各国中上来、永生的耶和华起誓。他们必住在本地。」

chapters.en:
As for the prophets:
My heart is broken within me, and all my bones tremble. I have become like a drunkard, like a man overcome by wine, because of the LORD, because of His holy words.
chapters.zh: 论到那些先知， 我心在我里面忧伤， 我骨头都发颤； 因耶和华和他的圣言， 我像醉酒的人， 像被酒所胜的人。

chapters.en:
For the land is full of adulterers— because of the curse, the land mourns
and the pastures of the wilderness have dried up— their course is evil and their power is misused.
chapters.zh: 地满了行淫的人！ 因妄自赌咒，地就悲哀； 旷野的草场都枯干了。 他们所行的道乃是恶的； 他们的勇力使得不正。

chapters.en: “For both prophet and priest are ungodly; even in My house I have found their wickedness,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 连先知带祭司都是亵渎的， 就是在我殿中我也看见他们的恶。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Therefore their path will become slick; they will be driven away into the darkness and fall into it. For I will bring disaster upon them in the year of their punishment,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 因此，他们的道路必像黑暗中的滑地， 他们必被追赶，在这路中仆倒； 因为当追讨之年， 我必使灾祸临到他们。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Among the prophets of Samaria I saw an offensive thing: They prophesied by Baal and led My people Israel astray.
chapters.zh: 我在撒马利亚的先知中曾见愚妄； 他们藉巴力说预言， 使我的百姓以色列走错了路。

chapters.en: And among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen a horrible thing: They commit adultery and walk in lies. They strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that no one turns his back on wickedness. They are all like Sodom to Me; the people of Jerusalem are like Gomorrah.”
chapters.zh: 我在耶路撒冷的先知中曾见可憎恶的事； 他们行奸淫，做事虚妄， 又坚固恶人的手， 甚至无人回头离开他的恶。 他们在我面前都像所多玛； 耶路撒冷的居民都像蛾摩拉。

chapters.en:
Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts says concerning the prophets:
“I will feed them wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink, for from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has spread throughout the land.”
chapters.zh: 所以万军之耶和华论到先知如此说： 我必将茵蔯给他们吃， 又将苦胆水给他们喝； 因为亵渎的事出于耶路撒冷的先知，流行遍地。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD of Hosts says:
“Do not listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you. They are filling you with false hopes. They speak visions from their own minds, not from the mouth of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「这些先知向你们说预言，你们不要听他们的话。他们以虚空教训你们，所说的异象是出于自己的心，不是出于耶和华的口。

chapters.en: They keep saying to those who despise Me, ‘The LORD says that you will have peace,’ and to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart, ‘No harm will come to you.’
chapters.zh: 他们常对藐视我的人说：『耶和华说：你们必享平安』；又对一切按自己顽梗之心而行的人说：『必没有灾祸临到你们。』」

chapters.en: But which of them has stood in the council of the LORD to see and hear His word? Who has given heed to His word and obeyed it?
chapters.zh: 有谁站在耶和华的会中 得以听见并会悟他的话呢？ 有谁留心听他的话呢？

chapters.en: Behold, the storm of the LORD has gone out with fury, a whirlwind swirling down upon the heads of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 看哪！耶和华的忿怒 好像暴风，已经发出； 是暴烈的旋风， 必转到恶人的头上。

chapters.en: The anger of the LORD will not turn back until He has fully accomplished the purposes of His heart. In the days to come you will understand this clearly.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的怒气必不转消， 直到他心中所拟定的成就了。 末后的日子你们要全然明白。

chapters.en: I did not send these prophets, yet they have run with their message; I did not speak to them, yet they have prophesied.
chapters.zh: 我没有打发那些先知， 他们竟自奔跑； 我没有对他们说话， 他们竟自预言。

chapters.en: But if they had stood in My council, they would have proclaimed My words to My people and turned them back from their evil ways and deeds.”
chapters.zh: 他们若是站在我的会中， 就必使我的百姓听我的话， 又使他们回头离开恶道和他们所行的恶。

chapters.en: “Am I only a God nearby,” declares the LORD, “and not a God far away?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我岂为近处的上帝呢？不也为远处的上帝吗？」

chapters.en:
“Can a man hide in secret places where I cannot see him?” declares the LORD.
“Do I not fill the heavens and the earth?” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「人岂能在隐密处藏身，使我看不见他呢？」耶和华说：「我岂不充满天地吗？

chapters.en: “I have heard the sayings of the prophets who prophesy lies in My name: ‘I had a dream! I had a dream!’
chapters.zh: 我已听见那些先知所说的，就是讬我名说的假预言，他们说：『我做了梦！我做了梦！』

chapters.en: How long will this continue in the hearts of these prophets who prophesy falsehood, these prophets of the delusion of their own minds?
chapters.zh: 说假预言的先知，就是预言本心诡诈的先知，他们这样存心要到几时呢？

chapters.en: They suppose the dreams that they tell one another will make My people forget My name, just as their fathers forgot My name through the worship of Baal.
chapters.zh: 他们各人将所做的梦对邻舍述说，想要使我的百姓忘记我的名，正如他们列祖因巴力忘记我的名一样。

chapters.en: Let the prophet who has a dream retell it, but let him who has My word speak it truthfully. For what is straw compared to grain?” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 得梦的先知可以述说那梦；得我话的人可以诚实讲说我的话。糠秕怎能与麦子比较呢？这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: “Is not My word like fire,” declares the LORD, “and like a hammer that smashes a rock?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我的话岂不像火，又像能打碎磐石的大锤吗？」

chapters.en: “Therefore behold,” declares the LORD, “I am against the prophets who steal from one another words they attribute to Me.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「那些先知各从邻舍偷窃我的言语，因此我必与他们反对。」

chapters.en: “Yes,” declares the LORD, “I am against the prophets who wag their own tongues and proclaim, ‘The LORD declares it.’”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「那些先知用舌头，说是耶和华说的；我必与他们反对。」

chapters.en: “Indeed,” declares the LORD, “I am against those who prophesy false dreams and retell them to lead My people astray with their reckless lies. It was not I who sent them or commanded them, and they are of no benefit at all to these people,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「那些以幻梦为预言，又述说这梦，以谎言和矜夸使我百姓走错了路的，我必与他们反对。我没有打发他们，也没有吩咐他们。他们与这百姓毫无益处。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: “Now when this people or a prophet or priest asks you, ‘What is the burden of the LORD?’ you are to say to them, ‘What burden? I will forsake you, declares the LORD.’
chapters.zh: 「无论是百姓，是先知，是祭司，问你说：『耶和华有什么默示呢？』你就对他们说：『什么默示啊？耶和华说：我要撇弃你们。』

chapters.en: As for the prophet or priest or anyone who claims, ‘This is the burden of the LORD,’ I will punish that man and his household.
chapters.zh: 无论是先知，是祭司，是百姓，说『耶和华的默示』，我必刑罚那人和他的家。

chapters.en: This is what each man is to say to his friend and to his brother: ‘What has the LORD answered?’ or ‘What has the LORD spoken?’
chapters.zh: 你们各人要对邻舍，各人要对弟兄如此说：『耶和华回答什么？』『耶和华说了什么呢？』

chapters.en: But refer no more to the burden of the LORD, for each man’s word becomes the burden, so that you pervert the words of the living God, the LORD of Hosts, our God.
chapters.zh: 『耶和华的默示』你们不可再提，各人所说的话必作自己的重担〔注：重担和默示原文同〕，因为你们谬用永生上帝、万军之耶和华－我们上帝的言语。

chapters.en: Thus you are to say to the prophet: ‘What has the LORD answered you?’ and ‘What has the LORD spoken?’
chapters.zh: 你们要对先知如此说：『耶和华回答你什么？』『耶和华说了什么呢？』

chapters.en: But if you claim, ‘This is the burden of the LORD,’ then this is what the LORD says: Because you have said, ‘This is the burden of the LORD,’ and I specifically told you not to make this claim,
chapters.zh: 你们若说『耶和华的默示』，耶和华就如此说：『因你们说「耶和华的默示」这句话，我也打发人到你们那里去，告诉你们不可说「耶和华的默示」。』

chapters.en: therefore I will surely forget you and will cast you out of My presence, both you and the city that I gave to you and your fathers.
chapters.zh: 所以我必全然忘记你们，将你们和我所赐给你们并你们列祖的城撇弃了；

chapters.en: And I will bring upon you everlasting shame and perpetual humiliation that will never be forgotten.”
chapters.zh: 又必使永远的凌辱和长久的羞耻临到你们，是不能忘记的。」

chapters.en: After Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, as well as the officials of Judah and the craftsmen and metalsmiths from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon, the LORD showed me two baskets of figs placed in front of the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒将犹大王约雅敬的儿子耶哥尼雅和犹大的首领，并工匠、铁匠从耶路撒冷掳去，带到巴比伦。这事以后，耶和华指给我看，有两筐无花果放在耶和华的殿前。

chapters.en: One basket had very good figs, like those that ripen early, but the other basket contained very poor figs, so bad they could not be eaten.
chapters.zh: 一筐是极好的无花果，好像是初熟的；一筐是极坏的无花果，坏得不可吃。

chapters.en:
“Jeremiah,” the LORD asked, “what do you see?”
“Figs!” I replied. “The good figs are very good, but the bad figs are very bad, so bad they cannot be eaten.”
chapters.zh: 于是耶和华问我说：「耶利米你看见什么？」我说：「我看见无花果，好的极好，坏的极坏，坏得不可吃。」

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：「

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Like these good figs, so I regard as good the exiles from Judah, whom I have sent away from this place to the land of the Chaldeans.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：被掳去的犹大人，就是我打发离开这地到迦勒底人之地去的，我必看顾他们如这好无花果，使他们得好处。

chapters.en: I will keep My eyes on them for good and will return them to this land. I will build them up and not tear them down; I will plant them and not uproot them.
chapters.zh: 我要眷顾他们，使他们得好处，领他们归回这地。我也要建立他们，必不拆毁；栽植他们，并不拔出。

chapters.en: I will give them a heart to know Me, that I am the LORD. They will be My people, and I will be their God, for they will return to Me with all their heart.
chapters.zh: 我要赐他们认识我的心，知道我是耶和华。他们要作我的子民，我要作他们的上帝，因为他们要一心归向我。」

chapters.en: But like the bad figs, so bad they cannot be eaten,’ says the LORD, ‘so will I deal with Zedekiah king of Judah, his officials, and the remnant of Jerusalem—those remaining in this land and those living in the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：「我必将犹大王西底家和他的首领，以及剩在这地耶路撒冷的余民，并住在埃及地的犹大人都交出来，好像那极坏、坏得不可吃的无花果。

chapters.en: I will make them a horror and an offense to all the kingdoms of the earth, a disgrace and an object of scorn, ridicule, and cursing wherever I have banished them.
chapters.zh: 我必使他们交出来，在天下万国中抛来抛去，遭遇灾祸；在我赶逐他们到的各处成为凌辱、笑谈、讥刺、咒诅。

chapters.en: And I will send against them sword and famine and plague, until they have perished from the land that I gave to them and their fathers.’”
chapters.zh: 我必使刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫临到他们，直到他们从我所赐给他们和他们列祖之地灭绝。」

chapters.en: This is the word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, which was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的元年，〔耶和华〕论犹大众民的话临到耶利米。

chapters.en: So the prophet Jeremiah spoke to all the people of Judah and all the residents of Jerusalem as follows:
chapters.zh: 先知耶利米就将这话对犹大众人和耶路撒冷的一切居民说：

chapters.en: “From the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah until this very day—twenty-three years—the word of the LORD has come to me, and I have spoken to you again and again, but you have not listened.
chapters.zh: 「从犹大王亚们的儿子约西亚十三年直到今日，这二十三年之内，常有耶和华的话临到我；我也对你们传说，就是从早起来传说，只是你们没有听从。

chapters.en: And the LORD has sent all His servants the prophets to you again and again, but you have not listened or inclined your ear to hear.
chapters.zh: 耶和华也从早起来，差遣他的仆人众先知到你们这里来（只是你们没有听从，也没有侧耳而听），

chapters.en: The prophets told you, ‘Turn now, each of you, from your evil ways and deeds, and you can dwell in the land that the LORD has given to you and your fathers forever and ever.
chapters.zh: 说：『你们各人当回头，离开恶道和所作的恶，便可居住耶和华古时所赐给你们和你们列祖之地，直到永远。

chapters.en: Do not follow other gods to serve and worship them, and do not provoke Me to anger with the works of your hands. Then I will do you no harm.’
chapters.zh: 不可随从别神事奉敬拜，以你们手所做的惹我发怒；这样，我就不加害与你们。

chapters.en: ‘But to your own harm, you have not listened to Me,’ declares the LORD, ‘so you have provoked Me to anger with the works of your hands.’
chapters.zh: 然而你们没有听从我，竟以手所做的惹我发怒，陷害自己。这是耶和华说的。』」

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Because you have not obeyed My words,
chapters.zh: 所以万军之耶和华如此说：「因为你们没有听从我的话，

chapters.en: behold, I will summon all the families of the north, declares the LORD, and I will send for My servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, whom I will bring against this land, against its residents, and against all the surrounding nations. So I will devote them to destruction and make them an object of horror and contempt, an everlasting desolation.
chapters.zh: 我必召北方的众族和我仆人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来攻击这地和这地的居民，并四围一切的国民。我要将他们尽行灭绝，以致他们令人惊骇、嗤笑，并且永久荒凉。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Moreover, I will banish from them the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of the bride and bridegroom, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the lamp.
chapters.zh: 我又要使欢喜和快乐的声音，新郎和新妇的声音，推磨的声音和灯的亮光，从他们中间止息。

chapters.en: And this whole land will become a desolate wasteland, and these nations will serve the king of Babylon for seventy years.
chapters.zh: 这全地必然荒凉，令人惊骇。这些国民要服事巴比伦王七十年。

chapters.en: But when seventy years are complete, I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation, the land of the Chaldeans, for their guilt, declares the LORD, and I will make it an everlasting desolation.
chapters.zh: 七十年满了以后，我必刑罚巴比伦王和那国民，并迦勒底人之地，因他们的罪孽使那地永远荒凉。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: I will bring upon that land all the words I have pronounced against it, all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.
chapters.zh: 我也必使我向那地所说的话，就是记在这书上的话，是耶利米向这些国民说的预言，都临到那地。

chapters.en: For many nations and great kings will enslave them, and I will repay them according to their deeds and according to the work of their hands.’”
chapters.zh: 因为有多国和大君王必使迦勒底人作奴仆；我也必照他们的行为，按他们手所做的报应他们。」

chapters.en: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, said to me: “Take from My hand this cup of the wine of wrath, and make all the nations to whom I send you drink from it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－以色列的上帝对我如此说：「你从我手中接这杯忿怒的酒，使我所差遣你去的各国的民喝。

chapters.en: And they will drink and stagger and go out of their minds, because of the sword that I will send among them.”
chapters.zh: 他们喝了就要东倒西歪，并要发狂，因我使刀剑临到他们中间。」

chapters.en: So I took the cup from the LORD’s hand and made all the nations drink from it, each one to whom the LORD had sent me,
chapters.zh: 我就从耶和华的手中接了这杯，给耶和华所差遣我去的各国的民喝，

chapters.en: to make them a ruin, an object of horror and contempt and cursing, as they are to this day—Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, its kings and officials;
chapters.zh: 就是耶路撒冷和犹大的城邑，并耶路撒冷的君王与首领，使这城邑荒凉，令人惊骇、嗤笑、咒诅，正如今日一样。

chapters.en: Pharaoh king of Egypt, his officials, his leaders, and all his people;
chapters.zh: 又有埃及王法老和他的臣仆、首领，以及他的众民，

chapters.en: all the mixed tribes; all the kings of Uz; all the kings of the Philistines: Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;
chapters.zh: 并杂族的人民和乌斯地的诸王，与非利士地的诸王（亚实基伦、迦萨、以革伦，以及亚实突剩下的人）；

chapters.en: Edom, Moab, and the Ammonites;
chapters.zh: 以东、摩押、亚扪人、

chapters.en: all the kings of Tyre and Sidon; the kings of the coastlands across the sea;
chapters.zh: 泰尔的诸王、西顿的诸王、海岛的诸王、

chapters.en: Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who cut the corners of their hair;
chapters.zh: 底但、提玛、布斯，和一切剃周围〔头发〕的；

chapters.en: all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mixed tribes who dwell in the desert;
chapters.zh: 阿拉伯的诸王、住旷野杂族人民的诸王、

chapters.en: all the kings of Zimri, Elam, and Media;
chapters.zh: 心利的诸王、以拦的诸王、米底亚的诸王、

chapters.en: all the kings of the north, both near and far, one after another—all the kingdoms on the face of the earth. And after all of them, the king of Sheshach will drink it too.
chapters.zh: 北方远近的诸王，以及天下地上的万国喝了，以后示沙克〔注：就是巴比伦〕王也要喝。

chapters.en: “Then you are to tell them that this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘Drink, get drunk, and vomit. Fall down and never get up again, because of the sword I will send among you.’
chapters.zh: 「你要对他们说：『万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：你们要喝，且要喝醉，要呕吐，且要跌倒，不得再起来，都因我使刀剑临到你们中间。』

chapters.en: If they refuse to take the cup from your hand and drink it, you are to tell them that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘You most certainly must drink it!
chapters.zh: 「他们若不肯从你手接这杯喝，你就要对他们说：『万军之耶和华如此说：你们一定要喝！

chapters.en: For behold, I am beginning to bring disaster on the city that bears My Name, so how could you possibly go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, for I am calling down a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, declares the LORD of Hosts.’
chapters.zh: 我既从称为我名下的城起首施行灾祸，你们能尽免刑罚吗？你们必不能免，因为我要命刀剑临到地上一切的居民。这是万军之耶和华说的。』

chapters.en:
So you are to prophesy all these words against them and say to them:
‘The LORD will roar from on high; He will raise His voice from His holy habitation. He will roar loudly over His pasture; like those who tread the grapes, He will call out with a shout against all the inhabitants of the earth.
chapters.zh: 「所以你要向他们预言这一切的话，攻击他们，说： 耶和华必从高天吼叫， 从圣所发声， 向自己的羊群大声吼叫； 他要向地上一切的居民吶喊， 像踹〔葡萄〕的一样。

chapters.en: The tumult will resound to the ends of the earth because the LORD brings a charge against the nations. He brings judgment on all mankind and puts the wicked to the sword,’” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 必有响声达到地极， 因为耶和华与列国相争； 凡有血气的，他必审问； 至于恶人，他必交给刀剑。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD of Hosts says:
“Behold! Disaster is spreading from nation to nation; a mighty storm is rising from the ends of the earth.”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说： 看哪，必有灾祸从这国发到那国， 并有大暴风从地极刮起。

chapters.en: Those slain by the LORD on that day will be spread from one end of the earth to the other. They will not be mourned, gathered, or buried. They will be like dung lying on the ground.
chapters.zh: 「到那日，从地这边直到地那边都有耶和华所杀戮的。必无人哀哭，不得收殓，不得葬埋，必在地上成为粪土。

chapters.en: Wail, you shepherds, and cry out; roll in the dust, you leaders of the flock. For the days of your slaughter have come; you will fall and be shattered like fine pottery.
chapters.zh: 牧人哪，你们当哀号，呼喊； 群众的头目啊，你们要滚〔在灰中〕； 因为你们被杀戮分散的日子足足来到。 你们要跌碎，好像美器打碎一样。

chapters.en: Flight will evade the shepherds, and escape will elude the leaders of the flock.
chapters.zh: 牧人无路逃跑； 群众的头目也无法逃脱。

chapters.en:
Hear the cry of the shepherds, the wailing of the leaders of the flock,
for the LORD is destroying their pasture.
chapters.zh: 听啊，有牧人呼喊， 有群众头目哀号的声音， 因为耶和华使他们的草场变为荒场。

chapters.en: The peaceful meadows have been silenced because of the LORD’s burning anger.
chapters.zh: 耶和华发出猛烈的怒气， 平安的羊圈就都寂静无声。

chapters.en: He has left His den like a lion, for their land has been made a desolation by the sword of the oppressor, and because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他离了隐密处像狮子一样， 他们的地，因〔刀剑〕凶猛的欺压， 又因他猛烈的怒气都成为可惊骇的。」

chapters.en: At the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came from the LORD:
chapters.zh: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬登基的时候，有这话从耶和华临到〔耶利米〕说：

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD says: Stand in the courtyard of the house of the LORD and speak all the words I have commanded you to speak to all the cities of Judah who come to worship there. Do not omit a word.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华如此说：你站在耶和华殿的院内，对犹大众城邑的人，就是到耶和华殿来礼拜的，说我所吩咐你的一切话，一字不可删减。

chapters.en: Perhaps they will listen and turn—each from his evil way of life—so that I may relent of the disaster I am planning to bring upon them because of the evil of their deeds.
chapters.zh: 或者他们肯听从，各人回头离开恶道，使我后悔不将我因他们所行的恶，想要施行的灾祸降与他们。

chapters.en: And you are to tell them that this is what the LORD says: ‘If you do not listen to Me and walk in My law, which I have set before you,
chapters.zh: 你要对他们说，耶和华如此说：『你们若不听从我，不遵行我设立在你们面前的律法，

chapters.en: and if you do not listen to the words of My servants the prophets, whom I have sent you again and again even though you did not listen,
chapters.zh: 不听我从早起来差遣到你们那里去我仆人众先知的话（你们还是没有听从），

chapters.en: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and I will make this city an object of cursing among all the nations of the earth.’”
chapters.zh: 我就必使这殿如示罗，使这城为地上万国所咒诅的。』」

chapters.en: Now the priests and prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD,
chapters.zh: 耶利米在耶和华殿中说的这些话，祭司、先知与众民都听见了。

chapters.en: and as soon as he had finished telling all the people everything the LORD had commanded him to say, the priests and prophets and all the people seized him, shouting, “You must surely die!
chapters.zh: 耶利米说完了耶和华所吩咐他对众人说的一切话，祭司、先知与众民都来抓住他，说：「你必要死！

chapters.en:
How dare you prophesy in the name of the LORD that this house will become like Shiloh and this city will be desolate and deserted!”
And all the people assembled against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你为何讬耶和华的名预言，说这殿必如示罗，这城必变为荒场无人居住呢？」于是众民都在耶和华的殿中聚集到耶利米那里。

chapters.en: When the officials of Judah heard these things, they went up from the king’s palace to the house of the LORD and sat there at the entrance of the New Gate.
chapters.zh: 犹大的首领听见这事，就从王宫上到耶和华的殿，坐在耶和华〔殿〕的新门口。

chapters.en: Then the priests and prophets said to the officials and all the people, “This man is worthy of death, for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your own ears!”
chapters.zh: 祭司、先知对首领和众民说：「这人是该死的；因为他说预言攻击这城，正如你们亲耳所听见的。」

chapters.en: But Jeremiah said to all the officials and all the people, “The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.
chapters.zh: 耶利米就对众首领和众民说：「耶和华差遣我预言，攻击这殿和这城，说你们所听见的这一切话。

chapters.en: So now, correct your ways and deeds, and obey the voice of the LORD your God, so that He might relent of the disaster He has pronounced against you.
chapters.zh: 现在要改正你们的行动作为，听从耶和华－你们上帝的话，他就必后悔，不将所说的灾祸降与你们。

chapters.en: As for me, here I am in your hands; do to me what you think is good and right.
chapters.zh: 至于我，我在你们手中，你们眼看何为善，何为正，就那样待我吧！

chapters.en: But know for certain that if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood upon yourselves, upon this city, and upon its residents; for truly the LORD has sent me to speak all these words in your hearing.”
chapters.zh: 但你们要确实地知道，若把我治死，就使无辜人的血归到你们和这城，并其中的居民了；因为耶和华实在差遣我到你们这里来，将这一切话传与你们耳中。」

chapters.en: Then the officials and all the people told the priests and prophets, “This man is not worthy of death, for he has spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God!”
chapters.zh: 首领和众民就对祭司、先知说：「这人是不该死的，因为他是奉耶和华－我们上帝的名向我们说话。」

chapters.en: Some of the elders of the land stood up and said to the whole assembly of the people,
chapters.zh: 国中的长老就有几个人起来，对聚会的众民说：

chapters.en:
“Micah the Moreshite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah and told all the people of Judah that this is what the LORD of Hosts says:
‘Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble,
and the temple mount a wooded ridge.’
chapters.zh: 「当犹大王希西家的日子，有摩利沙人弥迦对犹大众人预言说： 万军之耶和华如此说： 锡安必被耕种像一块田； 耶路撒冷必变为乱堆； 这殿的山必像丛林的高处。

chapters.en: Did Hezekiah king of Judah or anyone else in Judah put him to death? Did Hezekiah not fear the LORD and seek His favor, and did not the LORD relent of the disaster He had pronounced against them? But we are about to bring great harm on ourselves!”
chapters.zh: 犹大王希西家和犹大众人岂是把他治死呢？希西家岂不是敬畏耶和华、恳求他的恩吗？耶和华就后悔，不把自己所说的灾祸降与他们。〔若治死这人〕，我们就作了大恶，自害己命。」

chapters.en: Now there was another man prophesying in the name of the LORD, Uriah son of Shemaiah from Kiriath-jearim. He prophesied against this city and against this land the same things that Jeremiah did.
chapters.zh: （又有一个人奉耶和华的名说预言，是基列‧耶琳人示玛雅的儿子乌利亚，他照耶利米的一切话说预言，攻击这城和这地。

chapters.en: King Jehoiakim and all his mighty men and officials heard his words, and the king sought to put him to death. But when Uriah found out about it, he fled in fear and went to Egypt.
chapters.zh: 约雅敬王和他众勇士、众首领听见了乌利亚的话，王就想要把他治死。乌利亚听见就惧怕，逃往埃及去了。

chapters.en: Then King Jehoiakim sent men to Egypt: Elnathan son of Achbor along with some other men.
chapters.zh: 约雅敬王便打发亚革波的儿子以利拿单，带领几个人往埃及去。

chapters.en: They brought Uriah out of Egypt and took him to King Jehoiakim, who had him put to the sword and his body thrown into the burial place of the common people.
chapters.zh: 他们就从埃及将乌利亚带出来，送到约雅敬王那里；王用刀杀了他，把他的尸首抛在平民的坟地中。）

chapters.en: Nevertheless, Ahikam son of Shaphan supported Jeremiah, so he was not handed over to the people to be put to death.
chapters.zh: 然而，沙番的儿子亚希甘保护耶利米，不交在百姓的手中治死他。

chapters.en: At the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD.
chapters.zh: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬〔注：约雅敬是西底家的别名，看第三节〕登基的时候，有这话从耶和华临到耶利米说：

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD said to me:
“Make for yourself a yoke out of leather straps and put it on your neck.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华对我如此说：你做绳索与轭，加在自己的颈项上，

chapters.en: Send word to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon through the envoys who have come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.
chapters.zh: 藉那些来到耶路撒冷见犹大王西底家的使臣之手，把绳索与轭送到以东王、摩押王、亚扪王、泰尔王、西顿王那里，

chapters.en: Give them a message from the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, to relay to their masters:
chapters.zh: 且嘱咐使臣，传与他们的主人说，万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：

chapters.en: By My great power and outstretched arm, I made the earth and the men and beasts on the face of it, and I give it to whom I please.
chapters.zh: 我用大能和伸出来的膀臂，创造大地和地上的人民、牲畜。我看给谁相宜，就把地给谁。

chapters.en: So now I have placed all these lands under the authority of My servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. I have even made the beasts of the field subject to him.
chapters.zh: 现在我将这些地都交给我仆人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手，我也将田野的走兽给他使用。

chapters.en: All nations will serve him and his son and grandson, until the time of his own land comes; then many nations and great kings will enslave him.
chapters.zh: 列国都必服事他和他的儿孙，直到他本国〔遭报〕的日期来到。那时，多国和大君王要使他作他们的奴仆。

chapters.en: As for the nation or kingdom that does not serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and does not place its neck under his yoke, I will punish that nation by sword and famine and plague, declares the LORD, until I have destroyed it by his hand.
chapters.zh: 「无论哪一邦哪一国，不肯服事这巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒，也不把颈项放在巴比伦王的轭下，我必用刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫刑罚那邦，直到我藉巴比伦王的手将他们毁灭。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: But as for you, do not listen to your prophets, your diviners, your interpreters of dreams, your mediums, or your sorcerers who declare, ‘You will not serve the king of Babylon.’
chapters.zh: 至于你们，不可听从你们的先知和占卜的、圆梦的、观兆的，以及行邪术的；他们告诉你们说：『你们不致服事巴比伦王。』

chapters.en: For they prophesy to you a lie that will serve to remove you from your land; I will banish you and you will perish.
chapters.zh: 他们向你们说假预言，要叫你们迁移，远离本地，以致我将你们赶出去，使你们灭亡。

chapters.en: But the nation that will put its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serve him, I will leave in its own land, to cultivate it and reside in it, declares the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 但哪一邦肯把颈项放在巴比伦王的轭下服事他，我必使那邦仍在本地存留，得以耕种居住。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: And to Zedekiah king of Judah I spoke the same message: “Put your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon; serve him and his people, and live!
chapters.zh: 我就照这一切的话对犹大王西底家说：「要把你们的颈项放在巴比伦王的轭下，服事他和他的百姓，便得存活。

chapters.en: Why should you and your people die by sword and famine and plague, as the LORD has decreed against any nation that does not serve the king of Babylon?
chapters.zh: 你和你的百姓为何要因刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫死亡，正如耶和华论到不服事巴比伦王的那国说的话呢？

chapters.en: Do not listen to the words of the prophets who say, ‘You must not serve the king of Babylon,’ for they are prophesying to you a lie.
chapters.zh: 不可听那些先知对你们所说的话；他们说：『你们不致服事巴比伦王』，其实他们向你们说假预言。

chapters.en: For I have not sent them, declares the LORD, and yet they are prophesying falsely in My name; therefore I will banish you, and you will perish—you and the prophets who prophesy to you.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：『我并没有打发他们，他们却讬我的名说假预言，好使我将你们和向你们说预言的那些先知赶出去，一同灭亡。』」

chapters.en: Then I said to the priests and to all this people, “This is what the LORD says: Do not listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying, ‘Look, very soon now the articles from the house of the LORD will be brought back from Babylon.’ They are prophesying to you a lie.
chapters.zh: 我又对祭司和这众民说：「耶和华如此说：你们不可听那先知对你们所说的预言。他们说：『耶和华殿中的器皿快要从巴比伦带回来』；其实他们向你们说假预言。

chapters.en: Do not listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon and live! Why should this city become a ruin?
chapters.zh: 不可听从他们，只管服事巴比伦王便得存活。这城何致变为荒场呢？

chapters.en: If they are indeed prophets and the word of the LORD is with them, let them now plead with the LORD of Hosts that the articles remaining in the house of the LORD, in the palace of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem, not be taken to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 他们若果是先知，有耶和华的话临到他们，让他们祈求万军之耶和华，使那在耶和华殿中和犹大王宫内，并耶路撒冷剩下的器皿，不被带到巴比伦去。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD of Hosts says about the pillars, the sea, the bases, and the rest of the articles that remain in this city,
chapters.zh: （因为万军之耶和华论到柱子、〔铜〕海、〔盆〕座，并剩在这城里的器皿，

chapters.en: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take when he carried Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon, along with all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒掳掠犹大王约雅敬的儿子耶哥尼雅，和犹大、耶路撒冷一切贵胄的时候所没有掠去的器皿。）

chapters.en: Yes, this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says about the articles that remain in the house of the LORD, in the palace of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem:
chapters.zh: 论到那在耶和华殿中和犹大王宫内，并耶路撒冷剩下的器皿，万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：

chapters.en: ‘They will be carried to Babylon and will remain there until the day I attend to them again,’ declares the LORD. ‘Then I will bring them back and restore them to this place.’”
chapters.zh: 必被带到巴比伦存在那里，直到我眷顾以色列人的日子。那时，我必将这器皿带回来，交还此地。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: In the fifth month of that same year, the fourth year, near the beginning of the reign of King Zedekiah of Judah, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur, who was from Gibeon, said to me in the house of the LORD in the presence of the priests and all the people:
chapters.zh: 当年，就是犹大王西底家登基第四年五月，基遍人押朔的儿子，先知哈拿尼雅，在耶和华的殿中当着祭司和众民对我说：

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 「万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：我已经折断巴比伦王的轭。

chapters.en: Within two years I will restore to this place all the articles of the house of the LORD that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon removed from here and carried to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 二年之内，我要将巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒从这地掠到巴比伦的器皿，就是耶和华殿中的一切器皿都带回此地。

chapters.en: And I will restore to this place Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, along with all the exiles from Judah who went to Babylon,’ declares the LORD, ‘for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’”
chapters.zh: 我又要将犹大王约雅敬的儿子耶哥尼雅和被掳到巴比伦去的一切犹大人带回此地，因为我要折断巴比伦王的轭。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: Then the prophet Jeremiah replied to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests and all the people who were standing in the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 先知耶利米当着祭司和站在耶和华殿里的众民对先知哈拿尼雅说：

chapters.en: “Amen!” Jeremiah said. “May the LORD do so! May the LORD fulfill the words you have prophesied, and may He restore the articles of His house and all the exiles back to this place from Babylon.
chapters.zh: 「阿们！愿耶和华如此行，愿耶和华成就你所预言的话，将耶和华殿中的器皿和一切被掳去的人从巴比伦带回此地。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, listen now to this message I am speaking in your hearing and in the hearing of all the people.
chapters.zh: 然而我向你和众民耳中所要说的话，你应当听。

chapters.en: The prophets of old who preceded you and me prophesied war, disaster, and plague against many lands and great kingdoms.
chapters.zh: 从古以来，在你我以前的先知，向多国和大邦说预言，论到争战、灾祸、瘟疫的事。

chapters.en: As for the prophet who prophesies peace, only if the word of the prophet comes true will the prophet be recognized as one the LORD has truly sent.”
chapters.zh: 先知预言的平安，到话语成就的时候，人便知道他真是耶和华所差来的。」

chapters.en: Then the prophet Hananiah took the yoke off the neck of Jeremiah the prophet and broke it.
chapters.zh: 于是，先知哈拿尼雅将先知耶利米颈项上的轭取下来，折断了。

chapters.en:
And in the presence of all the people Hananiah proclaimed, “This is what the LORD says: ‘In this way, within two years I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon off the neck of all the nations.’”
At this, Jeremiah the prophet went on his way.
chapters.zh: 哈拿尼雅又当着众民说：「耶和华如此说：二年之内我必照样从列国人的颈项上折断巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的轭。」于是先知耶利米就走了。

chapters.en: But shortly after Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke off his neck, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
chapters.zh: 先知哈拿尼雅把先知耶利米颈项上的轭折断以后，耶和华的话临到耶利米说：

chapters.en: “Go and tell Hananiah that this is what the LORD says: ‘You have broken a yoke of wood, but in its place you have fashioned a yoke of iron.’
chapters.zh: 「你去告诉哈拿尼雅说，耶和华如此说：你折断木轭，却换了铁轭！

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations to make them serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and they will serve him. I have even given him control of the beasts of the field.’”
chapters.zh: 因为万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：我已将铁轭加在这些国的颈项上，使他们服事巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒，他们总要服事他；我也把田野的走兽给了他。」

chapters.en: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah, “Listen, Hananiah! The LORD did not send you, but you have persuaded this people to trust in a lie.
chapters.zh: 于是先知耶利米对先知哈拿尼雅说：「哈拿尼雅啊，你应当听！耶和华并没有差遣你，你竟使这百姓倚靠谎言。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘I am about to remove you from the face of the earth. You will die this year because you have preached rebellion against the LORD.’”
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华如此说：看哪，我要叫你去世，你今年必死，因为你向耶和华说了叛逆的话。」

chapters.en: And in the seventh month of that very year, the prophet Hananiah died.
chapters.zh: 这样，先知哈拿尼雅当年七月间就死了。

chapters.en: This is the text of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the surviving elders among the exiles and to the priests, the prophets, and all the others Nebuchadnezzar had carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 先知耶利米从耶路撒冷寄信与被掳的祭司、先知，和众民，并生存的长老，就是尼布甲尼撒从耶路撒冷掳到巴比伦去的。

chapters.en: (This was after King Jeconiah, the queen mother, the court officials, the officials of Judah and Jerusalem, the craftsmen, and the metalsmiths had been exiled from Jerusalem.)
chapters.zh: （这在耶哥尼雅王和太后、太监，并犹大、耶路撒冷的首领，以及工匠、铁匠都离了耶路撒冷以后。）

chapters.en: The letter was entrusted to Elasah son of Shaphan and Gemariah son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to King Nebuchadnezzar in Babylon. It stated:
chapters.zh: 他藉沙番的儿子以利亚萨和希勒家的儿子基玛利的手寄去。他们二人是犹大王西底家打发往巴比伦去见尼布甲尼撒王的。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says to all the exiles who were carried away from Jerusalem to Babylon:
chapters.zh: 信上说：「万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝对一切被掳去的（就是我使他们从耶路撒冷被掳到巴比伦的人）如此说：

chapters.en: “Build houses and settle down. Plant gardens and eat their produce.
chapters.zh: 你们要盖造房屋，住在其中；栽种田园，吃其中所产的；

chapters.en: Take wives and have sons and daughters. Take wives for your sons and give your daughters in marriage, so that they too may have sons and daughters. Multiply there; do not decrease.
chapters.zh: 娶妻生儿女，为你们的儿子娶妻，使你们的女儿嫁人，生儿养女。在那里生养众多，不致减少。

chapters.en: Seek the prosperity of the city to which I have sent you as exiles. Pray to the LORD on its behalf, for if it prospers, you too will prosper.”
chapters.zh: 我所使你们被掳到的那城，你们要为那城求平安，为那城祷告耶和华；因为那城得平安，你们也随着得平安。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “Do not be deceived by the prophets and diviners among you, and do not listen to the dreams you elicit from them.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：不要被你们中间的先知和占卜的诱惑，也不要听信自己所做的梦；

chapters.en: For they are falsely prophesying to you in My name; I have not sent them, declares the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 因为他们讬我的名对你们说假预言，我并没有差遣他们。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD says: “When Babylon’s seventy years are complete, I will attend to you and confirm My promise to restore you to this place.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华如此说：为巴比伦所定的七十年满了以后，我要眷顾你们，向你们成就我的恩言，使你们仍回此地。

chapters.en: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the LORD, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, to give you a future and a hope.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：我知道我向你们所怀的意念是赐平安的意念，不是降灾祸的意念，要叫你们末后有指望。

chapters.en: Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
chapters.zh: 你们要呼求我，祷告我，我就应允你们。

chapters.en: You will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart.
chapters.zh: 你们寻求我，若专心寻求我，就必寻见。

chapters.en: I will be found by you, declares the LORD, and I will restore you from captivity and gather you from all the nations and places to which I have banished you, declares the LORD. I will restore you to the place from which I sent you into exile.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：我必被你们寻见，我也必使你们被掳的人归回，将你们从各国中和我所赶你们到的各处招聚了来，又将你们带回我使你们被掳掠离开的地方。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Because you may say, “The LORD has raised up for us prophets in Babylon,”
chapters.zh: 「你们说：『耶和华在巴比伦为我们兴起先知』；

chapters.en: this is what the LORD says about the king who sits on David’s throne and all the people who remain in this city, your brothers who did not go with you into exile—
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华论到坐大卫宝座的王和住在这城里的一切百姓，就是未曾与你们一同被掳的弟兄，

chapters.en:
this is what the LORD of Hosts says:
“I will send against them sword and famine and plague, and I will make them like rotten figs, so bad they cannot be eaten.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：『看哪，我必使刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫临到他们，使他们像极坏的无花果，坏得不可吃。

chapters.en: I will pursue them with sword and famine and plague. I will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth—a curse, a desolation, and an object of scorn and reproach among all the nations to which I banish them.
chapters.zh: 我必用刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫追赶他们，使他们在天下万国抛来抛去，在我所赶他们到的各国中，令人咒诅、惊骇、嗤笑、羞辱。

chapters.en: I will do this because they have not listened to My words, declares the LORD, which I sent to them again and again through My servants the prophets. And neither have you exiles listened, declares the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：这是因为他们没有听从我的话，就是我从早起来差遣我仆人众先知去说的，无奈他们不听。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: So hear the word of the LORD, all you exiles I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 所以你们一切被掳去的，就是我从耶路撒冷打发到巴比伦去的，当听耶和华的话。』」

chapters.en: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says about Ahab son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah, who are prophesying to you lies in My name: “I will deliver them to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will kill them before your very eyes.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝论到哥赖雅的儿子亚哈，并玛西雅的儿子西底家，如此说：「他们是讬我名向你们说假预言的，我必将他们交在巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中；他要在你们眼前杀害他们。

chapters.en: Because of them, all the exiles of Judah who are in Babylon will use this curse: ‘May the LORD make you like Zedekiah and Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire!’
chapters.zh: 住巴比伦一切被掳的犹大人必藉这二人赌咒说：『愿耶和华使你像巴比伦王在火中烧的西底家和亚哈一样。』

chapters.en: For they have committed an outrage in Israel by committing adultery with the wives of their neighbors and speaking lies in My name, which I did not command them to do. I am He who knows, and I am a witness, declares the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 这二人是在以色列中行了丑事，与邻舍的妻行淫，又假讬我名说我未曾吩咐他们的话。知道的是我，作见证的也是我。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: You are to tell Shemaiah the Nehelamite that
chapters.zh: 「论到尼希兰人示玛雅，你当说，

chapters.en: this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “In your own name you have sent out letters to all the people of Jerusalem, to the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, and to all the priests. You said to Zephaniah:
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：你曾用自己的名寄信给耶路撒冷的众民和祭司玛西雅的儿子西番雅，并众祭司，说：

chapters.en: ‘The LORD has appointed you priest in place of Jehoiada, to be the chief officer in the house of the LORD, responsible for any madman who acts like a prophet—you must put him in stocks and neck irons.
chapters.zh: 『耶和华已经立你西番雅为祭司，代替祭司耶何耶大，使耶和华殿中有官长，好将一切狂妄自称为先知的人用枷枷住，用锁锁住。

chapters.en: So now, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who poses as a prophet among you?
chapters.zh: 现在亚拿突人耶利米向你们自称为先知，你们为何没有责备他呢？

chapters.en: For he has sent to us in Babylon, claiming: Since the exile will be lengthy, build houses and settle down; plant gardens and eat their produce.’”
chapters.zh: 因为他寄信给我们在巴比伦的人说：〔被掳的事〕必长久。你们要盖造房屋，住在其中；栽种田园，吃其中所产的。』」

chapters.en: (Zephaniah the priest, however, had read this letter to Jeremiah the prophet.)
chapters.zh: 祭司西番雅就把这信念给先知耶利米听。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
chapters.zh: 于是耶和华的话临到耶利米说：

chapters.en: “Send a message telling all the exiles what the LORD says concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite. Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you—though I did not send him—and has made you trust in a lie,
chapters.zh: 「你当寄信给一切被掳的人说：『耶和华论到尼希兰人示玛雅说：因为示玛雅向你们说预言，我并没有差遣他，他使你们倚靠谎言；

chapters.en: this is what the LORD says: ‘I will surely punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his descendants. He will have no one left among this people, nor will he see the good that I will bring to My people, declares the LORD, for he has preached rebellion against the LORD.’”
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华如此说：我必刑罚尼希兰人示玛雅和他的后裔，他必无一人存留住在这民中，也不得见我所要赐与我百姓的福乐，因为他向耶和华说了叛逆的话。这是耶和华说的。』」

chapters.en: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说：

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Write in a book all the words that I have spoken to you.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：你将我对你说过的一切话都写在书上。

chapters.en: For behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will restore from captivity My people Israel and Judah, declares the LORD. I will restore them to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they will possess it.’”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：日子将到，我要使我的百姓以色列和犹大被掳的人归回；我也要使他们回到我所赐给他们列祖之地，他们就得这地为业。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: These are the words that the LORD spoke concerning Israel and Judah.
chapters.zh: 以下是耶和华论到以色列和犹大所说的话：

chapters.en:
Yes, this is what the LORD says:
“A cry of panic is heard— a cry of terror, not of peace.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：我们听见声音， 是战抖惧怕而不平安的声音。

chapters.en:
Ask now, and see: Can a male give birth? Why then do I see every man with his hands on his stomach like a woman in labor
and every face turned pale?
chapters.zh: 你们且访问看看， 男人有产难吗？ 我怎么看见人人用手掐腰， 像产难的妇人， 脸面都变青了呢？

chapters.en: How awful that day will be! None will be like it! It is the time of Jacob’s distress, but he will be saved out of it.
chapters.zh: 哀哉！那日为大， 无日可比； 这是雅各遭难的时候， 但他必被救出来。

chapters.en:
On that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, I will break the yoke off their necks and tear off their bonds,
and no longer will strangers enslave them.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说：「到那日，我必从你颈项上折断仇敌的轭，扭开他的绳索；外邦人不得再使你作他们的奴仆。

chapters.en:
Instead, they will serve the LORD their God and David their king,
whom I will raise up for them.
chapters.zh: 你们却要事奉耶和华－你们的上帝和我为你们所要兴起的王大卫。」

chapters.en: As for you, O Jacob My servant, do not be afraid, declares the LORD, and do not be dismayed, O Israel. For I will surely save you out of a distant place, your descendants from the land of their captivity! Jacob will return to quiet and ease, with no one to make him afraid.
chapters.zh: 故此，耶和华说： 我的仆人雅各啊，不要惧怕； 以色列啊，不要惊惶； 因我要从远方拯救你， 从被掳到之地拯救你的后裔； 雅各必回来得享平靖安逸， 无人使他害怕。

chapters.en: For I am with you to save you, declares the LORD. Though I will completely destroy all the nations to which I have scattered you, I will not completely destroy you. Yet I will discipline you justly, and will by no means leave you unpunished.”
chapters.zh: 因我与你同在，要拯救你， 也要将所赶散你到的那些国灭绝净尽， 却不将你灭绝净尽，倒要从宽惩治你， 万不能不罚你〔注：不罚你：或译以你为无罪〕。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
For this is what the LORD says:
“Your injury is incurable; your wound is grievous.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 你的损伤无法医治； 你的伤痕极其重大。

chapters.en:
There is no one to plead your cause, no remedy for your sores,
no recovery for you.
chapters.zh: 无人为你分诉， 使你的伤痕得以缠裹； 你没有医治的良药。

chapters.en: All your lovers have forgotten you; they no longer seek you, for I have struck you as an enemy would, with the discipline of someone cruel, because of your great iniquity and your numerous sins.
chapters.zh: 你所亲爱的都忘记你， 不来探问〔注：或译：理会〕你。 我因你的罪孽甚大，罪恶众多， 曾用仇敌加的伤害伤害你， 用残忍者的惩治惩治你。

chapters.en:
Why do you cry out over your wound? Your pain has no cure! Because of your great iniquity and your numerous sins
I have done these things to you.
chapters.zh: 你为何因损伤哀号呢？ 你的痛苦无法医治。 我因你的罪孽甚大，罪恶众多， 曾将这些加在你身上。

chapters.en:
Nevertheless, all who devour you will be devoured, and all your adversaries—every one of them—
will go off into exile. Those who plundered you will be plundered, and all who raided you will be raided.
chapters.zh: 故此，凡吞吃你的必被吞吃； 你的敌人个个都被掳去； 掳掠你的必成为掳物； 抢夺你的必成为掠物。

chapters.en: But I will restore your health and heal your wounds, declares the LORD, because they call you an outcast, Zion, for whom no one cares.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：我必使你痊愈， 医好你的伤痕， 都因人称你为被赶散的， 〔说〕：这是锡安，无人来探问〔注：或译：理会〕的！

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“I will restore the fortunes of Jacob’s tents and have compassion on his dwellings. And the city will be rebuilt on her own ruins, and the palace will stand in its rightful place.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 我必使雅各被掳去的帐棚归回， 也必顾惜他的住处。 城必建造在原旧的山冈； 宫殿也照旧有人居住。

chapters.en: Thanksgiving will proceed from them, a sound of celebration. I will multiply them, and they will not be decreased; I will honor them, and they will not be belittled.
chapters.zh: 必有感谢和欢乐的声音从其中发出， 我要使他们增多，不致减少； 使他们尊荣，不致卑微。

chapters.en:
Their children will be as in days of old, and their congregation will be established before Me;
and I will punish all their oppressors.
chapters.zh: 他们的儿女要如往日； 他们的会众坚立在我面前； 凡欺压他们的，我必刑罚他。

chapters.en: Their leader will be one of their own, and their ruler will arise from their midst. And I will bring him near, and he will approach Me, for who would dare on his own to approach Me?” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们的君王必是属乎他们的； 掌权的必从他们中间而出。 我要使他就近我， 他也要亲近我； 不然，谁有胆量亲近我呢？ 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “And you will be My people, and I will be your God.”
chapters.zh: 你们要作我的子民， 我要作你们的上帝。

chapters.en: Behold, the storm of the LORD has gone out with fury, a whirlwind swirling down upon the heads of the wicked.
chapters.zh: 看哪，耶和华的忿怒 好像暴风已经发出； 是扫灭的暴风， 必转到恶人的头上。

chapters.en: The fierce anger of the LORD will not turn back until He has fully accomplished the purposes of His heart. In the days to come you will understand this.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的烈怒必不转消， 直到他心中所拟定的成就了； 末后的日子你们要明白。

chapters.en: “At that time,” declares the LORD, “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be My people.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「那时，我必作以色列各家的上帝；他们必作我的子民。」

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“The people who survived the sword found favor in the wilderness
when Israel went to find rest.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 脱离刀剑的就是以色列人。 我使他享安息的时候， 他曾在旷野蒙恩。

chapters.en:
The LORD appeared to us in the past, saying:
“I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore I have drawn you with loving devotion.
chapters.zh: 古时〔注：或译：从远方〕耶和华向以色列〔注：原文是我〕显现，〔说〕： 我以永远的爱爱你， 因此我以慈爱吸引你。

chapters.en: Again I will build you, and you will be rebuilt, O Virgin Israel. Again you will take up your tambourines and go out in joyful dancing.
chapters.zh: 以色列的民〔注：原文是处女〕哪， 我要再建立你，你就被建立； 你必再以击鼓为美， 与欢乐的人一同跳舞而出；

chapters.en: Again you will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria; the farmers will plant and enjoy the fruit.
chapters.zh: 又必在撒马利亚的山上栽种葡萄园， 栽种的人要享用〔所结的果子〕。

chapters.en: For there will be a day when watchmen will call out on the hills of Ephraim, ‘Arise, let us go up to Zion, to the LORD our God!’”
chapters.zh: 日子必到，以法莲山上守望的人必呼叫说： 起来吧！我们可以上锡安， 到耶和华－我们的上帝那里去。

chapters.en:
For this is what the LORD says:
“Sing with joy for Jacob; shout for the foremost of the nations! Make your praises heard, and say, ‘O LORD, save Your people,
the remnant of Israel!’
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 你们当为雅各欢乐歌唱， 因万国中为首的欢呼。 当传扬颂赞说： 耶和华啊， 求你拯救你的百姓以色列所剩下的人。

chapters.en:
Behold, I will bring them from the land of the north and gather them from the farthest parts of the earth, including the blind and the lame, expectant mothers and women in labor.
They will return as a great assembly!
chapters.zh: 我必将他们从北方领来， 从地极招聚； 同着他们来的有瞎子、瘸子、孕妇、产妇； 他们必成为大帮回到这里来。

chapters.en: They will come with weeping, and by their supplication I will lead them; I will make them walk beside streams of waters, on a level path where they will not stumble. For I am Israel’s Father, and Ephraim is My firstborn.”
chapters.zh: 他们要哭泣而来。 我要照他们恳求的引导他们， 使他们在河水旁走正直的路， 在其上不致绊跌； 因为我是以色列的父， 以法莲是我的长子。

chapters.en:
Hear, O nations, the word of the LORD, and proclaim it in distant coastlands:
“The One who scattered Israel will gather them and keep them as a shepherd keeps his flock.
chapters.zh: 列国啊，要听耶和华的话， 传扬在远处的海岛说： 赶散以色列的必招聚他， 又看守他，好像牧人看守羊群。

chapters.en: For the LORD has ransomed Jacob and redeemed him from the hand that had overpowered him.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华救赎了雅各， 救赎他脱离比他更强之人的手。

chapters.en: They will come and shout for joy on the heights of Zion; they will be radiant over the bounty of the LORD— the grain, new wine, and oil, and the young of the flocks and herds. Their life will be like a well-watered garden, and never again will they languish.
chapters.zh: 他们要来到锡安的高处歌唱， 又流归耶和华施恩〔之地〕， 就是有五谷、新酒，和油， 并羊羔、牛犊〔之地〕。 他们的心必像浇灌的园子； 他们也不再有一点愁烦。

chapters.en: Then the maidens will rejoice with dancing, young men and old as well. I will turn their mourning into joy, and give them comfort and joy for their sorrow.
chapters.zh: 那时，处女必欢乐跳舞； 年少的、年老的，也必一同欢乐； 因为我要使他们的悲哀变为欢喜， 并要安慰他们，使他们的愁烦转为快乐。

chapters.en: I will fill the souls of the priests abundantly, and will fill My people with My goodness,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必以肥油使祭司的心满足； 我的百姓也要因我的恩惠知足。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“A voice is heard in Ramah, mourning and great weeping, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted,
because they are no more.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 在拉玛听见号咷痛哭的声音， 是拉结哭她儿女，不肯受安慰， 因为他们都不在了。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“Keep your voice from weeping and your eyes from tears, for the reward for your work will come, declares the LORD. Then your children will return from the land of the enemy.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 你禁止声音不要哀哭， 禁止眼目不要流泪， 因你所做之工必有赏赐； 他们必从敌国归回。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: So there is hope for your future, declares the LORD, and your children will return to their own land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：你末后必有指望； 你的儿女必回到自己的境界。

chapters.en:
I have surely heard Ephraim’s moaning:
‘You disciplined me severely, like an untrained calf. Restore me, that I may return, for You are the LORD my God.
chapters.zh: 我听见以法莲为自己悲叹说： 你责罚我，我便受责罚， 像不惯〔负轭〕的牛犊一样。 求你使我回转，我便回转， 因为你是耶和华－我的上帝。

chapters.en: After I returned, I repented; and after I was instructed, I struck my thigh in grief. I was ashamed and humiliated because I bore the disgrace of my youth.’
chapters.zh: 我回转以后就真正懊悔； 受教以后就拍腿〔叹息〕； 我因担当幼年的凌辱就抱愧蒙羞。

chapters.en: Is not Ephraim a precious son to Me, a delightful child? Though I often speak against him, I still remember him. Therefore My heart yearns for him; I have great compassion for him,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：以法莲是我的爱子吗？ 是可喜悦的孩子吗？ 我每逢责备他，仍深顾念他； 所以我的心肠恋慕他； 我必要怜悯他。

chapters.en: “Set up the road markers, put up the signposts. Keep the highway in mind, the road you have traveled. Return, O Virgin Israel, return to these cities of yours.
chapters.zh: 以色列民〔注：原文是处女〕哪， 你当为自己设立指路碑， 竖起引路柱。 你要留心向大路， 就是你所去的原路； 你当回转，回转到你这些城邑。

chapters.en: How long will you wander, O faithless daughter? For the LORD has created a new thing in the land— a woman will shelter a man.”
chapters.zh: 背道的民〔注：原文是女子〕哪， 你反来覆去要到几时呢？ 耶和华在地上造了一件新事， 就是女子护卫男子。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “When I restore them from captivity, they will once again speak this word in the land of Judah and in its cities: ‘May the LORD bless you, O righteous dwelling place, O holy mountain.’
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：「我使被掳之人归回的时候，他们在犹大地和其中的城邑必再这样说： 公义的居所啊， 圣山哪，愿耶和华赐福给你。

chapters.en: And Judah and all its cities will dwell together in the land, the farmers and those who move with the flocks,
chapters.zh: 犹大和属犹大城邑的人，农夫和放羊的人，要一同住在其中。

chapters.en: for I will refresh the weary soul and replenish all who are weak.”
chapters.zh: 疲乏的人，我使他饱饫；愁烦的人，我使他知足。」

chapters.en: At this I awoke and looked around. My sleep had been most pleasant to me.
chapters.zh: 〔先知说〕：「我醒了，觉着睡得香甜！」

chapters.en: “The days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man and of beast.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「日子将到，我要把人的种和牲畜的种播种在以色列家和犹大家。

chapters.en: Just as I watched over them to uproot and tear down, to demolish, destroy, and bring disaster, so I will watch over them to build and to plant,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我先前怎样留意将他们拔出、拆毁、毁坏、倾覆、苦害，也必照样留意将他们建立、栽植。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
“In those days, it will no longer be said:
‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the teeth of the children are set on edge.’
chapters.zh: 当那些日子，人不再说： 父亲吃了酸葡萄， 儿子的牙酸倒了。

chapters.en: Instead, each will die for his own iniquity. If anyone eats the sour grapes, his own teeth will be set on edge.
chapters.zh: 但各人必因自己的罪死亡；凡吃酸葡萄的，自己的牙必酸倒。」

chapters.en: Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「日子将到，我要与以色列家和犹大家另立新约，

chapters.en: It will not be like the covenant I made with their fathers when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt— a covenant they broke, though I was a husband to them, ” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 不像我拉着他们祖宗的手，领他们出埃及地的时候，与他们所立的约。我虽作他们的丈夫，他们却背了我的约。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: “But this is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the LORD. I will put My law in their minds and inscribe it on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they will be My people.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「那些日子以后，我与以色列家所立的约乃是这样：我要将我的律法放在他们里面，写在他们心上。我要作他们的上帝，他们要作我的子民。

chapters.en: No longer will each man teach his neighbor or his brother, saying, ‘Know the LORD,’ because they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest, declares the LORD. For I will forgive their iniquities and will remember their sins no more.”
chapters.zh: 他们各人不再教导自己的邻舍和自己的弟兄说：『你该认识耶和华』，因为他们从最小的到至大的都必认识我。我要赦免他们的罪孽，不再记念他们的罪恶。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: Thus says the LORD, who gives the sun for light by day, who sets in order the moon and stars for light by night, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar—the LORD of Hosts is His name:
chapters.zh: 那使太阳白日发光， 使星月有定例，黑夜发亮， 又搅动大海，使海中波浪匉訇的， 万军之耶和华是他的名。 他如此说：

chapters.en: “Only if this fixed order departed from My presence, declares the LORD, would Israel’s descendants ever cease to be a nation before Me.”
chapters.zh: 这些定例若能在我面前废掉， 以色列的后裔也就在我面前断绝， 永远不再成国。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“Only if the heavens above could be measured and the foundations of the earth below searched out would I reject all of Israel’s descendants because of all they have done,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 若能量度上天， 寻察下地的根基， 我就因以色列后裔一切所行的弃绝他们。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “The days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when this city will be rebuilt for Me, from the tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「日子将到，这城必为耶和华建造，从哈楠业楼直到角门。

chapters.en: The measuring line will once again stretch out straight to the hill of Gareb and then turn toward Goah.
chapters.zh: 准绳要往外量出，直到迦立山，又转到歌亚。

chapters.en: The whole valley of the dead bodies and ashes, and all the fields as far as the Kidron Valley, to the corner of the Horse Gate to the east, will be holy to the LORD. It will never again be uprooted or demolished.”
chapters.zh: 抛尸的全谷和倒灰之处，并一切田地，直到汲沦溪，又直到东方马门的拐角，都要归耶和华为圣，不再拔出，不再倾覆，直到永远。」

chapters.en: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.
chapters.zh: 犹大王西底家第十年，就是尼布甲尼撒十八年，耶和华的话临到耶利米。

chapters.en: At that time the army of the king of Babylon was besieging Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet was imprisoned in the courtyard of the guard, which was in the palace of the king of Judah.
chapters.zh: 那时巴比伦王的军队围困耶路撒冷，先知耶利米囚在护卫兵的院内，在犹大王的宫中；

chapters.en: For Zedekiah king of Judah had imprisoned him, saying: “Why are you prophesying like this? You claim that the LORD says, ‘Behold, I am about to deliver this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it.
chapters.zh: 因为犹大王西底家已将他囚禁，说：「你为什么预言说，耶和华如此说：『我必将这城交在巴比伦王的手中，他必攻取这城。

chapters.en: Zedekiah king of Judah will not escape from the hands of the Chaldeans, but he will surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and will speak with him face to face and see him eye to eye.
chapters.zh: 犹大王西底家必不能逃脱迦勒底人的手，定要交在巴比伦王的手中，要口对口彼此说话，眼对眼彼此相看。

chapters.en: He will take Zedekiah to Babylon, where he will stay until I attend to him, declares the LORD. If you fight against the Chaldeans, you will not succeed.’”
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王必将西底家带到巴比伦；西底家必住在那里，直到我眷顾他的时候。你们虽与迦勒底人争战，却不顺利。这是耶和华说的。』」

chapters.en: Jeremiah replied, “The word of the LORD came to me, saying:
chapters.zh: 耶利米说：「耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: Behold! Hanamel, the son of your uncle Shallum, is coming to you to say, ‘Buy for yourself my field in Anathoth, for you have the right of redemption to buy it.’
chapters.zh: 『你叔叔沙龙的儿子哈拿篾必来见你，说：我在亚拿突的那块地，求你买来；因你买这地是合乎赎回之理。』」

chapters.en:
Then, as the LORD had said, my cousin Hanamel came to me in the courtyard of the guard and urged me, ‘Please buy my field in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin, for you own the right of inheritance and redemption. Buy it for yourself.’”
Then I knew that this was the word of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我叔叔的儿子哈拿篾果然照耶和华的话来到护卫兵的院内，对我说：「我在便雅悯境内、亚拿突的那块地，求你买来；因你买来是合乎承受之理，是你当赎的。你为自己买来吧！」我－耶利米就知道这是耶和华的话。

chapters.en: So I bought the field in Anathoth from my cousin Hanamel, and I weighed out seventeen shekels of silver.
chapters.zh: 我便向我叔叔的儿子哈拿篾买了亚拿突的那块地，平了十七舍客勒银子给他。

chapters.en: I signed and sealed the deed, called in witnesses, and weighed out the silver on the scales.
chapters.zh: 我在契上画押，将契封缄，又请见证人来，并用天平将银子平给他。

chapters.en: Then I took the deed of purchase—the sealed copy with its terms and conditions, as well as the open copy—
chapters.zh: 我便将〔照〕例〔按〕规〔所立的〕买契，就是封缄的那一张和敞着的那一张，

chapters.en: and I gave this deed to Baruch son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the sight of my cousin Hanamel and the witnesses who were signing the purchase agreement and all the Jews sitting in the courtyard of the guard.
chapters.zh: 当着我叔叔的儿子哈拿篾和画押作见证的人，并坐在护卫兵院内的一切犹大人眼前，交给玛西雅的孙子尼利亚的儿子巴录。

chapters.en: In their sight I instructed Baruch,
chapters.zh: 当着他们众人眼前，我嘱咐巴录说：

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Take these deeds—both the sealed copy and the open copy of the deed of purchase—and put them in a clay jar to preserve them for a long time.
chapters.zh: 「万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：要将这封缄的和敞着的两张契放在瓦器里，可以存留多日。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Houses, fields, and vineyards will again be bought in this land.”
chapters.zh: 因为万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：将来在这地必有人再买房屋、田地，和葡萄园。」

chapters.en: After I had given the deed of purchase to Baruch son of Neriah, I prayed to the LORD:
chapters.zh: 我将买契交给尼利亚的儿子巴录以后，便祷告耶和华说：

chapters.en: “Oh, Lord GOD! You have made the heavens and the earth by Your great power and outstretched arm. Nothing is too difficult for You!
chapters.zh: 「主耶和华啊，你曾用大能和伸出来的膀臂创造天地，在你没有难成的事。

chapters.en: You show loving devotion to thousands but lay the iniquity of the fathers into the laps of their children after them, O great and mighty God whose name is the LORD of Hosts,
chapters.zh: 你施慈爱与千万人，又将父亲的罪孽报应在他后世子孙的怀中，是至大全能的上帝，万军之耶和华是你的名。

chapters.en: the One great in counsel and mighty in deed, whose eyes are on all the ways of the sons of men, to reward each one according to his ways and according to the fruit of his deeds.
chapters.zh: 谋事有大略，行事有大能，注目观看世人一切的举动，为要照各人所行的和他做事的结果报应他。

chapters.en: You performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, and You do so to this very day, both in Israel and among all mankind. And You have made a name for Yourself, as is the case to this day.
chapters.zh: 在埃及地显神迹奇事，直到今日在以色列和〔别〕人中间也是如此，使自己得了名声，正如今日一样。

chapters.en: You brought Your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs and wonders, with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and with great terror.
chapters.zh: 用神迹奇事和大能的手，并伸出来的膀臂与大可畏的事，领你的百姓以色列出了埃及。

chapters.en: You gave them this land that You had sworn to give their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.
chapters.zh: 将这地赐给他们，就是你向他们列祖起誓应许赐给他们流奶与蜜之地。

chapters.en: They came in and possessed it, but they did not obey Your voice or walk in Your law. They failed to perform all that You commanded them to do, and so You have brought upon them all this disaster.
chapters.zh: 他们进入这地得了为业，却不听从你的话，也不遵行你的律法；你一切所吩咐他们行的，他们一无所行，因此你使这一切的灾祸临到他们。

chapters.en: See how the siege ramps are mounted against the city to capture it. And by sword and famine and plague, the city has been given into the hands of the Chaldeans who are fighting against it. What You have spoken has happened, as You now see!
chapters.zh: 看哪，敌人已经来到，筑垒要攻取这城；城也因刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫交在攻城的迦勒底人手中。你所说的话都成就了，你也看见了。

chapters.en: Yet You, O Lord GOD, have said to me, ‘Buy for yourself the field with silver and call in witnesses, even though the city has been delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans!’”
chapters.zh: 主耶和华啊，你对我说：要用银子为自己买那块地，又请见证人。其实这城已交在迦勒底人的手中了。」

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说：

chapters.en: “Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh. Is anything too difficult for Me?
chapters.zh: 「我是耶和华，是凡有血气者的上帝，岂有我难成的事吗？

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD says: Behold, I am about to deliver this city into the hands of the Chaldeans and of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who will capture it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：我必将这城交付迦勒底人的手和巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手，他必攻取这城。

chapters.en: And the Chaldeans who are fighting against this city will come in, set it on fire, and burn it, along with the houses of those who provoked Me to anger by burning incense to Baal on their rooftops and by pouring out drink offerings to other gods.
chapters.zh: 攻城的迦勒底人必来放火焚烧这城和其中的房屋。在这房屋上，人曾向巴力烧香，向别神浇奠，惹我发怒。

chapters.en: For the children of Israel and of Judah have done nothing but evil in My sight from their youth; indeed, they have done nothing but provoke Me to anger by the work of their hands, declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以色列人和犹大人自从幼年以来，专行我眼中看为恶的事；以色列人尽以手所做的惹我发怒。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: For this city has aroused My wrath and fury from the day it was built until now. Therefore I will remove it from My presence
chapters.zh: 这城自从建造的那日直到今日，常惹我的怒气和忿怒，使我将这城从我面前除掉；

chapters.en: because of all the evil the children of Israel and of Judah have done to provoke Me to anger—they, their kings, their officials, their priests and prophets, the men of Judah, and the residents of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 是因以色列人和犹大人一切的邪恶，就是他们和他们的君王、首领、祭司、先知，并犹大的众人，以及耶路撒冷的居民所行的，惹我发怒。

chapters.en: They have turned their backs to Me and not their faces. Though I taught them again and again, they would not listen or respond to discipline.
chapters.zh: 他们以背向我，不以面向我；我虽从早起来教训他们，他们却不听从，不受教训，

chapters.en: They have placed their abominations in the house that bears My Name, and so have defiled it.
chapters.zh: 竟把可憎之物设立在称为我名下的殿中，污秽了这殿。

chapters.en: They have built the high places of Baal in the Valley of Ben-hinnom to make their sons and daughters pass through the fire to Molech—something I never commanded them, nor had it ever entered My mind, that they should commit such an abomination and cause Judah to sin.
chapters.zh: 他们在欣嫩子谷建筑巴力的邱坛，好使自己的儿女经火归摩洛；他们行这可憎的事，使犹大陷在罪里，这并不是我所吩咐的，也不是我心所起的意。」

chapters.en: Now therefore, about this city of which you say, ‘It will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by sword and famine and plague,’ this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says:
chapters.zh: 现在论到这城，就是你们所说、已经因刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫交在巴比伦王手中的，耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：

chapters.en: I will surely gather My people from all the lands to which I have banished them in My furious anger and great wrath, and I will return them to this place and make them dwell in safety.
chapters.zh: 「我在怒气、忿怒，和大恼恨中，将以色列人赶到各国。日后我必从那里将他们招聚出来，领他们回到此地，使他们安然居住。

chapters.en: They will be My people, and I will be their God.
chapters.zh: 他们要作我的子民，我要作他们的上帝。

chapters.en: I will give them one heart and one way, so that they will always fear Me for their own good and for the good of their children after them.
chapters.zh: 我要使他们彼此同心同道，好叫他们永远敬畏我，使他们和他们后世的子孙得福乐，

chapters.en: I will make an everlasting covenant with them: I will never turn away from doing good to them, and I will put My fear in their hearts, so that they will never turn away from Me.
chapters.zh: 又要与他们立永远的约，必随着他们施恩，并不离开他们，且使他们有敬畏我的心，不离开我。

chapters.en: Yes, I will rejoice in doing them good, and I will faithfully plant them in this land with all My heart and with all My soul.
chapters.zh: 我必欢喜施恩与他们，要尽心尽意、诚诚实实将他们栽于此地。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD says: Just as I have brought all this great disaster on this people, so I will bring on them all the good I have promised them.
chapters.zh: 「因为耶和华如此说：我怎样使这一切大祸临到这百姓，我也要照样使我所应许他们的一切福乐都临到他们。

chapters.en: And fields will be bought in this land about which you are saying, ‘It is a desolation, without man or beast; it has been delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans.’
chapters.zh: 你们说，这地是荒凉、无人民、无牲畜，是交付迦勒底人手之地。日后在这境内，必有人置买田地。

chapters.en: Fields will be purchased with silver, and deeds will be signed, sealed, and witnessed in the land of Benjamin, in the areas surrounding Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah—the cities of the hill country, the foothills, and the Negev—because I will restore them from captivity, declares the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 在便雅悯地、耶路撒冷四围的各处、犹大的城邑、山地的城邑、高原的城邑，并南地的城邑，人必用银子买田地，在契上画押，将契封缄，请出见证人，因为我必使被掳的人归回。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: While Jeremiah was still confined in the courtyard of the guard, the word of the LORD came to him a second time:
chapters.zh: 耶利米还囚在护卫兵的院内，耶和华的话第二次临到他说：

chapters.en: “Thus says the LORD who made the earth, the LORD who formed it and established it, the LORD is His name:
chapters.zh: 「成就的是耶和华，造作、为要建立的也是耶和华；耶和华是他的名。他如此说：

chapters.en: Call to Me, and I will answer and show you great and unsearchable things you do not know.
chapters.zh: 你求告我，我就应允你，并将你所不知道、又大又难的事指示你。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says about the houses of this city and the palaces of the kings of Judah that have been torn down for defense against the siege ramps and the sword:
chapters.zh: 论到这城中的房屋和犹大王的宫室，就是拆毁为挡〔敌人〕高垒和刀剑的，耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：

chapters.en: The Chaldeans are coming to fight and to fill those places with the corpses of the men I will strike down in My anger and in My wrath. I have hidden My face from this city because of all its wickedness.
chapters.zh: 人要与迦勒底人争战，正是拿死尸充满这房屋，就是我在怒气和忿怒中所杀的人，因他们的一切恶，我就掩面不顾这城。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, I will bring to it health and healing, and I will heal its people and reveal to them the abundance of peace and truth.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我要使这城得以痊愈安舒，使城中的人得医治，又将丰盛的平安和诚实显明与他们。

chapters.en: I will restore Judah and Israel from captivity and will rebuild them as in former times.
chapters.zh: 我也要使犹大被掳的和以色列被掳的归回，并建立他们和起初一样。

chapters.en: And I will cleanse them from all the iniquity they have committed against Me, and will forgive all their sins of rebellion against Me.
chapters.zh: 我要除净他们的一切罪，就是向我所犯的罪；又要赦免他们的一切罪，就是干犯我、违背我的罪。

chapters.en: So this city will bring Me renown, joy, praise, and glory before all the nations of the earth, who will hear of all the good I do for it. They will tremble in awe because of all the goodness and prosperity that I will provide for it.
chapters.zh: 这城要在地上万国人面前使我得颂赞，得荣耀，名为可喜可乐之城。万国人因听见我向这城所赐的福乐、所施的恩惠平安，就惧怕战兢。」

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: In this place you say is a wasteland without man or beast, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem that are deserted—inhabited by neither man nor beast—there will be heard again
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：「你们论这地方，说是荒废无人民无牲畜之地，但在这荒凉无人民无牲畜的犹大城邑和耶路撒冷的街上，

chapters.en:
the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of the bride and bridegroom, and the voices of those bringing thank offerings into the house of the LORD, saying:
‘Give thanks to the LORD of Hosts, for the LORD is good;
His loving devotion endures forever.’
For I will restore the land from captivity as in former times, says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 必再听见有欢喜和快乐的声音、新郎和新妇的声音，并听见有人说： 要称谢万军之耶和华， 因耶和华本为善； 他的慈爱永远〔长存〕！ 又有奉感谢〔祭〕到耶和华殿中之人的声音；因为我必使这地被掳的人归回，和起初一样。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: In this desolate place, without man or beast, and in all its cities, there will once more be pastures for shepherds to rest their flocks.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「在这荒废无人民无牲畜之地，并其中所有的城邑，必再有牧人的住处；他们要使羊群躺卧在那里。

chapters.en: In the cities of the hill country, the foothills, and the Negev, in the land of Benjamin and the cities surrounding Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, the flocks will again pass under the hands of the one who counts them, says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 在山地的城邑、高原的城邑、南地的城邑、便雅悯地、耶路撒冷四围的各处，和犹大的城邑必再有羊群从数点的人手下经过。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will fulfill the gracious promise that I have spoken to the house of Israel and the house of Judah.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「日子将到，我应许以色列家和犹大家的恩言必然成就。

chapters.en: In those days and at that time I will cause to sprout for David a righteous Branch, and He will administer justice and righteousness in the land.
chapters.zh: 当那日子，那时候，我必使大卫公义的苗裔长起来；他必在地上施行公平和公义。

chapters.en: In those days Judah will be saved, and Jerusalem will dwell securely, and this is the name by which it will be called: The LORD Our Righteousness.
chapters.zh: 在那日子犹大必得救，耶路撒冷必安然居住，他〔的名〕必称为『耶和华－我们的义』。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD says: David will never lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel,
chapters.zh: 「因为耶和华如此说：大卫必永不断人坐在以色列家的宝座上；

chapters.en: nor will the priests who are Levites ever fail to have a man before Me to offer burnt offerings, to burn grain offerings, and to present sacrifices.”
chapters.zh: 祭司、利未人在我面前也不断人献燔祭、烧素祭，时常办理献祭的事。」

chapters.en: And the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说：

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD says: If you can break My covenant with the day and My covenant with the night, so that day and night cease to occupy their appointed time,
chapters.zh: 「耶和华如此说：你们若能废弃我所立白日黑夜的约，使白日黑夜不按时轮转，

chapters.en: then My covenant may also be broken with David My servant and with My ministers the Levites who are priests, so that David will not have a son to reign on his throne.
chapters.zh: 就能废弃我与我仆人大卫所立的约，使他没有儿子在他的宝座上为王，并能废弃我与事奉我的祭司、利未人所立的约。

chapters.en: As the hosts of heaven cannot be counted and as the sand on the seashore cannot be measured, so too will I multiply the descendants of My servant David and the Levites who minister before Me.”
chapters.zh: 天上的万象不能数算，海边的尘沙也不能斗量；我必照样使我仆人大卫的后裔和事奉我的利未人多起来。」

chapters.en: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说：

chapters.en: “Have you not noticed what these people are saying: ‘The LORD has rejected the two families He had chosen’? So they despise My people and no longer regard them as a nation.
chapters.zh: 「你没有揣摩这百姓的话吗？他们说：『耶和华所拣选的二族，他已经弃绝了。』他们这样藐视我的百姓，以为不再成国。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: If I have not established My covenant with the day and the night and the fixed order of heaven and earth,
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：若是我立白日黑夜的约不能〔存住〕，若是我未曾安排天地的定例，

chapters.en: then I would also reject the descendants of Jacob and of My servant David, so as not to take from his descendants rulers over the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. For I will restore them from captivity and will have compassion on them.”
chapters.zh: 我就弃绝雅各的后裔和我仆人大卫的后裔，不使大卫的后裔治理亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的后裔；因为我必使他们被掳的人归回，也必怜悯他们。」

chapters.en: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, all his army, all the earthly kingdoms under his control, and all the other nations were fighting against Jerusalem and all its surrounding cities.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领他的全军和地上属他的各国各邦，攻打耶路撒冷和属耶路撒冷所有的城邑。那时，耶和华的话临到耶利米说：

chapters.en: The LORD, the God of Israel, told Jeremiah to go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah and tell him that this is what the LORD says: “Behold, I am about to deliver this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it down.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华－以色列的上帝说，你去告诉犹大王西底家，耶和华如此说：我要将这城交付巴比伦王的手，他必用火焚烧。

chapters.en: And you yourself will not escape his grasp, but will surely be captured and delivered into his hand. You will see the king of Babylon eye to eye and speak with him face to face; and you will go to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 你必不能逃脱他的手，定被拿住，交在他的手中。你的眼要见巴比伦王的眼，他要口对口和你说话，你也必到巴比伦去。

chapters.en: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O Zedekiah king of Judah. This is what the LORD says concerning you: You will not die by the sword;
chapters.zh: 犹大王西底家啊，你还要听耶和华的话。耶和华论到你如此说：你必不被刀剑杀死，

chapters.en: you will die in peace. As spices were burned for your fathers, the former kings who preceded you, so people will burn spices for you and lament, ‘Alas, O master!’ For I Myself have spoken this word, declares the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 你必平安而死，人必为你焚烧〔物件〕，好像为你列祖，就是在你以前的先王焚烧一般。人必为你举哀〔说〕：『哀哉！我主啊。』耶和华说：这话是我说的。」

chapters.en: In Jerusalem, then, Jeremiah the prophet relayed all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah
chapters.zh: 于是，先知耶利米在耶路撒冷将这一切话告诉犹大王西底家。

chapters.en: as the army of the king of Babylon was fighting against Jerusalem and the remaining cities of Judah—against Lachish and Azekah. For these were the only fortified cities remaining in Judah.
chapters.zh: 那时，巴比伦王的军队正攻打耶路撒冷，又攻打犹大所剩下的城邑，就是拉吉和亚西加。原来犹大的坚固城〔只〕剩下这两座。

chapters.en: After King Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people in Jerusalem to proclaim liberty, the word came to Jeremiah from the LORD
that each man should free his Hebrew slaves, both male and female, and no one should hold his fellow Jew in bondage.
chapters.zh: 西底家王与耶路撒冷的众民立约，要向他们宣告自由，叫各人任他希伯来的仆人和婢女自由出去，谁也不可使他的一个犹大弟兄作奴仆。（此后，有耶和华的话临到耶利米。）

chapters.en: So all the officials and all the people who entered into this covenant agreed that they would free their menservants and maidservants and no longer hold them in bondage. They obeyed and released them,
chapters.zh: 所有立约的首领和众民就任他的仆人婢女自由出去，谁也不再叫他们作奴仆。大家都顺从，将他们释放了；

chapters.en: but later they changed their minds and took back the menservants and maidservants they had freed, and they forced them to become slaves again.
chapters.zh: 后来却又反悔，叫所任去自由的仆人婢女回来，勉强他们仍为仆婢。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
chapters.zh: 因此耶和华的话临到耶利米说：

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I made a covenant with your forefathers when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, saying:
chapters.zh: 「耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：我将你们的列祖从埃及地为奴之家领出来的时候，与他们立约说：

chapters.en: Every seventh year, each of you must free his Hebrew brother who has sold himself to you. He may serve you six years, but then you must let him go free. But your fathers did not listen or incline their ear.
chapters.zh: 『你的一个希伯来弟兄若卖给你，服事你六年，到第七年你们各人就要任他自由出去。』只是你们列祖不听从我，也不侧耳而听。

chapters.en: Recently you repented and did what pleased Me; each of you proclaimed freedom for his neighbor. You made a covenant before Me in the house that bears My Name.
chapters.zh: 如今你们回转，行我眼中看为正的事，各人向邻舍宣告自由，并且在称为我名下的殿中、在我面前立约。

chapters.en: But now you have changed your minds and profaned My name. Each of you has taken back the menservants and maidservants whom you had set at liberty to go wherever they wanted, and you have again forced them to be your slaves.
chapters.zh: 你们却又反悔，亵渎我的名，各人叫所任去随意自由的仆人婢女回来，勉强他们仍为仆婢。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD says: You have not obeyed Me; you have not proclaimed freedom, each man for his brother and for his neighbor. So now I proclaim freedom for you, declares the LORD—freedom to fall by sword, by plague, and by famine! I will make you a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华如此说：你们没有听从我，各人向弟兄邻舍宣告自由。看哪！我向你们宣告一样自由，就是使你们自由于刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫之下，并且使你们在天下万国中抛来抛去。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: And those who have transgressed My covenant and have not fulfilled the terms of the covenant they made before Me, I will treat like the calf they cut in two in order to pass between its pieces.
The officials of Judah and Jerusalem, the court officials, the priests, and all the people of the land who passed between the pieces of the calf,
chapters.zh: 犹大的首领、耶路撒冷的首领、太监、祭司，和国中的众民曾将牛犊劈开，分成两半，从其中经过，在我面前立约。后来又违背我的约，不遵行这约上的话。

chapters.en: I will deliver into the hands of their enemies who seek their lives. Their corpses will become food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth.
chapters.zh: 我必将他们交在仇敌和寻索其命的人手中；他们的尸首必给空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽作食物。

chapters.en: And I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah and his officials into the hands of their enemies who seek their lives, to the army of the king of Babylon that had withdrawn from you.
chapters.zh: 并且我必将犹大王西底家和他的首领交在他们仇敌和寻索其命的人，与那暂离你们而去巴比伦王军队的手中。

chapters.en: Behold, I am going to give the command, declares the LORD, and I will bring them back to this city. They will fight against it, capture it, and burn it down. And I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：我必吩咐他们回到这城，攻打这城，将城攻取，用火焚烧。我也要使犹大的城邑变为荒场，无人居住。」

chapters.en: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:
chapters.zh: 当犹大王约西亚之子约雅敬的时候，耶和华的话临到耶利米说：

chapters.en: “Go to the house of the Rechabites, speak to them, and bring them to one of the chambers of the house of the LORD to offer them a drink of wine.”
chapters.zh: 「你去见利甲族的人，和他们说话，领他们进入耶和华殿的一间屋子，给他们酒喝。」

chapters.en: So I took Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, and his brothers and all his sons—the entire house of the Rechabites—
chapters.zh: 我就将哈巴洗尼雅的孙子雅利米雅的儿子雅撒尼亚和他弟兄，并他众子，以及利甲全族的人，

chapters.en: and I brought them into the house of the LORD, to a chamber occupied by the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah, a man of God. This room was near the chamber of the officials, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah son of Shallum the doorkeeper.
chapters.zh: 领到耶和华的殿，进入神人伊基大利的儿子哈难众子的屋子。那屋子在首领的屋子旁边，在沙龙之子把门的玛西雅屋子以上。

chapters.en: Then I set pitchers full of wine and some cups before the men of the house of the Rechabites, and I said to them, “Drink some wine.”
chapters.zh: 于是我在利甲族人面前设摆盛满酒的碗和杯，对他们说：「请你们喝酒。」

chapters.en: “We do not drink wine,” they replied, “for our forefather Jonadab son of Rechab commanded us, ‘Neither you nor your descendants are ever to drink wine.
chapters.zh: 他们却说：「我们不喝酒；因为我们先祖利甲的儿子约拿达曾吩咐我们说：『你们与你们的子孙永不可喝酒，

chapters.en: Nor are you ever to build a house or sow seed or plant a vineyard. Those things are not for you. Instead, you must live in tents all your lives, so that you may live a long time in the land where you wander.’
chapters.zh: 也不可盖房、撒种、栽种葡萄园，但一生的年日要住帐棚，使你们的日子在寄居之地得以延长。』

chapters.en: And we have obeyed the voice of our forefather Jonadab son of Rechab in all he commanded us. So we have not drunk wine all our lives—neither we nor our wives nor our sons and daughters.
chapters.zh: 凡我们先祖利甲的儿子约拿达所吩咐我们的话，我们都听从了。我们和我们的妻子儿女一生的年日都不喝酒，

chapters.en: Nor have we built houses in which to live, and we have not owned any vineyards or fields or crops.
chapters.zh: 也不盖房居住，也没有葡萄园、田地，和种子，

chapters.en: But we have lived in tents and have obeyed and done exactly as our forefather Jonadab commanded us.
chapters.zh: 但住帐棚，听从我们先祖约拿达的话，照他所吩咐我们的去行。

chapters.en: So when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched into the land, we said: ‘Come, let us go into Jerusalem to escape the armies of the Chaldeans and the Arameans.’ So we have remained in Jerusalem.”
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒上此地来，我们因怕迦勒底的军队和亚兰的军队，就说：『来吧，我们到耶路撒冷去。』这样，我们才住在耶路撒冷。」

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说：

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Go and tell the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem: ‘Will you not accept discipline and obey My words?’ declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 「万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：你去对犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民说，耶和华说：你们不受教训，不听从我的话吗？

chapters.en: The words of Jonadab son of Rechab have been carried out. He commanded his sons not to drink wine, and they have not drunk it to this very day because they have obeyed the command of their forefather. But I have spoken to you again and again, and you have not obeyed Me!
chapters.zh: 利甲的儿子约拿达所吩咐他子孙不可喝酒的话，他们已经遵守，直到今日也不喝酒，因为他们听从先祖的吩咐。我从早起来警戒你们，你们却不听从我。

chapters.en: Again and again I have sent you all My servants the prophets, proclaiming: ‘Turn now, each of you, from your wicked ways, and correct your actions. Do not go after other gods to serve them. Live in the land that I have given to you and your fathers.’ But you have not inclined your ear or listened to Me.
chapters.zh: 我从早起来，差遣我的仆人众先知去，说：『你们各人当回头，离开恶道，改正行为，不随从事奉别神，就必住在我所赐给你们和你们列祖的地上。』只是你们没有听从我，也没有侧耳而听。

chapters.en: Yes, the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab carried out the command their forefather gave them, but these people have not listened to Me.
chapters.zh: 利甲的儿子约拿达的子孙能遵守先人所吩咐他们的命，这百姓却没有听从我！
