chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will bring to Judah and to all the residents of Jerusalem all the disaster I have pronounced against them, because I have spoken to them but they have not obeyed, and I have called to them but they have not answered.’”
chapters.zh: 因此，耶和华－万军之上帝、以色列的上帝如此说：我要使我所说的一切灾祸临到犹大人和耶路撒冷的一切居民。因为我对他们说话，他们没有听从；我呼唤他们，他们没有答应。」

chapters.en: Then Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites: “This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘Because you have obeyed the command of your forefather Jonadab and have kept all his commandments and have done all that he charged you to do,
chapters.zh: 耶利米对利甲族的人说：「万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：因你们听从你们先祖约拿达的吩咐，谨守他的一切诫命，照他所吩咐你们的去行，

chapters.en: this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Jonadab son of Rechab will never fail to have a man to stand before Me.’”
chapters.zh: 所以万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：利甲的儿子约拿达必永不缺人侍立在我面前。」

chapters.en: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
chapters.zh: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年，耶和华的话临到耶利米说：

chapters.en: “Take a scroll and write on it all the words I have spoken to you concerning Israel, Judah, and all the nations, from the day I first spoke to you during the reign of Josiah until today.
chapters.zh: 「你取一书卷，将我对你说攻击以色列和犹大，并各国的一切话，从我对你说话的那日，就是从约西亚的日子起直到今日，都写在其上。

chapters.en: Perhaps when the people of Judah hear about all the calamity I plan to bring upon them, each of them will turn from his wicked way. Then I will forgive their iniquity and their sin.”
chapters.zh: 或者犹大家听见我想要降与他们的一切灾祸，各人就回头，离开恶道，我好赦免他们的罪孽和罪恶。」

chapters.en: So Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah, and at the dictation of Jeremiah, Baruch wrote on a scroll all the words that the LORD had spoken to Jeremiah.
chapters.zh: 所以，耶利米召了尼利亚的儿子巴录来；巴录就从耶利米口中，将耶和华对耶利米所说的一切话写在书卷上。

chapters.en: Then Jeremiah commanded Baruch, “I am restricted; I cannot enter the house of the LORD;
chapters.zh: 耶利米吩咐巴录说：「我被拘管，不能进耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: so you are to go to the house of the LORD on a day of fasting, and in the hearing of the people you are to read the words of the LORD from the scroll you have written at my dictation. Read them in the hearing of all the people of Judah who are coming from their cities.
chapters.zh: 所以你要去趁禁食的日子，在耶和华殿中将耶和华的话，就是你从我口中所写在书卷上的话，念给百姓和一切从犹大城邑出来的人听。

chapters.en: Perhaps they will bring their petition before the LORD, and each one will turn from his wicked way; for great are the anger and fury that the LORD has pronounced against this people.”
chapters.zh: 或者他们在耶和华面前恳求各人回头，离开恶道，因为耶和华向这百姓所说要发的怒气和忿怒是大的。」

chapters.en: So Baruch son of Neriah did everything that Jeremiah the prophet had commanded him. In the house of the LORD he read the words of the LORD from the scroll.
chapters.zh: 尼利亚的儿子巴录就照先知耶利米一切所吩咐的去行，在耶和华的殿中从书上念耶和华的话。

chapters.en: Now in the ninth month of the fifth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, a fast before the LORD was proclaimed to all the people of Jerusalem and all who had come there from the cities of Judah.
chapters.zh: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第五年九月，耶路撒冷的众民和那从犹大城邑来到耶路撒冷的众民，在耶和华面前宣告禁食的日子，

chapters.en: From the chamber of Gemariah son of Shaphan the scribe, which was in the upper courtyard at the opening of the New Gate of the house of the LORD, Baruch read from the scroll the words of Jeremiah in the hearing of all the people.
chapters.zh: 巴录就在耶和华殿的上院，耶和华殿的新门口，沙番的儿子文士基玛利雅的屋内，念书上耶利米的话给众民听。

chapters.en: When Micaiah son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, heard all the words of the LORD from the scroll,
chapters.zh: 沙番的孙子、基玛利雅的儿子米该亚听见书上耶和华的一切话，

chapters.en: he went down to the scribe’s chamber in the king’s palace, where all the officials were sitting: Elishama the scribe, Delaiah son of Shemaiah, Elnathan son of Achbor, Gemariah son of Shaphan, Zedekiah son of Hananiah, and all the other officials.
chapters.zh: 他就下到王宫，进入文士的屋子。众首领，就是文士以利沙玛、示玛雅的儿子第莱雅、亚革波的儿子以利拿单、沙番的儿子基玛利雅、哈拿尼雅的儿子西底家，和其余的首领都坐在那里。

chapters.en: And Micaiah reported to them all the words he had heard Baruch read from the scroll in the hearing of the people.
chapters.zh: 于是米该亚对他们述说他所听见的一切话，就是巴录向百姓念那书的时候所听见的。

chapters.en:
Then all the officials sent word to Baruch through Jehudi son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, saying, “Bring the scroll that you read in the hearing of the people, and come here.”
So Baruch son of Neriah took the scroll and went to them.
chapters.zh: 众首领就打发古示的曾孙、示利米雅的孙子、尼探雅的儿子犹底到巴录那里，对他说：「你将所念给百姓听的书卷拿在手中到我们这里来。」尼利亚的儿子巴录就手拿书卷来到他们那里。

chapters.en:
“Please sit down,” they said, “and read it in our hearing.”
So Baruch read it in their hearing.
chapters.zh: 他们对他说：「请你坐下，念给我们听。」巴录就念给他们听。

chapters.en: When they had heard all these words, they turned to one another in fear and said to Baruch, “Surely we must report all these words to the king.”
chapters.zh: 他们听见这一切话就害怕，面面相观，对巴录说：「我们必须将这一切话告诉王。」

chapters.en: “Tell us now,” they asked Baruch, “how did you write all these words? Was it at Jeremiah’s dictation?”
chapters.zh: 他们问巴录说：「请你告诉我们，你怎样从他口中写这一切话呢？」

chapters.en: “It was at his dictation,” Baruch replied. “He recited all these words to me and I wrote them in ink on the scroll.”
chapters.zh: 巴录回答说：「他用口向我说这一切话，我就用笔墨写在书上。」

chapters.en: Then the officials said to Baruch, “You and Jeremiah must hide yourselves and tell no one where you are.”
chapters.zh: 众首领对巴录说：「你和耶利米要去藏起来，不可叫人知道你们在哪里。」

chapters.en: So the officials went to the king in the courtyard. And having stored the scroll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe, they reported everything to the king.
chapters.zh: 众首领进院见王，却先把书卷存在文士以利沙玛的屋内，以后将这一切话说给王听。

chapters.en: Then the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and he took it from the chamber of Elishama the scribe. And Jehudi read it in the hearing of the king and all the officials who were standing beside him.
chapters.zh: 王就打发犹底去拿这书卷来，他便从文士以利沙玛的屋内取来，念给王和王左右侍立的众首领听。

chapters.en: Since it was the ninth month, the king was sitting in his winter quarters with a fire burning before him.
chapters.zh: 那时正是九月，王坐在过冬的房屋里，王的前面火盆中〔有〕烧着的〔火〕。

chapters.en: And as soon as Jehudi had read three or four columns, Jehoiakim would cut them off with a scribe’s knife and throw them into the firepot, until the entire scroll had been consumed by the fire.
chapters.zh: 犹底念了三四篇〔注：或译：行〕，〔王〕就用文士的刀将书卷割破，扔在火盆中，直到全卷在火中烧尽了。

chapters.en: Yet in hearing all these words, the king and his servants did not become frightened or tear their garments.
chapters.zh: 王和听见这一切话的臣仆都不惧怕，也不撕裂衣服。

chapters.en: Even though Elnathan, Delaiah, and Gemariah urged the king not to burn the scroll, he would not listen to them.
chapters.zh: 以利拿单和第莱雅，并基玛利雅恳求王不要烧这书卷，他却不听。

chapters.en: Instead, the king commanded Jerahmeel, a son of the king, as well as Seraiah son of Azriel and Shelemiah son of Abdeel, to seize Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet. But the LORD had hidden them.
chapters.zh: 王就吩咐哈米勒的儿子〔注：或译：王的儿子〕耶拉篾和亚斯列的儿子西莱雅，并亚伯叠的儿子示利米雅，去捉拿文士巴录和先知耶利米。耶和华却将他们隐藏。

chapters.en: After the king had burned the scroll containing the words that Baruch had written at Jeremiah’s dictation, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
chapters.zh: 王烧了书卷（其上有巴录从耶利米口中所写的话）以后，耶和华的话临到耶利米说：

chapters.en: “Take another scroll and rewrite on it the very words that were on the original scroll, which Jehoiakim king of Judah has burned.
chapters.zh: 「你再取一卷，将犹大王约雅敬所烧第一卷上的一切话写在其上。

chapters.en: You are to proclaim concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah that this is what the LORD says: You have burned the scroll and said, ‘Why have you written on it that the king of Babylon would surely come and destroy this land and deprive it of man and beast?’
chapters.zh: 论到犹大王约雅敬你要说，耶和华如此说：你烧了书卷，说：『你为什么在其上写着，说巴比伦王必要来毁灭这地，使这地上绝了人民牲畜呢？』

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD says about Jehoiakim king of Judah: He will have no one to sit on David’s throne, and his body will be thrown out and exposed to heat by day and frost by night.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华论到犹大王约雅敬说：他后裔中必没有人坐在大卫的宝座上；他的尸首必被抛弃，白日受炎热，黑夜受寒霜。

chapters.en: I will punish him and his descendants and servants for their iniquity. I will bring on them, on the residents of Jerusalem, and on the men of Judah, all the calamity about which I warned them but they did not listen.”
chapters.zh: 我必因他和他后裔，并他臣仆的罪孽刑罚他们。我要使我所说的一切灾祸临到他们和耶路撒冷的居民，并犹大人；只是他们不听。」

chapters.en: Then Jeremiah took another scroll and gave it to the scribe Baruch son of Neriah, and at Jeremiah’s dictation he wrote on it all the words of the scroll that Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire. And many similar words were added to them.
chapters.zh: 于是，耶利米又取一书卷交给尼利亚的儿子文士巴录，他就从耶利米的口中写了犹大王约雅敬所烧前卷上的一切话，另外又添了许多相彷的话。

chapters.en: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made Zedekiah son of Josiah the king of Judah, and he reigned in place of Coniah son of Jehoiakim.
chapters.zh: 约西亚的儿子西底家代替约雅敬的儿子哥尼雅为王，是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒立在犹大地作王的。

chapters.en: But he and his officers and the people of the land refused to obey the words that the LORD had spoken through Jeremiah the prophet.
chapters.zh: 但西底家和他的臣仆，并国中的百姓，都不听从耶和华藉先知耶利米所说的话。

chapters.en: Yet King Zedekiah sent Jehucal son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the priest, the son of Maaseiah, to Jeremiah the prophet with the message, “Please pray to the LORD our God for us!”
chapters.zh: 西底家王打发示利米雅的儿子犹甲和祭司玛西雅的儿子西番雅去见先知耶利米，说：「求你为我们祷告耶和华－我们的上帝。」

chapters.en: Now Jeremiah was free to come and go among the people, for they had not yet put him in prison.
chapters.zh: 那时耶利米在民中出入，因为他们还没有把他囚在监里。

chapters.en: Pharaoh’s army had left Egypt, and when the Chaldeans who were besieging Jerusalem heard the report, they withdrew from Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 法老的军队已经从埃及出来，那围困耶路撒冷的迦勒底人听见他们的风声，就拔营离开耶路撒冷去了。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到先知耶利米说：

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says that you are to tell the king of Judah, who sent you to Me: Behold, Pharaoh’s army, which has marched out to help you, will go back to its own land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：犹大王打发你们来求问我，你们要如此对他说：『那出来帮助你们法老的军队必回埃及本国去。

chapters.en: Then the Chaldeans will return and fight against this city. They will capture it and burn it down.
chapters.zh: 迦勒底人必再来攻打这城，并要攻取，用火焚烧。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: Do not deceive yourselves by saying, ‘The Chaldeans will go away for good,’ for they will not!
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：你们不要自欺说「迦勒底人必定离开我们」，因为他们必不离开。

chapters.en: Indeed, if you were to strike down the entire army of the Chaldeans that is fighting against you, and only wounded men remained in their tents, they would still get up and burn this city down.”
chapters.zh: 你们即便杀败了与你们争战的迦勒底全军，但剩下受伤的人也必各人从帐棚里起来，用火焚烧这城。』」

chapters.en: When the Chaldean army withdrew from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army,
chapters.zh: 迦勒底的军队因怕法老的军队，拔营离开耶路撒冷的时候，

chapters.en: Jeremiah started to leave Jerusalem to go to the land of Benjamin to claim his portion there among the people.
chapters.zh: 耶利米就杂在民中出离耶路撒冷，要往便雅悯地去，在那里得自己的地业。

chapters.en: But when he reached the Gate of Benjamin, the captain of the guard, whose name was Irijah son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah, seized him and said, “You are deserting to the Chaldeans!”
chapters.zh: 他到了便雅悯门那里，有守门官名叫伊利雅，是哈拿尼亚的孙子、示利米雅的儿子，他就拿住先知耶利米，说：「你是投降迦勒底人哪！」

chapters.en:
“That is a lie,” Jeremiah replied. “I am not deserting to the Chaldeans!”
But Irijah would not listen to him; instead, he arrested Jeremiah and took him to the officials.
chapters.zh: 耶利米说：「你这是谎话，我并不是投降迦勒底人。」伊利雅不听他的话，就拿住他，解到首领那里。

chapters.en: The officials were angry with Jeremiah, and they beat him and placed him in jail in the house of Jonathan the scribe, for it had been made into a prison.
chapters.zh: 首领恼怒耶利米，就打了他，将他囚在文士约拿单的房屋中，因为他们以这房屋当作监牢。

chapters.en: So Jeremiah went into a cell in the dungeon and remained there a long time.
chapters.zh: 耶利米来到狱中，进入牢房，在那里囚了多日。

chapters.en:
Later, King Zedekiah sent for Jeremiah and received him in his palace, where he asked him privately, “Is there a word from the LORD?”
“There is,” Jeremiah replied. “You will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.”
chapters.zh: 西底家王打发人提出他来，在自己的宫内私下问他说：「从耶和华有什么话临到没有？」耶利米说：「有！」又说：「你必交在巴比伦王手中。」

chapters.en: Then Jeremiah asked King Zedekiah, “How have I sinned against you or your servants or these people, that you have put me in prison?
chapters.zh: 耶利米又对西底家王说：「我在什么事上得罪你，或你的臣仆，或这百姓，你竟将我囚在监里呢？

chapters.en: Where are your prophets who prophesied to you, claiming, ‘The king of Babylon will not come against you or this land’?
chapters.zh: 对你们预言巴比伦王必不来攻击你们和这地的先知，现今在哪里呢？

chapters.en: But now please listen, O my lord the king. May my petition come before you. Do not send me back to the house of Jonathan the scribe, or I will die there.”
chapters.zh: 主－我的王啊，求你现在垂听，准我在你面前的恳求：不要使我回到文士约拿单的房屋中，免得我死在那里。」

chapters.en: So King Zedekiah gave orders for Jeremiah to be placed in the courtyard of the guard and given a loaf of bread daily from the street of the bakers, until all the bread in the city was gone. So Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard.
chapters.zh: 于是，西底家王下令，他们就把耶利米交在护卫兵的院中，每天从饼舖街取一个饼给他，直到城中的饼用尽了。这样，耶利米仍在护卫兵的院中。

chapters.en: Now Shephatiah son of Mattan, Gedaliah son of Pashhur, Jucal son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur son of Malchijah heard that Jeremiah had been telling all the people:
chapters.zh: 玛坦的儿子示法提雅、巴施户珥的儿子基大利、示利米雅的儿子犹甲、玛基雅的儿子巴施户珥听见耶利米对众人所说的话，说：

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD says: Whoever stays in this city will die by sword and famine and plague, but whoever surrenders to the Chaldeans will live; he will retain his life like a spoil of war, and he will live.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华如此说：住在这城里的必遭刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫而死；但出去归降迦勒底人的必得存活，就是以自己命为掠物的，必得存活。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: This city will surely be delivered into the hands of the army of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：这城必要交在巴比伦王军队的手中，他必攻取这城。」

chapters.en: Then the officials said to the king, “This man ought to die, for he is discouraging the warriors who remain in this city, as well as all the people, by speaking such words to them; this man is not seeking the well-being of these people, but their ruin.”
chapters.zh: 于是首领对王说：「求你将这人治死；因他向城里剩下的兵丁和众民说这样的话，使他们的手发软。这人不是求这百姓得平安，乃是叫他们受灾祸。」

chapters.en: “Here he is,” replied King Zedekiah. “He is in your hands, since the king can do nothing to stop you.”
chapters.zh: 西底家王说：「他在你们手中，无论何事，王也不能与你们反对。」

chapters.en: So they took Jeremiah and dropped him into the cistern of Malchiah, the king’s son, which was in the courtyard of the guard. They lowered Jeremiah with ropes into the cistern, which had no water but only mud, and Jeremiah sank down into the mud.
chapters.zh: 他们就拿住耶利米，下在哈米勒的儿子〔注：或译：王的儿子〕玛基雅的牢狱里；那牢狱在护卫兵的院中。他们用绳子将耶利米系下去。牢狱里没有水，只有淤泥，耶利米就陷在淤泥中。

chapters.en: Now Ebed-melech the Cushite, a court official in the royal palace, heard that Jeremiah had been put into the cistern. While the king was sitting at the Gate of Benjamin,
chapters.zh: 在王宫的太监古实人以伯‧米勒，听见他们将耶利米下了牢狱（那时王坐在便雅悯门口），

chapters.en: Ebed-melech went out from the king’s palace and said to the king,
chapters.zh: 以伯‧米勒就从王宫里出来，对王说：

chapters.en: “My lord the king, these men have acted wickedly in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet. They have dropped him into the cistern, where he will starve to death, for there is no more bread in the city.”
chapters.zh: 「主－我的王啊，这些人向先知耶利米一味地行恶，将他下在牢狱中；他在那里必因饥饿而死，因为城中再没有粮食。」

chapters.en: So the king commanded Ebed-melech the Cushite, “Take thirty men from here with you and pull Jeremiah the prophet out of the cistern before he dies.”
chapters.zh: 王就吩咐古实人以伯‧米勒说：「你从这里带领三十人，趁着先知耶利米未死以前，将他从牢狱中提上来。」

chapters.en: Then Ebed-melech took the men with him and went to the king’s palace, to a place below the storehouse. From there he took old rags and worn-out clothes and lowered them with ropes to Jeremiah in the cistern.
chapters.zh: 于是以伯‧米勒带领这些人同去，进入王宫，到库房以下，从那里取了些碎布和破烂的衣服，用绳子缒下牢狱去到耶利米那里。

chapters.en: Ebed-melech the Cushite cried out to Jeremiah, “Put these worn-out rags and clothes under your arms to pad the ropes.” Jeremiah did so,
chapters.zh: 古实人以伯‧米勒对耶利米说：「你用这些碎布和破烂的衣服放在绳子上，垫你的胳肢窝。」耶利米就照样行了。

chapters.en: and they pulled him up with the ropes and lifted him out of the cistern. And Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard.
chapters.zh: 这样，他们用绳子将耶利米从牢狱里拉上来。耶利米仍在护卫兵的院中。

chapters.en: Then King Zedekiah sent for Jeremiah the prophet and received him at the third entrance to the house of the LORD. “I am going to ask you something,” said the king to Jeremiah. “Do not hide anything from me.”
chapters.zh: 西底家王打发人带领先知耶利米，进耶和华殿中第三门里见王。王就对耶利米说：「我要问你一件事，你丝毫不可向我隐瞒。」

chapters.en: “If I tell you,” Jeremiah replied, “you will surely put me to death. And even if I give you advice, you will not listen to me.”
chapters.zh: 耶利米对西底家说：「我若告诉你，你岂不定要杀我吗？我若劝戒你，你必不听从我。」

chapters.en: But King Zedekiah swore secretly to Jeremiah, “As surely as the LORD lives, who has given us this life, I will not kill you, nor will I deliver you into the hands of these men who are seeking your life.”
chapters.zh: 西底家王就私下向耶利米说：「我指着那造我们生命之永生的耶和华起誓：我必不杀你，也不将你交在寻索你命的人手中。」

chapters.en: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “This is what the LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you indeed surrender to the officers of the king of Babylon, then you will live, this city will not be burned down, and you and your household will survive.
chapters.zh: 耶利米对西底家说：「耶和华－万军之上帝、以色列的上帝如此说：你若出去归降巴比伦王的首领，你的命就必存活，这城也不致被火焚烧，你和你的全家都必存活。

chapters.en: But if you do not surrender to the officers of the king of Babylon, then this city will be delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans. They will burn it down, and you yourself will not escape their grasp.’”
chapters.zh: 你若不出去归降巴比伦王的首领，这城必交在迦勒底人手中。他们必用火焚烧，你也不得脱离他们的手。」

chapters.en: But King Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, “I am afraid of the Jews who have deserted to the Chaldeans, for the Chaldeans may deliver me into their hands to abuse me.”
chapters.zh: 西底家王对耶利米说：「我怕那些投降迦勒底人的犹大人，恐怕迦勒底人将我交在他们手中，他们戏弄我。」

chapters.en: “They will not hand you over,” Jeremiah replied. “Obey the voice of the LORD in what I am telling you, that it may go well with you and you may live.
chapters.zh: 耶利米说：「迦勒底人必不将你交出。求你听从我对你所说耶和华的话，这样你必得好处，你的命也必存活。

chapters.en: But if you refuse to surrender, this is the word that the LORD has shown me:
chapters.zh: 你若不肯出去，耶和华指示我的话乃是这样：

chapters.en:
All the women who remain in the palace of the king of Judah will be brought out to the officials of the king of Babylon, and those women will say:
‘They misled you and overcame you— those trusted friends of yours. Your feet sank into the mire, and they deserted you.’
chapters.zh: 犹大王宫里所剩的妇女必都带到巴比伦王的首领那里。这些妇女必说： 你知己的朋友催逼你， 胜过你； 〔见〕你的脚陷入淤泥中， 就转身退后了。

chapters.en: All your wives and children will be brought out to the Chaldeans. And you yourself will not escape their grasp, for you will be seized by the king of Babylon, and this city will be burned down.”
chapters.zh: 「人必将你的后妃和你的儿女带到迦勒底人那里；你也不得脱离他们的手，必被巴比伦王的手捉住；你也必使这城被火焚烧。」

chapters.en: Then Zedekiah warned Jeremiah, “Do not let anyone know about this conversation, or you will die.
chapters.zh: 西底家对耶利米说：「不要使人知道这些话，你就不至于死。

chapters.en: If the officials hear that I have spoken with you, and they come and demand of you, ‘Tell us what you said to the king and what he said to you; do not hide it from us, or we will kill you,’
chapters.zh: 首领若听见了我与你说话，就来见你，问你说：『你对王说什么话不要向我们隐瞒，我们就不杀你。王向你说什么话也要告诉我们。』

chapters.en: then tell them, ‘I was presenting to the king my petition that he not return me to the house of Jonathan to die there.’”
chapters.zh: 你就对他们说：『我在王面前恳求不要叫我回到约拿单的房屋死在那里。』」

chapters.en: When all the officials came to Jeremiah and questioned him, he relayed to them the exact words the king had commanded him to say. So they said no more to him, for no one had overheard the conversation.
chapters.zh: 随后众首领来见耶利米，问他，他就照王所吩咐的一切话回答他们。他们不再与他说话，因为事情没有洩漏。

chapters.en: And Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard until the day Jerusalem was captured.
chapters.zh: 于是耶利米仍在护卫兵的院中，直到耶路撒冷被攻取的日子。

chapters.en: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his entire army and laid siege to the city.
chapters.zh: 犹大王西底家第九年十月，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领全军来围困耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: And on the ninth day of the fourth month of Zedekiah’s eleventh year, the city was breached.
chapters.zh: 西底家十一年四月初九日，城被攻破。

chapters.en: Then all the officials of the king of Babylon entered and sat in the Middle Gate: Nergal-sharezer of Samgar, Nebo-sarsekim the Rabsaris, Nergal-sharezer the Rabmag, and all the rest of the officials of the king of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷被攻取的时候，巴比伦王的首领尼甲‧沙利薛、三甲‧尼波、撒西金－拉撒力、尼甲‧沙利薛－拉墨，并巴比伦王其余的一切首领都来坐在中门。

chapters.en: When Zedekiah king of Judah and all the soldiers saw them, they fled. They left the city at night by way of the king’s garden, through the gate between the two walls, and they went out along the route to the Arabah.
chapters.zh: 犹大王西底家和一切兵丁看见他们，就在夜间从靠近王园两城中间的门出城逃跑，往亚拉巴逃去。

chapters.en: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued them and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. They seized him and brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he pronounced judgment on him.
chapters.zh: 迦勒底的军队追赶他们，在耶利哥的平原追上西底家，将他拿住，带到哈马地的利比拉、巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒那里；尼布甲尼撒就审判他。

chapters.en: There at Riblah the king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and he also killed all the nobles of Judah.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王在利比拉、西底家眼前杀了他的众子，又杀了犹大的一切贵胄，

chapters.en: Then he put out Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him with bronze chains to take him to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 并且剜西底家的眼睛，用铜鍊锁着他，要带到巴比伦去。

chapters.en: The Chaldeans set fire to the palace of the king and to the houses of the people, and they broke down the walls of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 迦勒底人用火焚烧王宫和百姓的房屋，又拆毁耶路撒冷的城墙。

chapters.en: Then Nebuzaradan captain of the guard carried away to Babylon the remnant of the people who had remained in the city, along with the deserters who had defected to him.
chapters.zh: 那时，护卫长尼布撒拉旦将城里所剩下的百姓和投降他的逃民，以及其余的民都掳到巴比伦去了。

chapters.en: But Nebuzaradan left behind in the land of Judah some of the poor people who had no property, and at that time he gave them vineyards and fields.
chapters.zh: 护卫长尼布撒拉旦却将民中毫无所有的穷人留在犹大地，当时给他们葡萄园和田地。

chapters.en: Now Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had given orders about Jeremiah through Nebuzaradan captain of the guard, saying,
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒提到耶利米，嘱咐护卫长尼布撒拉旦说：

chapters.en: “Take him, look after him, and do not let any harm come to him; do for him whatever he says.”
chapters.zh: 「你领他去，好好地看待他，切不可害他；他对你怎么说，你就向他怎么行。」

chapters.en: So Nebuzaradan captain of the guard, Nebushazban the Rabsaris, Nergal-sharezer the Rabmag, and all the captains of the king of Babylon
chapters.zh: 护卫长尼布撒拉旦和尼布沙斯班－拉撒力、尼甲‧沙利薛－拉墨，并巴比伦王的一切官长，

chapters.en: had Jeremiah brought from the courtyard of the guard, and they turned him over to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, to take him home. So Jeremiah remained among his own people.
chapters.zh: 打发人去，将耶利米从护卫兵院中提出来，交与沙番的孙子亚希甘的儿子基大利，带回家去。于是耶利米住在民中。

chapters.en: And while Jeremiah had been confined in the courtyard of the guard, the word of the LORD had come to him:
chapters.zh: 耶利米还囚在护卫兵院中的时候，耶和华的话临到他说：

chapters.en: “Go and tell Ebed-melech the Cushite that this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘I am about to fulfill My words against this city for harm and not for good, and on that day they will be fulfilled before your eyes.
chapters.zh: 「你去告诉古实人以伯‧米勒说，万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：我说降祸不降福的话必临到这城，到那时必在你面前成就了。

chapters.en: But I will deliver you on that day, declares the LORD, and you will not be delivered into the hands of the men whom you fear.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：到那日我必拯救你，你必不致交在你所怕的人手中。

chapters.en: For I will surely rescue you so that you do not fall by the sword. Because you have trusted in Me, you will escape with your life like a spoil of war, declares the LORD.’”
chapters.zh: 我定要搭救你，你不致倒在刀下，却要以自己的命为掠物，因你倚靠我。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD after Nebuzaradan captain of the guard had released him at Ramah, having found him bound in chains among all the captives of Jerusalem and Judah who were being exiled to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 耶利米锁在耶路撒冷和犹大被掳到巴比伦的人中，护卫长尼布撒拉旦将他从拉玛释放以后，耶和华的话临到耶利米。

chapters.en: The captain of the guard found Jeremiah and said to him, “The LORD your God decreed this disaster on this place,
chapters.zh: 护卫长将耶利米叫来，对他说：「耶和华－你的上帝曾说要降这祸与此地。

chapters.en: and now the LORD has fulfilled it; He has done just as He said. Because you people have sinned against the LORD and have not obeyed His voice, this thing has happened to you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华使这祸临到，照他所说的行了；因为你们得罪耶和华，没有听从他的话，所以这事临到你们。

chapters.en: But now, behold, I am freeing you today from the chains that were on your wrists. If it pleases you to come with me to Babylon, then come, and I will take care of you. But if it seems wrong to you to come with me to Babylon, go no farther. Look, the whole land is before you. Wherever it seems good and right to you, go there.”
chapters.zh: 现在我解开你手上的鍊子，你若看与我同往巴比伦去好，就可以去，我必厚待你；你若看与我同往巴比伦去不好，就不必去。看哪，全地在你面前，你以为哪里美好，哪里合宜，只管上那里去吧！」

chapters.en: But before Jeremiah turned to go, Nebuzaradan added, “Return to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has appointed over the cities of Judah, and stay with him among the people, or go anywhere else that seems right.” Then the captain of the guard gave him a ration and a gift and released him.
chapters.zh: 耶利米还没有回去，〔护卫长说〕：「你可以回到沙番的孙子亚希甘的儿子基大利那里去；现在巴比伦王立他作犹大城邑的省长。你可以在他那里住在民中，不然，你看哪里合宜就可以上那里去。」于是护卫长送他粮食和礼物，释放他去了。

chapters.en: So Jeremiah went to Gedaliah son of Ahikam at Mizpah and stayed with him among the people who were left in the land.
chapters.zh: 耶利米就到米斯巴见亚希甘的儿子基大利，在他那里住在境内剩下的民中。

chapters.en: When all the commanders and men of the armies in the field heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam over the land and that he had put him in charge of the men, women, and children who were the poorest of the land and had not been exiled to Babylon,
chapters.zh: 在田野的一切军长和属他们的人听见巴比伦王立了亚希甘的儿子基大利作境内的省长，并将没有掳到巴比伦的男人、妇女、孩童，和境内极穷的人全交给他。

chapters.en: they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah—Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth, the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah son of the Maacathite—they and their men.
chapters.zh: 于是军长尼探雅的儿子以实玛利，加利亚的两个儿子约哈难和约拿单，单户篾的儿子西莱雅，并尼陀法人以斐的众子，玛迦人的儿子耶撒尼亚和属他们的人，都到米斯巴见基大利。

chapters.en: Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, swore an oath to them and their men, assuring them, “Do not be afraid to serve the Chaldeans. Live in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with you.
chapters.zh: 沙番的孙子亚希甘的儿子基大利向他们和属他们的人起誓说：「不要怕服事迦勒底人，只管住在这地，服事巴比伦王，就可以得福。

chapters.en: As for me, I will stay in Mizpah to represent you before the Chaldeans who come to us. As for you, gather wine grapes, summer fruit, and oil, place them in your storage jars, and live in the cities you have taken.”
chapters.zh: 至于我，我要住在米斯巴，伺候那到我们这里来的迦勒底人；只是你们当积蓄酒、油，和夏天的果子，收在器皿里，住在你们所佔的城邑中。」

chapters.en: When all the Jews in Moab, Ammon, Edom, and all the other lands heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant in Judah and had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, over them,
chapters.zh: 在摩押〔地〕和亚扪人中，在以东〔地〕和各国的一切犹大人，听见巴比伦王留下些犹大人，并立沙番的孙子亚希甘的儿子基大利管理他们。

chapters.en: they all returned from all the places to which they had been banished and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah at Mizpah. And they gathered an abundance of wine grapes and summer fruit.
chapters.zh: 这一切犹大人就从所赶到的各处回来，到犹大地米斯巴的基大利那里，又积蓄了许多的酒，并夏天的果子。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the armies in the field came to Gedaliah at Mizpah
chapters.zh: 加利亚的儿子约哈难和在田野的一切军长来到米斯巴见基大利，

chapters.en:
and said to him, “Are you aware that Baalis king of the Ammonites has sent Ishmael son of Nethaniah to take your life?”
But Gedaliah son of Ahikam did not believe them.
chapters.zh: 对他说：「亚扪人的王巴利斯打发尼探雅的儿子以实玛利来要你的命，你知道吗？」亚希甘的儿子基大利却不信他们的话。

chapters.en: Then Johanan son of Kareah spoke privately to Gedaliah at Mizpah. “Let me go and kill Ishmael son of Nethaniah,” he said. “No one will know it. Why should he take your life and scatter all the people of Judah who have gathered to you, so that the remnant of Judah would perish?”
chapters.zh: 加利亚的儿子约哈难在米斯巴私下对基大利说：「求你容我去杀尼探雅的儿子以实玛利，必无人知道。何必让他要你的命，使聚集到你这里来的犹大人都分散，以致犹大剩下的人都灭亡呢？」

chapters.en: But Gedaliah son of Ahikam said to Johanan son of Kareah, “Do not do such a thing! What you are saying about Ishmael is a lie.”
chapters.zh: 亚希甘的儿子基大利对加利亚的儿子约哈难说：「你不可行这事，你所论以实玛利的话是假的。」

chapters.en: In the seventh month, Ishmael son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, who was a member of the royal family and one of the king’s chief officers, came with ten men to Gedaliah son of Ahikam at Mizpah, and they ate a meal together there.
chapters.zh: 七月间，王的大臣宗室以利沙玛的孙子、尼探雅的儿子以实玛利带着十个人，来到米斯巴见亚希甘的儿子基大利。他们在米斯巴一同吃饭。

chapters.en: Then Ishmael son of Nethaniah and the ten men who were with him got up and struck down Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, with the sword, killing the one whom the king of Babylon had appointed to govern the land.
chapters.zh: 尼探雅的儿子以实玛利和同他来的那十个人起来，用刀杀了沙番的孙子亚希甘的儿子基大利，就是巴比伦王所立为全地省长的。

chapters.en: Ishmael also killed all the Jews who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, as well as the Chaldean soldiers who were there.
chapters.zh: 以实玛利又杀了在米斯巴、基大利那里的一切犹大人和所遇见的迦勒底兵丁。

chapters.en: On the second day after the murder of Gedaliah, when no one yet knew about it,
chapters.zh: 他杀了基大利，无人知道。

chapters.en: eighty men who had shaved off their beards, torn their garments, and cut themselves came from Shechem, Shiloh, and Samaria, carrying grain offerings and frankincense for the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 第二天，有八十人从示剑和示罗，并撒马利亚来，胡须剃去，衣服撕裂，身体划破，手拿素祭和乳香，要奉到耶和华的殿。

chapters.en:
And Ishmael son of Nethaniah went out from Mizpah to meet them, weeping as he went.
When Ishmael encountered the men, he said, “Come to Gedaliah son of Ahikam.”
chapters.zh: 尼探雅的儿子以实玛利出米斯巴迎接他们，随走随哭；遇见了他们，就对他们说：「你们可以来见亚希甘的儿子基大利。」

chapters.en: And when they came into the city, Ishmael son of Nethaniah and the men with him slaughtered them and threw them into a cistern.
chapters.zh: 他们到了城中，尼探雅的儿子以实玛利和同着他的人就将他们杀了，抛在坑中。

chapters.en: But ten of the men among them said to Ishmael, “Do not kill us, for we have hidden treasure in the field—wheat, barley, oil, and honey!” So he refrained from killing them with the others.
chapters.zh: 只是他们中间有十个人对以实玛利说：「不要杀我们，因为我们有许多大麦、小麦、油、蜜藏在田间。」于是他住了手，没有将他们杀在弟兄中间。

chapters.en: Now the cistern into which Ishmael had thrown all the bodies of the men he had struck down along with Gedaliah was a large one that King Asa had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel. Ishmael son of Nethaniah filled it with the slain.
chapters.zh: 以实玛利将所杀之人的尸首都抛在坑里基大利的旁边；这坑是从前亚撒王因怕以色列王巴沙所挖的。尼探雅的儿子以实玛利将那些被杀的人填满了坑。

chapters.en: Then Ishmael took captive all the remnant of the people of Mizpah—the daughters of the king along with all the others who remained in Mizpah—over whom Nebuzaradan captain of the guard had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam. Ishmael son of Nethaniah took them captive and set off to cross over to the Ammonites.
chapters.zh: 以实玛利将米斯巴剩下的人，就是众公主和仍住在米斯巴所有的百姓，原是护卫长尼布撒拉旦交给亚希甘的儿子基大利的，都掳去了。尼探雅的儿子以实玛利掳了他们，要往亚扪人那里去。

chapters.en: When Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the armies with him heard of all the crimes that Ishmael son of Nethaniah had committed,
chapters.zh: 加利亚的儿子约哈难和同着他的众军长听见尼探雅的儿子以实玛利所行的一切恶，

chapters.en: they took all their men and went to fight Ishmael son of Nethaniah. And they found him near the great pool in Gibeon.
chapters.zh: 就带领众人前往，要和尼探雅的儿子以实玛利争战，在基遍的大水旁〔注：或译：大水池旁〕遇见他。

chapters.en: When all the people with Ishmael saw Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the army with him, they rejoiced,
chapters.zh: 以实玛利那里的众人看见加利亚的儿子约哈难和同着他的众军长，就都欢喜。

chapters.en: and all the people whom Ishmael had taken captive at Mizpah turned and went over to Johanan son of Kareah.
chapters.zh: 这样，以实玛利从米斯巴所掳去的众人都转身归加利亚的儿子约哈难去了。

chapters.en: But Ishmael son of Nethaniah and eight of his men escaped from Johanan and went to the Ammonites.
chapters.zh: 尼探雅的儿子以实玛利和八个人脱离约哈难〔的手〕，逃往亚扪人那里去了。

chapters.en: Then Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the armies with him took the whole remnant of the people from Mizpah whom he had recovered from Ishmael son of Nethaniah after Ishmael had killed Gedaliah son of Ahikam: the soldiers, women, children, and court officials he had brought back from Gibeon.
chapters.zh: 尼探雅的儿子以实玛利杀了亚希甘的儿子基大利，从米斯巴将剩下的一切百姓、兵丁、妇女、孩童、太监掳到基遍之后，加利亚的儿子约哈难和同着他的众军长将他们都夺回来，

chapters.en: And they went and stayed in Geruth Chimham, near Bethlehem, in order to proceed into Egypt
chapters.zh: 带到靠近伯利恒的金罕寓〔注：或译：基罗特金罕〕住下，要进入埃及去；

chapters.en: to escape the Chaldeans. For they were afraid of the Chaldeans because Ishmael son of Nethaniah had struck down Gedaliah son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon had appointed over the land.
chapters.zh: 因为尼探雅的儿子以实玛利杀了巴比伦王所立为省长的亚希甘的儿子基大利，约哈难惧怕迦勒底人。

chapters.en: Then all the commanders of the forces, along with Johanan son of Kareah, Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least to the greatest, approached
chapters.zh: 众军长和加利亚的儿子约哈难，并何沙雅的儿子耶撒尼亚〔注：又名亚撒利雅，见四十三章二节〕以及众百姓，从最小的到至大的都进前来，

chapters.en: Jeremiah the prophet and said, “May our petition come before you; pray to the LORD your God on behalf of this entire remnant. For few of us remain of the many, as you can see with your own eyes.
chapters.zh: 对先知耶利米说：「求你准我们在你面前祈求，为我们这剩下的人祷告耶和华－你的上帝。我们本来众多，现在剩下的极少，这是你亲眼所见的。

chapters.en: Pray that the LORD your God will tell us the way we should walk and the thing we should do.”
chapters.zh: 愿耶和华－你的上帝指示我们所当走的路，所当做的事。」

chapters.en: “I have heard you,” replied Jeremiah the prophet. “I will surely pray to the LORD your God as you request, and I will tell you everything that the LORD answers. I will not withhold a word from you.”
chapters.zh: 先知耶利米对他们说：「我已经听见你们了，我必照着你们的话祷告耶和华－你们的上帝。耶和华无论回答什么，我必都告诉你们，毫不隐瞒。」

chapters.en: Then they said to Jeremiah, “May the LORD be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not act upon every word that the LORD your God sends you to tell us.
chapters.zh: 于是他们对耶利米说：「我们若不照耶和华－你的上帝差遣你来说的一切话行，愿耶和华在我们中间作真实诚信的见证。

chapters.en: Whether it is pleasant or unpleasant, we will obey the voice of the LORD our God to whom we are sending you, so that it may go well with us when we obey the voice of the LORD our God!”
chapters.zh: 我们现在请你到耶和华－我们的上帝面前，他说的无论是好是歹，我们都必听从；我们听从耶和华－我们上帝的话，就可以得福。」

chapters.en: After ten days the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah,
chapters.zh: 过了十天，耶和华的话临到耶利米。

chapters.en: and he summoned Johanan son of Kareah, all the commanders of the forces who were with him, and all the people from the least to the greatest.
chapters.zh: 他就将加利亚的儿子约哈难和同着他的众军长，并众百姓，从最小的到至大的都叫了来，

chapters.en: Jeremiah told them, “Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your petition:
chapters.zh: 对他们说：「耶和华－以色列的上帝，就是你们请我在他面前为你们祈求的〔主〕，如此说：

chapters.en: ‘If you will indeed stay in this land, then I will build you up and not tear you down; I will plant you and not uproot you, for I will relent of the disaster I have brought upon you.
chapters.zh: 『你们若仍住在这地，我就建立你们，必不拆毁，栽植你们，并不拔出，因我为降与你们的灾祸后悔了。

chapters.en: Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon, whom you now fear; do not be afraid of him, declares the LORD, for I am with you to save you and deliver you from him.
chapters.zh: 不要怕你们所怕的巴比伦王。』」耶和华说：「不要怕他！因为我与你们同在，要拯救你们脱离他的手。

chapters.en: And I will show you compassion, and he will have compassion on you and restore you to your own land.’
chapters.zh: 我也要使他发怜悯，好怜悯你们，叫你们归回本地。

chapters.en: But if you say, ‘We will not stay in this land,’ and you thus disobey the voice of the LORD your God,
chapters.zh: 倘若你们说：『我们不住在这地』，以致不听从耶和华－你们上帝的话，

chapters.en: and if you say, ‘No, but we will go to the land of Egypt and live there, where we will not see war or hear the sound of the ram’s horn or hunger for bread,’
chapters.zh: 说：『我们不住这地，却要进入埃及地，在那里看不见争战，听不见角声，也不致无食饥饿。我们必住在那里。』

chapters.en: then hear the word of the LORD, O remnant of Judah! This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you are determined to go to Egypt and reside there,
chapters.zh: 你们所剩下的犹大人哪，现在要听耶和华的话。万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：『你们若定意要进入埃及，在那里寄居，

chapters.en: then the sword you fear will overtake you there, and the famine you dread will follow on your heels into Egypt, and you will die there.
chapters.zh: 你们所惧怕的刀剑在埃及地必追上你们！你们所惧怕的饥荒在埃及要紧紧地跟随你们！你们必死在那里！

chapters.en: So all who resolve to go to Egypt to reside there will die by sword and famine and plague. Not one of them will survive or escape the disaster I will bring upon them.’
chapters.zh: 凡定意要进入埃及在那里寄居的必遭刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫而死，无一人存留，逃脱我所降与他们的灾祸。』

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘Just as My anger and wrath were poured out on the residents of Jerusalem, so will My wrath be poured out on you if you go to Egypt. You will become an object of cursing and horror, of vilification and disgrace, and you will never see this place again.’
chapters.zh: 「万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：『我怎样将我的怒气和忿怒倾在耶路撒冷的居民身上，你们进入埃及的时候，我也必照样将我的忿怒倾在你们身上，以致你们令人辱骂、惊骇、咒诅、羞辱，你们不得再见这地方。』

chapters.en: The LORD has told you, O remnant of Judah, ‘Do not go to Egypt.’ Know for sure that I have warned you today!
chapters.zh: 所剩下的犹大人哪，耶和华论到你们说：『不要进入埃及去。』你们要确实地知道我今日警教你们了。

chapters.en: For you have deceived yourselves by sending me to the LORD your God, saying, ‘Pray to the LORD our God on our behalf, and as for all that the LORD our God says, tell it to us and we will do it.’
chapters.zh: 你们行诡诈自害；因为你们请我到耶和华－你们的上帝那里，说：『求你为我们祷告耶和华－我们上帝，照耶和华－我们的上帝一切所说的告诉我们，我们就必遵行。』

chapters.en: For I have told you today, but you have not obeyed the voice of the LORD your God in all He has sent me to tell you.
chapters.zh: 我今日将这话告诉你们，耶和华－你们的上帝为你们的事差遣我到你们那里说的，你们却一样没有听从。

chapters.en: Now therefore, know for sure that by sword and famine and plague you will die in the place where you desire to go to reside.”
chapters.zh: 现在你们要确实地知道，你们在所要去寄居之地必遭刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫而死。」

chapters.en: When Jeremiah had finished telling all the people all the words of the LORD their God—everything that the LORD had sent him to say—
chapters.zh: 耶利米向众百姓说完了耶和华－他们上帝的一切话，就是耶和华－他们上帝差遣他去所说的一切话。

chapters.en: Azariah son of Hoshaiah, Johanan son of Kareah, and all the arrogant men said to Jeremiah, “You are lying! The LORD our God has not sent you to say, ‘You must not go to Egypt to reside there.’
chapters.zh: 何沙雅的儿子亚撒利雅和加利亚的儿子约哈难，并一切狂傲的人，就对耶利米说：「你说谎言！耶和华－我们的上帝并没有差遣你来说：『你们不可进入埃及，在那里寄居。』

chapters.en: Rather, Baruch son of Neriah is inciting you against us to deliver us into the hands of the Chaldeans, so that they may put us to death or exile us to Babylon!”
chapters.zh: 这是尼利亚的儿子巴录挑唆你害我们，要将我们交在迦勒底人的手中，使我们有被杀的，有被掳到巴比伦去的。」

chapters.en: So Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces disobeyed the command of the LORD to stay in the land of Judah.
chapters.zh: 于是加利亚的儿子约哈难和一切军长，并众百姓，不听从耶和华的话住在犹大地。

chapters.en: Instead, Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces took the whole remnant of Judah, those who had returned to the land of Judah from all the nations to which they had been scattered,

the men, the women, the children, the king’s daughters, and everyone whom Nebuzaradan captain of the guard had allowed to remain with Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, as well as Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah.
chapters.zh: 加利亚的儿子约哈难和一切军长却将所剩下的犹大人，就是从被赶到各国回来在犹大地寄居的男人、妇女、孩童，和众公主，并护卫长尼布撒拉旦所留在沙番的孙子亚希甘的儿子基大利那里的众人，与先知耶利米，以及尼利亚的儿子巴录，

chapters.en: So they entered the land of Egypt because they did not obey the voice of the LORD, and they went as far as Tahpanhes.
chapters.zh: 都带入埃及地，到了答比匿。这是因他们不听从耶和华的话。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah at Tahpanhes:
chapters.zh: 在答比匿，耶和华的话临到耶利米说：

chapters.en: “In the sight of the Jews, pick up some large stones and bury them in the clay of the brick pavement at the entrance to Pharaoh’s palace at Tahpanhes.
chapters.zh: 「你在犹大人眼前要用手拿几块大石头，藏在砌砖的灰泥中，就是在答比匿法老的宫门那里，

chapters.en: Then tell them that this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘I will send for My servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and I will set his throne over these stones that I have embedded, and he will spread his royal pavilion over them.
chapters.zh: 对他们说：『万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：我必召我的仆人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来。在所藏的石头上我要安置他的宝座；他必将光华的宝帐支搭在其上。

chapters.en: He will come and strike down the land of Egypt, bringing death to those destined for death, captivity to those destined for captivity, and the sword to those destined for the sword.
chapters.zh: 他要来攻击埃及地，定为死亡的，必致死亡；定为掳掠的，必被掳掠；定为刀杀的，必交刀杀。

chapters.en: I will kindle a fire in the temples of the gods of Egypt, and Nebuchadnezzar will burn those temples and take their gods as captives. So he will wrap himself with the land of Egypt as a shepherd wraps himself in his garment, and he will depart from there unscathed.
chapters.zh: 我要在埃及神的庙中使火着起，巴比伦王要将庙宇焚烧，神像掳去；他要得〔注：原文是披上〕埃及地，好像牧人披上外衣，从那里安然而去。

chapters.en: He will demolish the sacred pillars of the temple of the sun in the land of Egypt, and he will burn down the temples of the gods of Egypt.’”
chapters.zh: 他必打碎埃及地伯‧示麦的柱像，用火焚烧埃及神的庙宇。』」

chapters.en: This is the word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews living in the land of Egypt —in Migdol, Tahpanhes, and Memphis —and in the land of Pathros:
chapters.zh: 有临到耶利米的话，论及一切住在埃及地的犹大人，就是住在密夺、答比匿、挪弗、巴忒罗境内的犹大人，说：

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: You have seen all the disaster that I brought against Jerusalem and all the cities of Judah; and behold, they lie today in ruins and desolation
chapters.zh: 「万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：我所降与耶路撒冷和犹大各城的一切灾祸你们都看见了。那些城邑今日荒凉，无人居住；

chapters.en:
because of the evil they have done.
They provoked Me to anger by continuing to burn incense and to serve other gods that neither they nor you nor your fathers ever knew.
chapters.zh: 这是因居民所行的恶，去烧香事奉别神，就是他们和你们，并你们列祖所不认识的神，惹我发怒。

chapters.en: Yet I sent you all My servants the prophets again and again, saying: ‘Do not do this detestable thing that I hate.’
chapters.zh: 我从早起来差遣我的仆人众先知去说，你们切不要行我所厌恶这可憎之事。

chapters.en: But they did not listen or incline their ears; they did not turn from their wickedness or stop burning incense to other gods.
chapters.zh: 他们却不听从，不侧耳而听，不转离恶事，仍向别神烧香。

chapters.en: Therefore My wrath and anger poured out and burned in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, so that they have become the desolate ruin they are today.
chapters.zh: 因此，我的怒气和忿怒都倒出来，在犹大城邑中和耶路撒冷的街市上，〔如火〕着起，以致都荒废凄凉，正如今日一样。

chapters.en: So now, this is what the LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Why are you doing such great harm to yourselves by cutting off from Judah man and woman, child and infant, leaving yourselves without a remnant?
chapters.zh: 现在耶和华－万军之上帝、以色列的上帝如此说：你们为何作这大恶自害己命，使你们的男人、妇女、婴孩，和吃奶的都从犹大中剪除、不留一人呢？

chapters.en:
Why are you provoking Me to anger by the work of your hands by burning incense to other gods in the land of Egypt, where you have gone to reside?
As a result, you will be cut off and will become an object of cursing and reproach among all the nations of the earth.
chapters.zh: 就是因你们手所做的，在所去寄居的埃及地向别神烧香惹我发怒，使你们被剪除，在天下万国中令人咒诅羞辱。

chapters.en: Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers and of the kings of Judah and their wives, as well as the wickedness that you and your wives committed in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
chapters.zh: 你们列祖的恶行，犹大列王和他们后妃的恶行，你们自己和你们妻子的恶行，就是在犹大地、耶路撒冷街上所行的，你们都忘了吗？

chapters.en: To this day they have not humbled themselves or shown reverence, nor have they followed My instruction or the statutes that I set before you and your fathers.
chapters.zh: 到如今还没有懊悔，没有惧怕，没有遵行我在你们和你们列祖面前所设立的法度律例。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: I will set My face to bring disaster and to cut off all Judah.
chapters.zh: 「所以万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：我必向你们变脸降灾，以致剪除犹大众人。

chapters.en: And I will take away the remnant of Judah who have resolved to go to the land of Egypt to reside there; they will meet their end. They will all fall by the sword or be consumed by famine. From the least to the greatest, they will die by sword or famine; and they will become an object of cursing and horror, of vilification and reproach.
chapters.zh: 那定意进入埃及地、在那里寄居的，就是所剩下的犹大人，我必使他们尽都灭绝，必在埃及地仆倒，必因刀剑饥荒灭绝；从最小的到至大的都必遭刀剑饥荒而死，以致令人辱骂、惊骇、咒诅、羞辱。

chapters.en: I will punish those who live in the land of Egypt, just as I punished Jerusalem, by sword and famine and plague,
chapters.zh: 我怎样用刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫刑罚耶路撒冷，也必照样刑罚那些住在埃及地的犹大人；

chapters.en: so that none of the remnant of Judah who have gone to reside in Egypt will escape or survive to return to the land of Judah, where they long to return and live; for none will return except a few fugitives.”
chapters.zh: 甚至那进入埃及地寄居的，就是所剩下的犹大人，都不得逃脱，也不得存留归回犹大地。他们心中甚想归回居住之地；除了逃脱的以外，一个都不能归回。」

chapters.en: Then all the men who knew that their wives were burning incense to other gods, and all the women standing by—a great assembly—along with all the people living in the land of Egypt and in Pathros, said to Jeremiah,
chapters.zh: 那些住在埃及地巴忒罗知道自己妻子向别神烧香的，与旁边站立的众妇女，聚集成群，回答耶利米说：

chapters.en: “As for the word you have spoken to us in the name of the LORD, we will not listen to you!
chapters.zh: 「论到你奉耶和华的名向我们所说的话，我们必不听从。

chapters.en:
Instead, we will do everything we vowed to do: We will burn incense to the Queen of Heaven and offer drink offerings to her, just as we, our fathers, our kings, and our officials did in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem.
At that time we had plenty of food and good things, and we saw no disaster.
chapters.zh: 我们定要成就我们口中所出的一切话，向天后烧香、浇奠祭，按着我们与我们列祖、君王、首领在犹大的城邑中和耶路撒冷的街市上素常所行的一样；因为那时我们吃饱饭、享福乐，并不见灾祸。

chapters.en: But from the time we stopped burning incense to the Queen of Heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have lacked everything and have been perishing by sword and famine.”
chapters.zh: 自从我们停止向天后烧香、浇奠祭，我们倒缺乏一切，又因刀剑饥荒灭绝。」

chapters.en: “Moreover,” said the women, “when we burned incense to the Queen of Heaven and poured out drink offerings to her, was it without our husbands’ knowledge that we made sacrificial cakes in her image and poured out drink offerings to her?”
chapters.zh: 妇女说：「我们向天后烧香、浇奠祭，做天后像的饼供奉她，向她浇奠祭，是外乎我们的丈夫吗？」

chapters.en: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, both men and women, who were answering him,
chapters.zh: 耶利米对一切那样回答他的男人妇女说：

chapters.en: “As for the incense you burned in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem—you, your fathers, your kings, your officials, and the people of the land—did the LORD not remember and bring this to mind?
chapters.zh: 「你们与你们列祖、君王、首领，并国内的百姓，在犹大城邑中和耶路撒冷街市上所烧的香，耶和华岂不记念，心中岂不思想吗？

chapters.en: So the LORD could no longer endure the evil deeds and detestable acts you committed, and your land became a desolation, a horror, and an object of cursing, without inhabitant, as it is this day.
chapters.zh: 耶和华因你们所作的恶、所行可憎的事，不能再容忍，所以你们的地荒凉，令人惊骇咒诅，无人居住，正如今日一样。

chapters.en: Because you burned incense and sinned against the LORD and did not obey the voice of the LORD or walk in His instruction, His statutes, and His testimonies, this disaster has befallen you, as you see today.”
chapters.zh: 你们烧香，得罪耶和华，没有听从他的话，没有遵行他的律法、条例、法度，所以你们遭遇这灾祸，正如今日一样。」

chapters.en: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, including all the women, “Hear the word of the LORD, all those of Judah who are in the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 耶利米又对众民和众妇女说：「你们在埃及地的一切犹大人当听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: As for you and your wives, you have spoken with your mouths and fulfilled with your hands your words: ‘We will surely perform our vows that we have made to burn incense to the Queen of Heaven and to pour out drink offerings to her.’ Go ahead, then, do what you have promised! Keep your vows!
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：你们和你们的妻都口中说、手里做，说：『我们定要偿还所许的愿，向天后烧香、浇奠祭。』现在你们只管坚定所许的愿而偿还吧！

chapters.en: Nevertheless, hear the word of the LORD, all you people of Judah living in Egypt: Behold, I have sworn by My great name, says the LORD, that never again will any man of Judah living in the land of Egypt invoke My name or say, ‘As surely as the Lord GOD lives.’
chapters.zh: 所以你们住在埃及地的一切犹大人当听耶和华的话。耶和华说：我指着我的大名起誓，在埃及全地，我的名不再被犹大一个人的口称呼说：『我指着主－永生的耶和华起誓。』

chapters.en: I am watching over them for harm and not for good, and every man of Judah who is in the land of Egypt will meet his end by sword or famine, until they are finished off.
chapters.zh: 我向他们留意降祸不降福；在埃及地的一切犹大人必因刀剑、饥荒所灭，直到灭尽。

chapters.en: Those who escape the sword will return from Egypt to Judah, few in number, and the whole remnant of Judah who went to dwell in the land of Egypt will know whose word will stand, Mine or theirs!
chapters.zh: 脱离刀剑、从埃及地归回犹大地的人数很少；那进入埃及地要在那里寄居的，就是所剩下的犹大人，必知道是谁的话立得住，是我的话呢？是他们的话呢？

chapters.en: This will be a sign to you that I will punish you in this place, declares the LORD, so that you may know that My threats of harm against you will surely stand.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：我在这地方刑罚你们，必有预兆，使你们知道我降祸与你们的话必要立得住。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: Behold, I will deliver Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hands of his enemies who seek his life, just as I delivered Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the enemy who was seeking his life.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：我必将埃及王法老合弗拉交在他仇敌和寻索其命的人手中，像我将犹大王西底家交在他仇敌和寻索其命的巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒手中一样。」

chapters.en: This is the word that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch son of Neriah when he wrote these words on a scroll at the dictation of Jeremiah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah:
chapters.zh: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年，尼利亚的儿子巴录将先知耶利米口中所说的话写在书上。耶利米说：

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says to you, Baruch:
chapters.zh: 「巴录啊，耶和华－以色列的上帝说：

chapters.en: You have said, ‘Woe is me because the LORD has added sorrow to my pain! I am worn out with groaning and have found no rest.’”
chapters.zh: 巴录〔注：原文是你〕曾说：『哀哉！耶和华将忧愁加在我的痛苦上，我因唉哼而困乏，不得安歇。』

chapters.en: Thus Jeremiah was to say to Baruch: “This is what the LORD says: Throughout the land I will demolish what I have built and uproot what I have planted.
chapters.zh: 你要这样告诉他，耶和华如此说：我所建立的，我必拆毁；我所栽植的，我必拔出；在全地我都如此行。

chapters.en: But as for you, do you seek great things for yourself? Stop seeking! For I will bring disaster on every living creature, declares the LORD, but wherever you go, I will grant your life as a spoil of war.”
chapters.zh: 你为自己图谋大事吗？不要图谋！我必使灾祸临到凡有血气的。但你无论往哪里去，我必使你以自己的命为掠物。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: This is the word of the LORD about the nations—the word that came to Jeremiah the prophet
chapters.zh: 耶和华论列国的话临到先知耶利米。

chapters.en: concerning Egypt and the army of Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt, which was defeated at Carchemish on the Euphrates River by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah:
chapters.zh: 论到关乎埃及王法老尼哥的军队：这军队安营在幼发拉底河边的迦基米施，是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒在犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年所打败的。

chapters.en: “Deploy your shields, small and large; advance for battle!
chapters.zh: 你们要预备大小盾牌， 往前上阵。

chapters.en: Harness the horses; mount the steeds; take your positions with helmets on! Polish your spears; put on armor!
chapters.zh: 你们套上车， 骑上马！ 顶盔站立， 磨枪贯甲！
我为何看见他们惊惶转身退后呢？ 他们的勇士打败了， 急忙逃跑，并不回头； 惊吓四围都有！ 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “The swift cannot flee, and the warrior cannot escape! In the north by the River Euphrates they stumble and fall.
chapters.zh: 不要容快跑的逃避； 不要容勇士逃脱〔注：或译：快跑的不能逃避；勇士不能逃脱〕； 他们在北方幼发拉底河边绊跌仆倒。

chapters.en: Who is this, rising like the Nile, like rivers whose waters churn?
chapters.zh: 像尼罗河涨发， 像江河之水翻腾的是谁呢？

chapters.en: Egypt rises like the Nile, and its waters churn like rivers, boasting, ‘I will rise and cover the earth; I will destroy the cities and their people.’
chapters.zh: 埃及像尼罗河涨发， 像江河的水翻腾。 他说：我要涨发遮盖遍地； 我要毁灭城邑和其中的居民。

chapters.en: Advance, O horses! Race furiously, O chariots! Let the warriors come forth— Cush and Put carrying their shields, men of Lydia drawing the bow.
chapters.zh: 马匹上去吧！ 车辆急行吧！ 勇士，就是手拿盾牌的古实人和弗人〔注：又作利比亚人〕， 并拉弓的路德族，都出去吧！

chapters.en: For that day belongs to the Lord GOD of Hosts, a day of vengeance against His foes. The sword will devour until it is satisfied, until it is quenched with their blood. For the Lord GOD of Hosts will hold a sacrifice in the land of the north by the River Euphrates.
chapters.zh: 那日是主－万军之耶和华报仇的日子， 要向敌人报仇。 刀剑必吞吃得饱， 饮血饮足； 因为主－万军之耶和华 在北方幼发拉底河边有献祭的事。

chapters.en: Go up to Gilead for balm, O Virgin Daughter of Egypt! In vain you try many remedies, but for you there is no healing.
chapters.zh: 埃及的民〔注：原文是处女〕哪， 可以上基列取乳香去； 你虽多服良药， 总是徒然，不得治好。

chapters.en: The nations have heard of your shame, and your outcry fills the earth, because warrior stumbles over warrior and both of them have fallen together.”
chapters.zh: 列国听见你的羞辱， 遍地满了你的哀声； 勇士与勇士彼此相碰， 一齐跌倒。

chapters.en: This is the word that the LORD spoke to Jeremiah the prophet about the coming of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to strike the land of Egypt:
chapters.zh: 耶和华对先知耶利米所说的话，论到巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒要来攻击埃及地：

chapters.en: “Announce it in Egypt, and proclaim it in Migdol; proclaim it in Memphis and Tahpanhes: ‘Take your positions and prepare yourself, for the sword devours those around you.’
chapters.zh: 你们要传扬在埃及，宣告在密夺， 报告在挪弗、答比匿说： 要站起出队，自作准备， 因为刀剑在你四围施行吞灭的事。

chapters.en: Why have your warriors been laid low? They cannot stand, for the LORD has thrust them down.
chapters.zh: 你的壮士为何被冲去呢？ 他们站立不住； 因为耶和华驱逐他们，

chapters.en:
They continue to stumble; indeed, they have fallen over one another. They say, ‘Get up! Let us return to our people and to the land of our birth,
away from the sword of the oppressor.’
chapters.zh: 使多人绊跌； 他们也彼此撞倒，说： 起来吧！我们再往本民本地去， 好躲避欺压的刀剑。

chapters.en:
There they will cry out: ‘Pharaoh king of Egypt was all noise;
he has let the appointed time pass him by.’
chapters.zh: 他们在那里喊叫说： 埃及王法老不过是个声音〔注：或译：已经败亡〕； 他已错过所定的时候了。

chapters.en: As surely as I live, declares the King, whose name is the LORD of Hosts, there will come one who is like Tabor among the mountains and like Carmel by the sea.
chapters.zh: 君王－名为万军之耶和华的说： 我指着我的永生起誓： 尼布甲尼撒〔注：原文是他〕来的势派 必像他泊在众山之中， 像迦密在海边一样。

chapters.en: Pack your bags for exile, O daughter dwelling in Egypt! For Memphis will be laid waste, destroyed and uninhabited.
chapters.zh: 住在埃及的民〔注：原文是女子〕哪， 要预备掳去时所用的物件； 因为挪弗必成为荒场， 且被烧毁，无人居住。

chapters.en: Egypt is a beautiful heifer, but a gadfly from the north is coming against her.
chapters.zh: 埃及是肥美的母牛犊； 但出于北方的毁灭〔注：或译：牛詴〕来到了！来到了！

chapters.en: Even the mercenaries among her are like fattened calves. They too will turn back; together they will flee, they will not stand their ground, for the day of calamity is coming upon them— the time of their punishment.
chapters.zh: 其中的雇勇好像圈里的肥牛犊， 他们转身退后， 一齐逃跑，站立不住； 因为他们遭难的日子、 追讨的时候已经临到。

chapters.en: Egypt will hiss like a fleeing serpent, for the enemy will advance in force; with axes they will come against her like woodsmen cutting down trees.
chapters.zh: 其中的声音好像蛇行一样。 敌人要成队而来，如砍伐树木的手拿斧子攻击他。

chapters.en: They will chop down her forest, declares the LORD, dense though it may be, for they are more numerous than locusts; they cannot be counted.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说： 埃及的树林虽然不能寻察〔注：或译：穿不过〕， 敌人却要砍伐， 因他们多于蝗虫，不可胜数。

chapters.en: The Daughter of Egypt will be put to shame; she will be delivered into the hands of the people of the north.”
chapters.zh: 埃及的民〔注：原文是女子〕必然蒙羞， 必交在北方人的手中。

chapters.en: The LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I am about to punish Amon god of Thebes, along with Pharaoh, Egypt with her gods and kings, and those who trust in Pharaoh.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝说：「我必刑罚挪的亚扪〔注：埃及尊大之神〕和法老，并埃及与埃及的神，以及君王，也必刑罚法老和倚靠他的人。

chapters.en: I will deliver them into the hands of those who seek their lives—of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and his officers. But after this, Egypt will be inhabited as in days of old, declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我要将他们交付寻索其命之人的手和巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒与他臣仆的手；以后埃及必再有人居住，与从前一样。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: But you, O Jacob My servant, do not be afraid, and do not be dismayed, O Israel. For I will surely save you out of a distant place, your descendants from the land of their captivity! Jacob will return to quiet and ease, with no one to make him afraid.
chapters.zh: 我的仆人雅各啊，不要惧怕！ 以色列啊，不要惊惶！ 因我要从远方拯救你， 从被掳到之地拯救你的后裔。 雅各必回来，得享平靖安逸， 无人使他害怕。

chapters.en: And you, My servant Jacob, do not be afraid, declares the LORD, for I am with you. Though I will completely destroy all the nations to which I have banished you, I will not completely destroy you. Yet I will discipline you justly, and will by no means leave you unpunished.”
chapters.zh: 我的仆人雅各啊，不要惧怕！ 因我与你同在。 我要将我所赶你到的那些国灭绝净尽， 却不将你灭绝净尽， 倒要从宽惩治你， 万不能不罚你〔注：不罚你：或译以你为无罪〕。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is the word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet about the Philistines before Pharaoh struck down Gaza.
chapters.zh: 法老攻击迦萨之先，有耶和华论非利士人的话临到先知耶利米。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“See how the waters are rising from the north and becoming an overflowing torrent. They will overflow the land and its fullness, the cities and their inhabitants. The people will cry out, and all who dwell in the land will wail
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 有水从北方发起，成为涨溢的河， 要涨过遍地和其中所有的， 并城和其中所住的。 人必呼喊； 境内的居民都必哀号。

chapters.en:
at the sound of the galloping hooves of stallions, the rumbling of chariots,
and the clatter of their wheels. The fathers will not turn back for their sons; their hands will hang limp.
chapters.zh: 听见敌人壮马蹄跳的响声 和战车隆隆、车轮轰轰； 为父的手就发软， 不回头看顾儿女。

chapters.en: For the day has come to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every remaining ally. Indeed, the LORD is about to destroy the Philistines, the remnant from the coasts of Caphtor.
chapters.zh: 因为日子将到， 要毁灭一切非利士人， 剪除帮助泰尔、西顿所剩下的人。 原来耶和华必毁灭非利士人， 就是迦斐讬海岛余剩的人。

chapters.en: The people of Gaza will shave their heads in mourning; Ashkelon will be silenced. O remnant of their valley, how long will you gash yourself?
chapters.zh: 迦萨成了光秃； 平原中所剩的亚实基伦归于无有。 你用刀划身，要到几时呢？

chapters.en: ‘Alas, O sword of the LORD, how long until you rest? Return to your sheath; cease and be still!’
chapters.zh: 耶和华的刀剑哪，你到几时才止息呢？ 你要入鞘，安靖不动。

chapters.en: How can it rest when the LORD has commanded it? He has appointed it against Ashkelon and the shore of its coastland.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华既吩咐你攻击亚实基伦和海边之地， 他已经派定你，焉能止息呢？

chapters.en:
Concerning Moab, this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says:
“Woe to Nebo, for it will be devastated. Kiriathaim will be captured and disgraced; the fortress will be shattered and dismantled.
chapters.zh: 论摩押。万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说： 尼波有祸了！因变为荒场。 基列亭蒙羞被攻取； 米斯迦蒙羞被毁坏；

chapters.en:
There is no longer praise for Moab; in Heshbon they devise evil against her:
‘Come, let us cut her off from nationhood.’
You too, O people of Madmen, will be silenced; the sword will pursue you.
chapters.zh: 摩押不再被称赞。 有人在希实本设计谋害她，〔说〕： 来吧！我们将她剪除，不再成国。 玛得缅哪，你也必默默无声； 刀剑必追赶你。

chapters.en: A voice cries out from Horonaim: ‘Devastation and great destruction!’
chapters.zh: 从何罗念有喊荒凉大毁灭的哀声：

chapters.en: Moab will be shattered; her little ones will cry out.
chapters.zh: 摩押毁灭了！ 她的孩童〔注：或译：家僮〕发哀声，使人听见。

chapters.en:
For on the ascent to Luhith they weep bitterly as they go, and on the descent to Horonaim cries of distress resound
over the destruction:
chapters.zh: 人上鲁希坡随走随哭， 因为在何罗念的下坡听见毁灭的哀声。

chapters.en: ‘Flee! Run for your lives! Become like a juniper in the desert. ’
chapters.zh: 你们要奔逃，自救性命， 〔独自居住〕，好像旷野的杜松。

chapters.en: Because you trust in your works and treasures, you too will be captured, and Chemosh will go into exile with his priests and officials.
chapters.zh: 你因倚靠自己所做的和自己的财宝必被攻取。 基抹和属他的祭司、首领也要一同被掳去。

chapters.en:
The destroyer will move against every city, and not one town will escape. The valley will also be ruined, and the high plain will be destroyed,
as the LORD has said.
chapters.zh: 行毁灭的必来到各城， 并无一城得免。 山谷必致败落， 平原必被毁坏； 正如耶和华所说的。

chapters.en: Put salt on Moab, for she will be laid waste; her cities will become desolate, with no one to dwell in them.
chapters.zh: 要将翅膀给摩押， 使她可以飞去。 她的城邑必致荒凉， 无人居住。

chapters.en: Cursed is the one who is remiss in doing the work of the LORD, and cursed is he who withholds his sword from bloodshed.
chapters.zh: （懒惰为耶和华行事的，必受咒诅；禁止刀剑不经血的，必受咒诅。）

chapters.en: Moab has been at ease from youth, settled like wine on its dregs; he has not been poured from vessel to vessel or gone into exile. So his flavor has remained the same, and his aroma is unchanged.
chapters.zh: 摩押自幼年以来常享安逸， 〔如酒〕在渣滓上澄清， 没有从这器皿倒在那器皿里， 也未曾被掳去。 因此，它的原味尚存， 香气未变。

chapters.en: Therefore behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will send to him wanderers, who will pour him out. They will empty his vessels and shatter his jars.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「日子将到，我必打发倒〔酒〕的往她那里去，将她倒出来，倒空她的器皿，打碎她的坛子。

chapters.en:
Then Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, just as the house of Israel was ashamed
when they trusted in Bethel.
chapters.zh: 摩押必因基抹羞愧，像以色列家从前倚靠伯特利〔的神〕羞愧一样。

chapters.en: How can you say, ‘We are warriors, mighty men ready for battle’?
chapters.zh: 你们怎么说： 我们是勇士，是有勇力打仗的呢？

chapters.en: Moab has been destroyed and its towns have been invaded; the best of its young men have gone down in the slaughter, declares the King, whose name is the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 摩押变为荒场， 敌人上去进了她的城邑。 她所特选的少年人下去遭了杀戮； 这是君王－名为万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Moab’s calamity is at hand, and his affliction is rushing swiftly.
chapters.zh: 摩押的灾殃临近； 她的苦难速速来到。

chapters.en: Mourn for him, all you who surround him, everyone who knows his name; tell how the mighty scepter is shattered— the glorious staff!
chapters.zh: 凡在她四围的和认识她名的， 你们都要为她悲伤，说： 那结实的杖和那美好的棍， 何竟折断了呢？

chapters.en: Come down from your glory; sit on parched ground, O daughter dwelling in Dibon, for the destroyer of Moab has come against you; he has destroyed your fortresses.
chapters.zh: 住在底本的民〔注：原文是女子〕哪， 要从你荣耀的位上下来， 坐受干渴； 因毁灭摩押的上来攻击你， 毁坏了你的保障。

chapters.en: Stand by the road and watch, O dweller of Aroer! Ask the man fleeing or the woman escaping, ‘What has happened?’
chapters.zh: 住亚罗珥的啊， 要站在道旁观望， 问逃避的男人和逃脱的女人说： 是什么事呢？

chapters.en: Moab is put to shame, for it has been shattered. Wail and cry out! Declare by the Arnon that Moab is destroyed.
chapters.zh: 摩押因毁坏蒙羞； 你们要哀号呼喊， 要在亚嫩旁报告说： 摩押变为荒场！

chapters.en: Judgment has come upon the high plain— upon Holon, Jahzah, and Mephaath,
chapters.zh: 「刑罚临到平原之地的何伦、雅杂、米法押、

chapters.en: upon Dibon, Nebo, and Beth-diblathaim,
chapters.zh: 底本、尼波、伯‧低比拉太音、

chapters.en: upon Kiriathaim, Beth-gamul, and Beth-meon,
chapters.zh: 基列亭、伯‧迦末、伯‧米恩、

chapters.en: upon Kerioth, Bozrah, and all the towns of Moab, those far and near.
chapters.zh: 加略、波斯拉，和摩押地远近所有的城邑。

chapters.en: The horn of Moab has been cut off, and his arm is broken,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 摩押的角砍断了，摩押的膀臂折断了。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: “Make him drunk, because he has magnified himself against the LORD; so Moab will wallow in his own vomit, and he will also become a laughingstock.
chapters.zh: 「你们要使摩押沉醉，因她向耶和华夸大。她要在自己所吐之中打滚，又要被人嗤笑。

chapters.en: Was not Israel your object of ridicule? Was he ever found among thieves? For whenever you speak of him you shake your head.
chapters.zh: 摩押啊，你不曾嗤笑以色列吗？她岂是在贼中查出来的呢？你每逢提到她便摇头。

chapters.en: Abandon the towns and settle among the rocks, O dwellers of Moab! Be like a dove that nests at the mouth of a cave.
chapters.zh: 摩押的居民哪， 要离开城邑，住在山崖里， 像鸽子在深渊口上搭窝。

chapters.en:
We have heard of Moab’s pomposity, his exceeding pride and conceit,
his proud arrogance and haughtiness of heart.
chapters.zh: 我们听说摩押人骄傲， 是极其骄傲； 听说他自高自傲， 并且狂妄，居心自大。

chapters.en:
I know his insolence,” declares the LORD, “but it is futile.
His boasting is as empty as his deeds.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说： 我知道他的忿怒是虚空的； 他夸大的话一无所成。

chapters.en:
Therefore I will wail for Moab; I will cry out for all of Moab;
I will moan for the men of Kir-heres.
chapters.zh: 因此，我要为摩押哀号， 为摩押全地呼喊； 人必为吉珥‧哈列设人叹息。

chapters.en: I will weep for you, O vine of Sibmah, more than I weep for Jazer. Your tendrils have extended to the sea; they reach even to Jazer. The destroyer has descended on your summer fruit and grape harvest.
chapters.zh: 西比玛的葡萄树啊，我为你哀哭， 甚于雅谢人哀哭。 你的枝子蔓延过海， 直长到雅谢海。 那行毁灭的已经临到你夏天的果子 和你所摘的葡萄。

chapters.en:
Joy and gladness are removed from the orchard and from the fields of Moab. I have stopped the flow of wine from the presses; no one treads them with shouts of joy;
their shouts are not for joy.
chapters.zh: 肥田和摩押地的欢喜快乐都被夺去； 我使酒醡的酒绝流， 无人踹酒欢呼； 那欢呼却变为〔仇敌的〕吶喊〔注：原文是那欢呼却不是欢呼〕。

chapters.en: There is a cry from Heshbon to Elealeh; they raise their voices to Jahaz, from Zoar to Horonaim and Eglath-shelishiyah; for even the waters of Nimrim have dried up.
chapters.zh: 「希实本人发的哀声达到以利亚利，直达到雅杂；从琐珥达到何罗念，直到伊基拉‧施利施亚，因为宁林的水必然干涸。」

chapters.en: In Moab, declares the LORD, I will bring an end to those who make offerings on the high places and burn incense to their gods.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我必在摩押地使那在邱坛献祭的，和那向他的神烧香的都断绝了。

chapters.en:
Therefore My heart laments like a flute for Moab; it laments like a flute for the men of Kir-heres,
because the wealth they acquired has perished.
chapters.zh: 我心腹为摩押哀鸣如箫，我心肠为吉珥‧哈列设人也是如此，因摩押人所得的财物都灭没了。

chapters.en: For every head is shaved and every beard is clipped; on every hand is a gash, and around every waist is sackcloth.
chapters.zh: 「各人头上光秃，胡须剪短，手有划伤，腰束麻布。

chapters.en: On all the rooftops of Moab and in the public squares, everyone is mourning; for I have shattered Moab like an unwanted jar,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 在摩押的各房顶上和街市上处处有人哀哭；因我打碎摩押，好像打碎无人喜悦的器皿。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “How shattered it is! How they wail! How Moab has turned his back in shame! Moab has become an object of ridicule and horror to all those around him.”
chapters.zh: 摩押何等毁坏！何等哀号！何等羞愧转背！这样，摩押必令四围的人嗤笑惊骇。」

chapters.en:
For this is what the LORD says:
“Behold, an eagle swoops down and spreads his wings against Moab.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 仇敌必如大鹰飞起， 展开翅膀，攻击摩押。

chapters.en: Kirioth has been taken, and the strongholds seized. In that day the heart of Moab’s warriors will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
chapters.zh: 加略被攻取，保障也被占据。 到那日，摩押的勇士心中疼痛如临产的妇人。

chapters.en: Moab will be destroyed as a nation because he vaunted himself against the LORD.
chapters.zh: 摩押必被毁灭，不再成国， 因她向耶和华夸大。

chapters.en: Terror and pit and snare await you, O dweller of Moab,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：摩押的居民哪， 恐惧、陷坑、网罗都临近你。

chapters.en: “Whoever flees the panic will fall into the pit, and whoever climbs from the pit will be caught in the snare. For I will bring upon Moab the year of their punishment,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 躲避恐惧的必坠入陷坑； 从陷坑上来的必被网罗缠住； 因我必使追讨之年临到摩押。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
“Those who flee will stand helpless in Heshbon’s shadow, because fire has gone forth from Heshbon
and a flame from within Sihon. It devours the foreheads of Moab and the skulls of the sons of tumult.
chapters.zh: 躲避的人无力站在希实本的影下； 因为有火从希实本发出， 有火焰出于西宏〔的城〕， 烧尽摩押的角和鬨嚷人的头顶。

chapters.en: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh have perished; for your sons have been taken into exile and your daughters have gone into captivity.
chapters.zh: 摩押啊，你有祸了！ 属基抹的民灭亡了！ 因你的众子都被掳去， 你的众女也被掳去。

chapters.en:
Yet in the latter days I will restore Moab from captivity, ” declares the LORD.
Here ends the judgment on Moab.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说： 到末后，我还要使被掳的摩押人归回。 摩押受审判的话到此为止。

chapters.en:
Concerning the Ammonites, this is what the LORD says:
“Has Israel no sons? Is he without heir? Why then has Milcom taken possession of Gad? Why have his people settled in their cities?
chapters.zh: 论亚扪人。耶和华如此说： 以色列没有儿子吗？ 没有后嗣吗？ 玛勒堪为何得迦得之地为业呢？ 属他的民为何住其中的城邑呢？

chapters.en: Therefore, behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will sound the battle cry against Rabbah of the Ammonites. It will become a heap of ruins, and its villages will be burned. Then Israel will drive out their dispossessors, says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说： 日子将到，我必使人听见打仗的喊声， 是攻击亚扪人拉巴的喊声。 拉巴要成为乱堆； 属她的乡村〔注：原文是女子〕要被火焚烧。 先前得以色列地为业的， 此时以色列倒要得他们的地为业。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Wail, O Heshbon, for Ai has been destroyed; cry out, O daughters of Rabbah! Put on sackcloth and mourn; run back and forth within your walls, for Milcom will go into exile together with his priests and officials.
chapters.zh: 希实本哪，你要哀号， 因为爱地变为荒场。 拉巴的居民〔注：原文是女子〕哪，要呼喊， 以麻布束腰； 要哭号，在篱笆中跑来跑去； 因玛勒堪和属他的祭司、 首领要一同被掳去。

chapters.en:
Why do you boast of your valleys— your valleys so fruitful,
O faithless daughter? You trust in your riches and say, ‘Who can come against me?’
chapters.zh: 背道的民〔注：原文是女子〕哪， 你们为何因有山谷， 就是水流的山谷夸张呢？ 为何倚靠财宝〔说〕： 谁能来到我们这里呢？

chapters.en:
Behold, I am about to bring terror upon you, declares the Lord GOD of Hosts,
from all those around you. You will each be driven headlong, with no one to regather the fugitives.
chapters.zh: 主－万军之耶和华说： 我要使恐吓从四围的人中临到你们； 你们必被赶出， 各人一直前往， 没有人收聚逃民。

chapters.en: Yet afterward I will restore the Ammonites from captivity, ” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 后来我还要使被掳的亚扪人归回。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
Concerning Edom, this is what the LORD of Hosts says:
“Is there no longer wisdom in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent?
Has their wisdom decayed?
chapters.zh: 论以东。万军之耶和华如此说： 提幔中再没有智慧吗？ 明哲人不再有谋略吗？ 他们的智慧尽归无有吗？

chapters.en: Turn and run! Lie low, O dwellers of Dedan, for I will bring disaster on Esau at the time I punish him.
chapters.zh: 底但的居民哪，要转身逃跑， 住在深密处； 因为我向以扫追讨的时候， 必使灾殃临到他。

chapters.en: If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleanings? Were thieves to come in the night, would they not steal only what they wanted?
chapters.zh: 摘葡萄的若来到他那里， 岂不剩下些葡萄呢？ 盗贼若夜间而来， 岂不毁坏直到够了呢？

chapters.en:
But I will strip Esau bare; I will uncover his hiding places,
and he will be unable to conceal himself. His descendants will be destroyed along with his relatives and neighbors,
and he will be no more.
chapters.zh: 我却使以扫赤露， 显出他的隐密处； 他不能自藏。 他的后裔、弟兄、邻舍尽都灭绝； 他也归于无有。

chapters.en: Abandon your orphans; I will preserve their lives. Let your widows trust in Me.”
chapters.zh: 你撇下孤儿，我必保全他们的命； 你的寡妇可以倚靠我。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD says: “If those who do not deserve to drink the cup must drink it, can you possibly remain unpunished? You will not go unpunished, for you must drink it too.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：「原不该喝那杯的一定要喝。你能尽免刑罚吗？你必不能免，一定要喝！」

chapters.en: For by Myself I have sworn, declares the LORD, that Bozrah will become a desolation, a disgrace, a ruin, and a curse, and all her cities will be in ruins forever.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我指着自己起誓，波斯拉必令人惊骇、羞辱、咒诅，并且荒凉。她的一切城邑必变为永远的荒场。」

chapters.en: I have heard a message from the LORD; an envoy has been sent to the nations: “Assemble yourselves to march against her! Rise up for battle!”
chapters.zh: 我从耶和华那里听见信息， 并有使者被差往列国去，〔说〕： 你们聚集来攻击以东， 要起来争战。

chapters.en: “For behold, I will make you small among nations, despised among men.
chapters.zh: 我使你在列国中为最小， 在世人中被藐视。

chapters.en:
The terror you cause and the pride of your heart
have deceived you, O dwellers in the clefts of the rocks, O occupiers of the mountain summit. Though you elevate your nest like the eagle, even from there I will bring you down,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 住在山穴中据守山顶的啊， 论到你的威吓， 你因心中的狂傲自欺； 你虽如大鹰高高搭窝， 我却从那里拉下你来。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
“Edom will become an object of horror. All who pass by will be appalled
and will scoff at all her wounds.
chapters.zh: 「以东必令人惊骇；凡经过的人就受惊骇，又因她一切的灾祸嗤笑。

chapters.en: As Sodom and Gomorrah were overthrown along with their neighbors,” says the LORD, “no one will dwell there; no man will abide there.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：必无人住在那里，也无人在其中寄居，要像所多玛、蛾摩拉，和邻近的城邑倾覆的时候一样。

chapters.en: Behold, one will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan to the watered pasture. For in an instant I will chase Edom from her land. Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this? For who is like Me, and who can challenge Me? What shepherd can stand against Me?”
chapters.zh: 仇敌必像狮子从约旦河边的丛林上来，攻击坚固的居所。转眼之间，我要使以东人逃跑，离开这地。谁蒙拣选，我就派谁治理这地。谁能比我呢？谁能给我定规日期呢？有何牧人能在我面前站立得住呢？

chapters.en: Therefore hear the plans that the LORD has drawn up against Edom and the strategies He has devised against the people of Teman: Surely the little ones of the flock will be dragged away; certainly their pasture will be made desolate because of them.
chapters.zh: 你们要听耶和华攻击以东所说的谋略和他攻击提幔居民所定的旨意。仇敌定要将他们群众微弱的拉去，定要使他们的居所荒凉。

chapters.en: At the sound of their fall the earth will quake; their cry will resound to the Red Sea.
chapters.zh: 因他们仆倒的声音，地就震动。人在红海那里必听见呼喊的声音。

chapters.en: Look! An eagle will soar and swoop down, spreading its wings over Bozrah. In that day the hearts of Edom’s mighty men will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
chapters.zh: 仇敌必如大鹰飞起，展开翅膀攻击波斯拉。到那日，以东的勇士心中疼痛如临产的妇人。」

chapters.en:
Concerning Damascus:
“Hamath and Arpad are put to shame, for they have heard a bad report; they are agitated like the sea; their anxiety cannot be calmed.
chapters.zh: 论大马士革。 哈马和亚珥拔蒙羞， 因他们听见凶恶的信息就消化了。 海上有忧愁，不得平静。

chapters.en:
Damascus has become feeble; she has turned to flee. Panic has gripped her; anguish and pain have seized her
like a woman in labor.
chapters.zh: 大马士革发软，转身逃跑。 战兢将她捉住； 痛苦忧愁将她抓住， 如产难的妇人一样。

chapters.en: How is the city of praise not forsaken, the town that brings Me joy?
chapters.zh: 我所喜乐可称赞的城， 为何被撇弃了呢？

chapters.en: For her young men will fall in the streets, and all her warriors will be silenced in that day,” declares the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 她的少年人必仆倒在街上； 当那日，一切兵丁必默默无声。 这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “I will set fire to the walls of Damascus; it will consume the fortresses of Ben-hadad.”
chapters.zh: 我必在大马士革城中使火着起， 烧灭便‧哈达的宫殿。

chapters.en:
Concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon defeated, this is what the LORD says:
“Rise up, advance against Kedar, and destroy the people of the east!
chapters.zh: 论巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒所攻打的基达和夏琐的诸国。耶和华如此说： 迦勒底人哪，起来上基达去， 毁灭东方人。

chapters.en: They will take their tents and flocks, their tent curtains and all their goods. They will take their camels for themselves. They will shout to them: ‘Terror is on every side!’
chapters.zh: 他们的帐棚和羊群都要夺去， 将幔子和一切器皿，并骆驼为自己掠去。 人向他们喊着说： 四围都有惊吓。

chapters.en:
Run! Escape quickly! Lie low, O residents of Hazor,” declares the LORD, “for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has drawn up a plan against you;
he has devised a strategy against you.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说： 夏琐的居民哪，要逃奔远方， 住在深密处； 因为巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒设计谋害你们， 起意攻击你们。

chapters.en: Rise up, advance against a nation at ease, one that dwells securely,” declares the LORD. “They have no gates or bars; they live alone.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说： 迦勒底人哪，起来！ 上安逸无虑的居民那里去； 他们是无门无闩、独自居住的。

chapters.en: Their camels will become plunder, and their large herds will be spoil. I will scatter to the wind in every direction those who shave their temples; I will bring calamity on them from all sides,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们的骆驼必成为掠物； 他们众多的牲畜必成为掳物。 我必将剃周围〔头发〕的人分散四方〔注：原文是风〕， 使灾殃从四围临到他们。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Hazor will become a haunt for jackals, a desolation forever. No one will dwell there; no man will abide there.”
chapters.zh: 夏琐必成为野狗的住处， 永远凄凉； 必无人住在那里， 也无人在其中寄居。

chapters.en: This is the word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam at the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah.
chapters.zh: 犹大王西底家登基的时候，耶和华论以拦的话临到先知耶利米说：

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD of Hosts says:
“Behold, I will shatter Elam’s bow, the mainstay of their might.
chapters.zh: 「万军之耶和华如此说：我必折断以拦人的弓，就是他们为首的权力。

chapters.en: I will bring the four winds against Elam from the four corners of the heavens, and I will scatter them to all these winds. There will not be a nation to which Elam’s exiles will not go.
chapters.zh: 我要使四风从天的四方刮来，临到以拦人，将他们分散四方〔注：原文是风〕。这被赶散的人没有一国不到的。」

chapters.en: So I will shatter Elam before their foes, before those who seek their lives. I will bring disaster upon them, even My fierce anger,” declares the LORD. “I will send out the sword after them until I finish them off.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我必使以拦人在仇敌和寻索其命的人面前惊惶；我也必使灾祸，就是我的烈怒临到他们，又必使刀剑追杀他们，直到将他们灭尽。

chapters.en: I will set My throne in Elam, and destroy its king and officials,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我要在以拦设立我的宝座，从那里除灭君王和首领。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Yet in the last days, I will restore Elam from captivity, ” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 「到末后，我还要使被掳的以拦人归回。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: This is the word that the LORD spoke through Jeremiah the prophet concerning Babylon and the land of the Chaldeans:
chapters.zh: 耶和华藉先知耶利米论巴比伦和迦勒底人之地所说的话。
你们要在万国中传扬报告， 竖立大旗； 要报告，不可隐瞒，说： 巴比伦被攻取， 彼勒蒙羞， 米罗达惊惶。 巴比伦的神像都蒙羞； 她的偶像都惊惶。

chapters.en: For a nation from the north will come against her; it will make her land a desolation. No one will live in it; both man and beast will flee.”
chapters.zh: 「因有一国从北方上来攻击她，使她的地荒凉，无人居住，连人带牲畜都逃走了。」

chapters.en:
“In those days and at that time, declares the LORD, the children of Israel and the children of Judah will come together, weeping as they come,
and will seek the LORD their God.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「当那日子、那时候，以色列人要和犹大人同来，随走随哭，寻求耶和华－他们的上帝。

chapters.en:
They will ask the way to Zion and turn their faces toward it. They will come and join themselves to the LORD in an everlasting covenant
that will never be forgotten.
chapters.zh: 他们必访问锡安，又面向这里，〔说〕：『来吧，你们要与耶和华联合为永远不忘的约。』

chapters.en:
My people are lost sheep; their shepherds have led them astray,
causing them to roam the mountains. They have wandered from mountain to hill; they have forgotten their resting place.
chapters.zh: 「我的百姓作了迷失的羊，牧人使他们走差路，使他们转到山上。他们从大山走到小山，竟忘了安歇之处。

chapters.en:
All who found them devoured them, and their enemies said, ‘We are not guilty, for they have sinned against the LORD, their true pasture,
the LORD, the hope of their fathers.’
chapters.zh: 凡遇见他们的，就把他们吞灭。敌人说：『我们没有罪；因他们得罪那作公义居所的耶和华，就是他们列祖所仰望的耶和华。』

chapters.en:
Flee from the midst of Babylon; depart from the land of the Chaldeans;
be like the he-goats that lead the flock.
chapters.zh: 「我〔民哪〕，你们要从巴比伦中逃走，从迦勒底人之地出去，要像羊群前面走的公山羊。

chapters.en: For behold, I stir up and bring against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the land of the north. They will line up against her; from the north she will be captured. Their arrows will be like skilled warriors who do not return empty-handed.
chapters.zh: 因我必激动联合的大国从北方上来攻击巴比伦，他们要摆阵攻击她；她必从那里被攻取。他们的箭好像善射之勇士的箭，一枝也不徒然返回。

chapters.en: Chaldea will be plundered; all who plunder her will have their fill,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 迦勒底必成为掠物；凡掳掠她的都必心满意足。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en:
“Because you rejoice, because you sing in triumph—
you who plunder My inheritance— because you frolic like a heifer treading grain and neigh like stallions,
chapters.zh: 抢夺我产业的啊， 你们因欢喜快乐， 且像踹〔谷〕撒欢的母牛犊， 又像发嘶声的壮马。

chapters.en: your mother will be greatly ashamed; she who bore you will be disgraced. Behold, she will be the least of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
chapters.zh: 你们的母巴比伦就极其抱愧， 生你们的必然蒙羞。 她要列在诸国之末， 成为旷野、旱地、沙漠。

chapters.en:
Because of the wrath of the LORD, she will not be inhabited;
she will become completely desolate. All who pass through Babylon will be horrified and will hiss at all her wounds.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华的忿怒，必无人居住， 要全然荒凉。 凡经过巴比伦的要受惊骇， 又因她所遭的灾殃嗤笑。

chapters.en: Line up in formation around Babylon, all you who draw the bow! Shoot at her! Spare no arrows! For she has sinned against the LORD.
chapters.zh: 所有拉弓的，你们要在巴比伦的四围摆阵， 射箭攻击她。 不要爱惜箭枝， 因她得罪了耶和华。

chapters.en:
Raise a war cry against her on every side! She has thrown up her hands in surrender; her towers have fallen; her walls are torn down.
Since this is the vengeance of the LORD, take out your vengeance upon her; as she has done, do the same to her.
chapters.zh: 你们要在她四围吶喊； 她已经投降。 外郭坍塌了， 城墙拆毁了， 因为这是耶和华报仇的事。 你们要向巴比伦报仇； 她怎样待人，也要怎样待她。

chapters.en:
Cut off the sower from Babylon, and the one who wields the sickle at harvest time. In the face of the oppressor’s sword, each will turn to his own people,
each will flee to his own land.
chapters.zh: 你们要将巴比伦撒种的 和收割时拿镰刀的都剪除了。 他们各人因怕欺压的刀剑， 必归回本族，逃到本土。

chapters.en: Israel is a scattered flock, chased away by lions. The first to devour him was the king of Assyria; the last to crush his bones was Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.”
chapters.zh: 「以色列是打散的羊，是被狮子赶出的。首先是亚述王将他吞灭，末后是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒将他的骨头折断。」

chapters.en:
Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says:
“I will punish the king of Babylon and his land as I punished the king of Assyria.
chapters.zh: 所以万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说：「我必罚巴比伦王和他的地，像我从前罚亚述王一样。
