chapters.en: I will return Israel to his pasture, and he will graze on Carmel and Bashan; his soul will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and Gilead.
chapters.zh: 我必再领以色列回他的草场，他必在迦密和巴珊吃草，又在以法莲山上和基列境内得以饱足。」

chapters.en: In those days and at that time, declares the LORD, a search will be made for Israel’s guilt, but there will be none, and for Judah’s sins, but they will not be found; for I will forgive the remnant I preserve.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「当那日子、那时候，虽寻以色列的罪孽，一无所有；虽寻犹大的罪恶，也无所见；因为我所留下的人，我必赦免。」

chapters.en: Go up against the land of Merathaim, and against the residents of Pekod. Kill them and devote them to destruction. Do all that I have commanded you,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：上去攻击米拉大翁之地， 又攻击比割的居民。 要追杀灭尽， 照我一切所吩咐你的去行。

chapters.en: “The noise of battle is in the land— the noise of great destruction.
chapters.zh: 境内有打仗和大毁灭的响声。

chapters.en: How the hammer of the whole earth lies broken and shattered! What a horror Babylon has become among the nations!
chapters.zh: 全地的大锤何竟砍断破坏？ 巴比伦在列国中何竟荒凉？

chapters.en: I laid a snare for you, O Babylon, and you were caught before you knew it. You were found and captured because you challenged the LORD.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦哪，我为你设下网罗， 你不知不觉被缠住。 你被寻着，也被捉住； 因为你与耶和华争竞。

chapters.en: The LORD has opened His armory and brought out His weapons of wrath, for this is the work of the Lord GOD of Hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.
chapters.zh: 耶和华已经开了武库， 拿出他恼恨的兵器； 因为主－万军之耶和华 在迦勒底人之地有〔当做的事〕。

chapters.en: Come against her from the farthest border. Break open her granaries; pile her up like mounds of grain. Devote her to destruction; leave her no survivors.
chapters.zh: 你们要从极远的边界来攻击她， 开她的仓廪， 将她堆如高堆， 毁灭净尽，丝毫不留。

chapters.en: Kill all her young bulls; let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them, for their day has come— the time of their punishment.
chapters.zh: 要杀她的一切牛犊， 使他们下去遭遇杀戮。 他们有祸了， 因为追讨他们的日子已经来到。

chapters.en: Listen to the fugitives and refugees from the land of Babylon, declaring in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance for His temple.
chapters.zh: （有从巴比伦之地逃避出来的人，在锡安扬声报告耶和华－我们的上帝报仇，就是为他的殿报仇。）

chapters.en: Summon the archers against Babylon, all who string the bow. Encamp all around her; let no one escape. Repay her according to her deeds; do to her as she has done. For she has defied the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.
chapters.zh: 「招集一切弓箭手来攻击巴比伦。要在巴比伦四围安营，不要容一人逃脱，照着她所做的报应她；她怎样待人，也要怎样待她，因为她向耶和华－以色列的圣者发了狂傲。

chapters.en: Therefore, her young men will fall in the streets, and all her warriors will be silenced in that day,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 所以她的少年人必仆倒在街上。当那日，一切兵丁必默默无声。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: “Behold, I am against you, O arrogant one,” declares the Lord GOD of Hosts, “for your day has come, the time when I will punish you.
chapters.zh: 主－万军之耶和华说： 你这狂傲的啊，我与你反对， 因为我追讨你的日子已经来到。

chapters.en: The arrogant one will stumble and fall with no one to pick him up. And I will kindle a fire in his cities to consume all those around him.”
chapters.zh: 狂傲的必绊跌仆倒，无人扶起。 我也必使火在他的城邑中着起来， 将他四围所有的尽行烧灭。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD of Hosts says:
“The sons of Israel are oppressed, and the sons of Judah as well. All their captors hold them fast, refusing to release them.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「以色列人和犹大人一同受欺压；凡掳掠他们的都紧紧抓住他们，不肯释放。

chapters.en:
Their Redeemer is strong; the LORD of Hosts is His name. He will fervently plead their case so that He may bring rest to the earth,
but turmoil to those who live in Babylon.
chapters.zh: 他们的救赎主大有能力，万军之耶和华是他的名。他必伸清他们的冤，好使全地得平安，并搅扰巴比伦的居民。」

chapters.en: A sword is against the Chaldeans, declares the LORD, against those who live in Babylon, and against her officials and wise men.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「 有刀剑临到迦勒底人和巴比伦的居民， 并她的首领与智慧人。

chapters.en: A sword is against her false prophets, and they will become fools. A sword is against her warriors, and they will be filled with terror.
chapters.zh: 有刀剑临到矜夸的人， 他们就成为愚昧； 有刀剑临到她的勇士， 他们就惊惶。

chapters.en:
A sword is against her horses and chariots and against all the foreigners in her midst,
and they will become like women. A sword is against her treasuries, and they will be plundered.
chapters.zh: 有刀剑临到她的马匹、车辆， 和其中杂族的人民； 他们必像妇女一样。 有刀剑临到她的宝物， 就被抢夺。

chapters.en: A drought is upon her waters, and they will be dried up. For it is a land of graven images, and the people go mad over idols.
chapters.zh: 有干旱临到她的众水， 就必干涸； 因为这是有雕刻偶像之地， 人因偶像而颠狂。

chapters.en: So the desert creatures and hyenas will live there and ostriches will dwell there. It will never again be inhabited or lived in from generation to generation.
chapters.zh: 所以旷野的走兽和豺狼必住在那里，鸵鸟也住在其中，永无人烟，世世代代无人居住。」

chapters.en: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah along with their neighbors,” declares the LORD, “no one will dwell there; no man will abide there.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「必无人住在那里，也无人在其中寄居，要像我倾覆所多玛、蛾摩拉，和邻近的城邑一样。

chapters.en:
Behold, an army is coming from the north; a great nation and many kings are stirred up
from the ends of the earth.
chapters.zh: 看哪，有一种民从北方而来， 并有一大国和许多君王被激动，从地极来到。

chapters.en: They grasp the bow and spear; they are cruel and merciless. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride upon horses, lined up like men in formation against you, O Daughter of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 他们拿弓和枪， 性情残忍，不施怜悯； 他们的声音像海浪匉訇。 巴比伦城〔注：原文是女子〕啊， 他们骑马， 都摆队伍如上战场的人， 要攻击你。

chapters.en: The king of Babylon has heard the report, and his hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped him, pain like that of a woman in labor.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王听见他们的风声， 手就发软， 痛苦将他抓住， 疼痛仿佛产难的妇人。

chapters.en: Behold, one will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan to the watered pasture. For in an instant I will chase Babylon from her land. Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this? For who is like Me, and who can challenge Me? What shepherd can stand against Me?”
chapters.zh: 「〔仇敌〕必像狮子从约旦河边的丛林上来，攻击坚固的居所。转眼之间，我要使他们逃跑，离开这地。谁蒙拣选，我就派谁治理这地。谁能比我呢？谁能给我定规日期呢？有何牧人能在我面前站立得住呢？

chapters.en: Therefore hear the plans that the LORD has drawn up against Babylon and the strategies He has devised against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the little ones of the flock will be dragged away; certainly their pasture will be made desolate because of them.
chapters.zh: 你们要听耶和华攻击巴比伦所说的谋略和他攻击迦勒底人之地所定的旨意。仇敌定要将他们群众微弱的拉去，定要使他们的居所荒凉。

chapters.en: At the sound of Babylon’s capture the earth will quake; a cry will be heard among the nations.
chapters.zh: 因巴比伦被取的声音，地就震动，人在列邦都听见呼喊的声音。」

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“Behold, I will stir up against Babylon and against the people of Leb-kamai
the spirit of a destroyer.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 我必使毁灭的风刮起， 攻击巴比伦和住在立加米的人。

chapters.en: I will send strangers to Babylon to winnow her and empty her land; for they will come against her from every side in her day of disaster.
chapters.zh: 我要打发外邦人来到巴比伦， 簸扬她，使她的地空虚。 在她遭祸的日子， 他们要周围攻击她。

chapters.en: Do not let the archer bend his bow or put on his armor. Do not spare her young men; devote all her army to destruction!
chapters.zh: 拉弓的，要向拉弓的和贯甲挺身的射箭。 不要怜惜她的少年人； 要灭尽她的全军。

chapters.en: And they will fall slain in the land of the Chaldeans, and pierced through in her streets.
chapters.zh: 他们必在迦勒底人之地被杀仆倒， 在巴比伦的街上被刺透。

chapters.en: For Israel and Judah have not been abandoned by their God, the LORD of Hosts, though their land is full of guilt before the Holy One of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 以色列和犹大虽然境内充满违背以色列圣者的罪， 却没有被他的上帝－万军之耶和华丢弃。

chapters.en: Flee from Babylon! Escape with your lives! Do not be destroyed in her punishment. For this is the time of the LORD’s vengeance; He will pay her what she deserves.
chapters.zh: 你们要从巴比伦中逃奔， 各救自己的性命！ 不要陷在她的罪孽中一同灭亡； 因为这是耶和华报仇的时候， 他必向巴比伦施行报应。

chapters.en: Babylon was a gold cup in the hand of the LORD, making the whole earth drunk. The nations drank her wine; therefore the nations have gone mad.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦素来是耶和华手中的金杯， 使天下沉醉； 万国喝了她的酒就颠狂了。

chapters.en:
Suddenly Babylon has fallen and been shattered. Wail for her; get her balm for her pain;
perhaps she can be healed.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦忽然倾覆毁坏； 要为她哀号； 为止她的疼痛， 拿乳香或者可以治好。

chapters.en: “We tried to heal Babylon, but she could not be healed. Abandon her! Let each of us go to his own land, for her judgment extends to the sky and reaches to the clouds.”
chapters.zh: 我们想医治巴比伦， 她却没有治好。 离开她吧！我们各人归回本国； 因为她受的审判通于上天，达到穹苍。

chapters.en:
“The LORD has brought forth our vindication; come, let us tell in Zion
what the LORD our God has accomplished.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华已经彰显我们的公义。 来吧！我们可以在锡安 报告耶和华－我们上帝的作为。

chapters.en: Sharpen the arrows! Fill the quivers! The LORD has aroused the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because His plan is aimed at Babylon to destroy her, for it is the vengeance of the LORD— vengeance for His temple.
chapters.zh: 你们要磨尖了箭头， 抓住盾牌。 耶和华定意攻击巴比伦，将她毁灭，所以激动了米底亚君王的心；因这是耶和华报仇，就是为自己的殿报仇。

chapters.en: Raise a banner against the walls of Babylon; post the guard; station the watchmen; prepare the ambush. For the LORD has both devised and accomplished what He spoke against the people of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 你们要竖立大旗， 攻击巴比伦的城墙； 要坚固瞭望台， 派定守望的设下埋伏； 因为耶和华指着巴比伦居民所说的话、 所定的意，他已经作成。

chapters.en: You who dwell by many waters, rich in treasures, your end has come; the thread of your life is cut.
chapters.zh: 住在众水之上多有财宝的啊， 你的结局到了！ 你贪婪之量满了！

chapters.en:
The LORD of Hosts has sworn by Himself:
“Surely I will fill you up with men as with locusts, and they will shout in triumph over you.”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华指着自己起誓〔说〕： 我必使〔敌〕人充满你，像蚂蚱一样； 他们必吶喊攻击你。

chapters.en:
The LORD made the earth by His power; He established the world by His wisdom
and stretched out the heavens by His understanding.
chapters.zh: 耶和华用能力创造大地， 用智慧建立世界， 用聪明铺张穹苍。

chapters.en: When He thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
chapters.zh: 他一发声，空中便有多水激动； 他使云雾从地极上腾。 他造电随雨而闪， 从他府库中带出风来。

chapters.en: Every man is senseless and devoid of knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols. For his molten images are a fraud, and there is no breath in them.
chapters.zh: 各人都成了畜类，毫无知识。 各银匠都因他的偶像羞愧； 他所铸的偶像本是虚假的， 其中并无气息，

chapters.en: They are worthless, a work to be mocked. In the time of their punishment they will perish.
chapters.zh: 都是虚无的，是迷惑人的工作， 到追讨的时候，必被除灭。

chapters.en: The Portion of Jacob is not like these, for He is the Maker of all things, and of the tribe of His inheritance— the LORD of Hosts is His name.
chapters.zh: 雅各的分不像这些， 因他是造作万有的〔主〕； 以色列也是他产业的支派。 万军之耶和华是他的名。

chapters.en: “You are My war club, My weapon for battle. With you I shatter nations; with you I bring kingdoms to ruin.
chapters.zh: 你是我争战的斧子和打仗的兵器； 我要用你打碎列国， 用你毁灭列邦；

chapters.en: With you I shatter the horse and rider; with you I shatter the chariot and driver.
chapters.zh: 用你打碎马和骑马的； 用你打碎战车和坐在其上的；

chapters.en:
With you I shatter man and woman; with you I shatter the old man and the youth;
with you I shatter the young man and the maiden.
chapters.zh: 用你打碎男人和女人； 用你打碎老年人和少年人； 用你打碎壮丁和处女；

chapters.en:
With you I shatter the shepherd and his flock; with you I shatter the farmer and his oxen;
with you I shatter the governors and officials.
chapters.zh: 用你打碎牧人和他的群畜； 用你打碎农夫和他一对〔牛〕； 用你打碎省长和副省长。

chapters.en:
Before your very eyes I will repay Babylon and all the dwellers of Chaldea
for all the evil they have done in Zion,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我必在你们眼前报复巴比伦人和迦勒底居民在锡安所行的诸恶。」

chapters.en:
“Behold, I am against you, O destroying mountain, you who devastate the whole earth, declares the LORD. I will stretch out My hand against you; I will roll you over the cliffs
and turn you into a charred mountain.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说： 你这行毁灭的山哪， 就是毁灭天下的山， 我与你反对。 我必向你伸手， 将你从山巖滚下去， 使你成为烧毁的山。

chapters.en:
No one shall retrieve from you a cornerstone or a foundation stone,
because you will become desolate forever,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 人必不从你那里取石头为房角石， 也不取石头为根基石； 你必永远荒凉。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
“Raise a banner in the land! Blow the ram’s horn among the nations! Prepare the nations against her. Summon the kingdoms against her—
Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz. Appoint a captain against her; bring up horses like swarming locusts.
chapters.zh: 要在境内竖立大旗， 在各国中吹角， 使列国预备攻击巴比伦， 将亚拉腊、米尼、亚实基拿各国招来攻击她； 又派军长来攻击她， 使马匹上来如蚂蚱，

chapters.en: Prepare the nations for battle against her— the kings of the Medes, their governors and all their officials, and all the lands they rule.
chapters.zh: 使列国和米底亚君王，与省长和副省长， 并他们所管全地之人，都预备攻击她。

chapters.en: The earth quakes and writhes because the LORD’s intentions against Babylon stand: to make the land of Babylon a desolation, without inhabitant.
chapters.zh: 地必震动而瘠苦； 因耶和华向巴比伦所定的旨意成立了， 使巴比伦之地荒凉，无人居住。

chapters.en: The warriors of Babylon have stopped fighting; they sit in their strongholds. Their strength is exhausted; they have become like women. Babylon’s homes have been set ablaze, the bars of her gates are broken.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦的勇士止息争战， 藏在坚垒之中。 他们的勇力衰尽，好像妇女一样。 巴比伦的住处有火着起， 门闩都折断了。

chapters.en: One courier races to meet another, and messenger follows messenger, to announce to the king of Babylon that his city has been captured from end to end.
chapters.zh: 跑报的要彼此相遇， 送信的要互相迎接， 报告巴比伦王说： 城的四方被攻取了，

chapters.en:
The fords have been seized, the marshes set on fire,
and the soldiers are terrified.”
chapters.zh: 渡口被占据了， 苇塘被火烧了， 兵丁也惊慌了。

chapters.en:
For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says:
“The Daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time it is trampled. In just a little while her harvest time will come.”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝如此说： 巴比伦城〔注：原文是女子〕好像踹谷的禾场； 再过片时，收割她的时候就到了。

chapters.en: “Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has devoured me; he has crushed me. He has set me aside like an empty vessel; he has swallowed me like a monster; he filled his belly with my delicacies and vomited me out.
chapters.zh: 以色列人说： 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒吞灭我，压碎我， 使我成为空虚的器皿。 他像大鱼将我吞下， 用我的美物充满他的肚腹， 又将我赶出去。

chapters.en:
May the violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon,” says the dweller of Zion.
“May my blood be on the dwellers of Chaldea,” says Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 锡安的居民要说： 巴比伦以强暴待我， 损害我的身体， 愿这罪归给她。 耶路撒冷人要说： 愿流我们血的罪归到迦勒底的居民。

chapters.en:
Therefore this is what the LORD says:
“Behold, I will plead your case and take vengeance on your behalf; I will dry up her sea and make her springs run dry.
chapters.zh: 所以，耶和华如此说： 我必为你伸冤，为你报仇； 我必使巴比伦的海枯竭，使她的泉源干涸。

chapters.en: Babylon will become a heap of rubble, a haunt for jackals, an object of horror and scorn, without inhabitant.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦必成为乱堆，为野狗的住处， 令人惊骇、嗤笑， 并且无人居住。

chapters.en: They will roar together like young lions; they will growl like lion cubs.
chapters.zh: 他们要像少壮狮子咆哮， 像小狮子吼叫。

chapters.en: While they are flushed with heat, I will serve them a feast, and I will make them drunk so that they may revel; then they will fall asleep forever and never wake up, declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们火热的时候， 我必为他们设摆酒席， 使他们沉醉，好叫他们快乐， 睡了长觉，永不醒起。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with male goats.
chapters.zh: 我必使他们像羊羔、 像公绵羊和公山羊下到宰杀之地。

chapters.en: How Sheshach has been captured! The praise of all the earth has been seized. What a horror Babylon has become among the nations!
chapters.zh: 示沙克〔注：就是巴比伦〕何竟被攻取？ 天下所称赞的何竟被占据？ 巴比伦在列国中何竟变为荒场？

chapters.en: The sea has come up over Babylon; she is covered in turbulent waves.
chapters.zh: 海水涨起，漫过巴比伦； 她被许多海浪遮盖。

chapters.en: Her cities have become a desolation, a dry and arid land, a land where no one lives, where no son of man passes through.
chapters.zh: 她的城邑变为荒场、旱地、沙漠， 无人居住，无人经过之地。

chapters.en: I will punish Bel in Babylon. I will make him spew out what he swallowed. The nations will no longer stream to him; even the wall of Babylon will fall.
chapters.zh: 我必刑罚巴比伦的彼勒， 使他吐出所吞的。 万民必不再流归他那里； 巴比伦的城墙也必坍塌了。

chapters.en:
Come out of her, My people! Save your lives, each of you,
from the fierce anger of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我的民哪，你们要从其中出去！ 各人拯救自己，躲避耶和华的烈怒。

chapters.en:
Do not let your heart grow faint, and do not be afraid
when the rumor is heard in the land; for a rumor will come one year— and then another the next year— of violence in the land and of ruler against ruler.
chapters.zh: 你们不要心惊胆怯， 也不要因境内所听见的风声惧怕； 因为这年有风声传来； 那年也有风声〔传来〕， 境内有强暴的事， 官长攻击官长。

chapters.en: Therefore, behold, the days are coming when I will punish the idols of Babylon. Her entire land will suffer shame, and all her slain will lie fallen within her.
chapters.zh: 日子将到，我必刑罚巴比伦雕刻的偶像。 她全地必然抱愧； 她被杀的人必在其中仆倒。

chapters.en: Then heaven and earth and all that is in them will shout for joy over Babylon because the destroyers from the north will come against her,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 那时，天地和其中所有的， 必因巴比伦欢呼， 因为行毁灭的要从北方来到她那里。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Babylon must fall on account of the slain of Israel, just as the slain of all the earth have fallen because of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦怎样使以色列被杀的人仆倒， 照样她全地被杀的人也必在巴比伦仆倒。

chapters.en: You who have escaped the sword, depart and do not linger! Remember the LORD from far away, and let Jerusalem come to mind.”
chapters.zh: 你们躲避刀剑的要快走， 不要站住！ 要在远方记念耶和华， 心中追想耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: “We are ashamed because we have heard reproach; disgrace has covered our faces, because foreigners have entered the holy places of the LORD’s house.”
chapters.zh: 我们听见辱骂就蒙羞，满面惭愧， 因为外邦人进入耶和华殿的圣所。

chapters.en: “Therefore, behold, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will punish her idols, and throughout her land the wounded will groan.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说： 日子将到，我必刑罚巴比伦雕刻的偶像， 通国受伤的人必唉哼。

chapters.en: Even if Babylon ascends to the heavens and fortifies her lofty stronghold, the destroyers I send will come against her,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦虽升到天上， 虽使她坚固的高处更坚固， 还有行毁灭的从我这里到她那里。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “The sound of a cry comes from Babylon, the sound of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans!
chapters.zh: 有哀号的声音从巴比伦出来； 有大毁灭的响声从迦勒底人之地发出。

chapters.en: For the LORD will destroy Babylon; He will silence her mighty voice. The waves will roar like great waters; the tumult of their voices will resound.
chapters.zh: 因耶和华使巴比伦变为荒场， 使其中的大声灭绝。 仇敌仿佛众水， 波浪匉訇，响声已经发出。

chapters.en: For a destroyer is coming against her— against Babylon. Her warriors will be captured, and their bows will be broken, for the LORD is a God of retribution; He will repay in full.
chapters.zh: 这是行毁灭的临到巴比伦。 巴比伦的勇士被捉住， 他们的弓折断了； 因为耶和华是施行报应的上帝， 必定施行报应。

chapters.en: I will make her princes and wise men drunk, along with her governors, officials, and warriors. Then they will fall asleep forever and not wake up,” declares the King, whose name is the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 君王－名为万军之耶和华的说： 我必使巴比伦的首领、 智慧人、省长、副省长，和勇士都沉醉， 使他们睡了长觉，永不醒起。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD of Hosts says:
“Babylon’s thick walls will be leveled, and her high gates consumed by fire. So the labor of the people will be for nothing; the nations will exhaust themselves to fuel the flames.”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说： 巴比伦宽阔的城墙必全然倾倒； 她高大的城门必被火焚烧。 众民所劳碌的必致虚空； 列国所劳碌的被火焚烧， 他们都必困乏。

chapters.en: This is the message that Jeremiah the prophet gave to the quartermaster Seraiah son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went to Babylon with King Zedekiah of Judah in the fourth year of Zedekiah’s reign.
chapters.zh: 犹大王西底家在位第四年，上巴比伦去的时候，玛西雅的孙子、尼利亚的儿子西莱雅与王同去（西莱雅是王宫的大臣），先知耶利米有话吩咐他。

chapters.en: Jeremiah had written on a single scroll about all the disaster that would come upon Babylon—all these words that had been written concerning Babylon.
chapters.zh: 耶利米将一切要临到巴比伦的灾祸，就是论到巴比伦的一切话，写在书上。

chapters.en: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, “When you get to Babylon, see that you read all these words aloud,
chapters.zh: 耶利米对西莱雅说：「你到了巴比伦务要念这书上的话；

chapters.en: and say, ‘O LORD, You have promised to cut off this place so that no one will remain—neither man nor beast. Indeed, it will be desolate forever.’
chapters.zh: 又说：『耶和华啊，你曾论到这地方说：要剪除，甚至连人带牲畜没有在这里居住的，必永远荒凉。』

chapters.en: When you finish reading this scroll, tie a stone to it and cast it into the Euphrates.
chapters.zh: 你念完了这书，就把一块石头拴在书上，扔在幼发拉底河中，

chapters.en:
Then you are to say, ‘In the same way Babylon will sink and never rise again, because of the disaster I will bring upon her. And her people will grow weary.’”
Here end the words of Jeremiah.
chapters.zh: 说：『巴比伦因耶和华所要降与她的灾祸，必如此沉下去，不再兴起，人民也必困乏。』」 耶利米的话到此为止。

chapters.en: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.
chapters.zh: 西底家登基的时候年二十一岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母亲名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。

chapters.en: And Zedekiah did evil in the sight of the LORD, just as Jehoiakim had done.
chapters.zh: 西底家行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，是照约雅敬一切所行的。

chapters.en:
For because of the anger of the LORD, all this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until He finally banished them from His presence.
And Zedekiah also rebelled against the king of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 因此耶和华的怒气在耶路撒冷和犹大发作，以致将人民从自己的面前赶出。

chapters.en: So in the ninth year of Zedekiah’s reign, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his entire army. They encamped outside the city and built a siege wall all around it.
chapters.zh: 西底家背叛巴比伦王。他作王第九年十月初十日，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领全军来攻击耶路撒冷，对城安营，四围筑垒攻城。

chapters.en: And the city was kept under siege until King Zedekiah’s eleventh year.
chapters.zh: 于是城被围困直到西底家王十一年。

chapters.en: By the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine in the city was so severe that the people of the land had no food.
chapters.zh: 四月初九日，城里有大饥荒，甚至百姓都没有粮食。

chapters.en:
Then the city was breached; and though the Chaldeans had surrounded the city, all the men of war fled the city by night by way of the gate between the two walls near the king’s garden.
They headed toward the Arabah,
chapters.zh: 城被攻破，一切兵丁就在夜间从靠近王园两城中间的门，出城逃跑；迦勒底人正在四围攻城。他们就往亚拉巴逃去。

chapters.en: but the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho, and his whole army deserted him.
chapters.zh: 迦勒底的军队追赶西底家王，在耶利哥的平原追上他。他的全军都离开他四散了。

chapters.en: The Chaldeans seized the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he pronounced judgment on Zedekiah.
chapters.zh: 迦勒底人就拿住王，带他到在哈马地利比拉的巴比伦王那里；巴比伦王便审判他。

chapters.en: There at Riblah the king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and he also killed all the officials of Judah.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王在西底家眼前杀了他的众子，又在利比拉杀了犹大的一切首领，

chapters.en: Then he put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him with bronze shackles, and took him to Babylon, where he kept him in custody until his dying day.
chapters.zh: 并且剜了西底家的眼睛，用铜鍊锁着他，带到巴比伦去，将他囚在监里，直到他死的日子。

chapters.en: On the tenth day of the fifth month, in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar’s reign over Babylon, Nebuzaradan captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, entered Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初十日，在巴比伦王面前侍立的护卫长尼布撒拉旦进入耶路撒冷，

chapters.en: He burned down the house of the LORD, the royal palace, and all the houses of Jerusalem—every significant building.
chapters.zh: 用火焚烧耶和华的殿和王宫，又焚烧耶路撒冷的房屋，就是各大户家的房屋。

chapters.en: And the whole army of the Chaldeans under the captain of the guard broke down all the walls around Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 跟从护卫长迦勒底的全军就拆毁耶路撒冷四围的城墙。

chapters.en: Then Nebuzaradan captain of the guard carried into exile some of the poorest people and those who remained in the city, along with the deserters who had defected to the king of Babylon and the rest of the craftsmen.
chapters.zh: 那时护卫长尼布撒拉旦将民中最穷的和城里所剩下的百姓，并已经投降巴比伦王的人，以及大众所剩下的人，都掳去了。

chapters.en: But Nebuzaradan captain of the guard left behind some of the poorest of the land to tend the vineyards and fields.
chapters.zh: 但护卫长尼布撒拉旦留下些民中最穷的，使他们修理葡萄园，耕种田地。

chapters.en: Moreover, the Chaldeans broke up the bronze pillars and stands and the bronze Sea in the house of the LORD, and they carried all the bronze to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 耶和华殿的铜柱并殿内的〔盆〕座和铜海，迦勒底人都打碎了，将那铜运到巴比伦去了，

chapters.en: They also took away the pots, shovels, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes, and all the articles of bronze used in the temple service.
chapters.zh: 又带去锅、铲子、蜡剪、盘子、调羹，并所用的一切铜器、

chapters.en: The captain of the guard also took away the basins, censers, sprinkling bowls, pots, lampstands, pans, and drink offering bowls—anything made of pure gold or fine silver.
chapters.zh: 杯、火鼎、碗、盆、灯台、调羹、爵，无论金的银的，护卫长也都带去了。

chapters.en: As for the two pillars, the Sea, the twelve bronze bulls under it, and the movable stands that King Solomon had made for the house of the LORD, the weight of the bronze from all these articles was beyond measure.
chapters.zh: 所罗门为耶和华殿所造的两根〔铜〕柱、一个〔铜〕海，并座下的十二只铜牛，这一切的铜多得无法可称。

chapters.en: Each pillar was eighteen cubits tall and twelve cubits in circumference; each was hollow, four fingers thick.
chapters.zh: 这一根柱子高十八肘，厚四指，是空的，围十二肘。

chapters.en: The bronze capital atop one pillar was five cubits high, with a network of bronze pomegranates all around. The second pillar, with its pomegranates, was similar.
chapters.zh: 柱上有铜顶，高五肘；铜顶的周围有网子和石榴，都是铜的。那一根柱子照此一样，也有石榴。

chapters.en: Each capital had ninety-six pomegranates on the sides, and a total of a hundred pomegranates were above the surrounding network.
chapters.zh: 柱子四面有九十六个石榴，在网子周围，共有一百石榴。

chapters.en: The captain of the guard also took away Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the priest of second rank, and the three doorkeepers.
chapters.zh: 护卫长拿住大祭司西莱雅、副祭司西番亚，和三个把门的，

chapters.en: Of those still in the city, he took a court official who had been appointed over the men of war, as well as seven trusted royal advisers. He also took the scribe of the captain of the army, who had enlisted the people of the land, and sixty men who were found in the city.
chapters.zh: 又从城中拿住一个管理兵丁的官〔注：或译：太监〕，并在城里所遇常见王面的七个人和检点国民军长的书记，以及城里所遇见的国民六十个人。

chapters.en: Nebuzaradan captain of the guard took them and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
chapters.zh: 护卫长尼布撒拉旦将这些人带到利比拉的巴比伦王那里。

chapters.en: There at Riblah in the land of Hamath, the king of Babylon struck them down and put them to death. So Judah was taken into exile, away from its own land.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王就把他们击杀在哈马地的利比拉。这样，犹大人被掳去离开本地。

chapters.en:
These are the people Nebuchadnezzar carried away:
in the seventh year, 3,023 Jews;
chapters.zh: 尼布甲尼撒所掳的民数记在下面：在他第七年掳去犹大人三千零二十三名；

chapters.en: in Nebuchadnezzar’s eighteenth year, 832 people from Jerusalem;
chapters.zh: 尼布甲尼撒十八年从耶路撒冷掳去八百三十二人；

chapters.en:
in Nebuchadnezzar’s twenty-third year, Nebuzaradan captain of the guard carried away 745 Jews.
So in all, 4,600 people were taken away.
chapters.zh: 尼布甲尼撒二十三年，护卫长尼布撒拉旦掳去犹大人七百四十五名；共有四千六百人。

chapters.en: On the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth month of the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the first year of the reign of Evil-merodach king of Babylon, he pardoned Jehoiachin king of Judah and released him from prison.
chapters.zh: 犹大王约雅斤被掳后三十七年，巴比伦王以未‧米罗达〔元〕年十二月二十五日，使犹大王约雅斤抬头，提他出监，

chapters.en: And he spoke kindly to Jehoiachin and set his throne above the thrones of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.
chapters.zh: 又对他说恩言，使他的位高过与他一同在巴比伦众王的位，

chapters.en: So Jehoiachin changed out of his prison clothes, and he dined regularly at the king’s table for the rest of his life.
chapters.zh: 给他脱了囚服。他终身在巴比伦王面前吃饭。

chapters.en: And the king of Babylon provided Jehoiachin a daily portion for the rest of his life, until the day of his death.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦王赐他所需用的食物，日日赐他一分，终身是这样，直到他死的日子。

chapters.en: How lonely lies the city, once so full of people! She who was great among the nations has become a widow. The princess of the provinces has become a slave.
chapters.zh: 先前满有人民的城， 现在何竟独坐！ 先前在列国中为大的， 现在竟如寡妇； 先前在诸省中为王后的， 现在成为进贡的。

chapters.en: She weeps aloud in the night, with tears upon her cheeks. Among all her lovers there is no one to comfort her. All her friends have betrayed her; they have become her enemies.
chapters.zh: 她夜间痛哭，泪流满腮； 在一切所亲爱的中间没有一个安慰她的。 她的朋友都以诡诈待她， 成为她的仇敌。

chapters.en: Judah has gone into exile under affliction and harsh slavery; she dwells among the nations but finds no place to rest. All her pursuers have overtaken her in the midst of her distress.
chapters.zh: 犹大因遭遇苦难， 又因多服劳苦就迁到〔外邦〕。 她住在列国中，寻不着安息； 追逼她的都在狭窄之地将她追上。

chapters.en: The roads to Zion mourn, because no one comes to her appointed feasts. All her gates are deserted; her priests groan, her maidens grieve, and she herself is bitter with anguish.
chapters.zh: 锡安的路径因无人来守圣节就悲伤； 她的城门凄凉； 她的祭司叹息； 她的处女受艰难，自己也愁苦。

chapters.en: Her foes have become her masters; her enemies are at ease. For the LORD has brought her grief because of her many transgressions. Her children have gone away as captives before the enemy.
chapters.zh: 她的敌人为首； 她的仇敌亨通； 因耶和华为她许多的罪过使她受苦； 她的孩童被敌人掳去。

chapters.en: All the splendor has departed from the Daughter of Zion. Her princes are like deer that find no pasture; they lack the strength to flee in the face of the hunter.
chapters.zh: 锡安城〔注：原文是女子；下同〕的威荣全都失去。 她的首领像找不着草场的鹿； 在追赶的人前无力行走。

chapters.en:
In the days of her affliction and wandering Jerusalem remembers all the treasures
that were hers in days of old. When her people fell into enemy hands she received no help. Her enemies looked upon her, laughing at her downfall.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷在困苦窘迫之时， 就追想古时一切的乐境。 她百姓落在敌人手中，无人救济； 敌人看见，就因她的荒凉嗤笑。

chapters.en:
Jerusalem has sinned greatly; therefore she has become an object of scorn. All who honored her now despise her, for they have seen her nakedness;
she herself groans and turns away.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷大大犯罪， 所以成为不洁之物； 素来尊敬她的，见她赤露就都藐视她； 她自己也叹息退后。

chapters.en: Her uncleanness stains her skirts; she did not consider her end. Her downfall was astounding; there was no one to comfort her. Look, O LORD, on my affliction, for the enemy has triumphed!
chapters.zh: 她的污秽是在衣襟上； 她不思想自己的结局， 所以非常地败落， 无人安慰她。 〔她说〕：耶和华啊，求你看我的苦难， 因为仇敌夸大。

chapters.en: The adversary has seized all her treasures. For she has seen the nations enter her sanctuary— those You had forbidden to enter Your assembly.
chapters.zh: 敌人伸手，夺取她的美物； 她眼见外邦人进入她的圣所－ 论这外邦人，你曾吩咐不可入你的会中。

chapters.en: All her people groan as they search for bread. They have traded their treasures for food to keep themselves alive. Look, O LORD, and consider, for I have become despised.
chapters.zh: 她的民都叹息，寻求食物； 他们用美物换粮食，要救性命。 〔他们说〕：耶和华啊，求你观看， 因为我甚是卑贱。

chapters.en: Is this nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look around and see! Is there any sorrow like mine, which was inflicted on me, which the LORD made me suffer on the day of His fierce anger?
chapters.zh: 你们一切过路的人哪，这事你们不介意吗？ 你们要观看： 有像这临到我的痛苦没有－ 就是耶和华在他发烈怒的日子使我所受的苦？

chapters.en: He sent fire from on high, and it overpowered my bones. He spread a net for my feet and turned me back. He made me desolate, faint all the day long.
chapters.zh: 他从高天使火进入我的骨头， 克制了我； 他铺下网罗，绊我的脚， 使我转回； 他使我终日凄凉发昏。

chapters.en: My transgressions are bound into a yoke, knit together by His hand; they are draped over my neck, and the Lord has broken my strength. He has delivered me into the hands of those I cannot withstand.
chapters.zh: 我罪过的轭是他手所绑的， 犹如轭绳缚在我颈项上； 他使我的力量衰败。 主将我交在我所不能敌挡的人手中。

chapters.en: The Lord has rejected all the mighty men in my midst; He has summoned an army against me to crush my young warriors. Like grapes in a winepress, the Lord has trampled the Virgin Daughter of Judah.
chapters.zh: 主轻弃我中间的一切勇士， 招聚多人〔注：原文是大会〕攻击我， 要压碎我的少年人。 主将犹大居民踹下， 像在酒醡中一样。

chapters.en: For these things I weep; my eyes flow with tears. For there is no one nearby to comfort me, no one to revive my soul. My children are destitute because the enemy has prevailed.
chapters.zh: 我因这些事哭泣； 我眼泪汪汪； 因为那当安慰我、救我性命的， 离我甚远。 我的儿女孤苦， 因为仇敌得了胜。

chapters.en: Zion stretches out her hands, but there is no one to comfort her. The LORD has decreed against Jacob that his neighbors become his foes. Jerusalem has become an unclean thing among them.
chapters.zh: 锡安举手，无人安慰。 耶和华论雅各已经出令， 使四围的人作他仇敌； 耶路撒冷在他们中间像不洁之物。

chapters.en: The LORD is righteous, yet I rebelled against His command. Listen, all you people; look upon my suffering. My young men and maidens have gone into captivity.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是公义的！ 〔他这样待我〕，是因我违背他的命令。 众民哪，请听我的话， 看我的痛苦； 我的处女和少年人都被掳去。

chapters.en: I called out to my lovers, but they have betrayed me. My priests and elders perished in the city while they searched for food to keep themselves alive.
chapters.zh: 我招呼我所亲爱的， 他们却愚弄我。 我的祭司和长老正寻求食物、救性命的时候， 就在城中绝气。

chapters.en: See, O LORD, how distressed I am! I am churning within; my heart is pounding within me, for I have been most rebellious. Outside, the sword bereaves; inside, there is death.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你观看， 因为我在急难中。 我心肠扰乱； 我心在我里面翻转， 因我大大悖逆。 在外，刀剑使人丧子； 在家，犹如死亡。

chapters.en: People have heard my groaning, but there is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that You have caused it. May You bring the day You have announced, so that they may become like me.
chapters.zh: 听见我叹息的有人； 安慰我的却无人！ 我的仇敌都听见我所遭的患难； 因你做这事，他们都喜乐。 你必使你报告的日子来到， 他们就像我一样。

chapters.en: Let all their wickedness come before You, and deal with them as You have dealt with me because of all my transgressions. For my groans are many, and my heart is faint.
chapters.zh: 愿他们的恶行都呈在你面前； 你怎样因我的一切罪过待我， 求你照样待他们； 因我叹息甚多，心中发昏。

chapters.en: How the Lord has covered the Daughter of Zion with the cloud of His anger! He has cast the glory of Israel from heaven to earth. He has abandoned His footstool in the day of His anger.
chapters.zh: 主何竟发怒，使黑云遮蔽锡安城！ 他将以色列的华美从天扔在地上； 在他发怒的日子并不记念自己的脚凳。

chapters.en: Without pity the Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob. In His wrath He has demolished the fortified cities of the Daughter of Judah. He brought to the ground and defiled her kingdom and its princes.
chapters.zh: 主吞灭雅各一切的住处，并不顾惜。 他发怒倾覆犹大民的保障， 使这保障坍倒在地； 他辱没这国和其中的首领。

chapters.en: In fierce anger He has cut off every horn of Israel and withdrawn His right hand at the approach of the enemy. He has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire that consumes everything around it.
chapters.zh: 他发烈怒，把以色列的角全然砍断， 在仇敌面前收回右手。 他像火焰四围吞灭，将雅各烧毁。

chapters.en: He has bent His bow like an enemy; His right hand is positioned. Like a foe He has killed all who were pleasing to the eye; He has poured out His wrath like fire on the tent of the Daughter of Zion.
chapters.zh: 他张弓好像仇敌； 他站着举起右手， 如同敌人将悦人眼目的，尽行杀戮。 在锡安百姓的帐棚上 倒出他的忿怒，像火一样。

chapters.en: The Lord is like an enemy; He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation for the Daughter of Judah.
chapters.zh: 主如仇敌吞灭以色列和锡安的一切宫殿， 拆毁百姓的保障； 在犹大民中加增悲伤哭号。

chapters.en: He has laid waste His tabernacle like a garden booth; He has destroyed His place of meeting. The LORD has made Zion forget her appointed feasts and Sabbaths. In His fierce anger He has despised both king and priest.
chapters.zh: 他强取自己的帐幕，好像是园中的〔窝〕棚， 毁坏他的聚会之处。 耶和华使圣节和安息日在锡安都被忘记， 又在怒气的愤恨中藐视君王和祭司。

chapters.en: The Lord has rejected His altar; He has abandoned His sanctuary; He has delivered the walls of her palaces into the hand of the enemy. They have raised a shout in the house of the LORD as on the day of an appointed feast.
chapters.zh: 耶和华丢弃自己的祭坛， 憎恶自己的圣所， 将宫殿的墙垣交付仇敌。 他们在耶和华的殿中喧嚷， 像在圣会之日一样。

chapters.en: The LORD determined to destroy the wall of the Daughter of Zion. He stretched out a measuring line and did not withdraw His hand from destroying. He made the ramparts and walls lament; together they waste away.
chapters.zh: 耶和华定意拆毁锡安的城墙； 他拉了准绳， 不将手收回，定要毁灭。 他使外郭和城墙都悲哀， 一同衰败。

chapters.en: Her gates have sunk into the ground; He has destroyed and shattered their bars. Her king and her princes are exiled among the nations, the law is no more, and even her prophets find no vision from the LORD.
chapters.zh: 锡安的门都陷入地内； 主将她的门闩毁坏，折断。 她的君王和首领落在没有律法的列国中； 她的先知不得见耶和华的异象。

chapters.en: The elders of the Daughter of Zion sit on the ground in silence. They have thrown dust on their heads and put on sackcloth. The young women of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground.
chapters.zh: 锡安城的长老坐在地上默默无声； 他们扬起尘土落在头上，腰束麻布； 耶路撒冷的处女垂头至地。

chapters.en: My eyes fail from weeping; I am churning within. My heart is poured out in grief over the destruction of the daughter of my people, because children and infants faint in the streets of the city.
chapters.zh: 我眼中流泪，以致失明； 我的心肠扰乱，肝〔胆〕涂地， 都因我众民遭毁灭， 又因孩童和吃奶的在城内街上发昏。

chapters.en: They cry out to their mothers: “Where is the grain and wine?” as they faint like the wounded in the streets of the city, as their lives fade away in the arms of their mothers.
chapters.zh: 那时，他们在城内街上发昏，好像受伤的， 在母亲的怀里，将要丧命； 对母亲说：谷、酒在哪里呢？

chapters.en:
What can I say for you? To what can I compare you,
O Daughter of Jerusalem? To what can I liken you, that I may console you,
O Virgin Daughter of Zion? For your wound is as deep as the sea. Who can ever heal you?
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷的民哪，我可用什么向你证明呢？ 我可用什么与你相比呢？ 锡安的民哪，我可拿什么和你比较，好安慰你呢？ 因为你的裂口大如海， 谁能医治你呢？

chapters.en: The visions of your prophets were empty and deceptive; they did not expose your guilt to ward off your captivity. The burdens they envisioned for you were empty and misleading.
chapters.zh: 你的先知为你见虚假和愚昧的异象， 并没有显露你的罪孽， 使你被掳的归回； 却为你见虚假的默示 和使你被赶出本境的缘故。

chapters.en:
All who pass by clap their hands at you in scorn. They hiss and shake their heads at the Daughter of Jerusalem: “Is this the city that was called the perfection of beauty,
the joy of all the earth?”
chapters.zh: 凡过路的都向你拍掌。 他们向耶路撒冷城嗤笑，摇头，〔说〕： 难道人所称为全美的， 称为全地所喜悦的，就是这城吗？

chapters.en: All your enemies open their mouths against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth, saying, “We have swallowed her up. This is the day for which we have waited. We have lived to see it!”
chapters.zh: 你的仇敌都向你大大张口； 他们嗤笑，又切齿说： 我们吞灭她。 这真是我们所盼望的日子临到了！ 我们亲眼看见了！

chapters.en: The LORD has done what He planned; He has accomplished His decree, which He ordained in days of old; He has overthrown you without pity. He has let the enemy gloat over you and exalted the horn of your foes.
chapters.zh: 耶和华成就了他所定的， 应验了他古时所命定的。 他倾覆了，并不顾惜， 使你的仇敌向你夸耀； 使你敌人的角也被高举。

chapters.en:
The hearts of the people cry out to the Lord. O wall of the Daughter of Zion, let your tears run down like a river
day and night. Give yourself no relief, and your eyes no rest.
chapters.zh: 锡安民的心哀求主。 锡安的城墙啊，愿你流泪如河， 昼夜不息； 愿你眼中的瞳人泪流不止。

chapters.en: Arise, cry out in the night from the first watch of the night. Pour out your heart like water in the presence of the Lord. Lift up your hands to Him for the lives of your children who are fainting from hunger on the corner of every street.
chapters.zh: 夜间，每逢交更的时候要起来呼喊， 在主面前倾心如水。 你的孩童在各市口上受饿发昏； 你要为他们的性命向主举手祷告。

chapters.en: Look, O LORD, and consider: Whom have You ever treated like this? Should women eat their offspring, the infants they have nurtured? Should priests and prophets be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你观看！ 见你向谁这样行？ 妇人岂可吃自己所生育手里所摇弄的婴孩吗？ 祭司和先知岂可在主的圣所中被杀戮吗？

chapters.en: Both young and old lie together in the dust of the streets. My young men and maidens have fallen by the sword. You have slain them in the day of Your anger; You have slaughtered them without compassion.
chapters.zh: 少年人和老年人都在街上躺卧； 我的处女和壮丁都倒在刀下； 你发怒的日子杀死他们。 你杀了，并不顾惜。

chapters.en: You summoned my terrors on every side, as for the day of an appointed feast. In the day of the LORD’s anger no one escaped or survived; my enemy has destroyed those I nurtured and reared.
chapters.zh: 你招聚四围惊吓我的， 像在大会的日子招聚〔人〕一样。 耶和华发怒的日子， 无人逃脱，无人存留。 我所摇弄所养育的婴孩， 仇敌都杀净了。

chapters.en: I am the man who has seen affliction under the rod of God’s wrath.
chapters.zh: 我是因耶和华忿怒的杖， 遭遇困苦的人。

chapters.en: He has driven me away and made me walk in darkness instead of light.
chapters.zh: 他引导我，使我行在黑暗中， 不行在光明里。

chapters.en: Indeed, He keeps turning His hand against me all day long.
chapters.zh: 他真是终日再三反手攻击我。

chapters.en: He has worn away my flesh and skin; He has shattered my bones.
chapters.zh: 他使我的皮肉枯干； 他折断〔注：或译：压伤〕我的骨头。

chapters.en: He has besieged me and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
chapters.zh: 他筑垒攻击我， 用苦楚〔注：原文是苦胆〕和艰难围困我。

chapters.en: He has made me dwell in darkness like those dead for ages.
chapters.zh: 他使我住在幽暗之处， 像死了许久的人一样。

chapters.en: He has walled me in so I cannot escape; He has weighed me down with chains.
chapters.zh: 他用篱笆围住我，使我不能出去； 他使我的铜鍊沉重。

chapters.en: Even when I cry out and plead for help, He shuts out my prayer.
chapters.zh: 我哀号求救； 他使我的祷告不得上达。

chapters.en: He has barred my ways with cut stones; He has made my paths crooked.
chapters.zh: 他用凿过的石头挡住我的道； 他使我的路弯曲。

chapters.en: He is a bear lying in wait, a lion hiding in ambush.
chapters.zh: 他向我如熊埋伏， 如狮子在隐密处。

chapters.en: He forced me off my path and tore me to pieces; He left me without help.
chapters.zh: 他使我转离正路， 将我撕碎，使我凄凉。

chapters.en: He bent His bow and set me as the target for His arrow.
chapters.zh: 他张弓将我当作箭靶子。

chapters.en: He pierced my kidneys with His arrows.
chapters.zh: 他把箭袋中的箭射入我的肺腑。

chapters.en: I am a laughingstock to all my people; they mock me in song all day long.
chapters.zh: 我成了众民的笑话； 他们终日以我为歌曲。

chapters.en: He has filled me with bitterness; He has intoxicated me with wormwood.
chapters.zh: 他用苦楚充满我，使我饱用茵蔯。

chapters.en: He has ground my teeth with gravel and trampled me in the dust.
chapters.zh: 他又用沙石碜断我的牙， 用灰尘将我蒙蔽。

chapters.en: My soul has been deprived of peace; I have forgotten what prosperity is.
chapters.zh: 你使我远离平安， 我忘记好处。

chapters.en: So I say, “My strength has perished, along with my hope from the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 我就说：我的力量衰败； 我在耶和华那里毫无指望！

chapters.en: Remember my affliction and wandering, the wormwood and the gall.
chapters.zh: 〔耶和华啊〕，求你记念我 如茵蔯和苦胆的困苦窘迫。

chapters.en: Surely my soul remembers and is humbled within me.
chapters.zh: 我心想念这些， 就在里面忧闷。

chapters.en: Yet I call this to mind, and therefore I have hope:
chapters.zh: 我想起这事， 心里就有指望。

chapters.en: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.
chapters.zh: 我们不致消灭， 是出于耶和华诸般的慈爱； 是因他的怜悯不致断绝。

chapters.en: They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
chapters.zh: 每早晨，这都是新的； 你的诚实极其广大！

chapters.en: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul, “therefore I will hope in Him.”
chapters.zh: 我心里说：耶和华是我的分， 因此，我要仰望他。

chapters.en: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
chapters.zh: 凡等候耶和华，心里寻求他的， 耶和华必施恩给他。

chapters.en: It is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 人仰望耶和华， 静默等候他的救恩， 这原是好的。

chapters.en: It is good for a man to bear the yoke while he is still young.
chapters.zh: 人在幼年负轭， 这原是好的。

chapters.en: Let him sit alone in silence, for the LORD has laid it upon him.
chapters.zh: 他当独坐无言， 因为这是耶和华加在他身上的。

chapters.en: Let him bury his face in the dust— perhaps there is still hope.
chapters.zh: 他当口贴尘埃， 或者有指望。

chapters.en: Let him offer his cheek to the one who would strike him; let him be filled with reproach.
chapters.zh: 他当由人打他的腮颊， 要满受凌辱。

chapters.en: For the Lord will not cast us off forever.
chapters.zh: 因为主必不永远丢弃人。

chapters.en: Even if He causes grief, He will show compassion according to His abundant loving devotion.
chapters.zh: 主虽使人忧愁， 还要照他诸般的慈爱发怜悯。

chapters.en: For He does not willingly afflict or grieve the sons of men.
chapters.zh: 因他并不甘心使人受苦， 使人忧愁。

chapters.en: To crush underfoot all the prisoners of the land,
chapters.zh: 人将世上被囚的踹〔注：原文是压〕在脚下，

chapters.en: to deny a man justice before the Most High,
chapters.zh: 或在至高者面前屈枉人，

chapters.en: to subvert a man in his lawsuit— of these the Lord does not approve.
chapters.zh: 或在人的讼事上颠倒是非， 这都是主看不上的。

chapters.en: Who has spoken and it came to pass, unless the Lord has ordained it?
chapters.zh: 除非主命定， 谁能说成就成呢？

chapters.en: Do not both adversity and good come from the mouth of the Most High?
chapters.zh: 祸福不都出于至高者的口吗？

chapters.en: Why should any mortal man complain, in view of his sins?
chapters.zh: 活人因自己的罪受罚， 为何发怨言呢？

chapters.en: Let us examine and test our ways, and turn back to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我们当深深考察自己的行为， 再归向耶和华。

chapters.en: Let us lift up our hearts and hands to God in heaven:
chapters.zh: 我们当诚心向天上的上帝举手祷告。

chapters.en: “We have sinned and rebelled; You have not forgiven.”
chapters.zh: 我们犯罪背逆， 你并不赦免。

chapters.en: You have covered Yourself in anger and pursued us; You have killed without pity.
chapters.zh: 你自被怒气遮蔽，追赶我们； 你施行杀戮，并不顾惜。

chapters.en: You have covered Yourself with a cloud that no prayer can pass through.
chapters.zh: 你以黑云遮蔽自己， 以致祷告不得透入。

chapters.en: You have made us scum and refuse among the nations.
chapters.zh: 你使我们在万民中成为污秽和渣滓。

chapters.en: All our enemies open their mouths against us.
chapters.zh: 我们的仇敌都向我们大大张口。

chapters.en: Panic and pitfall have come upon us— devastation and destruction.
chapters.zh: 恐惧和陷坑，残害和毁灭， 都临近我们。

chapters.en: Streams of tears flow from my eyes over the destruction of the daughter of my people.
chapters.zh: 因我众民遭的毁灭， 我就眼泪下流如河。

chapters.en: My eyes overflow unceasingly, without relief,
chapters.zh: 我的眼多多流泪， 总不止息，

chapters.en: until the LORD looks down from heaven and sees.
chapters.zh: 直等耶和华垂顾， 从天观看。

chapters.en: My eyes bring grief to my soul because of all the daughters of my city.
chapters.zh: 因我本城的众民， 我的眼，使我的心伤痛。

chapters.en: Without cause my enemies hunted me like a bird.
chapters.zh: 无故与我为仇的追逼我， 像追雀鸟一样。

chapters.en: They dropped me alive into a pit and cast stones upon me.
chapters.zh: 他们使我的命在牢狱中断绝， 并将一块石头抛在我身上。

chapters.en: The waters flowed over my head, and I thought I was going to die.
chapters.zh: 众水流过我头， 我说：我〔命〕断绝了！

chapters.en: I called on Your name, O LORD, out of the depths of the Pit.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊， 我从深牢中求告你的名。

chapters.en: You heard my plea: “Do not ignore my cry for relief.”
chapters.zh: 你曾听见我的声音； 我求你解救， 你不要掩耳不听。

chapters.en: You drew near when I called on You; You said, “Do not be afraid.”
chapters.zh: 我求告你的日子，你临近我， 说：不要惧怕！

chapters.en: You defend my cause, O Lord; You redeem my life.
chapters.zh: 主啊，你伸明了我的冤； 你救赎了我的命。

chapters.en: You have seen, O LORD, the wrong done to me; vindicate my cause!
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你见了我受的委屈； 求你为我伸冤。

chapters.en: You have seen all their malice, all their plots against me.
chapters.zh: 他们仇恨我，谋害我， 你都看见了。

chapters.en: O LORD, You have heard their insults, all their plots against me—
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你听见他们辱骂我的话， 知道他们向我所设的计，

chapters.en: the slander and murmuring of my assailants against me all day long.
chapters.zh: 并那些起来攻击我的人口中所说的话， 以及终日向我所设的计谋。

chapters.en: When they sit and when they rise, see how they mock me in song.
chapters.zh: 求你观看， 他们坐下，起来，都以我为歌曲。

chapters.en: You will pay them back what they deserve, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你要按着他们手所做的 向他们施行报应。

chapters.en: Put a veil of anguish over their hearts; may Your curse be upon them!
chapters.zh: 你要使他们心里刚硬， 使你的咒诅临到他们。

chapters.en: You will pursue them in anger and exterminate them from under Your heavens, O LORD.
chapters.zh: 你要发怒追赶他们， 从耶和华的天下除灭他们。

chapters.en: How the gold has become tarnished, the pure gold has become dull! The gems of the temple lie scattered on every street corner.
chapters.zh: 黄金何其失光！ 纯金何其变色！ 圣所的石头倒在各市口上。

chapters.en: How the precious sons of Zion, once worth their weight in pure gold, are now esteemed as jars of clay, the work of a potter’s hands!
chapters.zh: 锡安宝贵的众子好比精金， 现在何竟算为窑匠手所做的瓦瓶？

chapters.en: Even jackals offer their breasts to nurse their young, but the daughter of my people has become cruel, like an ostrich in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 野狗尚且把奶乳哺其子， 我民的妇人倒成为残忍， 好像旷野的鸵鸟一般。

chapters.en: The nursing infant’s tongue clings in thirst to the roof of his mouth. Little children beg for bread, but no one gives them any.
chapters.zh: 吃奶孩子的舌头因干渴贴住上膛； 孩童求饼，无人擘给他们。

chapters.en: Those who once ate delicacies are destitute in the streets; those brought up in crimson huddle in ash heaps.
chapters.zh: 素来吃美好食物的， 现今在街上变为孤寒； 素来卧朱红褥子的， 现今躺卧粪堆。

chapters.en: The punishment of the daughter of my people is greater than that of Sodom, which was overthrown in an instant without a hand turned to help her.
chapters.zh: 都因我众民的罪孽比所多玛的罪还大； 所多玛虽然无人加手于她， 还是转眼之间被倾覆。

chapters.en: Her dignitaries were brighter than snow, whiter than milk; their bodies were more ruddy than rubies, their appearance like sapphires.
chapters.zh: 锡安的贵胄素来比雪纯净， 比奶更白； 他们的身体比红宝玉〔注：或译：珊瑚〕更红， 像光润的蓝宝石一样。

chapters.en: But now their appearance is blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets. Their skin has shriveled on their bones; it has become as dry as a stick.
chapters.zh: 现在他们的面貌比煤炭更黑， 以致在街上无人认识； 他们的皮肤紧贴骨头， 枯干如同槁木。

chapters.en: Those slain by the sword are better off than those who die of hunger, who waste away, pierced with pain because the fields lack produce.
chapters.zh: 饿死的不如被刀杀的， 因为这是缺了田间的土产， 就身体衰弱，渐渐消灭。

chapters.en: The hands of compassionate women have cooked their own children, who became their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
chapters.zh: 慈心的妇人，当我众民被毁灭的时候， 亲手煮自己的儿女作为食物。

chapters.en: The LORD has exhausted His wrath; He has poured out His fierce anger; He has kindled a fire in Zion, and it has consumed her foundations.
chapters.zh: 耶和华发怒成就他所定的， 倒出他的烈怒； 在锡安使火着起， 烧毁锡安的根基。

chapters.en: The kings of the earth did not believe, nor any people of the world, that an enemy or a foe could enter the gates of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 地上的君王和世上的居民都不信 敌人和仇敌能进耶路撒冷的城门。

chapters.en: But this was for the sins of her prophets and the guilt of her priests, who shed the blood of the righteous in her midst.
chapters.zh: 这都因她先知的罪恶和祭司的罪孽； 他们在城中流了义人的血。

chapters.en: They wandered blind in the streets, defiled by this blood, so that no one dared to touch their garments.
chapters.zh: 他们在街上如瞎子乱走， 又被血玷污， 以致人不能摸他们的衣服。

chapters.en: “Go away! Unclean!” men shouted at them. “Away, away! Do not touch us!” So they fled and wandered. Among the nations it was said, “They can stay here no longer.”
chapters.zh: 人向他们喊着说： 不洁净的，躲开，躲开！ 不要挨近我！ 他们逃走飘流的时候， 列国中有人说： 他们不可仍〔在这里〕寄居。

chapters.en: The presence of the LORD has scattered them; He regards them no more. The priests are shown no honor; the elders find no favor.
chapters.zh: 耶和华发怒，将他们分散， 不再眷顾他们； 人不重看祭司，也不厚待长老。

chapters.en: All the while our eyes were failing as we looked in vain for help. We watched from our towers for a nation that could not save us.
chapters.zh: 我们〔仰望〕人来帮助， 以致眼目失明，还是枉然； 我们所盼望的，竟盼望一个不能救人的国！

chapters.en: They stalked our every step, so that we could not walk in our streets. Our end drew near, our time ran out, for our end had come!
chapters.zh: 仇敌追赶我们的脚步像打猎的， 以致我们不敢在自己的街上行走。 我们的结局临近； 我们的日子满足； 我们的结局来到了。

chapters.en: Those who chased us were swifter than the eagles in the sky; they pursued us over the mountains and ambushed us in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 追赶我们的比空中的鹰更快； 他们在山上追逼我们， 在旷野埋伏，等候我们。

chapters.en: The LORD’s anointed, the breath of our life, was captured in their pits. We had said of him, “Under his shadow we will live among the nations.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华的受膏者好比我们鼻中的气， 在他们的坑中被捉住； 我们曾论到他说： 我们必在他荫下， 在列国中存活。

chapters.en: So rejoice and be glad, O Daughter of Edom, you who dwell in the land of Uz. Yet the cup will pass to you as well; you will get drunk and expose yourself.
chapters.zh: 住乌斯地的以东民哪，只管欢喜快乐； 〔苦〕杯也必传到你那里； 你必喝醉，以致露体。

chapters.en: O Daughter of Zion, your punishment is complete; He will not prolong your exile. But He will punish your iniquity, O Daughter of Edom; He will expose your sins.
chapters.zh: 锡安的民哪，你罪孽的刑罚受足了， 耶和华必不使你再被掳去。 以东的民哪，他必追讨你的罪孽， 显露你的罪恶。

chapters.en: Remember, O LORD, what has happened to us. Look and see our disgrace!
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你记念我们所遭遇的事， 观看我们所受的凌辱。

chapters.en: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to foreigners.
chapters.zh: 我们的产业归与外邦人； 我们的房屋归与外路人。

chapters.en: We have become fatherless orphans; our mothers are widows.
chapters.zh: 我们是无父的孤儿； 我们的母亲好像寡妇。

chapters.en: We must buy the water we drink; our wood comes at a price.
chapters.zh: 我们出钱才得水喝； 我们的柴是人卖给我们的。

chapters.en: We are closely pursued; we are weary and find no rest.
chapters.zh: 追赶我们的，到了我们的颈项上； 我们疲乏不得歇息。

chapters.en: We submitted to Egypt and Assyria to get enough bread.
chapters.zh: 我们投降埃及人和亚述人， 为要得粮吃饱。

chapters.en: Our fathers sinned and are no more, but we bear their punishment.
chapters.zh: 我们列祖犯罪，而今不在了； 我们担当他们的罪孽。

chapters.en: Slaves rule over us; there is no one to deliver us from their hands.
chapters.zh: 奴仆辖制我们， 无人救我们脱离他们的手。

chapters.en: We get our bread at the risk of our lives because of the sword in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 因为旷野的刀剑， 我们冒着险才得粮食。

chapters.en: Our skin is as hot as an oven with fever from our hunger.
chapters.zh: 因饥饿燥热， 我们的皮肤就黑如炉。

chapters.en: Women have been ravished in Zion, virgins in the cities of Judah.
chapters.zh: 敌人在锡安玷污妇人， 在犹大的城邑玷污处女。

chapters.en: Princes have been hung up by their hands; elders receive no respect.
chapters.zh: 他们吊起首领的手， 也不尊敬老人的面。

chapters.en: Young men toil at millstones; boys stagger under loads of wood.
chapters.zh: 少年人扛磨石， 孩童背木柴，都绊跌了。

chapters.en: The elders have left the city gate; the young men have stopped their music.
chapters.zh: 老年人在城门口断绝； 少年人不再作乐。

chapters.en: Joy has left our hearts; our dancing has turned to mourning.
chapters.zh: 我们心中的快乐止息， 跳舞变为悲哀。

chapters.en: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
chapters.zh: 冠冕从我们的头上落下； 我们犯罪了，我们有祸了！

chapters.en: Because of this, our hearts are faint; because of these, our eyes grow dim—
chapters.zh: 这些事我们心里发昏， 我们的眼睛昏花。

chapters.en: because of Mount Zion, which lies desolate, patrolled by foxes.
chapters.zh: 锡安山荒凉， 野狗〔注：或译：狐狸〕行在其上。

chapters.en: You, O LORD, reign forever; Your throne endures from generation to generation.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你存到永远； 你的宝座存到万代。

chapters.en: Why have You forgotten us forever? Why have You forsaken us for so long?
chapters.zh: 你为何永远忘记我们？ 为何许久离弃我们？

chapters.en: Restore us to Yourself, O LORD, so we may return; renew our days as of old,
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你使我们向你回转， 我们便得回转。 求你复新我们的日子，像古时一样。

chapters.en: unless You have utterly rejected us and remain angry with us beyond measure.
chapters.zh: 你竟全然弃绝我们， 向我们大发烈怒？

chapters.en: In the thirtieth year, on the fifth day of the fourth month, while I was among the exiles by the River Kebar, the heavens opened and I saw visions of God.
chapters.zh: 当三十年四〔月〕初五〔日〕，以西结〔注：原文是我〕在迦巴鲁河边被掳的人中，天就开了，得见上帝的异象。

chapters.en: On the fifth day of the month—it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin—
chapters.zh: 正是约雅斤王被掳去第五年四月初五日，

chapters.en: the word of the LORD came directly to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the River Kebar. And there the LORD’s hand was upon him.
chapters.zh: 在迦勒底人之地、迦巴鲁河边，耶和华的话特特临到布西的儿子祭司以西结；耶和华的灵〔注：原文是手〕降在他身上。

chapters.en: I looked and saw a whirlwind coming from the north, a great cloud with fire flashing back and forth and brilliant light all around it. In the center of the fire was a gleam like amber,
chapters.zh: 我观看，见狂风从北方刮来，随着有一朵包括闪烁火的大云，周围有光辉；从其中的火内发出好像光耀的精金；

chapters.en:
and within it was the form of four living creatures.
And this was their appearance: They had a human form,
chapters.zh: 又从其中显出四个活物的形像来。他们的形状是这样：有人的形像，

chapters.en: but each had four faces and four wings.
chapters.zh: 各有四个脸面，四个翅膀。

chapters.en: Their legs were straight, and the soles of their feet were like the hooves of a calf, gleaming like polished bronze.
chapters.zh: 他们的腿是直的，脚掌好像牛犊之蹄，都灿烂如光明的铜。

chapters.en: Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands. All four living creatures had faces and wings,
chapters.zh: 在四面的翅膀以下有人的手。这四个活物的脸和翅膀乃是这样：

chapters.en: and their wings were touching one another. They did not turn as they moved; each one went straight ahead.
chapters.zh: 翅膀彼此相接，行走并不转身，俱各直往前行。

chapters.en: The form of their faces was that of a man, and each of the four had the face of a lion on the right side, the face of an ox on the left side, and also the face of an eagle.
chapters.zh: 至于脸的形像：〔前面〕各有人的脸，右面各有狮子的脸，左面各有牛的脸，〔后面〕各有鹰的脸。

chapters.en:
Such were their faces.
Their wings were spread upward; each had two wings touching the wings of the creature on either side, and two wings covering its body.
chapters.zh: 各展开上边的两个翅膀相接，各以〔下边的〕两个〔翅膀〕遮体。

chapters.en: Each creature went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, without turning as they moved.
chapters.zh: 他们俱各直往前行。灵往哪里去，他们就往那里去，行走并不转身。

chapters.en: In the midst of the living creatures was the appearance of glowing coals of fire, or of torches. Fire moved back and forth between the living creatures; it was bright, and lightning flashed out of it.
chapters.zh: 至于四活物的形像，就如烧着火炭的形状，又如火把的形状。〔火〕在四活物中间上去下来，这火有光辉，从火中发出闪电。

chapters.en: The creatures were darting back and forth as quickly as flashes of lightning.
chapters.zh: 这活物往来奔走，好像电光一闪。

chapters.en: When I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces.
chapters.zh: 我正观看活物的时候，见活物的脸旁各有一轮在地上。

chapters.en: The workmanship of the wheels looked like the gleam of beryl, and all four had the same likeness. Their workmanship looked like a wheel within a wheel.
chapters.zh: 轮的形状和颜色〔注：原文是作法〕好像水苍玉。四轮都是一个样式，形状和作法好像轮中套轮。

chapters.en: As they moved, they went in any of the four directions, without pivoting as they moved.
chapters.zh: 轮行走的时候，向四方都能直行，并不掉转。

chapters.en: Their rims were high and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around.
chapters.zh: 至于轮辋，高而可畏；四个轮辋周围满有眼睛。

chapters.en: So as the living creatures moved, the wheels moved beside them, and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose.
chapters.zh: 活物行走，轮也在旁边行走；活物从地上升，轮也都上升。

chapters.en: Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, and the wheels would rise alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
chapters.zh: 灵往哪里去，活物就往那里去；活物上升，轮也在活物旁边上升，因为活物的灵在轮中。

chapters.en: When the creatures moved, the wheels moved; when the creatures stood still, the wheels stood still; and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
chapters.zh: 那些行走，这些也行走；那些站住，这些也站住；那些从地上升，轮也在旁边上升，因为活物的灵在轮中。

chapters.en: Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was the likeness of an awesome expanse, gleaming like crystal.
chapters.zh: 活物的头以上有穹苍的形像，看着像可畏的水晶，铺张在活物的头以上。

chapters.en: And under the expanse, their wings stretched out toward one another. Each one also had two wings covering its body.
chapters.zh: 穹苍以下，活物的翅膀直张，彼此相对；每活物有两个翅膀遮体。

chapters.en:
When the creatures moved, I heard the sound of their wings like the roar of many waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army.
When they stood still, they lowered their wings.
chapters.zh: 活物行走的时候，我听见翅膀的响声，像大水的声音，像全能者的声音，也像军队鬨嚷的声音。活物站住的时候，便将翅膀垂下。

chapters.en: And there came a voice from above the expanse over their heads as they stood still with their wings lowered.
chapters.zh: 在他们头以上的穹苍之上有声音。他们站住的时候，便将翅膀垂下。

chapters.en: Above the expanse over their heads was the likeness of a throne with the appearance of sapphire, and on the throne high above was a figure like that of a man.
chapters.zh: 在他们头以上的穹苍之上有宝座的形像，仿佛蓝宝石；在宝座形像以上有仿佛人的形状。

chapters.en: From what seemed to be His waist up, I saw a gleam like amber, with what looked like fire within it all around. And from what seemed to be His waist down, I saw what looked like fire; and brilliant light surrounded Him.
chapters.zh: 我见从他腰以上有仿佛光耀的精金，周围都有火的形状，又见从他腰以下有仿佛火的形状，周围也有光辉。

chapters.en: The appearance of the brilliant light all around Him was like that of a rainbow in a cloud on a rainy day. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw it, I fell facedown and heard a voice speaking.
chapters.zh: 下雨的日子，云中虹的形状怎样，周围光辉的形状也是怎样。 这就是耶和华荣耀的形像。我一看见就俯伏在地，又听见一位说话的声音。

chapters.en: “Son of man, ” He said to me, “stand up on your feet and I will speak to you.”
chapters.zh: 他对我说：「人子啊，你站起来，我要和你说话。」

chapters.en: And as He spoke to me, the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet, and I heard Him speaking to me.
chapters.zh: 他对我说话的时候，灵就进入我里面，使我站起来，我便听见那位对我说话的〔声音〕。

chapters.en: “Son of man,” He said to me, “I am sending you to the Israelites, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against Me. To this very day they and their fathers have rebelled against Me.
chapters.zh: 他对我说：「人子啊，我差你往悖逆的国民以色列人那里去。他们是悖逆我的，他们和他们的列祖违背我，直到今日。

chapters.en: They are obstinate and stubborn children. I am sending you to them, and you are to say to them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’
chapters.zh: 这众子面无羞耻，心里刚硬。我差你往他们那里去，你要对他们说：主耶和华如此说。

chapters.en: And whether they listen or refuse to listen—for they are a rebellious house—they will know that a prophet has been among them.
chapters.zh: 他们或听，或不听，（他们是悖逆之家），必知道在他们中间有了先知。

chapters.en: But you, son of man, do not be afraid of them or their words. Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns surround you, and you dwell among scorpions. Do not be afraid of their words or dismayed by their presence, though they are a rebellious house.
chapters.zh: 人子啊，虽有荆棘和蒺藜在你那里，你又住在蠍子中间，总不要怕他们，也不要怕他们的话；他们虽是悖逆之家，还不要怕他们的话，也不要因他们的脸色惊惶。

chapters.en: But speak My words to them, whether they listen or refuse to listen, for they are rebellious.
chapters.zh: 他们或听，或不听，你只管将我的话告诉他们；他们是极其悖逆的。

chapters.en: And you, son of man, listen to what I tell you. Do not be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth and eat what I give you.”
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，要听我对你所说的话，不要悖逆像那悖逆之家，你要开口吃我所赐给你的。」

chapters.en: Then I looked and saw a hand reaching out to me, and in it was a scroll,
chapters.zh: 我观看，见有一只手向我伸出来，手中有一书卷。

chapters.en: which He unrolled before me. And written on the front and back of it were words of lamentation, mourning, and woe.
chapters.zh: 他将书卷在我面前展开，内外都写着字，其上所写的有哀号、叹息、悲痛的话。

chapters.en: “Son of man,” He said to me, “eat what you find here. Eat this scroll, then go and speak to the house of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 他对我说：「人子啊，要吃你所得的，要吃这书卷，好去对以色列家讲说。」

chapters.en: So I opened my mouth, and He fed me the scroll.
chapters.zh: 于是我开口，他就使我吃这书卷，

chapters.en:
“Son of man,” He said to me, “eat and fill your stomach with this scroll I am giving you.”
So I ate, and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth.
chapters.zh: 又对我说：「人子啊，要吃我所赐给你的这书卷，充满你的肚腹。」我就吃了，口中觉得其甜如蜜。

chapters.en: Then He said to me, “Son of man, go now to the house of Israel and speak My words to them.
chapters.zh: 他对我说：「人子啊，你往以色列家那里去，将我的话对他们讲说。

chapters.en: For you are not being sent to a people of unfamiliar speech or difficult language, but to the house of Israel—
chapters.zh: 你奉差遣不是往那说话深奥、言语难懂的民那里去，乃是往以色列家去；

chapters.en: not to the many peoples of unfamiliar speech and difficult language whose words you cannot understand. Surely if I had sent you to them, they would have listened to you.
chapters.zh: 不是往那说话深奥、言语难懂的多国去，他们的话语是你不懂得的。我若差你往他们那里去，他们必听从你。

chapters.en: But the house of Israel will be unwilling to listen to you, since they are unwilling to listen to Me. For the whole house of Israel is hard-headed and hard-hearted.
chapters.zh: 以色列家却不肯听从你，因为他们不肯听从我；原来以色列全家是额坚心硬的人。

chapters.en: Behold, I will make your face as hard as their faces, and your forehead as hard as their foreheads.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我使你的脸硬过他们的脸，使你的额硬过他们的额。

chapters.en: I will make your forehead like a diamond, harder than flint. Do not be afraid of them or dismayed at their presence, even though they are a rebellious house.”
chapters.zh: 我使你的额像金钢钻，比火石更硬。他们虽是悖逆之家，你不要怕他们，也不要因他们的脸色惊惶。」

chapters.en: “Son of man,” He added, “listen carefully to all the words I speak to you, and take them to heart.
chapters.zh: 他又对我说：「人子啊，我对你所说的一切话，要心里领会，耳中听闻。

chapters.en: Go to your people, the exiles; speak to them and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ whether they listen or refuse to listen.”
chapters.zh: 你往你本国被掳的子民那里去，他们或听，或不听，你要对他们讲说，告诉他们这是主耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard a great rumbling sound behind me: “Blessed be the glory of the LORD in His dwelling place!”
chapters.zh: 那时，灵将我举起，我就听见在我身后有震动轰轰的声音，〔说〕：「从耶和华的所在显出来的荣耀是该称颂的！」

chapters.en: It was the sound of the wings of the living creatures brushing against one another and the sound of the wheels beside them, a great rumbling sound.
chapters.zh: 我又〔听见〕那活物翅膀相碰，与活物旁边轮子旋转震动轰轰的响声。

chapters.en: So the Spirit lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness and in the anger of my spirit, with the strong hand of the LORD upon me.
chapters.zh: 于是灵将我举起，带我而去。我心中甚苦，灵性忿激，并且耶和华的灵〔注：原文是手〕在我身上大有能力。

chapters.en: I came to the exiles at Tel-abib who dwelt by the River Kebar. And for seven days I sat where they sat and remained there among them, overwhelmed.
chapters.zh: 我就来到提勒‧亚毕，住在迦巴鲁河边被掳的人那里，到他们所住的地方，在他们中间忧忧闷闷地坐了七日。

chapters.en: At the end of seven days the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 过了七日，耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel. Whenever you hear a word from My mouth, give them a warning from Me.
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，我立你作以色列家守望的人，所以你要听我口中的话，替我警戒他们。

chapters.en: If I say to the wicked man, ‘You will surely die,’ but you do not warn him or speak out to warn him from his wicked way to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity, and I will hold you responsible for his blood.
chapters.zh: 我何时指着恶人说：他必要死；你若不警戒他，也不劝戒他，使他离开恶行，拯救他的性命，这恶人必死在罪孽之中；我却要向你讨他丧命的罪〔注：原文是血〕。

chapters.en: But if you warn a wicked man and he does not turn from his wickedness and his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity, but you will have saved yourself.
chapters.zh: 倘若你警戒恶人，他仍不转离罪恶，也不离开恶行，他必死在罪孽之中，你却救自己脱离了罪。

chapters.en: Now if a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I put a stumbling block before him, he will die. If you did not warn him, he will die in his sin, and the righteous acts he did will not be remembered. And I will hold you responsible for his blood.
chapters.zh: 再者，义人何时离义而犯罪，我将绊脚石放在他面前，他就必死；因你没有警戒他，他必死在罪中，他素来所行的义不被记念；我却要向你讨他丧命的罪〔注：原文是血〕。

chapters.en: But if you warn the righteous man not to sin, and he does not sin, he will indeed live because he heeded your warning, and you will have saved yourself.”
chapters.zh: 倘若你警戒义人，使他不犯罪，他就不犯罪；他因受警戒就必存活，你也救自己脱离了罪。」

chapters.en: And there the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He said to me, “Get up, go out to the plain, and there I will speak with you.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华的灵〔注：原文是手〕在那里降在我身上。他对我说：「你起来往平原去，我要在那里和你说话。」

chapters.en: So I got up and went out to the plain, and behold, the glory of the LORD was present there, like the glory I had seen by the River Kebar, and I fell facedown.
chapters.zh: 于是我起来往平原去，不料，耶和华的荣耀正如我在迦巴鲁河边所见的一样，停在那里，我就俯伏于地。

chapters.en: Then the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet. He spoke with me and said, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.
chapters.zh: 灵就进入我里面，使我站起来。耶和华对我说：「你进房屋去，将门关上。

chapters.en: And you, son of man, they will tie with ropes, and you will be bound so that you cannot go out among the people.
chapters.zh: 人子啊，人必用绳索捆绑你，你就不能出去在他们中间来往。

chapters.en: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth, and you will be silent and unable to rebuke them, though they are a rebellious house.
chapters.zh: 我必使你的舌头贴住上膛，以致你哑口，不能作责备他们的人；他们原是悖逆之家。

chapters.en: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you are to tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’ Whoever listens, let him listen; and whoever refuses, let him refuse, for they are a rebellious house.
chapters.zh: 但我对你说话的时候，必使你开口，你就要对他们说：『主耶和华如此说。』听的可以听，不听的任他不听，因为他们是悖逆之家。」

chapters.en: “Now you, son of man, take a brick, place it before you, and draw on it the city of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，你要拿一块砖，摆在你面前，将一座耶路撒冷城画在其上，

chapters.en: Then lay siege against it: Construct a siege wall, build a ramp to it, set up camps against it, and place battering rams around it on all sides.
chapters.zh: 又围困这城，造台筑垒，安营攻击，在四围安设撞锤攻城，

chapters.en: Then take an iron plate and set it up as an iron wall between yourself and the city. Turn your face toward it so that it is under siege, and besiege it. This will be a sign to the house of Israel.
chapters.zh: 又要拿个铁鏊，放在你和城的中间，作为铁墙。你要对面攻击这城，使城被困；这样，好作以色列家的预兆。

chapters.en: Then lie down on your left side and place the iniquity of the house of Israel upon yourself. You are to bear their iniquity for the number of days you lie on your side.
chapters.zh: 「你要向左侧卧，承当以色列家的罪孽；要〔按〕你向左侧卧的日数，担当他们的罪孽。

chapters.en: For I have assigned to you 390 days, according to the number of years of their iniquity. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
chapters.zh: 因为我已将他们作孽的年数定为你〔向左侧卧〕的日数，就是三百九十日，你要这样担当以色列家的罪孽。

chapters.en: When you have completed these days, lie down again, but on your right side, and bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have assigned to you 40 days, a day for each year.
chapters.zh: 再者，你满了这些日子，还要向右侧卧，担当犹大家的罪孽。我给你定规〔侧卧〕四十日，一日顶一年。

chapters.en: You must turn your face toward the siege of Jerusalem with your arm bared, and prophesy against it.
chapters.zh: 你要露出膀臂，面向被困的耶路撒冷，说预言攻击这城。

chapters.en: Now behold, I will tie you up with ropes so you cannot turn from side to side until you have finished the days of your siege.
chapters.zh: 我用绳索捆绑你，使你不能辗转，直等你满了困〔城〕的日子。

chapters.en: But take wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt; put them in a single container and make them into bread for yourself. This is what you are to eat during the 390 days you lie on your side.
chapters.zh: 「你要取小麦、大麦、豆子、红豆、小米、粗麦，装在一个器皿中，用以为自己做饼；要〔按〕你侧卧的三百九十日吃这饼。

chapters.en: You are to weigh out twenty shekels of food to eat each day, and you are to eat it at set times.
chapters.zh: 你所吃的要按分两吃，每日二十舍客勒，按时而吃。

chapters.en: You are also to measure out a sixth of a hin of water to drink, and you are to drink it at set times.
chapters.zh: 你喝水也要按制子，〔每日喝〕一欣六分之一，按时而喝。

chapters.en: And you shall eat the food as you would a barley cake, after you bake it over dried human excrement in the sight of the people.”
chapters.zh: 你吃这饼像吃大麦饼一样，要用人粪在众人眼前烧烤。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said, “This is how the Israelites will eat their defiled bread among the nations to which I will banish them.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「以色列人在我所赶他们到的各国中，也必这样吃不洁净的食物。」

chapters.en: “Ah, Lord GOD,” I said, “I have never defiled myself. From my youth until now I have not eaten anything found dead or mauled by wild beasts. No unclean meat has ever entered my mouth.”
chapters.zh: 我说：「哎！主耶和华啊，我素来未曾被玷污，从幼年到如今没有吃过自死的，或被野兽撕裂的，那可憎的肉也未曾入我的口。」

chapters.en: “Look,” He replied, “I will let you use cow dung instead of human excrement, and you may bake your bread over that.”
chapters.zh: 于是他对我说：「看哪，我给你牛粪代替人粪，你要将你的饼烤在其上。」

chapters.en: Then He told me, “Son of man, I am going to cut off the supply of food in Jerusalem. They will anxiously eat bread rationed by weight, and in despair they will drink water by measure.
chapters.zh: 他又对我说：「人子啊，我必在耶路撒冷折断他们的杖，就是断绝他们的粮。他们吃饼要按分两，忧虑而吃；喝水也要按制子，惊惶而喝；

chapters.en: So they will lack food and water; they will be appalled at the sight of one another wasting away in their iniquity.
chapters.zh: 使他们缺粮缺水，彼此惊惶，因自己的罪孽消灭。」

chapters.en: “As for you, son of man, take a sharp sword, use it as a barber’s razor, and shave your head and beard. Then take a set of scales and divide the hair.
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，你要拿一把快刀，当作剃头刀，用这刀剃你的头发和你的胡须，用天平将须发平分。

chapters.en: When the days of the siege have ended, you are to burn up a third of the hair inside the city; you are also to take a third and slash it with the sword all around the city; and you are to scatter a third to the wind. For I will unleash a sword behind them.
chapters.zh: 围困〔城〕的日子满了，你要将三分之一在城中用火焚烧，将三分之一在城的四围用刀砍碎，将三分之一任风吹散；我也要拔刀追赶。

chapters.en: But you are to take a few strands of hair and secure them in the folds of your garment.
chapters.zh: 你要从其中取几根包在衣襟里，

chapters.en: Again, take a few of these, throw them into the fire, and burn them. From there a fire will spread to the whole house of Israel.
chapters.zh: 再从这几根中取些扔在火中焚烧，从里面必有火出来烧入以色列全家。

chapters.en: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘This is Jerusalem, which I have set in the center of the nations, with countries all around her.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说：这就是耶路撒冷。我曾将她安置在列邦之中；列国都在她的四围。

chapters.en: But she has rebelled against My ordinances more wickedly than the nations, and against My statutes worse than the countries around her. For her people have rejected My ordinances and have not walked in My statutes.’
chapters.zh: 她行恶，违背我的典章，过于列国；干犯我的律例，过于四围的列邦，因为她弃掉我的典章。至于我的律例，她并没有遵行。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘You have been more insubordinate than the nations around you; you have not walked in My statutes or kept My ordinances, nor have you even conformed to the ordinances of the nations around you.’
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：因为你们纷争过于四围的列国，也不遵行我的律例，不谨守我的典章，并以遵从四围列国的恶规尚不满意，

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I Myself am against you, Jerusalem, and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：看哪，我与你反对，必在列国的眼前，在你中间，施行审判；

chapters.en: Because of all your abominations, I will do to you what I have never done before and will never do again.
chapters.zh: 并且因你一切可憎的事，我要在你中间行我所未曾行的，以后我也不再照着行。

chapters.en: As a result, fathers among you will eat their sons, and sons will eat their fathers. I will execute judgments against you and scatter all your remnant to every wind.’
chapters.zh: 在你中间父亲要吃儿子，儿子要吃父亲。我必向你施行审判，我必将你所剩下的分散四方〔注：方：原文是风〕。」

chapters.en: Therefore as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, because you have defiled My sanctuary with all your detestable idols and abominations, I Myself will withdraw My favor; I will not look upon you with pity, nor will I spare you.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说：「我指着我的永生起誓，因你用一切可憎的物、可厌的事玷污了我的圣所，故此，我定要使〔你人数〕减少，我眼必不顾惜你，也不可怜你。

chapters.en: A third of your people will die by plague or be consumed by famine within you, a third will fall by the sword outside your walls, and a third I will scatter to every wind and unleash a sword behind them.
chapters.zh: 你的民三分之一必遭瘟疫而死，在你中间必因饥荒消灭；三分之一必在你四围倒在刀下；我必将三分之一分散四方〔注：方：原文是风〕，并要拔刀追赶他们。

chapters.en: And when My anger is spent and I have vented My wrath against them, I will be appeased. And when I have spent My wrath on them, they will know that I, the LORD, in My zeal have spoken.
chapters.zh: 「我要这样成就怒中所定的；我向他们发的忿怒止息了，自己就得着安慰。我在他们身上成就怒中所定的那时，他们就知道我－耶和华所说的是出于热心；

chapters.en: I will make you a ruin and a disgrace among the nations around you, in the sight of all who pass by.
chapters.zh: 并且我必使你在四围的列国中，在经过的众人眼前，成了荒凉和羞辱。

chapters.en: So you will be a reproach and a taunt, a warning and a horror to the nations around you, when I execute judgments against you in anger, wrath, and raging fury. I, the LORD, have spoken.
chapters.zh: 这样，我必以怒气和忿怒，并烈怒的责备，向你施行审判。那时，你就在四围的列国中成为羞辱、讥刺、警戒、惊骇。这是我－耶和华说的。

chapters.en: When I shower you with the deadly arrows of famine and destruction that I will send to destroy you, I will intensify the famine against you and cut off your supply of food.
chapters.zh: 那时，我要将灭人、使人饥荒的恶箭，就是射去灭人的，射在你们身上，并要加增你们的饥荒，断绝你们所倚靠的粮食；

chapters.en: I will send famine and wild beasts against you, and they will leave you childless. Plague and bloodshed will sweep through you, and I will bring a sword against you. I, the LORD, have spoken.”
chapters.zh: 又要使饥荒和恶兽到你那里，叫你丧子，瘟疫和流血的事也必盛行在你那里；我也要使刀剑临到你。这是我－耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: “Son of man, set your face against the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them.
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，你要面向以色列的众山说预言，

chapters.en: You are to say: ‘O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD! This is what the Lord GOD says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys: I am about to bring a sword against you, and I will destroy your high places.
chapters.zh: 说：以色列的众山哪，要听主耶和华的话。主耶和华对大山、小冈、水沟、山谷如此说：我必使刀剑临到你们，也必毁灭你们的邱坛。

chapters.en: Your altars will be demolished and your incense altars will be smashed; and I will cast down your slain before your idols.
chapters.zh: 你们的祭坛必然荒凉，你们的日像必被打碎。我要使你们被杀的人倒在你们的偶像面前；

chapters.en: I will lay the corpses of the Israelites before their idols and scatter your bones around your altars.
chapters.zh: 我也要将以色列人的尸首放在他们的偶像面前，将你们的骸骨抛散在你们祭坛的四围。

chapters.en: Wherever you live, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be demolished, so that your altars will be laid waste and desecrated, your idols smashed and obliterated, your incense altars cut down, and your works blotted out.
chapters.zh: 在你们一切的住处，城邑要变为荒场，邱坛必然凄凉，使你们的祭坛荒废，将你们的偶像打碎。你们的日像被砍倒，你们的工作被毁灭。

chapters.en: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am the LORD.
chapters.zh: 被杀的人必倒在你们中间，你们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: Yet I will leave a remnant, for some of you will escape the sword when you are scattered among the nations and throughout the lands.
chapters.zh: 「你们分散在各国的时候，我必在列邦中使你们有剩下脱离刀剑的人。

chapters.en: Then in the nations to which they have been carried captive, your survivors will remember Me—how I have been grieved by their adulterous hearts that turned away from Me, and by their eyes that lusted after idols. So they will loathe themselves for the evil they have done and for all their abominations.
chapters.zh: 那脱离〔刀剑〕的人必在所掳到的各国中记念我，为他们心中何等伤破，是因他们起淫心，远离我，眼对偶像行邪淫。他们因行一切可憎的恶事，必厌恶自己。

chapters.en: And they will know that I am the LORD; I did not declare in vain that I would bring this calamity upon them.
chapters.zh: 他们必知道我是耶和华；我说要使这灾祸临到他们身上，并非空话。

chapters.en: This is what the Lord GOD says: Clap your hands, stomp your feet, and cry out “Alas!” because of all the wicked abominations of the house of Israel, who will fall by sword and famine and plague.
chapters.zh: 「主耶和华如此说：你当拍手顿足，说：哀哉！以色列家行这一切可憎的恶事，他们必倒在刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫之下。

chapters.en: He who is far off will die by the plague, he who is near will fall by the sword, and he who remains will die by famine. So I will vent My fury upon them.
chapters.zh: 在远处的，必遭瘟疫而死；在近处的，必倒在刀剑之下；那存留被围困的，必因饥荒而死；我必这样在他们身上成就我怒中所定的。

chapters.en: Then you will know that I am the LORD, when their slain lie among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the mountaintops, and under every green tree and leafy oak—the places where they offered fragrant incense to all their idols.
chapters.zh: 他们被杀的人〔倒在〕他们祭坛四围的偶像中，就是各高冈、各山顶、各青翠树下、各茂密的橡树下，乃是他们献馨香的祭牲给一切偶像的地方。那时，他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: I will stretch out My hand against them, and wherever they live I will make the land a desolate waste, from the wilderness to Diblah. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
chapters.zh: 我必伸手攻击他们，使他们的地从旷野到第伯拉他一切住处极其荒凉，他们就知道我是耶和华。」

chapters.en: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：

chapters.en:
“O son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says to the land of Israel:
‘The end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land.
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，主耶和华对以色列地如此说：结局到了，结局到了地的四境！

chapters.en: The end is now upon you, and I will unleash My anger against you. I will judge you according to your ways and repay you for all your abominations.
chapters.zh: 现在你的结局已经临到，我必使我的怒气归与你，也必按你的行为审判你，照你一切可憎的事刑罚你。

chapters.en:
I will not look on you with pity, nor will I spare you, but I will punish you for your ways and for the abominations among you.
Then you will know that I am the LORD.’
chapters.zh: 我眼必不顾惜你，也不可怜你，却要按你所行的报应你，照你中间可憎的事刑罚你。你就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en:
This is what the Lord GOD says:
‘Disaster! An unprecedented disaster — behold, it is coming!
chapters.zh: 「主耶和华如此说：有一灾，独有一灾；看哪，临近了！

chapters.en: The end has come! The end has come! It has roused itself against you. Behold, it has come!
chapters.zh: 结局来了，结局来了，向你兴起。看哪，来到了！

chapters.en: Doom has come to you, O inhabitants of the land. The time has come; the day is near; there is panic on the mountains instead of shouts of joy.
chapters.zh: 境内的居民哪，所定的灾临到你，时候到了，日子近了，乃是鬨嚷并非在山上欢呼的日子。

chapters.en: Very soon I will pour out My wrath upon you and vent My anger against you; I will judge you according to your ways and repay you for all your abominations.
chapters.zh: 我快要将我的忿怒倾在你身上，向你成就我怒中所定的，按你的行为审判你，照你一切可憎的事刑罚你。

chapters.en: I will not look on you with pity, nor will I spare you, but I will punish you for your ways and for the abominations among you. Then you will know that it is I, the LORD, who strikes the blow.
chapters.zh: 我眼必不顾惜你，也不可怜你，必按你所行的报应你，照你中间可憎的事刑罚你。你就知道击打你的是我耶和华。

chapters.en:
Behold, the day is here! It has come! Doom has gone out, the rod has budded,
arrogance has bloomed.
chapters.zh: 「看哪，看哪，日子快到了；所定的灾已经发出！杖已经开花，骄傲已经发芽。

chapters.en: Their violence has grown into a rod to punish their wickedness. None of them will remain: none of their multitude, none of their wealth, and nothing of value.
chapters.zh: 强暴兴起，成了罚恶的杖。以色列人，或是他们的群众，或是他们的财宝，无一〔存留〕；他们中间也没有得尊荣的。

chapters.en:
The time has come; the day has arrived. Let the buyer not rejoice and the seller not mourn,
for wrath is upon the whole multitude.
chapters.zh: 时候到了，日子近了，买主不可欢喜，卖主不可愁烦，因为烈怒已经临到他们众人身上。
