chapters.en: “Now you, son of man, mark out two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to take, both starting from the same land. And make a signpost where the road branches off to each city.
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，你要定出两条路，好使巴比伦王的刀来。这两条路必从一地分出来，又要在通城的路口上画出一只手来。

chapters.en: Mark out one road for the sword to come against Rabbah of the Ammonites, and another against Judah into fortified Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 你要定出一条路，使刀来到亚扪人的拉巴；又要定出一条路，使刀来到犹大的坚固城耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: For the king of Babylon stands at the fork in the road, at the junction of the two roads, to seek an omen: He shakes the arrows, he consults the idols, he examines the liver.
chapters.zh: 因为巴比伦王站在岔路那里，在两条路口上要占卜。他摇籤〔注：原文是箭〕求问神像，察看〔牺牲的〕肝；

chapters.en: In his right hand appears the portent for Jerusalem, where he is to set up battering rams, to call for the slaughter, to lift a battle cry, to direct the battering rams against the gates, to build a ramp, and to erect a siege wall.
chapters.zh: 在右手中拿着为耶路撒冷占卜的籤，使他安设撞城锤，张口叫杀，扬声吶喊，筑垒造台，以撞城锤，攻打城门。

chapters.en: It will seem like a false omen to the eyes of those who have sworn allegiance to him, but it will draw attention to their guilt and take them captive.
chapters.zh: 据那些曾起誓的犹大人看来，这是虚假的占卜；但巴比伦王要使他们想起罪孽，以致将他们捉住。」

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have drawn attention to your guilt, exposing your transgressions, so that your sins are revealed in all your deeds—because you have come to remembrance—you shall be taken in hand.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说：「因你们的过犯显露，使你们的罪孽被记念，以致你们的罪恶在行为上都彰显出来；又因你们被记念，就被捉住。

chapters.en: And you, O profane and wicked prince of Israel, the day has come for your final punishment.’
chapters.zh: 你这受死伤行恶的以色列王啊，罪孽的尽头到了，受报的日子已到。

chapters.en:
This is what the Lord GOD says:
‘Remove the turban, and take off the crown. Things will not remain as they are: Exalt the lowly
and bring low the exalted.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说：当除掉冠，摘下冕，景况必不再像先前；要使卑者升为高，使高者降为卑。

chapters.en:
A ruin, a ruin, I will make it a ruin! And it will not be restored until the arrival of Him to whom it belongs,
to whom I have assigned the right of judgment. ’
chapters.zh: 我要将〔这国〕倾覆，倾覆，而又倾覆；这〔国〕也必不再有，直等到那应得的人来到，我就赐给〔他〕。」

chapters.en:
Now prophesy, son of man, and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says concerning the Ammonites and their contempt:
‘A sword! A sword is drawn for slaughter, polished to consume, to flash like lightning—
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，要发预言说：主耶和华论到亚扪人和他们的凌辱，吩咐我如此说：有刀，有拔出来的刀，已经擦亮，为行杀戮，使他像闪电以行吞灭。

chapters.en: while they offer false visions for you and lying divinations about you— to be placed on the necks of the wicked who are slain, whose day has come, the time of their final punishment.
chapters.zh: 人为你见虚假的异象，行谎诈的占卜，使你倒在受死伤之恶人的颈项上。他们罪孽到了尽头，受报的日子已到。

chapters.en:
Return the sword to its sheath!
In the place where you were created, in the land of your origin,
I will judge you.
chapters.zh: 你将刀收入鞘吧！在你受造之处、生长之地，我必刑罚你。

chapters.en: I will pour out My anger upon you; I will breathe the fire of My fury against you; I will hand you over to brutal men, skilled in destruction.
chapters.zh: 我必将我的恼恨倒在你身上，将我烈怒的火喷在你身上；又将你交在善于杀灭的畜类人手中。

chapters.en: You will be fuel for the fire. Your blood will stain your own land. You will not be remembered, for I, the LORD, have spoken.’”
chapters.zh: 你必当柴被火焚烧；你的血必〔流〕在国中。你必不再被记念，因为这是我－耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：

chapters.en: “As for you, son of man, will you judge her? Will you pass judgment on the city of bloodshed? Then confront her with all her abominations
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，你要审问审问这流人血的城吗？当使她知道她一切可憎的事。

chapters.en: and tell her that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘O city who brings her own doom by shedding blood within her walls and making idols to defile herself,
chapters.zh: 你要说，主耶和华如此说：哎！这城有流人血的事在其中，叫她受报的日期来到，又做偶像玷污自己，陷害自己。

chapters.en: you are guilty of the blood you have shed, and you are defiled by the idols you have made. You have brought your days to a close and have come to the end of your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations and a mockery to all the lands.
chapters.zh: 你因流了人的血，就为有罪；你做了偶像，就玷污自己，使你受报之日临近，报应之年来到。所以我叫你受列国的凌辱和列邦的讥诮。

chapters.en: Those near and far will mock you, O infamous city, full of turmoil.
chapters.zh: 你这名臭、多乱的城啊，那些离你近、离你远的都必讥诮你。

chapters.en: See how every prince of Israel within you has used his power to shed blood.
chapters.zh: 「看哪，以色列的首领各逞其能，在你中间流人之血。

chapters.en: Father and mother are treated with contempt. Within your walls the foreign resident is exploited, the fatherless and the widow are oppressed.
chapters.zh: 在你中间有轻慢父母的，有欺压寄居的，有亏负孤儿寡妇的。

chapters.en: You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths.
chapters.zh: 你藐视了我的圣物，干犯了我的安息日。

chapters.en: Among you are slanderous men bent on bloodshed; within you are those who eat on the mountain shrines and commit acts of indecency.
chapters.zh: 在你中间有谗谤人、流人血的；有在山上吃过〔祭偶像之物〕的，有行淫乱的。

chapters.en: In you they have uncovered the nakedness of their fathers; in you they violate women during their menstrual impurity.
chapters.zh: 在你中间有露〔继〕母下体羞辱父亲的，有玷辱月经不洁净之妇人的。

chapters.en: One man commits an abomination with his neighbor’s wife; another wickedly defiles his daughter-in-law; and yet another violates his sister, his own father’s daughter.
chapters.zh: 这人与邻舍的妻行可憎的事；那人贪淫玷污儿妇；还有玷辱同父之姊妹的。

chapters.en: In you they take bribes to shed blood. You engage in usury, take excess interest, and extort your neighbors. But Me you have forgotten, declares the Lord GOD.
chapters.zh: 在你中间有为流人血受贿赂的；有向借钱的〔弟兄〕取利，向借粮的〔弟兄〕多要的。且因贪得无餍，欺压邻舍夺取财物，竟忘了我。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Now look, I strike My hands together against your unjust gain and against the blood you have shed in your midst.
chapters.zh: 「看哪，我因你所得不义之财和你中间所流的血，就拍掌〔叹息〕。

chapters.en: Will your courage endure or your hands be strong in the day I deal with you? I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will act.
chapters.zh: 到了我惩罚你的日子，你的心还能忍受吗？你的手还能有力吗？我－耶和华说了这话，就必照着行。

chapters.en: I will disperse you among the nations and scatter you throughout the lands; I will purge your uncleanness.
chapters.zh: 我必将你分散在列国，四散在列邦。我也必从你中间除掉你的污秽。

chapters.en: And when you have defiled yourself in the eyes of the nations, then you will know that I am the LORD.’”
chapters.zh: 你必在列国人的眼前因自己所行的被亵渎，你就知道我是耶和华。」

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: “Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to Me. All of them are copper, tin, iron, and lead inside the furnace; they are but the dross of silver.
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，以色列家在我看为渣滓。他们都是炉中的铜、锡、铁、铅，都是银渣滓。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because all of you have become dross, behold, I will gather you into Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：因你们都成为渣滓，我必聚集你们在耶路撒冷中。

chapters.en: Just as one gathers silver, copper, iron, lead, and tin into the furnace to melt with a fiery blast, so I will gather you in My anger and wrath, leave you there, and melt you.
chapters.zh: 人怎样将银、铜、铁、铅、锡聚在炉中，吹火镕化；照样，我也要发怒气和忿怒，将你们聚集放在城中，镕化你们。

chapters.en: Yes, I will gather you together and blow on you with the fire of My wrath, and you will be melted within the city.
chapters.zh: 我必聚集你们，把我烈怒的火吹在你们身上，你们就在其中镕化。

chapters.en: As silver is melted in a furnace, so you will be melted within the city. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out My wrath upon you.’”
chapters.zh: 银子怎样镕化在炉中，你们也必照样镕化在城中，你们就知道我－耶和华是将忿怒倒在你们身上了。」

chapters.en: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: “Son of man, say to her, ‘In the day of indignation, you are a land that has not been cleansed, upon which no rain has fallen.’
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，你要对这地说：你是未得洁净之地，在恼恨的日子也没有雨下在你以上。

chapters.en: The conspiracy of the princes in her midst is like a roaring lion tearing its prey. They devour the people, seize the treasures and precious things, and multiply the widows within her.
chapters.zh: 其中的先知同谋背叛，如咆哮的狮子抓撕掠物。他们吞灭人民，抢夺财宝，使这地多有寡妇。

chapters.en: Her priests do violence to My law and profane My holy things. They make no distinction between the holy and the common, and they fail to distinguish between the clean and the unclean. They disregard My Sabbaths, so that I am profaned among them.
chapters.zh: 其中的祭司强解我的律法，亵渎我的圣物，不分别圣的和俗的，也不使人分辨洁净的和不洁净的，又遮眼不顾我的安息日；我也在他们中间被亵慢。

chapters.en: Her officials within her are like wolves tearing their prey, shedding blood, and destroying lives for dishonest gain.
chapters.zh: 其中的首领仿佛豺狼抓撕掠物，杀人流血，伤害人命，要得不义之财。

chapters.en: Her prophets whitewash these deeds by false visions and lying divinations, saying, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ when the LORD has not spoken.
chapters.zh: 其中的先知为百姓用未泡透的〔灰〕抹墙，就是为他们见虚假的异象，用谎诈的占卜，说：『主耶和华如此说』，其实耶和华没有说。

chapters.en: The people of the land have practiced extortion and committed robbery. They have oppressed the poor and needy and have exploited the foreign resident without justice.
chapters.zh: 国内众民一味地欺压，惯行抢夺，亏负困苦穷乏的，背理欺压寄居的。

chapters.en: I searched for a man among them to repair the wall and stand in the gap before Me on behalf of the land, so that I should not destroy it. But I found no one.
chapters.zh: 我在他们中间寻找一人重修墙垣，在我面前为这国站在破口防堵，使我不灭绝这国，却找不着一个。

chapters.en: So I have poured out My indignation upon them and consumed them with the fire of My fury. I have brought their ways down upon their own heads, declares the Lord GOD.”
chapters.zh: 所以我将恼恨倒在他们身上，用烈怒的火灭了他们，照他们所行的报应在他们头上。这是主耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：

chapters.en: “Son of man, there were two women, daughters of the same mother,
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，有两个女子，是一母所生，

chapters.en: and they played in Egypt, prostituting themselves from their youth. Their breasts were fondled there, and their virgin bosoms caressed.
chapters.zh: 她们在埃及行邪淫，在幼年时行邪淫。她们在那里作处女的时候，有人拥抱她们的怀，抚摸她们的乳。

chapters.en: The older was named Oholah, and her sister was named Oholibah. They became Mine and gave birth to sons and daughters. As for their identities, Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 她们的名字，姊姊名叫阿荷拉，妹妹名叫阿荷利巴。她们都归于我，生了儿女。论到她们的名字，阿荷拉就是撒马利亚，阿荷利巴就是耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Oholah prostituted herself while she was still Mine. She lusted after her lovers, the Assyrians—warriors
chapters.zh: 「阿荷拉归我之后行邪淫，贪恋所爱的人，就是她的邻邦亚述人。

chapters.en: clothed in blue, governors and commanders, all desirable young men, horsemen mounted on steeds.
chapters.zh: 这些人都穿蓝衣，作省长、副省长，都骑着马，是可爱的少年人。

chapters.en: She offered sexual favors to all the elite of Assyria. She defiled herself with all the idols of those for whom she lusted.
chapters.zh: 阿荷拉就与亚述人中最美的男子放纵淫行，她因所恋爱之人的一切偶像，玷污自己。

chapters.en: She did not give up the prostitution she began in Egypt, when men slept with her in her youth, caressed her virgin bosom, and poured out their lust upon her.
chapters.zh: 自从在埃及的时候，她就没有离开淫乱，因为她年幼作处女的时候，埃及人与她行淫，抚摸她的乳，纵欲与她行淫。

chapters.en: Therefore I delivered her into the hands of her lovers, the Assyrians for whom she lusted.
chapters.zh: 因此，我将她交在她所爱的人手中，就是她所恋爱的亚述人手中。

chapters.en: They exposed her nakedness, seized her sons and daughters, and put her to the sword. Thus she became a byword among women, and they executed judgment against her.
chapters.zh: 他们就露了她的下体，掳掠她的儿女，用刀杀了她，使她在妇女中留下臭名，因他们向她施行审判。

chapters.en: Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet in her lust and prostitution she was more depraved than her sister.
chapters.zh: 「她妹妹阿荷利巴虽然看见了，却还贪恋，比她姊姊更丑；行淫乱比她姊姊更多。

chapters.en: She too lusted after the Assyrians—governors and commanders, warriors dressed in splendor, horsemen riding on steeds, all desirable young men.
chapters.zh: 她贪恋邻邦的亚述人，就是穿极华美的衣服，骑着马的省长、副省长，都是可爱的少年人。

chapters.en: And I saw that she too had defiled herself; both of them had taken the same path.
chapters.zh: 我看见她被玷污了，她姊妹二人同行一路。

chapters.en: But Oholibah carried her prostitution even further. She saw the men portrayed on the wall, images of the Chaldeans, engraved in vermilion,
chapters.zh: 阿荷利巴又加增淫行，因她看见人像画在墙上，就是用丹色所画迦勒底人的像，

chapters.en: wearing belts on their waists and flowing turbans on their heads; all of them looked like officers of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their birth.
chapters.zh: 腰间系着带子，头上有下垂的裹头巾，都是军长的形状，仿照巴比伦人的形像；他们的故土就是迦勒底。

chapters.en: At the sight of them, she lusted for them and sent messengers to them in Chaldea.
chapters.zh: 阿荷利巴一看见就贪恋他们，打发使者往迦勒底去见他们。

chapters.en: Then the Babylonians came to her, to the bed of love, and in their lust they defiled her. But after she had been defiled by them, she turned away in disgust.
chapters.zh: 巴比伦人就来登她爱情的床，与她行淫玷污她。她被玷污，随后心里与他们生疏。

chapters.en: When Oholibah openly prostituted herself and exposed her nakedness, I turned away from her in disgust, just as I had turned away from her sister.
chapters.zh: 这样，她显露淫行，又显露下体；我心就与她生疏，像先前与她姊姊生疏一样。

chapters.en: Yet she multiplied her promiscuity, remembering the days of her youth, when she had prostituted herself in the land of Egypt
chapters.zh: 她还加增她的淫行，追念她幼年在埃及地行邪淫的日子，

chapters.en: and lusted after their lovers, whose genitals were like those of donkeys and whose emission was like that of stallions.
chapters.zh: 贪恋情人身壮精足，如驴如马。

chapters.en: So you revisited the indecency of your youth, when the Egyptians caressed your bosom and pressed your young breasts.
chapters.zh: 这样，你就想起你幼年的淫行。那时，埃及人拥抱你的怀，抚摸你的乳。」

chapters.en: Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will incite your lovers against you, those from whom you turned away in disgust. And I will bring them against you from every side—
chapters.zh: 阿荷利巴啊，主耶和华如此说：「我必激动你先爱而后生疏的人来攻击你。我必使他们来，在你四围攻击你。

chapters.en: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, the men of Pekod, Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them—all desirable young men, governors and commanders, officers and men of renown, mounted on horses.
chapters.zh: 所来的就是巴比伦人、迦勒底的众人、比割人、书亚人、哥亚人，同着他们的还有亚述众人，乃是作省长、副省长、作军长有名声的，都骑着马，是可爱的少年人。

chapters.en: They will come against you with a host of peoples, with weapons, chariots, and wagons. They will array themselves against you on every side with buckler and shield and helmet. I will delegate judgment to them, and they will punish you according to their own standards.
chapters.zh: 他们必带兵器、战车、辎重车，率领大众来攻击你。他们要拿大小盾牌，顶盔摆阵，在你四围攻击你。我要将审判的事交给他们，他们必按着自己的条例审判你。

chapters.en: And I will set My jealous rage against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will cut off your noses and ears, and your survivors will fall by the sword. They will seize your sons and daughters, and your remnant will be consumed by fire.
chapters.zh: 我必以忌恨攻击你；他们必以忿怒办你。他们必割去你的鼻子和耳朵；你遗留〔注：或译：余剩；下同〕的人必倒在刀下。他们必掳去你的儿女；你所遗留的必被火焚烧。

chapters.en: They will strip off your clothes and take your fine jewelry.
chapters.zh: 他们必剥去你的衣服，夺取你华美的宝器。

chapters.en: So I will put an end to your indecency and prostitution, which began in the land of Egypt, and you will not lift your eyes to them or remember Egypt anymore.’
chapters.zh: 这样，我必使你的淫行和你从埃及地〔染〕来的淫乱止息了，使你不再仰望亚述，也不再追念埃及。

chapters.en: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Surely I will deliver you into the hands of those you hate, from whom you turned away in disgust.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说：我必将你交在你所恨恶的人手中，就是你心与他生疏的人手中。

chapters.en: They will treat you with hatred, take all for which you have worked, and leave you naked and bare, so that the shame of your prostitution will be exposed. Your indecency and promiscuity
chapters.zh: 他们必以恨恶办你，夺取你一切劳碌得来的，留下你赤身露体。你淫乱的下体，连你的淫行，带你的淫乱，都被显露。

chapters.en: have brought these things upon you, because you have prostituted yourself with the nations and defiled yourself with their idols.
chapters.zh: 人必向你行这些事；因为你随从外邦人行邪淫，被他们的偶像玷污了。

chapters.en: Because you have followed the path of your sister, I will put her cup into your hand.’
chapters.zh: 你走了你姊姊所走的路，所以我必将她的杯交在你手中。」

chapters.en:
This is what the Lord GOD says:
‘You will drink your sister’s cup, a cup deep and wide. It will bring scorn and derision, for it holds so much.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说： 你必喝你姊姊所喝的杯； 那杯又深又广，盛得甚多， 使你被人嗤笑讥刺。

chapters.en:
You will be filled with drunkenness and grief, with a cup of devastation and desolation,
the cup of your sister Samaria.
chapters.zh: 你必酩酊大醉，满有愁苦， 喝干你姊姊撒马利亚的杯， 就是令人惊骇凄凉的杯。

chapters.en: You will drink it and drain it; you will dash it to pieces, and tear your breasts. For I have spoken,’ declares the Lord GOD.
chapters.zh: 你必喝这杯，以致喝尽。 〔杯破〕又龈杯片， 撕裂自己的乳； 因为这事我曾说过。 这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have forgotten Me and have cast Me behind your back, you must bear the consequences of your indecency and prostitution.’”
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说：「因你忘记我，将我丢在背后，所以你要担当你淫行和淫乱〔的报应〕。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to me: “Son of man, will you pass judgment against Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.
chapters.zh: 耶和华又对我说：「人子啊，你要审问阿荷拉与阿荷利巴吗？当指出她们所行可憎的事。

chapters.en: For they have committed adultery, and blood is on their hands. They have committed adultery with their idols. They have even sacrificed their children, whom they bore to Me, in the fire as food for their idols.
chapters.zh: 她们行淫，手中有〔杀人的〕血，又与偶像行淫，并使她们为我所生的儿女经〔火〕烧〔给偶像〕。

chapters.en: They have also done this to Me: On that very same day, they defiled My sanctuary and profaned My Sabbaths.
chapters.zh: 此外，她们还有向我所行的，就是同日玷污我的圣所，干犯我的安息日。

chapters.en: On the very day they slaughtered their children for their idols, they entered My sanctuary to profane it. Yes, they did this inside My house.
chapters.zh: 她们杀了儿女献与偶像，当天又入我的圣所，将圣所亵渎了。她们在我殿中所行的乃是如此。

chapters.en: Furthermore, you sisters sent messengers for men who came from afar; and behold, when they arrived, you bathed for them, painted your eyes, and adorned yourself with jewelry.
chapters.zh: 「况且你们二妇打发使者去请远方人。使者到他们那里，他们就来了。你们为他们沐浴己身，粉饰眼目，佩戴妆饰，

chapters.en: You sat on a couch of luxury with a table spread before it, on which you had set My incense and My oil,
chapters.zh: 坐在华美的床上，前面摆设桌案，将我的香料膏油摆在其上。

chapters.en: accompanied by the sound of a carefree crowd. Drunkards were brought in from the desert along with men from the rabble, who put bracelets on your wrists and beautiful crowns on your head.
chapters.zh: 在那里有群众安逸欢乐的声音，并有粗俗的人和酒徒从旷野同来，把镯子戴在〔二妇〕的手上，把华冠戴在她们的头上。

chapters.en: Then I said of her who had grown old in adulteries: ‘Now let them use her as a prostitute, for that is all she is!’
chapters.zh: 「我论这行淫衰老的妇人说：现在人还要与她行淫，她也要〔与人〕行淫。

chapters.en: And they slept with her as with a prostitute; they slept with Oholah and Oholibah, those lewd women.
chapters.zh: 人与阿荷拉，并阿荷利巴二淫妇苟合，好像与妓女苟合。

chapters.en: But righteous men will sentence them to the punishment of those who commit adultery and bloodshed, because they are adulteresses with blood on their hands.
chapters.zh: 必有义人，照审判淫妇和流人血的妇人之例，审判她们；因为她们是淫妇，手中有〔杀人的〕血。」

chapters.en: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Bring a mob against them and consign them to terror and plunder.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说：「我必使多人来攻击她们，使她们抛来抛去，被人抢夺。

chapters.en: The mob will stone them and cut them down with their swords. They will kill their sons and daughters and burn down their houses.
chapters.zh: 这些人必用石头打死她们，用刀剑杀害她们，又杀戮她们的儿女，用火焚烧她们的房屋。

chapters.en: So I will put an end to indecency in the land, and all the women will be admonished not to imitate your behavior.
chapters.zh: 这样，我必使淫行从境内止息，好叫一切妇人都受警戒，不效法你们的淫行。

chapters.en: They will repay you for your indecency, and you will bear the consequences of your sins of idolatry. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’”
chapters.zh: 人必照着你们的淫行报应你们；你们要担当〔拜〕偶像的罪，就知道我是主耶和华。」

chapters.en: In the ninth year, on the tenth day of the tenth month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 第九年十月初十日，耶和华的话又临到我说：

chapters.en: “Son of man, write down today’s date, for on this very day the king of Babylon has laid siege to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，今日正是巴比伦王就近耶路撒冷的日子，你要将这日记下，

chapters.en:
Now speak a parable to this rebellious house and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says:
‘Put the pot on the fire; put it on and pour in the water.
chapters.zh: 要向这悖逆之家设比喻说，主耶和华如此说： 将锅放在火上， 放好了，就倒水在其中；

chapters.en: Put in the pieces of meat, every good piece— thigh and shoulder— fill it with choice bones.
chapters.zh: 将肉块，就是一切肥美的肉块、腿， 和肩都聚在其中， 拿美好的骨头把锅装满；

chapters.en: Take the choicest of the flock and pile the fuel beneath it. Bring it to a boil and cook the bones in it.’
chapters.zh: 取羊群中最好的， 将〔柴〕堆在〔锅〕下， 使锅开滚， 好把骨头煮在其中。

chapters.en:
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says:
‘Woe to the city of bloodshed, to the pot now rusted,
whose rust will not come off! Empty it piece by piece; cast no lots for its contents.
chapters.zh: 「主耶和华如此说：祸哉！这流人血的城，就是长锈的锅。其中的锈未曾除掉，须要将肉块从其中一一取出来，不必为它拈鬮。

chapters.en: For the blood she shed is still within her; she poured it out on the bare rock; she did not pour it on the ground to cover it with dust.
chapters.zh: 城中所流的血倒在净光的磐石上，不倒在地上，用土掩盖。

chapters.en: In order to stir up wrath and take vengeance, I have placed her blood on the bare rock, so that it would not be covered.’
chapters.zh: 这城中所流的血倒在净光的磐石上，不得掩盖，乃是出于我，为要发忿怒施行报应。

chapters.en:
Yes, this is what the Lord GOD says:
‘Woe to the city of bloodshed! I, too, will pile the kindling high.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：祸哉！这流人血的城，我也必大堆〔火柴〕，

chapters.en: Pile on the logs and kindle the fire; cook the meat well and mix in the spices; let the bones be burned.
chapters.zh: 添上木柴，使火着旺，将肉煮烂，把汤熬浓，使骨头烤焦；

chapters.en: Set the empty pot on its coals until it becomes hot and its copper glows. Then its impurity will melt within; its rust will be consumed.
chapters.zh: 把锅倒空坐在炭火上，使锅烧热，使铜烧红，镕化其中的污秽，除净其上的锈。

chapters.en:
It has frustrated every effort; its thick rust has not been removed,
even by the fire.
chapters.zh: 这锅劳碌疲乏，所长的大锈仍未除掉；这锈就是用火〔也不能除掉〕。

chapters.en: Because of the indecency of your uncleanness I tried to cleanse you, but you would not be purified from your filthiness. You will not be pure again until My wrath against you has subsided.
chapters.zh: 在你污秽中有淫行，我洁净你，你却不洁净。你的污秽再不能洁净，直等我向你发的忿怒止息。

chapters.en: I, the LORD, have spoken; the time is coming, and I will act. I will not refrain or show pity, nor will I relent. I will judge you according to your ways and deeds,’ declares the Lord GOD.”
chapters.zh: 我－耶和华说过的必定成就，必照话而行，必不返回，必不顾惜，也不后悔。人必照你的举动行为审判你。这是主耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：

chapters.en: “Son of man, behold, I am about to take away the desire of your eyes with a fatal blow. But you must not mourn or weep or let your tears flow.
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，我要将你眼目所喜爱的忽然取去，你却不可悲哀哭泣，也不可流泪，

chapters.en: Groan quietly; do not mourn for the dead. Put on your turban and strap your sandals on your feet; do not cover your lips or eat the bread of mourners.”
chapters.zh: 只可叹息，不可出声，不可办理丧事；头上仍勒裹头巾，脚上仍穿鞋，不可蒙着嘴唇，也不可吃吊丧的食物。」

chapters.en: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and in the evening my wife died. And the next morning I did as I had been commanded.
chapters.zh: 于是我将这事早晨告诉百姓，晚上我的妻就死了。次日早晨我便遵命而行。

chapters.en: Then the people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things you are doing mean to us?”
chapters.zh: 百姓问我说：「你这样行与我们有什么关系，你不告诉我们吗？」

chapters.en: So I answered them, “The word of the LORD came to me, saying:
chapters.zh: 我回答他们：「耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: Tell the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I am about to desecrate My sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and the delight of your soul. And the sons and daughters you left behind will fall by the sword.’
chapters.zh: 『你告诉以色列家，主耶和华如此说：我必使我的圣所，就是你们势力所夸耀、眼里所喜爱、心中所爱惜的被亵渎，并且你们所遗留的儿女必倒在刀下。

chapters.en: Then you will do as I have done: You will not cover your lips or eat the bread of mourners.
chapters.zh: 那时，你们必行我〔仆人〕所行的，不蒙着嘴唇，也不吃吊丧的食物。

chapters.en: Your turbans will remain on your heads and your sandals on your feet. You will not mourn or weep, but you will waste away because of your sins, and you will groan among yourselves.
chapters.zh: 你们仍要头上勒裹头巾，脚上穿鞋；不可悲哀哭泣。你们必因自己的罪孽相对叹息，渐渐消灭。

chapters.en: ‘Thus Ezekiel will be a sign for you; you will do everything that he has done. When this happens, you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’
chapters.zh: 以西结必这样为你们作预兆；凡他所行的，你们也必照样行。那事来到，你们就知道我是主耶和华。』

chapters.en: And you, son of man, know that on the day I take away their stronghold, their pride and joy—the desire of their eyes which uplifted their souls—and their sons and daughters as well,
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，我除掉他们所倚靠、所欢喜的荣耀，并眼中所喜爱、心里所重看的儿女。

chapters.en: on that day a fugitive will come and tell you the news.
chapters.zh: 那日逃脱的人岂不来到你这里，使你耳闻这事吗？

chapters.en: On that day your mouth will be opened to him who has escaped; you will speak and no longer be mute. So you will be a sign to them, and they will know that I am the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 你必向逃脱的人开口说话，不再哑口。你必这样为他们作预兆，他们就知道我是耶和华。」

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: “Son of man, set your face against the Ammonites and prophesy against them.
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，你要面向亚扪人说预言，攻击他们，

chapters.en: Tell the Ammonites to hear the word of the Lord GOD, for this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you exclaimed, “Aha!” when My sanctuary was profaned, when the land of Israel was laid waste, and when the house of Judah went into exile,
chapters.zh: 说：你们当听主耶和华的话。主耶和华如此说：我的圣所被亵渎，以色列地变荒凉，犹大家被掳掠；那时，你便因这些事说：『阿哈！』

chapters.en: therefore I will indeed give you as a possession to the people of the East. They will set up their camps and pitch their tents among you. They will eat your fruit and drink your milk.
chapters.zh: 所以我必将你的地交给东方人为业；他们必在你的地上安营居住，吃你的果子，喝你的奶。

chapters.en: I will make Rabbah a pasture for camels, and Ammon a resting place for sheep. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’
chapters.zh: 我必使拉巴为骆驼场，使亚扪人的地为羊群躺卧之处，你们就知道我是耶和华。」

chapters.en: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you clapped your hands and stomped your feet and rejoiced over the land of Israel with a heart full of contempt,
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说：「因你拍手顿足，以满心的恨恶向以色列地欢喜，

chapters.en: therefore I will indeed stretch out My hand against you and give you as plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples and exterminate you from the countries. I will destroy you, and you will know that I am the LORD.’
chapters.zh: 所以我伸手攻击你，将你交给列国作为掳物。我必从万民中剪除你，使你从万国中败亡。我必除灭你，你就知道我是耶和华。」

chapters.en: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because Moab and Seir said, “Look, the house of Judah is like all the other nations,”
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说：「因摩押和西珥人说：『看哪，犹大家与列国无异』，

chapters.en: therefore I will indeed expose the flank of Moab beginning with its frontier cities—Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim—the glory of the land.
chapters.zh: 所以我要破开摩押边界上的城邑，就是摩押人看为本国之荣耀的伯‧耶西末、巴力‧免、基列亭，

chapters.en: I will give it along with the Ammonites as a possession to the people of the East, so that the Ammonites will no longer be remembered among the nations.
chapters.zh: 好使东方人来攻击亚扪人。我必将亚扪人之地交给他们为业，使亚扪人在列国中不再被记念。

chapters.en: So I will execute judgments on Moab, and they will know that I am the LORD.’
chapters.zh: 我必向摩押施行审判，他们就知道我是耶和华。」

chapters.en: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because Edom acted vengefully against the house of Judah, and in so doing incurred grievous guilt,
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说：「因为以东报仇雪恨，攻击犹大家，向他们报仇，大大有罪，

chapters.en: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I will stretch out My hand against Edom and cut off from it both man and beast. I will make it a wasteland, and from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：我必伸手攻击以东，剪除人与牲畜，使以东从提幔起，人必倒在刀下，地要变为荒凉，直到底但。

chapters.en: I will take My vengeance on Edom by the hand of My people Israel, and they will deal with Edom according to My anger and wrath. Then they will know My vengeance, declares the Lord GOD.’
chapters.zh: 我必藉我民以色列的手报复以东；以色列民必照我的怒气，按我的忿怒在以东施报，以东人就知道是我施报。这是主耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because the Philistines acted in vengeance, taking vengeance with malice of soul to destroy Judah with ancient hostility,
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说：「因非利士人向犹大人报仇，就是以恨恶的心报仇雪恨，永怀仇恨，要毁灭他们，

chapters.en: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I will stretch out My hand against the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites and destroy the remnant along the coast.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：我必伸手攻击非利士人，剪除基利提人，灭绝沿海剩下的居民。

chapters.en: I will execute great vengeance against them with furious reproof. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I lay My vengeance upon them.’”
chapters.zh: 我向他们大施报应，发怒斥责他们。我报复他们的时候，他们就知道我是耶和华。」

chapters.en: In the eleventh month of the twelfth year, on the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 第十一年〔十一〕月初一日，耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: “Son of man, because Tyre has said of Jerusalem, ‘Aha! The gate to the nations is broken; it has swung open to me; now that she lies in ruins I will be filled,’
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，因泰尔向耶路撒冷说：『阿哈，那作众民之门的已经破坏，向我开放；她既变为荒场，我必丰盛。』

chapters.en: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, O Tyre, I am against you, and I will raise up many nations against you, as the sea brings up its waves.
chapters.zh: 所以，主耶和华如此说：泰尔啊，我必与你为敌，使许多国民上来攻击你，如同海使波浪涌上来一样。

chapters.en: They will destroy the walls of Tyre and demolish her towers. I will scrape the soil from her and make her a bare rock.
chapters.zh: 他们必破坏泰尔的墙垣，拆毁她的城楼。我也要刮净尘土，使她成为净光的磐石。

chapters.en: She will become a place to spread nets in the sea, for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD. She will become plunder for the nations,
chapters.zh: 她必在海中作晒网的地方，也必成为列国的掳物。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: and the villages on her mainland will be slain by the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’
chapters.zh: 属泰尔城邑的居民〔注：原文是田间的众女；八节同〕必被刀剑杀灭，他们就知道我是耶和华。」

chapters.en: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I will bring against Tyre from the north Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, with horses and chariots, with cavalry and a great company of troops.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说：「我必使诸王之王的巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领马匹车辆、马兵、军队，和许多人民从北方来攻击〔你〕泰尔。

chapters.en: He will slaughter the villages of your mainland with the sword; he will set up siege works against you, build a ramp to your walls, and raise his shields against you.
chapters.zh: 他必用刀剑杀灭属你城邑的居民，也必造台筑垒举盾牌攻击你。

chapters.en: He will direct the blows of his battering rams against your walls and tear down your towers with his axes.
chapters.zh: 他必安设撞城锤攻破你的墙垣，用铁器拆毁你的城楼。

chapters.en:
His multitude of horses will cover you in their dust.
When he enters your gates as an army entering a breached city, your walls will shake from the noise of cavalry, wagons, and chariots.
chapters.zh: 因他的马匹众多，尘土扬起遮蔽你。他进入你的城门，好像人进入已有破口之城。那时，你的墙垣必因骑马的和战车、辎重车的响声震动。

chapters.en: The hooves of his horses will trample all your streets. He will slaughter your people with the sword, and your mighty pillars will fall to the ground.
chapters.zh: 他的马蹄必践踏你一切的街道；他必用刀杀戮你的居民。你坚固的柱子〔注：或译：柱像〕必倒在地上。

chapters.en: They will plunder your wealth and pillage your merchandise. They will demolish your walls, tear down your beautiful homes, and throw your stones and timber and soil into the water.
chapters.zh: 人必以你的财宝为掳物，以你的货财为掠物，破坏你的墙垣，拆毁你华美的房屋，将你的石头、木头、尘土都抛在水中。

chapters.en: So I will silence the sound of your songs, and the music of your lyres will no longer be heard.
chapters.zh: 我必使你唱歌的声音止息；人也不再听见你弹琴的声音。

chapters.en: I will make you a bare rock, and you will become a place to spread the fishing nets. You will never be rebuilt, for I, the LORD, have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.’
chapters.zh: 我必使你成为净光的磐石，作晒网的地方。你不得再被建造，因为这是主耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: This is what the Lord GOD says to Tyre: ‘Will not the coastlands quake at the sound of your downfall, when the wounded groan at the slaughter in your midst?
chapters.zh: 主耶和华对泰尔如此说：「在你中间行杀戮，受伤之人唉哼的时候，因你倾倒的响声，海岛岂不都震动吗？

chapters.en: All the princes of the sea will descend from their thrones, remove their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. Clothed with terror, they will sit on the ground, trembling every moment, appalled over you.
chapters.zh: 那时靠海的君王必都下位，除去朝服，脱下花衣，披上战兢，坐在地上，时刻发抖，为你惊骇。

chapters.en:
Then they will lament for you, saying,
“How you have perished, O city of renown inhabited by seafaring men— she who was powerful on the sea, along with her people, who imposed terror on all peoples!
chapters.zh: 他们必为你作起哀歌说： 你这有名之城， 素为航海之人居住， 在海上为最坚固的； 平日你和居民使一切住在那里的人无不惊恐； 现在何竟毁灭了？

chapters.en: Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your downfall; the islands in the sea are dismayed by your demise.”’
chapters.zh: 如今在你这倾覆的日子， 海岛都必战兢； 海中的群岛见你归于无有就都惊惶。」

chapters.en: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘When I make you a desolate city like other deserted cities, and when I raise up the deep against you so that the mighty waters cover you,
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说：「泰尔啊，我使你变为荒凉，如无人居住的城邑；又使深水漫过你，大水淹没你。

chapters.en: then I will bring you down with those who descend to the Pit, to the people of antiquity. I will make you dwell in the earth below like the ancient ruins, with those who descend to the Pit, so that you will no longer be inhabited or set in splendor in the land of the living.
chapters.zh: 那时，我要叫你下入阴府，与古时的人一同在地的深处、久已荒凉之地居住，使你不再有居民。我也要在活人之地显荣耀〔注：我也......荣耀：或译在活人之地不再有荣耀〕。

chapters.en: I will make you an object of horror, and you will be no more. You will be sought, but will never be found,’ declares the Lord GOD.”
chapters.zh: 我必叫你令人惊恐，不再存留于世；人虽寻找你，却永寻不见。这是主耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：

chapters.en: “Now you, son of man, take up a lament for Tyre.
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，要为泰尔作起哀歌，

chapters.en:
Tell Tyre, who dwells at the gateway to the sea, merchant of the peoples on many coasts, that this is what the Lord GOD says:
You have said, O Tyre, ‘I am perfect in beauty.’
chapters.zh: 说：你居住海口，是众民的商埠；你的交易通到许多的海岛。主耶和华如此说： 泰尔啊，你曾说： 我是全然美丽的。

chapters.en: Your borders are in the heart of the seas; your builders perfected your beauty.
chapters.zh: 你的境界在海中， 造你的使你全然美丽。

chapters.en: They constructed all your planking with cypress from Senir. They took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.
chapters.zh: 他们用示尼珥的松树做你的一切板， 用黎巴嫩的香柏树做桅杆，

chapters.en: Of oaks from Bashan they made your oars; of wood from the coasts of Cyprus they made your deck, inlaid with ivory.
chapters.zh: 用巴珊的橡树做你的桨， 用象牙镶嵌基提海岛的黄杨木为坐板〔注：或译：舱板〕。

chapters.en:
Of embroidered fine linen from Egypt they made your sail,
which served as your banner. Of blue and purple from the coasts of Elishah they made your awning.
chapters.zh: 你的篷帆是用埃及绣花细麻布做的， 可以做你的大旗； 你的凉棚是用以利沙岛的蓝色、紫色〔布〕做的。

chapters.en: The men of Sidon and Arvad were your oarsmen. Your men of skill, O Tyre, were there as your captains.
chapters.zh: 西顿和亚发的居民作你荡桨的。 泰尔啊，你中间的智慧人作掌舵的。

chapters.en: The elders of Gebal were aboard as shipwrights, repairing your leaks. All the ships of the sea and their sailors came alongside to barter for your merchandise.
chapters.zh: 迦巴勒的老者和聪明人 都在你中间作补缝的； 一切泛海的船只和水手 都在你中间经营交易的事。

chapters.en: Men of Persia, Lydia, and Put served as warriors in your army. They hung their shields and helmets on your walls; they gave you splendor.
chapters.zh: 「波斯人、路德人、弗人在你军营中作战士；他们在你中间悬挂盾牌和头盔，彰显你的尊荣。

chapters.en: Men of Arvad and Helech manned your walls all around, and the men of Gammad were in your towers. They hung their shields around your walls; they perfected your beauty.
chapters.zh: 亚发人和你的军队都在你四围的墙上，你的望楼也有勇士；他们悬挂盾牌，成全你的美丽。

chapters.en: Tarshish was your merchant because of your great wealth of goods; they exchanged silver, iron, tin, and lead for your wares.
chapters.zh: 「他施人因你多有各类的财物，就作你的客商，拿银、铁、锡、铅兑换你的货物。

chapters.en: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your merchants. They exchanged slaves and bronze utensils for your merchandise.
chapters.zh: 雅完人、土巴人、米设人都与你交易；他们用人口和铜器兑换你的货物。

chapters.en: The men of Beth-togarmah exchanged horses, war horses, and mules for your wares.
chapters.zh: 陀迦玛族用马和战马并骡子兑换你的货物。

chapters.en: The men of Dedan were your clients; many coastlands were your market; they paid you with ivory tusks and ebony.
chapters.zh: 底但人与你交易，许多海岛作你的码头；他们拿象牙、乌木与你兑换〔注：或译：进贡〕。

chapters.en: Aram was your customer because of your many products; they exchanged turquoise, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies for your wares.
chapters.zh: 亚兰人因你的工作很多，就作你的客商；他们用绿宝石、紫色〔布〕绣货、细麻布、珊瑚、红宝石兑换你的货物。

chapters.en: Judah and the land of Israel traded with you; they exchanged wheat from Minnith, cakes and honey, oil and balm for your merchandise.
chapters.zh: 犹大和以色列地的人都与你交易；他们用米匿的麦子、饼、蜜、油、乳香兑换你的货物。

chapters.en: Because of your many products and your great wealth of goods, Damascus traded with you wine from Helbon, wool from Zahar,
chapters.zh: 大马士革人因你的工作很多，又因你多有各类的财物，就拿黑本酒和白羊毛与你交易。

chapters.en: and casks of wine from Izal for your wares. Wrought iron, cassia, and sweet cane were exchanged for your merchandise.
chapters.zh: 威但人和雅完人拿纺成的线、亮铁、桂皮、菖蒲兑换你的货物。

chapters.en: Dedan was your merchant in saddlecloths for riding.
chapters.zh: 底但人用高贵的毯子、鞍、屉与你交易。

chapters.en: Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your customers, trading in lambs, rams, and goats.
chapters.zh: 阿拉伯人和基达的一切首领都作你的客商，用羊羔、公绵羊、公山羊与你交易。

chapters.en: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah traded with you; for your wares they exchanged gold, the finest of all spices, and precious stones.
chapters.zh: 示巴和拉玛的商人与你交易，他们用各类上好的香料、各类的宝石，和黄金兑换你的货物。

chapters.en: Haran, Canneh, and Eden traded with you, and so did the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad.
chapters.zh: 哈兰人、干尼人、伊甸人、示巴的商人，和亚述人、基抹人与你交易。

chapters.en: In your marketplace they traded with you fine garments of blue, embroidered work, and multicolored rugs with cords tightly twisted and knotted.
chapters.zh: 这些商人以美好的货物包在绣花蓝色包袱内，又有华丽的衣服装在香柏木的箱子里，用绳捆着与你交易。

chapters.en: The ships of Tarshish carried your merchandise. And you were filled with heavy cargo in the heart of the sea.
chapters.zh: 他施的船只接连成帮为你运货， 你便在海中丰富极其荣华。

chapters.en: Your oarsmen have brought you onto the high seas, but the east wind will shatter you in the heart of the sea.
chapters.zh: 荡桨的已经把你荡到大水之处， 东风在海中将你打破。

chapters.en: Your wealth, wares, and merchandise, your sailors, captains, and shipwrights, your merchants and all the warriors within you, with all the other people on board, will sink into the heart of the sea on the day of your downfall.
chapters.zh: 你的资财、物件、货物、 水手、掌舵的、 补缝的、经营交易的， 并你中间的战士和人民， 在你破坏的日子必都沉在海中。

chapters.en: The countryside will shake when your sailors cry out.
chapters.zh: 你掌舵的呼号之声一发， 郊野都必震动。

chapters.en: All who handle the oars will abandon their ships. The sailors and all the captains of the sea will stand on the shore.
chapters.zh: 凡荡桨的和水手， 并一切泛海掌舵的， 都必下船登岸。

chapters.en: They will raise their voices for you and cry out bitterly. They will throw dust on their heads and roll in ashes.
chapters.zh: 他们必为你放声痛哭， 把尘土撒在头上， 在灰中打滚；

chapters.en: They will shave their heads for you and wrap themselves in sackcloth. They will weep over you with anguish of soul and bitter mourning.
chapters.zh: 又为你使头上光秃， 用麻布束腰， 号咷痛哭， 苦苦悲哀。

chapters.en:
As they wail and mourn over you, they will take up a lament for you:
‘Who was ever like Tyre, silenced in the middle of the sea?
chapters.zh: 他们哀号的时候， 为你作起哀歌哀哭， 〔说〕：有何城如泰尔？ 有何城如她在海中成为寂寞的呢？

chapters.en: When your wares went out to sea, you satisfied many nations. You enriched the kings of the earth with your abundant wealth and merchandise.
chapters.zh: 你由海上运出货物， 就使许多国民充足； 你以许多资财、货物 使地上的君王丰富。

chapters.en: Now you are shattered by the seas in the depths of the waters; your merchandise and the people among you have gone down with you.
chapters.zh: 你在深水中被海浪打破的时候， 你的货物和你中间的一切人民， 就都沉下去了。

chapters.en: All the people of the coastlands are appalled over you. Their kings shudder with fear; their faces are contorted.
chapters.zh: 海岛的居民为你惊奇； 他们的君王都甚恐慌， 面带愁容。

chapters.en: Those who trade among the nations hiss at you; you have come to a horrible end and will be no more.’”
chapters.zh: 各国民中的客商都向你发嘶声； 你令人惊恐， 不再存留于世，直到永远。」

chapters.en: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：

chapters.en:
“Son of man, tell the ruler of Tyre that this is what the Lord GOD says:
Your heart is proud, and you have said, ‘I am a god; I sit in the seat of gods
in the heart of the sea.’ Yet you are a man and not a god, though you have regarded your heart
as that of a god.
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，你对泰尔君王说，主耶和华如此说： 因你心里高傲，说：我是神； 我在海中坐神之位。 你虽然居心自比神， 也不过是人，并不是神！

chapters.en: Behold, you are wiser than Daniel; no secret is hidden from you!
chapters.zh: 看哪，你比但以理更有智慧， 什么祕事都不能向你隐藏。

chapters.en: By your wisdom and understanding you have gained your wealth and amassed gold and silver for your treasuries.
chapters.zh: 你靠自己的智慧聪明得了金银财宝， 收入库中。

chapters.en: By your great skill in trading you have increased your wealth, but your heart has grown proud because of it.
chapters.zh: 你靠自己的大智慧和贸易增添资财， 又因资财心里高傲。

chapters.en:
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says:
Because you regard your heart as the heart of a god,
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说： 因你居心自比神，

chapters.en:
behold, I will bring foreigners against you, the most ruthless of nations. They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom
and will defile your splendor.
chapters.zh: 我必使外邦人， 就是列国中的强暴人临到你这里； 他们必拔刀砍坏你用智慧得来的美物， 亵渎你的荣光。

chapters.en:
They will bring you down to the Pit, and you will die a violent death
in the heart of the seas.
chapters.zh: 他们必使你下坑； 你必死在海中， 与被杀的人一样。

chapters.en: Will you still say, ‘I am a god,’ in the presence of those who slay you? You will be only a man, not a god, in the hands of those who wound you.
chapters.zh: 在杀你的人面前你还能说「我是神」吗？ 其实你在杀害你的人手中， 不过是人，并不是神。

chapters.en:
You will die the death of the uncircumcised at the hands of foreigners.
For I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.”
chapters.zh: 你必死在外邦人手中， 与未受割礼〔注：或译：不洁；下同〕的人一样， 因为这是主耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en:
“Son of man, take up a lament for the king of Tyre and tell him that this is what the Lord GOD says:
‘You were the seal of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，你为泰尔王作起哀歌，说主耶和华如此说： 你无所不备， 智慧充足，全然美丽。

chapters.en: You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every kind of precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, and diamond, beryl, onyx, and jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and emerald. Your mountings and settings were crafted in gold, prepared on the day of your creation.
chapters.zh: 你曾在伊甸上帝的园中， 佩戴各样宝石， 就是红宝石、红璧玺、金钢石、 水苍玉、红玛瑙、碧玉、 蓝宝石、绿宝石、红玉，和黄金； 又有精美的鼓笛在你那里， 都是在你受造之日预备齐全的。

chapters.en: You were anointed as a guardian cherub, for I had ordained you. You were on the holy mountain of God; you walked among the fiery stones.
chapters.zh: 你是那受膏遮掩〔约柜〕的基路伯； 我将你安置在上帝的圣山上； 你在发〔光如〕火〔的宝〕石中间往来。

chapters.en:
From the day you were created you were blameless in your ways—
until wickedness was found in you.
chapters.zh: 你从受造之日所行的都完全， 后来在你中间又察出不义。

chapters.en: By the vastness of your trade, you were filled with violence, and you sinned. So I drove you in disgrace from the mountain of God, and I banished you, O guardian cherub, from among the fiery stones.
chapters.zh: 因你贸易很多， 就被强暴的事充满，以致犯罪， 所以我因你亵渎〔圣地〕， 就从上帝的山驱逐你。 遮掩〔约柜〕的基路伯啊， 我已将你从发〔光如〕火〔的宝〕石中除灭。

chapters.en: Your heart grew proud of your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom because of your splendor; so I cast you to the earth; I made you a spectacle before kings.
chapters.zh: 你因美丽心中高傲， 又因荣光败坏智慧， 我已将你摔倒在地， 使你倒在君王面前， 好叫他们目睹眼见。

chapters.en:
By the multitude of your iniquities and the dishonesty of your trading
you have profaned your sanctuaries. So I made fire come from within you, and it consumed you. I reduced you to ashes on the ground in the eyes of all who saw you.
chapters.zh: 你因罪孽众多， 贸易不公， 就亵渎你那里的圣所。 故此，我使火从你中间发出，烧灭你， 使你在所有观看的人眼前变为地上的炉灰。

chapters.en: All the nations who know you are appalled over you. You have come to a horrible end and will be no more.’”
chapters.zh: 各国民中，凡认识你的， 都必为你惊奇。 你令人惊恐， 不再存留于世，直到永远。」

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: “Son of man, set your face against Sidon and prophesy against her.
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，你要向西顿预言攻击她，

chapters.en:
And you are to declare that this is what the Lord GOD says:
‘Behold, I am against you, O Sidon, and I will be glorified within you. They will know that I am the LORD when I execute judgments against her
and demonstrate My holiness through her.
chapters.zh: 说主耶和华如此说： 西顿哪，我与你为敌， 我必在你中间得荣耀。 我在你中间施行审判、显为圣的时候， 人就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en:
I will send a plague against her and shed blood in her streets; the slain will fall within her, while the sword is against her on every side.
Then they will know that I am the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必使瘟疫进入西顿， 使血流在她街上。 被杀的必在其中仆倒， 四围有刀剑临到她， 人就知道我是耶和华。」

chapters.en: For the people of Israel will no longer face a pricking brier or a painful thorn from all around them who treat them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.’
chapters.zh: 「四围恨恶以色列家的人，必不再向他们作刺人的荆棘，伤人的蒺藜，人就知道我是主耶和华。」

chapters.en:
This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they have been scattered, I will show Myself holy among them in the sight of the nations.
Then they will dwell in their own land, which I have given to My servant Jacob.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说：「我将分散在万民中的以色列家招聚回来，向他们在列邦人眼前显为圣的时候，他们就在我赐给我仆人雅各之地，仍然居住。

chapters.en: And there they will dwell securely, build houses, and plant vineyards. They will dwell securely when I execute judgments against all those around them who treat them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.’”
chapters.zh: 他们要在这地上安然居住。我向四围恨恶他们的众人施行审判以后，他们要盖造房屋，栽种葡萄园，安然居住，就知道我是耶和华－他们的上帝。」

chapters.en: In the tenth year, on the twelfth day of the tenth month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 第十年十〔月〕十二〔日〕，耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: “Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，你要向埃及王法老预言攻击他和埃及全地，

chapters.en:
Speak to him and tell him that this is what the Lord GOD says:
Behold, I am against you, O Pharaoh king of Egypt, O great monster who lies among his rivers, who says, ‘The Nile is mine; I made it myself.’
chapters.zh: 说主耶和华如此说： 埃及王法老啊， 我与你这卧在自己河中的大鱼为敌。 你曾说：这河是我的， 是我为自己造的。

chapters.en:
But I will put hooks in your jaws and cause the fish of your streams
to cling to your scales. I will haul you up out of your rivers, and all the fish of your streams
will cling to your scales.
chapters.zh: 我－〔耶和华〕必用钩子钩住你的腮颊， 又使江河中的鱼贴住你的鳞甲； 我必将你和所有贴住你鳞甲的鱼， 从江河中拉上来，

chapters.en:
I will leave you in the desert, you and all the fish of your streams. You will fall on the open field and will not be taken away
or gathered for burial. I have given you as food to the beasts of the earth
and the birds of the air.
chapters.zh: 把你并江河中的鱼都抛在旷野； 你必倒在田间， 不被收殓，不被掩埋。 我已将你给地上野兽、空中飞鸟作食物。

chapters.en:
Then all the people of Egypt will know that I am the LORD.
For you were only a staff of reeds to the house of Israel.
chapters.zh: 「埃及一切的居民，因向以色列家成了芦苇的杖，就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: When Israel took hold of you with their hands, you splintered, tearing all their shoulders; when they leaned on you, you broke, and their backs were wrenched.
chapters.zh: 他们用手持住你，你就断折，伤了他们的肩；他们倚靠你，你就断折，闪了他们的腰。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I will bring a sword against you and cut off from you man and beast.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：我必使刀剑临到你，从你中间将人与牲畜剪除。

chapters.en:
The land of Egypt will become a desolate wasteland. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
Because you said, ‘The Nile is mine; I made it,’
chapters.zh: 埃及地必荒废凄凉，他们就知道我是耶和华。 「因为法老说：『这河是我的，是我所造的』，

chapters.en: therefore I am against you and against your rivers. I will turn the land of Egypt into a ruin, a desolate wasteland from Migdol to Syene, and as far as the border of Cush.
chapters.zh: 所以我必与你并你的江河为敌，使埃及地，从色弗尼塔直到古实境界，全然荒废凄凉。

chapters.en: No foot of man or beast will pass through, and it will be uninhabited for forty years.
chapters.zh: 人的脚、兽的蹄都不经过，四十年之久并无人居住。

chapters.en: I will make the land of Egypt a desolation among desolate lands, and her cities will lie desolate for forty years among the ruined cities. And I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them throughout the countries.
chapters.zh: 我必使埃及地在荒凉的国中成为荒凉，使埃及城在荒废的城中变为荒废，共有四十年。我必将埃及人分散在列国，四散在列邦。」

chapters.en: For this is what the Lord GOD says: At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations to which they were scattered.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说：「满了四十年，我必招聚分散在各国民中的埃及人。

chapters.en: I will restore Egypt from captivity and bring them back to the land of Pathros, the land of their origin. There they will be a lowly kingdom.
chapters.zh: 我必叫埃及被掳的人回来，使他们归回本地巴忒罗。在那里必成为低微的国，

chapters.en: Egypt will be the lowliest of kingdoms and will never again exalt itself above the nations. For I will diminish Egypt so that it will never again rule over the nations.
chapters.zh: 必为列国中最低微的，也不再自高于列国之上。我必减少他们，以致不再辖制列国。

chapters.en: Egypt will never again be an object of trust for the house of Israel, but will remind them of their iniquity in turning to the Egyptians. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.”
chapters.zh: 埃及必不再作以色列家所倚靠的；以色列家仰望埃及人的时候，便思念罪孽。他们就知道我是主耶和华。」

chapters.en: In the twenty-seventh year, on the first day of the first month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 二十七年正〔月〕初一〔日〕，耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: “Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to labor strenuously against Tyre. Every head was made bald and every shoulder made raw. But he and his army received no wages from Tyre for the labor they expended on it.
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒使他的军兵大大效劳，攻打泰尔，以致头都光秃，肩都磨破；然而他和他的军兵攻打泰尔，并没有从那里得什么酬劳。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who will carry off its wealth, seize its spoil, and remove its plunder. This will be the wages for his army.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：我必将埃及地赐给巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒；他必掳掠埃及群众，抢其中的财为掳物，夺其中的货为掠物，这就可以作他军兵的酬劳。

chapters.en: I have given him the land of Egypt as the reward for his labor, because it was done for Me, declares the Lord GOD.
chapters.zh: 我将埃及地赐给他，酬他所效的劳，因王与军兵是为我勤劳。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: In that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth to speak among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 「当那日，我必使以色列家的角发生，又必使你－以西结在他们中间得以开口；他们就知道我是耶和华。」

chapters.en: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：

chapters.en:
“Son of man, prophesy and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says:
Wail, ‘Alas for that day!’
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，你要发预言说，主耶和华如此说： 哀哉这日！你们应当哭号。

chapters.en: For the day is near, the Day of the LORD is near. It will be a day of clouds, a time of doom for the nations.
chapters.zh: 因为耶和华的日子临近， 就是密云之日， 列国〔受罚〕之期。

chapters.en:
A sword will come against Egypt, and there will be anguish in Cush when the slain fall in Egypt, its wealth is taken away,
and its foundations are torn down.
chapters.zh: 必有刀剑临到埃及； 在埃及被杀之人仆倒的时候， 古实人就有痛苦， 人民必被掳掠， 基址必被拆毁。

chapters.en: Cush, Put, and Lud, and all the various peoples, as well as Libya and the men of the covenant land, will fall with Egypt by the sword.
chapters.zh: 古实人、弗人〔注：或译：利比亚〕、路德人、杂族的人民，并古巴人，以及同盟之地的人都要与埃及人一同倒在刀下。」

chapters.en:
For this is what the LORD says:
The allies of Egypt will fall, and her proud strength will collapse. From Migdol to Syene they will fall by the sword within her, declares the Lord GOD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 扶助埃及的也必倾倒。 埃及因势力而有的骄傲必降低微； 其中的人民，从色弗尼塔起〔注：见二十九章十节〕必倒在刀下。 这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: They will be desolate among desolate lands, and their cities will lie among ruined cities.
chapters.zh: 埃及地在荒凉的国中必成为荒凉； 埃及城在荒废的城中也变为荒废。

chapters.en:
Then they will know that I am the LORD when I set fire to Egypt
and all her helpers are shattered.
chapters.zh: 我在埃及中使火着起； 帮助埃及的，都被灭绝。 那时，他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: On that day messengers will go out from Me in ships to frighten Cush out of complacency. Anguish will come upon them on the day of Egypt’s doom. For it is indeed coming.
chapters.zh: 「到那日，必有使者坐船，从我面前出去，使安逸无虑的古实人惊惧；必有痛苦临到他们，好像埃及〔遭灾〕的日子一样。看哪，这事临近了！

chapters.en:
This is what the Lord GOD says:
I will put an end to the hordes of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说： 我必藉巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手， 除灭埃及众人。

chapters.en:
He and his people with him, the most ruthless of the nations,
will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain.
chapters.zh: 他和随从他的人， 就是列国中强暴的， 必进来毁灭这地。 他们必拔刀攻击埃及， 使遍地有被杀的人。

chapters.en: I will make the streams dry up and sell the land to the wicked. By the hands of foreigners I will bring desolation upon the land and everything in it. I, the LORD, have spoken.
chapters.zh: 我必使江河干涸， 将地卖在恶人的手中； 我必藉外邦人的手， 使这地和其中所有的变为凄凉。 这是我－耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
This is what the Lord GOD says:
I will destroy the idols and put an end to the images in Memphis. There will no longer be a prince in Egypt, and I will instill fear in that land.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说： 我必毁灭偶像， 从挪弗除灭神像； 必不再有君王出自埃及地。 我要使埃及地的人惧怕。

chapters.en:
I will lay waste Pathros, set fire to Zoan,
and execute judgment on Thebes.
chapters.zh: 我必使巴忒罗荒凉， 在琐安中使火着起， 向挪施行审判。

chapters.en:
I will pour out My wrath on Pelusium, the stronghold of Egypt,
and cut off the crowds of Thebes.
chapters.zh: 我必将我的忿怒倒在埃及的保障上， 就是训上， 并要剪除挪的众人。

chapters.en: I will set fire to Egypt, Pelusium will writhe in anguish, Thebes will be split open, and Memphis will face daily distress.
chapters.zh: 我必在埃及中使火着起； 训必大大痛苦； 挪必被攻破； 挪弗白日〔注：或译：终日〕见仇敌。

chapters.en:
The young men of On and Pi-beseth will fall by the sword,
and those cities will go into captivity.
chapters.zh: 亚文和比伯实的少年人必倒在刀下； 这些〔城的人〕必被掳掠。

chapters.en:
The day will be darkened in Tahpanhes when I break the yoke of Egypt
and her proud strength comes to an end. A cloud will cover her, and her daughters will go into captivity.
chapters.zh: 我在答比匿折断埃及的诸轭， 使她因势力而有的骄傲在其中止息。 那时，日光必退去； 至于这城，必有密云遮蔽， 其中的女子必被掳掠。

chapters.en: So I will execute judgment on Egypt, and they will know that I am the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 我必这样向埃及施行审判， 他们就知道我是耶和华。」

chapters.en: In the eleventh year, on the seventh day of the first month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 十一年正〔月〕初七〔日〕，耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: “Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. See, it has not been bound up for healing, or splinted for strength to hold the sword.
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，我已打折埃及王法老的膀臂；没有敷药，也没有用布缠好，使他有力持刀。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt. I will break his arms, both the strong one and the one already broken, and will make the sword fall from his hand.
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：看哪，我与埃及王法老为敌，必将他有力的膀臂和已打折的膀臂全行打断，使刀从他手中坠落。

chapters.en: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
chapters.zh: 我必将埃及人分散在列国，四散在列邦。

chapters.en: I will strengthen the arms of Babylon’s king and place My sword in his hand, but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, who will groan before him like a mortally wounded man.
chapters.zh: 我必使巴比伦王的膀臂有力，将我的刀交在他手中；却要打断法老的膀臂，他就在巴比伦王面前唉哼，如同受死伤的人一样。

chapters.en:
I will strengthen the arms of Babylon’s king, but Pharaoh’s arms will fall limp.
Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I place My sword in the hand of Babylon’s king, and he wields it against the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 我必扶持巴比伦王的膀臂，法老的膀臂却要下垂；我将我的刀交在巴比伦王手中，他必举刀攻击埃及地，他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 我必将埃及人分散在列国，四散在列邦；他们就知道我是耶和华。」

chapters.en: In the eleventh year, on the first day of the third month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 十一年三〔月〕初一〔日〕，耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en:
“Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his multitude:
‘Who can be compared to your greatness?
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，你要向埃及王法老和他的众人说： 在威势上谁能与你相比呢？

chapters.en: Look at Assyria, a cedar in Lebanon, with beautiful branches that shaded the forest. It towered on high; its top was among the clouds.
chapters.zh: 亚述王曾如黎巴嫩中的香柏树， 枝条荣美，影密如林， 极其高大，树尖插入云中。

chapters.en: The waters made it grow; the deep springs made it tall, directing their streams all around its base and sending their channels to all the trees of the field.
chapters.zh: 众水使它生长； 深水使它长大。 所栽之地有江河围流， 汊出的水道延到田野诸树。

chapters.en: Therefore it towered higher than all the trees of the field. Its branches multiplied, and its boughs grew long as it spread them out because of the abundant waters.
chapters.zh: 所以它高大超过田野诸树； 发旺的时候，枝子繁多， 因得大水之力枝条长长。

chapters.en: All the birds of the air nested in its branches, and all the beasts of the field gave birth beneath its boughs; all the great nations lived in its shade.
chapters.zh: 空中的飞鸟都在枝子上搭窝； 田野的走兽都在枝条下生子； 所有大国的人民都在它荫下居住。

chapters.en: It was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its limbs, for its roots extended to abundant waters.
chapters.zh: 树大条长，成为荣美， 因为根在众水之旁。

chapters.en: The cedars in the garden of God could not rival it; the cypresses could not compare with its branches, nor the plane trees match its boughs. No tree in the garden of God could compare with its beauty.
chapters.zh: 上帝园中的香柏树不能遮蔽它； 松树不及它的枝子； 枫树不及它的枝条； 上帝园中的树都没有它荣美。

chapters.en:
I made it beautiful with its many branches, the envy of all the trees of Eden,
which were in the garden of God.’
chapters.zh: 我使它的枝条蕃多，成为荣美， 以致上帝伊甸园中的树都嫉妒它。」

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Since it became great in height and set its top among the clouds, and it grew proud on account of its height,
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说：「因它高大，树尖插入云中，心骄气傲，

chapters.en: I delivered it into the hand of the ruler of the nations, for him to deal with it according to its wickedness. I have banished it.
chapters.zh: 我就必将它交给列国中大有威势的人；他必定办它。我因它的罪恶，已经驱逐它。

chapters.en: Foreigners, the most ruthless of the nations, cut it down and left it. Its branches have fallen on the mountains and in every valley; its boughs lay broken in all the earth’s ravines. And all the peoples of the earth left its shade and abandoned it.
chapters.zh: 外邦人，就是列邦中强暴的，将它砍断弃掉。它的枝条落在山间和一切谷中，它的枝子折断，落在地的一切河旁。地上的众民已经走去，离开它的荫下。

chapters.en: All the birds of the air nested on its fallen trunk, and all the beasts of the field lived among its boughs.
chapters.zh: 空中的飞鸟都要宿在这败落的树上，田野的走兽都要卧在它的枝条下，

chapters.en: This happened so that no other trees by the waters would become great in height and set their tops among the clouds, and no other well-watered trees would reach them in height. For they have all been consigned to death, to the depths of the earth, among the mortals who descend to the Pit.’
chapters.zh: 好使水旁的诸树不因高大而自尊，也不将树尖插入云中，并且那些得水滋润、有势力的，也不得高大自立。因为它们在世人中，和下坑的人都被交与死亡，到阴府去了。」

chapters.en: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘On the day it was brought down to Sheol, I caused mourning. I covered the deep because of it; I held back its rivers; its abundant waters were restrained. I made Lebanon mourn for it, and all the trees of the field fainted because of it.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说：「它下阴间的那日，我便使人悲哀。我为它遮盖深渊，使江河凝结，大水停流；我也使黎巴嫩为它悽惨，田野的诸树都因它发昏。

chapters.en:
I made the nations quake at the sound of its downfall, when I cast it down to Sheol with those who descend to the Pit.
Then all the trees of Eden, the choicest and best of Lebanon, all the well-watered trees, were consoled in the earth below.
chapters.zh: 我将它扔到阴间，与下坑的人一同下去。那时，列国听见它坠落的响声就都震动，并且伊甸的一切树－就是黎巴嫩得水滋润、最佳最美的树－都在阴府受了安慰。

chapters.en: They too descended with it to Sheol, to those slain by the sword. As its allies they had lived in its shade among the nations.
chapters.zh: 它们也与它同下阴间，到被杀的人那里。它们曾作它的膀臂，在列国中它的荫下居住。

chapters.en: Who then is like you in glory and greatness among the trees of Eden? You also will be brought down to the depths of the earth to be with the trees of Eden. You will lie among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, declares the Lord GOD.’”
chapters.zh: 在这样荣耀威势上，在伊甸〔园〕诸树中，谁能与你相比呢？然而你要与伊甸的诸树一同下到阴府，在未受割礼的人中，与被杀的人一同躺卧。 「法老和他的群众乃是如此。这是主耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: In the twelfth year, on the first day of the twelfth month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 十二年十二月初一日，耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en:
“Son of man, take up a lament for Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him:
‘You are like a lion among the nations; you are like a monster in the seas. You thrash about in your rivers, churning up the waters with your feet
and muddying the streams.’
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，你要为埃及王法老作哀歌，说： 从前你在列国中，如同少壮狮子； 现在你却像海中的大鱼。 你冲出江河， 用爪搅动诸水， 使江河浑浊。

chapters.en:
This is what the Lord GOD says:
‘I will spread My net over you with a company of many peoples,
and they will draw you up in My net.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说： 我必用多国的人民， 将我的网撒在你身上， 把你拉上来。

chapters.en: I will abandon you on the land and hurl you into the open field. I will cause all the birds of the air to settle upon you, and all the beasts of the earth to eat their fill of you.
chapters.zh: 我必将你丢在地上， 抛在田野， 使空中的飞鸟都落在你身上， 使遍地的野兽吃你得饱。

chapters.en: I will put your flesh on the mountains and fill the valleys with your remains.
chapters.zh: 我必将你的肉丢在山间， 用你高大的〔尸首〕填满山谷。

chapters.en: I will drench the land with the flow of your blood, all the way to the mountains— the ravines will be filled.
chapters.zh: 我又必用你的血浇灌你所游泳之地， 漫过山顶； 河道都必充满。

chapters.en:
When I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens
and darken their stars. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light.
chapters.zh: 我将你扑灭的时候， 要把天遮蔽， 使众星昏暗， 以密云遮掩太阳， 月亮也不放光。

chapters.en: All the shining lights in the heavens I will darken over you, and I will bring darkness upon your land,’ declares the Lord GOD.
chapters.zh: 我必使天上的亮光都在你以上变为昏暗， 使你的地上黑暗。 这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
‘I will trouble the hearts of many peoples, when I bring about your destruction among the nations,
in countries you do not know.
chapters.zh: 「我使你败亡〔的风声〕传到你所不认识的各国。那时，我必使多民的心因你愁烦。

chapters.en:
I will cause many peoples to be appalled over you, and their kings will shudder in horror because of you when I brandish My sword before them. On the day of your downfall each of them will tremble
every moment for his life.’
chapters.zh: 我在许多国民和君王面前〔向你〕抡我的刀，国民就必因你惊奇，君王也必因你极其恐慌。在你仆倒的日子，他们各人为自己的性命时刻战兢。」

chapters.en:
For this is what the Lord GOD says:
‘The sword of the king of Babylon will come against you!
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说：「巴比伦王的刀必临到你。

chapters.en:
I will make your hordes fall by the swords of the mighty,
the most ruthless of all nations. They will ravage the pride of Egypt and all her multitudes will be destroyed.
chapters.zh: 我必藉勇士的刀使你的众民仆倒；这勇士都是列国中强暴的。 他们必使埃及的骄傲归于无有； 埃及的众民必被灭绝。

chapters.en: I will slaughter all her cattle beside the abundant waters. No human foot will muddy them again, and no cattle hooves will disturb them.
chapters.zh: 我必从埃及多水旁除灭所有的走兽； 人脚兽蹄必不再搅浑这水。

chapters.en: Then I will let her waters settle and will make her rivers flow like oil,’ declares the Lord GOD.
chapters.zh: 那时，我必使埃及河澄清， 江河像油缓流。 这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en: ‘When I make the land of Egypt a desolation and empty it of all that filled it, when I strike down all who live there, then they will know that I am the LORD.’
chapters.zh: 我使埃及地变为荒废凄凉； 这地缺少从前所充满的， 又击杀其中一切的居民。 那时，他们就知道我是耶和华。

chapters.en: This is the lament they will chant for her; the daughters of the nations will chant it. Over Egypt and all her multitudes they will chant it, declares the Lord GOD.”
chapters.zh: 「人必用这哀歌去哀哭，列国的女子为埃及和她的群众也必以此悲哀。这是主耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 十二年〔十二〕月十五日，耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: “Son of man, wail for the multitudes of Egypt, and consign her and the daughters of the mighty nations to the depths of the earth with those who descend to the Pit:
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，你要为埃及群众哀号，又要将埃及和有名之国的女子，并下坑的人，一同扔到阴府去。

chapters.en: Whom do you surpass in beauty? Go down and be placed with the uncircumcised!
chapters.zh: 你埃及的美丽胜过谁呢？ 你下去与未受割礼的人一同躺卧吧！

chapters.en: They will fall among those slain by the sword. The sword is appointed! Let them drag her away along with all her multitudes.
chapters.zh: 他们必在被杀的人中仆到。她被交给刀剑，要把她和她的群众拉去。

chapters.en: Mighty chiefs will speak from the midst of Sheol about Egypt and her allies: ‘They have come down and lie with the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword.’
chapters.zh: 强盛的勇士要在阴间对埃及王和帮助他的说话；他们是未受割礼被杀的人，已经下去，躺卧不动。

chapters.en: Assyria is there with her whole company; her graves are all around her. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword.
chapters.zh: 「亚述和她的众民都在那里，她〔民〕的坟墓在她四围；他们都是被杀倒在刀下的。

chapters.en: Her graves are set in the depths of the Pit, and her company is all around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword— those who once spread terror in the land of the living.
chapters.zh: 他们的坟墓在坑中极深之处。她的众民在她坟墓的四围，都是被杀倒在刀下的；他们曾在活人之地使人惊恐。

chapters.en: Elam is there with all her multitudes around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword— those who went down uncircumcised to the earth below, who once spread their terror in the land of the living. They bear their disgrace with those who descend to the Pit.
chapters.zh: 「以拦也在那里，她的群众在她坟墓的四围，都是被杀倒在刀下、未受割礼而下阴府的；他们曾在活人之地使人惊恐，并且与下坑的人一同担当羞辱。

chapters.en:
Among the slain they prepare a resting place for Elam with all her hordes, with her graves all around her. All of them are uncircumcised, slain by the sword, although their terror was once spread in the land of the living. They bear their disgrace with those who descend to the Pit.
They are placed among the slain.
chapters.zh: 人给她和她的群众在被杀的人中设立床榻。她〔民〕的坟墓在她四围，他们都是未受割礼被刀杀的；他们曾在活人之地使人惊恐，并且与下坑的人一同担当羞辱。以拦已经放在被杀的人中。

chapters.en:
Meshech and Tubal are there with all their multitudes,
with their graves all around them. All of them are uncircumcised, slain by the sword, because they spread their terror in the land of the living.
chapters.zh: 「米设、土巴，和她们的群众都在那里。她〔民〕的坟墓在她四围，他们都是未受割礼被刀杀的；他们曾在活人之地使人惊恐。

chapters.en: They do not lie down with the fallen warriors of old, who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war, whose swords were placed under their heads, whose shields rested on their bones, although the terror of the mighty was once in the land of the living.
chapters.zh: 他们不得与那未受割礼仆倒的勇士一同躺卧；这些勇士带着兵器下阴间，头枕刀剑，骨头上有本身的罪孽；〔他们〕曾在活人之地使勇士惊恐。

chapters.en:
But you too will be shattered and lie down among the uncircumcised,
with those slain by the sword.
chapters.zh: 「法老啊，你必在未受割礼的人中败坏，与那些被杀的人一同躺卧。

chapters.en: Edom is there, and all her kings and princes, who despite their might are laid among those slain by the sword. They lie down with the uncircumcised, with those who descend to the Pit.
chapters.zh: 「以东也在那里。她君王和一切首领虽然仗着势力，还是放在被杀的人中；他们必与未受割礼的和下坑的人一同躺卧。

chapters.en: All the leaders of the north and all the Sidonians are there; they went down in disgrace with the slain, despite the terror of their might. They lie uncircumcised with those slain by the sword and bear their shame with those who descend to the Pit.
chapters.zh: 「在那里有北方的众王子和一切西顿人，都与被杀的人下去。他们虽然仗着势力使人惊恐，还是蒙羞。他们未受割礼，和被刀杀的一同躺卧，与下坑的人一同担当羞辱。

chapters.en: Pharaoh will see them and be comforted over all his multitude— Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.
chapters.zh: 「法老看见他们，便为他被杀的军队受安慰。这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
For I will spread My terror in the land of the living, so that Pharaoh and all his multitude will be laid to rest among the uncircumcised,
with those slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.”
chapters.zh: 我任凭法老在活人之地使人惊恐，法老和他的群众必放在未受割礼和被杀的人中。这是主耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: “Son of man, speak to your people and tell them: ‘Suppose I bring the sword against a land, and the people of that land choose a man from among them, appointing him as their watchman,
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，你要告诉本国的子民说：我使刀剑临到哪一国，那一国的民从他们中间选立一人为守望的。

chapters.en: and he sees the sword coming against that land and blows the ram’s horn to warn the people.
chapters.zh: 他见刀剑临到那地，若吹角警戒众民，

chapters.en: Then if anyone hears the sound of the horn but fails to heed the warning, and the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.
chapters.zh: 凡听见角声不受警戒的，刀剑若来除灭了他，他的罪〔注：原文是血〕就必归到自己的头上。

chapters.en: Since he heard the sound of the horn but failed to heed the warning, his blood will be on his own head. If he had heeded the warning, he would have saved his life.
chapters.zh: 他听见角声，不受警戒，他的罪必归到自己的身上；他若受警戒，便是救了自己的性命。

chapters.en: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and fails to blow the horn to warn the people, and the sword comes and takes away a life, then that one will be taken away in his iniquity, but I will hold the watchman accountable for his blood.’
chapters.zh: 倘若守望的人见刀剑临到，不吹角，以致民不受警戒，刀剑来杀了他们中间的一个人，他虽然死在罪孽之中，我却要向守望的人讨他丧命的罪〔注：原文是血〕。

chapters.en: As for you, O son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel; so hear the word from My mouth and give them the warning from Me.
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，我照样立你作以色列家守望的人。所以你要听我口中的话，替我警戒他们。

chapters.en: If I say to the wicked, ‘O wicked man, you will surely die,’ but you do not speak out to dissuade him from his way, then that wicked man will die in his iniquity, yet I will hold you accountable for his blood.
chapters.zh: 我对恶人说：『恶人哪，你必要死！』你－以西结若不开口警戒恶人，使他离开所行的道，这恶人必死在罪孽之中，我却要向你讨他丧命的罪〔注：原文是血〕。

chapters.en: But if you warn the wicked man to turn from his way, and he does not turn from it, he will die in his iniquity, but you will have saved your life.
chapters.zh: 倘若你警戒恶人转离所行的道，他仍不转离，他必死在罪孽之中，你却救自己脱离了罪。」

chapters.en: Now as for you, son of man, tell the house of Israel that this is what they have said: ‘Our transgressions and our sins are heavy upon us, and we are wasting away because of them! How can we live?’
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，你要对以色列家说：『你们常说：我们的过犯罪恶在我们身上，我们必因此消灭，怎能存活呢？』

chapters.en: Say to them: ‘As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that the wicked should turn from their ways and live. Turn! Turn from your evil ways! For why should you die, O house of Israel?’
chapters.zh: 你对他们说，主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，我断不喜悦恶人死亡，惟喜悦恶人转离所行的道而活。以色列家啊，你们转回，转回吧！离开恶道，何必死亡呢？

chapters.en: Therefore, son of man, say to your people: ‘The righteousness of the righteous man will not deliver him in the day of his transgression; neither will the wickedness of the wicked man cause him to stumble on the day he turns from his wickedness. Nor will the righteous man be able to survive by his righteousness on the day he sins.’
chapters.zh: 人子啊，你要对本国的人民说：义人的义，在犯罪之日不能救他；至于恶人的恶，在他转离恶行之日也不能使他倾倒；义人在犯罪之日也不能因他的义存活。

chapters.en: If I tell the righteous man that he will surely live, but he then trusts in his righteousness and commits iniquity, then none of his righteous works will be remembered; he will die because of the iniquity he has committed.
chapters.zh: 我对义人说：『你必定存活！』他若倚靠他的义而作罪孽，他所行的义都不被记念。他必因所作的罪孽死亡。

chapters.en: But if I tell the wicked man, ‘You will surely die,’ and he turns from his sin and does what is just and right—
chapters.zh: 再者，我对恶人说：『你必定死亡！』他若转离他的罪，行正直与合理的事：

chapters.en: if he restores a pledge, makes restitution for what he has stolen, and walks in the statutes of life without practicing iniquity—then he will surely live; he will not die.
chapters.zh: 还人的当头和所抢夺的，遵行生命的律例，不作罪孽，他必定存活，不致死亡。

chapters.en: None of the sins he has committed will be held against him. He has done what is just and right; he will surely live.
chapters.zh: 他所犯的一切罪必不被记念。他行了正直与合理的事，必定存活。

chapters.en: Yet your people say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But it is their way that is not just.
chapters.zh: 「你本国的子民还说：『主的道不公平。』其实他们的道不公平。

chapters.en: If a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will die for it.
chapters.zh: 义人转离他的义而作罪孽，就必因此死亡。

chapters.en: But if a wicked man turns from his wickedness and does what is just and right, he will live because of this.
chapters.zh: 恶人转离他的恶，行正直与合理的事，就必因此存活。

chapters.en: Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But I will judge each of you according to his ways, O house of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 你们还说：『主的道不公平。』以色列家啊，我必按你们各人所行的审判你们。」

chapters.en: In the twelfth year of our exile, on the fifth day of the tenth month, a fugitive from Jerusalem came to me and reported, “The city has been taken!”
chapters.zh: 我们被掳之后十二年十〔月〕初五〔日〕，有人从耶路撒冷逃到我这里，说：「城已攻破。」

chapters.en: Now the evening before the fugitive arrived, the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He opened my mouth before the man came to me in the morning. So my mouth was opened and I was no longer mute.
chapters.zh: 逃来的人未到前一日的晚上，耶和华的灵〔注：原文是手〕降在我身上，开我的口。到第二日早晨，那人来到我这里，我口就开了，不再缄默。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: “Son of man, those living in the ruins in the land of Israel are saying, ‘Abraham was only one man, yet he possessed the land. But we are many; surely the land has been given to us as a possession.’
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，住在以色列荒废之地的人说：『亚伯拉罕独自一人能得这地为业，我们人数众多，这地〔更〕是给我们为业的。』

chapters.en: Therefore tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘You eat meat with the blood in it, lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood. Should you then possess the land?
chapters.zh: 所以你要对他们说，主耶和华如此说：你们吃带血的物，仰望偶像，并且杀人流血，你们还能得这地为业吗？

chapters.en: You have relied on your swords, you have committed detestable acts, and each of you has defiled his neighbor’s wife. Should you then possess the land?’
chapters.zh: 你们倚仗自己的刀剑行可憎的事，人人玷污邻舍的妻，你们还能得这地为业吗？

chapters.en: Tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘As surely as I live, those in the ruins will fall by the sword, those in the open field I will give to be devoured by wild animals, and those in the strongholds and caves will die by plague.
chapters.zh: 你要对他们这样说，主耶和华如此说：我指着我的永生起誓，在荒场中的，必倒在刀下；在田野间的，必交给野兽吞吃；在保障和洞里的，必遭瘟疫而死。

chapters.en: I will make the land a desolate waste, and the pride of her strength will come to an end. The mountains of Israel will become desolate, so that no one will pass through.
chapters.zh: 我必使这地荒凉，令人惊骇；她因势力而有的骄傲也必止息。以色列的山都必荒凉，无人经过。

chapters.en: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land a desolate waste because of all the abominations they have committed.’
chapters.zh: 我因他们所行一切可憎的事使地荒凉，令人惊骇。那时，他们就知道我是耶和华。」

chapters.en: As for you, son of man, your people are talking about you near the city walls and in the doorways of their houses. One speaks to another, each saying to his brother, ‘Come and hear the message that has come from the LORD!’
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，你本国的子民在墙垣旁边、在房屋门口谈论你。弟兄对弟兄彼此说：『来吧！听听有什么话从耶和华而出。』

chapters.en: So My people come to you as usual, sit before you, and hear your words; but they do not put them into practice. Although they express love with their mouths, their hearts pursue dishonest gain.
chapters.zh: 他们来到你这里如同民来〔聚会〕，坐在你面前仿佛是我的民。他们听你的话却不去行；因为他们的口多显爱情，心却追随财利。

chapters.en: Indeed, you are to them like a singer of love songs with a beautiful voice, who skillfully plays an instrument. They hear your words but do not put them into practice.
chapters.zh: 他们看你如善于奏乐、声音幽雅之人所唱的雅歌，他们听你的话却不去行。

chapters.en: So when it comes to pass—and surely it will come—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”
chapters.zh: 看哪，所说的快要应验；应验了，他们就知道在他们中间有了先知。」

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the shepherds of Israel, who only feed themselves! Should not the shepherds feed their flock?
chapters.zh: 「人子啊，你要向以色列的牧人发预言，攻击他们，说，主耶和华如此说：祸哉！以色列的牧人只知牧养自己。牧人岂不当牧养群羊吗？

chapters.en: You eat the fat, wear the wool, and butcher the fattened sheep, but you do not feed the flock.
chapters.zh: 你们吃脂油、穿羊毛、宰肥壮的，却不牧养群羊。

chapters.en: You have not strengthened the weak, healed the sick, bound up the injured, brought back the strays, or searched for the lost. Instead, you have ruled them with violence and cruelty.
chapters.zh: 瘦弱的，你们没有养壮；有病的，你们没有医治；受伤的，你们没有缠裹；被逐的，你们没有领回；失丧的，你们没有寻找；但用强暴严严地辖制。

chapters.en: They were scattered for lack of a shepherd, and when they were scattered they became food for all the wild beasts.
chapters.zh: 因无牧人，羊就分散；既分散，便作了一切野兽的食物。

chapters.en: My flock went astray on all the mountains and every high hill. They were scattered over the face of all the earth, with no one to search for them or seek them out.’
chapters.zh: 我的羊在诸山间、在各高冈上流离，在全地上分散，无人去寻，无人去找。

chapters.en: Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:
chapters.zh: 「所以，你们这些牧人要听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: ‘As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, because My flock lacks a shepherd and has become prey and food for every wild beast, and because My shepherds did not search for My flock but fed themselves instead,
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，我的羊因无牧人就成为掠物，也作了一切野兽的食物。我的牧人不寻找我的羊；这些牧人只知牧养自己，并不牧养我的羊。

chapters.en: therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD!’
chapters.zh: 所以你们这些牧人要听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against the shepherds, and I will demand from them My flock and remove them from tending the flock, so that they can no longer feed themselves. For I will deliver My flock from their mouths, and it will no longer be food for them.’
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说：我必与牧人为敌，必向他们的手追讨我的羊，使他们不再牧放群羊；牧人也不再牧养自己。我必救我的羊脱离他们的口，不再作他们的食物。」

chapters.en: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I Myself will search for My flock and seek them out.
chapters.zh: 「主耶和华如此说：看哪，我必亲自寻找我的羊，将牠们寻见。

chapters.en:
As a shepherd looks for his scattered sheep when he is among the flock, so I will look for My flock.
I will rescue them from all the places to which they were scattered on a day of clouds and darkness.
chapters.zh: 牧人在羊群四散的日子怎样寻找他的羊，我必照样寻找我的羊。这些羊在密云黑暗的日子散到各处，我必从那里救回牠们来。

chapters.en: I will bring them out from the peoples, gather them from the countries, and bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, in the ravines, and in all the settlements of the land.
chapters.zh: 我必从万民中领出牠们，从各国内聚集牠们，引导牠们归回故土，也必在以色列山上－一切溪水旁边、境内一切可居之处－牧养牠们。

chapters.en: I will feed them in good pasture, and the lofty mountains of Israel will be their grazing land. There they will lie down in a good grazing land; they will feed in rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
chapters.zh: 我必在美好的草场牧养牠们。牠们的圈必在以色列高处的山上，牠们必在佳美之圈中躺卧，也在以色列山肥美的草场吃草。

chapters.en: I will tend My flock and make them lie down, declares the Lord GOD.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说：我必亲自作我羊的牧人，使牠们得以躺卧。

chapters.en: I will seek the lost, bring back the strays, bind up the broken, and strengthen the weak; but the sleek and strong I will destroy. I will shepherd them with justice.’
chapters.zh: 失丧的，我必寻找；被逐的，我必领回；受伤的，我必缠裹；有病的，我必医治；只是肥的壮的，我必除灭，也要秉公牧养牠们。

chapters.en: This is what the Lord GOD says to you, My flock: ‘I will judge between one sheep and another, between the rams and the goats.
chapters.zh: 「我的羊群哪，论到你们，主耶和华如此说：我必在羊与羊中间、公绵羊与公山羊中间施行判断。

chapters.en: Is it not enough for you to feed on the good pasture? Must you also trample the rest of the pasture with your feet? Is it not enough for you to drink the clear waters? Must you also muddy the rest with your feet?
chapters.zh: 你们这些〔肥壮的羊〕，在美好的草场吃草还以为小事吗？剩下的草，你们竟用蹄践踏了；你们喝清水，剩下的水，你们竟用蹄搅浑了。

chapters.en: Why must My flock feed on what your feet have trampled, and drink what your feet have muddied?’
chapters.zh: 至于我的羊，只得吃你们所践踏的，喝你们所搅浑的。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says to them: ‘Behold, I Myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
chapters.zh: 「所以，主耶和华如此说：我必在肥羊和瘦羊中间施行判断。

chapters.en: Since you shove with flank and shoulder, butting all the weak ones with your horns until you have scattered them abroad,
chapters.zh: 因为你们用胁用肩拥挤一切瘦弱的，又用角牴触，以致使牠们四散。

chapters.en: I will save My flock, and they will no longer be prey. I will judge between one sheep and another.
chapters.zh: 所以，我必拯救我的群羊不再作掠物；我也必在羊和羊中间施行判断。

chapters.en: I will appoint over them one shepherd, My servant David, and he will feed them. He will feed them and be their shepherd.
chapters.zh: 我必立一牧人照管他们，牧养他们，就是我的仆人大卫。他必牧养他们，作他们的牧人。

chapters.en: I, the LORD, will be their God, and My servant David will be a prince among them. I, the LORD, have spoken.
chapters.zh: 我－耶和华必作他们的上帝，我的仆人大卫必在他们中间作王。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: I will make with them a covenant of peace and rid the land of wild animals, so that they may dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the forest.
chapters.zh: 「我必与他们立平安的约，使恶兽从境内断绝，他们就必安居在旷野，躺卧在林中。

chapters.en: I will make them and the places around My hill a blessing. I will send down showers in season—showers of blessing.
