chapters.zh: 那时，必有许多人起来攻击南方王，并且你本国的强暴人必兴起，要应验那异象，他们却要败亡。

chapters.en: Then the king of the North will come, build up a siege ramp, and capture a fortified city. The forces of the South will not stand; even their best troops will not be able to resist.
chapters.zh: 北方王必来筑垒攻取坚固城；南方的军兵必站立不住，就是选择的精兵〔注：原文是民〕也无力站住。

chapters.en: The invader will do as he pleases, and no one will stand against him. He will establish himself in the Beautiful Land, with destruction in his hand.
chapters.zh: 来攻击他的，必任意而行，无人在北方王〔注：原文是他〕面前站立得住。他必站在那荣美之地，用手施行毁灭。

chapters.en: He will resolve to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, and will reach an agreement with the king of the South. He will give him a daughter in marriage in order to overthrow the kingdom, but his plan will not succeed or help him.
chapters.zh: 「他必定意用全国之力而来，立公正的约，照约而行，将自己的女儿给南方王为妻，想要败坏他〔注：或译：埃及〕，这计却不得成就，与自己毫无益处。

chapters.en: Then he will turn his face to the coastlands and capture many of them. But a commander will put an end to his reproach and will turn it back upon him.
chapters.zh: 其后他必转回夺取了许多海岛。但有一大帅，除掉他令人受的羞辱，并且使这羞辱归他本身。

chapters.en: After this, he will turn back toward the fortresses of his own land, but he will stumble and fall and be no more.
chapters.zh: 他就必转向本地的保障，却要绊跌仆倒，归于无有。

chapters.en: In his place one will arise who will send out a tax collector for the glory of the kingdom; but within a few days he will be destroyed, though not in anger or in battle.
chapters.zh: 「那时，必有一人兴起接续他为王，使横征暴敛的人通行国中的荣美地。这王不多日就必灭亡，却不因忿怒，也不因争战。」

chapters.en: In his place a despicable person will arise; royal honors will not be given to him, but he will come in a time of peace and seize the kingdom by intrigue.
chapters.zh: 「必有一个卑鄙的人兴起接续为王，人未曾将国的尊荣给他，他却趁人坦然无备的时候，用谄媚的话得国。

chapters.en: Then a flood of forces will be swept away before him and destroyed, along with a prince of the covenant.
chapters.zh: 必有无数的军兵势如洪水，在他面前冲没败坏；同盟的君也必如此。

chapters.en: After an alliance is made with him, he will act deceitfully; for he will rise to power with only a few people.
chapters.zh: 与那君结盟之后，他必行诡诈，因为他必上来以微小的军〔注：原文是民〕成为强盛。

chapters.en: In a time of peace, he will invade the richest provinces and do what his fathers and forefathers never did. He will lavish plunder, loot, and wealth on his followers, and he will plot against the strongholds—but only for a time.
chapters.zh: 趁人坦然无备的时候，他必来到国中极肥美之地，行他列祖和他列祖之祖所未曾行的，将掳物、掠物，和财宝散给众人，又要设计攻打保障，然而这都是暂时的。

chapters.en: And with a large army he will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the South, who will mobilize a very large and powerful army but will not withstand the plots devised against him.
chapters.zh: 「他必奋勇向前，率领大军攻击南方王；南方王也必以极大极强的军兵与他争战，却站立不住，因为有人设计谋害南方王。

chapters.en: Those who eat from his provisions will seek to destroy him; his army will be swept away, and many will fall slain.
chapters.zh: 吃王膳的，必败坏他；他的军队必被冲没，而且被杀的甚多。

chapters.en: And the two kings, with their hearts bent on evil, will speak lies at the same table, but to no avail, for still the end will come at the appointed time.
chapters.zh: 至于这二王，他们心怀恶计，同席说谎，〔计谋〕却不成就；因为到了定期，事就了结。

chapters.en: The king of the North will return to his land with great wealth, but his heart will be set against the holy covenant; so he will do damage and return to his own land.
chapters.zh: 北方王〔注：原文是他〕必带许多财宝回往本国，他的心反对圣约，〔任意〕而行，回到本地。

chapters.en: At the appointed time he will invade the South again, but this time will not be like the first.
chapters.zh: 「到了定期，他必返回，来到南方。后一次却不如前一次，

chapters.en: Ships of Kittim will come against him, and he will lose heart. Then he will turn back and rage against the holy covenant and do damage. So he will return and show favor to those who forsake the holy covenant.
chapters.zh: 因为基提战船必来攻击他，他就丧胆而回，又要恼恨圣约，〔任意〕而行；他必回来联络背弃圣约的人。

chapters.en: His forces will rise up and desecrate the temple fortress. They will abolish the daily sacrifice and set up the abomination of desolation.
chapters.zh: 他必兴兵，这兵必亵渎圣地，就是保障，除掉常献的〔燔祭〕，设立那行毁坏可憎的。

chapters.en: With flattery he will corrupt those who violate the covenant, but the people who know their God will firmly resist him.
chapters.zh: 作恶违背〔圣〕约的人，他必用巧言勾引；惟独认识上帝的子民必刚强行事。

chapters.en: Those with insight will instruct many, though for a time they will fall by sword or flame, or be captured or plundered.
chapters.zh: 民间的智慧人必训诲多人；然而他们多日必倒在刀下，或被火烧，或被掳掠抢夺。

chapters.en: Now when they fall, they will be granted a little help, but many will join them insincerely.
chapters.zh: 他们仆倒的时候，稍得扶助，却有许多人用谄媚的话亲近他们。

chapters.en: Some of the wise will fall so that they may be refined, purified, and made spotless until the time of the end, for it will still come at the appointed time.
chapters.zh: 智慧人中有些仆倒的，为要熬炼其余的人，使他们清净洁白，直到末了；因为到了定期，事就了结。

chapters.en: Then the king will do as he pleases and will exalt and magnify himself above every god, and he will speak monstrous things against the God of gods. He will be successful until the time of wrath is completed, for what has been decreed must be accomplished.
chapters.zh: 「王必任意而行，自高自大，超过所有的神，又用奇异的话攻击万神之神。他必行事亨通，直到〔主的〕忿怒完毕，因为所定的事必然成就。

chapters.en: He will show no regard for the gods of his fathers, nor for the one desired by women, nor for any other god, because he will magnify himself above them all.
chapters.zh: 他必不顾他列祖的神，也不顾妇女所羨慕的神，无论何神他都不顾；因为他必自大，高过一切。

chapters.en: And in their place, he will honor a god of fortresses—a god his fathers did not know—with gold, silver, precious stones, and riches.
chapters.zh: 他倒要敬拜保障的神，用金、银、宝石和可爱之物敬奉他列祖所不认识的神。

chapters.en: He will attack the strongest fortresses with the help of a foreign god and will greatly honor those who acknowledge him, making them rulers over many and distributing the land for a price.
chapters.zh: 他必靠外邦神的帮助，攻破最坚固的保障。凡承认他的，他必将荣耀加给他们，使他们管辖许多人，又为贿赂分地〔与他们〕。

chapters.en: At the time of the end, the king of the South will engage him in battle, but the king of the North will storm out against him with chariots, horsemen, and many ships, invading many countries and sweeping through them like a flood.
chapters.zh: 「到末了，南方王要与他交战。北方王必用战车、马兵，和许多战船，势如暴风来攻击他，也必进入列国，如洪水泛滥。

chapters.en: He will also invade the Beautiful Land, and many countries will fall. But these will be delivered from his hand: Edom, Moab, and the leaders of the Ammonites.
chapters.zh: 又必进入那荣美之地，有许多〔国〕就被倾覆，但以东人、摩押人，和一大半亚扪人必脱离他的手。

chapters.en: He will extend his power over many countries, and not even the land of Egypt will escape.
chapters.zh: 他必伸手攻击列国；埃及地也不得脱离。

chapters.en: He will gain control of the treasures of gold and silver and over all the riches of Egypt, and the Libyans and Cushites will also submit to him.
chapters.zh: 他必把持埃及的金银财宝和各样的宝物。利比亚人和古实人都必跟从他。

chapters.en: But news from the east and the north will alarm him, and he will go out with great fury to destroy many and devote them to destruction.
chapters.zh: 但从东方和北方必有消息扰乱他，他就大发烈怒出去，要将多人杀灭净尽。

chapters.en: He will pitch his royal tents between the sea and the beautiful holy mountain, but he will meet his end with no one to help him.
chapters.zh: 他必在海和荣美的圣山中间设立他如宫殿的帐幕；然而到了他的结局，必无人能帮助他。」

chapters.en: “At that time Michael, the great prince who stands watch over your people, will rise up. There will be a time of distress, the likes of which will not have occurred from the beginning of nations until that time. But at that time your people—everyone whose name is found written in the book—will be delivered.
chapters.zh: 「那时，保佑你本国之民的天使长〔注：原文是大君〕米迦勒必站起来，并且有大艰难，从有国以来直到此时，没有这样的。你本国的民中，凡名录在册上的，必得拯救。

chapters.en: And many who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, but others to shame and everlasting contempt.
chapters.zh: 睡在尘埃中的，必有多人复醒。其中有得永生的，有受羞辱永远被憎恶的。

chapters.en: Then the wise will shine like the brightness of the heavens, and those who lead many to righteousness will shine like the stars forever and ever.
chapters.zh: 智慧人必发光如同天上的光；那使多人归义的，必发光如星，直到永永远远。

chapters.en: But you, Daniel, shut up these words and seal the book until the time of the end. Many will roam to and fro, and knowledge will increase.”
chapters.zh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑〔注：或译：切心研究〕，知识就必增长。」

chapters.en: Then I, Daniel, looked and saw two others standing there, one on this bank of the river and one on the opposite bank.
chapters.zh: 我－但以理观看，见另有两个人站立：一个在河这边，一个在河那边。

chapters.en: One of them said to the man dressed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long until the fulfillment of these wonders?”
chapters.zh: 有一个问那站在河水以上、穿细麻衣的说：「这奇异的事到几时才应验呢？」

chapters.en: And the man dressed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, raised his right hand and his left hand toward heaven, and I heard him swear by Him who lives forever, saying, “It will be for a time, and times, and half a time. When the power of the holy people has finally been shattered, all these things will be completed.”
chapters.zh: 我听见那站在河水以上、穿细麻衣的，向天举起左右手，指着活到永远的〔主〕起誓说：「要到一载、二载、半载，打破圣民权力的时候，这一切事就都应验了。」

chapters.en: I heard, but I did not understand. So I asked, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”
chapters.zh: 我听见这话，却不明白，就说：「我主啊，这些事的结局是怎样呢？」

chapters.en: “Go on your way, Daniel,” he replied, “for the words are closed up and sealed until the time of the end.
chapters.zh: 他说：「但以理啊，你只管去；因为这话已经隐藏封闭，直到末时。

chapters.en: Many will be purified, made spotless, and refined, but the wicked will continue to act wickedly. None of the wicked will understand, but the wise will understand.
chapters.zh: 必有许多人使自己清净洁白，且被熬炼；但恶人仍必行恶，一切恶人都不明白，惟独智慧人能明白。

chapters.en: And from the time the daily sacrifice is abolished and the abomination of desolation set up, there will be 1,290 days.
chapters.zh: 从除掉常献的〔燔祭〕，并设立那行毁坏可憎之物的时候，必有一千二百九十日。

chapters.en: Blessed is he who waits and reaches the end of the 1,335 days.
chapters.zh: 等到一千三百三十五日的，那人便为有福。

chapters.en: But as for you, go on your way until the end. You will rest, and then you will arise to your inheritance at the end of the days.”
chapters.zh: 「你且去等候结局，因为你必安歇。到了末期，你必起来，享受你的〔福〕分。」

chapters.en: This is the word of the LORD that came to Hosea son of Beeri in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and of Jeroboam son of Jehoash, king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 当乌西雅、约坦、亚哈斯、希西家作犹大王，约阿施的儿子耶罗波安作以色列王的时候，耶和华的话临到备利的儿子何西阿。

chapters.en: When the LORD first spoke through Hosea, He told him, “Go, take a prostitute as your wife and have children of adultery, because this land is flagrantly prostituting itself by departing from the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华初次与何西阿说话，对他说：「你去娶淫妇为妻，也收那从淫乱所生的儿女；因为这地大行淫乱，离弃耶和华。」

chapters.en: So Hosea went and married Gomer daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore him a son.
chapters.zh: 于是，何西阿去娶了滴拉音的女儿歌篾。这妇人怀孕，给他生了一个儿子。

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to Hosea, “Name him Jezreel, for soon I will bring the bloodshed of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and I will put an end to the kingdom of Israel.
chapters.zh: 耶和华对何西阿说：「给他起名叫耶斯列；因为再过片时，我必讨耶户家在耶斯列杀人流血的罪，也必使以色列家的国灭绝。

chapters.en: And on that day I will break the bow of Israel in the Valley of Jezreel.”
chapters.zh: 到那日，我必在耶斯列平原折断以色列的弓。」

chapters.en: Gomer again conceived and gave birth to a daughter, and the LORD said to Hosea, “Name her Lo-ruhamah, for I will no longer have compassion on the house of Israel, that I should ever forgive them.
chapters.zh: 歌篾又怀孕生了一个女儿，〔耶和华〕对何西阿说：「给她起名叫罗‧路哈玛〔注：就是不蒙怜悯的意思〕；因为我必不再怜悯以色列家，决不赦免他们。

chapters.en: Yet I will have compassion on the house of Judah, and I will save them—not by bow or sword or war, not by horses and cavalry, but by the LORD their God.”
chapters.zh: 我却要怜悯犹大家，使他们靠耶和华－他们的上帝得救，不使他们靠弓、刀、争战、马匹，与马兵得救。」

chapters.en: After she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, Gomer conceived and gave birth to a son.
chapters.zh: 歌篾给罗‧路哈玛断奶以后，又怀孕生了一个儿子。

chapters.en: And the LORD said, “Name him Lo-ammi, for you are not My people, and I am not your God.
chapters.zh: 〔耶和华〕说：「给他起名叫罗‧阿米〔注：就是非我民的意思〕；因为你们不作我的子民，我也不作你们的〔上帝〕。」

chapters.en: Yet the number of the Israelites will be like the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured or counted. And it will happen that in the very place where it was said to them, ‘You are not My people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’
chapters.zh: 然而，以色列的人数必如海沙，不可量，不可数。从前在什么地方对他们说「你们不是我的子民」，将来在那里必对他们说「〔你们是〕永生上帝的儿子」。

chapters.en: Then the people of Judah and of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint for themselves one leader, and will go up out of the land. For great will be the day of Jezreel.
chapters.zh: 犹大人和以色列人必一同聚集，为自己立一个首领，从这地上去〔注：或译：从被掳之地上来〕，因为耶斯列的日子必为大日。

chapters.en: “Say of your brothers, ‘My people,’ and of your sisters, ‘My loved one.’
chapters.zh: 你们要称你们的弟兄为阿米〔注：就是我民的意思〕，称你们的姊妹为路哈玛〔注：就是蒙怜悯的意思〕。

chapters.en: Rebuke your mother, rebuke her, for she is not My wife, and I am not her husband. Let her remove the adultery from her face and the unfaithfulness from between her breasts.
chapters.zh: 你们要与你们的母亲大大争辩； 因为她不是我的妻子， 我也不是她的丈夫。 叫她除掉脸上的淫像 和胸间的淫态，

chapters.en:
Otherwise, I will strip her naked and expose her like the day of her birth. I will make her like a desert and turn her into a parched land,
and I will let her die of thirst.
chapters.zh: 免得我剥她的衣服， 使她赤体，与才生的时候一样， 使她如旷野，如干旱之地， 因渴而死。

chapters.en: I will have no compassion on her children, because they are the children of adultery.
chapters.zh: 我必不怜悯她的儿女， 因为他们是从淫乱而生的。

chapters.en: For their mother has played the harlot and has conceived them in disgrace. For she thought, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me bread and water, wool and linen, oil and drink.’
chapters.zh: 他们的母亲行了淫乱， 怀他们的〔母〕做了可羞耻的事， 因为她说：我要随从所爱的； 我的饼、水、羊毛、麻、油、酒 都是他们给的。

chapters.en: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up her path with thorns; I will enclose her with a wall, so she cannot find her way.
chapters.zh: 因此，我必用荆棘堵塞她的道， 筑墙挡住她， 使她找不着路。

chapters.en:
She will pursue her lovers but not catch them; she will seek them but not find them. Then she will say, ‘I will return to my first husband,
for then I was better off than now.’
chapters.zh: 她必追随所爱的，却追不上； 她必寻找他们，却寻不见， 便说：我要归回前夫， 因我那时的光景比如今还好。

chapters.en:
For she does not acknowledge that it was I who gave her grain,
new wine, and oil, who lavished on her silver and gold— which they crafted for Baal.
chapters.zh: 她不知道是我给她五谷、新酒，和油， 又加增她的金银； 她却以此供奉〔注：或译：制造〕巴力。

chapters.en: Therefore I will take back My grain in its time and My new wine in its season; I will take away My wool and linen, which were given to cover her nakedness.
chapters.zh: 因此到了收割的日子， 出酒的时候， 我必将我的五谷、新酒收回， 也必将她应当遮体的羊毛和麻夺回来。

chapters.en: And then I will expose her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and no one will deliver her out of My hands.
chapters.zh: 如今我必在她所爱的眼前显露她的丑态； 必无人能救她脱离我的手。

chapters.en:
I will put an end to all her exultation: her feasts, New Moons, and Sabbaths—
all her appointed feasts.
chapters.zh: 我也必使她的宴乐、节期、月朔、安息日， 并她的一切大会都止息了。

chapters.en: I will destroy her vines and fig trees, which she thinks are the wages paid by her lovers. So I will make them into a thicket, and the beasts of the field will devour them.
chapters.zh: 我也必毁坏她的葡萄树和无花果树， 就是她说「这是我所爱的给我为赏赐」的。 我必使这些树变为荒林， 为田野的走兽所吃。

chapters.en:
I will punish her for the days of the Baals when she burned incense to them, when she adorned herself with rings and jewelry, and went after her lovers.
But Me she forgot,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必追讨她素日给诸巴力烧香的罪； 那时她佩带耳环和别样妆饰， 随从她所爱的，却忘记我。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
“Therefore, behold, I will allure her and lead her to the wilderness,
and speak to her tenderly.
chapters.zh: 后来我必劝导她，领她到旷野， 对她说安慰的话。

chapters.en:
There I will give back her vineyards and make the Valley of Achor
into a gateway of hope. There she will respond as she did in the days of her youth,
as in the day she came up out of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 她从那里出来，我必赐她葡萄园， 又赐她亚割谷作为指望的门。 她必在那里应声〔注：或译：歌唱〕， 与幼年的日子一样， 与从埃及地上来的时候相同。

chapters.en: In that day,” declares the LORD, “you will call Me ‘my Husband,’ and no longer call Me ‘my Master.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「那日你必称呼我伊施〔注：就是我夫的意思〕，不再称呼我巴力〔注：就是我主的意思〕；

chapters.en: For I will remove from her lips the names of the Baals; no longer will their names be invoked.
chapters.zh: 因为我必从我民的口中除掉诸巴力的名号，这名号不再提起。

chapters.en:
On that day I will make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field and the birds of the air
and the creatures that crawl on the ground. And I will abolish bow and sword and battle in the land,
and will make them lie down in safety.
chapters.zh: 当那日，我必为我的民，与田野的走兽和空中的飞鸟，并地上的昆虫立约；又必在国中折断弓刀，止息争战，使他们安然躺卧。

chapters.en:
So I will betroth you to Me forever; I will betroth you in righteousness and justice,
in loving devotion and compassion.
chapters.zh: 我必聘你永远归我为妻，以仁义、公平、慈爱、怜悯聘你归我；

chapters.en: And I will betroth you in faithfulness, and you will know the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 也以诚实聘你归我，你就必认识〔我〕－耶和华。

chapters.en: “On that day I will respond—” declares the LORD— “I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：那日我必应允， 我必应允天，天必应允地；

chapters.en:
And the earth will respond to the grain, to the new wine and oil,
and they will respond to Jezreel.
chapters.zh: 地必应允五谷、新酒，和油， 这些必应允耶斯列〔民〕〔注：耶斯列就是上帝栽种的意思〕。

chapters.en: And I will sow her as My own in the land, and I will have compassion on ‘No Compassion.’ I will say to those called ‘Not My People,’ ‘You are My people,’ and they will say, ‘You are my God.’”
chapters.zh: 我必将她种在这地。 素不蒙怜悯的，我必怜悯； 本非我民的，我必对他说： 你是我的民； 他必说：〔你是〕我的上帝。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD said to me, “Go show love to your wife again, though she is loved by another and is an adulteress. Love her as the LORD loves the Israelites, though they turn to other gods and love to offer raisin cakes to idols. ”
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说：「你再去爱一个淫妇，就是她情人所爱的；好像以色列人，虽然偏向别神，喜爱葡萄饼，耶和华还是爱他们。」

chapters.en: So I bought her for fifteen shekels of silver and a homer and a lethech of barley.
chapters.zh: 我便用银子十五舍客勒，大麦一贺梅珥半，买她归我。

chapters.en: Then I said to her, “You must live with me for many days; you must not be promiscuous or belong to another, and I will do the same for you.”
chapters.zh: 我对她说：「你当多日为我独居，不可行淫，不可归别人为妻，我向你也必这样。」

chapters.en: For the Israelites must live many days without king or prince, without sacrifice or sacred pillar, and without ephod or idol.
chapters.zh: 以色列人也必多日独居，无君王，无首领，无祭祀，无柱像，无以弗得，无家中的神像。

chapters.en: Afterward, the people of Israel will return and seek the LORD their God and David their king. They will come trembling to the LORD and to His goodness in the last days.
chapters.zh: 后来以色列人必归回〔注：或译：回心转意〕，寻求他们的上帝－耶和华和他们的王大卫。在末后的日子，必以敬畏的心归向耶和华，领受他的恩惠。

chapters.en:
Hear the word of the LORD, O children of Israel, for the LORD has a case against the people of the land:
“There is no truth, no loving devotion, and no knowledge of God in the land!
chapters.zh: 以色列人哪，你们当听耶和华的话。 耶和华与这地的居民争辩， 因这地上无诚实， 无良善，无人认识上帝。

chapters.en: Cursing and lying, murder and stealing, and adultery are rampant; one act of bloodshed follows another.
chapters.zh: 但起〔假〕誓，不践前言， 杀害，偷盗，奸淫，行强暴， 杀人流血，接连不断。

chapters.en: Therefore the land mourns, and all who dwell in it will waste away with the beasts of the field and the birds of the air; even the fish of the sea disappear.
chapters.zh: 因此，这地悲哀， 其上的民、田野的兽、 空中的鸟必都衰微， 海中的鱼也必消灭。

chapters.en: But let no man contend; let no man offer reproof; for your people are like those who contend with a priest.
chapters.zh: 然而，人都不必争辩，也不必指责， 因为这民与抗拒祭司的人一样。

chapters.en:
You will stumble by day, and the prophet will stumble with you by night;
so I will destroy your mother—
chapters.zh: 你这祭司必日间跌倒； 先知也必夜间与你一同跌倒； 我必灭绝你的母亲。

chapters.en: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you as My priests. Since you have forgotten the law of your God, I will also forget your children.
chapters.zh: 我的民因无知识而灭亡。 你弃掉知识， 我也必弃掉你， 使你不再给我作祭司。 你既忘了你上帝的律法， 我也必忘记你的儿女。

chapters.en: The more they multiplied, the more they sinned against Me; they exchanged their Glory for a thing of disgrace.
chapters.zh: 祭司越发增多，就越发得罪我； 我必使他们的荣耀变为羞辱。

chapters.en: They feed on the sins of My people and set their hearts on iniquity.
chapters.zh: 他们吃我民的〔赎〕罪〔祭〕， 满心愿意我民犯罪。

chapters.en: And it shall be like people, like priest. I will punish both of them for their ways and repay them for their deeds.
chapters.zh: 将来民如何， 祭司也必如何； 我必因他们所行的惩罚他们， 照他们所做的报应他们。

chapters.en: They will eat but not be satisfied; they will be promiscuous but not multiply. For they have abandoned the LORD to give themselves
chapters.zh: 他们吃，却不得饱； 行淫，而不得立后； 因为他们离弃耶和华， 不遵〔他的命〕。

chapters.en:
to promiscuity, wine, and new wine,
which take away understanding.
chapters.zh: 奸淫和酒，并新酒， 夺去人的心。

chapters.en: My people consult their wooden idols, and their divining rods inform them. For a spirit of prostitution leads them astray and they have played the harlot against their God.
chapters.zh: 我的民求问木偶， 以为木杖能指示他们； 因为他们的淫心使他们失迷， 他们就行淫离弃上帝， 不守约束，

chapters.en: They sacrifice on the mountaintops and burn offerings on the hills, under oak, poplar, and terebinth, because their shade is pleasant. And so your daughters turn to prostitution and your daughters-in-law to adultery.
chapters.zh: 在各山顶，各高冈的橡树、 杨树、栗树之下，献祭烧香， 因为树影美好。 所以，你们的女儿淫乱， 你们的新妇〔注：或译：儿妇；下同〕行淫。

chapters.en: I will not punish your daughters when they prostitute themselves, nor your daughters-in-law when they commit adultery. For the men themselves go off with prostitutes and offer sacrifices with shrine prostitutes. So a people without understanding will come to ruin.
chapters.zh: 你们的女儿淫乱， 你们的新妇行淫， 我却不惩罚她们； 因为你们自己离群与娼妓同居， 与妓女一同献祭。 这无知的民必致倾倒。

chapters.en: Though you prostitute yourself, O Israel, may Judah avoid such guilt! Do not journey to Gilgal, do not go up to Beth-aven, and do not swear on oath, ‘As surely as the LORD lives!’
chapters.zh: 以色列啊，你虽然行淫， 犹大却不可犯罪。 不要往吉甲去， 不要上到伯‧亚文， 也不要指着永生的耶和华起誓。

chapters.en: For Israel is as obstinate as a stubborn heifer. Can the LORD now shepherd them like lambs in an open meadow?
chapters.zh: 以色列倔强， 犹如倔强的母牛； 现在耶和华要放他们， 如同放羊羔在宽阔之地。

chapters.en: Ephraim is joined to idols; leave him alone!
chapters.zh: 以法莲亲近偶像， 任凭他吧！

chapters.en:
When their liquor is gone, they turn to prostitution;
their rulers dearly love disgrace.
chapters.zh: 他们所喝的已经发酸， 他们时常行淫， 他们的官长最爱羞耻的事。

chapters.en: The whirlwind has wrapped them in its wings, and their sacrifices will bring them shame.
chapters.zh: 风把他们裹在翅膀里； 他们因所献的祭必致蒙羞。

chapters.en:
“Hear this, O priests! Take heed, O house of Israel!
Give ear, O royal house! For this judgment is against you because you have been a snare at Mizpah,
a net spread out on Tabor.
chapters.zh: 众祭司啊，要听我的话！ 以色列家啊，要留心听！ 王家啊，要侧耳而听！ 审判要临到你们， 因你们在米斯巴如网罗， 在他泊山如铺张的网。

chapters.en: The rebels are deep in slaughter; but I will chastise them all.
chapters.zh: 这些悖逆的人肆行杀戮， 〔罪孽〕极深； 我却斥责他们众人。

chapters.en:
I know all about Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from Me. For now, O Ephraim, you have turned to prostitution;
Israel is defiled.
chapters.zh: 以法莲为我所知； 以色列不能向我隐藏。 以法莲哪，现在你行淫了， 以色列被玷污了。

chapters.en: Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God, for a spirit of prostitution is within them, and they do not know the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们所行的使他们不能归向上帝； 因有淫心在他们里面， 他们也不认识耶和华。

chapters.en:
Israel’s arrogance testifies against them; Israel and Ephraim stumble in their iniquity;
even Judah stumbles with them.
chapters.zh: 以色列的骄傲当面见证自己。 故此，以色列和以法莲必因自己的罪孽跌倒； 犹大也必与他们一同跌倒。

chapters.en: They go with their flocks and herds to seek the LORD, but they do not find Him; He has withdrawn Himself from them.
chapters.zh: 他们必牵着牛羊去寻求耶和华，却寻不见； 他已经转去离开他们。

chapters.en: They have been unfaithful to the LORD; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the New Moon will devour them along with their land.
chapters.zh: 他们向耶和华行事诡诈，生了私子。 到了月朔，他们与他们的地业必被吞灭。

chapters.en: Blow the ram’s horn in Gibeah, the trumpet in Ramah; raise the battle cry in Beth-aven: Lead on, O Benjamin!
chapters.zh: 你们当在基比亚吹角， 在拉玛吹号， 在伯‧亚文吹出大声，〔说〕： 便雅悯哪，〔有仇敌〕在你后头！

chapters.en: Ephraim will be laid waste on the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel I proclaim what is certain.
chapters.zh: 在责罚的日子，以法莲必变为荒场； 我在以色列支派中，指示将来必成的事。

chapters.en: The princes of Judah are like those who move boundary stones; I will pour out My fury upon them like water.
chapters.zh: 犹大的首领如同挪移地界的人， 我必将忿怒倒在他们身上，如水一般。

chapters.en: Ephraim is oppressed, crushed in judgment, for he is determined to follow worthless idols.
chapters.zh: 以法莲因乐从〔人的〕命令， 就受欺压，被审判压碎。

chapters.en: So I am like a moth to Ephraim, and like decay to the house of Judah.
chapters.zh: 我使以法莲如虫蛀之物， 使犹大家如朽烂之木。

chapters.en: When Ephraim saw his sickness and Judah his wound, then Ephraim turned to Assyria and sent to the great king. But he cannot cure you or heal your wound.
chapters.zh: 以法莲见自己有病， 犹大见自己有伤， 他们就打发人往亚述去见耶雷布王， 他却不能医治你们， 不能治好你们的伤。

chapters.en: For I am like a lion to Ephraim and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I, even I, will tear them to pieces and then go away. I will carry them off where no one can rescue them.
chapters.zh: 我必向以法莲如狮子， 向犹大家如少壮狮子。 我必撕裂而去， 我要夺去，无人搭救。

chapters.en:
Then I will return to My place until they admit their guilt and seek My face;
in their affliction they will earnestly seek Me.”
chapters.zh: 我要回到原处， 等他们自觉有罪〔注：或译：承认己罪〕，寻求我面； 他们在急难的时候必切切寻求我。

chapters.en:
Come, let us return to the LORD.
For He has torn us to pieces, but He will heal us; He has wounded us, but He will bind up our wounds.
chapters.zh: 来吧，我们归向耶和华！ 他撕裂我们，也必医治； 他打伤我们，也必缠裹。

chapters.en:
After two days He will revive us; on the third day He will raise us up,
that we may live in His presence.
chapters.zh: 过两天他必使我们苏醒， 第三天他必使我们兴起， 我们就在他面前得以存活。

chapters.en: So let us know— let us press on to know the LORD. As surely as the sun rises, He will appear; He will come to us like the rain, like the spring showers that water the earth.
chapters.zh: 我们务要认识耶和华， 竭力追求认识他。 他出现确如晨〔光〕； 他必临到我们像甘雨， 像滋润田地的春雨。

chapters.en: What shall I do with you, O Ephraim ? What shall I do with you, O Judah? For your loyalty is like a morning mist, like the early dew that vanishes.
chapters.zh: 主说：以法莲哪，我可向你怎样行呢？ 犹大啊，我可向你怎样做呢？ 因为你们的良善如同早晨的云雾， 又如速散的甘露。

chapters.en:
Therefore I have hewn them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of My mouth,
and My judgments go forth like lightning.
chapters.zh: 因此，我藉先知砍伐他们， 以我口中的话杀戮他们； 我施行的审判如光发出。

chapters.en:
For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God
rather than burnt offerings.
chapters.zh: 我喜爱良善〔注：或译：怜恤〕，不喜爱祭祀； 喜爱认识上帝，胜于燔祭。

chapters.en: But they, like Adam, have transgressed the covenant; there they were unfaithful to Me.
chapters.zh: 他们却如亚当背约， 在境内向我行事诡诈。

chapters.en: Gilead is a city of evildoers, tracked with footprints of blood.
chapters.zh: 基列是作孽之人的城， 被血沾染。

chapters.en: Like raiders who lie in ambush, so does a band of priests; they murder on the way to Shechem; surely they have committed atrocities.
chapters.zh: 强盗成群，怎样埋伏杀人， 祭司结党，也照样在示剑的路上杀戮， 行了邪恶。

chapters.en: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing: Ephraim practices prostitution there, and Israel is defiled.
chapters.zh: 在以色列家，我见了可憎的事； 在以法莲那里有淫行， 以色列被玷污。

chapters.en: Also for you, O Judah, a harvest is appointed, when I restore My people from captivity.
chapters.zh: 犹大啊，我使被掳之民归回的时候， 必有为你所命定的收场。

chapters.en:
When I heal Israel, the iniquity of Ephraim will be exposed,
as well as the crimes of Samaria. For they practice deceit and thieves break in; bandits raid in the streets.
chapters.zh: 我想医治以色列的时候， 以法莲的罪孽和撒马利亚的罪恶就显露出来。 他们行事虚谎， 内有贼人入室〔偷窃〕， 外有强盗成群骚扰。

chapters.en: But they fail to consider in their hearts that I remember all their evil. Now their deeds are all around them; they are before My face.
chapters.zh: 他们心里并不思想我记念他们的一切恶； 他们所行的现在缠绕他们，都在我面前。

chapters.en: They delight the king with their evil, and the princes with their lies.
chapters.zh: 他们行恶使君王欢喜， 说谎使首领喜乐。

chapters.en: They are all adulterers, like an oven heated by a baker who needs not stoke the fire from the kneading to the rising of the dough.
chapters.zh: 他们都是行淫的， 像火炉被烤饼的烧热， 从抟面到发面的时候， 暂不使〔火〕着旺。

chapters.en: The princes are inflamed with wine on the day of our king; so he joins hands with those who mock him.
chapters.zh: 在我们王〔宴乐〕的日子， 首领因酒的烈性成病； 王与亵慢人拉手。

chapters.en: For they prepare their heart like an oven while they lie in wait; all night their anger smolders; in the morning it blazes like a flaming fire.
chapters.zh: 首领埋伏的时候，心中热如火炉， 就如烤饼的整夜睡卧， 到了早晨火气炎炎。

chapters.en: All of them are hot as an oven, and they devour their rulers. All their kings fall; not one of them calls upon Me.
chapters.zh: 众民也热如火炉， 烧灭他们的官长。 他们的君王都仆倒而死； 他们中间无一人求告我。

chapters.en: Ephraim mixes with the nations; Ephraim is an unturned cake.
chapters.zh: 以法莲与列邦人搀杂； 以法莲是没有翻过的饼。

chapters.en: Foreigners consume his strength, but he does not notice. Even his hair is streaked with gray, but he does not know.
chapters.zh: 外邦人吞吃他劳力得来的，他却不知道； 头发斑白，他也不觉得。

chapters.en:
Israel’s arrogance testifies against them, yet they do not return to the LORD their God;
despite all this, they do not seek Him.
chapters.zh: 以色列的骄傲当面见证自己， 虽遭遇这一切， 他们仍不归向耶和华－他们的上帝， 也不寻求他。

chapters.en: So Ephraim has become like a silly, senseless dove— calling out to Egypt, then turning to Assyria.
chapters.zh: 以法莲好像鸽子愚蠢无知； 他们求告埃及，投奔亚述。

chapters.en: As they go, I will spread My net over them; I will bring them down like birds of the air. I will chastise them when I hear them flocking together.
chapters.zh: 他们去的时候，我必将我的网撒在他们身上； 我要打下他们，如同空中的鸟。 我必按他们会众所听见的惩罚他们。

chapters.en: Woe to them, for they have strayed from Me! Destruction to them, for they have rebelled against Me! Though I would redeem them, they speak lies against Me.
chapters.zh: 他们因离弃我，必定有祸； 因违背我，必被毁灭。 我虽要救赎他们，他们却向我说谎。

chapters.en: They do not cry out to Me from their hearts when they wail upon their beds. They slash themselves for grain and new wine, but turn away from Me.
chapters.zh: 他们并不诚心哀求我， 乃在床上呼号； 他们为求五谷新酒聚集， 仍然悖逆我。

chapters.en: Although I trained and strengthened their arms, they plot evil against Me.
chapters.zh: 我虽教导他们，坚固他们的膀臂， 他们竟图谋抗拒我。

chapters.en: They turn, but not to the Most High; they are like a faulty bow. Their leaders will fall by the sword for the cursing of their tongue; for this they will be ridiculed in the land of Egypt.
chapters.zh: 他们归向，却不归向至上者； 他们如同翻背的弓。 他们的首领必因舌头的狂傲倒在刀下； 这在埃及地必作人的讥笑。

chapters.en: Put the ram’s horn to your lips! An eagle looms over the house of the LORD, because the people have transgressed My covenant and rebelled against My law.
chapters.zh: 你用口吹角吧！ 〔敌人〕如鹰来攻打耶和华的家； 因为这民违背我的约， 干犯我的律法。

chapters.en: Israel cries out to Me, “O our God, we know You!”
chapters.zh: 他们必呼叫我说： 我的上帝啊，我们以色列认识你了。

chapters.en: But Israel has rejected good; an enemy will pursue him.
chapters.zh: 以色列丢弃良善〔注：或译：福分〕； 仇敌必追逼他。

chapters.en: They set up kings, but not by Me. They make princes, but without My approval. With their silver and gold they make themselves idols, to their own destruction.
chapters.zh: 他们立君王，却不由我； 他们立首领，我却不认。 他们用金银为自己制造偶像， 以致被剪除。

chapters.en: He has rejected your calf, O Samaria. My anger burns against them. How long will they be incapable of innocence?
chapters.zh: 撒马利亚啊，耶和华已经丢弃你的牛犊； 我的怒气向拜牛犊的人发作。 他们到几时方能无罪呢？

chapters.en: For this thing is from Israel— a craftsman made it, and it is not God. It will be broken to pieces, that calf of Samaria.
chapters.zh: 这〔牛犊〕出于以色列， 是匠人所造的，并不是神。 撒马利亚的牛犊必被打碎。

chapters.en: For they sow the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind. There is no standing grain; what sprouts fails to yield flour. Even if it should produce, the foreigners would swallow it up.
chapters.zh: 他们所种的是风，所收的是暴风； 所种的不成禾稼，就是发苗也不结实； 即便结实，外邦人必吞吃。

chapters.en:
Israel is swallowed up! Now they are among the nations
like a worthless vessel.
chapters.zh: 以色列被吞吃； 现今在列国中，好像人不喜悦的器皿。

chapters.en:
For they have gone up to Assyria like a wild donkey on its own.
Ephraim has hired lovers.
chapters.zh: 他们投奔亚述，如同独行的野驴； 以法莲贿买朋党。

chapters.en: Though they hire allies among the nations, I will now round them up, and they will begin to diminish under the oppression of the king of princes.
chapters.zh: 他们虽在列邦中贿买人， 现在我却要聚集〔惩罚〕他们； 他们因君王和首领所加的重担日渐衰微。

chapters.en: Though Ephraim multiplied the altars for sin, they became his altars for sinning.
chapters.zh: 以法莲增添祭坛取罪； 因此，祭坛使他犯罪。

chapters.en: Though I wrote for them the great things of My law, they regarded them as something strange.
chapters.zh: 我为他写了律法万条， 他却以为与他毫无关涉。

chapters.en:
Though they offer sacrifices as gifts to Me, and though they eat the meat,
the LORD does not accept them. Now He will remember their iniquity and punish their sins: They will return to Egypt.
chapters.zh: 至于献给我的祭物， 他们自食其肉， 耶和华却不悦纳他们。 现在必记念他们的罪孽， 追讨他们的罪恶； 他们必归回埃及。

chapters.en: Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; Judah has multiplied its fortified cities. But I will send fire upon their cities, and it will consume their citadels.
chapters.zh: 以色列忘记造他的主，建造宫殿； 犹大多造坚固城， 我却要降火焚烧他的城邑， 烧灭其中的宫殿。

chapters.en: Do not rejoice, O Israel, with exultation like the nations, for you have played the harlot against your God; you have made love for hire on every threshing floor.
chapters.zh: 以色列啊，不要像外邦人欢喜快乐； 因为你行邪淫离弃你的上帝， 在各谷场上〔如妓女〕喜爱赏赐。

chapters.en: The threshing floor and winepress will not feed them, and the new wine will fail them.
chapters.zh: 谷场和酒醡都不够以色列人使用； 新酒也必缺乏。

chapters.en: They will not remain in the land of the LORD; Ephraim will return to Egypt and eat unclean food in Assyria.
chapters.zh: 他们必不得住耶和华的地； 以法莲却要归回埃及， 必在亚述吃不洁净的食物。

chapters.en: They will not pour out wine offerings to the LORD, and their sacrifices will not please Him, but will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat will be defiled. For their bread will be for themselves; it will not enter the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们必不得向耶和华奠酒， 即便奠酒也不蒙悦纳。 他们的祭物必如居丧者的食物， 凡吃的必被玷污； 因他们的食物只为自己的口腹， 必不奉入耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: What will you do on the appointed day, on the day of the LORD’s feast?
chapters.zh: 在大会的日子， 到耶和华的节期，你们怎样行呢？

chapters.en:
For even if they flee destruction, Egypt will gather them
and Memphis will bury them. Their precious silver will be taken over by thistles, and thorns will overrun their tents.
chapters.zh: 看哪，他们逃避灾难； 埃及人必收殓他们的尸首， 摩弗人必葬埋他们的骸骨。 他们用银子做的美物上必长蒺藜； 他们的帐棚中必生荆棘。

chapters.en:
The days of punishment have come; the days of retribution have arrived—
let Israel know it. The prophet is called a fool, and the inspired man insane, because of the greatness of your iniquity and hostility.
chapters.zh: 以色列人必知道降罚的日子临近， 报应的时候来到。 〔民说〕：作先知的是愚昧； 受灵感的是狂妄， 皆因他们多多作孽，大怀怨恨。

chapters.en: The prophet is Ephraim’s watchman, along with my God, yet the snare of the fowler lies on all his paths. Hostility is in the house of his God!
chapters.zh: 以法莲曾作我上帝守望的； 至于先知，在他一切的道上作为捕鸟人的网罗， 在他上帝的家中怀怨恨。

chapters.en: They have deeply corrupted themselves as in the days of Gibeah; He will remember their guilt; He will punish their sins.
chapters.zh: 以法莲深深地败坏， 如在基比亚的日子一样。 耶和华必记念他们的罪孽， 追讨他们的罪恶。

chapters.en:
I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness. I saw your fathers as the firstfruits
of the fig tree in its first season. But they went to Baal-peor, and consecrated themselves to Shame; so they became as detestable as the thing they loved.
chapters.zh: 〔主说〕：我遇见以色列如葡萄在旷野； 我看见你们的列祖如无花果树上春季初熟的果子。 他们却来到巴力‧毗珥专拜那可羞耻的， 就成为可憎恶的， 与他们所爱的一样。

chapters.en: Ephraim’s glory will fly away like a bird, with no birth, no pregnancy, and no conception.
chapters.zh: 至于以法莲人，他们的荣耀必如鸟飞去， 必不生产，不怀胎，不成孕。

chapters.en: Even if they raise their children, I will bereave them of each one. Yes, woe be to them when I turn away from them!
chapters.zh: 纵然养大儿女， 我却必使他们丧子，甚至不留一个。 我离弃他们，他们就有祸了。

chapters.en: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a meadow. But Ephraim will bring out his children for slaughter.
chapters.zh: 我看以法莲如泰尔栽于美地。 以法莲却要将自己的儿女带出来， 交与行杀戮的人。

chapters.en: Give them, O LORD— what will You give? Give them wombs that miscarry and breasts that dry up!
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，求你加给他们－ 加什么呢？ 要使他们胎坠乳干。

chapters.en: All their evil appears at Gilgal, for there I hated them. I will drive them from My house for the wickedness of their deeds. I will no longer love them; all their leaders are rebellious.
chapters.zh: 〔耶和华说〕：他们一切的恶事都在吉甲； 我在那里憎恶他们。 因他们所行的恶， 我必从我地上赶出他们去， 不再怜爱他们； 他们的首领都是悖逆的。

chapters.en:
Ephraim is struck down; their root is withered;
they cannot bear fruit. Even if they bear children, I will slay the darlings of their wombs.
chapters.zh: 以法莲受责罚， 根本枯干，必不能结果， 即或生产， 我必杀他们所生的爱子。

chapters.en: My God will reject them because they have not obeyed Him; and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
chapters.zh: 我的上帝必弃绝他们， 因为他们不听从他； 他们也必飘流在列国中。

chapters.en: Israel was a luxuriant vine, yielding fruit for himself. The more his fruit increased, the more he increased the altars. The better his land produced, the better he made the sacred pillars.
chapters.zh: 以色列是茂盛的葡萄树，结果繁多。 果子越多，就越增添祭坛； 地土越肥美，就越造美丽的柱像。

chapters.en: Their hearts are devious; now they must bear their guilt. The LORD will break down their altars and demolish their sacred pillars.
chapters.zh: 他们心怀二意， 现今要定为有罪。 耶和华必拆毁他们的祭坛， 毁坏他们的柱像。

chapters.en: Surely now they will say, “We have no king, for we do not revere the LORD. What can a king do for us?”
chapters.zh: 他们必说：我们没有王， 因为我们不敬畏耶和华。 王能为我们做什么呢？

chapters.en: They speak mere words; with false oaths they make covenants. So judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of a field.
chapters.zh: 他们为立约说〔谎〕言，起假誓； 因此，灾罚如苦菜滋生在田间的诓沟中。

chapters.en: The people of Samaria will fear for the calf of Beth-aven. Indeed, its people will mourn over it with its idolatrous priests— those who rejoiced in its glory— for it has been taken from them into exile.
chapters.zh: 撒马利亚的居民必因伯‧亚文的牛犊惊恐； 崇拜牛犊的民和喜爱牛犊的祭司 都必因荣耀离开它，为它悲哀。

chapters.en: Yes, it will be carried to Assyria as tribute to the great king. Ephraim will be seized with shame; Israel will be ashamed of its wooden idols.
chapters.zh: 人必将牛犊带到亚述当作礼物， 献给耶雷布王。 以法莲必蒙羞； 以色列必因自己的计谋惭愧。

chapters.en: Samaria will be carried off with her king like a twig on the surface of the water.
chapters.zh: 至于撒马利亚，她的王必灭没， 如水面的沫子一样。

chapters.en:
The high places of Aven will be destroyed— it is the sin of Israel;
thorns and thistles will overgrow their altars. Then they will say to the mountains, “Cover us!” and to the hills, “Fall on us!”
chapters.zh: 伯‧亚文的邱坛－ 就是以色列取罪〔的地方〕必被毁灭； 荆棘和蒺藜必长在他们的祭坛上。 他们必对大山说：遮盖我们！ 对小山说：倒在我们身上！

chapters.en: Since the days of Gibeah you have sinned, O Israel, and there you have remained. Did not the battle in Gibeah overtake the sons of iniquity?
chapters.zh: 以色列啊， 你从基比亚的日子以来时常犯罪。 你们的先人曾站在那里， 现今住基比亚的人 以为攻击罪孽之辈的战事临不到自己。

chapters.en: I will chasten them when I please; nations will be gathered against them to put them in bondage for their double transgression.
chapters.zh: 我必随意惩罚他们。 他们为两样的罪所缠； 列邦的民必聚集攻击他们。

chapters.en: Ephraim is a well-trained heifer that loves to thresh; but I will place a yoke on her fair neck. I will harness Ephraim, Judah will plow, and Jacob will break the hard ground.
chapters.zh: 以法莲是驯良的母牛犊，喜爱踹〔谷〕， 我却将轭加在牠肥美的颈项上， 我要使以法莲拉套〔注：或译：被骑〕。 犹大必耕田； 雅各必耙地。
你们要为自己栽种公义， 就能收割慈爱。 现今正是寻求耶和华的时候； 你们要开垦荒地，等他临到， 使公义如雨降在你们身上。

chapters.en: You have plowed wickedness and reaped injustice; you have eaten the fruit of lies. Because you have trusted in your own way and in the multitude of your mighty men,
chapters.zh: 你们耕种的是奸恶， 收割的是罪孽， 吃的是谎话的果子。 因你倚靠自己的行为， 仰赖勇士众多，

chapters.en: the roar of battle will rise against your people, so that all your fortresses will be demolished as Shalman devastated Beth-arbel in the day of battle, when mothers were dashed to pieces along with their children.
chapters.zh: 所以在这民中必有鬨嚷之声， 你一切的保障必被拆毁， 就如沙勒幔在争战的日子拆毁伯‧亚比勒， 将其中的母子一同摔死。

chapters.en: Thus it will be done to you, O Bethel, because of your great wickedness. When the day dawns, the king of Israel will be utterly cut off.
chapters.zh: 因他们的大恶， 伯特利必使你们遭遇如此。 到了黎明，以色列的王必全然灭绝。

chapters.en: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called My son.
chapters.zh: 以色列年幼的时候，我爱他， 就从埃及召出我的儿子来。

chapters.en: But the more I called Israel, the farther they departed from Me. They sacrificed to the Baals and burned incense to carved images.
chapters.zh: 先知越发招呼他们， 他们越发走开， 向诸巴力献祭， 给雕刻的偶像烧香。

chapters.en: It was I who taught Ephraim to walk, taking them by the arms, but they never realized that it was I who healed them.
chapters.zh: 我原教导以法莲行走， 用膀臂抱着他们， 他们却不知道是我医治他们。

chapters.en: I led them with cords of kindness, with ropes of love; I lifted the yoke from their necks and bent down to feed them.
chapters.zh: 我用慈绳〔注：慈：原文是人的〕爱索牵引他们； 我待他们如人放松〔牛的〕两腮夹板， 把粮食放在他们面前。

chapters.en:
Will they not return to the land of Egypt and be ruled by Assyria
because they refused to repent?
chapters.zh: 他们必不归回埃及地， 亚述人却要作他们的王， 因他们不肯归向〔我〕。

chapters.en:
A sword will flash through their cities; it will destroy the bars of their gates
and consume them in their own plans.
chapters.zh: 刀剑必临到他们的城邑， 毁坏门闩，把人吞灭， 都因他们〔随从〕自己的计谋。

chapters.en:
My people are bent on turning from Me. Though they call to the Most High,
He will by no means exalt them.
chapters.zh: 我的民偏要背道离开我； 众先知虽然招呼他们归向至上的〔主〕， 却无人尊崇〔主〕。

chapters.en: How could I give you up, O Ephraim? How could I surrender you, O Israel? How could I make you like Admah? How could I treat you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within Me; My compassion is stirred!
chapters.zh: 以法莲哪，我怎能舍弃你？ 以色列啊，我怎能弃绝你？ 我怎能使你如押玛？ 怎能使你如洗扁？ 我回心转意， 我的怜爱大大发动。

chapters.en:
I will not execute the full fury of My anger; I will not destroy Ephraim again. For I am God and not man— the Holy One among you—
and I will not come in wrath.
chapters.zh: 我必不发猛烈的怒气， 也不再毁灭以法莲。 因我是上帝，并非世人， 是你们中间的圣者； 我必不在怒中临到你们。

chapters.en: They will walk after the LORD; He will roar like a lion. When He roars, His children will come trembling from the west.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必如狮子吼叫， 子民必跟随他。 他一吼叫， 他们就从西方急速而来。

chapters.en: They will come trembling like birds from Egypt and like doves from the land of Assyria. Then I will settle them in their homes, declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们必如雀鸟从埃及急速而来， 又如鸽子从亚述地来到。 我必使他们住自己的房屋。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Ephraim surrounds Me with lies, the house of Israel with deceit; but Judah still walks with God and is faithful to the Holy One.
chapters.zh: 以法莲用谎话， 以色列家用诡计围绕我； 犹大却靠上帝掌权， 向圣者有忠心〔注：或译：犹大向上帝，向诚实的圣者犹疑不定〕。

chapters.en:
Ephraim feeds on the wind and pursues the east wind all day long;
he multiplies lies and violence; he makes a covenant with Assyria and sends olive oil to Egypt.
chapters.zh: 以法莲吃风，且追赶东风， 时常增添虚谎和强暴， 与亚述立约，把油送到埃及。

chapters.en:
The LORD has a charge to bring against Judah. He will punish Jacob according to his ways
and repay him according to his deeds.
chapters.zh: 耶和华与犹大争辩， 必照雅各所行的惩罚他， 按他所做的报应他。

chapters.en: In the womb he grasped his brother’s heel, and in his vigor he wrestled with God.
chapters.zh: 他在腹中抓住哥哥的脚跟， 壮年的时候与上帝较力，

chapters.en: Yes, he struggled with the angel and prevailed; he wept and sought His favor; he found Him at Bethel and spoke with Him there —
the LORD God of Hosts, the LORD is His name of renown.
chapters.zh: 与天使较力，并且得胜， 哭泣恳求， 在伯特利遇见耶和华。 耶和华－万军之上帝在那里晓谕我们〔以色列〕人； 耶和华是他可记念的〔名〕。

chapters.en:
But you must return to your God; maintain love and justice,
and always wait on your God.
chapters.zh: 所以你当归向你的上帝， 谨守仁爱、公平，常常等候你的上帝。

chapters.en: A merchant loves to defraud with dishonest scales in his hands.
chapters.zh: 以法莲是商人， 手里有诡诈的天平，爱行欺骗。

chapters.en: And Ephraim boasts: “How rich I have become! I have found wealth for myself. In all my labors, they can find in me no iniquity that is sinful.”
chapters.zh: 以法莲说： 我果然成了富足，得了财宝； 我所劳碌得来的， 人必不见有什么不义，可算为罪的。

chapters.en: But I am the LORD your God ever since the land of Egypt. I will again make you dwell in tents, as in the days of the appointed feast.
chapters.zh: 自从你出埃及地以来， 我就是耶和华－你的上帝； 我必使你再住帐棚，如在大会的日子一样。

chapters.en:
I spoke through the prophets and multiplied their visions;
I gave parables through the prophets.
chapters.zh: 我已晓谕众先知， 并且加增默示， 藉先知设立比喻。

chapters.en:
Is there iniquity in Gilead? They will surely come to nothing. Do they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal? Indeed, their altars will be heaps of stones
in the furrows of the field.
chapters.zh: 基列人没有罪孽吗？ 他们全然是虚假的。 人在吉甲献牛犊为祭， 他们的祭坛好像田间诓沟中的乱堆。

chapters.en:
Jacob fled to the land of Aram and Israel worked for a wife—
for a wife he tended sheep.
chapters.zh: 从前雅各逃到亚兰地， 以色列为得妻服事人， 为得妻与人放羊。

chapters.en: But by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was preserved.
chapters.zh: 耶和华藉先知领以色列从埃及上来； 以色列也藉先知而得保存。

chapters.en:
Ephraim has provoked bitter anger, so his Lord will leave his bloodguilt upon him
and repay him for his contempt.
chapters.zh: 以法莲大大惹动〔主〕怒， 所以他流血的罪必归在他身上。 主必将那因以法莲所受的羞辱归还他。

chapters.en: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling; he was exalted in Israel. But he incurred guilt through Baal, and he died.
chapters.zh: 从前以法莲说话，人都战兢， 他在以色列中居处高位； 但他在〔事奉〕巴力的事上犯罪就死了。

chapters.en:
Now they sin more and more and make for themselves cast images, idols skillfully made from their silver, all of them the work of craftsmen. People say of them, “They offer human sacrifice
and kiss the calves!”
chapters.zh: 现今他们罪上加罪， 用银子为自己铸造偶像， 就是照自己的聪明制造， 都是匠人的工作。 有人论说， 献祭的人可以向牛犊亲嘴。

chapters.en: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the early dew that vanishes, like chaff blown from a threshing floor, like smoke through an open window.
chapters.zh: 因此，他们必如早晨的云雾， 又如速散的甘露， 像场上的糠秕被狂风吹去， 又像烟气腾于窗外。

chapters.en: Yet I am the LORD your God ever since the land of Egypt; you know no God but Me, for there is no Savior besides Me.
chapters.zh: 自从你出埃及地以来， 我就是耶和华－你的上帝。 在我以外，你不可认识别神； 除我以外并没有救主。

chapters.en: I knew you in the wilderness, in the land of drought.
chapters.zh: 我曾在旷野干旱之地认识你。

chapters.en:
When they had pasture, they became satisfied; when they were satisfied, their hearts became proud,
and as a result they forgot Me.
chapters.zh: 这些民照〔我所赐〕的食物得了饱足； 既得饱足，心就高傲， 忘记了我。

chapters.en: So like a lion I will pounce on them; like a leopard I will lurk by the path.
chapters.zh: 因此，我向他们如狮子， 又如豹伏在道旁。

chapters.en: Like a bear robbed of her cubs I will attack them, and I will tear open their chests. There I will devour them like a lion, like a wild beast tearing them apart.
chapters.zh: 我遇见他们必像丢崽子的母熊， 撕裂他们的胸膛〔注：或译：心膜〕。 在那里，我必像母狮吞吃他们； 野兽必撕裂他们。

chapters.en:
You are destroyed, O Israel, because you are against Me—
against your helper.
chapters.zh: 以色列啊，你与我反对， 就是反对帮助你的，自取败坏。

chapters.en: Where is your king now to save you in all your cities, and the rulers to whom you said, “Give me a king and princes”?
chapters.zh: 你曾求我说： 给我立王和首领。 现在你的王在哪里呢？ 治理你的在哪里呢？ 让他在你所有的城中拯救你吧！

chapters.en: So in My anger I gave you a king, and in My wrath I took him away.
chapters.zh: 我在怒气中将王赐你， 又在烈怒中将王废去。

chapters.en: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is stored up.
chapters.zh: 以法莲的罪孽包裹； 他的罪恶收藏。

chapters.en: Labor pains come upon him, but he is an unwise son. When the time arrives, he fails to present himself at the opening of the womb.
chapters.zh: 产妇的疼痛必临到他身上； 他是无智慧之子， 到了产期不当迟延。

chapters.en:
I will ransom them from the power of Sheol; I will redeem them from Death. Where, O Death, are your plagues? Where, O Sheol, is your sting?
Compassion is hidden from My eyes.
chapters.zh: 我必救赎他们脱离阴间， 救赎他们脱离死亡。 死亡啊，你的灾害在哪里呢？ 阴间哪，你的毁灭在哪里呢？ 在我眼前绝无后悔之事。

chapters.en: Although he flourishes among his brothers, an east wind will come— a wind from the LORD rising up from the desert. His fountain will fail, and his spring will run dry. The wind will plunder his treasury of every precious article.
chapters.zh: 他在弟兄中虽然茂盛， 必有东风刮来， 就是耶和华的风从旷野上来。 他的泉源必干； 他的源头必竭； 仇敌必掳掠他所积蓄的一切宝器。

chapters.en:
Samaria will bear her guilt because she has rebelled against her God. They will fall by the sword; their little ones will be dashed to pieces,
and their pregnant women ripped open.
chapters.zh: 撒马利亚必担当自己的罪， 因为悖逆她的上帝。 她必倒在刀下； 婴孩必被摔死； 孕妇必被剖开。

chapters.en: Return, O Israel, to the LORD your God, for you have stumbled by your iniquity.
chapters.zh: 以色列啊，你要归向耶和华－你的上帝； 你是因自己的罪孽跌倒了。

chapters.en: Bring your confessions and return to the LORD. Say to Him: “Take away all our iniquity and receive us graciously, that we may present the fruit of our lips.
chapters.zh: 当归向耶和华， 用言语祷告他说： 求你除净罪孽，悦纳善行； 这样，我们就把嘴唇〔的〕祭〔代替〕牛犊献上。

chapters.en:
Assyria will not save us, nor will we ride on horses. We will never again say, ‘Our gods!’ to the work of our own hands.
For in You the fatherless find compassion.”
chapters.zh: 我们不向亚述求救， 不骑埃及的马， 也不再对我们手所造的说： 〔你是〕我们的上帝。 因为孤儿在你－〔耶和华〕那里得蒙怜悯。

chapters.en:
I will heal their apostasy; I will freely love them,
for My anger has turned away from them.
chapters.zh: 我必医治他们背道的病， 甘心爱他们； 因为我的怒气向他们转消。

chapters.en:
I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like the lily
and take root like the cedars of Lebanon.
chapters.zh: 我必向以色列如甘露； 他必如百合花开放， 如黎巴嫩〔的树木〕扎根。

chapters.en:
His shoots will sprout, and his splendor will be like the olive tree,
his fragrance like the cedars of Lebanon.
chapters.zh: 他的枝条必延长； 他的荣华如橄榄树； 他的香气如黎巴嫩〔的香柏树〕。

chapters.en:
They will return and dwell in his shade; they will grow grain and blossom like the vine.
His renown will be like the wine of Lebanon.
chapters.zh: 曾住在他荫下的必归回， 发旺如五谷，开花如葡萄树。 他的香气如黎巴嫩的酒。

chapters.en:
O Ephraim, what have I to do anymore with idols? It is I who answer and watch over him. I am like a flourishing cypress;
your fruit comes from Me.
chapters.zh: 以法莲〔必说〕： 我与偶像还有什么关涉呢？ 我－〔耶和华〕回答他，也必顾念他。 我如青翠的松树； 你的果子从我而得。

chapters.en:
Whoever is wise, let him understand these things; whoever is discerning, let him know them. For the ways of the LORD are right, and the righteous walk in them
but the rebellious stumble in them.
chapters.zh: 谁是智慧人？可以明白这些事； 谁是通达人？可以知道这一切。 因为，耶和华的道是正直的； 义人必在其中行走， 罪人却在其上跌倒。

chapters.en: This is the word of the LORD that came to Joel son of Pethuel:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到毗土珥的儿子约珥。

chapters.en: Hear this, O elders; and give ear, all who dwell in the land. Has anything like this ever happened in your days or in the days of your fathers?
chapters.zh: 老年人哪，当听我的话； 国中的居民哪，都要侧耳而听。 在你们的日子， 或你们列祖的日子， 曾有这样的事吗？

chapters.en:
Tell it to your children; let your children tell it to their children,
and their children to the next generation.
chapters.zh: 你们要将这事传与子， 子传与孙， 孙传与后代。

chapters.en: What the devouring locust has left, the swarming locust has eaten; what the swarming locust has left, the young locust has eaten; and what the young locust has left, the destroying locust has eaten.
chapters.zh: 剪虫剩下的，蝗虫来吃； 蝗虫剩下的，蝻子来吃； 蝻子剩下的，蚂蚱来吃。

chapters.en: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep; wail, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine, for it has been cut off from your mouth.
chapters.zh: 酒醉的人哪，要清醒哭泣； 好酒的人哪，都要为甜酒哀号， 因为从你们的口中断绝了。

chapters.en: For a nation has invaded My land, powerful and without number; its teeth are the teeth of a lion, and its fangs are the fangs of a lioness.
chapters.zh: 有一队蝗虫〔注：原文是民〕又强盛又无数， 侵犯我的地； 牠的牙齿如狮子的牙齿， 大牙如母狮的大牙。

chapters.en: It has laid waste My grapevine and splintered My fig tree. It has stripped off the bark and thrown it away; the branches have turned white.
chapters.zh: 牠毁坏我的葡萄树， 剥了我无花果树的皮， 剥尽而丢弃，使枝条露白。

chapters.en: Wail like a virgin dressed in sackcloth, grieving for the husband of her youth.
chapters.zh: 〔我的民哪〕，你当哀号，像处女腰束麻布， 为幼年的丈夫哀号。

chapters.en: Grain and drink offerings have been cut off from the house of the LORD; the priests are in mourning, those who minister before the LORD.
chapters.zh: 素祭和奠祭从耶和华的殿中断绝； 事奉耶和华的祭司都悲哀。

chapters.en: The field is ruined; the land mourns. For the grain is destroyed, the new wine is dried up, and the oil fails.
chapters.zh: 田荒凉，地悲哀； 因为五谷毁坏， 新酒干竭，油也缺乏。

chapters.en: Be dismayed, O farmers, wail, O vinedressers, over the wheat and barley, because the harvest of the field has perished.
chapters.zh: 农夫啊，你们要惭愧； 修理葡萄园的啊，你们要哀号； 因为大麦小麦与田间的庄稼都灭绝了。

chapters.en:
The grapevine is dried up, and the fig tree is withered; the pomegranate, palm, and apple— all the trees of the orchard—are withered.
Surely the joy of mankind has dried up.
chapters.zh: 葡萄树枯干； 无花果树衰残。 石榴树、棕树、苹果树， 连田野一切的树木也都枯干； 众人的喜乐尽都消灭。

chapters.en: Put on sackcloth and lament, O priests; wail, O ministers of the altar. Come, spend the night in sackcloth, O ministers of my God, because the grain and drink offerings are withheld from the house of your God.
chapters.zh: 祭司啊，你们当腰束〔麻布〕痛哭； 伺候祭坛的啊，你们要哀号； 事奉我上帝的啊，你们要来披上麻布过夜， 因为素祭和奠祭从你们上帝的殿中断绝了。

chapters.en: Consecrate a fast; proclaim a solemn assembly! Gather the elders and all the residents of the land to the house of the LORD your God, and cry out to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你们要分定禁食的日子， 宣告严肃会， 招聚长老和国中的一切居民 到耶和华－你们上帝的殿， 向耶和华哀求。

chapters.en: Alas for the day! For the Day of the LORD is near, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.
chapters.zh: 哀哉！耶和华的日子临近了。 这日来到，好像毁灭从全能者来到。

chapters.en: Has not the food been cut off before our very eyes— joy and gladness from the house of our God?
chapters.zh: 粮食不是在我们眼前断绝了吗？ 欢喜快乐不是从我们上帝的殿中止息了吗？

chapters.en: The seeds lie shriveled beneath the clods; the storehouses are in ruins; the granaries are broken down, for the grain has withered away.
chapters.zh: 谷种在土块下朽烂； 仓也荒凉，廪也破坏； 因为五谷枯干了。

chapters.en: How the cattle groan! The herds wander in confusion because they have no pasture. Even the flocks of sheep are suffering.
chapters.zh: 牲畜哀鸣； 牛群混乱，因为无草； 羊群也受了困苦。

chapters.en:
To You, O LORD, I call, for fire has consumed the open pastures
and flames have scorched all the trees of the field.
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我向你求告， 因为火烧灭旷野的草场； 火焰烧尽田野的树木。

chapters.en:
Even the beasts of the field pant for You, for the streams of water have dried up,
and fire has consumed the open pastures.
chapters.zh: 田野的走兽向你发喘； 因为溪水干涸， 火也烧灭旷野的草场。

chapters.en:
Blow the ram’s horn in Zion; sound the alarm on My holy mountain! Let all who dwell in the land tremble, for the Day of the LORD is coming;
indeed, it is near—
chapters.zh: 你们要在锡安吹角， 在我圣山吹出大声。 国中的居民都要发颤； 因为耶和华的日子将到， 已经临近。

chapters.en: a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness. Like the dawn overspreading the mountains a great and strong army appears, such as never was of old, nor will ever be in ages to come.
chapters.zh: 那日是黑暗、幽冥、 密云、乌黑的日子， 好像晨光铺满山岭。 有一队蝗虫〔注：原文是民〕又大又强； 从来没有这样的， 以后直到万代也必没有。

chapters.en:
Before them a fire devours, and behind them a flame scorches. The land before them is like the Garden of Eden, but behind them, it is like a desert wasteland—
surely nothing will escape them.
chapters.zh: 牠们前面如火烧灭， 后面如火焰烧尽。 未到以前，地如伊甸园； 过去以后，成了荒凉的旷野； 没有一样能躲避牠们的。

chapters.en: Their appearance is like that of horses, and they gallop like swift steeds.
chapters.zh: 牠们的形状如马， 奔跑如马兵。

chapters.en: With a sound like that of chariots they bound over the mountaintops, like the crackling of fire consuming stubble, like a mighty army deployed for battle.
chapters.zh: 在山顶蹦跳的响声如车辆的响声， 又如火焰烧碎诩的响声， 好像强盛的民摆阵预备打仗。

chapters.en: Nations writhe in horror before them; every face turns pale.
chapters.zh: 牠们一来，众民伤恸， 脸都变色。

chapters.en: They charge like mighty men; they scale the walls like men of war. Each one marches in formation, not swerving from the course.
chapters.zh: 牠们如勇士奔跑， 像战士爬城； 各都步行，不乱队伍。

chapters.en: They do not jostle one another; each proceeds in his path. They burst through the defenses, never breaking ranks.
chapters.zh: 彼此并不拥挤，向前各行其路， 直闯兵器，不偏左右。

chapters.en: They storm the city; they run along the wall; they climb into houses, entering through windows like thieves.
chapters.zh: 牠们蹦上城，蹿上墙， 爬上房屋， 进入窗户如同盗贼。

chapters.en: Before them the earth quakes; the heavens tremble. The sun and moon grow dark, and the stars lose their brightness.
chapters.zh: 牠们一来， 地震天动， 日月昏暗， 星宿无光。

chapters.en: The LORD raises His voice in the presence of His army. Indeed, His camp is very large, for mighty are those who obey His command. For the Day of the LORD is great and very dreadful. Who can endure it?
chapters.zh: 耶和华在他军旅前发声， 他的队伍甚大； 成就他命的是强盛者。 因为耶和华的日子大而可畏， 谁能当得起呢？

chapters.en: “Yet even now,” declares the LORD, “return to Me with all your heart, with fasting, weeping, and mourning.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：虽然如此， 你们应当禁食、哭泣、悲哀， 一心归向我。

chapters.en:
So rend your hearts and not your garments, and return to the LORD your God. For He is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.
And He relents from sending disaster.
chapters.zh: 你们要撕裂心肠， 不撕裂衣服。 归向耶和华－你们的上帝； 因为他有恩典，有怜悯， 不轻易发怒， 有丰盛的慈爱， 并且后悔不降所说的灾。

chapters.en: Who knows? He may turn and relent and leave a blessing behind Him— grain and drink offerings for the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 或者他转意后悔，留下余福， 就是留下献给耶和华－你们上帝的素祭和奠祭， 也未可知。

chapters.en:
Blow the ram’s horn in Zion, consecrate a fast,
proclaim a sacred assembly.
chapters.zh: 你们要在锡安吹角， 分定禁食的日子， 宣告严肃会。

chapters.en:
Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the aged, gather the children,
even those nursing at the breast. Let the bridegroom leave his room, and the bride her chamber.
chapters.zh: 聚集众民，使会众自洁： 招聚老者， 聚集孩童和吃奶的； 使新郎出离洞房， 新妇出离内室。

chapters.en:
Let the priests who minister before the LORD weep between the portico and the altar, saying, “Spare Your people, O LORD, and do not make Your heritage a reproach,
an object of scorn among the nations. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’”
chapters.zh: 事奉耶和华的祭司 要在廊子和祭坛中间哭泣，说： 耶和华啊，求你顾惜你的百姓， 不要使你的产业受羞辱， 列邦管辖他们。 为何容列国的人说： 「他们的上帝在哪里」呢？

chapters.en: Then the LORD became jealous for His land, and He spared His people.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就为自己的地发热心， 怜恤他的百姓。

chapters.en:
And the LORD answered His people:
“Behold, I will send you grain, new wine, and oil,
and by them you will be satisfied. I will never again make you a reproach among the nations.
chapters.zh: 耶和华应允他的百姓说： 我必赐给你们五谷、新酒，和油， 使你们饱足； 我也不再使你们受列国的羞辱；

chapters.en:
The northern army I will drive away from you, banishing it to a barren and desolate land, its front ranks into the Eastern Sea, and its rear guard into the Western Sea. And its stench will rise; its foul odor will ascend.
For He has done great things.
chapters.zh: 却要使北方来的〔军队〕远离你们， 将他们赶到干旱荒废之地： 前队赶入东海， 后队赶入西海； 因为他们所行的大恶〔注：原文是事〕， 臭气上升，腥味腾空。

chapters.en:
Do not be afraid, O land; rejoice and be glad,
for the LORD has done great things.
chapters.zh: 地土啊，不要惧怕； 要欢喜快乐， 因为耶和华行了大事。

chapters.en: Do not be afraid, O beasts of the field, for the open pastures have turned green, the trees bear their fruit, and the fig tree and vine yield their best.
chapters.zh: 田野的走兽啊，不要惧怕； 因为，旷野的草发生， 树木结果， 无花果树、葡萄树也都效力。

chapters.en: Be glad, O children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God, for He has given you the autumn rains for your vindication. He sends you showers, both autumn and spring rains, as before.
chapters.zh: 锡安的民哪，你们要快乐， 为耶和华－你们的上帝欢喜； 因他赐给你们合宜的秋雨， 为你们降下甘霖， 就是秋雨、春雨，和先前一样。

chapters.en: The threshing floors will be full of grain, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.
chapters.zh: 禾场必满了麦子； 酒醡与油醡必有新酒和油盈溢。

chapters.en: I will repay you for the years eaten by locusts— the swarming locust, the young locust, the destroying locust, and the devouring locust — My great army that I sent against you.
chapters.zh: 我打发到你们中间的大军队， 就是蝗虫、蝻子、蚂蚱、剪虫， 那些年所吃的，我要补还你们。

chapters.en: You will have plenty to eat, until you are satisfied. You will praise the name of the LORD your God, who has worked wonders for you. My people will never again be put to shame.
chapters.zh: 你们必多吃而得饱足， 就赞美为你们行奇妙事之耶和华－你们上帝的名。 我的百姓必永远不致羞愧。

chapters.en:
Then you will know that I am present in Israel and that I am the LORD your God,
and there is no other. My people will never again be put to shame.
chapters.zh: 你们必知道我是在以色列中间， 又知道我是耶和华－你们的上帝； 在我以外并无别神。 我的百姓必永远不致羞愧。

chapters.en: And afterward, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your old men will dream dreams, your young men will see visions.
chapters.zh: 以后，我要将我的灵浇灌凡有血气的。 你们的儿女要说预言； 你们的老年人要做异梦， 少年人要见异象。

chapters.en: Even on My menservants and maidservants, I will pour out My Spirit in those days.
chapters.zh: 在那些日子， 我要将我的灵浇灌我的仆人和使女。

chapters.en: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth, blood and fire and columns of smoke.
chapters.zh: 「在天上地下，我要显出奇事，有血，有火，有烟柱。

chapters.en:
The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood
before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 日头要变为黑暗，月亮要变为血，这都在耶和华大而可畏的日子未到以前。

chapters.en:
And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance, as the LORD has promised,
among the remnant called by the LORD.
chapters.zh: 到那时候，凡求告耶和华名的就必得救；因为照耶和华所说的，在锡安山，耶路撒冷必有逃脱的人，在剩下的人中必有耶和华所召的。」

chapters.en: “Yes, in those days and at that time, when I restore Judah and Jerusalem from captivity,
chapters.zh: 「到那日，我使犹大和耶路撒冷被掳之人归回的时候，

chapters.en: I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will enter into judgment against them concerning My people, My inheritance, Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations as they divided up My land.
chapters.zh: 我要聚集万民，带他们下到约沙法谷，在那里施行审判；因为他们将我的百姓，就是我的产业以色列，分散在列国中，又分取我的地土，

chapters.en:
They cast lots for My people; they bartered a boy for a prostitute
and sold a girl for wine to drink.
chapters.zh: 且为我的百姓拈鬮，将童子换妓女，卖童女买酒喝。

chapters.en: Now what do you have against Me, O Tyre, Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Are you rendering against Me a recompense? If you retaliate against Me, I will swiftly and speedily return your recompense upon your heads.
chapters.zh: 「泰尔、西顿，和非利士四境的人哪，你们与我何干？你们要报复我吗？若报复我，我必使报应速速归到你们的头上。

chapters.en: For you took My silver and gold and carried off My finest treasures to your temples.
chapters.zh: 你们既然夺取我的金银，又将我可爱的宝物带入你们宫殿〔注：或译：庙中〕，

chapters.en: You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, to send them far from their homeland.
chapters.zh: 并将犹大人和耶路撒冷人卖给希腊人〔注：原文是雅完人〕，使他们远离自己的境界。

chapters.en: Behold, I will rouse them from the places to which you sold them; I will return your recompense upon your heads.
chapters.zh: 我必激动他们离开你们所卖到之地，又必使报应归到你们的头上。

chapters.en:
I will sell your sons and daughters into the hands of the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans—to a distant nation.”
Indeed, the LORD has spoken.
chapters.zh: 我必将你们的儿女卖在犹大人的手中，他们必卖给远方示巴国的人。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en:
Proclaim this among the nations:
“Prepare for war; rouse the mighty men; let all the men of war advance and attack!
chapters.zh: 当在万民中宣告说： 要预备打仗； 激动勇士， 使一切战士上前来。

chapters.en:
Beat your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears.
Let the weak say, ‘I am strong!’
chapters.zh: 要将诓头打成刀剑， 将镰刀打成戈矛； 软弱的要说：我有勇力。

chapters.en: Come quickly, all you surrounding nations, and gather yourselves. Bring down Your mighty ones, O LORD.
chapters.zh: 四围的列国啊， 你们要速速地来， 一同聚集。 耶和华啊， 求你使你的大能者降临。

chapters.en: Let the nations be roused and advance to the Valley of Jehoshaphat, for there I will sit down to judge all the nations on every side.
chapters.zh: 万民都当兴起， 上到约沙法谷； 因为我必坐在那里， 审判四围的列国。

chapters.en: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full; the wine vats overflow because their wickedness is great.
chapters.zh: 开镰吧！因为庄稼熟了； 践踏吧！因为酒醡满了。 酒池盈溢； 他们的罪恶甚大。

chapters.en: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the Day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
chapters.zh: 许多许多的人在断定谷， 因为耶和华的日子临近断定谷。

chapters.en: The sun and moon will grow dark, and the stars will no longer shine.
chapters.zh: 日月昏暗， 星宿无光。

chapters.en:
The LORD will roar from Zion and raise His voice from Jerusalem;
heaven and earth will tremble. But the LORD will be a refuge for His people, a stronghold for the people of Israel.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必从锡安吼叫， 从耶路撒冷发声， 天地就震动。 耶和华却要作他百姓的避难所， 作以色列人的保障。

chapters.en: Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who dwells in Zion, My holy mountain. Jerusalem will be holy, never again to be overrun by foreigners.
chapters.zh: 你们就知道我是耶和华－你们的上帝， 且又住在锡安－我的圣山。 那时，耶路撒冷必成为圣； 外邦人不再从其中经过。

chapters.en:
And in that day the mountains will drip with sweet wine, and the hills will flow with milk. All the streams of Judah will run with water, and a spring will flow from the house of the LORD
to water the Valley of Acacias.
chapters.zh: 到那日，大山要滴甜酒； 小山要流奶子； 犹大溪河都有水流。 必有泉源从耶和华的殿中流出来， 滋润什亭谷。

chapters.en: Egypt will become desolate, and Edom a desert wasteland, because of the violence done to the people of Judah, in whose land they shed innocent blood.
chapters.zh: 埃及必然荒凉， 以东变为悽凉的旷野， 都因向犹大人所行的强暴， 又因在本地流无辜人的血。

chapters.en: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
chapters.zh: 但犹大必存到永远； 耶路撒冷必存到万代。

chapters.en: For I will avenge their blood, which I have not yet avenged. ” For the LORD dwells in Zion.
chapters.zh: 我未曾报复〔注：或译：洗除；下同〕流血的罪， 现在我要报复， 因为耶和华住在锡安。

chapters.en: These are the words of Amos, who was among the sheepherders of Tekoa—what he saw concerning Israel two years before the earthquake, in the days when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel.
chapters.zh: 当犹大王乌西雅，以色列王约阿施的儿子耶罗波安在位的时候，大地震前二年，提哥亚牧人中的阿摩司得默示论以色列。

chapters.en:
He said:
“The LORD roars from Zion and raises His voice from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds mourn, and the summit of Carmel withers.”
chapters.zh: 他说：耶和华必从锡安吼叫， 从耶路撒冷发声； 牧人的草场要悲哀； 迦密的山顶要枯干。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“For three transgressions of Damascus, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they threshed Gilead with sledges of iron.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 大马士革三番四次地犯罪， 我必不免去她的刑罚； 因为她以打粮食的铁器打过基列。

chapters.en: So I will send fire upon the house of Hazael to consume the citadels of Ben-hadad.
chapters.zh: 我却要降火在哈薛的家中， 烧灭便‧哈达的宫殿。

chapters.en: I will break down the gates of Damascus; I will cut off the ruler from the Valley of Aven and the one who wields the scepter in Beth-eden. The people of Aram will be exiled to Kir,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必折断大马士革的门闩， 剪除亚文平原的居民和伯‧伊甸掌权的。 亚兰人必被掳到吉珥。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“For three transgressions of Gaza, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they exiled a whole population, delivering them up to Edom.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 迦萨三番四次地犯罪， 我必不免去她的刑罚； 因为她掳掠众民交给以东。

chapters.en: So I will send fire upon the walls of Gaza, to consume its citadels.
chapters.zh: 我却要降火在迦萨的城内， 烧灭其中的宫殿。

chapters.en: I will cut off the ruler of Ashdod and the one who wields the scepter in Ashkelon. I will turn My hand against Ekron, and the remnant of the Philistines will perish,” says the Lord GOD.
chapters.zh: 我必剪除亚实突的居民和亚实基伦掌权的， 也必反手攻击以革伦。 非利士人所余剩的必都灭亡。 这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“For three transgressions of Tyre, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they delivered up a whole congregation of exiles to Edom and broke a covenant of brotherhood.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 泰尔三番四次地犯罪， 我必不免去她的刑罚； 因为她将众民交给以东， 并不记念弟兄的盟约。

chapters.en: So I will send fire upon the walls of Tyre to consume its citadels.”
chapters.zh: 我却要降火在泰尔的城内， 烧灭其中的宫殿。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“For three transgressions of Edom, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because he pursued his brother with the sword and stifled all compassion; his anger raged continually, and his fury flamed incessantly.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 以东三番四次地犯罪， 我必不免去她的刑罚； 因为她拿刀追赶兄弟，毫无怜悯， 发怒撕裂，永怀忿怒。

chapters.en: So I will send fire upon Teman to consume the citadels of Bozrah.”
chapters.zh: 我却要降火在提幔， 烧灭波斯拉的宫殿。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“For three transgressions of the Ammonites, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead in order to enlarge their territory.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 亚扪人三番四次地犯罪， 我必不免去他们的刑罚； 因为他们剖开基列的孕妇， 扩张自己的境界。

chapters.en: So I will kindle a fire in the walls of Rabbah to consume its citadels amid war cries on the day of battle and a violent wind on the day of tempest.
chapters.zh: 我却要在争战吶喊的日子， 旋风狂暴的时候， 点火在拉巴的城内， 烧灭其中的宫殿。

chapters.en: Their king will go into exile — he and his princes together,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 他们的王和首领必一同被掳去。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Moab, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because he burned to lime the bones of Edom’s king.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 摩押三番四次地犯罪， 我必不免去她的刑罚； 因为她将以东王的骸骨焚烧成灰。

chapters.en: So I will send fire against Moab to consume the citadels of Kerioth. Moab will die in tumult, amid war cries and the sound of the ram’s horn.
chapters.zh: 我却要降火在摩押， 烧灭加略的宫殿。 摩押必在鬨嚷吶喊吹角之中死亡。

chapters.en: I will cut off the ruler of Moab and kill all the officials with him,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必剪除摩押中的审判者， 将其中的一切首领和他一同杀戮。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“For three transgressions of Judah, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they reject the Law of the LORD and fail to keep His statutes; they are led astray by the lies in which their fathers walked.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 犹大人三番四次地犯罪， 我必不免去他们的刑罚； 因为他们厌弃耶和华的训诲， 不遵守他的律例。 他们列祖所随从虚假的〔偶像〕使他们走迷了。

chapters.en: So I will send fire upon Judah to consume the citadels of Jerusalem.”
chapters.zh: 我却要降火在犹大， 烧灭耶路撒冷的宫殿。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“For three transgressions of Israel, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they sell the righteous for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 以色列人三番四次地犯罪， 我必不免去他们的刑罚； 因他们为银子卖了义人， 为一双鞋卖了穷人。
他们见穷人头上所蒙的灰也都垂涎， 阻碍谦卑人的道路。 父子同一个女子行淫， 亵渎我的圣名。

chapters.en: They lie down beside every altar on garments taken in pledge. And in the house of their God, they drink wine obtained through fines.
chapters.zh: 他们在各坛旁铺人所当的衣服，卧在其上， 又在他们神的庙中喝受罚之人的酒。

chapters.en: Yet it was I who destroyed the Amorite before them, though his height was like that of the cedars, and he was as strong as the oaks. Yet I destroyed his fruit above and his roots below.
chapters.zh: 我从以色列人面前除灭亚摩利人。 他虽高大如香柏树，坚固如橡树， 我却上灭他的果子，下绝他的根本。

chapters.en: And I brought you up from the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness, that you might take possession of the land of the Amorite.
chapters.zh: 我也将你们从埃及地领上来， 在旷野引导你们四十年， 使你们得亚摩利人之地为业。

chapters.en: I raised up prophets from your sons and Nazirites from your young men. Is this not true, O children of Israel?” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我从你们子弟中兴起先知， 又从你们少年人中兴起拿细耳人。 以色列人哪，不是这样吗？ 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “But you made the Nazirites drink wine and commanded the prophets not to prophesy.
chapters.zh: 你们却给拿细耳人酒喝， 嘱咐先知说：不要说预言。

chapters.en: Behold, I am about to crush you in your place as with a cart full of grain.
chapters.zh: 看哪，在你们所住之地，我必压〔你们〕， 如同装满禾捆的车压〔物〕一样。

chapters.en:
Escape will fail the swift, the strong will not prevail by his strength,
and the mighty will not save his life.
chapters.zh: 快跑的不能逃脱； 有力的不能用力； 刚勇的也不能自救。

chapters.en:
The archer will not stand his ground, the fleet of foot will not escape,
and the horseman will not save his life.
chapters.zh: 拿弓的不能站立； 腿快的不能逃脱； 骑马的也不能自救。

chapters.en: Even the bravest of mighty men will flee naked on that day,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 到那日，勇士中最有胆量的， 必赤身逃跑。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family that I brought up out of the land of Egypt:
chapters.zh: 以色列人哪，你们全家是我从埃及地领上来的，当听耶和华攻击你们的话：

chapters.en: “Only you have I known from all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.”
chapters.zh: 在地上万族中，我只认识你们； 因此，我必追讨你们的一切罪孽。

chapters.en: Can two walk together without agreeing where to go?
chapters.zh: 二人若不同心，岂能同行呢？

chapters.en: Does a lion roar in the forest when he has no prey? Does a young lion growl in his den if he has caught nothing?
chapters.zh: 狮子若非抓食，岂能在林中咆哮呢？ 少壮狮子若无所得，岂能从洞中发声呢？

chapters.en: Does a bird land in a snare where no bait has been set? Does a trap spring from the ground when it has nothing to catch?
chapters.zh: 若没有机槛，雀鸟岂能陷在网罗里呢？ 网罗若无所得，岂能从地上翻起呢？

chapters.en: If a ram’s horn sounds in a city, do the people not tremble? If calamity comes to a city, has not the LORD caused it?
chapters.zh: 城中若吹角，百姓岂不惊恐呢？ 灾祸若临到一城，岂非耶和华所降的吗？

chapters.en:
Surely the Lord GOD does nothing without revealing His plan
to His servants the prophets.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华若不将奥祕指示他的仆人－众先知， 就一无所行。

chapters.en: The lion has roared— who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken— who will not prophesy?
chapters.zh: 狮子吼叫，谁不惧怕呢？ 主耶和华发命，谁能不说预言呢？

chapters.en:
Proclaim to the citadels of Ashdod and to the citadels of Egypt: “Assemble on the mountains of Samaria; see the great unrest in the city
and the acts of oppression in her midst.”
chapters.zh: 要在亚实突的宫殿中 和埃及地的宫殿里传扬说： 你们要聚集在撒马利亚的山上， 就看见城中有何等大的扰乱与欺压的事。

chapters.en: “For they know not how to do right,” declares the LORD. “They store up violence and destruction in their citadels.”
chapters.zh: 那些以强暴抢夺财物、 积蓄在自己家中的人 不知道行正直的事。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says:
“An enemy will surround the land; he will pull down your strongholds
and plunder your citadels.”
chapters.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说： 敌人必来围攻这地， 使你的势力衰微， 抢掠你的家宅。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“As the shepherd snatches from the mouth of the lion two legs or a piece of an ear, so the Israelites dwelling in Samaria will be rescued having just the corner of a bed
or the cushion of a couch.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：「牧人怎样从狮子口中抢回两条〔羊〕腿或半个耳朵，住撒马利亚的以色列人躺卧在床角上或铺绣花毯的榻上，他们得救也不过如此。」

chapters.en: Hear and testify against the house of Jacob, declares the Lord GOD, the God of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华－万军之上帝说： 当听这话，警戒雅各家。

chapters.en: On the day I punish Israel for their transgressions, I will visit destruction on the altars of Bethel; the horns of the altar will be cut off, and they will fall to the ground.
chapters.zh: 我讨以色列罪的日子，也要讨伯特利祭坛的罪； 坛角必被砍下，坠落于地。

chapters.en: I will tear down the winter house along with the summer house; the houses of ivory will also perish, and the great houses will come to an end,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我要拆毁过冬和过夏的房屋。 象牙的房屋也必毁灭； 高大的房屋都归无有。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Hear this word, you cows of Bashan on Mount Samaria, you women who oppress the poor and crush the needy, who say to your husbands, “Bring us more to drink.”
chapters.zh: 你们住撒马利亚山如巴珊母牛的啊， 当听我的话－ 你们欺负贫寒的，压碎穷乏的， 对家主说：拿〔酒〕来，我们喝吧！

chapters.en:
The Lord GOD has sworn by His holiness:
“Behold, the days are coming when you will be taken away with hooks,
and your posterity with fishhooks.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华指着自己的圣洁起誓说： 日子快到，人必用钩子将你们钩去， 用鱼钩将你们余剩的钩去。

chapters.en:
You will go out through broken walls, each one straight ahead of her,
and you will be cast out toward Harmon, ” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你们各人必从破口直往前行， 投入哈门。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Go to Bethel and transgress; rebel even more at Gilgal! Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three days.
chapters.zh: 以色列人哪，任你们往伯特利去犯罪， 到吉甲加增罪过； 每日早晨献上你们的祭物， 每三日奉上你们的十分之一。

chapters.en:
Offer leavened bread as a thank offering, and loudly proclaim your freewill offerings.
For that is what you children of Israel love to do,” declares the Lord GOD.
chapters.zh: 任你们献有酵的感谢祭， 把甘心祭宣传报告给众人， 因为是你们所喜爱的。 这是主耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
“I afflicted all your cities with cleanness of teeth and all your towns with lack of bread,
yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我使你们在一切城中牙齿干净， 在你们各处粮食缺乏， 你们仍不归向我。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “I also withheld the rain from you when the harvest was three months away. I sent rain on one city but withheld it from another. One field received rain; another without rain withered.
chapters.zh: 在收割的前三月，我使雨停止， 不降在你们那里； 我降雨在这城， 不降雨在那城； 这块地有雨， 那块地无雨； 无雨的就枯干了。

chapters.en: People staggered from city to city for water to drink, but they were not satisfied; yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 这样，两三城的人凑到一城去找水， 却喝不足； 你们仍不归向我。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “I struck you with blight and mildew in your growing gardens and vineyards; the locust devoured your fig and olive trees, yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我以旱〔风〕、霉烂攻击你们， 你们园中许多菜蔬、葡萄树、 无花果树、橄榄树都被剪虫所吃； 你们仍不归向我。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “I sent plagues among you like those of Egypt; I killed your young men with the sword, along with your captured horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camp, yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我降瘟疫在你们中间， 像在埃及一样； 用刀杀戮你们的少年人， 使你们的马匹被掳掠， 营中〔尸首〕的臭气扑鼻； 你们仍不归向我。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Some of you I overthrew as I overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a firebrand snatched from a blaze, yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我倾覆你们中间的〔城邑〕， 如同我从前倾覆所多玛、蛾摩拉一样， 使你们好像从火中抽出来的一根柴； 你们仍不归向我。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Therefore, that is what I will do to you, O Israel, and since I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, O Israel!
chapters.zh: 以色列啊，我必向你如此行； 以色列啊，我既这样行， 你当预备迎见你的上帝。

chapters.en:
For behold, He who forms the mountains, who creates the wind
and reveals His thoughts to man, who turns the dawn to darkness and strides on the heights of the earth—
the LORD, the God of Hosts, is His name.”
chapters.zh: 那创山、造风、将心意指示人、 使晨光变为幽暗、脚踏在地之高处的， 他的名是耶和华－万军之上帝。

chapters.en: Hear this word, O house of Israel, this lamentation I take up against you:
chapters.zh: 以色列家啊，要听我为你们所作的哀歌：

chapters.en: “Fallen is Virgin Israel, never to rise again. She lies abandoned on her land, with no one to raise her up.”
chapters.zh: 以色列民〔注：原文是处女〕跌倒，不得再起； 躺在地上，无人搀扶。

chapters.en:
This is what the Lord GOD says:
“The city that marches out a thousand strong will have but a hundred left, and the one that marches out a hundred strong will have but ten left in the house of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 主耶和华如此说： 以色列家的城发出一千〔兵〕的，只剩一百； 发出一百的，只剩十个。

chapters.en:
For this is what the LORD says to the house of Israel:
“Seek Me and live!
chapters.zh: 耶和华向以色列家如此说： 你们要寻求我，就必存活。

chapters.en: Do not seek Bethel or go to Gilgal; do not journey to Beersheba, for Gilgal will surely go into exile, and Bethel will come to nothing.
chapters.zh: 不要往伯特利寻求， 不要进入吉甲， 不要过到别是巴； 因为吉甲必被掳掠， 伯特利也必归于无有。

chapters.en: Seek the LORD and live, or He will sweep like fire through the house of Joseph; it will devour everything, with no one at Bethel to extinguish it.
chapters.zh: 要寻求耶和华，就必存活， 免得他在约瑟家像火发出， 在伯特利焚烧，无人扑灭。

chapters.en: There are those who turn justice into wormwood and cast righteousness to the ground.
chapters.zh: 你们这使公平变为茵蔯、 将公义丢弃于地的，

chapters.en:
He who made the Pleiades and Orion, who turns darkness into dawn
and darkens day into night, who summons the waters of the sea and pours them over the face of the earth—
the LORD is His name—
chapters.zh: 要〔寻求〕那造昴星和参星， 使死荫变为晨光， 使白日变为黑夜， 命海水来浇在地上的－ 耶和华是他的名；

chapters.en: He flashes destruction on the strong, so that fury comes upon the stronghold.
chapters.zh: 他使力强的忽遭灭亡， 以致保障遭遇毁坏。

chapters.en: There are those who hate the one who reproves in the gate and despise him who speaks with integrity.
chapters.zh: 你们怨恨那在城门口责备人的， 憎恶那说正直话的。

chapters.en: Therefore, because you trample on the poor and exact from him a tax of grain, you will never live in the stone houses you have built; you will never drink the wine from the lush vineyards you have planted.
chapters.zh: 你们践踏贫民， 向他们勒索麦子； 你们用凿过的石头建造房屋， 却不得住在其内； 栽种美好的葡萄园， 却不得喝所出的酒。

chapters.en: For I know that your transgressions are many and your sins are numerous. You oppress the righteous by taking bribes; you deprive the poor of justice in the gate.
chapters.zh: 我知道你们的罪过何等多， 你们的罪恶何等大。 你们苦待义人，收受贿赂，在城门口屈枉穷乏人。

chapters.en: Therefore, the prudent keep silent in such times, for the days are evil.
chapters.zh: 所以通达人见这样的时势必静默不言， 因为时势真恶。

chapters.en: Seek good, not evil, so that you may live. And the LORD, the God of Hosts, will be with you, as you have claimed.
chapters.zh: 你们要求善， 不要求恶，就必存活。 这样，耶和华－万军之上帝 必照你们所说的与你们同在。

chapters.en: Hate evil and love good; establish justice in the gate. Perhaps the LORD, the God of Hosts, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.”
chapters.zh: 要恶恶好善， 在城门口秉公行义； 或者耶和华－万军之上帝向约瑟的余民施恩。

chapters.en:
Therefore this is what the LORD, the God of Hosts, the Lord, says:
“There will be wailing in all the public squares and cries of ‘Alas! Alas!’ in all the streets. The farmer will be summoned to mourn, and the mourners to wail.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华－万军之上帝如此说： 在一切宽阔处必有哀号的声音； 在各街市上必有人说： 哀哉！哀哉！ 又必叫农夫来哭号， 叫善唱哀歌的来举哀。

chapters.en: There will be wailing in all the vineyards, for I will pass through your midst,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 在各葡萄园必有哀号的声音， 因为我必从你中间经过。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
Woe to you who long for the Day of the LORD! What will the Day of the LORD be for you?
It will be darkness and not light.
chapters.zh: 想望耶和华日子来到的有祸了！ 你们为何想望耶和华的日子呢？ 那日黑暗没有光明，

chapters.en: It will be like a man who flees from a lion, only to encounter a bear, or who enters his house and rests his hand against the wall, only to be bitten by a snake.
chapters.zh: 景况好像人躲避狮子又遇见熊， 或是进房屋以手靠墙，就被蛇咬。

chapters.en:
