Will not the Day of the LORD be darkness and not light,
even gloom with no brightness in it?
chapters.zh: 耶和华的日子不是黑暗没有光明吗？ 不是幽暗毫无光辉吗？

chapters.en: “I hate, I despise your feasts! I cannot stand the stench of your solemn assemblies.
chapters.zh: 我厌恶你们的节期， 也不喜悦你们的严肃会。

chapters.en: Even though you offer Me burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them; for your peace offerings of fattened cattle I will have no regard.
chapters.zh: 你们虽然向我献燔祭和素祭， 我却不悦纳， 也不顾你们用肥畜献的平安祭；

chapters.en: Take away from Me the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.
chapters.zh: 要使你们歌唱的声音远离我， 因为我不听你们弹琴的响声。

chapters.en: But let justice roll on like a river, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.
chapters.zh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚， 使公义如江河滔滔。

chapters.en: Did you bring Me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
chapters.zh: 「以色列家啊，你们在旷野四十年，岂是将祭物和供物献给我呢？

chapters.en:
You have taken along Sakkuth your king and Kaiwan your star god,
the idols you made for yourselves.
chapters.zh: 你们抬着为自己所造之摩洛的帐幕和偶像的龛，并你们的神星。

chapters.en: Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Damascus,” says the LORD, whose name is the God of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 所以我要把你们掳到大马士革以外。」这是耶和华－名为万军之上帝说的。

chapters.en: Woe to those at ease in Zion and those secure on Mount Samaria, the distinguished ones of the foremost nation, to whom the house of Israel comes.
chapters.zh: 国为列国之首，人最著名， 且为以色列家所归向， 在锡安和撒马利亚山安逸无虑的，有祸了！

chapters.en:
Cross over to Calneh and see; go from there to the great Hamath;
then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Are you better than these kingdoms? Is their territory larger than yours?
chapters.zh: 你们要过到甲尼察看， 从那里往大〔城〕哈马去， 又下到非利士人的迦特， 看那些国比你们的国还强吗？ 境界比你们的境界还宽吗？

chapters.en: You dismiss the day of calamity and bring near a reign of violence.
chapters.zh: 你们以为降祸的日子还远， 坐在位上尽行强暴〔注：或译：行强暴使审判临近〕。

chapters.en: You lie on beds inlaid with ivory, and lounge upon your couches. You dine on lambs from the flock and calves from the stall.
chapters.zh: 你们躺卧在象牙床上，舒身在榻上， 吃群中的羊羔，棚里的牛犊；

chapters.en: You improvise songs on the harp like David and invent your own musical instruments.
chapters.zh: 弹琴鼓瑟唱消闲的歌曲， 为自己制造乐器，如同大卫〔所造〕的；

chapters.en: You drink wine by the bowlful and anoint yourselves with the finest oils, but you fail to grieve over the ruin of Joseph.
chapters.zh: 以大碗喝酒，用上等的油抹身， 却不为约瑟的苦难担忧。

chapters.en: Therefore, you will now go into exile as the first of the captives, and your feasting and lounging will come to an end.
chapters.zh: 所以这些人必在被掳的人中首先被掳； 舒身的人荒宴之乐必消灭了。

chapters.en:
The Lord GOD has sworn by Himself—the LORD, the God of Hosts, has declared:
“I abhor Jacob’s pride and detest his citadels, so I will deliver up the city and everything in it.”
chapters.zh: 主耶和华－万军之上帝指着自己起誓说： 我憎恶雅各的荣华，厌弃他的宫殿； 因此，我必将城和其中所有的都交付〔敌人〕。

chapters.en: And if there are ten men left in one house, they too will die.
chapters.zh: 那时，若在一房之内剩下十个人，也都必死。

chapters.en:
And when the relative who is to burn the bodies picks them up to remove them from the house, he will call to one inside, “Is anyone else with you?”
“None,” that person will answer.
“Silence,” the relative will retort, “for the name of the LORD must not be invoked.”
chapters.zh: 死人的伯叔，就是烧他尸首的，要将这尸首搬到房外，问房屋内间的人说：「你那里还有人没有？」他必说：「没有」；又说：「不要作声，因为我们不可提耶和华的名。」

chapters.en:
For the LORD gives a command:
“The great house will be smashed to pieces, and the small house to rubble.”
chapters.zh: 看哪，耶和华出令， 大房就被攻破， 小屋就被打裂。

chapters.en: “Do horses gallop on the cliffs? Does one plow the sea with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison and the fruit of righteousness into wormwood—
chapters.zh: 马岂能在崖石上奔跑？ 人岂能〔在那里〕用牛耕种呢？ 你们却使公平变为苦胆， 使公义的果子变为茵蔯。

chapters.en: you who rejoice in Lo-debar and say, ‘Did we not take Karnaim by our own strength?’
chapters.zh: 你们喜爱虚浮的事，〔自夸〕说： 我们不是凭自己的力量取了角吗？

chapters.en: For behold, I will raise up a nation against you, O house of Israel,” declares the LORD, the God of Hosts, “and they will oppress you from Lebo-hamath to the Brook of the Arabah.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华、万军之上帝说： 以色列家啊，我必兴起一国攻击你们； 他们必欺压你们， 从哈马口直到亚拉巴的河。

chapters.en: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: He was preparing swarms of locusts just after the king’s harvest, as the late spring crop was coming up.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华指示我一件事：为王割菜〔注：或译：草〕之后，菜又发生；刚发生的时候，主造蝗虫。

chapters.en: And when the locusts had eaten every green plant in the land, I said, “Lord GOD, please forgive! How will Jacob survive, since he is so small?”
chapters.zh: 蝗虫吃尽那地的青物，我就说：「主耶和华啊，求你赦免；因为雅各微弱，他怎能站立得住呢？」

chapters.en: So the LORD relented from this plan. “It will not happen,” He said.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就后悔说：「这灾可以免了。」

chapters.en: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: The Lord GOD was calling for judgment by fire. It consumed the great deep and devoured the land.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华又指示我一件事：他命火来惩罚以色列，火就吞灭深渊，险些将地烧灭。

chapters.en: Then I said, “Lord GOD, please stop! How will Jacob survive, since he is so small?”
chapters.zh: 我就说：「主耶和华啊，求你止息；因为雅各微弱，他怎能站立得住呢？」

chapters.en: So the LORD relented from this plan. “It will not happen either,” said the Lord GOD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就后悔说：「这灾也可免了。」

chapters.en: This is what He showed me: Behold, the Lord was standing by a wall true to plumb, with a plumb line in His hand.
chapters.zh: 他又指示我一件事：有一道墙是按准绳建筑的，主手拿准绳站在其上。

chapters.en:
“Amos, what do you see?” asked the LORD.
“A plumb line,” I replied.
“Behold,” said the Lord, “I am setting a plumb line among My people Israel; I will no longer spare them:
chapters.zh: 耶和华对我说：「阿摩司啊，你看见什么？」我说：「看见准绳。」主说：「我要吊起准绳在我民以色列中，我必不再宽恕他们。

chapters.en: The high places of Isaac will be deserted, and the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste; and I will rise up against the house of Jeroboam with My sword.”
chapters.zh: 以撒的邱坛必然凄凉；以色列的圣所必然荒废。我必兴起，用刀攻击耶罗波安的家。」

chapters.en: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent word to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, “Amos has conspired against you in the midst of the house of Israel. The land cannot bear all his words,
chapters.zh: 伯特利的祭司亚玛谢打发人到以色列王耶罗波安那里，说：「阿摩司在以色列家中图谋背叛你；他所说的一切话，这国担当不起；
因为阿摩司如此说：『耶罗波安必被刀杀；以色列民定被掳去离开本地。』」

chapters.en: And Amaziah said to Amos, “Go away, you seer! Flee to the land of Judah; earn your bread there and do your prophesying there.
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢又对阿摩司说：「你这先见哪，要逃往犹大地去，在那里糊口，在那里说预言，

chapters.en: But never prophesy at Bethel again, because it is the sanctuary of the king and the temple of the kingdom.”
chapters.zh: 却不要在伯特利再说预言；因为这里有王的圣所，有王的宫殿。」

chapters.en: “I was not a prophet,” Amos replied, “nor was I the son of a prophet; rather, I was a herdsman and a tender of sycamore-fig trees.
chapters.zh: 阿摩司对亚玛谢说：「我原不是先知，也不是先知的门徒〔注：原文是儿子〕。我是牧人，又是修理桑树的。

chapters.en: But the LORD took me from following the flock and said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to My people Israel.’
chapters.zh: 耶和华选召我，使我不跟从羊群，对我说：『你去向我民以色列说预言。』

chapters.en:
Now, therefore, hear the word of the LORD. You say:
‘Do not prophesy against Israel; do not preach against the house of Isaac.’
chapters.zh: 亚玛谢啊，现在你要听耶和华的话。你说：『不要向以色列说预言，也不要向以撒家滴下〔预言〕。』

chapters.en:
Therefore this is what the LORD says:
‘Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, and your sons and daughters will fall by the sword. Your land will be divided by a measuring line, and you yourself will die on pagan soil. And Israel will surely go into exile, away from their homeland.’”
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华如此说：『你的妻子必在城中作妓女；你的儿女必倒在刀下。你的地必有人用绳子量了分取；你自己必死在污秽之地。以色列民定被掳去离开本地。』」

chapters.en: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: I saw a basket of summer fruit.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华又指示我一件事：我看见一筐夏天的果子。

chapters.en:
“Amos, what do you see?” He asked.
“A basket of summer fruit,” I replied.
So the LORD said to me, “The end has come for My people Israel; I will no longer spare them.”
chapters.zh: 他说：「阿摩司啊，你看见什么？」我说：「看见一筐夏天的果子。」耶和华说：「我民以色列的结局到了，我必不再宽恕他们。」

chapters.en: “In that day,” declares the Lord GOD, “the songs of the temple will turn to wailing. Many will be the corpses, strewn in silence everywhere!”
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说：「那日，殿中的诗歌变为哀号；必有许多尸首在各处抛弃，无人作声。」

chapters.en: Hear this, you who trample the needy, who do away with the poor of the land,
chapters.zh: 你们这些要吞吃穷乏人、 使困苦人衰败的，当听我的话！

chapters.en: asking, “When will the New Moon be over, that we may sell grain? When will the Sabbath end, that we may market wheat? Let us reduce the ephah and increase the shekel; let us cheat with dishonest scales.
chapters.zh: 你们说：月朔几时过去， 我们好卖粮； 安息日几时过去， 我们好摆开麦子； 〔卖出〕用小升斗， 〔收银〕用大戥子， 用诡诈的天平欺哄人，

chapters.en:
Let us buy the poor with silver and the needy for a pair of sandals,
selling even the chaff with the wheat!”
chapters.zh: 好用银子买贫寒人， 用一双鞋换穷乏人， 将坏了的麦子卖给人。

chapters.en:
The LORD has sworn by the Pride of Jacob:
“I will never forget any of their deeds.
chapters.zh: 耶和华指着雅各的荣耀起誓说： 他们的一切行为，我必永远不忘。

chapters.en:
Will not the land quake for this, and all its dwellers mourn? All of it will swell like the Nile; it will surge and then subside
like the Nile in Egypt.
chapters.zh: 地岂不因这事震动？ 其上的居民不也悲哀吗？ 地必全然像尼罗河涨起， 如同埃及河涌上落下。

chapters.en: And in that day, declares the Lord GOD, I will make the sun go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the daytime.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说：到那日， 我必使日头在午间落下， 使地在白昼黑暗。

chapters.en: I will turn your feasts into mourning and all your songs into lamentation. I will cause everyone to wear sackcloth and every head to be shaved. I will make it like a time of mourning for an only son, and its outcome like a bitter day.
chapters.zh: 我必使你们的节期变为悲哀， 歌曲变为哀歌。 众人腰束麻布，头上光秃， 使这场悲哀如丧独生子， 至终如痛苦的日子一样。

chapters.en:
Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord GOD,
when I will send a famine on the land— not a famine of bread or a thirst for water, but a famine of hearing the words of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华说：日子将到， 我必命饥荒降在地上。 人饥饿非因无饼，干渴非因无水， 乃因不听耶和华的话。

chapters.en: People will stagger from sea to sea and roam from north to east, seeking the word of the LORD, but they will not find it.
chapters.zh: 他们必飘流，从这海到那海， 从北边到东边，往来奔跑， 寻求耶和华的话，却寻不着。

chapters.en:
In that day the lovely young women— the young men as well—
will faint from thirst.
chapters.zh: 当那日，美貌的处女 和少年的男子必因干渴发昏。

chapters.en: Those who swear by the guilt of Samaria and say, ‘As surely as your god lives, O Dan,’ or, ‘As surely as the way of Beersheba lives’— they will fall, never to rise again.”
chapters.zh: 那指着撒马利亚牛犊〔注：原文是罪〕起誓的说： 但哪，我们指着你那里的活神起誓； 又说：我们指着别是巴的神道〔注：神：原文是活〕起誓。 这些人都必仆倒，永不再起来。

chapters.en:
I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and He said:
“Strike the tops of the pillars so that the thresholds shake. Topple them on the heads of all the people, and I will kill the rest with the sword. None of those who flee will get away; none of the fugitives will escape.
chapters.zh: 我看见主站在祭坛旁边； 他说：你要击打柱顶，使门槛震动， 打碎柱顶，落在众人头上； 所剩下的人，我必用刀杀戮， 无一人能逃避，无一人能逃脱。

chapters.en: Though they dig down to Sheol, from there My hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, from there I will pull them down.
chapters.zh: 他们虽然挖透阴间， 我的手必取出他们来； 虽然爬上天去， 我必拿下他们来；

chapters.en: Though they hide themselves atop Carmel, there I will track them and seize them; and though they hide from Me at the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent to bite them.
chapters.zh: 虽然藏在迦密山顶， 我必搜寻，捉出他们来； 虽然从我眼前藏在海底， 我必命蛇咬他们；

chapters.en: Though they are driven by their enemies into captivity, there I will command the sword to slay them. I will fix My eyes upon them for harm and not for good.”
chapters.zh: 虽被仇敌掳去， 我必命刀剑杀戮他们； 我必向他们定住眼目， 降祸不降福。

chapters.en:
The Lord GOD of Hosts, He who touches the earth and it melts,
and all its dwellers mourn— all the land rises like the Nile, then sinks like the river of Egypt—
chapters.zh: 主－万军之耶和华摸地，地就消化， 凡住在地上的都必悲哀。 地必全然像尼罗河涨起， 如同埃及河落下。

chapters.en:
He builds His upper rooms in the heavens and founds His vault upon the earth. He summons the waters of the sea and pours them over the face of the earth.
The LORD is His name.
chapters.zh: 那在天上建造楼阁、 在地上安定穹苍、 命海水浇在地上的－ 耶和华是他的名。

chapters.en: “Are you not like the Cushites to Me, O children of Israel?” declares the LORD. “Did I not bring Israel up from the land of Egypt, the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Arameans from Kir?
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：以色列人哪， 我岂不看你们如古实人吗？ 我岂不是领以色列人出埃及地， 领非利士人出迦斐讬， 领亚兰人出吉珥吗？

chapters.en: Surely the eyes of the Lord GOD are on the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from the face of the earth. Yet I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华的眼目察看这有罪的国， 必将这国从地上灭绝， 却不将雅各家灭绝净尽。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
“For surely I will give the command, and I will shake the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is sifted in a sieve;
but not a pebble will reach the ground.
chapters.zh: 我必出令， 将以色列家分散在列国中， 好像用筛子筛〔谷〕， 连一粒也不落在地上。

chapters.en: All the sinners among My people will die by the sword— all those who say, ‘Disaster will never draw near or confront us.’”
chapters.zh: 我民中的一切罪人说： 灾祸必追不上我们， 也迎不着我们。 他们必死在刀下。

chapters.en: “In that day I will restore the fallen tent of David. I will repair its gaps, restore its ruins, and rebuild it as in the days of old,
chapters.zh: 到那日，我必建立大卫倒塌的帐幕， 堵住其中的破口， 把那破坏的建立起来， 重新修造，像古时一样，

chapters.en: that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations that bear My name,” declares the LORD, who will do this.
chapters.zh: 使以色列人得以东所余剩的 和所有称为我名下的国。 此乃行这事的耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Behold, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when the plowman will overtake the reaper and the treader of grapes, the sower of seed. The mountains will drip with sweet wine, with which all the hills will flow.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说： 日子将到， 耕种的必接续收割的； 踹葡萄的必接续撒种的； 大山要滴下甜酒； 小山都必流奶〔注：原文是消化，见约珥三章十八节〕。

chapters.en: I will restore My people Israel from captivity; they will rebuild and inhabit the ruined cities. They will plant vineyards and drink their wine; they will make gardens and eat their fruit.
chapters.zh: 我必使我民以色列被掳的归回； 他们必重修荒废的城邑居住， 栽种葡萄园，喝其中所出的酒， 修造果木园，吃其中的果子。

chapters.en:
I will firmly plant them in their own land, never again to be uprooted
from the land that I have given them,” says the LORD your God.
chapters.zh: 我要将他们栽于本地， 他们不再从我所赐给他们的地上拔出来。 这是耶和华－你的上帝说的。

chapters.en:
This is the vision of Obadiah:
This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom—
We have heard a message from the LORD; an envoy has been sent among the nations to say, “Rise up, and let us go to battle against her!”—
chapters.zh: 俄巴底亚得了耶和华的默示。 论以东说： 我从耶和华那里听见信息， 并有使者被差往列国去， 〔说〕：起来吧， 一同起来与以东争战！

chapters.en: “Behold, I will make you small among the nations; you will be deeply despised.
chapters.zh: 我使你－以东在列国中为最小的， 被人大大藐视。

chapters.en:
The pride of your heart has deceived you, O dwellers in the clefts of the rocks
whose habitation is the heights, who say in your heart, ‘Who can bring me down to the ground?’
chapters.zh: 住在山穴中、居所在高处的啊， 你因狂傲自欺， 心里说：谁能将我拉下地去呢？

chapters.en:
Though you soar like the eagle and make your nest among the stars,
even from there I will bring you down,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你虽如大鹰高飞， 在星宿之间搭窝， 我必从那里拉下你来。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “If thieves came to you, if robbers by night— oh, how you will be ruined— would they not steal only what they wanted? If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleanings?
chapters.zh: 盗贼若来在你那里， 或强盗夜间而来－ 你何竟被剪除－ 岂不偷窃直到够了呢？ 摘葡萄的若来到你那里， 岂不剩下些葡萄呢？

chapters.en: But how Esau will be pillaged, his hidden treasures sought out!
chapters.zh: 以扫〔的隐密处〕何竟被搜寻？ 他隐藏的宝物何竟被查出？

chapters.en:
All the men allied with you will drive you to the border; the men at peace with you will deceive and overpower you. Those who eat your bread will set a trap for you
without your awareness of it.
chapters.zh: 与你结盟的都送你上路，直到交界； 与你和好的欺骗你，且胜过你； 与你一同吃饭的设下网罗陷害你； 在你心里毫无聪明。

chapters.en: In that day, declares the LORD, will I not destroy the wise men of Edom and the men of understanding in the mountains of Esau?
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：到那日， 我岂不从以东除灭智慧人？ 从以扫山除灭聪明人？

chapters.en: Then your mighty men, O Teman, will be terrified, so that everyone in the mountains of Esau will be cut down in the slaughter.
chapters.zh: 提幔哪， 你的勇士必惊惶， 甚至以扫山的人都被杀戮剪除。

chapters.en:
Because of the violence against your brother Jacob, you will be covered with shame
and cut off forever.
chapters.zh: 因你向兄弟雅各行强暴， 羞愧必遮盖你， 你也必永远断绝。

chapters.en:
On the day you stood aloof while strangers carried off his wealth and foreigners entered his gate and cast lots for Jerusalem,
you were just like one of them.
chapters.zh: 当外人掳掠雅各的财物， 外邦人进入他的城门， 为耶路撒冷拈鬮的日子， 你竟站在一旁，像与他们同伙。

chapters.en: But you should not gloat in that day, your brother’s day of misfortune, nor rejoice over the people of Judah in the day of their destruction, nor boast proudly in the day of their distress.
chapters.zh: 你兄弟遭难的日子， 你不当瞪眼看着； 犹大人被灭的日子， 你不当因此欢乐； 他们遭难的日子， 你不当说狂傲的话。

chapters.en: You should not enter the gate of My people in the day of their disaster, nor gloat over their affliction in the day of their disaster, nor loot their wealth in the day of their disaster.
chapters.zh: 我民遭灾的日子， 你不当进他们的城门； 他们遭灾的日子， 你不当瞪眼看着他们受苦； 他们遭灾的日子， 你不当伸手抢他们的财物；

chapters.en: Nor should you stand at the crossroads to cut off their fugitives, nor deliver up their survivors in the day of their distress.
chapters.zh: 你不当站在岔路口剪除他们中间逃脱的； 他们遭难的日子， 你不当将他们剩下的人交付〔仇敌〕。

chapters.en: For the Day of the LORD is near for all the nations. As you have done, it will be done to you; your recompense will return upon your own head.
chapters.zh: 耶和华降罚的日子临近万国。 你怎样行，〔他〕也必照样向你行； 你的报应必归到你头上。

chapters.en: For as you drank on My holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. They will drink and gulp it down; they will be as if they had never existed.
chapters.zh: 你们犹大人在我圣山怎样喝了〔苦杯〕， 万国也必照样常常地喝； 且喝且咽，他们就归于无有。

chapters.en: But on Mount Zion there will be deliverance, and it will be holy, and the house of Jacob will reclaim their possession.
chapters.zh: 在锡安山必有逃脱的人， 那山也必成圣； 雅各家必得原有的产业。

chapters.en: Then the house of Jacob will be a blazing fire, and the house of Joseph a burning flame; but the house of Esau will be stubble— Jacob will set it ablaze and consume it. Therefore no survivor will remain from the house of Esau.” For the LORD has spoken.
chapters.zh: 雅各家必成为大火； 约瑟家必为火焰； 以扫家必如碎诩； 火必将他烧着吞灭。 以扫家必无余剩的。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Those from the Negev will possess the mountains of Esau; those from the foothills will possess the land of the Philistines. They will occupy the fields of Ephraim and Samaria, and Benjamin will possess Gilead.
chapters.zh: 南地的人必得以扫山； 高原的人必得非利士地， 也得以法莲地和撒马利亚地； 便雅悯人必得基列。

chapters.en: And the exiles of this host of the Israelites will possess the land of the Canaanites as far as Zarephath; and the exiles from Jerusalem who are in Sepharad will possess the cities of the Negev.
chapters.zh: 在迦南人中被掳的以色列众人 〔必得地〕直到撒勒法； 在西法拉中被掳的耶路撒冷人 必得南地的城邑。

chapters.en:
The deliverers will ascend Mount Zion to rule over the mountains of Esau.
And the kingdom will belong to the LORD.
chapters.zh: 必有拯救者上到锡安山，审判以扫山； 国度就归耶和华了。

chapters.en: Now the word of the LORD came to Jonah son of Amittai, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到亚米太的儿子约拿，说：

chapters.en: “Get up! Go to the great city of Nineveh and preach against it, because its wickedness has come up before Me.”
chapters.zh: 「你起来往尼尼微大城去，向其中的居民呼喊，因为他们的恶达到我面前。」

chapters.en: Jonah, however, got up to flee to Tarshish, away from the presence of the LORD. He went down to Joppa and found a ship bound for Tarshish. So he paid the fare and went aboard to sail for Tarshish, away from the presence of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 约拿却起来，逃往他施去躲避耶和华；下到约帕，遇见一只船，要往他施去。他就给了船价，上了船，要与船上的人同往他施去躲避耶和华。

chapters.en: Then the LORD hurled a great wind upon the sea, and such a violent storm arose that the ship was in danger of breaking apart.
chapters.zh: 然而耶和华使海中起大风，海就狂风大作，甚至船几乎破坏。

chapters.en: The sailors were afraid, and each cried out to his own god. And they threw the ship’s cargo into the sea to lighten the load. But Jonah had gone down to the lowest part of the vessel, where he lay down and fell into a deep sleep.
chapters.zh: 水手便惧怕，各人哀求自己的神。他们将船上的货物抛在海中，为要使船轻些。约拿已下到底舱，躺卧沉睡。

chapters.en: The captain approached him and said, “How can you sleep? Get up and call upon your God. Perhaps this God will consider us, so that we may not perish.”
chapters.zh: 船主到他那里对他说：「你这沉睡的人哪，为何这样呢？起来，求告你的神，或者神顾念我们，使我们不致灭亡。」

chapters.en:
“Come!” said the sailors to one another. “Let us cast lots to find out who is responsible for this calamity that is upon us.”
So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.
chapters.zh: 船上的人彼此说：「来吧，我们掣签，看看这灾临到我们是因谁的缘故。」于是他们掣签，掣出约拿来。

chapters.en: “Tell us now,” they demanded, “who is to blame for this calamity that is upon us? What is your occupation, and where have you come from? What is your country, and who are your people?”
chapters.zh: 众人对他说：「请你告诉我们，这灾临到我们是因谁的缘故？你以何事为业？你从哪里来？你是哪一国？属哪一族的人？」

chapters.en: “I am a Hebrew,” replied Jonah. “I worship the LORD, the God of the heavens, who made the sea and the dry land.”
chapters.zh: 他说：「我是希伯来人。我敬畏耶和华－那创造沧海旱地之天上的上帝。」

chapters.en: Then the men were even more afraid and said to him, “What have you done?” The men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of the LORD, because he had told them.
chapters.zh: 他们就大大惧怕，对他说：「你做的是什么事呢？」他们已经知道他躲避耶和华，因为他告诉了他们。

chapters.en: Now the sea was growing worse and worse, so they said to Jonah, “What must we do to you to calm this sea for us?”
chapters.zh: 他们问他说：「我们当向你怎样行，使海浪平静呢？」这话是因海浪越发翻腾。

chapters.en: “Pick me up,” he answered, “and cast me into the sea, so it may quiet down for you. For I know that I am to blame for this violent storm that has come upon you.”
chapters.zh: 他对他们说：「你们将我抬起来，抛在海中，海就平静了；我知道你们遭这大风是因我的缘故。」

chapters.en: Nevertheless, the men rowed hard to get back to dry land, but they could not, for the sea was raging against them more and more.
chapters.zh: 然而那些人竭力荡桨，要把船拢岸，却是不能，因为海浪越发向他们翻腾。

chapters.en: So they cried out to the LORD: “Please, O LORD, do not let us perish on account of this man’s life! Do not charge us with innocent blood! For You, O LORD, have done as You pleased.”
chapters.zh: 他们便求告耶和华说：「耶和华啊，我们恳求你，不要因这人的性命使我们死亡，不要使流无辜血的罪归与我们；因为你－耶和华是随自己的意旨行事。」

chapters.en: Then they picked up Jonah and cast him into the sea, and the raging sea grew calm.
chapters.zh: 他们遂将约拿抬起，抛在海中，海的狂浪就平息了。

chapters.en: Then the men feared the LORD greatly, and they offered a sacrifice to the LORD and made vows to Him.
chapters.zh: 那些人便大大敬畏耶和华，向耶和华献祭，并且许愿。

chapters.en: Now the LORD had appointed a great fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah spent three days and three nights in the belly of the fish.
chapters.zh: 耶和华安排一条大鱼吞了约拿，他在鱼腹中三日三夜。

chapters.en: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the LORD his God,
chapters.zh: 约拿在鱼腹中祷告耶和华－他的上帝，

chapters.en:
saying:
“In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered me. From the belly of Sheol I called for help, and You heard my voice.
chapters.zh: 说： 我遭遇患难求告耶和华， 你就应允我； 从阴间的深处呼求， 你就俯听我的声音。

chapters.en: For You cast me into the deep, into the heart of the seas, and the current swirled about me; all Your breakers and waves swept over me.
chapters.zh: 你将我投下深渊， 就是海的深处； 大水环绕我， 你的波浪洪涛都漫过我身。

chapters.en: At this, I said, ‘I have been banished from Your sight; yet I will look once more toward Your holy temple.’
chapters.zh: 我说：我从你眼前虽被驱逐， 我仍要仰望你的圣殿。

chapters.en: The waters engulfed me to take my life; the watery depths closed around me; the seaweed wrapped around my head.
chapters.zh: 诸水环绕我，几乎淹没我； 深渊围住我； 海草缠绕我的头。

chapters.en: To the roots of the mountains I descended; the earth beneath me barred me in forever! But You raised my life from the pit, O LORD my God!
chapters.zh: 我下到山根， 地的门将我永远〔关住〕。 耶和华－我的上帝啊， 你却将我的性命从坑中救出来。

chapters.en: As my life was fading away, I remembered the LORD. My prayer went up to You, to Your holy temple.
chapters.zh: 我心在我里面发昏的时候， 我就想念耶和华。 我的祷告进入你的圣殿， 达到你的面前。

chapters.en: Those who cling to worthless idols forsake His loving devotion.
chapters.zh: 那信奉虚无〔之神〕的人， 离弃怜爱他们的主；

chapters.en: But I, with the voice of thanksgiving, will sacrifice to You. I will fulfill what I have vowed. Salvation is from the LORD!”
chapters.zh: 但我必用感谢的声音献祭与你。 我所许的愿，我必偿还。 救恩出于耶和华。

chapters.en: And the LORD commanded the fish, and it vomited Jonah onto dry land.
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐鱼，鱼就把约拿吐在旱地上。

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Jonah a second time:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话二次临到约拿说：

chapters.en: “Get up! Go to the great city of Nineveh and proclaim to it the message that I give you.”
chapters.zh: 「你起来！往尼尼微大城去，向其中的居民宣告我所吩咐你的话。」

chapters.en:
This time Jonah got up and went to Nineveh, in accordance with the word of the LORD.
Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, requiring a three-day journey.
chapters.zh: 约拿便照耶和华的话起来，往尼尼微去。这尼尼微是极大的城，有三日的路程。

chapters.en: On the first day of his journey, Jonah set out into the city and proclaimed, “Forty more days and Nineveh will be overturned!”
chapters.zh: 约拿进城走了一日，宣告说：「再等四十日，尼尼微必倾覆了！」

chapters.en: And the Ninevites believed God. They proclaimed a fast and dressed in sackcloth, from the greatest of them to the least.
chapters.zh: 尼尼微人信服上帝，便宣告禁食，从最大的到至小的都穿麻衣〔注：或译：披上麻布〕。

chapters.en: When word reached the king of Nineveh, he got up from his throne, took off his royal robe, covered himself with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.
chapters.zh: 这信息传到尼尼微王的耳中，他就下了宝座，脱下朝服，披上麻布，坐在灰中。

chapters.en:
Then he issued a proclamation in Nineveh:
“By the decree of the king and his nobles:
Let no man or beast, herd or flock, taste anything at all. They must not eat or drink.
chapters.zh: 他又使人遍告尼尼微通城，说：「王和大臣有令，人不可尝什么，牲畜、牛羊不可吃草，也不可喝水。

chapters.en: Furthermore, let both man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and have everyone call out earnestly to God. Let each one turn from his evil ways and from the violence in his hands.
chapters.zh: 人与牲畜都当披上麻布；人要切切求告上帝。各人回头离开所行的恶道，丢弃手中的强暴。

chapters.en: Who knows? God may turn and relent; He may turn from His fierce anger, so that we will not perish.”
chapters.zh: 或者上帝转意后悔，不发烈怒，使我们不致灭亡，也未可知。」

chapters.en: When God saw their actions—that they had turned from their evil ways—He relented from the disaster He had threatened to bring upon them.
chapters.zh: 于是上帝察看他们的行为，见他们离开恶道，他就后悔，不把所说的灾祸降与他们了。

chapters.en: Jonah, however, was greatly displeased, and he became angry.
chapters.zh: 这事约拿大大不悦，且甚发怒，

chapters.en: So he prayed to the LORD, saying, “O LORD, is this not what I said while I was still in my own country? This is why I was so quick to flee toward Tarshish. I knew that You are a gracious and compassionate God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion—One who relents from sending disaster.
chapters.zh: 就祷告耶和华说：「耶和华啊，我在本国的时候岂不是这样说吗？我知道你是有恩典、有怜悯的上帝，不轻易发怒，有丰盛的慈爱，并且后悔不降所说的灾，所以我急速逃往他施去。

chapters.en: And now, O LORD, please take my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，现在求你取我的命吧！因为我死了比活着还好。」

chapters.en: But the LORD replied, “Have you any right to be angry?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「你这样发怒合乎理吗？」

chapters.en: Then Jonah left the city and sat down east of it, where he made himself a shelter and sat in its shade to see what would happen to the city.
chapters.zh: 于是约拿出城，坐在城的东边，在那里为自己搭了一座棚，坐在棚的荫下，要看看那城究竟如何。

chapters.en: So the LORD God appointed a vine, and it grew up to provide shade over Jonah’s head to ease his discomfort, and Jonah was greatly pleased with the plant.
chapters.zh: 耶和华上帝安排一棵蓖麻，使其发生高过约拿，影儿遮盖他的头，救他脱离苦楚；约拿因这棵蓖麻大大喜乐。

chapters.en: When dawn came the next day, God appointed a worm that attacked the plant so that it withered.
chapters.zh: 次日黎明，上帝却安排一条虫子咬这蓖麻，以致枯槁。

chapters.en: As the sun was rising, God appointed a scorching east wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah’s head so that he grew faint and wished to die, saying, “It is better for me to die than to live.”
chapters.zh: 日头出来的时候，上帝安排炎热的东风，日头曝晒约拿的头，使他发昏，他就为自己求死，说：「我死了比活着还好！」

chapters.en:
Then God asked Jonah, “Have you any right to be angry about the plant?”
“I do,” he replied. “I am angry enough to die!”
chapters.zh: 上帝对约拿说：「你因这棵蓖麻发怒合乎理吗？」他说：「我发怒以至于死，都合乎理！」

chapters.en: But the LORD said, “You cared about the plant, which you neither tended nor made grow. It sprang up in a night and perished in a night.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「这蓖麻不是你栽种的，也不是你培养的；一夜发生，一夜干死，你尚且爱惜；

chapters.en: So should I not care about the great city of Nineveh, which has more than 120,000 people who cannot tell their right hand from their left, and many cattle as well?”
chapters.zh: 何况这尼尼微大城，其中不能分辨左手右手的有十二万多人，并有许多牲畜，我岂能不爱惜呢？」

chapters.en: This is the word of the LORD that came to Micah the Moreshite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah—what he saw regarding Samaria and Jerusalem:
chapters.zh: 当犹大王约坦、亚哈斯、希西家在位的时候，摩利沙人弥迦得耶和华的默示，论撒马利亚和耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Hear, O peoples, all of you; listen, O earth, and everyone in it! May the Lord GOD bear witness against you, the Lord from His holy temple.
chapters.zh: 万民哪，你们都要听！ 地和其上所有的，也都要侧耳而听！ 主耶和华从他的圣殿 要见证你们的不是。

chapters.en: For behold, the LORD comes forth from His dwelling place; He will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
chapters.zh: 看哪，耶和华出了他的居所， 降临步行地的高处。

chapters.en: The mountains will melt beneath Him, and the valleys will split apart, like wax before the fire, like water rushing down a slope.
chapters.zh: 众山在他以下必消化， 诸谷必崩裂， 如蜡化在火中， 如水冲下山坡。

chapters.en: All this is for the transgression of Jacob and the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? Is it not Samaria? And what is the high place of Judah? Is it not Jerusalem?
chapters.zh: 这都因雅各的罪过， 以色列家的罪恶。 雅各的罪过在哪里呢？ 岂不是在撒马利亚吗？ 犹大的邱坛在哪里呢？ 岂不是在耶路撒冷吗？

chapters.en:
Therefore I will make Samaria a heap of rubble in the open field,
a planting area for a vineyard. I will pour her stones into the valley and expose her foundations.
chapters.zh: 所以我必使撒马利亚变为田野的乱堆， 又作为种葡萄之处； 也必将她的石头倒在谷中， 露出根基来。

chapters.en:
All her carved images will be smashed to pieces; all her wages will be burned in the fire,
and I will destroy all her idols. Since she collected the wages of a prostitute, they will be used again on a prostitute.
chapters.zh: 她一切雕刻的偶像必被打碎； 她所得的财物必被火烧； 所有的偶像我必毁灭； 因为是从妓女雇价所聚来的， 后必归为妓女的雇价。

chapters.en: Because of this I will lament and wail; I will walk barefoot and naked. I will howl like a jackal and mourn like an ostrich.
chapters.zh: 先知说：因此我必大声哀号， 赤脚露体而行； 又要呼号如野狗， 哀鸣如鸵鸟。

chapters.en: For her wound is incurable; it has reached even Judah; it has approached the gate of my people, as far as Jerusalem itself.
chapters.zh: 因为撒马利亚的伤痕无法医治， 延及犹大和耶路撒冷我民的城门。

chapters.en: Do not tell it in Gath; do not weep at all. Roll in the dust in Beth-leaphrah.
chapters.zh: 不要在迦特报告这事， 总不要哭泣； 我在伯‧亚弗拉滚于灰尘之中。

chapters.en: Depart in shameful nakedness, O dwellers of Shaphir. The dwellers of Zaanan will not come out. Beth-ezel is in mourning; its support is taken from you.
chapters.zh: 沙斐的居民哪，你们要赤身蒙羞过去。 撒南的居民不敢出来。 伯‧以薛人的哀哭使你们无处可站。

chapters.en:
For the dwellers of Maroth pined for good, but calamity came down from the LORD,
even to the gate of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 玛律的居民心甚忧急，切望得好处， 因为灾祸从耶和华那里临到耶路撒冷的城门。

chapters.en: Harness your chariot horses, O dweller of Lachish. You were the beginning of sin to the Daughter of Zion, for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.
chapters.zh: 拉吉的居民哪，要用快马套车； 锡安民〔注：原文是女子〕的罪由你而起； 以色列人的罪过在你那里显出。

chapters.en:
Therefore, send farewell gifts to Moresheth-gath; the houses of Achzib will prove deceptive
to the kings of Israel.
chapters.zh: 犹大啊，你要将礼物送给摩利设‧迦特。 亚革悉的众族必用诡诈待以色列诸王。

chapters.en:
I will again bring a conqueror against you, O dweller of Mareshah.
The glory of Israel will come to Adullam.
chapters.zh: 玛利沙的居民哪， 我必使那夺取你的来到你这里； 以色列的尊贵人〔注：原文是荣耀〕必到亚杜兰。

chapters.en: Shave yourselves bald and cut off your hair in mourning for your precious children; make yourselves as bald as an eagle, for they will go from you into exile.
chapters.zh: 犹大啊，要为你所喜爱的儿女剪除你的头发， 使头光秃，要大大地光秃，如同秃鹰， 因为他们都被掳去离开你。

chapters.en: Woe to those who devise iniquity and plot evil on their beds! At morning’s light they accomplish it because the power is in their hands.
chapters.zh: 祸哉，那些在床上图谋罪孽、造作奸恶的！ 天一发亮，因手有能力就行出来了。

chapters.en: They covet fields and seize them; they take away houses. They deprive a man of his home, a fellow man of his inheritance.
chapters.zh: 他们贪图田地就占据， 贪图房屋便夺取； 他们欺压人，霸占房屋和产业。

chapters.en:
Therefore this is what the LORD says:
“I am planning against this nation a disaster from which you cannot free your necks. Then you will not walk so proudly, for it will be a time of calamity.
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华如此说： 我筹划灾祸降与这族； 这祸在你们的颈项上不能解脱； 你们也不能昂首而行， 因为这时势是恶的。

chapters.en: In that day they will take up a proverb against you and taunt you with this bitter lamentation: ‘We are utterly ruined! He has changed the portion of my people. How He has removed it from me! He has allotted our fields to traitors.’”
chapters.zh: 到那日，必有人向你们提起悲惨的哀歌， 讥刺说：我们全然败落了！ 耶和华将我们的分转归别人， 何竟使这分离开我们？ 他将我们的田地分给悖逆的人。

chapters.en: Therefore, you will have no one in the assembly of the LORD to divide the land by lot.
chapters.zh: 所以在耶和华的会中， 你必没有人拈鬮拉准绳。

chapters.en:
“Do not preach,” they preach. “Do not preach these things;
disgrace will not overtake us.”
chapters.zh: 他们〔注：或译：假先知〕说：你们不可说预言； 不可向这些人说预言， 不住地羞辱〔我们〕。

chapters.en:
Should it be said, O house of Jacob, “Is the Spirit of the LORD impatient?
Are these the things He does?”
Do not My words bring good to him who walks uprightly?
chapters.zh: 雅各家啊，岂可说耶和华的心不忍耐吗〔注：或译：心肠狭窄吗〕？ 这些事是他所行的吗？ 我－〔耶和华〕的言语岂不是与行动正直的人有益吗？

chapters.en:
But of late My people have risen up like an enemy: You strip off the splendid robe from unsuspecting passersby
like men returning from battle.
chapters.zh: 然而，近来我的民兴起如仇敌， 从那些安然经过不愿打仗之人身上剥去外衣。

chapters.en: You drive the women of My people from their pleasant homes. You take away My blessing from their children forever.
chapters.zh: 你们将我民中的妇人从安乐家中赶出， 又将我的荣耀从她们的小孩子尽行夺去。

chapters.en: Arise and depart, for this is not your place of rest, because its defilement brings destruction— a grievous destruction!
chapters.zh: 你们起来去吧！ 这不是你们安息之所； 因为污秽使人〔注：或译：地〕毁灭， 而且大大毁灭。

chapters.en: If a man of wind were to come and say falsely, “I will preach to you of wine and strong drink,” he would be just the preacher for this people!
chapters.zh: 若有人心存虚假，用谎言〔说〕： 我要向你们预言得清酒和浓酒。 那人就必作这民的先知。

chapters.en:
I will surely gather all of you, O Jacob; I will collect the remnant of Israel. I will bring them together like sheep in a pen, like a flock in the midst of its pasture—
a noisy throng.
chapters.zh: 雅各家啊，我必要聚集你们， 必要招聚以色列剩下的人， 安置在一处，如波斯拉的羊， 又如草场上的羊群； 因为人数〔众〕多就必大大喧哗。

chapters.en: One who breaks open the way will go up before them; they will break through the gate, and go out by it. Their King will pass through before them, the LORD as their leader.
chapters.zh: 开路的〔注：或译：破城的〕在他们前面上去； 他们直闯过城门，从城门出去。 他们的王在前面行； 耶和华引导他们。

chapters.en:
Then I said:
“Hear now, O leaders of Jacob, you rulers of the house of Israel.
Should you not know justice?
chapters.zh: 我说：雅各的首领， 以色列家的官长啊，你们要听！ 你们不当知道公平吗？

chapters.en:
You hate good and love evil. You tear the skin from my people
and strip the flesh from their bones.
chapters.zh: 你们恶善好恶， 从人身上剥皮， 从人骨头上剔肉，

chapters.en:
You eat the flesh of my people after stripping off their skin
and breaking their bones. You chop them up like flesh for the cooking pot, like meat in a cauldron.”
chapters.zh: 吃我民的肉， 剥他们的皮， 打折他们的骨头， 分成块子像要下锅， 又像釜中的肉。

chapters.en: Then they will cry out to the LORD, but He will not answer them. At that time He will hide His face from them because of the evil they have done.
chapters.zh: 到了〔遭灾的〕时候， 这些人必哀求耶和华， 他却不应允他们。 那时他必照他们所行的恶事向他们掩面。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“As for the prophets who lead My people astray, who proclaim peace while they chew with their teeth, but declare war against one who puts nothing in their mouths:
chapters.zh: 论到使我民走差路的先知－ 他们牙齿有所嚼的， 他们就呼喊说：平安了！ 凡不供给他们吃的， 他们就预备攻击他〔注：预备攻击他：或译说必遭遇刀兵〕－ 耶和华如此说：

chapters.en: Therefore night will come over you without visions, and darkness without divination. The sun will set on these prophets, and the daylight will turn black over them.
chapters.zh: 你们必遭遇黑夜，以致不见异象； 又必遭遇幽暗，以致不能占卜。 日头必向你们沉落， 白昼变为黑暗。

chapters.en: Then the seers will be ashamed and the diviners will be disgraced. They will all cover their mouths because there is no answer from God.”
chapters.zh: 先见必抱愧， 占卜的必蒙羞， 都必捂着嘴唇， 因为上帝不应允他们。

chapters.en:
As for me, however, I am filled with power by the Spirit of the LORD, with justice and courage, to declare to Jacob his transgression
and to Israel his sin.
chapters.zh: 至于我，我藉耶和华的灵， 满有力量、公平、才能， 可以向雅各说明他的过犯， 向以色列指出他的罪恶。

chapters.en: Now hear this, O leaders of the house of Jacob and rulers of the house of Israel, who despise justice and pervert all that is right,
chapters.zh: 雅各家的首领、以色列家的官长啊， 当听我的话！ 你们厌恶公平， 在一切事上屈枉正直；

chapters.en: who build Zion with bloodshed and Jerusalem with iniquity.
chapters.zh: 以人血建立锡安， 以罪孽建造耶路撒冷。

chapters.en:
Her leaders judge for a bribe, her priests teach for a price,
and her prophets practice divination for money. Yet they lean upon the LORD, saying, “Is not the LORD among us?
No disaster can come upon us.”
chapters.zh: 首领为贿赂行审判； 祭司为雇价施训诲； 先知为银钱行占卜。 他们却倚赖耶和华，说： 耶和华不是在我们中间吗？ 灾祸必不临到我们。

chapters.en: Therefore, because of you, Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, and the temple mount a wooded ridge.
chapters.zh: 所以因你们的缘故， 锡安必被耕种像一块田， 耶路撒冷必变为乱堆； 这殿的山必像丛林的高处。

chapters.en: In the last days the mountain of the house of the LORD will be established as the chief of the mountains; it will be raised above the hills, and the peoples will stream to it.
chapters.zh: 末后的日子， 耶和华殿的山必坚立， 超乎诸山，高举过于万岭； 万民都要流归这山。

chapters.en:
And many nations will come and say:
“Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob. He will teach us His ways, so that we may walk in His paths.”
For the law will go forth from Zion and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 必有许多国的民前往，说： 来吧，我们登耶和华的山， 奔雅各上帝的殿。 主必将他的道教训我们； 我们也要行他的路。 因为训诲必出于锡安； 耶和华的言语必出于耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Then He will judge between many peoples and arbitrate for strong nations far and wide. Then they will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will no longer take up the sword against nation, nor will they train anymore for war.
chapters.zh: 他必在多国的民中施行审判， 为远方强盛的国断定是非。 他们要将刀打成诓头， 把枪打成镰刀。 这国不举刀攻击那国； 他们也不再学习战事。

chapters.en: And each man will sit under his own vine and under his own fig tree, with no one to frighten him. For the mouth of the LORD of Hosts has spoken.
chapters.zh: 人人都要坐在自己葡萄树下 和无花果树下，无人惊吓。 这是万军之耶和华亲口说的。

chapters.en: Though all the nations may walk in the name of their gods, yet we will walk in the name of the LORD our God forever and ever.
chapters.zh: 万民各奉己神的名而行； 我们却永永远远奉耶和华－我们上帝的名而行。

chapters.en: “On that day,” declares the LORD, “I will gather the lame; I will assemble the outcast, even those whom I have afflicted.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：到那日， 我必聚集瘸腿的， 招聚被赶出的和我所惩治的。

chapters.en: And I will make the lame into a remnant, the outcast into a strong nation. Then the LORD will rule over them in Mount Zion from that day and forever.
chapters.zh: 我必使瘸腿的为余剩之民， 使赶到远方的为强盛之民。 耶和华要在锡安山作王治理他们， 从今直到永远。

chapters.en: And you, O watchtower of the flock, O stronghold of the Daughter of Zion— the former dominion will be restored to you; sovereignty will come to the Daughter of Jerusalem.”
chapters.zh: 你这羊群的高台、锡安城〔注：原文是女子〕的山哪， 从前的权柄－ 就是耶路撒冷民〔注：原文是女子〕的国权－ 必归与你。

chapters.en: Why do you now cry aloud? Is there no king among you? Has your counselor perished so that anguish grips you like a woman in labor?
chapters.zh: 现在你为何大声哭号呢？ 疼痛抓住你仿佛产难的妇人， 是因你中间没有君王吗？ 你的谋士灭亡了吗？

chapters.en: Writhe in agony, O Daughter of Zion, like a woman in labor. For now you will leave the city and camp in the open fields. You will go to Babylon; there you will be rescued; there the LORD will redeem you from the hand of your enemies!
chapters.zh: 锡安的民〔注：原文是女子〕哪， 你要疼痛劬劳，仿佛产难的妇人； 因为你必从城里出来， 住在田野，到巴比伦去。 在那里要蒙解救； 在那里耶和华必救赎你脱离仇敌的手。

chapters.en: But now many nations have assembled against you, saying, “Let her be defiled, and let us feast our eyes on Zion.”
chapters.zh: 现在有许多国的民聚集攻击你，说： 愿锡安被玷污！ 愿我们亲眼见她〔遭报〕！

chapters.en: But they do not know the thoughts of the LORD or understand His plan, for He has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing floor.
chapters.zh: 他们却不知道耶和华的意念， 也不明白他的筹划。 他聚集他们，好像把禾捆聚到禾场一样。

chapters.en: Rise and thresh, O Daughter of Zion, for I will give you horns of iron and hooves of bronze to break to pieces many peoples. Then you will devote their gain to the LORD, their wealth to the Lord of all the earth.
chapters.zh: 锡安的民〔注：原文是女子〕哪，起来踹谷吧！ 我必使你的角成为铁， 使你的蹄成为铜。 你必打碎多国的民， 将他们的财献与耶和华， 将他们的货献与普天下的主。

chapters.en:
Now, O daughter of troops, mobilize your troops;
for a siege is laid against us! With a rod they will strike the cheek of the judge of Israel.
chapters.zh: 成群的民〔注：原文是女子〕哪，现在你要聚集成队； 〔因为〕仇敌围攻我们， 要用杖击打以色列审判者的脸。

chapters.en: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, who are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come forth for Me One to be ruler over Israel — One whose origins are of old, from the days of eternity.
chapters.zh: 伯利恒的以法他啊， 你在犹大诸城中为小， 将来必有一位从你那里出来， 在以色列中为我作掌权的； 他的根源从亘古，从太初就有。

chapters.en: Therefore Israel will be abandoned until she who is in labor has given birth; then the rest of His brothers will return to the children of Israel.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必将以色列人交付〔敌人〕， 直等那生产的妇人生下子来。 那时掌权者〔注：原文是他〕其余的弟兄 必归到以色列人那里。

chapters.en:
He will stand and shepherd His flock in the strength of the LORD,
in the majestic name of the LORD His God. And they will dwell securely, for then His greatness will extend
to the ends of the earth.
chapters.zh: 他必起来，倚靠耶和华的大能， 并耶和华－他上帝之名的威严， 牧养〔他的羊群〕。 他们要〔安然〕居住； 因为他必日见尊大，直到地极。

chapters.en:
And He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land
and tramples our citadels. We will raise against it seven shepherds, even eight leaders of men.
chapters.zh: 这位必作〔我们的〕平安。 当亚述人进入我们的地境， 践踏宫殿的时候， 我们就立起七个牧者， 八个首领攻击他。

chapters.en:
And they will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod with the blade drawn. So He will deliver us when Assyria invades our land
and marches into our borders.
chapters.zh: 他们必用刀剑毁坏亚述地 和宁录地的关口。 亚述人进入我们的地境践踏的时候， 他必拯救我们。

chapters.en: Then the remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which do not wait for man or linger for mankind.
chapters.zh: 雅各余剩的人必在多国的民中， 如从耶和华那里降下的露水， 又如甘霖降在草上； 不仗赖人〔力〕，也不等候世人〔之功〕。

chapters.en: Then the remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the beasts of the forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep, which tramples and tears as it passes through, with no one to rescue them.
chapters.zh: 雅各余剩的人必在多国多民中， 如林间百兽中的狮子， 又如少壮狮子在羊群中。 他若经过就必践踏撕裂， 无人搭救。

chapters.en: Your hand will be lifted over your foes, and all your enemies will be cut off.
chapters.zh: 愿你的手举起，高过敌人！ 愿你的仇敌都被剪除！

chapters.en: “In that day,” declares the LORD, “I will remove your horses from among you and wreck your chariots.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：到那日， 我必从你中间剪除马匹， 毁坏车辆，

chapters.en: I will remove the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.
chapters.zh: 也必从你国中除灭城邑， 拆毁一切的保障，

chapters.en: I will cut the sorceries from your hand, and you will have no fortune-tellers.
chapters.zh: 又必除掉你手中的邪术； 你那里也不再有占卜的。

chapters.en: I will also cut off the carved images and sacred pillars from among you, so that you will no longer bow down to the work of your own hands.
chapters.zh: 我必从你中间除灭雕刻的偶像和柱像， 你就不再跪拜自己手所造的。

chapters.en: I will root out the Asherah poles from your midst and demolish your cities.
chapters.zh: 我必从你中间拔出木偶， 又毁灭你的城邑。

chapters.en: I will take vengeance in anger and wrath upon the nations that have not obeyed Me.”
chapters.zh: 我也必在怒气和忿怒中向那不听从的列国施报。

chapters.en:
Hear now what the LORD says:
“Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.
chapters.zh: 以色列人哪，当听耶和华的话！ 要起来向山岭争辩， 使冈陵听你的话。

chapters.en: Hear, O mountains, the LORD’s indictment, you enduring foundations of the earth. For the LORD has a case against His people, and He will argue it against Israel:
chapters.zh: 山岭和地永久的根基啊， 要听耶和华争辩的话！ 因为耶和华要与他的百姓争辩， 与以色列争论。

chapters.en: ‘My people, what have I done to you? Testify against Me how I have wearied you!
chapters.zh: 我的百姓啊，我向你做了什么呢？ 我在什么事上使你厌烦？ 你可以对我证明。

chapters.en: For I brought you up from the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery. I sent Moses before you, as well as Aaron and Miriam.
chapters.zh: 我曾将你从埃及地领出来， 从作奴仆之家救赎你； 我也差遣摩西、亚伦，和米利暗在你前面行。

chapters.en: My people, remember what Balak king of Moab counseled and what Balaam son of Beor answered. Remember your journey from Shittim to Gilgal, so that you may acknowledge the righteousness of the LORD.’”
chapters.zh: 我的百姓啊，你们当追念摩押王巴勒所设的谋 和比珥的儿子巴兰回答他的话， 并你们从什亭到吉甲〔所遇见的事〕， 好使你们知道耶和华公义的作为。

chapters.en: With what shall I come before the LORD when I bow before the God on high? Should I come to Him with burnt offerings, with year-old calves?
chapters.zh: 我朝见耶和华， 在至高上帝面前跪拜，当献上什么呢？ 岂可献一岁的牛犊为燔祭吗？

chapters.en: Would the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousand rivers of oil? Shall I present my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
chapters.zh: 耶和华岂喜悦千千的公羊， 或是万万的油河吗？ 我岂可为自己的罪过献我的长子吗？ 为心中的罪恶献我身所生的吗？

chapters.en: He has shown you, O man, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
chapters.zh: 世人哪，耶和华已指示你何为善。 他向你所要的是什么呢？ 只要你行公义，好怜悯， 存谦卑的心，与你的上帝同行。

chapters.en: The voice of the LORD calls out to the city (and it is sound wisdom to fear Your name): “Heed the rod and the One who ordained it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华向这城呼叫， 智慧人必敬畏他的名。 你们当听是谁派定刑杖的惩罚。

chapters.en: Can I forget any longer, O house of the wicked, the treasures of wickedness and the short ephah, which is accursed?
chapters.zh: 恶人家中不仍有非义之财 和可恶的小升斗吗？

chapters.en: Can I excuse dishonest scales or bags of false weights?
chapters.zh: 我若用不公道的天平和囊中诡诈的法码， 岂可算为清洁呢？

chapters.en: For the wealthy of the city are full of violence, and its residents speak lies; their tongues are deceitful in their mouths.
chapters.zh: 城里的富户满行强暴； 其中的居民也说谎言， 口中的舌头是诡诈的。

chapters.en: Therefore I am striking you severely, to ruin you because of your sins.
chapters.zh: 因此，我击打你， 使你的伤痕甚重， 使你因你的罪恶荒凉。

chapters.en: You will eat but not be satisfied, and your hunger will remain with you. What you acquire, you will not preserve; and what you save, I will give to the sword.
chapters.zh: 你要吃，却吃不饱； 你的虚弱必显在你中间。 你必挪去，却不得救护； 所救护的，我必交给刀剑。

chapters.en:
You will sow but not reap; you will press olives but not anoint yourselves with oil;
you will tread grapes but not drink the wine.
chapters.zh: 你必撒种，却不得收割； 踹橄榄，却不得油抹身； 踹葡萄，却不得酒喝。
因为你守暗利的恶规， 行亚哈家一切所行的， 顺从他们的计谋； 因此，我必使你荒凉， 使你的居民令人嗤笑， 你们也必担当我民的羞辱。

chapters.en:
Woe is me!
For I am like one gathering summer fruit at the gleaning of the vineyard; there is no cluster to eat, no early fig that I crave.
chapters.zh: 哀哉！我〔注：或译：以色列〕好像夏天的果子已被收尽， 又像摘了葡萄所剩下的， 没有一挂可吃的； 我心羨慕初熟的无花果。

chapters.en: The godly man has perished from the earth; there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; they hunt one another with a net.
chapters.zh: 地上虔诚人灭尽； 世间没有正直人； 各人埋伏，要杀人流血， 都用网罗猎取弟兄。

chapters.en: Both hands are skilled at evil; the prince and the judge demand a bribe. When the powerful utters his evil desire, they all conspire together.
chapters.zh: 他们双手作恶； 君王徇情面，审判官要贿赂； 位分大的吐出恶意， 都彼此结联行恶。

chapters.en:
The best of them is like a brier; the most upright is sharper than a hedge of thorns. The day for your watchmen has come, the day of your visitation.
Now is the time of their confusion.
chapters.zh: 他们最好的，不过是蒺藜； 最正直的，不过是荆棘篱笆。 你守望者〔说〕，降罚的日子已经来到。 他们必扰乱不安。

chapters.en: Do not rely on a friend; do not trust in a companion. Seal the doors of your mouth from her who lies in your arms.
chapters.zh: 不要倚赖邻舍； 不要信靠密友。 要守住你的口； 不要向你怀中的妻提说。

chapters.en:
For a son dishonors his father, a daughter rises against her mother,
and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law. A man’s enemies are the members of his own household.
chapters.zh: 因为，儿子藐视父亲； 女儿抗拒母亲； 媳妇抗拒婆婆； 人的仇敌就是自己家里的人。

chapters.en:
But as for me, I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation.
My God will hear me.
chapters.zh: 至于我，我要仰望耶和华， 要等候那救我的上帝； 我的上帝必应允我。

chapters.en: Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will arise; though I sit in darkness, the LORD will be my light.
chapters.zh: 我的仇敌啊，不要向我夸耀。 我虽跌倒，却要起来； 我虽坐在黑暗里， 耶和华却作我的光。

chapters.en: Because I have sinned against Him, I must endure the rage of the LORD, until He argues my case and executes justice for me. He will bring me into the light; I will see His righteousness.
chapters.zh: 我要忍受耶和华的恼怒； 因我得罪了他， 直等他为我辨屈，为我伸冤。 他必领我到光明中； 我必得见他的公义。

chapters.en:
Then my enemy will see and will be covered with shame— she who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?” My eyes will see her; at that time she will be trampled
like mud in the streets.
chapters.zh: 那时我的仇敌， 就是曾对我说「耶和华－你上帝在哪里」的， 他一看见这事就被羞愧遮盖。 我必亲眼见他〔遭报〕； 他必被践踏，如同街上的泥土。

chapters.en: The day for rebuilding your walls will come— the day for extending your boundary.
chapters.zh: 以色列啊，日子必到， 你的墙垣必重修； 到那日，你的境界必开展〔注：或译：命令必传到远方〕。

chapters.en: On that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, even from Egypt to the Euphrates, from sea to sea and mountain to mountain.
chapters.zh: 当那日，人必从亚述， 从埃及的城邑， 从埃及到大河， 从这海到那海， 从这山到那山， 都归到你这里。

chapters.en:
Then the earth will become desolate because of its inhabitants,
as the fruit of their deeds.
chapters.zh: 然而，这地因居民的缘故， 又因他们行事的结果，必然荒凉。

chapters.en: Shepherd with Your staff Your people, the flock of Your inheritance. They live alone in a woodland, surrounded by pastures. Let them graze in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
chapters.zh: 求〔耶和华〕在迦密山的树林中， 用你的杖牧放你独居的民， 就是你产业的羊群。 求你容他们在巴珊和基列得食物，像古时一样。

chapters.en: As in the days when you came out of Egypt, I will show My wonders.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说： 我要把奇事显给他们看， 好像出埃及地的时候一样。

chapters.en: Nations will see and be ashamed, deprived of all their might. They will put their hands over their mouths, and their ears will become deaf.
chapters.zh: 列国看见这事就必为自己的势力惭愧； 他们必用手捂口，掩耳不听。

chapters.en:
They will lick the dust like a snake, like reptiles slithering on the ground. They will come trembling from their strongholds in the presence of the LORD our God;
they will tremble in fear of You.
chapters.zh: 他们必舔土如蛇， 又如土中腹行的物， 战战兢兢地出他们的营寨。 他们必战惧投降耶和华， 也必因我们的上帝而惧怕。

chapters.en: Who is a God like You, who pardons iniquity and passes over the transgression of the remnant of His inheritance— who does not retain His anger forever, because He delights in loving devotion?
chapters.zh: 上帝啊，有何神像你，赦免罪孽， 饶恕你产业之余民的罪过， 不永远怀怒，喜爱施恩？

chapters.en: He will again have compassion on us; He will vanquish our iniquities. You will cast out all our sins into the depths of the sea.
chapters.zh: 必再怜悯我们， 将我们的罪孽踏在脚下， 又将我们的一切罪投于深海。

chapters.en: You will show faithfulness to Jacob and loving devotion to Abraham, as You swore to our fathers from the days of old.
chapters.zh: 你必按古时起誓应许我们列祖的话， 向雅各发诚实， 向亚伯拉罕施慈爱。

chapters.en: This is the burden against Nineveh, the book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite:
chapters.zh: 论尼尼微的默示，就是伊勒歌斯人那鸿所得的默示。

chapters.en: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God; the LORD is avenging and full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on His foes and reserves wrath for His enemies.
chapters.zh: 耶和华是忌邪施报的上帝。 耶和华施报大有忿怒； 向他的敌人施报， 向他的仇敌怀怒。

chapters.en: The LORD is slow to anger and great in power; the LORD will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. His path is in the whirlwind and storm, and clouds are the dust beneath His feet.
chapters.zh: 耶和华不轻易发怒，大有能力， 万不以〔有罪的〕为无罪。 他乘旋风和暴风而来， 云彩为他脚下的尘土。

chapters.en: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; He makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither, and the flower of Lebanon wilts.
chapters.zh: 他斥责海，使海干了， 使一切江河干涸。 巴珊和迦密〔的树林〕衰残； 黎巴嫩的花草也衰残了。

chapters.en: The mountains quake before Him, and the hills melt away; the earth trembles at His presence— the world and all its dwellers.
chapters.zh: 大山因他震动； 小山也都消化。 大地在他面前突起； 世界和住在其间的也都如此。

chapters.en: Who can withstand His indignation? Who can endure His burning anger? His wrath is poured out like fire; even rocks are shattered before Him.
chapters.zh: 他发忿恨，谁能立得住呢？ 他发烈怒，谁能当得起呢？ 他的忿怒如火倾倒； 磐石因他崩裂。

chapters.en:
The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of distress;
He cares for those who trust in Him.
chapters.zh: 耶和华本为善， 在患难的日子为人的保障， 并且认得那些投靠他的人。

chapters.en:
But with an overwhelming flood He will make an end of Nineveh
and pursue His enemies into darkness.
chapters.zh: 但他必以涨溢的洪水淹没尼尼微， 又驱逐仇敌进入黑暗。

chapters.en: Whatever you plot against the LORD, He will bring to an end. Affliction will not rise up a second time.
chapters.zh: 尼尼微人哪，设何谋攻击耶和华呢？ 他必〔将你们〕灭绝净尽； 灾难不再兴起。

chapters.en:
For they will be entangled as with thorns and consumed like the drink of a drunkard—
like stubble that is fully dry.
chapters.zh: 你们像丛杂的荆棘， 像喝醉了的人， 又如枯干的碎诩全然烧灭。

chapters.en:
From you, O Nineveh, comes forth a plotter of evil against the LORD,
a counselor of wickedness.
chapters.zh: 有一人从你那里出来， 图谋邪恶，设恶计攻击耶和华。

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD says:
“Though they are allied and numerous, yet they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, O Judah, I will afflict you no longer.
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说： 尼尼微虽然势力充足，人数繁多， 也被剪除，归于无有。 犹大啊，我虽然使你受苦， 却不再使你受苦。

chapters.en: For I will now break their yoke from your neck and tear away your shackles.”
chapters.zh: 现在我必从你〔颈项〕上折断他的轭， 扭开他的绳索。

chapters.en:
The LORD has issued a command concerning you, O Nineveh:
“There will be no descendants to carry on your name. I will cut off the carved image and cast idol from the house of your gods; I will prepare your grave, for you are contemptible.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华已经出令，指着尼尼微说： 你名下的人必不留后； 我必从你神的庙中除灭雕刻的偶像和铸造的偶像； 我必因你鄙陋，使你归于坟墓。

chapters.en:
Look to the mountains— the feet of one who brings good news,
who proclaims peace! Celebrate your feasts, O Judah; fulfill your vows. For the wicked will never again march through you; they will be utterly cut off.
chapters.zh: 看哪，有报好信传平安之人的脚登山，〔说〕： 犹大啊，可以守你的节期， 还你所许的愿吧！ 因为那恶人不再从你中间经过， 他已灭绝净尽了。

chapters.en: One who scatters advances against you, O Nineveh. Guard the fortress! Watch the road! Brace yourselves! Summon all your strength!
chapters.zh: 尼尼微啊，那打碎〔邦国〕的上来攻击你。 你要看守保障，谨防道路， 使腰强壮，大大勉力。

chapters.en: For the LORD will restore the splendor of Jacob like the splendor of Israel, though destroyers have laid them waste and ruined the branches of their vine.
chapters.zh: （耶和华复兴雅各的荣华， 好像以色列的荣华一样； 因为使地空虚的， 已经使雅各和以色列空虚， 将他们的葡萄枝毁坏了。）

chapters.en: The shields of his mighty men are red; the valiant warriors are dressed in scarlet. The fittings of the chariots flash like fire on the day they are prepared, and the spears of cypress have been brandished.
chapters.zh: 他勇士的盾牌是红的， 精兵都穿朱红〔衣服〕。 在他预备〔争战〕的日子， 战车上的钢铁闪烁如火， 柏木把的〔枪〕也抡起来了。

chapters.en: The chariots dash through the streets; they rush around the plazas, appearing like torches, darting about like lightning.
chapters.zh: 车辆在街上〔注：或译：城外〕急行， 在宽阔处奔来奔去， 形状如火把， 飞跑如闪电。

chapters.en: He summons his nobles; they stumble as they advance. They race to its wall; the protective shield is set in place.
chapters.zh: 尼尼微王招聚他的贵胄； 他们步行绊跌， 速上城墙，预备挡牌。

chapters.en: The river gates are thrown open and the palace collapses.
chapters.zh: 河闸开放，宫殿冲没。

chapters.en: It is decreed that the city be exiled and carried away; her maidservants moan like doves, and beat upon their breasts.
chapters.zh: 王后蒙羞，被人掳去； 宫女搥胸，哀鸣如鸽。 此乃命定之事。

chapters.en:
Nineveh has been like a pool of water throughout her days,
but now it is draining away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one turns back.
chapters.zh: 尼尼微自古以来〔充满人民〕， 如同聚水的池子； 现在居民却都逃跑。 〔虽有人呼喊说〕：站住！站住！ 却无人回顾。

chapters.en: “Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold!” There is no end to the treasure, an abundance of every precious thing.
chapters.zh: 你们抢掠金银吧！ 因为所积蓄的无穷， 华美的宝器无数。

chapters.en: She is emptied! Yes, she is desolate and laid waste! Hearts melt, knees knock, bodies tremble, and every face grows pale!
chapters.zh: 尼尼微现在空虚荒凉， 人心消化，双膝相碰， 腰都疼痛，脸都变色。

chapters.en: Where is the lions’ lair or the feeding ground of the young lions, where the lion and lioness prowled with their cubs, with nothing to frighten them away?
chapters.zh: 狮子的洞和少壮狮子餵养之处在哪里呢？ 公狮母狮小狮游行、无人惊吓之地在哪里呢？

chapters.en: The lion mauled enough for its cubs and strangled prey for the lioness. It filled its dens with the kill, and its lairs with mauled prey.
chapters.zh: 公狮为小狮撕碎许多食物， 为母狮掐死活物， 把撕碎的、掐死的充满牠的洞穴。

chapters.en:
“Behold, I am against you,” declares the LORD of Hosts. “I will reduce your chariots to cinders, and the sword will devour your young lions. I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voices of your messengers
will no longer be heard.”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说：「我与你为敌，必将你的车辆焚烧成烟，刀剑也必吞灭你的少壮狮子。我必从地上除灭你所撕碎的，你使者的声音必不再听见。」

chapters.en: Woe to the city of blood, full of lies, full of plunder, never without prey.
chapters.zh: 祸哉！这流人血的城， 充满谎诈和强暴－ 抢夺的事总不止息。

chapters.en: The crack of the whip, the rumble of the wheel, galloping horse and bounding chariot!
chapters.zh: 鞭声响亮，车轮轰轰， 马匹踢跳，车辆奔腾，

chapters.en:
Charging horseman, flashing sword,
shining spear; heaps of slain, mounds of corpses, dead bodies without end— they stumble over their dead—
chapters.zh: 马兵争先，刀剑发光， 枪矛闪烁，被杀的甚多， 尸首成了大堆， 尸骸无数，人碰着而跌倒，

chapters.en: because of the many harlotries of the harlot, the seductive mistress of sorcery, who betrays nations by her prostitution and clans by her witchcraft.
chapters.zh: 都因那美貌的妓女多有淫行， 惯行邪术，藉淫行诱惑列国， 用邪术诱惑〔注：原文是卖〕多族。

chapters.en:
“Behold, I am against you,” declares the LORD of Hosts. “I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show your nakedness to the nations
and your shame to the kingdoms.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说：我与你为敌； 我必揭起你的衣襟，蒙在你脸上， 使列国看见你的赤体， 使列邦观看你的丑陋。

chapters.en:
I will pelt you with filth and treat you with contempt;
I will make a spectacle of you.
chapters.zh: 我必将可憎污秽之物抛在你身上， 辱没你，为众目所观。

chapters.en: Then all who see you will recoil from you and say, ‘Nineveh is devastated; who will grieve for her?’ Where can I find comforters for you?”
chapters.zh: 凡看见你的，都必逃跑离开你， 说：尼尼微荒凉了！有谁为你悲伤呢？ 我何处寻得安慰你的人呢？

chapters.en: Are you better than Thebes, stationed by the Nile with water around her, whose rampart was the sea, whose wall was the water?
chapters.zh: 你岂比挪亚们强呢？ 挪亚们坐落在众河之间，周围有水； 海〔注：指尼罗河〕作她的濠沟， 又作她的城墙。

chapters.en: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength; Put and Libya were her allies.
chapters.zh: 古实和埃及是她无穷的力量； 弗人和路比族是她的帮手。

chapters.en: Yet she became an exile; she went into captivity. Her infants were dashed to pieces at the head of every street. They cast lots for her dignitaries, and all her nobles were bound in chains.
chapters.zh: 但她被迁移，被掳去； 她的婴孩在各市口上也被摔死。 人为她的尊贵人拈鬮； 她所有的大人都被鍊子锁着。

chapters.en:
You too will become drunk; you will go into hiding
and seek refuge from the enemy.
chapters.zh: 你也必喝醉，必被埋藏， 并因仇敌的缘故寻求避难所。

chapters.en: All your fortresses are fig trees with the first ripe figs; when shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater!
chapters.zh: 你一切保障必像无花果树上初熟的无花果， 若一摇撼就落在想吃之人的口中。

chapters.en:
Look at your troops— they are like your women! The gates of your land are wide open to your enemies;
fire consumes their bars.
chapters.zh: 你地上的人民如同妇女； 你国中的关口向仇敌敞开； 你的门闩被火焚烧。

chapters.en: Draw your water for the siege; strengthen your fortresses. Work the clay and tread the mortar; repair the brick kiln!
chapters.zh: 你要打水预备受困； 要坚固你的保障， 踹土和泥，修补砖窑。

chapters.en:
There the fire will devour you; the sword will cut you down
and consume you like a young locust. Make yourself many like the young locust; make yourself many like the swarming locust!
chapters.zh: 在那里，火必烧灭你； 刀必杀戮你， 吞灭你如同蝻子。 任你加增人数多如蝻子， 多如蝗虫吧！

chapters.en: You have multiplied your merchants more than the stars of the sky. The young locust strips the land and flies away.
chapters.zh: 你增添商贾，多过天上的星； 蝻子吃尽而去。

chapters.en:
Your guards are like the swarming locust, and your scribes like clouds of locusts
that settle on the walls on a cold day. When the sun rises, they fly away, and no one knows where.
chapters.zh: 你的首领多如蝗虫； 你的军长仿佛成群的蚂蚱， 天凉的时候齐落在篱笆上， 日头一出便都飞去， 人不知道落在何处。

chapters.en: O king of Assyria, your shepherds slumber; your officers sleep. Your people are scattered on the mountains with no one to gather them.
chapters.zh: 亚述王啊，你的牧人睡觉； 你的贵胄安歇； 你的人民散在山间，无人招聚。

chapters.en: There is no healing for your injury; your wound is severe. All who hear the news of you applaud your downfall, for who has not experienced your constant cruelty?
chapters.zh: 你的损伤无法医治； 你的伤痕极其重大。 凡听你信息的必都因此向你拍掌。 你所行的恶谁没有时常遭遇呢？

chapters.en: This is the burden that Habakkuk the prophet received in a vision:
chapters.zh: 先知哈巴谷所得的默示。

chapters.en: How long, O LORD, must I call for help but You do not hear, or cry out to You, “Violence!” but You do not save?
chapters.zh: 他说：耶和华啊！我呼求你， 你不应允，要到几时呢？ 我因强暴哀求你，你还不拯救。

chapters.en: Why do You make me see iniquity? Why do You tolerate wrongdoing? Destruction and violence are before me. Strife is ongoing, and conflict abounds.
chapters.zh: 你为何使我看见罪孽？ 你为何看着奸恶〔而不理〕呢？ 毁灭和强暴在我面前， 又起了争端和相斗的事。

chapters.en: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never goes forth. For the wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
chapters.zh: 因此律法放松， 公理也不显明； 恶人围困义人， 所以公理显然颠倒。

chapters.en:
“Look at the nations and observe— be utterly astounded! For I am doing a work in your days that you would never believe
even if someone told you.
chapters.zh: 〔耶和华说〕：你们要向列国中观看， 大大惊奇； 因为在你们的时候，我行一件事， 虽有人告诉你们，你们总是不信。

chapters.en: For behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans — that ruthless and impetuous nation which marches through the breadth of the earth to seize dwellings not their own.
chapters.zh: 我必兴起迦勒底人， 就是那残忍暴躁之民，通行遍地， 占据那不属自己的住处。

chapters.en: They are dreaded and feared; from themselves they derive justice and sovereignty.
chapters.zh: 他威武可畏， 判断和势力都任意发出。

chapters.en: Their horses are swifter than leopards, fiercer than wolves of the night. Their horsemen charge ahead, and their cavalry comes from afar. They fly like a vulture, swooping down to devour.
chapters.zh: 他的马比豹更快， 比晚上的豺狼更猛。 马兵踊跃争先， 都从远方而来； 他们飞跑如鹰抓食，

chapters.en:
All of them come bent on violence; their hordes advance like the east wind;
they gather prisoners like sand.
chapters.zh: 都为行强暴而来， 定住脸面向前， 将掳掠的人聚集，多如尘沙。

chapters.en: They scoff at kings and make rulers an object of scorn. They laugh at every fortress and build up siege ramps to seize it.
chapters.zh: 他们讥诮君王，笑话首领， 嗤笑一切保障，筑垒攻取。

chapters.en: Then they sweep by like the wind and pass through. They are guilty; their own strength is their god.”
chapters.zh: 他以自己的势力为神， 像风猛然扫过，显为有罪。

chapters.en:
Are You not from everlasting, O LORD, my God, my Holy One?
We will not die. O LORD, You have appointed them to execute judgment; O Rock, You have established them for correction.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－我的上帝，我的圣者啊， 你不是从亘古而有吗？ 我们必不致死。 耶和华啊，你派定他为要刑罚人； 磐石啊，你设立他为要惩治人。

chapters.en: Your eyes are too pure to look upon evil, and You cannot tolerate wrongdoing. So why do You tolerate the faithless? Why are You silent while the wicked swallow up those more righteous than themselves?
chapters.zh: 你眼目清洁， 不看邪僻，不看奸恶； 行诡诈的，你为何看着不理呢？ 恶人吞灭比自己公义的， 你为何静默不语呢？

chapters.en: You have made men like the fish of the sea, like creeping things that have no ruler.
chapters.zh: 你为何使人如海中的鱼， 又如没有管辖的爬物呢？

chapters.en: The foe pulls all of them up with a hook; he catches them in his dragnet, and gathers them in his fishing net; so he rejoices gladly.
chapters.zh: 他用钩钩住，用网捕获， 用拉网聚集他们； 因此，他欢喜快乐，

chapters.en: Therefore he sacrifices to his dragnet and burns incense to his fishing net, for by these things his portion is sumptuous and his food is rich.
chapters.zh: 就向网献祭，向网烧香， 因他由此得肥美的分和富裕的食物。

chapters.en: Will he, therefore, empty his net and continue to slay nations without mercy?
chapters.zh: 他岂可屡次倒空网罗， 将列国的人时常杀戮，毫不顾惜呢？

chapters.en: I will stand at my guard post and station myself on the ramparts. I will watch to see what He will say to me, and how I should answer when corrected.
chapters.zh: 我要站在守望所， 立在望楼上观看， 看耶和华对我说什么话， 我可用什么话向他诉冤〔注：向他诉冤：或译回答所疑问的〕。

chapters.en:
Then the LORD answered me:
“Write down this vision and clearly inscribe it on tablets,
so that a herald may run with it.
chapters.zh: 他对我说：将这默示明明地写在版上， 使读的人容易读〔注：或译：随跑随读〕。

chapters.en: For the vision awaits an appointed time; it testifies of the end and does not lie. Though it lingers, wait for it, since it will surely come and will not delay.
chapters.zh: 因为这默示有一定的日期， 快要应验，并不虚谎。 虽然迟延，还要等候； 因为必然临到，不再迟延。

chapters.en: Look at the proud one; his soul is not upright — but the righteous will live by faith —
chapters.zh: 迦勒底人自高自大，心不正直； 惟义人因信得生。

chapters.en: and wealth indeed betrays him. He is an arrogant man never at rest. He enlarges his appetite like Sheol, and like Death, he is never satisfied. He gathers all the nations to himself and collects all the peoples as his own.
chapters.zh: 迦勒底人因酒诡诈，狂傲， 不住在家中， 扩充心欲，好像阴间。 他如死不能知足， 聚集万国，堆积万民都归自己。

chapters.en:
Will not all of these take up a taunt against him, speaking with mockery and derision:
‘Woe to him who amasses what is not his and makes himself rich with many loans!
How long will this go on?’
chapters.zh: 这些国的民岂不都要提起诗歌并俗语讥刺他说： 祸哉！迦勒底人，你增添不属自己的财物， 多多取人的当头，要到几时为止呢？

chapters.en:
Will not your creditors suddenly arise and those who disturb you awaken?
Then you will become their prey.
chapters.zh: 咬伤你的岂不忽然起来， 扰害你的岂不兴起， 你就作他们的掳物吗？

chapters.en:
Because you have plundered many nations, the remnant of the people will plunder you— because of your bloodshed against man and your violence against the land, the city,
and all their dwellers.
chapters.zh: 因你抢夺许多的国，杀人流血， 向国内的城并城中一切居民施行强暴， 所以各国剩下的民都必抢夺你。

chapters.en: Woe to him who builds his house by unjust gain, to place his nest on high and escape the hand of disaster!
chapters.zh: 为本家积蓄不义之财、 在高处搭窝、指望免灾的有祸了！

chapters.en:
You have plotted shame for your house by cutting off many peoples
and forfeiting your life.
chapters.zh: 你图谋剪除多国的民，犯了罪， 使你的家蒙羞，自害己命。

chapters.en: For the stones will cry out from the wall, and the rafters will echo it from the woodwork.
chapters.zh: 墙里的石头必呼叫； 房内的栋梁必应声。

chapters.en: Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed and establishes a town by iniquity!
chapters.zh: 以人血建城、 以罪孽立邑的有祸了！

chapters.en:
Is it not indeed from the LORD of Hosts that the labor of the people only feeds the fire,
and the nations weary themselves in vain?
chapters.zh: 众民所劳碌得来的被火焚烧， 列国由劳乏而得的归于虚空， 不都是出于万军之耶和华吗？

chapters.en:
For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD
as the waters cover the sea.
chapters.zh: 认识耶和华荣耀的知识要充满遍地， 好像水充满洋海一般。

chapters.en:
Woe to him who gives drink to his neighbors, pouring it from the wineskin until they are drunk,
in order to gaze at their nakedness!
chapters.zh: 给人〔酒〕喝、又加上毒物、 使他喝醉、好看见他下体的有祸了！

chapters.en:
You will be filled with shame instead of glory. You too must drink
and expose your uncircumcision! The cup in the LORD’s right hand will come around to you,
and utter disgrace will cover your glory.
chapters.zh: 你满受羞辱，不得荣耀； 你也喝吧，显出是未受割礼的！ 耶和华右手的杯必传到你那里； 你的荣耀就变为大大地羞辱。

chapters.en:
For your violence against Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of animals will terrify you, because of your bloodshed against men and your violence against the land, the city,
and all their dwellers.
chapters.zh: 你向黎巴嫩行强暴与残害 惊吓野兽的事必遮盖你； 因你杀人流血， 向国内的城并城中一切居民施行强暴。

chapters.en: What use is an idol, that a craftsman should carve it— or an image, a teacher of lies? For its maker trusts in his own creation; he makes idols that cannot speak.
chapters.zh: 雕刻的偶像，人将它刻出来， 有什么益处呢？ 铸造的偶像就是虚谎的师傅。 制造者倚靠这哑巴偶像有什么益处呢？

chapters.en:
Woe to him who says to wood, ‘Awake!’ or to silent stone, ‘Arise!’
Can it give guidance? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, yet there is no breath in it at all.”
chapters.zh: 对木偶说：醒起！ 对哑巴石像说：起来！那人有祸了！ 这个还能教训人吗？ 看哪，是包裹金银的，其中毫无气息。

chapters.en: But the LORD is in His holy temple; let all the earth be silent before Him.
chapters.zh: 惟耶和华在他的圣殿中； 全地的人都当在他面前肃敬静默。

chapters.en: This is a prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, according to Shigionoth:
chapters.zh: 先知哈巴谷的祷告，调用流离歌。

chapters.en:
O LORD, I have heard the report of You; I stand in awe, O LORD, of Your deeds. Revive them in these years; make them known in these years.
In Your wrath, remember mercy!
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，我听见你的名声〔注：或译：言语〕就惧怕。 耶和华啊，求你在这些年间复兴你的作为， 在这些年间显明出来； 在发怒的时候以怜悯为念。

chapters.en: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His glory covered the heavens, and His praise filled the earth.
chapters.zh: 上帝从提幔而来； 圣者从巴兰山临到。（细拉） 他的荣光遮蔽诸天； 颂赞充满大地。

chapters.en:
His radiance was like the sunlight; rays flashed from His hand,
where His power is hidden.
chapters.zh: 他的辉煌如同日光； 从他手里〔射出〕光线， 在其中藏着他的能力。

chapters.en: Plague went before Him, and fever followed in His steps.
chapters.zh: 在他前面有瘟疫流行； 在他脚下有热症发出。

chapters.en:
He stood and measured the earth; He looked and startled the nations; the ancient mountains crumbled; the perpetual hills collapsed.
His ways are everlasting.
chapters.zh: 他站立，量了大地〔注：或译：使地震动〕， 观看，赶散万民。 永久的山崩裂； 长存的岭塌陷； 他的作为与古时一样。

chapters.en: I saw the tents of Cushan in distress; the curtains of Midian were trembling.
chapters.zh: 我见古珊的帐棚遭难， 米甸的幔子战兢。

chapters.en:
Were You angry at the rivers, O LORD? Was Your wrath against the streams? Did You rage against the sea when You rode on Your horses,
on Your chariots of salvation?
chapters.zh: 耶和华啊，你乘在马上， 坐在得胜的车上， 岂是不喜悦江河、 向江河发怒气、 向洋海发愤恨吗？

chapters.en: You brandished Your bow; You called for many arrows. Selah You split the earth with rivers.
chapters.zh: 你的弓全然显露， 向众支派所起的誓都是〔可信的〕。（细拉） 你以江河分开大地。

chapters.en: The mountains saw You and quaked; torrents of water swept by. The deep roared with its voice and lifted its hands on high.
chapters.zh: 山岭见你，无不战惧； 大水泛滥过去， 深渊发声，汹涌翻腾〔注：原文是向上举手〕。

chapters.en: Sun and moon stood still in their places at the flash of Your flying arrows, at the brightness of Your shining spear.
chapters.zh: 因你的箭射出发光， 你的枪闪出光耀， 日月都在本宫停住。

chapters.en: You marched across the earth with fury; You threshed the nations in wrath.
chapters.zh: 你发忿恨通行大地， 发怒气责打列国，如同打粮。

chapters.en: You went forth for the salvation of Your people, to save Your anointed. You crushed the head of the house of the wicked and stripped him from head to toe. Selah
chapters.zh: 你出来要拯救你的百姓， 拯救你的受膏者， 打破恶人家长的头， 露出他的脚〔注：原文是根基〕，直到颈项。（细拉）

chapters.en: With his own spear You pierced his head, when his warriors stormed out to scatter us, gloating as though ready to secretly devour the weak.
chapters.zh: 你用〔敌人的〕戈矛刺透他战士的头； 他们来如旋风，要将我们分散。 他们所喜爱的是暗中吞吃贫民。

chapters.en: You trampled the sea with Your horses, churning the great waters.
chapters.zh: 你乘马践踏红海， 就是践踏汹涌的大水。

chapters.en: I heard and trembled within; my lips quivered at the sound. Decay entered my bones; I trembled where I stood. Yet I must wait patiently for the day of distress to come upon the people who invade us.
chapters.zh: 我听见〔耶和华的〕声音， 身体战兢，嘴唇发颤， 骨中朽烂； 我在所立之处战兢。 我只可安静等候灾难之日临到， 犯境之民上来。

chapters.en: Though the fig tree does not bud and no fruit is on the vines, though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food, though the sheep are cut off from the fold and no cattle are in the stalls,
chapters.zh: 虽然无花果树不发旺， 葡萄树不结果， 橄榄树也不效力， 田地不出粮食， 圈中绝了羊， 棚内也没有牛；

chapters.en: yet I will exult in the LORD; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!
chapters.zh: 然而，我要因耶和华欢欣， 因救我的上帝喜乐。

chapters.en:
GOD the Lord is my strength; He makes my feet like those of a deer;
He makes me walk upon the heights! For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments.
chapters.zh: 主耶和华是我的力量； 他使我的脚快如母鹿的〔蹄〕， 又使我稳行在高处。 这歌交与伶长，用丝弦的乐器。

chapters.en: This is the word of the LORD that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah:
chapters.zh: 当犹大王亚们的儿子约西亚在位的时候，耶和华的话临到希西家的玄孙，亚玛利雅的曾孙，基大利的孙子，古示的儿子西番雅。

chapters.en: “I will completely sweep away everything from the face of the earth,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说： 我必从地上除灭万类。

chapters.en: “I will sweep away man and beast; I will sweep away the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea, and the idols with their wicked worshipers. I will cut off mankind from the face of the earth,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必除灭人和牲畜， 与空中的鸟、海里的鱼， 以及绊脚石和恶人； 我必将人从地上剪除。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “I will stretch out My hand against Judah and against all who dwell in Jerusalem. I will cut off from this place every remnant of Baal, the names of the idolatrous and pagan priests—
chapters.zh: 我必伸手攻击犹大 和耶路撒冷的一切居民， 也必从这地方剪除所剩下的巴力， 并基玛林的名和祭司，

chapters.en: those who bow on the rooftops to worship the host of heaven, those who bow down and swear by the LORD but also swear by Milcom,
chapters.zh: 与那些在房顶上敬拜天上万象的， 并那些敬拜耶和华指着他起誓， 又指着玛勒堪起誓的，

chapters.en: and those who turn back from following the LORD, neither seeking the LORD nor inquiring of Him.”
chapters.zh: 与那些转去不跟从耶和华的， 和不寻求耶和华也不访问他的。

chapters.en: Be silent in the presence of the Lord GOD, for the Day of the LORD is near. Indeed, the LORD has prepared a sacrifice; He has consecrated His guests.
chapters.zh: 你要在主耶和华面前静默无声， 因为耶和华的日子快到。 耶和华已经预备祭物， 将他的客分别为圣。

chapters.en: “On the Day of the LORD’s sacrifice I will punish the princes, the sons of the king, and all who are dressed in foreign apparel.
chapters.zh: 到了我－耶和华献祭的日子， 必惩罚首领和王子， 并一切穿外邦衣服的。

chapters.en: On that day I will punish all who leap over the threshold, who fill the house of their master with violence and deceit.
chapters.zh: 到那日，我必惩罚一切跳过门槛、 将强暴和诡诈〔得来之物〕充满主人房屋的。

chapters.en: On that day,” declares the LORD, “a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, a wail from the Second District, and a loud crashing from the hills.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：当那日， 从鱼门必发出悲哀的声音， 从二城发出哀号的声音， 从山间发出大破裂的响声。

chapters.en:
Wail, O dwellers of the Hollow, for all your merchants will be silenced;
all who weigh out silver will be cut off.
chapters.zh: 玛革提施的居民哪，你们要哀号， 因为迦南的商民都灭亡了！ 凡搬运银子的都被剪除。

chapters.en:
And at that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish the men settled in complacency, who say to themselves, ‘The LORD will do nothing,
either good or bad.’
chapters.zh: 那时，我必用灯巡查耶路撒冷； 我必惩罚那些〔如酒〕在渣滓上澄清的； 他们心里说： 耶和华必不降福，也不降祸。

chapters.en: Their wealth will be plundered and their houses laid waste. They will build houses but not inhabit them, and plant vineyards but never drink their wine.
chapters.zh: 他们的财宝必成为掠物； 他们的房屋必变为荒场。 他们必建造房屋，却不得住在其内； 栽种葡萄园，却不得喝所出的酒。

chapters.en: The great Day of the LORD is near— near and coming quickly. Listen, the Day of the LORD! Then the cry of the mighty will be bitter.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的大日临近， 临近而且甚快， 乃是耶和华日子的风声； 勇士必痛痛地哭号。

chapters.en: That day will be a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of destruction and desolation, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,
chapters.zh: 那日是忿怒的日子， 是急难困苦的日子， 是荒废凄凉的日子， 是黑暗幽冥、密云乌黑的日子，

chapters.en:
a day of horn blast and battle cry against the fortified cities,
and against the high corner towers.
chapters.zh: 是吹角吶喊的日子， 要攻击坚固城和高大的城楼。

chapters.en:
I will bring such distress on mankind that they will walk like the blind,
because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.
chapters.zh: 我必使灾祸临到人身上， 使他们行走如同瞎眼的， 因为得罪了我。 他们的血必倒出如灰尘； 他们的肉必抛弃如粪土。

chapters.en:
Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them
on the Day of the LORD’s wrath. The whole earth will be consumed by the fire of His jealousy.”
For indeed, He will make a sudden end of all who dwell on the earth.
chapters.zh: 当耶和华发怒的日子， 他们的金银不能救他们； 他的忿怒如火必烧灭全地， 毁灭这地的一切居民，而且大大毁灭。

chapters.en: Gather yourselves, gather together, O shameful nation,
before the decree takes effect and the day passes like chaff, before the burning anger of the LORD comes upon you, before the Day of the LORD’s anger comes upon you.
chapters.zh: 不知羞耻的国民哪，你们应当聚集！ 趁命令没有发出， 日子过去如〔风前的〕糠， 耶和华的烈怒未临到你们， 他发怒的日子未到以先， 你们应当聚集前来。

chapters.en:
Seek the LORD, all you humble of the earth who carry out His justice. Seek righteousness; seek humility. Perhaps you will be sheltered
on the day of the LORD’s anger.
chapters.zh: 世上遵守耶和华典章的谦卑人哪， 你们都当寻求耶和华！ 当寻求公义谦卑， 或者在耶和华发怒的日子可以隐藏起来。

chapters.en: For Gaza will be abandoned, and Ashkelon left in ruins. Ashdod will be driven out at noon, and Ekron will be uprooted.
chapters.zh: 迦萨必致见弃； 亚实基伦必然荒凉。 人在正午必赶出亚实突的民； 以革伦也被拔出根来。

chapters.en: Woe to the dwellers of the seacoast, O nation of the Cherethites! The word of the LORD is against you, O Canaan, land of the Philistines: “I will destroy you, and no one will be left.”
chapters.zh: 住沿海之地的基利提族有祸了！ 迦南、非利士人之地啊，耶和华的话与你反对， 〔说〕：我必毁灭你，以致无人居住。

chapters.en: So the seacoast will become a land of pastures, with wells for shepherds and folds for sheep.
chapters.zh: 沿海之地要变为草场， 其上有牧人的住处和羊群的圈。

chapters.en: The coast will belong to the remnant of the house of Judah; there they will find pasture. They will lie down in the evening among the houses of Ashkelon, for the LORD their God will attend to them and restore their captives.
chapters.zh: 这地必为犹大家剩下的人所得； 他们必在那里牧放〔群羊〕， 晚上必躺卧在亚实基伦的房屋中； 因为耶和华－他们的上帝必眷顾他们， 使他们被掳的人归回。

chapters.en: “I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the Ammonites, who have taunted My people and threatened their borders.
chapters.zh: 我听见摩押人的毁谤和亚扪人的辱骂， 就是毁谤我的百姓，自夸自大， 侵犯他们的境界。

chapters.en:
Therefore, as surely as I live,” declares the LORD of Hosts,
the God of Israel, “surely Moab will be like Sodom and the Ammonites like Gomorrah— a place of weeds and salt pits, a perpetual wasteland. The remnant of My people will plunder them; the remainder of My nation will dispossess them.”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华－以色列的上帝说： 我指着我的永生起誓： 摩押必像所多玛， 亚扪人必像蛾摩拉， 都变为刺草、盐坑、永远荒废之地。 我百姓所剩下的必掳掠他们； 我国中所余剩的必得着他们的地。

chapters.en:
This they shall have in return for their pride, for taunting and mocking the people
of the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 这事临到他们是因他们骄傲，自夸自大， 毁谤万军之耶和华的百姓。

chapters.en:
The LORD will be terrifying to them when He starves all the gods of the earth. Then the nations of every shore will bow in worship to Him,
each in its own place.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必向他们显可畏之威， 因他必叫世上的诸神瘦弱。 列国海岛的居民各在自己的地方敬拜他。

chapters.en: “You too, O Cushites, will be slain by My sword.”
chapters.zh: 古实人哪，你们必被我的刀所杀。

chapters.en: And He will stretch out His hand against the north and destroy Assyria; He will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as a desert.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必伸手攻击北方，毁灭亚述， 使尼尼微荒凉，又干旱如旷野。

chapters.en:
Herds will lie down in her midst, creatures of every kind. Both the desert owl and screech owl will roost atop her pillars. Their calls will sound from the window, but desolation will lie on the threshold,
for He will expose the beams of cedar.
chapters.zh: 群畜，就是各国〔注：国：或译类〕的走兽必卧在其中； 鹈鹕和箭猪要宿在柱顶上。 在窗户内有鸣叫的声音； 门槛都必毁坏， 香柏木已经露出。

chapters.en: This carefree city that dwells securely, that thinks to herself: “I am it, and there is none besides me,” what a ruin she has become, a resting place for beasts. Everyone who passes by her hisses and shakes his fist.
chapters.zh: 这是素来欢乐安然居住的城， 心里说：惟有我，除我以外再没有别的； 现在何竟荒凉成为野兽躺卧之处！ 凡经过的人都必摇手嗤笑她。

chapters.en: Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!
chapters.zh: 这悖逆、污秽、欺压的城有祸了！

chapters.en: She heeded no voice; she accepted no correction. She does not trust in the LORD; she has not drawn near to her God.
chapters.zh: 她不听从命令，不领受训诲， 不倚靠耶和华， 不亲近她的上帝。

chapters.en:
Her princes are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves,
leaving nothing for the morning.
chapters.zh: 她中间的首领是咆哮的狮子； 她的审判官是晚上的豺狼， 一点〔食物〕也不留到早晨。

chapters.en: Her prophets are reckless, faithless men. Her priests profane the sanctuary; they do violence to the law.
chapters.zh: 她的先知是虚浮诡诈的人； 她的祭司亵渎圣所， 强解律法。

chapters.en:
The LORD within her is righteous; He does no wrong. He applies His justice morning by morning; He does not fail at dawn,
yet the unjust know no shame.
chapters.zh: 耶和华在她中间是公义的， 断不做非义的事， 每早晨显明他的公义，无日不然； 只是不义的人不知羞耻。

chapters.en: “I have cut off the nations; their corner towers are destroyed. I have made their streets deserted with no one to pass through. Their cities are laid waste, with no man, no inhabitant.
chapters.zh: 我－〔耶和华〕已经除灭列国的民； 他们的城楼毁坏。 我使他们的街道荒凉，以致无人经过； 他们的城邑毁灭，以致无人， 也无居民。

chapters.en: I said, ‘Surely you will fear Me and accept correction.’ Then her dwelling place would not be cut off despite all for which I punished her. But they rose early to corrupt all their deeds.
chapters.zh: 我说：你只要敬畏我，领受训诲； 如此，你的住处不致照我所拟定的除灭。 只是你们从早起来就在一切事上败坏自己。

chapters.en: Therefore wait for Me,” declares the LORD, “until the day I rise to testify. For My decision is to gather nations, to assemble kingdoms, to pour out upon them My indignation— all My burning anger. For all the earth will be consumed by the fire of My jealousy.
