chapters.zh: 耶和华说：你们要等候我， 直到我兴起掳掠的日子； 因为我已定意招聚列国，聚集列邦， 将我的恼怒－就是我的烈怒都倾在她们身上。 我的忿怒如火，必烧灭全地。

chapters.en: For then I will restore pure lips to the peoples, that all may call upon the name of the LORD and serve Him shoulder to shoulder.
chapters.zh: 那时，我必使万民用清洁的言语 好求告〔我〕－耶和华的名， 同心合意地事奉我。

chapters.en:
From beyond the rivers of Cush My worshipers, My scattered people,
will bring Me an offering.
chapters.zh: 祈祷我的，就是我所分散的民〔注：原文是女子；下同〕， 必从古实河外来，给我献供物。

chapters.en:
On that day you will not be put to shame for any of the deeds
by which you have transgressed against Me. For then I will remove from among you those who rejoice in their pride, and you will never again be haughty on My holy mountain.
chapters.zh: 当那日，你必不因你一切得罪我的事自觉羞愧； 因为那时我必从你中间除掉矜夸高傲之辈， 你也不再于我的圣山狂傲。

chapters.en: But I will leave within you a meek and humble people, and they will trust in the name of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我却要在你中间留下困苦贫寒的民； 他们必投靠我－耶和华的名。

chapters.en: The remnant of Israel will no longer do wrong or speak lies, nor will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouths. But they will feed and lie down, with no one to make them tremble.”
chapters.zh: 以色列所剩下的人必不作罪孽， 不说谎言，口中也没有诡诈的舌头； 而且吃喝躺卧，无人惊吓。

chapters.en: Sing for joy, O Daughter of Zion; shout aloud, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O Daughter of Jerusalem!
chapters.zh: 锡安的民哪，应当歌唱！ 以色列啊，应当欢呼！ 耶路撒冷的民哪，应当满心欢喜快乐！

chapters.en: The LORD has taken away your punishment; He has turned back your enemy. Israel’s King, the LORD, is among you; no longer will you fear any harm.
chapters.zh: 耶和华已经除去你的刑罚， 赶出你的仇敌。 以色列的王－耶和华在你中间； 你必不再惧怕灾祸。

chapters.en:
On that day they will say to Jerusalem: “Do not fear, O Zion;
do not let your hands fall limp.
chapters.zh: 当那日，必有话向耶路撒冷说： 不要惧怕！锡安哪； 不要手软！

chapters.en:
The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love;
He will rejoice over you with singing.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华－你的上帝是施行拯救、 大有能力的〔主〕。 他在你中间必因你欢欣喜乐， 默然爱你，且因你喜乐而欢呼。

chapters.en:
“I will gather those among you who grieve over the appointed feasts,
so that you will no longer suffer reproach.
chapters.zh: 那些属你、为无大会愁烦、 因你担当羞辱的，我必聚集他们。

chapters.en: Behold, at that time, I will deal with all who afflict you. I will save the lame and gather the scattered; and I will appoint praise and fame for the disgraced throughout the earth.
chapters.zh: 那时，我必罚办一切苦待你的人， 又拯救你瘸腿的，聚集你被赶出的。 那些在全地受羞辱的， 我必使他们得称赞，有名声。

chapters.en: At that time I will bring you in; yes, at that time I will gather you. For I will give you fame and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your captives before your very eyes,” says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 那时，我必领你们进来，聚集你们； 我使你们被掳之人归回的时候， 就必使你们在地上的万民中有名声，得称赞。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: In the second year of the reign of Darius, on the first day of the sixth month, the word of the LORD came through Haggai the prophet to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, stating
chapters.zh: 大流士王第二年六月初一日，耶和华的话藉先知哈该向犹大省长撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚说：

chapters.en:
that this is what the LORD of Hosts says:
“These people say, ‘The time has not yet come to rebuild the house of the LORD.’”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「这百姓说，建造耶和华殿的时候尚未来到。」

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came through Haggai the prophet, saying:
chapters.zh: 那时耶和华的话临到先知哈该说：

chapters.en:
“Is it a time for you yourselves to live in your paneled houses,
while this house lies in ruins?”
chapters.zh: 「这殿仍然荒凉，你们自己还住天花板的房屋吗？

chapters.en:
Now this is what the LORD of Hosts says:
“Consider carefully your ways.
chapters.zh: 现在万军之耶和华如此说：你们要省察自己的行为。

chapters.en: You have planted much but harvested little. You eat but never have enough. You drink but never have your fill. You put on clothes but never get warm. You earn wages to put into a bag pierced through.”
chapters.zh: 你们撒的种多，收的却少；你们吃，却不得饱；喝，却不得足；穿衣服，却不得暖；得工钱的，将工钱〔装〕在破漏的囊中。」

chapters.en:
This is what the LORD of Hosts says:
“Consider carefully your ways.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「你们要省察自己的行为。

chapters.en: Go up into the hills, bring down lumber, and build the house, so that I may take pleasure in it and be glorified, says the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你们要上山取木料，建造这殿，我就因此喜乐，且得荣耀。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
You expected much, but behold, it amounted to little. And what you brought home, I blew away. Why? declares the LORD of Hosts. Because My house still lies in ruins, while each of you is busy
with his own house.
chapters.zh: 你们盼望多得，所得的却少；你们收到家中，我就吹去。这是为什么呢？因为我的殿荒凉，你们各人却顾〔注：原文是奔〕自己的房屋。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
Therefore, on account of you the heavens have withheld their dew
and the earth has withheld its crops.
chapters.zh: 所以为你们的缘故，天就不降甘露，地也不出土产。

chapters.en: I have summoned a drought on the fields and on the mountains, on the grain, new wine, and oil, and on whatever the ground yields, on man and beast, and on all the labor of your hands.”
chapters.zh: 我命干旱临到地土、山冈、五谷、新酒，和油，并地上的出产、人民、牲畜，以及人手一切劳碌得来的。」

chapters.en: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, as well as all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the LORD their God and the words of the prophet Haggai, because the LORD their God had sent him. So the people feared the LORD.
chapters.zh: 那时，撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，并剩下的百姓，都听从耶和华－他们上帝的话和先知哈该奉耶和华－他们上帝差来所说的话；百姓也在耶和华面前存敬畏的心。

chapters.en:
Haggai, the messenger of the LORD, delivered the message of the LORD to the people:
“I am with you,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者哈该奉耶和华差遣对百姓说：「耶和华说：我与你们同在。」

chapters.en: So the LORD stirred the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, as well as the spirit of all the remnant of the people. And they came and began the work on the house of the LORD of Hosts, their God,
chapters.zh: 耶和华激动犹大省长撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，并剩下之百姓的心，他们就来为万军之耶和华－他们上帝的殿做工。

chapters.en: on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month, in the second year of King Darius.
chapters.zh: 这是在大流士王第二年六月二十四日。

chapters.en: On the twenty-first day of the seventh month, the word of the LORD came through Haggai the prophet, saying:
chapters.zh: 七〔月〕二十一〔日〕，耶和华的话临到先知哈该说：

chapters.en: “Speak to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and also to the remnant of the people. Ask them,
chapters.zh: 「你要晓谕犹大省长撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，并剩下的百姓，说：

chapters.en: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How does it look to you now? Does it not appear to you like nothing in comparison?’
chapters.zh: 你们中间存留的，有谁见过这殿从前的荣耀呢？现在你们看着如何？岂不在眼中看如无有吗？」

chapters.en: But now be strong, O Zerubbabel, declares the LORD. Be strong, O Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. And be strong, all you people of the land, declares the LORD. Work! For I am with you, declares the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「所罗巴伯啊，虽然如此，你当刚强！约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚啊，你也当刚强！这地的百姓，你们都当刚强做工，因为我与你们同在。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is the promise I made to you when you came out of Egypt. And My Spirit remains among you; do not be afraid.”
chapters.zh: 这是〔照着〕你们出埃及我与你们立约的话。那时，我的灵住在你们中间，你们不要惧怕。」

chapters.en:
For this is what the LORD of Hosts says:
“Once more, in a little while, I will shake the heavens and the earth,
the sea and the dry land.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「过不多时，我必再一次震动天地、沧海，与旱地。

chapters.en: I will shake all the nations, and they will come with all their treasures, and I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 我必震动万国；万国的珍宝必都运来〔注：或译：万国所羨慕的必来到〕，我就使这殿满了荣耀。这是万军之耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: The silver is Mine, and the gold is Mine, declares the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说：「银子是我的，金子也是我的。

chapters.en:
The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,
says the LORD of Hosts. And in this place I will provide peace, declares the LORD of Hosts.”
chapters.zh: 这殿后来的荣耀必大过先前的荣耀；在这地方我必赐平安。这是万军之耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to Haggai the prophet, saying,
chapters.zh: 大流士王第二年九〔月〕二十四〔日〕，耶和华的话临到先知哈该说：

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Ask the priests for a ruling.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「你要向祭司问律法，

chapters.en:
If a man carries consecrated meat in the fold of his garment, and it touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any other food, does that item become holy?’”
“No,” replied the priests.
chapters.zh: 说：若有人用衣襟兜圣肉，这衣襟挨着饼，或汤，或酒，或油，或别的食物，便算为圣吗？」祭司说：「不算为圣。」

chapters.en:
So Haggai asked, “If one who is defiled by contact with a corpse touches any of these, does it become defiled?”
“Yes, it becomes defiled,” the priests answered.
chapters.zh: 哈该又说：「若有人因摸死尸染了污秽，然后挨着这些物的哪一样，这物算污秽吗？」祭司说：「必算污秽。」

chapters.en: Then Haggai replied, “So it is with this people and this nation before Me, declares the LORD, and so it is with every work of their hands; whatever they offer there is defiled.
chapters.zh: 于是哈该说：「耶和华说：这民这国，在我面前也是如此；他们手下的各样工作都是如此；他们在坛上所献的也是如此。」

chapters.en: Now consider carefully from this day forward: Before one stone was placed on another in the temple of the LORD,
chapters.zh: 现在你们要追想，此日以前，耶和华的殿没有一块石头垒在石头上的光景。

chapters.en: from that time, when one came expecting a heap of twenty ephahs of grain, there were but ten. When one came to the winepress to draw out fifty baths, there were but twenty.
chapters.zh: 在那一切日子，有人来到〔谷〕堆，想得二十〔斗〕，只得了十〔斗〕。有人来到酒池，想得五十〔桶〕，只得了二十〔桶〕。

chapters.en: I struck you—all the work of your hands—with blight, mildew, and hail, but you did not turn to Me, declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 在你们手下的各样工作上，我以旱风、霉烂、冰雹攻击你们，你们仍不〔归向〕我。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Consider carefully from this day forward—from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, the day the foundation of the LORD’s temple was laid—consider carefully:
chapters.zh: 你们要追想此日以前，就是从这九月二十四日起，追想到立耶和华殿根基的日子。

chapters.en: Is there still seed in the barn? The vine, the fig, the pomegranate, and the olive tree have not yet yielded fruit. But from this day on, I will bless you.”
chapters.zh: 仓里有谷种吗？葡萄树、无花果树、石榴树、橄榄树都没有结果子。从今日起，我必赐福〔与你们〕。

chapters.en: For the second time that day, the twenty-fourth day of the month, the word of the LORD came to Haggai, saying,
chapters.zh: 这月二十四日，耶和华的话二次临到哈该说：

chapters.en: “Tell Zerubbabel governor of Judah that I am about to shake the heavens and the earth:
chapters.zh: 「你要告诉犹大省长所罗巴伯说：我必震动天地。

chapters.en:
I will overturn royal thrones and destroy the power
of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overturn chariots and their riders; horses and their riders will fall,
each by the sword of his brother.
chapters.zh: 我必倾覆列国的宝座，除灭列邦的势力，并倾覆战车和坐在其上的。马必跌倒，骑马的败落，各人被弟兄的刀所杀。

chapters.en:
On that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, I will take you, My servant, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel,
declares the LORD, and I will make you like My signet ring, for I have chosen you,
declares the LORD of Hosts.”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说：我仆人撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯啊，到那日，我必以你为印，因我拣选了你。这是万军之耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: In the eighth month of the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying:
chapters.zh: 大流士〔王〕第二年八月，耶和华的话临到易多的孙子、比利家的儿子先知撒迦利亚，说：

chapters.en: “The LORD was very angry with your fathers.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华曾向你们列祖大大发怒。

chapters.en: So tell the people that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Return to Me, declares the LORD of Hosts, and I will return to you, says the LORD of Hosts.’
chapters.zh: 所以你要对以色列人说，万军之耶和华如此说：你们要转向我，我就转向你们。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
Do not be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Turn now from your evil ways and deeds.’
But they did not listen or pay attention to Me, declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 不要效法你们列祖。从前的先知呼叫他们说，万军之耶和华如此说：『你们要回头离开你们的恶道恶行。』他们却不听，也不顺从我。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Where are your fathers now? And the prophets, do they live forever?
chapters.zh: 你们的列祖在哪里呢？那些先知能永远存活吗？

chapters.en: But did not My words and My statutes, which I commanded My servants the prophets, overtake your fathers? They repented and said, ‘Just as the LORD of Hosts purposed to do to us according to our ways and deeds, so He has done to us.’”
chapters.zh: 只是我的言语和律例，就是所吩咐我仆人众先知的，岂不临到你们列祖吗？他们就回头，说：『万军之耶和华定意按我们的行动作为向我们怎样行，他已照样行了。』」

chapters.en: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, the month of Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo.
chapters.zh: 大流士第二年十一月，就是细罢特月二十四日，耶和华的话临到易多的孙子、比利家的儿子先知撒迦利亚，说：

chapters.en: I looked out into the night and saw a man riding on a red horse. He was standing among the myrtle trees in the hollow, and behind him were red, sorrel, and white horses.
chapters.zh: 「我夜间观看，见一人骑着红马，站在洼地番石榴树中间。在他身后又有红马、黄马，和白马。」

chapters.en:
“What are these, my lord?” I asked.
And the angel who was speaking with me replied, “I will show you what they are.”
chapters.zh: 我对与我说话的天使说：「主啊，这是什么意思？」他说：「我要指示你这是什么意思。」

chapters.en: Then the man standing among the myrtle trees explained, “They are the ones the LORD has sent to patrol the earth.”
chapters.zh: 那站在番石榴树中间的人说：「这是奉耶和华差遣在遍地走来走去的。」

chapters.en: And the riders answered the angel of the LORD who was standing among the myrtle trees, “We have patrolled the earth, and behold, all the earth is at rest and tranquil.”
chapters.zh: 那些骑马的对站在番石榴树中间耶和华的使者说：「我们已在遍地走来走去，见全地都安息平静。」

chapters.en: Then the angel of the LORD said, “How long, O LORD of Hosts, will You withhold mercy from Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, with which You have been angry these seventy years?”
chapters.zh: 于是，耶和华的使者说：「万军之耶和华啊，你恼恨耶路撒冷和犹大的城邑已经七十年，你不施怜悯要到几时呢？」

chapters.en: So the LORD spoke kind and comforting words to the angel who was speaking with me.
chapters.zh: 耶和华就用美善的安慰话回答那与我说话的天使。

chapters.en: Then the angel who was speaking with me said, “Proclaim this word: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘I am very jealous for Jerusalem and Zion,
chapters.zh: 与我说话的天使对我说：「你要宣告说，万军之耶和华如此说：我为耶路撒冷为锡安，心里极其火热。

chapters.en: but I am fiercely angry with the nations that are at ease. For I was a little angry, but they have added to the calamity. ’
chapters.zh: 我甚恼怒那安逸的列国，因我从前稍微恼怒〔我民〕，他们就加害过分。

chapters.en: Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘I will return to Jerusalem with mercy, and there My house will be rebuilt, declares the LORD of Hosts, and a measuring line will be stretched out over Jerusalem.’
chapters.zh: 所以耶和华如此说：现今我回到耶路撒冷，仍施怜悯，我的殿必重建在其中，准绳必拉在耶路撒冷之上。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Proclaim further that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘My cities will again overflow with prosperity; the LORD will again comfort Zion and choose Jerusalem.’”
chapters.zh: 你要再宣告说，万军之耶和华如此说：我的城邑必再丰盛发达。耶和华必再安慰锡安，拣选耶路撒冷。」

chapters.en: Then I looked up and saw four horns.
chapters.zh: 我举目观看，见有四角。

chapters.en:
So I asked the angel who was speaking with me, “What are these?”
And he told me, “These are the horns that have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.”
chapters.zh: 我就问与我说话的天使说：「这是什么意思？」他回答说：「这是打散犹大、以色列，和耶路撒冷的角。」

chapters.en: Then the LORD showed me four craftsmen.
chapters.zh: 耶和华又指四个匠人给我看。

chapters.en:
“What are these coming to do?” I asked.
And He replied, “These are the horns that scattered Judah so that no one could raise his head; but the craftsmen have come to terrify them and throw down these horns of the nations that have lifted up their horns against the land of Judah to scatter it.”
chapters.zh: 我说：「他们来做什么呢？」他说：「这是打散犹大的角，使人不敢抬头；但这些匠人来威吓列国，打掉他们的角，就是举起打散犹大地的角。」

chapters.en: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw a man with a measuring line in his hand.
chapters.zh: 我又举目观看，见一人手拿准绳。

chapters.en:
“Where are you going?” I asked.
“To measure Jerusalem,” he replied, “and to determine its width and length.”
chapters.zh: 我说：「你往哪里去？」他对我说：「要去量耶路撒冷，看有多宽多长。」

chapters.en: Then the angel who was speaking with me went forth, and another angel came forward to meet him
chapters.zh: 与我说话的天使去的时候，又有一位天使迎着他来，

chapters.en: and said to him, “Run and tell that young man: ‘Jerusalem will be a city without walls because of the multitude of men and livestock within it.
chapters.zh: 对他说：「你跑去告诉那少年人说，耶路撒冷必有人居住，好像无城墙的乡村，因为人民和牲畜甚多。

chapters.en: For I will be a wall of fire around it, declares the LORD, and I will be the glory within it.’”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：我要作耶路撒冷四围的火城，并要作其中的荣耀。」

chapters.en: “Get up! Get up! Flee from the land of the north,” declares the LORD, “for I have scattered you like the four winds of heaven,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我从前分散你们在天的四方〔注：原文是犹如天的四风〕，现在你们要从北方之地逃回。这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Get up, O Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the Daughter of Babylon!”
chapters.zh: 与巴比伦人同住的锡安民哪，应当逃脱。

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “After His Glory has sent Me against the nations that have plundered you—for whoever touches you touches the apple of His eye—
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说，在显出荣耀之后，差遣我去〔惩罚〕那掳掠你们的列国，摸你们的就是摸他眼中的瞳人。

chapters.en: I will surely wave My hand over them, so that they will become plunder for their own servants. Then you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent Me.”
chapters.zh: 看哪，我〔注：或译：他〕要向他们抡手，他们就必作服事他们之人的掳物，你们便知道万军之耶和华差遣我了。

chapters.en: “Shout for joy and be glad, O Daughter of Zion, for I am coming to dwell among you,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 锡安城啊，应当欢乐歌唱，因为我来要住在你中间。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: “On that day many nations will join themselves to the LORD, and they will become My people. I will dwell among you, and you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent Me to you.
chapters.zh: 那时，必有许多国归附耶和华，作他〔注：原文是我〕的子民。他〔注：原文是我〕要住在你中间，你就知道万军之耶和华差遣我到你那里去了。

chapters.en: And the LORD will take possession of Judah as His portion in the Holy Land, and He will once again choose Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必收回犹大作他圣地的分，也必再拣选耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: Be silent before the LORD, all people, for He has roused Himself from His holy dwelling.”
chapters.zh: 凡有血气的都当在耶和华面前静默无声；因为他兴起，从圣所出来了。

chapters.en: Then the angel showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, with Satan standing at his right hand to accuse him.
chapters.zh: 天使〔注：原文是他〕又指给我看：大祭司约书亚站在耶和华的使者面前；撒但也站在约书亚的右边，与他作对。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to Satan: “The LORD rebukes you, Satan! Indeed, the LORD, who has chosen Jerusalem, rebukes you! Is not this man a firebrand snatched from the fire?”
chapters.zh: 耶和华向撒但说：「撒但哪，耶和华责备你！就是拣选耶路撒冷的耶和华责备你！这不是从火中抽出来的一根柴吗？」

chapters.en: Now Joshua was dressed in filthy garments as he stood before the angel.
chapters.zh: 约书亚穿着污秽的衣服站在使者面前。

chapters.en:
So the angel said to those standing before him, “Take off his filthy clothes!”
Then he said to Joshua, “See, I have removed your iniquity, and I will clothe you with splendid robes.”
chapters.zh: 使者吩咐站在面前的说：「你们要脱去他污秽的衣服」；又对约书亚说：「我使你脱离罪孽，要给你穿上华美的衣服。」

chapters.en: Then I said, “Let them put a clean turban on his head.” So a clean turban was placed on his head, and they clothed him, as the angel of the LORD stood by.
chapters.zh: 我说：「要将洁净的冠冕戴在他头上。」他们就把洁净的冠冕戴在他头上，给他穿上〔华美的〕衣服，耶和华的使者在旁边站立。

chapters.en: Then the angel of the LORD gave this charge to Joshua:
chapters.zh: 耶和华的使者告诫约书亚说：

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘If you walk in My ways and keep My instructions, then you will govern My house and will also have charge of My courts; and I will give you a place among these who are standing here.
chapters.zh: 「万军之耶和华如此说：你若遵行我的道，谨守我的命令，你就可以管理我的家，看守我的院宇；我也要使你在这些站立的人中间来往。

chapters.en: Hear now, O high priest Joshua, you and your companions seated before you, who are indeed a sign. For behold, I am going to bring My servant, the Branch.
chapters.zh: 大祭司约书亚啊，你和坐在你面前的同伴都当听。（他们是作预兆的。）我必使我仆人〔大卫〕的苗裔发出。

chapters.en: See the stone I have set before Joshua; on that one stone are seven eyes. Behold, I will engrave on it an inscription, declares the LORD of Hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of this land in a single day.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我在约书亚面前所立的石头，在一块石头上有七眼。万军之耶和华说：我要亲自雕刻这石头，并要在一日之间除掉这地的罪孽。

chapters.en: On that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, you will each invite your neighbor to sit under your own vine and fig tree.’”
chapters.zh: 当那日，你们各人要请邻舍坐在葡萄树和无花果树下。这是万军之耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: Then the angel who was speaking with me returned and woke me, as a man is awakened from his sleep.
chapters.zh: 那与我说话的天使又来叫醒我，好像人睡觉被唤醒一样。

chapters.en:
“What do you see?” he asked.
“I see a solid gold lampstand,” I replied, “with a bowl at the top and seven lamps on it, with seven spouts to the lamps.
chapters.zh: 他问我说：「你看见了什么？」我说：「我看见了一个纯金的灯台，顶上有灯盏，灯台上有七盏灯，每盏有七个管子。

chapters.en: There are also two olive trees beside it, one on the right side of the bowl and the other on its left.”
chapters.zh: 旁边有两棵橄榄树，一棵在灯盏的右边，一棵在灯盏的左边。」

chapters.en: “What are these, my lord?” I asked the angel who was speaking with me.
chapters.zh: 我问与我说话的天使说：「主啊，这是什么意思？」

chapters.en:
“Do you not know what they are?” replied the angel.
“No, my lord,” I answered.
chapters.zh: 与我说话的天使回答我说：「你不知道这是什么意思吗？」我说：「主啊，我不知道。」

chapters.en: So he said to me, “This is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel: Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit, says the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 他对我说：「这是耶和华指示所罗巴伯的。万军之耶和华说：不是倚靠势力，不是倚靠才能，乃是倚靠我的灵〔方能成事〕。

chapters.en: What are you, O great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you will become a plain. Then he will bring forth the capstone accompanied by shouts of ‘Grace, grace to it!’”
chapters.zh: 大山哪，你算什么呢？在所罗巴伯面前，你必成为平地。他必搬出一块石头，安在〔殿〕顶上。人且大声欢呼说：『愿恩惠恩惠归与这殿〔注：殿：或译石〕！』」

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：

chapters.en: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house, and his hands will complete it. Then you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent me to you.
chapters.zh: 「所罗巴伯的手立了这殿的根基，他的手也必完成这工，你就知道万军之耶和华差遣我到你们这里来了。

chapters.en: For who has despised the day of small things? But these seven eyes of the LORD, which scan the whole earth, will rejoice when they see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel.”
chapters.zh: 谁藐视这日的事为小呢？这七〔眼〕乃是耶和华的眼睛，遍察全地，见所罗巴伯手拿线铊就欢喜。」

chapters.en: Then I asked the angel, “What are the two olive trees on the right and left of the lampstand?”
chapters.zh: 我又问天使说：「这灯台左右的两棵橄榄树是什么意思？」

chapters.en: And I questioned him further, “What are the two olive branches beside the two gold pipes from which the golden oil pours?”
chapters.zh: 我二次问他说：「这两根橄榄枝在两个流出金色〔油〕的金嘴旁边是什么意思？」

chapters.en:
“Do you not know what these are?” he inquired.
“No, my lord,” I replied.
chapters.zh: 他对我说：「你不知道这是什么意思吗？」我说：「主啊，我不知道。」

chapters.en: So he said, “These are the two anointed ones who are standing beside the Lord of all the earth.”
chapters.zh: 他说：「这是两个受膏者站在普天下主的旁边。」

chapters.en: Again I lifted up my eyes and saw before me a flying scroll.
chapters.zh: 我又举目观看，见有一飞行的书卷。

chapters.en:
“What do you see?” asked the angel.
“I see a flying scroll,” I replied, “twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide. ”
chapters.zh: 他问我说：「你看见什么？」我回答说：「我看见一飞行的书卷，长二十肘，宽十肘。」

chapters.en: Then he told me, “This is the curse that is going out over the face of all the land, for according to one side of the scroll, every thief will be removed; and according to the other side, every perjurer will be removed.
chapters.zh: 他对我说：「这是发出行在遍地上的咒诅。凡偷窃的必按卷上这面的话除灭；凡起〔假〕誓的必按卷上那面的话除灭。

chapters.en: I will send it out, declares the LORD of Hosts, and it will enter the house of the thief and the house of him who swears falsely by My name. It will remain inside his house and destroy it, down to its timbers and stones.”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说：我必使这书卷出去，进入偷窃人的家和指我名起假誓人的家，必常在他家里，连房屋带木石都毁灭了。」

chapters.en: Then the angel who was speaking with me came forward and told me, “Now lift up your eyes and see what is approaching.”
chapters.zh: 与我说话的天使出来，对我说：「你要举目观看，见所出来的是什么？」

chapters.en:
“What is it?” I asked.
And he replied, “A measuring basket is going forth.” Then he continued, “This is their iniquity in all the land.”
chapters.zh: 我说：「这是什么呢？」他说：「这出来的是量器。」他又说：「这是恶人在遍地的形状。」

chapters.en: And behold, the cover of lead was raised, and there was a woman sitting inside the basket.
chapters.zh: （我见有一片圆铅被举起来。）这坐在量器中的是个妇人。

chapters.en: “This is Wickedness,” he said. And he shoved her down into the basket, pushing down the lead cover over its opening.
chapters.zh: 天使说：「这是罪恶。」他就把妇人扔在量器中，将那片圆铅扔在量器的口上。

chapters.en: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw two women approaching, with the wind in their wings. Their wings were like those of a stork, and they lifted up the basket between heaven and earth.
chapters.zh: 我又举目观看，见有两个妇人出来，在她们翅膀中有风，〔飞得甚快〕，翅膀如同鹳鸟的翅膀。她们将量器抬起来，悬在天地中间。

chapters.en: “Where are they taking the basket?” I asked the angel who was speaking with me.
chapters.zh: 我问与我说话的天使说：「她们要将量器抬到哪里去呢？」

chapters.en: “To build a house for it in the land of Shinar, ” he told me. “And when it is ready, the basket will be set there on its pedestal.”
chapters.zh: 他对我说：「要往示拿地去，为它盖造房屋；等房屋齐备，就把它安置在自己的地方。」

chapters.en: And again I lifted up my eyes and saw four chariots coming out from between two mountains—mountains of bronze.
chapters.zh: 我又举目观看，见有四辆车从两山中间出来；那山是铜山。

chapters.en: The first chariot had red horses, the second black horses,
chapters.zh: 第一辆车套着红马，第二辆车套着黑马。

chapters.en: the third white horses, and the fourth dappled horses—all of them strong.
chapters.zh: 第三辆车套着白马，第四辆车套着有斑点的壮马。

chapters.en: So I inquired of the angel who was speaking with me, “What are these, my lord?”
chapters.zh: 我就问与我说话的天使说：「主啊，这是什么意思？」

chapters.en: And the angel told me, “These are the four spirits of heaven, going forth from their station before the Lord of all the earth.
chapters.zh: 天使回答我说：「这是天的四风，是从普天下的主面前出来的。」

chapters.en: The one with the black horses is going toward the land of the north, the one with the white horses toward the west, and the one with the dappled horses toward the south.”
chapters.zh: 套着黑马的〔车〕往北方去，白马跟随在后；有斑点的马往南方去。

chapters.en: As the strong horses went out, they were eager to go and patrol the earth; and the LORD said, “Go and patrol the earth.” So they patrolled the earth.
chapters.zh: 壮马出来，要在遍地走来走去。天使说：「你们只管在遍地走来走去。」牠们就照样行了。

chapters.en: Then the LORD summoned me and said, “Behold, those going to the land of the north have given rest to My Spirit in the land of the north.”
chapters.zh: 他又呼叫我说：「看哪，往北方去的已在北方安慰我的心。」

chapters.en: The word of the LORD also came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: “Take an offering from the exiles—from Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah, who have arrived from Babylon—and go that same day to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah.
chapters.zh: 「你要从被掳之人中取黑玳、多比雅、耶大雅的〔金银〕。这三人是从巴比伦来到西番雅的儿子约西亚的家里。当日你要进他的家，

chapters.en: Take silver and gold, make an ornate crown, and set it on the head of the high priest, Joshua son of Jehozadak.
chapters.zh: 取这金银做冠冕，戴在约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚的头上，

chapters.en: And you are to tell him that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Here is a man whose name is the Branch, and He will branch out from His place and build the temple of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 对他说，万军之耶和华如此说：看哪，那名称为大卫苗裔的，他要在本处长起来，并要建造耶和华的殿。

chapters.en: Yes, He will build the temple of the LORD; He will be clothed in splendor and will sit on His throne and rule. And He will be a priest on His throne, and there will be peaceful counsel between the two.’
chapters.zh: 他要建造耶和华的殿，并担负尊荣，坐在位上掌王权；又必在位上作祭司，使两职之间筹定和平。

chapters.en: The crown will reside in the temple of the LORD as a memorial to Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and the gracious son of Zephaniah.
chapters.zh: 这冠冕要归希连〔注：就是黑玳〕、多比雅、耶大雅，和西番雅的儿子贤〔注：就是约西亚〕，放在耶和华的殿里为记念。」

chapters.en: Even those far away will come and build the temple of the LORD, and you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent Me to you. This will happen if you diligently obey the voice of the LORD your God.”
chapters.zh: 远方的人也要来建造耶和华的殿，你们就知道万军之耶和华差遣我到你们这里来。你们若留意听从耶和华－你们上帝的话，〔这事〕必然成就。

chapters.en: In the fourth year of King Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.
chapters.zh: 大流士王第四年九月，就是基斯流月初四日，耶和华的话临到撒迦利亚。

chapters.en: Now the people of Bethel had sent Sharezer and Regem-melech, along with their men, to plead before the LORD
chapters.zh: 那时伯特利人已经打发沙利色和利坚米勒，并跟从他们的人，去恳求耶和华的恩，

chapters.en: by asking the priests of the house of the LORD of Hosts, as well as the prophets, “Should I weep and fast in the fifth month, as I have done these many years?”
chapters.zh: 并问万军之耶和华殿中的祭司和先知说：「我历年以来，在五月间哭泣斋戒，现在还当这样行吗？」

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD of Hosts came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华的话就临到我说：

chapters.en: “Ask all the people of the land and the priests, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months for these seventy years, was it really for Me that you fasted?
chapters.zh: 「你要宣告国内的众民和祭司，说：『你们这七十年，在五月、七月禁食悲哀，岂是丝毫向我禁食吗？

chapters.en: And when you were eating and drinking, were you not doing so simply for yourselves?
chapters.zh: 你们吃喝，不是为自己吃，为自己喝吗？

chapters.en: Are these not the words that the LORD proclaimed through the earlier prophets, when Jerusalem and its surrounding towns were populous and prosperous, and the Negev and the foothills were inhabited?’”
chapters.zh: 当耶路撒冷和四围的城邑有居民，正兴盛，南地高原有人居住的时候，耶和华藉从前的先知所宣告的话，你们不〔当听〕吗？』」

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD came to Zechariah, saying,
chapters.zh: 耶和华的话又临到撒迦利亚说：

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Administer true justice. Show loving devotion and compassion to one another.
chapters.zh: 「万军之耶和华曾对〔你们的列祖〕如此说：『要按至理判断，各人以慈爱怜悯弟兄。

chapters.en: Do not oppress the widow or the fatherless, the foreigner or the poor. And do not plot evil in your hearts against one another.’
chapters.zh: 不可欺压寡妇、孤儿、寄居的，和贫穷人。谁都不可心里谋害弟兄。』」

chapters.en: But they refused to pay attention and turned a stubborn shoulder; they stopped up their ears from hearing.
chapters.zh: 他们却不肯听从，扭转肩头，塞耳不听，

chapters.en: They made their hearts like flint and would not listen to the law or to the words that the LORD of Hosts had sent by His Spirit through the earlier prophets. Therefore great anger came from the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 使心硬如金钢石，不听律法和万军之耶和华用灵藉从前的先知所说的话。故此，万军之耶和华大发烈怒。

chapters.en: And just as I had called and they would not listen, so when they called I would not listen, says the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说：「我曾呼唤他们，他们不听；将来他们呼求我，我也不听！

chapters.en: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations that they had not known, and the land was left desolate behind them so that no one could come or go. Thus they turned the pleasant land into a desolation.”
chapters.zh: 我必以旋风吹散他们到素不认识的万国中。这样，他们的地就荒凉，甚至无人来往经过，因为他们使美好之地荒凉了。」

chapters.en: Again the word of the LORD of Hosts came to me, saying:
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “I am jealous for Zion with great zeal; I am jealous for her with great fervor.”
chapters.zh: 「万军之耶和华如此说：我为锡安心里极其火热，我为她火热，向〔她的仇敌〕发烈怒。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD says: “I will return to Zion and dwell in Jerusalem. Then Jerusalem will be called the City of Truth, and the mountain of the LORD of Hosts will be called the Holy Mountain.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华如此说：我现在回到锡安，要住在耶路撒冷中。耶路撒冷必称为诚实的城，万军之耶和华的山必称为圣山。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Old men and old women will again sit along the streets of Jerusalem, each with a staff in hand because of great age.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：将来必有年老的男女坐在耶路撒冷街上，因为年纪老迈就手拿柺杖。

chapters.en: And the streets of the city will be filled with boys and girls playing there.”
chapters.zh: 城中街上必满有男孩女孩玩耍。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “If this is impossible in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be impossible in My eyes?” declares the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：到那日，这事在余剩的民眼中看为希奇，在我眼中也看为希奇吗？这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “I will save My people from the land of the east and from the land of the west.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：我要从东方从西方救回我的民。

chapters.en: I will bring them back to dwell in Jerusalem, where they will be My people, and I will be their faithful and righteous God.”
chapters.zh: 我要领他们来，使他们住在耶路撒冷中。他们要作我的子民，我要作他们的上帝，都凭诚实和公义。」

chapters.en: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Let your hands be strong, you who now hear these words spoken by the prophets who were present when the foundations were laid to rebuild the temple, the house of the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「当建造万军之耶和华的殿，立根基之日的先知所说的话，现在你们听见，应当手里强壮。

chapters.en: For before those days neither man nor beast received wages, nor was there safety from the enemy for anyone who came or went, for I had turned every man against his neighbor.
chapters.zh: 那日以先，人得不着雇价，牲畜也是如此；且因敌人的缘故，出入之人不得平安，乃因我使众人互相攻击。

chapters.en: But now I will not treat the remnant of this people as I did in the past,” declares the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 但如今，我待这余剩的民必不像从前。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “For the seed will be prosperous, the vine will yield its fruit, the ground will yield its produce, and the skies will give their dew. To the remnant of this people I will give all these things as an inheritance.
chapters.zh: 因为他们必平安撒种，葡萄树必结果子，地土必有出产，天也必降甘露。我要使这余剩的民享受这一切的福。

chapters.en: As you have been a curse among the nations, O house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you will be a blessing. Do not be afraid; let your hands be strong.”
chapters.zh: 犹大家和以色列家啊，你们从前在列国中怎样成为可咒诅的；照样，我要拯救你们，使人称你们为有福的〔注：或译：使你们叫人得福〕。你们不要惧怕，手要强壮。」

chapters.en: For this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Just as I resolved to bring disaster upon you when your fathers provoked Me to anger, and I did not relent,” says the LORD of Hosts,
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「你们列祖惹我发怒的时候，我怎样定意降祸，并不后悔。

chapters.en: “so now I have resolved to do good again to Jerusalem and Judah. Do not be afraid.
chapters.zh: 现在我照样定意施恩与耶路撒冷和犹大家，你们不要惧怕。

chapters.en: These are the things you must do: Speak truth to one another, render true and sound judgments in your gates,
chapters.zh: 你们所当行的是这样：各人与邻舍说话诚实，在城门口按至理判断，使人和睦。

chapters.en: do not plot evil in your hearts against your neighbor, and do not love to swear falsely, for I hate all these things,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 谁都不可心里谋害邻舍，也不可喜爱起假誓，因为这些事都为我所恨恶。这是耶和华说的。」

chapters.en: Then the word of the LORD of Hosts came to me, saying,
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华的话临到我说：

chapters.en: “This is what the LORD of Hosts says: The fasts of the fourth, the fifth, the seventh, and the tenth months will become times of joy and gladness, cheerful feasts for the house of Judah. Therefore you are to love both truth and peace.”
chapters.zh: 「万军之耶和华如此说：四月、五月禁食的日子，七月、十月禁食的日子，必变为犹大家欢喜快乐的日子和欢乐的节期；所以你们要喜爱诚实与和平。」

chapters.en: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Peoples will yet come—the residents of many cities—
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「将来必有列国的人和多城的居民来到。

chapters.en: and the residents of one city will go to another, saying: ‘Let us go at once to plead before the LORD and to seek the LORD of Hosts. I myself am going.’
chapters.zh: 这城的居民必到那城，说：『我们要快去恳求耶和华的恩，寻求万军之耶和华；我也要去。』

chapters.en: And many peoples and strong nations will come to seek the LORD of Hosts in Jerusalem and to plead before the LORD.”
chapters.zh: 必有列邦的人和强国的民来到耶路撒冷寻求万军之耶和华，恳求耶和华的恩。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “In those days ten men from the nations of every tongue will tightly grasp the robe of a Jew, saying, ‘Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.’”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：在那些日子，必有十个人从列国诸族〔注：原文是方言〕中出来，拉住一个犹大人的衣襟，说：『我们要与你们同去，因为我们听见上帝与你们同在了。』」

chapters.en:
This is the burden of the word of the LORD against the land of Hadrach
and Damascus its resting place— for the eyes of men and of all the tribes of Israel
are upon the LORD —
chapters.zh: 耶和华的默示应验在哈得拉地大马士革 －世人和以色列各支派的眼目都仰望耶和华－

chapters.en: and also against Hamath, which borders it, as well as Tyre and Sidon, though they are very shrewd.
chapters.zh: 和靠近的哈马，并泰尔、西顿； 因为这二城的人大有智慧。

chapters.en:
Tyre has built herself a fortress; she has heaped up silver like dust,
and gold like the dirt of the streets.
chapters.zh: 泰尔为自己修筑保障， 积蓄银子如尘沙， 堆起精金如街上的泥土。

chapters.en:
Behold, the Lord will impoverish her and cast her wealth into the sea,
and she will be consumed by fire.
chapters.zh: 主必赶出她， 打败她海上的权利； 她必被火烧灭。

chapters.en: Ashkelon will see and fear; Gaza will writhe in agony, as will Ekron, for her hope will wither. There will cease to be a king in Gaza, and Ashkelon will be uninhabited.
chapters.zh: 亚实基伦看见必惧怕； 迦萨看见甚痛苦； 以革伦因失了盼望蒙羞。 迦萨必不再有君王； 亚实基伦也不再有居民。

chapters.en: A mixed race will occupy Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
chapters.zh: 私生子〔注：或译：外族人〕必住在亚实突； 我必除灭非利士人的骄傲。

chapters.en:
I will remove the blood from their mouths and the abominations from between their teeth. Then they too will become a remnant for our God; they will become like a clan in Judah,
and Ekron will be like the Jebusites.
chapters.zh: 我必除去他口中带血之肉 和牙齿内可憎之物。 他必作为余剩的人归与我们的上帝， 必在犹大像族长； 以革伦人必如耶布斯人。

chapters.en: But I will camp around My house because of an army, because of those who march to and fro, and never again will an oppressor overrun My people, for now I keep watch with My own eyes.
chapters.zh: 我必在我家的四围安营， 使敌军不得任意往来， 暴虐的人也不再经过， 因为我亲眼看顾〔我的家〕。

chapters.en: Rejoice greatly, O Daughter of Zion! Shout in triumph, O Daughter of Jerusalem! See, your King comes to you, righteous and victorious, humble and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
chapters.zh: 锡安的民哪，应当大大喜乐； 耶路撒冷的民哪，应当欢呼。 看哪，你的王来到你这里！ 他是公义的，并且施行拯救， 谦谦和和地骑着驴， 就是骑着驴的驹子。

chapters.en:
And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem,
and the bow of war will be broken. Then He will proclaim peace to the nations. His dominion will extend from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.
chapters.zh: 我必除灭以法莲的战车 和耶路撒冷的战马； 争战的弓也必除灭。 他必向列国讲和平； 他的权柄必从这海管到那海， 从大河管到地极。

chapters.en: As for you, because of the blood of My covenant, I will release your prisoners from the waterless pit.
chapters.zh: 锡安哪，我因与你立约的血， 将你中间被掳而囚的人从无水的坑中释放出来。

chapters.en: Return to your stronghold, O prisoners of hope; even today I declare that I will restore to you double.
chapters.zh: 你们被囚而有指望的人都要转回保障。 我今日说明，我必加倍赐福给你们。

chapters.en: For I will bend Judah as My bow and fit it with Ephraim. I will rouse your sons, O Zion, against the sons of Greece. I will make you like the sword of a mighty man.
chapters.zh: 我拿犹大作上弦的弓； 我拿以法莲为张弓的箭。 锡安哪，我要激发你的众子， 攻击希腊〔注：原文是雅完〕的众子，使你如勇士的刀。

chapters.en: Then the LORD will appear over them, and His arrow will go forth like lightning. The Lord GOD will sound the ram’s horn and advance in the whirlwinds of the south.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必显现在他们以上； 他的箭必射出像闪电。 主耶和华必吹角， 乘南方的旋风而行。

chapters.en:
The LORD of Hosts will shield them. They will destroy and conquer with slingstones;
they will drink and roar as with wine. And they will be filled like sprinkling bowls, drenched like the corners of the altar.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华必保护他们； 他们必吞灭〔仇敌〕，践踏弹石。 他们必喝〔血〕吶喊，犹如饮酒； 他们必像盛满〔血〕的碗， 又像坛的四角满了〔血〕。

chapters.en: On that day the LORD their God will save them as the flock of His people; for like jewels in a crown they will sparkle over His land.
chapters.zh: 当那日，耶和华－他们的上帝 必看他的民如群羊，拯救他们； 因为〔他们必像〕冠冕上的宝石， 高举在他的地以上〔注：或译：在他的地上发光辉〕。

chapters.en: How lovely they will be, and how beautiful! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine, the young women.
chapters.zh: 他的恩慈何等大！ 他的荣美何其盛！ 五谷健壮少男； 新酒培养处女。

chapters.en: Ask the LORD for rain in springtime; the LORD makes the storm clouds, and He will give everyone showers of rain and crops in the field.
chapters.zh: 当春雨的时候， 你们要向发闪电的耶和华求雨。 他必为众人降下甘霖， 使田园生长菜蔬。

chapters.en: For idols speak deceit and diviners see illusions; they tell false dreams and offer empty comfort. Therefore the people wander like sheep, oppressed for lack of a shepherd.
chapters.zh: 因为，家神所言的是虚空； 卜士所见的是虚假； 做梦者所说的是假梦。 他们白白地安慰人， 所以众人如羊流离， 因无牧人就受苦。

chapters.en: “My anger burns against the shepherds, and I will punish the leaders. For the LORD of Hosts attends to His flock, the house of Judah; He will make them like His royal steed in battle.
chapters.zh: 我的怒气向牧人发作； 我必惩罚公山羊； 因我－万军之耶和华 眷顾自己的羊群，就是〔犹大〕家， 必使他们如骏马在阵上。

chapters.en: The cornerstone will come from Judah, the tent peg from him, as well as the battle bow and every ruler together.
chapters.zh: 房角石、钉子、争战的弓， 和一切掌权的都从他而出。

chapters.en: They will be like mighty men in battle, trampling the enemy in the mire of the streets. They will fight because the LORD is with them, and they will put the horsemen to shame.
chapters.zh: 他们必如勇士在阵上 将〔仇敌〕践踏在街上的泥土中。 他们必争战，因为耶和华与他们同在； 骑马的也必羞愧。

chapters.en: I will strengthen the house of Judah and save the house of Joseph. I will restore them because I have compassion on them, and they will be as though I had not rejected them. For I am the LORD their God, and I will answer them.
chapters.zh: 我要坚固犹大家，拯救约瑟家， 要领他们归回。 我要怜恤他们； 他们必像未曾弃绝的一样， 都因我是耶和华－他们的上帝， 我必应允他们〔的祷告〕。

chapters.en: Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their hearts will be glad as with wine. Their children will see it and be joyful; their hearts will rejoice in the LORD.
chapters.zh: 以法莲人必如勇士； 他们心中畅快如同喝酒； 他们的儿女必看见而快活； 他们的心必因耶和华喜乐。

chapters.en: I will whistle for them to gather, for I have redeemed them; and they will be as numerous as they once were.
chapters.zh: 我要发嘶声，聚集他们， 因我已经救赎他们。 他们的人数必加增， 如从前加增一样。

chapters.en: Though I sow them among the nations, they will remember Me in distant lands; they and their children will live and return.
chapters.zh: 我虽然〔注：或译：必〕播散他们在列国中， 他们必在远方记念我。 他们与儿女都必存活，且得归回。

chapters.en: I will bring them back from Egypt and gather them from Assyria. I will bring them to Gilead and Lebanon until no more room is found for them.
chapters.zh: 我必再领他们出埃及地， 招聚他们出亚述， 领他们到基列和黎巴嫩； 这地尚且不够他们居住。

chapters.en:
They will pass through the sea of distress and strike the waves of the sea;
all the depths of the Nile will dry up. The pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必经过苦海，击打海浪， 使尼罗河的深处都枯干。 亚述的骄傲必致卑微； 埃及的权柄必然灭没。

chapters.en: I will strengthen them in the LORD, and in His name they will walk,” declares the LORD.
chapters.zh: 我必使他们倚靠我，得以坚固； 一举一动必奉我的名。 这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: Open your doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may consume your cedars!
chapters.zh: 黎巴嫩哪，开开你的门， 任火烧灭你的香柏树。

chapters.en: Wail, O cypress, for the cedar has fallen; the majestic trees are ruined! Wail, O oaks of Bashan, for the dense forest has been cut down!
chapters.zh: 松树啊，应当哀号； 因为香柏树倾倒，佳美的树毁坏。 巴珊的橡树啊，应当哀号， 因为茂盛的树林已经倒了。

chapters.en: Listen to the wailing of the shepherds, for their glory is in ruins. Listen to the roaring of the young lions, for the thickets of the Jordan are destroyed.
chapters.zh: 听啊，有牧人哀号的声音， 因他们荣华〔的草场〕毁坏了。 有少壮狮子咆哮的声音， 因约旦河旁的丛林荒废了。

chapters.en: This is what the LORD my God says: “Pasture the flock marked for slaughter,
chapters.zh: 耶和华－我的上帝如此说：「你－撒迦利亚要牧养这将宰的群羊。

chapters.en: whose buyers slaughter them without remorse. Those who sell them say, ‘Blessed be the LORD, for I am rich!’ Even their own shepherds have no compassion on them.
chapters.zh: 买他们的宰了他们，以自己为无罪；卖他们的说：『耶和华是应当称颂的，因我成为富足。』牧养他们的并不怜恤他们。

chapters.en: For I will no longer have compassion on the people of the land, declares the LORD, but behold, I will cause each man to fall into the hands of his neighbor and his king, who will devastate the land, and I will not deliver it from their hands.”
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：『我不再怜恤这地的居民，必将这民交给各人的邻舍和他们王的手中。他们必毁灭这地，我也不救这民脱离他们的手。』」

chapters.en: So I pastured the flock marked for slaughter, especially the afflicted of the flock. Then I took for myself two staffs, calling one Favor and the other Union, and I pastured the flock.
chapters.zh: 于是，我牧养这将宰的群羊，就是群中最困苦的羊。我拿着两根杖，一根我称为「荣美」，一根我称为「联索」。这样，我牧养了群羊。

chapters.en:
And in one month I dismissed three shepherds.
My soul grew impatient with the flock, and their souls also detested me.
chapters.zh: 一月之内，我除灭三个牧人，因为我的心厌烦他们；他们的心也憎嫌我。

chapters.en: Then I said, “I will no longer shepherd you. Let the dying die, and the perishing perish; and let those who remain devour one another’s flesh.”
chapters.zh: 我就说：「我不牧养你们。要死的，由他死；要丧亡的，由他丧亡；余剩的，由他们彼此相食。」

chapters.en: Next I took my staff called Favor and cut it in two, revoking the covenant I had made with all the nations.
chapters.zh: 我折断那称为「荣美」的杖，表明我废弃与万民所立的约。

chapters.en: It was revoked on that day, and so the afflicted of the flock who were watching me knew that it was the word of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 当日就废弃了。这样，那些仰望我的困苦羊就知道所说的是耶和华的话。

chapters.en: Then I told them, “If it seems right to you, give me my wages; but if not, keep them.” So they weighed out my wages, thirty pieces of silver.
chapters.zh: 我对他们说：「你们若以为美，就给我工价。不然，就罢了！」于是他们给了三十块钱作为我的工价。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to me, “Throw it to the potter”—this magnificent price at which they valued me. So I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter in the house of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 耶和华吩咐我说：「要把众人所估定美好的价值丢给窑户。」我便将这三十块钱，在耶和华的殿中丢给窑户了。

chapters.en: Then I cut in two my second staff called Union, breaking the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
chapters.zh: 我又折断称为「联索」的那根杖，表明我废弃犹大与以色列弟兄的情谊。

chapters.en: And the LORD said to me: “Take up once more the equipment of a foolish shepherd.
chapters.zh: 耶和华又吩咐我说：「你再取愚昧牧人所用的器具，

chapters.en: For behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will neither care for the lost, nor seek the young, nor heal the broken, nor sustain the healthy, but he will devour the flesh of the choice sheep and tear off their hooves.
chapters.zh: 因我要在这地兴起一个牧人。他不看顾丧亡的，不寻找分散的，不医治受伤的，也不牧养强壮的；却要吃肥〔羊〕的肉，撕裂牠的蹄子。

chapters.en: Woe to the worthless shepherd, who deserts the flock! May a sword strike his arm and his right eye! May his arm be completely withered and his right eye utterly blinded!”
chapters.zh: 无用的牧人丢弃羊群有祸了！ 刀必临到他的膀臂和右眼上。 他的膀臂必全然枯干； 他的右眼也必昏暗失明。」

chapters.en:
This is the burden of the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
Thus declares the LORD, who stretches out the heavens and lays the foundation of the earth, who forms the spirit of man within him:
chapters.zh: 耶和华论以色列的默示。 铺张诸天、建立地基、造人里面之灵的耶和华说：

chapters.en: “Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of drunkenness to all the surrounding peoples. Judah will be besieged, as well as Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 「我必使耶路撒冷被围困的时候，向四围列国的民成为令人昏醉的杯；这默示也论到犹大〔注：或译：犹大也是如此〕。

chapters.en: On that day, when all the nations of the earth gather against her, I will make Jerusalem a heavy stone for all the peoples; all who would heave it away will be severely injured.
chapters.zh: 那日，我必使耶路撒冷向聚集攻击他的万民当作一块重石头；凡举起的必受重伤。

chapters.en: On that day, declares the LORD, I will strike every horse with panic, and every rider with madness. I will keep a watchful eye on the house of Judah, but I will strike with blindness all the horses of the nations.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：到那日，我必使一切马匹惊惶，使骑马的颠狂。我必看顾犹大家，使列国的一切马匹瞎眼。

chapters.en: Then the leaders of Judah will say in their hearts: ‘The people of Jerusalem are my strength, for the LORD of Hosts is their God.’
chapters.zh: 犹大的族长必心里说：『耶路撒冷的居民倚靠万军之耶和华－他们的上帝，就作我们的能力。』

chapters.en: On that day I will make the clans of Judah like a firepot in a woodpile, like a flaming torch among the sheaves; they will consume all the peoples around them on the right and on the left, while the people of Jerusalem remain secure there.
chapters.zh: 「那日，我必使犹大的族长如火盆在木柴中，又如火把在禾捆里；他们必左右烧灭四围列国的民。耶路撒冷人必仍住本处，就是耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: The LORD will save the tents of Judah first, so that the glory of the house of David and of the people of Jerusalem may not be greater than that of Judah.
chapters.zh: 「耶和华必先拯救犹大的帐棚，免得大卫家的荣耀和耶路撒冷居民的荣耀胜过犹大。

chapters.en: On that day the LORD will defend the people of Jerusalem, so that the weakest among them will be like David, and the house of David will be like God, like the angel of the LORD going before them.
chapters.zh: 那日，耶和华必保护耶路撒冷的居民。他们中间软弱的必如大卫；大卫的家必如上帝，如行在他们前面之耶和华的使者。

chapters.en: So on that day I will set out to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 那日，我必定意灭绝来攻击耶路撒冷各国的民。

chapters.en: Then I will pour out on the house of David and on the people of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and prayer, and they will look on Me, the One they have pierced. They will mourn for Him as one mourns for an only child, and grieve bitterly for Him as one grieves for a firstborn son.
chapters.zh: 「我必将那施恩叫人恳求的灵，浇灌大卫家和耶路撒冷的居民。他们必仰望我〔注：或译：他；本节同〕，就是他们所扎的；必为我悲哀，如丧独生子，又为我愁苦，如丧长子。

chapters.en: On that day the wailing in Jerusalem will be as great as the wailing of Hadad-rimmon in the plain of Megiddo.
chapters.zh: 那日，耶路撒冷必有大大的悲哀，如米吉多平原之哈达临门的悲哀。

chapters.en: The land will mourn, each clan on its own: the clan of the house of David and their wives, the clan of the house of Nathan and their wives,
chapters.zh: 境内一家一家地都必悲哀。大卫家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。拿单家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。

chapters.en: the clan of the house of Levi and their wives, the clan of Shimei and their wives,
chapters.zh: 利未家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。示每家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。

chapters.en: and all the remaining clans and their wives.
chapters.zh: 其余的各家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。

chapters.en: “On that day a fountain will be opened to the house of David and the people of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from sin and impurity.
chapters.zh: 「那日，必给大卫家和耶路撒冷的居民开一个泉源，洗除罪恶与污秽。」

chapters.en: And on that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, I will erase the names of the idols from the land, and they will no longer be remembered. I will also remove the prophets and the spirit of impurity from the land.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说：「那日，我必从地上除灭偶像的名，不再被人记念；也必使这地不再有〔假〕先知与污秽的灵。

chapters.en: And if anyone still prophesies, his father and mother who bore him will say to him, ‘You shall not remain alive, because you have spoken falsely in the name of the LORD.’ When he prophesies, his father and mother who bore him will pierce him through.
chapters.zh: 若再有人说预言，生他的父母必对他说：『你不得存活，因为你讬耶和华的名说假预言。』生他的父母在他说预言的时候，要将他刺透。

chapters.en: And on that day every prophet who prophesies will be ashamed of his vision, and he will not put on a hairy cloak in order to deceive.
chapters.zh: 那日，凡作先知说预言的必因他所论的异象羞愧，不再穿毛衣哄骗人。

chapters.en: He will say, ‘I am not a prophet; I work the land, for I was purchased as a servant in my youth. ’
chapters.zh: 他必说：『我不是先知，我是耕地的；我从幼年作人的奴仆。』

chapters.en: If someone asks him, ‘What are these wounds on your chest ?’ he will answer, ‘These are the wounds I received in the house of my friends.’
chapters.zh: 必有人问他说：『你两臂中间是什么伤呢？』他必回答说：『这是我在亲友家中所受的伤。』」

chapters.en:
Awake, O sword, against My Shepherd, against the man who is My Companion,
declares the LORD of Hosts. Strike the Shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered, and I will turn My hand against the little ones.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说： 刀剑哪，应当兴起， 攻击我的牧人和我的同伴。 击打牧人，羊就分散； 我必反手加在微小者的身上。

chapters.en: And in all the land, declares the LORD, two-thirds will be cut off and perish, but a third will be left in it.
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：这全地的人， 三分之二必剪除而死， 三分之一仍必存留。

chapters.en:
This third I will bring through the fire; I will refine them like silver
and test them like gold. They will call on My name, and I will answer them. I will say, ‘They are My people,’ and they will say, ‘The LORD is our God.’”
chapters.zh: 我要使这三分之一经火， 熬炼他们，如熬炼银子； 试炼他们，如试炼金子。 他们必求告我的名， 我必应允他们。 我要说：这是我的子民。 他们也要说：耶和华是我〔们〕的上帝。

chapters.en: Behold, a day of the LORD is coming when your plunder will be divided in your presence.
chapters.zh: 耶和华的日子临近，你的财物必被抢掠，在你中间分散。

chapters.en: For I will gather all the nations for battle against Jerusalem, and the city will be captured, the houses looted, and the women ravished. Half of the city will go into exile, but the rest of the people will not be removed from the city.
chapters.zh: 因为我必聚集万国与耶路撒冷争战，城必被攻取，房屋被抢夺，妇女被玷污，城中的民一半被掳去；剩下的民仍在城中，不致剪除。

chapters.en: Then the LORD will go out to fight against those nations, as He fights in the day of battle.
chapters.zh: 那时，耶和华必出去与那些国争战，好像从前争战一样。

chapters.en: On that day His feet will stand on the Mount of Olives, east of Jerusalem, and the Mount of Olives will be split in two from east to west, forming a great valley, with half the mountain moving to the north and half to the south.
chapters.zh: 那日，他的脚必站在耶路撒冷前面朝东的橄榄山上。这山必从中间分裂，自东至西成为极大的谷。山的一半向北挪移，一半向南挪移。

chapters.en: You will flee by My mountain valley, for it will extend to Azal. You will flee as you fled from the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Then the LORD my God will come, and all the holy ones with Him.
chapters.zh: 你们要从我山的谷中逃跑，因为山谷必延到亚萨。你们逃跑，必如犹大王乌西雅年间的人逃避大地震一样。耶和华－我的上帝必降临，有一切圣者同来。

chapters.en: On that day there will be no light, no cold or frost.
chapters.zh: 那日，必没有光，三光必退缩。

chapters.en: It will be a unique day known only to the LORD, without day or night; but when evening comes, there will be light.
chapters.zh: 那日，必是耶和华所知道的，不是白昼，也不是黑夜，到了晚上才有光明。

chapters.en: And on that day living water will flow out from Jerusalem, half of it toward the Eastern Sea and the other half toward the Western Sea, in summer and winter alike.
chapters.zh: 那日，必有活水从耶路撒冷出来，一半往东海流，一半往西海流；冬夏都是如此。

chapters.en: On that day the LORD will become King over all the earth—the LORD alone, and His name alone.
chapters.zh: 耶和华必作全地的王。那日耶和华必为独一无二的，他的名也是独一无二的。

chapters.en: All the land from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem will be turned into a plain, but Jerusalem will be raised up and will remain in her place, from the Benjamin Gate to the site of the First Gate to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the royal winepresses.
chapters.zh: 全地，从迦巴直到耶路撒冷南方的临门，要变为亚拉巴。耶路撒冷必仍居高位，就是从便雅悯门到第一门之处，又到角门，并从哈楠业楼，直到王的酒醡。

chapters.en: People will live there, and never again will there be an utter destruction. So Jerusalem will dwell securely.
chapters.zh: 人必住在其中，不再有咒诅。耶路撒冷人必安然居住。

chapters.en: And this will be the plague with which the LORD strikes all the peoples who have warred against Jerusalem: Their flesh will rot while they stand on their feet, their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongues will rot in their mouths.
chapters.zh: 耶和华用灾殃攻击那与耶路撒冷争战的列国人，必是这样：他们两脚站立的时候，肉必消没，眼在眶中干瘪，舌在口中溃烂。

chapters.en: On that day a great panic from the LORD will come upon them, so that each will seize the hand of another, and the hand of one will rise against the other.
chapters.zh: 那日，耶和华必使他们大大扰乱。他们各人彼此揪住，举手攻击。

chapters.en: Judah will also fight at Jerusalem, and the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be collected—gold, silver, and apparel in great abundance.
chapters.zh: 犹大也必在耶路撒冷争战。那时四围各国的财物，就是许多金银衣服，必被收聚。

chapters.en: And a similar plague will strike the horses and mules, camels and donkeys, and all the animals in those camps.
chapters.zh: 那临到马匹、骡子、骆驼、驴，和营中一切牲畜的灾殃是与那灾殃一般。

chapters.en: Then all the survivors from the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up year after year to worship the King, the LORD of Hosts, and to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.
chapters.zh: 所有来攻击耶路撒冷列国中剩下的人，必年年上来敬拜〔大〕君王－万军之耶和华，并守住棚节。

chapters.en: And should any of the families of the earth not go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of Hosts, then the rain will not fall on them.
chapters.zh: 地上〔万〕族中，凡不上耶路撒冷敬拜〔大〕君王－万军之耶和华的，必无雨降在他们的地上。

chapters.en: And if the people of Egypt will not go up and enter in, then the rain will not fall on them; this will be the plague with which the LORD strikes the nations who do not go up to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.
chapters.zh: 埃及族若不上来，〔雨〕也不降在他们的地上；凡不上来守住棚节的列国人，耶和华也必用这灾攻击他们。

chapters.en: This will be the punishment of Egypt and of all the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.
chapters.zh: 这就是埃及的刑罚和那不上来守住棚节之列国的刑罚。

chapters.en: On that day, HOLY TO THE LORD will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, and the cooking pots in the house of the LORD will be like the sprinkling bowls before the altar.
chapters.zh: 当那日，马的铃铛上必有「归耶和华为圣」的这句话。耶和华殿内的锅必如祭坛前的碗一样。

chapters.en: Indeed, every pot in Jerusalem and Judah will be holy to the LORD of Hosts, and all who sacrifice will come and take some pots and cook in them. And on that day there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 凡耶路撒冷和犹大的锅都必归万军之耶和华为圣。凡献祭的都必来取这锅，煮〔肉〕在其中。当那日，在万军之耶和华的殿中必不再有迦南人。

chapters.en: This is the burden of the word of the LORD to Israel through Malachi:
chapters.zh: 耶和华藉玛拉基传给以色列的默示。

chapters.en:
“I have loved you,” says the LORD.
But you ask, “How have You loved us?”
“Was not Esau Jacob’s brother?” declares the LORD. “Yet Jacob I have loved,
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「我曾爱你们。」你们却说：「你在何事上爱我们呢？」耶和华说：「以扫不是雅各的哥哥吗？我却爱雅各，

chapters.en: but Esau I have hated, and I have made his mountains a wasteland and left his inheritance to the desert jackals. ”
chapters.zh: 恶以扫，使他的山岭荒凉，把他的地业〔交给〕旷野的野狗。」

chapters.en: Though Edom may say, “We have been devastated, but we will rebuild the ruins,” this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “They may build, but I will demolish. They will be called the Land of Wickedness, and a people with whom the LORD is indignant forever.
chapters.zh: 以东人说：「我们现在虽被毁坏，却要重建荒废之处。」万军之耶和华如此说：「任他们建造，我必拆毁；人必称他们的地为『罪恶之境』；称他们的民为『耶和华永远恼怒之民』。」

chapters.en: You will see this with your own eyes, and you yourselves will say, ‘The LORD is great—even beyond the borders of Israel.’”
chapters.zh: 你们必亲眼看见，也必说：「愿耶和华在以色列境界之外被尊为大！」

chapters.en:
“A son honors his father, and a servant his master. But if I am a father, where is My honor? And if I am a master, where is your fear of Me?” says the LORD of Hosts to you priests who despise My name.
“But you ask, ‘How have we despised Your name?’
chapters.zh: 「藐视我名的祭司啊，万军之耶和华对你们说：儿子尊敬父亲，仆人敬畏主人；我既为父亲，尊敬我的在哪里呢？我既为主人，敬畏我的在哪里呢？你们却说：『我们在何事上藐视你的名呢？』

chapters.en:
By presenting defiled food on My altar.
But you ask, ‘How have we defiled You ?’
By saying that the table of the LORD is contemptible.
chapters.zh: 你们将污秽的食物献在我的坛上，且说：『我们在何事上污秽你呢？』因你们说，耶和华的桌子是可藐视的。

chapters.en: When you offer blind animals for sacrifice, is it not wrong? And when you present the lame and sick ones, is it not wrong? Try offering them to your governor! Would he be pleased with you or show you favor?” asks the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 你们将瞎眼的献为祭物，这不为恶吗？将瘸腿的、有病的献上，这不为恶吗？你献给你的省长，他岂喜悦你，岂能看你的情面吗？这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “But ask now for God’s favor. Will He be gracious? Since this has come from your hands, will He show you favor?” asks the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 「现在我劝你们恳求上帝，他好施恩与我们。这〔妄献〕的事，既由你们经手，他岂能看你们的情面吗？这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Oh, that one of you would shut the temple doors, so that you would no longer kindle useless fires on My altar! I take no pleasure in you,” says the LORD of Hosts, “and I will accept no offering from your hands.
chapters.zh: 甚愿你们中间有一人关上〔殿〕门，免得你们徒然在我坛上烧〔火〕。万军之耶和华说：我不喜悦你们，也不从你们手中收纳供物。

chapters.en: For My name will be great among the nations, from where the sun rises to where it sets. In every place, incense and pure offerings will be presented in My name, because My name will be great among the nations,” says the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说：从日出之地到日落之处，我的名在外邦中必尊为大。在各处，人必奉我的名烧香，献洁净的供物，因为我的名在外邦中必尊为大。

chapters.en: “But you profane it when you say, ‘The table of the Lord is defiled, and as for its fruit, its food is contemptible.’
chapters.zh: 你们却亵渎我的名，说：『耶和华的桌子是污秽的，其上的食物是可藐视的。』

chapters.en:
You also say: ‘Oh, what a nuisance!’ And you turn up your nose at it,” says the LORD of Hosts.
“You bring offerings that are stolen, lame, or sick! Should I accept these from your hands?” asks the LORD.
chapters.zh: 你们又说：『这些事何等烦琐！』并嗤之以鼻。这是万军之耶和华说的。你们把抢夺的、瘸腿的、有病的拿来献上为祭。我岂能从你们手中收纳呢？这是耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “But cursed is the deceiver who has an acceptable male in his flock and vows to give it, but sacrifices a defective animal to the Lord. For I am a great King,” says the LORD of Hosts, “and My name is to be feared among the nations.
chapters.zh: 行诡诈的在群中有公羊，他许愿却用有残疾的献给主，这人是可咒诅的。因为我是大君王，我的名在外邦中是可畏的。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “And now this decree is for you, O priests:
chapters.zh: 「众祭司啊，这诫命是传给你们的。

chapters.en: If you do not listen, and if you do not take it to heart to honor My name,” says the LORD of Hosts, “I will send a curse among you, and I will curse your blessings. Yes, I have already begun to curse them, because you are not taking it to heart.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说：你们若不听从，也不放在心上，将荣耀归与我的名，我就使咒诅临到你们，使你们的福分变为咒诅；因你们不把诫命放在心上，我已经咒诅你们了。

chapters.en: Behold, I will rebuke your descendants, and I will spread dung on your faces, the waste from your feasts, and you will be carried off with it.
chapters.zh: 我必斥责你们的种子，又把你们牺牲的粪抹在你们的脸上；你们要与粪一同除掉。

chapters.en: Then you will know that I have sent you this commandment so that My covenant with Levi may continue,” says the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 你们就知道我传这诫命给你们，使我与利未〔注：或译：利未人〕所立的约可以常存。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “My covenant with him was one of life and peace, which I gave to him; it called for reverence, and he revered Me and stood in awe of My name.
chapters.zh: 我曾与他立生命和平安的约。我将这两样赐给他，使他存敬畏的心，他就敬畏我，惧怕我的名。

chapters.en: True instruction was in his mouth, and nothing false was found on his lips. He walked with Me in peace and uprightness, and he turned many from iniquity.
chapters.zh: 真实的律法在他口中，他嘴里没有不义的话。他以平安和正直与我同行，使多人回头离开罪孽。

chapters.en: For the lips of a priest should preserve knowledge, and people should seek instruction from his mouth, because he is the messenger of the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 祭司的嘴里当存知识，人也当由他口中寻求律法，因为他是万军之耶和华的使者。

chapters.en: But you have departed from the way, and your instruction has caused many to stumble. You have violated the covenant of Levi,” says the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 你们却偏离正道，使许多人在律法上跌倒。你们废弃〔我〕与利未所立的约。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “So I in turn have made you despised and humiliated before all the people, because you have not kept My ways, but have shown partiality in matters of the law.”
chapters.zh: 所以我使你们被众人藐视，看为下贱；因你们不守我的道，竟在律法上瞻徇情面。」

chapters.en: Do we not all have one Father? Did not one God create us? Why then do we break faith with one another so as to profane the covenant of our fathers?
chapters.zh: 我们岂不都是一位父吗？岂不是一位上帝所造的吗？我们各人怎么以诡诈待弟兄，背弃了〔上帝〕与我们列祖所立的约呢？

chapters.en: Judah has broken faith; an abomination has been committed in Israel and in Jerusalem. For Judah has profaned the LORD’s beloved sanctuary by marrying the daughter of a foreign god.
chapters.zh: 犹大人行事诡诈，并且在以色列和耶路撒冷中行一件可憎的事；因为犹大人亵渎耶和华所喜爱的圣洁〔注：或译：圣地〕，娶〔事奉〕外邦神的女子为妻。

chapters.en: As for the man who does this, may the LORD cut off from the tents of Jacob everyone who is awake and aware—even if he brings an offering to the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 凡行这事的，无论何人〔注：何人：原文是叫醒的，答应的〕，就是献供物给万军之耶和华，耶和华也必从雅各的帐棚中剪除他。

chapters.en: And this is another thing you do: You cover the altar of the LORD with tears, with weeping and groaning, because He no longer regards your offerings or receives them gladly from your hands.
chapters.zh: 你们又行了一件这样的事，使〔前妻〕叹息哭泣的眼泪遮盖耶和华的坛，以致耶和华不再看顾那供物，也不乐意从你们手中收纳。

chapters.en:
Yet you ask, “Why?”
It is because the LORD has been a witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have broken faith, though she is your companion and your wife by covenant.
chapters.zh: 你们还说：「这是为什么呢？」因耶和华在你和你幼年所娶的妻中间作见证。她虽是你的配偶，又是你盟约的妻，你却以诡诈待她。

chapters.en: Has not the LORD made them one, having a portion of the Spirit? And why one? Because He seeks godly offspring. So guard yourselves in your spirit and do not break faith with the wife of your youth.
chapters.zh: 虽然上帝有灵的余〔力能造多人〕，他不是单造一人吗？为何只造一人呢？乃是他愿人得虔诚的后裔。所以当谨守你们的心，谁也不可以诡诈待幼年所娶的妻。

chapters.en: “For I hate divorce,” says the LORD, the God of Israel. “He who divorces his wife covers his garment with violence,” says the LORD of Hosts. So guard yourselves in your spirit and do not break faith.
chapters.zh: 耶和华－以色列的上帝说：「休妻的事和以强暴待妻的人都是我所恨恶的！所以当谨守你们的心，不可行诡诈。」这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en:
You have wearied the LORD with your words; yet you ask, “How have we wearied Him?”
By saying, “All who do evil are good in the sight of the LORD, and in them He delights,” or, “Where is the God of justice?”
chapters.zh: 你们用言语烦琐耶和华，你们还说：「我们在何事上烦琐他呢？」因为你们说：「凡行恶的，耶和华眼看为善，并且他喜悦他们」；或说：「公义的上帝在哪里呢？」

chapters.en: “Behold, I will send My messenger, who will prepare the way before Me. Then the Lord whom you seek will suddenly come to His temple—the Messenger of the covenant, in whom you delight—see, He is coming,” says the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说：「我要差遣我的使者在我前面预备道路。你们所寻求的主必忽然进入他的殿；立约的使者，就是你们所仰慕的，快要来到。」

chapters.en: But who can endure the day of His coming? And who can stand when He appears? For He will be like a refiner’s fire, like a launderer’s soap.
chapters.zh: 他来的日子，谁能当得起呢？他显现的时候，谁能立得住呢？因为他如炼〔金〕之人的火，如漂布之人的碱。

chapters.en: And He will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver; He will purify the sons of Levi and refine them like gold and silver. Then they will present offerings to the LORD in righteousness.
chapters.zh: 他必坐下如炼净银子的，必洁净利未人，熬炼他们像金银一样；他们就凭公义献供物给耶和华。

chapters.en: Then the offerings of Judah and Jerusalem will please the LORD, as in days of old and years gone by.
chapters.zh: 那时，犹大和耶路撒冷所献的供物必蒙耶和华悦纳，仿佛古时之日、上古之年。

chapters.en: “Then I will draw near to you for judgment. And I will be a swift witness against sorcerers and adulterers and perjurers, against oppressors of the widowed and fatherless, and against those who defraud laborers of their wages and deny justice to the foreigner but do not fear Me,” says the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说：「我必临近你们，施行审判。我必速速作见证，警戒行邪术的、犯奸淫的、起假誓的、亏负人之工价的、欺压寡妇孤儿的、屈枉寄居的，和不敬畏我的。」

chapters.en: “Because I, the LORD, do not change, you descendants of Jacob have not been destroyed.
chapters.zh: 「因我－耶和华是不改变的，所以你们雅各之子没有灭亡。

chapters.en:
Yet from the days of your fathers, you have turned away from My statutes and have not kept them. Return to Me, and I will return to you,” says the LORD of Hosts.
“But you ask, ‘How can we return?’
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说：从你们列祖的日子以来，你们常常偏离我的典章而不遵守。现在你们要转向我，我就转向你们。你们却问说：『我们如何才是转向呢？』

chapters.en:
Will a man rob God? Yet you are robbing Me!
But you ask, ‘How do we rob You?’
In tithes and offerings.
chapters.zh: 人岂可夺取上帝之物呢？你们竟夺取我〔的供物〕。你们却说：『我们在何事上夺取你〔的供物〕呢？』就是你们在当纳的十分之一和当献的供物上。

chapters.en: You are cursed with a curse, yet you—the whole nation—are still robbing Me.
chapters.zh: 因你们通国的人都夺取我〔的供物〕，咒诅就临到你们身上。

chapters.en: Bring the full tithe into the storehouse, so that there may be food in My house. Test Me in this,” says the LORD of Hosts. “See if I will not open the windows of heaven and pour out for you blessing without measure.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说：你们要将当纳的十分之一全然送入仓库，使我家有粮，以此试试我，是否为你们敞开天上的窗户，倾福与你们，甚至无处可容。

chapters.en: I will rebuke the devourer for you, so that it will not destroy the fruits of your land, and the vine in your field will not fail to produce fruit,” says the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说：我必为你们斥责蝗虫〔注：原文是吞噬者〕，不容牠毁坏你们的土产。你们田间的葡萄树在未熟之先也不掉果子。

chapters.en: “Then all the nations will call you blessed, for you will be a land of delight,” says the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说：万国必称你们为有福的，因你们的地必成为喜乐之地。」

chapters.en: “Your words against Me have been harsh,” says the LORD. “Yet you ask, ‘What have we spoken against You?’
chapters.zh: 耶和华说：「你们用话顶撞我，你们还说：『我们用什么话顶撞了你呢？』

chapters.en: You have said, ‘It is futile to serve God. What have we gained by keeping His requirements and walking mournfully before the LORD of Hosts?
chapters.zh: 你们说：『事奉上帝是徒然的，遵守上帝所吩咐的，在万军之耶和华面前苦苦斋戒，有什么益处呢？

chapters.en: So now we call the arrogant blessed. Not only do evildoers prosper, they even test God and escape.’”
chapters.zh: 如今我们称狂傲的人为有福，并且行恶的人得建立；他们虽然试探上帝，却得脱离〔灾难〕。』」

chapters.en: At that time those who feared the LORD spoke with one another, and the LORD listened and heard them. So a scroll of remembrance was written before Him regarding those who feared the LORD and honored His name.
chapters.zh: 那时，敬畏耶和华的彼此谈论，耶和华侧耳而听，且有纪念册在他面前，记录那敬畏耶和华、思念他名的人。

chapters.en: “They will be Mine,” says the LORD of Hosts, “on the day when I prepare My treasured possession. And I will spare them as a man spares his own son who serves him.
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说：「在我所定的日子，他们必属我，特特归我。我必怜恤他们，如同人怜恤服事自己的儿子。

chapters.en: So you will again distinguish between the righteous and the wicked, between those who serve God and those who do not.”
chapters.zh: 那时你们必归回，将善人和恶人，事奉上帝的和不事奉上帝的，分别出来。」

chapters.en: “For behold, the day is coming, burning like a furnace, when all the arrogant and every evildoer will be stubble; the day is coming when I will set them ablaze,” says the LORD of Hosts. “Not a root or branch will be left to them.”
chapters.zh: 万军之耶和华说：「那日临近，势如烧着的火炉，凡狂傲的和行恶的必如碎诩，在那日必被烧尽，根本枝条一无存留。

chapters.en: “But for you who fear My name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings, and you will go out and leap like calves from the stall.
chapters.zh: 但向你们敬畏我名的人必有公义的日头出现，其光线〔注：原文是翅膀〕有医治之能。你们必出来跳跃如圈里的肥犊。

chapters.en: Then you will trample the wicked, for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet on the day I am preparing,” says the LORD of Hosts.
chapters.zh: 你们必践踏恶人；在我所定的日子，他们必如灰尘在你们脚掌之下。这是万军之耶和华说的。

chapters.en: “Remember the law of My servant Moses, the statutes and ordinances I commanded him for all Israel at Horeb.
chapters.zh: 「你们当记念我仆人摩西的律法，就是我在何烈〔山〕为以色列众人所吩咐他的律例典章。

chapters.en: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD.
chapters.zh: 「看哪，耶和华大而可畏之日未到以前，我必差遣先知以利亚到你们那里去。

chapters.en: And he will turn the hearts of the fathers to their children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers. Otherwise, I will come and strike the land with a curse.”
chapters.zh: 他必使父亲的心转向儿女，儿女的心转向父亲，免得我来咒诅遍地。」

chapters.en: This is the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham:
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕的后裔，大卫的子孙〔注：后裔，子孙：原文是儿子；下同〕，耶稣基督的家谱：

chapters.en:
Abraham was the father of Isaac,
Isaac the father of Jacob,
and Jacob the father of Judah and his brothers.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕生以撒；以撒生雅各；雅各生犹大和他的弟兄；

chapters.en:
Judah was the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar,
Perez the father of Hezron,
and Hezron the father of Ram.
chapters.zh: 犹大从她玛氏生法勒斯和谢拉；法勒斯生希斯崙；希斯崙生亚兰；

chapters.en:
Ram was the father of Amminadab,
Amminadab the father of Nahshon,
and Nahshon the father of Salmon.
chapters.zh: 亚兰生亚米拿达；亚米拿达生拿顺；拿顺生撒门；

chapters.en:
Salmon was the father of Boaz by Rahab,
Boaz the father of Obed by Ruth,
Obed the father of Jesse,
chapters.zh: 撒门从喇合氏生波阿斯；波阿斯从路得氏生俄备得；俄备得生耶西；

chapters.en:
and Jesse the father of David the king.
Next:
David was the father of Solomon by Uriah’s wife,
chapters.zh: 耶西生大卫王。 大卫从乌利亚的妻子生所罗门；

chapters.en:
Solomon the father of Rehoboam,
Rehoboam the father of Abijah,
and Abijah the father of Asa.
chapters.zh: 所罗门生罗波安；罗波安生亚比雅；亚比雅生亚撒；

chapters.en:
Asa was the father of Jehoshaphat,
Jehoshaphat the father of Joram,
and Joram the father of Uzziah.
chapters.zh: 亚撒生约沙法；约沙法生约兰；约兰生乌西雅；

chapters.en:
Uzziah was the father of Jotham,
Jotham the father of Ahaz,
and Ahaz the father of Hezekiah.
chapters.zh: 乌西雅生约坦；约坦生亚哈斯；亚哈斯生希西家；

chapters.en:
Hezekiah was the father of Manasseh,
Manasseh the father of Amon,
Amon the father of Josiah,
chapters.zh: 希西家生玛拿西；玛拿西生亚们；亚们生约西亚；

chapters.en: and Josiah the father of Jeconiah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.
chapters.zh: 百姓被迁到巴比伦的时候，约西亚生耶哥尼雅和他的弟兄。

chapters.en:
After the exile to Babylon:
Jeconiah was the father of Shealtiel,
Shealtiel the father of Zerubbabel,
chapters.zh: 迁到巴比伦之后，耶哥尼雅生撒拉铁；撒拉铁生所罗巴伯；

chapters.en:
Zerubbabel the father of Abiud,
Abiud the father of Eliakim,
and Eliakim the father of Azor.
chapters.zh: 所罗巴伯生亚比玉；亚比玉生以利亚敬；以利亚敬生亚所；

chapters.en:
Azor was the father of Zadok,
Zadok the father of Achim,
and Achim the father of Eliud.
chapters.zh: 亚所生撒督；撒督生亚金；亚金生以律；

chapters.en:
Eliud was the father of Eleazar,
Eleazar the father of Matthan,
Matthan the father of Jacob,
chapters.zh: 以律生以利亚撒；以利亚撒生马但；马但生雅各；

chapters.en: and Jacob the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
chapters.zh: 雅各生约瑟，就是马利亚的丈夫。那称为基督的耶稣是从马利亚生的。

chapters.en: In all, then, there were fourteen generations from Abraham to David, fourteen from David to the exile to Babylon, and fourteen from the exile to the Christ.
chapters.zh: 这样，从亚伯拉罕到大卫共有十四代；从大卫到迁至巴比伦的时候也有十四代；从迁至巴比伦的时候到基督又有十四代。

chapters.en: This is how the birth of Jesus Christ came about: His mother Mary was pledged in marriage to Joseph, but before they came together, she was found to be with child through the Holy Spirit.
chapters.zh: 耶稣基督降生的事记在下面：他母亲马利亚已经许配了约瑟，还没有迎娶，马利亚就从圣灵怀了孕。

chapters.en: Because Joseph her husband was a righteous man and was unwilling to disgrace her publicly, he resolved to divorce her quietly.
chapters.zh: 她丈夫约瑟是个义人，不愿意明明地羞辱她，想要暗暗地把她休了。

chapters.en: But after he had pondered these things, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to embrace Mary as your wife, for the One conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.
chapters.zh: 正思念这事的时候，有主的使者向他梦中显现，〔说〕：「大卫的子孙约瑟，不要怕！只管娶过你的妻子马利亚来，因她所怀的孕是从圣灵来的。

chapters.en: She will give birth to a Son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins.”
chapters.zh: 她将要生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫耶稣，因他要将自己的百姓从罪恶里救出来。」

chapters.en: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had said through the prophet:
chapters.zh: 这一切的事成就是要应验主藉先知所说的话，

chapters.en: “Behold, the virgin will be with child and will give birth to a son, and they will call Him Immanuel” (which means, “God with us” ).
chapters.zh: 说： 必有童女怀孕生子； 人要称他的名为以马内利。 （以马内利翻出来就是「上帝与我们同在」。）

chapters.en: When Joseph woke up, he did as the angel of the Lord had commanded him and embraced Mary as his wife.
chapters.zh: 约瑟醒了，起来，就遵着主使者的吩咐把妻子娶过来；

chapters.en: But he had no union with her until she gave birth to a Son. And he gave Him the name Jesus.
chapters.zh: 只是没有和她同房，等她生了儿子〔注：有古卷：等她生了头胎的儿子〕，就给他起名叫耶稣。

chapters.en: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea, during the time of King Herod, Magi from the east arrived in Jerusalem,
chapters.zh: 当希律王的时候，耶稣生在犹太的伯利恒。有几个博士从东方来到耶路撒冷，〔说〕：

chapters.en: asking, “Where is the One who has been born King of the Jews? We saw His star in the east and have come to worship Him.”
chapters.zh: 「那生下来作犹太人之王的在哪里？我们在东方看见他的星，特来拜他。」

chapters.en: When King Herod heard this, he was disturbed, and all Jerusalem with him.
chapters.zh: 希律王听见了，就心里不安；耶路撒冷合城的人也都不安。

chapters.en: And when he had assembled all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ was to be born.
chapters.zh: 他就召齐了祭司长和民间的文士，问他们说：「基督当生在何处？」

chapters.en: “In Bethlehem in Judea,” they replied, “for this is what the prophet has written:
chapters.zh: 他们回答说：「在犹太的伯利恒。因为有先知记着，说：

chapters.en: ‘But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah, for out of you will come a ruler who will be the shepherd of My people Israel.’ ”
chapters.zh: 犹大地的伯利恒啊， 你在犹大诸城中并不是最小的； 因为将来有一位君王要从你那里出来， 牧养我以色列民。」

chapters.en: Then Herod called the Magi secretly and learned from them the exact time the star had appeared.
chapters.zh: 当下，希律暗暗地召了博士来，细问那星是什么时候出现的，

chapters.en: And sending them to Bethlehem, he said: “Go and search carefully for the Child, and when you find Him, report to me, so that I too may go and worship Him.”
chapters.zh: 就差他们往伯利恒去，说：「你们去仔细寻访那小孩子，寻到了就来报信，我也好去拜他。」

chapters.en: After they had heard the king, they went on their way, and the star they had seen in the east went ahead of them until it stood over the place where the Child was.
chapters.zh: 他们听见王的话就去了。在东方所看见的那星忽然在他们前头行，直行到小孩子的地方，就在上头停住了。

chapters.en: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with great delight.
chapters.zh: 他们看见那星，就大大地欢喜；

chapters.en: On coming to the house, they saw the Child with His mother Mary, and they fell down and worshiped Him. Then they opened their treasures and presented Him with gifts of gold and frankincense and myrrh.
chapters.zh: 进了房子，看见小孩子和他母亲马利亚，就俯伏拜那小孩子，揭开宝盒，拿黄金、乳香、没药为礼物献给他。

chapters.en: And having been warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they withdrew to their country by another route.
chapters.zh: 博士因为在梦中被〔主〕指示不要回去见希律，就从别的路回本地去了。

chapters.en: When the Magi had gone, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream. “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and flee to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, for Herod is going to search for the Child to kill Him.”
chapters.zh: 他们去后，有主的使者向约瑟梦中显现，说：「起来！带着小孩子同他母亲逃往埃及，住在那里，等我吩咐你；因为希律必寻找小孩子，要除灭他。」

chapters.en: So he got up, took the Child and His mother by night, and withdrew to Egypt,
chapters.zh: 约瑟就起来，夜间带着小孩子和他母亲往埃及去，

chapters.en: where he stayed until the death of Herod. This fulfilled what the Lord had spoken through the prophet: “Out of Egypt I called My Son.”
chapters.zh: 住在那里，直到希律死了。这是要应验主藉先知所说的话，说：「我从埃及召出我的儿子来。」

chapters.en: When Herod saw that he had been outwitted by the Magi, he was filled with rage. Sending orders, he put to death all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who were two years old and under, according to the time he had learned from the Magi.
chapters.zh: 希律见自己被博士愚弄，就大大发怒，差人将伯利恒城里并四境所有的男孩，照着他向博士仔细查问的时候，凡两岁以里的，都杀尽了。

chapters.en: Then what was spoken through the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled:
chapters.zh: 这就应了先知耶利米的话，说：

chapters.en:
“A voice is heard in Ramah, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted,
because they are no more.”
chapters.zh: 在拉玛听见号咷大哭的声音， 是拉结哭她儿女， 不肯受安慰， 因为他们都不在了。

chapters.en: After Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt.
chapters.zh: 希律死了以后，有主的使者在埃及向约瑟梦中显现，说：

chapters.en: “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and go to the land of Israel, for those seeking the Child’s life are now dead.”
chapters.zh: 「起来！带着小孩子和他母亲往以色列地去，因为要害小孩子性命的人已经死了。」

chapters.en: So Joseph got up, took the Child and His mother, and went to the land of Israel.
chapters.zh: 约瑟就起来，把小孩子和他母亲带到以色列地去；

chapters.en: But when he learned that Archelaus was reigning in Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. And having been warned in a dream, he withdrew to the district of Galilee,
chapters.zh: 只因听见亚基老接着他父亲希律作了犹太王，就怕往那里去，又在梦中被〔主〕指示，便往加利利境内去了，

chapters.en: and he went and lived in a town called Nazareth. So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophets: “He will be called a Nazarene.”
chapters.zh: 到了一座城，名叫拿撒勒，就住在那里。这是要应验先知所说，他将称为拿撒勒人的话了。

chapters.en: In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea
chapters.zh: 那时，有施洗的约翰出来，在犹太的旷野传道，说：

chapters.en: and saying, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.”
chapters.zh: 「天国近了，你们应当悔改！」

chapters.en:
This is he who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah:
“A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord,
make straight paths for Him.’”
chapters.zh: 这人就是先知以赛亚所说的。他说：「在旷野有人声喊着说： 预备主的道， 修直他的路！」

chapters.en: John wore a garment of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
chapters.zh: 这约翰身穿骆驼毛的衣服，腰束皮带，吃的是蝗虫、野蜜。

chapters.en: People went out to him from Jerusalem and all Judea and the whole region around the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 那时，耶路撒冷和犹太全地，并约旦河一带地方的人，都出去到约翰那里，

chapters.en: Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
chapters.zh: 承认他们的罪，在约旦河里受他的洗。

chapters.en: But when John saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his place of baptism, he said to them, “You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
chapters.zh: 约翰看见许多法利赛人和撒都该人也来受洗，就对他们说：「毒蛇的种类！谁指示你们逃避将来的忿怒呢？

chapters.en: Produce fruit, then, in keeping with repentance.
chapters.zh: 你们要结出果子来，与悔改的心相称。

chapters.en: And do not presume to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.
chapters.zh: 不要自己心里说：『有亚伯拉罕为我们的祖宗。』我告诉你们，上帝能从这些石头中给亚伯拉罕兴起子孙来。

chapters.en: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
chapters.zh: 现在斧子已经放在树根上，凡不结好果子的树就砍下来，丢在火里。

chapters.en: I baptize you with water for repentance, but after me will come One more powerful than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
chapters.zh: 我是用水给你们施洗，叫你们悔改。但那在我以后来的，能力比我更大，我就是给他提鞋也不配。他要用圣灵与火给你们施洗。

chapters.en: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather His wheat into the barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
chapters.zh: 他手里拿着簸箕，要扬净他的场，把麦子收在仓里，把糠用不灭的火烧尽了。」

chapters.en: At that time Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John.
chapters.zh: 当下，耶稣从加利利来到约旦河，见了约翰，要受他的洗。

chapters.en: But John tried to prevent Him, saying, “I need to be baptized by You, and do You come to me?”
chapters.zh: 约翰想要拦住他，说：「我当受你的洗，你反倒上我这里来吗？」

chapters.en: “Let it be so now,” Jesus replied. “It is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness in this way.” Then John permitted Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你暂且许我，因为我们理当这样尽诸般的义〔注：或译：礼〕。」于是约翰许了他。
