chapters.en: As soon as Jesus was baptized, He went up out of the water. Suddenly the heavens were opened, and He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and resting on Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣受了洗，随即从水里上来。天忽然为他开了，他就看见上帝的灵仿佛鸽子降下，落在他身上。

chapters.en: And a voice from heaven said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased!”
chapters.zh: 从天上有声音说：「这是我的爱子，我所喜悦的。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
chapters.zh: 当时，耶稣被〔圣〕灵引到旷野，受魔鬼的试探。

chapters.en: After fasting forty days and forty nights, He was hungry.
chapters.zh: 他禁食四十昼夜，后来就饿了。

chapters.en: The tempter came to Him and said, “If You are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.”
chapters.zh: 那试探人的进前来，对他说：「你若是上帝的儿子，可以吩咐这些石头变成食物。」

chapters.en:
But Jesus answered, “It is written:
‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶稣却回答说：「〔经上〕记着说： 人活着，不是单靠食物， 乃是靠上帝口里所出的一切话。」

chapters.en: Then the devil took Him to the holy city and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple.
chapters.zh: 魔鬼就带他进了圣城，叫他站在殿顶〔注：顶：原文是翅〕上，

chapters.en:
“If You are the Son of God,” he said, “throw Yourself down. For it is written:
‘He will command His angels concerning You, and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’ ”
chapters.zh: 对他说：「你若是上帝的儿子，可以跳下去，因为〔经上〕记着说： 主要为你吩咐他的使者 用手托着你， 免得你的脚碰在石头上。」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “It is also written: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「〔经上〕又记着说：『不可试探主－你的上帝。』」

chapters.en: Again, the devil took Him to a very high mountain and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
chapters.zh: 魔鬼又带他上了一座最高的山，将世上的万国与万国的荣华都指给他看，

chapters.en: “All this I will give You,” he said, “if You will fall down and worship me.”
chapters.zh: 对他说：「你若俯伏拜我，我就把这一切都赐给你。」

chapters.en: “Away from Me, Satan!” Jesus told him. “For it is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「撒但〔注：就是抵挡的意思，乃魔鬼的别名〕，退去吧！因为〔经上〕记着说： 当拜主－你的上帝， 单要事奉他。」

chapters.en: Then the devil left Him, and angels came and ministered to Him.
chapters.zh: 于是，魔鬼离了耶稣，有天使来伺候他。

chapters.en: When Jesus heard that John had been imprisoned, He withdrew to Galilee.
chapters.zh: 耶稣听见约翰下了监，就退到加利利去；

chapters.en: Leaving Nazareth, He went and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,
chapters.zh: 后又离开拿撒勒，往迦百农去，就住在那里。那地方靠海，在西布伦和拿弗他利的边界上。

chapters.en: to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:
chapters.zh: 这是要应验先知以赛亚的话，

chapters.en: “Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles—
chapters.zh: 说： 西布伦地，拿弗他利地， 就是沿海的路，约旦河外， 外邦人的加利利地－

chapters.en: the people living in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death, a light has dawned.”
chapters.zh: 那坐在黑暗里的百姓看见了大光； 坐在死荫之地的人有光发现照着他们。

chapters.en: From that time on Jesus began to preach, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.”
chapters.zh: 从那时候，耶稣就传起道来，说：「天国近了，你们应当悔改！」

chapters.en: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, He saw two brothers, Simon called Peter and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
chapters.zh: 耶稣在加利利海边行走，看见弟兄二人，就是那称呼彼得的西门和他兄弟安得烈，在海里撒网；他们本是打鱼的。

chapters.en: “Come, follow Me,” Jesus said, “and I will make you fishers of men.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「来跟从我，我要叫你们得人如得鱼一样。」

chapters.en: And at once they left their nets and followed Him.
chapters.zh: 他们就立刻舍了网，跟从了他。

chapters.en: Going on from there, He saw two other brothers, James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat with their father Zebedee, mending their nets. Jesus called them,
chapters.zh: 从那里往前走，又看见弟兄二人，就是西庇太的儿子雅各和他兄弟约翰，同他们的父亲西庇太在船上补网，耶稣就招呼他们，

chapters.en: and immediately they left the boat and their father and followed Him.
chapters.zh: 他们立刻舍了船，别了父亲，跟从了耶稣。

chapters.en: Jesus went throughout Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness among the people.
chapters.zh: 耶稣走遍加利利，在各会堂里教训人，传天国的福音，医治百姓各样的病症。

chapters.en: News about Him spread all over Syria, and people brought to Him all who were ill with various diseases, those suffering acute pain, the demon-possessed, those having seizures, and the paralyzed, and He healed them.
chapters.zh: 他的名声就传遍了觜利亚。那里的人把一切害病的，就是害各样疾病、各样疼痛的和被鬼附的、癫痫的、瘫痪的，都带了来，耶稣就治好了他们。

chapters.en: Large crowds followed Him, having come from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and beyond the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 当下，有许多人从加利利、低加坡里、耶路撒冷、犹太、约旦河外来跟着他。

chapters.en: When Jesus saw the crowds, He went up on the mountain and sat down. His disciples came to Him,
chapters.zh: 耶稣看见这许多的人，就上了山，既已坐下，门徒到他跟前来，

chapters.en: and He began to teach them, saying:
chapters.zh: 他就开口教训他们，说：

chapters.en: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
chapters.zh: 虚心的人有福了！ 因为天国是他们的。

chapters.en: Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.
chapters.zh: 哀恸的人有福了！ 因为他们必得安慰。

chapters.en: Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.
chapters.zh: 温柔的人有福了！ 因为他们必承受地土。

chapters.en: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.
chapters.zh: 饥渴慕义的人有福了！ 因为他们必得饱足。

chapters.en: Blessed are the merciful, for they will be shown mercy.
chapters.zh: 怜恤人的人有福了！ 因为他们必蒙怜恤。

chapters.en: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
chapters.zh: 清心的人有福了！ 因为他们必得见上帝。

chapters.en: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.
chapters.zh: 使人和睦的人有福了！ 因为他们必称为上帝的儿子。

chapters.en: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
chapters.zh: 为义受逼迫的人有福了！ 因为天国是他们的。

chapters.en: Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you, and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of Me.
chapters.zh: 「人若因我辱骂你们，逼迫你们，捏造各样坏话毁谤你们，你们就有福了！

chapters.en: Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets before you.
chapters.zh: 应当欢喜快乐，因为你们在天上的赏赐是大的。在你们以前的先知，人也是这样逼迫他们。」

chapters.en: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its savor, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled by men.
chapters.zh: 「你们是世上的盐。盐若失了味，怎能叫它再咸呢？以后无用，不过丢在外面，被人践踏了。

chapters.en: You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden.
chapters.zh: 你们是世上的光。城造在山上是不能隐藏的。

chapters.en: Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a basket. Instead, they set it on a stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house.
chapters.zh: 人点灯，不放在斗底下，是放在灯台上，就照亮一家的人。

chapters.en: In the same way, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.
chapters.zh: 你们的光也当这样照在人前，叫他们看见你们的好行为，便将荣耀归给你们在天上的父。」

chapters.en: Do not think that I have come to abolish the Law or the Prophets. I have not come to abolish them, but to fulfill them.
chapters.zh: 「莫想我来要废掉律法和先知。我来不是要废掉，乃是要成全。

chapters.en: For I tell you truly, until heaven and earth pass away, not a single jot, not a stroke of a pen, will disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，就是到天地都废去了，律法的一点一画也不能废去，都要成全。

chapters.en: So then, whoever breaks one of the least of these commandments and teaches others to do likewise will be called least in the kingdom of heaven; but whoever practices and teaches them will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
chapters.zh: 所以，无论何人废掉这诫命中最小的一条，又教训人这样做，他在天国要称为最小的。但无论何人遵行这诫命，又教训人遵行，他在天国要称为大的。

chapters.en: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
chapters.zh: 我告诉你们，你们的义若不胜于文士和法利赛人的义，断不能进天国。」

chapters.en: You have heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘Do not murder’ and ‘Anyone who murders will be subject to judgment.’
chapters.zh: 「你们听见有吩咐古人的话，说：『不可杀人』；〔又说〕：『凡杀人的难免受审判。』

chapters.en: But I tell you that anyone who is angry with his brother will be subject to judgment. Again, anyone who says to his brother, ‘Raca,’ will be subject to the Sanhedrin. But anyone who says, ‘You fool!’ will be subject to the fire of hell.
chapters.zh: 只是我告诉你们，凡〔注：有古卷在凡字下加：无缘无故地〕向弟兄动怒的，难免受审判；凡骂弟兄是拉加的，难免公会〔的审判〕；凡骂弟兄是魔利的，难免地狱的火。

chapters.en: So if you are offering your gift at the altar and there remember that your brother has something against you,
chapters.zh: 所以，你在祭坛上献礼物的时候，若想起弟兄向你怀怨，

chapters.en: leave your gift there before the altar. First go and be reconciled to your brother; then come and offer your gift.
chapters.zh: 就把礼物留在坛前，先去同弟兄和好，然后来献礼物。

chapters.en: Reconcile quickly with your adversary, while you are still on the way to court. Otherwise, he may hand you over to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the officer, and you may be thrown into prison.
chapters.zh: 你同告你的对头还在路上，就赶紧与他和息，恐怕他把你送给审判官，审判官交付衙役，你就下在监里了。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny.
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你，若有一文钱没有还清，你断不能从那里出来。」

chapters.en: You have heard that it was said, ‘Do not commit adultery.’
chapters.zh: 「你们听见有话说：『不可奸淫。』

chapters.en: But I tell you that anyone who looks at a woman to lust after her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
chapters.zh: 只是我告诉你们，凡看见妇女就动淫念的，这人心里已经与她犯奸淫了。

chapters.en: If your right eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.
chapters.zh: 若是你的右眼叫你跌倒，就剜出来丢掉，宁可失去百体中的一体，不叫全身丢在地狱里。

chapters.en: And if your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to depart into hell.
chapters.zh: 若是右手叫你跌倒，就砍下来丢掉，宁可失去百体中的一体，不叫全身下入地狱。」

chapters.en: It has also been said, ‘Whoever divorces his wife must give her a certificate of divorce.’
chapters.zh: 「又有话说：『人若休妻，就当给她休书。』

chapters.en: But I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, brings adultery upon her. And he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
chapters.zh: 只是我告诉你们，凡休妻的，若不是为淫乱的缘故，就是叫她作淫妇了；人若娶这被休的妇人，也是犯奸淫了。」

chapters.en: Again, you have heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘Do not break your oath, but fulfill your vows to the Lord.’
chapters.zh: 「你们又听见有吩咐古人的话，说：『不可背誓，所起的誓总要向主谨守。』

chapters.en: But I tell you not to swear at all: either by heaven, for it is God’s throne;
chapters.zh: 只是我告诉你们，什么誓都不可起。不可指着天起誓，因为天是上帝的座位；

chapters.en: or by the earth, for it is His footstool; or by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
chapters.zh: 不可指着地起誓，因为地是他的脚凳；也不可指着耶路撒冷起誓，因为耶路撒冷是大君的京城；

chapters.en: Nor should you swear by your head, for you cannot make a single hair white or black.
chapters.zh: 又不可指着你的头起誓，因为你不能使一根头发变黑变白了。

chapters.en: Simply let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes,’ and your ‘No,’ ‘No.’ Anything more comes from the evil one.
chapters.zh: 你们的话，是，就说是；不是，就说不是；若再多说就是出于那恶者〔注：或译：就是从恶里出来的〕。」

chapters.en: You have heard that it was said, ‘Eye for eye and tooth for tooth.’
chapters.zh: 「你们听见有话说：『以眼还眼，以牙还牙。』

chapters.en: But I tell you not to resist an evil person. If someone slaps you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also;
chapters.zh: 只是我告诉你们，不要与恶人作对。有人打你的右脸，连左脸也转过来由他打；

chapters.en: if someone wants to sue you and take your tunic, let him have your cloak as well;
chapters.zh: 有人想要告你，要拿你的里衣，连外衣也由他拿去；

chapters.en: and if someone forces you to go one mile, go with him two miles.
chapters.zh: 有人强逼你走一里路，你就同他走二里；

chapters.en: Give to the one who asks you, and do not turn away from the one who wants to borrow from you.
chapters.zh: 有求你的，就给他；有向你借贷的，不可推辞。」

chapters.en: You have heard that it was said, ‘Love your neighbor’ and ‘Hate your enemy.’
chapters.zh: 「你们听见有话说：『当爱你的邻舍，恨你的仇敌。』

chapters.en: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,
chapters.zh: 只是我告诉你们，要爱你们的仇敌，为那逼迫你们的祷告。

chapters.en: that you may be sons of your Father in heaven. He causes His sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.
chapters.zh: 〔这样〕就可以作你们天父的儿子；因为他叫日头照好人，也照歹人；降雨给义人，也给不义的人。

chapters.en: If you love those who love you, what reward will you get? Do not even tax collectors do the same?
chapters.zh: 你们若〔单〕爱那爱你们的人，有什么赏赐呢？就是税吏不也是这样行吗？

chapters.en: And if you greet only your brothers, what are you doing more than others? Do not even Gentiles do the same?
chapters.zh: 你们若单请你弟兄的安，比人有什么长处呢？就是外邦人不也是这样行吗？

chapters.en: Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
chapters.zh: 所以，你们要完全，像你们的天父完全一样。」

chapters.en: “Be careful not to perform your righteous acts before men to be seen by them. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.
chapters.zh: 「你们要小心，不可将善事行在人的面前，故意叫他们看见，若是这样，就不能得你们天父的赏赐了。

chapters.en: So when you give to the needy, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
chapters.zh: 所以，你施舍的时候，不可在你前面吹号，像那假冒为善的人在会堂里和街道上所行的，故意要得人的荣耀。我实在告诉你们，他们已经得了他们的赏赐。

chapters.en: But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,
chapters.zh: 你施舍的时候，不要叫左手知道右手所做的，

chapters.en: so that your giving may be in secret. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
chapters.zh: 要叫你施舍的事行在暗中。你父在暗中察看，必然报答你〔注：有古卷：必在明处报答你〕。」

chapters.en: And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites. For they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
chapters.zh: 「你们祷告的时候，不可像那假冒为善的人，爱站在会堂里和十字路口上祷告，故意叫人看见。我实在告诉你们，他们已经得了他们的赏赐。

chapters.en: But when you pray, go into your inner room, shut your door, and pray to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
chapters.zh: 你祷告的时候，要进你的内屋，关上门，祷告你在暗中的父；你父在暗中察看，必然报答你。

chapters.en: And when you pray, do not babble on like pagans, for they think that by their many words they will be heard.
chapters.zh: 你们祷告，不可像外邦人，用许多重复话，他们以为话多了必蒙垂听。

chapters.en: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask Him.
chapters.zh: 你们不可效法他们；因为你们没有祈求以先，你们所需用的，你们的父早已知道了。

chapters.en:
So then, this is how you should pray:
‘Our Father in heaven, hallowed be Your name.
chapters.zh: 所以，你们祷告要这样说： 我们在天上的父： 愿人都尊你的名为圣。

chapters.en:
Your kingdom come, Your will be done,
on earth as it is in heaven.
chapters.zh: 愿你的国降临； 愿你的旨意行在地上， 如同行在天上。

chapters.en: Give us this day our daily bread.
chapters.zh: 我们日用的饮食，今日赐给我们。

chapters.en: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
chapters.zh: 免我们的债， 如同我们免了人的债。

chapters.en: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. ’
chapters.zh: 不叫我们遇见试探； 救我们脱离凶恶〔注：或译：脱离恶者〕。 因为国度、权柄、荣耀，全是你的， 直到永远。阿们〔注：有古卷没有因为…阿们等字〕！

chapters.en: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
chapters.zh: 「你们饶恕人的过犯，你们的天父也必饶恕你们〔的过犯〕；

chapters.en: But if you do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive yours.
chapters.zh: 你们不饶恕人的过犯，你们的〔天〕父也必不饶恕你们的过犯。」

chapters.en: When you fast, do not be somber like the hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces to show men they are fasting. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
chapters.zh: 「你们禁食的时候，不可像那假冒为善的人，脸上带着愁容；因为他们把脸弄得难看，故意叫人看出他们是禁食。我实在告诉你们，他们已经得了他们的赏赐。

chapters.en: But when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,
chapters.zh: 你禁食的时候，要梳头洗脸，

chapters.en: so that your fasting will not be obvious to men, but only to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
chapters.zh: 不叫人看出你禁食来，只叫你暗中的父看见；你父在暗中察看，必然报答你。」

chapters.en: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy, and where thieves break in and steal.
chapters.zh: 「不要为自己积攒财宝在地上；地上有虫子咬，能锈坏，也有贼挖窟窿来偷。

chapters.en: But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where moth and rust do not destroy, and where thieves do not break in and steal.
chapters.zh: 只要积攒财宝在天上；天上没有虫子咬，不能锈坏，也没有贼挖窟窿来偷。

chapters.en: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
chapters.zh: 因为你的财宝在哪里，你的心也在那里。」

chapters.en: The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eyes are good, your whole body will be full of light.
chapters.zh: 「眼睛就是身上的灯。你的眼睛若瞭亮，全身就光明；

chapters.en: But if your eyes are bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light within you is darkness, how great is that darkness!
chapters.zh: 你的眼睛若昏花，全身就黑暗。你里头的光若黑暗了，那黑暗是何等大呢！」

chapters.en: No one can serve two masters: Either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.
chapters.zh: 「一个人不能事奉两个主；不是恶这个、爱那个，就是重这个、轻那个。你们不能又事奉上帝，又事奉玛门〔注：玛门：财利的意思〕。」

chapters.en: Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?
chapters.zh: 「所以我告诉你们，不要为生命忧虑吃什么，喝什么；为身体忧虑穿什么。生命不胜于饮食吗？身体不胜于衣裳吗？

chapters.en: Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?
chapters.zh: 你们看那天上的飞鸟，也不种，也不收，也不积蓄在仓里，你们的天父尚且养活牠。你们不比飞鸟贵重得多吗？

chapters.en: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?
chapters.zh: 你们哪一个能用思虑使寿数多加一刻呢〔注：或译：使身量多加一肘呢〕？

chapters.en: And why do you worry about clothes? Consider how the lilies of the field grow: They do not labor or spin.
chapters.zh: 何必为衣裳忧虑呢？你想野地里的百合花怎么长起来；它也不劳苦，也不纺线。

chapters.en: Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these.
chapters.zh: 然而我告诉你们，就是所罗门极荣华的时候，他所穿戴的，还不如这花一朵呢！

chapters.en: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
chapters.zh: 你们这小信的人哪！野地里的草今天还在，明天就丢在炉里，上帝还给它这样的妆饰，何况你们呢！

chapters.en: Therefore do not worry, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’
chapters.zh: 所以，不要忧虑说，吃什么？喝什么？穿什么？

chapters.en: For the Gentiles strive after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.
chapters.zh: 这都是外邦人所求的。你们需用的这一切东西，你们的天父是知道的。

chapters.en: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.
chapters.zh: 你们要先求他的国和他的义，这些东西都要加给你们了。

chapters.en: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.
chapters.zh: 所以，不要为明天忧虑，因为明天自有明天的忧虑；一天的难处一天当就够了。」

chapters.en: “Do not judge, or you will be judged.
chapters.zh: 「你们不要论断人，免得你们被论断。

chapters.en: For with the same judgment you pronounce, you will be judged, and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.
chapters.zh: 因为你们怎样论断人，也必怎样被论断；你们用什么量器量给人，也必用什么量器量给你们。

chapters.en: Why do you look at the speck in your brother’s eye but fail to notice the beam in your own eye?
chapters.zh: 为什么看见你弟兄眼中有刺，却不想自己眼中有梁木呢？

chapters.en: How can you say to your brother, ‘Let me take the speck out of your eye,’ while there is still a beam in your own eye?
chapters.zh: 你自己眼中有梁木，怎能对你弟兄说：『容我去掉你眼中的刺』呢？

chapters.en: You hypocrite! First take the beam out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.
chapters.zh: 你这假冒为善的人！先去掉自己眼中的梁木，然后才能看得清楚，去掉你弟兄眼中的刺。

chapters.en: Do not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine. If you do, they may trample them under their feet, and then turn and tear you to pieces.
chapters.zh: 不要把圣物给狗，也不要把你们的珍珠丢在猪前，恐怕牠践踏了珍珠，转过来咬你们。」

chapters.en: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
chapters.zh: 「你们祈求，就给你们；寻找，就寻见；叩门，就给你们开门。

chapters.en: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.
chapters.zh: 因为凡祈求的，就得着；寻找的，就寻见；叩门的，就给他开门。

chapters.en: Which of you, if his son asks for bread, will give him a stone?
chapters.zh: 你们中间谁有儿子求饼，反给他石头呢？

chapters.en: Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake?
chapters.zh: 求鱼，反给他蛇呢？

chapters.en: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!
chapters.zh: 你们虽然不好，尚且知道拿好东西给儿女，何况你们在天上的父，岂不更把好东西给求他的人吗？

chapters.en: In everything, then, do to others as you would have them do to you. For this is the essence of the Law and the Prophets.
chapters.zh: 所以，无论何事，你们愿意人怎样待你们，你们也要怎样待人，因为这就是律法和先知〔的道理〕。」

chapters.en: Enter through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.
chapters.zh: 「你们要进窄门。因为引到灭亡，那门是宽的，路是大的，进去的人也多；

chapters.en: But small is the gate and narrow the way that leads to life, and only a few find it.
chapters.zh: 引到〔永〕生，那门是窄的，路是小的，找着的人也少。」

chapters.en: Beware of false prophets. They come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves.
chapters.zh: 「你们要防备假先知。他们到你们这里来，外面披着羊皮，里面却是残暴的狼。

chapters.en: By their fruit you will recognize them. Are grapes gathered from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?
chapters.zh: 凭着他们的果子，就可以认出他们来。荆棘上岂能摘葡萄呢？蒺藜里岂能摘无花果呢？

chapters.en: Likewise, every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit.
chapters.zh: 这样，凡好树都结好果子，惟独坏树结坏果子。

chapters.en: A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot bear good fruit.
chapters.zh: 好树不能结坏果子；坏树不能结好果子。

chapters.en: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
chapters.zh: 凡不结好果子的树就砍下来，丢在火里。

chapters.en: So then, by their fruit you will recognize them.
chapters.zh: 所以，凭着他们的果子就可以认出他们来。」

chapters.en: Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only he who does the will of My Father in heaven.
chapters.zh: 「凡称呼我『主啊，主啊』的人不能都进天国；惟独遵行我天父旨意的人才能进去。

chapters.en: Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and in Your name drive out demons and perform many miracles?’
chapters.zh: 当那日必有许多人对我说：『主啊，主啊，我们不是奉你的名传道，奉你的名赶鬼，奉你的名行许多异能吗？』

chapters.en: Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!’
chapters.zh: 我就明明地告诉他们说：『我从来不认识你们，你们这些作恶的人，离开我去吧！』」

chapters.en: Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.
chapters.zh: 「所以，凡听见我这话就去行的，好比一个聪明人，把房子盖在磐石上；

chapters.en: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house; yet it did not fall, because its foundation was on the rock.
chapters.zh: 雨淋，水冲，风吹，撞着那房子，房子总不倒塌，因为根基立在磐石上。

chapters.en: But everyone who hears these words of Mine and does not act on them is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.
chapters.zh: 凡听见我这话不去行的，好比一个无知的人，把房子盖在沙土上；

chapters.en: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell—and great was its collapse!”
chapters.zh: 雨淋，水冲，风吹，撞着那房子，房子就倒塌了，并且倒塌得很大。」

chapters.en: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the crowds were astonished at His teaching,
chapters.zh: 耶稣讲完了这些话，众人都希奇他的教训；

chapters.en: because He taught as one who had authority, and not as their scribes.
chapters.zh: 因为他教训他们，正像有权柄的人，不像他们的文士。

chapters.en: When Jesus came down from the mountain, large crowds followed Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣下了山，有许多人跟着他。

chapters.en: Suddenly a leper came and knelt before Him, saying, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.”
chapters.zh: 有一个长大痲疯的来拜他，说：「主若肯，必能叫我洁净了。」

chapters.en: Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!” And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
chapters.zh: 耶稣伸手摸他，说：「我肯，你洁净了吧！」他的大痲疯立刻就洁净了。

chapters.en: Then Jesus instructed him, “See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift prescribed by Moses, as a testimony to them.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「你切不可告诉人，只要去把身体给祭司察看，献上摩西所吩咐的礼物，对众人作证据。」

chapters.en: When Jesus had entered Capernaum, a centurion came and pleaded with Him,
chapters.zh: 耶稣进了迦百农，有一个百夫长进前来，求他说：

chapters.en: “Lord, my servant lies at home, paralyzed and in terrible agony.”
chapters.zh: 「主啊，我的仆人害瘫痪病，躺在家里，甚是疼苦。」

chapters.en: “I will go and heal him,” Jesus replied.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我去医治他。」

chapters.en: The centurion answered, “Lord, I am not worthy to have You come under my roof. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
chapters.zh: 百夫长回答说：「主啊，你到我舍下，我不敢当；只要你说一句话，我的仆人就必好了。

chapters.en: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell one to go, and he goes, and another to come, and he comes. I tell my servant to do something, and he does it.”
chapters.zh: 因为我在人的权下，也有兵在我以下；对这个说『去！』他就去；对那个说『来！』他就来；对我的仆人说『你做这事！』他就去做。」

chapters.en: When Jesus heard this, He marveled and said to those following Him, “Truly I tell you, I have not found anyone in Israel with such great faith.
chapters.zh: 耶稣听见就希奇，对跟从的人说：「我实在告诉你们，这么大的信心，就是在以色列中，我也没有遇见过。

chapters.en: I say to you that many will come from the east and the west to share the banquet with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.
chapters.zh: 我又告诉你们，从东从西，将有许多人来，在天国里与亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各一同坐席；

chapters.en: But the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
chapters.zh: 惟有本国的子民竟被赶到外边黑暗里去，在那里必要哀哭切齿了。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus said to the centurion, “Go! As you have believed, so will it be done for you.” And his servant was healed at that very hour.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对百夫长说：「你回去吧！照你的信心，给你成全了。」那时，他的仆人就好了。

chapters.en: When Jesus arrived at Peter’s house, He saw Peter’s mother-in-law sick in bed with a fever.
chapters.zh: 耶稣到了彼得家里，见彼得的岳母害热病躺着。

chapters.en: So He touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she got up and began to serve Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣把她的手一摸，热就退了；她就起来服事耶稣。

chapters.en: When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to Jesus, and He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick.
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，有人带着许多被鬼附的来到耶稣跟前，他只用一句话就把鬼都赶出去，并且治好了一切有病的人。

chapters.en:
This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:
“He took up our infirmities and carried our diseases.”
chapters.zh: 这是要应验先知以赛亚的话，说： 他代替我们的软弱， 担当我们的疾病。

chapters.en: When Jesus saw a large crowd around Him, He gave orders to cross to the other side of the sea.
chapters.zh: 耶稣见许多人围着他，就吩咐渡到那边去。

chapters.en: And one of the scribes came to Him and said, “Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go.”
chapters.zh: 有一个文士来，对他说：「夫子，你无论往哪里去，我要跟从你。」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「狐狸有洞，天空的飞鸟有窝，人子却没有枕头的地方。」

chapters.en: Another of His disciples requested, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”
chapters.zh: 又有一个门徒对耶稣说：「主啊，容我先回去埋葬我的父亲。」

chapters.en: But Jesus told him, “Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「任凭死人埋葬他们的死人；你跟从我吧！」

chapters.en: When He got into the boat, His disciples followed Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣上了船，门徒跟着他。

chapters.en: Suddenly a violent storm came up on the sea, so that the boat was engulfed by the waves. But Jesus was sleeping.
chapters.zh: 海里忽然起了暴风，甚至船被波浪掩盖；耶稣却睡着了。

chapters.en: The disciples went and woke Him, saying, “Lord, save us! We are perishing!”
chapters.zh: 门徒来叫醒了他，说：「主啊，救我们，我们丧命啦！」

chapters.en: “You of little faith,” Jesus replied, “why are you so afraid?” Then He got up and rebuked the winds and the sea, and it was perfectly calm.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们这小信的人哪，为什么胆怯呢？」于是起来，斥责风和海，风和海就大大地平静了。

chapters.en: The men were amazed and asked, “What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the sea obey Him!”
chapters.zh: 众人希奇，说：「这是怎样的人？连风和海也听从他了！」

chapters.en: When Jesus arrived on the other side in the region of the Gadarenes, He was met by two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs. They were so violent that no one could pass that way.
chapters.zh: 耶稣既渡到那边去，来到加大拉人的地方，就有两个被鬼附的人从坟茔里出来迎着他，极其凶猛，甚至没有人能从那条路上经过。

chapters.en: “What do You want with us, Son of God?” they shouted. “Have You come here to torture us before the appointed time?”
chapters.zh: 他们喊着说：「上帝的儿子，我们与你有什么相干？时候还没有到，你就上这里来叫我们受苦吗？」

chapters.en: In the distance a large herd of pigs was feeding.
chapters.zh: 离他们很远，有一大群猪吃食。

chapters.en: So the demons begged Jesus, “If You drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs.”
chapters.zh: 鬼就央求耶稣，说：「若把我们赶出去，就打发我们进入猪群吧！」

chapters.en: “Go!” He told them. So they came out and went into the pigs, and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「去吧！」鬼就出来，进入猪群。全群忽然闯下山崖，投在海里淹死了。

chapters.en: Those tending the pigs ran off into the town and reported all this, including the account of the demon-possessed men.
chapters.zh: 放猪的就逃跑进城，将这一切事和被鬼附的人所遭遇的都告诉人。

chapters.en: Then the whole town went out to meet Jesus. And when they saw Him, they begged Him to leave their region.
chapters.zh: 合城的人都出来迎见耶稣，既见了就央求他离开他们的境界。

chapters.en: Jesus got into a boat, crossed over, and came to His own town.
chapters.zh: 耶稣上了船，渡过〔海〕，来到自己的城里。

chapters.en: Just then some men brought to Him a paralytic lying on a mat. When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Take courage, son; your sins are forgiven.”
chapters.zh: 有人用褥子抬着一个瘫子到耶稣跟前来。耶稣见他们的信心，就对瘫子说：「小子，放心吧！你的罪赦了。」

chapters.en: On seeing this, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man is blaspheming!”
chapters.zh: 有几个文士心里说：「这个人说僭妄的话了。」

chapters.en: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said, “Why do you harbor evil in your hearts?
chapters.zh: 耶稣知道他们的心意，就说：「你们为什么心里怀着恶念呢？

chapters.en: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?
chapters.zh: 或说『你的罪赦了』，或说『你起来行走』，哪一样容易呢？

chapters.en: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...” Then He said to the paralytic, “Get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”
chapters.zh: 但要叫你们知道，人子在地上有赦罪的权柄」；就对瘫子说：「起来！拿你的褥子回家去吧。」

chapters.en: And the man got up and went home.
chapters.zh: 那人就起来，回家去了。

chapters.en: When the crowds saw this, they were filled with awe and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.
chapters.zh: 众人看见都惊奇，就归荣耀与上帝，因为他将这样的权柄赐给人。

chapters.en: As Jesus went on from there, He saw a man named Matthew sitting at the tax booth. “Follow Me,” He told him, and Matthew got up and followed Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣从那里往前走，看见一个人名叫马太，坐在税关上，就对他说：「你跟从我来。」他就起来跟从了耶稣。

chapters.en: Later, as Jesus was dining at Matthew’s house, many tax collectors and sinners came and ate with Him and His disciples.
chapters.zh: 耶稣在屋里坐席的时候，有好些税吏和罪人来，与耶稣和他的门徒一同坐席。

chapters.en: When the Pharisees saw this, they asked His disciples, “Why does your Teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
chapters.zh: 法利赛人看见，就对耶稣的门徒说：「你们的先生为什么和税吏并罪人一同吃饭呢？」

chapters.en: On hearing this, Jesus said, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.
chapters.zh: 耶稣听见，就说：「康健的人用不着医生，有病的人才用得着。

chapters.en: But go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice.’ For I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners. ”
chapters.zh: 〔经上说〕：『我喜爱怜恤，不喜爱祭祀。』这句话的意思，你们且去揣摩。我来本不是召义人，乃是召罪人。」

chapters.en: Then John’s disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Why is it that we and the Pharisees fast so often, but Your disciples do not fast?”
chapters.zh: 那时，约翰的门徒来见耶稣，说：「我们和法利赛人常常禁食，你的门徒倒不禁食，这是为什么呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “How can the guests of the bridegroom mourn while He is with them? But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「新郎和陪伴之人同在的时候，陪伴之人岂能哀恸呢？但日子将到，新郎要离开他们，那时候他们就要禁食。

chapters.en: No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. For the patch will pull away from the garment, and a worse tear will result.
chapters.zh: 没有人把新布补在旧衣服上；因为所补上的反带坏了那衣服，破的就更大了。

chapters.en: Neither do men pour new wine into old wineskins. If they do, the skins will burst, the wine will spill, and the wineskins will be ruined. Instead, they pour new wine into new wineskins, and both are preserved.”
chapters.zh: 也没有人把新酒装在旧皮袋里；若是这样，皮袋就裂开，酒漏出来，连皮袋也坏了。惟独把新酒装在新皮袋里，两样就都保全了。」

chapters.en: While Jesus was saying these things, a synagogue leader came and knelt before Him. “My daughter has just died,” he said. “But come and place Your hand on her, and she will live.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说这话的时候，有一个管〔会堂的〕来拜他，说：「我女儿刚才死了，求你去按手在她身上，她就必活了。」

chapters.en: So Jesus got up and went with him, along with His disciples.
chapters.zh: 耶稣便起来跟着他去；门徒也跟了去。

chapters.en: Suddenly a woman who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years came up behind Him and touched the fringe of His cloak.
chapters.zh: 有一个女人，患了十二年的血漏，来到耶稣背后，摸他的衣裳繸子；

chapters.en: She said to herself, “If only I touch His cloak, I will be healed.”
chapters.zh: 因为她心里说：「我只摸他的衣裳，就必痊愈。」

chapters.en: Jesus turned and saw her. “Take courage, daughter,” He said, “your faith has healed you.” And the woman was healed from that very hour.
chapters.zh: 耶稣转过来，看见她，就说：「女儿，放心！你的信救了你。」从那时候，女人就痊愈了。

chapters.en: When Jesus entered the house of the synagogue leader, He saw the flute players and the noisy crowd.
chapters.zh: 耶稣到了管〔会堂〕的家里，看见有吹手，又有许多人乱嚷，

chapters.en: “Go away,” He told them. “The girl is not dead, but asleep.” And they laughed at Him.
chapters.zh: 就说：「退去吧！这闺女不是死了，是睡着了。」他们就嗤笑他。

chapters.en: After the crowd had been put outside, Jesus went in and took the girl by the hand, and she got up.
chapters.zh: 众人既被撵出，耶稣就进去，拉着闺女的手，闺女便起来了。

chapters.en: And the news about this spread throughout that region.
chapters.zh: 于是这风声传遍了那地方。

chapters.en: As Jesus went on from there, two blind men followed Him, crying out, “Have mercy on us, Son of David!”
chapters.zh: 耶稣从那里往前走，有两个瞎子跟着他，喊叫说：「大卫的子孙，可怜我们吧！」

chapters.en:
After Jesus had entered the house, the blind men came to Him. “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” He asked.
“Yes, Lord,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 耶稣进了房子，瞎子就来到他跟前。耶稣说：「你们信我能做这事吗？」他们说：「主啊，我们信。」

chapters.en: Then He touched their eyes and said, “According to your faith will it be done to you.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣就摸他们的眼睛，说：「照着你们的信给你们成全了吧。」

chapters.en: And their eyes were opened. Jesus warned them sternly, “See that no one finds out about this!”
chapters.zh: 他们的眼睛就开了。耶稣切切地嘱咐他们说：「你们要小心，不可叫人知道。」

chapters.en: But they went out and spread the news about Him throughout the land.
chapters.zh: 他们出去，竟把他的名声传遍了那地方。

chapters.en: As they were leaving, a demon-possessed man who was mute was brought to Jesus.
chapters.zh: 他们出去的时候，有人将鬼所附的一个哑巴带到耶稣跟前来。

chapters.en: And when the demon had been driven out, the man began to speak. The crowds were amazed and said, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”
chapters.zh: 鬼被赶出去，哑巴就说出话来。众人都希奇，说：「在以色列中，从来没有见过这样的事。」

chapters.en: But the Pharisees said, “It is by the prince of demons that He drives out demons.”
chapters.zh: 法利赛人却说：「他是靠着鬼王赶鬼。」

chapters.en: Jesus went through all the towns and villages, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness.
chapters.zh: 耶稣走遍各城各乡，在会堂里教训人，宣讲天国的福音，又医治各样的病症。

chapters.en: When He saw the crowds, He was moved with compassion for them, because they were harassed and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.
chapters.zh: 他看见许多的人，就怜悯他们；因为他们困苦流离，如同羊没有牧人一般。

chapters.en: Then He said to His disciples, “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few.
chapters.zh: 于是对门徒说：「要收的庄稼多，做工的人少。

chapters.en: Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into His harvest.”
chapters.zh: 所以，你们当求庄稼的主打发工人出去收他的庄稼。」

chapters.en: And calling His twelve disciples to Him, Jesus gave them authority over unclean spirits, so that they could drive them out and heal every disease and sickness.
chapters.zh: 耶稣叫了十二个门徒来，给他们权柄，能赶逐污鬼，并医治各样的病症。

chapters.en: These are the names of the twelve apostles: first Simon, called Peter, and his brother Andrew; James son of Zebedee, and his brother John;
chapters.zh: 这十二使徒的名：头一个叫西门（又称彼得），还有他兄弟安得烈，西庇太的儿子雅各和雅各的兄弟约翰，

chapters.en: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;
chapters.zh: 腓力和巴多罗买，多马和税吏马太，亚勒腓的儿子雅各，和达太，

chapters.en: Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus.
chapters.zh: 奋锐党的西门，还有卖耶稣的加略人犹大。

chapters.en: These twelve Jesus sent out with the following instructions: “Do not go onto the road of the Gentiles or enter any town of the Samaritans.
chapters.zh: 耶稣差这十二个人去，吩咐他们说：「外邦人的路，你们不要走；撒马利亚人的城，你们不要进；

chapters.en: Go rather to the lost sheep of Israel.
chapters.zh: 宁可往以色列家迷失的羊那里去。

chapters.en: As you go, preach this message: ‘The kingdom of heaven is near.’
chapters.zh: 随走随传，说『天国近了！』

chapters.en: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, drive out demons. Freely you have received; freely give.
chapters.zh: 医治病人，叫死人复活，叫长大痲疯的洁净，把鬼赶出去。你们白白地得来，也要白白地舍去。

chapters.en: Do not take along any gold or silver or copper in your belts.
chapters.zh: 腰袋里不要带金银铜钱；

chapters.en: Take no bag for the road, or second tunic, or sandals, or staff; for the worker is worthy of his provisions.
chapters.zh: 行路不要带口袋；不要带两件褂子，也不要带鞋和柺杖。因为工人得饮食是应当的。

chapters.en: Whatever town or village you enter, find out who is worthy there and stay at his house until you move on.
chapters.zh: 你们无论进哪一城，哪一村，要打听那里谁是好人，就住在他家，直住到走的时候。

chapters.en: As you enter the home, greet its occupants.
chapters.zh: 进他家里去，要请他的安。

chapters.en: If the home is worthy, let your peace rest on it, but if it is not, let your peace return to you.
chapters.zh: 那家若配得平安，你们所求的平安就必临到那家；若不配得，你们所求的平安仍归你们。

chapters.en: And if anyone will not welcome you or heed your words, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that home or town.
chapters.zh: 凡不接待你们、不听你们话的人，你们离开那家，或是那城的时候，就把脚上的尘土跺下去。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, it will be more bearable for Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of judgment than for that town.
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，当审判的日子，所多玛和蛾摩拉所受的，比那城还容易受呢！」

chapters.en: Behold, I am sending you out like sheep among wolves; therefore be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves.
chapters.zh: 「我差你们去，如同羊进入狼群；所以你们要灵巧像蛇，驯良像鸽子。

chapters.en: But beware of men, for they will hand you over to their councils and flog you in their synagogues.
chapters.zh: 你们要防备人；因为他们要把你们交给公会，也要在会堂里鞭打你们，

chapters.en: On My account you will be brought before governors and kings as witnesses to them and to the Gentiles.
chapters.zh: 并且你们要为我的缘故被送到诸侯君王面前，对他们和外邦人作见证。

chapters.en: But when they hand you over, do not worry about how to respond or what to say. In that hour you will be given what to say.
chapters.zh: 你们被交的时候，不要思虑怎样说话，或说什么话。到那时候，必赐给你们当说的话；

chapters.en: For it will not be you speaking, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.
chapters.zh: 因为不是你们自己说的，乃是你们父的灵在你们里头说的。

chapters.en: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child; children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.
chapters.zh: 弟兄要把弟兄，父亲要把儿子，送到死地；儿女要与父母为敌，害死他们；

chapters.en: You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
chapters.zh: 并且你们要为我的名被众人恨恶。惟有忍耐到底的必然得救。

chapters.en: When they persecute you in one town, flee to the next. Truly I tell you, you will not reach all the towns of Israel before the Son of Man comes.
chapters.zh: 有人在这城里逼迫你们，就逃到那城里去。我实在告诉你们，以色列的城邑，你们还没有走遍，人子就到了。

chapters.en: A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his master.
chapters.zh: 学生不能高过先生；仆人不能高过主人。

chapters.en: It is enough for a disciple to be like his teacher, and a servant like his master. If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, how much more the members of his household!
chapters.zh: 学生和先生一样，仆人和主人一样，也就罢了。人既骂家主是别西卜〔注：别西卜：是鬼王的名〕，何况他的家人呢？」

chapters.en: So do not be afraid of them. For there is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, and nothing hidden that will not be made known.
chapters.zh: 「所以，不要怕他们；因为掩盖的事没有不露出来的，隐藏的事没有不被人知道的。

chapters.en: What I tell you in the dark, speak in the daylight; what is whispered in your ear, proclaim from the housetops.
chapters.zh: 我在暗中告诉你们的，你们要在明处说出来；你们耳中所听的，要在房上宣扬出来。

chapters.en: Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Instead, fear the One who can destroy both soul and body in hell.
chapters.zh: 那杀身体、不能杀灵魂的，不要怕他们；惟有能把身体和灵魂都灭在地狱里的，正要怕他。

chapters.en: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father.
chapters.zh: 两个麻雀不是卖一分银子吗？若是你们的父不许，一个也不能掉在地上；

chapters.en: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
chapters.zh: 就是你们的头发也都被数过了。

chapters.en: So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.
chapters.zh: 所以，不要惧怕，你们比许多麻雀还贵重！」

chapters.en: Therefore everyone who confesses Me before men, I will also confess him before My Father in heaven.
chapters.zh: 「凡在人面前认我的，我在我天上的父面前也必认他；

chapters.en: But whoever denies Me before men, I will also deny him before My Father in heaven.
chapters.zh: 凡在人面前不认我的，我在我天上的父面前也必不认他。」

chapters.en: Do not assume that I have come to bring peace to the earth; I have not come to bring peace, but a sword.
chapters.zh: 「你们不要想我来是叫地上太平；我来并不是叫地上太平，乃是叫地上动刀兵。

chapters.en:
For I have come to turn
‘a man against his father, a daughter against her mother,
a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
chapters.zh: 因为我来是叫 人与父亲生疏， 女儿与母亲生疏， 媳妇与婆婆生疏。

chapters.en: A man’s enemies will be the members of his own household.’
chapters.zh: 人的仇敌就是自己家里的人。

chapters.en: Anyone who loves his father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me; anyone who loves his son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me;
chapters.zh: 「爱父母过于爱我的，不配作我的门徒；爱儿女过于爱我的，不配作我的门徒；

chapters.en: and anyone who does not take up his cross and follow Me is not worthy of Me.
chapters.zh: 不背着他的十字架跟从我的，也不配作我的门徒。

chapters.en: Whoever finds his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.
chapters.zh: 得着生命的，将要失丧生命；为我失丧生命的，将要得着生命。」

chapters.en: He who receives you receives Me, and he who receives Me receives the One who sent Me.
chapters.zh: 「人接待你们就是接待我；接待我就是接待那差我来的。

chapters.en: Whoever receives a prophet because he is a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward, and whoever receives a righteous man because he is a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.
chapters.zh: 人因为先知的名接待先知，必得先知所得的赏赐；人因为义人的名接待义人，必得义人所得的赏赐。

chapters.en: And if anyone gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because he is My disciple, truly I tell you, he will never lose his reward.”
chapters.zh: 无论何人，因为门徒的名，只把一杯凉水给这小子里的一个喝，我实在告诉你们，这人不能不得赏赐。」

chapters.en: After Jesus had finished instructing His twelve disciples, He went on from there to teach and preach in their cities.
chapters.zh: 耶稣吩咐完了十二个门徒，就离开那里，往各城去传道、教训人。

chapters.en: Meanwhile John heard in prison about the works of Christ, and he sent his disciples
chapters.zh: 约翰在监里听见基督所做的事，就打发〔两个〕门徒去，

chapters.en: to ask Him, “Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?”
chapters.zh: 问他说：「那将要来的是你吗？还是我们等候别人呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Go back and report to John what you hear and see:
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你们去，把所听见、所看见的事告诉约翰。

chapters.en: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.
chapters.zh: 就是瞎子看见，瘸子行走，长大痲疯的洁净，聋子听见，死人复活，穷人有福音传给他们。

chapters.en: Blessed is the one who does not fall away on account of Me. ”
chapters.zh: 凡不因我跌倒的就有福了！」

chapters.en: As John’s disciples were leaving, Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed swaying in the wind?
chapters.zh: 他们走的时候，耶稣就对众人讲论约翰说：「你们从前出到旷野是要看什么呢？要看风吹动的芦苇吗？

chapters.en: Otherwise, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? Look, those who wear fine clothing are found in kings’ palaces.
chapters.zh: 你们出去到底是要看什么？要看穿细软〔衣服〕的人吗？那穿细软〔衣服〕的人是在王宫里。

chapters.en: What then did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
chapters.zh: 你们出去究竟是为什么？是要看先知吗？我告诉你们，是的，他比先知大多了。

chapters.en:
This is the one about whom it is written:
‘Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way before You.’
chapters.zh: 〔经上〕记着说：『我要差遣我的使者在你前面预备道路』，所说的就是这个人。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, among those born of women there has risen no one greater than John the Baptist. Yet even the least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，凡妇人所生的，没有一个兴起来大过施洗约翰的；然而天国里最小的比他还大。

chapters.en: From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven has been subject to violence, and the violent lay claim to it.
chapters.zh: 从施洗约翰的时候到如今，天国是努力进入的，努力的人就得着了。

chapters.en: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.
chapters.zh: 因为众先知和律法说预言，到约翰为止。

chapters.en: And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come.
chapters.zh: 你们若肯领受，这人就是那应当来的以利亚。

chapters.en: He who has ears, let him hear.
chapters.zh: 有耳可听的，就应当听！

chapters.en: To what can I compare this generation? They are like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling out to others:
chapters.zh: 我可用什么比这世代呢？好像孩童坐在街市上招呼同伴，说：

chapters.en: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not mourn.’
chapters.zh: 我们向你们吹笛， 你们不跳舞； 我们向你们举哀， 你们不捶胸。

chapters.en: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon!’
chapters.zh: 约翰来了，也不吃也不喝，人就说他是被鬼附着的；

chapters.en: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Look at this glutton and drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is vindicated by her actions.”
chapters.zh: 人子来了，也吃也喝，人又说他是贪食好酒的人，是税吏和罪人的朋友。但智慧之子总以智慧为是〔注：有古卷：但智慧在行为上就显为是〕。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus began to denounce the cities in which most of His miracles had been performed, because they did not repent.
chapters.zh: 耶稣在诸城中行了许多异能，那些城的人终不悔改，就在那时候责备他们，说：

chapters.en: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
chapters.zh: 「哥拉汛哪，你有祸了！伯赛大啊，你有祸了！因为在你们中间所行的异能，若行在泰尔、西顿，他们早已披麻蒙灰悔改了。

chapters.en: But I tell you, it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.
chapters.zh: 但我告诉你们，当审判的日子，泰尔、西顿所受的，比你们还容易受呢！

chapters.en: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted up to heaven? No, you will be brought down to Hades! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Sodom, it would have remained to this day.
chapters.zh: 迦百农啊，你已经升到天上〔注：或译：你将要升到天上吗〕，将来必坠落阴间；因为在你那里所行的异能，若行在所多玛，它还可以存到今日。

chapters.en: But I tell you that it will be more bearable for Sodom on the day of judgment than for you.”
chapters.zh: 但我告诉你们，当审判的日子，所多玛所受的，比你还容易受呢！」

chapters.en: At that time Jesus declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.
chapters.zh: 那时，耶稣说：「父啊，天地的主，我感谢你！因为你将这些事向聪明通达人就藏起来，向婴孩就显出来。

chapters.en: Yes, Father, for this was well-pleasing in Your sight.
chapters.zh: 父啊，是的，因为你的美意本是如此。

chapters.en: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.
chapters.zh: 一切所有的，都是我父交付我的；除了父，没有人知道子；除了子和子所愿意指示的，没有人知道父。

chapters.en: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
chapters.zh: 凡劳苦担重担的人可以到我这里来，我就使你们得安息。

chapters.en: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
chapters.zh: 我心里柔和谦卑，你们当负我的轭，学我的样式；这样，你们心里就必得享安息。

chapters.en: For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.”
chapters.zh: 因为我的轭是容易的，我的担子是轻省的。」

chapters.en: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry and began to pick the heads of grain and eat them.
chapters.zh: 那时，耶稣在安息日从麦地经过。他的门徒饿了，就掐起麦穗来吃。

chapters.en: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to Him, “Look, Your disciples are doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath.”
chapters.zh: 法利赛人看见，就对耶稣说：「看哪，你的门徒做安息日不可做的事了！」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Have you not read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「〔经上记着〕大卫和跟从他的人饥饿之时所做的事，你们没有念过吗？

chapters.en: He entered the house of God, and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread, which was not lawful for them to eat, but only for the priests.
chapters.zh: 他怎么进了上帝的殿，吃了陈设饼，这饼不是他和跟从他的人可以吃得，惟独祭司才可以吃。

chapters.en: Or haven’t you read in the Law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple break the Sabbath and yet are innocent?
chapters.zh: 再者，律法上所记的，当安息日，祭司在殿里犯了安息日还是没有罪，你们没有念过吗？

chapters.en: But I tell you that One greater than the temple is here.
chapters.zh: 但我告诉你们，在这里有一人比殿更大。

chapters.en: If only you had known the meaning of ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the innocent.
chapters.zh: 『我喜爱怜恤，不喜爱祭祀。』你们若明白这话的意思，就不将无罪的当作有罪的了。

chapters.en: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
chapters.zh: 因为人子是安息日的主。」

chapters.en: Moving on from there, Jesus entered their synagogue,
chapters.zh: 耶稣离开那地方，进了一个会堂。

chapters.en: and a man with a withered hand was there. In order to accuse Jesus, they asked Him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
chapters.zh: 那里有一个人枯干了一只手。有人问耶稣说：「安息日治病可以不可以？」意思是要控告他。

chapters.en: He replied, “If one of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will he not take hold of it and lift it out?
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们中间谁有一只羊，当安息日掉在坑里，不把牠抓住、拉上来呢？

chapters.en: How much more valuable is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath.”
chapters.zh: 人比羊何等贵重呢！所以，在安息日做善事是可以的。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” So he stretched it out, and it was restored to full use, just like the other.
chapters.zh: 于是对那人说：「伸出手来！」他把手一伸，手就复了原，和那只手一样。

chapters.en: But the Pharisees went out and plotted how they might kill Jesus.
chapters.zh: 法利赛人出去，商议怎样可以除灭耶稣。

chapters.en: Aware of this, Jesus withdrew from that place. Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them all,
chapters.zh: 耶稣知道了，就离开那里，有许多人跟着他。他把其中有病的人都治好了；

chapters.en: warning them not to make Him known.
chapters.zh: 又嘱咐他们，不要给他传名。

chapters.en: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:
chapters.zh: 这是要应验先知以赛亚的话，说：

chapters.en: “Here is My Servant, whom I have chosen, My beloved, in whom My soul delights. I will put My Spirit on Him, and He will proclaim justice to the nations.
chapters.zh: 看哪！我的仆人， 我所拣选、所亲爱、心里所喜悦的， 我要将我的灵赐给他； 他必将公理传给外邦。

chapters.en: He will not quarrel or cry out; no one will hear His voice in the streets.
chapters.zh: 他不争竞，不喧嚷； 街上也没有人听见他的声音。

chapters.en: A bruised reed He will not break, and a smoldering wick He will not extinguish, till He leads justice to victory.
chapters.zh: 压伤的芦苇，他不折断； 将残的灯火，他不吹灭； 等他施行公理，叫公理得胜。

chapters.en: In His name the nations will put their hope.”
chapters.zh: 外邦人都要仰望他的名。

chapters.en: Then a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute was brought to Jesus, and He healed the man so that he could speak and see.
chapters.zh: 当下，有人将一个被鬼附着、又瞎又哑的人带到耶稣那里，耶稣就医治他，甚至那哑巴又能说话，又能看见。

chapters.en: The crowds were astounded and asked, “Could this be the Son of David?”
chapters.zh: 众人都惊奇，说：「这不是大卫的子孙吗？」

chapters.en: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, “Only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, does this man drive out demons.”
chapters.zh: 但法利赛人听见，就说：「这个人赶鬼，无非是靠着鬼王别西卜啊。」

chapters.en: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.
chapters.zh: 耶稣知道他们的意念，就对他们说：「凡一国自相纷争，就成为荒场；一城一家自相纷争，必站立不住；

chapters.en: If Satan drives out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then can his kingdom stand?
chapters.zh: 若撒但赶逐撒但，就是自相纷争，他的国怎能站得住呢？

chapters.en: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.
chapters.zh: 我若靠着别西卜赶鬼，你们的子弟赶鬼又靠着谁呢？这样，他们就要断定你们的是非。

chapters.en: But if I drive out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
chapters.zh: 我若靠着上帝的灵赶鬼，这就是上帝的国临到你们了。

chapters.en: Or again, how can anyone enter a strong man’s house and steal his possessions, unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can plunder his house.
chapters.zh: 人怎能进壮士家里，抢夺他的家具呢？除非先捆住那壮士，才可以抢夺他的〔家财〕。

chapters.en: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.
chapters.zh: 不与我相合的，就是敌我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。」

chapters.en: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.
chapters.zh: 所以我告诉你们：「人一切的罪和亵渎的话都可得赦免，惟独亵渎圣灵，总不得赦免。

chapters.en: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the one to come.
chapters.zh: 凡说话干犯人子的，还可得赦免；惟独说话干犯圣灵的，今世来世总不得赦免。」

chapters.en: Make a tree good and its fruit will be good, or make a tree bad and its fruit will be bad, for a tree is known by its fruit.
chapters.zh: 「你们或以为树好，果子也好；树坏，果子也坏；因为看果子就可以知道树。

chapters.en: You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For out of the overflow of the heart the mouth speaks.
chapters.zh: 毒蛇的种类！你们既是恶人，怎能说出好话来呢？因为心里所充满的，口里就说出来。

chapters.en: The good man brings good things out of his good store of treasure, and the evil man brings evil things out of his evil store of treasure.
chapters.zh: 善人从他〔心里〕所存的善就发出善来；恶人从他〔心里〕所存的恶就发出恶来。

chapters.en: But I tell you that men will give an account on the day of judgment for every careless word they have spoken.
chapters.zh: 我又告诉你们，凡人所说的闲话，当审判的日子，必要句句供出来；

chapters.en: For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned.”
chapters.zh: 因为要凭你的话定你为义，也要凭你的话定你有罪。」

chapters.en: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees said to Him, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from You.”
chapters.zh: 当时，有几个文士和法利赛人对耶稣说：「夫子，我们愿意你显个神迹给我们看。」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「一个邪恶淫乱的世代求看神迹，除了先知约拿的神迹以外，再没有神迹给他们看。

chapters.en: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the great fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
chapters.zh: 约拿三日三夜在大鱼肚腹中，人子也要这样三日三夜在地里头。

chapters.en: The men of Nineveh will stand at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now One greater than Jonah is here.
chapters.zh: 当审判的时候，尼尼微人要起来定这世代的罪，因为尼尼微人听了约拿所传的就悔改了。看哪，在这里有一人比约拿更大！

chapters.en: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and now One greater than Solomon is here.
chapters.zh: 当审判的时候，南方的女王要起来定这世代的罪；因为她从地极而来，要听所罗门的智慧话。看哪，在这里有一人比所罗门更大！」

chapters.en: When an unclean spirit comes out of a man, it passes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it.
chapters.zh: 「污鬼离了人身，就在无水之地过来过去，寻求安歇〔之处〕，却寻不着。

chapters.en: Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’ On its return, it finds the house vacant, swept clean, and put in order.
chapters.zh: 于是说：『我要回到我所出来的屋里去。』到了，就看见里面空闲，打扫干净，修饰好了，

chapters.en: Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and dwell there. And the final plight of that man is worse than the first. So will it be with this wicked generation.”
chapters.zh: 便去另带了七个比自己更恶的鬼来，都进去住在那里。那人末后的景况比先前更不好了。这邪恶的世代也要如此。」

chapters.en: While Jesus was still speaking to the crowds, His mother and brothers stood outside, wanting to speak to Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣还对众人说话的时候，不料他母亲和他弟兄站在外边，要与他说话。

chapters.en: Someone told Him, “Look, Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to speak to You.”
chapters.zh: 有人告诉他说：「看哪，你母亲和你弟兄站在外边，要与你说话。」

chapters.en: But Jesus replied, “Who is My mother, and who are My brothers?”
chapters.zh: 他却回答那人说：「谁是我的母亲？谁是我的弟兄？」

chapters.en: Pointing to His disciples, He said, “Here are My mother and My brothers.
chapters.zh: 就伸手指着门徒，说：「看哪，我的母亲，我的弟兄。

chapters.en: For whoever does the will of My Father in heaven is My brother and sister and mother.”
chapters.zh: 凡遵行我天父旨意的人，就是我的弟兄姊妹和母亲了。」

chapters.en: That same day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the sea.
chapters.zh: 当那一天，耶稣从房子里出来，坐在海边。

chapters.en: Such large crowds gathered around Him that He got into a boat and sat down, while all the people stood on the shore.
chapters.zh: 有许多人到他那里聚集，他只得上船坐下，众人都站在岸上。

chapters.en: And He told them many things in parables, saying, “A farmer went out to sow his seed.
chapters.zh: 他用比喻对他们讲许多道理，说：「有一个撒种的出去撒种；

chapters.en: And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.
chapters.zh: 撒的时候，有落在路旁的，飞鸟来吃尽了；

chapters.en: Some fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.
chapters.zh: 有落在土浅石头地上的，土既不深，发苗最快，

chapters.en: But when the sun rose, the seedlings were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.
chapters.zh: 日头出来一晒，因为没有根，就枯干了；

chapters.en: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the seedlings.
chapters.zh: 有落在荆棘里的，荆棘长起来，把它挤住了；

chapters.en: Still other seed fell on good soil and produced a crop—a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.
chapters.zh: 又有落在好土里的，就结实，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。

chapters.en: He who has ears, let him hear.”
chapters.zh: 有耳〔可听〕的，就应当听！」

chapters.en: Then the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Why do You speak to the people in parables?”
chapters.zh: 门徒进前来，问耶稣说：「对众人讲话，为什么用比喻呢？」

chapters.en: He replied, “The knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「因为天国的奥祕只叫你们知道，不叫他们知道。

chapters.en: Whoever has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
chapters.zh: 凡有的，还要加给他，叫他有余；凡没有的，连他所有的，也要夺去。

chapters.en:
This is why I speak to them in parables:
‘Though seeing, they do not see; though hearing, they do not hear or understand.’
chapters.zh: 所以我用比喻对他们讲，是因他们看也看不见，听也听不见，也不明白。

chapters.en:
In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled:
‘You will be ever hearing but never understanding; you will be ever seeing but never perceiving.
chapters.zh: 在他们身上，正应了以赛亚的预言，说： 你们听是要听见，却不明白； 看是要看见，却不晓得；

chapters.en:
For this people’s heart has grown callous; they hardly hear with their ears,
and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears,
understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.’
chapters.zh: 因为这百姓油蒙了心， 耳朵发沉， 眼睛闭着， 恐怕眼睛看见， 耳朵听见， 心里明白，回转过来， 我就医治他们。

chapters.en: But blessed are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear.
chapters.zh: 「但你们的眼睛是有福的，因为看见了；你们的耳朵也是有福的，因为听见了。

chapters.en: For truly I tell you, many prophets and righteous men longed to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，从前有许多先知和义人要看你们所看的，却没有看见，要听你们所听的，却没有听见。」

chapters.en: Consider, then, the parable of the sower:
chapters.zh: 「所以，你们当听这撒种的比喻。

chapters.en: When anyone hears the message of the kingdom but does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart. This is the seed sown along the path.
chapters.zh: 凡听见天国道理不明白的，那恶者就来，把所撒在他心里的夺了去；这就是撒在路旁的了。

chapters.en: The seed sown on rocky ground is the one who hears the word and at once receives it with joy.
chapters.zh: 撒在石头地上的，就是人听了道，当下欢喜领受，

chapters.en: But since he has no root, he remains for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, he quickly falls away.
chapters.zh: 只因心里没有根，不过是暂时的，及至为道遭了患难，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。

chapters.en: The seed sown among the thorns is the one who hears the word, but the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
chapters.zh: 撒在荆棘里的，就是人听了道，后来有世上的思虑、钱财的迷惑把道挤住了，不能结实。

chapters.en: But the seed sown on good soil is the one who hears the word and understands it. He indeed bears fruit and produces a crop—a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.”
chapters.zh: 撒在好地上的，就是人听道明白了，后来结实，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。」

chapters.en: Jesus put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又设个比喻对他们说：「天国好像人撒好种在田里，

chapters.en: But while everyone was asleep, his enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, and slipped away.
chapters.zh: 及至人睡觉的时候，有仇敌来，将稗子撒在麦子里就走了。

chapters.en: When the wheat sprouted and bore grain, then the weeds also appeared.
chapters.zh: 到长苗吐穗的时候，稗子也显出来。

chapters.en: The owner’s servants came to him and said, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where then did the weeds come from?’
chapters.zh: 田主的仆人来告诉他说：『主啊，你不是撒好种在田里吗？从哪里来的稗子呢？』

chapters.en:
‘An enemy did this,’ he replied.
So the servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and pull them up?’
chapters.zh: 主人说：『这是仇敌做的。』仆人说：『你要我们去薅出来吗？』

chapters.en: ‘No,’ he said, ‘if you pull the weeds now, you might uproot the wheat with them.
chapters.zh: 主人说：『不必，恐怕薅稗子，连麦子也拔出来。

chapters.en: Let both grow together until the harvest. At that time I will tell the harvesters: First collect the weeds and tie them in bundles to be burned; then gather the wheat into my barn.’”
chapters.zh: 容这两样一齐长，等着收割。当收割的时候，我要对收割的人说，先将稗子薅出来，捆成捆，留着烧；惟有麦子要收在仓里。』」

chapters.en: He put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed that a man took and planted in his field.
chapters.zh: 他又设个比喻对他们说：「天国好像一粒芥菜种，有人拿去种在田里。

chapters.en: Although it is the smallest of all seeds, yet it grows into the largest of garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and nest in its branches.”
chapters.zh: 这原是百种里最小的，等到长起来，却比各样的菜都大，且成了树，天上的飞鸟来宿在它的枝上。」

chapters.en: He told them still another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.”
chapters.zh: 他又对他们讲个比喻说：「天国好像面酵，有妇人拿来，藏在三斗面里，直等全团都发起来。」

chapters.en: Jesus spoke all these things to the crowds in parables. He did not tell them anything without using a parable.
chapters.zh: 这都是耶稣用比喻对众人说的话；若不用比喻，就不对他们说什么。

chapters.en:
So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophet:
“I will open My mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden since the foundation of the world.”
chapters.zh: 这是要应验先知的话，说： 我要开口用比喻， 把创世以来所隐藏的事发明出来。

chapters.en: Then Jesus dismissed the crowds and went into the house. His disciples came to Him and said, “Explain to us the parable of the weeds in the field.”
chapters.zh: 当下，耶稣离开众人，进了房子。他的门徒进前来，说：「请把田间稗子的比喻讲给我们听。」

chapters.en: He replied, “The One who sows the good seed is the Son of Man.
chapters.zh: 他回答说：「那撒好种的就是人子；

chapters.en: The field is the world, and the good seed represents the sons of the kingdom. The weeds are the sons of the evil one,
chapters.zh: 田地就是世界；好种就是天国之子；稗子就是那恶者之子；

chapters.en: and the enemy who sows them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels.
chapters.zh: 撒稗子的仇敌就是魔鬼；收割的时候就是世界的末了；收割的人就是天使。

chapters.en: As the weeds are collected and burned in the fire, so will it be at the end of the age.
chapters.zh: 将稗子薅出来用火焚烧，世界的末了也要如此。

chapters.en: The Son of Man will send out His angels, and they will weed out of His kingdom every cause of sin and all who practice lawlessness.
chapters.zh: 人子要差遣使者，把一切叫人跌倒的和作恶的，从他国里挑出来，

chapters.en: And they will throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
chapters.zh: 丢在火炉里；在那里必要哀哭切齿了。

chapters.en:
Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father.
He who has ears, let him hear.
chapters.zh: 那时，义人在他们父的国里，要发出光来，像太阳一样。有耳〔可听〕的，就应当听！」

chapters.en: The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and in his joy he went and sold all he had and bought that field.
chapters.zh: 「天国好像宝贝藏在地里，人遇见了就把它藏起来，欢欢喜喜地去变卖一切所有的，买这块地。

chapters.en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant in search of fine pearls.
chapters.zh: 天国又好像买卖人寻找好珠子，

chapters.en: When he found one very precious pearl, he went away and sold all he had and bought it.
chapters.zh: 遇见一颗重价的珠子，就去变卖他一切所有的，买了这颗珠子。

chapters.en: Once again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was cast into the sea and caught all kinds of fish.
chapters.zh: 天国又好像网撒在海里，聚拢各样水族，

chapters.en: When it was full, the men pulled it ashore. Then they sat down and sorted the good fish into containers, but threw the bad away.
chapters.zh: 网既满了，人就拉上岸来，坐下，拣好的收在器具里，将不好的丢弃了。

chapters.en: So will it be at the end of the age: The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous
chapters.zh: 世界的末了也要这样。天使要出来，从义人中把恶人分别出来，

chapters.en: and throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
chapters.zh: 丢在火炉里；在那里必要哀哭切齿了。」

chapters.en:
Have you understood all these things?”
“Yes,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 〔耶稣说〕：「这一切的话你们都明白了吗？」他们说：「我们明白了。」

chapters.en: Then He told them, “For this reason, every scribe who has been discipled in the kingdom of heaven is like a homeowner who brings out of his storeroom new treasures as well as old.”
chapters.zh: 他说：「凡文士受教作天国的门徒，就像一个家主从他库里拿出新旧的东西来。」

chapters.en: When Jesus had finished these parables, He withdrew from that place.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说完了这些比喻，就离开那里，

chapters.en: Coming to His hometown, He taught the people in their synagogue, and they were astonished. “Where did this man get such wisdom and miraculous powers?” they asked.
chapters.zh: 来到自己的家乡，在会堂里教训人，甚至他们都希奇，说：「这人从哪里有这等智慧和异能呢？

chapters.en: “Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t His mother’s name Mary, and aren’t His brothers James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas?
chapters.zh: 这不是木匠的儿子吗？他母亲不是叫马利亚吗？他弟兄们不是叫雅各、约西〔注：有古卷：约瑟〕、西门、犹大吗？

chapters.en: Aren’t all His sisters with us as well? Where then did this man get all these things?”
chapters.zh: 他妹妹们不是都在我们这里吗？这人从哪里有这一切的事呢？」

chapters.en:
And they took offense at Him.
But Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”
chapters.zh: 他们就厌弃他〔注：厌弃他：原文是因他跌倒〕。耶稣对他们说：「大凡先知，除了本地本家之外，没有不被人尊敬的。」

chapters.en: And He did not do many miracles there, because of their unbelief.
chapters.zh: 耶稣因为他们不信，就在那里不多行异能了。

chapters.en: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus
chapters.zh: 那时，分封的王希律听见耶稣的名声，

chapters.en: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptist; he has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”
chapters.zh: 就对臣仆说：「这是施洗的约翰从死里复活，所以这些异能从他里面发出来。」

chapters.en: Now Herod had arrested John and bound him and put him in prison on account of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife,
chapters.zh: 起先，希律为他兄弟腓力的妻子希罗底的缘故，把约翰拿住，锁在监里。

chapters.en: because John had been telling him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
chapters.zh: 因为约翰曾对他说：「你娶这妇人是不合理的。」

chapters.en: Although Herod wanted to kill John, he was afraid of the people, because they regarded John as a prophet.
chapters.zh: 希律就想要杀他，只是怕百姓，因为他们以约翰为先知。

chapters.en: On Herod’s birthday, however, the daughter of Herodias danced before them and pleased Herod
chapters.zh: 到了希律的生日，希罗底的女儿在众人面前跳舞，使希律欢喜。

chapters.en: so much that he promised with an oath to give to her whatever she asked.
chapters.zh: 希律就起誓，应许随她所求的给她。

chapters.en: Prompted by her mother, she said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist.”
chapters.zh: 女儿被母亲所使，就说：「请把施洗约翰的头放在盘子里，拿来给我。」

chapters.en: The king was grieved, but because of his oaths and his guests, he ordered that her wish be granted
chapters.zh: 王便忧愁，但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就吩咐给她；

chapters.en: and sent to have John beheaded in the prison.
chapters.zh: 于是打发人去，在监里斩了约翰，

chapters.en: John’s head was brought in on a platter and presented to the girl, who carried it to her mother.
chapters.zh: 把头放在盘子里，拿来给了女子；女子拿去给她母亲。

chapters.en: Then John’s disciples came and took his body and buried it. And they went and informed Jesus.
chapters.zh: 约翰的门徒来，把尸首领去埋葬了，就去告诉耶稣。

chapters.en: When Jesus heard about John, He withdrew by boat privately to a solitary place. But the crowds found out about it and followed Him on foot from the towns.
chapters.zh: 耶稣听见了，就上船从那里独自退到野地里去。众人听见，就从各城里步行跟随他。

chapters.en: When He stepped ashore and saw a large crowd, He had compassion on them and healed their sick.
chapters.zh: 耶稣出来，见有许多的人，就怜悯他们，治好了他们的病人。

chapters.en: When evening came, the disciples came to Him and said, “This is a desolate place, and the hour is already late. Dismiss the crowds so they can go to the villages and buy themselves some food.”
chapters.zh: 天将晚的时候，门徒进前来，说：「这是野地，时候已经过了，请叫众人散开，他们好往村子里去，自己买吃的。」

chapters.en: “They do not need to go away,” Jesus replied. “You give them something to eat.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「不用他们去，你们给他们吃吧！」

chapters.en: “We have here only five loaves of bread and two fish,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 门徒说：「我们这里只有五个饼，两条鱼。」

chapters.en: “Bring them here to Me,” Jesus said.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「拿过来给我。」

chapters.en: And He directed the crowds to sit down on the grass. Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, He spoke a blessing. Then He broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.
chapters.zh: 于是吩咐众人坐在草地上，就拿着这五个饼，两条鱼，望着天祝福，擘开饼，递给门徒，门徒又递给众人。

chapters.en: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
chapters.zh: 他们都吃，并且吃饱了，把剩下的零碎收拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。

chapters.en: About five thousand men were fed, besides women and children.
chapters.zh: 吃的人，除了妇女孩子，约有五千。

chapters.en: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of Him to the other side, while He dismissed the crowds.
chapters.zh: 耶稣随即催门徒上船，先渡到那边去，等他叫众人散开。

chapters.en: After He had dismissed them, He went up on the mountain by Himself to pray. When evening came, He was there alone,
chapters.zh: 散了众人以后，他就独自上山去祷告。到了晚上，只有他一人在那里。

chapters.en: but the boat was already far from land, buffeted by the waves because the wind was against it.
chapters.zh: 那时船在海中，因风不顺，被浪摇撼。

chapters.en: During the fourth watch of the night, Jesus went out to them, walking on the sea.
chapters.zh: 夜里四更天，耶稣在海面上走，往门徒那里去。

chapters.en: When the disciples saw Him walking on the sea, they were terrified. “It’s a ghost!” they said, and cried out in fear.
chapters.zh: 门徒看见他在海面上走，就惊慌了，说：「是个鬼怪！」便害怕，喊叫起来。

chapters.en: But Jesus spoke up at once: “Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣连忙对他们说：「你们放心，是我，不要怕！」

chapters.en: “Lord, if it is You,” Peter replied, “command me to come to You on the water.”
chapters.zh: 彼得说：「主，如果是你，请叫我从水面上走到你那里去。」

chapters.en:
“Come,” said Jesus.
Then Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water, and came toward Jesus.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你来吧。」彼得就从船上下去，在水面上走，要到耶稣那里去；

chapters.en: But when he saw the strength of the wind, he was afraid and, beginning to sink, cried out, “Lord, save me!”
chapters.zh: 只因见风甚大，就害怕，将要沉下去，便喊着说：「主啊，救我！」

chapters.en: Immediately Jesus reached out His hand and took hold of Peter. “You of little faith,” He said, “why did you doubt?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣赶紧伸手拉住他，说：「你这小信的人哪，为什么疑惑呢？」

chapters.en: And when they had climbed back into the boat, the wind died down.
chapters.zh: 他们上了船，风就住了。

chapters.en: Then those who were in the boat worshiped Him, saying, “Truly You are the Son of God!”
chapters.zh: 在船上的人都拜他，说：「你真是上帝的儿子了。」

chapters.en: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret.
chapters.zh: 他们过了〔海〕，来到革尼撒勒地方。

chapters.en: And when the men of that place recognized Jesus, they sent word to all the surrounding region. People brought all the sick to Him
chapters.zh: 那里的人一认出是耶稣，就打发人到周围地方去，把所有的病人带到他那里，

chapters.en: and begged Him just to let them touch the fringe of His cloak. And all who touched Him were healed.
chapters.zh: 只求耶稣准他们摸他的衣裳繸子；摸着的人就都好了。

chapters.en: Then some Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem and asked,
chapters.zh: 那时，有法利赛人和文士从耶路撒冷来见耶稣，说：

chapters.en: “Why do Your disciples break the tradition of the elders? They do not wash their hands before they eat.”
chapters.zh: 「你的门徒为什么犯古人的遗传呢？因为吃饭的时候，他们不洗手。」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “And why do you break the command of God for the sake of your tradition?
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你们为什么因着你们的遗传犯上帝的诫命呢？

chapters.en: For God said, ‘Honor your father and mother’ and ‘Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.’
chapters.zh: 上帝说：『当孝敬父母』；又说：『咒骂父母的，必治死他。』

chapters.en: But you say that if anyone says to his father or mother, ‘Whatever you would have received from me is a gift devoted to God,’
chapters.zh: 你们倒说：『无论何人对父母说：我所当奉给你的已经作了供献，

chapters.en: he need not honor his father or mother with it. Thus you nullify the word of God for the sake of your tradition.
chapters.zh: 他就可以不孝敬父母。』这就是你们藉着遗传，废了上帝的诫命。

chapters.en: You hypocrites! Isaiah prophesied correctly about you:
chapters.zh: 假冒为善的人哪，以赛亚指着你们说的预言是不错的。他说：

chapters.en: ‘These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.
chapters.zh: 这百姓用嘴唇尊敬我， 心却远离我；

chapters.en: They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’ ”
chapters.zh: 他们将人的吩咐当作道理教导人， 所以拜我也是枉然。」

chapters.en: Jesus called the crowd to Him and said, “Listen and understand.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就叫了众人来，对他们说：「你们要听，也要明白。

chapters.en: A man is not defiled by what enters his mouth, but by what comes out of it.”
chapters.zh: 入口的不能污秽人，出口的乃能污秽人。」

chapters.en: Then the disciples came to Him and said, “Are You aware that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this?”
chapters.zh: 当时，门徒进前来对他说：「法利赛人听见这话，不服〔注：原文是跌倒〕，你知道吗？」

chapters.en: But Jesus replied, “Every plant that My heavenly Father has not planted will be pulled up by its roots.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「凡栽种的物，若不是我天父栽种的，必要拔出来。

chapters.en: Disregard them! They are blind guides. If a blind man leads a blind man, both will fall into a pit.”
chapters.zh: 任凭他们吧！他们是瞎眼领路的；若是瞎子领瞎子，两个人都要掉在坑里。」

chapters.en: Peter said to Him, “Explain this parable to us.”
chapters.zh: 彼得对耶稣说：「请将这比喻讲给我们听。」

chapters.en: “Do you still not understand?” Jesus asked.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们到如今还不明白吗？

chapters.en: “Do you not yet realize that whatever enters the mouth goes into the stomach and then is eliminated?
chapters.zh: 岂不知凡入口的，是运到肚子里，又落在茅厕里吗？

chapters.en: But the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart, and these things defile a man.
chapters.zh: 惟独出口的，是从心里发出来的，这才污秽人。

chapters.en: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, and slander.
chapters.zh: 因为从心里发出来的，有恶念、凶杀、奸淫、苟合、偷盗、妄证、谤讟。

chapters.en: These are what defile a man, but eating with unwashed hands does not defile him.”
chapters.zh: 这都是污秽人的；至于不洗手吃饭，那却不污秽人。」

chapters.en: Leaving that place, Jesus withdrew to the district of Tyre and Sidon.
chapters.zh: 耶稣离开那里，退到泰尔、西顿的境内去。

chapters.en: And a Canaanite woman from that region came to Him, crying out, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on me! My daughter is miserably possessed by a demon.”
chapters.zh: 有一个迦南妇人，从那地方出来，喊着说：「主啊，大卫的子孙，可怜我！我女儿被鬼附得甚苦。」

chapters.en: But Jesus did not answer a word. So His disciples came and urged Him, “Send her away, for she keeps crying out after us.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣却一言不答。门徒进前来，求他说：「这妇人在我们后头喊叫，请打发她走吧。」

chapters.en: He answered, “I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我奉差遣不过是到以色列家迷失的羊那里去。」

chapters.en: The woman came and knelt before Him. “Lord, help me!” she said.
chapters.zh: 那妇人来拜他，说：「主啊，帮助我！」

chapters.en: But Jesus replied, “It is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”
chapters.zh: 他回答说：「不好拿儿女的饼丢给狗吃。」

chapters.en: “Yes, Lord,” she said, “even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their master’s table.”
chapters.zh: 妇人说：「主啊，不错；但是狗也吃牠主人桌子上掉下来的碎渣儿。」

chapters.en: “O woman,” Jesus answered, “your faith is great! Let it be done for you as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that very hour.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「妇人，你的信心是大的！照你所要的，给你成全了吧。」从那时候，她女儿就好了。

chapters.en: Moving on from there, Jesus went along the Sea of Galilee. Then He went up on a mountain and sat down.
chapters.zh: 耶稣离开那地方，来到靠近加利利的海边，就上山坐下。

chapters.en: Large crowds came to Him, bringing the lame, the blind, the crippled, the mute, and many others, and laid them at His feet, and He healed them.
chapters.zh: 有许多人到他那里，带着瘸子、瞎子、哑巴、有残疾的，和好些别的病人，都放在他脚前；他就治好了他们。

chapters.en: The crowd was amazed when they saw the mute speaking, the crippled restored, the lame walking, and the blind seeing. And they glorified the God of Israel.
chapters.zh: 甚至众人都希奇；因为看见哑巴说话，残疾的痊愈，瘸子行走，瞎子看见，他们就归荣耀给以色列的上帝。

chapters.en: Then Jesus called His disciples to Him and said, “I have compassion for this crowd, because they have already been with Me three days and have nothing to eat. I do not want to send them away hungry, or they may faint along the way.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣叫门徒来，说：「我怜悯这众人；因为他们同我在这里已经三天，也没有吃的了。我不愿意叫他们饿着回去，恐怕在路上困乏。」

chapters.en: The disciples replied, “Where in this desolate place could we find enough bread to feed such a large crowd?”
chapters.zh: 门徒说：「我们在这野地，哪里有这么多的饼叫这许多人吃饱呢？」

chapters.en:
“How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked.
“Seven,” they replied, “and a few small fish.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们有多少饼？」他们说：「有七个，还有几条小鱼。」

chapters.en: And He instructed the crowd to sit down on the ground.
chapters.zh: 他就吩咐众人坐在地上，

chapters.en: Taking the seven loaves and the fish, He gave thanks and broke them. Then He gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.
chapters.zh: 拿着这七个饼和几条鱼，祝谢了，擘开，递给门徒；门徒又递给众人。

chapters.en: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
chapters.zh: 众人都吃，并且吃饱了，收拾剩下的零碎，装满了七个筐子。

chapters.en: A total of four thousand men were fed, besides women and children.
chapters.zh: 吃的人，除了妇女孩子，共有四千。

chapters.en: After Jesus had dismissed the crowds, He got into the boat and went to the region of Magadan.
chapters.zh: 耶稣叫众人散去，就上船，来到马加丹的境界。

chapters.en: Then the Pharisees and Sadducees came and tested Jesus by asking Him to show them a sign from heaven.
chapters.zh: 法利赛人和撒都该人来试探耶稣，请他从天上显个神迹给他们看。

chapters.en: But He replied, “When evening comes, you say, ‘The weather will be fair, for the sky is red,’
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「晚上天发红，你们就说：『天必要晴。』

chapters.en: and in the morning, ‘Today it will be stormy, for the sky is red and overcast.’ You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but not the signs of the times.
chapters.zh: 早晨天发红，又发黑，你们就说：『今日必有风雨。』你们知道分辨天上的气色，倒不能分辨这时候的神迹。

chapters.en: A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.” Then He left them and went away.
chapters.zh: 一个邪恶淫乱的世代求神迹，除了约拿的神迹以外，再没有神迹给他看。」耶稣就离开他们去了。

chapters.en: When they crossed to the other side, the disciples forgot to take bread.
chapters.zh: 门徒渡到那边去，忘了带饼。

chapters.en: “Watch out!” Jesus told them. “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们要谨慎，防备法利赛人和撒都该人的酵。」

chapters.en: They discussed this among themselves and concluded, “It is because we did not bring any bread.”
chapters.zh: 门徒彼此议论说：「这是因为我们没有带饼吧。」

chapters.en: Aware of their conversation, Jesus said, “You of little faith, why are you debating among yourselves about having no bread?
chapters.zh: 耶稣看出来，就说：「你们这小信的人，为什么因为没有饼彼此议论呢？

chapters.en: Do you still not understand? Do you not remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?
chapters.zh: 你们还不明白吗？不记得那五个饼分给五千人、又收拾了多少篮子〔的零碎〕吗？

chapters.en: Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?
chapters.zh: 也不记得那七个饼分给四千人、又收拾了多少筐子〔的零碎〕吗？

chapters.en: How do you not understand that I was not telling you about bread? But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
chapters.zh: 我对你们说：『要防备法利赛人和撒都该人的酵』，这话不是指着饼说的，你们怎么不明白呢？」

chapters.en: Then they understood that He was not telling them to beware of the leaven used in bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
chapters.zh: 门徒这才晓得他说的不是叫他们防备饼的酵，乃是防备法利赛人和撒都该人的教训。

chapters.en: When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, He questioned His disciples: “Who do people say the Son of Man is?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣到了凯撒利亚‧腓立比的境内，就问门徒说：「人说我－〔注：有古卷没有我字〕－人子是谁？」

chapters.en: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「有人说是施洗的约翰；有人说是以利亚；又有人说是耶利米或是先知里的一位。」
