chapters.en: “But what about you?” Jesus asked. “Who do you say I am?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们说我是谁？」

chapters.en: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
chapters.zh: 西门‧彼得回答说：「你是基督，是永生上帝的儿子。」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah! For this was not revealed to you by flesh and blood, but by My Father in heaven.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「西门‧巴‧约拿，你是有福的！因为这不是属血肉〔的〕指示你的，乃是我在天上的父指示的。

chapters.en: And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.
chapters.zh: 我还告诉你，你是彼得，我要把我的教会建造在这磐石上；阴间的权柄〔注：权柄：原文是门〕不能胜过他。

chapters.en: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven. Whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.”
chapters.zh: 我要把天国的钥匙给你，凡你在地上所捆绑的，在天上也要捆绑；凡你在地上所释放的，在天上也要释放。」

chapters.en: Then He admonished the disciples not to tell anyone that He was the Christ.
chapters.zh: 当下，耶稣嘱咐门徒，不可对人说他是基督。

chapters.en: From that time on Jesus began to show His disciples that He must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things at the hands of the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and that He must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.
chapters.zh: 从此，耶稣才指示门徒，他必须上耶路撒冷去，受长老、祭司长、文士许多的苦，并且被杀，第三日复活。

chapters.en: Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him. “Far be it from You, Lord!” he said. “This shall never happen to You!”
chapters.zh: 彼得就拉着他，劝他说：「主啊，万不可如此！这事必不临到你身上。」

chapters.en: But Jesus turned and said to Peter, “Get behind Me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to Me. For you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣转过来，对彼得说：「撒但，退我后边去吧！你是绊我脚的；因为你不体贴上帝的意思，只体贴人的意思。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus told His disciples, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.
chapters.zh: 于是耶稣对门徒说：「若有人要跟从我，就当舍己，背起他的十字架来跟从我。

chapters.en: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.
chapters.zh: 因为，凡要救自己生命〔注：生命：或译灵魂；下同〕的，必丧掉生命；凡为我丧掉生命的，必得着生命。

chapters.en: What will it profit a man if he gains the whole world, yet forfeits his soul? Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?
chapters.zh: 人若赚得全世界，赔上自己的生命，有什么益处呢？人还能拿什么换生命呢？

chapters.en: For the Son of Man will come in His Father’s glory with His angels, and then He will repay each one according to what he has done.
chapters.zh: 人子要在他父的荣耀里，同着众使者降临；那时候，他要照各人的行为报应各人。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the Son of Man coming in His kingdom.”
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，站在这里的，有人在没尝死味以前必看见人子降临在他的国里。」

chapters.en: After six days Jesus took with Him Peter, James, and John the brother of James, and led them up a high mountain by themselves.
chapters.zh: 过了六天，耶稣带着彼得、雅各，和雅各的兄弟约翰，暗暗地上了高山，

chapters.en: There He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and His clothes became as white as the light.
chapters.zh: 就在他们面前变了形像，脸面明亮如日头，衣裳洁白如光。

chapters.en: Suddenly Moses and Elijah appeared before them, talking with Jesus.
chapters.zh: 忽然，有摩西、以利亚向他们显现，同耶稣说话。

chapters.en: Peter said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If You wish, I will put up three shelters —one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
chapters.zh: 彼得对耶稣说：「主啊，我们在这里真好！你若愿意，我就在这里搭三座棚，一座为你，一座为摩西，一座为以利亚。」

chapters.en: While Peter was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him!”
chapters.zh: 说话之间，忽然有一朵光明的云彩遮盖他们，且有声音从云彩里出来，说：「这是我的爱子，我所喜悦的。你们要听他！」

chapters.en: When the disciples heard this, they fell facedown in terror.
chapters.zh: 门徒听见，就俯伏在地，极其害怕。

chapters.en: Then Jesus came over and touched them. “Get up,” He said. “Do not be afraid.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣进前来，摸他们，说：「起来，不要害怕！」

chapters.en: And when they looked up, they saw no one except Jesus.
chapters.zh: 他们举目不见一人，只见耶稣在那里。

chapters.en: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus commanded them, “Do not tell anyone about this vision until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead.”
chapters.zh: 下山的时候，耶稣吩咐他们说：「人子还没有从死里复活，你们不要将所看见的告诉人。」

chapters.en: The disciples asked Him, “Why then do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
chapters.zh: 门徒问耶稣说：「文士为什么说以利亚必须先来？」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Elijah does indeed come, and he will restore all things.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「以利亚固然先来，并要复兴万事；

chapters.en: But I tell you that Elijah has already come, and they did not recognize him, but have done to him whatever they wished. In the same way, the Son of Man will suffer at their hands.”
chapters.zh: 只是我告诉你们，以利亚已经来了，人却不认识他，竟任意待他。人子也将要这样受他们的害。」

chapters.en: Then the disciples understood that He was speaking to them about John the Baptist.
chapters.zh: 门徒这才明白耶稣所说的是指着施洗的约翰。

chapters.en: When they came to the crowd, a man came up to Jesus and knelt before Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣和门徒到了众人那里，有一个人来见耶稣，跪下，

chapters.en: “Lord, have mercy on my son,” he said. “He has seizures and is suffering terribly. He often falls into the fire or into the water.
chapters.zh: 说：「主啊，怜悯我的儿子！他害癫痫的病很苦，屡次跌在火里，屡次跌在水里。

chapters.en: I brought him to Your disciples, but they could not heal him.”
chapters.zh: 我带他到你门徒那里，他们却不能医治他。」

chapters.en: “O unbelieving and perverse generation!” Jesus replied. “How long must I remain with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring the boy here to Me.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「嗳！这又不信又悖谬的世代啊，我在你们这里要到几时呢？我忍耐你们要到几时呢？把他带到我这里来吧！」

chapters.en: Then Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy, and he was healed from that moment.
chapters.zh: 耶稣斥责那鬼，鬼就出来；从此孩子就痊愈了。

chapters.en: Afterward the disciples came to Jesus privately and asked, “Why couldn’t we drive it out?”
chapters.zh: 门徒暗暗地到耶稣跟前，说：「我们为什么不能赶出那鬼呢？」

chapters.en: “Because you have so little faith,” He answered. “For truly I tell you, if you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「是因你们的信心小。我实在告诉你们，你们若有信心，像一粒芥菜种，就是对这座山说：『你从这边挪到那边』，它也必挪去；并且你们没有一件不能做的事了。
至于这一类的鬼，若不祷告、禁食，他就不出来〔注：或译：不能赶他出来〕。」

chapters.en: When they gathered together in Galilee, Jesus told them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men.
chapters.zh: 他们还住在加利利的时候，耶稣对门徒说：「人子将要被交在人手里。

chapters.en: They will kill Him, and on the third day He will be raised to life.” And the disciples were deeply grieved.
chapters.zh: 他们要杀害他，第三日他要复活。」门徒就大大地忧愁。

chapters.en: After they had arrived in Capernaum, the collectors of the two-drachma tax came to Peter and asked, “Does your Teacher pay the two drachmas?”
chapters.zh: 到了迦百农，有收丁税的人来见彼得，说：「你们的先生不纳丁税〔注：丁税约有半块钱〕吗？」

chapters.en:
“Yes,” he answered.
When Peter entered the house, Jesus preempted him. “What do you think, Simon?” He asked. “From whom do the kings of the earth collect customs and taxes: from their own sons, or from others?”
chapters.zh: 彼得说：「纳。」他进了屋子，耶稣先向他说：「西门，你的意思如何？世上的君王向谁征收关税、丁税？是向自己的儿子呢？是向外人呢？」

chapters.en:
“From others,” Peter answered.
“Then the sons are exempt,” Jesus said to him.
chapters.zh: 彼得说：「是向外人。」耶稣说：「既然如此，儿子就可以免税了。

chapters.en: “But so that we may not offend them, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take the first fish you catch. When you open its mouth, you will find a four-drachma coin. Take it and give it to them for My tax and yours.”
chapters.zh: 但恐怕触犯〔注：触犯：原文是绊倒〕他们，你且往海边去钓鱼，把先钓上来的鱼拿起来，开了牠的口，必得一块钱，可以拿去给他们，作你我的税银。」

chapters.en: At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Who then is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?”
chapters.zh: 当时，门徒进前来，问耶稣说：「天国里谁是最大的？」

chapters.en: Jesus invited a little child to stand among them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣便叫一个小孩子来，使他站在他们当中，

chapters.en: “Truly I tell you,” He said, “unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
chapters.zh: 说：「我实在告诉你们，你们若不回转，变成小孩子的样式，断不得进天国。

chapters.en: Therefore, whoever humbles himself like this little child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
chapters.zh: 所以，凡自己谦卑像这小孩子的，他在天国里就是最大的。

chapters.en: And whoever welcomes a little child like this in My name welcomes Me.
chapters.zh: 凡为我的名接待一个像这小孩子的，就是接待我。」

chapters.en: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.
chapters.zh: 「凡使这信我的一个小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在这人的颈项上，沉在深海里。

chapters.en: Woe to the world for the causes of sin. These stumbling blocks must come, but woe to the man through whom they come!
chapters.zh: 这世界有祸了，因为将人绊倒；绊倒人的事是免不了的，但那绊倒人的有祸了！

chapters.en: If your hand or your foot causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life crippled or lame than to have two hands and two feet and be thrown into the eternal fire.
chapters.zh: 倘若你一只手，或是一只脚，叫你跌倒，就砍下来丢掉。你缺一只手，或是一只脚，进入永生，强如有两手两脚被丢在永火里。

chapters.en: And if your eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.
chapters.zh: 倘若你一只眼叫你跌倒，就把它剜出来丢掉。你只有一只眼进入〔永〕生，强如有两只眼被丢在地狱的火里。」

chapters.en: See that you do not look down on any of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of My Father in heaven.
chapters.zh: 「你们要小心，不可轻看这小子里的一个；我告诉你们，他们的使者在天上，常见我天父的面。
〔注：有古卷加：11 人子来，为要拯救失丧的人。〕

chapters.en: What do you think? If a man has a hundred sheep and one of them goes astray, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go out to search for the one that is lost?
chapters.zh: 一个人若有一百只羊，一只走迷了路，你们的意思如何？他岂不撇下这九十九只，往山里去找那只迷路的羊吗？

chapters.en: And if he finds it, truly I tell you, he rejoices more over that one sheep than over the ninety-nine that did not go astray.
chapters.zh: 若是找着了，我实在告诉你们，他为这一只羊欢喜，比为那没有迷路的九十九只欢喜还大呢！

chapters.en: In the same way, your Father in heaven is not willing that any of these little ones should perish.
chapters.zh: 你们在天上的父也是这样，不愿意这小子里失丧一个。」

chapters.en: If your brother sins against you, go and confront him privately. If he listens to you, you have won your brother over.
chapters.zh: 「倘若你的弟兄得罪你，你就去，趁着只有他和你在一处的时候，指出他的错来。他若听你，你便得了你的弟兄；

chapters.en: But if he will not listen, take one or two others along, so that ‘every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.’
chapters.zh: 他若不听，你就另外带一两个人同去，要凭两三个人的口作见证，句句都可定准。

chapters.en: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the church. And if he refuses to listen even to the church, regard him as you would a pagan or a tax collector.
chapters.zh: 若是不听他们，就告诉教会；若是不听教会，就看他像外邦人和税吏一样。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.
chapters.zh: 「我实在告诉你们，凡你们在地上所捆绑的，在天上也要捆绑；凡你们在地上所释放的，在天上也要释放。

chapters.en: Again, I tell you truly that if two of you on the earth agree about anything you ask for, it will be done for you by My Father in heaven.
chapters.zh: 我又告诉你们，若是你们中间有两个人在地上同心合意地求什么事，我在天上的父必为他们成全。

chapters.en: For where two or three gather together in My name, there am I with them.”
chapters.zh: 因为无论在哪里，有两三个人奉我的名聚会，那里就有我在他们中间。」

chapters.en: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, “Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother who sins against me? Up to seven times?”
chapters.zh: 那时，彼得进前来，对耶稣说：「主啊，我弟兄得罪我，我当饶恕他几次呢？到七次可以吗？」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “I tell you, not just seven times, but seventy-seven times!
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我对你说，不是到七次，乃是到七十个七次。

chapters.en: Because of this, the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
chapters.zh: 天国好像一个王要和他仆人算帐。

chapters.en: As he began the settlements, a debtor owing ten thousand talents was brought to him.
chapters.zh: 才算的时候，有人带了一个欠一千万银子的来。

chapters.en: Since the man was unable to pay, the master ordered that he be sold to pay his debt, along with his wife and children and everything he owned.
chapters.zh: 因为他没有什么偿还之物，主人吩咐把他和他妻子儿女，并一切所有的都卖了偿还。

chapters.en: Then the servant fell on his knees before him. ‘Have patience with me,’ he begged, ‘and I will pay back everything.’
chapters.zh: 那仆人就俯伏拜他，说：『主啊，宽容我，将来我都要还清。』

chapters.en: His master had compassion on him, forgave his debt, and released him.
chapters.zh: 那仆人的主人就动了慈心，把他释放了，并且免了他的债。

chapters.en: But when that servant went out, he found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred denarii. He grabbed him and began to choke him, saying, ‘Pay back what you owe me!’
chapters.zh: 「那仆人出来，遇见他的一个同伴欠他十两银子，便揪着他，掐住他的喉咙，说：『你把所欠的还我！』

chapters.en: So his fellow servant fell down and begged him, ‘Have patience with me, and I will pay you back.’
chapters.zh: 他的同伴就俯伏央求他，说：『宽容我吧，将来我必还清。』

chapters.en: But he refused. Instead, he went and had the man thrown into prison until he could pay his debt.
chapters.zh: 他不肯，竟去把他下在监里，等他还了所欠的债。

chapters.en: When his fellow servants saw what had happened, they were greatly distressed, and they went and recounted all of this to their master.
chapters.zh: 众同伴看见他所做的事就甚忧愁，去把这事都告诉了主人。

chapters.en: Then the master summoned him and said, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave all your debt because you begged me.
chapters.zh: 于是主人叫了他来，对他说：『你这恶奴才！你央求我，我就把你所欠的都免了，

chapters.en: Shouldn’t you have had mercy on your fellow servant, just as I had on you?’
chapters.zh: 你不应当怜恤你的同伴，像我怜恤你吗？』

chapters.en: In anger his master turned him over to the jailers to be tortured, until he should repay all that he owed.
chapters.zh: 主人就大怒，把他交给掌刑的，等他还清了所欠的债。

chapters.en: That is how My heavenly Father will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother from your heart.”
chapters.zh: 你们各人若不从心里饶恕你的弟兄，我天父也要这样待你们了。」

chapters.en: When Jesus had finished saying these things, He left Galilee and went into the region of Judea beyond the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说完了这些话，就离开加利利，来到犹太的境界约旦河外。

chapters.en: Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them there.
chapters.zh: 有许多人跟着他，他就在那里把他们〔的病人〕治好了。

chapters.en: Then some Pharisees came and tested Him by asking, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
chapters.zh: 有法利赛人来试探耶稣，说：「人无论什么缘故都可以休妻吗？」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “Have you not read that from the beginning the Creator ‘made them male and female,’
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「那起初造人的，是造男造女，

chapters.en: and said, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh’ ?
chapters.zh: 并且说：『因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。』〔这经〕你们没有念过吗？

chapters.en: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.”
chapters.zh: 既然如此，夫妻不再是两个人，乃是一体的了。所以，上帝配合的，人不可分开。」

chapters.en: “Why then,” they asked, “did Moses order a man to give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away? ”
chapters.zh: 法利赛人说：「这样，摩西为什么吩咐给妻子休书，就可以休她呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because of your hardness of heart. But it was not this way from the beginning.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「摩西因为你们的心硬，所以许你们休妻，但起初并不是这样。

chapters.en: Now I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another woman commits adultery. ”
chapters.zh: 我告诉你们，凡休妻另娶的，若不是为淫乱的缘故，就是犯奸淫了；有人娶那被休的妇人，也是犯奸淫了。」

chapters.en: His disciples said to Him, “If this is the case between a man and his wife, it is better not to marry.”
chapters.zh: 门徒对耶稣说：「人和妻子既是这样，倒不如不娶。」

chapters.en: “Not everyone can accept this word,” He replied, “but only those to whom it has been given.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「这话不是人都能领受的，惟独赐给谁，谁才能领受。

chapters.en: For there are eunuchs who were born that way; others were made that way by men; and still others live like eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. The one who can accept this should accept it.”
chapters.zh: 因为有生来是阉人，也有被人阉的，并有为天国的缘故自阉的。这话谁能领受就可以领受。」

chapters.en: Then little children were brought to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them and pray for them. And the disciples rebuked those who brought them.
chapters.zh: 那时，有人带着小孩子来见耶稣，要耶稣给他们按手祷告，门徒就责备那些人。

chapters.en: But Jesus said, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「让小孩子到我这里来，不要禁止他们；因为在天国的，正是这样的人。」

chapters.en: And after He had placed His hands on them, He went on from there.
chapters.zh: 耶稣给他们按手，就离开那地方去了。

chapters.en: Just then a man came up to Jesus and inquired, “Teacher, what good thing must I do to obtain eternal life?”
chapters.zh: 有一个人来见耶稣，说：「夫子〔注：有古卷：良善的夫子〕，我该做什么善事才能得永生？」

chapters.en: “Why do you ask Me about what is good?” Jesus replied. “There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, keep the commandments.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「你为什么以善事问我呢？只有一位是善的〔注：有古卷：你为什么称我是良善的？除了上帝以外，没有一个良善的〕。你若要进入〔永〕生，就当遵守诫命。」

chapters.en:
“Which ones?” the man asked.
Jesus answered, “‘Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness,
chapters.zh: 他说：「什么诫命？」耶稣说：「就是不可杀人；不可奸淫；不可偷盗；不可作假见证；

chapters.en: honor your father and mother, and love your neighbor as yourself.’ ”
chapters.zh: 当孝敬父母；又当爱人如己。」

chapters.en: “All these I have kept,” said the young man. “What do I still lack?”
chapters.zh: 那少年人说：「这一切我都遵守了，还缺少什么呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus told him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你若愿意作完全人，可去变卖你所有的，分给穷人，就必有财宝在天上；你还要来跟从我。」

chapters.en: When the young man heard this, he went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.
chapters.zh: 那少年人听见这话，就忧忧愁愁地走了，因为他的产业很多。

chapters.en: Then Jesus said to His disciples, “Truly I tell you, it is hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对门徒说：「我实在告诉你们，财主进天国是难的。

chapters.en: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
chapters.zh: 我又告诉你们，骆驼穿过针的眼，比财主进上帝的国还容易呢！」

chapters.en: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished and asked, “Who then can be saved?”
chapters.zh: 门徒听见这话，就希奇得很，说：「这样谁能得救呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣看着他们，说：「在人这是不能的，在上帝凡事都能。」

chapters.en: “Look,” Peter replied, “we have left everything to follow You. What then will there be for us?”
chapters.zh: 彼得就对他说：「看哪，我们已经撇下所有的跟从你，将来我们要得什么呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, in the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on His glorious throne, you who have followed Me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我实在告诉你们，你们这跟从我的人，到复兴的时候，人子坐在他荣耀的宝座上，你们也要坐在十二个宝座上，审判以色列十二个支派。

chapters.en: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for the sake of My name will receive a hundredfold and will inherit eternal life.
chapters.zh: 凡为我的名撇下房屋，或是弟兄、姊妹、父亲、母亲、〔注：有古卷加：妻子、〕儿女、田地的，必要得着百倍，并且承受永生。

chapters.en: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.
chapters.zh: 然而，有许多在前的，将要在后；在后的，将要在前。」

chapters.en: “For the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire workers for his vineyard.
chapters.zh: 「因为天国好像家主清早去雇人进他的葡萄园做工，

chapters.en: He agreed to pay them a denarius for the day and sent them into his vineyard.
chapters.zh: 和工人讲定一天一钱银子，就打发他们进葡萄园去。

chapters.en: About the third hour he went out and saw others standing in the marketplace doing nothing.
chapters.zh: 约在巳初出去，看见市上还有闲站的人，

chapters.en: ‘You also go into my vineyard,’ he said, ‘and I will pay you whatever is right.’
chapters.zh: 就对他们说：『你们也进葡萄园去，所当给的，我必给你们。』他们也进去了。

chapters.en:
So they went.
He went out again about the sixth hour and the ninth hour and did the same thing.
chapters.zh: 约在午正和申初又出去，也是这样行。

chapters.en: About the eleventh hour he went out and found still others standing around. ‘Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?’ he asked.
chapters.zh: 约在酉初出去，看见还有人站在那里，就问他们说：『你们为什么整天在这里闲站呢？』

chapters.en:
‘Because no one has hired us,’ they answered.
So he told them, ‘You also go into my vineyard.’
chapters.zh: 他们说：『因为没有人雇我们。』他说：『你们也进葡萄园去。』

chapters.en: When evening came, the owner of the vineyard said to his foreman, ‘Call the workers and pay them their wages, starting with the last ones hired and moving on to the first.’
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，园主对管事的说：『叫工人都来，给他们工钱，从后来的起，到先来的为止。』

chapters.en: The workers who were hired about the eleventh hour came and each received a denarius.
chapters.zh: 约在酉初雇的人来了，各人得了一钱银子。

chapters.en: So when the original workers came, they assumed they would receive more. But each of them also received a denarius.
chapters.zh: 及至那先雇的来了，他们以为必要多得；谁知也是各得一钱。

chapters.en: On receiving their pay, they began to grumble against the landowner.
chapters.zh: 他们得了，就埋怨家主说：

chapters.en: ‘These men who were hired last worked only one hour,’ they said, ‘and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden and the scorching heat of the day.’
chapters.zh: 『我们整天劳苦受热，那后来的只做了一小时，你竟叫他们和我们一样吗？』

chapters.en: But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am not being unfair to you. Did you not agree with me on one denarius?
chapters.zh: 家主回答其中的一人说：『朋友，我不亏负你，你与我讲定的不是一钱银子吗？

chapters.en: Take your pay and go. I want to give this last man the same as I gave you.
chapters.zh: 拿你的走吧！我给那后来的和给你一样，这是我愿意的。

chapters.en: Do I not have the right to do as I please with what is mine? Or are you envious because I am generous?’
chapters.zh: 我的东西难道不可随我的意思用吗？因为我作好人，你就红了眼吗？』

chapters.en: So the last will be first, and the first will be last.”
chapters.zh: 这样，那在后的，将要在前；在前的，将要在后了。〔注：有古卷加：因为被召的人多，选上的人少。〕」

chapters.en: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, He took the twelve disciples aside and said,
chapters.zh: 耶稣上耶路撒冷去的时候，在路上把十二个门徒带到一边，对他们说：

chapters.en: “Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and scribes. They will condemn Him to death
chapters.zh: 「看哪，我们上耶路撒冷去，人子要被交给祭司长和文士。他们要定他死罪，

chapters.en: and will deliver Him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and flogged and crucified. And on the third day He will be raised to life.”
chapters.zh: 又交给外邦人，将他戏弄，鞭打，钉在十字架上；第三日他要复活。」

chapters.en: Then the mother of Zebedee’s sons came to Jesus with her sons and knelt down to make a request of Him.
chapters.zh: 那时，西庇太儿子的母亲同她两个儿子上前来拜耶稣，求他一件事。

chapters.en:
“What do you want?” He inquired.
She answered, “Declare that in Your kingdom one of these two sons of mine may sit at Your right hand, and the other at Your left.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你要什么呢？」她说：「愿你叫我这两个儿子在你国里，一个坐在你右边，一个坐在你左边。」

chapters.en:
“You do not know what you are asking,” Jesus replied. “Can you drink the cup I am going to drink?”
“We can,” the brothers answered.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你们不知道所求的是什么；我将要喝的杯，你们能喝吗？」他们说：「我们能。」

chapters.en: “You will indeed drink My cup,” Jesus said. “But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to grant. These seats belong to those for whom My Father has prepared them.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我所喝的杯，你们必要喝；只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以赐的，乃是我父为谁预备的，就赐给谁。」

chapters.en: When the ten heard about this, they were indignant with the two brothers.
chapters.zh: 那十个门徒听见，就恼怒他们弟兄二人。

chapters.en: But Jesus called them aside and said, “You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their superiors exercise authority over them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣叫了他们来，说：「你们知道外邦人有君王为主治理他们，有大臣操权管束他们。

chapters.en: It shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
chapters.zh: 只是在你们中间，不可这样；你们中间谁愿为大，就必作你们的用人；

chapters.en: and whoever wants to be first among you must be your slave—
chapters.zh: 谁愿为首，就必作你们的仆人。

chapters.en: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.”
chapters.zh: 正如人子来，不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，并且要舍命，作多人的赎价。」

chapters.en: As they were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed Him.
chapters.zh: 他们出耶利哥的时候，有极多的人跟随他。

chapters.en: And there were two blind men sitting beside the road. When they heard that Jesus was passing by, they cried out, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”
chapters.zh: 有两个瞎子坐在路旁，听说是耶稣经过，就喊着说：「主啊，大卫的子孙，可怜我们吧！」

chapters.en: The crowd admonished them to be silent, but they cried out all the louder, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”
chapters.zh: 众人责备他们，不许他们作声；他们却越发喊着说：「主啊，大卫的子孙，可怜我们吧！」

chapters.en: Jesus stopped and called them. “What do you want Me to do for you?” He asked.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就站住，叫他们来，说：「要我为你们做什么？」

chapters.en: “Lord,” they answered, “let our eyes be opened.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「主啊，要我们的眼睛能看见！」

chapters.en: Moved with compassion, Jesus touched their eyes, and at once they received their sight and followed Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就动了慈心，把他们的眼睛一摸，他们立刻看见，就跟从了耶稣。

chapters.en: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage on the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent out two disciples,
chapters.zh: 耶稣和门徒将近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其，在橄榄山那里。

chapters.en: saying to them, “Go into the village ahead of you, and at once you will find a donkey tied there, with her colt beside her. Untie them and bring them to Me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就打发两个门徒，对他们说：「你们往对面村子里去，必看见一匹驴拴在那里，还有驴驹同在一处；你们解开，牵到我这里来。

chapters.en: If anyone questions you, tell him that the Lord needs them, and he will send them right away.”
chapters.zh: 若有人对你们说什么，你们就说：『主要用牠。』那人必立时让你们牵来。

chapters.en: This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet:
chapters.zh: 这事成就是要应验先知的话，说：

chapters.en: “Say to the Daughter of Zion, ‘See, your King comes to you, gentle and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.’”
chapters.zh: 要对锡安的居民〔注：原文是女子〕说： 看哪，你的王来到你这里， 是温柔的，又骑着驴， 就是骑着驴驹子。」

chapters.en: So the disciples went and did as Jesus had directed them.
chapters.zh: 门徒就照耶稣所吩咐的去行，

chapters.en: They brought the donkey and the colt and laid their cloaks on them, and Jesus sat on them.
chapters.zh: 牵了驴和驴驹来，把自己的衣服搭在上面，耶稣就骑上。

chapters.en: A massive crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
chapters.zh: 众人多半把衣服铺在路上；还有人砍下树枝来铺在路上。

chapters.en:
The crowds that went ahead of Him and those that followed were shouting:
“Hosanna to the Son of David!”
“Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!”
“Hosanna in the highest!”
chapters.zh: 前行后随的众人喊着说： 和散那〔注：原有求救的意思，在此是称颂的话〕归于大卫的子孙！ 奉主名来的是应当称颂的！ 高高在上和散那！

chapters.en: When Jesus had entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, “Who is this?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣既进了耶路撒冷，合城都惊动了，说：「这是谁？」

chapters.en: The crowds replied, “This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee.”
chapters.zh: 众人说：「这是加利利拿撒勒的先知耶稣。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus entered the temple courts and drove out all who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling doves.
chapters.zh: 耶稣进了上帝的殿，赶出殿里一切做买卖的人，推倒兑换银钱之人的桌子，和卖鸽子之人的凳子，

chapters.en: And He declared to them, “It is written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer.’ But you are making it ‘a den of robbers.’ ”
chapters.zh: 对他们说：「〔经上〕记着说： 我的殿必称为祷告的殿， 你们倒使它成为贼窝了。」

chapters.en: The blind and the lame came to Him at the temple, and He healed them.
chapters.zh: 在殿里有瞎子、瘸子到耶稣跟前，他就治好了他们。

chapters.en: But the chief priests and scribes were indignant when they saw the wonders He performed and the children shouting in the temple courts, “Hosanna to the Son of David!”
chapters.zh: 祭司长和文士看见耶稣所行的奇事，又见小孩子在殿里喊着说：「和散那归于大卫的子孙！」就甚恼怒，

chapters.en:
“Do You hear what these children are saying?” they asked.
“Yes,” Jesus answered. “Have you never read:
‘From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise’ ?”
chapters.zh: 对他说：「这些人所说的，你听见了吗？」耶稣说：「是的。〔经上〕说『你从婴孩和吃奶的口中完全了赞美』的话，你们没有念过吗？」

chapters.en: Then He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where He spent the night.
chapters.zh: 于是离开他们，出城到伯大尼去，在那里住宿。

chapters.en: In the morning, as Jesus was returning to the city, He was hungry.
chapters.zh: 早晨回城的时候，他饿了，

chapters.en: Seeing a fig tree by the road, He went up to it but found nothing on it except leaves. “May you never bear fruit again!” He said. And immediately the tree withered.
chapters.zh: 看见路旁有一棵无花果树，就走到跟前，在树上找不着什么，不过有叶子，就对树说：「从今以后，你永不结果子。」那无花果树就立刻枯干了。

chapters.en: When the disciples saw this, they marveled and asked, “How did the fig tree wither so quickly?”
chapters.zh: 门徒看见了，便希奇说：「无花果树怎么立刻枯干了呢？」

chapters.en: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “if you have faith and do not doubt, not only will you do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you say to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ it will happen.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我实在告诉你们，你们若有信心，不疑惑，不但能行无花果树上所行的事，就是对这座山说：『你挪开此地，投在海里！』也必成就。

chapters.en: If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.”
chapters.zh: 你们祷告，无论求什么，只要信，就必得着。」

chapters.en: When Jesus returned to the temple courts and began to teach, the chief priests and elders of the people came up to Him. “By what authority are You doing these things?” they asked. “And who gave You this authority?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣进了殿，正教训人的时候，祭司长和民间的长老来问他说：「你仗着什么权柄做这些事？给你这权柄的是谁呢？」

chapters.en: “I will also ask you one question,” Jesus replied, “and if you answer Me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我也要问你们一句话，你们若告诉我，我就告诉你们我仗着什么权柄做这些事。

chapters.en:
What was the source of John’s baptism? Was it from heaven or from men?”
They deliberated among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
chapters.zh: 约翰的洗礼是从哪里来的？是从天上来的？是从人间来的呢？」他们彼此商议说：「我们若说『从天上来』，他必对我们说：『这样，你们为什么不信他呢？』

chapters.en: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we are afraid of the people, for they all regard John as a prophet.”
chapters.zh: 若说『从人间来』，我们又怕百姓，因为他们都以约翰为先知。」

chapters.en:
So they answered, “We do not know.”
And Jesus replied, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
chapters.zh: 于是回答耶稣说：「我们不知道。」耶稣说：「我也不告诉你们我仗着什么权柄做这些事。」

chapters.en: But what do you think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first one and said, ‘Son, go and work today in the vineyard.’
chapters.zh: 又说：「一个人有两个儿子。他来对大儿子说：『我儿，你今天到葡萄园里去做工。』

chapters.en: ‘I will not,’ he replied. But later he changed his mind and went.
chapters.zh: 他回答说：『我不去』，以后自己懊悔，就去了。

chapters.en:
Then the man went to the second son and told him the same thing.
‘I will, sir,’ he said. But he did not go.
chapters.zh: 又来对小儿子也是这样说。他回答说：『父啊，我去』，他却不去。

chapters.en:
Which of the two did the will of his father?”
“The first, ” they answered.
Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, the tax collectors and prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God before you.
chapters.zh: 你们想，这两个儿子是哪一个遵行父命呢？」他们说：「大儿子。」耶稣说：「我实在告诉你们，税吏和娼妓倒比你们先进上帝的国。

chapters.en: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and prostitutes did. And even after you saw this, you did not repent and believe him.
chapters.zh: 因为约翰遵着义路到你们这里来，你们却不信他；税吏和娼妓倒信他。你们看见了，后来还是不懊悔去信他。」

chapters.en: Listen to another parable: There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it, and built a tower. Then he rented it out to some tenants and went away on a journey.
chapters.zh: 「你们再听一个比喻：有个家主栽了一个葡萄园，周围圈上篱笆，里面挖了一个压酒池，盖了一座楼，租给园户，就往外国去了。

chapters.en: When the harvest time drew near, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit.
chapters.zh: 收果子的时候近了，就打发仆人到园户那里去收果子。

chapters.en: But the tenants seized his servants. They beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.
chapters.zh: 园户拿住仆人，打了一个，杀了一个，用石头打死一个。

chapters.en: Again, he sent other servants, more than the first group. But the tenants did the same to them.
chapters.zh: 主人又打发别的仆人去，比先前更多；园户还是照样待他们。

chapters.en: Finally, he sent his son to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.
chapters.zh: 后来打发他的儿子到他们那里去，〔意思〕说：『他们必尊敬我的儿子。』

chapters.en: But when the tenants saw the son, they said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him and take his inheritance.’
chapters.zh: 不料，园户看见他儿子，就彼此说：『这是承受产业的。来吧，我们杀他，佔他的产业！』

chapters.en: So they seized him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.
chapters.zh: 他们就拿住他，推出葡萄园外，杀了。

chapters.en: Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard returns, what will he do to those tenants?”
chapters.zh: 园主来的时候要怎样处治这些园户呢？」

chapters.en: “He will bring those wretches to a wretched end,” they replied, “and will rent out the vineyard to other tenants who will give him his share of the fruit at harvest time.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「要下毒手除灭那些恶人，将葡萄园另租给那按着时候交果子的园户。」

chapters.en:
Jesus said to them, “Have you never read in the Scriptures:
‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’ ?
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「〔经上写着〕： 匠人所弃的石头 已作了房角的头块石头。 这是主所做的， 在我们眼中看为希奇。 这经你们没有念过吗？

chapters.en: Therefore I tell you that the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce its fruit.
chapters.zh: 所以我告诉你们，上帝的国必从你们夺去，赐给那能结果子的百姓。

chapters.en: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but he on whom it falls will be crushed. ”
chapters.zh: 谁掉在这石头上，必要跌碎；这石头掉在谁的身上，就要把谁砸得稀烂。」

chapters.en: When the chief priests and Pharisees heard His parables, they knew that Jesus was speaking about them.
chapters.zh: 祭司长和法利赛人听见他的比喻，就看出他是指着他们说的。

chapters.en: Although they wanted to arrest Him, they were afraid of the crowds, because the people regarded Him as a prophet.
chapters.zh: 他们想要捉拿他，只是怕众人，因为众人以他为先知。

chapters.en: Once again, Jesus spoke to them in parables:
chapters.zh: 耶稣又用比喻对他们说：

chapters.en: “The kingdom of heaven is like a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son.
chapters.zh: 「天国好比一个王为他儿子摆设娶亲的筵席，

chapters.en: He sent his servants to call those he had invited to the banquet, but they refused to come.
chapters.zh: 就打发仆人去，请那些被召的人来赴席，他们却不肯来。

chapters.en: Again, he sent other servants and said, ‘Tell those who have been invited that I have prepared my dinner. My oxen and fattened cattle have been killed, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding banquet.’
chapters.zh: 王又打发别的仆人，说：『你们告诉那被召的人，我的筵席已经预备好了，牛和肥畜已经宰了，各样都齐备，请你们来赴席。』

chapters.en: But they paid no attention and went away, one to his field, another to his business.
chapters.zh: 那些人不理就走了；一个到自己田里去；一个做买卖去；

chapters.en: The rest seized his servants, mistreated them, and killed them.
chapters.zh: 其余的拿住仆人，凌辱他们，把他们杀了。

chapters.en: The king was enraged, and he sent his troops to destroy those murderers and burn their city.
chapters.zh: 王就大怒，发兵除灭那些凶手，烧毁他们的城。

chapters.en: Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding banquet is ready, but those I invited were not worthy.
chapters.zh: 于是对仆人说：『喜筵已经齐备，只是所召的人不配。

chapters.en: Go therefore to the crossroads and invite to the banquet as many as you can find.’
chapters.zh: 所以你们要往岔路口上去，凡遇见的，都召来赴席。』

chapters.en: So the servants went out into the streets and gathered everyone they could find, both evil and good, and the wedding hall was filled with guests.
chapters.zh: 那些仆人就出去，到大路上，凡遇见的，不论善恶都召聚了来，筵席上就坐满了客。

chapters.en: But when the king came in to see the guests, he spotted a man who was not dressed in wedding clothes.
chapters.zh: 王进来观看宾客，见那里有一个没有穿礼服的，

chapters.en:
‘Friend,’ he asked, ‘how did you get in here without wedding clothes?’
But the man was speechless.
chapters.zh: 就对他说：『朋友，你到这里来怎么不穿礼服呢？』那人无言可答。

chapters.en: Then the king told the servants, ‘Tie him hand and foot, and throw him into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
chapters.zh: 于是王对使唤的人说：『捆起他的手脚来，把他丢在外边的黑暗里；在那里必要哀哭切齿了。』

chapters.en: For many are called, but few are chosen.”
chapters.zh: 因为被召的人多，选上的人少。」

chapters.en: Then the Pharisees went out and conspired to trap Jesus in His words.
chapters.zh: 当时，法利赛人出去商议，怎样就着耶稣的话陷害他，

chapters.en: They sent their disciples to Him along with the Herodians. “Teacher,” they said, “we know that You are honest and that You teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. You seek favor from no one, because You pay no attention to external appearance.
chapters.zh: 就打发他们的门徒同希律党的人去见耶稣，说：「夫子，我们知道你是诚实人，并且诚诚实实传上帝的道，什么人你都不徇情面，因为你不看人的外貌。

chapters.en: So tell us what You think: Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not?”
chapters.zh: 请告诉我们，你的意见如何？纳税给凯撒可以不可以？」

chapters.en: But Jesus knew their evil intent and said, “You hypocrites, why are you testing Me?
chapters.zh: 耶稣看出他们的恶意，就说：「假冒为善的人哪，为什么试探我？

chapters.en:
Show Me the coin used for the tax.”
And they brought Him a denarius.
chapters.zh: 拿一个上税的钱给我看！」他们就拿一个银钱来给他。

chapters.en: “Whose image is this,” He asked, “and whose inscription?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「这像和这号是谁的？」

chapters.en:
“Caesar’s,” they answered.
So Jesus told them, “Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「是凯撒的。」耶稣说：「这样，凯撒的物当归给凯撒；上帝的物当归给上帝。」

chapters.en: And when they heard this, they were amazed. So they left Him and went away.
chapters.zh: 他们听见就希奇，离开他走了。

chapters.en: That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus and questioned Him.
chapters.zh: 撒都该人常说没有复活的事。那天，他们来问耶稣说：

chapters.en: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses declared that if a man dies without having children, his brother is to marry the widow and raise up offspring for him.
chapters.zh: 「夫子，摩西说：『人若死了，没有孩子，他兄弟当娶他的妻，为哥哥生子立后。』

chapters.en: Now there were seven brothers among us. The first one married and died without having children. So he left his wife to his brother.
chapters.zh: 从前，在我们这里有弟兄七人，第一个娶了妻，死了，没有孩子，撇下妻子给兄弟。

chapters.en: The same thing happened to the second and third brothers, down to the seventh.
chapters.zh: 第二、第三，直到第七个，都是如此。

chapters.en: And last of all, the woman died.
chapters.zh: 末后，妇人也死了。

chapters.en: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be of the seven? For all of them were married to her.”
chapters.zh: 这样，当复活的时候，她是七个人中哪一个的妻子呢？因为他们都娶过她。」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “You are mistaken because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你们错了；因为不明白圣经，也不晓得上帝的大能。

chapters.en: In the resurrection, people will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.
chapters.zh: 当复活的时候，人也不娶也不嫁，乃像天上的使者一样。

chapters.en: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, have you not read what God said to you:
chapters.zh: 论到死人复活，上帝〔在经上〕向你们所说的，你们没有念过吗？

chapters.en: ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’ ? He is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”
chapters.zh: 他说：『我是亚伯拉罕的上帝，以撒的上帝，雅各的上帝。』上帝不是死人的上帝，乃是活人的上帝。」

chapters.en: When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at His teaching.
chapters.zh: 众人听见这话，就希奇他的教训。

chapters.en: And when the Pharisees heard that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, they themselves gathered together.
chapters.zh: 法利赛人听见耶稣堵住了撒都该人的口，他们就聚集。

chapters.en: One of them, an expert in the law, tested Him with a question:
chapters.zh: 内中有一个人是律法师，要试探耶稣，就问他说：

chapters.en: “Teacher, which commandment is the greatest in the Law?”
chapters.zh: 「夫子，律法上的诫命，哪一条是最大的呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus declared, “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「你要尽心、尽性、尽意爱主－你的上帝。

chapters.en: This is the first and greatest commandment.
chapters.zh: 这是诫命中的第一，且是最大的。

chapters.en: And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’
chapters.zh: 其次也相倣，就是要爱人如己。

chapters.en: All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two commandments.”
chapters.zh: 这两条诫命是律法和先知一切〔道理〕的总纲。」

chapters.en: While the Pharisees were assembled, Jesus questioned them:
chapters.zh: 法利赛人聚集的时候，耶稣问他们说：

chapters.en:
“What do you think about the Christ? Whose son is He?”
“David’s,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 「论到基督，你们的意见如何？他是谁的子孙呢？」他们回答说：「是大卫的子孙。」

chapters.en: Jesus said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call Him ‘Lord’? For he says:
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「这样，大卫被圣灵感动，怎么还称他为主，说：

chapters.en: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I put Your enemies under Your feet.”’
chapters.zh: 主对我主说： 你坐在我的右边， 等我把你仇敌放在你的脚下。

chapters.en: So if David calls Him ‘Lord,’ how can He be David’s son?”
chapters.zh: 大卫既称他为主，他怎么又是大卫的子孙呢？」

chapters.en: No one was able to answer a word, and from that day on no one dared to question Him any further.
chapters.zh: 他们没有一个人能回答一言。从那日以后，也没有人敢再问他什么。

chapters.en: Then Jesus spoke to the crowds and to His disciples:
chapters.zh: 那时，耶稣对众人和门徒讲论，

chapters.en: “The scribes and Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat.
chapters.zh: 说：「文士和法利赛人坐在摩西的位上，

chapters.en: So practice and observe everything they tell you. But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach.
chapters.zh: 凡他们所吩咐你们的，你们都要谨守遵行。但不要效法他们的行为；因为他们能说，不能行。

chapters.en: They tie up heavy, burdensome loads and lay them on men’s shoulders, but they themselves are not willing to lift a finger to move them.
chapters.zh: 他们把难担的重担捆起来，搁在人的肩上，但自己一个指头也不肯动。

chapters.en: All their deeds are done for men to see. They broaden their phylacteries and lengthen their tassels.
chapters.zh: 他们一切所做的事都是要叫人看见，所以将佩戴的经文做宽了，〔衣裳的〕繸子做长了，

chapters.en: They love the places of honor at banquets, the chief seats in the synagogues,
chapters.zh: 喜爱筵席上的首座，会堂里的高位，

chapters.en: the greetings in the marketplaces, and the title of ‘Rabbi’ by which they are addressed.
chapters.zh: 又喜爱人在街市上问他安，称呼他拉比〔注：拉比就是夫子〕。

chapters.en: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers.
chapters.zh: 但你们不要受拉比的称呼，因为只有一位是你们的夫子；你们都是弟兄。

chapters.en: And do not call anyone on earth your father, for you have one Father, who is in heaven.
chapters.zh: 也不要称呼地上的人为父，因为只有一位是你们的父，就是在天上的父。

chapters.en: Nor are you to be called instructors, for you have one Instructor, the Christ.
chapters.zh: 也不要受师尊的称呼，因为只有一位是你们的师尊，就是基督。

chapters.en: The greatest among you shall be your servant.
chapters.zh: 你们中间谁为大，谁就要作你们的用人。

chapters.en: For whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
chapters.zh: 凡自高的，必降为卑；自卑的，必升为高。

chapters.en: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You shut the kingdom of heaven in men’s faces. You yourselves do not enter, nor will you let in those who wish to enter.
chapters.zh: 「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们正当人前，把天国〔的门〕关了，自己不进去，正要进去的人，你们也不容他们进去。
〔注：有古卷加：14 你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们侵吞寡妇的家产，假意做很长的祷告，所以要受更重的刑罚。〕

chapters.en: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You traverse land and sea to win a single convert, and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of hell as you are.
chapters.zh: 「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们走遍洋海陆地，勾引一个人入教，既入了教，却使他作地狱之子，比你们还加倍。

chapters.en: Woe to you, blind guides! You say, ‘If anyone swears by the temple, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gold of the temple, he is bound by his oath.’
chapters.zh: 「你们这瞎眼领路的有祸了！你们说：『凡指着殿起誓的，这算不得什么；只是凡指着殿中金子起誓的，他就该谨守。』

chapters.en: You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes it sacred?
chapters.zh: 你们这无知瞎眼的人哪，什么是大的？是金子呢？还是叫金子成圣的殿呢？

chapters.en: And you say, ‘If anyone swears by the altar, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gift on it, he is bound by his oath.’
chapters.zh: 你们又说：『凡指着坛起誓的，这算不得什么；只是凡指着坛上礼物起誓的，他就该谨守。』

chapters.en: You blind men! Which is greater: the gift, or the altar that makes it sacred?
chapters.zh: 你们这瞎眼的人哪，什么是大的？是礼物呢？还是叫礼物成圣的坛呢？

chapters.en: So then, he who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.
chapters.zh: 所以，人指着坛起誓，就是指着坛和坛上一切所有的起誓；

chapters.en: And he who swears by the temple swears by it and by the One who dwells in it.
chapters.zh: 人指着殿起誓，就是指着殿和那住在殿里的起誓；

chapters.en: And he who swears by heaven swears by God’s throne and by the One who sits on it.
chapters.zh: 人指着天起誓，就是指着上帝的宝座和那坐在上面的起誓。

chapters.en: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You pay tithes of mint, dill, and cumin. But you have disregarded the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faithfulness. You should have practiced the latter, without neglecting the former.
chapters.zh: 「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们将薄荷、茴香、芹菜献上十分之一，那律法上更重的事，就是公义、怜悯、信实，反倒不行了。这〔更重的〕是你们当行的；那也是不可不行的。

chapters.en: You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.
chapters.zh: 你们这瞎眼领路的，蠓虫你们就滤出来，骆驼你们倒吞下去。

chapters.en: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.
chapters.zh: 「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们洗净杯盘的外面，里面却盛满了勒索和放荡。

chapters.en: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, so that the outside may become clean as well.
chapters.zh: 你这瞎眼的法利赛人，先洗净杯盘的里面，好叫外面也干净了。

chapters.en: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of dead men’s bones and every kind of impurity.
chapters.zh: 「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们好像粉饰的坟墓，外面好看，里面却装满了死人的骨头和一切的污秽。

chapters.en: In the same way, on the outside you appear to be righteous, but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.
chapters.zh: 你们也是如此，在人前，外面显出公义来，里面却装满了假善和不法的事。

chapters.en: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the monuments of the righteous.
chapters.zh: 「你们这假冒为善的文士和法利赛人有祸了！因为你们建造先知的坟，修饰义人的墓，说：

chapters.en: And you say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partners with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’
chapters.zh: 『若是我们在我们祖宗的时候，必不和他们同流先知的血。』

chapters.en: So you testify against yourselves that you are the sons of those who murdered the prophets.
chapters.zh: 这就是你们自己证明是杀害先知者的子孙了。

chapters.en: Fill up, then, the measure of the sin of your fathers.
chapters.zh: 你们去充满你们祖宗的恶贯吧！

chapters.en: You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape the sentence of hell?
chapters.zh: 你们这些蛇类、毒蛇之种啊，怎能逃脱地狱的刑罚呢？

chapters.en: Because of this, I am sending you prophets and wise men and teachers. Some of them you will kill and crucify, and others you will flog in your synagogues and persecute from town to town.
chapters.zh: 所以我差遣先知和智慧人并文士到你们这里来，有的你们要杀害，要钉十字架；有的你们要在会堂里鞭打，从这城追逼到那城，

chapters.en: And so upon you will come all the righteous blood shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.
chapters.zh: 叫世上所流义人的血都归到你们身上，从义人亚伯的血起，直到你们在殿和坛中间所杀的巴拉加的儿子撒迦利亚的血为止。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，这一切的罪都要归到这世代了。」

chapters.en: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were unwilling!
chapters.zh: 「耶路撒冷啊，耶路撒冷啊，你常杀害先知，又用石头打死那奉差遣到你这里来的人。我多次愿意聚集你的儿女，好像母鸡把小鸡聚集在翅膀底下，只是你们不愿意。

chapters.en: Look, your house is left to you desolate.
chapters.zh: 看哪，你们的家成为荒场留给你们。

chapters.en: For I tell you that you will not see Me again until you say, ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我告诉你们，从今以后，你们不得再见我，直等到你们说：『奉主名来的是应当称颂的。』」

chapters.en: As Jesus left the temple and was walking away, His disciples came up to Him to point out its buildings.
chapters.zh: 耶稣出了〔圣〕殿，正走的时候，门徒进前来，把殿宇指给他看。

chapters.en: “Do you see all these things?” He replied. “Truly I tell you, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们不是看见这殿宇吗？我实在告诉你们，将来在这里没有一块石头留在石头上，不被拆毁了。」

chapters.en: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately. “Tell us,” they said, “when will these things happen, and what will be the sign of Your coming and of the end of the age?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣在橄榄山上坐着，门徒暗暗地来说：「请告诉我们，什么时候有这些事？你降临和世界的末了有什么预兆呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “See to it that no one deceives you.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你们要谨慎，免得有人迷惑你们。

chapters.en: For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will deceive many.
chapters.zh: 因为将来有好些人冒我的名来，说：『我是基督』，并且要迷惑许多人。

chapters.en: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.
chapters.zh: 你们也要听见打仗和打仗的风声，总不要惊慌；因为〔这些事〕是必须有的，只是末期还没有到。

chapters.en: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.
chapters.zh: 民要攻打民，国要攻打国；多处必有饥荒、地震。

chapters.en: All these are the beginning of birth pains.
chapters.zh: 这都是灾难〔注：灾难：原文是生产之难〕的起头。

chapters.en: Then they will deliver you over to be persecuted and killed, and you will be hated by all nations because of My name.
chapters.zh: 那时，人要把你们陷在患难里，也要杀害你们；你们又要为我的名被万民恨恶。

chapters.en: At that time many will fall away and will betray and hate one another,
chapters.zh: 那时，必有许多人跌倒，也要彼此陷害，彼此恨恶；

chapters.en: and many false prophets will arise and deceive many.
chapters.zh: 且有好些假先知起来，迷惑多人。

chapters.en: Because of the multiplication of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold.
chapters.zh: 只因不法的事增多，许多人的爱心才渐渐冷淡了。

chapters.en: But the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
chapters.zh: 惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。

chapters.en: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in all the world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.
chapters.zh: 这天国的福音要传遍天下，对万民作见证，然后末期才来到。」

chapters.en: So when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination of desolation,’ spoken of by the prophet Daniel (let the reader understand),
chapters.zh: 「你们看见先知但以理所说的『那行毁坏可憎的』站在圣地（读〔这经〕的人须要会意）。

chapters.en: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
chapters.zh: 那时，在犹太的，应当逃到山上；

chapters.en: Let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve anything from his house.
chapters.zh: 在房上的，不要下来拿家里的东西；

chapters.en: And let no one in the field return for his cloak.
chapters.zh: 在田里的，也不要回去取衣裳。

chapters.en: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!
chapters.zh: 当那些日子，怀孕的和奶孩子的有祸了。

chapters.en: Pray that your flight will not occur in the winter or on the Sabbath.
chapters.zh: 你们应当祈求，叫你们逃走的时候，不遇见冬天或是安息日。

chapters.en: For at that time there will be great tribulation, unseen from the beginning of the world until now, and never to be seen again.
chapters.zh: 因为那时必有大灾难，从世界的起头直到如今，没有这样的灾难，后来也必没有。

chapters.en: If those days had not been cut short, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, those days will be cut short.
chapters.zh: 若不减少那日子，凡有血气的总没有一个得救的；只是为选民，那日子必减少了。

chapters.en: At that time, if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.
chapters.zh: 那时，若有人对你们说：『基督在这里』，或说：『基督在那里』，你们不要信！

chapters.en: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders to deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
chapters.zh: 因为假基督、假先知将要起来，显大神迹、大奇事，倘若能行，连选民也就迷惑了。

chapters.en: See, I have told you in advance.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我预先告诉你们了。

chapters.en: So if they tell you, ‘There He is, in the wilderness,’ do not go out, or, ‘Here He is, in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.
chapters.zh: 若有人对你们说：『看哪，基督在旷野里』，你们不要出去！〔或说〕：『看哪，基督在内屋中』，你们不要信！

chapters.en: For just as the lightning comes from the east and flashes as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
chapters.zh: 闪电从东边发出，直照到西边。人子降临也要这样。

chapters.en: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.
chapters.zh: 尸首在哪里，鹰也必聚在那里。」

chapters.en:
Immediately after the tribulation of those days:
‘The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken. ’
chapters.zh: 「那些日子的灾难一过去， 日头就变黑了， 月亮也不放光， 众星要从天上坠落， 天势都要震动。

chapters.en: At that time the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn. They will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
chapters.zh: 那时，人子的兆头要显在天上，地上的万族都要哀哭。他们要看见人子，有能力，有大荣耀，驾着天上的云降临。

chapters.en: And He will send out His angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather His elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.
chapters.zh: 他要差遣使者，用号筒的大声，将他的选民，从四方〔注：方：原文是风〕，从天这边到天那边，都招聚了来。」

chapters.en: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.
chapters.zh: 「你们可以从无花果树学个比方：当树枝发嫩长叶的时候，你们就知道夏天近了。

chapters.en: So also, when you see all these things, you will know that He is near, right at the door.
chapters.zh: 这样，你们看见这一切的事，也该知道人子近了，正在门口了。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，这世代还没有过去，这些事都要成就。

chapters.en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
chapters.zh: 天地要废去，我的话却不能废去。」

chapters.en: No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
chapters.zh: 「但那日子，那时辰，没有人知道，连天上的使者也不知道，子也不知道，惟独父知道。

chapters.en: As it was in the days of Noah, so will it be at the coming of the Son of Man.
chapters.zh: 挪亚的日子怎样，人子降临也要怎样。

chapters.en: For in the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark.
chapters.zh: 当洪水以前的日子，人照常吃喝嫁娶，直到挪亚进方舟的那日；

chapters.en: And they were oblivious until the flood came and swept them all away. So will it be at the coming of the Son of Man.
chapters.zh: 不知不觉洪水来了，把他们全都冲去。人子降临也要这样。

chapters.en: Two men will be in the field: one will be taken and the other left.
chapters.zh: 那时，两个人在田里，取去一个，撇下一个。

chapters.en: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and the other left.
chapters.zh: 两个女人推磨，取去一个，撇下一个。

chapters.en: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day on which your Lord will come.
chapters.zh: 所以，你们要警醒，因为不知道你们的主是哪一天来到。

chapters.en: But understand this: If the homeowner had known in which watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.
chapters.zh: 家主若知道几更天有贼来，就必警醒，不容人挖透房屋；这是你们所知道的。

chapters.en: For this reason, you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect.
chapters.zh: 所以，你们也要预备，因为你们想不到的时候，人子就来了。」

chapters.en: Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of his household, to give the others their food at the proper time?
chapters.zh: 「谁是忠心有见识的仆人，为主人所派，管理家里的人，按时分粮给他们呢？

chapters.en: Blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.
chapters.zh: 主人来到，看见他这样行，那仆人就有福了。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，主人要派他管理一切所有的。

chapters.en: But suppose that servant is wicked and says in his heart, ‘My master will be away a long time.’
chapters.zh: 倘若那恶仆心里说：『我的主人必来得迟』，

chapters.en: And he begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.
chapters.zh: 就动手打他的同伴，又和酒醉的人一同吃喝。

chapters.en: The master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate.
chapters.zh: 在想不到的日子，不知道的时辰，那仆人的主人要来，

chapters.en: Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
chapters.zh: 重重地处治他〔注：或译：把他腰斩了〕，定他和假冒为善的人同罪；在那里必要哀哭切齿了。」

chapters.en: “At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
chapters.zh: 「那时，天国好比十个童女拿着灯出去迎接新郎。

chapters.en: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
chapters.zh: 其中有五个是愚拙的，五个是聪明的。

chapters.en: The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take along any extra oil.
chapters.zh: 愚拙的拿着灯，却不预备油；

chapters.en: But the wise ones took oil in flasks along with their lamps.
chapters.zh: 聪明的拿着灯，又预备油在器皿里。

chapters.en: When the bridegroom was delayed, they all became drowsy and fell asleep.
chapters.zh: 新郎迟延的时候，她们都打盹，睡着了。

chapters.en: At midnight the cry rang out: ‘Here is the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!’
chapters.zh: 半夜有人喊着说：『新郎来了，你们出来迎接他！』

chapters.en: Then all the virgins woke up and trimmed their lamps.
chapters.zh: 那些童女就都起来收拾灯。

chapters.en: The foolish ones said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil; our lamps are going out.’
chapters.zh: 愚拙的对聪明的说：『请分点油给我们，因为我们的灯要灭了。』

chapters.en: ‘No,’ said the wise ones, ‘or there may not be enough for both us and you. Instead, go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves.’
chapters.zh: 聪明的回答说：『恐怕不够你我用的；不如你们自己到卖油的那里去买吧。』

chapters.en: But while they were on their way to buy it, the bridegroom arrived. Those who were ready went in with him to the wedding banquet, and the door was shut.
chapters.zh: 她们去买的时候，新郎到了。那预备好了的，同他进去坐席，门就关了。

chapters.en: Later the other virgins arrived and said, ‘Lord, lord, open the door for us!’
chapters.zh: 其余的童女随后也来了，说：『主啊，主啊，给我们开门！』

chapters.en: But he replied, ‘Truly I tell you, I do not know you.’
chapters.zh: 他却回答说：『我实在告诉你们，我不认识你们。』

chapters.en: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour.
chapters.zh: 所以，你们要警醒；因为那日子，那时辰，你们不知道。」

chapters.en: For it is just like a man going on a journey, who called his servants and entrusted them with his possessions.
chapters.zh: 「〔天国〕又好比一个人要往外国去，就叫了仆人来，把他的家业交给他们，

chapters.en: To one he gave five talents, to another two talents, and to another one talent—each according to his own ability. And he went on his journey.
chapters.zh: 按着各人的才干给他们银子：一个给了五千，一个给了二千，一个给了一千，就往外国去了。

chapters.en: The servant who had received the five talents went at once and put them to work and gained five more.
chapters.zh: 那领五千的随即拿去做买卖，另外赚了五千。

chapters.en: Likewise, the one with the two talents gained two more.
chapters.zh: 那领二千的也照样另赚了二千。

chapters.en: But the servant who had received the one talent went off, dug a hole in the ground, and hid his master’s money.
chapters.zh: 但那领一千的去掘开地，把主人的银子埋藏了。

chapters.en: After a long time the master of those servants returned and settled accounts with them.
chapters.zh: 过了许久，那些仆人的主人来了，和他们算帐。

chapters.en: The servant who had received the five talents came and presented five more. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘you entrusted me with five talents. See, I have gained five more.’
chapters.zh: 那领五千银子的又带着那另外的五千来，说：『主啊，你交给我五千银子。请看，我又赚了五千。』

chapters.en: His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Enter into the joy of your master!’
chapters.zh: 主人说：『好，你这又良善又忠心的仆人，你在不多的事上有忠心，我要把许多事派你管理；可以进来享受你主人的快乐。』

chapters.en: The servant who had received the two talents also came and said, ‘Master, you entrusted me with two talents. See, I have gained two more.’
chapters.zh: 那领二千的也来，说：『主啊，你交给我二千银子。请看，我又赚了二千。』

chapters.en: His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Enter into the joy of your master!’
chapters.zh: 主人说：『好，你这又良善又忠心的仆人，你在不多的事上有忠心，我要把许多事派你管理；可以进来享受你主人的快乐。』

chapters.en: Finally, the servant who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Master, I knew that you are a hard man, reaping where you have not sown and gathering where you have not scattered seed.
chapters.zh: 那领一千的也来，说：『主啊，我知道你是忍心的人，没有种的地方要收割，没有散的地方要聚敛，

chapters.en: So I was afraid and went out and hid your talent in the ground. See, you have what belongs to you.’
chapters.zh: 我就害怕，去把你的一千银子埋藏在地里。请看，你的原银子在这里。』

chapters.en: ‘You wicked, lazy servant!’ replied his master. ‘You knew that I reap where I have not sown and gather where I have not scattered seed.
chapters.zh: 主人回答说：『你这又恶又懒的仆人，你既知道我没有种的地方要收割，没有散的地方要聚敛，

chapters.en: Then you should have deposited my money with the bankers, and on my return I would have received it back with interest.
chapters.zh: 就当把我的银子放给兑换银钱的人，到我来的时候，可以连本带利收回。

chapters.en: Therefore take the talent from him and give it to the one who has ten talents.
chapters.zh: 夺过他这一千来，给那有一万的。

chapters.en: For everyone who has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. But the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
chapters.zh: 因为凡有的，还要加给他，叫他有余；没有的，连他所有的也要夺过来。

chapters.en: And throw that worthless servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
chapters.zh: 把这无用的仆人丢在外面黑暗里；在那里必要哀哭切齿了。』」

chapters.en: When the Son of Man comes in His glory, and all the angels with Him, He will sit on His glorious throne.
chapters.zh: 「当人子在他荣耀里、同着众天使降临的时候，要坐在他荣耀的宝座上。

chapters.en: All the nations will be gathered before Him, and He will separate the people one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
chapters.zh: 万民都要聚集在他面前。他要把他们分别出来，好像牧羊的分别绵羊山羊一般，

chapters.en: He will place the sheep on His right and the goats on His left.
chapters.zh: 把绵羊安置在右边，山羊在左边。

chapters.en: Then the King will say to those on His right, ‘Come, you who are blessed by My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.
chapters.zh: 于是王要向那右边的说：『你们这蒙我父赐福的，可来承受那创世以来为你们所预备的国；

chapters.en: For I was hungry and you gave Me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave Me something to drink, I was a stranger and you took Me in,
chapters.zh: 因为我饿了，你们给我吃，渴了，你们给我喝；我作客旅，你们留我住；

chapters.en: I was naked and you clothed Me, I was sick and you looked after Me, I was in prison and you visited Me.’
chapters.zh: 我赤身露体，你们给我穿；我病了，你们看顾我；我在监里，你们来看我。』

chapters.en: Then the righteous will answer Him, ‘Lord, when did we see You hungry and feed You, or thirsty and give You something to drink?
chapters.zh: 义人就回答说：『主啊，我们什么时候见你饿了，给你吃，渴了，给你喝？

chapters.en: When did we see You a stranger and take You in, or naked and clothe You?
chapters.zh: 什么时候见你作客旅，留你住，或是赤身露体，给你穿？

chapters.en: When did we see You sick or in prison and visit You?’
chapters.zh: 又什么时候见你病了，或是在监里，来看你呢？』

chapters.en: And the King will reply, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers of Mine, you did for Me.’
chapters.zh: 王要回答说：『我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。』

chapters.en: Then He will say to those on His left, ‘Depart from Me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.
chapters.zh: 王又要向那左边的说：『你们这被咒诅的人，离开我！进入那为魔鬼和他的使者所预备的永火里去！

chapters.en: For I was hungry and you gave Me nothing to eat, I was thirsty and you gave Me nothing to drink,
chapters.zh: 因为我饿了，你们不给我吃，渴了，你们不给我喝；

chapters.en: I was a stranger and you did not take Me in, I was naked and you did not clothe Me, I was sick and in prison and you did not look after Me.’
chapters.zh: 我作客旅，你们不留我住；我赤身露体，你们不给我穿；我病了，我在监里，你们不来看顾我。』

chapters.en: And they too will reply, ‘Lord, when did we see You hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and did not minister to You?’
chapters.zh: 他们也要回答说：『主啊，我们什么时候见你饿了，或渴了，或作客旅，或赤身露体，或病了，或在监里，不伺候你呢？』

chapters.en: Then the King will answer, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did not do for one of the least of these, you did not do for Me.’
chapters.zh: 王要回答说：『我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既不做在我这〔弟兄〕中一个最小的身上，就是不做在我身上了。』

chapters.en: And they will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
chapters.zh: 这些人要往永刑里去；那些义人要往永生里去。」

chapters.en: When Jesus had finished saying all these things, He told His disciples,
chapters.zh: 耶稣说完了这一切的话，就对门徒说：

chapters.en: “You know that the Passover is two days away, and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified.”
chapters.zh: 「你们知道，过两天是逾越节，人子将要被交给人，钉在十字架上。」

chapters.en: At that time the chief priests and elders of the people assembled in the courtyard of the high priest, whose name was Caiaphas,
chapters.zh: 那时，祭司长和民间的长老聚集在大祭司称为该亚法的院里。

chapters.en: and they conspired to arrest Jesus covertly and kill Him.
chapters.zh: 大家商议要用诡计拿住耶稣，杀他，

chapters.en: “But not during the feast,” they said, “or there may be a riot among the people.”
chapters.zh: 只是说：「当节的日子不可，恐怕民间生乱。」

chapters.en: While Jesus was in Bethany in the home of Simon the Leper,
chapters.zh: 耶稣在伯大尼长大痲疯的西门家里，

chapters.en: a woman came to Him with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume, which she poured on His head as He reclined at the table.
chapters.zh: 有一个女人拿着一玉瓶极贵的香膏来，趁耶稣坐席的时候，浇在他的头上。

chapters.en: When the disciples saw this, they were indignant and asked, “Why this waste?
chapters.zh: 门徒看见就很不喜悦，说：「何用这样的枉费呢！

chapters.en: This perfume could have been sold at a high price, and the money given to the poor.”
chapters.zh: 这〔香膏〕可以卖许多钱，赒济穷人。」

chapters.en: Aware of this, Jesus asked, “Why are you bothering this woman? She has done a beautiful deed to Me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣看出他们的意思，就说：「为什么难为这女人呢？她在我身上做的是一件美事。

chapters.en: The poor you will always have with you, but you will not always have Me.
chapters.zh: 因为常有穷人和你们同在；只是你们不常有我。

chapters.en: By pouring this perfume on Me, she has prepared My body for burial.
chapters.zh: 她将这香膏浇在我身上是为我安葬做的。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, wherever this gospel is preached in all the world, what she has done will also be told in memory of her.”
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，普天之下，无论在什么地方传这福音，也要述说这女人所行的，作个纪念。」

chapters.en: Then one of the Twelve, the one called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests
chapters.zh: 当下，十二门徒里有一个称为加略人犹大的，去见祭司长，

chapters.en: and asked, “What are you willing to give me if I hand Him over to you?” And they set out for him thirty pieces of silver.
chapters.zh: 说：「我把他交给你们，你们愿意给我多少钱？」他们就给了他三十块钱。

chapters.en: So from then on Judas looked for an opportunity to betray Jesus.
chapters.zh: 从那时候，他就找机会要把耶稣交给他们。

chapters.en: On the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Where do You want us to prepare for You to eat the Passover?”
chapters.zh: 除酵节的第一天，门徒来问耶稣说：「你吃逾越〔节的筵席〕，要我们在哪里给你预备？」

chapters.en: He answered, “Go into the city to a certain man and tell him that the Teacher says, ‘My time is near. I will keep the Passover with My disciples at your house.’”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们进城去，到某人那里，对他说：『夫子说：我的时候快到了，我与门徒要在你家里守逾越〔节〕。』」

chapters.en: So the disciples did as Jesus had directed them and prepared the Passover.
chapters.zh: 门徒遵着耶稣所吩咐的就去预备了逾越〔节的筵席〕。

chapters.en: When evening came, Jesus was reclining with the twelve disciples.
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，耶稣和十二个门徒坐席。

chapters.en: And while they were eating, He said to them, “Truly I tell you, one of you will betray Me.”
chapters.zh: 正吃的时候，耶稣说：「我实在告诉你们，你们中间有一个人要卖我了。」

chapters.en: They were deeply grieved and began to ask Him one after another, “Surely not I, Lord?”
chapters.zh: 他们就甚忧愁，一个一个地问他说：「主，是我吗？」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with Me will betray Me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「同我蘸手在盘子里的，就是他要卖我。

chapters.en: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed. It would be better for him if he had not been born.”
chapters.zh: 人子必要去世，正如〔经上〕指着他所写的；但卖人子的人有祸了！那人不生在世上倒好。」

chapters.en:
Then Judas, who would betray Him, said, “Surely not I, Rabbi?”
Jesus answered, “You have said it yourself.”
chapters.zh: 卖耶稣的犹大问他说：「拉比，是我吗？」耶稣说：「你说的是。」

chapters.en: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, spoke a blessing and broke it, and gave it to the disciples, saying, “Take and eat; this is My body.”
chapters.zh: 他们吃的时候，耶稣拿起饼来，祝福，就擘开，递给门徒，说：「你们拿着吃，这是我的身体」；

chapters.en: Then He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, “Drink from it, all of you.
chapters.zh: 又拿起杯来，祝谢了，递给他们，说：「你们都喝这个；

chapters.en: This is My blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.
chapters.zh: 因为这是我立约的血，为多人流出来，使罪得赦。

chapters.en: I tell you, I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it anew with you in My Father’s kingdom.”
chapters.zh: 但我告诉你们，从今以后，我不再喝这葡萄汁，直到我在我父的国里同你们喝新的那日子。」

chapters.en: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
chapters.zh: 他们唱了诗，就出来往橄榄山去。

chapters.en:
Then Jesus said to them, “This very night you will all fall away on account of Me. For it is written:
‘I will strike the Shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
chapters.zh: 那时，耶稣对他们说：「今夜，你们为我的缘故都要跌倒。因为〔经上〕记着说： 我要击打牧人， 羊就分散了。

chapters.en: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”
chapters.zh: 但我复活以后，要在你们以先往加利利去。」

chapters.en: Peter said to Him, “Even if all fall away on account of You, I never will.”
chapters.zh: 彼得说：「众人虽然为你的缘故跌倒，我却永不跌倒。」

chapters.en: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus declared, “this very night, before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我实在告诉你，今夜鸡叫以先，你要三次不认我。」

chapters.en: Peter replied, “Even if I have to die with You, I will never deny You.” And all the other disciples said the same thing.
chapters.zh: 彼得说：「我就是必须和你同死，也总不能不认你。」众门徒都是这样说。

chapters.en: Then Jesus went with His disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and He told them, “Sit here while I go over there and pray.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣同门徒来到一个地方，名叫客西马尼，就对他们说：「你们坐在这里，等我到那边去祷告。」

chapters.en: He took with Him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee and began to be sorrowful and deeply distressed.
chapters.zh: 于是带着彼得和西庇太的两个儿子同去，就忧愁起来，极其难过，

chapters.en: Then He said to them, “My soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with Me.”
chapters.zh: 便对他们说：「我心里甚是忧伤，几乎要死；你们在这里等候，和我一同警醒。」

chapters.en: Going a little farther, He fell facedown and prayed, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from Me. Yet not as I will, but as You will.”
chapters.zh: 他就稍往前走，俯伏在地，祷告说：「我父啊，倘若可行，求你叫这杯离开我。然而，不要照我的意思，只要照你的意思。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus returned to the disciples and found them sleeping. “Were you not able to keep watch with Me for one hour?” He asked Peter.
chapters.zh: 来到门徒那里，见他们睡着了，就对彼得说：「怎么样？你们不能同我警醒片时吗？

chapters.en: “Watch and pray so that you will not enter into temptation. For the spirit is willing, but the body is weak.”
chapters.zh: 总要警醒祷告，免得入了迷惑。你们心灵固然愿意，肉体却软弱了。」

chapters.en: A second time He went away and prayed, “My Father, if this cup cannot pass unless I drink it, may Your will be done.”
chapters.zh: 第二次又去祷告说：「我父啊，这杯若不能离开我，必要我喝，就愿你的意旨成全。」

chapters.en: And again Jesus returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
chapters.zh: 又来，见他们睡着了，因为他们的眼睛困倦。

chapters.en: So He left them and went away once more and prayed a third time, saying the same thing.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又离开他们去了。第三次祷告，说的话还是与先前一样。

chapters.en: Then He returned to the disciples and said, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Look, the hour is near, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
chapters.zh: 于是来到门徒那里，对他们说：「现在你们仍然睡觉安歇吧〔注：吧：或译吗？〕！时候到了，人子被卖在罪人手里了。

chapters.en: Rise, let us go! See, My betrayer is approaching!”
chapters.zh: 起来！我们走吧。看哪，卖我的人近了！」

chapters.en: While Jesus was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived, accompanied by a large crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests and elders of the people.
chapters.zh: 说话之间，那十二个门徒里的犹大来了，并有许多人带着刀棒，从祭司长和民间的长老那里与他同来。

chapters.en: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The One I kiss is the man; arrest Him.”
chapters.zh: 那卖耶稣的给了他们一个暗号，说：「我与谁亲嘴，谁就是他。你们可以拿住他。」

chapters.en: Going directly to Jesus, he said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed Him.
chapters.zh: 犹大随即到耶稣跟前，说：「请拉比安」，就与他亲嘴。

chapters.en:
“Friend,” Jesus replied, “do what you came for.”
Then the men stepped forward, seized Jesus, and arrested Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「朋友，你来要做的事，就做吧。」于是那些人上前，下手拿住耶稣。

chapters.en: At this, one of Jesus’ companions drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
chapters.zh: 有跟随耶稣的一个人伸手拔出刀来，将大祭司的仆人砍了一刀，削掉了他一个耳朵。

chapters.en: “Put your sword back in its place,” Jesus said to him. “For all who draw the sword will die by the sword.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「收刀入鞘吧！凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

chapters.en: Are you not aware that I can call on My Father, and He will at once put at My disposal more than twelve legions of angels?
chapters.zh: 你想，我不能求我父现在为我差遣十二营多天使来吗？

chapters.en: But how then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen this way?”
chapters.zh: 若是这样，经上所说，事情必须如此的话怎么应验呢？」

chapters.en: At that time Jesus said to the crowd, “Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me as you would an outlaw? Every day I sat teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest Me.
chapters.zh: 当时，耶稣对众人说：「你们带着刀棒出来拿我，如同拿强盗吗？我天天坐在殿里教训人，你们并没有拿我。

chapters.en:
But this has all happened so that the writings of the prophets would be fulfilled.”
Then all the disciples deserted Him and fled.
chapters.zh: 但这一切的事成就了，为要应验先知书上的话。」当下，门徒都离开他，逃走了。

chapters.en: Those who had arrested Jesus led Him away to the house of Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and elders had gathered.
chapters.zh: 拿耶稣的人把他带到大祭司该亚法那里去；文士和长老已经在那里聚会。

chapters.en: But Peter followed Him at a distance, right up to the courtyard of the high priest. And he went in and sat down with the guards to see the outcome.
chapters.zh: 彼得远远地跟着耶稣，直到大祭司的院子，进到里面，就和差役同坐，要看这事到底怎样。

chapters.en: Now the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were seeking false testimony against Jesus in order to put Him to death.
chapters.zh: 祭司长和全公会寻找假见证控告耶稣，要治死他。

chapters.en:
But they did not find any, though many false witnesses came forward.
Finally two came forward
chapters.zh: 虽有好些人来作假见证，总得不着实据。末后有两个人前来，说：

chapters.en: and declared, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days.’”
chapters.zh: 「这个人曾说：『我能拆毁上帝的殿，三日内又建造起来。』」

chapters.en: So the high priest stood up and asked Him, “Have You no answer? What are these men testifying against You?”
chapters.zh: 大祭司就站起来，对耶稣说：「你什么都不回答吗？这些人作见证告你的是什么呢？」

chapters.en:
But Jesus remained silent.
Then the high priest said to Him, “I charge You under oath by the living God: Tell us if You are the Christ, the Son of God.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣却不言语。大祭司对他说：「我指着永生上帝叫你起誓告诉我们，你是上帝的儿子基督不是？」

chapters.en: “You have said it yourself,” Jesus answered. “But I say to all of you, from now on you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of heaven.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「你说的是。然而，我告诉你们，后来你们要看见人子坐在那权能者的右边，驾着天上的云降临。」

chapters.en: At this, the high priest tore his clothes and declared, “He has blasphemed! Why do we need any more witnesses? Look, now you have heard the blasphemy.
chapters.zh: 大祭司就撕开衣服，说：「他说了僭妄的话，我们何必再用见证人呢？这僭妄的话，现在你们都听见了。

chapters.en:
What do you think?”
“He deserves to die,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 你们的意见如何？」他们回答说：「他是该死的。」

chapters.en: Then they spit in His face and struck Him. Others slapped Him
chapters.zh: 他们就吐唾沫在他脸上，用拳头打他，也有用手掌打他的，说：

chapters.en: and said, “Prophesy to us, Christ! Who hit You?”
chapters.zh: 「基督啊！你是先知，告诉我们打你的是谁？」

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, and a servant girl came up to him. “You also were with Jesus the Galilean,” she said.
chapters.zh: 彼得在外面院子里坐着，有一个使女前来，说：「你素来也是同那加利利人耶稣一伙的。」

chapters.en: But he denied it before them all: “I do not know what you are talking about.”
chapters.zh: 彼得在众人面前却不承认，说：「我不知道你说的是什么！」

chapters.en: When Peter had gone out to the gateway, another servant girl saw him and said to the people there, “This man was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
chapters.zh: 既出去，到了门口，又有一个〔使女〕看见他，就对那里的人说：「这个人也是同拿撒勒人耶稣一伙的。」

chapters.en: And again he denied it with an oath: “I do not know the man!”
chapters.zh: 彼得又不承认，并且起誓说：「我不认得那个人。」

chapters.en: After a little while, those standing nearby came up to Peter. “Surely you are one of them,” they said, “for your accent gives you away.”
chapters.zh: 过了不多的时候，旁边站着的人前来，对彼得说：「你真是他们一党的，你的口音把你露出来了。」

chapters.en:
At that he began to curse and swear to them, “I do not know the man!”
And immediately a rooster crowed.
chapters.zh: 彼得就发咒起誓地说：「我不认得那个人。」立时，鸡就叫了。

chapters.en: Then Peter remembered the word that Jesus had spoken: “Before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.” And he went outside and wept bitterly.
chapters.zh: 彼得想起耶稣所说的话：「鸡叫以先，你要三次不认我。」他就出去痛哭。

chapters.en: When morning came, all the chief priests and elders of the people conspired against Jesus to put Him to death.
chapters.zh: 到了早晨，众祭司长和民间的长老大家商议要治死耶稣，

chapters.en: They bound Him, led Him away, and handed Him over to Pilate the governor.
chapters.zh: 就把他捆绑，解去，交给巡抚彼拉多。

chapters.en: When Judas, who had betrayed Him, saw that Jesus was condemned, he was filled with remorse and returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders.
chapters.zh: 这时候，卖耶稣的犹大看见耶稣已经定了罪，就后悔，把那三十块钱拿回来给祭司长和长老，说：

chapters.en:
“I have sinned by betraying innocent blood,” he said.
“What is that to us?” they replied. “You bear the responsibility.”
chapters.zh: 「我卖了无辜之人的血是有罪了。」他们说：「那与我们有什么相干？你自己承当吧！」

chapters.en: So Judas threw the silver into the temple and left. Then he went away and hanged himself.
chapters.zh: 犹大就把那银钱丢在殿里，出去吊死了。

chapters.en: The chief priests picked up the pieces of silver and said, “It is unlawful to put this into the treasury, since it is blood money.”
chapters.zh: 祭司长拾起银钱来，说：「这是血价，不可放在库里。」

chapters.en: After conferring together, they used the money to buy the potter’s field as a burial place for foreigners.
chapters.zh: 他们商议，就用那银钱买了窑户的一块田，为要埋葬外乡人。

chapters.en: That is why it has been called the Field of Blood to this day.
chapters.zh: 所以那块田直到今日还叫做「血田」。

chapters.en:
Then what was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled:
“They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price set on Him by the people of Israel,
chapters.zh: 这就应了先知耶利米的话，说：「他们用那三十块钱，就是被估定之人的价钱，是以色列人中所估定的，

chapters.en: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord had commanded me.”
chapters.zh: 买了窑户的一块田；这是照着主所吩咐我的。」

chapters.en:
Meanwhile Jesus stood before the governor, who questioned Him: “Are You the King of the Jews?”
“You have said so,” Jesus replied.
chapters.zh: 耶稣站在巡抚面前；巡抚问他说：「你是犹太人的王吗？」耶稣说：「你说的是。」

chapters.en: And when He was accused by the chief priests and elders, He gave no answer.
chapters.zh: 他被祭司长和长老控告的时候，什么都不回答。

chapters.en: Then Pilate asked Him, “Do You not hear how many charges they are bringing against You?”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多就对他说：「他们作见证告你这么多的事，你没有听见吗？」

chapters.en: But Jesus gave no answer, not even to a single charge, much to the governor’s amazement.
chapters.zh: 耶稣仍不回答，连一句话也不说，以致巡抚甚觉希奇。

chapters.en: Now it was the governor’s custom at the feast to release to the crowd a prisoner of their choosing.
chapters.zh: 巡抚有一个常例，每逢这节期，随众人所要的释放一个囚犯给他们。

chapters.en: At that time they were holding a notorious prisoner named Barabbas.
chapters.zh: 当时有一个出名的囚犯叫巴拉巴。

chapters.en: So when the crowd had assembled, Pilate asked them, “Which one do you want me to release to you: Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”
chapters.zh: 众人聚集的时候，彼拉多就对他们说：「你们要我释放哪一个给你们？是巴拉巴呢？是称为基督的耶稣呢？」

chapters.en: For he knew it was out of envy that they had handed Jesus over to him.
chapters.zh: 巡抚原知道他们是因为嫉妒才把他解了来。

chapters.en: While Pilate was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent him this message: “Have nothing to do with that innocent man, for I have suffered terribly in a dream today because of Him.”
chapters.zh: 正坐堂的时候，他的夫人打发人来说：「这义人的事，你一点不可管，因为我今天在梦中为他受了许多的苦。」

chapters.en: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the crowds to ask for Barabbas and to have Jesus put to death.
chapters.zh: 祭司长和长老挑唆众人，求释放巴拉巴，除灭耶稣。

chapters.en:
“Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” asked the governor.
“Barabbas,” they replied.
chapters.zh: 巡抚对众人说：「这两个人，你们要我释放哪一个给你们呢？」他们说：「巴拉巴。」

chapters.en:
“What then should I do with Jesus who is called Christ?” Pilate asked.
They all answered, “Crucify Him!”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多说：「这样，那称为基督的耶稣我怎么办他呢？」他们都说：「把他钉十字架！」

chapters.en:
“Why?” asked Pilate. “What evil has He done?”
But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify Him!”
chapters.zh: 巡抚说：「为什么呢？他做了什么恶事呢？」他们便极力地喊着说：「把他钉十字架！」

chapters.en: When Pilate saw that he was accomplishing nothing, but that instead a riot was breaking out, he took water and washed his hands before the crowd. “I am innocent of this man’s blood, ” he said. “You bear the responsibility.”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多见说也无济于事，反要生乱，就拿水在众人面前洗手，说：「流这义人的血，罪不在我，你们承当吧。」

chapters.en: All the people answered, “His blood be on us and on our children!”
chapters.zh: 众人都回答说：「他的血归到我们和我们的子孙身上。」

chapters.en: So Pilate released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed Him over to be crucified.
chapters.zh: 于是彼拉多释放巴拉巴给他们，把耶稣鞭打了，交给人钉十字架。

chapters.en: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company around Him.
chapters.zh: 巡抚的兵就把耶稣带进衙门，叫全营的兵都聚集在他那里。

chapters.en: They stripped Him and put a scarlet robe on Him.
chapters.zh: 他们给他脱了衣服，穿上一件朱红色袍子，

chapters.en: And they twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on His head. They put a staff in His right hand, knelt down before Him, and mocked Him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
chapters.zh: 用荆棘编做冠冕，戴在他头上，拿一根苇子放在他右手里，跪在他面前，戏弄他，说：「恭喜，犹太人的王啊！」

chapters.en: Then they spit on Him and took the staff and struck Him on the head repeatedly.
chapters.zh: 又吐唾沫在他脸上，拿苇子打他的头。
