chapters.en: After they had mocked Him, they removed the robe and put His own clothes back on Him. Then they led Him away to crucify Him.
chapters.zh: 戏弄完了，就给他脱了袍子，仍穿上他自己的衣服，带他出去，要钉十字架。

chapters.en: Along the way they found a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross of Jesus.
chapters.zh: 他们出来的时候，遇见一个古利奈人，名叫西门，就勉强他同去，好背着耶稣的十字架。

chapters.en: And when they came to a place called Golgotha, which means The Place of the Skull,
chapters.zh: 到了一个地方名叫各各他，意思就是「髑髅地」。

chapters.en: they offered Him wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, He refused to drink it.
chapters.zh: 兵丁拿苦胆调和的酒给耶稣喝；他尝了，就不肯喝。

chapters.en: When they had crucified Him, they divided up His garments by casting lots.
chapters.zh: 他们既将他钉在十字架上，就拈鬮分他的衣服，

chapters.en: And sitting down, they kept watch over Him there.
chapters.zh: 又坐在那里看守他。

chapters.en:
Above His head they posted the written charge against Him:
THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
chapters.zh: 在他头以上安一个牌子，写着他的罪状，说：「这是犹太人的王耶稣。」

chapters.en: Two robbers were crucified with Him, one on His right and the other on His left.
chapters.zh: 当时，有两个强盗和他同钉十字架，一个在右边，一个在左边。

chapters.en: And those who passed by heaped abuse on Him, shaking their heads
chapters.zh: 从那里经过的人讥诮他，摇着头，说：

chapters.en: and saying, “You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days, save Yourself! If You are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”
chapters.zh: 「你这拆毁〔圣〕殿、三日又建造起来的，可以救自己吧！你如果是上帝的儿子，就从十字架上下来吧！」

chapters.en: In the same way, the chief priests, scribes, and elders mocked Him, saying,
chapters.zh: 祭司长和文士并长老也是这样戏弄他，说：

chapters.en: “He saved others, but He cannot save Himself. He is the King of Israel! Let Him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in Him.
chapters.zh: 「他救了别人，不能救自己。他是以色列的王，现在可以从十字架上下来，我们就信他。

chapters.en: He trusts in God. Let God deliver Him now if He wants Him. For He said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”
chapters.zh: 他倚靠上帝，上帝若喜悦他，现在可以救他；因为他曾说：『我是上帝的儿子。』」

chapters.en: In the same way, even the robbers who were crucified with Him berated Him.
chapters.zh: 那和他同钉的强盗也是这样地讥诮他。

chapters.en: From the sixth hour until the ninth hour darkness came over all the land.
chapters.zh: 从午正到申初，遍地都黑暗了。

chapters.en: About the ninth hour Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?” which means, “My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?”
chapters.zh: 约在申初，耶稣大声喊着说：「以利！以利！拉马撒巴各大尼？」就是说：「我的上帝！我的上帝！为什么离弃我？」

chapters.en: When some of those standing there heard this, they said, “He is calling Elijah.”
chapters.zh: 站在那里的人，有的听见就说：「这个人呼叫以利亚呢！」

chapters.en: One of them quickly ran and brought a sponge. He filled it with sour wine, put it on a reed, and held it up for Jesus to drink.
chapters.zh: 内中有一个人赶紧跑去，拿海绒蘸满了醋，绑在苇子上，送给他喝。

chapters.en: But the others said, “Leave Him alone. Let us see if Elijah comes to save Him.”
chapters.zh: 其余的人说：「且等着，看以利亚来救他不来。」

chapters.en: When Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice, He yielded up His spirit.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又大声喊叫，气就断了。

chapters.en: At that moment the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth quaked, and the rocks were split.
chapters.zh: 忽然，殿里的幔子从上到下裂为两半，地也震动，磐石也崩裂，

chapters.en: The tombs broke open, and the bodies of many saints who had fallen asleep were raised.
chapters.zh: 坟墓也开了，已睡圣徒的身体多有起来的。

chapters.en: After Jesus’ resurrection, when they had come out of the tombs, they entered the holy city and appeared to many people.
chapters.zh: 到耶稣复活以后，他们从坟墓里出来，进了圣城，向许多人显现。

chapters.en: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and all that had happened, they were terrified and said, “Truly this was the Son of God.”
chapters.zh: 百夫长和一同看守耶稣的人看见地震并所经历的事，就极其害怕，说：「这真是上帝的儿子了！」

chapters.en: And many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to minister to Him.
chapters.zh: 有好些妇女在那里，远远地观看；她们是从加利利跟随耶稣来服事他的。

chapters.en: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedee’s sons.
chapters.zh: 内中有抹大拉的马利亚，又有雅各和约西的母亲马利亚，并有西庇太两个儿子的母亲。

chapters.en: When it was evening, there came a rich man from Arimathea named Joseph, who himself was a disciple of Jesus.
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，有一个财主，名叫约瑟，是亚利马太来的，他也是耶稣的门徒。

chapters.en: He went to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus, and Pilate ordered that it be given to him.
chapters.zh: 这人去见彼拉多，求耶稣的身体；彼拉多就吩咐给他。

chapters.en: So Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
chapters.zh: 约瑟取了身体，用干净细麻布裹好，

chapters.en: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut into the rock. Then he rolled a great stone across the entrance to the tomb and went away.
chapters.zh: 安放在自己的新坟墓里，就是他凿在磐石里的。他又把大石头滚到墓门口，就去了。

chapters.en: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.
chapters.zh: 有抹大拉的马利亚和那个马利亚在那里，对着坟墓坐着。

chapters.en: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and Pharisees assembled before Pilate.
chapters.zh: 次日，就是预备日的第二天，祭司长和法利赛人聚集来见彼拉多，说：

chapters.en: “Sir,” they said, “we remember that while He was alive that deceiver said, ‘After three days I will rise again.’
chapters.zh: 「大人，我们记得那诱惑人的还活着的时候曾说：『三日后我要复活。』

chapters.en: So give the order that the tomb be secured until the third day. Otherwise, His disciples may come and steal Him away and tell the people He has risen from the dead. And this last deception would be worse than the first.”
chapters.zh: 因此，请吩咐人将坟墓把守妥当，直到第三日，恐怕他的门徒来，把他偷了去，就告诉百姓说：『他从死里复活了。』这样，那后来的迷惑比先前的更利害了！」

chapters.en: “You have a guard,” Pilate said. “Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how.”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多说：「你们有看守的兵，去吧！尽你们所能的把守妥当。」

chapters.en: So they went and secured the tomb by sealing the stone and posting the guard.
chapters.zh: 他们就带着看守的兵同去，封了石头，将坟墓把守妥当。

chapters.en: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb.
chapters.zh: 安息日将尽，七日的头一日，天快亮的时候，抹大拉的马利亚和那个马利亚来看坟墓。

chapters.en: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, rolled away the stone, and sat on it.
chapters.zh: 忽然，地大震动；因为有主的使者从天上下来，把石头滚开，坐在上面。

chapters.en: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.
chapters.zh: 他的相貌如同闪电，衣服洁白如雪。

chapters.en: The guards trembled in fear of him and became like dead men.
chapters.zh: 看守的人就因他吓得浑身乱战，甚至和死人一样。

chapters.en: But the angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.
chapters.zh: 天使对妇女说：「不要害怕！我知道你们是寻找那钉十字架的耶稣。

chapters.en: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said! Come, see the place where He lay.
chapters.zh: 他不在这里，照他所说的，已经复活了。你们来看安放主的地方。

chapters.en: Then go quickly and tell His disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him.’ See, I have told you.”
chapters.zh: 快去告诉他的门徒，说他从死里复活了，并且在你们以先往加利利去，在那里你们要见他。看哪，我已经告诉你们了。」

chapters.en: So they hurried away from the tomb in fear and great joy, and ran to tell His disciples.
chapters.zh: 妇女们就急忙离开坟墓，又害怕，又大大地欢喜，跑去要报给他的门徒。

chapters.en: Suddenly Jesus met them and said, “Greetings!” They came to Him, grasped His feet, and worshiped Him.
chapters.zh: 忽然，耶稣遇见她们，说：「愿你们平安！」她们就上前抱住他的脚拜他。

chapters.en: “Do not be afraid,” said Jesus. “Go and tell My brothers to go to Galilee. There they will see Me.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对她们说：「不要害怕！你们去告诉我的弟兄，叫他们往加利利去，在那里必见我。」

chapters.en: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests all that had happened.
chapters.zh: 她们去的时候，看守的兵有几个进城去，将所经历的事都报给祭司长。

chapters.en: And after the chief priests had met with the elders and formed a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money
chapters.zh: 祭司长和长老聚集商议，就拿许多银钱给兵丁，说：

chapters.en: and instructed them: “You are to say, ‘His disciples came by night and stole Him away while we were asleep.’
chapters.zh: 「你们要这样说：『夜间我们睡觉的时候，他的门徒来，把他偷去了。』

chapters.en: If this report reaches the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble.”
chapters.zh: 倘若这话被巡抚听见，有我们劝他，保你们无事。」

chapters.en: So the guards took the money and did as they were instructed. And this account has been circulated among the Jews to this very day.
chapters.zh: 兵丁受了银钱，就照所嘱咐他们的去行。这话就传说在犹太人中间，直到今日。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain Jesus had designated.
chapters.zh: 十一个门徒往加利利去，到了耶稣约定的山上。

chapters.en: When they saw Him, they worshiped Him, but some doubted.
chapters.zh: 他们见了耶稣就拜他，然而还有人疑惑。

chapters.en: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣进前来，对他们说：「天上地下所有的权柄都赐给我了。

chapters.en: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
chapters.zh: 所以，你们要去，使万民作我的门徒，奉父、子、圣灵的名给他们施洗〔注：或译：给他们施洗，归于父、子、圣灵的名〕。

chapters.en: and teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”
chapters.zh: 凡我所吩咐你们的，都教训他们遵守，我就常与你们同在，直到世界的末了。」

chapters.en: This is the beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
chapters.zh: 上帝的儿子，耶稣基督福音的起头。

chapters.en:
As it is written in Isaiah the prophet:
“Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way.”
chapters.zh: 正如先知以赛亚〔注：有古卷没有以赛亚三个字〕书上记着说： 看哪，我要差遣我的使者在你前面， 预备道路。

chapters.en:
“A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord,
make straight paths for Him.’”
chapters.zh: 在旷野有人声喊着说： 预备主的道， 修直他的路。

chapters.en: John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
chapters.zh: 〔照这话〕，约翰来了，在旷野施洗，传悔改的洗礼，使罪得赦。

chapters.en: People went out to him from all of Jerusalem and the countryside of Judea. Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
chapters.zh: 犹太全地和耶路撒冷的人都出去到约翰那里，承认他们的罪，在约旦河里受他的洗。

chapters.en: John was clothed in camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
chapters.zh: 约翰穿骆驼毛〔的衣服〕，腰束皮带，吃的是蝗虫、野蜜。

chapters.en: And he proclaimed: “After me will come One more powerful than I, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.
chapters.zh: 他传道说：「有一位在我以后来的，能力比我更大，我就是弯腰给他解鞋带也是不配的。

chapters.en: I baptize you with water, but He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit. ”
chapters.zh: 我是用水给你们施洗，他却要用圣灵给你们施洗。」

chapters.en: In those days Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
chapters.zh: 那时，耶稣从加利利的拿撒勒来，在约旦河里受了约翰的洗。

chapters.en: As soon as Jesus came up out of the water, He saw the heavens breaking open and the Spirit descending on Him like a dove.
chapters.zh: 他从水里一上来，就看见天裂开了，圣灵仿佛鸽子，降在他身上。

chapters.en: And a voice came from heaven: “You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased.”
chapters.zh: 又有声音从天上来，〔说〕：「你是我的爱子，我喜悦你。」

chapters.en: At once the Spirit drove Jesus into the wilderness,
chapters.zh: 圣灵就把耶稣催到旷野里去。

chapters.en: and He was there for forty days, being tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and the angels ministered to Him.
chapters.zh: 他在旷野四十天，受撒但的试探，并与野兽同在一处，且有天使来伺候他。

chapters.en: After the arrest of John, Jesus went into Galilee and proclaimed the gospel of God.
chapters.zh: 约翰下监以后，耶稣来到加利利，宣传上帝的福音，

chapters.en: “The time is fulfilled,” He said, “and the kingdom of God is near. Repent and believe in the gospel!”
chapters.zh: 说：「日期满了，上帝的国近了。你们当悔改，信福音！」

chapters.en: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, He saw Simon and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
chapters.zh: 耶稣顺着加利利的海边走，看见西门和西门的兄弟安得烈在海里撒网；他们本是打鱼的。

chapters.en: “Come, follow Me,” Jesus said, “and I will make you fishers of men.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「来跟从我，我要叫你们得人如得鱼一样。」

chapters.en: And at once they left their nets and followed Him.
chapters.zh: 他们就立刻舍了网，跟从了他。

chapters.en: Going on a little farther, He saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat, mending their nets.
chapters.zh: 耶稣稍往前走，又见西庇太的儿子雅各和雅各的兄弟约翰在船上补网。

chapters.en: Immediately Jesus called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣随即招呼他们，他们就把父亲西庇太和雇工人留在船上，跟从耶稣去了。

chapters.en: Then Jesus and His companions went to Capernaum, and right away Jesus entered the synagogue on the Sabbath and began to teach.
chapters.zh: 到了迦百农，耶稣就在安息日进了会堂教训人。

chapters.en: The people were astonished at His teaching, because He taught as one who had authority, and not as the scribes.
chapters.zh: 众人很希奇他的教训；因为他教训他们，正像有权柄的人，不像文士。

chapters.en: Suddenly a man with an unclean spirit cried out in the synagogue:
chapters.zh: 在会堂里，有一个人被污鬼附着。他喊叫说：

chapters.en: “What do You want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!”
chapters.zh: 「拿撒勒人耶稣，我们与你有什么相干？你来灭我们吗？我知道你是谁，乃是上帝的圣者。」

chapters.en: But Jesus rebuked the spirit. “Be silent!” He said. “Come out of him!”
chapters.zh: 耶稣责备他说：「不要作声！从这人身上出来吧。」

chapters.en: At this, the unclean spirit threw the man into convulsions and came out with a loud shriek.
chapters.zh: 污鬼叫那人抽了一阵疯，大声喊叫，就出来了。

chapters.en: All the people were amazed and began to ask one another, “What is this? A new teaching with authority! He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey Him!”
chapters.zh: 众人都惊讶，以致彼此对问说：「这是什么事？是个新道理啊！他用权柄吩咐污鬼，连污鬼也听从了他。」

chapters.en: And the news about Jesus spread quickly through the whole region of Galilee.
chapters.zh: 耶稣的名声就传遍了加利利的四方。

chapters.en: As soon as Jesus and His companions had left the synagogue, they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew.
chapters.zh: 他们一出会堂，就同着雅各、约翰，进了西门和安得烈的家。

chapters.en: Simon’s mother-in-law was sick in bed with a fever, and they promptly told Jesus about her.
chapters.zh: 西门的岳母正害热病躺着，就有人告诉耶稣。

chapters.en: So He went to her, took her by the hand, and helped her up. The fever left her, and she began to serve them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣进前拉着她的手，扶她起来，热就退了，她就服事他们。

chapters.en: That evening, after sunset, people brought to Jesus all the sick and demon-possessed,
chapters.zh: 天晚日落的时候，有人带着一切害病的，和被鬼附的，来到耶稣跟前。

chapters.en: and the whole town gathered at the door.
chapters.zh: 合城的人都聚集在门前。

chapters.en: And He healed many who were ill with various diseases and drove out many demons. But He would not allow the demons to speak, because they knew who He was.
chapters.zh: 耶稣治好了许多害各样病的人，又赶出许多鬼，不许鬼说话，因为鬼认识他。

chapters.en: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up and went out to a solitary place to pray.
chapters.zh: 次日早晨，天未亮的时候，耶稣起来，到旷野地方去，在那里祷告。

chapters.en: Simon and his companions went to look for Him,
chapters.zh: 西门和同伴追了他去，

chapters.en: and when they found Him, they said, “Everyone is looking for You!”
chapters.zh: 遇见了就对他说：「众人都找你。」

chapters.en: But Jesus answered, “Let us go on to the neighboring towns so I can preach there as well, for that is why I have come.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「我们可以往别处去，到邻近的乡村，我也好在那里传道，因为我是为这事出来的。」

chapters.en: So He went throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.
chapters.zh: 于是在加利利全地，进了会堂，传道，赶鬼。

chapters.en: Then a leper came to Jesus, begging on his knees: “If You are willing, You can make me clean.”
chapters.zh: 有一个长大痲疯的来求耶稣，向他跪下，说：「你若肯，必能叫我洁净了。」

chapters.en: Moved with compassion, Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!”
chapters.zh: 耶稣动了慈心，就伸手摸他，说：「我肯，你洁净了吧！」

chapters.en: And immediately the leprosy left him, and the man was cleansed.
chapters.zh: 大痲疯即时离开他，他就洁净了。

chapters.en: Jesus promptly sent him away with a stern warning:
chapters.zh: 耶稣严严地嘱咐他，就打发他走，

chapters.en: “See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and present the offering Moses prescribed for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”
chapters.zh: 对他说：「你要谨慎，什么话都不可告诉人，只要去把身体给祭司察看，又因为你洁净了，献上摩西所吩咐的礼物，对众人作证据。」

chapters.en:
But the man went out and openly began to proclaim and spread the news.
Consequently, Jesus could no longer enter a town in plain view, but He stayed out in solitary places. Yet people came to Him from every quarter.
chapters.zh: 那人出去，倒说许多的话，把这件事传扬开了，叫耶稣以后不得再明明地进城，只好在外边旷野地方。人从各处都就了他来。

chapters.en: A few days later Jesus went back to Capernaum. And when the people heard that He was home,
chapters.zh: 过了些日子，耶稣又进了迦百农。人听见他在房子里，

chapters.en: they gathered in such large numbers that there was no more room, not even outside the door, as Jesus spoke the word to them.
chapters.zh: 就有许多人聚集，甚至连门前都没有空地；耶稣就对他们讲道。

chapters.en: Then a paralytic was brought to Him, carried by four men.
chapters.zh: 有人带着一个瘫子来见耶稣，是用四个人抬来的；

chapters.en: Since they were unable to get to Jesus through the crowd, they uncovered the roof above Him, made an opening, and lowered the paralytic on his mat.
chapters.zh: 因为人多，不得近前，就把耶稣所在的房子，拆了房顶，既拆通了，就把瘫子连所躺卧的褥子都缒下来。

chapters.en: When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣见他们的信心，就对瘫子说：「小子，你的罪赦了。」

chapters.en: But some of the scribes were sitting there and thinking in their hearts,
chapters.zh: 有几个文士坐在那里，心里议论，说：

chapters.en: “Why does this man speak like this? He is blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
chapters.zh: 「这个人为什么这样说呢？他说僭妄的话了。除了上帝以外，谁能赦罪呢？」

chapters.en: At once Jesus knew in His spirit that they were thinking this way within themselves. “Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?” He asked.
chapters.zh: 耶稣心中知道他们心里这样议论，就说：「你们心里为什么这样议论呢？

chapters.en: “Which is easier: to say to a paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up, pick up your mat, and walk’?
chapters.zh: 或对瘫子说『你的罪赦了』，或说『起来！拿你的褥子行走』，哪一样容易呢？

chapters.en: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...” He said to the paralytic,
chapters.zh: 但要叫你们知道，人子在地上有赦罪的权柄。」就对瘫子说：

chapters.en: “I tell you, get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”
chapters.zh: 「我吩咐你，起来！拿你的褥子回家去吧。」

chapters.en: And immediately the man got up, picked up his mat, and walked out in front of them all. As a result, they were all astounded and glorified God, saying, “We have never seen anything like this!”
chapters.zh: 那人就起来，立刻拿着褥子，当众人面前出去了，以致众人都惊奇，归荣耀与上帝，说：「我们从来没有见过这样的事！」

chapters.en: Once again Jesus went out beside the sea. All the people came to Him, and He taught them there.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又出到海边去，众人都就了他来，他便教训他们。

chapters.en: As He was walking along, He saw Levi son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax booth. “Follow Me,” He told him, and Levi got up and followed Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣经过的时候，看见亚勒腓的儿子利未坐在税关上，就对他说：「你跟从我来。」他就起来，跟从了耶稣。

chapters.en: While Jesus was dining at Levi’s house, many tax collectors and sinners were eating with Him and His disciples—for there were many who followed Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣在利未家里坐席的时候，有好些税吏和罪人与耶稣并门徒一同坐席；因为这样的人多，他们也跟随耶稣。

chapters.en: When the scribes who were Pharisees saw Jesus eating with these people, they asked His disciples, “Why does He eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
chapters.zh: 法利赛人中的文士〔注：有古卷：文士和法利赛人〕看见耶稣和罪人并税吏一同吃饭，就对他门徒说：「他和税吏并罪人一同吃喝吗？」

chapters.en: On hearing this, Jesus told them, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣听见，就对他们说：「康健的人用不着医生，有病的人才用得着。我来本不是召义人，乃是召罪人。」

chapters.en: Now John’s disciples and the Pharisees were often fasting. So people came to Jesus and asked, “Why don’t Your disciples fast like John’s disciples and those of the Pharisees?”
chapters.zh: 当下，约翰的门徒和法利赛人禁食。他们来问耶稣说：「约翰的门徒和法利赛人的门徒禁食，你的门徒倒不禁食，这是为什么呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “How can the guests of the bridegroom fast while He is with them? As long as He is with them, they cannot fast.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「新郎和陪伴之人同在的时候，陪伴之人岂能禁食呢？新郎还同在，他们不能禁食。

chapters.en: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.
chapters.zh: 但日子将到，新郎要离开他们，那日他们就要禁食。

chapters.en: No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. If he does, the new piece will pull away from the old, and a worse tear will result.
chapters.zh: 没有人把新布缝在旧衣服上，恐怕所补上的新布带坏了旧衣服，破的就更大了。

chapters.en: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. Instead, new wine is poured into new wineskins.”
chapters.zh: 也没有人把新酒装在旧皮袋里，恐怕酒把皮袋裂开，酒和皮袋就都坏了；惟把新酒装在新皮袋里。」

chapters.en: One Sabbath Jesus was passing through the grainfields, and His disciples began to pick the heads of grain as they walked along.
chapters.zh: 耶稣当安息日从麦地经过。他门徒行路的时候，掐了麦穗。

chapters.en: So the Pharisees said to Him, “Look, why are they doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”
chapters.zh: 法利赛人对耶稣说：「看哪，他们在安息日为什么做不可做的事呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry and in need?
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「〔经上记着〕大卫和跟从他的人缺乏饥饿之时所做的事，你们没有念过吗？

chapters.en: During the high priesthood of Abiathar, he entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which was lawful only for the priests. And he gave some to his companions as well.”
chapters.zh: 他当亚比亚他作大祭司的时候，怎么进了上帝的殿，吃了陈设饼，又给跟从他的人吃。这饼除了祭司以外，人都不可吃。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus declared, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
chapters.zh: 又对他们说：「安息日是为人设立的，人不是为安息日设立的。

chapters.en: Therefore, the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.”
chapters.zh: 所以，人子也是安息日的主。」

chapters.en: Once again Jesus entered the synagogue, and a man with a withered hand was there.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又进了会堂，在那里有一个人枯干了一只手。

chapters.en: In order to accuse Jesus, they were watching to see if He would heal on the Sabbath.
chapters.zh: 众人窥探耶稣，在安息日医治不医治，意思是要控告耶稣。

chapters.en: Then Jesus said to the man with the withered hand, “Stand up among us.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对那枯干一只手的人说：「起来，站在当中。」

chapters.en:
And He asked them, “Which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?”
But they were silent.
chapters.zh: 又问众人说：「在安息日行善行恶，救命害命，哪样是可以的呢？」他们都不作声。

chapters.en: Jesus looked around at them with anger and sorrow at their hardness of heart. Then He said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” So he stretched it out, and it was restored.
chapters.zh: 耶稣怒目周围看他们，忧愁他们的心刚硬，就对那人说：「伸出手来！」他把手一伸，手就复了原。

chapters.en: At this, the Pharisees went out and began plotting with the Herodians how they might kill Jesus.
chapters.zh: 法利赛人出去，同希律一党的人商议怎样可以除灭耶稣。

chapters.en: So Jesus withdrew with His disciples to the sea, accompanied by a large crowd from Galilee, Judea,
chapters.zh: 耶稣和门徒退到海边去，有许多人从加利利跟随他。

chapters.en: Jerusalem, Idumea, the region beyond the Jordan, and the vicinity of Tyre and Sidon. The large crowd came to Him when they heard what great things He was doing.
chapters.zh: 还有许多人听见他所做的大事，就从犹太、耶路撒冷、以土买、约旦河外，并泰尔、西顿的四方来到他那里。

chapters.en: Jesus asked His disciples to have a boat ready for Him so that the crowd would not crush Him.
chapters.zh: 他因为人多，就吩咐门徒叫一只小船伺候着，免得众人拥挤他。

chapters.en: For He had healed so many that all who had diseases were pressing forward to touch Him.
chapters.zh: 他治好了许多人，所以凡有灾病的，都挤进来要摸他。

chapters.en: And when the unclean spirits saw Him, they fell down before Him and cried out, “You are the Son of God!”
chapters.zh: 污鬼无论何时看见他，就俯伏在他面前，喊着说：「你是上帝的儿子。」

chapters.en: But He warned them sternly not to make Him known.
chapters.zh: 耶稣再三地嘱咐他们，不要把他显露出来。

chapters.en: Then Jesus went up on the mountain and called for those He wanted, and they came to Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣上了山，随自己的意思叫人来；他们便来到他那里。

chapters.en: He appointed twelve of them, whom He designated as apostles, to accompany Him, to be sent out to preach,
chapters.zh: 他就设立十二个人，要他们常和自己同在，也要差他们去传道，

chapters.en: and to have authority to drive out demons.
chapters.zh: 并给他们权柄赶鬼。

chapters.en: These are the twelve He appointed: Simon (whom He named Peter),
chapters.zh: 〔这十二个人〕有西门（耶稣又给他起名叫彼得），

chapters.en: James son of Zebedee and his brother John (whom He named Boanerges, meaning “Sons of Thunder”),
chapters.zh: 还有西庇太的儿子雅各和雅各的兄弟约翰（又给这两个人起名叫半尼其，就是雷子的意思），

chapters.en: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot,
chapters.zh: 又有安得烈、腓力、巴多罗买、马太、多马、亚勒腓的儿子雅各，和达太，并奋锐党的西门，

chapters.en: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus.
chapters.zh: 还有卖耶稣的加略人犹大。

chapters.en: Then Jesus went home, and once again a crowd gathered, so that He and His disciples could not even eat.
chapters.zh: 耶稣进了一个屋子，众人又聚集，甚至他连饭也顾不得吃。

chapters.en: When His family heard about this, they went out to take custody of Him, saying, “He is out of His mind.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣的亲属听见，就出来要拉住他，因为他们说他癫狂了。

chapters.en: And the scribes who had come down from Jerusalem were saying, “He is possessed by Beelzebul, ” and, “By the prince of the demons He drives out demons.”
chapters.zh: 从耶路撒冷下来的文士说：「他是被别西卜附着」；又说：「他是靠着鬼王赶鬼。」

chapters.en: So Jesus called them together and began to speak to them in parables: “How can Satan drive out Satan?
chapters.zh: 耶稣叫他们来，用比喻对他们说：「撒但怎能赶出撒但呢？

chapters.en: If a kingdom is divided against itself, it cannot stand.
chapters.zh: 若一国自相纷争，那国就站立不住；

chapters.en: If a house is divided against itself, it cannot stand.
chapters.zh: 若一家自相纷争，那家就站立不住。

chapters.en: And if Satan is divided and rises against himself, he cannot stand; his end has come.
chapters.zh: 若撒但自相攻打纷争，他就站立不住，必要灭亡。

chapters.en: Indeed, no one can enter a strong man’s house to steal his possessions unless he first ties up the strong man. Then he can plunder his house.
chapters.zh: 没有人能进壮士家里，抢夺他的家具；必先捆住那壮士，才可以抢夺他的家。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, the sons of men will be forgiven all sins and blasphemies, as many as they utter.
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，世人一切的罪和一切亵渎的话都可得赦免；

chapters.en: But whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; he is guilty of eternal sin.”
chapters.zh: 凡亵渎圣灵的，却永不得赦免，乃要担当永远的罪。」

chapters.en: Jesus made this statement because they were saying, “He has an unclean spirit.”
chapters.zh: 〔这话是〕因为他们说：「他是被污鬼附着的。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus’ mother and brothers came and stood outside. They sent someone in to summon Him,
chapters.zh: 当下，耶稣的母亲和弟兄来，站在外边，打发人去叫他。

chapters.en: and a crowd was sitting around Him. “Look,” He was told, “Your mother and brothers are outside, asking for You.”
chapters.zh: 有许多人在耶稣周围坐着，他们就告诉他说：「看哪，你母亲和你弟兄在外边找你。」

chapters.en: But Jesus replied, “Who are My mother and My brothers?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「谁是我的母亲？谁是我的弟兄？」

chapters.en: Looking at those seated in a circle around Him, He said, “Here are My mother and My brothers!
chapters.zh: 就四面观看那周围坐着的人，说：「看哪，我的母亲，我的弟兄。

chapters.en: For whoever does the will of God is My brother and sister and mother.”
chapters.zh: 凡遵行上帝旨意的人就是我的弟兄姊妹和母亲了。」

chapters.en: Once again Jesus began to teach beside the sea, and such a large crowd gathered around Him that He got into a boat and sat in it, while all the people crowded along the shore.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又在海边教训人。有许多人到他那里聚集，他只得上船坐下。船在海里，众人都靠近海，站在岸上。

chapters.en: And He taught them many things in parables, and in His teaching He said,
chapters.zh: 耶稣就用比喻教训他们许多道理。在教训之间，对他们说：

chapters.en: “Listen! A farmer went out to sow his seed.
chapters.zh: 「你们听啊！有一个撒种的出去撒种。

chapters.en: And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.
chapters.zh: 撒的时候，有落在路旁的，飞鸟来吃尽了；

chapters.en: Some fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.
chapters.zh: 有落在土浅石头地上的，土既不深，发苗最快，

chapters.en: But when the sun rose, the seedlings were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.
chapters.zh: 日头出来一晒，因为没有根，就枯干了；

chapters.en: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the seedlings, and they yielded no crop.
chapters.zh: 有落在荆棘里的，荆棘长起来，把它挤住了，就不结实；

chapters.en: Still other seed fell on good soil, where it sprouted, grew up, and produced a crop—one bearing thirtyfold, another sixtyfold, and another a hundredfold.”
chapters.zh: 又有落在好土里的，就发生长大，结实有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的」；

chapters.en: Then Jesus said, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
chapters.zh: 又说：「有耳可听的，就应当听！」

chapters.en: As soon as Jesus was alone with the Twelve and those around Him, they asked Him about the parable.
chapters.zh: 无人的时候，跟随耶稣的人和十二个门徒问他这比喻的意思。

chapters.en: He replied, “The mystery of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to those on the outside everything is expressed in parables,
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「上帝国的奥祕只叫你们知道，若是对外人讲，凡事就用比喻，

chapters.en:
so that,
‘they may be ever seeing but never perceiving, and ever hearing but never understanding; otherwise they might turn and be forgiven.’ ”
chapters.zh: 叫他们 看是看见，却不晓得； 听是听见，却不明白； 恐怕他们回转过来，就得赦免。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus said to them, “Do you not understand this parable? Then how will you understand any of the parables?
chapters.zh: 又对他们说：「你们不明白这比喻吗？这样怎能明白一切的比喻呢？

chapters.en: The farmer sows the word.
chapters.zh: 撒种之人所撒的就是道。

chapters.en: Some are like the seeds along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.
chapters.zh: 那撒在路旁的，就是人听了道，撒但立刻来，把撒在他心里的道夺了去。

chapters.en: Some are like the seeds sown on rocky ground. They hear the word and at once receive it with joy.
chapters.zh: 那撒在石头地上的，就是人听了道，立刻欢喜领受，

chapters.en: But they themselves have no root, and they remain for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.
chapters.zh: 但他心里没有根，不过是暂时的，及至为道遭了患难，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。

chapters.en: Others are like the seeds sown among the thorns. They hear the word,
chapters.zh: 还有那撒在荆棘里的，就是人听了道，

chapters.en: but the worries of this life, the deceitfulness of wealth, and the desire for other things come in and choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
chapters.zh: 后来有世上的思虑、钱财的迷惑，和别样的私欲进来，把道挤住了，就不能结实。

chapters.en: Still others are like the seeds sown on good soil. They hear the word, receive it, and produce a crop—thirtyfold, sixtyfold, or a hundredfold.”
chapters.zh: 那撒在好地上的，就是人听道，又领受，并且结实，有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的。」

chapters.en: Jesus also said to them, “Does anyone bring in a lamp to put it under a basket or under a bed? Doesn’t he set it on a stand?
chapters.zh: 耶稣又对他们说：「人拿灯来，岂是要放在斗底下，床底下，不放在灯台上吗？

chapters.en: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be brought to light.
chapters.zh: 因为掩藏的事，没有不显出来的；隐瞒的事，没有不露出来的。

chapters.en: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear.”
chapters.zh: 有耳可听的，就应当听！」

chapters.en: He went on to say, “Pay attention to what you hear. With the measure you use, it will be measured to you, and even more will be added to you.
chapters.zh: 又说：「你们所听的要留心。你们用什么量器量给人，也必用什么量器量给你们，并且要多给你们。

chapters.en: For whoever has will be given more. But whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.”
chapters.zh: 因为有的，还要给他；没有的，连他所有的也要夺去。」

chapters.en: Jesus also said, “The kingdom of God is like a man who scatters seed on the ground.
chapters.zh: 又说：「上帝的国如同人把种撒在地上。

chapters.en: Night and day he sleeps and wakes, and the seed sprouts and grows, though he knows not how.
chapters.zh: 黑夜睡觉，白日起来，这种就发芽渐长，那人却不晓得如何这样。

chapters.en: All by itself the earth produces a crop—first the stalk, then the head, then grain that ripens within.
chapters.zh: 地生五谷是出于自然的：先发苗，后长穗，再后穗上结成饱满的子粒；

chapters.en: And as soon as the grain is ripe, he swings the sickle, because the harvest has come. ”
chapters.zh: 谷既熟了，就用镰刀去割，因为收成的时候到了。」

chapters.en: Then He asked, “To what can we compare the kingdom of God? With what parable shall we present it?
chapters.zh: 又说：「上帝的国，我们可用什么比较呢？可用什么比喻表明呢？

chapters.en: It is like a mustard seed, which is the smallest of all seeds sown upon the earth.
chapters.zh: 好像一粒芥菜种，种在地里的时候，虽比地上的百种都小，

chapters.en: But after it is planted, it grows to be the largest of all garden plants and puts forth great branches, so that the birds of the air nest in its shade.”
chapters.zh: 但种上以后，就长起来，比各样的菜都大，又长出大枝来，甚至天上的飞鸟可以宿在它的荫下。」

chapters.en: With many such parables Jesus spoke the word to them, to the extent that they could understand.
chapters.zh: 耶稣用许多这样的比喻，照他们所能听的，对他们讲道。

chapters.en: He did not tell them anything without using a parable. But privately He explained everything to His own disciples.
chapters.zh: 若不用比喻，就不对他们讲；没有人的时候，就把一切的道讲给门徒听。

chapters.en: When that evening came, He said to His disciples, “Let us cross to the other side.”
chapters.zh: 当那天晚上，耶稣对门徒说：「我们渡到那边去吧。」

chapters.en: After they had dismissed the crowd, they took Jesus with them, since He was already in the boat. And there were other boats with Him.
chapters.zh: 门徒离开众人，耶稣仍在船上，他们就把他一同带去；也有别的船和他同行。

chapters.en: Soon a violent windstorm came up, and the waves were breaking over the boat, so that it was being swamped.
chapters.zh: 忽然起了暴风，波浪打入船内，甚至船要满了水。

chapters.en: But Jesus was in the stern, sleeping on the cushion. So they woke Him and said, “Teacher, don’t You care that we are perishing?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣在船尾上，枕着枕头睡觉。门徒叫醒了他，说：「夫子！我们丧命，你不顾吗？」

chapters.en: Then Jesus got up and rebuked the wind and the sea. “Silence!” He commanded. “Be still!” And the wind died down, and it was perfectly calm.
chapters.zh: 耶稣醒了，斥责风，向海说：「住了吧！静了吧！」风就止住，大大地平静了。

chapters.en: “Why are you so afraid?” He asked. “Do you still have no faith?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「为什么胆怯？你们还没有信心吗？」

chapters.en: Overwhelmed with fear, they asked one another, “Who is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?”
chapters.zh: 他们就大大地惧怕，彼此说：「这到底是谁，连风和海也听从他了。」

chapters.en: On the other side of the sea, they arrived in the region of the Gerasenes.
chapters.zh: 他们来到海那边格拉森人的地方。

chapters.en: As soon as Jesus got out of the boat, He was met by a man with an unclean spirit, who was coming from the tombs.
chapters.zh: 耶稣一下船，就有一个被污鬼附着的人从坟茔里出来迎着他。

chapters.en: This man had been living in the tombs and could no longer be restrained, even with chains.
chapters.zh: 那人常住在坟茔里，没有人能捆住他，就是用铁鍊也不能；

chapters.en: Though he was often bound with chains and shackles, he had broken the chains and shattered the shackles. Now there was no one with the strength to subdue him.
chapters.zh: 因为人屡次用脚镣和铁鍊捆锁他，铁鍊竟被他挣断了，脚镣也被他弄碎了；总没有人能制伏他。

chapters.en: Night and day in the tombs and in the mountains he kept crying out and cutting himself with stones.
chapters.zh: 他昼夜常在坟茔里和山中喊叫，又用石头砍自己。

chapters.en: When the man saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and fell on his knees before Him.
chapters.zh: 他远远地看见耶稣，就跑过去拜他，

chapters.en: And he shouted in a loud voice, “What do You want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You before God not to torture me!”
chapters.zh: 大声呼叫说：「至高上帝的儿子耶稣，我与你有什么相干？我指着上帝恳求你，不要叫我受苦！」

chapters.en: For Jesus had already declared, “Come out of this man, you unclean spirit!”
chapters.zh: 是因耶稣曾吩咐他说：「污鬼啊，从这人身上出来吧！」

chapters.en:
“What is your name?” Jesus asked.
“My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣问他说：「你名叫什么？」回答说：「我名叫『群』，因为我们多的缘故」；

chapters.en: And he begged Jesus repeatedly not to send them out of that region.
chapters.zh: 就再三地求耶稣，不要叫他们离开那地方。

chapters.en: There on the nearby hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding.
chapters.zh: 在那里山坡上，有一大群猪吃食；

chapters.en: So the demons begged Jesus, “Send us to the pigs, so that we may enter them.”
chapters.zh: 鬼就央求耶稣说：「求你打发我们往猪群里，附着猪去。」

chapters.en: He gave them permission, and the unclean spirits came out and went into the pigs, and the herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea and drowned in the water.
chapters.zh: 耶稣准了他们，污鬼就出来，进入猪里去。于是那群猪闯下山崖，投在海里，淹死了。〔猪的数目〕约有二千。

chapters.en: Those tending the pigs ran off and reported this in the town and countryside, and the people went out to see what had happened.
chapters.zh: 放猪的就逃跑了，去告诉城里和乡下的人。众人就来，要看是什么事。

chapters.en: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons sitting there, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
chapters.zh: 他们来到耶稣那里，看见那被鬼附着的人，就是从前被群鬼所附的，坐着，穿上衣服，心里明白过来，他们就害怕。

chapters.en: Those who had seen it described what had happened to the demon-possessed man and also to the pigs.
chapters.zh: 看见这事的，便将鬼附之人所遇见的和那群猪的事都告诉了众人；

chapters.en: And the people began to beg Jesus to leave their region.
chapters.zh: 众人就央求耶稣离开他们的境界。

chapters.en: As He was getting into the boat, the man who had been possessed by the demons begged to go with Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣上船的时候，那从前被鬼附着的人恳求和耶稣同在。

chapters.en: But Jesus would not allow him. “Go home to your own people,” He said, “and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and what mercy He has shown you.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣不许，却对他说：「你回家去，到你的亲属那里，将主为你所做的是何等大的事，是怎样怜悯你，都告诉他们。」

chapters.en: So the man went away and began to proclaim throughout the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him. And everyone was amazed.
chapters.zh: 那人就走了，在低加坡里传扬耶稣为他做了何等大的事，众人就都希奇。

chapters.en: When Jesus had again crossed by boat to the other side, a large crowd gathered around Him beside the sea.
chapters.zh: 耶稣坐船又渡到那边去，就有许多人到他那里聚集；他正在海边上。

chapters.en: A synagogue leader named Jairus arrived, and seeing Jesus, he fell at His feet
chapters.zh: 有一个管会堂的人，名叫睚鲁，来见耶稣，就俯伏在他脚前，

chapters.en: and pleaded with Him urgently, “My little daughter is near death. Please come and place Your hands on her, so that she will be healed and live.”
chapters.zh: 再三地求他，说：「我的小女儿快要死了，〔求你〕去按手在她身上，使她痊愈，得以活了。」

chapters.en: So Jesus went with him, and a large crowd followed and pressed around Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就和他同去。 有许多人跟随拥挤他。

chapters.en: And a woman was there who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years.
chapters.zh: 有一个女人，患了十二年的血漏，

chapters.en: She had borne much agony under the care of many physicians and had spent all she had, but to no avail. Instead, her condition had only grown worse.
chapters.zh: 在好些医生手里受了许多的苦，又花尽了她所有的，一点也不见好，病势反倒更重了。

chapters.en: When the woman heard about Jesus, she came up through the crowd behind Him and touched His cloak.
chapters.zh: 她听见耶稣的事，就从后头来，杂在众人中间，摸耶稣的衣裳，

chapters.en: For she kept saying, “If only I touch His garments, I will be healed.”
chapters.zh: 意思说：「我只摸他的衣裳，就必痊愈。」

chapters.en: Immediately her bleeding stopped, and she sensed in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
chapters.zh: 于是她血漏的源头立刻干了；她便觉得身上的灾病好了。

chapters.en: At once Jesus was aware that power had gone out from Him. Turning to the crowd, He asked, “Who touched My garments?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣顿时心里觉得有能力从自己身上出去，就在众人中间转过来，说：「谁摸我的衣裳？」

chapters.en: His disciples answered, “You can see the crowd pressing in on You, and yet You ask, ‘Who touched Me?’”
chapters.zh: 门徒对他说：「你看众人拥挤你，还说『谁摸我』吗？」

chapters.en: But He kept looking around to see who had done this.
chapters.zh: 耶稣周围观看，要见做这事的女人。

chapters.en: Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell down before Him trembling in fear, and she told Him the whole truth.
chapters.zh: 那女人知道在自己身上所成的事，就恐惧战兢，来俯伏在耶稣跟前，将实情全告诉他。

chapters.en: “Daughter,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be free of your affliction.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对她说：「女儿，你的信救了你，平平安安地回去吧！你的灾病痊愈了。」

chapters.en: While He was still speaking, messengers from the house of Jairus arrived and said, “Your daughter is dead; why bother the Teacher anymore?”
chapters.zh: 还说话的时候，有人从管会堂的家里来，说：「你的女儿死了，何必还劳动先生呢？」

chapters.en: But Jesus overheard their conversation and said to Jairus, “Do not be afraid; just believe.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣听见所说的话，就对管会堂的说：「不要怕，只要信！」

chapters.en: And He did not allow anyone to accompany Him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
chapters.zh: 于是带着彼得、雅各，和雅各的兄弟约翰同去，不许别人跟随他。

chapters.en: When they arrived at the house of the synagogue leader, Jesus saw the commotion and the people weeping and wailing loudly.
chapters.zh: 他们来到管会堂的家里；耶稣看见那里乱嚷，并有人大大地哭泣哀号，

chapters.en: He went inside and asked, “Why all this commotion and weeping? The child is not dead, but asleep.”
chapters.zh: 进到里面，就对他们说：「为什么乱嚷哭泣呢？孩子不是死了，是睡着了。」

chapters.en:
And they laughed at Him.
After He had put them all outside, He took the child’s father and mother and His own companions, and went in to see the child.
chapters.zh: 他们就嗤笑耶稣。耶稣把他们都撵出去，就带着孩子的父母和跟随的人进了孩子所在的地方，

chapters.en: Taking her by the hand, Jesus said, “Talitha koum!” which means, “Little girl, I say to you, get up!”
chapters.zh: 就拉着孩子的手，对她说：「大利大，古米！」（翻出来就是说：「闺女，我吩咐你起来！」）

chapters.en: Immediately the girl got up and began to walk around (she was twelve years old). And at once they were utterly astounded.
chapters.zh: 那闺女立时起来走。他们就大大地惊奇；闺女已经十二岁了。

chapters.en: Then Jesus gave strict orders that no one should know about this, and He told them to give her something to eat.
chapters.zh: 耶稣切切地嘱咐他们，不要叫人知道这事，又吩咐给她东西吃。

chapters.en: Jesus went on from there and came to His hometown, accompanied by His disciples.
chapters.zh: 耶稣离开那里，来到自己的家乡；门徒也跟从他。

chapters.en: When the Sabbath came, He began to teach in the synagogue, and many who heard Him were astonished. “Where did this man get these ideas?” they asked. “What is this wisdom He has been given? And how can He perform such miracles?
chapters.zh: 到了安息日，他在会堂里教训人。众人听见，就甚希奇，说：「这人从哪里有这些事呢？所赐给他的是什么智慧？他手所做的是何等的异能呢？

chapters.en: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and the brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon? Aren’t His sisters here with us as well?” And they took offense at Him.
chapters.zh: 这不是那木匠吗？不是马利亚的儿子雅各、约西、犹大、西门的长兄吗？他妹妹们不也是在我们这里吗？」他们就厌弃他〔注：厌弃他：原文是因他跌倒〕。

chapters.en: Then Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown, among his relatives, and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「大凡先知，除了本地、亲属、本家之外，没有不被人尊敬的。」

chapters.en: So He could not perform any miracles there, except to lay His hands on a few of the sick and heal them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就在那里不得行什么异能，不过按手在几个病人身上，治好他们。

chapters.en:
And He was amazed at their unbelief.
And He went around from village to village, teaching the people.
chapters.zh: 他也诧异他们不信，就往周围乡村教训人去了。

chapters.en: Then Jesus called the Twelve to Him and began to send them out two by two, giving them authority over unclean spirits.
chapters.zh: 耶稣叫了十二个门徒来，差遣他们两个两个地出去，也赐给他们权柄，制伏污鬼；

chapters.en: He instructed them to take nothing but a staff for the journey—no bread, no bag, no money in their belts—
chapters.zh: 并且嘱咐他们：「行路的时候不要带食物和口袋，腰袋里也不要带钱，除了柺杖以外，什么都不要带；

chapters.en: and to wear sandals, but not a second tunic.
chapters.zh: 只要穿鞋，也不要穿两件褂子」；

chapters.en: And He told them, “When you enter a house, stay there until you leave that area.
chapters.zh: 又对他们说：「你们无论到何处，进了人的家，就住在那里，直到离开那地方。

chapters.en: If anyone will not welcome you or listen to you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that place, as a testimony against them.”
chapters.zh: 何处的人不接待你们，不听你们，你们离开那里的时候，就把脚上的尘土跺下去，对他们作见证。」

chapters.en: So they set out and preached that the people should repent.
chapters.zh: 门徒就出去传道，叫人悔改，

chapters.en: They also drove out many demons and healed many of the sick, anointing them with oil.
chapters.zh: 又赶出许多的鬼，用油抹了许多病人，治好他们。

chapters.en: Now King Herod heard about this, for Jesus’ name had become well known, and people were saying, “John the Baptist has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣的名声传扬出来。希律王听见了，就说：「施洗的约翰从死里复活了，所以这些异能由他里面发出来。」

chapters.en: Others were saying, “He is Elijah,” and still others, “He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of old.”
chapters.zh: 但别人说：「是以利亚。」又有人说：「是先知，〔正〕像先知中的一位。」

chapters.en: But when Herod heard this, he said, “John, whom I beheaded, has risen from the dead!”
chapters.zh: 希律听见却说：「是我所斩的约翰，他复活了。」

chapters.en: For Herod himself had ordered that John be arrested and bound and imprisoned, on account of his brother Philip’s wife Herodias, whom Herod had married.
chapters.zh: 先是希律为他兄弟腓力的妻子希罗底的缘故，差人去拿住约翰，锁在监里，因为希律已经娶了那妇人。

chapters.en: For John had been telling Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife!”
chapters.zh: 约翰曾对希律说：「你娶你兄弟的妻子是不合理的。」

chapters.en: So Herodias held a grudge against John and wanted to kill him. But she had been unable,
chapters.zh: 于是希罗底怀恨他，想要杀他，只是不能；

chapters.en: because Herod feared John and protected him, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man. When he heard John’s words, he was greatly perplexed; yet he listened to him gladly.
chapters.zh: 因为希律知道约翰是义人，是圣人，所以敬畏他，保护他，听他讲论，就多照着行〔注：有古卷：游移不定〕，并且乐意听他。

chapters.en: On Herod’s birthday, her opportunity arose. Herod held a banquet for his nobles and military commanders and the leading men of Galilee.
chapters.zh: 有一天，恰巧是希律的生日，希律摆设筵席，请了大臣和千夫长，并加利利作首领的。

chapters.en: When the daughter of Herodias came and danced, she pleased Herod and his guests, and the king said to the girl, “Ask me for whatever you wish, and I will give it to you.”
chapters.zh: 希罗底的女儿进来跳舞，使希律和同席的人都欢喜。王就对女子说：「你随意向我求什么，我必给你。」

chapters.en: And he swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half my kingdom!”
chapters.zh: 又对她起誓说：「随你向我求什么，就是我国的一半，我也必给你。」

chapters.en:
Then she went out and asked her mother, “What should I request?”
And her mother answered, “The head of John the Baptist.”
chapters.zh: 她就出去对她母亲说：「我可以求什么呢？」她母亲说：「施洗约翰的头。」

chapters.en: At once the girl hurried back to the king with her request: “I want you to give me the head of John the Baptist on a platter immediately.”
chapters.zh: 她就急忙进去见王，求他说：「我愿王立时把施洗约翰的头放在盘子里给我。」

chapters.en: The king was consumed with sorrow, but because of his oaths and his guests, he did not want to refuse her.
chapters.zh: 王就甚忧愁；但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就不肯推辞，

chapters.en: So without delay, the king commanded that John’s head be brought in. He sent an executioner, who went and beheaded him in the prison.
chapters.zh: 随即差一个护卫兵，吩咐拿约翰的头来。护卫兵就去，在监里斩了约翰，

chapters.en: The man brought John’s head on a platter and presented it to the girl, who gave it to her mother.
chapters.zh: 把头放在盘子里，拿来给女子，女子就给她母亲。

chapters.en: When John’s disciples heard about this, they came and took his body and placed it in a tomb.
chapters.zh: 约翰的门徒听见了，就来把他的尸首领去，葬在坟墓里。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, the apostles gathered around Jesus and brought Him news of all they had done and taught.
chapters.zh: 使徒聚集到耶稣那里，将一切所做的事、所传的道全告诉他。

chapters.en: And He said to them, “Come with Me privately to a solitary place, and let us rest for a while.” For many people were coming and going, and they did not even have time to eat.
chapters.zh: 他就说：「你们来，同我暗暗地到旷野地方去歇一歇。」这是因为来往的人多，他们连吃饭也没有工夫。

chapters.en: So they went away in a boat by themselves to a solitary place.
chapters.zh: 他们就坐船，暗暗地往旷野地方去。

chapters.en: But many people saw them leaving and recognized them. They ran together on foot from all the towns and arrived before them.
chapters.zh: 〔众人〕看见他们去，有许多认识他们的，就从各城步行，一同跑到那里，比他们先赶到了。

chapters.en: When Jesus stepped ashore and saw a large crowd, He had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd. And He began to teach them many things.
chapters.zh: 耶稣出来，见有许多的人，就怜悯他们，因为他们如同羊没有牧人一般，于是开口教训他们许多道理。

chapters.en: By now the hour was already late. So the disciples came to Jesus and said, “This is a desolate place, and the hour is already late.
chapters.zh: 天已经晚了，门徒进前来，说：「这是野地，天已经晚了，

chapters.en: Dismiss the crowd so they can go to the surrounding countryside and villages and buy themselves something to eat.”
chapters.zh: 请叫众人散开，他们好往四面乡村里去，自己买什么吃。」

chapters.en:
But Jesus told them, “You give them something to eat.”
They asked Him, “Should we go out and spend two hundred denarii to give all of them bread to eat?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你们给他们吃吧。」门徒说：「我们可以去买二十两银子的饼给他们吃吗？」

chapters.en:
“Go and see how many loaves you have,” He told them.
And after checking, they said, “Five—and two fish.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们有多少饼，可以去看看。」他们知道了，就说：「五个饼，两条鱼。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus directed them to have the people sit in groups on the green grass.
chapters.zh: 耶稣吩咐他们，叫众人一帮一帮地坐在青草地上。

chapters.en: So they sat down in groups of hundreds and fifties.
chapters.zh: 众人就一排一排地坐下，有一百一排的，有五十一排的。

chapters.en: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, Jesus spoke a blessing and broke the loaves. Then He gave them to His disciples to set before the people. And He divided the two fish among them all.
chapters.zh: 耶稣拿着这五个饼，两条鱼，望着天祝福，擘开饼，递给门徒，摆在众人面前，也把那两条鱼分给众人。

chapters.en: They all ate and were satisfied,
chapters.zh: 他们都吃，并且吃饱了。

chapters.en: and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces of bread and fish.
chapters.zh: 门徒就把碎饼碎鱼收拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。

chapters.en: And there were five thousand men who had eaten the loaves.
chapters.zh: 吃饼的男人共有五千。

chapters.en: Immediately Jesus made His disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of Him to Bethsaida, while He dismissed the crowd.
chapters.zh: 耶稣随即催门徒上船，先渡到那边伯赛大去，等他叫众人散开。

chapters.en: After bidding them farewell, He went up on the mountain to pray.
chapters.zh: 他既辞别了他们，就往山上去祷告。

chapters.en: When evening came, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and Jesus was alone on land.
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，船在海中，耶稣独自在岸上；

chapters.en: He could see that the disciples were straining to row, because the wind was against them. About the fourth watch of the night, Jesus went out to them, walking on the sea. He intended to pass by them,
chapters.zh: 看见门徒因风不顺，摇橹甚苦。夜里约有四更天，就在海面上走，往他们那里去，意思要走过他们去。

chapters.en: but when they saw Him walking on the sea, they cried out, thinking He was a ghost—
chapters.zh: 但门徒看见他在海面上走，以为是鬼怪，就喊叫起来；

chapters.en:
for they all saw Him and were terrified.
But Jesus spoke up at once: “Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.”
chapters.zh: 因为他们都看见了他，且甚惊慌。耶稣连忙对他们说：「你们放心！是我，不要怕！」

chapters.en: Then He climbed into the boat with them, and the wind died down. And the disciples were utterly astounded,
chapters.zh: 于是到他们那里，上了船，风就住了；他们心里十分惊奇。

chapters.en: for they had not understood about the loaves, but their hearts had been hardened.
chapters.zh: 这是因为他们不明白那分饼的事，心里还是愚顽。

chapters.en: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret and moored the boat.
chapters.zh: 既渡过去，来到革尼撒勒地方，就靠了岸，

chapters.en: As soon as they got out of the boat, the people recognized Jesus
chapters.zh: 一下船，众人认得是耶稣，

chapters.en: and ran through that whole region, carrying the sick on mats to wherever they heard He was.
chapters.zh: 就跑遍那一带地方，听见他在何处，便将有病的人用褥子抬到那里。

chapters.en: And wherever He went—villages and towns and countrysides—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged Him just to let them touch the fringe of His cloak. And all who touched Him were healed.
chapters.zh: 凡耶稣所到的地方，或村中，或城里，或乡间，他们都将病人放在街市上，求耶稣只容他们摸他的衣裳繸子；凡摸着的人就都好了。

chapters.en: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes who had come from Jerusalem gathered around Jesus,
chapters.zh: 有法利赛人和几个文士从耶路撒冷来，到耶稣那里聚集。

chapters.en: and they saw some of His disciples eating with hands that were defiled—that is, unwashed.
chapters.zh: 他们曾看见他的门徒中有人用俗手，就是没有洗的手，吃饭。

chapters.en: Now in holding to the tradition of the elders, the Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat until they wash their hands ceremonially.
chapters.zh: （原来法利赛人和犹太人都拘守古人的遗传，若不仔细洗手就不吃饭；

chapters.en: And on returning from the market, they do not eat unless they wash. And there are many other traditions for them to observe, including the washing of cups, pitchers, kettles, and couches for dining.
chapters.zh: 从市上来，若不洗浴也不吃饭；还有好些别的规矩，他们历代拘守，就是洗杯、罐、铜器〔等物〕。）

chapters.en: So the Pharisees and scribes questioned Jesus: “Why do Your disciples not walk according to the tradition of the elders? Instead, they eat with defiled hands.”
chapters.zh: 法利赛人和文士问他说：「你的门徒为什么不照古人的遗传，用俗手吃饭呢？」

chapters.en:
Jesus answered them, “Isaiah prophesied correctly about you hypocrites, as it is written:
‘These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「以赛亚指着你们假冒为善之人所说的预言是不错的。如经上说： 这百姓用嘴唇尊敬我， 心却远离我。

chapters.en: They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’
chapters.zh: 他们将人的吩咐当作道理教导人， 所以拜我也是枉然。

chapters.en: You have disregarded the commandment of God to keep the tradition of men. ”
chapters.zh: 你们是离弃上帝的诫命，拘守人的遗传」；

chapters.en: He went on to say, “You neatly set aside the command of God to maintain your own tradition.
chapters.zh: 又说：「你们诚然是废弃上帝的诫命，要守自己的遗传。

chapters.en: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother’ and ‘Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.’
chapters.zh: 摩西说：『当孝敬父母』；又说：『咒骂父母的，必治死他。』

chapters.en: But you say that if a man says to his father or mother, ‘Whatever you would have received from me is Corban’ (that is, a gift devoted to God),
chapters.zh: 你们倒说：『人若对父母说：我所当奉给你的，已经作了各耳板』（各耳板就是供献的意思），

chapters.en: he is no longer permitted to do anything for his father or mother.
chapters.zh: 以后你们就不容他再奉养父母。

chapters.en: Thus you nullify the word of God by the tradition you have handed down. And you do so in many such matters.”
chapters.zh: 这就是你们承接遗传，废了上帝的道。你们还做许多这样的事。」

chapters.en: Once again Jesus called the crowd to Him and said, “All of you, listen to Me and understand:
chapters.zh: 耶稣又叫众人来，对他们说：「你们都要听我的话，也要明白。

chapters.en: Nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him; but the things that come out of a man, these are what defile him.”
chapters.zh: 从外面进去的不能污秽人，惟有从里面出来的乃能污秽人。」
〔注：有古卷加：16 有耳可听的，就应当听！〕

chapters.en: After Jesus had left the crowd and gone into the house, His disciples inquired about the parable.
chapters.zh: 耶稣离开众人，进了屋子，门徒就问他这比喻的意思。

chapters.en: “Are you still so dull?” He asked. “Do you not understand? Nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him,
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们也是这样不明白吗？岂不晓得凡从外面进入的，不能污秽人，

chapters.en: because it does not enter his heart, but it goes into the stomach and then is eliminated.” (Thus all foods are clean.)
chapters.zh: 因为不是入他的心，乃是入他的肚腹，又落到茅厕里（〔这是说〕，各样的食物都是洁净的）」；

chapters.en: He continued: “What comes out of a man, that is what defiles him.
chapters.zh: 又说：「从人里面出来的，那才能污秽人；

chapters.en: For from within the hearts of men come evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery,
chapters.zh: 因为从里面，就是从人心里，发出恶念、苟合、

chapters.en: greed, wickedness, deceit, debauchery, envy, slander, arrogance, and foolishness.
chapters.zh: 偷盗、凶杀、奸淫、贪婪、邪恶、诡诈、淫荡、嫉妒、谤讟、骄傲、狂妄。

chapters.en: All these evils come from within, and these are what defile a man.”
chapters.zh: 这一切的恶都是从里面出来，且能污秽人。」

chapters.en: Jesus left that place and went to the region of Tyre. Not wanting anyone to know He was there, He entered a house, but was unable to escape their notice.
chapters.zh: 耶稣从那里起身，往泰尔、西顿的境内去，进了一家，不愿意人知道，却隐藏不住。

chapters.en: Instead, a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit soon heard about Jesus, and she came and fell at His feet.
chapters.zh: 当下，有一个妇人，她的小女儿被污鬼附着，听见耶稣的事，就来俯伏在他脚前。

chapters.en: Now she was a Greek woman of Syrophoenician origin, and she kept asking Jesus to drive the demon out of her daughter.
chapters.zh: 这妇人是希腊人，属觜利腓尼基族。她求耶稣赶出那鬼离开她的女儿。

chapters.en: “First let the children have their fill,” He said. “For it is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对她说：「让儿女们先吃饱，不好拿儿女的饼丢给狗吃。」

chapters.en: “Yes, Lord,” she replied, “even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
chapters.zh: 妇人回答说：「主啊，不错；但是狗在桌子底下也吃孩子们的碎渣儿。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus told her, “Because of this answer, you may go. The demon has left your daughter.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对她说：「因这句话，你回去吧；鬼已经离开你的女儿了。」

chapters.en: And she went home and found her child lying on the bed, and the demon was gone.
chapters.zh: 她就回家去，见小孩子躺在床上，鬼已经出去了。

chapters.en: Then Jesus left the region of Tyre and went through Sidon to the Sea of Galilee and into the region of the Decapolis.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又离了泰尔的境界，经过西顿，就从低加坡里境内来到加利利海。

chapters.en: Some people brought to Him a man who was deaf and hardly able to speak, and they begged Jesus to place His hand on him.
chapters.zh: 有人带着一个耳聋舌结的人来见耶稣，求他按手在他身上。

chapters.en: So Jesus took him aside privately, away from the crowd, and put His fingers into the man’s ears. Then He spit and touched the man’s tongue.
chapters.zh: 耶稣领他离开众人，到一边去，就用指头探他的耳朵，吐唾沫抹他的舌头，

chapters.en: And looking up to heaven, He sighed deeply and said to him, “Ephphatha!” (which means, “Be opened!”).
chapters.zh: 望天叹息，对他说：「以法大！」就是说：「开了吧！」

chapters.en: Immediately the man’s ears were opened and his tongue was released, and he began to speak plainly.
chapters.zh: 他的耳朵就开了，舌结也解了，说话也清楚了。

chapters.en: Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone. But the more He ordered them, the more widely they proclaimed it.
chapters.zh: 耶稣嘱咐他们不要告诉人；但他越发嘱咐，他们越发传扬开了。

chapters.en: The people were utterly astonished and said, “He has done all things well! He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”
chapters.zh: 众人分外希奇，说：「他所做的事都好，他连聋子也叫他们听见，哑巴也叫他们说话。」

chapters.en: In those days the crowd once again became very large, and they had nothing to eat. Jesus called the disciples to Him and said,
chapters.zh: 那时，又有许多人聚集，并没有什么吃的。耶稣叫门徒来，说：

chapters.en: “I have compassion for this crowd, because they have already been with Me three days and have nothing to eat.
chapters.zh: 「我怜悯这众人；因为他们同我在这里已经三天，也没有吃的了。

chapters.en: If I send them home hungry, they will faint along the way. For some of them have come a great distance.”
chapters.zh: 我若打发他们饿着回家，就必在路上困乏，因为其中有从远处来的。」

chapters.en: His disciples replied, “Where in this desolate place could anyone find enough bread to feed all these people?”
chapters.zh: 门徒回答说：「在这野地，从哪里能得饼，叫这些人吃饱呢？」

chapters.en:
“How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked.
“Seven,” they replied.
chapters.zh: 耶稣问他们说：「你们有多少饼？」他们说：「七个。」

chapters.en: And He instructed the crowd to sit down on the ground. Then He took the seven loaves, gave thanks and broke them, and gave them to His disciples to set before the people. And they distributed them to the crowd.
chapters.zh: 他吩咐众人坐在地上，就拿着这七个饼祝谢了，擘开，递给门徒，叫他们摆开，门徒就摆在众人面前。

chapters.en: They also had a few small fish, and Jesus blessed them and ordered that these be set before them as well.
chapters.zh: 又有几条小鱼；耶稣祝了福，就吩咐也摆在众人面前。

chapters.en: The people ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
chapters.zh: 众人都吃，并且吃饱了，收拾剩下的零碎，有七筐子。

chapters.en:
And about four thousand men were present.
And when Jesus had dismissed the crowd,
chapters.zh: 人数约有四千。耶稣打发他们走了，

chapters.en: He immediately got into the boat with His disciples and went to the district of Dalmanutha.
chapters.zh: 随即同门徒上船，来到大玛努他境内。

chapters.en: Then the Pharisees came and began to argue with Jesus, testing Him by demanding from Him a sign from heaven.
chapters.zh: 法利赛人出来盘问耶稣，求他从天上显个神迹给他们看，想要试探他。

chapters.en: Jesus sighed deeply in His spirit and said, “Why does this generation demand a sign? Truly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣心里深深地叹息，说：「这世代为什么求神迹呢？我实在告诉你们，没有神迹给这世代看。」

chapters.en: And He left them, got back into the boat, and crossed to the other side.
chapters.zh: 他就离开他们，又上〔船〕往海那边去了。

chapters.en: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, except for one loaf they had with them in the boat.
chapters.zh: 门徒忘了带饼；在船上除了一个饼，没有别的食物。

chapters.en: “Watch out!” He cautioned them. “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of Herod.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣嘱咐他们说：「你们要谨慎，防备法利赛人的酵和希律的酵。」

chapters.en: So they began to discuss with one another the fact that they had no bread.
chapters.zh: 他们彼此议论说：「〔这是因为〕我们没有饼吧。」

chapters.en: Aware of their conversation, Jesus asked them, “Why are you debating about having no bread? Do you still not see or understand? Do you have such hard hearts?
chapters.zh: 耶稣看出来，就说：「你们为什么因为没有饼就议论呢？你们还不省悟，还不明白吗？你们的心还是愚顽吗？

chapters.en: ‘Having eyes, do you not see? And having ears, do you not hear?’ And do you not remember?
chapters.zh: 你们有眼睛，看不见吗？有耳朵，听不见吗？也不记得吗？

chapters.en:
When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many basketfuls of broken pieces did you collect?”
“Twelve,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 我擘开那五个饼分给五千人，你们收拾的零碎装满了多少篮子呢？」他们说：「十二个。」

chapters.en:
“And when I broke the seven loaves for the four thousand, how many basketfuls of broken pieces did you collect?”
“Seven,” they said.
chapters.zh: 「〔又擘开〕那七个饼分给四千人，你们收拾的零碎装满了多少筐子呢？」他们说：「七个。」

chapters.en: Then He asked them, “Do you still not understand?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们还是不明白吗？」

chapters.en: When they arrived at Bethsaida, some people brought a blind man and begged Jesus to touch him.
chapters.zh: 他们来到伯赛大，有人带一个瞎子来，求耶稣摸他。

chapters.en: So He took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the village. Then He spit on the man’s eyes and placed His hands on him. “Can you see anything?” He asked.
chapters.zh: 耶稣拉着瞎子的手，领他到村外，就吐唾沫在他眼睛上，按手在他身上，问他说：「你看见什么了？」

chapters.en: The man looked up and said, “I can see the people, but they look like trees walking around.”
chapters.zh: 他就抬头一看，说：「我看见人了；他们好像树木，并且行走。」

chapters.en: Once again Jesus placed His hands on the man’s eyes, and when he opened them his sight was restored, and he could see everything clearly.
chapters.zh: 随后又按手在他眼睛上，他定睛一看，就复了原，样样都看得清楚了。

chapters.en: Jesus sent him home and said, “Do not go back into the village.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣打发他回家，说：「连这村子你也不要进去。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus and His disciples went on to the villages around Caesarea Philippi. On the way, He questioned His disciples: “Who do people say I am?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣和门徒出去，往凯撒利亚‧腓立比村庄去；在路上问门徒说：「人说我是谁？」

chapters.en: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, one of the prophets.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「〔有人说〕是施洗的约翰；有人说是以利亚；又有人说是先知里的一位。」

chapters.en:
“But what about you?” Jesus asked. “Who do you say I am?”
Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”
chapters.zh: 又问他们说：「你们说我是谁？」彼得回答说：「你是基督。」

chapters.en: And Jesus warned them not to tell anyone about Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就禁戒他们，不要告诉人。

chapters.en: Then He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and that He must be killed and after three days rise again.
chapters.zh: 从此，他教训他们说：「人子必须受许多的苦，被长老、祭司长，和文士弃绝，并且被杀，过三天复活。」

chapters.en: He spoke this message quite frankly, and Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣明明地说这话，彼得就拉着他，劝他。

chapters.en: But Jesus, turning and looking at His disciples, rebuked Peter and said, “Get behind Me, Satan! For you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣转过来，看着门徒，就责备彼得说：「撒但，退我后边去吧！因为你不体贴上帝的意思，只体贴人的意思。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus called the crowd to Him along with His disciples, and He told them, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.
chapters.zh: 于是叫众人和门徒来，对他们说：「若有人要跟从我，就当舍己，背起他的十字架来跟从我。

chapters.en: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake and for the gospel will save it.
chapters.zh: 因为，凡要救自己生命〔注：或译：灵魂；下同〕的，必丧掉生命；凡为我和福音丧掉生命的，必救了生命。

chapters.en: What does it profit a man to gain the whole world, yet forfeit his soul?
chapters.zh: 人就是赚得全世界，赔上自己的生命，有什么益处呢？

chapters.en: Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?
chapters.zh: 人还能拿什么换生命呢？

chapters.en: If anyone is ashamed of Me and My words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will also be ashamed of him when He comes in His Father’s glory with the holy angels.”
chapters.zh: 凡在这淫乱罪恶的世代，把我和我的道当作可耻的，人子在他父的荣耀里，同圣天使降临的时候，也要把那人当作可耻的。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, there are some standing here who will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God arrive with power.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣又对他们说：「我实在告诉你们，站在这里的，有人在没尝死味以前，必要看见上帝的国大有能力临到。」

chapters.en: After six days Jesus took with Him Peter, James, and John, and led them up a high mountain by themselves. There He was transfigured before them.
chapters.zh: 过了六天，耶稣带着彼得、雅各、约翰暗暗地上了高山，就在他们面前变了形像，

chapters.en: His clothes became radiantly white, brighter than any launderer on earth could bleach them.
chapters.zh: 衣服放光，极其洁白，地上漂布的，没有一个能漂得那样白。

chapters.en: And Elijah and Moses appeared before them, talking with Jesus.
chapters.zh: 〔忽然〕，有以利亚同摩西向他们显现，并且和耶稣说话。

chapters.en: Peter said to Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters —one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
chapters.zh: 彼得对耶稣说：「拉比〔注：就是夫子〕，我们在这里真好！可以搭三座棚，一座为你，一座为摩西，一座为以利亚。」

chapters.en: For they were all so terrified that Peter did not know what else to say.
chapters.zh: 彼得不知道说什么才好，因为他们甚是惧怕。

chapters.en: Then a cloud appeared and enveloped them, and a voice came from the cloud: “This is My beloved Son. Listen to Him!”
chapters.zh: 有一朵云彩来遮盖他们；也有声音从云彩里出来，说：「这是我的爱子，你们要听他。」

chapters.en: Suddenly, when they looked around, they saw no one with them except Jesus.
chapters.zh: 门徒忽然周围一看，不再见一人，只见耶稣同他们在那里。

chapters.en: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus admonished them not to tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.
chapters.zh: 下山的时候，耶稣嘱咐他们说：「人子还没有从死里复活，你们不要将所看见的告诉人。」

chapters.en: So they kept this matter to themselves, discussing what it meant to rise from the dead.
chapters.zh: 门徒将这话存记在心，彼此议论「从死里复活」是什么意思。

chapters.en: And they asked Jesus, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
chapters.zh: 他们就问耶稣说：「文士为什么说以利亚必须先来？」

chapters.en: He replied, “Elijah does indeed come first, and he restores all things. Why then is it written that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected?
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「以利亚固然先来复兴万事；〔经上〕不是指着人子说，他要受许多的苦被人轻慢呢？

chapters.en: But I tell you that Elijah has indeed come, and they have done to him whatever they wished, just as it is written about him.”
chapters.zh: 我告诉你们，以利亚已经来了，他们也任意待他，正如〔经上〕所指着他的话。」

chapters.en: When they returned to the other disciples, they saw a large crowd around them, and scribes arguing with them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣到了门徒那里，看见有许多人围着他们，又有文士和他们辩论。

chapters.en: As soon as all the people saw Jesus, they were filled with awe and ran to greet Him.
chapters.zh: 众人一见耶稣，都甚希奇，就跑上去问他的安。

chapters.en: “What are you disputing with them?” He asked.
chapters.zh: 耶稣问他们说：「你们和他们辩论的是什么？」

chapters.en: Someone in the crowd replied, “Teacher, I brought You my son, who has a spirit that makes him mute.
chapters.zh: 众人中间有一个人回答说：「夫子，我带了我的儿子到你这里来，他被哑巴鬼附着。

chapters.en: Whenever it seizes him, it throws him to the ground. He foams at the mouth, gnashes his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked Your disciples to drive it out, but they were unable.”
chapters.zh: 无论在哪里，鬼捉弄他，把他摔倒，他就口中流沫，咬牙切齿，身体枯干。我请过你的门徒把鬼赶出去，他们却是不能。」

chapters.en: “O unbelieving generation!” Jesus replied. “How long must I remain with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring the boy to Me.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「嗳！不信的世代啊，我在你们这里要到几时呢？我忍耐你们要到几时呢？把他带到我这里来吧。」

chapters.en: So they brought him, and seeing Jesus, the spirit immediately threw the boy into a convulsion. He fell to the ground and rolled around, foaming at the mouth.
chapters.zh: 他们就带了他来。他一见耶稣，鬼便叫他重重地抽疯，倒在地上，翻来覆去，口中流沫。

chapters.en:
Jesus asked the boy’s father, “How long has this been with him?”
“From childhood,” he said.
chapters.zh: 耶稣问他父亲说：「他得这病有多少日子呢？」回答说：「从小的时候。

chapters.en: “It often throws him into the fire or into the water, trying to kill him. But if You can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”
chapters.zh: 鬼屡次把他扔在火里、水里，要灭他。你若能做什么，求你怜悯我们，帮助我们。」

chapters.en: “If You can?” echoed Jesus. “All things are possible to him who believes!”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「你若能〔信〕，在信的人，凡事都能。」

chapters.en: Immediately the boy’s father cried out, “I do believe; help my unbelief!”
chapters.zh: 孩子的父亲立时喊着说〔注：有古卷：立时流泪地喊着说〕：「我信！但我信不足，求主帮助。」

chapters.en: When Jesus saw that a crowd had come running, He rebuked the unclean spirit. “You deaf and mute spirit,” He said, “I command you to come out and never enter him again.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣看见众人都跑上来，就斥责那污鬼，说：「你这聋哑的鬼，我吩咐你从他里头出来，再不要进去！」

chapters.en: After shrieking and convulsing him violently, the spirit came out. The boy became like a corpse, so that many said, “He is dead.”
chapters.zh: 那鬼喊叫，使孩子大大地抽了一阵疯，就出来了。〔孩子〕好像死了一般，以致众人多半说：「他是死了。」

chapters.en: But Jesus took him by the hand and helped him to his feet, and he stood up.
chapters.zh: 但耶稣拉着他的手，扶他起来，他就站起来了。

chapters.en: After Jesus had gone into the house, His disciples asked Him privately, “Why couldn’t we drive it out?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣进了屋子，门徒就暗暗地问他说：「我们为什么不能赶出他去呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “This kind cannot come out, except by prayer.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「非用祷告〔注：有古卷加：禁食二字〕，这一类的〔鬼〕总不能出来〔注：或译：不能赶他出来〕。」

chapters.en: Going on from there, they passed through Galilee. But Jesus did not want anyone to know,
chapters.zh: 他们离开那地方，经过加利利；耶稣不愿意人知道。

chapters.en: because He was teaching His disciples. He told them, “The Son of Man will be delivered into the hands of men. They will kill Him, and after three days He will rise.”
chapters.zh: 于是教训门徒，说：「人子将要被交在人手里，他们要杀害他；被杀以后，过三天他要复活。」

chapters.en: But they did not understand this statement, and they were afraid to ask Him about it.
chapters.zh: 门徒却不明白这话，又不敢问他。

chapters.en: Then they came to Capernaum. While Jesus was in the house, He asked them, “What were you discussing on the way?”
chapters.zh: 他们来到迦百农。耶稣在屋里问门徒说：「你们在路上议论的是什么？」

chapters.en: But they were silent, for on the way they had been arguing about which of them was the greatest.
chapters.zh: 门徒不作声，因为他们在路上彼此争论谁为大。

chapters.en: Sitting down, Jesus called the Twelve and said, “If anyone wants to be first, he must be the last of all and the servant of all.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣坐下，叫十二个门徒来，说：「若有人愿意作首先的，他必作众人末后的，作众人的用人。」

chapters.en: Then He had a little child stand among them. Taking the child in His arms, He said to them,
chapters.zh: 于是领过一个小孩子来，叫他站在门徒中间，又抱起他来，对他们说：

chapters.en: “Whoever welcomes one of these little children in My name welcomes Me, and whoever welcomes Me welcomes not only Me, but the One who sent Me.”
chapters.zh: 「凡为我名接待一个像这小孩子的，就是接待我；凡接待我的，不是接待我，乃是接待那差我来的。」

chapters.en: John said to Him, “Teacher, we saw someone else driving out demons in Your name, and we tried to stop him, because he does not accompany us.”
chapters.zh: 约翰对耶稣说：「夫子，我们看见一个人奉你的名赶鬼，我们就禁止他，因为他不跟从我们。」

chapters.en: “Do not stop him,” Jesus replied. “For no one who performs a miracle in My name can turn around and speak evil of Me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「不要禁止他；因为没有人奉我名行异能，反倒轻易毁谤我。

chapters.en: For whoever is not against us is for us.
chapters.zh: 不敌挡我们的，就是帮助我们的。

chapters.en: Indeed, if anyone gives you even a cup of water because you bear the name of Christ, truly I tell you, he will never lose his reward.
chapters.zh: 凡因你们是属基督，给你们一杯水喝的，我实在告诉你们，他不能不得赏赐。」

chapters.en: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be thrown into the sea.
chapters.zh: 「凡使这信我的一个小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在这人的颈项上，扔在海里。

chapters.en: If your hand causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life crippled than to have two hands and go into hell, into the unquenchable fire.
chapters.zh: 倘若你一只手叫你跌倒，就把它砍下来；
你缺了肢体进入〔永〕生，强如有两〔只〕手落到地狱，入那不灭的火里去。

chapters.en: If your foot causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life lame than to have two feet and be thrown into hell.
chapters.zh: 倘若你一只脚叫你跌倒，就把它砍下来；
你瘸腿进入〔永〕生，强如有两只脚被丢在地狱里。

chapters.en: And if your eye causes you to sin, pluck it out. It is better for you to enter the kingdom of God with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell,
chapters.zh: 倘若你一只眼叫你跌倒，就去掉它；你只有一只眼进入上帝的国，强如有两只眼被丢在地狱里。

chapters.en: where ‘their worm never dies, and the fire is never quenched.’
chapters.zh: 在那里，虫是不死的，火是不灭的。

chapters.en: For everyone will be salted with fire.
chapters.zh: 因为必用火当盐醃各人。〔注：有古卷加：凡祭物必用盐醃。〕

chapters.en: Salt is good, but if the salt loses its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt among yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”
chapters.zh: 盐本是好的，若失了味，可用什么叫它再咸呢？你们里头应当有盐，彼此和睦。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus left that place and went into the region of Judea, beyond the Jordan. Again the crowds came to Him and He taught them, as was His custom.
chapters.zh: 耶稣从那里起身，来到犹太的境界并约旦河外。众人又聚集到他那里，他又照常教训他们。

chapters.en: Some Pharisees came to test Him. “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?” they inquired.
chapters.zh: 有法利赛人来问他说：「人休妻可以不可以？」意思要试探他。

chapters.en: “What did Moses command you?” He replied.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「摩西吩咐你们的是什么？」

chapters.en: They answered, “Moses permitted a man to write his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「摩西许人写了休书便可以休妻。」

chapters.en: But Jesus told them, “Moses wrote this commandment for you because of your hardness of heart.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「摩西因为你们的心硬，所以写这条例给你们；

chapters.en: However, from the beginning of creation, ‘God made them male and female.’
chapters.zh: 但从起初创造的时候，上帝造人是造男造女。

chapters.en: ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife,
chapters.zh: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

chapters.en: and the two will become one flesh.’ So they are no longer two, but one flesh.
chapters.zh: 既然如此，夫妻不再是两个人，乃是一体的了。

chapters.en: Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.”
chapters.zh: 所以，上帝配合的，人不可分开。」

chapters.en: When they were back inside the house, the disciples asked Jesus about this matter.
chapters.zh: 到了屋里，门徒就问他这事。

chapters.en: So He told them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「凡休妻另娶的，就是犯奸淫，辜负他的妻子；

chapters.en: And if a woman divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.”
chapters.zh: 妻子若离弃丈夫另嫁，也是犯奸淫了。」

chapters.en: Now people were bringing the little children to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them, and the disciples rebuked those who brought them.
chapters.zh: 有人带着小孩子来见耶稣，要耶稣摸他们，门徒便责备那些人。

chapters.en: But when Jesus saw this, He was indignant and told them, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
chapters.zh: 耶稣看见就恼怒，对门徒说：「让小孩子到我这里来，不要禁止他们；因为在上帝国的，正是这样的人。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，凡要承受上帝国的，若不像小孩子，断不能进去。」

chapters.en: And He took the children in His arms, placed His hands on them, and blessed them.
chapters.zh: 于是抱着小孩子，给他们按手，为他们祝福。

chapters.en: As Jesus started on His way, a man ran up and knelt before Him. “Good Teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to inherit eternal life?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣出来行路的时候，有一个人跑来，跪在他面前，问他说：「良善的夫子，我当做什么事才可以承受永生？」

chapters.en: “Why do you call Me good?” Jesus replied. “No one is good except God alone.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「你为什么称我是良善的？除了上帝一位之外，再没有良善的。

chapters.en: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness, do not cheat others, honor your father and mother.’ ”
chapters.zh: 诫命你是晓得的：不可杀人；不可奸淫；不可偷盗；不可作假见证；不可亏负人；当孝敬父母。」

chapters.en: “Teacher,” he replied, “all these I have kept from my youth.”
chapters.zh: 他对耶稣说：「夫子，这一切我从小都遵守了。」

chapters.en: Jesus looked at him, loved him, and said to him, “There is one thing you lack: Go, sell everything you own and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me. ”
chapters.zh: 耶稣看着他，就爱他，对他说：「你还缺少一件：去变卖你所有的，分给穷人，就必有财宝在天上；你还要来跟从我。」

chapters.en: But the man was saddened by these words and went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.
chapters.zh: 他听见这话，脸上就变了色，忧忧愁愁地走了，因为他的产业很多。

chapters.en: Then Jesus looked around and said to His disciples, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!”
chapters.zh: 耶稣周围一看，对门徒说：「有钱财的人进上帝的国是何等地难哪！」

chapters.en:
And the disciples were amazed at His words.
But Jesus said to them again, “Children, how hard it is to enter the kingdom of God!
chapters.zh: 门徒希奇他的话。耶稣又对他们说：「小子，倚靠钱财的人进上帝的国是何等地难哪！

chapters.en: It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
chapters.zh: 骆驼穿过针的眼，比财主进上帝的国还容易呢。」

chapters.en: They were even more astonished and said to one another, “Who then can be saved?”
chapters.zh: 门徒就分外希奇，对他说：「这样谁能得救呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but not with God. For all things are possible with God.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣看着他们，说：「在人是不能，在上帝却不然，因为上帝凡事都能。」

chapters.en: Peter began to say to Him, “Look, we have left everything and followed You.”
chapters.zh: 彼得就对他说：「看哪，我们已经撇下所有的跟从你了。」

chapters.en: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “no one who has left home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for My sake and for the gospel
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我实在告诉你们，人为我和福音撇下房屋，或是弟兄、姊妹、父母、儿女、田地，

chapters.en: will fail to receive a hundredfold in the present age—houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and fields, along with persecutions—and in the age to come, eternal life.
chapters.zh: 没有不在今世得百倍的，就是房屋、弟兄、姊妹、母亲、儿女、田地，并且要受逼迫，在来世必得永生。

chapters.en: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.”
chapters.zh: 然而，有许多在前的，将要在后，在后的，将要在前。」

chapters.en: As they were going up the road to Jerusalem, Jesus was walking ahead of them. The disciples were amazed, but those who followed were afraid. Again Jesus took the Twelve aside and began to tell them what was going to happen to Him:
chapters.zh: 他们行路上耶路撒冷去。耶稣在前头走，门徒就希奇，跟从的人也害怕。耶稣又叫过十二个门徒来，把自己将要遭遇的事告诉他们说：

chapters.en: “Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and scribes. They will condemn Him to death and will deliver Him over to the Gentiles,
chapters.zh: 「看哪，我们上耶路撒冷去，人子将要被交给祭司长和文士，他们要定他死罪，交给外邦人。

chapters.en: who will mock Him and spit on Him and flog Him and kill Him. And after three days He will rise again.”
chapters.zh: 他们要戏弄他，吐唾沫在他脸上，鞭打他，杀害他。过了三天，他要复活。」

chapters.en: Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to Jesus and declared, “Teacher, we want You to do for us whatever we ask.”
chapters.zh: 西庇太的儿子雅各、约翰进前来，对耶稣说：「夫子，我们无论求你什么，愿你给我们做。」

chapters.en: “What do you want Me to do for you?” He inquired.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「要我给你们做什么？」

chapters.en: They answered, “Grant that one of us may sit at Your right hand and the other at Your left in Your glory.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「赐我们在你的荣耀里，一个坐在你右边，一个坐在你左边。」

chapters.en: “You do not know what you are asking,” Jesus replied. “Can you drink the cup I will drink, or be baptized with the baptism I will undergo?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们不知道所求的是什么。我所喝的杯，你们能喝吗？我所受的洗，你们能受吗？」

chapters.en:
“We can,” the brothers answered.
“You will drink the cup that I drink,” Jesus said, “and you will be baptized with the baptism that I undergo.
chapters.zh: 他们说：「我们能。」耶稣说：「我所喝的杯，你们也要喝；我所受的洗，你们也要受；

chapters.en: But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to grant. These seats belong to those for whom they have been prepared.”
chapters.zh: 只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以赐的，乃是为谁预备的，就赐给谁。」

chapters.en: When the ten heard about this, they became indignant with James and John.
chapters.zh: 那十个门徒听见，就恼怒雅各、约翰。

chapters.en: So Jesus called them together and said, “You know that those regarded as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their superiors exercise authority over them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣叫他们来，对他们说：「你们知道，外邦人有尊为君王的，治理他们，有大臣操权管束他们。

chapters.en: But it shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
chapters.zh: 只是在你们中间，不是这样。你们中间，谁愿为大，就必作你们的用人；

chapters.en: and whoever wants to be first must be the slave of all.
chapters.zh: 在你们中间，谁愿为首，就必作众人的仆人。

chapters.en: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.”
chapters.zh: 因为人子来，并不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，并且要舍命作多人的赎价。」

chapters.en: Next, they came to Jericho. And as Jesus and His disciples were leaving Jericho with a large crowd, a blind beggar named Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, was sitting beside the road.
chapters.zh: 到了耶利哥；耶稣同门徒并许多人出耶利哥的时候，有一个讨饭的瞎子，是底买的儿子巴底买，坐在路旁。

chapters.en: When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”
chapters.zh: 他听见是拿撒勒的耶稣，就喊着说：「大卫的子孙耶稣啊！可怜我吧！」

chapters.en: Many people admonished him to be silent, but he cried out all the louder, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”
chapters.zh: 有许多人责备他，不许他作声。他却越发大声喊着说：「大卫的子孙哪，可怜我吧！」

chapters.en:
Jesus stopped and said, “Call him.”
So they called the blind man. “Take courage!” they said. “Get up! He is calling for you.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣就站住，说：「叫过他来。」他们就叫那瞎子，对他说：「放心，起来！他叫你啦。」

chapters.en: Throwing off his cloak, Bartimaeus jumped up and came to Jesus.
chapters.zh: 瞎子就丢下衣服，跳起来，走到耶稣那里。

chapters.en:
“What do you want Me to do for you?” Jesus asked.
“Rabboni,” said the blind man, “let me see again.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「要我为你做什么？」瞎子说：「拉波尼〔注：就是夫子〕，我要能看见。」

chapters.en: “Go,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you.” And immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus along the road.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你去吧！你的信救了你了。」瞎子立刻看见了，就在路上跟随耶稣。

chapters.en: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent out two of His disciples
chapters.zh: 耶稣和门徒将近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其和伯大尼，在橄榄山那里；耶稣就打发两个门徒，
