chapters.en: and said to them, “Go into the village ahead of you, and as soon as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, on which no one has ever sat. Untie it and bring it here.
chapters.zh: 对他们说：「你们往对面村子里去，一进去的时候，必看见一匹驴驹拴在那里，是从来没有人骑过的，可以解开，牵来。

chapters.en: If anyone asks, ‘Why are you doing this?’ tell him, ‘The Lord needs it and will return it shortly.’”
chapters.zh: 若有人对你们说：『为什么做这事？』你们就说：『主要用牠。』那人必立时让你们牵来。」

chapters.en: So they went and found the colt outside in the street, tied at a doorway. They untied it,
chapters.zh: 他们去了，便看见一匹驴驹拴在门外街道上，就把牠解开。

chapters.en: and some who were standing there asked, “Why are you untying the colt?”
chapters.zh: 在那里站着的人，有几个说：「你们解驴驹做什么？」

chapters.en: The disciples answered as Jesus had instructed them, and the people gave them permission.
chapters.zh: 门徒照着耶稣所说的回答，那些人就任凭他们牵去了。

chapters.en: Then they led the colt to Jesus and threw their cloaks over it, and He sat on it.
chapters.zh: 他们把驴驹牵到耶稣那里，把自己的衣服搭在上面，耶稣就骑上。

chapters.en: Many in the crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others spread branches they had cut from the fields.
chapters.zh: 有许多人把衣服铺在路上，也有人把田间的树枝砍下来，铺在路上。

chapters.en:
The ones who went ahead and those who followed were shouting:
“Hosanna!”
“Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!”
chapters.zh: 前行后随的人都喊着说： 和散那〔注：和散那：原有求救的意思，在此乃是称颂的话〕！ 奉主名来的是应当称颂的！

chapters.en:
“Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David!”
“Hosanna in the highest!”
chapters.zh: 那将要来的我祖大卫之国是应当称颂的！ 高高在上和散那！

chapters.en: Then Jesus entered Jerusalem and went into the temple courts. He looked around at everything, but since it was already late, He went out to Bethany with the Twelve.
chapters.zh: 耶稣进了耶路撒冷，入了〔圣〕殿，周围看了各样物件。天色已晚，就和十二个门徒出城，往伯大尼去了。

chapters.en: The next day, when they had left Bethany, Jesus was hungry.
chapters.zh: 第二天，他们从伯大尼出来，耶稣饿了。

chapters.en: Seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf, He went to see if there was any fruit on it. But when He reached it, He found nothing on it except leaves, since it was not the season for figs.
chapters.zh: 远远地看见一棵无花果树，树上有叶子，就往那里去，或者在树上可以找着什么。到了树下，竟找不着什么，不过有叶子，因为不是收无花果的时候。

chapters.en: Then He said to the tree, “May no one ever eat of your fruit again.” And His disciples heard this statement.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就对树说：「从今以后，永没有人吃你的果子。」他的门徒也听见了。

chapters.en: When they arrived in Jerusalem, Jesus entered the temple courts and began to drive out those who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling doves.
chapters.zh: 他们来到耶路撒冷。耶稣进入〔圣〕殿，赶出殿里做买卖的人，推倒兑换银钱之人的桌子和卖鸽子之人的凳子；

chapters.en: And He would not allow anyone to carry merchandise through the temple courts.
chapters.zh: 也不许人拿着器具从殿里经过；

chapters.en: Then Jesus began to teach them, and He declared, “Is it not written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’ ? But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’ ”
chapters.zh: 便教训他们说：「〔经上〕不是记着说： 我的殿必称为万国祷告的殿吗？ 你们倒使它成为贼窝了。」

chapters.en: When the chief priests and scribes heard this, they looked for a way to kill Him. For they were afraid of Him, because the whole crowd was astonished at His teaching.
chapters.zh: 祭司长和文士听见这话，就想法子要除灭耶稣，却又怕他，因为众人都希奇他的教训。

chapters.en: And when evening came, Jesus and His disciples went out of the city.
chapters.zh: 每天晚上，耶稣出城去。

chapters.en: As they were walking back in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered from its roots.
chapters.zh: 早晨，他们从那里经过，看见无花果树连根都枯干了。

chapters.en: Peter remembered it and said, “Look, Rabbi! The fig tree You cursed has withered.”
chapters.zh: 彼得想起耶稣的话来，就对他说：「拉比，请看！你所咒诅的无花果树已经枯干了。」

chapters.en: “Have faith in God,” Jesus said to them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你们当信服上帝。

chapters.en: “Truly I tell you that if anyone says to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ and has no doubt in his heart but believes that it will happen, it will be done for him.
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，无论何人对这座山说：『你挪开此地，投在海里！』他若心里不疑惑，只信他所说的必成，就必给他成了。

chapters.en: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
chapters.zh: 所以我告诉你们，凡你们祷告祈求的，无论是什么，只要信是得着的，就必得着。

chapters.en: And when you stand to pray, if you hold anything against another, forgive it, so that your Father in heaven will forgive your trespasses as well. ”
chapters.zh: 你们站着祷告的时候，若想起有人得罪你们，就当饶恕他，好叫你们在天上的父也饶恕你们的过犯。
你们若不饶恕人，你们在天上的父也不饶恕你们的过犯。〔注：有古卷无此节〕」

chapters.en: After their return to Jerusalem, Jesus was walking in the temple courts, and the chief priests, scribes, and elders came up to Him.
chapters.zh: 他们又来到耶路撒冷。耶稣在殿里行走的时候，祭司长和文士并长老进前来，

chapters.en: “By what authority are You doing these things?” they asked. “And who gave You the authority to do them?”
chapters.zh: 问他说：「你仗着什么权柄做这些事？给你这权柄的是谁呢？」

chapters.en: “I will ask you one question,” Jesus replied, “and if you answer Me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「我要问你们一句话，你们回答我，我就告诉你们我仗着什么权柄做这些事。

chapters.en: John’s baptism—was it from heaven or from men? Answer Me!”
chapters.zh: 约翰的洗礼是从天上来的？是从人间来的呢？你们可以回答我。」

chapters.en: They deliberated among themselves what they should answer: “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
chapters.zh: 他们彼此商议说：「我们若说『从天上来』，他必说：『这样，你们为什么不信他呢？』

chapters.en: But if we say, ‘From men’...” they were afraid of the people, for they all held that John truly was a prophet.
chapters.zh: 若说『从人间来』，却又怕百姓，因为众人真以约翰为先知。」

chapters.en:
So they answered, “We do not know.”
And Jesus replied, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.”
chapters.zh: 于是回答耶稣说：「我们不知道。」耶稣说：「我也不告诉你们我仗着什么权柄做这些事。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus began to speak to them in parables: “A man planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a wine vat, and built a watchtower. Then he rented it out to some tenants and went away on a journey.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就用比喻对他们说：「有人栽了一个葡萄园，周围圈上篱笆，挖了一个压酒池，盖了一座楼，租给园户，就往外国去了。

chapters.en: At harvest time, he sent a servant to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard.
chapters.zh: 到了时候，打发一个仆人到园户那里，要从园户收葡萄园的果子。

chapters.en: But they seized the servant, beat him, and sent him away empty-handed.
chapters.zh: 园户拿住他，打了他，叫他空手回去。

chapters.en: Then he sent them another servant, and they struck him over the head and treated him shamefully.
chapters.zh: 再打发一个仆人到他们那里。他们打伤他的头，并且凌辱他。

chapters.en:
He sent still another, and this one they killed.
He sent many others; some they beat and others they killed.
chapters.zh: 又打发一个仆人去，他们就杀了他。后又打发好些仆人去，有被他们打的，有被他们杀的。

chapters.en: Finally, having one beloved son, he sent him to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.
chapters.zh: 园主还有一位是他的爱子，末后又打发他去，〔意思〕说：『他们必尊敬我的儿子。』

chapters.en: But the tenants said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
chapters.zh: 不料，那些园户彼此说：『这是承受产业的。来吧，我们杀他，产业就归我们了！』

chapters.en: So they seized the son, killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.
chapters.zh: 于是拿住他，杀了他，把他丢在园外。

chapters.en: What then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others.
chapters.zh: 这样，葡萄园的主人要怎么办呢？他要来除灭那些园户，将葡萄园转给别人。

chapters.en:
Have you never read this Scripture:
‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
chapters.zh: 〔经上写着说〕： 匠人所弃的石头 已作了房角的头块石头。

chapters.en: This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’ ?”
chapters.zh: 这是主所做的， 在我们眼中看为希奇。 这经你们没有念过吗？」

chapters.en: At this, the leaders sought to arrest Jesus, for they knew that He had spoken this parable against them. But fearing the crowd, they left Him and went away.
chapters.zh: 他们看出这比喻是指着他们说的，就想要捉拿他，只是惧怕百姓，于是离开他走了。

chapters.en: Later, they sent some of the Pharisees and Herodians to catch Jesus in His words.
chapters.zh: 后来，他们打发几个法利赛人和几个希律党的人到耶稣那里，要就着他的话陷害他。

chapters.en: “Teacher,” they said, “we know that You are honest and seek favor from no one. Indeed, You are impartial and teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not? Should we pay them or not?”
chapters.zh: 他们来了，就对他说：「夫子，我们知道你是诚实的，什么人你都不徇情面；因为你不看人的外貌，乃是诚诚实实传上帝的道。纳税给凯撒可以不可以？

chapters.en: But Jesus saw through their hypocrisy and said, “Why are you testing Me? Bring Me a denarius to inspect.”
chapters.zh: 我们该纳不该纳？」耶稣知道他们的假意，就对他们说：「你们为什么试探我？拿一个银钱来给我看！」

chapters.en:
So they brought it, and He asked them, “Whose image is this? And whose inscription?”
“Caesar’s,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 他们就拿了来。耶稣说：「这像和这号是谁的？」他们说：「是凯撒的。」

chapters.en:
Then Jesus told them, “Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”
And they marveled at Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「凯撒的物当归给凯撒，上帝的物当归给上帝。」他们就很希奇他。

chapters.en: Then the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus and questioned Him:
chapters.zh: 撒都该人常说没有复活的事。他们来问耶稣说：

chapters.en: “Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man is to marry his brother’s widow and raise up offspring for him.
chapters.zh: 「夫子，摩西为我们写着说：『人若死了，撇下妻子，没有孩子，他兄弟当娶他的妻，为哥哥生子立后。』

chapters.en: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married and died, leaving no children.
chapters.zh: 有弟兄七人，第一个娶了妻，死了，没有留下孩子。

chapters.en: Then the second one married the widow, but he also died and left no children. And the third did likewise.
chapters.zh: 第二个娶了她，也死了，没有留下孩子。第三个也是这样。

chapters.en: In this way, none of the seven left any children. And last of all, the woman died.
chapters.zh: 那七个人都没有留下孩子；末了，那妇人也死了。

chapters.en: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her.”
chapters.zh: 当复活的时候，她是哪一个的妻子呢？因为他们七个人都娶过她。」

chapters.en: Jesus said to them, “Aren’t you mistaken, because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God?
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们所以错了，岂不是因为不明白圣经，不晓得上帝的大能吗？

chapters.en: When the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.
chapters.zh: 人从死里复活，也不娶也不嫁，乃像天上的使者一样。

chapters.en: But concerning the dead rising, have you not read about the burning bush in the Book of Moses, how God told him, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’ ?
chapters.zh: 论到死人复活，你们没有念过摩西的书荆棘篇上〔所载的〕吗？上帝对摩西说：『我是亚伯拉罕的上帝，以撒的上帝，雅各的上帝。』

chapters.en: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are badly mistaken!”
chapters.zh: 上帝不是死人的上帝，乃是活人的上帝。你们是大错了。」

chapters.en: Now one of the scribes had come up and heard their debate. Noticing how well Jesus had answered them, he asked Him, “Which commandment is the most important of all?”
chapters.zh: 有一个文士来，听见他们辩论，晓得耶稣回答的好，就问他说：「诫命中哪是第一〔要紧的〕呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “This is the most important: ‘Hear O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is One.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「第一〔要紧的〕就是说：『以色列啊，你要听，主－我们上帝是独一的主。

chapters.en: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.’
chapters.zh: 你要尽心、尽性、尽意、尽力爱主－你的上帝。』

chapters.en: The second is this: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’ No other commandment is greater than these.”
chapters.zh: 其次就是说：『要爱人如己。』再没有比这两条诫命更大的了。」

chapters.en: “Right, Teacher,” the scribe replied. “You have stated correctly that God is One and there is no other but Him,
chapters.zh: 那文士对耶稣说：「夫子说，上帝是一位，实在不错；除了他以外，再没有别的上帝；

chapters.en: and to love Him with all your heart and with all your understanding and with all your strength, and to love your neighbor as yourself. This is more important than all burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
chapters.zh: 并且尽心、尽智、尽力爱他，又爱人如己，就比一切燔祭和各样祭祀好的多。」

chapters.en:
When Jesus saw that the man had answered wisely, He said, “You are not far from the kingdom of God.”
And no one dared to question Him any further.
chapters.zh: 耶稣见他回答的有智慧，就对他说：「你离上帝的国不远了。」从此以后，没有人敢再问他什么。

chapters.en: While Jesus was teaching in the temple courts, He asked, “How can the scribes say that the Christ is the Son of David?
chapters.zh: 耶稣在殿里教训人，就问他们说：「文士怎么说基督是大卫的子孙呢？

chapters.en:
Speaking by the Holy Spirit, David himself declared:
‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I put Your enemies under Your feet.”’
chapters.zh: 大卫被圣灵感动，说： 主对我主说： 你坐在我的右边， 等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。

chapters.en:
David himself calls Him ‘Lord.’ So how can He be David’s son?”
And the large crowd listened to Him with delight.
chapters.zh: 大卫既自己称他为主，他怎么又是大卫的子孙呢？」众人都喜欢听他。

chapters.en: In His teaching Jesus also said, “Watch out for the scribes. They like to walk around in long robes, to receive greetings in the marketplaces,
chapters.zh: 耶稣在教训之间，说：「你们要防备文士；他们好穿长衣游行，喜爱人在街市上问他们的安，

chapters.en: and to have the chief seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.
chapters.zh: 又喜爱会堂里的高位，筵席上的首座。

chapters.en: They defraud widows of their houses, and for a show make lengthy prayers. These men will receive greater condemnation.”
chapters.zh: 他们侵吞寡妇的家产，假意作很长的祷告。这些人要受更重的刑罚！」

chapters.en: As Jesus was sitting opposite the treasury, He watched the crowd putting money into it. And many rich people put in large amounts.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对银库坐着，看众人怎样投钱入库。有好些财主往里投了若干的钱。

chapters.en: Then one poor widow came and put in two small copper coins, which amounted to a small fraction of a denarius.
chapters.zh: 有一个穷寡妇来，往里投了两个小钱，就是一个大钱。

chapters.en: Jesus called His disciples to Him and said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow has put more than all the others into the treasury.
chapters.zh: 耶稣叫门徒来，说：「我实在告诉你们，这穷寡妇投入库里的，比众人所投的更多。

chapters.en: For they all contributed out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.”
chapters.zh: 因为，他们都是自己有余，拿出来投在里头；但这寡妇是自己不足，把她一切养生的都投上了。」

chapters.en: As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of His disciples said to Him, “Teacher, look at the magnificent stones and buildings!”
chapters.zh: 耶稣从殿里出来的时候，有一个门徒对他说：「夫子，请看，这是何等的石头！何等的殿宇！」

chapters.en: “Do you see all these great buildings?” Jesus replied. “Not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「你看见这大殿宇吗？将来在这里没有一块石头留在石头上，不被拆毁了。」

chapters.en: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked Him privately,
chapters.zh: 耶稣在橄榄山上对〔圣〕殿而坐。彼得、雅各、约翰，和安得烈暗暗地问他说：

chapters.en: “Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to be fulfilled?”
chapters.zh: 「请告诉我们，什么时候有这些事呢？这一切事将成的时候有什么预兆呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus began by telling them, “See to it that no one deceives you.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们要谨慎，免得有人迷惑你们。

chapters.en: Many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and will deceive many.
chapters.zh: 将来有好些人冒我的名来，说：『我是〔基督〕』，并且要迷惑许多人。

chapters.en: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.
chapters.zh: 你们听见打仗和打仗的风声，不要惊慌。〔这些事〕是必须有的，只是末期还没有到。

chapters.en: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, as well as famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.
chapters.zh: 民要攻打民，国要攻打国；多处必有地震、饥荒。这都是灾难〔注：灾难：原文是生产之难〕的起头。

chapters.en: So be on your guard. You will be delivered over to the councils and beaten in the synagogues. On My account you will stand before governors and kings as witnesses to them.
chapters.zh: 但你们要谨慎；因为人要把你们交给公会，并且你们在会堂里要受鞭打，又为我的缘故站在诸侯与君王面前，对他们作见证。

chapters.en: And the gospel must first be proclaimed to all the nations.
chapters.zh: 然而，福音必须先传给万民。

chapters.en: But when they arrest you and hand you over, do not worry beforehand what to say. Instead, speak whatever you are given at that time, for it will not be you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.
chapters.zh: 人把你们拉去交官的时候，不要预先思虑说什么；到那时候，赐给你们什么话，你们就说什么；因为说话的不是你们，乃是圣灵。

chapters.en: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.
chapters.zh: 弟兄要把弟兄，父亲要把儿子，送到死地；儿女要起来与父母为敌，害死他们；

chapters.en: You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
chapters.zh: 并且你们要为我的名被众人恨恶。惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。」

chapters.en: So when you see the abomination of desolation standing where it should not be (let the reader understand), then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
chapters.zh: 「你们看见那行毁坏可憎的，站在不当站的地方（读〔这经〕的人须要会意）。那时，在犹太的，应当逃到山上；

chapters.en: Let no one on the housetop go back inside to retrieve anything from his house.
chapters.zh: 在房上的，不要下来，也不要进去拿家里的东西；

chapters.en: And let no one in the field return for his cloak.
chapters.zh: 在田里的，也不要回去取衣裳。

chapters.en: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!
chapters.zh: 当那些日子，怀孕的和奶孩子的有祸了！

chapters.en: Pray that this will not occur in the winter.
chapters.zh: 你们应当祈求，叫这些事不在冬天临到。

chapters.en: For those will be days of tribulation unseen from the beginning of God’s creation until now, and never to be seen again.
chapters.zh: 因为在那些日子必有灾难，自从上帝创造万物直到如今，并没有这样的灾难，后来也必没有。

chapters.en: If the Lord had not cut short those days, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, whom He has chosen, He has cut them short.
chapters.zh: 若不是主减少那日子，凡有血气的，总没有一个得救的；只是为主的选民，他将那日子减少了。

chapters.en: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.
chapters.zh: 那时若有人对你们说：『看哪，基督在这里』，或说：『基督在那里』，你们不要信！

chapters.en: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders to deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
chapters.zh: 因为假基督、假先知将要起来，显神迹奇事，倘若能行，就把选民迷惑了。

chapters.en: So be on your guard; I have told you everything in advance.
chapters.zh: 你们要谨慎。看哪，凡事我都预先告诉你们了。」

chapters.en:
But in those days, after that tribulation:
‘The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light;
chapters.zh: 「在那些日子，那灾难以后， 日头要变黑了， 月亮也不放光，

chapters.en: the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.’
chapters.zh: 众星要从天上坠落， 天势都要震动。

chapters.en: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
chapters.zh: 那时，他们〔注：马太二十四章三十节是地上的万族〕要看见人子有大能力、大荣耀，驾云降临。

chapters.en: And He will send out the angels to gather His elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of heaven.
chapters.zh: 他要差遣天使，把他的选民，从四方〔注：方：原文是风〕，从地极直到天边，都招聚了来。」

chapters.en: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.
chapters.zh: 「你们可以从无花果树学个比方：当树枝发嫩长叶的时候，你们就知道夏天近了。

chapters.en: So also, when you see these things happening, know that He is near, right at the door.
chapters.zh: 这样，你们几时看见这些事成就，也该知道人子〔注：人子：或译上帝的国〕近了，正在门口了。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，这世代还没有过去，这些事都要成就。

chapters.en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
chapters.zh: 天地要废去，我的话却不能废去。」

chapters.en: No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
chapters.zh: 「但那日子，那时辰，没有人知道，连天上的使者也不知道，子也不知道，惟有父知道。

chapters.en: Be on your guard and stay alert! For you do not know when the appointed time will come.
chapters.zh: 你们要谨慎，警醒祈祷，因为你们不晓得那日期几时来到。

chapters.en: It is like a man going on a journey who left his house, put each servant in charge of his own task, and instructed the doorkeeper to keep watch.
chapters.zh: 这事正如一个人离开本家，寄居外邦，把权柄交给仆人，分派各人当做的工，又吩咐看门的警醒。

chapters.en: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know when the master of the house will return—whether in the evening, at midnight, when the rooster crows, or in the morning.
chapters.zh: 所以，你们要警醒；因为你们不知道家主什么时候来，或晚上，或半夜，或鸡叫，或早晨；

chapters.en: Otherwise, he may arrive without notice and find you sleeping.
chapters.zh: 恐怕他忽然来到，看见你们睡着了。

chapters.en: And what I say to you, I say to everyone: Keep watch!”
chapters.zh: 我对你们所说的话，也是对众人说：要警醒！」

chapters.en: Now the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread were two days away, and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a covert way to arrest Jesus and kill Him.
chapters.zh: 过两天是逾越〔节〕，又是除酵节，祭司长和文士想法子怎么用诡计捉拿耶稣，杀他。

chapters.en: “But not during the feast,” they said, “or there may be a riot among the people.”
chapters.zh: 只是说：「当节的日子不可，恐怕百姓生乱。」

chapters.en: While Jesus was in Bethany reclining at the table in the home of Simon the Leper, a woman came with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume, made of pure nard. She broke open the jar and poured it on Jesus’ head.
chapters.zh: 耶稣在伯大尼长大痲疯的西门家里坐席的时候，有一个女人拿着一玉瓶至贵的真哪哒香膏来，打破玉瓶，把膏浇在耶稣的头上。

chapters.en: Some of those present, however, expressed their indignation to one another: “Why this waste of perfume?
chapters.zh: 有几个人心中很不喜悦，说：「何用这样枉费香膏呢？

chapters.en: It could have been sold for over three hundred denarii and the money given to the poor.” And they scolded her.
chapters.zh: 这香膏可以卖三十多两银子赒济穷人。」他们就向那女人生气。

chapters.en: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone; why are you bothering her? She has done a beautiful deed to Me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「由她吧！为什么难为她呢？她在我身上做的是一件美事。

chapters.en: The poor you will always have with you, and you can help them whenever you want. But you will not always have Me.
chapters.zh: 因为常有穷人和你们同在，要向他们行善随时都可以；只是你们不常有我。

chapters.en: She has done what she could to anoint My body in advance of My burial.
chapters.zh: 她所做的，是尽她所能的；她是为我安葬的事把香膏预先浇在我身上。

chapters.en: And truly I tell you, wherever the gospel is preached in all the world, what she has done will also be told in memory of her.”
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，普天之下，无论在什么地方传这福音，也要述说这女人所做的，以为记念。」

chapters.en: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests to betray Jesus to them.
chapters.zh: 十二门徒之中，有一个加略人犹大去见祭司长，要把耶稣交给他们。

chapters.en:
They were delighted to hear this, and they promised to give him money.
So Judas began to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus.
chapters.zh: 他们听见就欢喜，又应许给他银子；他就寻思如何得便把耶稣交给他们。

chapters.en: On the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread, when the Passover lamb was to be sacrificed, Jesus’ disciples asked Him, “Where do You want us to prepare for You to eat the Passover?”
chapters.zh: 除酵节的第一天，就是宰逾越〔羊羔〕的那一天，门徒对耶稣说：「你吃逾越〔节的筵席〕要我们往哪里去预备呢？」

chapters.en: So He sent two of His disciples and told them, “Go into the city, and a man carrying a jug of water will meet you. Follow him,
chapters.zh: 耶稣就打发两个门徒，对他们说：「你们进城去，必有人拿着一瓶水迎面而来，你们就跟着他。

chapters.en: and whichever house he enters, say to the owner, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is My guest room, where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?’
chapters.zh: 他进哪家去，你们就对那家的主人说：『夫子说：客房在哪里？我与门徒好在那里吃逾越〔节的筵席〕。』

chapters.en: And he will show you a large upper room, furnished and ready. Make preparations for us there.”
chapters.zh: 他必指给你们摆设整齐的一间大楼，你们就在那里为我们预备。」

chapters.en: So the disciples left and went into the city, where they found everything as Jesus had described. And they prepared the Passover.
chapters.zh: 门徒出去，进了城，所遇见的正如耶稣所说的。他们就预备了逾越〔节的筵席〕。

chapters.en: When evening came, Jesus arrived with the Twelve.
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，耶稣和十二个门徒都来了。

chapters.en: And while they were reclining and eating, Jesus said, “Truly I tell you, one of you who is eating with Me will betray Me.”
chapters.zh: 他们坐席正吃的时候，耶稣说：「我实在告诉你们，你们中间有一个与我同吃的人要卖我了。」

chapters.en: They began to be grieved and to ask Him one after another, “Surely not I?”
chapters.zh: 他们就忧愁起来，一个一个地问他说：「是我吗？」

chapters.en: He answered, “It is one of the Twelve—the one who is dipping his hand into the bowl with Me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「是十二个门徒中同我蘸手在盘子里的那个人。

chapters.en: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed! It would be better for him if he had not been born.”
chapters.zh: 人子必要去世，正如〔经上〕指着他所写的；但卖人子的人有祸了！那人不生在世上倒好。」

chapters.en: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, spoke a blessing and broke it, and gave it to the disciples, saying, “Take it; this is My body.”
chapters.zh: 他们吃的时候，耶稣拿起饼来，祝了福，就擘开，递给他们，说：「你们拿着吃，这是我的身体」；

chapters.en: Then He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave it to them, and they all drank from it.
chapters.zh: 又拿起杯来，祝谢了，递给他们；他们都喝了。

chapters.en: He said to them, “This is My blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「这是我立约的血，为多人流出来的。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, I will no longer drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in the kingdom of God.”
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，我不再喝这葡萄汁，直到我在上帝的国里喝新的那日子。」

chapters.en: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
chapters.zh: 他们唱了诗，就出来，往橄榄山去。

chapters.en:
Then Jesus said to them, “You will all fall away, for it is written:
‘I will strike the Shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们都要跌倒了，因为〔经上〕记着说： 我要击打牧人， 羊就分散了。

chapters.en: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”
chapters.zh: 但我复活以后，要在你们以先往加利利去。」

chapters.en: Peter declared, “Even if all fall away, I never will.”
chapters.zh: 彼得说：「众人虽然跌倒，我总不能。」

chapters.en: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “this very night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny Me three times.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「我实在告诉你，就在今天夜里，鸡叫两遍以先，你要三次不认我。」

chapters.en: But Peter kept insisting, “Even if I have to die with You, I will never deny You.” And all the others said the same thing.
chapters.zh: 彼得却极力地说：「我就是必须和你同死，也总不能不认你。」众门徒都是这样说。

chapters.en: Then they came to a place called Gethsemane, and Jesus told His disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”
chapters.zh: 他们来到一个地方，名叫客西马尼。耶稣对门徒说：「你们坐在这里，等我祷告。」

chapters.en: He took with Him Peter, James, and John, and began to be deeply troubled and distressed.
chapters.zh: 于是带着彼得、雅各、约翰同去，就惊恐起来，极其难过，

chapters.en: Then He said to them, “My soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch.”
chapters.zh: 对他们说：「我心里甚是忧伤，几乎要死；你们在这里等候，警醒。」

chapters.en: Going a little farther, He fell to the ground and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour would pass from Him.
chapters.zh: 他就稍往前走，俯伏在地，祷告说：「倘若可行，便叫那时候过去。」

chapters.en: “Abba, Father,” He said, “all things are possible for You. Take this cup from Me. Yet not what I will, but what You will.”
chapters.zh: 他说：「阿爸！父啊！在你凡事都能；求你将这杯撤去。然而，不要从我的意思，只要从你的意思。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus returned and found them sleeping. “Simon, are you asleep?” He asked. “Were you not able to keep watch for one hour?
chapters.zh: 耶稣回来，见他们睡着了，就对彼得说：「西门，你睡觉吗？不能警醒片时吗？

chapters.en: Watch and pray so that you will not enter into temptation. For the spirit is willing, but the body is weak.”
chapters.zh: 总要警醒祷告，免得入了迷惑。你们心灵固然愿意，肉体却软弱了。」

chapters.en: Again He went away and prayed, saying the same thing.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又去祷告，说的话还是与先前一样，

chapters.en: And again Jesus returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy. And they did not know what to answer Him.
chapters.zh: 又来见他们睡着了，因为他们的眼睛甚是困倦；他们也不知道怎么回答。

chapters.en: When Jesus returned the third time, He said, “Are you still sleeping and resting? That is enough! The hour has come. Look, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
chapters.zh: 第三次来，对他们说：「现在你们仍然睡觉安歇吧〔注：吧：或译吗？〕！够了，时候到了。看哪，人子被卖在罪人手里了。

chapters.en: Rise, let us go. See, My betrayer is approaching!”
chapters.zh: 起来！我们走吧。看哪，那卖我的人近了！」

chapters.en: While Jesus was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived, accompanied by a crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests, scribes, and elders.
chapters.zh: 说话之间，忽然那十二个门徒里的犹大来了，并有许多人带着刀棒，从祭司长和文士并长老那里与他同来。

chapters.en: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The One I kiss is the man; arrest Him and lead Him away securely.”
chapters.zh: 卖耶稣的人曾给他们一个暗号，说：「我与谁亲嘴，谁就是他。你们把他拿住，牢牢靠靠地带去。」

chapters.en: Going directly to Jesus, he said, “Rabbi!” and kissed Him.
chapters.zh: 犹大来了，随即到耶稣跟前，说：「拉比」，便与他亲嘴。

chapters.en: Then the men seized Jesus and arrested Him.
chapters.zh: 他们就下手拿住他。

chapters.en: And one of the bystanders drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
chapters.zh: 旁边站着的人，有一个拔出刀来，将大祭司的仆人砍了一刀，削掉了他一个耳朵。

chapters.en: Jesus asked the crowd, “Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me as you would an outlaw?
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们带着刀棒出来拿我，如同拿强盗吗？

chapters.en: Every day I was with you, teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest Me. But this has happened that the Scriptures would be fulfilled.”
chapters.zh: 我天天教训人，同你们在殿里，你们并没有拿我。但〔这事成就〕，为要应验经上的话。」

chapters.en: Then everyone deserted Him and fled.
chapters.zh: 门徒都离开他，逃走了。

chapters.en: One young man who had been following Jesus was wearing a linen cloth around his body. They caught hold of him,
chapters.zh: 有一个少年人，赤身披着一块麻布，跟随耶稣，众人就捉拿他。

chapters.en: but he pulled free of the linen cloth and ran away naked.
chapters.zh: 他却丢了麻布，赤身逃走了。

chapters.en: They led Jesus away to the high priest, and all the chief priests, elders, and scribes assembled.
chapters.zh: 他们把耶稣带到大祭司那里，又有众祭司长和长老并文士都来和大祭司一同聚集。

chapters.en: Peter followed Him at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest. And he sat with the officers and warmed himself by the fire.
chapters.zh: 彼得远远地跟着耶稣，一直进入大祭司的院里，和差役一同坐在火光里烤火。

chapters.en: Now the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were seeking testimony against Jesus to put Him to death, but they did not find any.
chapters.zh: 祭司长和全公会寻找见证控告耶稣，要治死他，却寻不着。

chapters.en: For many bore false witness against Jesus, but their testimony was inconsistent.
chapters.zh: 因为有好些人作假见证告他，只是他们的见证各不相合。

chapters.en: Then some men stood up and testified falsely against Him:
chapters.zh: 又有几个人站起来作假见证告他，说：

chapters.en: “We heard Him say, ‘I will destroy this man-made temple, and in three days I will build another that is made without hands.’”
chapters.zh: 「我们听见他说：『我要拆毁这人手所造的殿，三日内就另造一座不是人手所造的。』」

chapters.en: But even their testimony was inconsistent.
chapters.zh: 他们就是这么作见证，也是各不相合。

chapters.en: So the high priest stood up before them and questioned Jesus, “Have You no answer? What are these men testifying against You?”
chapters.zh: 大祭司起来站在中间，问耶稣说：「你什么都不回答吗？这些人作见证告你的是什么呢？」

chapters.en:
But Jesus remained silent and made no reply.
Again the high priest questioned Him, “Are You the Christ, the Son of the Blessed One?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣却不言语，一句也不回答。大祭司又问他说：「你是那当称颂者的儿子基督不是？」

chapters.en: “I am,” said Jesus, “and you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming with the clouds of heaven.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我是。你们必看见人子坐在那权能者的右边，驾着天上的云降临。」

chapters.en: At this, the high priest tore his clothes and declared, “Why do we need any more witnesses?
chapters.zh: 大祭司就撕开衣服，说：「我们何必再用见证人呢？

chapters.en:
You have heard the blasphemy. What is your verdict?”
And they all condemned Him as deserving of death.
chapters.zh: 你们已经听见他这僭妄的话了。你们的意见如何？」他们都定他该死的罪。

chapters.en: Then some of them began to spit on Him. They blindfolded Him, struck Him with their fists, and said to Him, “Prophesy!” And the officers received Him with slaps in His face.
chapters.zh: 就有人吐唾沫在他脸上，又蒙着他的脸，用拳头打他，对他说：「你说预言吧！」差役接过他来，用手掌打他。

chapters.en: While Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the servant girls of the high priest came down
chapters.zh: 彼得在下边院子里；来了大祭司的一个使女，

chapters.en: and saw him warming himself there. She looked at Peter and said, “You also were with Jesus the Nazarene.”
chapters.zh: 见彼得烤火，就看着他，说：「你素来也是同拿撒勒人耶稣一伙的。」

chapters.en: But he denied it. “I do not know or even understand what you are talking about,” he said. Then he went out to the gateway, and the rooster crowed.
chapters.zh: 彼得却不承认，说：「我不知道，也不明白你说的是什么。」于是出来，到了前院，鸡就叫了。

chapters.en: There the servant girl saw him and again said to those standing nearby, “This man is one of them.”
chapters.zh: 那使女看见他，又对旁边站着的人说：「这也是他们一党的。」

chapters.en:
But he denied it again.
After a little while, those standing nearby said once more to Peter, “Surely you are one of them, for you too are a Galilean.”
chapters.zh: 彼得又不承认。过了不多的时候，旁边站着的人又对彼得说：「你真是他们一党的！因为你是加利利人。」

chapters.en: But he began to curse and swear, “I do not know this man of whom you speak!”
chapters.zh: 彼得就发咒起誓地说：「我不认得你们说的这个人。」

chapters.en:
And immediately the rooster crowed a second time.
Then Peter remembered the word that Jesus had spoken to him: “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny Me three times.” And he broke down and wept.
chapters.zh: 立时鸡叫了第二遍。彼得想起耶稣对他所说的话：「鸡叫两遍以先，你要三次不认我。」思想起来，就哭了。

chapters.en: Early in the morning, the chief priests, elders, scribes, and the whole Sanhedrin devised a plan. They bound Jesus, led Him away, and handed Him over to Pilate.
chapters.zh: 一到早晨，祭司长和长老、文士、全公会的人大家商议，就把耶稣捆绑，解去交给彼拉多。

chapters.en:
So Pilate questioned Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?”
“You have said so,” Jesus replied.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多问他说：「你是犹太人的王吗？」耶稣回答说：「你说的是。」

chapters.en: And the chief priests began to accuse Him of many things.
chapters.zh: 祭司长告他许多的事。

chapters.en: Then Pilate questioned Him again, “Have You no answer? Look how many charges they are bringing against You!”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多又问他说：「你看，他们告你这么多的事，你什么都不回答吗？」

chapters.en: But to Pilate’s amazement, Jesus made no further reply.
chapters.zh: 耶稣仍不回答，以致彼拉多觉得希奇。

chapters.en: Now it was Pilate’s custom at the feast to release to the people a prisoner of their choosing.
chapters.zh: 每逢这节期，巡抚照众人所求的，释放一个囚犯给他们。

chapters.en: And a man named Barabbas was imprisoned with the rebels who had committed murder during the insurrection.
chapters.zh: 有一个人名叫巴拉巴，和作乱的人一同捆绑。他们作乱的时候，曾杀过人。

chapters.en: So the crowd went up and began asking Pilate to keep his custom.
chapters.zh: 众人上去求巡抚，照常例给他们办。

chapters.en: “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?” Pilate asked.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多说：「你们要我释放犹太人的王给你们吗？」

chapters.en: For he knew it was out of envy that the chief priests had handed Jesus over.
chapters.zh: 他原晓得，祭司长是因为嫉妒才把耶稣解了来。

chapters.en: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have him release Barabbas to them instead.
chapters.zh: 只是祭司长挑唆众人，宁可释放巴拉巴给他们。

chapters.en: So Pilate asked them again, “What then do you want me to do with the One you call the King of the Jews?”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多又说：「那么样，你们所称为犹太人的王，我怎么办他呢？」

chapters.en: And they shouted back, “Crucify Him!”
chapters.zh: 他们又喊着说：「把他钉十字架！」

chapters.en:
“Why?” asked Pilate. “What evil has He done?”
But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify Him!”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多说：「为什么呢？他做了什么恶事呢？」他们便极力地喊着说：「把他钉十字架！」

chapters.en: And wishing to satisfy the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed Him over to be crucified.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多要叫众人喜悦，就释放巴拉巴给他们，将耶稣鞭打了，交给人钉十字架。

chapters.en: Then the soldiers led Jesus away into the palace (that is, the Praetorium) and called the whole company together.
chapters.zh: 兵丁把耶稣带进衙门院里，叫齐了全营的兵。

chapters.en: They dressed Him in a purple robe, twisted together a crown of thorns, and set it on His head.
chapters.zh: 他们给他穿上紫袍，又用荆棘编做冠冕给他戴上，

chapters.en: And they began to salute Him: “Hail, King of the Jews!”
chapters.zh: 就庆贺他说：「恭喜，犹太人的王啊！」

chapters.en: They kept striking His head with a staff and spitting on Him. And they knelt down and bowed before Him.
chapters.zh: 又拿一根苇子打他的头，吐唾沫在他脸上，屈膝拜他。

chapters.en: After they had mocked Him, they removed the purple robe and put His own clothes back on Him. Then they led Him out to crucify Him.
chapters.zh: 戏弄完了，就给他脱了紫袍，仍穿上他自己的衣服，带他出去，要钉十字架。

chapters.en: Now Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, was passing by on his way in from the country, and the soldiers forced him to carry the cross of Jesus.
chapters.zh: 有一个古利奈人西门，就是亚历山大和鲁孚的父亲，从乡下来，经过那地方，他们就勉强他同去，好背着耶稣的十字架。

chapters.en: They brought Jesus to a place called Golgotha, which means The Place of the Skull.
chapters.zh: 他们带耶稣到了各各他地方（各各他翻出来就是髑髅地），

chapters.en: There they offered Him wine mixed with myrrh, but He did not take it.
chapters.zh: 拿没药调和的酒给耶稣，他却不受。

chapters.en:
And they crucified Him.
They also divided His garments by casting lots to decide what each of them would take.
chapters.zh: 于是将他钉在十字架上，拈鬮分他的衣服，看是谁得什么。

chapters.en: It was the third hour when they crucified Him.
chapters.zh: 钉他在十字架上是巳初的时候。

chapters.en:
And the charge inscribed against Him read:
THE KING OF THE JEWS.
chapters.zh: 在上面有他的罪状，写的是：「犹太人的王。」

chapters.en: Along with Jesus, they crucified two robbers, one on His right and one on His left.
chapters.zh: 他们又把两个强盗和他同钉十字架，一个在右边，一个在左边。
〔注：有古卷加：28 这就应了经上的话说：他被列在罪犯之中。〕

chapters.en: And those who passed by heaped abuse on Him, shaking their heads and saying, “Aha! You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days,
chapters.zh: 从那里经过的人辱骂他，摇着头说：「咳！你这拆毁圣殿、三日又建造起来的，

chapters.en: come down from the cross and save Yourself!”
chapters.zh: 可以救自己，从十字架上下来吧！」

chapters.en: In the same way, the chief priests and scribes mocked Him among themselves, saying, “He saved others, but He cannot save Himself!
chapters.zh: 祭司长和文士也是这样戏弄他，彼此说：「他救了别人，不能救自己。

chapters.en: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, come down now from the cross, so that we may see and believe!” And even those who were crucified with Him berated Him.
chapters.zh: 以色列的王基督，现在可以从十字架上下来，叫我们看见，就信了。」那和他同钉的人也是讥诮他。

chapters.en: From the sixth hour until the ninth hour darkness came over all the land.
chapters.zh: 从午正到申初，遍地都黑暗了。

chapters.en: At the ninth hour, Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?” which means, “My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?”
chapters.zh: 申初的时候，耶稣大声喊着说：「以罗伊！以罗伊！拉马撒巴各大尼？」（翻出来就是：我的上帝！我的上帝！为什么离弃我？）

chapters.en: When some of those standing nearby heard this, they said, “Behold, He is calling Elijah.”
chapters.zh: 旁边站着的人，有的听见就说：「看哪，他叫以利亚呢！」

chapters.en: And someone ran and filled a sponge with sour wine. He put it on a reed and held it up for Jesus to drink, saying, “Leave Him alone. Let us see if Elijah comes to take Him down.”
chapters.zh: 有一个人跑去，把海绒蘸满了醋，绑在苇子上，送给他喝，说：「且等着，看以利亚来不来把他取下。」

chapters.en: But Jesus let out a loud cry and breathed His last.
chapters.zh: 耶稣大声喊叫，气就断了。

chapters.en: And the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.
chapters.zh: 殿里的幔子从上到下裂为两半。

chapters.en: When the centurion standing there in front of Jesus saw how He had breathed His last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”
chapters.zh: 对面站着的百夫长看见耶稣这样喊叫〔注：有古卷没有喊叫二字〕断气，就说：「这人真是上帝的儿子！」

chapters.en: And there were also women watching from a distance. Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James the younger and of Joses, and Salome.
chapters.zh: 还有些妇女远远地观看；内中有抹大拉的马利亚，又有小雅各和约西的母亲马利亚，并有撒罗米，

chapters.en: These women had followed Jesus and ministered to Him while He was in Galilee, and there were many other women who had come up to Jerusalem with Him.
chapters.zh: 就是耶稣在加利利的时候，跟随他、服事他的那些人，还有同耶稣上耶路撒冷的好些妇女〔在那里观看〕。

chapters.en: Now it was already evening. Since it was Preparation Day (that is, the day before the Sabbath),
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，因为这是预备日，就是安息日的前一日，

chapters.en: Joseph of Arimathea, a prominent Council member who himself was waiting for the kingdom of God, boldly went to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus.
chapters.zh: 有亚利马太的约瑟前来，他是尊贵的议士，也是等候上帝国的。他放胆进去见彼拉多，求耶稣的身体；

chapters.en: Pilate was surprised to hear that Jesus was already dead, so he summoned the centurion to ask if this was so.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多诧异耶稣已经死了，便叫百夫长来，问他耶稣死了久不久。

chapters.en: When Pilate had confirmed it with the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.
chapters.zh: 既从百夫长得知实情，就把耶稣的尸首赐给约瑟。

chapters.en: So Joseph bought a linen cloth, took down the body of Jesus, wrapped it in the cloth, and placed it in a tomb that had been cut out of the rock. Then he rolled a stone against the entrance to the tomb.
chapters.zh: 约瑟买了细麻布，把耶稣取下来，用细麻布裹好，安放在磐石中凿出来的坟墓里，又滚过一块石头来挡住墓门。

chapters.en: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph saw where His body was placed.
chapters.zh: 抹大拉的马利亚和约西的母亲马利亚都看见安放他的地方。

chapters.en: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so they could go and anoint the body of Jesus.
chapters.zh: 过了安息日，抹大拉的马利亚和雅各的母亲马利亚并撒罗米，买了香膏要去膏耶稣的身体。

chapters.en: Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they went to the tomb.
chapters.zh: 七日的第一日清早，出太阳的时候，她们来到坟墓那里，

chapters.en: They were asking one another, “Who will roll away the stone from the entrance of the tomb?”
chapters.zh: 彼此说：「谁给我们把石头从墓门滚开呢？」

chapters.en: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone had been rolled away, even though it was extremely large.
chapters.zh: 那石头原来很大，她们抬头一看，却见石头已经滚开了。

chapters.en: When they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side, and they were alarmed.
chapters.zh: 她们进了坟墓，看见一个少年人坐在右边，穿着白袍，就甚惊恐。

chapters.en: But he said to them, “Do not be alarmed. You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has risen! He is not here! See the place where they put Him.
chapters.zh: 那少年人对她们说：「不要惊恐！你们寻找那钉十字架的拿撒勒人耶稣，他已经复活了，不在这里。请看安放他的地方。

chapters.en: But go, tell His disciples and Peter, ‘He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him, just as He told you.’”
chapters.zh: 你们可以去告诉他的门徒和彼得，说：『他在你们以先往加利利去。在那里你们要见他，正如他从前所告诉你们的。』」

chapters.en: So the women left the tomb and ran away, trembling and bewildered. And in their fear they did not say a word to anyone.
chapters.zh: 她们就出来，从坟墓那里逃跑，又发抖又惊奇，什么也不告诉人，因为她们害怕。

chapters.en: Early on the first day of the week, after Jesus had risen, He appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom He had driven out seven demons.
chapters.zh: 在七日的第一日清早，耶稣复活了，就先向抹大拉的马利亚显现（耶稣从她身上曾赶出七个鬼）。

chapters.en: She went and told those who had been with Him, who were mourning and weeping.
chapters.zh: 她去告诉那向来跟随耶稣的人；那时他们正哀恸哭泣。

chapters.en: And when they heard that Jesus was alive and she had seen Him, they did not believe it.
chapters.zh: 他们听见耶稣活了，被马利亚看见，却是不信。

chapters.en: After this, Jesus appeared in a different form to two of them as they walked along in the country.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，门徒中间有两个人往乡下去。走路的时候，耶稣变了形像，向他们显现。

chapters.en: And they went back and reported it to the rest, but they did not believe them either.
chapters.zh: 他们就去告诉其余的门徒；其余的门徒也是不信。

chapters.en: Later, as they were eating, Jesus appeared to the Eleven and rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they did not believe those who had seen Him after He had risen.
chapters.zh: 后来，十一个门徒坐席的时候，耶稣向他们显现，责备他们不信，心里刚硬，因为他们不信那些在他复活以后看见他的人。

chapters.en: And He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.
chapters.zh: 他又对他们说：「你们往普天下去，传福音给万民〔注：万民：原文是凡受造的〕听。

chapters.en: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.
chapters.zh: 信而受洗的，必然得救；不信的，必被定罪。

chapters.en: And these signs will accompany those who believe: In My name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues;
chapters.zh: 信的人必有神迹随着他们，就是奉我的名赶鬼；说新方言；

chapters.en: they will pick up snakes with their hands, and if they drink any deadly poison, it will not harm them; they will lay their hands on the sick, and they will be made well.”
chapters.zh: 手能拿蛇；若喝了什么毒物，也必不受害；手按病人，病人就必好了。」

chapters.en: After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, He was taken up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.
chapters.zh: 主耶稣和他们说完了话，后来被接到天上，坐在上帝的右边。

chapters.en: And they went out and preached everywhere, and the Lord worked through them, confirming His word by the signs that accompanied it.
chapters.zh: 门徒出去，到处宣传〔福音〕。主和他们同工，用神迹随着，证实所传的道。阿们！

chapters.en: Many have undertaken to compose an account of the things that have been fulfilled among us,
just as they were handed down to us by the initial eyewitnesses and servants of the word.
chapters.zh: 提阿非罗大人哪，有好些人提笔作书，述说在我们中间所成就的事，是照传道的人从起初亲眼看见又传给我们的。

chapters.en: Therefore, having carefully investigated everything from the beginning, it seemed good also to me to write an orderly account for you, most excellent Theophilus,
chapters.zh: 这些事我既从起头都详细考察了，就定意要按着次序写给你，

chapters.en: so that you may know the certainty of the things you have been taught.
chapters.zh: 使你知道所学之道都是确实的。

chapters.en: In the time of Herod king of Judea there was a priest named Zechariah, who belonged to the priestly division of Abijah, and whose wife Elizabeth was a descendant of Aaron.
chapters.zh: 当犹太王希律的时候，亚比雅班里有一个祭司，名叫撒迦利亚；他妻子是亚伦的后人，名叫伊利莎白。

chapters.en: Both of them were righteous in the sight of God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and decrees of the Lord.
chapters.zh: 他们二人在上帝面前都是义人，遵行主的一切诫命礼仪，没有可指摘的，

chapters.en: But they had no children, because Elizabeth was barren, and they were both well along in years.
chapters.zh: 只是没有孩子；因为伊利莎白不生育，两个人又年纪老迈了。

chapters.en: One day while Zechariah’s division was on duty and he was serving as priest before God,
chapters.zh: 撒迦利亚按班次在上帝面前供祭司的职分，

chapters.en: he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to enter the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
chapters.zh: 照祭司的规矩掣签，得进主殿烧香。

chapters.en: And at the hour of the incense offering, the whole congregation was praying outside.
chapters.zh: 烧香的时候，众百姓在外面祷告。

chapters.en: Just then an angel of the Lord appeared to Zechariah, standing at the right side of the altar of incense.
chapters.zh: 有主的使者站在香坛的右边，向他显现。

chapters.en: When Zechariah saw him, he was startled and gripped with fear.
chapters.zh: 撒迦利亚看见，就惊慌害怕。

chapters.en: But the angel said to him, “Do not be afraid, Zechariah, because your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to give him the name John.
chapters.zh: 天使对他说：「撒迦利亚，不要害怕，因为你的祈祷已经被听见了。你的妻子伊利莎白要给你生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫约翰。

chapters.en: He will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice at his birth,
chapters.zh: 你必欢喜快乐；有许多人因他出世，也必喜乐。

chapters.en: for he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He shall never take wine or strong drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even from his mother’s womb.
chapters.zh: 他在主面前将要为大，淡酒浓酒都不喝，从母腹里就被圣灵充满了。

chapters.en: Many of the sons of Israel he will turn back to the Lord their God.
chapters.zh: 他要使许多以色列人回转，归于主－他们的上帝。

chapters.en: And he will go on before the Lord in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of the fathers to their children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous—to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.”
chapters.zh: 他必有以利亚的心志能力，行在主的前面，叫为父的心转向儿女，叫悖逆的人转从义人的智慧，又为主预备合用的百姓。」

chapters.en: “How can I be sure of this?” Zechariah asked the angel. “I am an old man, and my wife is well along in years.”
chapters.zh: 撒迦利亚对天使说：「我凭着什么可知道这事呢？我已经老了，我的妻子也年纪老迈了。」

chapters.en: “I am Gabriel,” replied the angel. “I stand in the presence of God, and I have been sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
chapters.zh: 天使回答说：「我是站在上帝面前的加百列，奉差而来对你说话，将这好信息报给你。

chapters.en: And now you will be silent and unable to speak until the day this comes to pass, because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled at their proper time.”
chapters.zh: 到了时候，这话必然应验；只因你不信，你必哑巴，不能说话，直到这事成就的日子。」

chapters.en: Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah and wondering why he took so long in the temple.
chapters.zh: 百姓等候撒迦利亚，诧异他许久在殿里。

chapters.en: When he came out and was unable to speak to them, they realized he had seen a vision in the temple. He kept making signs to them but remained unable to speak.
chapters.zh: 及至他出来，不能和他们说话，他们就知道他在殿里见了异象；因为他直向他们打手式，竟成了哑巴。

chapters.en: And when the days of his service were complete, he returned home.
chapters.zh: 他供职的日子已满，就回家去了。

chapters.en: After these days, his wife Elizabeth became pregnant and for five months remained in seclusion. She declared,
chapters.zh: 这些日子以后，他的妻子伊利莎白怀了孕，就隐藏了五个月，

chapters.en: “The Lord has done this for me. In these days He has shown me favor and taken away my disgrace among the people.”
chapters.zh: 说：「主在眷顾我的日子，这样看待我，要把我在人间的羞耻除掉。」

chapters.en: In the sixth month, God sent the angel Gabriel to a town in Galilee called Nazareth,
chapters.zh: 到了第六个月，天使加百列奉上帝的差遣往加利利的一座城去（这城名叫拿撒勒），

chapters.en: to a virgin pledged in marriage to a man named Joseph, who was of the house of David. And the virgin’s name was Mary.
chapters.zh: 到一个童女那里，是已经许配大卫家的一个人，名叫约瑟。童女的名字叫马利亚；

chapters.en: The angel appeared to her and said, “Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you. ”
chapters.zh: 天使进去，对她说：「蒙大恩的女子，我问你安，主和你同在了！」

chapters.en: Mary was greatly troubled at his words and wondered what kind of greeting this might be.
chapters.zh: 马利亚因这话就很惊慌，又反覆思想这样问安是什么意思。

chapters.en: So the angel told her, “Do not be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
chapters.zh: 天使对她说：「马利亚，不要怕！你在上帝面前已经蒙恩了。

chapters.en: Behold, you will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus.
chapters.zh: 你要怀孕生子，可以给他起名叫耶稣。

chapters.en: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David,
chapters.zh: 他要为大，称为至高者的儿子；主上帝要把他祖大卫的位给他。

chapters.en: and He will reign over the house of Jacob forever. His kingdom will never end!”
chapters.zh: 他要作雅各家的王，直到永远；他的国也没有穷尽。」

chapters.en: “How can this be,” Mary asked the angel, “since I am a virgin?”
chapters.zh: 马利亚对天使说：「我没有出嫁，怎么有这事呢？」

chapters.en: The angel replied, “The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. So the Holy One to be born will be called the Son of God.
chapters.zh: 天使回答说：「圣灵要临到你身上，至高者的能力要荫庇你，因此所要生的圣者必称为上帝的儿子〔注：或译：所要生的，必称为圣，称为上帝的儿子〕。

chapters.en: Look, even Elizabeth your relative has conceived a son in her old age, and she who was called barren is in her sixth month.
chapters.zh: 况且你的亲戚伊利莎白，在年老的时候也怀了男胎，就是那素来称为不生育的，现在有孕六个月了。

chapters.en: For no word from God will ever fail. ”
chapters.zh: 因为，出于上帝的话，没有一句不带能力的。」

chapters.en: “I am the Lord’s servant,” Mary answered. “May it happen to me according to your word.” Then the angel left her.
chapters.zh: 马利亚说：「我是主的使女，情愿照你的话成就在我身上。」天使就离开她去了。

chapters.en: In those days Mary got ready and hurried to a town in the hill country of Judah,
chapters.zh: 那时候，马利亚起身，急忙往山地里去，来到犹大的一座城；

chapters.en: where she entered the home of Zechariah and greeted Elizabeth.
chapters.zh: 进了撒迦利亚的家，问伊利莎白安。

chapters.en: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
chapters.zh: 伊利莎白一听马利亚问安，所怀的胎就在腹里跳动。伊利莎白且被圣灵充满，

chapters.en: In a loud voice she exclaimed, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
chapters.zh: 高声喊着说：「你在妇女中是有福的！你所怀的胎也是有福的！

chapters.en: And why am I so honored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
chapters.zh: 我主的母到我这里来，这是从哪里得的呢？

chapters.en: For as soon as the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby in my womb leaped for joy.
chapters.zh: 因为你问安的声音一入我耳，我腹里的胎就欢喜跳动。

chapters.en: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord’s word to her will be fulfilled.”
chapters.zh: 这相信的女子是有福的！因为主对她所说的话都要应验。」

chapters.en:
Then Mary said:
“My soul magnifies the Lord,
chapters.zh: 马利亚说： 我心尊主为大；

chapters.en: and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior!
chapters.zh: 我灵以上帝我的救主为乐；

chapters.en: For He has looked with favor on the humble state of His servant. From now on all generations will call me blessed.
chapters.zh: 因为他顾念他使女的卑微； 从今以后， 万代要称我有福。

chapters.en: For the Mighty One has done great things for me. Holy is His name.
chapters.zh: 那有权能的，为我成就了大事； 他的名为圣。

chapters.en: His mercy extends to those who fear Him, from generation to generation.
chapters.zh: 他怜悯敬畏他的人， 直到世世代代。

chapters.en:
He has performed mighty deeds with His arm; He has scattered those who are proud
in the thoughts of their hearts.
chapters.zh: 他用膀臂施展大能； 那狂傲的人正心里妄想就被他赶散了。

chapters.en: He has brought down rulers from their thrones, but has exalted the humble.
chapters.zh: 他叫有权柄的失位， 叫卑贱的升高；

chapters.en: He has filled the hungry with good things, but has sent the rich away empty.
chapters.zh: 叫饥饿的得饱美食， 叫富足的空手回去。

chapters.en: He has helped His servant Israel, remembering to be merciful,
chapters.zh: 他扶助了他的仆人以色列，

chapters.en: as He promised to our fathers, to Abraham and his descendants forever.”
chapters.zh: 为要记念亚伯拉罕和他的后裔， 施怜悯直到永远， 正如从前对我们列祖所说的话。

chapters.en: Mary stayed with Elizabeth for about three months and then returned home.
chapters.zh: 马利亚和伊利莎白同住，约有三个月，就回家去了。

chapters.en: When the time came for Elizabeth to have her child, she gave birth to a son.
chapters.zh: 伊利莎白的产期到了，就生了一个儿子。

chapters.en: Her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had shown her great mercy, and they rejoiced with her.
chapters.zh: 邻里亲族听见主向她大施怜悯，就和她一同欢乐。

chapters.en: On the eighth day, when they came to circumcise the child, they were going to name him after his father Zechariah.
chapters.zh: 到了第八日，他们来要给孩子行割礼，并要照他父亲的名字叫他撒迦利亚。

chapters.en: But his mother replied, “No! He shall be called John.”
chapters.zh: 他母亲说：「不可！要叫他约翰。」

chapters.en: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who bears this name.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「你亲族中没有叫这名字的。」

chapters.en: So they made signs to his father to find out what he wanted to name the child.
chapters.zh: 他们就向他父亲打手式，问他要叫这孩子什么名字。

chapters.en: Zechariah asked for a tablet and wrote, “His name is John.” And they were all amazed.
chapters.zh: 他要了一块写字的板，就写上，说：「他的名字是约翰。」他们便都希奇。

chapters.en: Immediately Zechariah’s mouth was opened and his tongue was released, and he began to speak, praising God.
chapters.zh: 撒迦利亚的口立时开了，舌头也〔舒展了〕，就说出话来，称颂上帝。

chapters.en: All their neighbors were filled with awe, and people throughout the hill country of Judea were talking about these events.
chapters.zh: 周围居住的人都惧怕；这一切的事就传遍了犹太的山地。

chapters.en: And all who heard this wondered in their hearts and asked, “What then will this child become?” For the Lord’s hand was with him.
chapters.zh: 凡听见的人都将这事放在心里，说：「这个孩子将来怎么样呢？因为有主与他同在。」

chapters.en: Then his father Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied:
chapters.zh: 他父亲撒迦利亚被圣灵充满了，就预言说：

chapters.en: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, because He has visited and redeemed His people.
chapters.zh: 主－以色列的上帝是应当称颂的！ 因他眷顾他的百姓，为他们施行救赎，

chapters.en: He has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of His servant David,
chapters.zh: 在他仆人大卫家中， 为我们兴起了拯救的角，

chapters.en: as He spoke through His holy prophets, those of ages past,
chapters.zh: 正如主藉着从创世以来圣先知的口所说的话，

chapters.en: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us,
chapters.zh: 拯救我们脱离仇敌 和一切恨我们之人的手，

chapters.en: to show mercy to our fathers and to remember His holy covenant,
chapters.zh: 向我们列祖施怜悯， 记念他的圣约－

chapters.en: the oath He swore to our father Abraham, to grant us
chapters.zh: 就是他对我们祖宗亚伯拉罕所起的誓－

chapters.en:
deliverance from hostile hands,
that we may serve Him without fear,
chapters.zh: 叫我们既从仇敌手中被救出来，

chapters.en: in holiness and righteousness before Him all the days of our lives.
chapters.zh: 就可以终身在他面前， 坦然无惧地用圣洁、公义事奉他。

chapters.en: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go on before the Lord to prepare the way for Him,
chapters.zh: 孩子啊！你要称为至高者的先知； 因为你要行在主的前面， 预备他的道路，

chapters.en: to give to His people the knowledge of salvation through the forgiveness of their sins,
chapters.zh: 叫他的百姓因罪得赦， 就知道救恩。

chapters.en: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the Dawn will visit us from on high,
chapters.zh: 因我们上帝怜悯的心肠， 叫清晨的日光从高天临到我们，

chapters.en: to shine on those who live in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the path of peace.”
chapters.zh: 要照亮坐在黑暗中死荫里的人， 把我们的脚引到平安的路上。

chapters.en: And the child grew and became strong in spirit; and he lived in the wilderness until the time of his public appearance to Israel.
chapters.zh: 那孩子渐渐长大，心灵强健，住在旷野，直到他显明在以色列人面前的日子。

chapters.en: Now in those days a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that a census should be taken of the whole empire.
chapters.zh: 当那些日子，凯撒奥古斯都有旨意下来，叫天下人民都报名上册。

chapters.en: This was the first census to take place while Quirinius was governor of Syria.
chapters.zh: 这是居里扭作觜利亚巡抚的时候，头一次行报名上册的事。

chapters.en: And everyone went to his own town to register.
chapters.zh: 众人各归各城，报名上册。

chapters.en: So Joseph also went up from Nazareth in Galilee to Judea, to the city of David called Bethlehem, since he was from the house and line of David.
chapters.zh: 约瑟也从加利利的拿撒勒城上犹太去，到了大卫的城，名叫伯利恒，因他本是大卫一族一家的人，

chapters.en: He went there to register with Mary, who was pledged to him in marriage and was expecting a child.
chapters.zh: 要和他所聘之妻马利亚一同报名上册。那时马利亚的身孕已经重了。

chapters.en: While they were there, the time came for her Child to be born.
chapters.zh: 他们在那里的时候，马利亚的产期到了，

chapters.en: And she gave birth to her firstborn, a Son. She wrapped Him in swaddling cloths and laid Him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn.
chapters.zh: 就生了头胎的儿子，用布包起来，放在马槽里，因为客店里没有地方。

chapters.en: And there were shepherds residing in the fields nearby, keeping watch over their flocks by night.
chapters.zh: 在伯利恒之野地里有牧羊的人，夜间按着更次看守羊群。

chapters.en: Just then an angel of the Lord stood before them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.
chapters.zh: 有主的使者站在他们旁边，主的荣光四面照着他们；牧羊的人就甚惧怕。

chapters.en: But the angel said to them, “Do not be afraid! For behold, I bring you good news of great joy that will be for all the people:
chapters.zh: 那天使对他们说：「不要惧怕！我报给你们大喜的信息，是关乎万民的；

chapters.en: Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you. He is Christ the Lord!
chapters.zh: 因今天在大卫的城里，为你们生了救主，就是主基督。

chapters.en: And this will be a sign to you: You will find a baby wrapped in swaddling cloths and lying in a manger.”
chapters.zh: 你们要看见一个婴孩，包着布，卧在〔马〕槽里，那就是记号了。」

chapters.en: And suddenly there appeared with the angel a great multitude of the heavenly host, praising God and saying:
chapters.zh: 忽然，有一大队天兵同那天使赞美上帝说：

chapters.en:
“Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to men
on whom His favor rests!”
chapters.zh: 在至高之处荣耀归与上帝！ 在地上平安归与他所喜悦的人〔注：有古卷：喜悦归与人〕！

chapters.en: When the angels had left them and gone into heaven, the shepherds said to one another, “Let us go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”
chapters.zh: 众天使离开他们，升天去了。牧羊的人彼此说：「我们往伯利恒去，看看所成的事，就是主所指示我们的。」

chapters.en: So they hurried off and found Mary and Joseph and the Baby, who was lying in the manger.
chapters.zh: 他们急忙去了，就寻见马利亚和约瑟，又有那婴孩卧在〔马〕槽里；

chapters.en: After they had seen the Child, they spread the message they had received about Him.
chapters.zh: 既然看见，就把天使论这孩子的话传开了。

chapters.en: And all who heard it were amazed at what the shepherds said to them.
chapters.zh: 凡听见的，就诧异牧羊之人对他们所说的话。

chapters.en: But Mary treasured up all these things and pondered them in her heart.
chapters.zh: 马利亚却把这一切的事存在心里，反覆思想。

chapters.en: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all they had heard and seen, which was just as the angel had told them.
chapters.zh: 牧羊的人回去了，因所听见所看见的一切事，正如〔天使〕向他们所说的，就归荣耀与上帝，赞美他。

chapters.en: When the eight days before His circumcision had passed, He was named Jesus, the name the angel had given Him before He was conceived.
chapters.zh: 满了八天，就给孩子行割礼，与他起名叫耶稣；这就是没有成胎以前，天使所起的名。

chapters.en: And when the time of purification according to the Law of Moses was complete, His parents brought Him to Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord
chapters.zh: 按摩西律法满了洁净的日子，他们带着孩子上耶路撒冷去，要把他献与主，

chapters.en: (as it is written in the Law of the Lord: “Every firstborn male shall be consecrated to the Lord” ),
chapters.zh: （正如主的律法上所记：「凡头生的男子必称圣归主。」）

chapters.en: and to offer the sacrifice specified in the Law of the Lord: “A pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons.”
chapters.zh: 又要照主的律法上所说，或用一对斑鸠，或用两只雏鸽献祭。

chapters.en: Now there was a man in Jerusalem named Simeon, who was righteous and devout. He was waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was upon him.
chapters.zh: 在耶路撒冷有一个人，名叫西面；这人又公义又虔诚，素常盼望以色列的安慰〔者〕来到，又有圣灵在他身上。

chapters.en: The Holy Spirit had revealed to him that he would not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
chapters.zh: 他得了圣灵的启示，知道自己未死以前，必看见主所立的基督。

chapters.en: Led by the Spirit, he went into the temple courts. And when the parents brought in the child Jesus to do for Him what was customary under the Law,
chapters.zh: 他受了〔圣〕灵的感动，进入圣殿，正遇见耶稣的父母抱着孩子进来，要照律法的规矩办理。

chapters.en: Simeon took Him in his arms and blessed God, saying:
chapters.zh: 西面就用手接过他来，称颂上帝说：

chapters.en: “Sovereign Lord, as You have promised, You now dismiss Your servant in peace.
chapters.zh: 主啊！如今可以照你的话， 释放仆人安然去世；

chapters.en: For my eyes have seen Your salvation,
chapters.zh: 因为我的眼睛已经看见你的救恩－

chapters.en: which You have prepared in the sight of all people,
chapters.zh: 就是你在万民面前所预备的：

chapters.en: a light for revelation to the Gentiles, and for glory to Your people Israel.”
chapters.zh: 是照亮外邦人的光， 又是你民以色列的荣耀。

chapters.en: The Child’s father and mother were amazed at what was spoken about Him.
chapters.zh: 孩子的父母因这论耶稣的话就希奇。

chapters.en:
Then Simeon blessed them and said to His mother Mary:
“Behold, this Child is appointed to cause the rise and fall of many in Israel,
and to be a sign that will be spoken against,
so that the thoughts of many hearts will be revealed— and a sword will pierce your soul as well.”
chapters.zh: 西面给他们祝福，又对孩子的母亲马利亚说：「这〔孩子〕被立，是要叫以色列中许多人跌倒，许多人兴起；又要作毁谤的话柄，叫许多人心里的意念显露出来；你自己的心也要被刀刺透。」

chapters.en: There was also a prophetess named Anna, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher, who was well along in years. She had been married for seven years,
chapters.zh: 又有女先知，名叫亚拿，是亚设支派法内力的女儿，年纪已经老迈，从作童女出嫁的时候，同丈夫住了七年就寡居了，

chapters.en: and then was a widow to the age of eighty-four. She never left the temple, but worshiped night and day, fasting and praying.
chapters.zh: 现在已经八十四岁〔注：或译：就寡居了八十四年〕，并不离开圣殿，禁食祈求，昼夜事奉上帝。

chapters.en: Coming forward at that moment, she gave thanks to God and spoke about the Child to all who were waiting for the redemption of Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 正当那时，她进前来称谢上帝，将孩子的事对一切盼望耶路撒冷得救赎的人讲说。

chapters.en: When Jesus’ parents had done everything required by the Law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own town of Nazareth.
chapters.zh: 约瑟和马利亚照主的律法办完了一切的事，就回加利利，到自己的城拿撒勒去了。

chapters.en: And the Child grew and became strong. He was filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon Him.
chapters.zh: 孩子渐渐长大，强健起来，充满智慧，又有上帝的恩在他身上。

chapters.en: Every year His parents went to Jerusalem for the Feast of the Passover.
chapters.zh: 每年到逾越节，他父母就上耶路撒冷去。

chapters.en: And when He was twelve years old, they went up according to the custom of the Feast.
chapters.zh: 当他十二岁的时候，他们按着节期的规矩上去。

chapters.en: When those days were over and they were returning home, the boy Jesus remained behind in Jerusalem, but His parents were unaware He had stayed.
chapters.zh: 守满了节期，他们回去，孩童耶稣仍旧在耶路撒冷。他的父母并不知道，

chapters.en: Assuming He was in their company, they traveled on for a day before they began to look for Him among their relatives and friends.
chapters.zh: 以为他在同行的人中间，走了一天的路程，就在亲族和熟识的人中找他，

chapters.en: When they could not find Him, they returned to Jerusalem to search for Him.
chapters.zh: 既找不着，就回耶路撒冷去找他。

chapters.en: Finally, after three days they found Him in the temple courts, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.
chapters.zh: 过了三天，就遇见他在殿里，坐在教师中间，一面听，一面问。

chapters.en: And all who heard Him were astounded at His understanding and His answers.
chapters.zh: 凡听见他的，都希奇他的聪明和他的应对。

chapters.en: When His parents saw Him, they were astonished. “Child, why have You done this to us?” His mother asked. “Your father and I have been anxiously searching for You.”
chapters.zh: 他父母看见就很希奇。他母亲对他说：「我儿！为什么向我们这样行呢？看哪，你父亲和我伤心来找你！」

chapters.en: “Why were you looking for Me?” He asked. “Did you not know that I had to be in My Father’s house ?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「为什么找我呢？岂不知我应当以我父的事为念吗〔注：或译：岂不知我应当在我父的家里吗〕？」

chapters.en: But they did not understand the statement He was making to them.
chapters.zh: 他所说的这话，他们不明白。

chapters.en: Then He went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them. But His mother treasured up all these things in her heart.
chapters.zh: 他就同他们下去，回到拿撒勒，并且顺从他们。他母亲把这一切的事都存在心里。

chapters.en: And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.
chapters.zh: 耶稣的智慧和身量〔注：或译：年纪〕，并上帝和人喜爱他的心，都一齐增长。

chapters.en: In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, while Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, Herod tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
chapters.zh: 凯撒提庇留在位第十五年，本丢‧彼拉多作犹太巡抚，希律作加利利分封的王，他兄弟腓力作以土利亚和特拉可尼地方分封的王，吕撒聂作亚比利尼分封的王，

chapters.en: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John son of Zechariah in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 亚那和该亚法作大祭司。那时，撒迦利亚的儿子约翰在旷野里，上帝的话临到他。

chapters.en: He went into all the region around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins,
chapters.zh: 他就来到约旦河一带地方，宣讲悔改的洗礼，使罪得赦。

chapters.en:
as it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet:
“A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord,
make straight paths for Him.
chapters.zh: 正如先知以赛亚书上所记的话，说： 在旷野有人声喊着说： 预备主的道， 修直他的路！

chapters.en: Every valley shall be filled in, and every mountain and hill made low. The crooked ways shall be made straight, and the rough ways smooth.
chapters.zh: 一切山洼都要填满； 大小山冈都要削平！ 弯弯曲曲的地方要改为正直； 高高低低的道路要改为平坦！

chapters.en: And all humanity will see God’s salvation.’”
chapters.zh: 凡有血气的，都要见上帝的救恩！

chapters.en: Then John said to the crowds coming out to be baptized by him, “You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
chapters.zh: 约翰对那出来要受他洗的众人说：「毒蛇的种类！谁指示你们逃避将来的忿怒呢？

chapters.en: Produce fruit, then, in keeping with repentance. And do not begin to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.
chapters.zh: 你们要结出果子来，与悔改的心相称。不要自己心里说：『有亚伯拉罕为我们的祖宗。』我告诉你们，上帝能从这些石头中，给亚伯拉罕兴起子孙来。

chapters.en: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.”
chapters.zh: 现在斧子已经放在树根上，凡不结好果子的树就砍下来，丢在火里。」

chapters.en: The crowds asked him, “What then should we do?”
chapters.zh: 众人问他说：「这样，我们当做什么呢？」

chapters.en: John replied, “Whoever has two tunics should share with him who has none, and whoever has food should do the same.”
chapters.zh: 约翰回答说：「有两件衣裳的，就分给那没有的；有食物的，也当这样行。」

chapters.en: Even tax collectors came to be baptized. “Teacher,” they asked, “what should we do?”
chapters.zh: 又有税吏来要受洗，问他说：「夫子，我们当做什么呢？」

chapters.en: “Collect no more than you are authorized,” he answered.
chapters.zh: 约翰说：「除了例定的数目，不要多取。」

chapters.en:
Then some soldiers asked him, “And what should we do?”
“Do not take money by force or false accusation,” he said. “Be content with your wages.”
chapters.zh: 又有兵丁问他说：「我们当做什么呢？」约翰说：「不要以强暴待人，也不要讹诈人，自己有钱粮就当知足。」

chapters.en: The people were waiting expectantly and were all wondering in their hearts if John could be the Christ.
chapters.zh: 百姓指望〔基督来〕的时候，人都心里猜疑，或者约翰是基督。

chapters.en: John answered all of them: “I baptize you with water, but One more powerful than I will come, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
chapters.zh: 约翰说：「我是用水给你们施洗，但有一位能力比我更大的要来，我就是给他解鞋带也不配。他要用圣灵与火给你们施洗。

chapters.en: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather the wheat into His barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
chapters.zh: 他手里拿着簸箕，要扬净他的场，把麦子收在仓里，把糠用不灭的火烧尽了。」

chapters.en: With these and many other exhortations, John proclaimed the good news to the people.
chapters.zh: 约翰又用许多别的话劝百姓，向他们传福音。

chapters.en: But when he rebuked Herod the tetrarch regarding his brother’s wife Herodias and all the evils he had done,
chapters.zh: 只是分封的王希律，因他兄弟之妻希罗底的缘故，并因他所行的一切恶事，受了约翰的责备；

chapters.en: Herod added this to them all: He locked John up in prison.
chapters.zh: 又另外添了一件，就是把约翰收在监里。

chapters.en: When all the people were being baptized, Jesus was baptized too. And as He was praying, heaven was opened,
chapters.zh: 众百姓都受了洗，耶稣也受了洗。正祷告的时候，天就开了，

chapters.en: and the Holy Spirit descended on Him in a bodily form like a dove. And a voice came from heaven: “You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased.”
chapters.zh: 圣灵降临在他身上，形状仿佛鸽子；又有声音从天上来，说：「你是我的爱子，我喜悦你。」

chapters.en:
Jesus Himself was about thirty years old when He began His ministry.
He was regarded as the son of Joseph, the son of Heli,
chapters.zh: 耶稣开头〔传道〕，年纪约有三十岁。依人看来，他是约瑟的儿子；约瑟是希里的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,
chapters.zh: 希里是玛塔的儿子；玛塔是利未的儿子；利未是麦基的儿子；麦基是雅拿的儿子；雅拿是约瑟的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,
chapters.zh: 约瑟是玛他提亚的儿子；玛他提亚是亚摩斯的儿子；亚摩斯是拿鸿的儿子；拿鸿是以斯利的儿子；以斯利是拿该的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Josech, the son of Joda,
chapters.zh: 拿该是玛押的儿子；玛押是玛他提亚的儿子；玛他提亚是西美的儿子；西美是约瑟的儿子；约瑟是犹大的儿子；犹大是约亚拿的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,
chapters.zh: 约亚拿是利撒的儿子；利撒是所罗巴伯的儿子；所罗巴伯是撒拉铁的儿子；撒拉铁是尼利的儿子；尼利是麦基的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmadam, the son of Er,
chapters.zh: 麦基是亚底的儿子；亚底是哥桑的儿子；哥桑是以摩当的儿子；以摩当是珥的儿子；珥是约细的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Joshua, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,
chapters.zh: 约细是以利以谢的儿子；以利以谢是约令的儿子；约令是玛塔的儿子；玛塔是利未的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonam, the son of Eliakim,
chapters.zh: 利未是西缅的儿子；西缅是犹大的儿子；犹大是约瑟的儿子；约瑟是约南的儿子；约南是以利亚敬的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Melea, the son of Menna, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,
chapters.zh: 以利亚敬是米利亚的儿子；米利亚是买南的儿子；买南是玛达他的儿子；玛达他是拿单的儿子；拿单是大卫的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Sala, the son of Nahshon,
chapters.zh: 大卫是耶西的儿子；耶西是俄备得的儿子；俄备得是波阿斯的儿子；波阿斯是撒门的儿子；撒门是拿顺的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Amminadab, the son of Admin, the son of Arni, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,
chapters.zh: 拿顺是亚米拿达的儿子；亚米拿达是亚兰的儿子；亚兰是希斯崙的儿子；希斯崙是法勒斯的儿子；法勒斯是犹大的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,
chapters.zh: 犹大是雅各的儿子；雅各是以撒的儿子；以撒是亚伯拉罕的儿子；亚伯拉罕是他拉的儿子；他拉是拿鹤的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,
chapters.zh: 拿鹤是西鹿的儿子；西鹿是拉吴的儿子；拉吴是法勒的儿子；法勒是希伯的儿子；希伯是沙拉的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,
chapters.zh: 沙拉是该南的儿子；该南是亚法撒的儿子；亚法撒是闪的儿子；闪是挪亚的儿子；挪亚是拉麦的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalalel, the son of Cainan,
chapters.zh: 拉麦是玛土撒拉的儿子；玛土撒拉是以诺的儿子；以诺是雅列的儿子；雅列是玛勒列的儿子；玛勒列是该南的儿子；该南是以挪士的儿子；

chapters.en: the son of Enosh, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
chapters.zh: 以挪士是塞特的儿子；塞特是亚当的儿子；亚当是上帝的儿子。

chapters.en: Then Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
chapters.zh: 耶稣被圣灵充满，从约旦河回来，圣灵将他引到旷野，

chapters.en: where for forty days He was tempted by the devil. He ate nothing during those days, and when they had ended, He was hungry.
chapters.zh: 四十天受魔鬼的试探。那些日子没有吃什么；日子满了，他就饿了。

chapters.en: The devil said to Him, “If You are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread.”
chapters.zh: 魔鬼对他说：「你若是上帝的儿子，可以吩咐这块石头变成食物。」

chapters.en: But Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「〔经上〕记着说：『人活着不是单靠食物，〔乃是靠上帝口里所出的一切话〕。』」

chapters.en: Then the devil led Him up to a high place and showed Him in an instant all the kingdoms of the world.
chapters.zh: 魔鬼又领他上了〔高山〕，霎时间把天下的万国都指给他看，

chapters.en: “I will give You authority over all these kingdoms and all their glory,” he said. “For it has been relinquished to me, and I can give it to anyone I wish.
chapters.zh: 对他说：「这一切权柄、荣华，我都要给你，因为这原是交付我的，我愿意给谁就给谁。

chapters.en: So if You worship me, it will all be Yours.”
chapters.zh: 你若在我面前下拜，这都要归你。」

chapters.en: But Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「〔经上〕记着说： 当拜主－你的上帝， 单要事奉他。」

chapters.en: Then the devil led Him to Jerusalem and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple. “If You are the Son of God,” he said, “throw Yourself down from here.
chapters.zh: 魔鬼又领他到耶路撒冷去，叫他站在殿顶〔注：顶：原文是翅〕上，对他说：「你若是上帝的儿子，可以从这里跳下去；

chapters.en:
For it is written:
‘He will command His angels concerning You to guard You carefully,
chapters.zh: 因为〔经上〕记着说： 主要为你吩咐他的使者保护你；

chapters.en: and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’ ”
chapters.zh: 他们要用手托着你， 免得你的脚碰在石头上。」

chapters.en: But Jesus answered, “It also says, ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’ ”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「〔经上〕说：『不可试探主－你的上帝。』」

chapters.en: When the devil had finished every temptation, he left Him until an opportune time.
chapters.zh: 魔鬼用完了各样的试探，就暂时离开耶稣。

chapters.en: Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and the news about Him spread throughout the surrounding region.
chapters.zh: 耶稣满有圣灵的能力，回到加利利；他的名声就传遍了四方。

chapters.en: He taught in their synagogues and was glorified by everyone.
chapters.zh: 他在各会堂里教训人，众人都称赞他。

chapters.en: Then Jesus came to Nazareth, where He had been brought up. As was His custom, He entered the synagogue on the Sabbath. And when He stood up to read,
chapters.zh: 耶稣来到拿撒勒，就是他长大的地方。在安息日，照他平常的规矩进了会堂，站起来要念〔圣经〕。

chapters.en: the scroll of the prophet Isaiah was handed to Him. Unrolling it, He found the place where it was written:
chapters.zh: 有人把先知以赛亚的书交给他，他就打开，找到一处写着说：

chapters.en:
“The Spirit of the Lord is on Me, because He has anointed Me
to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to proclaim liberty to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind,
to release the oppressed,
chapters.zh: 主的灵在我身上， 因为他用膏膏我， 叫我传福音给贫穷的人； 差遣我报告： 被掳的得释放， 瞎眼的得看见， 叫那受压制的得自由，

chapters.en: to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor.”
chapters.zh: 报告上帝悦纳人的禧年。

chapters.en: Then He rolled up the scroll, returned it to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fixed on Him,
chapters.zh: 于是把书卷起来，交还执事，就坐下。会堂里的人都定睛看他。

chapters.en: and He began by saying, “Today this Scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「今天这经应验在你们耳中了。」

chapters.en: All spoke well of Him and marveled at the gracious words that came from His lips. “Isn’t this the son of Joseph?” they asked.
chapters.zh: 众人都称赞他，并希奇他口中所出的恩言；又说：「这不是约瑟的儿子吗？」

chapters.en: Jesus said to them, “Surely you will quote this proverb to Me: ‘Physician, heal yourself! Do here in Your hometown what we have heard that You did in Capernaum.’”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们必引这俗语向我说：『医生，你医治自己吧！我们听见你在迦百农所行的事，也当行在你自己家乡里』」；

chapters.en: Then He added, “Truly I tell you, no prophet is accepted in his hometown.
chapters.zh: 又说：「我实在告诉你们，没有先知在自己家乡被人悦纳的。

chapters.en: But I tell you truthfully that there were many widows in Israel in the time of Elijah, when the sky was shut for three and a half years and great famine swept over all the land.
chapters.zh: 我对你们说实话，当以利亚的时候，天闭塞了三年零六个月，遍地有大饥荒，那时，以色列中有许多寡妇，

chapters.en: Yet Elijah was not sent to any of them, but to the widow of Zarephath in Sidon.
chapters.zh: 以利亚并没有奉差往她们一个人那里去，只奉差往西顿的撒勒法一个寡妇那里去。

chapters.en: And there were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet. Yet not one of them was cleansed—only Naaman the Syrian.”
chapters.zh: 先知以利沙的时候，以色列中有许多长大痲疯的，但内中除了觜利亚国的乃缦，没有一个得洁净的。」

chapters.en: On hearing this, all the people in the synagogue were enraged.
chapters.zh: 会堂里的人听见这话，都怒气满胸，

chapters.en: They got up, drove Him out of the town, and led Him to the brow of the hill on which the town was built, in order to throw Him over the cliff.
chapters.zh: 就起来撵他出城（他们的城造在山上）；他们带他到山崖，要把他推下去。

chapters.en: But Jesus passed through the crowd and went on His way.
chapters.zh: 他却从他们中间直行，过去了。

chapters.en: Then He went down to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and on the Sabbath He began to teach the people.
chapters.zh: 耶稣下到迦百农，就是加利利的一座城，在安息日教训众人。

chapters.en: They were astonished at His teaching, because His message had authority.
chapters.zh: 他们很希奇他的教训，因为他的话里有权柄。

chapters.en: In the synagogue there was a man possessed by the spirit of an unclean demon. He cried out in a loud voice,
chapters.zh: 在会堂里有一个人，被污鬼的精气附着，大声喊叫说：

chapters.en: “Ha! What do You want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!”
chapters.zh: 「唉！拿撒勒的耶稣，我们与你有什么相干？你来灭我们吗？我知道你是谁，乃是上帝的圣者。」

chapters.en: But Jesus rebuked the demon. “Be silent!” He said. “Come out of him!” At this, the demon threw the man down before them all and came out without harming him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣责备他说：「不要作声，从这人身上出来吧！」鬼把那人摔倒在众人中间，就出来了，却也没有害他。

chapters.en: All the people were overcome with amazement and asked one another, “What is this message? With authority and power He commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”
chapters.zh: 众人都惊讶，彼此对问说：「这是什么道理呢？因为他用权柄能力吩咐污鬼，污鬼就出来。」

chapters.en: And the news about Jesus spread throughout the surrounding region.
chapters.zh: 于是耶稣的名声传遍了周围地方。

chapters.en: After Jesus had left the synagogue, He went to the home of Simon, whose mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever. So they appealed to Jesus on her behalf,
chapters.zh: 耶稣出了会堂，进了西门的家。西门的岳母害热病甚重，有人为她求耶稣。

chapters.en: and He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. And she got up at once and began to serve them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣站在她旁边，斥责那热病，热就退了。她立刻起来服事他们。

chapters.en: At sunset, all who were ill with various diseases were brought to Jesus, and laying His hands on each one, He healed them.
chapters.zh: 日落的时候，凡有病人的，不论害什么病，都带到耶稣那里。耶稣按手在他们各人身上，医好他们。

chapters.en: Demons also came out of many people, shouting, “You are the Son of God!” But He rebuked the demons and would not allow them to speak, because they knew He was the Christ.
chapters.zh: 又有鬼从好些人身上出来，喊着说：「你是上帝的儿子。」耶稣斥责他们，不许他们说话，因为他们知道他是基督。

chapters.en: At daybreak, Jesus went out to a solitary place, and the crowds were looking for Him. They came to Him and tried to keep Him from leaving.
chapters.zh: 天亮的时候，耶稣出来，走到旷野地方。众人去找他，到了他那里，要留住他，不要他离开他们。

chapters.en: But Jesus told them, “I must preach the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns as well, because that is why I was sent.”
chapters.zh: 但耶稣对他们说：「我也必须在别城传上帝国的福音，因我奉差原是为此。」

chapters.en: And He continued to preach in the synagogues of Judea.
chapters.zh: 于是耶稣在加利利的各会堂传道。

chapters.en: On one occasion, while Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret with the crowd pressing in on Him to hear the word of God,
chapters.zh: 耶稣站在革尼撒勒湖边，众人拥挤他，要听上帝的道。

chapters.en: He saw two boats at the edge of the lake. The fishermen had left them and were washing their nets.
chapters.zh: 他见有两只船湾在湖边；打鱼的人却离开船洗网去了。

chapters.en: Jesus got into the boat belonging to Simon and asked him to put out a little from shore. And sitting down, He taught the people from the boat.
chapters.zh: 有一只船是西门的，耶稣就上去，请他把船撑开，稍微离岸，就坐下，从船上教训众人。

chapters.en: When Jesus had finished speaking, He said to Simon, “Put out into deep water and let down your nets for a catch.”
chapters.zh: 讲完了，对西门说：「把船开到水深之处，下网打鱼。」

chapters.en: “Master,” Simon replied, “we have worked hard all night without catching anything. But because You say so, I will let down the nets.”
chapters.zh: 西门说：「夫子，我们整夜劳力，并没有打着什么。但依从你的话，我就下网。」

chapters.en: When they had done so, they caught such a large number of fish that their nets began to tear.
chapters.zh: 他们下了网，就圈住许多鱼，网险些裂开，

chapters.en: So they signaled to their partners in the other boat to come and help them, and they came and filled both boats so full that they began to sink.
chapters.zh: 便招呼那只船上的同伴来帮助。他们就来，把鱼装满了两只船，甚至船要沉下去。

chapters.en: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees. “Go away from me, Lord,” he said, “for I am a sinful man.”
chapters.zh: 西门‧彼得看见，就俯伏在耶稣膝前，说：「主啊，离开我，我是个罪人！」

chapters.en: For he and his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken,
chapters.zh: 他和一切同在的人都惊讶这一网所打的鱼。

chapters.en:
and so were his partners James and John, the sons of Zebedee.
“Do not be afraid,” Jesus said to Simon. “From now on you will catch men.”
chapters.zh: 他的伙伴西庇太的儿子雅各、约翰，也是这样。耶稣对西门说：「不要怕！从今以后，你要得人了。」

chapters.en: And when they had brought their boats ashore, they left everything and followed Him.
chapters.zh: 他们把两只船拢了岸，就撇下所有的，跟从了耶稣。

chapters.en: While Jesus was in one of the towns, a man came along who was covered with leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell facedown and begged Him, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.”
chapters.zh: 有一回，耶稣在一个城里，有人满身长了大痲疯，看见他，就俯伏在地，求他说：「主若肯，必能叫我洁净了。」

chapters.en: Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!” And immediately the leprosy left him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣伸手摸他，说：「我肯，你洁净了吧！」大痲疯立刻就离了他的身。
