chapters.en: Then Jesus said to the man who had invited Him, “When you host a dinner or a banquet, do not invite your friends or brothers or relatives or rich neighbors. Otherwise, they may invite you in return, and you will be repaid.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又对请他的人说：「你摆设午饭或晚饭，不要请你的朋友、弟兄、亲属，和富足的邻舍，恐怕他们也请你，你就得了报答。

chapters.en: But when you host a banquet, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, and the blind,
chapters.zh: 你摆设筵席，倒要请那贫穷的、残废的、瘸腿的、瞎眼的，你就有福了！

chapters.en: and you will be blessed. Since they cannot repay you, you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous.”
chapters.zh: 因为他们没有什么可报答你。到义人复活的时候，你要得着报答。」

chapters.en: When one of those reclining with Him heard this, he said to Jesus, “Blessed is everyone who will eat at the feast in the kingdom of God.”
chapters.zh: 同席的有一人听见这话，就对耶稣说：「在上帝国里吃饭的有福了！」

chapters.en: But Jesus replied, “A certain man prepared a great banquet and invited many guests.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「有一人摆设大筵席，请了许多客。

chapters.en: When it was time for the banquet, he sent his servant to tell those who had been invited, ‘Come, for everything is now ready.’
chapters.zh: 到了坐席的时候，打发仆人去对所请的人说：『请来吧！样样都齐备了。』

chapters.en: But one after another they all began to make excuses. The first one said, ‘I have bought a field, and I need to go see it. Please excuse me.’
chapters.zh: 众人一口同音地推辞。头一个说：『我买了一块地，必须去看看。请你准我辞了。』

chapters.en: Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I am going to try them out. Please excuse me.’
chapters.zh: 又有一个说：『我买了五对牛，要去试一试。请你准我辞了。』

chapters.en: Still another said, ‘I have married a wife, so I cannot come.’
chapters.zh: 又有一个说：『我才娶了妻，所以不能去。』

chapters.en: The servant returned and reported all this to his master. Then the owner of the house became angry and said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and alleys of the city, and bring in the poor, the crippled, the blind, and the lame.’
chapters.zh: 那仆人回来，把这事都告诉了主人。家主就动怒，对仆人说：『快出去，到城里大街小巷，领那贫穷的、残废的、瞎眼的、瘸腿的来。』

chapters.en: ‘Sir,’ the servant replied, ‘what you ordered has been done, and there is still room.’
chapters.zh: 仆人说：『主啊，你所吩咐的已经办了，还有空座。』

chapters.en: So the master told his servant, ‘Go out to the highways and hedges and compel them to come in, so that my house will be full.
chapters.zh: 主人对仆人说：『你出去到路上和篱笆那里，勉强人进来，坐满我的屋子。

chapters.en: For I tell you, not one of those men who were invited will taste my banquet.’”
chapters.zh: 我告诉你们，先前所请的人没有一个得尝我的筵席。』」

chapters.en: Now large crowds were traveling with Jesus, and He turned and said to them,
chapters.zh: 有极多的人和耶稣同行。他转过来对他们说：

chapters.en: “If anyone comes to Me and does not hate his father and mother and wife and children and brothers and sisters—yes, even his own life—he cannot be My disciple.
chapters.zh: 「人到我这里来，若不爱我胜过爱〔注：爱我胜过爱：原文是恨〕自己的父母、妻子、儿女、弟兄、姊妹，和自己的性命，就不能作我的门徒。

chapters.en: And whoever does not carry his cross and follow Me cannot be My disciple.
chapters.zh: 凡不背着自己十字架跟从我的，也不能作我的门徒。

chapters.en: Which of you, wishing to build a tower, does not first sit down and count the cost to see if he has the resources to complete it?
chapters.zh: 你们哪一个要盖一座楼，不先坐下算计花费，能盖成不能呢？

chapters.en: Otherwise, if he lays the foundation and is unable to finish the work, everyone who sees it will ridicule him,
chapters.zh: 恐怕安了地基，不能成功，看见的人都笑话他，说：

chapters.en: saying, ‘This man could not finish what he started to build.’
chapters.zh: 『这个人开了工，却不能完工。』

chapters.en: Or what king on his way to war with another king will not first sit down and consider whether he can engage with ten thousand men the one coming against him with twenty thousand?
chapters.zh: 或是一个王出去和别的王打仗，岂不先坐下酌量，能用一万兵去敌那领二万兵来攻打他的吗？

chapters.en: And if he is unable, he will send a delegation while the other king is still far off, to ask for terms of peace.
chapters.zh: 若是不能，就趁敌人还远的时候，派使者去求和息的条款。

chapters.en: In the same way, any one of you who does not give up everything he has cannot be My disciple.
chapters.zh: 这样，你们无论什么人，若不撇下一切所有的，就不能作我的门徒。」

chapters.en: Salt is good, but if the salt loses its savor, with what will it be seasoned?
chapters.zh: 「盐本是好的；盐若失了味，可用什么叫它再咸呢？

chapters.en:
It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile, and it is thrown out.
He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
chapters.zh: 或用在田里，或堆在粪里，都不合式，只好丢在外面。有耳可听的，就应当听！」

chapters.en: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were gathering around to listen to Jesus.
chapters.zh: 众税吏和罪人都挨近耶稣，要听他〔讲道〕。

chapters.en: So the Pharisees and scribes began to grumble: “This man welcomes sinners and eats with them.”
chapters.zh: 法利赛人和文士私下议论说：「这个人接待罪人，又同他们吃饭。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus told them this parable:
chapters.zh: 耶稣就用比喻说：

chapters.en: “What man among you, if he has a hundred sheep and loses one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the pasture and go after the one that is lost, until he finds it?
chapters.zh: 「你们中间谁有一百只羊失去一只，不把这九十九只撇在旷野、去找那失去的羊，直到找着呢？

chapters.en: And when he finds it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders,
chapters.zh: 找着了，就欢欢喜喜地扛在肩上，回到家里，

chapters.en: comes home, and calls together his friends and neighbors to tell them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost sheep!’
chapters.zh: 就请朋友邻舍来，对他们说：『我失去的羊已经找着了，你们和我一同欢喜吧！』

chapters.en: I tell you that in the same way there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous ones who do not need to repent.
chapters.zh: 我告诉你们，一个罪人悔改，在天上也要这样为他欢喜，较比为九十九个不用悔改的义人欢喜更大。」

chapters.en: Or what woman who has ten silver coins and loses one of them does not light a lamp, sweep her house, and search carefully until she finds it?
chapters.zh: 「或是一个妇人有十块钱，若失落一块，岂不点上灯，打扫屋子，细细地找，直到找着吗？

chapters.en: And when she finds it, she calls together her friends and neighbors to say, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost coin.’
chapters.zh: 找着了，就请朋友邻舍来，对他们说：『我失落的那块钱已经找着了，你们和我一同欢喜吧！』

chapters.en: In the same way, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of God’s angels over one sinner who repents.”
chapters.zh: 我告诉你们，一个罪人悔改，在上帝的使者面前也是这样为他欢喜。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus said, “There was a man who had two sons.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又说：「一个人有两个儿子。

chapters.en: The younger son said to him, ‘Father, give me my share of the estate.’ So he divided his property between them.
chapters.zh: 小儿子对父亲说：『父亲，请你把我应得的家业分给我。』他父亲就把产业分给他们。

chapters.en: After a few days, the younger son got everything together and journeyed to a distant country, where he squandered his wealth in wild living.
chapters.zh: 过了不多几日，小儿子就把他一切所有的都收拾起来，往远方去了。在那里任意放荡，浪费资财。

chapters.en: After he had spent all he had, a severe famine swept through that country, and he began to be in need.
chapters.zh: 既耗尽了一切所有的，又遇着那地方大遭饥荒，就穷苦起来。

chapters.en: So he went and hired himself out to a citizen of that country, who sent him into his fields to feed the pigs.
chapters.zh: 于是去投靠那地方的一个人；那人打发他到田里去放猪。

chapters.en: He longed to fill his belly with the pods the pigs were eating, but no one would give him a thing.
chapters.zh: 他恨不得拿猪所吃的豆荚充饥，也没有人给他。

chapters.en: Finally he came to his senses and said, ‘How many of my father’s hired servants have plenty of food, but here I am, starving to death!
chapters.zh: 他醒悟过来，就说：『我父亲有多少的雇工，口粮有余，我倒在这里饿死吗？

chapters.en: I will get up and go back to my father and say to him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.
chapters.zh: 我要起来，到我父亲那里去，向他说：父亲！我得罪了天，又得罪了你；

chapters.en: I am no longer worthy to be called your son. Make me like one of your hired servants.”’
chapters.zh: 从今以后，我不配称为你的儿子，把我当作一个雇工吧！』

chapters.en: So he got up and went to his father. But while he was still in the distance, his father saw him and was filled with compassion. He ran to his son, embraced him, and kissed him.
chapters.zh: 于是起来，往他父亲那里去。相离还远，他父亲看见，就动了慈心，跑去抱着他的颈项，连连与他亲嘴。

chapters.en: The son declared, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son. ’
chapters.zh: 儿子说：『父亲！我得罪了天，又得罪了你；从今以后，我不配称为你的儿子。』

chapters.en: But the father said to his servants, ‘Quick! Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet.
chapters.zh: 父亲却吩咐仆人说：『把那上好的袍子快拿出来给他穿；把戒指戴在他指头上；把鞋穿在他脚上；

chapters.en: Bring the fattened calf and kill it. Let us feast and celebrate.
chapters.zh: 把那肥牛犊牵来宰了，我们可以吃喝快乐；

chapters.en: For this son of mine was dead and is alive again! He was lost and is found!’ So they began to celebrate.
chapters.zh: 因为我这个儿子是死而复活，失而又得的。』他们就快乐起来。

chapters.en: Meanwhile the older son was in the field, and as he approached the house, he heard music and dancing.
chapters.zh: 那时，大儿子正在田里。他回来，离家不远，听见作乐跳舞的声音，

chapters.en: So he called one of the servants and asked what was going on.
chapters.zh: 便叫过一个仆人来，问是什么事。

chapters.en: ‘Your brother has returned,’ he said, ‘and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has him back safe and sound.’
chapters.zh: 仆人说：『你兄弟来了；你父亲因为得他无灾无病地回来，把肥牛犊宰了。』

chapters.en: The older son became angry and refused to go in. So his father came out and pleaded with him.
chapters.zh: 大儿子却生气，不肯进去；他父亲就出来劝他。

chapters.en: But he answered his father, ‘Look, all these years I have served you and never disobeyed a commandment of yours. Yet you never gave me even a young goat so I could celebrate with my friends.
chapters.zh: 他对父亲说：『我服事你这多年，从来没有违背过你的命，你并没有给我一只山羊羔，叫我和朋友一同快乐。

chapters.en: But when this son of yours returns from squandering your wealth with prostitutes, you kill the fattened calf for him!’
chapters.zh: 但你这个儿子和娼妓吞尽了你的产业，他一来了，你倒为他宰了肥牛犊。』

chapters.en: ‘Son, you are always with me,’ the father said, ‘and all that is mine is yours.
chapters.zh: 父亲对他说：『儿啊！你常和我同在，我一切所有的都是你的；

chapters.en: But it was fitting to celebrate and be glad, because this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.’”
chapters.zh: 只是你这个兄弟是死而复活、失而又得的，所以我们理当欢喜快乐。』」

chapters.en: Jesus also said to His disciples, “There was a rich man whose manager was accused of wasting his possessions.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又对门徒说：「有一个财主的管家，别人向他主人告他浪费主人的财物。

chapters.en: So he called him in to ask, ‘What is this I hear about you? Turn in an account of your management, for you cannot be manager any longer.’
chapters.zh: 主人叫他来，对他说：『我听见你这事怎么样呢？把你所经管的交代明白，因你不能再作〔我的〕管家。』

chapters.en: The manager said to himself, ‘What shall I do, now that my master is taking away my position? I am too weak to dig and too ashamed to beg.
chapters.zh: 那管家心里说：『主人辞我，不用我再作管家，我将来做什么？锄地呢？无力；讨饭呢？怕羞。

chapters.en: I know what I will do so that after my removal from management, people will welcome me into their homes.’
chapters.zh: 我知道怎么行，好叫人在我不作管家之后，接我到他们家里去。』

chapters.en: And he called in each one of his master’s debtors. ‘How much do you owe my master?’ he asked the first.
chapters.zh: 于是把欠他主人债的，一个一个地叫了来，问头一个说：『你欠我主人多少？』

chapters.en:
‘A hundred measures of olive oil,’ he answered.
‘Take your bill,’ said the manager, ‘sit down quickly, and write fifty.’
chapters.zh: 他说：『一百篓〔注：每篓约五十斤〕油。』管家说：『拿你的帐，快坐下，写五十。』

chapters.en:
Then he asked another, ‘And how much do you owe?’
‘A hundred measures of wheat,’ he replied.
‘Take your bill and write eighty,’ he told him.
chapters.zh: 又问一个说：『你欠多少？』他说：『一百石麦子。』管家说：『拿你的帐，写八十。』

chapters.en: The master commended the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly. For the sons of this age are more shrewd in dealing with their own kind than are the sons of light.
chapters.zh: 主人就夸奖这不义的管家做事聪明；因为今世之子，在世事之上，较比光明之子更加聪明。

chapters.en: I tell you, use worldly wealth to make friends for yourselves so that when it is gone, they will welcome you into eternal dwellings.
chapters.zh: 我又告诉你们，要藉着那不义的钱财结交朋友，到了钱财无用的时候，他们可以接你们到永存的帐幕里去。

chapters.en: Whoever is faithful with very little will also be faithful with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
chapters.zh: 人在最小的事上忠心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不义，在大事上也不义。

chapters.en: So if you have not been faithful with worldly wealth, who will entrust you with true riches?
chapters.zh: 倘若你们在不义的钱财上不忠心，谁还把那真实的〔钱财〕托付你们呢？

chapters.en: And if you have not been faithful with the belongings of another, who will give you belongings of your own?
chapters.zh: 倘若你们在别人的东西上不忠心，谁还把你们自己的东西给你们呢？

chapters.en: No servant can serve two masters. Either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.”
chapters.zh: 一个仆人不能事奉两个主；不是恶这个爱那个，就是重这个轻那个。你们不能又事奉上帝，又事奉玛门。」

chapters.en: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, heard all of this and were scoffing at Jesus.
chapters.zh: 法利赛人是贪爱钱财的；他们听见这一切话，就嗤笑耶稣。

chapters.en: So He said to them, “You are the ones who justify yourselves before men, but God knows your hearts. For what is prized among men is detestable before God.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们是在人面前自称为义的，你们的心，上帝却知道；因为人所尊贵的，是上帝看为可憎恶的。

chapters.en: The Law and the Prophets were proclaimed until John. Since that time, the gospel of the kingdom of God is being preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
chapters.zh: 律法和先知到约翰为止，从此上帝国的福音传开了，人人努力要进去。

chapters.en: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for a single stroke of a pen to drop out of the Law.
chapters.zh: 天地废去较比律法的一点一画落空还容易。

chapters.en: Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery, and he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
chapters.zh: 凡休妻另娶的就是犯奸淫；娶被休之妻的也是犯奸淫。」

chapters.en: Now there was a rich man dressed in purple and fine linen, who lived each day in joyous splendor.
chapters.zh: 「有一个财主穿着紫色〔袍〕和细麻布衣服，天天奢华宴乐。

chapters.en: And a beggar named Lazarus lay at his gate, covered with sores
chapters.zh: 又有一个讨饭的，名叫拉撒路，浑身生疮，被人放在财主门口，

chapters.en: and longing to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Even the dogs came and licked his sores.
chapters.zh: 要得财主桌子上掉下来的〔零碎〕充饥，并且狗来舔他的疮。

chapters.en: One day the beggar died and was carried by the angels to Abraham’s side. And the rich man also died and was buried.
chapters.zh: 后来那讨饭的死了，被天使带去放在亚伯拉罕的怀里。财主也死了，并且埋葬了。

chapters.en: In Hades, where he was in torment, he looked up and saw Abraham from afar, with Lazarus by his side.
chapters.zh: 他在阴间受痛苦，举目远远地望见亚伯拉罕，又望见拉撒路在他怀里，

chapters.en: So he cried out, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me and send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue. For I am in agony in this fire.’
chapters.zh: 就喊着说：『我祖亚伯拉罕哪，可怜我吧！打发拉撒路来，用指头尖蘸点水，凉凉我的舌头；因为我在这火焰里，极其痛苦。』

chapters.en: But Abraham answered, ‘Child, remember that during your lifetime you received your good things, while Lazarus received bad things. But now he is comforted here, while you are in agony.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：『儿啊，你该回想你生前享过福，拉撒路也受过苦；如今他在这里得安慰，你倒受痛苦。

chapters.en: And besides all this, a great chasm has been fixed between us and you, so that even those who wish cannot cross from here to you, nor can anyone cross from there to us.’
chapters.zh: 不但这样，并且在你我之间，有深渊限定，以致人要从这边过到你们那边是不能的；要从那边过到我们这边也是不能的。』

chapters.en: ‘Then I beg you, father,’ he said, ‘send Lazarus to my father’s house,
chapters.zh: 财主说：『我祖啊！既是这样，求你打发拉撒路到我父家去；

chapters.en: for I have five brothers. Let him warn them, so that they will not also end up in this place of torment.’
chapters.zh: 因为我还有五个弟兄，他可以对他们作见证，免得他们也来到这痛苦的地方。』

chapters.en: But Abraham replied, ‘They have Moses and the Prophets; let your brothers listen to them.’
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：『他们有摩西和先知〔的话〕可以听从。』

chapters.en: ‘No, father Abraham,’ he said, ‘but if someone is sent to them from the dead, they will repent.’
chapters.zh: 他说：『我祖亚伯拉罕哪，不是的，若有一个从死里〔复活的〕，到他们那里去的，他们必要悔改。』

chapters.en: Then Abraham said to him, ‘If they do not listen to Moses and the Prophets, they will not be persuaded even if someone rises from the dead.’”
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：『若不听从摩西和先知〔的话〕，就是有一个从死里复活的，他们也是不听劝。』」

chapters.en: Jesus said to His disciples, “It is inevitable that stumbling blocks will come, but woe to the one through whom they come!
chapters.zh: 耶稣又对门徒说：「绊倒人的事是免不了的；但那绊倒人的有祸了。

chapters.en: It would be better for him to have a millstone hung around his neck and to be thrown into the sea than to cause one of these little ones to stumble.
chapters.zh: 就是把磨石拴在这人的颈项上，丢在海里，还强如他把这小子里的一个绊倒了。

chapters.en: Watch yourselves. If your brother sins, rebuke him; and if he repents, forgive him.
chapters.zh: 你们要谨慎！若是你的弟兄得罪〔你〕，就劝戒他；他若懊悔，就饶恕他。

chapters.en: Even if he sins against you seven times in a day, and seven times returns to say, ‘I repent,’ you must forgive him.”
chapters.zh: 倘若他一天七次得罪你，又七次回转，说：『我懊悔了』，你总要饶恕他。」

chapters.en: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith!”
chapters.zh: 使徒对主说：「〔求主〕加增我们的信心。」

chapters.en: And the Lord answered, “If you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be uprooted and planted in the sea,’ and it will obey you.
chapters.zh: 主说：「你们若有信心像一粒芥菜种，就是对这棵桑树说：『你要拔起根来，栽在海里』，它也必听从你们。

chapters.en: Which of you whose servant comes in from plowing or shepherding in the field will say to him, ‘Come at once and sit down to eat’?
chapters.zh: 你们谁有仆人耕地或是放羊，从田里回来，就对他说：『你快来坐下吃饭』呢？

chapters.en: Instead, won’t he tell him, ‘Prepare my meal and dress yourself to serve me while I eat and drink, and afterward you may eat and drink’?
chapters.zh: 岂不对他说：『你给我预备晚饭，束上带子伺候我，等我吃喝完了，你才可以吃喝』吗？

chapters.en: Does he thank the servant because he did what he was told?
chapters.zh: 仆人照所吩咐的去做，主人还谢谢他吗？

chapters.en: So you also, when you have done everything commanded of you, should say, ‘We are unworthy servants; we have only done our duty.’”
chapters.zh: 这样，你们做完了一切所吩咐的，只当说：『我们是无用的仆人，所做的本是我们应分做的。』」

chapters.en: While Jesus was on His way to Jerusalem, He was passing between Samaria and Galilee.
chapters.zh: 耶稣往耶路撒冷去，经过撒马利亚和加利利。

chapters.en: As He entered one of the villages, He was met by ten lepers. They stood at a distance
chapters.zh: 进入一个村子，有十个长大痲疯的，迎面而来，远远地站着，

chapters.en: and raised their voices, shouting, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”
chapters.zh: 高声说：「耶稣，夫子，可怜我们吧！」

chapters.en: When Jesus saw them, He said, “Go, show yourselves to the priests.” And as they were on their way, they were cleansed.
chapters.zh: 耶稣看见，就对他们说：「你们去把身体给祭司察看。」他们去的时候就洁净了。

chapters.en: When one of them saw that he was healed, he came back, praising God in a loud voice.
chapters.zh: 内中有一个见自己已经好了，就回来大声归荣耀与上帝，

chapters.en: He fell facedown at Jesus’ feet in thanksgiving to Him—and he was a Samaritan.
chapters.zh: 又俯伏在耶稣脚前感谢他；这人是撒马利亚人。

chapters.en: “Were not all ten cleansed?” Jesus asked. “Where then are the other nine?
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「洁净了的不是十个人吗？那九个在哪里呢？

chapters.en: Was no one found except this foreigner to return and give glory to God?”
chapters.zh: 除了这外族人，再没有别人回来归荣耀与上帝吗？」

chapters.en: Then Jesus said to him, “Rise and go; your faith has made you well! ”
chapters.zh: 就对那人说：「起来，走吧！你的信救了你了。」

chapters.en: When asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, Jesus replied, “The kingdom of God will not come with observable signs.
chapters.zh: 法利赛人问：「上帝的国几时来到？」耶稣回答说：「上帝的国来到不是眼所能见的。

chapters.en: Nor will people say, ‘Look, here it is,’ or ‘There it is.’ For you see, the kingdom of God is in your midst. ”
chapters.zh: 人也不得说：『看哪，在这里！看哪，在那里！』因为上帝的国就在你们心里〔注：心里：或译中间〕。」

chapters.en: Then He said to the disciples, “The time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not see it.
chapters.zh: 他又对门徒说：「日子将到，你们巴不得看见人子的一个日子，却不得看见。

chapters.en: People will tell you, ‘Look, there He is!’ or ‘Look, here He is!’ Do not go out or chase after them.
chapters.zh: 人将要对你们说：『看哪，在那里！看哪，在这里！』你们不要出去，也不要跟随他们！

chapters.en: For just as the lightning flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other, so will be the Son of Man in His day.
chapters.zh: 因为人子在他〔降临〕的日子，好像闪电从天这边一闪直照到天那边。

chapters.en: But first He must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
chapters.zh: 只是他必须先受许多苦，又被这世代弃绝。

chapters.en: Just as it was in the days of Noah, so also will it be in the days of the Son of Man:
chapters.zh: 挪亚的日子怎样，人子的日子也要怎样。

chapters.en: People were eating and drinking, marrying and being given in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark. Then the flood came and destroyed them all.
chapters.zh: 那时候的人又吃又喝，又娶又嫁，到挪亚进方舟的那日，洪水就来，把他们全都灭了。

chapters.en: It was the same in the days of Lot: People were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.
chapters.zh: 又好像罗得的日子；人又吃又喝，又买又卖，又耕种又盖造。

chapters.en: But on the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.
chapters.zh: 到罗得出所多玛的那日，就有火与硫磺从天上降下来，把他们全都灭了。

chapters.en: It will be just like that on the day the Son of Man is revealed.
chapters.zh: 人子显现的日子也要这样。

chapters.en: On that day, let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve his possessions. Likewise, let no one in the field return for anything he has left behind.
chapters.zh: 当那日，人在房上，器具在屋里，不要下来拿；人在田里，也不要回家。

chapters.en: Remember Lot’s wife!
chapters.zh: 你们要回想罗得的妻子。

chapters.en: Whoever tries to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life will preserve it.
chapters.zh: 凡想要保全生命的，必丧掉生命；凡丧掉生命的，必救活生命。

chapters.en: I tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed: one will be taken and the other left.
chapters.zh: 我对你们说，当那一夜，两个人在一个床上，要取去一个，撇下一个。

chapters.en: Two women will be grinding grain together: one will be taken and the other left.”
chapters.zh: 两个女人一同推磨，要取去一个，撇下一个。
〔注：有古卷加：36 两个人在田里，要取去一个，撇下一个。〕」

chapters.en:
“Where, Lord?” they asked.
Jesus answered, “Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.”
chapters.zh: 门徒说：「主啊，在哪里〔有这事〕呢？」耶稣说：「尸首在哪里，鹰也必聚在那里。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus told them a parable about their need to pray at all times and not lose heart:
chapters.zh: 耶稣设一个比喻，是要人常常祷告，不可灰心。

chapters.en: “In a certain town there was a judge who neither feared God nor respected men.
chapters.zh: 说：「某城里有一个官，不惧怕上帝，也不尊重世人。

chapters.en: And there was a widow in that town who kept appealing to him, ‘Give me justice against my adversary.’
chapters.zh: 那城里有个寡妇，常到他那里，说：『我有一个对头，求你给我伸冤。』

chapters.en: For a while he refused, but later he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect men,
chapters.zh: 他多日不准，后来心里说：『我虽不惧怕上帝，也不尊重世人，

chapters.en: yet because this widow keeps pestering me, I will give her justice. Otherwise, she will wear me out with her perpetual requests.’”
chapters.zh: 只因这寡妇烦扰我，我就给她伸冤吧，免得她常来缠磨我！』」

chapters.en: And the Lord said, “Listen to the words of the unjust judge.
chapters.zh: 主说：「你们听这不义之官所说的话。

chapters.en: Will not God bring about justice for His elect who cry out to Him day and night? Will He delay in helping them?
chapters.zh: 上帝的选民昼夜呼吁他，他纵然为他们忍了多时，岂不终久给他们伸冤吗？

chapters.en: I tell you, He will promptly carry out justice on their behalf. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will He find faith on earth?”
chapters.zh: 我告诉你们，要快快地给他们伸冤了。然而，人子来的时候，遇得见世上有信德吗？」

chapters.en: To some who trusted in their own righteousness and viewed others with contempt, He also told this parable:
chapters.zh: 耶稣向那些仗着自己是义人，藐视别人的，设一个比喻，

chapters.en: “Two men went up to the temple to pray. One was a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.
chapters.zh: 说：「有两个人上殿里去祷告：一个是法利赛人，一个是税吏。

chapters.en: The Pharisee stood by himself and prayed, ‘God, I thank You that I am not like other men—swindlers, evildoers, adulterers—or even like this tax collector.
chapters.zh: 法利赛人站着，自言自语地祷告说：『上帝啊，我感谢你，我不像别人勒索、不义、奸淫，也不像这个税吏。

chapters.en: I fast twice a week and pay tithes of all that I acquire.’
chapters.zh: 我一个礼拜禁食两次，凡我所得的都捐上十分之一。』

chapters.en: But the tax collector stood at a distance, unwilling even to lift up his eyes to heaven. Instead, he beat his breast and said, ‘God, have mercy on me, a sinner!’
chapters.zh: 那税吏远远地站着，连举目望天也不敢，只捶着胸说：『上帝啊，开恩可怜我这个罪人！』

chapters.en: I tell you, this man, rather than the Pharisee, went home justified. For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but the one who humbles himself will be exalted.”
chapters.zh: 我告诉你们，这人回家去比那人倒算为义了；因为，凡自高的，必降为卑；自卑的，必升为高。」

chapters.en: Now people were even bringing their babies to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them. And when the disciples saw this, they rebuked those who brought them.
chapters.zh: 有人抱着自己的婴孩来见耶稣，要他摸他们；门徒看见就责备那些人。

chapters.en: But Jesus called the children to Him and said, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
chapters.zh: 耶稣却叫他们来，说：「让小孩子到我这里来，不要禁止他们，因为在上帝国的正是这样的人。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，凡要承受上帝国的，若不像小孩子，断不能进去。」

chapters.en: Then a certain ruler asked Him, “Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?”
chapters.zh: 有一个官问耶稣说：「良善的夫子，我该做什么事才可以承受永生？」

chapters.en: “Why do you call Me good?” Jesus replied. “No one is good except God alone.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「你为什么称我是良善的？除了上帝一位之外，再没有良善的。

chapters.en: You know the commandments: ‘Do not commit adultery, do not murder, do not steal, do not bear false witness, honor your father and mother.’ ”
chapters.zh: 诫命你是晓得的：『不可奸淫；不可杀人；不可偷盗；不可作假见证；当孝敬父母。』」

chapters.en: “All these I have kept from my youth,” he said.
chapters.zh: 那人说：「这一切我从小都遵守了。」

chapters.en: On hearing this, Jesus told him, “You still lack one thing: Sell everything you own and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣听见了，就说：「你还缺少一件：要变卖你一切所有的，分给穷人，就必有财宝在天上；你还要来跟从我。」

chapters.en: But when the ruler heard this, he became very sad, because he was extremely wealthy.
chapters.zh: 他听见这话，就甚忧愁，因为他很富足。

chapters.en: Seeing the man’s sadness, Jesus said, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!
chapters.zh: 耶稣看见他，就说：「有钱财的人进上帝的国是何等的难哪！

chapters.en: Indeed, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
chapters.zh: 骆驼穿过针的眼比财主进上帝的国还容易呢！」

chapters.en: Those who heard this asked, “Who then can be saved?”
chapters.zh: 听见的人说：「这样，谁能得救呢？」

chapters.en: But Jesus said, “What is impossible with man is possible with God.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「在人所不能的事，在上帝却能。」

chapters.en: “Look,” said Peter, “we have left all we had to follow You.”
chapters.zh: 彼得说：「看哪，我们已经撇下自己所有的跟从你了。」

chapters.en: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “no one who has left home or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我实在告诉你们，人为上帝的国撇下房屋，或是妻子、弟兄、父母、儿女，

chapters.en: will fail to receive many times more in this age—and in the age to come, eternal life.”
chapters.zh: 没有在今世不得百倍，在来世不得永生的。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus took the Twelve aside and said to them, “Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and everything the prophets have written about the Son of Man will be fulfilled.
chapters.zh: 耶稣带着十二个门徒，对他们说：「看哪，我们上耶路撒冷去，先知所写的一切事都要成就在人子身上。

chapters.en: He will be delivered over to the Gentiles and will be mocked and insulted and spit upon.
chapters.zh: 他将要被交给外邦人；他们要戏弄他，凌辱他，吐唾沫在他脸上，

chapters.en: They will flog Him and kill Him, and on the third day He will rise again.”
chapters.zh: 并要鞭打他，杀害他；第三日他要复活。」

chapters.en: But the disciples did not understand any of these things. The meaning was hidden from them, and they did not comprehend what He was saying.
chapters.zh: 这些事门徒一样也不懂得，意思乃是隐藏的；他们不晓得所说的是什么。

chapters.en: As Jesus drew near to Jericho, a blind man was sitting beside the road, begging.
chapters.zh: 耶稣将近耶利哥的时候，有一个瞎子坐在路旁讨饭。

chapters.en: When he heard the crowd going by, he asked what was happening.
chapters.zh: 听见许多人经过，就问是什么事。

chapters.en: “Jesus of Nazareth is passing by,” they told him.
chapters.zh: 他们告诉他，是拿撒勒人耶稣经过。

chapters.en: So he called out, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”
chapters.zh: 他就呼叫说：「大卫的子孙耶稣啊，可怜我吧！」

chapters.en: Those who led the way admonished him to be silent, but he cried out all the louder, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”
chapters.zh: 在前头走的人就责备他，不许他作声；他却越发喊叫说：「大卫的子孙，可怜我吧！」

chapters.en: Jesus stopped and directed that the man be brought to Him. When he had come near, Jesus asked him,
chapters.zh: 耶稣站住，吩咐把他领过来，到了跟前，就问他说：

chapters.en:
“What do you want Me to do for you?”
“Lord,” he said, “let me see again.”
chapters.zh: 「你要我为你做什么？」他说：「主啊，我要能看见。」

chapters.en: “Receive your sight!” Jesus replied. “Your faith has healed you.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你可以看见！你的信救了你了。」

chapters.en: Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus, glorifying God. And all the people, when they saw it, gave praise to God.
chapters.zh: 瞎子立刻看见了，就跟随耶稣，〔一路〕归荣耀与上帝。众人看见这事，也赞美上帝。

chapters.en: Then Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through.
chapters.zh: 耶稣进了耶利哥，正经过的时候，

chapters.en: And there was a man named Zacchaeus, a chief tax collector, who was very wealthy.
chapters.zh: 有一个人名叫撒该，作税吏长，是个财主。

chapters.en: He was trying to see who Jesus was, but could not see over the crowd because he was small in stature.
chapters.zh: 他要看看耶稣是怎样的人；只因人多，他的身量又矮，所以不得看见，

chapters.en: So he ran on ahead and climbed a sycamore tree to see Him, since Jesus was about to pass that way.
chapters.zh: 就跑到前头，爬上桑树，要看耶稣，因为耶稣必从那里经过。

chapters.en: When Jesus came to that place, He looked up and said, “Zacchaeus, hurry down, for I must stay at your house today.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣到了那里，抬头一看，对他说：「撒该，快下来！今天我必住在你家里。」

chapters.en: So Zacchaeus hurried down and welcomed Him joyfully.
chapters.zh: 他就急忙下来，欢欢喜喜地接待耶稣。

chapters.en: And all who saw this began to grumble, saying, “He has gone to be the guest of a sinful man!”
chapters.zh: 众人看见，都私下议论说：「他竟到罪人家里去住宿。」

chapters.en: But Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, “Look, Lord, half of my possessions I give to the poor, and if I have cheated anyone, I will repay it fourfold.”
chapters.zh: 撒该站着对主说：「主啊，我把所有的一半给穷人；我若讹诈了谁，就还他四倍。」

chapters.en: Jesus said to him, “Today salvation has come to this house, because this man too is a son of Abraham.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「今天救恩到了这家，因为他也是亚伯拉罕的子孙。

chapters.en: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.”
chapters.zh: 人子来，为要寻找、拯救失丧的人。」

chapters.en: While the people were listening to this, Jesus proceeded to tell them a parable, because He was near Jerusalem and they thought the kingdom of God would appear imminently.
chapters.zh: 众人正在听见这些话的时候，耶稣因为将近耶路撒冷，又因他们以为上帝的国快要显出来，就另设一个比喻，说：

chapters.en: So He said, “A man of noble birth went to a distant country to lay claim to his kingship and then return.
chapters.zh: 「有一个贵胄往远方去，要得国回来，

chapters.en: Beforehand, he called ten of his servants and gave them ten minas. ‘Conduct business with this until I return,’ he said.
chapters.zh: 便叫了他的十个仆人来，交给他们十锭〔注：锭：原文作弥拿，一弥拿约银十两〕银子，说：『你们去做生意，直等我回来。』

chapters.en: But his subjects hated him and sent a delegation after him to say, ‘We do not want this man to rule over us.’
chapters.zh: 他本国的人却恨他，打发使者随后去，说：『我们不愿意这个人作我们的王。』

chapters.en: When he returned from procuring his kingship, he summoned the servants to whom he had given the money, to find out what each one had earned.
chapters.zh: 他既得国回来，就吩咐叫那领银子的仆人来，要知道他们做生意赚了多少。

chapters.en: The first servant came forward and said, ‘Master, your mina has produced ten more minas.’
chapters.zh: 头一个上来，说：『主啊，你的一锭银子已经赚了十锭。』

chapters.en: His master replied, ‘Well done, good servant! Because you have been faithful in a very small matter, you shall have authority over ten cities.’
chapters.zh: 主人说：『好！良善的仆人，你既在最小的事上有忠心，可以有权柄管十座城。』

chapters.en: The second servant came and said, ‘Master, your mina has made five minas.’
chapters.zh: 第二个来，说：『主啊，你的一锭银子已经赚了五锭。』

chapters.en: And to this one he said, ‘You shall have authority over five cities.’
chapters.zh: 主人说：『你也可以管五座城。』

chapters.en: Then another servant came and said, ‘Master, here is your mina, which I have laid away in a piece of cloth.
chapters.zh: 又有一个来说：『主啊，看哪，你的一锭银子在这里，我把它包在手巾里存着。

chapters.en: For I was afraid of you, because you are a harsh man. You withdraw what you did not deposit and reap what you did not sow.’
chapters.zh: 我原是怕你，因为你是严厉的人；没有放下的，还要去拿，没有种下的，还要去收。』

chapters.en: His master replied, ‘You wicked servant, I will judge you by your own words. So you knew that I am a harsh man, withdrawing what I did not deposit and reaping what I did not sow?
chapters.zh: 主人对他说：『你这恶仆，我要凭你的口定你的罪。你既知道我是严厉的人，没有放下的，还要去拿，没有种下的，还要去收，

chapters.en: Why then did you not deposit my money in the bank, and upon my return I could have collected it with interest?’
chapters.zh: 为什么不把我的银子交给银行，等我来的时候，连本带利都可以要回来呢？』

chapters.en: Then he told those standing by, ‘Take the mina from him and give it to the one who has ten minas.’
chapters.zh: 就对旁边站着的人说：『夺过他这一锭来，给那有十锭的。』

chapters.en: ‘Master,’ they said, ‘he already has ten!’
chapters.zh: 他们说：『主啊，他已经有十锭了。』

chapters.en: He replied, ‘I tell you that everyone who has will be given more; but the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
chapters.zh: 〔主人说〕：『我告诉你们，凡有的，还要加给他；没有的，连他所有的也要夺过来。

chapters.en: And these enemies of mine who were unwilling for me to rule over them, bring them here and slay them in front of me.’”
chapters.zh: 至于我那些仇敌，不要我作他们王的，把他们拉来，在我面前杀了吧！』」

chapters.en: After Jesus had said this, He went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说完了这话，就在前面走，上耶路撒冷去。

chapters.en: As He approached Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, He sent out two of His disciples,
chapters.zh: 将近伯法其和伯大尼，在一座山名叫橄榄山那里，就打发两个门徒，说：

chapters.en: saying, “Go into the village ahead of you, and as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, on which no one has ever sat. Untie it and bring it here.
chapters.zh: 「你们往对面村子里去，进去的时候，必看见一匹驴驹拴在那里，是从来没有人骑过的，可以解开牵来。

chapters.en: If anyone asks, ‘Why are you untying it?’ tell him, ‘The Lord needs it.’”
chapters.zh: 若有人问为什么解牠，你们就说：『主要用牠。』」

chapters.en: So those who were sent went out and found it just as Jesus had told them.
chapters.zh: 打发的人去了，所遇见的正如耶稣所说的。

chapters.en: As they were untying the colt, its owners asked, “Why are you untying the colt?”
chapters.zh: 他们解驴驹的时候，主人问他们说：「解驴驹做什么？」

chapters.en: “The Lord needs it,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 他们说：「主要用牠。」

chapters.en: Then they led the colt to Jesus, threw their cloaks over it, and put Jesus on it.
chapters.zh: 他们牵到耶稣那里，把自己的衣服搭在上面，扶着耶稣骑上。

chapters.en: As He rode along, the people spread their cloaks on the road.
chapters.zh: 走的时候，众人把衣服铺在路上。

chapters.en: And as He approached the descent from the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of disciples began to praise God joyfully in a loud voice for all the miracles they had seen:
chapters.zh: 将近耶路撒冷，正下橄榄山的时候，众门徒因所见过的一切异能，都欢乐起来，大声赞美上帝，

chapters.en:
“Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!”
“Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!”
chapters.zh: 说： 奉主名来的王是应当称颂的！ 在天上有和平； 在至高之处有荣光。

chapters.en: But some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to Him, “Teacher, rebuke Your disciples!”
chapters.zh: 众人中有几个法利赛人对耶稣说：「夫子，责备你的门徒吧！」

chapters.en: “I tell you,” He answered, “if they remain silent, the very stones will cry out.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我告诉你们，若是他们闭口不说，这些石头必要呼叫起来。」

chapters.en: As Jesus approached Jerusalem and saw the city, He wept over it
chapters.zh: 耶稣快到耶路撒冷，看见城，就为它哀哭，

chapters.en: and said, “If only you had known on this day what would bring you peace! But now it is hidden from your eyes.
chapters.zh: 说：「巴不得你在这日子知道关系你平安的事；无奈这事现在是隐藏的，叫你的眼看不出来。

chapters.en: For the days will come upon you when your enemies will barricade you and surround you and hem you in on every side.
chapters.zh: 因为日子将到，你的仇敌必筑起土垒，周围环绕你，四面困住你，

chapters.en: They will level you to the ground—you and the children within your walls. They will not leave one stone on another, because you did not recognize the time of your visitation from God. ”
chapters.zh: 并要扫灭你和你里头的儿女，连一块石头也不留在石头上，因你不知道眷顾你的时候。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus entered the temple courts and began to drive out those who were selling there.
chapters.zh: 耶稣进了殿，赶出里头做买卖的人，

chapters.en: He declared to them, “It is written: ‘My house will be a house of prayer.’ But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’ ”
chapters.zh: 对他们说：「〔经上〕说： 我的殿必作祷告的殿， 你们倒使它成为贼窝了。」

chapters.en: Jesus was teaching at the temple every day, but the chief priests, scribes, and leaders of the people were intent on killing Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣天天在殿里教训人。祭司长和文士与百姓的尊长都想要杀他，

chapters.en: Yet they could not find a way to do so, because all the people hung on His words.
chapters.zh: 但寻不出法子来，因为百姓都侧耳听他。

chapters.en: One day as Jesus was teaching the people in the temple courts and proclaiming the gospel, the chief priests and scribes, together with the elders, came up to Him.
chapters.zh: 有一天，耶稣在殿里教训百姓，讲福音的时候，祭司长和文士并长老上前来，

chapters.en: “Tell us,” they said, “by what authority are You doing these things, and who gave You this authority?”
chapters.zh: 问他说：「你告诉我们，你仗着什么权柄做这些事？给你这权柄的是谁呢？」

chapters.en: “I will also ask you a question,” Jesus replied. “Tell Me:
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我也要问你们一句话，你们且告诉我。

chapters.en: John’s baptism—was it from heaven, or from men?”
chapters.zh: 约翰的洗礼是从天上来的？是从人间来的呢？」

chapters.en: They deliberated among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why did you not believe him?’
chapters.zh: 他们彼此商议说：「我们若说『从天上来』，他必说：『你们为什么不信他呢？』

chapters.en: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are convinced that John was a prophet.”
chapters.zh: 若说『从人间来』，百姓都要用石头打死我们，因为他们信约翰是先知。」

chapters.en: So they answered that they did not know where it was from.
chapters.zh: 于是回答说：「不知道是从哪里来的。」

chapters.en: And Jesus replied, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我也不告诉你们，我仗着什么权柄做这些事。」

chapters.en: Then He proceeded to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard, rented it out to some tenants, and went away for a long time.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就设比喻对百姓说：「有人栽了一个葡萄园，租给园户，就往外国去住了许久。

chapters.en: At harvest time, he sent a servant to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the tenants beat the servant and sent him away empty-handed.
chapters.zh: 到了时候，打发一个仆人到园户那里去，叫他们把园中当纳的果子交给他；园户竟打了他，叫他空手回去。

chapters.en: So he sent another servant, but they beat him and treated him shamefully, sending him away empty-handed.
chapters.zh: 又打发一个仆人去，他们也打了他，并且凌辱他，叫他空手回去。

chapters.en: Then he sent a third, but they wounded him and threw him out.
chapters.zh: 又打发第三个仆人去，他们也打伤了他，把他推出去了。

chapters.en: ‘What shall I do?’ asked the owner of the vineyard. ‘I will send my beloved son. Perhaps they will respect him.’
chapters.zh: 园主说：『我怎么办呢？我要打发我的爱子去，或者他们尊敬他。』

chapters.en: But when the tenants saw the son, they discussed it among themselves and said, ‘This is the heir. Let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
chapters.zh: 不料，园户看见他，就彼此商量说：『这是承受产业的，我们杀他吧，使产业归于我们！』

chapters.en:
So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.
What then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?
chapters.zh: 于是把他推出葡萄园外，杀了。这样，葡萄园的主人要怎样处治他们呢？

chapters.en:
He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others.”
And when the people heard this, they said, “May such a thing never happen!”
chapters.zh: 他要来除灭这些园户，将葡萄园转给别人。」听见的人说：「这是万不可的！」

chapters.en:
But Jesus looked directly at them and said, “Then what is the meaning of that which is written:
‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone’ ?
chapters.zh: 耶稣看着他们说：「〔经上〕记着： 匠人所弃的石头 已作了房角的头块石头。 这是什么意思呢？

chapters.en: Everyone who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but he on whom it falls will be crushed.”
chapters.zh: 凡掉在那石头上的，必要跌碎；那石头掉在谁的身上，就要把谁砸得稀烂。」

chapters.en: When the scribes and chief priests realized that Jesus had spoken this parable against them, they sought to arrest Him that very hour. But they were afraid of the people.
chapters.zh: 文士和祭司长看出这比喻是指着他们说的，当时就想要下手拿他，只是惧怕百姓。

chapters.en: So they watched Him closely and sent spies who pretended to be sincere. They were hoping to catch Him in His words in order to hand Him over to the rule and authority of the governor.
chapters.zh: 于是窥探耶稣，打发奸细装作好人，要在他的话上得把柄，好将他交在巡抚的政权之下。

chapters.en: “Teacher,” they inquired, “we know that You speak and teach correctly. You show no partiality but teach the way of God in accordance with the truth.
chapters.zh: 奸细就问耶稣说：「夫子，我们晓得你所讲所传都是正道，也不取人的外貌，乃是诚诚实实传上帝的道。

chapters.en: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?”
chapters.zh: 我们纳税给凯撒，可以不可以？」

chapters.en: But Jesus saw through their duplicity and said to them,
chapters.zh: 耶稣看出他们的诡诈，就对他们说：

chapters.en:
“Show Me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?”
“Caesar’s,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 「拿一个银钱来给我看。这像和这号是谁的？」他们说：「是凯撒的。」

chapters.en: So Jesus told them, “Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「这样，凯撒的物当归给凯撒，上帝的物当归给上帝。」

chapters.en: And they were unable to trap Him in His words before the people. And amazed at His answer, they fell silent.
chapters.zh: 他们当着百姓，在这话上得不着把柄，又希奇他的应对，就闭口无言了。

chapters.en: Then some of the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to question Him.
chapters.zh: 撒都该人常说没有复活的事。有几个来问耶稣说：

chapters.en: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man is to marry his brother’s widow and raise up offspring for him.
chapters.zh: 「夫子！摩西为我们写着说：『人若有妻无子就死了，他兄弟当娶他的妻，为哥哥生子立后。』

chapters.en: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married a wife but died childless.
chapters.zh: 有弟兄七人，第一个娶了妻，没有孩子死了；

chapters.en: Then the second
chapters.zh: 第二个、第三个也娶过她；

chapters.en: and the third married the widow, and in the same way all seven died, leaving no children.
chapters.zh: 那七个人都娶过她，没有留下孩子就死了。

chapters.en: And last of all, the woman died.
chapters.zh: 后来妇人也死了。

chapters.en: So then, in the resurrection, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her.”
chapters.zh: 这样，当复活的时候，她是哪一个的妻子呢？因为他们七个人都娶过她。」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “The sons of this age marry and are given in marriage.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「这世界的人有娶有嫁；

chapters.en: But those who are considered worthy to share in the age to come and in the resurrection from the dead will neither marry nor be given in marriage.
chapters.zh: 惟有算为配得那世界，与从死里复活的人也不娶也不嫁；

chapters.en: In fact, they can no longer die, because they are like the angels. And since they are sons of the resurrection, they are sons of God.
chapters.zh: 因为他们不能再死，和天使一样；既是复活的人，就为上帝的儿子。

chapters.en: Even Moses demonstrates that the dead are raised, in the passage about the burning bush. For he calls the Lord ‘the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’
chapters.zh: 至于死人复活，摩西在荆棘篇上，称主是亚伯拉罕的上帝，以撒的上帝，雅各的上帝，就指示明白了。

chapters.en: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for to Him all are alive.”
chapters.zh: 上帝原不是死人的上帝，乃是活人的上帝；因为在他那里〔注：那里：或译看来〕，人都是活的。」

chapters.en: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, You have spoken well!”
chapters.zh: 有几个文士说：「夫子！你说得好。」

chapters.en: And they did not dare to question Him any further.
chapters.zh: 以后他们不敢再问他什么。

chapters.en: Then Jesus declared, “How can it be said that the Christ is the Son of David?
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「人怎么说基督是大卫的子孙呢？

chapters.en:
For David himself says in the book of Psalms:
‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand
chapters.zh: 诗篇上大卫自己说： 主对我主说： 你坐在我的右边，

chapters.en: until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”’
chapters.zh: 等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。

chapters.en: Thus David calls Him ‘Lord.’ So how can He be David’s son?”
chapters.zh: 大卫既称他为主，他怎么又是大卫的子孙呢？」

chapters.en: In the hearing of all the people, Jesus said to His disciples,
chapters.zh: 众百姓听的时候，耶稣对门徒说：

chapters.en: “Beware of the scribes. They like to walk around in long robes, and they love the greetings in the marketplaces, the chief seats in the synagogues, and the places of honor at banquets.
chapters.zh: 「你们要防备文士。他们好穿长衣游行，喜爱人在街市上问他们安，又喜爱会堂里的高位，筵席上的首座；

chapters.en: They defraud widows of their houses, and for a show make lengthy prayers. These men will receive greater condemnation.”
chapters.zh: 他们侵吞寡妇的家产，假意作很长的祷告。这些人要受更重的刑罚！」

chapters.en: Then Jesus looked up and saw the rich putting their gifts into the treasury,
chapters.zh: 耶稣抬头观看，见财主把捐项投在库里，

chapters.en: and He saw a poor widow put in two small copper coins.
chapters.zh: 又见一个穷寡妇投了两个小钱，

chapters.en: “Truly I tell you,” He said, “this poor widow has put in more than all the others.
chapters.zh: 就说：「我实在告诉你们，这穷寡妇所投的比众人还多；

chapters.en: For they all contributed out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.”
chapters.zh: 因为众人都是自己有余，拿出来投在捐项里，但这寡妇是自己不足，把她一切养生的都投上了。」

chapters.en: As some of the disciples were remarking how the temple was adorned with beautiful stones and consecrated gifts, Jesus said,
chapters.zh: 有人谈论圣殿是用美石和供物妆饰的；

chapters.en: “As for what you see here, the time will come when not one stone will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣就说：「论到你们所看见的这一切，将来日子到了，在这里没有一块石头留在石头上，不被拆毁了。」

chapters.en: “Teacher,” they asked, “when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to take place?”
chapters.zh: 他们问他说：「夫子！什么时候有这事呢？这事将到的时候有什么预兆呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “See to it that you are not deceived. For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and, ‘The time is near.’ Do not follow them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们要谨慎，不要受迷惑；因为将来有好些人冒我的名来，说：『我是〔基督〕』，又说：『时候近了』，你们不要跟从他们！

chapters.en: When you hear of wars and rebellions, do not be alarmed. These things must happen first, but the end is not imminent.”
chapters.zh: 你们听见打仗和扰乱的事，不要惊惶；因为这些事必须先有，只是末期不能立时就到。」

chapters.en: Then He told them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
chapters.zh: 当时，耶稣对他们说：「民要攻打民，国要攻打国；

chapters.en: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and pestilences in various places, along with fearful sights and great signs from heaven.
chapters.zh: 地要大大震动，多处必有饥荒、瘟疫，又有可怕的异象和大神迹从天上显现。

chapters.en: But before all this, they will seize you and persecute you. On account of My name they will deliver you to the synagogues and prisons, and they will bring you before kings and governors.
chapters.zh: 但这一切的事以先，人要下手拿住你们，逼迫你们，把你们交给会堂，并且收在监里，又为我的名拉你们到君王诸侯面前。

chapters.en: This will be your opportunity to serve as witnesses.
chapters.zh: 但这些事终必为你们的见证。

chapters.en: So make up your mind not to worry beforehand how to defend yourselves.
chapters.zh: 所以，你们当立定心意，不要预先思想怎样分诉；

chapters.en: For I will give you speech and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.
chapters.zh: 因为我必赐你们口才、智慧，是你们一切敌人所敌不住、驳不倒的。

chapters.en: You will be betrayed even by parents and brothers and relatives and friends, and some of you will be put to death.
chapters.zh: 连你们的父母、弟兄、亲族、朋友也要把你们交官；你们也有被他们害死的。

chapters.en: And you will be hated by everyone because of My name.
chapters.zh: 你们要为我的名被众人恨恶，

chapters.en: Yet not even a hair of your head will perish.
chapters.zh: 然而，你们连一根头发也必不损坏。

chapters.en: By your patient endurance you will gain your souls.
chapters.zh: 你们常存忍耐，就必保全灵魂〔注：或译：必得生命〕。」

chapters.en: But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, you will know that her desolation is near.
chapters.zh: 「你们看见耶路撒冷被兵围困，就可知道它成荒场的日子近了。

chapters.en: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those in the city get out, and let those in the country stay out of the city.
chapters.zh: 那时，在犹太的应当逃到山上；在城里的应当出来；在乡下的不要进城；

chapters.en: For these are the days of vengeance, to fulfill all that is written.
chapters.zh: 因为这是报应的日子，使〔经上〕所写的都得应验。

chapters.en: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers! For there will be great distress upon the land and wrath against this people.
chapters.zh: 当那些日子，怀孕的和奶孩子的有祸了！因为将有大灾难降在这地方，也有震怒临到这百姓。

chapters.en: They will fall by the edge of the sword and be led captive into all the nations. And Jerusalem will be trodden down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
chapters.zh: 他们要倒在刀下，又被掳到各国去。耶路撒冷要被外邦人践踏，直到外邦人的日期满了。」

chapters.en: There will be signs in the sun and moon and stars, and on the earth dismay among the nations, bewildered by the roaring of the sea and the surging of the waves.
chapters.zh: 「日、月、星辰要显出异兆，地上的邦国也有困苦；因海中波浪的响声，就慌慌不定。

chapters.en: Men will faint from fear and anxiety over what is coming upon the earth, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
chapters.zh: 天势都要震动，人想起那将要临到世界的事，就都吓得魂不附体。

chapters.en: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
chapters.zh: 那时，他们要看见人子有能力，有大荣耀驾云降临。

chapters.en: When these things begin to happen, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.”
chapters.zh: 一有这些事，你们就当挺身昂首，因为你们得赎的日子近了。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus told them a parable: “Look at the fig tree and all the trees.
When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又设比喻对他们说：「你们看无花果树和各样的树；它发芽的时候，你们一看见，自然晓得夏天近了。

chapters.en: So also, when you see these things happening, know that the kingdom of God is near.
chapters.zh: 这样，你们看见这些事渐渐地成就，也该晓得上帝的国近了。

chapters.en: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
chapters.zh: 我实在告诉你们，这世代还没有过去，这些事都要成就。

chapters.en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
chapters.zh: 天地要废去，我的话却不能废去。」

chapters.en: But watch yourselves, or your hearts will be weighed down by dissipation, drunkenness, and the worries of life—and that day will spring upon you suddenly like a snare.
chapters.zh: 「你们要谨慎，恐怕因贪食、醉酒，并今生的思虑累住你们的心，那日子就如同网罗忽然临到你们；

chapters.en: For it will come upon all who dwell on the face of all the earth.
chapters.zh: 因为那日子要〔这样〕临到全地上一切居住的人。

chapters.en: So keep watch at all times, and pray that you may have the strength to escape all that is about to happen and to stand before the Son of Man.”
chapters.zh: 你们要时时警醒，常常祈求，使你们能逃避这一切要来的事，得以站立在人子面前。」

chapters.en: Every day Jesus taught at the temple, but every evening He went out to spend the night on the Mount of Olives.
chapters.zh: 耶稣每日在殿里教训人，每夜出城在一座山，名叫橄榄山住宿。

chapters.en: And early in the morning all the people would come to hear Him at the temple.
chapters.zh: 众百姓清早上〔圣〕殿，到耶稣那里，要听他讲道。

chapters.en: Now the Feast of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover, was approaching,
chapters.zh: 除酵节（又名逾越〔节〕）近了。

chapters.en: and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a way to put Jesus to death, for they feared the people.
chapters.zh: 祭司长和文士想法子怎么才能杀害耶稣，是因他们惧怕百姓。

chapters.en: Then Satan entered Judas Iscariot, who was one of the Twelve.
chapters.zh: 这时，撒但入了那称为加略人犹大的心；他本是十二门徒里的一个。

chapters.en: And Judas went to discuss with the chief priests and temple officers how he might betray Jesus to them.
chapters.zh: 他去和祭司长并守殿官商量，怎么可以把耶稣交给他们。

chapters.en: They were delighted and agreed to give him money.
chapters.zh: 他们欢喜，就约定给他银子。

chapters.en: Judas consented, and began to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus to them in the absence of a crowd.
chapters.zh: 他应允了，就找机会，要趁众人不在跟前的时候把耶稣交给他们。

chapters.en: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb was to be sacrificed.
chapters.zh: 除酵〔节〕，须宰逾越〔羊羔〕的那一天到了。

chapters.en: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and make preparations for us to eat the Passover.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣打发彼得、约翰，说：「你们去为我们预备逾越〔节的筵席〕，好叫我们吃。」

chapters.en: “Where do You want us to prepare it?” they asked.
chapters.zh: 他们问他说：「要我们在哪里预备？」

chapters.en: He answered, “When you enter the city, a man carrying a jug of water will meet you. Follow him to the house he enters,
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们进了城，必有人拿着一瓶水迎面而来，你们就跟着他，到他所进的房子里去，

chapters.en: and say to the owner of that house, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?’
chapters.zh: 对那家的主人说：『夫子说：客房在哪里？我与门徒好在那里吃逾越〔节的筵席〕。』

chapters.en: And he will show you a large upper room, already furnished. Make preparations there.”
chapters.zh: 他必指给你们摆设整齐的一间大楼，你们就在那里预备。」

chapters.en: So they went and found it just as Jesus had told them. And they prepared the Passover.
chapters.zh: 他们去了，所遇见的正如耶稣所说的；他们就预备了逾越〔节的筵席〕。

chapters.en: When the hour had come, Jesus reclined at the table with His apostles.
chapters.zh: 时候到了，耶稣坐席，使徒也和他同坐。

chapters.en: And He said to them, “I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before My suffering.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「我很愿意在受害以先和你们吃这逾越〔节的筵席〕。

chapters.en: For I tell you that I will not eat it again until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God.”
chapters.zh: 我告诉你们，我不〔再〕吃〔这筵席〕，直到成就在上帝的国里。」

chapters.en: After taking the cup, He gave thanks and said, “Take this and divide it among yourselves.
chapters.zh: 耶稣接过杯来，祝谢了，说：「你们拿这个，大家分着喝。

chapters.en: For I tell you that I will not drink of the fruit of the vine from now on until the kingdom of God comes.”
chapters.zh: 我告诉你们，从今以后，我不再喝这葡萄汁，直等上帝的国来到。」

chapters.en: And He took the bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, “This is My body, given for you; do this in remembrance of Me.”
chapters.zh: 又拿起饼来，祝谢了，就擘开，递给他们，说：「这是我的身体，为你们舍的，你们也应当如此行，为的是记念我。」

chapters.en: In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood, which is poured out for you.
chapters.zh: 饭后也照样拿起杯来，说：「这杯是用我血所立的新约，是为你们流出来的。

chapters.en: Look! The hand of My betrayer is with Mine on the table.
chapters.zh: 看哪，那卖我之人的手与我一同在桌子上。

chapters.en: Indeed, the Son of Man will go as it has been determined, but woe to that man who betrays Him.”
chapters.zh: 人子固然要照所预定的去世，但卖人子的人有祸了！」

chapters.en: Then they began to question among themselves which of them was going to do this.
chapters.zh: 他们就彼此对问，是哪一个要做这事。

chapters.en: A dispute also arose among the disciples as to which of them should be considered the greatest.
chapters.zh: 门徒起了争论，他们中间哪一个可算为大。

chapters.en: So Jesus declared, “The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them, and those in authority over them call themselves benefactors.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「外邦人有君王为主治理他们，那掌权管他们的称为恩主。

chapters.en: But you shall not be like them. Instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who leads like the one who serves.
chapters.zh: 但你们不可这样；你们里头为大的，倒要像年幼的，为首领的，倒要像服事人的。

chapters.en: For who is greater, the one who reclines at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who reclines? But I am among you as one who serves.
chapters.zh: 是谁为大？是坐席的呢？是服事人的呢？不是坐席的大吗？然而，我在你们中间如同服事人的。

chapters.en: You are the ones who have stood by Me in My trials.
chapters.zh: 我在磨炼之中，常和我同在的就是你们。

chapters.en: And I bestow on you a kingdom, just as My Father has bestowed one on Me,
chapters.zh: 我将国赐给你们，正如我父赐给我一样，

chapters.en: so that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
chapters.zh: 叫你们在我国里，坐在我的席上吃喝，并且坐在宝座上，审判以色列十二个支派。」

chapters.en: Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift all of you like wheat.
chapters.zh: 〔主又说〕：「西门！西门！撒但想要得着你们，好筛你们像筛麦子一样；

chapters.en: But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith will not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.”
chapters.zh: 但我已经为你祈求，叫你不至于失了信心。你回头以后，要坚固你的弟兄。」

chapters.en: “Lord,” said Peter, “I am ready to go with You even to prison and to death.”
chapters.zh: 彼得说：「主啊，我就是同你下监，同你受死，也是甘心！」

chapters.en: But Jesus replied, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow today until you have denied three times that you know Me.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「彼得，我告诉你，今日鸡还没有叫，你要三次说不认得我。」

chapters.en:
Then Jesus asked them, “When I sent you out without purse or bag or sandals, did you lack anything?”
“Nothing,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又对他们说：「我差你们出去的时候，没有钱囊，没有口袋，没有鞋，你们缺少什么没有？」他们说：「没有。」

chapters.en: “Now, however,” He told them, “the one with a purse should take it, and likewise a bag; and the one without a sword should sell his cloak and buy one.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「但如今有钱囊的可以带着，有口袋的也可以带着，没有刀的要卖衣服买刀。

chapters.en: For I tell you that this Scripture must be fulfilled in Me: ‘And He was numbered with the transgressors.’ For what is written about Me is reaching its fulfillment.”
chapters.zh: 我告诉你们，〔经上〕写着说：『他被列在罪犯之中。』这话必应验在我身上，因为那关系我的事必然成就。」

chapters.en:
So they said, “Look, Lord, here are two swords.”
“That is enough,” He answered.
chapters.zh: 他们说：「主啊，请看！这里有两把刀。」耶稣说：「够了。」

chapters.en: Jesus went out as usual to the Mount of Olives, and the disciples followed Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣出来，照常往橄榄山去，门徒也跟随他。

chapters.en: When He came to the place, He told them, “Pray that you will not enter into temptation.”
chapters.zh: 到了那地方，就对他们说：「你们要祷告，免得入了迷惑。」

chapters.en: And He withdrew about a stone’s throw beyond them, where He knelt down and prayed,
chapters.zh: 于是离开他们约有扔一块石头那么远，跪下祷告，

chapters.en: “Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.”
chapters.zh: 说：「父啊！你若愿意，就把这杯撤去；然而，不要成就我的意思，只要成就你的意思。」

chapters.en: Then an angel from heaven appeared to Him and strengthened Him.
chapters.zh: 有一位天使从天上显现，加添他的力量。

chapters.en: And in His anguish, He prayed more earnestly, and His sweat became like drops of blood falling to the ground.
chapters.zh: 耶稣极其伤痛，祷告更加恳切，汗珠如大血点滴在地上。

chapters.en: When Jesus rose from prayer and returned to the disciples, He found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow.
chapters.zh: 祷告完了，就起来，到门徒那里，见他们因为忧愁都睡着了，

chapters.en: “Why are you sleeping?” He asked. “Get up and pray so that you will not enter into temptation.”
chapters.zh: 就对他们说：「你们为什么睡觉呢？起来祷告，免得入了迷惑！」

chapters.en: While He was still speaking, a crowd arrived, led by the man called Judas, one of the Twelve. He approached Jesus to kiss Him.
chapters.zh: 说话之间，来了许多人。那十二个门徒里名叫犹大的，走在前头，就近耶稣，要与他亲嘴。

chapters.en: But Jesus asked him, “Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「犹大！你用亲嘴〔的暗号〕卖人子吗？」

chapters.en: Those around Jesus saw what was about to happen and said, “Lord, should we strike with our swords?”
chapters.zh: 左右的人见光景不好，就说：「主啊！我们拿刀砍可以不可以？」

chapters.en: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
chapters.zh: 内中有一个人把大祭司的仆人砍了一刀，削掉了他的右耳。

chapters.en: But Jesus answered, “No more of this!” And He touched the man’s ear and healed him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「到了这个地步，由他们吧！」就摸那人的耳朵，把他治好了。

chapters.en: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, temple officers, and elders who had come for Him, “Have you come out with swords and clubs as you would against an outlaw?
chapters.zh: 耶稣对那些来拿他的祭司长和守殿官并长老说：「你们带着刀棒出来拿我，如同拿强盗吗？

chapters.en: Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on Me. But this hour belongs to you and to the power of darkness.”
chapters.zh: 我天天同你们在殿里，你们不下手拿我。现在却是你们的时候，黑暗掌权了。」

chapters.en: Then they seized Jesus, led Him away, and took Him into the house of the high priest. And Peter followed at a distance.
chapters.zh: 他们拿住耶稣，把他带到大祭司的宅里。彼得远远地跟着。

chapters.en: When those present had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat down among them.
chapters.zh: 他们在院子里生了火，一同坐着；彼得也坐在他们中间。

chapters.en: A servant girl saw him seated in the firelight and looked intently at him. “This man also was with Him,” she said.
chapters.zh: 有一个使女看见彼得坐在〔火〕光里，就定睛看他，说：「这个人素来也是同那人一伙的。」

chapters.en: But Peter denied it. “Woman, I do not know Him,” he said.
chapters.zh: 彼得却不承认，说：「女子，我不认得他。」

chapters.en:
A short time later, someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them.”
But Peter said, “Man, I am not.”
chapters.zh: 过了不多的时候，又有一个人看见他，说：「你也是他们一党的。」彼得说：「你这个人！我不是。」

chapters.en: About an hour later, another man insisted, “Certainly this man was with Him, for he too is a Galilean.”
chapters.zh: 约过了一小时，又有一个人极力地说：「他实在是同那人一伙的，因为他也是加利利人。」

chapters.en:
“Man, I do not know what you are talking about,” Peter replied.
And immediately, while he was still speaking, the rooster crowed.
chapters.zh: 彼得说：「你这个人！我不晓得你说的是什么！」正说话之间，鸡就叫了。

chapters.en:
And the Lord turned and looked at Peter.
Then Peter remembered the word that the Lord had spoken to him: “Before the rooster crows today, you will deny Me three times.”
chapters.zh: 主转过身来看彼得，彼得便想起主对他所说的话：「今日鸡叫以先，你要三次不认我。」

chapters.en: And he went outside and wept bitterly.
chapters.zh: 他就出去痛哭。

chapters.en: The men who were holding Jesus began to mock Him and beat Him.
chapters.zh: 看守耶稣的人戏弄他，打他，

chapters.en: They blindfolded Him and kept demanding, “Prophesy! Who hit You?”
chapters.zh: 又蒙着他的眼，问他说：「你是先知，告诉我们打你的是谁？」

chapters.en: And they said many other blasphemous things against Him.
chapters.zh: 他们还用许多别的话辱骂他。

chapters.en: At daybreak the council of the elders of the people, both the chief priests and scribes, met together. They led Jesus into their Sanhedrin and said,
chapters.zh: 天一亮，民间的众长老连祭司长带文士都聚会，把耶稣带到他们的公会里，

chapters.en:
“If You are the Christ, tell us.”
Jesus answered, “If I tell you, you will not believe.
chapters.zh: 说：「你若是基督，就告诉我们。」耶稣说：「我若告诉你们，你们也不信；

chapters.en: And if I ask you a question, you will not answer.
chapters.zh: 我若问你们，你们也不回答。

chapters.en: But from now on the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”
chapters.zh: 从今以后，人子要坐在上帝权能的右边。」

chapters.en:
So they all asked, “Are You then the Son of God?”
He replied, “You say that I am.”
chapters.zh: 他们都说：「这样，你是上帝的儿子吗？」耶稣说：「你们所说的是。」

chapters.en: “Why do we need any more testimony?” they declared. “We have heard it for ourselves from His own lips.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「何必再用见证呢？他亲口所说的，我们都亲自听见了。」

chapters.en: Then the whole council rose and led Jesus away to Pilate.
chapters.zh: 众人都起来，把耶稣解到彼拉多面前，

chapters.en: And they began to accuse Him, saying, “We found this man subverting our nation, forbidding payment of taxes to Caesar, and proclaiming Himself to be Christ, a King.”
chapters.zh: 就告他说：「我们见这人诱惑国民，禁止纳税给凯撒，并说自己是基督，是王。」

chapters.en:
So Pilate asked Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?”
“You have said so,” Jesus replied.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多问耶稣说：「你是犹太人的王吗？」耶稣回答说：「你说的是。」

chapters.en: Then Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多对祭司长和众人说：「我查不出这人有什么罪来。」

chapters.en: But they kept insisting, “He stirs up the people all over Judea with His teaching. He began in Galilee and has come all the way here.”
chapters.zh: 但他们越发极力地说：「他煽惑百姓，在犹太遍地传道，从加利利起，直到这里了。」

chapters.en: When Pilate heard this, he asked if the man was a Galilean.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多一听见，就问：「这人是加利利人吗？」

chapters.en: And learning that Jesus was under Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent Him to Herod, who himself was in Jerusalem at that time.
chapters.zh: 既晓得耶稣属希律所管，就把他送到希律那里去。那时希律正在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: When Herod saw Jesus, he was greatly pleased. He had wanted to see Him for a long time, because he had heard about Him and was hoping to see Him perform a miracle.
chapters.zh: 希律看见耶稣，就很欢喜；因为听见过他的事，久已想要见他，并且指望看他行一件神迹，

chapters.en: Herod questioned Jesus at great length, but He gave no answer.
chapters.zh: 于是问他许多的话，耶稣却一言不答。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, the chief priests and scribes stood there, vehemently accusing Him.
chapters.zh: 祭司长和文士都站着，极力地告他。

chapters.en: And even Herod and his soldiers ridiculed and mocked Him. Dressing Him in a fine robe, they sent Him back to Pilate.
chapters.zh: 希律和他的兵丁就藐视耶稣，戏弄他，给他穿上华丽衣服，把他送回彼拉多那里去。

chapters.en: That day Herod and Pilate became friends; before this time they had been enemies.
chapters.zh: 从前希律和彼拉多彼此有仇，在那一天就成了朋友。

chapters.en: Then Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,
chapters.zh: 彼拉多传齐了祭司长和官府并百姓，

chapters.en: and said to them, “You brought me this man as one who was inciting the people to rebellion. I have examined Him here in your presence and found Him not guilty of your charges against Him.
chapters.zh: 就对他们说：「你们解这人到我这里，说他是诱惑百姓的。看哪，我也曾将你们告他的事，在你们面前审问他，并没有查出他什么罪来；

chapters.en: Neither has Herod, for he sent Him back to us. As you can see, He has done nothing deserving of death.
chapters.zh: 就是希律也是如此，所以把他送回来。可见他没有做什么该死的事。

chapters.en: Therefore I will punish Him and release Him.”
chapters.zh: 故此，我要责打他，把他释放了。」
〔注：有古卷加：17 每逢这节期，巡抚必须释放一个囚犯给他们。〕

chapters.en: But they all cried out in unison: “Away with this man! Release Barabbas to us!”
chapters.zh: 众人却一齐喊着说：「除掉这个人！释放巴拉巴给我们！」

chapters.en: (Barabbas had been imprisoned for an insurrection in the city, and for murder.)
chapters.zh: 这巴拉巴是因在城里作乱杀人，下在监里的。

chapters.en: Wanting to release Jesus, Pilate addressed them again,
chapters.zh: 彼拉多愿意释放耶稣，就又劝解他们。

chapters.en: but they kept shouting, “Crucify Him! Crucify Him!”
chapters.zh: 无奈他们喊着说：「钉他十字架！钉他十字架！」

chapters.en: A third time he said to them, “What evil has this man done? I have found in Him no offense worthy of death. So after I punish Him, I will release Him.”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多第三次对他们说：「为什么呢？这人做了什么恶事呢？我并没有查出他什么该死的罪来。所以，我要责打他，把他释放了。」

chapters.en: But they were insistent, demanding with loud voices for Jesus to be crucified. And their clamor prevailed.
chapters.zh: 他们大声催逼彼拉多，求他把耶稣钉在十字架上。他们的声音就得了胜。

chapters.en: So Pilate sentenced that their demand be met.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多这才照他们所求的定案，

chapters.en: As they had requested, he released the one imprisoned for insurrection and murder, and he handed Jesus over to their will.
chapters.zh: 把他们所求的那作乱杀人、下在监里的释放了，把耶稣交给他们，任凭他们的意思行。

chapters.en: As the soldiers led Him away, they seized Simon of Cyrene on his way in from the country, and they put the cross on him to carry behind Jesus.
chapters.zh: 带耶稣去的时候，有一个古利奈人西门，从乡下来；他们就抓住他，把十字架搁在他身上，叫他背着跟随耶稣。

chapters.en: A great number of people followed Him, including women who kept mourning and wailing for Him.
chapters.zh: 有许多百姓跟随耶稣，内中有好些妇女；妇女们为他号咷痛哭。

chapters.en: But Jesus turned to them and said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
chapters.zh: 耶稣转身对她们说：「耶路撒冷的女子，不要为我哭，当为自己和自己的儿女哭。

chapters.en: Look, the days are coming when people will say, ‘Blessed are the barren women, the wombs that never bore, and breasts that never nursed!’
chapters.zh: 因为日子要到，人必说：『不生育的，和未曾怀胎的，未曾乳养婴孩的，有福了！』

chapters.en:
At that time
‘they will say to the mountains, “Fall on us!” and to the hills, “Cover us!”’
chapters.zh: 那时，人要向大山说： 倒在我们身上！ 向小山说： 遮盖我们！

chapters.en: For if men do these things while the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?”
chapters.zh: 「这些事既行在有汁水的树上，那枯干的树将来怎么样呢？」

chapters.en: Two others, who were criminals, were also led away to be executed with Jesus.
chapters.zh: 又有两个犯人，和耶稣一同带来处死。

chapters.en: When they came to the place called The Skull, they crucified Him there, along with the criminals, one on His right and the other on His left.
chapters.zh: 到了一个地方，名叫「髑髅地」，就在那里把耶稣钉在十字架上，又钉了两个犯人：一个在左边，一个在右边。

chapters.en: Then Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.” And they divided up His garments by casting lots.
chapters.zh: 当下耶稣说：「父啊！赦免他们；因为他们所做的，他们不晓得。」〔兵丁〕就拈鬮分他的衣服。

chapters.en: The people stood watching, and the rulers sneered at Him, saying, “He saved others; let Him save Himself if He is the Christ of God, the Chosen One.”
chapters.zh: 百姓站在那里观看。官府也嗤笑他，说：「他救了别人；他若是基督，上帝所拣选的，可以救自己吧！」

chapters.en: The soldiers also mocked Him and came up to offer Him sour wine.
chapters.zh: 兵丁也戏弄他，上前拿醋送给他喝，

chapters.en: “If You are the King of the Jews,” they said, “save Yourself!”
chapters.zh: 说：「你若是犹太人的王，可以救自己吧！」

chapters.en:
Above Him was posted an inscription:
THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
chapters.zh: 在耶稣以上有一个牌子〔注：有古卷加：用希腊、罗马、希伯来的文字〕写着：「这是犹太人的王。」

chapters.en: One of the criminals who hung there heaped abuse on Him. “Are You not the Christ?” he said. “Save Yourself and us!”
chapters.zh: 那同钉的两个犯人有一个讥笑他，说：「你不是基督吗？可以救自己和我们吧！」

chapters.en: But the other one rebuked him, saying, “Do you not even fear God, since you are under the same judgment?
chapters.zh: 那一个就应声责备他，说：「你既是一样受刑的，还不怕上帝吗？

chapters.en: We are punished justly, for we are receiving what our actions deserve. But this man has done nothing wrong.”
chapters.zh: 我们是应该的，因我们所受的与我们所做的相称，但这个人没有做过一件不好的事。」

chapters.en: Then he said, “Jesus, remember me when You come into Your kingdom!”
chapters.zh: 就说：「耶稣啊，你得国降临的时候，求你记念我！」

chapters.en: And Jesus said to him, “Truly I tell you, today you will be with Me in Paradise.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「我实在告诉你，今日你要同我在乐园里了。」

chapters.en: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over all the land until the ninth hour.
chapters.zh: 那时约有午正，遍地都黑暗了，直到申初，

chapters.en: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn down the middle.
chapters.zh: 日头变黑了；殿里的幔子从当中裂为两半。

chapters.en: Then Jesus called out in a loud voice, “Father, into Your hands I commit My Spirit.” And when He had said this, He breathed His last.
chapters.zh: 耶稣大声喊着说：「父啊！我将我的灵魂交在你手里。」说了这话，气就断了。

chapters.en: When the centurion saw what had happened, he gave glory to God, saying, “Surely this was a righteous man. ”
chapters.zh: 百夫长看见所成的事，就归荣耀与上帝，说：「这真是个义人！」

chapters.en: And when all the people who had gathered for this spectacle saw what had happened, they returned home beating their breasts.
chapters.zh: 聚集观看的众人见了这所成的事都捶着胸回去了。

chapters.en: But all those who knew Jesus, including the women who had followed Him from Galilee, stood at a distance watching these things.
chapters.zh: 还有一切与耶稣熟识的人，和从加利利跟着他来的妇女们，都远远地站着看这些事。

chapters.en: Now there was a Council member named Joseph, a good and righteous man,
chapters.zh: 有一个人名叫约瑟，是个议士，为人善良公义；

chapters.en: who had not consented to their decision or action. He was from the Judean town of Arimathea and was waiting for the kingdom of God.
chapters.zh: 众人所谋所为，他并没有附从。他本是犹太、亚利马太城里素常盼望上帝国的人。

chapters.en: He went to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus.
chapters.zh: 这人去见彼拉多，求耶稣的身体，

chapters.en: Then he took it down, wrapped it in a linen cloth, and placed it in a tomb cut into the rock, where no one had yet been laid.
chapters.zh: 就取下来，用细麻布裹好，安放在石头凿成的坟墓里；那里头从来没有葬过人。

chapters.en: It was Preparation Day, and the Sabbath was beginning.
chapters.zh: 那日是预备日，安息日也快到了。

chapters.en: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed, and they saw the tomb and how His body was placed.
chapters.zh: 那些从加利利和耶稣同来的妇女跟在后面，看见了坟墓和他的身体怎样安放。

chapters.en: Then they returned to prepare spices and perfumes. And they rested on the Sabbath, according to the commandment.
chapters.zh: 她们就回去，预备了香料香膏。她们在安息日，便遵着诫命安息了。

chapters.en: On the first day of the week, very early in the morning, the women came to the tomb, bringing the spices they had prepared.
chapters.zh: 七日的头一日，黎明的时候，那些妇女带着所预备的香料来到坟墓前，

chapters.en: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb,
chapters.zh: 看见石头已经从坟墓滚开了，

chapters.en: but when they entered, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.
chapters.zh: 她们就进去，只是不见主耶稣的身体。

chapters.en: While they were puzzling over this, suddenly two men in radiant apparel stood beside them.
chapters.zh: 正在猜疑之间，忽然有两个人站在旁边，衣服放光。

chapters.en: As the women bowed their faces to the ground in terror, the two men asked them, “Why do you look for the living among the dead?
chapters.zh: 妇女们惊怕，将脸伏地。那两个人就对她们说：「为什么在死人中找活人呢？

chapters.en: He is not here; He has risen! Remember how He told you while He was still in Galilee:
chapters.zh: 他不在这里，已经复活了。当记念他还在加利利的时候怎样告诉你们，

chapters.en: ‘The Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and on the third day rise again.’”
chapters.zh: 说：『人子必须被交在罪人手里，钉在十字架上，第三日复活。』」

chapters.en: Then they remembered His words.
chapters.zh: 她们就想起耶稣的话来，

chapters.en: And when they returned from the tomb, they reported all these things to the Eleven and to all the others.
chapters.zh: 便从坟墓那里回去，把这一切的事告诉十一个使徒和其余的人。

chapters.en: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the other women with them who told this to the apostles.
chapters.zh: 那告诉使徒的就是抹大拉的马利亚和约亚拿，并雅各的母亲马利亚，还有与她们在一处的妇女。

chapters.en: But their words seemed like nonsense to them, and they did not believe the women.
chapters.zh: 她们这些话，使徒以为是胡言，就不相信。

chapters.en: Peter, however, got up and ran to the tomb. And after bending down and seeing only the linen cloths, he went away, wondering to himself what had happened.
chapters.zh: 彼得起来，跑到坟墓前，低头往里看，见细麻布独在一处，就回去了，心里希奇所成的事。

chapters.en: That same day two of them were going to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 正当那日，门徒中有两个人往一个村子去；这村子名叫以马忤斯，离耶路撒冷约有二十五里。

chapters.en: They were talking with each other about everything that had happened.
chapters.zh: 他们彼此谈论所遇见的这一切事。

chapters.en: And as they talked and deliberated, Jesus Himself came up and walked along with them.
chapters.zh: 正谈论相问的时候，耶稣亲自就近他们，和他们同行；

chapters.en: But their eyes were kept from recognizing Him.
chapters.zh: 只是他们的眼睛迷糊了，不认识他。

chapters.en:
He asked them, “What are you discussing so intently as you walk along?”
They stood still, with sadness on their faces.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们走路彼此谈论的是什么事呢？」他们就站住，脸上带着愁容。

chapters.en: One of them, named Cleopas, asked Him, “Are You the only visitor to Jerusalem who does not know the things that have happened there in recent days?”
chapters.zh: 二人中有一个名叫革流巴的回答说：「你在耶路撒冷作客，还不知道这几天在那里所出的事吗？」

chapters.en:
“What things?” He asked.
“The events involving Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered. “This man was a prophet, powerful in speech and action before God and all the people.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「什么事呢？」他们说：「就是拿撒勒人耶稣的事。他是个先知，在上帝和众百姓面前，说话行事都有大能。

chapters.en: Our chief priests and rulers delivered Him up to the sentence of death, and they crucified Him.
chapters.zh: 祭司长和我们的官府竟把他解去，定了死罪，钉在十字架上。

chapters.en: But we were hoping He was the One who would redeem Israel. And besides all this, it is the third day since these things took place.
chapters.zh: 但我们素来所盼望、要赎以色列民的就是他！不但如此，而且这事成就，现在已经三天了。

chapters.en: Furthermore, some of our women astounded us. They were at the tomb early this morning,
chapters.zh: 再者，我们中间有几个妇女使我们惊奇；她们清早到了坟墓那里，

chapters.en: but they did not find His body. They came and told us they had seen a vision of angels, who said that Jesus was alive.
chapters.zh: 不见他的身体，就回来告诉我们，说看见了天使显现，说他活了。

chapters.en: Then some of our companions went to the tomb and found it just as the women had described. But Him they did not see.”
chapters.zh: 又有我们的几个人往坟墓那里去，所遇见的正如妇女们所说的，只是没有看见他。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus said to them, “O foolish ones, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken!
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「无知的人哪，先知所说的一切话，你们的心信得太迟钝了。

chapters.en: Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and then to enter His glory?”
chapters.zh: 基督这样受害，又进入他的荣耀，岂不是应当的吗？」

chapters.en: And beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, He explained to them what was written in all the Scriptures about Himself.
chapters.zh: 于是从摩西和众先知起，凡经上所指着自己的话都给他们讲解明白了。

chapters.en: As they approached the village where they were headed, He seemed to be going farther.
chapters.zh: 将近他们所去的村子，耶稣好像还要往前行，

chapters.en:
But they pleaded with Him, “Stay with us, for it is nearly evening and the day is almost over.”
So He went in to stay with them.
chapters.zh: 他们却强留他，说：「时候晚了，日头已经平西了，请你同我们住下吧！」耶稣就进去，要同他们住下。

chapters.en: While He was reclining at the table with them, He took bread, spoke a blessing and broke it, and gave it to them.
chapters.zh: 到了坐席的时候，耶稣拿起饼来，祝谢了，擘开，递给他们。

chapters.en: Then their eyes were opened and they recognized Jesus—and He disappeared from their sight.
chapters.zh: 他们的眼睛明亮了，这才认出他来。忽然耶稣不见了。

chapters.en: They asked each other, “Were not our hearts burning within us as He spoke with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?”
chapters.zh: 他们彼此说：「在路上，他和我们说话，给我们讲解圣经的时候，我们的心岂不是火热的吗？」

chapters.en:
And they got up that very hour and returned to Jerusalem.
There they found the Eleven and those with them, gathered together
chapters.zh: 他们就立时起身，回耶路撒冷去，正遇见十一个使徒和他们的同人聚集在一处，

chapters.en: and saying, “The Lord has indeed risen and has appeared to Simon!”
chapters.zh: 说：「主果然复活，已经现给西门看了。」

chapters.en: Then the two told what had happened on the road, and how they had recognized Jesus in the breaking of the bread.
chapters.zh: 两个人就把路上〔所遇见〕，和擘饼的时候怎么被他们认出来的事，都述说了一遍。

chapters.en: While they were describing these events, Jesus Himself stood among them and said, “Peace be with you.”
chapters.zh: 正说这话的时候，耶稣亲自站在他们当中，说：「愿你们平安！」

chapters.en: But they were startled and frightened, thinking they had seen a spirit.
chapters.zh: 他们却惊慌害怕，以为所看见的是魂。

chapters.en: “Why are you troubled,” Jesus asked, “and why do doubts arise in your hearts?
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们为什么愁烦？为什么心里起疑念呢？

chapters.en: Look at My hands and My feet. It is I Myself. Touch Me and see—for a spirit does not have flesh and bones, as you see I have.”
chapters.zh: 你们看我的手，我的脚，就〔知道〕实在是我了。摸我看看！魂无骨无肉，你们看，我是有的。」

chapters.en: And when He had said this, He showed them His hands and feet.
chapters.zh: 说了这话，就把手和脚给他们看。

chapters.en: While they were still in disbelief because of their joy and amazement, He asked them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”
chapters.zh: 他们正喜得不敢信，并且希奇；耶稣就说：「你们这里有什么吃的没有？」

chapters.en: So they gave Him a piece of broiled fish,
chapters.zh: 他们便给他一片烧鱼。〔注：有古卷加：和一块蜜房。〕

chapters.en: and He took it and ate it in front of them.
chapters.zh: 他接过来，在他们面前吃了。

chapters.en: Jesus said to them, “These are the words I spoke to you while I was still with you: Everything must be fulfilled that is written about Me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets, and the Psalms.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「这就是我从前与你们同在之时所告诉你们的话说：摩西的律法、先知的书，和诗篇上所记的，凡指着我的话都必须应验。」

chapters.en: Then He opened their minds to understand the Scriptures.
chapters.zh: 于是耶稣开他们的心窍，使他们能明白圣经，

chapters.en: And He told them, “This is what is written: The Christ will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,
chapters.zh: 又对他们说：「照〔经上〕所写的，基督必受害，第三日从死里复活，

chapters.en: and in His name repentance and forgiveness of sins will be proclaimed to all nations, beginning in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 并且人要奉他的名传悔改、赦罪的道，从耶路撒冷起直传到万邦。

chapters.en: You are witnesses of these things.
chapters.zh: 你们就是这些事的见证。

chapters.en: And behold, I am sending the promise of My Father upon you. But remain in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high.”
chapters.zh: 我要将我父所应许的降在你们身上，你们要在城里等候，直到你们领受从上头来的能力。」

chapters.en: When Jesus had led them out as far as Bethany, He lifted up His hands and blessed them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣领他们到伯大尼的对面，就举手给他们祝福。

chapters.en: While He was blessing them, He left them and was carried up into heaven.
chapters.zh: 正祝福的时候，他就离开他们，被带到天上去了。

chapters.en: And they worshiped Him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
chapters.zh: 他们就拜他，大大地欢喜，回耶路撒冷去，

chapters.en: praising God continually in the temple.
chapters.zh: 常在殿里称颂上帝。

chapters.en: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
chapters.zh: 太初有道，道与上帝同在，道就是上帝。

chapters.en: He was with God in the beginning.
chapters.zh: 这道太初与上帝同在。

chapters.en: Through Him all things were made, and without Him nothing was made that has been made.
chapters.zh: 万物是藉着他造的；凡被造的，没有一样不是藉着他造的。

chapters.en: In Him was life, and that life was the light of men.
chapters.zh: 生命在他里头，这生命就是人的光。

chapters.en: The Light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
chapters.zh: 光照在黑暗里，黑暗却不接受光。

chapters.en: There came a man who was sent from God. His name was John.
chapters.zh: 有一个人，是从上帝那里差来的，名叫约翰。

chapters.en: He came as a witness to testify about the Light, so that through him everyone might believe.
chapters.zh: 这人来，为要作见证，就是为光作见证，叫众人因他可以信。

chapters.en: He himself was not the Light, but he came to testify about the Light.
chapters.zh: 他不是那光，乃是要为光作见证。

chapters.en: The true Light, who gives light to everyone, was coming into the world.
chapters.zh: 那光是真光，照亮一切生在世上的人。

chapters.en: He was in the world, and though the world was made through Him, the world did not recognize Him.
chapters.zh: 他在世界，世界也是藉着他造的，世界却不认识他。

chapters.en: He came to His own, and His own did not receive Him.
chapters.zh: 他到自己的地方来，自己的人倒不接待他。

chapters.en: But to all who did receive Him, to those who believed in His name, He gave the right to become children of God—
chapters.zh: 凡接待他的，就是信他名的人，他就赐他们权柄作上帝的儿女。

chapters.en: children born not of blood, nor of the desire or will of man, but born of God.
chapters.zh: 这等人不是从血气生的，不是从情欲生的，也不是从人意生的，乃是从上帝生的。

chapters.en: The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us. We have seen His glory, the glory of the one and only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
chapters.zh: 道成了肉身，住在我们中间，充充满满地有恩典有真理。我们也见过他的荣光，正是父独生子的荣光。

chapters.en: John testified concerning Him. He cried out, saying, “This is He of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.’”
chapters.zh: 约翰为他作见证，喊着说：「这就是我曾说：『那在我以后来的，反成了在我以前的，因他本来在我以前。』」

chapters.en: From His fullness we have all received grace upon grace.
chapters.zh: 从他丰满〔的恩典〕里，我们都领受了，而且恩上加恩。

chapters.en: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 律法本是藉着摩西传的；恩典和真理都是由耶稣基督来的。

chapters.en: No one has ever seen God, but the one and only Son, who is Himself God and is at the Father’s side, has made Him known.
chapters.zh: 从来没有人看见上帝，只有在父怀里的独生子将他表明出来。

chapters.en: And this was John’s testimony when the Jews of Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him, “Who are you?”
chapters.zh: 约翰所作的见证记在下面：犹太人从耶路撒冷差祭司和利未人到约翰那里，问他说：「你是谁？」

chapters.en: He did not refuse to confess, but openly declared, “I am not the Christ.”
chapters.zh: 他就明说，并不隐瞒，明说：「我不是基督。」

chapters.en:
