“Then who are you?” they inquired. “Are you Elijah?”
He said, “I am not.”
“Are you the Prophet?”
He answered, “No.”
chapters.zh: 他们又问他说：「这样，你是谁呢？是以利亚吗？」他说：「我不是。」「是那先知吗？」他回答说：「不是。」

chapters.en: So they said to him, “Who are you? We need an answer for those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
chapters.zh: 于是他们说：「你到底是谁，叫我们好回复差我们来的人。你自己说，你是谁？」

chapters.en:
John replied in the words of Isaiah the prophet:
“I am a voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way for the Lord.’”
chapters.zh: 他说：「我就是那在旷野有人声喊着说：『修直主的道路』，正如先知以赛亚所说的。」

chapters.en: Then the Pharisees who had been sent
chapters.zh: 那些人是法利赛人差来的〔注：或译：那差来的是法利赛人〕；

chapters.en: asked him, “Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?”
chapters.zh: 他们就问他说：「你既不是基督，不是以利亚，也不是那先知，为什么施洗呢？」

chapters.en: “I baptize with water,” John replied, “but among you stands One you do not know.
chapters.zh: 约翰回答说：「我是用水施洗，但有一位站在你们中间，是你们不认识的，

chapters.en: He is the One who comes after me, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.”
chapters.zh: 就是那在我以后来的，我给他解鞋带也不配。」

chapters.en: All this happened at Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
chapters.zh: 这是在约旦河外伯大尼〔注：有古卷：伯大巴喇〕，约翰施洗的地方作的见证。

chapters.en: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, “Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
chapters.zh: 次日，约翰看见耶稣来到他那里，就说：「看哪，上帝的羔羊，除去〔注：或译：背负〕世人罪孽的！

chapters.en: This is He of whom I said, ‘A man who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.’
chapters.zh: 这就是我曾说：『有一位在我以后来、反成了在我以前的，因他本来在我以前。』

chapters.en: I myself did not know Him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was that He might be revealed to Israel.”
chapters.zh: 我先前不认识他，如今我来用水施洗，为要叫他显明给以色列人。」

chapters.en: Then John testified, “I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove and resting on Him.
chapters.zh: 约翰又作见证说：「我曾看见圣灵，仿佛鸽子从天降下，住在他的身上。

chapters.en: I myself did not know Him, but the One who sent me to baptize with water told me, ‘The man on whom you see the Spirit descend and rest is He who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.’
chapters.zh: 我先前不认识他，只是那差我来用水施洗的、对我说：『你看见圣灵降下来，住在谁的身上，谁就是用圣灵施洗的。』

chapters.en: I have seen and testified that this is the Son of God. ”
chapters.zh: 我看见了，就证明这是上帝的儿子。」

chapters.en: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.
chapters.zh: 再次日，约翰同两个门徒站在那里。

chapters.en: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Look, the Lamb of God!”
chapters.zh: 他见耶稣行走，就说：「看哪，这是上帝的羔羊！」

chapters.en: And when the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.
chapters.zh: 两个门徒听见他的话，就跟从了耶稣。

chapters.en:
Jesus turned and saw them following. “What do you want?” He asked.
They said to Him, “Rabbi” (which means Teacher), “where are You staying?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣转过身来，看见他们跟着，就问他们说：「你们要什么？」他们说：「拉比，在哪里住？」（拉比翻出来就是夫子。）

chapters.en: “Come and see,” He replied. So they went and saw where He was staying, and spent that day with Him. It was about the tenth hour.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们来看。」他们就去看他在哪里住，这一天便与他同住；那时约有申正了。

chapters.en: Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, was one of the two who heard John’s testimony and followed Jesus.
chapters.zh: 听见约翰的话跟从耶稣的那两个人，一个是西门‧彼得的兄弟安得烈。

chapters.en: He first found his brother Simon and told him, “We have found the Messiah” (which is translated as Christ).
chapters.zh: 他先找着自己的哥哥西门，对他说：「我们遇见弥赛亚了。」（弥赛亚翻出来就是基督。）

chapters.en: Andrew brought him to Jesus, who looked at him and said, “You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas” (which is translated as Peter).
chapters.zh: 于是领他去见耶稣。耶稣看着他，说：「你是约翰的儿子西门〔注：约翰在马太十六章十七节称约拿〕，你要称为矶法。」（矶法翻出来就是彼得。）

chapters.en: The next day Jesus decided to set out for Galilee. Finding Philip, He told him, “Follow Me.”
chapters.zh: 又次日，耶稣想要往加利利去，遇见腓力，就对他说：「来跟从我吧。」

chapters.en: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the same town as Andrew and Peter.
chapters.zh: 这腓力是伯赛大人，和安得烈、彼得同城。

chapters.en: Philip found Nathanael and told him, “We have found the One Moses wrote about in the Law, the One the prophets foretold—Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
chapters.zh: 腓力找着拿但业，对他说：「摩西在律法上所写的和众先知所记的那一位，我们遇见了，就是约瑟的儿子拿撒勒人耶稣。」

chapters.en:
“Can anything good come from Nazareth?” Nathanael asked.
“Come and see,” said Philip.
chapters.zh: 拿但业对他说：「拿撒勒还能出什么好的吗？」腓力说：「你来看！」

chapters.en: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, He said of him, “Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣看见拿但业来，就指着他说：「看哪，这是个真以色列人，他心里是没有诡诈的。」

chapters.en:
“How do You know me?” Nathanael asked.
Jesus replied, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”
chapters.zh: 拿但业对耶稣说：「你从哪里知道我呢？」耶稣回答说：「腓力还没有招呼你，你在无花果树底下，我就看见你了。」

chapters.en: “Rabbi,” Nathanael answered, “You are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!”
chapters.zh: 拿但业说：「拉比，你是上帝的儿子，你是以色列的王！」

chapters.en: Jesus said to him, “Do you believe just because I told you I saw you under the fig tree? You will see greater things than these.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「因为我说『在无花果树底下看见你』，你就信吗？你将要看见比这更大的事」；

chapters.en: Then He declared, “Truly, truly, I tell you, you will all see heaven open and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
chapters.zh: 又说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，你们将要看见天开了，上帝的使者上去下来在人子身上。」

chapters.en: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there,
chapters.zh: 第三日，在加利利的迦拿有娶亲的筵席，耶稣的母亲在那里。

chapters.en: and Jesus and His disciples had also been invited to the wedding.
chapters.zh: 耶稣和他的门徒也被请去赴席。

chapters.en: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to Him, “They have no more wine.”
chapters.zh: 酒用尽了，耶稣的母亲对他说：「他们没有酒了。」

chapters.en: “Woman, what is that to you and to Me?” Jesus replied. “My hour has not yet come.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「母亲〔注：原文是妇人〕，我与你有什么相干？我的时候还没有到。」

chapters.en: His mother said to the servants, “Do whatever He tells you.”
chapters.zh: 他母亲对用人说：「他告诉你们什么，你们就做什么。」

chapters.en: Now six stone water jars had been set there for the Jewish rites of purification. Each could hold from twenty to thirty gallons.
chapters.zh: 照犹太人洁净的规矩，有六口石缸摆在那里，每口可以盛两三桶水。

chapters.en:
Jesus told the servants, “Fill the jars with water.”
So they filled them to the brim.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对用人说：「把缸倒满了水。」他们就倒满了，直到缸口。

chapters.en:
“Now draw some out,” He said, “and take it to the master of the banquet.”
They did so,
chapters.zh: 耶稣又说：「现在可以舀出来，送给管筵席的。」他们就送了去。

chapters.en: and the master of the banquet tasted the water that had been turned into wine. He did not know where it was from, but the servants who had drawn the water knew. Then he called the bridegroom aside
chapters.zh: 管筵席的尝了那水变的酒，并不知道是哪里来的，只有舀水的用人知道。管筵席的便叫新郎来，

chapters.en: and said, “Everyone serves the fine wine first, and then the cheap wine after the guests are drunk. But you have saved the fine wine until now!”
chapters.zh: 对他说：「人都是先摆上好酒，等客喝足了，才摆上次的，你倒把好酒留到如今！」

chapters.en: Jesus performed this, the first of His signs, at Cana in Galilee. He thus revealed His glory, and His disciples believed in Him.
chapters.zh: 这是耶稣所行的头一件神迹，是在加利利的迦拿行的，显出他的荣耀来；他的门徒就信他了。

chapters.en: After this, He went down to Capernaum with His mother and brothers and His disciples, and they stayed there a few days.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，耶稣与他的母亲、弟兄，和门徒都下迦百农去，在那里住了不多几日。

chapters.en: When the Jewish Passover was near, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 犹太人的逾越节近了，耶稣就上耶路撒冷去。

chapters.en: In the temple courts He found men selling cattle, sheep, and doves, and money changers seated at their tables.
chapters.zh: 看见殿里有卖牛、羊、鸽子的，并有兑换银钱的人坐在那里，

chapters.en: So He made a whip out of cords and drove all from the temple courts, both sheep and cattle. He poured out the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就拿绳子做成鞭子，把牛羊都赶出殿去，倒出兑换银钱之人的银钱，推翻他们的桌子，

chapters.en: To those selling doves He said, “Get these out of here! How dare you turn My Father’s house into a marketplace!”
chapters.zh: 又对卖鸽子的说：「把这些东西拿去！不要将我父的殿当作买卖的地方。」

chapters.en: His disciples remembered that it is written: “Zeal for Your house will consume Me.”
chapters.zh: 他的门徒就想起〔经上〕记着说：「我为你的殿心里焦急，如同火烧。」

chapters.en: On account of this, the Jews demanded, “What sign can You show us to prove Your authority to do these things?”
chapters.zh: 因此犹太人问他说：「你既做这些事，还显什么神迹给我们看呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up again.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你们拆毁这殿，我三日内要再建立起来。」

chapters.en: “This temple took forty-six years to build,” the Jews replied, “and You are going to raise it up in three days?”
chapters.zh: 犹太人便说：「这殿是四十六年才造成的，你三日内就再建立起来吗？」

chapters.en: But Jesus was speaking about the temple of His body.
chapters.zh: 但耶稣这话是以他的身体为殿。

chapters.en: After He was raised from the dead, His disciples remembered that He had said this. Then they believed the Scripture and the word that Jesus had spoken.
chapters.zh: 所以到他从死里复活以后，门徒就想起他说过这话，便信了圣经和耶稣所说的。

chapters.en: While He was in Jerusalem at the Passover Feast, many people saw the signs He was doing and believed in His name.
chapters.zh: 当耶稣在耶路撒冷过逾越节的时候，有许多人看见他所行的神迹，就信了他的名。

chapters.en: But Jesus did not entrust Himself to them, for He knew them all.
chapters.zh: 耶稣却不将自己交讬他们；因为他知道万人，

chapters.en: He did not need any testimony about man, for He knew what was in a man.
chapters.zh: 也用不着谁见证人怎样，因他知道人心里所存的。

chapters.en: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a leader of the Jews.
chapters.zh: 有一个法利赛人，名叫尼哥德慕，是犹太人的官。

chapters.en: He came to Jesus at night and said, “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs You are doing if God were not with him.”
chapters.zh: 这人夜里来见耶稣，说：「拉比，我们知道你是由上帝那里来作师傅的；因为你所行的神迹，若没有上帝同在，无人能行。」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again. ”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我实实在在地告诉你，人若不重生，就不能见上帝的国。」

chapters.en: “How can a man be born when he is old?” Nicodemus asked. “Can he enter his mother’s womb a second time to be born?”
chapters.zh: 尼哥德慕说：「人已经老了，如何能重生呢？岂能再进母腹生出来吗？」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and the Spirit.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我实实在在地告诉你，人若不是从水和〔圣〕灵生的，就不能进上帝的国。

chapters.en: Flesh is born of flesh, but spirit is born of the Spirit.
chapters.zh: 从肉身生的就是肉身；从灵生的就是灵。

chapters.en: Do not be amazed that I said, ‘You must be born again.’
chapters.zh: 我说：『你们必须重生』，你不要以为希奇。

chapters.en: The wind blows where it wishes. You hear its sound, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”
chapters.zh: 风随着意思吹，你听见风的响声，却不晓得从哪里来，往哪里去；凡从〔圣〕灵生的，也是如此。」

chapters.en: “How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.
chapters.zh: 尼哥德慕问他说：「怎能有这事呢？」

chapters.en: “You are Israel’s teacher,” said Jesus, “and you do not understand these things?
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你是以色列人的先生，还不明白这事吗？

chapters.en: Truly, truly, I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, and yet you people do not accept our testimony.
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你，我们所说的是我们知道的；我们所见证的是我们见过的；你们却不领受我们的见证。

chapters.en: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?
chapters.zh: 我对你们说地上的事，你们尚且不信，若说天上的事，如何能信呢？

chapters.en: No one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven—the Son of Man.
chapters.zh: 除了从天降下、仍旧在天的人子，没有人升过天。

chapters.en: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,
chapters.zh: 摩西在旷野怎样举蛇，人子也必照样被举起来，

chapters.en: that everyone who believes in Him may have eternal life.
chapters.zh: 叫一切信他的都得永生〔注：或译：叫一切信的人在他里面得永生〕。

chapters.en: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
chapters.zh: 「上帝爱世人，甚至将他的独生子赐给〔他们〕，叫一切信他的，不致灭亡，反得永生。

chapters.en: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.
chapters.zh: 因为上帝差他的儿子降世，不是要定世人的罪〔注：或译：审判世人；下同〕，乃是要叫世人因他得救。

chapters.en: Whoever believes in Him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe has already been condemned, because he has not believed in the name of God’s one and only Son.
chapters.zh: 信他的人，不被定罪；不信的人，罪已经定了，因为他不信上帝独生子的名。

chapters.en: And this is the verdict: The Light has come into the world, but men loved the darkness rather than the Light because their deeds were evil.
chapters.zh: 光来到世间，世人因自己的行为是恶的，不爱光，倒爱黑暗，定他们的罪就是在此。

chapters.en: Everyone who does evil hates the Light, and does not come into the Light for fear that his deeds will be exposed.
chapters.zh: 凡作恶的便恨光，并不来就光，恐怕他的行为受责备。

chapters.en: But whoever practices the truth comes into the Light, so that it may be seen clearly that what he has done has been accomplished in God.”
chapters.zh: 但行真理的必来就光，要显明他所行的是靠上帝而行。」

chapters.en: After this, Jesus and His disciples went into the Judean countryside, where He spent some time with them and baptized.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，耶稣和门徒到了犹太地，在那里居住，施洗。

chapters.en: Now John was also baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because the water was plentiful there, and people kept coming to be baptized.
chapters.zh: 约翰在靠近撒冷的哀嫩也施洗；因为那里水多，众人都去受洗。

chapters.en: (For John had not yet been thrown into prison.)
chapters.zh: （那时约翰还没有下在监里。）

chapters.en: Then a dispute arose between John’s disciples and a certain Jew over the issue of ceremonial washing.
chapters.zh: 约翰的门徒和一个犹太人辩论洁净的礼，

chapters.en: So John’s disciples came to him and said, “Look, Rabbi, the One who was with you beyond the Jordan, the One you testified about—He is baptizing, and everyone is going to Him.”
chapters.zh: 就来见约翰，说：「拉比，从前同你在约旦河外、你所见证的那位，现在施洗，众人都往他那里去了。」

chapters.en: John replied, “A man can receive only what is given him from heaven.
chapters.zh: 约翰说：「若不是从天上赐的，人就不能得什么。

chapters.en: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ, but am sent ahead of Him.’
chapters.zh: 我曾说：『我不是基督，是奉差遣在他前面的』，你们自己可以给我作见证。

chapters.en: The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend of the bridegroom stands and listens for him, and is overjoyed to hear the bridegroom’s voice. That joy is mine, and it is now complete.
chapters.zh: 娶新妇的就是新郎；新郎的朋友站着，听见新郎的声音就甚喜乐。故此，我这喜乐满足了。

chapters.en: He must increase; I must decrease.
chapters.zh: 他必兴旺，我必衰微。」

chapters.en: The One who comes from above is above all. The one who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks as one from the earth. The One who comes from heaven is above all.
chapters.zh: 「从天上来的是在万有之上；从地上来的是属乎地，他所说的也是属乎地。从天上来的是在万有之上。

chapters.en: He testifies to what He has seen and heard, yet no one accepts His testimony.
chapters.zh: 他将所见所闻的见证出来，只是没有人领受他的见证。

chapters.en: Whoever accepts His testimony has certified that God is truthful.
chapters.zh: 那领受他见证的，就印上印，证明上帝是真的。

chapters.en: For the One whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.
chapters.zh: 上帝所差来的就说上帝的话，因为上帝赐〔圣〕灵〔给他〕是没有限量的。

chapters.en: The Father loves the Son and has placed all things in His hands.
chapters.zh: 父爱子，已将万有交在他手里。

chapters.en: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life. Whoever rejects the Son will not see life. Instead, the wrath of God remains on him.”
chapters.zh: 信子的人有永生；不信子的人得不着〔永〕生〔注：原文是不得见永生〕，上帝的震怒常在他身上。」

chapters.en: When Jesus realized that the Pharisees were aware He was gaining and baptizing more disciples than John
chapters.zh: 主知道法利赛人听见他收门徒，施洗，比约翰还多，

chapters.en: (although it was not Jesus who baptized, but His disciples),
chapters.zh: （其实不是耶稣亲自施洗，乃是他的门徒施洗，）

chapters.en: He left Judea and returned to Galilee.
chapters.zh: 他就离了犹太，又往加利利去。

chapters.en: Now He had to pass through Samaria.
chapters.zh: 必须经过撒马利亚，

chapters.en: So He came to a town of Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground that Jacob had given to his son Joseph.
chapters.zh: 于是到了撒马利亚的一座城，名叫觜加，靠近雅各给他儿子约瑟的那块地。

chapters.en: Since Jacob’s well was there, Jesus, weary from His journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
chapters.zh: 在那里有雅各井；耶稣因走路困乏，就坐在井旁。那时约有午正。

chapters.en: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, “Give Me a drink.”
chapters.zh: 有一个撒马利亚的妇人来打水。耶稣对她说：「请你给我水喝。」

chapters.en: (His disciples had gone into the town to buy food.)
chapters.zh: （那时门徒进城买食物去了。）

chapters.en: “You are a Jew,” said the woman. “How can You ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.)
chapters.zh: 撒马利亚的妇人对他说：「你既是犹太人，怎么向我一个撒马利亚妇人要水喝呢？」原来犹太人和撒马利亚人没有来往。

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你若知道上帝的恩赐，和对你说『给我水喝』的是谁，你必早求他，他也必早给了你活水。」

chapters.en: “Sir,” the woman replied, “You have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where then will You get this living water?
chapters.zh: 妇人说：「先生，没有打水的器具，井又深，你从哪里得活水呢？

chapters.en: Are You greater than our father Jacob, who gave us this well and drank from it himself, as did his sons and his livestock?”
chapters.zh: 我们的祖宗雅各将这井留给我们，他自己和儿子并牲畜也都喝这井里的水，难道你比他还大吗？」

chapters.en: Jesus said to her, “Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「凡喝这水的还要再渴；

chapters.en: But whoever drinks the water I give him will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give him will become in him a fount of water springing up to eternal life.”
chapters.zh: 人若喝我所赐的水就永远不渴。我所赐的水要在他里头成为泉源，直涌到永生。」

chapters.en: The woman said to Him, “Sir, give me this water so that I will not get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water.”
chapters.zh: 妇人说：「先生，请把这水赐给我，叫我不渴，也不用来这么远打水。」

chapters.en: Jesus told her, “Go, call your husband and come back.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你去叫你丈夫也到这里来。」

chapters.en:
“I have no husband,” the woman replied.
Jesus said to her, “You are correct to say that you have no husband.
chapters.zh: 妇人说：「我没有丈夫。」耶稣说：「你说没有丈夫是不错的。

chapters.en: In fact, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. You have spoken truthfully.”
chapters.zh: 你已经有五个丈夫，你现在有的并不是你的丈夫。你这话是真的。」

chapters.en: “Sir,” the woman said, “I see that You are a prophet.
chapters.zh: 妇人说：「先生，我看出你是先知。

chapters.en: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say that the place where one must worship is in Jerusalem.”
chapters.zh: 我们的祖宗在这山上礼拜，你们倒说，应当礼拜的地方是在耶路撒冷。」

chapters.en: “Believe Me, woman,” Jesus replied, “a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「妇人，你当信我。时候将到，你们拜父，也不在这山上，也不在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: You worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.
chapters.zh: 你们所拜的，你们不知道；我们所拜的，我们知道，因为救恩是从犹太人出来的。

chapters.en: But a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and in truth, for the Father is seeking such as these to worship Him.
chapters.zh: 时候将到，如今就是了，那真正拜父的，要用心灵和诚实拜他，因为父要这样的人拜他。」

chapters.en: God is Spirit, and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth.”
chapters.zh: 上帝是个灵〔注：或无个字〕，所以拜他的必须用心灵和诚实拜他。」

chapters.en: The woman said, “I know that Messiah” (called Christ) “is coming. When He comes, He will explain everything to us.”
chapters.zh: 妇人说：「我知道弥赛亚（就是那称为基督的）要来；他来了，必将一切的事都告诉我们。」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “I who speak to you am He.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「这和你说话的就是他！」

chapters.en: Just then His disciples returned and were surprised that He was speaking with a woman. But no one asked Him, “What do You want from her?” or “Why are You talking with her?”
chapters.zh: 当下门徒回来，就希奇耶稣和一个妇人说话；只是没有人说：「你是要什么？」或说：「你为什么和她说话？」

chapters.en: Then the woman left her water jar, went back into the town, and said to the people,
chapters.zh: 那妇人就留下水罐子，往城里去，对众人说：

chapters.en: “Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Christ?”
chapters.zh: 「你们来看！有一个人将我素来所行的一切事都给我说出来了，莫非这就是基督吗？」

chapters.en: So they left the town and made their way toward Jesus.
chapters.zh: 众人就出城，往耶稣那里去。

chapters.en: Meanwhile the disciples urged Him, “Rabbi, eat something.”
chapters.zh: 这其间，门徒对耶稣说：「拉比，请吃。」

chapters.en: But He told them, “I have food to eat that you know nothing about.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我有食物吃，是你们不知道的。」

chapters.en: So the disciples asked one another, “Could someone have brought Him food?”
chapters.zh: 门徒就彼此对问说：「莫非有人拿什么给他吃吗？」

chapters.en: Jesus explained, “My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me and to finish His work.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我的食物就是遵行差我来者的旨意，做成他的工。

chapters.en: Do you not say, ‘There are still four months until the harvest’? I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, for they are ripe for harvest.
chapters.zh: 你们岂不说『到收割的时候还有四个月』吗？我告诉你们，举目向田观看，庄稼已经熟了〔注：原文是发白〕，可以收割了。

chapters.en: Already the reaper draws his wages and gathers a crop for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may rejoice together.
chapters.zh: 收割的人得工价，积蓄五谷到永生，叫撒种的和收割的一同快乐。

chapters.en: For in this case the saying ‘One sows and another reaps’ is true.
chapters.zh: 俗语说：『那人撒种，这人收割』，这话可见是真的。

chapters.en: I sent you to reap what you have not worked for; others have done the hard work, and now you have taken up their labor.”
chapters.zh: 我差你们去收你们所没有劳苦的；别人劳苦，你们享受他们所劳苦的。」

chapters.en: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in Jesus because of the woman’s testimony, “He told me everything I ever did.”
chapters.zh: 那城里有好些撒马利亚人信了耶稣，因为那妇人作见证说：「他将我素来所行的一切事都给我说出来了。」

chapters.en: So when the Samaritans came to Him, they asked Him to stay with them, and He stayed two days.
chapters.zh: 于是撒马利亚人来见耶稣，求他在他们那里住下，他便在那里住了两天。

chapters.en: And many more believed because of His message.
chapters.zh: 因耶稣的话，信的人就更多了，

chapters.en: They said to the woman, “We now believe not only because of your words; we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this man truly is the Savior of the world.”
chapters.zh: 便对妇人说：「现在我们信，不是因为你的话，是我们亲自听见了，知道这真是救世主。」

chapters.en: After two days, Jesus left for Galilee.
chapters.zh: 过了那两天，耶稣离了那地方，往加利利去。

chapters.en: Now He Himself had testified that a prophet has no honor in his own hometown.
chapters.zh: 因为耶稣自己作过见证说：「先知在本地是没有人尊敬的。」

chapters.en: Yet when He arrived, the Galileans welcomed Him. They had seen all the great things He had done in Jerusalem at the feast, for they had gone there as well.
chapters.zh: 到了加利利，加利利人既然看见他在耶路撒冷过节所行的一切事，就接待他，因为他们也是上去过节。

chapters.en: So once again He came to Cana in Galilee, where He had turned the water into wine. And there was a royal official whose son lay sick at Capernaum.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又到了加利利的迦拿，就是他从前变水为酒的地方。有一个大臣，他的儿子在迦百农患病。

chapters.en: When he heard that Jesus had come from Judea to Galilee, he went and begged Him to come down and heal his son, who was about to die.
chapters.zh: 他听见耶稣从犹太到了加利利，就来见他，求他下去医治他的儿子，因为他儿子快要死了。

chapters.en: Jesus said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will never believe.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣就对他说：「若不看见神迹奇事，你们总是不信。」

chapters.en: “Sir,” the official said, “come down before my child dies.”
chapters.zh: 那大臣说：「先生，求你趁着我的孩子还没有死就下去。」

chapters.en:
“Go,” said Jesus. “Your son will live.”
The man took Jesus at His word and departed.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「回去吧，你的儿子活了！」那人信耶稣所说的话就回去了。

chapters.en: And while he was still on the way, his servants met him with the news that his boy was alive.
chapters.zh: 正下去的时候，他的仆人迎见他，说他的儿子活了。

chapters.en: So he inquired as to the hour when his son had recovered, and they told him, “The fever left him yesterday at the seventh hour. ”
chapters.zh: 他就问什么时候见好的。他们说：「昨日未时热就退了。」

chapters.en: Then the father realized that this was the very hour in which Jesus had told him, “Your son will live.” And he and all his household believed.
chapters.zh: 他便知道这正是耶稣对他说「你儿子活了」的时候；他自己和全家就都信了。

chapters.en: This was now the second sign that Jesus performed after coming from Judea into Galilee.
chapters.zh: 这是耶稣在加利利行的第二件神迹，是他从犹太回去以后行的。

chapters.en: Some time later there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，到了犹太人的一个节期，耶稣就上耶路撒冷去。

chapters.en: Now there is in Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate a pool with five covered colonnades, which in Hebrew is called Bethesda.
chapters.zh: 在耶路撒冷，靠近羊〔门〕有一个池子，希伯来话叫作毕士大，〔旁边〕有五个廊子；

chapters.en: On these walkways lay a great number of the sick, the blind, the lame, and the paralyzed.
chapters.zh: 里面躺着瞎眼的、瘸腿的、血气枯干的许多病人。〔注：有古卷加：等候水动；4 因为有天使按时下池子搅动那水，水动之后，谁先下去，无论害什么病就痊愈了。〕

chapters.en: One man there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.
chapters.zh: 在那里有一个人，病了三十八年。

chapters.en: When Jesus saw him lying there and realized that he had spent a long time in this condition, He asked him, “Do you want to get well?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣看见他躺着，知道他病了许久，就问他说：「你要痊愈吗？」

chapters.en: “Sir,” the invalid replied, “I have no one to help me into the pool when the water is stirred. While I am on my way, someone else goes in before me.”
chapters.zh: 病人回答说：「先生，水动的时候，没有人把我放在池子里；我正去的时候，就有别人比我先下去。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus told him, “Get up, pick up your mat, and walk.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「起来，拿你的褥子走吧！」

chapters.en:
Immediately the man was made well, and he picked up his mat and began to walk.
Now this happened on the Sabbath day,
chapters.zh: 那人立刻痊愈，就拿起褥子来走了。

chapters.en: so the Jews said to the man who had been healed, “This is the Sabbath! It is unlawful for you to carry your mat.”
chapters.zh: 那天是安息日，所以犹太人对那医好的人说：「今天是安息日，你拿褥子是不可的。」

chapters.en: But he answered, “The man who made me well told me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’”
chapters.zh: 他却回答说：「那使我痊愈的，对我说：『拿你的褥子走吧。』」

chapters.en: “Who is this man who told you to pick it up and walk?” they asked.
chapters.zh: 他们问他说：「对你说『拿褥子走』的是什么人？」

chapters.en: But the man who was healed did not know who it was, for Jesus had slipped away while the crowd was there.
chapters.zh: 那医好的人不知道是谁；因为那里的人多，耶稣已经躲开了。

chapters.en: Afterward, Jesus found the man at the temple and said to him, “See, you have been made well. Stop sinning, or something worse may happen to you.”
chapters.zh: 后来耶稣在殿里遇见他，对他说：「你已经痊愈了，不要再犯罪，恐怕你遭遇的更加利害。」

chapters.en: And the man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
chapters.zh: 那人就去告诉犹太人，使他痊愈的是耶稣。

chapters.en: Now because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jews began to persecute Him.
chapters.zh: 所以犹太人逼迫耶稣，因为他在安息日做了这事。

chapters.en: But Jesus answered them, “To this very day My Father is at His work, and I too am working.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣就对他们说：「我父做事直到如今，我也做事。」

chapters.en: Because of this, the Jews tried all the harder to kill Him. Not only was He breaking the Sabbath, but He was even calling God His own Father, making Himself equal with God.
chapters.zh: 所以犹太人越发想要杀他；因他不但犯了安息日，并且称上帝为他的父，将自己和上帝当作平等。

chapters.en: So Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing by Himself, unless He sees the Father doing it. For whatever the Father does, the Son also does.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，子凭着自己不能做什么，惟有看见父所做的，子才能做；父所做的事，子也照样做。

chapters.en: The Father loves the Son and shows Him all He does. And to your amazement, He will show Him even greater works than these.
chapters.zh: 父爱子，将自己所做的一切事指给他看，还要将比这更大的事指给他看，叫你们希奇。

chapters.en: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so also the Son gives life to whom He wishes.
chapters.zh: 父怎样叫死人起来，使他们活着，子也照样随自己的意思使人活着。

chapters.en: Furthermore, the Father judges no one, but has assigned all judgment to the Son,
chapters.zh: 父不审判什么人，乃将审判的事全交与子，

chapters.en: so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.
chapters.zh: 叫人都尊敬子如同尊敬父一样。不尊敬子的，就是不尊敬差子来的父。

chapters.en: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever hears My word and believes Him who sent Me has eternal life and will not come under judgment. Indeed, he has crossed over from death to life.
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，那听我话、又信差我来者的，就有永生；不至于定罪，是已经出死入生了。

chapters.en: Truly, truly, I tell you, the hour is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，时候将到，现在就是了，死人要听见上帝儿子的声音，听见的人就要活了。

chapters.en: For as the Father has life in Himself, so also He has granted the Son to have life in Himself.
chapters.zh: 因为父怎样在自己有生命，就赐给他儿子也照样在自己有生命，

chapters.en: And He has given Him authority to execute judgment, because He is the Son of Man.
chapters.zh: 并且因为他是人子，就赐给他行审判的权柄。

chapters.en: Do not be amazed at this, for the hour is coming when all who are in their graves will hear His voice
chapters.zh: 你们不要把这事看作希奇。时候要到，凡在坟墓里的，都要听见他的声音，就出来：

chapters.en: and come out—those who have done good to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil to the resurrection of judgment.
chapters.zh: 行善的，复活得生；作恶的，复活定罪。

chapters.en: I can do nothing by Myself; I judge only as I hear. And My judgment is just, because I do not seek My own will, but the will of Him who sent Me.
chapters.zh: 「我凭着自己不能做什么，我怎么听见就怎么审判。我的审判也是公平的；因为我不求自己的意思，只求那差我来者的意思。」

chapters.en: If I testify about Myself, My testimony is not valid.
chapters.zh: 「我若为自己作见证，我的见证就不真。

chapters.en: There is another who testifies about Me, and I know that His testimony about Me is valid.
chapters.zh: 另有一位给我作见证，我也知道他给我作的见证是真的。

chapters.en: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
chapters.zh: 你们曾差人到约翰那里，他为真理作过见证。

chapters.en: Even though I do not accept human testimony, I say these things so that you may be saved.
chapters.zh: 其实，我所受的见证不是从人来的；然而，我说这些话，为要叫你们得救。

chapters.en: John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you were willing for a season to bask in his light.
chapters.zh: 约翰是点着的明灯，你们情愿暂时喜欢他的光。

chapters.en: But I have testimony more substantial than that of John. For the works that the Father has given Me to accomplish—the very works I am doing—testify about Me that the Father has sent Me.
chapters.zh: 但我有比约翰更大的见证；因为父交给我要我成就的事，就是我所做的事，这便见证我是父所差来的。

chapters.en: And the Father who sent Me has Himself testified about Me. You have never heard His voice nor seen His form,
chapters.zh: 差我来的父也为我作过见证。你们从来没有听见他的声音，也没有看见他的形像。

chapters.en: nor does His word abide in you, because you do not believe the One He sent.
chapters.zh: 你们并没有他的道存在心里；因为他所差来的，你们不信。

chapters.en: You pore over the Scriptures because you presume that by them you possess eternal life. These are the very words that testify about Me,
chapters.zh: 你们查考圣经〔注：或译：应当查考圣经〕，因你们以为内中有永生；给我作见证的就是这经。

chapters.en: yet you refuse to come to Me to have life.
chapters.zh: 然而，你们不肯到我这里来得生命。

chapters.en: I do not accept glory from men,
chapters.zh: 「我不受从人来的荣耀。

chapters.en: but I know you, that you do not have the love of God within you.
chapters.zh: 但我知道，你们心里没有上帝的爱。

chapters.en: I have come in My Father’s name, and you have not received Me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will receive him.
chapters.zh: 我奉我父的名来，你们并不接待我；若有别人奉自己的名来，你们倒要接待他。

chapters.en: How can you believe if you accept glory from one another, yet do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?
chapters.zh: 你们互相受荣耀，却不求从独一之上帝来的荣耀，怎能信〔我〕呢？

chapters.en: Do not think that I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, in whom you have put your hope.
chapters.zh: 不要想我在父面前要告你们；有一位告你们的，就是你们所仰赖的摩西。

chapters.en: If you had believed Moses, you would believe Me, because he wrote about Me.
chapters.zh: 你们如果信摩西，也必信我，因为他〔书上〕有指着我写的话。

chapters.en: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how will you believe what I say?”
chapters.zh: 你们若不信他的书，怎能信我的话呢？」

chapters.en: After this, Jesus crossed to the other side of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias).
chapters.zh: 这事以后，耶稣渡过加利利海，就是提比哩亚海。

chapters.en: A large crowd followed Him because they saw the signs He was performing on the sick.
chapters.zh: 有许多人因为看见他在病人身上所行的神迹，就跟随他。

chapters.en: Then Jesus went up on the mountain and sat down with His disciples.
chapters.zh: 耶稣上了山，和门徒一同坐在那里。

chapters.en: Now the Jewish Feast of the Passover was near.
chapters.zh: 那时犹太人的逾越节近了。

chapters.en: When Jesus looked up and saw a large crowd coming toward Him, He said to Philip, “Where can we buy bread for these people to eat?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣举目看见许多人来，就对腓力说：「我们从哪里买饼叫这些人吃呢？」

chapters.en: But He was asking this to test him, for He knew what He was about to do.
chapters.zh: （他说这话是要试验腓力；他自己原知道要怎样行。）

chapters.en: Philip answered, “Two hundred denarii would not buy enough bread for each of them to have a small piece.”
chapters.zh: 腓力回答说：「就是二十两银子的饼，叫他们各人吃一点也是不够的。」

chapters.en: One of His disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to Him,
chapters.zh: 有一个门徒，就是西门‧彼得的兄弟安得烈，对耶稣说：

chapters.en: “Here is a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish. But what difference will these make among so many?”
chapters.zh: 「在这里有一个孩童，带着五个大麦饼、两条鱼，只是分给这许多人还算什么呢？」

chapters.en: “Have the people sit down,” Jesus said. Now there was plenty of grass in that place, so the men sat down, about five thousand of them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们叫众人坐下。」原来那地方的草多，众人就坐下，数目约有五千。

chapters.en: Then Jesus took the loaves and the fish, gave thanks, and distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted.
chapters.zh: 耶稣拿起饼来，祝谢了，就分给那坐着的人；分鱼也是这样，都随着他们所要的。

chapters.en: And when everyone was full, He said to His disciples, “Gather the pieces that are left over, so that nothing will be wasted.”
chapters.zh: 他们吃饱了，耶稣对门徒说：「把剩下的零碎收拾起来，免得有糟蹋的。」

chapters.en: So they collected them and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten.
chapters.zh: 他们便将那五个大麦饼的零碎，就是众人吃了剩下的，收拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。

chapters.en: When the people saw the sign that Jesus had performed, they began to say, “Truly this is the Prophet who is to come into the world.”
chapters.zh: 众人看见耶稣所行的神迹，就说：「这真是那要到世间来的先知！」

chapters.en: Then Jesus, realizing that they were about to come and make Him king by force, withdrew again to a mountain by Himself.
chapters.zh: 耶稣既知道众人要来强逼他作王，就独自又退到山上去了。

chapters.en: When evening came, His disciples went down to the sea,
chapters.zh: 到了晚上，他的门徒下海边去，

chapters.en: got into a boat, and started across the sea to Capernaum. It was already dark, and Jesus had not yet gone out to them.
chapters.zh: 上了船，要过海往迦百农去。天已经黑了，耶稣还没有来到他们那里。

chapters.en: A strong wind was blowing, and the sea grew agitated.
chapters.zh: 忽然狂风大作，海就翻腾起来。

chapters.en: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus approaching the boat, walking on the sea—and they were terrified.
chapters.zh: 门徒摇橹，约行了十里多路，看见耶稣在海面上走，渐渐近了船，他们就害怕。

chapters.en: But Jesus spoke up: “It is I; do not be afraid.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「是我，不要怕！」

chapters.en: Then they were willing to take Him into the boat, and at once the boat reached the shore where they were heading.
chapters.zh: 门徒就喜欢接他上船，船立时到了他们所要去的地方。

chapters.en: The next day, the crowd that had remained on the other side of the sea realized that only one boat had been there, and that Jesus had not boarded it with His disciples, but they had gone away alone.
chapters.zh: 第二日，站在海那边的众人知道那里没有别的船，只有一只小船，又知道耶稣没有同他的门徒上船，乃是门徒自己去的。

chapters.en: However, some boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
chapters.zh: 然而，有几只小船从提比哩亚来，靠近主祝谢后〔分饼给人〕吃的地方。

chapters.en: So when the crowd saw that neither Jesus nor His disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Him.
chapters.zh: 众人见耶稣和门徒都不在那里，就上了船，往迦百农去找耶稣。

chapters.en: When they found Him on the other side of the sea, they asked Him, “Rabbi, when did You get here?”
chapters.zh: 既在海那边找着了，就对他说：「拉比，是几时到这里来的？」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, it is not because you saw these signs that you are looking for Me, but because you ate the loaves and had your fill.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，你们找我，并不是因见了神迹，乃是因吃饼得饱。

chapters.en: Do not work for food that perishes, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on Him God the Father has placed His seal of approval.”
chapters.zh: 不要为那必坏的食物劳力，要为那存到永生的食物劳力，就是人子要赐给你们的，因为人子是父上帝所印证的。」

chapters.en: Then they inquired, “What must we do to perform the works of God?”
chapters.zh: 众人问他说：「我们当行什么才算做上帝的工呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “The work of God is this: to believe in the One He has sent.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「信上帝所差来的，这就是做上帝的工。」

chapters.en: So they asked Him, “What sign then will You perform, so that we may see it and believe You? What will You do?
chapters.zh: 他们又说：「你行什么神迹，叫我们看见就信你；你到底做什么事呢？

chapters.en: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ ”
chapters.zh: 我们的祖宗在旷野吃过吗哪，如〔经上〕写着说：『他从天上赐下粮来给他们吃。』」

chapters.en: Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I tell you, it was not Moses who gave you the bread from heaven, but it is My Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，那从天上来的粮不是摩西赐给你们的，乃是我父将天上来的真粮赐给你们。

chapters.en: For the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”
chapters.zh: 因为上帝的粮就是那从天上降下来、赐生命给世界的。」

chapters.en: “Sir,” they said, “give us this bread at all times.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「主啊，常将这粮赐给我们！」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我就是生命的粮。到我这里来的，必定不饿；信我的，永远不渴。

chapters.en: But as I stated, you have seen Me and still you do not believe.
chapters.zh: 只是我对你们说过，你们已经看见我，还是不信。

chapters.en: Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away.
chapters.zh: 凡父所赐给我的人必到我这里来；到我这里来的，我总不丢弃他。

chapters.en: For I have come down from heaven, not to do My own will, but to do the will of Him who sent Me.
chapters.zh: 因为我从天上降下来，不是要按自己的意思行，乃是要按那差我来者的意思行。

chapters.en: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that I shall lose none of those He has given Me, but raise them up at the last day.
chapters.zh: 差我来者的意思就是：他所赐给我的，叫我一个也不失落，在末日却叫他复活。

chapters.en: For it is My Father’s will that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.”
chapters.zh: 因为我父的意思是叫一切见子而信的人得永生，并且在末日我要叫他复活。」

chapters.en: At this, the Jews began to grumble about Jesus because He had said, “I am the bread that came down from heaven.”
chapters.zh: 犹太人因为耶稣说「我是从天上降下来的粮」，就私下议论他，

chapters.en: They were asking, “Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then can He say, ‘I have come down from heaven?’”
chapters.zh: 说：「这不是约瑟的儿子耶稣吗？他的父母我们岂不认得吗？他如今怎么说『我是从天上降下来的』呢？」

chapters.en: “Stop grumbling among yourselves,” Jesus replied.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你们不要大家议论。

chapters.en: “No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him, and I will raise him up at the last day.
chapters.zh: 若不是差我来的父吸引人，就没有能到我这里来的；〔到我这里来的〕，在末日我要叫他复活。

chapters.en: It is written in the Prophets: ‘And they will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from Him comes to Me—
chapters.zh: 在先知书上写着说：『他们都要蒙上帝的教训。』凡听见父〔之教训〕又学习的，就到我这里来。

chapters.en: not that anyone has seen the Father except the One who is from God; only He has seen the Father.
chapters.zh: 这不是说有人看见过父，惟独从上帝来的，他看见过父。

chapters.en: Truly, truly, I tell you, he who believes has eternal life.
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，信的人有永生。

chapters.en: I am the bread of life.
chapters.zh: 我就是生命的粮。

chapters.en: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, yet they died.
chapters.zh: 你们的祖宗在旷野吃过吗哪，还是死了。

chapters.en: This is the bread that comes down from heaven, so that anyone may eat of it and not die.
chapters.zh: 这是从天上降下来的粮，叫人吃了就不死。

chapters.en: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. And this bread, which I will give for the life of the world, is My flesh.”
chapters.zh: 我是从天上降下来生命的粮；人若吃这粮，就必永远活着。我所要赐的粮就是我的肉，为世人之生命所赐的。」

chapters.en: At this, the Jews began to argue among themselves, “How can this man give us His flesh to eat?”
chapters.zh: 因此，犹太人彼此争论说：「这个人怎能把他的肉给我们吃呢？」

chapters.en: So Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I tell you, unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man, you have no life in you.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，你们若不吃人子的肉，不喝人子的血，就没有生命在你们里面。

chapters.en: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
chapters.zh: 吃我肉、喝我血的人就有永生，在末日我要叫他复活。

chapters.en: For My flesh is real food, and My blood is real drink.
chapters.zh: 我的肉真是可吃的，我的血真是可喝的。

chapters.en: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood remains in Me, and I in him.
chapters.zh: 吃我肉、喝我血的人常在我里面，我也常在他里面。

chapters.en: Just as the living Father sent Me and I live because of the Father, so also the one who feeds on Me will live because of Me.
chapters.zh: 永活的父怎样差我来，我又因父活着；照样，吃我〔肉〕的人也要因我活着。

chapters.en: This is the bread that came down from heaven. Unlike your fathers, who ate the manna and died, the one who eats this bread will live forever.”
chapters.zh: 这就是从天上降下来的粮。吃这粮的人就永远活着，不像〔你们的〕祖宗吃过〔吗哪〕还是死了。」

chapters.en: Jesus said this while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.
chapters.zh: 这些话是耶稣在迦百农会堂里教训人说的。

chapters.en: On hearing it, many of His disciples said, “This is a difficult teaching. Who can accept it?”
chapters.zh: 他的门徒中有好些人听见了，就说：「这话甚难，谁能听呢？」

chapters.en: Aware that His disciples were grumbling about this teaching, Jesus asked them, “Does this offend you?
chapters.zh: 耶稣心里知道门徒为这话议论，就对他们说：「这话是叫你们厌弃〔注：原文是跌倒〕吗？

chapters.en: Then what will happen if you see the Son of Man ascend to where He was before?
chapters.zh: 倘或你们看见人子升到他原来所在之处，怎么样呢？

chapters.en: The Spirit gives life; the flesh profits nothing. The words I have spoken to you are spirit and they are life.
chapters.zh: 叫人活着的乃是灵，肉体是无益的。我对你们所说的话就是灵，就是生命。

chapters.en: However, there are some of you who do not believe.” (For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray Him.)
chapters.zh: 只是你们中间有不信的人。」耶稣从起头就知道谁不信他，谁要卖他。

chapters.en: Then Jesus said, “This is why I told you that no one can come to Me unless the Father has granted it to him.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣又说：「所以我对你们说过，若不是蒙我父的恩赐，没有人能到我这里来。」

chapters.en: From that time on many of His disciples turned back and no longer walked with Him.
chapters.zh: 从此，他门徒中多有退去的，不再和他同行。

chapters.en: So Jesus asked the Twelve, “Do you want to leave too?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣就对那十二个门徒说：「你们也要去吗？」

chapters.en: Simon Peter replied, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
chapters.zh: 西门‧彼得回答说：「主啊，你有永生之道，我们还归从谁呢？

chapters.en: We believe and know that You are the Holy One of God. ”
chapters.zh: 我们已经信了，又知道你是上帝的圣者。」

chapters.en: Jesus answered them, “Have I not chosen you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is a devil!”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我不是拣选了你们十二个门徒吗？但你们中间有一个是魔鬼。」

chapters.en: He was speaking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. For although Judas was one of the Twelve, he was later to betray Jesus.
chapters.zh: 耶稣这话是指着加略人西门的儿子犹大说的；他本是十二个门徒里的一个，后来要卖耶稣的。

chapters.en: After this, Jesus traveled throughout Galilee. He did not want to travel in Judea, because the Jews there were trying to kill Him.
chapters.zh: 这事以后，耶稣在加利利游行，不愿在犹太游行，因为犹太人想要杀他。

chapters.en: However, the Jewish Feast of Tabernacles was near.
chapters.zh: 当时犹太人的住棚节近了。

chapters.en: So Jesus’ brothers said to Him, “Leave here and go to Judea, so that Your disciples there may see the works You are doing.
chapters.zh: 耶稣的弟兄就对他说：「你离开这里上犹太去吧，叫你的门徒也看见你所行的事。

chapters.en: For no one who wants to be known publicly acts in secret. Since You are doing these things, show Yourself to the world.”
chapters.zh: 人要显扬名声，没有在暗处行事的；你如果行这些事，就当将自己显明给世人看。」

chapters.en: For even His own brothers did not believe in Him.
chapters.zh: 因为连他的弟兄〔说这话〕，是因为不信他。

chapters.en: Therefore Jesus told them, “Although your time is always at hand, My time has not yet come.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就对他们说：「我的时候还没有到；你们的时候常是方便的。

chapters.en: The world cannot hate you, but it hates Me, because I testify that its works are evil.
chapters.zh: 世人不能恨你们，却是恨我，因为我指证他们所做的事是恶的。

chapters.en: Go up to the feast on your own. I am not going up to this feast, because My time has not yet come.”
chapters.zh: 你们上去过节吧，我现在不上去过这节，因为我的时候还没有满。」

chapters.en: Having said this, Jesus remained in Galilee.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说了这话，仍旧住在加利利。

chapters.en: But after His brothers had gone up to the feast, He also went—not publicly, but in secret.
chapters.zh: 但他弟兄上去以后，他也上去过节，不是明去，似乎是暗去的。

chapters.en: So the Jews were looking for Him at the feast and asking, “Where is He?”
chapters.zh: 正在节期，犹太人寻找耶稣，说：「他在哪里？」

chapters.en:
Many in the crowds were whispering about Him. Some said, “He is a good man.”
But others replied, “No, He deceives the people.”
chapters.zh: 众人为他纷纷议论，有的说：「他是好人。」有的说：「不然，他是迷惑众人的。」

chapters.en: Yet no one would speak publicly about Him for fear of the Jews.
chapters.zh: 只是没有人明明地讲论他，因为怕犹太人。

chapters.en: About halfway through the feast, Jesus went up to the temple courts and began to teach.
chapters.zh: 到了节期，耶稣上殿里去教训人。

chapters.en: The Jews were amazed and asked, “How did this man attain such learning without having studied?”
chapters.zh: 犹太人就希奇，说：「这个人没有学过，怎么明白书呢？」

chapters.en: “My teaching is not My own,” Jesus replied. “It comes from Him who sent Me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我的教训不是我自己的，乃是那差我来者的。

chapters.en: If anyone desires to do His will, he will know whether My teaching is from God or whether I speak on My own.
chapters.zh: 人若立志遵着他的旨意行，就必晓得这教训或是出于上帝，或是我凭着自己说的。

chapters.en: He who speaks on his own authority seeks his own glory, but He who seeks the glory of the One who sent Him is a man of truth; in Him there is no falsehood.
chapters.zh: 人凭着自己说，是求自己的荣耀；惟有求那差他来者的荣耀，这人是真的，在他心里没有不义。

chapters.en: Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps it. Why are you trying to kill Me?”
chapters.zh: 摩西岂不是传律法给你们吗？你们却没有一个人守律法。为什么想要杀我呢？」

chapters.en: “You have a demon,” the crowd replied. “Who is trying to kill You?”
chapters.zh: 众人回答说：「你是被鬼附着了！谁想要杀你？」

chapters.en: Jesus answered them, “I did one miracle, and you are all amazed.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我做了一件事，你们都以为希奇。

chapters.en: But because Moses gave you circumcision, you circumcise a boy on the Sabbath (not that it is from Moses, but from the patriarchs.)
chapters.zh: 摩西传割礼给你们（其实不是从摩西起的，乃是从祖先起的），因此你们也在安息日给人行割礼。

chapters.en: If a boy can be circumcised on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses will not be broken, why are you angry with Me for making the whole man well on the Sabbath?
chapters.zh: 人若在安息日受割礼，免得违背摩西的律法，我在安息日叫一个人全然好了，你们就向我生气吗？

chapters.en: Stop judging by outward appearances, and start judging justly.”
chapters.zh: 不可按外貌断定是非，总要按公平断定是非。」

chapters.en: Then some of the people of Jerusalem began to say, “Isn’t this the man they are trying to kill?
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷人中有的说：「这不是他们想要杀的人吗？

chapters.en: Yet here He is, speaking publicly, and they are not saying anything to Him. Have the rulers truly recognized that this is the Christ?
chapters.zh: 你看他还明明地讲道，他们也不向他说什么，难道官长真知道这是基督吗？

chapters.en: But we know where this man is from. When the Christ comes, no one will know where He is from.”
chapters.zh: 然而，我们知道这个人从哪里来；只是基督来的时候，没有人知道他从哪里来。」

chapters.en: Then Jesus, still teaching in the temple courts, cried out, “You know Me, and you know where I am from. I have not come of My own accord, but He who sent Me is true. You do not know Him,
chapters.zh: 那时，耶稣在殿里教训人，大声说：「你们也知道我，也知道我从哪里来；我来并不是由于自己。但那差我来的是真的。你们不认识他，

chapters.en: but I know Him, because I am from Him and He sent Me.”
chapters.zh: 我却认识他；因为我是从他来的，他也是差了我来。」

chapters.en: So they tried to seize Him, but no one laid a hand on Him, because His hour had not yet come.
chapters.zh: 他们就想要捉拿耶稣；只是没有人下手，因为他的时候还没有到。

chapters.en: Many in the crowd, however, believed in Him and said, “When the Christ comes, will He perform more signs than this man?”
chapters.zh: 但众人中间有好些信他的，说：「基督来的时候，他所行的神迹岂能比这人所行的更多吗？」

chapters.en: When the Pharisees heard the crowd whispering these things about Jesus, they and the chief priests sent officers to arrest Him.
chapters.zh: 法利赛人听见众人为耶稣这样纷纷议论，祭司长和法利赛人就打发差役去捉拿他。

chapters.en: So Jesus said, “I am with you only a little while longer, and then I am going to the One who sent Me.
chapters.zh: 于是耶稣说：「我还有不多的时候和你们同在，以后就回到差我来的那里去。

chapters.en: You will look for Me, but you will not find Me; and where I am, you cannot come.”
chapters.zh: 你们要找我，却找不着；我所在的地方你们不能到。」

chapters.en: At this, the Jews said to one another, “Where does He intend to go that we will not find Him? Will He go where the Jews are dispersed among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?
chapters.zh: 犹太人就彼此对问说：「这人要往哪里去，叫我们找不着呢？难道他要往散住希腊中的犹太人那里去教训希腊人吗？

chapters.en: What does He mean by saying, ‘You will look for Me, but you will not find Me,’ and, ‘Where I am, you cannot come’?”
chapters.zh: 他说：『你们要找我，却找不着；我所在的地方，你们不能到』，这话是什么意思呢？」

chapters.en: On the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood up and called out in a loud voice, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink.
chapters.zh: 节期的末日，就是最大之日，耶稣站着高声说：「人若渴了，可以到我这里来喝。

chapters.en: Whoever believes in Me, as the Scripture has said: ‘Streams of living water will flow from within him.’”
chapters.zh: 信我的人就如经上所说：『从他腹中要流出活水的江河来。』」

chapters.en: He was speaking about the Spirit, whom those who believed in Him were later to receive. For the Spirit had not yet been given, because Jesus had not yet been glorified.
chapters.zh: 耶稣这话是指着信他之人要受〔圣〕灵说的。那时还没有〔赐下圣〕灵〔来〕，因为耶稣尚未得着荣耀。

chapters.en: On hearing these words, some of the people said, “This is truly the Prophet.”
chapters.zh: 众人听见这话，有的说：「这真是那先知。」

chapters.en:
Others declared, “This is the Christ.”
But still others asked, “How can the Christ come from Galilee?
chapters.zh: 有的说：「这是基督。」但也有的说：「基督岂是从加利利出来的吗？

chapters.en: Doesn’t the Scripture say that the Christ will come from the line of David and from Bethlehem, the village where David lived? ”
chapters.zh: 经上岂不是说『基督是大卫的后裔，从大卫本乡伯利恒出来的』吗？」

chapters.en: So there was division in the crowd because of Jesus.
chapters.zh: 于是众人因着耶稣起了纷争。

chapters.en: Some of them wanted to seize Him, but no one laid a hand on Him.
chapters.zh: 其中有人要捉拿他，只是无人下手。

chapters.en: Then the officers returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, who asked them, “Why didn’t you bring Him in?”
chapters.zh: 差役回到祭司长和法利赛人那里。他们对差役说：「你们为什么没有带他来呢？」

chapters.en: “Never has anyone spoken like this man!” the officers answered.
chapters.zh: 差役回答说：「从来没有像他这样说话的！」

chapters.en: “Have you also been deceived?” replied the Pharisees.
chapters.zh: 法利赛人说：「你们也受了迷惑吗？

chapters.en: “Have any of the rulers or Pharisees believed in Him?
chapters.zh: 官长或是法利赛人岂有信他的呢？

chapters.en: But this crowd that does not know the law—they are under a curse.”
chapters.zh: 但这些不明白律法的百姓是被咒诅的！」

chapters.en: Nicodemus, who had gone to Jesus earlier and who himself was one of them, asked,
chapters.zh: 内中有尼哥德慕，就是从前去见耶稣的，对他们说：

chapters.en: “Does our law convict a man without first hearing from him to determine what he has done?”
chapters.zh: 「不先听本人的口供，不知道他所做的事，难道我们的律法还定他的罪吗？」

chapters.en: “Aren’t you also from Galilee?” they replied. “Look into it, and you will see that no prophet comes out of Galilee.”
chapters.zh: 他们回答说：「你也是出于加利利吗？你且去查考，就可知道加利利没有出过先知。」

chapters.en: Then each went to his own home.
But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
chapters.zh: 于是各人都回家去了；耶稣却往橄榄山去，

chapters.en: Early in the morning He went back into the temple courts. All the people came to Him, and He sat down to teach them.
chapters.zh: 清早又回到殿里。众百姓都到他那里去，他就坐下，教训他们。

chapters.en: The scribes and Pharisees, however, brought to Him a woman caught in adultery. They made her stand before them
chapters.zh: 文士和法利赛人带着一个行淫时被拿的妇人来，叫她站在当中，

chapters.en: and said, “Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.
chapters.zh: 就对耶稣说：「夫子，这妇人是正行淫之时被拿的。

chapters.en: In the Law Moses commanded us to stone such a woman. So what do You say?”
chapters.zh: 摩西在律法上吩咐我们把这样的妇人用石头打死。你说该把她怎么样呢？」

chapters.en: They said this to test Him, in order to have a basis for accusing Him. But Jesus bent down and began to write on the ground with His finger.
chapters.zh: 他们说这话，乃试探耶稣，要得着告他的把柄。耶稣却弯着腰，用指头在地上画字。

chapters.en: When they continued to question Him, He straightened up and said to them, “Let him who is without sin among you be the first to cast a stone at her.”
chapters.zh: 他们还是不住地问他，耶稣就直起腰来，对他们说：「你们中间谁是没有罪的，谁就可以先拿石头打她。」

chapters.en: And again He bent down and wrote on the ground.
chapters.zh: 于是又弯着腰，用指头在地上画字。

chapters.en: When they heard this, they began to go away one by one, beginning with the older ones, until only Jesus was left, with the woman standing there.
chapters.zh: 他们听见这话，就从老到少，一个一个地都出去了，只剩下耶稣一人，还有那妇人仍然站在当中。

chapters.en: Then Jesus straightened up and asked her, “Woman, where are your accusers? Has no one condemned you?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣就直起腰来，对她说：「妇人，那些人在哪里呢？没有人定你的罪吗？」

chapters.en:
“No one, Lord,” she answered.
“Then neither do I condemn you,” Jesus declared. “Now go and sin no more.”
chapters.zh: 她说：「主啊，没有。」耶稣说：「我也不定你的罪。去吧，从此不要再犯罪了！」

chapters.en: Once again, Jesus spoke to the people and said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣又对众人说：「我是世界的光。跟从我的，就不在黑暗里走，必要得着生命的光。」

chapters.en: So the Pharisees said to Him, “You are testifying about Yourself; Your testimony is not valid.”
chapters.zh: 法利赛人对他说：「你是为自己作见证，你的见证不真。」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Even if I testify about Myself, My testimony is valid, because I know where I came from and where I am going. But you do not know where I came from or where I am going.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我虽然为自己作见证，我的见证还是真的；因我知道我从哪里来，往哪里去；你们却不知道我从哪里来，往哪里去。

chapters.en: You judge according to the flesh; I judge no one.
chapters.zh: 你们是以外貌〔注：原文是凭肉身〕判断人，我却不判断人。

chapters.en: But even if I do judge, My judgment is true, because I am not alone; I am with the Father who sent Me.
chapters.zh: 就是判断人，我的判断也是真的；因为不是我独自在这里，还有差我来的父与我同在。

chapters.en: Even in your own Law it is written that the testimony of two men is valid.
chapters.zh: 你们的律法上也记着说：『两个人的见证是真的。』

chapters.en: I am One who testifies about Myself, and the Father, who sent Me, also testifies about Me.”
chapters.zh: 我是为自己作见证，还有差我来的父也是为我作见证。」

chapters.en:
“Where is Your Father?” they asked Him.
“You do not know Me or My Father,” Jesus answered. “If you knew Me, you would know My Father as well.”
chapters.zh: 他们就问他说：「你的父在哪里？」耶稣回答说：「你们不认识我，也不认识我的父；若是认识我，也就认识我的父。」

chapters.en: He spoke these words while teaching in the temple courts, near the treasury. Yet no one seized Him, because His hour had not yet come.
chapters.zh: 这些话是耶稣在殿里的库房、教训人时所说的，也没有人拿他，因为他的时候还没有到。

chapters.en: Again He said to them, “I am going away, and you will look for Me, but you will die in your sin. Where I am going, you cannot come.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣又对他们说：「我要去了，你们要找我，并且你们要死在罪中。我所去的地方，你们不能到。」

chapters.en: So the Jews began to ask, “Will He kill Himself, since He says, ‘Where I am going, you cannot come’?”
chapters.zh: 犹太人说：「他说『我所去的地方，你们不能到』，难道他要自尽吗？」

chapters.en: Then He told them, “You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们是从下头来的，我是从上头来的；你们是属这世界的，我不是属这世界的。

chapters.en: That is why I told you that you would die in your sins. For unless you believe that I am He, you will die in your sins.”
chapters.zh: 所以我对你们说，你们要死在罪中。你们若不信我是〔基督〕，必要死在罪中。」

chapters.en:
“Who are You?” they asked.
“Just what I have been telling you from the beginning,” Jesus replied.
chapters.zh: 他们就问他说：「你是谁？」耶稣对他们说：「就是我从起初所告诉你们的。

chapters.en: “I have much to say about you and much to judge. But the One who sent Me is truthful, and what I have heard from Him, I tell the world.”
chapters.zh: 我有许多事讲论你们，判断你们；但那差我来的是真的，我在他那里所听见的，我就传给世人。」

chapters.en: They did not understand that He was telling them about the Father.
chapters.zh: 他们不明白耶稣是指着父说的。

chapters.en: So Jesus said, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am He, and that I do nothing on My own, but speak exactly what the Father has taught Me.
chapters.zh: 所以耶稣说：「你们举起人子以后，必知道我是〔基督〕，并且知道我没有一件事是凭着自己做的。我说这些话乃是照着父所教训我的。

chapters.en: He who sent Me is with Me. He has not left Me alone, because I always do what pleases Him.”
chapters.zh: 那差我来的是与我同在；他没有撇下我独自在这里，因为我常做他所喜悦的事。」

chapters.en: As Jesus spoke these things, many believed in Him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说这话的时候，就有许多人信他。

chapters.en: So He said to the Jews who had believed Him, “If you continue in My word, you are truly My disciples.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对信他的犹太人说：「你们若常常遵守我的道，就真是我的门徒；

chapters.en: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
chapters.zh: 你们必晓得真理，真理必叫你们得以自由。」

chapters.en: “We are Abraham’s descendants,” they answered. “We have never been slaves to anyone. How can You say we will be set free?”
chapters.zh: 他们回答说：「我们是亚伯拉罕的后裔，从来没有作过谁的奴仆。你怎么说『你们必得以自由』呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，所有犯罪的就是罪的奴仆。

chapters.en: A slave does not remain in the house forever, but a son remains forever.
chapters.zh: 奴仆不能永远住在家里；儿子是永远住在家里。

chapters.en: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.
chapters.zh: 所以〔天父的〕儿子若叫你们自由，你们就真自由了。

chapters.en: I know you are Abraham’s descendants, but you are trying to kill Me because My word has no place within you.
chapters.zh: 我知道你们是亚伯拉罕的子孙，你们却想要杀我，因为你们心里容不下我的道。

chapters.en: I speak of what I have seen in the presence of the Father, and you do what you have heard from your father.”
chapters.zh: 我所说的是在我父那里看见的；你们所行的是在你们的父那里听见的。」

chapters.en:
“Abraham is our father,” they replied.
“If you were children of Abraham,” said Jesus, “you would do the works of Abraham.
chapters.zh: 他们说：「我们的父就是亚伯拉罕。」耶稣说：「你们若是亚伯拉罕的儿子，就必行亚伯拉罕所行的事。

chapters.en: But now you are trying to kill Me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham never did such a thing.
chapters.zh: 我将在上帝那里所听见的真理告诉了你们，现在你们却想要杀我，这不是亚伯拉罕所行的事。

chapters.en:
You are doing the works of your father.”
“We are not illegitimate children,” they declared. “Our only Father is God Himself.”
chapters.zh: 你们是行你们父所行的事。」他们说：「我们不是从淫乱生的；我们只有一位父，就是上帝。」

chapters.en: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love Me, for I have come here from God. I have not come on My own, but He sent Me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「倘若上帝是你们的父，你们就必爱我；因为我本是出于上帝，也是从上帝而来，并不是由着自己来，乃是他差我来。

chapters.en: Why do you not understand what I am saying? It is because you are unable to accept My message.
chapters.zh: 你们为什么不明白我的话呢？无非是因你们不能听我的道。

chapters.en: You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out his desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, refusing to uphold the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language, because he is a liar and the father of lies.
chapters.zh: 你们是出于你们的父魔鬼，你们父的私欲你们偏要行。他从起初是杀人的，不守真理，因他心里没有真理。他说谎是出于自己；因他本来是说谎的，也是说谎之人的父。

chapters.en: But because I speak the truth, you do not believe Me!
chapters.zh: 我将真理告诉你们，你们就因此不信我。

chapters.en: Which of you can prove Me guilty of sin? If I speak the truth, why do you not believe Me?
chapters.zh: 你们中间谁能指证我有罪呢？我既然将真理告诉你们，为什么不信我呢？

chapters.en: Whoever belongs to God hears the words of God. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God.”
chapters.zh: 出于上帝的，必听上帝的话；你们不听，因为你们不是出于上帝。」

chapters.en: The Jews answered Him, “Are we not right to say that You are a Samaritan and You have a demon?”
chapters.zh: 犹太人回答说：「我们说你是撒马利亚人，并且是鬼附着的，这话岂不正对吗？」

chapters.en: “I do not have a demon,” Jesus replied, “but I honor My Father, and you dishonor Me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我不是鬼附着的；我尊敬我的父，你们倒轻慢我。

chapters.en: I do not seek My own glory. There is One who seeks it, and He is the Judge.
chapters.zh: 我不求自己的荣耀，有一位〔为我〕求〔荣耀〕、定是非的。

chapters.en: Truly, truly, I tell you, if anyone keeps My word, he will never see death.”
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，人若遵守我的道，就永远不见死。」

chapters.en: “Now we know that You have a demon!” declared the Jews. “Abraham died, and so did the prophets, yet You say that anyone who keeps Your word will never taste death.
chapters.zh: 犹太人对他说：「现在我们知道你是鬼附着的。亚伯拉罕死了，众先知也死了，你还说：『人若遵守我的道，就永远不尝死味。』

chapters.en: Are You greater than our father Abraham? He died, as did the prophets. Who do You claim to be?”
chapters.zh: 难道你比我们的祖宗亚伯拉罕还大吗？他死了，众先知也死了，你将自己当作什么人呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “If I glorify Myself, My glory means nothing. The One who glorifies Me is My Father, of whom you say, ‘He is our God.’
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我若荣耀自己，我的荣耀就算不得什么；荣耀我的乃是我的父，就是你们所说是你们的上帝。

chapters.en: You do not know Him, but I know Him. If I said I did not know Him, I would be a liar like you. But I do know Him, and I keep His word.
chapters.zh: 你们未曾认识他；我却认识他。我若说不认识他，我就是说谎的，像你们一样；但我认识他，也遵守他的道。

chapters.en: Your father Abraham rejoiced that he would see My day. He saw it and was glad.”
chapters.zh: 你们的祖宗亚伯拉罕欢欢喜喜地仰望我的日子，既看见了就快乐。」

chapters.en: Then the Jews said to Him, “You are not yet fifty years old, and You have seen Abraham?”
chapters.zh: 犹太人说：「你还没有五十岁，岂见过亚伯拉罕呢？」

chapters.en: “Truly, truly, I tell you,” Jesus declared, “before Abraham was born, I am! ”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，还没有亚伯拉罕就有了我。」

chapters.en: At this, they picked up stones to throw at Him. But Jesus was hidden and went out of the temple area.
chapters.zh: 于是他们拿石头要打他；耶稣却躲藏，从殿里出去了。

chapters.en: Now as Jesus was passing by, He saw a man blind from birth,
chapters.zh: 耶稣过去的时候，看见一个人生来是瞎眼的。

chapters.en: and His disciples asked Him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
chapters.zh: 门徒问耶稣说：「拉比，这人生来是瞎眼的，是谁犯了罪？是这人呢？是他父母呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “Neither this man nor his parents sinned, but this happened so that the works of God would be displayed in him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「也不是这人犯了罪，也不是他父母犯了罪，是要在他身上显出上帝的作为来。

chapters.en: While it is daytime, we must do the works of Him who sent Me. Night is coming, when no one can work.
chapters.zh: 趁着白日，我们必须做那差我来者的工；黑夜将到，就没有人能做工了。

chapters.en: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
chapters.zh: 我在世上的时候，是世上的光。」

chapters.en: When Jesus had said this, He spit on the ground, made some mud, and applied it to the man’s eyes.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说了这话，就吐唾沫在地上，用唾沫和泥抹在瞎子的眼睛上，

chapters.en: Then He told him, “Go, wash in the Pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So the man went and washed, and came back seeing.
chapters.zh: 对他说：「你往西罗亚池子里去洗。」（西罗亚翻出来就是「奉差遣」。）他去一洗，回头就看见了。

chapters.en: At this, his neighbors and those who had formerly seen him begging began to ask, “Isn’t this the man who used to sit and beg?”
chapters.zh: 他的邻舍和那素常见他是讨饭的，就说：「这不是那从前坐着讨饭的人吗？」

chapters.en:
Some claimed that he was, but others said, “No, he just looks like him.”
But the man kept saying, “I am the one.”
chapters.zh: 有人说：「是他」；又有人说：「不是，却是像他。」他自己说：「是我。」

chapters.en: “How then were your eyes opened?” they asked.
chapters.zh: 他们对他说：「你的眼睛是怎么开的呢？」

chapters.en: He answered, “The man they call Jesus made some mud and anointed my eyes, and He told me to go to Siloam and wash. So I went and washed and received my sight.”
chapters.zh: 他回答说：「有一个人，名叫耶稣，他和泥抹我的眼睛，对我说：『你往西罗亚〔池子〕去洗。』我去一洗，就看见了。」

chapters.en:
“Where is He?” they asked.
“I do not know,” he answered.
chapters.zh: 他们说：「那个人在哪里？」他说：「我不知道。」

chapters.en: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had been blind.
chapters.zh: 他们把从前瞎眼的人带到法利赛人那里。

chapters.en: Now the day on which Jesus had made the mud and opened his eyes was a Sabbath.
chapters.zh: 耶稣和泥开他眼睛的日子是安息日。

chapters.en:
So the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight.
The man answered, “He put mud on my eyes, and I washed, and now I can see.”
chapters.zh: 法利赛人也问他是怎么得看见的。瞎子对他们说：「他把泥抹在我的眼睛上，我去一洗，就看见了。」

chapters.en:
Because of this, some of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, for He does not keep the Sabbath.”
But others said, “How can a sinful man perform such signs?”
And there was division among them.
chapters.zh: 法利赛人中有的说：「这个人不是从上帝来的，因为他不守安息日。」又有人说：「一个罪人怎能行这样的神迹呢？」他们就起了纷争。

chapters.en:
So once again they asked the man who had been blind, “What do you say about Him, since it was your eyes He opened?”
“He is a prophet,” the man replied.
chapters.zh: 他们又对瞎子说：「他既然开了你的眼睛，你说他是怎样的人呢？」他说：「是个先知。」

chapters.en: The Jews still did not believe that the man had been blind and had received his sight until they summoned his parents
chapters.zh: 犹太人不信他从前是瞎眼，后来能看见的，等到叫了他的父母来，

chapters.en: and asked, “Is this your son, the one you say was born blind? So how is it that he can now see?”
chapters.zh: 问他们说：「这是你们的儿子吗？你们说他生来是瞎眼的，如今怎么能看见了呢？」

chapters.en: His parents answered, “We know he is our son, and we know he was born blind.
chapters.zh: 他父母回答说：「他是我们的儿子，生来就瞎眼，这是我们知道的。

chapters.en: But how he can now see or who opened his eyes, we do not know. Ask him. He is old enough to speak for himself.”
chapters.zh: 至于他如今怎么能看见，我们却不知道；是谁开了他的眼睛，我们也不知道。他已经成了人，你们问他吧，他自己必能说。」

chapters.en: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jews. For the Jews had already determined that anyone who confessed Jesus as the Christ would be put out of the synagogue.
chapters.zh: 他父母说这话，是怕犹太人；因为犹太人已经商议定了，若有认耶稣是基督的，要把他赶出会堂。

chapters.en: That was why his parents said, “He is old enough. Ask him.”
chapters.zh: 因此他父母说：「他已经成了人，你们问他吧。」

chapters.en: So a second time they called for the man who had been blind and said, “Give glory to God! We know that this man is a sinner.”
chapters.zh: 所以法利赛人第二次叫了那从前瞎眼的人来，对他说：「你该将荣耀归给上帝，我们知道这人是个罪人。」

chapters.en: He answered, “Whether He is a sinner I do not know. There is one thing I do know: I was blind, but now I see!”
chapters.zh: 他说：「他是个罪人不是，我不知道；有一件事我知道，从前我是眼瞎的，如今能看见了。」

chapters.en: “What did He do to you?” they asked. “How did He open your eyes?”
chapters.zh: 他们就问他说：「他向你做什么？是怎么开了你的眼睛呢？」

chapters.en: He replied, “I already told you, and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you also want to become His disciples?”
chapters.zh: 他回答说：「我方才告诉你们，你们不听，为什么又要听呢？莫非你们也要作他的门徒吗？」

chapters.en: Then they heaped insults on him and said, “You are His disciple; we are disciples of Moses.
chapters.zh: 他们就骂他说：「你是他的门徒；我们是摩西的门徒。

chapters.en: We know that God spoke to Moses, but we do not know where this man is from.”
chapters.zh: 上帝对摩西说话是我们知道的；只是这个人，我们不知道他从哪里来！」

chapters.en: “That is remarkable indeed!” the man said. “You do not know where He is from, and yet He opened my eyes.
chapters.zh: 那人回答说：「他开了我的眼睛，你们竟不知道他从哪里来，这真是奇怪！

chapters.en: We know that God does not listen to sinners, but He does listen to the one who worships Him and does His will.
chapters.zh: 我们知道上帝不听罪人，惟有敬奉上帝、遵行他旨意的，上帝才听他。

chapters.en: Never before has anyone heard of opening the eyes of a man born blind.
chapters.zh: 从创世以来，未曾听见有人把生来是瞎子的眼睛开了。

chapters.en: If this man were not from God, He could do no such thing.”
chapters.zh: 这人若不是从上帝来的，什么也不能做。」

chapters.en: They replied, “You were born in utter sin, and you are instructing us?” And they threw him out.
chapters.zh: 他们回答说：「你全然生在罪孽中，还要教训我们吗？」于是把他赶出去了。

chapters.en: When Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, He found the man and said, “Do you believe in the Son of Man ?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣听说他们把他赶出去，后来遇见他，就说：「你信上帝的儿子吗？」

chapters.en: “Who is He, Sir?” he replied. “Tell me so that I may believe in Him.”
chapters.zh: 他回答说：「主啊，谁是上帝的儿子，叫我信他呢？」

chapters.en: “You have already seen Him,” Jesus answered. “He is the One speaking with you.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你已经看见他，现在和你说话的就是他。」

chapters.en: “Lord, I believe,” he said. And he worshiped Jesus.
chapters.zh: 他说：「主啊，我信！」就拜耶稣。

chapters.en: Then Jesus declared, “For judgment I have come into this world, so that the blind may see and those who see may become blind.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我为审判到这世上来，叫不能看见的，可以看见；能看见的，反瞎了眼。」

chapters.en: Some of the Pharisees who were with Him heard this, and they asked Him, “Are we blind too?”
chapters.zh: 同他在那里的法利赛人听见这话，就说：「难道我们也瞎了眼吗？」

chapters.en: “If you were blind,” Jesus replied, “you would not be guilty of sin. But since you claim you can see, your guilt remains.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们若瞎了眼，就没有罪了；但如今你们说『我们能看见』，〔所以〕你们的罪还在。」

chapters.en: “Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever does not enter the sheepfold by the gate, but climbs in some other way, is a thief and a robber.
chapters.zh: 「我实实在在地告诉你们，人进羊圈，不从门进去，倒从别处爬进去，那人就是贼，就是强盗。

chapters.en: But the one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.
chapters.zh: 从门进去的，才是羊的牧人。

chapters.en: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen for his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
chapters.zh: 看门的就给他开门；羊也听他的声音。他按着名叫自己的羊，把羊领出来。

chapters.en: When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.
chapters.zh: 既放出自己的羊来，就在前头走，羊也跟着他，因为认得他的声音。

chapters.en: But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will flee from him because they do not recognize his voice.”
chapters.zh: 羊不跟着生人；因为不认得他的声音，必要逃跑。」

chapters.en: Jesus spoke to them using this illustration, but they did not understand what He was telling them.
chapters.zh: 耶稣将这比喻告诉他们，但他们不明白所说的是什么意思。

chapters.en: So He said to them again, “Truly, truly, I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.
chapters.zh: 所以，耶稣又对他们说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，我就是羊的门。

chapters.en: All who came before Me were thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.
chapters.zh: 凡在我以先来的都是贼，是强盗；羊却不听他们。

chapters.en: I am the gate. If anyone enters through Me, he will be saved. He will come in and go out and find pasture.
chapters.zh: 我就是门；凡从我进来的，必然得救，并且出入得草吃。

chapters.en: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I have come that they may have life, and have it in all its fullness.
chapters.zh: 盗贼来，无非要偷窃，杀害，毁坏；我来了，是要叫羊〔注：或译：人〕得生命，并且得的更丰盛。

chapters.en: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.
chapters.zh: 我是好牧人；好牧人为羊舍命。

chapters.en: The hired hand is not the shepherd, and the sheep are not his own. When he sees the wolf coming, he abandons the sheep and runs away. Then the wolf pounces on them and scatters the flock.
chapters.zh: 若是雇工，不是牧人，羊也不是他自己的，他看见狼来，就撇下羊逃走；狼抓住羊，赶散了羊群。

chapters.en: The man runs away because he is a hired servant and is unconcerned for the sheep.
chapters.zh: 雇工〔逃走〕，因他是雇工，并不顾念羊。

chapters.en: I am the good shepherd. I know My sheep and My sheep know Me,
chapters.zh: 我是好牧人；我认识我的羊，我的羊也认识我，

chapters.en: just as the Father knows Me and I know the Father. And I lay down My life for the sheep.
chapters.zh: 正如父认识我，我也认识父一样；并且我为羊舍命。

chapters.en: I have other sheep that are not of this fold. I must bring them in as well, and they will listen to My voice. Then there will be one flock and one shepherd.
chapters.zh: 我另外有羊，不是这圈里的；我必须领他们来，他们也要听我的声音，并且要合成一群，归一个牧人了。

chapters.en: The reason the Father loves Me is that I lay down My life in order to take it up again.
chapters.zh: 我父爱我；因我将命舍去，好再取回来。

chapters.en: No one takes it from Me, but I lay it down of My own accord. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again. This charge I have received from My Father.”
chapters.zh: 没有人夺我的命去，是我自己舍的。我有权柄舍了，也有权柄取回来。这是我从我父所受的命令。」

chapters.en: Again there was division among the Jews because of Jesus’ message.
chapters.zh: 犹太人为这些话又起了纷争。

chapters.en: Many of them said, “He is demon-possessed and insane. Why would you listen to Him?”
chapters.zh: 内中有好些人说：「他是被鬼附着，而且疯了，为什么听他呢？」

chapters.en: But others replied, “These are not the words of a man possessed by a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?”
chapters.zh: 又有人说：「这不是鬼附之人所说的话。鬼岂能叫瞎子的眼睛开了呢？」

chapters.en: At that time the Feast of Dedication took place in Jerusalem. It was winter,
chapters.zh: 在耶路撒冷有修殿节，是冬天的时候。

chapters.en: and Jesus was walking in the temple courts in Solomon’s Colonnade.
chapters.zh: 耶稣在殿里所罗门的廊下行走。

chapters.en: So the Jews gathered around Him and demanded, “How long will You keep us in suspense? If You are the Christ, tell us plainly.”
chapters.zh: 犹太人围着他，说：「你叫我们犹疑不定到几时呢？你若是基督，就明明地告诉我们。」

chapters.en: “I already told you,” Jesus replied, “but you did not believe. The works I do in My Father’s name testify on My behalf.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我已经告诉你们，你们不信。我奉我父之名所行的事可以为我作见证；

chapters.en: But because you are not My sheep, you refuse to believe.
chapters.zh: 只是你们不信，因为你们不是我的羊。

chapters.en: My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me.
chapters.zh: 我的羊听我的声音，我也认识他们，他们也跟着我。

chapters.en: I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand.
chapters.zh: 我又赐给他们永生；他们永不灭亡，谁也不能从我手里把他们夺去。

chapters.en: My Father who has given them to Me is greater than all. No one can snatch them out of My Father’s hand.
chapters.zh: 我父把羊赐给我，他比万有都大，谁也不能从我父手里把他们夺去。

chapters.en: I and the Father are one.”
chapters.zh: 我与父原为一。」

chapters.en: At this, the Jews again picked up stones to stone Him.
chapters.zh: 犹太人又拿起石头来要打他。

chapters.en: But Jesus responded, “I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these do you stone Me?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「我从父显出许多善事给你们看，你们是为哪一件拿石头打我呢？」

chapters.en: “We are not stoning You for any good work,” said the Jews, “but for blasphemy, because You, who are a man, make Yourself out to be God.”
chapters.zh: 犹太人回答说：「我们不是为善事拿石头打你，是为你说僭妄的话；又为你是个人，反将自己当作上帝。」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Is it not written in your Law: ‘I have said you are gods’ ?
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们的律法上岂不是写着『我曾说你们是神』吗？

chapters.en: If he called them gods to whom the word of God came—and the Scripture cannot be broken—
chapters.zh: 经上的话是不能废的；若那些承受上帝道的人尚且称为神，

chapters.en: then what about the One whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world? How then can you accuse Me of blasphemy for stating that I am the Son of God?
chapters.zh: 父所分别为圣、又差到世间来的，他自称是上帝的儿子，你们还向他说『你说僭妄的话』吗？

chapters.en: If I am not doing the works of My Father, then do not believe Me.
chapters.zh: 我若不行我父的事，你们就不必信我；

chapters.en: But if I am doing them, even though you do not believe Me, believe the works themselves, so that you may know and understand that the Father is in Me, and I am in the Father.”
chapters.zh: 我若行了，你们纵然不信我，也当信这些事，叫你们又知道又明白父在我里面，我也在父里面。」

chapters.en: At this, they tried again to seize Him, but He escaped their grasp.
chapters.zh: 他们又要拿他，他却逃出他们的手走了。

chapters.en: Then Jesus went back across the Jordan to the place where John had first been baptizing, and He stayed there.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又往约旦河外去，到了约翰起初施洗的地方，就住在那里。

chapters.en: Many came to Him and said, “Although John never performed a sign, everything he said about this man was true.”
chapters.zh: 有许多人来到他那里。他们说：「约翰一件神迹没有行过，但约翰指着这人所说的一切话都是真的。」

chapters.en: And many in that place believed in Jesus.
chapters.zh: 在那里，信耶稣的人就多了。

chapters.en: At this time a man named Lazarus was sick. He lived in Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
chapters.zh: 有一个患病的人，名叫拉撒路，住在伯大尼，就是马利亚和她姊姊马大的村庄。

chapters.en: (Mary, whose brother Lazarus was sick, was to anoint the Lord with perfume and wipe His feet with her hair.)
chapters.zh: 这马利亚就是那用香膏抹主，又用头发擦他脚的；患病的拉撒路是她的兄弟。

chapters.en: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, “Lord, the one You love is sick.”
chapters.zh: 她姊妹两个就打发人去见耶稣，说：「主啊，你所爱的人病了。」

chapters.en: When Jesus heard this, He said, “This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣听见，就说：「这病不至于死，乃是为上帝的荣耀，叫上帝的儿子因此得荣耀。」

chapters.en: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
chapters.zh: 耶稣素来爱马大和她妹子并拉撒路。

chapters.en: So on hearing that Lazarus was sick, He stayed where He was for two days,
chapters.zh: 听见拉撒路病了，就在所居之地仍住了两天。

chapters.en: and then He said to the disciples, “Let us go back to Judea.”
chapters.zh: 然后对门徒说：「我们再往犹太去吧。」

chapters.en: “Rabbi,” they replied, “the Jews just tried to stone You, and You are going back there?”
chapters.zh: 门徒说：「拉比，犹太人近来要拿石头打你，你还往那里去吗？」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “Are there not twelve hours of daylight? If anyone walks in the daytime, he will not stumble, because he sees by the light of this world.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「白日不是有十二小时吗？人在白日走路，就不致跌倒，因为看见这世上的光。

chapters.en: But if anyone walks at night, he will stumble, because he has no light.”
chapters.zh: 若在黑夜走路，就必跌倒，因为他没有光。」

chapters.en: After He had said this, He told them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going there to wake him up.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说了这话，随后对他们说：「我们的朋友拉撒路睡了，我去叫醒他。」

chapters.en: His disciples replied, “Lord, if he is sleeping, he will get better.”
chapters.zh: 门徒说：「主啊，他若睡了，就必好了。」

chapters.en: They thought that Jesus was talking about actual sleep, but He was speaking about the death of Lazarus.
chapters.zh: 耶稣这话是指着他死说的，他们却以为是说照常睡了。

chapters.en: So Jesus told them plainly, “Lazarus is dead,
chapters.zh: 耶稣就明明地告诉他们说：「拉撒路死了。

chapters.en: and for your sake I am glad I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him.”
chapters.zh: 我没有在那里就欢喜，这是为你们的缘故，好叫你们相信。〔如今〕我们可以往他那里去吧。」

chapters.en: Then Thomas called Didymus said to his fellow disciples, “Let us also go, so that we may die with Him.”
chapters.zh: 多马，又称为低土马，就对那同作门徒的说：「我们也去和他同死吧。」

chapters.en: When Jesus arrived, He found that Lazarus had already spent four days in the tomb.
chapters.zh: 耶稣到了，就知道拉撒路在坟墓里已经四天了。

chapters.en: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, a little less than two miles away,
chapters.zh: 伯大尼离耶路撒冷不远，约有六里路。

chapters.en: and many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary to console them in the loss of their brother.
chapters.zh: 有好些犹太人来看马大和马利亚，要为她们的兄弟安慰她们。

chapters.en: So when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went out to meet Him, but Mary stayed at home.
chapters.zh: 马大听见耶稣来了，就出去迎接他；马利亚却仍然坐在家里。

chapters.en: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.
chapters.zh: 马大对耶稣说：「主啊，你若早在这里，我兄弟必不死。

chapters.en: But even now I know that God will give You whatever You ask of Him.”
chapters.zh: 就是现在，我也知道，你无论向上帝求什么，上帝也必赐给你。」

chapters.en: “Your brother will rise again,” Jesus told her.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你兄弟必然复活。」

chapters.en: Martha replied, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
chapters.zh: 马大说：「我知道在末日复活的时候，他必复活。」

chapters.en: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对她说：「复活在我，生命也在我。信我的人虽然死了，也必复活；

chapters.en: And everyone who lives and believes in Me will never die. Do you believe this?”
chapters.zh: 凡活着信我的人必永远不死。你信这话吗？」

chapters.en: “Yes, Lord,” she answered, “I believe that You are the Christ, the Son of God, who was to come into the world.”
chapters.zh: 马大说：「主啊，是的，我信你是基督，是上帝的儿子，就是那要临到世界的。」

chapters.en: After Martha had said this, she went back and called her sister Mary aside to tell her, “The Teacher is here and is asking for you.”
chapters.zh: 马大说了这话，就回去暗暗地叫她妹子马利亚，说：「夫子来了，叫你。」

chapters.en: And when Mary heard this, she got up quickly and went to Him.
chapters.zh: 马利亚听见了，就急忙起来，到耶稣那里去。

chapters.en: Now Jesus had not yet entered the village, but was still at the place where Martha had met Him.
chapters.zh: 那时，耶稣还没有进村子，仍在马大迎接他的地方。

chapters.en: When the Jews who were in the house consoling Mary saw how quickly she got up and went out, they followed her, supposing she was going to the tomb to mourn there.
chapters.zh: 那些同马利亚在家里安慰她的犹太人，见她急忙起来出去，就跟着她，以为她要往坟墓那里去哭。

chapters.en: When Mary came to Jesus and saw Him, she fell at His feet and said, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.”
chapters.zh: 马利亚到了耶稣那里，看见他，就俯伏在他脚前，说：「主啊，你若早在这里，我兄弟必不死。」

chapters.en: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come with her also weeping, He was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.
chapters.zh: 耶稣看见她哭，并看见与她同来的犹太人也哭，就心里悲叹，又甚忧愁，

chapters.en:
“Where have you put him?” He asked.
“Come and see, Lord,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 便说：「你们把他安放在哪里？」他们回答说：「请主来看。」

chapters.en: Jesus wept.
chapters.zh: 耶稣哭了。

chapters.en: Then the Jews said, “See how He loved him!”
chapters.zh: 犹太人就说：「你看他爱这人是何等恳切。」

chapters.en: But some of them asked, “Could not this man who opened the eyes of the blind also have kept Lazarus from dying?”
chapters.zh: 其中有人说：「他既然开了瞎子的眼睛，岂不能叫这人不死吗？」

chapters.en: Jesus, once again deeply moved, came to the tomb. It was a cave with a stone laid across the entrance.
chapters.zh: 耶稣又心里悲叹，来到坟墓前；那坟墓是个洞，有一块石头挡着。

chapters.en:
“Take away the stone,” Jesus said.
“Lord, by now he stinks,” said Martha, the sister of the dead man. “It has already been four days.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们把石头挪开。」那死人的姊姊马大对他说：「主啊，他现在必是臭了，因为他〔死了〕已经四天了。」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see the glory of God?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我不是对你说过，你若信，就必看见上帝的荣耀吗？」

chapters.en: So they took away the stone. Then Jesus lifted His eyes upward and said, “Father, I thank You that You have heard Me.
chapters.zh: 他们就把石头挪开。耶稣举目〔望天〕，说：「父啊，我感谢你，因为你已经听我。

chapters.en: I knew that You always hear Me, but I say this for the benefit of the people standing here, so they may believe that You sent Me.”
chapters.zh: 我也知道你常听我，但我说这话是为周围站着的众人，叫他们信是你差了我来。」

chapters.en: After Jesus had said this, He called out in a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
