chapters.zh: 说了这话，就大声呼叫说：「拉撒路出来！」

chapters.en:
The man who had been dead came out with his hands and feet bound in strips of linen, and his face wrapped in a cloth.
“Unwrap him and let him go,” Jesus told them.
chapters.zh: 那死人就出来了，手脚裹着布，脸上包着手巾。耶稣对他们说：「解开，叫他走！」

chapters.en: Therefore many of the Jews who had come to Mary, and had seen what Jesus did, believed in Him.
chapters.zh: 那些来看马利亚的犹太人见了耶稣所做的事，就多有信他的；

chapters.en: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.
chapters.zh: 但其中也有去见法利赛人的，将耶稣所做的事告诉他们。

chapters.en: Then the chief priests and Pharisees convened the Sanhedrin and said, “What are we to do? This man is performing many signs.
chapters.zh: 祭司长和法利赛人聚集公会，说：「这人行好些神迹，我们怎么办呢？

chapters.en: If we let Him go on like this, everyone will believe in Him, and then the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”
chapters.zh: 若这样由着他，人人都要信他，罗马人也要来夺我们的地土和我们的百姓。」

chapters.en: But one of them, named Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all!
chapters.zh: 内中有一个人，名叫该亚法，本年作大祭司，对他们说：「你们不知道什么。

chapters.en: You do not realize that it is better for you that one man die for the people than that the whole nation perish.”
chapters.zh: 独不想一个人替百姓死，免得通国灭亡，就是你们的益处。」

chapters.en: Caiaphas did not say this on his own. Instead, as high priest that year, he was prophesying that Jesus would die for the nation,
chapters.zh: 他这话不是出于自己，是因他本年作大祭司，所以预言耶稣将要替这一国死；

chapters.en: and not only for the nation, but also for the scattered children of God, to gather them together into one.
chapters.zh: 也不但替这一国死，并要将上帝四散的子民都聚集归一。

chapters.en: So from that day on they plotted to kill Him.
chapters.zh: 从那日起，他们就商议要杀耶稣。

chapters.en: As a result, Jesus no longer went about publicly among the Jews, but He withdrew to a town called Ephraim in an area near the wilderness. And He stayed there with the disciples.
chapters.zh: 所以，耶稣不再显然行在犹太人中间，就离开那里往靠近旷野的地方去，到了一座城，名叫以法莲，就在那里和门徒同住。

chapters.en: Now the Jewish Passover was near, and many people went up from the country to Jerusalem to purify themselves before the Passover.
chapters.zh: 犹太人的逾越〔节〕近了，有许多人从乡下上耶路撒冷去，要在节前洁净自己。

chapters.en: They kept looking for Jesus and asking one another as they stood in the temple courts, “What do you think? Will He come to the feast at all?”
chapters.zh: 他们就寻找耶稣，站在殿里彼此说：「你们的意思如何，他不来过节吗？」

chapters.en: But the chief priests and Pharisees had given orders that anyone who knew where He was must report it, so that they could arrest Him.
chapters.zh: 那时，祭司长和法利赛人早已吩咐说，若有人知道耶稣在哪里，就要报明，好去拿他。

chapters.en: Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, the hometown of Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead.
chapters.zh: 逾越节前六日，耶稣来到伯大尼，就是他叫拉撒路从死里复活之处。

chapters.en: So they hosted a dinner for Jesus there. Martha served, and Lazarus was among those reclining at the table with Him.
chapters.zh: 有人在那里给耶稣预备筵席；马大伺候，拉撒路也在那同耶稣坐席的人中。

chapters.en: Then Mary took about a pint of expensive perfume, made of pure nard, and she anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped them with her hair. And the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.
chapters.zh: 马利亚就拿着一斤极贵的真哪哒香膏，抹耶稣的脚，又用自己头发去擦，屋里就满了膏的香气。

chapters.en: But one of His disciples, Judas Iscariot, who was going to betray Him, asked,
chapters.zh: 有一个门徒，就是那将要卖耶稣的加略人犹大，

chapters.en: “Why wasn’t this perfume sold for three hundred denarii and the money given to the poor?”
chapters.zh: 说：「这香膏为什么不卖三十两银子赒济穷人呢？」

chapters.en: Judas did not say this because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief. As keeper of the money bag, he used to take from what was put into it.
chapters.zh: 他说这话，并不是挂念穷人，乃因他是个贼，又带着钱囊，常取其中所存的。

chapters.en: “Leave her alone,” Jesus replied. “She has kept this perfume in preparation for the day of My burial.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「由她吧！她是为我安葬之日存留的。

chapters.en: The poor you will always have with you, but you will not always have Me.”
chapters.zh: 因为常有穷人和你们同在，只是你们不常有我。」

chapters.en: Meanwhile a large crowd of Jews learned that Jesus was there. And they came not only because of Him, but also to see Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead.
chapters.zh: 有许多犹太人知道耶稣在那里，就来了，不但是为耶稣的缘故，也是要看他从死里所复活的拉撒路。

chapters.en: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus as well,
chapters.zh: 但祭司长商议连拉撒路也要杀了；

chapters.en: for on account of him many of the Jews were deserting them and believing in Jesus.
chapters.zh: 因有好些犹太人为拉撒路的缘故，回去信了耶稣。

chapters.en: The next day the great crowd that had come to the feast heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 第二天，有许多上来过节的人听见耶稣将到耶路撒冷，

chapters.en:
They took palm branches and went out to meet Him, shouting:
“Hosanna!”
“Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!”
“Blessed is the King of Israel!”
chapters.zh: 就拿着棕树枝出去迎接他，喊着说： 和散那！ 奉主名来的以色列王是应当称颂的！

chapters.en: Finding a young donkey, Jesus sat on it, as it is written:
chapters.zh: 耶稣得了一个驴驹，就骑上，如〔经〕上所记的说：

chapters.en:
“Do not be afraid, O Daughter of Zion. See, your King is coming,
seated on the colt of a donkey.”
chapters.zh: 锡安的民〔注：原文是女子〕哪，不要惧怕！ 你的王骑着驴驹来了。

chapters.en: At first His disciples did not understand these things, but after Jesus was glorified they remembered what had been done to Him, and they realized that these very things had also been written about Him.
chapters.zh: 这些事门徒起先不明白，等到耶稣得了荣耀以后才想起这话是指着他写的，并且众人果然向他这样行了。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, many people who had been with Jesus when He called Lazarus from the tomb and raised him from the dead continued to testify.
chapters.zh: 当耶稣呼唤拉撒路，叫他从死复活出坟墓的时候，同耶稣在那里的众人就作见证。

chapters.en: That is also why the crowd went out to meet Him, because they heard that He had performed this sign.
chapters.zh: 众人因听见耶稣行了这神迹，就去迎接他。

chapters.en: Then the Pharisees said to one another, “You can see that this is doing you no good. Look how the whole world has gone after Him!”
chapters.zh: 法利赛人彼此说：「看哪，你们是徒劳无益，世人都随从他去了。」

chapters.en: Now there were some Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.
chapters.zh: 那时，上来过节礼拜的人中，有几个希腊人。

chapters.en: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, and requested of him, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
chapters.zh: 他们来见加利利、伯赛大的腓力，求他说：「先生，我们愿意见耶稣。」

chapters.en: Philip relayed this appeal to Andrew, and both of them went and told Jesus.
chapters.zh: 腓力去告诉安得烈，安得烈同腓力去告诉耶稣。

chapters.en: But Jesus replied, “The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「人子得荣耀的时候到了。

chapters.en: Truly, truly, I tell you, unless a kernel of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it remains only a seed. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，一粒麦子不落在地里死了，仍旧是一粒，若是死了，就结出许多子粒来。

chapters.en: Whoever loves his life will lose it, but whoever hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.
chapters.zh: 爱惜自己生命的，就失丧生命；在这世上恨恶自己生命的，就要保守生命到永生。

chapters.en: If anyone serves Me, he must follow Me; and where I am, My servant will be as well. If anyone serves Me, the Father will honor him.
chapters.zh: 若有人服事我，就当跟从我；我在哪里，服事我的人也要在那里；若有人服事我，我父必尊重他。」

chapters.en: Now My soul is troubled, and what shall I say? ‘Father, save Me from this hour’? No, it is for this purpose that I have come to this hour.
chapters.zh: 「我现在心里忧愁，我说什么才好呢？父啊，救我脱离这时候；但我原是为这时候来的。

chapters.en:
Father, glorify Your name!”
Then a voice came from heaven: “I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again.”
chapters.zh: 父啊，愿你荣耀你的名！」当时就有声音从天上来，说：「我已经荣耀了我的名，还要再荣耀。」

chapters.en: The crowd standing there heard it and said that it had thundered. Others said that an angel had spoken to Him.
chapters.zh: 站在旁边的众人听见，就说：「打雷了。」还有人说：「有天使对他说话。」

chapters.en: In response, Jesus said, “This voice was not for My benefit, but yours.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「这声音不是为我，是为你们来的。

chapters.en: Now judgment is upon this world; now the prince of this world will be cast out.
chapters.zh: 现在这世界受审判，这世界的王要被赶出去。

chapters.en: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw everyone to Myself.”
chapters.zh: 我若从地上被举起来，就要吸引万人来归我。」

chapters.en: He said this to indicate the kind of death He was going to die.
chapters.zh: 耶稣这话原是指着自己将要怎样死说的。

chapters.en: The crowd replied, “We have heard from the Law that the Christ will remain forever. So how can You say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”
chapters.zh: 众人回答说：「我们听见律法上有话说，基督是永存的，你怎么说『人子必须被举起来』呢？这人子是谁呢？」

chapters.en: Then Jesus told them, “For a little while longer, the Light will be among you. Walk while you have the Light, so that darkness will not overtake you. The one who walks in the darkness does not know where he is going.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「光在你们中间还有不多的时候，应当趁着有光行走，免得黑暗临到你们；那在黑暗里行走的，不知道往何处去。

chapters.en:
While you have the Light, believe in the Light, so that you may become sons of light.”
After Jesus had spoken these things, He went away and was hidden from them.
chapters.zh: 你们应当趁着有光，信从这光，使你们成为光明之子。」 耶稣说了这话，就离开他们隐藏了。

chapters.en: Although Jesus had performed so many signs in their presence, they still did not believe in Him.
chapters.zh: 他虽然在他们面前行了许多神迹，他们还是不信他。

chapters.en:
This was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet:
“Lord, who has believed our message? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
chapters.zh: 这是要应验先知以赛亚的话，说： 主啊，我们所传的有谁信呢？ 主的膀臂向谁显露呢？

chapters.en: For this reason they were unable to believe. For again, Isaiah says:
chapters.zh: 他们所以不能信，因为以赛亚又说：

chapters.en: “He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, so that they cannot see with their eyes, and understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.”
chapters.zh: 主叫他们瞎了眼， 硬了心， 免得他们眼睛看见， 心里明白，回转过来， 我就医治他们。

chapters.en: Isaiah said these things because he saw Jesus’ glory and spoke about Him.
chapters.zh: 以赛亚因为看见他的荣耀，就指着他说这话。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, many of the leaders believed in Him. But because of the Pharisees they did not confess Him, for fear that they would be put out of the synagogue.
chapters.zh: 虽然如此，官长中却有好些信他的，只因法利赛人的缘故，就不承认，恐怕被赶出会堂。

chapters.en: For they loved praise from men more than praise from God.
chapters.zh: 这是因他们爱人的荣耀过于爱上帝的荣耀。

chapters.en: Then Jesus cried out, “Whoever believes in Me does not believe in Me alone, but in the One who sent Me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣大声说：「信我的，不是信我，乃是信那差我来的。

chapters.en: And whoever sees Me sees the One who sent Me.
chapters.zh: 人看见我，就是看见那差我来的。

chapters.en: I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in Me should remain in darkness.
chapters.zh: 我到世上来，乃是光，叫凡信我的，不住在黑暗里。

chapters.en: As for anyone who hears My words and does not keep them, I do not judge him. For I have not come to judge the world, but to save the world.
chapters.zh: 若有人听见我的话不遵守，我不审判他。我来本不是要审判世界，乃是要拯救世界。

chapters.en: There is a judge for the one who rejects Me and does not receive My words: The word that I have spoken will judge him on the last day.
chapters.zh: 弃绝我、不领受我话的人，有审判他的－就是我所讲的道在末日要审判他。

chapters.en: I have not spoken on My own, but the Father who sent Me has commanded Me what to say and how to say it.
chapters.zh: 因为我没有凭着自己讲，惟有差我来的父已经给我命令，叫我说什么，讲什么。

chapters.en: And I know that His command leads to eternal life. So I speak exactly what the Father has told Me to say.”
chapters.zh: 我也知道他的命令就是永生。故此，我所讲的话正是照着父对我所说的。」

chapters.en: It was now just before the Passover Feast, and Jesus knew that His hour had come to leave this world and return to the Father. Having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the very end.
chapters.zh: 逾越节以前，耶稣知道自己离世归父的时候到了。他既然爱世间属自己的人，就爱他们到底。

chapters.en: The evening meal was underway, and the devil had already put into the heart of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, to betray Jesus.
chapters.zh: 吃晚饭的时候，魔鬼已将卖耶稣的意思放在西门的儿子加略人犹大心里。

chapters.en: Jesus knew that the Father had delivered all things into His hands, and that He had come from God and was returning to God.
chapters.zh: 耶稣知道父已将万有交在他手里，且知道自己是从上帝出来的，又要归到上帝那里去，

chapters.en: So He got up from the supper, laid aside His outer garments, and wrapped a towel around His waist.
chapters.zh: 就离席站起来，脱了衣服，拿一条手巾束腰，

chapters.en: After that, He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and dry them with the towel that was around Him.
chapters.zh: 随后把水倒在盆里，就洗门徒的脚，并用自己所束的手巾擦干。

chapters.en: He came to Simon Peter, who asked Him, “Lord, are You going to wash my feet?”
chapters.zh: 挨到西门‧彼得，彼得对他说：「主啊，你洗我的脚吗？」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我所做的，你如今不知道，后来必明白。」

chapters.en:
“Never shall You wash my feet!” Peter told Him.
Jesus answered, “Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.”
chapters.zh: 彼得说：「你永不可洗我的脚！」耶稣说：「我若不洗你，你就与我无分了。」

chapters.en: “Then, Lord,” Simon Peter replied, “not only my feet, but my hands and my head as well!”
chapters.zh: 西门‧彼得说：「主啊，不但我的脚，连手和头也要洗。」

chapters.en: Jesus told him, “Whoever has already bathed needs only to wash his feet, and he will be completely clean. And you are clean, though not all of you.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「凡洗过澡的人，只要把脚一洗，全身就干净了。你们是干净的，然而不都是干净的。」

chapters.en: For He knew who would betray Him. That is why He said, “Not all of you are clean.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣原知道要卖他的是谁，所以说：「你们不都是干净的。」

chapters.en: When Jesus had washed their feet and put on His outer garments, He reclined with them again and asked, “Do you know what I have done for you?
chapters.zh: 耶稣洗完了他们的脚，就穿上衣服，又坐下，对他们说：「我向你们所做的，你们明白吗？

chapters.en: You call Me Teacher and Lord, and rightly so, because I am.
chapters.zh: 你们称呼我夫子，称呼我主，你们说的不错，我本来是。

chapters.en: So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.
chapters.zh: 我是你们的主，你们的夫子，尚且洗你们的脚，你们也当彼此洗脚。

chapters.en: I have set you an example so that you should do as I have done for you.
chapters.zh: 我给你们作了榜样，叫你们照着我向你们所做的去做。

chapters.en: Truly, truly, I tell you, no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，仆人不能大于主人，差人也不能大于差他的人。

chapters.en: If you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.
chapters.zh: 你们既知道这事，若是去行就有福了。

chapters.en: I am not speaking about all of you; I know whom I have chosen. But this is to fulfill the Scripture: ‘The one who shares My bread has lifted up his heel against Me.’
chapters.zh: 我这话不是指着你们众人说的，我知道我所拣选的是谁。现在要应验经上的话，说：『同我吃饭的人用脚踢我。』

chapters.en: I am telling you now before it happens, so that when it comes to pass, you will believe that I am He.
chapters.zh: 如今事情还没有成就，我要先告诉你们，叫你们到事情成就的时候可以信我是〔基督〕。

chapters.en: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever receives the one I send receives Me, and whoever receives Me receives the One who sent Me.”
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，有人接待我所差遣的，就是接待我；接待我，就是接待那差遣我的。」

chapters.en: After Jesus had said this, He became troubled in spirit and testified, “Truly, truly, I tell you, one of you will betray Me.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说了这话，心里忧愁，就明说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，你们中间有一个人要卖我了。」

chapters.en: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed as to which of them He meant.
chapters.zh: 门徒彼此对看，猜不透所说的是谁。

chapters.en: One of His disciples, the one whom Jesus loved, was reclining at His side.
chapters.zh: 有一个门徒，是耶稣所爱的，侧身挨近耶稣的怀里。

chapters.en: So Simon Peter motioned to him to ask Jesus which one He was talking about.
chapters.zh: 西门‧彼得点头对他说：「你告诉我们，主是指着谁说的。」

chapters.en: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked, “Lord, who is it?”
chapters.zh: 那门徒便就势靠着耶稣的胸膛，问他说：「主啊，是谁呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “It is the one to whom I give this morsel after I have dipped it.” Then He dipped the morsel and gave it to Judas son of Simon Iscariot.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我蘸一点饼给谁，就是谁。」耶稣就蘸了一点饼，递给加略人西门的儿子犹大。

chapters.en:
And when Judas had taken the morsel, Satan entered into him.
Then Jesus said to Judas, “What you are about to do, do quickly.”
chapters.zh: 他吃了以后，撒但就入了他的心。耶稣便对他说：「你所做的，快做吧！」

chapters.en: But no one at the table knew why Jesus had said this to him.
chapters.zh: 同席的人没有一个知道是为什么对他说这话。

chapters.en: Since Judas kept the money bag, some thought that Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the feast, or to give something to the poor.
chapters.zh: 有人因犹大带着钱囊，以为耶稣是对他说：「你去买我们过节所应用的东西」，或是叫他拿什么赒济穷人。

chapters.en: As soon as he had received the morsel, Judas went out into the night.
chapters.zh: 犹大受了那点饼，立刻就出去。那时候是夜间了。

chapters.en: When Judas had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in Him.
chapters.zh: 他既出去，耶稣就说：「如今人子得了荣耀，上帝在人子身上也得了荣耀。

chapters.en: If God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify the Son in Himself—and will glorify Him at once.
chapters.zh: 上帝要因自己荣耀人子，并且要快快地荣耀他。

chapters.en: Little children, I am with you only a little while longer. You will look for Me, and as I said to the Jews, so now I say to you: ‘Where I am going, you cannot come.’
chapters.zh: 小子们，我还有不多的时候与你们同在；后来你们要找我，但我所去的地方你们不能到。这话我曾对犹太人说过，如今也照样对你们说。

chapters.en: A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another.
chapters.zh: 我赐给你们一条新命令，乃是叫你们彼此相爱；我怎样爱你们，你们也要怎样相爱。

chapters.en: By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.”
chapters.zh: 你们若有彼此相爱的心，众人因此就认出你们是我的门徒了。」

chapters.en:
“Lord, where are You going?” Simon Peter asked.
Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you cannot follow Me now, but you will follow later.”
chapters.zh: 西门‧彼得问耶稣说：「主往哪里去？」耶稣回答说：「我所去的地方，你现在不能跟我去，后来却要跟我去。」

chapters.en: “Lord,” said Peter, “why can’t I follow You now? I will lay down my life for You.”
chapters.zh: 彼得说：「主啊，我为什么现在不能跟你去？我愿意为你舍命！」

chapters.en: “Will you lay down your life for Me?” Jesus replied. “Truly, truly, I tell you, before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你愿意为我舍命吗？我实实在在地告诉你，鸡叫以先，你要三次不认我。」

chapters.en: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.
chapters.zh: 「你们心里不要忧愁；你们信上帝，也当信我。

chapters.en: In My Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?
chapters.zh: 在我父的家里有许多住处；若是没有，我就早已告诉你们了。我去原是为你们预备地方去。

chapters.en: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and welcome you into My presence, so that you also may be where I am.
chapters.zh: 我若去为你们预备了地方，就必再来接你们到我那里去，我在哪里，叫你们也在那里。

chapters.en: You know the way to the place where I am going. ”
chapters.zh: 我往哪里去，你们知道；那条路，你们也知道〔注：有古卷：我往哪里去，你们知道那条路〕。」

chapters.en: “Lord,” said Thomas, “we do not know where You are going, so how can we know the way?”
chapters.zh: 多马对他说：「主啊，我们不知道你往哪里去，怎么知道那条路呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我就是道路、真理、生命；若不藉着我，没有人能到父那里去。

chapters.en: If you had known Me, you would know My Father as well. From now on you do know Him and have seen Him.”
chapters.zh: 你们若认识我，也就认识我的父。从今以后，你们认识他，并且已经看见他。」

chapters.en: Philip said to Him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
chapters.zh: 腓力对他说：「求主将父显给我们看，我们就知足了。」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “Philip, I have been with you all this time, and still you do not know Me? Anyone who has seen Me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「腓力，我与你们同在这样长久，你还不认识我吗？人看见了我，就是看见了父；你怎么说『将父显给我们看』呢？

chapters.en: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me? The words I say to you, I do not speak on My own. Instead, it is the Father dwelling in Me, performing His works.
chapters.zh: 我在父里面，父在我里面，你不信吗？我对你们所说的话，不是凭着自己说的，乃是住在我里面的父做他自己的事。

chapters.en: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me—or at least believe on account of the works themselves.
chapters.zh: 你们当信我，我在父里面，父在我里面；即或不信，也当因我所做的事信我。

chapters.en: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever believes in Me will also do the works that I am doing. He will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，我所做的事，信我的人也要做，并且要做比这更大的事，因为我往父那里去。

chapters.en: And I will do whatever you ask in My name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
chapters.zh: 你们奉我的名无论求什么，我必成就，叫父因儿子得荣耀。

chapters.en: If you ask Me for anything in My name, I will do it.
chapters.zh: 你们若奉我的名求什么，我必成就。」

chapters.en: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.
chapters.zh: 「你们若爱我，就必遵守我的命令。

chapters.en: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate to be with you forever—
chapters.zh: 我要求父，父就另外赐给你们一位保惠师〔注：或译：训慰师；下同〕，叫他永远与你们同在，

chapters.en: the Spirit of truth. The world cannot receive Him, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him. But you do know Him, for He abides with you and will be in you.
chapters.zh: 就是真理的〔圣〕灵，乃世人不能接受的；因为不见他，也不认识他。你们却认识他，因他常与你们同在，也要在你们里面。

chapters.en: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.
chapters.zh: 我不撇下你们为孤儿，我必到你们这里来。

chapters.en: In a little while the world will see Me no more, but you will see Me. Because I live, you also will live.
chapters.zh: 还有不多的时候，世人不再看见我，你们却看见我；因为我活着，你们也要活着。

chapters.en: On that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you are in Me, and I am in you.
chapters.zh: 到那日，你们就知道我在父里面，你们在我里面，我也在你们里面。

chapters.en: Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.”
chapters.zh: 有了我的命令又遵守的，这人就是爱我的；爱我的必蒙我父爱他，我也要爱他，并且要向他显现。」

chapters.en: Judas (not Iscariot) asked Him, “Lord, why are You going to reveal Yourself to us and not to the world?”
chapters.zh: 犹大（不是加略人犹大）问耶稣说：「主啊，为什么要向我们显现，不向世人显现呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word. My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「人若爱我，就必遵守我的道；我父也必爱他，并且我们要到他那里去，与他同住。

chapters.en: Whoever does not love Me does not keep My words. The word that you hear is not My own, but it is from the Father who sent Me.
chapters.zh: 不爱我的人就不遵守我的道。你们所听见的道不是我的，乃是差我来之父的道。

chapters.en: All this I have spoken to you while I am still with you.
chapters.zh: 「我还与你们同住的时候，已将这些话对你们说了。

chapters.en: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.
chapters.zh: 但保惠师，就是父因我的名所要差来的圣灵，他要将一切的事指教你们，并且要叫你们想起我对你们所说的一切话。

chapters.en: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.
chapters.zh: 我留下平安给你们；我将我的平安赐给你们。我所赐的，不像世人所赐的。你们心里不要忧愁，也不要胆怯。

chapters.en: You heard Me say, ‘I am going away, and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved Me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.
chapters.zh: 你们听见我对你们说了，我去还要到你们这里来。你们若爱我，因我到父那里去，就必喜乐，因为父是比我大的。

chapters.en: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe.
chapters.zh: 现在事情还没有成就，我预先告诉你们，叫你们到事情成就的时候就可以信。

chapters.en: I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Me.
chapters.zh: 以后我不再和你们多说话，因为这世界的王将到。他在我里面是毫无所有；

chapters.en:
But I do exactly what the Father has commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love the Father.
Get up! Let us go on from here.
chapters.zh: 但要叫世人知道我爱父，并且父怎样吩咐我，我就怎样行。起来，我们走吧！」

chapters.en: “I am the true vine, and My Father is the keeper of the vineyard.
chapters.zh: 「我是真葡萄树，我父是栽培的人。

chapters.en: He cuts off every branch in Me that bears no fruit, and every branch that does bear fruit, He prunes to make it even more fruitful.
chapters.zh: 凡属我不结果子的枝子，他就剪去；凡结果子的，他就修理干净，使枝子结果子更多。

chapters.en: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.
chapters.zh: 现在你们因我讲给你们的道，已经干净了。

chapters.en: Remain in Me, and I will remain in you. Just as no branch can bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, neither can you bear fruit unless you remain in Me.
chapters.zh: 你们要常在我里面，我也常在你们里面。枝子若不常在葡萄树上，自己就不能结果子；你们若不常在我里面，也是这样。

chapters.en: I am the vine and you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him, will bear much fruit. For apart from Me you can do nothing.
chapters.zh: 我是葡萄树，你们是枝子。常在我里面的，我也常在他里面，这人就多结果子；因为离了我，你们就不能做什么。

chapters.en: If anyone does not remain in Me, he is like a branch that is thrown away and withers. Such branches are gathered up, thrown into the fire, and burned.
chapters.zh: 人若不常在我里面，就像枝子丢在外面枯干，人拾起来，扔在火里烧了。

chapters.en: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
chapters.zh: 你们若常在我里面，我的话也常在你们里面，凡你们所愿意的，祈求，就给你们成就。

chapters.en: This is to My Father’s glory, that you bear much fruit, proving yourselves to be My disciples.
chapters.zh: 你们多结果子，我父就因此得荣耀，你们也就是我的门徒了。

chapters.en: As the Father has loved Me, so have I loved you. Remain in My love.
chapters.zh: 我爱你们，正如父爱我一样；你们要常在我的爱里。

chapters.en: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love.
chapters.zh: 你们若遵守我的命令，就常在我的爱里，正如我遵守了我父的命令，常在他的爱里。

chapters.en: I have told you these things so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be complete.
chapters.zh: 「这些事我已经对你们说了，是要叫我的喜乐存在你们心里，并叫你们的喜乐可以满足。

chapters.en: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.
chapters.zh: 你们要彼此相爱，像我爱你们一样；这就是我的命令。

chapters.en: Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.
chapters.zh: 人为朋友舍命，人的爱心没有比这个大的。

chapters.en: You are My friends if you do what I command you.
chapters.zh: 你们若遵行我所吩咐的，就是我的朋友了。

chapters.en: No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not understand what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you.
chapters.zh: 以后我不再称你们为仆人，因仆人不知道主人所做的事。我乃称你们为朋友；因我从我父所听见的，已经都告诉你们了。

chapters.en: You did not choose Me, but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit—fruit that will remain—so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
chapters.zh: 不是你们拣选了我，是我拣选了你们，并且分派你们去结果子，叫你们的果子常存，使你们奉我的名，无论向父求什么，他就赐给你们。

chapters.en: This is My command to you: Love one another.
chapters.zh: 我这样吩咐你们，是要叫你们彼此相爱。」

chapters.en: If the world hates you, understand that it hated Me first.
chapters.zh: 「世人若恨你们，你们知道〔注：或译：该知道〕，恨你们以先已经恨我了。

chapters.en: If you were of the world, it would love you as its own. Instead, the world hates you, because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world.
chapters.zh: 你们若属世界，世界必爱属自己的；只因你们不属世界，乃是我从世界中拣选了你们，所以世界就恨你们。

chapters.en: Remember the word that I spoke to you: ‘No servant is greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will persecute you as well; if they kept My word, they will keep yours as well.
chapters.zh: 你们要记念我从前对你们所说的话：『仆人不能大于主人。』他们若逼迫了我，也要逼迫你们；若遵守了我的话，也要遵守你们的话。

chapters.en: But they will treat you like this because of My name, since they do not know the One who sent Me.
chapters.zh: 但他们因我的名要向你们行这一切的事，因为他们不认识那差我来的。

chapters.en: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. Now, however, they have no excuse for their sin.
chapters.zh: 我若没有来教训他们，他们就没有罪；但如今他们的罪无可推诿了。

chapters.en: Whoever hates Me hates My Father as well.
chapters.zh: 恨我的，也恨我的父。

chapters.en: If I had not done among them the works that no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin; but now they have seen and hated both Me and My Father.
chapters.zh: 我若没有在他们中间行过别人未曾行的事，他们就没有罪；但如今连我与我的父，他们也看见也恨恶了。

chapters.en: But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: ‘They hated Me without reason.’
chapters.zh: 这要应验他们律法上所写的话，说：『他们无故地恨我。』

chapters.en: When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father—He will testify about Me.
chapters.zh: 但我要从父那里差保惠师来，就是从父出来真理的圣灵；他来了，就要为我作见证。

chapters.en: And you also must testify, because you have been with Me from the beginning.
chapters.zh: 你们也要作见证，因为你们从起头就与我同在。」

chapters.en: “I have told you these things so that you will not fall away.
chapters.zh: 「我已将这些事告诉你们，使你们不至于跌倒。

chapters.en: They will put you out of the synagogues. In fact, a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think he is offering a service to God.
chapters.zh: 人要把你们赶出会堂，并且时候将到，凡杀你们的就以为是事奉上帝。

chapters.en: They will do these things because they have not known the Father or Me.
chapters.zh: 他们这样行，是因未曾认识父，也未曾认识我。

chapters.en: But I have told you these things so that when their hour comes, you will remember that I told you about them. I did not tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
chapters.zh: 我将这事告诉你们，是叫你们到了时候可以想起我对你们说过了。」 「我起先没有将这事告诉你们，因为我与你们同在。

chapters.en: Now, however, I am going to Him who sent Me; yet none of you asks Me, ‘Where are You going?’
chapters.zh: 现今我往差我来的〔父〕那里去，你们中间并没有人问我：『你往哪里去？』

chapters.en: Instead, your hearts are filled with sorrow because I have told you these things.
chapters.zh: 只因我将这事告诉你们，你们就满心忧愁。

chapters.en: But I tell you the truth, it is for your benefit that I am going away. Unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send Him to you.
chapters.zh: 然而，我将真情告诉你们，我去是与你们有益的；我若不去，保惠师就不到你们这里来；我若去，就差他来。

chapters.en: And when He comes, He will convict the world in regard to sin and righteousness and judgment:
chapters.zh: 他既来了，就要叫世人为罪、为义、为审判，自己责备自己。

chapters.en: in regard to sin, because they do not believe in Me;
chapters.zh: 为罪，是因他们不信我；

chapters.en: in regard to righteousness, because I am going to the Father and you will no longer see Me;
chapters.zh: 为义，是因我往父那里去，你们就不再见我；

chapters.en: and in regard to judgment, because the prince of this world has been condemned.
chapters.zh: 为审判，是因这世界的王受了审判。

chapters.en: I still have much to tell you, but you cannot yet bear to hear it.
chapters.zh: 「我还有好些事要告诉你们，但你们现在担当不了〔注：或译：不能领会〕。

chapters.en: However, when the Spirit of truth comes, He will guide you into all truth. For He will not speak on His own, but He will speak what He hears, and He will declare to you what is to come.
chapters.zh: 只等真理的圣灵来了，他要引导你们明白〔注：原文是进入〕一切的真理；因为他不是凭自己说的，乃是把他所听见的都说出来，并要把将来的事告诉你们。

chapters.en: He will glorify Me by taking from what is Mine and disclosing it to you.
chapters.zh: 他要荣耀我，因为他要将受于我的告诉你们。

chapters.en: Everything that belongs to the Father is Mine. That is why I said that the Spirit will take from what is Mine and disclose it to you.
chapters.zh: 凡父所有的，都是我的；所以我说，他要将受于我的告诉你们。」

chapters.en: In a little while you will see Me no more, and then after a little while you will see Me. ”
chapters.zh: 「等不多时，你们就不得见我；再等不多时，你们还要见我。」

chapters.en: Then some of His disciples asked one another, “Why is He telling us, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’ and ‘Because I am going to the Father’?”
chapters.zh: 有几个门徒就彼此说：「他对我们说：『等不多时，你们就不得见我；再等不多时，你们还要见我』；又〔说〕：『因我往父那里去。』这是什么意思呢？」

chapters.en: They kept asking, “Why is He saying, ‘a little while’? We do not understand what He is saying.”
chapters.zh: 门徒彼此说：「他说『等不多时』到底是什么意思呢？我们不明白他所说的话。」

chapters.en: Aware that they wanted to question Him, Jesus said to them, “Are you asking one another why I said, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’?
chapters.zh: 耶稣看出他们要问他，就说：「我说『等不多时，你们就不得见我；再等不多时，你们还要见我』，你们为这话彼此相问吗？

chapters.en: Truly, truly, I tell you, you will weep and wail while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你们，你们将要痛哭、哀号，世人倒要喜乐；你们将要忧愁，然而你们的忧愁要变为喜乐。

chapters.en: A woman has pain in childbirth because her time has come; but when she brings forth her child, she forgets her anguish because of her joy that a child has been born into the world.
chapters.zh: 妇人生产的时候就忧愁，因为她的时候到了；既生了孩子，就不再记念那苦楚，因为欢喜世上生了一个人。

chapters.en: So also you have sorrow now, but I will see you again and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.
chapters.zh: 你们现在也是忧愁，但我要再见你们，你们的心就喜乐了；这喜乐也没有人能夺去。

chapters.en: In that day you will no longer ask Me anything. Truly, truly, I tell you, whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
chapters.zh: 到那日，你们什么也就不问我了。我实实在在地告诉你们，你们若向父求什么，他必因我的名赐给你们。

chapters.en: Until now you have not asked for anything in My name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.
chapters.zh: 向来你们没有奉我的名求什么，如今你们求，就必得着，叫你们的喜乐可以满足。」

chapters.en: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. An hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you this way, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
chapters.zh: 「这些事，我是用比喻对你们说的；时候将到，我不再用比喻对你们说，乃要将父明明地告诉你们。

chapters.en: In that day you will ask in My name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.
chapters.zh: 到那日，你们要奉我的名祈求；我并不对你们说，我要为你们求父。

chapters.en: For the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came from God.
chapters.zh: 父自己爱你们；因为你们已经爱我，又信我是从父出来的。

chapters.en: I came from the Father and entered the world. In turn, I will leave the world and go to the Father.”
chapters.zh: 我从父出来，到了世界；我又离开世界，往父那里去。」

chapters.en: His disciples said, “See, now You are speaking plainly and without figures of speech.
chapters.zh: 门徒说：「如今你是明说，并不用比喻了。

chapters.en: Now we understand that You know all things and that You have no need for anyone to question You. Because of this, we believe that You came from God.”
chapters.zh: 现在我们晓得你凡事都知道，也不用人问你，因此我们信你是从上帝出来的。」

chapters.en: “Do you finally believe?” Jesus replied.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「现在你们信吗？

chapters.en: “Look, an hour is coming and has already come when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and you will leave Me all alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.
chapters.zh: 看哪，时候将到，且是已经到了，你们要分散，各归自己的地方去，留下我独自一人；其实我不是独自一人，因为有父与我同在。

chapters.en: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!”
chapters.zh: 我将这些事告诉你们，是要叫你们在我里面有平安。在世上，你们有苦难；但你们可以放心，我已经胜了世界。」

chapters.en: When Jesus had spoken these things, He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said, “Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son may glorify You.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说了这话，就举目望天，说：「父啊，时候到了，愿你荣耀你的儿子，使儿子也荣耀你；

chapters.en: For You granted Him authority over all people, so that He may give eternal life to all those You have given Him.
chapters.zh: 正如你曾赐给他权柄管理凡有血气的，叫他将永生赐给你所赐给他的人。

chapters.en: Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.
chapters.zh: 认识你－独一的真神，并且认识你所差来的耶稣基督，这就是永生。

chapters.en: I have glorified You on earth by accomplishing the work You gave Me to do.
chapters.zh: 我在地上已经荣耀你，你所托付我的事，我已成全了。

chapters.en: And now, Father, glorify Me in Your presence with the glory I had with You before the world existed.
chapters.zh: 父啊，现在求你使我同你享荣耀，就是未有世界以先，我同你所有的荣耀。

chapters.en: I have revealed Your name to those You have given Me out of the world. They were Yours; You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.
chapters.zh: 「你从世上赐给我的人，我已将你的名显明与他们。他们本是你的，你将他们赐给我，他们也遵守了你的道。

chapters.en: Now they know that everything You have given Me comes from You.
chapters.zh: 如今他们知道，凡你所赐给我的，都是从你那里来的；

chapters.en: For I have given them the words You gave Me, and they have received them. They knew with certainty that I came from You, and they believed that You sent Me.
chapters.zh: 因为你所赐给我的道，我已经赐给他们，他们也领受了，又确实知道，我是从你出来的，并且信你差了我来。

chapters.en: I ask on their behalf. I do not ask on behalf of the world, but on behalf of those You have given Me; for they are Yours.
chapters.zh: 我为他们祈求，不为世人祈求，却为你所赐给我的人祈求，因他们本是你的。

chapters.en: All I have is Yours, and all You have is Mine; and in them I have been glorified.
chapters.zh: 凡是我的，都是你的；你的也是我的，并且我因他们得了荣耀。

chapters.en:
I will no longer be in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You.
Holy Father, protect them by Your name, the name You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one.
chapters.zh: 从今以后，我不在世上，他们却在世上；我往你那里去。圣父啊，求你因你所赐给我的名保守他们，叫他们合而为一像我们一样。

chapters.en: While I was with them, I protected and preserved them by Your name, the name You gave Me. Not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.
chapters.zh: 我与他们同在的时候，因你所赐给我的名保守了他们，我也护卫了他们；其中除了那灭亡之子，没有一个灭亡的，好叫经上的话得应验。

chapters.en: But now I am coming to You; and I am saying these things while I am in the world, so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them.
chapters.zh: 现在我往你那里去，我还在世上说这话，是叫他们心里充满我的喜乐。

chapters.en: I have given them Your word and the world has hated them. For they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
chapters.zh: 我已将你的道赐给他们。世界又恨他们；因为他们不属世界，正如我不属世界一样。

chapters.en: I am not asking that You take them out of the world, but that You keep them from the evil one.
chapters.zh: 我不求你叫他们离开世界，只求你保守他们脱离那恶者〔注：或译：脱离罪恶〕。

chapters.en: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
chapters.zh: 他们不属世界，正如我不属世界一样。

chapters.en: Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth.
chapters.zh: 求你用真理使他们成圣；你的道就是真理。

chapters.en: As You sent Me into the world, I have also sent them into the world.
chapters.zh: 你怎样差我到世上，我也照样差他们到世上。

chapters.en: For them I sanctify Myself, so that they too may be sanctified by the truth.
chapters.zh: 我为他们的缘故，自己分别为圣，叫他们也因真理成圣。

chapters.en: I am not asking on behalf of them alone, but also on behalf of those who will believe in Me through their message,
chapters.zh: 「我不但为这些人祈求，也为那些因他们的话信我的人祈求，

chapters.en: that all of them may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I am in You. May they also be in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.
chapters.zh: 使他们都合而为一。正如你父在我里面，我在你里面，使他们也在我们里面，叫世人可以信你差了我来。

chapters.en: I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one—
chapters.zh: 你所赐给我的荣耀，我已赐给他们，使他们合而为一，像我们合而为一。

chapters.en: I in them and You in Me—that they may be perfectly united, so that the world may know that You sent Me and have loved them just as You have loved Me.
chapters.zh: 我在他们里面，你在我里面，使他们完完全全地合而为一，叫世人知道你差了我来，也知道你爱他们如同爱我一样。

chapters.en: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.
chapters.zh: 父啊，我在哪里，愿你所赐给我的人也同我在那里，叫他们看见你所赐给我的荣耀；因为创立世界以前，你已经爱我了。

chapters.en: Righteous Father, although the world has not known You, I know You, and they know that You sent Me.
chapters.zh: 公义的父啊，世人未曾认识你，我却认识你；这些人也知道你差了我来。

chapters.en: And I have made Your name known to them and will continue to make it known, so that the love You have for Me may be in them, and I in them.”
chapters.zh: 我已将你的名指示他们，还要指示他们，使你所爱我的爱在他们里面，我也在他们里面。」

chapters.en: After Jesus had spoken these words, He went out with His disciples across the Kidron Valley, where they entered a garden.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说了这话，就同门徒出去，过了汲沦溪。在那里有一个园子，他和门徒进去了。

chapters.en: Now Judas His betrayer also knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with His disciples.
chapters.zh: 卖耶稣的犹大也知道那地方，因为耶稣和门徒屡次上那里去聚集。

chapters.en: So Judas brought a band of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees. They arrived at the garden carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons.
chapters.zh: 犹大领了一队兵，和祭司长并法利赛人的差役，拿着灯笼、火把、兵器，就来到园里。

chapters.en: Jesus, knowing all that was coming upon Him, stepped forward and asked them, “Whom are you seeking?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣知道将要临到自己的一切事，就出来对他们说：「你们找谁？」

chapters.en:
“Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered.
Jesus said, “I am He.”
And Judas His betrayer was standing there with them.
chapters.zh: 他们回答说：「找拿撒勒人耶稣。」耶稣说：「我就是！」卖他的犹大也同他们站在那里。

chapters.en: When Jesus said, “I am He,” they drew back and fell to the ground.
chapters.zh: 耶稣一说「我就是」，他们就退后倒在地上。

chapters.en:
So He asked them again, “Whom are you seeking?”
“Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 他又问他们说：「你们找谁？」他们说：「找拿撒勒人耶稣。」

chapters.en: “I told you that I am He,” Jesus replied. “So if you are looking for Me, let these men go.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我已经告诉你们，我就是。你们若找我，就让这些人去吧。」

chapters.en: This was to fulfill the word He had spoken: “I have not lost one of those You have given Me.”
chapters.zh: 这要应验耶稣从前的话，说：「你所赐给我的人，我没有失落一个。」

chapters.en: Then Simon Peter drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
chapters.zh: 西门‧彼得带着一把刀，就拔出来，将大祭司的仆人砍了一刀，削掉他的右耳；那仆人名叫马勒古。

chapters.en: “Put your sword back in its sheath!” Jesus said to Peter. “Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given Me?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣就对彼得说：「收刀入鞘吧，我父所给我的那杯，我岂可不喝呢？」

chapters.en: Then the band of soldiers, with its commander and the officers of the Jews, arrested Jesus and bound Him.
chapters.zh: 那队兵和千夫长，并犹太人的差役就拿住耶稣，把他捆绑了，

chapters.en: They brought Him first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.
chapters.zh: 先带到亚那面前，因为亚那是本年作大祭司该亚法的岳父。

chapters.en: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it would be better if one man died for the people.
chapters.zh: 这该亚法就是从前向犹太人发议论说「一个人替百姓死是有益的」那位。

chapters.en: Now Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. Since that disciple was known to the high priest, he also went with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest.
chapters.zh: 西门‧彼得跟着耶稣，还有一个门徒跟着。那门徒是大祭司所认识的，他就同耶稣进了大祭司的院子。

chapters.en: But Peter stood outside at the door. Then the disciple who was known to the high priest went out and spoke to the doorkeeper, and brought Peter in.
chapters.zh: 彼得却站在门外。大祭司所认识的那个门徒出来，和看门的使女说了一声，就领彼得进去。

chapters.en:
At this, the servant girl watching the door said to Peter, “Aren’t you also one of this man’s disciples?”
“I am not,” he answered.
chapters.zh: 那看门的使女对彼得说：「你不也是这人的门徒吗？」他说：「我不是。」

chapters.en: Because it was cold, the servants and officers were standing around a charcoal fire they had made to keep warm. And Peter was also standing with them, warming himself.
chapters.zh: 仆人和差役因为天冷，就生了炭火，站在那里烤火；彼得也同他们站着烤火。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about His disciples and His teaching.
chapters.zh: 大祭司就以耶稣的门徒和他的教训盘问他。

chapters.en: “I have spoken openly to the world,” Jesus answered. “I always taught in the synagogues and at the temple, where all the Jews come together. I said nothing in secret.
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我从来是明明地对世人说话。我常在会堂和殿里，就是犹太人聚集的地方教训人；我在暗地里并没有说什么。

chapters.en: Why are you asking Me? Ask those who heard My message. Surely they know what I said.”
chapters.zh: 你为什么问我呢？可以问那听见的人，我对他们说的是什么；我所说的，他们都知道。」

chapters.en: When Jesus had said this, one of the officers standing nearby slapped Him in the face and said, “Is this how You answer the high priest?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说了这话，旁边站着的一个差役用手掌打他，说：「你这样回答大祭司吗？」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “If I said something wrong, testify as to what was wrong. But if I spoke correctly, why did you strike Me?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「我若说的不是，你可以指证那不是；我若说的是，你为什么打我呢？」

chapters.en: Then Annas sent Him, still bound, to Caiaphas the high priest.
chapters.zh: 亚那就把耶稣解到大祭司该亚法那里，仍是捆着解去的。

chapters.en:
Simon Peter was still standing and warming himself. So they asked him, “Aren’t you also one of His disciples?”
He denied it and said, “I am not.”
chapters.zh: 西门‧彼得正站着烤火，有人对他说：「你不也是他的门徒吗？」彼得不承认，说：「我不是。」

chapters.en: One of the high priest’s servants, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, asked, “Didn’t I see you with Him in the garden?”
chapters.zh: 有大祭司的一个仆人，是彼得削掉耳朵那人的亲属，说：「我不是看见你同他在园子里吗？」

chapters.en: Peter denied it once more, and immediately a rooster crowed.
chapters.zh: 彼得又不承认。立时鸡就叫了。

chapters.en: Then they led Jesus away from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. By now it was early morning, and the Jews did not enter the Praetorium, to avoid being defiled and unable to eat the Passover.
chapters.zh: 众人将耶稣从该亚法那里往衙门内解去，那时天还早。他们自己却不进衙门，恐怕染了污秽，不能吃逾越〔节的筵席〕。

chapters.en: So Pilate went out to them and asked, “What accusation are you bringing against this man?”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多就出来，到他们那里，说：「你们告这人是为什么事呢？」

chapters.en: “If He were not a criminal,” they replied, “we would not have handed Him over to you.”
chapters.zh: 他们回答说：「这人若不是作恶的，我们就不把他交给你。」

chapters.en:
“You take Him and judge Him by your own law,” Pilate told them.
“We are not permitted to execute anyone,” the Jews replied.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多说：「你们自己带他去，按着你们的律法审问他吧。」犹太人说：「我们没有杀人的权柄。」

chapters.en: This was to fulfill the word that Jesus had spoken to indicate the kind of death He was going to die.
chapters.zh: 这要应验耶稣所说自己将要怎样死的话了。

chapters.en: Pilate went back into the Praetorium, summoned Jesus, and asked Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多又进了衙门，叫耶稣来，对他说：「你是犹太人的王吗？」

chapters.en: “Are you saying this on your own,” Jesus asked, “or did others tell you about Me?”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「这话是你自己说的，还是别人论我对你说的呢？」

chapters.en: “Am I a Jew?” Pilate replied. “Your own people and chief priests handed You over to me. What have You done?”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多说：「我岂是犹太人呢？你本国的人和祭司长把你交给我。你做了什么事呢？」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “My kingdom is not of this world; if it were, My servants would fight to prevent My arrest by the Jews. But now My kingdom is not of this realm.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我的国不属这世界；我的国若属这世界，我的臣仆必要争战，使我不至于被交给犹太人。只是我的国不属这世界。」

chapters.en:
“Then You are a king!” Pilate said.
“You say that I am a king,” Jesus answered. “For this reason I was born and have come into the world, to testify to the truth. Everyone who belongs to the truth listens to My voice.”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多就对他说：「这样，你是王吗？」耶稣回答说：「你说我是王。我为此而生，也为此来到世间，特为给真理作见证。凡属真理的人就听我的话。」

chapters.en:
“What is truth?” Pilate asked.
And having said this, he went out again to the Jews and told them, “I find no basis for a charge against Him.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多说：「真理是什么呢？」 说了这话，又出来到犹太人那里，对他们说：「我查不出他有什么罪来。

chapters.en: But it is your custom that I release to you one prisoner at the Passover. So then, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
chapters.zh: 但你们有个规矩，在逾越节要我给你们释放一个人，你们要我给你们释放犹太人的王吗？」

chapters.en: “Not this man,” they shouted, “but Barabbas!” (Now Barabbas was an insurrectionist.)
chapters.zh: 他们又喊着说：「不要这人，要巴拉巴！」这巴拉巴是个强盗。

chapters.en: Then Pilate took Jesus and had Him flogged.
chapters.zh: 当下彼拉多将耶稣鞭打了。

chapters.en: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns, set it on His head, and dressed Him in a purple robe.
chapters.zh: 兵丁用荆棘编做冠冕戴在他头上，给他穿上紫袍，

chapters.en: And they went up to Him again and again, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and slapping Him in the face.
chapters.zh: 又挨近他，说：「恭喜，犹太人的王啊！」他们就用手掌打他。

chapters.en: Once again Pilate came out and said to the Jews, “Look, I am bringing Him out to you to let you know that I find no basis for a charge against Him.”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多又出来对众人说：「我带他出来见你们，叫你们知道我查不出他有什么罪来。」

chapters.en: When Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, “Here is the man!”
chapters.zh: 耶稣出来，戴着荆棘冠冕，穿着紫袍。〔彼拉多〕对他们说：「你们看这个人！」

chapters.en:
As soon as the chief priests and officers saw Him, they shouted, “Crucify Him! Crucify Him!”
“You take Him and crucify Him,” Pilate replied, “for I find no basis for a charge against Him.”
chapters.zh: 祭司长和差役看见他，就喊着说：「钉他十字架！钉他十字架！」彼拉多说：「你们自己把他钉十字架吧！我查不出他有什么罪来。」

chapters.en: “We have a law,” answered the Jews, “and according to that law He must die, because He declared Himself to be the Son of God.”
chapters.zh: 犹太人回答说：「我们有律法，按那律法，他是该死的，因他以自己为上帝的儿子。」

chapters.en: When Pilate heard this statement, he was even more afraid,
chapters.zh: 彼拉多听见这话，越发害怕，

chapters.en:
and he went back into the Praetorium. “Where are You from?” he asked.
But Jesus gave no answer.
chapters.zh: 又进衙门，对耶稣说：「你是哪里来的？」耶稣却不回答。

chapters.en: So Pilate said to Him, “Do You refuse to speak to me? Do You not know that I have authority to release You and authority to crucify You?”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多说：「你不对我说话吗？你岂不知我有权柄释放你，也有权柄把你钉十字架吗？」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “You would have no authority over Me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed Me over to you is guilty of greater sin.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣回答说：「若不是从上头赐给你的，你就毫无权柄办我。所以，把我交给你的那人罪更重了。」

chapters.en: From then on, Pilate tried to release Him, but the Jews kept shouting, “If you release this man, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who declares himself a king is defying Caesar.”
chapters.zh: 从此，彼拉多想要释放耶稣，无奈犹太人喊着说：「你若释放这个人，就不是凯撒的忠臣〔注：原文是朋友〕。凡以自己为王的，就是背叛凯撒了。」

chapters.en: When Pilate heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat on the judgment seat at a place called the Stone Pavement, which in Hebrew is Gabbatha.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多听见这话，就带耶稣出来，到了一个地方，名叫「铺华石处」，希伯来话叫厄巴大，就在那里坐堂。

chapters.en: It was the day of Preparation for the Passover, about the sixth hour. And Pilate said to the Jews, “Here is your King!”
chapters.zh: 那日是预备逾越〔节〕的日子，约有午正。彼拉多对犹太人说：「看哪，这是你们的王！」

chapters.en:
At this, they shouted, “Away with Him! Away with Him! Crucify Him!”
“Shall I crucify your King?” Pilate asked.
“We have no king but Caesar,” replied the chief priests.
chapters.zh: 他们喊着说：「除掉他！除掉他！钉他在十字架上！」彼拉多说：「我可以把你们的王钉十字架吗？」祭司长回答说：「除了凯撒，我们没有王。」

chapters.en: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be crucified, and the soldiers took Him away.
chapters.zh: 于是彼拉多将耶稣交给他们去钉十字架。

chapters.en: Carrying His own cross, He went out to The Place of the Skull, which in Hebrew is called Golgotha.
chapters.zh: 他们就把耶稣带了去。耶稣背着自己的十字架出来，到了一个地方，名叫「髑髅地」，希伯来话叫各各他。

chapters.en: There they crucified Him, and with Him two others, one on each side, with Jesus in the middle.
chapters.zh: 他们就在那里钉他在十字架上，还有两个人和他一同钉着，一边一个，耶稣在中间。

chapters.en:
Pilate also had a notice posted on the cross. It read:
JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
chapters.zh: 彼拉多又〔用牌子〕写了一个名号，安在十字架上，写的是：「犹太人的王，拿撒勒人耶稣。」

chapters.en: Many of the Jews read this sign, because the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and it was written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek.
chapters.zh: 有许多犹太人念这名号；因为耶稣被钉十字架的地方与城相近，并且是用希伯来、罗马、希腊三样文字写的。

chapters.en: So the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, “Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but only that He said, ‘I am the King of the Jews.’”
chapters.zh: 犹太人的祭司长就对彼拉多说：「不要写『犹太人的王』，要写『他自己说：我是犹太人的王』。」

chapters.en: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
chapters.zh: 彼拉多说：「我所写的，我已经写上了。」

chapters.en: When the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they divided His garments into four parts, one for each soldier, with the tunic remaining. It was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.
chapters.zh: 兵丁既然将耶稣钉在十字架上，就拿他的衣服分为四分，每兵一分；又拿他的里衣，这件里衣原来没有缝儿，是上下一片织成的。

chapters.en:
So they said to one another, “Let us not tear it. Instead, let us cast lots to see who will get it.” This was to fulfill the Scripture:
“They divided My garments among them, and cast lots for My clothing.”
So that is what the soldiers did.
chapters.zh: 他们就彼此说：「我们不要撕开，只要拈鬮，看谁得着。」这要应验经上的话说： 他们分了我的外衣， 为我的里衣拈鬮。 兵丁果然做了这事。

chapters.en: Near the cross of Jesus stood His mother and her sister, as well as Mary the wife of Clopas and Mary Magdalene.
chapters.zh: 站在耶稣十字架旁边的，有他母亲与他母亲的姊妹，并革罗罢的妻子马利亚，和抹大拉的马利亚。

chapters.en: When Jesus saw His mother and the disciple whom He loved standing nearby, He said to His mother, “Woman, here is your son.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣见母亲和他所爱的那门徒站在旁边，就对他母亲说：「母亲〔注：原文是妇人〕，看，你的儿子！」

chapters.en: Then He said to the disciple, “Here is your mother.” So from that hour, this disciple took her into his home.
chapters.zh: 又对那门徒说：「看，你的母亲！」从此，那门徒就接她到自己家里去了。

chapters.en: After this, knowing that everything had now been accomplished, and to fulfill the Scripture, Jesus said, “I am thirsty.”
chapters.zh: 这事以后，耶稣知道各样的事已经成了，为要使经上的话应验，就说：「我渴了。」

chapters.en: A jar of sour wine was sitting there. So they soaked a sponge in the wine, put it on a stalk of hyssop, and lifted it to His mouth.
chapters.zh: 有一个器皿盛满了醋，放在那里；他们就拿海绒蘸满了醋，绑在牛膝草上，送到他口。

chapters.en: When Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, “It is finished.” And bowing His head, He yielded up His spirit.
chapters.zh: 耶稣尝〔注：原文是受〕了那醋，就说：「成了！」便低下头，将灵魂交付〔上帝〕了。

chapters.en: It was the day of Preparation, and the next day was a High Sabbath. In order that the bodies would not remain on the cross during the Sabbath, the Jews asked Pilate to have the legs broken and the bodies removed.
chapters.zh: 犹太人因这日是预备日，又因那安息日是个大日，就求彼拉多叫人打断他们的腿，把他们拿去，免得尸首当安息日留在十字架上。

chapters.en: So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first man who had been crucified with Jesus, and those of the other.
chapters.zh: 于是兵丁来，把头一个人的腿，并与耶稣同钉第二个人的腿，都打断了。

chapters.en: But when they came to Jesus and saw that He was already dead, they did not break His legs.
chapters.zh: 只是来到耶稣那里，见他已经死了，就不打断他的腿。

chapters.en: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear, and immediately blood and water flowed out.
chapters.zh: 惟有一个兵拿枪扎他的肋旁，随即有血和水流出来。

chapters.en: The one who saw it has testified to this, and his testimony is true. He knows that he is telling the truth, so that you also may believe.
chapters.zh: 看见〔这事〕的那人就作见证－他的见证也是真的，并且他知道自己所说的是真的－叫你们也可以信。

chapters.en: Now these things happened so that the Scripture would be fulfilled: “Not one of His bones will be broken.”
chapters.zh: 这些事成了，为要应验经上的话说：「他的骨头一根也不可折断。」

chapters.en: And, as another Scripture says: “They will look on the One they have pierced.”
chapters.zh: 经上又有一句说：「他们要仰望自己所扎的人。」

chapters.en: Afterward, Joseph of Arimathea, who was a disciple of Jesus (but secretly for fear of the Jews), asked Pilate to let him remove the body of Jesus. Pilate gave him permission, so he came and removed His body.
chapters.zh: 这些事以后，有亚利马太人约瑟，是耶稣的门徒，只因怕犹太人，就暗暗地作门徒。他来求彼拉多，要把耶稣的身体领去。彼拉多允准，他就把耶稣的身体领去了。

chapters.en: Nicodemus, who had previously come to Jesus at night, also brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.
chapters.zh: 又有尼哥德慕，就是先前夜里去见耶稣的，带着没药和沉香约有一百斤前来。

chapters.en: So they took the body of Jesus and wrapped it in linen cloths with the spices, according to the Jewish burial custom.
chapters.zh: 他们就照犹太人殡葬的规矩，把耶稣的身体用细麻布加上香料裹好了。

chapters.en: Now there was a garden in the place where Jesus was crucified, and in the garden a new tomb in which no one had yet been laid.
chapters.zh: 在耶稣钉十字架的地方有一个园子，园子里有一座新坟墓，是从来没有葬过人的。

chapters.en: And because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and the tomb was nearby, they placed Jesus there.
chapters.zh: 只因是犹太人的预备日，又因那坟墓近，他们就把耶稣安放在那里。

chapters.en: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance.
chapters.zh: 七日的第一日清早，天还黑的时候，抹大拉的马利亚来到坟墓那里，看见石头从坟墓挪开了，

chapters.en: So she came running to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one whom Jesus loved. “They have taken the Lord out of the tomb,” she said, “and we do not know where they have put Him!”
chapters.zh: 就跑来见西门‧彼得和耶稣所爱的那个门徒，对他们说：「有人把主从坟墓里挪了去，我们不知道放在哪里。」

chapters.en: Then Peter and the other disciple set out for the tomb.
chapters.zh: 彼得和那门徒就出来，往坟墓那里去。

chapters.en: The two were running together, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.
chapters.zh: 两个人同跑，那门徒比彼得跑得更快，先到了坟墓，

chapters.en: He bent down and looked in at the linen cloths lying there, but he did not go in.
chapters.zh: 低头往里看，就见细麻布还放在那里，只是没有进去。

chapters.en: Simon Peter arrived just after him. He entered the tomb and saw the linen cloths lying there.
chapters.zh: 西门‧彼得随后也到了，进坟墓里去，就看见细麻布还放在那里，

chapters.en: The cloth that had been around Jesus’ head was rolled up, lying separate from the linen cloths.
chapters.zh: 又看见耶稣的裹头巾没有和细麻布放在一处，是另在一处卷着。

chapters.en: Then the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went in. And he saw and believed.
chapters.zh: 先到坟墓的那门徒也进去，看见就信了。

chapters.en: For they still did not understand from the Scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead.
chapters.zh: （因为他们还不明白圣经的〔意思〕，就是耶稣必要从死里复活。）

chapters.en: Then the disciples returned to their homes.
chapters.zh: 于是两个门徒回自己的住处去了。

chapters.en: But Mary stood outside the tomb weeping. And as she wept, she bent down to look into the tomb,
chapters.zh: 马利亚却站在坟墓外面哭。哭的时候，低头往坟墓里看，

chapters.en: and she saw two angels in white sitting where the body of Jesus had lain, one at the head and the other at the feet.
chapters.zh: 就见两个天使，穿着白衣，在安放耶稣身体的地方坐着，一个在头，一个在脚。

chapters.en:
“Woman, why are you weeping?” they asked.
“Because they have taken my Lord away,” she said, “and I do not know where they have put Him.”
chapters.zh: 天使对她说：「妇人，你为什么哭？」她说：「因为有人把我主挪了去，我不知道放在哪里。」

chapters.en: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there. But she did not recognize that it was Jesus.
chapters.zh: 说了这话，就转过身来，看见耶稣站在那里，却不知道是耶稣。

chapters.en:
“Woman, why are you weeping?” Jesus asked. “Whom are you seeking?”
Thinking He was the gardener, she said, “Sir, if you have carried Him off, tell me where you have put Him, and I will get Him.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣问她说：「妇人，为什么哭？你找谁呢？」马利亚以为是看园的，就对他说：「先生，若是你把他移了去，请告诉我，你把他放在哪里，我便去取他。」

chapters.en:
Jesus said to her, “Mary.”
She turned and said to Him in Hebrew, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「马利亚。」马利亚就转过来，用希伯来话对他说：「拉波尼！」（拉波尼就是夫子的意思。）

chapters.en: “Do not cling to Me,” Jesus said, “for I have not yet ascended to the Father. But go and tell My brothers, ‘I am ascending to My Father and your Father, to My God and your God.’”
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「不要摸我，因我还没有升上去见我的父。你往我弟兄那里去，告诉他们说，我要升上去见我的父，也是你们的父，见我的上帝，也是你们的上帝。」

chapters.en: Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples, “I have seen the Lord!” And she told them what He had said to her.
chapters.zh: 抹大拉的马利亚就去告诉门徒说：「我已经看见了主。」她又将主对她说的这话告诉他们。

chapters.en: It was the first day of the week, and that very evening, while the disciples were together with the doors locked for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood among them. “Peace be with you!” He said to them.
chapters.zh: 那日（就是七日的第一日）晚上，门徒所在的地方，因怕犹太人，门都关了。耶稣来，站在当中，对他们说：「愿你们平安！」

chapters.en:
After He had said this, He showed them His hands and His side.
The disciples rejoiced when they saw the Lord.
chapters.zh: 说了这话，就把手和肋旁指给他们看。门徒看见主，就喜乐了。

chapters.en: Again Jesus said to them, “Peace be with you. As the Father has sent Me, so also I am sending you.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣又对他们说：「愿你们平安！父怎样差遣了我，我也照样差遣你们。」

chapters.en: When He had said this, He breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
chapters.zh: 说了这话，就向他们吹一口气，说：「你们受圣灵！

chapters.en: If you forgive anyone his sins, they are forgiven; if you withhold forgiveness from anyone, it is withheld.”
chapters.zh: 你们赦免谁的罪，谁的罪就赦免了；你们留下谁的罪，谁的罪就留下了。」

chapters.en: Now Thomas called Didymus, one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.
chapters.zh: 那十二个门徒中，有称为低土马的多马；耶稣来的时候，他没有和他们同在。

chapters.en:
So the other disciples told him, “We have seen the Lord!”
But he replied, “Unless I see the nail marks in His hands, and put my finger where the nails have been, and put my hand into His side, I will never believe.”
chapters.zh: 那些门徒就对他说：「我们已经看见主了。」多马却说：「我非看见他手上的钉痕，用指头探入那钉痕，又用手探入他的肋旁，我总不信。」

chapters.en: Eight days later, His disciples were once again inside with the doors locked, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you.”
chapters.zh: 过了八日，门徒又在屋里，多马也和他们同在，门都关了。耶稣来，站在当中说：「愿你们平安！」

chapters.en: Then Jesus said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at My hands. Reach out your hand and put it into My side. Stop doubting and believe.”
chapters.zh: 就对多马说：「伸过你的指头来，摸〔注：原文是看〕我的手；伸出你的手来，探入我的肋旁。不要疑惑，总要信！」

chapters.en: Thomas replied, “My Lord and my God!”
chapters.zh: 多马说：「我的主！我的上帝！」

chapters.en: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen Me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「你因看见了我才信；那没有看见就信的有福了。」

chapters.en: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of His disciples, which are not written in this book.
chapters.zh: 耶稣在门徒面前另外行了许多神迹，没有记在这书上。

chapters.en: But these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in His name.
chapters.zh: 但记这些事要叫你们信耶稣是基督，是上帝的儿子，并且叫你们信了他，就可以因他的名得生命。

chapters.en: Later, by the Sea of Tiberias, Jesus again revealed Himself to the disciples. He made Himself known in this way:
chapters.zh: 这些事以后，耶稣在提比哩亚海边又向门徒显现。他怎样显现记在下面：

chapters.en: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples were together.
chapters.zh: 有西门‧彼得和称为低土马的多马，并加利利的迦拿人拿但业，还有西庇太的两个儿子，又有两个门徒，都在一处。

chapters.en:
Simon Peter told them, “I am going fishing.”
“We will go with you,” they said. So they went out and got into the boat, but caught nothing that night.
chapters.zh: 西门‧彼得对他们说：「我打鱼去。」他们说：「我们也和你同去。」他们就出去，上了船；那一夜并没有打着什么。

chapters.en: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not recognize that it was Jesus.
chapters.zh: 天将亮的时候，耶稣站在岸上，门徒却不知道是耶稣。

chapters.en:
So He called out to them, “Children, do you have any fish?”
“No,” they answered.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就对他们说：「小子！你们有吃的没有？」他们回答说：「没有。」

chapters.en: He told them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” So they cast it there, and they were unable to haul it in because of the great number of fish.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们把网撒在船的右边，就必得着。」他们便撒下网去，竟拉不上来了，因为鱼甚多。

chapters.en: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It is the Lord!” As soon as Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his outer garment (for he had removed it) and jumped into the sea.
chapters.zh: 耶稣所爱的那门徒对彼得说：「是主！」那时西门‧彼得赤着身子，一听见是主，就束上一件外衣，跳在海里。

chapters.en: The other disciples came ashore in the boat. They dragged in the net full of fish, for they were not far from land, only about a hundred yards.
chapters.zh: 其余的门徒离岸不远，约有二百肘〔注：古时以肘为尺，一肘约有今时尺半〕，就在小船上把那网鱼拉过来。

chapters.en: When they landed, they saw a charcoal fire there with fish on it, and some bread.
chapters.zh: 他们上了岸，就看见那里有炭火，上面有鱼，又有饼。

chapters.en: Jesus told them, “Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「把刚才打的鱼拿几条来。」

chapters.en: So Simon Peter went aboard and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many, the net was not torn.
chapters.zh: 西门‧彼得就去〔注：或译：上船〕，把网拉到岸上。那网满了大鱼，共一百五十三条；鱼虽这样多，网却没有破。

chapters.en: “Come, have breakfast,” Jesus said to them. None of the disciples dared to ask Him, “Who are You?” They knew it was the Lord.
chapters.zh: 耶稣说：「你们来吃早饭。」门徒中没有一个敢问他：「你是谁？」因为知道是主。

chapters.en: Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and He did the same with the fish.
chapters.zh: 耶稣就来拿饼和鱼给他们。

chapters.en: This was now the third time that Jesus appeared to the disciples after He was raised from the dead.
chapters.zh: 耶稣从死里复活以后，向门徒显现，这是第三次。

chapters.en:
When they had finished eating, Jesus asked Simon Peter, “Simon son of John, do you love Me more than these?”
“Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.”
Jesus replied, “Feed My lambs.”
chapters.zh: 他们吃完了早饭，耶稣对西门‧彼得说：「约翰〔注：在马太十六章十七节称约拿〕的儿子西门，你爱我比这些更深吗？」彼得说：「主啊，是的，你知道我爱你。」耶稣对他说：「你餵养我的小羊。」

chapters.en:
Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?”
“Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.”
Jesus told him, “Shepherd My sheep.”
chapters.zh: 耶稣第二次又对他说：「约翰的儿子西门，你爱我吗？」彼得说：「主啊，是的，你知道我爱你。」耶稣说：「你牧养我的羊。」

chapters.en:
Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?”
Peter was deeply hurt that Jesus had asked him a third time, “Do you love Me?”
“Lord, You know all things,” he replied. “You know I love You.”
Jesus said to him, “Feed My sheep.
chapters.zh: 第三次对他说：「约翰的儿子西门，你爱我吗？」彼得因为耶稣第三次对他说「你爱我吗」，就忧愁，对耶稣说：「主啊，你是无所不知的；你知道我爱你。」耶稣说：「你餵养我的羊。

chapters.en: Truly, truly, I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted; but when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go.”
chapters.zh: 我实实在在地告诉你，你年少的时候，自己束上〔带子〕，随意往来；但年老的时候，你要伸出手来，别人要把你束上，带你到不愿意去的地方。」

chapters.en:
Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God.
And after He had said this, He told him, “Follow Me.”
chapters.zh: （耶稣说这话是指着彼得要怎样死，荣耀上帝。）说了这话，就对他说：「你跟从我吧！」

chapters.en: Peter turned and saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following them. He was the one who had leaned back against Jesus at the supper to ask, “Lord, who is going to betray You?”
chapters.zh: 彼得转过来，看见耶稣所爱的那门徒跟着，（就是在晚饭的时候，靠着耶稣胸膛说：「主啊，卖你的是谁？」的那门徒。）

chapters.en: When Peter saw him, he asked, “Lord, what about him?”
chapters.zh: 彼得看见他，就问耶稣说：「主啊，这人将来如何？」

chapters.en: Jesus answered, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you? You follow Me!”
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他说：「我若要他等到我来的时候，与你何干？你跟从我吧！」

chapters.en: Because of this, the rumor spread among the brothers that this disciple would not die. However, Jesus did not say that he would not die, but only, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you?”
chapters.zh: 于是这话传在弟兄中间，说那门徒不死。其实，耶稣不是说他不死，乃是说：「我若要他等到我来的时候，与你何干？」

chapters.en: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who has written them down. And we know that his testimony is true.
chapters.zh: 为这些事作见证，并且记载这些事的就是这门徒；我们也知道他的见证是真的。

chapters.en: There are many more things that Jesus did. If all of them were written down, I suppose that not even the world itself would have space for the books that would be written.
chapters.zh: 耶稣所行的事还有许多，若是一一地都写出来，我想，所写的书就是世界也容不下了。

chapters.en: In my first book, O Theophilus, I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach,
chapters.zh: 提阿非罗啊，我已经作了前书，论到耶稣开头一切所行所教训的，

chapters.en: until the day He was taken up to heaven, after giving instructions through the Holy Spirit to the apostles He had chosen.
chapters.zh: 直到他藉着圣灵吩咐所拣选的使徒，以后被接上升的日子为止。

chapters.en: After His suffering, He presented Himself to them with many convincing proofs that He was alive. He appeared to them over a span of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.
chapters.zh: 他受害之后，用许多的凭据将自己活活地显给使徒看，四十天之久向他们显现，讲说上帝国的事。

chapters.en: And while they were gathered together, He commanded them: “Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift the Father promised, which you have heard Me discuss.
chapters.zh: 耶稣和他们聚集的时候，嘱咐他们说：「不要离开耶路撒冷，要等候父所应许的，就是你们听见我说过的。

chapters.en: For John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit. ”
chapters.zh: 约翰是用水施洗，但不多几日，你们要受圣灵的洗。」

chapters.en: So when they came together, they asked Him, “Lord, will You at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?”
chapters.zh: 他们聚集的时候，问耶稣说：「主啊，你复兴以色列国就在这时候吗？」

chapters.en: Jesus replied, “It is not for you to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed by His own authority.
chapters.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「父凭着自己的权柄所定的时候、日期，不是你们可以知道的。

chapters.en: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you will be My witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.”
chapters.zh: 但圣灵降临在你们身上，你们就必得着能力，并要在耶路撒冷、犹太全地，和撒马利亚，直到地极，作我的见证。」

chapters.en: After He had said this, they watched as He was taken up, and a cloud hid Him from their sight.
chapters.zh: 说了这话，他们正看的时候，他就被取上升，有一朵云彩把他接去，便看不见他了。

chapters.en: They were looking intently into the sky as He was going, when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them.
chapters.zh: 当他往上去，他们定睛望天的时候，忽然有两个人身穿白衣，站在旁边，说：

chapters.en: “Men of Galilee,” they said, “why do you stand here looking into the sky? This same Jesus, who has been taken from you into heaven, will come back in the same way you have seen Him go into heaven.”
chapters.zh: 「加利利人哪，你们为什么站着望天呢？这离开你们被接升天的耶稣，你们见他怎样往天上去，他还要怎样来。」

chapters.en: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, which is near the city, a Sabbath day’s journey away.
chapters.zh: 有一座山，名叫橄榄山，离耶路撒冷不远，约有安息日可走的路程。当下，门徒从那里回耶路撒冷去，

chapters.en: When they arrived, they went to the upper room where they were staying: Peter and John, James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James.
chapters.zh: 进了城，就上了所住的一间楼房；在那里有彼得、约翰、雅各、安得烈、腓力、多马、巴多罗买、马太、亚勒腓的儿子雅各、奋锐党的西门，和雅各的儿子〔注：或译：兄弟〕犹大。

chapters.en: With one accord they all continued in prayer, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with His brothers.
chapters.zh: 这些人同着几个妇人和耶稣的母亲马利亚，并耶稣的弟兄，都同心合意地恒切祷告。

chapters.en: In those days Peter stood up among the brothers (a gathering of about a hundred and twenty) and said,
chapters.zh: 那时，有许多人〔聚会〕，约有一百二十名，彼得就在弟兄中间站起来，

chapters.en: “Brothers, the Scripture had to be fulfilled that the Holy Spirit foretold through the mouth of David concerning Judas, who became a guide for those who arrested Jesus.
chapters.zh: 说：「弟兄们！圣灵藉大卫的口，在圣经上预言领人捉拿耶稣的犹大，这话是必须应验的。

chapters.en: He was one of our number and shared in this ministry.”
chapters.zh: 他本来列在我们数中，并且在〔使徒的〕职任上得了一分。

chapters.en: (Now with the reward for his wickedness Judas bought a field; there he fell headlong and burst open in the middle, and all his intestines spilled out.
chapters.zh: 这人用他作恶的工价买了一块田，以后身子仆倒，肚腹崩裂，肠子都流出来。

chapters.en: This became known to all who lived in Jerusalem, so they called that field in their own language Akeldama, that is, Field of Blood.)
chapters.zh: 住在耶路撒冷的众人都知道这事，所以按着他们那里的话给那块田起名叫亚革大马，就是「血田」的意思。

chapters.en:
“For it is written in the book of Psalms:
‘May his place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in it,’
and,
‘May another take his position.’
chapters.zh: 因为诗篇上写着，说： 愿他的住处变为荒场， 无人在内居住； 又说： 愿别人得他的职分。

chapters.en: Therefore it is necessary to choose one of the men who have accompanied us the whole time the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
chapters.zh: 所以，主耶稣在我们中间始终出入的时候，

chapters.en: beginning from John’s baptism until the day Jesus was taken up from us. For one of these must become a witness with us of His resurrection.”
chapters.zh: 就是从约翰施洗起，直到主离开我们被接上升的日子为止，必须从那常与我们作伴的人中立一位与我们同作耶稣复活的见证。」

chapters.en: So they proposed two men: Joseph called Barsabbas (also known as Justus) and Matthias.
chapters.zh: 于是选举两个人，就是那叫做巴撒巴，又称呼犹士都的约瑟，和马提亚。

chapters.en: And they prayed, “Lord, You know everyone’s heart. Show us which of these two You have chosen
to take up this ministry and apostleship, which Judas abandoned to go to his rightful place.”
chapters.zh: 众人就祷告说：「主啊，你知道万人的心，求你从这两个人中，指明你所拣选的是谁，叫他得这使徒的位分。这位分犹大已经丢弃，往自己的地方去了。」

chapters.en: Then they cast lots, and the lot fell to Matthias. So he was added to the eleven apostles.
chapters.zh: 于是众人为他们摇籤，摇出马提亚来；他就和十一个使徒同列。

chapters.en: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.
chapters.zh: 五旬节到了，门徒都聚集在一处。

chapters.en: Suddenly a sound like a mighty rushing wind came from heaven and filled the whole house where they were sitting.
chapters.zh: 忽然，从天上有响声下来，好像一阵大风吹过，充满了他们所坐的屋子，

chapters.en: They saw tongues like flames of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them.
chapters.zh: 又有舌头如火焰显现出来，分开落在他们各人头上。

chapters.en: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them.
chapters.zh: 他们就都被圣灵充满，按着〔圣〕灵所赐的口才说起别国的话来。

chapters.en: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews from every nation under heaven.
chapters.zh: 那时，有虔诚的犹太人从天下各国来，住在耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: And when this sound rang out, a crowd came together in bewilderment, because each one heard them speaking his own language.
chapters.zh: 这声音一响，众人都来聚集，各人听见门徒用众人的乡谈说话，就甚纳闷；

chapters.en: Astounded and amazed, they asked, “Are not all these who are speaking Galileans?
chapters.zh: 都惊讶希奇说：「看哪，这说话的不都是加利利人吗？

chapters.en: How is it then that each of us hears them in his own native language?
chapters.zh: 我们各人怎么听见他们说我们生来所用的乡谈呢？

chapters.en: Parthians, Medes, and Elamites; residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,
chapters.zh: 我们帕提亚人、米底亚人、以拦人，和住在美索不达米亚、犹太、加帕多家、本都、亚细亚、

chapters.en: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene; visitors from Rome,
chapters.zh: 弗吕家、旁非利亚、埃及的人，并靠近古利奈的利比亚一带地方的人，从罗马来的客旅中，或是犹太人，或是进〔犹太〕教的人，

chapters.en: both Jews and converts to Judaism; Cretans and Arabs—we hear them declaring the wonders of God in our own tongues!”
chapters.zh: 克里特和阿拉伯人，都听见他们用我们的乡谈，讲说上帝的大作为。」

chapters.en: Astounded and perplexed, they asked one another, “What does this mean?”
chapters.zh: 众人就都惊讶猜疑，彼此说：「这是什么意思呢？」

chapters.en: But others mocked them and said, “They are drunk on new wine!”
chapters.zh: 还有人讥诮说：「他们无非是新酒灌满了。」

chapters.en: Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, lifted up his voice, and addressed the crowd: “Men of Judea and all who dwell in Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen carefully to my words.
chapters.zh: 彼得和十一个使徒站起，高声说：「犹太人和一切住在耶路撒冷的人哪，这件事你们当知道，也当侧耳听我的话。

chapters.en: These men are not drunk, as you suppose. It is only the third hour of the day!
chapters.zh: 你们想这些人是醉了；其实不是醉了，因为时候刚到巳初。

chapters.en: No, this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:
chapters.zh: 这正是先知约珥所说的：

chapters.en:
‘In the last days, God says, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions,
your old men will dream dreams.
chapters.zh: 上帝说：在末后的日子， 我要将我的灵浇灌凡有血气的。 你们的儿女要说预言； 你们的少年人要见异象； 老年人要做异梦。

chapters.en:
Even on My menservants and maidservants I will pour out My Spirit in those days,
and they will prophesy.
chapters.zh: 在那些日子， 我要将我的灵浇灌我的仆人和使女， 他们就要说预言。

chapters.en:
I will show wonders in the heavens above and signs on the earth below,
blood and fire and billows of smoke.
chapters.zh: 在天上，我要显出奇事； 在地下，我要显出神迹； 有血，有火，有烟雾。

chapters.en:
The sun will be turned to darkness, and the moon to blood,
before the coming of the great and glorious Day of the Lord.
chapters.zh: 日头要变为黑暗， 月亮要变为血； 这都在主大而明显的日子未到以前。

chapters.en: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
chapters.zh: 到那时候， 凡求告主名的，就必得救。

chapters.en: Men of Israel, listen to this message: Jesus of Nazareth was a man certified by God to you by miracles, wonders, and signs, which God did among you through Him, as you yourselves know.
chapters.zh: 「以色列人哪，请听我的话：上帝藉着拿撒勒人耶稣在你们中间施行异能、奇事、神迹，将他证明出来，这是你们自己知道的。

chapters.en: He was delivered up by God’s set plan and foreknowledge, and you, by the hands of the lawless, put Him to death by nailing Him to the cross.
chapters.zh: 他既按着上帝的定旨先见被交与人，你们就藉着无法之人的手，把他钉在十字架上，杀了。

chapters.en: But God raised Him from the dead, releasing Him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for death to keep Him in its grip.
chapters.zh: 上帝却将死的痛苦解释了，叫他复活，因为他原不能被死拘禁。

chapters.en:
David says about Him:
‘I saw the Lord always before me; because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
chapters.zh: 大卫指着他说： 我看见主常在我眼前； 他在我右边，叫我不至于摇动。

chapters.en: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell in hope,
chapters.zh: 所以，我心里欢喜， 我的灵〔注：原文是舌〕快乐； 并且我的肉身要安居在指望中。

chapters.en: because You will not abandon my soul to Hades, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
chapters.zh: 因你必不将我的灵魂撇在阴间， 也不叫你的圣者见朽坏。

chapters.en: You have made known to me the paths of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence.’
chapters.zh: 你已将生命的道路指示我， 必叫我因见你的面〔注：或译：叫我在你面前〕 得着满足的快乐。

chapters.en: Brothers, I can tell you with confidence that the patriarch David died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
chapters.zh: 「弟兄们！先祖大卫的事，我可以明明地对你们说：他死了，也葬埋了，并且他的坟墓直到今日还在我们这里。

chapters.en: But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that He would place one of his descendants on his throne.
chapters.zh: 大卫既是先知，又晓得上帝曾向他起誓，要从他的后裔中立一位坐在他的宝座上，

chapters.en: Foreseeing this, David spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that He was not abandoned to Hades, nor did His body see decay.
chapters.zh: 就预先看明这事，讲论基督复活说： 他的灵魂不撇在阴间； 他的肉身也不见朽坏。

chapters.en: God has raised this Jesus to life, to which we are all witnesses.
chapters.zh: 这耶稣，上帝已经叫他复活了，我们都为这事作见证。

chapters.en: Exalted, then, to the right hand of God, He has received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear.
chapters.zh: 他既被上帝的右手高举〔注：或译：他既高举在上帝的右边〕，又从父受了所应许的圣灵，就把你们所看见所听见的，浇灌下来。

chapters.en:
For David did not ascend into heaven, but he himself says:
‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand
chapters.zh: 大卫并没有升到天上，但自己说： 主对我主说： 你坐在我的右边，

chapters.en: until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”’
chapters.zh: 等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。

chapters.en: Therefore let all Israel know with certainty that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ!”
chapters.zh: 「故此，以色列全家当确实地知道，你们钉在十字架上的这位耶稣，上帝已经立他为主，为基督了。」

chapters.en: When the people heard this, they were cut to the heart and asked Peter and the other apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”
chapters.zh: 众人听见这话，觉得扎心，就对彼得和其余的使徒说：「弟兄们，我们当怎样行？」

chapters.en: Peter replied, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
chapters.zh: 彼得说：「你们各人要悔改，奉耶稣基督的名受洗，叫你们的罪得赦，就必领受所赐的圣灵；

chapters.en: This promise belongs to you and your children and to all who are far off—to all whom the Lord our God will call to Himself.”
chapters.zh: 因为这应许是给你们和你们的儿女，并一切在远方的人，就是主－我们上帝所召来的。」

chapters.en: With many other words he testified, and he urged them, “Be saved from this corrupt generation.”
chapters.zh: 彼得还用许多话作见证，劝勉他们说：「你们当救自己脱离这弯曲的世代。」

chapters.en: Those who embraced his message were baptized, and about three thousand were added to the believers that day.
chapters.zh: 于是领受他话的人就受了洗。那一天，〔门徒〕约添了三千人，

chapters.en: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.
chapters.zh: 都恒心遵守使徒的教训，彼此交接，擘饼，祈祷。

chapters.en: A sense of awe came over everyone, and the apostles performed many wonders and signs.
chapters.zh: 众人都惧怕；使徒又行了许多奇事神迹。

chapters.en: All the believers were together and had everything in common.
chapters.zh: 信的人都在一处，凡物公用，

chapters.en: Selling their possessions and goods, they shared with anyone who was in need.
chapters.zh: 并且卖了田产、家业，照各人所需用的分给各人。

chapters.en: With one accord they continued to meet daily in the temple courts and to break bread from house to house, sharing their meals with gladness and sincerity of heart,
chapters.zh: 他们天天同心合意恒切地在殿里，且在家中擘饼，存着欢喜、诚实的心用饭，

chapters.en: praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people. And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.
chapters.zh: 赞美上帝，得众民的喜爱。主将得救的人天天加给他们。

chapters.en: One afternoon Peter and John were going up to the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.
chapters.zh: 申初祷告的时候，彼得、约翰上〔圣〕殿去。

chapters.en: And a man who was lame from birth was being carried to the temple gate called Beautiful, where he was put every day to beg from those entering the temple courts.
chapters.zh: 有一个人，生来是瘸腿的，天天被人抬来，放在殿的一个门口（那门名叫美〔门〕），要求进殿的人赒济。

chapters.en: When he saw Peter and John about to enter, he asked them for money.
chapters.zh: 他看见彼得、约翰将要进殿，就求他们赒济。

chapters.en: Peter looked directly at him, as did John. “Look at us!” said Peter.
chapters.zh: 彼得、约翰定睛看他；彼得说：「你看我们！」

chapters.en: So the man gave them his attention, expecting to receive something from them.
chapters.zh: 那人就留意看他们，指望得着什么。

chapters.en: But Peter said, “Silver or gold I do not have, but what I have I give you: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk! ”
chapters.zh: 彼得说：「金银我都没有，只把我所有的给你：我奉拿撒勒人耶稣基督的名，叫你起来行走！」

chapters.en: Taking him by the right hand, Peter helped him up, and at once the man’s feet and ankles were made strong.
chapters.zh: 于是拉着他的右手，扶他起来；他的脚和踝子骨立刻健壮了，

chapters.en: He sprang to his feet and began to walk. Then he went with them into the temple courts, walking and leaping and praising God.
chapters.zh: 就跳起来，站着，又行走，同他们进了殿，走着，跳着，赞美上帝。

chapters.en: When all the people saw him walking and praising God,
chapters.zh: 百姓都看见他行走，赞美上帝；

chapters.en: they recognized him as the man who used to sit begging at the Beautiful Gate of the temple, and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
chapters.zh: 认得他是那素常坐在殿的美门口求赒济的，就因他所遇着的事满心希奇、惊讶。

chapters.en: While the man clung to Peter and John, all the people were astonished and ran to them in the walkway called Solomon’s Colonnade.
chapters.zh: 那人正在称为所罗门的廊下，拉着彼得、约翰；众百姓一齐跑到他们那里，很觉希奇。

chapters.en: And when Peter saw this, he addressed the people: “Men of Israel, why are you surprised by this? Why do you stare at us as if by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?
chapters.zh: 彼得看见，就对百姓说：「以色列人哪，为什么把这事当作希奇呢？为什么定睛看我们，以为我们凭自己的能力和虔诚使这人行走呢？

chapters.en: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified His servant Jesus. You handed Him over and rejected Him before Pilate, even though he had decided to release Him.
chapters.zh: 亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的上帝，就是我们列祖的上帝，已经荣耀了他的仆人〔注：或译：儿子〕耶稣；你们却把他交付彼拉多。彼拉多定意要释放他，你们竟在彼拉多面前弃绝了他。

chapters.en: You rejected the Holy and Righteous One and asked that a murderer be released to you.
chapters.zh: 你们弃绝了那圣洁公义者，反求着释放一个凶手给你们。

chapters.en: You killed the Author of life, but God raised Him from the dead, and we are witnesses of this fact.
chapters.zh: 你们杀了那生命的主，上帝却叫他从死里复活了；我们都是为这事作见证。
