chapters.en: By faith in the name of Jesus, this man whom you see and know has been made strong. It is Jesus’ name and the faith that comes through Him that has given him this complete healing in your presence.
chapters.zh: 我们因信他的名，他的名便叫你们所看见所认识的这人健壮了；正是他所赐的信心，叫这人在你们众人面前全然好了。

chapters.en: And now, brothers, I know that you acted in ignorance, as did your leaders.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，我晓得你们做这事是出于不知，你们的官长也是如此。

chapters.en: But in this way God has fulfilled what He foretold through all the prophets, saying that His Christ would suffer.
chapters.zh: 但上帝曾藉众先知的口，预言基督将要受害，就这样应验了。

chapters.en: Repent, then, and turn back, so that your sins may be wiped away,
chapters.zh: 所以，你们当悔改归正，使你们的罪得以涂抹，

chapters.en: that times of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord, and that He may send Jesus, the Christ, who has been appointed for you.
chapters.zh: 这样，那安舒的日子就必从主面前来到；主也必差遣所预定给你们的基督（耶稣）降临。

chapters.en: Heaven must take Him in until the time comes for the restoration of all things, which God announced long ago through His holy prophets.
chapters.zh: 天必留他，等到万物复兴的时候，就是上帝从创世以来、藉着圣先知的口所说的。

chapters.en: For Moses said, ‘The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers. You must listen to Him in everything He tells you.
chapters.zh: 摩西曾说：『主－上帝要从你们弟兄中间给你们兴起一位先知像我，凡他向你们所说的，你们都要听从。

chapters.en: Everyone who does not listen to Him will be completely cut off from among his people. ’
chapters.zh: 凡不听从那先知的，必要从民中全然灭绝。』

chapters.en: Indeed, all the prophets from Samuel on, as many as have spoken, have proclaimed these days.
chapters.zh: 从撒母耳以来的众先知，凡说预言的，也都说到这些日子。

chapters.en: And you are sons of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your fathers when He said to Abraham, ‘Through your offspring all the families of the earth will be blessed.’
chapters.zh: 你们是先知的子孙，也承受上帝与你们祖宗所立的约，就是对亚伯拉罕说：『地上万族都要因你的后裔得福。』

chapters.en: When God raised up His Servant, He sent Him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways.”
chapters.zh: 上帝既兴起他的仆人〔注：或译：儿子〕，就先差他到你们这里来，赐福给你们，叫你们各人回转，离开罪恶。」

chapters.en: While Peter and John were speaking to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple guard and the Sadducees came up to them,
chapters.zh: 使徒对百姓说话的时候，祭司们和守殿官，并撒都该人忽然来了。

chapters.en: greatly disturbed that they were teaching the people and proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection of the dead.
chapters.zh: 因他们教训百姓，本着耶稣，传说死人复活，就很烦恼，

chapters.en: They seized Peter and John, and because it was evening, they put them in custody until the next day.
chapters.zh: 于是下手拿住他们；因为天已经晚了，就把他们押到第二天。

chapters.en: But many who heard the message believed, and the number of men grew to about five thousand.
chapters.zh: 但听道之人有许多信的，男丁数目约到五千。

chapters.en: The next day the rulers, elders, and scribes assembled in Jerusalem,
chapters.zh: 第二天，官府、长老，和文士在耶路撒冷聚会，

chapters.en: along with Annas the high priest, Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and many others from the high priest’s family.
chapters.zh: 又有大祭司亚那和该亚法、约翰、亚历山大，并大祭司的亲族都在那里，

chapters.en: They had Peter and John brought in and began to question them: “By what power or what name did you do this?”
chapters.zh: 叫使徒站在当中，就问他们说：「你们用什么能力，奉谁的名做这事呢？」

chapters.en: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “Rulers and elders of the people!
chapters.zh: 那时彼得被圣灵充满，对他们说：

chapters.en: If we are being examined today about a kind service to a man who was lame, to determine how he was healed,
chapters.zh: 「治民的官府和长老啊，倘若今日因为在残疾人身上所行的善事查问我们他是怎么得了痊愈，

chapters.en: then let this be known to all of you and to all the people of Israel: It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead, that this man stands before you healed.
chapters.zh: 你们众人和以色列百姓都当知道，站在你们面前的这人得痊愈是因你们所钉十字架、上帝叫他从死里复活的拿撒勒人耶稣基督的名。

chapters.en:
This Jesus is
‘the stone you builders rejected, which has become the cornerstone.’
chapters.zh: 他是 你们匠人所弃的石头， 已成了房角的头块石头。

chapters.en: Salvation exists in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to men by which we must be saved.”
chapters.zh: 除他以外，别无拯救；因为在天下人间，没有赐下别的名，我们可以靠着得救。」

chapters.en: When they saw the boldness of Peter and John and realized that they were unschooled, ordinary men, they marveled and took note that these men had been with Jesus.
chapters.zh: 他们见彼得、约翰的胆量，又看出他们原是没有学问的小民，就希奇，认明他们是跟过耶稣的；

chapters.en: And seeing the man who had been healed standing there with them, they had nothing to say in response.
chapters.zh: 又看见那治好了的人和他们一同站着，就无话可驳。

chapters.en: So they ordered them to leave the Sanhedrin and then conferred together.
chapters.zh: 于是吩咐他们从公会出去，就彼此商议说：

chapters.en: “What shall we do with these men?” they asked. “It is clear to everyone living in Jerusalem that a remarkable miracle has occurred through them, and we cannot deny it.
chapters.zh: 「我们当怎样办这两个人呢？因为他们诚然行了一件明显的神迹，凡住耶路撒冷的人都知道，我们也不能说没有。

chapters.en: But to keep this message from spreading any further among the people, we must warn them not to speak to anyone in this name.”
chapters.zh: 惟恐这事越发传扬在民间，我们必须恐吓他们，叫他们不再奉这名对人讲论。」

chapters.en: Then they called them in again and commanded them not to speak or teach at all in the name of Jesus.
chapters.zh: 于是叫了他们来，禁止他们总不可奉耶稣的名讲论教训人。

chapters.en: But Peter and John replied, “Judge for yourselves whether it is right in God’s sight to listen to you rather than God.
chapters.zh: 彼得、约翰说：「听从你们，不听从上帝，这在上帝面前合理不合理，你们自己酌量吧！

chapters.en: For we cannot stop speaking about what we have seen and heard.”
chapters.zh: 我们所看见所听见的，不能不说。」

chapters.en: After further threats they let them go. They could not find a way to punish them, because all the people were glorifying God for what had happened.
chapters.zh: 官长为百姓的缘故，想不出法子刑罚他们，又恐吓一番，把他们释放了。这是因众人为所行的奇事都归荣耀与上帝。

chapters.en: For the man who was miraculously healed was over forty years old.
chapters.zh: 原来藉着神迹医好的那人有四十多岁了。

chapters.en: On their release, Peter and John returned to their own people and reported everything that the chief priests and elders had said to them.
chapters.zh: 二人既被释放，就到会友那里去，把祭司长和长老所说的话都告诉他们。

chapters.en: When the believers heard this, they lifted up their voices to God with one accord. “Sovereign Lord,” they said, “You made the heaven and the earth and the sea and everything in them.
chapters.zh: 他们听见了，就同心合意地高声向上帝说：「主啊！你是造天、地、海，和其中万物的，

chapters.en:
You spoke by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of Your servant, our father David:
‘Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
chapters.zh: 你曾藉着圣灵，〔讬〕你仆人－我们祖宗大卫的口，说： 外邦为什么争闹？ 万民为什么谋算虚妄的事？

chapters.en: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together against the Lord and against His Anointed One.’
chapters.zh: 世上的君王一齐起来， 臣宰也聚集， 要敌挡主， 并主的受膏者〔注：或译：基督〕。

chapters.en: In fact, this is the very city where Herod and Pontius Pilate conspired with the Gentiles and the people of Israel against Your holy servant Jesus, whom You anointed.
chapters.zh: 希律和本丢‧彼拉多，外邦人和以色列民，果然在这城里聚集，要攻打你所膏的圣仆〔注：仆：或译子〕耶稣，

chapters.en: They carried out what Your hand and will had decided beforehand would happen.
chapters.zh: 成就你手和你意旨所预定必有的事。

chapters.en: And now, Lord, consider their threats, and enable Your servants to speak Your word with complete boldness,
as You stretch out Your hand to heal and perform signs and wonders through the name of Your holy servant Jesus.”
chapters.zh: 他们恐吓我们，现在求主鉴察，一面叫你仆人大放胆量讲你的道，一面伸出你的手来医治疾病，并且使神迹奇事因着你圣仆〔注：仆：或译子〕耶稣的名行出来。」

chapters.en: After they had prayed, their meeting place was shaken, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly.
chapters.zh: 祷告完了，聚会的地方震动，他们就都被圣灵充满，放胆讲论上帝的道。

chapters.en: The multitude of believers was one in heart and soul. No one claimed that any of his possessions was his own, but they shared everything they owned.
chapters.zh: 那许多信的人都是一心一意的，没有一人说他的东西有一样是自己的，都是大家公用。

chapters.en: With great power the apostles continued to give their testimony about the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. And abundant grace was upon them all.
chapters.zh: 使徒大有能力，见证主耶稣复活；众人也都蒙大恩。

chapters.en: There were no needy ones among them, because those who owned lands or houses would sell their property, bring the proceeds from the sales,
chapters.zh: 内中也没有一个缺乏的；因为人人将田产房屋都卖了，把所卖的价银拿来，

chapters.en: and lay them at the apostles’ feet for distribution to anyone as he had need.
chapters.zh: 放在使徒脚前，照各人所需用的，分给各人。

chapters.en: Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus, whom the apostles called Barnabas (meaning Son of Encouragement),
chapters.zh: 有一个利未人，生在塞浦路斯，名叫约瑟，使徒称他为巴拿巴（巴拿巴翻出来就是劝慰子）。

chapters.en: sold a field he owned, brought the money, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
chapters.zh: 他有田地，也卖了，把价银拿来，放在使徒脚前。

chapters.en: Now a man named Ananias, together with his wife Sapphira, also sold a piece of property.
chapters.zh: 有一个人，名叫亚拿尼亚，同他的妻子撒非喇卖了田产，

chapters.en: With his wife’s full knowledge, he kept back some of the proceeds for himself, but brought a portion and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
chapters.zh: 把价银私自留下几分，他的妻子也知道，其余的几分拿来放在使徒脚前。

chapters.en: Then Peter said, “Ananias, how is it that Satan has filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and withhold some of the proceeds from the land?
chapters.zh: 彼得说：「亚拿尼亚！为什么撒但充满了你的心，叫你欺哄圣灵，把田地的价银私自留下几分呢？

chapters.en: Did it not belong to you before it was sold? And after it was sold, was it not at your disposal? How could you conceive such a deed in your heart? You have not lied to men, but to God!”
chapters.zh: 田地还没有卖，不是你自己的吗？既卖了，价银不是你作主吗？你怎么心里起这意念呢？你不是欺哄人，是欺哄上帝了。」

chapters.en: On hearing these words, Ananias fell down and died. And great fear came over all who heard what had happened.
chapters.zh: 亚拿尼亚听见这话，就仆倒，断了气；听见的人都甚惧怕。

chapters.en: Then the young men stepped forward, wrapped up his body, and carried him out and buried him.
chapters.zh: 有些少年人起来，把他包裹，抬出去埋葬了。

chapters.en: About three hours later his wife also came in, unaware of what had happened.
chapters.zh: 约过了三小时，他的妻子进来，还不知道这事。

chapters.en:
“Tell me,” said Peter, “is this the price you and your husband got for the land?”
“Yes,” she answered, “that is the price.”
chapters.zh: 彼得对她说：「你告诉我，你们卖田地的价银就是这些吗？」她说：「就是这些。」

chapters.en: “How could you agree to test the Spirit of the Lord?” Peter replied. “Look, the feet of the men who buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out also.”
chapters.zh: 彼得说：「你们为什么同心试探主的灵呢？埋葬你丈夫之人的脚已到门口，他们也要把你抬出去。」

chapters.en: At that instant she fell down at his feet and died. Then the young men came in and, finding her dead, carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
chapters.zh: 妇人立刻仆倒在彼得脚前，断了气。那些少年人进来，见她已经死了，就抬出去，埋在她丈夫旁边。

chapters.en: And great fear came over the whole church and all who heard about these events.
chapters.zh: 全教会和听见这事的人都甚惧怕。

chapters.en: The apostles performed many signs and wonders among the people, and with one accord the believers gathered together in Solomon’s Colonnade.
chapters.zh: 主藉使徒的手在民间行了许多神迹奇事；他们〔注：或译：信的人〕都同心合意地在所罗门的廊下。

chapters.en: Although the people regarded them highly, no one else dared to join them.
chapters.zh: 其余的人没有一个敢贴近他们，百姓却尊重他们。

chapters.en: Yet more and more believers were brought to the Lord—large numbers of both men and women.
chapters.zh: 信而归主的人越发增添，连男带女很多。

chapters.en: As a result, people brought the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mats, so that at least Peter’s shadow might fall on some of them as he passed by.
chapters.zh: 甚至有人将病人抬到街上，放在床上或褥子上，指望彼得过来的时候，或者得他的影儿照在什么人身上。

chapters.en: Crowds also gathered from the towns around Jerusalem, bringing the sick and those tormented by unclean spirits, and all of them were healed.
chapters.zh: 还有许多人带着病人和被污鬼缠磨的，从耶路撒冷四围的城邑来，全都得了医治。

chapters.en: Then the high priest and all his associates, who belonged to the party of the Sadducees, were filled with jealousy. They went out
chapters.zh: 大祭司和他的一切同人，就是撒都该教门的人，都起来，满心忌恨，

chapters.en: and arrested the apostles and put them in the public jail.
chapters.zh: 就下手拿住使徒，收在外监。

chapters.en: But during the night an angel of the Lord opened the doors of the jail and brought them out, saying,
chapters.zh: 但主的使者夜间开了监门，领他们出来，

chapters.en: “Go, stand in the temple courts and tell the people the full message of this new life.”
chapters.zh: 说：「你们去站在殿里，把这生命的道都讲给百姓听。」

chapters.en:
At daybreak the apostles entered the temple courts as they had been told and began to teach the people.
When the high priest and his associates arrived, they convened the Sanhedrin —the full assembly of the elders of Israel—and sent to the jail for the apostles.
chapters.zh: 使徒听了这话，天将亮的时候就进殿里去教训人。大祭司和他的同人来了，叫齐公会的人和以色列族的众长老，就差人到监里去，要把使徒提出来。

chapters.en: But on arriving at the jail, the officers did not find them there. So they returned with the report:
chapters.zh: 但差役到了，不见他们在监里，就回来禀报说：

chapters.en: “We found the jail securely locked, with the guards posted at the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside.”
chapters.zh: 「我们看见监牢关得极妥当，看守的人也站在门外；及至开了门，里面一个人都不见。」

chapters.en: When the captain of the temple guard and the chief priests heard this account, they were perplexed as to what was happening.
chapters.zh: 守殿官和祭司长听见这话，心里犯难，不知这事将来如何。

chapters.en: Then someone came in and announced, “Look, the men you put in jail are standing in the temple courts teaching the people!”
chapters.zh: 有一个人来禀报说：「你们收在监里的人，现在站在殿里教训百姓。」

chapters.en: At that point, the captain went with the officers and brought the apostles—but not by force, for fear the people would stone them.
chapters.zh: 于是守殿官和差役去带使徒来，并没有用强暴，因为怕百姓用石头打他们。

chapters.en: They brought them in and made them stand before the Sanhedrin, where the high priest interrogated them.
chapters.zh: 带到了，便叫使徒站在公会前；大祭司问他们说：

chapters.en: “We gave you strict orders not to teach in this name,” he said. “Yet you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and are determined to make us responsible for this man’s blood.”
chapters.zh: 「我们不是严严地禁止你们，不可奉这名教训人吗？你们倒把你们的道理充满了耶路撒冷，想要叫这人的血归到我们身上！」

chapters.en: But Peter and the other apostles replied, “We must obey God rather than men.
chapters.zh: 彼得和众使徒回答说：「顺从上帝，不顺从人，是应当的。

chapters.en: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you had killed by hanging Him on a tree.
chapters.zh: 你们挂在木头上杀害的耶稣，我们祖宗的上帝已经叫他复活。

chapters.en: God exalted Him to His right hand as Prince and Savior, in order to grant repentance and forgiveness of sins to Israel.
chapters.zh: 上帝且用右手将他高举〔注：或译：他就是上帝高举在自己的右边〕，叫他作君王，作救主，将悔改的心和赦罪的恩赐给以色列人。

chapters.en: We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey Him.”
chapters.zh: 我们为这事作见证；上帝赐给顺从之人的圣灵也为这事作见证。」

chapters.en: When the Council members heard this, they were enraged, and they resolved to put the apostles to death.
chapters.zh: 公会的人听见就极其恼怒，想要杀他们。

chapters.en: But a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law who was honored by all the people, stood up in the Sanhedrin and ordered that the men be put outside for a short time.
chapters.zh: 但有一个法利赛人，名叫迦玛列，是众百姓所敬重的教法师，在公会中站起来，吩咐人把使徒暂且带到外面去，

chapters.en: “Men of Israel,” he said, “consider carefully what you are about to do to these men.
chapters.zh: 就对众人说：「以色列人哪，论到这些人，你们应当小心怎样办理。

chapters.en: Some time ago Theudas rose up, claiming to be somebody, and about four hundred men joined him. He was killed, all his followers were dispersed, and it all came to nothing.
chapters.zh: 从前杜达起来，自夸为大，附从他的人约有四百，他被杀后，附从他的全都散了，归于无有。

chapters.en: After him, Judas the Galilean appeared in the days of the census and drew away people after him. He too perished, and all his followers were scattered.
chapters.zh: 此后，报名上册的时候，又有加利利的犹大起来，引诱些百姓跟从他；他也灭亡，附从他的人也都四散了。

chapters.en: So in the present case I advise you: Leave these men alone. Let them go! For if their purpose or endeavor is of human origin, it will fail.
chapters.zh: 现在，我劝你们不要管这些人，任凭他们吧！他们所谋的、所行的，若是出于人，必要败坏；

chapters.en: But if it is from God, you will not be able to stop them. You may even find yourselves fighting against God.”
chapters.zh: 若是出于上帝，你们就不能败坏他们，恐怕你们倒是攻击上帝了。」

chapters.en: At this, they yielded to Gamaliel. They called the apostles in and had them flogged. Then they ordered them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and released them.
chapters.zh: 公会的人听从了他，便叫使徒来，把他们打了，又吩咐他们不可奉耶稣的名讲道，就把他们释放了。

chapters.en: The apostles left the Sanhedrin, rejoicing that they had been counted worthy of suffering disgrace for the Name.
chapters.zh: 他们离开公会，心里欢喜，因被算是配为这名受辱。

chapters.en: Every day, in the temple courts and from house to house, they did not stop teaching and proclaiming the good news that Jesus is the Christ.
chapters.zh: 他们就每日在殿里、在家里不住地教训人，传耶稣是基督。

chapters.en: In those days when the disciples were increasing in number, the Grecian Jews among them began to grumble against the Hebraic Jews because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution of food.
chapters.zh: 那时，门徒增多，有说希腊话的犹太人向希伯来人发怨言，因为在天天的供给上忽略了他们的寡妇。

chapters.en: So the Twelve summoned all the disciples and said, “It is unacceptable for us to neglect the word of God in order to wait on tables.
chapters.zh: 十二使徒叫众门徒来，对他们说：「我们撇下上帝的道去管理饭食，原是不合宜的。

chapters.en: Therefore, brothers, select from among you seven men confirmed to be full of the Spirit and wisdom. We will assign this responsibility to them
chapters.zh: 所以弟兄们，当从你们中间选出七个有好名声、被〔圣〕灵充满、智慧充足的人，我们就派他们管理这事。

chapters.en: and will devote ourselves to prayer and to the ministry of the word.”
chapters.zh: 但我们要专心以祈祷、传道为事。」

chapters.en: This proposal pleased the whole group. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, as well as Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas from Antioch, a convert to Judaism.
chapters.zh: 大众都喜悦这话，就拣选了司提反，乃是大有信心、圣灵充满的人，又拣选腓利、伯罗哥罗、尼迦挪、提门、巴米拿，并进〔犹太〕教的安提阿人尼哥拉，

chapters.en: They presented these seven to the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.
chapters.zh: 叫他们站在使徒面前。使徒祷告了，就按手在他们头上。

chapters.en: So the word of God continued to spread. The number of disciples in Jerusalem grew rapidly, and a great number of priests became obedient to the faith.
chapters.zh: 上帝的道兴旺起来；在耶路撒冷门徒数目加增的甚多，也有许多祭司信从了这道。

chapters.en: Now Stephen, who was full of grace and power, was performing great wonders and signs among the people.
chapters.zh: 司提反满得恩惠、能力，在民间行了大奇事和神迹。

chapters.en: But resistance arose from what was called the Synagogue of the Freedmen, including Cyrenians, Alexandrians, and men from the provinces of Cilicia and Asia. They disputed with Stephen,
chapters.zh: 当时有称利百地拿会堂的几个人，并有古利奈、亚历山大、基利家、亚细亚各处会堂的几个人，都起来和司提反辩论。

chapters.en: but they could not stand up to his wisdom or the Spirit by whom he spoke.
chapters.zh: 司提反是以智慧和〔圣〕灵说话，众人敌挡不住，

chapters.en: Then they prompted some men to say, “We heard Stephen speak words of blasphemy against Moses and against God.”
chapters.zh: 就买出人来说：「我们听见他说谤讟摩西和上帝的话。」

chapters.en: So they stirred up the people, elders, and scribes and confronted Stephen. They seized him and brought him before the Sanhedrin,
chapters.zh: 他们又耸动了百姓、长老，并文士，就忽然来捉拿他，把他带到公会去，

chapters.en: where they presented false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking against this holy place and against the law.
chapters.zh: 设下假见证，说：「这个人说话，不住地糟践圣所和律法。

chapters.en: For we have heard him say that Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs that Moses handed down to us.”
chapters.zh: 我们曾听见他说，这拿撒勒人耶稣要毁坏此地，也要改变摩西所交给我们的规条。」

chapters.en: All who were sitting in the Sanhedrin looked intently at Stephen, and they saw that his face was like the face of an angel.
chapters.zh: 在公会里坐着的人都定睛看他，见他的面貌，好像天使的面貌。

chapters.en: Then the high priest asked Stephen, “Are these charges true?”
chapters.zh: 大祭司就说：「这些事果然有吗？」

chapters.en: And Stephen declared: “Brothers and fathers, listen to me! The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
chapters.zh: 司提反说：「诸位父兄请听！当日我们的祖宗亚伯拉罕在美索不达米亚还未住哈兰的时候，荣耀的上帝向他显现，

chapters.en: and told him, ‘Leave your country and your kindred and go to the land I will show you.’
chapters.zh: 对他说：『你要离开本地和亲族，往我所要指示你的地方去。』

chapters.en: So Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, God brought him out of that place and into this land where you are now living.
chapters.zh: 他就离开迦勒底人之地，住在哈兰。他父亲死了以后，〔上帝〕使他从那里搬到你们现在所住之地。

chapters.en: He gave him no inheritance here, not even a foot of ground. But God promised to give possession of the land to Abraham and his descendants, even though he did not yet have a child.
chapters.zh: 在这地方，上帝并没有给他产业，连立足之地也没有给他；但应许要将这地赐给他和他的后裔为业；那时他还没有儿子。

chapters.en: God told him that his descendants would be foreigners in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.
chapters.zh: 上帝说：『他的后裔必寄居外邦，那里的人要叫他们作奴仆，苦待他们四百年。』

chapters.en: ‘But I will punish the nation that enslaves them,’ God said, ‘and afterward they will come forth and worship Me in this place.’
chapters.zh: 上帝又说：『使他们作奴仆的那国，我要惩罚。以后他们要出来，在这地方事奉我。』

chapters.en: Then God gave Abraham the covenant of circumcision, and Abraham became the father of Isaac and circumcised him on the eighth day. And Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob of the twelve patriarchs.
chapters.zh: 上帝又赐他割礼的约。于是〔亚伯拉罕〕生了以撒，第八日给他行了割礼。以撒生雅各；雅各生十二位先祖。

chapters.en: Because the patriarchs were jealous of Joseph, they sold him as a slave into Egypt. But God was with him
chapters.zh: 「先祖嫉妒约瑟，把他卖到埃及去；上帝却与他同在，

chapters.en: and rescued him from all his troubles. He granted Joseph favor and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt, who appointed him ruler over Egypt and all his household.
chapters.zh: 救他脱离一切苦难，又使他在埃及王法老面前得恩典，有智慧。法老就派他作埃及国的宰相兼管全家。

chapters.en: Then famine and great suffering swept across Egypt and Canaan, and our fathers could not find food.
chapters.zh: 后来埃及和迦南全地遭遇饥荒，大受艰难，我们的祖宗就绝了粮。

chapters.en: When Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our fathers on their first visit.
chapters.zh: 雅各听见在埃及有粮，就打发我们的祖宗初次往那里去。

chapters.en: On their second visit, Joseph revealed his identity to his brothers, and his family became known to Pharaoh.
chapters.zh: 第二次约瑟与弟兄们相认，他的亲族也被法老知道了。

chapters.en: Then Joseph sent for his father Jacob and all his relatives, seventy-five in all.
chapters.zh: 约瑟就打发弟兄请父亲雅各和全家七十五个人都来。

chapters.en: So Jacob went down to Egypt, where he and our fathers died.
chapters.zh: 于是雅各下了埃及，后来他和我们的祖宗都死在那里；

chapters.en: Their bones were carried back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor at Shechem for a price he paid in silver.
chapters.zh: 又被带到示剑，葬于亚伯拉罕在示剑用银子从哈抹子孙买来的坟墓里。

chapters.en: As the time drew near for God to fulfill His promise to Abraham, our people in Egypt increased greatly in number.
chapters.zh: 「及至上帝应许亚伯拉罕的日期将到，以色列民在埃及兴盛众多，

chapters.en: Then another king, who knew nothing of Joseph, arose over Egypt.
chapters.zh: 直到有不晓得约瑟的新王兴起。

chapters.en: He exploited our people and oppressed our fathers, forcing them to abandon their infants so they would die.
chapters.zh: 他用诡计待我们的宗族，苦害我们的祖宗，叫他们丢弃婴孩，使婴孩不能存活。

chapters.en: At that time Moses was born, and he was beautiful in the sight of God. For three months he was nurtured in his father’s house.
chapters.zh: 那时，摩西生下来，俊美非凡，在他父亲家里抚养了三个月。

chapters.en: When he was set outside, Pharaoh’s daughter took him and brought him up as her own son.
chapters.zh: 他被丢弃的时候，法老的女儿拾了去，养为自己的儿子。

chapters.en: So Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in speech and action.
chapters.zh: 摩西学了埃及人一切的学问，说话行事都有才能。

chapters.en: When Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
chapters.zh: 「他将到四十岁，心中起意去看望他的弟兄以色列人；

chapters.en: And when he saw one of them being mistreated, Moses went to his defense and avenged him by striking down the Egyptian who was oppressing him.
chapters.zh: 〔到了那里〕，见他们一个人受冤屈，就护庇他，为那受欺压的人报仇，打死了那埃及人。

chapters.en: He assumed his brothers would understand that God was using him to deliver them, but they did not.
chapters.zh: 他以为弟兄必明白上帝是藉他的手搭救他们；他们却不明白。

chapters.en: The next day he came upon two Israelites who were fighting, and he tried to reconcile them, saying, ‘Men, you are brothers. Why are you mistreating each other?’
chapters.zh: 第二天，遇见两个〔以色列〕人争斗，就劝他们和睦，说：『你们二位是弟兄，为什么彼此欺负呢？』

chapters.en: But the man who was abusing his neighbor pushed Moses aside and said, ‘Who made you ruler and judge over us?
chapters.zh: 那欺负邻舍的把他推开，说：『谁立你作我们的首领和审判官呢？

chapters.en: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
chapters.zh: 难道你要杀我，像昨天杀那埃及人吗？』

chapters.en: At this remark, Moses fled to the land of Midian, where he lived as a foreigner and had two sons.
chapters.zh: 摩西听见这话就逃走了，寄居于米甸；在那里生了两个儿子。

chapters.en: After forty years had passed, an angel appeared to Moses in the flames of a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
chapters.zh: 「过了四十年，在西奈山的旷野，有一位天使从荆棘火焰中向摩西显现。

chapters.en: When Moses saw it, he marveled at the sight. As he approached to look more closely, the voice of the Lord came to him:
chapters.zh: 摩西见了那异象，便觉希奇，正进前观看的时候，有主的声音说：

chapters.en: ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.’ Moses trembled with fear and did not dare to look.
chapters.zh: 『我是你列祖的上帝，就是亚伯拉罕的上帝，以撒的上帝，雅各的上帝。』摩西战战兢兢，不敢观看。

chapters.en: Then the Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.
chapters.zh: 主对他说：『把你脚上的鞋脱下来，因为你所站之地是圣地。

chapters.en: I have indeed seen the oppression of My people in Egypt. I have heard their groaning and have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you back to Egypt.’
chapters.zh: 我的百姓在埃及所受的困苦，我实在看见了，他们悲叹的声音，我也听见了。我下来要救他们。你来！我要差你往埃及去。』

chapters.en: This Moses, whom they had rejected with the words, ‘Who made you ruler and judge?’ is the one whom God sent to be their ruler and redeemer through the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
chapters.zh: 这摩西就是百姓弃绝说『谁立你作我们的首领和审判官』的；上帝却藉那在荆棘中显现之使者的手差派他作首领、作救赎的。

chapters.en: He led them out and performed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, at the Red Sea, and for forty years in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 这人领百姓出来，在埃及，在红海，在旷野，四十年间行了奇事神迹。

chapters.en: This is the same Moses who told the Israelites, ‘God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers.’
chapters.zh: 那曾对以色列人说『上帝要从你们弟兄中间给你们兴起一位先知像我』的，就是这位摩西。

chapters.en: He was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers. And he received living words to pass on to us.
chapters.zh: 这人曾在旷野会中和西奈山上，与那对他说话的天使同在，又与我们的祖宗同在，并且领受活泼的圣言传给我们。

chapters.en: But our fathers refused to obey him. Instead, they rejected him and in their hearts turned back to Egypt.
chapters.zh: 我们的祖宗不肯听从，反弃绝他，心里归向埃及，

chapters.en: They said to Aaron, ‘Make us gods who will go before us! As for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him.’
chapters.zh: 对亚伦说：『你且为我们造些神像，在我们前面引路；因为领我们出埃及地的那个摩西，我们不知道他遭了什么事。』

chapters.en: At that time they made a calf and offered a sacrifice to the idol, rejoicing in the works of their hands.
chapters.zh: 那时，他们造了一个牛犊，又拿祭物献给那像，欢喜自己手中的工作。

chapters.en:
But God turned away from them and gave them over to the worship of the host of heaven, as it is written in the book of the prophets:
‘Did you bring Me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
chapters.zh: 上帝就转脸不顾，任凭他们事奉天上的日月星辰，正如先知书上所写的说： 以色列家啊， 你们四十年间在旷野， 岂是将牺牲和祭物献给我吗？

chapters.en:
You have taken along the tabernacle of Molech and the star of your god Rephan,
the idols you made to worship. Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Babylon.’
chapters.zh: 你们抬着摩洛的帐幕和理番神的星， 就是你们所造为要敬拜的像。 〔因此〕，我要把你们迁到巴比伦外去。

chapters.en: Our fathers had the tabernacle of the Testimony with them in the wilderness. It was constructed exactly as God had directed Moses, according to the pattern he had seen.
chapters.zh: 「我们的祖宗在旷野，有法柜的帐幕，是〔上帝〕吩咐摩西叫他照所看见的样式做的。

chapters.en: And our fathers who received it brought it in with Joshua when they dispossessed the nations God drove out before them. It remained until the time of David,
chapters.zh: 这帐幕，我们的祖宗相继承受。当上帝在他们面前赶出外邦人去的时候，他们同约书亚把帐幕搬进承受为业之地，直存到大卫的日子。

chapters.en: who found favor in the sight of God and asked to provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.
chapters.zh: 大卫在上帝面前蒙恩，祈求为雅各的上帝预备居所；

chapters.en: But it was Solomon who built the house for Him.
chapters.zh: 却是所罗门为上帝造成殿宇。

chapters.en: However, the Most High does not dwell in houses made by human hands. As the prophet says:
chapters.zh: 其实，至高者并不住人手所造的，就如先知所言：

chapters.en: ‘Heaven is My throne and the earth is My footstool. What kind of house will you build for Me, says the Lord, or where will My place of repose be?
chapters.zh: 主说：天是我的座位， 地是我的脚凳； 你们要为我造何等的殿宇？ 哪里是我安息的地方呢？

chapters.en: Has not My hand made all these things?’
chapters.zh: 这一切不都是我手所造的吗？

chapters.en: You stiff-necked people with uncircumcised hearts and ears! You always resist the Holy Spirit, just as your fathers did.
chapters.zh: 「你们这硬着颈项、心与耳未受割礼的人，常时抗拒圣灵！你们的祖宗怎样，你们也怎样。

chapters.en: Which of the prophets did your fathers fail to persecute? They even killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One. And now you are His betrayers and murderers—
chapters.zh: 哪一个先知不是你们祖宗逼迫呢？他们也把预先传说那义者要来的人杀了；如今你们又把那义者卖了，杀了。

chapters.en: you who received the law ordained by angels, yet have not kept it.”
chapters.zh: 你们受了天使所传的律法，竟不遵守。」

chapters.en: On hearing this, the members of the Sanhedrin were enraged, and they gnashed their teeth at him.
chapters.zh: 众人听见这话就极其恼怒，向司提反咬牙切齿。

chapters.en: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked intently into heaven and saw the glory of God and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.
chapters.zh: 但司提反被圣灵充满，定睛望天，看见上帝的荣耀，又看见耶稣站在上帝的右边，

chapters.en: “Look,” he said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God.”
chapters.zh: 就说：「我看见天开了，人子站在上帝的右边。」

chapters.en: At this they covered their ears, cried out in a loud voice, and rushed together at him.
chapters.zh: 众人大声喊叫，捂着耳朵，齐心拥上前去，

chapters.en: They dragged him out of the city and began to stone him. Meanwhile the witnesses laid their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
chapters.zh: 把他推到城外，用石头打他。作见证的人把衣裳放在一个少年人名叫扫罗的脚前。

chapters.en: While they were stoning him, Stephen appealed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.”
chapters.zh: 他们正用石头打的时候，司提反呼吁〔主〕说：「求主耶稣接收我的灵魂！」

chapters.en: Falling on his knees, he cried out in a loud voice, “Lord, do not hold this sin against them.” And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
chapters.zh: 又跪下大声喊着说：「主啊，不要将这罪归于他们！」说了这话，就睡了。扫罗也喜悦他被害。

chapters.en:
And Saul was there, giving approval to Stephen’s death.
On that day a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria.
chapters.zh: 从这日起，耶路撒冷的教会大遭逼迫，除了使徒以外，门徒都分散在犹太和撒马利亚各处。

chapters.en: God-fearing men buried Stephen and mourned deeply over him.
chapters.zh: 有虔诚的人把司提反埋葬了，为他捶胸大哭。

chapters.en: But Saul began to destroy the church. Going from house to house, he dragged off men and women and put them in prison.
chapters.zh: 扫罗却残害教会，进各人的家，拉着男女下在监里。

chapters.en: Those who had been scattered preached the word wherever they went.
chapters.zh: 那些分散的人往各处去传道。

chapters.en: Philip went down to a city in Samaria and proclaimed the Christ to them.
chapters.zh: 腓利下撒马利亚城去，宣讲基督。

chapters.en: The crowds all paid close attention to Philip’s message and to the signs they saw him perform.
chapters.zh: 众人听见了，又看见腓利所行的神迹，就同心合意地听从他的话。

chapters.en: With loud shrieks, unclean spirits came out of many who were possessed, and many of the paralyzed and lame were healed.
chapters.zh: 因为有许多人被污鬼附着，那些鬼大声呼叫，从他们身上出来；还有许多瘫痪的、瘸腿的，都得了医治。

chapters.en: So there was great joy in that city.
chapters.zh: 在那城里，就大有欢喜。

chapters.en: Prior to that time, a man named Simon had practiced sorcery in the city and astounded the people of Samaria. He claimed to be someone great,
chapters.zh: 有一个人，名叫西门，向来在那城里行邪术，妄自尊大，使撒马利亚的百姓惊奇；

chapters.en: and all the people, from the least to the greatest, heeded his words and said, “This man is the divine power called the Great Power.”
chapters.zh: 无论大小都听从他，说：「这人就是那称为上帝的大能者。」

chapters.en: They paid close attention to him because he had astounded them for a long time with his sorcery.
chapters.zh: 他们听从他，因他久用邪术，使他们惊奇。

chapters.en: But when they believed Philip as he preached the gospel of the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
chapters.zh: 及至他们信了腓利所传上帝国的福音和耶稣基督的名，连男带女就受了洗。

chapters.en: Even Simon himself believed and was baptized. He followed Philip closely and was astounded by the great signs and miracles he observed.
chapters.zh: 西门自己也信了；既受了洗，就常与腓利在一处，看见他所行的神迹和大异能，就甚惊奇。

chapters.en: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them.
chapters.zh: 使徒在耶路撒冷听见撒马利亚人领受了上帝的道，就打发彼得、约翰往他们那里去。

chapters.en: On their arrival, they prayed for them to receive the Holy Spirit.
chapters.zh: 两个人到了，就为他们祷告，要叫他们受圣灵。

chapters.en: For the Holy Spirit had not yet fallen upon any of them; they had simply been baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.
chapters.zh: 因为圣灵还没有降在他们一个人身上，他们只奉主耶稣的名受了洗。

chapters.en: Then Peter and John laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
chapters.zh: 于是使徒按手在他们〔头〕上，他们就受了圣灵。

chapters.en: When Simon saw that the Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money.
chapters.zh: 西门看见使徒按手，便有圣灵赐下，就拿钱给使徒，

chapters.en: “Give me this power as well,” he said, “so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit.”
chapters.zh: 说：「把这权柄也给我，叫我手按着谁，谁就可以受圣灵。」

chapters.en: But Peter replied, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could buy the gift of God with money!
chapters.zh: 彼得说：「你的银子和你一同灭亡吧！因你想上帝的恩赐是可以用钱买的。

chapters.en: You have no part or share in our ministry, because your heart is not right before God.
chapters.zh: 你在这道上无分无关；因为在上帝面前，你的心不正。

chapters.en: Repent, therefore, of your wickedness, and pray to the Lord. Perhaps He will forgive you for the intent of your heart.
chapters.zh: 你当懊悔你这罪恶，祈求主，或者你心里的意念可得赦免。

chapters.en: For I see that you are poisoned by bitterness and captive to iniquity.”
chapters.zh: 我看出你正在苦胆之中，被罪恶捆绑。」

chapters.en: Then Simon answered, “Pray to the Lord for me, so that nothing you have said may happen to me.”
chapters.zh: 西门说：「愿你们为我求主，叫你们所说的，没有一样临到我身上。」

chapters.en: And after Peter and John had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel in many of the Samaritan villages.
chapters.zh: 使徒既证明主道，而且传讲，就回耶路撒冷去，一路在撒马利亚好些村庄传扬福音。

chapters.en: Now an angel of the Lord said to Philip, “Get up and go south to the desert road that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza.”
chapters.zh: 有主的一个使者对腓利说：「起来！向南走，往那从耶路撒冷下迦萨的路上去。」那路是旷野。

chapters.en: So he started out, and on his way he met an Ethiopian eunuch, a court official in charge of the entire treasury of Candace, queen of the Ethiopians. He had gone to Jerusalem to worship,
chapters.zh: 腓利就起身去了，不料，有一个衣索匹亚〔注：就是古实，见以赛亚十八章一节〕人，是个有大权的太监，在衣索匹亚女王甘大基的手下总管银库，他上耶路撒冷礼拜去了。

chapters.en: and on his return was sitting in his chariot reading Isaiah the prophet.
chapters.zh: 现在回来，在车上坐着，念先知以赛亚的书。

chapters.en: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go over to that chariot and stay by it.”
chapters.zh: 圣灵对腓利说：「你去！贴近那车走。」

chapters.en: So Philip ran up and heard the man reading Isaiah the prophet. “Do you understand what you are reading?” Philip asked.
chapters.zh: 腓利就跑到太监那里，听见他念先知以赛亚的书，便问他说：「你所念的，你明白吗？」

chapters.en: “How can I,” he said, “unless someone guides me?” And he invited Philip to come up and sit with him.
chapters.zh: 他说：「没有人指教我，怎能明白呢？」于是请腓利上车，与他同坐。

chapters.en:
The eunuch was reading this passage of Scripture:
“He was led like a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before the shearer is silent,
so He did not open His mouth.
chapters.zh: 他所念的那段经，说： 他像羊被牵到宰杀之地， 又像羊羔在剪毛的人手下无声； 他也是这样不开口。

chapters.en:
In His humiliation He was deprived of justice. Who can recount His descendants?
For His life was removed from the earth.”
chapters.zh: 他卑微的时候， 人不按公义审判他〔注：原文是他的审判被夺去〕； 谁能述说他的世代？ 因为他的生命从地上夺去。

chapters.en: “Tell me,” said the eunuch, “who is the prophet talking about, himself or someone else?”
chapters.zh: 太监对腓利说：「请问，先知说这话是指着谁？是指着自己呢？是指着别人呢？」

chapters.en: Then Philip began with this very Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.
chapters.zh: 腓利就开口从这经上起，对他传讲耶稣。

chapters.en: As they traveled along the road and came to some water, the eunuch said, “Look, here is water! What is there to prevent me from being baptized?”
chapters.zh: 二人正往前走，到了有水的地方，太监说：「看哪，这里有水，我受洗有什么妨碍呢？」
〔注：有古卷加：37 腓利说：「你若是一心相信，就可以。」他回答说：「我信耶稣基督是上帝的儿子。」〕

chapters.en: And he gave orders to stop the chariot. Then both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.
chapters.zh: 于是吩咐车站住，腓利和太监二人同下水里去，腓利就给他施洗。

chapters.en: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord carried Philip away, and the eunuch saw him no more, but went on his way rejoicing.
chapters.zh: 从水里上来，主的灵把腓利提了去，太监也不再见他了，就欢欢喜喜地走路。

chapters.en: But Philip appeared at Azotus and traveled through that region, preaching the gospel in all the towns until he came to Caesarea.
chapters.zh: 后来有人在亚锁都遇见腓利；他走遍那地方，在各城宣传福音，直到凯撒利亚。

chapters.en: Meanwhile, Saul was still breathing out murderous threats against the disciples of the Lord. He approached the high priest
chapters.zh: 扫罗仍然向主的门徒口吐威吓凶煞的话，去见大祭司，

chapters.en: and requested letters to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any men or women belonging to the Way, he could bring them as prisoners to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 求文书给大马士革的各会堂，若是找着信奉这道的人，无论男女，都准他捆绑带到耶路撒冷。

chapters.en: As Saul drew near to Damascus on his journey, suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.
chapters.zh: 扫罗行路，将到大马士革，忽然从天上发光，四面照着他；

chapters.en: He fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?”
chapters.zh: 他就仆倒在地，听见有声音对他说：「扫罗！扫罗！你为什么逼迫我？」

chapters.en:
“Who are You, Lord?” Saul asked.
“I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,” He replied.
chapters.zh: 他说：「主啊！你是谁？」主说：「我就是你所逼迫的耶稣。

chapters.en: “Now get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do.”
chapters.zh: 起来！进城去，你所当做的事，必有人告诉你。」

chapters.en: The men traveling with Saul stood there speechless. They heard the voice but did not see anyone.
chapters.zh: 同行的人站在那里，说不出话来，听见声音，却看不见人。

chapters.en: Saul got up from the ground, but when he opened his eyes he could not see a thing. So they led him by the hand into Damascus.
chapters.zh: 扫罗从地上起来，睁开眼睛，竟不能看见什么。有人拉他的手，领他进了大马士革；

chapters.en: For three days he was without sight, and he did not eat or drink anything.
chapters.zh: 三日不能看见，也不吃也不喝。

chapters.en:
In Damascus there was a disciple named Ananias. The Lord spoke to him in a vision, “Ananias!”
“Here I am, Lord,” he answered.
chapters.zh: 当下，在大马士革有一个门徒，名叫亚拿尼亚。主在异象中对他说：「亚拿尼亚。」他说：「主，我在这里。」

chapters.en: “Get up!” the Lord told him. “Go to the house of Judas on Straight Street and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul, for he is praying.
chapters.zh: 主对他说：「起来！往直街去，在犹大的家里，访问一个大数人，名叫扫罗。他正祷告，

chapters.en: In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias come and place his hands on him to restore his sight.”
chapters.zh: 又看见了一个人，名叫亚拿尼亚，进来按手在他身上，叫他能看见。」

chapters.en: But Ananias answered, “Lord, many people have told me about this man and all the harm he has done to Your saints in Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 亚拿尼亚回答说：「主啊，我听见许多人说，这人怎样在耶路撒冷多多苦害你的圣徒，

chapters.en: And now he is here with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on Your name.”
chapters.zh: 并且他在这里有从祭司长得来的权柄捆绑一切求告你名的人。」

chapters.en: “Go!” said the Lord. “This man is My chosen instrument to carry My name before the Gentiles and their kings, and before the people of Israel.
chapters.zh: 主对亚拿尼亚说：「你只管去！他是我所拣选的器皿，要在外邦人和君王，并以色列人面前宣扬我的名。

chapters.en: I will show him how much he must suffer for My name.”
chapters.zh: 我也要指示他，为我的名必须受许多的苦难。」

chapters.en: So Ananias went to the house, and when he arrived, he placed his hands on Saul. “Brother Saul,” he said, “the Lord Jesus, who appeared to you on the road as you were coming here, has sent me so that you may see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
chapters.zh: 亚拿尼亚就去了，进入那家，把手按在扫罗身上，说：「兄弟扫罗，在你来的路上向你显现的主，就是耶稣，打发我来，叫你能看见，又被圣灵充满。」

chapters.en: At that instant, something like scales fell from Saul’s eyes, and his sight was restored. He got up and was baptized,
chapters.zh: 扫罗的眼睛上，好像有鳞立刻掉下来，他就能看见。于是起来受了洗；

chapters.en: and after taking some food, he regained his strength. And he spent several days with the disciples in Damascus.
chapters.zh: 吃过饭就健壮了。 扫罗和大马士革的门徒同住了些日子，

chapters.en: Saul promptly began to proclaim Jesus in the synagogues, declaring, “He is the Son of God.”
chapters.zh: 就在各会堂里宣传耶稣，说他是上帝的儿子。

chapters.en: All who heard him were astounded and asked, “Isn’t this the man who wreaked havoc in Jerusalem on those who call on this name? And hasn’t he come here to take them as prisoners to the chief priests?”
chapters.zh: 凡听见的人都惊奇，说：「在耶路撒冷残害求告这名的，不是这人吗？并且他到这里来，特要捆绑他们，带到祭司长那里。」

chapters.en: But Saul was empowered all the more, and he confounded the Jews living in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Christ.
chapters.zh: 但扫罗越发有能力，驳倒住大马士革的犹太人，证明耶稣是基督。

chapters.en: After many days had passed, the Jews conspired to kill him,
chapters.zh: 过了好些日子，犹太人商议要杀扫罗，

chapters.en: but Saul learned of their plot. Day and night they watched the city gates in order to kill him.
chapters.zh: 但他们的计谋被扫罗知道了。他们又昼夜在城门守候，要杀他。

chapters.en: One night, however, his disciples took him and lowered him in a basket through a window in the wall.
chapters.zh: 他的门徒就在夜间用筐子把他从城墙上缒下去。

chapters.en: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
chapters.zh: 扫罗到了耶路撒冷，想与门徒结交，他们却都怕他，不信他是门徒。

chapters.en: Then Barnabas brought him to the apostles and described how Saul had seen the Lord, who had spoken to him on the road to Damascus, and how Saul had spoken boldly in that city in the name of Jesus.
chapters.zh: 惟有巴拿巴接待他，领去见使徒，把他在路上怎么看见主，主怎么向他说话，他在大马士革怎么奉耶稣的名放胆传道，都述说出来。

chapters.en: So Saul stayed with them, moving about freely in Jerusalem and speaking boldly in the name of the Lord.
chapters.zh: 于是扫罗在耶路撒冷和门徒出入来往，

chapters.en: He talked and debated with the Grecian Jews, but they tried to kill him.
chapters.zh: 奉主的名放胆传道，并与说希腊话的犹太人讲论辩驳；他们却想法子要杀他。

chapters.en: When the brothers learned of this, they took him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们知道了就送他下凯撒利亚，打发他往大数去。

chapters.en: Then the church throughout Judea, Galilee, and Samaria experienced a time of peace. It grew in strength and numbers, living in the fear of the Lord and the encouragement of the Holy Spirit.
chapters.zh: 那时，犹太、加利利、撒马利亚各处的教会都得平安，被建立；凡事敬畏主，蒙圣灵的安慰，人数就增多了。

chapters.en: As Peter traveled throughout the area, he went to visit the saints in Lydda.
chapters.zh: 彼得周流四方的时候，也到了居住吕大的圣徒那里；

chapters.en: There he found a man named Aeneas who had been paralyzed and bedridden for eight years.
chapters.zh: 遇见一个人，名叫以尼雅，得了瘫痪，在褥子上躺卧八年。

chapters.en: “Aeneas,” Peter said to him, “Jesus Christ heals you! Get up and put away your mat.” Immediately Aeneas got up,
chapters.zh: 彼得对他说：「以尼雅，耶稣基督医好你了，起来！收拾你的褥子。」他就立刻起来了。

chapters.en: and all who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.
chapters.zh: 凡住吕大和沙崙的人都看见了他，就归服主。

chapters.en: In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha (which is translated as Dorcas), who was always occupied with works of kindness and charity.
chapters.zh: 在约帕有一个女徒，名叫大比大，翻〔希腊〕话就是多加〔注：就是羚羊的意思〕；她广行善事，多施赒济。

chapters.en: At that time, however, she became sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upper room.
chapters.zh: 当时，她患病而死，有人把她洗了，停在楼上。

chapters.en: Since Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to urge him, “Come to us without delay.”
chapters.zh: 吕大原与约帕相近；门徒听见彼得在那里，就打发两个人去见他，央求他说：「快到我们那里去，不要耽延。」

chapters.en: So Peter got up and went with them. On his arrival, they took him to the upper room. All the widows stood around him, weeping and showing him the tunics and other clothing that Dorcas had made while she was still with them.
chapters.zh: 彼得就起身和他们同去；到了，便有人领他上楼。众寡妇都站在彼得旁边哭，拿多加与她们同在时所做的里衣外衣给他看。

chapters.en: Then Peter sent them all out of the room. He knelt down and prayed, and turning toward her body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and seeing Peter, she sat up.
chapters.zh: 彼得叫她们都出去，就跪下祷告，转身对着死人说：「大比大，起来！」她就睁开眼睛，见了彼得，便坐起来。

chapters.en: Peter took her by the hand and helped her up. Then he called the saints and widows and presented her to them alive.
chapters.zh: 彼得伸手扶她起来，叫众圣徒和寡妇进去，把多加活活地交给他们。

chapters.en: This became known all over Joppa, and many people believed in the Lord.
chapters.zh: 这事传遍了约帕，就有许多人信了主。

chapters.en: And Peter stayed for several days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.
chapters.zh: 此后，彼得在约帕一个硝皮匠西门的家里住了多日。

chapters.en: At Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, a centurion in what was called the Italian Regiment.
chapters.zh: 在凯撒利亚有一个人，名叫哥尼流，是「意大利营」的百夫长。

chapters.en: He and all his household were devout and God-fearing. He gave generously to the people and prayed to God regularly.
chapters.zh: 他是个虔诚人，他和全家都敬畏上帝，多多赒济百姓，常常祷告上帝。

chapters.en: One day at about the ninth hour, he had a clear vision of an angel of God who came to him and said, “Cornelius!”
chapters.zh: 有一天，约在申初，他在异象中明明看见上帝的一个使者进去，到他那里，说：「哥尼流。」

chapters.en:
Cornelius stared at him in fear and asked, “What is it, Lord?”
The angel answered, “Your prayers and gifts to the poor have ascended as a memorial offering before God.
chapters.zh: 哥尼流定睛看他，惊怕说：「主啊，什么事呢？」天使说：「你的祷告和你的赒济达到上帝面前，已蒙记念了。

chapters.en: Now send men to Joppa to call for a man named Simon who is called Peter.
chapters.zh: 现在你当打发人往约帕去，请那称呼彼得的西门来。

chapters.en: He is staying with Simon the tanner, whose house is by the sea. ”
chapters.zh: 他住在海边一个硝皮匠西门的家里，房子在海边上。」

chapters.en: When the angel who spoke to him had gone, Cornelius called two of his servants and a devout soldier from among his attendants.
chapters.zh: 向他说话的天使去后，哥尼流叫了两个家人和常伺候他的一个虔诚兵来，

chapters.en: He explained what had happened and sent them to Joppa.
chapters.zh: 把这事都述说给他们听，就打发他们往约帕去。

chapters.en: The next day at about the sixth hour, as the men were approaching the city on their journey, Peter went up on the roof to pray.
chapters.zh: 第二天，他们行路将近那城。彼得约在午正，上房顶去祷告，

chapters.en: He became hungry and wanted something to eat, but while the meal was being prepared, he fell into a trance.
chapters.zh: 觉得饿了，想要吃。那家的人正预备饭的时候，彼得魂游象外，

chapters.en: He saw heaven open and something like a large sheet being let down to earth by its four corners.
chapters.zh: 看见天开了，有一物降下，好像一块大布，系着四角，缒在地上，

chapters.en: It contained all kinds of four-footed animals and reptiles of the earth, as well as birds of the air.
chapters.zh: 里面有地上各样四足的走兽和昆虫，并天上的飞鸟；

chapters.en: Then a voice said to him: “Get up, Peter, kill and eat!”
chapters.zh: 又有声音向他说：「彼得，起来，宰了吃！」

chapters.en: “No, Lord!” Peter answered. “I have never eaten anything impure or unclean.”
chapters.zh: 彼得却说：「主啊，这是不可的！凡俗物和不洁净的物，我从来没有吃过。」

chapters.en: The voice spoke to him a second time: “Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.”
chapters.zh: 第二次有声音向他说：「上帝所洁净的，你不可当作俗物。」

chapters.en: This happened three times, and all at once the sheet was taken back up into heaven.
chapters.zh: 这样一连三次，那物随即收回天上去了。

chapters.en: While Peter was puzzling over the meaning of the vision, the men sent by Cornelius found Simon’s house and approached the gate.
chapters.zh: 彼得心里正在猜疑之间，不知所看见的异象是什么意思。哥尼流所差来的人已经访问到西门的家，站在门外，

chapters.en: They called out to ask if Simon called Peter was staying there.
chapters.zh: 喊着问：「有称呼彼得的西门住在这里没有？」

chapters.en: As Peter continued to reflect on the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men are looking for you.
chapters.zh: 彼得还思想那异象的时候，〔圣〕灵向他说：「有三个人来找你。

chapters.en: So get up! Go downstairs and accompany them without hesitation, because I have sent them.”
chapters.zh: 起来，下去，和他们同往，不要疑惑，因为是我差他们来的。」

chapters.en: So Peter went down to the men and said, “Here am I, the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
chapters.zh: 于是彼得下去见那些人，说：「我就是你们所找的人。你们来是为什么缘故？」

chapters.en: “Cornelius the centurion has sent us,” they said. “He is a righteous and God-fearing man with a good reputation among the whole Jewish nation. A holy angel instructed him to request your presence in his home so he could hear a message from you.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「百夫长哥尼流是个义人，敬畏上帝，为犹太通国所称赞。他蒙一位圣天使指示，叫他请你到他家里去，听你的话。」

chapters.en: So Peter invited them in as his guests. And the next day he got ready and went with them, accompanied by some of the brothers from Joppa.
chapters.zh: 彼得就请他们进去，住了一宿。 次日，起身和他们同去，还有约帕的几个弟兄同着他去；

chapters.en: The following day he arrived in Caesarea, where Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.
chapters.zh: 又次日，他们进入凯撒利亚，哥尼流已经请了他的亲属密友等候他们。

chapters.en: As Peter was about to enter, Cornelius met him and fell at his feet to worship him.
chapters.zh: 彼得一进去，哥尼流就迎接他，俯伏在他脚前拜他。

chapters.en: But Peter helped him up. “Stand up,” he said, “I am only a man myself.”
chapters.zh: 彼得却拉他，说：「你起来，我也是人。」

chapters.en: As Peter talked with him, he went inside and found many people gathered together.
chapters.zh: 彼得和他说着话进去，见有好些人在那里聚集，

chapters.en: He said to them, “You know how unlawful it is for a Jew to associate with a foreigner or visit him. But God has shown me that I should not call any man impure or unclean.
chapters.zh: 就对他们说：「你们知道，犹太人和别国的人亲近来往本是不合例的，但上帝已经指示我，无论什么人都不可看作俗而不洁净的。

chapters.en: So when I was invited, I came without objection. I ask, then, why have you sent for me?”
chapters.zh: 所以我被请的时候，就不推辞而来。现在请问：你们叫我来有什么意思呢？」

chapters.en: Cornelius answered: “Four days ago I was in my house praying at this, the ninth hour. Suddenly a man in radiant clothing stood before me
chapters.zh: 哥尼流说：「前四天，这个时候，我在家中守着申初的祷告，忽然有一个人穿着光明的衣裳，站在我面前，

chapters.en: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer has been heard, and your gifts to the poor have been remembered before God.
chapters.zh: 说：『哥尼流，你的祷告已蒙垂听，你的赒济达到上帝面前已蒙记念了。

chapters.en: Therefore send to Joppa for Simon, who is called Peter. He is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner, by the sea.’
chapters.zh: 你当打发人往约帕去，请那称呼彼得的西门来，他住在海边一个硝皮匠西门的家里。』

chapters.en: So I sent for you immediately, and you were kind enough to come. Now then, we are all here in the presence of God to listen to everything the Lord has instructed you to tell us.”
chapters.zh: 所以我立时打发人去请你。你来了很好；现今我们都在上帝面前，要听主所吩咐你的一切话。」

chapters.en: Then Peter began to speak: “I now truly understand that God does not show favoritism,
chapters.zh: 彼得就开口说：「我真看出上帝是不偏待人。

chapters.en: but welcomes those from every nation who fear Him and do what is right.
chapters.zh: 原来，各国中那敬畏主、行义的人都为主所悦纳。

chapters.en: He has sent this message to the people of Israel, proclaiming the gospel of peace through Jesus Christ, who is Lord of all.
chapters.zh: 上帝藉着耶稣基督（他是万有的主）传和平的福音，将这道赐给以色列人。

chapters.en: You yourselves know what has happened throughout Judea, beginning in Galilee with the baptism that John proclaimed:
chapters.zh: 这话在约翰宣传洗礼以后，从加利利起，传遍了犹太。

chapters.en: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, and how Jesus went around doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, because God was with Him.
chapters.zh: 上帝怎样以圣灵和能力膏拿撒勒人耶稣，这都是你们知道的。他周流四方，行善事，医好凡被魔鬼压制的人，因为上帝与他同在。

chapters.en: We are witnesses of all that He did, both in the land of the Jews and in Jerusalem. And although they put Him to death by hanging Him on a tree,
chapters.zh: 他在犹太人之地，并耶路撒冷所行的一切事，有我们作见证。他们竟把他挂在木头上杀了。

chapters.en: God raised Him up on the third day and caused Him to be seen—
chapters.zh: 第三日，上帝叫他复活，显现出来；

chapters.en: not by all the people, but by the witnesses God had chosen beforehand, by us who ate and drank with Him after He rose from the dead.
chapters.zh: 不是显现给众人看，乃是显现给上帝预先所拣选为他作见证的人看，就是我们这些在他从死里复活以后和他同吃同喝的人。

chapters.en: And He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that He is the One appointed by God to judge the living and the dead.
chapters.zh: 他吩咐我们传道给众人，证明他是上帝所立定的，要作审判活人、死人的主。

chapters.en: All the prophets testify about Him that everyone who believes in Him receives forgiveness of sins through His name.”
chapters.zh: 众先知也为他作见证说：『凡信他的人必因他的名得蒙赦罪。』」

chapters.en: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell upon all who heard his message.
chapters.zh: 彼得还说这话的时候，圣灵降在一切听道的人身上。

chapters.en: All the circumcised believers who had accompanied Peter were astounded that the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out even on the Gentiles.
chapters.zh: 那些奉割礼、和彼得同来的信徒，见圣灵的恩赐也浇在外邦人身上，就都希奇；

chapters.en:
For they heard them speaking in tongues and exalting God.
Then Peter said,
chapters.zh: 因听见他们说方言，称赞上帝为大。

chapters.en: “Can anyone withhold the water to baptize these people? They have received the Holy Spirit just as we have!”
chapters.zh: 于是彼得说：「这些人既受了圣灵，与我们一样，谁能禁止用水给他们施洗呢？」

chapters.en: So he ordered that they be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay for a few days.
chapters.zh: 就吩咐奉耶稣基督的名给他们施洗。他们又请彼得住了几天。

chapters.en: The apostles and brothers throughout Judea soon heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.
chapters.zh: 使徒和在犹太的众弟兄听说外邦人也领受了上帝的道。

chapters.en: So when Peter went up to Jerusalem, the circumcised believers took issue with him
chapters.zh: 及至彼得上了耶路撒冷，那些奉割礼的门徒和他争辩说：

chapters.en: and said, “You visited uncircumcised men and ate with them.”
chapters.zh: 「你进入未受割礼之人的家和他们一同吃饭了。」

chapters.en: But Peter began and explained to them the whole sequence of events:
chapters.zh: 彼得就开口把这事挨次给他们讲解说：

chapters.en: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision of something like a large sheet being let down from heaven by its four corners, and it came right down to me.
chapters.zh: 「我在约帕城里祷告的时候，魂游象外，看见异象，有一物降下，好像一块大布，系着四角，从天缒下，直来到我跟前。

chapters.en: I looked at it closely and saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds of the air.
chapters.zh: 我定睛观看，见内中有地上四足的牲畜和野兽、昆虫，并天上的飞鸟。

chapters.en: Then I heard a voice saying to me, ‘Get up, Peter, kill and eat.’
chapters.zh: 我且听见有声音向我说：『彼得，起来，宰了吃！』

chapters.en: ‘No, Lord,’ I said, ‘for nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’
chapters.zh: 我说：『主啊，这是不可的！凡俗而不洁净的物从来没有入过我的口。』

chapters.en: But the voice spoke from heaven a second time, ‘Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.’
chapters.zh: 第二次，有声音从天上说：『上帝所洁净的，你不可当作俗物。』

chapters.en: This happened three times, and everything was drawn back up into heaven.
chapters.zh: 这样一连三次，就都收回天上去了。

chapters.en: Just then three men sent to me from Caesarea stopped at the house where I was staying.
chapters.zh: 正当那时，有三个人站在我们所住的房门前，是从凯撒利亚差来见我的。

chapters.en: The Spirit told me to accompany them without hesitation. These six brothers also went with me, and we entered the man’s home.
chapters.zh: 圣灵吩咐我和他们同去，不要疑惑〔注：或译：不要分别等类〕。同着我去的，还有这六位弟兄，我们都进了那人的家。

chapters.en: He told us how he had seen an angel standing in his house and saying, ‘Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter.
chapters.zh: 那人就告诉我们，他如何看见一位天使站在他屋里，说：『你打发人往约帕去，请那称呼彼得的西门来，

chapters.en: He will convey to you a message by which you and all your household will be saved.’
chapters.zh: 他有话告诉你，可以叫你和你的全家得救。』

chapters.en: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell upon them, just as He had fallen upon us at the beginning.
chapters.zh: 我一开讲，圣灵便降在他们身上，正像当初降在我们身上一样。

chapters.en: Then I remembered the word of the Lord, how He said, ‘John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.’
chapters.zh: 我就想起主的话说：『约翰是用水施洗，但你们要受圣灵的洗。』

chapters.en: So if God gave them the same gift He gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to hinder the work of God?”
chapters.zh: 上帝既然给他们恩赐，像在我们信主耶稣基督的时候给了我们一样；我是谁，能拦阻上帝呢？」

chapters.en: When they heard this, they had no further objections, and they glorified God, saying, “So then, God has granted even the Gentiles repentance unto life.”
chapters.zh: 众人听见这话，就不言语了，只归荣耀与上帝，说：「这样看来，上帝也赐恩给外邦人，叫他们悔改得生命了。」

chapters.en: Meanwhile those scattered by the persecution that began with Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the message only to Jews.
chapters.zh: 那些因司提反的事遭患难四散的门徒直走到腓尼基和塞浦路斯，并安提阿；他们不向别人讲道，只向犹太人讲。

chapters.en: But some of them, men from Cyprus and Cyrene, went to Antioch and began speaking to the Greeks as well, proclaiming the good news about the Lord Jesus.
chapters.zh: 但内中有塞浦路斯和古利奈人，他们到了安提阿也向希腊人传讲主耶稣〔注：有古卷：也向说希腊话的犹太人传讲主耶稣〕。

chapters.en: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number of people believed and turned to the Lord.
chapters.zh: 主与他们同在，信而归主的人就很多了。

chapters.en: When news of this reached the ears of the church in Jerusalem, they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
chapters.zh: 这风声传到耶路撒冷教会人的耳中，他们就打发巴拿巴出去，走到安提阿为止。

chapters.en: When he arrived and saw the grace of God, he rejoiced and encouraged them all to abide in the Lord with all their hearts.
chapters.zh: 他到了那里，看见上帝所赐的恩就欢喜，劝勉众人，立定心志，恒久靠主。

chapters.en: Barnabas was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and faith, and a great number of people were brought to the Lord.
chapters.zh: 这巴拿巴原是个好人，被圣灵充满，大有信心。于是有许多人归服了主。

chapters.en: Then Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul,
chapters.zh: 他又往大数去找扫罗，

chapters.en: and when he found him, he brought him back to Antioch. So for a full year they met together with the church and taught large numbers of people. The disciples were first called Christians at Antioch.
chapters.zh: 找着了，就带他到安提阿去。他们足有一年的工夫和教会一同聚集，教训了许多人。门徒称为「基督徒」是从安提阿起首。

chapters.en: In those days some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
chapters.zh: 当那些日子，有几位先知从耶路撒冷下到安提阿。

chapters.en: One of them named Agabus stood up and predicted through the Spirit that a great famine would sweep across the whole world. (This happened under Claudius.)
chapters.zh: 内中有一位，名叫亚迦布，站起来，藉着〔圣〕灵指明天下将有大饥荒。（这事到克劳第年间果然有了。）

chapters.en: So the disciples, each according to his ability, decided to send relief to the brothers living in Judea.
chapters.zh: 于是门徒定意照各人的力量捐钱，送去供给住在犹太的弟兄。

chapters.en: This they did, sending their gifts to the elders with Barnabas and Saul.
chapters.zh: 他们就这样行，把捐项讬巴拿巴和扫罗送到众长老那里。

chapters.en: About that time, King Herod reached out to harm some who belonged to the church.
chapters.zh: 那时，希律王下手苦害教会中几个人，

chapters.en: He had James, the brother of John, put to death with the sword.
chapters.zh: 用刀杀了约翰的哥哥雅各。

chapters.en: And seeing that this pleased the Jews, Herod proceeded to seize Peter during the Feast of Unleavened Bread.
chapters.zh: 他见犹太人喜欢这事，又去捉拿彼得。那时正是除酵的日子。

chapters.en: He arrested him and put him in prison, handing him over to be guarded by four squads of four soldiers each. Herod intended to bring him out to the people after the Passover.
chapters.zh: 希律拿了彼得，收在监里，交付四班兵丁看守，每班四个人，意思要在逾越节后把他提出来，当着百姓〔办他〕。

chapters.en: So Peter was kept in prison, but the church was fervently praying to God for him.
chapters.zh: 于是彼得被囚在监里；教会却为他切切地祷告上帝。

chapters.en: On the night before Herod was to bring him to trial, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, with sentries standing guard at the entrance to the prison.
chapters.zh: 希律将要提他出来的前一夜，彼得被两条铁鍊锁着，睡在两个兵丁当中；看守的人也在门外看守。

chapters.en: Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared and a light shone in the cell. He tapped Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Get up quickly.” And the chains fell off his wrists.
chapters.zh: 忽然，有主的一个使者站在旁边，屋里有光照耀，天使拍彼得的肋旁，拍醒了他，说：「快快起来！」那铁鍊就从他手上脱落下来。

chapters.en: “Get dressed and put on your sandals,” said the angel. Peter did so, and the angel told him, “Wrap your cloak around you and follow me.”
chapters.zh: 天使对他说：「束上带子，穿上鞋。」他就那样做。天使又说：「披上外衣，跟着我来。」

chapters.en: So Peter followed him out, but he was unaware that what the angel was doing was real. He thought he was only seeing a vision.
chapters.zh: 彼得就出来跟着他，不知道天使所做是真的，只当见了异象。

chapters.en: They passed the first and second guards and came to the iron gate leading to the city, which opened for them by itself. When they had gone outside and walked the length of one block, the angel suddenly left him.
chapters.zh: 过了第一层第二层监牢，就来到临街的铁门，那门自己开了。他们出来，走过一条街，天使便离开他去了。

chapters.en: Then Peter came to himself and said, “Now I know for sure that the Lord has sent His angel and rescued me from Herod’s grasp and from everything the Jewish people were anticipating.”
chapters.zh: 彼得醒悟过来，说：「我现在真知道主差遣他的使者，救我脱离希律的手和犹太百姓一切所盼望的。」

chapters.en: And when he had realized this, he went to the house of Mary the mother of John, also called Mark, where many people had gathered together and were praying.
chapters.zh: 想了一想，就往那称呼马可的约翰、他母亲马利亚家去，在那里有好些人聚集祷告。

chapters.en: He knocked at the outer gate, and a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer it.
chapters.zh: 彼得敲外门，有一个使女，名叫罗大，出来探听，

chapters.en: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she was so overjoyed that she forgot to open the gate, but ran inside and announced, “Peter is standing at the gate!”
chapters.zh: 听得是彼得的声音，就欢喜的顾不得开门，跑进去告诉众人说：「彼得站在门外。」

chapters.en: “You are out of your mind,” they told her. But when she kept insisting it was so, they said, “It must be his angel.”
chapters.zh: 他们说：「你是疯了！」使女极力地说：「真是他！」他们说：「必是他的天使！」

chapters.en: But Peter kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astounded.
chapters.zh: 彼得不住地敲门。他们开了门，看见他，就甚惊奇。

chapters.en: Peter motioned with his hand for silence, and he described how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. “Send word to James and to the brothers,” he said, and he left for another place.
chapters.zh: 彼得摆手，不要他们作声，就告诉他们主怎样领他出监；又说：「你们把这事告诉雅各和众弟兄。」于是出去，往别处去了。

chapters.en: At daybreak there was no small commotion among the soldiers as to what had become of Peter.
chapters.zh: 到了天亮，兵丁扰乱得很，不知道彼得往哪里去了。

chapters.en: After Herod had searched for him unsuccessfully, he examined the guards and ordered that they be executed. Then he went down from Judea to Caesarea and spent some time there.
chapters.zh: 希律找他，找不着，就审问看守的人，吩咐把他们拉去杀了。后来希律离开犹太，下凯撒利亚去，住在那里。

chapters.en: Now Herod was in a furious dispute with the people of Tyre and Sidon, and they convened before him. Having secured the support of Blastus, the king’s chamberlain, they asked for peace, because their region depended on the king’s country for food.
chapters.zh: 希律恼怒泰尔、西顿的人。他们那一带地方是从王的地土得粮，因此就讬了王的内侍臣伯拉斯都的情，一心来求和。

chapters.en: On the appointed day, Herod donned his royal robes, sat on his throne, and addressed the people.
chapters.zh: 希律在所定的日子，穿上朝服，坐在位上，对他们讲论一番。

chapters.en: And they began to shout, “This is the voice of a god, not a man!”
chapters.zh: 百姓喊着说：「这是神的声音，不是人的声音。」

chapters.en: Immediately, because Herod did not give glory to God, an angel of the Lord struck him down, and he was eaten by worms and died.
chapters.zh: 希律不归荣耀给上帝，所以主的使者立刻罚他，他被虫所咬，气就绝了。

chapters.en: But the word of God continued to spread and multiply.
chapters.zh: 上帝的道日见兴旺，越发广传。

chapters.en: When Barnabas and Saul had fulfilled their mission to Jerusalem, they returned, bringing with them John, also called Mark.
chapters.zh: 巴拿巴和扫罗办完了他们供给的事，就从耶路撒冷回来，带着称呼马可的约翰同去。

chapters.en: Now in the church at Antioch there were prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen (who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch), and Saul.
chapters.zh: 在安提阿的教会中，有几位先知和教师，就是巴拿巴和称呼尼结的西面、古利奈人路求，与分封之王希律同养的马念，并扫罗。

chapters.en: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, “Set apart for Me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.”
chapters.zh: 他们事奉主、禁食的时候，圣灵说：「要为我分派巴拿巴和扫罗，去做我召他们所做的工。」

chapters.en: And after they had fasted and prayed, they laid their hands on them and sent them off.
chapters.zh: 于是禁食祷告，按手在他们〔头〕上，就打发他们去了。

chapters.en: So Barnabas and Saul, sent forth by the Holy Spirit, went down to Seleucia and sailed from there to Cyprus.
chapters.zh: 他们既被圣灵差遣，就下到西流基，从那里坐船往塞浦路斯去。

chapters.en: When they arrived at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues. And John was with them as their helper.
chapters.zh: 到了撒拉米，就在犹太人各会堂里传讲上帝的道，也有约翰作他们的帮手。

chapters.en: They traveled through the whole island as far as Paphos, where they found a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet named Bar-Jesus,
chapters.zh: 经过全岛，直到帕弗，在那里遇见一个有法术、假充先知的犹太人，名叫巴‧耶稣。

chapters.en: an attendant of the proconsul, Sergius Paulus. The proconsul, a man of intelligence, summoned Barnabas and Saul because he wanted to hear the word of God.
chapters.zh: 这人常和方伯士求‧保罗同在。士求‧保罗是个通达人，他请了巴拿巴和扫罗来，要听上帝的道。

chapters.en: But Elymas the sorcerer (for that is what his name means) opposed them and tried to turn the proconsul from the faith.
chapters.zh: 只是那行法术的以吕马（这名翻出来就是行法术的意思）敌挡使徒，要叫方伯不信真道。

chapters.en: Then Saul, who was also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, looked directly at Elymas
chapters.zh: 扫罗又名保罗，被圣灵充满，定睛看他，

chapters.en: and said, “O child of the devil and enemy of all righteousness, you are full of all kinds of deceit and trickery! Will you never stop perverting the straight ways of the Lord?
chapters.zh: 说：「你这充满各样诡诈奸恶，魔鬼的儿子，众善的仇敌，你混乱主的正道还不止住吗？

chapters.en: Now look, the hand of the Lord is against you, and for a time you will be blind and unable to see the light of the sun.” Immediately mist and darkness came over him, and he groped about, seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
chapters.zh: 现在主的手加在你身上，你要瞎眼，暂且不见日光。」他的眼睛立刻昏蒙黑暗，四下里求人拉着手领他。

chapters.en: When the proconsul saw what had happened, he believed, for he was astonished at the teaching about the Lord.
chapters.zh: 方伯看见所做的事，很希奇主的道，就信了。

chapters.en: After setting sail from Paphos, Paul and his companions came to Perga in Pamphylia, where John left them to return to Jerusalem.
chapters.zh: 保罗和他的同人从帕弗开船，来到旁非利亚的别加，约翰就离开他们，回耶路撒冷去。

chapters.en: And from Perga, they traveled inland to Pisidian Antioch, where they entered the synagogue on the Sabbath and sat down.
chapters.zh: 他们离了别加往前行，来到彼西底的安提阿，在安息日进会堂坐下。

chapters.en: After the reading from the Law and the Prophets, the synagogue leaders sent word to them: “Brothers, if you have a word of encouragement for the people, please speak.”
chapters.zh: 读完了律法和先知〔的书〕，管会堂的叫人过去，对他们说：「二位兄台，若有什么劝勉众人的话，请说。」

chapters.en: Paul stood up, motioned with his hand, and began to speak: “Men of Israel and you Gentiles who fear God, listen to me!
chapters.zh: 保罗就站起来，举手，说：「以色列人和一切敬畏上帝的人，请听。

chapters.en: The God of the people of Israel chose our fathers. He made them into a great people during their stay in Egypt, and with an uplifted arm He led them out of that land.
chapters.zh: 这以色列民的上帝拣选了我们的祖宗，当民寄居埃及的时候抬举他们，用大能的手领他们出来；

chapters.en: He endured their conduct for about forty years in the wilderness.
chapters.zh: 又在旷野容忍〔注：或译：抚养〕他们，约有四十年。

chapters.en: And having vanquished seven nations in Canaan, He gave their land to His people as an inheritance.
chapters.zh: 既灭了迦南地七族的人，就把那地分给他们为业；

chapters.en:
All this took about 450 years.
After this, God gave them judges until the time of Samuel the prophet.
chapters.zh: 此后给他们设立士师，约有四百五十年，直到先知撒母耳的时候。

chapters.en: Then the people asked for a king, and God gave them Saul son of Kish, from the tribe of Benjamin, who ruled forty years.
chapters.zh: 后来他们求一个王，上帝就将便雅悯支派中基士的儿子扫罗，给他们作王四十年。

chapters.en: After removing Saul, He raised up David as their king and testified about him: ‘I have found David son of Jesse a man after My own heart; he will carry out My will in its entirety.’
chapters.zh: 既废了扫罗，就选立大卫作他们的王，又为他作见证说：『我寻得耶西的儿子大卫，他是合我心意的人，凡事要遵行我的旨意。』

chapters.en: From the descendants of this man, God has brought to Israel the Savior Jesus, as He promised.
chapters.zh: 从这人的后裔中，上帝已经照着所应许的，为以色列人立了一位救主，就是耶稣。

chapters.en: Before the arrival of Jesus, John preached a baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
chapters.zh: 在他没有出来以先，约翰向以色列众民宣讲悔改的洗礼。

chapters.en: As John was completing his course, he said, ‘Who do you suppose I am? I am not that One. But there is One coming after me whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.’
chapters.zh: 约翰将行尽他的程途说：『你们以为我是谁？我不是〔基督〕；只是有一位在我以后来的，我解他脚上的鞋带也是不配的。』

chapters.en: Brothers, children of Abraham, and you Gentiles who fear God, it is to us that this message of salvation has been sent.
chapters.zh: 「弟兄们，亚伯拉罕的子孙和你们中间敬畏上帝的人哪，这救世的道是传给我们的。

chapters.en: The people of Jerusalem and their rulers did not recognize Jesus, yet in condemning Him they fulfilled the words of the prophets that are read every Sabbath.
chapters.zh: 耶路撒冷居住的人和他们的官长，因为不认识基督，也不明白每安息日所读众先知的书，就把基督定了死罪，正应了先知的预言；

chapters.en: And though they found no ground for a death sentence, they asked Pilate to have Him executed.
chapters.zh: 虽然查不出他有当死的罪来，还是求彼拉多杀他；

chapters.en: When they had carried out all that was written about Him, they took Him down from the tree and laid Him in a tomb.
chapters.zh: 既成就了〔经上〕指着他所记的一切话，就把他从木头上取下来，放在坟墓里。

chapters.en: But God raised Him from the dead,
chapters.zh: 上帝却叫他从死里复活。

chapters.en: and for many days He was seen by those who had accompanied Him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They are now His witnesses to our people.
chapters.zh: 那从加利利同他上耶路撒冷的人多日看见他，这些人如今在民间是他的见证。

chapters.en: And now we proclaim to you the good news: What God promised our fathers
chapters.zh: 我们也报好信息给你们，就是那应许祖宗的话，

chapters.en:
He has fulfilled for us, their children, by raising up Jesus. As it is written in the second Psalm:
‘You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.’
chapters.zh: 上帝已经向我们这作儿女的应验，叫耶稣复活了。正如诗篇第二篇上记着说： 你是我的儿子， 我今日生你。

chapters.en:
In fact, God raised Him from the dead, never to see decay. As He has said:
‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings promised to David.’
chapters.zh: 论到上帝叫他从死里复活，不再归于朽坏，就这样说： 我必将〔所应许〕大卫那圣洁、 可靠的〔恩典〕赐给你们。

chapters.en:
So also, He says in another Psalm:
‘You will not let Your Holy One see decay.’
chapters.zh: 又有一篇上说： 你必不叫你的圣者见朽坏。

chapters.en: For when David had served God’s purpose in his own generation, he fell asleep. His body was buried with his fathers and saw decay.
chapters.zh: 「大卫在世的时候遵行了上帝的旨意，就睡了〔注：或译：大卫按上帝的旨意服事了他那一世的人，就睡了〕，归到他祖宗那里，已见朽坏；

chapters.en: But the One whom God raised from the dead did not see decay.
chapters.zh: 惟独上帝所复活的，他并未见朽坏。

chapters.en: Therefore let it be known to you, brothers, that through Jesus the forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you.
chapters.zh: 所以，弟兄们，你们当晓得：赦罪的道是由这人传给你们的。

chapters.en: Through Him everyone who believes is justified from everything from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.
chapters.zh: 你们靠摩西的律法，在一切不得称义的事上信靠这人，就都得称义了。

chapters.en: Watch out, then, that what was spoken by the prophets does not happen to you:
chapters.zh: 所以，你们务要小心，免得先知书上所说的临到你们。

chapters.en:
‘Look, you scoffers, wonder and perish! For I am doing a work in your days that you would never believe,
even if someone told you.’ ”
chapters.zh: 主〔说〕： 你们这轻慢的人要观看，要惊奇，要灭亡； 因为在你们的时候，我行一件事， 虽有人告诉你们， 你们总是不信。」

chapters.en: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people urged them to continue this message on the next Sabbath.
chapters.zh: 他们出会堂的时候，众人请他们到下安息日再讲这话给他们听。

chapters.en: After the synagogue was dismissed, many of the Jews and devout converts to Judaism followed Paul and Barnabas, who spoke to them and urged them to continue in the grace of God.
chapters.zh: 散会以后，犹太人和敬虔进犹太教的人多有跟从保罗、巴拿巴的。二人对他们讲道，劝他们务要恒久在上帝的恩中。

chapters.en: On the following Sabbath, nearly the whole city gathered to hear the word of the Lord.
chapters.zh: 到下安息日，合城的人几乎都来聚集，要听上帝的道。

chapters.en: But when the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy, and they blasphemously contradicted what Paul was saying.
chapters.zh: 但犹太人看见人这样多，就满心嫉妒，硬驳保罗所说的话，并且毁谤。

chapters.en: Then Paul and Barnabas answered them boldly: “It was necessary to speak the word of God to you first. But since you reject it and do not consider yourselves worthy of eternal life, we now turn to the Gentiles.
chapters.zh: 保罗和巴拿巴放胆说：「上帝的道先讲给你们原是应当的；只因你们弃绝这道，断定自己不配得永生，我们就转向外邦人去。

chapters.en:
For this is what the Lord has commanded us:
‘I have made you a light for the Gentiles, to bring salvation to the ends of the earth.’ ”
chapters.zh: 因为主曾这样吩咐我们说： 我已经立你作外邦人的光， 叫你施行救恩，直到地极。」

chapters.en: When the Gentiles heard this, they rejoiced and glorified the word of the Lord, and all who were appointed for eternal life believed.
chapters.zh: 外邦人听见这话，就欢喜了，赞美上帝的道；凡预定得永生的人都信了。

chapters.en: And the word of the Lord spread throughout that region.
chapters.zh: 于是主的道传遍了那一带地方。

chapters.en: The Jews, however, incited the religious women of prominence and the leading men of the city. They stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas and drove them out of their district.
chapters.zh: 但犹太人挑唆虔敬、尊贵的妇女和城内有名望的人，逼迫保罗、巴拿巴，将他们赶出境外。

chapters.en: So they shook the dust off their feet in protest against them and went to Iconium.
chapters.zh: 二人对着众人跺下脚上的尘土，就往以哥念去了。

chapters.en: And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
chapters.zh: 门徒满心喜乐，又被圣灵充满。

chapters.en: At Iconium, Paul and Barnabas went as usual into the Jewish synagogue, where they spoke so well that a great number of Jews and Greeks believed.
chapters.zh: 二人在以哥念同进犹太人的会堂，在那里讲的，叫犹太人和希腊人信的很多。

chapters.en: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles and poisoned their minds against the brothers.
chapters.zh: 但那不顺从的犹太人耸动外邦人，叫他们心里恼恨弟兄。

chapters.en: So Paul and Barnabas spent considerable time there, speaking boldly for the Lord, who affirmed the message of His grace by enabling them to perform signs and wonders.
chapters.zh: 二人在那里住了多日，倚靠主放胆讲道，主藉他们的手施行神迹奇事，证明他的恩道。

chapters.en: The people of the city were divided. Some sided with the Jews, and others with the apostles.
chapters.zh: 城里的众人就分了党，有附从犹太人的，有附从使徒的。

chapters.en: But when the Gentiles and Jews, together with their rulers, set out to mistreat and stone them,
chapters.zh: 那时，外邦人和犹太人，并他们的官长，一齐拥上来，要凌辱使徒，用石头打他们。

chapters.en: they found out about it and fled to the Lycaonian cities of Lystra and Derbe and to the surrounding region,
chapters.zh: 使徒知道了，就逃往吕高尼的路司得、特庇两个城和周围地方去，

chapters.en: where they continued to preach the gospel.
chapters.zh: 在那里传福音。

chapters.en: In Lystra there sat a man crippled in his feet, who was lame from birth and had never walked.
chapters.zh: 路司得城里坐着一个两脚无力的人，生来是瘸腿的，从来没有走过。

chapters.en: This man was listening to the words of Paul, who looked intently at him and saw that he had faith to be healed.
chapters.zh: 他听保罗讲道，保罗定睛看他，见他有信心，可得痊愈，

chapters.en: In a loud voice Paul called out, “Stand up on your feet!” And the man jumped up and began to walk.
chapters.zh: 就大声说：「你起来，两脚站直！」那人就跳起来，而且行走。

chapters.en: When the crowds saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices in the Lycaonian language: “The gods have come down to us in human form!”
chapters.zh: 众人看见保罗所做的事，就用吕高尼的话大声说：「有神藉着人形降临在我们中间了。」

chapters.en: Barnabas they called Zeus, and Paul they called Hermes, because he was the chief speaker.
chapters.zh: 于是称巴拿巴为宙斯，称保罗为希耳米，因为他说话领首。

chapters.en: The priest of Zeus, whose temple was just outside the city, brought bulls and wreaths to the city gates, hoping to offer a sacrifice along with the crowds.
chapters.zh: 有城外宙斯〔庙〕的祭司牵着牛，拿着花圈，来到门前，要同众人〔向使徒〕献祭。

chapters.en: But when the apostles Barnabas and Paul found out about this, they tore their clothes and rushed into the crowd, shouting,
chapters.zh: 巴拿巴、保罗二使徒听见，就撕开衣裳，跳进众人中间，喊着说：

chapters.en: “Men, why are you doing this? We too are only men, human like you. We are bringing you good news that you should turn from these worthless things to the living God, who made heaven and earth and sea and everything in them.
chapters.zh: 「诸君，为什么做这事呢？我们也是人，性情和你们一样。我们传福音给你们，是叫你们离弃这些虚妄，归向那创造天、地、海，和其中万物的永生上帝。

chapters.en: In past generations, He let all nations go their own way.
chapters.zh: 他在从前的世代，任凭万国各行其道；

chapters.en: Yet He has not left Himself without testimony to His goodness: He gives you rain from heaven and fruitful seasons, filling your hearts with food and gladness.”
chapters.zh: 然而为自己未尝不显出证据来，就如常施恩惠，从天降雨，赏赐丰年，叫你们饮食饱足，满心喜乐。」

chapters.en: Even with these words, Paul and Barnabas could hardly stop the crowds from sacrificing to them.
chapters.zh: 二人说了这些话，仅仅地拦住众人不献祭与他们。

chapters.en: Then some Jews arrived from Antioch and Iconium and won over the crowds. They stoned Paul and dragged him outside the city, presuming he was dead.
chapters.zh: 但有些犹太人从安提阿和以哥念来，挑唆众人，就用石头打保罗，以为他是死了，便拖到城外。

chapters.en: But after the disciples had gathered around him, he got up and went back into the city. And the next day he left with Barnabas for Derbe.
chapters.zh: 门徒正围着他，他就起来，走进城去。 第二天，同巴拿巴往特庇去，

chapters.en: They preached the gospel to that city and made many disciples. Then they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,
chapters.zh: 对那城里〔的人〕传了福音，使好些人作门徒，就回路司得、以哥念、安提阿去，

chapters.en: strengthening the souls of the disciples and encouraging them to continue in the faith. “We must endure many hardships to enter the kingdom of God,” they said.
chapters.zh: 坚固门徒的心，劝他们恒守所信的道；又说：「我们进入上帝的国，必须经历许多艰难。」

chapters.en: Paul and Barnabas appointed elders for them in each church, praying and fasting as they entrusted them to the Lord, in whom they had believed.
chapters.zh: 二人在各教会中选立了长老，又禁食祷告，就把他们交讬所信的主。

chapters.en: After passing through Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
chapters.zh: 二人经过彼西底，来到旁非利亚。

chapters.en: And when they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.
chapters.zh: 在别加讲了道，就下亚大利去，

chapters.en: From Attalia they sailed to Antioch, where they had been commended to the grace of God for the work they had just completed.
chapters.zh: 从那里坐船，往安提阿去。当初，他们被众人所讬、蒙上帝之恩、要办现在所做之工，就是在这地方。

chapters.en: When they arrived, they gathered the church together and reported all that God had done through them, and how He had opened the door of faith to the Gentiles.
chapters.zh: 到了那里，聚集了会众，就述说上帝藉他们所行的一切事，并上帝怎样为外邦人开了信道的门。

chapters.en: And they spent a long time there with the disciples.
chapters.zh: 二人就在那里同门徒住了多日。

chapters.en: Then some men came down from Judea and were teaching the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised according to the custom of Moses, you cannot be saved.”
chapters.zh: 有几个人从犹太下来，教训弟兄们说：「你们若不按摩西的规条受割礼，不能得救。」

chapters.en: And after engaging these men in sharp debate, Paul and Barnabas were appointed, along with some other believers, to go up to Jerusalem to see the apostles and elders about this question.
chapters.zh: 保罗、巴拿巴与他们大大地纷争辩论；〔众门徒〕就定规，叫保罗、巴拿巴和本会中几个人，为所辩论的，上耶路撒冷去见使徒和长老。

chapters.en: Sent on their way by the church, they passed through Phoenicia and Samaria, recounting the conversion of the Gentiles and bringing great joy to all the brothers.
chapters.zh: 于是教会送他们起行。他们经过腓尼基、撒马利亚，随处传说外邦人归主的事，叫众弟兄都甚欢喜。

chapters.en: On their arrival in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church and apostles and elders, to whom they reported all that God had done through them.
chapters.zh: 到了耶路撒冷，教会和使徒并长老都接待他们，他们就述说上帝同他们所行的一切事。

chapters.en: But some believers from the party of the Pharisees stood up and declared, “The Gentiles must be circumcised and required to obey the law of Moses.”
chapters.zh: 惟有几个信徒，是法利赛教门的人，起来说：「必须给外邦人行割礼，吩咐他们遵守摩西的律法。」

chapters.en: So the apostles and elders met to look into this matter.
chapters.zh: 使徒和长老聚会商议这事；

chapters.en: After much discussion, Peter got up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that in the early days God made a choice among you that the Gentiles would hear from my lips the message of the gospel and believe.
chapters.zh: 辩论已经多了，彼得就起来，说：「诸位弟兄，你们知道上帝早已在你们中间拣选了我，叫外邦人从我口中得听福音之道，而且相信。

chapters.en: And God, who knows the heart, showed His approval by giving the Holy Spirit to them, just as He did to us.
chapters.zh: 知道人心的上帝也为他们作了见证，赐圣灵给他们，正如给我们一样；

chapters.en: He made no distinction between us and them, for He cleansed their hearts by faith.
chapters.zh: 又藉着信洁净了他们的心，并不分他们我们。

chapters.en: Now then, why do you test God by placing on the necks of the disciples a yoke that neither we nor our fathers have been able to bear?
chapters.zh: 现在为什么试探上帝，要把我们祖宗和我们所不能负的轭放在门徒的颈项上呢？

chapters.en: On the contrary, we believe it is through the grace of the Lord Jesus that we are saved, just as they are.”
chapters.zh: 我们得救乃是因主耶稣的恩，和他们一样，这是我们所信的。」

chapters.en: The whole assembly fell silent as they listened to Barnabas and Paul describing the signs and wonders God had done among the Gentiles through them.
chapters.zh: 众人都默默无声，听巴拿巴和保罗述说上帝藉他们在外邦人中所行的神迹奇事。

chapters.en: When they had finished speaking, James declared, “Brothers, listen to me!
chapters.zh: 他们住了声，雅各就说：「诸位弟兄，请听我的话。

chapters.en: Simon has told us how God first visited the Gentiles to take from them a people to be His own.
chapters.zh: 方才西门述说上帝当初怎样眷顾外邦人，从他们中间选取百姓归于自己的名下；

chapters.en: The words of the prophets agree with this, as it is written:
chapters.zh: 众先知的话也与这意思相合。
