chapters.zh: 因此，我－保罗为你们外邦人作了基督耶稣被囚的，〔替你们祈祷〕〔注：此句是照对十四节所加〕。

chapters.en: Surely you have heard about the stewardship of God’s grace that was given to me for you,
chapters.zh: 谅必你们曾听见上帝赐恩给我，将关切你们的职分托付我，

chapters.en: that is, the mystery made known to me by revelation, as I have already written briefly.
chapters.zh: 用启示使我知道〔福音的〕奥祕，正如我以前略略写过的。

chapters.en: In reading this, then, you will be able to understand my insight into the mystery of Christ,
chapters.zh: 你们念了，就能晓得我深知基督的奥祕。

chapters.en: which was not made known to men in other generations as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to God’s holy apostles and prophets.
chapters.zh: 这奥祕在以前的世代没有叫人知道，像如今藉着圣灵启示他的圣使徒和先知一样。

chapters.en: This mystery is that through the gospel the Gentiles are fellow heirs, fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus.
chapters.zh: 〔这奥祕〕就是外邦人在基督耶稣里，藉着福音，得以同为后嗣，同为一体，同蒙应许。

chapters.en: I became a servant of this gospel by the gift of God’s grace, given me through the working of His power.
chapters.zh: 我作了这福音的执事，是照上帝的恩赐，这恩赐是照他运行的大能赐给我的。

chapters.en: Though I am less than the least of all the saints, this grace was given me: to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
chapters.zh: 我本来比众圣徒中最小的还小，然而他还赐我这恩典，叫我把基督那测不透的丰富传给外邦人，

chapters.en: and to illuminate for everyone the stewardship of this mystery, which for ages past was kept hidden in God, who created all things.
chapters.zh: 又使众人都明白，这历代以来隐藏在创造万物之上帝里的奥祕是如何安排的，

chapters.en: His purpose was that now, through the church, the manifold wisdom of God should be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms,
chapters.zh: 为要藉着教会使天上执政的、掌权的，现在得知上帝百般的智慧。

chapters.en: according to the eternal purpose that He accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.
chapters.zh: 这是照上帝从万世以前，在我们主基督耶稣里所定的旨意。

chapters.en: In Him and through faith in Him we may enter God’s presence with boldness and confidence.
chapters.zh: 我们因信耶稣，就在他里面放胆无惧，笃信不疑地来到上帝面前。

chapters.en: So I ask you not to be discouraged because of my sufferings for you, which are your glory.
chapters.zh: 所以，我求你们不要因我为你们所受的患难丧胆，这原是你们的荣耀。

chapters.en: ... for this reason I bow my knees before the Father,
chapters.zh: 因此，我在父面前屈膝，

chapters.en: from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name.
chapters.zh: （天上地上的各〔注：或译：全〕家，都是从他得名。）

chapters.en: I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being,
chapters.zh: 求他按着他丰盛的荣耀，藉着他的灵，叫你们心里的力量刚强起来，

chapters.en: so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith. Then you, being rooted and grounded in love,
chapters.zh: 使基督因你们的信，住在你们心里，叫你们的爱心有根有基，

chapters.en: will have power, together with all the saints, to comprehend the length and width and height and depth
chapters.zh: 能以和众圣徒一同明白基督的爱是何等长阔高深，

chapters.en: of the love of Christ, and to know this love that surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
chapters.zh: 并知道这爱是过于人所能测度的，便叫上帝一切所充满的，充满了你们。

chapters.en: Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,
chapters.zh: 上帝能照着运行在我们心里的大力充充足足地成就一切，超过我们所求所想的。

chapters.en: to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
chapters.zh: 但愿他在教会中，并在基督耶稣里，得着荣耀，直到世世代代，永永远远。阿们！

chapters.en: As a prisoner in the Lord, then, I urge you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling you have received:
chapters.zh: 我为主被囚的劝你们：既然蒙召，行事为人就当与蒙召的恩相称。

chapters.en: with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
chapters.zh: 凡事谦虚、温柔、忍耐，用爱心互相宽容，

chapters.en: and with diligence to preserve the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace.
chapters.zh: 用和平彼此联络，竭力保守〔圣〕灵所赐合而为一的心。

chapters.en: There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to one hope when you were called;
chapters.zh: 身体只有一个，〔圣〕灵只有一个，正如你们蒙召同有一个指望。

chapters.en: one Lord, one faith, one baptism;
chapters.zh: 一主，一信，一洗，

chapters.en: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.
chapters.zh: 一上帝，就是众人的父，超乎众人之上，贯乎众人之中，也住在众人之内。

chapters.en: Now to each one of us grace has been given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
chapters.zh: 我们各人蒙恩，都是照基督所量给各人的恩赐。

chapters.en:
This is why it says:
“When He ascended on high, He led captives away,
and gave gifts to men.”
chapters.zh: 所以〔经上〕说： 他升上高天的时候，掳掠了仇敌， 将各样的恩赐赏给人。

chapters.en: What does “He ascended” mean, except that He also descended to the lower parts of the earth?
chapters.zh: （既说升上，岂不是先降在地下吗？

chapters.en: He who descended is the very One who ascended above all the heavens, in order to fill all things.
chapters.zh: 那降下的，就是远升诸天之上要充满万有的。）

chapters.en: And it was He who gave some to be apostles, some to be prophets, some to be evangelists, and some to be pastors and teachers,
chapters.zh: 他所赐的，有使徒，有先知，有传福音的，有牧师和教师，

chapters.en: to equip the saints for works of ministry and to build up the body of Christ,
chapters.zh: 为要成全圣徒，各尽其职，建立基督的身体，

chapters.en: until we all reach unity in the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God, as we mature to the full measure of the stature of Christ.
chapters.zh: 直等到我们众人在真道上同归于一，认识上帝的儿子，得以长大成人，满有基督长成的身量，

chapters.en: Then we will no longer be infants, tossed about by the waves and carried around by every wind of teaching and by the clever cunning of men in their deceitful scheming.
chapters.zh: 使我们不再作小孩子，中了人的诡计和欺骗的法术，被一切异教之风摇动，飘来飘去，就随从各样的异端；

chapters.en: Instead, speaking the truth in love, we will in all things grow up into Christ Himself, who is the head.
chapters.zh: 惟用爱心说诚实话，凡事长进，连于元首基督，

chapters.en: From Him the whole body, fitted and held together by every supporting ligament, grows and builds itself up in love through the work of each individual part.
chapters.zh: 全身都靠他联络得合式，百节各按各职，照着各体的功用彼此相助，便叫身体渐渐增长，在爱中建立自己。

chapters.en: So I tell you this, and insist on it in the Lord, that you must no longer walk as the Gentiles do, in the futility of their thinking.
chapters.zh: 所以我说，且在主里确实地说，你们行事不要再像外邦人存虚妄的心行事。

chapters.en: They are darkened in their understanding and alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them due to the hardness of their hearts.
chapters.zh: 他们心地昏昧，与上帝所赐的生命隔绝了，都因自己无知，心里刚硬；

chapters.en: Having lost all sense of shame, they have given themselves over to sensuality for the practice of every kind of impurity, with a craving for more.
chapters.zh: 良心既然丧尽，就放纵私欲，贪行种种的污秽。

chapters.en: But this is not the way you came to know Christ.
chapters.zh: 你们学了基督，却不是这样。

chapters.en: Surely you heard of Him and were taught in Him—in keeping with the truth that is in Jesus—
chapters.zh: 如果你们听过他的道，领了他的教，学了他的真理，

chapters.en: to put off your former way of life, your old self, which is being corrupted by its deceitful desires;
chapters.zh: 就要脱去你们从前行为上的旧人，这旧人是因私欲的迷惑渐渐变坏的；

chapters.en: to be renewed in the spirit of your minds;
chapters.zh: 又要将你们的心志改换一新，

chapters.en: and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.
chapters.zh: 并且穿上新人；这新人是照着上帝〔的形像〕造的，有真理的仁义和圣洁。

chapters.en: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are all members of one another.
chapters.zh: 所以，你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话，因为我们是互相为肢体。

chapters.en: “Be angry, yet do not sin.” Do not let the sun set upon your anger,
chapters.zh: 生气却不要犯罪；不可含怒到日落，

chapters.en: and do not give the devil a foothold.
chapters.zh: 也不可给魔鬼留地步。

chapters.en: He who has been stealing must steal no longer, but must work, doing good with his own hands, that he may have something to share with the one in need.
chapters.zh: 从前偷窃的，不要再偷；总要劳力，亲手做正经事，就可有〔余〕分给那缺少的人。

chapters.en: Let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.
chapters.zh: 污秽的言语一句不可出口，只要随事说造就人的好话，叫听见的人得益处。

chapters.en: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
chapters.zh: 不要叫上帝的圣灵担忧；你们原是受了他的印记，等候得赎的日子来到。

chapters.en: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, outcry and slander, along with every form of malice.
chapters.zh: 一切苦毒、恼恨、忿怒、嚷闹、毁谤，并一切的恶毒〔注：或译：阴毒〕，都当从你们中间除掉；

chapters.en: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.
chapters.zh: 并要以恩慈相待，存怜悯的心，彼此饶恕，正如上帝在基督里饶恕了你们一样。

chapters.en: Be imitators of God, therefore, as beloved children,
chapters.zh: 所以，你们该效法上帝，好像蒙慈爱的儿女一样。

chapters.en: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.
chapters.zh: 也要凭爱心行事，正如基督爱我们，为我们舍了自己，当作馨香的供物和祭物，献与上帝。

chapters.en: But among you, as is proper among the saints, there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity, or of greed.
chapters.zh: 至于淫乱并一切污秽，或是贪婪，在你们中间连提都不可，方合圣徒的体统。

chapters.en: Nor should there be obscenity, foolish talk, or crude joking, which are out of character, but rather thanksgiving.
chapters.zh: 淫词、妄语，和戏笑的话都不相宜；总要说感谢的话。

chapters.en: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater) has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
chapters.zh: 因为你们确实地知道，无论是淫乱的，是污秽的，是有贪心的，在基督和上帝的国里都是无分的。有贪心的，就与拜偶像的一样。

chapters.en: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of such things the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.
chapters.zh: 不要被人虚浮的话欺哄；因这些事，上帝的忿怒必临到那悖逆之子。

chapters.en: Therefore do not be partakers with them.
chapters.zh: 所以，你们不要与他们同伙。

chapters.en: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
chapters.zh: 从前你们是暗昧的，但如今在主里面是光明的，行事为人就当像光明的子女。

chapters.en: for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness, and truth.
chapters.zh: 光明所结的果子就是一切良善、公义、诚实。

chapters.en: Test and prove what pleases the Lord.
chapters.zh: 总要察验何为主所喜悦的事。

chapters.en: Have no fellowship with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.
chapters.zh: 那暗昧无益的事，不要与人同行，倒要责备〔行这事的人〕；

chapters.en: For it is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do in secret.
chapters.zh: 因为他们暗中所行的，就是提起来也是可耻的。

chapters.en: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible, for everything that is illuminated becomes a light itself.
chapters.zh: 凡事受了责备，就被光显明出来，因为一切能显明的就是光。

chapters.en:
So it is said:
“Wake up, O sleeper, rise up from the dead,
and Christ will shine on you.”
chapters.zh: 所以〔主〕说： 你这睡着的人当醒过来， 从死里复活！ 基督就要光照你了。

chapters.en: Pay careful attention, then, to how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,
chapters.zh: 你们要谨慎行事，不要像愚昧人，当像智慧人。

chapters.en: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
chapters.zh: 要爱惜光阴，因为现今的世代邪恶。

chapters.en: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord’s will is.
chapters.zh: 不要作糊涂人，要明白主的旨意如何。

chapters.en: Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to reckless indiscretion. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.
chapters.zh: 不要醉酒，酒能使人放荡；乃要被〔圣〕灵充满。

chapters.en: Speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord,
chapters.zh: 当用诗章、颂词、灵歌彼此对说，口唱心和地赞美主。

chapters.en: always giving thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 凡事要奉我们主耶稣基督的名常常感谢父上帝。

chapters.en: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.
chapters.zh: 又当存敬畏基督的心，彼此顺服。

chapters.en: Wives, submit to your husbands as to the Lord.
chapters.zh: 你们作妻子的，〔当顺服〕自己的丈夫，如同〔顺服〕主。

chapters.en: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, His body, of which He is the Savior.
chapters.zh: 因为丈夫是妻子的头，如同基督是教会的头；他又是〔教会〕全体的救主。

chapters.en: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.
chapters.zh: 教会怎样顺服基督，妻子也要怎样凡事顺服丈夫。

chapters.en: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her
chapters.zh: 你们作丈夫的，要爱你们的妻子，正如基督爱教会，为教会舍己。

chapters.en: to sanctify her, cleansing her by the washing with water through the word,
chapters.zh: 要用水藉着道把教会洗净，成为圣洁，

chapters.en: and to present her to Himself as a glorious church, without stain or wrinkle or any such blemish, but holy and blameless.
chapters.zh: 可以献给自己，作个荣耀的教会，毫无玷污、皱纹等类的病，乃是圣洁没有瑕疵的。

chapters.en: In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.
chapters.zh: 丈夫也当照样爱妻子，如同爱自己的身子；爱妻子便是爱自己了。

chapters.en: Indeed, no one ever hated his own body, but he nourishes and cherishes it, just as Christ does the church.
chapters.zh: 从来没有人恨恶自己的身子，总是保养顾惜，正像基督待教会一样，

chapters.en: For we are members of His body.
chapters.zh: 因我们是他身上的肢体〔注：有古卷加：就是他的骨他的肉〕。

chapters.en: “For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.”
chapters.zh: 为这个缘故，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

chapters.en: This mystery is profound, but I am speaking about Christ and the church.
chapters.zh: 这是极大的奥祕，但我是指着基督和教会说的。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
chapters.zh: 然而，你们各人都当爱妻子，如同爱自己一样。妻子也当敬重她的丈夫。

chapters.en: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
chapters.zh: 你们作儿女的，要在主里听从父母，这是理所当然的。

chapters.en: “Honor your father and mother” (which is the first commandment with a promise),
“that it may go well with you and that you may have a long life on the earth.”
chapters.zh: 「要孝敬父母，使你得福，在世长寿。」这是第一条带应许的诫命。

chapters.en: Fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath; instead, bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
chapters.zh: 你们作父亲的，不要惹儿女的气，只要照着主的教训和警戒养育他们。

chapters.en: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and fear and sincerity of heart, just as you would obey Christ.
chapters.zh: 你们作仆人的，要惧怕战兢，用诚实的心听从你们肉身的主人，好像听从基督一般。

chapters.en: And do this not only to please them while they are watching, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from your heart.
chapters.zh: 不要只在眼前事奉，像是讨人喜欢的，要像基督的仆人，从心里遵行上帝的旨意。

chapters.en: Serve with good will, as to the Lord and not to men,
chapters.zh: 甘心事奉，好像服事主，不像服事人。

chapters.en: because you know that the Lord will reward each one for whatever good he does, whether he is slave or free.
chapters.zh: 因为晓得各人所行的善事，不论是为奴的，是自主的，都必按所行的得主的赏赐。

chapters.en: And masters, do the same for your slaves. Give up your use of threats, because you know that He who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no favoritism with Him.
chapters.zh: 你们作主人的，待仆人也是一理，不要威吓他们。因为知道，他们和你们同有一位主在天上；他并不偏待人。

chapters.en: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.
chapters.zh: 我还有末了的话：你们要靠着主，倚赖他的大能大力作刚强的人。

chapters.en: Put on the full armor of God, so that you can make your stand against the devil’s schemes.
chapters.zh: 要穿戴上帝〔所赐〕的全副军装，就能抵挡魔鬼的诡计。

chapters.en: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this world’s darkness, and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
chapters.zh: 因我们并不是与属血气的争战〔注：原文是摔跤；下同〕，乃是与那些执政的、掌权的、管辖这幽暗世界的，以及天空属灵气的恶魔争战。

chapters.en: Therefore take up the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you will be able to stand your ground, and having done everything, to stand.
chapters.zh: 所以，要拿起上帝〔所赐〕的全副军装，好在磨难的日子抵挡〔仇敌〕，并且成就了一切，还能站立得住。

chapters.en: Stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness arrayed,
chapters.zh: 所以要站稳了，用真理当作带子束腰，用公义当作护心镜遮胸，

chapters.en: and with your feet fitted with the readiness of the gospel of peace.
chapters.zh: 又用平安的福音当作预备走路的鞋穿在脚上。

chapters.en: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
chapters.zh: 此外，又拿着信德当作盾牌，可以灭尽那恶者一切的火箭；

chapters.en: And take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
chapters.zh: 并戴上救恩的头盔，拿着〔圣〕灵的宝剑，就是上帝的道；

chapters.en: Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition. To this end, stay alert with all perseverance in your prayers for all the saints.
chapters.zh: 靠着〔圣〕灵，随时多方祷告祈求；并要在此警醒不倦，为众圣徒祈求，

chapters.en: Pray also for me, that whenever I open my mouth, words may be given me so that I will boldly make known the mystery of the gospel,
chapters.zh: 也为我祈求，使我得着口才，能以放胆开口讲明福音的奥祕，

chapters.en: for which I am an ambassador in chains. Pray that I may proclaim it fearlessly, as I should.
chapters.zh: （我为这福音的奥祕作了带锁鍊的使者，）并使我照着当尽的本分放胆讲论。

chapters.en: Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything, so that you also may know about me and what I am doing.
chapters.zh: 今有所亲爱、忠心事奉主的兄弟推基古，他要把我的事情，并我的景况如何全告诉你们，叫你们知道。

chapters.en: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts.
chapters.zh: 我特意打发他到你们那里去，好叫你们知道我们的光景，又叫他安慰你们的心。

chapters.en: Peace to the brothers and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 愿平安、仁爱、信心从父上帝和主耶稣基督归与弟兄们！

chapters.en: Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.
chapters.zh: 并愿所有诚心爱我们主耶稣基督的人都蒙恩惠！

chapters.en:
Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus,
To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:
chapters.zh: 基督耶稣的仆人保罗和提摩太写信给凡住腓立比、在基督耶稣里的众圣徒，和诸位监督，诸位执事。

chapters.en: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 愿恩惠、平安从上帝我们的父并主耶稣基督归与你们！

chapters.en: I thank my God every time I remember you.
chapters.zh: 我每逢想念你们，就感谢我的上帝；

chapters.en: In every prayer for all of you, I always pray with joy,
chapters.zh: 每逢为你们众人祈求的时候，常是欢欢喜喜地祈求。

chapters.en: because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,
chapters.zh: 因为从头一天直到如今，你们是同心合意地兴旺福音。

chapters.en: being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
chapters.zh: 我深信那在你们心里动了善工的，必成全这工，直到耶稣基督的日子。

chapters.en: It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, since I have you in my heart. For in my chains and in my defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partners in grace with me.
chapters.zh: 我为你们众人有这样的意念，原是应当的；因你们常在我心里，无论我是在捆锁之中，是辩明证实福音的时候，你们都与我一同得恩。

chapters.en: God is my witness how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.
chapters.zh: 我体会基督耶稣的心肠，切切地想念你们众人；这是上帝可以给我作见证的。

chapters.en: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight,
chapters.zh: 我所祷告的，就是要你们的爱心在知识和各样见识上多而又多，

chapters.en: so that you may be able to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,
chapters.zh: 使你们能分别是非〔注：或译：喜爱那美好的事〕，作诚实无过的人，直到基督的日子；

chapters.en: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
chapters.zh: 并靠着耶稣基督结满了仁义的果子，叫荣耀称赞归与上帝。

chapters.en: Now I want you to know, brothers, that my circumstances have actually served to advance the gospel.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，我愿意你们知道，我所遭遇的事更是叫福音兴旺，

chapters.en: As a result, it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ.
chapters.zh: 以致我受的捆锁在御营全军和其余的人中，已经显明是为基督的缘故。

chapters.en: And most of the brothers, confident in the Lord by my chains, now dare more greatly to speak the word without fear.
chapters.zh: 并且那在主里的弟兄多半因我受的捆锁就笃信不疑，越发放胆传上帝的道，无所惧怕。

chapters.en: It is true that some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry, but others out of goodwill.
chapters.zh: 有的传基督是出于嫉妒纷争，也有的是出于好意。

chapters.en: The latter do so in love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel.
chapters.zh: 这一等是出于爱心，知道我是为辩明福音设立的；

chapters.en: The former, however, preach Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing that they can add to the distress of my chains.
chapters.zh: 那一等传基督是出于结党，并不诚实，意思要加增我捆锁的苦楚。

chapters.en: What then is the issue? Just this: that in every way, whether by false motives or true, Christ is preached. And in this I rejoice. Yes, and I will continue to rejoice,
chapters.zh: 这有何妨呢？或是假意，或是真心，无论怎样，基督究竟被传开了。为此，我就欢喜，并且还要欢喜；

chapters.en: because I know that through your prayers and the provision of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, my distress will turn out for my deliverance.
chapters.zh: 因为我知道，这事藉着你们的祈祷和耶稣基督之灵的帮助，终必叫我得救。

chapters.en: I eagerly expect and hope that I will in no way be ashamed, but will have complete boldness so that now as always Christ will be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death.
chapters.zh: 照着我所切慕、所盼望的，没有一事叫我羞愧。只要凡事放胆，无论是生是死，总叫基督在我身上照常显大。

chapters.en: For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
chapters.zh: 因我活着就是基督，我死了就有益处。

chapters.en: But if I go on living in the body, this will mean fruitful labor for me. So what shall I choose? I do not know.
chapters.zh: 但我在肉身活着，若成就我工夫的果子，我就不知道该挑选什么。

chapters.en: I am torn between the two. I desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better indeed.
chapters.zh: 我正在两难之间，情愿离世与基督同在，因为这是好得无比的。

chapters.en: But it is more necessary for you that I remain in the body.
chapters.zh: 然而，我在肉身活着，为你们更是要紧的。

chapters.en: Convinced of this, I know that I will remain and will continue with all of you for your progress and joy in the faith,
chapters.zh: 我既然这样深信，就知道仍要住在世间，且与你们众人同住，使你们在所信的道上又长进又喜乐，

chapters.en: so that through my coming to you again your exultation in Christ Jesus will resound on account of me.
chapters.zh: 叫你们在基督耶稣里的欢乐，因我再到你们那里去，就越发加增。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, conduct yourselves in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or only hear about you in my absence, I will know that you stand firm in one spirit, contending together as one for the faith of the gospel,
chapters.zh: 只要你们行事为人与基督的福音相称，叫我或来见你们，或不在你们那里，可以听见你们的景况，知道你们同有一个心志，站立得稳，为所信的福音齐心努力。

chapters.en: without being frightened in any way by those who oppose you. This is a clear sign of their destruction but of your salvation, and it is from God.
chapters.zh: 凡事不怕敌人的惊吓，这是证明他们沉沦，你们得救都是出于上帝。

chapters.en: For it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer for Him,
chapters.zh: 因为你们蒙恩，不但得以信服基督，并要为他受苦。

chapters.en: since you are encountering the same struggle you saw I had, and now hear that I still have.
chapters.zh: 你们的争战，就与你们在我身上从前所看见、现在所听见的一样。

chapters.en: Therefore if you have any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort from His love, if any fellowship with the Spirit, if any affection and compassion,
chapters.zh: 所以，在基督里若有什么劝勉，爱心有什么安慰，〔圣〕灵有什么交通，〔心中〕有什么慈悲怜悯，

chapters.en: then make my joy complete by being like-minded, having the same love, being united in spirit and purpose.
chapters.zh: 你们就要意念相同，爱心相同，有一样的心思，有一样的意念，使我的喜乐可以满足。

chapters.en: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or empty pride, but in humility consider others more important than yourselves.
chapters.zh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。

chapters.en: Each of you should look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others.
chapters.zh: 各人不要单顾自己的事，也要顾别人的事。

chapters.en: Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus:
chapters.zh: 你们当以基督耶稣的心为心：

chapters.en:
Who, existing in the form of God, did not consider equality with God
something to be grasped,
chapters.zh: 他本有上帝的形像， 不以自己与上帝同等为强夺的；

chapters.en:
but emptied Himself, taking the form of a servant,
being made in human likeness.
chapters.zh: 反倒虚己， 取了奴仆的形像， 成为人的样式；

chapters.en: And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself and became obedient to death— even death on a cross.
chapters.zh: 既有人的样子，就自己卑微， 存心顺服，以至于死， 且死在十字架上。

chapters.en: Therefore God exalted Him to the highest place and gave Him the name above all names,
chapters.zh: 所以，上帝将他升为至高， 又赐给他那超乎万名之上的名，

chapters.en: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,
chapters.zh: 叫一切在天上的、地上的，和地底下的， 因耶稣的名无不屈膝，

chapters.en: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
chapters.zh: 无不口称「耶稣基督为主」， 使荣耀归与父上帝。

chapters.en: Therefore, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now even more in my absence, continue to work out your salvation with fear and trembling.
chapters.zh: 这样看来，我亲爱的〔弟兄〕，你们既是常顺服的，不但我在你们那里，就是我如今不在你们那里，更是顺服的，就当恐惧战兢做成你们得救的工夫。

chapters.en: For it is God who works in you to will and to act on behalf of His good purpose.
chapters.zh: 因为你们立志行事都是上帝在你们心里运行，为要成就他的美意。

chapters.en: Do everything without complaining or arguing,
chapters.zh: 凡所行的，都不要发怨言，起争论，

chapters.en: so that you may be blameless and pure, children of God without fault in a crooked and perverse generation, in which you shine as lights in the world
chapters.zh: 使你们无可指摘，诚实无伪，在这弯曲悖谬的世代作上帝无瑕疵的儿女。你们显在这世代中，好像明光照耀，

chapters.en: as you hold forth the word of life, in order that I may boast on the day of Christ that I did not run or labor in vain.
chapters.zh: 将生命的道表明出来，叫我在基督的日子好夸我没有空跑，也没有徒劳。

chapters.en: But even if I am being poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with all of you.
chapters.zh: 我以你们的信心为供献的祭物，我若被浇奠在其上，也是喜乐，并且与你们众人一同喜乐。

chapters.en: So you too should be glad and rejoice with me.
chapters.zh: 你们也要照样喜乐，并且与我一同喜乐。

chapters.en: Now I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered when I learn how you are doing.
chapters.zh: 我靠主耶稣指望快打发提摩太去见你们，叫我知道你们的事，心里就得着安慰。

chapters.en: I have nobody else like him who will genuinely care for your needs.
chapters.zh: 因为我没有别人与我同心，实在挂念你们的事。

chapters.en: For all the others look after their own interests, not those of Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 别人都求自己的事，并不求耶稣基督的事。

chapters.en: But you know Timothy’s proven worth, that as a child with his father he has served with me to advance the gospel.
chapters.zh: 但你们知道提摩太的明证；他兴旺福音，与我同劳，待我像儿子待父亲一样。

chapters.en: So I hope to send him as soon as I see what happens with me.
chapters.zh: 所以，我一看出我的事要怎样了结，就盼望立刻打发他去；

chapters.en: And I trust in the Lord that I myself will come soon.
chapters.zh: 但我靠着主自信我也必快去。

chapters.en: But I thought it necessary to send back to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, and fellow soldier, who is also your messenger and minister to my needs.
chapters.zh: 然而，我想必须打发以巴弗提到你们那里去。他是我的兄弟，与我一同做工，一同当兵，是你们所差遣的，也是供给我需用的。

chapters.en: For he has been longing for all of you and is distressed because you heard he was ill.
chapters.zh: 他很想念你们众人，并且极其难过，因为你们听见他病了。

chapters.en: He was sick indeed, nearly unto death. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, to spare me sorrow upon sorrow.
chapters.zh: 他实在是病了，几乎要死；然而上帝怜恤他，不但怜恤他，也怜恤我，免得我忧上加忧。

chapters.en: Therefore I am all the more eager to send him, so that when you see him again you may rejoice, and I may be less anxious.
chapters.zh: 所以我越发急速打发他去，叫你们再见他，就可以喜乐，我也可以少些忧愁。

chapters.en: Welcome him in the Lord with great joy, and honor men like him,
chapters.zh: 故此，你们要在主里欢欢乐乐地接待他，而且要尊重这样的人；

chapters.en: because he nearly died for the work of Christ, risking his life to make up for your deficit of service to me.
chapters.zh: 因他为做基督的工夫，几乎至死，不顾性命，要补足你们供给我的不及之处。

chapters.en: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. It is no trouble for me to write the same things to you again, and it is a safeguard for you.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，我还有话说，你们要靠主喜乐。我把这话再写给你们，于我并不为难，于你们却是妥当。

chapters.en: Watch out for those dogs, those workers of evil, those mutilators of the flesh!
chapters.zh: 应当防备犬类，防备作恶的，防备妄自行割的。

chapters.en: For it is we who are the circumcision, we who worship by the Spirit of God, who glory in Christ Jesus, and who put no confidence in the flesh—
chapters.zh: 因为〔真〕受割礼的，乃是我们这以上帝的灵敬拜、在基督耶稣里夸口、不靠着肉体的。

chapters.en:
though I myself could have such confidence.
If anyone else thinks he has grounds for confidence in the flesh, I have more:
chapters.zh: 其实，我也可以靠肉体；若是别人想他可以靠肉体，我更可以靠着了。

chapters.en: circumcised on the eighth day, of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin; a Hebrew of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;
chapters.zh: 我第八天受割礼；我是以色列族、便雅悯支派的人，是希伯来人所生的希伯来人。就律法说，我是法利赛人；

chapters.en: as to zeal, persecuting the church; as to righteousness in the law, faultless.
chapters.zh: 就热心说，我是逼迫教会的；就律法上的义说，我是无可指摘的。

chapters.en: But whatever was gain to me I count as loss for the sake of Christ.
chapters.zh: 只是我先前以为与我有益的，我现在因基督都当作有损的。

chapters.en: More than that, I count all things as loss compared to the surpassing excellence of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have lost all things. I consider them rubbish, that I may gain Christ
chapters.zh: 不但如此，我也将万事当作有损的，因我以认识我主基督耶稣为至宝。我为他已经丢弃万事，看作粪土，为要得着基督；

chapters.en: and be found in Him, not having my own righteousness from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness from God on the basis of faith.
chapters.zh: 并且得以在他里面，不是有自己因律法而得的义，乃是有信基督的义，就是因信上帝而来的义，

chapters.en: I want to know Christ and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings, being conformed to Him in His death,
chapters.zh: 使我认识基督，晓得他复活的大能，并且晓得和他一同受苦，效法他的死，

chapters.en: and so, somehow, to attain to the resurrection from the dead.
chapters.zh: 或者我也得以从死里复活。

chapters.en: Not that I have already obtained all this, or have already been made perfect, but I press on to take hold of that for which Christ Jesus took hold of me.
chapters.zh: 这不是说我已经得着了，已经完全了；我乃是竭力追求，或者可以得着基督耶稣所以得着我的〔注：所以得着我的：或译所要我得的〕。

chapters.en: Brothers, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead,
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，我不是以为自己已经得着了；我只有一件事，就是忘记背后，努力面前的，

chapters.en: I press on toward the goal to win the prize of God’s heavenly calling in Christ Jesus.
chapters.zh: 向着标竿直跑，要得上帝在基督耶稣里从上面召我来得的奖赏。

chapters.en: All of us who are mature should embrace this point of view. And if you think differently about some issue, God will reveal this to you as well.
chapters.zh: 所以我们中间，凡是完全人总要存这样的心；若在什么事上存别样的心，上帝也必以此指示你们。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, we must live up to what we have already attained.
chapters.zh: 然而，我们到了什么地步，就当照着什么地步行。

chapters.en: Join one another in following my example, brothers, and carefully observe those who walk according to the pattern we set for you.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，你们要一同效法我，也当留意看那些照我们榜样行的人。

chapters.en: For as I have often told you before, and now say again even with tears: Many live as enemies of the cross of Christ.
chapters.zh: 因为有许多人行事是基督十字架的仇敌。我屡次告诉你们，现在又流泪地告诉你们：

chapters.en: Their end is destruction, their god is their belly, and their glory is in their shame. Their minds are set on earthly things.
chapters.zh: 他们的结局就是沉沦；他们的神就是自己的肚腹。他们以自己的羞辱为荣耀，专以地上的事为念。

chapters.en: But our citizenship is in heaven, and we eagerly await a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ,
chapters.zh: 我们却是天上的国民，并且等候救主，就是主耶稣基督从天上降临。

chapters.en: who, by the power that enables Him to subject all things to Himself, will transform our lowly bodies to be like His glorious body.
chapters.zh: 他要按着那能叫万有归服自己的大能，将我们这卑贱的身体改变形状，和他自己荣耀的身体相似。

chapters.en: Therefore, my brothers, whom I love and long for, my joy and crown, that is how you must stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.
chapters.zh: 我所亲爱、所想念的弟兄们，你们就是我的喜乐，我的冠冕。我亲爱的〔弟兄〕，你们应当靠主站立得稳。

chapters.en: I urge Euodia and Syntyche to agree with each other in the Lord.
chapters.zh: 我劝友阿蝶和循都基，要在主里同心。

chapters.en: Yes, and I ask you, my true yokefellow, to help these women who have contended at my side for the gospel, along with Clement and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the Book of Life.
chapters.zh: 我也求你这真实同负一轭的，帮助这两个女人，因为她们在福音上曾与我一同劳苦；还有革利免，并其余和我一同做工的，他们的名字都在生命册上。

chapters.en: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!
chapters.zh: 你们要靠主常常喜乐。我再说，你们要喜乐。

chapters.en: Let your gentleness be apparent to all. The Lord is near.
chapters.zh: 当叫众人知道你们谦让的心。主已经近了。

chapters.en: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
chapters.zh: 应当一无挂虑，只要凡事藉着祷告、祈求，和感谢，将你们所要的告诉上帝。

chapters.en: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
chapters.zh: 上帝所赐、出人意外的平安必在基督耶稣里保守你们的心怀意念。

chapters.en: Finally, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable—if anything is excellent or praiseworthy—think on these things.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，我还有未尽的话：凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，若有什么德行，若有什么称赞，这些事你们都要思念。

chapters.en: Whatever you have learned or received or heard from me, or seen in me, put it into practice. And the God of peace will be with you.
chapters.zh: 你们在我身上所学习的，所领受的，所听见的，所看见的，这些事你们都要去行，赐平安的上帝就必与你们同在。

chapters.en: Now I rejoice greatly in the Lord that at last you have revived your concern for me. You were indeed concerned, but you had no opportunity to show it.
chapters.zh: 我靠主大大地喜乐，因为你们思念我的心如今又发生；你们向来就思念我，只是没得机会。

chapters.en: I am not saying this out of need, for I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances.
chapters.zh: 我并不是因缺乏说这话；我无论在什么景况都可以知足，这是我已经学会了。

chapters.en: I know how to live humbly, and I know how to abound. In any and every situation I have learned the secret of being filled and being hungry, of having plenty and having need.
chapters.zh: 我知道怎样处卑贱，也知道怎样处丰富；或饱足，或饥饿；或有余，或缺乏，随事随在，我都得了秘诀。

chapters.en: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
chapters.zh: 我靠着那加给我力量的，凡事都能做。

chapters.en: Nevertheless, you have done well to share in my affliction.
chapters.zh: 然而，你们和我同受患难原是美事。

chapters.en: And as you Philippians know, in the early days of the gospel, when I left Macedonia, no church but you partnered with me in the matter of giving and receiving.
chapters.zh: 腓立比人哪，你们也知道我初传福音离了马其顿的时候，论到授受的事，除了你们以外，并没有别的教会供给我。

chapters.en: For even while I was in Thessalonica, you provided for my needs again and again.
chapters.zh: 就是我在帖撒罗尼迦，你们也一次两次地打发人供给我的需用。

chapters.en: Not that I am seeking a gift, but I am looking for the fruit that may be credited to your account.
chapters.zh: 我并不求什么餽送，所求的就是你们的果子渐渐增多，归在你们的帐上。

chapters.en: I have all I need and more, now that I have received your gifts from Epaphroditus. They are a fragrant offering, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.
chapters.zh: 但我样样都有，并且有余。我已经充足，因我从以巴弗提受了你们的餽送，当作极美的香气，为上帝所收纳、所喜悦的祭物。

chapters.en: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
chapters.zh: 我的上帝必照他荣耀的丰富，在基督耶稣里，使你们一切所需用的都充足。

chapters.en: To our God and Father be glory forever and ever. Amen.
chapters.zh: 愿荣耀归给我们的父上帝，直到永永远远。阿们！

chapters.en:
Greet all the saints in Christ Jesus.
The brothers who are with me send you greetings.
chapters.zh: 请问在基督耶稣里的各位圣徒安。在我这里的众弟兄都问你们安。

chapters.en: All the saints send you greetings, especially those from the household of Caesar.
chapters.zh: 众圣徒都问你们安。在凯撒家里的人特特地问你们安。

chapters.en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
chapters.zh: 愿主耶稣基督的恩〔常〕在你们心里！

chapters.en: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
chapters.zh: 奉上帝旨意，作基督耶稣使徒的保罗和兄弟提摩太

chapters.en:
To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae:
Grace and peace to you from God our Father.
chapters.zh: 写信给歌罗西的圣徒，在基督里有忠心的弟兄。愿恩惠、平安从上帝我们的父归与你们！

chapters.en: We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you,
chapters.zh: 我们感谢上帝我们主耶稣基督的父，常常为你们祷告；

chapters.en: because we have heard about your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all the saints—
chapters.zh: 因听见你们在基督耶稣里的信心，并向众圣徒的爱心，

chapters.en: the faith and love proceeding from the hope stored up for you in heaven, of which you have already heard in the word of truth, the gospel
chapters.zh: 是为那给你们存在天上的盼望；这盼望就是你们从前在福音真理的道上所听见的。

chapters.en:
that has come to you.
All over the world this gospel is bearing fruit and growing, just as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood the grace of God.
chapters.zh: 这福音传到你们那里，也传到普天之下，并且结果，增长，如同在你们中间，自从你们听见福音，真知道上帝恩惠的日子一样。

chapters.en: You learned it from Epaphras, our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ on our behalf,
chapters.zh: 正如你们从我们所亲爱、一同作仆人的以巴弗所学的。他为我们〔注：有古卷：你们〕作了基督忠心的执事，

chapters.en: and who also informed us of your love in the Spirit.
chapters.zh: 也把你们因〔圣〕灵所存的爱心告诉了我们。

chapters.en: For this reason, since the day we heard about you, we have not stopped praying for you and asking God to fill you with the knowledge of His will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
chapters.zh: 因此，我们自从听见的日子，也就为你们不住地祷告祈求，愿你们在一切属灵的智慧悟性上，满心知道上帝的旨意；

chapters.en: so that you may walk in a manner worthy of the Lord and may please Him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God,
chapters.zh: 好叫你们行事为人对得起主，凡事蒙他喜悦，在一切善事上结果子，渐渐地多知道上帝；

chapters.en: being strengthened with all power according to His glorious might so that you may have full endurance and patience, and joyfully
chapters.zh: 照他荣耀的权能，得以在各样的力上加力，好叫你们凡事欢欢喜喜地忍耐宽容；

chapters.en: giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified you to share in the inheritance of the saints in the light.
chapters.zh: 又感谢父，叫我们能与众圣徒在光明中同得基业。

chapters.en: He has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of His beloved Son,
chapters.zh: 他救了我们脱离黑暗的权势，把我们迁到他爱子的国里；

chapters.en: in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.
chapters.zh: 我们在爱子里得蒙救赎，罪过得以赦免。

chapters.en: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.
chapters.zh: 爱子是那不能看见之上帝的像，是首生的，在一切被造的以先。

chapters.en: For in Him all things were created, things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. All things were created through Him and for Him.
chapters.zh: 因为万有都是靠他造的，无论是天上的，地上的；能看见的，不能看见的；或是有位的，主治的，执政的，掌权的；一概都是藉着他造的，又是为他造的。

chapters.en: He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.
chapters.zh: 他在万有之先；万有也靠他而立。

chapters.en: And He is the head of the body, the church; He is the beginning and firstborn from among the dead, so that in all things He may have preeminence.
chapters.zh: 他也是教会全体之首。他是元始，是从死里首先复生的，使他可以在凡事上居首位。

chapters.en: For God was pleased to have all His fullness dwell in Him,
chapters.zh: 因为〔父〕喜欢叫一切的丰盛在他里面居住。

chapters.en: and through Him to reconcile to Himself all things, whether things on earth or things in heaven, by making peace through the blood of His cross.
chapters.zh: 既然藉着他在十字架上所流的血成就了和平，便藉着他叫万有－无论是地上的、天上的－都与自己和好了。

chapters.en: Once you were alienated from God and were hostile in your minds, engaging in evil deeds.
chapters.zh: 你们从前与上帝隔绝，因着恶行，心里〔与他〕为敌。

chapters.en: But now He has reconciled you by Christ’s physical body through death to present you holy, unblemished, and blameless in His presence—
chapters.zh: 但如今他藉着基督的肉身受死，叫你们与自己和好，都成了圣洁，没有瑕疵，无可责备，把你们引到自己面前。

chapters.en: if indeed you continue in your faith, established and firm, not moved from the hope of the gospel you heard, which has been proclaimed to every creature under heaven, and of which I, Paul, have become a servant.
chapters.zh: 只要你们在所信的道上恒心，根基稳固，坚定不移，不致被引动失去〔注：原文是离开〕福音的盼望。这福音就是你们所听过的，也是传与普天下万人听的〔注：原文是凡受造的〕，我－保罗也作了这福音的执事。

chapters.en: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for you, and I fill up in my flesh what is lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions for the sake of His body, which is the church.
chapters.zh: 现在我为你们受苦，倒觉欢乐；并且为基督的身体，就是为教会，要在我肉身上补满基督患难的缺欠。

chapters.en: I became its servant by the commission God gave me to fully proclaim to you the word of God,
chapters.zh: 我照上帝为你们所赐我的职分作了教会的执事，要把上帝的道理传得全备，

chapters.en: the mystery that was hidden for ages and generations but is now revealed to His saints.
chapters.zh: 这道理就是历世历代所隐藏的奥祕；但如今向他的圣徒显明了。

chapters.en: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
chapters.zh: 上帝愿意叫他们知道，这奥祕在外邦人中有何等丰盛的荣耀，就是基督在你们心里成了〔有〕荣耀的盼望。

chapters.en: We proclaim Him, admonishing and teaching everyone with all wisdom, so that we may present everyone perfect in Christ.
chapters.zh: 我们传扬他，是用诸般的智慧，劝戒各人，教导各人，要把各人在基督里完完全全地引到上帝面前。

chapters.en: To this end I also labor, striving with all His energy working powerfully within me.
chapters.zh: 我也为此劳苦，照着他在我里面运用的大能尽心竭力。

chapters.en: For I want you to know how much I am struggling for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not met me face to face,
chapters.zh: 我愿意你们晓得，我为你们和老底嘉人，并一切没有与我亲自见面的人，是何等地尽心竭力；

chapters.en: that they may be encouraged in heart, knit together in love, and filled with the full riches of complete understanding, so that they may know the mystery of God, namely Christ,
chapters.zh: 要叫他们的心得安慰，因爱心互相联络，以致丰丰足足在悟性中有充足的信心，使他们真知上帝的奥祕，就是基督；

chapters.en: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
chapters.zh: 所积蓄的一切智慧知识，都在他里面藏着。

chapters.en: I say this so that no one will deceive you by smooth rhetoric.
chapters.zh: 我说这话，免得有人用花言巧语迷惑你们。

chapters.en: For although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit, and I delight to see your orderly condition and firm faith in Christ.
chapters.zh: 我身子虽与你们相离，心却与你们同在，见你们循规蹈矩，信基督的心也坚固，我就欢喜了。

chapters.en: Therefore, just as you have received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to walk in Him,
chapters.zh: 你们既然接受了主基督耶稣，就当遵他而行，

chapters.en: rooted and built up in Him, established in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.
chapters.zh: 在他里面生根建造，信心坚固，正如你们所领的教训，感谢的心也更增长了。

chapters.en: See to it that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception, which are based on human tradition and the spiritual forces of the world rather than on Christ.
chapters.zh: 你们要谨慎，恐怕有人用他的理学和虚空的妄言，不照着基督，乃照人间的遗传和世上的小学就把你们掳去。

chapters.en: For in Christ all the fullness of the Deity dwells in bodily form.
chapters.zh: 因为上帝本性一切的丰盛都有形有体地居住在基督里面，

chapters.en: And you have been made complete in Christ, who is the head over every ruler and authority.
chapters.zh: 你们在他里面也得了丰盛。他是各样执政掌权者的元首。

chapters.en: In Him you were also circumcised, in the putting off of your sinful nature, with the circumcision performed by Christ and not by human hands.
chapters.zh: 你们在他里面也受了不是人手所行的割礼，乃是基督使你们脱去肉体〔情欲〕的割礼。

chapters.en: And having been buried with Him in baptism, you were raised with Him through your faith in the power of God, who raised Him from the dead.
chapters.zh: 你们既受洗与他一同埋葬，也就在此与他一同复活，都因信那叫他从死里复活上帝的功用。

chapters.en: When you were dead in your trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your sinful nature, God made you alive with Christ. He forgave us all our trespasses,
chapters.zh: 你们从前在过犯和未受割礼的肉体中死了，上帝赦免了你们〔注：或译：我们〕一切过犯，便叫你们与基督一同活过来；

chapters.en: having canceled the debt ascribed to us in the decrees that stood against us. He took it away, nailing it to the cross!
chapters.zh: 又涂抹了在律例上所写、攻击我们、有碍于我们的字据，把它撤去，钉在十字架上。

chapters.en: And having disarmed the powers and authorities, He made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them by the cross.
chapters.zh: 既将一切执政的、掌权的掳来，明显给众人看，就仗着十字架夸胜。

chapters.en: Therefore let no one judge you by what you eat or drink, or with regard to a feast, a New Moon, or a Sabbath.
chapters.zh: 所以，不拘在饮食上，或节期、月朔、安息日都不可让人论断你们。

chapters.en: These are a shadow of the things to come, but the body that casts it belongs to Christ.
chapters.zh: 这些原是后事的影儿；那形体却是基督。

chapters.en: Do not let anyone who delights in false humility and the worship of angels disqualify you with speculation about what he has seen. Such a person is puffed up without basis by his unspiritual mind.
chapters.zh: 不可让人因着故意谦虚和敬拜天使，就夺去你们的奖赏。这等人拘泥在所见过的〔注：有古卷：这等人窥察所没有见过的〕，随着自己的欲心，无故地自高自大，

chapters.en: He has lost connection to the head, from whom the whole body, supported and knit together by its joints and ligaments, grows as God causes it to grow.
chapters.zh: 不持定元首。全身既然靠着他，筋节得以相助联络，就因上帝大得长进。

chapters.en: If you have died with Christ to the spiritual forces of the world, why, as though you still belonged to the world, do you submit to its regulations:
“Do not handle, do not taste, do not touch!”?
chapters.zh: 你们若是与基督同死，脱离了世上的小学，为什么仍像在世俗中活着、服从那「不可拿、不可尝、不可摸」等类的规条呢？

chapters.en: These will all perish with use, because they are based on human commands and teachings.
chapters.zh: 这都是照人所吩咐、所教导的。说到这一切，正用的时候就都败坏了。

chapters.en: Such restrictions indeed have an appearance of wisdom, with their self-prescribed worship, their false humility, and their harsh treatment of the body; but they are of no value against the indulgence of the flesh.
chapters.zh: 这些规条使人徒有智慧之名，用私意崇拜，自表谦卑，苦待己身，其实在克制肉体的情欲上是毫无功效。

chapters.en: Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
chapters.zh: 所以，你们若真与基督一同复活，就当求在上面的事；那里有基督坐在上帝的右边。

chapters.en: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.
chapters.zh: 你们要思念上面的事，不要思念地上的事。

chapters.en: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.
chapters.zh: 因为你们已经死了，你们的生命与基督一同藏在上帝里面。

chapters.en: When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with Him in glory.
chapters.zh: 基督是我们的生命，他显现的时候，你们也要与他一同显现在荣耀里。

chapters.en: Put to death, therefore, the components of your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires, and greed, which is idolatry.
chapters.zh: 所以，要治死你们在地上的肢体，就如淫乱、污秽、邪情、恶欲，和贪婪（贪婪就与拜偶像一样）。

chapters.en: Because of these, the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.
chapters.zh: 因这些事，上帝的忿怒必临到那悖逆之子。

chapters.en: When you lived among them, you also used to walk in these ways.
chapters.zh: 当你们在这些事中活着的时候，也曾这样行过。

chapters.en: But now you must put aside all such things as these: anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language from your lips.
chapters.zh: 但现在你们要弃绝这一切的事，以及恼恨、忿怒、恶毒〔注：或译：阴毒〕、毁谤，并口中污秽的言语。

chapters.en: Do not lie to one another, since you have taken off the old self with its practices,
chapters.zh: 不要彼此说谎；因你们已经脱去旧人和旧人的行为，

chapters.en: and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.
chapters.zh: 穿上了新人。这新人在知识上渐渐更新，正如造他主的形像。

chapters.en: Here there is no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free, but Christ is all and is in all.
chapters.zh: 在此并不分希腊人、犹太人，受割礼的、未受割礼的，化外人、西古提人，为奴的、自主的，惟有基督是包括一切，又住在各人之内。

chapters.en: Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
chapters.zh: 所以，你们既是上帝的选民，圣洁蒙爱的人，就要存〔注：原文是穿：下同〕怜悯、恩慈、谦虚、温柔、忍耐的心。

chapters.en: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
chapters.zh: 倘若这人与那人有嫌隙，总要彼此包容，彼此饶恕；主怎样饶恕了你们，你们也要怎样饶恕人。

chapters.en: And over all these virtues put on love, which is the bond of perfect unity.
chapters.zh: 在这一切之外，要存着爱心，爱心就是联络全德的。

chapters.en: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, for to this you were called as members of one body. And be thankful.
chapters.zh: 又要叫基督的平安在你们心里作主；你们也为此蒙召，归为一体；且要存感谢的心。

chapters.en: Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God.
chapters.zh: 当用各样的智慧，把基督的道理丰丰富富地存在心里〔注：或译：当把基督的道理丰丰富富地存在心里，以各样的智慧〕，用诗章、颂词、灵歌，彼此教导，互相劝戒，心被恩感，歌颂上帝。

chapters.en: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
chapters.zh: 无论做什么，或说话或行事，都要奉主耶稣的名，藉着他感谢父上帝。

chapters.en: Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
chapters.zh: 你们作妻子的，当顺服自己的丈夫，这在主里面是相宜的。

chapters.en: Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.
chapters.zh: 你们作丈夫的，要爱你们的妻子，不可苦待她们。

chapters.en: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing to the Lord.
chapters.zh: 你们作儿女的，要凡事听从父母，因为这是主所喜悦的。

chapters.en: Fathers, do not provoke your children, so they will not become discouraged.
chapters.zh: 你们作父亲的，不要惹儿女的气，恐怕他们失了志气。

chapters.en: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything, not only to please them while they are watching, but with sincerity of heart and fear of the Lord.
chapters.zh: 你们作仆人的，要凡事听从你们肉身的主人，不要只在眼前事奉，像是讨人喜欢的，总要存心诚实敬畏主。

chapters.en: Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, as for the Lord and not for men,
chapters.zh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的，

chapters.en: because you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as your reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.
chapters.zh: 因你们知道从主那里必得着基业为赏赐；你们所事奉的乃是主基督。

chapters.en: Whoever does wrong will be repaid for his wrong, and there is no favoritism.
chapters.zh: 那行不义的必受不义的报应；〔主〕并不偏待人。

chapters.en: Masters, supply your slaves with what is right and fair, since you know that you also have a Master in heaven.
chapters.zh: 你们作主人的，要公公平平地待仆人，因为知道你们也有一位主在天上。

chapters.en: Devote yourselves to prayer, being watchful and thankful,
chapters.zh: 你们要恒切祷告，在此警醒感恩。

chapters.en: as you pray also for us, that God may open to us a door for the word, so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ, for which I am in chains.
chapters.zh: 也要为我们祷告，求上帝给我们开传道的门，能以讲基督的奥祕（我为此被捆锁），

chapters.en: Pray that I may declare it clearly, as I should.
chapters.zh: 叫我按着所该说的话将这奥祕发明出来。

chapters.en: Act wisely toward outsiders, redeeming the time.
chapters.zh: 你们要爱惜光阴，用智慧与外人交往。

chapters.en: Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how to answer everyone.
chapters.zh: 你们的言语要常常带着和气，〔好像〕用盐调和，就可知道该怎样回答各人。

chapters.en: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me. He is a beloved brother, a faithful minister, and a fellow servant in the Lord.
chapters.zh: 有我亲爱的兄弟推基古要将我一切的事都告诉你们。他是忠心的执事，和我一同作主的仆人。

chapters.en: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts.
chapters.zh: 我特意打发他到你们那里去，好叫你们知道我们的光景，又叫他安慰你们的心。

chapters.en: With him I am sending Onesimus, our faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will tell you about everything here.
chapters.zh: 我又打发一位亲爱忠心的兄弟阿尼西谋同去；他也是你们那里的人。他们要把这里一切的事都告诉你们。

chapters.en: My fellow prisoner Aristarchus sends you greetings, as does Mark the cousin of Barnabas. You have already received instructions about him: If he comes to you, welcome him.
chapters.zh: 与我一同坐监的亚里达古问你们安。巴拿巴的表弟马可也问你们安。（说到这马可，你们已经受了吩咐；他若到了你们那里，你们就接待他。）

chapters.en: Jesus, who is called Justus, also sends greetings. These are the only Jews among my fellow workers for the kingdom of God, and they have been a comfort to me.
chapters.zh: 耶数又称为犹士都，也问你们安。奉割礼的人中，只有这三个人是为上帝的国与我一同做工的，也是叫我心里得安慰的。

chapters.en: Epaphras, who is one of you and a servant of Christ Jesus, sends you greetings. He is always wrestling in prayer for you, so that you may stand mature and fully assured in the full will of God.
chapters.zh: 有你们那里的人，作基督耶稣仆人的以巴弗问你们安。他在祷告之间，常为你们竭力地祈求，愿你们在上帝一切的旨意上得以完全，信心充足，能站立得稳。

chapters.en: For I testify about him that he goes to great pains for you and for those at Laodicea and Hierapolis.
chapters.zh: 他为你们和老底嘉并希拉坡里的弟兄多多地劳苦，这是我可以给他作见证的。

chapters.en: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas send you greetings.
chapters.zh: 所亲爱的医生路加和底马问你们安。

chapters.en: Greet the brothers in Laodicea, as well as Nympha and the church that meets at her house.
chapters.zh: 请问老底嘉的弟兄和宁法，并她家里的教会安。

chapters.en: After this letter has been read among you, make sure that it is also read in the church of the Laodiceans, and that you in turn read the letter from Laodicea.
chapters.zh: 你们念了这书信，便交给老底嘉的教会，叫他们也念；你们也要念从老底嘉来的书信。

chapters.en: Tell Archippus: “See to it that you complete the ministry you have received in the Lord.”
chapters.zh: 要对亚基布说：「务要谨慎，尽你从主所受的职分。」

chapters.en:
This greeting is in my own hand—Paul.
Remember my chains.
Grace be with you.
chapters.zh: 我－保罗亲笔问你们安。你们要记念我的捆锁。愿恩惠〔常〕与你们同在！

chapters.en:
Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy,
To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
Grace and peace to you.
chapters.zh: 保罗、西拉、提摩太写信给帖撒罗尼迦在父上帝和主耶稣基督里的教会。愿恩惠、平安归与你们！

chapters.en: We always thank God for all of you, remembering you in our prayers
chapters.zh: 我们为你们众人常常感谢上帝，祷告的时候提到你们，

chapters.en: and continually recalling before our God and Father your work of faith, your labor of love, and your enduring hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 在上帝－我们的父面前，不住地记念你们因信心所做的工夫，因爱心所受的劳苦，因盼望我们主耶稣基督所存的忍耐。

chapters.en: Brothers who are beloved by God, we know that He has chosen you,
chapters.zh: 被上帝所爱的弟兄啊，我知道你们是蒙拣选的；

chapters.en: because our gospel came to you not only in word, but also in power, in the Holy Spirit, and with great conviction—just as you know we lived among you for your sake.
chapters.zh: 因为我们的福音传到你们那里，不独在乎言语，也在乎权能和圣灵，并充足的信心。正如你们知道，我们在你们那里，为你们的缘故是怎样为人。

chapters.en: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord when you welcomed the message with the joy of the Holy Spirit, in spite of your great suffering.
chapters.zh: 并且你们在大难之中，蒙了圣灵所赐的喜乐，领受真道就效法我们，也效法了主；

chapters.en: As a result, you have become an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.
chapters.zh: 甚至你们作了马其顿和亚该亚所有信〔主〕之人的榜样。

chapters.en: For not only did the message of the Lord ring out from you to Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has gone out to every place, so that we have no need to say anything more.
chapters.zh: 因为主的道从你们那里已经传扬出来。你们向上帝的信心不但在马其顿和亚该亚，就是在各处也都传开了，所以不用我们说什么话。

chapters.en: For they themselves report what kind of welcome you gave us, and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God
chapters.zh: 因为他们自己已经报明我们是怎样进到你们那里，你们是怎样离弃偶像，归向上帝，要服事那又真又活的上帝，

chapters.en: and to await His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead—Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath.
chapters.zh: 等候他儿子从天降临，就是他从死里复活的－那位救我们脱离将来忿怒的耶稣。

chapters.en: You yourselves know, brothers, that our visit to you was not in vain.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，你们自己原晓得我们进到你们那里并不是徒然的。

chapters.en: As you are aware, we had already endured suffering and shameful treatment in Philippi. But in the face of strong opposition, we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God.
chapters.zh: 我们从前在腓立比被害受辱，这是你们知道的；然而还是靠我们的上帝放开胆量，在大争战中把上帝的福音传给你们。

chapters.en: For our appeal does not arise from deceit or ulterior motives or trickery.
chapters.zh: 我们的劝勉不是出于错误，不是出于污秽，也不是用诡诈。

chapters.en: Instead, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, not in order to please men but God, who examines our hearts.
chapters.zh: 但上帝既然验中了我们，把福音托付我们，我们就照样讲，不是要讨人喜欢，乃是要讨那察验我们心的上帝喜欢。

chapters.en: As you know, we never used words of flattery or any pretext for greed. God is our witness!
chapters.zh: 因为我们从来没有用过谄媚的话，这是你们知道的；也没有藏着贪心，这是上帝可以作见证的。

chapters.en: Nor did we seek praise from you or from anyone else, although as apostles of Christ we had authority to demand it.
chapters.zh: 我们作基督的使徒，虽然可以叫人尊重，却没有向你们或向别人求荣耀；

chapters.en: On the contrary, we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring for her children.
chapters.zh: 只在你们中间存心温柔，如同母亲乳养自己的孩子。

chapters.en: We cared so deeply that we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God, but our own lives as well. That is how beloved you have become to us.
chapters.zh: 我们既是这样爱你们，不但愿意将上帝的福音给你们，连自己的性命也愿意给你们，因你们是我们所疼爱的。

chapters.en: Surely you recall, brothers, our labor and toil. We worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to anyone while we proclaimed to you the gospel of God.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，你们记念我们的辛苦劳碌，昼夜做工，传上帝的福音给你们，免得叫你们一人受累。

chapters.en: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous, and blameless our conduct was among you who believed.
chapters.zh: 我们向你们信〔主〕的人，是何等圣洁、公义、无可指摘，有你们作见证，也有上帝作见证。

chapters.en: For you know that we treated each of you as a father treats his own children—
chapters.zh: 你们也晓得，我们怎样劝勉你们，安慰你们，嘱咐你们各人，好像父亲待自己的儿女一样，

chapters.en: encouraging you, comforting you, and urging you to walk in a manner worthy of God, who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.
chapters.zh: 要叫你们行事对得起那召你们进他国、得他荣耀的上帝。

chapters.en: And we continually thank God because, when you received the word of God that you heard from us, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it truly is, the word of God, which is also now at work in you who believe.
chapters.zh: 为此，我们也不住地感谢上帝，因你们听见我们所传上帝的道就领受了；不以为是人的道，乃以为是上帝的道。这道实在是上帝的，并且运行在你们信〔主〕的人心中。

chapters.en: For you, brothers, became imitators of the churches of God in Judea that are in Christ Jesus. You suffered from your own countrymen the very things they suffered from the Jews,
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，你们曾效法犹太中在基督耶稣里上帝的各教会；因为你们也受了本地人的苦害，像他们受了犹太人的苦害一样。

chapters.en: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets and drove us out as well. They are displeasing to God and hostile to all men,
chapters.zh: 这犹太人杀了主耶稣和先知，又把我们赶出去。他们不得上帝的喜悦，且与众人为敌，

chapters.en: hindering us from telling the Gentiles how they may be saved. As a result, they continue to heap up their sins to full capacity; the utmost wrath has come upon them.
chapters.zh: 不许我们传道给外邦人使外邦人得救，常常充满自己的罪恶。〔上帝的〕忿怒临在他们身上已经到了极处。

chapters.en: Brothers, although we were torn away from you for a short time (in person, not in heart), our desire to see you face to face was even more intense.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，我们暂时与你们离别，是面目离别，心里却不离别；我们极力地想法子，很愿意见你们的面。

chapters.en: For we wanted to come to you—indeed I, Paul, tried again and again—but Satan obstructed us.
chapters.zh: 所以我们有意到你们那里；我－保罗有一两次要去，只是撒但阻挡了我们。

chapters.en: After all, who is our hope, our joy, our crown of boasting, if it is not you yourselves in the presence of our Lord Jesus at His coming?
chapters.zh: 我们的盼望和喜乐，并所夸的冠冕是什么呢？岂不是我们主耶稣来的时候、你们在他面前站〔立得住〕吗？

chapters.en: You are indeed our glory and our joy.
chapters.zh: 因为你们就是我们的荣耀，我们的喜乐。

chapters.en: So when we could bear it no longer, we were willing to be left on our own in Athens.
chapters.zh: 我们既不能再忍，就愿意独自等在雅典，

chapters.en: We sent Timothy, our brother and fellow worker for God in the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you in your faith,
chapters.zh: 打发我们的兄弟在基督福音上作上帝执事的〔注：作上帝执事的：有古卷是与上帝同工的〕提摩太前去，坚固你们，并在你们所信的道上劝慰你们，

chapters.en: so that none of you would be shaken by these trials. For you know that we are destined for this.
chapters.zh: 免得有人被诸般患难摇动。因为你们自己知道，我们受患难原是命定的。

chapters.en: Indeed, when we were with you, we kept warning you that we would suffer persecution; and as you know, it has come to pass.
chapters.zh: 我们在你们那里的时候，预先告诉你们，我们必受患难，以后果然应验了，你们也知道。

chapters.en: For this reason, when I could bear it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith, for fear that the tempter had somehow tempted you and that our labor might have been in vain.
chapters.zh: 为此，我既不能再忍，就打发人去，要晓得你们的信心如何，恐怕那诱惑人的到底诱惑了你们，叫我们的劳苦归于徒然。

chapters.en: But just now, Timothy has returned from his visit with the good news about your faith, your love, and the fond memories you have preserved, longing to see us just as we long to see you.
chapters.zh: 但提摩太刚才从你们那里回来，将你们信心和爱心的好消息报给我们，又说你们常常记念我们，切切地想见我们，如同我们想见你们一样。

chapters.en: For this reason, brothers, in all our distress and persecution, we have been reassured about you, because of your faith.
chapters.zh: 所以，弟兄们，我们在一切困苦患难之中，因着你们的信心就得了安慰。

chapters.en: For now we can go on living, as long as you are standing firm in the Lord.
chapters.zh: 你们若靠主站立得稳，我们就活了。

chapters.en: How can we adequately thank God for you in return for our great joy over you in His presence?
chapters.zh: 我们在上帝面前，因着你们甚是喜乐；为这一切喜乐，可用何等的感谢为你们报答上帝呢？

chapters.en: Night and day we pray most earnestly that we may see you face to face and supply what is lacking in your faith.
chapters.zh: 我们昼夜切切地祈求，要见你们的面，补满你们信心的不足。

chapters.en: Now may our God and Father Himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you.
chapters.zh: 愿上帝－我们的父和我们的主耶稣一直引领我们到你们那里去。

chapters.en: And may the Lord cause you to increase and overflow with love for one another and for everyone else, just as our love for you overflows,
chapters.zh: 又愿主叫你们彼此相爱的心，并爱众人的心都能增长，充足，如同我们爱你们一样，

chapters.en: so that He may establish your hearts in blamelessness and holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints. Amen.
chapters.zh: 好使你们当我们主耶稣同他众圣徒来的时候，在我们父上帝面前，心里坚固，成为圣洁，无可责备。

chapters.en: Finally, brothers, we ask and encourage you in the Lord Jesus to live in a way that is pleasing to God, just as you have received from us. This is how you already live, so you should do so all the more.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，我还有话说：我们靠着主耶稣求你们，劝你们，你们既然受了我们的教训，知道该怎样行可以讨上帝的喜悦，就要照你们现在所行的更加勉励。

chapters.en: For you know the instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.
chapters.zh: 你们原晓得，我们凭主耶稣传给你们什么命令。

chapters.en: For it is God’s will that you should be holy: You must abstain from sexual immorality;
chapters.zh: 上帝的旨意就是要你们成为圣洁，远避淫行；

chapters.en: each of you must know how to control his own body in holiness and honor,
chapters.zh: 要你们各人晓得怎样用圣洁、尊贵守着自己的身体，

chapters.en: not in lustful passion like the Gentiles who do not know God;
chapters.zh: 不放纵私欲的邪情，像那不认识上帝的外邦人。

chapters.en: and no one should ever violate or exploit his brother in this regard, because the Lord will avenge all such acts, as we have already told you and solemnly warned you.
chapters.zh: 不要一个人在这事上越分，欺负他的弟兄；因为这一类的事，主必报应，正如我预先对你们说过、又切切嘱咐你们的。

chapters.en: For God has not called us to impurity, but to holiness.
chapters.zh: 上帝召我们，本不是要我们沾染污秽，乃是要我们成为圣洁。

chapters.en: Anyone, then, who rejects this command does not reject man but God, the very One who gives you His Holy Spirit.
chapters.zh: 所以，那弃绝的，不是弃绝人，乃是弃绝那赐圣灵给你们的上帝。

chapters.en: Now about brotherly love, you do not need anyone to write to you, because you yourselves have been taught by God to love one another.
chapters.zh: 论到弟兄们相爱，不用人写信给你们；因为你们自己蒙了上帝的教训，叫你们彼此相爱。

chapters.en: And you are indeed showing this love to all the brothers throughout Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers, to excel more and more
chapters.zh: 你们向马其顿全地的众弟兄固然是这样行，但我劝弟兄们要更加勉励。

chapters.en: and to aspire to live quietly, to attend to your own matters, and to work with your own hands, as we instructed you.
chapters.zh: 又要立志作安静人，办自己的事，亲手做工，正如我们从前所吩咐你们的，

chapters.en: Then you will behave properly toward outsiders, without being dependent on anyone.
chapters.zh: 叫你们可以向外人行事端正，自己也就没有什么缺乏了。

chapters.en: Brothers, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you will not grieve like the rest, who are without hope.
chapters.zh: 论到睡了的人，我们不愿意弟兄们不知道，恐怕你们忧伤，像那些没有指望的人一样。

chapters.en: For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again, we also believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in Him.
chapters.zh: 我们若信耶稣死而复活了，那已经在耶稣里睡了的人，上帝也必将他们与耶稣一同带来。

chapters.en: By the word of the Lord, we declare to you that we who are alive and remain until the coming of the Lord will by no means precede those who have fallen asleep.
chapters.zh: 我们现在照主的话告诉你们一件事：我们这活着还存留到主降临的人，断不能在那已经睡了的人之先。

chapters.en: For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a loud command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will be the first to rise.
chapters.zh: 因为主必亲自从天降临，有呼叫的声音和天使长的声音，又有上帝的号〔吹响〕；那在基督里死了的人必先复活。

chapters.en: After that, we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will always be with the Lord.
chapters.zh: 以后我们这活着还存留的人必和他们一同被提到云里，在空中与主相遇。这样，我们就要和主永远同在。

chapters.en: Therefore encourage one another with these words.
chapters.zh: 所以，你们当用这些话彼此劝慰。

chapters.en: Now about the times and seasons, brothers, we do not need to write to you.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，论到时候、日期，不用写信给你们，

chapters.en: For you are fully aware that the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
chapters.zh: 因为你们自己明明晓得，主的日子来到，好像夜间的贼一样。

chapters.en: While people are saying, “Peace and security,” destruction will come upon them suddenly, like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.
chapters.zh: 人正说「平安稳妥」的时候，灾祸忽然临到他们，如同产难临到怀胎的妇人一样，他们绝不能逃脱。

chapters.en: But you, brothers, are not in the darkness so that this day should overtake you like a thief.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，你们却不在黑暗里，叫那日子临到你们像贼一样。

chapters.en: For you are all sons of the light and sons of the day; we do not belong to the night or to the darkness.
chapters.zh: 你们都是光明之子，都是白昼之子。我们不是属黑夜的，也不是属幽暗的。

chapters.en: So then, let us not sleep as the others do, but let us remain awake and sober.
chapters.zh: 所以，我们不要睡觉像别人一样，总要警醒谨守。

chapters.en: For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.
chapters.zh: 因为睡了的人是在夜间睡，醉了的人是在夜间醉。

chapters.en: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of our hope of salvation.
chapters.zh: 但我们既然属乎白昼，就应当谨守，把信和爱当作护心镜遮胸，把得救的盼望当作头盔戴上。

chapters.en: For God has not appointed us to suffer wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 因为上帝不是预定我们受刑，乃是预定我们藉着我们主耶稣基督得救。

chapters.en: He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with Him.
chapters.zh: 他替我们死，叫我们无论醒着，睡着，都与他同活。

chapters.en: Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing.
chapters.zh: 所以，你们该彼此劝慰，互相建立，正如你们素常所行的。

chapters.en: But we ask you, brothers, to acknowledge those who work diligently among you, who care for you in the Lord and who admonish you.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，我们劝你们敬重那在你们中间劳苦的人，就是在主里面治理你们、劝戒你们的；

chapters.en: In love, hold them in highest regard because of their work. Live in peace with one another.
chapters.zh: 又因他们所做的工，用爱心格外尊重他们。你们也要彼此和睦。

chapters.en: And we urge you, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.
chapters.zh: 我们又劝弟兄们，要警戒不守规矩的人，勉励灰心的人，扶助软弱的人，也要向众人忍耐。

chapters.en: Make sure that no one repays evil for evil. Always pursue what is good for one another and for all people.
chapters.zh: 你们要谨慎，无论是谁都不可以恶报恶；或是彼此相待，或是待众人，常要追求良善。

chapters.en: Rejoice at all times.
chapters.zh: 要常常喜乐，

chapters.en: Pray without ceasing.
chapters.zh: 不住地祷告，

chapters.en: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
chapters.zh: 凡事谢恩；因为这是上帝在基督耶稣里向你们所定的旨意。

chapters.en: Do not extinguish the Spirit.
chapters.zh: 不要消灭〔圣〕灵〔的感动〕；

chapters.en: Do not treat prophecies with contempt,
chapters.zh: 不要藐视先知的讲论。

chapters.en: but test all things. Hold fast to what is good.
chapters.zh: 但要凡事察验；善美的要持守，

chapters.en: Abstain from every form of evil.
chapters.zh: 各样的恶事要禁戒不做。

chapters.en: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 愿赐平安的上帝亲自使你们全然成圣！又愿你们的灵与魂与身子得蒙保守，在我们主耶稣基督降临的时候，完全无可指摘！

chapters.en: The One who calls you is faithful, and He will do it.
chapters.zh: 那召你们的本是信实的，他必成就这事。

chapters.en: Brothers, pray for us as well.
chapters.zh: 请弟兄们为我们祷告。

chapters.en: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
chapters.zh: 与众弟兄亲嘴问安，务要圣洁。

chapters.en: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers.
chapters.zh: 我指着主嘱咐你们，要把这信念给众弟兄听。

chapters.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
chapters.zh: 愿我主耶稣基督的恩〔常〕与你们同在！

chapters.en:
Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy,
To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
chapters.zh: 保罗、西拉、提摩太写信给帖撒罗尼迦、在上帝－我们的父与主耶稣基督里的教会。

chapters.en: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 愿恩惠、平安从父上帝和主耶稣基督归与你们！

chapters.en: We are obligated to thank God for you all the time, brothers, as is fitting, because your faith is growing more and more, and your love for one another is increasing.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，我们该为你们常常感谢上帝，这本是合宜的；因你们的信心格外增长，并且你们众人彼此相爱的心也都充足。

chapters.en: That is why we boast among God’s churches about your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring.
chapters.zh: 甚至我们在上帝的各教会里为你们夸口，都因你们在所受的一切逼迫患难中，仍旧存忍耐和信心。

chapters.en: All this is clear evidence of God’s righteous judgment. And so you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are suffering.
chapters.zh: 这正是上帝公义判断的明证，叫你们可算配得上帝的国；你们就是为这国受苦。

chapters.en: After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
chapters.zh: 上帝既是公义的，就必将患难报应那加患难给你们的人，

chapters.en: and to grant relief to you who are oppressed and to us as well. This will take place when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with His mighty angels
chapters.zh: 也必使你们这受患难的人与我们同得平安。那时，主耶稣同他有能力的天使从天上在火焰中显现，

chapters.en: in blazing fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
chapters.zh: 要报应那不认识上帝和那不听从我主耶稣福音的人。

chapters.en: They will suffer the penalty of eternal destruction, separated from the presence of the Lord and the glory of His might,
chapters.zh: 他们要受刑罚，就是永远沉沦，离开主的面和他权能的荣光。

chapters.en: on the day He comes to be glorified in His saints and regarded with wonder by all who have believed, including you who have believed our testimony.
chapters.zh: 这正是主降临、要在他圣徒的身上得荣耀、又在一切信的人身上显为希奇的那日子。我们对你们作的见证，你们也信了。

chapters.en: To this end, we always pray for you, that our God will count you worthy of His calling, and that He will powerfully fulfill your every good desire and work of faith,
chapters.zh: 因此，我们常为你们祷告，愿我们的上帝看你们配得过所蒙的召，又用大能成就你们一切所羨慕的良善和一切因信心所做的工夫，

chapters.en: so that the name of our Lord Jesus will be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 叫我们主耶稣的名在你们身上得荣耀，你们也在他身上得荣耀，都照着我们的上帝并主耶稣基督的恩。

chapters.en: Now concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered together to Him, we ask you, brothers,
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，论到我们主耶稣基督降临和我们到他那里聚集，

chapters.en: not to be easily disconcerted or alarmed by any spirit or message or letter seeming to be from us, alleging that the Day of the Lord has already come.
chapters.zh: 我劝你们：无论有灵、有言语、有冒我名的书信，说主的日子现在〔注：现在：或译就〕到了，不要轻易动心，也不要惊慌。

chapters.en: Let no one deceive you in any way, for it will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness—the son of destruction—is revealed.
chapters.zh: 人不拘用什么法子，你们总不要被他诱惑；因为那日子以前，必有离道反教的事，并有那大罪人，就是沉沦之子，显露出来。

chapters.en: He will oppose and exalt himself above every so-called god or object of worship. So he will seat himself in the temple of God, proclaiming himself to be God.
chapters.zh: 他是抵挡主，高抬自己，超过一切称为神的和一切受人敬拜的，甚至坐在上帝的殿里，自称是上帝。

chapters.en: Do you not remember that I told you these things while I was still with you?
chapters.zh: 我还在你们那里的时候，曾把这些事告诉你们，你们不记得吗？

chapters.en: And you know what is now restraining him, so that he may be revealed at the proper time.
chapters.zh: 现在你们也知道，那拦阻他的是什么，是叫他到了的时候才可以显露。

chapters.en: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work, but the one who now restrains it will continue until he is taken out of the way.
chapters.zh: 因为那不法的隐意已经发动，只是现在有一个拦阻的，等到那拦阻的被除去，

chapters.en: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will slay with the breath of His mouth and annihilate by the majesty of His arrival.
chapters.zh: 那时这不法的人必显露出来。主耶稣要用口中的气灭绝他，用降临的荣光废掉他。

chapters.en: The coming of the lawless one will be accompanied by the working of Satan, with every kind of power, sign, and false wonder,
chapters.zh: 这不法的人来，是照撒但的运动，行各样的异能、神迹，和一切虚假的奇事，

chapters.en: and with every wicked deception directed against those who are perishing, because they refused the love of the truth that would have saved them.
chapters.zh: 并且在那沉沦的人身上行各样出于不义的诡诈；因他们不领受爱真理的心，使他们得救。

chapters.en: For this reason God will send them a powerful delusion so that they believe the lie,
chapters.zh: 故此，上帝就给他们一个生发错误的心，叫他们信从虚谎，

chapters.en: in order that judgment may come upon all who have disbelieved the truth and delighted in wickedness.
chapters.zh: 使一切不信真理、倒喜爱不义的人都被定罪。

chapters.en: But we should always thank God for you, brothers who are loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning to be saved by the sanctification of the Spirit and by faith in the truth.
chapters.zh: 主所爱的弟兄们哪，我们本该常为你们感谢上帝；因为他从起初拣选了你们，叫你们因信真道，又被圣灵感动，成为圣洁，能以得救。

chapters.en: To this He called you through our gospel, so that you may share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 上帝藉我们所传的福音召你们到这地步，好得着我们主耶稣基督的荣光。

chapters.en: Therefore, brothers, stand firm and cling to the traditions we taught you, whether by speech or by letter.
chapters.zh: 所以，弟兄们，你们要站立得稳，凡所领受的教训，不拘是我们口传的，是信上写的，都要坚守。

chapters.en: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, who by grace has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope,
chapters.zh: 但愿我们主耶稣基督和那爱我们、开恩将永远的安慰并美好的盼望赐给我们的父上帝，

chapters.en: encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good word and deed.
chapters.zh: 安慰你们的心，并且在一切善行善言上坚固你们。

chapters.en: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread quickly and be held in honor, just as it was with you.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，我还有话说：请你们为我们祷告，好叫主的道理快快行开，得着荣耀，正如在你们中间一样，

chapters.en: And pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil men; for not everyone holds to the faith.
chapters.zh: 也叫我们脱离无理之恶人的手；因为人不都是有信心。

chapters.en: But the Lord is faithful, and He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
chapters.zh: 但主是信实的，要坚固你们，保护你们脱离那恶者〔注：或译：脱离凶恶〕。

chapters.en: And we have confidence in the Lord that you are doing and will continue to do what we command.
chapters.zh: 我们靠主深信，你们现在是遵行我们所吩咐的，后来也必要遵行。

chapters.en: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.
chapters.zh: 愿主引导你们的心，叫你们爱上帝，并学基督的忍耐！

chapters.en: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from any brother who leads an undisciplined life that is not in keeping with the tradition you received from us.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，我们奉主耶稣基督的名吩咐你们，凡有弟兄不按规矩而行，不遵守从我们所受的教训，就当远离他。

chapters.en: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not undisciplined among you,
chapters.zh: 你们自己原知道应当怎样效法我们。因为我们在你们中间，未尝不按规矩而行，

chapters.en: nor did we eat anyone’s food without paying for it. Instead, in labor and toil, we worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to any of you.
chapters.zh: 也未尝白吃人的饭，倒是辛苦劳碌，昼夜做工，免得叫你们一人受累。

chapters.en: Not that we lack this right, but we wanted to offer ourselves as an example for you to imitate.
chapters.zh: 这并不是因我们没有权柄，乃是要给你们作榜样，叫你们效法我们。

chapters.en: For even while we were with you, we gave you this command: “If anyone is unwilling to work, he shall not eat.”
chapters.zh: 我们在你们那里的时候，曾吩咐你们说，若有人不肯做工，就不可吃饭。

chapters.en: For we hear that some of you are leading undisciplined lives, accomplishing nothing, but being busybodies.
chapters.zh: 因我们听说，在你们中间有人不按规矩而行，什么工都不做，反倒专管闲事。

chapters.en: We command and urge such people by our Lord Jesus Christ to begin working quietly to earn their own living.
chapters.zh: 我们靠主耶稣基督吩咐、劝戒这样的人，要安静做工，吃自己的饭。

chapters.en: But as for you, brothers, do not grow weary in well-doing.
chapters.zh: 弟兄们，你们行善不可丧志。

chapters.en: Take note of anyone who does not obey the instructions we have given in this letter. Do not associate with him, so that he may be ashamed.
chapters.zh: 若有人不听从我们这信上的话，要记下他，不和他交往，叫他自觉羞愧。

chapters.en: Yet do not regard him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
chapters.zh: 但不要以他为仇人，要劝他如弟兄。

chapters.en: Now may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.
chapters.zh: 愿赐平安的主随时随事亲自给你们平安！愿主〔常〕与你们众人同在！

chapters.en: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul. This is my mark in every letter; it is the way I write.
chapters.zh: 我－保罗亲笔问你们安。凡我的信都以此为记，我的笔迹就是这样。

chapters.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you.
chapters.zh: 愿我们主耶稣基督的恩〔常〕与你们众人同在！

chapters.en: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,
chapters.zh: 奉我们救主上帝和我们的盼望基督耶稣之命，作基督耶稣使徒的保罗

chapters.en:
To Timothy, my true child in the faith:
Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
chapters.zh: 写信给那因信主作我真儿子的提摩太。愿恩惠、怜悯、平安从父上帝和我们主基督耶稣归与你！

chapters.en: As I urged you on my departure to Macedonia, you should stay on at Ephesus to instruct certain men not to teach false doctrines
chapters.zh: 我往马其顿去的时候，曾劝你仍住在以弗所，好嘱咐那几个人不可传异教，

chapters.en: or devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies, which promote speculation rather than the stewardship of God’s work, which is by faith.
chapters.zh: 也不可听从荒渺无凭的话语和无穷的家谱；这等事只生辩论，并不发明上帝在信上所立的章程。

chapters.en: The goal of our instruction is the love that comes from a pure heart, a clear conscience, and a sincere faith.
chapters.zh: 但命令的总归就是爱；这爱是从清洁的心和无亏的良心，无伪的信心生出来的。

chapters.en: Some have strayed from these ways and turned aside to empty talk.
chapters.zh: 有人偏离这些，反去讲虚浮的话，

chapters.en: They want to be teachers of the law, but they do not understand what they are saying or that which they so confidently assert.
chapters.zh: 想要作教法师，却不明白自己所讲说的所论定的。

chapters.en: Now we know that the law is good, if one uses it legitimately.
chapters.zh: 我们知道律法原是好的，只要人用得合宜；

chapters.en: We realize that law is not enacted for the righteous, but for the lawless and rebellious, for the ungodly and sinful, for the unholy and profane, for killers of father or mother, for murderers,
chapters.zh: 因为律法不是为义人设立的，乃是为不法和不服的，不虔诚和犯罪的，不圣洁和恋世俗的，弑父母和杀人的，

chapters.en: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave traders and liars and perjurers, and for anyone else who is averse to sound teaching
chapters.zh: 行淫和亲男色的，抢人口和说谎话的，并起假誓的，或是为别样敌正道的事设立的。

chapters.en: that agrees with the glorious gospel of the blessed God, with which I have been entrusted.
chapters.zh: 这是照着可称颂之上帝交讬我荣耀福音说的。

chapters.en: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has strengthened me, that He considered me faithful and appointed me to service.
chapters.zh: 我感谢那给我力量的我们主基督耶稣，因他以我有忠心，派我服事他。

chapters.en: I was formerly a blasphemer, a persecutor, and a violent man; yet because I had acted in ignorance and unbelief, I was shown mercy.
chapters.zh: 我从前是亵渎〔上帝〕的，逼迫〔人〕的，侮慢〔人〕的；然而我还蒙了怜悯，因我是不信不明白的时候而做的。

chapters.en: And the grace of our Lord overflowed to me, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
chapters.zh: 并且我主的恩是格外丰盛，使我在基督耶稣里有信心和爱心。

chapters.en: This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the worst.
chapters.zh: 「基督耶稣降世，为要拯救罪人。」这话是可信的，是十分可佩服的。在罪人中我是个罪魁。

chapters.en: But for this very reason I was shown mercy, so that in me, the worst of sinners, Christ Jesus might display His perfect patience as an example to those who would believe in Him for eternal life.
chapters.zh: 然而，我蒙了怜悯，是因耶稣基督要在我这罪魁身上显明他一切的忍耐，给后来信他得永生的人作榜样。

chapters.en: Now to the King eternal, immortal, and invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
chapters.zh: 但愿尊贵、荣耀归与那不能朽坏、不能看见、永世的君王、独一的上帝，直到永永远远。阿们！

chapters.en: Timothy, my child, I entrust you with this command in keeping with the previous prophecies about you, so that by them you may fight the good fight,
chapters.zh: 我儿提摩太啊，我照从前指着你的预言，将这命令交讬你，叫你因此可以打那美好的仗。

chapters.en: holding on to faith and a good conscience, which some have rejected and thereby shipwrecked their faith.
chapters.zh: 常存信心和无亏的良心。有人丢弃良心，就在真道上如同船破坏了一般。

chapters.en: Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan to be taught not to blaspheme.
chapters.zh: 其中有许米乃和亚历山大；我已经把他们交给撒但，使他们受责罚就不再谤渎了。

chapters.en: First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgiving be offered for everyone—
chapters.zh: 我劝你，第一要为万人恳求、祷告、代求、祝谢；

chapters.en: for kings and all those in authority—so that we may lead tranquil and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity.
chapters.zh: 为君王和一切在位的，〔也该如此〕，使我们可以敬虔、端正、平安无事地度日。

chapters.en: This is good and pleasing in the sight of God our Savior,
chapters.zh: 这是好的，在上帝我们救主面前可蒙悦纳。

chapters.en: who wants everyone to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
chapters.zh: 他愿意万人得救，明白真道。

chapters.en: For there is one God, and there is one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
chapters.zh: 因为只有一位上帝，在上帝和人中间，只有一位中保，乃是〔降世〕为人的基督耶稣；

chapters.en: who gave Himself as a ransom for all—the testimony that was given at just the right time.
chapters.zh: 他舍自己作万人的赎价，到了时候，这事必证明出来。

chapters.en: For this reason I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a faithful and true teacher of the Gentiles. I am telling the truth; I am not lying about anything.
chapters.zh: 我为此奉派作传道的，作使徒，作外邦人的师傅，教导他们相信，学习真道。我说的是真话，并不是谎言。

chapters.en: Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands, without anger or dissension.
chapters.zh: 我愿男人无忿怒，无争论〔注：或译：疑惑〕，举起圣洁的手，随处祷告；

chapters.en: Likewise, I want the women to adorn themselves with respectable apparel, with modesty, and with self-control, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or expensive clothes,
