chapters.en: We are from God. Whoever knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us. That is how we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of deception.
chapters.zh: 我们是属上帝的，认识上帝的就听从我们；不属上帝的就不听从我们。从此我们可以认出真理的灵和谬妄的灵来。

chapters.en: Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的〔弟兄〕啊，我们应当彼此相爱，因为爱是从上帝来的。凡有爱心的，都是由上帝而生，并且认识上帝。

chapters.en: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.
chapters.zh: 没有爱心的，就不认识上帝，因为上帝就是爱。

chapters.en: This is how God’s love was revealed among us: God sent His one and only Son into the world, so that we might live through Him.
chapters.zh: 上帝差他独生子到世间来，使我们藉着他得生，上帝爱我们的心在此就显明了。

chapters.en: And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
chapters.zh: 不是我们爱上帝，乃是上帝爱我们，差他的儿子为我们的罪作了挽回祭，这就是爱了。

chapters.en: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的〔弟兄〕啊，上帝既是这样爱我们，我们也当彼此相爱。

chapters.en: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.
chapters.zh: 从来没有人见过上帝，我们若彼此相爱，上帝就住在我们里面，爱他的心在我们里面得以完全了。

chapters.en: By this we know that we remain in Him, and He in us: He has given us of His Spirit.
chapters.zh: 上帝将他的灵赐给我们，从此就知道我们是住在他里面，他也住在我们里面。

chapters.en: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent His Son to be the Savior of the world.
chapters.zh: 父差子作世人的救主；这是我们所看见且作见证的。

chapters.en: If anyone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.
chapters.zh: 凡认耶稣为上帝儿子的，上帝就住在他里面，他也住在上帝里面。

chapters.en: And we have come to know and believe the love that God has for us. God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.
chapters.zh: 上帝爱我们的心，我们也知道也信。 上帝就是爱；住在爱里面的，就是住在上帝里面，上帝也住在他里面。

chapters.en: In this way, love has been perfected among us, so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment; for in this world we are just like Him.
chapters.zh: 这样，爱在我们里面得以完全，我们就可以在审判的日子坦然无惧。因为他如何，我们在这世上也如何。

chapters.en: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. The one who fears has not been perfected in love.
chapters.zh: 爱里没有惧怕；爱既完全，就把惧怕除去。因为惧怕里含着刑罚，惧怕的人在爱里未得完全。

chapters.en: We love because He first loved us.
chapters.zh: 我们爱，因为上帝先爱我们。

chapters.en: If anyone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar. For anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
chapters.zh: 人若说「我爱上帝」，却恨他的弟兄，就是说谎话的；不爱他所看见的弟兄，就不能爱没有看见的上帝〔注：有古卷：怎能爱没有看见的上帝呢〕。

chapters.en: And we have this commandment from Him: Whoever loves God must love his brother as well.
chapters.zh: 爱上帝的，也当爱弟兄，这是我们从上帝所受的命令。

chapters.en: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father also loves those born of Him.
chapters.zh: 凡信耶稣是基督的，都是从上帝而生，凡爱生他之上帝的，也必爱从上帝生的。

chapters.en: By this we know that we love the children of God: when we love God and keep His commandments.
chapters.zh: 我们若爱上帝，又遵守他的诫命，从此就知道我们爱上帝的儿女。

chapters.en: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome,
chapters.zh: 我们遵守上帝的诫命，这就是爱他了，并且他的诫命不是难守的。

chapters.en: because everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
chapters.zh: 因为凡从上帝生的，就胜过世界；使我们胜了世界的，就是我们的信心。

chapters.en: Who then overcomes the world? Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
chapters.zh: 胜过世界的是谁呢？不是那信耶稣是上帝儿子的吗？

chapters.en: This is the One who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ—not by water alone, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies to this, because the Spirit is the truth.
chapters.zh: 这藉着水和血而来的，就是耶稣基督；不是单用水，乃是用水又用血，

chapters.en: For there are three that testify:
chapters.zh: 并且有〔圣〕灵作见证，因为〔圣〕灵就是真理。

chapters.en: the Spirit, the water, and the blood—and these three are in agreement.
chapters.zh: 作见证的原来有三：就是〔圣〕灵、水，与血，这三样也都归于一。

chapters.en: Even if we accept human testimony, the testimony of God is greater. For this is the testimony that God has given about His Son.
chapters.zh: 我们既领受人的见证，上帝的见证更该领受〔注：该领受：原文是大〕了，因上帝的见证是为他儿子作的。

chapters.en: Whoever believes in the Son of God has this testimony within him; whoever does not believe God has made Him out to be a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given about His Son.
chapters.zh: 信上帝儿子的，就有这见证在他心里；不信上帝的，就是将上帝当作说谎的，因不信上帝为他儿子作的见证。

chapters.en: And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
chapters.zh: 这见证就是上帝赐给我们永生；这〔永〕生也是在他儿子里面。

chapters.en: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.
chapters.zh: 人有了〔上帝的〕儿子就有生命，没有上帝的儿子就没有生命。

chapters.en: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
chapters.zh: 我将这些话写给你们信奉上帝儿子之名的人，要叫你们知道自己有永生。

chapters.en: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
chapters.zh: 我们若照他的旨意求什么，他就听我们，这是我们向他所存坦然无惧的心。

chapters.en: And if we know that He hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we already possess what we have asked of Him.
chapters.zh: 既然知道他听我们一切所求的，就知道我们所求于他的，无不得着。

chapters.en: If anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he should ask God, who will give life to those who commit this kind of sin. There is a sin that leads to death; I am not saying he should ask regarding that sin.
chapters.zh: 人若看见弟兄犯了不至于死的罪，就当为他祈求，〔上帝〕必将生命赐给他；有至于死的罪，我不说当为这罪祈求。

chapters.en: All unrighteousness is sin, yet there is sin that does not lead to death.
chapters.zh: 凡不义的事都是罪，也有不至于死的罪。

chapters.en: We know that anyone born of God does not keep on sinning; the One who was born of God protects him, and the evil one cannot touch him.
chapters.zh: 我们知道凡从上帝生的，必不犯罪，从上帝生的，必保守自己〔注：有古卷：那从上帝生的必保护他〕，那恶者也就无法害他。

chapters.en: We know that we are of God, and that the whole world is under the power of the evil one.
chapters.zh: 我们知道，我们是属上帝的，全世界都卧在那恶者手下。

chapters.en: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true—in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
chapters.zh: 我们也知道，上帝的儿子已经来到，且将智慧赐给我们，使我们认识那位真实的，我们也在那位真实的里面，就是在他儿子耶稣基督里面。这是真神，也是永生。

chapters.en: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
chapters.zh: 小子们哪，你们要自守，远避偶像！

chapters.en:
The elder,
To the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in the truth—and not I alone, but also all who know the truth—
chapters.zh: 作长老的写信给蒙拣选的太太〔注：或译：教会；下同〕和她的儿女，就是我诚心所爱的；不但我爱，也是一切知道真理之人所爱的。

chapters.en: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever:
chapters.zh: 爱你们是为真理的缘故，这真理存在我们里面，也必永远与我们同在。

chapters.en: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, will be with us in truth and love.
chapters.zh: 恩惠、怜悯、平安从父上帝和他儿子耶稣基督在真理和爱心上必常与我们同在！

chapters.en: I was overjoyed to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father has commanded us.
chapters.zh: 我见你的儿女，有照我们从父所受之命令遵行真理的，就甚欢喜。

chapters.en: And now I urge you, dear lady—not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning—that we love one another.
chapters.zh: 太太啊，我现在劝你，我们大家要彼此相爱。这并不是我写一条新命令给你，乃是我们从起初所受的命令。

chapters.en: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the very commandment you have heard from the beginning, that you must walk in love.
chapters.zh: 我们若照他的命令行，这就是爱。你们从起初所听见当行的，就是这命令。

chapters.en: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, refusing to confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.
chapters.zh: 因为世上有许多迷惑人的出来，他们不认耶稣基督是成了肉身来的；这就是那迷惑人、敌基督的。

chapters.en: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be fully rewarded.
chapters.zh: 你们要小心，不要失去你们〔注：有古卷：我们〕所做的工，乃要得着满足的赏赐。

chapters.en: Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in His teaching has both the Father and the Son.
chapters.zh: 凡越过基督的教训不常守着的，就没有上帝；常守这教训的，就有父又有子。

chapters.en: If anyone comes to you but does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your home or even greet him.
chapters.zh: 若有人到你们那里，不是传这教训，不要接他到家里，也不要问他的安；

chapters.en: Whoever greets such a person shares in his evil deeds.
chapters.zh: 因为问他安的，就在他的恶行上有分。

chapters.en: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come and speak with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
chapters.zh: 我还有许多事要写给你们，却不愿意用纸墨〔写出来〕，但盼望到你们那里，与你们当面谈论，使你们的喜乐满足。

chapters.en: The children of your elect sister send you greetings.
chapters.zh: 你那蒙拣选之姊妹的儿女都问你安。

chapters.en:
The elder,
To the beloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth:
chapters.zh: 作长老的写信给亲爱的该犹，就是我诚心所爱的。

chapters.en: Beloved, I pray that in every way you may prosper and enjoy good health, as your soul also prospers.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的〔兄弟〕啊，我愿你凡事兴盛，身体健壮，正如你的灵魂兴盛一样。

chapters.en: For I was overjoyed when the brothers came and testified about your devotion to the truth, in which you continue to walk.
chapters.zh: 有弟兄来证明你心里存的真理，正如你按真理而行，我就甚喜乐。

chapters.en: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.
chapters.zh: 我听见我的儿女们按真理而行，我的喜乐就没有比这个大的。

chapters.en: Beloved, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers, and especially since they are strangers to you.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的〔兄弟〕啊，凡你向作客旅之弟兄所行的都是忠心的。

chapters.en: They have testified to the church about your love. You will do well to send them on their way in a manner worthy of God.
chapters.zh: 他们在教会面前证明了你的爱；你若配得过上帝，帮助他们往前行，这就好了。

chapters.en: For they went out on behalf of the Name, accepting nothing from the Gentiles.
chapters.zh: 因他们是为主的名〔注：原文是那名〕出外，对于外邦人一无所取。

chapters.en: Therefore we ought to support such men, so that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
chapters.zh: 所以我们应该接待这样的人，叫我们与他们一同为真理做工。

chapters.en: I have written to the church about this, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will not accept our instruction.
chapters.zh: 我曾略略地写信给教会，但那在教会中好为首的丢特腓不接待我们。

chapters.en: So if I come, I will call attention to his malicious slander against us. And unsatisfied with that, he refuses to welcome the brothers and forbids those who want to do so, even putting them out of the church.
chapters.zh: 所以我若去，必要提说他所行的事，就是他用恶言妄论我们。还不以此为足，他自己不接待弟兄，有人愿意接待，他也禁止，并且将接待弟兄的人赶出教会。

chapters.en: Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good is of God; the one who does evil has not seen God.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的〔兄弟〕啊，不要效法恶，只要效法善。行善的属乎上帝；行恶的未曾见过上帝。

chapters.en: Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself. We also testify for him, and you know that our testimony is true.
chapters.zh: 低米丢〔行善〕，有众人给他作见证，又有真理给他作见证，就是我们也给他作见证。你也知道我们的见证是真的。

chapters.en: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with pen and ink.
chapters.zh: 我原有许多事要写给你，却不愿意用笔墨写给你，

chapters.en:
Instead, I hope to see you soon and speak with you face to face.
Peace to you.
The friends here send you greetings.
Greet each of our friends there by name.
chapters.zh: 但盼望快快地见你，我们就当面谈论。
愿你平安。众位朋友都问你安。请你替我按着姓名问众位朋友安。

chapters.en:
Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James,
To those who are called, loved by God the Father, and kept in Jesus Christ:
chapters.zh: 耶稣基督的仆人，雅各的弟兄犹大，写信给那被召、在父上帝里蒙爱、为耶稣基督保守的人。

chapters.en: Mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
chapters.zh: 愿怜恤、平安、慈爱多多地加给你们。

chapters.en: Beloved, although I made every effort to write to you about the salvation we share, I felt it necessary to write and urge you to contend earnestly for the faith entrusted once for all to the saints.
chapters.zh: 亲爱的〔弟兄〕啊，我想尽心写信给你们，论我们同得救恩的时候，就不得不写信劝你们，要为从前一次交付圣徒的真道竭力地争辩。

chapters.en: For certain men have crept in among you unnoticed—ungodly ones who were designated long ago for condemnation. They turn the grace of our God into a license for immorality, and they deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 因为有些人偷着进来，就是自古被定受刑罚的，是不虔诚的，将我们上帝的恩变作放纵情欲的机会，并且不认独一的主宰－我们〔注：或译：和我们〕主耶稣基督。

chapters.en: Although you are fully aware of this, I want to remind you that after Jesus had delivered His people out of the land of Egypt, He destroyed those who did not believe.
chapters.zh: 从前主救了〔他的〕百姓出埃及地，后来就把那些不信的灭绝了。这一切的事，你们虽然都知道，我却仍要提醒你们。

chapters.en: And the angels who did not stay within their own domain but abandoned their proper dwelling—these He has kept in eternal chains under darkness, bound for judgment on that great day.
chapters.zh: 又有不守本位、离开自己住处的天使，主用锁鍊把他们永远拘留在黑暗里，等候大日的审判。

chapters.en: In like manner, Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, who indulged in sexual immorality and pursued strange flesh, are on display as an example of those who sustain the punishment of eternal fire.
chapters.zh: 又如所多玛、蛾摩拉和周围城邑的人，也照他们一味地行淫，随从逆性的情欲，就受永火的刑罚，作为鉴戒。

chapters.en: Yet in the same way these dreamers defile their bodies, reject authority, and slander glorious beings.
chapters.zh: 这些做梦的人也像他们污秽身体，轻慢主治的，毁谤在尊位的。

chapters.en: But even the archangel Michael, when he disputed with the devil over the body of Moses, did not presume to bring a slanderous charge against him, but said, “The Lord rebuke you!”
chapters.zh: 天使长米迦勒为摩西的尸首与魔鬼争辩的时候，尚且不敢用毁谤的话罪责他，只说：「主责备你吧！」。

chapters.en: These men, however, slander what they do not understand, and like irrational animals, they will be destroyed by the things they do instinctively.
chapters.zh: 但这些人毁谤他们所不知道的。他们本性所知道的事与那没有灵性的畜类一样，在这事上竟败坏了自己。

chapters.en: Woe to them! They have traveled the path of Cain; they have rushed headlong into the error of Balaam; they have perished in Korah’s rebellion.
chapters.zh: 他们有祸了！因为走了该隐的道路，又为利往巴兰的错谬里直奔，并在可拉的背叛中灭亡了。

chapters.en: These men are hidden reefs in your love feasts, shamelessly feasting with you but shepherding only themselves. They are clouds without water, carried along by the wind; fruitless trees in autumn, twice dead after being uprooted.
chapters.zh: 这样的人在你们的爱席上与你们同吃的时候，正是礁石〔注：或译：玷污〕。他们作牧人，只知餵养自己，无所惧怕；是没有雨的云彩，被风飘荡；是秋天没有果子的树，死而又死，连根被拔出来；

chapters.en: They are wild waves of the sea, foaming up their own shame; wandering stars, for whom blackest darkness has been reserved forever.
chapters.zh: 是海里的狂浪，涌出自己可耻的沫子来；是流荡的星，有墨黑的幽暗为他们永远存留。

chapters.en:
Enoch, the seventh from Adam, also prophesied about them:
“Behold, the Lord is coming with myriads of His holy ones
chapters.zh: 亚当的七世孙以诺曾预言这些人说：「看哪，主带着他的千万圣者降临，

chapters.en:
to execute judgment on everyone, and to convict all the ungodly of every ungodly act of wickedness
and every harsh word spoken against Him by ungodly sinners.”
chapters.zh: 要在众人身上行审判，证实那一切不敬虔的人所妄行一切不敬虔的事，又证实不敬虔之罪人所说顶撞他的刚愎话。」

chapters.en: These men are discontented grumblers, following after their own lusts; their mouths spew arrogance; they flatter others for their own advantage.
chapters.zh: 这些人是私下议论，常发怨言的，随从自己的情欲而行，口中说夸大的话，为得便宜谄媚人。

chapters.en: But you, beloved, remember what was foretold by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ
chapters.zh: 亲爱的〔弟兄〕啊，你们要记念我们主耶稣基督之使徒从前所说的话。

chapters.en: when they said to you, “In the last times there will be scoffers who will follow after their own ungodly desires.”
chapters.zh: 他们曾对你们说过，末世必有好讥诮的人随从自己不敬虔的私欲而行。

chapters.en: These are the ones who cause divisions, who are worldly and devoid of the Spirit.
chapters.zh: 这就是那些引人结党、属乎血气、没有〔圣〕灵的人。

chapters.en: But you, beloved, by building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit,
chapters.zh: 亲爱的〔弟兄〕啊，你们却要在至圣的真道上造就自己，在圣灵里祷告，

chapters.en: keep yourselves in the love of God as you await the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you eternal life.
chapters.zh: 保守自己常在上帝的爱中，仰望我们主耶稣基督的怜悯，直到永生。

chapters.en: And indeed, have mercy on those who doubt;
chapters.zh: 有些人存疑心，你们要怜悯他们；

chapters.en: save others by snatching them from the fire; and to still others show mercy tempered with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
chapters.zh: 有些人你们要从火中抢出来，搭救他们；有些人你们要存惧怕的心怜悯他们，连那被情欲沾染的衣服也当厌恶。

chapters.en: Now to Him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you unblemished in His glorious presence, with great joy—
chapters.zh: 那能保守你们不失脚、叫你们无瑕无疵、欢欢喜喜站在他荣耀之前的我们的救主－独一的上帝，

chapters.en:
to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord before all time, and now, and for all eternity.
Amen.
chapters.zh: 愿荣耀、威严、能力、权柄，因我们的主耶稣基督归与他，从万古以前并现今，直到永永远远。阿们！

chapters.en: This is the revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants what must soon come to pass. He made it known by sending His angel to His servant John,
chapters.zh: 耶稣基督的启示，就是上帝赐给他，叫他将必要快成的事指示他的众仆人。他就差遣使者晓谕他的仆人约翰。

chapters.en: who testifies to everything he saw. This is the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
chapters.zh: 约翰便将上帝的道和耶稣基督的见证，凡自己所看见的都证明出来。

chapters.en: Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear and obey what is written in it, because the time is near.
chapters.zh: 念这书上预言的和那些听见又遵守其中所记载的，都是有福的，因为日期近了。

chapters.en:
John,
To the seven churches in the province of Asia:
Grace and peace to you from Him who is and was and is to come, and from the seven spirits before His throne,
chapters.zh: 约翰写信给亚细亚的七个教会。但愿从那昔在、今在、以后永在的〔上帝〕，和他宝座前的七灵，

chapters.en:
and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth.
To Him who loves us and has released us from our sins by His blood,
chapters.zh: 并那诚实作见证的、从死里首先复活、为世上君王元首的耶稣基督，有恩惠、平安归与你们！ 他爱我们，用自己的血使我们脱离〔注：有古卷：洗去〕罪恶，

chapters.en: who has made us to be a kingdom, priests to His God and Father—to Him be the glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
chapters.zh: 又使我们成为国民，作他父上帝的祭司。但愿荣耀、权能归给他，直到永永远远。阿们！

chapters.en: Behold, He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him—even those who pierced Him. And all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him. So shall it be! Amen.
chapters.zh: 看哪，他驾云降临！ 众目要看见他， 连刺他的人也要看见他； 地上的万族都要因他哀哭。 这话是真实的。阿们！

chapters.en: “I am the Alpha and the Omega, ” says the Lord God, who is and was and is to come—the Almighty.
chapters.zh: 主上帝说：「我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛〔注：阿拉法，俄梅戛：是希腊字母首末二字〕，是昔在、今在、以后〔永〕在的全能者。」

chapters.en: I, John, your brother and partner in the tribulation and kingdom and perseverance that are in Jesus, was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and my testimony about Jesus.
chapters.zh: 我－约翰就是你们的弟兄，和你们在耶稣的患难、国度、忍耐里一同有分，为上帝的道，并为给耶稣作的见证，曾在那名叫拔摩的海岛上。

chapters.en: On the Lord’s day I was in the Spirit, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,
chapters.zh: 当主日，我被〔圣〕灵感动，听见在我后面有大声音如吹号，说：

chapters.en: saying, “Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
chapters.zh: 「你所看见的当写在书上，达与以弗所、士每拿、别迦摩、推雅推喇、撒狄、非拉铁非、老底嘉那七个教会。」

chapters.en: Then I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me. And having turned, I saw seven golden lampstands,
chapters.zh: 我转过身来，要看是谁发声与我说话；既转过来，就看见七个金灯台。

chapters.en: and among the lampstands was One like the Son of Man, dressed in a long robe, with a golden sash around His chest.
chapters.zh: 灯台中间有一位好像人子，身穿长衣，直垂到脚，胸间束着金带。

chapters.en: The hair of His head was white like wool, as white as snow, and His eyes were like a blazing fire.
chapters.zh: 他的头与发皆白，如白羊毛，如雪；眼目如同火焰；

chapters.en: His feet were like polished bronze refined in a furnace, and His voice was like the roar of many waters.
chapters.zh: 脚好像在炉中锻鍊光明的铜；声音如同众水的声音。

chapters.en: He held in His right hand seven stars, and a sharp double-edged sword came from His mouth. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
chapters.zh: 他右手拿着七星，从他口中出来一把两刃的利剑；面貌如同烈日放光。

chapters.en: When I saw Him, I fell at His feet like a dead man. But He placed His right hand on me and said, “Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last,
chapters.zh: 我一看见，就仆倒在他脚前，像死了一样。他用右手按着我，说：「不要惧怕！我是首先的，我是末后的，

chapters.en: the Living One. I was dead, and behold, now I am alive forever and ever! And I hold the keys of Death and of Hades.
chapters.zh: 又是那存活的；我曾死过，现在又活了，直活到永永远远；并且拿着死亡和阴间的钥匙。

chapters.en: Therefore write down the things you have seen, the things that are, and the things that will happen after this.
chapters.zh: 所以你要把所看见的，和现在的事，并将来必成的事，都写出来。

chapters.en: This is the mystery of the seven stars you saw in My right hand and of the seven golden lampstands: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.
chapters.zh: 论到你所看见、在我右手中的七星和七个金灯台的奥祕，那七星就是七个教会的使者，七灯台就是七个教会。」

chapters.en:
“To the angel of the church in Ephesus write:
These are the words of Him who holds the seven stars in His right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands.
chapters.zh: 「你要写信给以弗所教会的使者，说：『那右手拿着七星、在七个金灯台中间行走的，说：

chapters.en: I know your deeds, your labor, and your perseverance. I know that you cannot tolerate those who are evil, and you have tested and exposed as liars those who falsely claim to be apostles.
chapters.zh: 我知道你的行为、劳碌、忍耐，也知道你不能容忍恶人。你也曾试验那自称为使徒却不是使徒的，看出他们是假的来。

chapters.en: Without growing weary, you have persevered and endured many things for the sake of My name.
chapters.zh: 你也能忍耐，曾为我的名劳苦，并不乏倦。

chapters.en: But I have this against you: You have abandoned your first love.
chapters.zh: 然而有一件事我要责备你，就是你把起初的爱心离弃了。

chapters.en: Therefore, keep in mind how far you have fallen. Repent and perform the deeds you did at first. But if you do not repent, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.
chapters.zh: 所以，应当回想你是从哪里坠落的，并要悔改，行起初所行的事。你若不悔改，我就临到你那里，把你的灯台从原处挪去。

chapters.en: But you have this to your credit: You hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
chapters.zh: 然而你还有一件可取的事，就是你恨恶尼哥拉一党人的行为，这也是我所恨恶的。

chapters.en: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to eat from the tree of life in the Paradise of God.
chapters.zh: 〔圣〕灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！得胜的，我必将上帝乐园中生命树的果子赐给他吃。』」

chapters.en:
To the angel of the church in Smyrna write:
These are the words of the First and the Last, who died and returned to life.
chapters.zh: 「你要写信给士每拿教会的使者，说：『那首先的、末后的、死过又活的，说：

chapters.en: I know your affliction and your poverty—though you are rich! And I am aware of the slander of those who falsely claim to be Jews, but are in fact a synagogue of Satan.
chapters.zh: 我知道你的患难，你的贫穷（你却是富足的），也知道那自称是犹太人所说的毁谤话，其实他们不是犹太人，乃是撒但一会的人。

chapters.en: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will suffer tribulation for ten days. Be faithful even unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.
chapters.zh: 你将要受的苦你不用怕。魔鬼要把你们中间几个人下在监里，叫你们被试炼，你们必受患难十日。你务要至死忠心，我就赐给你那生命的冠冕。

chapters.en: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who overcomes will not be harmed by the second death.
chapters.zh: 〔圣〕灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！得胜的，必不受第二次死的害。』」

chapters.en:
To the angel of the church in Pergamum write:
These are the words of the One who holds the sharp, double-edged sword.
chapters.zh: 「你要写信给别迦摩教会的使者，说：『那有两刃利剑的，说：

chapters.en: I know where you live, where the throne of Satan sits, yet you hold fast to My name. You did not deny your faith in Me, even in the days of My faithful witness Antipas, who was killed among you where Satan dwells.
chapters.zh: 我知道你的居所，就是有撒但座位之处；当我忠心的见证人安提帕在你们中间、撒但所住的地方被杀之时，你还坚守我的名，没有弃绝我的道。

chapters.en: But I have a few things against you, because some of you hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to place a stumbling block before the Israelites so they would eat food sacrificed to idols and commit sexual immorality.
chapters.zh: 然而，有几件事我要责备你：因为在你那里有人服从了巴兰的教训；这巴兰曾教导巴勒将绊脚石放在以色列人面前，叫他们吃祭偶像之物，行奸淫的事。

chapters.en: In the same way, some of you also hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
chapters.zh: 你那里也有人照样服从了尼哥拉一党人的教训。

chapters.en: Therefore repent! Otherwise I will come to you shortly and wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.
chapters.zh: 所以，你当悔改；若不悔改，我就快临到你那里，用我口中的剑攻击他们。

chapters.en: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will give the hidden manna. I will also give him a white stone inscribed with a new name, known only to the one who receives it.
chapters.zh: 〔圣〕灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！得胜的，我必将那隐藏的吗哪赐给他，并赐他一块白石，石上写着新名；除了那领受的以外，没有人能认识。』」

chapters.en:
To the angel of the church in Thyatira write:
These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like a blazing fire and whose feet are like polished bronze.
chapters.zh: 「你要写信给推雅推喇教会的使者，说：『那眼目如火焰、脚像光明铜的上帝之子说：

chapters.en: I know your deeds—your love, your faith, your service, your perseverance—and your latest deeds are greater than your first.
chapters.zh: 我知道你的行为、爱心、信心、勤劳、忍耐，又知道你末后所行的〔善〕事，比起初所行的更多。

chapters.en: But I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. By her teaching she misleads My servants to be sexually immoral and to eat food sacrificed to idols.
chapters.zh: 然而，有一件事我要责备你，就是你容让那自称是先知的妇人耶洗别教导我的仆人，引诱他们行奸淫，吃祭偶像之物。

chapters.en: Even though I have given her time to repent of her immorality, she is unwilling.
chapters.zh: 我曾给她悔改的机会，她却不肯悔改她的淫行。

chapters.en: Behold, I will cast her onto a bed of sickness, and those who commit adultery with her will suffer great tribulation unless they repent of her deeds.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我要叫她病卧在床。那些与她行淫的人，若不悔改所行的，我也要叫他们同受大患难。

chapters.en: Then I will strike her children dead, and all the churches will know that I am the One who searches minds and hearts, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.
chapters.zh: 我又要杀死她的党类〔注：原文是儿女〕，叫众教会知道，我是那察看人肺腑心肠的，并要照你们的行为报应你们各人。

chapters.en: But I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not hold to her teaching and have not learned the so-called deep things of Satan: I will place no further burden upon you
chapters.zh: 至于你们推雅推喇其余的人，就是一切不从那教训、不晓得他们素常所说撒但深奥之理的人，我告诉你们，我不将别的担子放在你们身上。

chapters.en: than to hold fast to what you have until I come.
chapters.zh: 但你们已经有的，总要持守，直等到我来。

chapters.en: And to the one who overcomes and continues in My work until the end, I will give authority over the nations.
chapters.zh: 那得胜又遵守我命令到底的，我要赐给他权柄制伏列国；

chapters.en: He will rule them with an iron scepter and shatter them like pottery —just as I have received authority from My Father.
chapters.zh: 他必用铁杖辖管〔注：辖管：原文是牧〕他们，将他们如同窑户的瓦器打得粉碎，像我从我父领受的权柄一样。

chapters.en: And I will give him the morning star.
chapters.zh: 我又要把晨星赐给他。

chapters.en: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
chapters.zh: 〔圣〕灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！』」

chapters.en:
“To the angel of the church in Sardis write:
These are the words of the One who holds the seven spirits of God and the seven stars.
I know your deeds; you have a reputation for being alive, yet you are dead.
chapters.zh: 「你要写信给撒狄教会的使者，说：『那有上帝的七灵和七星的，说：我知道你的行为，按名你是活的，其实是死的。

chapters.en: Wake up and strengthen what remains, which is about to die; for I have found your deeds incomplete in the sight of My God.
chapters.zh: 你要警醒，坚固那剩下将要衰微〔注：原文是死〕的；因我见你的行为，在我上帝面前，没有一样是完全的。

chapters.en: Remember, then, what you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know the hour when I will come upon you.
chapters.zh: 所以要回想你是怎样领受、怎样听见的，又要遵守，并要悔改。若不警醒，我必临到你那里，如同贼一样。我几时临到，你也决不能知道。

chapters.en: But you do have a few people in Sardis who have not soiled their garments, and because they are worthy, they will walk with Me in white.
chapters.zh: 然而在撒狄，你还有几名是未曾污秽自己衣服的，他们要穿白衣与我同行，因为他们是配得过的。

chapters.en: Like them, he who overcomes will be dressed in white. And I will never blot out his name from the Book of Life, but I will confess his name before My Father and His angels.
chapters.zh: 凡得胜的必这样穿白衣，我也必不从生命册上涂抹他的名；且要在我父面前，和我父众使者面前，认他的名。

chapters.en: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
chapters.zh: 〔圣〕灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！』」

chapters.en:
To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write:
These are the words of the One who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What He opens no one can shut, and what He shuts no one can open.
chapters.zh: 「你要写信给非拉铁非教会的使者，说：『那圣洁、真实、拿着大卫的钥匙、开了就没有人能关、关了就没有人能开的，说：

chapters.en: I know your deeds. Behold, I have placed before you an open door, which no one can shut. I know that you have only a little strength, yet you have kept My word and have not denied My name.
chapters.zh: 我知道你的行为，你略有一点力量，也曾遵守我的道，没有弃绝我的名。看哪，我在你面前给你一个敞开的门，是无人能关的。

chapters.en: As for those who belong to the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews but are liars instead, I will make them come and bow down at your feet, and they will know that I love you.
chapters.zh: 那撒但一会的，自称是犹太人，其实不是犹太人，乃是说谎话的，我要使他们来，在你脚前下拜，也使他们知道我是已经爱你了。

chapters.en: Because you have kept My command to persevere, I will also keep you from the hour of testing that is about to come upon the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
chapters.zh: 你既遵守我忍耐的道，我必在普天下人受试炼的时候，保守你免去你的试炼。

chapters.en: I am coming soon. Hold fast to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.
chapters.zh: 我必快来，你要持守你所有的，免得人夺去你的冠冕。

chapters.en: The one who overcomes I will make a pillar in the temple of My God, and he will never again leave it. Upon him I will write the name of My God, and the name of the city of My God (the new Jerusalem that comes down out of heaven from My God), and My new name.
chapters.zh: 得胜的，我要叫他在我上帝殿中作柱子，他也必不再从那里出去。我又要将我上帝的名和我上帝城的名（这城就是从天上、从我上帝那里降下来的新耶路撒冷），并我的新名，都写在他上面。

chapters.en: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
chapters.zh: 〔圣〕灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！』」

chapters.en:
To the angel of the church in Laodicea write:
These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true Witness, the Originator of God’s creation.
chapters.zh: 「你要写信给老底嘉教会的使者，说：『那为阿们的，为诚信真实见证的，在上帝创造万物之上为元首的，说：

chapters.en: I know your deeds; you are neither cold nor hot. How I wish you were one or the other!
chapters.zh: 我知道你的行为，你也不冷也不热；我巴不得你或冷或热。

chapters.en: So because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to vomit you out of My mouth!
chapters.zh: 你既〔如〕温〔水〕，也不冷也不热，所以我必从我口中把你吐出去。

chapters.en: You say, ‘I am rich; I have grown wealthy and need nothing.’ But you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
chapters.zh: 你说：我是富足，已经发了财，一样都不缺；却不知道你是那困苦、可怜、贫穷、瞎眼、赤身的。

chapters.en: I counsel you to buy from Me gold refined by fire so that you may become rich, white garments so that you may be clothed and your shameful nakedness not exposed, and salve to anoint your eyes so that you may see.
chapters.zh: 我劝你向我买火炼的金子，叫你富足；又买白衣穿上，叫你赤身的羞耻不露出来；又买眼药擦你的眼睛，使你能看见。

chapters.en: Those I love I rebuke and discipline. Therefore be earnest and repent.
chapters.zh: 凡我所疼爱的，我就责备管教他；所以你要发热心，也要悔改。

chapters.en: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in and dine with him, and he with Me.
chapters.zh: 看哪，我站在门外叩门，若有听见我声音就开门的，我要进到他那里去，我与他，他与我一同坐席。

chapters.en: To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to sit with Me on My throne, just as I overcame and sat down with My Father on His throne.
chapters.zh: 得胜的，我要赐他在我宝座上与我同坐，就如我得了胜，在我父的宝座上与他同坐一般。

chapters.en: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.”
chapters.zh: 〔圣〕灵向众教会所说的话，凡有耳的，就应当听！』」

chapters.en: After this I looked and saw a door standing open in heaven. And the voice I had previously heard speak to me like a trumpet was saying, “Come up here, and I will show you what must happen after these things.”
chapters.zh: 此后，我观看，见天上有门开了。我初次听见好像吹号的声音，对我说：「你上到这里来，我要将以后必成的事指示你。」

chapters.en: At once I was in the Spirit, and I saw a throne standing in heaven, with someone seated on it.
chapters.zh: 我立刻被〔圣〕灵感动，见有一个宝座安置在天上，又有一位坐在宝座上。

chapters.en: The One seated there looked like jasper and carnelian, and a rainbow that gleamed like an emerald encircled the throne.
chapters.zh: 看那坐着的，好像碧玉和红宝石；又有虹围着宝座，好像绿宝石。

chapters.en: Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and on these thrones sat twenty-four elders dressed in white, with golden crowns on their heads.
chapters.zh: 宝座的周围又有二十四个座位；其上坐着二十四位长老，身穿白衣，头上戴着金冠冕。

chapters.en: From the throne came flashes of lightning, rumblings, and peals of thunder. Before the throne burned seven torches of fire. These are the seven spirits of God.
chapters.zh: 有闪电、声音、雷轰从宝座中发出；又有七盏火灯在宝座前点着；这七灯就是上帝的七灵。

chapters.en: And before the throne was something like a sea of glass, as clear as crystal. In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures, covered with eyes in front and back.
chapters.zh: 宝座前好像一个玻璃海，如同水晶。 宝座中和宝座周围有四个活物，前后遍体都满了眼睛。

chapters.en: The first living creature was like a lion, the second like a calf, the third had a face like a man, and the fourth was like an eagle in flight.
chapters.zh: 第一个活物像狮子，第二个像牛犊，第三个脸面像人，第四个像飞鹰。

chapters.en:
And each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and within. Day and night they never stop saying:
“Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty,
who was and is and is to come!”
chapters.zh: 四活物各有六个翅膀，遍体内外都满了眼睛。他们昼夜不住地说： 圣哉！圣哉！圣哉！ 主上帝是昔在、今在、 以后〔永〕在的全能者。

chapters.en: And whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the One seated on the throne, who lives forever and ever,
chapters.zh: 每逢四活物将荣耀、尊贵、感谢归给那坐在宝座上、活到永永远远者的时候，

chapters.en: the twenty-four elders fall down before the One seated on the throne, and they worship Him who lives forever and ever. They cast their crowns before the throne, saying:
chapters.zh: 那二十四位长老就俯伏在坐宝座的面前敬拜那活到永永远远的，又把他们的冠冕放在宝座前，说：

chapters.en: “Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things; by Your will they exist and were created.”
chapters.zh: 我们的主，我们的上帝， 你是配得荣耀、尊贵、权柄的； 因为你创造了万物， 并且万物是因你的旨意被创造而有的。

chapters.en: Then I saw a scroll in the right hand of the One seated on the throne. It had writing on both sides and was sealed with seven seals.
chapters.zh: 我看见坐宝座的右手中有书卷，里外都写着字，用七印封严了。

chapters.en: And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, “Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?”
chapters.zh: 我又看见一位大力的天使大声宣传说：「有谁配展开那书卷，揭开那七印呢？」

chapters.en: But no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
chapters.zh: 在天上、地上、地底下，没有能展开、能观看那书卷的。

chapters.en: And I began to weep bitterly, because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
chapters.zh: 因为没有配展开、配观看那书卷的，我就大哭。

chapters.en: Then one of the elders said to me, “Do not weep! Behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed to open the scroll and its seven seals.”
chapters.zh: 长老中有一位对我说：「不要哭！看哪，犹大支派中的狮子，大卫的根，他已得胜，能以展开那书卷，揭开那七印。」

chapters.en: Then I saw a Lamb who appeared to have been slain, standing in the center of the throne, encircled by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes, which represent the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
chapters.zh: 我又看见宝座与四活物，并长老之中有羔羊站立，像是被杀过的，有七角七眼，就是上帝的七灵，奉差遣往普天下去的。

chapters.en: And He came and took the scroll from the right hand of the One seated on the throne.
chapters.zh: 这羔羊前来，从坐宝座的右手里拿了书卷。

chapters.en: When He had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp, and they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
chapters.zh: 他既拿了书卷，四活物和二十四位长老就俯伏在羔羊面前，各拿着琴和盛满了香的金炉；这香就是众圣徒的祈祷。

chapters.en:
And they sang a new song:
“Worthy are You to take the scroll and open its seals, because You were slain, and by Your blood You purchased for God those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation.
chapters.zh: 他们唱新歌，说： 你配拿书卷， 配揭开七印； 因为你曾被杀， 用自己的血 从各族、各方、各民、各国中买了人来， 叫他们归于上帝，

chapters.en:
You have made them to be a kingdom and priests to serve our God,
and they will reign upon the earth.”
chapters.zh: 又叫他们成为国民， 作祭司归于上帝， 在地上执掌王权。

chapters.en: Then I looked, and I heard the voices of many angels encircling the throne, and the living creatures and the elders. And their number was myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands.
chapters.zh: 我又看见且听见，宝座与活物并长老的周围有许多天使的声音；他们的数目有千千万万，

chapters.en:
In a loud voice they were saying:
“Worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing!”
chapters.zh: 大声说： 曾被杀的羔羊是配得 权柄、丰富、智慧、能力、 尊贵、荣耀、颂赞的。

chapters.en:
And I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and all that is in them, saying:
“To Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power forever and ever!”
chapters.zh: 我又听见在天上、地上、地底下、沧海里，和天地间一切所有被造之物，都说： 但愿颂赞、尊贵、荣耀、权势 都归给坐宝座的和羔羊， 直到永永远远！

chapters.en: And the four living creatures said, “Amen,” and the elders fell down and worshiped.
chapters.zh: 四活物就说：「阿们！」众长老也俯伏敬拜。

chapters.en: Then I watched as the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures say in a voice like thunder, “Come!”
chapters.zh: 我看见羔羊揭开七印中第一印的时候，就听见四活物中的一个活物，声音如雷，说：「你来！」

chapters.en: So I looked and saw a white horse, and its rider held a bow. And he was given a crown, and he rode out to overcome and conquer.
chapters.zh: 我就观看，见有一匹白马；骑在马上的，拿着弓，并有冠冕赐给他。他便出来，胜了又要胜。

chapters.en: And when the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come!”
chapters.zh: 揭开第二印的时候，我听见第二个活物说：「你来！」

chapters.en: Then another horse went forth. It was bright red, and its rider was granted permission to take away peace from the earth and to make men slay one another. And he was given a great sword.
chapters.zh: 就另有一匹马出来，是红的，有权柄给了那骑马的，可以从地上夺去太平，使人彼此相杀；又有一把大刀赐给他。

chapters.en:
And when the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come!”
Then I looked and saw a black horse, and its rider held in his hand a pair of scales.
chapters.zh: 揭开第三印的时候，我听见第三个活物说：「你来！」我就观看，见有一匹黑马；骑在马上的，手里拿着天平。

chapters.en: And I heard what sounded like a voice from among the four living creatures, saying, “A quart of wheat for a denarius, and three quarts of barley for a denarius, and do not harm the oil and wine.”
chapters.zh: 我听见在四活物中似乎有声音说：「一钱银子买一升麦子，一钱银子买三升大麦；油和酒不可糟蹋。」

chapters.en: And when the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come!”
chapters.zh: 揭开第四印的时候，我听见第四个活物说：「你来！」

chapters.en: Then I looked and saw a pale green horse. Its rider’s name was Death, and Hades followed close behind. And they were given authority over a fourth of the earth, to kill by sword, by famine, by plague, and by the beasts of the earth.
chapters.zh: 我就观看，见有一匹灰色马；骑在马上的，名字叫作死，阴府也随着他；有权柄赐给他们，可以用刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫〔注：或译：死亡〕、野兽，杀害地上四分之一的人。

chapters.en: And when the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain for the word of God and for the testimony they had upheld.
chapters.zh: 揭开第五印的时候，我看见在祭坛底下，有为上帝的道、并为作见证被杀之人的灵魂，

chapters.en: And they cried out in a loud voice, “How long, O Lord, holy and true, until You judge those who dwell upon the earth and avenge our blood?”
chapters.zh: 大声喊着说：「圣洁真实的主啊，你不审判住在地上的人，给我们伸流血的冤，要等到几时呢？」

chapters.en: Then each of them was given a white robe and told to rest a little while longer until the full number of their fellow servants, their brothers, were killed, just as they had been killed.
chapters.zh: 于是有白衣赐给他们各人；又有话对他们说，还要安息片时，等着一同作仆人的和他们的弟兄也像他们被杀，满足了数目。

chapters.en: And I watched as the Lamb opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake, and the sun became black like sackcloth of goat hair, and the whole moon turned blood red,
chapters.zh: 揭开第六印的时候，我又看见地大震动，日头变黑像毛布，满月变〔红〕像血，

chapters.en: and the stars of the sky fell to the earth like unripe figs dropping from a tree shaken by a great wind.
chapters.zh: 天上的星辰坠落于地，如同无花果树被大风摇动，落下未熟的果子一样。

chapters.en: The sky receded like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved from its place.
chapters.zh: 天就挪移，好像书卷被卷起来；山岭海岛都被挪移离开本位。

chapters.en: Then the kings of the earth, the nobles, the commanders, the rich, the mighty, and every slave and free man hid in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
chapters.zh: 地上的君王、臣宰、将军、富户、壮士，和一切为奴的、自主的，都藏在山洞和巖石穴里，

chapters.en: And they said to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us and hide us from the face of the One seated on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb.
chapters.zh: 向山和巖石说：「倒在我们身上吧！把我们藏起来，躲避坐宝座者的面目和羔羊的忿怒；

chapters.en: For the great day of Their wrath has come, and who is able to withstand it?”
chapters.zh: 因为他们忿怒的大日到了，谁能站得住呢？」

chapters.en: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back its four winds so that no wind would blow on land or sea or on any tree.
chapters.zh: 此后，我看见四位天使站在地的四角，执掌地上四方的风，叫风不吹在地上、海上，和树上。

chapters.en: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, with the seal of the living God. And he called out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and the sea:
chapters.zh: 我又看见另有一位天使，从日出之地上来，拿着永生上帝的印。他就向那得着权柄能伤害地和海的四位天使大声喊着说：

chapters.en: “Do not harm the land or sea or trees until we have placed a seal on the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
chapters.zh: 「地与海并树木，你们不可伤害，等我们印了我们上帝众仆人的额。」

chapters.en: And I heard the number of those who were sealed, 144,000 from all the tribes of Israel:
chapters.zh: 我听见以色列人各支派中受印的数目有十四万四千。
犹大支派中受印的有一万二千；吕便支派中有一万二千；迦得支派中有一万二千；
亚设支派中有一万二千；拿弗他利支派中有一万二千；玛拿西支派中有一万二千；
西缅支派中有一万二千；利未支派中有一万二千；以萨迦支派中有一万二千；
西布伦支派中有一万二千；约瑟支派中有一万二千；便雅悯支派中受印的有一万二千。

chapters.en: After this I looked and saw a multitude too large to count, from every nation and tribe and people and tongue, standing before the throne and before the Lamb. They were wearing white robes and holding palm branches in their hands.
chapters.zh: 此后，我观看，见有许多的人，没有人能数过来，是从各国、各族、各民、各方来的，站在宝座和羔羊面前，身穿白衣，手拿棕树枝，

chapters.en:
And they cried out in a loud voice:
“Salvation to our God, who sits on the throne,
and to the Lamb!”
chapters.zh: 大声喊着说：「愿救恩归与坐在宝座上我们的上帝，也归与羔羊！」

chapters.en: And all the angels stood around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures. And they fell facedown before the throne and worshiped God,
chapters.zh: 众天使都站在宝座和众长老并四活物的周围，在宝座前，面伏于地，敬拜上帝，

chapters.en: saying, “Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”
chapters.zh: 说： 阿们！颂赞、荣耀、智慧、 感谢、尊贵、权柄、大力 都归与我们的上帝， 直到永永远远。阿们！

chapters.en: Then one of the elders addressed me: “These in white robes,” he asked, “who are they, and where have they come from?”
chapters.zh: 长老中有一位问我说：「这些穿白衣的是谁？是从哪里来的？」

chapters.en:
“Sir,” I answered, “you know.”
So he replied, “These are the ones who have come out of the great tribulation; they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
chapters.zh: 我对他说：「我主，你知道。」他向我说：「这些人是从大患难中出来的，曾用羔羊的血把衣裳洗白净了。

chapters.en:
For this reason,
they are before the throne of God and serve Him day and night in His temple; and the One seated on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them.
chapters.zh: 所以，他们在上帝宝座前，昼夜在他殿中事奉他。坐宝座的要用帐幕覆庇他们。

chapters.en: ‘Never again will they hunger, and never will they thirst; nor will the sun beat down upon them, nor any scorching heat.’
chapters.zh: 他们不再饥，不再渴；日头和炎热也必不伤害他们。

chapters.en: For the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. ‘He will lead them to springs of living water,’ and ‘God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’ ”
chapters.zh: 因为宝座中的羔羊必牧养他们，领他们到生命水的泉源；上帝也必擦去他们一切的眼泪。」

chapters.en: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
chapters.zh: 羔羊揭开第七印的时候，天上寂静约有二刻。

chapters.en: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and they were given seven trumpets.
chapters.zh: 我看见那站在上帝面前的七位天使，有七枝号赐给他们。

chapters.en: Then another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense to offer, along with the prayers of all the saints, on the golden altar before the throne.
chapters.zh: 另有一位天使，拿着金香炉来，站在祭坛旁边。有许多香赐给他，要和众圣徒的祈祷一同献在宝座前的金坛上。

chapters.en: And the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of the saints, rose up before God from the hand of the angel.
chapters.zh: 那香的烟和众圣徒的祈祷从天使的手中一同升到上帝面前。

chapters.en: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it to the earth; and there were peals of thunder, rumblings, flashes of lightning, and an earthquake.
chapters.zh: 天使拿着香炉，盛满了坛上的火，倒在地上；随有雷轰、大声、闪电、地震。

chapters.en: And the seven angels with the seven trumpets prepared to sound them.
chapters.zh: 拿着七枝号的七位天使就预备要吹。

chapters.en: Then the first angel sounded his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood were hurled down upon the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, along with a third of the trees and all the green grass.
chapters.zh: 第一位天使吹号，就有雹子与火搀着血丢在地上；地的三分之一和树的三分之一被烧了，一切的青草也被烧了。

chapters.en: Then the second angel sounded his trumpet, and something like a great mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,
chapters.zh: 第二位天使吹号，就有仿佛火烧着的大山扔在海中；海的三分之一变成血，

chapters.en: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
chapters.zh: 海中的活物死了三分之一，船只也坏了三分之一。

chapters.en: Then the third angel sounded his trumpet, and a great star burning like a torch fell from heaven and landed on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
chapters.zh: 第三位天使吹号，就有烧着的大星，好像火把从天上落下来，落在江河的三分之一和众水的泉源上。

chapters.en: The name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters turned bitter like wormwood oil, and many people died from the bitter waters.
chapters.zh: （这星名叫「茵蔯」。）众水的三分之一变为茵蔯，因水变苦，就死了许多人。

chapters.en: Then the fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and a third of the sun and moon and stars were struck. A third of the stars were darkened, a third of the day was without light, and a third of the night as well.
chapters.zh: 第四位天使吹号，日头的三分之一、月亮的三分之一、星辰的三分之一都被击打，以致日月星的三分之一黑暗了，白昼的三分之一没有光，黑夜也是这样。

chapters.en: And as I observed, I heard an eagle flying overhead, calling in a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded by the remaining three angels!”
chapters.zh: 我又看见一个鹰飞在空中，并听见牠大声说：「三位天使要吹那其余的号。你们住在地上的民，祸哉！祸哉！祸哉！」

chapters.en: Then the fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from heaven to earth, and it was given the key to the pit of the Abyss.
chapters.zh: 第五位天使吹号，我就看见一个星从天落到地上，有无底坑的钥匙赐给它。

chapters.en: The star opened the pit of the Abyss, and smoke rose out of it like the smoke of a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened by the smoke from the pit.
chapters.zh: 它开了无底坑，便有烟从坑里往上冒，好像大火炉的烟；日头和天空都因这烟昏暗了。

chapters.en: And out of the smoke, locusts descended on the earth, and they were given power like that of the scorpions of the earth.
chapters.zh: 有蝗虫从烟中出来，飞到地上；有能力赐给牠们，好像地上蠍子的能力一样，

chapters.en: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
chapters.zh: 并且吩咐牠们说，不可伤害地上的草和各样青物，并一切树木，惟独要伤害额上没有上帝印记的人。

chapters.en: The locusts were not given power to kill them, but only to torment them for five months, and their torment was like the stinging of a scorpion.
chapters.zh: 但不许蝗虫害死他们，只叫他们受痛苦五个月。这痛苦就像蠍子螫人的痛苦一样。

chapters.en: In those days men will seek death and will not find it; they will long to die, but death will escape them.
chapters.zh: 在那些日子，人要求死，决不得死；愿意死，死却远避他们。

chapters.en: And the locusts looked like horses prepared for battle, with something like crowns of gold on their heads; and their faces were like the faces of men.
chapters.zh: 蝗虫的形状，好像预备出战的马一样，头上戴的好像金冠冕，脸面好像〔男〕人的脸面，

chapters.en: They had hair like that of women, and teeth like those of lions.
chapters.zh: 头发像女人的头发，牙齿像狮子的牙齿。

chapters.en: They also had breastplates like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the roar of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.
chapters.zh: 胸前有甲，好像铁甲。牠们翅膀的声音，好像许多车马奔跑上阵的声音。

chapters.en: They had tails with stingers like scorpions, which had the power to injure people for five months.
chapters.zh: 有尾巴像蠍子，〔尾巴上〕的毒钩能伤人五个月。

chapters.en: They were ruled by a king, the angel of the Abyss. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek it is Apollyon.
chapters.zh: 有无底坑的使者作牠们的王，按着希伯来话，名叫亚巴顿，希腊话，名叫亚玻伦。

chapters.en: The first woe has passed. Behold, two woes are still to follow.
chapters.zh: 第一样灾祸过去了，还有两样灾祸要来。

chapters.en: Then the sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar before God
chapters.zh: 第六位天使吹号，我就听见有声音从上帝面前金坛的四角出来，

chapters.en: saying to the sixth angel with the trumpet, “Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates.”
chapters.zh: 吩咐那吹号的第六位天使，说：「把那捆绑在幼发拉底大河的四个使者释放了。」

chapters.en: So the four angels who had been prepared for this hour and day and month and year were released to kill a third of mankind.
chapters.zh: 那四个使者就被释放；他们原是预备好了，到某年某月某日某时，要杀人的三分之一。

chapters.en: And the number of mounted troops was two hundred million; I heard their number.
chapters.zh: 马军有二万万；他们的数目我听见了。

chapters.en: Now the horses and riders in my vision looked like this: The riders had breastplates the colors of fire, sapphire, and sulfur. The heads of the horses were like the heads of lions, and out of their mouths proceeded fire, smoke, and sulfur.
chapters.zh: 我在异象中看见那些马和骑马的，骑马的胸前有甲如火，与紫玛瑙并硫磺。马的头好像狮子头，有火、有烟、有硫磺从马的口中出来。

chapters.en: A third of mankind was killed by the three plagues of fire, smoke, and sulfur that proceeded from their mouths.
chapters.zh: 口中所出来的火与烟并硫磺，这三样灾杀了人的三分之一。

chapters.en: For the power of the horses was in their mouths and in their tails; indeed, their tails were like snakes, having heads with which to inflict harm.
chapters.zh: 这马的能力是在口里和尾巴上；因这尾巴像蛇，并且有头用以害人。

chapters.en: Now the rest of mankind who were not killed by these plagues still did not repent of the works of their hands. They did not stop worshiping demons and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood, which cannot see or hear or walk.
chapters.zh: 其余未曾被这些灾所杀的人仍旧不悔改自己手所做的，还是去拜鬼魔和那些不能看、不能听、不能走，金、银、铜、木、石的偶像，

chapters.en: Furthermore, they did not repent of their murder, sorcery, sexual immorality, and theft.
chapters.zh: 又不悔改他们那些凶杀、邪术、奸淫、偷窃的事。

chapters.en: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, with a rainbow above his head. His face was like the sun, and his legs were like pillars of fire.
chapters.zh: 我又看见另有一位大力的天使从天降下，披着云彩，头上有虹，脸面像日头，两脚像火柱。

chapters.en: He held in his hand a small scroll, which lay open. He placed his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
chapters.zh: 他手里拿着小书卷，是展开的。他右脚踏海，左脚踏地，

chapters.en: Then he cried out in a loud voice like the roar of a lion. And when he cried out, the seven thunders sounded their voices.
chapters.zh: 大声呼喊，好像狮子吼叫。呼喊完了，就有七雷发声。

chapters.en: When the seven thunders had spoken, I was about to put it in writing. But I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Seal up what the seven thunders have said, and do not write it down.”
chapters.zh: 七雷发声之后，我正要写出来，就听见从天上有声音说：「七雷所说的，你要封上，不可写出来。」

chapters.en: Then the angel I had seen standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to heaven.
chapters.zh: 我所看见的那踏海踏地的天使向天举起右手来，

chapters.en: And he swore by Him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and everything in it, the earth and everything in it, and the sea and everything in it: “There will be no more delay!
chapters.zh: 指着那创造天和天上之物，地和地上之物，海和海中之物，直活到永永远远的，起誓说：「不再有时日了〔注：或译：不再耽延了〕。」

chapters.en: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he begins to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be fulfilled, just as He proclaimed to His servants the prophets.”
chapters.zh: 但在第七位天使吹号发声的时候，上帝的奥祕就成全了，正如上帝所传给他仆人众先知的佳音。

chapters.en: Then the voice that I had heard from heaven spoke to me again, saying, “Go, take the small scroll that lies open in the hand of the angel standing on the sea and on the land.”
chapters.zh: 我先前从天上所听见的那声音又吩咐我说：「你去，把那踏海踏地之天使手中展开的小书卷取过来。」

chapters.en:
And I went to the angel and said, “Give me the small scroll.”
“Take it and eat it,” he said. “It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”
chapters.zh: 我就走到天使那里，对他说：「请你把小书卷给我。」他对我说：「你拿着吃尽了，便叫你肚子发苦，然而在你口中要甜如蜜。」

chapters.en: So I took the small scroll from the angel’s hand and ate it, and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth. But when I had eaten it, my stomach turned bitter.
chapters.zh: 我从天使手中把小书卷接过来，吃尽了，在我口中果然甜如蜜，吃了以后，肚子觉得发苦了。

chapters.en: And they told me, “You must prophesy again about many peoples and nations and tongues and kings.”
chapters.zh: 天使〔注：原文是他们〕对我说：「你必指着多民、多国、多方、多王再说预言。」

chapters.en: Then I was given a measuring rod like a staff and was told, “Go and measure the temple of God and the altar, and count the number of worshipers there.
chapters.zh: 有一根苇子赐给我，当作量度的杖；且有话说：「起来！将上帝的殿和祭坛，并在殿中礼拜的人都量一量。

chapters.en: But exclude the courtyard outside the temple. Do not measure it, because it has been given over to the nations, and they will trample the holy city for 42 months.
chapters.zh: 只是殿外的院子要留下不用量，因为这是给了外邦人的；他们要践踏圣城四十二个月。

chapters.en: And I will empower my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth.”
chapters.zh: 我要使我那两个见证人，穿着毛衣，传道一千二百六十天。」

chapters.en: These witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.
chapters.zh: 他们就是那两棵橄榄树，两个灯台，立在世界之主面前的。

chapters.en: If anyone wants to harm them, fire proceeds from their mouths and devours their enemies. In this way, anyone who wants to harm them must be killed.
chapters.zh: 若有人想要害他们，就有火从他们口中出来，烧灭仇敌。凡想要害他们的都必这样被杀。

chapters.en: These witnesses have power to shut the sky so that no rain will fall during the days of their prophecy, and power to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they wish.
chapters.zh: 这二人有权柄，在他们传道的日子叫天闭塞不下雨；又有权柄叫水变为血，并且能随时随意用各样的灾殃攻击世界。

chapters.en: When the two witnesses have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up from the Abyss will wage war with them, and will overpower and kill them.
chapters.zh: 他们作完见证的时候，那从无底坑里上来的兽必与他们交战，并且得胜，把他们杀了。

chapters.en: Their bodies will lie in the street of the great city—figuratively called Sodom and Egypt—where their Lord was also crucified.
chapters.zh: 他们的尸首就倒在大城里的街上；这城按着灵意叫所多玛，又叫埃及，就是他们的主钉十字架之处。

chapters.en: For three and a half days all peoples and tribes and tongues and nations will view their bodies and will not permit them to be laid in a tomb.
chapters.zh: 从各民、各族、各方、各国中，有人观看他们的尸首三天半，又不许把尸首放在坟墓里。

chapters.en: And those who dwell on the earth will gloat over them and celebrate and send one another gifts, because these two prophets had tormented them.
chapters.zh: 住在地上的人就为他们欢喜快乐，互相餽送礼物，因这两位先知曾叫住在地上的人受痛苦。

chapters.en: But after the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered the two witnesses, and they stood on their feet, and great fear fell upon those who saw them.
chapters.zh: 过了这三天半，有生气从上帝那里进入他们里面，他们就站起来；看见他们的人甚是害怕。

chapters.en: And the witnesses heard a loud voice from heaven saying, “Come up here.” And they went up to heaven in a cloud as their enemies watched them.
chapters.zh: 两位先知听见有大声音从天上来，对他们说：「上到这里来。」他们就驾着云上了天，他们的仇敌也看见了。

chapters.en: And in that hour there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city collapsed. Seven thousand were killed in the quake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
chapters.zh: 正在那时候，地大震动，城就倒塌了十分之一，因地震而死的有七千人；其余的都恐惧，归荣耀给天上的上帝。

chapters.en: The second woe has passed. Behold, the third woe is coming shortly.
chapters.zh: 第二样灾祸过去，第三样灾祸快到了。

chapters.en:
Then the seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and loud voices called out in heaven:
“The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ, and He will reign forever and ever.”
chapters.zh: 第七位天使吹号，天上就有大声音说： 世上的国成了我主和主基督的国； 他要作王，直到永永远远。

chapters.en: And the twenty-four elders who sit on their thrones before God fell on their faces and worshiped God,
chapters.zh: 在上帝面前，坐在自己位上的二十四位长老，就面伏于地，敬拜上帝，

chapters.en:
saying:
“We give thanks to You, O Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, because You have taken Your great power and have begun to reign.
chapters.zh: 说： 昔在、今在的主上帝－ 全能者啊，我们感谢你！ 因你执掌大权作王了。

chapters.en:
The nations were enraged, and Your wrath has come. The time has come to judge the dead and to reward Your servants the prophets, as well as the saints and those who fear Your name, both small and great—
and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”
chapters.zh: 外邦发怒，你的忿怒也临到了； 审判死人的时候也到了。 你的仆人众先知和众圣徒， 凡敬畏你名的人， 连大带小得赏赐的时候也到了。 你败坏那些败坏世界之人的时候也就到了。

chapters.en: Then the temple of God in heaven was opened, and the ark of His covenant appeared in His temple. And there were flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, an earthquake, and a great hailstorm.
chapters.zh: 当时，上帝天上的殿开了，在他殿中现出他的约柜。随后有闪电、声音、雷轰、地震、大雹。

chapters.en: And a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed in the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
chapters.zh: 天上现出大异象来：有一个妇人身披日头，脚踏月亮，头戴十二星的冠冕。

chapters.en: She was pregnant and crying out in the pain and agony of giving birth.
chapters.zh: 她怀了孕，在生产的艰难中疼痛呼叫。

chapters.en: Then another sign appeared in heaven: a huge red dragon with seven heads, ten horns, and seven royal crowns on his heads.
chapters.zh: 天上又现出异象来：有一条大红龙，七头十角；七头上戴着七个冠冕。

chapters.en: His tail swept a third of the stars from the sky, hurling them to the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, ready to devour her child as soon as she gave birth.
chapters.zh: 牠的尾巴拖拉着天上星辰的三分之一，摔在地上。龙就站在那将要生产的妇人面前，等她生产之后，要吞吃她的孩子。

chapters.en: And she gave birth to a son, a male child, who will rule all the nations with an iron scepter. And her child was caught up to God and to His throne.
chapters.zh: 妇人生了一个男孩子，是将来要用铁杖辖管〔注：辖管：原文是牧〕万国的；她的孩子被提到上帝宝座那里去了。

chapters.en: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where God had prepared a place for her to be nourished for 1,260 days.
chapters.zh: 妇人就逃到旷野，在那里有上帝给她预备的地方，使她被养活一千二百六十天。

chapters.en: Then a war broke out in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.
chapters.zh: 在天上就有了争战。米迦勒同他的使者与龙争战，龙也同牠的使者去争战，

chapters.en: But the dragon was not strong enough, and no longer was any place found in heaven for him and his angels.
chapters.zh: 并没有得胜，天上再没有牠们的地方。

chapters.en: And the great dragon was hurled down—that ancient serpent called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was hurled to the earth, and his angels with him.
chapters.zh: 大龙就是那古蛇，名叫魔鬼，又叫撒但，是迷惑普天下的。牠被摔在地上，牠的使者也一同被摔下去。

chapters.en:
And I heard a loud voice in heaven saying:
“Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God,
and the authority of His Christ. For the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down— he who accuses them day and night before our God.
chapters.zh: 我听见在天上有大声音说：「我上帝的救恩、能力、国度，并他基督的权柄，现在都来到了！因为那在我们上帝面前昼夜控告我们弟兄的，已经被摔下去了。

chapters.en: They have conquered him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony. And they did not love their lives so as to shy away from death.
chapters.zh: 弟兄胜过牠，是因羔羊的血和自己所见证的道。他们虽至于死，也不爱惜性命。

chapters.en:
Therefore rejoice, O heavens, and you who dwell in them! But woe to the earth and the sea; with great fury the devil has come down to you,
knowing he has only a short time.”
chapters.zh: 所以，诸天和住在其中的，你们都快乐吧！只是地与海有祸了！因为魔鬼知道自己的时候不多，就气忿忿地下到你们那里去了。」

chapters.en: And when the dragon saw that he had been thrown to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.
chapters.zh: 龙见自己被摔在地上，就逼迫那生男孩子的妇人。

chapters.en: But the woman was given two wings of a great eagle to fly from the presence of the serpent to her place in the wilderness, where she was nourished for a time, and times, and half a time.
chapters.zh: 于是有大鹰的两个翅膀赐给妇人，叫她能飞到旷野，到自己的地方，躲避那蛇；她在那里被养活一载二载半载。

chapters.en: Then from his mouth the serpent spewed water like a river to overtake the woman and sweep her away in the torrent.
chapters.zh: 蛇就在妇人身后，从口中吐出水来，像河一样，要将妇人冲去。

chapters.en: But the earth helped the woman and opened its mouth to swallow up the river that the dragon had poured from his mouth.
chapters.zh: 地却帮助妇人，开口吞了从龙口吐出来的水〔注：原文是河〕。

chapters.en:
And the dragon was enraged at the woman and went to make war with the rest of her children, who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus.
And the dragon stood on the shore of the sea.
chapters.zh: 龙向妇人发怒，去与她其余的儿女争战，这儿女就是那守上帝诫命、为耶稣作见证的。
那时龙就站在海边的沙上。

chapters.en: Then I saw a beast with ten horns and seven heads rising out of the sea. There were ten royal crowns on its horns and blasphemous names on its heads.
chapters.zh: 我又看见一个兽从海中上来，有十角七头，在十角上戴着十个冠冕，七头上有亵渎的名号。

chapters.en: The beast I saw was like a leopard, with the feet of a bear and the mouth of a lion. And the dragon gave the beast his power and his throne and great authority.
chapters.zh: 我所看见的兽，形状像豹，脚像熊的脚，口像狮子的口。那龙将自己的能力、座位，和大权柄都给了牠。

chapters.en: One of the heads of the beast appeared to have been mortally wounded. But the mortal wound was healed, and the whole world marveled and followed the beast.
chapters.zh: 我看见兽的七头中，有一个似乎受了死伤，那死伤却医好了。全地的人都希奇跟从那兽，

chapters.en: They worshiped the dragon who had given authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast, and who can wage war against it?”
chapters.zh: 又拜那龙－因为牠将自己的权柄给了兽，也拜兽，说：「谁能比这兽，谁能与牠交战呢？」

chapters.en: The beast was given a mouth to speak arrogant and blasphemous words, and authority to act for 42 months.
chapters.zh: 又赐给牠说夸大亵渎话的口，又有权柄赐给牠，可以任意而行四十二个月。

chapters.en: And the beast opened its mouth to speak blasphemies against God and to slander His name and His tabernacle—those who dwell in heaven.
chapters.zh: 兽就开口向上帝说亵渎的话，亵渎上帝的名并他的帐幕，以及那些住在天上的。

chapters.en: Then the beast was permitted to wage war against the saints and to conquer them, and it was given authority over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.
chapters.zh: 又任凭牠与圣徒争战，并且得胜；也把权柄赐给牠，制伏各族、各民、各方、各国。

chapters.en: And all who dwell on the earth will worship the beast—all whose names have not been written from the foundation of the world in the Book of Life belonging to the Lamb who was slain.
chapters.zh: 凡住在地上、名字从创世以来没有记在被杀之羔羊生命册上的人，都要拜牠。

chapters.en: He who has an ear, let him hear:
chapters.zh: 凡有耳的，就应当听！

chapters.en:
“If anyone is destined for captivity, into captivity he will go; if anyone is to die by the sword, by the sword he must be killed.”
Here is a call for the perseverance and faith of the saints.
chapters.zh: 掳掠人的，必被掳掠； 用刀杀人的，必被刀杀。 圣徒的忍耐和信心就是在此。

chapters.en: Then I saw another beast rising out of the earth. This beast had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
chapters.zh: 我又看见另有一个兽从地中上来，有两角如同羊羔，说话好像龙。

chapters.en: And this beast exercised all the authority of the first beast and caused the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose mortal wound had been healed.
chapters.zh: 牠在头一个兽面前，施行头一个兽所有的权柄，并且叫地和住在地上的人拜那死伤医好的头一个兽。

chapters.en: And the second beast performed great signs, even causing fire from heaven to come down to earth in the presence of the people.
chapters.zh: 又行大奇事，甚至在人面前，叫火从天降在地上。

chapters.en: Because of the signs it was given to perform on behalf of the first beast, it deceived those who dwell on the earth, telling them to make an image to the beast that had been wounded by the sword and yet had lived.
chapters.zh: 牠因赐给牠权柄在兽面前能行奇事，就迷惑住在地上的人，说：「要给那受刀伤还活着的兽作个像。」

chapters.en: The second beast was permitted to give breath to the image of the first beast, so that the image could speak and cause all who refused to worship it to be killed.
chapters.zh: 又有权柄赐给牠，叫兽像有生气，并且能说话，又叫所有不拜兽像的人都被杀害。

chapters.en: And the second beast required all people, small and great, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hand or on their forehead,
chapters.zh: 牠又叫众人，无论大小、贫富、自主的、为奴的，都在右手上或是在额上受一个印记。

chapters.en: so that no one could buy or sell unless he had the mark—the name of the beast or the number of its name.
chapters.zh: 除了那受印记、有了兽名或有兽名数目的，都不得做买卖。

chapters.en: Here is a call for wisdom: Let the one who has insight calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, and that number is 666.
chapters.zh: 在这里有智慧：凡有聪明的，可以算计兽的数目；因为这是人的数目，它的数目是六百六十六。

chapters.en: Then I looked and saw the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with Him 144,000 who had His name and His Father’s name written on their foreheads.
chapters.zh: 我又观看，见羔羊站在锡安山，同他又有十四万四千人，都有他的名和他父的名写在额上。

chapters.en: And I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of many waters and the loud rumbling of thunder. And the sound I heard was like harpists strumming their harps.
chapters.zh: 我听见从天上有声音，像众水的声音和大雷的声音，并且我所听见的好像弹琴的所弹的琴声。

chapters.en: And they sang a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. And no one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.
chapters.zh: 他们在宝座前，并在四活物和众长老前唱歌，仿佛是新歌；除了从地上买来的那十四万四千人以外，没有人能学这歌。

chapters.en: These are the ones who have not been defiled with women, for they are virgins. They follow the Lamb wherever He goes. They have been redeemed from among men as firstfruits to God and to the Lamb.
chapters.zh: 这些人未曾沾染妇女，他们原是童身。羔羊无论往哪里去，他们都跟随他。他们是从人间买来的，作初熟的果子归与上帝和羔羊。

chapters.en: And no lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless.
chapters.zh: 在他们口中察不出谎言来；他们是没有瑕疵的。

chapters.en: Then I saw another angel flying overhead, with the eternal gospel to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth—to every nation and tribe and tongue and people.
chapters.zh: 我又看见另有一位天使飞在空中，有永远的福音要传给住在地上的人，就是各国、各族、各方、各民。

chapters.en: And he said in a loud voice, “Fear God and give Him glory, because the hour of His judgment has come. Worship the One who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and the springs of waters.”
chapters.zh: 他大声说：「应当敬畏上帝，将荣耀归给他！因他施行审判的时候已经到了。应当敬拜那创造天地海和众水泉源的。」

chapters.en: Then a second angel followed, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, who has made all the nations drink the wine of the passion of her immorality.”
chapters.zh: 又有第二位天使接着说：「叫万民喝邪淫、大怒之酒的巴比伦大城倾倒了！倾倒了！」

chapters.en: And a third angel followed them, calling out in a loud voice, “If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives its mark on his forehead or on his hand,
chapters.zh: 又有第三位天使接着他们，大声说：「若有人拜兽和兽像，在额上或在手上受了印记，

chapters.en: he too will drink the wine of God’s anger, poured undiluted into the cup of His wrath. And he will be tormented in fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and of the Lamb.
chapters.zh: 这人也必喝上帝大怒的酒；此酒斟在上帝忿怒的杯中纯一不杂。他要在圣天使和羔羊面前，在火与硫磺之中受痛苦。

chapters.en: And the smoke of their torment rises forever and ever. Day and night there is no rest for those who worship the beast and its image, or for anyone who receives the mark of its name.”
chapters.zh: 他受痛苦的烟往上冒，直到永永远远。那些拜兽和兽像，受牠名之印记的，昼夜不得安宁。」

chapters.en: Here is a call for the perseverance of the saints, who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.
chapters.zh: 圣徒的忍耐就在此；他们是守上帝诫命和耶稣真道的。

chapters.en:
And I heard a voice from heaven telling me to write, “Blessed are the dead—those who die in the Lord from this moment on.”
“Yes,” says the Spirit, “they will rest from their labors, for their deeds will follow them.”
chapters.zh: 我听见从天上有声音说：「你要写下：从今以后，在主里面而死的人有福了！」〔圣〕灵说：「是的，他们息了自己的劳苦，做工的果效也随着他们。」

chapters.en: And I looked and saw a white cloud, and seated on the cloud was One like the Son of Man, with a golden crown on His head and a sharp sickle in His hand.
chapters.zh: 我又观看，见有一片白云，云上坐着一位好像人子，头上戴着金冠冕，手里拿着快镰刀。

chapters.en: Then another angel came out of the temple, crying out in a loud voice to the One seated on the cloud, “Swing Your sickle and reap, because the time has come to harvest, for the crop of the earth is ripe.”
chapters.zh: 又有一位天使从殿中出来，向那坐在云上的大声喊着说：「伸出你的镰刀来收割；因为收割的时候已经到了，地上的庄稼已经熟透了。」

chapters.en: So the One seated on the cloud swung His sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.
chapters.zh: 那坐在云上的，就把镰刀扔在地上，地上的庄稼就被收割了。

chapters.en: Then another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he too had a sharp sickle.
chapters.zh: 又有一位天使从天上的殿中出来，他也拿着快镰刀。

chapters.en: Still another angel, with authority over the fire, came from the altar and called out in a loud voice to the angel with the sharp sickle, “Swing your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of grapes from the vine of the earth, because its grapes are ripe.”
chapters.zh: 又有一位天使从祭坛中出来，是有权柄管火的，向拿着快镰刀的大声喊着说：「伸出快镰刀来，收取地上葡萄树的果子，因为葡萄熟透了！」

chapters.en: So the angel swung his sickle over the earth and gathered the grapes of the earth, and he threw them into the great winepress of God’s wrath.
chapters.zh: 那天使就把镰刀扔在地上，收取了地上的葡萄，丢在上帝忿怒的大酒醡中。

chapters.en: And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and the blood that flowed from it rose as high as the bridles of the horses for a distance of 1,600 stadia.
chapters.zh: 那酒醡踹在城外，就有血从酒醡里流出来，高到马的嚼环，远有六百里。

chapters.en: Then I saw another great and marvelous sign in heaven: seven angels with the seven final plagues, with which the wrath of God is completed.
chapters.zh: 我又看见在天上有异象，大而且奇，就是七位天使掌管末了的七灾，因为上帝的大怒在这七灾中发尽了。

chapters.en: And I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, beside which stood those who had conquered the beast and its image and the number of its name. They were holding harps from God,
chapters.zh: 我看见仿佛有玻璃海，其中有火搀杂。又看见那些胜了兽和兽的像并牠名字数目的人，都站在玻璃海上，拿着上帝的琴，

chapters.en:
and they sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb:
“Great and wonderful are Your works, O Lord God Almighty! Just and true are Your ways, O King of the nations!
chapters.zh: 唱上帝仆人摩西的歌和羔羊的歌，说： 主上帝－全能者啊， 你的作为大哉！奇哉！ 万世〔注：或译：国〕之王啊， 你的道途义哉！诚哉！

chapters.en:
Who will not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name?
For You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before You, for Your righteous acts have been revealed.”
chapters.zh: 主啊，谁敢不敬畏你， 不将荣耀归与你的名呢？ 因为独有你是圣的。 万民都要来在你面前敬拜， 因你公义的作为已经显出来了。

chapters.en: After this I looked, and the temple—the tabernacle of the Testimony—was opened in heaven.
chapters.zh: 此后，我看见在天上那存法柜的殿开了。

chapters.en: And out of the temple came the seven angels with the seven plagues, dressed in clean and bright linen and girded with golden sashes around their chests.
chapters.zh: 那掌管七灾的七位天使从殿中出来，穿着洁白光明的细麻衣〔注：细麻衣：有古卷是宝石〕，胸间束着金带。

chapters.en: Then one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
chapters.zh: 四活物中有一个把盛满了活到永永远远之上帝大怒的七个金碗给了那七位天使。

chapters.en: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power; and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.
chapters.zh: 因上帝的荣耀和能力，殿中充满了烟。于是没有人能以进殿，直等到那七位天使〔所降〕的七灾完毕了。

chapters.en: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, “Go, pour out on the earth the seven bowls of God’s wrath.”
chapters.zh: 我听见有大声音从殿中出来，向那七位天使说：「你们去，把盛上帝大怒的七碗倒在地上。」

chapters.en: So the first angel went and poured out his bowl on the earth, and loathsome, malignant sores broke out on those who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image.
chapters.zh: 第一位天使便去，把碗倒在地上，就有恶而且毒的疮生在那些有兽印记、拜兽像的人身上。

chapters.en: And the second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it turned to blood like that of the dead, and every living thing in the sea died.
chapters.zh: 第二位天使把碗倒在海里，海就变成血，好像死人的血，海中的活物都死了。

chapters.en: And the third angel poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they turned to blood.
chapters.zh: 第三位天使把碗倒在江河与众水的泉源里，水就变成血了。

chapters.en:
And I heard the angel of the waters say:
“Righteous are You, O Holy One, who is and was,
because You have brought these judgments.
chapters.zh: 我听见掌管众水的天使说： 昔在、今在的圣者啊， 你这样判断是公义的；

chapters.en:
For they have spilled the blood of saints and prophets, and You have given them blood to drink,
as they deserve.”
chapters.zh: 他们曾流圣徒与先知的血， 现在你给他们血喝； 这是他们所该受的。

chapters.en:
And I heard the altar reply:
“Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are Your judgments.”
chapters.zh: 我又听见祭坛〔中有声音〕说： 是的，主上帝－全能者啊， 你的判断义哉！诚哉！

chapters.en: Then the fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given power to scorch the people with fire.
chapters.zh: 第四位天使把碗倒在日头上，叫日头能用火烤人。

chapters.en: And the people were scorched by intense heat, and they cursed the name of God, who had authority over these plagues. Yet they did not repent and give Him glory.
chapters.zh: 人被大热所烤，就亵渎那有权掌管这些灾的上帝之名，并不悔改将荣耀归给上帝。

chapters.en: And the fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was plunged into darkness, and men began to gnaw their tongues in anguish
chapters.zh: 第五位天使把碗倒在兽的座位上，兽的国就黑暗了。人因疼痛就咬自己的舌头；

chapters.en: and curse the God of heaven for their pains and sores. Yet they did not repent of their deeds.
chapters.zh: 又因所受的疼痛，和生的疮，就亵渎天上的上帝，并不悔改所行的。

chapters.en: And the sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up to prepare the way for the kings of the East.
chapters.zh: 第六位天使把碗倒在幼发拉底大河上，河水就干了，要给那从日出之地所来的众王预备道路。

chapters.en: And I saw three unclean spirits that looked like frogs coming out of the mouths of the dragon, the beast, and the false prophet.
chapters.zh: 我又看见三个污秽的灵，好像青蛙，从龙口、兽口并假先知的口中出来。

chapters.en: These are demonic spirits that perform signs and go out to all the kings of the earth, to assemble them for battle on the great day of God the Almighty.
chapters.zh: 他们本是鬼魔的灵，施行奇事，出去到普天下众王那里，叫他们在上帝全能者的大日聚集争战。

chapters.en: “Behold, I am coming like a thief. Blessed is the one who remains awake and clothed, so that he will not go naked and let his shame be exposed.”
chapters.zh: （看哪，我来像贼一样。那警醒、看守衣服、免得赤身而行、叫人见他羞耻的有福了！）

chapters.en: And they assembled the kings in the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon.
chapters.zh: 那三个鬼魔便叫众王聚集在一处，希伯来话叫作哈米吉多顿。

chapters.en: Then the seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and a loud voice came from the throne in the temple, saying, “It is done!”
chapters.zh: 第七位天使把碗倒在空中，就有大声音从殿中的宝座上出来，说：「成了！」

chapters.en: And there were flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, and a great earthquake the likes of which had not occurred since men were upon the earth—so mighty was the great quake.
chapters.zh: 又有闪电、声音、雷轰、大地震，自从地上有人以来，没有这样大、这样厉害的地震。

chapters.en: The great city was split into three parts, and the cities of the nations collapsed. And God remembered Babylon the great and gave her the cup of the wine of the fury of His wrath.
chapters.zh: 那大城裂为三段，列国的城也都倒塌了；上帝也想起巴比伦大城来，要把那盛自己烈怒的酒杯递给他。

chapters.en: Then every island fled, and no mountain could be found.
chapters.zh: 各海岛都逃避了，众山也不见了。

chapters.en: And great hailstones weighing almost a hundred pounds each rained down on them from above. And men cursed God for the plague of hail, because it was so horrendous.
chapters.zh: 又有大雹子从天落在人身上，每一个约重一他连得〔注：一他连得约有九十斤〕。为这雹子的灾极大，人就亵渎上帝。

chapters.en: Then one of the seven angels with the seven bowls came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the punishment of the great prostitute, who sits on many waters.
chapters.zh: 拿着七碗的七位天使中，有一位前来对我说：「你到这里来，我将坐在众水上的大淫妇所要受的刑罚指给你看。

chapters.en: The kings of the earth were immoral with her, and those who dwell on the earth were intoxicated with the wine of her immorality.”
chapters.zh: 地上的君王与她行淫，住在地上的人喝醉了她淫乱的酒。」

chapters.en: And the angel carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness, where I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was covered with blasphemous names and had seven heads and ten horns.
chapters.zh: 我被〔圣〕灵感动，天使带我到旷野去，我就看见一个女人骑在朱红色的兽上；那兽有七头十角，遍体有亵渎的名号。

chapters.en: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls. She held in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of her sexual immorality.
chapters.zh: 那女人穿着紫色和朱红色的衣服，用金子、宝石、珍珠为妆饰；手拿金杯，杯中盛满了可憎之物，就是她淫乱的污秽。

chapters.en:
And on her forehead a mysterious name was written:
BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.
chapters.zh: 在她额上有名写着说：「奥祕哉！大巴比伦，作世上的淫妇和一切可憎之物的母。」

chapters.en: I could see that the woman was drunk with the blood of the saints and witnesses for Jesus. And I was utterly amazed at the sight of her.
chapters.zh: 我又看见那女人喝醉了圣徒的血和为耶稣作见证之人的血。 我看见她，就大大地希奇。

chapters.en: “Why are you so amazed?” said the angel. “I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and ten horns.
chapters.zh: 天使对我说：「你为什么希奇呢？我要将这女人和驮着她的那七头十角兽的奥祕告诉你。

chapters.en: The beast that you saw—it was, and now is no more, but is about to come up out of the Abyss and go to its destruction. And those who dwell on the earth whose names were not written in the Book of Life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see the beast that was, and is not, and yet will be.
chapters.zh: 你所看见的兽，先前有，如今没有，将要从无底坑里上来，又要归于沉沦。凡住在地上、名字从创世以来没有记在生命册上的，见先前有、如今没有、以后再有的兽，就必希奇。

chapters.en: This calls for a mind with wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
chapters.zh: 智慧的心在此〔可以思想〕。那七头就是女人所坐的七座山，

chapters.en: There are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, and the other has not yet come. But when he does come, he must remain for only a little while.
chapters.zh: 又是七位王；五位已经倾倒了，一位还在，一位还没有来到；他来的时候，必须暂时存留。

chapters.en: The beast that was, and now is not, is an eighth king, who belongs to the other seven and is going into destruction.
chapters.zh: 那先前有如今没有的兽，就是第八位；他也和那七位同列，并且归于沉沦。

chapters.en: The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but will receive one hour of authority as kings along with the beast.
chapters.zh: 你所看见的那十角就是十王；他们还没有得国，但他们一时之间要和兽同得权柄，与王一样。

chapters.en: These kings have one purpose: to yield their power and authority to the beast.
chapters.zh: 他们同心合意将自己的能力、权柄给那兽。

chapters.en: They will make war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will triumph over them, because He is Lord of lords and King of kings; and He will be accompanied by His called and chosen and faithful ones.”
chapters.zh: 他们与羔羊争战，羔羊必胜过他们，因为羔羊是万主之主、万王之王。同着羔羊的，就是蒙召、被选、有忠心的，〔也必得胜〕。」

chapters.en: Then the angel said to me, “The waters you saw, where the prostitute was seated, are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues.
chapters.zh: 天使又对我说：「你所看见那淫妇坐的众水，就是多民、多人、多国、多方。

chapters.en: And the ten horns and the beast that you saw will hate the prostitute. They will leave her desolate and naked, and they will eat her flesh and burn her with fire.
chapters.zh: 你所看见的那十角与兽必恨这淫妇，使她冷落赤身，又要吃她的肉，用火将她烧尽。

chapters.en: For God has put it into their hearts to carry out His purpose by uniting to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.
chapters.zh: 因为上帝使诸王同心合意，遵行他的旨意，把自己的国给那兽，直等到上帝的话都应验了。

chapters.en: And the woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth.”
chapters.zh: 你所看见的那女人就是管辖地上众王的大城。」

chapters.en: After this I saw another angel descending from heaven with great authority, and the earth was illuminated by his glory.
chapters.zh: 此后，我看见另有一位有大权柄的天使从天降下，地就因他的荣耀发光。

chapters.en:
And he cried out in a mighty voice:
“Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a lair for demons and a haunt for every unclean spirit, every unclean bird,
and every detestable beast.
chapters.zh: 他大声喊着说： 巴比伦大城倾倒了！倾倒了！ 成了鬼魔的住处 和各样污秽之灵的巢穴〔注：或译：牢狱；下同〕， 并各样污秽可憎之雀鸟的巢穴。

chapters.en:
All the nations have drunk the wine of the passion of her immorality. The kings of the earth were immoral with her, and the merchants of the earth have grown wealthy
from the extravagance of her luxury.”
chapters.zh: 因为列国都被她邪淫大怒的酒倾倒了。 地上的君王与她行淫； 地上的客商因她奢华太过就发了财。

chapters.en:
Then I heard another voice from heaven say:
“Come out of her, My people, so that you will not share in her sins
or contract any of her plagues.
chapters.zh: 我又听见从天上有声音说： 我的民哪，你们要从那城出来， 免得与她一同有罪，受她所受的灾殃；

chapters.en: For her sins are piled up to heaven, and God has remembered her iniquities.
chapters.zh: 因她的罪恶滔天； 她的不义，上帝已经想起来了。

chapters.en:
Give back to her as she has done to others; pay her back double for what she has done;
mix her a double portion in her own cup.
chapters.zh: 她怎样待人，也要怎样待她， 按她所行的加倍地报应她； 用她调酒的杯加倍地调给她〔喝〕。
