chapters.en: As much as she has glorified herself and lived in luxury, give her the same measure of torment and grief. In her heart she says, ‘I sit as queen; I am not a widow and will never see grief.’
chapters.zh: 她怎样荣耀自己，怎样奢华， 也当叫她照样痛苦悲哀， 因她心里说： 我坐了皇后的位， 并不是寡妇， 决不至于悲哀。

chapters.en: Therefore her plagues will come in one day— death and grief and famine— and she will be consumed by fire, for mighty is the Lord God who judges her.”
chapters.zh: 所以在一天之内， 她的灾殃要一齐来到， 就是死亡、悲哀、饥荒。 她又要被火烧尽了， 因为审判她的主上帝大有能力。

chapters.en: Then the kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived in luxury with her will weep and wail at the sight of the smoke rising from the fire that consumes her.
chapters.zh: 地上的君王，素来与她行淫、一同奢华的，看见烧她的烟，就必为她哭泣哀号。

chapters.en:
In fear of her torment, they will stand at a distance and cry out:
“Woe, woe to the great city, the mighty city of Babylon! For in a single hour your judgment has come.”
chapters.zh: 因怕她的痛苦，就远远地站着说：哀哉！哀哉！ 巴比伦大城，坚固的城啊， 一时之间你的刑罚就来到了。

chapters.en: And the merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over her, because there is no one left to buy their cargo—
chapters.zh: 地上的客商也都为她哭泣悲哀，因为没有人再买他们的货物了；

chapters.en: cargo of gold, silver, precious stones, and pearls; of fine linen, purple, silk, and scarlet; of all kinds of citron wood and every article of ivory, precious wood, bronze, iron, and marble;
chapters.zh: 这货物就是金、银、宝石、珍珠、细麻布、紫色料、绸子、朱红色料、各样香木、各样象牙的器皿、各样极宝贵的木头，和铜、铁、汉白玉的器皿，

chapters.en: of cinnamon, spice, incense, myrrh, and frankincense; of wine, olive oil, fine flour, and wheat; of cattle, sheep, horses, and carriages; of bodies and souls of slaves.
chapters.zh: 并肉桂、荳蔻、香料、香膏、乳香、酒、油、细面、麦子、牛、羊、车、马，和奴仆、人口。

chapters.en:
And they will say:
“The fruit of your soul’s desire has departed from you; all your luxury and splendor have vanished, never to be seen again.”
chapters.zh: 〔巴比伦〕哪，你所贪爱的果子离开了你； 你一切的珍馐美味 和华美的物件也从你中间毁灭， 决不能再见了。

chapters.en: The merchants who sold these things and gained their wealth from her will stand at a distance, in fear of her torment. They will weep and mourn,
chapters.zh: 贩卖这些货物、藉着她发了财的客商，因怕她的痛苦，就远远地站着哭泣悲哀，说：

chapters.en:
saying:
“Woe, woe to the great city, clothed in fine linen and purple and scarlet,
adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls!
chapters.zh: 哀哉！哀哉！这大城啊， 素常穿着细麻、 紫色、朱红色的衣服， 又用金子、宝石，和珍珠为妆饰。

chapters.en:
For in a single hour such fabulous wealth has been destroyed!”
Every shipmaster, passenger, and sailor, and all who make their living from the sea, will stand at a distance
chapters.zh: 一时之间，这么大的富厚就归于无有了。 凡船主和坐船往各处去的，并众水手，连所有靠海为业的，都远远地站着，

chapters.en: and cry out at the sight of the smoke rising from the fire that consumes her. “What city was ever like this great city?” they will exclaim.
chapters.zh: 看见烧她的烟，就喊着说：「有何城能比这大城呢？」

chapters.en:
Then they will throw dust on their heads as they weep and mourn and cry out:
“Woe, woe to the great city, where all who had ships on the sea
were enriched by her wealth! For in a single hour she has been destroyed.”
chapters.zh: 他们又把尘土撒在头上，哭泣悲哀，喊着说： 哀哉！哀哉！这大城啊。 凡有船在海中的，都因她的珍宝成了富足！ 她在一时之间就成了荒场！

chapters.en: Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, because God has pronounced for you His judgment against her.
chapters.zh: 天哪，众圣徒、众使徒、众先知啊， 你们都要因她欢喜， 因为上帝已经在她身上伸了你们的冤。

chapters.en:
Then a mighty angel picked up a stone the size of a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying:
“With such violence the great city of Babylon will be cast down,
never to be seen again.
chapters.zh: 有一位大力的天使举起一块石头，好像大磨石，扔在海里，说： 巴比伦大城也必这样猛力地被扔下去， 决不能再见了。

chapters.en:
And the sound of harpists and musicians, of flute players and trumpeters,
will never ring out in you again. Nor will any craftsmen of any trade be found in you again, nor the sound of a millstone be heard in you again.
chapters.zh: 弹琴、作乐、吹笛、吹号的声音， 在你中间决不能再听见； 各行手艺人在你中间决不能再遇见； 推磨的声音在你中间决不能再听见；

chapters.en: The light of a lamp will never shine in you again, and the voices of a bride and bridegroom will never call out in you again. For your merchants were the great ones of the earth, because all the nations were deceived by your sorcery.”
chapters.zh: 灯光在你中间决不能再照耀； 新郎和新妇的声音，在你中间决不能再听见。 你的客商原来是地上的尊贵人； 万国也被你的邪术迷惑了。

chapters.en: And there was found in her the blood of prophets and saints, and of all who had been slain on the earth.
chapters.zh: 先知和圣徒，并地上一切被杀之人的血，都在这城里看见了。

chapters.en:
After this I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude in heaven, shouting:
“Hallelujah!
Salvation and glory and power belong to our God!
chapters.zh: 此后，我听见好像群众在天上大声说： 哈利路亚〔注：就是要赞美耶和华的意思〕！ 救恩、荣耀、权能都属乎我们的上帝！

chapters.en: For His judgments are true and just. He has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her immorality. He has avenged the blood of His servants that was poured out by her hand.”
chapters.zh: 他的判断是真实公义的； 因他判断了那用淫行败坏世界的大淫妇， 并且向淫妇讨流仆人血的罪， 给他们伸冤。

chapters.en:
And a second time they called out:
“Hallelujah!
Her smoke rises forever and ever.”
chapters.zh: 又说： 哈利路亚！ 烧淫妇的烟往上冒， 直到永永远远。

chapters.en:
And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying:
“Amen, Hallelujah!”
chapters.zh: 那二十四位长老与四活物就俯伏敬拜坐宝座的上帝，说： 阿们！哈利路亚！

chapters.en:
Then a voice came from the throne, saying:
“Praise our God, all you who serve Him, and those who fear Him, small and great alike!”
chapters.zh: 有声音从宝座出来说： 上帝的众仆人哪， 凡敬畏他的，无论大小， 都要赞美我们的上帝！

chapters.en:
And I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude, like the rushing of many waters, and like a mighty rumbling of thunder, crying out:
“Hallelujah!
For the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.
chapters.zh: 我听见好像群众的声音，众水的声音，大雷的声音，说： 哈利路亚！ 因为主－我们的上帝、 全能者作王了。

chapters.en:
Let us rejoice and be glad
and give Him the glory. For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His bride has made herself ready.
chapters.zh: 我们要欢喜快乐， 将荣耀归给他。 因为，羔羊婚娶的时候到了； 新妇也自己预备好了，

chapters.en:
She was given clothing of fine linen, bright and pure.”
For the fine linen she wears is the righteous acts of the saints.
chapters.zh: 就蒙恩得穿光明洁白的细麻衣。 （这细麻衣就是圣徒所行的义。）

chapters.en: Then the angel told me to write, “Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.” And he said to me, “These are the true words of God.”
chapters.zh: 天使吩咐我说：「你要写上：凡被请赴羔羊之婚筵的有福了！」又对我说：「这是上帝真实的话。」

chapters.en: So I fell at his feet to worship him. But he told me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers who rely on the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.”
chapters.zh: 我就俯伏在他脚前要拜他。他说：「千万不可！我和你，并你那些为耶稣作见证的弟兄同是作仆人的，你要敬拜上帝。」因为预言中的灵意乃是为耶稣作见证。

chapters.en: Then I saw heaven standing open, and there before me was a white horse. And its rider is called Faithful and True. With righteousness He judges and wages war.
chapters.zh: 我观看，见天开了。有一匹白马，骑在马上的称为诚信真实，他审判，争战，都按着公义。

chapters.en: He has eyes like blazing fire, and many royal crowns on His head. He has a name written on Him that only He Himself knows.
chapters.zh: 他的眼睛如火焰，他头上戴着许多冠冕；又有写着的名字，除了他自己没有人知道。

chapters.en: He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and His name is The Word of God.
chapters.zh: 他穿着溅了血的衣服；他的名称为上帝之道。

chapters.en: The armies of heaven, dressed in fine linen, white and pure, follow Him on white horses.
chapters.zh: 在天上的众军骑着白马，穿着细麻衣，又白又洁，跟随他。

chapters.en: And from His mouth proceeds a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations, and He will rule them with an iron scepter. He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.
chapters.zh: 有利剑从他口中出来，可以击杀列国。他必用铁杖辖管〔注：辖管：原文是牧〕他们，并要踹全能上帝烈怒的酒醡。

chapters.en:
And He has a name written on His robe and on His thigh:
KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
chapters.zh: 在他衣服和大腿上有名写着说：「万王之王，万主之主。」

chapters.en: Then I saw an angel standing in the sun, and he cried out in a loud voice to all the birds flying overhead, “Come, gather together for the great supper of God,
chapters.zh: 我又看见一位天使站在日头中，向天空所飞的鸟大声喊着说：「你们聚集来赴上帝的大筵席，

chapters.en: so that you may eat the flesh of kings and commanders and mighty men, of horses and riders, of everyone slave and free, small and great.”
chapters.zh: 可以吃君王与将军的肉，壮士与马和骑马者的肉，并一切自主的为奴的，以及大小人民的肉。」

chapters.en: Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth with their armies assembled to wage war against the One seated on the horse, and against His army.
chapters.zh: 我看见那兽和地上的君王，并他们的众军都聚集，要与骑〔白〕马的并他的军兵争战。

chapters.en: But the beast was captured along with the false prophet, who on its behalf had performed signs deceiving those who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image. Both the beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur.
chapters.zh: 那兽被擒拿；那在兽面前曾行奇事、迷惑受兽印记和拜兽像之人的假先知，也与兽同被擒拿。他们两个就活活地被扔在烧着硫磺的火湖里；

chapters.en:
And the rest were killed with the sword that proceeded from the mouth of the One seated on the horse.
And all the birds gorged themselves on their flesh.
chapters.zh: 其余的被骑〔白〕马者口中出来的剑杀了；飞鸟都吃饱了他们的肉。

chapters.en: Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven with the key to the Abyss, holding in his hand a great chain.
chapters.zh: 我又看见一位天使从天降下，手里拿着无底坑的钥匙和一条大鍊子。

chapters.en: He seized the dragon, that ancient serpent who is the devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.
chapters.zh: 他捉住那龙，就是古蛇，又叫魔鬼，也叫撒但，把牠捆绑一千年，

chapters.en: And he threw him into the Abyss, shut it, and sealed it over him, so that he could not deceive the nations until the thousand years were complete. After that, he must be released for a brief period of time.
chapters.zh: 扔在无底坑里，将无底坑关闭，用印封上，使牠不得再迷惑列国。等到那一千年完了，以后必须暂时释放牠。

chapters.en: Then I saw the thrones, and those seated on them had been given authority to judge. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for their testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and those who had not worshiped the beast or its image and had not received its mark on their foreheads or hands. And they came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
chapters.zh: 我又看见几个宝座，也有坐在上面的，并有审判的权柄赐给他们。我又看见那些因为给耶稣作见证，并为上帝之道被斩者的灵魂，和那没有拜过兽与兽像，也没有在额上和手上受过他印记之人的灵魂，他们都复活了，与基督一同作王一千年。

chapters.en: The rest of the dead did not come back to life until the thousand years were complete. This is the first resurrection.
chapters.zh: 这是头一次的复活。（其余的死人还没有复活，直等那一千年完了。）

chapters.en: Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection! The second death has no power over them, but they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with Him for a thousand years.
chapters.zh: 在头一次复活有分的有福了，圣洁了！第二次的死在他们身上没有权柄。他们必作上帝和基督的祭司，并要与基督一同作王一千年。

chapters.en: When the thousand years are complete, Satan will be released from his prison,
chapters.zh: 那一千年完了，撒但必从监牢里被释放，

chapters.en: and will go out to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth—Gog and Magog—to assemble them for battle. Their number is like the sand of the seashore.
chapters.zh: 出来要迷惑地上四方〔注：原文是角〕的列国，就是歌革和玛各，叫他们聚集争战。他们的人数多如海沙。

chapters.en: And they marched across the broad expanse of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. But fire came down from heaven and consumed them.
chapters.zh: 他们上来遍满了全地，围住圣徒的营与蒙爱的城，就有火从天降下，烧灭了他们。

chapters.en: And the devil who had deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, into which the beast and the false prophet had already been thrown. There they will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
chapters.zh: 那迷惑他们的魔鬼被扔在硫磺的火湖里，就是兽和假先知所在的地方。他们必昼夜受痛苦，直到永永远远。

chapters.en: Then I saw a great white throne and the One seated on it. Earth and heaven fled from His presence, and no place was found for them.
chapters.zh: 我又看见一个白色的大宝座与坐在上面的；从他面前天地都逃避，再无可见之处了。

chapters.en:
And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne.
And books were opened, and one of them was the Book of Life. And the dead were judged according to their deeds, as recorded in the books.
chapters.zh: 我又看见死了的人，无论大小，都站在宝座前。案卷展开了，并且另有一卷展开，就是生命册。死了的人都凭着这些案卷所记载的，照他们所行的受审判。

chapters.en: The sea gave up its dead, and Death and Hades gave up their dead, and each one was judged according to his deeds.
chapters.zh: 于是海交出其中的死人；死亡和阴间也交出其中的死人；他们都照各人所行的受审判。

chapters.en: Then Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death—the lake of fire.
chapters.zh: 死亡和阴间也被扔在火湖里；这火湖就是第二次的死。

chapters.en: And if anyone was found whose name was not written in the Book of Life, he was thrown into the lake of fire.
chapters.zh: 若有人名字没记在生命册上，他就被扔在火湖里。

chapters.en: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and earth had passed away, and the sea was no more.
chapters.zh: 我又看见一个新天新地；因为先前的天地已经过去了，海也不再有了。

chapters.en: I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
chapters.zh: 我又看见圣城新耶路撒冷由上帝那里从天而降，预备好了，就如新妇妆饰整齐，等候丈夫。

chapters.en:
And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying:
“Behold, the dwelling place of God is with man, and He will dwell with them. They will be His people, and God Himself will be with them as their God.
chapters.zh: 我听见有大声音从宝座出来说：「看哪，上帝的帐幕在人间。他要与人同住，他们要作他的子民。上帝要亲自与他们同在，作他们的上帝。

chapters.en: ‘He will wipe away every tear from their eyes,’ and there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the former things have passed away.”
chapters.zh: 上帝要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛，因为以前的事都过去了。」

chapters.en: And the One seated on the throne said, “Behold, I make all things new.” Then He said, “Write this down, for these words are faithful and true.”
chapters.zh: 坐宝座的说：「看哪，我将一切都更新了！」又说：「你要写上；因这些话是可信的，是真实的。」

chapters.en: And He told me, “It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To the thirsty I will give freely from the spring of the water of life.
chapters.zh: 他又对我说：「都成了！我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛；我是初，我是终。我要将生命泉的水白白赐给那口渴的人喝。

chapters.en: The one who overcomes will inherit all things, and I will be his God, and he will be My son.
chapters.zh: 得胜的，必承受这些为业：我要作他的上帝，他要作我的儿子。

chapters.en: But to the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. This is the second death.”
chapters.zh: 惟有胆怯的、不信的、可憎的、杀人的、淫乱的、行邪术的、拜偶像的，和一切说谎话的，他们的分就在烧着硫磺的火湖里；这是第二次的死。」

chapters.en: Then one of the seven angels with the seven bowls full of the seven final plagues came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.”
chapters.zh: 拿着七个金碗、盛满末后七灾的七位天使中，有一位来对我说：「你到这里来，我要将新妇，就是羔羊的妻，指给你看。」

chapters.en: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a mountain great and high, and showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down out of heaven from God,
chapters.zh: 我被〔圣〕灵感动，天使就带我到一座高大的山，将那由上帝那里、从天而降的圣城耶路撒冷指示我。

chapters.en: shining with the glory of God. Its radiance was like a most precious jewel, like a jasper, as clear as crystal.
chapters.zh: 城中有上帝的荣耀；城的光辉如同极贵的宝石，好像碧玉，明如水晶。

chapters.en: The city had a great and high wall with twelve gates inscribed with the names of the twelve tribes of Israel, and twelve angels at the gates.
chapters.zh: 有高大的墙，有十二个门，门上有十二位天使，门上又写着以色列十二个支派的名字。

chapters.en: There were three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south, and three on the west.
chapters.zh: 东边有三门，北边有三门，南边有三门，西边有三门。

chapters.en: The wall of the city had twelve foundations bearing the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
chapters.zh: 城墙有十二根基，根基上有羔羊十二使徒的名字。

chapters.en: The angel who spoke with me had a golden measuring rod to measure the city and its gates and walls.
chapters.zh: 对我说话的，拿着金苇子当尺，要量那城和城门城墙。

chapters.en: The city lies foursquare, with its width the same as its length. And he measured the city with the rod, and all its dimensions were equal—12,000 stadia in length and width and height.
chapters.zh: 城是四方的，长宽一样。天使用苇子量那城，共有四千里，长、宽、高都是一样；

chapters.en: And he measured its wall to be 144 cubits, by the human measure the angel was using.
chapters.zh: 又量了城墙，按着人的尺寸，就是天使的尺寸，共有一百四十四肘。

chapters.en: The wall was made of jasper, and the city itself of pure gold, as pure as glass.
chapters.zh: 墙是碧玉造的；城是精金的，如同明净的玻璃。

chapters.en:
The foundations of the city walls were adorned with every kind of precious stone:
The first foundation was jasper,
the second sapphire,
the third chalcedony,
the fourth emerald,
chapters.zh: 城墙的根基是用各样宝石修饰的：第一根基是碧玉；第二是蓝宝石；第三是绿玛瑙；第四是绿宝石；

chapters.en:
the fifth sardonyx,
the sixth carnelian,
the seventh chrysolite,
the eighth beryl,
the ninth topaz,
the tenth chrysoprase,
the eleventh jacinth,
and the twelfth amethyst.
chapters.zh: 第五是红玛瑙；第六是红宝石；第七是黄璧玺；第八是水苍玉；第九是红璧玺；第十是翡翠；第十一是紫玛瑙；第十二是紫晶。

chapters.en: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls, with each gate consisting of a single pearl. The main street of the city was pure gold, as clear as glass.
chapters.zh: 十二个门是十二颗珍珠，每门是一颗珍珠。城内的街道是精金，好像明透的玻璃。

chapters.en: But I saw no temple in the city, because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.
chapters.zh: 我未见城内有殿，因主上帝－全能者和羔羊为城的殿。

chapters.en: And the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it, because the glory of God illuminates the city, and the Lamb is its lamp.
chapters.zh: 那城内又不用日月光照；因有上帝的荣耀光照，又有羔羊为城的灯。

chapters.en: By its light the nations will walk, and into it the kings of the earth will bring their glory.
chapters.zh: 列国要在城的光里行走；地上的君王必将自己的荣耀归与那城。

chapters.en: Its gates will never be shut at the end of the day, because there will be no night there.
chapters.zh: 城门白昼总不关闭，在那里原没有黑夜。

chapters.en: And into the city will be brought the glory and honor of the nations.
chapters.zh: 人必将列国的荣耀、尊贵归与那城。

chapters.en: But nothing unclean will ever enter it, nor anyone who practices an abomination or a lie, but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s Book of Life.
chapters.zh: 凡不洁净的，并那行可憎与虚谎之事的，总不得进那城；只有名字写在羔羊生命册上的〔才得进去〕。

chapters.en: Then the angel showed me a river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb
chapters.zh: 天使又指示我在城内街道当中一道生命水的河，明亮如水晶，从上帝和羔羊的宝座流出来。

chapters.en: down the middle of the main street of the city. On either side of the river stood a tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruit and yielding a fresh crop for each month. And the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.
chapters.zh: 在河这边与那边有生命树，结十二样〔注：或译：回〕果子，每月都结果子；树上的叶子乃为医治万民。

chapters.en: No longer will there be any curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be within the city, and His servants will worship Him.
chapters.zh: 以后再没有咒诅；在城里有上帝和羔羊的宝座；他的仆人都要事奉他，

chapters.en: They will see His face, and His name will be on their foreheads.
chapters.zh: 也要见他的面。他的名字必写在他们的额上。

chapters.en: There will be no more night in the city, and they will have no need for the light of a lamp or of the sun. For the Lord God will shine on them, and they will reign forever and ever.
chapters.zh: 不再有黑夜；他们也不用灯光、日光，因为主上帝要光照他们。他们要作王，直到永永远远。

chapters.en: Then the angel said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent His angel to show His servants what must soon take place.”
chapters.zh: 天使又对我说：「这些话是真实可信的。主就是众先知被感之灵的上帝，差遣他的使者，将那必要快成的事指示他仆人。」

chapters.en: “Behold, I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of prophecy in this book. ”
chapters.zh: 「看哪，我必快来！凡遵守这书上预言的有福了！」

chapters.en: And I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. And when I had heard and seen them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.
chapters.zh: 这些事是我－约翰所听见、所看见的；我既听见、看见了，就在指示我的天使脚前俯伏要拜他。

chapters.en: But he said to me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God!”
chapters.zh: 他对我说：「千万不可！我与你和你的弟兄众先知，并那些守这书上言语的人，同是作仆人的。你要敬拜上帝。」

chapters.en: Then he told me, “Do not seal up the words of prophecy in this book, because the time is near.
chapters.zh: 他又对我说：「不可封了这书上的预言，因为日期近了。

chapters.en: Let the unrighteous continue to be unrighteous, and the vile continue to be vile; let the righteous continue to practice righteousness, and the holy continue to be holy.”
chapters.zh: 不义的，叫他仍旧不义；污秽的，叫他仍旧污秽；为义的，叫他仍旧为义；圣洁的，叫他仍旧圣洁。」

chapters.en: “Behold, I am coming soon, and My reward is with Me, to give to each one according to what he has done.
chapters.zh: 「看哪，我必快来！赏罚在我，要照各人所行的报应他。

chapters.en: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.”
chapters.zh: 我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛；我是首先的，我是末后的；我是初，我是终。」

chapters.en: Blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city by its gates.
chapters.zh: 那些洗净自己衣服的有福了！可得权柄能到生命树那里，也能从门进城。

chapters.en: But outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
chapters.zh: 城外有那些犬类、行邪术的、淫乱的、杀人的、拜偶像的，并一切喜好说谎言、编造虚谎的。

chapters.en: “I, Jesus, have sent My angel to give you this testimony for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the bright Morning Star.”
chapters.zh: 「我－耶稣差遣我的使者为众教会将这些事向你们证明。我是大卫的根，又是他的后裔。我是明亮的晨星。」

chapters.en: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Let the one who hears say, “Come!” And let the one who is thirsty come, and the one who desires the water of life drink freely.
chapters.zh: 〔圣〕灵和新妇都说：「来！」听见的人也该说：「来！」口渴的人也当来；愿意的，都可以白白取生命的水〔喝〕。

chapters.en: I testify to everyone who hears the words of prophecy in this book: If anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues described in this book.
chapters.zh: 我向一切听见这书上预言的作见证，若有人在这预言上加添什么，上帝必将写在这书上的灾祸加在他身上；

chapters.en: And if anyone takes away from the words of this book of prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of life and the holy city, which are described in this book.
chapters.zh: 这书上的预言，若有人删去什么，上帝必从这书上所写的生命树和圣城删去他的分。

chapters.en: He who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
chapters.zh: 证明这事的说：「是了，我必快来！」阿们！主耶稣啊，我愿你来！

chapters.en:
The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all the saints.
Amen.
chapters.zh: 愿主耶稣的恩惠〔常〕与众圣徒同在。阿们！
